prompt: Provide a list of MRNs for specified list of de-identified IDs
Update Darwin report RON22826 to include 'Summary of Sections' from the surgical reports for the specified list patients.
completion: WITH AC AS (SELECT DISTINCT AC_IRB_NO, AC_MRN AS MRN, STRIP(PT_LAST_NAME)||', '||STRIP(PT_FIRST_NAME) AS NAME FROM IDB.PATIENT JOIN IDB.ACCRUALS AC ON PT_MRN = AC_MRN WHERE AC_IRB_NO IN ('18-431', '18-486') UNION SELECT DISTINCT AC_IRB_NO, AC_MRN AS MRN, STRIP(PT_LAST_NAME)||', '||STRIP(PT_FIRST_NAME) AS NAME FROM IDB.PATIENT JOIN IDB.ACCRUALS AC ON PT_MRN = AC_MRN WHERE AC_IRB_NO IN ('12-245') #PROMPTMANY('MRN', 'String', ' ', ' and AC_MRN in (', '', ')') ) , P1 AS (SELECT DISTINCT "t1"."PT_MRN" AS "MRN", STRIP(PT_LAST_NAME) || ', ' || STRIP(PT_FIRST_NAME) AS "Name", "t2"."PRPT_ACCESSION_NO" AS "Pathology Report", PRPT_REPORT_TYPE, "t3"."PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_DESC" AS "Pathology Report Type", "t4"."DT_DTE" AS "Pathology Procedure Date", "t5"."DT_DTE" AS "Pathology Report Date", POSITION('SUMMARY OF SECTIONS:', UPPER(PRPT_REPORT), CODEUNITS32) AS POS1, UPPER(CASE WHEN LENGTH(PRPT_REPORT) <= 15000 THEN RTRIM(CAST(SUBSTR(PRPT_REPORT, 1, 15000) AS VARCHAR(15000))) ELSE CAST(SUBSTR(PRPT_REPORT, 1, 15000) AS VARCHAR(15000)) END) AS TXT FROM AC LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V" "t1" ON "t1"."PT_MRN" = MRN LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED" "t6" ON "t1"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t6"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V" "t2" ON "t6"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t2"."PRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATH_RPRT_TYPE_LOOKUP" "t3" ON "t2"."PRPT_REPORT_TYPE" = "t3"."PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_CD" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" "t4" ON "t2"."PRPT_PROCEDURE_DATE_ID" = "t4"."DT_DATE_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" "t5" ON "t2"."PRPT_REPORT_DATE_ID" = "t5"."DT_DATE_ID" WHERE 1=1 AND "t2"."PRPT_REPORT" IS NOT NULL AND "t3"."PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_DESC" like '%Surgical Pathology%' AND CONTAINS(PRPT_REPORT, '"SUMMARY OF SECTIONS:"') = 1 ) , P2 AS (SELECT DISTINCT "MRN", "Name", "Pathology Report", PRPT_REPORT_TYPE, "Pathology Report Type", "Pathology Procedure Date", "Pathology Report Date", REPLACE(SUBSTRING(CAST(UPPER(TXT) AS VARCHAR(32000)), POS1, 10000, CODEUNITS32), ' ', '') AS TMP, POS1, TXT FROM P1) , P3 AS (SELECT DISTINCT "MRN", "Name", "Pathology Report", PRPT_REPORT_TYPE, "Pathology Report Type", "Pathology Procedure Date", "Pathology Report Date", TXT, POS1, TMP, POSITION('------', TMP, CODEUNITS32) AS POS2 FROM P2) SELECT "MRN", "Name", "Pathology Report", PRPT_REPORT_TYPE, "Pathology Report Type", "Pathology Procedure Date", "Pathology Report Date", TXT, POS1, TMP, POS2, REPLACE(SUBSTRING(CAST(UPPER(TMP) AS VARCHAR(32000)), 1, CASE WHEN POS2 = 0 THEN 10000 ELSE POS2 END, CODEUNITS32), ' ', '') AS "Summary of Sections:" FROM P3

prompt: Amendment to RON27303 - updating visit types and departments
completion: SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN "MRN", PT_LAST_NAME "Last Name", PT_FIRST_NAME "First Name", A.CRE_RES_NAME "Resource", B.CRE_RES_NAME "Referring Provider", CLD_CLD_CENTER "Location", CPE_ENC_DTE "Appt Date", TIME(CPE_APPT_DT) AS "Appt Time", CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME "Visit Type", OOC_ITEM_DESC "Order", OSTS_STS_DESC "Order Status" FROM IDB.PATIENT JOIN IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER ON PT_MRN = CPE_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE A ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = A.CRE_RES_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE B ON CPE_REF_RES_ID = B.CRE_RES_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_ORDER ON OO_MRN = PT_MRN AND OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID = '9000006089100730' LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_STATUS ON OO_ORD_STS_CD = OSTS_ORD_STS_CD LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_CATALOG ON OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID = OOC_MSTR_ITEM_GUID WHERE PT_SEX = 'F' AND YEAR(CPE_ENC_DTE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) BETWEEN 11 AND 51 AND CPE_CPE_APPT_STS = 'Sch' AND CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID IN ('5108', '5110', '5111', '5112', '5113', '5103', '5104', '5105', '5106', '5107', '6650', '6648', '11472', '6649', '6653', '11879', '6651', '11470', '6652', '11458', '11459', '11460', '11461', '11463', '11464', '11465', '11570', '11571', '11564', '11565', '11567', '11568', '11569', '11468', '11469', '6647', '11477') AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT DATE + 1 DAY AND CURRENT date + 7 DAYS AND CLD_DEPT_ID IN ('372', '374', '824')

prompt: Schedule a weekly list of patients diagnosed with small cell lung cancer and neuroendocrine carcinoma presenting to clinic in the next two weeks.
completion: SELECT STRIP(TM_MRN) AS MRN, STRIP(PT_LAST_NAME) AS "Last Name", STRIP(PT_FIRST_NAME) AS "First Name", PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH AS DOB, TM_DX_DTE AS "Dx Date", STRIP(TM_SITE_CD) AS "ICD-O Site Code", S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS "ICD-O Site Description", STRIP(TM_HIST_CD) AS "ICD-O Histology Code", H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS "ICD-O Histology Description", MAX(CASE WHEN AC_IRB_NO = '06-107' THEN AC_CONS_DTE ELSE NULL END) AS "06-107 Consent Date", MAX(CASE WHEN AC_IRB_NO = '12-245' THEN AC_CONS_DTE ELSE NULL END) AS "12-245 Consent Date", CPE_ENC_DTE AS "Scheduled Appt Date", STRIP(CLD_DEPT_NAME) AS "Appt Location", STRIP(CRE_RES_NAME) AS "Attending" FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON TM_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.SEERGROUPING ON RECODE = IDB.SEERF_ICDO(TM_SITE_CD, TM_HIST_CD) JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD LEFT JOIN IDB.ACCRUALS ON PT_MRN = AC_MRN AND AC_IRB_NO IN ('06-107', '12-245') JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN, CPE_ENC_DTE, CRE_RES_NAME, CRE_RES_TYP, CLD_DEPT_NAME, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8, CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Sch') AND CRE_RES_TYP IN ('Physician') AND CLD_DEPT_NAME LIKE '%ST%THR%' AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT DATE + 7 DAYS AND CURRENT DATE + 20 DAYS) SCH ON TM_MRN = CPE_MRN WHERE 1=1 AND TM_CASE_STS IN ('3', '6', '7', '8') AND CATEGORY2 = 'Lung and Bronchus' AND TM_HIST_CD IN ('M8013/3', 'M8246/3', 'M8574/3', 'M8002/3', 'M8041/3', 'M8043/3', 'M8044/3', 'M8045/3', 'M8073/3', 'M8803/3') GROUP BY TM_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, TM_DX_DTE, TM_SITE_CD, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK, TM_HIST_CD, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK, CPE_ENC_DTE, CLD_DEPT_NAME, CRE_RES_NAME, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8

prompt: Provide a daily report of CSF samples that have resulted for MSK-IMPACT for clinical and research use
completion: WITH DEID AS (SELECT DISTINCT PDRX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID AS P_ID FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML INNER JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML_SETTINGS ON PDRX_PATH_DMP_RESULTS_XML_ID = PDRXS_PATH_DMP_RESULTS_XML_ID INNER JOIN DVDMC.PATHOLOGY_DMP_WEBSVC_SETTINGS ON PDRXS_SETTING_ID = PDWS_SETTING_ID INNER JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON PDRX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID, XMLTABLE('$c/root/meta-data' PASSING PDRX_XML_VALUE AS "c" COLUMNS TUMOR_TYPE_CODE VARCHAR(100) PATH 'tumor_type_code', TUMOR_TYPE_NAME VARCHAR(255) PATH 'tumor_type_name', IS_METASTASIS VARCHAR(10) PATH 'is_metastasis', PRIMARY_SITE VARCHAR(255) PATH 'primary_site', METASTASIS_SITE VARCHAR(255) PATH 'metastasis_site', PART_DESCRIPTION VARCHAR(2000) PATH 'part_description') T WHERE UPPER(PART_DESCRIPTION) like '%CEREBROSPINAL%' AND PDWS_NAME = 'IMPACT' )

prompt: I have a list of MRNs, I want to know which patients have undergone IMPACT testing. I also want to know of their IMPACT sample and patient ID.
Provide a twice a month list of IMPACT sample IDs for a given list of patients under study protocol.
completion: SELECT DISTINCT STRIP("t1"."PT_MRN") AS "MRN", STRIP("t2"."PRPT_ACCESSION_NO") AS "Pathology Report", "t3"."DT_DTE" AS "Pathology Procedure Date", "t4"."DT_DTE" AS "Pathology Report Date", STRIP("t5"."PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_DESC") AS "Pathology Report Type", UPPER(CASE WHEN LENGTH(PRPT_REPORT) <= 15000 THEN RTRIM(CAST(SUBSTR(PRPT_REPORT, 1, 15000) AS VARCHAR(15000))) ELSE CAST(SUBSTR(PRPT_REPORT, 1, 15000) AS VARCHAR(15000)) END) AS TXT FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V" "t1" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED" "t6" ON "t1"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t6"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V" "t2" ON "t6"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t2"."PRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" "t3" ON "t2"."PRPT_PROCEDURE_DATE_ID" = "t3"."DT_DATE_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" "t4" ON "t2"."PRPT_REPORT_DATE_ID" = "t4"."DT_DATE_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATH_RPRT_TYPE_LOOKUP" "t5" ON "t2"."PRPT_REPORT_TYPE" = "t5"."PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_CD" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_IDENTIFICATION_MRN_V" "t7" ON "t1"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t7"."PI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" WHERE (("t7"."PI_SOURCE_SYSTEM_PT_ID" IN () AND CONTAINS("t2"."PRPT_REPORT", '("high grade" AND "background" AND "low grade" AND "bladder")') = 1) AND "t2"."PRPT_REPORT" IS NOT NULL ) SELECT DISTINCT STRIP(PT_MRN) AS DX_MRN, PDRX_ACCESSION_NO, PDRX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID, DV.TODATE(DT_PROCEDURE) AS "Procedure Date", T.* FROM DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML DT ON PDRX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID CROSS JOIN XMLTABLE('$c/root/*' PASSING DT.PDRX_XML_VALUE AS "c" COLUMNS SAMPLEID VARCHAR(100) PATH '../meta-data/dmp_sample_id', PATIENTID VARCHAR(100) PATH '../meta-data/dmp_patient_id', TUMOR_TYPE_CODE VARCHAR(100) PATH '../meta-data/tumor_type_code', TUMOR_TYPE_NAME VARCHAR(255) PATH '../meta-data/tumor_type_name', IS_METASTASIS VARCHAR(10) PATH '../meta-data/is_metastasis', PRIMARY_SITE VARCHAR(255) PATH '../meta-data/primary_site', METASTASIS_SITE VARCHAR(255) PATH '../meta-data/metastasis_site', DT_PROCEDURE VARCHAR(40) PATH '../meta-data/dt_procedure') T WHERE LOWER(PRIMARY_SITE) like '%bladder%' AND LOWER(PRIMARY_SITE) not like '%gall%' AND PT_MRN IN ()

prompt: Breast Cancer patient diagnosed in the last 3 months who did not have any hormonal therapy.
completion: WITH CHEMO AS (SELECT DISTINCT APR_MRN FROM IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX_V WHERE CDG_HORMONE_FLAG = 'Y' ) , DX AS (SELECT CC_MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS DX_DTE FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE SUBSTR(CC_CLSF_CD, 1, 3) IN ('C50') AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND (CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) AND CC_MRN NOT IN (SELECT * FROM CHEMO) GROUP BY CC_MRN HAVING MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) BETWEEN CURRENT DATE - 90 DAYS AND CURRENT DATE) SELECT RRPT_MRN "MRN", PT_LAST_NAME "Last Name", PT_FIRST_NAME "First Name", PT_BIRTH_DTE "Date of Birth", DX_DTE "Diagnosis Date", RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE, RRPT_ORDER_GROUP, RRPT_PROCEDURE_NAME, RRPT_REPORT_TXT FROM DV.RADIOLOGY_REPORT_V JOIN DX ON RRPT_MRN = CC_MRN JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON RRPT_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE RRPT_ORDER_GROUP IN ('CT', 'MR', 'NM', 'PET CT for Cancer') AND PT_DEATH_DTE IS NULL

prompt: Schedule a monthly report of surgical procedures, opioids prescribed and quantity remaining, for procedures performed by the specified list of Urology physicians.
completion: WITH THR AS (SELECT DISTINCT STRIP(SSE_MRN) AS SSE_MRN, SSE_LOG_ID, SSE_SURG_DTE, STRIP(SSP_SURG_LAST_NM) || ', ' || STRIP(SSP_SURG_FIRST_NM) AS SURGEON, STRIP(SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD) AS SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD, STRIP(SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC) AS SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC FROM IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE ON SSE_LOG_ID = SSP_LOG_ID WHERE 1=1 AND SSE_SURG_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT DATE - (DAY(CURRENT DATE) - 1) DAYS - 1 MONTH AND CURRENT DATE - (DAY(CURRENT DATE)) DAYS AND STRIP(SSP_SURG_LAST_NM) || ', ' || STRIP(SSP_SURG_FIRST_NM) IN ('BOCHNER, BERNARD', 'CARVER, BRETT S', 'CHA, EUGENE K', 'CHEUNG, FELIX', 'COLEMAN, JONATHAN A', 'DALBAGNI, GUIDO', 'DONAHUE, TIMOTHY FRANCIS', 'EASTHAM, JAMES', 'EHDAIE, BEHFAR', 'FAINBERG, JONATHAN S.', 'GOH, ALVIN CHUN CHIN', 'HAKIMI, ABRAHAM', 'LAUDONE, VINCENT P', 'MATULEWICZ, RICHARD STEVEN', 'PIETZAK, EUGENE', 'RUSSO, PAUL', 'SANDHU, JASPREET S.', 'SHEINFELD, JOEL', 'SMITH, ROBERT CHARLES', 'TOUIJER, KARIM A') ) , EF1 AS (SELECT DISTINCT SSE_MRN AS MRN, SSE_LOG_ID, EF_FORM_ID, STRIP(EF_FORM_NAME) AS EF_FORM_NAME, EF_FORM_ALIAS, DATE(EF_SUBMISSION_DT) AS EF_SUBMISSION_DTE, EFI_ITEM_TEXT, STRIP(LEFT(EFI_VALUE, 2000)) AS EFI_VALUE FROM THR LEFT JOIN IDB.EF_FORM ON SSE_MRN = EF_MRN AND DATE(EF_SUBMISSION_DT) BETWEEN SSE_SURG_DTE + 7 DAYS AND SSE_SURG_DTE + 10 DAYS AND DATE(EF_SUBMISSION_DT) >= SSE_SURG_DTE AND EF_FORM_NAME IN ('Recovery Tracker After Your Hospital Stay', 'Opioid Use After Discharge') LEFT JOIN IDB.EF_FORM_ITEM ON EFI_FORM_ID = EF_FORM_ID AND EFI_ITEM_TEXT IN ('Do you take opioids (narcotics) for chronic pain?', 'Which opioid medicine were you prescribed when you were discharged?', 'In total, how many do you have left? Include your initial prescription and any refills.', 'Which other pain medications did you take?', 'How much did the medicine help your pain?', 'Which other methods did you use to relieve your pain?', 'Which other method did you use to relive your pain?', 'How much did the method help your pain?', 'Which pain medication or other method used for surgical pain provided the best pain relief for you?')) , EF2 AS (SELECT MRN AS EF_MRN, SSE_LOG_ID AS LOG_ID, EF_FORM_ID, EF_SUBMISSION_DTE, MAX(CASE WHEN EFI_ITEM_TEXT = 'Do you take opioids (narcotics) for chronic pain?' THEN EFI_VALUE END) AS "Do you take opioids (narcotics) for chronic pain?", MAX(CASE WHEN EFI_ITEM_TEXT = 'Which opioid medicine were you prescribed when you were discharged?' THEN EFI_VALUE END) AS "Which opioid medicine were you prescribed when you were discharged?", MAX(CASE WHEN EFI_ITEM_TEXT = 'In total, how many do you have left? Include your initial prescription and any refills.' THEN EFI_VALUE END) AS "In total, how many do you have left? Include your initial prescription and any refills.", MAX(CASE WHEN EFI_ITEM_TEXT = 'Which other pain medications did you take?' THEN EFI_VALUE END) AS "Which other pain medications did you take?", MAX(CASE WHEN EFI_ITEM_TEXT = 'How much did the medicine help your pain?' THEN EFI_VALUE END) AS "How much did the medicine help your pain?", MAX(CASE WHEN EFI_ITEM_TEXT = 'Which other methods did you use to relieve your pain?' THEN EFI_VALUE END) AS "Which other methods did you use to relieve your pain?", MAX(CASE WHEN EFI_ITEM_TEXT = 'Which other method did you use to relive your pain?' THEN EFI_VALUE END) AS "Which other method did you use to relive your pain?", MAX(CASE WHEN EFI_ITEM_TEXT = 'How much did the method help your pain?' THEN EFI_VALUE END) AS "How much did the method help your pain?", MAX(CASE WHEN EFI_ITEM_TEXT = 'Which pain medication or other method used for surgical pain provided the best pain relief for you?' THEN EFI_VALUE END) AS "Which pain medication or other method used for surgical pain provided the best pain relief for you?" FROM EF1 GROUP BY MRN, SSE_LOG_ID, EF_FORM_ID, EF_SUBMISSION_DTE) , X AS (SELECT DISTINCT THR.*, EF_SUBMISSION_DTE, "Which opioid medicine were you prescribed when you were discharged?", "In total, how many do you have left? Include your initial prescription and any refills." FROM THR JOIN EF2 ON SSE_MRN = EF_MRN AND SSE_LOG_ID = EF2.LOG_ID) SELECT * FROM X WHERE "Which opioid medicine were you prescribed when you were discharged?" <> '' OR "In total, how many do you have left? Include your initial prescription and any refills." <> ''

prompt: We want to extract baseline clinical features for a list of patients who are on enfortumab vedotin.
completion: WITH BASE AS (SELECT APR_MRN , MIN(APR_START_DTE) FIRST_ADMIN FROM IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX_V WHERE CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME = 'ENFORTUMAB VEDOTIN' GROUP BY APR_MRN HAVING MIN(APR_START_DTE) <= '2020-08-14') , PTS AS (SELECT PT_MRN , PT_BIRTH_DTE , PT_SEX , FIRST_ADMIN FROM DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS JOIN BASE ON PT_MRN = APR_MRN) , PMH AS (SELECT * FROM (SELECT PMH_MRN, PMH_MEASURE_DTE, PMH_WT_KG, PMH_HT_CM, ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY PMH_MRN ORDER BY PMH_MEASURE_DTE DESC) AS RN FROM IDB.PT_MEASURES_HX JOIN PTS ON PMH_MRN = PT_MRN AND PMH_MEASURE_DTE <= FIRST_ADMIN) A WHERE RN = 1 ) , LABS AS (SELECT LR_MRN , LAB_IND_1ST_ADM , MIN(CASE WHEN LR_SUBTEST_NAME = 'HGB' THEN LR_RESULT_VALUE END) HGB , MIN(CASE WHEN LR_SUBTEST_NAME = 'HGB' THEN LR_PERFORMED_DTE END) HGB_DTE , MIN(CASE WHEN LR_SUBTEST_NAME = 'Albumin' THEN LR_RESULT_VALUE END) ALBUMIN , MIN(CASE WHEN LR_SUBTEST_NAME = 'Albumin' THEN LR_PERFORMED_DTE END) ALBUMIN_DTE , MIN(CASE WHEN LR_SUBTEST_NAME = 'Abs Neut' THEN LR_RESULT_VALUE END) ABS_NEUT , MIN(CASE WHEN LR_SUBTEST_NAME = 'Abs Neut' THEN LR_PERFORMED_DTE END) ABS_NEUT_DTE , MIN(CASE WHEN LR_SUBTEST_NAME = 'Abs Lymph' THEN LR_RESULT_VALUE END) ABS_LYMPH , MIN(CASE WHEN LR_SUBTEST_NAME = 'Abs Lymph' THEN LR_PERFORMED_DTE END) ABS_LYMPH_DTE , MIN(CASE WHEN LR_SUBTEST_NAME = 'Abs Eos' THEN LR_RESULT_VALUE END) ABS_EOS , MIN(CASE WHEN LR_SUBTEST_NAME = 'Abs Eos' THEN LR_PERFORMED_DTE END) ABS_EOS_DTE , MIN(CASE WHEN LR_SUBTEST_NAME = 'Creatinine' THEN LR_RESULT_VALUE END) CREATININE , MIN(CASE WHEN LR_SUBTEST_NAME = 'Creatinine' THEN LR_PERFORMED_DTE END) CREATININE_DTE FROM (SELECT LR_MRN, LR_PERFORMED_DT, LR_PERFORMED_DTE, FIRST_ADMIN LAB_IND_1ST_ADM, CASE WHEN LR_SUBTEST_NAME = 'HGB' THEN LR_SUBTEST_NAME WHEN LR_SUBTEST_NAME = 'Albumin' THEN LR_SUBTEST_NAME WHEN LR_SUBTEST_NAME = 'Abs Neut' THEN LR_SUBTEST_NAME WHEN LR_SUBTEST_NAME = 'Abs Lymph' THEN LR_SUBTEST_NAME WHEN LR_SUBTEST_NAME = 'Creatinine' THEN LR_SUBTEST_NAME WHEN LR_SUBTEST_NAME IN ('Abs Eos', 'Absolute Eosinophil') THEN 'Abs Eos' END LR_SUBTEST_NAME, LR_RESULT_VALUE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY LR_MRN, CASE WHEN LR_SUBTEST_NAME = 'HGB' THEN LR_SUBTEST_NAME WHEN LR_SUBTEST_NAME = 'Albumin' THEN LR_SUBTEST_NAME WHEN LR_SUBTEST_NAME = 'Abs Neut' THEN LR_SUBTEST_NAME WHEN LR_SUBTEST_NAME = 'Abs Lymph' THEN LR_SUBTEST_NAME WHEN LR_SUBTEST_NAME = 'Creatinine' THEN LR_SUBTEST_NAME WHEN LR_SUBTEST_NAME IN ('Abs Eos', 'Absolute Eosinophil') THEN 'Abs Eos' END ORDER BY LR_PERFORMED_DT DESC) AS RN FROM IDB.LAB_RESULTS JOIN PTS ON LR_MRN = PT_MRN AND LR_PERFORMED_DTE <= FIRST_ADMIN WHERE LR_SUBTEST_NAME IN ('HGB', 'Albumin', 'Abs Neut', 'Abs Lymph', 'Abs Eos', 'Absolute Eosinophil', 'Creatinine') AND LR_RESULT_VALUE <> 'NOT MEASURED' ) A WHERE RN=1 GROUP BY LR_MRN , LAB_IND_1ST_ADM ) , RAD AS (SELECT RRPT_MRN, RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE, RRPT_ORDER_GROUP, RRPT_PROCEDURE_NAME, RRPT_REPORT_TXT FROM DV.RADIOLOGY_REPORT_V JOIN PTS ON RRPT_MRN = PT_MRN AND RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE BETWEEN FIRST_ADMIN - 56 DAY AND FIRST_ADMIN WHERE RRPT_ORDER_GROUP IN ('CT', 'MR') ) , PTH AS (SELECT PRPT_MRN , PRPT_PROCEDURE_DTE , PRPT_REPORT_TYPE_DESC , PRPT_REPORT , TRIM(DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)(?<=dop:) ?\d{1,2}[\/-]\d{1,2}[\/-]\d{1,4}', PRPT_REPORT)) DOP FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V JOIN PTS ON PRPT_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE PRPT_REPORT IS NOT NULL AND PRPT_PROCEDURE_DTE >= FIRST_ADMIN AND PRPT_PROCEDURE_DTE <= '2020-08-14' ) , KPS AS (SELECT * FROM (SELECT CDD_MRN , CDD_AUTHORED_DTE KPS_DTE , CDO_ITEM_NAME KPS_NAME , CDO_VALUE_TEXT KPS_VALUE , ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY CDD_MRN ORDER BY CDD_AUTHORED_DTE DESC) RN FROM IDB.CD_DOCUMENT JOIN PTS ON CDD_MRN = PT_MRN AND CDD_AUTHORED_DTE BETWEEN FIRST_ADMIN - 14 DAY AND FIRST_ADMIN JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION ON CDD_DOC_GUID = CDO_DOC_GUID AND CDD_AUTHORED_DTE = CDO_AUTHORED_DTE AND CDO_VALUE_TEXT <> '' JOIN IDB.OMS_PROVIDER ON CDD_AUTH_PROV_GUID = OP_PVDR_GUID WHERE CDD_CANCEL_IND <> '1' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND <> '1' AND (UPPER(CDO_ITEM_NAME) LIKE '%KARNOFSKY%' OR UPPER(CDO_ITEM_NAME) LIKE '%KPS%') ) A WHERE RN=1 ) SELECT PT_MRN MRN , PT_BIRTH_DTE DOB , PT_SEX SEX , FIRST_ADMIN , RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE RAD_DTE , RRPT_ORDER_GROUP RAD_CRP , RRPT_PROCEDURE_NAME RAD_NAME , RRPT_REPORT_TXT RAD_RPT , PRPT_REPORT_TYPE_DESC PTH_TYPE , DOP , PRPT_REPORT PTH_REPORT , PMH_HT_CM HT_CM , PMH_WT_KG WT_KG , PMH_MEASURE_DTE HT_WT_DTE , HGB , HGB_DTE , ALBUMIN , ALBUMIN_DTE , ABS_NEUT , ABS_NEUT_DTE , ABS_LYMPH , ABS_LYMPH_DTE , ABS_EOS , ABS_EOS_DTE , CREATININE , CREATININE_DTE , KPS_DTE , KPS_NAME , KPS_VALUE FROM PTS JOIN PMH ON PT_MRN = PMH_MRN LEFT JOIN RAD ON PT_MRN = RRPT_MRN AND RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE BETWEEN FIRST_ADMIN - 56 DAY AND FIRST_ADMIN LEFT JOIN PTH ON PT_MRN = PRPT_MRN AND PRPT_PROCEDURE_DTE >= FIRST_ADMIN LEFT JOIN LABS ON PT_MRN = LR_MRN AND FIRST_ADMIN = LAB_IND_1ST_ADM LEFT JOIN KPS ON PT_MRN = CDD_MRN

prompt: Daily summary of OR procedures performed by Radiation Oncology attendings
completion: WITH SRG AS (SELECT LOG_NUMBER, PATIENT_MRN, PATIENT_NAME, PATIENT_AGE, PATIENT_SEX, OL_SURG_DTE SURG_DTE , TOES_IN_TIME_ACTUAL ROOM_IN_DT, TOES_OUT_TIME_ACTUAL ROOM_OUT_DT, LOG_NUMBER_OF_PANELS, LOG_PRIMARY_SERVICE, LOG_PRIMARY_SURGEON, LOG_LOCATION, LOG_CAMPUS FROM IDB.OR_LOG JOIN IDB.PERIOP_CASE_EVENT_V ON PATIENT_MRN = OL_MRN AND LOG_NUMBER = OL_LOG_ID WHERE OL_SURG_DTE BETWEEN (CASE WHEN DAYOFWEEK(CURRENT DATE) = 2 THEN CURRENT DATE - 3 DAY ELSE CURRENT DATE - 1 DAY END) AND CURRENT DATE AND NOT (OL_LOG_STS_CD IN ('4 ', '6 ')) ) , PROCS AS (SELECT OLAP_LOG_ID, OLAP_LINE_NO, OLAP_PNL_NO FROM SRG JOIN IDB.OR_LOG_ALL_PROC ON OLAP_LOG_ID = LOG_NUMBER) , SURGEONS AS (SELECT DISTINCT A.OLAS_LOG_ID, A.OLAS_MRN, OLAS_PNL_NO, A.OLAS_LINE_NO LINE_NO, A.OLAS_SURG_SVC SURG_SVC, A.OLAS_SURG_ROLE SURG_ROLE, CRE_RES_NAME SURGEON_NAME FROM PROCS JOIN IDB.OR_LOG_ALL_SURG A ON OLAP_LOG_ID = A.OLAS_LOG_ID AND OLAP_PNL_NO = A.OLAS_PNL_NO AND A.OLAS_SURG_ROLE = 'Primary' AND A.OLAS_SURG_SVC = 'RAD ONC' JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON OLAS_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID) SELECT LOG_NUMBER, PATIENT_MRN, PATIENT_NAME, SURG_DTE , OLAP_PNL_NO, LOG_NUMBER_OF_PANELS, SURG_SVC, SURGEON_NAME, LOG_LOCATION, LOG_CAMPUS, SURG_ROLE, SURGEON_NAME, (CASE WHEN DAYOFWEEK(CURRENT DATE) = 2 THEN CURRENT DATE - 3 DAY ELSE CURRENT DATE - 1 DAY END) START_DATE, CURRENT date - 1 DAY END_DATE FROM SRG JOIN PROCS ON LOG_NUMBER = OLAP_LOG_ID JOIN SURGEONS ON OLAS_LOG_ID = OLAP_LOG_ID AND OLAS_PNL_NO = OLAP_PNL_NO

prompt: Provide MRN, Date of Surgery, Name of Procedure, for all patients who at surgery in the Head and Neck Service from 2000-2011.
completion: SELECT SSE_MRN, SSE_SURG_DTE, SSE_SURG_LOC , STRIP(PT_LAST_NAME)||', '||STRIP(PT_FIRST_NAME) AS PT_NAME, SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD, SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC , SSP_SURG_LAST_NM , SSP_SURG_FIRST_NM , SSP_SURG_SVC_CD , SSP_PROC_NAME , SSE_LOG_STS FROM IDB.SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT ON SSE_LOG_ID = SSP_LOG_ID JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON SSE_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE SSE_SURG_DTE BETWEEN '2001-01-01' AND '2011-13-31' AND SSP_SURG_SVC_CD = 'HNS' AND SSE_LOG_STS IN ('Posted', 'Unposted')

prompt: List of patients who were seen for surgical consult with and without Geri via Telemed consult that proceeded to OR for surgery.
completion: WITH PTS AS (SELECT * FROM (SELECT DISTINCT OO_MRN, OO_ORD_ID, OOC_ITEM_NAME, OO_ENTER_DTE, OSTS_STS_DESC, OO_REQUESTED_DTE, OUD_USER_DI_CD, OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE, OUD_USER_DI_VALUE FROM IDB.OMS_ORDER JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_CATALOG ON OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID = OOC_MSTR_ITEM_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_STATUS ON OO_ORD_STS_CD = OSTS_ORD_STS_CD LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_USER_DATA ON OUD_ORD_GUID = OO_ORD_GUID AND (OUD_USER_DI_CD IN ('Consult_Geriatric OP Type', 'Consult_Cardio OP Consult Type', 'Consult_Neuro Reason For_OP', 'Consult_Endo OP_Reason', 'Consult_ACM_Service', 'Consult_Medicine OP Type', 'Consult_PsychOP_Reason')) WHERE OOC_ITEM_NAME IN ('Geriatric Outpatient Consult', 'Cardiology Outpatient Consult', 'Endocrine Outpatient Consult', 'General Internal Medicine Outpatient Consult', 'Hematology/ACM Outpatient Consult', 'Adult Neurology Outpatient Consult', 'Psychiatry Outpatient Consult') AND OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE BETWEEN '2020-02-01' AND '2021-02-28' AND OO_ORD_STS_CD NOT IN ('CANP', 'CANC', 'AUC3') ) A WHERE OUD_USER_DI_VALUE IN ('Telemedicine', 'Pre-op Evaluation', 'Pre-operative clearance', 'preoperative evaluation', 'Pre-Operative Evaluation', 'Preoperative Evaluation') ) , PROCEDURES AS (SELECT DISTINCT OC_MRN , OC_CASE_ID , OC_OR_CASE_STS , OC_REC_CR_DTE , OC_SCH_DT , OC_SURG_DTE , LISTAGG('| ' || TRIM(CPX_PROC_CD) || ' - ' || TRIM(CPX_PROC_NAME) || ' |', CHR(13) || CHR(10)) WITHIN GROUP( ORDER BY CPX_PROC_CD) AS PROCEDURE , ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY OC_MRN ORDER BY OC_SURG_DTE ASC) RN FROM (SELECT DISTINCT OC_MRN , OC_CASE_ID , OC_OR_CASE_STS , OC_REC_CR_DTE , OC_SCH_DT , OC_SURG_DTE , CPX_PROC_CD , CPX_PROC_NAME FROM IDB.OR_CASE JOIN PTS ON OO_MRN = OC_MRN JOIN IDB.OR_CASE_ALL_PROC ON OC_CASE_ID = OCAP_CASE_ID JOIN IDB.OR_CASE_ALL_SURG ON OCAP_CASE_ID = OCAS_CASE_ID AND OCAS_PNL_NO = OCAP_PNL_NO AND OCAS_SURG_ROLE = 'Primary' JOIN IDB.OR_PROC ON OCAP_OR_PROC_ID = OP_OR_PROC_ID JOIN IDB.OR_CL_PROC ON OP_OR_PROC_ID = OCP_OR_PROC_ID JOIN IDB.CL_PROC ON OCP_PROC_ID = CPX_PROC_ID JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE R ON R.CRE_RES_ID = OCAS_RES_ID JOIN IDB.DOC ON R.CRE_RES_ID = DOC_DR_NO LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE REF ON REF.CRE_RES_ID = OC_REF_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_LOCATION ON OC_SURG_LOC_ID = LOC_LOC_ID WHERE OC_MRN <> '' AND OC_OR_CASE_STS_CD NOT IN ('2', '5') AND OC_SURG_DTE >= OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE ) A GROUP BY OC_MRN , OC_CASE_ID , OC_OR_CASE_STS , OC_REC_CR_DTE , OC_SCH_DT , OC_SURG_DTE) SELECT DISTINCT OO_MRN "MRN", OO_ORD_ID "Order ID", OOC_ITEM_NAME "Order Name", OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE "Order significant date", OUD_USER_DI_VALUE "Pre-op value", OC_SURG_DTE "Procedure Date", PROCEDURE "Procedure Details" FROM PTS LEFT JOIN PROCEDURES ON OO_MRN = OC_MRN AND RN = 1 ; WITH PST AS (SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN, CPE_ENC_DTE, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8, CLD_DEPT_NAME, CRE_RES_NAME, CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME, CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Comp', 'Arrived') AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 = 'SRG' AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN '2020-02-01' AND '2021-02-28' AND CRE_RES_TYP IN ('Physician') AND CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME IN ('TELEHEALTH IR', 'TELEHEALTH NV', 'TELEHEALTH NV1', 'TELEHEALTH NV2', 'TELEHEALTH NV3', 'TELEHEALTH TRANSFER FX', 'TELEHEALTH POST OP') ) , PROCEDURES AS (SELECT DISTINCT OC_MRN , OC_CASE_ID , OC_OR_CASE_STS , OC_REC_CR_DTE , OC_SCH_DT , OC_SURG_DTE , LISTAGG('| ' || TRIM(CPX_PROC_CD) || ' - ' || TRIM(CPX_PROC_NAME) || ' |', CHR(13) || CHR(10)) WITHIN GROUP( ORDER BY CPX_PROC_CD) AS PROCEDURE , ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY OC_MRN ORDER BY OC_SURG_DTE ASC) RN FROM (SELECT DISTINCT OC_MRN , OC_CASE_ID , OC_OR_CASE_STS , OC_REC_CR_DTE , OC_SCH_DT , OC_SURG_DTE , CPX_PROC_CD , CPX_PROC_NAME FROM IDB.OR_CASE JOIN PST ON CPE_MRN = OC_MRN JOIN IDB.OR_CASE_ALL_PROC ON OC_CASE_ID = OCAP_CASE_ID JOIN IDB.OR_CASE_ALL_SURG ON OCAP_CASE_ID = OCAS_CASE_ID AND OCAS_PNL_NO = OCAP_PNL_NO AND OCAS_SURG_ROLE = 'Primary' JOIN IDB.OR_PROC ON OCAP_OR_PROC_ID = OP_OR_PROC_ID JOIN IDB.OR_CL_PROC ON OP_OR_PROC_ID = OCP_OR_PROC_ID JOIN IDB.CL_PROC ON OCP_PROC_ID = CPX_PROC_ID JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE R ON R.CRE_RES_ID = OCAS_RES_ID JOIN IDB.DOC ON R.CRE_RES_ID = DOC_DR_NO LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE REF ON REF.CRE_RES_ID = OC_REF_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_LOCATION ON OC_SURG_LOC_ID = LOC_LOC_ID WHERE OC_MRN <> '' AND OC_OR_CASE_STS_CD NOT IN ('2', '5') AND OC_SURG_DTE >= CPE_ENC_DTE ) A GROUP BY OC_MRN , OC_CASE_ID , OC_OR_CASE_STS , OC_REC_CR_DTE , OC_SCH_DT , OC_SURG_DTE) SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN "MRN", CPE_ENC_DTE "Appt Date", CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 "Department", CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 "Service", CLD_DEPT_NAME "Department Name", CRE_RES_NAME "Provider", CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME "Visit Type Name", OC_SURG_DTE "Procedure Date", PROCEDURE "Procedure Details" FROM PST LEFT JOIN PROCEDURES ON CPE_MRN = OC_MRN AND RN = 1

prompt: Provide a list of patients with prostate cancer admitted with new cord compression over the past year.
completion: WITH CA AS (SELECT CC_MRN AS DX_MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS DX_DATE, CLM_CLSF_CD AS DX_CODE, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS DX_DESC FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND ((CC_PT_TYPE = 'I')) AND CC_CLSF_CD IN ('C61') GROUP BY CC_MRN, CLM_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK HAVING YEAR(MIN(CC_EFF_DTE)) ='2023' ) SELECT RRPT_MRN, RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE, RRPT_RPT_ID, RRPT_ACCESSION_NO, RRPT_ORDER_GROUP, RRPT_PROCEDURE_NAME, RRPT_REPORT_TXT FROM DV.RADIOLOGY_REPORT_V JOIN CA ON RRPT_MRN = DX_MRN WHERE CONTAINS("RRPT_REPORT_TXT", '("cord compression")') = 1 AND RRPT_ORDER_GROUP = 'MR' AND YEAR(RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE) = '2023' ; WITH CA AS (SELECT CC_MRN AS DX_MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS DX_DATE, CLM_CLSF_CD AS DX_CODE, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS DX_DESC FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND ((CC_PT_TYPE = 'I') OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) AND CC_CLSF_CD IN ('C61') GROUP BY CC_MRN, CLM_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK HAVING YEAR(MIN(CC_EFF_DTE)) ='2023' ) SELECT RRPT_MRN, RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE, RRPT_RPT_ID, RRPT_ACCESSION_NO, RRPT_ORDER_GROUP, RRPT_PROCEDURE_NAME, RRPT_REPORT_TXT FROM DV.RADIOLOGY_REPORT_V JOIN CA ON RRPT_MRN = DX_MRN WHERE CONTAINS("RRPT_REPORT_TXT", '("cord compression")') = 1 AND RRPT_ORDER_GROUP = 'MR' AND YEAR(RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE) = '2023' ;

prompt: External Hospital Transfers coming to MSK in the last two weeks
completion: SELECT VIS_MRN, VIS_HOSP_SVC, VIS_ADM_DT, VIS_DSCH_DT FROM IDB.VISIT WHERE VIS_ADM_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT DATE - 14 DAY AND CURRENT DATE AND VIS_PATIENT_TYPE = 'IP' AND VIS_TREATMENT_PLAN = 'HT' ORDER BY VIS_ADM_DT

prompt: Provide the number of patients who have had a surgery by Dr. Michael La Quaglia for patients diagnosed with neuroblastoma, starting January 1, 1987.
completion: WITH "cte1" AS (SELECT UPPER(MP_FULL_NM) MP_FULL_NM_UPPER, M.* FROM DV.MEDPRO_V M), "cte2" AS (SELECT DXCC_DX_CATALOG_ID, LTRIM(RTRIM(DXCC_ICD_CODE)) DXCC_ICD_CODE, LTRIM(RTRIM(DXCC_ICD_MSK_DESC)) DXCC_ICD_MSK_DESC, LTRIM(RTRIM(DXCC_ICD_CODE)) || ' - ' || LTRIM(RTRIM(DXCC_ICD_MSK_DESC)) AS DXCC_CODE_AND_MSK_DESC, LTRIM(RTRIM(DXCC_ICD_NATIONAL_DESC)) DXCC_ICD_NATIONAL_DESC, DXCC_DESC_LONG, CASE WHEN DXCC_ICD_CODE BETWEEN '196' AND '196.99' OR DXCC_ICD_CODE BETWEEN '197' AND '197.99' OR DXCC_ICD_CODE BETWEEN '198' AND '198.99' THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS DXCC_METS_INDICATOR, DXCC_CREATED_DT, DXCC_CREATED_BY, DXCC_MODIFIED_DT FROM DV.DIAGNOSIS_CATALOG WHERE DXCC_DX_TYPE = 'ICD9' ) SELECT DISTINCT "t1"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AS "Deident PT #", "t2"."MP_FULL_NM_UPPER" AS "CPT Procedure Physician (OR)", "t3"."DT_DTE" AS "CPT Procedure Date (OR)", "t4"."PCC_CODE" AS "CPT Procedure Code (OR)", "t4"."PCC_DESC" AS "CPT Procedure Desc (OR)", "t5"."PT_MRN" AS "MRN" FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED" "t1" LEFT JOIN "DV"."CPT_OR_PATIENT_PROCEDURE" "t4" ON "t1"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t4"."PTX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "cte1" "t2" ON "t4"."PTX_MEDPRO_ID" = "t2"."MP_MEDPRO_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" "t3" ON "t4"."PTX_PROC_DATE_ID" = "t3"."DT_DATE_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V" "t5" ON "t1"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t5"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."CDB_TUMOR_V" "t6" ON "t1"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t6"."CDTM_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DIAGNOSIS_CODE_CAT_ICDO_V" "t7" ON "t6"."CDTM_DX_CATALOG_ID" = "t7"."DXCC_DX_CATALOG_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."TUMOR_CASE_ATTRIBUTES_V" "t8" ON "t6"."CDTM_CASE_ATTR_ID" = "t8"."TUMOR_CASE_ATTR_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" "t9" ON "t6"."CDTM_DX_DATE_ID" = "t9"."DT_DATE_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DIAGNOSIS_FINAL_ALL_V" "t10" ON "t1"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t10"."PDX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "cte2" "t11" ON "t10"."PDX_DX_CATALOG_ID" = "t11"."DXCC_DX_CATALOG_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DIAGNOSIS_FINAL_DATES_V" "t12" ON "t10"."PDX_DX_CATALOG_ID" = "t12"."PDX_DX_CATALOG_ID" AND "t10"."PDX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t12"."PDX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" "t13" ON "t12"."FIRST_DIAGNOSIS_DATE_ID" = "t13"."DT_DATE_ID" WHERE ((("t7"."DXCC_ICD_CODE" IN ('M9490/3', 'M9500/3') AND ("t8"."TCA_CASE_STS_DESC" IN ('Completed', 'Consult only', 'Non-Index tumor', 'Pathology only') AND "t9"."DT_DTE" >= '1987-1-1')) OR ("t11"."DXCC_ICD_CODE" IN ('194.0') AND ("t13"."DT_DTE" >= '1987-1-1' AND (("t10"."DXA_CIC_CDER_INIT" = 'YES' AND "t10"."PDX_INPATIENT_OUTPATIENT_IND" = 'OUTPATIENT') OR "t10"."PDX_INPATIENT_OUTPATIENT_IND" = 'INPATIENT')))) AND UPPER("t2"."MP_FULL_NM_UPPER") IN ('LAQUAGLIA MICHAEL P', 'LAQUAGLIA,', 'LAQUAGLIA, MICHAEL_DUP'))

prompt: Provide list of MRIs and radiation treatment data for cohort of patients provided.
Provide a list of young onset patients seen in the colorectal service between Jan 2018-Oct 2019 with a Nursing Ambulatory Referral Social Work order
completion: WITH ORD AS (SELECT OO_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, CPE_ENC_DTE, CRE_RES_NAME, OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE, OO_ORD_NAME, OO_ORD_STS_CD, PLA_LST_CHEMO_DTE, PLA_LST_RT_DTE FROM IDB.OMS_ORDER JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_USER_DATA ON OO_MRN = OUD_MRN AND OO_ORD_GUID = OUD_ORD_GUID JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON OO_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY ON OO_MRN = PLA_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER ON OO_MRN = CPE_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID WHERE OO_ORD_NAME = 'Nursing Ambulatory Referral Social Work' AND OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE BETWEEN '2018-01-01' AND '2019-10-31' AND OO_ORD_STS_CD NOT IN ('CANP', 'CANC', 'AUC3') AND OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'NSG_Amb_Social_Young' AND OUD_USER_DI_VALUE = 1 AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN '2018-01-01' AND '2019-10-31' AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 = 'SRG' AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 = 'COL' AND CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') ) SELECT OO_MRN "MRN", PT_LAST_NAME "Last Name", PT_FIRST_NAME "First Name", CPE_ENC_DTE "Appt Date", CRE_RES_NAME "Appt Resource", PLA_LST_CHEMO_DTE "Last Chemo Date", PLA_LST_RT_DTE "Last RT Date", TM_DX_DTE "Tumor Dx Date", TM_SITE_CD AS "Tumor Site Code", S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS "Tumor Site Desc", TM_HIST_CD AS "Tumor Hist Code", H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS "Tumor Histology Desc", CATEGORY3 "SEER Category", MAX(CASE WHEN (TRIM(TM_PATH_STG_GRP) NOT IN ('99') AND TRIM(TM_PATH_STG_DSCR) NOT IN ('4', '6')) THEN TRIM(PATH_STG.AV_DESC) ELSE TRIM(CLIN_STG.AV_DESC) END) "Stage" FROM ORD JOIN IDB.CDB_TUMOR ON OO_MRN = TM_MRN JOIN IDB.CLM H ON TM_HIST_CD = H.CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON TM_SITE_CD = S.CLM_CLSF_CD LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS PATH_STG ON PATH_STG.AV_ELEMENT = 'PATH_STG_GRP' AND TM_PATH_STG_GRP = PATH_STG.AV_CODE LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS CLIN_STG ON CLIN_STG.AV_ELEMENT = 'CLIN_STG_GRP' AND TM_CLIN_STG_GRP = CLIN_STG.AV_CODE JOIN IDB.SEERGROUPING ON IDB.SEERF_ICDO(TM_SITE_CD, TM_HIST_CD) = RECODE WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7') AND CATEGORY2 = 'Colon and Rectum' GROUP BY OO_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, CPE_ENC_DTE, CRE_RES_NAME, PLA_LST_CHEMO_DTE, PLA_LST_RT_DTE, TM_DX_DTE, TM_SITE_CD, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK, TM_HIST_CD, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK, CATEGORY3

prompt: Employees who are still covid-positive and why
completion: SELECT EMPLOYEE_ID, LAST_NAME, FIRST_NAME, DATE(MIN_IDENTIFIED_DT) AS MIN_IDENTIFIED_DTE, MIN(CEV_EHS_VISIT_DTE) AS FIRST_EHWS_COVID_VISIT_DATE, MAX(CEV_EHS_VISIT_DTE) AS LAST_EHWS_COVID_VISIT_DATE, LISTAGG(CASE WHEN EMPLOYEE_ID = '' THEN 'No Employee ID' WHEN CEV_EMPLOYEE_ID IS NULL THEN 'No EHWS Visit' WHEN COALESCE(CEV_COVID19_RELATED_FLAG, '') <> 'True' THEN 'Not a COVID-Related Visit' WHEN COALESCE(CEV_DUTY_DISPOSITION, '') <> 'Fit For Full Duty' THEN CEV_DUTY_DISPOSITION WHEN CEV_EHS_VISIT_DTE < DATE(MIN_IDENTIFIED_DT) THEN 'Earlier than Identified Date' END, ', ') WITHIN GROUP ( ORDER BY CEV_EHS_VISIT_DTE) AS REASON_NOT_RESOLVED FROM IDB.COVID19_EMPLOYEE_INFO LEFT JOIN IDB.COVID19_EHS_VISIT ON EMPLOYEE_ID = CEV_EMPLOYEE_ID AND CEV_COVID19_RELATED_FLAG = 'True' JOIN IDB.MSKCC_EMPLOYEE_INFO ON MEI_EMPLOYEE_ID = EMPLOYEE_ID AND MEI_STATUS = 'Active' AND DATE_OF_DEATH IS NULL WHERE RESULT = 'Positive' GROUP BY EMPLOYEE_ID, LAST_NAME, FIRST_NAME, DATE(MIN_IDENTIFIED_DT), CASE WHEN MEI_EMPLOYEE_ID IS NOT NULL THEN 'Y' ELSE '' END ;

prompt: Provide an annual list of IMPACT samples performed on spine tumors and bones outside of the spine.
completion: WITH SRG AS (SELECT DISTINCT SSE_MRN, SSE_SURG_DTE, SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD, SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC, STRIP(SSP_SURG_LAST_NM) || ', ' || STRIP(SSP_SURG_FIRST_NM) AS SURGEON FROM IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE ON SSE_LOG_ID = SSP_LOG_ID WHERE 1=1 AND SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD NOT LIKE '9999%' AND SSE_SURG_DTE BETWEEN '2021-01-01' AND '2021-12-31' AND(STRIP(SSP_SURG_LAST_NM) || ', ' || STRIP(SSP_SURG_FIRST_NM) IN ('BARZILAI, ORI', 'BILSKY, MARK', 'LAUFER, ILYA', 'SANTOS MARTIN, ERNESTO GARCIAN') OR STRIP(SSP_SURG_LAST_NM) || ', ' || STRIP(SSP_SURG_FIRST_NM) LIKE '%LIS%ERIC%') ) , IMPACT AS (SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN, PDRX_ACCESSION_NO, PRPT_PROCEDURE_DTE, PDRX_DMP_PATIENT_ID, PDRX_DMP_SAMPLE_ID, T.* FROM SRG JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON PT_MRN = SSE_MRN JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML DT ON PDRX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML_SETTINGS ON PDRX_PATH_DMP_RESULTS_XML_ID = PDRXS_PATH_DMP_RESULTS_XML_ID JOIN DVDMC.PATHOLOGY_DMP_WEBSVC_SETTINGS ON PDRXS_SETTING_ID = PDWS_SETTING_ID JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V ON PDRX_ACCESSION_NO = PRPT_ACCESSION_NO CROSS JOIN XMLTABLE('$c/root/*' PASSING DT.PDRX_XML_VALUE AS "c" COLUMNS TUMOR_TYPE_NAME VARCHAR(264) PATH '../meta-data/tumor_type_name', TUMOR_TYPE_CODE VARCHAR(100) PATH '../meta-data/tumor_type_code', PRIMARY_SITE VARCHAR(100) PATH '../meta-data/primary_site', IS_METASTASIS VARCHAR(10) PATH '../meta-data/is_metastasis', METASTASIS_SITE VARCHAR(100) PATH '../meta-data/metastasis_site', PART_DESCRIPTION VARCHAR(2000) PATH '../meta-data/part_description') T WHERE 1=1 AND PDWS_NAME like '%IMPACT%' AND NOT (UPPER(PART_DESCRIPTION) not like '%CEREBRO%' AND (UPPER(PART_DESCRIPTION) like '%SPINE%' OR UPPER(PART_DESCRIPTION) like '%SPINAL%' OR UPPER(PART_DESCRIPTION) like '%OCCIPTAL%' OR UPPER(PART_DESCRIPTION) like '%SACRUM%' OR UPPER(PART_DESCRIPTION) like '%EPIDURAL%' OR UPPER(PART_DESCRIPTION) like '%INTRADURAL%' OR UPPER(PART_DESCRIPTION) like '%EXTRAMEDULLARY%' OR UPPER(PART_DESCRIPTION) like '%INTRAMEDULLARY%' OR UPPER(PART_DESCRIPTION) like '%C1%' OR UPPER(PART_DESCRIPTION) like '%C2%' OR UPPER(PART_DESCRIPTION) like '%C3%' OR UPPER(PART_DESCRIPTION) like '%C4%' OR UPPER(PART_DESCRIPTION) like '%C5%' OR UPPER(PART_DESCRIPTION) like '%C6%' OR UPPER(PART_DESCRIPTION) like '%C7%' OR UPPER(PART_DESCRIPTION) like '%C8%' OR UPPER(PART_DESCRIPTION) like '%T1%' OR UPPER(PART_DESCRIPTION) like '%T2%' OR UPPER(PART_DESCRIPTION) like '%T3%' OR UPPER(PART_DESCRIPTION) like '%T4%' OR prompt: Provide a number of patients who possibly obtained a VTE due to surgery by locating patients who have had enoxaparin or treatment dose heparin during their visit.
completion: WITH ORDERS AS (SELECT OO_MRN, OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE, OO_ORD_NAME AS ORDER_NAME, OO_ORD_PRIO AS WHERE_TO_FILL, OMD_DOSE_LOW AS DOSE, OMD_DOSE_UNIT AS DOSE_UNIT, OO_ORD_FREQ AS FREQUENCY, OSTS_STS_DESC AS ORDER_STATUS, OO_SUMMARY_LINE AS SUMMARY_LINE FROM IDB.OMS_ORDER JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_CATALOG ON OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID = OOC_MSTR_ITEM_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_MED_DETAIL ON OMD_ORD_GUID = OO_ORD_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_STATUS ON OO_ORD_STS_CD = OSTS_ORD_STS_CD WHERE (OOC_ITEM_NAME like 'Enoxaparin%' OR OOC_ITEM_NAME like 'heparin%') AND YEAR(OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE) = 2020 AND OO_ORD_STS_CD NOT IN ('CANC', 'CANP', 'AUC3') ) SELECT DISTINCT SSE_MRN, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, PLA_LST_PED_APPT_DTE, YEAR(SSE_SURG_DTE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) AS AGE_AT_SURG_DTE, SSE_SURG_DTE, MIN(CASE WHEN ORDER_NAME like 'Enoxaparin%' THEN OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE ELSE NULL END) AS ENOXAPARIN_DTE, MIN(CASE WHEN ORDER_NAME like 'heparin%' THEN OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE ELSE NULL END) AS HEPARIN_DTE FROM IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE ON SSE_LOG_ID = SSP_LOG_ID AND SSE_ENC_CSN_ID = SSP_ENC_CSN_ID JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON SSE_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY ON SSE_MRN = PLA_MRN JOIN ORDERS ON SSE_MRN = OO_MRN AND OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE BETWEEN SSE_SURG_DTE AND SSE_SURG_DTE + 30 DAY WHERE (SSE_SURG_LOC not like '%IR%' AND SSE_SURG_LOC not like '%ENDO%' AND SSE_SOURCE_TYPE <> 'E') AND YEAR(SSE_SURG_DTE) = 2020 AND PLA_PED_IND = 'Y' GROUP BY SSE_MRN, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, PLA_LST_PED_APPT_DTE, SSE_SURG_DTE, YEAR(SSE_SURG_DTE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) ; WITH ORDERS AS (SELECT OO_MRN, OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE, OO_ORD_NAME AS ORDER_NAME, OO_ORD_PRIO AS WHERE_TO_FILL, OMD_DOSE_LOW AS DOSE, OMD_DOSE_UNIT AS DOSE_UNIT, OO_ORD_FREQ AS FREQUENCY, OSTS_STS_DESC AS ORDER_STATUS, OO_SUMMARY_LINE AS SUMMARY_LINE FROM IDB.OMS_ORDER JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_CATALOG ON OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID = OOC_MSTR_ITEM_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_MED_DETAIL ON OMD_ORD_GUID = OO_ORD_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_STATUS ON OO_ORD_STS_CD = OSTS_ORD_STS_CD WHERE (OOC_ITEM_NAME like 'Enoxaparin%' OR OOC_ITEM_NAME like 'heparin%') AND YEAR(OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE) = 2020 AND OO_ORD_STS_CD NOT IN ('CANC', 'CANP', 'AUC3') ) SELECT DISTINCT SSE_MRN, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, PLA_LST_PED_APPT_DTE, YEAR(SSE_SURG_DTE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) AS AGE_AT_SURG_DTE, SSE_SURG_DTE, ORDERS.* FROM IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE ON SSE_LOG_ID = SSP_LOG_ID AND SSE_ENC_CSN_ID = SSP_ENC_CSN_ID JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON SSE_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY ON SSE_MRN = PLA_MRN JOIN ORDERS ON SSE_MRN = OO_MRN AND OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE BETWEEN SSE_SURG_DTE AND SSE_SURG_DTE + 30 DAY WHERE (SSE_SURG_LOC not like '%IR%' AND SSE_SURG_LOC not like '%ENDO%' AND SSE_SOURCE_TYPE <> 'E') AND YEAR(SSE_SURG_DTE) = 2020 AND PLA_PED_IND = 'Y' ;

completion: WITH CD AS (SELECT DISTINCT CDD_MRN, CDD_DOC_GUID, CDD_SERVICE_DTE, CDD_DOC_NAME, CASE WHEN CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND = '0' THEN 'Complete' WHEN CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND = '1' THEN 'Incomplete' END "Document Status", U1.OU_DISPLAY_NAME AS "Author", U1.OU_OCCUPATION AS "Author Occupation", U1.OU_ORD_ROLE_TYPE AS "Author Role", U2.OU_DISPLAY_NAME AS "Signer", U2.OU_OCCUPATION AS "Signer Occupation", U2.OU_ORD_ROLE_TYPE AS "Signer Role" , CDH_HISTORY_DT "Entered/Signed Date" , CDD_SIGNATURE_STATUS_DESC "Signature Status" FROM IDB.CD_DOCUMENT JOIN IDB.OMS_USER U1 ON CDD_AUTH_PROV_GUID = U1.OU_USER_GUID LEFT JOIN IDB.CD_DOCUMENT_HISTORY ON CDD_DOC_GUID = CDH_CLIENT_DOC_GUID AND CDD_CLIENT_GUID = CDH_CLIENT_GUID LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_USER U2 ON CDH_USER_GUID = U2.OU_USER_GUID WHERE CDD_CANCEL_IND = '0' AND CDD_DOC_NAME like 'Consent Discussion%' AND CDD_SERVICE_DTE >= '2023-11-06' ) , IRB AS (SELECT DISTINCT CDO_DOC_GUID, STRIP(CDO_VALUE_TEXT) IRB FROM CD JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION ON CDD_DOC_GUID = CDO_DOC_GUID AND CDO_ITEM_NAME = 'CONSENT DISCUSSION: TREATMENT PLAN/PROTOCOL') SELECT CDD_MRN MRN, PT_LAST_NAME "Last Name", PT_FIRST_NAME "First Name", CDD_SERVICE_DTE "Service Date", CDD_DOC_NAME "ClinDoc Name", "Document Status", IRB, "Author", "Author Occupation", "Author Role", "Signer", "Signer Occupation", "Signer Role" , "Entered/Signed Date" , "Signature Status" FROM CD LEFT JOIN IRB ON CDD_DOC_GUID = CDO_DOC_GUID JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON CDD_MRN = PT_MRN

BP_HER2_VALUE_DESC, TRIM(BP_FISH_CD) BP_FISH_CD, TRIM(BP_FISH_DESC) BP_FISH_DESC, TRIM(BP_LYM_SNT_POS) BP_LYM_SNT_POS, TRIM(BP_LYM_SNT_NO) BP_LYM_SNT_NO, TRIM(BP_LYM_NONSNT_POS) BP_LYM_NONSNT_POS, TRIM(BP_LYM_NONSNT_NO) BP_LYM_NONSNT_NO, TRIM(BP_LYM_NO) BP_LYM_NO, TRIM(BP_LYM_NO_POS) BP_LYM_NO_POS, TRIM(BP_ER_PCT) BP_ER_PCT, TRIM(BP_PR_PCT) BP_PR_PCT, TRIM(BP_RATIO) BP_RATIO, TRIM(BP_NUCL_GRD_DESC) BP_NUCL_GRD_DESC, CASE WHEN PDG_GENE_DESC = 'BRCA1' AND PDG_MUTATION_DESC NOT IN ('No Mutation Detected') THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS "DMT BRCA1 Y/N", CASE WHEN PDG_GENE_DESC = 'BRCA2' AND PDG_MUTATION_DESC NOT IN ('No Mutation Detected') THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS "DMT BRCA2 Y/N" FROM PTS JOIN IDB.BR_PRIMARY ON MRN = BP_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.BR_PT_EVENT ON BP_DX_ID = BPE_DX_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.BR_DISEASE_EVENTS ON BP_DX_ID = BDE_DX_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.BR_GENERAL ON BP_MRN = BG_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.DOC ON BG_SURG_DR_NO = DOC_DR_NO LEFT JOIN IDB.BR_CHEMO ON BP_DX_ID = BC_DX_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.BR_HORMONE ON BP_DX_ID = BH_DX_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.BR_RADIATION ON BP_DX_ID = BR_DX_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.BR_SURGERY ON BP_MRN = BS_MRN AND BP_DX_ID = BS_DX_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.PATIENT A ON BP_MRN = A.PT_MRN LEFT JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_STRUCTURED_RESULTS_V B ON BP_MRN = B.PT_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.PT_DMT_GENETICS ON BP_MRN = PDG_MRN AND PDG_GENE_DESC IN ('BRCA1', 'BRCA2') WHERE 1=1 ;

prompt: Identify patients with a diagnosis of vaginal and/or vulvar cancer and which of these patients had a CT or an MRI at any point.
completion: SELECT DISTINCT TM_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PT_MRN = TM_MRN WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('3', '6', '7', '8') AND TM_SITE_CD IN ('C518', 'C519', 'C529') AND TM_DX_DTE >= '2001-01-01' ORDER BY TM_MRN WITH CTE AS (SELECT DISTINCT TM_MRN, TM_DX_DTE FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('3', '6', '7', '8') AND TM_SITE_CD IN ('C518', 'C519', 'C529') AND TM_DX_DTE >= '2001-01-01') SELECT PBD_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PBD_SVC_DTE FROM CTE JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PT_MRN = TM_MRN JOIN IDB.PBD_DTL ON PBD_MRN = TM_MRN AND PBD_SVC_DTE >= TM_DX_DTE JOIN IDB.PBD_CODE ON PBC_PBD_CD = PBD_PBD_CD WHERE PBC_CPT_CD IN ('72195', '72196', '72197', '74181', '74182', '74183') ORDER BY PBD_MRN, PBD_SVC_DTE WITH CTE AS (SELECT DISTINCT TM_MRN, TM_DX_DTE FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('3', '6', '7', '8') AND TM_SITE_CD IN ('C518', 'C519', 'C529') AND TM_DX_DTE >= '2001-01-01') SELECT PBD_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PBD_SVC_DTE FROM CTE JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PT_MRN = TM_MRN JOIN IDB.PBD_DTL ON PBD_MRN = TM_MRN AND PBD_SVC_DTE >= TM_DX_DTE JOIN IDB.PBD_CODE ON PBC_PBD_CD = PBD_PBD_CD WHERE PBC_CPT_CD IN ('72192', '72193', '72194', '74150', '74160', '74170') ORDER BY PBD_MRN, PBD_SVC_DTE

prompt: Provide a list of patients that received intraoral and extraoral prosthesis from 2001-2018.
completion: SELECT DISTINCT PBD_MRN AS MRN, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, PBD_SVC_DTE, PBC_CPT_CD, PBC_PBD_DESC, LISTAGG(TRIM(S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK), '; ') "Primary Cancer Site(s)" FROM IDB.PBD_DTL JOIN IDB.PBD_CODE ON PBD_PBD_CD = PBC_PBD_CD JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PT_MRN = PBD_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.CDB_TUMOR ON TM_MRN = PBD_MRN AND TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') LEFT JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD WHERE 1=1 AND PBD_SVC_DTE BETWEEN '2001-01-01' AND '2018-12-31' AND PBC_CPT_CD IN ('21076', '21077', '21079', '21080', '21081', '21082', '21083', '21084', '21085', '21086', '21087', '21088', '21089') GROUP BY PBD_MRN, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, PBD_SVC_DTE, PBC_CPT_CD, PBC_PBD_DESC

prompt: List of Patients with 'H' cases for the year 2023 and their zip codes to identify the patient population's geographic distribution.
completion: WITH HCASES AS (SELECT DISTINCT PRPT_MRN, PRPT_PROCEDURE_DTE, PRPT_REPORT_DTE, PRPT_REPORT_TYPE_DESC, PRPT_ACCESSION_NO FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V WHERE PRPT_REPORT IS NOT NULL AND PRPT_ACCESSION_NO LIKE 'H%' AND YEAR(PRPT_PROCEDURE_DTE) = '2023') SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_SEX, PT_ZIP_CD FROM IDB.PATIENT_V JOIN HCASES ON PT_MRN = PRPT_MRN ; WITH HCASES AS (SELECT DISTINCT PRPT_MRN, PRPT_PROCEDURE_DTE, PRPT_REPORT_DTE, PRPT_REPORT_TYPE_DESC, PRPT_ACCESSION_NO FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V WHERE PRPT_REPORT IS NOT NULL AND PRPT_ACCESSION_NO LIKE 'H%' AND YEAR(PRPT_PROCEDURE_DTE) = '2023') SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN, PRPT_PROCEDURE_DTE, PRPT_ACCESSION_NO FROM IDB.PATIENT_V JOIN HCASES ON PT_MRN = PRPT_MRN

prompt: Provide a list of all future entered orders in CIS for patients under Dr. Laura Leddy's name.
completion: SELECT PTS.PT_FIRST_NAME, PTS.PT_LAST_NAME, OO_MRN, OO_ENTER_DTE AS "Entered Date", OO_REQUESTED_DT, OO_SCHEDULED_DT AS "Scheduled Date", OOC_ITEM_NAME AS "Order Name", OOC_ITEM_DESC, OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE, OSTS_STS_DESC, P.OP_DISPLAY_NAME "Provider", P.OP_PROV_TYPE "Provider Role", OO_ENTER_ROLE "User Enter Role", OU_DISPLAY_NAME "User Entered" FROM IDB.OMS_ORDER JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_CATALOG ON OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID = OOC_MSTR_ITEM_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_STATUS ON OO_ORD_STS_CD = OSTS_ORD_STS_CD JOIN IDB.OMS_PROVIDER P ON OO_PVDR_GUID = P.OP_PVDR_GUID LEFT JOIN IDB.PATIENT PTS ON OO_MRN = PTS.PT_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_USER ON OO_USER_GUID = OU_USER_GUID WHERE 1 = 1 AND OO_ORD_STS_CD NOT IN ('CANP', 'CANC', 'AUC3') AND OO_ENTER_DTE >= CURRENT DATE - 2 YEARS AND OP_PVDR_GUID = 9000350517201190 ORDER BY OO_MRN, OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE DESC

prompt: Darwin cohort notification for patients with NRAS G12C and/or HRAS G12C mutant tumors.
completion: WITH PTS AS (SELECT DISTINCT A.PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID AS P_ID, A.PT_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_BIRTH_DTE, PLA_LST_APPT_DTE, GENE, AA_CHANGE FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_STRUCTURED_RESULTS_V A JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS B ON A.PT_MRN = B.PT_MRN JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY ON A.PT_MRN = PLA_MRN WHERE 1=1 AND (((GENE = 'NRAS' OR GENE2 = 'NRAS') AND AA_CHANGE = 'G12C') OR ((GENE = 'HRAS' OR GENE2 = 'HRAS') AND AA_CHANGE = 'G12C')) AND PT_VITAL_STATUS = 'ALIVE' ) , DEID AS (SELECT DISTINCT P_ID FROM PTS)

prompt: Provide a Darwin cohort of patients for the given criteria along with access to the patients in the Darwin Digital Platform.
completion: WITH PTS AS (SELECT PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID PID FROM DV.PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED) , DT_1 AS (SELECT PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID AS P_ID FROM DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS REC LEFT JOIN DV.PATIENT_CORE_DEMOGRAPHICS ON PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = CORE_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID WHERE 1=1 ) , DT_2 AS (SELECT DISTINCT AC_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID AS P_ID FROM DV.ACCRUALS REC JOIN DV.PROTOCOL ON AC_PROTOCOL_ID = PRO_PROTOCOL_ID JOIN (SELECT TRIM(COLUMN_VALUES) COLUMN_VALUES FROM TABLE(DV.STRING_SPLIT('09-022,09-052,11-212,12-109,12-179,12-224,14-109,14-121,15-005,15-006,15-069,15-072,16-1141,16-324,16-490,17-023,17-139,19-027,19-109,19-358,19-406,19-419,20-202,20-345,12-283,13-187,15-176,15-185,15-257,16-019,17-448,17-573,19-187,18-273,17-332', ',')) S) X ON X.COLUMN_VALUES = PRO_IRB_NO WHERE 1=1 ) , DT_3_1 AS (SELECT INC.PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID P_ID FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_STRUCTURED_RESULTS_V INC JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML DT ON INC.PRPT_PATH_RPT_ID = DT.PDRX_PATH_RPT_ID CROSS JOIN XMLTABLE('$c/root/*' PASSING DT.PDRX_XML_VALUE AS "c" COLUMNS PRIMARY_SITE VARCHAR(264) PATH 'primary_site', TUMOR_TYPE_NAME VARCHAR(264) PATH 'tumor_type_name' , TUMOR_TYPE_CODE VARCHAR(264) PATH 'tumor_type_code', IS_METASTASIS VARCHAR(3) PATH 'is_metastasis' , METASTASIS_SITE VARCHAR(264) PATH 'metastasis_site' , MSI_COMMENT VARCHAR(264) PATH 'msi-comment' , MSI_SCORE VARCHAR(264) PATH 'msi-score' , MSI_TYPE VARCHAR(264) PATH 'msi-type' , TMB_SCORE VARCHAR(25) PATH 'tmb_score' , TMB_COUNT VARCHAR(25) PATH 'tmb-count', COSMIC_ID VARCHAR(5000) PATH 'cosmic_id') T JOIN (SELECT T.TUMOR_TYPE_CODE TTC FROM TABLE(DV.STRING_SPLIT('BOWEL', ',')) S CROSS JOIN TABLE(DV.ONCOTREE_CHILDREN(COLUMN_VALUES)) T) X ON T.TUMOR_TYPE_CODE = X.TTC WHERE 1=1 ) , DT_3_2 AS (SELECT PDX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID AS P_ID FROM DV.PATIENT_DIAGNOSIS PD , DV.DIAGNOSIS_ATTRIBUTE DA, (SELECT DXCC_DX_CATALOG_ID, DXCC_ICD_CODE, DXCC_ICD_MSK_DESC , SUBSTR(DXCC_ICD_CODE, 1, CASE WHEN LOCATE('.', DXCC_ICD_CODE) THEN LOCATE('.', DXCC_ICD_CODE) -1 ELSE LENGTH(DXCC_ICD_CODE) END)AS ICD_CODE_GROUP , CASE WHEN (DXCC_DX_TYPE = 'ICD9' AND DXCC_ICD_CODE BETWEEN '196' AND '198.99') OR (DXCC_DX_TYPE = 'ICD10' AND DXCC_ICD_CODE BETWEEN 'C77' AND 'C79.9') THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS IS_METS , CASE WHEN (DXCC_DX_TYPE = 'ICD9' AND DXCC_ICD_CODE BETWEEN '140' AND '239.999' AND DXCC_ICD_CODE NOT BETWEEN '210' AND '229') OR (DXCC_DX_TYPE = 'ICD10' AND DXCC_ICD_CODE BETWEEN 'C00' AND 'D49.99' AND DXCC_ICD_CODE NOT BETWEEN 'D10' AND 'D36' AND DXCC_ICD_CODE NOT BETWEEN 'D3A' AND 'D3A') OR DXCC_ICD_CODE BETWEEN 'Z85.0' AND 'Z85.999' THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS IS_CA FROM DV.DIAGNOSIS_CATALOG WHERE DXCC_DX_TYPE IN ('ICD9', 'ICD10') ) DCC JOIN (SELECT TRIM(COLUMN_VALUES) COLUMN_VALUES FROM TABLE(DV.STRING_SPLIT('154, 153, C18, C19, C20', ',')) S) X ON LOWER(X.COLUMN_VALUES) = LOWER(ICD_CODE_GROUP) , (SELECT DT_DATE_ID, DT_DTE AS PDX_DX_DTE FROM DV.DATE_V) DT WHERE PD.PDX_DIAGNOSIS_ATTRIBUTE_ID = DA.DXA_ATTRIBUTE_ID AND PD.PDX_DX_CATALOG_ID = DCC.DXCC_DX_CATALOG_ID AND DA.DXA_CLSF_TYPE like 'DF%' AND DT.DT_DATE_ID = PD.PDX_DX_DATE_ID ) , DEID AS (SELECT DISTINCT P_ID FROM (SELECT P_ID FROM DT_1 INTERSECT SELECT P_ID FROM DT_2 INTERSECT (SELECT P_ID FROM DT_3_1 UNION ALL SELECT P_ID FROM DT_3_2 )))

prompt: Provide number of 2013 radiology visits of female Pediatric patients between 11 and 18 years old by visit type.
completion: SELECT CPE_MRN MRN, STRIP(PT_LAST_NAME)||', '||STRIP(PT_FIRST_NAME) AS PT_NAME, PT_SEX SEX, YEAR(CPE_ENC_DTE) - YEAR(PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) AGE_AT_VST, CPE_ENC_DTE VST_DTE, CLD_DEPT_NAME DEPT_NAME, CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME VST_TYPE, CASE WHEN CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME LIKE '% MIBG%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END MIBG, CASE WHEN CVT_EXT_NAME = 'CT Scan' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END CT, CASE WHEN CVT_EXT_NAME = 'PET Scan' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END PET, CASE WHEN CVT_EXT_NAME = 'MRI' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END MRI FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PT_MRN = CPE_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN '2014-01-01' AND '2014-01-15' AND PT_SEX = 'F' AND YEAR(CPE_ENC_DTE) - YEAR(PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) BETWEEN 11 AND 18 AND (CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID IN (2303, 2304, 2848, 2849, 3623, 3624, 5397, 5398, 5807, 5867, 5399, 8124, 8125, 8126, 8127) OR CVT_EXT_NAME = 'CT Scan' OR CVT_EXT_NAME = 'PET Scan' OR CVT_EXT_NAME = 'MRI')

prompt: Weekly list of newly diagnosed cervical cancer patients to be seen by the GYN Clinic.
completion: WITH CTE AS (SELECT MRN, STRIP(PT_LAST_NAME)||', '||PT_FIRST_NAME PT_NAME, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH DOB, DX_CD, DX_DESC, FIRST_DX_DTE, DOC_NAME, DOC_SVC FROM (SELECT CC_MRN MRN, CC_CLSF_CD DX_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK DX_DESC, CC_EFF_DTE FIRST_DX_DTE, DOC_NAME, DOC_SVC, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CC_MRN ORDER BY CC_EFF_DTE) RN FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.DOC ON CC_RESP_PARTY = DOC_DR_NO JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE CC_CLSF_CD like 'C53.%' AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'D%' AND (CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND ='Y')) ) AS A JOIN IDB.PATIENT_V ON MRN = PT_MRN WHERE RN = 1 AND FIRST_DX_DTE >= CURRENT DATE - 14 DAY ) , MRI AS (SELECT CPE_MRN, CPE_ENC_DTE, CPE_CPE_APPT_STS, CRE_RES_NAME RESOURCE, CRE_RES_TYP, CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME, CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR, CVT_EXT_NAME, CLD_DEPT_NAME DEPARTMENT, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 GRP FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN CTE ON MRN = CPE_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS = 'Sch' AND CVT_EXT_NAME LIKE 'MRI%' AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 = 'RAD') SELECT MRN, PT_NAME, DOB, DX_CD, DX_DESC, FIRST_DX_DTE, DOC_NAME, DOC_SVC , CPE_ENC_DTE MRI_DTE, CPE_CPE_APPT_STS VST_STS, RESOURCE, CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME VISIT_TYPE, CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR VST_ABBR, DEPARTMENT, GRP FROM CTE LEFT JOIN MRI ON MRN = CPE_MRN ;

prompt: Provide a list of patients who had paracentesis at Urgent Care Center from 2013 to 2017
completion: WITH PTS AS (SELECT DISTINCT PBD_MRN, PBD_SVC_DTE FROM IDB.PBD_DTL JOIN IDB.PBD_CODE ON PBD_PBD_CD = PBC_PBD_CD WHERE PBC_CPT_CD IN ('49083', '49082') AND PBD_SVC_DTE BETWEEN '2013-01-01' AND '2017-12-31' ) , CENSUS AS (SELECT DISTINCT UC_MRN, PBD_SVC_DTE UC_PBD_SVC_DTE, UC_ADM_NUM, UC_TRANSFER_DTE, UC_END_DTE, UC_HOSP_SVC, UC_NURS_STA, UC_SEQ_NO, ROW_NUMBER()OVER(PARTITION BY UC_MRN, UC_ADM_NUM ORDER BY UC_END_DTE ASC) FIRST_XFER_DATE_RANK, ROW_NUMBER()OVER(PARTITION BY UC_MRN, UC_ADM_NUM ORDER BY UC_END_DTE DESC) LAST_END_DATE_RANK FROM IDB.UNIFIED_CENSUS JOIN PTS ON UC_MRN = PBD_MRN AND PBD_SVC_DTE BETWEEN UC_TRANSFER_DTE AND UC_END_DTE AND (UC_NURS_STA = 'UCC' OR UC_HOSP_SVC = 'IR')) , LABS AS (SELECT DISTINCT LR_MRN, LABS_PBD_SVC_DTE, LR_PERFORMED_DTE, LR_TEST_NAME, "Albumin Results", "Creatinine Results", ROW_NUMBER()OVER(PARTITION BY LR_MRN, LABS_PBD_SVC_DTE ORDER BY DATE_DIFF ASC) AS LABS_RANK FROM (SELECT LR_MRN, LR_PERFORMED_DTE, LR_TEST_NAME, PBD_SVC_DTE AS LABS_PBD_SVC_DTE, MAX(CASE WHEN LR_SUBTEST_NAME IN ('Albumin', 'Albumin, Plasma', 'Protein Electrophoresis Albumin', 'PE Albumin') THEN LR_RESULT_VALUE END) AS "Albumin Results", MAX(CASE WHEN LR_SUBTEST_NAME IN ('Creatinine', 'Creatinine, Plasma') THEN LR_RESULT_VALUE END) AS "Creatinine Results", ABS(LR_PERFORMED_DTE - PBD_SVC_DTE) DATE_DIFF FROM IDB.LAB_RESULTS JOIN PTS ON PBD_MRN = LR_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.LAB_TEXT_LINE ON LTL_RESULT_GUID = LR_RESULT_GUID WHERE LR_TEST_NAME IN ('CMPC', 'Comp. Metabolic Panel & Conj Bilirubin', 'Comp. Metabolic Panel & Conj Bilirubin, Plasma', 'Comp. Metabolic Panel & Direct Bilirubin', 'Comp. Metabolic Panel & Direct Bilirubin, Plasma', 'Comp. Panel & Conj Bilirubin, Plasma', 'Compre. Metabolic Panel & Conj Bilirubin', 'Comprehensive Metabolic Panel', 'Comprehensive Metabolic Panel, Plasma') AND LR_SUBTEST_NAME IN ('Creatinine', 'Creatinine, Plasma', 'Albumin', 'Albumin, Plasma', 'Protein Electrophoresis Albumin', 'PE Albumin') GROUP BY LR_MRN, LR_PERFORMED_DTE, LR_TEST_NAME, PBD_SVC_DTE) A) , DX AS (SELECT DISTINCT TM_MRN , TM_DX_DTE , DX_PBD_SERVICE_DTE , HIST_DESC , SITE_DESC , DIFF_DATE , ROW_NUMBER()OVER(PARTITION BY TM_MRN, DX_PBD_SERVICE_DTE ORDER BY DIFF_DATE ASC) AS DX_RANK FROM (SELECT DISTINCT TM_MRN, TM_DX_DTE, PBD_SVC_DTE AS DX_PBD_SERVICE_DTE, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS HIST_DESC, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_DESC, ABS(DAYS(PBD_SVC_DTE) - DAYS(TM_DX_DTE)) AS DIFF_DATE FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS ON AV_ELEMENT = 'CASE_STS' AND AV_CODE = TM_CASE_STS AND TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') JOIN PTS ON PBD_MRN = TM_MRN WHERE TM_DX_DTE <= PBD_SVC_DTE ) A) , RAD AS (SELECT RRPT_MRN, RRPT_PROCEDURE_NAME, RRPT_ANC_CODE, RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE, RRPT_REPORT_TXT, UC_PBD_SVC_DTE AS RAD_PBD_SVC_DTE, DIFF_DATE, ROW_NUMBER()OVER(PARTITION BY RRPT_MRN, UC_PBD_SVC_DTE ORDER BY DIFF_DATE ASC) AS RAD_RANK FROM (SELECT RRPT_MRN, RRPT_PROCEDURE_NAME, RRPT_ANC_CODE, RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE, RRPT_REPORT_TXT, UC_PBD_SVC_DTE, ABS(DAYS(UC_PBD_SVC_DTE) - DAYS(RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE)) AS DIFF_DATE FROM DV.RADIOLOGY_REPORT_V JOIN CENSUS ON UC_MRN = RRPT_MRN WHERE RRPT_ANC_CODE = 'PARA' ) A) , VITALS AS (SELECT CDD_MRN, CDD_SERVICE_DTE, UC_PBD_SVC_DTE V_PBD_SVC_DTE, SYSTOLICBP, DIASTOLICBP, RESPRATE, HEARTRATE, DIFF_DATE, ROW_NUMBER()OVER(PARTITION BY CDD_MRN, UC_PBD_SVC_DTE ORDER BY DIFF_DATE ASC) AS V_RANK FROM (SELECT CDD_MRN, CDD_SERVICE_DTE, UC_PBD_SVC_DTE, SUBSTR(BPS.CDO_VALUE_TEXT, 01, 15) SYSTOLICBP, SUBSTR(BPD.CDO_VALUE_TEXT, 01, 15) DIASTOLICBP, SUBSTR(RESP.CDO_VALUE_TEXT, 01, 15) RESPRATE, SUBSTR(HR.CDO_VALUE_TEXT, 01, 15) AS HEARTRATE, ABS(DAYS(UC_PBD_SVC_DTE) - DAYS(CDD_SERVICE_DTE)) AS DIFF_DATE FROM CENSUS JOIN IDB.CD_DOCUMENT ON UC_MRN = CDD_MRN AND CDD_SERVICE_DTE >= UC_PBD_SVC_DTE LEFT JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION BPS ON CDD_DOC_GUID = BPS.CDO_DOC_GUID AND CDD_AUTHORED_DTE = BPS.CDO_AUTHORED_DTE AND BPS.CDO_ITEM_NAME IN ('Blood Pressure BP Systolic', 'Blood Pressure Systolic') LEFT JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION BPD ON CDD_DOC_GUID = BPD.CDO_DOC_GUID AND CDD_AUTHORED_DTE = BPD.CDO_AUTHORED_DTE AND BPD.CDO_ITEM_NAME IN ('Blood Pressure Diastolic') LEFT JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION RESP ON CDD_DOC_GUID = RESP.CDO_DOC_GUID AND CDD_AUTHORED_DTE = RESP.CDO_AUTHORED_DTE AND RESP.CDO_ITEM_NAME IN ('Resp Rate', 'Respirations', 'Respirations Respirations') LEFT JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION HR ON CDD_DOC_GUID = HR.CDO_DOC_GUID AND CDD_AUTHORED_DTE = HR.CDO_AUTHORED_DTE AND HR.CDO_ITEM_NAME IN ('Heart Rate Pulse/Heart Rate', 'Pulse/Heart Rate', 'Heart Rate Heart Rate') WHERE 1=1 AND CDD_CANCEL_IND <> '1' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND <> '1' AND CDD_DOC_NAME like '%Vital%' ) A) SELECT PBD_MRN "MRN" , PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH "DOB" , PBD_SVC_DTE "Paracentesis Service Date" , A.UC_TRANSFER_DTE "UCC Admission Date" , B.UC_END_DTE "UCC Discharge Date" , A.UC_HOSP_SVC "UCC Admission Service" , TM_DX_DTE "Dx Date" , SITE_DESC "Site" , HIST_DESC "Histology" , RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE "Radiology Report Date" , RRPT_REPORT_TXT "Radiology Report" , SYSTOLICBP "Systolic BP" , DIASTOLICBP "Diastolic BP" , RESPRATE "Respiratory Rate" , HEARTRATE "Heart Rate" , "Albumin Results" , "Creatinine Results" FROM PTS JOIN CENSUS A ON PBD_MRN = A.UC_MRN AND PBD_SVC_DTE BETWEEN A.UC_TRANSFER_DTE AND A.UC_END_DTE AND A.FIRST_XFER_DATE_RANK = 1 JOIN CENSUS B ON PBD_MRN = B.UC_MRN AND PBD_SVC_DTE BETWEEN B.UC_TRANSFER_DTE AND B.UC_END_DTE AND B.LAST_END_DATE_RANK = 1 AND A.UC_ADM_NUM = B.UC_ADM_NUM LEFT JOIN DX ON PBD_MRN = TM_MRN AND DX_RANK = 1 AND PBD_SVC_DTE = DX_PBD_SERVICE_DTE LEFT JOIN RAD ON PBD_MRN = RRPT_MRN AND RAD_RANK = 1 AND PBD_SVC_DTE = RAD_PBD_SVC_DTE LEFT JOIN VITALS ON PBD_MRN = CDD_MRN AND V_RANK = 1 AND PBD_SVC_DTE = V_PBD_SVC_DTE LEFT JOIN LABS ON PBD_MRN = LR_MRN AND LABS_RANK = 1 AND PBD_SVC_DTE = LABS_PBD_SVC_DTE LEFT JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PBD_MRN = PT_MRN ;

prompt: Provide a list of all Follicular Lymphoma (FL) and Diffuse Large B-Cell Lymphoma (DLBCL) patients with IMPACT results, with the mutation type of the CREBBP gene (“truncating mutation” vs “missense mutation” vs “no mutation”).
completion: WITH DMP AS (SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN, PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID AS PID, PT_SEX_DESC, PT_BIRTH_DTE, PDRX_ACCESSION_NO AS "Accession No", MAINPRC.DT_DTE AS "Procedure Date", RTRIM(SUBSTR(CAST(MAINPATH.PRPT_REPORT AS VARCHAR(32000)), POSITION('PHYSICIAN:', UPPER(MAINPATH.PRPT_REPORT), CODEUNITS32) + 11, POSITION('ACCESSION', UPPER(MAINPATH.PRPT_REPORT), CODEUNITS32) - POSITION('PHYSICIAN:', UPPER(MAINPATH.PRPT_REPORT), CODEUNITS32) - 11)) AS "Physician", PDWS_DESCRIPTION, T.* FROM DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML DT ON PDRX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML_SETTINGS ON PDRX_PATH_DMP_RESULTS_XML_ID = PDRXS_PATH_DMP_RESULTS_XML_ID JOIN DVDMC.PATHOLOGY_DMP_WEBSVC_SETTINGS ON PDRXS_SETTING_ID = PDWS_SETTING_ID JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V MAINPATH ON MAINPATH.PRPT_PATH_RPT_ID = PDRX_PATH_RPT_ID JOIN DV.DATE_V MAINPRC ON MAINPRC.DT_DATE_ID = MAINPATH.PRPT_PROCEDURE_DATE_ID CROSS JOIN XMLTABLE('$c/root/*' PASSING DT.PDRX_XML_VALUE AS "c" COLUMNS CNV_TYPE VARCHAR(500) PATH 'name()', VARIANT_CLASS VARCHAR(100) PATH 'variant_class', SITE1_GENE VARCHAR(100) PATH 'site1_gene', SITE2_GENE VARCHAR(100) PATH 'site2_gene', GENE_ID VARCHAR(100) PATH 'gene_id', EXON_NUM VARCHAR(100) PATH 'exon_num', AA_CHANGE VARCHAR(100) PATH 'aa_change', NORMAL_VFREQ VARCHAR(100) PATH 'normal_vfreq', TUMOR_VFREQ VARCHAR(100) PATH 'tumor_vfreq', MAFREQ_1000G VARCHAR(100) PATH 'mafreq_1000g', CHROMOSOME VARCHAR(100) PATH 'chromosome', CDNA_CHANGE VARCHAR(100) PATH 'cDNA_change', GENE_FOLD_CHANGE VARCHAR(100) PATH 'gene_fold_change', NORMAL_DP VARCHAR(100) PATH 'normal_dp', TUMOR_DP VARCHAR(100) PATH 'tumor_dp', NORMAL_AD VARCHAR(100) PATH 'normal_ad', TUMOR_AD VARCHAR(100) PATH 'tumor_ad', START_POSITION int PATH 'start_position', ALT_ALLELE VARCHAR(255) PATH 'alt_allele', REF_ALLELE VARCHAR(255) PATH 'ref_allele', TUMOR_TYPE_NAME VARCHAR(100) PATH '../meta-data/tumor_type_name', METASTASIS_SITE VARCHAR(100) PATH '../meta-data/metastasis_site', VARIANT_TYPE VARCHAR(100) PATH 'variant_type', PROJECT VARCHAR(100) PATH '../meta-data/dmp_alys_task_name', SAMPLEID VARCHAR(100) PATH '../meta-data/dmp_sample_id', PATIENTID VARCHAR(100) PATH '../meta-data/dmp_patient_id') T WHERE 1=1 AND PDWS_NAME IN ('IMPACT - HEME', 'IMPACT') AND TUMOR_TYPE_NAME IN ('Follicular Lymphoma', 'Diffuse Large B-Cell Lymphoma, NOS') AND(SITE1_GENE like '%CREBBP%' OR SITE2_GENE like '%CREBBP%' OR GENE_ID like '%CREBBP%') ) , CONSENT_09_141 AS (SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN, AC_CONS_DTE AS "09-141 Consent Date", AC_OFF_STUDY_DTE AS "09-141 Off Date" FROM DMP JOIN DV.ACCRUALS ACC_1 ON ACC_1.AC_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PID JOIN DV.PROTOCOL PRO_1 ON PRO_1.PRO_PROTOCOL_ID = ACC_1.AC_PROTOCOL_ID AND PRO_1.PRO_IRB_NO = '09-141') , CONSENT_06_107 AS (SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN, AC_CONS_DTE AS "06-107 Consent Date", AC_OFF_STUDY_DTE AS "06-107 Off Date" FROM DMP JOIN DV.ACCRUALS ACC_1 ON ACC_1.AC_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PID JOIN DV.PROTOCOL PRO_1 ON PRO_1.PRO_PROTOCOL_ID = ACC_1.AC_PROTOCOL_ID AND PRO_1.PRO_IRB_NO = '06-107') , CONSENT_12_245 AS (SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN, AC_CONS_DTE AS "12-245 Consent Date", AC_OFF_STUDY_DTE AS "12-245 Off Date" FROM DMP JOIN DV.ACCRUALS ACC_1 ON ACC_1.AC_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PID JOIN DV.PROTOCOL PRO_1 ON PRO_1.PRO_PROTOCOL_ID = ACC_1.AC_PROTOCOL_ID AND PRO_1.PRO_IRB_NO = '12-245') , MAIN AS (SELECT DMP.* , "09-141 Consent Date" , "09-141 Off Date" , "06-107 Consent Date" , "06-107 Off Date" , "12-245 Consent Date" , "12-245 Off Date" FROM DMP LEFT JOIN CONSENT_06_107 ON DMP.PT_MRN = CONSENT_06_107.PT_MRN LEFT JOIN CONSENT_09_141 ON DMP.PT_MRN = CONSENT_09_141.PT_MRN LEFT JOIN CONSENT_12_245 ON DMP.PT_MRN = CONSENT_12_245.PT_MRN) SELECT * FROM MAIN ORDER BY PT_MRN, "Accession No", GENE_ID

prompt: Create a report that identifies patients with recent activity using an SSN that is on the Social Security list of deceased SSNs.
completion: SELECT PLA_MRN, NDM_DEATH_DTE, PLA_LST_APPT_DTE, PLA_LST_DRVST_DTE, PLA_LST_ADM_DTE, PLA_LST_DSCH_DTE, PLA_LST_TX_DTE, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_AKA, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, PT_ZIP_CD, NDM_LAST_NAME, NDM_FIRST_NAME, NDM_MIDDLE_NAME, NDM_BIRTH_DTE, NDM_RSDNCE_ZIP_CD FROM IDB.PATIENT JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY ON PT_MRN = PLA_MRN JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTV_DTL ON PLA_MRN = LAD_MRN JOIN IDB.PATIENT_SSN ON PLA_MRN = PTSS_MRN JOIN IDB.NTIS_DEATH_MASTER ON PTSS_SSA_NO = NDM_SSA_NO WHERE MAX(PLA_LST_APPT_DTE, PLA_LST_DRVST_DTE, PLA_LST_ADM_DTE, PLA_LST_DSCH_DTE, PLA_LST_TX_DTE) >= '2010-03-01' AND PT_DATE_OF_DEATH IS NULL

prompt: Provide a list of male patients who had a DUS (CPT 93980).
completion: WITH "cte1" AS (SELECT UPPER(MP_FULL_NM) MP_FULL_NM_UPPER, M.* FROM DV.MEDPRO_V M) SELECT DISTINCT "t1"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AS "Deident PT #", "t2"."PT_MRN" AS "MRN", "t2"."PT_LAST_NAME" AS "Last Name", "t2"."PT_FIRST_NAME" AS "First Name", "t2"."PT_BIRTH_DTE" AS "Date of Birth", "t3"."DT_DTE" AS "CPT Procedure Date (PBD)", "t4"."PCC_CODE" AS "CPT Procedure Code (PBD)", "t4"."PCC_DESC" AS "CPT Procedure Desc (PBD)", "t5"."MP_FULL_NM_UPPER" AS "CPT Procedure Physician (PBD)" FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED" "t1" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V" "t2" ON "t1"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t2"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."CPT_PBD_PATIENT_PROCEDURE" "t4" ON "t1"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t4"."PTX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" "t3" ON "t4"."PTX_PROC_DATE_ID" = "t3"."DT_DATE_ID" LEFT JOIN "cte1" "t5" ON "t4"."PTX_MEDPRO_ID" = "t5"."MP_MEDPRO_ID" WHERE ("t4"."PCC_CODE" IN ('93980') AND "t2"."PT_SEX_DESC" IN ('MALE', 'NO VALUE ENTERED', 'UNKNOWN'))

prompt: COVID-19 positive patients treated over the last 6 weeks with specific drugs to assess potential trial eligibility
completion: WITH CV AS (SELECT CCV_MRN, RESULT, MIN_RESULT_DT, MAX_RESULT_DT, CCV_PROVIDER_NAME, CCV_ADMIT_DT, CCV_DISCHARGE_DT, CCV_SERVICE_GROUP_CODE, CCV_SERVICE_DESC FROM IDB.COVID19_PATIENT_INFO JOIN IDB.COVID19_CLIENT_VISIT ON MRN = CCV_MRN WHERE CCV_CARE_LEVEL_CODE <> 'Inpt Schedule' AND CCV_VISIT_STATUS IN ('ADM', 'DSC') AND CCV_VISIT_TYPE = 'Inpatient' AND RESULT NOT IN ('Negative') AND CAST(CCV_DISCHARGE_DT AS DATE) >= '2020-05-21' ) , ORDERS AS (SELECT OO_MRN AS MRN, OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE AS "Order Date", OO_ORD_NAME AS "Drug Name", OO_ORD_PRIO AS "Fill Detail", OMD_DOSE_LOW AS "Dose", OMD_DOSE_UNIT AS "Dose unit", OO_ORD_FREQ AS "Frequency", OSTS_STS_DESC AS "Order Status", OO_SUMMARY_LINE AS "Order Summary", ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY OO_MRN ORDER BY OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE DESC) AS RN FROM IDB.OMS_ORDER JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_CATALOG ON OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID = OOC_MSTR_ITEM_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_MED_DETAIL ON OMD_ORD_GUID = OO_ORD_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_STATUS ON OO_ORD_STS_CD = OSTS_ORD_STS_CD WHERE OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE >= '2020-05-21' AND OO_ORD_STS_CD NOT IN ('CANC', 'CANP', 'AUC3') AND (LOWER(OO_ORD_NAME) LIKE '%olanzapine%' OR LOWER(OO_ORD_NAME) LIKE '%quetiapine%' OR LOWER(OO_ORD_NAME) LIKE '%haloperidol%' OR LOWER(OO_ORD_NAME) LIKE '%asenapine%' OR LOWER(OO_ORD_NAME) LIKE '%risperidone%' OR LOWER(OO_ORD_NAME) LIKE '%chlorpromazine%') ) , PROTOCOL AS (SELECT PRO_IRB_NO, PRO_IRB_TITLE, PRO_IRB_STS, PRO_PROTOCOL_TYPE, AC_MRN, AC_NON_MSK_INST, AC_LAST_NAME, AC_FIRST_NAME, AC_PVDR_OF_RECORD_NAME, ACD_REG_DTE, ACD_TX_ST_DTE, ACD_TX_END_DTE, ACD_OFF_STUDY_DTE, ACD_CONS_DTE FROM IDB.PROTOCOL JOIN IDB.ACCRUALS ON PRO_IRB_NO = AC_IRB_NO JOIN IDB.ACCRUALS_DATES ON AC_IRB_NO = ACD_IRB_NO AND AC_SUBJ_ID_NO = ACD_SUBJ_ID_NO AND AC_SUBJ_SEQ_NO = ACD_SUBJ_SEQ_NO WHERE ACD_OFF_STUDY_DTE IS NULL ) , CLINTRAC AS (SELECT TM_MRN, AV_DESC AS CASE_STS, TM_DX_DTE, TM_HIST_CD, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS HIST_DESC, TM_SITE_CD, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_DESC FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS ON AV_ELEMENT = 'CASE_STS' AND AV_CODE = TM_CASE_STS WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') ) SELECT DISTINCT DENSE_RANK() OVER ( ORDER BY CCV_MRN) AS "Patient number", RESULT AS "COVID Status", "Drug Name", "Dose", "Dose unit", "Frequency", "Order Status", "Order Summary", TM_HIST_CD AS "Histology code", HIST_DESC AS "Histology", TM_SITE_CD AS "Site code", SITE_DESC AS "Site description", CASE WHEN CAST(MAX_RESULT_DT AS DATE) >= '2020-05-21' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS "COVID_POS_6_WEEKS" FROM CV JOIN ORDERS ON CCV_MRN = MRN JOIN CLINTRAC ON CCV_MRN = TM_MRN WHERE CCV_MRN NOT IN (SELECT AC_MRN FROM PROTOCOL) ;

prompt: MSK's Same-day Surgery Cancellation Rates by Services
completion: WITH CTE AS (SELECT YEAR(OC_SURG_DTE) YR, OC_SURG_SVC SVC, COUNT(DISTINCT OC_CASE_ID) ALL_SURG, COUNT(CASE WHEN OC_OR_CASE_STS = 'Can' AND OC_SURG_DTE = OC_CANC_DTE THEN OC_CASE_ID END) AS CANCELED_SAME_DAY FROM IDB.OR_CASE JOIN IDB.CL_LOCATION ON OC_SURG_LOC_ID = LOC_LOC_ID WHERE YEAR(OC_SURG_DTE) IN (2017, 2018) AND (LOC_LOC_NAME NOT LIKE '%IR%' AND LOC_LOC_NAME NOT LIKE '%ENDO%') AND OC_OR_CASE_STS NOT IN ('Not Sch', 'Voided') AND LOC_LOC_ID <> 1000090 AND OC_SURG_SVC NOT IN ('ANES', 'BMM', 'BMP', 'CARD', 'GI', 'IR', 'PAIN', 'PULM', 'RAD ONC', 'VASC', '') GROUP BY YEAR(OC_SURG_DTE), OC_SURG_SVC ) SELECT YR "Year", SVC "Service", ALL_SURG "All Surgeries", CANCELED_SAME_DAY "Canceled Same Day", DECIMAL(CANCELED_SAME_DAY)/ALL_SURG AS "% Canceled" FROM CTE

prompt: Research project on financial toxicity.
completion: WITH PROCEDURES_0 AS (SELECT "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AS PT_DEID, "IDB"."SRG_SURG_EVENT"."SSE_LOG_ID" AS SUBJECT_ID, CAST(TRIM("IDB"."SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE"."SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD") AS VARCHAR) || ' - ' || CAST(TRIM("IDB"."SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE"."SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC") AS VARCHAR) AS PROC_CODE_DESC, CAST(TRIM("IDB"."SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE"."SSP_SURG_LAST_NM") AS VARCHAR) || ', ' || CAST(TRIM("IDB"."SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE"."SSP_SURG_FIRST_NM") AS VARCHAR) AS SURGEON FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS" JOIN "IDB"."SRG_SURG_EVENT" ON "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_MRN" = "IDB"."SRG_SURG_EVENT"."SSE_MRN" JOIN "IDB"."SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE" ON "IDB"."SRG_SURG_EVENT"."SSE_LOG_ID" = "IDB"."SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE"."SSP_LOG_ID" WHERE "IDB"."SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE"."SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD" IN ('61510') AND CAST(TRIM("IDB"."SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE"."SSP_SURG_LAST_NM") AS VARCHAR) || ', ' || CAST(TRIM("IDB"."SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE"."SSP_SURG_FIRST_NM") AS VARCHAR) IN ('SOUWEIDANE, MARK')), COHORT AS (SELECT PT_DEID AS PT_DEID FROM (SELECT PROCEDURES_0.PT_DEID AS PT_DEID FROM PROCEDURES_0)), COHORT_PROCEDURES AS (SELECT SUBJECT_ID AS SUBJECT_ID, PT_DEID AS PT_DEID FROM (SELECT PROCEDURES_0.SUBJECT_ID AS SUBJECT_ID, PROCEDURES_0.PT_DEID AS PT_DEID FROM PROCEDURES_0)), KEYS AS (SELECT COHORT.PT_DEID AS COHORT_PT_DEID, COHORT_PROCEDURES.SUBJECT_ID AS COHORT_PROCEDURES_SUBJECT_ID, COHORT_PROCEDURES.PT_DEID AS COHORT_PROCEDURES_PT_DEID FROM COHORT LEFT OUTER JOIN COHORT_PROCEDURES ON COHORT_PROCEDURES.PT_DEID = COHORT.PT_DEID), DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS AS (SELECT DISTINCT "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AS PT_DEID, "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AS SUBJECT_ID, "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_MRN" AS PT_MRN, "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_SEX_DESC" AS GENDER, "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_VITAL_STATUS" AS VITAL_STATS, "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_BIRTH_DTE" AS DATE_OF_BIRTH, "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_DEATH_DTE" AS DATE_OF_DEATH, "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_RACE_DESC" AS RACE, ETHNICITY."CORE_ETHNICITY_DESC" AS ETHNICITY, ALLOWVALS_LANGUAGE."AV_DESC" AS PRIMARY_LANGUAGE, LAST_ACTIVITY_DATE."PLA_LAST_ACTV_DTE" AS LAST_ACTIVITY_DATE FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS" LEFT OUTER JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_CORE_DEMOGRAPHICS" AS ETHNICITY ON "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = ETHNICITY."CORE_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT OUTER JOIN "IDB"."PATIENT" AS IDB_PATIENT ON "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_MRN" = IDB_PATIENT."PT_MRN" LEFT OUTER JOIN "IDB"."ALLOWVALS" AS ALLOWVALS_LANGUAGE ON IDB_PATIENT."PT_PRIMARY_LANG" = ALLOWVALS_LANGUAGE."AV_CODE" AND ALLOWVALS_LANGUAGE."AV_ELEMENT" = 'PRIMARY_LANG' LEFT OUTER JOIN "DV".PATIENT_LATEST_ACTIVITY AS LAST_ACTIVITY_DATE ON "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = LAST_ACTIVITY_DATE."PLA_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID") SELECT DISTINCT DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS.PT_MRN AS MRN, DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS.GENDER AS GENDER, DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS.VITAL_STATS AS VITAL_STATUS, DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS.DATE_OF_BIRTH AS DATE_OF_BIRTH, DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS.DATE_OF_DEATH AS DATE_OF_DEATH, DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS.RACE AS RACE, DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS.ETHNICITY AS ETHNICITY, DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS.PRIMARY_LANGUAGE AS PRIMARY_LANGUAGE, DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS.LAST_ACTIVITY_DATE AS LAST_ACTIVITY_DATE FROM KEYS LEFT OUTER JOIN DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS ON DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS.PT_DEID = KEYS.COHORT_PT_DEID; WITH PROCEDURES_0 AS (SELECT "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AS PT_DEID, "IDB"."SRG_SURG_EVENT"."SSE_LOG_ID" AS SUBJECT_ID, CAST(TRIM("IDB"."SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE"."SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD") AS VARCHAR) || ' - ' || CAST(TRIM("IDB"."SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE"."SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC") AS VARCHAR) AS PROC_CODE_DESC, CAST(TRIM("IDB"."SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE"."SSP_SURG_LAST_NM") AS VARCHAR) || ', ' || CAST(TRIM("IDB"."SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE"."SSP_SURG_FIRST_NM") AS VARCHAR) AS SURGEON FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS" JOIN "IDB"."SRG_SURG_EVENT" ON "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_MRN" = "IDB"."SRG_SURG_EVENT"."SSE_MRN" JOIN "IDB"."SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE" ON "IDB"."SRG_SURG_EVENT"."SSE_LOG_ID" = "IDB"."SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE"."SSP_LOG_ID" WHERE "IDB"."SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE"."SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD" IN ('61510') AND CAST(TRIM("IDB"."SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE"."SSP_SURG_LAST_NM") AS VARCHAR) || ', ' || CAST(TRIM("IDB"."SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE"."SSP_SURG_FIRST_NM") AS VARCHAR) IN ('SOUWEIDANE, MARK')), COHORT AS (SELECT PT_DEID AS PT_DEID FROM (SELECT PROCEDURES_0.PT_DEID AS PT_DEID FROM PROCEDURES_0)), COHORT_PROCEDURES AS (SELECT SUBJECT_ID AS SUBJECT_ID, PT_DEID AS PT_DEID FROM (SELECT PROCEDURES_0.SUBJECT_ID AS SUBJECT_ID, PROCEDURES_0.PT_DEID AS PT_DEID FROM PROCEDURES_0)), KEYS AS (SELECT COHORT.PT_DEID AS COHORT_PT_DEID, COHORT_PROCEDURES.SUBJECT_ID AS COHORT_PROCEDURES_SUBJECT_ID, COHORT_PROCEDURES.PT_DEID AS COHORT_PROCEDURES_PT_DEID FROM COHORT LEFT OUTER JOIN COHORT_PROCEDURES ON COHORT_PROCEDURES.PT_DEID = COHORT.PT_DEID), DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS AS (SELECT DISTINCT "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AS PT_DEID, "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AS SUBJECT_ID, "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_MRN" AS PT_MRN FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"), DIAGNOSIS_COLUMNS AS (SELECT DISTINCT PT_DEID, SUBJECT_ID, DIAGNOSIS_DATE, ICD_CODES_ICD_CODE, ICD_CODES_ICD_CODE_DESC FROM (SELECT "DV"."PATIENT_DIAGNOSIS_FINAL_ALL_V"."PDX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AS PT_DEID, CAST(TRIM("DV"."PATIENT_DIAGNOSIS_FINAL_ALL_V"."PDX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID") AS VARCHAR) || CAST(TRIM("DV"."PATIENT_DIAGNOSIS_FINAL_ALL_V"."PDX_DX_CATALOG_ID") AS VARCHAR) AS SUBJECT_ID, MIN(DIAGNOSIS_DATE."DT_DTE") AS DIAGNOSIS_DATE, TRIM(ICD_CODE_DESC."DXCC_ICD_CODE") AS ICD_CODES_ICD_CODE, TRIM(ICD_CODE_DESC."DXCC_ICD_CODE") || '-' || TRIM(ICD_CODE_DESC."DXCC_ICD_MSK_DESC") AS ICD_CODES_ICD_CODE_DESC FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DIAGNOSIS_FINAL_ALL_V" JOIN "DV"."DIAGNOSIS_CATALOG" AS ICD_CODE_DESC ON "DV"."PATIENT_DIAGNOSIS_FINAL_ALL_V"."PDX_DX_CATALOG_ID" = ICD_CODE_DESC."DXCC_DX_CATALOG_ID" JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" AS DIAGNOSIS_DATE ON "DV"."PATIENT_DIAGNOSIS_FINAL_ALL_V"."PDX_DX_DATE_ID" = DIAGNOSIS_DATE."DT_DATE_ID" GROUP BY "DV"."PATIENT_DIAGNOSIS_FINAL_ALL_V"."PDX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID", CAST(TRIM("DV"."PATIENT_DIAGNOSIS_FINAL_ALL_V"."PDX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID") AS VARCHAR) || CAST(TRIM("DV"."PATIENT_DIAGNOSIS_FINAL_ALL_V"."PDX_DX_CATALOG_ID") AS VARCHAR), ICD_CODE_DESC."DXCC_ICD_CODE", ICD_CODE_DESC."DXCC_ICD_MSK_DESC", ICD_CODE_DESC."DXCC_ICD_CODE", ICD_CODE_DESC."DXCC_ICD_MSK_DESC")) SELECT DISTINCT DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS.PT_MRN AS MRN, DIAGNOSIS_COLUMNS.DIAGNOSIS_DATE AS DIAGNOSIS_DATE, DIAGNOSIS_COLUMNS.ICD_CODES_ICD_CODE AS ICD_CODE, DIAGNOSIS_COLUMNS.ICD_CODES_ICD_CODE_DESC AS ICD_CODE_DESCRIPTION FROM KEYS LEFT OUTER JOIN DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS ON DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS.PT_DEID = KEYS.COHORT_PT_DEID LEFT OUTER JOIN DIAGNOSIS_COLUMNS ON DIAGNOSIS_COLUMNS.PT_DEID = KEYS.COHORT_PT_DEID;

prompt: Design a monthly report to help determine the volume and timing of patient care encounters for the inpatient dietitians.
completion: SELECT DISTINCT STRIP(CDD_MRN) AS CDD_MRN, OS_SVC_GRP_CD, OS_SVC_DESC, DATE(OCV_ADM_DT) AS ADM_DATE, DATE(OCV_DSCH_DT) AS DSCH_DATE, CDD_DOC_GUID, STRIP(CDD_DOC_NAME) AS CDD_DOC_NAME, CDD_SERVICE_DTE, CDD_SERVICE_DT, STRIP(OU_DISPLAY_NAME) AS "Electronic Signature", STRIP(CDO_VALUE_TEXT) AS RISK_LEVEL FROM IDB.CD_DOCUMENT LEFT JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION ON CDO_DOC_GUID = CDD_DOC_GUID AND CDO_AUTHORED_DTE = CDD_AUTHORED_DTE AND CDO_ITEM_NAME = 'Risk Level:' JOIN IDB.OMS_USER ON CDD_AUTH_PROV_GUID = OU_USER_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_CLIENT_VISIT ON OCV_VISIT_GUID = CDD_VISIT_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_SERVICE ON OCV_SVC_GUID = OS_SVC_GUID WHERE CDD_CANCEL_IND = '0' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND = '0' AND CDD_DOC_NAME = 'Initial Assessment - Nutrition' AND CDD_SERVICE_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT DATE - (DAY(CURRENT DATE) - 1) DAYS - 1 MONTH AND CURRENT DATE - (DAY(CURRENT DATE)) DAYS

prompt: Provide report on specified drugs ordered the same day at 53rd St.
completion: SELECT PT_MRN AS MRN, STRIP(PT_LAST_NAME)||', '||STRIP(PT_FIRST_NAME) NAME, F_START_DATE AS FLO_START_DATE, F_DISP_LOC AS DISPENSE_LOCATION, F_MNEMONIC, F_DRUG_NAME, F_RX_NO, F_DOSE, F_DOSE_UNIT, F_NET_PT_DOSE, F_DR_NAME, L_MNEMONIC, L_DRUG_NAME, L_RX_NO, L_DOSE, L_DOSE_UNIT, L_NET_PT_DOSE, L_DR_NAME, O_MNEMONIC, O_DRUG_NAME, O_RX_NO, O_DOSE, O_DOSE_UNIT, O_NET_PT_DOSE, O_DR_NAME, A_MNEMONIC, A_DRUG_NAME, A_RX_NO, A_DOSE, A_DOSE_UNIT, A_NET_PT_DOSE, A_DR_NAME FROM IDB.PATIENT JOIN (SELECT PO_MRN F_MRN, PIN_MNEMONIC F_MNEMONIC, POD_STRT_DTE F_START_DATE, POD_ITEM_DESC F_DRUG_NAME, PO_RX_NO F_RX_NO, POI_DOSE F_DOSE, POI_DOSE_UNIT F_DOSE_UNIT, POI_NET_PT_DOSE F_NET_PT_DOSE, PO_DR_NAME F_DR_NAME, PO_DISP_LOC_NAME F_DISP_LOC FROM IDB.PHM_ORDER JOIN IDB.PHM_ORD_DTL ON PO_ORD_SEQ = POD_ORD_SEQ AND LEFT(PO_ACCT_NO, 2) NOT IN ('00', '84') JOIN IDB.PHM_ORD_INV ON POD_ORD_SEQ = POI_ORD_SEQ AND POD_ITEM_NO = POI_ITEM_NO JOIN IDB.PHM_INVENTORY ON POI_INV_SEQ = PIN_INV_SEQ AND PIN_MNEMONIC IN ('FLU50I10', 'FLU50I100', 'FLU50I50', 'FLUC50I100') WHERE POD_STRT_DTE >= '2006-01-01' AND PO_ORD_STS NOT IN ('X', 'P') AND PO_DISP_LOC_NAME = '53rd Street Clinic' ) AS F ON F_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN (SELECT PO_MRN L_MRN, PIN_MNEMONIC L_MNEMONIC, POD_STRT_DTE L_START_DATE, POD_ITEM_DESC L_DRUG_NAME, PO_RX_NO L_RX_NO, POI_DOSE L_DOSE, POI_DOSE_UNIT L_DOSE_UNIT, POI_NET_PT_DOSE L_NET_PT_DOSE, PO_DR_NAME L_DR_NAME, PO_DISP_LOC_NAME L_DISP_LOC FROM IDB.PHM_ORDER JOIN IDB.PHM_ORD_DTL ON PO_ORD_SEQ = POD_ORD_SEQ AND LEFT(PO_ACCT_NO, 2) NOT IN ('00', '84') JOIN IDB.PHM_ORD_INV ON
