POD_ORD_SEQ = POI_ORD_SEQ AND POD_ITEM_NO = POI_ITEM_NO JOIN IDB.PHM_INVENTORY ON POI_INV_SEQ = PIN_INV_SEQ AND PIN_MNEMONIC IN ('LEU100I', 'LEU10I50', 'LEU200I', 'LEU350I', 'LEUC100I', 'LEUC350I') WHERE POD_STRT_DTE >= '2006-01-01' AND PO_ORD_STS NOT IN ('X', 'P') AND PO_DISP_LOC_NAME = '53rd Street Clinic' ) AS L ON L_MRN = F_MRN AND L_START_DATE = F_START_DATE AND L_DISP_LOC = F_DISP_LOC JOIN (SELECT PO_MRN O_MRN, PIN_MNEMONIC O_MNEMONIC, POD_STRT_DTE O_START_DATE, POD_ITEM_DESC AS O_DRUG_NAME, PO_RX_NO AS O_RX_NO, POI_DOSE AS O_DOSE, POI_DOSE_UNIT AS O_DOSE_UNIT, POI_NET_PT_DOSE AS O_NET_PT_DOSE, PO_DR_NAME AS O_DR_NAME, PO_DISP_LOC_NAME AS O_DISP_LOC FROM IDB.PHM_ORDER JOIN IDB.PHM_ORD_DTL ON PO_ORD_SEQ = POD_ORD_SEQ AND LEFT(PO_ACCT_NO, 2) NOT IN ('00', '84') JOIN IDB.PHM_ORD_INV ON POD_ORD_SEQ = POI_ORD_SEQ AND POD_ITEM_NO = POI_ITEM_NO JOIN IDB.PHM_INVENTORY ON POI_INV_SEQ = PIN_INV_SEQ AND PIN_MNEMONIC IN ('OXA100I', 'OXA100INV', 'OXA50I', 'OXA50INV') WHERE POD_STRT_DTE >= '2006-01-01' AND PO_ORD_STS NOT IN ('X', 'P') AND PO_DISP_LOC_NAME = '53rd Street Clinic' ) AS O ON O_MRN = F_MRN AND O_START_DATE = F_START_DATE AND O_DISP_LOC = F_DISP_LOC LEFT JOIN (SELECT PA_MRN A_MRN, PIN_MNEMONIC A_MNEMONIC, POD_STRT_DTE A_START_DATE, POD_ITEM_DESC AS A_DRUG_NAME, PA_RX_NO AS A_RX_NO, POI_DOSE AS A_DOSE, POI_DOSE_UNIT AS A_DOSE_UNIT, POI_NET_PT_DOSE AS A_NET_PT_DOSE, PA_DR_NAME AS A_DR_NAME, PA_DISP_LOC_NAME AS A_DISP_LOC FROM IDB.PHM_ORDER JOIN IDB.PHM_ORD_DTL ON PA_ORD_SEQ = POD_ORD_SEQ AND LEFT(PA_ACCT_NO, 2) NOT IN ('00', '84') JOIN IDB.PHM_ORD_INV ON POD_ORD_SEQ = POI_ORD_SEQ AND POD_ITEM_NO = POI_ITEM_NO JOIN IDB.PHM_INVENTORY ON POI_INV_SEQ = PIN_INV_SEQ AND PIN_MNEMONIC IN ('APR125C', 'APR125INV', 'APR80C', 'APR80INV', 'APRP') WHERE POD_STRT_DTE >= '2006-01-01' AND PA_ORD_STS NOT IN ('X', 'P') AND PA_DISP_LOC_NAME = '53rd Street Clinic' ) AS A ON A_MRN = F_MRN AND A_START_DATE = F_START_DATE AND A_DISP_LOC = F_DISP_LOC

prompt: Provide an ongoing weekly report of treatment-naïve patients who are diagnosed with either UPS, MFS, LPS, or LMS (any sub-type) and have a clinic visit scheduled.
completion: WITH LMS_LPS_UPS AS (SELECT DISTINCT TM_MRN LMS_MRN FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND TM_HIST_CD IN ('M8890/0', 'M8890/1', 'M8890/3', 'M8890/6', 'M8850/3', 'M8851/3', 'M8852/3', 'M8853/3', 'M8854/3', 'M8855/3', 'M8857/3', 'M8858/3', 'M8860/3', 'M8830/3') ), UPCOMING_VISIT AS (SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN, CRE_RES_NAME ATN_NAME, CPE_ENC_DTE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CPE_MRN ORDER BY CPE_ENC_DTE DESC) RN FROM LMS_LPS_UPS JOIN IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER ON LMS_MRN = CPE_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Sch') AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT date AND CURRENT date + 14 DAY ) , HAS_METS AS (SELECT DISTINCT CC_MRN METS_MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) METS_DX_DTE FROM UPCOMING_VISIT JOIN IDB.CTC_CLSF ON CPE_MRN = CC_MRN JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE (CC_CLSF_CD BETWEEN '196' AND '198.999' OR CC_CLSF_CD BETWEEN 'C77' AND 'C79.999') AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND (CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) GROUP BY CC_MRN) , NO_TX AS (SELECT METS_MRN NO_TX_MRN, METS_DX_DTE FROM HAS_METS WHERE METS_MRN NOT IN (SELECT SSE_MRN FROM IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE ON SSE_LOG_ID = SSP_LOG_ID AND SSE_ENC_CSN_ID = SSP_ENC_CSN_ID WHERE (SSE_SURG_LOC not like '%IR%' AND SSE_SURG_LOC not like '%ENDO%' AND SSE_SOURCE_TYPE <> 'E') ) AND METS_MRN NOT IN (SELECT APR_MRN FROM IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX) AND METS_MRN NOT IN (SELECT RTC_TX_MRN FROM IDB.RADONC_TREATMENT_COURSE) ) SELECT TM_MRN, CHAR(PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) DOB, PT_SEX, AV_DESC AS CASE_STS, CHAR(TM_DX_DTE) TM_DX_DTE, TM_HIST_CD, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS HIST_DESC, TM_SITE_CD, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_DESC, CHAR(METS_DX_DTE) METS_DX_DTE, ATN_NAME, CHAR(CPE_ENC_DTE) NEXT_CLINIC_DTE FROM NO_TX JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PT_MRN = NO_TX_MRN JOIN IDB.CDB_TUMOR ON TM_MRN = NO_TX_MRN JOIN UPCOMING_VISIT ON CPE_MRN = NO_TX_MRN AND RN = 1 JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS ON AV_ELEMENT = 'CASE_STS' AND AV_CODE = TM_CASE_STS AND TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') ;

prompt: Provide a weekly list of breast patients starting systemic treatment (NV1, 2, and 3)
completion: WITH BRE AS (SELECT CPE_MRN AS "MRN", CASE WHEN PT_DATE_OF_DEATH IS NULL THEN YEAR(CURRENT DATE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) ELSE YEAR(PT_DATE_OF_DEATH - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) END AS "AGE", CPE_ENC_DTE AS "NV Appt Date", CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 AS "Department", CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 AS "Service", CLD_DEPT_NAME AS "Department Name", CRE_RES_NAME AS "Treating MD", CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME AS "Visit Type", CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON CPE_MRN = PT_MRN AND PT_SEX = 'F' AND YEAR(CURRENT DATE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) BETWEEN 18 AND 45 JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 = 'MED' AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 = 'BRE' JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT DATE - 7 DAY AND CURRENT DATE AND (CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR LIKE '%NV%') AND CPE_MRN NOT IN (SELECT APR_MRN FROM IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX_V WHERE CDG_CHEMO_FLAG = 'Y') ), SCH_CHM AS (SELECT CPE_MRN AS SH_MRN , CPE_ENC_DTE AS SH_ENC_DT , CLD_DEPT_NAME FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN BRE ON CPE_MRN = "MRN" JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Sch') AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 = 'CHM' AND CRE_RES_TYP = 'Chemotherapy Unit' ), ICD AS (SELECT CC_MRN, CLM_CLSF_CD AS ICD_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS ICD_DESC, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS ICD_DT FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CLM_CLSF_CD = CC_CLSF_CD JOIN BRE ON "MRN" = CC_MRN WHERE CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND ((CC_PT_TYPE = 'I') OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) GROUP BY CC_MRN, CLM_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK ), ICD1 AS (SELECT DISTINCT CC_MRN, LISTAGG (COALESCE(STRIP(ICD_DT), '') || ' | ' || COALESCE(STRIP(CAST(ICD_CD AS VARCHAR(12000))), '') || ' | ' || COALESCE(STRIP(CAST(ICD_DESC AS VARCHAR(12000))), '') , CHR(13) || CHR(10)) WITHIN GROUP( ORDER BY CC_MRN, ICD_DT, ICD_CD, ICD_DESC) AS ICD_1 FROM ICD GROUP BY CC_MRN), ICDO AS (SELECT DISTINCT TM_MRN, TM_DX_DTE AS DX_DATE, TM_SITE_CD AS DX_CODE, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS DX_DESC, TM_HIST_CD AS HIST_CODE, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS HIST_DESC, CASE WHEN TM_BEST_AJCC_STG NOT IN ('', '88', '9', '99') THEN TM_BEST_AJCC_STG WHEN TM_AJCC_7 NOT IN ('', '888', '999') THEN AJCC7.AV_DESC WHEN TM_AJCC NOT IN ('', '88', '99') THEN AJCC.AV_DESC WHEN TM_GENERAL_STG NOT IN ('', '9') THEN GS.AV_DESC WHEN TM_PATH_STG_GRP NOT IN ('', '88', '9', '99') THEN TM_PATH_STG_GRP ELSE CLIN.AV_DESC END AS STAGE FROM BRE JOIN IDB.CDB_TUMOR ON TM_MRN = "MRN" JOIN IDB.SEERGROUPING ON RECODE = IDB.SEERF_ICDO(TM_SITE_CD, TM_HIST_CD) JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS AJCC7 ON AJCC7.AV_ELEMENT = 'AJCC_7' AND AJCC7.AV_CODE = TM_AJCC_7 LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS AJCC ON AJCC.AV_ELEMENT = 'AJCC' AND AJCC.AV_CODE = TM_AJCC LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS GS ON GS.AV_ELEMENT = 'GENERAL_STG' AND GS.AV_CODE = TM_GENERAL_STG LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS CLIN ON CLIN.AV_ELEMENT = 'CLIN_STG_DSCR' AND CLIN.AV_CODE = TM_CLIN_STG_DSCR WHERE 1=1 AND TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') ), ICDO_1 AS (SELECT DISTINCT TM_MRN, LISTAGG (COALESCE(STRIP(DX_DATE), '') || ' | ' || COALESCE(STRIP(CAST(DX_CODE AS VARCHAR(12000))), '') || ' | ' || COALESCE(STRIP(CAST(DX_DESC AS VARCHAR(12000))), '') || ' | ' || COALESCE(STRIP(CAST(HIST_CODE AS VARCHAR(12000))), '') || ' | ' || COALESCE(STRIP(CAST(HIST_DESC AS VARCHAR(12000))), '') || ' | ' || COALESCE(STRIP(CAST(STAGE AS VARCHAR(12000))), '') , CHR(13) || CHR(10)) WITHIN GROUP( ORDER BY TM_MRN, DX_DATE, DX_CODE, DX_DESC, HIST_CODE, HIST_DESC, STAGE) AS ICD_O FROM ICDO GROUP BY TM_MRN), IMP AS (SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN, PDWS_NAME AS ASSAYNAME, DV.TODATE(DV.REGEXSTR('[0-9]*[\-|\.|\/][0-9]*[\-|\.|\/][0-9]*', T1.DT_PROCEDURE)) AS PROCEDUREDATE, T1.DT_PROCEDURE AS DT_PROCEDURE, TUMOR_TYPE_CODE, TUMOR_TYPE_NAME, IS_METASTASIS, PRIMARY_SITE, METASTASIS_SITE FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS PD ON PDRX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PD.PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID JOIN BRE ON "MRN" = PD.PT_MRN INNER JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML_SETTINGS ON PDRX_PATH_DMP_RESULTS_XML_ID = PDRXS_PATH_DMP_RESULTS_XML_ID INNER JOIN DVDMC.PATHOLOGY_DMP_WEBSVC_SETTINGS ON PDRXS_SETTING_ID = PDWS_SETTING_ID, XMLTABLE('$x/root/meta-data' PASSING PDRX_XML_VALUE AS "x" COLUMNS DT_PROCEDURE VARCHAR(40) PATH 'dt_procedure', DT_SIGNOUT VARCHAR(40) PATH 'dt_signout', TUMOR_TYPE_CODE VARCHAR(100) PATH 'tumor_type_code', TUMOR_TYPE_NAME VARCHAR(255) PATH 'tumor_type_name', IS_METASTASIS VARCHAR(10) PATH 'is_metastasis', PRIMARY_SITE VARCHAR(255) PATH 'primary_site', METASTASIS_SITE VARCHAR(255) PATH 'metastasis_site') T1 WHERE PDWS_NAME like 'IMPACT%' AND (UPPER (TUMOR_TYPE_NAME) LIKE ('%BREAST%') OR UPPER (PRIMARY_SITE) LIKE ('%BREAST%') ) ), IMP_1 AS (SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN AS IMP_MRN, LISTAGG(COALESCE(STRIP(CAST(DT_PROCEDURE AS VARCHAR(12000))), '') || ' : ' || COALESCE(STRIP(CAST(TUMOR_TYPE_NAME AS VARCHAR(12000))), '') || ' : ' || COALESCE(STRIP(CAST(PRIMARY_SITE AS VARCHAR(12000))), '') || ' : ' || COALESCE(STRIP(CAST(METASTASIS_SITE AS VARCHAR(12000))), '') , CHR(13) || CHR(10)) WITHIN GROUP( ORDER BY PT_MRN, DT_PROCEDURE, TUMOR_TYPE_NAME, PRIMARY_SITE, METASTASIS_SITE) AS DX_IMPACT FROM IMP GROUP BY PT_MRN) SELECT DISTINCT "MRN" , "AGE" , "NV Appt Date" , "Treating MD" , "Visit Type" , SH_ENC_DT "SCH CHEMO VISIT DT" , A1.ICD_1 , A2.ICD_O , DX_IMPACT FROM BRE LEFT JOIN SCH_CHM ON "MRN" = SH_MRN LEFT JOIN ICD1 A1 ON "MRN" = A1.CC_MRN LEFT JOIN ICDO_1 A2 ON "MRN" = A2.TM_MRN LEFT JOIN IMP_1 A3 ON "MRN" = A3.IMP_MRN

prompt: Provide a daily report of mammograms scheduled at the Breast and Imaging Center in the last 24 hours.
completion: SELECT CPE_ENC_DTE AS "Appt Date", TIME(CPE_APPT_DT) AS "Appt Time", CPE_MRN AS "MRN", PT_LAST_NAME "Last Name", PT_FIRST_NAME "First Name", CPE_APPT_MADE_DTE "Appt Create Date", CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 AS "Department", CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 AS "Service", CLD_DEPT_NAME AS "Department Name", CRE_RES_NAME AS "Provider Name", CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME AS "Visit Type", CPE_CPE_APPT_STS AS "Appt Status" FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON CPE_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE 1=1 AND CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Sch') AND CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID IN ('1482', '1487', '7534', '7535', '7536') AND CLD_DEPT_ID IN ('599') AND CRE_RES_ID IN ('200150', '200803', '201877', '200079', '200080', '201875') AND DATE(CPE_APPT_MADE_DTE) >= CURRENT date - 1 DAY ORDER BY CPE_ENC_DTE, TIME(CPE_APPT_DT) ASC ;

prompt: requesting a list of accrued patients on 11-153, 12-153, and 12-228 as part of a large data and protocol QA project under the cords transplant program
completion: WITH PROTOCOL_0 AS (SELECT "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AS PT_DEID, "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_MRN" AS PT_MRN, CAST(TRIM("IDB"."ACCRUALS"."AC_CONS_DTE") AS VARCHAR) || CAST(TRIM("IDB"."ACCRUALS"."AC_MRN") AS VARCHAR) || CAST(TRIM("IDB"."ACCRUALS"."AC_IRB_NO") AS VARCHAR) AS SUBJECT_ID, "IDB"."ACCRUALS"."AC_IRB_NO" AS AC_IRB_NO FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS" JOIN "IDB"."ACCRUALS" ON "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_MRN" = "IDB"."ACCRUALS"."AC_MRN" WHERE "IDB"."ACCRUALS"."AC_NON_MSK_INST" = '' AND "IDB"."ACCRUALS"."AC_IRB_NO" IN ('11-153', '12-153', '12-228')), COHORT AS (SELECT PT_DEID AS PT_DEID FROM (SELECT PROTOCOL_0.PT_DEID AS PT_DEID FROM PROTOCOL_0)), COHORT_PROTOCOL AS (SELECT SUBJECT_ID AS SUBJECT_ID, PT_DEID AS PT_DEID FROM (SELECT PROTOCOL_0.SUBJECT_ID AS SUBJECT_ID, PROTOCOL_0.PT_DEID AS PT_DEID FROM PROTOCOL_0)), KEYS AS (SELECT COHORT.PT_DEID AS COHORT_PT_DEID, COHORT_PROTOCOL.SUBJECT_ID AS COHORT_PROTOCOL_SUBJECT_ID, COHORT_PROTOCOL.PT_DEID AS COHORT_PROTOCOL_PT_DEID FROM COHORT LEFT OUTER JOIN COHORT_PROTOCOL ON COHORT_PROTOCOL.PT_DEID = COHORT.PT_DEID), DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS AS (SELECT DISTINCT "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AS PT_DEID, "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_MRN" AS PT_MRN, "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AS SUBJECT_ID, DMP_ID_TBL."PDRX_DMP_PATIENT_ID" AS DMP_ID, TRIM("DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_LAST_NAME") || ', ' || TRIM("DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_FIRST_NAME") AS PT_NAME, "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_SEX_DESC" AS GENDER, "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_VITAL_STATUS" AS VITAL_STATS, "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_BIRTH_DTE" AS DATE_OF_BIRTH, "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_DEATH_DTE" AS DATE_OF_DEATH, ALLOWVALS_RACE."AV_DESC" AS RACE, ALLOWVALS_ETHNICITY."AV_DESC" AS ETHNICITY, ALLOWVALS_LANGUAGE."AV_DESC" AS PRIMARY_LANGUAGE, "DV".PATIENT_LATEST_ACTIVITY."PLA_LAST_ACTV_DTE" AS LAST_ACTIVITY_DATE, "DV".PATIENT_LATEST_ACTIVITY."PLA_LAST_CONTACT_DTE" AS LAST_CONTACT_DATE FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS" LEFT OUTER JOIN "DV"."PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML" AS DMP_ID_TBL ON DMP_ID_TBL."PDRX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT OUTER JOIN "IDB"."PATIENT" AS IDB_PATIENT ON "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_MRN" = IDB_PATIENT."PT_MRN" LEFT OUTER JOIN "IDB"."ALLOWVALS" AS ALLOWVALS_RACE ON IDB_PATIENT."PT_RACE" = ALLOWVALS_RACE."AV_CODE" AND ALLOWVALS_RACE."AV_ELEMENT" = 'RACE' LEFT OUTER JOIN "IDB"."ALLOWVALS" AS ALLOWVALS_ETHNICITY ON IDB_PATIENT."PT_PT_ETHNICITY" = ALLOWVALS_ETHNICITY."AV_CODE" AND ALLOWVALS_ETHNICITY."AV_ELEMENT" = 'PT_ETHNICITY' LEFT OUTER JOIN "IDB"."ALLOWVALS" AS ALLOWVALS_LANGUAGE ON IDB_PATIENT."PT_PRIMARY_LANG" = ALLOWVALS_LANGUAGE."AV_CODE" AND ALLOWVALS_LANGUAGE."AV_ELEMENT" = 'PRIMARY_LANG' LEFT OUTER JOIN "DV".PATIENT_LATEST_ACTIVITY ON "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "DV".PATIENT_LATEST_ACTIVITY."PLA_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID") SELECT DISTINCT DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS.PT_MRN AS MRN, DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS.DMP_ID AS DMP_ID, DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS.PT_NAME AS PT_NAME, DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS.GENDER AS GENDER, DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS.VITAL_STATS AS VITAL_STATUS, DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS.DATE_OF_BIRTH AS DATE_OF_BIRTH, DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS.DATE_OF_DEATH AS DATE_OF_DEATH, DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS.RACE AS RACE, DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS.ETHNICITY AS ETHNICITY, DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS.PRIMARY_LANGUAGE AS PRIMARY_LANGUAGE, DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS.LAST_ACTIVITY_DATE AS LAST_ACTIVITY_DATE, DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS.LAST_CONTACT_DATE AS LAST_CONTACT_DATE FROM KEYS LEFT OUTER JOIN DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS ON DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS.PT_DEID = KEYS.COHORT_PT_DEID; WITH PROTOCOL_0 AS (SELECT "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AS PT_DEID, "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_MRN" AS PT_MRN, CAST(TRIM("IDB"."ACCRUALS"."AC_CONS_DTE") AS VARCHAR) || CAST(TRIM("IDB"."ACCRUALS"."AC_MRN") AS VARCHAR) || CAST(TRIM("IDB"."ACCRUALS"."AC_IRB_NO") AS VARCHAR) AS SUBJECT_ID, "IDB"."ACCRUALS"."AC_IRB_NO" AS AC_IRB_NO FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS" JOIN "IDB"."ACCRUALS" ON "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_MRN" = "IDB"."ACCRUALS"."AC_MRN" WHERE "IDB"."ACCRUALS"."AC_NON_MSK_INST" = '' AND "IDB"."ACCRUALS"."AC_IRB_NO" IN ('11-153', '12-153', '12-228')), COHORT AS (SELECT PT_DEID AS PT_DEID FROM (SELECT PROTOCOL_0.PT_DEID AS PT_DEID FROM PROTOCOL_0)), COHORT_PROTOCOL AS (SELECT SUBJECT_ID AS SUBJECT_ID, PT_DEID AS PT_DEID FROM (SELECT PROTOCOL_0.SUBJECT_ID AS SUBJECT_ID, PROTOCOL_0.PT_DEID AS PT_DEID FROM PROTOCOL_0)), KEYS AS (SELECT COHORT.PT_DEID AS COHORT_PT_DEID, COHORT_PROTOCOL.SUBJECT_ID AS COHORT_PROTOCOL_SUBJECT_ID, COHORT_PROTOCOL.PT_DEID AS COHORT_PROTOCOL_PT_DEID FROM COHORT LEFT OUTER JOIN COHORT_PROTOCOL ON COHORT_PROTOCOL.PT_DEID = COHORT.PT_DEID), DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS AS (SELECT DISTINCT "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AS PT_DEID, "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_MRN" AS PT_MRN, "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AS SUBJECT_ID FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"), PROTOCOL_COLUMNS AS (SELECT DISTINCT "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AS PT_DEID, "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_MRN" AS PT_MRN, CAST(TRIM("IDB"."ACCRUALS"."AC_CONS_DTE") AS VARCHAR) || CAST(TRIM("IDB"."ACCRUALS"."AC_MRN") AS VARCHAR) || CAST(TRIM("IDB"."ACCRUALS"."AC_IRB_NO") AS VARCHAR) AS SUBJECT_ID, "IDB"."ACCRUALS"."AC_CONS_DTE" AS AC_CONS_DTE, "IDB"."ACCRUALS"."AC_IRB_NO" AS AC_IRB_NO, "IDB"."PROTOCOL"."PRO_IRB_TITLE" AS PRO_IRB_TITLE FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS" JOIN "IDB"."ACCRUALS" ON "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_MRN" = "IDB"."ACCRUALS"."AC_MRN" JOIN "IDB"."PROTOCOL" ON "IDB"."ACCRUALS"."AC_IRB_NO" = "IDB"."PROTOCOL"."PRO_IRB_NO") SELECT DISTINCT DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS.PT_MRN AS MRN, PROTOCOL_COLUMNS.AC_CONS_DTE AS AC_CONS_DTE, PROTOCOL_COLUMNS.AC_IRB_NO AS AC_IRB_NO, PROTOCOL_COLUMNS.PRO_IRB_TITLE AS PRO_IRB_TITLE FROM KEYS LEFT OUTER JOIN DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS ON DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS.PT_DEID = KEYS.COHORT_PT_DEID LEFT OUTER JOIN PROTOCOL_COLUMNS ON PROTOCOL_COLUMNS.SUBJECT_ID = KEYS.COHORT_PROTOCOL_SUBJECT_ID;

prompt: Provide genetic, RT, antineoplastic, surgery, and demographic data for patients who have had NGS tests which indicate specific salivary type histologies.
completion: WITH DMP_DX_PRE AS (SELECT DISTINCT PDRX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID AS P_ID, RPT.DT_DTE AS REPORT_DATE , PT_MRN AS DMP_MRN , DT.PDRX_PATH_RPT_ID AS R_ID, PRPT_ACCESSION_NO AS "M Accession" , DMP_PATIENT_ID , DMP_SAMPLE_ID , DV.TODATE(DT_PROCEDURE) AS "Procedure Date" , DT_PROCEDURE , PRIMARY_SITE , TUMOR_TYPE_CODE , TUMOR_TYPE_NAME , METASTASIS_SITE , GENE_PANEL , PART_DESCRIPTION FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML DT CROSS JOIN XMLTABLE('$c/root/*' PASSING DT.PDRX_XML_VALUE AS "c" COLUMNS DMP_PATIENT_ID VARCHAR(264) PATH '../meta-data/dmp_patient_id', DMP_SAMPLE_ID VARCHAR(264) PATH '../meta-data/dmp_sample_id' , DT_PROCEDURE VARCHAR(100) PATH '../meta-data/dt_procedure', PRIMARY_SITE VARCHAR(264) PATH '../meta-data/primary_site', TUMOR_TYPE_NAME VARCHAR(264) PATH '../meta-data/tumor_type_name' , TUMOR_TYPE_CODE VARCHAR(264) PATH '../meta-data/tumor_type_code', METASTASIS_SITE VARCHAR(264) PATH '../meta-data/metastasis_site' , GENE_PANEL VARCHAR(264) PATH '../meta-data/gene-panel' , PART_DESCRIPTION VARCHAR(264) PATH '../meta-data/part_description') T JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON PDRX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID INNER JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML_SETTINGS ON PDRX_PATH_DMP_RESULTS_XML_ID = PDRXS_PATH_DMP_RESULTS_XML_ID LEFT JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V PRV ON PRV.PRPT_PATH_RPT_ID = PDRX_PATH_RPT_ID LEFT JOIN DV.DATE_V RPT ON RPT.DT_DATE_ID = PRPT_REPORT_DATE_ID WHERE 1=1 AND (TUMOR_TYPE_CODE IN ('SDCA', 'CAEXPA', 'MUCC', 'PAC', 'SAAD', 'OSACA', 'SACA') OR UPPER(TUMOR_TYPE_NAME) like '%SALIV%' ) AND TUMOR_TYPE_CODE NOT IN ('HNMASC', 'SGTTL', 'SGO', 'ACCC', 'ACYC', 'PADA') ) , DMP_DATA_OUT AS (SELECT DMP_MRN AS MRN , "M Accession", DMP_PATIENT_ID, DMP_SAMPLE_ID, "Procedure Date", DT_PROCEDURE, PRIMARY_SITE, TUMOR_TYPE_NAME, METASTASIS_SITE, GENE_PANEL , DV.REGEXSTR('(S|H|C|M|F|B|DMG)[0-9]{2}[\s|-][0-9]*', PART_DESCRIPTION) AS "Referenced Accession" , PART_DESCRIPTION FROM DMP_DX_PRE) , PHI (PHI) AS ( VALUES ('Y')) , ICD9DXCODES AS (SELECT DXA_ATTRIBUTE_ID FROM DV.DIAGNOSIS_ATTRIBUTE WHERE DXA_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND DXA_CIC_CDER_INIT = 'YES') , DT AS (SELECT DISTINCT DMP_MRN AS MRN , P_ID AS PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID FROM DMP_DX_PRE) , RT_FROM_PA_PRE AS (SELECT MRN, SVC_DTE, RAD_TYPE, SOURCE_IND, SVC_CD, SVC_DESC, DPT_CD, DPT_DESC, IP_OP_IND, SUM(AMT) AS SVC_AMT, SUM(QTY) AS SVC_QTY, RMS_VISIT_ID, RMS_ADM_NUM, SMS_ACCT_NO FROM (SELECT DTL_MRN AS MRN, DTL_SVC_DTE AS SVC_DTE, RAD_TYPE, 'SMS' AS SOURCE_IND, DTL_SVC_CD AS SVC_CD, CDM_SVC_DESC AS SVC_DESC, CDM_DPT_CD AS DPT_CD, AV_DESC AS DPT_DESC, DTL_IP_OP_IND AS IP_OP_IND, DTL_SVC_AMT AS AMT, DTL_SVC_QTY AS QTY, 0 AS RMS_VISIT_ID, DTL_ACCT_NO AS RMS_ADM_NUM, DTL_ACCT_NO AS SMS_ACCT_NO FROM DT DT JOIN IDB.PA_DETAIL ON MRN = DTL_MRN JOIN IDB.CDM ON CDM_SVC_CD = DTL_SVC_CD JOIN IDB.RADIATION_TYPES ON RAD_SVC_CD = DTL_SVC_CD AND RAD_SOURCE = 'SMS' LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS ON CDM_DPT_CD = AV_CODE AND AV_ELEMENT = 'DPT_CD' WHERE DTL_DTL_TYPE = 'C' AND DTL_SVC_DTE <= '2018-12-31' UNION ALL SELECT RVCD_MRN AS MRN, RVCD_SVC_DTE AS SVC_DTE, RAD_TYPE, 'RMS' AS SOURCE_IND, RCDD_CHARGE_CD AS SVC_CD, RCDD_CHARGE_DESCRIPTION AS SVC_DESC, RDPD_DEPARTMENT_MNEMONIC AS DPT_CD, RDPD_DEPARTMENT_NAME AS DPT_DESC, VIS_IP_OP_ADJUSTED_IND AS IP_OP_IND, RVCD_AMT AS AMT, RVCD_UNITS AS QTY, VIS_VISIT_ID AS RMS_VISIT_ID, VIS_ADM_NUM AS RMS_ADM_NUM, ' ' AS SMS_ACCT_NO FROM DT DT JOIN IDB.RMS_VISIT_CHARGE_DTL ON MRN = RVCD_MRN JOIN IDB.VISIT ON RVCD_VISIT_ID = VIS_VISIT_ID JOIN IDB.RMS_CHARGE_CODE_DICT_DN1240 ON RVCD_CHARGE_CODE_REC_NO = RCDD_RECORD_NUMBER JOIN IDB.RMS_DEPARTMENT_DICT_DN1301 ON RVCD_CHARGE_DEPT_REC_NO = RDPD_RECORD_NUMBER JOIN IDB.RADIATION_TYPES ON RAD_SVC_CD = RCDD_CHARGE_CD AND RAD_SOURCE = 'RMS' WHERE RVCD_SVC_DTE >= '2017-11-01' ) A GROUP BY MRN, SVC_DTE, A.RAD_TYPE, SOURCE_IND, SVC_CD, SVC_DESC, DPT_CD, DPT_DESC, IP_OP_IND, RMS_VISIT_ID, RMS_ADM_NUM, SMS_ACCT_NO HAVING SUM(QTY) > 0) , RT_FROM_PA AS (SELECT MRN, MIN(SVC_DTE) AS MIN_DTE, MAX(SVC_DTE) AS MAX_DTE, RAD_TYPE, SVC_DESC FROM RT_FROM_PA_PRE GROUP BY MRN, RAD_TYPE, SVC_DESC) , RT_FROM_PA_LISTAGG AS (SELECT MRN AS RT_FROM_PA_MRN, LISTAGG(COALESCE(MIN_DTE, '') || ' | ' || COALESCE(MAX_DTE, '') || ' | ' || COALESCE(TRIM(CAST(RAD_TYPE AS VARCHAR(3900))), '') || ' | ' || COALESCE(TRIM(SVC_DESC), ''), CHR(13) || CHR(10)) WITHIN GROUP( ORDER BY MRN, MIN_DTE) AS "RT Info from Patient Accounts" FROM RT_FROM_PA GROUP BY MRN) , ANTINEO_PRE AS (SELECT APR_MRN , APR_GENERIC_NAME , MIN(COALESCE(APR_START_DTE, APR_ORD_CREATE_DTE)) AS MIN_START_DTE_VAR , MAX(APR_END_DTE) AS MAX_END_DTE FROM IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX_V JOIN DT ON APR_MRN = MRN WHERE 1=1 GROUP BY APR_MRN , APR_GENERIC_NAME) , ANTINEO_LISTAGG AS (SELECT APR_MRN, LISTAGG(COALESCE(TRIM(APR_GENERIC_NAME), '') || ' | ' || COALESCE(TRIM(CAST(MIN_START_DTE_VAR AS VARCHAR(12000))), '') || ' | ' || COALESCE(TRIM(MAX_END_DTE), '') , CHR(13) || CHR(10)) WITHIN GROUP( ORDER BY MIN_START_DTE_VAR) AS "Antineoplastic Source" FROM ANTINEO_PRE GROUP BY APR_MRN) , ANTINEO_DETAIL AS (SELECT DISTINCT APR_MRN AS MRN , APR_START_DTE AS "Start Date", APR_END_DTE AS "End Date", APR_ORD_CREATE_DTE AS "Create Date" , CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME AS "Common Generic Name" , APR_DRUG_NAME AS "Drug Name" , APR_ORD_RX_TYPE AS "Rx Type" , APR_ROUTE AS "Route" , APR_QTY AS "Qty", APR_FREQ AS "Freq", APR_DURATION AS "Duration", APR_DIAGNOSIS_DESC AS "Diagnosis Desc", APR_PROVIDER_NAME AS "Provider Name", APR_PROVIDER_ROLE AS "Provider Role" , APR_TOTAL_GIVEN_DOSE AS "Given Dose" , APR_PERFORMED_ORDERS_QTY_TEXT AS "Performed Orders QTY" , APR_SET_NAME AS "Set Name", APR_SET_FORM_NAME AS "Set Form Name" , APR_INVESTIGATIVE_FLAG AS "Investigative Flag", APR_PLACEBO_FLAG AS "Placebo", APR_TOPICAL_FLAG AS "Topical", CDG_CLASSIC_CHEMO_FLAG AS "Classic Chemo", CDG_BIOLOGIC_IMMUNO_FLAG AS "Biologic" , CDG_TARGETED_FLAG AS "Targeted", CDG_HORMONE_FLAG AS "Hormone", CDG_BONE_AGENTS_FLAG AS "Bone Agents", CDG_THERAPEUTIC_CATEGORY AS "Therapeutic Category" FROM IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX_V APR JOIN DT DT ON MRN = APR_MRN) SELECT * FROM ANTINEO_DETAIL ORDER BY MRN, "Common Generic Name", "Start Date" ;

prompt: List of patients with Neuroendocrine disease of the lungs, with FDG and 68Ga-Dotatate PET/CTs within 90 days of each other
completion: WITH GA68 AS (SELECT RRPT_MRN "gmrn", RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE "Date of Ga68 PET/CT" FROM DV.RADIOLOGY_REPORT_V WHERE RRPT_ANC_CODE IN ('PETGA68DOT') ) , FDG AS (SELECT RRPT_MRN "fmrn", RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE "Date of FDG PET/CT" FROM GA68 JOIN DV.RADIOLOGY_REPORT_V ON "gmrn" = RRPT_MRN WHERE RRPT_ANC_CODE IN ('PETCAP', 'PETHCAP', 'PETHTT', 'PETNCAP', 'PETVCARD', 'PMRHCAP', 'PMRHTT', 'PMRNCAP') ) SELECT DISTINCT "gmrn", "Date of FDG PET/CT", "Date of Ga68 PET/CT", ABS(DAYS("Date of FDG PET/CT") - DAYS("Date of Ga68 PET/CT")) "Abs Difference in Days", H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS HIST_DESC, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_DESC, I.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS ICD9_DESC FROM GA68 JOIN FDG ON "gmrn" = "fmrn" LEFT JOIN IDB.CDB_TUMOR ON "gmrn" = TM_MRN AND TM_SITE_CD LIKE 'C34%' LEFT JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD LEFT JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD LEFT JOIN IDB.CTC_CLSF ON "gmrn" = CC_MRN AND SUBSTR(CC_CLSF_CD, 1, 3) IN ('162', 'C34', 'C7A', 'C7B') LEFT JOIN IDB.CLM I ON CC_CLSF_CD = I.CLM_CLSF_CD GROUP BY "gmrn", "Date of FDG PET/CT", "Date of Ga68 PET/CT", H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK, I.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK HAVING ABS(DAYS("Date of FDG PET/CT") - DAYS("Date of Ga68 PET/CT")) <= 60 ORDER BY SITE_DESC, "gmrn"

prompt: Dr. Patel is requesting a list of patients treated over the last 6 years with cpt code 31576
completion: SELECT "PATIENT"."PT_MRN", "PATIENT"."PT_LAST_NAME", "PATIENT"."PT_FIRST_NAME", "PATIENT"."PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH", "PATIENT"."PT_SEX", "PBD_DTL"."PBD_SVC_DTE", "DOC"."DOC_NAME", "PBD_CODE"."PBC_CPT_CD", "PBD_CODE"."PBC_PBD_DESC" FROM ((("IDB"."PBD_DTL" "PBD_DTL" INNER JOIN "IDB"."PBD_INVOICE" "PBD_INVOICE" ON (("PBD_DTL"."PBD_MRN"="PBD_INVOICE"."PBI_MRN") AND ("PBD_DTL"."PBD_ACCT_NO"="PBD_INVOICE"."PBI_ACCT_NO")) AND ("PBD_DTL"."PBD_INV_NO"="PBD_INVOICE"."PBI_INV_NO")) INNER JOIN "IDB"."PATIENT" "PATIENT" ON "PBD_DTL"."PBD_MRN"="PATIENT"."PT_MRN") INNER JOIN "IDB"."PBD_CODE" "PBD_CODE" ON "PBD_DTL"."PBD_PBD_CD"="PBD_CODE"."PBC_PBD_CD") INNER JOIN "IDB"."DOC" "DOC" ON "PBD_INVOICE"."PBI_PERFORM_DR_NO"="DOC"."DOC_DR_NO" WHERE "PBD_CODE"."PBC_CPT_CD"='31576' AND "PBD_DTL"."PBD_SVC_DTE">='2018-01-01' AND "DOC"."DOC_NAME" LIKE 'PATEL MBBS,SNEHAL%'

prompt: Provide a weekly report of newly positive COVID-19 or newly admitted patients with history of radiation therapy
completion: WITH PTS AS (SELECT P.MRN, P.LAST_NAME, P.FIRST_NAME, P.DATE_OF_BIRTH, P.DATE_OF_DEATH, DATE(P.MIN_IDENTIFIED_DT) COVID_DX_DATE, ADMIT_ID, ADMIT_DATE, DISCHARGE_DATE, LOS, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY P.MRN ORDER BY COALESCE(ADMIT_DATE, DATE(P.MIN_IDENTIFIED_DT)) DESC) RN FROM IDB.PATIENT_COVID_INFO_V P LEFT JOIN IDB.INPATIENT_ADMISSIONS_V A ON P.MRN = A.MRN AND ADMIT_DATE >= '2020-03-01' LEFT JOIN IDB.EMPLOYEE_COVID_INFO_V E ON P.MRN = E.MRN WHERE P.RESULT IN ('Positive', 'Resolved') AND P.MRN <> '' AND E.MRN IS NULL ) , CDB AS (SELECT TM_MRN, TM_DX_DTE, TM_HIST_CD, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS HIST_DESC, TM_SITE_CD, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_DESC FROM PTS JOIN IDB.CDB_TUMOR ON MRN = TM_MRN JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS ON AV_ELEMENT = 'CASE_STS' AND AV_CODE = TM_CASE_STS AND TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') ) , ICD AS (SELECT CC_MRN, CC_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK, MIN (CC_EFF_DTE) CC_EFF_DTE FROM PTS JOIN IDB.CTC_CLSF ON MRN = CC_MRN JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE 1=1 AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND (CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) AND CC_CLSF_CD BETWEEN 'C00.0' AND 'D49.9' AND CC_MRN NOT IN (SELECT TM_MRN FROM CDB) GROUP BY CC_MRN, CC_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK ) , COMORBID AS (SELECT CC_MRN CO_MRN, MIN(CASE WHEN CCS_SINGLE_LEVEL_DESC like 'Congestive heart failure%' THEN CC_EFF_DTE END) AS "Congestive heart failure", MIN(CASE WHEN CCS_SINGLE_LEVEL_DESC = 'Hypertension with complications and secondary hypertension' THEN CC_EFF_DTE END) AS "Hypertension", MIN(CASE WHEN CCS_SINGLE_LEVEL_DESC IN ('Diabetes mellitus with complications', 'Diabetes mellitus without complication') THEN CC_EFF_DTE END) AS "Diabetes", MIN(CASE WHEN CCS_SINGLE_LEVEL_DESC = 'Chronic obstructive pulmonary disease and bronchiectasis' THEN CC_EFF_DTE END) AS "COPD", MIN(CASE WHEN CCS_SINGLE_LEVEL_DESC = 'Asthma' THEN CC_EFF_DTE END) AS "Asthma" FROM IDB.CCS_HIER JOIN IDB.CLM ON CCS_ICD_CODE = CLM_CLSF_CD AND CLM_CD_TYPE = 'D' JOIN IDB.CTC_CLSF ON CLM_CLSF_CD = CC_CLSF_CD JOIN PTS ON CC_MRN = MRN WHERE (CCS_SINGLE_LEVEL_DESC like 'Congestive heart failure%' OR CCS_SINGLE_LEVEL_DESC IN ('Hypertension with complications and secondary hypertension', 'Diabetes mellitus with complications', 'Diabetes mellitus without complication', 'Chronic obstructive pulmonary disease and bronchiectasis', 'Asthma')) AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND (CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) GROUP BY CC_MRN) , TUMOR AS (SELECT TM_MRN, LISTAGG(TUMOR, CHR(13)||CHR(10)) TUMOR FROM (SELECT TM_MRN, CHAR(TM_DX_DTE) ||': ' || TRIM(TM_SITE_CD) || ' ' || TRIM(SITE_DESC) || ' ' || TRIM(TM_HIST_CD) || ' ' || TRIM(HIST_DESC) TUMOR FROM CDB UNION SELECT CC_MRN TM_MRN, CHAR(CC_EFF_DTE) || ': ' || TRIM (CC_CLSF_CD) || ' ' || TRIM (CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK) TUMOR FROM ICD) GROUP BY TM_MRN) , ICU_R AS (SELECT D.MRN, D.ADMIT_ID, SERVICE_MIDNIGHT, CALENDAR_DATE, DAYS(CALENDAR_DATE) - ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY D.MRN, D.ADMIT_ID, SERVICE_MIDNIGHT ORDER BY CALENDAR_DATE) SERVICE_DTE_GRP FROM PTS P JOIN IDB.INPATIENT_DAYS_V D ON P.ADMIT_ID = D.ADMIT_ID) , ICU AS (SELECT MRN, ADMIT_ID, LISTAGG('Start Date: ' || CHAR(START_DTE) || ' End Date: ' || CHAR(END_DTE) || ' LOS: ' || LOS, CHR(13)||CHR(10)) ICU FROM (SELECT MRN, ADMIT_ID, SERVICE_MIDNIGHT, SERVICE_DTE_GRP, MIN(CALENDAR_DATE) START_DTE, MAX(CALENDAR_DATE) END_DTE, DAYS(MAX(CALENDAR_DATE)) - DAYS(MIN(CALENDAR_DATE)) LOS FROM ICU_R WHERE SERVICE_MIDNIGHT = 'Intensive Care Unit' GROUP BY MRN, ADMIT_ID, SERVICE_MIDNIGHT, SERVICE_DTE_GRP ) GROUP BY MRN, ADMIT_ID) , RT AS (SELECT RTC_TX_MRN, RTC_TX_START_DTE, RTC_TX_STOP_DTE, RTC_TX_PLAN_NAME, RTC_TX_DELIVERED_FRACTIONS, RTC_TX_DELIVERED_DOSE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY RTC_TX_MRN ORDER BY RTC_TX_START_DTE DESC) RN FROM PTS D JOIN IDB.RADONC_TREATMENT_COURSE ON D.MRN = RTC_TX_MRN) , VENT AS (SELECT D.MRN, ADMIT_DTE, DAYS(MAX(CALENDAR_DATE)) - DAYS(MIN(CALENDAR_DATE)) DAYS_ON_VENT, ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY D.MRN, ADMIT_DTE ORDER BY ADMIT_DTE DESC) RN FROM PTS D JOIN IDB.COVID19_RT_VENTILATOR_V V ON D.MRN = V.MRN GROUP BY D.MRN, ADMIT_DTE) , COVID AS (SELECT OO_MRN, LISTAGG(TRIM(CHAR(OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE)) || ': ' || TRIM(OUD_USER_DI_VALUE), CHR(13)||CHR(10)) COVID_LAB FROM (SELECT DISTINCT MRN FROM PTS) D JOIN IDB.OMS_ORDER ON D.MRN = OO_MRN JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_CATALOG ON OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID = OOC_MSTR_ITEM_GUID LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_USER_DATA ON OO_ORD_GUID = OUD_ORD_GUID WHERE OOC_ITEM_NAME ='COVID-19 Qualitative RNA' AND OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'LBRZ_COVID_PatientType' AND OO_ORD_STS_CD NOT IN ('CANP', 'CANC', 'AUC3') GROUP BY OO_MRN ) , BMI AS (SELECT PMH_MRN, PMH_MEASURE_DTE, PMH_BMI, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY PMH_MRN ORDER BY PMH_MEASURE_DTE DESC) RN FROM PTS D JOIN IDB.PT_MEASURES_HX ON D.MRN = PMH_MRN) SELECT P.MRN, PT_SEX SEX, P.DATE_OF_BIRTH, P.DATE_OF_DEATH, TUMOR, COVID_DX_DATE, COVID_LAB, PMH_MEASURE_DTE LAST_BMI_DATE, PMH_BMI LAST_BMI, ADMIT_DATE, DISCHARGE_DATE, P.LOS, CASE WHEN RTC_TX_MRN IS NOT NULL THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END PRIOR_RADIATION, RTC_TX_START_DTE RT_START_DTE, RTC_TX_STOP_DTE RT_STOP_DTE, RTC_TX_PLAN_NAME PLAN_NAME, RTC_TX_DELIVERED_FRACTIONS DELIVERED_FRACTIONS, RTC_TX_DELIVERED_DOSE DELIVERED_DOSE, CASE WHEN ICU.MRN IS NOT NULL THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END PRIOR_ICU, ICU, CASE WHEN V.MRN IS NOT NULL THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END PRIOR_VENT, V.DAYS_ON_VENT, CASE WHEN PLA_LST_CHEMO_DTE IS NOT NULL THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END PRIOR_CHEMO, PLA_LST_CHEMO_DTE LAST_CHEMO_DATE, CASE WHEN PLA_LST_SURG_DTE IS NOT NULL THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END PRIOR_SRG, PLA_LST_SURG_DTE LAST_SRG_DATE, "Congestive heart failure", "Hypertension", "Diabetes", "COPD", "Asthma" FROM PTS P JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON P.MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY ON P.MRN = PLA_MRN LEFT JOIN TUMOR ON P.MRN = TM_MRN LEFT JOIN RT RT ON P.MRN = RTC_TX_MRN AND RT.RN = 1 LEFT JOIN ICU ICU ON P.MRN = ICU.MRN AND P.ADMIT_ID = ICU.ADMIT_ID LEFT JOIN VENT V ON P.MRN = V.MRN AND V.RN = 1 LEFT JOIN COVID COV ON P.MRN = OO_MRN LEFT JOIN BMI BMI ON P.MRN = PMH_MRN AND BMI.RN = 1 LEFT JOIN COMORBID COMORBID ON P.MRN = CO_MRN WHERE P.RN = 1 AND (COVID_DX_DATE >= CURRENT date - 7 DAYS OR ADMIT_DATE >= CURRENT date - 7 DAYS)

prompt: Provide weekly report on patients scheduled for surgery with specified providers for clinical trial screening.
completion: SELECT OC_MRN MRN, PT_LAST_NAME LAST, PT_FIRST_NAME FIRST, OC_SURG_DTE, A.CRE_RES_NAME SURGEON, CPX_PROC_NAME PROC_NAME, COALESCE(SITE_DESC, ICD_DESC) AS SITE, HIST_DESC, MAX(CPE_ENC_DTE) LAST_MRI FROM IDB.OR_CASE JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON OC_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.OR_CASE_ALL_PROC ON OC_CASE_ID = OCAP_CASE_ID JOIN IDB.OR_CASE_ALL_SURG ON OCAP_CASE_ID = OCAS_CASE_ID AND OCAS_PNL_NO = OCAP_PNL_NO AND OCAS_SURG_ROLE = 'Primary' JOIN IDB.OR_PROC ON OCAP_OR_PROC_ID = OP_OR_PROC_ID JOIN IDB.OR_CL_PROC ON OP_OR_PROC_ID = OCP_OR_PROC_ID JOIN IDB.CL_PROC ON OCP_PROC_ID = CPX_PROC_ID JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE A ON A.CRE_RES_ID = OCAS_RES_ID LEFT JOIN (SELECT TM_MRN, AV_DESC AS CASE_STS, TM_DX_DTE, TM_HIST_CD, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS HIST_DESC, TM_SITE_CD, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_DESC FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS ON AV_ELEMENT = 'CASE_STS' AND AV_CODE = TM_CASE_STS AND TM_CASE_STS IN ('3', '6', '7', '8') AND TM_SITE_CD LIKE 'C71%') ON TM_MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN (SELECT CC_MRN, CC_CLSF_CD AS ICD9_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS ICD_DESC FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE CC_CLSF_CD LIKE 'C71%' AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND (CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y'))) ON CC_MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER ON CPE_MRN = OC_MRN AND (CPE_CPE_APPT_STS ='Comp' OR CPE_CPE_APPT_STS ='Arrived') JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE C ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = C.CRE_RES_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE B ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = B.CRE_RES_ID AND B.CRE_RES_NAME LIKE '%MRI %' AND B.CRE_RES_NAME NOT LIKE '%MRI 1275-OR%' LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 = 'RAD' WHERE (UPPER(A.CRE_RES_NAME) like '%TABAR%' OR UPPER(A.CRE_RES_NAME) like '%MOSS%' OR UPPER(A.CRE_RES_NAME) like '%BRENNAN%') AND CPX_PROC_CD IN ('61518', '61510', '61333', '61500', '61458') AND OC_SURG_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT date AND CURRENT date + 21 DAYS GROUP BY OC_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, OC_SURG_DTE, A.CRE_RES_NAME, CPX_PROC_CD, SITE_DESC, ICD_DESC, HIST_DESC, CPX_PROC_NAME

prompt: Provide a Darwin Cohort notification of patients with Esophagogastric Tumors who are HER2+.
completion: WITH DX AS (SELECT CC_MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS MIN_EFF_DTE, CC_CLSF_CD AS ICD_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS ICD_DESC FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE SUBSTR(CC_CLSF_CD, 1, 3) IN ('C15', 'C16', 'C17', 'C26') AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' GROUP BY CC_MRN, CC_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK ) , ERBB2 AS (SELECT DISTINCT A.PT_MRN, A.PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID, A.GENE, A.GENE2 FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_STRUCTURED_RESULTS_V A JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS B ON A.PT_MRN = B.PT_MRN JOIN DX ON A.PT_MRN = CC_MRN WHERE 1=1 AND PT_VITAL_STATUS = 'ALIVE' AND (A.GENE = 'ERBB2' OR A.GENE2 = 'ERBB2') ) , DEID AS (SELECT DISTINCT PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID AS P_ID FROM ERBB2)

prompt: Provide a report for consenting specific patients to 12-245 for IMPACT testing.
completion: WITH X AS (SELECT PT_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_SEX, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, PT_DATE_OF_DEATH, COALESCE(MAX(PLA_LST_APPT_DTE, PLA_LST_DSCH_DTE), PLA_LST_APPT_DTE, PLA_LST_DSCH_DTE) AS LAST_FU_DATE FROM IDB.PATIENT JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY ON PT_MRN = PLA_MRN WHERE PT_MRN IN () ) , CPE AS (SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN, CPE_ENC_DTE, CRE_RES_NAME, CRE_RES_TYP, CLD_DEPT_NAME, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8, CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CPE_MRN ORDER BY CPE_ENC_DTE) AS RN FROM X JOIN IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER ON CPE_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Sch') AND CRE_RES_TYP IN ('Physician') AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 = 'LYM' AND NOT (CVT_CVT_RPT_GRP_17 = 'TELEHEALTH' OR UPPER(CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME) LIKE '%PHONE%') ) , CPE2 AS (SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN, CPE_ENC_DTE, CRE_RES_NAME, CRE_RES_TYP, CLD_DEPT_NAME, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8, CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CPE_MRN ORDER BY CPE_ENC_DTE DESC) AS RN FROM X JOIN IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER ON CPE_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CRE_RES_TYP IN ('Physician') AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 = 'LYM' AND NOT (CVT_CVT_RPT_GRP_17 = 'TELEHEALTH' OR UPPER(CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME) LIKE '%PHONE%') ) SELECT X.*, COALESCE(CPE.CPE_ENC_DTE, CPE2.CPE_ENC_DTE) AS CPE_ENC_DTE, COALESCE(CPE.CRE_RES_NAME, CPE2.CRE_RES_NAME) AS CRE_RES_NAME, COALESCE(CPE.CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8, CPE2.CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8) AS CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8, COALESCE(CPE.CLD_DEPT_NAME, CPE2.CLD_DEPT_NAME) AS CLD_DEPT_NAME FROM X LEFT JOIN CPE ON PT_MRN = CPE.CPE_MRN AND CPE.RN = 1 LEFT JOIN CPE2 ON PT_MRN = CPE2.CPE_MRN AND CPE2.RN = 1

prompt: Identifying patients with Multiple Myeloma who had radiation therapy after bone marrow transplant for 1 site of recurrence
completion: WITH MM AS (SELECT DISTINCT TM_MRN AS MRN , TM_DX_DTE AS DX_DATE , TM_HIST_CD AS DX_CODE , H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS DX_DESC FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM H ON TM_HIST_CD = H.CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON TM_SITE_CD = S.CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND TM_HIST_CD IN ('M9731/3', 'M9732/3', 'M9734/3') AND TM_DX_DTE BETWEEN '1990-01-01' AND '2021-12-31' UNION SELECT DISTINCT CC_MRN AS MRN , MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS DX_DATE , CLM_CLSF_CD AS DX_CODE , CLM_CLSF_DESC AS DX_DESC FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND ((CC_PT_TYPE = 'I') OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) AND CC_CLSF_CD IN ('203', '203.0', '203.00', '203.01', '203.02', '238.6', 'C90.0', 'C90.00', 'C90.01', 'C90.02', 'C90.2', 'C90.20', 'C90.21', 'C90.22', 'C90.30', 'C90.31', 'C90.32') GROUP BY CC_MRN, CLM_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC HAVING MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) BETWEEN '1990-01-01' AND '2021-12-31'), BMT AS (SELECT CBM_MRN AS MRN, CBM_TRANSPLANT_TYPE AS "TRANSPLANT TYPE", (CBM_TRANSPLANT_DTE) AS "TRANSPLANT DATE" FROM IDB.CRDB_BMT_MEDICINE JOIN MM ON MM.MRN = CBM_MRN WHERE CBM_TRANSPLANT_DTE BETWEEN '1990-01-01' AND '2021-12-31' UNION SELECT CBP_MRN AS MRN, CBP_TRANSPLANT_TYPE AS "TRANSPLANT TYPE", (CBP_TRANSPLANT_DTE) AS "TRANSPLANT DATE" FROM IDB.CRDB_BMT_PEDIATRICS JOIN MM ON MM.MRN = CBP_MRN WHERE CBP_TRANSPLANT_DTE BETWEEN '1990-01-01' AND '2021-12-31' ), RT AS (SELECT DISTINCT RTC_TX_MRN AS MRN , RTC_TX_PLAN_NAME , RTC_TX_START_DTE , RTC_TX_STOP_DTE , RTC_TX_DELIVERED_DOSE , RTC_TX_DELIVERED_FRACTIONS FROM MM LEFT JOIN IDB.RADONC_TREATMENT_COURSE ON RTC_TX_MRN = MM.MRN ), MD_NOTE AS (SELECT DISTINCT CDD_MRN AS MRN , CDD_SERVICE_DTE , ROW_NUMBER () OVER (PARTITION BY CDD_MRN ORDER BY CDD_SERVICE_DTE DESC) AS RN FROM MM JOIN IDB.CD_DOCUMENT ON CDD_MRN = MM.MRN AND CDD_DOC_NAME NOT LIKE ('Telephone/Communication%') JOIN IDB.OMS_PROVIDER ON CDD_AUTH_PROV_GUID = OP_PVDR_GUID AND OP_PROV_TYPE IN ('Physician', 'Nurse Practitioner', 'Physician Assistant') JOIN IDB.OMS_USER ON CDD_AUTH_PROV_GUID = OU_USER_GUID AND OP_TASK_ROLE_TYPE IN ('MD', 'NP', 'PA')), PT AS (SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN AS MRN , TRIM(PT_FIRST_NAME)||', '||TRIM(PT_LAST_NAME) AS "NAME" , PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH AS "DOB" , TRIM(A.AV_DESC) AS "SEX" , TRIM(B.AV_DESC) AS "RACE" , TRIM(C.AV_DESC) AS "ETHNICITY" , CASE WHEN PT_DEATH_IND IN ('', 'A') THEN 'ALIVE' ELSE 'DECEASED' END AS "VITAL_STATUS" , PT_DATE_OF_DEATH AS "DOD" FROM IDB.PATIENT LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS A ON A.AV_CODE = PT_SEX AND A.AV_ELEMENT = 'SEX' LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS B ON B.AV_CODE = PT_RACE AND B.AV_ELEMENT = 'RACE' LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS C ON C.AV_CODE = PT_PT_ETHNICITY AND C.AV_ELEMENT = 'PT_ETHNICITY') SELECT DISTINCT PT.MRN "MRN" , PT.NAME "NAME" , PT.DOB "DATE OF BIRTH" , PT.SEX "SEX" , PT.RACE "RACE" , "ETHNICITY" , PT.VITAL_STATUS "VITAL STATUS" , PT.DOD "DATE OF DEATH" , BMT."TRANSPLANT TYPE" , BMT."TRANSPLANT DATE" , RT.RTC_TX_PLAN_NAME "RT LOCATION" , RT.RTC_TX_START_DTE "RT START DATE" , RT.RTC_TX_STOP_DTE "RT END DATE" , RT.RTC_TX_DELIVERED_DOSE "RT DOSE" , RT.RTC_TX_DELIVERED_FRACTIONS "RT FX" , MD_NOTE.CDD_SERVICE_DTE AS "LAST MD NOTE" FROM BMT JOIN PT ON PT.MRN = BMT.MRN JOIN RT ON RT.MRN = BMT.MRN AND RT.RTC_TX_START_DTE > BMT."TRANSPLANT DATE" JOIN MD_NOTE ON MD_NOTE.MRN = BMT.MRN AND RN = 1

prompt:
Provide a list of comorbidities based on ICD9/10 codes and 

Adult Health Screening questionnaire to calculate MSK-FI (MSK frailty index)
completion: WITH PT AS (SELECT * FROM IDB.PATIENT WHERE PT_MRN IN () ) SELECT CC_MRN AS MRN, STRIP(CC_CLSF_CD) AS "ICD-9/ICD-10 Code", STRIP(CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK) AS "ICD-9/ICD-10 Desc", MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS "Initial Effective Date" FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND ((CC_PT_TYPE = 'I') OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) AND CC_MRN IN (SELECT PT_MRN FROM PT) GROUP BY CC_MRN, STRIP(CC_CLSF_CD), STRIP(CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK) ORDER BY MRN SELECT MRN, DOC_GUID, DOC_NAME, SERVICE_DATE, MAX(CASE WHEN VALUE_TEXT LIKE '%NONE%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "NONE", MAX(CASE WHEN VALUE_TEXT LIKE '%DRESSING%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "DRESSING", MAX(CASE WHEN VALUE_TEXT LIKE '%GROOMING%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "GROOMING", MAX(CASE WHEN VALUE_TEXT LIKE '%EATING%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "EATING", MAX(CASE WHEN VALUE_TEXT LIKE '%WALKING%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "WALKING", MAX(CASE WHEN VALUE_TEXT LIKE '%BATHING%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "BATHING", MAX(CASE WHEN VALUE_TEXT LIKE '%USING THE TOILET%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "USING THE TOILET", MAX(CASE WHEN VALUE_TEXT LIKE '%USING THE PHONE%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "USING THE PHONE", MAX(CASE WHEN VALUE_TEXT LIKE '%SHOPPING FOR GROCERIES%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "SHOPPING FOR GROCERIES", MAX(CASE WHEN VALUE_TEXT LIKE '%PREPARING MEALS%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "PREPARING MEALS", MAX(CASE WHEN VALUE_TEXT LIKE '%DOING SIMPLE CLEANING%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "DOING SIMPLE CLEANING", MAX(CASE WHEN VALUE_TEXT LIKE '%DOING YOUR OWN LAUNDRY%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "DOING YOUR OWN LAUNDRY", MAX(CASE WHEN VALUE_TEXT LIKE '%MANAGING FINANCES%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "MANAGING FINANCES", MAX(CASE WHEN VALUE_TEXT LIKE '%HANDLING YOU OWN MEDICINE%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "HANDLING YOU OWN MEDICINE", MAX(CASE WHEN VALUE_TEXT LIKE '%VISITING YOUR DOCTOR%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "VISITING YOUR DOCTOR" FROM (SELECT DISTINCT CDD_MRN AS MRN, CDD_DOC_GUID AS DOC_GUID, CDD_DOC_NAME AS DOC_NAME, CDD_SERVICE_DTE AS SERVICE_DATE, CDO_SECTION AS "Section", CDO_CTLG_DISPL_NM AS CTLG_DISPL_NM, CDO_MSTR_ITEM_NM AS MSTR_ITEM_NM, CDO_ITEM_NAME AS ITEM_NAME, UPPER(STRIP(SUBSTR(CDO_VALUE_TEXT, 1, 2000))) AS VALUE_TEXT FROM PT JOIN IDB.CD_DOCUMENT ON CDD_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION ON CDD_DOC_GUID = CDO_DOC_GUID WHERE CDD_DOC_NAME IN ('Adult Health Screening (65+), Ambulatory - Nursing', 'Adult Health Screening, Ambulatory - Nursing', 'Nursing Adult Health Screening 65+, Patient/RN - Outpatient', 'Nursing Adult Health Screening, Patient/RN - Outpatient') AND CDD_CANCEL_IND <> '1' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND <> '1' ) AHS GROUP BY MRN, DOC_GUID, DOC_NAME, SERVICE_DATE

prompt: Daily report of admitted COVID-19 positive patients in Critical Care with orders for specific psychiatric medications
completion: WITH IP AS (SELECT CCV_MRN, CCV_ADMIT_DT, CCV_PROVIDER_NAME, CCV_DISCHARGE_DT, CCV_SERVICE_GROUP_CODE, CCV_SERVICE_DESC, OL_LOC_NAME, CCV_CURRENT_LOCATION FROM IDB.COVID19_PATIENT_INFO JOIN IDB.COVID19_CLIENT_VISIT ON MRN = CCV_MRN JOIN IDB.OMS_LOCATION ON CCV_CURRENT_LOCATION_GUID = OL_LOC_GUID WHERE CCV_CARE_LEVEL_CODE <> 'Inpt Schedule' AND CCV_VISIT_STATUS IN ('ADM', 'DSC') AND CCV_VISIT_TYPE = 'Inpatient' AND COALESCE(CCV_DISCHARGE_DT, MIN_IDENTIFIED_DT) >= MIN_IDENTIFIED_DT ) , COVID AS (SELECT DISTINCT TRIM(MRN) "MRN", TRIM(LAST_NAME) || ', ' || TRIM(FIRST_NAME) "Name", DATE_OF_BIRTH "Date of Birth", DATE_OF_DEATH "Date of Death", RESULT "Result", MIN_IDENTIFIED_DT "Identified Date", MIN_RESULT_DT "Result Date", TRIM(OL_LOC_NAME) "In Hospital Nursing Station", TRIM(CCV_CURRENT_LOCATION) "In Hospital Bed", CASE WHEN OL_LOC_NAME IS NOT NULL AND CCV_DISCHARGE_DT IS NULL THEN 'Yes' WHEN CCV_DISCHARGE_DT IS NOT NULL THEN 'Discharged' ELSE 'No' END "In Hospital Flag", TRIM(CCV_SERVICE_GROUP_CODE) "Service Code", TRIM(CCV_SERVICE_DESC) "Service Description", CASE WHEN LEFT(TRIM(CCV_SERVICE_GROUP_CODE), 2) IN ('IC', 'AI') THEN 'Critical Care' ELSE TRIM(CCV_SERVICE_DESC) END AS "Service Description CC", CCV_ADMIT_DT "Admit Date", CCV_DISCHARGE_DT "Discharge Date", TRIM(CCV_PROVIDER_NAME) "Attending Provider", TRIM(POSITIVE_SOURCES) "Positive Source", TRIM(NEGATIVE_SOURCES) "Negative Source", TRIM(PENDING_SOURCES) "Pending Source", CASE WHEN UPPER(POSITIVE_SOURCES) LIKE '%ORDER_AND_RESULT%' AND RESULT IN ('Positive', 'Resolved') THEN 'MSK Lab' WHEN UPPER(POSITIVE_SOURCES) NOT LIKE '%ORDER_AND_RESULT%' AND RESULT IN ('Positive', 'Resolved') THEN 'Non-MSK Lab' END "Lab Flag" FROM IDB.COVID19_PATIENT_INFO LEFT JOIN IP ON MRN = CCV_MRN WHERE CASE WHEN OL_LOC_NAME IS NOT NULL AND CCV_DISCHARGE_DT IS NULL THEN 'Yes' WHEN CCV_DISCHARGE_DT IS NOT NULL THEN 'Discharged' ELSE 'No' END = 'Yes' ) , ORDERS AS (SELECT OO_MRN AS MRN, OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE AS "Order Date", OO_ORD_NAME AS "Drug Name", OO_ORD_PRIO AS "Fill Detail", OMD_DOSE_LOW AS "Dose", OMD_DOSE_UNIT AS "Dose unit", OO_ORD_FREQ AS "Frequency", OSTS_STS_DESC AS "Order Status", OO_SUMMARY_LINE AS "Order Summary", ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY OO_MRN ORDER BY OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE DESC) AS RN FROM IDB.OMS_ORDER JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_CATALOG ON OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID = OOC_MSTR_ITEM_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_MED_DETAIL ON OMD_ORD_GUID = OO_ORD_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_STATUS ON OO_ORD_STS_CD = OSTS_ORD_STS_CD WHERE OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE >= '2020-03-01' AND OO_ORD_STS_CD NOT IN ('CANC', 'CANP', 'AUC3') AND (LOWER(OO_ORD_NAME) LIKE '%clonazepam%' OR LOWER(OO_ORD_NAME) LIKE '%lorazepam%' OR LOWER(OO_ORD_NAME) LIKE '%diazepam%' OR LOWER(OO_ORD_NAME) LIKE '%chlordiazepoxide%' OR LOWER(OO_ORD_NAME) LIKE '%alprazolam%' OR LOWER(OO_ORD_NAME) LIKE '%propofol%' OR LOWER(OO_ORD_NAME) LIKE '%midazolam%' OR LOWER(OO_ORD_NAME) LIKE '%clonidine%' OR LOWER(OO_ORD_NAME) LIKE '%dexmedetomidine%' OR LOWER(OO_ORD_NAME) LIKE '%fentanyl%' OR LOWER(OO_ORD_NAME) LIKE '%ketamine%' OR LOWER(OO_ORD_NAME) LIKE '%chlorpromazine%' OR LOWER(OO_ORD_NAME) LIKE '%olanzapine%' OR LOWER(OO_ORD_NAME) LIKE '%quetiapine%' OR LOWER(OO_ORD_NAME) LIKE '%asenapine%' OR LOWER(OO_ORD_NAME) LIKE '%haloperidol%' OR LOWER(OO_ORD_NAME) LIKE '%risperidone%') AND OSTS_STS_DESC = 'Active' ) SELECT COVID.MRN, COVID."Name", COVID."Date of Birth", COVID."Result" AS "COVID Result", COVID."Result Date" AS "COVID Result Date", ORDERS."Order Date" AS "Medication Order Date", UPPER(ORDERS."Drug Name") AS "Medication Name", ORDERS."Order Summary" AS "Medication Order Summary", COVID."Service Description", COVID."In Hospital Nursing Station", COVID."In Hospital Bed", COVID."Service Description CC" AS "Critical Care", COVID."In Hospital Flag", COVID."Identified Date" AS "COVID Identified Date", COVID."Admit Date", COVID."Attending Provider" FROM COVID JOIN ORDERS ON COVID.MRN = ORDERS.MRN WHERE COVID."In Hospital Flag" = 'Yes' AND COVID."Result" NOT IN ('Negative', 'Pending') ORDER BY COVID."Name" ;

prompt: identifying patients with Lynch syndrome treated at MSKCC and identifying the subset of patients that developed endometrial cancer and what testing they had received
completion: WITH DIAGNOSIS_TR_0 AS (SELECT "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AS PT_DEID, "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_MRN" AS PT_MRN, CAST(TRIM("IDB"."CDB_TUMOR"."TM_MRN") AS VARCHAR) || CAST(TRIM("IDB"."CDB_TUMOR"."TM_TUMOR_SEQ") AS VARCHAR) || CAST(TRIM("IDB"."CDB_TUMOR"."TM_DX_DTE") AS VARCHAR) AS SUBJECT_ID, "IDB"."ALLOWVALS"."AV_DESC" AS DX_TR_CASE_STATUS, TRIM("IDB"."CDB_TUMOR"."TM_SITE_CD") || ' - ' || TRIM(CLM_SITE."CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK") AS DX_TR_SITE FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS" JOIN "IDB"."CDB_TUMOR" ON "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_MRN" = "IDB"."CDB_TUMOR"."TM_MRN" JOIN "IDB"."ALLOWVALS" ON "IDB"."ALLOWVALS"."AV_CODE" = "IDB"."CDB_TUMOR"."TM_CASE_STS" AND "IDB"."ALLOWVALS"."AV_ELEMENT" = 'CASE_STS' JOIN "IDB"."CLM" AS CLM_SITE ON CLM_SITE."CLM_CLSF_CD" = "IDB"."CDB_TUMOR"."TM_SITE_CD" WHERE "IDB"."ALLOWVALS"."AV_DESC" IN ('COMPLETED', 'CONSULT ONLY', 'INCOMPLETE', 'NON-INDEX', 'PATHOLOGY ONLY') AND "IDB"."CDB_TUMOR"."TM_SITE_CD" IN ('C541', 'C559')), CLINDOC_1 AS (SELECT "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AS PT_DEID, "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_MRN" AS PT_MRN, "IDB"."CD_DOCUMENT"."CDD_DOC_GUID" AS SUBJECT_ID, "IDB"."CD_OBSERVATION"."CDO_ITEM_NAME" AS CD_ITEM FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS" JOIN "IDB"."CD_DOCUMENT" ON "IDB"."CD_DOCUMENT"."CDD_MRN" = "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_MRN" JOIN "IDB"."CD_OBSERVATION" ON "IDB"."CD_DOCUMENT"."CDD_DOC_GUID" = "IDB"."CD_OBSERVATION"."CDO_DOC_GUID" AND "IDB"."CD_DOCUMENT"."CDD_AUTHORED_DTE" = "IDB"."CD_OBSERVATION"."CDO_AUTHORED_DTE" AND "IDB"."CD_OBSERVATION"."CDO_VALUE_TEXT" != '' WHERE "IDB"."CD_DOCUMENT"."CDD_CANCEL_IND" != '1' AND "IDB"."CD_DOCUMENT"."CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND" != '1' AND "IDB"."CD_OBSERVATION"."CDO_ITEM_NAME" IN ('In a recent large trial, Lynch syndrome patients who took a high dosage of aspirin', 'Information about Lynch Syndrome:', 'International Lynch syndrome Awareness Day is March 22nd each year', 'Lynch GYN', 'Men and women who have Lynch syndrome should undergo colonoscopy', 'Small Bowel: For individuals who have Lynch syndrome', 'Women who have Lynch syndrome are at risk for gynecologic cancers')), COHORT AS (SELECT PT_DEID AS PT_DEID FROM (SELECT DIAGNOSIS_TR_0.PT_DEID AS PT_DEID FROM DIAGNOSIS_TR_0 INTERSECT SELECT CLINDOC_1.PT_DEID AS PT_DEID FROM CLINDOC_1)), COHORT_DIAGNOSIS_TR AS (SELECT SUBJECT_ID AS SUBJECT_ID, PT_DEID AS PT_DEID FROM (SELECT DIAGNOSIS_TR_0.SUBJECT_ID AS SUBJECT_ID, DIAGNOSIS_TR_0.PT_DEID AS PT_DEID FROM DIAGNOSIS_TR_0)), COHORT_CLINDOC AS (SELECT SUBJECT_ID AS SUBJECT_ID, PT_DEID AS PT_DEID FROM (SELECT CLINDOC_1.SUBJECT_ID AS SUBJECT_ID, CLINDOC_1.PT_DEID AS PT_DEID FROM CLINDOC_1)), KEYS AS (SELECT COHORT.PT_DEID AS COHORT_PT_DEID, COHORT_DIAGNOSIS_TR.SUBJECT_ID AS COHORT_DIAGNOSIS_TR_SUBJECT_ID, COHORT_DIAGNOSIS_TR.PT_DEID AS COHORT_DIAGNOSIS_TR_PT_DEID, COHORT_CLINDOC.SUBJECT_ID AS COHORT_CLINDOC_SUBJECT_ID, COHORT_CLINDOC.PT_DEID AS COHORT_CLINDOC_PT_DEID FROM COHORT LEFT OUTER JOIN COHORT_DIAGNOSIS_TR ON COHORT_DIAGNOSIS_TR.PT_DEID = COHORT.PT_DEID LEFT OUTER JOIN COHORT_CLINDOC ON COHORT_CLINDOC.PT_DEID = COHORT.PT_DEID), DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS AS (SELECT DISTINCT "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AS PT_DEID, IDB_PATIENT."PT_MRN" AS PT_MRN, "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AS SUBJECT_ID, DMP_ID_TBL."PDRX_DMP_PATIENT_ID" AS DMP_ID, TRIM(IDB_PATIENT."PT_LAST_NAME") || ', ' || TRIM(IDB_PATIENT."PT_FIRST_NAME") AS PT_NAME, ALLOWVALS_SEX."AV_DESC" AS SEX, CASE WHEN (IDB_PATIENT."PT_DATE_OF_DEATH" IS NULL) THEN 'Alive' ELSE 'Deceased' END AS VITAL_STATS, IDB_PATIENT."PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH" AS DATE_OF_BIRTH, IDB_PATIENT."PT_DATE_OF_DEATH" AS DATE_OF_DEATH, ALLOWVALS_RACE."AV_DESC" AS RACE, ALLOWVALS_ETHNICITY."AV_DESC" AS ETHNICITY, ALLOWVALS_LANGUAGE."AV_DESC" AS PRIMARY_LANGUAGE, LAST_ACTIVITY_DATE."PLA_LST_ACTV_DTE" AS LAST_ACTIVITY_DATE, LAST_CONTACT_DATE."PLA_LST_CON_DTE" AS LAST_CONTACT_DATE FROM "IDB"."PATIENT" AS IDB_PATIENT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS" ON IDB_PATIENT."PT_MRN" = "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_MRN" LEFT OUTER JOIN "DV"."PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML" AS DMP_ID_TBL ON DMP_ID_TBL."PDRX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT OUTER JOIN "IDB"."ALLOWVALS" AS ALLOWVALS_SEX ON IDB_PATIENT."PT_SEX" = ALLOWVALS_SEX."AV_CODE" AND ALLOWVALS_SEX."AV_ELEMENT" = 'SEX' LEFT OUTER JOIN "IDB"."ALLOWVALS" AS ALLOWVALS_RACE ON IDB_PATIENT."PT_RACE" = ALLOWVALS_RACE."AV_CODE" AND ALLOWVALS_RACE."AV_ELEMENT" = 'RACE' LEFT OUTER JOIN "IDB"."ALLOWVALS" AS ALLOWVALS_ETHNICITY ON IDB_PATIENT."PT_PT_ETHNICITY" = ALLOWVALS_ETHNICITY."AV_CODE" AND ALLOWVALS_ETHNICITY."AV_ELEMENT" = 'PT_ETHNICITY' LEFT OUTER JOIN "IDB"."ALLOWVALS" AS ALLOWVALS_LANGUAGE ON IDB_PATIENT."PT_PRIMARY_LANG" = ALLOWVALS_LANGUAGE."AV_CODE" AND ALLOWVALS_LANGUAGE."AV_ELEMENT" = 'PRIMARY_LANG' LEFT OUTER JOIN "IDB".PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY AS LAST_ACTIVITY_DATE ON IDB_PATIENT."PT_MRN" = LAST_ACTIVITY_DATE."PLA_MRN" LEFT OUTER JOIN "IDB".PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY AS LAST_CONTACT_DATE ON IDB_PATIENT."PT_MRN" = LAST_CONTACT_DATE."PLA_MRN") SELECT DISTINCT DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS.PT_MRN AS MRN, DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS.DMP_ID AS DMP_ID, DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS.PT_NAME AS PT_NAME, DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS.SEX AS SEX, DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS.VITAL_STATS AS VITAL_STATUS, DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS.DATE_OF_BIRTH AS DATE_OF_BIRTH, DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS.DATE_OF_DEATH AS DATE_OF_DEATH, DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS.RACE AS RACE, DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS.ETHNICITY AS ETHNICITY, DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS.PRIMARY_LANGUAGE AS PRIMARY_LANGUAGE, DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS.LAST_ACTIVITY_DATE AS LAST_ACTIVITY_DATE, DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS.LAST_CONTACT_DATE AS LAST_CONTACT_DATE FROM KEYS LEFT OUTER JOIN DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS ON DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS.PT_DEID = KEYS.COHORT_PT_DEID;

prompt: We currently receive weekly reports of the prostate biopsies done at Kimmel. I am looking for a breakdown of how many prostate biopsies are done at Kimmel per year and by provider
completion: SELECT SSE_MRN, SSE_SURG_DTE, MONTH(SSE_SURG_DTE) AS MON, SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD, SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC, TRIM(SSP_SURG_LAST_NM)||', '||TRIM(SSP_SURG_FIRST_NM) AS SURGEON, SSP_SURG_SVC_CD FROM IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE ON SSE_LOG_ID = SSP_LOG_ID AND SSE_ENC_CSN_ID = SSP_ENC_CSN_ID WHERE SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD = '55700' AND YEAR(SSE_SURG_DTE) IN ('2024', '2023') ;

prompt: Please provide a list of patients with confirmed pathology diagnosis for Hereditary leiomyomatosis renal cell cancer (HLRCC).
completion: SELECT PT_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, PRPT_REPORT_TYPE, DT_DTE AS "REPORT DATE" PRPT_REPORT FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON PRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID= PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID JOIN DV.DATE_V ON PRPT_REPORT_DATE_ID = DT_DATE_ID WHERE DT_DTE BETWEEN '2007-10-01' AND '2017-10-01' (CONTAINS(PRPT_REPORT, '"fumarate hydratase"') <> 0 OR CONTAINS(PRPT_REPORT, '"hereditary leiomyomatosis"') <> 0 OR CONTAINS(PRPT_REPORT, '"HLRCC"') <> 0)

prompt: Weekly report of patients scheduled for a mammogram at BAIC in the coming week who have completed another mammogram in the prior 2 months.
completion: WITH PTS AS (SELECT PT_MRN MRN, PT_LAST_NAME LAST, PT_FIRST_NAME FIRST, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH "DOB", CLD_CLD_CENTER "Center", CPE_APPT_DT "Appointment Date/Time", CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME AS "Visit Type" FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON CPE_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Sch') AND CLD_CLD_CENTER = '300 E66' AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT date AND CURRENT date + 7 DAYS AND CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME IN ('BI MAMMO BILAT', 'BI MAMMO CONE VIEW LEFT', 'BI MAMMO UNILATERAL LEFT', 'BI MAMMO UNILATERAL RIGHT', 'BI SCREEN MAMMO DIRECT DIG', 'BI SPEC MAMMO BILAT W/CON', 'BI SPEC MAMMO UNI RIGHT W/CON') AND YEAR(CURRENT date) - YEAR(PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) > 30 ) SELECT PTS.* FROM PTS JOIN IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER ON MRN = CPE_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT date - 62 DAYS AND CURRENT date - 1 DAY AND CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME IN ('BECH BILAT DIGI SCREEN MAMMMO INIT', 'BECH BILAT DIGI SCREEN MAMMO ANNUAL', 'BECH UNI DIGI SCREEN MAMMO ANNUAL RIGHT', 'BECH UNI DIGI SCREEN MAMMO INITIAL LEFT', 'BI BECH DIG SCRN MAMMO UNI/LT', 'BI BECH DIG SCRN MAMMO UNI/RT', 'BI BECH SCRN MAMMO DIRECT DIG', 'BI CRP BR BILAT SCR MAM W/TOMO', 'BI CRP BR UNI LT SCR MAM W/TOM', 'BI CRP SPONS BR SCRN MAMM BILA', 'BI DIG SCREEN MAMMO UNI/LT', 'BI DIG SCREEN MAMMO UNI/RT', 'BI SCREEN MAMMO DIRECT DIG', 'BI SCREENING MAMMO BILATERAL', 'BI SCREENING MAMMO UNI LEFT', 'BI SCREENING MAMMO UNI RIGHT') ;

prompt: Provide list of patients diagnosed with DCIS since 2018
completion: SELECT DISTINCT TM_MRN "MRN", PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH "DOB", TM_DX_DTE "Diagnosis Date", H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS "Histology Description", S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS "Site Description", B.AV_DESC AS "Tumor Grade", CASE WHEN TM_TUMOR_SIZE_SUM = '999' THEN '' ELSE TM_TUMOR_SIZE_SUM END AS "Tumor Size", CASE WHEN SURG.DOC_NAME = 'FOREIGN MAIL,UNKNOWN' THEN '' ELSE SURG.DOC_NAME END AS "Surgeon", CASE WHEN RAD.DOC_NAME = 'FOREIGN MAIL,UNKNOWN' THEN '' ELSE RAD.DOC_NAME END AS "Radiation Oncologist", CASE WHEN RTC_TX_MRN IS NOT NULL THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS "Radiation Therapy Indicator", CASE WHEN TM_SSF1 = '000' THEN 'Test not done (test not ordered and not performed)' WHEN TM_SSF1 = '010' THEN 'Positive/elevated' WHEN TM_SSF1 = '020' THEN 'Negative/normal; within normal limits' WHEN TM_SSF1 = '030' THEN 'Borderline; undetermined whether positive or negative' WHEN TM_SSF1 = '080' THEN 'Ordered, but results not in chart' WHEN TM_SSF1 = '988' THEN 'Not applicable: Information not collected for this case' WHEN TM_SSF1 = '996' THEN 'Test ordered, results not interpretable' WHEN TM_SSF1 = '997' THEN 'Test ordered, results not in chart' WHEN TM_SSF1 = '998' THEN 'Test not done (test not ordered and not performed)' WHEN TM_SSF1 = '999' THEN 'Unknown or no information; not documented in patient record' ELSE '' END AS "ER Status" FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS A ON A.AV_ELEMENT = 'CASE_STS' AND A.AV_CODE = TM_CASE_STS JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS B ON B.AV_ELEMENT = 'HIST_CD_GRADE' AND B.AV_CODE = TM_HIST_CD_GRADE JOIN IDB.DOC SURG ON TM_PRIM_SURGEON = SURG.DOC_DR_NO JOIN IDB.DOC RAD ON TM_RAD_MD = RAD.DOC_DR_NO LEFT JOIN IDB.RADONC_TREATMENT_COURSE ON RTC_TX_MRN = TM_MRN JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PT_MRN = TM_MRN WHERE 1=1 AND TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND TM_SITE_CD LIKE 'C50%' AND TM_DX_DTE > '2018-01-01' AND TM_HIST_CD IN ('M8050/2', 'M8201/2', 'M8230/2', 'M8500/2', 'M8503/2', 'M8504/2', 'M8507/2', 'M8522/2', 'M8523/2')

prompt: Appointment seen by and referred to Dr. James Root and Dr. Elizabeth Ryan in 2018
completion: WITH "cte1" AS (SELECT * FROM DV.ENCOUNTER_SCHD_RESOURCES WHERE ENSR_PRIMARY_RES_IND = 'Y' ) , "cte2" AS (SELECT EDC_DEPT_ABBREV, EDC_DEPT_DESC FROM DV.ENCOUNTER_DESC_CATALOG WHERE EDC_GROUP_ID = 'STS' ) SELECT DISTINCT "t1"."PT_MRN" AS "MRN", "t2"."DT_DTE" AS "Encounter Date", "t3"."ENR_RES_NAME" AS "Primary Resource Name", "t4"."EDC_DEPT_DESC" AS "Encounter Status", "t5"."ENVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR" AS "Visit Type Abbrev", "t5"."ENVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME" AS "Visit Type Name", "t6"."PENC_PT_ENC_ID" AS "Encounter ID" FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V" "t1" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED" "t7" ON "t1"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t7"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_ENCOUNTER" "t6" ON "t7"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t6"."PENC_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" "t2" ON "t6"."PENC_ENC_DATE_ID" = "t2"."DT_DATE_ID" LEFT JOIN "cte1" "t8" ON "t6"."PENC_PT_ENC_ID" = "t8"."ENSR_PT_ENC_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."ENCOUNTER_RESOURCE" "t3" ON "t8"."ENSR_RES_ID" = "t3"."ENR_ENC_RES_ID" LEFT JOIN "cte2" "t4" ON "t6"."PENC_APPT_STS" = "t4"."EDC_DEPT_ABBREV" LEFT JOIN "DV"."ENCOUNTER_VISIT_TYPE" "t5" ON "t6"."PENC_VISIT_TYPE_ID" = "t5"."ENVT_ENC_VISIT_TYPE_ID" WHERE ("t2"."DT_DTE" BETWEEN '2018-1-1' AND CURRENT date AND (UPPER("t3"."ENR_RES_NAME") IN ('ROOT, JAMES', 'RYAN, ELIZABETH') AND "t4"."EDC_DEPT_DESC" IN ('Arrived', 'Completed')))

prompt: Create a Tableau dashboard to look at MSK Engage responses of Head and Neck Patient Reported Outcomes
completion: SELECT DISTINCT TRIM(ENCV_MRN) "MRN", TRIM(PT_LAST_NAME) "Last Name", TRIM(PT_FIRST_NAME) "First Name", PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH "Date of Birth", PT_SEX "Gender", DATE(EA_SUBM_DT) "Submission Date", ENCV_TIME_POINT "Form Name", ENCV_NAME "Question", ENCV_VALUE "Answer" FROM IDB.EF_ASSESSMENT JOIN IDB.ENAR_CALC_VALUE ON EA_ASSESS_ID = ENCV_ASSESSMENT_ID JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON ENCV_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE ENCV_NAME IN ('Eating Assessment Tool', 'Voice Handicap Index') AND ENCV_TIME_POINT IN ('Face-Q: 72-hr Survey', 'Face-Q: Post-Treatment Survey') AND DATE(EA_SUBM_DT) BETWEEN CURRENT DATE - 14 DAY AND CURRENT DATE UNION ALL SELECT DISTINCT TRIM(EF_MRN) "MRN", TRIM(PT_LAST_NAME) "Last Name", TRIM(PT_FIRST_NAME) "First Name", PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH "Date of Birth", TRIM(PT_SEX) "Gender", DATE(EF_SUBMISSION_DT) "Submission Date", EF_FORM_NAME "Form Name", EFI_ITEM_TEXT "Question", EFI_VALUE "Answer" FROM IDB.EF_FORM JOIN IDB.EF_FORM_ITEM ON EF_FORM_ID = EFI_FORM_ID JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON EF_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE EF_FORM_NAME = 'Head and Neck Patient Reported Outcomes' AND DATE(EF_SUBMISSION_DT) BETWEEN CURRENT DATE - 14 DAY AND CURRENT DATE

prompt: Provide list of patients who underwent IR palliative procedures for the management of ascites between 2009 and 2018
completion: WITH PTS AS (SELECT ALL_PROCS.RRPT_MRN MRN, MIN(RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE) FIRST_PROC, FIRST_PALL_PROC FROM DV.RADIOLOGY_REPORT_V ALL_PROCS JOIN (SELECT INN1.RRPT_MRN, MIN(INN1.RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE) FIRST_PALL_PROC FROM DV.RADIOLOGY_REPORT_V INN1 WHERE INN1.RRPT_PROCEDURE_NAME IN ('TENCKHOFF CATHETER PLACE', 'IR TENCKHOFF CATHETER PLACE', 'IR TENCKHOFF CATHETER PLACEMENT', 'IR CLINIC PARACENTESIS', 'IR CLINIC US PARACENTISIS', 'IR PARACENTESIS', 'IR PARACENTESIS US', 'PARACENTESIS US', 'DENVER SHUNT PLACE', 'IR DENVER SHUNT PLACE') GROUP BY INN1.RRPT_MRN) FIRST_PROC ON FIRST_PROC.RRPT_MRN = ALL_PROCS.RRPT_MRN GROUP BY ALL_PROCS.RRPT_MRN, FIRST_PALL_PROC HAVING MIN(RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE) = MIN(FIRST_PALL_PROC) AND MIN(RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE) <= '2017-12-31') SELECT * FROM (SELECT MRN, PT_BIRTH_DTE "Date of Birth", PT_SEX "Gender", PT_DEATH_DTE "Date of Death", PT_DEATH_IND_DESC "Death Status", RRPT_ACCESSION_NO "Accession Number", RRPT_PROCEDURE_NAME "Procedure Name", RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE "Procedure Date", '' "Indication", '' "Aspirate", RRPT_REPORT_TXT "Report Text", ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY RRPT_MRN ORDER BY RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE) AS RN FROM PTS JOIN DV.RADIOLOGY_REPORT_V ON MRN=RRPT_MRN JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON PT_MRN=MRN WHERE RRPT_PROCEDURE_NAME IN ('TENCKHOFF CATHETER PLACE', 'IR TENCKHOFF CATHETER PLACE', 'IR TENCKHOFF CATHETER PLACEMENT', 'IR CLINIC PARACENTESIS', 'IR CLINIC US PARACENTISIS', 'IR PARACENTESIS', 'IR PARACENTESIS US', 'PARACENTESIS US', 'DENVER SHUNT PLACE', 'IR DENVER SHUNT PLACE') ) XX WHERE RN = 1 ORDER BY 1 SELECT DISTINCT TM_MRN, CASE_STS.AV_DESC AS CASE_STS, TM_DX_DTE, TM_HIST_CD, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS HIST_DESC, TM_SITE_CD, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_DESC, TM_HIST_CD_GRADE, HIST_CD_GRADE.AV_DESC AS HIST_GRADE, TM_TSTAGE, TSTAGES.AV_DESC AS TSTAGE, TM_NSTAGE, NSTAGES.AV_DESC AS NSTAGE, TM_MSTAGE, MSTAGES.AV_DESC AS MSTAGE, MSK_STAGES.AV_DESC AS STAGE, TM_MSK_STG, TM_CSSIZE FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS CASE_STS ON CASE_STS.AV_ELEMENT = 'CASE_STS' AND CASE_STS.AV_CODE = TM_CASE_STS AND TM_CASE_STS IN ('3', '6', '7', '8') JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS HIST_CD_GRADE ON TM_HIST_CD_GRADE = HIST_CD_GRADE.AV_CODE AND HIST_CD_GRADE.AV_ELEMENT='HIST_CD_GRADE' JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PT_MRN=TM_MRN JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS TSTAGES ON TSTAGES.AV_ELEMENT='TSTAGE' AND TSTAGES.AV_CODE=TM_TSTAGE JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS NSTAGES ON NSTAGES.AV_ELEMENT='NSTAGE' AND NSTAGES.AV_CODE=TM_NSTAGE JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS MSTAGES ON MSTAGES.AV_ELEMENT='MSTAGE' AND MSTAGES.AV_CODE=TM_MSTAGE JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS MSK_STAGES ON MSK_STAGES.AV_ELEMENT='MSK_STAGE' AND MSK_STAGES.AV_CODE=TM_MSK_STG WHERE TM_MRN IN ({}) SELECT MRN, "Set Name", "Order Name", "First Admin Date" FROM (SELECT CPO_MRN MRN, CPO_SET_NAME "Set Name", CPO_ORD_NAME "Order Name", CPO_FST_ADMIN_DT "First Admin Date", ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CPO_MRN ORDER BY CPO_FST_ADMIN_DT) AS RN FROM IDB.CHEMO_PERFORMED_ORDERS WHERE CPO_MRN IN ({}) ) XX WHERE RN=1 WITH PTS_DATES AS (SELECT INN1.RRPT_MRN, MIN(INN1.RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE) FIRST_PALL_PROC FROM DV.RADIOLOGY_REPORT_V INN1 WHERE INN1.RRPT_PROCEDURE_NAME IN ('TENCKHOFF CATHETER PLACE', 'IR TENCKHOFF CATHETER PLACE', 'IR TENCKHOFF CATHETER PLACEMENT', 'IR CLINIC PARACENTESIS', 'IR CLINIC US PARACENTISIS', 'IR PARACENTESIS', 'IR PARACENTESIS US', 'PARACENTESIS US', 'DENVER SHUNT PLACE', 'IR DENVER SHUNT PLACE') AND RRPT_MRN IN ({}) GROUP BY INN1.RRPT_MRN) SELECT SSE_MRN, SSE_SURG_DTE, SSE_LOG_STS, SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD, SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC, SSP_SURG_LAST_NM, SSP_SURG_FIRST_NM, SSP_SURG_SVC_CD FROM PTS_DATES JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT ON RRPT_MRN = SSE_MRN AND SSE_SURG_DTE < FIRST_PALL_PROC JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE ON SSE_LOG_ID = SSP_LOG_ID WITH PTS_DATES AS (SELECT INN1.RRPT_MRN, MIN(INN1.RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE) FIRST_PALL_PROC FROM DV.RADIOLOGY_REPORT_V INN1 WHERE INN1.RRPT_PROCEDURE_NAME IN ('TENCKHOFF CATHETER PLACE', 'IR TENCKHOFF CATHETER PLACE', 'IR TENCKHOFF CATHETER PLACEMENT', 'IR CLINIC PARACENTESIS', 'IR CLINIC US PARACENTISIS', 'IR PARACENTESIS', 'IR PARACENTESIS US', 'PARACENTESIS US', 'DENVER SHUNT PLACE', 'IR DENVER SHUNT PLACE') AND RRPT_MRN IN ({}) GROUP BY INN1.RRPT_MRN) SELECT DISTINCT LR_MRN "MRN", LR_PERFORMED_DTE "Lab Date", LR_TEST_NAME "Lab Test Name", LR_SUBTEST_NAME "Lab Subtest Name", LR_RESULT_VALUE "Lab Result Value", LTL_TEXT_RESULT "Lab Result Text" FROM PTS_DATES JOIN IDB.LAB_RESULTS ON RRPT_MRN=LR_MRN AND LR_PERFORMED_DTE = FIRST_PALL_PROC LEFT JOIN IDB.LAB_TEXT_LINE ON LTL_RESULT_GUID = LR_RESULT_GUID WHERE LR_TEST_NAME like '%Metabolic Panel%' OR LR_TEST_NAME like '%Blood%'

prompt: Provide a list of female breast cancer patients scheduled to receive chemotherapy in the next week
completion: WITH APPT AS (SELECT CPE_MRN AS "MRN", CPE_ENC_DTE AS "Appt Date", CLD_CLD_CENTER, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 AS "Department", CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 AS "Service", CLD_DEPT_NAME AS "Department Name", CRE_RES_NAME AS "Provider Name", CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME AS "Visit Type", CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Sch') AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT date AND CURRENT date + 7 DAYS AND (CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR IN ('TX180', 'TX300', 'TX120', 'TX330', 'TX90', 'TX210') OR CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME = 'BMS MD TX') ) SELECT A."MRN", PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, YEAR("Appt Date" - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) "Age at Appt", CPP_LANG, "Appt Date", CLD_CLD_CENTER "Location", "Department", "Service", "Department Name", "Provider Name", "Visit Type", CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR "Visit Type Abbr" FROM APPT A JOIN (SELECT TM_MRN MRN FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS ON AV_ELEMENT = 'CASE_STS' AND AV_CODE = TM_CASE_STS AND TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7') AND TM_SITE_CD like 'C50%' UNION SELECT CC_MRN MRN FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE (CC_CLSF_CD LIKE 'C50.%' ) AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND (CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) ) B ON A."MRN" = B.MRN JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY ON A."MRN" = PLA_MRN JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON A."MRN" = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_PAS_PATIENT ON A."MRN" = CPP_MRN WHERE PT_SEX = 'F' AND CLD_CLD_CENTER = '300 E66' AND PLA_LST_CHEMO_DTE IS NULL

prompt: I would like a daily dataline of patients with CNS tumors who have an order for bevacizumab from the prior day.
completion: WITH ORDERS AS (SELECT DISTINCT OO_MRN, OO_ENTER_DTE, OO_SUMMARY_LINE, DOC_NAME REQ_DR_NAME, DOC_ACDMC_SVC REQ_DR_SVC FROM IDB.OMS_ORDER JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_CATALOG ON OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID = OOC_MSTR_ITEM_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_STATUS ON OO_ORD_STS_CD = OSTS_ORD_STS_CD JOIN IDB.DOC ON DOC_DR_NO = OO_REQ_DR_NO JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PT_MRN = OO_MRN AND YEAR(OO_ENTER_DTE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) >= 18 WHERE LOWER(OOC_ITEM_NAME) like '%bevacizumab%' AND OO_ORD_STS_CD NOT IN ('CANP', 'CANC', 'AUC3') AND OO_ENTER_DTE = CURRENT date - 1 DAY ) , PREVIOUS_BEVACIZUMAB AS (SELECT O.OO_MRN MRN FROM ORDERS O JOIN IDB.OMS_ORDER OO ON OO.OO_MRN = O.OO_MRN AND O.OO_ENTER_DTE > OO.OO_ENTER_DTE JOIN IDB.OMS_STATUS ON OO.OO_ORD_STS_CD = OSTS_ORD_STS_CD JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_CATALOG ON OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID = OOC_MSTR_ITEM_GUID WHERE LOWER(OOC_ITEM_NAME) like '%bevacizumab%' AND OO.OO_ORD_STS_CD NOT IN ('CANP', 'CANC', 'AUC3') AND OO.OO_ENTER_DTE < CURRENT date - 1 DAY ) , CNS AS (SELECT TM_MRN MRN FROM ORDERS JOIN IDB.CDB_TUMOR ON TM_MRN = OO_MRN JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS ON AV_ELEMENT = 'CASE_STS' AND AV_CODE = TM_CASE_STS AND TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') WHERE (TM_HIST_CD IN ('M9440/3', 'M9441/3', 'M9442/3', '9442/3') OR TM_SITE_CD LIKE 'C719%') UNION SELECT CC_MRN MRN FROM ORDERS JOIN IDB.CTC_CLSF ON CC_MRN = OO_MRN JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE CC_CLSF_CD IN ('C71.9') ) SELECT DISTINCT OO_MRN, CHAR(OO_ENTER_DTE) OO_ENTER_DTE, OO_SUMMARY_LINE, REQ_DR_NAME, REQ_DR_SVC FROM CNS LEFT JOIN ORDERS ON OO_MRN = MRN WHERE MRN NOT IN (SELECT MRN FROM PREVIOUS_BEVACIZUMAB) ; WITH ORDERS AS (SELECT OO_MRN, OO_ENTER_DTE, OO_SUMMARY_LINE, DOC_NAME REQ_DR_NAME, DOC_ACDMC_SVC REQ_DR_SVC FROM IDB.OMS_ORDER JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_CATALOG ON OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID = OOC_MSTR_ITEM_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_STATUS ON OO_ORD_STS_CD = OSTS_ORD_STS_CD JOIN IDB.DOC ON DOC_DR_NO = OO_REQ_DR_NO JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PT_MRN = OO_MRN AND YEAR(OO_ENTER_DTE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) >= 18 WHERE LOWER(OOC_ITEM_NAME) like '%bevacizumab%' AND OO_ORD_STS_CD NOT IN ('CANP', 'CANC', 'AUC3') AND OO_ENTER_DTE = CURRENT date - 1 DAY ) , PREVIOUS_BEVACIZUMAB AS (SELECT O.OO_MRN MRN FROM ORDERS O JOIN IDB.OMS_ORDER OO ON OO.OO_MRN = O.OO_MRN AND O.OO_ENTER_DTE > OO.OO_ENTER_DTE JOIN IDB.OMS_STATUS ON OO.OO_ORD_STS_CD = OSTS_ORD_STS_CD JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_CATALOG ON OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID = OOC_MSTR_ITEM_GUID WHERE LOWER(OOC_ITEM_NAME) like '%bevacizumab%' AND OO.OO_ORD_STS_CD NOT IN ('CANP', 'CANC', 'AUC3') ) , CNS AS (SELECT PT_MRN, CASE_STS, CHAR(TM_DX_DTE) TM_DX_DTE, TM_HIST_CD, HIST_DESC, TM_SITE_CD, SITE_DESC, CHAR(MIN_ICD9_EFF_DTE) MIN_ICD9_EFF_DTE, ICD9_CD, ICD9_DESC FROM IDB.PATIENT LEFT JOIN (SELECT TM_MRN, AV_DESC AS CASE_STS, TM_DX_DTE, TM_HIST_CD, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS HIST_DESC, TM_SITE_CD, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_DESC FROM ORDERS JOIN IDB.CDB_TUMOR ON TM_MRN = OO_MRN JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS ON AV_ELEMENT = 'CASE_STS' AND AV_CODE = TM_CASE_STS AND TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND (TM_HIST_CD IN ('M9440/3', 'M9441/3', 'M9442/3', '9442/3') OR TM_SITE_CD LIKE 'C719%')) AS CDB ON TM_MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN (SELECT CC_MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS MIN_ICD9_EFF_DTE, CC_CLSF_CD AS ICD9_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS ICD9_DESC FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE CC_CLSF_CD IN ('C71.9') GROUP BY CC_MRN, CC_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK ) AS ICD9 ON CC_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE COALESCE(TM_MRN, CC_MRN) IS NOT NULL ) SELECT DISTINCT CNS.* FROM CNS JOIN ORDERS ON OO_MRN=PT_MRN WHERE PT_MRN NOT IN (SELECT MRN FROM PREVIOUS_BEVACIZUMAB) ;

ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CPE_MRN ORDER BY CPE_ENC_DTE DESC) AS RN_LA FROM (SELECT DISTINCT MRN FROM X) X1 JOIN IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER ON CPE_MRN = MRN JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CRE_RES_TYP IN ('Physician') ) CPE_ENC_DTE) AS RN_NA FROM (SELECT DISTINCT MRN FROM X) X1 JOIN IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER ON CPE_MRN = MRN JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Sch') AND CRE_RES_TYP IN ('Physician') ) , Y AS (SELECT DISTINCT X.*, LA.CPE_ENC_DTE AS "Last Appt Date", STRIP(LA.CRE_RES_NAME) AS "Last Appt Physician", NA.CPE_ENC_DTE AS "Next Appt Date", STRIP(NA.CRE_RES_NAME) AS "Next Appt Physician" FROM X LEFT JOIN LA ON X.MRN = LA.CPE_MRN AND RN_LA = 1 LEFT JOIN
