prompt: Provide data for patients previously and currently enrolled in any Early Drug Development (EDD) service trials.
completion: WITH PTS AS (SELECT DISTINCT AC_MRN, PRO_IRB_NO FROM IDB.PROTOCOL JOIN IDB.ACCRUALS ON PRO_IRB_NO = AC_IRB_NO JOIN IDB.ACCRUALS_DATES ON AC_IRB_NO = ACD_IRB_NO AND AC_SUBJ_ID_NO = ACD_SUBJ_ID_NO AND AC_SUBJ_SEQ_NO = ACD_SUBJ_SEQ_NO WHERE PRO_SPON_DPT_NAME = 'Medicine/ Early Drug Development Service' AND AC_MRN <> 'ZZZZZZZZ' ) , TIS AS (SELECT DISTINCT TRIM(PT_MRN) "MRN", TBA_PROCUREMENT_DTE "Procurement Date", TRIM(TBA_ACCESSION_NUM) "Accession Number", TRIM(TBA_PART_NUM) "Part Number", TRIM(TBA_SUB_PART_NUM) "Sub Part Number", TBD_BANK_NUM "Bank Number", TRIM(TBA_TISSUE_TYPE_DESC) "Tissue Type", TBA_DISEASE_DESC "Disease", TBA_SITE_DESC "Site", TBD_CATEGORY_DESC, TBD_UNIT_DESC, TBD_SPECIMEN_TYPE_DESC, TBD_QUALITY_DESC, PRO_IRB_NO FROM DV.TISSUE_BANK_ACCESSION JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON TBA_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID JOIN PTS A ON PT_MRN = AC_MRN LEFT JOIN DV.TISSUE_BANK_DETAIL ON TBA_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = TBD_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID AND TBA_ACCESSION_NUM = TBD_ACCESSION_NUM AND TBA_PART_NUM = TBD_PART_NUM AND TBA_SUB_PART_NUM = TBD_SUB_PART_NUM WHERE (TBD_RESERVED_REQUEST_ID IS NULL OR TBD_RESERVED_REQUEST_ID IN ('', '1036', '1234')) AND (TBD_DISTRIBUTION_DT IS NULL OR TBD_REQUEST_ID = '1234') AND TBD_BANK_NUM IS NOT NULL AND SUBSTR(TBD_ACCESSION_NUM, 1, 1) IN ('A', 'H', 'S') AND TBD_QUALITY_DESC = 'Frozen Specimen' AND TBD_SPECIMEN_TYPE_DESC = 'Tissue' ) SELECT DISTINCT AC_MRN "MRN" , "Procurement Date" , "Accession Number" , "Part Number" , "Sub Part Number" , "Bank Number" , "Disease" , "Site" , "Tissue Type" , TBD_CATEGORY_DESC "Specimen Category" , TBD_UNIT_DESC "Specimen Unit" FROM PTS LEFT JOIN TIS ON AC_MRN = "MRN" ; WITH PTS AS (SELECT DISTINCT AC_MRN FROM IDB.PROTOCOL JOIN IDB.ACCRUALS ON PRO_IRB_NO = AC_IRB_NO JOIN IDB.ACCRUALS_DATES ON AC_IRB_NO = ACD_IRB_NO AND AC_SUBJ_ID_NO = ACD_SUBJ_ID_NO AND AC_SUBJ_SEQ_NO = ACD_SUBJ_SEQ_NO WHERE PRO_SPON_DPT_NAME = 'Medicine/ Early Drug Development Service' AND AC_MRN <> 'ZZZZZZZZ' ) , IMPACT1 AS (SELECT DISTINCT MD.PRPT_MRN IMPACT_MRN, MDD.DT_DTE IMPACT_DATE, MD.PRPT_PATH_RPT_ID IMPACT_RPT_ID, MD.PRPT_ACCESSION_NO IMPACT_ACCESSION_NO, PDRX_DMP_SAMPLE_ID IMPACT_SAMPLE_ID, PDRX_DMP_PATIENT_ID, PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_DESC FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V MD JOIN DV.DATE_V MDD ON MDD.DT_DATE_ID = MD.PRPT_PROCEDURE_DATE_ID JOIN DV.PATH_RPRT_TYPE_LOOKUP ON MD.PRPT_REPORT_TYPE = PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_CD JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_REFERENCES ON MD.PRPT_PATH_RPT_ID = PRPTR_CHILD_PATH_RPT_ID JOIN PTS A ON A.AC_MRN = MD.PRPT_MRN JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML ON MD.PRPT_ACCESSION_NO = PDRX_ACCESSION_NO WHERE CONTAINS(MD."PRPT_REPORT", '("MSK-IMPACT")') = 1 AND PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_DESC = 'Diagnostic Molecular Pathology' ) , IMPACT AS (SELECT A.IMPACT_MRN, A.IMPACT_DATE, A.IMPACT_RPT_ID, A.IMPACT_ACCESSION_NO, A.IMPACT_SAMPLE_ID, A.PDRX_DMP_PATIENT_ID, B.PRPT_REPORT, A.PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_DESC FROM IMPACT1 A JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V B ON A.IMPACT_ACCESSION_NO = B.PRPT_ACCESSION_NO AND A.IMPACT_MRN = B.PRPT_MRN) SELECT AC_MRN "MRN" , PDRX_DMP_PATIENT_ID "DMP ID" , PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_DESC "Report Type" , SUBSTR(B.PRPT_REPORT, 1, 32765) "Pathology Text" , IMPACT_DATE "IMPACT Date" , IMPACT_SAMPLE_ID "IMPACT Sample ID" , IMPACT_ACCESSION_NO "IMPACT Accession Number" FROM PTS A LEFT JOIN IMPACT B ON A.AC_MRN = B.IMPACT_MRN ; SELECT DISTINCT AC_MRN "MRN", PRO_IRB_NO "IRB Number", AC_CONS_DTE "Consent Date", ACD_OFF_STUDY_DTE "Off Study Date" FROM IDB.PROTOCOL JOIN IDB.ACCRUALS ON PRO_IRB_NO = AC_IRB_NO JOIN IDB.ACCRUALS_DATES ON AC_IRB_NO = ACD_IRB_NO AND AC_SUBJ_ID_NO = ACD_SUBJ_ID_NO AND AC_SUBJ_SEQ_NO = ACD_SUBJ_SEQ_NO WHERE PRO_SPON_DPT_NAME = 'Medicine/ Early Drug Development Service' AND AC_MRN <> 'ZZZZZZZZ' AND ACD_CONS_DTE <> ACD_TX_ST_DTE ; SELECT DISTINCT AC_MRN "MRN", PT_LAST_NAME "Last Name", PT_FIRST_NAME "First Name", PT_SEX "Gender", PT_VITAL_STATUS "Vital Status", PT_DEATH_DTE "Date of Death" FROM IDB.PROTOCOL JOIN IDB.ACCRUALS ON PRO_IRB_NO = AC_IRB_NO JOIN IDB.ACCRUALS_DATES ON AC_IRB_NO = ACD_IRB_NO AND AC_SUBJ_ID_NO = ACD_SUBJ_ID_NO AND AC_SUBJ_SEQ_NO = ACD_SUBJ_SEQ_NO JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON AC_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY ON PT_MRN = PLA_MRN JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTV_DTL ON PT_MRN = LAD_MRN WHERE PRO_SPON_DPT_NAME = 'Medicine/ Early Drug Development Service' AND AC_MRN <> 'ZZZZZZZZ' ; WITH PTS AS (SELECT DISTINCT AC_MRN, PRO_IRB_NO, AC_CONS_DTE, ACD_OFF_STUDY_DTE FROM IDB.PROTOCOL JOIN IDB.ACCRUALS ON PRO_IRB_NO = AC_IRB_NO JOIN IDB.ACCRUALS_DATES ON AC_IRB_NO = ACD_IRB_NO AND AC_SUBJ_ID_NO = ACD_SUBJ_ID_NO AND AC_SUBJ_SEQ_NO = ACD_SUBJ_SEQ_NO WHERE PRO_SPON_DPT_NAME = 'Medicine/ Early Drug Development Service' AND AC_MRN <> 'ZZZZZZZZ' AND ACD_CONS_DTE <> ACD_TX_ST_DTE ) , RAD AS (SELECT RTC_TX_MRN, RTC_TX_PLAN_NAME, RTC_TX_START_DTE, RTC_TX_STOP_DTE, 'Radiation' AS TX FROM IDB.RADONC_TREATMENT_COURSE JOIN PTS ON AC_MRN = RTC_TX_MRN) , CHEMO AS (SELECT APR_MRN, APR_GENERIC_NAME, APR_START_DTE, APR_END_DTE, 'Chemotherapy' AS TX FROM IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX JOIN IDB.CHEMO_DRUG_GENERIC ON APR_GENERIC_NAME = CDG_GENERIC_NAME JOIN PTS ON AC_MRN = APR_MRN) , RAD_CHEMO AS (SELECT RTC_TX_MRN AS RC_MRN, RTC_TX_PLAN_NAME AS RC_TX_NAME, RTC_TX_START_DTE AS RC_START_DTE, RTC_TX_STOP_DTE AS RC_STOP_DTE, TX FROM RAD UNION SELECT APR_MRN AS RC_MRN, APR_GENERIC_NAME AS RC_TX_NAME, APR_START_DTE AS RC_START_DTE, APR_END_DTE AS RC_STOP_DTE, TX FROM CHEMO) SELECT AC_MRN "MRN", TX "Treatment Type", RC_TX_NAME "Treatment", RC_START_DTE "Start Date", RC_STOP_DTE "End Date" FROM PTS LEFT JOIN RAD_CHEMO ON AC_MRN = RC_MRN ; WITH PTS AS (SELECT DISTINCT AC_MRN, PRO_IRB_NO, AC_CONS_DTE, ACD_OFF_STUDY_DTE FROM IDB.PROTOCOL JOIN IDB.ACCRUALS ON PRO_IRB_NO = AC_IRB_NO JOIN IDB.ACCRUALS_DATES ON AC_IRB_NO = ACD_IRB_NO AND AC_SUBJ_ID_NO = ACD_SUBJ_ID_NO AND AC_SUBJ_SEQ_NO = ACD_SUBJ_SEQ_NO WHERE PRO_SPON_DPT_NAME = 'Medicine/ Early Drug Development Service' AND AC_MRN <> 'ZZZZZZZZ' AND ACD_CONS_DTE <> ACD_TX_ST_DTE ) , DX AS (SELECT PT_MRN, CASE_STS, TM_DX_DTE, TM_HIST_CD, HIST_DESC, TM_SITE_CD, SITE_DESC, MIN_ICD9_EFF_DTE, ICD9_CD, ICD9_DESC FROM IDB.PATIENT LEFT JOIN (SELECT TM_MRN, AV_DESC AS CASE_STS, TM_DX_DTE, TM_HIST_CD, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS HIST_DESC, TM_SITE_CD, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_DESC FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS ON AV_ELEMENT = 'CASE_STS' AND AV_CODE = TM_CASE_STS AND TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') ) AS CDB ON TM_MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN (SELECT CC_MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS MIN_ICD9_EFF_DTE, CC_CLSF_CD AS ICD9_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS ICD9_DESC FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE 1=1 AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND ((CC_CLSF_CD BETWEEN '140' AND '239.99') OR (CC_CLSF_CD BETWEEN 'C00' AND 'D49')) GROUP BY CC_MRN, CC_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK ) AS ICD9 ON CC_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE COALESCE(TM_MRN, CC_MRN) IS NOT NULL ) SELECT DISTINCT AC_MRN "MRN", TM_DX_DTE "Primary Dx Date", HIST_DESC "Primary Histology", SITE_DESC "Primary Site", MIN_ICD9_EFF_DTE "Secondary Dx Date", ICD9_DESC "Secondary Histology/Site" FROM PTS JOIN DX ON AC_MRN = PT_MRN ; WITH PTS AS (SELECT DISTINCT AC_MRN, PRO_IRB_NO, AC_CONS_DTE, ACD_OFF_STUDY_DTE FROM IDB.PROTOCOL JOIN IDB.ACCRUALS ON PRO_IRB_NO = AC_IRB_NO JOIN IDB.ACCRUALS_DATES ON AC_IRB_NO = ACD_IRB_NO AND AC_SUBJ_ID_NO = ACD_SUBJ_ID_NO AND AC_SUBJ_SEQ_NO = ACD_SUBJ_SEQ_NO WHERE PRO_SPON_DPT_NAME = 'Medicine/ Early Drug Development Service' AND AC_MRN <> 'ZZZZZZZZ' AND ACD_CONS_DTE <> ACD_TX_ST_DTE ) , GENOMIC AS (SELECT PT_MRN, PATH_RPT_DATE, GENE, GENE2, LOCUS, AA_CHANGE, METHOD, SEARCH_HIT1, SEARCH_HIT2 FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_STRUCTURED_RESULTS_V WHERE METHOD = 'IMPACT' ) SELECT AC_MRN, PATH_RPT_DATE, GENE, GENE2, LOCUS, AA_CHANGE, METHOD, SEARCH_HIT1, SEARCH_HIT2 FROM PTS JOIN GENOMIC ON AC_MRN = PT_MRN ; WITH PTS AS (SELECT DISTINCT AC_MRN, PRO_IRB_NO, AC_CONS_DTE, ACD_OFF_STUDY_DTE FROM IDB.PROTOCOL JOIN IDB.ACCRUALS ON PRO_IRB_NO = AC_IRB_NO JOIN IDB.ACCRUALS_DATES ON AC_IRB_NO = ACD_IRB_NO AND AC_SUBJ_ID_NO = ACD_SUBJ_ID_NO AND AC_SUBJ_SEQ_NO = ACD_SUBJ_SEQ_NO WHERE PRO_SPON_DPT_NAME = 'Medicine/ Early Drug Development Service' AND AC_MRN <> 'ZZZZZZZZ' AND ACD_CONS_DTE <> ACD_TX_ST_DTE ) , CTMS AS (SELECT P.PRT_ID, P.PT_MRN, DISEASE, TXT_END_DATE, OFF_STUDY_DATE, OFF_STUDY_REASON, TXT_END_REASON, BEST_RESPONSE FROM NN.CRDB_DASH_PT_REG R JOIN NN.CRDB_DASH_PT P ON R.PRT_ID = P.PRT_ID AND R.PT_MRN = P.PT_MRN) SELECT DISTINCT AC_MRN, PRT_ID, DISEASE, TXT_END_DATE, OFF_STUDY_DATE, OFF_STUDY_REASON, TXT_END_REASON, BEST_RESPONSE FROM PTS JOIN CTMS ON AC_MRN = PT_MRN

ORDER_ENTER_DATE, "IDB"."OMS_ORDER"."OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE" AS ORDER_SIGNIF_DATE, "IDB"."OMS_STATUS"."OSTS_STS_DESC" AS ORDER_STATUS, "IDB"."OMS_ORDER"."OO_ORD_NAME" AS ORDER_NAME, "IDB"."OMS_ORD_CATALOG"."OOC_ITEM_NAME" AS ORDER_ITEM_NAME, "IDB"."OMS_ORD_CATALOG"."OOC_ITEM_DESC" AS ORDER_ITEM_DESCRIPTION, "IDB"."OMS_ORDER"."OO_SET_NAME" AS ORDER_SET_NAME, "IDB"."OMS_PROVIDER"."OP_DISPLAY_NAME" AS ORDER_PROVIDER, "IDB"."OMS_PROVIDER"."OP_PROV_TYPE" AS ORDER_PROVIDER_TYPE FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS" JOIN "IDB"."OMS_ORDER" ON "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_MRN" = "IDB"."OMS_ORDER"."OO_MRN" JOIN "IDB"."OMS_STATUS" ON "IDB"."OMS_ORDER"."OO_ORD_STS_CD" = "IDB"."OMS_STATUS"."OSTS_ORD_STS_CD" JOIN "IDB"."OMS_ORD_CATALOG" ON "IDB"."OMS_ORDER"."OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID" = "IDB"."OMS_ORD_CATALOG"."OOC_MSTR_ITEM_GUID" LEFT OUTER JOIN "IDB"."OMS_PROVIDER" ON "IDB"."OMS_ORDER"."OO_PVDR_GUID" = "IDB"."OMS_PROVIDER"."OP_PVDR_GUID"), DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS AS (SELECT DISTINCT "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AS PT_DEID, IDB_PATIENT."PT_MRN" AS PT_MRN, "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AS SUBJECT_ID FROM "IDB"."PATIENT" AS IDB_PATIENT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS" ON IDB_PATIENT."PT_MRN" = "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_MRN") SELECT DISTINCT DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS.PT_MRN AS MRN, ORDERS_COLUMNS.ORDER_ENTER_DATE AS ORDER_ENTER_DATE, ORDERS_COLUMNS.ORDER_SIGNIF_DATE AS ORDER_SIGNIF_DATE, ORDERS_COLUMNS.ORDER_STATUS AS ORDER_STATUS, ORDERS_COLUMNS.ORDER_NAME AS ORDER_NAME, ORDERS_COLUMNS.ORDER_ITEM_NAME AS ORDER_ITEM_NAME, ORDERS_COLUMNS.ORDER_ITEM_DESCRIPTION AS ORDER_ITEM_DESCRIPTION, ORDERS_COLUMNS.ORDER_SET_NAME AS ORDER_SET_NAME, ORDERS_COLUMNS.ORDER_PROVIDER AS ORDER_PROVIDER, ORDERS_COLUMNS.ORDER_PROVIDER_TYPE AS ORDER_PROVIDER_TYPE FROM KEYS LEFT OUTER JOIN ORDERS_COLUMNS ON ORDERS_COLUMNS.SUBJECT_ID = KEYS.COHORT_ORDERS_SUBJECT_ID LEFT OUTER JOIN DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS ON DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS.PT_DEID = KEYS.COHORT_PT_DEID;

prompt:
Provide a daily list of patients with released pathology specimens (biopsies or cytology) completed at the Nassau location day prior

Need to confirm if specimen is received in COPATH
completion: WITH BASE AS (SELECT PBD_MRN, PBD_SVC_DTE, PBC_CPT_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK, DOC_NAME, PBI_SVC_LOC FROM IDB.PBD_DTL JOIN IDB.PBD_CODE ON PBD_PBD_CD = PBC_PBD_CD AND PBC_CPT_CD IN ('10005', '10006', '11104', '11106', '15834', '15839', '19000', '19081', '19082', '19083', '19084', '19085', '19086', '19100', '19285', '20205', '20610', '31575', '31576', '38220', '38221', '38222', '38505', '40490', '41100', '42800', '45331', '45333', '55700', '56605', '57100', '57420', '57454', '57455', '57456', '57500', '57505', '58100', '62270', '62272') JOIN IDB.CLM ON PBC_CPT_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.PBD_INVOICE ON PBD_INV_NO = PBI_INV_NO AND PBI_HOSP_ID = '46' JOIN IDB.DOC ON PBI_PERFORM_DR_NO = DOC_DR_NO WHERE PBD_SVC_DTE = CURRENT date - 1 DAY ) , ORD AS (SELECT * FROM (SELECT OO_MRN , OO_SIGNIFICANT_DT , OOC_ITEM_NAME , ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY OO_MRN ORDER BY OO_SIGNIFICANT_DT DESC) AS RN FROM IDB.OMS_ORDER JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_CATALOG ON OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID = OOC_MSTR_ITEM_GUID AND OOC_ITEM_NAME IN ('Surgical Pathology', 'Cytology-Non GYN', 'Diagnostic Molecular Pathology', 'Hematopathology Flow Cytometry Report', 'Diagnostic Molecular Genetics Report', 'Cytogenetics', 'Surgical Pathology Breast', 'Hematopathology Report', 'Cytology-GYN') JOIN BASE ON OO_MRN = PBD_MRN AND OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE <= PBD_SVC_DTE) A WHERE RN=1 ) SELECT PT_MRN MRN , PT_FIRST_NAME , PT_LAST_NAME , PBD_SVC_DTE SERVICE_DTE , PBC_CPT_CD CPT_CODE , CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK CPT_DESC , DOC_NAME PROVIDER , OO_SIGNIFICANT_DT ORDER_RELEASE_DT , OOC_ITEM_NAME ORDER_NAME , PBI_SVC_LOC SVC , PRPT_ACCESSION_NO PATH_ACCESSION_NO , DV.REGEXSTR('(?<=Date of Receipt: ).*', PRPT_REPORT) PATH_RECEIPT_DTE FROM BASE JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON PBD_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN ORD ON PT_MRN = OO_MRN LEFT JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V ON PBD_MRN = PRPT_MRN AND PRPT_PROCEDURE_DTE = PBD_SVC_DTE

prompt: I would like to screen the interventional radiology clinic appointments for research study eligibility. Please use the IR Clinic Schedule to collect patient information
completion: WITH CTE AS (SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN AS "MRN", PT_LAST_NAME "Last", PT_FIRST_NAME "First", CPE_ENC_DTE AS "Appt Date", CLD_DEPT_NAME AS "Department Name", CRE_RES_NAME AS "Provider Name", CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME AS "Visit Type", CPP_LANG "Language", SITE_DESC, HIST_DESC, ICD10_DESC, CASE WHEN TM_SITE_CD like 'C22%' THEN 'Y' WHEN TM_SITE_CD = 'C78.7' THEN 'Y' WHEN ICD10_CD like 'C22%' THEN 'Y' WHEN ICD10_CD = 'C78.7' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS "Liver Involvement", REPLACE(SUBSTR(REPLACE(REPLACE(CAST(XMLSERIALIZE(CONTENT XMLAGG(XMLELEMENT(NAME "c", IDB.CL_PT_APPT_NOTES.CPAN_NOTE) ORDER BY IDB.CL_PT_APPT_NOTES.CPAN_LINE_NO) AS CLOB(3200)) AS VARCHAR(3200)), '<c>', CHR(13) || CHR(10)), '</c>', ''), 2), 'c/>', '') AS "Appt Note" FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON CPE_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID JOIN IDB.CL_PAS_PATIENT ON CPE_MRN = CPP_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_PT_APPT_NOTES ON IDB.CL_PT_APPT_NOTES.CPAN_CL_PT_ID = IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER.CPE_CL_PT_ID AND IDB.CL_PT_APPT_NOTES.CPAN_ENC_DTE_SEQ = IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER.CPE_ENC_DTE_SEQ LEFT JOIN (SELECT TM_MRN, AV_DESC AS CASE_STS, TM_DX_DTE, TM_HIST_CD, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS HIST_DESC, TM_SITE_CD, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_DESC FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS ON AV_ELEMENT = 'CASE_STS' AND AV_CODE = TM_CASE_STS AND TM_CASE_STS IN ('3', '6', '7', '8') WHERE TM_SITE_CD like 'C%' OR TM_SITE_CD like 'D%') AS CDB ON TM_MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN (SELECT CC_MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS MIN_ICD10_EFF_DTE, CC_CLSF_CD AS ICD10_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS ICD10_DESC FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND CC_CLSF_CD like 'C%' OR CC_CLSF_CD like 'D0%' OR CC_CLSF_CD like 'D1%' OR CC_CLSF_CD like 'D2%' OR CC_CLSF_CD like 'D3%' OR CC_CLSF_CD like 'D4%' GROUP BY CC_MRN, CC_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK HAVING MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) BETWEEN '2018-01-01' AND CURRENT DATE) AS ICD9 ON CC_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE CLD_DEPT_NAME IN ('IR CLINIC 1275', 'IR CLINIC 16 E60-4', 'IR CLINIC 53', 'IR 12575 PENDING APPRVL') AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT date AND CASE WHEN DAYOFWEEK(CURRENT date) = 6 THEN CURRENT date + 3 DAYS ELSE CURRENT date + 1 DAY END GROUP BY CPE_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, CPE_ENC_DTE, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6, CLD_DEPT_NAME, CRE_RES_NAME, CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME, CPP_LANG, TM_SITE_CD, ICD10_CD, SITE_DESC, HIST_DESC, ICD10_DESC) SELECT "Appt Date", TRIM("Last") "Last", TRIM("First") "First", TRIM("MRN") "MRN", TRIM("Provider Name") "Provider Name", TRIM("Appt Note") "Appt Note", TRIM("Language") "Language", LISTAGG(DISTINCT TRIM(SITE_DESC), '; ') "CDB Tumor Site", LISTAGG(DISTINCT TRIM(HIST_DESC), '; ') "CDB Tumor Histology", LISTAGG(DISTINCT TRIM(ICD10_DESC), '; ') "ICD Diagnosis", TRIM("Liver Involvement") "Liver Involvement", TRIM("Department Name") "Department Name", TRIM("Visit Type") "Visit Type" FROM CTE GROUP BY "MRN", "Last", "First", "Appt Date", "Department Name", "Provider Name", "Visit Type", "Language", "Liver Involvement", "Appt Note" ORDER BY "Appt Date", "MRN", "Liver Involvement" DESC ;

prompt: Opex Working Group- we are piloting the use of a CIS Clin Doc note-  "Dose Assignment and Modification – Research" within TOS and EDD research services. The note has 2 sections - Dose assignment and modification. We want a list of when this note is used for dose assignment and date and time stamped on when initiated, signed off.
completion: SELECT CDD_DOC_GUID, CDD_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, CDD_AUTH_PROV_NAME, DOC_SVC, CDD_DOC_NAME, CASE WHEN CDD_SIGNED_DTE IS NULL THEN 'PENDING' ELSE 'SIGNED' END DOC_STATUS, CDD_SIGNED_DTE, CDD_LAST_UPD_DT FROM DV.CLINDOC_FULL_TEXT_V JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON CDD_MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_PROVIDER ON CDD_AUTH_PROV_GUID = OP_PVDR_GUID LEFT JOIN IDB.DOC ON OP_PVDR_NO = DOC_DR_NO WHERE 1 = 1 AND CDD_CANCEL_IND = '0' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND = '0' AND UPPER(CDD_DOC_NAME) LIKE '%DOSE%ASSIGN%'

prompt: Provide the number of doses given/or prescribed daptomycin and IV and oral linezolid for the period of 1-1-05 to 12-31-09 sorted by year.
completion: WITH "cte1" AS (SELECT "t1"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AS "Deident PT #", "t2"."PINC_GENERIC_NAME" AS "Generic Drug Name", "t3"."DT_YEAR" AS "Order Start Year", "t4"."POD_NET_ACCUM_DOSE" AS "Net Dose", "t5"."PA_IP_OP_IND" AS "IP-OP Indicator" FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED" "t1" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PHM_PT_MEDS_MQT" "t6" ON "t1"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t6"."POD_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PHM_INVENTORY_CATALOG" "t2" ON "t6"."POD_PHARMA_INVENTORY_CTLG_ID" = "t2"."PINC_INVENTORY_CTLG_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PHM_ORDER_DTL" "t4" ON "t6"."POD_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t4"."POD_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AND "t6"."POD_PHARMA_INVENTORY_CTLG_ID" = "t4"."POD_PHARMA_INVENTORY_CTLG_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE" "t3" ON "t4"."POD_START_DATE_ID" = "t3"."DT_DATE_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_ACCOUNT" "t5" ON "t4"."POD_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t5"."PA_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AND "t4"."POD_PT_ACCT_ID" = "t5"."PA_PT_ACCT_ID" WHERE ("t2"."PINC_GENERIC_NAME" IN ('DAPTOmycin', 'LINEZOLID', 'Linezolid') AND ("t3"."DT_YEAR" BETWEEN 2005 AND 2009 AND "t5"."PA_IP_OP_IND" IN ('INPATIENT'))) ) SELECT "t7"."Generic Drug Name" AS "Generic Drug Name", "t7"."Order Start Year" AS "Order Start Year", SUM("t7"."Net Dose") AS "SUM (Net Dose)" FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED" "t8" INNER JOIN "cte1" "t7" ON "t8"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t7"."Deident PT #" GROUP BY "t7"."Generic Drug Name", "t7"."Order Start Year"

prompt: List of active (seen w/n last 12 months) psychiatry patients who live near a NJ regional site.
completion: WITH LAST_DOS_PRE AS (SELECT CPE_MRN, CPE_ENC_DTE, CRE_RES_NAME, CRE_RES_ID, CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CPE_MRN, CRE_RES_ID ORDER BY CPE_ENC_DTE DESC) AS ORDERING FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CPE_ENC_DTE >= CURRENT date - 12 MONTH AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 = 'PSY' AND CRE_RES_TYP IN ('Physician', 'Fellow') ) , LAST_DOS AS (SELECT CPE_MRN, CPE_ENC_DTE, CRE_RES_NAME, CRE_RES_ID, CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME FROM LAST_DOS_PRE WHERE ORDERING = 1) , NEXT_DOS_PRE AS (SELECT E.CPE_MRN, E.CPE_ENC_DTE, R.CRE_RES_NAME, R.CRE_RES_ID, V.CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY E.CPE_MRN, R.CRE_RES_ID ORDER BY E.CPE_ENC_DTE ASC) AS ORDERING FROM LAST_DOS A JOIN IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER E ON A.CPE_MRN = E.CPE_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE R ON E.CPE_VST_RES_ID = R.CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT D ON E.CPE_DEPT_ID = D.CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE V ON E.CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = V.CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE E.CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Sch') AND E.CPE_ENC_DTE > CURRENT date AND D.CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 = 'PSY' AND R.CRE_RES_TYP = 'Physician' ) , NEXT_DOS AS (SELECT CPE_MRN, CPE_ENC_DTE, CRE_RES_NAME, CRE_RES_ID, CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME FROM NEXT_DOS_PRE WHERE ORDERING = 1) , BR_LOC AS (SELECT 40.639228 AS LAT2, -74.584477 AS LON2, 'Basking Ridge' AS LOC2 FROM SYSIBM.SYSDUMMY1) , BERGEN_LOC AS (SELECT 41.05706 AS LAT3, -74.06948 AS LON3, 'Bergen' AS LOC3 FROM SYSIBM.SYSDUMMY1) , MON_LOC AS (SELECT 40.374905 AS LAT4, -74.146517 AS LON4, 'Monmouth' AS LOC4 FROM SYSIBM.SYSDUMMY1) , MAIN_LOC AS (SELECT 40.763909 AS LAT5, -73.956047 AS LON5, 'Main' AS LOC5 FROM SYSIBM.SYSDUMMY1) SELECT PT_MRN "MRN", PT_LAST_NAME "Last Name", PT_FIRST_NAME "First Name", PT_ZIP_CD "Zip Code", L.CPE_ENC_DTE "Last DOS", L.CRE_RES_NAME "Last DOS Attending", L.CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME "Last DOS Visit Type", N.CPE_ENC_DTE "Scheduled Visit Date", N.CRE_RES_NAME "Scheduled Attending", N.CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME "Scheduled Visit Type", ROUND(DEGREES(ACOS(SIN(RADIANS(ZC_LATITUDE)) *SIN(RADIANS(LAT2)) +COS(RADIANS(ZC_LATITUDE)) *COS(RADIANS(LAT2)) *COS(RADIANS(ZC_LONGITUDE-LON2))) * 69.09)) AS "Distance to BR", ROUND(DEGREES(ACOS(SIN(RADIANS(ZC_LATITUDE)) *SIN(RADIANS(LAT3)) +COS(RADIANS(ZC_LATITUDE)) *COS(RADIANS(LAT3)) *COS(RADIANS(ZC_LONGITUDE-LON3))) * 69.09)) AS "Distance to Bergen", ROUND(DEGREES(ACOS(SIN(RADIANS(ZC_LATITUDE)) *SIN(RADIANS(LAT4)) +COS(RADIANS(ZC_LATITUDE)) *COS(RADIANS(LAT4)) *COS(RADIANS(ZC_LONGITUDE-LON4))) * 69.09)) AS "Distance to Monmouth", ROUND(DEGREES(ACOS(SIN(RADIANS(ZC_LATITUDE)) *SIN(RADIANS(LAT5)) +COS(RADIANS(ZC_LATITUDE)) *COS(RADIANS(LAT5)) *COS(RADIANS(ZC_LONGITUDE-LON5))) * 69.09)) AS "Distance to Main" FROM LAST_DOS L LEFT JOIN NEXT_DOS N ON L.CPE_MRN = N.CPE_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.PATIENT P ON L.CPE_MRN = P.PT_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.ZIPCODE ON ZC_ZIP = LEFT(PT_ZIP_CD, 5), BR_LOC, BERGEN_LOC, MON_LOC, MAIN_LOC ORDER BY PT_LAST_NAME, PT_MRN

prompt: Provide a weekly list of pediatric patients who have alopecia and completed either systemic or radiation therapy (cytotoxic chemotherapy and external beam radiation therapy) for their cancer at least 1 year ago.
completion: WITH MAIN AS (SELECT CC_MRN AS DX_MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS DX_DATE, CLM_CLSF_CD AS DX_CODE, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS DX_DESC FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND ((CC_PT_TYPE = 'I') OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) AND (CC_CLSF_CD like ('L63.%') OR CC_CLSF_CD IN ('704.01', '704.09', '704.00', '704.02', '697.0', '701.8', '704.8', '704.2', '704.3') OR CC_CLSF_CD like ('L64.%') OR CC_CLSF_CD like ('L65.%') OR CC_CLSF_CD like ('L66.%') OR CC_CLSF_CD like ('L67.%')) AND CC_MRN NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT OO_MRN FROM IDB.OMS_ORDER JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_CATALOG ON OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID = OOC_MSTR_ITEM_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_STATUS ON OO_ORD_STS_CD = OSTS_ORD_STS_CD WHERE UPPER(OOC_ITEM_NAME) LIKE ('MINOXIDIL%') AND OO_ORD_STS_CD NOT IN ('CANP', 'CANC', 'AUC3')) GROUP BY CC_MRN, CLM_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK HAVING MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) BETWEEN CURRENT DATE - 60 DAY AND CURRENT DATE), CHM AS (SELECT DISTINCT APR_MRN, CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME, MIN(APR_START_DTE) AS APR_START, MAX(APR_END_DTE) AS APR_END FROM IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX_V JOIN MAIN ON DX_MRN = APR_MRN WHERE CDG_CHEMO_FLAG = 'Y' GROUP BY APR_MRN, CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME) SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, DX_DATE, DX_CODE, DX_DESC, YEAR(DX_DATE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) AS AGE_AT_DIAGNOSIS, YEAR(CURRENT DATE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) CURRENT_AGE, CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME, APR_START, APR_END FROM MAIN JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON DX_MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN CHM ON DX_MRN = APR_MRN WHERE YEAR(DX_DATE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) < 17 AND YEAR(CURRENT DATE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) BETWEEN 6 AND 18 ; WITH MAIN AS (SELECT CC_MRN AS DX_MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS DX_DATE, CLM_CLSF_CD AS DX_CODE, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS DX_DESC FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND ((CC_PT_TYPE = 'I') OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) AND (CC_CLSF_CD like ('L63.%') OR CC_CLSF_CD IN ('704.01', '704.09', '704.00', '704.02', '697.0', '701.8', '704.8', '704.2', '704.3') OR CC_CLSF_CD like ('L64.%') OR CC_CLSF_CD like ('L65.%') OR CC_CLSF_CD like ('L66.%') OR CC_CLSF_CD like ('L67.%')) AND CC_MRN NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT OO_MRN FROM IDB.OMS_ORDER JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_CATALOG ON OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID = OOC_MSTR_ITEM_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_STATUS ON OO_ORD_STS_CD = OSTS_ORD_STS_CD WHERE UPPER(OOC_ITEM_NAME) LIKE ('MINOXIDIL%') AND OO_ORD_STS_CD NOT IN ('CANP', 'CANC', 'AUC3')) GROUP BY CC_MRN, CLM_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK HAVING MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) BETWEEN CURRENT DATE - 60 DAY AND CURRENT DATE), RAD AS (SELECT DISTINCT RTC_TX_MRN, RTC_TX_PLAN_NAME, RTC_TX_PLANNED_FRACTIONS, RTC_TX_DELIVERED_FRACTIONS, RTC_TX_PLANNED_DOSE, RTC_TX_DELIVERED_DOSE, RTC_TX_START_DTE, RTC_TX_STOP_DTE, RTC_PRIMARY_REF_POINT FROM IDB.RADONC_TREATMENT_COURSE JOIN MAIN ON DX_MRN = RTC_TX_MRN) SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, DX_DATE, DX_CODE, DX_DESC, YEAR(DX_DATE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) AS AGE_AT_DIAGNOSIS, YEAR(CURRENT DATE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) CURRENT_AGE, RTC_TX_PLAN_NAME, RTC_TX_PLANNED_FRACTIONS, RTC_TX_DELIVERED_FRACTIONS, RTC_TX_PLANNED_DOSE, RTC_TX_DELIVERED_DOSE, RTC_TX_START_DTE, RTC_TX_STOP_DTE, RTC_PRIMARY_REF_POINT FROM MAIN JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON DX_MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN RAD ON DX_MRN = RTC_TX_MRN WHERE YEAR(DX_DATE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) < 17 AND YEAR(CURRENT DATE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) BETWEEN 6 AND 18 ;

prompt: Provide list of patients who completed both massage and physical/occupational therapy services within a 7 day timeframe in 2019.
completion: WITH PTOT_APPT AS (SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN AS PTOT_MRN, CPE_ENC_DTE AS PTOT_DTE, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 AS PTOT_DEPT, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 AS PTOT_SERVICE, CLD_DEPT_NAME AS PTOT_DEPT_NAME, CRE_RES_NAME AS PTOT_PROVIDER, CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME AS PTOT_VISIT_TYPE FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE 1=1 AND CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CLD_DEPT_ID IN (182, 412, 613, 615, 859, 1073, 1157, 1198, 1318, 1603) ) , MASSAGE_APPT AS (SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN AS M_MRN, CPE_ENC_DTE AS M_DTE, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 AS M_DEPT, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 AS M_SERVICE, CLD_DEPT_NAME AS M_DEPT_NAME, CRE_RES_NAME AS M_PROVIDER, CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME AS M_VISIT_TYPE, CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE 1=1 AND CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CLD_DEPT_NAME IN ('INTEG MED 74', 'INTEG MED 300 E66') AND CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID IN (8217, 8222, 8444, 8443, 12749, 12748, 7220, 7219, 12747, 12746, 340, 341, 342, 343) ) SELECT DISTINCT PTOT_MRN AS "MRN" , PT_LAST_NAME AS "PT Last Name" , PT_FIRST_NAME AS "PT First Name" , PTOT_DTE AS "PT/OT Dte" , PTOT_VISIT_TYPE AS "PT/OT Visit Type" , PTOT_PROVIDER AS "PT/OT Provider" , M_DTE AS "Massage Dte" , M_VISIT_TYPE AS "Massage Visit Type" , M_PROVIDER AS "Massage Provider" FROM PTOT_APPT JOIN MASSAGE_APPT ON PTOT_MRN = M_MRN AND ((PTOT_DTE BETWEEN M_DTE - 14 DAYS AND M_DTE + 14 DAYS) OR (M_DTE BETWEEN PTOT_DTE - 14 DAYS AND PTOT_DTE + 14 DAYS)) JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PTOT_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE 1=1 AND (YEAR(PTOT_DTE) = 2019 OR YEAR(M_DTE) = 2019) ;

prompt: Provide a weekly list of T4, N0-3 patients seen by breast surgery and their NAC status (if they have started, are currently on, or have completed NAC).
completion: WITH CDB AS (SELECT DISTINCT TM_MRN AS MRN, TM_DX_DTE AS DX_DATE, TM_HIST_CD AS HIST_CODE, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS HIST_DESC, TM_SITE_CD AS SITE_CODE, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_DESC, TM_CLIN_TNM_T AS T_STAGE, TM_CLIN_TNM_N N_STAGE FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM H ON TM_HIST_CD = H.CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON TM_SITE_CD = S.CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.SEERGROUPING ON RECODE = DV.SEERF_ICDO(TM_SITE_CD, TM_HIST_CD) AND CATEGORY1 = 'Breast' WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND UPPER(TM_CLIN_TNM_T) like '%T%4%' ) , CD AS (SELECT * FROM (SELECT CDD_MRN AS MRN, CDD_SERVICE_DTE, MAX(CASE WHEN CDO_ITEM_NAME IN ('T', 'T:') THEN TRIM(SUBSTR(CDO_VALUE_TEXT, 1, 200)) END) AS T_STAGE, MAX(CASE WHEN CDO_ITEM_NAME IN ('N', 'N:') THEN TRIM(SUBSTR(CDO_VALUE_TEXT, 1, 200)) END) AS N_STAGE, MAX(CASE WHEN CDO_ITEM_NAME IN ('M', 'M:') THEN TRIM(SUBSTR(CDO_VALUE_TEXT, 1, 200)) END) AS "M Stage", MAX(CASE WHEN CDO_ITEM_NAME IN ('Staging') THEN TRIM(SUBSTR(CDO_VALUE_TEXT, 1, 200)) END) AS "Stage" FROM IDB.CD_DOCUMENT JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION ON CDD_DOC_GUID = CDO_DOC_GUID AND CDD_AUTHORED_DTE = CDO_AUTHORED_DTE WHERE 1=1 AND CDD_DOC_NAME like '%Breast%' AND CDO_ITEM_NAME IN ('T', 'T:', 'N', 'N:', 'M', 'M:', 'Staging') AND CDD_CANCEL_IND <> '1' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND <> '1' GROUP BY CDD_MRN, CDD_SERVICE_DTE) C WHERE UPPER(T_STAGE) like '%T%4%' ) , T AS (SELECT MRN, T_STAGE, N_STAGE FROM CDB UNION ALL SELECT MRN, T_STAGE, N_STAGE FROM CD) , CHEMO_ORDERS AS (SELECT APR_MRN, MIN(APR_START_DTE) MIN_START_DATE, MAX(APR_END_DTE) MAX_END_DATE, T_STAGE, N_STAGE FROM (SELECT DISTINCT APR_MRN, APR_GENERIC_NAME, APR_DRUG_NAME, APR_START_DTE, APR_END_DTE, T_STAGE, N_STAGE FROM T JOIN IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX ON MRN = APR_MRN WHERE(UPPER(APR_GENERIC_NAME) like '%CYCLOPHOSPHAMIDE%' OR UPPER(APR_GENERIC_NAME) like '%FLUOROURACIL%' OR UPPER(APR_GENERIC_NAME) like '%METHOTREXATE%' OR UPPER(APR_GENERIC_NAME) like '%PACLITAXEL%' OR UPPER(APR_GENERIC_NAME) like '%TRASTUZUMAB%' OR UPPER(APR_GENERIC_NAME) like '%PERTUZUMAB%' OR UPPER(APR_GENERIC_NAME) like '%DOXORUBICIN%' OR UPPER(APR_GENERIC_NAME) like '%CARBOPLATIN%') AND APR_CHEMO_FLAG = 'Y') A GROUP BY APR_MRN, T_STAGE, N_STAGE) , SURG AS (SELECT DISTINCT SSE_MRN, SSE_SURG_DTE, SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD, SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC, SSP_SURG_SVC_CD FROM IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE ON SSE_LOG_ID = SSP_LOG_ID WHERE SSP_SURG_SVC_CD = 'BRE' ) , APPTS AS (SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN AS "MRN", CPE_ENC_DTE AS "Appt Date", TIME(CPE_APPT_DT) AS "Time", CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 AS "Department", CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 AS "Service", CLD_DEPT_NAME AS "Department Name", CRE_RES_NAME AS "Provider Name", CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME AS "Visit Type" FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN CHEMO_ORDERS ON APR_MRN = CPE_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Sch') AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 = 'SRG' AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 = 'BRE' AND CRE_RES_TYP IN ('Physician') AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT date AND CURRENT date + 14 DAYS ) SELECT DISTINCT S.APR_MRN "MRN", MIN_START_DATE CHEMO_START_DATE, MAX_END_DATE CHEMO_END_DATE, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_LAST_NAME, T_STAGE, N_STAGE, "Appt Date", "Provider Name" FROM CHEMO_ORDERS S JOIN APPTS ON S.APR_MRN = "MRN" LEFT JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON S.APR_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE S.APR_MRN NOT IN (SELECT SSE_MRN FROM SURG)

prompt: Provide a daily list of all breast cancer patients prescribed a CDK4/6 inhibitor the prior day
completion: WITH CHEMO AS (SELECT APR_MRN AS FIRST_CHEMO_MRN, MIN(APR_START_DTE) AS FIRST_CHEMO_DATE, CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME AS FIRST_CHEMO_GENERIC_NAME FROM IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX_V WHERE 1=1 AND CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME IN ('PALBOCICLIB', 'RIBOCICLIB', 'ABEMACICLIB') GROUP BY APR_MRN, CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME HAVING MIN(APR_START_DTE) = CURRENT DATE - 1 DAY) , LABS AS (SELECT DISTINCT LR_MRN, LR_PERFORMED_DTE, LR_TEST_NAME, LR_SUBTEST_NAME, LR_RESULT_VALUE FROM CHEMO JOIN IDB.LAB_RESULTS ON FIRST_CHEMO_MRN = LR_MRN WHERE LR_TEST_NAME = 'Comprehensive Metabolic Panel' AND LR_PERFORMED_DTE BETWEEN FIRST_CHEMO_DATE - 1 DAY AND FIRST_CHEMO_DATE ) SELECT DISTINCT FIRST_CHEMO_MRN AS MRN, FIRST_CHEMO_DATE AS "Original Chemo Start Date", FIRST_CHEMO_GENERIC_NAME AS "Chemo Generic Name", LR_PERFORMED_DTE AS "Lab Performed Date", LR_TEST_NAME AS "Lab Test Name", LR_SUBTEST_NAME AS "Lab Subtest Name", LR_RESULT_VALUE AS "Lab Result Value" FROM CHEMO LEFT JOIN LABS ON FIRST_CHEMO_MRN = LR_MRN

prompt:
Please assign the task to Padmapriya Subramanian. 



Missing Patients in MED26733 Dataline.



Two MRNs are missing from the MED26733 data report. Please contact CRA Gyuri Han (hang1@mskcc.org) as soon as possible for the MRNs.
completion: SELECT PT_MRN , PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_ZIP_CD, PT_SEX AS GENDER, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, PT_DATE_OF_DEATH, TRIM(R.AV_DESC) AS RACE, LR_PERFORMED_DTE FROM IDB.PATIENT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT LR_MRN, LR_PERFORMED_DTE FROM IDB.LAB_RESULTS WHERE LR_TEST_NAME = 'Streptococcus Pneumoniae AG (URINE)' AND LR_SUBTEST_NAME = 'Streptococcus Pneumoniae AG (URINE)' AND LR_PERFORMED_DTE >= CURRENT date - 7 DAYS ) ON LR_MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS R ON R.AV_ELEMENT = 'RACE' AND R.AV_CODE = PT_RACE ; WITH PTS AS (SELECT PT_MRN AS MRN , TRIM(PT_LAST_NAME) || ', ' || TRIM(PT_FIRST_NAME) PATIENT_NAME , PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, LR_PERFORMED_DTE, LAB_ORD_ID FROM IDB.PATIENT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT LR_MRN, LR_PERFORMED_DTE, LR_ORD_ID AS LAB_ORD_ID FROM IDB.LAB_RESULTS WHERE LR_TEST_NAME = 'Streptococcus Pneumoniae AG (URINE)' AND LR_SUBTEST_NAME = 'Streptococcus Pneumoniae AG (URINE)' AND LR_PERFORMED_DTE >= CURRENT date - 7 DAYS ) ON LR_MRN = PT_MRN) SELECT LR_MRN AS MRN, LAB_ORD_ID, OO_ORD_ID, PATIENT_NAME , YEAR(R.LR_PERFORMED_DTE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) AS "Age as of Lab Test", R. LR_PERFORMED_DTE AS "Lab Test Date", ORD_LOC AS "Order Location", TRIM(LR_TEST_NAME) AS "Lab Test Name", LTL_TEXT_RESULT AS "Result of Streptococcus Test" FROM PTS JOIN IDB.LAB_RESULTS R ON LAB_ORD_ID = R.LR_ORD_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.LAB_TEXT_LINE ON LTL_RESULT_GUID = LR_RESULT_GUID LEFT JOIN (SELECT OO_MRN, OO_ORD_ID, OO_PERFORMED_DT, OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE, OCV_CURR_LOC AS CURR_LOC, OL_LOC_NAME AS ORD_LOC FROM IDB.OMS_ORDER JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_CATALOG ON OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID = OOC_MSTR_ITEM_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_CLIENT_VISIT ON OO_VISIT_GUID = OCV_VISIT_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_LOCATION ON OL_LOC_GUID = OCV_CURR_LOC_GUID WHERE OOC_ITEM_NAME = 'Streptococcus Pneumoniae AG (URINE)' AND OO_ORD_STS_CD NOT IN ('CANP', 'CANC', 'AUC3') AND date (OO_PERFORMED_DT) >= CURRENT date - 7 DAYS ) ON OO_ORD_ID = LAB_ORD_ID WHERE R.LR_PERFORMED_DTE >= CURRENT date - 7 DAYS AND LR_TEST_NAME = 'Streptococcus Pneumoniae AG (URINE)' AND LR_SUBTEST_NAME = 'Streptococcus Pneumoniae AG (URINE)' ; WITH PTS AS (SELECT PT_MRN AS MRN , TRIM(PT_LAST_NAME) || ', ' || TRIM(PT_FIRST_NAME) PATIENT_NAME , PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, LR_PERFORMED_DTE, LAB_ORD_ID FROM IDB.PATIENT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT LR_MRN, LR_PERFORMED_DTE, LR_ORD_ID AS LAB_ORD_ID FROM IDB.LAB_RESULTS WHERE LR_TEST_NAME = 'Streptococcus Pneumoniae AG (URINE)' AND LR_SUBTEST_NAME = 'Streptococcus Pneumoniae AG (URINE)' AND LR_PERFORMED_DTE >= CURRENT date - 7 DAYS ) ON LR_MRN = PT_MRN) SELECT LR_MRN AS MRN, LAB_ORD_ID, PATIENT_NAME , YEAR(R.LR_PERFORMED_DTE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) AS "Age as of Lab Test", R. LR_PERFORMED_DTE AS "Lab Test Date", ORD_LOC AS "Order Location", TRIM(LR_TEST_NAME) AS "Lab Test Name", LTL_TEXT_RESULT AS "Result of Streptococcus Test" FROM PTS JOIN IDB.LAB_RESULTS R ON LAB_ORD_ID = R.LR_ORD_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.LAB_TEXT_LINE ON LTL_RESULT_GUID = LR_RESULT_GUID LEFT JOIN (SELECT OO_MRN, OO_PERFORMED_DT, OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE, OCV_CURR_LOC AS CURR_LOC, OL_LOC_NAME AS ORD_LOC FROM IDB.OMS_ORDER JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_CATALOG ON OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID = OOC_MSTR_ITEM_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_CLIENT_VISIT ON OO_VISIT_GUID = OCV_VISIT_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_LOCATION ON OL_LOC_GUID = OCV_CURR_LOC_GUID WHERE OOC_ITEM_NAME = 'Streptococcus Pneumoniae AG (URINE)' AND OO_ORD_STS_CD NOT IN ('CANP', 'CANC', 'AUC3') AND OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE >= CURRENT date - 7 DAYS ) ON OO_MRN = LR_MRN AND DATE(OO_PERFORMED_DT) = R.LR_PERFORMED_DTE WHERE R.LR_PERFORMED_DTE >= CURRENT date - 7 DAYS AND LR_TEST_NAME = 'Streptococcus Pneumoniae AG (URINE)' AND LR_SUBTEST_NAME = 'Streptococcus Pneumoniae AG (URINE)' ;

prompt: To Provide all patients who've answered/completed the following MSK Engage survey: Bladder Cancer Treatment Symptom Questionnaire (NCI-PROCTCAE)
completion: SELECT DISTINCT EF_MRN AS "MRN", EFI_FORM_ID AS "SURVEY ID", DATE(EF_SUBMISSION_DT) AS "SURVEY DATE", EF_FORM_NAME, EF_FORM_ALIAS, EFI_ITEM_ALIAS, EFI_ITEM_TEXT AS "QUESTIONS", LEFT(EFI_VALUE, 400) AS "ANSWERS" FROM IDB.EF_FORM JOIN IDB.EF_FORM_ITEM ON EFI_FORM_ID = EF_FORM_ID WHERE 1=1 AND EF_FORM_NAME = 'Bladder Cancer Treatment Symptom Questionnaire' GROUP BY EF_MRN , EFI_FORM_ID , DATE(EF_SUBMISSION_DT) , EF_FORM_NAME, EF_FORM_ALIAS, EFI_ITEM_ALIAS , EFI_ITEM_TEXT, EFI_VALUE ; WITH SURVEY AS (SELECT DISTINCT EF_MRN AS "MRN", EFI_FORM_ID AS "SURVEY ID", DATE(EF_SUBMISSION_DT) AS "SURVEY DATE", EF_FORM_NAME, EF_FORM_ALIAS, EFI_ITEM_ALIAS, EFI_ITEM_TEXT AS "QUESTIONS", LEFT(EFI_VALUE, 400) AS "ANSWERS" FROM IDB.EF_FORM JOIN IDB.EF_FORM_ITEM ON EFI_FORM_ID = EF_FORM_ID WHERE 1=1 AND EF_FORM_NAME = 'Bladder Cancer Treatment Symptom Questionnaire' GROUP BY EF_MRN , EFI_FORM_ID , DATE(EF_SUBMISSION_DT) , EF_FORM_NAME, EF_FORM_ALIAS, EFI_ITEM_ALIAS , EFI_ITEM_TEXT, EFI_VALUE) SELECT DISTINCT APR_MRN, APR_START_DTE, CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME, APR_GENERIC_NAME, APR_PRESCRIBED_DOSE, APR_ROUTE FROM SURVEY JOIN IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX ON "MRN" = APR_MRN JOIN IDB.CHEMO_DRUG_GENERIC ON APR_GENERIC_NAME = CDG_GENERIC_NAME WHERE (CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME LIKE '%GEMCITABINE%' OR CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME LIKE '%BCG%' OR CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME LIKE '%DOCETAXEL%' OR CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME LIKE '%MITOMYCIN%') ;

prompt:
Can we rerun AMB16788 just for 2018, but including the full 2018 year.

Is it also possible to remove lines that are exact duplicates? Same Patient and Procedure and DoS. Some procedures produce both a technical and professional charge and those came up twice and for this round we just want to focus on count rather than type and billing.
completion: WITH PROCEDURES AS (SELECT PBD_MRN, PBD_SVC_DTE, PBC_CPT_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK, DOC_NAME, PBC_PBD_CD FROM IDB.PBD_DTL JOIN IDB.PBD_CODE ON PBD_PBD_CD = PBC_PBD_CD JOIN IDB.CLM ON PBC_CPT_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.PBD_INVOICE ON PBD_INV_NO = PBI_INV_NO JOIN IDB.DOC ON PBI_PERFORM_DR_NO = DOC_DR_NO WHERE PBD_SVC_DTE BETWEEN '2018-01-01' AND CURRENT date AND (CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK LIKE '%BIOPSY%' OR CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK LIKE '%REMOVAL%' OR CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK LIKE '%CATHETER%' OR CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK LIKE '%PARACENTESIS%') ), VISITS AS (SELECT CPE_MRN, CPE_ENC_DTE, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8, CLD_DEPT_NAME, CRE_RES_NAME, CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME, CLD_DEPT_ID FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CLD_DEPT_ID IN ('802') AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN '2018-01-01' AND CURRENT date ) SELECT DISTINCT PBD_MRN "MRN", PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, PBD_SVC_DTE "Service Date", DOC_NAME "Billing Provider", CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK "Procedure Name" FROM VISITS JOIN PROCEDURES ON PBD_MRN = CPE_MRN AND PBD_SVC_DTE = CPE_ENC_DTE JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PT_MRN = PBD_MRN ;

prompt: Identify all patients with prostate cancer treated with Ra-223. I will manually narrow down the list to patients treated off-protocol.
completion: WITH INIT AS (SELECT DISTINCT CC_MRN, CC_CLSF_CD AS ICD9_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS ICD9_DESC FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE (CC_CLSF_CD) IN ('C61', 'C185') AND CASE WHEN CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y' AND CC_PT_TYPE <> 'E' THEN 'Y' WHEN CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' AND YEAR(CC_EFF_DTE) < 2004 THEN 'Y' WHEN CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND YEAR(CC_EFF_DTE) < 2001 THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END = 'Y' GROUP BY CC_MRN, CC_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK ) SELECT DISTINCT APR_MRN, APR_START_DTE, CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME, APR_GENERIC_NAME, APR_PRESCRIBED_DOSE, APR_ROUTE FROM INIT LEFT JOIN IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX ON CC_MRN = APR_MRN JOIN IDB.CHEMO_DRUG_GENERIC ON APR_GENERIC_NAME = CDG_GENERIC_NAME WHERE UPPER(CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME) LIKE '%RA-223%'

prompt: Please provide information on incisional hernias/identify patients with incisional hernia after midline vertical laparotomy in ovarian cancer.
completion: WITH MAIN AS (SELECT PT_MRN, CASE_STS, TM_DX_DTE, TM_HIST_CD, HIST_DESC, TM_SITE_CD, SITE_DESC, MIN_ICD_EFF_DTE, ICD_CD, ICD_DESC FROM IDB.PATIENT LEFT JOIN (SELECT TM_MRN, AV_DESC AS CASE_STS, TM_DX_DTE, TM_HIST_CD, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS HIST_DESC, TM_SITE_CD, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_DESC FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS ON AV_ELEMENT = 'CASE_STS' AND AV_CODE = TM_CASE_STS AND TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND TM_SITE_CD IN ('C482', 'C569', 'C570' ) ) AS CDB ON TM_MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN (SELECT CC_MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS MIN_ICD_EFF_DTE, CC_CLSF_CD AS ICD_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS ICD_DESC FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE CC_CLSF_CD IN ('183.0', '183.2', '183.4', 'C57.00', 'C57.01', 'C57.02', 'C57.3', 'C56.1', 'C56.2', 'C56.9' ) AND CASE WHEN CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y' AND CC_PT_TYPE <> 'E' THEN 'Y' WHEN CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' AND YEAR(CC_EFF_DTE) < 2004 THEN 'Y' WHEN CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND YEAR(CC_EFF_DTE) < 2001 THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END = 'Y' GROUP BY CC_MRN, CC_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK ) AS ICD9 ON CC_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE COALESCE(TM_MRN, CC_MRN) IS NOT NULL ) SELECT * FROM MAIN ; WITH MAIN AS (SELECT PT_MRN, CASE_STS, TM_DX_DTE, TM_HIST_CD, HIST_DESC, TM_SITE_CD, SITE_DESC, MIN_ICD9_EFF_DTE, ICD9_CD, ICD9_DESC FROM IDB.PATIENT LEFT JOIN (SELECT TM_MRN, AV_DESC AS CASE_STS, TM_DX_DTE, TM_HIST_CD, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS HIST_DESC, TM_SITE_CD, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_DESC FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS ON AV_ELEMENT = 'CASE_STS' AND AV_CODE = TM_CASE_STS AND TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND TM_SITE_CD IN ('C482', 'C569', 'C570' ) ) AS CDB ON TM_MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN (SELECT CC_MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS MIN_ICD9_EFF_DTE, CC_CLSF_CD AS ICD9_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS ICD9_DESC FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE CC_CLSF_CD IN ('183.0', '183.2', '183.4', 'C57.00', 'C57.01', 'C57.02', 'C57.3', 'C56.1', 'C56.2', 'C56.9' ) AND CASE WHEN CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y' AND CC_PT_TYPE <> 'E' THEN 'Y' WHEN CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' AND YEAR(CC_EFF_DTE) < 2004 THEN 'Y' WHEN CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND YEAR(CC_EFF_DTE) < 2001 THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END = 'Y' GROUP BY CC_MRN, CC_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK ) AS ICD9 ON CC_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE COALESCE(TM_MRN, CC_MRN) IS NOT NULL ) SELECT DISTINCT CDD_MRN, CDD_SERVICE_DTE, CDD_DOC_NAME, CDO_SECTION, CDO_ITEM_NAME, CDO_VALUE_TEXT FROM MAIN JOIN IDB.CD_DOCUMENT CD ON PT_MRN = CDD_MRN JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION CO ON CDD_DOC_GUID = CDO_DOC_GUID AND CDD_AUTHORED_DTE = CDO_AUTHORED_DTE WHERE CDD_CANCEL_IND = '0' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND = '0' AND CDD_DOC_NAME LIKE 'Operative%' AND (LOWER(CDO_ITEM_NAME) LIKE '%hernia%' OR LOWER(CDO_ITEM_NAME) LIKE '%midline vertical incision%' OR LOWER(CDO_ITEM_NAME) LIKE '%midline vertical%' OR LOWER(CDO_ITEM_NAME) LIKE '%laparotomy%') AND CDO_VALUE_TEXT <> '' ;

prompt: Provide a list of endoscopy patients that received simethicone (documented under "medications" in EPIC) from January 2018 to January 2019
completion: WITH ETO AS (SELECT SSE_ENC_CSN_ID CSN_ID, SSE_LOG_ID LOGID, SSE_SURG_STRT_DT SURG_STRT_DT, SSE_SURG_END_DT SURG_END_DT, SSP_PROC_NAME PROC_NAME, SSE_MRN MRN, SSE_SURG_DTE SURG_DTE, SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD CPT_CD, SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC CPT_DESC, SSE_SURG_LOC SRG_LOCATION, SSP_SURG_SVC_CD SURG_SVC_CD FROM IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE ON SSE_LOG_ID = SSP_LOG_ID AND SSE_SURG_DTE BETWEEN '2018-01-01' AND '2019-01-31' AND UPPER(SSP_PROC_NAME) LIKE '%ENDO%' AND SSE_SURG_LOC LIKE '%ENDO%') SELECT MRN, LOGID, SURG_DTE, SRG_LOCATION, SURG_SVC_CD, PROC_NAME, CPT_CD, CPT_DESC, IDB.OR_SUPPLY.OS_SPLY_NAME MED_NAME, IDB.OR_LNLG_MEDS.OLLM_MED_DOSE DOSE, IDB.OR_LNLG_MEDS.OLLM_MED_UNIT UNIT, IDB.OR_LNLG_MEDS.OLLM_MED_ROUTE ROUTE FROM ETO JOIN IDB.OR_LNLG_MEDS ON LOGID = OLLM_LOG_ID INNER JOIN IDB.OR_SUPPLY ON IDB.OR_LNLG_MEDS.OLLM_MED_ID=IDB.OR_SUPPLY.OS_SPLY_ID WHERE UPPER(IDB.OR_SUPPLY.OS_SPLY_NAME) like '%SIMETHICONE%'

prompt: Provide a monthly report of all new instances of the clindoc note "Assessment, Patient Personal Values"
completion: SELECT CDD_MRN "MRN", PT_LAST_NAME "Last Name", PT_FIRST_NAME "First Name", CDD_DOC_NAME "ClinDoc Name", CDD_SERVICE_DTE "Service Date", CDD_AUTHORED_DTE "Authored Date", OP_DISPLAY_NAME "Authoring Provider", OP_PROV_TYPE "Authoring Provider Type", CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 "Department", CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 "Service" FROM IDB.CD_DOCUMENT JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON CDD_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.OMS_PROVIDER ON CDD_AUTH_PROV_GUID = OP_PVDR_GUID LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_CLIENT_VISIT ON CDD_VISIT_GUID = OCV_VISIT_GUID LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER ON OCV_ENC_CSN_ID = CPE_ENC_CSN_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID WHERE CDD_DOC_NAME = 'Assessment, Patient Personal Values' AND CDD_CANCEL_IND <> '1' AND CDD_SERVICE_DTE >= CURRENT date - 7 DAYS ;

prompt: Provide a report on admissions, ICU visits and COVID testing for the specified list of patients.
completion: WITH X AS (SELECT PT_MRN AS MRN, STRIP(PT_LAST_NAME) || ', ' || STRIP(PT_FIRST_NAME) AS NAME FROM IDB.PATIENT WHERE PT_MRN IN () ) , ICU AS (SELECT * FROM IDB.ICU_CENSUS WHERE ICU_ICU_ADM_DTE BETWEEN '2020-03-15' AND '2020-04-02' AND(ICU_ICU_ADM_TME <= '07:00:00' OR ICU_ICU_ADM_TME >= '19:30:00') AND ICU_MRN IN (SELECT MRN FROM X) ) , COVID AS (SELECT MRN AS COV_MRN, RESULT, DATE(MIN_IDENTIFIED_DT) AS IDENTIFIED_DATE, DATE(MIN_RESULT_DT) AS RESULT_DATE FROM IDB.COVID19_PATIENT_INFO WHERE MRN IN (SELECT MRN FROM X) ) , VISITS AS (SELECT DISTINCT VIS_MRN, VIS_ADM_DTE, VIS_DSCH_DTE, VIS_IP_OP_ADJUSTED_IND, VIS_PATIENT_TYPE, VIS_HOSP_SVC, HOSP_SVC_DESC, VIS_NURS_STA AS "Floor", CASE WHEN VIS_HOSP_SVC IN ('ALG', 'BMT', 'CHA', 'CHB', 'HEM', 'HAT', 'LKA', 'LKB', 'LKC', 'LYM', 'LYG', 'LYK', 'LYR', 'MYL', 'TRB', 'TRG', 'TRW') THEN 'Liquid Tumor' END AS SVC_TYPE FROM IDB.VISIT_V WHERE VIS_MRN IN (SELECT MRN FROM X) AND VIS_ADM_DTE BETWEEN '2020-03-15' AND '2020-04-02' ) SELECT DISTINCT X.*, VIS_ADM_DTE, VIS_DSCH_DTE, VIS_IP_OP_ADJUSTED_IND, VIS_PATIENT_TYPE, "Floor", VIS_HOSP_SVC, HOSP_SVC_DESC, SVC_TYPE, ICU_ICU_ADM_DTE, ICU_ICU_ADM_TME, ICU_ICU_DSCH_DTE, ICU_ICU_DSCH_TME, RESULT, IDENTIFIED_DATE, RESULT_DATE FROM X LEFT JOIN VISITS ON X.MRN = VISITS.VIS_MRN LEFT JOIN ICU ON VISITS.VIS_MRN = ICU.ICU_MRN AND VIS_IP_OP_ADJUSTED_IND = 'I' AND ICU_ICU_ADM_DTE BETWEEN VIS_ADM_DTE AND VIS_DSCH_DTE LEFT JOIN COVID ON X.MRN = COVID.COV_MRN

prompt: Provide all PSL appointments with physician billing data.
completion: WITH APPTS AS (SELECT CPE_MRN , CPE_ENC_DTE , CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 , CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 , CLD_DEPT_NAME , CRE_RES_NAME , CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND (CRE_RES_NAME like 'PSL%' OR (CRE_RES_NAME = 'TAN, MIRANDA' AND CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME like '%PSL%')) ) , PBD AS (SELECT DISTINCT PBD_MRN CHARGE_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, CPE_ENC_DTE, CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME, CLD_DEPT_NAME, PBD_SVC_DTE CHARGE_SVC_DTE, PBD_POST_DTE, PBC_CPT_CD HCPCS_CPT_CODE, PBC_PBD_DESC, PBD_SVC_QTY UNITS, PBD_SVC_AMT AMT FROM IDB.PBD_DTL JOIN APPTS ON PBD_MRN = CPE_MRN AND PBD_SVC_DTE = CPE_ENC_DTE JOIN IDB.PBD_INVOICE ON PBD_INV_NO = PBI_INV_NO LEFT JOIN IDB.PBD_CODE ON PBD_PBD_CD = PBC_PBD_CD LEFT JOIN IDB.DOC ON PBI_PERFORM_DR_NO = DOC_DR_NO LEFT JOIN IDB.PBD_GROUP ON PBI_GRP_ID = PBDG_GRP_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.PBD_DIVISION ON PBI_DIV_ID = PBDD_DIV_ID JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PBD_MRN = PT_MRN) SELECT * FROM PBD

prompt: Sjogren's patients
completion: WITH DIAGNOSIS_0 AS (SELECT DISTINCT PT_DEID, SUBJECT_ID, ICD_CODES_ICD_CODE, ICD_CODES_ICD_CODE_DESC FROM (SELECT "DV"."PATIENT_DIAGNOSIS_FINAL_ALL_V"."PDX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AS PT_DEID, CAST(TRIM("DV"."PATIENT_DIAGNOSIS_FINAL_ALL_V"."PDX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID") AS VARCHAR) || CAST(TRIM("DV"."PATIENT_DIAGNOSIS_FINAL_ALL_V"."PDX_DX_CATALOG_ID") AS VARCHAR) AS SUBJECT_ID, TRIM(ICD_CODE_DESC."DXCC_ICD_CODE") AS ICD_CODES_ICD_CODE, TRIM(ICD_CODE_DESC."DXCC_ICD_CODE") || '-' || TRIM(ICD_CODE_DESC."DXCC_ICD_MSK_DESC") AS ICD_CODES_ICD_CODE_DESC FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DIAGNOSIS_FINAL_ALL_V" JOIN "DV"."DIAGNOSIS_CATALOG" AS ICD_CODE_DESC ON "DV"."PATIENT_DIAGNOSIS_FINAL_ALL_V"."PDX_DX_CATALOG_ID" = ICD_CODE_DESC."DXCC_DX_CATALOG_ID" JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" AS DIAGNOSIS_DATE ON "DV"."PATIENT_DIAGNOSIS_FINAL_ALL_V"."PDX_DX_DATE_ID" = DIAGNOSIS_DATE."DT_DATE_ID" GROUP BY "DV"."PATIENT_DIAGNOSIS_FINAL_ALL_V"."PDX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID", CAST(TRIM("DV"."PATIENT_DIAGNOSIS_FINAL_ALL_V"."PDX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID") AS VARCHAR) || CAST(TRIM("DV"."PATIENT_DIAGNOSIS_FINAL_ALL_V"."PDX_DX_CATALOG_ID") AS VARCHAR), ICD_CODE_DESC."DXCC_ICD_CODE", ICD_CODE_DESC."DXCC_ICD_MSK_DESC") WHERE ICD_CODES_ICD_CODE IN ('M35.00', 'M35.01', 'M35.02', 'M35.04', 'M35.09')), COHORT AS (SELECT PT_DEID AS PT_DEID FROM (SELECT DIAGNOSIS_0.PT_DEID AS PT_DEID FROM DIAGNOSIS_0)), COHORT_DIAGNOSIS AS (SELECT SUBJECT_ID AS SUBJECT_ID, PT_DEID AS PT_DEID FROM (SELECT DIAGNOSIS_0.SUBJECT_ID AS SUBJECT_ID, DIAGNOSIS_0.PT_DEID AS PT_DEID FROM DIAGNOSIS_0)), KEYS AS (SELECT COHORT.PT_DEID AS COHORT_PT_DEID, COHORT_DIAGNOSIS.SUBJECT_ID AS COHORT_DIAGNOSIS_SUBJECT_ID, COHORT_DIAGNOSIS.PT_DEID AS COHORT_DIAGNOSIS_PT_DEID FROM COHORT LEFT OUTER JOIN COHORT_DIAGNOSIS ON COHORT_DIAGNOSIS.PT_DEID = COHORT.PT_DEID), DIAGNOSIS_COLUMNS AS (SELECT DISTINCT PT_DEID, SUBJECT_ID, DIAGNOSIS_DATE, ICD_CODES_ICD_CODE, ICD_CODES_ICD_CODE_DESC FROM (SELECT "DV"."PATIENT_DIAGNOSIS_FINAL_ALL_V"."PDX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AS PT_DEID, CAST(TRIM("DV"."PATIENT_DIAGNOSIS_FINAL_ALL_V"."PDX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID") AS VARCHAR) || CAST(TRIM("DV"."PATIENT_DIAGNOSIS_FINAL_ALL_V"."PDX_DX_CATALOG_ID") AS VARCHAR) AS SUBJECT_ID, MIN(DIAGNOSIS_DATE."DT_DTE") AS DIAGNOSIS_DATE, TRIM(ICD_CODE_DESC."DXCC_ICD_CODE") AS ICD_CODES_ICD_CODE, TRIM(ICD_CODE_DESC."DXCC_ICD_CODE") || '-' || TRIM(ICD_CODE_DESC."DXCC_ICD_MSK_DESC") AS ICD_CODES_ICD_CODE_DESC FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DIAGNOSIS_FINAL_ALL_V" JOIN "DV"."DIAGNOSIS_CATALOG" AS ICD_CODE_DESC ON "DV"."PATIENT_DIAGNOSIS_FINAL_ALL_V"."PDX_DX_CATALOG_ID" = ICD_CODE_DESC."DXCC_DX_CATALOG_ID" JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" AS DIAGNOSIS_DATE ON "DV"."PATIENT_DIAGNOSIS_FINAL_ALL_V"."PDX_DX_DATE_ID" = DIAGNOSIS_DATE."DT_DATE_ID" GROUP BY "DV"."PATIENT_DIAGNOSIS_FINAL_ALL_V"."PDX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID", CAST(TRIM("DV"."PATIENT_DIAGNOSIS_FINAL_ALL_V"."PDX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID") AS VARCHAR) || CAST(TRIM("DV"."PATIENT_DIAGNOSIS_FINAL_ALL_V"."PDX_DX_CATALOG_ID") AS VARCHAR), ICD_CODE_DESC."DXCC_ICD_CODE", ICD_CODE_DESC."DXCC_ICD_MSK_DESC", ICD_CODE_DESC."DXCC_ICD_CODE", ICD_CODE_DESC."DXCC_ICD_MSK_DESC")), DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS AS (SELECT DISTINCT "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AS PT_DEID, "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AS SUBJECT_ID, "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_MRN" AS PT_MRN FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS") SELECT DISTINCT DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS.PT_MRN AS MRN, DIAGNOSIS_COLUMNS.DIAGNOSIS_DATE AS DIAGNOSIS_DATE, DIAGNOSIS_COLUMNS.ICD_CODES_ICD_CODE AS ICD_CODE, DIAGNOSIS_COLUMNS.ICD_CODES_ICD_CODE_DESC AS ICD_CODE_DESCRIPTION FROM KEYS LEFT OUTER JOIN DIAGNOSIS_COLUMNS ON DIAGNOSIS_COLUMNS.SUBJECT_ID = KEYS.COHORT_DIAGNOSIS_SUBJECT_ID LEFT OUTER JOIN DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS ON DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS.PT_DEID = KEYS.COHORT_PT_DEID;

prompt: Provide a list of elderly(older than 60 yo) classical Hodgkin lymphoma patients treated between 2012 and 2023.
completion: WITH DIAG AS (SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN, MIN_TM_DX_DTE, MIN_ICD_EFF_DTE, COALESCE(MIN_TM_DX_DTE, MIN_ICD_EFF_DTE) AS DIAG_DATE FROM IDB.PATIENT LEFT JOIN (SELECT TM_MRN, MIN(TM_DX_DTE) AS MIN_TM_DX_DTE FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR INNER JOIN IDB.SEERGROUPING ON RECODE = IDB.SEERF_ICDO(TM_SITE_CD, TM_HIST_CD) AND CATEGORY2 = 'Hodgkin Lymphoma' GROUP BY TM_MRN ) AS CDB ON TM_MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT CC_MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS MIN_ICD_EFF_DTE FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE CC_CLSF_CD like '%C81%' AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND (CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) GROUP BY CC_MRN ) AS ICD9 ON CC_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE COALESCE(TM_MRN, CC_MRN) IS NOT NULL ) , DEMO AS (SELECT DISTINCT C.PT_MRN AS MRN, C.PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH AS DOB, C.PT_SEX, R.AV_DESC AS "Race", E.AV_DESC AS "Ethnicity", N.PT_VITAL_STATUS FROM IDB.PATIENT C JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V N ON C.PT_MRN = N.PT_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS R ON C.PT_RACE = R.AV_CODE AND R.AV_ELEMENT = 'RACE' LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS E ON C.PT_PT_ETHNICITY = E.AV_CODE AND E.AV_ELEMENT = 'PT_ETHNICITY') , CHEMO AS (SELECT APR_MRN, MIN(APR_START_DTE) AS START_DATE, MAX(APR_END_DTE) AS END_DATE FROM IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX_V JOIN DIAG ON PT_MRN = APR_MRN WHERE CDG_CHEMO_FLAG = 'Y' AND CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME IN ('BRENTUXIMAB VEDOTIN', 'NIVOLUMAB') AND APR_START_DTE BETWEEN '2012-01-01' AND CURRENT DATE GROUP BY APR_MRN), MAIN AS (SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN, DIAG_DATE, DOB, PT_SEX, "Race", "Ethnicity", PT_VITAL_STATUS, YEAR(DIAG_DATE - DOB) AS AGE, START_DATE CHEMO_START, END_DATE CHEMO_END FROM DIAG D JOIN DEMO M ON PT_MRN = MRN AND DIAG_DATE BETWEEN '2012-01-01' AND CURRENT DATE AND YEAR(DIAG_DATE - DOB) >=60 LEFT JOIN CHEMO ON APR_MRN = PT_MRN) , APPTS AS (SELECT CPE_MRN AS "MRN", CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 AS "Service", COUNT(CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8) AS CNT, ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY CPE_MRN ORDER BY CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8) AS RN FROM MAIN JOIN IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER ON PT_MRN = CPE_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN '2012-01-01' AND CURRENT DATE AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 IN ('BMT', 'LYM') GROUP BY CPE_MRN, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8) SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN, DIAG_DATE, DOB, PT_SEX, "Race", "Ethnicity", PT_VITAL_STATUS, AGE, CHEMO_START, CHEMO_END, CASE WHEN HL.HL_MRN <> '' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS "Hodgkin Lymphoma" FROM MAIN JOIN (SELECT "MRN", MAX(CNT) AS M_CNT FROM APPTS GROUP BY "MRN") T ON PT_MRN = "MRN" LEFT JOIN (SELECT TM_MRN AS HL_MRN FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR INNER JOIN IDB.SEERGROUPING ON RECODE = IDB.SEERF_ICDO(TM_SITE_CD, TM_HIST_CD) AND CATEGORY2 = 'Hodgkin Lymphoma') HL ON PT_MRN = HL.HL_MRN WHERE T.M_CNT <> 1 ;

prompt: Can we re-run AMB19354 to include all of 2019 as well as adding any visits that fall under Radiation Oncology at Monmouth?
completion: SELECT TRIM(A.RVCD_MRN) AS "MRN", A.RVCD_SVC_DTE AS "DOS", PT_LAST_NAME "PT Last Name", PT_FIRST_NAME "PT First Name", TRIM(A.PROV_PHYSICIAN_NAME) AS "Physician", TRIM(CHARGE_CD) AS "Service Code", TRIM(CHARGE_DESCRIPTION) AS "Service Code Description", A.RVCD_AMT AS "AMT" FROM IDB.RMS_VISIT_CHARGE_DTL_V A JOIN IDB.RMS_VISIT_CHARGE_DTL B ON A.RVCD_VISIT_ID = B.RVCD_VISIT_ID AND A.RVCD_BATCH_NUMBER = B.RVCD_BATCH_NUMBER AND A.RVCD_LINE_NO = B.RVCD_LINE_NO LEFT JOIN IDB.VISIT ON B.RVCD_VISIT_ID = VIS_VISIT_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.RMS_VISIT ON B.RVCD_VISIT_ID = RV_VISIT_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON A.RVCD_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE 1=1 AND A.RVCD_SVC_DTE BETWEEN '2019-01-01' AND '2019-12-31' AND DAYOFWEEK(A.RVCD_SVC_DTE) = '7' AND PERF_SITE_MNEMONIC = 'MON' AND (CHARGE_CD like 'AMB%' OR CHARGE_CD like 'AMBS%' OR CHARGE_CD like 'RAD%' OR CHARGE_CD like 'OUT%' OR CHARGE_CD like 'RAO%')

prompt: Requesting automated emails with modified versions of the 12-245 IMPACT reports as they are signed out for patients consented in the GU Prostate service.
completion:
WITH MRNS AS (SELECT AC_MRN MRN, AC_PVDR_OF_RECORD_NAME FROM IDB.ACCRUALS WHERE AC_IRB_NO = '12-245' AND (AC_CONS_STAFF_NAME IN ('ABIDA,MOHAMED WASSIM' , 'AUTIO,KAREN' , 'BAMBURY,RICHARD MARTIN' , 'CHEN,YU' , 'DANILA,DANIEL' , 'KAMPEL,LEWIS J' , 'KOUTCHER,JASON A' , 'MORRIS,MICHAEL J' , 'RATHKOPF,DANA' , 'SCHER,HOWARD I' , 'SLOVIN,SUSAN' , 'SOLIT,DAVID') OR AC_PVDR_OF_RECORD_NAME IN ('ABIDA,WASSIM' ,'ABIDA,MOHAMED WASSIM' ,'AUTIO,KAREN' ,'BAMBURY,RICHARD MARTIN' ,'CHEN,YU' ,'DANILA,DANIEL' ,'KAMPEL,LEWIS J' ,'KOUTCHER,JASON A' ,'MORRIS,MICHAEL J' ,'RATHKOPF,DANA' ,'SCHER,HOWARD I' ,'SLOVIN,SUSAN' ,'SOLIT,DAVID')) ) , PATH AS (SELECT R.* FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT R INNER JOIN DV.PATIENT_IDENTIFICATION_MRN_V ON PRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID INNER JOIN MRNS ON MRN = PI_SOURCE_SYSTEM_PT_ID) , EMAIL AS (SELECT PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID P_ID , PT_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_SEX , P.PRPT_REPORT , DV.REGEXSTR('\d+', DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)(?<=Physician ID: )[^\n]*', PRPT_REPORT)) AS PHY_ID , ' ' || DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)(?<=DOP: ?)\d{1,2}/\d{1,2}/\d{1,4}', PRPT_REPORT) AS DOP FROM PATH P JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS D ON P.PRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = D.PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID WHERE PRPT_MODIFIED_DT >= CURRENT date - 30 DAYS AND PRPT_REPORT_TYPE = 'M_DM' AND DV.REGEX('(?i)IMPACT', PRPT_REPORT, 'matchCount') > 0 AND DV.REGEX('(?i)in 410 genes', PRPT_REPORT, 'matchCount') > 0 ) , $APPTNEXTLAST$nextpre as ( select PENC_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID PID, d.pt_mrn "MRN", DT_DAY_ABBREVIATION ,rtrim( ENR_EXT_RES_NAME) ENR_EXT_RES_NAME , PENC_ENC_DT , rtrim(ENDP_CENTER_ABBR) ENDP_CENTER_ABBR , rtrim(ENDP_PHY_LOC) ENDP_PHY_LOC , rtrim(ENVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME) VISIT_TYPE_NAME, er.ENR_RES_NAME , rtrim(evt.ENVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR) as VisitType , case when ENR_RES_TYP in ('Physician', 'PhD', 'Dentist' ,'Psychologist') and evt.ENVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR like '%IR%' then 'New Visit' when ENR_RES_TYP in ('Physician', 'PhD', 'Dentist' ,'Psychologist') and evt.ENVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR like '%NV%' then 'New Visit' else'' end NewVisitInd , trim(cre_email_addr) as phys_email_addr , case when evt."ENVT_EXT_NAME" like 'CT%' OR evt."ENVT_EXT_NAME" like 'MR%' OR evt."ENVT_EXT_NAME" like 'PET%' then 1 else 0 end as scan_indicator , case when ENR_RES_TYP IN ( 'Dentist', 'Nurse Practitioner', 'PhD', 'Physician', 'Psychologist') then 1 else 0 end dr_visit_indicator , days(PENC_ENC_DT) - days(current date) as days_from_today , days(current date) - days(PENC_MODIFIED_DT) as days_since_appt_modified , current date as today , PENC_MODIFIED_DT -- select * from DV.ENCOUNTER_RESOURCE where ENR_RES_NAME = 'SCHER, HOWARD' , case when row_number() over ( partition by p_id order by PENC_ENC_DT ) = 1 then 1 else 0 end as is_next_visit , ENR_SRC_RES_ID from email t5 inner join dv.patient_demographics_v d on t5.p_id = d.pt_pt_deidentification_id inner JOIN DV.PATIENT_ENCOUNTER t6 ON t5.P_ID = t6.PENC_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID inner join DV.ENCOUNTER_SCHD_RESOURCES sr on t6."PENC_PT_ENC_ID" = sr."ENSR_PT_ENC_ID" and sr.ENSR_PRIMARY_RES_IND = 'Y' inner join DV.ENCOUNTER_RESOURCE er ON sr."ENSR_RES_ID" = er."ENR_ENC_RES_ID" inner join DV.ENCOUNTER_VISIT_TYPE evt ON t6.PENC_VISIT_TYPE_ID = evt.ENVT_ENC_VISIT_TYPE_ID inner JOIN DV.ENCOUNTER_DESC_CATALOG t2 on EDC_GROUP_ID = 'STS'and t6.PENC_APPT_STS = t2.EDC_DEPT_ABBREV inner JOIN DV.ENCOUNTER_DEPARTMENT t3 ON t6.PENC_DEPT_ID = t3.ENDP_ENC_DEPT_ID inner JOIN DV.DATE_V t4 ON t6.PENC_ENC_DATE_ID = t4.DT_DATE_ID left join (select cre_res_id, cre_email_addr from idb.CL_RESOURCE where CRE_RES_STS = 'Active') clr on "ENR_SRC_RES_ID" = clr.cre_res_id WHERE t2.EDC_DEPT_DESC = 'Scheduled' AND t4.DT_DTE >= current_date and ENR_SRC_RES_ID in ('020388', '018135', '019547', '016543', '015008', '005173', '001735', '009209', '012468', '000786', '006122', '010215') order by t4.DT_DTE ) -- select * from $APPTNEXTLAST$NEXTPRE SELECT E.* , DV.SENDJAVAXMAIL('darwin@mskcc.org' , 'wooe@mskcc.org', 'eubankm@mskcc.org' , '', TRIM(PT_LAST_NAME) || ', ' || TRIM(PT_FIRST_NAME) || ' (' || TRIM(PT_MRN) || ') - IMPACT report resulted' , '
Dr. '|| SUBSTR(MP_LAST_NM, 1, 1) || LOWER(SUBSTR(MP_LAST_NM, 2, (LENGTH(TRIM(MP_LAST_NM))-1))) || ',

We sent material from this patient’s'|| DOP || ' procedure. See report below.

' || CASE WHEN ENR_EXT_RES_NAME IS NOT NULL THEN CASE WHEN PT_SEX = 'M' THEN 'He is' WHEN PT_SEX = 'F' THEN 'She is' ELSE 'They are' END || ' scheduled to see ' || CASE WHEN ENR_SRC_RES_ID = MP_SOURCE_PROVIDER_NO THEN 'you' ELSE 'Dr. ' || ENR_EXT_RES_NAME END || ' in clinic ' || DT_DAY_ABBREVIATION || ' ' || VARCHAR_FORMAT(PENC_ENC_DT, 'DD-Mon-YYYY') || '.' ELSE 'Currently this patient does not have any future appointments scheduled with you.' END || '



' || PRPT_REPORT || '
', 'text/html') MSG FROM EMAIL E LEFT JOIN DV.MEDPRO ON PHY_ID = MP_SOURCE_PROVIDER_NO LEFT JOIN $APPTNEXTLAST$NEXTPRE APPT ON PID = P_ID

prompt: Provide a list of patients seen in Breast Medicine or Survivorship in the last year who were diagnosed with breast cancer less than 10 years ago.
completion: WITH PTS_R AS (SELECT CPE_MRN AS "MRN", PT_LAST_NAME "Last Name", PT_FIRST_NAME "First Name", PT_ZIP_CD, CPP_LANG "Language", CPP_EMAIL_ADDR "Email", CPE_ENC_DTE AS "Appt Date", TIME(CPE_APPT_DT) "Appt Time", YEAR(CPE_ENC_DTE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) "Age at Appt", PLA_LST_CHEMO_DTE "Last Chemo Date", PLA_LST_RT_DTE "Last Radiation Date", CLD_CLD_CENTER "Location", CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 AS "Department", CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 AS "Service", CLD_DEPT_NAME AS "Department Name", CRE_RES_TYP "Resource Type", CRE_RES_NAME AS "Provider Name", CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME AS "Visit Type" FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON CPE_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY ON CPE_MRN = PLA_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_PAS_PATIENT ON CPE_MRN = CPP_MRN WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND PT_SEX = 'F' AND ((CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 = 'MED' AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 = 'BRE') OR (CRE_RES_NAME = 'NOUVINI, ROSA') OR (CLD_DEPT_NAME IN ('BRE MED 300 E66 SVRSHP', 'BREAST 300 E66 SVRSHP', 'BREAST DMT 300 E66 SVR')) OR (CLD_DEPT_NAME IN ('BSK SURVIVORSHIP-4', 'CMK SURVIVORSHIP', 'NAS SURVIVORSHIP-2', 'RVC SURVIVORSHIP') AND (CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME LIKE '%SNP %' OR CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME LIKE '%SAPP %' OR CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME LIKE '%PHONE%' OR CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME LIKE '%TELEH%'))) AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT date - 3 MONTHS AND CURRENT date - 1 DAY AND CPE_MRN <> '' AND CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME not like 'URO%' ) , BREAST_R AS (SELECT DISTINCT TM_MRN, TM_DX_DTE, CASE WHEN TM_BEST_AJCC_STG like '0%' THEN '0' WHEN TM_BEST_AJCC_STG like '1%' THEN '1' WHEN TM_BEST_AJCC_STG like '2%' THEN '2' WHEN TM_BEST_AJCC_STG like '3%' THEN '3' WHEN TM_BEST_AJCC_STG like '4%' THEN '4' WHEN TM_BEST_AJCC_STG IN ('', '88', '99') THEN 'No Stage' END STAGE, TM_SITE_CD AS SITE_CODE, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_DESC, TM_HIST_CD AS HIST_CODE, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS HIST_DESC, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY TM_MRN ORDER BY TM_DX_DTE) RN FROM (SELECT DISTINCT MRN FROM PTS_R) P JOIN IDB.CDB_TUMOR ON MRN = TM_MRN JOIN IDB.CLM H ON TM_HIST_CD = H.CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON TM_SITE_CD = S.CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND TM_SITE_CD like 'C50%' AND TM_DX_DTE >= CURRENT date - 10 YEARS ) , BREAST AS (SELECT * FROM BREAST_R WHERE RN = 1 ) , PTS AS (SELECT DISTINCT MRN, PT_ZIP_CD FROM PTS_R JOIN BREAST ON MRN = TM_MRN) , AROMATASE AS (SELECT APR_MRN, APR_START_DTE, CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME FROM (SELECT APR_MRN, APR_START_DTE, CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY APR_MRN ORDER BY APR_START_DTE DESC) RN FROM PTS P JOIN IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX_V ON MRN = APR_MRN WHERE CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME IN ('ANASTROZOLE', 'EXEMESTANE', 'LETROZOLE', 'TAMOXIFEN') ) WHERE RN = 1 ) , BMI AS (SELECT PMH_MRN, PMH_MEASURE_DTE, PMH_BMI FROM (SELECT PMH_MRN, PMH_MEASURE_DTE, PMH_BMI, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY PMH_MRN ORDER BY PMH_MEASURE_DTE DESC) RN FROM (SELECT DISTINCT MRN FROM PTS_R) P JOIN IDB.PT_MEASURES_HX ON MRN = PMH_MRN) WHERE RN = 1 ) , ER_PR_HER AS (SELECT CDD_MRN, CDD_DOC_GUID, CDD_SERVICE_DTE, CDO_ITEM_NAME, CDO_VALUE_TEXT FROM (SELECT DISTINCT MRN FROM PTS_R) P JOIN IDB.CD_DOCUMENT ON MRN = CDD_MRN JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION ON CDD_DOC_GUID = CDO_DOC_GUID AND CDD_AUTHORED_DTE = CDO_AUTHORED_DTE WHERE 1=1 AND CDD_CANCEL_IND <> '1' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND <> '1' AND CDD_DOC_NAME IN ('Follow Up Note - Breast Surgery', 'Follow Up, NP - Breast Surgery', 'Follow Up - Breast Surgery', 'Follow Up - Surgery-Breast', 'Follow Up, NP/PA - Breast Surgery') AND CDO_ITEM_NAME IN ('HER2:', 'ER:', 'PR:') ) , ER AS (SELECT CDD_MRN ER_MRN, CDD_SERVICE_DTE, CDO_VALUE_TEXT ER FROM (SELECT CDD_MRN, CDD_SERVICE_DTE, CDO_VALUE_TEXT, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CDD_MRN ORDER BY CDD_SERVICE_DTE DESC) RN FROM ER_PR_HER WHERE CDO_ITEM_NAME = 'ER:' ) WHERE RN = 1 ) , PR AS (SELECT CDD_MRN PR_MRN, CDD_SERVICE_DTE, CDO_VALUE_TEXT PR FROM (SELECT CDD_MRN, CDD_SERVICE_DTE, CDO_VALUE_TEXT, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CDD_MRN ORDER BY CDD_SERVICE_DTE DESC) RN FROM ER_PR_HER WHERE CDO_ITEM_NAME = 'PR:' ) WHERE RN = 1 ) , HER2 AS (SELECT CDD_MRN HER2_MRN, CDD_SERVICE_DTE, CDO_VALUE_TEXT HER2 FROM (SELECT CDD_MRN, CDD_SERVICE_DTE, CDO_VALUE_TEXT, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CDD_MRN ORDER BY CDD_SERVICE_DTE DESC) RN FROM ER_PR_HER WHERE CDO_ITEM_NAME = 'HER2:' ) WHERE RN = 1 ) , LOCS AS (SELECT '300 E66' ML_LOC_GRP, '300 E66' ML_LOC_CD, '300 E66th St' ML_ADDR, 'New York' ML_CITY, 'NY' ML_STATE, '10065' ML_ZIP_CD, 40.671400 ML_LATITUDE, -73.986165 ML_LONGITUDE FROM SYSIBM.SYSDUMMY1) , DISTANCE AS (SELECT MRN DIST_MRN, ML_LOC_CD DIST_LOC_CD, ROUND(DEGREES(ACOS(SIN(RADIANS(LAT1)) *SIN(RADIANS(ML_LATITUDE)) +COS(RADIANS(LAT1)) *COS(RADIANS(ML_LATITUDE)) *COS(RADIANS(LON1-ML_LONGITUDE))) * 69.09)) AS "Distance from E66" FROM (SELECT DISTINCT MRN, ZC_LATITUDE LAT1, ZC_LONGITUDE AS LON1 FROM (SELECT DISTINCT MRN, PT_ZIP_CD FROM PTS) A JOIN IDB.ZIPCODE ON ZC_ZIP=PT_ZIP_CD) A, LOCS) SELECT "MRN", "Last Name", "First Name", "Language", "Email", TM_DX_DTE "Dx Date", STAGE "Stage", "Appt Date", "Appt Time", "Age at Appt", PLA_LST_CHEMO_DTE "Last Chemo Date", PLA_LST_RT_DTE "Last Radiation Date", "Location", "Distance from E66", "Department", "Service", "Department Name", "Resource Type", "Provider Name", "Visit Type", PMH_MEASURE_DTE "Most Recent BMI Date", PMH_BMI "BMI", APR_START_DTE "Most Recent Aromatase Inhibitor Date", CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME "Aromatase Inhibitor", ER, PR, HER2 FROM PTS_R LEFT JOIN DISTANCE ON MRN = DIST_MRN JOIN BREAST ON MRN = TM_MRN LEFT JOIN BMI ON MRN = PMH_MRN LEFT JOIN ER ON MRN = ER_MRN LEFT JOIN PR ON MRN = PR_MRN LEFT JOIN HER2 ON MRN = HER2_MRN LEFT JOIN AROMATASE ON MRN = APR_MRN JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY ON MRN = PLA_MRN WITH UR

prompt: Head & Neck Survivorship patients seen by Janet McKiernan that have had radiation treatment
completion: WITH APPTS AS (SELECT CPE_MRN, MAX(CPE_ENC_DTE) MAX_CPE_ENC_DTE FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CRE_RES_NAME = 'MCKIERNAN, JANET' GROUP BY CPE_MRN ) , RT AS (SELECT RTC_TX_MRN, MAX_CPE_ENC_DTE, MIN(RTC_TX_START_DTE) RTC_TX_START_DTE, MAX(RTC_TX_STOP_DTE) RTC_TX_STOP_DTE FROM APPTS JOIN IDB.RADONC_TREATMENT_COURSE ON CPE_MRN = RTC_TX_MRN GROUP BY RTC_TX_MRN, MAX_CPE_ENC_DTE) SELECT RTC_TX_MRN MRN, PT_LAST_NAME "Last Name", PT_FIRST_NAME "First Name", TM_DX_DTE "Tumor Dx Date", TM_SITE_CD AS "Tumor Site Code", S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS "Tumor Site Desc", TM_HIST_CD AS "Tumor Hist Code", H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS "Tumor Hist Desc", RTC_TX_START_DTE "First Radiation Date", RTC_TX_STOP_DTE "Last Radiation Stop Date", MAX_CPE_ENC_DTE "Most Recent appt with Janet" FROM RT JOIN IDB.CDB_TUMOR ON RTC_TX_MRN = TM_MRN JOIN IDB.CLM H ON TM_HIST_CD = H.CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON TM_SITE_CD = S.CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON RTC_TX_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('3', '6', '7', '8')

prompt: Provide a list of all patients who have pancreatic adenocarcinoma and Leptomeningeal and/or brain metastasis between '2000-01-01' and '2020-06-30' .
completion: WITH PAN AS (SELECT PRPT_MRN MRN, PRPT_PROCEDURE_DTE, PRPT_REPORT_DTE, PRPT_ACCESSION_NO, PRPT_REPORT_TYPE_DESC, PRPT_REPORT FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V WHERE CONTAINS("PRPT_REPORT", '("pancreas adenocarcinoma" | "pancreatic adenocarcinoma")') = 1 AND PRPT_PROCEDURE_DTE BETWEEN '2000-01-01' AND '2020-06-30' ) , ICD AS (SELECT CC_MRN MRN, CC_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) MIN_EFF_DTE FROM PAN JOIN IDB.CTC_CLSF ON MRN = CC_MRN JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE (CC_CLSF_CD IN ('C70.1', '192.3', '198.4', 'C79.32', 'C79.40', 'C79.49')) AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND (CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) AND PRPT_PROCEDURE_DTE <= CC_EFF_DTE AND CC_EFF_DTE BETWEEN '2000-01-01' AND '2020-06-30' GROUP BY CC_MRN, CC_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK ) , RAD AS (SELECT RRPT_MRN MRN, PRPT_PROCEDURE_DTE, PRPT_REPORT_DTE, PRPT_ACCESSION_NO, PRPT_REPORT_TYPE_DESC, PRPT_REPORT, RRPT_PROCEDURE_NAME, RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE, RRPT_REPORT_DTE, RRPT_ACCESSION_NO, RRPT_REPORT_TXT FROM DV.RADIOLOGY_REPORT_V JOIN PAN ON RRPT_MRN = MRN AND PRPT_PROCEDURE_DTE <= RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE WHERE CONTAINS("RRPT_REPORT_TXT", '("leptomeningeal" | "brain metastasis")') = 1 AND RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE BETWEEN '2000-01-01' AND '2020-06-30' ) SELECT DISTINCT MRN, PT_LAST_NAME LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME FIRST_NAME, PT_BIRTH_DTE DOB FROM RAD JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V ON MRN = PT_MRN UNION SELECT DISTINCT MRN, PT_LAST_NAME LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME FIRST_NAME, PT_BIRTH_DTE DOB FROM ICD JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V ON MRN = PT_MRN

prompt: We have a database of stage III lung cancer patients treated with chemoradiation durvalumab, this database goes to July of 2021. We have published several articles on the outcomes of these patients that have contributed to current and future management strategies (PMID: 36602799 , PMID: 34942280 , PMID: 34590042, PMID: 33992811). We want to update the database and hope that the dataline team can give a one time list of patients that we can further investigate under our research protocol.
completion: WITH RTC AS (SELECT DISTINCT RTC_TX_MRN, MIN(RTC_TX_START_DTE)AS MIN_RT_DATE, MAX(RTC_TX_STOP_DTE) AS MAX_RT_DATE FROM IDB.RADONC_TREATMENT_COURSE WHERE RTC_TX_START_DTE BETWEEN '2021-06-01' AND '2023-01-31' GROUP BY RTC_TX_MRN HAVING MIN(RTC_TX_START_DTE) BETWEEN '2021-06-01' AND '2023-01-31') , CHEMO AS (SELECT DISTINCT APR_MRN, MIN_RT_DATE, MAX_RT_DATE, MIN(APR_START_DTE) AS MIN_CHEMO_DT, MAX(APR_END_DTE) AS MAX_CHEMO_DT FROM IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX_V JOIN RTC ON RTC_TX_MRN=APR_MRN WHERE CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME IN ('CISPLATIN', 'CARBOPLATIN', 'PEMETREXED', 'PACLITAXEL', 'ETOPOSIDE') AND APR_ROUTE IN ('intravenous', 'IV', 'IV PUSH', 'IVPB') AND APR_START_DTE BETWEEN MIN_RT_DATE -1 MONTH AND MIN_RT_DATE + 3 MONTH GROUP BY APR_MRN, MIN_RT_DATE, MAX_RT_DATE) , IMMUNO AS (SELECT DISTINCT APR_MRN, APR_DRUG_NAME, MIN_RT_DATE, MAX_RT_DATE, MIN(APR_START_DTE) AS MIN_DURVALUMAB_DT, MAX(APR_END_DTE) AS MAX_DURVALUMAB_DT FROM IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX_V JOIN RTC ON APR_MRN=RTC_TX_MRN WHERE APR_START_DTE > MIN_RT_DATE AND LOWER(CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME) like '%durvalumab%' GROUP BY APR_MRN, APR_DRUG_NAME, MIN_RT_DATE, MAX_RT_DATE HAVING MIN(APR_START_DTE) > MIN_RT_DATE) , PATH AS (SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN, PDRX_DMP_PATIENT_ID AS "Patient ID", PDRX_DMP_SAMPLE_ID AS "Sample ID", PT_SEX FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID= PDRX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID) ,COMBINE AS (SELECT DISTINCT A.APR_MRN, PT_SEX, A.MIN_RT_DATE, A.MAX_RT_DATE, A.MIN_CHEMO_DT, A.MAX_CHEMO_DT, B.MIN_DURVALUMAB_DT, B.MAX_DURVALUMAB_DT, "Patient ID", LISTAGG("Sample ID", ' , ') WITHIN GROUP ( ORDER BY "Sample ID") AS "Sample ID(s)" FROM CHEMO A JOIN IMMUNO B ON A.APR_MRN=B. APR_MRN LEFT JOIN PATH ON A.APR_MRN=PT_MRN GROUP BY A.APR_MRN, PT_SEX, A.MIN_RT_DATE, A.MAX_RT_DATE, A.MIN_CHEMO_DT, A.MAX_CHEMO_DT, B.MIN_DURVALUMAB_DT, B.MAX_DURVALUMAB_DT, "Patient ID" ORDER BY 3, 1) SELECT * FROM COMBINE

prompt: Provide weight/BMI and conmeds for each visit for patients received TRK inhibitor at MSK

Please provide an excel file that details the dates (e.g., 03/24/2023) and times (e.g., 16:00) that durvalumab was infused for a list of patients (I have the MRNs) with non-small cell lung cancer. If this is something that I can do myself through the new beta version, I can do it that way (if given the permission).
PSA and Testosterone test results for a list of patient MRNs
Please provide a list of patients at MSKCC who had the lab value 'troponin' elevated (greater than or equal to 0.03) from January 1, 2016 and their Cancer Diagnoses
completion: SELECT LR_MRN AS MRN, CASE WHEN OCV_IP_OP_IND = 'I' THEN 'Inpatient' ELSE 'Outpatient' END AS IP_OP_FLAG , TRIM(LR_TEST_NAME) AS LAB_TEST_NAME, LR_PERFORMED_DT AS LAB_PERFORMED_DATE, LR_RESULT_VALUE AS LAB_RESULT, LR_ABNORMALITY_CD FROM IDB.LAB_RESULTS LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_CLIENT_VISIT ON OCV_VISIT_GUID = LR_CL_VISIT_GUID WHERE LR_SUBTEST_NAME LIKE 'Troponin%' AND REPLACE(REPLACE(TRIM(LR_RESULT_VALUE), '<', ''), '>', '') >= '0.03' AND LR_PERFORMED_DTE BETWEEN '2016-01-01' AND CURRENT date ; WITH LAB AS (SELECT DISTINCT LR_MRN FROM IDB.LAB_RESULTS WHERE LR_SUBTEST_NAME LIKE 'Troponin%' AND REPLACE(REPLACE(TRIM(LR_RESULT_VALUE), '<', ''), '>', '') >= '0.03' AND LR_PERFORMED_DTE BETWEEN '2016-01-01' AND CURRENT date ) SELECT PT_MRN AS "MRN" , PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH AS "Date of Birth" , PT_DATE_OF_DEATH AS "Date of Death" , R.AV_DESC AS "Race" , E.AV_DESC AS "Ethnicity" FROM IDB.PATIENT JOIN LAB ON LR_MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS R ON R.AV_ELEMENT = 'RACE' AND R.AV_CODE = PT_RACE LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS E ON E.AV_ELEMENT = 'PT_ETHNICITY' AND E.AV_CODE = PT_PT_ETHNICITY ; WITH LAB AS (SELECT DISTINCT LR_MRN FROM IDB.LAB_RESULTS WHERE LR_SUBTEST_NAME LIKE 'Troponin%' AND REPLACE(REPLACE(TRIM(LR_RESULT_VALUE), '<', ''), '>', '') >= '0.03' AND LR_PERFORMED_DTE BETWEEN '2016-01-01' AND CURRENT date ) SELECT LR_MRN AS MRN, HIST_CODE, HIST_DESC, SITE_CODE, SITE_DESC, MIN_ICD9_EFF_DTE, ICD9_CD, ICD9_DESC FROM LAB LEFT JOIN (SELECT TM_MRN, TM_DX_DTE, TM_HIST_CD HIST_CODE, TRIM(H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK) AS HIST_DESC, TM_SITE_CD SITE_CODE, TRIM(S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK) AS SITE_DESC FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD AND TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8')) AS CDB ON TM_MRN = LR_MRN LEFT JOIN (SELECT CC_MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS MIN_ICD9_EFF_DTE, CC_CLSF_CD AS ICD9_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS ICD9_DESC FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE SUBSTR(CC_CLSF_CD, 1, 3) BETWEEN 'C00' AND 'D49' AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND (CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) GROUP BY CC_MRN, CC_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK ) AS ICD9 ON CC_MRN = LR_MRN WHERE COALESCE(TM_MRN, CC_MRN) IS NOT NULL ;
