ELSE 'Other' END, CASE WHEN DAYOFWEEK(OO_SIGNIFICANT_DT) = 1 THEN 'Sunday' WHEN DAYOFWEEK(OO_SIGNIFICANT_DT) = 2 THEN 'Monday' WHEN DAYOFWEEK(OO_SIGNIFICANT_DT) = 3 THEN 'Tuesday' WHEN DAYOFWEEK(OO_SIGNIFICANT_DT) = 4 THEN 'Wednesday' WHEN DAYOFWEEK(OO_SIGNIFICANT_DT) = 5 THEN 'Thursday' WHEN DAYOFWEEK(OO_SIGNIFICANT_DT) = 6 THEN 'Friday' WHEN DAYOFWEEK(OO_SIGNIFICANT_DT) = 7 THEN 'Saturday' END ORDER BY OOC_ITEM_NAME, CASE WHEN DAYOFWEEK(OO_SIGNIFICANT_DT) = 1 THEN 'Sunday' WHEN DAYOFWEEK(OO_SIGNIFICANT_DT) = 2 THEN 'Monday' WHEN DAYOFWEEK(OO_SIGNIFICANT_DT) = 3 THEN 'Tuesday' WHEN DAYOFWEEK(OO_SIGNIFICANT_DT) = 4 THEN 'Wednesday' WHEN DAYOFWEEK(OO_SIGNIFICANT_DT) = 5 THEN 'Thursday' WHEN DAYOFWEEK(OO_SIGNIFICANT_DT) = 6 THEN 'Friday' WHEN DAYOFWEEK(OO_SIGNIFICANT_DT) = 7 THEN 'Saturday' END;

prompt: Provide a report of inpatients with discharge dates  1/1/2012 to 7/31/2012, where the patients had Pegfilgrastim INJ order starting on the discharge date.
completion: SELECT CS_MRN, CS_ACCT_NO, CS_DSCH_DATE , CS_LAST_NAME, CS_FIRST_NAME , OCV_CURR_LOC, OCV_DSCH_DT, OO_REQUESTED_DT, OO_ENTER_DTE , OO_ORD_GUID, OO_ORD_ID, OO_ORD_NAME, OO_SUMMARY_LINE , CASE WHEN CS_DSCH_DATE = DATE(OO_REQUESTED_DT) THEN 'Y' ELSE ' ' END STRT_DSCH_DTE , CASE WHEN CS_DSCH_DATE = DATE(OCV_DSCH_DT) THEN 'Y' ELSE ' ' END DIFF_DSCH_DTE FROM IDB.OMS_ORDER JOIN IDB.OMS_CLIENT_VISIT ON OO_VISIT_GUID = OCV_VISIT_GUID JOIN IDB.CASE ON CS_MRN = OO_MRN AND CS_ACCT_NO = OO_ACCT_NO AND CS_PT_STS LIKE 'I%' AND CS_PT_STS <> 'IP' WHERE CS_DSCH_DATE BETWEEN '2012-01-01' AND '2012-07-31' AND OO_ORD_TYPE_CD = 'Medication' AND OO_ENTER_DTE >= CS_ADM_DATE AND OO_ORD_STS_CD NOT LIKE 'CA%' AND OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID IN('1000003826074029', '3000003826074029', '6000003630073029', '9000005222100730', '9000006177100740')

prompt: Provide data on patients with medullary thyroid carcinoma who received dacarbazine.
completion: SELECT DISTINCT "t1"."PT_MRN" AS "MRN", "t2"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AS "Deident PT #", "t3"."DXCC_ICD_CODE" AS "ICD-O Histology Code", "t3"."DXCC_ICD_MSK_DESC" AS "ICD-O Histology Description", "t4"."ICSC_SITE_CD" AS "ICD-O Site Code", "t4"."ICSC_ICDO_SITE_MSK_DESC" AS "ICD-O Site Description", "t5"."PINC_ITEM_NAME" AS "Drug Name" FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED" "t2" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V" "t1" ON "t2"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t1"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."CDB_TUMOR_V" "t6" ON "t2"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t6"."CDTM_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DIAGNOSIS_CODE_CAT_ICDO_V" "t3" ON "t6"."CDTM_DX_CATALOG_ID" = "t3"."DXCC_DX_CATALOG_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."ICDO_SITE_CATALOG_V" "t4" ON "t6"."CDTM_SITE_CATALOG_ID" = "t4"."ICSC_SITE_CATALOG_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PHM_PT_MEDS_MQT" "t7" ON "t2"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t7"."POD_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PHM_ORDER_DTL" "t8" ON "t7"."POD_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t8"."POD_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AND "t7"."POD_PHARMA_INVENTORY_CTLG_ID" = "t8"."POD_PHARMA_INVENTORY_CTLG_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PHM_INVENTORY_CATALOG" "t5" ON "t8"."POD_PHARMA_INVENTORY_CTLG_ID" = "t5"."PINC_INVENTORY_CTLG_ID" WHERE (("t3"."DXCC_ICD_CODE" IN ('M8345/3', 'M8346/3', 'M8347/3', 'M8510/3', 'M8510/6', 'M8511/3', 'M8511/6', 'M8512/3', 'M8512/6', 'M8513/3') AND "t4"."ICSC_SITE_CD" IN ('C739')) AND (UPPER("t5"."PINC_GENERIC_NAME") IN ('DACARBAZINE', 'DACARBAZINE INVEST', 'DACARBAZINE', 'DACARBAZINE') OR UPPER("t5"."PINC_TRADE_NAME") IN ('DTIC-DOME', 'DTIC-DOME IV')))

prompt: Provide a list of patients who were treated with chemotherapy for any malignancy and subsequently diagnosed with colorectal cancer and have had IMPACT testing.
completion: WITH X AS (SELECT DISTINCT AC_MRN AS MRN, N.TM_HIST_CD AS HIST_CODE, HH.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS HIST_DESC, N.TM_SITE_CD AS SITE_CODE, SS.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_DESC, N.TM_DX_DTE AS DX_DATE, M.TM_SITE_CD AS CR_SITE_CODE, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS CR_SITE_DESC, M.TM_HIST_CD AS CR_HIST_CODE, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS CR_HIST_DESC, M.TM_DX_DTE AS CR_DX_DATE FROM IDB.ACCRUALS JOIN IDB.CDB_TUMOR M ON M.TM_MRN = AC_MRN AND M.TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') JOIN IDB.CLM H ON M.TM_HIST_CD = H.CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON M.TM_SITE_CD = S.CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.SEERGROUPING SM ON SM.RECODE = IDB.SEERF_ICDO(M.TM_SITE_CD, M.TM_HIST_CD) AND SM.CATEGORY2 = 'Colon and Rectum' AND H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK like '%ADENO%' JOIN IDB.CDB_TUMOR N ON N.TM_MRN = AC_MRN AND N.TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') JOIN IDB.CLM HH ON N.TM_HIST_CD = HH.CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.CLM SS ON N.TM_SITE_CD = SS.CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.SEERGROUPING SN ON SN.RECODE = IDB.SEERF_ICDO(N.TM_SITE_CD, N.TM_HIST_CD) JOIN IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX_V ON AC_MRN = APR_MRN AND CDG_CHEMO_FLAG = 'Y' WHERE AC_IRB_NO IN ('12-245') AND APR_START_DTE >= N.TM_DX_DTE AND APR_START_DTE < M.TM_DX_DTE ) , CTE AS (SELECT DISTINCT MRN AS DX_MRN, STRIP(SITE_CODE) || '-' || STRIP(SITE_DESC) || ' | ' || STRIP(HIST_CODE) || '-' || STRIP(HIST_DESC) AS DX_CODE, DX_DATE FROM X) , CTE2 AS (SELECT * FROM CTE ORDER BY DX_MRN, DX_DATE, DX_CODE) , T1 AS (SELECT DX_MRN, DX_DATE, DX_CODE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY DX_MRN ORDER BY DX_DATE) AS RN FROM CTE2 ORDER BY DX_MRN, DX_DATE) , T2 (MRN, DX, RN1) AS (SELECT DX_MRN, CAST(DX_DATE AS VARCHAR(6000))||' | '||CAST(DX_CODE AS VARCHAR(100)), RN FROM T1 WHERE T1.RN = 1 UNION ALL SELECT DX_MRN, RTRIM(CAST(DX AS VARCHAR(4000))) || ', ' || CHR(13) || CHR(10) || CAST(DX_DATE AS VARCHAR(100))||' | '||RTRIM(CAST(DX_CODE AS VARCHAR(100))) , RN1 + 1 FROM T1, T2 WHERE DX_MRN = MRN AND RN = RN1+1 ) , T3 AS (SELECT MRN, MAX(RN1) RN FROM T2 GROUP BY MRN) , T4 AS (SELECT T2.MRN, RN, DX FROM T2 JOIN T3 ON T2.MRN = T3.MRN AND T2.RN1 = T3.RN) , LIST2 AS (SELECT DISTINCT X.MRN, DX, CR_SITE_CODE, CR_SITE_DESC, CR_HIST_CODE, CR_HIST_DESC, CR_DX_DATE FROM X LEFT JOIN T4 ON X.MRN = T4.MRN) SELECT * FROM LIST2 WITH Y AS (SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN AS MRN, GENE, RESULT, METHOD FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_STRUCTURED_RESULTS_V WHERE PT_MRN IN () ) , CTE3 AS (SELECT MRN AS DM_MRN, STRIP(GENE) || ' | ' || STRIP(METHOD) AS DM_GENE FROM Y) , CTE3A AS (SELECT * FROM CTE3 ORDER BY DM_MRN, DM_GENE) , G1 AS (SELECT DM_MRN, DM_GENE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY DM_MRN ORDER BY DM_GENE) AS RN FROM CTE3 ORDER BY DM_MRN, DM_GENE) , G2 (MRN, GENE, RN1) AS (SELECT DM_MRN, CAST(DM_GENE AS VARCHAR(10000)), RN FROM G1 WHERE G1.RN = 1 UNION ALL SELECT DM_MRN, RTRIM(CAST(GENE AS VARCHAR(10000))) || ', ' || CHR(13) || CHR(10) || CAST(DM_GENE AS VARCHAR(500)) , RN1 + 1 FROM G1, G2 WHERE DM_MRN = MRN AND RN = RN1+1 ) , G3 AS (SELECT MRN, MAX(RN1) RN FROM G2 GROUP BY MRN) , G4 AS (SELECT G2.MRN, RN, GENE FROM G2 JOIN G3 ON G2.MRN = G3.MRN AND G2.RN1 = G3.RN) SELECT * FROM G4

prompt: Provide on-demand report from notes written by infectious disease service in Clindocs.
completion: SELECT CDD_DOC_NAME AS "DOCUMENT NAME", USR.OU_DISPLAY_NAME ENTEREDBY, PVDR.OU_DISPLAY_NAME AS "SERVICE_PVDR", PVDR.OU_ORD_ROLE_TYPE ROLE_TYPE, CDD_ENTER_DTE ENTERED_DTE, CDD_AUTHORED_DTE AS "SERVICE DATE", CDD_MRN AS "MRN", STRIP(PT_LAST_NAME)||', '||STRIP(PT_FIRST_NAME) AS PT_NAME, CDO_SECTION AS "SECTION", MAX(CASE WHEN CDO_ITEM_NAME = 'Consult Requested with' THEN CDO_VALUE_TEXT ELSE '' END) AS "Reason For Consult", MAX(CASE WHEN CDO_ITEM_NAME = 'Consult Request by' THEN CDO_VALUE_TEXT ELSE '' END) AS "Consult Req By", OCV_CURR_LOC LOCATION, OCV_PVDR_NAME PROVIDER_NAME, DOC_NAME, DOC_SVC, OS_SVC_GRP_CD, OS_SVC_DESC FROM IDB.CD_DOCUMENT JOIN CPE ON DOCNAME = CDD_DOC_NAME JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION ON CDD_DOC_GUID = CDO_DOC_GUID JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON CDD_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.OMS_USER PVDR ON CDD_AUTH_PROV_GUID = PVDR.OU_USER_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_USER USR ON USR.OU_USER_GUID = CDD_USER_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_CLIENT_VISIT ON CDD_VISIT_GUID = OCV_VISIT_GUID JOIN IDB.DOC ON OCV_ATT_DR_NO = DOC_DR_NO JOIN IDB.OMS_SERVICE ON OCV_SVC_GUID = OS_SVC_GUID WHERE CDD_CANCEL_IND = '0' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND = '0' AND CDD_ENTER_DTE >= '2013-11-01' AND CDO_SECTION = 'Reason for Consult' GROUP BY CDD_DOC_NAME, USR.OU_DISPLAY_NAME, PVDR.OU_DISPLAY_NAME, PVDR.OU_ORD_ROLE_TYPE, PVDR.OU_OCCUPATION, CDD_ENTER_DTE, CDD_AUTHORED_DTE, CDD_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, CDO_SECTION, OCV_CURR_LOC, OCV_PVDR_NAME, DOC_NAME, DOC_SVC, OS_SVC_GRP_CD, OS_SVC_DESC

prompt: Schedule a list of patients with upcoming laparoscopic prostatectomies and hysterectomies.
completion: WITH X AS (SELECT OC_CASE_ID, OC_MRN, OC_SURG_DTE, CRE_RES_NAME, CPX_PROC_CD, CPX_PROC_NAME, OP_OR_PROC_ID, OP_PROC_NAME, OCP_OR_PROC_ID, OCP_LINE_NO, OCP_PROC_ID FROM IDB.OR_CASE JOIN IDB.OR_CASE_ALL_PROC ON OC_CASE_ID = OCAP_CASE_ID JOIN IDB.OR_CASE_ALL_SURG ON OCAP_CASE_ID = OCAS_CASE_ID AND OCAS_PNL_NO = OCAP_PNL_NO AND OCAS_SURG_ROLE = 'Primary' JOIN IDB.OR_PROC ON OCAP_OR_PROC_ID = OP_OR_PROC_ID JOIN IDB.OR_CL_PROC ON OP_OR_PROC_ID = OCP_OR_PROC_ID JOIN IDB.CL_PROC ON OCP_PROC_ID = CPX_PROC_ID JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CRE_RES_ID = OCAS_RES_ID WHERE 1=1 AND OC_SURG_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT date AND CURRENT date + 21 DAYS AND OC_OR_CASE_STS_CD NOT IN ('2', '5') AND(CPX_PROC_CD IN ('55866', '56308', '58550', '58552', '58553', '58554', '58570', '58571', '58572', '58573', '58578') OR CPX_PROC_NAME LIKE '%PROSTATECTOMY%' OR CPX_PROC_NAME LIKE '%PRSTECT%' OR OP_PROC_NAME LIKE '%PROSTATECTOMY%' OR OP_PROC_NAME LIKE '%HYSTERECTOMY%') AND CPX_PROC_CD NOT IN ('55801', '55810', '55812', '55815', '55821', '55831', '55840', '55842', '55845', '55862', '55865', '58150', '58180', '58200', '58210', '58240', '58260', '58262', '58267', '58285', '58291') AND CRE_RES_NAME IN ('EASTHAM, JAMES', 'EHDAIE, BEHFAR', 'GOH, ALVIN CHUN CHIN', 'LAUDONE, VINCENT P', 'PIETZAK, EUGENE', 'SMITH, ROBERT CHARLES', 'LONG ROCHE, KARA', 'MATULEWICZ, RICHARD STEVEN') ) , Y AS (SELECT DISTINCT STRIP(OC_MRN) AS MRN, STRIP(PT_LAST_NAME) || ', ' || STRIP(PT_FIRST_NAME) AS "Name", OC_SURG_DTE AS "Surgery Date", STRIP(CRE_RES_NAME) AS "Surgeon Name", STRIP(CPX_PROC_CD) AS "CPT Code", STRIP(CPX_PROC_NAME) AS "Procedure Name" FROM X JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON OC_MRN = PT_MRN) , AC AS (SELECT AC_MRN, MAX(CASE WHEN AC_IRB_NO = '23-094' THEN 'Y' END) AS "23-094", MAX(CASE WHEN AC_IRB_NO = '06-107' THEN 'Y' END) AS "06-107" FROM IDB.PATIENT LEFT JOIN IDB.ACCRUALS ON PT_MRN = AC_MRN WHERE AC_MRN IN (SELECT MRN FROM Y) AND AC_IRB_NO IN ('23-094', '06-107') GROUP BY AC_MRN ) SELECT DISTINCT Y.*, "23-094", "06-107" FROM Y LEFT JOIN AC ON MRN = AC_MRN

prompt: Provide a report of patients with a follicular lymphoma diagnosis who have not been treated with chemotherapy or radiation therapy
completion: WITH FL AS (SELECT DISTINCT TM_MRN AS MRN, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH AS DOB, PT_SEX AS GENDER, R.AV_DESC AS "Race", E.AV_DESC AS "Ethnicity", PT_DATE_OF_DEATH AS DOD, COALESCE(MAX(PLA_LST_APPT_DTE, PLA_LST_DSCH_DTE), PLA_LST_APPT_DTE, PLA_LST_DSCH_DTE) AS LAST_FU_DATE, TM_DX_DTE AS DX_DATE, TM_HIST_CD AS DX_CODE, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS DX_DESC, CASE WHEN TM_AJCC_7 NOT IN ('', '888', '999') THEN AJCC7.AV_DESC WHEN TM_AJCC NOT IN ('', '88', '99') THEN AJCC.AV_DESC WHEN TM_GENERAL_STG NOT IN ('', '9') THEN GS.AV_DESC WHEN TM_PATH_STG_GRP NOT IN ('', '88', '9', '99') THEN TM_PATH_STG_GRP ELSE CLIN.AV_DESC END AS STAGE FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON TM_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY ON PT_MRN = PLA_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS R ON PT_RACE = R.AV_CODE AND R.AV_ELEMENT = 'RACE' LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS E ON PT_PT_ETHNICITY = E.AV_CODE AND E.AV_ELEMENT = 'PT_ETHNICITY' JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS AJCC7 ON AJCC7.AV_ELEMENT = 'AJCC_7' AND AJCC7.AV_CODE = TM_AJCC_7 LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS AJCC ON AJCC.AV_ELEMENT = 'AJCC' AND AJCC.AV_CODE = TM_AJCC LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS GS ON GS.AV_ELEMENT = 'GENERAL_STG' AND GS.AV_CODE = TM_GENERAL_STG LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS CLIN ON CLIN.AV_ELEMENT = 'CLIN_STG_DSCR' AND CLIN.AV_CODE = TM_CLIN_STG_DSCR WHERE 1=1 AND TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND TM_HIST_CD IN ('M9595/3', 'M9597/3', 'M9690/3', 'M9691/3', 'M9695/3', 'M9698/3') ) , FL2 AS (SELECT * FROM FL WHERE STAGE IN ('DISTANT METASTASES/SYSTEMIC DISEASE') OR STAGE like '%III%' OR STAGE like '%IV%' ) , LYM AS (SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN AS MRN, CPE_ENC_DTE, CRE_RES_NAME, CRE_RES_TYP, CLD_DEPT_NAME, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8, CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CPE_MRN ORDER BY CPE_ENC_DTE) AS RN_FIRST, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CPE_MRN ORDER BY CPE_ENC_DTE DESC) AS RN_LAST FROM FL2 JOIN IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER ON CPE_MRN = MRN JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CRE_RES_TYP IN ('Physician') AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 = 'LYM' ) , LYM_FIRST AS (SELECT MRN, CPE_ENC_DTE AS FIRST_LYM_VISIT, CRE_RES_NAME AS FIRST_LYM_PHYSICIAN FROM LYM WHERE RN_FIRST = 1 ) , LYM_LAST AS (SELECT MRN, CPE_ENC_DTE AS LAST_LYM_VISIT, CRE_RES_NAME AS LAST_LYM_PHYSICIAN FROM LYM WHERE RN_LAST = 1 ) , CPE_ALL AS (SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN AS MRN, CPE_ENC_DTE, CRE_RES_NAME, CRE_RES_TYP, CLD_DEPT_NAME, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8, CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CPE_MRN ORDER BY CPE_ENC_DTE DESC) AS RN_LAST_ALL FROM FL2 JOIN IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER ON CPE_MRN = MRN JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CRE_RES_TYP IN ('Physician') ) , CPE_ALL_LAST AS (SELECT MRN, CPE_ENC_DTE AS LAST_VISIT_OVERALL, CRE_RES_NAME AS LAST_VISIT_OVERALL_PHYSICIAN FROM CPE_ALL WHERE RN_LAST_ALL = 1 ) , X AS (SELECT FL2.*, FIRST_LYM_VISIT, FIRST_LYM_PHYSICIAN, LAST_LYM_VISIT, LAST_LYM_PHYSICIAN, LAST_VISIT_OVERALL, LAST_VISIT_OVERALL_PHYSICIAN FROM FL2 LEFT JOIN LYM_FIRST ON FL2.MRN = LYM_FIRST.MRN LEFT JOIN LYM_LAST ON FL2.MRN = LYM_LAST.MRN LEFT JOIN CPE_ALL_LAST ON FL2.MRN = CPE_ALL_LAST.MRN) SELECT * FROM X , IO AS (SELECT APR_MRN, CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME, MIN(APR_START_DTE) AS START_DATE, MAX(APR_END_DTE) AS END_DATE, APR_ORD_RX_TYPE FROM IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX_V WHERE 1=1 AND CDG_IMMUNOTHERAPY_FLAG = 'Y' AND APR_MRN IN (SELECT MRN FROM X) GROUP BY APR_MRN, CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME, APR_ORD_RX_TYPE ) , CHEMO AS (SELECT APR_MRN, CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME, MIN(APR_START_DTE) AS START_DATE, MAX(APR_END_DTE) AS END_DATE FROM IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX_V WHERE 1=1 AND CDG_CHEMO_FLAG = 'Y' AND CDG_IMMUNOTHERAPY_FLAG <> 'Y' AND APR_MRN IN (SELECT MRN FROM X) GROUP BY APR_MRN, CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME ) , RT AS (SELECT DISTINCT RTC_TX_MRN, RTC_TX_PLAN_NAME, RTC_PRIMARY_REF_POINT, RTC_TX_START_DTE, RTC_TX_STOP_DTE, RTC_TX_ELAPSED_DAYS, RTC_TX_PLANNED_FRACTIONS, RTC_TX_DELIVERED_FRACTIONS, RTC_TX_PLANNED_DOSE, RTC_TX_DELIVERED_DOSE, RTC_DOSE_CORRECTION FROM IDB.RADONC_TREATMENT_COURSE WHERE RTC_TX_MRN IN (SELECT MRN FROM X) ) , DM AS (SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN, GENE, RESULT, METHOD FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_STRUCTURED_RESULTS_V JOIN X ON PT_MRN = MRN) SELECT DISTINCT MRN, "t2"."PRPT_ACCESSION_NO" AS "Pathology Report", PRPT_REPORT_DTE, PRPT_PROCEDURE_DTE, UPPER(CASE WHEN LENGTH(PRPT_REPORT) <= 15000 THEN RTRIM(CAST(SUBSTR(PRPT_REPORT, 1, 15000) AS VARCHAR(15000))) ELSE CAST(SUBSTR(PRPT_REPORT, 1, 15000) AS VARCHAR(15000)) END) AS TXT FROM X JOIN "DV"."PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V" "t2" ON PRPT_MRN = MRN

prompt: Patients seen at MSKCC between 2010-01-01 and 2019-04-11 diagnosed with lung cancer and have mutation in specific genes (IMPACT)
completion: WITH IMPACT AS (SELECT PT_MRN IMPACT_MRN, PDRX_PATH_DMP_RESULTS_XML_ID, PDRX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID, PDRX_PATH_RPT_ID, PDRX_ACCESSION_NO, PDRX_DMP_PATIENT_ID, PDRX_DMP_SAMPLE_ID, PDWS_NAME, PROJECT, TUMOR_TYPE_CODE, TUMOR_TYPE_NAME, IS_METASTASIS, PRIMARY_SITE, METASTASIS_SITE, VARIANT_DESC, VARIANT_ID, VARIANT_CLASS, GENE_ID, SITE1_GENE, SITE2_GENE, EXON_NUM, AA_CHANGE, CDNA_CHANGE, GENE_FOLD_CHANGE, CHROMOSOME, IS_HOTSPOT, CONFIDENCE_CV_ID, TRANSCRIPT_ID, NORMAL_DP, TUMOR_DP, NORMAL_AD, TUMOR_AD, TUMOR_VFREQ, DBSNP_ID, START_POSITION, ALT_ALLELE, REF_ALLELE, MAF_VARIANT_TYPE, MAF_NP_COUNT, MAF_START_POSITION, MAF_END_POSITION, MAF_REF_ALLELE, MAF_ALT_ALLELE, MAF_T_REF_COUNT, MAF_VARIANT_CLASSIFICATION FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML INNER JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON PDRX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID INNER JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML_SETTINGS ON PDRX_PATH_DMP_RESULTS_XML_ID = PDRXS_PATH_DMP_RESULTS_XML_ID INNER JOIN DVDMC.PATHOLOGY_DMP_WEBSVC_SETTINGS ON PDRXS_SETTING_ID = PDWS_SETTING_ID , XMLTABLE('$x/root/*' PASSING PDRX_XML_VALUE AS "x" COLUMNS PROJECT VARCHAR(100) PATH '../meta-data/dmp_alys_task_name', TUMOR_TYPE_CODE VARCHAR(100) PATH '../meta-data/tumor_type_code', TUMOR_TYPE_NAME VARCHAR(255) PATH '../meta-data/tumor_type_name', IS_METASTASIS VARCHAR(10) PATH '../meta-data/is_metastasis', PRIMARY_SITE VARCHAR(255) PATH '../meta-data/primary_site', METASTASIS_SITE VARCHAR(255) PATH '../meta-data/metastasis_site', VARIANT_DESC VARCHAR(100) PATH './local-name(.)', VARIANT_ID VARCHAR(255) PATH 'snp_indel_variant_id|cnv_variant_id|sv_variant_id', VARIANT_CLASS VARCHAR(255) PATH 'variant_class', SITE1_GENE VARCHAR(100) PATH 'site1_gene', SITE2_GENE VARCHAR(100) PATH 'site2_gene', GENE_ID VARCHAR(100) PATH 'gene_id', EXON_NUM VARCHAR(100) PATH 'exon_num', AA_CHANGE VARCHAR(100) PATH 'aa_change', CDNA_CHANGE VARCHAR(100) PATH 'cDNA_change', GENE_FOLD_CHANGE VARCHAR(100) PATH 'gene_fold_change', CHROMOSOME VARCHAR(100) PATH 'chromosome', IS_HOTSPOT VARCHAR(100) PATH 'is_hotspot', CONFIDENCE_CV_ID VARCHAR(100) PATH 'confidence_cv_id', TRANSCRIPT_ID VARCHAR(100) PATH 'transcript_id', NORMAL_DP VARCHAR(100) PATH 'normal_dp', TUMOR_DP VARCHAR(100) PATH 'tumor_dp', NORMAL_AD VARCHAR(100) PATH 'normal_ad', TUMOR_AD VARCHAR(100) PATH 'tumor_ad', TUMOR_VFREQ VARCHAR(100) PATH 'tumor_vfreq', DBSNP_ID VARCHAR(100) PATH 'dbSNP_id', START_POSITION int PATH 'start_position', ALT_ALLELE VARCHAR(255) PATH 'alt_allele', prompt: We are working on a manuscript (IRB Protocol Approved 22-020) and previously received data through dataline APP23674.  We need additional data for time period July 1st 2020 to June 30th 2021.  For the manuscript, we just need to include how many RRTs were called at 1275, Koch and JRSC on patients >18 years ago, excluding calls for visitors or employees.
completion: WITH CLINDOC AS (SELECT CDD_MRN AS "MRN", CDD_SERVICE_DTE AS "Service Date", CDD_DOC_NAME AS "Document Name", OP_DISPLAY_NAME AS "Provider", CDD_DOC_GUID AS "Document Guid", CDO_SECTION AS "Section", CDO_ITEM_NAME AS "Item", CDO_VALUE_TEXT AS "Value" FROM IDB.CD_DOCUMENT LEFT JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION ON CDD_DOC_GUID = CDO_DOC_GUID AND CDD_AUTHORED_DTE = CDO_AUTHORED_DTE AND CDO_VALUE_TEXT <> '' JOIN IDB.OMS_PROVIDER ON CDD_AUTH_PROV_GUID = OP_PVDR_GUID WHERE CDD_CANCEL_IND <> '1' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND <> '1' ) , COHORT AS (SELECT C.* FROM CLINDOC C JOIN IDB.PATIENT P ON C.MRN = P.PT_MRN WHERE C."Document Name" like 'Initial Evaluation, Adult Team%' AND C."Service Date" BETWEEN '2020-07-01' AND '2021-06-30' AND YEAR(C."Service Date" - P.PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) > 18 AND (C."Item" IN ('Reason for Call: Visit Type', 'Reason for Call: Location', 'Reason for Call: Visit Initiated') OR C."Item" like 'Crit_Care_RRT%') ) , Q1 AS (SELECT MRN, "Service Date", "Document Name", "Provider", "Document Guid", MAX(CASE WHEN "Item" like 'Crit_Care_RRT%' THEN CAST("Value" AS VARCHAR(64)) ELSE NULL END) AS "CC_Koch", MAX(CASE WHEN "Item" like '%Visit Type%' THEN CAST("Value" AS VARCHAR(64)) ELSE NULL END) AS "Visit Type", MAX(CASE WHEN "Item" like '%Location%' THEN CAST("Value" AS VARCHAR(64)) ELSE NULL END) AS "Location", MAX(CASE WHEN "Item" like '%Visit Initiated%' THEN CAST("Value" AS VARCHAR(64)) ELSE NULL END) AS "Visit Initiated" FROM COHORT GROUP BY MRN, "Service Date", "Document Name", "Provider", "Document Guid") SELECT "CC_Koch", "Visit Type", COUNT(DISTINCT "Document Guid") COUNT FROM Q1 WHERE ("Visit Initiated" like 'Rapid Response%') OR ("Visit Initiated" IS NULL) GROUP BY "CC_Koch", "Visit Type"

prompt: Provide admission, discharge, and census data for the GI service on weekends for 2018 to track patient flow for the three GI teams.
completion: SELECT TRIM(UC_HOSP_SVC) "Admit Service", YEAR_TIME "Admit Year", CASE WHEN MONTH_TIME = 1 THEN 'January' WHEN MONTH_TIME = 2 THEN 'February' WHEN MONTH_TIME = 3 THEN 'March' WHEN MONTH_TIME = 4 THEN 'April' WHEN MONTH_TIME = 5 THEN 'May' WHEN MONTH_TIME = 6 THEN 'June' WHEN MONTH_TIME = 7 THEN 'July' WHEN MONTH_TIME = 8 THEN 'August' WHEN MONTH_TIME = 9 THEN 'September' WHEN MONTH_TIME = 10 THEN 'October' WHEN MONTH_TIME = 11 THEN 'November' WHEN MONTH_TIME = 12 THEN 'December' END "Admit Month", HOUR_TIME "Admit Time", COUNT(DISTINCT UC_MRN || CHAR(UC_TRANSFER_DTE)) "Count" FROM (SELECT A.*, DAYOFWEEK(A.UC_TRANSFER_DTE) DAY_OF_WEEK, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM A.UC_TRANSFER_DTE) YEAR_TIME, EXTRACT(MONTH FROM A.UC_TRANSFER_DTE) MONTH_TIME, EXTRACT(HOUR FROM A.UC_TRANSFER_TME) HOUR_TIME FROM IDB.UNIFIED_CENSUS A JOIN IDB.VISIT_V V ON V.VIS_VISIT_ID = A.UC_VISIT_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.UNIFIED_CENSUS B ON A.UC_MRN = B.UC_MRN AND A.UC_VISIT_ID = B.UC_VISIT_ID AND B.UC_HOSP_SVC IN ('GIA', 'GIB', 'GIC') AND B.UC_SEQ_NO = A.UC_SEQ_NO - 1 WHERE A.UC_HOSP_SVC IN ('GIA', 'GIB', 'GIC') AND B.UC_MRN IS NULL AND DAYOFWEEK(A.UC_TRANSFER_DTE) IN (1, 7) AND A.UC_TRANSFER_DTE BETWEEN '2018-01-01' AND CURRENT date AND V.VIS_IP_OP_ADJUSTED_IND = 'I' ) A GROUP BY UC_HOSP_SVC, YEAR_TIME, MONTH_TIME, DAY_OF_WEEK, HOUR_TIME ORDER BY YEAR_TIME ASC, MONTH_TIME ASC, DAY_OF_WEEK ASC, UC_HOSP_SVC ; SELECT TRIM(UC_HOSP_SVC) "Discharge Service", YEAR_TIME "Discharge Year", CASE WHEN MONTH_TIME = 1 THEN 'January' WHEN MONTH_TIME = 2 THEN 'February' WHEN MONTH_TIME = 3 THEN 'March' WHEN MONTH_TIME = 4 THEN 'April' WHEN MONTH_TIME = 5 THEN 'May' WHEN MONTH_TIME = 6 THEN 'June' WHEN MONTH_TIME = 7 THEN 'July' WHEN MONTH_TIME = 8 THEN 'August' WHEN MONTH_TIME = 9 THEN 'September' WHEN MONTH_TIME = 10 THEN 'October' WHEN MONTH_TIME = 11 THEN 'November' WHEN MONTH_TIME = 12 THEN 'December' END "Discharge Month", HOUR_TIME "Discharge Time", COUNT(DISTINCT UC_MRN || CHAR(UC_END_DTE)) "Count" FROM (SELECT A.*, DAYOFWEEK(A.UC_END_DTE) DAY_OF_WEEK, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM A.UC_END_DTE) YEAR_TIME, EXTRACT(MONTH FROM A.UC_END_DTE) MONTH_TIME, EXTRACT(HOUR FROM A.UC_END_TME) HOUR_TIME FROM IDB.UNIFIED_CENSUS A JOIN IDB.VISIT_V V ON V.VIS_VISIT_ID = A.UC_VISIT_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.UNIFIED_CENSUS B ON A.UC_MRN = B.UC_MRN AND A.UC_VISIT_ID = B.UC_VISIT_ID AND B.UC_HOSP_SVC IN ('GIA', 'GIB', 'GIC') AND B.UC_SEQ_NO = A.UC_SEQ_NO + 1 WHERE A.UC_HOSP_SVC IN ('GIA', 'GIB', 'GIC') AND B.UC_MRN IS NULL AND DAYOFWEEK(A.UC_END_DTE) IN (1, 7) AND A.UC_END_DTE BETWEEN '2018-01-01' AND CURRENT date AND V.VIS_IP_OP_ADJUSTED_IND = 'I' ) A GROUP BY UC_HOSP_SVC, YEAR_TIME, MONTH_TIME, DAY_OF_WEEK, HOUR_TIME ORDER BY YEAR_TIME ASC, MONTH_TIME ASC, DAY_OF_WEEK ASC, UC_HOSP_SVC ; SELECT UC_HOSP_SVC "Census Service", EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CENSUS_DATE) "Census Year", EXTRACT(MONTH FROM CENSUS_DATE) "Census Month", COUNT(DISTINCT UC_MRN || CHAR(CENSUS_DATE)) "Count" FROM IDB.UNIFIED_CENSUS JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT VIS_ADM_DTE AS CENSUS_DATE FROM IDB.VISIT WHERE VIS_ADM_DTE BETWEEN DATE('2018-01-01') AND CURRENT date) AS A ON CENSUS_DATE >= UC_TRANSFER_DTE AND CENSUS_DATE <= COALESCE(UC_END_DTE, CENSUS_DATE) WHERE UC_HOSP_SVC IN ('GIA', 'GIB', 'GIC') AND DAYOFWEEK(CENSUS_DATE) IN (1, 7) GROUP BY UC_HOSP_SVC, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CENSUS_DATE), EXTRACT(MONTH FROM CENSUS_DATE)

prompt: Currently due to high demand for our services, patients have to wait a couple of months for a new visit with our counseling center providers.  Simultaneously, our providers are currently seeing patients that are clinically appropriate to be transferred to the community. If these patients are identified and transferred to the community, we can reduce the wait time for new patients.  We need data in order to identify these patients who can be transferred. Currently, the providers review their patient lists manually which takes several days to complete and is not feasible to do on a regular basis.
completion: WITH APPTS AS (SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN "MRN" , CPE_ENC_DTE "APPT DATE" , CLD_CLD_CENTER "LOCATION" , CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 "DEPARTMENT" , CLD_DEPT_NAME "DEPARTMENT NAME" , CRE_RES_NAME "PROVIDER NAME" , CRE_RES_TYP "RESOURCE TYPE" , CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME "VISIT TYPE" , CPE_CPE_APPT_STS "APPT STATUS" FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE 1=1 AND CPE_MRN <> '' AND CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp', 'Sch') AND YEAR(CPE_ENC_DTE) >= '2022' AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 = 'PSY' ), SURV AS (SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN, CPE_ENC_DTE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CPE_MRN ORDER BY CPE_ENC_DTE) RN_FIRST, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CPE_MRN ORDER BY CPE_ENC_DTE DESC) RN_LAST FROM APPTS JOIN IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER ON APPTS.MRN = CPE_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID AND (CLD_DEPT_NAME LIKE '%SVR%' OR CLD_DEPT_NAME LIKE '%SURVIVOR%') JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID AND (CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME LIKE '%SNP %' OR CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME LIKE '%SAPP %') WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp', 'Sch') AND YEAR(CPE_ENC_DTE) >= '2022' ), LST_PSY AS (SELECT CPE_MRN AS LST_MRN, MAX(CPE_ENC_DTE) AS "LAST PSY APPOINTMENT DATE" FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN APPTS ON CPE_MRN = APPTS."MRN" JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 = 'PSY' GROUP BY CPE_MRN ), VISITS AS (SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN, CASE WHEN COUNT(CPE_ENC_DTE) OVER (PARTITION BY CPE_MRN) >= '4' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS FLAG_VISIT FROM LST_PSY JOIN IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER ON LST_MRN = CPE_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 IN ('MED', 'RDO', 'SRG') AND CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN "LAST PSY APPOINTMENT DATE" - 1 YEAR AND "LAST PSY APPOINTMENT DATE"), NEXT_SCH AS (SELECT CPE_MRN, MIN(CPE_ENC_DTE) AS "NEXT APPT DATE" FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN APPTS ON APPTS.MRN = CPE_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Sch') GROUP BY CPE_MRN) SELECT DISTINCT A."MRN" , PT_LAST_NAME "LAST NAME" , PT_FIRST_NAME "FIRST NAME" , PT_STATE "STATE" , CASE WHEN PT_DEATH_IND IN ('', 'A') THEN 'ALIVE' ELSE 'DECEASED' END AS "VITAL_STATUS" , A."APPT DATE" , A."LOCATION" , A."DEPARTMENT" , A."DEPARTMENT NAME" , A."PROVIDER NAME" , A."RESOURCE TYPE" , A."VISIT TYPE" , A."APPT STATUS" , NS."NEXT APPT DATE" , L."LAST PSY APPOINTMENT DATE" , FS.CPE_ENC_DTE "First Survivorship Appt Date" , LS.CPE_ENC_DTE "Last Survivorship Appt Date" , CASE WHEN (FLAG_VISIT IS NULL OR FLAG_VISIT = '' OR FLAG_VISIT = 'N') THEN 'N' ELSE FLAG_VISIT END AS "FLAG VISIT (>= 4)" , CASE WHEN (PLA_LST_CHEMO_DTE BETWEEN "LAST PSY APPOINTMENT DATE" - 1 YEAR AND "LAST PSY APPOINTMENT DATE" OR PLA_LST_RT_DTE BETWEEN "LAST PSY APPOINTMENT DATE" - 1 YEAR AND "LAST PSY APPOINTMENT DATE" OR PLA_LST_SURG_DTE BETWEEN "LAST PSY APPOINTMENT DATE" - 1 YEAR AND "LAST PSY APPOINTMENT DATE") THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS "FLAG CHEMO" FROM APPTS A JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON A."MRN" = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY ON A."MRN" = PLA_MRN LEFT JOIN LST_PSY L ON A."MRN" = L.LST_MRN LEFT JOIN SURV FS ON A."MRN" = FS.CPE_MRN AND FS.RN_FIRST = 1 LEFT JOIN SURV LS ON A."MRN" = LS.CPE_MRN AND LS.RN_LAST = 1 LEFT JOIN VISITS V ON L.LST_MRN = V.CPE_MRN LEFT JOIN NEXT_SCH NS ON A."MRN" = NS.CPE_MRN ; WITH APPTS AS (SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN "MRN" , CPE_ENC_DTE "APPT DATE" , CLD_CLD_CENTER "LOCATION" , CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 "DEPARTMENT" , CLD_DEPT_NAME "DEPARTMENT NAME" , CRE_RES_NAME "PROVIDER NAME" , CRE_RES_TYP "RESOURCE TYPE" , CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME "VISIT TYPE" , CPE_CPE_APPT_STS "APPT STATUS" FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE YEAR(CPE_ENC_DTE) >= '2022' AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 = 'PSY' AND CPE_MRN <> '' ), SURV AS (SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN, CPE_ENC_DTE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CPE_MRN ORDER BY CPE_ENC_DTE) RN_FIRST, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CPE_MRN ORDER BY CPE_ENC_DTE DESC) RN_LAST FROM APPTS JOIN IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER ON APPTS.MRN = CPE_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID AND (CLD_DEPT_NAME LIKE '%SVR%' OR CLD_DEPT_NAME LIKE '%SURVIVOR%') JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID AND (CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME LIKE '%SNP %' OR CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME LIKE '%SAPP %') WHERE YEAR(CPE_ENC_DTE) >= '2022' ), LST_PSY AS (SELECT CPE_MRN AS LST_MRN, MAX(CPE_ENC_DTE) AS "LAST PSY APPOINTMENT DATE" FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN APPTS ON CPE_MRN = APPTS."MRN" JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 = 'PSY' GROUP BY CPE_MRN ), NEXT_SCH AS (SELECT CPE_MRN, MIN(CPE_ENC_DTE) AS "NEXT APPT DATE" FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN APPTS ON APPTS.MRN = CPE_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Sch') GROUP BY CPE_MRN) SELECT DISTINCT A."MRN" , PT_LAST_NAME "LAST NAME" , PT_FIRST_NAME "FIRST NAME" , PT_STATE "STATE" , CASE WHEN PT_DEATH_IND IN ('', 'A') THEN 'ALIVE' ELSE 'DECEASED' END AS "VITAL_STATUS" , A."APPT DATE" , A."LOCATION" , A."DEPARTMENT" , A."DEPARTMENT NAME" , A."PROVIDER NAME" , A."RESOURCE TYPE" , A."VISIT TYPE" , A."APPT STATUS" , NS."NEXT APPT DATE" , L."LAST PSY APPOINTMENT DATE" , FS.CPE_ENC_DTE "First Survivorship Appt Date" , LS.CPE_ENC_DTE "Last Survivorship Appt Date" FROM APPTS A JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON A."MRN" = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN LST_PSY L ON A."MRN" = L.LST_MRN LEFT JOIN SURV FS ON A."MRN" = FS.CPE_MRN AND FS.RN_FIRST = 1 LEFT JOIN SURV LS ON A."MRN" = LS.CPE_MRN AND LS.RN_LAST = 1 LEFT JOIN NEXT_SCH NS ON A."MRN" = NS.CPE_MRN ;

prompt: Can you please provide the demographic and insurance data of all MSK pediatric patients seen in 2023? Ages 0-21
completion: WITH OPS AS (SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN AS OP_MRN, 'OP' AS OP, CPE_ENC_DTE, CLD_DEPT_NAME, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CLD_DEPT_ID = CPE_DEPT_ID AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 <> 'EHS' AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 NOT IN ('MSKACCESS', 'PFS') WHERE CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN '2023-01-01' AND '2023-12-31' AND CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Comp', 'Arrived') AND CPE_CPE_IP_IND <> 'INPATIENT' AND CPE_ENC_TYP_CD = 50 ) , IPS AS (SELECT DISTINCT VIS_MRN AS IP_MRN, 'IP' AS IP FROM IDB.VISIT_V WHERE 1=1 AND VIS_ADM_DTE BETWEEN '2023-01-01' AND '2023-12-31' AND VIS_IP_OP_ADJUSTED_IND = 'I' ) , ALLPTS AS (SELECT OP_MRN AS MRN FROM OPS UNION SELECT IP_MRN AS MRN FROM IPS) , FCDATE AS (SELECT MRN AS MRNFC, MAX(VIS_ADM_DTE) AS MAXADMDTE FROM ALLPTS JOIN IDB.VISIT_V ON MRN = VIS_MRN AND VIS_PATIENT_TYPE <> 'OPRE' AND VIS_VISIT_STATUS IN ('2', '3') GROUP BY MRN) , FC AS (SELECT DISTINCT MRNFC, MAXADMDTE, CASE WHEN RVPM_FSC_CAT_NAME = 'SELF PAY' THEN 'SELFPAY' WHEN RVPM_FSC_CAT_NAME LIKE 'MEDICAID%' THEN 'MEDICAID' WHEN RVPM_FSC_CAT_NAME LIKE 'MEDICARE%' THEN 'MEDICARE' WHEN RVPM_FSC_CAT_NAME IN ('ADMIN', 'MSK EMPLOYEE', 'PAT REP ADMIN') THEN 'OTHER' ELSE 'PRIVATE' END AS INSURANCE FROM FCDATE JOIN IDB.RMS_VISIT_FSC_CAT_MAP_V ON RVPM_MRN = MRNFC AND RVPM_ADM_DTE = MAXADMDTE) , MAXFC AS (SELECT DISTINCT A.MRNFC, MAXADMDTE, INSURANCE FROM FC A JOIN (SELECT MRNFC, MAX(MAXADMDTE) AS MAXMAXADMDTE FROM FC GROUP BY MRNFC) AS X ON A.MRNFC = X.MRNFC AND MAXADMDTE = MAXMAXADMDTE), RAW_DATA AS (SELECT DISTINCT MRN, OP, IP, YEAR(CURRENT DATE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) AS AGE, PT_SEX AS GENDER, R.AV_DESC AS RACE, E.AV_DESC AS ETHNIC, INSURANCE, PT_COUNTRY, PT_STATE , CASE WHEN ZC_COUNTY IN ('Kings', 'Queens', 'Bronx', 'New York', 'Richmond') THEN ZC_COUNTY ELSE '' END AS NY_BORO FROM ALLPTS LEFT JOIN OPS ON MRN = OP_MRN LEFT JOIN IPS ON MRN = IP_MRN JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON MRN = PT_MRN AND PT_MRN <> '' LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS R ON R.AV_ELEMENT = 'RACE' AND R.AV_CODE = PT_RACE LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS E ON E.AV_ELEMENT = 'PT_ETHNICITY' AND E.AV_CODE = PT_PT_ETHNICITY LEFT JOIN IDB.ZIPCODE ON ZC_ZIP = SUBSTR(PT_ZIP_CD, 1, 5) LEFT JOIN MAXFC ON MRN = MRNFC) SELECT AGE, GENDER, RACE, ETHNIC, INSURANCE, PT_COUNTRY, PT_STATE, NY_BORO, COUNT (DISTINCT MRN) AS NO_OF_PATIENTS FROM RAW_DATA GROUP BY AGE, GENDER, RACE, ETHNIC, INSURANCE, PT_COUNTRY, PT_STATE, NY_BORO ;

prompt: Identify patients diagnosed with adenocarcinoma of the lung in 2009-2010 tested for EGFR.
completion: WITH "cte1" AS (SELECT TEXTTABLE.*, CONTAINS("PRPT_REPORT", '"egfr"') AS "HitCol1" FROM "DV"."PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V" TEXTTABLE) SELECT DISTINCT "t1"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AS "Deident PT #", "t2"."PT_MRN" AS "MRN", "t2"."PT_SEX" AS "Gender", "t2"."PT_BIRTH_DTE" AS "Date of Birth", "t2"."PT_RACE_DESC" AS "Race", "t3"."DT_DTE" AS "CDB Tumor Diagnosis Date", "t4"."DXCC_ICD_CODE" AS "ICD-O Histology Code", "t4"."DXCC_ICD_MSK_DESC" AS "ICD-O Histology Desc", "t5"."ICSC_SITE_CD" AS "ICD-O Site Code", "t5"."ICSC_ICDO_SITE_MSK_DESC" AS "ICD-O Site Desc", "t6"."TCA_CASE_STS_DESC" AS "Case Status", "t7"."PRPT_ACCESSION_NO" AS "Pathology Report", "t8"."DT_DTE" AS "Pathology Report Date", "t9"."CDTM_SMOKING_HX_DESC" AS "SMOKING_HIST_DESC" FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED" "t1" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V" "t2" ON "t1"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t2"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."CDB_TUMOR_V" "t9" ON "t1"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t9"."CDTM_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE" "t3" ON "t9"."CDTM_DX_DATE_ID" = "t3"."DT_DATE_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DIAGNOSIS_CODE_CAT_ICDO_V" "t4" ON "t9"."CDTM_DX_CATALOG_ID" = "t4"."DXCC_DX_CATALOG_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."ICDO_SITE_CATALOG_V" "t5" ON "t9"."CDTM_SITE_CATALOG_ID" = "t5"."ICSC_SITE_CATALOG_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."TUMOR_CASE_ATTRIBUTES" "t6" ON "t9"."CDTM_CASE_ATTR_ID" = "t6"."TUMOR_CASE_ATTR_ID" LEFT JOIN "cte1" "t7" ON "t1"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t7"."PRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE" "t8" ON "t7"."PRPT_REPORT_DATE_ID" = "t8"."DT_DATE_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."TUMOR_CASE_ATTRIBUTES" "t9" ON "t9"."CDTM_CASE_ATTR_ID" = "t6"."TUMOR_CASE_ATTR_ID" WHERE ("t7"."HitCol1" <> 0 AND ("t3"."DT_YEAR" BETWEEN 2009 AND 2010 AND ("t4"."DXCC_ICD_CODE" IN ('M8140/3') AND "t5"."ICSC_SITE_CD" IN ('C340', 'C341', 'C342', 'C343', 'C348', 'C349'))))

prompt: Surgery EMR Recon - can we get a list of visits that were documented with a U22 that didn't connect with the correct DocGUID?
completion: SELECT CDD_DOC_GUID, CDD_MRN, CDD_DOC_NAME, CDD_SERVICE_DTE , CDD_SIGNATURE_STATUS_DESC, CDD_PTCAREDOC_GUID, CDD_FLOWSHEET_GUID , CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND, CDD_CANCEL_IND FROM IDB.CD_DOCUMENT LEFT JOIN IDB.CD_CNFG_PAT_CARE_DOCUMENT ON CPCD_KTREE_ROOT_GUID = CDD_FLOWSHEET_GUID AND CPCD_GUID = CDD_PTCAREDOC_GUID LEFT JOIN IDB.CD_CNFG_REPORT_GROUPING ON UPPER(CPCD_NAME) = UPPER(CRG_DOCUMENT_NAME) WHERE CDD_DOC_NAME = 'Follow Up, Sexual Health, AMB - Urology' AND CPCD_GUID IS NULL

prompt: Please provide a list of patients who had a kidney biopsy in Interventional Radiology from January 1, 2018 through June 30, 2018. In OpTime this is coded as "NBB Needle Biopsy Body Kidney", the procedure code is 11100055, and the CPT code is 999992.
completion: SELECT SSE_MRN, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_LAST_NAME, SSE_SURG_DTE, SSE_LOG_STS, SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD, SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC, SSP_SURG_LAST_NM, SSP_SURG_FIRST_NM, SSP_SURG_SVC_CD FROM IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE ON SSE_LOG_ID = SSP_LOG_ID JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PT_MRN = SSE_MRN WHERE SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC = 'NBB NEEDLE BIOPSY BODY KIDNEY' AND SSE_SURG_DTE BETWEEN '2018-01-01' AND '2018-06-30'

prompt: Provide an initial backload, then weekly data for NSCLC patients with NSD3 copy number gain aberrations.
completion: WITH PTS AS (SELECT PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID, PT_MRN, PRPT_ACCESSION_NO, PRPT_PATH_RPT_ID, GENE, RESULT, LOCUS, AA_CHANGE, NUCLEOTIDE, SEARCH_HIT1, SEARCH_HIT2, METHOD, ABERRATIONTYPE, FOLD_CHANGE, GENE2, CR_DATE FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_STRUCTURED_RESULTS_V JOIN (SELECT CHP_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID AS COH_DEID, DATE(CHP_CREATED_DT) AS CR_DATE FROM DVCMS.COHORT_PATIENT JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V ON PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = CHP_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID WHERE CHP_COHORT_ID=10418 ) COHORT ON COH_DEID = PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID WHERE 1=1 AND (GENE = 'NSD3' OR GENE2 = 'NSD3') AND ABERRATIONTYPE = 'copy number gain' ) , DMP_DX AS (SELECT DISTINCT PDRX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID P_ID, RPT.DT_DTE AS REPORT_DATE, T.*, DT.PDRX_PATH_RPT_ID , PTS.* FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML DT CROSS JOIN XMLTABLE('$c/root/*' PASSING DT.PDRX_XML_VALUE AS "c" COLUMNS DMP_PATIENT_ID VARCHAR(264) PATH '../meta-data/dmp_patient_id', DMP_SAMPLE_ID VARCHAR(264) PATH '../meta-data/dmp_sample_id', PRIMARY_SITE VARCHAR(264) PATH '../meta-data/primary_site', TUMOR_TYPE_NAME VARCHAR(264) PATH '../meta-data/tumor_type_name' , TUMOR_TYPE_CODE VARCHAR(264) PATH '../meta-data/tumor_type_code' , METASTASIS_SITE VARCHAR(264) PATH '../meta-data/metastasis_site') T JOIN PTS ON PTS.PRPT_PATH_RPT_ID = PDRX_PATH_RPT_ID JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V PRV ON PRV.PRPT_PATH_RPT_ID = PDRX_PATH_RPT_ID JOIN DV.DATE_V RPT ON RPT.DT_DATE_ID = PRV.PRPT_REPORT_DATE_ID JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT T.TUMOR_TYPE_CODE TTC FROM TABLE(DV.STRING_SPLIT('NSCLC', ',')) S CROSS JOIN TABLE(DV.ONCOTREE_CHILDREN(TRIM(COLUMN_VALUES))) T) X ON T.TUMOR_TYPE_CODE = X.TTC ) , DX AS (SELECT D1.PID, MIN(DT_DTE) AS DT_DTE FROM (SELECT P_ID AS PID, REPORT_DATE AS DT_DTE FROM DMP_DX) D1 GROUP BY D1.PID) , DT AS (SELECT PT_MRN AS MRN , PID AS PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID , DT_DTE FROM DX JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PID) SELECT DISTINCT DAYS(CURRENT date) - DAYS(CR_DATE) AS "Days ID" , DT.MRN , PT_LAST_NAME AS "Last Name" , PT_FIRST_NAME AS "First Name" , PT_BIRTH_DTE AS "Date of Birth" , PT_DEATH_DTE AS "Date of Death" , PT_SEX AS "Gender" , GENE AS "Gene" , GENE2 , SEARCH_HIT2 AS "Other" , DT_DTE AS "Min NGS Date" , FOLD_CHANGE AS "Fold Change" , TUMOR_TYPE_NAME AS "Tumor Type / Histology" , METASTASIS_SITE AS "Metastasis Site" , PRIMARY_SITE AS "Primary Site" , AA_CHANGE AS "Amino Acid Change" , NUCLEOTIDE AS "Nucleotide" , LOCUS AS "Locus" , CR_DATE AS "ID Date" FROM DT DT JOIN DMP_DX ON P_ID = DT.PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V PT ON DT.PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PT.PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID WHERE 1=1 ORDER BY DAYS(CURRENT date) - DAYS(CR_DATE), DT.MRN, GENE, AA_CHANGE, SEARCH_HIT2

prompt: Obtain baseline CBC and additional labs performed on requested patients as part of RRP 19-241.
Please search for cases (HR/R specimen class) with the diagnosis text "Burkitt lymphoma" under the diagnosis line.
completion: WITH BURKITT AS (SELECT PT_MRN AS MRNB, PT_LAST_NAME AS "Last Name", PT_FIRST_NAME AS "First Name", PT_BIRTH_DTE AS "DOB", PRPT_ACCESSION_NO AS "Path Accession Number", PRPT_REPORT_TYPE AS "Path Report Type", R.DT_DTE AS "Path Procedure Date", PRPT_REPORT AS "Path Report" FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT JOIN DV.DATE R ON R.DT_DATE_ID = PRPT_REPORT_DATE_ID JOIN DV.PATH_RPRT_TYPE_LOOKUP ON PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_CD = PRPT_REPORT_TYPE JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON PRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID WHERE (CONTAINS("PRPT_REPORT", '("burkitt" OR "BURKIT")') = 1) AND R.DT_DTE >= '2015-01-01' AND PRPT_REPORT IS NOT NULL AND (PRPT_ACCESSION_NO like 'H%' OR PRPT_ACCESSION_NO like 'S%') AND (PRPT_REPORT_TYPE like '%_R' OR PRPT_REPORT_TYPE like '%_HR') ) , SNP AS (SELECT DISTINCT MRNB, "Last Name", "First Name", "DOB", "Path Accession Number", "Path Report Type", "Path Procedure Date", PT_MRN AS MRNSNP, PRPT_ACCESSION_NO, PRPT_REPORT_TYPE, R.DT_DTE FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT JOIN DV.DATE R ON R.DT_DATE_ID = PRPT_REPORT_DATE_ID JOIN DV.PATH_RPRT_TYPE_LOOKUP ON PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_CD = PRPT_REPORT_TYPE JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON PRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID JOIN BURKITT ON PT_MRN = MRNB WHERE 1=1 AND (CONTAINS("PRPT_REPORT", '("ARRAY")') = 1) AND R.DT_DTE >= '2015-01-01' AND PRPT_REPORT IS NOT NULL AND PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_DESC IN ('Cytogenetics') ) SELECT * FROM SNP

prompt: High dose methotrexate (HD MTX) is usually defined as greater or equal to 1000mg/m2.  The rate of acute kidney injury (AKI) from HD MTX in children ranges from 0.1%-2% [1-3].  In adults, rates of AKI of up to 39% have been reported [4, 5].  Differences is pharmacokinetic processes (adsorption, plasma protein binding, metabolism and excretion) and concomitant medical conditions may explain some of the differences in rates of AKI in children and adults [6].  A large prospective study of 1,122 childhood cancer survivors (CSC) showed no significant decline in glomerular filtration rate (GFR) or glomerular dysfunction up to 35 years after cancer diagnosis [7].  There are no data on long term GFR in adults who experienced AKI from the administration of HD MTX.
completion: WITH METHOTREXATE AS (SELECT DISTINCT "t1"."PT_MRN" AS "MRN", MIN("t5"."DT_DTE") AS "Order Start Date" FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V" "t1" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED" "t5" ON "t1"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t5"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PHM_PT_MEDS_MQT" "t6" ON "t5"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t6"."POD_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PHM_ORDER_DTL" "t3" ON "t6"."POD_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t3"."POD_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AND "t6"."POD_PHARMA_INVENTORY_CTLG_ID" = "t3"."POD_PHARMA_INVENTORY_CTLG_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PHM_INVENTORY_CATALOG" "t2" ON "t3"."POD_PHARMA_INVENTORY_CTLG_ID" = "t2"."PINC_INVENTORY_CTLG_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PHM_ORDER_ATTR" "t4" ON "t3"."POD_PHARMA_ORD_ATTR_ID" = "t4"."POA_PHARMA_ORDER_ATTR_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" "t5" ON "t3"."POD_START_DATE_ID" = "t5"."DT_DATE_ID" WHERE UPPER("t2"."PINC_GENERIC_NAME") IN ('METHOTREXATE', 'METHOTREXATE INVEST', 'METHOTREXATE SODIUM', 'METHOTREXATE', 'METHOTREXATE SODIUM') AND ("t3"."POD_DOSE" >= 1000 OR ("t3"."POD_TOTAL_DOSE_UNIT" = 'GM' AND "t3"."POD_DOSE" >= 1)) GROUP BY "t1"."PT_MRN" HAVING MIN("t5"."DT_DTE") BETWEEN '2002-01-01' AND '2012-12-31' AND MAX("t5"."DT_DTE") BETWEEN '2002-01-01' AND '2012-12-31'), ORDER_AND_DEMO_INFO AS (SELECT TRIM(MRN) MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, "Order Start Date", YEAR("Order Start Date" - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) "Age at Order Start Date", PT_DATE_OF_DEATH, PT_DEATH_IND FROM METHOTREXATE JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PT_MRN = MRN WHERE (PT_DEATH_IND = 'A' OR PT_DATE_OF_DEATH > "Order Start Date" + 5 YEAR) AND YEAR("Order Start Date" - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) >= 18 ) SELECT ORDER_AND_DEMO_INFO.*, LR_PERFORMED_DT, LR_SUBTEST_NAME, LR_RESULT_VALUE FROM ORDER_AND_DEMO_INFO LEFT JOIN IDB.LAB_RESULTS ON MRN = LR_MRN AND LR_PERFORMED_DTE < "Order Start Date" WHERE (LR_SUBTEST_NAME = 'Creatinine' OR LR_SUBTEST_NAME = 'Creatinine-' OR LR_SUBTEST_NAME = 'Creatinine.' OR LR_SUBTEST_NAME = 'Creatinine, Blood') ORDER BY MRN, LR_PERFORMED_DT ; SELECT TRIM(ORD_MRN) MRN FROM IDB.ORDERS JOIN IDB.ORDER_OCCR ON ORD_MRN = OCC_MRN AND ORD_ACCT_NO = OCC_ACCT_NO AND ORD_ORD_NO = OCC_ORD_NO AND OCC_OCCR_STS_CD = '40' JOIN IDB.RX_MEDSOL ON RMS_ORD_NO = ORD_ORD_NO AND ORD_MRN = RMS_MRN AND ORD_ACCT_NO = RMS_ACCT_NO JOIN IDB.SVM ON RMS_SVM_DPT = SVM_SVM_DPT AND RMS_SVM_CD = SVM_SVM_CD WHERE ORD_STRT_DTE <= '2003-09-14' AND ORD_ORD_STS_CD IN ('20', '85') AND SVM_SVM_SUBDPT IN ('300', '400') AND SVM_SVM_DESC LIKE '%CISPLATIN%' AND SVM_SVM_DESC NOT LIKE '%PLACEBO%' AND ORD_MRN IN ({}) UNION SELECT TRIM(PO_MRN) MRN FROM IDB.PHM_ORDER JOIN IDB.PHM_ORD_DTL ON PO_ORD_SEQ = POD_ORD_SEQ JOIN IDB.PHM_ORD_INV ON POD_ORD_SEQ = POI_ORD_SEQ AND POD_ITEM_NO = POI_ITEM_NO JOIN IDB.PHM_INVENTORY ON POI_INV_SEQ = PIN_INV_SEQ WHERE POD_STRT_DTE >= '2003-09-14' AND PO_ORD_STS NOT IN ('X', 'P') AND UCASE(PIN_GENERIC_NAME) LIKE '%CISPLATIN%' AND PIN_ATT_FLAG LIKE '%CHEMO%' AND UCASE(PIN_GENERIC_NAME) NOT LIKE '%PLACEBO%' AND PO_MRN IN ({}) ; SELECT DISTINCT TRIM(PT_MRN) MRN FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED" "t1" JOIN "DV"."PHM_ORDER_DTL" "t5" ON "t1"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t5"."POD_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" JOIN "DV"."PHM_INVENTORY_CATALOG" "t2" ON "t5"."POD_PHARMA_INVENTORY_CTLG_ID" = "t2"."PINC_INVENTORY_CTLG_ID" JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" ON "POD_START_DATE_ID" = "DT_DATE_ID" JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID WHERE UPPER("t2"."PINC_GENERIC_NAME") IN ('IFOSFAMIDE', 'IFOSFAMIDE/MESNA') AND PT_MRN IN ({}) ; SELECT PT_MRN MRN, "t5"."DT_DTE", CASE WHEN "t3"."POD_TOTAL_DOSE_UNIT" = 'GM' THEN "t3".POD_DOSE*1000 ELSE "t3".POD_DOSE END AS POD_DOSE_CONVERTED FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V" "t1" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED" "t5" ON "t1"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t5"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PHM_PT_MEDS_MQT" "t6" ON "t5"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t6"."POD_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PHM_ORDER_DTL" "t3" ON "t5"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t3"."POD_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AND "t6"."POD_PHARMA_INVENTORY_CTLG_ID" = "t3"."POD_PHARMA_INVENTORY_CTLG_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PHM_INVENTORY_CATALOG" "t2" ON "t3"."POD_PHARMA_INVENTORY_CTLG_ID" = "t2"."PINC_INVENTORY_CTLG_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" "t5" ON "t3"."POD_START_DATE_ID" = "t5"."DT_DATE_ID" WHERE UPPER("t2"."PINC_GENERIC_NAME") IN ('METHOTREXATE', 'METHOTREXATE INVEST', 'METHOTREXATE SODIUM', 'METHOTREXATE', 'METHOTREXATE SODIUM') AND ("t3"."POD_DOSE" >= 1000 OR ("t3"."POD_TOTAL_DOSE_UNIT" = 'GM' AND "t3"."POD_DOSE" >= 1)) AND "t5"."DT_DTE" <= '2012-12-31' AND PT_MRN IN ({}) ORDER BY 1, 2 ; WITH METHO AS (SELECT DISTINCT "t1"."PT_MRN" AS "MRN", "t5"."DT_DTE" FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V" "t1" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED" "t5" ON "t1"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t5"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PHM_PT_MEDS_MQT" "t6" ON "t5"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t6"."POD_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PHM_ORDER_DTL" "t3" ON "t6"."POD_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t3"."POD_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AND "t6"."POD_PHARMA_INVENTORY_CTLG_ID" = "t3"."POD_PHARMA_INVENTORY_CTLG_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PHM_INVENTORY_CATALOG" "t2" ON "t3"."POD_PHARMA_INVENTORY_CTLG_ID" = "t2"."PINC_INVENTORY_CTLG_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PHM_ORDER_ATTR" "t4" ON "t3"."POD_PHARMA_ORD_ATTR_ID" = "t4"."POA_PHARMA_ORDER_ATTR_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" "t5" ON "t3"."POD_START_DATE_ID" = "t5"."DT_DATE_ID" WHERE UPPER("t2"."PINC_GENERIC_NAME") IN ('METHOTREXATE', 'METHOTREXATE INVEST', 'METHOTREXATE SODIUM', 'METHOTREXATE', 'METHOTREXATE SODIUM') AND ("t3"."POD_DOSE" >= 1000 OR ("t3"."POD_TOTAL_DOSE_UNIT" = 'GM' AND "t3"."POD_DOSE" >= 1)) AND "t5"."DT_DTE" BETWEEN '2003-01-01' AND '2013-01-01' ) SELECT DISTINCT TRIM(LR_MRN) MRN, LR_RESULT_VALUE, LR_PERFORMED_DT, DT_DTE HD_MTX_DTE FROM METHO JOIN IDB.LAB_RESULTS ON LR_MRN = MRN AND LR_PERFORMED_DTE BETWEEN DT_DTE AND DT_DTE + 3 DAYS WHERE (LR_SUBTEST_NAME = 'Creatinine' OR LR_SUBTEST_NAME = 'Creatinine-' OR LR_SUBTEST_NAME = 'Creatinine.' OR LR_SUBTEST_NAME = 'Creatinine, Blood') AND LR_MRN IN ({}) ; SELECT DISTINCT TRIM(PT_MRN) MRN, TRIM(PT_SEX) PT_SEX, TRIM(AV_DESC) RACE FROM IDB.PATIENT LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS ON AV_ELEMENT='RACE' AND PT_RACE = AV_CODE WHERE PT_MRN IN ({}) ; SELECT DISTINCT TRIM(LR_MRN) MRN, TRIM(LR_RESULT_VALUE) LR_RESULT_VALUE, LR_PERFORMED_DT FROM IDB.LAB_RESULTS WHERE (LR_SUBTEST_NAME = 'Creatinine' OR LR_SUBTEST_NAME = 'Creatinine-' OR LR_SUBTEST_NAME = 'Creatinine.' OR LR_SUBTEST_NAME = 'Creatinine, Blood') AND LR_MRN IN ({}) ORDER BY 1, 3 ; SELECT TM_MRN, AV_DESC AS CASE_STS, TM_DX_DTE, TM_HIST_CD, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS HIST_DESC, TM_SITE_CD, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_DESC, IDB.SEERGROUPING.* FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.SEERGROUPING ON RECODE = IDB.SEERF_ICDO(TM_SITE_CD, TM_HIST_CD) JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS ON AV_ELEMENT = 'CASE_STS' AND AV_CODE = TM_CASE_STS AND TM_CASE_STS IN ('3', '6', '7', '8') AND TM_MRN IN ({}) ;

Patients with head and neck cancer treated with definitive cetuximab-radiation
completion: WITH CETUXIMAB_AND_RAD AS (SELECT CPO_MRN FROM IDB.CHEMO_PERFORMED_ORDERS JOIN IDB.RADONC_TREATMENT_COURSE ON CPO_MRN=RTC_TX_MRN WHERE UPPER(CPO_ORD_NAME) LIKE '%CETUXIMAB%' UNION SELECT OO_MRN CPO_MRN FROM IDB.OMS_ORDER WHERE UPPER(OO_ORD_NAME) LIKE '%CETUXIMAB%' ) SELECT PT_MRN, CASE_STS, TM_DX_DTE, TM_HIST_CD, HIST_DESC, TM_SITE_CD, SITE_DESC, MIN_ICD_EFF_DTE, ICD_CD, ICD_DESC FROM IDB.PATIENT JOIN CETUXIMAB_AND_RAD ON CPO_MRN=PT_MRN LEFT JOIN (SELECT TM_MRN, AV_DESC AS CASE_STS, TM_DX_DTE, TM_HIST_CD, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS HIST_DESC, TM_SITE_CD, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_DESC FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS ON AV_ELEMENT = 'CASE_STS' AND AV_CODE = TM_CASE_STS AND TM_CASE_STS IN ('3', '6', '7', '8') AND (TM_SITE_CD BETWEEN 'C320' AND 'C329' OR TM_SITE_CD BETWEEN 'C130' AND 'C139' OR TM_SITE_CD BETWEEN 'C100' AND 'C109')) AS CDB ON TM_MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN (SELECT CC_MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS MIN_ICD_EFF_DTE, CC_CLSF_CD AS ICD_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS ICD_DESC FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE (CC_CLSF_CD BETWEEN '161.0' AND '161.9' OR CC_CLSF_CD BETWEEN '148.0' AND '148.9' OR CC_CLSF_CD BETWEEN '146.0' AND '146.9' OR CC_CLSF_CD BETWEEN 'C32.0' AND 'C32.9' OR CC_CLSF_CD BETWEEN 'C13.0' AND 'C13.9' OR CC_CLSF_CD BETWEEN 'C09.9' AND 'C10.9') AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND (CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) GROUP BY CC_MRN, CC_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK ) AS ICD9 ON CC_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE COALESCE(TM_MRN, CC_MRN) IS NOT NULL ;

prompt: Daily (every 3 hours) vaccine admin count report for DOH.
completion: WITH Q AS (SELECT DATE(CEVE_ADMIN_DT) AS date, CEVE_MFG_NAME BRAND, CEVE_LOCATION_DESC LOCATION, CEVE_DOSE_NUM DOSE, SUM(CASE WHEN CEVE_COHORT like '%Patient%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS PATIENT_COUNT, SUM(CASE WHEN CEVE_COHORT like '%Empl%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS EMPLOYEE_COUNT, COUNT(*) TOTAL_COUNT FROM (SELECT CEVE_MRN, 'Employee' CEVE_COHORT, CEVE_ORDER_GUID, CEVE_PT_TYPE, CEVE_ADMIN_DT, CEVE_TASK_STATUS_CD, CEVE_ORDER_NAME, CEVE_DOSE_NUM, CEVE_MFG_NAME, CEVE_LOT, CEVE_LOT_EXP_DTE, CEVE_LOCATION_DESC FROM IDB.COVID19_EMPLOYEE_VACCINE_EMAR WHERE CEVE_PT_TYPE = 'Employee' UNION SELECT CPVE_MRN CEVE_MRN, 'Patient' CEVE_COHORT, CPVE_ORDER_GUID CEVE_ORDER_GUID, CPVE_PT_TYPE CEVE_PT_TYPE, CPVE_ADMIN_DT CEVE_ADMIN_DT, CPVE_TASK_STATUS_CD CEVE_TASK_STATUS_CD, CPVE_ORDER_NAME CEVE_ORDER_NAME, CPVE_DOSE_NUM CEVE_DOSE_NUM, CPVE_MFG_NAME CEVE_MFG_NAME, CPVE_LOT CEVE_LOT, CPVE_LOT_EXP_DTE CEVE_LOT_EXP_DTE, CPVE_LOCATION_DESC CEVE_LOCATION_DESC FROM IDB.COVID19_PATIENT_CP_VACCINE_EMAR) WHERE DATE(CEVE_ADMIN_DT) = CURRENT date AND CEVE_TASK_STATUS_CD = 'Performed' GROUP BY DATE(CEVE_ADMIN_DT), CEVE_LOCATION_DESC, CEVE_MFG_NAME, CEVE_DOSE_NUM) SELECT CAST(date AS CHAR(10)) date, BRAND, RIGHT(DOSE, 1) DOSE, LOCATION, PATIENT_COUNT, EMPLOYEE_COUNT, TOTAL_COUNT FROM Q

completion: SELECT PT_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, PBD_SVC_DTE AS SLNB_DATE, ICDO_HIST_CODE, ICDO_HIST_DESC, ICDO_SITE_CODE, ICDO_SITE_DESC, SURG_DATE, RAD_START_DATE, ICDO_DX_DATE, ICD9_CODE, ICD9_DESC, ICD9_EFF_DATE FROM (SELECT * FROM (SELECT TM_MRN, TM_HIST_CD AS ICDO_HIST_CODE, CLM1.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS ICDO_HIST_DESC, TM_SITE_CD AS ICDO_SITE_CODE, CLM2.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS ICDO_SITE_DESC, TM_CA_SURG_DTE AS SURG_DATE, TM_RAD_STRT_DTE AS RAD_START_DATE, TM_DX_DTE AS ICDO_DX_DATE FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM CLM1 ON TM_HIST_CD = CLM1.CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.CLM CLM2 ON TM_SITE_CD = CLM2.CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE TM_HIST_CD IN ('M8720/2' ,'M8720/3' ,'M8721/3' ,'M8722/2' ,'M8722/3' ,'M8723/2' ,'M8723/3' ,'M8728/3' ,'M8730/3' ,'M8740/3' ,'M8741/2' ,'M8741/3' ,'M8742/2' ,'M8742/3' ,'M8743/2' ,'M8743/3' ,'M8744/2' ,'M8744/3' ,'M8745/3' ,'M8746/3' ,'M8761/3' ,'M8770/3' ,'M8771/3' ,'M8772/2' ,'M8772/3' ,'M8773/3' ,'M8774/3' ,'M8775/3' ,'M8780/3') AND TM_DX_DTE BETWEEN '1980-01-01' AND '2009-02-28') AS A FULL JOIN (SELECT CC_MRN, CC_CLSF_CD AS ICD9_CODE, CLM3.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS ICD9_DESC, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS ICD9_EFF_DATE FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM CLM3 ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM3.CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE CC_CLSF_CD IN ('172' ,'172.0' ,'172.1' ,'172.2' ,'172.3' ,'172.4' ,'172.5' ,'172.6' ,'172.7' ,'172.8' ,'172.9') AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND (CC_CIC_CDR_INITLS <> '' OR SUBSTR(CC_ACCT_NO, 1, 2) IN ('00', '84')) AND CC_EFF_DTE BETWEEN '1985-07-01' AND '2009-02-28' GROUP BY CC_MRN, CC_CLSF_CD, CLM3.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK) AS B ON TM_MRN = CC_MRN) AS X JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PT_MRN = COALESCE(TM_MRN, CC_MRN) JOIN IDB.PBD_DTL ON PT_MRN = PBD_MRN AND PBD_SVC_DTE BETWEEN '1993-10-01' AND '2009-02-28' JOIN IDB.PBD_CODE ON PBD_PBD_CD = PBC_PBD_CD AND PBC_CPT_CD = '38792' JOIN IDB.PBD_INVOICE ON PBD_INV_NO = PBI_INV_NO JOIN IDB.DOC ON PBI_PERFORM_DR_NO = DOC_DR_NO AND DOC_SVC = 'HNS'

AC_MRN AND ACD_IRB_NO = AC_IRB_NO AND AC_IRB_NO = '12-245') , DMP AS (SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN AS DMP_MRN , MAINRPT.DT_DTE AS "Report Date" , PRPT_ACCESSION_NO , PDWS_NAME , T.* , PDRX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V MAINPATH ON MAINPATH.PRPT_PATH_RPT_ID = PDRX_PATH_RPT_ID JOIN DV.DATE_V MAINRPT ON MAINRPT.DT_DATE_ID = MAINPATH.PRPT_REPORT_DATE_ID, XMLTABLE('$c/root/*' PASSING PDRX_XML_VALUE AS "c" COLUMNS CNV_TYPE VARCHAR(500) PATH 'name()', VARIANT_CLASS VARCHAR(100) PATH 'variant_class', DT_PROCEDURE VARCHAR(100) PATH '../meta-data/dt_procedure', SAMPLEID VARCHAR(100) PATH '../meta-data/dmp_sample_id', PATIENTID VARCHAR(100) PATH '../meta-data/dmp_patient_id', PRIMARY_SITE VARCHAR(100) PATH prompt: Provide monthly transfers of pediatric patient in and out of the facility.
completion: SELECT DISTINCT OUO_ORD_NAME AS ORDER_NAME, OUO_MRN AS MRN, OUO_CURR_LOC AS LOCATION, OUO_ORD_ID AS ORDERID, OUO_PVDR_NAME AS REQUESTING_PROVIDER, OUO_USER_NAME AS ENTEREDBY, OUO_USER_ROLE_TYPE AS ENTERROLE, OUO_ENTER_DTE AS ENTERED_DTE, OUO_STS_DESC AS STATUS, A.OUD_USER_DI_CD, A.OUD_USER_DI_VALUE AS PED_PACC_ADMISSION_TYPE, B.OUD_USER_DI_VALUE AS ADMISSION_REASON, YEAR (CURRENT DATE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) AS CURRENT_AGE FROM IDB.OMS_USER_ORDERS LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_USER_DATA A ON OUO_ORD_GUID = A.OUD_ORD_GUID AND A.OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'PED_PACC_Admission Type' AND A.OUD_USER_DI_VALUE = 'Hospital to Hospital Transfer' LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_USER_DATA B ON OUO_ORD_GUID = B.OUD_ORD_GUID AND B.OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'ICDx Pert Signs - Ped' JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON OUO_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE 1=1 AND OUO_ENTER_DTE BETWEEN LAST_DAY(CURRENT DATE - 2 MONTH) + 1 DAY AND LAST_DAY(CURRENT DATE - 1 MONTH) AND OUO_ORD_NAME = 'External Transfer to MSK' AND YEAR (CURRENT DATE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) < 18

prompt: Identify all IV medication orders written in any location by the month of the year.   Ability to create an output field which indicates "order start month" on the report.
completion: SELECT PT_MRN, RTRIM(PT_LAST_NAME)||','||RTRIM(PT_FIRST_NAME) AS PT_NAME, PT_WT_KG, PT_HT_CM, PT_BSA, YEAR(POD_STRT_DTE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) AGE, PO_RX_NO AS RX_NO, PIN_GENERIC_NAME, PIN_MNEMONIC, POD_ITEM_DESC AS DRUG_NAME, PO_DIRECTIONS, PO_INFUSE_OVER_TXT, POD_STRT_DTE AS START_DATE, POI_DOSE AS DOSE, POI_DOSE_UNIT AS DOSE_UNIT, INT(MAX(POI_NET_PT_DOSE, 1)) AS DISENSES, PO_DR_NAME AS DR_NAME, POD_SCH_CD FREQUENCY, PO_ROUTE_ABBR AS ROUTE, PO_DISP_LOC_NAME AS LOCATION, CASE WHEN PO_ACCT_NO LIKE '84%' THEN 'Inpatient' ELSE 'Outpatient' END AS RX_TYPE, PO_LAST_FILL_DTE, PO_IV_VOL, PO_IV_VOL_UNIT, PO_IV_FLOW_RATE, POI_CALC_HT_CM, POI_CALC_WT_KG, POI_CALC_BSA, POI_VOLUME, POI_VOLUME_UNIT, POI_CALC_DOSE_INFO, POI_CHEMO_RPT_DOSE, POI_DAILY_DOSE_TXT, SUBSTR(CHAR(POD_STRT_DTE), 1, 7) RPT_MONTH FROM IDB.PHM_ORDER JOIN IDB.PHM_ORD_DTL ON PO_ORD_SEQ = POD_ORD_SEQ JOIN IDB.PHM_ORD_INV ON POD_ITEM_NO = POI_ITEM_NO AND POD_ORD_SEQ = POI_ORD_SEQ JOIN IDB.PHM_INVENTORY ON POI_INV_SEQ = PIN_INV_SEQ LEFT JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PT_MRN = PO_MRN WHERE POD_STRT_DTE BETWEEN LAST_DAY(CURRENT DATE - 2 MONTH) + 1 DAY AND LAST_DAY(CURRENT DATE - 1 MONTH) AND PO_ORD_STS NOT IN ('X', 'P') AND POD_ATT_FLAG NOT LIKE '%IVVEH%' AND PO_ROUTE_ABBR LIKE 'IV%' AND PO_ROUTE_ABBR NOT IN ('IV PUSH', 'IVCATHINST') AND PO_CARE_CLASS <> 'AMB'
