prompt: Provide HCT-CI score and Social Support rating for adult ALLO stem cell transplants between 1/1/2018 and 12/31/2019.
completion: WITH PT AS (SELECT PT_MRN FROM IDB.PATIENT WHERE PT_MRN IN () ) , X AS (SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH AS DOB, PT_SEX AS GENDER, R.AV_DESC AS "Race", E.AV_DESC AS "Ethnicity" FROM IDB.PATIENT LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS R ON PT_RACE = R.AV_CODE AND R.AV_ELEMENT = 'RACE' LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS E ON PT_PT_ETHNICITY = E.AV_CODE AND E.AV_ELEMENT = 'PT_ETHNICITY' WHERE PT_MRN IN (SELECT PT_MRN FROM PT) ) , CD AS (SELECT DISTINCT CDD_MRN, CDD_SERVICE_DTE, CDD_DOC_NAME, STRIP(SUBSTR(CDO_VALUE_TEXT, 1, 200)) AS "Total Score" FROM X JOIN IDB.CD_DOCUMENT ON CDD_MRN = PT_MRN AND CDD_CANCEL_IND = '0' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND = '0' AND CDD_SERVICE_DTE BETWEEN '2018-01-01' AND '2019-12-31' AND CDD_DOC_NAME = 'Hematopoietic Cell Transplant Co-Morbidity Index - BMT' JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION ON CDO_DOC_GUID = CDD_DOC_GUID AND CDO_AUTHORED_DTE = CDD_AUTHORED_DTE AND CDO_MSTR_ITEM_NM = 'BMT_HCT_Total Score CALC' AND CDO_VALUE_TEXT <> '') SELECT DISTINCT X.*, CDD_SERVICE_DTE, CDD_DOC_NAME, "Total Score" FROM X LEFT JOIN CD ON PT_MRN = CDD_MRN

prompt: Identify all GBM patients diagnosed between 1998 and 2011 and treated here, provide their diagnosis date and death date (if applicable), and indicate if they received temozolomide and/or bevacizumab.
completion: WITH CTE AS (SELECT "t1"."PT_MRN" AS "MRN", "t1"."PT_LAST_NAME" AS "Last Name", "t1"."PT_FIRST_NAME" AS "First Name", "t1"."PT_SEX" AS "Gender", "t1"."PT_BIRTH_DTE" AS "Date of Birth", "t1"."PT_DEATH_DTE" AS "Deceased Date", "t2"."DT_DTE" AS "CDB Tumor Diagnosis Date", "t3"."TCA_CLASS_OF_CASE" AS "Class of Case", "t4"."DXCC_ICD_CODE" AS "ICD-O Histology Code", "t4"."DXCC_ICD_MSK_DESC" AS "ICD-O Histology Desc", "t5"."ICSC_SITE_CD" AS "ICD-O Site Code", "t5"."ICSC_ICDO_SITE_MSK_DESC" AS "ICD-O Site Desc", "t6"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AS "Deident PT #" FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED" "t6" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V" "t1" ON "t6"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t1"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."CDB_TUMOR_V" "t7" ON "t6"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t7"."CDTM_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE" "t2" ON "t7"."CDTM_DX_DATE_ID" = "t2"."DT_DATE_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."TUMOR_CASE_ATTRIBUTES" "t3" ON "t7"."CDTM_CASE_ATTR_ID" = "t3"."TUMOR_CASE_ATTR_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DIAGNOSIS_CODE_CAT_ICDO_V" "t4" ON "t7"."CDTM_DX_CATALOG_ID" = "t4"."DXCC_DX_CATALOG_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."ICDO_SITE_CATALOG_V" "t5" ON "t7"."CDTM_SITE_CATALOG_ID" = "t5"."ICSC_SITE_CATALOG_ID" WHERE ("t3"."TCA_CASE_STS_DESC" IN ('Completed ') AND ("t3"."TCA_CLASS_OF_CASE" IN ('Dx elsewhere tx here ', 'Dx elsewhere Tx here ', 'Dx here tx here ') AND ("t4"."DXCC_ICD_CODE" IN ('M9440/3') AND "t2"."DT_DTE" BETWEEN '1998-1-1' AND '2011-12-31'))) ), CTE2 AS (SELECT "t1"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AS "Drug Deid", MAX(CASE WHEN "t2"."PINC_GENERIC_NAME" IN ('BEVACIZUMAB', 'BEVACIZUmab ') THEN "t3"."DT_DTE" ELSE NULL END) AS "Bevacizumab First Order Start Date", MAX(CASE WHEN "t2"."PINC_GENERIC_NAME" IN ('TEMOZOLOMIDE', 'Temozolomide ') THEN "t3"."DT_DTE" ELSE NULL END) AS "Temozolomide First Order Start Date" FROM CTE JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED" "t1" ON "Deident PT #" = "t1"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PHM_PT_MEDS_MQT" "t4" ON "t1"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t4"."POD_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PHM_INVENTORY_CATALOG" "t2" ON "t4"."POD_PHARMA_INVENTORY_CTLG_ID" = "t2"."PINC_INVENTORY_CTLG_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE" "t3" ON "t4"."FIST_START_DATE_ID" = "t3"."DT_DATE_ID" WHERE "t2"."PINC_GENERIC_NAME" IN ('BEVACIZUMAB', 'BEVACIZUmab ', 'TEMOZOLOMIDE', 'Temozolomide ') GROUP BY "t1"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID") SELECT "MRN", "Last Name", "First Name", "Gender", "Date of Birth", "Deceased Date", "CDB Tumor Diagnosis Date", "Class of Case", "ICD-O Histology Code", "ICD-O Histology Desc", "ICD-O Site Code", "ICD-O Site Desc", "Bevacizumab First Order Start Date", "Temozolomide First Order Start Date" FROM CTE LEFT JOIN CTE2 ON "Deident PT #" = "Drug Deid"

prompt: Provide monthly report on 'Rehabilitation Medicine Clinic Consult' order and list of entered orders since 1/1/2013 similar to NEU8287
completion: SELECT OO_MRN MRN, OO_ACCT_NO ACCT_NO, STRIP(PT_LAST_NAME)||', '||STRIP(PT_FIRST_NAME) PT_NAME, OO_ENTER_DTE ENTER_DTE, OO_ORD_STS_CD STS_CD, OO_ORD_ID ORDID, OO_ORD_NAME ORDNAME , CA.OUD_USER_DI_VALUE AS CA_DX, LAST_DAY(CURRENT DATE - 2 MONTH) + 1 DAY AS START_DTE, LAST_DAY(CURRENT DATE - 1 MONTH) AS END_DTE, OP_DISPLAY_NAME REFERRED_BY, DOC_SVC, AV_DESC, OS_SVC_GRP_CD SVC_GRP, OS_SVC_DESC SERVICE_DESC FROM IDB.OMS_ORDER JOIN IDB.OMS_CLIENT_VISIT ON OO_VISIT_GUID = OCV_VISIT_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_SERVICE ON OCV_SVC_GUID = OS_SVC_GUID JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON OO_MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_USER_DATA CA ON OO_ORD_GUID = CA.OUD_ORD_GUID AND CA.OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'Consult_Rehab Cancer Dx' JOIN IDB.OMS_PROVIDER ON OO_PVDR_GUID = OP_PVDR_GUID JOIN IDB.DOC ON OP_PVDR_NO = DOC_DR_NO JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS ON DOC_SVC = AV_CODE AND AV_ELEMENT = 'SVC' AND AV_CD_STS = 'A' WHERE OO_ENTER_DTE >= LAST_DAY(CURRENT DATE - 2 MONTH) + 1 DAY AND OO_ENTER_DTE <= LAST_DAY(CURRENT DATE - 1 MONTH) AND OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID = '4000001040073001' AND OO_ORD_STS_CD NOT IN ('CANC', 'CANP', 'AUC3', 'HOLD')

prompt: Create a weekly Darwin Cohort notification of Chondrosarcoma patients with an IDH1 mutation.
completion: WITH CTE1 AS (SELECT PRPT_MRN, PRPT_PROCEDURE_DTE, PRPT_REPORT_DTE, PRPT_REPORT_TYPE_DESC, PRPT_ACCESSION_NO, PRPT_REPORT FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V WHERE PRPT_REPORT IS NOT NULL AND CONTAINS("PRPT_REPORT", '("GRADE 2" | "GRADE 3" | "INTERMEDIATE GRADE" | "HIGH GRADE") & "CHONDROSARCOMA"') = 1 ) , CTE2 AS (SELECT PT_MRN FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_STRUCTURED_RESULTS_V WHERE 1=1 AND METHOD like 'IMPACT%' AND (GENE = 'IDH1' OR GENE2 = 'IDH1') ) , CTE3 AS (SELECT DISTINCT A.PRPT_MRN , PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID FROM CTE1 A JOIN CTE2 B ON A.PRPT_MRN = B.PT_MRN JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS C ON A.PRPT_MRN = C.PT_MRN WHERE 1=1 AND PT_VITAL_STATUS = 'ALIVE' AND YEAR(CURRENT date - PT_BIRTH_DTE) >= 18 ) , DEID AS (SELECT DISTINCT PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID AS P_ID FROM CTE3)

prompt: Provide pathology data for H-/S- cases with "mucocutaneous ulcer" OR "post-transplant lymphoproliferative disorder" OR "post transplant lymphoproliferative disorder" OR "PTLD" in the report text from 01/01/2016 to present.
completion: SELECT DISTINCT DMP.PRPT_MRN AS MRN , PT_BIRTH_DTE, PT_VITAL_STATUS, PT_DEATH_DTE , CASE WHEN PT_DEATH_DTE IS NULL THEN YEAR(CURRENT date - PT_BIRTH_DTE) END AS "Current Age" , DMP.PRPT_ACCESSION_NO AS "Accession No" , DMP.PRPT_REPORT_DTE AS "Report Date" , DMP.PRPT_PROCEDURE_DTE AS "Procedure Date" , DMP.PRPT_REPORT_TYPE_DESC AS "Report Type" , DMP.PRPT_REPORT_TYPE , DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)diag[\w\W]*(?=I ATTEST)', DMP.PRPT_REPORT) AS DIAGNOSIS_TEXT , VARCHAR(DMP.PRPT_REPORT, 32000) AS "Report Text (first 32000 characters)" , SRG.PRPT_ACCESSION_NO AS RELATED_ACC_NO , SRG_DATE.DT_DTE AS RELATED_PROC_DTE , (SELECT VARCHAR(PRPT_REPORT, 32000) AS REFERENCEDPATHTEXTFROM FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT WHERE PRPT_ACCESSION_NO = SRG.PRPT_ACCESSION_NO) AS REFERENCEDPATHTEXT FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V DMP LEFT JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_REFERENCES ON PRPTR_CHILD_PATH_RPT_ID = DMP.PRPT_PATH_RPT_ID LEFT JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT SRG ON SRG.PRPT_PATH_RPT_ID = PRPTR_PATH_RPT_ID LEFT JOIN DV.DATE_V SRG_DATE ON SRG_DATE.DT_DATE_ID = SRG.PRPT_PROCEDURE_DATE_ID JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = DMP.PRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID WHERE 1=1 AND (DMP.PRPT_ACCESSION_NO like 'H%' OR DMP.PRPT_ACCESSION_NO like 'S%') AND (DMP.PRPT_REPORT_DTE >= '01/01/2016' OR DMP.PRPT_PROCEDURE_DTE >= '01/01/2016' ) AND CONTAINS(DMP.PRPT_REPORT, '("mucocutaneous ulcer" OR "post-transplant lymphoproliferative disorder" OR "post transplant lymphoproliferative disorder" OR "PTLD")') = 1 AND DMP.PRPT_REPORT IS NOT NULL ORDER BY 1, 9, 8 ;

prompt: Patients scheduled for follow up with Sheila Kenny
completion: WITH BMT AS (SELECT PT_MRN BMT_MRN, MAX(TRANSPLANT_DATE) TRANSPLANT_DATE FROM NN.CRDB_BMT_MEDICINE WHERE TRANSPLANT_TYPE = 'AUTO' GROUP BY PT_MRN ) SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN AS "MRN", PT_LAST_NAME "Last Name", PT_FIRST_NAME "First Name", PT_STATE "State", CPE_ENC_DTE AS "Appt Date", CLD_DEPT_NAME AS "Department Name", CRE_RES_NAME AS "Provider Name", CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME AS "Visit Type", CASE WHEN CPP_PP_LST_LGN_DTE IS NOT NULL THEN 'Y' ELSE '' END "Portal User", TRANSPLANT_DATE "Transplant Date" FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON CPE_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_PAS_PATIENT ON CPE_CL_PT_ID = CPP_CL_PT_ID LEFT JOIN BMT ON CPE_MRN = BMT_MRN WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Sch') AND CPE_ENC_DTE >= '2019-05-13' AND CRE_RES_NAME = 'KENNY, SHEILA A' AND CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME = 'BMTMED SAPP FR'

prompt: Provide a weekly listing of MTAP positive mesothelioma patients.
completion: WITH DMP_GENES AS (SELECT DISTINCT PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID AS DMP_PID, PT_MRN AS DMP_MRN, PRPT_PATH_RPT_ID AS DMP_RID, ABERRATIONTYPE, FOLD_CHANGE , GENE, GENE2 FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_STRUCTURED_RESULTS_V WHERE 1=1 AND (GENE = 'MTAP' OR GENE2 = 'MTAP' ) ) , DMP_DX_PRE AS (SELECT DISTINCT PDRX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID AS P_ID, T.*, DT.PDRX_PATH_RPT_ID, PT_VITAL_STATUS, PT_MRN AS MRN , GENE, GENE2 , DMP_RID, DMP_PID , ABERRATIONTYPE FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML DT JOIN DMP_GENES ON DMP_RID = DT.PDRX_PATH_RPT_ID CROSS JOIN XMLTABLE('$c/root/*' PASSING DT.PDRX_XML_VALUE AS "c" COLUMNS PRIMARY_SITE VARCHAR(100) PATH 'fn:string-join(../meta-data/primary_site,",")' , TUMOR_TYPE_NAME VARCHAR(100) PATH 'fn:string-join(../meta-data/tumor_type_name,",")' , TUMOR_TYPE_CODE VARCHAR(100) PATH 'fn:string-join(../meta-data/tumor_type_code,",")' , M_ACCESSION_NUM VARCHAR(100) PATH 'fn:string-join(../meta-data/m_accession_num,",")' , GENE_PANEL VARCHAR(100) PATH 'fn:string-join(../meta-data/gene_panel,",")') T JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PDRX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID WHERE 1=1 AND UPPER(TUMOR_TYPE_NAME) like '%MESOTHEL%' AND PT_VITAL_STATUS = 'ALIVE' ) , DEID AS (SELECT * FROM DMP_DX_PRE WHERE 1=1 ) , DT AS (SELECT DISTINCT MRN , P_ID AS PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID FROM DEID) , SCANS AS (SELECT DISTINCT "t1"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AS PID_SCAN, CAST(RTRIM("t3"."ENVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME") AS VARCHAR(1000)) AS "Visit Type Name", CAST(RTRIM("t7"."ENR_RES_NAME") AS VARCHAR(1000)) AS "Primary Resource Name", "t6"."DT_DTE" AS "Encounter Date" FROM DT "t1" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_ENCOUNTER" "t11" ON "t1"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t11"."PENC_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN (SELECT EDC_DEPT_ABBREV, EDC_DEPT_DESC FROM DV.ENCOUNTER_DESC_CATALOG WHERE EDC_GROUP_ID = 'STS') "t2" ON "t11"."PENC_APPT_STS" = "t2"."EDC_DEPT_ABBREV" LEFT JOIN "DV"."ENCOUNTER_VISIT_TYPE" "t3" ON "t11"."PENC_VISIT_TYPE_ID" = "t3"."ENVT_ENC_VISIT_TYPE_ID" LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM DV.ENCOUNTER_SCHD_RESOURCES WHERE ENSR_PRIMARY_RES_IND = 'Y' ) "t12" ON "t11"."PENC_PT_ENC_ID" = "t12"."ENSR_PT_ENC_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."ENCOUNTER_RESOURCE" "t7" ON "t12"."ENSR_RES_ID" = "t7"."ENR_ENC_RES_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" "t6" ON "t11"."PENC_ENC_DATE_ID" = "t6"."DT_DATE_ID" WHERE CASE WHEN "t2"."EDC_DEPT_DESC"IN ('Arrived', 'Completed') THEN 'Completed' WHEN "t2"."EDC_DEPT_DESC" IN ('Scheduled') THEN 'Scheduled' ELSE 'Non-Completed/Scheduled' END = 'Scheduled' AND "t6"."DT_DTE" BETWEEN CURRENT date AND CURRENT date + 8 DAY AND ("t3"."ENVT_EXT_NAME" like 'CT%' OR "t3"."ENVT_EXT_NAME" like 'MR%' OR "t3"."ENVT_EXT_NAME" like 'PET%') ) , SCANX AS (SELECT PID_SCAN, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY PID_SCAN) RN_SCAN, CAST("Encounter Date" AS VARCHAR(250)) || ' | ' || "Primary Resource Name" || ' | ' || "Visit Type Name" AS SCAN_D FROM SCANS ORDER BY PID_SCAN, "Encounter Date", "Primary Resource Name" ASC) , SCAN (PID_SCAN, RN_SCAN, SCAN_DS) AS (SELECT SCANX.PID_SCAN, SCANX.RN_SCAN, SCANX.SCAN_D FROM SCANX WHERE RN_SCAN = 1 UNION ALL SELECT T1.PID_SCAN, T1.RN_SCAN, SCAN_DS || CHR(13) || CHR(10) || SCAN_D FROM SCAN T0, SCANX T1 WHERE T0.PID_SCAN = T1.PID_SCAN AND T0.RN_SCAN + 1 = T1.RN_SCAN AND T1.RN_SCAN < 1000 ) , SCAN_MX AS (SELECT PID_SCAN, MAX(RN_SCAN) MX FROM SCANX GROUP BY PID_SCAN), SCAN_FIN AS (SELECT F.* FROM SCAN F INNER JOIN SCAN_MX M ON F.PID_SCAN = M.PID_SCAN AND F.RN_SCAN = M.MX) , SCANS_RECENT AS (SELECT DISTINCT "t1"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AS PID_SCAN, CAST(RTRIM("t3"."ENVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME") AS VARCHAR(1000)) AS "Visit Type Name", CAST(RTRIM("t7"."ENR_RES_NAME") AS VARCHAR(1000)) AS "Primary Resource Name", "t6"."DT_DTE" AS "Encounter Date" FROM DT "t1" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_ENCOUNTER" "t11" ON "t1"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t11"."PENC_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN (SELECT EDC_DEPT_ABBREV, EDC_DEPT_DESC FROM DV.ENCOUNTER_DESC_CATALOG WHERE EDC_GROUP_ID = 'STS') "t2" ON "t11"."PENC_APPT_STS" = "t2"."EDC_DEPT_ABBREV" LEFT JOIN "DV"."ENCOUNTER_VISIT_TYPE" "t3" ON "t11"."PENC_VISIT_TYPE_ID" = "t3"."ENVT_ENC_VISIT_TYPE_ID" LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM DV.ENCOUNTER_SCHD_RESOURCES WHERE ENSR_PRIMARY_RES_IND = 'Y' ) "t12" ON "t11"."PENC_PT_ENC_ID" = "t12"."ENSR_PT_ENC_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."ENCOUNTER_RESOURCE" "t7" ON "t12"."ENSR_RES_ID" = "t7"."ENR_ENC_RES_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" "t6" ON "t11"."PENC_ENC_DATE_ID" = "t6"."DT_DATE_ID" WHERE CASE WHEN "t2"."EDC_DEPT_DESC"IN ('Arrived', 'Completed') THEN 'Completed' WHEN "t2"."EDC_DEPT_DESC" IN ('Scheduled') THEN 'Scheduled' ELSE 'Non-Completed/Scheduled' END <> 'Scheduled' AND "t6"."DT_DTE" BETWEEN CURRENT date - 7 DAY AND CURRENT date - 1 DAY AND ("t3"."ENVT_EXT_NAME" like 'CT%' OR "t3"."ENVT_EXT_NAME" like 'MR%' OR "t3"."ENVT_EXT_NAME" like 'PET%') ) , SCANX_RECENT AS (SELECT PID_SCAN, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY PID_SCAN) RN_SCAN, CAST("Encounter Date" AS VARCHAR(250)) || ' | ' || "Primary Resource Name" || ' | ' || "Visit Type Name" AS SCAN_D FROM SCANS_RECENT ORDER BY PID_SCAN, "Encounter Date", "Primary Resource Name" ASC) , SCAN_RECENT (PID_SCAN, RN_SCAN, SCAN_DS) AS (SELECT SCANX_RECENT.PID_SCAN, SCANX_RECENT.RN_SCAN, SCANX_RECENT.SCAN_D FROM SCANX_RECENT WHERE RN_SCAN = 1 UNION ALL SELECT T1.PID_SCAN, T1.RN_SCAN, SCAN_DS || CHR(13) || CHR(10) || SCAN_D FROM SCAN_RECENT T0, SCANX_RECENT T1 WHERE T0.PID_SCAN = T1.PID_SCAN AND T0.RN_SCAN + 1 = T1.RN_SCAN AND T1.RN_SCAN < 1000 ) , SCAN_MX_RECENT AS (SELECT PID_SCAN, MAX(RN_SCAN) MX FROM SCANX_RECENT GROUP BY PID_SCAN), SCAN_FIN_RECENT AS (SELECT F.* FROM SCAN_RECENT F INNER JOIN SCAN_MX_RECENT M ON F.PID_SCAN = M.PID_SCAN AND F.RN_SCAN = M.MX) SELECT DISTINCT "t1"."PT_MRN" AS "MRN", "t1"."PT_LAST_NAME" AS "Last Name", "t1"."PT_FIRST_NAME" AS "First Name", "t1"."PT_BIRTH_DTE" AS "Date of Birth", CASE WHEN "t1"."PT_DEATH_DTE" IS NULL THEN YEAR(CURRENT date - "t1"."PT_BIRTH_DTE") END AS "Cur Age", "t1"."PT_VITAL_STATUS" AS "Vital Status", "t1"."PT_SEX_DESC" AS "Gender", "t1"."PT_RACE_DESC" AS "Race", "t2"."CORE_ETHNICITY_DESC" AS "Ethnicity" , SCAN_FIN.SCAN_DS "Upcoming Scans" , SCAN_FIN_RECENT.SCAN_DS "Past Scans" FROM DT DT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V" "t1" ON "t1"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = DT.PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID LEFT JOIN SCAN_FIN ON DT.PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = SCAN_FIN.PID_SCAN LEFT JOIN SCAN_FIN_RECENT ON DT.PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = SCAN_FIN_RECENT.PID_SCAN LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_CORE_DEMOGRAPHICS" "t2" ON "t1"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t2"."CORE_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_LATEST_ACTIVITY" "t3" ON "t1"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t3"."PLA_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" WHERE 1=1 ORDER BY "t1"."PT_MRN" ;

prompt: Provide a list of patients who underwent a total pancreatectomy in the last 4 years
completion: WITH PROC AS (SELECT DISTINCT PBD_MRN AS MRN, PBC_CPT_CD AS PROC_CD FROM IDB.PBD_DTL JOIN IDB.PBD_CODE ON PBD_PBD_CD = PBC_PBD_CD WHERE PBC_CPT_CD IN ('48146', '48152', '48153', '48154', '48155', '48160') AND PBD_SVC_DTE BETWEEN '2017-07-01' AND CURRENT date ), BILL AS (SELECT DISTINCT SSE_MRN AS MRN, SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD AS PROC_CD FROM IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE ON SSE_LOG_ID = SSP_LOG_ID AND SSE_ENC_CSN_ID = SSP_ENC_CSN_ID WHERE (SSE_SURG_LOC not like '%IR%' AND SSE_SURG_LOC not like '%ENDO%' AND SSE_SOURCE_TYPE <> 'E') AND SSE_SURG_DTE BETWEEN '2017-07-01' AND CURRENT date AND SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD IN ('48146', '48152', '48153', '48154', '48155', '48160') ), PROC_BILL AS (SELECT MRN, PROC_CD FROM BILL UNION SELECT MRN, PROC_CD FROM PROC) SELECT DISTINCT MRN FROM PROC_BILL WHERE PROC_CD NOT IN ('48155'); WITH PROC AS (SELECT DISTINCT PBD_MRN AS MRN, PBC_CPT_CD AS PROC_CD FROM IDB.PBD_DTL JOIN IDB.PBD_CODE ON PBD_PBD_CD = PBC_PBD_CD WHERE PBC_CPT_CD IN ('48146', '48152', '48153', '48154', '48155', '48160') AND PBD_SVC_DTE BETWEEN '2017-07-01' AND CURRENT date ), BILL AS (SELECT DISTINCT SSE_MRN AS MRN, SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD AS PROC_CD FROM IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE ON SSE_LOG_ID = SSP_LOG_ID AND SSE_ENC_CSN_ID = SSP_ENC_CSN_ID WHERE (SSE_SURG_LOC not like '%IR%' AND SSE_SURG_LOC not like '%ENDO%' AND SSE_SOURCE_TYPE <> 'E') AND SSE_SURG_DTE BETWEEN '2017-07-01' AND CURRENT date AND SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD IN ('48146', '48152', '48153', '48154', '48155', '48160') ), PROC_BILL AS (SELECT MRN, PROC_CD FROM BILL UNION SELECT MRN, PROC_CD FROM PROC) SELECT DISTINCT MRN FROM PROC_BILL WHERE PROC_CD IN ('48155') ;

prompt: Provide a bi-weekly list of patients who are receiving trastuzumab (H) and pertuzumab (P) or phesgo
completion: WITH X AS (SELECT DISTINCT STRIP(APR_MRN) AS MRN, STRIP(PT_LAST_NAME) || ', ' || STRIP(PT_FIRST_NAME) AS NAME, CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME AS GENERIC_NAME, APR_START_DTE AS START_DATE, APR_END_DTE AS END_DATE, APR_LOCATION AS LOCATION, APR_PROVIDER_NAME AS PROVIDER, APR_DOC_SVC AS DOC_SVC FROM IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX_V JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON APR_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE 1=1 AND(UPPER(CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME) like '%PERTUZUMAB%' OR UPPER(CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME) = 'HYALURONIDASE/PERTUZUMAB/TRASTUZUMAB') AND APR_START_DTE >= '2021-04-01' ) , Y AS (SELECT DISTINCT STRIP(APR_MRN) AS MRN, STRIP(PT_LAST_NAME) || ', ' || STRIP(PT_FIRST_NAME) AS NAME, CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME AS GENERIC_NAME, APR_START_DTE AS START_DATE, APR_END_DTE AS END_DATE, APR_LOCATION AS LOCATION, APR_PROVIDER_NAME AS PROVIDER, APR_DOC_SVC AS DOC_SVC FROM X JOIN IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX_V ON APR_MRN = MRN AND APR_START_DTE = START_DATE JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON APR_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE 1=1 AND UPPER(CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME) = 'TRASTUZUMAB' AND APR_START_DTE >= '2021-04-01' ) , Z AS (SELECT X.* FROM X UNION SELECT * FROM Y) , T0 AS (SELECT MRN, LISTAGG(COALESCE(STRIP(GENERIC_NAME), '') , CHR(13) || CHR(10)) WITHIN GROUP( ORDER BY MRN, GENERIC_NAME) AS GENERIC_NAME FROM (SELECT DISTINCT MRN, GENERIC_NAME FROM Z) T GROUP BY MRN) , T1 AS (SELECT MRN, LISTAGG(COALESCE(STRIP(LOCATION), '') , CHR(13) || CHR(10)) WITHIN GROUP( ORDER BY MRN, LOCATION) AS LOCATION FROM (SELECT DISTINCT MRN, LOCATION FROM Z) T GROUP BY MRN) , T2 AS (SELECT MRN, LISTAGG(COALESCE(STRIP(PROVIDER), '') , CHR(13) || CHR(10)) WITHIN GROUP( ORDER BY MRN, PROVIDER) AS PROVIDER FROM (SELECT DISTINCT MRN, PROVIDER FROM Z) T GROUP BY MRN) , T3 AS (SELECT MRN, LISTAGG(COALESCE(STRIP(DOC_SVC), '') , CHR(13) || CHR(10)) WITHIN GROUP( ORDER BY MRN, DOC_SVC) AS DOC_SVC FROM (SELECT DISTINCT MRN, DOC_SVC FROM Z) T GROUP BY MRN) , Z1 AS (SELECT MRN, NAME, MIN(START_DATE) AS START_DATE, MAX(END_DATE) AS END_DATE FROM Z GROUP BY MRN, NAME) , Z2 AS (SELECT Z1.MRN, Z1.NAME, GENERIC_NAME, START_DATE, END_DATE, LOCATION, PROVIDER, DOC_SVC FROM Z1 LEFT JOIN T0 ON Z1.MRN = T0.MRN LEFT JOIN T1 ON Z1.MRN = T1.MRN LEFT JOIN T2 ON Z1.MRN = T2.MRN LEFT JOIN T3 ON Z1.MRN = T3.MRN) , NEXT_APPT AS (SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN, CPE_ENC_DTE, CRE_RES_NAME, CRE_RES_TYP, CLD_DEPT_NAME, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8, CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CPE_MRN ORDER BY CPE_ENC_DTE) AS RN2 FROM (SELECT DISTINCT MRN FROM Z2) Z JOIN IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER ON MRN = CPE_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Sch') AND CRE_RES_TYP IN ('Physician') AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 = 'BRE' ) , NEXT_CH AS (SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN, CPE_ENC_DTE, R2.CRE_RES_NAME AS REFERRING_MD, CLD_DEPT_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CPE_MRN ORDER BY CPE_ENC_DTE) AS RN3 FROM Z2 JOIN IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER ON CPE_MRN = MRN JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE R1 ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = R1.CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE R2 ON CPE_REF_RES_ID = R2.CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID JOIN IDB.CL_PT_CHEMO ON CPC_CL_PT_ID = CPE_CL_PT_ID AND CPC_ENC_DTE_SEQ = CPE_ENC_DTE_SEQ JOIN IDB.CL_CHEMO ON CPC_CHEMO_ID = CCH_CHEMO_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Sch') AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 = 'CHM' AND R1.CRE_RES_TYP = 'Chemotherapy Unit' AND CPE_ENC_DTE >= CURRENT date AND(CCH_CHEMO_NAME LIKE '%PERTUZUMAB%' OR CCH_CHEMO_NAME LIKE '%TRASTUZUMAB%') ) SELECT DISTINCT Z2.*, NA.CPE_ENC_DTE AS NEXT_APPT, NA.CRE_RES_NAME AS NEXT_PHYSICIAN, NC.CPE_ENC_DTE AS NEXT_CHEMO_DATE, NC.REFERRING_MD AS NEXT_CHEMO_REFERRING_PHYSICIAN, NC.CLD_DEPT_NAME AS NEXT_CHEMO_REFERRING_DEPT FROM Z2 LEFT JOIN NEXT_APPT NA ON MRN = NA.CPE_MRN AND RN2 = 1 JOIN NEXT_CH NC ON MRN = NC.CPE_MRN AND RN3 = 1

prompt: Patients who received a transfusion in the Donor Room
completion: WITH ORDERS AS (SELECT DISTINCT OO_MRN, OOC_ITEM_NAME, OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE, OSTS_STS_DESC, OUD_USER_DI_CD, OUD_USER_DI_VALUE FROM IDB.OMS_ORDER JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_CATALOG ON OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID = OOC_MSTR_ITEM_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_STATUS ON OO_ORD_STS_CD = OSTS_ORD_STS_CD JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_USER_DATA ON OO_ORD_GUID = OUD_ORD_GUID WHERE OOC_ITEM_NAME IN ('Red Blood Cells', 'Platelets') AND OO_ORD_STS_CD NOT IN ('CANP', 'CANC', 'AUC3') AND OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'BB_Product OP Transfusion Site' AND OUD_USER_DI_VALUE = 'Donor Room' ) SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN AS "MRN", CPE_ENC_DTE AS "Appt Date", B.CLD_DEPT_NAME AS "Department Name", CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME AS "Visit Type", D.CLD_DEPT_NAME "Referring Department", C.CRE_RES_NAME "Referring Provider", OUD_USER_DI_CD "OMS User Code", OUD_USER_DI_VALUE "OMS User Value" FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE A ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = A.CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT B ON CPE_DEPT_ID = B.CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID JOIN ORDERS ON CPE_MRN = OO_MRN AND CPE_ENC_DTE = OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE C ON CPE_REF_RES_ID = C.CRE_RES_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT D ON CPE_REF_DEP_ID = D.CLD_DEPT_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND YEAR(CPE_ENC_DTE) >= 2018 AND B.CLD_DEPT_NAME = 'CELL COLLECTION 1275'

prompt: Number of pts 65+ yrs in the auto and allo surv clinics from Jan 1, 2016-Dec 31, 2020.
completion: SELECT YEAR(CPE_ENC_DTE) YR, CBM_TRANSPLANT_TYPE TRANSPLANT_TYPE, COUNT(DISTINCT CPE_MRN) PATIENT_CNT, COUNT(DISTINCT CPE_ENC_CSN_ID) VISIT_CNT FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON CPE_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.CRDB_BMT_MEDICINE ON CPE_MRN = CBM_MRN WHERE CLD_DEPT_NAME IN ('BMTMED 1275 SURVIVORSP', 'BMTMED 205 E64-LC SVR', 'BMTMED KOCH-12 SVR') AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN '2016-01-01' AND '2020-12-31' AND YEAR(CPE_ENC_DTE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) >= 60 AND CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') GROUP BY YEAR(CPE_ENC_DTE), CBM_TRANSPLANT_TYPE ; SELECT CBM_TRANSPLANT_TYPE TRANSPLANT_TYPE, COUNT(DISTINCT CPE_MRN) PATIENT_CNT, COUNT(DISTINCT CPE_ENC_CSN_ID) VISIT_CNT FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON CPE_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.CRDB_BMT_MEDICINE ON CPE_MRN = CBM_MRN WHERE CLD_DEPT_NAME IN ('BMTMED 1275 SURVIVORSP', 'BMTMED 205 E64-LC SVR', 'BMTMED KOCH-12 SVR') AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN '2016-01-01' AND '2020-12-31' AND YEAR(CPE_ENC_DTE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) >= 60 AND CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') GROUP BY CBM_TRANSPLANT_TYPE ;

prompt: Provide a review of attended visits in the Westchester SCC with related CPT codes processed for the visits.
completion: WITH APPTS AS (SELECT CPE_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME "Last Name", PT_FIRST_NAME "First Name", PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH "DOB", CPE_ENC_DTE AS "Appt Date", CLD_DEPT_NAME AS "Department Name", R.CRE_RES_NAME AS "Referring Provider Name", CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME AS "Visit Type", CPE_ENC_CSN_ID FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE P ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = P.CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE R ON CPE_REF_RES_ID = R.CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON CPE_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE 1=1 AND CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN '2021-01-01' AND '2021-11-30' AND CLD_DEPT_ID = '1615' ) , CHARGES AS (SELECT RVCD_MRN CHARGE_MRN, RVCD_SVC_DTE CHARGE_SVC_DTE, HCPCS_CODE HCPCS_CPT_CODE, RVCD_UNITS UNITS, RVCD_AMT AMT, 'RMS' AS SOURCE FROM APPTS JOIN IDB.RMS_VISIT_CHARGE_DTL_V ON CPE_MRN = RVCD_MRN JOIN IDB.VISIT_XREF ON VX_VISIT_ID = RVCD_VISIT_ID AND TRIM(CPE_ENC_CSN_ID) = TRIM(VX_XREF_VISIT_NUM) WHERE 1=1 AND SUBSTR(HCPCS_CODE, 1, 1) IN ('1', '2', '3', '4', '5', '6', '7', '8', '9', '0', 'G') AND SUBSTR(HCPCS_CODE, 5, 1) IN ('1', '2', '3', '4', '5', '6', '7', '8', '9', '0') AND HCPCS_CODE <> '' UNION SELECT PBD_MRN CHARGE_MRN, PBD_SVC_DTE CHARGE_SVC_DTE, PBC_CPT_CD HCPCS_CPT_CODE, PBD_SVC_QTY UNITS, PBD_SVC_AMT AMT, 'PBD' AS SOURCE FROM IDB.PBD_DTL JOIN APPTS ON PBD_MRN = CPE_MRN AND PBD_SVC_DTE = "Appt Date" JOIN IDB.PBD_INVOICE ON PBD_INV_NO = PBI_INV_NO LEFT JOIN IDB.PBD_CODE ON PBD_PBD_CD = PBC_PBD_CD LEFT JOIN IDB.DOC ON PBI_PERFORM_DR_NO = DOC_DR_NO LEFT JOIN IDB.PBD_GROUP ON PBI_GRP_ID = PBDG_GRP_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.PBD_DIVISION ON PBI_DIV_ID = PBDD_DIV_ID WHERE 1=1 ) SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN "MRN", "Last Name", "First Name", "DOB", "Appt Date", "Department Name", "Referring Provider Name", "Visit Type", CHARGE_SVC_DTE "Charge Date", HCPCS_CPT_CODE "HCPCS_CPT Code", UNITS "Units", AMT "Amt", SOURCE "Source" FROM APPTS A LEFT JOIN CHARGES ON CPE_MRN = CHARGE_MRN AND "Appt Date" = CHARGE_SVC_DTE ORDER BY CPE_MRN, "Appt Date"

prompt: Provide a list of all H/S pathology reports since 1/1/2010 containing any of the specified search terms.
completion: WITH CLL AS (SELECT DISTINCT "t1"."PT_MRN" AS "MRN", PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_BIRTH_DTE AS DOB, "t2"."PRPT_ACCESSION_NO" AS "Pathology Report", PRPT_REPORT_TYPE, "t3"."PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_DESC" AS "Pathology Report Type", YEAR("t4"."DT_DTE") AS YR, "t4"."DT_DTE" AS "Pathology Procedure Date", "t5"."DT_DTE" AS "Pathology Report Date", UPPER(CASE WHEN LENGTH(PRPT_REPORT) <= 15000 THEN RTRIM(CAST(SUBSTR(PRPT_REPORT, 1, 15000) AS VARCHAR(15000))) ELSE CAST(SUBSTR(PRPT_REPORT, 1, 15000) AS VARCHAR(15000)) END) AS TXT, CASE WHEN UPPER(DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)DIAGNOSIS:[\w\W]*(?=NOTE:)', PRPT_REPORT)) <> '' THEN UPPER(DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)DIAGNOSIS:[\w\W]*(?=NOTE:)', PRPT_REPORT)) WHEN UPPER(DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)DIAGNOSIS:[\w\W]*(?=I ATTEST)', PRPT_REPORT)) <> '' THEN UPPER(DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)DIAGNOSIS:[\w\W]*(?=I ATTEST)', PRPT_REPORT)) WHEN UPPER(DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)DIAGNOSIS:[\w\W]*(?=REPORT ELECTRONICALLY SIGNED OUT )', PRPT_REPORT)) <> '' THEN UPPER(DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)DIAGNOSIS:[\w\W]*(?=REPORT ELECTRONICALLY SIGNED OUT )', PRPT_REPORT)) END AS DIAGNOSIS, CASE WHEN UPPER(DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)SPECIMENS SUBMITTED[\w\W]*(?=DIAGNOSIS:)', PRPT_REPORT)) <> '' THEN UPPER(DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)SPECIMENS SUBMITTED[\w\W]*(?=DIAGNOSIS:)', PRPT_REPORT)) WHEN UPPER(DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)SPECIMENSSUBMITTED[\w\W]*(?=DIAGNOSIS:)', PRPT_REPORT)) <> '' THEN UPPER(DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)SPECIMENSSUBMITTED[\w\W]*(?=DIAGNOSIS:)', PRPT_REPORT)) END AS SPECIMENS_SUBMITTED FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V" "t1" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED" "t6" ON "t1"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t6"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V" "t2" ON "t6"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t2"."PRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATH_RPRT_TYPE_LOOKUP" "t3" ON "t2"."PRPT_REPORT_TYPE" = "t3"."PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_CD" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" "t4" ON "t2"."PRPT_PROCEDURE_DATE_ID" = "t4"."DT_DATE_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" "t5" ON "t2"."PRPT_REPORT_DATE_ID" = "t5"."DT_DATE_ID" WHERE 1=1 AND CONTAINS("t2"."PRPT_REPORT", '("chronic lymphocytic leukemia" OR "cll")') = 1 AND "t2"."PRPT_REPORT" IS NOT NULL AND("t2"."PRPT_ACCESSION_NO" LIKE 'H%' OR "t2"."PRPT_ACCESSION_NO" LIKE 'S%') AND PRPT_REPORT_TYPE not like '%SSL%' AND "t4"."DT_DTE" BETWEEN '2010-01-01' AND CURRENT date ) , HL AS (SELECT DISTINCT "t1"."PT_MRN" AS "MRN", PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_BIRTH_DTE AS DOB, "t2"."PRPT_ACCESSION_NO" AS "Pathology Report", PRPT_REPORT_TYPE, "t3"."PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_DESC" AS "Pathology Report Type", YEAR("t4"."DT_DTE") AS YR, "t4"."DT_DTE" AS "Pathology Procedure Date", "t5"."DT_DTE" AS "Pathology Report Date", UPPER(CASE WHEN LENGTH(PRPT_REPORT) <= 15000 THEN RTRIM(CAST(SUBSTR(PRPT_REPORT, 1, 15000) AS VARCHAR(15000))) ELSE CAST(SUBSTR(PRPT_REPORT, 1, 15000) AS VARCHAR(15000)) END) AS TXT, CASE WHEN UPPER(DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)DIAGNOSIS:[\w\W]*(?=NOTE:)', PRPT_REPORT)) <> '' THEN UPPER(DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)DIAGNOSIS:[\w\W]*(?=NOTE:)', PRPT_REPORT)) WHEN UPPER(DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)DIAGNOSIS:[\w\W]*(?=I ATTEST)', PRPT_REPORT)) <> '' THEN UPPER(DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)DIAGNOSIS:[\w\W]*(?=I ATTEST)', PRPT_REPORT)) WHEN UPPER(DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)DIAGNOSIS:[\w\W]*(?=REPORT ELECTRONICALLY SIGNED OUT )', PRPT_REPORT)) <> '' THEN UPPER(DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)DIAGNOSIS:[\w\W]*(?=REPORT ELECTRONICALLY SIGNED OUT )', PRPT_REPORT)) END AS DIAGNOSIS, CASE WHEN UPPER(DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)SPECIMENS SUBMITTED[\w\W]*(?=DIAGNOSIS:)', PRPT_REPORT)) <> '' THEN UPPER(DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)SPECIMENS SUBMITTED[\w\W]*(?=DIAGNOSIS:)', PRPT_REPORT)) WHEN UPPER(DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)SPECIMENSSUBMITTED[\w\W]*(?=DIAGNOSIS:)', PRPT_REPORT)) <> '' THEN UPPER(DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)SPECIMENSSUBMITTED[\w\W]*(?=DIAGNOSIS:)', PRPT_REPORT)) END AS SPECIMENS_SUBMITTED FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V" "t1" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED" "t6" ON "t1"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t6"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V" "t2" ON "t6"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t2"."PRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATH_RPRT_TYPE_LOOKUP" "t3" ON "t2"."PRPT_REPORT_TYPE" = "t3"."PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_CD" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" "t4" ON "t2"."PRPT_PROCEDURE_DATE_ID" = "t4"."DT_DATE_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" "t5" ON "t2"."PRPT_REPORT_DATE_ID" = "t5"."DT_DATE_ID" WHERE 1=1 AND CONTAINS("t2"."PRPT_REPORT", '("Hodgkin lymphoma" OR "Hodgkins lymphoma")') = 1 AND "t2"."PRPT_REPORT" IS NOT NULL AND("t2"."PRPT_ACCESSION_NO" LIKE 'H%' OR "t2"."PRPT_ACCESSION_NO" LIKE 'S%') AND PRPT_REPORT_TYPE not like '%SSL%' AND "t4"."DT_DTE" BETWEEN '2010-01-01' AND CURRENT date ) , NHL AS (SELECT DISTINCT "t1"."PT_MRN" AS "MRN", PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_BIRTH_DTE AS DOB, "t2"."PRPT_ACCESSION_NO" AS "Pathology Report", PRPT_REPORT_TYPE, "t3"."PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_DESC" AS "Pathology Report Type", YEAR("t4"."DT_DTE") AS YR, "t4"."DT_DTE" AS "Pathology Procedure Date", "t5"."DT_DTE" AS "Pathology Report Date", UPPER(CASE WHEN LENGTH(PRPT_REPORT) <= 15000 THEN RTRIM(CAST(SUBSTR(PRPT_REPORT, 1, 15000) AS VARCHAR(15000))) ELSE CAST(SUBSTR(PRPT_REPORT, 1, 15000) AS VARCHAR(15000)) END) AS TXT, CASE WHEN UPPER(DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)DIAGNOSIS:[\w\W]*(?=NOTE:)', PRPT_REPORT)) <> '' THEN UPPER(DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)DIAGNOSIS:[\w\W]*(?=NOTE:)', PRPT_REPORT)) WHEN UPPER(DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)DIAGNOSIS:[\w\W]*(?=I ATTEST)', PRPT_REPORT)) <> '' THEN UPPER(DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)DIAGNOSIS:[\w\W]*(?=I ATTEST)', PRPT_REPORT)) WHEN UPPER(DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)DIAGNOSIS:[\w\W]*(?=REPORT ELECTRONICALLY SIGNED OUT )', PRPT_REPORT)) <> '' THEN UPPER(DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)DIAGNOSIS:[\w\W]*(?=REPORT ELECTRONICALLY SIGNED OUT )', PRPT_REPORT)) END AS DIAGNOSIS, CASE WHEN UPPER(DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)SPECIMENS SUBMITTED[\w\W]*(?=DIAGNOSIS:)', PRPT_REPORT)) <> '' THEN UPPER(DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)SPECIMENS SUBMITTED[\w\W]*(?=DIAGNOSIS:)', PRPT_REPORT)) WHEN UPPER(DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)SPECIMENSSUBMITTED[\w\W]*(?=DIAGNOSIS:)', PRPT_REPORT)) <> '' THEN UPPER(DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)SPECIMENSSUBMITTED[\w\W]*(?=DIAGNOSIS:)', PRPT_REPORT)) END AS SPECIMENS_SUBMITTED FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V" "t1" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED" "t6" ON "t1"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t6"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V" "t2" ON "t6"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t2"."PRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATH_RPRT_TYPE_LOOKUP" "t3" ON "t2"."PRPT_REPORT_TYPE" = "t3"."PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_CD" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" "t4" ON "t2"."PRPT_PROCEDURE_DATE_ID" = "t4"."DT_DATE_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" "t5" ON "t2"."PRPT_REPORT_DATE_ID" = "t5"."DT_DATE_ID" WHERE 1=1 AND CONTAINS("t2"."PRPT_REPORT", '("NHL" OR "Non-Hodgkin lymphoma" OR "Non-Hodgkins lymphoma" OR "Non Hodgkin lymphoma" OR "Non Hodgkins lymphoma")') = 1 AND "t2"."PRPT_REPORT" IS NOT NULL AND("t2"."PRPT_ACCESSION_NO" LIKE 'H%' OR "t2"."PRPT_ACCESSION_NO" LIKE 'S%') AND PRPT_REPORT_TYPE not like '%SSL%' AND "t4"."DT_DTE" BETWEEN '2010-01-01' AND CURRENT date ) SELECT * FROM CLL JOIN HL ON CLL."Pathology Report" = HL."Pathology Report" WHERE CLL."Pathology Report" NOT IN (SELECT "Pathology Report" FROM NHL)

prompt: Provide CA stage for all participants enrolled in IRB #03-003
completion: WITH CTE1 AS (SELECT AC_MRN FROM IDB.ACCRUALS WHERE AC_IRB_NO = '03-003' ), CTE2 AS (SELECT TM_MRN, TM_SITE_CD AS SITE_CODE, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_DESC, TM_HIST_CD AS HIST_CODE, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS HIST_DESC, CASE WHEN COALESCE(TM_AJCC, TM_PATH_STG_GRP, TM_CLIN_STG_GRP) <= '' THEN 'G'||TM_GENERAL_STG WHEN TM_AJCC > ' ' AND TM_AJCC <> '88' THEN SUBSTR(AV_DESC, 1, 10) ELSE CASE WHEN TM_PATH_STG_DSCR <> '4' AND TM_PATH_STG_GRP NOT IN ('99', '88', '') THEN TM_PATH_STG_GRP ELSE CASE WHEN TM_CLIN_STG_GRP = '88' THEN 'NA' WHEN TM_CLIN_STG_GRP = '99' THEN 'UNK' ELSE TM_CLIN_STG_GRP END END END AS STAGE FROM CTE1 INNER JOIN IDB.CDB_TUMOR ON AC_MRN = TM_MRN INNER JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS ON TM_AJCC = AV_CODE INNER JOIN IDB.CLM S ON TM_SITE_CD = S.CLM_CLSF_CD INNER JOIN IDB.CLM H ON TM_HIST_CD = H.CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE AV_ELEMENT = 'AJCC' ) SELECT DISTINCT AC_MRN, B.* FROM CTE1 A LEFT JOIN CTE2 B ON AC_MRN = TM_MRN

prompt: Create an audit sample from 14 of the Rad Onc Physicians and orders entered into OMS by the attending physician vs transcribed orders.
completion: SELECT OUO_MRN, OUO_ENTER_DTE, OUO_PVDR_NAME, OUO_USER_NAME, OUO_ORD_NAME, CASE WHEN OUO_PVDR_NAME = OUO_USER_NAME THEN 'MD Entered' WHEN OUO_ORD_SOURCE = '.Transcribed Order' THEN 'Transcribed' ELSE OUO_ORD_SOURCE END AS SOURCE , OUO_REQUESTED_DT, OUO_REQ_DTE_TXT, OUO_REQ_FOR_DTE FROM IDB.OMS_USER_ORDERS WHERE OUO_ENTER_DTE BETWEEN '2010-01-01' AND '2010-01-31' AND OUO_ORD_STS_CD NOT IN ('CANC', 'CANP') AND OUO_PVDR_NAME IN ('Wu, Abraham', 'Ho, Alice', 'Kiess, Ana', 'Rimner, Andreas', 'Goenka, Anuj', 'Thiagarajan, Anuradha', 'McCormick, Beryl', 'Cox, Brett Wayne', 'Barker, Christopher', 'Housman, Douglas', 'Bieniek, Eva', 'Gupta, Gaorav', 'Yahalom, Joachim', 'Alektiar, Kaled', 'Goodman, Karyn A', 'Beal, Kathryn', 'Vyas, Kavita', 'Rosenzweig, Kenneth', 'Shapiro, Lauren', 'Koutcher, Lawrence', 'Kollmeier, Marisa', 'Laufer, Marsha', 'Zelefsky, Michael', 'Sircar, Monica', 'Lee, Nancy', 'Bindra, Ranjit', 'Bakst, Richard', 'Mutter, Robert', 'Rawlins-Duell, Robin', 'Damast, Shari', 'Powell, Simon N.', 'Edwards-Bennett, Sophia', 'Wolden, Suzanne', 'Chan, Timothy', 'Yamada, Yoshiya')

prompt: Provide a list of patients who have received adjuvant chemotherapy for pancreas cancer from 1/1/2015 to 1/1/2022.
completion: WITH TUMOR AS (SELECT DISTINCT TM_MRN, TM_HIST_CD, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK HIST_DESC, TM_SITE_CD, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK SITE_DESC, TM_DX_DTE, TM_TSTAGE_7, TM_NSTAGE_7, TM_MSTAGE_7, TM_AJCC_7, TM_CLIN_TNM_T, TM_CLIN_TNM_N, TM_CLIN_TNM_M, TM_CLIN_STG_GRP, TM_PATH_TNM_T, TM_PATH_TNM_N, TM_PATH_TNM_M, TM_PATH_STG_GRP, B.AV_DESC AS AJCC_STAGE, CS.AV_DESC AS TM_CASE_STS FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR T JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = T.TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = T.TM_SITE_CD LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS B ON T.TM_AJCC = B.AV_CODE AND B.AV_ELEMENT = 'AJCC' LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS CS ON CS.AV_ELEMENT = 'CASE_STS' AND CS.AV_CODE = T.TM_CASE_STS WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND TM_SITE_CD LIKE ('C25%') AND TM_DX_DTE BETWEEN '2015-01-01' AND '2022-01-01' ) , CHEMO AS (SELECT DISTINCT T.*, APR_START_DTE, APR_END_DTE, CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME, APR_GENERIC_NAME, APR_PRESCRIBED_DOSE, APR_ROUTE FROM TUMOR T JOIN IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX_V ON TM_MRN = APR_MRN WHERE CDG_CHEMO_FLAG = 'Y' ) , ALLBMI AS (SELECT TM_MRN AS ALLBMI_MRN, PMH_MEASURE_DTE AS ALLBMI_MEASURE_DTE, PMH_BMI AS ALLBMI_BMI, TM_DX_DTE AS DX_DTE, ABS(DAYS(PMH_MEASURE_DTE) - DAYS(TM_DX_DTE)) AS ABS_DAYS_DIFF_BMI_DX FROM TUMOR LEFT JOIN IDB.PT_MEASURES_HX ON TM_MRN = PMH_MRN AND PMH_BMI IS NOT NULL), CLOSESTBMI AS (SELECT DISTINCT ALLBMI_MRN AS CLOSEST_BMI_MRN, ALLBMI_MEASURE_DTE AS CLOSEST_BMI_MEASURE_DTE, ALLBMI_BMI AS CLOSEST_BMI_BMI, ABS_DAYS_DIFF_BMI_DX FROM ALLBMI A WHERE COALESCE(ABS_DAYS_DIFF_BMI_DX, 999999) = (SELECT COALESCE(MIN(ABS_DAYS_DIFF_BMI_DX), 999999) FROM ALLBMI M WHERE A.ALLBMI_MRN = M.ALLBMI_MRN AND A.DX_DTE = M.DX_DTE) ) , DEMO AS (SELECT PT_MRN AS "MRN" , PT_LAST_NAME , PT_FIRST_NAME , PT_SEX , YEAR(CURRENT DATE)-YEAR(PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) AGE , E.AV_DESC ETHNICITY_REG , CE.AV_DESC ETHNICITY_CDB, TM_CLIN_TNM_T, TM_CLIN_TNM_N, TM_CLIN_TNM_M, TM_CLIN_STG_GRP, TM_PATH_TNM_T, TM_PATH_TNM_N, TM_PATH_TNM_M, TM_PATH_STG_GRP FROM TUMOR T JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON TM_MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS E ON E.AV_ELEMENT = 'PT_ETHNICITY' AND E.AV_CODE = PT_PT_ETHNICITY LEFT JOIN IDB.CDB_PATIENT ON PT_MRN = CP_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS CE ON CE.AV_ELEMENT = 'ETHNICITY' AND CE.AV_CODE = CP_ETHNICITY LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS Q ON Q.AV_ELEMENT='TSTAGE_7' AND Q.AV_CODE = T.TM_TSTAGE_7 LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS N ON N.AV_ELEMENT='NSTAGE_7' AND N.AV_CODE = T.TM_NSTAGE_7 LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS M ON M.AV_ELEMENT='MSTAGE_7' AND M.AV_CODE = T.TM_MSTAGE_7) SELECT DISTINCT T.TM_MRN MRN, PT_LAST_NAME AS "Last Name" , PT_FIRST_NAME AS "First Name" , PT_SEX AS "Gender" , AGE , ETHNICITY_REG , ETHNICITY_CDB, CLOSEST_BMI_BMI, T.TM_HIST_CD, T.HIST_DESC, T.TM_CASE_STS, APR_GENERIC_NAME, APR_PRESCRIBED_DOSE, T.TM_PATH_TNM_T AS "Pathologic T Stage", T.TM_PATH_TNM_N AS "Pathologic N Stage", T.TM_PATH_TNM_M AS "Pathologic M Stage", T.TM_PATH_STG_GRP AS "Pathologic Group Stage" FROM TUMOR T JOIN CHEMO C ON T.TM_MRN = C.TM_MRN LEFT JOIN DEMO ON T.TM_MRN =MRN LEFT JOIN CLOSESTBMI ON T.TM_MRN = CLOSEST_BMI_MRN

prompt: Data related to inpatient heparin infusions for past year 6/2022-6/2023
completion: WITH ORD AS (SELECT DISTINCT OO_MRN, OOC_ITEM_NAME, OOC_ITEM_DESC, OO_SET_NAME, OO_SIGNIFICANT_DT, OO_STOP_DT, OSTS_STS_DESC, OCV_CURR_LOC FROM IDB.OMS_ORDER JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_CATALOG ON OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID = OOC_MSTR_ITEM_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_STATUS ON OO_ORD_STS_CD = OSTS_ORD_STS_CD JOIN IDB.OMS_CLIENT_VISIT ON OCV_VISIT_GUID = OO_VISIT_GUID WHERE OO_SET_NAME IN ('Heparin (.Treatment_of_.DVT_and_PE) Orderset', 'Heparin (.Treatment_of_ACS_A-Fib_Mech-Valves) Orderset') AND OO_ORD_STS_CD NOT IN ('CANP', 'CANC', 'AUC3') AND OCV_IP_OP_IND = 'I' AND OO_SIGNIFICANT_DT BETWEEN '2022-06-01' AND '2023-06-30' ), HEPARIN AS (SELECT DISTINCT LR_MRN AS HEP_MRN, OO_SIGNIFICANT_DT AS HEP_ORD_START_DATE, OO_STOP_DT AS HEP_ORD_END_DATE, LR_PERFORMED_DT AS HEP_PERF_DTE, LR_TEST_NAME AS HEP_TEST_NAME, LR_SUBTEST_NAME AS HEP_SUBTEST_NAME, LR_RESULT_VALUE AS HEP_RESULT FROM ORD JOIN IDB.LAB_RESULTS ON OO_MRN = LR_MRN WHERE LR_SUBTEST_NAME IN ('Anti-Factor Xa (.Heparin Assay)', 'Anti-Factor Xa (Heparin Assay)', 'Heparin (Anti-Xa) Level', 'Anti-Factor XA (Heparin Assay)') AND LR_PERFORMED_DTE BETWEEN OO_SIGNIFICANT_DT AND OO_STOP_DT ) , HCT AS (SELECT DISTINCT LR_MRN AS HCT_MRN, OO_SIGNIFICANT_DT AS HCT_ORD_START_DATE, OO_STOP_DT AS HCT_ORD_END_DATE, LR_PERFORMED_DT AS HCT_PERF_DTE, LR_TEST_NAME AS HCT_TEST_NAME, LR_SUBTEST_NAME AS HCT_SUBTEST_NAME, LR_RESULT_VALUE AS HCT_RESULT FROM ORD JOIN IDB.LAB_RESULTS ON OO_MRN = LR_MRN WHERE LR_SUBTEST_NAME IN ('HCT') AND LR_PERFORMED_DTE BETWEEN OO_SIGNIFICANT_DT AND OO_STOP_DT ) , TSFBEFORE AS (SELECT DISTINCT BBP_MRN AS TSBFR_MRN, OO_SIGNIFICANT_DT AS ORD_SIG_DATE, BBP_TRANSACTION_DTE AS TSBFR_DTE, BBP_PRODUCT_ABRV AS TSBFR_PRODUCT_ABRV, BBP_PRODUCT_DESC AS TSBFR_PRODUCT_DESC, BBP_UNIT_VOLUME AS TSBFR_UNIT_VOLUME, BBP_BLOOD_TYPE AS TSBFR_BLOOD_TYPE FROM ORD JOIN IDB.TRANSFUSED_BLOOD_PRODUCTS_V ON OO_MRN = BBP_MRN WHERE BBP_PRODUCT_ABRV = 'RBC' AND BBP_TRANSACTION_DTE BETWEEN OO_SIGNIFICANT_DT - 1 DAY AND OO_SIGNIFICANT_DT ) , TSFAFTER AS (SELECT DISTINCT BBP_MRN AS TSAFR_MRN, BBP_TRANSACTION_DTE AS TSAFR_DTE, BBP_PRODUCT_ABRV AS TSAFR_PRODUCT_ABRV, BBP_PRODUCT_DESC AS TSAFR_PRODUCT_DESC, BBP_UNIT_VOLUME AS TSAFR_UNIT_VOLUME, BBP_BLOOD_TYPE AS TSAFR_BLOOD_TYPE FROM ORD JOIN IDB.TRANSFUSED_BLOOD_PRODUCTS_V ON OO_MRN = BBP_MRN WHERE BBP_PRODUCT_ABRV = 'RBC' AND BBP_TRANSACTION_DTE BETWEEN OO_SIGNIFICANT_DT AND OO_SIGNIFICANT_DT +1 DAY ) , TSFDURING AS (SELECT DISTINCT BBP_MRN AS TSDUR_MRN, BBP_TRANSACTION_DTE AS TSDUR_DTE, BBP_PRODUCT_ABRV AS TSDUR_PRODUCT_ABRV, BBP_PRODUCT_DESC AS TSDUR_PRODUCT_DESC, BBP_UNIT_VOLUME AS TSDUR_UNIT_VOLUME, BBP_BLOOD_TYPE AS TSDUR_BLOOD_TYPE FROM ORD JOIN IDB.TRANSFUSED_BLOOD_PRODUCTS_V ON OO_MRN = BBP_MRN WHERE BBP_PRODUCT_ABRV = 'RBC' AND BBP_TRANSACTION_DTE = OO_SIGNIFICANT_DT ) SELECT DISTINCT OO_MRN AS MRN, OO_SIGNIFICANT_DT AS "Order Significant Date", OO_STOP_DT AS "Order Stop Date", OSTS_STS_DESC AS "Order Status", OCV_CURR_LOC AS LOCATION, OO_SET_NAME AS "Order Set Name", OOC_ITEM_NAME AS "Order Item Name", OOC_ITEM_DESC AS "Order Item Description", HEP_PERF_DTE AS "Heparin Performed Date", HEP_TEST_NAME AS "Heparin Test Name", HEP_SUBTEST_NAME AS "Heparin SubTest Name", HEP_RESULT AS "Heparin Result Value", HCT_PERF_DTE AS "HCT Performed Date", HCT_TEST_NAME AS "HCT Test Name", HCT_SUBTEST_NAME AS "HCT Subtest Name", HCT_RESULT AS "HCT Result Value", TSBFR_DTE AS "Transfusion Before Order Start Date", TSBFR_PRODUCT_ABRV AS "Transfusion Before Product Abrv", TSBFR_PRODUCT_DESC AS "Transfusion Before Product Description", TSBFR_UNIT_VOLUME AS "Transfusion Before Unit Volume", TSBFR_BLOOD_TYPE AS "Transfusion Before Blood Type", TSAFR_DTE AS "Transfusion After Order Start Date", TSAFR_PRODUCT_ABRV AS "Transfusion After Product Abrv", TSAFR_PRODUCT_DESC AS "Transfusion After Product Description", TSAFR_UNIT_VOLUME AS "Transfusion After Unit Volume", TSAFR_BLOOD_TYPE AS "Transfusion After Blood Type", TSDUR_DTE AS "Transfusion During Order Start Date", TSDUR_PRODUCT_ABRV AS "Transfusion During Product Abrv", TSDUR_PRODUCT_DESC AS "Transfusion During Product Description", TSDUR_UNIT_VOLUME AS "Transfusion During Unit Volume", TSDUR_BLOOD_TYPE AS "Transfusion During Blood Type" FROM ORD LEFT JOIN HEPARIN ON OO_MRN = HEP_MRN LEFT JOIN HCT ON OO_MRN = HCT_MRN LEFT JOIN TSFBEFORE ON OO_MRN = TSBFR_MRN LEFT JOIN TSFAFTER ON OO_MRN = TSAFR_MRN LEFT JOIN TSFDURING ON OO_MRN = TSDUR_MRN ORDER BY OO_MRN

prompt:
Please generate a list of all breast NV's that RadOnc MD Lior Braunstein has seen at Bergen, going back 6 months (6/1/23).



The ask is that the list differentiate NV/IRs that are referred from Bergen vs from outside, and seen on Dr. Braunstein's Wednesday Bergen template.
completion: SELECT CPE_MRN, CPE_ENC_DTE AS APPT_DATE, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 AS DEPARTMENT, CLD_DEPT_NAME AS DEPARTMENT_NAME, CLD_CLD_CENTER AS CENTER, CRE_RES_NAME AS PROVIDER_NAME, CRE_RES_ID AS PROVIDER_ID, CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME AS VISIT_TYPE, CVT_EXT_NAME AS "Visit Type External", CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE 1 = 1 AND CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CRE_RES_ID IN ('021733') AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT DATE - 9 MONTHS AND CURRENT DATE AND CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME LIKE ('%BREAST%') AND CLD_DEPT_NAME LIKE ('%BER%') AND (CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR LIKE '%NV%' OR CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR LIKE '%IR%') ;

prompt: Daily report of all patients that had orders for "Financial Clearance (Genitourinary)" for chemo the day prior.
completion: WITH ORD AS (SELECT OO_MRN, OO_ORD_GUID GUID, OUD_USER_DI_VALUE, OOC_ITEM_NAME, OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE, OSTS_STS_DESC, OO_REQ_DR_NO, DOC_NAME FROM IDB.OMS_ORDER JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_CATALOG ON OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID = OOC_MSTR_ITEM_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_STATUS ON OO_ORD_STS_CD = OSTS_ORD_STS_CD JOIN IDB.OMS_PROVIDER ON OO_PVDR_GUID = OP_PVDR_GUID JOIN IDB.DOC ON OP_PVDR_NO = DOC_DR_NO JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_USER_DATA ON OUD_ORD_GUID = OO_ORD_GUID AND OUD_USER_DI_CD LIKE '%Drug Name%' WHERE OOC_ITEM_NAME = 'Financial Clearance for Chemotherapy (Genitourinary)' AND OO_ORD_STS_CD NOT IN ('CANP', 'CANC', 'AUC3') AND OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE >= CURRENT DATE - 4 DAYS AND LOWER(OUD_USER_DI_VALUE) LIKE '%cabazitaxel%' ) , APPT AS (SELECT CPE_MRN , CPE_ENC_DTE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CPE_MRN ORDER BY CPE_ENC_DTE ASC) RN FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID JOIN ORD ON OO_MRN = CPE_MRN WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Sch') AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 ='GU' AND (CLD_DEPT_NAME LIKE 'ST GU' OR CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME LIKE '%STGU%') ) , DX AS (SELECT DISTINCT CC_MRN FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN ORD ON OO_MRN = CC_MRN WHERE SUBSTR(CC_CLSF_CD, 1, 3) IN ('185', 'C61') AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND (CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) ) SELECT OO_MRN AS MRN, TRIM(PT_LAST_NAME) || ', ' || TRIM(PT_FIRST_NAME) AS PATIENT_NAME, OOC_ITEM_NAME AS ORDER_NAME, OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE AS ORDER_DATE, TRIM(OSTS_STS_DESC) AS ORDER_STATUS, OO_REQ_DR_NO || ' - ' || TRIM(DOC_NAME) AS ORDERED_BY, CASE WHEN CC_MRN IS NOT NULL THEN 'Y' END AS PROSTATE_CANCER_FLAG, CPE_ENC_DTE AS NEXT_GU_APPOINTMENT FROM ORD LEFT JOIN APPT ON CPE_MRN = OO_MRN AND RN =1 LEFT JOIN DX ON CC_MRN = OO_MRN JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PT_MRN = OO_MRN ;

prompt: Provide a list of patients who identify as LGBTQ+ who have dermatologic conditions and a list of non-LGBTQ+ controls who have dermatologic conditions.
completion: SELECT * FROM (SELECT CPE_MRN AS MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, CPE_ENC_DTE AS "Appointment Date", CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 AS "Department", CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 AS "Service", CLD_DEPT_NAME AS "Department Name", CRE_RES_NAME AS "Provider Name", ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CPE_MRN ORDER BY CPE_ENC_DTE ASC) RN FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PT_MRN = CPE_MRN WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CRE_RES_ID = '015271' AND CRE_RES_TYP = 'Physician' AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN '2022-02-02' AND '2023-02-28' AND CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME IN ('DERM ACTIVE FR', 'DERM ACTIVE FR', 'DERM NV') ) WHERE RN=1 ; WITH APPT AS (SELECT * FROM (SELECT CPE_MRN , CPE_ENC_DTE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CPE_MRN ORDER BY CPE_ENC_DTE ASC) RN FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CRE_RES_ID = '015271' AND CRE_RES_TYP = 'Physician' AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN '2022-02-02' AND '2023-02-28' AND CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME IN ('DERM ACTIVE FR', 'DERM ACTIVE FR', 'DERM NV') ) WHERE RN=1 ) SELECT TM_MRN, TM_DX_DTE, TM_HIST_CD, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS HIST_DESC, TM_SITE_CD, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_DESC, TM_BEST_AJCC_STG FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD JOIN APPT ON TM_MRN = CPE_MRN WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') ;

prompt: While data doing analysis, we wanted to see how many patients during the same time frame had CTCL (in other words, since we have pulled patients who have HSV & CTCL, we wanted to see what the overall number of CTCL patients were during this time-same time period). We wanted to see how many CTCL patients were there stratified by the subtype diagnosis (Mycosis fungoides, PTCL, ETC.)
completion: WITH TM AS (SELECT TM_MRN, TM_DX_DTE, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS HISTOLOGY FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND TM_DX_DTE BETWEEN '1966-04-01' AND '2020-09-01' AND TM_HIST_CD IN ('M9827/3', 'M9948/3', 'M9702/3', 'M9714/3', 'M9705/3', 'M9831/3', 'M9717/3', 'M9719/3', 'M9716/3', 'M9725/3', 'M9718/1', 'M9700/3', 'M9718/3', 'M9709/3', 'M9726/3', 'M9701/3', 'M9724/3', 'M9834/3', 'M9708/3') ) , PTS AS (SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN, PT_SEX, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_DATE_OF_DEATH, CASE WHEN COALESCE(R.AV_DESC, CR.AV_DESC) IN ('WHITE', 'WHITE HISPANIC') THEN 'White' WHEN COALESCE(R.AV_DESC, CR.AV_DESC) IN ('BLACK OR AFRICAN AMERICAN', 'BLACK', 'BLACK HISPANIC') THEN 'Black' WHEN COALESCE(R.AV_DESC, CR.AV_DESC) IN ('ASIAN-FAR EAST/INDIAN SUBCONT', 'KAMPUCHEAN', 'LAOTIAN', 'VIETNAMESE', 'HMONG', 'CHINESE', 'ASIAN INDIAN PAKISTANI', 'JAPANESE', 'KOREAN', 'OTHER ASIAN', 'THAI') THEN 'Asian' WHEN COALESCE(R.AV_DESC, CR.AV_DESC) IN ('NATIVE AMERICAN-AM IND/ALASKA', 'AMER IND ALEUT ESKIMO') THEN 'Native American or Alaska Native' WHEN COALESCE(R.AV_DESC, CR.AV_DESC) IN ('NATIVE HAWAIIAN OR PACIFIC ISL', 'HAWAIIAN', 'MELANESIAN', 'MICRONESIAN', 'FIJI ISLANDER', 'FILIPINO', 'GUAMANIAN', 'PACIFIC ISLANDER') THEN 'Native Hawaiian or Other Pacific Islander' ELSE 'Unspecified' END AS PT_RACE, CASE WHEN COALESCE(CE.AV_DESC, E.AV_DESC) IN ('SPANISH NOS; HISPANIC NOS, LATINO NOS', 'HISPANIC OR LATINO', 'PUERTO RICAN', 'SOUTH/CENTRAL AMERICA (EXCEPT BRAZIL)', 'DOMINICAN REPUBLIC', 'OTHER SPANISH/HISPANIC(INCL EUROPEAN; EXCL DOM REP)', 'CUBAN', 'MEXICAN (INCLUDES CHICANO)') OR COALESCE(R.AV_DESC, CR.AV_DESC) IN ('WHITE HISPANIC', 'BLACK HISPANIC') THEN 'Hispanic' WHEN COALESCE(CE.AV_DESC, E.AV_DESC) IN ('NOT HISPANIC', 'SPANISH SURNAME ONLY', 'NON-SPANISH; NON-HISPANIC') THEN 'Non-Hispanic' ELSE 'Unspecified' END AS PT_ETHNICITY FROM IDB.PATIENT JOIN TM ON PT_MRN = TM_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS R ON R.AV_ELEMENT = 'RACE' AND R.AV_CODE = PT_RACE LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS E ON E.AV_ELEMENT = 'PT_ETHNICITY' AND E.AV_CODE = PT_PT_ETHNICITY LEFT JOIN IDB.CDB_PATIENT ON PT_MRN = CP_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS CR ON CR.AV_ELEMENT = 'CDB_RACE' AND CR.AV_CODE = CP_CDB_RACE LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS CE ON CE.AV_ELEMENT = 'ETHNICITY' AND CE.AV_CODE = CP_ETHNICITY) SELECT TM_MRN MRN , PT_LAST_NAME LAST_NAME , PT_FIRST_NAME FIRST_NAME , PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH DOB , PT_DATE_OF_DEATH DATE_OF_DEATH , PT_SEX SEX , PT_RACE RACE , PT_ETHNICITY ETHNICITY , HISTOLOGY , TM_DX_DTE DIAGNOSIS_DTE , YEAR(TM_DX_DTE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) AGE_AT_DIAGNOSIS FROM TM JOIN PTS ON TM_MRN = PT_MRN

TM_HIST_CD like 'M942%' OR TM_HIST_CD like 'M943%' OR TM_HIST_CD like 'M944%' OR TM_HIST_CD like 'M945%' OR TM_HIST_CD like 'M946%' OR TM_HIST_CD like 'M947%' OR TM_HIST_CD like 'M948%' THEN 'GLIOMA' like 'M945%' OR TM_HIST_CD like 'M946%' OR TM_HIST_CD like 'M947%' OR TM_HIST_CD like 'M948%' OR TM_HIST_CD IN ('M9550/0') OR TM_HIST_CD IN ('M9540/3', 'M9561/3')) GROUP BY TM_MRN, CASE WHEN TM_HIST_CD like 'M938%' OR TM_HIST_CD like 'M939%' OR TM_HIST_CD like 'M940%' OR TM_HIST_CD like 'M941%' OR TM_HIST_CD like 'M942%' OR TM_HIST_CD like 'M943%' OR TM_HIST_CD like 'M944%' OR TM_HIST_CD like 'M945%' OR TM_HIST_CD like 'M946%' OR TM_HIST_CD like 'M947%' OR TM_HIST_CD like 'M948%' THEN 'GLIOMA' WHEN TM_HIST_CD IN ('M9560/0', 'M9560/3', 'M9561/3') THEN 'SCHWANNOMATOSIS' WHEN TM_HIST_CD IN ('M9550/0') THEN 'PLEXIFORM NEUROFIBROMA' WHEN TM_HIST_CD IN ('M9540/3', 'M9561/3') THEN 'MPNST' END ) , APPTS AS (SELECT CPE_MRN AS "MRN", PT_LAST_NAME LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME FIRST_NAME, PT_SEX GENDER, R.AV_DESC AS RACE, E.AV_DESC AS ETHNICITY, DISORDER, FIRST_DX_DTE, YEAR(CPE_ENC_DTE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) AGE_AT_APPT, CPE_ENC_DTE AS "Appt Date", CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 AS "Department", CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 AS "Service", CLD_DEPT_NAME AS "Department Name", CRE_RES_NAME AS "Provider Name", CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME AS "Visit Type", ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CPE_MRN, DISORDER ORDER BY CPE_ENC_DTE) RN FROM PTS JOIN IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER ON CC_MRN = CPE_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON CPE_MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS R ON PT_RACE = R.AV_CODE AND R.AV_ELEMENT = 'RACE' LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS E ON PT_PT_ETHNICITY = E.AV_CODE AND E.AV_ELEMENT = 'PT_ETHNICITY' WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN '2018-01-01' AND '2020-12-31' AND CRE_RES_TYP = 'Physician' AND CPE_MRN <> '' AND DISORDER IN ('NF1', 'NF2', 'NF_NOT_SPECIFIED', 'SCHWANNOMATOSIS') ) SELECT * FROM APPTS A1 LEFT JOIN PTS A2 ON A1.MRN = A2.CC_MRN AND A2.DISORDER NOT IN ('NF1', 'NF2', 'NF_NOT_SPECIFIED', 'SCHWANNOMATOSIS') WHERE A1.RN = 1

prompt: Provide a list of prostate cancer patients, consented to 12-245 or 06-107, with BRCA2 or BRCA1 NEGATIVE results.
completion: WITH DX1 AS (SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN AS MRN, PDWS_NAME, DT_PROCEDURE, PRIMARY_SITE, TUMOR_TYPE_CODE, TUMOR_TYPE_NAME FROM DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML DT ON PDRX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML_SETTINGS ON PDRX_PATH_DMP_RESULTS_XML_ID = PDRXS_PATH_DMP_RESULTS_XML_ID JOIN DVDMC.PATHOLOGY_DMP_WEBSVC_SETTINGS ON PDRXS_SETTING_ID = PDWS_SETTING_ID CROSS JOIN XMLTABLE('$c/root/*' PASSING DT.PDRX_XML_VALUE AS "c" COLUMNS DT_PROCEDURE VARCHAR(40) PATH '../meta-data/dt_procedure', TUMOR_TYPE_CODE VARCHAR(100) PATH '../meta-data/tumor_type_code', TUMOR_TYPE_NAME VARCHAR(255) PATH '../meta-data/tumor_type_name', PRIMARY_SITE VARCHAR(255) PATH '../meta-data/primary_site') T WHERE 1=1 AND (UPPER(PRIMARY_SITE) LIKE '%PROS%' OR UPPER(TUMOR_TYPE_NAME) LIKE '%PROS%') ) , B1 AS (SELECT DISTINCT MRN, GENE, GENE2 FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_STRUCTURED_RESULTS_V JOIN DX1 ON MRN = PT_MRN WHERE 1=1 AND(GENE like '%BRCA%' OR GENE2 like '%BRCA%') ) , X AS (SELECT DISTINCT DX1.* FROM DX1 LEFT JOIN B1 ON DX1.MRN = B1.MRN WHERE B1.MRN IS NULL ) , AC AS (SELECT AC_MRN, MAX(CASE WHEN AC_IRB_NO = '06-107' THEN AC_CONS_DTE END) AS "06-107 Consent Date", MAX(CASE WHEN AC_IRB_NO = '12-245' THEN AC_CONS_DTE END) AS "12-245 Consent Date" FROM IDB.ACCRUALS WHERE AC_IRB_NO IN ('06-107', '12-245') AND AC_MRN IN (SELECT DISTINCT MRN FROM X) GROUP BY AC_MRN ) SELECT DISTINCT X.*, "06-107 Consent Date", "12-245 Consent Date" FROM X LEFT JOIN AC ON X.MRN = AC_MRN

prompt: Provide survival and demographic data for a list of DMP IDs.
Create a Tableau dashboard to looks at Paracentesis Consult Orders
completion: WITH USER_DATA AS (SELECT DISTINCT OUD_ORD_GUID, MAX(TRIM(CASE WHEN OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'RIS_IR-Procedure' THEN OUD_USER_DI_VALUE END)) "IR-Procedure" FROM IDB.OMS_ORD_USER_DATA JOIN IDB.OMS_ORDER ON OO_ORD_GUID = OUD_ORD_GUID WHERE OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID = '9000006000100730' AND OO_ORD_STS_CD NOT IN ('CANP', 'CANC', 'AUC3') AND OO_ENTER_DTE >= '2018-01-01' GROUP BY OUD_ORD_GUID ) , IR AS (SELECT DISTINCT RRPT_MRN, RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE, RRPT_PROCEDURE_NAME FROM DV.RADIOLOGY_REPORT_V WHERE RRPT_PROCEDURE_NAME IN ('IR CLINIC PARACENTESIS' , 'IR PARACENTESIS US') AND RRPT_REPORT_TXT IS NOT NULL AND RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE >= '2018-01-01' ) SELECT DISTINCT OO_ORD_GUID "Order GUID", OO_MRN "MRN", TRIM(PT_LAST_NAME) || ', ' || TRIM(PT_FIRST_NAME) "Patient Name", OOC_ITEM_NAME "Order Name", OCV_IP_OP_IND "Patient Type", OCV_CURR_LOC "Location", OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE "Order Date", OSTS_STS_DESC "Order Status", OU_DISPLAY_NAME "Entered by", OP_DISPLAY_NAME "Provider Name", OS_SVC_DESC "Service", "IR-Procedure", MIN(CASE WHEN RRPT_PROCEDURE_NAME = 'IR CLINIC PARACENTESIS' AND OCV_IP_OP_IND = 'O' THEN RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE END) "OP Procedure Date", MIN(CASE WHEN RRPT_PROCEDURE_NAME = 'IR PARACENTESIS US' AND OCV_IP_OP_IND = 'I' THEN RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE END) "IP Procedure Date" FROM IDB.OMS_ORDER JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_CATALOG ON OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID = OOC_MSTR_ITEM_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_STATUS ON OO_ORD_STS_CD = OSTS_ORD_STS_CD JOIN IDB.OMS_USER ON OO_USER_GUID = OU_USER_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_PROVIDER ON OO_PVDR_GUID = OP_PVDR_GUID JOIN USER_DATA ON OO_ORD_GUID = OUD_ORD_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_CLIENT_VISIT ON OO_VISIT_GUID = OCV_VISIT_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_SERVICE ON OCV_SVC_GUID = OS_SVC_GUID JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON OO_MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN IR ON OO_MRN = RRPT_MRN AND RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE >= OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE WHERE OO_ORD_STS_CD NOT IN ('CANP', 'CANC', 'AUC3') AND OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID = '9000006000100730' AND "IR-Procedure" = 'Drainage - Ascites' AND OO_ENTER_DTE >= '2018-01-01' GROUP BY OO_ORD_GUID, OO_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, OOC_ITEM_NAME, OCV_IP_OP_IND, OCV_CURR_LOC, OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE, OSTS_STS_DESC, OU_DISPLAY_NAME, OP_DISPLAY_NAME, OS_SVC_DESC, "IR-Procedure"

prompt: Replicate ACC9339 for all tryptase levels drawn in the hospital. Report should be sent weekly with all tryptase levels drawn in the past month.
completion: SELECT DISTINCT LR_MRN MRN, STRIP(PT_LAST_NAME)||', '|| STRIP(PT_FIRST_NAME) PT_NAME, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH DOB , OO_ENTER_DT ORD_PLACED_DTE, NURS_STA_DESC ORD_PLACED_LOCATION, LR_PERFORMED_DT SPES_COLLECTED_DT , LR_ENTER_DT RESULT_ENTERED_DT, LR_ACCESSION_NO ACCESSION_NO, LR_RESULT_STS_CD, LR_SUBTEST_NAME TEST_NAME, LR_RESULT_VALUE RESULT, LR_UNIT_MEASURE UOM, CASE WHEN LR_ABNORMALITY_CD = 'HH' THEN 'Very High' WHEN LR_ABNORMALITY_CD = 'H' THEN 'High' WHEN LR_ABNORMALITY_CD = 'LL' THEN 'Very Low' WHEN LR_ABNORMALITY_CD = 'L' THEN 'Low' WHEN LR_ABNORMALITY_CD = 'AA' THEN 'Very Abnorm Txt' WHEN LR_ABNORMALITY_CD = 'A' THEN 'Abnorm Txt' ELSE LR_ABNORMALITY_CD END ABNORM, LR_ORD_ID LAB_ORDID , VIS_IP_OP_ADJUSTED_IND IP_OP , VIS_ADM_DT ADM_DT, VIS_DSCH_DT DSCH_DT, NURS_STA_DESC DSCH_LOC FROM IDB.LAB_RESULTS JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON LR_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.LAB_TEXT_LINE ON LR_RESULT_GUID = LTL_RESULT_GUID AND LTL_LINE_NO = 1 LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_ORDER ON LR_ORD_GUID = OO_ORD_GUID LEFT JOIN IDB.VISIT_V ON VIS_MRN = OO_MRN AND LR_PERFORMED_DT BETWEEN VIS_ADM_DT - 24 HOUR AND COALESCE(VIS_DSCH_DT, VIS_ADM_DT) + 24 HOUR WHERE LR_CTLG_ITEM_GUID IN('9000004428301010', '9000005397101010') AND LR_ENTER_DT BETWEEN CURRENT TIMESTAMP - 7 DAY AND CURRENT TIMESTAMP - 1 DAY

prompt: provide a list of patients with a diagnosis of small cell carcinoma and POU2F3 stain done.
completion: WITH INIT AS (SELECT PDWS_NAME, PDRX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID AS DEID, PT_MRN, PDRX_ACCESSION_NO, PDRX_DMP_PATIENT_ID, PDRX_DMP_SAMPLE_ID, DT_PROCEDURE, TUMOR_TYPE_CODE, TUMOR_TYPE_NAME, IS_METASTASIS, PRIMARY_SITE, METASTASIS_SITE, PART_DESCRIPTION, DV.REGEXSTR('[S|H|C][0-9]{2}\-[0-9]*', XMLCAST(XMLQUERY('$x/root/meta-data/part_description' PASSING PDRX_XML_VALUE AS "x") AS VARCHAR(2000))) AS REFERENCEDACCESSION FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML INNER JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML_SETTINGS ON PDRX_PATH_DMP_RESULTS_XML_ID = PDRXS_PATH_DMP_RESULTS_XML_ID INNER JOIN DVDMC.PATHOLOGY_DMP_WEBSVC_SETTINGS ON PDRXS_SETTING_ID = PDWS_SETTING_ID INNER JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON PDRX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID, XMLTABLE('$c/root/meta-data' PASSING PDRX_XML_VALUE AS "c" COLUMNS DT_PROCEDURE VARCHAR(40) PATH 'dt_procedure', TUMOR_TYPE_CODE VARCHAR(100) PATH 'tumor_type_code', TUMOR_TYPE_NAME VARCHAR(255) PATH 'tumor_type_name', IS_METASTASIS VARCHAR(10) PATH 'is_metastasis', PRIMARY_SITE VARCHAR(255) PATH 'primary_site', METASTASIS_SITE VARCHAR(255) PATH 'metastasis_site', PART_DESCRIPTION VARCHAR(2000) PATH 'part_description') T WHERE TUMOR_TYPE_CODE= 'SCLC' ) SELECT PRPT_MRN, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, PT_SEX, YEAR(CURRENT DATE -PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) AS AGE, TUMOR_TYPE_CODE, TUMOR_TYPE_NAME, PDRX_ACCESSION_NO, PRPT_PROCEDURE_DTE, PRPT_REPORT_DTE, PRPT_REPORT_TYPE_DESC, PRPT_ACCESSION_NO, PRPT_REPORT, DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)Addendum Date Ordered[\w\W]*(?=Signed out)', PRPT_REPORT) AS ADDENDUM_DX_TEXT , DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)Procedures/Addenda:[\w\W]*(?=Immunohistochemistry)', PRPT_REPORT) AS ADDENDUM_DX_TEXT, DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)diagnosis:[\w\W]*(?=I[ ]*ATTEST)', PRPT_REPORT) AS DIAGNOSIS_TEXT, DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)clinical diagnosis [and]*[&]* history:[\w\W]*(?=I[ ]*ATTEST)', PRPT_REPORT) AS CLINDX_TEXT FROM INIT T LEFT JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V ON T.PT_MRN = PRPT_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.PATIENT P ON T.PT_MRN = P.PT_MRN WHERE PRPT_REPORT IS NOT NULL AND CONTAINS("PRPT_REPORT", '("POU2F3" OR "pou2f3")') = 1 AND PRPT_PROCEDURE_DTE >= '2023-07-01'

prompt: Provide a biweekly list of patients with cervical cancer and ERBB2 mutation.
completion: WITH DX AS (SELECT CC_MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS DX_DTE, CC_CLSF_CD AS ICD_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS ICD_DESC FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE SUBSTR(CC_CLSF_CD, 1, 3) IN ('180', 'C53') AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' GROUP BY CC_MRN, CC_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK ) , ERBB2 AS (SELECT PT_MRN, GENE, GENE2, ABERRATIONTYPE, SEARCH_HIT1, SEARCH_HIT2 FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_STRUCTURED_RESULTS_V JOIN DX ON CC_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE 1=1 AND (GENE = 'ERBB2' OR GENE2 = 'ERBB2') ) SELECT DISTINCT CC_MRN "MRN" , DX_DTE "Dx Date" , ICD_DESC "Dx Desc" , GENE , GENE2 , ABERRATIONTYPE , SEARCH_HIT1 , SEARCH_HIT2 FROM DX A JOIN ERBB2 B ON CC_MRN = B.PT_MRN JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS C ON CC_MRN = C.PT_MRN WHERE 1=1 AND PT_VITAL_STATUS = 'ALIVE' ;

completion: WITH PTS AS (SELECT DISTINCT TM_MRN MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, AV_DESC AS CASE_STS, TM_DX_DTE, TM_HIST_CD, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS HIST_DESC, TM_SITE_CD, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_DESC FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PT_MRN = TM_MRN JOIN IDB.SEERGROUPING ON RECODE = IDB.SEERF_ICDO(TM_SITE_CD, TM_HIST_CD) JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS ON AV_ELEMENT = 'CASE_STS' AND AV_CODE = TM_CASE_STS AND TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8')), CHEMO AS (SELECT DISTINCT APR_MRN, APR_START_DTE, APR_GENERIC_NAME, APR_PRESCRIBED_DOSE, APR_ROUTE FROM PTS JOIN IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX ON MRN= APR_MRN WHERE APR_GENERIC_NAME IN ('PEMBROLIZUMAB', 'NIVOLUMAB', 'ATEZOLIZUMAB') ), ACCRUALS AS (SELECT DISTINCT AC_MRN, AC_IRB_NO, AC_NON_MSK_INST, AC_LAST_NAME, AC_FIRST_NAME, AC_PVDR_OF_RECORD_NAME, ACD_REG_DTE, ACD_TX_ST_DTE, ACD_TX_END_DTE, ACD_OFF_STUDY_DTE, ACD_CONS_DTE FROM CHEMO JOIN IDB.ACCRUALS ON AC_MRN = APR_MRN JOIN IDB.ACCRUALS_DATES ON AC_IRB_NO = ACD_IRB_NO AND AC_SUBJ_ID_NO = ACD_SUBJ_ID_NO AND AC_SUBJ_SEQ_NO = ACD_SUBJ_SEQ_NO WHERE ACD_OFF_STUDY_DTE IS NULL AND AC_IRB_NO IN ('09-141', '06-107', '12-245') ) SELECT DISTINCT PTS.* FROM PTS JOIN ACCRUALS ON AC_MRN = MRN ; WITH PTS AS (SELECT DISTINCT TM_MRN MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, AV_DESC AS CASE_STS, TM_DX_DTE, TM_HIST_CD, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS HIST_DESC, TM_SITE_CD, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_DESC FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PT_MRN = TM_MRN JOIN IDB.SEERGROUPING ON RECODE = IDB.SEERF_ICDO(TM_SITE_CD, TM_HIST_CD) JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS ON AV_ELEMENT = 'CASE_STS' AND AV_CODE = TM_CASE_STS AND TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8')), CHEMO AS (SELECT DISTINCT APR_MRN, APR_START_DTE, APR_GENERIC_NAME, APR_PRESCRIBED_DOSE, APR_ROUTE FROM PTS JOIN IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX ON MRN= APR_MRN WHERE APR_GENERIC_NAME IN ('PEMBROLIZUMAB', 'NIVOLUMAB', 'ATEZOLIZUMAB') ), ACCRUALS AS (SELECT DISTINCT AC_MRN, AC_IRB_NO, AC_NON_MSK_INST, AC_LAST_NAME, AC_FIRST_NAME, AC_PVDR_OF_RECORD_NAME, ACD_REG_DTE, ACD_TX_ST_DTE, ACD_TX_END_DTE, ACD_OFF_STUDY_DTE, ACD_CONS_DTE FROM CHEMO JOIN IDB.ACCRUALS ON AC_MRN = APR_MRN JOIN IDB.ACCRUALS_DATES ON AC_IRB_NO = ACD_IRB_NO AND AC_SUBJ_ID_NO = ACD_SUBJ_ID_NO AND AC_SUBJ_SEQ_NO = ACD_SUBJ_SEQ_NO WHERE ACD_OFF_STUDY_DTE IS NULL AND AC_IRB_NO IN ('09-141', '06-107', '12-245') ) SELECT DISTINCT CHEMO.* FROM CHEMO JOIN ACCRUALS ON AC_MRN = APR_MRN ; WITH PTS AS (SELECT DISTINCT TM_MRN MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, AV_DESC AS CASE_STS, TM_DX_DTE, TM_HIST_CD, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS HIST_DESC, TM_SITE_CD, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_DESC FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PT_MRN = TM_MRN JOIN IDB.SEERGROUPING ON RECODE = IDB.SEERF_ICDO(TM_SITE_CD, TM_HIST_CD) JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS ON AV_ELEMENT = 'CASE_STS' AND AV_CODE = TM_CASE_STS AND TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8')), CHEMO AS (SELECT DISTINCT APR_MRN, APR_START_DTE, APR_GENERIC_NAME, APR_PRESCRIBED_DOSE, APR_ROUTE FROM PTS JOIN IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX ON MRN= APR_MRN WHERE APR_GENERIC_NAME IN ('PEMBROLIZUMAB', 'NIVOLUMAB', 'ATEZOLIZUMAB') ), ACCRUALS AS (SELECT DISTINCT AC_MRN, AC_IRB_NO, AC_NON_MSK_INST, AC_LAST_NAME, AC_FIRST_NAME, AC_PVDR_OF_RECORD_NAME, ACD_REG_DTE, ACD_TX_ST_DTE, ACD_TX_END_DTE, ACD_OFF_STUDY_DTE, ACD_CONS_DTE FROM CHEMO JOIN IDB.ACCRUALS ON AC_MRN = APR_MRN JOIN IDB.ACCRUALS_DATES ON AC_IRB_NO = ACD_IRB_NO AND AC_SUBJ_ID_NO = ACD_SUBJ_ID_NO AND AC_SUBJ_SEQ_NO = ACD_SUBJ_SEQ_NO WHERE ACD_OFF_STUDY_DTE IS NULL AND AC_IRB_NO IN ('09-141', '06-107', '12-245') ) SELECT DISTINCT ACCRUALS.* FROM ACCRUALS ;

prompt: Provide a list of patients that have been seen in PACC between Jan - Apr 2019 whose most recent weight is between 0 and 15 kg
completion: WITH PTS AS (SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN AS "MRN" FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN '2019-01-01' AND '2019-04-30' AND CLD_DEPT_NAME IN ('PACC BED 1275', 'PACC TREATMENT 1275', 'PACC PROC RM 1275') ) , WT AS (SELECT PMH_MRN, PMH_MEASURE_DTE, PMH_WT_KG, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY PMH_MRN ORDER BY PMH_MEASURE_DTE DESC) RN FROM PTS JOIN IDB.PT_MEASURES_HX ON MRN = PMH_MRN) , PRIM_DOC AS (SELECT CPE_MRN PRIM_MRN, CRE_RES_NAME PRIM_DR FROM (SELECT CPE_MRN, CRE_RES_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CPE_MRN ORDER BY CNT DESC) RN FROM (SELECT CPE_MRN, CRE_RES_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT CPE_ENC_CSN_ID) CNT FROM PTS JOIN IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER ON MRN = CPE_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CRE_RES_TYP = 'Physician' GROUP BY CPE_MRN, CRE_RES_NAME ) A) B WHERE RN = 1 ) SELECT PMH_MRN MRN, PT_LAST_NAME "Last Name", PT_FIRST_NAME "First Name", PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH "DOB", PMH_MEASURE_DTE "Most recent measure date", PMH_WT_KG "Wt (kg)", PRIM_DR "Primary Doctor" FROM WT LEFT JOIN PRIM_DOC ON PMH_MRN = PRIM_MRN JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PMH_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE RN = 1 AND PMH_WT_KG BETWEEN 0 AND 15

prompt: Provide a report that queries the appropriate database for the associated ICD Codes for documents in ClinDoc.
completion: WITH X AS (SELECT DISTINCT STRIP(CDD_MRN) AS "MRN", STRIP(PT_LAST_NAME) AS "Last Name", STRIP(PT_FIRST_NAME) AS "First Name", CDD_SERVICE_DTE AS "Service Date", STRIP(CDD_DOC_NAME) AS "Document Name", CDD_DOC_GUID, STRIP(OP_DISPLAY_NAME) AS "Provider", OU_DISPLAY_NAME AS "Signer", OU_OCCUPATION AS "Signer Occupation", OU_ORD_ROLE_TYPE AS "Signer Role", STRIP(LGR_LOC_GRP) AS "Campus", STRIP(CDO_VALUE_TEXT) AS DX_0, OCV_IP_OP_IND , T.* FROM IDB.CD_DOCUMENT JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION ON CDD_DOC_GUID = CDO_DOC_GUID AND CDD_AUTHORED_DTE = CDO_AUTHORED_DTE AND CDO_VALUE_TEXT <> '' JOIN IDB.OMS_PROVIDER ON CDD_AUTH_PROV_GUID = OP_PVDR_GUID LEFT JOIN IDB.CD_DOCUMENT_HISTORY ON CDD_DOC_GUID = CDH_CLIENT_DOC_GUID AND CDD_CLIENT_GUID = CDH_CLIENT_GUID LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_USER ON CDH_USER_GUID = OU_USER_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_CLIENT_VISIT ON CDD_VISIT_GUID = OCV_VISIT_GUID JOIN IDB.LOCATION_GROUPS_REFERENCE ON OCV_CURR_LOC_GUID = LGR_LOC_GUID JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON CDD_MRN = PT_MRN CROSS JOIN TABLE(DV.REGEXTABLE('(?<=\[)[^\]]*', STRIP(SUBSTR(CDO_VALUE_TEXT, 1, 2000)))) T WHERE CDD_CANCEL_IND <> '1' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND <> '1' AND CDD_SERVICE_DTE BETWEEN '2021-07-01' AND '2021-09-30' AND CDO_MSTR_ITEM_NM = 'Billing_ProblemList_FT' AND CDD_DOC_NAME IN ('Initial Visit, AMB - Rad Onc', 'Initial Visit, AMB - Radiation Oncology', 'Subsequent New Visit, AMB - Rad Onc') AND(CDO_VALUE_TEXT like '%]%' OR CDO_VALUE_TEXT like '%[%') ) , Y AS (SELECT "MRN", "Last Name", "First Name", "Service Date", "Document Name", CDD_DOC_GUID, "Provider", "Signer", "Signer Occupation", "Signer Role", "Campus", OCV_IP_OP_IND, LISTAGG(COALESCE(STRIP(RETURN_VALUE), '') , CHR(13) || CHR(10)) WITHIN GROUP( ORDER BY "MRN", "Service Date") AS ICD_10 FROM X GROUP BY "MRN", "Last Name", "First Name", "Service Date", "Document Name", CDD_DOC_GUID, "Provider", "Signer", "Signer Occupation", "Signer Role", "Campus", OCV_IP_OP_IND UNION SELECT DISTINCT STRIP(CDD_MRN) AS "MRN", STRIP(PT_LAST_NAME) AS "Last Name", STRIP(PT_FIRST_NAME) AS "First Name", CDD_SERVICE_DTE AS "Service Date", STRIP(CDD_DOC_NAME) AS "Document Name", CDD_DOC_GUID, STRIP(OP_DISPLAY_NAME) AS "Provider", OU_DISPLAY_NAME AS "Signer", OU_OCCUPATION AS "Signer Occupation", OU_ORD_ROLE_TYPE AS "Signer Role", STRIP(LGR_LOC_GRP) AS "Campus", OCV_IP_OP_IND, STRIP(CDO_VALUE_TEXT) AS ICD_10 FROM IDB.CD_DOCUMENT JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION ON CDD_DOC_GUID = CDO_DOC_GUID AND CDD_AUTHORED_DTE = CDO_AUTHORED_DTE AND CDO_VALUE_TEXT <> '' JOIN IDB.OMS_PROVIDER ON CDD_AUTH_PROV_GUID = OP_PVDR_GUID LEFT JOIN IDB.CD_DOCUMENT_HISTORY ON CDD_DOC_GUID = CDH_CLIENT_DOC_GUID AND CDD_CLIENT_GUID = CDH_CLIENT_GUID LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_USER ON CDH_USER_GUID = OU_USER_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_CLIENT_VISIT ON CDD_VISIT_GUID = OCV_VISIT_GUID JOIN IDB.LOCATION_GROUPS_REFERENCE ON OCV_CURR_LOC_GUID = LGR_LOC_GUID JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON CDD_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE CDD_CANCEL_IND <> '1' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND <> '1' AND CDD_SERVICE_DTE BETWEEN '2021-07-01' AND '2021-09-30' AND CDO_MSTR_ITEM_NM = 'Billing_ProblemList_FT' AND CDD_DOC_NAME IN ('Initial Visit, AMB - Rad Onc', 'Initial Visit, AMB - Radiation Oncology', 'Subsequent New Visit, AMB - Rad Onc') AND CDO_VALUE_TEXT not like '%]%' AND CDO_VALUE_TEXT not like '%[%' ) , Z AS (SELECT * FROM Y WHERE "Signer Role" NOT IN ('Housestaff', 'Fellow') ) , Z1 AS (SELECT * FROM Z WHERE "Signer Role" IN ('Attending') ) , Z2 AS (SELECT * FROM Z WHERE "Signer Role" IN ('Nurse Practitioner', 'Physician Assistant', 'Advanced Practice Nurse') ) , Z3 AS (SELECT * FROM Z1 UNION SELECT * FROM Z2 WHERE CDD_DOC_GUID NOT IN (SELECT CDD_DOC_GUID FROM Z1) ) , Z4 AS (SELECT DISTINCT "MRN", "Last Name", "First Name", "Service Date", "Document Name", Z3.CDD_DOC_GUID, "Provider", "Signer Role", "Signer", "Campus", OCV_IP_OP_IND, ICD_10, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY Z3.CDD_DOC_GUID ORDER BY "Signer") AS RN FROM Z3 ) SELECT * FROM Z4 WHERE RN = 1

prompt: We need all patients with a diagnosis in the hospital of intracranial hemorrhage, intracranial bleed, stroke, and neurological catastrophe during their care between 1/1/2004- 1/31/2019. Along with the diagnosis they also need to have died in the ICU during the same time period.
completion: WITH DSCH_ICU_DECEASED_DISPO AS (SELECT DISTINCT VIS_MRN MRN, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, VIS_DSCH_DISP, PT_SEX, PT_DATE_OF_DEATH, VIS_NURS_STA FROM IDB.VISIT_V LEFT JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PT_MRN=VIS_MRN AND PT_DATE_OF_DEATH IS NOT NULL WHERE VIS_NURS_STA like '%ICU%' AND VIS_DSCH_DTE BETWEEN '2004-01-01' AND '2019-01-31' AND SUBSTR(VIS_DSCH_DISP, 1, 1) IN ('C', 'D') ), DX AS (SELECT CC_MRN, CC_EFF_DTE, CC_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK, PT_DATE_OF_DEATH FROM DSCH_ICU_DECEASED_DISPO JOIN IDB.CTC_CLSF ON CC_MRN = MRN JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE CC_CLSF_CD IN ('I62.9', '432.9', 'I61.9', '431', 'I63.9', '434.91', 'R40.20', '780.01') AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND CC_EFF_DTE BETWEEN '2004-01-01' AND '2019-01-31' ) SELECT DISTINCT MRN, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, PT_SEX, VIS_NURS_STA, DX.PT_DATE_OF_DEATH, CC_EFF_DTE DX_DTE, CC_CLSF_CD DX_ICD_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK DX_DESC FROM DSCH_ICU_DECEASED_DISPO JOIN DX ON CC_MRN = MRN ORDER BY MRN, CC_EFF_DTE DESC ;
