prompt: Tableau dashboard for Clinical Genetics Appointments for Breast Cancer Patients
completion: WITH DX AS (SELECT CC_MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) DX_DTE FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON CC_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE SUBSTR(CC_CLSF_CD, 1, 3) IN ('174', 'C50') AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND (CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) AND PT_DATE_OF_DEATH IS NULL GROUP BY CC_MRN) SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN "MRN", DX_DTE "Diagnosis Date", MIN(CPE_ENC_DTE) "First Appt Date", MAX(CPE_ENC_DTE) "Last Appt Date", COUNT(*) "Number of Appts" FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID JOIN DX ON CPE_MRN = CC_MRN WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 = 'GNT' GROUP BY CPE_MRN, DX_DTE

prompt: Please provide disease/diagnosis data for patients enrolled on this protocol. If available, we would also like stage of disease.
completion: SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN "MRN" , PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH "DOB" , ACD_REG_DTE "Date Enrolled" , CASE WHEN HIST_DESC IS NULL THEN ICD9_DESC ELSE HIST_DESC END AS "Histology" , SITE_DESC "Site" , LATERALITY "Laterality" , STAGE "Stage" FROM IDB.PATIENT JOIN IDB.ACCRUALS_DATES ON PT_MRN = ACD_MRN AND ACD_IRB_NO = '16-001' AND ACD_REG_DTE >= '2017-11-01' LEFT JOIN (SELECT TM_MRN, TM_HIST_TXT, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS HIST_DESC, TM_BEST_AJCC_STG AS STAGE, TM_SITE_TXT, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_DESC, L.AV_DESC AS LATERALITY FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS C ON C.AV_ELEMENT = 'CASE_STS' AND C.AV_CODE = TM_CASE_STS AND TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND TM_SITE_CD LIKE 'C34%' JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS L ON L.AV_ELEMENT = 'LATERALITY_CD' AND L.AV_CODE = TM_LATERALITY_CD) CDBT ON PT_MRN = TM_MRN LEFT JOIN (SELECT CC_MRN, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS ICD9_DESC FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE SUBSTR(CC_CLSF_CD, 1, 3) IN ('162', 'C34') AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND (CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) ) CTRAC ON PT_MRN = CC_MRN WHERE PT_MRN <> 'ZZZZZZZZ'

prompt:
We are investigating whether antibiotic treatment in patients under active immune checkpoint blockade is associated with the occurrence of immune related cutaneous adverse events.

As a control group, I need to understand the frequency of antibiotic treatment in patients treated with immune checkpoint blockade (ICB).
completion: WITH PRE_BASE AS (SELECT DISTINCT APR_MRN MRN FROM IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX_V WHERE CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME IN ('CEMIPLIMAB', 'DURVALUMAB', 'IPILIMUMAB', 'ATEZOLIZUMAB', 'AVELUMAB', 'NIVOLUMAB', 'CEMIPLIMAB', 'PEMBROLIZUMAB', 'MEDI0680 (AMP-514)', 'SPARTALIZUMAB (PDR001)') AND APR_PLACEBO_FLAG <> 'Y' AND APR_START_DTE BETWEEN '2017-09-28' AND '2020-09-28' ) , BASE AS (SELECT APR_MRN , PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH DOB , MIN(APR_START_DTE) ICB_START_DTE , MAX(APR_START_DTE) ICB_LAST_DTE FROM IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX_V JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON APR_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN PRE_BASE ON APR_MRN = MRN WHERE CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME IN ('CEMIPLIMAB', 'DURVALUMAB', 'IPILIMUMAB', 'ATEZOLIZUMAB', 'AVELUMAB', 'NIVOLUMAB', 'CEMIPLIMAB', 'PEMBROLIZUMAB', 'MEDI0680 (AMP-514)', 'SPARTALIZUMAB (PDR001)') AND APR_PLACEBO_FLAG <> 'Y' GROUP BY APR_MRN , PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH ) , MEDS AS (SELECT OO_MRN , OOC_ITEM_DESC , MIN(OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE) DRUG_START_DTE , MAX(OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE) DRUG_LAST_DTE FROM IDB.OMS_ORDER JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_CATALOG ON OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID = OOC_MSTR_ITEM_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_MED_DETAIL ON OMD_ORD_GUID = OO_ORD_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_STATUS ON OO_ORD_STS_CD = OSTS_ORD_STS_CD JOIN BASE ON OO_MRN = APR_MRN AND OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE BETWEEN ICB_START_DTE AND ICB_LAST_DTE WHERE OO_ORD_STS_CD NOT IN ('CANC', 'CANP', 'AUC3') AND OOC_THERAPEUTIC_CAT like 'anti-infectives | %' GROUP BY OO_MRN , OOC_ITEM_DESC ) , EXC AS (SELECT DISTINCT CC_MRN FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.SEERGROUPING ON CLM_CLSF_RECODE = RECODE AND CATEGORY1 IN ('Lymphoma', 'Myeloma', 'Leukemia') JOIN BASE ON CC_MRN = APR_MRN WHERE CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND (CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) ) SELECT APR_MRN MRN , DOB , ICB_START_DTE , ICB_LAST_DTE , OOC_ITEM_DESC DRUG_NAME , DRUG_START_DTE , DRUG_LAST_DTE FROM BASE LEFT JOIN MEDS ON APR_MRN = OO_MRN WHERE APR_MRN NOT IN (SELECT CC_MRN FROM EXC)

prompt: List of all image guided biopsies performed in Interventional Radiology between Jan1, 2016 and Dec 31, 2017 and indication of whether an IMPACT order was requested or not for that biopsy
completion: SELECT DISTINCT PBD_MRN MRN FROM IDB.PBD_DTL JOIN IDB.PBD_CODE ON PBD_PBD_CD = PBC_PBD_CD WHERE PBC_PBD_DESC LIKE '%BIOP%' AND PBC_PBD_DESC LIKE '%IMAG%' AND PBD_SVC_DTE BETWEEN '2015-01-01' AND '2017-12-31' SELECT OO_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME "LAST NAME", PT_FIRST_NAME "FIRST NAME", OO_ENTER_DTE "IMPACT ORDER DATE", OO_SUMMARY_LINE "IMPACT SUMMARY", OSTS_STS_DESC AS "ORDER STATUS" FROM IDB.OMS_ORDER JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PT_MRN = OO_MRN JOIN IDB.OMS_STATUS ON OO_ORD_STS_CD = OSTS_ORD_STS_CD WHERE OO_MRN IN ({}) AND OO_SET_NAME = 'MSK-IMPACT' AND OO_ENTER_DTE BETWEEN '2015-01-01' AND '2017-12-31' SELECT PT_MRN AS "MRN", PT_LAST_NAME "LAST NAME", PT_FIRST_NAME "FIRST NAME", DT_DTE "PROCEDURE DATE", PRPT_ACCESSION_NO "ACCESSION NO", PRPT_REPORT "PATH REPORT", PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_DESC AS PATH_RPT_TYPE FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V JOIN DV.DATE ON PRPT_PROCEDURE_DATE_ID = DT_DATE_ID JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V ON PRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID JOIN DV.PATH_RPRT_TYPE_LOOKUP ON PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_CD = PRPT_REPORT_TYPE WHERE PT_MRN IN ({}) AND DT_DTE BETWEEN '2015-01-01' AND '2017-12-31' SELECT DISTINCT PBD_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME "LAST NAME", PT_FIRST_NAME "FIRST NAME", PBC_PBD_DESC "BIOPSY DESC", PBD_SVC_DTE "BIOPSY DATE" FROM IDB.PBD_DTL JOIN IDB.PBD_CODE ON PBD_PBD_CD = PBC_PBD_CD JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PT_MRN = PBD_MRN WHERE PBD_MRN IN ({}) AND PBC_PBD_DESC LIKE '%BIOP%' AND PBC_PBD_DESC LIKE '%IMAG%' AND PBD_SVC_DTE BETWEEN '2015-01-01' AND '2017-12-31'

prompt: List of all patients who are currently on or received brentuximab vedotin
completion: WITH APR AS (SELECT APR_MRN, APR_START_DTE, APR_PRESCRIBED_DOSE, PMH_WT_KG, ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY APR_MRN, APR_START_DTE ORDER BY PMH_MEASURE_DTE DESC) AS RN FROM IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX_V LEFT JOIN IDB.PT_MEASURES_HX ON APR_MRN = PMH_MRN AND APR_START_DTE >= PMH_MEASURE_DTE WHERE CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME = 'BRENTUXIMAB VEDOTIN' AND APR_START_DTE IS NOT NULL ) , PTS AS (SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN, CASE WHEN COALESCE(R.AV_DESC, CR.AV_DESC) IN ('WHITE', 'WHITE HISPANIC') THEN 'White' WHEN COALESCE(R.AV_DESC, CR.AV_DESC) IN ('BLACK OR AFRICAN AMERICAN', 'BLACK', 'BLACK HISPANIC') THEN 'Black' WHEN COALESCE(R.AV_DESC, CR.AV_DESC) IN ('ASIAN-FAR EAST/INDIAN SUBCONT', 'KAMPUCHEAN', 'LAOTIAN', 'VIETNAMESE', 'HMONG', 'CHINESE', 'ASIAN INDIAN PAKISTANI', 'JAPANESE', 'KOREAN', 'OTHER ASIAN', 'THAI') THEN 'Asian' WHEN COALESCE(R.AV_DESC, CR.AV_DESC) IN ('NATIVE AMERICAN-AM IND/ALASKA', 'AMER IND ALEUT ESKIMO') THEN 'Native American or Alaska Native' WHEN COALESCE(R.AV_DESC, CR.AV_DESC) IN ('NATIVE HAWAIIAN OR PACIFIC ISL', 'HAWAIIAN', 'MELANESIAN', 'MICRONESIAN', 'FIJI ISLANDER', 'FILIPINO', 'GUAMANIAN', 'PACIFIC ISLANDER') THEN 'Native Hawaiian or Other Pacific Islander' ELSE 'Unspecified' END AS PT_RACE, CASE WHEN COALESCE(CE.AV_DESC, E.AV_DESC) IN ('SPANISH NOS; HISPANIC NOS, LATINO NOS', 'HISPANIC OR LATINO', 'PUERTO RICAN', 'SOUTH/CENTRAL AMERICA (EXCEPT BRAZIL)', 'DOMINICAN REPUBLIC', 'OTHER SPANISH/HISPANIC(INCL EUROPEAN; EXCL DOM REP)', 'CUBAN', 'MEXICAN (INCLUDES CHICANO)') OR COALESCE(R.AV_DESC, CR.AV_DESC) IN ('WHITE HISPANIC', 'BLACK HISPANIC') THEN 'Hispanic' WHEN COALESCE(CE.AV_DESC, E.AV_DESC) IN ('NOT HISPANIC', 'SPANISH SURNAME ONLY', 'NON-SPANISH; NON-HISPANIC') THEN 'Non-Hispanic' ELSE 'Unspecified' END AS PT_ETHNICITY, PT_SEX, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH FROM IDB.PATIENT JOIN APR ON PT_MRN = APR_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS R ON R.AV_ELEMENT = 'RACE' AND R.AV_CODE = PT_RACE LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS E ON E.AV_ELEMENT = 'PT_ETHNICITY' AND E.AV_CODE = PT_PT_ETHNICITY LEFT JOIN IDB.CDB_PATIENT ON PT_MRN = CP_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS CR ON CR.AV_ELEMENT = 'CDB_RACE' AND CR.AV_CODE = CP_CDB_RACE LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS CE ON CE.AV_ELEMENT = 'ETHNICITY' AND CE.AV_CODE = CP_ETHNICITY) , DX AS (SELECT DISTINCT OO_MRN, OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE, OUD_USER_DI_VALUE FROM IDB.OMS_ORDER JOIN APR ON OO_MRN = APR_MRN AND OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE = APR_START_DTE AND RN=1 JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_CATALOG ON OOC_MSTR_ITEM_GUID = OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_USER_DATA ON OUD_ORD_GUID = OO_ORD_GUID AND OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'Cancer Diagnosis' WHERE OO_ORD_STS_CD NOT IN ('CANP', 'CANC') AND OOC_ITEM_NAME = 'Chemo Tx' ) , DERM AS (SELECT CDD_MRN , MIN(CDD_SERVICE_DTE) AS FIRST_DERM_DTE FROM IDB.CD_DOCUMENT JOIN APR ON CDD_MRN = APR_MRN AND CDD_SERVICE_DTE >= APR_START_DTE AND RN=1 WHERE CDD_CANCEL_IND <> '1' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND <> '1' AND CDD_DOC_NAME IN ('Follow Up - Dermatology', 'Initial Consult/Initial Visit - Dermatology') GROUP BY CDD_MRN ) , PTH AS (SELECT PRPT_MRN, COALESCE(PRPT_PROCEDURE_DTE, DV.REGEXSTR('(?<=Date of Collection\/Procedure\/Outside Report: ).*', PRPT_REPORT)) AS SKIN_BIOP_DTE, DV.REGEXSTR('(?<=DIAGNOSIS:)[\S\s]*(?=I ATTEST)', PRPT_REPORT) SKIN_BIOP_DX_SECT FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V JOIN PTS ON PRPT_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE PRPT_REPORT IS NOT NULL AND CONTAINS("PRPT_REPORT", '("SKIN" & "BIOPSY")') = 1 AND PRPT_REPORT_TYPE_DESC = 'Surgical Pathology' ) SELECT APR_MRN MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH DOB, PT_SEX SEX, PT_RACE RACE, PT_ETHNICITY ETHNICITY, APR_START_DTE AS BRENT_VEDO_DTE, APR_PRESCRIBED_DOSE DOSE_MG, PMH_WT_KG WT_KG, OUD_USER_DI_VALUE AS CANCER_DX, FIRST_DERM_DTE, SKIN_BIOP_DTE, SKIN_BIOP_DX_SECT FROM APR JOIN PTS ON APR_MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN DX ON APR_MRN = OO_MRN AND OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE = APR_START_DTE LEFT JOIN PTH ON APR_MRN = PRPT_MRN LEFT JOIN DERM ON APR_MRN = CDD_MRN WHERE RN = 1

prompt: Provide contact information for the parents of deceased pediatric patients and data about those patients.
completion: WITH PTS AS (SELECT A.RPT_MRN, C1.RRD_REL_NAME AS EMERG_CON_RELATION, A.RPT_CONT_1_NAME AS EMERG_CON_NAME, A.RPT_U_CONT_1_PHONE AS EMERG_CON_PHONE, C2.RRD_REL_NAME AS NEAREST_LIVING_RELATION, A.RPT_CONT_2_NAME AS NEAREST_LIVING_NAME, A.RPT_U_CONT_2_PHONE AS NEAREST_LIVING_PHONE, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, PT_DATE_OF_DEATH, YEAR(PT_DATE_OF_DEATH - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) AS AGE_AT_DEATH, CASE WHEN PT_DEATH_IND IN ('C', 'D') THEN 'Died at MSK' WHEN PT_DEATH_IND = 'X' THEN 'Died Elsewhere' END AS DEATH_LOCATION, PT_ADDR1, PT_ADDR2, PT_CITY, PT_STATE, PT_ZIP_CD, PT_COUNTRY, PT_PHONE, PLA_LST_TX_DTE, PLA_LST_CHEMO_DTE, PLA_LST_RT_DTE, PLA_LST_SURG_DTE FROM IDB.RMS_PATIENT A JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON A.RPT_MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.RMS_RELATION_DICT_DN31 C1 ON RPT_CONT_1_REL_REC_NO = C1.RRD_RECORD_NUMBER LEFT JOIN IDB.RMS_RELATION_DICT_DN31 C2 ON RPT_CONT_2_REL_REC_NO = C2.RRD_RECORD_NUMBER LEFT JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY ON A.RPT_MRN = PLA_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTV_DTL ON A.RPT_MRN = LAD_MRN WHERE 1=1 AND PT_DATE_OF_DEATH >= '2014-01-01' AND YEAR(PT_DATE_OF_DEATH - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) <= 39 AND PT_STATE IN ('NY', 'NJ') AND LAD_DONOT_CON_IND <> 'Y' ) , DX AS (SELECT PT_MRN, TUMOR_REG_DATA, ICD_DATA FROM IDB.PATIENT LEFT JOIN (SELECT TM_MRN, LISTAGG(CHAR(TM_DX_DTE, ISO) || ' | ' || TRIM(TM_SITE_CD) || ' | ' || TRIM(SITE_DESC) || ' | ' || TRIM(TM_HIST_CD) || ' | ' || TRIM(HIST_DESC) || ' | ' || TRIM(CASE_STS), CHR(13) || CHR(10)) WITHIN GROUP( ORDER BY TM_DX_DTE) AS TUMOR_REG_DATA FROM (SELECT DISTINCT TM_MRN, AV_DESC AS CASE_STS, TM_DX_DTE, TM_HIST_CD, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS HIST_DESC, TM_SITE_CD, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_DESC FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS ON AV_ELEMENT = 'CASE_STS' AND AV_CODE = TM_CASE_STS AND TM_CASE_STS IN ('3', '6', '7')) A GROUP BY TM_MRN) AS CDB ON TM_MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN (SELECT CC_MRN, LISTAGG(CHAR(MIN_ICD_EFF_DTE, ISO) || ' | ' || TRIM(ICD_CD) || ' | ' || TRIM(ICD_DESC), CHR(13) || CHR(10)) WITHIN GROUP( ORDER BY MIN_ICD_EFF_DTE) AS ICD_DATA FROM (SELECT DISTINCT CC_MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS MIN_ICD_EFF_DTE, CC_CLSF_CD AS ICD_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS ICD_DESC FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE 1=1 AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND ((CC_CLSF_CD BETWEEN '140' AND '239.99') OR (CC_CLSF_CD BETWEEN 'C00' AND 'D49')) GROUP BY CC_MRN, CC_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK ) A GROUP BY CC_MRN) AS ICD ON CC_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE COALESCE(TM_MRN, CC_MRN) IS NOT NULL ) , DX_FINAL AS (SELECT PT_MRN DX_MRN, TUMOR_REG_DATA, ICD_DATA FROM DX JOIN PTS ON RPT_MRN = PT_MRN) , APPTS AS (SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN PTS ON RPT_MRN = CPE_MRN WHERE CRE_RES_ID IN ('013854', '023093', '459174', '014670', '018432') AND CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') ) SELECT RPT_MRN "MRN", PT_LAST_NAME "PT Last Name", PT_FIRST_NAME "PT First Name", PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH "DOB", PT_DATE_OF_DEATH "DOD", AGE_AT_DEATH "Age at Death", DEATH_LOCATION "Location of Death", PT_ADDR1 "Address 1", PT_ADDR2 "Address 2", PT_CITY "City", PT_STATE "State", PT_ZIP_CD "Zip Code", PT_COUNTRY "Country", PT_PHONE "Phone", PLA_LST_TX_DTE "Last Tx Date", PLA_LST_CHEMO_DTE "Last Chemo Date", PLA_LST_RT_DTE "Last RT Date", PLA_LST_SURG_DTE "Last Surgery Date", EMERG_CON_RELATION "Emergency Contact Relation", EMERG_CON_NAME "Emergency Contact Name", NEAREST_LIVING_RELATION "Nearest Living Relation", NEAREST_LIVING_NAME "Nearest Living Name", TUMOR_REG_DATA "CDB Dx Data", ICD_DATA "ICD Dx Data" FROM PTS JOIN APPTS ON RPT_MRN = CPE_MRN LEFT JOIN DX_FINAL ON RPT_MRN = DX_MRN WHERE 1=1

prompt: Provide a list of renal medullary carcinoma patients and clinical data for retrospective research. For 1/1/2000 - 6/19/2020.
completion: WITH PREP AS (SELECT OTR_RELEASE_NAME, OTR_RELEASE_DATE, OTTT_CODE, OTTT_NAME, OTTT_MAINTYPENAME, OTTT_TISSUE FROM (SELECT OTR_RELEASE_NAME, OTR_RELEASE_DATE, OTTT_CODE, OTTT_NAME, OTTT_MAINTYPENAME, OTTT_TISSUE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY OTTT_CODE ORDER BY CASE WHEN OTR_RELEASE_NAME = 'oncotree_latest_stable' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END DESC, OTR_RELEASE_DATE DESC) RN FROM DSGTOOLS.ONCOTREE_TUMORTYPE_V WHERE OTR_RELEASE_NAME NOT IN ('oncotree_development', 'oncotree_candidate_release') ) WHERE RN = 1 ) , ONCOTREE AS (SELECT PDWS_NAME, PDRX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID AS DEID, PT_MRN AS MRN, PDRX_ACCESSION_NO, PDRX_DMP_PATIENT_ID, PDRX_DMP_SAMPLE_ID, TUMOR_TYPE_CODE, TUMOR_TYPE_NAME, OTTT_MAINTYPENAME, OTTT_TISSUE, OTR_RELEASE_NAME, IS_METASTASIS, PRIMARY_SITE, METASTASIS_SITE, PART_DESCRIPTION FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML INNER JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML_SETTINGS ON PDRX_PATH_DMP_RESULTS_XML_ID = PDRXS_PATH_DMP_RESULTS_XML_ID INNER JOIN DVDMC.PATHOLOGY_DMP_WEBSVC_SETTINGS ON PDRXS_SETTING_ID = PDWS_SETTING_ID INNER JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON PDRX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID, XMLTABLE('$c/root/meta-data' PASSING PDRX_XML_VALUE AS "c" COLUMNS TUMOR_TYPE_CODE VARCHAR(100) PATH 'tumor_type_code', TUMOR_TYPE_NAME VARCHAR(255) PATH 'tumor_type_name', IS_METASTASIS VARCHAR(10) PATH 'is_metastasis', PRIMARY_SITE VARCHAR(255) PATH 'primary_site', METASTASIS_SITE VARCHAR(255) PATH 'metastasis_site', PART_DESCRIPTION VARCHAR(2000) PATH 'part_description') T INNER JOIN PREP ON TUMOR_TYPE_CODE = OTTT_CODE WHERE TUMOR_TYPE_NAME = 'Renal Medullary Carcinoma' ) , DX AS (SELECT TM_MRN, AV_DESC AS CASE_STS, TM_DX_DTE, TM_HIST_CD, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS HIST_DESC, TM_SITE_CD, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_DESC, TM_BEST_AJCC_STG FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS ON AV_ELEMENT = 'CASE_STS' AND AV_CODE = TM_CASE_STS WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND TM_HIST_CD = 'M8510/3' AND TM_SITE_CD = 'C649' ) , MRN_LIST AS (SELECT COALESCE(TM_MRN, MRN) AS MRN, CASE WHEN MRN IS NOT NULL THEN 'Y' ELSE NULL END AS "Oncotree" FROM DX FULL OUTER JOIN ONCOTREE ON TM_MRN = MRN) , DIAGNOSES AS (SELECT TM_MRN, AV_DESC AS CASE_STS, TM_DX_DTE, TM_HIST_CD, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS HIST_DESC, TM_SITE_CD, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_DESC, TM_BEST_AJCC_STG FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS ON AV_ELEMENT = 'CASE_STS' AND AV_CODE = TM_CASE_STS WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') ) SELECT TM_MRN AS "MRN", TM_DX_DTE AS "Diagnosis date", TM_HIST_CD AS "Histology code", HIST_DESC AS "Histology", TM_SITE_CD AS "Site code", SITE_DESC AS "Site", "Oncotree" FROM DIAGNOSES INNER JOIN MRN_LIST ON TM_MRN = MRN WHERE TM_SITE_CD = 'C649' ; WITH PREP AS (SELECT OTR_RELEASE_NAME, OTR_RELEASE_DATE, OTTT_CODE, OTTT_NAME, OTTT_MAINTYPENAME, OTTT_TISSUE FROM (SELECT OTR_RELEASE_NAME, OTR_RELEASE_DATE, OTTT_CODE, OTTT_NAME, OTTT_MAINTYPENAME, OTTT_TISSUE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY OTTT_CODE ORDER BY CASE WHEN OTR_RELEASE_NAME = 'oncotree_latest_stable' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END DESC, OTR_RELEASE_DATE DESC) RN FROM DSGTOOLS.ONCOTREE_TUMORTYPE_V WHERE OTR_RELEASE_NAME NOT IN ('oncotree_development', 'oncotree_candidate_release') ) WHERE RN = 1 ) , ONCOTREE AS (SELECT PDWS_NAME, PDRX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID AS DEID, PT_MRN AS MRN, PDRX_ACCESSION_NO, PDRX_DMP_PATIENT_ID, PDRX_DMP_SAMPLE_ID, TUMOR_TYPE_CODE, TUMOR_TYPE_NAME, OTTT_MAINTYPENAME, OTTT_TISSUE, OTR_RELEASE_NAME, IS_METASTASIS, PRIMARY_SITE, METASTASIS_SITE, PART_DESCRIPTION FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML INNER JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML_SETTINGS ON PDRX_PATH_DMP_RESULTS_XML_ID = PDRXS_PATH_DMP_RESULTS_XML_ID INNER JOIN DVDMC.PATHOLOGY_DMP_WEBSVC_SETTINGS ON PDRXS_SETTING_ID = PDWS_SETTING_ID INNER JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON PDRX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID, XMLTABLE('$c/root/meta-data' PASSING PDRX_XML_VALUE AS "c" COLUMNS TUMOR_TYPE_CODE VARCHAR(100) PATH 'tumor_type_code', TUMOR_TYPE_NAME VARCHAR(255) PATH 'tumor_type_name', IS_METASTASIS VARCHAR(10) PATH 'is_metastasis', PRIMARY_SITE VARCHAR(255) PATH 'primary_site', METASTASIS_SITE VARCHAR(255) PATH 'metastasis_site', PART_DESCRIPTION VARCHAR(2000) PATH 'part_description') T INNER JOIN PREP ON TUMOR_TYPE_CODE = OTTT_CODE WHERE TUMOR_TYPE_NAME = 'Renal Medullary Carcinoma' ) , DX AS (SELECT TM_MRN, AV_DESC AS CASE_STS, TM_DX_DTE, TM_HIST_CD, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS HIST_DESC, TM_SITE_CD, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_DESC, TM_BEST_AJCC_STG FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS ON AV_ELEMENT = 'CASE_STS' AND AV_CODE = TM_CASE_STS WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND TM_HIST_CD = 'M8510/3' AND TM_SITE_CD = 'C649' ) , MRN_LIST AS (SELECT COALESCE(TM_MRN, MRN) AS MRN, CASE WHEN MRN IS NOT NULL THEN 'Y' ELSE NULL END AS "Oncotree" FROM DX FULL OUTER JOIN ONCOTREE ON TM_MRN = MRN) , DIAGNOSES AS (SELECT TM_MRN, AV_DESC AS CASE_STS, TM_DX_DTE, TM_HIST_CD, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS HIST_DESC, TM_SITE_CD, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_DESC, TM_BEST_AJCC_STG FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR INNER JOIN MRN_LIST ON TM_MRN = MRN JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS ON AV_ELEMENT = 'CASE_STS' AND AV_CODE = TM_CASE_STS WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') ) SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN AS "MRN" , PT_LAST_NAME AS "Last Name" , PT_FIRST_NAME AS "First Name" , PT_SEX AS "Gender" , PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH AS "Date of Birth" , PT_DATE_OF_DEATH AS "Date of Death" , R.AV_DESC AS "Race (Reg)" , E.AV_DESC AS "Ethnicity (Reg)" FROM IDB.PATIENT JOIN DIAGNOSES ON PT_MRN = TM_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS R ON R.AV_ELEMENT = 'RACE' AND R.AV_CODE = PT_RACE LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS E ON E.AV_ELEMENT = 'PT_ETHNICITY' AND E.AV_CODE = PT_PT_ETHNICITY ;

prompt: Requesting similar report to MED10183 but for Pediatrics and also to add/change a few elements suitable for PEDS needs in tracking 08-047 consented patients to the CIBMTR federally mandated national registry.
completion: WITH PEDS AS (SELECT DISTINCT CBP_MRN, CBP_TRANSPLANT_DTE, CBP_INDICATION_CD, CBP_INDICATION_DESC, CBP_TRANSPLANT_TYPE FROM IDB.CRDB_BMT_PEDIATRICS), PROTOCOL AS (SELECT DISTINCT AC_MRN, AC_LAST_NAME, AC_FIRST_NAME, PRO_IRB_NO, PRO_IRB_TITLE, PRO_PROTOCOL_TYPE, ACD_OFF_STUDY_DTE, AC_CONS_DTE, AC_CONS_STAFF_NAME, AC_PVDR_OF_RECORD_NAME FROM PEDS JOIN IDB.ACCRUALS ON CBP_MRN = AC_MRN JOIN IDB.PROTOCOL ON PRO_IRB_NO = AC_IRB_NO JOIN IDB.ACCRUALS_DATES ON AC_IRB_NO = ACD_IRB_NO AND AC_SUBJ_ID_NO = ACD_SUBJ_ID_NO AND AC_SUBJ_SEQ_NO = ACD_SUBJ_SEQ_NO WHERE PRO_IRB_NO = '08-047' AND ACD_OFF_STUDY_DTE IS NULL ) SELECT DISTINCT AC_MRN AS MRN, PT_LAST_NAME AS "Last Name", PT_FIRST_NAME AS "First Name", G.AV_DESC AS GENDER, R.AV_DESC AS RACE, E.AV_DESC AS ETHNICITY, PT_PRIMARY_LANG AS "Language Preference", PRO_IRB_NO AS "IRB NO", AC_CONS_DTE AS "Consent Date", AC_CONS_STAFF_NAME AS "Consenting Staff", AC_PVDR_OF_RECORD_NAME AS "Provider of Record" FROM PROTOCOL JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON AC_MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS R ON R.AV_ELEMENT = 'RACE' AND R.AV_CODE = PT_RACE LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS G ON G.AV_ELEMENT = 'SEX' AND G.AV_CODE = PT_SEX LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS E ON E.AV_ELEMENT = 'PT_ETHNICITY' AND E.AV_CODE = PT_PT_ETHNICITY ; WITH PEDS AS (SELECT DISTINCT CBP_MRN, CBP_TRANSPLANT_DTE, CBP_INDICATION_CD, CBP_INDICATION_DESC, CBP_TRANSPLANT_TYPE FROM IDB.CRDB_BMT_PEDIATRICS), PROTOCOL AS (SELECT DISTINCT AC_MRN, AC_LAST_NAME, AC_FIRST_NAME, PRO_IRB_NO, PRO_IRB_TITLE, PRO_PROTOCOL_TYPE, ACD_OFF_STUDY_DTE, AC_CONS_DTE, AC_CONS_STAFF_NAME, AC_PVDR_OF_RECORD_NAME FROM PEDS JOIN IDB.ACCRUALS ON CBP_MRN = AC_MRN JOIN IDB.PROTOCOL ON PRO_IRB_NO = AC_IRB_NO JOIN IDB.ACCRUALS_DATES ON AC_IRB_NO = ACD_IRB_NO AND AC_SUBJ_ID_NO = ACD_SUBJ_ID_NO AND AC_SUBJ_SEQ_NO = ACD_SUBJ_SEQ_NO WHERE PRO_IRB_NO = '08-047' AND ACD_OFF_STUDY_DTE IS NULL ), ACD AS (SELECT DISTINCT OO_MRN, OO_ORD_NAME, OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE, OO_SUMMARY_LINE FROM PROTOCOL JOIN IDB.OMS_ORDER ON AC_MRN = OO_MRN JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_CATALOG ON OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID = OOC_MSTR_ITEM_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_STATUS ON OO_ORD_STS_CD = OSTS_ORD_STS_CD WHERE OO_ORD_STS_CD NOT IN ('CANP', 'CANC', 'AUC3') AND OO_ORD_NAME = 'Research Test' AND UPPER(OO_SUMMARY_LINE) LIKE '%ACD%' AND UPPER(OO_SUMMARY_LINE) NOT LIKE '%URINE COLLECTION%' ) SELECT DISTINCT AC_MRN AS MRN, PT_LAST_NAME AS "Last Name", PT_FIRST_NAME AS "First Name", OO_ORD_NAME AS "Order Name", OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE AS "Order Significant Date", OO_SUMMARY_LINE AS "Order Summary" FROM PROTOCOL JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON AC_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN ACD ON OO_MRN = AC_MRN ; WITH PEDS AS (SELECT DISTINCT CBP_MRN, CBP_TRANSPLANT_DTE, CBP_INDICATION_CD, CBP_INDICATION_DESC, CBP_TRANSPLANT_TYPE FROM IDB.CRDB_BMT_PEDIATRICS), PROTOCOL AS (SELECT DISTINCT AC_MRN, AC_LAST_NAME, AC_FIRST_NAME, PRO_IRB_NO, PRO_IRB_TITLE, PRO_PROTOCOL_TYPE, ACD_OFF_STUDY_DTE, AC_CONS_DTE, AC_CONS_STAFF_NAME, AC_PVDR_OF_RECORD_NAME FROM PEDS JOIN IDB.ACCRUALS ON CBP_MRN = AC_MRN JOIN IDB.PROTOCOL ON PRO_IRB_NO = AC_IRB_NO JOIN IDB.ACCRUALS_DATES ON AC_IRB_NO = ACD_IRB_NO AND AC_SUBJ_ID_NO = ACD_SUBJ_ID_NO AND AC_SUBJ_SEQ_NO = ACD_SUBJ_SEQ_NO WHERE PRO_IRB_NO = '08-047' AND ACD_OFF_STUDY_DTE IS NULL ), CELL AS (SELECT DISTINCT CDD_MRN, CDD_SERVICE_DTE AS "Service Date", CDD_DOC_NAME AS "Document Name", CDO_SECTION AS "Section", CDO_ITEM_NAME AS "Item", CDO_VALUE_TEXT AS "Cell Infusion Type Notes" FROM PROTOCOL LEFT JOIN IDB.CD_DOCUMENT ON AC_MRN = CDD_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION ON CDD_DOC_GUID = CDO_DOC_GUID AND CDD_AUTHORED_DTE = CDO_AUTHORED_DTE AND CDO_VALUE_TEXT <> '' WHERE CDD_CANCEL_IND <> '1' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND <> '1' AND CDD_DOC_NAME IN ('Cell Infusion - BMT', 'Cell Infusion - BMT/CTS', 'Cell Infusion - BMT/CTS-BMT', 'Cell Infusion - BMT/CTS-CTS', 'Cell Infusion - BMT/CTS-Cell Infusion - BMT') AND UPPER(CDO_ITEM_NAME) LIKE '%CELL INFUSION%' ) SELECT DISTINCT AC_MRN AS MRN, PT_LAST_NAME AS "Last Name", PT_FIRST_NAME AS "First Name", "Service Date", "Document Name", "Section", "Item", "Cell Infusion Type Notes" FROM PROTOCOL JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON AC_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN CELL ON CDD_MRN = AC_MRN ; WITH PEDS AS (SELECT DISTINCT CBP_MRN, CBP_TRANSPLANT_DTE, CBP_INDICATION_CD, CBP_INDICATION_DESC, CBP_TRANSPLANT_TYPE FROM IDB.CRDB_BMT_PEDIATRICS), PROTOCOL AS (SELECT DISTINCT AC_MRN, AC_LAST_NAME, AC_FIRST_NAME, PRO_IRB_NO, PRO_IRB_TITLE, PRO_PROTOCOL_TYPE, ACD_OFF_STUDY_DTE, AC_CONS_DTE, AC_CONS_STAFF_NAME, AC_PVDR_OF_RECORD_NAME FROM PEDS JOIN IDB.ACCRUALS ON CBP_MRN = AC_MRN JOIN IDB.PROTOCOL ON PRO_IRB_NO = AC_IRB_NO JOIN IDB.ACCRUALS_DATES ON AC_IRB_NO = ACD_IRB_NO AND AC_SUBJ_ID_NO = ACD_SUBJ_ID_NO AND AC_SUBJ_SEQ_NO = ACD_SUBJ_SEQ_NO WHERE PRO_IRB_NO = '08-047' AND ACD_OFF_STUDY_DTE IS NULL ), DT AS (SELECT DISTINCT CDD_MRN, MIN(CDD_SERVICE_DTE) AS "Service Date", MIN(CDD_DOC_NAME) AS "Document Name", MIN(CDO_SECTION) AS "Section", MIN(CDO_ITEM_NAME) AS "Item", CDO_VALUE_TEXT AS "Value Text" FROM PROTOCOL LEFT JOIN IDB.CD_DOCUMENT ON AC_MRN = CDD_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION ON CDD_DOC_GUID = CDO_DOC_GUID AND CDD_AUTHORED_DTE = CDO_AUTHORED_DTE AND CDO_VALUE_TEXT <> '' WHERE CDD_CANCEL_IND <> '1' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND <> '1' AND (UPPER(CDO_SECTION) LIKE '%DONOR INFORMATION%' OR UPPER(CDO_SECTION) LIKE '%PRODUCT INFORMATION%' OR UPPER(CDO_SECTION) LIKE '%DIAGNOSIS%') AND UPPER(CDO_ITEM_NAME) LIKE '%DONOR%' GROUP BY CDD_MRN, CDO_VALUE_TEXT) SELECT DISTINCT AC_MRN AS MRN, PT_LAST_NAME AS "Last Name", PT_FIRST_NAME AS "First Name", "Service Date", "Document Name", "Section", "Item", "Value Text" FROM PROTOCOL JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON AC_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN DT ON CDD_MRN = AC_MRN ;

prompt: I would like to receive a weekly report for all patients scheduled for a CT or MRI at 53rd street who also have lab work resulted on the same day.
completion: WITH RAD AS (SELECT CPE_MRN AS "MRN", CPE_ENC_DTE "Appt Date", LISTAGG(TRIM(CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME), ' | ') WITHIN GROUP( ORDER BY CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME) AS "Visit Type" FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 IN ('RAD') AND CLD_CLD_CENTER = '53RD' AND (CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME like 'MR%' OR CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME like 'CT%') AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT date - 8 DAYS AND CURRENT date GROUP BY CPE_MRN, CPE_ENC_DTE) SELECT DISTINCT MRN, "Visit Type", "Appt Date", COUNT(DISTINCT LR_SUBTEST_NAME) "Lab Subtest Name Count" FROM RAD JOIN IDB.LAB_RESULTS ON LR_MRN = MRN AND "Appt Date"=LR_PERFORMED_DTE JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON PT_MRN = MRN GROUP BY MRN, "Visit Type", "Appt Date" ORDER BY "Appt Date" ; WITH RAD AS (SELECT CPE_MRN AS "MRN", CPE_ENC_DTE "Appt Date", LISTAGG(TRIM(CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME), ' | ') WITHIN GROUP( ORDER BY CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME) AS "Visit Type" FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 IN ('RAD') AND CLD_CLD_CENTER = '53RD' AND (CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME like 'MR%' OR CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME like 'CT%') AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT date - 8 DAYS AND CURRENT date GROUP BY CPE_MRN, CPE_ENC_DTE), RECORDS AS (SELECT DISTINCT MRN, "Visit Type", "Appt Date", COUNT(DISTINCT LR_SUBTEST_NAME) "Lab Subtest Name Count" FROM RAD JOIN IDB.LAB_RESULTS ON LR_MRN = MRN AND "Appt Date"=LR_PERFORMED_DTE JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON PT_MRN = MRN GROUP BY MRN, "Visit Type", "Appt Date" ORDER BY "Appt Date") SELECT "Appt Date", COUNT(*) "Patient Count" FROM RECORDS GROUP BY "Appt Date" ORDER BY "Appt Date" ;

prompt: Number of IR Procedures and Nitroglycerin Orders in 2019
completion: SELECT SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC, COUNT(*) COUNT FROM IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE ON SSE_LOG_ID = SSP_LOG_ID AND SSE_ENC_CSN_ID = SSP_ENC_CSN_ID WHERE SSE_SURG_LOC LIKE '%IR%' AND YEAR(SSE_SURG_DTE) = 2019 AND SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC IN ('MAPPING ARTERIOGRAM', 'HAIP ARTERIOGRAM (PUMP ANGIO)', 'DIAGNOSTIC ARTERIOGRAM', 'TWO DOSE THERASPHERE TREATMENT', 'THREE DOSE THERASPHERE TREATMENT', 'THERASPHERE TREATMENT', 'SIRSPHERE TREATMENT WITH 3 DOSES', 'SIRSPHERE TREATMENT WITH 2 DOSES', 'SIRSPHERE TREATMENT SINGLE DOSE', 'GU URETERAL EMBOLIZATION', 'TRANS-ARTERIAL CHEMO EMBOLIZATION', 'EMBOLIZATION, ARTERIAL TUMOR NON-HEPATIC', 'EMBOLIZATION, NON-TUMOR', 'EMBOLIZATION, ARTERIAL TUMOR HEPATIC') GROUP BY SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC ORDER BY 1 ; SELECT OOC_ITEM_NAME, WEEK(OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE) AS WEEK_NUMBER, COUNT(*) COUNT FROM IDB.OMS_ORDER JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_CATALOG ON OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID = OOC_MSTR_ITEM_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_STATUS ON OO_ORD_STS_CD = OSTS_ORD_STS_CD WHERE OO_ORD_STS_CD NOT IN ('CANP', 'CANC', 'AUC3') AND YEAR(OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE) = 2019 AND OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID = '9000008252100730' GROUP BY OOC_ITEM_NAME, WEEK(OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE) ORDER BY 2 ; SELECT OOC_ITEM_NAME, OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE, COUNT(*) COUNT FROM IDB.OMS_ORDER JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_CATALOG ON OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID = OOC_MSTR_ITEM_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_STATUS ON OO_ORD_STS_CD = OSTS_ORD_STS_CD WHERE OO_ORD_STS_CD NOT IN ('CANP', 'CANC', 'AUC3') AND YEAR(OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE) = 2019 AND OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID = '9000008252100730' GROUP BY OOC_ITEM_NAME, OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE ORDER BY 2

prompt: Number of patients who established care with MSK since 2015
completion: WITH PTS AS (SELECT PFA_MRN FROM IDB.PT_FIRST_ACTIVITY WHERE PFA_FST_APPT_DTE >= '2015-01-01' ) , REPEAT AS (SELECT CPE_MRN AS MRN, COUNT(*) COUNT FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID JOIN PTS ON CPE_MRN = PFA_MRN WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND YEAR(CPE_ENC_DTE) >= 2015 AND CPE_MRN <> '' GROUP BY CPE_MRN HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2) SELECT RACE.AV_DESC "Race", RELIGION.AV_DESC "Religion", COUNT(*) "Patients" FROM IDB.PATIENT JOIN REPEAT ON PT_MRN = MRN JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS RACE ON PT_RACE = RACE.AV_CODE AND RACE.AV_ELEMENT = 'RACE' JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS RELIGION ON PT_RELIGION = RELIGION.AV_CODE AND RELIGION.AV_ELEMENT = 'RELIGION' JOIN PTS ON PFA_MRN = PT_MRN GROUP BY RACE.AV_DESC, RELIGION.AV_DESC ; WITH PTS AS (SELECT PFA_MRN, PFA_FST_APPT_DTE FROM IDB.PT_FIRST_ACTIVITY WHERE PFA_FST_APPT_DTE >= '2015-01-01' ) , REPEAT AS (SELECT CPE_MRN AS MRN, COUNT(*) COUNT FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID JOIN PTS ON CPE_MRN = PFA_MRN WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND YEAR(CPE_ENC_DTE) >= 2015 AND CPE_MRN <> '' GROUP BY CPE_MRN HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2) SELECT RACE.AV_DESC "Race", RELIGION.AV_DESC "Religion", YEAR(PFA_FST_APPT_DTE) "Year", COUNT(*) "Patients" FROM IDB.PATIENT JOIN REPEAT ON PT_MRN = MRN JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS RACE ON PT_RACE = RACE.AV_CODE AND RACE.AV_ELEMENT = 'RACE' JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS RELIGION ON PT_RELIGION = RELIGION.AV_CODE AND RELIGION.AV_ELEMENT = 'RELIGION' JOIN PTS ON PFA_MRN = PT_MRN GROUP BY RACE.AV_DESC, RELIGION.AV_DESC, YEAR(PFA_FST_APPT_DTE) ; WITH PTS AS (SELECT PFA_MRN FROM IDB.PT_FIRST_ACTIVITY WHERE PFA_FST_APPT_DTE >= '2015-01-01' ) , REPEAT AS (SELECT CPE_MRN AS MRN, COUNT(*) COUNT FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID JOIN PTS ON CPE_MRN = PFA_MRN WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND YEAR(CPE_ENC_DTE) >= 2015 AND CPE_MRN <> '' GROUP BY CPE_MRN HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2) SELECT S.CAV_TITLE AS "Service Desc", RACE.AV_DESC "Race", RELIGION.AV_DESC "Religion", COUNT(*) AS "Visits", COUNT(DISTINCT CPE_MRN) AS "Patients" FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_CATEGORY S ON S.CAV_CATEGORY = 'CLD_RPT_GRP_8' AND S.CAV_ABBR = CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID JOIN PTS ON CPE_MRN = PFA_MRN JOIN REPEAT ON CPE_MRN = MRN JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON CPE_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS RACE ON PT_RACE = RACE.AV_CODE AND RACE.AV_ELEMENT = 'RACE' JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS RELIGION ON PT_RELIGION = RELIGION.AV_CODE AND RELIGION.AV_ELEMENT = 'RELIGION' WHERE CPE_ENC_DTE >= '2015-01-01' AND CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') GROUP BY S.CAV_TITLE, RACE.AV_DESC, RELIGION.AV_DESC ; WITH PTS AS (SELECT PFA_MRN FROM IDB.PT_FIRST_ACTIVITY WHERE PFA_FST_APPT_DTE >= '2015-01-01' ) , REPEAT AS (SELECT CPE_MRN AS MRN, COUNT(*) COUNT FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID JOIN PTS ON CPE_MRN = PFA_MRN WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND YEAR(CPE_ENC_DTE) >= 2015 AND CPE_MRN <> '' GROUP BY CPE_MRN HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2) SELECT S.CAV_TITLE AS "Service Desc", RACE.AV_DESC "Race", RELIGION.AV_DESC "Religion", YEAR(CPE_ENC_DTE) "Year", COUNT(*) AS "Visits", COUNT(DISTINCT CPE_MRN) AS "Patients" FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_CATEGORY S ON S.CAV_CATEGORY = 'CLD_RPT_GRP_8' AND S.CAV_ABBR = CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID JOIN PTS ON CPE_MRN = PFA_MRN JOIN REPEAT ON CPE_MRN = MRN JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON CPE_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS RACE ON PT_RACE = RACE.AV_CODE AND RACE.AV_ELEMENT = 'RACE' JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS RELIGION ON PT_RELIGION = RELIGION.AV_CODE AND RELIGION.AV_ELEMENT = 'RELIGION' WHERE CPE_ENC_DTE >= '2015-01-01' AND CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') GROUP BY S.CAV_TITLE, RACE.AV_DESC, RELIGION.AV_DESC, YEAR(CPE_ENC_DTE)

prompt: General mailing to patient with activity in the past two years to notify them of MSK's participation in Carequality and HIEs in general.
completion: SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, PT_ADDR1, PT_ADDR2, PT_CITY, PT_STATE, PT_ZIP_CD, PT_COUNTRY FROM IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY JOIN IDB.CL_PAS_PATIENT ON PLA_MRN = CPP_MRN AND (CPP_PP_LST_LGN_DTE < CURRENT DATE - 180 DAYS OR CPP_PP_LST_LGN_DTE IS NULL) JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON CPP_MRN = PT_MRN AND NOT (PT_COUNTRY = 'CANADA' OR PT_STATE IN ('ON', 'BC')) AND NOT (PT_STATE = 'XX' AND PT_COUNTRY NOT IN ('PUERTO RICO', 'VIRGIN ISLANDS')) WHERE PLA_LST_CON_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT DATE -2 YEAR AND CURRENT DATE AND PLA_DECEASED_IND <> 'Y'

prompt: Provide a list of Dr. Stone patients that are scheduled in new visit and break slots for all upcoming tuesdays and thursdays for the rest of 2021.
completion: SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN , CPP_PT_NAME, CLD_DEPT_NAME , CRE_RES_NAME, CRE_RES_ID , CPE_ENC_DTE, TIME(CPE_APPT_DT) AS TIME , CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR, CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME, CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID, CPE_ENC_CSN_ID , CPE_CPE_APPT_STS FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CRE_RES_ID = CPE_VST_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID JOIN IDB.CL_PAS_PATIENT ON CPP_CL_PT_ID = CPE_CL_PT_ID WHERE 1=1 AND CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Sch') AND CPE_ENC_DTE >= CURRENT date AND CRE_RES_ID IN ('020214')

prompt: Provide data on patients with ampullectomies.
completion: WITH CTE AS (SELECT CC_MRN AS AMP_MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS MIN_AMP_EFF_DTE FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF WHERE CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND CC_CLSF_CD IN ('156.2', '211.5', '239.0', '576.9', '751.69') GROUP BY CC_MRN ), CTE2 AS (SELECT PBD_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_SEX, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, PT_DATE_OF_DEATH, PBD_SVC_DTE, PBC_CPT_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS PBD_CPT_DESC, DOC_NAME, AV_DESC AS DOC_SVC, MIN_AMP_EFF_DTE FROM CTE JOIN IDB.PBD_DTL ON AMP_MRN = PBD_MRN JOIN IDB.PBD_CODE ON PBD_PBD_CD = PBC_PBD_CD JOIN IDB.CLM ON PBC_CPT_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.PBD_INVOICE ON PBD_INV_NO = PBI_INV_NO JOIN IDB.DOC ON PBI_PERFORM_DR_NO = DOC_DR_NO JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS ON AV_ELEMENT = 'SVC' AND DOC_SVC = AV_CODE JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON AMP_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE PBC_CPT_CD IN ('43251', '43260', '43262', '43268', '43271', '43272', '47999') ) SELECT A.*, MIN_COL_EFF_DTE FROM CTE2 A LEFT JOIN (SELECT CC_MRN AS COL_MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS MIN_COL_EFF_DTE FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN CTE ON AMP_MRN = CC_MRN WHERE CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND CC_CLSF_CD IN ('211.3', 'V12.72') AND CC_EFF_DTE IS NOT NULL GROUP BY CC_MRN) AS B ON PBD_MRN = COL_MRN

prompt: Provide a list of all patients with hepatocellular carcinoma treated with immunotherapy from 11/1/2011 to 11/1/2021
completion: WITH PTS AS (SELECT DISTINCT CC_MRN AS MRN FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE 1=1 AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND (CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) AND CC_CLSF_CD IN ('C22.0', '155.0') ) SELECT PT_MRN, PT_SEX, PT_GENDER, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, CASE WHEN PT_DEATH_IND IN ('C', 'D', 'X') THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS DEATH_IND, PT_DATE_OF_DEATH, PLA_LST_APPT_DTE, PLA_LST_CON_DTE , APR_DRUG_NAME, MIN(APR_START_DTE) AS START_DATE, MAX(APR_END_DTE) AS END_DATE FROM PTS JOIN IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX_V ON APR_MRN = MRN JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON APR_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY ON PT_MRN = PLA_MRN WHERE 1=1 AND (LOWER(APR_DRUG_NAME) like '%atezolizumab%' OR LOWER(APR_DRUG_NAME) like '%nivolumab%' OR LOWER(APR_DRUG_NAME) like '%pembrolizumab%' OR LOWER(APR_DRUG_NAME) like '%durvalumab%' OR LOWER(APR_DRUG_NAME) like '%tremelimumab%' OR LOWER(APR_DRUG_NAME) like '%ipilimumab%' OR LOWER(APR_DRUG_NAME) like '%avelumab%') AND APR_START_DTE BETWEEN '2011-01-01' AND '2021-11-01' GROUP BY PT_MRN, PT_SEX, PT_GENDER, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, PT_DEATH_IND, PT_DATE_OF_DEATH, PLA_LST_APPT_DTE, PLA_LST_CON_DTE , APR_DRUG_NAME

prompt: Provide a list of on hold and released return visit pediatric orders
completion: WITH ORD AS (SELECT DISTINCT TRIM(OO_MRN) AS OO_MRN, OO_ORD_ID AS "Order ID", OO_ORD_GUID AS "Order GUID", DATE(OO_ENTER_DT) AS "Order Enter Date", OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE AS "Order Date", OSTS_STS_DESC "Order Status", OSH_CREATE_DTE AS "Order Release Date", OO_SET_NAME AS "Set Name", OO_ORD_NAME AS "Order Name", OO_SUMMARY_LINE AS "Summary Line", CASE WHEN OO_ORD_NAME = 'Pediatric Procedure W/Anesthesia Request' AND OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'Peds_Service_Req_Procedure' THEN UPPER(OUD_USER_DI_VALUE) ELSE SUBSTR(OO_ORD_NAME, 20) END SERVICE FROM IDB.OMS_ORDER LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_STS_HX ON OO_ORD_GUID = OSH_ORD_GUID AND OSH_FUNCTION_CD = '105' JOIN IDB.OMS_STATUS ON OO_ORD_STS_CD = OSTS_ORD_STS_CD LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_USER_DATA ON OO_MRN = OUD_MRN AND OO_ORD_GUID = OUD_ORD_GUID AND OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'Peds_Service_Req_Procedure' WHERE OO_ORD_STS_CD NOT IN ('CANC', 'CANP', 'AUC3') AND OO_ORD_STS_CD IN ('PEND', 'AUC1') AND OSH_CREATE_DTE >= CURRENT date - 3 DAYS AND OO_ORD_NAME IN ('Pediatric Procedure W/Anesthesia Request', 'PED_Return Visit - BMT', 'PED_Return Visit - LEUKEMIA/LYMPHOMA', 'PED_Return Visit - LTFU', 'PED_Return Visit - NEURO-ONCOLOGY', 'PED_Return Visit - NEUROBLASTOMA', 'PED_Return Visit - NEUROSURGERY', 'PED_Return Visit - PACT', 'PED_Return Visit - SARCOMA', 'PED_Return Visit - SURGERY') ) , APPT_RAW AS (SELECT CPE_MRN AS "MRN", "Order GUID", CPE_ENC_DTE AS "Appt Date", CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 AS "Department", CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 AS "Service", CLD_DEPT_NAME AS "Department Name", CRE_RES_NAME AS "Provider Name", CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME AS "Visit Type", CASE WHEN CASE WHEN SERVICE = 'NEUROBLASTOMA' THEN 'NBL' WHEN SERVICE IN ('NEURO-ONCOLOGY', 'NEURO ONCOLOGY') THEN 'NOC' WHEN SERVICE = 'NEUROSURGERY' THEN 'NRS' WHEN SERVICE = 'LEUKEMIA/LYMPHOMA' THEN 'LEU' WHEN SERVICE = 'LTFU' THEN 'LFU' WHEN SERVICE = 'SARCOMA' THEN 'SAR' WHEN SERVICE = 'CLINICAL GENETICS' THEN 'GNT' WHEN SERVICE = 'OPHTHALMOLOGY' THEN 'OPH' WHEN SERVICE = 'SURGERY' THEN 'PDS' ELSE SERVICE END = CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 THEN ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CPE_MRN ORDER BY CPE_ENC_DTE) ELSE ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CPE_MRN ORDER BY CPE_ENC_DTE) + 1 END RN FROM ORD ORD JOIN IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER ON OO_MRN = CPE_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Sch') AND CRE_RES_TYP = 'Physician' AND (CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 = ('PED') OR CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_4 = ('PED') OR CLD_DEPT_NAME = 'ORTHOPEDICS 1275-9') AND CPE_CPE_IP_IND <> 'INPATIENT' ) , APPT AS (SELECT MRN, "Order GUID", "Appt Date", "Department", "Service", "Department Name", "Provider Name", "Visit Type", ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY MRN, "Order GUID" ORDER BY RN) RN FROM APPT_RAW) SELECT OO_MRN MRN, PT_LAST_NAME LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME FIRST_NAME, "Order ID", "Order Enter Date", "Order Status", "Order Release Date", SERVICE, "Order Name", "Set Name", "Appt Date", "Department Name", "Provider Name", "Visit Type" FROM ORD O LEFT JOIN APPT A ON O.OO_MRN = A.MRN AND O."Order GUID" = A."Order GUID" AND RN = 1 JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON O.OO_MRN = PT_MRN ; WITH ORD AS (SELECT DISTINCT TRIM(OO_MRN) AS OO_MRN, OO_ORD_ID AS "Order ID", OO_ORD_GUID AS "Order GUID", DATE(OO_ENTER_DT) AS "Order Enter Date", OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE AS "Order Date", OSTS_STS_DESC "Order Status", OSH_CREATE_DTE AS "Order Release Date", DOC_NAME "Ordering Provider", OO_SET_NAME AS "Set Name", OO_ORD_NAME AS "Order Name", OO_SUMMARY_LINE AS "Summary Line", CASE WHEN OO_ORD_NAME = 'Pediatric Procedure W/Anesthesia Request' AND OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'Peds_Service_Req_Procedure' THEN UPPER(OUD_USER_DI_VALUE) ELSE SUBSTR(OO_ORD_NAME, 20) END SERVICE FROM IDB.OMS_ORDER LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_STS_HX ON OO_ORD_GUID = OSH_ORD_GUID AND OSH_FUNCTION_CD = '105' JOIN IDB.OMS_STATUS ON OO_ORD_STS_CD = OSTS_ORD_STS_CD LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_USER_DATA ON OO_MRN = OUD_MRN AND OO_ORD_GUID = OUD_ORD_GUID AND OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'Peds_Service_Req_Procedure' JOIN IDB.DOC ON OO_REQ_DR_NO = DOC_DR_NO WHERE OO_ORD_STS_CD NOT IN ('CANC', 'CANP', 'AUC3') AND OO_ENTER_DTE >= CURRENT date - 2 DAYS AND OO_ORD_NAME IN ('Pediatric Procedure W/Anesthesia Request', 'PED_Return Visit - BMT', 'PED_Return Visit - LEUKEMIA/LYMPHOMA', 'PED_Return Visit - LTFU', 'PED_Return Visit - NEURO-ONCOLOGY', 'PED_Return Visit - NEUROBLASTOMA', 'PED_Return Visit - NEUROSURGERY', 'PED_Return Visit - PACT', 'PED_Return Visit - SARCOMA', 'PED_Return Visit - SURGERY') AND OSTS_STS_DESC = 'Hold' ) , APPT_RAW AS (SELECT CPE_MRN AS "MRN", "Order GUID", CPE_ENC_DTE AS "Appt Date", CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 AS "Department", CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 AS "Service", CLD_DEPT_NAME AS "Department Name", CRE_RES_NAME AS "Provider Name", CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME AS "Visit Type", CASE WHEN CASE WHEN SERVICE = 'NEUROBLASTOMA' THEN 'NBL' WHEN SERVICE IN ('NEURO-ONCOLOGY', 'NEURO ONCOLOGY') THEN 'NOC' WHEN SERVICE = 'NEUROSURGERY' THEN 'NRS' WHEN SERVICE = 'LEUKEMIA/LYMPHOMA' THEN 'LEU' WHEN SERVICE = 'LTFU' THEN 'LFU' WHEN SERVICE = 'SARCOMA' THEN 'SAR' WHEN SERVICE = 'CLINICAL GENETICS' THEN 'GNT' WHEN SERVICE = 'OPHTHALMOLOGY' THEN 'OPH' WHEN SERVICE = 'SURGERY' THEN 'PDS' ELSE SERVICE END = CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 THEN ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CPE_MRN ORDER BY CPE_ENC_DTE) ELSE ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CPE_MRN ORDER BY CPE_ENC_DTE) + 1 END RN FROM ORD ORD JOIN IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER ON OO_MRN = CPE_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Sch') AND CRE_RES_TYP = 'Physician' AND (CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 = ('PED') OR CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_4 = ('PED') OR CLD_DEPT_NAME = 'ORTHOPEDICS 1275-9') AND CPE_CPE_IP_IND <> 'INPATIENT' ) , APPT AS (SELECT MRN, "Order GUID", "Appt Date", "Department", "Service", "Department Name", "Provider Name", "Visit Type", ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY MRN, "Order GUID" ORDER BY RN) RN FROM APPT_RAW) SELECT OO_MRN MRN, PT_LAST_NAME LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME FIRST_NAME, "Order ID", "Order Enter Date", "Order Status", "Order Release Date", SERVICE, "Ordering Provider", "Order Name", "Set Name", "Appt Date", "Department Name", "Provider Name", "Visit Type" FROM ORD O LEFT JOIN APPT A ON O.OO_MRN = A.MRN AND O."Order GUID" = A."Order GUID" AND RN = 1 JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON O.OO_MRN = PT_MRN ;

completion: WITH "cte1" AS (SELECT PRPTR_PATH_RPT_ID, PRPTR_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID, PRPTR_CHILD_PATH_RPT_ID FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_REFERENCES) SELECT DISTINCT "t1"."PT_MRN" AS "MRN", "t2"."MDPRA_GENE" AS "Assoc. Gene", "t3"."DT_DTE" AS "Pathology Report Date" FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V" "t1" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED" "t4" ON "t1"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t4"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V" "t5" ON "t4"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t5"."PRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "cte1" "t6" ON "t5"."PRPT_PATH_RPT_ID" = "t6"."PRPTR_PATH_RPT_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V" "t7" ON "t6"."PRPTR_CHILD_PATH_RPT_ID" = "t7"."PRPT_PATH_RPT_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."MOLECULAR_DX_PATH_REPORT_ANNOTATIONS_V" "t2" ON "t7"."PRPT_PATH_RPT_ID" = "t2"."MDPRA_PRPT_PATH_RPT_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" "t3" ON "t5"."PRPT_REPORT_DATE_ID" = "t3"."DT_DATE_ID"

prompt: Provide counts of AXR procedures and AXR orders.
completion: WITH COUNT_PRE AS (SELECT DISTINCT OC_CASE_ID AS ID, 'axr_surg_count' AS TYPE, OC_SURG_DTE AS date FROM IDB.OR_CASE A JOIN IDB.OR_CASE_ALL_PROC ON OC_CASE_ID = OCAP_CASE_ID JOIN IDB.OR_CASE_ALL_SURG ON OCAP_CASE_ID = OCAS_CASE_ID AND OCAS_PNL_NO = OCAP_PNL_NO AND OCAS_SURG_ROLE = 'Primary' JOIN IDB.OR_PROC ON OCAP_OR_PROC_ID = OP_OR_PROC_ID JOIN IDB.OR_CL_PROC ON OP_OR_PROC_ID = OCP_OR_PROC_ID JOIN IDB.CL_PROC ON OCP_PROC_ID = CPX_PROC_ID JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CRE_RES_ID = OCAS_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_LOCATION ON OC_SURG_LOC_ID = LOC_LOC_ID WHERE 1=1 AND OC_SURG_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT date - 28 DAYS AND CURRENT date - 1 DAYS AND OC_OR_CASE_STS_CD NOT IN ('2', '5') AND OC_PT_CLASS = 'AXR' AND LOC_LOC_NAME IN ('MAIN OR', 'SDH OR') UNION SELECT DISTINCT OO_MRN AS ID, 'op_axr_order' AS TYPE, OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE AS date FROM IDB.OMS_ORDER JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_CATALOG ON OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID = OOC_MSTR_ITEM_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_STATUS ON OO_ORD_STS_CD = OSTS_ORD_STS_CD WHERE OOC_ITEM_NAME = 'Patient On Ambulatory Extended Recovery (OP to AXR)' AND OO_ORD_STS_CD NOT IN ('CANP', 'CANC', 'AUC3') AND OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT date - 28 DAYS AND CURRENT date - 1 DAYS UNION (SELECT DISTINCT OO_MRN AS ID, 'axr_ip_order' AS TYPE, OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE AS date FROM IDB.OMS_ORDER JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_CATALOG ON OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID = OOC_MSTR_ITEM_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_STATUS ON OO_ORD_STS_CD = OSTS_ORD_STS_CD LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_FORM_FIELD ON OO_ENTRY_FRM_GUID = OFF_ENTRY_FRM_GUID LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_USER_DATA ON OUD_ORD_GUID = OO_ORD_GUID AND OFF_DI_CD = OUD_USER_DI_CD JOIN IDB.VISIT_V ON OO_ADM_NUM = VIS_ADM_NUM WHERE OOC_ITEM_NAME = 'Patient Off Ambulatory Extended Recovery (AXR to IP)' AND OO_ORD_STS_CD NOT IN ('CANP', 'CANC', 'AUC3') AND OFF_FLD_LABEL = 'Location Decision Made:' AND OUD_USER_DI_VALUE <> 'AXR Unit' AND OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT date - 28 DAYS AND CURRENT date - 1 DAYS UNION ALL SELECT DISTINCT OO_MRN AS ID, 'axr_ip_order' AS TYPE, OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE - 1 DAY AS date FROM IDB.OMS_ORDER JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_CATALOG ON OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID = OOC_MSTR_ITEM_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_STATUS ON OO_ORD_STS_CD = OSTS_ORD_STS_CD LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_FORM_FIELD ON OO_ENTRY_FRM_GUID = OFF_ENTRY_FRM_GUID LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_USER_DATA ON OUD_ORD_GUID = OO_ORD_GUID AND OFF_DI_CD = OUD_USER_DI_CD JOIN IDB.VISIT_V ON OO_ADM_NUM = VIS_ADM_NUM WHERE OOC_ITEM_NAME = 'Patient Off Ambulatory Extended Recovery (AXR to IP)' AND OO_ORD_STS_CD NOT IN ('CANP', 'CANC', 'AUC3') AND OFF_FLD_LABEL = 'Location Decision Made:' AND OUD_USER_DI_VALUE = 'AXR Unit' AND OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT date - 28 DAYS AND CURRENT date - 1 DAYS ) UNION SELECT DISTINCT OO_MRN AS ID, 'axr_telemetry' AS TYPE, OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE AS date FROM IDB.OMS_ORDER JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_CATALOG ON OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID = OOC_MSTR_ITEM_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_STATUS ON OO_ORD_STS_CD = OSTS_ORD_STS_CD WHERE OOC_ITEM_NAME = 'AXR Telemetry Monitoring' AND OO_ORD_STS_CD NOT IN ('CANP', 'CANC', 'AUC3') AND OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT date - 28 DAYS AND CURRENT date - 1 DAYS ) , COUNT AS (SELECT CASE WHEN TYPE = 'axr_surg_count' THEN COUNT(ID) ELSE 0 END AS "AXR Surg Count", CASE WHEN TYPE = 'op_axr_order' THEN COUNT(ID) ELSE 0 END AS "OP to AXR Count", CASE WHEN TYPE = 'axr_ip_order' THEN COUNT(ID) ELSE 0 END AS "AXR to IP Count", CASE WHEN TYPE = 'axr_telemetry' THEN COUNT(ID) ELSE 0 END AS "AXR Telemetry Count", date FROM COUNT_PRE GROUP BY TYPE, date ) , COUNT_FINAL AS (SELECT date, CASE WHEN DAYOFWEEK(date) = 1 THEN 'Sunday' WHEN DAYOFWEEK(date) = 2 THEN 'Monday' WHEN DAYOFWEEK(date) = 3 THEN 'Tuesday' WHEN DAYOFWEEK(date) = 4 THEN 'Wednesday' WHEN DAYOFWEEK(date) = 5 THEN 'Thursday' WHEN DAYOFWEEK(date) = 6 THEN 'Friday' WHEN DAYOFWEEK(date) = 7 THEN 'Saturday' END AS "Day of Week", MAX("AXR Surg Count") AS "AXR Surg Count", MAX("OP to AXR Count") AS "OP to AXR Count", MAX("AXR to IP Count") AS "AXR to IP Count", MAX("AXR Telemetry Count") AS "AXR Telemetry Count" FROM COUNT GROUP BY date) SELECT * FROM COUNT_FINAL;

prompt: Active patients with Portal accounts who completed or scheduled an appointment with the Psychiatry department
completion: WITH CTECOMP AS (SELECT CPE_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CPE_MRN, CRE_RES_NAME ORDER BY CPE_ENC_DTE DESC) AS ROWNUMBER, CPE_ENC_DTE, CLD_DEPT_NAME, CRE_RES_NAME, CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME, CPP_PP_LST_LGN_DTE FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID JOIN IDB.CL_PAS_PATIENT ON CPE_CL_PT_ID = CPP_CL_PT_ID JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON CPE_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 = 'PSY' AND CPE_ENC_DTE >= CURRENT date - 12 MONTHS AND CPP_PP_LST_LGN_DTE IS NOT NULL AND PT_DATE_OF_DEATH IS NULL ) , COMP AS (SELECT CPE_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, CPE_ENC_DTE, CLD_DEPT_NAME, CRE_RES_NAME, CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME, CPP_PP_LST_LGN_DTE FROM CTECOMP WHERE ROWNUMBER = 1 ) , CTESCH AS (SELECT CPE_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CPE_MRN, CRE_RES_NAME ORDER BY CPE_ENC_DTE ASC) AS ROWNUMBER, CPE_ENC_DTE, CLD_DEPT_NAME, CRE_RES_NAME, CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME, CPP_PP_LST_LGN_DTE FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID JOIN IDB.CL_PAS_PATIENT ON CPE_CL_PT_ID = CPP_CL_PT_ID JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON CPE_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Sch') AND CPE_ENC_DTE >= CURRENT date - 12 MONTHS AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 = 'PSY' AND CPP_PP_LST_LGN_DTE IS NOT NULL AND PT_DATE_OF_DEATH IS NULL ) , SCH AS (SELECT CPE_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, CPE_ENC_DTE, CLD_DEPT_NAME, CRE_RES_NAME, CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME, CPP_PP_LST_LGN_DTE FROM CTESCH WHERE ROWNUMBER = 1 ) SELECT DISTINCT COALESCE(A.CPE_MRN, B.CPE_MRN) MRN, COALESCE(A.PT_LAST_NAME, B.PT_LAST_NAME) "Last Name", COALESCE(A.PT_FIRST_NAME, B.PT_FIRST_NAME) "First Name", COALESCE(A.CPP_PP_LST_LGN_DTE, B.CPP_PP_LST_LGN_DTE) "Last Portal Log-In", A.CPE_ENC_DTE "Completed Appt Date", A.CLD_DEPT_NAME "Completed Dept", A.CRE_RES_NAME "Completed Provider", A.CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME "Completed Visit Type", B.CPE_ENC_DTE "Scheduled Appt Date", B.CLD_DEPT_NAME "Scheduled Dept", B.CRE_RES_NAME "Scheduled Provider", B.CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME "Scheduled Visit Type" FROM COMP A FULL JOIN SCH B ON A.CPE_MRN = B.CPE_MRN

prompt: Provide raw number of 1) patients with colon cancer that also have peritoneal disease and 2) patients with colon cancer that also have desmoid disease
completion: WITH DIAG AS (SELECT DISTINCT CC_MRN FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE (SUBSTR(CC_CLSF_CD, 1, 3) IN ('C18') OR SUBSTR(CC_CLSF_CD, 1, 5) IN ('C20.9') OR SUBSTR(CC_CLSF_CD, 1, 5) IN ('C21.8')) AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND (CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) GROUP BY CC_MRN, CC_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK HAVING MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) BETWEEN '2012-01-01' AND '2022-09-26'), PATHOLOGY AS (SELECT PRPT_MRN FROM DIAG LEFT JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V ON CC_MRN = PRPT_MRN WHERE PRPT_REPORT IS NOT NULL AND CONTAINS("PRPT_REPORT", '("peritoneal" OR "metastatic" OR "mets" OR "metastases")') >= 1 ) SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT PRPT_MRN) NO_OF_MRN FROM PATHOLOGY ; WITH DIAG AS (SELECT DISTINCT CC_MRN FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE (SUBSTR(CC_CLSF_CD, 1, 3) IN ('C18') OR SUBSTR(CC_CLSF_CD, 1, 5) IN ('C20.9') OR SUBSTR(CC_CLSF_CD, 1, 5) IN ('C21.8')) AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND (CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) GROUP BY CC_MRN, CC_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK HAVING MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) BETWEEN '2012-01-01' AND '2022-09-26'), PATHOLOGY AS (SELECT PRPT_MRN FROM DIAG LEFT JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V ON CC_MRN = PRPT_MRN WHERE PRPT_REPORT IS NOT NULL AND CONTAINS("PRPT_REPORT", '("desmoid")') >= 1 ) SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT PRPT_MRN) NO_OF_MRN FROM PATHOLOGY ;

prompt: NJDOH COVID Vaccine Survey for each NJ Facility
completion: SELECT CVP_WORK_LOCATION, 'Q1 Total Facility Staff' AS QUESTION, COUNT(DISTINCT EVI_EMPLOYEE_ID) AS "COUNT", '- Employee Type is Employee and Contingent (only include NJ work location) - Exclude 100% remote - Exclude Terminated' AS LOGIC FROM IDB.COVID19_EMPLOYEE_VACCINE_INFO JOIN IDB.COVID19_VACCINE_PERSON ON EVI_EMPLOYEE_ID = CVP_EMPLOYEE_ID WHERE 1=1 AND CVP_STATUS <> 'Terminated' AND CEVE_CATEGORY IN ('Employees', 'Contingents') AND COALESCE(CVP_VACC_REMT_EXMP_IND, '') <> 'Y' AND CVP_WORK_LOCATION IN ('480 Red Hill Road (Monmouth)', '225 Summit Av (Montvale)', '136 Mountain View Blvd. (BR)') GROUP BY CVP_WORK_LOCATION UNION ALL SELECT CVP_WORK_LOCATION, 'Q2 Clinically Fully Vaccinated' AS QUESTION, COUNT(DISTINCT EVI_EMPLOYEE_ID) AS "COUNT", '- Employee Type is Employee and Contingent (only include NJ work location) - Exclude 100% remote - Exclude Terminated - Vaccine Status is Clinically Fully Vaccinated' AS LOGIC FROM IDB.COVID19_EMPLOYEE_VACCINE_INFO JOIN IDB.COVID19_VACCINE_PERSON ON EVI_EMPLOYEE_ID = CVP_EMPLOYEE_ID WHERE 1=1 AND CVP_STATUS <> 'Terminated' AND CEVE_CATEGORY IN ('Employees', 'Contingents') AND VACCINE_STATUS IN ('Clinically Fully Vaccinated') AND COALESCE(CVP_VACC_REMT_EXMP_IND, '') <> 'Y' AND CVP_WORK_LOCATION IN ('480 Red Hill Road (Monmouth)', '225 Summit Av (Montvale)', '136 Mountain View Blvd. (BR)') GROUP BY CVP_WORK_LOCATION UNION ALL SELECT CVP_WORK_LOCATION, 'Q3 Received Booster' AS QUESTION, COUNT(DISTINCT EVI_EMPLOYEE_ID) AS "COUNT", '- Employee Type is Employee and Contingent (only include NJ work location) - Exclude 100% remote - Exclude Terminated - Received Additional Dose' AS LOGIC FROM IDB.COVID19_EMPLOYEE_VACCINE_INFO JOIN IDB.COVID19_VACCINE_PERSON ON EVI_EMPLOYEE_ID = CVP_EMPLOYEE_ID WHERE 1=1 AND CVP_STATUS <> 'Terminated' AND CEVE_CATEGORY IN ('Employees', 'Contingents') AND COALESCE(CVP_VACC_REMT_EXMP_IND, '') <> 'Y' AND DOSE_ADDL_ADMIN_DTE IS NOT NULL AND CVP_WORK_LOCATION IN ('480 Red Hill Road (Monmouth)', '225 Summit Av (Montvale)', '136 Mountain View Blvd. (BR)') GROUP BY CVP_WORK_LOCATION

prompt: Create a report which will Identify patients that have been scheduled for cell collection appointments and identify whether or not the patient has received an auto transplant.
completion: SELECT CPE_MRN AS MRN, PT_LAST_NAME AS LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME AS FIRST_NAME, CPE_ENC_DTE AS APPT_DATE, CLD_DEPT_NAME, CRE_RES_NAME, CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME, PBD_SVC_DTE, PBD_SVC_AMT, PBC_CPT_CD, PBC_PBD_DESC, DOC_NAME FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CRE_RES_ID = CPE_VST_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID AND CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID IN (8182, 8183, 8179, 8180) JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PT_MRN = CPE_MRN LEFT JOIN (SELECT PBD_MRN, PBD_SVC_DTE, PBD_SVC_AMT, PBC_CPT_CD, PBC_PBD_DESC, DOC_NAME FROM IDB.PBD_DTL JOIN IDB.PBD_CODE ON PBD_PBD_CD = PBC_PBD_CD AND PBC_CPT_CD = '38241' JOIN IDB.PBD_INVOICE ON PBI_MRN = PBD_MRN AND PBI_ACCT_NO = PBD_ACCT_NO AND PBI_INV_NO = PBD_INV_NO JOIN IDB.DOC ON DOC_DR_NO = PBI_PERFORM_DR_NO WHERE PBD_SVC_DTE BETWEEN '2010-08-01' AND '2011-12-31' ) AS X ON PBD_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN '2010-08-01' AND '2011-03-31' AND CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp')

prompt: Provide a list of pediatric patients diagnosed with pneumothorax within the last 20 years.
completion: SELECT CC_MRN, CC_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) FIRST_DX_DTE FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE (CC_CLSF_CD IN ('J93.0', 'J93.1', 'J93.8', 'J93.9', 'J95.81', 'J95.811', 'J95.812', '512.0', '512.89', '512.1', '512.2')) AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND (CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) AND CC_EFF_DTE BETWEEN '2000-01-01' AND '2019-12-31' GROUP BY CC_MRN, CC_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK

prompt: Generate a weekly list each Thursday of eligible patients for X22-012 being seen in the survivorship clinics within the next 10 days.
completion: WITH APPOINTMENT AS (SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN, CPE_ENC_DTE, CLD_DEPT_NAME, CRE_RES_NAME FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Sch') AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT DATE +1 DAY AND CURRENT DATE + 10 DAYS AND CRE_RES_ID IN ('012419', '084988', '019851', '74867', '014720', '013946', '017095', '083782', '46301', '080903', '083584', '014126', '080242', '016089', '100132') AND CLD_DEPT_ID IN (989, 367, 1042, 463, 267, 1147, 574, 281) ORDER BY CPE_MRN ) , CDB AS (SELECT TM_MRN, TM_DX_DTE FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN APPOINTMENT ON CPE_MRN = TM_MRN JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS ON AV_ELEMENT = 'CASE_STS' AND AV_CODE = TM_CASE_STS WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') GROUP BY TM_MRN, TM_DX_DTE, TM_HIST_CD, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK, TM_SITE_CD, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK ) , ICD AS (SELECT DISTINCT CC_MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS MIN_ICD9_EFF_DTE, CC_CLSF_CD AS ICD9_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS ICD9_DESC FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN APPOINTMENT ON CC_MRN = CPE_MRN WHERE 1=1 AND (CC_CLSF_CD BETWEEN '140' AND '239.99' OR CC_CLSF_CD BETWEEN 'C' AND 'D49.99') AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND (CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) GROUP BY CC_MRN, CC_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK ) , TMDX AS (SELECT DX_MRN, DX_DTE, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH AS DATE_OF_BIRTH, TRIM(PT_LAST_NAME) || ', ' || PT_FIRST_NAME AS PT_NAME, YEAR(COALESCE(PT_DATE_OF_DEATH, CURRENT DATE) - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) AS CURRENT_AGE FROM (SELECT TM_MRN AS DX_MRN, TM_DX_DTE AS DX_DTE FROM CDB UNION SELECT CC_MRN AS DX_MRN, MIN_ICD9_EFF_DTE AS DX_DTE FROM ICD) JOIN IDB.PATIENT_V ON DX_MRN = PT_MRN AND YEAR(DX_DTE- PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) >= 15) SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN AS MRN, PT_NAME, CPE_ENC_DTE AS APPOINTMENT_DATE, CLD_DEPT_NAME AS DEPT_NAME, CRE_RES_NAME AS PROVIDER_NAME FROM APPOINTMENT JOIN TMDX ON DX_MRN = CPE_MRN GROUP BY CPE_MRN, PT_NAME, DX_DTE, CURRENT_AGE, CLD_DEPT_NAME, CRE_RES_NAME, CPE_ENC_DTE ORDER BY CPE_MRN; WITH APPOINTMENT AS (SELECT CPE_MRN, CPE_ENC_DTE, CLD_DEPT_NAME, CRE_RES_NAME FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Sch') AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT DATE +1 DAY AND CURRENT DATE + 10 DAYS AND CRE_RES_ID IN ('012419', '084988', '019851', '74867', '014720', '013946', '017095', '083782', '46301', '080903', '083584', '014126', '080242', '016089', '100132') AND CLD_DEPT_ID IN (989, 367, 1042, 463, 267, 1147, 574, 281) ) , CDB AS (SELECT TM_MRN, TM_DX_DTE, CONCAT(CONCAT(RTRIM(TM_SITE_CD), '-'), S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK) AS CDB_SITE, CONCAT(CONCAT(RTRIM(TM_HIST_CD), '-'), H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK) AS CDB_HIST FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN APPOINTMENT ON CPE_MRN = TM_MRN JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS ON AV_ELEMENT = 'CASE_STS' AND AV_CODE = TM_CASE_STS WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') GROUP BY TM_MRN, TM_DX_DTE, TM_HIST_CD, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK, TM_SITE_CD, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK ) , ICD AS (SELECT DISTINCT CC_MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS MIN_ICD9_EFF_DTE, CC_CLSF_CD AS ICD9_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS ICD9_DESC FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN APPOINTMENT ON CC_MRN = CPE_MRN WHERE 1=1 AND (CC_CLSF_CD BETWEEN '140' AND '239.99' OR CC_CLSF_CD BETWEEN 'C' AND 'D49.99') AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND (CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) GROUP BY CC_MRN, CC_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK ) , TMDX AS (SELECT DX_MRN, DX_DTE, DX_CODE, DX_DESC, YEAR(DX_DTE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) AS AGE_AT_DIAGNOSIS, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH AS DATE_OF_BIRTH, TRIM(PT_LAST_NAME) || ', ' || PT_FIRST_NAME AS PT_NAME, YEAR(COALESCE(PT_DATE_OF_DEATH, CURRENT DATE) - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) AS CURRENT_AGE FROM (SELECT TM_MRN AS DX_MRN, TM_DX_DTE AS DX_DTE, CDB_SITE AS DX_CODE, CDB_HIST AS DX_DESC FROM CDB UNION SELECT CC_MRN AS DX_MRN, MIN_ICD9_EFF_DTE AS DX_DTE, ICD9_CD AS DX_CODE, ICD9_DESC AS DX_DESC FROM ICD) JOIN IDB.PATIENT_V ON DX_MRN = PT_MRN AND YEAR(DX_DTE- PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) >= 15) SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN AS MRN, PT_NAME, CURRENT_AGE, DX_DTE AS DIAGNOSIS_DATE, AGE_AT_DIAGNOSIS, LISTAGG(COALESCE(STRIP(CAST(DX_CODE AS VARCHAR(12000))), '')||' - '|| COALESCE(STRIP(CAST(DX_DESC AS VARCHAR(12000))), '')|| ' | ', CHR(13) || CHR(10)) WITHIN GROUP ( ORDER BY DX_CODE) AS DIAGNOSIS FROM APPOINTMENT JOIN TMDX ON DX_MRN = CPE_MRN GROUP BY CPE_MRN, PT_NAME, DX_DTE, CURRENT_AGE, AGE_AT_DIAGNOSIS, CLD_DEPT_NAME, CRE_RES_NAME ORDER BY CPE_MRN;

prompt: Provide a list of patients with genitourinary cancers who are enrolled in the World Trade Center Health Program (WTCHP). Patients on the WTCHP have insurer coverage that assists with copayments and covers the costs of high dollar oral medications and our Patient Financial Service may have an automated way of determining WTCHP.
completion: WITH PREP AS (SELECT OTR_RELEASE_NAME, OTR_RELEASE_DATE, OTTT_CODE, OTTT_NAME, OTTT_MAINTYPENAME, OTTT_TISSUE FROM (SELECT OTR_RELEASE_NAME, OTR_RELEASE_DATE, OTTT_CODE, OTTT_NAME, OTTT_MAINTYPENAME, OTTT_TISSUE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY OTTT_CODE ORDER BY CASE WHEN OTR_RELEASE_NAME = 'oncotree_latest_stable' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END DESC, OTR_RELEASE_DATE DESC) RN FROM DSGTOOLS.ONCOTREE_TUMORTYPE_V WHERE OTR_RELEASE_NAME NOT IN ('oncotree_development', 'oncotree_candidate_release') ) WHERE RN = 1 ), IMPACT AS (SELECT PDWS_NAME, PDRX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID AS DEID, PT_MRN, PDRX_ACCESSION_NO, PDRX_DMP_PATIENT_ID, PDRX_DMP_SAMPLE_ID, TUMOR_TYPE_CODE, TUMOR_TYPE_NAME, OTTT_MAINTYPENAME, OTTT_TISSUE, OTR_RELEASE_NAME, IS_METASTASIS, PRIMARY_SITE, METASTASIS_SITE, PART_DESCRIPTION FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML INNER JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML_SETTINGS ON PDRX_PATH_DMP_RESULTS_XML_ID = PDRXS_PATH_DMP_RESULTS_XML_ID INNER JOIN DVDMC.PATHOLOGY_DMP_WEBSVC_SETTINGS ON PDRXS_SETTING_ID = PDWS_SETTING_ID INNER JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON PDRX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID, XMLTABLE('$c/root/meta-data' PASSING PDRX_XML_VALUE AS "c" COLUMNS TUMOR_TYPE_CODE VARCHAR(100) PATH 'tumor_type_code', TUMOR_TYPE_NAME VARCHAR(255) PATH 'tumor_type_name', IS_METASTASIS VARCHAR(10) PATH 'is_metastasis', PRIMARY_SITE VARCHAR(255) PATH 'primary_site', METASTASIS_SITE VARCHAR(255) PATH 'metastasis_site', PART_DESCRIPTION VARCHAR(2000) PATH 'part_description') T INNER JOIN PREP ON TUMOR_TYPE_CODE = OTTT_CODE WHERE OTTT_MAINTYPENAME IN ('Prostate Cancer', 'Bladder Cancer', 'Renal Cell Carcinoma') AND PDWS_NAME = 'IMPACT') , CDOC AS (SELECT DISTINCT CDD_MRN, CDD_DOC_GUID, CDD_SERVICE_DTE, CDD_DOC_NAME, CDO_SECTION, CDO_CTLG_DISPL_NM, CDO_MSTR_ITEM_NM, CDO_ITEM_NAME, CDO_VALUE_TEXT FROM IDB.CD_DOCUMENT JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION ON CDO_DOC_GUID = CDD_DOC_GUID AND CDO_AUTHORED_DTE = CDD_AUTHORED_DTE WHERE CDD_CANCEL_IND = '0' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND = '0' AND(UPPER(CDO_VALUE_TEXT) LIKE '%WTC%' OR UPPER(CDO_ITEM_NAME) LIKE '%WTC%' OR UPPER(CDO_SECTION) LIKE '%WTC%' OR UPPER(CDO_CTLG_DISPL_NM) LIKE '%WTC%') ) SELECT DISTINCT CC_MRN, CLM_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) DIAGNOSIS_DATE FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN CDOC ON CDD_MRN = CC_MRN JOIN IMPACT ON CC_MRN= PT_MRN WHERE CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND ((CC_PT_TYPE = 'I') OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) AND CC_CLSF_CD IN ('C61', 'C67.9', 'C64.9') GROUP BY CC_MRN, CLM_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK

We would like to have a list of all mesothelioma patients seen by a Thoracic Oncology attending between 7/1/2017 and 6/30/2023. We would like a total for the number of mesothelioma new visits, follow up visits, and infusion chair appointments during this time frame. 



Separately, we would like a list of all peritoneal mesothelioma patients seen by GI Medical Oncology during this time frame as well as a total for the number of mesothelioma new visits, follow up visits, and infusion chair appointments during this time frame.
completion: WITH MT AS (SELECT PRPT_MRN, PRPT_PROCEDURE_DTE, PRPT_REPORT_DTE, PRPT_REPORT_TYPE_DESC, PRPT_ACCESSION_NO, PRPT_REPORT, PRPT_ORD_DR_NAME, PRPT_ORD_DR_SVC_DESC FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V WHERE PRPT_REPORT IS NOT NULL AND CONTAINS("PRPT_REPORT", '("mesothelioma")') = 1 ) , THR_VISIT AS (SELECT CPE_MRN AS MRN, CPE_ENC_DTE AS APPT_DATE, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 AS DEPT, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 AS SVC, CLD_DEPT_NAME AS DEPT_NAME, CRE_RES_NAME AS PROVIDER, CRE_RES_TYP AS RESOURCE_TYPE, CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME AS VISIT_TYPE, CVT_EXT_NAME AS VISIT_TYPE_NAME FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN '2017-07-01' AND '2023-06-30' AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 IN ('THR', 'GI', 'COL') AND CRE_RES_TYP = 'Physician' ) , COHORT AS (SELECT MT.PRPT_MRN, THR_VISIT.APPT_DATE, THR_VISIT.DEPT, THR_VISIT.SVC, THR_VISIT.DEPT_NAME, THR_VISIT.PROVIDER, THR_VISIT.RESOURCE_TYPE, THR_VISIT.VISIT_TYPE, THR_VISIT.VISIT_TYPE_NAME FROM MT JOIN THR_VISIT ON MT.PRPT_MRN = THR_VISIT.MRN) SELECT DISTINCT * FROM COHORT ; WITH MT AS (SELECT PRPT_MRN, PRPT_PROCEDURE_DTE, PRPT_REPORT_DTE, PRPT_REPORT_TYPE_DESC, PRPT_ACCESSION_NO, PRPT_REPORT, PRPT_ORD_DR_NAME, PRPT_ORD_DR_SVC_DESC FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V WHERE PRPT_REPORT IS NOT NULL AND CONTAINS("PRPT_REPORT", '("mesothelioma")') = 1 ) , THR_VISIT AS (SELECT CPE_MRN AS MRN, CPE_ENC_DTE AS APPT_DATE, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 AS DEPT, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 AS SVC, CLD_DEPT_NAME AS DEPT_NAME, CRE_RES_NAME AS PROVIDER, CRE_RES_TYP AS RESOURCE_TYPE, CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME AS VISIT_TYPE, CVT_EXT_NAME AS VISIT_TYPE_NAME FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN '2017-07-01' AND '2023-06-30' AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 IN ('THR', 'GI', 'COL') AND CRE_RES_TYP = 'Physician' ) , COHORT AS (SELECT MT.PRPT_MRN, MT.PRPT_REPORT_DTE, THR_VISIT.APPT_DATE, THR_VISIT.DEPT, THR_VISIT.SVC, THR_VISIT.DEPT_NAME, THR_VISIT.PROVIDER, THR_VISIT.RESOURCE_TYPE, THR_VISIT.VISIT_TYPE, THR_VISIT.VISIT_TYPE_NAME FROM MT JOIN THR_VISIT ON MT.PRPT_MRN = THR_VISIT.MRN) , COHORT_MRN_LIST AS (SELECT DISTINCT PRPT_MRN COHORT_MRN FROM COHORT) , VISITS AS (SELECT CPE_MRN AS MRN, CPE_ENC_DTE AS APPT_DATE, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 AS DEPT, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 AS SVC, CLD_DEPT_NAME AS DEPT_NAME, CRE_RES_NAME AS PROVIDER, CRE_RES_TYP AS RESOURCE_TYPE, CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME AS VISIT_TYPE, CVT_EXT_NAME AS VISIT_TYPE_NAME, CASE WHEN (CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR LIKE '%NV%' OR CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR LIKE '%IR%') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS NEW_VISIT, CASE WHEN UPPER(CVT_EXT_NAME) LIKE '%FOLLOW%UP%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS FOLLOW_UP, CASE WHEN CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 = 'CHM' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS CHEMO FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN '2017-07-01' AND '2023-06-30' ) SELECT * FROM COHORT_MRN_LIST LEFT JOIN VISITS ON COHORT_MRN_LIST.COHORT_MRN = VISITS.MRN WHERE (SVC IN ('COL', 'CTC', 'CTS', 'GI', 'GU', 'THR', 'MEDONC') OR CHEMO = 1) ;

completion: WITH DIAG1 AS (SELECT CC_MRN DIAG1_MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS DIAG1_DTE, CC_CLSF_CD AS DIAG1_ICD_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS DIAG1_ICD_DESC FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE 1 =1 AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND (CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) AND (UPPER(CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK) LIKE '%VENOUS%THROMBOSIS%EMBOLISM%' OR UPPER(CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK) LIKE '%PULMONARY%EMBOLISM%' OR UPPER(CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK) LIKE '%CEREBRAL%INFARCTION%UNSPECIFIED%' OR UPPER(CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK) LIKE '%ESSENTIAL%PRIMARY%HYPERTENSION%') GROUP BY CC_MRN, CC_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK), DIAG2 AS (SELECT CC_MRN DIAG2_MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS DIAG2_DTE, CC_CLSF_CD AS DIAG2_ICD_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS DIAG2_ICD_DESC FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE 1 =1 AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND (CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) AND (UPPER(CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK) LIKE '%INTRACRANIAL%HEMORRHAGE%' OR UPPER(CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK) LIKE '%INTRACEREBRAL%HEMORRHAGE%' OR UPPER(CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK) LIKE '%INTRACPARENCHYMAL%HEMORRHAGE%' OR UPPER(CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK) LIKE '%SUBARACHNOID%HEMORRHAGE%' OR UPPER(CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK) LIKE '%INTRAVENTRICULAR%HEMORRHAGE%' OR UPPER(CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK) LIKE '%ACUTE%HEMORRHAGIC%STROKE%' OR UPPER(CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK) LIKE '%HEMORRHAGIC%CEREBRAL%INFARCTION%' OR UPPER(CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK) LIKE '%BULBAR%HEMORRHAGE%' OR UPPER(CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK) LIKE '%HEMORRHAGIC%CEREBRAL%INFARCTION%') GROUP BY CC_MRN, CC_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK), BEV_DRUG AS (SELECT CPO_MRN, CPO_ORD_GUID, CPO_DRUG_NAME, MIN(CPO_START_DTE) ORD_START_DATE, MAX(CPO_STOP_DTE) ORD_END_DATE FROM IDB.CHEMO_PERFORMED_ORDERS WHERE UPPER(CPO_DRUG_NAME) LIKE '%BEVACIZUMAB%' GROUP BY CPO_MRN, CPO_ORD_GUID, CPO_DRUG_NAME ORDER BY CPO_MRN) SELECT PT_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_SEX, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, PT_DEATH_IND, PT_DATE_OF_DEATH, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) DATE_OF_FIRST_MELANOMA_BRAIN_METASTASIS, CASE WHEN RTC_TX_COURSE_ID IS NOT NULL THEN 'YES' ELSE 'NO' END RAD_TREATMENT, CASE WHEN DIAG1_DTE IS NOT NULL THEN 'YES' ELSE 'NO' END DIAGNOSIS_GROUP1, DIAG1_DTE, DIAG1_ICD_CD, DIAG1_ICD_DESC, CASE WHEN DIAG2_DTE IS NOT NULL THEN 'YES' ELSE 'NO' END DIAGNOSIS_GROUP2, DIAG2_DTE, DIAG2_ICD_CD, DIAG2_ICD_DESC FROM IDB.PATIENT JOIN IDB.CTC_CLSF ON PT_MRN = CC_MRN JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD LEFT JOIN IDB.RADONC_TREATMENT_COURSE ON PT_MRN = RTC_TX_MRN LEFT JOIN DIAG1 ON PT_MRN = DIAG1_MRN LEFT JOIN DIAG2 ON PT_MRN = DIAG2_MRN WHERE CC_CLSF_CD IN ('C79.31') AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND CC_EFF_DTE BETWEEN '2004-01-01' AND '2021-12-31' AND (CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM BEV_DRUG WHERE PT_MRN = CPO_MRN AND ORD_START_DATE >= '2004-01-01' AND ORD_END_DATE <= '2021-12-31') GROUP BY PT_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_SEX, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, PT_DEATH_IND, PT_DATE_OF_DEATH, CC_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK, CASE WHEN RTC_TX_COURSE_ID IS NOT NULL THEN 'YES' ELSE 'NO' END, CASE WHEN DIAG1_DTE IS NOT NULL THEN 'YES' ELSE 'NO' END, DIAG1_DTE, DIAG1_ICD_CD, DIAG1_ICD_DESC, CASE WHEN DIAG2_DTE IS NOT NULL THEN 'YES' ELSE 'NO' END, DIAG2_DTE, DIAG2_ICD_CD, DIAG2_ICD_DESC ORDER BY PT_MRN

prompt:
Count of patients 

Count of case/surgery cancellations



Criteria:

Department includes all MSKCC PST clinics



Biannual- june 2023 to december 2023



Surgery date/ cancellation comes after the first encounter date at any PST clinic
completion: SELECT CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME AS VISIT_TYPE, COUNT(CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME) VISITS_COUNT , COUNT(DISTINCT CPE_MRN) PATIENT_COUNT FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE V ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 = 'PST' AND CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME IN ('TELEHEALTH PST', 'PST') AND CPE_ENC_DTE >= CURRENT date - 6 MONTHS GROUP BY CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME ; WITH APPT AS (SELECT CPE_MRN, CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME AS VISIT_TYPE, MIN(CPE_ENC_DTE) AS FIRST_APPT FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE V ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CLD_DEPT_NAME LIKE '%PST%' AND CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME IN ('TELEHEALTH PST', 'PST') AND CPE_ENC_DTE >= CURRENT date - 6 MONTHS GROUP BY CPE_MRN, CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME) , SRG AS (SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN, OC_CASE_ID, VISIT_TYPE, COALESCE(OL_LOG_STS, OC_OR_CASE_STS) AS SURGSTATUS , FIRST_APPT FROM APPT LEFT JOIN IDB.OR_CASE ON CPE_MRN = OC_MRN AND OC_SURG_DTE >= FIRST_APPT LEFT JOIN IDB.OR_CASE_ALL_PROC ON OCAP_CASE_ID = OC_CASE_ID AND OC_OR_CASE_STS_CD IN ('2', '5') LEFT JOIN IDB.OR_PROC ON OP_OR_PROC_ID = OCAP_OR_PROC_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.OR_CASE_ALL_SURG ON OCAS_CASE_ID = OCAP_CASE_ID AND OCAS_PNL_NO = OCAP_PNL_NO AND OCAS_SURG_ROLE = 'Primary' AND OC_OR_CASE_STS_CD IN ('2', '5') LEFT JOIN IDB.OR_LOG ON OL_LOG_ID = OC_CASE_ID AND OL_SURG_DTE >= FIRST_APPT ) SELECT VISIT_TYPE, COUNT(OC_CASE_ID) CANCELLED_SURGERIES, COUNT(DISTINCT CPE_MRN) PATIENT_COUNT FROM SRG WHERE SURGSTATUS ='Can' GROUP BY VISIT_TYPE ;

prompt: Provide list of patients diagnosed with Anaplastic Large Cell Lymphoma.
completion: WITH X AS (SELECT DISTINCT "t1"."PT_MRN" AS "MRN", "t2"."PRPT_ACCESSION_NO" AS "Pathology Report", "t3"."DT_DTE" AS "Pathology Procedure Date", UPPER(CASE WHEN LENGTH(PRPT_REPORT) <= 15000 THEN RTRIM(CAST(SUBSTR(PRPT_REPORT, 1, 15000) AS VARCHAR(15000))) ELSE CAST(SUBSTR(PRPT_REPORT, 1, 15000) AS VARCHAR(15000)) END) AS FULLTEXT FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V" "t1" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED" "t4" ON "t1"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t4"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V" "t2" ON "t4"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t2"."PRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" "t3" ON "t2"."PRPT_PROCEDURE_DATE_ID" = "t3"."DT_DATE_ID" WHERE ((CONTAINS("t2"."PRPT_REPORT", '("ALCL" | "Anaplastic Large Cell Lymphoma" | "Anaplastic Lymphoma")') = 1 AND CONTAINS("t2"."PRPT_REPORT", '"ALK"') = 1) AND ("t2"."PRPT_REPORT" IS NOT NULL AND "t2"."PRPT_REPORT" IS NOT NULL)) ) , PT AS (SELECT PT_MRN, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, PT_DATE_OF_DEATH, COALESCE(MAX(PLA_LST_APPT_DTE, PLA_LST_DSCH_DTE), PLA_LST_APPT_DTE, PLA_LST_DSCH_DTE) AS LAST_FU_DATE FROM IDB.PATIENT JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY ON PT_MRN = PLA_MRN WHERE PT_MRN IN (SELECT MRN FROM X) ) , CHEMO AS (SELECT DISTINCT APR_MRN, APR_GENERIC_NAME, APR_DRUG_NAME, APR_START_DTE, APR_END_DTE, APR_ORD_RX_TYPE, APR_ORDER_SOURCE, APR_ORDER_SOURCE_ID, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY APR_MRN ORDER BY APR_START_DTE) AS RN FROM IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX_V WHERE CDG_CHEMO_FLAG = 'Y' AND APR_MRN IN (SELECT MRN FROM X) ) SELECT MRN, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, PT_DATE_OF_DEATH, LAST_FU_DATE, APR_GENERIC_NAME, APR_START_DTE, "Pathology Procedure Date", "Pathology Report", FULLTEXT FROM X JOIN PT ON MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN CHEMO ON MRN = APR_MRN AND RN = 1
