ELSE 0 END) AS "NONE", MAX(CASE WHEN VALUE_TEXT LIKE '%DRESSING%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "DRESSING", MAX(CASE WHEN VALUE_TEXT LIKE '%GROOMING%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "GROOMING", MAX(CASE WHEN VALUE_TEXT LIKE '%EATING%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "EATING", MAX(CASE WHEN VALUE_TEXT LIKE '%WALKING%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "WALKING", MAX(CASE WHEN VALUE_TEXT LIKE '%BATHING%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "BATHING", MAX(CASE WHEN VALUE_TEXT LIKE '%USING THE TOILET%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "USING THE TOILET", MAX(CASE WHEN VALUE_TEXT LIKE '%USING THE PHONE%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "USING THE PHONE", MAX(CASE WHEN VALUE_TEXT LIKE '%SHOPPING FOR GROCERIES%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "SHOPPING FOR GROCERIES", MAX(CASE WHEN VALUE_TEXT LIKE '%PREPARING MEALS%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "PREPARING MEALS", MAX(CASE WHEN VALUE_TEXT LIKE '%DOING SIMPLE CLEANING%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "DOING SIMPLE CLEANING", MAX(CASE WHEN VALUE_TEXT LIKE '%DOING YOUR OWN LAUNDRY%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "DOING YOUR OWN LAUNDRY", MAX(CASE WHEN VALUE_TEXT LIKE '%MANAGING FINANCES%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "MANAGING FINANCES", MAX(CASE WHEN VALUE_TEXT LIKE '%HANDLING YOU OWN MEDICINE%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "HANDLING YOU OWN MEDICINE", MAX(CASE WHEN VALUE_TEXT LIKE '%VISITING YOUR DOCTOR%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "VISITING YOUR DOCTOR" FROM (SELECT DISTINCT CDD_MRN AS MRN, CDD_DOC_GUID AS DOC_GUID, CDD_DOC_NAME AS DOC_NAME, CDD_SERVICE_DTE AS SERVICE_DATE, CDO_SECTION AS "Section", CDO_CTLG_DISPL_NM AS CTLG_DISPL_NM, CDO_MSTR_ITEM_NM AS MSTR_ITEM_NM, CDO_ITEM_NAME AS ITEM_NAME, UPPER(STRIP(SUBSTR(CDO_VALUE_TEXT, 1, 2000))) AS VALUE_TEXT FROM PT JOIN IDB.CD_DOCUMENT ON CDD_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION ON CDD_DOC_GUID = CDO_DOC_GUID WHERE CDD_DOC_NAME IN ('Adult Health Screening (65+), Ambulatory - Nursing', 'Adult Health Screening, Ambulatory - Nursing', 'Nursing Adult Health Screening 65+, Patient/RN - Outpatient', 'Nursing Adult Health Screening, Patient/RN - Outpatient') AND CDD_CANCEL_IND <> '1' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND <> '1' ) AHS GROUP BY MRN, DOC_GUID, DOC_NAME, SERVICE_DATE

prompt: Provide a list of patients with breast cancer who received Trastuzumab Deruxtecan (Enhertu) from 6/20/2022 to 9/30/2023.
completion: WITH APR AS (SELECT DISTINCT APR_MRN, CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME, APR_GENERIC_NAME, APR_DRUG_NAME, APR_START_DTE, APR_END_DTE, APR_ORD_RX_TYPE, APR_DIAGNOSIS_DESC FROM IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX_V WHERE CDG_CHEMO_FLAG = 'Y' AND(UPPER(APR_GENERIC_NAME) LIKE '%TRASTUZUMAB DERUXTECAN%' OR UPPER(APR_DRUG_NAME) LIKE '%TRASTUZUMAB DERUXTECAN%' OR UPPER(APR_GENERIC_NAME) LIKE '%ENHERTU%' OR UPPER(APR_DRUG_NAME) LIKE '%ENHERTU%') AND APR_START_DTE BETWEEN '2022-06-20' AND '2023-09-30' ) SELECT APR_MRN, CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME, MIN(APR_START_DTE) AS START_DATE, MAX(APR_END_DTE) AS END_DATE, APR_DIAGNOSIS_DESC FROM APR GROUP BY APR_MRN, CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME, APR_DIAGNOSIS_DESC

prompt: Provide monthly list of patients scheduled with Radiation, Department of Medicine and Department of Surgery who have a Oropharyngeal diagnosis
completion: WITH CC AS (SELECT CC_MRN, CLM_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS DX_DATE FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND ((CC_PT_TYPE = 'I') OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) AND CC_CLSF_CD IN ('C10', 'C10.0', 'C10.1', 'C10.2', 'C10.3', 'C10.4', 'C10.8', 'C10.9') GROUP BY CC_MRN, CLM_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK ) , DX AS (SELECT CC_MRN, LISTAGG(COALESCE(STRIP(CAST(DX_DATE AS VARCHAR(12000))), '') || ' : ' || COALESCE(STRIP(CLM_CLSF_CD), '') || ' | ' || COALESCE(STRIP(CAST(CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS VARCHAR(12000))), '') , CHR(13) || CHR(10)) WITHIN GROUP( ORDER BY CC_MRN, DX_DATE, CLM_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK) AS ICD_10 FROM CC GROUP BY CC_MRN) , CPE AS (SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN, CPE_ENC_DTE AS "Appt Date", STRIP(CRE_RES_NAME) AS "Visit MD", STRIP(CLD_DEPT_NAME) AS "Department", STRIP(CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6) AS "Dept Grouper6", STRIP(CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8) AS "Dept Grouper8", STRIP(CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME) AS "Visit Type", ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CPE_MRN ORDER BY CPE_ENC_DTE) AS RN FROM DX JOIN IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER ON CPE_MRN = CC_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Sch') AND CRE_RES_TYP IN ('Physician') AND CPE_ENC_DTE >= CURRENT DATE ) SELECT STRIP(CC_MRN) AS CC_MRN, STRIP(PT_LAST_NAME) || ', ' || STRIP(PT_FIRST_NAME) AS "Name", ICD_10, "Appt Date", "Visit MD", "Department", "Dept Grouper6", "Dept Grouper8", "Visit Type" FROM DX JOIN CPE ON CC_MRN = CPE_MRN JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON CC_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE "Dept Grouper6" IN ('MED', 'SRG', 'RDO') ORDER BY CC_MRN, "Appt Date"

prompt: The most recent 100 patients on or before 4/8/2019 with a pathology report, surgical pathology report, or dermatology surgical pathology report with the term "intradermal nevus"
completion: WITH PATH AS (SELECT PRPT_MRN, CASE WHEN PRPT_PROCEDURE_DTE IS NULL THEN DV.REGEXSTR('(?<=Date of Collection\/Procedure\/Outside Report: ).*', PRPT_REPORT) ELSE PRPT_PROCEDURE_DTE END AS PRPT_PROCEDURE_DTE, PRPT_REPORT_DTE, PRPT_REPORT_TYPE_DESC, PRPT_ACCESSION_NO, PRPT_REPORT FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V WHERE PRPT_REPORT IS NOT NULL AND PRPT_REPORT_DTE <= '2019-04-08' AND CONTAINS("PRPT_REPORT", '("intradermal nevus")') = 1 AND PRPT_REPORT_TYPE_DESC <> 'Surgical Submitted Slides' ) SELECT PRPT_MRN AS MRN , PT_LAST_NAME , PT_FIRST_NAME , PRPT_PROCEDURE_DTE AS PROCEDURE_DATE , PRPT_REPORT_DTE AS REPORT_DATE , PRPT_REPORT_TYPE_DESC AS REPORT_TYPE , PRPT_REPORT AS FULL_REPORT_TEXT FROM PATH JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V ON PRPT_MRN = PT_MRN ORDER BY PRPT_PROCEDURE_DTE DESC FETCH FIRST 100 ROWS ONLY

prompt: Patients seen by the Pediatric department who died from January 2018 to June 2021 with five or more visits
completion: SELECT * FROM (SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN MRN, YEAR(PT_DATE_OF_DEATH - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) AS AGE_OF_DEATH, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, PT_DATE_OF_DEATH, PT_ADDR1, PT_ADDR2, PT_EMAIL_ADDRESS, PT_PHONE, CL_MOBILE_PHONE, AV_DESC AS LANGUAGE, COUNT(CPE_ENC_CSN_ID) AS PED_APPT_CNT FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON CPE_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_PATIENT ON PT_MRN = CL_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS A ON AV_CODE = CL_PRIMARY_LANG AND AV_ELEMENT = 'PRIMARY_LANG' WHERE 1=1 AND CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CRE_RES_TYP IN ('Physician') AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 = 'PED' AND PT_DATE_OF_DEATH BETWEEN '2018-01-01' AND '2021-06-30' GROUP BY CPE_MRN, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, PT_DATE_OF_DEATH, PT_ADDR1, PT_ADDR2, PT_EMAIL_ADDRESS, PT_PHONE, CL_MOBILE_PHONE, AV_DESC) AS X WHERE PED_APPT_CNT >= 5

completion: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CC_MRN) AS COUNT, CC_CLSF_CD AS ICD_CD, YEAR(EFF_DTE) AS YEAR FROM (SELECT CC_MRN, CC_CLSF_CD, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS EFF_DTE FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE CC_CLSF_CD IN ('C71.9', '191.9', 'C72.3', 'C70.1', '192.3 ') AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' GROUP BY CC_MRN, CC_CLSF_CD HAVING MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) BETWEEN '2014-01-01' AND CURRENT date) A GROUP BY CC_CLSF_CD, YEAR(EFF_DTE) ORDER BY YEAR(EFF_DTE), CC_CLSF_CD

prompt: We would like to create an on demand report for our breast service database.
completion: SELECT DISTINCT CDD_MRN, CDD_DOC_GUID, CDD_SERVICE_DTE, CDD_DOC_NAME , CDO_ITEM_NAME , STRIP(SUBSTR(CDO_VALUE_TEXT, 1, 200)) AS "Distant Metastasis" FROM IDB.CD_DOCUMENT JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION ON CDO_DOC_GUID = CDD_DOC_GUID WHERE 1=1 #PROMPTMANY('MRN', 'String', ' ', ' and CDD_MRN in (', '', ')')# AND CDD_CANCEL_IND = '0' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND = '0' AND CDO_OBS_CTLG_MSTR_ITEM_GUID = '9000098314202890' AND CDO_VALUE_TEXT IS NOT NULL AND CDO_VALUE_TEXT > '' ORDER BY CDD_MRN, CDD_DOC_GUID, CDD_SERVICE_DTE ;

prompt: Provide a report of patients aged 12 - 15 eligible to receive Pfizer covid19 vaccine series and booster
completion: WITH PTS AS (SELECT CPE_MRN, CPE_ENC_DTE, CRE_RES_NAME, YEAR(CURRENT DATE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) CURRENT_AGE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CPE_MRN ORDER BY CPE_ENC_DTE DESC) RN FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON CPE_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN '2021-01-01' AND CURRENT date AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 = 'PED' AND YEAR(CURRENT DATE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) BETWEEN 11 AND 16 AND PT_DEATH_IND IN ('', 'A') ) , UPCOMING AS (SELECT C.CPE_MRN, C.CPE_ENC_DTE, R.CRE_RES_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY C.CPE_MRN ORDER BY C.CPE_ENC_DTE) RN FROM PTS P JOIN IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER C ON P.CPE_MRN = C.CPE_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE R ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT D ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON C.CPE_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Sch') AND C.CPE_ENC_DTE >= CURRENT date AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 = 'PED' AND PT_DEATH_IND IN ('', 'A') ) SELECT PT_MRN, TRIM(PT_LAST_NAME) || ', ' || TRIM(PT_FIRST_NAME) PT_NAME, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, CURRENT_AGE, COALESCE(DATE(DOSE_1_EMAR_ADMIN_DT), DATE(DOSE_1_APPT_DT), DOSE_1_HM_ACTION_DTE) DOSE1_DATE, DOSE_1_BRAND, COALESCE(DATE(DOSE_2_EMAR_ADMIN_DT), DATE(DOSE_2_APPT_DT), DOSE_2_HM_ACTION_DTE) DOSE2_DATE, DOSE_2_BRAND, COALESCE(DATE(DOSE_ADDL_EMAR_ADMIN_DT), DATE(DOSE_ADDL_APPT_DT)) ADDL_DOSE_DATE, DOSE_ADDL_BRAND, R.CPE_ENC_DTE LAST_PED_APPT_DATE, U.CPE_ENC_DTE NEXT_PED_APPT_DATE FROM PTS R JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON R.CPE_MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.COVID19_PATIENT_CP_VACCINE_INFO ON R.CPE_MRN = CP_MRN LEFT JOIN UPCOMING U ON R.CPE_MRN = U.CPE_MRN AND U.RN = 1 WHERE R.RN = 1 ;

prompt: Create a report on patients who responded "Yes" to the question "Would you like to speak to someone about talking to your minor children about cancer?" on the Ambulatory Nursing Adult Health Screening.
completion: WITH X AS (SELECT DISTINCT CDD_MRN AS MRN, CDD_DOC_GUID AS DOC_GUID, CDD_DOC_NAME AS DOC_NAME, CDD_SERVICE_DTE AS SERVICE_DATE, CDO_SECTION AS "Section", CDO_CTLG_DISPL_NM AS CTLG_DISPL_NM, CDO_MSTR_ITEM_NM AS MSTR_ITEM_NM, CDO_ITEM_NAME AS ITEM_NAME, STRIP(SUBSTR(CDO_VALUE_TEXT, 1, 100)) AS VALUE_TEXT, OS_SVC_GRP_CD, OS_SVC_DESC FROM IDB.CD_DOCUMENT JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION ON CDD_DOC_GUID = CDO_DOC_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_CLIENT_VISIT ON CDD_VISIT_GUID = OCV_VISIT_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_SERVICE ON OCV_SVC_GUID = OS_SVC_GUID JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON CDD_MRN = PT_MRN AND YEAR(CDD_SERVICE_DTE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) < 40 WHERE CDD_DOC_NAME IN ('Nursing Adult Health Screening 65+, Patient/RN - Outpatient', 'Nursing Adult Health Screening, Patient/RN - Outpatient') AND CDO_ITEM_NAME = '***Would you like to speak to someone about talking with your minor children about cancer?' AND CDO_VALUE_TEXT LIKE '%Yes%' AND CDD_SERVICE_DTE BETWEEN '2019-01-01' AND CURRENT DATE AND CDD_CANCEL_IND <> '1' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND <> '1' ) SELECT OS_SVC_GRP_CD, OS_SVC_DESC, COUNT(*) FROM X GROUP BY OS_SVC_GRP_CD, OS_SVC_DESC WITH X AS (SELECT DISTINCT CDD_MRN AS MRN, CDD_DOC_GUID AS DOC_GUID, CDD_DOC_NAME AS DOC_NAME, CDD_SERVICE_DTE AS SERVICE_DATE, CDO_SECTION AS "Section", CDO_CTLG_DISPL_NM AS CTLG_DISPL_NM, CDO_MSTR_ITEM_NM AS MSTR_ITEM_NM, CDO_ITEM_NAME AS ITEM_NAME, STRIP(SUBSTR(CDO_VALUE_TEXT, 1, 100)) AS VALUE_TEXT, OS_SVC_GRP_CD, OS_SVC_DESC FROM IDB.CD_DOCUMENT JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION ON CDD_DOC_GUID = CDO_DOC_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_CLIENT_VISIT ON CDD_VISIT_GUID = OCV_VISIT_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_SERVICE ON OCV_SVC_GUID = OS_SVC_GUID JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON CDD_MRN = PT_MRN AND YEAR(CDD_SERVICE_DTE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) < 40 WHERE CDD_DOC_NAME = 'Initial Evaluation - Psychiatry' AND CDO_ITEM_NAME = 'Does the patient have children?' AND CDO_VALUE_TEXT LIKE '%yes%' AND CDD_SERVICE_DTE BETWEEN '2019-01-01' AND CURRENT DATE AND CDD_CANCEL_IND <> '1' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND <> '1' ) SELECT OS_SVC_GRP_CD, OS_SVC_DESC, COUNT(*) FROM X GROUP BY OS_SVC_GRP_CD, OS_SVC_DESC

prompt: Provide a list of patients treated for metastases to the spine with 800cGy x 5 fractions between between 8 and 2018.
completion: SELECT DISTINCT RTC_TX_MRN "MRN", PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH "DOB", RTC_PRIMARY_REF_POINT "RT Ref Point", RTC_TX_PLAN_NAME "RT Plan Name", RTC_TX_DELIVERED_DOSE "Delivered Dose", RTC_TX_START_DTE "RT Start Date", RTC_TX_STOP_DTE "RT Stop Date", S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_DESC, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS HIST_DESC, TM_DX_DTE "Diagnosis Date", CASE WHEN M.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK IS NOT NULL THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS "Bone Mets DX" FROM IDB.RADONC_TREATMENT_COURSE JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON RTC_TX_MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.CDB_TUMOR ON RTC_TX_MRN = TM_MRN AND TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') LEFT JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD LEFT JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD LEFT JOIN IDB.CTC_CLSF ON RTC_TX_MRN = CC_MRN AND SUBSTR(CC_CLSF_CD, 1, 5) IN ('C79.5') AND CC_CLSF_TYPE like 'DF%' LEFT JOIN IDB.CLM M ON CC_CLSF_CD = M.CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE RTC_TX_PLANNED_DOSE = 4000.00 AND RTC_TX_DELIVERED_FRACTIONS = 5 AND UPPER(RTC_PRIMARY_REF_POINT) not like '%PROS%' AND UPPER(RTC_PRIMARY_REF_POINT) not like '%LUNG%' AND UPPER(RTC_PRIMARY_REF_POINT) not like '%LIVER%' AND UPPER(RTC_TX_PLAN_NAME) not like '%PROS%' AND UPPER(RTC_TX_PLAN_NAME) not like '%LUNG%' AND UPPER(RTC_TX_PLAN_NAME) not like '%LIVER%' AND RTC_TX_START_DTE > '2008-01-01' ORDER BY "Bone Mets DX" DESC ; WITH PTS AS (SELECT RTC_TX_MRN "MRN", PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH "DOB", RTC_PRIMARY_REF_POINT "RT Ref Point", RTC_TX_PLAN_NAME "RT Plan Name", RTC_TX_DELIVERED_DOSE "Delivered Dose", RTC_TX_START_DTE "RT Start Date", RTC_TX_STOP_DTE "RT Stop Date", S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_DESC, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS HIST_DESC, TM_DX_DTE "Diagnosis Date" FROM IDB.RADONC_TREATMENT_COURSE JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON RTC_TX_MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.CDB_TUMOR ON RTC_TX_MRN = TM_MRN AND TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') LEFT JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD LEFT JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD WHERE RTC_TX_PLANNED_DOSE = 4000.00 AND RTC_TX_DELIVERED_FRACTIONS = 5 AND UPPER(RTC_PRIMARY_REF_POINT) not like '%PROS%' AND UPPER(RTC_PRIMARY_REF_POINT) not like '%LUNG%' AND UPPER(RTC_PRIMARY_REF_POINT) not like '%LIVER%' AND UPPER(RTC_TX_PLAN_NAME) not like '%PROS%' AND UPPER(RTC_TX_PLAN_NAME) not like '%LUNG%' AND UPPER(RTC_TX_PLAN_NAME) not like '%LIVER%' ) SELECT PBD_MRN, PBD_SVC_DTE, PBC_CPT_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK FROM IDB.PBD_DTL JOIN IDB.PBD_CODE ON PBD_PBD_CD = PBC_PBD_CD JOIN IDB.CLM ON PBC_CPT_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.PBD_INVOICE ON PBD_INV_NO = PBI_INV_NO JOIN IDB.DOC ON PBI_PERFORM_DR_NO = DOC_DR_NO JOIN PTS ON PBD_MRN = "MRN" WHERE DOC_ACDMC_SVC = 'INTERVENTIONAL RADIOLOGY'

prompt: Update MED10778 with admission dates, IP/OP status and ICU dates.
completion: WITH BMT AS (SELECT DISTINCT CDD_MRN AS MRN, STRIP(PT_LAST_NAME)||', '||STRIP(PT_FIRST_NAME) AS PT_NAME, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH AS DOB FROM IDB.CD_DOCUMENT JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION ON CDO_DOC_GUID = CDD_DOC_GUID AND CDO_AUTHORED_DTE = CDD_AUTHORED_DTE JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PT_MRN = CDD_MRN AND PT_DATE_OF_DEATH IS NULL WHERE CDD_CANCEL_IND = '0' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND = '0' AND(UPPER(CDD_DOC_NAME) LIKE '%FOLLOW%UP%BMT%' OR UPPER(CDD_DOC_NAME) LIKE '%FOLLOW%UP%BONE%MARROW%TRANSPLANT%' OR UPPER(CDD_DOC_NAME) LIKE '%PROGRESS%NOTE%BMT%' OR UPPER(CDD_DOC_NAME) LIKE '%PROGRESS%NOTE%BONE%MARROW%TRANSPLANT%') AND UPPER(CDD_DOC_NAME) NOT LIKE '%NURS%' ) , DNR AS (SELECT MRN, PT_NAME, DOB, 'Y' AS "DNR" FROM BMT JOIN IDB.OMS_ORDER ON MRN = OO_MRN WHERE OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID = '2000001302073001' AND OO_ORD_STS_CD NOT IN ('CANC', 'CANP', 'AUC3') AND OO_STOP_DT IS NULL AND OO_ORD_MODIFIER NOT LIKE '%Discontinue DNR%' ) , CD AS (SELECT DISTINCT MRN, PT_NAME, DOB, 'Y' AS "ClinDoc" FROM BMT JOIN IDB.CD_DOCUMENT ON MRN = CDD_MRN JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION ON CDO_DOC_GUID = CDD_DOC_GUID AND CDO_AUTHORED_DTE = CDD_AUTHORED_DTE JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PT_MRN = CDD_MRN AND PT_DATE_OF_DEATH IS NULL WHERE CDD_CANCEL_IND = '0' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND = '0' AND CDD_SERVICE_DTE = CURRENT DATE - 3 DAYS AND(UPPER(CDO_VALUE_TEXT) LIKE '% GOC %' OR UPPER(CDO_VALUE_TEXT) LIKE '%GOALS OF CARE%' OR UPPER(CDO_VALUE_TEXT) LIKE '%FAMILY MEETING%' OR UPPER(CDO_VALUE_TEXT) LIKE '%FAMILY DISCUSSION%' OR UPPER(CDO_VALUE_TEXT) LIKE '%HOSPICE%' OR UPPER(CDO_VALUE_TEXT) LIKE '%G.O.C.%' OR UPPER(CDO_VALUE_TEXT) LIKE '%COMFORT MEASURES%' OR UPPER(CDO_VALUE_TEXT) LIKE '%PROGNOSIS%') ) , ICU AS (SELECT DISTINCT MRN, PT_NAME, DOB, 'Y' AS "ICU" FROM BMT JOIN IDB.ICU_CENSUS ON MRN = ICU_MRN AND ICU_ICU_DSCH_DTE IS NULL) , HOSPICE AS (SELECT DISTINCT MRN, PT_NAME, DOB, 'Y' AS "Hospice" FROM BMT JOIN IDB.OMS_ORDER ON MRN = OO_MRN WHERE OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID = '9000010264100730' AND OO_ORD_STS_CD NOT IN ('CANC', 'CANP', 'AUC3') AND OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT DATE - 30 DAYS AND CURRENT DATE - 1 DAYS ) , CTE1 AS (SELECT DISTINCT CDD_MRN AS MRN, CDD_SERVICE_DTE AS SERVICE_DATE, LEFT(STRIP(CDO_VALUE_TEXT), 10) AS VALUE_TEXT, LENGTH(STRIP(CDO_VALUE_TEXT)) AS DATE_LEN, LOCATE('/', LEFT(STRIP(CDO_VALUE_TEXT), 10)) - 1 AS MM_LEN, LOCATE('/', LEFT(STRIP(CDO_VALUE_TEXT), 10)) AS X1 FROM IDB.CD_DOCUMENT JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION ON CDO_DOC_GUID = CDD_DOC_GUID AND CDO_AUTHORED_DTE = CDD_AUTHORED_DTE WHERE CDD_CANCEL_IND = '0' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND = '0' AND CDD_DOC_NAME = 'Progress Note - BMT' AND CDO_ITEM_NAME = 'HSCT Date' AND CDD_SERVICE_DTE BETWEEN '2012-01-01' AND CURRENT DATE AND CDD_MRN IN (SELECT MRN FROM BMT) ) , CTE2 AS (SELECT MRN, SERVICE_DATE, VALUE_TEXT, DATE_LEN, MM_LEN, X1, CASE WHEN MM_LEN = 1 THEN '0' || LEFT(VALUE_TEXT, MM_LEN) WHEN MM_LEN = 2 THEN LEFT(VALUE_TEXT, MM_LEN) END AS MM, SUBSTR(VALUE_TEXT, X1 + 1, DATE_LEN - X1) AS DDYY FROM CTE1) , CTE3 AS (SELECT MRN, SERVICE_DATE, VALUE_TEXT, DATE_LEN, MM_LEN, X1, MM, DDYY, LOCATE('/', DDYY) - 1 AS DD_LEN, LOCATE('/', DDYY) AS X2 FROM CTE2) , CTE4 AS (SELECT MRN, SERVICE_DATE, VALUE_TEXT, DATE_LEN, MM_LEN, X1, DDYY, DD_LEN, X2, MM, CASE WHEN DD_LEN = 1 THEN '0' || LEFT(DDYY, DD_LEN) WHEN DD_LEN = 2 THEN LEFT(DDYY, DD_LEN) END AS DD FROM CTE3) , CTE5 AS (SELECT MRN, SERVICE_DATE, VALUE_TEXT, DATE_LEN, MM_LEN, X1, DDYY, DD_LEN, X2, RIGHT(DDYY, LENGTH(DDYY) - LOCATE('/', DDYY)) AS YY_1, MM, DD FROM CTE4) , CTE6 AS (SELECT MRN, SERVICE_DATE, VALUE_TEXT, DATE_LEN, MM_LEN, X1, MM, DDYY, DD_LEN, DD, CASE WHEN LENGTH(YY_1) = 2 THEN '20' || YY_1 WHEN LENGTH(YY_1) = 4 THEN YY_1 END AS YY FROM CTE5) , CTE7 AS (SELECT DISTINCT MRN, SERVICE_DATE, VALUE_TEXT, DATE(STRIP(CHAR(YY)) || '-' || STRIP(CHAR(MM)) || '-' || STRIP(CHAR(DD))) AS BMT_DATE FROM CTE6) , CTE8 AS (SELECT MRN, MAX(BMT_DATE) AS BMT_DATE FROM CTE7 GROUP BY MRN) , FINAL AS (SELECT MRN, PT_NAME, DOB, "DNR", '' AS "ClinDoc", '' AS "ICU", '' AS "Hospice" FROM DNR UNION SELECT MRN, PT_NAME, DOB, '' AS "DNR", "ClinDoc", '' AS "ICU", '' AS "Hospice" FROM CD UNION SELECT MRN, PT_NAME, DOB, '' AS "DNR", '' AS "ClinDoc", "ICU", '' AS "Hospice" FROM ICU UNION SELECT MRN, PT_NAME, DOB, '' AS "DNR", '' AS "ClinDoc", '' AS "ICU", "Hospice" FROM HOSPICE) , FINAL2 AS (SELECT MRN, PT_NAME, DOB, MAX("DNR") AS DNR, MAX("ClinDoc") AS CLINDOC, MAX("ICU") AS ICU, MAX("Hospice") AS HOSPICE FROM FINAL GROUP BY MRN, PT_NAME, DOB) , FINAL3 AS (SELECT MRN, PT_NAME, DOB, DNR, CLINDOC, ICU, HOSPICE, CASE WHEN VIS_MRN IS NOT NULL THEN 'IP' ELSE 'OP' END AS STS, VIS_ADM_NUM, VIS_ADM_DTE AS CURRENT_ADMIT_DATE, VIS_DSCH_DTE, VIS_PATIENT_TYPE, VIS_HOSP_SVC, VIS_NURS_STA, VIS_IP_OP_ADJUSTED_IND FROM FINAL2 LEFT JOIN IDB.VISIT ON MRN = VIS_MRN AND VIS_IP_OP_ADJUSTED_IND = 'I' AND VIS_VISIT_STATUS IN ('2', '3') AND CURRENT date BETWEEN VIS_ADM_DTE AND COALESCE(VIS_DSCH_DTE, CURRENT date)) , FINAL4 AS (SELECT FINAL3.*, BMT_DATE, CURRENT DATE AS "Current Date", DAYS(CURRENT DATE) - DAYS(COALESCE(BMT_DATE, CURRENT DATE)) AS "Transplant Day", DAYS(CURRENT DATE) - DAYS(COALESCE(CURRENT_ADMIT_DATE, CURRENT DATE)) AS "Hospital Day" FROM FINAL3 LEFT JOIN CTE8 ON FINAL3.MRN = CTE8.MRN ORDER BY STS, DAYS(CURRENT DATE) - DAYS(COALESCE(BMT_DATE, CURRENT DATE)) DESC, DAYS(CURRENT DATE) - DAYS(COALESCE(CURRENT_ADMIT_DATE, CURRENT DATE)) DESC, ICU, DNR, FINAL3.MRN) , GVHD1 AS (SELECT DISTINCT CDD_MRN AS MRN, CDD_DOC_GUID, CDD_SERVICE_DTE, CDD_SERVICE_DT, CDD_DOC_NAME, G2.CDO_VALUE_TEXT AS "GvHD Details" FROM IDB.CD_DOCUMENT LEFT JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION G2 ON G2.CDO_DOC_GUID = CDD_DOC_GUID AND G2.CDO_AUTHORED_DTE = CDD_AUTHORED_DTE AND G2.CDO_ITEM_NAME = 'GvHD Details' WHERE CDD_CANCEL_IND = '0' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND = '0' AND CDD_DOC_NAME IN ('Follow Up - BMT', 'Progress Note - BMT') AND CDD_MRN IN (SELECT MRN FROM FINAL4) ) , GVHD2 AS (SELECT MRN, MAX(CDD_SERVICE_DT) AS LATEST_GVHD_DT FROM GVHD1 GROUP BY MRN) , GVHD3 AS (SELECT DISTINCT G1.MRN, G1.CDD_SERVICE_DTE AS "Latest GvHD Date", G2.LATEST_GVHD_DT, "GvHD Details" FROM GVHD1 G1 JOIN GVHD2 G2 ON G1.MRN = G2.MRN AND G1.CDD_SERVICE_DT = G2.LATEST_GVHD_DT) SELECT DISTINCT FINAL4.*, "Latest GvHD Date", "GvHD Details" FROM FINAL4 LEFT JOIN GVHD3 ON FINAL4.MRN = GVHD3.MRN

prompt: Provide a weekly list of MSI-High patients who have been given PD-1 inhibitor treatment within the past 45 days.
completion: WITH IMMUNO AS (SELECT DISTINCT APR_MRN , APR_GENERIC_NAME , CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME , COALESCE(APR_START_DTE, APR_ORD_CREATE_DTE) AS START_DATE , APR_START_DTE , APR_ORD_CREATE_DTE , APR_END_DTE FROM IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX_V WHERE 1=1 AND CDG_BIOLOGIC_IMMUNO_FLAG = 'Y' AND CDG_THERAPEUTIC_CATEGORY like '%anti-%' AND APR_START_DTE >= CURRENT date - 45 DAYS ) , IMMUNO_PTS AS (SELECT DISTINCT APR_MRN FROM IMMUNO) , DMP_DX_PRE AS (SELECT DISTINCT PDRX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID AS P_ID, PT_MRN, T.*, DT.PDRX_PATH_RPT_ID FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML DT CROSS JOIN XMLTABLE('$c/root/*' PASSING DT.PDRX_XML_VALUE AS "c" COLUMNS PRIMARY_SITE VARCHAR(264) PATH '../meta-data/primary_site', TUMOR_TYPE_NAME VARCHAR(264) PATH '../meta-data/tumor_type_name' , M_ACCESSION_NUM VARCHAR(264) PATH '../meta-data/m_accession_num' , GENE_PANEL VARCHAR(264) PATH '../meta-data/gene-panel' , PART_DESCRIPTION VARCHAR(264) PATH '../meta-data/part_description' , MSI_COMMENT VARCHAR(264) PATH '../meta-data/msi-comment' , MSI_TYPE VARCHAR(264) PATH '../meta-data/msi-type' , MSI_SCORE VARCHAR(264) PATH '../meta-data/msi-score') T JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PDRX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID JOIN IMMUNO_PTS ON APR_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE 1=1 AND MSI_TYPE = 'Instable' AND GENE_PANEL like 'IMPACT%' AND GENE_PANEL not like 'IMPACT-HEME%' ) SELECT * FROM DMP_DX_PRE ; WITH IMMUNO AS (SELECT DISTINCT APR_MRN , APR_GENERIC_NAME , CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME , COALESCE(APR_START_DTE, APR_ORD_CREATE_DTE) AS START_DATE , APR_START_DTE , APR_END_DTE , APR_ORD_CREATE_DTE FROM IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX_V WHERE 1=1 AND CDG_BIOLOGIC_IMMUNO_FLAG = 'Y' AND CDG_THERAPEUTIC_CATEGORY like '%anti-%' AND APR_START_DTE >= CURRENT date - 45 DAYS ) , IMMUNO_PTS AS (SELECT DISTINCT APR_MRN FROM IMMUNO) , DMP_DX_PRE AS (SELECT DISTINCT PDRX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID AS P_ID, PT_MRN, T.*, DT.PDRX_PATH_RPT_ID FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML DT CROSS JOIN XMLTABLE('$c/root/*' PASSING DT.PDRX_XML_VALUE AS "c" COLUMNS PRIMARY_SITE VARCHAR(264) PATH '../meta-data/primary_site', TUMOR_TYPE_NAME VARCHAR(264) PATH '../meta-data/tumor_type_name' , M_ACCESSION_NUM VARCHAR(264) PATH '../meta-data/m_accession_num' , GENE_PANEL VARCHAR(264) PATH '../meta-data/gene-panel' , PART_DESCRIPTION VARCHAR(264) PATH '../meta-data/part_description' , MSI_COMMENT VARCHAR(264) PATH '../meta-data/msi-comment' , MSI_TYPE VARCHAR(264) PATH '../meta-data/msi-type' , MSI_SCORE VARCHAR(264) PATH '../meta-data/msi-score') T JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PDRX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID JOIN IMMUNO_PTS ON APR_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE 1=1 AND MSI_TYPE = 'Instable' AND GENE_PANEL like 'IMPACT%' AND GENE_PANEL not like 'IMPACT-HEME%' ) SELECT DISTINCT IM.* FROM IMMUNO IM JOIN DMP_DX_PRE ON PT_MRN = APR_MRN ORDER BY APR_MRN, CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME, START_DATE ;

prompt: Provide composite Breast-Q scores, BMI and pathology N stage for a list of MRNs.
completion: SELECT EF_MRN MRN , EF_FORM_ID SURVEY_ID , EF_SUBMISSION_DT SURVEY_DTE , MAX(CASE WHEN ENCV_NAME = 'Psychosocial Well-Being' THEN (CASE WHEN ENCV_VALUE='Skipped' THEN NULL ELSE CAST(ENCV_VALUE AS int) END) END) AS "Psychosocial Well-Being" , MAX(CASE WHEN ENCV_NAME = 'Satisfaction with Breasts' THEN (CASE WHEN ENCV_VALUE='Skipped' THEN NULL ELSE CAST(ENCV_VALUE AS int) END) END) AS "Satisfaction with Breasts" , MAX(CASE WHEN ENCV_NAME = 'Sexual Well-Being' THEN (CASE WHEN ENCV_VALUE='Skipped' THEN NULL ELSE CAST(ENCV_VALUE AS int) END) END) AS "Sexual Well-Being" FROM IDB.EF_FORM LEFT JOIN IDB.ENAR_CALC_VALUE ON EF_FORM_EXTERNAL_ID = ENCV_ASSESSMENT_ID AND ENCV_NAME IN ('Psychosocial Well-Being', 'Satisfaction with Breasts', 'Sexual Well-Being') WHERE EF_FORM_NAME = 'Breast-Q' AND EF_MRN IN ({}) GROUP BY EF_MRN , EF_FORM_ID , EF_FORM_NAME , EF_SUBMISSION_DT ; BMI_SQL = """ select mrn, bmi from ( select PMH_MRN mrn , PMH_MEASURE_DTE , PMH_BMI bmi , row_number() over(partition by pmh_mrn order by PMH_MEASURE_DTE desc) as rn from idb.pt_measures_hx join dadm.sur22159 on PMH_MRN = mrn and PMH_MEASURE_DTE <= SURGERY_DTE ) a where rn=1""" BMI = MC.STR_STRIP(PD.READ_SQL_QUERY(BMI_SQL, MC.CONN_IDB(PANDAS=TRUE))) PN_SQL = F""" SELECT TM_MRN mrn, TM_DX_DTE DX_DTE, s.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK as site_desc, TM_PATH_TNM_N path_n_stage FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') --Good to include '1' ("INCOMPLETE") for now because many 2018 cases are incomplete but have good data AND TM_SITE_CD LIKE 'C50%' and tm_mrn in ({mrns})""" PNSTG = MC.STR_STRIP(PD.READ_SQL_QUERY(PN_SQL, MC.CONN_IDB(PANDAS=TRUE))) APR_SQL = """select apr_mrn mrn ,min(apr_start_dte) first_chemo_dte from idb.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX_V join dadm.sur22159 on apr_mrn = mrn and apr_start_dte between surgery_dte - 1 year and surgery_dte + 3 year where CDG_CHEMO_FLAG = 'Y' group by apr_mrn """ CHEMO = MC.STR_STRIP(PD.READ_SQL_QUERY(APR_SQL, MC.CONN_IDB(PANDAS=TRUE))) RT_SQL = """select RTC_TX_MRN mrn ,min(RTC_TX_START_DTE) first_rt_dte from IDB.RADONC_TREATMENT_COURSE join dadm.sur22159 on RTC_TX_MRN = mrn and RTC_TX_START_DTE between surgery_dte - 1 year and surgery_dte + 3 year group by RTC_TX_MRN"""

prompt: Provide information from the specified Document types created in 2011-2012
completion: SELECT EPD_MRN MRN, DOC_NAME CREATED_FOR, DOC_SVC CREATED_FOR_SVC, DOC_ACDMC_DPT CREATED_FOR_DEPT, OU_DISPLAY_NAME CREATED_BY, OU_OCCUPATION CREATED_BY_OCCUPATION, OU_ORD_ROLE_TYPE CREATED_BY_ROLE, EPD_DOC_DTE DOC_DTE, EMD_DOCTYPE DOCTYPE, EMD_EMR_DESC DOC_NAME FROM IDB.EMR_PT_DOCUMENT JOIN IDB.EMR_PT_DOCTYPE ON EPD_DOCTYPE = EMD_DOCTYPE JOIN IDB.OMS_USER ON SUBSTR(EPD_CREATE_ID, 2) = OU_LOGON_ID JOIN IDB.DOC ON EPD_DOCTOR_NUM = DOC_DR_NO WHERE EPD_DOCTYPE IN('PY2', 'PQ9', 'PT6', 'PJ4', 'PJ2', 'J96', 'PK2', 'PY3', 'PT1') AND EPD_DOC_DTE >= '2011-01-01' AND EPD_VIEW_LEVEL = 20 AND EPD_DOC_STATUS IN (16, 17, 18, 19, 20, 99, 100) ORDER BY EMD_DOCTYPE, EPD_DOC_DTE, EPD_MRN

prompt: Provide the number of patient days patients were dispensed bcg, mitomycin, MCC or gemcitabine in 2009 at the Kimmel Chemo location, grouped by age <65 and 65+.
completion: WITH CTE AS (SELECT PIN_GENERIC_NAME, PO_MRN || CHAR(POD_STRT_DTE) AS MRN_DTE, CASE WHEN YEAR(POD_STRT_DTE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) < 65 THEN '<65' ELSE '65+' END AS AGE_GROUP FROM IDB.PHM_ORDER JOIN IDB.PHM_ORD_DTL ON PO_ORD_SEQ = POD_ORD_SEQ JOIN IDB.PHM_ORD_INV ON POD_ORD_SEQ = POI_ORD_SEQ AND POD_ITEM_NO = POI_ITEM_NO JOIN IDB.PHM_INVENTORY ON POI_INV_SEQ = PIN_INV_SEQ JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PO_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE PO_ORD_STS NOT IN ('X', 'P') AND PIN_GENERIC_NAME IN ('BCG Live Vaccine', 'mitoMYCIN', 'MCC (Mycobacterial Cell Wall-DNA Complex)', 'Gemcitabine HCl') AND POD_STRT_DTE BETWEEN '2009-01-01' AND '2009-12-31' AND PO_DISP_LOC_NAME IN ('68th Street Clinic', 'Kimmel')) SELECT PIN_GENERIC_NAME, AGE_GROUP, COUNT(DISTINCT MRN_DTE) FROM (SELECT PIN_GENERIC_NAME, MRN_DTE, AGE_GROUP FROM CTE UNION ALL SELECT 'ALL' AS PIN_GENERIC_NAME, MRN_DTE, AGE_GROUP FROM CTE) AS A GROUP BY PIN_GENERIC_NAME, AGE_GROUP

prompt: Procedures performed by Orthopedic Surgery Faculty and Fellows during the previous academic year (2018-2019).
completion: WITH CTE AS (SELECT DISTINCT OL_LOG_ID AS ORTHO_LOGID FROM IDB.OR_LOG JOIN IDB.OR_LOG_ALL_SURG ON OL_LOG_ID = OLAS_LOG_ID JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON OLAS_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.OR_LNLG_DX ON OLAS_LOG_ID = OLLD_LOG_ID AND OLAS_PNL_NO = OLLD_DX_PROC_PNL LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_PROC AS CL_PROC_2 ON OLLD_DX_CPT2_ID = CL_PROC_2.CPX_PROC_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_PROC AS CL_PROC_3 ON OLLD_DX_CPT3_ID = CL_PROC_3.CPX_PROC_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.OR_PROC ON OLLD_DX_OR_PROC = OP_OR_PROC_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.OR_CL_PROC ON OP_OR_PROC_ID = OCP_OR_PROC_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_PROC AS CL_PROC_1 ON OCP_PROC_ID = CL_PROC_1.CPX_PROC_ID WHERE OL_LOG_STS IN ('Posted', 'Unposted') AND OLAS_SURG_ROLE_CD = '1' AND CL_PROC_3.CPX_PROC_CD IS NOT NULL AND OLAS_SURG_SVC = 'ORTHO' AND OL_SURG_DTE BETWEEN '2018-08-01' AND '2019-07-31' ) SELECT OL_LOG_ID AS LOGID, OL_MRN, OL_SURG_DTE AS SURGDATE, OLLD_LOG_LINE_NO AS LOGLINENO, OLLD_DX_PROC_PNL AS DXPRODPANEL, CRE_RES_NAME AS SURGEON, OLAS_SURG_ROLE, OLAS_SURG_SVC AS SURGSVC, OP_PROC_NAME AS CIRCRN_ORPNAME, CL_PROC_1.CPX_PROC_NAME AS CIRCRN_CPTNAME, CL_PROC_1.CPX_PROC_CD AS CIRCRN_CPT, CL_PROC_3.CPX_PROC_NAME AS PBD_CPTDESC, CL_PROC_3.CPX_PROC_CD AS PBD_CPT FROM IDB.OR_LOG JOIN IDB.OR_LOG_ALL_SURG ON OL_LOG_ID = OLAS_LOG_ID JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON OLAS_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.OR_LNLG_DX ON OLAS_LOG_ID = OLLD_LOG_ID AND OLAS_PNL_NO = OLLD_DX_PROC_PNL JOIN CTE ON OL_LOG_ID = ORTHO_LOGID LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_PROC AS CL_PROC_2 ON OLLD_DX_CPT2_ID = CL_PROC_2.CPX_PROC_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_PROC AS CL_PROC_3 ON OLLD_DX_CPT3_ID = CL_PROC_3.CPX_PROC_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.OR_PROC ON OLLD_DX_OR_PROC = OP_OR_PROC_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.OR_CL_PROC ON OP_OR_PROC_ID = OCP_OR_PROC_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_PROC AS CL_PROC_1 ON OCP_PROC_ID = CL_PROC_1.CPX_PROC_ID WHERE OL_LOG_STS IN ('Posted', 'Unposted') AND CL_PROC_3.CPX_PROC_CD IS NOT NULL ORDER BY 1, 4

prompt: We need to verify an already generated dataline report SKI16950 to include additional parameters if not already included.
completion: WITH DX AS (SELECT DISTINCT CC_MRN, CC_CLSF_CD AS "ICD-9/10 Code", CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK "ICD-9/10 Desc", MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS "Min ICD-9/10 Date" FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE CC_CLSF_CD IN ('227.6', '227.5', 'D35.5', '194.5', 'C75.5', 'C75.4', 'D44.6', 'D44.7', 'D35.6', '237.3', '194.6', '1945', '1946') AND CC_CLSF_TYPE like 'DF%' AND CC_EFF_DTE <= '2017-12-31' GROUP BY CC_MRN, CC_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK) , TMDX AS (SELECT DISTINCT TM_MRN, TM_SITE_CD, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK "Site Description", H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK "Histology", TM_HIST_CD, TM_DX_DTE FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS CS ON CS.AV_ELEMENT = 'CASE_STS' WHERE TM_HIST_CD IN ('M8680/1', 'M8680/3', 'M8690/1', 'M8692/1', 'M8692/3', 'M8693/1', 'M8693/3', 'M8711/3') ) , SURG AS (SELECT SSE_MRN, MIN(SSE_SURG_DTE) AS "Min Surgery Date" FROM IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT WHERE (SSE_SURG_LOC not like '%IR%' AND SSE_SURG_LOC not like '%ENDO%') AND SSE_MRN IN (SELECT CC_MRN FROM DX) GROUP BY SSE_MRN ) SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN MRN, "ICD-9/10 Code", "ICD-9/10 Desc", "Min ICD-9/10 Date", "Min Surgery Date", TM_SITE_CD "Site Code", "Site Description", TM_HIST_CD, "Histology", TM_DX_DTE "Diagnosis Date" FROM IDB.PATIENT LEFT JOIN DX ON PT_MRN = CC_MRN LEFT JOIN TMDX ON PT_MRN = TM_MRN LEFT JOIN SURG ON PT_MRN = SSE_MRN WHERE COALESCE(CC_MRN, TM_MRN) IS NOT NULL

completion: SELECT PDWS_NAME AS ASSAY, COUNT(PDRX_PATH_RPT_ID) AS NUMRPTS, COUNT(DISTINCT PRPT_MRN) AS UNIQUE_PTS FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML LEFT JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML_SETTINGS ON PDRX_PATH_DMP_RESULTS_XML_ID = PDRXS_PATH_DMP_RESULTS_XML_ID LEFT JOIN DVDMC.PATHOLOGY_DMP_WEBSVC_SETTINGS ON PDRXS_SETTING_ID = PDWS_SETTING_ID JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V ON PRPT_PATH_RPT_ID = PDRX_PATH_RPT_ID WHERE PDWS_NAME = 'IMPACT' AND PRPT_REPORT_DTE BETWEEN '1/1/2014' AND '12/31/2016' GROUP BY PDWS_NAME ; SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CPE_MRN) AS DIST_MRNS FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CRE_RES_TYP = 'Physician' AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN '1/1/2014' AND '12/31/2016' ; HOW MANY PATIENTS WERE REGISTERED INTO THE CANCER REGISTRY (HAD THEIR FIRST VISIT) BETWEEN 1/1/2014 AND 1/1/2016? HOW MANY PATIENTS WHO WERE REGISTERED INTO THE CANCER REGISTRY PRIOR TO 1/12014 HAD A FU VISIT AT MSK BETWEEN 1/1/2014 AND 1/1/2016?

prompt: Create a weekly report of patients scheduled for an orchiectomy or a retroperitoneal lymph node dissection and who were diagnosed with a germ cell tumor.
completion: SELECT PT_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, PT_SEX, OC_SURG_DTE, STRIP(CRE_RES_NAME) AS CRE_RES_NAME, STRIP(OCAS_SURG_SVC) AS OCAS_SURG_SVC, CPX_PROC_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK FROM IDB.PATIENT JOIN IDB.OR_CASE ON PT_MRN = OC_MRN JOIN IDB.OR_CASE_ALL_PROC ON OC_CASE_ID = OCAP_CASE_ID JOIN IDB.OR_CASE_ALL_SURG ON OCAP_CASE_ID = OCAS_CASE_ID AND OCAP_LINE_NO = OCAS_LINE_NO JOIN IDB.OR_CL_PROC ON OCAP_OR_PROC_ID = OCP_OR_PROC_ID JOIN IDB.CL_PROC ON OCP_PROC_ID = CPX_PROC_ID JOIN IDB.CLM ON CPX_PROC_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON OCAS_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID WHERE OC_SURG_DTE >= CURRENT DATE - 1 DAY AND UPPER(OC_OR_CASE_STS) = 'SCH' AND CPX_PROC_CD IN ('38780', '38570') AND PT_MRN IN (SELECT CC_MRN AS MRN FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF INNER JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND ((CC_PT_TYPE = 'I') OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) AND (CC_CLSF_CD LIKE '183%' OR CC_CLSF_CD LIKE '186%' OR CC_CLSF_CD LIKE '220%' OR CC_CLSF_CD LIKE '222%') UNION SELECT TM_MRN AS MRN FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('3', '6', '7', '8') AND TM_HIST_CD IN ('M9060/3', 'M9061/3', 'M9062/3', 'M9063/3', 'M9064/3', 'M9065/3', 'M9070/3', 'M9071/3', 'M9072/3', 'M9080/3', 'M9081/3', 'M9082/3', 'M9083/3', 'M9084/3', 'M9085/3', 'M9090/3', 'M9091/3', 'M9100/3', 'M9101/3', 'M9080/0', 'M9080/1', 'M9080/6', 'M9102/3') ) GROUP BY PT_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, PT_SEX, OC_SURG_DTE, CRE_RES_NAME, OCAS_SURG_SVC, CPX_PROC_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK UNION SELECT PT_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, PT_SEX, OC_SURG_DTE, STRIP(CRE_RES_NAME) AS CRE_RES_NAME, STRIP(OCAS_SURG_SVC) AS OCAS_SURG_SVC, CPX_PROC_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK FROM IDB.PATIENT JOIN IDB.OR_CASE ON PT_MRN = OC_MRN JOIN IDB.OR_CASE_ALL_PROC ON OC_CASE_ID = OCAP_CASE_ID JOIN IDB.OR_CASE_ALL_SURG ON OCAP_CASE_ID = OCAS_CASE_ID AND OCAP_LINE_NO = OCAS_LINE_NO JOIN IDB.OR_CL_PROC ON OCAP_OR_PROC_ID = OCP_OR_PROC_ID JOIN IDB.CL_PROC ON OCP_PROC_ID = CPX_PROC_ID JOIN IDB.CLM ON CPX_PROC_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON OCAS_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID WHERE OC_SURG_DTE >= CURRENT DATE - 1 DAY AND UPPER(OC_OR_CASE_STS) = 'SCH' AND CPX_PROC_CD IN ('54520', '54522', '54530', '54535', '54690', '56318') GROUP BY PT_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, PT_SEX, OC_SURG_DTE, CRE_RES_NAME, OCAS_SURG_SVC, CPX_PROC_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK

prompt: Provide a list of patients who underwent minimally invasive liver resection from 1/1/2000 - 12/31/2019
completion: WITH ROBOTIC AS (SELECT DISTINCT OLAP_MRN MRN FROM IDB.OR_LOG JOIN IDB.OR_LOG_ALL_PROC ON OL_LOG_ID = OLAP_LOG_ID JOIN IDB.OR_PROC ON OLAP_OR_PROC_ID = OP_OR_PROC_ID JOIN IDB.OR_CL_PROC ON OP_OR_PROC_ID = OCP_OR_PROC_ID JOIN IDB.CL_PROC ON OCP_PROC_ID = CPX_PROC_ID WHERE OL_SURG_DTE BETWEEN '2000-01-01' AND '2019-12-31' AND (OP_PROC_NAME like '%LAPAROSCOPIC%' OR OP_PROC_NAME like '%ROBOTIC%') ) SELECT OLAP_MRN MRN, OLAP_LOG_ID LOG_ID, OL_SURG_DTE SRG_DATE, OP_PROC_NAME PROCEDURE_NAME, CPX_PROC_CD CPT_CODE FROM ROBOTIC JOIN IDB.OR_LOG ON MRN = OLAP_MRN JOIN IDB.OR_LOG_ALL_PROC ON OL_LOG_ID = OLAP_LOG_ID JOIN IDB.OR_PROC ON OLAP_OR_PROC_ID = OP_OR_PROC_ID JOIN IDB.OR_CL_PROC ON OP_OR_PROC_ID = OCP_OR_PROC_ID JOIN IDB.CL_PROC ON OCP_PROC_ID = CPX_PROC_ID WHERE OL_SURG_DTE BETWEEN '2000-01-01' AND '2019-12-31' AND OP_PROC_NAME like '%LIVER%'

prompt: Dashboard to track upcoming Dose 3 Appts for Patients
