OCV_IP_OP_IND END AS IP_OP_FLAG, CDD_DOC_NAME , ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CDD_MRN, CDD_SERVICE_DTE, CDD_DOC_NAME, OP_DISCIPLINE, CDO_ITEM_NAME ORDER BY CDD_SERVICE_DT DESC) RN , OCV_CURR_LOC AS LOCATION, OP_DISPLAY_NAME AS PROVIDER, OP_DISCIPLINE AS SERVICE, CDO_SECTION , CDO_ITEM_NAME, TRIM(CDO_VALUE_TEXT) AS VALUE_TEXT FROM IDB.CD_DOCUMENT LEFT JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION ON CDD_DOC_GUID = CDO_DOC_GUID AND CDD_AUTHORED_DTE = CDO_AUTHORED_DTE JOIN IDB.OMS_PROVIDER ON CDD_AUTH_PROV_GUID = OP_PVDR_GUID AND OP_DISCIPLINE IN ('Physical Therapy', 'Occupational Therapy') LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_CLIENT_VISIT ON OCV_VISIT_GUID = CDD_VISIT_GUID WHERE CDD_CANCEL_IND <> '1' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND <> '1' AND CDD_SERVICE_DTE >= '2015-01-01' AND CDD_DOC_NAME IN ('Initial/ReEval/Completion Summary, OT - Rehabilitation', 'Initial/ReEval/Completion Summary, PT - Rehabilitation', 'Initial/ReEval/ReAssess, Lymphedema Therapy - Rehabilitation') AND (CDO_ITEM_NAME IN ('In-Person Visit', 'LTO_Visit Type ls obs', 'Visit Type:', 'PTO_Visit IRD type res obs', 'LTO_Visit Discipline ls obs', 'LTO_Visit Type ls obs', 'OTO_Visit Initial Re eval res obs', 'Referral Date:', 'Date Start:', 'Start of care:', 'Start of Care Date:', 'Referring MD/NP:', 'Visit #:', 'Discipline:', 'Other Untimed Treatment Minutes:', 'Other Untimed Treatment Minutes', 'Date Start:', 'Therapy Plan of Care Date:', 'Date End:', 'Onset date:', 'Start of care:', 'Timed treatment minutes: min', 'Total Minutes', 'Insurance:', 'Consent', 'Pre-Cert Required', 'Insurance:', 'License Number:', 'Consent', 'Preferred Language') OR LOWER(CDO_ITEM_NAME) LIKE '%in%person%visit%' ) AND CDO_SECTION <> 'Therapist Identification' ) WHERE RN =1 ) SELECT C.CDD_MRN AS MRN, C.CDD_SERVICE_DTE AS SERVICE_DATE, C.CDD_DOC_NAME DOC_NAME, MAX(C.IP_OP_FLAG) OP_IP_FLAG, MAX(C.PROVIDER) AS PROVIDER, MAX(A14.VALUE_TEXT) AS DISCIPLINE , MAX(C.LOCATION) AS LOCATION, MAX(T.VALUE_TEXT) AS VISIT_TYPE, MAX(COALESCE(P.VALUE_TEXT, 'No-')) AS "In Person Visit", MAX(R.VALUE_TEXT) AS REFERRAL_DATE, MAX(D.VALUE_TEXT) AS START_DATE, MAX(E.VALUE_TEXT) AS END_DATE, MAX(S.VALUE_TEXT) AS "Start of Care", MAX(N.VALUE_TEXT) AS "Referring MD/NP", MAX(V.VALUE_TEXT) AS "Visit Number", MAX(A12.VALUE_TEXT) AS "Specialty", MAX(A13.VALUE_TEXT) AS PREHAB, MAX(A1.VALUE_TEXT) AS "Other Untimed Treatment Minutes", MAX(A2.VALUE_TEXT) AS "Therapy Plan of Care Date", MAX(A3.VALUE_TEXT) AS "Onset date:", MAX(A4.VALUE_TEXT) AS "Timed Treatment Minutes", MAX(A11.VALUE_TEXT) AS "IE/RE Untimed Treatment Minutes", MAX(A5.VALUE_TEXT) AS "Total Minutes", MAX(A6.VALUE_TEXT) AS "Insurance", MAX(A7.VALUE_TEXT) AS "Consent", MAX(A8.VALUE_TEXT) AS "Pre-Cert Required", MAX(A9.VALUE_TEXT) AS "License Number", MAX(A10.VALUE_TEXT) AS "Preferred Language" FROM CLIN C LEFT JOIN CLIN T ON C.DOC_GUID = T.DOC_GUID AND T.CDO_ITEM_NAME IN ('LTO_Visit Type ls obs', 'Visit Type:' , 'PTO_Visit IRD type res obs', 'LTO_Visit Discipline ls obs', 'LTO_Visit Type ls obs', 'OTO_Visit Initial Re eval res obs') LEFT JOIN CLIN P ON C.DOC_GUID = P.DOC_GUID AND LOWER(P.CDO_ITEM_NAME) LIKE '%in%person%visit%' LEFT JOIN CLIN R ON C.DOC_GUID = R.DOC_GUID AND R.CDO_ITEM_NAME = 'Referral Date:' LEFT JOIN CLIN D ON C.DOC_GUID = D.DOC_GUID AND D.CDO_ITEM_NAME = 'Date Start:' LEFT JOIN CLIN E ON C.DOC_GUID = D.DOC_GUID AND D.CDO_ITEM_NAME = 'Date End:' LEFT JOIN CLIN S ON C.DOC_GUID = S.DOC_GUID AND S.CDO_ITEM_NAME IN ('Start of care:', 'Start of Care Date:') LEFT JOIN CLIN N ON C.DOC_GUID = N.DOC_GUID AND N.CDO_ITEM_NAME = 'Referring MD/NP:' LEFT JOIN CLIN V ON C.DOC_GUID = V.DOC_GUID AND V.CDO_ITEM_NAME = 'Visit #:' LEFT JOIN CLIN A1 ON C.DOC_GUID = A1.DOC_GUID AND A1.CDO_ITEM_NAME IN ('Other Untimed Treatment Minutes:', 'Other Untimed Treatment Minutes') LEFT JOIN CLIN A2 ON C.DOC_GUID = A2.DOC_GUID AND A2.CDO_ITEM_NAME IN ('Therapy Plan of Care Date:') LEFT JOIN CLIN A3 ON C.DOC_GUID = A3.DOC_GUID AND A3.CDO_ITEM_NAME = 'Onset date:' LEFT JOIN CLIN A4 ON C.DOC_GUID = A4.DOC_GUID AND A4.CDO_ITEM_NAME IN ('Timed treatment minutes: min', 'Timed Treatment Minutes') LEFT JOIN CLIN A5 ON C.DOC_GUID = A5.DOC_GUID AND A5.CDO_ITEM_NAME IN ('Total Minutes', 'Total Minutes: min') LEFT JOIN CLIN A6 ON C.DOC_GUID = A6.DOC_GUID AND A6.CDO_ITEM_NAME = 'Insurance:' LEFT JOIN CLIN A7 ON C.DOC_GUID = A7.DOC_GUID AND A7.CDO_ITEM_NAME LIKE '%Consent%' LEFT JOIN CLIN A8 ON C.DOC_GUID = A8.DOC_GUID AND A8.CDO_ITEM_NAME = 'Pre-Cert Required' LEFT JOIN CLIN A9 ON C.DOC_GUID = A9.DOC_GUID AND A9.CDO_ITEM_NAME = 'License Number:' LEFT JOIN CLIN A10 ON C.DOC_GUID = A10.DOC_GUID AND A10.CDO_ITEM_NAME = 'Preferred Language' LEFT JOIN CLIN A11 ON C.DOC_GUID = A11.DOC_GUID AND A11.CDO_ITEM_NAME = 'IE/RE Untimed Treatment Minutes:' LEFT JOIN CLIN A12 ON C.DOC_GUID = A12.DOC_GUID AND A12.CDO_ITEM_NAME = 'Specialty:' LEFT JOIN CLIN A13 ON C.DOC_GUID = A13.DOC_GUID AND A13.CDO_ITEM_NAME = 'PREHAB' LEFT JOIN CLIN A14 ON C.DOC_GUID = A14.DOC_GUID AND A14.CDO_ITEM_NAME ='Discipline:' GROUP BY C.CDD_MRN, C.CDD_SERVICE_DTE, C.CDD_DOC_NAME ;

prompt: Identify stage IV colorectal cancer patients treated with cetuximab or panitumumab who had a pathology specimen at least 6 months after the start date of cetuximab or panitumumab treatment.
completion: WITH CTE AS (SELECT "t1"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID", "t2"."PT_MRN" AS "MRN", "t2"."PT_LAST_NAME" AS "Last Name", "t2"."PT_FIRST_NAME" AS "First Name", "t2"."PT_SEX" AS "Gender", "t2"."PT_BIRTH_DTE" AS "Date of Birth", "t2"."PT_DEATH_DTE" AS "Deceased Date", MIN("t3"."DT_DTE") AS "Min Order Start Date", MAX("t3"."DT_DTE") AS "Max Order Start Date" FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED" "t1" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V" "t2" ON "t1"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t2"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PHM_PT_MEDS_MQT" "t6" ON "t1"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t6"."POD_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PHM_ORDER_DTL" "t7" ON "t6"."POD_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t7"."POD_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AND "t6"."POD_PHARMA_INVENTORY_CTLG_ID" = "t7"."POD_PHARMA_INVENTORY_CTLG_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE" "t3" ON "t7"."POD_START_DATE_ID" = "t3"."DT_DATE_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PHM_INVENTORY_CATALOG" "t8" ON "t6"."POD_PHARMA_INVENTORY_CTLG_ID" = "t8"."PINC_INVENTORY_CTLG_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."CDB_TUMOR_V" "t9" ON "t1"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t9"."CDTM_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."TUMOR_CASE_ATTRIBUTES" "t10" ON "t9"."CDTM_CASE_ATTR_ID" = "t10"."TUMOR_CASE_ATTR_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."ICDO_SITE_CATALOG_V" "t11" ON "t9"."CDTM_SITE_CATALOG_ID" = "t11"."ICSC_SITE_CATALOG_ID" WHERE ("t8"."PINC_GENERIC_NAME" IN ('C225 (CETUXIMAB)', 'CETUXIMAB (C225)', 'CETUXimab', 'PANITUMUmab') AND ("t10"."TCA_CASE_STS_DESC" IN ('Completed ') AND "t11"."ICSC_SITE_CD" BETWEEN 'C180' AND 'C209')) GROUP BY "t1"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID", "t2"."PT_MRN", "t2"."PT_LAST_NAME", "t2"."PT_FIRST_NAME", "t2"."PT_SEX", "t2"."PT_BIRTH_DTE", "t2"."PT_DEATH_DTE") SELECT "MRN", "Last Name", "First Name", "Gender", "Date of Birth", "Deceased Date", "Min Order Start Date", "Max Order Start Date", "t5"."DT_DTE" AS "Pathology Report Date", "t4"."PRPT_ACCESSION_NO" AS "Pathology Report" FROM CTE JOIN "DV"."PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V" "t4" ON "PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t4"."PRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" JOIN "DV"."DATE" "t5" ON "t4"."PRPT_REPORT_DATE_ID" = "t5"."DT_DATE_ID" WHERE "t5"."DT_DTE" >= "Min Order Start Date" + 6 MONTHS

prompt: Comprehensive list of patients with specific mutations.
completion: WITH PTS_R AS (SELECT MRN, LISTAGG(TRIM(GENE), ', ') WITHIN GROUP( ORDER BY GENE) AS GENE, LISTAGG(TRIM(GENE2), ', ') WITHIN GROUP( ORDER BY GENE2) AS GENE2, LISTAGG(TRIM(AA_CHANGE), ', ') WITHIN GROUP( ORDER BY AA_CHANGE) AS AA_CHANGE, PLA_LST_APPT_DTE FROM (SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN AS MRN , GENE , GENE2 , CASE WHEN AA_CHANGE = '' THEN NULL ELSE AA_CHANGE END AA_CHANGE , PLA_LST_APPT_DTE FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_STRUCTURED_RESULTS_V JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY ON PT_MRN = PLA_MRN WHERE 1=1 AND METHOD IN ('IMPACT') AND (GENE IN ('ATM', 'ATRIP', 'BRCA1', 'BRCA2', 'CDK12', 'CHTF8', 'MRE11', 'NBN', 'PALB2', 'RAD17', 'RAD50', 'RAD51B', 'RAD54L', 'SETD2') OR GENE2 IN ('ATM', 'ATRIP', 'BRCA1', 'BRCA2', 'CDK12', 'CHTF8', 'MRE11', 'NBN', 'PALB2', 'RAD17', 'RAD50', 'RAD51B', 'RAD54L', 'SETD2') OR (GENE IN ('CYSLTR2', 'RB1') AND ABERRATIONTYPE IN ('deletion', 'copy number loss')) OR (GENE2 IN ('CYSLTR2', 'RB1') AND ABERRATIONTYPE IN ('deletion', 'copy number loss'))) AND ABERRATIONTYPE NOT IN ('amplification', 'copy number gain') ) A GROUP BY MRN, PLA_LST_APPT_DTE) , PTS AS (SELECT MRN, GENE, GENE2, AA_CHANGE, PLA_LST_APPT_DTE, LISTAGG(TRIM(ACD_IRB_NO), ',') WITHIN GROUP( ORDER BY ACD_IRB_NO) AS AC_IRB_NO FROM PTS_R R LEFT JOIN IDB.ACCRUALS_DATES ON MRN = ACD_MRN AND ACD_OFF_STUDY_DTE IS NULL GROUP BY MRN, GENE, GENE2, AA_CHANGE, PLA_LST_APPT_DTE) , ONCOTREE_PREP AS (SELECT OTR_RELEASE_NAME, OTR_RELEASE_DATE, OTTT_CODE, OTTT_NAME, OTTT_MAINTYPENAME, OTTT_TISSUE FROM (SELECT OTR_RELEASE_NAME, OTR_RELEASE_DATE, OTTT_CODE, OTTT_NAME, OTTT_MAINTYPENAME, OTTT_TISSUE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY OTTT_CODE ORDER BY CASE WHEN OTR_RELEASE_NAME = 'oncotree_latest_stable' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END DESC, OTR_RELEASE_DATE DESC) RN FROM DSGTOOLS.ONCOTREE_TUMORTYPE_V WHERE OTR_RELEASE_NAME NOT IN ('oncotree_development', 'oncotree_candidate_release') ) WHERE RN = 1 ) , ONCOTREE AS (SELECT DISTINCT PDWS_NAME, PT_MRN, PDRX_DMP_PATIENT_ID, TUMOR_TYPE_CODE, TUMOR_TYPE_NAME, PRIMARY_SITE FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML INNER JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML_SETTINGS ON PDRX_PATH_DMP_RESULTS_XML_ID = PDRXS_PATH_DMP_RESULTS_XML_ID INNER JOIN DVDMC.PATHOLOGY_DMP_WEBSVC_SETTINGS ON PDRXS_SETTING_ID = PDWS_SETTING_ID INNER JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON PDRX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID JOIN PTS ON MRN = PT_MRN, XMLTABLE('$c/root/meta-data' PASSING PDRX_XML_VALUE AS "c" COLUMNS TUMOR_TYPE_CODE VARCHAR(100) PATH 'tumor_type_code', TUMOR_TYPE_NAME VARCHAR(255) PATH 'tumor_type_name', IS_METASTASIS VARCHAR(10) PATH 'is_metastasis', PRIMARY_SITE VARCHAR(255) PATH 'primary_site', METASTASIS_SITE VARCHAR(255) PATH 'metastasis_site', PART_DESCRIPTION VARCHAR(2000) PATH 'part_description') T INNER JOIN ONCOTREE_PREP ON TUMOR_TYPE_CODE = OTTT_CODE) SELECT DISTINCT MRN , PDRX_DMP_PATIENT_ID "DMPID" , PT_LAST_NAME "Last Name" , PT_FIRST_NAME "First Name" , AC_IRB_NO "IRBs" , GENE , GENE2 , AA_CHANGE , PLA_LST_APPT_DTE "Last Appt Date" , TUMOR_TYPE_CODE "Oncotree Code" , TUMOR_TYPE_NAME "Oncotree Name" , PRIMARY_SITE "Primary Site" FROM PTS A LEFT JOIN ONCOTREE B ON MRN = B.PT_MRN LEFT JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS C ON MRN = C.PT_MRN

prompt: Provide a list of patients who were treated with Mohs surgery for BCCs of the nose.
completion: WITH X AS (SELECT CDD_MRN, CDD_DOC_GUID, CDD_SERVICE_DTE, CDD_DOC_NAME, CDO_SECTION, CDO_CTLG_DISPL_NM, CDO_MSTR_ITEM_NM, CDO_ITEM_NAME, CDO_VALUE_TEXT FROM IDB.CD_DOCUMENT JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION ON CDO_DOC_GUID = CDD_DOC_GUID AND CDO_AUTHORED_DTE = CDD_AUTHORED_DTE WHERE CDD_CANCEL_IND = '0' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND = '0' AND CDD_SERVICE_DTE BETWEEN '2015-01-01' AND '2020-12-31' AND CDD_DOC_NAME = 'Procedure Note - Dermatologic Surgery' AND UPPER(CDO_VALUE_TEXT) LIKE '%MOHS%' AND(UPPER(CDO_VALUE_TEXT) LIKE '%NOSE%' OR UPPER(CDO_VALUE_TEXT) LIKE '%NASAL%' OR UPPER(CDO_VALUE_TEXT) LIKE '%BRIDGE%' OR UPPER(CDO_VALUE_TEXT) LIKE '%ALAR%' OR UPPER(CDO_VALUE_TEXT) LIKE '% ALA %') AND(UPPER(CDO_VALUE_TEXT) LIKE '%BASAL CELL CARCINOMA%' OR UPPER(CDO_VALUE_TEXT) LIKE '%BCC%') ) , Y AS (SELECT CDD_MRN, COUNT(DISTINCT CDD_DOC_GUID) AS NOTE_COUNT FROM X GROUP BY CDD_MRN) SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH AS DOB, R.AV_DESC AS "Race", E.AV_DESC AS "Ethnicity", CPP_HOME_PHONE, CPP_WORK_PHONE, CPP_MOBILE_PHONE, CASE WHEN NOTE_COUNT > 1 THEN 'Y' END AS "> 1 Note" FROM Y JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON CDD_MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_PAS_PATIENT ON CDD_MRN = CPP_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS R ON PT_RACE = R.AV_CODE AND R.AV_ELEMENT = 'RACE' LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS E ON PT_PT_ETHNICITY = E.AV_CODE AND E.AV_ELEMENT = 'PT_ETHNICITY'

prompt: Provide a monthly list of MCL patients that are prescribed with pirtobrutinib (LOXO-305) for treatment.
completion: WITH APR AS (SELECT DISTINCT APR_MRN, CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME, MIN(APR_START_DTE) AS MIN_START FROM IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX_V WHERE LOWER(CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME) like '%pirtobrutinib%' GROUP BY APR_MRN, CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME HAVING MIN(APR_START_DTE) BETWEEN CURRENT DATE - 30 DAY AND CURRENT DATE) , DX AS (SELECT CC_MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS EFF_DTE, CC_CLSF_CD AS ICD_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS ICD_DESC FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN APR ON APR_MRN = CC_MRN JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE CC_CLSF_CD like 'C83.1%' OR CC_CLSF_CD like '200.4%' GROUP BY CC_MRN, CC_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK) , FN AS (SELECT DISTINCT CC_MRN "MRN", TRIM(PT_FIRST_NAME) "FIRST NAME", TRIM(PT_LAST_NAME) "LAST NAME", YEAR(EFF_DTE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) "AGE AT DIAGNOSIS", EFF_DTE "DIAGNOSIS DATE", ICD_CD "ICD CODE", ICD_DESC "ICD DESCRIPTION", MIN_START "PIRTOBRUTINIB START DATE" FROM APR JOIN DX ON CC_MRN = APR_MRN JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON APR_MRN = PT_MRN) SELECT * FROM FN WHERE "MRN" NOT IN (SELECT AC_MRN FROM IDB.ACCRUALS WHERE AC_IRB_NO = '21-360' )

prompt: Provide variables on a list of approx. 1800 MRNs that will be emailed.
completion: SELECT TM_MRN, AV_DESC AS CASE_STS, TM_DX_DTE, TM_HIST_CD, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS HIST_DESC, TM_SITE_CD, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_DESC, TM_BEST_AJCC_STG FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS ON AV_ELEMENT = 'CASE_STS' AND AV_CODE = TM_CASE_STS WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND TM_SITE_CD LIKE 'C34%' AND TM_DX_DTE BETWEEN '2009-01-01' AND '2009-01-31'

prompt:
Please send weekly reports of the disease types seen in the Myeloma Service

Newly diagnosed

Relapsed/refractory

Smoldering

Any other type of Myeloma
completion: WITH CTE AS (SELECT CPE_MRN AS MRN, PT_LAST_NAME "Last Name", PT_FIRST_NAME "First Name", CPE_ENC_DTE AS "Appt Date", STRIP(CPE_CPE_APPT_STS) "Appt Status", STRIP(CLD_CLD_CENTER) AS "Center", STRIP(D.CAV_NAME) AS "Dept", COALESCE(STRIP(S.CAV_NAME), '') AS "Service", STRIP(CLD_DEPT_NAME) AS "Dept Name", STRIP(CRE_RES_NAME) AS "Provider Name", STRIP(CRE_RES_TYP) AS "Provider Type", STRIP(CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME) AS "Visit Type" FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON CPE_MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_CATEGORY D ON D.CAV_CATEGORY = 'CLD_RPT_GRP_6' AND D.CAV_ABBR = CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_CATEGORY S ON S.CAV_CATEGORY = 'CLD_RPT_GRP_8' AND S.CAV_ABBR = CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 LEFT JOIN IDB.ACCRUALS_DATES ON CPE_MRN = ACD_MRN WHERE 1=1 AND CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT DATE - DAY(CURRENT DATE) DAYS + 1 DAY - 1 MONTH AND CURRENT DATE - DAY(CURRENT DATE) DAYS AND ACD_MRN IS NULL AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 = 'MYL' ) , CLINDOC AS (SELECT CDD_MRN, MAX(CASE WHEN CDO_ITEM_NAME = 'STATUS' THEN SUBSTR(CDO_VALUE_TEXT, 1, 500) END) AS "Status", MAX(CASE WHEN CDO_ITEM_NAME = 'CHIEF COMPLAINT' THEN SUBSTR(CDO_VALUE_TEXT, 1, 500) END) AS "Chief Complaint" FROM IDB.CD_DOCUMENT JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION ON CDD_DOC_GUID = CDO_DOC_GUID AND CDD_AUTHORED_DTE = CDO_AUTHORED_DTE AND CDO_VALUE_TEXT <> '' JOIN IDB.OMS_PROVIDER ON CDD_AUTH_PROV_GUID = OP_PVDR_GUID JOIN CTE ON MRN = CDD_MRN WHERE CDD_CANCEL_IND <> '1' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND <> '1' AND CDD_DOC_NAME = 'Initial Consult/Initial Visit, AMB - DOM-Myeloma' AND CDO_ITEM_NAME IN ('STATUS', 'CHIEF COMPLAINT') GROUP BY CDD_MRN) SELECT * FROM CTE LEFT JOIN CLINDOC ON MRN = CDD_MRN

prompt: Provide data on patients who have had IMPACT testing done on a spine sample who had a surgery/biopsy with a specified physician.
completion: WITH IMPACT AS (SELECT PDWS_NAME, PDRX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID AS DEID, PT_MRN, PDRX_ACCESSION_NO, PDRX_DMP_PATIENT_ID, PDRX_DMP_SAMPLE_ID, TUMOR_TYPE_CODE, TUMOR_TYPE_NAME, IS_METASTASIS, PRIMARY_SITE, METASTASIS_SITE, PART_DESCRIPTION, DV.REGEXSTR('[S|H|C][0-9]{2}\-[0-9]*', XMLCAST(XMLQUERY('$x/root/meta-data/part_description' PASSING PDRX_XML_VALUE AS "x") AS VARCHAR(2000))) AS REFERENCEDACCESSION FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML INNER JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML_SETTINGS ON PDRX_PATH_DMP_RESULTS_XML_ID = PDRXS_PATH_DMP_RESULTS_XML_ID INNER JOIN DVDMC.PATHOLOGY_DMP_WEBSVC_SETTINGS ON PDRXS_SETTING_ID = PDWS_SETTING_ID INNER JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON PDRX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID, XMLTABLE('$c/root/meta-data' PASSING PDRX_XML_VALUE AS "c" COLUMNS TUMOR_TYPE_CODE VARCHAR(100) PATH 'tumor_type_code', TUMOR_TYPE_NAME VARCHAR(255) PATH 'tumor_type_name', IS_METASTASIS VARCHAR(10) PATH 'is_metastasis', PRIMARY_SITE VARCHAR(255) PATH 'primary_site', METASTASIS_SITE VARCHAR(255) PATH 'metastasis_site', PART_DESCRIPTION VARCHAR(2000) PATH 'part_description') T WHERE UPPER(PART_DESCRIPTION) like '%TIBIA%' OR UPPER(PART_DESCRIPTION) like '%FIBULA%' OR UPPER(PART_DESCRIPTION) like '%HUMERUS%' OR UPPER(PART_DESCRIPTION) like '%FEMUR%' OR UPPER(PART_DESCRIPTION) like '%SCAPULA%' OR UPPER(PART_DESCRIPTION) like '%ILIUM%' OR UPPER(PART_DESCRIPTION) like '%ILIAC%' OR UPPER(PART_DESCRIPTION) like '%TROCHANTER%' OR UPPER(PART_DESCRIPTION) like '%ACETABULUM%' OR UPPER(PART_DESCRIPTION) like '%RAMUS%' OR METASTASIS_SITE IN ('BONE', 'BONE MARROW', 'BONE', 'BONE (FEMUR)', 'BONE MARROW', 'CHEST WALL', 'CLIVUS', 'FEMUR', 'HUMERUS', 'ILIAC', 'ILIAC BONE', 'KNEE', 'LEFT ILIAC BONE', 'LOWER EXTREMITY', 'MANUBRIUM', 'PELVIC WALL', 'PELVIS', 'PENIS', 'PUBIC BONE', 'RIB', 'RIGHT ILIAC BONE', 'RIGHT ISCHIUM', 'SCAPULA', 'SKULL BASE', 'SKULL BASE - PTERYGOID MARGIN', 'TIBIA') OR PRIMARY_SITE IN ('BONE', 'BONE MARROW', 'BONE', 'BONE (FEMUR)', 'BONE MARROW', 'CHEST WALL', 'CLIVUS', 'FEMUR', 'HUMERUS', 'ILIAC', 'ILIAC BONE', 'KNEE', 'LEFT ILIAC BONE', 'LOWER EXTREMITY', 'MANUBRIUM', 'PELVIC WALL', 'PELVIS', 'PENIS', 'PUBIC BONE', 'RIB', 'RIGHT ILIAC BONE', 'RIGHT ISCHIUM', 'SCAPULA', 'SKULL BASE', 'SKULL BASE - PTERYGOID MARGIN', 'TIBIA') ) SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN, PDRX_DMP_PATIENT_ID, PDRX_DMP_SAMPLE_ID, PDRX_ACCESSION_NO, DV.TODATE(DV.REGEXSTR('[0-9]*[\-|\.|\/][0-9]*[\-|\.|\/][0-9]*', DT_PROCEDURE)) AS PROCEDUREDATE, TUMOR_TYPE_CODE, TUMOR_TYPE_NAME, PRIMARY_SITE, METASTASIS_SITE, PART_DESCRIPTION, PDWS_NAME FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML INNER JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML_SETTINGS ON PDRX_PATH_DMP_RESULTS_XML_ID = PDRXS_PATH_DMP_RESULTS_XML_ID INNER JOIN DVDMC.PATHOLOGY_DMP_WEBSVC_SETTINGS ON PDRXS_SETTING_ID = PDWS_SETTING_ID INNER JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON PDRX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID, XMLTABLE('$c/root/meta-data' PASSING PDRX_XML_VALUE AS "c" COLUMNS DT_PROCEDURE VARCHAR(40) PATH 'dt_procedure', TUMOR_TYPE_CODE VARCHAR(100) PATH 'tumor_type_code', TUMOR_TYPE_NAME VARCHAR(255) PATH 'tumor_type_name', IS_METASTASIS VARCHAR(10) PATH 'is_metastasis', PRIMARY_SITE VARCHAR(255) PATH 'primary_site', METASTASIS_SITE VARCHAR(255) PATH 'metastasis_site', PART_DESCRIPTION VARCHAR(2000) PATH 'part_description') T WHERE PT_MRN IN (SELECT PT_MRN FROM IMPACT) ;

prompt: Provide a weekly report of patients seen in the Sarcoma service returning for a PACC visit 3 weeks post their New Visit with Sarcoma service.
completion: WITH PACC AS (SELECT CPE_MRN AS "MRN", CPE_ENC_DTE AS "Appt Date", CPE_CPE_APPT_STS "Appt Status", CLD_DEPT_NAME AS "Department Name", CRE_RES_NAME AS "Provider Name", CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME AS "Visit Type" FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Sch') AND CLD_DEPT_NAME IN ('PACC BED 1275', 'PACC TREATMENT 1275', 'PACC PROC RM 1275') AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT date + 3 DAY AND CURRENT date + 7 DAYS ) , SAR AS (SELECT CPE_MRN AS "MRN", CPE_ENC_DTE AS "Appt Date", CPE_CPE_APPT_STS "Appt Status", CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 AS "Department", CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 AS "Service", CLD_DEPT_NAME AS "Department Name", CRE_RES_NAME AS "Provider Name", CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME AS "Visit Type" FROM (SELECT DISTINCT "MRN" FROM PACC) PACC JOIN IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER ON PACC."MRN" = CPE_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND (CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR LIKE '%NV%' OR CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR LIKE '%IR%') AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 = 'PED' AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 = 'SAR' AND CPE_ENC_DTE >= '2021-01-01' ) , PEC AS (SELECT DOP.PT_MRN PEC_MRN, COALESCE(ADMIN_QUESTION_DSCRP, '') "MSKKids Status", COALESCE(ANSWER, '') "Eligible for Project Every Child?", COALESCE(NOTE, '') "Project Every Child Notes" FROM PACC JOIN NN.CRDB_DOP_PEDS DOP ON PACC."MRN" = DOP.PT_MRN LEFT JOIN NN.CRDB_PT_ADM_SPC ADM ON DOP.PT_MRN = ADM.PT_MRN AND QUESTION_ID = 306) SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN MRN, PT_LAST_NAME "Last Name", PT_FIRST_NAME "First Name", PACC.*, SAR."Appt Date" "PED SAR Appt Date", SAR."Department Name" "PED SAR Dept Name", SAR."Provider Name" "PED SAR Provider", SAR."Visit Type" "PED SAR Visit Type", "MSKKids Status", "Eligible for Project Every Child?", "Project Every Child Notes" FROM PACC JOIN SAR ON PACC."MRN" = SAR."MRN" AND SAR."Appt Date" <= PACC."Appt Date" - 21 DAYS JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PACC."MRN" = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN PEC ON PACC."MRN" = PEC_MRN

prompt: Requesting numbers for allogeneic transplant patients that have been tested for adenovirus (AdV). This data is not currently captured in the departmental CRDB database (MED-HCT)
completion: WITH X AS (SELECT * FROM IDB.CRDB_BMT_MEDICINE WHERE CBM_TRANSPLANT_DTE <= '2023-07-01' AND CBM_TRANSPLANT_TYPE = 'ALLO' ) , OUTPATIENT AS (SELECT DISTINCT CDD_MRN AS "MRN", CDD_DOC_NAME AS "Document Name" FROM X LEFT JOIN IDB.CD_DOCUMENT ON CBM_MRN = CDD_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION ON CDD_DOC_GUID = CDO_DOC_GUID AND CDD_AUTHORED_DTE = CDO_AUTHORED_DTE AND CDO_VALUE_TEXT <> '' JOIN IDB.OMS_PROVIDER ON CDD_AUTH_PROV_GUID = OP_PVDR_GUID JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON CDD_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE CDD_CANCEL_IND <> '1' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND <> '1' AND CDD_DOC_NAME IN ('Follow Up, AMB - BMT/CTS', 'Follow Up - BMT', 'Follow Up, AMB - BMT/CTS-BMT', 'Follow Up, AMB - BMT/CTS-CTS') AND CDD_SERVICE_DTE BETWEEN '2022-06-01' AND '2023-07-01' AND PT_DATE_OF_DEATH IS NOT NULL ) , TEST AS (SELECT DISTINCT LR_MRN, LTL_LINE_NO, LR_TEST_NAME, LR_SUBTEST_NAME, LR_RESULT_VALUE, LR_RESULT_TYPE_CD, LR_RESULT_STS_CD, LTL_TEXT_RESULT FROM X LEFT JOIN IDB.LAB_RESULTS ON CBM_MRN = LR_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.LAB_TEXT_LINE ON LTL_RESULT_GUID = LR_RESULT_GUID WHERE UPPER(LR_TEST_NAME) LIKE ('ADENOVIRUS QUA%') AND LR_PERFORMED_DTE <= '2023-07-01' ) , POSPT AS (SELECT DISTINCT LPC_MRN FROM X JOIN IDB.LAB_POSITIVE_CULTURES ON CBM_MRN = LPC_MRN WHERE(UPPER(LPC_ORGANISM_OBSERVATION) like '%ADENOVIRUS%QUA%' OR UPPER(LPC_ORGANISM_OBSERVATION) like '%ADV%') ) , DRUG AS (SELECT OO_MRN, OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE, OO_ORD_NAME, OOC_ITEM_NAME, OOC_ITEM_DESC, OSTS_STS_DESC FROM TEST JOIN IDB.OMS_ORDER ON LR_MRN = OO_MRN JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_CATALOG ON OOC_MSTR_ITEM_GUID = OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_USER_DATA ON OUD_ORD_GUID = OO_ORD_GUID LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_STATUS ON OSTS_ORD_STS_CD = OO_ORD_STS_CD WHERE UPPER(OOC_ITEM_NAME) LIKE '%CIDO%VIR%' ) SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CBM_MRN) TOTAL_COUNT, COUNT(DISTINCT "MRN") OUTPATIENT_COUNT, COUNT(DISTINCT LR_MRN) TEST_COUNT, COUNT(DISTINCT LPC_MRN) POSITIVE_PT_COUNT, COUNT(DISTINCT OO_MRN)DRUG_STARTED_PT_COUNT FROM X LEFT JOIN OUTPATIENT V ON X.CBM_MRN = "MRN" LEFT JOIN TEST T ON X.CBM_MRN = T.LR_MRN LEFT JOIN POSPT ON X.CBM_MRN =LPC_MRN LEFT JOIN DRUG ON X.CBM_MRN = OO_MRN

prompt: Provide a list of all patients that underwent a partial and/or total laryngectomy at MSK between '2000-01-01' and '2021-04-01'
completion: SELECT DISTINCT SSE_MRN AS MRN, SSE_SURG_DTE AS "Surgery Date", SSP_SURG_SVC_CD AS "Surgery Service Code", SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD AS "Surgery CPT Code", SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC AS "Surgery CPT Description", TRIM(SSP_SURG_LAST_NM)||','||TRIM(SSP_SURG_FIRST_NM) AS "SURGEON NAME" FROM IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE ON SSE_LOG_ID = SSP_LOG_ID AND SSE_ENC_CSN_ID = SSP_ENC_CSN_ID WHERE SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD IN ('31300', '31360', '31365', '31367', '31370', '31375', '31382', '31390', '31395', '31400') AND SSE_SURG_DTE BETWEEN '2000-01-01' AND '2021-04-01' ORDER BY SSE_MRN

prompt: Provide list of MRNs and associated surgical pathology report/surgical submitted slide for EBER results.
completion: WITH PATH AS (SELECT PRPT_MRN, PRPT_REPORT FROM (SELECT PRPT_MRN, PRPT_PROCEDURE_DTE, PRPT_REPORT_DTE, PRPT_REPORT_TYPE_DESC, PRPT_ACCESSION_NO, PRPT_REPORT, PRPT_ORD_DR_NAME, PRPT_ORD_DR_SVC_DESC FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V WHERE PRPT_REPORT IS NOT NULL AND PRPT_REPORT_TYPE_DESC IN ('Surgical Submitted Slides', 'Surgical Pathology') AND CONTAINS("PRPT_REPORT", '("STOMACH" )') = 1 ) WHERE 1=1 AND CONTAINS("PRPT_REPORT", '("EBER" OR "Epstein Barr virus" OR "FISH analysis for EBER" OR "EBV associated gastric adenocarcinoma" OR "Epstein-Barr virus-associated gastric adenocarcinoma" )') = 1 ) ,ICD AS (SELECT DISTINCT CC_MRN AS DX_MRN, CLM_CLSF_CD AS DX_CODE, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS DX_DESC FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN PATH ON PRPT_MRN = CC_MRN JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND ((CC_PT_TYPE = 'I') OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) AND (CC_CLSF_CD LIKE ('C16%') OR UPPER(CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK) LIKE ('%STOMACH%')) ) SELECT PRPT_MRN, PRPT_REPORT FROM PATH JOIN ICD ON PRPT_MRN = DX_MRN

prompt: List of patients on protocol 15-129 who have completed a Dose Modification Research Note
completion: SELECT DISTINCT CDD_MRN "MRN", PT_LAST_NAME "Last Name", PT_FIRST_NAME "First Name", CDD_SERVICE_DTE AS "Service Date", CDO_ITEM_NAME AS "Item", CDO_VALUE_TEXT AS "Value" FROM IDB.CD_DOCUMENT LEFT JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION ON CDD_DOC_GUID = CDO_DOC_GUID AND CDD_AUTHORED_DTE = CDO_AUTHORED_DTE AND CDO_VALUE_TEXT <> '' JOIN IDB.OMS_PROVIDER ON CDD_AUTH_PROV_GUID = OP_PVDR_GUID JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON CDD_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.ACCRUALS ON CDD_MRN = AC_MRN AND AC_IRB_NO = '15-129' WHERE CDD_CANCEL_IND <> '1' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND <> '1' AND CDD_DOC_NAME = 'Dose Modification - Research' AND CDO_ITEM_NAME = 'Protocol Number' ORDER BY 1

prompt: Please provide a list of patients that have had stem cell transplants and have been seen in the dental service between 1/1/2001-12/31/2018.
completion: WITH DX AS (SELECT PT_MRN, PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_BIRTH_DTE, MIN(DT_DTE) AS "ICD-9/10 Min Dx Date", DXCC_ICD_CODE AS "ICD-9/10 Dx Code", DXCC_ICD_MSK_DESC AS "ICD-9/10 Dx Description" FROM DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS JOIN DV.PATIENT_DIAGNOSIS_FINAL_ALL_V ON PDX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID JOIN DV.DATE_V ON PDX_DX_DATE_ID = DT_DATE_ID JOIN DV.DIAGNOSIS_CATALOG ON PDX_DX_CATALOG_ID = DXCC_DX_CATALOG_ID WHERE DXCC_ICD_CODE IN ('T86.5', 'Z94.84', 'Z94.81', 'D84.9', 'D80.2', 'D80.3', 'D80.4', 'D81.9', 'D81.0', 'D83.9', 'D82.0', 'D89.9', 'D56.1' ) OR DXCC_ICD_CODE IN ('996.88', 'V42.82', 'V42.81', '279.3', '279.01', '279.03', '279.02', '279.2', '279.2', '279.06', '279.12', '279.9', '282.44' ) GROUP BY PT_MRN, PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_BIRTH_DTE, DXCC_ICD_CODE, DXCC_ICD_MSK_DESC ), CPT AS (SELECT TRIM(PT_MRN) AS "CPT_MRN", PCC_CODE AS "CPT OR PBD CODE", PCC_DESC AS "PROCEDURE DESC", DT_DTE AS "PROCEDURE DATE" FROM DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V JOIN DV.CPT_PBD_PATIENT_PROCEDURE ON PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PTX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID JOIN DV.DATE ON PTX_PROC_DATE_ID = DT_DATE_ID WHERE PCC_CODE IN ('99201', '99202', '99203', '99204', '99205', '99212', '99213', '99214', '99215') AND DT_DTE BETWEEN '2001-01-01' AND '2018-12-31' ) SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_BIRTH_DTE, "ICD-9/10 Min Dx Date", "ICD-9/10 Dx Code", "ICD-9/10 Dx Description", YEAR("ICD-9/10 Min Dx Date" - PT_BIRTH_DTE) AGE_AT_DX FROM DX JOIN CPT ON CPT_MRN = PT_MRN ; WITH DX AS (SELECT PT_MRN, PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_BIRTH_DTE, MIN(DT_DTE) AS "ICD-9/10 Min Dx Date", DXCC_ICD_CODE AS "ICD-9/10 Dx Code", DXCC_ICD_MSK_DESC AS "ICD-9/10 Dx Description" FROM DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS JOIN DV.PATIENT_DIAGNOSIS_FINAL_ALL_V ON PDX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID JOIN DV.DATE_V ON PDX_DX_DATE_ID = DT_DATE_ID JOIN DV.DIAGNOSIS_CATALOG ON PDX_DX_CATALOG_ID = DXCC_DX_CATALOG_ID WHERE DXCC_ICD_CODE IN ('T86.5', 'Z94.84', 'Z94.81', 'D84.9', 'D80.2', 'D80.3', 'D80.4', 'D81.9', 'D81.0', 'D83.9', 'D82.0', 'D89.9', 'D56.1' ) OR DXCC_ICD_CODE IN ('996.88', 'V42.82', 'V42.81', '279.3', '279.01', '279.03', '279.02', '279.2', '279.2', '279.06', '279.12', '279.9', '282.44' ) GROUP BY PT_MRN, PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_BIRTH_DTE, DXCC_ICD_CODE, DXCC_ICD_MSK_DESC ), CPT AS (SELECT PT_MRN, PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID, PCC_CODE AS "CPT OR PBD CODE", PCC_DESC AS "PROCEDURE DESC", DT_DTE AS "PROCEDURE DATE" FROM DX JOIN DV.CPT_PBD_PATIENT_PROCEDURE ON PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PTX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID JOIN DV.DATE ON PTX_PROC_DATE_ID = DT_DATE_ID WHERE PCC_CODE IN ('99201', '99202', '99203', '99204', '99205', '99212', '99213', '99214', '99215') AND DT_DTE BETWEEN '2001-01-01' AND '2018-12-31' ), CPT_ALL AS (SELECT * FROM CPT UNION SELECT PT_MRN, PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID, PCC_CODE AS "CPT OR PBD CODE", PCC_DESC AS "PROCEDURE DESC", DT_DTE AS "PROCEDURE DATE" FROM CPT JOIN DV.CPT_PBD_PATIENT_PROCEDURE ON PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PTX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID JOIN DV.DATE ON PTX_PROC_DATE_ID = DT_DATE_ID WHERE PCC_CODE IN ('70355') AND DT_DTE BETWEEN '2001-01-01' AND '2018-12-31' ) SELECT DISTINCT DX.PT_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, "CPT OR PBD CODE", "PROCEDURE DESC", "PROCEDURE DATE" FROM DX JOIN CPT_ALL ON CPT_ALL.PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = DX.PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID ;

prompt: Pain medications, sedatives, and anti-psychotics dispensed to M10 patients during the night shift from the year 2018 in the following services: GYN Med Onc, Breast medicine, GYN Surgery.
completion: WITH DRUG AS (SELECT DISTINCT OOC_MSTR_ITEM_GUID ITEM_GUID, OOC_ITEM_NAME ITEM_NAME , OOC_REV_CAT_DEPT REVIEW_CATEGORY, OTPX_TRS_POL_NAME TRANSMIT_POLICY , OOC_THERAPEUTIC_CAT THERAPEUTIC_CAT , OC.OCCT_VALUE HVC_CATEGORY, SRX.OCCT_VALUE SRX_CATEGORY , FR.OCCT_VALUE EMAR_FREQ , OCIT_PERF_POL_NAME EMAR_PERF_POL_NAME , OCIT_REV_CAT_CD EMAR_TASK_CAT, OTT_NAME EMAR_TASK_TYPE FROM IDB.OMS_ORD_CATALOG JOIN IDB.OMS_TRANS_POL_XREF ON OTPX_MST_ITEM_GUID = OOC_MSTR_ITEM_GUID LEFT JOIN IDB.OAS_CTLG_ITEM_TASK ON OOC_MSTR_ITEM_GUID = OCIT_MST_ITEM_GUID AND OCIT_LEVEL_NO = 0 LEFT JOIN IDB.OAS_TASK_TYPE ON OCIT_TASK_TYP_GUID = OTT_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_CTLG_CLASS_TYP OC ON OC.OCCT_MST_ITEM_GUID = OOC_MSTR_ITEM_GUID AND OC.OCCT_CLASS_TYPE_CD = 'HVC-OrderCategory' LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_CTLG_CLASS_TYP FR ON FR.OCCT_MST_ITEM_GUID = OOC_MSTR_ITEM_GUID AND FR.OCCT_CLASS_TYPE_CD = 'HVC-Frequency' JOIN IDB.OMS_CTLG_CLASS_TYP SRX ON SRX.OCCT_MST_ITEM_GUID = OOC_MSTR_ITEM_GUID AND SRX.OCCT_CLASS_TYPE_CD = 'SRx-OrderCategory' WHERE OOC_EXP_DT IS NULL AND OTPX_SESSION_TYPE = 'Standard' AND OTPX_TRS_POL_NAME LIKE 'Rx%' AND OOC_REV_CAT_DEPT IN ('Pharmacy') AND SRX.OCCT_VALUE ='01 PAIN, SEDATIVES & ANTI-PSYCHOTICS' ) , MEDS AS (SELECT SPD_ORD_ID, SPD_ORD_GUID, SPD_MRN, SPD_ACCT_NO, SPD_VISIT_GUID , SPD_ORD_NAME, SPD_ORD_DESC , SPD_TIME_PRIORITY, SPD_START_DT, SPD_DOSE_NO , SPD_DOSE_UOM, SPD_ROUTE_CD, SPD_DRUG_NAME, SPD_THERAPEUTIC_CLASS, THERAPEUTIC_CAT, HVC_CATEGORY, SRX_CATEGORY, SPD_EMAR_OCCR_GUID, SPD_TRANS_TYPE_DESC, TSK.OOTO_SIGNIFIC_DT, TSK.OOTO_SIGNIFIC_TME, TSK.OOTO_TASK_OCC_DESC, TSK.OOTO_STATUS_CD , OS_SVC_DESC , OCV_CURR_LOC, OOTO_PERF_FROM_DT PERF_FROM_DT, TSK.OOTO_GUID , SUBSTR(X.OU_DISPLAY_NAME, 1, 35) ENTERED_BY FROM IDB.SRX_PHARMACY_DETAIL JOIN DRUG ON SPD_MSTR_ITEM_GUID = ITEM_GUID JOIN IDB.OAS_ORD_TASK_OCCR TSK ON SPD_ORD_GUID = OOTO_ORD_GUID AND SPD_EMAR_OCCR_GUID = OOTO_GUID AND TSK.OOTO_STATUS_CD = 'Performed' JOIN IDB.OMS_CLIENT_VISIT ON SPD_VISIT_GUID = OCV_VISIT_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_SERVICE ON OCV_SVC_GUID = OS_SVC_GUID LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_USER X ON OOTO_ENT_PVDR_GUID = X.OU_USER_GUID WHERE SPD_START_DTE BETWEEN '2018-01-01' AND '2018-12-31' AND OS_SVC_DESC IN ('Breast - Surgery', 'Breast Medicine Service', 'Gynecologic Medical Oncology', 'Gynecology') ) , PERF_LOCATION AS (SELECT OVL_MRN, OVL_VISIT_GUID, OVL_VISIT_LOC_GUID, OOTO_GUID TASK_GUID , OVL_EFF_DT, OVL_CHNG_DT, OL_LOC_NAME "PerformedAtLocation" FROM MEDS JOIN IDB.OMS_VISIT_LOCATION A ON SPD_MRN = OVL_MRN AND SPD_VISIT_GUID = OVL_VISIT_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_LOCATION ON OVL_LOC_GUID = OL_LOC_GUID WHERE A.OVL_VISIT_LOC_GUID = (SELECT MAX(B.OVL_VISIT_LOC_GUID) FROM IDB.OMS_VISIT_LOCATION B WHERE A.OVL_VISIT_GUID = B.OVL_VISIT_GUID AND B.OVL_EFF_DT <= PERF_FROM_DT) ) SELECT SPD_ORD_ID ORDID, SPD_ORD_GUID ORD_GUID, SPD_MRN MRN, SPD_VISIT_GUID VISIT_GUID, SPD_ORD_NAME ORDNAME, SPD_ORD_DESC ORDDESC, SPD_DRUG_NAME DRUG_NAME, SPD_TIME_PRIORITY TIME_PRIORITY, SPD_DOSE_NO DOSE, SPD_DOSE_UOM DOSE_UOM, SPD_ROUTE_CD ROUTE, SPD_THERAPEUTIC_CLASS THERAPEUTIC_CLASS, THERAPEUTIC_CAT, HVC_CATEGORY, SRX_CATEGORY , OOTO_SIGNIFIC_DT, OOTO_SIGNIFIC_TME, OOTO_TASK_OCC_DESC, OOTO_STATUS_CD , OS_SVC_DESC HOSP_SERVICE , OCV_CURR_LOC CURRENT_LOCATION, PERF_FROM_DT PERF_DT, TIME(PERF_FROM_DT) PERFORMED_TIME, OOTO_GUID TASK_GUID , ENTERED_BY , OVL_EFF_DT, OVL_CHNG_DT, "PerformedAtLocation" FROM PERF_LOCATION JOIN MEDS ON SPD_MRN = OVL_MRN AND SPD_VISIT_GUID = OVL_VISIT_GUID AND OOTO_GUID = TASK_GUID WHERE "PerformedAtLocation" LIKE 'M%10%' AND (TIME(PERF_FROM_DT) BETWEEN '19:00:00' AND '23:59:59' OR TIME(PERF_FROM_DT) BETWEEN '00:00:00' AND '07:00:00')

prompt: Engage/Patient Satisfaction survey responses for Shared Notes
completion: WITH DEMO AS (SELECT PT_MRN AS "MRN" , PT_LAST_NAME AS "Last Name" , PT_FIRST_NAME AS "First Name" , PT_SEX AS "Gender" , PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH AS "Date of Birth" , PT_DATE_OF_DEATH AS "Date of Death" , R.AV_DESC AS "Race (Reg)" , E.AV_DESC AS "Ethnicity (Reg)" , CR.AV_DESC AS "Race (CDB)" , CE.AV_DESC AS "Ethnicity (CDB)" , PT_PRIMARY_LANG FROM IDB.PATIENT LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS R ON R.AV_ELEMENT = 'RACE' AND R.AV_CODE = PT_RACE LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS E ON E.AV_ELEMENT = 'PT_ETHNICITY' AND E.AV_CODE = PT_PT_ETHNICITY LEFT JOIN IDB.CDB_PATIENT ON PT_MRN = CP_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS CR ON CR.AV_ELEMENT = 'CDB_RACE' AND CR.AV_CODE = CP_CDB_RACE LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS CE ON CE.AV_ELEMENT = 'ETHNICITY' AND CE.AV_CODE = CP_ETHNICITY) SELECT EF_MRN, EF_PATIENT_ID, "Gender", "Date of Birth", YEAR(DATE(CURRENT date)-"Date of Birth") AS "Age", "Date of Death", "Race (Reg)", "Ethnicity (Reg)", PT_PRIMARY_LANG "Primary Language", EF_SUBMISSION_DT "Submit date", EF_FORM_ID "Form ID", EF_FORM_NAME "Form name", EFI_ITEM_TEXT "Item text", EFI_ITEM_ALIAS "Item name", EFI_VALUE "Value" FROM IDB.EF_FORM LEFT JOIN IDB.EF_FORM_ITEM ON EF_FORM_ID = EFI_FORM_ID LEFT JOIN DEMO ON EF_MRN = MRN WHERE EF_FORM_NAME = 'Shared Notes Survey' AND YEAR(EF_SUBMISSION_DT) = 2021 ; WITH DEMO AS (SELECT PT_MRN AS "MRN" , PT_LAST_NAME AS "Last Name" , PT_FIRST_NAME AS "First Name" , PT_SEX AS "Gender" , PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH AS "Date of Birth" , PT_DATE_OF_DEATH AS "Date of Death" , R.AV_DESC AS "Race (Reg)" , E.AV_DESC AS "Ethnicity (Reg)" , CR.AV_DESC AS "Race (CDB)" , CE.AV_DESC AS "Ethnicity (CDB)" , PT_PRIMARY_LANG FROM IDB.PATIENT LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS R ON R.AV_ELEMENT = 'RACE' AND R.AV_CODE = PT_RACE LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS E ON E.AV_ELEMENT = 'PT_ETHNICITY' AND E.AV_CODE = PT_PT_ETHNICITY LEFT JOIN IDB.CDB_PATIENT ON PT_MRN = CP_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS CR ON CR.AV_ELEMENT = 'CDB_RACE' AND CR.AV_CODE = CP_CDB_RACE LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS CE ON CE.AV_ELEMENT = 'ETHNICITY' AND CE.AV_CODE = CP_ETHNICITY) SELECT DISTINCT EF_MRN, EF_PATIENT_ID, "Gender", "Date of Birth", YEAR(DATE(CURRENT date)-"Date of Birth") AS "Age", "Date of Death", "Race (Reg)", "Ethnicity (Reg)", PT_PRIMARY_LANG "Primary Language" FROM IDB.EF_FORM LEFT JOIN IDB.EF_FORM_ITEM ON EF_FORM_ID = EFI_FORM_ID LEFT JOIN DEMO ON EF_MRN = MRN WHERE EF_FORM_NAME = 'Shared Notes Survey' AND YEAR(EF_SUBMISSION_DT) = 2021 ;

prompt:
Provide a list of all patients who had IMPACT who are positive for the following mutations:



IDH1, IDH2, SDHA, SDHAF2, SDHB, SDHC, SDHD, FH, TET1, TET2
completion: WITH HIST AS (SELECT DISTINCT TM_MRN, TM_HIST_CD, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS HIST_DESC FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD AND TM_CASE_STS IN ('3', '6', '7', '8') AND TM_HIST_CD IN ('M9440/3', 'M9441/3', 'M9442/3')) , EGFR AS (SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN "mrn", LISTAGG(METHOD, ', ') "Method" FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_STRUCTURED_RESULTS_V WHERE RESULT = 'POSITIVE' AND GENE = 'EGFR' AND (UPPER(SEARCH_HIT2) like '%VIII%' OR SEARCH_HIT2 = 'EGFR Exons 2-7 deletion (NM_005228)' OR UPPER(SEARCH_HIT1) like '%VIII%' OR LOCUS = 'vIII_transcript') AND PT_MRN IN (SELECT TM_MRN FROM HIST) GROUP BY PT_MRN) SELECT "mrn", PT_BIRTH_DTE, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, "Method" FROM EGFR JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V ON "mrn" = PT_MRN FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID WHERE CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT date + 3 DAYS AND CURRENT date + 10 DAYS AND CRE_RES_ID IN ('023903', '019091', '019042', '001826', '018010', '012484', '016345', '015057', '021378', '023911', '014118', '020230', '022863', '023721' '014118', '022665', '011510', '8651', '016337', '021766', '58265', '020248', '71005', '92193', '020214')

prompt: I would like to pull the data for all the screening order for clinical trials entered on CIS for all the patients in Prostate Service from January to June of this year. Could you help assist me getting this metric data?
completion: SELECT DISTINCT OO_MRN AS MRN, OO_ENTER_DTE AS "Order Enter Date", OO_ORD_NAME AS "Order Name", OFF_FLD_LABEL, OUD_USER_DI_VALUE FROM IDB.OMS_ORDER LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_FORM_FIELD ON OFF_ENTRY_FRM_GUID = OO_ENTRY_FRM_GUID LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_USER_DATA ON OO_ORD_GUID = OUD_ORD_GUID AND OFF_DI_CD = OUD_USER_DI_CD WHERE OO_ENTER_DTE BETWEEN '2023-01-01' AND '2023-06-30' AND OO_ORD_NAME = 'STGU Prostate Screening' AND OFF_FLD_LABEL = 'Potential trials (up to 3):' ORDER BY OO_MRN

prompt: Accruing to 20-497. Provide a direct-to-primary oncologist notification for MSS Stable BOWEL, CCRCC, and MEL patients.
completion: WITH DMP_DX_PRE AS (SELECT DISTINCT PDRX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID AS P_ID, RPT.DT_DTE AS REPORT_DATE , PT_MRN AS DMP_MRN , DT.PDRX_PATH_RPT_ID AS R_ID, PRPT_ACCESSION_NO , PDRX_DMP_PATIENT_ID, PDRX_DMP_SAMPLE_ID , DV.TODATE(DT_PROCEDURE) AS "Procedure Date" , DT_PROCEDURE , PRIMARY_SITE , TUMOR_TYPE_CODE , TUMOR_TYPE_NAME , METASTASIS_SITE , PDWS_NAME, PDWS_DESCRIPTION , GENE_PANEL , PART_DESCRIPTION FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML DT CROSS JOIN XMLTABLE('$c/root/*' PASSING DT.PDRX_XML_VALUE AS "c" COLUMNS PRIMARY_SITE VARCHAR(100) PATH 'fn:string-join(../meta-data/primary_site,",")' , DT_PROCEDURE VARCHAR(100) PATH 'fn:string-join(../meta-data/dt_procedure,",")' , TUMOR_TYPE_NAME VARCHAR(100) PATH 'fn:string-join(../meta-data/tumor_type_name,",")' , TUMOR_TYPE_CODE VARCHAR(100) PATH 'fn:string-join(../meta-data/tumor_type_code,",")' , METASTASIS_SITE VARCHAR(100) PATH 'fn:string-join(../meta-data/metastasis_site,",")' , MSI_TYPE VARCHAR(100) PATH 'fn:string-join(../meta-data/msi-type,",")' , GENE_PANEL VARCHAR(100) PATH 'fn:string-join(../meta-data/gene_panel,",")' , PART_DESCRIPTION VARCHAR(264) PATH 'fn:string-join(../meta-data/part_description,",")') T JOIN (SELECT T.TUMOR_TYPE_CODE AS TTC FROM TABLE(DV.STRING_SPLIT('CCRCC,SKCM,COADREAD', ',')) S CROSS JOIN TABLE(DV.ONCOTREE_CHILDREN(COLUMN_VALUES)) T) X ON T.TUMOR_TYPE_CODE = X.TTC JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON PDRX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID INNER JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML_SETTINGS ON PDRX_PATH_DMP_RESULTS_XML_ID = PDRXS_PATH_DMP_RESULTS_XML_ID INNER JOIN DVDMC.PATHOLOGY_DMP_WEBSVC_SETTINGS ON PDRXS_SETTING_ID = PDWS_SETTING_ID LEFT JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V PRV ON PRV.PRPT_PATH_RPT_ID = PDRX_PATH_RPT_ID LEFT JOIN DV.DATE_V RPT ON RPT.DT_DATE_ID = PRPT_REPORT_DATE_ID WHERE 1=1 AND PT_VITAL_STATUS = 'ALIVE' AND MSI_TYPE ='Stable' ) SELECT * FROM DMP_DX_PRE ;

prompt: Lymphoma patients who had COVID Spike antibody test
completion: WITH DX AS (SELECT CC_MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS DX_DTE FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE SUBSTR(CC_CLSF_CD, 1, 3) IN ('C81', 'C82', 'C83', 'C84', 'C85', 'C86', 'C88') AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND (CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) GROUP BY CC_MRN ) , VAX AS (SELECT CP_MRN, DOSE_1_EMAR_MFG_NAME AS BRAND, DATE(DOSE_1_EMAR_ADMIN_DT) AS DOSE1, DATE(DOSE_2_EMAR_ADMIN_DT) AS DOSE2 FROM IDB.COVID19_PATIENT_CP_VACCINE_INFO JOIN DX ON CC_MRN = CP_MRN WHERE DOSE_1_EMAR_ADMIN_DT IS NOT NULL OR DOSE_2_EMAR_ADMIN_DT IS NOT NULL ) SELECT OO_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, DX_DTE, OOC_ITEM_NAME, OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE, OSTS_STS_DESC, A.AC_CONS_DTE "06-107 Consent", B.AC_CONS_DTE "09-141 Consent", BRAND, DOSE1, DOSE2 FROM IDB.OMS_ORDER JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_CATALOG ON OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID = OOC_MSTR_ITEM_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_STATUS ON OO_ORD_STS_CD = OSTS_ORD_STS_CD JOIN DX ON OO_MRN = CC_MRN JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON OO_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.ACCRUALS A ON OO_MRN = A.AC_MRN AND A.AC_IRB_NO = '06-107' AND A.AC_CONS_DTE IS NOT NULL LEFT JOIN IDB.ACCRUALS B ON OO_MRN = B.AC_MRN AND B.AC_IRB_NO = '09-141' AND B.AC_CONS_DTE IS NOT NULL LEFT JOIN VAX ON OO_MRN = CP_MRN WHERE OO_ORD_STS_CD NOT IN ('CANP', 'CANC', 'AUC3') AND OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID IN ('9000015430100730', '9000015552100730') ORDER BY OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE DESC ; WITH DX AS (SELECT CC_MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS DX_DTE FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE SUBSTR(CC_CLSF_CD, 1, 3) IN ('C90') AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND (CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) GROUP BY CC_MRN ) , VAX AS (SELECT CP_MRN, DOSE_1_EMAR_MFG_NAME AS BRAND, DATE(DOSE_1_EMAR_ADMIN_DT) AS DOSE1, DATE(DOSE_2_EMAR_ADMIN_DT) AS DOSE2 FROM IDB.COVID19_PATIENT_CP_VACCINE_INFO JOIN DX ON CC_MRN = CP_MRN WHERE DOSE_1_EMAR_ADMIN_DT IS NOT NULL OR DOSE_2_EMAR_ADMIN_DT IS NOT NULL ) SELECT OO_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, DX_DTE, OOC_ITEM_NAME, OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE, OSTS_STS_DESC, A.AC_CONS_DTE "06-107 Consent", B.AC_CONS_DTE "09-141 Consent", BRAND, DOSE1, DOSE2 FROM IDB.OMS_ORDER JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_CATALOG ON OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID = OOC_MSTR_ITEM_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_STATUS ON OO_ORD_STS_CD = OSTS_ORD_STS_CD JOIN DX ON OO_MRN = CC_MRN JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON OO_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.ACCRUALS A ON OO_MRN = A.AC_MRN AND A.AC_IRB_NO = '06-107' AND A.AC_CONS_DTE IS NOT NULL LEFT JOIN IDB.ACCRUALS B ON OO_MRN = B.AC_MRN AND B.AC_IRB_NO = '09-141' AND B.AC_CONS_DTE IS NOT NULL LEFT JOIN VAX ON OO_MRN = CP_MRN WHERE OO_ORD_STS_CD NOT IN ('CANP', 'CANC', 'AUC3') AND OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID IN ('9000015430100730', '9000015552100730') ORDER BY OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE DESC ; WITH DX AS (SELECT CC_MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS DX_DTE FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE SUBSTR(CC_CLSF_CD, 1, 3) IN ('C91', 'C92', 'C93', 'C94', 'C95', 'C96') AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND (CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) GROUP BY CC_MRN ) , VAX AS (SELECT CP_MRN, DOSE_1_EMAR_MFG_NAME AS BRAND, DATE(DOSE_1_EMAR_ADMIN_DT) AS DOSE1, DATE(DOSE_2_EMAR_ADMIN_DT) AS DOSE2 FROM IDB.COVID19_PATIENT_CP_VACCINE_INFO JOIN DX ON CC_MRN = CP_MRN WHERE DOSE_1_EMAR_ADMIN_DT IS NOT NULL OR DOSE_2_EMAR_ADMIN_DT IS NOT NULL ) SELECT OO_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, DX_DTE, OOC_ITEM_NAME, OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE, OSTS_STS_DESC, A.AC_CONS_DTE "06-107 Consent", B.AC_CONS_DTE "09-141 Consent", BRAND, DOSE1, DOSE2 FROM IDB.OMS_ORDER JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_CATALOG ON OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID = OOC_MSTR_ITEM_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_STATUS ON OO_ORD_STS_CD = OSTS_ORD_STS_CD JOIN DX ON OO_MRN = CC_MRN JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON OO_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.ACCRUALS A ON OO_MRN = A.AC_MRN AND A.AC_IRB_NO = '06-107' AND A.AC_CONS_DTE IS NOT NULL LEFT JOIN IDB.ACCRUALS B ON OO_MRN = B.AC_MRN AND B.AC_IRB_NO = '09-141' AND B.AC_CONS_DTE IS NOT NULL LEFT JOIN VAX ON OO_MRN = CP_MRN WHERE OO_ORD_STS_CD NOT IN ('CANP', 'CANC', 'AUC3') AND OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID IN ('9000015430100730', '9000015552100730') ORDER BY OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE DESC

prompt: Provide a list of patients in the Sarcoma service that have been diagnosed with a retinoblastoma
completion: WITH SARCOMA AS (SELECT CPE_MRN FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CRE_RES_NAME IN ('TAP, WILLIAM', 'DICKSON, MARK A', 'D''ANGELO, SANDRA P', 'CHI, PING', 'KELLY, CIARA MARIE', 'KEOHAN, MARY LOUISE', 'GOUNDER, MRINAL M', 'MOVVA, SUJANA', 'NACEV, BENJAMIN ALEXANDER', 'SINGER, SAMUEL', 'YOON, SAM SUNGHYUN') ) SELECT DISTINCT TM_MRN "MRN", PT_LAST_NAME "Last Name", PT_FIRST_NAME "First Name", PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH "Date of Birth", TM_DX_DTE "Tumor Dx Date", TM_HIST_CD "Histology Code", H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK "Histology Description", TM_SITE_CD "Site Code", S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK "Site Description" FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD JOIN SARCOMA ON TM_MRN = CPE_MRN JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON TM_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND TM_SITE_CD LIKE 'C692%' AND TM_DX_DTE BETWEEN '1960-04-01' AND '2020-05-14'

prompt: Provide labs on demand for PED and MED BMT groups
completion: SELECT STRIP(PT_MRN) AS "MRN", STRIP(PT_LAST_NAME) AS "Last Name", STRIP(PT_FIRST_NAME) AS "First Name", DATE(PLR_PERFORMED_DT) AS "Lab Performed Date", STRIP(TEST.LTC_SUBTEST_NAME) AS "Lab Test Name", STRIP(SUBTEST.LTC_SUBTEST_NAME) AS "Lab Subtest Name", STRIP(PLR_RESULT_VALUE) AS "Lab Result Value", STRIP(PLR_UNIT_MEASURE) AS "Lab Unit Measure", STRIP(PLR_ABNORMALITY_CD) AS "Abnormality Code", STRIP(SUBSTR(PLR_TEXT_RESULT, 1, 1000)) AS "Lab Result Notes" FROM DV.PATIENT_LAB_RESULT JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PLR_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID JOIN DV.LAB_TEST_CATALOG AS TEST ON PLR_LAB_TEST_CATALOG_ID = TEST.LTC_LAB_TEST_CATALOG_ID JOIN DV.LAB_TEST_CATALOG AS SUBTEST ON PLR_LAB_SUBTEST_CATALOG_ID = SUBTEST.LTC_LAB_TEST_CATALOG_ID WHERE 1=1 AND DATE(PLR_PERFORMED_DT) >= '2022-09-20' ORDER BY PT_MRN, DATE(PLR_PERFORMED_DT), STRIP(TEST.LTC_SUBTEST_NAME), STRIP(SUBTEST.LTC_SUBTEST_NAME)

prompt: Daily list of  patients coming to Rad Onc for MR for the next 7 days who have been assigned the Assessment - Screening Questionnaire for MRI- MAIN and KOCH departments.
completion: WITH APPTS AS (SELECT DISTINCT ENC.CPE_ENC_CSN_ID , ENC.CPE_PRK , ENC.CPE_MRN , PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_LAST_NAME , ENC.CPE_ENC_DTE , CLD_CLD_CENTER , DEPT.CLD_DEPT_NAME FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER AS ENC JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE AS RESOURCE ON ENC.CPE_REF_RES_ID = RESOURCE.CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT AS DEPT ON ENC.CPE_DEPT_ID = DEPT.CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE AS VISIT_TYP ON ENC.CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = VISIT_TYP.CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON CPE_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY ON PLA_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE CPE_MRN > '' AND PLA_DECEASED_IND <> 'Y' AND UCASE(CPE_CPE_APPT_STS) IN('SCH', 'ARRIVED', 'COMP') AND ENC.CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT_DATE AND CURRENT_DATE + 7 DAY AND ((CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 = 'RAD' AND ENC.CPE_VST_RES_ID IN (SELECT CRE_RES_ID FROM IDB.CL_RESOURCE WHERE CRE_RES_NAME LIKE '%MRI 1275%' OR CRE_RES_NAME LIKE '%MRI 53%' OR CRE_RES_NAME LIKE '%MRI 300 E66%' OR CRE_RES_NAME LIKE '%MRI KOCH%' OR CRE_RES_NAME LIKE '%MRI BSK%' OR CRE_RES_NAME LIKE '%MRI CMK%' OR CRE_RES_NAME LIKE 'MRI BER%' OR CRE_RES_NAME LIKE '%MRI MON%' OR CRE_RES_NAME LIKE '%MRI NAS%' OR CRE_RES_NAME LIKE 'MR WES%' )) OR CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID IN (9691, 9692, 9765, 9766, 13187, 13188, 13272) OR (CPE_DEPT_ID = 1558 AND ENC.CPE_VST_RES_ID = 202262 AND CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID IN (11459, 6653, 11463, 6650, 6660, 13195, 3772, 3776)) ) ) , FORM AS (SELECT EPI_MRN , EA_STS_ID , EAS_ASSESS_STS, EA_SUBM_DT, EA_SOURCE_ID , EA_ASSIGN_DT FROM IDB.EF_ASSESSMENT JOIN IDB.EF_PATIENT_INFO ON EA_PT_INFO_ID = EPI_PT_INFO_ID JOIN APPTS ON CHAR(EA_SOURCE_ID) = CHAR(CPE_ENC_CSN_ID) JOIN IDB.EF_SURVEY ON EA_SURV_ID = ES_SURV_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.EF_ASSESSMENT_STS ON EA_STS_ID = EAS_ASSESS_STS_ID WHERE ES_SURV_ALIAS = 'screeningmri' AND EA_STS_ID IN(1, 2) ) SELECT CPE_MRN AS MRN, TRIM(PT_LAST_NAME) || ', ' || TRIM(PT_FIRST_NAME) AS PATIENT_NAME, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH AS DATE_OF_BIRTH, CLD_DEPT_NAME AS DEPARTMENT, CPE_ENC_DTE AS APPOINTMENT_DATE, COALESCE (EAS_ASSESS_STS, 'Not-Assigned') AS SURVEY_STATUS, EA_ASSIGN_DT AS ASSIGNED_DATE FROM APPTS LEFT JOIN FORM ON EPI_MRN = CPE_MRN WHERE CLD_DEPT_NAME LIKE '%KOCH%'

prompt: Create a dataset of breast cancer patients with the following criteria: women, postmenopausal (can use 50 at the time of surgery as a surrogate), cT1-2N0 (Breast DMT or other database), final breast surgery lumpectomy (aka exclude patients who had mastectomy either before or after lumpectomy), receptors either ER or PR positive and HER2 negative, underwent SLNB with or without an ALND, and women treated at MSK since 2010.
completion: WITH PROCEDURES AS (SELECT SSE_MRN, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, PT_SEX, YEAR(SSE_SURG_DTE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) AGE_AT_PROC, SSE_SURG_DTE, SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD, SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC, SSP_SURG_LAST_NM, SSP_SURG_FIRST_NM, SSP_SURG_SVC_CD, TM_DTE, CASE WHEN DAYS(TM_DTE) - DAYS(SSE_SURG_DTE) < 365 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS TM_FLAG FROM IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE ON SSE_LOG_ID = SSP_LOG_ID AND SSE_ENC_CSN_ID = SSP_ENC_CSN_ID JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON SSE_MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN (SELECT SSE_MRN TM_MRN, SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD TM_PROC, SSE_SURG_DTE TM_DTE FROM IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE ON SSE_LOG_ID = SSP_LOG_ID AND SSE_ENC_CSN_ID = SSP_ENC_CSN_ID WHERE SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD IN ('19303', '19304', '19307') ) ON SSE_MRN = TM_MRN WHERE SSE_SURG_DTE >= '2010-01-01' AND PT_SEX = 'F' AND YEAR(SSE_SURG_DTE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) >= 50 AND SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD IN ('19301', '19302') ) , DX AS (SELECT TM_MRN, AV_DESC AS CASE_STS, TM_DX_DTE, TM_HIST_CD, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS HIST_DESC, TM_SITE_CD, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_DESC, TM_CLIN_TNM_T, TM_CLIN_TNM_N, TM_CLIN_TNM_M FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS ON AV_ELEMENT = 'CASE_STS' AND AV_CODE = TM_CASE_STS WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND TM_CLIN_TNM_T IN ('T1', 'T1A', 'T1B', 'T1C', 'T1M', 'T1MI', 'T2', 'T2A', 'T2B') AND TM_CLIN_TNM_N = 'N0' AND LEFT(TM_SITE_CD, 3) = 'C50' ) , SLNB AS (SELECT SSE_MRN SLNB_MRN, MAX(SSE_SURG_DTE) SLNB_MAX_DTE FROM IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE ON SSE_LOG_ID = SSP_LOG_ID AND SSE_ENC_CSN_ID = SSP_ENC_CSN_ID AND SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD IN ('38500', '38525', '38900') GROUP BY SSE_MRN) , ALND AS (SELECT SSE_MRN ALND_MRN, MAX(SSE_SURG_DTE) ALND_MAX_DTE FROM IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE ON SSE_LOG_ID = SSP_LOG_ID AND SSE_ENC_CSN_ID = SSP_ENC_CSN_ID AND SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD IN ('38740', '38745') GROUP BY SSE_MRN) , HER2 AS (SELECT TM_MRN AS HER2_MRN, CASE WHEN TM_SSF1 = '000' THEN 'Test not done (test not ordered and not performed)' WHEN TM_SSF1 = '010' THEN 'Positive/elevated' WHEN TM_SSF1 = '020' THEN 'Negative/normal; within normal limits' WHEN TM_SSF1 = '030' THEN 'Borderline; undetermined whether positive or negative' WHEN TM_SSF1 = '080' THEN 'Ordered, but results not in chart' WHEN TM_SSF1 = '988' THEN 'Not applicable: Information not collected for this case' WHEN TM_SSF1 = '996' THEN 'Test ordered, results not interpretable' WHEN TM_SSF1 = '997' THEN 'Test ordered, results not in chart' WHEN TM_SSF1 = '998' THEN 'Test not done (test not ordered and not performed)' WHEN TM_SSF1 = '999' THEN 'Unknown or no information; not documented in patient record' ELSE '' END AS ER, CASE WHEN TM_SSF2 = '000' THEN 'Test not done (test not ordered and not performed)' WHEN TM_SSF2 = '010' THEN 'Positive/elevated' WHEN TM_SSF2 = '020' THEN 'Negative/normal; within normal limits' WHEN TM_SSF2 = '030' THEN 'Borderline; undetermined whether positive or negative' WHEN TM_SSF2 = '080' THEN 'Ordered, but results not in chart' WHEN TM_SSF2 = '988' THEN 'Not applicable: Information not collected for this case' WHEN TM_SSF2 = '996' THEN 'Test ordered, results not interpretable' WHEN TM_SSF2 = '997' THEN 'Test ordered, results not in chart' WHEN TM_SSF2 = '998' THEN 'Test not done (test not ordered and not performed)' WHEN TM_SSF2 = '999' THEN 'Unknown or no information; not documented in patient record' ELSE '' END AS PR, CASE WHEN TM_SSF15 = '010' THEN 'Positive/elevated; amplified' WHEN TM_SSF15 = '020' THEN 'Negative/normal; within normal limits; not amplified' WHEN TM_SSF15 = '030' THEN 'Borderline; equivocal; indeterminate; undetermined whether positive or negative' WHEN TM_SSF15 = '988' THEN 'Not applicable: Information not collected for this case' WHEN TM_SSF15 = '997' THEN 'Test ordered, results not in chart' WHEN TM_SSF15 = '998' THEN 'Test not done (test not ordered and not performed)' WHEN TM_SSF15 = '999' THEN 'Unknown or no information; not documented in patient record' ELSE '' END AS HER2_SUMMARY, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY TM_MRN ORDER BY TM_DX_DTE DESC) RN FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('3', '6', '7') AND TM_SITE_CD IN ('C500' ,'C501' ,'C502' ,'C503' ,'C504' ,'C505' ,'C506' ,'C508' ,'C509') ) SELECT DISTINCT SSE_MRN MRN, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH DOB, PT_SEX SEX, SSE_SURG_DTE SURGERY_DTE, AGE_AT_PROC AGE_AT_SURGERY, SSP_SURG_LAST_NM SURGEON_LAST_NAME, SSP_SURG_FIRST_NM SURGEON_FIRST_NAME, SSP_SURG_SVC_CD SURGEON_SVC, SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD PROCEDURE_CODE, SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC PROCEDURE_DESC, TM_DX_DTE DX_DATE, TM_CLIN_TNM_T CLIN_T, TM_CLIN_TNM_N CLIN_N, TM_CLIN_TNM_M CLIN_M, TM_SITE_CD SITE_CODE, SITE_DESC SITE_DESC, TM_HIST_CD HIST_CODE, HIST_DESC, TM_DTE, SLNB_MAX_DTE, ALND_MAX_DTE, ER, PR, HER2_SUMMARY FROM PROCEDURES JOIN DX ON TM_MRN = SSE_MRN JOIN SLNB ON SSE_MRN = SLNB_MRN LEFT JOIN HER2 ON HER2_MRN = SSE_MRN AND RN = 1 LEFT JOIN ALND ON SSE_MRN = ALND_MRN WHERE TM_FLAG <> 1 ;

prompt: Need a list of rectal cancer patients with specific MRI report text
completion: WITH RADIOLOGY_0 AS (SELECT "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AS PT_DEID, "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_MRN" AS PT_MRN, CAST(TRIM("DV"."RADIOLOGY_REPORT_V"."RRPT_RPT_ID") AS VARCHAR) || CAST(TRIM("DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_MRN") AS VARCHAR) AS SUBJECT_ID, "DV"."RADIOLOGY_REPORT_V"."RRPT_ORDER_GROUP" AS RRPT_ORDER_GROUP, CAST("DV"."RADIOLOGY_REPORT_V"."RRPT_REPORT_TXT" AS VARCHAR(32500)) AS RRPT_REPORT_TXT FROM "DV"."RADIOLOGY_REPORT_V" JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS" ON "DV"."RADIOLOGY_REPORT_V"."RRPT_MRN" = "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_MRN" WHERE "DV"."RADIOLOGY_REPORT_V"."RRPT_ORDER_GROUP" IN ('MR', 'Submitted Films') AND SYSIBM.REGEXP_LIKE("DV"."RADIOLOGY_REPORT_V"."RRPT_REPORT_TXT", 'Post[\s\S]{1,3}ESD', 'i')), DIAGNOSIS_1 AS (SELECT "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AS PT_DEID, BASE_QUERY.PT_MRN AS PT_MRN, CAST(TRIM(BASE_QUERY.PT_MRN) AS VARCHAR) || CAST(TRIM(BASE_QUERY.DIAGNOSIS_DATE) AS VARCHAR) || CAST(TRIM(BASE_QUERY.ICD_CODES_ICD_CODE) AS VARCHAR) AS SUBJECT_ID, BASE_QUERY.DIAGNOSIS_DATE AS DIAGNOSIS_DATE, TRIM(BASE_QUERY.ICD_CODES_ICD_CODE) || '-' || TRIM("IDB"."CLM"."CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK") AS ICD_CODES_ICD_CODE_DESC FROM (SELECT "IDB"."CTC_CLSF"."CC_MRN" AS PT_MRN, "IDB"."CTC_CLSF"."CC_CLSF_CD" AS ICD_CODES_ICD_CODE, MIN("IDB"."CTC_CLSF"."CC_EFF_DTE") AS DIAGNOSIS_DATE FROM "IDB"."CTC_CLSF" WHERE "IDB"."CTC_CLSF"."CC_CLSF_TYPE" LIKE 'DF%' AND ("IDB"."CTC_CLSF"."CC_PT_TYPE" = 'I' OR ("IDB"."CTC_CLSF"."CC_PT_TYPE" = 'O' AND "IDB"."CTC_CLSF"."CC_FINALIZED_IND" = 'Y')) GROUP BY "IDB"."CTC_CLSF"."CC_MRN", "IDB"."CTC_CLSF"."CC_CLSF_CD") AS BASE_QUERY JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS" ON BASE_QUERY.PT_MRN = "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_MRN" JOIN "IDB"."CLM" ON BASE_QUERY.ICD_CODES_ICD_CODE = "IDB"."CLM"."CLM_CLSF_CD" WHERE BASE_QUERY.DIAGNOSIS_DATE BETWEEN '1990-01-01' AND '2023-05-01' AND BASE_QUERY.ICD_CODES_ICD_CODE IN ('154.1', '154.8', 'C20')), COHORT AS (SELECT PT_DEID AS PT_DEID FROM (SELECT RADIOLOGY_0.PT_DEID AS PT_DEID FROM RADIOLOGY_0 INTERSECT SELECT DIAGNOSIS_1.PT_DEID AS PT_DEID FROM DIAGNOSIS_1)), COHORT_RADIOLOGY AS (SELECT SUBJECT_ID AS SUBJECT_ID, PT_DEID AS PT_DEID FROM (SELECT RADIOLOGY_0.SUBJECT_ID AS SUBJECT_ID, RADIOLOGY_0.PT_DEID AS PT_DEID FROM RADIOLOGY_0)), COHORT_DIAGNOSIS AS (SELECT SUBJECT_ID AS SUBJECT_ID, PT_DEID AS PT_DEID FROM (SELECT DIAGNOSIS_1.SUBJECT_ID AS SUBJECT_ID, DIAGNOSIS_1.PT_DEID AS PT_DEID FROM DIAGNOSIS_1)), KEYS AS (SELECT COHORT.PT_DEID AS COHORT_PT_DEID, COHORT_RADIOLOGY.SUBJECT_ID AS COHORT_RADIOLOGY_SUBJECT_ID, COHORT_RADIOLOGY.PT_DEID AS COHORT_RADIOLOGY_PT_DEID, COHORT_DIAGNOSIS.SUBJECT_ID AS COHORT_DIAGNOSIS_SUBJECT_ID, COHORT_DIAGNOSIS.PT_DEID AS COHORT_DIAGNOSIS_PT_DEID FROM COHORT LEFT OUTER JOIN COHORT_RADIOLOGY ON COHORT_RADIOLOGY.PT_DEID = COHORT.PT_DEID LEFT OUTER JOIN COHORT_DIAGNOSIS ON COHORT_DIAGNOSIS.PT_DEID = COHORT.PT_DEID), DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS AS (SELECT DISTINCT "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AS PT_DEID, IDB_PATIENT."PT_MRN" AS PT_MRN, "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AS SUBJECT_ID, TRIM(IDB_PATIENT."PT_LAST_NAME") || ', ' || TRIM(IDB_PATIENT."PT_FIRST_NAME") AS PT_NAME FROM "IDB"."PATIENT" AS IDB_PATIENT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS" ON IDB_PATIENT."PT_MRN" = "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_MRN") SELECT DISTINCT DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS.PT_MRN AS MRN, DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS.PT_NAME AS PT_NAME FROM KEYS LEFT OUTER JOIN DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS ON DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS.PT_DEID = KEYS.COHORT_PT_DEID; WITH RADIOLOGY_0 AS (SELECT "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AS PT_DEID, "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_MRN" AS PT_MRN, CAST(TRIM("DV"."RADIOLOGY_REPORT_V"."RRPT_RPT_ID") AS VARCHAR) || CAST(TRIM("DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_MRN") AS VARCHAR) AS SUBJECT_ID, "DV"."RADIOLOGY_REPORT_V"."RRPT_ORDER_GROUP" AS RRPT_ORDER_GROUP, CAST("DV"."RADIOLOGY_REPORT_V"."RRPT_REPORT_TXT" AS VARCHAR(32500)) AS RRPT_REPORT_TXT FROM "DV"."RADIOLOGY_REPORT_V" JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS" ON "DV"."RADIOLOGY_REPORT_V"."RRPT_MRN" = "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_MRN" WHERE "DV"."RADIOLOGY_REPORT_V"."RRPT_ORDER_GROUP" IN ('MR', 'Submitted Films') AND SYSIBM.REGEXP_LIKE("DV"."RADIOLOGY_REPORT_V"."RRPT_REPORT_TXT", 'Post[\s\S]{1,3}ESD', 'i')), DIAGNOSIS_1 AS (SELECT "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AS PT_DEID, BASE_QUERY.PT_MRN AS PT_MRN, CAST(TRIM(BASE_QUERY.PT_MRN) AS VARCHAR) || CAST(TRIM(BASE_QUERY.DIAGNOSIS_DATE) AS VARCHAR) || CAST(TRIM(BASE_QUERY.ICD_CODES_ICD_CODE) AS VARCHAR) AS SUBJECT_ID, BASE_QUERY.DIAGNOSIS_DATE AS DIAGNOSIS_DATE, TRIM(BASE_QUERY.ICD_CODES_ICD_CODE) || '-' || TRIM("IDB"."CLM"."CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK") AS ICD_CODES_ICD_CODE_DESC FROM (SELECT "IDB"."CTC_CLSF"."CC_MRN" AS PT_MRN, "IDB"."CTC_CLSF"."CC_CLSF_CD" AS ICD_CODES_ICD_CODE, MIN("IDB"."CTC_CLSF"."CC_EFF_DTE") AS DIAGNOSIS_DATE FROM "IDB"."CTC_CLSF" WHERE "IDB"."CTC_CLSF"."CC_CLSF_TYPE" LIKE 'DF%' AND ("IDB"."CTC_CLSF"."CC_PT_TYPE" = 'I' OR ("IDB"."CTC_CLSF"."CC_PT_TYPE" = 'O' AND "IDB"."CTC_CLSF"."CC_FINALIZED_IND" = 'Y')) GROUP BY "IDB"."CTC_CLSF"."CC_MRN", "IDB"."CTC_CLSF"."CC_CLSF_CD") AS BASE_QUERY JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS" ON BASE_QUERY.PT_MRN = "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_MRN" JOIN "IDB"."CLM" ON BASE_QUERY.ICD_CODES_ICD_CODE = "IDB"."CLM"."CLM_CLSF_CD" WHERE BASE_QUERY.DIAGNOSIS_DATE BETWEEN '1990-01-01' AND '2023-05-01' AND BASE_QUERY.ICD_CODES_ICD_CODE IN ('154.1', '154.8', 'C20')), COHORT AS (SELECT PT_DEID AS PT_DEID FROM (SELECT RADIOLOGY_0.PT_DEID AS PT_DEID FROM RADIOLOGY_0 INTERSECT SELECT DIAGNOSIS_1.PT_DEID AS PT_DEID FROM DIAGNOSIS_1)), COHORT_RADIOLOGY AS (SELECT SUBJECT_ID AS SUBJECT_ID, PT_DEID AS PT_DEID FROM (SELECT RADIOLOGY_0.SUBJECT_ID AS SUBJECT_ID, RADIOLOGY_0.PT_DEID AS PT_DEID FROM RADIOLOGY_0)), COHORT_DIAGNOSIS AS (SELECT SUBJECT_ID AS SUBJECT_ID, PT_DEID AS PT_DEID FROM (SELECT DIAGNOSIS_1.SUBJECT_ID AS SUBJECT_ID, DIAGNOSIS_1.PT_DEID AS PT_DEID FROM DIAGNOSIS_1)), KEYS AS (SELECT COHORT.PT_DEID AS COHORT_PT_DEID, COHORT_RADIOLOGY.SUBJECT_ID AS COHORT_RADIOLOGY_SUBJECT_ID, COHORT_RADIOLOGY.PT_DEID AS COHORT_RADIOLOGY_PT_DEID, COHORT_DIAGNOSIS.SUBJECT_ID AS COHORT_DIAGNOSIS_SUBJECT_ID, COHORT_DIAGNOSIS.PT_DEID AS COHORT_DIAGNOSIS_PT_DEID FROM COHORT LEFT OUTER JOIN COHORT_RADIOLOGY ON COHORT_RADIOLOGY.PT_DEID = COHORT.PT_DEID LEFT OUTER JOIN COHORT_DIAGNOSIS ON COHORT_DIAGNOSIS.PT_DEID = COHORT.PT_DEID), RADIOLOGY_COLUMNS AS (SELECT DISTINCT "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AS PT_DEID, "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_MRN" AS PT_MRN, CAST(TRIM("DV"."RADIOLOGY_REPORT_V"."RRPT_RPT_ID") AS VARCHAR) || CAST(TRIM("DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_MRN") AS VARCHAR) AS SUBJECT_ID, "DV"."RADIOLOGY_REPORT_V"."RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE" AS RRPT_PERFORMED_DATE, "DV"."RADIOLOGY_REPORT_V"."RRPT_ORDER_GROUP" AS RRPT_ORDER_GROUP, "DV"."RADIOLOGY_REPORT_V"."RRPT_PROCEDURE_NAME" AS RRPT_PROC_NAME, CAST("DV"."RADIOLOGY_REPORT_V"."RRPT_REPORT_TXT" AS VARCHAR(32500)) AS RRPT_REPORT_TXT, "DV"."RADIOLOGY_REPORT_V"."RRPT_ACCESSION_NO" AS RRPT_ACCESSION_NO FROM "DV"."RADIOLOGY_REPORT_V" JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS" ON "DV"."RADIOLOGY_REPORT_V"."RRPT_MRN" = "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_MRN"), DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS AS (SELECT DISTINCT "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AS PT_DEID, IDB_PATIENT."PT_MRN" AS PT_MRN, "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AS SUBJECT_ID FROM "IDB"."PATIENT" AS IDB_PATIENT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS" ON IDB_PATIENT."PT_MRN" = "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_MRN") SELECT DISTINCT DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS.PT_MRN AS MRN, RADIOLOGY_COLUMNS.RRPT_PERFORMED_DATE AS RRPT_PERFORMED_DATE, RADIOLOGY_COLUMNS.RRPT_ORDER_GROUP AS RRPT_ORDER_GROUP, RADIOLOGY_COLUMNS.RRPT_PROC_NAME AS RRPT_PROC_NAME, RADIOLOGY_COLUMNS.RRPT_REPORT_TXT AS RRPT_REPORT_TXT, RADIOLOGY_COLUMNS.RRPT_ACCESSION_NO AS RRPT_ACCESSION_NO FROM KEYS LEFT OUTER JOIN RADIOLOGY_COLUMNS ON RADIOLOGY_COLUMNS.SUBJECT_ID = KEYS.COHORT_RADIOLOGY_SUBJECT_ID LEFT OUTER JOIN DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS ON DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS.PT_DEID = KEYS.COHORT_PT_DEID;

prompt: A list of H-case numbers with "TET2" AND "SRSF2" AND ("myeloid neoplasms" OR "MDS" OR "MPN" OR "MDS/MPN" OR "CMML" OR "AML") mentioned in report text from 01/01/2013 to present.
completion: SELECT DISTINCT DMP.PRPT_MRN AS MRN , PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_BIRTH_DTE, PT_VITAL_STATUS, PT_DEATH_DTE , CASE WHEN PT_DEATH_DTE IS NULL THEN YEAR(CURRENT date - PT_BIRTH_DTE) END AS "Current Age" , DMP.PRPT_ACCESSION_NO AS "Accession No" , DMP.PRPT_REPORT_DTE AS "Report Date" , DMP.PRPT_PROCEDURE_DTE AS "Procedure Date" , SRG.PRPT_ACCESSION_NO AS RELATED_ACC_NO , SRG_DATE.DT_DTE AS RELATED_PROC_DTE , DMP.PRPT_REPORT_TYPE_DESC AS "Report Type" , DMP.PRPT_REPORT_TYPE , DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)diag[\w\W]*(?=I ATTEST)', DMP.PRPT_REPORT) AS DIAGNOSIS_TEXT , VARCHAR(DMP.PRPT_REPORT, 32000) AS "Report Text (first 32000 characters)" , (SELECT VARCHAR(PRPT_REPORT, 32000) AS REFERENCEDPATHTEXTFROM FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT WHERE PRPT_ACCESSION_NO = SRG.PRPT_ACCESSION_NO) AS REFERENCEDPATHTEXT FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V DMP LEFT JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_REFERENCES ON PRPTR_CHILD_PATH_RPT_ID = DMP.PRPT_PATH_RPT_ID LEFT JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT SRG ON SRG.PRPT_PATH_RPT_ID = PRPTR_PATH_RPT_ID LEFT JOIN DV.DATE_V SRG_DATE ON SRG_DATE.DT_DATE_ID = SRG.PRPT_PROCEDURE_DATE_ID JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = DMP.PRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID WHERE 1=1 AND DMP.PRPT_ACCESSION_NO like 'H%' AND (DMP.PRPT_REPORT_DTE >= '01/01/2013' OR DMP.PRPT_PROCEDURE_DTE >= '01/01/2013' ) AND CONTAINS(DMP.PRPT_REPORT, '("TET2" AND "SRSF2" AND ("myeloid neoplasms" OR "MDS" OR "MPN" OR "MDS/MPN" OR "CMML" OR "AML"))') = 1 AND DMP.PRPT_REPORT IS NOT NULL ORDER BY 1, 9, 8 ;

prompt: Given a list of MRNs, provide dates of IMPACT testing
COVID 19 Screening appointments in next 72 hours without CIS Order
completion: WITH COVID_ORDERS AS (SELECT COR_MRN, COR_PATIENT_NAME, COR_ORDER_NAME, COR_SIGNIFICANT_DT, COR_ORDER_STATUS_CODE, COR_RESULT_ARRIVAL_DT, COR_RESULT_TEXT FROM IDB.COVID19_ORDER_AND_RESULT) , APPT AS (SELECT CPE_MRN, CPE_ENC_DTE AS "Appt Date", CPE_CPE_APPT_STS AS "Appt Status", CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 AS "Department", CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 AS "Service", CLD_DEPT_NAME AS "Department Name", P.CRE_RES_NAME AS "Provider Name", R.CRE_RES_NAME AS "Referring Provider", CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME AS "Visit Type", CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE P ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = P.CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE R ON CPE_REF_RES_ID = R.CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp', 'Sch') AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT date AND CURRENT date + 5 DAY AND CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID IN (12848, 12864) ) SELECT CPE_MRN AS "MRN", PT_LAST_NAME "Patient First Name", PT_FIRST_NAME "Patient Last Name", "Appt Date", "Appt Status", "Service", "Department Name", "Provider Name", "Referring Provider", "Visit Type", COR_ORDER_NAME "Order Name", CAST(COR_SIGNIFICANT_DT AS DATE) "Order Date", COR_ORDER_STATUS_CODE AS "Order Status" FROM APPT LEFT JOIN COVID_ORDERS ON COR_MRN = CPE_MRN AND "Appt Date" = CAST(COR_SIGNIFICANT_DT AS DATE) LEFT JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON CPE_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE COR_ORDER_STATUS_CODE IS NULL OR COR_ORDER_STATUS_CODE = 'CANC' ORDER BY "Appt Date"

prompt: Create a Tableau dashboard monitor metrics related to Benign Hematology consult requests.
completion: WITH CADENCE AS (SELECT CPE_MRN, CPE_APPT_DT, CPE_ENC_DTE, CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME, CRE_EXT_RES_NAME FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CLD_DEPT_NAME LIKE 'HEMATOLOGY%' AND (CPE_CPE_APPT_STS = 'Arrived' OR CPE_CPE_APPT_STS = 'Comp') AND (CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR LIKE '%NV%' OR CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR LIKE '%IR%') ) , CDH AS (SELECT OU_DISPLAY_NAME, OU_USER_GUID, CDH_CLIENT_DOC_GUID, CDH_CLIENT_GUID, CDH_MRN, OU_ORD_ROLE_TYPE, DENSE_RANK() OVER(PARTITION BY CDH_CLIENT_GUID, CDH_CLIENT_DOC_GUID ORDER BY OU_DISPLAY_NAME) AS RANK FROM IDB.CD_DOCUMENT_HISTORY JOIN IDB.OMS_USER ON CDH_USER_GUID = OU_USER_GUID AND OU_ORD_ROLE_TYPE <> 'Transcriptionist') , CLINDOC AS (SELECT CDD_MRN, CDD_DOC_NAME, CDD_DOC_GUID, CDD_ENTER_DTE, CDD_ENTER_DT, CDD_SIGNED_DT, MIN(CASE WHEN RANK = 1 THEN OU_DISPLAY_NAME END) AS AUTH1, MIN(CASE WHEN RANK = 1 THEN OU_ORD_ROLE_TYPE END) AS AUTH1_ROLE, MIN(CASE WHEN RANK = 2 THEN OU_DISPLAY_NAME END) AS AUTH2, MIN(CASE WHEN RANK = 2 THEN OU_ORD_ROLE_TYPE END) AS AUTH2_ROLE FROM (SELECT DISTINCT CDD_MRN, CDD_DOC_NAME, CDD_DOC_GUID, CDD_ENTER_DTE, CDD_ENTER_DT, CDD_SIGNED_DT, OU_DISPLAY_NAME, OU_ORD_ROLE_TYPE, RANK, MIN(CASE WHEN OU_USER_GUID IN ('9000008832201190', '6000003430119029', '9000140162101190', '9000706456601190', '9000014397101190', '1000002405119001') OR OU_USER_GUID IN ('9000008832201190', '6000003430119029', '9000140162101190', '9000706456601190', '9000014397101190', '1000002405119001') THEN 'y' END) OVER (PARTITION BY CDH_CLIENT_GUID, CDH_CLIENT_DOC_GUID) AS FLAG FROM IDB.CD_DOCUMENT JOIN CDH ON CDD_DOC_GUID = CDH_CLIENT_DOC_GUID AND CDD_CLIENT_GUID = CDH_CLIENT_GUID WHERE CDD_CANCEL_IND = '0' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND = '0' AND CDD_DOC_NAME IN ('Follow Up - DOM (Short Form)-Hematology/Anticoag', 'Follow Up - DOM-Hematology/Anticoag', 'Follow Up Consultation - DOM-Hematology/Anticoag', 'Initial Consult/Initial Visit, AMB - DOM-Hematology/Anticoag', 'Initial Consult/Initial Visit, IP - DOM-Hematology/Anticoag') AND CDD_SERVICE_DTE >= '2016-01-01' ) WHERE FLAG = 'y' GROUP BY CDD_MRN, CDD_DOC_NAME, CDD_DOC_GUID, CDD_ENTER_DTE, CDD_ENTER_DT, CDD_SIGNED_DT ) , ORD AS (SELECT OO_MRN, OO_ORD_GUID, OP_DISPLAY_NAME, OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE, OO_SIGNIFICANT_DT, MIN(CPE_ENC_DTE) AS MIN_CPE_ENC_DTE, MIN(CPE_APPT_DT) AS MIN_CPE_ENC_DT, OOC_ITEM_NAME, CDD_DOC_NAME, CDD_DOC_GUID, CDD_ENTER_DT, CDD_SIGNED_DT, AUTH1, AUTH1_ROLE, AUTH2, AUTH2_ROLE FROM IDB.OMS_ORDER JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_CATALOG ON OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID = OOC_MSTR_ITEM_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_STATUS ON OO_ORD_STS_CD = OSTS_ORD_STS_CD JOIN IDB.OMS_USER_ORDERS ON OO_ORD_GUID = OUO_ORD_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_PROVIDER ON OO_PVDR_GUID = OP_PVDR_GUID JOIN CADENCE ON OO_MRN = CPE_MRN AND CPE_ENC_DTE >= OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE JOIN CLINDOC ON OO_MRN = CDD_MRN AND CDD_ENTER_DTE >= OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE AND CDD_DOC_NAME IN ('Follow Up - DOM (Short Form)-Hematology/Anticoag', 'Follow Up - DOM-Hematology/Anticoag', 'Follow Up Consultation - DOM-Hematology/Anticoag', 'Initial Consult/Initial Visit, AMB - DOM-Hematology/Anticoag') WHERE OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE >= '2016-01-01' AND OUO_ORD_NAME = 'Hematology/ACM Outpatient Consult' AND OSTS_STS_DESC IN ('Active', 'Pending Auto-Completion', 'Completed/Expired', 'Completed') GROUP BY OO_MRN, OO_ORD_GUID, OP_DISPLAY_NAME, OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE, OO_SIGNIFICANT_DT, OOC_ITEM_NAME, CDD_DOC_NAME, CDD_DOC_GUID, CDD_ENTER_DT, CDD_SIGNED_DT, AUTH1, AUTH1_ROLE, AUTH2, AUTH2_ROLE UNION SELECT OO_MRN, OO_ORD_GUID, OP_DISPLAY_NAME, OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE, OO_SIGNIFICANT_DT, NULLIF(CURRENT DATE,CURRENT DATE) AS MIN_CPE_ENC_DTE, NULLIF(CURRENT TIMESTAMP,CURRENT TIMESTAMP) AS MIN_CPE_ENC_DT, OOC_ITEM_NAME, CDD_DOC_NAME, CDD_DOC_GUID, CDD_ENTER_DT, CDD_SIGNED_DT, AUTH1, AUTH1_ROLE, AUTH2, AUTH2_ROLE FROM IDB.OMS_ORDER JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_CATALOG ON OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID = OOC_MSTR_ITEM_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_STATUS ON OO_ORD_STS_CD = OSTS_ORD_STS_CD JOIN IDB.OMS_USER_ORDERS ON OO_ORD_GUID = OUO_ORD_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_PROVIDER ON OO_PVDR_GUID = OP_PVDR_GUID JOIN CLINDOC ON OO_MRN = CDD_MRN AND CDD_ENTER_DTE >= OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE AND CDD_DOC_NAME IN ('Follow Up - DOM (Short Form)-Hematology/Anticoag', 'Follow Up - DOM-Hematology/Anticoag', 'Follow Up Consultation - DOM-Hematology/Anticoag', 'Initial Consult/Initial Visit, IP - DOM-Hematology/Anticoag') WHERE OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE >= '2016-01-01' AND OUO_ORD_NAME = 'Hematology Inpatient Consult' AND OSTS_STS_DESC IN ('Active', 'Pending Auto-Completion', 'Completed/Expired', 'Completed') ) SELECT MRN, ORDER_GUID, ORDER_RELEASE_DT, ORDER_PROV, ORDER_NAME, CADENCE_DATE, CADENCE_DT, CLINDOC_NAME, CDD_DOC_GUID, CLINDOC_ENTER_DT, CLINDOC_SIGNED_DT, CLINDOC_AUTH_1, CLINDOC_AUTH1_ROLE, CLINDOC_AUTH_2, CLINDOC_AUTH2_ROLE FROM (SELECT OO_MRN AS MRN, OO_ORD_GUID AS ORDER_GUID, OO_SIGNIFICANT_DT AS ORDER_RELEASE_DT, OP_DISPLAY_NAME AS ORDER_PROV, OOC_ITEM_NAME AS ORDER_NAME, MIN_CPE_ENC_DTE AS CADENCE_DATE, MIN_CPE_ENC_DT AS CADENCE_DT, CDD_DOC_NAME AS CLINDOC_NAME, CDD_DOC_GUID, CDD_ENTER_DT AS CLINDOC_ENTER_DT, CDD_SIGNED_DT AS CLINDOC_SIGNED_DT, AUTH1 AS CLINDOC_AUTH_1, AUTH1_ROLE AS CLINDOC_AUTH1_ROLE, AUTH2 AS CLINDOC_AUTH_2, AUTH2_ROLE AS CLINDOC_AUTH2_ROLE, RANK() OVER(PARTITION BY OO_MRN, OO_ORD_GUID ORDER BY CDD_ENTER_DT ASC) AS RANK FROM ORD) WHERE RANK = 1 ;

prompt: Create a Tableau dashboard to track Pediatric visits to the bed area and treatment room
completion: SELECT CPE_MRN AS MRN, CPC_ENC_DTE_SEQ, CPE_ENC_CSN_ID "Encounter ID", STRIP(CPE_ENC_DTE_SEQ) "Encounter Seq", CPE_ENC_DTE AS "Appt Date", CPE_APPT_MADE_DTE "Appt Made Date", STRIP(CPE_CPE_APPT_STS) AS "Appt Status", STRIP(CLD_CLD_CENTER) AS "Center", STRIP(D.CAV_NAME) AS "Dept", COALESCE(STRIP(S.CAV_NAME), '') AS "Service", STRIP(CLD_DEPT_NAME) AS "Dept Name", STRIP(CR.CRE_RES_NAME) AS "Provider Name", STRIP(CR.CRE_RES_TYP) AS "Provider Type", STRIP(RP.CRE_RES_NAME) AS "Referring Provider Name", STRIP(CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME) AS "Visit Type", STRIP(CCH_CHEMO_NAME) "Chemo Treatment" FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE CR ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CR.CRE_RES_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE RP ON CPE_REF_RES_ID = RP.CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_PT_CHEMO ON CPE_CL_PT_ID = CPC_CL_PT_ID AND CPE_ENC_DTE_SEQ = CPC_ENC_DTE_SEQ LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_CHEMO ON CPC_CHEMO_ID = CCH_CHEMO_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_CATEGORY D ON D.CAV_CATEGORY = 'CLD_RPT_GRP_6' AND D.CAV_ABBR = CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_CATEGORY S ON S.CAV_CATEGORY = 'CLD_RPT_GRP_8' AND S.CAV_ABBR = CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CLD_DEPT_NAME IN ('PACC BED 1275', 'PACC TREATMENT 1275') AND YEAR(CPE_ENC_DTE) >= YEAR(CURRENT date) - 1 AND CPE_MRN <> ''

prompt: We would like to evaluate the efficacy of HA FUDR + mitomycin in colorectal cancer and cholangiocarcinoma
completion: WITH F AS (SELECT DISTINCT CPO_MRN FROM IDB.CHEMO_PERFORMED_ORDERS WHERE LOWER(CPO_DRUG_NAME) like '%floxuridine%' ) , M AS (SELECT DISTINCT CPO_MRN FROM IDB.CHEMO_PERFORMED_ORDERS WHERE LOWER(CPO_DRUG_NAME) like '%mitomycin%' UNION SELECT DISTINCT CP_MRN AS CPO_MRN FROM IDB.CHEMO_PRESCRIPTIONS WHERE LOWER(CP_GENERIC_NAME) like '%mitomycin%' ) , PTS AS (SELECT DISTINCT F.CPO_MRN, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH FROM F JOIN M ON F.CPO_MRN = M.CPO_MRN JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PT_MRN=F.CPO_MRN) SELECT DISTINCT TM_MRN, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, AV_DESC AS CASE_STS, TM_DX_DTE, TM_HIST_CD, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS HIST_DESC, TM_SITE_CD, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_DESC FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN PTS ON CPO_MRN = TM_MRN JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS ON AV_ELEMENT = 'CASE_STS' AND AV_CODE = TM_CASE_STS AND TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND (TM_SITE_CD BETWEEN 'C180' AND 'C209' OR TM_HIST_CD IN ('M8160/3')) ;
