completion: WITH PATIENT AS (SELECT PT_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME FROM IDB.PATIENT), ENCOUNTER AS (SELECT CPE_MRN, CPE_APPT_DT, CPE_CPE_APPT_STS, CPE_APPT_ARRIVAL_DT, CPE_VST_RES_TTL, CPE_DEPT_ID, CPE_VST_RES_ID, CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER CPE WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Sch') AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT date AND CURRENT DATE + 14 DAYS ), VISIT AS (SELECT CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID, CVT_EXT_NAME, CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME FROM IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE WHERE CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME IN ('AD HOC FR', 'CTS ACTIVE FR', 'CTS MD TX', 'CTS RES AFR', 'LONG TERM FR', 'MD TX', 'MEL MD TX', 'PHONE FR', 'RES ACTIVE FR', 'RES LONG TERM FR', 'RES MD TX', 'STGI MD TX', 'STHN ACTIVE FR', 'STHN LONG TERM FR', 'STTHR ACTIVE FR', 'STTHR ACTIVE FX', 'STTHR COVERING MD AFR', 'STTHR COVERING MD MDTX', 'STTHR LONG TERM FR', 'STTHR MD CH', 'STTHR_MD TX', 'STTHR RES ACTIVE FR', 'STTHR_RES APP MD FR', 'STTHR RES APP MDTX', 'STTHR RES APP ONLY', 'STTHR RES MDTX', 'STTHR TRANSFER FX', 'TELEHEALTH AFR', 'TELEHEALTH FR', 'TELEHEALTH LFR', 'TELEHEALTH MD CH', 'TELEHEALTH MD TX', 'TELEHEALTH POST OP', 'THR COVERING MD FR', 'THR FR', 'THR FX', 'HR POST OP') ), DEPT AS (SELECT CLD_DEPT_ID, CLD_DEPT_NAME FROM IDB.CL_DEPT WHERE CLD_DEPT_NAME IN ('BER STTH R-C', 'BER THORACIC-2', 'BSK ST THR-4', 'BSK THORACIC', 'CMK ST THR', 'CMK THORACIC', 'MON ST THR-C', 'MON THORACIC-2', 'NAS ST THR-2', 'NAS THORACIC-2', 'ST THR KOCH-11', 'ST THR KOCH-16', 'ST THR WES', 'THORACIC KOCH-16', 'THORACIC WES') ), RESOURCE AS (SELECT CRE_RES_ID, CRE_RES_NAME FROM IDB.CL_RESOURCE) SELECT PT_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, CPE_APPT_DT, CRE_RES_NAME, CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME, CLD_DEPT_NAME FROM ENCOUNTER AS E JOIN PATIENT AS P ON E.CPE_MRN = P.PT_MRN JOIN VISIT AS V ON E.CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = V.CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID JOIN RESOURCE AS R ON E.CPE_VST_RES_ID = R.CRE_RES_ID JOIN DEPT AS D ON E.CPE_DEPT_ID = D.CLD_DEPT_ID

prompt: Thoracic surgery new visits and subsequent surgeries in 2021
completion: SELECT DISTINCT A.CLD_CLD_CENTER AS SITE, A.CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 AS DEPARTMENT, A.CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 AS SERVICE, A.CLD_DEPT_NAME AS DEPARTMENT_NAME, A.CLD_SPECIALTY AS SITE_SPECIALTY, B.CRE_RES_NAME AS PROVIDER_NAME, B.CRE_RES_TYP AS PROVIDER_TYPE, CPE_MRN AS MRN, CPE_ENC_DTE AS APPT_DATE, CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR AS VISIT_TYPE, SSE_LOG_ID AS LOG_ID, SSE_SURG_DTE AS SURGERY_DATE , D.CRE_RES_NAME AS SURGEON_NAME FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT A ON CPE_DEPT_ID = A.CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE B ON B.CRE_RES_ID = CPE_VST_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT ON CPE_MRN = SSE_MRN AND SSE_SURG_DTE BETWEEN CPE_ENC_DTE AND '2021-12-31' LEFT JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE ON SSE_LOG_ID = SSP_LOG_ID AND SSE_SOURCE_TYPE = SSP_SOURCE_TYPE AND SSP_PROC_SEQ_NO = 1 LEFT JOIN IDB.OR_LOG_ALL_SURG ON SSE_LOG_ID = OLAS_LOG_ID AND OLAS_SURG_ROLE_CD = '1' AND (OLAS_PNL_NO = 1 OR OLAS_PNL_NO IS NULL) LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE D ON D.CRE_RES_ID = OLAS_RES_ID WHERE 1=1 AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN '2021-01-01' AND '2021-12-31' AND A.CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 = 'SRG' AND A.CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 = 'THR' AND CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Comp', 'Arrived') AND B.CRE_RES_TYP IN ('Physician', 'Advanced Practice Nurse', 'Dentist', 'PhD', 'Psychologist', 'Physician Assistant', 'Nurse Practitioner') AND (CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR like '%NV%' OR CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR LIKE '%IR%')

prompt: Provide a list of patients diagnosed with osteosarcoma, ewing sarcoma, synovial sarcoma, desmoplastic small round cell tumor, rhabdomyosarcoma between 1/1/1999 - 6/6/2019.
completion: WITH PTS AS (SELECT DISTINCT TM_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, CASE WHEN PT_DEATH_IND IN ('X', 'C', 'D') THEN 'DECEASED' ELSE 'ALIVE' END VITAL_STATUS, YEAR(TM_DX_DTE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) AGE_AT_DX, TM_DX_DTE, CASE WHEN TM_AJCC_7 NOT IN ('', '888', '999') THEN AJCC7.AV_DESC WHEN TM_AJCC NOT IN ('', '88', '99') THEN AJCC.AV_DESC WHEN TM_GENERAL_STG NOT IN ('', '9') THEN GS.AV_DESC WHEN TM_PATH_STG_GRP NOT IN ('', '88', '9', '99') THEN TM_PATH_STG_GRP ELSE CLIN.AV_DESC END AS BEST_STAGE, CASE WHEN TM_AJCC_7 NOT IN ('', '888', '999') THEN 'AJCC_7' WHEN TM_AJCC NOT IN ('', '88', '99') THEN 'AJCC' WHEN TM_GENERAL_STG NOT IN ('', '9') THEN 'GeneralStage' WHEN TM_PATH_STG_GRP NOT IN ('', '88', '9', '99') THEN 'PathStage' ELSE 'ClinicalStage' END AS BEST_STAGE_SOURCE, TM_SITE_CD AS SITE_CODE, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_DESC, TM_HIST_CD AS HIST_CODE, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS HIST_DESC, PFA_FST_APPT_DTE, PLA_LST_CON_DTE FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM H ON TM_HIST_CD = H.CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON TM_SITE_CD = S.CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON TM_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.PT_FIRST_ACTIVITY ON TM_MRN = PFA_MRN JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY ON TM_MRN = PLA_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS AJCC7 ON AJCC7.AV_ELEMENT = 'AJCC_7' AND AJCC7.AV_CODE = TM_AJCC_7 LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS AJCC ON AJCC.AV_ELEMENT = 'AJCC' AND AJCC.AV_CODE = TM_AJCC LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS GS ON GS.AV_ELEMENT = 'GENERAL_STG' AND GS.AV_CODE = TM_GENERAL_STG LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS CLIN ON CLIN.AV_ELEMENT = 'CLIN_STG_DSCR' AND CLIN.AV_CODE = TM_CLIN_STG_DSCR WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND TM_DX_DTE BETWEEN '1999-01-01' AND '2019-06-06' AND TM_HIST_CD IN ('M9180/3', 'M9181/3', 'M9182/3', 'M9183/3', 'M9184/3', 'M9185/3', 'M9186/3', 'M9187/3', 'M9190/3', 'M9192/3', 'M9193/3', 'M9194/3', 'M9195/3', 'M9260/3', 'M9040/3', 'M9041/3', 'M9042/3', 'M9043/3', 'M8806/3', 'M8900/3', 'M8901/3', 'M8902/3', 'M8910/3', 'M8912/3', 'M8920/3', 'M8921/3') ) , APPTS AS (SELECT CPE_MRN, COUNT(DISTINCT CPE_ENC_CSN_ID) TOTAL_APPT_CNT, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN ((CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 = 'PED' OR CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_4 = 'PED' OR CLD_DEPT_NAME = 'ORTHOPEDICS 1275-9') AND CPE_CPE_IP_IND <> 'INPATIENT') THEN CPE_ENC_CSN_ID END) TOTAL_PEDS_APPT, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 = 'MED' THEN CPE_ENC_CSN_ID END) TOTAL_MED_APPT FROM PTS JOIN IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER ON TM_MRN = CPE_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') GROUP BY CPE_MRN ) , FINAL AS (SELECT TM_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, VITAL_STATUS, AGE_AT_DX, TM_DX_DTE, BEST_STAGE, BEST_STAGE_SOURCE, SITE_CODE, SITE_DESC, HIST_CODE, HIST_DESC, PFA_FST_APPT_DTE, PLA_LST_CON_DTE, TOTAL_APPT_CNT, TOTAL_PEDS_APPT, TOTAL_MED_APPT FROM PTS LEFT JOIN APPTS ON TM_MRN = CPE_MRN ) SELECT AC_MRN MRN, PRO_IRB_NO FROM (SELECT DISTINCT TM_MRN FROM FINAL) A JOIN IDB.ACCRUALS ON TM_MRN = AC_MRN JOIN IDB.PROTOCOL ON AC_IRB_NO = PRO_IRB_NO WHERE PRO_PROTOCOL_TYPE IN ('Therapeutic', 'Therapeutic/QOL') ; SELECT RTC_TX_MRN, RTC_TX_COURSE_NO, RTC_TX_PLANSETUP_NO, RTC_TX_COURSE_ID, RTC_TX_PLAN_NAME, RTC_TX_PLANNED_FRACTIONS, RTC_TX_DELIVERED_FRACTIONS, RTC_TX_PLANNED_DOSE, RTC_TX_DELIVERED_DOSE, RTC_TX_START_DTE, RTC_TX_STOP_DTE, RTC_TX_ELAPSED_DAYS, RTC_PRIMARY_REF_POINT FROM (SELECT DISTINCT TM_MRN FROM FINAL) A JOIN IDB.RADONC_TREATMENT_COURSE ON TM_MRN = RTC_TX_MRN ; SELECT SSE_MRN, SSE_SURG_DTE, SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK FROM (SELECT DISTINCT TM_MRN FROM FINAL) A JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT ON TM_MRN = SSE_MRN JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE ON SSE_LOG_ID = SSP_LOG_ID JOIN IDB.CLM ON SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD ; SELECT APR_MRN, APR_START_DTE, APR_END_DTE, CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME, APR_TOTAL_GIVEN_DOSE, APR_DOSE_UOM FROM (SELECT DISTINCT TM_MRN FROM FINAL) A JOIN IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX_V ON TM_MRN = APR_MRN WHERE CDG_CHEMO_FLAG = 'Y' ;

prompt: Provide a list of patients, since 2000, that were diagnosed with adrenocortical carcinoma and underwent systemic treatment at MSK with either mitotane or chemotherapy.
completion: WITH PATH AS (SELECT DISTINCT T1.PT_MRN AS MRN, TRIM(PT_LAST_NAME)||', '||TRIM(PT_FIRST_NAME) "Name", T1.PT_BIRTH_DTE "Date of Birth", T1.PT_DEATH_DTE "Date of Death", PT_SEX "Gender", COALESCE(CORE_ETHNICITY_DESC, 'N/A') "Ethnicity" , CASE WHEN PT_RACE IN ('1', '98') THEN 'WHITE' WHEN PT_RACE IN ('2', '99') THEN 'BLACK' WHEN PT_RACE = '3' THEN 'AMER IND ALEUT ESKIMO' WHEN PT_RACE = '4' THEN 'ASIAN-FAR EAST/INDIAN SUBCONT' WHEN PT_RACE = '5' THEN 'NATIVE HAWAIIAN OR PACIFIC ISL ' WHEN CORE_CDB_RACE = '01' THEN 'WHITE' WHEN CORE_CDB_RACE = '02' THEN 'BLACK' WHEN CORE_CDB_RACE = '03' THEN 'AMER IND ALEUT ESKIMO' WHEN CORE_CDB_RACE IN ('04', '05', '06', '96') OR CORE_CDB_RACE BETWEEN '08' AND '15' THEN 'ASIAN-FAR EAST/INDIAN SUBCONT' WHEN CORE_CDB_RACE IN ('07', '97') OR CORE_CDB_RACE BETWEEN '20' AND '32' THEN 'NATIVE HAWAIIAN OR PACIFIC ISL' ELSE 'UNKNOWN' END "Race", T2.DT_DTE AS "Report Date", T3.DT_DTE AS "Procedure Date", T4.PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_DESC AS "Report Type", T5.PRPT_ACCESSION_NO AS "Accession No" , CAST(T5.PRPT_REPORT AS VARCHAR(18000)) AS PATH_TEXT , CASE WHEN LOCATE('DIAGNOS', UPPER(CAST(T5.PRPT_REPORT AS VARCHAR(18000)))) > 1 AND LOCATE('DIAGNOS', UPPER(CAST(T5.PRPT_REPORT AS VARCHAR(18000)))) < LOCATE('I ATTEST', CAST(T5.PRPT_REPORT AS VARCHAR(18000))) THEN LOCATE('DIAGNOS', UPPER(CAST(T5.PRPT_REPORT AS VARCHAR(18000)))) END L1 , LOCATE('I ATTEST', CAST(T5.PRPT_REPORT AS VARCHAR(18000))) L2 , LOCATE('I ATTEST', CAST(T5.PRPT_REPORT AS VARCHAR(18000))) - CASE WHEN LOCATE('DIAGNOS', UPPER(CAST(T5.PRPT_REPORT AS VARCHAR(18000)))) > 1 AND LOCATE('DIAGNOS', UPPER(CAST(T5.PRPT_REPORT AS VARCHAR(18000)))) < LOCATE('I ATTEST', CAST(T5.PRPT_REPORT AS VARCHAR(18000))) THEN LOCATE('DIAGNOS', UPPER(CAST(T5.PRPT_REPORT AS VARCHAR(18000)))) END L3 FROM DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V T1 LEFT JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED T6 ON T1.PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = T6.PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID LEFT JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V T5 ON T6.PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = T5.PRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID LEFT JOIN DV.DATE_V T2 ON T5.PRPT_REPORT_DATE_ID = T2.DT_DATE_ID LEFT JOIN DV.DATE_V T3 ON T5.PRPT_PROCEDURE_DATE_ID = T3.DT_DATE_ID LEFT JOIN DV.PATH_RPRT_TYPE_LOOKUP T4 ON T5.PRPT_REPORT_TYPE = T4.PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_CD LEFT JOIN DV.PATIENT_CORE_DEMOGRAPHICS ON CORE_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = T1.PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID WHERE 1=1 AND LOWER(CAST(T5.PRPT_REPORT AS VARCHAR(18000))) like '%adren%cortic%i attest%' AND LOCATE('carcinoma', LOWER(CAST(T5.PRPT_REPORT AS VARCHAR(18000)))) > 1 AND(T2.DT_DTE >= '1/1/2000' OR T3.DT_DTE >= '1/1/2000') AND T5.PRPT_REPORT IS NOT NULL ) SELECT A.MRN, "Name", "Date of Birth", "Date of Death", "Gender", "Race", "Ethnicity" , MAX(CASE WHEN CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME = 'MITOTANE' THEN 'Y' ELSE '' END) MITOTANE_FLAG , MAX(CASE WHEN CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME = 'ETOPOSIDE' THEN 'Y' ELSE '' END) ETOPOSIDE_FLAG FROM PATH A JOIN IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX_V ON MRN = APR_MRN WHERE CDG_CHEMO_FLAG = 'Y' AND CDG_DRUG_TYPE = 'Antineoplastics' AND CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME IN ('MITOTANE', 'ETOPOSIDE') GROUP BY MRN, "Name", "Date of Birth", "Date of Death", "Gender", "Race", "Ethnicity"

prompt: Provide metrics for US News Survey Section.
completion: WITH PTS AS (SELECT CPE_MRN MRN, MIN(CPE_ENC_DTE) FIRST_PSYCH_DATE, MAX(CPE_ENC_DTE) LAST_PSYCH_DATE, COUNT(DISTINCT CPE_ENC_DTE) NUMBER_APPT_DATES FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON CPE_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND YEAR(DATE('2021-01-01') - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) < 21 AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 = 'PSY' AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN '2020-01-01' AND '2021-12-31' GROUP BY CPE_MRN HAVING DAYS(MAX(CPE_ENC_DTE)) - DAYS(MIN(CPE_ENC_DTE)) > 90) , ORD AS (SELECT OO_MRN, MAX(CASE WHEN (LOWER(OOC_ITEM_NAME) like 'chlorpromazine%' OR OOC_ITEM_NAME IN ('Droperidol (NO)', 'Thioridazine HCl', 'Aripiprazole', 'Asenapine', 'quetiapine', 'Ziprasidone') OR LOWER(OOC_ITEM_NAME) like 'haloperidol%' OR LOWER(OOC_ITEM_NAME) like 'prochlorperazine%' OR LOWER(OOC_ITEM_NAME) like 'clozapine%' OR LOWER(OOC_ITEM_NAME) like 'olanzapine%' OR LOWER(OOC_ITEM_NAME) like 'risperidone%') THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END) ANTIPSYCHOTIC_FLAG, MAX(CASE WHEN (LOWER(OOC_ITEM_NAME) like 'dextroamphetamine%' OR LOWER(OOC_ITEM_NAME) like 'amphetamine%' OR LOWER(OOC_ITEM_NAME) like 'methylphenidate%' OR LOWER(OOC_ITEM_NAME) like 'dexmethylphenidate%' OR LOWER(OOC_ITEM_NAME) like 'lisdexamfetamine%') THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END) STIMULANTS_FLAG FROM PTS JOIN IDB.OMS_ORDER ON MRN = OO_MRN JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_CATALOG ON OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID = OOC_MSTR_ITEM_GUID WHERE OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE BETWEEN '2021-01-01' AND '2021-12-31' AND OO_ORD_STS_CD NOT IN ('CANP', 'CANC', 'AUC3') AND (LOWER(OOC_ITEM_NAME) like 'chlorpromazine%' OR OOC_ITEM_NAME IN ('Droperidol (NO)', 'Thioridazine HCl', 'Aripiprazole', 'Asenapine', 'quetiapine', 'Ziprasidone') OR LOWER(OOC_ITEM_NAME) like 'haloperidol%' OR LOWER(OOC_ITEM_NAME) like 'prochlorperazine%' OR LOWER(OOC_ITEM_NAME) like 'clozapine%' OR LOWER(OOC_ITEM_NAME) like 'olanzapine%' OR LOWER(OOC_ITEM_NAME) like 'risperidone%' OR LOWER(OOC_ITEM_NAME) like 'dextroamphetamine%' OR LOWER(OOC_ITEM_NAME) like 'amphetamine%' OR LOWER(OOC_ITEM_NAME) like 'methylphenidate%' OR LOWER(OOC_ITEM_NAME) like 'dexmethylphenidate%' OR LOWER(OOC_ITEM_NAME) like 'lisdexamfetamine%') GROUP BY OO_MRN ) SELECT PTS.*, ANTIPSYCHOTIC_FLAG, STIMULANTS_FLAG FROM PTS LEFT JOIN ORD ON MRN = OO_MRN

prompt: Pediatric patients (ages 1-30 years) with a diagnosis of radiation therapy associated glioblastoma or secondary glioblastoma
completion: WITH CTE AS (SELECT DISTINCT TM_MRN, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, TM_DX_DTE FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON TM_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND TM_SITE_CD LIKE 'C71%' AND YEAR(TM_DX_DTE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) BETWEEN 0 AND 30 AND TM_DX_DTE BETWEEN '1990-01-01' AND '2020-06-23' AND TM_HIST_CD IN ('M9401/3', 'M9385/3', 'M9442/3', 'M9441/3', 'M9440/3', 'M9380/3', 'M9381/3', 'M9382/3', 'M9451/3', 'M9473/0', 'M9473/3') ) , DX AS (SELECT DISTINCT TM_MRN, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, TM_DX_DTE FROM DV.CLINDOC_FULL_TEXT_V JOIN CTE ON CDD_MRN = TM_MRN WHERE CDD_CANCEL_IND <> '1' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND <> '1' AND CDD_SERVICE_DTE BETWEEN '1990-01-01' AND '2020-06-23' AND CONTAINS(CDD_DOCUMENT_FULL_TEXT, '("rt-associated" | "rt associated" | "radiation associated" | "radiation-associated" | "radiation induced" | "radiation-induced" | "rt-induced" | "rt induced"| "secondary to radiation")') = 1 ) , IMPACT AS (SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_STRUCTURED_RESULTS_V JOIN DX ON PT_MRN = TM_MRN WHERE METHOD = 'IMPACT' ) SELECT DISTINCT TM_MRN, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, TM_DX_DTE, CASE WHEN PT_MRN IS NOT NULL THEN 'Y' ELSE '' END AS HAVE_IMPACT FROM DX LEFT JOIN IMPACT ON TM_MRN = PT_MRN ORDER BY 1, 3

prompt: Please provide a list of cases with the diagnosis of "Double hit lymphoma" OR "high grade B-cell lymphoma" OR "aggressive B-cell lymphoma" AND "TdT"
completion: WITH X AS (SELECT DISTINCT "t1"."PT_MRN" AS "MRN", PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_BIRTH_DTE AS DOB, "t2"."PRPT_ACCESSION_NO" AS "Pathology Report", PRPT_REPORT_TYPE, "t3"."PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_DESC" AS "Pathology Report Type", "t4"."DT_DTE" AS "Pathology Procedure Date", UPPER(CASE WHEN LENGTH(PRPT_REPORT) <= 18000 THEN RTRIM(CAST(SUBSTR(PRPT_REPORT, 1, 18000) AS VARCHAR(18000))) ELSE CAST(SUBSTR(PRPT_REPORT, 1, 18000) AS VARCHAR(18000)) END) AS TXT, UPPER(DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)DIAGNOSIS:[\w\W]*(?=COMMENT:)', UPPER(PRPT_REPORT))) AS "DIAGNOSIS1", UPPER(DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)DIAGNOSIS:[\w\W]*(?=NOTE:)', UPPER(PRPT_REPORT))) AS "DIAGNOSIS2", UPPER(DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)DIAGNOSIS:[\w\W]*(?=MORPHOLOGY)', UPPER(PRPT_REPORT))) AS "DIAGNOSIS3", UPPER(DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)DIAGNOSIS:[\w\W]*(?=I ATTEST)', UPPER(PRPT_REPORT))) AS "DIAGNOSIS4", UPPER(DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)CLINICAL DIAGNOSIS AND HISTORY:[\w\W]*(?=SPECIMENS SUBMITTED:)', UPPER(PRPT_REPORT))) AS "DIAGNOSIS5", UPPER(DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)CLINICAL DIAGNOSIS AND HISTORY:[\w\W]*(?=SPECIMENSSUBMITTED:)', UPPER(PRPT_REPORT))) AS "DIAGNOSIS6", UPPER(DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)CLINICAL DIAGNOSIS & HISTORY:[\w\W]*(?=SPECIMENS SUBMITTED:)', UPPER(PRPT_REPORT))) AS "DIAGNOSIS7" FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V" "t1" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED" "t6" ON "t1"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t6"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V" "t2" ON "t6"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t2"."PRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATH_RPRT_TYPE_LOOKUP" "t3" ON "t2"."PRPT_REPORT_TYPE" = "t3"."PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_CD" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" "t4" ON "t2"."PRPT_PROCEDURE_DATE_ID" = "t4"."DT_DATE_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" "t5" ON "t2"."PRPT_REPORT_DATE_ID" = "t5"."DT_DATE_ID" WHERE 1=1 AND CONTAINS("t2"."PRPT_REPORT", '(("Double hit lymphoma" OR "high grade B-cell lymphoma" OR "high grade B cell lymphoma" OR "aggressive B-cell lymphoma" OR "aggressive B cell lymphoma") AND "TdT")') = 1 AND "t2"."PRPT_REPORT" IS NOT NULL AND "t4"."DT_DTE" >= '2017-01-01' ) , Y AS (SELECT "MRN", PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, DOB, "Pathology Report", PRPT_REPORT_TYPE, "Pathology Report Type", "Pathology Procedure Date", TXT, CASE WHEN "DIAGNOSIS1" <> '' THEN "DIAGNOSIS1" WHEN "DIAGNOSIS2" <> '' THEN "DIAGNOSIS2" WHEN "DIAGNOSIS3" <> '' THEN "DIAGNOSIS3" WHEN "DIAGNOSIS4" <> '' THEN "DIAGNOSIS4" WHEN "DIAGNOSIS5" <> '' THEN "DIAGNOSIS5" WHEN "DIAGNOSIS6" <> '' THEN "DIAGNOSIS6" WHEN "DIAGNOSIS7" <> '' THEN "DIAGNOSIS7" END AS "DIAGNOSIS" FROM X) SELECT * FROM Y

prompt: Provide a list of patients untreated coming to MSK for head and neck ca, pancreas ca, lung ca and bladder ca
completion: WITH LKUP_TYPE AS (SELECT 'displayName' AS TYPE, 'zzPDL_MED_19-466' SEARCH_VAL FROM SYSIBM.SYSDUMMY1) , USRS AS (SELECT 1 COHORT_ID , DV.LDAPQUERY(SEARCH_VAL, TYPE, 'member') MEM , DV.LDAPQUERY(SEARCH_VAL, TYPE, 'displayName') DISPLAYNAME , DV.LDAPQUERY(SEARCH_VAL, TYPE, 'managedBy') OWNER FROM LKUP_TYPE) , MEM AS (SELECT DISPLAYNAME, OWNER, COLUMN_VALUES MEM FROM USRS CROSS JOIN TABLE(DVCMS.DRF_SPLIT(MEM, '|')) T) , MEM_LVL1 AS (SELECT DISPLAYNAME, MEM, SUBSTR(MEM, 4, LOCATE(',', MEM) - 4) USERNAME , CASE WHEN OWNER <> 'Unavailable - error in UDF - java.lang.NullPointerException' THEN SUBSTR(OWNER, 4, LOCATE(',', OWNER) - 4) ELSE '' END OWNER FROM MEM WHERE UPPER(MEM) not like 'CN=ZZPDL%' ) , FIN AS (SELECT USERNAME, MP_SOURCE_PROVIDER_NO AS DR_NO FROM MEM_LVL1 JOIN DV.MEDPRO ON (LOWER(TRIM(USERNAME)) || '@mskcc.org') = MP_EMAIL_ADDR) , APPT AS (SELECT CPE_MRN, CPE_APPT_DT, DEPARTMENT, SERVICE, DEPARTMENT_NAME, CLD_CLD_CENTER, PROVIDER_NAME, VISIT_TYPE, LISTAGG(TRIM(CPAN_NOTE), ' ') WITHIN GROUP( ORDER BY CPAN_ENC_DTE_SEQ, CPAN_LINE_NO ASC) AS APPT_NOTE FROM (SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN, CPE_APPT_DT, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 AS DEPARTMENT, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 AS SERVICE, CLD_DEPT_NAME AS DEPARTMENT_NAME, CLD_CLD_CENTER, CRE_RES_NAME AS PROVIDER_NAME, CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME AS VISIT_TYPE, CPAN_NOTE, CPAN_ENC_DTE_SEQ, CPAN_LINE_NO FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN FIN ON CRE_RES_ID = DR_NO JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_PT_APPT_NOTES ON CPE_PRK = CPAN_PRK AND CPAN_ENC_DTE = CPE_ENC_DTE WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS = 'Sch' AND CLD_CLD_CENTER IN ('16 E60', '1919', '205 E64', '300 E66', '301', '515', '53RD', '54th', '68TH', '70th', '72nd', '74th', 'UCC', 'MAIN', 'JRSC', 'KOCH', 'MEC') AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT DATE AND CURRENT DATE + 14 DAYS AND (CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR LIKE '%NV%' OR CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR LIKE '%IR%') ) GROUP BY CPE_MRN, CPE_APPT_DT, DEPARTMENT, SERVICE, DEPARTMENT_NAME, CLD_CLD_CENTER, PROVIDER_NAME, VISIT_TYPE) , SMOKE AS (SELECT CDD_MRN, CDD_AUTHORED_DTE, TU.CDO_VALUE_TEXT AS TOBACCO_USE FROM IDB.CD_DOCUMENT JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION TU ON CDD_DOC_GUID = TU.CDO_DOC_GUID AND TU.CDO_CTLG_DISPL_NM = 'Social History' AND TU.CDO_ITEM_NAME = 'Tobacco Use' WHERE CDD_CANCEL_IND = '0' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND = '0' ) SELECT CPE_APPT_DT AS APPT_DT , TRIM(PT_LAST_NAME) || ', ' || TRIM(PT_FIRST_NAME) AS PATIENT_NAME , PT_MRN AS MRN , PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH AS DOB , PROVIDER_NAME , VISIT_TYPE , APPT_NOTE , DEPARTMENT , SERVICE , AV_DESC AS PRIMARY_LANG , DEPARTMENT_NAME , TOBACCO_USE , MIN(CASE WHEN AC_IRB_NO = '12-245' THEN 'Y' END) AS "12-245" , MIN(CASE WHEN AC_IRB_NO = '06-107' THEN 'Y' END) AS "06-107" FROM IDB.PATIENT JOIN APPT ON PT_MRN = CPE_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS ON AV_ELEMENT = 'PRIMARY_LANG' AND AV_CODE = PT_PRIMARY_LANG LEFT JOIN IDB.ACCRUALS ON PT_MRN = AC_MRN AND AC_IRB_NO IN ('12-245', '06-107') LEFT JOIN SMOKE ON PT_MRN = CDD_MRN GROUP BY CPE_APPT_DT , TRIM(PT_LAST_NAME) || ', ' || TRIM(PT_FIRST_NAME) , PT_MRN , PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH , PROVIDER_NAME , VISIT_TYPE , APPT_NOTE , DEPARTMENT , SERVICE , AV_DESC , DEPARTMENT_NAME , TOBACCO_USE ORDER BY CPE_APPT_DT , PROVIDER_NAME WITH UR

3. Cardiac Arrest (date of MERT) --> MERT note author should include if cardiac arrest

12. IF got supplemetnal O2 (100% NRB, n/c) can get from flow sheet

completion: SELECT CDD_MRN AS MRN, CDD_SERVICE_DTE, CDD_DOC_NAME, OP_DISPLAY_NAME AS PROVIDER, OP_PROV_TYPE, CDD_DOC_GUID, CDO_SECTION, CDO_ITEM_SEQ, CDO_OBS_CTLG_MSTR_ITEM_GUID, TRIM(CDO_ITEM_NAME) CDO_ITEM_NAME, TRIM(CDO_VALUE_TEXT) CDO_VALUE_TEXT FROM IDB.CD_DOCUMENT LEFT JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION ON CDD_DOC_GUID = CDO_DOC_GUID AND CDD_AUTHORED_DTE = CDO_AUTHORED_DTE AND CDO_VALUE_TEXT <> '' JOIN IDB.OMS_PROVIDER ON CDD_AUTH_PROV_GUID = OP_PVDR_GUID WHERE CDD_CANCEL_IND <> '1' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND <> '1' AND CDO_SECTION = 'MERT' AND CDD_SERVICE_DTE BETWEEN '2020-07-01' AND '2021-06-30'

prompt: Provide a list of patients with new visit appointments to breast medical oncologist and breast surgeons within the last 7 days.
completion: WITH AC AS (SELECT * FROM IDB.ACCRUALS WHERE AC_IRB_NO = '19-382' ) , EF AS (SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN, STRIP(PT_LAST_NAME) AS PT_LAST_NAME, STRIP(PT_FIRST_NAME) AS PT_FIRST_NAME, AC_IRB_NO, AC_CONS_DTE, EF_FORM_NAME, EF_FORM_ALIAS, DATE(EF_SUBMISSION_DT) AS EF_SUBMISSION_DTE FROM AC JOIN IDB.EF_FORM ON EF_MRN = AC_MRN JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PT_MRN = EF_MRN WHERE 1=1 AND EF_FORM_NAME IN ('Technical Survey', 'Demographics', 'Quality of Life Questionnaire (FACT-G)', 'Telehealth Usability Questionnaire', 'Serious Illness Questionnaire') ) SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN AS MRN, STRIP(PT_LAST_NAME) AS PT_LAST_NAME, STRIP(PT_FIRST_NAME) AS PT_FIRST_NAME, CPE_ENC_DTE, STRIP(CRE_RES_NAME) AS CRE_RES_NAME, STRIP(CRE_RES_TYP) AS CRE_RES_TYP, STRIP(CLD_DEPT_NAME) AS CLD_DEPT_NAME, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8, CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR, STRIP(CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME) AS CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME, STRIP(CPE_CPE_APPT_STS) AS CPE_CPE_APPT_STS FROM AC JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PT_MRN = AC_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER ON CPE_MRN = AC_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp', 'Can', 'Sch') AND CRE_RES_TYP IN ('Physician', 'Nurse Practitioner') AND CRE_RES_ID IN ('021113', '025676', '082727')

prompt: I would like to request a data report that provides info on patient deaths as entered in CIS  = Death Note. I would like  a report that lists the MRNs for patients who died and the value entered in data field=Immediate cause of death from time frame 2017-2023 (YTD).
completion: SELECT CDD_MRN MRN, CDD_SERVICE_DTE "Note date", CDD_DOC_GUID AS "Document Guid", CDD_DOC_NAME AS "Document Name" , MAX(CASE WHEN CDO_OBS_CTLG_MSTR_ITEM_GUID = '9000116962502890' THEN SUBSTR(TRIM(CDO_VALUE_TEXT), 1, 155) END) "Immediate Cause of death" , MAX(CASE WHEN CDO_OBS_CTLG_MSTR_ITEM_GUID = '9000006422302890' THEN SUBSTR(TRIM(CDO_VALUE_TEXT), 1, 55) END) "Time of Death" , MAX(CASE WHEN CDO_OBS_CTLG_MSTR_ITEM_GUID = '9000006416502890' THEN SUBSTR(TRIM(CDO_VALUE_TEXT), 1, 255) END) "Physical Exam Notable" , MAX(CASE WHEN CDO_OBS_CTLG_MSTR_ITEM_GUID = '9000006418702890' THEN SUBSTR(TRIM(CDO_VALUE_TEXT), 1, 55) END) "Organ Donation Network Notified" , MAX(CASE WHEN CDO_OBS_CTLG_MSTR_ITEM_GUID = '9000158103402890' THEN SUBSTR(TRIM(CDO_VALUE_TEXT), 1, 55) END) "Organ Donation Network Notified DateTime" FROM IDB.CD_DOCUMENT JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION ON CDD_DOC_GUID = CDO_DOC_GUID WHERE CDD_DOC_NAME = 'Death Note' AND CDD_SERVICE_DTE >= '2017-01-01' AND TRIM(CDO_VALUE_TEXT) > '' GROUP BY CDD_MRN, CDD_SERVICE_DTE, CDD_DOC_GUID, CDD_DOC_NAME ORDER BY 2

prompt: Provide a Darwin cohort of patients for the given criteria along with access to the patients in the Darwin Digital Platform.
completion: WITH PTS AS (SELECT PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID PID FROM DV.PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED) , DT_1 AS (SELECT PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID AS P_ID FROM DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS REC LEFT JOIN DV.PATIENT_CORE_DEMOGRAPHICS ON PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = CORE_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID WHERE 1=1 ) , DT_2 AS (SELECT PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID AS P_ID FROM DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS REC LEFT JOIN DV.PATIENT_CORE_DEMOGRAPHICS ON PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = CORE_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID WHERE 1=1 AND PT_VITAL_STATUS IN ('ALIVE') ) , DT_3 AS (SELECT INC.PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID P_ID FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_STRUCTURED_RESULTS_V INC WHERE 1=1 AND (INC.GENE IN ('BRAF') OR INC.GENE2 IN ('BRAF')) AND UPPER(INC.AA_CHANGE) like '%V600%' ) , DEID AS (SELECT DISTINCT P_ID FROM (SELECT P_ID FROM DT_1 INTERSECT SELECT P_ID FROM DT_2 INTERSECT SELECT P_ID FROM DT_3 ))

prompt: provide a 1-time list of young adult patients who have undergone transplant and are within eligibility parameters for social work led YA post transplant support group
completion: WITH TRANSPLANT AS (SELECT CB.CBM_MRN AS TRANS_MRN, CB.CBM_TRANSPLANT_TYPE AS TRANSPLANT_TYPE, CB.CBM_INDICATION_DESC AS INDICATION_DESC, CB.CBM_TRANSPLANT_DTE AS TRANSPLANT_DTE FROM IDB.CRDB_BMT_MEDICINE CB WHERE CB.CBM_TRANSPLANT_DTE BETWEEN '2021-01-01' AND CURRENT date -1 DAY UNION SELECT CP.CBP_MRN AS TRANS_MRN, CP.CBP_TRANSPLANT_TYPE AS TRANSPLANT_TYPE, CP.CBP_INDICATION_DESC AS INDICATION_DESC, CP.CBP_TRANSPLANT_DTE AS TRANSPLANT_DTE FROM IDB.CRDB_BMT_PEDIATRICS CP WHERE CP.CBP_TRANSPLANT_DTE BETWEEN '2021-01-01' AND CURRENT date -1 DAY ), TRANS AS (SELECT DISTINCT TRANS_MRN AS TRANSPLANT_MRN, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH AS "Date of Birth", PT_DATE_OF_DEATH AS "Date of Death", CASE WHEN PT_DATE_OF_DEATH IS NULL THEN 'Alive' ELSE 'Deceased' END AS "Vital Status", CASE WHEN PT_DATE_OF_DEATH IS NULL THEN YEAR(CURRENT date - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) END AS "Current Age", COALESCE(MAX(PLA_LST_APPT_DTE, PLA_LST_DSCH_DTE), PLA_LST_APPT_DTE, PLA_LST_DSCH_DTE) AS "DATE OF LAST FOLLOW UP", PLA_LST_ACTV_DTE AS "Patient Last Active Date", TRANSPLANT_DTE, TRANSPLANT_TYPE, INDICATION_DESC FROM TRANSPLANT JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON TRANS_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY ON PLA_MRN = TRANS_MRN WHERE CASE WHEN PT_DATE_OF_DEATH IS NULL THEN YEAR(CURRENT date - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) END BETWEEN '18' AND '39' ) SELECT DISTINCT APR_MRN AS MRN, "Date of Birth", "Date of Death", "Vital Status", "Current Age", "DATE OF LAST FOLLOW UP", "Patient Last Active Date", TRANSPLANT_DTE AS "Transplant Date", TRANSPLANT_TYPE AS "Trnaplant Type", INDICATION_DESC AS "Indication Description" FROM TRANS JOIN IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX_V ON TRANSPLANT_MRN = APR_MRN WHERE CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME NOT IN ('AXICABTAGENE CILOLEUCEL', 'TISAGENLECLEUCEL', 'BREXUCABTAGENE AUTOLEUCEL', 'LISOCABTAGENE MARALEUCEL', 'IDECABTAGENE VICLEUCEL')

prompt: Provide a total number of scheduled Optime cases for Urology Attendings booked by the provided HIS log-on.
completion: SELECT DISTINCT OC_CASE_ID CASE_ID, OC_SURG_DTE SURG_DATE, OC_OR_CASE_STS CASE_STS, UN.CLE_USER_ID USERID, UN.CLE_NAME USER_NAME, MD.CRE_RES_NAME AS SURGEON, CASE WHEN POA.OU_LOGON_ID IS NOT NULL THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS POA_IND, CASE WHEN OC_SURG_DTE BETWEEN '2008-10-01' AND '2008-12-31' THEN '2008-Q4' WHEN OC_SURG_DTE BETWEEN '2009-01-01' AND '2009-03-31' THEN '2009-Q1' ELSE '2009-Q2' END AS RPT_QTR FROM IDB.OR_CASE JOIN IDB.OR_CASE_ALL_SURG ON OC_CASE_ID = OCAS_CASE_ID AND OCAS_SURG_ROLE = 'Primary' AND OCAS_PNL_NO = 1 AND OCAS_SURG_SVC = 'URO' JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE MD ON OCAS_RES_ID = MD.CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_USER UN ON OC_CR_USER_ID = UN.CLE_USER_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_USER POA ON OC_CR_USER_ID = POA.OU_LOGON_ID AND(POA.OU_LOGON_ID IN ('045831', '049825', '061689', '106781', '145102', '215806', '222554', '301150', '322701', '328583', '349183', '359653', '416909', '428565', '430017', '499269') OR POA.OU_OCCUPATION = 'POA') WHERE OC_SURG_DTE BETWEEN '2008-10-01' AND '2009-06-30' WITH UR

prompt: Provide a report that includes all MPN patients seen at MSK from 2021 to assess MPN programmatic growth.
completion: WITH X AS (SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN AS MRN, CPP_PT_NAME, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, CPP_CITY, CPP_STATE, CPP_ZIP_CD, CPE_ENC_DTE, CRE_RES_NAME, CLD_CLD_CENTER, CLD_DEPT_NAME, CASE WHEN IIC_CATCHMENT IS NULL OR IIC_CATCHMENT = 'Out of Catchment' THEN STRIP('Out of Catchment') ELSE STRIP(IIC_CATCHMENT) END AS "Catchment Area", CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID JOIN IDB.CL_PAS_PATIENT ON CPP_PRK = CPE_PRK JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON CPE_MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.ZIPCODE ON LEFT(PT_ZIP_CD, 5) = ZC_ZIP LEFT JOIN IDB.ID_IP_IWT_CATCHMENT ON ZC_ZIP = IIC_ZIP_CD WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CRE_RES_TYP IN ('Physician') AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN '2021-01-01' AND CURRENT date AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 = 'LEU' ) , CC AS (SELECT TM_MRN AS MRN, TM_DX_DTE AS DX_DATE, TM_HIST_CD AS DX_CODE, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS DX_DESC FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM H ON TM_HIST_CD = H.CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON TM_SITE_CD = S.CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND TM_HIST_CD IN ('M9960/1', 'M9960/3', 'M9962/3', 'M9950/1', 'M9950/3', 'M9932/3', 'M9975/1') UNION SELECT CC_MRN AS MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS DX_DATE, CLM_CLSF_CD AS DX_CODE, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS DX_DESC FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND ((CC_PT_TYPE = 'I') OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) AND CC_CLSF_CD IN ('238.71', '238.4', 'D75.81', '289.83', 'D47.1', 'D47.3') GROUP BY CC_MRN, CLM_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK ) , CC1 AS (SELECT MRN AS DX_MRN, DX_DATE, STRIP(DX_CODE) || '-' || STRIP(DX_DESC) AS DX_CODE FROM CC) , CC2 AS (SELECT * FROM CC1 ORDER BY DX_MRN, DX_DATE, DX_CODE) , C1 AS (SELECT DX_MRN, DX_DATE, DX_CODE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY DX_MRN ORDER BY DX_DATE) AS RN FROM CC2 ORDER BY DX_MRN, DX_DATE) , C4 AS (SELECT DX_MRN AS MRN, LISTAGG(COALESCE(STRIP(CAST(DX_DATE AS VARCHAR(1000))), '') || ' | ' || COALESCE(STRIP(CAST(DX_CODE AS VARCHAR(1000))), '') , CHR(13) || CHR(10)) WITHIN GROUP( ORDER BY DX_MRN, DX_DATE, DX_CODE) AS DX1 FROM C1 GROUP BY DX_MRN) , METS AS (SELECT CC_MRN, CLM_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS INIT_EFF_DATE FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND ((CC_PT_TYPE = 'I') OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) AND (CC_CLSF_CD BETWEEN '196' AND '198.99' OR CC_CLSF_CD BETWEEN 'C77' AND 'C79.99') AND CC_MRN IN (SELECT MRN FROM X) GROUP BY CC_MRN, CLM_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK ) , CTE AS (SELECT CC_MRN AS DX_MRN, STRIP(CLM_CLSF_CD) || '-' || STRIP(CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK) AS DX_CODE FROM METS) , CTE2 AS (SELECT * FROM CTE ORDER BY DX_MRN, DX_CODE) , T1 AS (SELECT DX_MRN, DX_CODE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY DX_MRN ORDER BY DX_CODE) AS RN FROM CTE2 ORDER BY DX_MRN) , T2 (MRN, DX, RN1) AS (SELECT DX_MRN, CAST(DX_CODE AS VARCHAR(6000)), RN FROM T1 WHERE T1.RN = 1 UNION ALL SELECT DX_MRN, RTRIM(CAST(DX AS VARCHAR(4000))) || ', ' || CHR(13) || CHR(10) ||RTRIM(CAST(DX_CODE AS VARCHAR(100))) , RN1 + 1 FROM T1, T2 WHERE DX_MRN = MRN AND RN = RN1+1 ) , T3 AS (SELECT MRN, MAX(RN1) RN FROM T2 GROUP BY MRN) , T4 AS (SELECT T2.MRN, RN, DX FROM T2 JOIN T3 ON T2.MRN = T3.MRN AND T2.RN1 = T3.RN) , Y AS (SELECT DISTINCT X.*, DX AS SECONDARY, DX1 FROM X JOIN C4 ON X.MRN = C4.MRN LEFT JOIN T4 ON X.MRN = T4.MRN) , Z AS (SELECT CPE_MRN, MAX(CPE_ENC_DTE) AS "Late Visit Date" FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID JOIN IDB.CL_PAS_PATIENT ON CPP_PRK = CPE_PRK JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON CPE_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CRE_RES_TYP IN ('Physician') AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN '2021-01-01' AND CURRENT date AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 = 'LEU' GROUP BY CPE_MRN ) SELECT DISTINCT Y.*, "Late Visit Date" FROM Y LEFT JOIN Z ON Y.MRN = Z.CPE_MRN

prompt:
Patients that received Vocal fold injections from Jan 2018-Jan 2020

Billing codes: 31574, 31570, 31571
completion: SELECT PBD_MRN MRN, PT_LAST_NAME LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME FIRST_NAME, PT_SEX_DESC SEX, PT_RACE_DESC RACE, PT_PT_ETHNICITY_DESC ETHNICITY, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH DOB, PBD_SVC_DTE SVC_DTE, PT_DATE_OF_DEATH DOD, PBI_SVC_LOC SVC_LOCATION, DOC_NAME, DOC_SVC , PBC_CPT_CD CPTCD, PBC_PBD_DESC SVC_DESC, DX_CLSF_CD DX_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK DX_DESC FROM IDB.PBD_DTL JOIN IDB.PATIENT_V ON PBD_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.PBD_INVOICE ON PBD_MRN = PBI_MRN AND PBD_ACCT_NO = PBI_ACCT_NO AND PBD_INV_NO = PBI_INV_NO JOIN IDB.PBD_CODE ON PBD_PBD_CD = PBC_PBD_CD JOIN IDB.DOC ON PBI_PERFORM_DR_NO = DOC_DR_NO JOIN IDB.PBD_DX ON DX_MRN = PBI_MRN AND DX_ACCT_NO = PBI_ACCT_NO AND DX_INV_NO = PBI_INV_NO JOIN IDB.CLM ON DX_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE PBD_SVC_DTE BETWEEN '2018-01-01' AND '2020-01-31' AND PBC_CPT_CD IN ('31574', '31570', '31571')

prompt: Provide a weekly list of PDAC, GI cancer patients scheduled for a CT scan at main campus and BAIC.
completion: WITH DX AS (SELECT CC_MRN AS DX_MRN, CC_EFF_DTE AS DX_EFF_DTE, CC_CLSF_CD AS DX_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS DX_DESC, ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY CC_MRN ORDER BY CC_EFF_DTE DESC) AS DX_RANK FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE SUBSTR(CC_CLSF_CD, 1, 3) IN ('209', 'C7A', '159', 'C26', '154', 'C19', 'C20', 'C21', '157', 'C25', '153', 'C18', '150', 'C15') AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' ) , METS AS (SELECT CC_MRN AS METS_MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS METS_EFF_DTE, CC_CLSF_CD AS METS_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS METS_DESC FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN DX ON CC_MRN = DX_MRN WHERE CC_CLSF_CD IN ('197.7', 'C78.7') AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' GROUP BY CC_MRN, CC_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK ) , APPTS AS (SELECT CPE_MRN AS "MRN", CPE_ENC_DTE AS "Appt Date", CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 AS "Department", CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 AS "Service", CLD_DEPT_NAME AS "Department Name", CRE_RES_NAME AS "Provider Name", CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME AS "Visit Type", CLD_CLD_CENTER FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID JOIN DX ON DX_MRN = CPE_MRN WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Sch', 'Comp', 'Arrived') AND CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME IN ('CT ABDOMEN/PELVIS W/ CONTRAST', 'CT CHEST/ABD/PELVIS W/CONTRAST') AND CLD_DEPT_NAME IN ('RADIOLOGY (ADV) 1275', 'RADIOLOGY (ADV) 53', 'RADIOLOGY (ADV)300 E66') AND CPE_APPT_MADE_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT date - 7 DAYS AND CURRENT date ) , CT AS (SELECT DISTINCT "MRN", "t2"."RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE" AS "Radiology Performed Date", "t2"."RRPT_ACCESSION_NO" AS "Radiology Accession Number", "t2"."RRPT_REPORT_DTE" AS "Radiology Report Date", "t2"."RRPT_ORDER_GROUP" AS "Radiology Order Group", "t2"."RRPT_PROCEDURE_NAME" AS "Radiology Procedure Name", "t2"."RRPT_ANC_CODE" AS "Radiology Ancillary Code", "t2"."RRPT_REQUESTER" AS "Radiology Order Requester", CASE WHEN LENGTH(RRPT_REPORT_TXT) <= 15000 THEN RTRIM(CAST(SUBSTR(RRPT_REPORT_TXT, 1, 15000) AS VARCHAR(15000))) ELSE CAST(SUBSTR(RRPT_REPORT_TXT, 1, 15000) AS VARCHAR(15000)) END "PRPT_REPORT", ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY "MRN" ORDER BY "t2"."RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE" DESC) AS CT_RANK FROM APPTS LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V" "t1" ON "t1"."PT_MRN" = "MRN" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED" "t3" ON "t1"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t3"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."RADIOLOGY_REPORT_V" "t2" ON "t3"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t2"."RRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_IDENTIFICATION_MRN_V" "t4" ON "t1"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t4"."PI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" WHERE ("t2"."RRPT_ORDER_GROUP" = 'CT') ) , FINAL2 AS (SELECT "MRN", "Radiology Procedure Name", "Radiology Accession Number", "Radiology Performed Date", "PRPT_REPORT", POSITION('IMPRESSION:', "PRPT_REPORT", CODEUNITS32) AS POS1, POSITION('FINAL REPORT', "PRPT_REPORT", CODEUNITS32) AS POS2, CT_RANK FROM CT) , FINAL3 AS (SELECT FINAL2.*, REPLACE(SUBSTRING(CAST(UPPER("PRPT_REPORT") AS VARCHAR(32000)), POS1, ABS(POS2 - POS1), CODEUNITS32), ' ', '') AS TXT FROM FINAL2) SELECT DISTINCT A."MRN", PT_LAST_NAME "PT Last Name", PT_FIRST_NAME "PT First Name", DX_DESC "Dx", "Appt Date", "Department", "Service", "Department Name", "Provider Name", "Visit Type", MIN(METS_EFF_DTE) AS "Mets Dx Date", TXT AS "Most Recent Impression", CASE WHEN (LOWER(TXT) like '%metastasis%' OR LOWER(TXT) like '%metastases%') THEN 'Y' END AS "Mets in impressions" FROM APPTS A LEFT JOIN METS ON A."MRN" = METS_MRN LEFT JOIN FINAL3 F ON A."MRN" = F."MRN" AND CT_RANK = 1 JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON A."MRN" = PT_MRN JOIN DX ON A."MRN" = DX_MRN AND DX_RANK = 1 GROUP BY A."MRN", PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, DX_DESC, "Appt Date", "Department", "Service", "Department Name", "Provider Name", "Visit Type", TXT ;

prompt: Pathology reports from 2016-01-01 - 2019-09-10 containing search terms and H or S specimen classes
completion: SELECT PRPT_MRN "MRN", RTRIM(PT_FIRST_NAME) || ', ' || PT_LAST_NAME AS "Patient name", PRPT_PROCEDURE_DTE "Procedure date", PRPT_REPORT_DTE "Report date", PRPT_REPORT_TYPE_DESC "Report type", PRPT_ACCESSION_NO "Accession no", PRPT_REPORT "Path report" FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PRPT_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE PRPT_REPORT IS NOT NULL AND LEFT(PRPT_ACCESSION_NO, 1) IN ('H', 'S') AND PRPT_REPORT_DTE BETWEEN '2016-01-01' AND '2019-09-10' AND NOT CONTAINS(PRPT_REPORT, '("bone marrow biopsy")') = 1 AND CONTAINS(PRPT_REPORT, '("myeloid leukemia")') = 1 ;

prompt: Patients treated at MSK between 2008 and present with lung/bronchus neoplasm (diagnosis) plus small cell carcinoma (histology).
completion: SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN "MRN", PT_LAST_NAME "Last Name", PT_FIRST_NAME "First Name", PT_SEX "Gender", PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH "Date of Birth", PT_DATE_OF_DEATH "Date of Death", PLA_LST_APPT_DTE "Last Appt Date", TM_DX_DTE "Diagnosis Date", TM_HIST_CD "Histology Code", H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK "Histology Description", TM_SITE_CD "Site Code", S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK "Site Description", TM_BEST_AJCC_STG "AJCC Best Stage", STAGE.AV_DESC "AJCC Stage" FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON TM_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY ON PT_MRN = PLA_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS STAGE ON TM_AJCC = STAGE.AV_CODE AND STAGE.AV_ELEMENT = 'AJCC' WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND TM_SITE_CD LIKE 'C34%' AND TM_DX_DTE >= '2008-01-01' AND TM_HIST_CD IN ('M8041/2', 'M8041/3', 'M8042/3', 'M8043/3', 'M8045/3') ORDER BY 1 DESC, 8 ; WITH DX AS (SELECT DISTINCT TM_MRN FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND TM_SITE_CD LIKE 'C34%' AND TM_DX_DTE >= '2008-01-01' AND TM_HIST_CD IN ('M8041/2', 'M8041/3', 'M8042/3', 'M8043/3', 'M8045/3') ) , SRG AS (SELECT SSE_MRN, SSE_SURG_DTE, SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD, SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC, SSP_SURG_SVC_CD FROM IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE ON SSE_LOG_ID = SSP_LOG_ID AND SSE_ENC_CSN_ID = SSP_ENC_CSN_ID JOIN DX ON SSE_MRN = TM_MRN WHERE (SSE_SURG_LOC not like '%IR%' AND SSE_SURG_LOC not like '%ENDO%' AND SSE_SOURCE_TYPE <> 'E') AND SSE_SURG_DTE >= '2008-01-01' ) SELECT TM_MRN "MRN", PT_LAST_NAME "Last Name", PT_FIRST_NAME "First Name", PT_SEX "Gender", PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH "Date of Birth", PT_DATE_OF_DEATH "Date of Death", PLA_LST_APPT_DTE "Last Appt Date", SSE_SURG_DTE "Surgery Date", SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD "CPT Code", SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC "CPT Description", SSP_SURG_SVC_CD "Service" FROM DX JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON TM_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY ON PT_MRN = PLA_MRN LEFT JOIN SRG ON TM_MRN = SSE_MRN ORDER BY 1 DESC, 8, 9 ; WITH DX AS (SELECT DISTINCT TM_MRN FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND TM_SITE_CD LIKE 'C34%' AND TM_DX_DTE >= '2008-01-01' AND TM_HIST_CD IN ('M8041/2', 'M8041/3', 'M8042/3', 'M8043/3', 'M8045/3') ) , CHEMO AS (SELECT APR_MRN, APR_GENERIC_NAME "Chemo", MIN(APR_START_DTE) "First Start Date", MAX(APR_START_DTE) "Last Start Date", COUNT(*) "Count" FROM IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX JOIN IDB.CHEMO_DRUG_GENERIC ON APR_GENERIC_NAME = CDG_GENERIC_NAME JOIN DX ON APR_MRN = TM_MRN WHERE CDG_CHEMO_FLAG = 'Y' AND APR_START_DTE >= '2008-01-01' GROUP BY APR_MRN, APR_GENERIC_NAME ) SELECT TM_MRN "MRN", PT_LAST_NAME "Last Name", PT_FIRST_NAME "First Name", PT_SEX "Gender", PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH "Date of Birth", PT_DATE_OF_DEATH "Date of Death", PLA_LST_APPT_DTE "Last Appt Date", "Chemo", "First Start Date", "Last Start Date", "Count" FROM DX JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON TM_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY ON PT_MRN = PLA_MRN LEFT JOIN CHEMO ON TM_MRN = APR_MRN ORDER BY 1 DESC, 8, 9 ; WITH DX AS (SELECT DISTINCT TM_MRN FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND TM_SITE_CD LIKE 'C34%' AND TM_DX_DTE >= '2008-01-01' AND TM_HIST_CD IN ('M8041/2', 'M8041/3', 'M8042/3', 'M8043/3', 'M8045/3') ) , RAD AS (SELECT DISTINCT RTC_TX_MRN, RTC_TX_START_DTE, RTC_TX_STOP_DTE, RTC_TX_PLAN_NAME, RTC_TX_DELIVERED_DOSE, RTC_TX_DELIVERED_FRACTIONS FROM IDB.RADONC_TREATMENT_COURSE JOIN DX ON RTC_TX_MRN = TM_MRN JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON RTC_TX_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE RTC_TX_START_DTE >= '2008-01-01' ) SELECT TM_MRN "MRN", PT_LAST_NAME "Last Name", PT_FIRST_NAME "First Name", PT_SEX "Gender", PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH "Date of Birth", PT_DATE_OF_DEATH "Date of Death", PLA_LST_APPT_DTE "Last Appt Date", RTC_TX_START_DTE "Radiation Start", RTC_TX_STOP_DTE "Radiation Stop", RTC_TX_PLAN_NAME "Radiation Site", RTC_TX_DELIVERED_DOSE "Delivered Dose", RTC_TX_DELIVERED_FRACTIONS "Delivered Fractions" FROM DX JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON TM_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY ON PT_MRN = PLA_MRN LEFT JOIN RAD ON TM_MRN = RTC_TX_MRN ORDER BY 1 DESC, 8, 9

prompt: Provide all Hormone, Endocrine drugs and immunotherapy details of pituitary/skull base tumor patients who are seen or operated in Neurosurgery since 2021.
completion: WITH SURG AS (SELECT DISTINCT SSE_MRN, SSE_SURG_DTE, SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD, SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC, SSP_SURG_LAST_NM, SSP_SURG_FIRST_NM, SSP_SURG_SVC_CD FROM IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE ON SSE_LOG_ID = SSP_LOG_ID AND SSE_ENC_CSN_ID = SSP_ENC_CSN_ID WHERE (SSE_SURG_LOC not like '%IR%' AND SSE_SURG_LOC not like '%ENDO%' AND SSE_SOURCE_TYPE <> 'E') AND SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD IN ('20926', '61510', '61548', '61580', '61781', '62165') AND SSP_SURG_SVC_CD = 'NEURO' AND SSE_SURG_DTE >= '2021-01-01' ) , ANTINEO AS (SELECT DISTINCT SSE_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, SSE_SURG_DTE AS "Surgery Date", SSP_SURG_SVC_CD, MIN(APR_START_DTE) OVER (PARTITION BY SSE_MRN) AS MIN_APR_START_DTE, MAX(APR_END_DTE) OVER (PARTITION BY SSE_MRN) AS MAX_APR_END_DTE, CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME, APR_GENERIC_NAME, APR_ORD_RX_TYPE, APR_DOSE_UOM, APR_PRESCRIBED_DOSE, APR_TOTAL_GIVEN_DOSE, APR_QTY, APR_PERFORMED_ORDERS_QTY_TEXT, APR_ROUTE, APR_FREQ AS "Schedule", APR_DURATION FROM SURG JOIN IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX ON SSE_MRN = APR_MRN JOIN IDB.CHEMO_DRUG_GENERIC ON APR_GENERIC_NAME = CDG_GENERIC_NAME LEFT JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON SSE_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE APR_DRUG_PROCESS_STAGE <> 'H' AND UPPER(CDG_DRUG_TYPE) = 'ANTINEOPLASTICS' ) SELECT * FROM ANTINEO ;

prompt: Provide a list of patients on immune checkpoint inhibitors who had psoriasiform rash and received infliximab or prednisone
completion: WITH INIT AS (SELECT APR_MRN, APR_START_DTE, APR_END_DTE, MIN(APR_START_DTE) OVER( ORDER BY APR_MRN) AS "MIN_APR_START_DTE", MAX(APR_END_DTE) OVER( ORDER BY APR_MRN) AS "MAX_APR_END_DTE", CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME, APR_GENERIC_NAME FROM IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX JOIN IDB.CHEMO_DRUG_GENERIC ON APR_GENERIC_NAME = CDG_GENERIC_NAME WHERE APR_START_DTE BETWEEN '2017-03-01' AND '2022-12-22' AND CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME IN ('IPILIMUMAB', 'PEMBROLIZUMAB', 'NIVOLUMAB', 'CEMIPLIMAB', 'ATEZOLIZUMAB', 'AVELUMAB', 'DURVALUMAB') ) , CLINDOC AS (SELECT DISTINCT CDD_MRN AS "MRN", ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY CDD_MRN ORDER BY CDD_SERVICE_DTE ASC) AS RN, CDD_SERVICE_DTE, APR_START_DTE, APR_END_DTE, "MIN_APR_START_DTE", "MAX_APR_END_DTE", CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME, APR_GENERIC_NAME, CDO_SECTION AS "Section", CDO_ITEM_NAME AS "Item", CDO_VALUE_TEXT AS "Value", CASE WHEN LOWER(CDO_VALUE_TEXT) LIKE ('%psoriasis%') THEN 'YES' ELSE 'NO' END AS "psoriasis", CASE WHEN LOWER(CDO_VALUE_TEXT) LIKE ('%psoriasiform%') THEN 'YES' ELSE 'NO' END AS "psoriasiform", CASE WHEN LOWER(CDO_VALUE_TEXT) LIKE ('%lichenoid%') THEN 'YES' ELSE 'NO' END AS "lichenoid" FROM INIT JOIN IDB.CD_DOCUMENT ON APR_MRN = CDD_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION ON CDD_DOC_GUID = CDO_DOC_GUID AND CDD_AUTHORED_DTE = CDO_AUTHORED_DTE AND CDO_VALUE_TEXT <> '' WHERE CDD_CANCEL_IND <> '1' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND <> '1' AND (LOWER(CDO_VALUE_TEXT) LIKE '%psoriasis%' OR LOWER(CDO_VALUE_TEXT) LIKE '%psoriasiform%' OR LOWER(CDO_VALUE_TEXT) LIKE '%lichenoid%') ), CLINDOC1 AS (SELECT * FROM CLINDOC WHERE RN = 1) , MED AS (SELECT DISTINCT HCPR_MRN, CDD_SERVICE_DTE, APR_START_DTE, APR_END_DTE , "MIN_APR_START_DTE" , "MAX_APR_END_DTE" , CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME , APR_GENERIC_NAME , "Value" , "psoriasis" , "psoriasiform" , "lichenoid" , DATE(HCPR_START_DT) AS S_DT , DATE(HCPR_END_DT) AS E_DT , MIN(DATE(HCPR_START_DT)) OVER(PARTITION BY HCPR_MRN) AS "MIN_START_DATE" , MAX(DATE(HCPR_END_DT)) OVER(PARTITION BY HCPR_MRN) AS "MAX_END_DATE" , HCPR_DRUG_NAME AS DRUG_NAME , HGN_GENERIC_NAME AS GENERIC_NAME, HCPR_PRESCRIPTION_TYPE FROM CLINDOC1 JOIN IDB.HML_CLIENT_PRESCRIPTION ON "MRN" = HCPR_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.HML_GENERIC_NAME ON HGN_GENERIC_NAME_ID = HCPR_GENERIC_NAME_ID WHERE HCPR_STATUS_TYPE NOT IN (4, 5, 8) AND HCPR_CREATED_DTE IS NOT NULL AND((HCPR_PRESCRIPTION_TYPE = 1 AND HCPR_TRANSMISSION_STATUS IN (1, 2, 5) ) OR HCPR_PRESCRIPTION_TYPE = 3) AND (UPPER(HCPR_DRUG_NAME) LIKE '%INFLIXIMAB%' OR UPPER(HCPR_DRUG_NAME) LIKE '%PREDNISONE%' OR UPPER(HGN_GENERIC_NAME) LIKE '%INFLIXIMAB%' OR UPPER(HGN_GENERIC_NAME) LIKE '%PREDNISONE%' ) ) , MAIN AS (SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN AS MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_SEX, R.AV_DESC AS "Race", E.AV_DESC AS "Ethnicity" FROM MED JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON HCPR_MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS R ON PT_RACE = R.AV_CODE AND R.AV_ELEMENT = 'RACE' LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS E ON PT_PT_ETHNICITY = E.AV_CODE AND E.AV_ELEMENT = 'PT_ETHNICITY') , ANTINEO AS (SELECT DISTINCT MRN, CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME, APR_GENERIC_NAME, APR_START_DTE, APR_END_DTE FROM MAIN JOIN MED ON MRN = HCPR_MRN) , ERX_MED AS (SELECT DISTINCT MRN, DRUG_NAME, GENERIC_NAME, S_DT AS START_DT, E_DT AS END_DT, CDD_SERVICE_DTE, "psoriasis", "psoriasiform", "lichenoid" FROM MAIN JOIN MED ON MRN = HCPR_MRN) SELECT * FROM ERX_MED ;

prompt: Create a quarterly report for patients who are "on-study" on one of the specified protocols and are turning 18 years old in the upcoming quarter.
completion: SELECT AC_IRB_NO IRB_NO, AC_MRN MRN, AC_LAST_NAME LAST_NAME, AC_FIRST_NAME FIRST_NAME, AC_DOB DOB , (AC_DOB + 18 YEAR) AS BD_18, AC_CONS_DTE CONSENT_DTE, AC_CONS_STAFF_NAME CONSENTING_NAME, ACD_OFF_STUDY_DTE OFF_STUDY FROM IDB.ACCRUALS JOIN IDB.ACCRUALS_DATES ON AC_IRB_NO = ACD_IRB_NO AND AC_SUBJ_ID_NO = ACD_SUBJ_ID_NO AND AC_SUBJ_SEQ_NO = ACD_SUBJ_SEQ_NO WHERE AC_IRB_NO IN ('05-065', '06-125', '07-035', '07-055', '08-008', '08-031', '08-060', '09-072', '10-050', '10-164', '11-164', '11-038', '11-130', '12-053', '12-086', '95-024', '11-164', '08-047', '10-150', '11-067') AND ACD_OFF_STUDY_DTE IS NULL AND AC_DOB + 18 YEAR >= CURRENT DATE - DAY(CURRENT DATE - 1 MONTHS)DAYS + 1 DAYS AND AC_DOB + 18 YEAR <= LAST_DAY(CURRENT DATE + 3 MONTHS)

prompt: Researching predicting metastatic events and obtaining histology from breast pathology reports
completion: WITH PATHOLOGY_0 AS (SELECT "DV"."PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V"."PRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AS PT_DEID, "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_MRN" AS PT_MRN, "DV"."PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V"."PRPT_PATH_RPT_ID" AS SUBJECT_ID, "DV"."PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V"."PRPT_REPORT_TYPE_DESC" AS PATH_RPT_TYPE FROM "DV"."PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V" JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS" ON "DV"."PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V"."PRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" WHERE "DV"."PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V"."PRPT_REPORT_TYPE_DESC" IN ('Surgical Pathology Breast')), COHORT AS (SELECT PT_DEID AS PT_DEID FROM (SELECT PATHOLOGY_0.PT_DEID AS PT_DEID FROM PATHOLOGY_0)), COHORT_PATHOLOGY AS (SELECT SUBJECT_ID AS SUBJECT_ID, PT_DEID AS PT_DEID FROM (SELECT PATHOLOGY_0.SUBJECT_ID AS SUBJECT_ID, PATHOLOGY_0.PT_DEID AS PT_DEID FROM PATHOLOGY_0)), KEYS AS (SELECT COHORT.PT_DEID AS COHORT_PT_DEID, COHORT_PATHOLOGY.SUBJECT_ID AS COHORT_PATHOLOGY_SUBJECT_ID, COHORT_PATHOLOGY.PT_DEID AS COHORT_PATHOLOGY_PT_DEID FROM COHORT LEFT OUTER JOIN COHORT_PATHOLOGY ON COHORT_PATHOLOGY.PT_DEID = COHORT.PT_DEID), DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS AS (SELECT DISTINCT "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AS PT_DEID, "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_MRN" AS PT_MRN, "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AS SUBJECT_ID, DMP_ID_TBL."PDRX_DMP_PATIENT_ID" AS DMP_ID, TRIM("DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_LAST_NAME") || ', ' || TRIM("DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_FIRST_NAME") AS PT_NAME, "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_SEX_DESC" AS GENDER, "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_VITAL_STATUS" AS VITAL_STATS, "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_BIRTH_DTE" AS DATE_OF_BIRTH, "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_DEATH_DTE" AS DATE_OF_DEATH, ALLOWVALS_RACE."AV_DESC" AS RACE, ALLOWVALS_ETHNICITY."AV_DESC" AS ETHNICITY, ALLOWVALS_LANGUAGE."AV_DESC" AS PRIMARY_LANGUAGE, "DV".PATIENT_LATEST_ACTIVITY."PLA_LAST_ACTV_DTE" AS LAST_ACTIVITY_DATE, "DV".PATIENT_LATEST_ACTIVITY."PLA_LAST_CONTACT_DTE" AS LAST_CONTACT_DATE FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS" LEFT OUTER JOIN "DV"."PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML" AS DMP_ID_TBL ON DMP_ID_TBL."PDRX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT OUTER JOIN "IDB"."PATIENT" AS IDB_PATIENT ON "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_MRN" = IDB_PATIENT."PT_MRN" LEFT OUTER JOIN "IDB"."ALLOWVALS" AS ALLOWVALS_RACE ON IDB_PATIENT."PT_RACE" = ALLOWVALS_RACE."AV_CODE" AND ALLOWVALS_RACE."AV_ELEMENT" = 'RACE' LEFT OUTER JOIN "IDB"."ALLOWVALS" AS ALLOWVALS_ETHNICITY ON IDB_PATIENT."PT_PT_ETHNICITY" = ALLOWVALS_ETHNICITY."AV_CODE" AND ALLOWVALS_ETHNICITY."AV_ELEMENT" = 'PT_ETHNICITY' LEFT OUTER JOIN "IDB"."ALLOWVALS" AS ALLOWVALS_LANGUAGE ON IDB_PATIENT."PT_PRIMARY_LANG" = ALLOWVALS_LANGUAGE."AV_CODE" AND ALLOWVALS_LANGUAGE."AV_ELEMENT" = 'PRIMARY_LANG' LEFT OUTER JOIN "DV".PATIENT_LATEST_ACTIVITY ON "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "DV".PATIENT_LATEST_ACTIVITY."PLA_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID") SELECT DISTINCT DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS.PT_MRN AS MRN, DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS.DMP_ID AS DMP_ID, DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS.PT_NAME AS PT_NAME, DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS.GENDER AS GENDER, DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS.VITAL_STATS AS VITAL_STATUS, DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS.DATE_OF_BIRTH AS DATE_OF_BIRTH, DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS.DATE_OF_DEATH AS DATE_OF_DEATH, DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS.RACE AS RACE, DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS.ETHNICITY AS ETHNICITY, DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS.PRIMARY_LANGUAGE AS PRIMARY_LANGUAGE, DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS.LAST_ACTIVITY_DATE AS LAST_ACTIVITY_DATE, DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS.LAST_CONTACT_DATE AS LAST_CONTACT_DATE FROM KEYS LEFT OUTER JOIN DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS ON DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS.PT_DEID = KEYS.COHORT_PT_DEID; WITH PATHOLOGY_0 AS (SELECT "DV"."PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V"."PRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AS PT_DEID, "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_MRN" AS PT_MRN, "DV"."PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V"."PRPT_PATH_RPT_ID" AS SUBJECT_ID, "DV"."PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V"."PRPT_REPORT_TYPE_DESC" AS PATH_RPT_TYPE FROM "DV"."PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V" JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS" ON "DV"."PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V"."PRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" WHERE "DV"."PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V"."PRPT_REPORT_TYPE_DESC" IN ('Surgical Pathology Breast')), COHORT AS (SELECT PT_DEID AS PT_DEID FROM (SELECT PATHOLOGY_0.PT_DEID AS PT_DEID FROM PATHOLOGY_0)), 7 DAYS ) , ORDDATA AS (SELECT MRN , ORDER_NAME , OUO_ORD_GUID AS ORDER_GUID , ORDER_ENTER_DATE , ORDER_ENTER_TIME , DATE(CPE_CHK_IN_DT) AS CHECK_IN_DATE , TIME(CPE_CHK_IN_DT) AS CHECK_IN_TIME , ORDER_STATUS , STATUS_DATE , STATUS_TIME , OSH_MAINT_SUMLNE , OSH_ARRIVAL_DT FROM (SELECT DISTINCT OUO_MRN AS MRN , OUO_ORD_GUID , OUO_ORD_NAME AS ORDER_NAME , OUO_ENTER_DTE AS ORDER_ENTER_DATE , TIME(OUO_ENTER_DT) AS ORDER_ENTER_TIME , CPE_CHK_IN_DT , OSH_ARRIVAL_DT , date (OSH_ARRIVAL_DT) AS STATUS_DATE , TIME (OSH_ARRIVAL_DT) AS STATUS_TIME , OSH_ORD_GUID , OSH_ORD_STS_CD , OSTS_STS_DESC AS ORDER_STATUS , OSH_MAINT_SUMLNE , ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY OSH_ORD_GUID, OSH_ORD_STS_CD ORDER BY OSH_ARRIVAL_DT ASC) AS ROW_NUM FROM IDB.OMS_USER_ORDERS JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_STS_HX ON OUO_MRN = OSH_MRN AND OSH_ORD_GUID = OUO_ORD_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_STATUS ON OSH_ORD_STS_CD = OSTS_ORD_STS_CD JOIN APT ON CPE_MRN = OUO_MRN AND CPE_ENC_DTE = date (OSH_ARRIVAL_DT) WHERE 1=1 AND LOWER(OUO_ORD_NAME) = 'creatinine' AND OUO_ORD_STS_CD NOT IN ('CANP', 'CANC', 'AUC3') AND date (OSH_ARRIVAL_DT) >= CURRENT date - 7 DAYS ) AS X WHERE ROW_NUM = 1 ORDER BY OUO_ORD_GUID, STATUS_TIME ASC) , SPECCOLTD AS (SELECT DISTINCT MRN_COL , ORDER_GUID , DATE(OSH_ARRIVAL_TIMESTAMP) AS SPECIMEN_COLLECTED_DATE , TIME(OSH_ARRIVAL_TIMESTAMP) AS SPECIMEN_COLLECTED_TIME FROM (SELECT MRN AS MRN_COL , ORDER_GUID , MIN(HX.OSH_ARRIVAL_DT) AS OSH_ARRIVAL_TIMESTAMP FROM ORDDATA JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_STS_HX HX ON MRN = OSH_MRN AND HX.OSH_ORD_GUID= ORDER_GUID WHERE DATE (HX.OSH_ARRIVAL_DT) >= CURRENT DATE - TRIM(ICD_CD) || ' | ' || TRIM(ICD_DESC), CHR(13) || CHR(10)) WITHIN GROUP( ORDER BY MIN_ICD_EFF_DTE) AS ICD_DATA FROM (SELECT DISTINCT CC_MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS MIN_ICD_EFF_DTE, CC_CLSF_CD AS ICD_CD, CC_MRN, CC_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK ) A GROUP BY CC_MRN) AS ICD ON CC_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE COALESCE(TM_MRN, CC_MRN) IS NOT NULL ) , DX_FINAL AS (SELECT PT_MRN DX_MRN, TUMOR_REG_DATA, ICD_DATA FROM DX) , TX AS (SELECT APR_MRN, SUBSTR(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(CAST(XMLSERIALIZE(CONTENT XMLAGG(XMLELEMENT(NAME "C", '| '||DATE(APR_START_DTE) || ' | ' || DATE(APR_END_DTE) || ' | ' || '<C/>', ''), ',', ''), 1) AS CHEMO_TX FROM (SELECT DISTINCT APR_MRN, APR_START_DTE, APR_END_DTE, CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME, APR_PRESCRIBED_DOSE FROM IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX JOIN IDB.CHEMO_DRUG_GENERIC PRO_IRB_NO = '12-245' THEN ACD_CONS_DTE END) AS "12-245 Consent Date" FROM IDB.PROTOCOL JOIN IDB.ACCRUALS ON PRO_IRB_NO = AC_IRB_NO JOIN IDB.ACCRUALS_DATES ON AC_IRB_NO = ACD_IRB_NO AND AC_SUBJ_ID_NO completion: WITH APPTS AS (SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN AS MRN, CPE_ENC_CSN_ID, PT_LAST_NAME LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME FIRST_NAME, CPE_ENC_DTE AS APPT_DATE, TIME(CPE_APPT_DT) APPT_TIME, CLD_DEPT_NAME AS DEPT_NAME, CLD_CLD_CENTER LOCATION FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON CPE_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Sch') AND CPE_ENC_DTE = CURRENT date + 1 DAY AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 = 'PST' ) , ALLERGY AS (SELECT DISTINCT EA_ASSIGN_DT, EAS_ASSESS_STS, EA_SOURCE_ID, CPE_ENC_CSN_ID, EA_SURV_ID, EF_FORM_NAME, EF_FORM_ID, EF_SUBMISSION_DT, EF_MRN FROM IDB.EF_ASSESSMENT LEFT JOIN IDB.EF_FORM ON EF_FORM_EXTERNAL_ID = EA_ASSESS_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.EF_ASSESSMENT_STS ON EA_STS_ID = EAS_ASSESS_STS_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER ON CHAR(EA_SOURCE_ID) = CPE_ENC_CSN_ID WHERE EA_SURV_ID = 99 ) SELECT MRN, LAST_NAME, FIRST_NAME, APPT_DATE, APPT_TIME, DEPT_NAME, LOCATION, DATE(EA_ASSIGN_DT) ENGAGE_ASSIGN_DATE, DATE(EF_SUBMISSION_DT) ENGAGE_SUBMIT_DATE, EAS_ASSESS_STS ENGAGE_STATUS FROM APPTS APPTS LEFT JOIN ALLERGY ALLERGY ON APPTS.CPE_ENC_CSN_ID = ALLERGY.CPE_ENC_CSN_ID

PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) BETWEEN 15 AND 39 WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND TM_HIST_CD IN ('M9180/3', 'M9180/6', 'M9181/3', 'M9181/6', 'M9182/3', 'M9182/6', 'M9183/3', 'M9183/6', 'M9184/3', 'M9184/6', 'M9185/3', 'M9186/3', 'M9187/3', 'M9190/3', 'M9190/6', 'M9192/3', 'M9193/3', 'M9194/3', 'M9195/3') AND TM_DX_DTE BETWEEN '2007-01-01' AND '2023-05-10' ) , SET1_CHEMO AS (SELECT DISTINCT APR_MRN FROM IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX JOIN IDB.CHEMO_DRUG_GENERIC ON APR_GENERIC_NAME = CDG_GENERIC_NAME JOIN SET1 ON TM_MRN = APR_MRN WHERE 1=1 AND APR_START_DTE >= '2007-01-01' AND APR_END_DTE <='2023-05-10' AND CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME IN ('REGORAFENIB', 'LENVANTINIB', 'CABOZANTINIB', 'SORAFENIB', 'SUNITINIB') ) , SET2 AS (SELECT DISTINCT TM_MRN FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS ON AV_ELEMENT = 'CASE_STS' AND AV_CODE = TM_CASE_STS JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PT_MRN = TM_MRN AND YEAR(TM_DX_DTE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) BETWEEN 15 AND 39 WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND TM_HIST_CD IN ('M9040/3', 'M9041/3', 'M9042/3', 'M9043/3' ) AND TM_DX_DTE BETWEEN '2007-01-01' AND '2023-05-10' ), SET2_CHEMO AS (SELECT DISTINCT APR_MRN FROM IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX JOIN IDB.CHEMO_DRUG_GENERIC ON APR_GENERIC_NAME = CDG_GENERIC_NAME JOIN SET2 ON TM_MRN = APR_MRN WHERE 1=1 AND APR_START_DTE >= '2007-01-01' AND APR_END_DTE <='2023-05-10' AND CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME IN ('REGORAFENIB', 'LENVANTINIB', 'CABOZANTINIB', 'SORAFENIB', 'PAZOPANIB', 'SUNITINIB', 'AXITINIB') ) SELECT 'OSTEO-SARCOMA & Pneumothorax' AS DX_TYPE, COUNT(*) AS DX_COUNT FROM SET1_CHEMO WHERE APR_MRN IN (SELECT CC_MRN FROM PX) UNION SELECT 'OSTEO-SARCOMA & NO Pneumothorax' AS DX_TYPE, COUNT(*) AS DX_COUNT FROM SET1_CHEMO WHERE APR_MRN NOT IN (SELECT CC_MRN FROM PX ) UNION SELECT 'SYNOVIAL-SARCOMA & Pneumothorax ' AS DX_TYPE, COUNT(*) AS DX_COUNT FROM SET2_CHEMO WHERE APR_MRN IN (SELECT CC_MRN FROM PX) UNION SELECT 'SYNOVIAL-SARCOMA & NO Pneumothorax ' AS DX_TYPE, COUNT(*) AS DX_COUNT FROM SET2_CHEMO WHERE APR_MRN NOT IN (SELECT CC_MRN FROM PX)

prompt: Quarterly report of Plastic Surgery Inpatient Consults placed - by timestamp and month, and detailed view
completion: WITH ORDERS AS (SELECT OO_MRN, OO_ORD_GUID, OO_ENTER_DT, MONTH(OO_ENTER_DT) AS MONTH, HOUR(OO_ENTER_DT) AS HOUR FROM IDB.OMS_ORDER JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_CATALOG ON OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID = OOC_MSTR_ITEM_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_STATUS ON OO_ORD_STS_CD = OSTS_ORD_STS_CD WHERE OOC_ITEM_NAME IN ('Plastic Surgery Inpatient Consult') AND OO_ORD_STS_CD NOT IN ('CANP', 'CANC', 'AUC3') ) SELECT "Year", CASE WHEN MONTH = 1 THEN 'January' WHEN MONTH = 2 THEN 'February' WHEN MONTH = 3 THEN 'March' WHEN MONTH = 4 THEN 'April' WHEN MONTH = 5 THEN 'May' WHEN MONTH = 6 THEN 'June' WHEN MONTH = 7 THEN 'July' WHEN MONTH = 8 THEN 'August' WHEN MONTH = 9 THEN 'September' WHEN MONTH = 10 THEN 'October' WHEN MONTH = 11 THEN 'November' WHEN MONTH = 12 THEN 'December' END AS "Month", COUNT("6am to 6pm") AS "6am to 6pm", COUNT("6pm to 6am") AS "6pm to 6am", COUNT("6am to 6pm") + COUNT("6pm to 6am") AS "Total Count" FROM (SELECT YEAR(OO_ENTER_DT) AS "Year", OO_ENTER_DT, MONTH, HOUR, CASE WHEN HOUR BETWEEN 6 AND 18 THEN OO_ORD_GUID END AS "6am to 6pm", CASE WHEN HOUR BETWEEN 0 AND 5 OR HOUR BETWEEN 19 AND 23 THEN OO_ORD_GUID END AS "6pm to 6am" FROM ORDERS WHERE 1=1 AND DATE(OO_ENTER_DT) BETWEEN '2022-01-01' AND '2022-03-31' ) GROUP BY "Year", MONTH ORDER BY MONTH ; WITH ORDERS AS (SELECT OO_MRN, OO_ORD_GUID, OO_ENTER_DT, MONTH(OO_ENTER_DT) AS MONTH, HOUR(OO_ENTER_DT) AS HOUR FROM IDB.OMS_ORDER JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_CATALOG ON OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID = OOC_MSTR_ITEM_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_STATUS ON OO_ORD_STS_CD = OSTS_ORD_STS_CD WHERE OOC_ITEM_NAME IN ('Plastic Surgery Inpatient Consult') AND OO_ORD_STS_CD NOT IN ('CANP', 'CANC', 'AUC3') ) SELECT OO_MRN "MRN", PT_LAST_NAME "Last Name", PT_FIRST_NAME "First Name", OO_ENTER_DT "Order Enter Date" FROM ORDERS LEFT JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON OO_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE 1=1 AND DATE(OO_ENTER_DT) BETWEEN '2022-01-01' AND '2022-03-31'

prompt: Create a report which will provide the number of patients diagnosed with GIST at MSKCC broken down by year
completion: WITH "cte1" AS (SELECT DISTINCT "t1"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AS "Deident PT #", "t2"."DT_YEAR" AS "CDB Tumor Diagnosis Year" FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED" "t1" LEFT JOIN "DV"."CDB_TUMOR_V" "t3" ON "t1"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t3"."CDTM_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE" "t2" ON "t3"."CDTM_DX_DATE_ID" = "t2"."DT_DATE_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DIAGNOSIS_CODE_CAT_ICDO_V" "t4" ON "t3"."CDTM_DX_CATALOG_ID" = "t4"."DXCC_DX_CATALOG_ID" WHERE ("t4"."DXCC_ICD_CODE" IN ('M8936/0', 'M8936/1', 'M8936/3') AND "t2"."DT_YEAR" >= 2008) ) SELECT "t5"."CDB Tumor Diagnosis Year" AS "CDB Tumor Diagnosis Year", COUNT("t5"."Deident PT #") AS "COUNT (Deident PT #)", COUNT (DISTINCT("t5"."Deident PT #")) AS "UNIQUE COUNT (Deident PT #)" FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED" "t6" INNER JOIN "cte1" "t5" ON "t6"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t5"."Deident PT #" GROUP BY "t5"."CDB Tumor Diagnosis Year"

prompt: Provide a report of MSK patients in three age buckets, <15, 15-39 and 40-60 and their associated clinical trial enrollment.
completion: WITH PROTOCOL AS (SELECT DISTINCT AC_MRN FROM IDB.PROTOCOL JOIN IDB.ACCRUALS ON PRO_IRB_NO = AC_IRB_NO JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON AC_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE YEAR(AC_CONS_DTE) BETWEEN 2000 AND 2020 AND YEAR(AC_CONS_DTE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) BETWEEN 15 AND 39 ) , DX AS (SELECT DISTINCT TM_MRN, TM_DX_DTE, TM_HIST_CD, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS HIST_DESC, TM_SITE_CD, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_DESC FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD JOIN PROTOCOL ON TM_MRN = AC_MRN WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') ) , CTE AS (SELECT TM_MRN, TM_SITE_CD, SITE_DESC, TM_HIST_CD, HIST_DESC, YEAR(TM_DX_DTE) DX_YEAR FROM DX) SELECT DISTINCT A.PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID, A.PT_SEX, A.PT_RACE_DESC, E.AV_DESC AS PT_PT_ETHNICITY, A.PT_ZIP_CD, PRO_PROTOCOL_TYPE "Protocol Type", PRO_IRB_NO "IRB No", PRO_IRB_TITLE "IRB Title", PRO_IRB_STS_DESC "IRB Status", PRO_SPON_NAME "Sponsor Name", PRO_SPON_DPT_NAME "Sponsor Dept", YEAR(AC_CONS_DTE - PT_BIRTH_DTE) "Age", YEAR(AC_CONS_DTE) "Consent Year", DX_YEAR, TM_SITE_CD, SITE_DESC, TM_HIST_CD, HIST_DESC FROM IDB.PROTOCOL JOIN IDB.ACCRUALS ON PRO_IRB_NO = AC_IRB_NO JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS A ON AC_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.PATIENT B ON A.PT_MRN = B.PT_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS E ON E.AV_ELEMENT = 'PT_ETHNICITY' AND PT_PT_ETHNICITY = E. AV_CODE LEFT JOIN CTE ON AC_MRN = TM_MRN WHERE YEAR(AC_CONS_DTE) BETWEEN 2000 AND 2020 AND YEAR(AC_CONS_DTE - PT_BIRTH_DTE) BETWEEN 15 AND 39 ORDER BY 1

prompt: A list of Dr. Jahan Aghalar patients currently alive with diagnosis, chemotherapy, and appointment information.
completion: WITH PTS AS (SELECT CPE_MRN, PT_COUNTY, CPE_ENC_DTE, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8, CLD_DEPT_NAME, CRE_RES_NAME, CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME, PT_DEATH_IND, PT_DATE_OF_DEATH FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON
