DX_EFF_DTE, CC_CLSF_CD AS DX_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS DX_DESC FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN PTS ON CC_MRN = CPE_MRN WHERE 1=1 AND CLM_CLSF_CD IN ('C61', '185' ,'C67', 'C67.0', 'C67.1', 'C67.2', 'C67.3', 'C67.4', 'C67.5', 'C67.6', 'C67.7', 'C67.8', 'C67.9', '188', '188.0', '188.1', '188.2', '188.3', '188.4', '188.5', '188.6', '188.7', '188.8', '188.9' ,'C64', 'C64.1', 'C64.2', 'C64.9', 'C65', 'C65.1', 'C65.2', 'C65.9', '189', '189.0', '189.1' ,'C62', 'C62.0', 'C62.00', 'C62.01', 'C62.02', 'C62.1', 'C62.10', 'C62.11', 'C62.12', 'C62.9', 'C62.90', 'C62.91', 'C62.92', '186', '186.0', '186.9') AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' GROUP BY CC_MRN, CC_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK ) , FIRST_SEEN_DTE AS (SELECT B.CPE_MRN FSD_MRN, B.CPE_ENC_DTE FSD_CPE_ENC_DTE, D.CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 FSD_CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6, D.CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 FSD_CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8, D.CLD_DEPT_NAME FSD_CLD_DEPT_NAME, C.CRE_RES_NAME FSD_CRE_RES_NAME, C.CRE_RES_TYP FSD_CRE_RES_TYPE, E.CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME FSD_CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY B.CPE_MRN ORDER BY B.CPE_ENC_DTE ASC) AS FSD_ORDERING FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER B JOIN PTS A ON A.CPE_MRN = B.CPE_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE C ON B.CPE_VST_RES_ID = C.CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT D ON B.CPE_DEPT_ID = D.CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE E ON B.CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = E.CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE B.CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND D.CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 = 'MED' AND D.CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 IN ('GU', '') AND C.CRE_RES_TYP IN ('Physician', 'Nurse Practitioner') ) , LAST_SEEN_DTE AS (SELECT B.CPE_MRN LSD_MRN, B.CPE_ENC_DTE LSD_CPE_ENC_DTE, D.CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 LSD_CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6, D.CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 LSD_CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8, D.CLD_DEPT_NAME LSD_CLD_DEPT_NAME, C.CRE_RES_NAME LSD_CRE_RES_NAME, C.CRE_RES_TYP LSD_CRE_RES_TYPE, E.CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME LSD_CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY B.CPE_MRN ORDER BY B.CPE_ENC_DTE DESC) AS LSD_ORDERING FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER B JOIN PTS A ON A.CPE_MRN = B.CPE_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE C ON B.CPE_VST_RES_ID = C.CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT D ON B.CPE_DEPT_ID = D.CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE E ON B.CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = E.CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE B.CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND D.CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 = 'MED' AND D.CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 IN ('GU', '') AND C.CRE_RES_TYP IN ('Physician', 'Nurse Practitioner') ) , CHEMO AS (SELECT DISTINCT APR_MRN, SUBSTR(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(CAST(XMLSERIALIZE(CONTENT XMLAGG(XMLELEMENT(NAME "c", CHEMO_START_DTE || ' | ' || CHEMO_END_DTE|| ' | ' || APR_DRUG_NAME || CHR(13) || CHR(10)) ORDER BY CHEMO_START_DTE, APR_DRUG_NAME) AS CLOB(32000)) AS VARCHAR(32000)), '<c>', ','), '</c>', ''), '', ''), '<c/>', ''), ',', ''), 1) AS CHEMO FROM (SELECT APR_MRN, APR_DRUG_NAME, MIN(APR_START_DTE) AS CHEMO_START_DTE, MAX(APR_END_DTE) AS CHEMO_END_DTE FROM IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX WHERE 1=1 GROUP BY APR_MRN, APR_DRUG_NAME)A JOIN PTS ON CPE_MRN = APR_MRN WHERE 1=1 GROUP BY APR_MRN) , ACCRUALS AS (SELECT AC_MRN, LISTAGG(AC_IRB_NO, CHR(13) || CHR(10)) WITHIN GROUP( ORDER BY AC_MRN) AC_IRB_NO FROM (SELECT DISTINCT AC_MRN, AC_IRB_NO FROM IDB.ACCRUALS JOIN PTS ON CPE_MRN = AC_MRN) A GROUP BY AC_MRN) SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN "MRN", PT_COUNTY "County", DX_EFF_DTE "Dx Eff Dte", DX_DESC "Dx Description", FSD_CPE_ENC_DTE "First Seen Date", LSD_CPE_ENC_DTE "Last Seen Date", CHEMO "Chemo History", AC_IRB_NO "Protocols" FROM PTS LEFT JOIN DX ON CPE_MRN = CC_MRN LEFT JOIN FIRST_SEEN_DTE ON CPE_MRN = FSD_MRN AND FSD_ORDERING = 1 LEFT JOIN LAST_SEEN_DTE ON CPE_MRN = LSD_MRN AND LSD_ORDERING = 1 LEFT JOIN CHEMO ON APR_MRN = CPE_MRN LEFT JOIN ACCRUALS ON AC_MRN = CPE_MRN ;

prompt: Provide a list of PED_Path order sets and corresponding order details
completion: SELECT OO_MRN "MRN", PT_LAST_NAME "Last Name", PT_FIRST_NAME "First Name", OO_ENTER_DTE "Order Entered Date", OSH_CREATE_DTE AS "Order Release Date", OO_ORD_NAME "Order Name", OO_SET_NAME "Order Set Name", DOC_NAME "Requesting Doctor", OU_DISPLAY_NAME "Order Entered By" FROM IDB.OMS_ORDER LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_STS_HX ON OO_ORD_GUID = OSH_ORD_GUID AND OSH_FUNCTION_CD = '105' JOIN IDB.OMS_USER ON OO_USER_GUID = OU_USER_GUID JOIN IDB.DOC ON OO_REQ_DR_NO = DOC_DR_NO JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON OO_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE OO_SET_NAME IN ('PED_Path_Solid', 'PED_Path_Heme') AND OO_ENTER_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT date - 1 MONTH AND CURRENT date - 1 DAY

prompt: Provide a report of patients who had a Genetics Consult  or Miscellaneous Consult orders placed by or requested by a STBRE Physician for Q1 2012
completion: WITH ORD AS (SELECT OO_MRN MRN, OO_ACCT_NO ACCT_NO , STRIP(CL_LAST_NAME)||', '||STRIP(CL_FIRST_NAME)AS PT_NAME , OO_ENTER_DTE ORD_ENTER_DTE , OO_ORD_ID ORDID, OO_ORD_NAME ORD_NAME , ENT.OU_DISPLAY_NAME AS ENTERED_BY, ENT.OU_ORD_ROLE_TYPE AS ENT_ROLE , PVDR.OP_DISPLAY_NAME REQ_BY , PVDR.OP_PVDR_NO REQ_BY_NO , OUD_USER_DI_VALUE AS TYPE_OF_CONSULT FROM IDB.OMS_ORDER JOIN IDB.OMS_USER ENT ON OO_USER_GUID = ENT.OU_USER_GUID JOIN IDB.CL_PATIENT ON CL_MRN = OO_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_USER_DATA ON OO_ORD_GUID = OUD_ORD_GUID AND OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'Type of Consult:' LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_PROVIDER AS USR ON OO_USER_GUID = USR.OP_USER_GUID LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_PROVIDER AS PVDR ON OO_PVDR_GUID = PVDR.OP_PVDR_GUID WHERE OO_ORD_NAME IN ('Genetics Consult', 'Miscellaneous Consult') AND OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID IN ('2000004514073029', '2000002589073001') AND OO_ENTER_DTE >= CURRENT DATE - 4 MONTH - DAY(CURRENT DATE - 4 MONTHS)DAYS + 1 DAYS AND OO_ENTER_DTE <= LAST_DAY(CURRENT DATE - 2 MONTHS) AND OO_ORD_STS_CD not like 'CAN%' AND (USR.OP_PVDR_NO IN ('002618', '003285', '003715', '004135', '004812', '004861', '005314', '006403', '006825', '006890', '008128', '008292', '008771', '009936', '012294', '013151', '014589', '014696', '015370', '015511', '016121', '016246') OR PVDR.OP_PVDR_NO IN ('002618', '003285', '003715', '004135', '004812', '004861', '005314', '006403', '006825', '006890', '008128', '008292', '008771', '009936', '012294', '013151', '014589', '014696', '015370', '015511', '016121', '016246')) ) , VST AS (SELECT CPE_MRN MRN, CPE_ENC_DTE VST_DTE , CPE_CPE_APPT_STS VST_STS , ORD_ENTER_DTE , CLD_DEPT_NAME DEPT_NAME , CRE_RES_NAME VST_MD, CRE_RES_TYP, CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME, CVT_EXT_NAME VST_NAME FROM ORD JOIN IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER ON MRN = CPE_MRN AND CPE_ENC_DTE > ORD_ENTER_DTE JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID AND CRE_RES_ID IN ('002345', '006403', '010819') JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID) SELECT DISTINCT ORD.MRN, ORD.ACCT_NO, ORD.PT_NAME , ORD.ORD_ENTER_DTE, ORD.ORDID, ORD.ORD_NAME, ORD.TYPE_OF_CONSULT , ORD.ENTERED_BY, ORD.ENT_ROLE, ORD.REQ_BY, ORD.REQ_BY_NO , VST_DTE, VST_STS, DEPT_NAME, VST_MD, VST_NAME FROM ORD LEFT JOIN VST ON ORD.MRN = VST.MRN

prompt: Provide a list of all the patients with endometrial cancer who received lenvatinib and pembrolizumab
completion: WITH X AS (SELECT TM_MRN, B.AV_DESC AS CASE_STS, TM_DX_DTE, TM_HIST_CD, R.AV_DESC AS "Race", H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS HIST_DESC, TM_SITE_CD, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_DESC, TM_BEST_AJCC_STG FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON TM_MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS R ON PT_RACE = R.AV_CODE AND R.AV_ELEMENT = 'RACE' JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS B ON B.AV_ELEMENT = 'CASE_STS' AND B.AV_CODE = TM_CASE_STS WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND TM_SITE_CD LIKE 'C541%' ), X1 AS (SELECT DISTINCT OO_MRN AS MRN, MIN(OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE) START_DRUG_DATE, MAX(OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE) LAST_DRUG_DATE, OOC_ITEM_NAME, OO_ORD_NAME AS ORDER_NAME, OO_ORD_PRIO AS WHERE_TO_FILL, OMD_DOSE_LOW AS DOSE, OMD_DOSE_UNIT AS DOSE_UNIT, OO_ORD_FREQ AS FREQUENCY, OSTS_STS_DESC AS ORDER_STATUS FROM X LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_ORDER ON TM_MRN = OO_MRN JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_CATALOG ON OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID = OOC_MSTR_ITEM_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_MED_DETAIL ON OMD_ORD_GUID = OO_ORD_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_STATUS ON OO_ORD_STS_CD = OSTS_ORD_STS_CD WHERE (LOWER(OOC_ITEM_NAME) like '%pembrolizumab%' OR LOWER(OOC_ITEM_NAME) like '%lenvatinib%') AND OO_ORD_STS_CD NOT IN ('CANC', 'CANP', 'AUC3') GROUP BY OO_MRN, OO_ORD_NAME, OO_ORD_PRIO, OMD_DOSE_LOW, OMD_DOSE_UNIT, OOC_ITEM_NAME, OO_ORD_FREQ, OSTS_STS_DESC), PATHOLOGY AS (SELECT PT_MRN, PDRX_PATH_RPT_ID, DTRPT.DT_DTE AS REPORTDATE, PDRX_ACCESSION_NO, PRPT_REPORT_TYPE_DESC, PDWS_NAME AS ASSAY_NAME, T.GENE_PANEL FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML INNER JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML_SETTINGS ON PDRX_PATH_DMP_RESULTS_XML_ID = PDRXS_PATH_DMP_RESULTS_XML_ID INNER JOIN DVDMC.PATHOLOGY_DMP_WEBSVC_SETTINGS ON PDRXS_SETTING_ID = PDWS_SETTING_ID INNER JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON PDRX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID INNER JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V ON PDRX_PATH_RPT_ID = PRPT_PATH_RPT_ID LEFT JOIN DV.DATE DTRPT ON PRPT_REPORT_DATE_ID = DTRPT.DT_DATE_ID JOIN X1 ON PT_MRN = MRN, XMLTABLE('$c/root/meta-data' PASSING PDRX_XML_VALUE AS "c" COLUMNS GENE_PANEL VARCHAR(100) PATH 'gene-panel') T) SELECT DISTINCT TM_MRN, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, PT_DATE_OF_DEATH, CASE_STS, TM_DX_DTE, "Race", HIST_DESC, TM_SITE_CD, SITE_DESC, SSE_SURG_DTE, PDRX_PATH_RPT_ID, REPORTDATE, PDRX_ACCESSION_NO, PRPT_REPORT_TYPE_DESC, CASE WHEN LOWER(OOC_ITEM_NAME) like '%pembrolizumab%' THEN START_DRUG_DATE ELSE NULL END AS PEMBROLIZUMAB_START_DATE, CASE WHEN LOWER(OOC_ITEM_NAME) like '%pembrolizumab%' THEN LAST_DRUG_DATE ELSE NULL END AS PEMBROLIZUMAB_LAST_DATE, CASE WHEN LOWER(OOC_ITEM_NAME) like '%lenvatinib%' THEN START_DRUG_DATE ELSE NULL END AS LENVATINIB_START_DATE, CASE WHEN LOWER(OOC_ITEM_NAME) like '%lenvatinib%' THEN LAST_DRUG_DATE ELSE NULL END AS LENVATINIB_LAST_DATE FROM X JOIN X1 ON TM_MRN= MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT ON TM_MRN = SSE_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON TM_MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN PATHOLOGY V ON MRN = V.PT_MRN

prompt: Create a new Notification for study 21-389
completion: WITH PTS AS (SELECT PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID PID FROM DV.PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED) , DT_1 AS (SELECT PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID AS P_ID FROM DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS REC LEFT JOIN DV.PATIENT_CORE_DEMOGRAPHICS ON PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = CORE_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID WHERE 1 = 1) , DT_2 AS (SELECT DISTINCT PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID AS P_ID FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML INNER JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML_SETTINGS ON PDRX_PATH_DMP_RESULTS_XML_ID = PDRXS_PATH_DMP_RESULTS_XML_ID INNER JOIN DVDMC.PATHOLOGY_DMP_WEBSVC_SETTINGS ON PDRXS_SETTING_ID = PDWS_SETTING_ID INNER JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON PDRX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID , XMLTABLE('$c/root/*' PASSING PDRX_XML_VALUE AS "c" COLUMNS SITE1_GENE VARCHAR(100) PATH 'site1_gene', SITE2_GENE VARCHAR(100) PATH 'site2_gene', GENE_ID VARCHAR(100) PATH 'gene_id', AA_CHANGE VARCHAR(100) PATH 'aa_change', TUMOR_TYPE_CODE VARCHAR(100) PATH '../meta-data/tumor_type_code', TUMOR_TYPE_NAME VARCHAR(255) PATH '../meta-data/tumor_type_name') T JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT T.TUMOR_TYPE_CODE TTC FROM TABLE(DV.STRING_SPLIT('NSCLC', ',')) S CROSS JOIN TABLE(DV.ONCOTREE_CHILDREN(TRIM(COLUMN_VALUES))) T) X ON T.TUMOR_TYPE_CODE = X.TTC WHERE (SITE1_GENE IN ('KRAS') OR SITE2_GENE IN ('KRAS') OR GENE_ID IN ('KRAS')) AND LOCATE('G12C', AA_CHANGE) >= 1) , DT_3 AS (SELECT PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID AS P_ID FROM DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS REC LEFT JOIN DV.PATIENT_CORE_DEMOGRAPHICS ON PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = CORE_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID WHERE 1 = 1 AND PT_VITAL_STATUS IN ('ALIVE')) , DT_4 AS (SELECT PENC_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID AS P_ID FROM (SELECT PENC_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID , TRIM(ENDP_SERVICE_DEPT_GRP_6) DEPT_GRP_6 , TRIM(ENDP_SVC_CLINIC_SUB_DEPT_GRP_7) DIV_GRP_7 , TRIM(ENDP_SERVICE_SPECIALTY_GRP_8) RPT_GRP_8 , TRIM(ENDP_CENTER_FULL_NAME) CENTER_FULL_NAME , TRIM(ENDP_DEPT_NAME) DEPT_NAME , TRIM(T2.EDC_DEPT_DESC) APPT_STATUS_DESC , CASE WHEN ENVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR like '%NV%' THEN 'New Visit' WHEN ENVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR like '%IR%' THEN 'Internal Referral' ELSE 'Non-New Visit/Interal Referral' END AS IRNV_IND , PENC_ENC_DT , PENC_MODIFIED_DT FROM DV.PATIENT_ENCOUNTER T6 INNER JOIN DV.ENCOUNTER_SCHD_RESOURCES SR ON T6.PENC_PT_ENC_ID = SR.ENSR_PT_ENC_ID INNER JOIN DV.ENCOUNTER_RESOURCE ER ON SR.ENSR_RES_ID = ER.ENR_ENC_RES_ID INNER JOIN DV.ENCOUNTER_VISIT_TYPE EVT ON T6.PENC_VISIT_TYPE_ID = EVT.ENVT_ENC_VISIT_TYPE_ID INNER JOIN DV.ENCOUNTER_DESC_CATALOG T2 ON EDC_GROUP_ID = 'STS' AND T6.PENC_APPT_STS = T2.EDC_DEPT_ABBREV INNER JOIN DV.ENCOUNTER_DEPARTMENT T3 ON T6.PENC_DEPT_ID = T3.ENDP_ENC_DEPT_ID INNER JOIN DV.DATE_V REC ON T6.PENC_ENC_DATE_ID = REC.DT_DATE_ID WHERE 1 = 1 AND ((T2.EDC_DEPT_DESC IN ('Completed', 'Scheduled') AND DT_DTE <= CURRENT date + (7 - (DAYOFWEEK_ISO(CURRENT date))) DAYS AND DT_DTE >= CURRENT date - (DAYOFWEEK_ISO(CURRENT date) - 1) DAYS) OR (T2.EDC_DEPT_DESC IN ('Completed') AND DT_DTE >= DATE('2021-12-15') )) ) T WHERE 1 = 1) , DEID AS (SELECT DISTINCT P_ID FROM (SELECT P_ID FROM DT_1 INTERSECT SELECT P_ID FROM DT_2 INTERSECT SELECT P_ID FROM DT_3 INTERSECT SELECT P_ID FROM DT_4 ))

prompt: RAD ONC - Weekly Head and Neck Patients
completion: SELECT DISTINCT CDD_MRN AS "MRN", PT_LAST_NAME AS "Last Name", PT_FIRST_NAME AS "First Name", CDD_SERVICE_DTE AS "Service Date", CDD_DOC_NAME AS "Document Name", OP_DISPLAY_NAME AS "Provider", LGR_LOC_GRP AS "Campus", CDO_VALUE_TEXT AS "Diagnosis" FROM IDB.CD_DOCUMENT JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION ON CDD_DOC_GUID = CDO_DOC_GUID AND CDD_AUTHORED_DTE = CDO_AUTHORED_DTE AND CDO_VALUE_TEXT <> '' JOIN IDB.OMS_PROVIDER ON CDD_AUTH_PROV_GUID = OP_PVDR_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_CLIENT_VISIT ON CDD_VISIT_GUID = OCV_VISIT_GUID JOIN IDB.LOCATION_GROUPS_REFERENCE ON OCV_CURR_LOC_GUID = LGR_LOC_GUID JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON CDD_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE CDD_CANCEL_IND <> '1' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND <> '1' AND CDD_SERVICE_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT DATE - 8 DAY AND CURRENT DATE - 1 DAY AND CDO_MSTR_ITEM_NM = 'Billing_ProblemList_FT' AND CDD_DOC_NAME IN ('Initial Visit, AMB - Rad Onc', 'Subsequent New Visit, AMB - Rad Onc', 'Follow Up, AMB - Rad Onc') AND(CDO_VALUE_TEXT LIKE '%C00%' OR CDO_VALUE_TEXT LIKE '%C01%' OR CDO_VALUE_TEXT LIKE '%C02%' OR CDO_VALUE_TEXT LIKE '%C03%' OR CDO_VALUE_TEXT LIKE '%C04%' OR CDO_VALUE_TEXT LIKE '%C05%' OR CDO_VALUE_TEXT LIKE '%C06%' OR CDO_VALUE_TEXT LIKE '%C07%' OR CDO_VALUE_TEXT LIKE '%C08%' OR CDO_VALUE_TEXT LIKE '%C09%' OR CDO_VALUE_TEXT LIKE '%C10%' OR CDO_VALUE_TEXT LIKE '%C11%' OR CDO_VALUE_TEXT LIKE '%C12%' OR CDO_VALUE_TEXT LIKE '%C13%' OR CDO_VALUE_TEXT LIKE '%C14%' OR CDO_VALUE_TEXT LIKE '%C30%' OR CDO_VALUE_TEXT LIKE '%C31%' OR CDO_VALUE_TEXT LIKE '%C32%' OR CDO_VALUE_TEXT LIKE '%C69%' OR CDO_VALUE_TEXT LIKE '%C73%' OR CDO_VALUE_TEXT LIKE '%C76%' OR CDO_VALUE_TEXT LIKE '%C77%' OR CDO_VALUE_TEXT LIKE '%D00%' OR CDO_VALUE_TEXT LIKE '%D02%' OR CDO_VALUE_TEXT LIKE '%D03%' OR CDO_VALUE_TEXT LIKE '%D09%' OR CDO_VALUE_TEXT LIKE '%D10%' OR CDO_VALUE_TEXT LIKE '%D11%' OR CDO_VALUE_TEXT LIKE '%D14%' OR CDO_VALUE_TEXT LIKE '%D15%' OR CDO_VALUE_TEXT LIKE '%D18%' OR CDO_VALUE_TEXT LIKE '%D31%' OR CDO_VALUE_TEXT LIKE '%D34%' OR CDO_VALUE_TEXT LIKE '%D35%' OR CDO_VALUE_TEXT LIKE '%D36%' OR CDO_VALUE_TEXT LIKE '%D37%' OR CDO_VALUE_TEXT LIKE '%D38%' OR CDO_VALUE_TEXT LIKE '%D44%' OR CDO_VALUE_TEXT LIKE '%D49%') ORDER BY LGR_LOC_GRP, CDD_SERVICE_DTE, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME

prompt: Provide a weekly list of GYN patients with potential complications to report.
completion: WITH SRG1 AS (SELECT DISTINCT SSE_MRN AS MRN, STRIP(PT_LAST_NAME) || ',' || STRIP(PT_FIRST_NAME) AS "Name", SSE_LOG_ID AS LOGID1, SSE_SURG_DTE AS "Surgery Date", SUBSTR(SSP_SURG_SVC_CD, 1, 3) AS "Service", SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD AS CPT, SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC AS CPT_DESC, SUBSTR(STRIP(SSP_SURG_LAST_NM)||', '||SSP_SURG_FIRST_NM, 1, 35) AS "Surgeon" FROM IDB.PATIENT JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT ON PT_MRN = SSE_MRN JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE ON SSE_LOG_ID = SSP_LOG_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.OR_LOG ON SSE_MRN = OL_LOG_ID WHERE 1=1 AND SSP_SURG_SVC_CD = 'GYN' AND SSE_SURG_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT DATE - 42 DAYS AND CURRENT DATE - 36 DAYS ) , SRG2 AS (SELECT DISTINCT MRN, "Name", LOGID1, "Surgery Date", "Service", "Surgeon", SSE_SURG_DTE AS "Reoperation Date", SUBSTR(SSP_SURG_SVC_CD, 1, 3) AS "Reoperation Service", SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD, SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC, SUBSTR(STRIP(SSP_SURG_LAST_NM)||', '||SSP_SURG_FIRST_NM, 1, 35) AS "Reoperation Surgeon" FROM SRG1 JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT ON MRN = SSE_MRN JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE ON SSE_LOG_ID = SSP_LOG_ID WHERE 1=1 AND SSP_SURG_SVC_CD IN ('GYN', 'IR') AND SSE_SURG_DTE BETWEEN "Surgery Date" AND "Surgery Date" + 30 DAYS AND SSE_LOG_ID <> LOGID1 AND SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC NOT LIKE '%MEDIPORT%' ) , EBL AS (SELECT OL_LOG_ID , SUM(CAST(CASE WHEN AIFM_FLO_MEAS_ID = '400620' THEN AIFM_MEAS_VALUE END AS DECIMAL(7, 1))) EBL FROM (SELECT DISTINCT OL_LOG_ID, AIFM_FLO_MEAS_ID, AIFM_MEAS_VALUE FROM IDB.OR_LOG JOIN SRG1 ON OL_LOG_ID = LOGID1 JOIN IDB.OR_LOG_ALL_PROC ON OL_LOG_ID = OLAP_LOG_ID AND OLAP_PNL_NO = 1 JOIN IDB.AN_RECORD_SUMMARY ON OL_LOG_ID = ARS_AN_CASELOG_ID JOIN IDB.AN_IP_DATA_STORE ON ARS_AN_CL_PT_ID = AIDS_CL_PT_ID JOIN IDB.AN_HSB_LINKED_DOC_CSN ON ARS_AN_EPISODE_ID = AHLDC_SUMMARY_BLOCK_ID AND AHLDC_LINKED_DOC_CSN = AIDS_ENC_CSN_ID JOIN IDB.AN_IP_FLOWSHEET_REC ON AIFRC_INPATIENT_DATA_ID = AIDS_INPATIENT_DATA_ID JOIN IDB.AN_IP_FLOWSHEET_MEAS ON AIFRC_FSD_ID = AIFM_FSD_ID AND AHLDC_LINKED_DOC_CSN = AIDS_ENC_CSN_ID AND AIFM_FLO_MEAS_ID IN ('400620') LEFT JOIN IDB.AN_IP_FLOWSHEET_GP_DATA ON AIFM_FLO_MEAS_ID = AIFGD_FLO_MEAS_ID WHERE AIFM_MEAS_VALUE >= '0' AND(AIFM_MEAS_VALUE > '0' OR AIFM_FLO_MEAS_ID = '400620') ) AS X GROUP BY OL_LOG_ID) , EBL2 AS (SELECT DISTINCT SRG1.*, EBL FROM SRG1 LEFT JOIN EBL ON LOGID1 = OL_LOG_ID WHERE EBL >= 1500 ) , ADMISSIONS AS (SELECT MRN, "Name", "Surgery Date", VIS_ADM_NUM, VIS_ADM_DTE AS "Admission Date", VIS_DSCH_DTE AS "Discharge Date", VIS_PATIENT_TYPE FROM IDB.VISIT JOIN SRG1 ON MRN = VIS_MRN WHERE VIS_IP_OP_ADJUSTED_IND = 'I' AND VIS_VISIT_STATUS IN ('2', '3') AND VIS_ADM_DTE BETWEEN "Surgery Date" + 1 DAYS AND "Surgery Date" + 30 DAYS ) , UCC AS (SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN AS MRN, "Name", "Surgery Date", CLD_DEPT_NAME, CPE_ENC_DTE AS "UCC Visit Date" FROM SRG1 JOIN IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER ON MRN = CPE_MRN AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN "Surgery Date" + 1 DAYS AND "Surgery Date" + 30 DAYS JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CPE_DEPT_ID = 230 ORDER BY CPE_MRN, CPE_ENC_DTE ) , CDD AS (SELECT MRN, "Name", "Surgery Date", CDD_DOC_GUID AS DOC_GUID, CDD_SERVICE_DTE AS SVC_DATE, CDD_DOC_NAME AS DOC_NAME, CDO_ITEM_NAME AS ITEM_NAME, CDO_VALUE_TEXT AS VALUE_TEXT FROM SRG1 JOIN IDB.CD_DOCUMENT ON MRN = CDD_MRN JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION ON CDO_DOC_GUID = CDD_DOC_GUID AND CDO_AUTHORED_DTE = CDD_AUTHORED_DTE WHERE CDD_CANCEL_IND = '0' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND = '0' AND CDD_DOC_NAME = 'Operative Report - GYN' AND CDO_MSTR_ITEM_NM = 'OP_GYN_Complications Y/N' AND CDO_VALUE_TEXT = 'Yes' AND CDD_SERVICE_DTE = "Surgery Date" ) SELECT DISTINCT CDD_MRN, CDD_DOC_GUID, "Name", "Surgery Date", CDD_SERVICE_DTE, CDD_DOC_NAME, STRIP(SUBSTR(X1.CDO_VALUE_TEXT, 1, 2000)) AS "Complications Include:", STRIP(SUBSTR(X2.CDO_VALUE_TEXT, 1, 2000)) AS "Complication Details" FROM CDD JOIN IDB.CD_DOCUMENT ON CDD_DOC_GUID = DOC_GUID JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION X1 ON X1.CDO_DOC_GUID = CDD_DOC_GUID AND X1.CDO_MSTR_ITEM_NM = 'OP_GYN_Complications Include' JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION X2 ON X2.CDO_DOC_GUID = CDD_DOC_GUID AND X2.CDO_MSTR_ITEM_NM = 'OP_GYN_Complication Details' SELECT DISTINCT BBP_MRN, "Surgery Date", "Name", BBP_TRANSACTION_DTE AS TRANSFUSION_DATE, BBP_PRODUCT_DESC FROM SRG1 JOIN IDB.TRANSFUSED_BLOOD_PRODUCTS_V ON MRN = BBP_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.DOC ON BBP_PVDR_NO = DOC_DR_NO WHERE BBP_TRANSACTION_DTE BETWEEN "Surgery Date" + 1 DAYS AND "Surgery Date" + 30 DAYS AND BBP_PRODUCT_DESC = 'Red Blood Cells'

AND OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'UCC Disposition' AND OUD_USER_DI_VALUE = 'Place in Observation') , DISP AS (SELECT OO_MRN DISP_MRN , OO_VISIT_GUID DISP_VISIT_GUID , OO_ORD_GUID DISP_ORD_GUID , OUD_USER_DI_VALUE OBS_DISPO , OO_SIGNIFICANT_DT AS OBS_DISPO_DT FROM PTS JOIN IDB.OMS_ORDER ON MRN = OO_MRN AND ORD_GUID = OO_ORD_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_USER_DATA ON OO_ORD_GUID = OUD_ORD_GUID AND OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'UCC Disposition' AND OUD_USER_DI_VALUE <> 'Place in Observation' JOIN OBS ON OO_VISIT_GUID = OBS_VISIT_GUID WHERE OO_SIGNIFICANT_DT > OBS_PLACE_DT ) SELECT MRN , VISIT_GUID , VISIT_DTE , PT_FIRST_NAME , PT_LAST_NAME , MIN(ORD_ENTER_DTE) FIRST_ORD_ENTER_DTE , ORD_NAME , PRIMARY_ATTENDING , MIN(PRIMARY_DX) PRIMARY_DX , MIN(PRIMARY_DX2) PRIMARY_DX2 , MIN(FEVER_NEUT_YN) FEVER_NEUT_YN , SVC , OBS_ORD_NAME , OBS_PLACE_DT , OBS_DISPO , OBS_DISPO_DT , HOUR(OBS_DISPO_DT - OBS_PLACE_DT) HOURS_IN_OBS FROM PTS JOIN OBS ON MRN = OBS_MRN AND VISIT_GUID = OBS_VISIT_GUID LEFT JOIN DISP ON OBS_MRN = DISP_MRN AND OBS_VISIT_GUID = DISP_VISIT_GUID GROUP BY MRN , VISIT_GUID , VISIT_DTE , PT_FIRST_NAME , PT_LAST_NAME , ORD_NAME , PRIMARY_ATTENDING , SVC , OBS_ORD_NAME , OBS_PLACE_DT , OBS_DISPO , OBS_DISPO_DT , HOUR(OBS_DISPO_DT - OBS_PLACE_DT) ; SELECT OO_MRN MRN , OO_ORD_GUID ORD_GUID , OO_VISIT_GUID VISIT_GUID , OCV_VISIT_DTE VISIT_DTE , PT_FIRST_NAME , PT_LAST_NAME , OO_ENTER_DTE ORD_ENTER_DTE , OOC_ITEM_NAME ORD_NAME , OCV_PVDR_NAME PRIMARY_ATTENDING , OS_SVC_DESC SVC , MIN(CASE WHEN OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'UCC Primary Dx' THEN OUD_USER_DI_VALUE END) AS PRIMARY_DX , MIN(CASE WHEN OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'BMT_Teams' THEN OUD_USER_DI_VALUE END) AS BMT_TEAM , MIN(CASE WHEN OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'BMT_Reason_for_Admission' THEN OUD_USER_DI_VALUE END) AS RSN_FOR_ADMIT , MIN(CASE WHEN (OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'UCC Primary Dx' AND UPPER(OUD_USER_DI_VALUE) LIKE '%FEVER%') OR (OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'UCC Primary Dx' AND UPPER(OUD_USER_DI_VALUE) LIKE '%NEUT%') THEN 'Y' END) AS FEVER_NEUT_DX_YN , MIN(CASE WHEN (OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'BMT_Reason_for_Admission' AND UPPER(OUD_USER_DI_VALUE) LIKE '%FEVER%') OR (OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'BMT_Reason_for_Admission' AND UPPER(OUD_USER_DI_VALUE) LIKE '%NEUT%') THEN 'Y' END) AS FEVER_NEUT_RSN_YN FROM IDB.OMS_ORDER JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_CATALOG ON OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID = OOC_MSTR_ITEM_GUID AND OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID = '9000006305100730' JOIN IDB.OMS_CLIENT_VISIT ON OO_VISIT_GUID = OCV_VISIT_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_SERVICE ON OCV_SVC_GUID = OS_SVC_GUID JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON OO_MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_USER_DATA ON OO_ORD_GUID = OUD_ORD_GUID AND OUD_USER_DI_CD IN ('BMT_Reason_for_Admission', 'UCC Primary Dx', 'BMT_Teams') WHERE OO_ENTER_DTE >= '2021-01-01' AND OO_ORD_STS_CD NOT IN ('CANP', 'CANC', 'AUC3') GROUP BY OO_MRN , OO_ORD_GUID , OO_VISIT_GUID , OCV_VISIT_DTE , PT_FIRST_NAME , PT_LAST_NAME , OO_ENTER_DTE , OOC_ITEM_NAME , OCV_PVDR_NAME , OS_SVC_DESC ; WITH PTS AS (SELECT OO_MRN MRN , OO_ORD_GUID ORD_GUID , OO_VISIT_GUID VISIT_GUID , OCV_ADM_NUM , OCV_VISIT_DTE VISIT_DTE , PT_FIRST_NAME , PT_LAST_NAME , OO_ENTER_DTE ORD_ENTER_DTE , OOC_ITEM_NAME ORD_NAME , OCV_PVDR_NAME PRIMARY_ATTENDING , OS_SVC_DESC SVC , MIN(CASE WHEN DX.OUD_USER_DI_CD IN ('UCC Primary Dx', 'UCC Primary Diagnoses2') THEN DX.OUD_USER_DI_VALUE END) AS PRIMARY_DX , MIN(CASE WHEN DX.OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'UCC Primary Dx#2' THEN DX.OUD_USER_DI_VALUE END) AS PRIMARY_DX2 , CASE WHEN (UPPER(DX.OUD_USER_DI_VALUE) LIKE '%FEVER%' OR UPPER(DX.OUD_USER_DI_VALUE) LIKE '%NEUT%') THEN 'Y' END AS FEVER_NEUT_YN FROM IDB.OMS_ORDER JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_CATALOG ON OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID = OOC_MSTR_ITEM_GUID AND OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID IN ('1000004272073029', '9000013014100730') JOIN IDB.OMS_CLIENT_VISIT ON OO_VISIT_GUID = OCV_VISIT_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_SERVICE ON OCV_SVC_GUID = OS_SVC_GUID AND OS_SVC_GRP_CD IN ('TRB', 'TRW', 'TRG', 'TRK') JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON OO_MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_USER_DATA DX ON OO_ORD_GUID = DX.OUD_ORD_GUID AND DX.OUD_USER_DI_CD IN ('UCC Primary Dx#2', 'UCC Primary Dx', 'UCC Primary Diagnoses2') WHERE OO_ENTER_DTE >= '2021-01-01' AND OO_ORD_STS_CD NOT IN ('CANP', 'CANC', 'AUC3') AND (CASE WHEN (UPPER(DX.OUD_USER_DI_VALUE) LIKE '%FEVER%' OR UPPER(DX.OUD_USER_DI_VALUE) LIKE '%NEUT%') THEN 'Y' END) = 'Y' GROUP BY OO_MRN , OO_ORD_GUID , OO_VISIT_GUID , OCV_ADM_NUM , OCV_VISIT_DTE , PT_FIRST_NAME , PT_LAST_NAME , OO_ENTER_DTE , OOC_ITEM_NAME , OCV_PVDR_NAME , OS_SVC_DESC , CASE WHEN (UPPER(DX.OUD_USER_DI_VALUE) LIKE '%FEVER%' OR UPPER(DX.OUD_USER_DI_VALUE) LIKE '%NEUT%') THEN 'Y' END ) , OBS AS (SELECT OO_MRN OBS_MRN , OO_VISIT_GUID OBS_VISIT_GUID , OO_ORD_GUID OBS_ORD_GUID , OO_SIGNIFICANT_DT AS OBS_PLACE_DT , OUD_USER_DI_VALUE AS OBS_ORD_NAME FROM PTS JOIN IDB.OMS_ORDER ON MRN = OO_MRN AND ORD_GUID = OO_ORD_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_USER_DATA ON OO_ORD_GUID = OUD_ORD_GUID AND OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'UCC Disposition' AND OUD_USER_DI_VALUE = 'Admit to IP') SELECT A.MRN , VISIT_GUID , VISIT_DTE , PT_FIRST_NAME , PT_LAST_NAME , MIN(ORD_ENTER_DTE) FIRST_ORD_ENTER_DTE , ORD_NAME , PRIMARY_ATTENDING , MIN(PRIMARY_DX) PRIMARY_DX , MIN(PRIMARY_DX2) PRIMARY_DX2 , MIN(FEVER_NEUT_YN) FEVER_NEUT_YN , SVC , ADMIT_DT FROM PTS A JOIN OBS ON A.MRN = OBS_MRN AND VISIT_GUID = OBS_VISIT_GUID LEFT JOIN IDB.INPATIENT_ADMISSIONS_V B ON OCV_ADM_NUM = ADMIT_ID GROUP BY A.MRN , VISIT_GUID , VISIT_DTE , PT_FIRST_NAME , PT_LAST_NAME , ORD_NAME , PRIMARY_ATTENDING , SVC , ADMIT_DT

prompt: Provide a list of patients diagnosed with ganglioneuroma.
completion: WITH "cte1" AS (SELECT TEXTTABLE.*, CONTAINS("PRPT_REPORT", '"ganglioneuroma"') AS "HitCol1" FROM "DV"."PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V" TEXTTABLE) SELECT DISTINCT "t1"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AS "Deident PT #", "t2"."PT_MRN" AS "MRN", "t2"."PT_SEX_DESC" AS "Gender", "t2"."PT_VITAL_STATUS" AS "Vital Status", "t2"."PT_BIRTH_DTE" AS "Date of Birth", "t3"."DXCC_ICD_CODE" AS "ICD-O Histology Code", "t3"."DXCC_ICD_MSK_DESC" AS "ICD-O Histology Description", "t4"."ICSC_SITE_CD" AS "ICD-O Site Code", "t4"."ICSC_ICDO_SITE_MSK_DESC" AS "ICD-O Site Description", "t5"."DT_DTE" AS "Tumor Diagnosis Date", "t6"."DT_DTE" AS "Pathology Report Date", "t7"."PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_DESC" AS "Pathology Report Type", "t8"."PRPT_ACCESSION_NO" AS "Pathology Report" FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED" "t1" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V" "t2" ON "t1"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t2"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."CDB_TUMOR_V" "t9" ON "t1"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t9"."CDTM_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DIAGNOSIS_CODE_CAT_ICDO_V" "t3" ON "t9"."CDTM_DX_CATALOG_ID" = "t3"."DXCC_DX_CATALOG_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."ICDO_SITE_CATALOG_V" "t4" ON "t9"."CDTM_SITE_CATALOG_ID" = "t4"."ICSC_SITE_CATALOG_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" "t5" ON "t9"."CDTM_DX_DATE_ID" = "t5"."DT_DATE_ID" LEFT JOIN "cte1" "t8" ON "t1"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t8"."PRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" "t6" ON "t8"."PRPT_REPORT_DATE_ID" = "t6"."DT_DATE_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATH_RPRT_TYPE_LOOKUP" "t7" ON "t8"."PRPT_REPORT_TYPE" = "t7"."PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_CD" WHERE (("t3"."DXCC_ICD_CODE" IN ('M9490/0') OR "t8"."HitCol1" <> 0) AND "t3"."DXCC_ICD_CODE" NOT IN ('M9490/3', 'M9500/3', 'M9500/6'))

prompt: I would like to request a report that shows the Most Frequent Volume of Subsequent New Visits (visit type [3669]) for all Radiation Oncology MDs from Q2, Q3, and Q4 of 2022 per clinic day.
completion: SELECT CRE_RES_NAME AS PHYSICIAN_NAME, CPE_ENC_DTE, QUARTER(CPE_ENC_DTE) AS QUARTER, DAYNAME(CPE_ENC_DTE) AS WEEKDAY, CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID, COUNT(DISTINCT CPE_MRN) NUM_OF_VISITS FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN '2022-04-01' AND '2022-12-31' AND CRE_RES_TYP IN ('Physician') AND CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID = 3669 GROUP BY CRE_RES_NAME, CPE_ENC_DTE, QUARTER(CPE_ENC_DTE), DAYNAME(CPE_ENC_DTE), CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID ORDER BY CPE_ENC_DTE

prompt: Provide list of patients who received antibiotic Zosyn (piperacillin and tazobactam) for prophylaxis at the time of hepatic artery embolization during the year 2017.
completion: WITH PTS AS (SELECT RRPT_MRN, RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE FROM DV.RADIOLOGY_REPORT_V WHERE RRPT_PROCEDURE_NAME LIKE '%EMBOLIZATION, ARTERIAL TUMOR HEPATIC' AND RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE BETWEEN '2017-01-01' AND '2017-12-31' ) SELECT DISTINCT OO_MRN AS MRN , OO_ORD_NAME AS ORDER_NAME , RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE AS PROCEDURE_DATE , OOTO_SIGNIFIC_DTE AS ADMIN_DATE FROM PTS JOIN IDB.OMS_ORDER ON OO_MRN = RRPT_MRN JOIN IDB.OAS_ORD_TASK_OCCR ON OOTO_ORD_GUID = OO_ORD_GUID AND OOTO_STATUS_CD = 'Performed' JOIN IDB.OAS_CTLG_ITEM_TASK ON OOTO_CAT_ITEM_GUID = OCIT_GUID AND OCIT_LEVEL_NO = 0 WHERE OO_ORD_STS_CD NOT IN ('CANC', 'CANP', 'AUC3') AND OOTO_SIGNIFIC_DTE = RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE AND(UPPER(OO_ORD_NAME) LIKE '%PIPERACILIN%' OR UPPER(OO_ORD_NAME) LIKE '%TAZOBACTAM%') ;

prompt: MED24301, update to be all BC patients not just metastatic
completion: WITH PTS AS (SELECT CC_MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS BREAST_DX_DTE FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE 1=1 AND SUBSTR(CC_CLSF_CD, 1, 3) IN ('C50', '174', '175') AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' GROUP BY CC_MRN) SELECT DISTINCT CC_MRN "MRN" , LOC_LOC_NAME "Location" , OC_SURG_DTE "Procedure Date" , CRE_RES_NAME "Surgeon" , CPX_PROC_NAME "Procedure Name" , CPX_PROC_CD , "Appt Date" , "Provider Name" , "Visit Type" FROM PTS A JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT OC_MRN, OC_SURG_DTE, OC_OR_CASE_STS, OC_OR_CASE_STS_CD, CRE_RES_NAME, CPX_PROC_NAME, OC_CASE_ID, OCAP_OR_PROC_ID, LOC_LOC_NAME, OCAS_PNL_NO, CPX_PROC_CD FROM IDB.OR_CASE JOIN IDB.OR_CASE_ALL_PROC ON OC_CASE_ID = OCAP_CASE_ID JOIN IDB.OR_CASE_ALL_SURG ON OCAP_CASE_ID = OCAS_CASE_ID AND OCAS_PNL_NO = OCAP_PNL_NO AND OCAS_SURG_ROLE = 'Primary' JOIN IDB.OR_PROC ON OCAP_OR_PROC_ID = OP_OR_PROC_ID JOIN IDB.OR_CL_PROC ON OP_OR_PROC_ID = OCP_OR_PROC_ID JOIN IDB.CL_PROC ON OCP_PROC_ID = CPX_PROC_ID JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CRE_RES_ID = OCAS_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_LOCATION ON OC_SURG_LOC_ID = LOC_LOC_ID WHERE OC_MRN <> '' AND OC_OR_CASE_STS_CD NOT IN ('2', '5') AND OC_SURG_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT date AND CURRENT date + 7 DAYS AND (CPX_PROC_CD IN ('38525', '999992') OR UPPER(CPX_PROC_NAME) like '%IR PROCEDURE%' OR UPPER(CPX_PROC_NAME) LIKE '%BX%' OR UPPER(CPX_PROC_NAME) LIKE '%BIOPSY%') ) B ON A.CC_MRN = OC_MRN LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN AS "MRN", CPE_ENC_DTE AS "Appt Date", CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 AS "Department", CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 AS "Service", CLD_DEPT_NAME AS "Department Name", CRE_RES_NAME AS "Provider Name", CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME AS "Visit Type", CLD_CLD_CENTER "Location" FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID JOIN PTS ON CC_MRN = CPE_MRN WHERE 1=1 AND CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Sch') AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT date AND CURRENT date + 7 DAYS AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 = 'MED' AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 = 'BRE' ) C ON B.OC_MRN = "MRN" AND "Appt Date" BETWEEN CURRENT date AND OC_SURG_DTE WHERE 1=1 ORDER BY OC_SURG_DTE, CC_MRN ASC ;

prompt: List of breast cancer patients salivary gland like morphology or basaloid morphology.
completion: WITH PTS AS (SELECT PT_MRN AS MRN, PT_VITAL_STATUS, PT_BIRTH_DTE, P.DT_DTE AS PATH_PROC_DTE, R.DT_DTE AS PATH_RPT_DTE, MP_FULL_NM AS ORD_PROVIDER, MP_SERVICE_DESC AS ORD_PROVIDER_SVC_DESC, PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_DESC AS PATH_RPT_TYPE, PRPT_ACCESSION_NO AS PATH_ACCESSION_NO, PRPT_REPORT AS PATH_RPT FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT JOIN DV.DATE P ON P.DT_DATE_ID = PRPT_PROCEDURE_DATE_ID JOIN DV.DATE R ON R.DT_DATE_ID = PRPT_REPORT_DATE_ID JOIN DV.PATH_RPRT_TYPE_LOOKUP ON PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_CD = PRPT_REPORT_TYPE JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON PRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID JOIN DV.MEDPRO ON PRPT_ORDERING_MEDPRO_ID = MP_MEDPRO_ID WHERE (CONTAINS("PRPT_REPORT", '("salivary gland like" | "salivary gland-like" | "basaloid")') = 1 AND CONTAINS("PRPT_REPORT", '("breast")') = 1 AND CONTAINS("PRPT_REPORT", '("carcinoma")') = 1) AND PRPT_REPORT IS NOT NULL ) , DX AS (SELECT TM_MRN, AV_DESC AS CASE_STS, TM_DX_DTE, TM_HIST_CD, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS HIST_DESC, TM_SITE_CD, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_DESC FROM PTS JOIN IDB.CDB_TUMOR ON MRN = TM_MRN JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS ON AV_ELEMENT = 'CASE_STS' AND AV_CODE = TM_CASE_STS AND TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND TM_SITE_CD LIKE 'C50%') , RADONC AS (SELECT RTC_TX_MRN, SUBSTR(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(CAST(XMLSERIALIZE(CONTENT XMLAGG(XMLELEMENT(NAME "c", '| '||RTC_TX_START_DTE||' | '||RTC_TX_STOP_DTE||' | '||RTC_TX_DELIVERED_DOSE||' | '||RTC_TX_DELIVERED_FRACTIONS||' | '||RTC_TX_PLAN_NAME||' |'|| CHR(13) || CHR(10)) ORDER BY RTC_TX_START_DTE) AS CLOB(32000)) AS VARCHAR(32000)), '<c>', ','), '</c>', ''), '', ''), '<c/>', ''), ',', ''), 1) AS RADONC_TREATMENT FROM PTS JOIN IDB.RADONC_TREATMENT_COURSE ON MRN = RTC_TX_MRN GROUP BY RTC_TX_MRN) , CHEMO AS (SELECT APR_MRN, SUBSTR(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(CAST(XMLSERIALIZE(CONTENT XMLAGG(XMLELEMENT(NAME "c", CHEMO_START_DTE || ' | ' || CHEMO_END_DTE|| ' | ' || APR_DRUG_NAME || CHR(13) || CHR(10)) ORDER BY CHEMO_START_DTE, APR_DRUG_NAME) AS CLOB(32000)) AS VARCHAR(32000)), '<c>', ','), '</c>', ''), '', ''), '<c/>', ''), ',', ''), 1) AS CHEMO FROM (SELECT APR_MRN, APR_DRUG_NAME, MIN(APR_START_DTE) AS CHEMO_START_DTE, MAX(APR_END_DTE) AS CHEMO_END_DTE FROM IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX WHERE 1=1 GROUP BY APR_MRN, APR_DRUG_NAME)A JOIN PTS ON MRN = APR_MRN WHERE 1=1 GROUP BY APR_MRN) SELECT MRN, PT_BIRTH_DTE, PT_VITAL_STATUS, PATH_ACCESSION_NO, TM_DX_DTE, SITE_DESC, HIST_DESC, RADONC_TREATMENT, CHEMO, MAX(COALESCE(PLA_LST_APPT_DTE, PLA_LST_DSCH_DTE), COALESCE(PLA_LST_DSCH_DTE, PLA_LST_APPT_DTE)) "Last Follow-up Date" FROM PTS JOIN DX ON MRN = TM_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY ON MRN = PLA_MRN LEFT JOIN RADONC ON MRN = RTC_TX_MRN LEFT JOIN CHEMO ON MRN = APR_MRN

prompt: For all patients diagnosed with COVID-19, please provide any documented information on smoking status
completion: WITH PTS AS (SELECT DISTINCT A.MRN , ADMIT_ID , ADMIT_DT , DISCHARGE_DT , DISCHARGE_DT_FOR_CALCS , MIN_IDENTIFIED_DT , MIN_RESOLVED_PROBLEM_DT FROM IDB.COVID19_PATIENT_INFO A LEFT JOIN IDB.INPATIENT_ADMISSIONS_V B ON A.MRN = B.MRN AND DISCHARGE_DT_FOR_CALCS >= MIN_IDENTIFIED_DT AND (MAX_RESOLVED_PROBLEM_DT <= DISCHARGE_DT_FOR_CALCS OR MAX_RESOLVED_PROBLEM_DT IS NULL) WHERE RESULT IN ('Positive', 'Resolved') AND TRIM(A.MRN) <> '' ) , ICU AS (SELECT UC_MRN , UC_ADM_NUM , MIN(TIMESTAMP(UC_TRANSFER_DTE, UC_TRANSFER_TME)) ICU_ADMIT_DT FROM IDB.UNIFIED_CENSUS JOIN PTS ON UC_MRN = MRN AND UC_ADM_NUM = ADMIT_ID JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS ON AV_ELEMENT = 'HOSP_SVC' AND AV_CODE = UC_HOSP_SVC WHERE AV_DESC like '%INTENSIV%' AND TIMESTAMP(UC_TRANSFER_DTE, UC_TRANSFER_TME) BETWEEN ADMIT_DT AND DISCHARGE_DT_FOR_CALCS GROUP BY UC_MRN , UC_ADM_NUM ) , DEMO AS (SELECT PT_MRN, PT_SEX, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, PT_DATE_OF_DEATH, CASE WHEN COALESCE(R.AV_DESC, CR.AV_DESC) IN ('WHITE', 'WHITE HISPANIC') THEN 'White' WHEN COALESCE(R.AV_DESC, CR.AV_DESC) IN ('BLACK OR AFRICAN AMERICAN', 'BLACK', 'BLACK HISPANIC') THEN 'Black' WHEN COALESCE(R.AV_DESC, CR.AV_DESC) IN ('ASIAN-FAR EAST/INDIAN SUBCONT', 'KAMPUCHEAN', 'LAOTIAN', 'VIETNAMESE', 'HMONG', 'CHINESE', 'ASIAN INDIAN PAKISTANI', 'JAPANESE', 'KOREAN', 'OTHER ASIAN', 'THAI') THEN 'Asian' WHEN COALESCE(R.AV_DESC, CR.AV_DESC) IN ('NATIVE AMERICAN-AM IND/ALASKA', 'AMER IND ALEUT ESKIMO') THEN 'Native American or Alaska Native' WHEN COALESCE(R.AV_DESC, CR.AV_DESC) IN ('NATIVE HAWAIIAN OR PACIFIC ISL', 'HAWAIIAN', 'MELANESIAN', 'MICRONESIAN', 'FIJI ISLANDER', 'FILIPINO', 'GUAMANIAN', 'PACIFIC ISLANDER') THEN 'Native Hawaiian or Other Pacific Islander' ELSE 'Unspecified' END AS PT_RACE, CASE WHEN COALESCE(CE.AV_DESC, E.AV_DESC) IN ('SPANISH NOS; HISPANIC NOS, LATINO NOS', 'HISPANIC OR LATINO', 'PUERTO RICAN', 'SOUTH/CENTRAL AMERICA (EXCEPT BRAZIL)', 'DOMINICAN REPUBLIC', 'OTHER SPANISH/HISPANIC(INCL EUROPEAN; EXCL DOM REP)', 'CUBAN', 'MEXICAN (INCLUDES CHICANO)') OR COALESCE(R.AV_DESC, CR.AV_DESC) IN ('WHITE HISPANIC', 'BLACK HISPANIC') THEN 'Hispanic' WHEN COALESCE(CE.AV_DESC, E.AV_DESC) IN ('NOT HISPANIC', 'SPANISH SURNAME ONLY', 'NON-SPANISH; NON-HISPANIC') THEN 'Non-Hispanic' ELSE 'Unspecified' END AS PT_ETHNICITY FROM IDB.PATIENT JOIN PTS ON PT_MRN = MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS R ON R.AV_ELEMENT = 'RACE' AND R.AV_CODE = PT_RACE LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS E ON E.AV_ELEMENT = 'PT_ETHNICITY' AND E.AV_CODE = PT_PT_ETHNICITY LEFT JOIN IDB.CDB_PATIENT ON PT_MRN = CP_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS CR ON CR.AV_ELEMENT = 'CDB_RACE' AND CR.AV_CODE = CP_CDB_RACE LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS CE ON CE.AV_ELEMENT = 'ETHNICITY' AND CE.AV_CODE = CP_ETHNICITY) , BMI AS (SELECT PMH_MRN , PMH_BMI BMI , ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY PMH_MRN ORDER BY PMH_MEASURE_DTE DESC) AS RN FROM IDB.PT_MEASURES_HX JOIN DEMO ON PMH_MRN = PT_MRN) SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN MRN , PT_SEX SEX , PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH DOB , PT_DATE_OF_DEATH DATE_OF_DEATH , PT_RACE RACE , PT_ETHNICITY ETHNICITY , BMI , MIN_IDENTIFIED_DT AS FIRST_POS_COVID_DT , MIN_RESOLVED_PROBLEM_DT AS FIRST_NEG_COVID_DT , ADMIT_DT , ICU_ADMIT_DT , DISCHARGE_DT FROM DEMO JOIN PTS ON PT_MRN = MRN LEFT JOIN BMI ON PT_MRN = PMH_MRN AND RN=1 LEFT JOIN ICU ON PT_MRN = UC_MRN AND UC_ADM_NUM = ADMIT_ID ^ WITH PTS AS (SELECT DISTINCT A.MRN FROM IDB.COVID19_PATIENT_INFO A LEFT JOIN IDB.INPATIENT_ADMISSIONS_V B ON A.MRN = B.MRN AND DISCHARGE_DT_FOR_CALCS >= MIN_IDENTIFIED_DT AND (MAX_RESOLVED_PROBLEM_DT <= DISCHARGE_DT_FOR_CALCS OR MAX_RESOLVED_PROBLEM_DT IS NULL) WHERE RESULT IN ('Positive', 'Resolved') AND TRIM(A.MRN) <> '' ) SELECT ASH_MRN, ASH_ENC_DTE, ASH_TOBACCO_PAK_PER_DAY, ASH_TOBACCO_USED_YEARS, ASH_TOBACCO_COMMENT, ASH_SMOKING_QUIT_DTE, ASH_CIGARETTES_IND, ASH_PIPES_IND, ASH_CIGARS_IND, ASH_SNUFF_IND, ASH_CHEW_IND FROM IDB.AN_SOCIAL_HX JOIN PTS ON ASH_MRN = MRN ^ WITH PTS AS (SELECT DISTINCT A.MRN FROM IDB.COVID19_PATIENT_INFO A LEFT JOIN IDB.INPATIENT_ADMISSIONS_V B ON A.MRN = B.MRN AND DISCHARGE_DT_FOR_CALCS >= MIN_IDENTIFIED_DT AND (MAX_RESOLVED_PROBLEM_DT <= DISCHARGE_DT_FOR_CALCS OR MAX_RESOLVED_PROBLEM_DT IS NULL) WHERE RESULT IN ('Positive', 'Resolved') AND TRIM(A.MRN) <> '' ) , SMOKE_STS AS (SELECT CDD_MRN, CDD_ADM_NUM, CDD_DOC_GUID, CDD_SERVICE_DTE, CDD_DOC_NAME, CDO_SECTION, CDO_ITEM_NAME, CDO_VALUE_TEXT, CDD_VISIT_GUID, CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND = '0' AND (UPPER(CDO_ITEM_NAME) like '%SMOK%' OR UPPER(CDO_ITEM_NAME) like '%TOBACCO%') AND CDD_SERVICE_DTE >= '2009-01-01' ) , LOC AS (SELECT LGR_LOC_GRP, OL_LOC_NAME, CDD_DOC_GUID LOC_DOC_GUID FROM SMOKE_STS A JOIN IDB.OMS_VISIT_LOCATION ON OVL_VISIT_GUID = CDD_VISIT_GUID AND OVL_EFF_DT = (SELECT MAX(OVL_EFF_DT) AS MAX_OVL_EFF_DT FROM IDB.OMS_VISIT_LOCATION WHERE OVL_EFF_DT <= A.CDD_AUTHORED_DT AND OVL_VISIT_GUID = A.CDD_VISIT_GUID AND YEAR(OVL_EFF_DT) >= 2009 ) JOIN IDB.OMS_LOCATION ON OVL_LOC_GUID = OL_LOC_GUID JOIN IDB.LOCATION_GROUPS_REFERENCE ON OL_LOC_GUID = LGR_LOC_GUID) SELECT CDD_MRN, CDD_ADM_NUM, CDD_DOC_GUID, CDD_SERVICE_DTE, CDD_DOC_NAME, CDO_SECTION, CDO_ITEM_NAME, CDO_VALUE_TEXT, CDD_VISIT_GUID, CDD_AUTHORED_DT, LGR_LOC_GRP, OL_LOC_NAME FROM SMOKE_STS JOIN LOC ON CDD_DOC_GUID = LOC_DOC_GUID ^ WITH PTS AS (SELECT DISTINCT A.MRN , ADMIT_ID , ADMIT_DT , DISCHARGE_DT , DISCHARGE_DT_FOR_CALCS , MIN_IDENTIFIED_DT , MIN_RESOLVED_PROBLEM_DT FROM IDB.COVID19_PATIENT_INFO A LEFT JOIN IDB.INPATIENT_ADMISSIONS_V B ON A.MRN = B.MRN AND DISCHARGE_DT_FOR_CALCS >= MIN_IDENTIFIED_DT AND (MAX_RESOLVED_PROBLEM_DT <= DISCHARGE_DT_FOR_CALCS OR MAX_RESOLVED_PROBLEM_DT IS NULL) WHERE RESULT IN ('Positive', 'Resolved') AND TRIM(A.MRN) <> '' ) SELECT CC_MRN MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS MIN_ICD_EFF_DTE, CASE WHEN CLM_CLSF_TYPE = 'I0' THEN 'ICD10' completion: WITH KIDNEY_CANCER AS (SELECT DISTINCT TM_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, PT_SEX, AV_DESC AS CASE_STS, TM_DX_DTE, TM_HIST_CD, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS HIST_DESC, TM_SITE_CD, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_DESC FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS ON AV_ELEMENT = 'CASE_STS' AND AV_CODE = TM_CASE_STS AND TM_CASE_STS IN ('3', '6', '7', '8') AND TM_HIST_CD IN ('M8317/3', 'M8319/3', 'M8316/3', 'M8318/3', 'M8312/3', 'M8964/3') AND TM_DX_DTE >= '2005-01-01' JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PT_MRN=TM_MRN), SPINE_IMAGE AS (SELECT DISTINCT RRPT_MRN FROM DV.RADIOLOGY_REPORT_V JOIN KIDNEY_CANCER ON TM_MRN = RRPT_MRN WHERE RRPT_PROCEDURE_NAME LIKE '%SPINE%' ) SELECT * FROM KIDNEY_CANCER WHERE TM_MRN IN (SELECT * FROM SPINE_IMAGE) ; WITH KIDNEY_CANCER AS (SELECT DISTINCT TM_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, PT_SEX, AV_DESC AS CASE_STS, TM_DX_DTE, TM_HIST_CD, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS HIST_DESC, TM_SITE_CD, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_DESC FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS ON AV_ELEMENT = 'CASE_STS' AND AV_CODE = TM_CASE_STS AND TM_CASE_STS IN ('3', '6', '7', '8') AND TM_HIST_CD IN ('M8317/3', 'M8319/3', 'M8316/3', 'M8318/3', 'M8312/3', 'M8964/3') AND TM_DX_DTE >= '2005-01-01' JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PT_MRN=TM_MRN), SPINE_IMAGE AS (SELECT DISTINCT RRPT_MRN, RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE, RRPT_ACCESSION_NO, RRPT_ORDER_GROUP, RRPT_PROCEDURE_NAME FROM DV.RADIOLOGY_REPORT_V JOIN KIDNEY_CANCER ON TM_MRN = RRPT_MRN WHERE RRPT_PROCEDURE_NAME LIKE '%SPINE%' ) SELECT * FROM SPINE_IMAGE ORDER BY 1, 2 ; WITH KIDNEY_CANCER AS (SELECT DISTINCT TM_MRN FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS ON AV_ELEMENT = 'CASE_STS' AND AV_CODE = TM_CASE_STS AND TM_CASE_STS IN ('3', '6', '7', '8') AND TM_HIST_CD IN ('M8317/3', 'M8319/3', 'M8316/3', 'M8318/3', 'M8312/3', 'M8964/3') AND TM_DX_DTE >= '2005-01-01' JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PT_MRN=TM_MRN), SPINE_IMAGE AS (SELECT DISTINCT RRPT_MRN FROM DV.RADIOLOGY_REPORT_V JOIN KIDNEY_CANCER ON TM_MRN = RRPT_MRN WHERE RRPT_PROCEDURE_NAME LIKE '%SPINE%' ) SELECT SSE_MRN, SSE_SURG_DTE, SSE_LOG_STS, SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD, SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC, SSP_SURG_LAST_NM, SSP_SURG_FIRST_NM, SSP_SURG_SVC_CD FROM KIDNEY_CANCER JOIN SPINE_IMAGE ON RRPT_MRN=TM_MRN JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT ON SSE_MRN=TM_MRN JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE ON SSE_LOG_ID = SSP_LOG_ID ; Provide a list of patients with brain tumors with PDGFRA and KIT mutations
completion: WITH PTS AS (SELECT PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID PID FROM DV.PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED) , DT_1 AS (SELECT PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID AS P_ID FROM DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS REC LEFT JOIN DV.PATIENT_CORE_DEMOGRAPHICS ON PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = CORE_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID WHERE 1=1 ) , DT_2 AS (SELECT INC.PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID P_ID FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_STRUCTURED_RESULTS_V INC JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML DT ON INC.PRPT_PATH_RPT_ID = DT.PDRX_PATH_RPT_ID CROSS JOIN XMLTABLE('$c/root/meta-data' PASSING DT.PDRX_XML_VALUE AS "c" COLUMNS PRIMARY_SITE VARCHAR(264) PATH 'primary_site', TUMOR_TYPE_NAME VARCHAR(264) PATH 'tumor_type_name' , TUMOR_TYPE_CODE VARCHAR(264) PATH 'tumor_type_code', IS_METASTASIS VARCHAR(3) PATH 'is_metastasis' , METASTASIS_SITE VARCHAR(264) PATH 'metastasis_site' , MSI_COMMENT VARCHAR(264) PATH 'msi-comment' , MSI_SCORE VARCHAR(264) PATH 'msi-score' , MSI_TYPE VARCHAR(264) PATH 'msi-type' , TMB_SCORE VARCHAR(25) PATH 'tmb_score' , TMB_COUNT VARCHAR(25) PATH 'tmb-count', COSMIC_ID VARCHAR(5000) PATH 'cosmic_id') T JOIN (SELECT T.TUMOR_TYPE_CODE TTC FROM TABLE(DV.STRING_SPLIT('BRAIN', ',')) S CROSS JOIN TABLE(DV.ONCOTREE_CHILDREN(COLUMN_VALUES)) T) X ON T.TUMOR_TYPE_CODE = TRIM(X.TTC) WHERE 1=1 AND (INC.GENE IN ('KIT', 'PDGFRA') OR INC.GENE2 IN ('KIT', 'PDGFRA')) ) , DEID AS (SELECT DISTINCT P_ID FROM (SELECT P_ID FROM DT_1 INTERSECT SELECT P_ID FROM DT_2 ))

prompt: Trying to confirm how many same day consults our service receives per week
completion: WITH ORDERS_0 AS (SELECT "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AS PT_DEID, "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_MRN" AS PT_MRN, "IDB"."OMS_ORDER"."OO_ORD_GUID" AS SUBJECT_ID, "IDB"."OMS_ORDER"."OO_ENTER_DTE" AS ORDER_ENTER_DATE, "IDB"."OMS_STATUS"."OSTS_STS_DESC" AS ORDER_STATUS, "IDB"."OMS_ORDER"."OO_ORD_NAME" AS ORDER_NAME FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS" JOIN "IDB"."OMS_ORDER" ON "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_MRN" = "IDB"."OMS_ORDER"."OO_MRN" JOIN "IDB"."OMS_STATUS" ON "IDB"."OMS_ORDER"."OO_ORD_STS_CD" = "IDB"."OMS_STATUS"."OSTS_ORD_STS_CD" WHERE "IDB"."OMS_ORDER"."OO_ORD_STS_CD" NOT IN ('CANP', 'CANC', 'AUC3') AND "IDB"."OMS_ORDER"."OO_ENTER_DTE" BETWEEN '2022-01-01' AND '2023-07-31' AND "IDB"."OMS_STATUS"."OSTS_STS_DESC" IN ('Completed') AND "IDB"."OMS_ORDER"."OO_ORD_NAME" IN ('Dermatology Outpatient Consult')), COHORT AS (SELECT PT_DEID AS PT_DEID FROM (SELECT ORDERS_0.PT_DEID AS PT_DEID FROM ORDERS_0)), COHORT_ORDERS AS (SELECT SUBJECT_ID AS SUBJECT_ID, PT_DEID AS PT_DEID FROM (SELECT ORDERS_0.SUBJECT_ID AS SUBJECT_ID, ORDERS_0.PT_DEID AS PT_DEID FROM ORDERS_0)), KEYS AS (SELECT COHORT.PT_DEID AS COHORT_PT_DEID, COHORT_ORDERS.SUBJECT_ID AS COHORT_ORDERS_SUBJECT_ID, COHORT_ORDERS.PT_DEID AS COHORT_ORDERS_PT_DEID FROM COHORT LEFT OUTER JOIN COHORT_ORDERS ON COHORT_ORDERS.PT_DEID = COHORT.PT_DEID), DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS AS (SELECT DISTINCT "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AS PT_DEID, IDB_PATIENT."PT_MRN" AS PT_MRN, "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AS Date" , DMP.PRPT_REPORT_TYPE_DESC AS "Report Type" , DMP.PRPT_REPORT_TYPE , DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)diag[\w\W]*(?=I ATTEST)', DMP.PRPT_REPORT) AS DIAGNOSIS , VARCHAR(DMP.PRPT_REPORT, 32000) AS "Report Text (first 32000 characters)" , UPPER(DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)SPECIMENS( )*SUBMITTED[\w\W]*(?=DIAGNOSIS:)', VARCHAR(DMP.PRPT_REPORT, 30000))) AS "SPECIMENS SUBMITTED" , SRG.PRPT_ACCESSION_NO AS RELATED_ACC_NO , SRG_DATE.DT_DTE AS RELATED_PROC_DTE , (SELECT VARCHAR(PRPT_REPORT, 32000) AS REFERENCEDPATHTEXTFROM FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT WHERE PRPT_ACCESSION_NO = SRG.PRPT_ACCESSION_NO) AS REFERENCEDPATHTEXT FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V DMP LEFT JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_REFERENCES ON PRPTR_CHILD_PATH_RPT_ID = DMP.PRPT_PATH_RPT_ID LEFT JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT SRG ON SRG.PRPT_PATH_RPT_ID = PRPTR_PATH_RPT_ID LEFT JOIN DV.DATE_V SRG_DATE ON SRG_DATE.DT_DATE_ID = SRG.PRPT_PROCEDURE_DATE_ID JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = DMP.PRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID WHERE 1=1 AND SUBSTR(DMP.PRPT_ACCESSION_NO, 1, 1) IN ('H', 'S') AND (DMP.PRPT_REPORT_DTE >= '01/01/2022' OR DMP.PRPT_PROCEDURE_DTE >= '01/01/2022') AND CONTAINS(DMP.PRPT_REPORT, '("Follicular lymphoma" OR "B-cell lymphoma with germinal center immunophenotype" OR "B cell lymphoma with germinal center immunophenotype" OR "Low-grade B-cell lymphoma" OR "low-grade b cell lymphoma" OR "low grade b-cell lymphoma" OR "low grade b cell lymphoma" OR "Low-grade follicular lymphoma" OR "Low grade follicular lymphoma" )') = 1 AND DMP.PRPT_REPORT IS NOT NULL ORDER BY 1, 9, 8) , DX AS (SELECT * FROM PATHREPORT WHERE(UPPER(DIAGNOSIS) LIKE '%FOLLICULAR LYMPHOMA%' OR UPPER(DIAGNOSIS) LIKE '%B-CELL LYMPHOMA WITH GERMINAL CENTER IMMUNOPHENOTYPE%' OR UPPER(DIAGNOSIS) LIKE '%B CELL LYMPHOMA WITH GERMINAL CENTER IMMUNOPHENOTYPE%' OR UPPER(DIAGNOSIS) LIKE '%LOW GRADE B CELL LYMPHOMA WITH PLASMACYTIC DIFFERENTIATION%' OR UPPER(DIAGNOSIS) LIKE '%LOW-GRADE B-CELL LYMPHOMA%' OR UPPER(DIAGNOSIS) LIKE '%LOW-GRADE B CELL LYMPHOMA%' OR UPPER(DIAGNOSIS) LIKE '%LOW GRADE B-CELL LYMPHOMA%' OR UPPER(DIAGNOSIS) LIKE '%LOW GRADE B CELL LYMPHOMA%' OR UPPER(DIAGNOSIS) LIKE '%LOW-GRADE FOLLICULAR LYMPHOMA%' OR UPPER(DIAGNOSIS) LIKE '%LOW GRADE FOLLICULAR LYMPHOMA%')) , SS AS (SELECT * FROM DX WHERE "SPECIMENS SUBMITTED" LIKE '%PERIPHERAL%BLOOD%' ) SELECT * FROM SS ORDER BY 1, 10

prompt: Provide a list of patients with ATM mutations
completion: WITH PTS AS (SELECT PT_MRN, PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID DEID, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, YEAR(CURRENT date - PT_BIRTH_DTE) CURRENT_AGE, PRPT_PROCEDURE_DTE, PRPT_REPORT_DTE, PDRX_ACCESSION_NO, T.* FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML LEFT JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V ON PDRX_ACCESSION_NO = PRPT_ACCESSION_NO INNER JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML_SETTINGS ON PDRX_PATH_DMP_RESULTS_XML_ID = PDRXS_PATH_DMP_RESULTS_XML_ID INNER JOIN DVDMC.PATHOLOGY_DMP_WEBSVC_SETTINGS ON PDRXS_SETTING_ID = PDWS_SETTING_ID INNER JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON PDRX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID, XMLTABLE('$c/root/*' PASSING PDRX_XML_VALUE AS "c" COLUMNS VARIANT_CLASS VARCHAR(100) PATH 'variant_class', SITE1_GENE VARCHAR(100) PATH 'site1_gene', SITE2_GENE VARCHAR(100) PATH 'site2_gene', GENE_ID VARCHAR(100) PATH 'gene_id', EXON_NUM VARCHAR(100) PATH 'exon_num', AA_CHANGE VARCHAR(100) PATH 'aa_change', CDNA_CHANGE VARCHAR(100) PATH 'cDNA_change', GENE_FOLD_CHANGE VARCHAR(100) PATH 'gene_fold_change', VARIANT_TYPE VARCHAR(100) PATH './local-name(.)', PROJECT VARCHAR(100) PATH '../meta-data/dmp_alys_task_name', SAMPLEID VARCHAR(100) PATH '../meta-data/dmp_sample_id', PATIENTID VARCHAR(100) PATH '../meta-data/dmp_patient_id', TUMOR_TYPE_CODE VARCHAR(100) PATH '../meta-data/tumor_type_code', TUMOR_TYPE_NAME VARCHAR(255) PATH '../meta-data/tumor_type_name', IS_METASTASIS VARCHAR(10) PATH '../meta-data/is_metastasis', PRIMARY_SITE VARCHAR(255) PATH '../meta-data/primary_site', METASTASIS_SITE VARCHAR(255) PATH '../meta-data/metastasis_site', MSI_COMMENT VARCHAR(264) PATH 'msi-comment', MSI_SCORE VARCHAR(264) PATH 'msi-score', MSI_TYPE VARCHAR(264) PATH 'msi-type') T WHERE (GENE_ID IN ('ATM') OR SITE1_GENE IN ('ATM') OR SITE2_GENE IN ('ATM')) AND PRPT_PROCEDURE_DTE >= CURRENT date - 7 DAYS ) , PTS_D AS (SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN, DEID FROM PTS) , NEXT_MD AS (SELECT PT_MRN NEXT_MD_MRN, DEID, MIN(DT_DTE) NEXT_MD_VISIT_DATE FROM PTS_D JOIN DV.PATIENT_ENCOUNTER ON DEID = PENC_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID JOIN DV.ENCOUNTER_SCHD_RESOURCES ON PENC_PT_ENC_ID = ENSR_PT_ENC_ID AND ENSR_PRIMARY_RES_IND = 'Y' JOIN DV.ENCOUNTER_RESOURCE ON ENSR_RES_ID = ENR_ENC_RES_ID JOIN DV.DATE ON PENC_ENC_DATE_ID = DT_DATE_ID WHERE PENC_APPT_STS IN ('Sch') AND ENR_RES_TYP = 'Physician' GROUP BY PT_MRN, DEID ) , PRIM_MD AS (SELECT PT_MRN PRIM_MD_MRN, DEID, ENR_RES_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT PENC_ENC_CSN_ID) VISIT_CNT, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY PT_MRN, DEID ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT PENC_ENC_CSN_ID) DESC) RN FROM PTS_D JOIN DV.PATIENT_ENCOUNTER ON DEID = PENC_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID JOIN DV.ENCOUNTER_SCHD_RESOURCES ON PENC_PT_ENC_ID = ENSR_PT_ENC_ID AND ENSR_PRIMARY_RES_IND = 'Y' JOIN DV.ENCOUNTER_RESOURCE ON ENSR_RES_ID = ENR_ENC_RES_ID JOIN DV.DATE ON PENC_ENC_DATE_ID = DT_DATE_ID WHERE PENC_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND ENR_RES_TYP = 'Physician' GROUP BY PT_MRN, DEID, ENR_RES_NAME ) , RT AS (SELECT RTC_TX_MRN, LISTAGG('Start: ' || RTC_TX_START_DTE || ' Stop: ' || RTC_TX_STOP_DTE || ' ' || RTC_TX_PLAN_NAME || ' ' || RTC_TX_DELIVERED_DOSE, CHR(13)||CHR(10)) RT FROM PTS_D JOIN IDB.RADONC_TREATMENT_COURSE ON PT_MRN = RTC_TX_MRN GROUP BY RTC_TX_MRN) , SCAN AS (SELECT PBD_MRN, MAX(PBD_SVC_DTE) MOST_RECENT_SCAN_DATE FROM PTS_D JOIN IDB.PBD_DTL ON PT_MRN = PBD_MRN JOIN IDB.PBD_CODE ON PBD_PBD_CD = PBC_PBD_CD JOIN IDB.CLM ON PBC_CPT_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE CLM_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'C%' AND CLM_CLSF_CD LIKE '7%' AND (CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK LIKE '%ULTRASOUND%' OR CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK LIKE '%US %' OR CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK LIKE '%MR%' OR CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK LIKE '% CT %' OR CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK LIKE 'CT %') GROUP BY PBD_MRN ) SELECT PT_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, CURRENT_AGE, PRPT_PROCEDURE_DTE, PRPT_REPORT_DTE, PDRX_ACCESSION_NO, TUMOR_TYPE_NAME, PRIMARY_SITE, VARIANT_TYPE, AA_CHANGE, NEXT_MD_VISIT_DATE, PLA_LAST_CHEMO_DTE, RT, ENR_RES_NAME PRIM_MD, MOST_RECENT_SCAN_DATE FROM PTS P LEFT JOIN NEXT_MD ON PT_MRN = NEXT_MD_MRN LEFT JOIN PRIM_MD ON PT_MRN = PRIM_MD_MRN AND RN = 1 LEFT JOIN RT ON PT_MRN = RTC_TX_MRN LEFT JOIN SCAN ON PT_MRN = PBD_MRN JOIN DV.PATIENT_LATEST_ACTIVITY ON P.DEID = PLA_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID

prompt: Provide the total number of patients with a diagnosis of breast cancer who have a GLP1 receptor agonist medication in their Outpatient Medication List.
completion: WITH DRUGS AS (SELECT DISTINCT STRIP(HCPR_MRN) AS "MRN" , STRIP(HGN_GENERIC_NAME) AS "Generic Name" , CASE HCPR_STATUS_TYPE WHEN 1 THEN 'Active' WHEN 4 THEN 'Cancelled' WHEN 7 THEN 'Completed' WHEN 3 THEN 'Discontinued' WHEN 8 THEN 'EnteredInError' WHEN 2 THEN 'Inactive' WHEN 6 THEN 'NoLongerTaking' WHEN 5 THEN 'Unapproved' END AS "Prescription Status" , CASE WHEN HCPR_PRESCRIPTION_TYPE = 1 THEN 'eRx' WHEN HCPR_PRESCRIPTION_TYPE = 3 THEN 'HML' ELSE 'Oth' END AS "Rx Type" FROM IDB.HML_CLIENT_PRESCRIPTION LEFT JOIN IDB.HML_GENERIC_NAME ON HGN_GENERIC_NAME_ID = HCPR_GENERIC_NAME_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.HML_RX_UNIT_OF_MEASURE UOM ON UOM.HRUM_RXUOM_ID = HCPR_DOSE_UOM_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.HML_RX_UNIT_OF_MEASURE PKG ON PKG.HRUM_RXUOM_ID = HCPR_INNER_PACKAGE_SIZE_UOM_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.HML_SCRIPT_FREQUENCY ON HSF_SCRIPT_FREQ_ID = HCPR_SCRIPT_FREQ_ID WHERE LOWER(HGN_GENERIC_NAME) IN ('dulaglutide', 'albiglutide', 'liraglutide', 'semaglutide', 'exenatide', 'lixisenatide', 'tirzepatide') AND HCPR_STATUS_TYPE IN (1, 2, 3, 6, 7) AND DATE(HCPR_START_DT) IS NOT NULL AND(HCPR_PRESCRIPTION_TYPE = 1 AND HCPR_TRANSMISSION_STATUS IN (1, 2, 5) OR HCPR_PRESCRIPTION_TYPE = 3)), BREAST_CA AS (SELECT DISTINCT TM_MRN AS MRN FROM (SELECT DISTINCT MRN FROM DRUGS)AS DRUGS_MRN JOIN IDB.CDB_TUMOR ON MRN=TM_MRN JOIN IDB.SEERGROUPING ON RECODE = IDB.SEERF_ICDO(TM_SITE_CD, TM_HIST_CD) AND CATEGORY1 = 'Breast' JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD WHERE 1=1 AND TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') UNION SELECT DISTINCT CC_MRN AS MRN FROM (SELECT DISTINCT MRN FROM DRUGS)AS DRUGS_MRN JOIN IDB.CTC_CLSF ON MRN=CC_MRN JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE ((CLM_CLSF_CD LIKE 'C50%' OR CLM_CLSF_CD LIKE 'C174%' OR CLM_CLSF_CD LIKE 'C175%') OR CC_CLSF_CD IN ('174', '174.1', '174.2', '174.3', '174.4', '174.5', '174.6', '174.8', '174.9', '175', '175.9')) AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND 1=1 AND ((CC_PT_TYPE = 'I') OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) ), BRCA_WITH_DRUG AS (SELECT D.* FROM BREAST_CA B JOIN DRUGS D ON B.MRN=D.MRN) SELECT "Rx Type", COUNT(DISTINCT MRN) AS "Unique MRN count" FROM BRCA_WITH_DRUG GROUP BY "Rx Type"

prompt: We'd like to pull data with the same parameters as was requested in MKT26742 for the last 3 months, as well as the 3 months before that (up to 6 months ago).

Comp' GROUP BY CADENCE_PT_ID, MRN), NOT_CONVERTED AS (SELECT IAP_DATE_NULL.*, JULY_VISITS.MRN, JULY_VISITS.MOSTRECENTVISITDATEINJULY FROM IAP_DATE_NULL INNER JOIN JULY_VISITS ON IAP_DATE_NULL.PT_ID = JULY_VISITS.CADENCE_PT_ID) , NO_PRE_EXISITING_TREATMENT_DATE AS (SELECT NC.* FROM NOT_CONVERTED NC LEFT JOIN DBO.MIDB_IAP MI ON NC.MRN = MI.MRN WHERE MI.MIN_TX_DTE IS NULL), ORAL_TREATMENT AS (SELECT ND.* FROM NO_PRE_EXISITING_TREATMENT_DATE ND ) , MAX_APPT_DT AS (SELECT OT.PT_ID, OT.MRN, MAX(CPE_APPT_DT) AS 'MaxApptDt', CPE_CPE_APPT_STS, OT.MOSTRECENTVISITDATEINJULY FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER CPE INNER JOIN ORAL_TREATMENT OT ON CPE.CPE_CL_PT_ID = OT.PT_ID LEFT JOIN DBO.ACCESSMSK_VISIT_TYPE CVT ON CPE.CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT.VISIT_TYPE_ID GROUP BY OT.PT_ID, OT.MRN, CPE_CPE_APPT_STS, OT.MOSTRECENTVISITDATEINJULY), MAX_APPT_STS AS ( (SELECT * FROM (SELECT PT_ID, MRN, MAXAPPTDT, CPE_CPE_APPT_STS, MOSTRECENTVISITDATEINJULY, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY PT_ID ORDER BY MAXAPPTDT DESC) AS RN FROM MAX_APPT_DT) T WHERE T.RN = 1)) SELECT MS.*, P.PT_NAME, P.SEX, P.CURRENT_AGE, P.HOME_PHONE, P.MOBILE_PHONE, P.[LANGUAGE] FROM MAX_APPT_STS MS LEFT JOIN ACCESSMSK_PATIENT P ON MS.PT_ID = P.CADENCE_PT_ID

AND(UPPER(CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME) LIKE '%LENALIDOMIDE%' OR UPPER(APR_GENERIC_NAME) LIKE '%LENALIDOMIDE%' OR UPPER(APR_DRUG_NAME) LIKE '%LENALIDOMIDE%') AND APR_ORD_RX_TYPE = 'Rx' GROUP BY APR_MRN, CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME ) , EMAR AS (SELECT DISTINCT OO_MRN AS MRN, CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME, LENALIDOMIDE_START_DATE, LENALIDOMIDE_END_DATE , OO_ORD_NAME, OOTO_SIGNIFIC_DTE AS ADMIN_DATE , UPPER(OO_ORD_NAME) LIKE '%DUPILUMAB%' ) , X AS (SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN AS MRN, STRIP(PT_LAST_NAME) || ', ' || STRIP(PT_FIRST_NAME) AS "Name", PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH AS DOB, PT_SEX AS GENDER, R.AV_DESC AS 'PT_ETHNICITY') SELECT * FROM X , TM1 AS (SELECT DISTINCT TM_MRN AS MRN, TM_DX_DTE AS DX_DATE, TM_HIST_CD AS HIST_CODE, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS HIST_DESC FROM X JOIN IDB.CDB_TUMOR ON TM_MRN = MRN JOIN IDB.SEERGROUPING ON RECODE = IDB.SEERF_ICDO(TM_SITE_CD, TM_HIST_CD) AND CATEGORY1 IN ('Myeloma', 'Leukemia', 'Lymphoma') JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS AJCC7 ON AJCC7.AV_ELEMENT = 'AJCC_7' AND AJCC7.AV_CODE = TM_AJCC_7 LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS AJCC ON AJCC.AV_ELEMENT = 'AJCC' AND AJCC.AV_CODE = TM_AJCC LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS GS ON GS.AV_ELEMENT = 'GENERAL_STG' AND GS.AV_CODE = TM_GENERAL_STG LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS CLIN ON CLIN.AV_ELEMENT = 'CLIN_STG_DSCR' AND CLIN.AV_CODE = TM_CLIN_STG_DSCR WHERE 1=1 AND TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') UNION SELECT CC_MRN AS MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS DX_DATE, CLM_CLSF_CD AS HIST_CODE, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS HIST_DESC FROM X JOIN IDB.CTC_CLSF ON CC_MRN = MRN JOIN CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND ((CC_PT_TYPE = 'I') OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) GROUP BY CC_MRN, CLM_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK ) , TM AS (SELECT MRN, LISTAGG(COALESCE(STRIP(CAST(DX_DATE AS VARCHAR(12000))), '') || ' | ' || COALESCE(STRIP(CAST(HIST_CODE AS VARCHAR(12000))), '') || ' | ' || COALESCE(STRIP(CAST(HIST_DESC AS VARCHAR(12000))), '') , LENALIDOMIDE_START_DATE, MAX(APR_END_DTE) AS LENALIDOMIDE_END_DATE FROM IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX_V WHERE 1=1 AND(UPPER(CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME) LIKE '%LENALIDOMIDE%' OR UPPER(APR_GENERIC_NAME) LIKE '%LENALIDOMIDE%' OR UPPER(APR_DRUG_NAME) LIKE '%LENALIDOMIDE%') AND APR_ORD_RX_TYPE = 'Rx' GROUP BY APR_MRN, CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME ) , ERX AS (SELECT HCPR_MRN AS MRN , CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME, LENALIDOMIDE_START_DATE, LENALIDOMIDE_END_DATE , HCPR_PRESCRIPTION_ID RX_ID , HCPR_CREATED_DTE RX_CREATE_DATE , DATE(HCPR_START_DT) START_DATE , DATE(HCPR_END_DT) AS END_DATE , DATE(HCPR_DISCONTINUE_DT) AS DISCONTINUE_DATE , HCPR_DRUG_NAME AS DRUG_NAME , HGN_GENERIC_NAME AS GENERIC_NAME , HCPR_STATUS_TYPE_DESC AS PRESCRIPTION_STATUS , HCPR_PRESCRIPTION_TYPE_DESC AS RX_TYPE , HCPR_DOSE_AMT AS DOSE_AMT , UOM.HRUM_NAME UOM , UOM.HRUM_DESCRIPTION UOM_DESC , HCPR_ROUTE AS ROUTE , HCPR_NDC AS NDC , REQ.OU_DISPLAY_NAME AS "Requester", REQ.OU_ORD_ROLE_TYPE AS "Requester Role" FROM APR JOIN IDB.HML_CLIENT_PRESCRIPTION ON HCPR_MRN = APR_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_CLIENT_VISIT ON OCV_VISIT_GUID = HCPR_VISIT_GUID LEFT JOIN IDB.HML_GENERIC_NAME ON HGN_GENERIC_NAME_ID = HCPR_GENERIC_NAME_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_USER USR ON USR.OU_USER_GUID = HCPR_USER_GUID LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_USER REQ ON REQ.OU_USER_GUID = HCPR_CARE_PROV_GUID LEFT JOIN IDB.HML_RX_UNIT_OF_MEASURE UOM ON UOM.HRUM_RXUOM_ID = HCPR_DOSE_UOM_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.HML_RX_UNIT_OF_MEASURE PKG ON PKG.HRUM_RXUOM_ID = HCPR_INNER_PACKAGE_SIZE_UOM_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.HML_SCRIPT_FREQUENCY ON HSF_SCRIPT_FREQ_ID = HCPR_SCRIPT_FREQ_ID WHERE HCPR_STATUS_TYPE NOT IN (4, 5, 8) AND HCPR_CREATED_DTE IS NOT NULL AND((HCPR_PRESCRIPTION_TYPE = 1 AND HCPR_TRANSMISSION_STATUS IN (1, 2, 5) ) OR HCPR_PRESCRIPTION_TYPE = 3) AND (UPPER(HCPR_DRUG_NAME) LIKE '%DUPILUMAB%' OR UPPER(HGN_GENERIC_NAME) LIKE '%DUPILUMAB%') ) , X AS (SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN AS MRN, STRIP(PT_LAST_NAME) || ', ' || STRIP(PT_FIRST_NAME) AS "Name", PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH AS DOB, PT_SEX AS GENDER, R.AV_DESC AS "Race", E.AV_DESC AS "Ethnicity", CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME, LENALIDOMIDE_START_DATE, LENALIDOMIDE_END_DATE , RX_ID , RX_CREATE_DATE , START_DATE , END_DATE , DISCONTINUE_DATE , DRUG_NAME , GENERIC_NAME , PRESCRIPTION_STATUS , RX_TYPE , DOSE_AMT , UOM FROM ERX JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON ERX.MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY ON PT_MRN = PLA_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS R ON PT_RACE = R.AV_CODE AND R.AV_ELEMENT = 'RACE' LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS E ON PT_PT_ETHNICITY = E.AV_CODE AND E.AV_ELEMENT = 'PT_ETHNICITY') SELECT * FROM X WITH X AS (SELECT PT_MRN AS MRN FROM IDB.PATIENT WHERE PT_MRN IN () ) , TM1 AS (SELECT DISTINCT TM_MRN AS MRN, TM_DX_DTE AS DX_DATE, TM_HIST_CD AS HIST_CODE, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS HIST_DESC FROM X JOIN IDB.CDB_TUMOR ON TM_MRN = MRN JOIN IDB.SEERGROUPING ON RECODE = IDB.SEERF_ICDO(TM_SITE_CD, TM_HIST_CD) AND CATEGORY1 IN ('Myeloma', 'Leukemia', 'Lymphoma') JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS AJCC7 ON AJCC7.AV_ELEMENT = 'AJCC_7' AND AJCC7.AV_CODE = TM_AJCC_7 LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS AJCC ON AJCC.AV_ELEMENT = 'AJCC' AND AJCC.AV_CODE = TM_AJCC LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS GS ON GS.AV_ELEMENT = 'GENERAL_STG' AND GS.AV_CODE = TM_GENERAL_STG LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS CLIN ON CLIN.AV_ELEMENT = 'CLIN_STG_DSCR' AND CLIN.AV_CODE = TM_CLIN_STG_DSCR WHERE 1=1 AND TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') UNION SELECT CC_MRN AS MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS DX_DATE, CLM_CLSF_CD AS HIST_CODE, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS HIST_DESC FROM X JOIN IDB.CTC_CLSF ON CC_MRN = MRN JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.SEERGROUPING ON RECODE = MIN(IDB.SEERF_ICD9(CLM_CLSF_CD), IDB.SEERF_ICD10(CLM_CLSF_CD)) AND CATEGORY1 IN ('Myeloma', 'Leukemia', 'Lymphoma') WHERE CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND ((CC_PT_TYPE = 'I') OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) GROUP BY CC_MRN, CLM_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK ) SELECT MRN, LISTAGG(COALESCE(STRIP(CAST(DX_DATE AS VARCHAR(12000))), '') || ' | ' || COALESCE(STRIP(CAST(HIST_CODE AS VARCHAR(12000))), '') || ' | ' || COALESCE(STRIP(CAST(HIST_DESC AS VARCHAR(12000))), '') , CHR(13) || CHR(10)) WITHIN GROUP( ORDER BY MRN, DX_DATE) AS DX FROM TM1 GROUP BY MRN

prompt: List of pediatric patient who died from July 2021 to June 2022 and were under the age of 25 during their initial encounter.
completion: SELECT CPE_MRN MRN, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, PT_DATE_OF_DEATH, YEAR(PT_DATE_OF_DEATH - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) AS AGE_OF_DEATH, MIN(YEAR(CPE_ENC_DTE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH)) AS "AGE_INITIAL_ENCOUNTER", PT_ADDR1, PT_ADDR2, PT_EMAIL_ADDRESS, PT_PHONE, CL_MOBILE_PHONE, AV_DESC AS "LANGUAGE", PLA_DONOT_MAIL_IND FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON CPE_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_PATIENT ON PT_MRN = CL_MRN JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY ON CL_MRN = PLA_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS A ON AV_CODE = CL_PRIMARY_LANG AND AV_ELEMENT = 'PRIMARY_LANG' WHERE 1=1 AND CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CRE_RES_TYP IN ('Physician') AND (CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 = ('PED') OR CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_4 = ('PED') OR CLD_DEPT_NAME = 'ORTHOPEDICS 1275-9') AND CPE_CPE_IP_IND <> 'INPATIENT' AND PT_DATE_OF_DEATH BETWEEN '2021-07-01' AND '2022-06-30' GROUP BY CPE_MRN, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, PT_DATE_OF_DEATH, YEAR(PT_DATE_OF_DEATH - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH), PT_ADDR1, PT_ADDR2, PT_EMAIL_ADDRESS, PT_PHONE, CL_MOBILE_PHONE, AV_DESC, PLA_DONOT_MAIL_IND HAVING MIN(YEAR(CPE_ENC_DTE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH)) < 25 ORDER BY CPE_MRN;

prompt: Provide a list of surgical pathology reports for patients diagnosed with carcinoma ex-pleomorphic
completion: WITH DIAGNOSIS AS (SELECT DISTINCT CC_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME AS "Last Name", PT_FIRST_NAME AS "First Name", G.AV_DESC AS GENDER, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH AS "Date of Birth", PT_DATE_OF_DEATH AS "Date of Death", R.AV_DESC AS RACE, PFA_FST_ACTV_DTE, PLA_LST_ACTV_DTE, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS ICD_EFF_DTE, CC_CLSF_CD AS ICD_CODE, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS ICD_DESC FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON CC_MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS R ON R.AV_ELEMENT = 'RACE' AND R.AV_CODE = PT_RACE LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS G ON G.AV_ELEMENT = 'SEX' AND G.AV_CODE = PT_SEX JOIN IDB.PT_FIRST_ACTIVITY ON CC_MRN = PFA_MRN JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY ON CC_MRN = PLA_MRN WHERE CC_CLSF_CD IN ('C07', 'C08.0', 'C08.9') AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND (CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) GROUP BY CC_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, G.AV_DESC, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, PT_DATE_OF_DEATH, R.AV_DESC, PFA_FST_ACTV_DTE, PLA_LST_ACTV_DTE, CC_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK HAVING MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) BETWEEN '2016-01-01' AND '2021-12-31'), PATHOLOGY AS (SELECT DISTINCT PRPT_MRN, PRPT_REPORT_DTE, PRPT_ACCESSION_NO, PRPT_REPORT_TYPE_DESC, VARCHAR(PRPT_REPORT, 32000) AS REPORT_TXT FROM DIAGNOSIS JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V ON CC_MRN = PRPT_MRN WHERE PRPT_REPORT IS NOT NULL AND PRPT_REPORT_DTE BETWEEN '2016-01-01' AND '2021-12-31' AND PRPT_REPORT_TYPE_DESC = 'Surgical Pathology' AND CONTAINS("PRPT_REPORT", '("pleomorphic")') = 1 AND CONTAINS("PRPT_REPORT", '("carcinoma")') = 1 ) SELECT DISTINCT CC_MRN AS MRN, "Last Name", "First Name", GENDER, "Date of Birth", "Date of Death", RACE, PFA_FST_ACTV_DTE AS "Patient First Visit", PLA_LST_ACTV_DTE AS "Patient Last Visit", ICD_EFF_DTE AS "ICD-10 Date", ICD_CODE AS "ICD-10 Code", ICD_DESC AS "ICD-10 Description", PRPT_REPORT_DTE AS "Pathology Report Date", PRPT_ACCESSION_NO AS "Accession Number", PRPT_REPORT_TYPE_DESC AS "Pathology Report Type Description", REPORT_TXT AS "Pathology Report Text" FROM DIAGNOSIS JOIN PATHOLOGY ON CC_MRN = PRPT_MRN

prompt: Change the data source for the diagnose code column. Use data from Operative Report – Surgery-Hepatopancreatobiliary instead of physician billing.  Use PreOp Diagnosis and PostOp.
completion: WITH PTS AS (SELECT DISTINCT VIS_MRN, VIS_ADM_NUM, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, (TRIM(PT_LAST_NAME) CONCAT ', ' CONCAT TRIM(PT_FIRST_NAME)) AS PT_NAME, VIS_ADM_DTE, VIS_DSCH_DTE, VIS_DAYS_STAY, VIS_IP_OP_ADJUSTED_IND, ADM_DR_NAME, ATN_DR_NAME FROM IDB.VISIT_V JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON VIS_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE 1=1 AND VIS_DSCH_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT date - 31 DAYS AND CURRENT date - 1 DAY AND VIS_HOSP_SVC = 'HEP' AND VIS_IP_OP_ADJUSTED_IND = 'I' ) , CLINDOC_DX AS (SELECT CDD_MRN, CDO_VALUE_TEXT AS CLINDOC_DX FROM IDB.CD_DOCUMENT LEFT JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION ON CDD_DOC_GUID = CDO_DOC_GUID AND CDD_AUTHORED_DTE = CDO_AUTHORED_DTE AND CDO_VALUE_TEXT <> '' JOIN IDB.OMS_PROVIDER ON CDD_AUTH_PROV_GUID = OP_PVDR_GUID JOIN PTS ON VIS_MRN = CDD_MRN AND CDD_SERVICE_DTE BETWEEN VIS_ADM_DTE AND VIS_DSCH_DTE WHERE CDD_CANCEL_IND <> '1' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND <> '1' AND CDD_DOC_NAME = 'Operative Report - Surgery-Hepatopancreatobiliary' AND CDO_ITEM_NAME = 'PreOp Diagnosis' ) , PBD_DX AS (SELECT DISTINCT PBD_MRN , LISTAGG(' | ' || TRIM(DX_CLSF_CD) || ' - ' || TRIM(CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK) || ' | ', CHR(13) || CHR(10)) WITHIN GROUP( ORDER BY DX_CLSF_CD) AS PBD_DX FROM (SELECT DISTINCT PBD_MRN, DX_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK FROM IDB.PBD_DTL JOIN PTS ON VIS_MRN = PBD_MRN JOIN IDB.PBD_DX ON PBD_MRN = DX_MRN AND PBD_INV_NO = DX_INV_NO AND DX_CLSF_CD BETWEEN 'C00' AND 'D49' JOIN IDB.CLM ON DX_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE 1=1 AND PBD_SVC_DTE BETWEEN VIS_ADM_DTE AND VIS_DSCH_DTE ) A GROUP BY PBD_MRN ) , PROCEDURES AS (SELECT DISTINCT SSE_MRN, SSE_SURG_DTE, (TRIM(SSP_SURG_LAST_NM) CONCAT ', ' CONCAT TRIM(SSP_SURG_FIRST_NM)) AS SURG_NAME, LISTAGG(' | ' || TRIM(SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC) || ' | ', CHR(13) || CHR(10)) WITHIN GROUP( ORDER BY SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC) AS SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC FROM IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE ON SSE_LOG_ID = SSP_LOG_ID AND SSP_SURG_SVC_CD = 'HEP' JOIN IDB.VISIT_V ON VIS_MRN = SSE_MRN WHERE 1=1 AND VIS_DSCH_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT date - 31 DAYS AND CURRENT date - 1 DAY AND VIS_HOSP_SVC = 'HEP' AND VIS_IP_OP_ADJUSTED_IND = 'I' AND SSE_SURG_DTE BETWEEN VIS_ADM_DTE AND VIS_DSCH_DTE GROUP BY SSE_MRN, SSE_SURG_DTE, (TRIM(SSP_SURG_LAST_NM) CONCAT ', ' CONCAT TRIM(SSP_SURG_FIRST_NM))) , COMPLICATIONS AS (SELECT DISTINCT SAE_MRN, LISTAGG(' | ' || DATE(SAE_TOX_OCCR_DT) || ' | ' || TRIM(SAE_TOXICITY_NAME) || ' | ' || TRIM(SAE_TOX_GRADE) || ' | ' || TRIM(SAE_TOX_GRADE_NAME) || ' | ', CHR(13) || CHR(10)) WITHIN GROUP( ORDER BY SAE_TOX_OCCR_DT) AS COMPLICATIONS FROM (SELECT DISTINCT SAE_MRN, SAE_TOX_OCCR_DT, SAE_TOXICITY_NAME, SAE_TOX_GRADE, SAE_TOX_GRADE_NAME FROM IDB.SRG_ADVERSE_EVENT WHERE 1=1 AND DATE(SAE_TOX_OCCR_DT) BETWEEN CURRENT date - 90 DAYS AND CURRENT date ) A GROUP BY SAE_MRN) SELECT A.* FROM (SELECT DISTINCT A.VIS_MRN "MRN", TRIM(A.PT_NAME) "PT Name", A.VIS_ADM_DTE "Admit Dte", A.VIS_DSCH_DTE "Discharge Dte", TRIM(A.VIS_DAYS_STAY) "Days stayed", TRIM(A.ATN_DR_NAME) "Attending Name", TRIM(CLINDOC_DX) "ClinDoc Dx", TRIM(PBD_DX) "PBD Dx", B.SSE_SURG_DTE "Procedure Date", TRIM(B.SURG_NAME) "Surgeon Name", TRIM(B.SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC) "Procedure Name", TRIM(COMPLICATIONS) "Complications" FROM PTS A LEFT JOIN PROCEDURES B ON A.VIS_MRN = B.SSE_MRN LEFT JOIN COMPLICATIONS ON A.VIS_MRN = SAE_MRN LEFT JOIN CLINDOC_DX ON A.VIS_MRN = CDD_MRN LEFT JOIN PBD_DX ON A.VIS_MRN = PBD_MRN) A ORDER BY TRIM("Attending Name"), "Discharge Dte" ASC ;

prompt: Provide distinct patient counts for patients with colon or rectal adenocarcinoma diagnosed in 2019
completion: WITH PTS AS (SELECT DISTINCT TM_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, PT_SEX, R.AV_DESC AS RACE, E.AV_DESC AS ETHNICITY, TM_DX_DTE, TM_SITE_CD AS SITE_CODE, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_DESC, TM_HIST_CD AS HIST_CODE, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS HIST_DESC, TM_CASE_STS, CS.AV_DESC AS CASE_STS_DESC, TM_CA_SURG_DTE, PLA_LST_APPT_DTE, PLA_LST_DSCH_DTE, PT_DATE_OF_DEATH FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM H ON TM_HIST_CD = H.CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON TM_SITE_CD = S.CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON TM_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY ON PT_MRN = PLA_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS CS ON CS.AV_ELEMENT = 'CASE_STS' AND CS.AV_CODE = TM_CASE_STS LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS R ON PT_RACE = R.AV_CODE AND R.AV_ELEMENT = 'RACE' LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS E ON PT_PT_ETHNICITY = E.AV_CODE AND E.AV_ELEMENT = 'PT_ETHNICITY' WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND TM_DX_DTE BETWEEN '2019-01-01' AND '2020-01-01' AND TM_SITE_CD BETWEEN 'C180' AND 'C209' AND TM_HIST_CD IN ('M8140/3', 'M8140/2', 'M8480/3') ) , SRG AS (SELECT DISTINCT SSE_MRN FROM PTS JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT ON TM_MRN = SSE_MRN JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE ON SSE_LOG_ID = SSP_LOG_ID JOIN IDB.CLM ON SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD IN ('44130', '49203', '49205', '49204', '22900', '21930', '21556', '45171', '11626', '11622', '44111', '45170', '49000', '44025', '44207', '44208', '44205', '44188', '44187', '45395', '44204', '49329', '44970', '49321', '58662', '44200', '44140', '44143', '44144', '44145', '44146', '22905', '45999', '44150', '44160', '44153', '44155', '45110', '45112', '45119', '45399') ) , CHEMO AS (SELECT DISTINCT APR_MRN FROM PTS JOIN IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX_V ON TM_MRN = APR_MRN WHERE CDG_CLASSIC_CHEMO_FLAG = 'Y' ) , MSKACCESS AS (SELECT DISTINCT OO_MRN FROM PTS JOIN IDB.OMS_ORDER ON TM_MRN = OO_MRN JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_CATALOG ON OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID = OOC_MSTR_ITEM_GUID WHERE OOC_ITEM_NAME = 'MSK-ACCESS cfDNA (for pts with Solid Tumor)' AND OO_ORD_STS_CD NOT IN ('CANP', 'CANC', 'AUC3') ) SELECT SITE_CODE, SITE_DESC, HIST_CODE, HIST_DESC, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN SSE_MRN IS NOT NULL THEN SSE_MRN END) SRG_CNT, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN APR_MRN IS NOT NULL THEN APR_MRN END) CHEMO_CNT, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN OO_MRN IS NOT NULL THEN OO_MRN END) MSKACCESS_CNT FROM PTS LEFT JOIN SRG ON TM_MRN = SSE_MRN LEFT JOIN CHEMO ON TM_MRN = APR_MRN LEFT JOIN MSKACCESS ON TM_MRN = OO_MRN GROUP BY SITE_CODE, SITE_DESC, HIST_CODE, HIST_DESC

prompt: Can you please provide the demographic and insurance data of all MSK patients seen in 2023?
completion: WITH OPS AS (SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN AS OP_MRN, 'OP' AS OP, CPE_ENC_DTE, CLD_DEPT_NAME, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CLD_DEPT_ID = CPE_DEPT_ID AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 <> 'EHS' AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 NOT IN ('MSKACCESS', 'PFS') WHERE CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN '2023-01-01' AND '2023-12-31' AND CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Comp', 'Arrived') AND CPE_CPE_IP_IND <> 'INPATIENT' AND CPE_ENC_TYP_CD = 50 ) , IPS AS (SELECT DISTINCT VIS_MRN AS IP_MRN, 'IP' AS IP FROM IDB.VISIT_V WHERE 1=1 AND VIS_ADM_DTE BETWEEN '2023-01-01' AND '2023-12-31' AND VIS_IP_OP_ADJUSTED_IND = 'I' ) , ALLPTS AS (SELECT OP_MRN AS MRN FROM OPS UNION SELECT IP_MRN AS MRN FROM IPS) , FCDATE AS (SELECT MRN AS MRNFC, MAX(VIS_ADM_DTE) AS MAXADMDTE FROM ALLPTS JOIN IDB.VISIT_V ON MRN = VIS_MRN AND VIS_PATIENT_TYPE <> 'OPRE' AND VIS_VISIT_STATUS IN ('2', '3') GROUP BY MRN) , FC AS (SELECT DISTINCT MRNFC, MAXADMDTE, CASE WHEN RVPM_FSC_CAT_NAME = 'SELF PAY' THEN 'SELFPAY' WHEN RVPM_FSC_CAT_NAME LIKE 'MEDICAID%' THEN 'MEDICAID' WHEN RVPM_FSC_CAT_NAME LIKE 'MEDICARE%' THEN 'MEDICARE' WHEN RVPM_FSC_CAT_NAME IN ('ADMIN', 'MSK EMPLOYEE', 'PAT REP ADMIN') THEN 'OTHER' ELSE 'PRIVATE' END AS INSURANCE FROM FCDATE JOIN IDB.RMS_VISIT_FSC_CAT_MAP_V ON RVPM_MRN = MRNFC AND RVPM_ADM_DTE = MAXADMDTE) , MAXFC AS (SELECT DISTINCT A.MRNFC, MAXADMDTE, INSURANCE FROM FC A JOIN (SELECT MRNFC, MAX(MAXADMDTE) AS MAXMAXADMDTE FROM FC GROUP BY MRNFC) AS X ON A.MRNFC = X.MRNFC AND MAXADMDTE = MAXMAXADMDTE), RAW_DATA AS (SELECT DISTINCT MRN, OP, IP, YEAR(CURRENT DATE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) AS AGE, PT_SEX AS GENDER, R.AV_DESC AS RACE, E.AV_DESC AS ETHNIC, INSURANCE, PT_COUNTRY, PT_STATE , CASE WHEN ZC_COUNTY IN ('Kings', 'Queens', 'Bronx', 'New York', 'Richmond') THEN ZC_COUNTY ELSE '' END AS NY_BORO FROM ALLPTS LEFT JOIN OPS ON MRN = OP_MRN LEFT JOIN IPS ON MRN = IP_MRN JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON MRN = PT_MRN AND PT_MRN <> '' LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS R ON R.AV_ELEMENT = 'RACE' AND R.AV_CODE = PT_RACE LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS E ON E.AV_ELEMENT = 'PT_ETHNICITY' AND E.AV_CODE = PT_PT_ETHNICITY LEFT JOIN IDB.ZIPCODE ON ZC_ZIP = SUBSTR(PT_ZIP_CD, 1, 5) LEFT JOIN MAXFC ON MRN = MRNFC) SELECT AGE, GENDER, RACE, ETHNIC, INSURANCE, PT_COUNTRY, PT_STATE, NY_BORO, COUNT (DISTINCT MRN) AS NO_OF_PATIENTS FROM RAW_DATA GROUP BY AGE, GENDER, RACE, ETHNIC, INSURANCE, PT_COUNTRY, PT_STATE, NY_BORO ;

prompt: Grant IDGU and CAISAPP select access to a view of HML tables for a feed from IDB to Caisis.
completion: WITH GENDRUG AS (SELECT DISTINCT HGN_GENERIC_NAME, OCDX_DRUG_KEY CAT_DRUG_KEY, CASE WHEN (C2.ODC_CATEGORY_NAME = ' ' OR C2.ODC_CATEGORY_NAME IS NULL) THEN C1.ODC_CATEGORY_NAME WHEN (C3.ODC_CATEGORY_NAME = ' ' OR C3.ODC_CATEGORY_NAME IS NULL) THEN C2.ODC_CATEGORY_NAME CONCAT ' | ' CONCAT C1.ODC_CATEGORY_NAME ELSE C3.ODC_CATEGORY_NAME CONCAT ' | ' CONCAT C2.ODC_CATEGORY_NAME END AS CATEGORY_NAME FROM IDB.HML_GENERIC_NAME JOIN IDB.OMS_CATEGORY_DRUG_XREF ON HGN_DRUG_CATALOG_KEY = OCDX_DRUG_KEY JOIN IDB.OMS_DRUG_CATEGORIES C1 ON C1.ODC_MULTUM_CATEGORY_ID = OCDX_MULTUM_CATEGORY_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_CATEGORY_SUB_XREF L2 ON C1.ODC_MULTUM_CATEGORY_ID = L2.OCSX_SUB_CATEGORY_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_DRUG_CATEGORIES C2 ON C2.ODC_MULTUM_CATEGORY_ID = L2.OCSX_MULTUM_CATEGORY_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_CATEGORY_SUB_XREF L3 ON L2.OCSX_MULTUM_CATEGORY_ID = L3.OCSX_SUB_CATEGORY_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_DRUG_CATEGORIES C3 ON C3.ODC_MULTUM_CATEGORY_ID = L3.OCSX_MULTUM_CATEGORY_ID) , DRUGRN AS (SELECT DISTINCT CAT_DRUG_KEY, HGN_GENERIC_NAME, CATEGORY_NAME , ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CAT_DRUG_KEY ORDER BY CATEGORY_NAME) RN FROM GENDRUG) , DRUG AS (SELECT CAT_DRUG_KEY, HGN_GENERIC_NAME , MAX(CASE WHEN RN = 1 THEN CATEGORY_NAME END)|| MAX(CASE WHEN RN = 2 THEN '; '||STRIP(CATEGORY_NAME) ELSE '' END)|| MAX(CASE WHEN RN = 3 THEN '; '||STRIP(CATEGORY_NAME) ELSE '' END)|| MAX(CASE WHEN RN = 4 THEN '; '||STRIP(CATEGORY_NAME) ELSE '' END) THERAP_CATEGORY FROM DRUGRN GROUP BY CAT_DRUG_KEY, HGN_GENERIC_NAME) , DRUGCAT AS (SELECT DISTINCT CAT_DRUG_KEY, HGN_GENERIC_NAME GENERIC_NAME, THERAP_CATEGORY, CHEMO_IND FROM DRUG LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT CPO_ORD_NAME, CPO_DRUG_NAME, 'Y' CHEMO_IND FROM IDB.CHEMO_PERFORMED_ORDERS WHERE CPO_CHEMO_IND = 'Y' AND RIGHT(STRIP(CPO_ORD_NAME), 1) <> '*' ) AS CHM ON THERAP_CATEGORY like '%antineoplast%' AND HGN_GENERIC_NAME <> 'mesna' AND (LOCATE(UPPER(STRIP(HGN_GENERIC_NAME)), UPPER(CPO_DRUG_NAME)) = 1 OR LOCATE(UPPER(STRIP(HGN_GENERIC_NAME)), UPPER(CPO_ORD_NAME)) = 1)) SELECT DISTINCT HCPR_PRESCRIPTION_ID RX_ID, HCPR_MRN MRN, HCPR_ACCT_NO ACCT_NO , OCV_VISIT_DTE VISIT_DTE, OCV_IP_OP_IND IP_OP_IND, HCPR_START_DT START_DT, HCPR_END_DT END_DT , HCPR_DRUG_NAME DRUG_NAME, HGN_GENERIC_NAME GENERIC_NAME , HGN_DRUG_CATALOG_KEY DRUG_KEY, THERAP_CATEGORY, CHEMO_IND , CASE HCPR_STATUS_TYPE WHEN 1 THEN 'Active' WHEN 4 THEN 'Cancelled' WHEN 7 THEN 'Completed' WHEN 3 THEN 'Discontinued' WHEN 8 THEN 'EnteredInError' WHEN 2 THEN 'Inactive' WHEN 6 THEN 'NoLongerTaking' WHEN 5 THEN 'Unapproved' END STATUS_TYPE , CASE WHEN HCPR_PRESCRIPTION_TYPE = 1 THEN 'eRx' WHEN HCPR_PRESCRIPTION_TYPE = 3 THEN 'HML' ELSE 'Oth' END RX_TYPE , HCPR_DOSE_AMT DOSE_AMT, HCPR_ROUTE ROUTE, HCPR_IS_CONTINUOUS IS_CONTINUOUS , UOM.HRUM_NAME UOM, UOM.HRUM_DESCRIPTION UOM_DESC , PKG.HRUM_NAME PKG, PKG.HRUM_DESCRIPTION PKG_DESC , HSF_ABBREVIATIION FREQ_ABBR, HSF_DESCRIPTION FREQ_DESC , HSF_FREQ_MULTIPLIER FREQ_MULTIPLIER, HCPR_REFILLS REFILLS , HCPR_INSTRUCTIONS INSTRUCTIONS, HCPR_COMMENTS COMMENTS , HCPR_DISCONTINUE_DT DISCONTINUE_DT, HCPR_DENIAL_DT DENIAL_DT , HCPR_DENIAL_REASON DENIAL_REASON, HCPR_RX_REFERENCE_NUMBER RX_REFERENCE_NO , HCPR_NDC NDC, HCPR_IS_PRN IS_PRN, HCPR_PRN_REASON PRN_REASON , OCV_CARE_LVL VST_CARE_LVL, OCV_CURR_LOC VST_LOC, OCV_PVDR_NAME VST_PVDR_NAME , USR.OU_DISPLAY_NAME USER_NAME, USR.OU_ORD_ROLE_TYPE USER_ROLE , REQ.OU_DISPLAY_NAME REQUESTER_NAME, REQ.OU_ORD_ROLE_TYPE REQ_ROLE , HMRR_REVIEW_STATUS_TYPE REVIEW_STS_TYPE, HMRR_REVIEW_DT REVIEW_DT , REV.OU_DISPLAY_NAME REVIEWER_NAME, REV.OU_ORD_ROLE_TYPE REVIEWER_ROLE , HMRRD_ITEM_REV_STS_TYPE REV_STS_TYPE, HMRRD_LAST_DOSE_TAKEN LAST_DOSE_TAKEN , HMRRD_INFO_SOURCE INFO_SOURCE, HMRRD_FOLLOW_UP_REASON FOLLOW_UP_REASON , RPH_PHARMACY_NAME, RPH_ADDR1, RPH_ADDR2, RPH_CITY , RPH_STATE, RPH_POSTAL_CD, RPH_PHONE_AREA_CD, RPH_PHONE_NUMBER , RPH_SPECIALTY_TYPE1, RPH_NPI FROM IDB.HML_CLIENT_PRESCRIPTION JOIN IDB.OMS_CLIENT_VISIT ON OCV_VISIT_GUID = HCPR_VISIT_GUID LEFT JOIN IDB.HML_GENERIC_NAME ON HGN_GENERIC_NAME_ID = HCPR_GENERIC_NAME_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_USER USR ON USR.OU_USER_GUID = HCPR_USER_GUID LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_USER REQ ON REQ.OU_USER_GUID = HCPR_CARE_PROV_GUID LEFT JOIN IDB.HML_RX_UNIT_OF_MEASURE UOM ON UOM.HRUM_RXUOM_ID = HCPR_DOSE_UOM_ID LEFT JOIN
