prompt: Provide data on patients accrued to protocol 08-060 or 06-127 with paracentesis.
completion: SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, CDD_AUTHORED_DTE, CDD_DOC_NAME FROM IDB.CD_DOCUMENT JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION ON CDD_DOC_GUID = CDO_DOC_GUID JOIN IDB.ACCRUALS ON AC_MRN = CDD_MRN JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PT_MRN = CDD_MRN WHERE (UCASE(CDO_VALUE_TEXT) like '%PARACENTESIS%' OR CDO_ITEM_NAME IN ('UCC_ParaProc_perform by ob', 'Paracentesis Indications', 'ucc_paraproc_perform by list restricted')) AND AC_IRB_NO IN ('08-060', '06-127') AND CDD_CANCEL_IND <> '1'

prompt: On-demand Darwin report that provides Measles, Mumps, Rubella, and Varicella titer results.
completion: WITH PTS AS (SELECT VIS_MRN, VIS_ADM_NUM, ADM_TYPE, ADM_TYPE_DESC, VIS_ADM_DTE, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, VIS_HOSP_SVC, HOSP_SVC_DESC, PATIENT_TYPE_DESC, VIS_NURS_STA, NURS_STA_DESC, VIS_ATN_DR_NO, ATN_DR_NAME, DOC_DR_NO, DOC_NAME, DOC_DR_STS FROM IDB.VISIT_V A JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON VIS_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.DOC ON VIS_ATN_DR_NO = DOC_DR_NO WHERE 1=1 AND VISIT_STATUS_DESC = 'ADMITTED' AND DOC_DR_NO NOT IN ('999999', '999998', '999995') ) , TITERS AS (SELECT LR_MRN, LR_PERFORMED_DTE, LR_TEST_NAME, LR_SUBTEST_NAME, LTL_TEXT_RESULT, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY LR_MRN, LR_SUBTEST_NAME ORDER BY LR_PERFORMED_DTE DESC) AS ORDERING FROM IDB.LAB_RESULTS JOIN IDB.LAB_TEXT_LINE ON LTL_RESULT_GUID = LR_RESULT_GUID JOIN IDB.LAB_CATALOG_ITEM ON LCI_CTLG_ITEM_GUID = LR_CTLG_ITEM_GUID WHERE LCI_SUBTEST_NAME IN ('Measles Antibody', 'Measles Antibody (IgG)', 'Measles Virus IgG AntiBODY', 'Mumps Antibody (IgG)', 'Mumps Antibody', 'Rubella Antibody', 'Rubella Antibody (IgG)', 'Varicella Zoster (IgG)', 'Varicella Zoster IgM Ab, Mayo', 'Varicella-zoster (IgG)', 'Varicella-Zoster Virus AB') ) , CD_FORM AS (SELECT CCMIV_DOC_NAME, CCMIV_NAME, CCMIV_DESCRIPTION, CCMIV_DATA_TYPE_DESC FROM IDB.CD_CNFG_CATALOG_MASTER_ITEM_V WHERE CCMIV_DOC_NAME='Cell Infusion - BMT' ) , SCT AS (SELECT CDD_MRN AS MRN, CDD_SERVICE_DTE, CDD_SERVICE_DT, MAX(CASE WHEN CDO_MSTR_ITEM_NM IN ('BMT_Cell_INF_Dx RES', 'BMT_Cell INF_Dx Other FT') THEN TRIM(CDO_VALUE_TEXT) END) "Diagnosis", MAX(CASE WHEN CDO_MSTR_ITEM_NM IN ('BMT_Cell INF_PI_Cell Infusion Type RES') THEN TRIM(CDO_VALUE_TEXT) END) "Cell Infusion Type", MAX(CASE WHEN CDO_MSTR_ITEM_NM IN ('BMT_Cell INF_PI_Cell Infusion Type phr') THEN TRIM(CDO_VALUE_TEXT) END) "Cell Infusion Type Other", ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CDD_MRN ORDER BY CDD_SERVICE_DT DESC) AS ORDERING FROM CD_FORM LEFT JOIN IDB.CD_DOCUMENT ON CDD_DOC_NAME = CCMIV_DOC_NAME LEFT JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION ON CDD_MRN = CDO_MRN AND CDD_DOC_GUID = CDO_DOC_GUID AND CDD_AUTHORED_DTE = CDO_AUTHORED_DTE AND CDO_MSTR_ITEM_NM = CCMIV_NAME WHERE 1=1 AND CDD_CANCEL_IND <> '1' GROUP BY CDD_MRN, CDD_SERVICE_DTE, CDD_SERVICE_DT) , LATEST_SCT AS (SELECT * FROM SCT WHERE ORDERING = 1 ) , PACC_DOC AS (SELECT DISTINCT CDD_DOC_NAME, OCV_PVDR_NAME AS "Provider from PACC Note", CDD_SERVICE_DTE PACC_CDD_SERVICE_DTE, CDD_MRN, ROW_NUMBER()OVER(PARTITION BY CDD_MRN ORDER BY CDD_SERVICE_DTE DESC) AS RANK, CDD_DOC_GUID FROM IDB.CD_DOCUMENT JOIN IDB.OMS_CLIENT_VISIT ON CDD_VISIT_GUID = OCV_VISIT_GUID JOIN PTS ON CDD_MRN = VIS_MRN WHERE CDD_CANCEL_IND <> '1' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND <> '1' AND CDD_DOC_NAME IN ('Follow Up - PACC BMT', 'Follow Up - PACC Leuk/Lymphoma', 'Follow Up - PACC LTFU', 'Follow Up - PACC Neuro Onc/Neuro', 'Follow Up - PACC Neuroblastoma', 'Follow Up - PACC Neurosurgery', 'Follow Up - PACC Sarcoma', 'Follow Up - PACC Surgery') ORDER BY ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY CDD_MRN ORDER BY CDD_SERVICE_DTE DESC)) SELECT DISTINCT VIS_MRN "MRN", PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH "DOB", PT_LAST_NAME "PT Last Name", PT_FIRST_NAME "PT First Name", CASE WHEN VIS_HOSP_SVC = 'BMT' THEN 'BMT' ELSE 'Not BMT' END AS "BMT Service?", VIS_HOSP_SVC "Hospital Service", HOSP_SVC_DESC "Hospital Service Desc", "Provider from PACC Note", PATIENT_TYPE_DESC "Patient Type", ATN_DR_NAME "Attending Doctor", LR_PERFORMED_DTE "Titer Date", LR_SUBTEST_NAME "Titer Name", LTL_TEXT_RESULT "Titer Results", CDD_SERVICE_DTE "SCT Svc Date", "Diagnosis", "Cell Infusion Type", "Cell Infusion Type Other" FROM PTS LEFT JOIN TITERS A ON VIS_MRN = LR_MRN AND A.ORDERING = 1 LEFT JOIN LATEST_SCT ON VIS_MRN = MRN LEFT JOIN PACC_DOC ON VIS_MRN = CDD_MRN AND RANK = 1 WHERE VIS_MRN IN ('38034397', '38000107', '38024257', '35590121', '35512414') ORDER BY VIS_MRN, LR_PERFORMED_DTE, LR_SUBTEST_NAME

prompt: Provide a list of patients diagnosed with giant cell tumor of bone, giant cell tumor of tendon sheath and pigmented villo-nodular synovitis between the years 2008-2018
completion: WITH PTS AS (SELECT DISTINCT CC_MRN FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE CC_CLSF_CD IN ('D21.22', 'M12.262', 'D16.22', 'D48', 'D48.1', 'D49.2', '215.3', '719.26', '213.7', '238.1', '239.2') AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND (CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) GROUP BY CC_MRN, CC_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK HAVING MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) BETWEEN '2008-01-01' AND '2017-12-31') SELECT PT_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, PT_DATE_OF_DEATH, PLA_LST_KNOWN_ALIVE_DTE "Last Known Alive Date", PLA_LST_CON_DTE "Last Contact Date" FROM IDB.PATIENT JOIN PTS ON CC_MRN=PT_MRN JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY ON PLA_MRN = PT_MRN ; SELECT CC_MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS MIN_ICD_EFF_DTE, CC_CLSF_CD AS ICD_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS ICD_DESC FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE CC_CLSF_CD IN ('D21.22', 'M12.262', 'D16.22', 'D48', 'D48.1', 'D49.2', '215.3', '719.26', '213.7', '238.1', '239.2') AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND (CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) GROUP BY CC_MRN, CC_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK HAVING MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) BETWEEN '2008-01-01' AND '2017-12-31' ; WITH PTS AS (SELECT DISTINCT CC_MRN FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE CC_CLSF_CD IN ('D21.22', 'M12.262', 'D16.22', 'D48', 'D48.1', 'D49.2', '215.3', '719.26', '213.7', '238.1', '239.2') AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND (CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) GROUP BY CC_MRN, CC_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK HAVING MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) BETWEEN '2008-01-01' AND '2017-12-31') SELECT TM_MRN, AV_DESC AS CASE_STS, TM_DX_DTE, TM_HIST_CD, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS HIST_DESC, TM_SITE_CD, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_DESC FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN PTS ON CC_MRN=TM_MRN JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS ON AV_ELEMENT = 'CASE_STS' AND AV_CODE = TM_CASE_STS AND TM_CASE_STS IN ('3', '6', '7', '8') ; WITH PTS AS (SELECT DISTINCT CC_MRN FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE CC_CLSF_CD IN ('D21.22', 'M12.262', 'D16.22', 'D48', 'D48.1', 'D49.2', '215.3', '719.26', '213.7', '238.1', '239.2') AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND (CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) GROUP BY CC_MRN, CC_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK HAVING MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) BETWEEN '2008-01-01' AND '2017-12-31') SELECT SSE_MRN, SSE_SURG_DTE, SSE_LOG_STS, SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD, SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC, SSP_SURG_LAST_NM, SSP_SURG_FIRST_NM, SSP_SURG_SVC_CD FROM IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE ON SSE_LOG_ID = SSP_LOG_ID JOIN PTS ON CC_MRN=SSE_MRN ;

prompt: All Pharmacy orders starting 14 days from the current date with an AHFS beginning with 08 and an attribute flag containing RESTRICT.
completion: SELECT POD_ITEM_DESC, PO_MRN, CS_LAST_NAME, CS_FIRST_NAME, PO_VISIT_SEQ, CS_NURS_STA, CS_BED, POD_STRT_DTE, POI_DOSE, POI_DOSE_UNIT, PO_ROUTE_DESC FROM IDB.PHM_ORDER JOIN IDB.PHM_ORD_DTL ON PO_ORD_SEQ = POD_ORD_SEQ JOIN IDB.PHM_ORD_INV ON POD_ITEM_NO = POI_ITEM_NO AND POD_ORD_SEQ = POI_ORD_SEQ JOIN IDB.PHM_INVENTORY ON POI_INV_SEQ = PIN_INV_SEQ JOIN IDB.CASE ON PO_MRN = CS_MRN AND PO_ACCT_NO = CS_ACCT_NO AND CS_ACCT_NO LIKE '84%' WHERE PO_ORD_STS = 'A' AND POI_AHFS LIKE '08%' AND POD_ATT_FLAG LIKE '%RESTRICT%' AND POD_STRT_DTE <= CURRENT DATE - 14 DAYS ORDER BY CS_NURS_STA, CS_BED

prompt: Provide a list of classical Hodgkin lymphoma patients who received radiotherapy
completion: SELECT TM_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME AS LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME AS FIRST_NAME, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, PT_DATE_OF_DEATH, PLA_LST_DRVST_DTE, TM_DX_DTE, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS HIST_DESC, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_DESC, TM_BEST_AJCC_STG AS BEST_AJCC_STAGE, TM_CLIN_STG_DSCR AS CLINICAL_STAGE, PFA_FST_CHEMO_MSK_DTE, PFA_FST_RT_MSK_DTE, FIRST_TRANSPLANT_DATE, CASE WHEN PFA_FST_CHEMO_MSK_DTE < PFA_FST_RT_MSK_DTE THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END CHEMO_PRIOR_TO_RT, CASE WHEN PFA_FST_CHEMO_MSK_DTE < FIRST_TRANSPLANT_DATE THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END CHEMO_PRIOR_TO_BMT, CASE WHEN PFA_FST_RT_MSK_DTE < PFA_FST_CHEMO_MSK_DTE THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END RT_PRIOR_TO_CHEMO, CASE WHEN PFA_FST_RT_MSK_DTE < FIRST_TRANSPLANT_DATE THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END RT_PRIOR_TO_BMT, CASE WHEN FIRST_TRANSPLANT_DATE < PFA_FST_CHEMO_MSK_DTE THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END BMT_PRIOR_TO_CHEMO, CASE WHEN FIRST_TRANSPLANT_DATE < PFA_FST_RT_MSK_DTE THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END BMT_PRIOR_TO_RT FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PT_MRN = TM_MRN JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS ON AV_ELEMENT = 'CASE_STS' AND AV_CODE = TM_CASE_STS JOIN IDB.SEERGROUPING SG ON DV.SEERF_ICDO(TM_SITE_CD, TM_HIST_CD) = SG.RECODE JOIN IDB.PT_FIRST_ACTIVITY ON TM_MRN = PFA_MRN JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY ON TM_MRN = PLA_MRN LEFT JOIN (SELECT BMT_MRN, MIN(TRANSPLANT_DATE) FIRST_TRANSPLANT_DATE FROM (SELECT CBM_MRN BMT_MRN, CBM_TRANSPLANT_DTE TRANSPLANT_DATE FROM IDB.CRDB_BMT_MEDICINE UNION SELECT CBP_MRN BMT_MRN, CBP_TRANSPLANT_DTE TRANSPLANT_DATE FROM IDB.CRDB_BMT_PEDIATRICS) GROUP BY BMT_MRN) ON TM_MRN = BMT_MRN WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND SG.CATEGORY1 IN ('Lymphoma') AND SG.CATEGORY2 IN ('Hodgkin Lymphoma') AND PFA_FST_RT_MSK_DTE IS NOT NULL ; WITH PTS AS (SELECT TM_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME AS LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME AS FIRST_NAME , TM_DX_DTE FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PT_MRN = TM_MRN JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS ON AV_ELEMENT = 'CASE_STS' AND AV_CODE = TM_CASE_STS JOIN IDB.SEERGROUPING SG ON DV.SEERF_ICDO(TM_SITE_CD, TM_HIST_CD) = SG.RECODE JOIN IDB.PT_FIRST_ACTIVITY ON TM_MRN = PFA_MRN JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY ON TM_MRN = PLA_MRN WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND SG.CATEGORY1 IN ('Lymphoma') AND SG.CATEGORY2 IN ('Hodgkin Lymphoma') AND PFA_FST_RT_MSK_DTE IS NOT NULL ), CHEMO AS (SELECT APR_MRN, APR_START_DTE, APR_END_DTE, CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME DRUG_NAME FROM PTS JOIN IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX_V ON TM_MRN = APR_MRN WHERE CDG_CHEMO_FLAG = 'Y' AND APR_START_DTE >= TM_DX_DTE ), CHEMO_CNT AS (SELECT APR_MRN, DRUG_NAME, COUNT(*) TOTAL_DRUG_CNT FROM CHEMO GROUP BY APR_MRN, DRUG_NAME) SELECT C.APR_MRN, C.DRUG_NAME, TOTAL_DRUG_CNT, APR_START_DTE, APR_END_DTE FROM CHEMO C JOIN CHEMO_CNT CC ON C.APR_MRN = CC.APR_MRN AND C.DRUG_NAME = CC.DRUG_NAME ; WITH PTS AS (SELECT TM_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME AS LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME AS FIRST_NAME , TM_DX_DTE FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PT_MRN = TM_MRN JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS ON AV_ELEMENT = 'CASE_STS' AND AV_CODE = TM_CASE_STS JOIN IDB.SEERGROUPING SG ON DV.SEERF_ICDO(TM_SITE_CD, TM_HIST_CD) = SG.RECODE JOIN IDB.PT_FIRST_ACTIVITY ON TM_MRN = PFA_MRN JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY ON TM_MRN = PLA_MRN WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND SG.CATEGORY1 IN ('Lymphoma') AND SG.CATEGORY2 IN ('Hodgkin Lymphoma') AND PFA_FST_RT_MSK_DTE IS NOT NULL ) SELECT RTC_TX_MRN, RTC_TX_START_DTE, RTC_TX_STOP_DTE, RTC_TX_COURSE_ID, RTC_TX_COURSE_NO, RTC_TX_PLAN_NAME, RTC_TX_DELIVERED_FRACTIONS, RTC_TX_DELIVERED_DOSE FROM PTS JOIN IDB.RADONC_TREATMENT_COURSE ON TM_MRN = RTC_TX_MRN AND RTC_TX_START_DTE >= TM_DX_DTE ; WITH PATHL AS (SELECT TM_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME AS LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME AS FIRST_NAME, TM_DX_DTE FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PT_MRN = TM_MRN JOIN IDB.SEERGROUPING SG ON DV.SEERF_ICDO(TM_SITE_CD, TM_HIST_CD) = SG.RECODE JOIN IDB.PT_FIRST_ACTIVITY ON TM_MRN = PFA_MRN WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND SG.CATEGORY1 IN ('Lymphoma') AND SG.CATEGORY2 IN ('Hodgkin Lymphoma') AND PFA_FST_RT_MSK_DTE IS NOT NULL ) SELECT PRPT_MRN, PRPT_REPORT_DTE, PRPT_REPORT FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V JOIN PATHL ON TM_MRN = PRPT_MRN WHERE PRPT_REPORT IS NOT NULL AND PRPT_REPORT_DTE >= TM_DX_DTE AND (CONTAINS (PRPT_REPORT, 'BIOPSY') = 1 OR CONTAINS (PRPT_REPORT, 'Biopsy') = 1 OR CONTAINS (PRPT_REPORT, 'BX') = 1) AND PRPT_REPORT_TYPE_DESC ='Surgical Pathology';

prompt: PIK3CA mutations (excluding BOWEL)
completion: WITH PTS AS (SELECT PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID PID FROM DV.PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED) , DT_1 AS (SELECT PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID AS P_ID FROM DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS REC LEFT JOIN DV.PATIENT_CORE_DEMOGRAPHICS ON PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = CORE_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID WHERE 1=1 ) , DT_2 AS (SELECT PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID AS P_ID FROM DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS REC LEFT JOIN DV.PATIENT_CORE_DEMOGRAPHICS ON PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = CORE_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID WHERE 1=1 AND PT_VITAL_STATUS IN ('ALIVE') ) , DT_3 AS (SELECT INC.PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID P_ID FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_STRUCTURED_RESULTS_V INC WHERE 1=1 AND (INC.GENE IN ('PIK3CA') OR INC.GENE2 IN ('PIK3CA')) AND INC.AA_CHANGE IN ('R88Q', 'R93X', 'G118D', 'N345K', 'C420R', 'E453X', 'E542K', 'E545X', 'Q546X', 'E726K', 'M1043I', 'H1047X', 'G1049R') ) , DT_4 AS (SELECT INC.PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID P_ID FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_STRUCTURED_RESULTS_V INC JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML DT ON INC.PRPT_PATH_RPT_ID = DT.PDRX_PATH_RPT_ID CROSS JOIN XMLTABLE('$c/root/meta-data' PASSING DT.PDRX_XML_VALUE AS "c" COLUMNS PRIMARY_SITE VARCHAR(264) PATH 'primary_site', TUMOR_TYPE_NAME VARCHAR(264) PATH 'tumor_type_name' , TUMOR_TYPE_CODE VARCHAR(264) PATH 'tumor_type_code', IS_METASTASIS VARCHAR(3) PATH 'is_metastasis' , METASTASIS_SITE VARCHAR(264) PATH 'metastasis_site' , MSI_COMMENT VARCHAR(264) PATH 'msi-comment' , MSI_SCORE VARCHAR(264) PATH 'msi-score' , MSI_TYPE VARCHAR(264) PATH 'msi-type' , TMB_SCORE VARCHAR(25) PATH 'tmb_score' , TMB_COUNT VARCHAR(25) PATH 'tmb-count', COSMIC_ID VARCHAR(5000) PATH 'cosmic_id') T JOIN (SELECT T.TUMOR_TYPE_CODE TTC FROM TABLE(DV.STRING_SPLIT('BOWEL', ',')) S CROSS JOIN TABLE(DV.ONCOTREE_CHILDREN(COLUMN_VALUES)) T) X ON T.TUMOR_TYPE_CODE = TRIM(X.TTC) WHERE 1=1 ) , DEID AS (SELECT DISTINCT P_ID FROM (SELECT P_ID FROM DT_1 INTERSECT SELECT P_ID FROM DT_2 INTERSECT SELECT P_ID FROM DT_3 EXCEPT SELECT P_ID FROM DT_4 ))

prompt: Provide the number and percentage of patients who had the Colorectal Counseling and had Colonoscopy boxes checked off on the History and Intervention BECH form for the years 2017, 2018 and 2019, to-date.
completion: WITH X AS (SELECT CDD_MRN, CDD_DOC_GUID, CDD_AUTHORED_DTE, CDD_SERVICE_DTE, CDD_DOC_NAME FROM IDB.CD_DOCUMENT JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON CDD_MRN = PT_MRN AND YEAR(CDD_SERVICE_DTE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) >= 50 WHERE CDD_CANCEL_IND = '0' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND = '0' AND CDD_DOC_NAME = 'History & Intervention - BECH' AND CDD_SERVICE_DTE BETWEEN '2019-01-01' AND '2019-12-31' ) SELECT DISTINCT CDD_MRN, CDD_DOC_NAME, CDD_SERVICE_DTE, STRIP(SUBSTR(Y1.CDO_VALUE_TEXT, 1, 10)) AS "Had Colonoscopy", STRIP(SUBSTR(Y2.CDO_VALUE_TEXT, 1, 10)) AS "Had FIT", STRIP(SUBSTR(Y3.CDO_VALUE_TEXT, 1, 10)) AS "FIT Interventions" FROM X LEFT JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION Y1 ON Y1.CDO_DOC_GUID = CDD_DOC_GUID AND Y1.CDO_AUTHORED_DTE = CDD_AUTHORED_DTE AND Y1.CDO_MSTR_ITEM_NM = 'BECH_HI_Colonoscopy RES' LEFT JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION Y2 ON Y2.CDO_DOC_GUID = CDD_DOC_GUID AND Y2.CDO_AUTHORED_DTE = CDD_AUTHORED_DTE AND Y2.CDO_MSTR_ITEM_NM = 'BECH_HI_FIT RES' LEFT JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION Y3 ON Y3.CDO_DOC_GUID = CDD_DOC_GUID AND Y3.CDO_AUTHORED_DTE = CDD_AUTHORED_DTE AND Y3.CDO_MSTR_ITEM_NM = 'BECH_HI_FIT Interventions RES'

prompt: list of patient MRNs and smoking status of those who were seen in 2020 by Thoracic Malignancy DMT.
completion: WITH PTS AS (SELECT MRN, LAST_NAME, FIRST_NAME, DEPT_NAME, PROVIDER, APPT_DTE, VISIT_TYPE_NAME FROM (SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN AS MRN, CPE_PRK AS PRK, CL_LAST_NAME AS LAST_NAME, CL_FIRST_NAME AS FIRST_NAME, CLD_DEPT_NAME AS DEPT_NAME, CRE_RES_NAME AS PROVIDER, CPE_ENC_DTE AS APPT_DTE, CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR AS VT_ABBR, CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME AS VISIT_TYPE_NAME, CPE_ENC_CSN_ID AS CSN, CPE_CPE_APPT_STS AS APPT_STS , CPE_APPT_DT AS APPT_DT, ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY CPE_MRN ORDER BY CPE_APPT_DT DESC) AS ROW FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CRE_RES_ID = CPE_VST_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID JOIN IDB.CL_PATIENT ON CPE_PRK = CL_PRK WHERE 1=1 AND CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Comp') AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN '2020-01-01' AND '2020-12-31' AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 IN ('SRG', 'MED') AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 = 'THR' ) AS X WHERE ROW = 1 ) , SMOKE AS (SELECT CDD_MRN, CDD_SERVICE_DTE, CDO_VALUE_TEXT FROM (SELECT CDD_MRN, CDD_SERVICE_DTE, CDO_VALUE_TEXT , ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY CDD_MRN ORDER BY CDD_SERVICE_DTE DESC) AS ROW FROM PTS JOIN IDB.CD_DOCUMENT ON CDD_MRN = MRN JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION ON CDD_DOC_GUID = CDO_DOC_GUID AND CDD_AUTHORED_DTE = CDO_AUTHORED_DTE AND CDO_VALUE_TEXT <> '' WHERE CDD_CANCEL_IND <> '1' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND <> '1' AND LOWER(CDO_ITEM_NAME) IN ('smoking status') AND CDD_SERVICE_DTE BETWEEN '2020-01-01' AND '2020-12-31' ) AS X WHERE ROW = 1 ) SELECT MRN, LAST_NAME, FIRST_NAME, DEPT_NAME, PROVIDER, APPT_DTE, VISIT_TYPE_NAME, CDO_VALUE_TEXT AS SMOKE_STATUS, CDD_SERVICE_DTE AS SMOKE_STS_DATE FROM PTS LEFT JOIN SMOKE ON MRN = CDD_MRN

IDB.CDB_ALLOWVALS ON CDB_AV_ELEMENT = 'SMOKING_HX' AND CDB_AV_CD_STS = 'A' AND CDB_AV_CODE = TM_SMOKING_HX WHERE TM_CASE_STS = '3' AND TM_SITE_CD like 'C34%' AND TM_DX_DTE BETWEEN '2010-04-20' AND '2012-04-20' ), SURG AS (SELECT PBD_MRN AS SURG_MRN , PBD_SVC_DTE AS "Procedure Date" , PBC_CPT_CD AS "CPT Code" , CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS "CPT Desc" FROM IDB.PBD_DTL JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT TM_MRN, "Tumor Diagnosis Date" FROM CDB) A ON TM_MRN = PBD_MRN JOIN IDB.PBD_CODE ON PBD_PBD_CD = PBC_PBD_CD JOIN IDB.CLM ON PBC_CPT_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE PBC_CPT_CD IN ('31625', '31628', '31629', '31632', '31633', IDB.PBD_DTL JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT SURG_MRN FROM SURG) A ON SURG_MRN = PBD_MRN WHERE PBD_PBD_CD IN ('1678815' ,'9500219' ,'9500411' ,'9500444' ,'9500700' ,'9500733' ,'9500744' ,'9500755' ,'9500774' PT_LAST_NAME AS "Last Name" , PT_FIRST_NAME AS "First Name" , PT_SEX AS "Gender" , PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH AS "Date of Birth" , PT_DATE_OF_DEATH AS "Date of Death" , R.AV_DESC AS "Race (Reg)" , E.AV_DESC AS "Ethnicity (Reg)" , CR.AV_DESC AS "Race (CDB)" , CE.AV_DESC AS "Ethnicity (CDB)" , PT_HT_CM AS "Height (cm)" , PT_WT_KG AS "Weight (kg)" , "Tumor Diagnosis Date" , "ICD-O Histology Code" , "ICD-O Histology Desc" , "ICD-O Site Code" , "ICD-O Site Desc" , GEO.AV_DESC AS "Country of Birth (CDB)" , "Procedure Date" , "CPT Code" , "CPT Desc" , "Min PET Date" , "Max PET Date" FROM IDB.PATIENT JOIN CDB ON PT_MRN = TM_MRN JOIN SURG ON PT_MRN = SURG_MRN JOIN PET ON PT_MRN = PBD_MRN JOIN IDB.CDB_PATIENT ON PT_MRN = CP_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS R ON R.AV_ELEMENT = 'RACE' AND R.AV_CODE = PT_RACE prompt: A weekly list of patients with colorectal cancer and DNA Damage Repair genetic alterations scheduled for surgery
completion: WITH DX AS (SELECT PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID AS PID, MIN(DT_DTE) AS DX_DTE FROM DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS JOIN DV.PATIENT_DIAGNOSIS_FINAL_ALL_V ON PDX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID JOIN DV.DATE_V ON PDX_DX_DATE_ID = DT_DATE_ID JOIN DV.DIAGNOSIS_CATALOG ON PDX_DX_CATALOG_ID = DXCC_DX_CATALOG_ID WHERE SUBSTR(DXCC_ICD_CODE, 1, 3) IN ('C18', 'C19', 'C20', 'C21') AND PT_DEATH_DTE IS NULL GROUP BY PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID ) , GENE AS (SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN, PID FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_STRUCTURED_RESULTS_V JOIN DX ON PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PID WHERE METHOD = 'IMPACT' AND GENE IN ('ATR', 'ATM', 'BARD1', 'BRCA1', 'BRCA2', 'MSH2', 'POLE', 'RAD21', 'RAD52', 'MSH3', 'PARP1', 'POT1', 'RAD50', 'RAD54L', 'RECQL', 'ERCC2', 'MLH1', 'MSH6', 'RAD51', 'RECQL4', 'ERCC3', 'FANCA', 'RAD51B', 'CHEK1', 'ERCC4', 'FANCC', 'RAD51C', 'CHEK2', 'ERCC5', 'MDC1', 'MRE11', 'POLD1', 'RAD51D', 'MUTYH', 'BLM', 'PALB2', 'BRIP1', 'NBN', 'PMS1', 'PMS2') ) , SRG AS (SELECT DISTINCT PID, OC_MRN AS MRN, OC_SURG_DTE AS SCH_SURG_DTE, A.CRE_RES_NAME AS SURGEON, B.CRE_RES_NAME AS ROOM, OC_OR_CASE_STS AS STATUS, CPX_PROC_NAME AS PROCEDURE_NAME FROM IDB.OR_CASE JOIN IDB.OR_CASE_ALL_PROC ON OCAP_CASE_ID = OC_CASE_ID JOIN IDB.OR_CASE_ALL_SURG ON OCAS_CASE_ID = OCAP_CASE_ID AND OCAS_PNL_NO = OCAP_PNL_NO JOIN IDB.OR_CL_PROC ON OCAP_OR_PROC_ID = OCP_OR_PROC_ID JOIN IDB.CL_PROC ON OCP_PROC_ID = CPX_PROC_ID JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE A ON A.CRE_RES_ID = OCAS_RES_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE B ON B.CRE_RES_ID = OC_ROOM_RES_ID JOIN GENE ON OC_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE OC_SURG_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT DATE AND CURRENT DATE + 14 DAY AND OC_OR_CASE_STS IN ('Sch') ) , PROTOCOL_06107 AS (SELECT PID AS PID06, AC_CONS_DTE "06-107 Consent" FROM DV.PROTOCOL JOIN DV.ACCRUALS ON PRO_PROTOCOL_ID = AC_PROTOCOL_ID JOIN SRG ON PID = AC_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID WHERE PRO_IRB_NO = '06-107' ) , PROTOCOL_12245 AS (SELECT PID AS PID12, AC_CONS_DTE "12-245 Consent" FROM DV.PROTOCOL JOIN DV.ACCRUALS ON PRO_PROTOCOL_ID = AC_PROTOCOL_ID JOIN SRG ON PID = AC_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID WHERE PRO_IRB_NO = '12-245' ) , APPT AS (SELECT CPE_MRN, CPE_ENC_DTE AS "Dr Appt Date", CLD_DEPT_NAME AS "Department Name", CRE_RES_NAME AS "Provider Name", CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME AS "Visit Type", ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CPE_MRN ORDER BY CPE_ENC_DTE ASC) AS RN FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID JOIN SRG ON MRN = CPE_MRN WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Sch') AND CRE_RES_TYP IN ('Physician', 'PhD', 'Dentist', 'Psychologist') ) SELECT MRN, "06-107 Consent", "12-245 Consent", SCH_SURG_DTE, SURGEON, ROOM, STATUS, PROCEDURE_NAME, "Dr Appt Date", "Department Name", "Provider Name", "Visit Type" FROM SRG LEFT JOIN APPT ON MRN = CPE_MRN AND RN = 1 LEFT JOIN PROTOCOL_06107 ON PID = PID06 LEFT JOIN PROTOCOL_12245 ON PID = PID12

completion: WITH SAR AS (SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN SAR_MRN FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CRE_RES_TYP = 'Physician' AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 = 'SAR' AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN '2015-01-01' AND '2021-12-31' ) , PTS AS (SELECT CPE_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_SEX, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, PT_DATE_OF_DEATH, R.AV_DESC AS RACE, E.AV_DESC AS ETHNICITY, CPE_ENC_DTE, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8, CLD_DEPT_NAME, CRE_RES_NAME, CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CPE_MRN ORDER BY CPE_ENC_DTE) RN FROM SAR JOIN IDB.PATIENT P ON SAR_MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS R ON PT_RACE = R.AV_CODE AND R.AV_ELEMENT = 'RACE' LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS E ON PT_PT_ETHNICITY = E.AV_CODE AND E.AV_ELEMENT = 'PT_ETHNICITY' JOIN IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER ON PT_MRN = CPE_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CRE_RES_TYP = 'Physician' AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 = 'SAR' ) , FINAL AS (SELECT CPE_MRN MRN, PT_LAST_NAME LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME FIRST_NAME, PT_SEX GENDER, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH DOB, PT_DATE_OF_DEATH DOD, PLA_LST_CON_DTE LAST_CONTACT_DATE, RACE, ETHNICITY, CPE_ENC_DTE FIRST_MSK_DR_VISIT, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 FIRST_MSK_SERVICE, TM_DX_DTE, TM_SITE_CD AS SITE_CODE, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_DESC, TM_HIST_CD AS HIST_CODE, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS HIST_DESC, CASE WHEN PLA_LST_CHEMO_DTE IS NOT NULL THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END CHEMO, CASE WHEN PLA_LST_RT_DTE IS NOT NULL THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END RT FROM PTS LEFT JOIN IDB.CDB_TUMOR ON CPE_MRN = TM_MRN AND TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') LEFT JOIN IDB.CLM H ON TM_HIST_CD = H.CLM_CLSF_CD LEFT JOIN IDB.CLM S ON TM_SITE_CD = S.CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY ON CPE_MRN = PLA_MRN WHERE RN = 1 AND YEAR(CPE_ENC_DTE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) BETWEEN 15 AND 39 ) , INS AS (SELECT F.MRN INS_MRN, MAX(CASE WHEN FSC_PRIORITY = 1 THEN FSC_NAME END) PRIMARY_INSURANCE_NAME, MAX(CASE WHEN FSC_PRIORITY = 1 THEN FSC_REP_CAT_NAME END) PRIMARY_INSURANCE_CATEGORY, MAX(CASE WHEN FSC_PRIORITY = 1 THEN INS_EFF_DATE END) PRIMARY_INSURANCE_EFF_DATE, MAX(CASE WHEN FSC_PRIORITY = 1 THEN INS_EXP_DATE END) PRIMARY_INSURANCE_EXP_DATE, MAX(CASE WHEN FSC_PRIORITY = 2 THEN FSC_NAME END) SECONDARY_INSURANCE_NAME, MAX(CASE WHEN FSC_PRIORITY = 2 THEN FSC_REP_CAT_NAME END) SECONDARY_INSURANCE_CATEGORY, MAX(CASE WHEN FSC_PRIORITY = 2 THEN INS_EFF_DATE END) SECONDARY_INSURANCE_EFF_DATE, MAX(CASE WHEN FSC_PRIORITY = 2 THEN INS_EXP_DATE END) SECONDARY_INSURANCE_EXP_DATE FROM FINAL F JOIN IDB.PATIENT_INSURANCE_V I ON F.MRN = I.MRN GROUP BY F.MRN) , BMT AS (SELECT DISTINCT BMT_MRN FROM FINAL JOIN (SELECT CBM_MRN BMT_MRN FROM IDB.CRDB_BMT_MEDICINE UNION SELECT CBP_MRN BMT_MRN FROM IDB.CRDB_BMT_PEDIATRICS) ON MRN = BMT_MRN) , IMMUNO AS (SELECT DISTINCT APR_MRN IMMUNO_MRN FROM FINAL JOIN IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX_V ON MRN = APR_MRN WHERE CDG_BIOLOGIC_IMMUNO_FLAG = 'Y' ) , IMPACT AS (SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN IMPACT_MRN FROM FINAL JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_STRUCTURED_RESULTS_V ON MRN = PT_MRN WHERE METHOD = 'IMPACT' ) SELECT F.*, CASE WHEN COALESCE(PRIMARY_INSURANCE_EFF_DATE, SECONDARY_INSURANCE_EFF_DATE) IS NULL THEN 'N' WHEN FIRST_MSK_DR_VISIT BETWEEN PRIMARY_INSURANCE_EFF_DATE AND COALESCE(PRIMARY_INSURANCE_EXP_DATE, CURRENT date) THEN 'Y' WHEN FIRST_MSK_DR_VISIT BETWEEN SECONDARY_INSURANCE_EFF_DATE AND COALESCE(SECONDARY_INSURANCE_EXP_DATE, CURRENT date) THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END INSURANCE_AT_FIRST_MSK_DR_VISIT, PRIMARY_INSURANCE_NAME, PRIMARY_INSURANCE_CATEGORY, PRIMARY_INSURANCE_EFF_DATE, PRIMARY_INSURANCE_EXP_DATE, SECONDARY_INSURANCE_NAME, SECONDARY_INSURANCE_CATEGORY, SECONDARY_INSURANCE_EFF_DATE, SECONDARY_INSURANCE_EXP_DATE, CASE WHEN BMT_MRN IS NOT NULL THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END BMT, CASE WHEN IMMUNO_MRN IS NOT NULL THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END BIOLOGIC_IMMUNO, CASE WHEN IMPACT_MRN IS NOT NULL THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END IMPACT FROM FINAL F LEFT JOIN INS I ON MRN = INS_MRN LEFT JOIN BMT ON MRN = BMT_MRN LEFT JOIN IMMUNO ON MRN = IMMUNO_MRN LEFT JOIN IMPACT ON MRN = IMPACT_MRN

prompt: Provide a list of patients who saw a surgeon in the HPB Surgery Service (including Jennifer Flood  and Meaghan Gomez, both APP) who also had a COVID infection.
completion: WITH X AS (SELECT CPE_MRN AS "MRN", CPE_ENC_DTE AS "Appt Date", CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 AS "Department", CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 AS "Service", CLD_DEPT_NAME AS "Department Name", CRE_RES_NAME AS "Provider Name", CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME AS "Visit Type" FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CRE_RES_TYP IN ('Physician', 'PhD', 'Dentist', 'Psychologist', 'Nurse Practitioner', 'Physician Assistant') AND (UPPER(CRE_RES_NAME) like ('%FLOOD%JENNIFER%') OR UPPER(CRE_RES_NAME) like '%GOMEZ%MEAGHAN%' OR UPPER(CRE_RES_NAME) like '%JARNAGIN%WILLIAM%' OR UPPER(CRE_RES_NAME) like '%D%ANGELICA%MICHAEL%' OR UPPER(CRE_RES_NAME) like '%BALACHANDRAN%VINOD%' OR UPPER(CRE_RES_NAME) like '%KINGHAM%PETER%' OR UPPER(CRE_RES_NAME) like '%SOARES%KEVIN%' OR UPPER(CRE_RES_NAME) like '%DREBIN%JEFFREY%' OR UPPER(CRE_RES_NAME) like '%WEI%ALICE%') AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT date- 30 DAYS AND CURRENT date ), PROC AS (SELECT DISTINCT SSE_MRN, SSE_SURG_DTE, SSP_PROC_NAME FROM X LEFT JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT ON "MRN"= SSE_MRN JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE ON SSE_LOG_ID = SSP_LOG_ID AND SSE_ENC_CSN_ID = SSP_ENC_CSN_ID WHERE (SSE_SURG_LOC not like '%IR%' AND SSE_SURG_LOC not like '%ENDO%' AND SSE_SOURCE_TYPE <> 'E') ) , COVID AS (SELECT S.*, RESULT, MIN_RESULT_DT AS COVID_DATE FROM X S LEFT JOIN IDB.COVID19_PATIENT_INFO V ON S."MRN" = V.MRN WHERE RESULT IN ('Positive', 'Resolved') ) , VACCINE AS (SELECT DISTINCT CP_MRN, CHAR(DATE(DOSE_1_EMAR_ADMIN_DT), USA) AS DOSE_1_EMAR_ADMIN_DTE, DOSE_1_EMAR_MFG_NAME, CHAR(DOSE_1_EXTERNAL_ADMIN_DTE, USA) AS DOSE_1_EXTERNAL_ADMIN_DTE, DOSE_1_EXTERNAL_BRAND, CHAR(DATE(DOSE_2_EMAR_ADMIN_DT), USA) AS DOSE_2_EMAR_ADMIN_DTE, DOSE_2_EMAR_MFG_NAME, CHAR(DOSE_2_EXTERNAL_ADMIN_DTE, USA) AS DOSE_2_EXTERNAL_ADMIN_DTE, DOSE_2_EXTERNAL_BRAND, CHAR(DATE(DOSE_3_EMAR_ADMIN_DT), USA) AS DOSE_3_EMAR_ADMIN_DTE, DOSE_3_EMAR_MFG_NAME, CHAR(DATE(DOSE_ADDL_EMAR_ADMIN_DT), USA) AS DOSE_ADDL_EMAR_ADMIN_DTE, DOSE_ADDL_EMAR_MFG_NAME, CHAR(DATE(EMAR_BOOSTER_ADMIN_DT), USA) AS DOSE_BOOSTER_ADMIN_DTE, EMAR_BOOSTER_MFG_NAME FROM X LEFT JOIN IDB.COVID19_PATIENT_CP_VACCINE_INFO ON "MRN"= CP_MRN) SELECT DISTINCT X.*, SSE_SURG_DTE, SSP_PROC_NAME, RESULT, COVID_DATE, DOSE_1_EMAR_ADMIN_DTE, DOSE_1_EMAR_MFG_NAME, DOSE_1_EXTERNAL_ADMIN_DTE, DOSE_1_EXTERNAL_BRAND, DOSE_2_EMAR_ADMIN_DTE, DOSE_2_EMAR_MFG_NAME, DOSE_2_EXTERNAL_ADMIN_DTE, DOSE_2_EXTERNAL_BRAND, DOSE_3_EMAR_ADMIN_DTE, DOSE_3_EMAR_MFG_NAME, DOSE_ADDL_EMAR_ADMIN_DTE, DOSE_ADDL_EMAR_MFG_NAME, DOSE_BOOSTER_ADMIN_DTE, EMAR_BOOSTER_MFG_NAME FROM X LEFT JOIN PROC ON X."MRN" = SSE_MRN LEFT JOIN COVID C ON X."MRN" = C.MRN LEFT JOIN VACCINE ON X."MRN"= CP_MRN

prompt: Please provide a list of patients with Anaplastic large cell lymphoma diagnosed from year 2000 to present.
completion: WITH CLINTRAC AS (SELECT CC_MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS MIN_ICD9_EFF_DTE FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE SUBSTR(CC_CLSF_CD, 1, 5) IN ('C84.6', 'C84.7', '200.6') AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND (CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) GROUP BY CC_MRN ) , TUMOR AS (SELECT DISTINCT TM_MRN, TM_DX_DTE, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK, TM_BEST_AJCC_STG AS STAGE FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS ON AV_ELEMENT = 'CASE_STS' AND AV_CODE = TM_CASE_STS AND TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND TM_HIST_CD IN ('M9714/3', 'M9715/3', 'M9718/3') AND TM_DX_DTE >= '2000-01-01') SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN AS MRN, PT_LAST_NAME "Patient Last Name", PT_FIRST_NAME "Patient First Name", PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH AS DOB, (DAYS(CURRENT_DATE) - DAYS(PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH))/365 "Current Age", PT_SEX AS "Sex", AV_DESC "Race", CASE WHEN PT_PT_ETHNICITY = 'HIS' THEN 'Hispanic' WHEN PT_PT_ETHNICITY = 'NON' THEN 'Non-Hispanic' ELSE PT_PT_ETHNICITY END "Ethnicity", CASE WHEN PT_DATE_OF_DEATH IS NOT NULL THEN 'DECEASED' ELSE 'ALIVE' END "Vital Status", COALESCE(TM_DX_DTE, MIN_ICD9_EFF_DTE) "ICD Diagnosis Date" FROM IDB.PATIENT JOIN IDB.RADONC_TREATMENT_COURSE ON PT_MRN = RTC_TX_MRN JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS ON AV_ELEMENT = 'RACE' AND AV_CODE = PT_RACE LEFT JOIN TUMOR ON PT_MRN = TM_MRN LEFT JOIN CLINTRAC ON PT_MRN = CC_MRN AND MIN_ICD9_EFF_DTE >= '2000-01-01' LEFT JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V ON PT_MRN = PRPT_MRN AND PRPT_REPORT IS NOT NULL AND CONTAINS("PRPT_REPORT", '("ANAPLASTIC LARGE CELL LYMPHOMA")') = 1 WHERE COALESCE(TM_MRN, CC_MRN, PRPT_MRN) IS NOT NULL ORDER BY PT_MRN ; SELECT PRPT_MRN AS MRN, PRPT_PROCEDURE_DTE "Pathology Procedure Date", PRPT_REPORT_DTE "Pathology Report Date", PRPT_REPORT_TYPE_DESC "Report Type", PRPT_REPORT "Pathology Report" FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V JOIN IDB.RADONC_TREATMENT_COURSE ON PRPT_MRN = RTC_TX_MRN WHERE CONTAINS("PRPT_REPORT", '("ANAPLASTIC LARGE CELL LYMPHOMA")') = 1 AND PRPT_REPORT IS NOT NULL ORDER BY PRPT_MRN ; WITH CLINTRAC AS (SELECT CC_MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS MIN_ICD9_EFF_DTE FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE SUBSTR(CC_CLSF_CD, 1, 5) IN ('C84.6', 'C84.7', '200.6') AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND (CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) GROUP BY CC_MRN ) , TUMOR AS (SELECT DISTINCT TM_MRN, TM_DX_DTE FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS ON AV_ELEMENT = 'CASE_STS' AND AV_CODE = TM_CASE_STS AND TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND TM_HIST_CD IN ('M9714/3', 'M9715/3', 'M9718/3') AND TM_DX_DTE >= '2000-01-01') SELECT DISTINCT RTC_TX_MRN AS MRN, RTC_TX_PLAN_NAME "RT Site", RTC_TX_START_DTE "RT Start", RTC_TX_STOP_DTE "RT End", RTC_TX_PLANNED_FRACTIONS "Planned Fractions", RTC_TX_DELIVERED_FRACTIONS "Delivered Fractions", RTC_TX_PLANNED_DOSE "Planned Dose", RTC_TX_DELIVERED_DOSE "Delivered Dose" FROM IDB.RADONC_TREATMENT_COURSE LEFT JOIN TUMOR ON RTC_TX_MRN = TM_MRN LEFT JOIN CLINTRAC ON RTC_TX_MRN = CC_MRN AND MIN_ICD9_EFF_DTE >= '2000-01-01' LEFT JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V ON RTC_TX_MRN = PRPT_MRN AND PRPT_REPORT IS NOT NULL AND CONTAINS("PRPT_REPORT", '("ANAPLASTIC LARGE CELL LYMPHOMA")') = 1 WHERE COALESCE(TM_MRN, CC_MRN, PRPT_MRN) IS NOT NULL ORDER BY RTC_TX_MRN ; WITH CLINTRAC AS (SELECT CC_MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS MIN_ICD9_EFF_DTE FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE SUBSTR(CC_CLSF_CD, 1, 5) IN ('C84.6', 'C84.7', '200.6') AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND (CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) GROUP BY CC_MRN ) , TUMOR AS (SELECT DISTINCT TM_MRN, TM_DX_DTE FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS ON AV_ELEMENT = 'CASE_STS' AND AV_CODE = TM_CASE_STS AND TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND TM_HIST_CD IN ('M9714/3', 'M9715/3', 'M9718/3') AND TM_DX_DTE >= '2000-01-01') SELECT MRN, "Start Date", LISTAGG(TRIM("Chemo Drug Name"), ' / ') WITHIN GROUP( ORDER BY "Chemo Drug Name") "Chemo Drug Name" FROM (SELECT DISTINCT APR_MRN AS MRN, APR_START_DTE "Start Date", APR_GENERIC_NAME "Chemo Drug Name" FROM IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX JOIN IDB.CHEMO_DRUG_GENERIC ON APR_GENERIC_NAME = CDG_GENERIC_NAME LEFT JOIN TUMOR ON APR_MRN = TM_MRN LEFT JOIN CLINTRAC ON APR_MRN = CC_MRN AND MIN_ICD9_EFF_DTE >= '2000-01-01' LEFT JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V ON APR_MRN = PRPT_MRN AND PRPT_REPORT IS NOT NULL AND CONTAINS("PRPT_REPORT", '("ANAPLASTIC LARGE CELL LYMPHOMA")') = 1 WHERE COALESCE(TM_MRN, CC_MRN, PRPT_MRN) IS NOT NULL ORDER BY APR_MRN ) JOIN IDB.RADONC_TREATMENT_COURSE ON MRN = RTC_TX_MRN GROUP BY MRN, "Start Date"

prompt: Rerun of report MED24485 but include regional locations and apply surv exclusion criteria of no chemo/rt for eligible pts w/in 6 mo of appt date.
completion: WITH APPT AS (SELECT CPE_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, CPE_ENC_CSN_ID CSNID, CPE_CPE_APPT_STS, CPE_ENC_DTE "APPT_DATE", CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8, CLD_DEPT_NAME, CRE_RES_NAME, CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME, CLD_CLD_CENTER, CASE WHEN CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 = 'GU' THEN 'UROLOGY' WHEN CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 = 'GMO' THEN 'GYNECOLOGY' WHEN CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 = 'THR' THEN 'THORACIC' WHEN CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 = 'HNS' THEN 'HEAD & NECK' WHEN CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 = 'GI' THEN 'COLORECTAL' ELSE 'NOT_LISTED' END AS "CLD_GRP8_CATEG" , ROW_NUMBER () OVER (PARTITION BY CPE_MRN, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 ORDER BY CPE_ENC_DTE DESC) RN FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON CPE_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Sch', 'Arrived', 'Comp' ) AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN '2022-01-01' AND '2022-06-30' AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 = 'MED' AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 IN ('GU', 'GMO', 'THR', 'HNS', 'GI') AND CPE_MRN <> '' ) , DIAG AS (SELECT A.*, TM_DX_DTE AS "DIAGNOSIS_DATE", YEAR (APPT_DATE - TM_DX_DTE) AS "YEARS_SINCE_DX", CASE WHEN TM_AJCC_7 NOT IN ('', '888', '999') THEN AJCC7.AV_DESC WHEN TM_AJCC NOT IN ('', '88', '99') THEN AJCC.AV_DESC WHEN TM_GENERAL_STG NOT IN ('', '9') THEN GS.AV_DESC WHEN TM_PATH_STG_GRP NOT IN ('', '88', '9', '99') THEN TM_PATH_STG_GRP ELSE CLIN.AV_DESC END AS STAGE, CASE WHEN CATEGORY2 IN ('Lung and Bronchus', 'Esophagus') THEN 'THORACIC' WHEN CATEGORY1 = 'Urinary System' THEN 'UROLOGY' WHEN CATEGORY2 IN ('Prostate', 'Testis') THEN 'UROLOGY' WHEN CATEGORY1 = 'Female Genital System' THEN 'GYNECOLOGY' WHEN CATEGORY2 IN ('Colon and Rectum', 'Anus, Anal Canal and Anorectum') THEN 'COLORECTAL' WHEN CATEGORY1 = 'Oral Cavity and Pharynx' THEN 'HEAD & NECK' WHEN CATEGORY2 = 'Larynx' THEN 'HEAD & NECK' ELSE 'NOT_____LISTED' END AS "DISEASE_GROUP", ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY A.CPE_MRN, A.CLD_GRP8_CATEG ORDER BY TM_DX_DTE ASC) DG FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR T JOIN APPT A ON TM_MRN = A.CPE_MRN AND RN = 1 JOIN IDB.SEERGROUPING SG ON IDB.SEERF_ICDO(TM_SITE_CD, TM_HIST_CD) = RECODE JOIN IDB.CLM H ON TM_HIST_CD = H.CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON TM_SITE_CD = S.CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.CL_PAS_PATIENT ON TM_MRN = CPP_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS CS ON CS.AV_ELEMENT = 'CASE_STS' AND CS.AV_CODE = TM_CASE_STS LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS AJCC7 ON AJCC7.AV_ELEMENT = 'AJCC_7' AND AJCC7.AV_CODE = TM_AJCC_7 LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS AJCC ON AJCC.AV_ELEMENT = 'AJCC' AND AJCC.AV_CODE = TM_AJCC LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS GS ON GS.AV_ELEMENT = 'GENERAL_STG' AND GS.AV_CODE = TM_GENERAL_STG LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS CLIN ON CLIN.AV_ELEMENT = 'CLIN_STG_DSCR' AND CLIN.AV_CODE = TM_CLIN_STG_DSCR WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7') ) , PREV_REP AS (SELECT CPE_MRN AS MRN, PT_LAST_NAME AS LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME AS FIRST_NAME, APPT_DATE AS LATEST_APPOINTMENT_DATE, CLD_DEPT_NAME AS DEPARTMENT, TRIM(CRE_RES_NAME) AS PROVIDER, TRIM(CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME) AS VISIT_TYPE, TRIM(CLD_CLD_CENTER) AS LOCATION, YEARS_SINCE_DX, DISEASE_GROUP, TRIM(STAGE) DISEASE_STAGE FROM DIAG D WHERE 1=1 AND YEARS_SINCE_DX >=5 AND DG = 1 AND CLD_GRP8_CATEG = DISEASE_GROUP AND ((DISEASE_GROUP = 'THORACIC' AND (STAGE like '1%' OR STAGE like '2%' OR STAGE like 'I%') AND STAGE NOT like 'III%' AND STAGE NOT like 'IV%' AND STAGE <> 'IN SITU') OR (DISEASE_GROUP IN ('UROLOGY', 'GYNECOLOGY', 'COLORECTAL', 'HEAD & NECK') AND (STAGE like '1%' OR STAGE like '2%' OR STAGE like '3%' OR STAGE like 'I%') AND STAGE NOT like 'IV%' AND STAGE <> 'IN SITU')) ) , CHEMO AS (SELECT APR_MRN , TREATMENT_DATE, 'Cheomo Therapy' AS TREATMENT FROM (SELECT APR_MRN , APR_END_DTE AS TREATMENT_DATE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY APR_MRN ORDER BY APR_END_DTE DESC) CT FROM IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX_V JOIN PREV_REP R ON R.MRN = APR_MRN WHERE CDG_CHEMO_FLAG = 'Y' AND MONTHS_BETWEEN (R.LATEST_APPOINTMENT_DATE, APR_END_DTE) <= 6 ) WHERE CT =1 ) , RAD AS (SELECT DISTINCT MRN FROM (SELECT MRN, SVC_DTE, RAD_TYPE, SOURCE_IND, SVC_CD, SVC_DESC, DPT_CD, DPT_DESC, IP_OP_IND, SUM(AMT) AS SVC_AMT, SUM(QTY) AS SVC_QTY, RMS_VISIT_ID, RMS_ADM_NUM, SMS_ACCT_NO FROM (SELECT DTL_MRN AS MRN, DTL_SVC_DTE AS SVC_DTE, RAD_TYPE, 'SMS' AS SOURCE_IND, DTL_SVC_CD AS SVC_CD, CDM_SVC_DESC AS SVC_DESC, CDM_DPT_CD AS DPT_CD, AV_DESC AS DPT_DESC, DTL_IP_OP_IND AS IP_OP_IND, DTL_SVC_AMT AS AMT, DTL_SVC_QTY AS QTY, 0 AS RMS_VISIT_ID, DTL_ACCT_NO AS RMS_ADM_NUM, DTL_ACCT_NO AS SMS_ACCT_NO FROM PREV_REP PR JOIN IDB.PA_DETAIL ON PR.MRN = DTL_MRN JOIN IDB.CDM ON CDM_SVC_CD = DTL_SVC_CD JOIN IDB.RADIATION_TYPES ON RAD_SVC_CD = DTL_SVC_CD AND RAD_SOURCE = 'SMS' LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS ON CDM_DPT_CD = AV_CODE AND AV_ELEMENT = 'DPT_CD' WHERE DTL_DTL_TYPE = 'C' AND MONTHS_BETWEEN (PR.LATEST_APPOINTMENT_DATE, DTL_SVC_DTE) <= 6 UNION ALL SELECT RVCD_MRN AS MRN, RVCD_SVC_DTE AS SVC_DTE, RAD_TYPE, 'RMS' AS SOURCE_IND, RCDD_CHARGE_CD AS SVC_CD, RCDD_CHARGE_DESCRIPTION AS SVC_DESC, RDPD_DEPARTMENT_MNEMONIC AS DPT_CD, RDPD_DEPARTMENT_NAME AS DPT_DESC, VIS_IP_OP_ADJUSTED_IND AS IP_OP_IND, RVCD_AMT AS AMT, RVCD_UNITS AS QTY, VIS_VISIT_ID AS RMS_VISIT_ID, VIS_ADM_NUM AS RMS_ADM_NUM, ' ' AS SMS_ACCT_NO FROM PREV_REP PV JOIN IDB.RMS_VISIT_CHARGE_DTL ON PV.MRN = RVCD_MRN JOIN IDB.VISIT ON RVCD_VISIT_ID = VIS_VISIT_ID JOIN IDB.RMS_CHARGE_CODE_DICT_DN1240 ON RVCD_CHARGE_CODE_REC_NO = RCDD_RECORD_NUMBER JOIN IDB.RMS_DEPARTMENT_DICT_DN1301 ON RVCD_CHARGE_DEPT_REC_NO = RDPD_RECORD_NUMBER JOIN IDB.RADIATION_TYPES ON RAD_SVC_CD = RCDD_CHARGE_CD AND RAD_SOURCE = 'RMS' WHERE MONTHS_BETWEEN (PV.LATEST_APPOINTMENT_DATE, RVCD_SVC_DTE) <= 6 ) A GROUP BY MRN, SVC_DTE, A.RAD_TYPE, SOURCE_IND, SVC_CD, SVC_DESC, DPT_CD, prompt: DTU Appointments at 53rd and Koch
completion: WITH PROTOCOL AS (SELECT DISTINCT AC_MRN, AC_IRB_NO, AC_CONS_DTE FROM IDB.ACCRUALS JOIN IDB.ACCRUALS_DATES ON AC_IRB_NO = ACD_IRB_NO AND AC_SUBJ_ID_NO = ACD_SUBJ_ID_NO AND AC_SUBJ_SEQ_NO = ACD_SUBJ_SEQ_NO WHERE AC_IRB_NO IN ('12-142', '13-131', '15-183', '16-026', '17-084', '17-573', '18-291', '19-067', '19-072', '19-099', '19-148', '19-235', '19-257') AND ACD_OFF_STUDY_DTE IS NULL ) , APPT AS (SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, AC_IRB_NO, AC_CONS_DTE, CPE_ENC_DTE, CPE_APPT_DT, CLD_DEPT_NAME, CRE_RES_NAME, CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME, CVT_EXT_NAME FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON CPE_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN PROTOCOL ON CPE_MRN = AC_MRN WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Sch') AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT DATE AND CURRENT DATE + 5 DAYS AND CPE_DEPT_ID IN (346) AND CVT_EXT_NAME = 'Treatment' ) , ORDERS AS (SELECT DISTINCT OO_MRN, OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE, OOC_ITEM_NAME, OSTS_STS_DESC, OO_SUMMARY_LINE FROM IDB.OMS_ORDER JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_CATALOG ON OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID = OOC_MSTR_ITEM_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_STATUS ON OO_ORD_STS_CD = OSTS_ORD_STS_CD JOIN APPT ON OO_MRN = CPE_MRN AND OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE >= CPE_ENC_DTE WHERE OO_ORD_STS_CD NOT IN ('CANP', 'CANC', 'AUC3') AND UPPER(OOC_ITEM_NAME) LIKE '%INVEST%' ) SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN "MRN", PT_LAST_NAME "Last Name", PT_FIRST_NAME "First Name", AC_IRB_NO "IRB No", AC_CONS_DTE "Consent Date", CPE_ENC_DTE "Appt Date", TIME(CPE_APPT_DT) "Appt Time", OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE "INVEST Order Date", OOC_ITEM_NAME "Order Item Name", OSTS_STS_DESC "Order Status", CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME "Visit Type Name", CLD_DEPT_NAME "Department Name", OO_SUMMARY_LINE "Order Summary Line" FROM APPT LEFT JOIN ORDERS ON CPE_MRN = OO_MRN ORDER BY CPE_MRN, CPE_ENC_DTE, OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE ; WITH PROTOCOL AS (SELECT DISTINCT AC_MRN, AC_IRB_NO, AC_CONS_DTE FROM IDB.ACCRUALS JOIN IDB.ACCRUALS_DATES ON AC_IRB_NO = ACD_IRB_NO AND AC_SUBJ_ID_NO = ACD_SUBJ_ID_NO AND AC_SUBJ_SEQ_NO = ACD_SUBJ_SEQ_NO WHERE AC_IRB_NO IN ('13-171', '15-328', '17-213', '17-242', '17-332', '18-256', '18-273', '18-525', '19-014', '19-103', '19-115', '19-139', '19-187', '17-573', '17-467', '16-1535') AND ACD_OFF_STUDY_DTE IS NULL ) , APPT AS (SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, AC_IRB_NO, AC_CONS_DTE, CPE_ENC_DTE, CPE_APPT_DT, CLD_DEPT_NAME, CRE_RES_NAME, CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME, CVT_EXT_NAME FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON CPE_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN PROTOCOL ON CPE_MRN = AC_MRN WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Sch') AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT DATE AND CURRENT DATE + 5 DAYS AND CPE_DEPT_ID IN (1606) AND CVT_EXT_NAME = 'Treatment' ) , ORDERS AS (SELECT DISTINCT OO_MRN, OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE, OOC_ITEM_NAME, OSTS_STS_DESC, OO_SUMMARY_LINE FROM IDB.OMS_ORDER JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_CATALOG ON OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID = OOC_MSTR_ITEM_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_STATUS ON OO_ORD_STS_CD = OSTS_ORD_STS_CD JOIN APPT ON OO_MRN = CPE_MRN AND OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE >= CPE_ENC_DTE WHERE OO_ORD_STS_CD NOT IN ('CANP', 'CANC', 'AUC3') AND UPPER(OOC_ITEM_NAME) LIKE '%INVEST%' ) SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN "MRN", PT_LAST_NAME "Last Name", PT_FIRST_NAME "First Name", AC_IRB_NO "IRB No", AC_CONS_DTE "Consent Date", CPE_ENC_DTE "Appt Date", TIME(CPE_APPT_DT) "Appt Time", OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE "INVEST Order Date", OOC_ITEM_NAME "Order Item Name", OSTS_STS_DESC "Order Status", CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME "Visit Type Name", CLD_DEPT_NAME "Department Name", OO_SUMMARY_LINE "Order Summary Line" FROM APPT LEFT JOIN ORDERS ON CPE_MRN = OO_MRN ORDER BY CPE_MRN, CPE_ENC_DTE, OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE ; SELECT MAX(0) ROWS FROM IDB.ALLOWVALS

prompt: Provide a darwin cohort of patient with tumor mutational Burden of 10 or higher
completion: WITH EX_CPI AS (SELECT DISTINCT PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID P_ID FROM DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS JOIN IDB.CHEMO_PERFORMED_ORDERS C ON PT_MRN = CPO_MRN AND CASE WHEN (LOWER(CPO_DRUG_NAME) like '%atezolizumab%' OR LOWER(CPO_DRUG_NAME) like '%avelumab%' OR LOWER(CPO_DRUG_NAME) like '%durvalumab%' OR LOWER(CPO_DRUG_NAME) like '%ipilimumab%' OR LOWER(CPO_DRUG_NAME) like '%nivolumab%' OR LOWER(CPO_DRUG_NAME) like '%pembrolizumab%' OR LOWER(CPO_DRUG_NAME) like '%tremelimumab%' OR LOWER(CPO_DRUG_NAME) like '%mpdl3280a%' OR LOWER(CPO_DRUG_NAME) like '%medi4736%') THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END = 'Yes') , XML_DATA AS (SELECT DISTINCT PDRX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID P_ID, VARIANT_TYPE, PT_MRN, PDRX_ACCESSION_NO, PDRX_DMP_PATIENT_ID, PDRX_PATH_RPT_ID, DT_DTE, GENE_ID, TUMOR_TYPE_NAME, PRIMARY_SITE, IMPACT_PANEL, TMB_COUNT, TMB_SCORE, MSI_SCORE, MSI_COMMENT, MSI_TYPE, DT_PROCEDURE FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML INNER JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON PDRX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT ON PDRX_PATH_RPT_ID = PRPT_PATH_RPT_ID JOIN DV.DATE ON DT_DATE_ID = PRPT_REPORT_DATE_ID LEFT JOIN EX_CPI ON P_ID = PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID , XMLTABLE('$c/root/*' PASSING PDRX_XML_VALUE AS "c" COLUMNS GENE_ID VARCHAR(100) PATH 'gene_id', VARIANT_TYPE VARCHAR(100) PATH './local-name(.)', TUMOR_TYPE_NAME VARCHAR(255) PATH '../meta-data/tumor_type_name', TUMOR_TYPE_CODE VARCHAR(255) PATH '../meta-data/tumor_type_code', PRIMARY_SITE VARCHAR(255) PATH '../meta-data/primary_site', IMPACT_PANEL VARCHAR(255) PATH '../meta-data/gene-panel', TMB_COUNT VARCHAR(25) PATH '../meta-data/tmb-count', TMB_SCORE VARCHAR(25) PATH 'tmb_score', MSI_SCORE VARCHAR(255) PATH '../meta-data/msi-score', MSI_COMMENT VARCHAR(255) PATH '../meta-data/msi-comment', MSI_TYPE VARCHAR(255) PATH '../meta-data/msi-type', DT_PROCEDURE VARCHAR(255) PATH '../meta-data/dt_procedure') T LEFT JOIN (SELECT T.TUMOR_TYPE_CODE TTC FROM TABLE(DV.STRING_SPLIT('MCC|MEL|BLADDER|NSCLC|RCC|CSCC', '|')) S CROSS JOIN TABLE(DV.ONCOTREE_CHILDREN(COLUMN_VALUES)) T) X ON T.TUMOR_TYPE_CODE = X.TTC WHERE LOWER(MSI_TYPE) NOT IN ('instable') AND RTRIM(LTRIM(TRANSLATE(RTRIM(TMB_SCORE), '*', ' 1234567890'))) IN ('', '.', ',') AND CAST(TMB_SCORE AS DECIMAL(10, 2)) >= 10 AND LOWER(TUMOR_TYPE_NAME) not like '%melanoma%' AND LOWER(TUMOR_TYPE_NAME) not like '%leukem%' AND LOWER(TUMOR_TYPE_NAME) not like '%lymphoma%' AND LOWER(TUMOR_TYPE_NAME) NOT IN ('anaplastic astrocytoma', 'anaplastic oligodendroglioma', 'astrocytoma', 'head and neck mucosal melanoma', 'head and neck squamous cell carcinoma', 'larynx squamous cell carcinoma', 'oral cavity squamous cell carcinoma', 'oropharynx squamous cell carcinoma', 'small cell lung cancer') AND EX_CPI.P_ID IS NULL AND X.TTC IS NULL ) , DEID AS (SELECT P_ID, TUMOR_TYPE_NAME, MSI_TYPE FROM XML_DATA JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON P_ID = PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID AND PT_VITAL_STATUS = 'ALIVE' AND YEAR(CURRENT date - PT_BIRTH_DTE) >= 18 JOIN DV.PATIENT_LATEST_ACTIVITY ON P_ID = PLA_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID AND PLA_LAST_DRVST_DTE >= CURRENT date - 90 DAYS WHERE CASE WHEN LOWER(TUMOR_TYPE_NAME) IN ('colon adenocarcinoma', 'colorectal adenocarcinoma', 'rectal adenocarcinoma', 'uterine endometrioid carcinoma tumor') AND LOWER(MSI_TYPE) IN ('indeterminant') THEN 0 ELSE 1 END = 1 ) SELECT * FROM DEID

prompt: Generate a list of all MSKCC Attending Physicians active from 2016 to Present
completion: SELECT CRE_RES_NAME, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6, MIN(CPE_ENC_DTE) AS FIRST_APPT_DATE, MAX(CPE_ENC_DTE) AS LAST_APPT_DATE, CRE_RES_TYP, CRE_RES_STS FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CRE_RES_ID = CPE_VST_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CLD_DEPT_ID = CPE_DEPT_ID WHERE 1=1 AND CRE_RES_TYP IN ('Physician') AND CPE_ENC_DTE >= '2016-01-01' AND CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CRE_RES_NAME <> 'TEST, PROVIDER' GROUP BY CRE_RES_NAME, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6, CRE_RES_TYP, CRE_RES_STS

prompt: Update Tableau dashboard HIM29237 to match documents to surgeon.
completion: WITH SURG AS (SELECT DISTINCT SSE_MRN , SSE_LOG_ID , SSE_SURG_DTE , SSE_SURG_LOC , SSE_PT_TYPE , SSP_SURG_SVC_CD , SSP_PNL_NO , TRIM(SSP_SURG_LAST_NM) || ', ' || TRIM(SSP_SURG_FIRST_NM) SURGEON FROM IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT LEFT JOIN IDB.CD_DOCUMENT ON CDD_MRN = SSE_MRN AND CDD_SERVICE_DTE = SSE_SURG_DTE LEFT JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE ON SSE_LOG_ID = SSP_LOG_ID AND SSE_ENC_CSN_ID = SSP_ENC_CSN_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_PROVIDER ON CDD_AUTH_PROV_GUID = OP_PVDR_GUID AND OP_PVDR_NO = SSP_RES_ID WHERE (SSE_SURG_LOC not like '%IR%' AND SSE_SURG_LOC not like '%ENDO%' AND SSE_SOURCE_TYPE <> 'E') AND SSE_SURG_DTE = CASE WHEN DAYOFWEEK(CURRENT date) = 2 THEN CURRENT DATE - 3 DAY ELSE CURRENT DATE - 1 DAY END AND SSP_PNL_NO >= 1 ) , SURG_PNL_CT AS (SELECT SSE_LOG_ID, SSP_PNL_NO, COUNT(*) PANEL_COUNT FROM IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT LEFT JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE ON SSE_LOG_ID = SSP_LOG_ID AND SSE_ENC_CSN_ID = SSP_ENC_CSN_ID WHERE (SSE_SURG_LOC not like '%IR%' AND SSE_SURG_LOC not like '%ENDO%' AND SSE_SOURCE_TYPE <> 'E') AND SSE_SURG_DTE = CASE WHEN DAYOFWEEK(CURRENT date) = 2 THEN CURRENT DATE - 3 DAY ELSE CURRENT DATE - 1 DAY END AND SSP_PNL_NO >= 1 GROUP BY SSE_LOG_ID, SSP_PNL_NO) , DOC AS (SELECT DISTINCT CDD_MRN AS "MRN", CDD_SERVICE_DTE AS "Service Date", CDD_AUTHORED_DTE, CDD_DOC_NAME AS "Document Name", OP_DISPLAY_NAME AS "Provider", CDD_DOC_GUID AS DOC_GUID, CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND AS INCOMPLETE_IND FROM IDB.CD_DOCUMENT LEFT JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION ON CDD_DOC_GUID = CDO_DOC_GUID AND CDD_AUTHORED_DTE = CDO_AUTHORED_DTE AND CDO_VALUE_TEXT <> '' JOIN IDB.OMS_PROVIDER ON CDD_AUTH_PROV_GUID = OP_PVDR_GUID WHERE CDD_CANCEL_IND <> '1' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND <> '1' AND CDD_SERVICE_DTE = CASE WHEN DAYOFWEEK(CURRENT date) = 2 THEN CURRENT DATE - 3 DAY ELSE CURRENT DATE - 1 DAY END AND (CDD_DOC_NAME like 'Operative%' OR CDD_DOC_NAME like 'Endoscopy Proc%' OR CDD_DOC_NAME like 'Procedure Note%' OR CDD_DOC_NAME like '%Procedure Rep%') ) , X AS (SELECT DISTINCT SURG.SSE_MRN MRN, SURG.SSE_LOG_ID SURG_LOG_ID, SURG.SSE_SURG_DTE SURG_DATE, SURG.SSE_SURG_LOC SURG_LOCATION, SURG.SSE_PT_TYPE SURG_PT_TYPE, SURG.SURGEON SURG_SURGEON, SURG.SSP_SURG_SVC_CD SURG_SERVICE, SURG.SSP_PNL_NO, PANEL_COUNT, CASE WHEN PANEL_COUNT > 1 THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS MULTIPLE_PANEL FROM SURG LEFT JOIN SURG_PNL_CT ON SURG.SSE_LOG_ID = SURG_PNL_CT.SSE_LOG_ID AND SURG.SSP_PNL_NO = SURG_PNL_CT.SSP_PNL_NO ) , Y AS (SELECT DISTINCT X.*, DOC."Document Name" DOC_DOCUMENT_NAME, DOC."Provider" DOV_PROVIDER, CDD_AUTHORED_DTE DOC_AUTHORED_DTE, DOC_GUID, CASE WHEN DOC_GUID IS NULL THEN 'Missing' WHEN INCOMPLETE_IND = 1 THEN 'Incomplete' WHEN INCOMPLETE_IND = 0 THEN 'Complete' END AS "Documentation Status" FROM X LEFT JOIN DOC ON X.MRN = DOC.MRN AND X.SURG_DATE = DOC."Service Date" WHERE DOC.MRN IS NULL AND DOC."Service Date" IS NULL ) SELECT * FROM Y

prompt: Provide a list of all MSK patients with Stage I-III early stage breast cancer with TNBC and whether they had: AR >1%, AR 0%, or no AR testing.
Provide a daily report of patients scheduled within the next 3 business days that do not have a PT/INR order entered or resulted within 72 hours of the appointment.
completion: WITH DATE_LIST AS (SELECT DT_DTE DL_DATE FROM (SELECT DT_DTE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( ORDER BY DT_DTE - CURRENT_DATE DESC) RN FROM DV.DATE WHERE DT_WEEKDAY_FLAG = 'Weekday' AND DT_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT_DATE - 30 DAYS AND CURRENT_DATE UNION SELECT DT_DTE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( ORDER BY DT_DTE - CURRENT_DATE) RN FROM DV.DATE WHERE DT_WEEKDAY_FLAG = 'Weekday' AND DT_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT_DATE AND CURRENT_DATE + 30 DAYS ) ORDER BY DT_DTE) , VISIT_CTE AS (SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN, DT_DTE, ENR_RES_NAME AS "PRIM_RES_NAME", PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, ENDP_CENTER_ABBR, MP_EXTERNAL_NM AS "REF_PROVIDER_NAME" FROM DV.PATIENT_ENCOUNTER JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PENC_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID JOIN DV.DATE ON PENC_ENC_DATE_ID = DT_DATE_ID LEFT JOIN DV.ENCOUNTER_DESC_CATALOG STS ON PENC_APPT_STS = STS.EDC_DEPT_ABBREV AND STS.EDC_GROUP_ID = 'STS' JOIN DV.ENCOUNTER_DEPARTMENT ON PENC_DEPT_ID = ENDP_ENC_DEPT_ID JOIN DV.ENCOUNTER_SCHD_RESOURCES ON PENC_PT_ENC_ID = ENSR_PT_ENC_ID AND ENSR_PRIMARY_RES_IND = 'Y' JOIN DV.ENCOUNTER_RESOURCE ON ENSR_RES_ID = ENR_ENC_RES_ID JOIN DV.ENCOUNTER_VISIT_TYPE ON PENC_VISIT_TYPE_ID = ENVT_ENC_VISIT_TYPE_ID JOIN DV.MEDPRO ON PENC_REF_PROVIDER_ID = MP_MEDPRO_ID WHERE (PENC_APPT_STS IN ('Sch', 'Comp')) AND (ENVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR = 'APP PR60' OR ENVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME = 'NEUAPP PR60') AND (ENDP_CENTER_ABBR IN ('MON', 'WES', 'BER', 'NAS')) ) , ORDER_CTE AS (SELECT OO_MRN AS "ORD_MRN", OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE AS "SIG_DT", OSTS_STS_DESC AS "STS", OOC_ITEM_NAME, CASE WHEN (OO_PERFORMED_DT >= OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE) THEN 'Performed' ELSE 'Not Yet Performed' END AS "SCENARIO" FROM IDB.OMS_ORDER JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_CATALOG ON OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID = OOC_MSTR_ITEM_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_STATUS ON OO_ORD_STS_CD = OSTS_ORD_STS_CD JOIN VISIT_CTE ON OO_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE (OOC_ITEM_NAME LIKE '%PT%INR%') ) SELECT DISTINCT DL_DATE, PT_MRN, TRIM(PT_LAST_NAME) || ', ' || TRIM(PT_FIRST_NAME) AS PATIENT_NAME, PRIM_RES_NAME PROVIDER, REF_PROVIDER_NAME REFERRING_PROVIDER, SIG_DT ORDER_DATE, OOC_ITEM_NAME ORDER_NAME, STS ORDER_STATUS, SCENARIO FROM DATE_LIST LEFT JOIN VISIT_CTE ON DL_DATE = DT_DTE LEFT JOIN ORDER_CTE ON DL_DATE = SIG_DT AND PT_MRN = ORD_MRN ORDER BY DL_DATE

prompt: Patients with order to receive a draining PEG procedure.
completion: SELECT OO_MRN AS MRN , PT_LAST_NAME AS "Last Name" , PT_FIRST_NAME AS "First Name" , PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH AS "Date of Birth" , PT_DATE_OF_DEATH AS "Date of Death" , CASE WHEN PT_DATE_OF_DEATH IS NULL THEN YEAR(CURRENT date - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) END AS "Current Age" , CASE WHEN PT_DATE_OF_DEATH IS NULL THEN 'Alive' ELSE 'Deceased' END AS "Vital Status" , PT_SEX AS "Gender" , R.AV_DESC AS "Race (Reg)" , E.AV_DESC AS "Ethnicity (Reg)" , OO_ENTER_DTE AS "Enter Date" , VIS_ADM_DTE AS "Admit Date" , VIS_DSCH_DTE AS "Discharge Date" , OO_ENTER_ROLE AS "Enter Role" , OO_REQUESTED_DTE AS "Requested Date" , OO_SUMMARY_LINE AS "Summary Line" , OO_ORD_STS_CD AS "Order Status" , OO_REQ_TME_PRIO AS "Priority" , OCV_VISIT_STS AS "Visit Status" , OCV_CURR_LOC AS "Location" , OCV_PVDR_NAME AS "Provider Name" , OCV_DSCH_DISP AS "Discharge Disp" , OO_ORD_NAME AS "Order Name" , OO_SET_HEADING AS "Set Heading" , OO_SET_NAME AS "Set Name" FROM IDB.OMS_ORDER OO JOIN IDB.OMS_CLIENT_VISIT OCV ON OCV_VISIT_GUID = OO_VISIT_GUID JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PT_MRN = OO_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS R ON R.AV_ELEMENT = 'RACE' AND R.AV_CODE = PT_RACE LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS E ON E.AV_ELEMENT = 'PT_ETHNICITY' AND E.AV_CODE = PT_PT_ETHNICITY LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM (SELECT VIS_MRN, VIS_ADM_NUM, VIS_ADM_DTE, VIS_DSCH_DTE, VIS_PATIENT_TYPE, VIS_HOSP_SVC, VIS_NURS_STA , ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY VIS_MRN ORDER BY DATE(VIS_ADM_DT) DESC) RN FROM IDB.VISIT WHERE VIS_IP_OP_ADJUSTED_IND = 'I' AND VIS_VISIT_STATUS IN ('2', '3') ) XYZ WHERE RN = 1 ) ABC ON VIS_MRN = OO_MRN WHERE 1=1 AND OCV_IP_OP_IND = 'I' AND OO_ENTER_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT date - 1 DAY AND CURRENT date AND OO_ORD_STS_CD NOT IN ('CANP', 'CANC', 'AUC3') AND (OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID IN ('9000009882100730' , '9000005902300730' , '9000005902600730') OR (OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID = '9000006000100730' AND (UPPER(OO_SUMMARY_LINE) like '%GASTRO%' OR UPPER(OO_SUMMARY_LINE) like '%GASTRIC%' OR UPPER(OO_SUMMARY_LINE) like '%TUBE%' OR UPPER(OO_SUMMARY_LINE) like '%D%PEG%' OR UPPER(OO_SUMMARY_LINE) like '%DRAINAGE%PEG%') ) ) ORDER BY OO_ENTER_DTE, OO_MRN

prompt: Build dataset for Dr. Jillian Tsai in replicating an ML algorithm in predicting toxicity in patients receiving radiation treatment
completion: WITH RT AS (SELECT RTC_TX_MRN , RTC_TX_START_DTE , RTC_TX_STOP_DTE , RTC_TX_PLAN_NAME , RTC_TX_PLANNED_DOSE , RTC_TX_PLANNED_FRACTIONS FROM IDB.RADONC_TREATMENT_COURSE JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON RTC_TX_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE YEAR(RTC_TX_START_DTE) = 2018 ) , PT AS (SELECT PT_MRN, PT_SEX, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, M.AV_DESC MARITAL_STS, RL.AV_DESC RELIGION, LEFT(PT_ZIP_CD, 5) ZIPCODE, CASE WHEN COALESCE(R.AV_DESC, CR.AV_DESC) IN ('WHITE', 'WHITE HISPANIC') THEN 'White' WHEN COALESCE(R.AV_DESC, CR.AV_DESC) IN ('BLACK OR AFRICAN AMERICAN', 'BLACK', 'BLACK HISPANIC') THEN 'Black' WHEN COALESCE(R.AV_DESC, CR.AV_DESC) IN ('ASIAN-FAR EAST/INDIAN SUBCONT', 'KAMPUCHEAN', 'LAOTIAN', 'VIETNAMESE', 'HMONG', 'CHINESE', 'ASIAN INDIAN PAKISTANI', 'JAPANESE', 'KOREAN', 'OTHER ASIAN', 'THAI') THEN 'Asian' WHEN COALESCE(R.AV_DESC, CR.AV_DESC) IN ('NATIVE AMERICAN-AM IND/ALASKA', 'AMER IND ALEUT ESKIMO') THEN 'Native American or Alaska Native' WHEN COALESCE(R.AV_DESC, CR.AV_DESC) IN ('NATIVE HAWAIIAN OR PACIFIC ISL', 'HAWAIIAN', 'MELANESIAN', 'MICRONESIAN', 'FIJI ISLANDER', 'FILIPINO', 'GUAMANIAN', 'PACIFIC ISLANDER') THEN 'Native Hawaiian or Other Pacific Islander' ELSE 'Unspecified' END AS PT_RACE, CASE WHEN COALESCE(CE.AV_DESC, E.AV_DESC) IN ('SPANISH NOS; HISPANIC NOS, LATINO NOS', 'HISPANIC OR LATINO', 'PUERTO RICAN', 'SOUTH/CENTRAL AMERICA (EXCEPT BRAZIL)', 'DOMINICAN REPUBLIC', 'OTHER SPANISH/HISPANIC(INCL EUROPEAN; EXCL DOM REP)', 'CUBAN', 'MEXICAN (INCLUDES CHICANO)') OR COALESCE(R.AV_DESC, CR.AV_DESC) IN ('WHITE HISPANIC', 'BLACK HISPANIC') THEN 'Hispanic' WHEN COALESCE(CE.AV_DESC, E.AV_DESC) IN ('NOT HISPANIC', 'SPANISH SURNAME ONLY', 'NON-SPANISH; NON-HISPANIC') THEN 'Non-Hispanic' ELSE 'Unspecified' END AS PT_ETHNICITY FROM IDB.PATIENT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT RTC_TX_MRN FROM RT) RT ON PT_MRN = RTC_TX_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS R ON R.AV_ELEMENT = 'RACE' AND R.AV_CODE = PT_RACE LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS E ON E.AV_ELEMENT = 'PT_ETHNICITY' AND E.AV_CODE = PT_PT_ETHNICITY LEFT JOIN IDB.CDB_PATIENT ON PT_MRN = CP_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS CR ON CR.AV_ELEMENT = 'CDB_RACE' AND CR.AV_CODE = CP_CDB_RACE LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS CE ON CE.AV_ELEMENT = 'ETHNICITY' AND CE.AV_CODE = CP_ETHNICITY LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS RL ON RL.AV_ELEMENT = 'RELIGION' AND RL.AV_CODE = PT_RELIGION LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS M ON M.AV_ELEMENT = 'MARITAL_STS' AND M.AV_CODE = PT_MARITAL_STS) , APR AS (SELECT APR_MRN , RTC_TX_START_DTE APR_RT_START , RTC_TX_STOP_DTE APR_RT_STOP , RTC_TX_PLAN_NAME APR_RT_PLAN , MAX(CASE WHEN APR_START_DTE BETWEEN RTC_TX_START_DTE - 6 MONTH AND RTC_TX_START_DTE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) APR_RECENT , MAX(CASE WHEN APR_START_DTE BETWEEN RTC_TX_START_DTE AND RTC_TX_START_DTE + 14 DAY THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) APR_CONCURRENT FROM IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX_V JOIN RT ON APR_MRN = RTC_TX_MRN AND APR_START_DTE BETWEEN RTC_TX_START_DTE - 6 MONTH AND RTC_TX_START_DTE + 14 DAY GROUP BY APR_MRN , RTC_TX_START_DTE , RTC_TX_STOP_DTE , RTC_TX_PLAN_NAME) SELECT RTC_TX_MRN MRN , PT_SEX SEX , RTC_TX_START_DTE , RTC_TX_STOP_DTE , YEAR(RTC_TX_START_DTE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) AGE_AT_RT_START , MARITAL_STS , PT_RACE , PT_ETHNICITY , RELIGION , ZIPCODE , RTC_TX_PLANNED_DOSE , RTC_TX_PLANNED_FRACTIONS , CASE WHEN APR_RECENT IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE APR_RECENT END APR_RECENT , CASE WHEN APR_CONCURRENT IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE APR_CONCURRENT END APR_CONCURRENT FROM RT JOIN PT ON RTC_TX_MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN APR ON RTC_TX_MRN = APR_MRN AND RTC_TX_START_DTE = APR_RT_START AND RTC_TX_STOP_DTE = APR_RT_STOP AND RTC_TX_PLAN_NAME = APR_RT_PLAN FETCH FIRST 100 ROWS ONLY

prompt:
Provide a list of pathology reports from 2014 - 2018 that include of cases of:
