2. Chronic myelomoncytic leukemia
completion: SELECT PT_MRN AS "MRN", PT_LAST_NAME AS "Last Name", PT_FIRST_NAME AS "First Name", PT_BIRTH_DTE AS "DOB", YEAR(CURRENT date - PT_BIRTH_DTE) AS "Current Age", PRPT_ACCESSION_NO AS "Path Accession Number", PRPT_REPORT_TYPE "Path Report Type", PRPT_REPORT AS "Path Report" FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT JOIN DV.DATE R ON R.DT_DATE_ID = PRPT_REPORT_DATE_ID JOIN DV.PATH_RPRT_TYPE_LOOKUP ON PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_CD = PRPT_REPORT_TYPE JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON PRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID WHERE 1=1 AND CONTAINS("PRPT_REPORT", '("myelofibrosis")') = 1 AND CONTAINS("PRPT_REPORT", '("monocytosis")') = 1 AND R.DT_DTE BETWEEN '2014-01-01' AND '2018-12-31' AND PRPT_REPORT IS NOT NULL AND (PRPT_ACCESSION_NO like 'H%' OR PRPT_ACCESSION_NO like 'S%') ; SELECT PT_MRN AS "MRN", PT_LAST_NAME AS "Last Name", PT_FIRST_NAME AS "First Name", PT_BIRTH_DTE AS "DOB", YEAR(CURRENT date - PT_BIRTH_DTE) AS "Current Age", PRPT_ACCESSION_NO AS "Path Accession Number", PRPT_REPORT_TYPE "Path Report Type", PRPT_REPORT AS "Path Report" FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT JOIN DV.DATE R ON R.DT_DATE_ID = PRPT_REPORT_DATE_ID JOIN DV.PATH_RPRT_TYPE_LOOKUP ON PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_CD = PRPT_REPORT_TYPE JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON PRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID WHERE 1=1 AND CONTAINS("PRPT_REPORT", '("chronic myelomonocytic leukemia")') = 1 AND R.DT_DTE BETWEEN '2014-01-01' AND '2018-12-31' AND PRPT_REPORT IS NOT NULL AND (PRPT_ACCESSION_NO like 'H%' OR PRPT_ACCESSION_NO like 'S%')

prompt: Provide a daily list of CIS Pathology Submission made by International Center employees. Need daily report to include request status and requester information for tracking and follow up purposes.
completion: SELECT DISTINCT OO_MRN AS MRN, OO_USER_GUID, TRIM(PT_LAST_NAME) || ', ' || PT_FIRST_NAME AS PT_NAME, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH AS DATE_OF_BIRTH, OU_DISPLAY_NAME AS ORDER_ENTERED_USER, OO_ENTER_DTE AS ORDER_ENTER_DATE, OO_ORD_ID AS ORDER_ID, OO_ORD_NAME AS ORDER_NAME, OP_DISPLAY_NAME AS REQUESTED_PROVIDER, DOC_NAME AS DOCTOR_NAME, OSH_REASON_TXT AS REASON_TEXT, OSH_CREATE_DTE AS ORDER_SIGNED_DATE, DOC_SVC AS PROVIDER_SERVICE, OSTS_STS_DESC AS ORDER_STATUS FROM IDB.OMS_ORDER JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_CATALOG ON OOC_MSTR_ITEM_GUID = OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_STS_HX ON OSH_ORD_GUID = OO_ORD_GUID LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_STATUS ON OSTS_ORD_STS_CD = OO_ORD_STS_CD LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_USER ON OO_USER_GUID = OU_USER_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_PROVIDER ON OO_PVDR_GUID= OP_PVDR_GUID LEFT JOIN IDB.DOC ON OP_PVDR_NO = DOC_DR_NO JOIN IDB.PATIENT_V ON OO_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE 1=1 AND OO_ENTER_DTE = CURRENT DATE - 1 DAY AND OSH_FUNCTION_CD = 100 AND OO_ORD_NAME IN('Surgical Pathology Submitted Slides Order', 'Cytology-Submitted Slides Order') AND OO_USER_GUID IN ('3000002701119001', '4000004561119029', '9000014576201190', '8000005422119029', '9000302384401190', '9000166009301190', '9001728461201190', '9000569461201190', '9001015742101190', '9001040297001190', '9000481690401190', '9000554094301190', '9000692594301190', '9000831921001190', '9000866283001190', '9001003780601190', '9001072203201190', '9001974851001190', '9000823821001190', '9001072203101190', '9001757575701190', '9000484070501190', '8000001182119001');

prompt: Provide a list of CLL patients with a positive mutation for BTK or PLCG.
completion: WITH X AS (SELECT TM_MRN AS MRN, TM_DX_DTE AS DX_DATE, TM_HIST_CD AS DX_CODE, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS DX_DESC FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM H ON TM_HIST_CD = H.CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON TM_SITE_CD = S.CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND TM_HIST_CD = 'M9823/3' UNION SELECT CC_MRN AS MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS DX_DATE, CLM_CLSF_CD AS DX_CODE, CLM_CLSF_DESC AS DX_DESC FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND ((CC_PT_TYPE = 'I') OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) AND CC_CLSF_CD IN ('204.1', '204.10', '204.11', '204.12', 'C91.1', 'C91.10', 'C91.11', 'C91.12') GROUP BY CC_MRN, CLM_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC ) , CTE AS (SELECT MRN AS DX_MRN, DX_DATE, STRIP(DX_CODE) || '-' || STRIP(DX_DESC) AS DX_CODE FROM X) , CTE2 AS (SELECT * FROM CTE ORDER BY DX_MRN, DX_DATE, DX_CODE) , T1 AS (SELECT DX_MRN, DX_DATE, DX_CODE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY DX_MRN ORDER BY DX_DATE) AS RN FROM CTE2 ORDER BY DX_MRN, DX_DATE) , T2 (MRN, DX, RN1) AS (SELECT DX_MRN, CAST(DX_DATE AS VARCHAR(6000))||' | '||CAST(DX_CODE AS VARCHAR(100)), RN FROM T1 WHERE T1.RN = 1 UNION ALL SELECT DX_MRN, RTRIM(CAST(DX AS VARCHAR(4000))) || ', ' || CHR(13) || CHR(10) || CAST(DX_DATE AS VARCHAR(100))||' | '||RTRIM(CAST(DX_CODE AS VARCHAR(100))) , RN1 + 1 FROM T1, T2 WHERE DX_MRN = MRN AND RN = RN1+1 ) , T3 AS (SELECT MRN, MAX(RN1) RN FROM T2 GROUP BY MRN) , T4 AS (SELECT T2.MRN, RN, DX FROM T2 JOIN T3 ON T2.MRN = T3.MRN AND T2.RN1 = T3.RN) SELECT MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, DX, PATH_PROCEDURE_DATE, PATH_RPT_DATE, PRPT_ACCESSION_NO, GENE, RESULT, METHOD, LOCUS, AA_CHANGE, NUCLEOTIDE, SEARCH_HIT1, SEARCH_HIT2, ABERRATIONTYPE, FOLD_CHANGE, GENE2 FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_STRUCTURED_RESULTS_V X JOIN T4 ON PT_MRN = MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.PATIENT Y ON X.PT_MRN = Y.PT_MRN WHERE GENE LIKE '%BTK%' OR GENE LIKE '%PLC%'

prompt: Provide the annual number of patients who've received an allogeneic stem cell (HSCT) transplant and influenza vaccine after HSCT.
completion: WITH CTE_PROC AS (SELECT CC_MRN AS MRN, CC_EFF_DTE AS PROC_DTE, YEAR(CC_EFF_DTE) AS PROC_YR FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF A INNER JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE CC_CLSF_CD IN ('41.02', '41.03', '41.05', '41.06', '41.08') AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'P%' AND YEAR(CC_EFF_DTE) >= 2006 GROUP BY CC_MRN, CC_EFF_DTE, YEAR(CC_EFF_DTE) UNION ALL SELECT PBD_MRN AS MRN, PBD_SVC_DTE AS PROC_DTE, YEAR(PBD_SVC_DTE) AS PROC_YR FROM IDB.PBD_DTL_CHARGES INNER JOIN IDB.PBD_CODE ON PBD_PBD_CD = PBC_PBD_CD INNER JOIN IDB.CLM ON PBC_CPT_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE PBC_CPT_CD IN ('85667') AND CLM_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'C%' AND YEAR(PBD_SVC_DTE) >= 2006 GROUP BY PBD_MRN, PBD_SVC_DTE, YEAR(PBD_SVC_DTE) HAVING SUM(PBD_SVC_QTY) > 0), CTE_PHM AS (SELECT MRN, PROC_DTE, PROC_YR, MIN(POD_STRT_DTE) AS PHM_STRT_DTE FROM IDB.PHM_ORDER JOIN IDB.PHM_ORD_DTL ON PO_ORD_SEQ = POD_ORD_SEQ JOIN IDB.PHM_ORD_INV ON POD_ORD_SEQ = POI_ORD_SEQ AND POD_ITEM_NO = POI_ITEM_NO JOIN IDB.PHM_INVENTORY ON POI_INV_SEQ = PIN_INV_SEQ JOIN CTE_PROC ON POD_MRN = MRN WHERE UPPER(PIN_GENERIC_NAME) LIKE '%INFLUENZA%' AND PO_ORD_STS NOT IN ('X', 'P') AND POD_STRT_DTE BETWEEN PROC_DTE AND (PROC_DTE + 1 YEAR) GROUP BY MRN, PROC_DTE, PROC_YR ), CTE_SUMMARY AS (SELECT A.MRN, A.PROC_DTE, A.PROC_YR, B.PHM_STRT_DTE FROM CTE_PROC A LEFT JOIN CTE_PHM B ON A.MRN = B.MRN AND A.PROC_DTE = B.PROC_DTE AND A.PROC_YR = B.PROC_YR) SELECT PROC_YR, COUNT(MRN) AS TOTAL_PROCEDURE_COUNT, COUNT(PHM_STRT_DTE) AS VACCINE_COUNT, COUNT(MRN) - COUNT(PHM_STRT_DTE) AS NO_VACCINE_COUNT FROM CTE_SUMMARY GROUP BY PROC_YR

prompt:
We are looking to identify patients with a medulloblastoma diagnosed under age 7, comparing their treatment course with the absence or use of radiation therapy and type of radiation therapy (CSI vs focal RT).



Downstream projects using this information will look to determine the overall survival (OS) and progression-free survival (PFS) of young children with WNT or Group 4 medulloblastoma treated with high dose chemotherapy and CSI-sparing approach.
completion: SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN AS MRN, PT_LAST_NAME AS "Last Name", PT_FIRST_NAME AS "First Name", PT_SEX AS GENDER, PT_BIRTH_DTE AS "Date of Birth", YEAR(PRPT_REPORT_DTE - PT_BIRTH_DTE) AS "Age at Diagnosis", CASE WHEN RTC_TX_START_DTE IS NOT NULL THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS "RT Indicator(Y/N)", PRPT_REPORT_DTE AS "Pathology Report Date", PDRX_DMP_PATIENT_ID AS "DMP Patient ID", PRPT_ACCESSION_NO AS "Accession Number", PRPT_REPORT_TYPE_DESC AS "Pathology Report Type Description", VARCHAR(PRPT_REPORT, 32000) AS "Report Text" FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V LEFT JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML ON PDRX_PATH_RPT_ID = PRPT_PATH_RPT_ID JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON PRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.RADONC_TREATMENT_COURSE ON PT_MRN = RTC_TX_MRN WHERE CONTAINS("PRPT_REPORT", '("medulloblastoma" OR "PNET" OR "MEDULLOBLASTOMA")') = 1 AND YEAR(PRPT_REPORT_DTE - PT_BIRTH_DTE) BETWEEN '0' AND '7' ORDER BY PT_MRN ; WITH DX AS (SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_SEX, PT_BIRTH_DTE, YEAR(PRPT_REPORT_DTE - PT_BIRTH_DTE) AS "Age at Diagnosis", CASE WHEN RTC_TX_START_DTE IS NOT NULL THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS "RT Indicator(Y/N)", PRPT_REPORT_DTE, PDRX_DMP_PATIENT_ID, PRPT_ACCESSION_NO, PRPT_REPORT_TYPE, PRPT_REPORT_TYPE_DESC, VARCHAR(PRPT_REPORT, 32000) AS REPORT_TXT FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V LEFT JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML ON PDRX_PATH_RPT_ID = PRPT_PATH_RPT_ID JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON PRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.RADONC_TREATMENT_COURSE ON PT_MRN = RTC_TX_MRN WHERE CONTAINS("PRPT_REPORT", '("medulloblastoma" OR "PNET" OR "MEDULLOBLASTOMA")') = 1 AND YEAR(PRPT_REPORT_DTE - PT_BIRTH_DTE) BETWEEN '0' AND '7' ) SELECT DISTINCT RTC_TX_MRN AS MRN, PT_LAST_NAME AS "Last Name", PT_FIRST_NAME AS "First Name", PT_SEX AS GENDER, PT_BIRTH_DTE AS "Date of Birth", RTC_TX_START_DTE AS "RT Start Date", RTC_TX_STOP_DTE AS "RT End Date", RTC_TX_PLAN_NAME AS "RT Plan Name", RTC_TX_DELIVERED_DOSE AS "RT Delivered Dose" FROM DX JOIN IDB.RADONC_TREATMENT_COURSE ON PT_MRN = RTC_TX_MRN ORDER BY RTC_TX_MRN ;

prompt: Provide a Darwin cohort of patients for the given criteria along with access to the patients in the Darwin Digital Platform.
completion: WITH PTS AS (SELECT PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID PID FROM DV.PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED) , DT_1 AS (SELECT PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID AS P_ID FROM DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS REC LEFT JOIN DV.PATIENT_CORE_DEMOGRAPHICS ON PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = CORE_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID WHERE 1=1 AND PT_VITAL_STATUS IN ('ALIVE') ) , DT_2 AS (SELECT INC.PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID P_ID FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_STRUCTURED_RESULTS_V INC WHERE 1=1 AND (INC.GENE IN ('FGFR3') OR INC.GENE2 IN ('FGFR3')) AND CASE WHEN LOCATE('heme', LOWER(INC.METHOD)) > 0 OR LOCATE('liquid', LOWER(INC.METHOD)) > 0 OR LOCATE('RDTB', INC.METHOD) >0 THEN 'liquid' ELSE 'solid' END IN ('solid') AND (INC.ABERRATIONTYPE IN ('fusion', 'mutation', 'point_mutation') OR CASE WHEN 'fusion' IN ('fusion', 'mutation', 'point_mutation') AND (UPPER(SEARCH_HIT2) like '%FUSION%' OR UPPER(SEARCH_HIT2) like '%TRANSLOCATION%' OR UPPER(SEARCH_HIT2) like '%REARRAN%' OR UPPER(SEARCH_HIT2) like '%INVERSION%') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END = 1) ) , DT_3 AS (SELECT INC.PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID P_ID FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_STRUCTURED_RESULTS_V INC WHERE 1=1 AND (INC.GENE IN ('RXRA') OR INC.GENE2 IN ('RXRA')) AND CASE WHEN LOCATE('heme', LOWER(INC.METHOD)) > 0 OR LOCATE('liquid', LOWER(INC.METHOD)) > 0 OR LOCATE('RDTB', INC.METHOD) >0 THEN 'liquid' ELSE 'solid' END IN ('solid') AND (INC.ABERRATIONTYPE IN ('mutation') OR CASE WHEN 'fusion' IN ('mutation') AND (UPPER(SEARCH_HIT2) like '%FUSION%' OR UPPER(SEARCH_HIT2) like '%TRANSLOCATION%' OR UPPER(SEARCH_HIT2) like '%REARRAN%' OR UPPER(SEARCH_HIT2) like '%INVERSION%') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END = 1) ) , DT_4 AS (SELECT INC.PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID P_ID FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_STRUCTURED_RESULTS_V INC WHERE 1=1 AND (INC.GENE IN ('PPARG') OR INC.GENE2 IN ('PPARG')) AND CASE WHEN LOCATE('heme', LOWER(INC.METHOD)) > 0 OR LOCATE('liquid', LOWER(INC.METHOD)) > 0 OR LOCATE('RDTB', INC.METHOD) >0 THEN 'liquid' ELSE 'solid' END IN ('solid') AND (INC.ABERRATIONTYPE IN ('amplification', 'fusion', 'mutation', 'point_mutation') OR CASE WHEN 'fusion' IN ('amplification', 'fusion', 'mutation', 'point_mutation') AND (UPPER(SEARCH_HIT2) like '%FUSION%' OR UPPER(SEARCH_HIT2) like '%TRANSLOCATION%' OR UPPER(SEARCH_HIT2) like '%REARRAN%' OR UPPER(SEARCH_HIT2) like '%INVERSION%') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END = 1) ) , DT_5 AS (SELECT PDX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID AS P_ID FROM DV.PATIENT_DIAGNOSIS PD , DV.DIAGNOSIS_ATTRIBUTE DA, (SELECT DXCC_DX_CATALOG_ID, DXCC_ICD_CODE, DXCC_ICD_MSK_DESC , SUBSTR(DXCC_ICD_CODE, 1, CASE WHEN LOCATE('.', DXCC_ICD_CODE) THEN LOCATE('.', DXCC_ICD_CODE) -1 ELSE LENGTH(DXCC_ICD_CODE) END)AS ICD_CODE_GROUP , CASE WHEN (DXCC_DX_TYPE = 'ICD9' AND DXCC_ICD_CODE BETWEEN '196' AND '198.99') OR (DXCC_DX_TYPE = 'ICD10' AND DXCC_ICD_CODE BETWEEN 'C77' AND 'C79.9') THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS IS_METS , CASE WHEN (DXCC_DX_TYPE = 'ICD9' AND DXCC_ICD_CODE BETWEEN '140' AND '239.999' AND DXCC_ICD_CODE NOT BETWEEN '210' AND '229') OR (DXCC_DX_TYPE = 'ICD10' AND DXCC_ICD_CODE BETWEEN 'C00' AND 'D49.99' AND DXCC_ICD_CODE NOT BETWEEN 'D10' AND 'D36' AND DXCC_ICD_CODE NOT BETWEEN 'D3A' AND 'D3A') OR DXCC_ICD_CODE BETWEEN 'Z85.0' AND 'Z85.999' THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS IS_CA FROM DV.DIAGNOSIS_CATALOG WHERE DXCC_DX_TYPE IN ('ICD9', 'ICD10') ) DCC JOIN (SELECT TRIM(COLUMN_VALUES) COLUMN_VALUES FROM TABLE(DV.STRING_SPLIT('E10,250', ',')) S) X ON LOWER(TRIM(X.COLUMN_VALUES)) = LOWER(ICD_CODE_GROUP) , (SELECT DT_DATE_ID, DT_DTE AS DX_DTE FROM DV.DATE_V) DT WHERE PD.PDX_DIAGNOSIS_ATTRIBUTE_ID = DA.DXA_ATTRIBUTE_ID AND PD.PDX_DX_CATALOG_ID = DCC.DXCC_DX_CATALOG_ID AND DA.DXA_CLSF_TYPE like 'DF%' AND DT.DT_DATE_ID = PD.PDX_DX_DATE_ID ) , DEID AS (SELECT DISTINCT P_ID FROM (SELECT P_ID FROM DT_1 INTERSECT SELECT P_ID FROM DT_2 INTERSECT SELECT P_ID FROM DT_3 INTERSECT SELECT P_ID FROM DT_4 ) EXCEPT SELECT P_ID FROM DT_5 )

prompt: Schedule a report of immunotherapy patients who had an ircAE in the previous week.
completion: WITH IO1 AS (SELECT DISTINCT APR_MRN, CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME, APR_START_DTE, APR_ORD_RX_TYPE, APR_LOCATION FROM IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX_V WHERE CDG_IMMUNOTHERAPY_FLAG = 'Y' AND APR_START_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT date - 2 YEARS AND CURRENT date ) , IO_MAX AS (SELECT APR_MRN, MAX(APR_START_DTE) AS LATEST_IO_DATE FROM IO1 GROUP BY APR_MRN) , IO2 AS (SELECT IO1.* FROM IO1 JOIN IO_MAX ON IO1.APR_MRN = IO_MAX.APR_MRN AND IO1.APR_START_DTE = IO_MAX.LATEST_IO_DATE) , IO AS (SELECT APR_MRN, APR_START_DTE, APR_LOCATION, LISTAGG(COALESCE(STRIP(CAST(CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME AS VARCHAR(12000))), '') , CHR(13) || CHR(10)) WITHIN GROUP( ORDER BY APR_MRN) AS IO_NAME FROM IO2 GROUP BY APR_MRN, APR_START_DTE, APR_LOCATION ) , CC AS (SELECT CC_MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS DX_DATE, CLM_CLSF_CD AS DX_CODE, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS DX_DESC FROM IO JOIN IDB.CTC_CLSF ON APR_MRN = CC_MRN JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND ((CC_PT_TYPE = 'I') OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) AND CC_EFF_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT date - 7 DAYS AND CURRENT date AND CC_CLSF_CD IN ('L12.0', 'L13.9', 'L20.9', 'L50.8', 'L50.9', 'L20.82', 'L28', 'L28.0', 'L80', 'L81.6', 'L81.8', 'L81.9') GROUP BY CC_MRN, CLM_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK ) SELECT DISTINCT STRIP(PT_MRN) AS MRN, STRIP(PT_LAST_NAME) || ', ' || STRIP(PT_FIRST_NAME) AS "Name", APR_START_DTE AS "Most Recent Immunotherapy Date", STRIP(IO_NAME) AS "Immunotherapy Name", DX_DATE AS "ircAE Date", STRIP(DX_CODE) AS "ICD-10 Code", STRIP(DX_DESC) AS "ICD-10 Description", APR_LOCATION FROM IDB.PATIENT JOIN IO ON PT_MRN = APR_MRN JOIN CC ON PT_MRN = CC_MRN

prompt: Provide a list of patients who are consented to the protocols 06-107 or 12-245 and are MyMSK iOS app users.
completion: WITH X AS (SELECT PT.PT_MRN, STRIP(PT_LAST_NAME)||', '||STRIP(PT_FIRST_NAME) AS NAME, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH AS DOB, CPP_EMAIL_ADDR AS EMAIL, CPP_PP_LST_LGN_DTE, MAX(CASE WHEN AC_IRB_NO = '06-107' THEN AC_CONS_DTE END) AS "06-107 Consent Date", MAX(CASE WHEN AC_IRB_NO = '12-245' THEN AC_CONS_DTE END) AS "12-245 Consent Date", MAX(CASE WHEN AC_IRB_NO = '06-107' THEN REGISTRATION_DATETIME END) AS "06-107 Reg Date", MAX(CASE WHEN AC_IRB_NO = '12-245' THEN REGISTRATION_DATETIME END) AS "12-245 Reg Date" FROM IDB.PATIENT PT JOIN IDB.CL_PAS_PATIENT ON CPP_MRN = PT.PT_MRN AND CPP_PP_LST_LGN_DTE IS NOT NULL JOIN IDB.ACCRUALS ON PT.PT_MRN = AC_MRN LEFT JOIN NN.CRDB_DASH_PT C1 ON C1.PT_MRN = AC_MRN AND C1.PRT_ID = AC_IRB_NO LEFT JOIN NN.CRDB_DASH_PT_REG C2 ON C2.PT_MRN = AC_MRN AND C2.PRT_ID = AC_IRB_NO AND C2.REG_ID_DSCRP = 'CTMS Registration' WHERE AC_IRB_NO IN ('06-107', '12-245') GROUP BY PT.PT_MRN, STRIP(PT_LAST_NAME)||', '||STRIP(PT_FIRST_NAME), PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, CPP_EMAIL_ADDR, CPP_PP_LST_LGN_DTE, REGISTRATION_DATETIME, REG_ID, REG_ID_DSCRP, REG_INDVDL, REG_STATUS ) , Y AS (SELECT TM_MRN, TM_DX_DTE, TM_SITE_CD AS SITE_CODE, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_DESC, TM_HIST_CD AS HIST_CODE, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS HIST_DESC FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM H ON TM_HIST_CD = H.CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON TM_SITE_CD = S.CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('3', '6', '7', '8') AND TM_MRN IN (SELECT PT_MRN FROM X) ) , CTE AS (SELECT TM_MRN AS DX_MRN, TM_DX_DTE AS DX_DATE, STRIP(SITE_CODE) || '-' || STRIP(SITE_DESC) || '|' || STRIP(HIST_CODE) || '-' || STRIP(HIST_DESC) AS DX_CODE FROM Y) , CTE2 AS (SELECT * FROM CTE ORDER BY DX_MRN, DX_DATE, DX_CODE) , T1 AS (SELECT DX_MRN, DX_DATE, DX_CODE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY DX_MRN ORDER BY DX_DATE) AS RN FROM CTE2 ORDER BY DX_MRN, DX_DATE) , T2 (MRN, DX, RN1) AS (SELECT DX_MRN, CAST(DX_DATE AS VARCHAR(6000))||' | '||CAST(DX_CODE AS VARCHAR(100)), RN FROM T1 WHERE T1.RN = 1 UNION ALL SELECT DX_MRN, RTRIM(CAST(DX AS VARCHAR(4000))) || ', ' || CHR(13) || CHR(10) || CAST(DX_DATE AS VARCHAR(100))||' | '||RTRIM(CAST(DX_CODE AS VARCHAR(100))) , RN1 + 1 FROM T1, T2 WHERE DX_MRN = MRN AND RN = RN1+1 ) , T3 AS (SELECT MRN, MAX(RN1) RN FROM T2 GROUP BY MRN) , T4 AS (SELECT T2.MRN, RN, DX FROM T2 JOIN T3 ON T2.MRN = T3.MRN AND T2.RN1 = T3.RN) , Z AS (SELECT X.*, DX FROM X LEFT JOIN T4 ON PT_MRN = MRN) , CD AS (SELECT DISTINCT CDD_MRN, CDD_DOC_NAME, CDO_SECTION, CDO_CTLG_DISPL_NM, CDO_ITEM_NAME, CDO_VALUE_TEXT, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CDD_MRN ORDER BY CDD_SERVICE_DT DESC) AS RN FROM Z JOIN IDB.CD_DOCUMENT ON PT_MRN = CDD_MRN JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION ON CDO_DOC_GUID = CDD_DOC_GUID AND CDO_AUTHORED_DTE = CDD_AUTHORED_DTE WHERE CDD_CANCEL_IND = '0' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND = '0' AND(UPPER(CDO_ITEM_NAME) LIKE '%KPS%' OR UPPER(CDO_ITEM_NAME) LIKE '%KARNOFSKY%' OR UPPER(CDO_ITEM_NAME) LIKE '%ECOG%' OR UPPER(CDO_ITEM_NAME) LIKE '%FUNCT%' OR UPPER(CDO_ITEM_NAME) LIKE '%QOL%' OR UPPER(CDO_ITEM_NAME) LIKE '%ADL%' OR UPPER(CDO_ITEM_NAME) LIKE '%LANSKY%' OR UPPER(CDO_ITEM_NAME) LIKE '%LPS%' OR UPPER(CDO_ITEM_NAME) LIKE '%TINETTI%' OR UPPER(CDO_ITEM_NAME) LIKE '%ZUBROD%') AND UPPER(CDO_ITEM_NAME) NOT LIKE '%PULMONARY FUNCTION%' ) SELECT Z.*, CDO_ITEM_NAME, CDO_VALUE_TEXT FROM Z LEFT JOIN CD ON PT_MRN = CDD_MRN

prompt: Provide a list of patients who have started palbociclib in the last 6 months.
completion: WITH X AS (SELECT STRIP(APR_MRN) AS MRN, STRIP(PT_LAST_NAME) || ', ' || STRIP(PT_FIRST_NAME) AS NAME, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH AS DOB, STRIP(CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME) AS "Drug Name", MIN(APR_START_DTE) AS "Start Date", MAX(APR_END_DTE) AS "End Date" FROM IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX_V JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON APR_MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS R ON PT_RACE = R.AV_CODE AND R.AV_ELEMENT = 'RACE' LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS E ON PT_PT_ETHNICITY = E.AV_CODE AND E.AV_ELEMENT = 'PT_ETHNICITY' WHERE 1=1 AND CDG_CHEMO_FLAG = 'Y' AND UPPER(CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME) LIKE '%PALBOCICLIB%' GROUP BY APR_MRN, STRIP(PT_LAST_NAME) || ', ' || STRIP(PT_FIRST_NAME), PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME HAVING MIN(APR_START_DTE) >= CURRENT date - 6 MONTHS) , LAST_APPT AS (SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN, CPE_ENC_DTE, CRE_RES_NAME, CRE_RES_TYP, CLD_DEPT_NAME, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8, CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CPE_MRN ORDER BY CPE_ENC_DTE DESC) AS RN FROM X JOIN IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER ON MRN = CPE_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CRE_RES_TYP IN ('Physician') AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 = 'BRE' AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 = 'MED' ) , NEXT_APPT AS (SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN, CPE_ENC_DTE, CRE_RES_NAME, CRE_RES_TYP, CLD_DEPT_NAME, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8, CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CPE_MRN ORDER BY CPE_ENC_DTE) AS RN FROM X JOIN IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER ON MRN = CPE_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Sch') AND CRE_RES_TYP IN ('Physician') AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 = 'BRE' AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 = 'MED' ) , LAST_CT AS (SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN, CPE_ENC_DTE, CRE_RES_NAME, CRE_RES_TYP, CLD_DEPT_NAME, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8, CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CPE_MRN ORDER BY CPE_ENC_DTE DESC) AS RN FROM X JOIN IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER ON MRN = CPE_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME LIKE 'CT%' ) , NEXT_CT AS (SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN, CPE_ENC_DTE, CRE_RES_NAME, CRE_RES_TYP, CLD_DEPT_NAME, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8, CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CPE_MRN ORDER BY CPE_ENC_DTE) AS RN FROM X JOIN IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER ON MRN = CPE_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Sch') AND CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME LIKE 'CT%' ) , Y AS (SELECT DISTINCT X.*, LA.CPE_ENC_DTE AS "Last Appt Date", STRIP(LA.CRE_RES_NAME) AS "Last Appt Physician", NA.CPE_ENC_DTE AS "Next Appt Date", STRIP(NA.CRE_RES_NAME) AS "Next Appt Physician", LC.CPE_ENC_DTE AS "Last CT Date", STRIP(LC.CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME) AS "Last CT Type", NC.CPE_ENC_DTE AS "Next CT Date", STRIP(NC.CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME) AS "Next CT Type" FROM X LEFT JOIN LAST_APPT LA ON MRN = LA.CPE_MRN AND LA.RN = 1 LEFT JOIN NEXT_APPT NA ON MRN = NA.CPE_MRN AND NA.RN = 1 LEFT JOIN LAST_CT LC ON MRN = LC.CPE_MRN AND LC.RN = 1 LEFT JOIN NEXT_CT NC ON MRN = NC.CPE_MRN AND NC.RN = 1) , HML AS (SELECT HCPR_MRN AS MRN , LOWER(HGN_GENERIC_NAME) AS DRUG_NAME , HCPR_CREATED_DTE AS DTE , HCPR_PRESCRIPTION_TYPE_DESC AS RX_TYPE FROM IDB.HML_CLIENT_PRESCRIPTION LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_CLIENT_VISIT ON OCV_VISIT_GUID = HCPR_VISIT_GUID LEFT JOIN IDB.HML_GENERIC_NAME ON HGN_GENERIC_NAME_ID = HCPR_GENERIC_NAME_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_USER USR ON USR.OU_USER_GUID = HCPR_USER_GUID LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_USER REQ ON REQ.OU_USER_GUID = HCPR_CARE_PROV_GUID LEFT JOIN IDB.HML_RX_UNIT_OF_MEASURE UOM ON UOM.HRUM_RXUOM_ID = HCPR_DOSE_UOM_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.HML_RX_UNIT_OF_MEASURE PKG ON PKG.HRUM_RXUOM_ID = HCPR_INNER_PACKAGE_SIZE_UOM_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.HML_SCRIPT_FREQUENCY ON HSF_SCRIPT_FREQ_ID = HCPR_SCRIPT_FREQ_ID WHERE HCPR_STATUS_TYPE NOT IN (4, 5, 8) AND HCPR_CREATED_DTE IS NOT NULL AND((HCPR_PRESCRIPTION_TYPE = 1 AND HCPR_TRANSMISSION_STATUS IN (1, 2, 5) ) OR HCPR_PRESCRIPTION_TYPE = 3) AND (LOWER(HCPR_DRUG_NAME) = 'letrozole' OR LOWER(HGN_GENERIC_NAME) = 'letrozole') AND HCPR_MRN IN (SELECT MRN FROM Y) AND HCPR_CREATED_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT DATE - 8 MONTHS AND CURRENT DATE ) , EMAR AS (SELECT DISTINCT OO_MRN AS MRN , LOWER(OO_ORD_NAME) AS DRUG_NAME, OOTO_SIGNIFIC_DTE AS DTE, 'emar' AS RX_TYPE FROM IDB.OMS_ORDER LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_MED_DETAIL ON OO_ORD_GUID = OMD_ORD_GUID JOIN IDB.OAS_ORD_TASK_OCCR ON OOTO_ORD_GUID = OO_ORD_GUID AND OOTO_STATUS_CD = 'Performed' JOIN IDB.OAS_CTLG_ITEM_TASK ON OOTO_CAT_ITEM_GUID = OCIT_GUID AND OCIT_LEVEL_NO = 0 WHERE OO_ORD_STS_CD NOT IN ('CANC', 'CANP', 'AUC3') AND LOWER(OO_ORD_NAME) = 'letrozole' AND OO_MRN IN (SELECT MRN FROM Y) AND OOTO_SIGNIFIC_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT DATE - 8 MONTHS AND CURRENT DATE ) , LETRO AS (SELECT MRN, STRIP(DRUG_NAME) AS DRUG_NAME, MIN(DTE) AS "initial date (last 8 months)" FROM (SELECT * FROM HML UNION SELECT * FROM EMAR) L GROUP BY MRN, STRIP(DRUG_NAME)) SELECT DISTINCT Y.*, DRUG_NAME, "initial date (last 8 months)" FROM Y LEFT JOIN LETRO ON Y.MRN = LETRO.MRN

prompt: We need a weekly report to screen for patients that meet eligibility criteria for this study.
completion: WITH VISIT AS (SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN AS MRN, CPE_ENC_DTE "VISIT DATE", CRE_RES_NAME "PHYSICIAN", CRE_RES_TYP FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 = 'NEU' JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS = ('Sch') AND CRE_RES_TYP IN ('Physician') AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT DATE AND CURRENT DATE + 14 DAYS ) , DX AS (SELECT DISTINCT CC_MRN MRN , MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) OVER (PARTITION BY CC_MRN, CC_CLSF_CD) DX_DTE , CC_CLSF_CD DX_CD , PT_FIRST_NAME "FIRST NAME" , PT_LAST_NAME "LAST NAME" , YEAR(CURRENT DATE) - YEAR(PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) "AGE" FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN VISIT V ON V.MRN = CC_MRN JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PT_MRN = CC_MRN WHERE CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'D%' AND CC_CLSF_CD IN ('C70', 'C70.0', 'C70.1', 'C70.9', '192.1', '192.3') AND (CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) ), PATH AS (SELECT DISTINCT "t1"."PT_MRN" AS "MRN", "t4"."DT_DTE" AS "Pathology Procedure Date", "t5"."DT_DTE" AS "Pathology Report Date", UPPER(CASE WHEN LENGTH(PRPT_REPORT) <= 15000 THEN RTRIM(CAST(SUBSTR(PRPT_REPORT, 1, 15000) AS VARCHAR(15000))) ELSE CAST(SUBSTR(PRPT_REPORT, 1, 15000) AS VARCHAR(15000)) END) AS TXT FROM VISIT V JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V" "t1" ON V.MRN = "t1".PT_MRN LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED" "t6" ON "t1"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t6"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V" "t2" ON "t6"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t2"."PRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATH_RPRT_TYPE_LOOKUP" "t3" ON "t2"."PRPT_REPORT_TYPE" = "t3"."PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_CD" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" "t4" ON "t2"."PRPT_PROCEDURE_DATE_ID" = "t4"."DT_DATE_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" "t5" ON "t2"."PRPT_REPORT_DATE_ID" = "t5"."DT_DATE_ID" WHERE 1=1 AND "t2"."PRPT_REPORT" IS NOT NULL AND ((LOCATE('CSF', "t2"."PRPT_REPORT") >= 1 OR LOCATE('cerebrospinal fluid', "t2"."PRPT_REPORT") >= 1) AND (LOCATE('positive', "t2"."PRPT_REPORT") >= 1 OR LOCATE('abnormal', "t2"."PRPT_REPORT") >= 1 OR LOCATE('atypical', "t2"."PRPT_REPORT") >= 1 OR LOCATE('suspicious', "t2"."PRPT_REPORT") >= 1)) AND UPPER("t3"."PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_DESC") like '%CYTOLOGY%' ) ,CT AS (SELECT DISTINCT LR_MRN AS MRN, LR_PERFORMED_DTE AS PERFORMED_DTE, LR_TEST_NAME AS TEST_NAME, LR_SUBTEST_NAME AS SUBTEST_NAME, LR_RESULT_VALUE AS RESULT_VALUE, LR_UNIT_MEASURE AS UNIT_MEASURE FROM VISIT V JOIN IDB.LAB_RESULTS ON V.MRN = LR_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.LAB_TEXT_LINE ON LTL_RESULT_GUID = LR_RESULT_GUID WHERE(UPPER(LR_SUBTEST_NAME) LIKE '%CIRCULATING TUMOR CELLS%' OR LR_SUBTEST_NAME like '%CTC%')), FN AS (SELECT DX.MRN , "FIRST NAME" , "LAST NAME" , "AGE" , "VISIT DATE" , "PHYSICIAN" , CASE WHEN PATH.TXT <> '' THEN 'YES' ELSE 'NO' END AS "CSF" , CASE WHEN CT.RESULT_VALUE <> '' THEN 'YES' ELSE 'NO' END AS "CTC" FROM DX JOIN VISIT V ON DX.MRN = V.MRN LEFT JOIN PATH ON V.MRN = PATH.MRN LEFT JOIN CT ON V.MRN = CT.MRN) SELECT * FROM FN WHERE CSF = 'YES'
