prompt: Provide data for patients who have specific pathology report search terms since 1/1/2009.
completion: SELECT DISTINCT "t1"."PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_DESC" AS "Pathology Report Type", "t2"."PRPT_PATH_RPT_ID" AS "DE-ID Pathology Report", "t3"."DT_YEAR" AS "Pathology Procedure Year", "t4"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AS "Deident PT #" FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V" "t5" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED" "t4" ON "t5"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t4"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V" "t2" ON "t4"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t2"."PRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATH_RPRT_TYPE_LOOKUP" "t1" ON "t2"."PRPT_REPORT_TYPE" = "t1"."PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_CD" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" "t3" ON "t2"."PRPT_PROCEDURE_DATE_ID" = "t3"."DT_DATE_ID" WHERE (("t1"."PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_DESC" IN ('Special Procedure, Surgical', 'Surgical Pathology', 'Surgical Pathology Breast', 'Surgical Pathology Consult', 'Surgical Pathology Molecular Genetics', 'Surgical Submitted Slides') AND (CONTAINS("t2"."PRPT_DEID_REPORT", '("Basal cell carcinoma" | "Basal cell" | "BCC")') = 1 AND ("t3"."DT_YEAR" >= 2009 AND NOT(CONTAINS("t2"."PRPT_DEID_REPORT", '("Rule out basal cell carcinoma" | "Rule out basal cell" | "Rule out BCC")') = 1)))) AND ("t2"."PRPT_DEID_REPORT" IS NOT NULL AND "t2"."PRPT_DEID_REPORT" IS NOT NULL))

prompt: List of patients with specific CPTs code from 1/1/2016-10/05/2018.
completion: SELECT DISTINCT PBD_MRN "MRN", PT_LAST_NAME "PT Last Name", PT_FIRST_NAME "PT First Name", PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH "DOB", PBD_SVC_DTE "Service Date", PBC_CPT_CD "CPT Code", PBC_DENTAL_CD "CPT Dental Code", PBC_PBD_DESC "CPT Description" FROM IDB.PBD_DTL JOIN IDB.PBD_CODE ON PBD_PBD_CD = PBC_PBD_CD JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PBD_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE (PBC_CPT_CD IN ('21248', '21249') OR PBC_DENTAL_CD = 'D6010') AND PBD_SVC_DTE BETWEEN '2016-01-01' AND '2018-10-05' ORDER BY PBD_SVC_DTE ;

prompt: Provide outside prescriptions and home medication list of patients who are noted in their medical record to have received specific medications at any time. *TIME SENSITIVE QUERY*
completion: WITH GENDRUG AS (SELECT DISTINCT HGN_GENERIC_NAME, OCDX_DRUG_KEY CAT_DRUG_KEY, CASE WHEN (C2.ODC_CATEGORY_NAME = ' ' OR C2.ODC_CATEGORY_NAME IS NULL) THEN C1.ODC_CATEGORY_NAME WHEN (C3.ODC_CATEGORY_NAME = ' ' OR C3.ODC_CATEGORY_NAME IS NULL) THEN C2.ODC_CATEGORY_NAME CONCAT ' | ' CONCAT C1.ODC_CATEGORY_NAME ELSE C3.ODC_CATEGORY_NAME CONCAT ' | ' CONCAT C2.ODC_CATEGORY_NAME END AS CATEGORY_NAME FROM IDB.HML_GENERIC_NAME JOIN IDB.OMS_CATEGORY_DRUG_XREF ON HGN_DRUG_CATALOG_KEY = OCDX_DRUG_KEY JOIN IDB.OMS_DRUG_CATEGORIES C1 ON C1.ODC_MULTUM_CATEGORY_ID = OCDX_MULTUM_CATEGORY_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_CATEGORY_SUB_XREF L2 ON C1.ODC_MULTUM_CATEGORY_ID = L2.OCSX_SUB_CATEGORY_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_DRUG_CATEGORIES C2 ON C2.ODC_MULTUM_CATEGORY_ID = L2.OCSX_MULTUM_CATEGORY_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_CATEGORY_SUB_XREF L3 ON L2.OCSX_MULTUM_CATEGORY_ID = L3.OCSX_SUB_CATEGORY_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_DRUG_CATEGORIES C3 ON C3.ODC_MULTUM_CATEGORY_ID = L3.OCSX_MULTUM_CATEGORY_ID WHERE HGN_GENERIC_NAME IN ('cimetidine', 'tagamet', 'ranitidine', 'zantac', 'nizatidine', 'axid', 'famotidine', 'pepsid', 'omeprazole', 'prilosec', 'prilosec otc', 'zegerid', 'lansoprazole', 'prevacid', 'pantoprazole', 'protonix', 'rabeprazole', 'aciphex', 'esomeprazole', 'nexium', 'dexlansoprazole', 'dexilant') ), DRUGRN AS (SELECT DISTINCT CAT_DRUG_KEY, HGN_GENERIC_NAME, CATEGORY_NAME , ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CAT_DRUG_KEY ORDER BY CATEGORY_NAME) RN FROM GENDRUG), DRUGCAT AS (SELECT CAT_DRUG_KEY, HGN_GENERIC_NAME GENERIC_NAME , MAX(CASE WHEN RN = 1 THEN CATEGORY_NAME END)|| MAX(CASE WHEN RN = 2 THEN '; '||STRIP(CATEGORY_NAME) ELSE '' END)|| MAX(CASE WHEN RN = 3 THEN '; '||STRIP(CATEGORY_NAME) ELSE '' END)|| MAX(CASE WHEN RN = 4 THEN '; '||STRIP(CATEGORY_NAME) ELSE '' END) THERAP_CATEGORY FROM DRUGRN GROUP BY CAT_DRUG_KEY, HGN_GENERIC_NAME) SELECT STRIP(HCPR_MRN) AS "MRN", DATE(HCPR_CREATED_DT) AS "Created Date", DATE(HCPR_START_DT) AS "Start Date", DATE(HCPR_END_DT) AS "End Date", DATE(HCPR_RENEWAL_DT) AS "Renewal Date", DATE(HCPR_DISCONTINUE_DT) AS "Discontinued Date", STRIP(HCPR_DRUG_NAME) AS "Drug Name", STRIP(HGN_GENERIC_NAME) AS "Generic Name", STRIP(THERAP_CATEGORY) AS "Therapeutic Category" , CASE HCPR_STATUS_TYPE WHEN 1 THEN 'Active' WHEN 4 THEN 'Cancelled' WHEN 7 THEN 'Completed' WHEN 3 THEN 'Discontinued' WHEN 8 THEN 'EnteredInError' WHEN 2 THEN 'Inactive' WHEN 6 THEN 'NoLongerTaking' WHEN 5 THEN 'Unapproved' END AS "Prescription Status" , CASE WHEN HCPR_PRESCRIPTION_TYPE = 1 THEN 'eRx' WHEN HCPR_PRESCRIPTION_TYPE = 3 THEN 'HML' ELSE 'Oth' END AS "Rx Type", STRIP(HCPR_DOSE_AMT) AS "Dose Amount", STRIP(HCPR_ROUTE) AS "Route", STRIP(UOM.HRUM_NAME) AS "Unit of Measure", STRIP(HSF_ABBREVIATIION) AS "Frequency", STRIP(HCPR_INSTRUCTIONS) AS "Instructions" , STRIP(HCPR_COMMENTS) AS "Comments" , STRIP(HCPR_IS_PRN) AS "PRN" FROM IDB.HML_CLIENT_PRESCRIPTION LEFT JOIN IDB.HML_GENERIC_NAME ON HGN_GENERIC_NAME_ID = HCPR_GENERIC_NAME_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.HML_RX_UNIT_OF_MEASURE UOM ON UOM.HRUM_RXUOM_ID = HCPR_DOSE_UOM_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.HML_RX_UNIT_OF_MEASURE PKG ON PKG.HRUM_RXUOM_ID = HCPR_INNER_PACKAGE_SIZE_UOM_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.HML_SCRIPT_FREQUENCY ON HSF_SCRIPT_FREQ_ID = HCPR_SCRIPT_FREQ_ID JOIN DRUGCAT ON CAT_DRUG_KEY = HGN_DRUG_CATALOG_KEY WHERE HCPR_STATUS_TYPE IN (1, 7) AND DATE(HCPR_START_DT) IS NOT NULL AND(HCPR_PRESCRIPTION_TYPE = 1 AND HCPR_TRANSMISSION_STATUS IN (1, 2, 5) OR HCPR_PRESCRIPTION_TYPE = 3)

prompt: A list of all patients from 2016-2018 who had a Whipple procedure at MSK. Can you please also indicate if they were coded as having a VTE, DVT and/or PE?
completion: SELECT SSE_MRN, SSE_SURG_DTE, SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD, SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC, SSP_SURG_LAST_NM, SSP_SURG_FIRST_NM, SSP_SURG_SVC_CD, VIS_ADM_DTE, VIS_DSCH_DTE FROM IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE ON SSE_LOG_ID = SSP_LOG_ID AND SSE_ENC_CSN_ID = SSP_ENC_CSN_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.VISIT_V ON VIS_MRN = SSE_MRN AND VIS_ADM_DTE <= SSE_SURG_DTE AND VIS_DSCH_DTE >= SSE_SURG_DTE WHERE UPPER(SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC) like '%WHIPPLE%' AND SSE_SURG_DTE BETWEEN '2016-01-01' AND '2018-12-31' ; WITH PTS AS (SELECT DISTINCT SSE_MRN MRN FROM IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE ON SSE_LOG_ID = SSP_LOG_ID AND SSE_ENC_CSN_ID = SSP_ENC_CSN_ID WHERE UPPER(SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC) like '%WHIPPLE%' AND SSE_SURG_DTE BETWEEN '2016-01-01' AND '2018-12-31' ) SELECT CC_MRN, CC_EFF_DTE AS ICD_EFF_DTE, CC_CLSF_CD AS ICD_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS ICD_DESC FROM PTS JOIN IDB.CTC_CLSF ON CC_MRN = MRN JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND (CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y') ) AND CC_CLSF_CD IN ('I26.01', 'I26.02', 'I26.09', 'I26.90', 'I26.92', 'I26.99', '415.0', '415.12', '415.13', '415.19', '453.40', '453.41', '453.42', '453.50', '453.51', '453.52', 'I82.401', 'I82.402', 'I82.403', 'I82.409', 'I82.411', 'I82.412', 'I82.413', 'I82.419', 'I82.421', 'I82.422', 'I82.423', 'I82.429', 'I82.431', 'I82.432', 'I82.433', 'I82.439', 'I82.441', 'I82.442', 'I82.443', 'I82.449', 'I82.491', 'I82.492', 'I82.493', 'I82.499', 'I82.4Y1', 'I82.4Y2', 'I82.4Y3', 'I82.4Y9', 'I82.4Z1', 'I82.4Z2', 'I82.4Z3', 'I82.4Z9', 'I82.501', 'I82.502', 'I82.503', 'I82.509', 'I82.511', 'I82.512', 'I82.513', 'I82.519', 'I82.521', 'I82.522', 'I82.523', 'I82.529', 'I82.531', 'I82.532', 'I82.533', 'I82.539', 'I82.541', 'I82.542', 'I82.543', 'I82.549', 'I82.591', 'I82.592', 'I82.593', 'I82.599', 'I82.5Y1', 'I82.5Y2', 'I82.5Y3', 'I82.5Y9', 'I82.5Z1', 'I82.5Z2', 'I82.5Z3', 'I82.5Z9') AND CC_EFF_DTE BETWEEN '2016-01-01' AND '2018-12-31' ; WITH WHIPPLE AS (SELECT DISTINCT SSE_MRN, SSE_LOG_ID, SSE_SURG_DTE, SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD, SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC, SSP_SURG_LAST_NM, SSP_SURG_FIRST_NM, SSP_SURG_SVC_CD, VIS_ADM_DTE, VIS_DSCH_DTE FROM IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE ON SSE_LOG_ID = SSP_LOG_ID AND SSE_ENC_CSN_ID = SSP_ENC_CSN_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.VISIT_V ON VIS_MRN = SSE_MRN AND VIS_ADM_DTE <= SSE_SURG_DTE AND VIS_DSCH_DTE >= SSE_SURG_DTE WHERE UPPER(SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC) like '%WHIPPLE%' AND SSE_SURG_DTE BETWEEN '2016-01-01' AND '2018-12-31' ) SELECT DISTINCT WHIPPLE.*, SAE_TOXICITY_NAME, SAE_TOX_GRADE_NAME, SAE_TOX_OCCR_DT FROM WHIPPLE JOIN IDB.SRG_ADVERSE_EVENT ON SSE_LOG_ID = SAE_SURG_LOG_ID AND SAE_TOXICITY_NAME IN ('Deep Venous Thrombosis', 'Pulmonary Embolus') ;

prompt: Provide scheduled IR, OR, and ENDO OR procedures and UCC admissions of a cohort of patients.
completion: WITH PTS AS (SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME FROM DVCMS.COHORT JOIN DVCMS.COHORT_PATIENT ON CHP_COHORT_ID = CHT_COHORT_ID JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON CHP_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID WHERE CHT_COHORT_ID = 6358 ) SELECT OC_MRN MRN, PT_LAST_NAME "Patient Last Name", PT_FIRST_NAME "Patient First Name", OC_SURG_DTE "Procedure Date", CPX_PROC_NAME "Procedure Name" FROM PTS JOIN IDB.OR_CASE ON MRN = OC_MRN JOIN IDB.OR_CASE_ALL_PROC ON OC_CASE_ID = OCAP_CASE_ID JOIN IDB.OR_CASE_ALL_SURG ON OCAP_CASE_ID = OCAS_CASE_ID AND OCAS_PNL_NO = OCAP_PNL_NO AND OCAS_SURG_ROLE = 'Primary' JOIN IDB.OR_PROC ON OCAP_OR_PROC_ID = OP_OR_PROC_ID JOIN IDB.OR_CL_PROC ON OP_OR_PROC_ID = OCP_OR_PROC_ID JOIN IDB.CL_PROC ON OCP_PROC_ID = CPX_PROC_ID JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CRE_RES_ID = OCAS_RES_ID WHERE OC_SURG_DTE >= CURRENT date AND OC_OR_CASE_STS_CD NOT IN ('2', '5') ; WITH PTS AS (SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME FROM DVCMS.COHORT JOIN DVCMS.COHORT_PATIENT ON CHP_COHORT_ID = CHT_COHORT_ID JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON CHP_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID WHERE CHT_COHORT_ID = 6358 ) SELECT CPE_MRN MRN, PT_LAST_NAME "Patient First Name", PT_FIRST_NAME "Patient Last Name", LISTAGG (CPE_ENC_DTE, ' | ') "UCC Visit Dates" FROM PTS JOIN IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER ON MRN = CPE_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID WHERE CLD_DEPT_NAME = 'UCC 1275' AND CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT date - 14 DAYS AND CURRENT date GROUP BY CPE_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME ;

prompt: total number of patients with HCC (codes 155.0 and C22.0) that saw medical oncology in the time period (last 10 years)
completion: SELECT DISTINCT CC_MRN AS MRN, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, PT_SEX, PT_GENDER FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER ON CC_MRN = CPE_MRN AND CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Comp', 'Arrived') AND CPE_ENC_DTE >= '2012-01-01' JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 = 'MED' JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID AND CRE_RES_TYP IN ('Dentist', 'Fellow', 'Nurse Practitioner', 'Physician', 'Physician Assistant', 'PhD', 'Physiologist', 'Psychologist', 'Resident', 'Counselor', 'Advanced Practice Nurse') JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON CC_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE 1=1 AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND (CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) AND CC_CLSF_CD IN ('C22.0', '155.0')

prompt: Due to CIS order change modify the report ACC18457 add new order with the corresponding positions to the existing report
completion: WITH ORD AS (SELECT OO_ORD_GUID ORDGUID, OO_MRN MRN, STRIP(PT_LAST_NAME)||', '||STRIP(PT_FIRST_NAME) PT_NAME, OO_ENTER_DTE ENTER_DTE, STRIP(OO_ORD_STS_CD)||'-'||STRIP(OSTS_STS_DESC) ORDSTS, OO_ORD_ID ORDID, OO_ORD_NAME ORDNAME , DOC_NAME REQUESTEDBY, OO_VISIT_GUID, MAX(CASE WHEN OUD_USER_DI_CD ='Consult_Pain OP_Reason' THEN OUD_USER_DI_VALUE ELSE '' END) CONSULT_REASON, MAX(CASE WHEN OUD_USER_DI_CD ='CONSULT_PAIN_Cancer Dx' THEN OUD_USER_DI_VALUE ELSE '' END) CANCER_DX, MAX(CASE WHEN OUD_USER_DI_CD ='CONSULT_PAIN_OP_LOCATION' THEN OUD_USER_DI_VALUE ELSE '' END) CONSULT_LOCATION, MAX(CASE WHEN OUD_USER_DI_CD ='CONSULT_PAIN_OP_Referring MD' THEN OUD_USER_DI_VALUE ELSE '' END) REF_MD, MAX(CASE WHEN OUD_USER_DI_CD ='Requested For' THEN OUD_USER_DI_VALUE ELSE '' END) REQUESTEDDATE FROM IDB.OMS_ORDER JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON OO_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.DOC ON OO_REQ_DR_NO = DOC_DR_NO JOIN IDB.OMS_STATUS ON OO_ORD_STS_CD = OSTS_ORD_STS_CD JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_USER_DATA ON OO_ORD_GUID = OUD_ORD_GUID WHERE OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID = '9000007556200730' AND OO_ORD_STS_CD NOT LIKE 'CA%' AND OO_ENTER_DTE > (CASE WHEN DAYOFWEEK(CURRENT DATE) = 2 THEN CURRENT DATE - 9 DAY ELSE CURRENT DATE - 7 DAY END) GROUP BY OO_ORD_GUID , OO_MRN, STRIP(PT_LAST_NAME)||', '||STRIP(PT_FIRST_NAME) , OO_ENTER_DTE , STRIP(OO_ORD_STS_CD)||'-'||STRIP(OSTS_STS_DESC) , OO_ORD_ID , OO_ORD_NAME , OO_REQUESTED_DTE , DOC_NAME , OO_VISIT_GUID HAVING MAX(CASE WHEN OUD_USER_DI_CD ='Consult_Pain OP_Reason' THEN OUD_USER_DI_VALUE ELSE '' END) IN ('Pain Management', 'Nerve Block')) , VST AS (SELECT CPE_MRN, CPE_ENC_DTE, CPE_APPT_MADE_DTE, CPE_CPE_APPT_STS, CLD_DEPT_NAME, CASE WHEN CLD_CLD_CENTER IN ('MAIN', '53RD', 'JRSC', 'Koch') THEN 'MANHATTAN' WHEN CLD_CLD_CENTER = 'WES' THEN 'WESTCHESTER' WHEN CLD_CLD_CENTER = 'BSK' THEN 'BASKING RIDGE' WHEN CLD_CLD_CENTER = 'MON' THEN 'MONMOUTH' WHEN CLD_CLD_CENTER = 'BER' THEN 'BERGEN' WHEN CLD_CLD_CENTER = 'NAS' THEN 'NASSAU' WHEN CLD_CLD_CENTER = 'CMK' THEN 'COMMACK' END SCHEDULED_CENTER, CRE_RES_NAME, CRE_RES_TYP, CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME, CVT_EXT_NAME, CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR FROM ORD JOIN IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER ON MRN = CPE_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID WHERE CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_4 = 'ANS' AND CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Sch') AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN ENTER_DTE AND ENTER_DTE + 30 DAY ) SELECT ORDGUID, OO_VISIT_GUID, MRN, PT_NAME, ENTER_DTE, ORDSTS, ORDID, ORDNAME , REQUESTEDBY, CONSULT_REASON, CANCER_DX, REF_MD, CONSULT_LOCATION REQUESTED_LOCATION, SCHEDULED_CENTER, CLD_DEPT_NAME DEPT_NAME, CPE_ENC_DTE SCH_VISIT_DTE, CPE_CPE_APPT_STS APPT_STS, CRE_RES_NAME VISIT_MD_NAME, CRE_RES_TYP MD_TYPE, CVT_EXT_NAME VISIT_TYPE FROM ORD LEFT JOIN VST ON MRN = CPE_MRN WHERE CPE_MRN IS NULL OR SCHEDULED_CENTER = UPPER(CONSULT_LOCATION)

prompt: Provide a list of patients with a diagnosis of "epithelioid sarcoma" who were treated with immune checkpoint blockade
completion: WITH PTR AS (SELECT PRPT_MRN, PRPT_ORD_DR_NAME, PRPT_ORD_DR_SVC_DESC FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V WHERE PRPT_REPORT IS NOT NULL AND CONTAINS("PRPT_REPORT", '("epithelioid sarcoma")') = 1 ) , APR_MIN AS (SELECT APR_MRN, APR_START_DTE AS "FIRST_DATE_IMMUNOTHERAPY", ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY APR_MRN ORDER BY APR_START_DTE ASC) MIN_APR_ST_DT FROM IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX_V JOIN PTR ON PRPT_MRN = APR_MRN WHERE CDG_THERAPEUTIC_CATEGORY IN ('antineoplastics | anti-PD-1 monoclonal antibodies', 'antineoplastics | anti-CTLA-4 monoclonal antibodies') OR CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME IN ('ATEZOLIZUMAB', 'AVELUMAB', 'BMS-936558', 'CEMIPLIMAB', 'DURVALUMAB', 'MDX-1106', 'MEDI4736', 'MK-3475', 'MPDL3280A', 'MSB0010718C', 'NIVOLUMAB', 'PEMBROLIZUMAB', 'REGN2810', 'IPILIMUMAB', 'MDX-010', 'TREMELIMUMAB', 'TICILIMUMAB (CP-675,206)', 'PDR001') ) , APR_MAX AS (SELECT APR_MRN, APR_END_DTE AS "LAST_DATE_IMMUNOTHERAPY", ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY APR_MRN ORDER BY APR_END_DTE DESC) MAX_APR_END_DT FROM IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX_V JOIN PTR ON PRPT_MRN = APR_MRN WHERE CDG_THERAPEUTIC_CATEGORY IN ('antineoplastics | anti-PD-1 monoclonal antibodies', 'antineoplastics | anti-CTLA-4 monoclonal antibodies') OR CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME IN ('ATEZOLIZUMAB', 'AVELUMAB', 'BMS-936558', 'CEMIPLIMAB', 'DURVALUMAB', 'MDX-1106', 'MEDI4736', 'MK-3475', 'MPDL3280A', 'MSB0010718C', 'NIVOLUMAB', 'PEMBROLIZUMAB', 'REGN2810', 'IPILIMUMAB', 'MDX-010', 'TREMELIMUMAB', 'TICILIMUMAB (CP-675,206)', 'PDR001') ) , PTD AS (SELECT PT_MRN AS "MRN" , PT_LAST_NAME AS "Last Name" , PT_FIRST_NAME AS "First Name" , PT_SEX AS "Gender" , PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH AS "Date of Birth" , PT_DATE_OF_DEATH AS "Date of Death" , R.AV_DESC AS "Race (Reg)" , E.AV_DESC AS "Ethnicity (Reg)" , PLA_LST_APPT_DTE AS "Last Appointment", CASE WHEN PT_DEATH_IND IN ('', 'A') THEN 'ALIVE' ELSE 'DECEASED' END AS VITAL_STS FROM IDB.PATIENT LEFT JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY ON PT_MRN = PLA_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS R ON R.AV_ELEMENT = 'RACE' AND R.AV_CODE = PT_RACE LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS E ON E.AV_ELEMENT = 'PT_ETHNICITY' AND E.AV_CODE = PT_PT_ETHNICITY) SELECT D.*, N.FIRST_DATE_IMMUNOTHERAPY, X.LAST_DATE_IMMUNOTHERAPY FROM PTD D JOIN APR_MIN N ON N.APR_MRN = D.MRN AND MIN_APR_ST_DT =1 JOIN APR_MAX X ON X.APR_MRN = D.MRN AND MAX_APR_END_DT =1

prompt: Provide a bimonthly list of TNBC breast cancer patients who have been on sacituzumab govitecan in the last 18 months and have had a follow up visit in the last 6 months.
completion: WITH X AS (SELECT DISTINCT STRIP(APR_MRN) AS MRN, STRIP(CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME) AS "Drug Name", APR_START_DTE, APR_END_DTE, STRIP(APR_ORD_RX_TYPE) AS "Rx Type", STRIP(APR_PROVIDER_NAME) AS "Provider Name", STRIP(APR_DOC_SVC) AS "Service", STRIP(APR_LOCATION) AS "Location", APR_DIAGNOSIS_DESC FROM IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX_V WHERE CDG_CHEMO_FLAG = 'Y' AND(UPPER(APR_GENERIC_NAME) LIKE '%SACITUZUMAB%' OR UPPER(APR_GENERIC_NAME) LIKE '%GOVITECAN%' OR UPPER(APR_DRUG_NAME) LIKE '%SACITUZUMAB%' OR UPPER(APR_DRUG_NAME) LIKE '%GOVITECAN%') AND APR_START_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT date - 18 MONTHS AND CURRENT date ) , TM AS (SELECT * FROM (SELECT DISTINCT TM_MRN, "Provider Name", TM_DX_DTE AS DX_DATE, TM_HIST_CD AS HIST_CODE, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS HIST_DESC, TM_SITE_CD AS SITE_CODE, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_DESC, CASE WHEN TM_SSF1 = '000' THEN 'Test not done (test not ordered and not performed)' WHEN TM_SSF1 = '010' THEN 'Positive/elevated' WHEN TM_SSF1 = '020' THEN 'Negative/normal; within normal limits' WHEN TM_SSF1 = '030' THEN 'Borderline; undetermined whether positive or negative' WHEN TM_SSF1 = '080' THEN 'Ordered, but results not in chart' WHEN TM_SSF1 = '988' THEN 'Not applicable: Information not collected for this case' WHEN TM_SSF1 = '996' THEN 'Test ordered, results not interpretable' WHEN TM_SSF1 = '997' THEN 'Test ordered, results not in chart' WHEN TM_SSF1 = '998' THEN 'Test not done (test not ordered and not performed)' WHEN TM_SSF1 = '999' THEN 'Unknown or no information; not documented in patient record' ELSE '' END AS "ER", CASE WHEN TM_SSF2 = '000' THEN 'Test not done (test not ordered and not performed)' WHEN TM_SSF2 = '010' THEN 'Positive/elevated' WHEN TM_SSF2 = '020' THEN 'Negative/normal; within normal limits' WHEN TM_SSF2 = '030' THEN 'Borderline; undetermined whether positive or negative' WHEN TM_SSF2 = '080' THEN 'Ordered, but results not in chart' WHEN TM_SSF2 = '988' THEN 'Not applicable: Information not collected for this case' WHEN TM_SSF2 = '996' THEN 'Test ordered, results not interpretable' WHEN TM_SSF2 = '997' THEN 'Test ordered, results not in chart' WHEN TM_SSF2 = '998' THEN 'Test not done (test not ordered and not performed)' WHEN TM_SSF2 = '999' THEN 'Unknown or no information; not documented in patient record' ELSE '' END AS "PR", CASE WHEN TM_SSF15 = '010' THEN 'Positive/elevated; amplified' WHEN TM_SSF15 = '020' THEN 'Negative/normal; within normal limits; not amplified' WHEN TM_SSF15 = '030' THEN 'Borderline; equivocal; indeterminate; undetermined whether positive or negative' WHEN TM_SSF15 = '988' THEN 'Not applicable: Information not collected for this case' WHEN TM_SSF15 = '997' THEN 'Test ordered, results not in chart' WHEN TM_SSF15 = '998' THEN 'Test not done (test not ordered and not performed)' WHEN TM_SSF15 = '999' THEN 'Unknown or no information; not documented in patient record' ELSE '' END AS "HER2" FROM X JOIN IDB.CDB_TUMOR ON TM_MRN = MRN JOIN IDB.CLM H ON TM_HIST_CD = H.CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON TM_SITE_CD = S.CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.SEERGROUPING ON RECODE = DV.SEERF_ICDO(TM_SITE_CD, TM_HIST_CD) WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND CATEGORY2 = 'Breast') B WHERE UPPER("ER") like '%NEGATIVE%' AND UPPER("PR") like '%NEGATIVE%' AND UPPER("HER2") like '%NEGATIVE%' ) , ER_PR_HER AS (SELECT DISTINCT CDD_MRN, CDD_DOC_GUID, CDD_DOC_NAME, CDD_SERVICE_DTE, CDO_ITEM_NAME, CDO_VALUE_TEXT FROM X JOIN IDB.CD_DOCUMENT ON CDD_MRN = MRN JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION ON CDD_DOC_GUID = CDO_DOC_GUID AND CDD_AUTHORED_DTE = CDO_AUTHORED_DTE WHERE 1=1 AND CDD_CANCEL_IND <> '1' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND <> '1' AND UPPER(CDD_DOC_NAME) like '%BREAST%' AND CDO_ITEM_NAME IN ('HER2:', 'ER:', 'PR:', 'T', 'T:', 'N', 'N:', 'M', 'M:', 'Staging') AND CDD_SERVICE_DTE >= '2022-01-01' ) , ER AS (SELECT CDD_MRN ER_MRN, CDD_SERVICE_DTE, CDO_VALUE_TEXT ER FROM (SELECT CDD_MRN, CDD_SERVICE_DTE, CDO_VALUE_TEXT, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CDD_MRN ORDER BY CDD_SERVICE_DTE DESC) RN FROM ER_PR_HER WHERE CDO_ITEM_NAME = 'ER:' ) WHERE RN = 1 ) , PR AS (SELECT CDD_MRN PR_MRN, CDD_SERVICE_DTE, CDO_VALUE_TEXT PR FROM (SELECT CDD_MRN, CDD_SERVICE_DTE, CDO_VALUE_TEXT, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CDD_MRN ORDER BY CDD_SERVICE_DTE DESC) RN FROM ER_PR_HER WHERE CDO_ITEM_NAME = 'PR:' ) WHERE RN = 1 ) , HER2 AS (SELECT CDD_MRN HER2_MRN, CDD_SERVICE_DTE, CDO_VALUE_TEXT HER2 FROM (SELECT CDD_MRN, CDD_SERVICE_DTE, CDO_VALUE_TEXT, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CDD_MRN ORDER BY CDD_SERVICE_DTE DESC) RN FROM ER_PR_HER WHERE CDO_ITEM_NAME = 'HER2:' ) WHERE RN = 1 ) , T AS (SELECT CDD_MRN T_MRN, CDD_SERVICE_DTE, CDO_VALUE_TEXT "T Stage" FROM (SELECT CDD_MRN, CDD_SERVICE_DTE, CDO_VALUE_TEXT, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CDD_MRN ORDER BY CDD_SERVICE_DTE DESC) RN FROM ER_PR_HER WHERE CDO_ITEM_NAME IN ('T', 'T:') ) WHERE RN = 1 ) , N AS (SELECT CDD_MRN N_MRN, CDD_SERVICE_DTE, CDO_VALUE_TEXT "N Stage" FROM (SELECT CDD_MRN, CDD_SERVICE_DTE, CDO_VALUE_TEXT, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CDD_MRN ORDER BY CDD_SERVICE_DTE DESC) RN FROM ER_PR_HER WHERE CDO_ITEM_NAME IN ('N', 'N:') ) WHERE RN = 1 ) , M AS (SELECT CDD_MRN M_MRN, CDD_SERVICE_DTE, CDO_VALUE_TEXT "M Stage" FROM (SELECT CDD_MRN, CDD_SERVICE_DTE, CDO_VALUE_TEXT, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CDD_MRN ORDER BY CDD_SERVICE_DTE DESC) RN FROM ER_PR_HER WHERE CDO_ITEM_NAME IN ('M', 'M:') ) WHERE RN = 1 ) , STAGING AS (SELECT CDD_MRN S_MRN, CDD_SERVICE_DTE, CDO_VALUE_TEXT "Stage" FROM (SELECT CDD_MRN, CDD_SERVICE_DTE, CDO_VALUE_TEXT, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CDD_MRN ORDER BY CDD_SERVICE_DTE DESC) RN FROM ER_PR_HER WHERE CDO_ITEM_NAME IN ('Staging') ) WHERE RN = 1 ) , CD AS (SELECT DISTINCT MRN, ER AS "ER", PR AS "PR", HER2 AS "HER2", "Stage", "T Stage", "N Stage", "M Stage", APR_DIAGNOSIS_DESC, "Provider Name" FROM X LEFT JOIN ER ON MRN = ER_MRN LEFT JOIN PR ON MRN = PR_MRN LEFT JOIN HER2 ON MRN = HER2_MRN LEFT JOIN T ON MRN = T_MRN LEFT JOIN N ON MRN = N_MRN LEFT JOIN M ON MRN = M_MRN LEFT JOIN STAGING ON MRN = S_MRN WHERE ER = 'Negative' AND PR = 'Negative' AND HER2 = 'Negative' ) , CD2 AS (SELECT DISTINCT MRN, "Provider Name", ER AS "ER", PR AS "PR", HER2 AS "HER2", "Stage", "T Stage", "N Stage", "M Stage", APR_DIAGNOSIS_DESC FROM CD ) , Y AS (SELECT TM_MRN AS MRN, "Provider Name" FROM TM UNION SELECT MRN, "Provider Name" FROM CD2) , CPE AS (SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN, CPE_ENC_DTE, CRE_RES_NAME, CRE_RES_TYP, CLD_DEPT_NAME, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8, CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME, CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CPE_MRN ORDER BY CPE_ENC_DTE DESC) AS RN FROM Y JOIN IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER ON CPE_MRN = MRN JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CRE_RES_TYP IN ('Physician') AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 = 'BRE' AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT DATE - 2 MONTHS AND CURRENT DATE AND(CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR like '%FR%' OR CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR like '%FX%') ) SELECT DISTINCT MRN, STRIP(PT_LAST_NAME) || ', ' || STRIP(PT_FIRST_NAME) AS "Name", CPE_ENC_DTE AS "Last Appt Date", STRIP(CRE_RES_NAME) AS "Attending", STRIP(CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME) AS "Visit Type" FROM Y JOIN CPE ON MRN = CPE_MRN JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON MRN = PT_MRN WHERE RN = 1

prompt: Provide a list of patients with records of Verification Checklist for Non-OR Setting documentation.
completion: WITH X AS (SELECT DISTINCT CDD_MRN, CDD_ADM_NUM, CDD_DOC_GUID, OCV_CURR_LOC, OS_SVC_DESC, OU_DISPLAY_NAME, OU_ORD_ROLE_TYPE, CDD_SERVICE_DTE, CDD_DOC_NAME, CDO_SECTION, CDO_CTLG_DISPL_NM, CDO_MSTR_ITEM_NM, CDO_ITEM_NAME, CDO_VALUE_TEXT FROM IDB.CD_DOCUMENT JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION ON CDO_DOC_GUID = CDD_DOC_GUID AND CDO_AUTHORED_DTE = CDD_AUTHORED_DTE JOIN IDB.OMS_CLIENT_VISIT ON CDD_VISIT_GUID = OCV_VISIT_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_SERVICE ON OCV_SVC_GUID = OS_SVC_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_USER ON CDD_AUTH_PROV_GUID = OU_USER_GUID WHERE CDD_CANCEL_IND = '0' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND = '0' AND CDD_DOC_NAME = 'Verification Checklist Non-OR Setting' AND CDD_SERVICE_DTE BETWEEN '2021-01-01' AND CURRENT date ) SELECT DISTINCT X.CDD_MRN, X.CDD_ADM_NUM, X.CDD_DOC_GUID, X.OCV_CURR_LOC, X.OS_SVC_DESC, X.OU_DISPLAY_NAME, X.OU_ORD_ROLE_TYPE, X.CDD_SERVICE_DTE, X.CDD_DOC_NAME, X1.CDO_VALUE_TEXT AS "Pre Procedure Verification completed", X2.CDO_VALUE_TEXT AS "Site/SideMarking 1", X3.CDO_VALUE_TEXT AS "Site/SideMarking 2", X4.CDO_VALUE_TEXT AS "TimeOut Completed", X5.CDO_VALUE_TEXT AS "Time when Timeout completed", X6.CDO_VALUE_TEXT AS "Time out members:", X7.CDO_VALUE_TEXT AS "Preferred Language (MSK Engage)", X8.CDO_VALUE_TEXT AS "Preferred Language", X9.CDO_VALUE_TEXT AS "Were professional interpreter services used", X10.CDO_VALUE_TEXT AS "Interpreter service(s) used:", X11.CDO_VALUE_TEXT AS "Interpreter ID#:", X12.CDO_VALUE_TEXT AS "Interpreter services were not used", X13.CDO_VALUE_TEXT AS "Interpreter services not used - Other", X14.CDO_VALUE_TEXT AS "Procedure Note Date & Time", X15.CDO_VALUE_TEXT AS "Procedure Note", X16.CDO_VALUE_TEXT AS "Pre Procedure Verification", X17.CDO_VALUE_TEXT AS "Time Out", X18.CDO_VALUE_TEXT AS "Site/Side Marking Completed", X19.CDO_VALUE_TEXT AS "Site/Side Marking Not Completed" FROM X LEFT JOIN X X1 ON X.CDD_DOC_GUID = X1.CDD_DOC_GUID AND X1.CDO_MSTR_ITEM_NM = 'PROC_VerifCheckList preproc ob' LEFT JOIN X X2 ON X.CDD_DOC_GUID = X2.CDD_DOC_GUID AND X2.CDO_MSTR_ITEM_NM = 'PROC_Site/SideMarking ob' LEFT JOIN X X3 ON X.CDD_DOC_GUID = X3.CDD_DOC_GUID AND X3.CDO_MSTR_ITEM_NM = 'PROC_Site/Side MarkNOT done ob' LEFT JOIN X X4 ON X.CDD_DOC_GUID = X4.CDD_DOC_GUID AND X4.CDO_MSTR_ITEM_NM = 'PROC_TimeOut Completed ob' LEFT JOIN X X5 ON X.CDD_DOC_GUID = X5.CDD_DOC_GUID AND X5.CDO_MSTR_ITEM_NM = 'PROC_TimeOut Time Completed ob' LEFT JOIN X X6 ON X.CDD_DOC_GUID = X6.CDD_DOC_GUID AND X6.CDO_MSTR_ITEM_NM = 'PROC_VerifCk_Time out members FT ob' LEFT JOIN X X7 ON X.CDD_DOC_GUID = X7.CDD_DOC_GUID AND X7.CDO_MSTR_ITEM_NM = 'Preferred Language (Engage) FT' LEFT JOIN X X8 ON X.CDD_DOC_GUID = X8.CDD_DOC_GUID AND X8.CDO_MSTR_ITEM_NM = 'Preferred_Language RES' LEFT JOIN X X9 ON X.CDD_DOC_GUID = X9.CDD_DOC_GUID AND X9.CDO_MSTR_ITEM_NM = 'PEDF_Translation Assistance Utilized RES' LEFT JOIN X X10 ON X.CDD_DOC_GUID = X10.CDD_DOC_GUID AND X10.CDO_MSTR_ITEM_NM = 'Preferred Language Int Services_RES' LEFT JOIN X X11 ON X.CDD_DOC_GUID = X11.CDD_DOC_GUID AND X11.CDO_MSTR_ITEM_NM = 'Preferred Language Int Id_FT' LEFT JOIN X X12 ON X.CDD_DOC_GUID = X12.CDD_DOC_GUID AND X12.CDO_MSTR_ITEM_NM = 'Preferred Language Int Services Not Used_RES' LEFT JOIN X X13 ON X.CDD_DOC_GUID = X13.CDD_DOC_GUID AND X13.CDO_MSTR_ITEM_NM = 'Preferred Language Int Services No Other_FT' LEFT JOIN X X14 ON X.CDD_DOC_GUID = X14.CDD_DOC_GUID AND X14.CDO_MSTR_ITEM_NM = 'PROC_Procedure Note DTM ob' LEFT JOIN X X15 ON X.CDD_DOC_GUID = X15.CDD_DOC_GUID AND X15.CDO_MSTR_ITEM_NM = 'PROC_Procedure Note FT ob' LEFT JOIN X X16 ON X.CDD_DOC_GUID = X16.CDD_DOC_GUID AND X16.CDO_MSTR_ITEM_NM = 'PROC_VerifCheckList _Preproc Verification RES' LEFT JOIN X X17 ON X.CDD_DOC_GUID = X17.CDD_DOC_GUID AND X17.CDO_MSTR_ITEM_NM = 'PROC_VerifCheckList _Time Out RES' LEFT JOIN X X18 ON X.CDD_DOC_GUID = X18.CDD_DOC_GUID AND X18.CDO_MSTR_ITEM_NM = 'PROC_VerifCheckList_Side/Side Marking RES' LEFT JOIN X X19 ON X.CDD_DOC_GUID = X19.CDD_DOC_GUID AND X19.CDO_MSTR_ITEM_NM = 'PROC_VerifCheckList_Side/Side Marking Not Completed RES' SELECT DISTINCT EAD_MRN AS MRN, EADT_DOCTYPE AS "Doc Type", EADT_EMR_DESC AS "Document Description", EAD_DOCUMENT_DTE AS "Document Date", DOC_NAME, DOC_SVC FROM IDB.EMR_AA_DOCUMENT JOIN IDB.EMR_AA_DOCTYPE ON EADT_DOCTYPE = EAD_DOCTYPE LEFT JOIN IDB.DOC ON EAD_DOCTOR_NUM = DOC_DR_NO WHERE 1=1 AND EADT_EMR_DESC like '%Procedure Verif%' AND EAD_DOCUMENT_DTE BETWEEN '2021-01-01' AND CURRENT date

prompt: Requesting monthly report to capture walk in, no show & cancelled same day appointments for Radiology across the institution.
completion: SELECT CPE_MRN AS "MRN", CPE_ENC_DTE AS "Appt Date", CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 AS "Department", CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 AS "Service", CLD_DEPT_NAME AS "Department Name", CRE_RES_NAME AS "Provider Name", CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME AS "Visit Type" , CPE_CPE_APPT_STS AS "Appt status" FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE ((CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('No Show', 'CxlSameDay')) OR CPE_WALK_IN_IND = 'Y') AND CPE_ENC_DTE >= CURRENT date - 30 DAY AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 IN ('RAD') ;

prompt: Patients with a financial clearance order receiving ipilimumab/nivolumab (ipi/nivo) and nivolumab monotherapy.
completion: WITH PTS0 AS (SELECT DISTINCT OO_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME FROM IDB.OMS_ORDER JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_USER_DATA IPIL ON OO_ORD_GUID = IPIL.OUD_ORD_GUID AND IPIL.OUD_USER_DI_CD IN ('PreAuthChemo_Drug Names', 'PreAuthChemo_Chemo INJ1', 'PreAuthChemo_Chemo INJ2') AND UPPER(IPIL.OUD_USER_DI_VALUE) like '%IPIL%' JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_USER_DATA NIVO ON OO_ORD_GUID = NIVO.OUD_ORD_GUID AND NIVO.OUD_USER_DI_CD IN ('PreAuthChemo_Drug Names', 'PreAuthChemo_Chemo INJ1', 'PreAuthChemo_Chemo INJ2') AND UPPER(NIVO.OUD_USER_DI_VALUE) like '%NIVO%' JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PT_MRN=OO_MRN WHERE OO_ORD_STS_CD NOT IN ('CANC', 'CANP', 'AUC3') ) , PTS AS (SELECT OO_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME FROM PTS0 JOIN IDB.CDB_TUMOR ON OO_MRN = TM_MRN JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS ON AV_ELEMENT = 'CASE_STS' AND AV_CODE = TM_CASE_STS AND TM_CASE_STS IN ('3', '6', '7', '8') AND TM_SITE_CD = 'C649' AND TM_HIST_CD IN ('M8312/3', 'M8317/3') UNION SELECT OO_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME FROM PTS0 JOIN IDB.CTC_CLSF ON CC_MRN = OO_MRN JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE (CC_CLSF_CD = 'C64.9' OR CC_CLSF_CD = '189.0') ) , APPTS AS (SELECT * FROM (SELECT TRIM(CPE_MRN) AS "MRN", CPE_ENC_DTE AS "Appt Date", TRIM(CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6) AS "Department", TRIM(CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8) AS "Service", TRIM(CLD_DEPT_NAME) AS "Department Name", TRIM(CRE_RES_NAME) AS "Provider Name", TRIM(CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME) AS "Visit Type", ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CPE_MRN ORDER BY CPE_ENC_DTE) AS A_RN FROM PTS JOIN IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER ON OO_MRN = CPE_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Sch') AND CRE_RES_TYP IN ('Physician', 'PhD', 'Dentist', 'Psychologist') AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT date AND CURRENT date + 7 DAYS ) A WHERE A_RN=1 ) , UPCOMING_DOSING_DATES AS (SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN, LISTAGG(CPE_ENC_DTE, '|') WITHIN GROUP( ORDER BY CPE_ENC_DTE) AS "Upcoming Dosing Dates", LISTAGG(TRIM(CCH_CHEMO_NAME), '|') WITHIN GROUP( ORDER BY CPE_ENC_DTE) AS "Upcoming Dosing Names" FROM PTS JOIN IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER ON OO_MRN=CPE_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_PT_CHEMO ON CPE_CL_PT_ID=CPC_CL_PT_ID AND CPE_ENC_DTE_SEQ=CPC_ENC_DTE_SEQ JOIN IDB.CL_CHEMO ON CPC_CHEMO_ID=CCH_CHEMO_ID WHERE CPE_ENC_DTE > CURRENT date AND (CCH_CHEMO_NAME LIKE '%IPIL%' OR CCH_CHEMO_NAME LIKE '%NIVO%') GROUP BY CPE_MRN) , REPORTS AS (SELECT * FROM (SELECT PT_MRN, PRPT_REPORT, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY PT_MRN ORDER BY DT_DTE DESC) AS R_RN FROM PTS JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON OO_MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V ON PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID JOIN DV.PATH_RPRT_TYPE_LOOKUP ON PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_CD = PRPT_REPORT_TYPE AND PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_DESC IN ('Surgical Pathology', 'Surgical Submitted Slides') LEFT JOIN DV.DATE ON PRPT_REPORT_DATE_ID = DT_DATE_ID) WHERE R_RN=1 ) , CONSENT_STATUS AS (SELECT MRN_C, CASE WHEN CONS_12_245 IS NULL THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS "Consent 12-245", CASE WHEN CONS_06_107 IS NULL THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS "Consent 06-107" FROM (SELECT DISTINCT AC_MRN MRN_C, MAX(DECODE(PRO_IRB_NO, '12-245', ACD_OFF_STUDY_DTE)) AS CONS_12_245, MAX(DECODE(PRO_IRB_NO, '06-107', ACD_OFF_STUDY_DTE)) AS CONS_06_107 FROM PTS JOIN IDB.ACCRUALS ON AC_MRN=OO_MRN JOIN IDB.PROTOCOL ON PRO_IRB_NO = AC_IRB_NO AND PRO_IRB_NO IN ('12-245', '06-107') JOIN IDB.ACCRUALS_DATES ON AC_IRB_NO = ACD_IRB_NO AND AC_SUBJ_ID_NO = ACD_SUBJ_ID_NO AND AC_SUBJ_SEQ_NO = ACD_SUBJ_SEQ_NO GROUP BY AC_MRN) A) , UPCOMING_CT_MR AS (SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN UC_MRN, LISTAGG(VARCHAR_FORMAT(CPE_APPT_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI'), '|') WITHIN GROUP( ORDER BY CPE_APPT_DT) AS "Upcoming CT/MR Dates", LISTAGG(TRIM(CRE_RES_NAME), '|') WITHIN GROUP( ORDER BY CPE_APPT_DT) AS "Upcoming CT/MR Names" FROM PTS JOIN IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER ON OO_MRN = CPE_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS = 'Sch' AND (CRE_RES_NAME LIKE '%MRI %' OR CRE_RES_NAME LIKE '%CT %') AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 = 'RAD' AND CRE_RES_NAME NOT LIKE '%MRI 1275-OR%' GROUP BY CPE_MRN) SELECT OO_MRN MRN, PT_LAST_NAME "Last Name", PT_FIRST_NAME "First Name", "Appt Date", "Department", "Service", "Department Name", "Provider Name", "Visit Type", "Upcoming Dosing Dates", "Upcoming Dosing Names", "Upcoming CT/MR Dates", "Upcoming CT/MR Names", COALESCE("Consent 12-245", 'N') "Consent 12-245", COALESCE("Consent 06-107", 'N') "Consent 06-107", PRPT_REPORT AS "Last Pathology Report" FROM PTS LEFT JOIN APPTS ON OO_MRN=MRN LEFT JOIN REPORTS ON PT_MRN = OO_MRN LEFT JOIN UPCOMING_DOSING_DATES ON CPE_MRN=OO_MRN LEFT JOIN CONSENT_STATUS ON MRN_C=OO_MRN LEFT JOIN UPCOMING_CT_MR ON UC_MRN=OO_MRN ORDER BY "Appt Date", OO_MRN ;

prompt: Provide a weekly list of when nursing documentation is completed with “states local MSK hospital partnership and Shared Care program”.
completion: SELECT STRIP(CDD_MRN) AS MRN, STRIP(PT_LAST_NAME) || ', ' || STRIP(PT_FIRST_NAME) AS "Name", PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH AS DOB, CDD_DOC_GUID, CDD_SERVICE_DTE AS "Service Date", STRIP(CDD_DOC_NAME) AS "Document Name", OS_SVC_GRP_CD, STRIP(OS_SVC_DESC) AS "Service", STRIP(CDO_SECTION) AS "Section", STRIP(CDO_ITEM_NAME) AS "Item Name", STRIP(SUBSTR(CDO_VALUE_TEXT, 1, 500)) AS "Value Text" FROM IDB.CD_DOCUMENT JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION ON CDO_DOC_GUID = CDD_DOC_GUID AND CDO_AUTHORED_DTE = CDD_AUTHORED_DTE JOIN IDB.OMS_CLIENT_VISIT ON CDD_VISIT_GUID = OCV_VISIT_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_SERVICE ON OCV_SVC_GUID = OS_SVC_GUID JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PT_MRN = CDD_MRN WHERE CDD_CANCEL_IND = '0' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND = '0' AND CDO_VALUE_TEXT LIKE '%States local MSK hospital partnership and Shared Care Program%' AND CDD_SERVICE_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT date - 7 DAYS AND CURRENT DATE

prompt: Provide a prospective list of GUNP patients who have had both gemcitabine and cisplatin ordered since 10/28/19.
completion: WITH CHEMO AS (SELECT DISTINCT A.APR_MRN FROM IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX_V A JOIN IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX_V B ON A.APR_MRN = B.APR_MRN AND B.CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME = 'GEMCITABINE' WHERE A.CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME = 'CISPLATIN' ) , CIS AS (SELECT DISTINCT OO_MRN AS CIS_MRN FROM IDB.OMS_ORDER JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_CATALOG ON OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID = OOC_MSTR_ITEM_GUID WHERE OO_ORD_STS_CD NOT IN ('CANP', 'CANC', 'AUC3') AND OO_MRN NOT IN (SELECT * FROM CHEMO) AND UPPER(OOC_ITEM_NAME) LIKE ('%CISPLATIN%') AND OO_ENTER_DTE >= CURRENT DATE - 14 DAYS ) , PT AS (SELECT DISTINCT OO_MRN AS MRN FROM IDB.OMS_ORDER JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_CATALOG ON OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID = OOC_MSTR_ITEM_GUID JOIN CIS ON OO_MRN = CIS_MRN WHERE OO_ORD_STS_CD NOT IN ('CANP', 'CANC', 'AUC3') AND UPPER(OOC_ITEM_NAME) LIKE ('%GEMCITABINE%') AND OO_ENTER_DTE >= CURRENT DATE - 14 DAYS ) , PROTOCOL AS (SELECT AC_MRN, AC_CONS_DTE FROM IDB.ACCRUALS WHERE AC_IRB_NO = '12-245' ) , APPT_C AS (SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN AS APPT_C_MRN, CPE_ENC_DTE AS APPT_C_ENC_DTE, CLD_DEPT_NAME AS APPT_C_DEPT, CRE_RES_NAME AS APPT_C_RES_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CPE_MRN ORDER BY CPE_ENC_DTE DESC) APPT_C_RN FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID JOIN PT ON CPE_MRN = MRN WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 = 'GU' AND CRE_RES_TYP IN ('Physician') ) , APPT_S AS (SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN AS APPT_S_MRN, CPE_ENC_DTE AS APPT_S_ENC_DTE, CLD_DEPT_NAME AS APPT_S_DEPT, CRE_RES_NAME AS APPT_S_RES_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CPE_MRN ORDER BY CPE_ENC_DTE ASC) APPT_S_RN FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID JOIN PT ON CPE_MRN = MRN WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Sch') AND CPE_ENC_DTE >= CURRENT DATE AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 = 'GU' AND CRE_RES_TYP IN ('Physician') ) , GU AS (SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN AS GU_MRN FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN PT ON CPE_MRN = MRN WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Sch', 'Arrived', 'Comp') AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 = 'GU' AND CRE_RES_TYP IN ('Physician') ) SELECT DISTINCT OO_MRN "MRN", PT_LAST_NAME "Last Name", PT_FIRST_NAME "First Name", PT_SEX "Gender", PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH "Date of Birth", OOC_ITEM_NAME "Order Item Name", OO_ENTER_DTE "Order Enter Date", MIN(OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE) "Order Significant Date", OSTS_STS_DESC "Order Status", AC_CONS_DTE "12-245 Consent Date", APPT_C_ENC_DTE "Last Appt Date", APPT_C_DEPT "Last Appt Dept", APPT_C_RES_NAME "Last Appt Provider", APPT_S_ENC_DTE "Upcoming Appt Date", APPT_S_DEPT "Upcoming Appt Dept", APPT_S_RES_NAME "Upcoming Appt Provider" FROM IDB.OMS_ORDER JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_CATALOG ON OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID = OOC_MSTR_ITEM_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_STATUS ON OO_ORD_STS_CD = OSTS_ORD_STS_CD JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON OO_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN GU ON OO_MRN = GU_MRN LEFT JOIN PROTOCOL ON OO_MRN = AC_MRN LEFT JOIN APPT_C ON OO_MRN = APPT_C_MRN AND APPT_C_RN = 1 LEFT JOIN APPT_S ON OO_MRN = APPT_S_MRN AND APPT_S_RN = 1 WHERE OO_ORD_STS_CD NOT IN ('CANP', 'CANC', 'AUC3') AND (UPPER(OOC_ITEM_NAME) LIKE ('%CISPLATIN%') OR UPPER(OOC_ITEM_NAME) LIKE ('%GEMCITABINE%')) AND OO_ENTER_DTE >= CURRENT DATE - 14 DAYS AND PT_DATE_OF_DEATH IS NULL GROUP BY OO_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_SEX, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, OOC_ITEM_NAME, OO_ENTER_DTE, OSTS_STS_DESC, AC_CONS_DTE, APPT_C_ENC_DTE, APPT_C_DEPT, APPT_C_RES_NAME, APPT_S_ENC_DTE, APPT_S_DEPT, APPT_S_RES_NAME ORDER BY 1, 6, 7, 8 ; WITH APPT_S AS (SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN AS APPT_S_MRN, CPE_ENC_DTE AS APPT_S_ENC_DTE, CLD_DEPT_NAME AS APPT_S_DEPT, CRE_RES_NAME AS APPT_S_RES_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CPE_MRN ORDER BY CPE_ENC_DTE ASC) APPT_S_RN FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Sch') AND CPE_ENC_DTE >= CURRENT DATE AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 = 'GU' AND CRE_RES_TYP IN ('Physician') ) , PROTOCOL AS (SELECT DISTINCT AC_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID, AC_CONS_DTE FROM DV.PROTOCOL JOIN DV.ACCRUALS ON PRO_PROTOCOL_ID = AC_PROTOCOL_ID WHERE PRO_IRB_NO = '12-245' ) SELECT PRPT_MRN "MRN", PT_LAST_NAME "Last Name", PT_FIRST_NAME "First Name", PT_SEX "Gender", PT_BIRTH_DTE "Date of Birth", PRPT_PROCEDURE_DTE "Procedure Date", PRPT_REPORT_DTE "Path Report Date", PRPT_REPORT_TYPE_DESC "Path Report Type", PRPT_ACCESSION_NO "Accession No", PRPT_REPORT "Path Report Text", APPT_S_ENC_DTE "Upcoming Appt Date", APPT_S_DEPT "Upcoming Appt Dept", APPT_S_RES_NAME "Upcoming Appt Provider", AC_CONS_DTE "12-245 Consent Date" FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON PRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID LEFT JOIN APPT_S ON PRPT_MRN = APPT_S_MRN AND APPT_S_RN = 1 LEFT JOIN PROTOCOL ON PRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = AC_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID WHERE PRPT_REPORT IS NOT NULL AND PRPT_REPORT_DTE >= CURRENT DATE - 7 DAYS AND CONTAINS("PRPT_REPORT", '("muscularis propria" AND "urothelial")') = 1 AND PT_DEATH_DTE IS NULL ORDER BY 1, 7

prompt: BMT and CAR-T patient dashboard
completion: SELECT MRN_LIST.MRN, TRIM(PT_LAST_NAME) || ', ' || TRIM(PT_FIRST_NAME) "Name", PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH AS "Date of Birth", PT_DATE_OF_DEATH AS "Date of Death", PROTOCOL.PRO_IRB_NO "IRB Number", ACD_TX_ST_DTE "Protocol Start Date", PLA_LST_ADM_DTE "Last Admit Date", VISIT.ATN_DR_NAME "Last Attending Doctor", VISIT.DOC_NAME, VISIT.DOC_ACDMC_DPT AS "Department", VISIT.VIS_HOSP_SVC AS "Service", VIS_IP_OP_ADJUSTED_IND AS "Inpatient/Outpatient", MRN_LIST."Patient type", CASE WHEN VIS_IP_OP_ADJUSTED_IND = 'O' THEN 'OUTPATIENT' ELSE TREATMENT_PLAN_DESC END AS "Treatment plan", MRN_LIST."Transplant type", MRN_LIST."Transplant date" FROM (SELECT "MRN", "Patient type", "Transplant type", "Transplant date" FROM (SELECT DISTINCT CBM_MRN AS "MRN", 'BMT' AS "Patient type", CBM_TRANSPLANT_TYPE AS "Transplant type", CBM_TRANSPLANT_DTE AS "Transplant date" FROM IDB.CRDB_BMT_MEDICINE UNION SELECT DISTINCT CBP_MRN AS "MRN", 'BMT' AS "Patient type", CBP_TRANSPLANT_TYPE AS "Transplant type", CBP_TRANSPLANT_DTE AS "Transplant date" FROM IDB.CRDB_BMT_PEDIATRICS UNION SELECT DISTINCT APR_MRN MRN, 'CAR-T' AS "Patient type", 'CAR-T' AS "Transplant type", APR_START_DTE AS "Transplant date" FROM IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX JOIN IDB.CHEMO_DRUG_GENERIC ON APR_GENERIC_NAME = CDG_GENERIC_NAME WHERE LOWER(CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME) LIKE '%axicabtagene%' OR LOWER(CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME) LIKE '%tisagenlecleucel%' ) WHERE MRN <> 'ZZZZZZZZ' ) MRN_LIST LEFT JOIN (SELECT PRO_IRB_NO, PRO_IRB_TITLE, PRO_IRB_STS, PRO_PROTOCOL_TYPE, AC_MRN, AC_NON_MSK_INST, AC_LAST_NAME, AC_FIRST_NAME, AC_PVDR_OF_RECORD_NAME, ACD_REG_DTE, ACD_TX_ST_DTE, ACD_TX_END_DTE, ACD_OFF_STUDY_DTE, ACD_CONS_DTE FROM IDB.PROTOCOL JOIN IDB.ACCRUALS ON PRO_IRB_NO = AC_IRB_NO JOIN IDB.ACCRUALS_DATES ON AC_IRB_NO = ACD_IRB_NO AND AC_SUBJ_ID_NO = ACD_SUBJ_ID_NO AND AC_SUBJ_SEQ_NO = ACD_SUBJ_SEQ_NO WHERE ACD_OFF_STUDY_DTE IS NULL ) PROTOCOL ON MRN_LIST.MRN = AC_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY ON MRN_LIST.MRN = PLA_MRN LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM (SELECT VIS_MRN, VIS_ADM_NUM, VIS_ADM_DTE, VIS_DSCH_DTE, VIS_PATIENT_TYPE, VIS_HOSP_SVC, VIS_NURS_STA, ATN_DR_NAME, VIS_IP_OP_ADJUSTED_IND, DOC_NAME, DOC_ACDMC_DPT, TREATMENT_PLAN_DESC, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY VIS_MRN ORDER BY VIS_ADM_DTE DESC) AS RN FROM IDB.VISIT_V LEFT JOIN IDB.DOC ON DOC_DR_NO = VIS_ADM_DR_NO WHERE VIS_VISIT_STATUS IN ('2', '3') AND VIS_ATN_DR_NO <> '999998' AND VIS_PATIENT_TYPE IN ('OP', 'IP') ) WHERE RN = 1) VISIT ON MRN_LIST.MRN = VIS_MRN JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON MRN_LIST.MRN = PT_MRN

prompt: Provide list of scheduled appts of patients diagnosed with skin GVHD or Chronic GVHD.
completion: WITH APPTS AS (SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN AS "MRN", CPE_ENC_DTE AS "Appt Date", CPE_APPT_DT AS "Appt Time", CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 AS "Department", CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 AS "Service", CLD_DEPT_NAME AS "Department Name", CRE_RES_NAME AS "Provider Name", CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME AS "Visit Type", CLD_CLD_CENTER AS "Appt Location" FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Sch') AND CRE_RES_TYP IN ('Physician', 'Advanced Practice Nurse') AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT date + 3 DAYS AND CURRENT date + 9 DAYS AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 = 'BMT' ) , DX_PRE AS (SELECT CC_MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS DX_EFF_DTE, CC_CLSF_CD AS DX_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS DX_DESC FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN APPTS ON CC_MRN = "MRN" JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE CC_CLSF_CD IN ('D89.81', 'D89.811', 'D89.813') AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' GROUP BY CC_MRN, CC_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK ) , DX AS (SELECT CC_MRN, LISTAGG(CHAR(DX_EFF_DTE, ISO) || ' | ' || TRIM(DX_CD) || ' | ' || TRIM(DX_DESC), CHR(13) || CHR(10)) WITHIN GROUP( ORDER BY DX_EFF_DTE) AS DX_DATA FROM DX_PRE GROUP BY CC_MRN) SELECT DISTINCT "MRN", PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH "DOB", DX_DATA "Diagnosis Data", TIME("Appt Time") "Appt Time", "Appt Date", "Provider Name", "Appt Location" FROM APPTS JOIN DX ON "MRN" = CC_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON "MRN" = PT_MRN WHERE YEAR("Appt Date" - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) >= 12 ;

prompt: Provide a report of outside vaccine receipt for the specified list of MRNs.
completion: SELECT CDD_MRN, CDD_DOC_GUID, CDD_SERVICE_DTE, CDD_DOC_NAME, CDO_SECTION, CDO_CTLG_DISPL_NM, CDO_MSTR_ITEM_NM, CDO_ITEM_NAME, CDO_VALUE_TEXT FROM IDB.CD_DOCUMENT JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION ON CDO_DOC_GUID = CDD_DOC_GUID AND CDO_AUTHORED_DTE = CDD_AUTHORED_DTE WHERE CDD_CANCEL_IND = '0' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND = '0' AND UPPER(CDO_SECTION) = 'HEALTH MAINTENANCE' AND UPPER(CDO_CTLG_DISPL_NM) LIKE '%VACCINES%' AND UPPER(CDO_MSTR_ITEM_NM) = 'DOM_HEALTH_MAINTENANCE_VACCINES_COVID FT' AND CDD_SERVICE_DTE >= '2020-01-01' AND CDD_MRN IN ()

prompt: Demographic data of  brain cancer patients who have received a specific radiotracer, C-11 methionine in PET or NM scans
completion: SELECT PT_MRN AS MRN, TM_DX_DTE AS DIAGNOSIS_DATE, TRIM(TM_HIST_CD) || ' - ' || TRIM(HIST_DESC) AS HISTOLOGY, TRIM(TM_SITE_CD) || ' - ' || TRIM(SITE_DESC) AS SITE, MIN_ICD9_EFF_DTE , ICD9_CD, ICD9_DESC FROM IDB.PATIENT LEFT JOIN (SELECT TM_MRN, AV_DESC AS CASE_STS, TM_DX_DTE, TM_HIST_CD, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS HIST_DESC, TM_SITE_CD, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_DESC FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS ON AV_ELEMENT = 'CASE_STS' AND AV_CODE = TM_CASE_STS AND TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND TM_SITE_CD LIKE 'C71%' ) AS CDB ON TM_MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN (SELECT CC_MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS MIN_ICD9_EFF_DTE, TRIM(CC_CLSF_CD) AS ICD9_CD, TRIM(CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK) AS ICD9_DESC FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE CC_CLSF_CD IN ('191', '191.1', '191.2', '191.3', '191.4', '191.5', '191.6', '191.7', '191.8', '191.9', '198.3', '225', '239.6', 'A17.81', 'C71.0', 'C71.1', 'C71.2', 'C71.3', 'C71.4', 'C71.5', 'C71.6', 'C71.7', 'C71.8', 'C71.9', 'C79.31') AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND (CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) GROUP BY CC_MRN, CC_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK ) AS ICD ON CC_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE COALESCE(TM_MRN, CC_MRN) IS NOT NULL ; WITH DX AS (SELECT PT_MRN AS CC_MRN, TM_DX_DTE FROM IDB.PATIENT LEFT JOIN (SELECT TM_MRN, AV_DESC AS CASE_STS, TM_DX_DTE FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS ON AV_ELEMENT = 'CASE_STS' AND AV_CODE = TM_CASE_STS AND TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND TM_SITE_CD LIKE 'C71%' ) AS CDB ON TM_MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN (SELECT CC_MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS MIN_ICD9_EFF_DTE FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE CC_CLSF_CD IN ('191', '191.1', '191.2', '191.3', '191.4', '191.5', '191.6', '191.7', '191.8', '191.9', '198.3', '225', '239.6', 'A17.81', 'C71.0', 'C71.1', 'C71.2', 'C71.3', 'C71.4', 'C71.5', 'C71.6', 'C71.7', 'C71.8', 'C71.9', 'C79.31') AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND (CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) GROUP BY CC_MRN, CC_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK ) AS ICD ON CC_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE COALESCE(TM_MRN, CC_MRN) IS NOT NULL ) SELECT PT_MRN AS MRN, PT_LAST_NAME AS "Last Name", PT_SEX AS GENDER, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH AS DOB, TRIM(R.AV_DESC) AS "Race", TRIM(E.AV_DESC) AS "Ethnicity", TRIM(D.AV_DESC) AS "Vital Status", PLA_LST_CON_DTE AS "Last Contact Date" FROM DX JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PT_MRN = CC_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS R ON R.AV_ELEMENT = 'RACE' AND R.AV_CODE = PT_RACE LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS E ON E.AV_ELEMENT = 'PT_ETHNICITY' AND E.AV_CODE = PT_PT_ETHNICITY LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS D ON D.AV_ELEMENT = 'DEATH_IND' AND D.AV_CODE = PT_DEATH_IND LEFT JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY ON PLA_MRN = PT_MRN ; WITH DX AS (SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN AS CC_MRN, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH AS DOB FROM IDB.PATIENT LEFT JOIN (SELECT TM_MRN, AV_DESC AS CASE_STS, TM_DX_DTE FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS ON AV_ELEMENT = 'CASE_STS' AND AV_CODE = TM_CASE_STS AND TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND TM_SITE_CD LIKE 'C71%' ) AS CDB ON TM_MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN (SELECT CC_MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS MIN_ICD9_EFF_DTE, TRIM(CC_CLSF_CD) AS ICD9_CD, TRIM(CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK) AS ICD9_DESC FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE CC_CLSF_CD IN ('191', '191.1', '191.2', '191.3', '191.4', '191.5', '191.6', '191.7', '191.8', '191.9', '198.3', '225', '239.6', 'A17.81', 'C71.0', 'C71.1', 'C71.2', 'C71.3', 'C71.4', 'C71.5', 'C71.6', 'C71.7', 'C71.8', 'C71.9', 'C79.31') AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND (CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) GROUP BY CC_MRN, CC_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK ) AS ICD ON CC_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE COALESCE(TM_MRN, CC_MRN) IS NOT NULL ), RAD AS (SELECT PT_MRN RAD_MRN, MRPT_PERFORMED_DTE, MRPT_REPORT_TYPE, YEAR (MRPT_PERFORMED_DTE - DOB) AS AGE, MRPT_ACCESSION_NO, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY PT_MRN ORDER BY MRPT_PERFORMED_DTE DESC) RN, RCI_CATEGORY1, RCI_CATEGORY2, RCI_ITEM_NAME, MRPT_MED_REPORT_TXT FROM DV.MEDICAL_REPORTS JOIN DV.RESULT_CATALOG_ITEM ON MPRT_RESULT_CATALOG_ITEM_ID = RCI_RESULT_CATALOG_ITEM_ID JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON MRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID JOIN DX ON CC_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE RCI_MASTER_CATEGORY = 'Diag Rad & Nuc Med' AND RCI_CATEGORY1 IN ('MRI', 'Nuclear Medicine') AND INSTR(LOWER(CAST (MRPT_MED_REPORT_TXT AS VARCHAR(12000))), 'methionine') > 0 ) SELECT RAD_MRN AS MRN, MRPT_PERFORMED_DTE AS "Scan Performed Date", MRPT_ACCESSION_NO AS "Accession No", MRPT_REPORT_TYPE AS "Report Type", TRIM(RCI_CATEGORY1) || ' - ' || TRIM(RCI_CATEGORY2) AS CATEGORY, RCI_ITEM_NAME AS "Exam Description", AGE AS "Age as of Scan Perf Date", MRPT_MED_REPORT_TXT AS REPORT_TEXT FROM RAD WHERE RN =1 ;

prompt: Provide a number of NV1, NV2, NV3, IR1, AFR and LFR seen in 2010 and YTD for dept 453
completion: SELECT CLD_DEPT_NAME, CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR, COUNT(CPE_ENC_CSN_ID) AS COUNT FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID AND CLD_DEPT_ID = 453 JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN '2010-01-10' AND '2010-12-31' AND CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') GROUP BY CLD_DEPT_NAME, CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR

prompt: Provide a list of pediatric and young adult patients ages 18-39 with any cancer type who are currently receiving cancer treatment at MSK or completed cancer treatment at MSK within the last 5 years.
completion: WITH X AS (SELECT DISTINCT TM_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, PT_PRIMARY_LANG, YEAR(CURRENT DATE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) AGE, TM_HIST_CD ||H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK HIST, TM_SITE_CD || S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_DESC, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 AS "Department", CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 ||'-'||CRE_RES_NAME PROVIDER_DEPT, CRE_RES_NAME AS "Provider Name" FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON TM_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER ON PT_MRN = CPE_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND YEAR(CURRENT DATE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) BETWEEN 18 AND 39 AND CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND PT_PRIMARY_LANG = 'ENG' AND CRE_RES_TYP = 'Physician' AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 IN ('PED', 'MED') ) , PROV AS (SELECT DISTINCT TM_MRN, LISTAGG(PROVIDER_DEPT, CHR(10)) WITHIN GROUP( ORDER BY PROVIDER_DEPT) PROVIDER_AND_DEPT FROM (SELECT DISTINCT TM_MRN, PROVIDER_DEPT FROM X) GROUP BY TM_MRN), DIAG AS (SELECT DISTINCT TM_MRN, LISTAGG(HIST, CHR(10)) WITHIN GROUP( ORDER BY HIST) HISTOLOGY, LISTAGG(SITE_DESC, CHR(10)) WITHIN GROUP( ORDER BY SITE_DESC) SITES FROM (SELECT DISTINCT TM_MRN, HIST, SITE_DESC FROM X) GROUP BY TM_MRN) SELECT DISTINCT X.TM_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, PT_PRIMARY_LANG, AGE, HISTOLOGY, SITES, PROVIDER_AND_DEPT, PLA_LST_SURG_DTE, PLA_LST_CHEMO_DTE, PLA_LST_RT_DTE FROM X LEFT JOIN DIAG D ON X.TM_MRN =D.TM_MRN LEFT JOIN PROV P ON X.TM_MRN = P.TM_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY ON X.TM_MRN = PLA_MRN WHERE PLA_LST_SURG_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT DATE - 5 YEARS AND CURRENT DATE AND PLA_LST_CHEMO_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT DATE - 5 YEARS AND CURRENT DATE AND PLA_LST_RT_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT DATE - 5 YEARS AND CURRENT DATE

prompt: Provide a list of patients with esophageal, gastroesophageal junction, or gastric cancer, who also developed brain metastases.
completion: WITH CDB AS (SELECT DISTINCT TM_MRN AS MRN, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH AS DOB, YEAR(TM_DX_DTE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) DX_AGE, TM_DX_DTE AS DX_DATE, PT_DATE_OF_DEATH AS DOD, TM_SITE_CD AS SITE_CODE, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_DESC, TM_HIST_CD AS HIST_CODE, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS HIST_DESC, TM_CLIN_TNM_T, TM_CLIN_TNM_N, TM_CLIN_TNM_M, TM_PATH_TNM_T, TM_PATH_TNM_N, TM_PATH_TNM_M, CASE WHEN TM_SSF15 = '010' THEN 'Positive/elevated; amplified' WHEN TM_SSF15 = '020' THEN 'Negative/normal; within normal limits; not amplified' WHEN TM_SSF15 = '030' THEN 'Borderline; equivocal; indeterminate; undetermined whether positive or negative' WHEN TM_SSF15 = '988' THEN 'Not applicable: Information not collected for this case' WHEN TM_SSF15 = '997' THEN 'Test ordered, results not in chart' WHEN TM_SSF15 = '998' THEN 'Test not done (test not ordered and not performed)' WHEN TM_SSF15 = '999' THEN 'Unknown or no information; not documented in patient record' ELSE '' END AS "HER2 Summary Result" FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON TM_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.SEERGROUPING ON RECODE = IDB.SEERF_ICDO(TM_SITE_CD, TM_HIST_CD) JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD WHERE CATEGORY2 IN ('Esophagus', 'Stomach') AND H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK LIKE '%ADENO%' AND TM_HIST_CD NOT IN ('M8200/3', 'M8245/3', 'M8310/3') AND TM_CASE_STS IN ('3', '6', '7', '8') ) , METS AS (SELECT DISTINCT CC_MRN FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND ((CC_PT_TYPE = 'I') OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) AND (CC_CLSF_CD BETWEEN '196' AND '198.99' OR CC_CLSF_CD BETWEEN 'C77' AND 'C79.99') AND CC_MRN IN (SELECT MRN FROM CDB) AND CC_CLSF_CD IN ('C79.31', '198.3') ) , X AS (SELECT DISTINCT CDB.* FROM CDB WHERE MRN IN (SELECT CC_MRN FROM METS) ) , SRG AS (SELECT DISTINCT SSE_MRN, SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD, SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC, SSE_SURG_DTE FROM IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE ON SSE_LOG_ID = SSP_LOG_ID WHERE SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD LIKE '43%' AND SSE_MRN IN (SELECT MRN FROM X) ) , CHEMO AS (SELECT APR_MRN, APR_DRUG_NAME, MIN(APR_START_DTE) AS START_DATE, MAX(APR_END_DTE) AS END_DATE FROM IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX JOIN IDB.CHEMO_DRUG_GENERIC ON APR_GENERIC_NAME = CDG_GENERIC_NAME WHERE APR_MRN IN (SELECT MRN FROM X) AND CDG_CHEMO_FLAG = 'Y' GROUP BY APR_MRN, APR_DRUG_NAME ) , RT AS (SELECT DISTINCT RTC_TX_MRN, RTC_TX_PLAN_NAME, RTC_PRIMARY_REF_POINT, RTC_TX_START_DTE, RTC_TX_STOP_DTE, RTC_TX_ELAPSED_DAYS, RTC_TX_PLANNED_FRACTIONS, RTC_TX_DELIVERED_FRACTIONS, RTC_TX_PLANNED_DOSE, RTC_TX_DELIVERED_DOSE, RTC_DOSE_CORRECTION FROM IDB.RADONC_TREATMENT_COURSE WHERE RTC_TX_MRN IN (SELECT MRN FROM X) ) SELECT DISTINCT X.*, CASE WHEN SSE_MRN IS NOT NULL THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS "Surgery", CASE WHEN APR_MRN IS NOT NULL THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS "Chemo", CASE WHEN RTC_TX_MRN IS NOT NULL THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS "Radiation Therapy" FROM X LEFT JOIN SRG ON MRN = SSE_MRN LEFT JOIN CHEMO ON MRN = APR_MRN LEFT JOIN RT ON MRN = RTC_TX_MRN SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN, GENE, PRPT_ACCESSION_NO, PATH_RPT_DATE, PATH_PROCEDURE_DATE, PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_DESC, METHOD, RESULT, LOCUS, AA_CHANGE, NUCLEOTIDE, ABERRATIONTYPE, FOLD_CHANGE FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_STRUCTURED_RESULTS_V WHERE METHOD = 'IMPACT' AND PT_MRN IN ()

prompt: Provide a monthly report showing Inpatient Covid admissions, discharges, patient days and Length of Stay.
completion: WITH MTH AS (SELECT DISTINCT '2021-12-01' AS START_DATE, '2021-12-31' AS END_DATE FROM IDB.ALLOWVALS) SELECT DISTINCT STRIP(COVID.MRN) AS MRN, STRIP(PT_LAST_NAME) || ', ' || STRIP(PT_FIRST_NAME) AS NAME, STRIP(RESULT) AS RESULT, START_DATE, END_DATE, ADMIT_DATE, DISCHARGE_DATE, COALESCE(MIN(DISCHARGE_DATE, END_DATE), END_DATE) AS DISCHARGE_DATE_FOR_LOS, LOS AS LOS_OLD, CASE WHEN DAYS(COALESCE(MIN(DISCHARGE_DATE, END_DATE), END_DATE)) - DAYS(MAX(ADMIT_DATE, START_DATE)) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE DAYS(COALESCE(MIN(DISCHARGE_DATE, END_DATE), END_DATE)) - DAYS(MAX(ADMIT_DATE, START_DATE)) END AS LOS, FLOOR_ADMIT, FLOOR_DISCHARGE, COVID.IN_HOSP_NS FROM IDB.COVID19_PATIENT_INFO COVID, MTH JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON COVID.MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.INPATIENT_ADMISSIONS_V IP ON COVID.MRN = IP.MRN AND MIN_IDENTIFIED_DT <= DISCHARGE_DT_FOR_CALCS AND (RESULT = 'Positive' OR (RESULT = 'Resolved' AND MIN_RESOLVED_PROBLEM_DT > ADMIT_DT)) WHERE 1=1 AND(ADMIT_DATE BETWEEN START_DATE AND END_DATE OR DISCHARGE_DATE BETWEEN START_DATE AND END_DATE OR(ADMIT_DATE < START_DATE AND DISCHARGE_DATE > END_DATE) OR(ADMIT_DATE < START_DATE AND DISCHARGE_DATE IS NULL))

prompt: Need total # of chemotherapy doses ordered by all physicians from Jan-June of 2007.
completion: SELECT PT_MRN, RTRIM(PT_LAST_NAME)||', '||RTRIM(PT_FIRST_NAME) AS PT_NAME, PO_RX_NO AS RX_NO, POD_ITEM_DESC AS DRUG_NAME, POD_STRT_DTE AS START_DATE, POD_SCH_CD AS SCHED_CODE, POD_ORD_DUR AS DURATION, POI_DOSE AS DOSE, POI_DOSE_UNIT AS DOSE_UNIT, POI_NET_PT_DOSE AS NET_PT_DOSE, PO_ROUTE_DESC AS ROUTE_DESC, PO_DISP_LOC_NAME AS LOC_NAME, PO_DR_NAME AS DR_NAME, POI_AHFS AS AHFS FROM IDB.PHM_ORDER JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PT_MRN = PO_MRN JOIN IDB.PHM_ORD_DTL ON PO_ORD_SEQ = POD_ORD_SEQ JOIN IDB.PHM_ORD_INV ON POD_ITEM_NO = POI_ITEM_NO AND POD_ORD_SEQ = POI_ORD_SEQ JOIN IDB.PHM_INVENTORY ON POI_INV_SEQ = PIN_INV_SEQ WHERE POD_STRT_DTE BETWEEN DATE(SUBSTR(CHAR(CURRENT DATE), 1, 8)||'01') - 6 MONTH AND DATE(SUBSTR(CHAR(CURRENT DATE), 1, 8)||'01') - 1 DAY AND POD_ITEM_STS <>'X' AND POD_ATT_FLAG NOT LIKE '%IVVEH%' AND POD_ATT_FLAG LIKE '%CHEMO%' AND (POI_AHFS LIKE '10:%' OR POI_AHFS IN ('08:18.24.00.00', '88:04.01.00.20', '92:01.01.03.09', '92:01.01.01.55'))

prompt: Provide a one-time list of lymphoma patients diagnosis and nuclear medicine imaging information
completion: WITH DX AS (SELECT PT_MRN , DT_DTE DX_DTE , DXCC_ICD_CODE HIST_CD , DXCC_ICD_MSK_DESC HIST_DESC FROM DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS JOIN DV.CDB_TUMOR_V ON CDTM_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID JOIN DV.DATE_V ON CDTM_DX_DATE_ID = DT_DATE_ID JOIN DV.DIAGNOSIS_CODE_CAT_ICDO_V ON CDTM_DX_CATALOG_ID = DXCC_DX_CATALOG_ID JOIN DV.ICDO_SITE_CATALOG_V ON CDTM_SITE_CATALOG_ID = ICSC_SITE_CATALOG_ID JOIN DV.TUMOR_CASE_ATTRIBUTES_V ON CDTM_CASE_ATTR_ID = TUMOR_CASE_ATTR_ID WHERE DXCC_ICD_CODE IN ('M9679/3', 'M9680/3', 'M9681/3', 'M9614/3', 'M9690/3', 'M9698/3', 'M9650/3', 'M9652/3', 'M9659/3', 'M9663/3', 'M9665/3') AND DT_DTE BETWEEN '2010-01-01' AND '2021-01-31' ) SELECT RRPT_MRN MRN , DX_DTE , HIST_CD , HIST_DESC , RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE EXAM_DTE , RRPT_ACCESSION_NO ACCESSION_NO , RRPT_PROCEDURE_NAME EXAM_NAME , RRPT_REPORT_TXT EXAM_REPORT FROM DV.RADIOLOGY_REPORT_V JOIN DX ON RRPT_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE RRPT_ORDER_GROUP IN ('PET for Cancer', 'PET CT for Cancer', 'PET') AND CONTAINS(RRPT_REPORT_TXT, '("lymphoma")') = 1

prompt: Provide a list of patients who were screened for food insecurity by the MSK dietitians.
completion: WITH X AS (SELECT DISTINCT CDD_MRN, CDD_DOC_GUID, CDD_SERVICE_DTE, CDD_DOC_NAME, OP_DISPLAY_NAME, STRIP(SUBSTR(CDO_VALUE_TEXT, 1, 100)) AS VISIT_TYPE FROM IDB.CD_DOCUMENT JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION X1 ON CDO_DOC_GUID = CDD_DOC_GUID AND CDO_AUTHORED_DTE = CDD_AUTHORED_DTE AND CDO_MSTR_ITEM_NM = 'OUT_NUT_NEW General Visit RES' JOIN IDB.OMS_PROVIDER ON OP_PVDR_GUID = CDD_AUTH_PROV_GUID WHERE CDD_CANCEL_IND = '0' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND = '0' AND CDD_SERVICE_DTE BETWEEN '2020-01-01' AND CURRENT date AND CDD_DOC_NAME = 'Initial Assessment/Reassessment Amb - Nutrition' ) SELECT DISTINCT CDD_MRN, STRIP(PT_LAST_NAME) || ', ' || STRIP(PT_FIRST_NAME) AS NAME, CDD_SERVICE_DTE, CDD_DOC_NAME, OP_DISPLAY_NAME, VISIT_TYPE, STRIP(SUBSTR(X1.CDO_VALUE_TEXT, 1, 100)) AS "Does patient have difficulty getting food", STRIP(SUBSTR(X2.CDO_VALUE_TEXT, 1, 100)) AS "Reason for food insecurity", STRIP(SUBSTR(X3.CDO_VALUE_TEXT, 1, 100)) AS "Is it more difficult getting food during pandemic" FROM X JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON CDD_MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION X1 ON X1.CDO_DOC_GUID = CDD_DOC_GUID AND X1.CDO_CTLG_DISPL_NM = 'Food Insecurity' AND X1.CDO_MSTR_ITEM_NM = 'Initial_NUTASSMT_Food insecurity_Pt has difficulty getting food Res' LEFT JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION X2 ON X2.CDO_DOC_GUID = CDD_DOC_GUID AND X2.CDO_CTLG_DISPL_NM = 'Food Insecurity' AND X2.CDO_MSTR_ITEM_NM = 'Initial_NUTASSMT_Food Insecurity reason FT' LEFT JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION X3 ON X3.CDO_DOC_GUID = CDD_DOC_GUID AND X3.CDO_CTLG_DISPL_NM = 'Food Insecurity' AND X3.CDO_MSTR_ITEM_NM = 'Initial_NUTASSMT_Food insecurity_Is it more difficult getting food during pandemic Res'

prompt: Identify patients with AML-M7 who were seen at MSKCC.
completion: WITH "cte1" AS (SELECT TEXTTABLE.*, CONTAINS("PRPT_DEID_REPORT", '"megakaryoblastic"') AS "HitCol1" FROM "DV"."PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V" TEXTTABLE) SELECT DISTINCT "t2"."PRPT_ACCESSION_NO" AS "Pathology Report", "t3"."PT_MRN" AS "MRN", "t3"."PT_LAST_NAME" AS "Last Name", "t3"."PT_FIRST_NAME" AS "First Name" FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED" "t1" LEFT JOIN "cte1" "t2" ON "t1"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t2"."PRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V" "t3" ON "t1"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t3"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" WHERE "t2"."HitCol1" <> 0 WITH "cte1" AS (SELECT TEXTTABLE.*, CONTAINS("PRPT_DEID_REPORT", '"M7"') AS "HitCol1" FROM "DV"."PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V" TEXTTABLE) SELECT DISTINCT "t1"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AS "Deident PT #", "t2"."PRPT_PATH_RPT_ID" AS "DE-ID Pathology Report", "t2"."PRPT_ACCESSION_NO" AS "Pathology Report", "t3"."PT_MRN" AS "MRN", "t3"."PT_LAST_NAME" AS "Last Name", "t3"."PT_FIRST_NAME" AS "First Name" FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED" "t1" LEFT JOIN "cte1" "t2" ON "t1"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t2"."PRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V" "t3" ON "t1"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t3"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" WHERE "t2"."HitCol1" <> 0

prompt: Volumes of IR procedures completed on patients coming from MSK Bergen and MSK Basking Ridge
completion: WITH CTE AS (SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CLD_CLD_CENTER IN ('BER', 'BSK') ) SELECT DISTINCT SSE_MRN "MRN", PT_LAST_NAME "Last Name", PT_FIRST_NAME "First Name", PT_STATE "State", PT_ZIP_CD "Zip Code", SSE_SURG_DTE "Surgery Date", SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD "CPT Code", SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC "CPT Description", TRIM(SSP_SURG_LAST_NM) || ', ' || TRIM(SSP_SURG_FIRST_NM) "Surgeon", SSE_SURG_LOC "Location" FROM IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE ON SSE_LOG_ID = SSP_LOG_ID JOIN CTE ON SSE_MRN = CPE_MRN JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON SSE_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE SSE_SURG_LOC like '%IR%' AND SSP_SURG_SVC_CD = 'IR' AND YEAR(SSE_SURG_DTE) = 2019

prompt: Please provide MRN, first name, last name, procedure date, report date, report type, and full report text for all patients with a pathology report, surgical pathology report, or dermatology surgical pathology report with the term listed below in criteria.
completion: SELECT PRPT_MRN AS MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, CASE WHEN PRPT_PROCEDURE_DTE IS NULL THEN DV.REGEXSTR('(?<=Date of Collection\/Procedure\/Outside Report: ).*', PRPT_REPORT) ELSE PRPT_PROCEDURE_DTE END AS PROCEDURE_DATE, PRPT_REPORT_DTE AS REPORT_DATE, PRPT_REPORT_TYPE_DESC AS REPORT_TYPE, PRPT_REPORT AS FULL_PATH_REPORT FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON PRPT_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE PRPT_REPORT IS NOT NULL AND PRPT_REPORT_TYPE_DESC = 'Surgical Pathology' AND CONTAINS("PRPT_REPORT", '("ANGIOSARCOMA")') = 1

prompt: Provide a weekly list of all unsolicited EKG tests (all EKGs performed without an associated order).
completion: SELECT PT_MRN MRN, TRIM(PT_LAST_NAME)|| ', ' ||TRIM(PT_FIRST_NAME) AS "Patient Name" , OCV_IP_OP_IND AS "Indicator", MRPT_PERFORMED_DTE AS "Performed Date" , OO_ORD_NAME "Order Name", MRPT_ORDER_IDENTIFIER "Order ID", OL_LOC_NAME AS "Order Location" , OU_DISPLAY_NAME "User name", OU_ORD_ROLE_TYPE "User Role" , CASE WHEN UPPER(OO_CREATE_BY) LIKE '%INTERFACE%' OR OU_OCCUPATION = 'I' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END "Unsolicited Flag" , TO_CHAR(MRPT_PERFORMED_DT, 'DD/MM/YYYY HH:MI:SS AM') "Performed DateTime" FROM DV.MEDICAL_REPORTS JOIN DV.RESULT_CATALOG_ITEM ON MPRT_RESULT_CATALOG_ITEM_ID = RCI_RESULT_CATALOG_ITEM_ID JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON MRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID JOIN IDB.OMS_ORDER ON MRPT_ORDER_GUID = OO_ORD_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_USER ON OO_USER_GUID = OU_USER_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_CLIENT_VISIT ON OCV_VISIT_GUID = OO_VISIT_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_VISIT_LOCATION A ON OVL_VISIT_GUID = MRPT_CLIENT_VISIT_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_LOCATION ON OL_LOC_GUID = OVL_LOC_GUID WHERE MRPT_PERFORMED_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT DATE - 7 DAY AND CURRENT DATE - 1 DAY AND RCI_ITEM_NAME= 'Cardiac Result' AND OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID IN ('9000005062100730', '1309073001') AND(UPPER(OO_CREATE_BY) LIKE '%INTERFACE%' OR OU_OCCUPATION = 'I') AND A.OVL_VISIT_LOC_GUID = (SELECT MAX(B.OVL_VISIT_LOC_GUID) FROM IDB.OMS_VISIT_LOCATION B WHERE A.OVL_VISIT_GUID = B.OVL_VISIT_GUID AND B.OVL_EFF_DT <= OO_PERFORMED_DT)

prompt: List of patients with colorectal adenocarcinoma and liver metastasis who had molecular pathology reports and PET/CT scans at MSKCC from 1/1/2010 - 6/6/2018.
completion: WITH XML_DATA AS (SELECT DISTINCT PDRX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID, PDWS_NAME, PT_MRN, PDRX_ACCESSION_NO, PDRX_DMP_PATIENT_ID, PDRX_PATH_RPT_ID, T.* FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML INNER JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML_SETTINGS ON PDRX_PATH_DMP_RESULTS_XML_ID = PDRXS_PATH_DMP_RESULTS_XML_ID INNER JOIN DVDMC.PATHOLOGY_DMP_WEBSVC_SETTINGS ON PDRXS_SETTING_ID = PDWS_SETTING_ID INNER JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON PDRX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID, XMLTABLE('$c/root/*' PASSING PDRX_XML_VALUE AS "c" COLUMNS DT_PROCEDURE VARCHAR(100) PATH 'dt_procedure', SITE1_GENE VARCHAR(100) PATH 'site1_gene', SITE2_GENE VARCHAR(100) PATH 'site2_gene', GENE_ID VARCHAR(100) PATH 'gene_id', EXON_NUM VARCHAR(100) PATH 'exon_num', AA_CHANGE VARCHAR(100) PATH 'aa_change', CDNA_CHANGE VARCHAR(100) PATH 'cDNA_change', MAFREQ VARCHAR(100) PATH 'mafreq_1000g', GENE_FOLD_CHANGE VARCHAR(100) PATH 'gene_fold_change', VARIANT_TYPE VARCHAR(100) PATH './local-name(.)', TUMOR_TYPE_NAME VARCHAR(255) PATH '../meta-data/tumor_type_name', PRIMARY_SITE VARCHAR(255) PATH '../meta-data/primary_site', IMPACT_PANEL VARCHAR(255) PATH '../meta-data/gene-panel', TMB_COUNT DECIMAL(5, 1) PATH '../meta-data/tmb-count') T WHERE VARIANT_TYPE <> 'meta-data' ) , DT AS (SELECT DISTINCT PDRX_PATH_RPT_ID, PDRX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID, PT_MRN, PDRX_DMP_PATIENT_ID, PDRX_ACCESSION_NO, TUMOR_TYPE_NAME, PRIMARY_SITE FROM XML_DATA WHERE LOWER(PRIMARY_SITE) like '%colon%' ) , PETCT AS (SELECT RRPT_MRN, MIN(RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE) MIN_RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE, LISTAGG(RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE, CHR(13) || CHR(10)) WITHIN GROUP( ORDER BY RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE) AS RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE FROM (SELECT DISTINCT RRPT_MRN, RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE FROM DV.RADIOLOGY_REPORT_V JOIN DT ON PT_MRN = RRPT_MRN WHERE RRPT_ORDER_GROUP IN ('PET', 'PET for Cancer', 'PET for Cardiac viability or perfusion') AND RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE BETWEEN '2010-01-01' AND '2018-11-14' AND RRPT_ORDER_STATUS_CD IN ('PERF', 'RESC', 'RESF', 'RESI') ) A GROUP BY RRPT_MRN) , LIVERMETS AS (SELECT DISTINCT CC_MRN FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN PETCT ON RRPT_MRN = CC_MRN WHERE SUBSTR(CC_CLSF_CD, 1, 5) IN ('197.7', 'C78.7') AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' ) , GENEINFO AS (SELECT DISTINCT A.PT_MRN, PRPT_ACCESSION_NO, PRPT_PATH_RPT_ID, PATH_RPT_DATE, PATH_PROCEDURE_DATE, SUBSTR(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(CAST(XMLSERIALIZE(CONTENT XMLAGG(XMLELEMENT(NAME "c", R.GENE || ' | ' || COALESCE(R.GENE2, '') || ' | ' || COALESCE(R.ABERRATIONTYPE, '') || ' | ' || COALESCE(R.LOCUS, '') || ' | ' || COALESCE(R.AA_CHANGE, '') || ' | ' || COALESCE(R.NUCLEOTIDE, '') || CHR(13) || CHR(10)) ORDER BY A.PT_MRN) AS CLOB(32000)) AS VARCHAR(32000)), '<c>', ','), '</c>', ''), '', ''), '<c/>', ''), ',', ''), '&', '&'), '<', '<'), '>', '>'), 1) AS GENE_INFO FROM DT A JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_STRUCTURED_RESULTS_V R ON A.PT_MRN = R.PT_MRN AND PDRX_PATH_RPT_ID = PRPT_PATH_RPT_ID AND PDRX_ACCESSION_NO = PRPT_ACCESSION_NO GROUP BY A.PT_MRN, PRPT_ACCESSION_NO, PRPT_PATH_RPT_ID, PATH_RPT_DATE, PATH_PROCEDURE_DATE) , CRP_EXACT AS (SELECT DISTINCT LR_TEST_NAME, LR_SUBTEST_NAME FROM IDB.LAB_RESULTS WHERE 1=1 AND LOWER(LR_SUBTEST_NAME) like '%protein%' ) , CRP_G AS (SELECT DISTINCT LR_MRN, LR_PERFORMED_DTE, ABS(DAYS(LR_PERFORMED_DTE) - DAYS(PATH_RPT_DATE)) ABS_DIFF, LR_TEST_NAME, LR_SUBTEST_NAME, LR_RESULT_VALUE, LR_UNIT_MEASURE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY LR_MRN ORDER BY ABS(DAYS(LR_PERFORMED_DTE) - DAYS(PATH_RPT_DATE)) ASC) AS ROW_NUM FROM GENEINFO LEFT JOIN IDB.LAB_RESULTS ON LR_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE LR_SUBTEST_NAME IN ('C-Reactive Protein', 'C-Reactive Protein', 'C-Reactive Protein, High Sensitivity', 'C-Reactive Protein, High Sensitivity') ) SELECT DISTINCT A.PT_MRN "MRN", PRPT_ACCESSION_NO "Accession No", G.PRPT_PATH_RPT_ID "Path Report ID", PATH_RPT_DATE "Path Report Date", PATH_PROCEDURE_DATE "Path Procedure Date", PT_BIRTH_DTE "DOB", PT_LAST_NAME "Last Name", PT_FIRST_NAME "First Name", RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE "PET/CT Scan Date", A.TUMOR_TYPE_NAME "Disease Type", A.PRIMARY_SITE "Primary Site", LR_PERFORMED_DTE "Lab Performed Date", ABS(DAYS(LR_PERFORMED_DTE) - DAYS(MIN_RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE)) "CRP Lab to PETCT Scan Day Diff", LR_TEST_NAME "Lab Test Name", LR_RESULT_VALUE "Lab Result", LR_UNIT_MEASURE "Lab Unit", GENE_INFO "Gene Info" FROM DT A LEFT JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS D ON A.PT_MRN = D.PT_MRN JOIN GENEINFO G ON A.PT_MRN = G.PT_MRN JOIN PETCT ON A.PT_MRN = RRPT_MRN JOIN LIVERMETS ON A.PT_MRN = CC_MRN LEFT JOIN CRP_G C ON A.PT_MRN = C.LR_MRN AND ROW_NUM = 1 ;
