prompt: Please provide a weekly list for each provider in the STGU service of the list of patients with upcoming CT and/or Mammogram scans with contrast.
completion: SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN , CL_LAST_NAME, CL_FIRST_NAME , A.CLD_DEPT_NAME , A.CLD_CLD_CENTER, B.CRE_RES_NAME, CPE_ENC_DTE , CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME, D.CRE_RES_NAME AS REF_MD, C.CLD_DEPT_NAME AS REF_DEPT FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT A ON CPE_DEPT_ID = A.CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE B ON B.CRE_RES_ID = CPE_VST_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID JOIN IDB.CL_PATIENT ON CPE_PRK = CL_PRK LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT C ON C.CLD_DEPT_ID = CPE_REF_DEP_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE D ON D.CRE_RES_ID = CPE_REF_RES_ID WHERE 1=1 AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT DATE AND CURRENT date + 90 DAY AND A.CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 = 'RAD' AND C.CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 = 'MED' AND C.CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 = 'GU' AND CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Sch') AND ((B.CRE_RES_NAME like 'CT%' AND (CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME LIKE '%W/CONTRAST%' OR CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME LIKE '%W/ CONTRAST%')) OR B.CRE_RES_NAME LIKE 'MAMMO%')

prompt: We are requesting details, where available, from ClinDoc notes relating to location of targeted lesion.
completion: WITH PTS AS (SELECT * FROM COTA.FL_PATIENTS_5_22_24), X AS (SELECT LR_MRN, LR_PERFORMED_DTE, LR_ACCESSION_NO, LR_TEST_NAME, LR_SUBTEST_NAME, LLG_LOINC_CD, LCI_ANCIL_NAME, LR_RESULT_GUID, LR_RESULT_VALUE, LR_UNIT_MEASURE, LR_TEST_LOW_LIMIT, LR_TEST_UP_LIMIT, LR_ABNORMALITY_CD, LISTAGG (TRIM(CAST(LTL_TEXT_RESULT AS VARCHAR(10000))), '') LTL_TEXT_RESULT FROM PTS JOIN IDB.LAB_RESULTS ON MRN = LR_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.LAB_TEXT_LINE ON LTL_RESULT_GUID = LR_RESULT_GUID LEFT JOIN IDB.LAB_CATALOG_ITEM ON LR_CTLG_ITEM_GUID = LCI_CTLG_ITEM_GUID LEFT JOIN IDB.LAB_LOINC_GENLAB ON LR_RESULT_GUID = LLG_RESULT_GUID WHERE LR_PERFORMED_DTE < '2021-01-01' GROUP BY LR_MRN, LR_PERFORMED_DTE, LR_ACCESSION_NO, LR_TEST_NAME, LR_SUBTEST_NAME, LLG_LOINC_CD, LCI_ANCIL_NAME, LR_RESULT_GUID, LR_RESULT_VALUE, LR_UNIT_MEASURE, LR_TEST_LOW_LIMIT, LR_TEST_UP_LIMIT, LR_ABNORMALITY_CD) SELECT * FROM X ; WITH PTS AS (SELECT * FROM COTA.FL_PATIENTS_5_22_24), X AS (SELECT LR_MRN, LR_PERFORMED_DTE, LR_ACCESSION_NO, LR_TEST_NAME, LR_SUBTEST_NAME, LLG_LOINC_CD, LCI_ANCIL_NAME, LR_RESULT_GUID, LR_RESULT_VALUE, LR_UNIT_MEASURE, LR_TEST_LOW_LIMIT, LR_TEST_UP_LIMIT, LR_ABNORMALITY_CD, LISTAGG (TRIM(CAST(LTL_TEXT_RESULT AS VARCHAR(20000))), '') LTL_TEXT_RESULT FROM PTS JOIN IDB.LAB_RESULTS ON MRN = LR_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.LAB_TEXT_LINE ON LTL_RESULT_GUID = LR_RESULT_GUID LEFT JOIN IDB.LAB_CATALOG_ITEM ON LR_CTLG_ITEM_GUID = LCI_CTLG_ITEM_GUID LEFT JOIN IDB.LAB_LOINC_GENLAB ON LR_RESULT_GUID = LLG_RESULT_GUID WHERE LR_PERFORMED_DTE BETWEEN '2021-01-01' AND '2023-05-01' GROUP BY LR_MRN, LR_PERFORMED_DTE, LR_ACCESSION_NO, LR_TEST_NAME, LR_SUBTEST_NAME, LLG_LOINC_CD, LCI_ANCIL_NAME, LR_RESULT_GUID, LR_RESULT_VALUE, LR_UNIT_MEASURE, LR_TEST_LOW_LIMIT, LR_TEST_UP_LIMIT, LR_ABNORMALITY_CD) SELECT * FROM X ; WITH PTS AS (SELECT * FROM COTA.FL_PATIENTS_5_22_24), X AS (SELECT LR_MRN, LR_PERFORMED_DTE, LR_ACCESSION_NO, LR_TEST_NAME, LR_SUBTEST_NAME, LLG_LOINC_CD, LCI_ANCIL_NAME, LR_RESULT_GUID, LR_RESULT_VALUE, LR_UNIT_MEASURE, LR_TEST_LOW_LIMIT, LR_TEST_UP_LIMIT, LR_ABNORMALITY_CD, LISTAGG (TRIM(CAST(LTL_TEXT_RESULT AS VARCHAR(10000))), '') LTL_TEXT_RESULT FROM PTS JOIN IDB.LAB_RESULTS ON MRN = LR_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.LAB_TEXT_LINE ON LTL_RESULT_GUID = LR_RESULT_GUID LEFT JOIN IDB.LAB_CATALOG_ITEM ON LR_CTLG_ITEM_GUID = LCI_CTLG_ITEM_GUID LEFT JOIN IDB.LAB_LOINC_GENLAB ON LR_RESULT_GUID = LLG_RESULT_GUID WHERE LR_PERFORMED_DTE BETWEEN '2023-05-01' AND '2024-05-01' GROUP BY LR_MRN, LR_PERFORMED_DTE, LR_ACCESSION_NO, LR_TEST_NAME, LR_SUBTEST_NAME, LLG_LOINC_CD, LCI_ANCIL_NAME, LR_RESULT_GUID, LR_RESULT_VALUE, LR_UNIT_MEASURE, LR_TEST_LOW_LIMIT, LR_TEST_UP_LIMIT, LR_ABNORMALITY_CD) SELECT * FROM X

prompt: Provide weekly list of breast cancer patients who are on day 20-25 of radiation fraction therapy
completion: WITH CTE AS (SELECT CPE_MRN AS MRN, CPE_ENC_CSN_ID AS ID, CPE_APPT_DT AS VST_DT , CVT_EXT_NAME , CASE WHEN DOC_NAME='NO DOCTOR INFO AVAILABLE' THEN 'Unk' WHEN DOC_NAME='DOCTOR NAME NOT ENTERED' THEN 'Unk' WHEN DOC_NAME='UNKNOWN PHYSICIAN' THEN 'Unk' ELSE DOC_NAME END AS DOC , DOC_SVC REF_SVC , CLD_DEPT_NAME AS LOCATION , ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY CPE_MRN ORDER BY CPE_ENC_CSN_ID DESC) RN FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER INNER JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID=CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID INNER JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID=CLD_DEPT_ID INNER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CRE_RES_ID=CPE_VST_RES_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.DOC ON DOC_DR_NO=CPE_REF_RES_ID WHERE CVT_EXT_NAME IN ('Brachytherapy', 'Setup' ,'Treatment' ,'Stereotactic Radiosurgery') AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6='RDO' AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT date - 7 DAY AND CURRENT date AND (CPE_CPE_APPT_STS='Comp' OR CPE_CPE_APPT_STS='Arrived') AND CPE_CPE_IP_IND <> 'INPATIENT' AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 NOT LIKE '%EHS%' ) , DX AS (SELECT CC_MRN, CC_CLSF_CD DX_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK DX_DESC , CC_EFF_DTE FIRST_DX_DTE , ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY CC_MRN ORDER BY CC_EFF_DTE) RND FROM CTE JOIN IDB.CTC_CLSF ON MRN = CC_MRN JOIN IDB.CLM ON CLM_CLSF_CD = CC_CLSF_CD WHERE RN = 1 AND CC_CLSF_CD LIKE 'C50.%' AND ((CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y' AND CC_PT_TYPE = 'O') OR CC_PT_TYPE = 'I') AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'D%' ) SELECT DISTINCT RTC_TX_MRN MRN, STRIP(PT_LAST_NAME)||', '||PT_FIRST_NAME PT_NAME, DX_CD, DX_DESC, FIRST_DX_DTE, RTC_TX_COURSE_NO, RTC_TX_PLANSETUP_NO, RTC_TX_COURSE_ID, RTC_TX_PLAN_NAME, RTC_TX_START_DTE, VST_DT, DOC, REF_SVC, LOCATION VISIT_LOCATION, DAYS(DATE(VST_DT)) - DAYS(RTC_TX_START_DTE) DAYS_DIFFERENCE, RTC_TX_STOP_DTE, RTC_TX_ELAPSED_DAYS, RTC_PRIMARY_REF_POINT FROM IDB.RADONC_TREATMENT_COURSE JOIN IDB.PATIENT_V ON RTC_TX_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN CTE ON MRN = RTC_TX_MRN AND RN = 1 JOIN DX ON MRN = CC_MRN AND RND = 1 WHERE DATE(VST_DT) BETWEEN RTC_TX_START_DTE AND RTC_TX_STOP_DTE AND DAYS(DATE(VST_DT)) - DAYS(RTC_TX_START_DTE) BETWEEN 20 AND 25 ;

prompt: Provide a Darwin cohort of patients for the given criteria along with access to the patients in the Darwin Digital Platform.
completion: WITH PTS AS (SELECT PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID PID FROM DV.PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED) , DT_1 AS (SELECT PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID AS P_ID FROM DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS REC LEFT JOIN DV.PATIENT_CORE_DEMOGRAPHICS ON PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = CORE_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID WHERE 1=1 ) , DT_2 AS (SELECT PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID AS P_ID FROM DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS REC LEFT JOIN DV.PATIENT_CORE_DEMOGRAPHICS ON PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = CORE_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID WHERE 1=1 AND PT_VITAL_STATUS IN ('ALIVE') ) , DT_3 AS (SELECT INC.PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID P_ID FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_STRUCTURED_RESULTS_V INC WHERE 1=1 AND (INC.GENE IN ('MET') OR INC.GENE2 IN ('MET')) AND CASE WHEN LOCATE('heme', LOWER(INC.METHOD)) > 0 OR LOCATE('liquid', LOWER(INC.METHOD)) > 0 OR LOCATE('RDTB', INC.METHOD) >0 THEN 'liquid' ELSE 'solid' END IN ('solid') AND (INC.ABERRATIONTYPE IN ('amplification', 'copy number gain') OR CASE WHEN 'fusion' IN ('amplification', 'copy number gain') AND (UPPER(SEARCH_HIT2) like '%FUSION%' OR UPPER(SEARCH_HIT2) like '%TRANSLOCATION%' OR UPPER(SEARCH_HIT2) like '%REARRAN%' OR UPPER(SEARCH_HIT2) like '%INVERSION%') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END = 1) AND CASE WHEN INC.METHOD = 'IMPACT' THEN 'IMPACT' WHEN INC.METHOD like 'IMPACTv%' THEN 'IMPACT' WHEN INC.METHOD = 'ArcherHeme' THEN 'ArcherHeme' WHEN INC.METHOD like 'ArcherHemeV%' THEN 'ArcherHeme' WHEN LOWER(INC.METHOD) like LOWER('ArcherPanHemeV%') THEN 'ArcherPanHeme' WHEN INC.METHOD = 'Archer' THEN 'Archer' WHEN LOWER(INC.METHOD) like 'archerv%' THEN 'Archer' WHEN INC.METHOD like 'ACCESSv%' THEN 'ACCESS' WHEN INC.METHOD like 'IMPACTHv%' THEN 'IMPACTHeme' WHEN INC.METHOD like 'RDTB%' THEN 'RDTB' WHEN INC.METHOD like 'RDTS%' THEN 'RDTS' ELSE INC.METHOD END IN ('IMPACT') ) , DEID AS (SELECT DISTINCT P_ID FROM (SELECT P_ID FROM DT_1 INTERSECT SELECT P_ID FROM DT_2 INTERSECT SELECT P_ID FROM DT_3 ))

prompt: Provide an active patient list of Dr. Louise Ligresti's Basking Ridge-BSK Location
completion: WITH COMP AS (SELECT CPE_MRN AS "MRN", TRIM(PT_LAST_NAME) || ', ' || TRIM(PT_FIRST_NAME) PT_NAME, PT_ADDR1, PT_ADDR2, PT_CITY, PT_STATE, PT_ZIP_CD, PT_PHONE, CPE_ENC_DTE AS "Appt Date", CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 AS "Department", CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 AS "Service", CLD_DEPT_NAME AS "Department Name", CRE_RES_NAME AS "Provider Name", CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME AS "Visit Type", PLA_DONOT_MAIL_IND, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CPE_MRN ORDER BY CPE_APPT_DT DESC) AS ROW_NUM, CPE_CL_PT_ID FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY ON PLA_MRN = CPE_MRN JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PT_MRN = CPE_MRN WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND YEAR(CPE_ENC_DTE) > 2017 AND CRE_RES_NAME = 'LIGRESTI, LOUISE G E' AND CLD_CLD_CENTER = 'BSK' AND PT_DATE_OF_DEATH IS NULL ) , LAST_COMP AS (SELECT * FROM COMP WHERE ROW_NUM = 1 ) , SCH AS (SELECT CPE_MRN AS "MRN", TRIM(PT_LAST_NAME) || ', ' || TRIM(PT_FIRST_NAME) PT_NAME, PT_ADDR1, PT_ADDR2, PT_CITY, PT_STATE, PT_ZIP_CD, PT_PHONE, CPE_ENC_DTE AS "Appt Date", CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 AS "Department", CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 AS "Service", CLD_DEPT_NAME AS "Department Name", CRE_RES_NAME AS "Provider Name", CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME AS "Visit Type", PLA_DONOT_MAIL_IND, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CPE_MRN ORDER BY CPE_APPT_DT ASC) AS ROW_NUM, CPE_CL_PT_ID FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY ON PLA_MRN = CPE_MRN JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PT_MRN = CPE_MRN WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS = 'Sch' AND CRE_RES_NAME = 'LIGRESTI, LOUISE G E' AND CLD_CLD_CENTER = 'BSK' AND PT_DATE_OF_DEATH IS NULL ) , NEXT_SCHED AS (SELECT * FROM SCH WHERE ROW_NUM = 1 ) , COMBINED AS (SELECT DISTINCT COALESCE(A.MRN, B.MRN) AS MRN, COALESCE(A.PT_NAME, B.PT_NAME) AS "Patient Name", COALESCE(A.PT_ADDR1, B.PT_ADDR1) AS "Address 1", COALESCE(A.PT_ADDR2, B.PT_ADDR2) AS "Address 2", COALESCE(A.PT_CITY, B.PT_CITY) AS "City", COALESCE(A.PT_STATE, B.PT_STATE) AS "State", COALESCE(A.PT_ZIP_CD, B.PT_ZIP_CD) AS "Zip", COALESCE(A.PT_PHONE, B.PT_PHONE) AS "Phone", A."Appt Date" AS "Last Appt Date", A."Visit Type" AS "Last Appt Visit Type", B."Appt Date" AS "Next Appt Date", B."Visit Type" AS "Next Appt Visit Type", COALESCE(A.PLA_DONOT_MAIL_IND, B.PLA_DONOT_MAIL_IND) "Do Not Mail" FROM LAST_COMP A FULL JOIN NEXT_SCHED B ON A.MRN = B.MRN) , PBD AS (SELECT DISTINCT PBD_MRN, PBD_SVC_DTE, TRIM(DX_CLSF_CD) DX_CLSF_CD, TRIM(CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK) CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK FROM COMBINED JOIN IDB.PBD_DTL ON PBD_MRN = MRN AND PBD_SVC_DTE = "Last Appt Date" JOIN IDB.PBD_INVOICE ON PBD_INV_NO = PBI_INV_NO JOIN IDB.DOC ON PBI_PERFORM_DR_NO = DOC_DR_NO JOIN IDB.PBD_DX ON DX_MRN = PBD_MRN AND DX_INV_NO = PBD_INV_NO JOIN IDB.CLM ON DX_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE DOC_NAME = 'LIGRESTI MD,LOUISE G E' AND DX_CLSF_PRIO = 1 ) , SRG AS (SELECT SSE_MRN, MAX(SSE_SURG_DTE) LAST_SURGERY, SSP_SURG_SVC_CD FROM IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE ON SSE_LOG_ID = SSP_LOG_ID AND SSE_ENC_CSN_ID = SSP_ENC_CSN_ID JOIN COMBINED ON SSE_MRN = MRN WHERE SSP_SURG_SVC_CD IN ('BRE', 'GYN') GROUP BY SSE_MRN, SSP_SURG_SVC_CD) , LAST_CHEMO AS (SELECT APR_MRN, MAX(APR_START_DTE) LAST_CHEMO FROM IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX WHERE APR_MRN IN (SELECT DISTINCT MRN FROM COMBINED) GROUP BY APR_MRN) , NEXT_CHEMO AS (SELECT CPE_MRN, MIN(CPE_ENC_DTE) AS NEXT_CHEMO_APPT FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS = 'Sch' AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 = 'CHM' AND CPE_MRN IN (SELECT MRN FROM COMBINED) GROUP BY CPE_MRN) SELECT COMBINED.*, LAST_CHEMO "Last Chemo", NEXT_CHEMO_APPT "Next Chemo Appt", DX_CLSF_CD "ICD10 Code", CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK "ICD Description", LAST_SURGERY "Last Surgery", SSP_SURG_SVC_CD "Surgery Service" FROM COMBINED LEFT JOIN LAST_CHEMO ON MRN = APR_MRN LEFT JOIN NEXT_CHEMO ON MRN = CPE_MRN LEFT JOIN PBD ON MRN = PBD_MRN LEFT JOIN SRG ON MRN = SSE_MRN

prompt: Provide a list of lymphoma patients with upcoming appointments eligible to be transitioned to community
completion: WITH APPTS AS (SELECT CPE_MRN, CPE_ENC_DTE, CLD_DEPT_NAME, CRE_RES_NAME, CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR, CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.CRDB_BMT_MEDICINE ON CPE_MRN = CBM_MRN WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Sch') AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT date + 7 DAYS AND CURRENT date + 14 DAYS AND CLD_DEPT_NAME IN ('LYM 205 E64-LC SVRSHP', 'LYMPHOMA 205E64-LC APP', 'LYM KOCH-14 SVR') AND CBM_MRN IS NULL AND CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR not like '%IR%' ) , DX AS (SELECT TM_MRN, CPE_ENC_DTE, CLD_DEPT_NAME, CRE_RES_NAME, CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR, CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME, TM_DX_DTE, CATEGORY2, TM_SITE_CD AS SITE_CODE, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_DESC, TM_HIST_CD AS HIST_CODE, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS HIST_DESC FROM APPTS JOIN IDB.CDB_TUMOR ON CPE_MRN = TM_MRN JOIN IDB.CLM H ON TM_HIST_CD = H.CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON TM_SITE_CD = S.CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.SEERGROUPING ON IDB.SEERF_ICDO(TM_SITE_CD, TM_HIST_CD) = RECODE WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND CATEGORY1 = 'Lymphoma' AND TM_DX_DTE <= CPE_ENC_DTE - 60 MONTHS ) , DOX AS (SELECT DISTINCT APR_MRN FROM DX JOIN IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX_V ON TM_MRN = APR_MRN JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON TM_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME = 'DOXORUBICIN' AND CATEGORY2 = 'Hodgkin Lymphoma' AND YEAR(APR_START_DTE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) < 36 UNION SELECT DISTINCT APR_MRN FROM DX JOIN IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX_V ON TM_MRN = APR_MRN WHERE CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME = 'DOXORUBICIN' AND HIST_CODE IN ('M9687/3', 'M9680/3') ) , RT AS (SELECT DISTINCT RTC_TX_MRN FROM DX JOIN IDB.RADONC_TREATMENT_COURSE ON TM_MRN = RTC_TX_MRN JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON TM_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE CATEGORY2 = 'Hodgkin Lymphoma' AND YEAR(RTC_TX_START_DTE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) < 36 AND (UPPER(RTC_TX_PLAN_NAME) like '%MEDIA%' OR UPPER(RTC_PRIMARY_REF_POINT) like '%MEDIA%') UNION SELECT DISTINCT RTC_TX_MRN FROM DX JOIN IDB.RADONC_TREATMENT_COURSE ON TM_MRN = RTC_TX_MRN WHERE HIST_CODE IN ('M9687/3', 'M9680/3') AND (UPPER(RTC_TX_PLAN_NAME) like '%MEDIA%' OR UPPER(RTC_PRIMARY_REF_POINT) like '%MEDIA%') ) SELECT TM_MRN MRN, PT_LAST_NAME "Last Name", PT_FIRST_NAME "First Name", CPE_ENC_DTE "Appt Date", PLA_LST_CHEMO_DTE "Last Chemo Date", HIST_DESC "Tumor Histology" FROM DX LEFT JOIN DOX ON TM_MRN = APR_MRN LEFT JOIN RT ON TM_MRN = RTC_TX_MRN JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY ON TM_MRN = PLA_MRN JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON TM_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE NOT (APR_MRN IS NOT NULL AND RTC_TX_MRN IS NOT NULL) ;

prompt: list of patients with MGUS diagnosis seen at MSKCC
completion: WITH DIAGNOSIS_0 AS (SELECT "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AS PT_DEID, BASE_QUERY.PT_MRN AS PT_MRN, CAST(TRIM(BASE_QUERY.PT_MRN) AS VARCHAR) || CAST(TRIM(BASE_QUERY.DIAGNOSIS_DATE) AS VARCHAR) || CAST(TRIM(BASE_QUERY.ICD_CODES_ICD_CODE) AS VARCHAR) AS SUBJECT_ID, TRIM(BASE_QUERY.ICD_CODES_ICD_CODE) || '-' || TRIM("IDB"."CLM"."CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK") AS ICD_CODES_ICD_CODE_DESC FROM (SELECT "IDB"."CTC_CLSF"."CC_MRN" AS PT_MRN, "IDB"."CTC_CLSF"."CC_CLSF_CD" AS ICD_CODES_ICD_CODE, MIN("IDB"."CTC_CLSF"."CC_EFF_DTE") AS DIAGNOSIS_DATE FROM "IDB"."CTC_CLSF" WHERE "IDB"."CTC_CLSF"."CC_CLSF_TYPE" LIKE 'DF%' AND ("IDB"."CTC_CLSF"."CC_PT_TYPE" = 'I' OR ("IDB"."CTC_CLSF"."CC_PT_TYPE" = 'O' AND "IDB"."CTC_CLSF"."CC_FINALIZED_IND" = 'Y')) GROUP BY "IDB"."CTC_CLSF"."CC_MRN", "IDB"."CTC_CLSF"."CC_CLSF_CD") AS BASE_QUERY JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS" ON BASE_QUERY.PT_MRN = "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_MRN" JOIN "IDB"."CLM" ON BASE_QUERY.ICD_CODES_ICD_CODE = "IDB"."CLM"."CLM_CLSF_CD" WHERE BASE_QUERY.ICD_CODES_ICD_CODE IN ('273.1', 'D47.2')), DIAGNOSIS_TR_1 AS (SELECT "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AS PT_DEID, "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_MRN" AS PT_MRN, CAST(TRIM("IDB"."CDB_TUMOR"."TM_MRN") AS VARCHAR) || CAST(TRIM("IDB"."CDB_TUMOR"."TM_TUMOR_SEQ") AS VARCHAR) || CAST(TRIM("IDB"."CDB_TUMOR"."TM_DX_DTE") AS VARCHAR) AS SUBJECT_ID, "IDB"."ALLOWVALS"."AV_DESC" AS DX_TR_CASE_STATUS, TRIM("IDB"."CDB_TUMOR"."TM_SITE_CD") || ' - ' || TRIM(CLM_SITE."CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK") AS DX_TR_SITE FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS" JOIN "IDB"."CDB_TUMOR" ON "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_MRN" = "IDB"."CDB_TUMOR"."TM_MRN" JOIN "IDB"."ALLOWVALS" ON "IDB"."ALLOWVALS"."AV_CODE" = "IDB"."CDB_TUMOR"."TM_CASE_STS" AND "IDB"."ALLOWVALS"."AV_ELEMENT" = 'CASE_STS' JOIN "IDB"."CLM" AS CLM_SITE ON CLM_SITE."CLM_CLSF_CD" = "IDB"."CDB_TUMOR"."TM_SITE_CD" WHERE "IDB"."ALLOWVALS"."AV_DESC" IN ('COMPLETED', 'CONSULT ONLY', 'INCOMPLETE', 'NON-INDEX', 'PATHOLOGY ONLY') AND "IDB"."CDB_TUMOR"."TM_SITE_CD" IN ('C421')), COHORT AS (SELECT PT_DEID AS PT_DEID FROM (SELECT DIAGNOSIS_0.PT_DEID AS PT_DEID FROM DIAGNOSIS_0 INTERSECT SELECT DIAGNOSIS_TR_1.PT_DEID AS PT_DEID FROM DIAGNOSIS_TR_1)), COHORT_DIAGNOSIS AS (SELECT SUBJECT_ID AS SUBJECT_ID, PT_DEID AS PT_DEID FROM (SELECT DIAGNOSIS_0.SUBJECT_ID AS SUBJECT_ID, DIAGNOSIS_0.PT_DEID AS PT_DEID FROM DIAGNOSIS_0)), COHORT_DIAGNOSIS_TR AS (SELECT SUBJECT_ID AS SUBJECT_ID, PT_DEID AS PT_DEID FROM (SELECT DIAGNOSIS_TR_1.SUBJECT_ID AS SUBJECT_ID, DIAGNOSIS_TR_1.PT_DEID AS PT_DEID FROM DIAGNOSIS_TR_1)), KEYS AS (SELECT COHORT.PT_DEID AS COHORT_PT_DEID, COHORT_DIAGNOSIS.SUBJECT_ID AS COHORT_DIAGNOSIS_SUBJECT_ID, COHORT_DIAGNOSIS.PT_DEID AS COHORT_DIAGNOSIS_PT_DEID, COHORT_DIAGNOSIS_TR.SUBJECT_ID AS COHORT_DIAGNOSIS_TR_SUBJECT_ID, COHORT_DIAGNOSIS_TR.PT_DEID AS COHORT_DIAGNOSIS_TR_PT_DEID FROM COHORT LEFT OUTER JOIN COHORT_DIAGNOSIS ON COHORT_DIAGNOSIS.PT_DEID = COHORT.PT_DEID LEFT OUTER JOIN COHORT_DIAGNOSIS_TR ON COHORT_DIAGNOSIS_TR.PT_DEID = COHORT.PT_DEID), DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS AS (SELECT DISTINCT "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AS PT_DEID, IDB_PATIENT."PT_MRN" AS PT_MRN, "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AS SUBJECT_ID, DMP_ID_TBL."PDRX_DMP_PATIENT_ID" AS DMP_ID, TRIM(IDB_PATIENT."PT_LAST_NAME") || ', ' || TRIM(IDB_PATIENT."PT_FIRST_NAME") AS PT_NAME, ALLOWVALS_SEX."AV_DESC" AS SEX, CASE WHEN (IDB_PATIENT."PT_DATE_OF_DEATH" IS NULL) THEN 'Alive' ELSE 'Deceased' END AS VITAL_STATS, IDB_PATIENT."PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH" AS DATE_OF_BIRTH, IDB_PATIENT."PT_DATE_OF_DEATH" AS DATE_OF_DEATH, ALLOWVALS_RACE."AV_DESC" AS RACE, ALLOWVALS_ETHNICITY."AV_DESC" AS ETHNICITY, ALLOWVALS_LANGUAGE."AV_DESC" AS PRIMARY_LANGUAGE, LAST_ACTIVITY_DATE."PLA_LST_ACTV_DTE" AS LAST_ACTIVITY_DATE, LAST_CONTACT_DATE."PLA_LST_CON_DTE" AS LAST_CONTACT_DATE FROM "IDB"."PATIENT" AS IDB_PATIENT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS" ON IDB_PATIENT."PT_MRN" = "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_MRN" LEFT OUTER JOIN "DV"."PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML" AS DMP_ID_TBL ON DMP_ID_TBL."PDRX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT OUTER JOIN "IDB"."ALLOWVALS" AS ALLOWVALS_SEX ON IDB_PATIENT."PT_SEX" = ALLOWVALS_SEX."AV_CODE" AND ALLOWVALS_SEX."AV_ELEMENT" = 'SEX' LEFT OUTER JOIN "IDB"."ALLOWVALS" AS ALLOWVALS_RACE ON IDB_PATIENT."PT_RACE" = ALLOWVALS_RACE."AV_CODE" AND ALLOWVALS_RACE."AV_ELEMENT" = 'RACE' LEFT OUTER JOIN "IDB"."ALLOWVALS" AS ALLOWVALS_ETHNICITY ON IDB_PATIENT."PT_PT_ETHNICITY" = ALLOWVALS_ETHNICITY."AV_CODE" AND ALLOWVALS_ETHNICITY."AV_ELEMENT" = 'PT_ETHNICITY' LEFT OUTER JOIN "IDB"."ALLOWVALS" AS ALLOWVALS_LANGUAGE ON IDB_PATIENT."PT_PRIMARY_LANG" = ALLOWVALS_LANGUAGE."AV_CODE" AND ALLOWVALS_LANGUAGE."AV_ELEMENT" = 'PRIMARY_LANG' LEFT OUTER JOIN "IDB".PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY AS LAST_ACTIVITY_DATE ON IDB_PATIENT."PT_MRN" = LAST_ACTIVITY_DATE."PLA_MRN" LEFT OUTER JOIN "IDB".PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY AS LAST_CONTACT_DATE ON IDB_PATIENT."PT_MRN" = LAST_CONTACT_DATE."PLA_MRN") SELECT DISTINCT DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS.PT_MRN AS MRN, DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS.DMP_ID AS DMP_ID, DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS.PT_NAME AS PT_NAME, DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS.SEX AS SEX, DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS.VITAL_STATS AS VITAL_STATUS, DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS.DATE_OF_BIRTH AS DATE_OF_BIRTH, DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS.DATE_OF_DEATH AS DATE_OF_DEATH, DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS.RACE AS RACE, DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS.ETHNICITY AS ETHNICITY, DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS.PRIMARY_LANGUAGE AS PRIMARY_LANGUAGE, DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS.LAST_ACTIVITY_DATE AS LAST_ACTIVITY_DATE, DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS.LAST_CONTACT_DATE AS LAST_CONTACT_DATE FROM KEYS LEFT OUTER JOIN DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS ON DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS.PT_DEID = KEYS.COHORT_PT_DEID;

prompt: Provide pathology and demographic data for patients with specific search terms within report text since 1/1/2016.
completion: SELECT DISTINCT DMP.PRPT_MRN AS MRN , PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_BIRTH_DTE, PT_VITAL_STATUS, PT_DEATH_DTE , CASE WHEN PT_DEATH_DTE IS NULL THEN YEAR(CURRENT date - PT_BIRTH_DTE) END AS "Current Age" , PDRX_DMP_PATIENT_ID , DMP.PRPT_ACCESSION_NO AS "Accession No" , DMP.PRPT_REPORT_DTE AS "Report Date" , DMP.PRPT_PROCEDURE_DTE AS "Procedure Date" , DMP.PRPT_REPORT_TYPE_DESC AS "Report Type" , DMP.PRPT_REPORT_TYPE , DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)diag[\w\W]*(?=I ATTEST)', DMP.PRPT_REPORT) AS DIAGNOSIS_TEXT , VARCHAR(DMP.PRPT_REPORT, 32000) AS "Report Text (first 32000 characters)" , SRG.PRPT_ACCESSION_NO AS RELATED_ACC_NO , SRG_DATE.DT_DTE AS RELATED_PROC_DTE , (SELECT VARCHAR(PRPT_REPORT, 32000) AS REFERENCEDPATHTEXTFROM FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT WHERE PRPT_ACCESSION_NO = SRG.PRPT_ACCESSION_NO) AS REFERENCEDPATHTEXT FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V DMP LEFT JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML ON PDRX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = DMP.PRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID LEFT JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_REFERENCES ON PRPTR_CHILD_PATH_RPT_ID = DMP.PRPT_PATH_RPT_ID LEFT JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT SRG ON SRG.PRPT_PATH_RPT_ID = PRPTR_PATH_RPT_ID LEFT JOIN DV.DATE_V SRG_DATE ON SRG_DATE.DT_DATE_ID = SRG.PRPT_PROCEDURE_DATE_ID JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = DMP.PRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID WHERE 1=1 AND (DMP.PRPT_ACCESSION_NO like 'H%' OR DMP.PRPT_ACCESSION_NO like 'S%') AND (DMP.PRPT_REPORT_DTE >= '01/01/2016' OR DMP.PRPT_PROCEDURE_DTE >= '01/01/2016') AND CONTAINS(DMP.PRPT_REPORT, '("peripheral T-cell lymphoma" OR "peripheral T cell lymphoma" OR "PTCL")') = 1 AND DMP.PRPT_REPORT IS NOT NULL ORDER BY 1, 9, 8 ;

prompt: Provide an On-Demand Report containing Health Insurance data and patient zip code for a user specified MRN
completion: SELECT DISTINCT PATIENT_MRN, TRIM(BP_MENOP_STS_DESC) MENOPAUSE_STATUS, PT_ZIP_CD , CASE WHEN (V.FSC_NAME IS NULL OR V.FSC_NAME = '') THEN 'UNINSURED' WHEN (UPPER(V.FSC_NAME) LIKE '%MEDICARE%') THEN 'MEDICARE' WHEN (UPPER(V.FSC_NAME) LIKE '%MEDICAID%') THEN 'MEDICAID' ELSE 'PRIVATE' END AS INSURANCE_STATUS, V.FSC_NAME INSURANCE_NAME FROM IDB.PERIOP_CASE_EVENT_V JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PT_MRN = PATIENT_MRN JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE ON LOG_NUMBER = SSP_LOG_ID AND SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD IN ('19301', '19302', '19303', '19304', '19307', '38500', '38525', '38530', '38740', '38745') LEFT JOIN IDB.PATIENT_INSURANCE_V V ON V.MRN = PATIENT_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.BR_PRIMARY ON BP_MRN = PATIENT_MRN WHERE CASE_STATUS = 'Completed' AND CASE_SURGERY_DTE >= '2000-01-01'

prompt: Weekly list of BMT patients on ganciclovir, valganciclovir, or foscarnet
completion: WITH CTE AS (SELECT PT_MRN AS MRN, PINC_GENERIC_NAME AS DRUG_NAME, MAX(START_DTE.DT_DTE) AS LAST_ORDER FROM DV.PHM_ORDER_DTL DTL JOIN DV.PHM_INVENTORY_CATALOG CAT ON DTL.POD_PHARMA_INVENTORY_CTLG_ID = PINC_INVENTORY_CTLG_ID JOIN DV.DATE_V START_DTE ON DTL.POD_START_DATE_ID = START_DTE.DT_DATE_ID LEFT JOIN DV.DATE_V STOP_DTE ON DTL.POD_STOP_DATE_ID = STOP_DTE.DT_DATE_ID JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = POD_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID WHERE (UPPER(CAT.PINC_GENERIC_NAME) LIKE '%GANCICLOVIR%' OR UPPER(CAT.PINC_GENERIC_NAME) LIKE '%FOSCARNET%') AND PT_DEATH_DTE IS NULL AND YEAR(CURRENT DATE - PT_BIRTH_DTE) >= 12 GROUP BY PT_MRN, PINC_GENERIC_NAME UNION ALL SELECT OO_MRN AS MRN, OO_ORD_NAME AS DRUG_NAME, MAX(OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE) AS LAST_ORDER FROM IDB.OMS_ORDER JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_CATALOG ON OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID = OOC_MSTR_ITEM_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_MED_DETAIL ON OMD_ORD_GUID = OO_ORD_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_STATUS ON OO_ORD_STS_CD = OSTS_ORD_STS_CD JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON OO_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE OO_ORD_STS_CD NOT IN ('CANC', 'CANP', 'AUC3') AND (UPPER(OOC_ITEM_NAME) LIKE '%GANCICLOVIR%' OR UPPER(OOC_ITEM_NAME) LIKE '%FOSCARNET%') AND PT_DATE_OF_DEATH IS NULL AND YEAR(CURRENT DATE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) >= 12 GROUP BY OO_MRN, OO_ORD_NAME UNION ALL SELECT HCPR_MRN AS MRN, HGN_GENERIC_NAME AS DRUG_NAME, MAX(DATE(COALESCE(HCPR_START_DT, HCPR_CREATED_DT))) AS LAST_ORDER FROM IDB.HML_CLIENT_PRESCRIPTION JOIN IDB.HML_GENERIC_NAME ON HGN_GENERIC_NAME_ID = HCPR_GENERIC_NAME_ID JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON HCPR_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE (UPPER(HGN_GENERIC_NAME) LIKE '%GANCICLOVIR%' OR UPPER(HGN_GENERIC_NAME) LIKE '%FOSCARNET%') AND PT_DATE_OF_DEATH IS NULL AND YEAR(CURRENT DATE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) >= 12 GROUP BY HCPR_MRN, HGN_GENERIC_NAME ) , BMT AS (SELECT DISTINCT CBM_MRN, MIN(CBM_TRANSPLANT_DTE) FIRST_TRANSPLANT FROM IDB.CRDB_BMT_MEDICINE WHERE CBM_TRANSPLANT_TYPE = 'ALLO' GROUP BY CBM_MRN UNION ALL SELECT DISTINCT CBP_MRN CBM_MRN, MIN(CBP_TRANSPLANT_DTE) FIRST_TRANSPLANT FROM IDB.CRDB_BMT_PEDIATRICS WHERE CBP_TRANSPLANT_TYPE = 'ALLO' GROUP BY CBP_MRN ) , BMT_PROC AS (SELECT DISTINCT CBM_MRN, MIN(FIRST_TRANSPLANT) FIRST_TRANSPLANT FROM BMT GROUP BY CBM_MRN) SELECT DISTINCT MRN "MRN", PT_LAST_NAME "Last Name", PT_FIRST_NAME "First Name", PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH "Date of Birth", YEAR(FIRST_TRANSPLANT - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) "Age at Transplant", DRUG_NAME "Drug", MAX(LAST_ORDER) "Latest Drug Order", FIRST_TRANSPLANT "First Transplant Date" FROM CTE JOIN BMT_PROC ON MRN = CBM_MRN JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON MRN = PT_MRN WHERE YEAR(FIRST_TRANSPLANT - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) >= 12 AND PT_DATE_OF_DEATH IS NULL GROUP BY MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, YEAR(FIRST_TRANSPLANT - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH), DRUG_NAME, FIRST_TRANSPLANT HAVING YEAR(MAX(LAST_ORDER)) >= 2019

prompt: Toxicity Grading and outcome data for patients accrued to 13-198
completion: WITH IRB AS (SELECT AC_MRN, AC_CONS_DTE FROM IDB.ACCRUALS WHERE AC_IRB_NO = '13-198' ) SELECT CDD_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, CDD_SERVICE_DTE, CDD_DOC_NAME, CDO_ITEM_NAME, CDO_VALUE_TEXT FROM IRB JOIN IDB.CD_DOCUMENT ON AC_MRN = CDD_MRN JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION ON CDD_MRN = CDO_MRN AND CDD_DOC_GUID = CDO_DOC_GUID AND CDD_AUTHORED_DTE = CDO_AUTHORED_DTE JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON AC_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE CDD_DOC_NAME = 'Toxicity Grading' AND CDD_CANCEL_IND <> '1' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND <> '1' AND CDD_SERVICE_DTE >= AC_CONS_DTE ; WITH IRB AS (SELECT AC_MRN, AC_CONS_DTE FROM IDB.ACCRUALS WHERE AC_IRB_NO = '13-198' ) , PTS AS (SELECT DISTINCT CDD_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, CDD_SERVICE_DTE, CDD_DOC_NAME, CDO_SECTION, CDO_CTLG_DISPL_NM, CDO_ITEM_NAME, CDO_VALUE_TEXT, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CDD_MRN ORDER BY CDD_SERVICE_DTE DESC) RN FROM IRB JOIN IDB.CD_DOCUMENT ON AC_MRN = CDD_MRN JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION ON CDO_DOC_GUID = CDD_DOC_GUID AND CDO_AUTHORED_DTE = CDD_AUTHORED_DTE JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON AC_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE CDD_CANCEL_IND <> '1' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND <> '1' AND (CDO_MSTR_ITEM_NM = 'Smoking Status RES' OR CDO_MSTR_ITEM_NM = 'D_UCC_Tobacco use' OR CDO_MSTR_ITEM_NM = 'D_UCC_Tobacco products') ) SELECT * FROM PTS WHERE RN = 1 ; WITH IRB AS (SELECT AC_MRN FROM IDB.ACCRUALS WHERE AC_IRB_NO = '13-198' ) SELECT P.PT_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, RESPONSE_DATE, RESPONSE_DSCRP FROM IRB JOIN NN.OUTCOME O ON AC_MRN = O.PT_MRN AND PRT_ID = '13-198' JOIN IDB.PATIENT P ON AC_MRN = P.PT_MRN ; WITH IRB AS (SELECT AC_MRN FROM IDB.ACCRUALS WHERE AC_IRB_NO = '13-198' ) SELECT DISTINCT "t1"."PT_MRN" AS "MRN", PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, "t2"."PINC_GENERIC_NAME" AS "Generic Drug Name", "t3"."DT_DTE" AS "Last Order Stop Date" FROM IRB JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V" "t1" ON AC_MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED" "t4" ON "t1"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t4"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PHM_PT_MEDS_MQT" "t5" ON "t4"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t5"."POD_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PHM_ORDER_DTL" "t6" ON "t5"."POD_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t6"."POD_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AND "t5"."POD_PHARMA_INVENTORY_CTLG_ID" = "t6"."POD_PHARMA_INVENTORY_CTLG_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PHM_INVENTORY_CATALOG" "t2" ON "t6"."POD_PHARMA_INVENTORY_CTLG_ID" = "t2"."PINC_INVENTORY_CTLG_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" "t3" ON "t5"."LAST_STOP_DATE_ID" = "t3"."DT_DATE_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_IDENTIFICATION_MRN_V" "t7" ON "t1"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t7"."PI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" WHERE "t2"."PINC_GENERIC_NAME" ='MEDI4736'

prompt: provide a monthly report of Commack Completed chemo appointments with referring provider and patients last chemo location
completion: WITH ETO AS (SELECT CPE_MRN MRN, STRIP(PT_LAST_NAME)||', '||STRIP(PT_FIRST_NAME) PT_NAME, PT_ZIP_CD ZIPCD, PT_COUNTY COUNTY, CPE_ENC_DTE VST_DATE, VD.CLD_DEPT_NAME DEPT_NAME, VD.CLD_CLD_CENTER CLD_CENTER, VD.CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_20 CLINIC, VD.CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 SERVICE, CPE_APPT_DT APPT_DT , VT.CRE_RES_NAME VST_MD, REF.CRE_RES_NAME REF_MD, CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME VST_NAME , CVT_EXT_NAME VST_TYPE FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.PATIENT_V ON CPE_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID = CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID AND CVT_EXT_NAME = 'Treatment' AND CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR LIKE 'Tx%' JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT VD ON CPE_DEPT_ID = VD.CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE VT ON VT.CRE_RES_ID = CPE_VST_RES_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE REF ON REF.CRE_RES_ID = CPE_REF_RES_ID AND REF.CRE_RES_TYP IN ('Physician', 'Dentist', 'Psychologist', 'PhD', 'Nurse Practitioner', 'Physician Assistant', 'Advanced Practice Nurse') LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_PT_APPT ON CPE_CL_PT_ID = CPA_CL_PT_ID AND CPE_ENC_DTE_SEQ = CPA_ENC_DTE_SEQ AND CPA_LINE_NO = 2 LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT SD ON CPA_DEPT_ID = SD.CLD_DEPT_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE SR ON SR.CRE_RES_ID = CPE_VST_RES_ID WHERE (CPE_ENC_DTE>='2019-11-01' AND CPE_ENC_DTE <= '2020-03-01') AND CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Comp', 'Arrived') AND CPE_ENC_TYP_CD = 50 AND VD.CLD_DEPT_NAME IN ('CMK CHEMO', 'COMMACK INJECTION') ) , PRI_VST AS (SELECT CPE_MRN, VST_DATE CURR_VST, CPE_ENC_DTE PRIO_VST_DATE, VD.CLD_DEPT_NAME PRIO_DEPT_NAME , VD.CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_20 PRI_CLINIC, VD.CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 PRI_SERVICE, CPE_APPT_DT PRI_APPT_DT , ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY MRN, VST_DATE ORDER BY CPE_APPT_DT DESC) RN FROM ETO JOIN IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER ON CPE_MRN = MRN JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID = CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID AND CVT_EXT_NAME = 'Treatment' AND CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR LIKE 'Tx%' JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT VD ON CPE_DEPT_ID = VD.CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE VT ON VT.CRE_RES_ID = CPE_VST_RES_ID AND CRE_RES_NAME like '%CHEMO%' JOIN IDB.CL_PT_CHEMO ON CPE_MRN=CPC_MRN AND CPE_ENC_DTE_SEQ=CPC_ENC_DTE_SEQ JOIN IDB.CL_CHEMO ON CPC_CHEMO_ID=CCH_CHEMO_ID WHERE CPE_ENC_DTE < VST_DATE AND CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Comp', 'Arrived') AND CPE_ENC_TYP_CD = 50 ) SELECT MRN, PT_NAME, ZIPCD, COUNTY, VST_DATE, DEPT_NAME, REF_MD, VST_NAME, PRIO_VST_DATE, PRIO_DEPT_NAME FROM ETO LEFT JOIN PRI_VST ON MRN = CPE_MRN AND VST_DATE = CURR_VST AND RN = 1 ORDER BY MRN, VST_DATE ;

prompt: Would like to request corresponding MRNs for the following MSK-IMPACT patient IDs to be able to correlate IMPACT data with clinical data from our MSKCC sarcoma database
Patients with mucinous breast carcinoma
completion: SELECT PT_MRN AS MRN, PT_LAST_NAME "Last Name", PT_FIRST_NAME "First Name", PT_BIRTH_DTE "Date of Birth", PT_DEATH_DTE "Date of Death", PLA_LAST_APPT_DTE "Last Appt Date", YEAR(P.DT_DTE-PT_BIRTH_DTE) "Age at Procedure", P.DT_DTE AS "Procedure Date", PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_DESC "Path Report Type", PRPT_ACCESSION_NO AS "Accession No", PRPT_REPORT AS "Report Text" FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT JOIN DV.DATE P ON P.DT_DATE_ID = PRPT_PROCEDURE_DATE_ID JOIN DV.DATE R ON R.DT_DATE_ID = PRPT_REPORT_DATE_ID JOIN DV.PATH_RPRT_TYPE_LOOKUP ON PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_CD = PRPT_REPORT_TYPE JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON PRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID JOIN DV.PATIENT_LATEST_ACTIVITY ON PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PLA_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID WHERE PRPT_REPORT IS NOT NULL AND CONTAINS("PRPT_REPORT", '("breast" & "carcinoma" & "mucinous" & "invasive")') = 1

prompt: Provide a list of all small cell lung cancer patients since 2014 with CSF(cerebrospinal fluid) information.
completion: WITH PTS AS (SELECT DISTINCT PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID P_ID, PT_MRN, PRIMARY_SITE, TUMOR_TYPE_NAME, PDRX_DMP_PATIENT_ID, DTPROCPATHRPT.DT_DTE AS PROCEDUREDATE_PATHCLIN FROM DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS PT JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML DT ON PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PDRX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID INNER JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT ON PDRX_PATH_RPT_ID = PRPT_PATH_RPT_ID LEFT JOIN DV.DATE DTPROCPATHRPT ON PRPT_PROCEDURE_DATE_ID = DTPROCPATHRPT.DT_DATE_ID CROSS JOIN XMLTABLE('$c/root/*' PASSING DT.PDRX_XML_VALUE AS "c" COLUMNS PRIMARY_SITE VARCHAR(264) PATH '../meta-data/primary_site' , TUMOR_TYPE_NAME VARCHAR(264) PATH '../meta-data/tumor_type_name') T WHERE LOWER(PRIMARY_SITE) IN ('lung') AND (LOWER(TUMOR_TYPE_NAME) like '%small%' AND LOWER(TUMOR_TYPE_NAME) not like '%non-small%' AND LOWER(TUMOR_TYPE_NAME) not like '%non small%') AND DT_DTE >= '2014-01-01' ) , PRE_DX AS (SELECT PT_MRN, DT_DTE, DXCC_ICD_CODE, DXCC_ICD_MSK_DESC, ICSC_SITE_CD, ICSC_ICDO_SITE_MSK_DESC, TCA_CASE_STS_DESC FROM DV.CDB_TUMOR_V JOIN DV.DATE_V ON CDTM_DX_DATE_ID = DT_DATE_ID JOIN DV.DIAGNOSIS_CODE_CAT_ICDO_V ON CDTM_DX_CATALOG_ID = DXCC_DX_CATALOG_ID JOIN DV.ICDO_SITE_CATALOG_V ON CDTM_SITE_CATALOG_ID = ICSC_SITE_CATALOG_ID JOIN DV.TUMOR_CASE_ATTRIBUTES_V ON CDTM_CASE_ATTR_ID = TUMOR_CASE_ATTR_ID JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON CDTM_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID WHERE ICSC_SITE_CD like 'C34%' AND DT_DTE >= '2014-01-01' AND DXCC_ICD_CODE IN ('M8002/3', 'M8041/2', 'M8041/3', 'M8042/3', 'M8043/3', 'M8044/3', 'M8045/3', 'M8073/3', 'M8803/3') ) , DX AS (SELECT COALESCE(B.PDRX_DMP_PATIENT_ID, NULL) AS DMPID, A.PT_MRN AS PT_MRN FROM PRE_DX A LEFT JOIN PTS B ON A.PT_MRN = B.PT_MRN UNION SELECT PDRX_DMP_PATIENT_ID AS DMPID, PT_MRN AS PT_MRN FROM PTS) , MRI_BRAIN AS (SELECT DISTINCT RRPT_MRN , MIN(RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE) PERFORMED_DTE FROM DV.RADIOLOGY_REPORT_V JOIN DX ON PT_MRN = RRPT_MRN WHERE RRPT_ORDER_GROUP IN ('MR', 'MR RO') AND (LOWER(RRPT_PROCEDURE_NAME) like '%brain%' OR LOWER(RRPT_PROCEDURE_NAME) like '%head%') AND RRPT_ORDER_STATUS_CD IN ('PERF', 'RESC', 'RESF', 'RESI') GROUP BY RRPT_MRN) , MRI_SPINE AS (SELECT DISTINCT RRPT_MRN , MIN(RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE) PERFORMED_DTE FROM DV.RADIOLOGY_REPORT_V JOIN DX ON PT_MRN = RRPT_MRN WHERE RRPT_ORDER_GROUP IN ('MR', 'MR RO') AND (LOWER(RRPT_PROCEDURE_NAME) like '%neck%' OR LOWER(RRPT_PROCEDURE_NAME) like '%spine%') AND RRPT_ORDER_STATUS_CD IN ('PERF', 'RESC', 'RESF', 'RESI') GROUP BY RRPT_MRN) , CSF_CYT_PRE AS (SELECT PRPT_MRN, PRPT_PROCEDURE_DTE, PRPT_REPORT_DTE, PRPT_REPORT_TYPE, PRPT_REPORT_TYPE_DESC, PRPT_ACCESSION_NO, PRPT_REPORT FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V JOIN DX ON PRPT_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE 1=1 AND PRPT_REPORT_TYPE_DESC IN ('Cytology-Non GYN', 'Cytology-Submitted Slides') AND PRPT_REPORT_DTE >= '2014-01-01' AND PRPT_REPORT IS NOT NULL ) , CSF_CYT_IND AS (SELECT DISTINCT PRPT_MRN AS CSF_PRPT_MRN, PRPT_ACCESSION_NO AS CSF_PRPT_ACCESSION_NO FROM CSF_CYT_PRE WHERE 1=1 AND CONTAINS("PRPT_REPORT", '("cerebrospinal fluid" | "CSF" | "lumbar")') = 1 ) , CSF_CYT AS (SELECT PRPT_MRN, PRPT_PROCEDURE_DTE, PRPT_REPORT_DTE, PRPT_REPORT_TYPE, PRPT_REPORT_TYPE_DESC, PRPT_ACCESSION_NO, PRPT_REPORT, CASE WHEN PRPT_MRN = CSF_PRPT_MRN THEN 'Y' ELSE NULL END AS CSF_IND FROM CSF_CYT_PRE LEFT JOIN CSF_CYT_IND ON PRPT_MRN = CSF_PRPT_MRN AND PRPT_ACCESSION_NO = CSF_PRPT_ACCESSION_NO) , LABS AS (SELECT DISTINCT LR_MRN, LR_PERFORMED_DTE, LISTAGG(TRIM(LR_TEST_NAME), CHR(13) || CHR(10)) WITHIN GROUP( ORDER BY LR_PERFORMED_DTE) AS LR_TEST_NAME FROM (SELECT DISTINCT LR_MRN, LR_PERFORMED_DTE, LR_TEST_NAME FROM IDB.LAB_RESULTS JOIN DX ON PT_MRN = LR_MRN WHERE 1=1 AND LR_TEST_NAME IN ('Bacterial/Fungal Cult, CSF', 'Body Fluid Cell Count and Differential CSF', 'Circulating Tumor Cells, CSF', 'CSF Fluid Cell Count and Differential', 'Glucose, CSF', 'Protein, CSF') ) A GROUP BY LR_MRN, LR_PERFORMED_DTE) , ORDERS AS (SELECT OO_MRN, OO_ENTER_DTE, REASON_FOR_CONSULT, LISTAGG(TRIM(OOC_ITEM_NAME), CHR(13) || CHR(10)) WITHIN GROUP( ORDER BY OO_ENTER_DTE) AS OOC_ITEM_NAME FROM (SELECT DISTINCT OO_MRN, OOC_ITEM_NAME, OO_ENTER_DTE, MAX(CASE WHEN OUD_USER_DI_CD IN ('Consult_Neuro Reason For', 'Consult_Neuro Reason For_OP', 'CONSULT_NRS_Reason') THEN OUD_USER_DI_VALUE END) AS REASON_FOR_CONSULT FROM IDB.OMS_ORDER JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_CATALOG ON OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID = OOC_MSTR_ITEM_GUID LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_USER_DATA ON OUD_ORD_GUID = OO_ORD_GUID WHERE 1=1 AND OOC_ITEM_NAME IN ('Financial Clearance for Chemotherapy (Neurology)', 'Neurology Clinic Consult', 'Neurology Consult - JRSC Only', 'Neurology Inpatient Consult', 'Neurology Visit', 'Neurosurgery External Consult', 'Neurosurgery Inpatient Consult') AND OO_ENTER_DTE >= '2014-01-01' GROUP BY OO_MRN, OOC_ITEM_NAME, OO_ENTER_DTE) A GROUP BY OO_MRN, OO_ENTER_DTE, REASON_FOR_CONSULT) SELECT A.* , C.PRPT_PROCEDURE_DTE "Cytology Performed Date" , CASE WHEN "CSF Performed Date" = PRPT_PROCEDURE_DTE THEN C.PRPT_REPORT WHEN CSF_IND = 'Y' THEN C.PRPT_REPORT WHEN "CSF Performed Date" IS NULL AND PRPT_PROCEDURE_DTE IS NOT NULL THEN PRPT_REPORT ELSE NULL END AS "Cytology Report" , C.CSF_IND "CSF in report Indicator" FROM (SELECT DISTINCT A.PT_MRN "MRN" , A.DMPID "DMPID" , B.PERFORMED_DTE "Brain MRI Performed Date" , S.PERFORMED_DTE "Spine MRI Performed Date" , OOC_ITEM_NAME "Neurology Order" , REASON_FOR_CONSULT "Reason For Consult" , L.LR_TEST_NAME "CSF Lab Name" , L.LR_PERFORMED_DTE "CSF Performed Date" FROM DX A LEFT JOIN MRI_BRAIN B ON A.PT_MRN = B.RRPT_MRN LEFT JOIN MRI_SPINE S ON A.PT_MRN = S.RRPT_MRN LEFT JOIN LABS L ON A.PT_MRN = L.LR_MRN LEFT JOIN ORDERS O ON A.PT_MRN = O.OO_MRN) A LEFT JOIN CSF_CYT C ON A."MRN" = C.PRPT_MRN ;

prompt:
We would like to edit the existing dataline above for IRB 19-049, adding a request for pts who have been newly dx with primary brain tumors or dx with recurrence of a primary brain tumor.

Requesting a report in the beginning of each week with pts dx entered from the previous week.
completion: WITH ORDERS AS (SELECT DISTINCT OO_MRN, OOC_ITEM_NAME, OO_ENTER_DTE, OO_SUMMARY_LINE, DOC_NAME REQ_DR_NAME, DOC_ACDMC_SVC REQ_DR_SVC, OO_ORD_STS_CD FROM IDB.OMS_ORDER JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_CATALOG ON OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID = OOC_MSTR_ITEM_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_STATUS ON OO_ORD_STS_CD = OSTS_ORD_STS_CD JOIN IDB.DOC ON DOC_DR_NO = OO_REQ_DR_NO JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PT_MRN = OO_MRN WHERE OOC_ITEM_NAME IN ('bEVAcizumab INJ', 'Financial Clearance for Chemotherapy (Neurology)') AND OO_ORD_STS_CD NOT IN ('CANP', 'CANC', 'AUC3') AND OO_ENTER_DTE BETWEEN (SELECT DISTINCT CASE WHEN DAYOFWEEK(CURRENT date) = 2 THEN CURRENT date - 3 DAYS ELSE CURRENT date - 1 DAY END FROM SYSIBM.SYSDUMMY1) AND (SELECT DISTINCT CASE WHEN DAYOFWEEK(CURRENT date) = 2 THEN CURRENT date - 1 DAYS ELSE CURRENT date - 1 DAY END FROM SYSIBM.SYSDUMMY1) ) , CNS AS (SELECT DISTINCT TM_MRN MRN, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS HIST_DESC, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_DESC FROM ORDERS JOIN IDB.CDB_TUMOR ON TM_MRN = OO_MRN JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS ON AV_ELEMENT = 'CASE_STS' AND AV_CODE = TM_CASE_STS AND TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') WHERE TM_SITE_CD LIKE 'C71%' OR TM_SITE_CD = 'C729' UNION SELECT DISTINCT CC_MRN MRN, 'NA' AS HIST_DESC, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_DESC FROM ORDERS JOIN IDB.CTC_CLSF ON CC_MRN = OO_MRN JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND (CC_CLSF_CD IN ('C72.9') OR SUBSTR(CC_CLSF_CD, 1, 3) = ('C71')) ) , CHEMO AS (SELECT DISTINCT APR_MRN, APR_GENERIC_NAME, APR_END_DTE "Last Chemo Date", ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY APR_MRN ORDER BY APR_END_DTE DESC) AS RANK FROM CNS JOIN IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX_V ON APR_MRN = MRN WHERE APR_END_DTE IS NOT NULL ) SELECT DISTINCT OO_MRN MRN, SITE_DESC, HIST_DESC, CHAR(OO_ENTER_DTE) ENTERED_DATE, OOC_ITEM_NAME ITEM_NAME, OO_SUMMARY_LINE SUMMARY_LINE, REQ_DR_NAME ORDER_DOCTOR, OO_ORD_STS_CD STATUS, CHAR(PLA_LST_RT_DTE) LAST_RT_DATE, CHAR("Last Chemo Date") LAST_CHEMO_DATE, APR_GENERIC_NAME "Chemo Name" FROM ORDERS JOIN CNS ON MRN = OO_MRN JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY ON PLA_MRN = OO_MRN LEFT JOIN CHEMO ON APR_MRN = OO_MRN AND RANK = 1 ; SELECT DISTINCT TM_MRN MRN, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS HIST_DESC, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_DESC, TM_DX_DTE AS DX_DTE FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS ON AV_ELEMENT = 'CASE_STS' AND AV_CODE = TM_CASE_STS AND TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') WHERE (TM_SITE_CD LIKE 'C71%' OR TM_SITE_CD = 'C729') AND TM_DX_DTE >= CURRENT date - 14 DAY UNION SELECT DISTINCT CC_MRN MRN, 'NA' AS HIST_DESC, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_DESC, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) DX_DTE FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND (CC_CLSF_CD IN ('C72.9') OR SUBSTR(CC_CLSF_CD, 1, 3) = ('C71')) GROUP BY CC_MRN, 'NA', CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK HAVING MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) >= CURRENT date - 14 DAY ;

prompt: Identify all salivary duct carcinomas diagnosed and treated at MSKCC.
completion: WITH "cte1" AS (SELECT TEXTTABLE.*, CONTAINS("PRPT_REPORT", '"salivary duct carcinoma"') AS "HitCol1" FROM "DV"."PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V" TEXTTABLE), PTS AS (SELECT DISTINCT "PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID", "t3"."PT_MRN" AS "MRN", "t3"."PT_LAST_NAME" AS "Last Name", "t3"."PT_FIRST_NAME" AS "First Name", "t4"."DT_DTE" AS "Pathology Report Date", "t8"."PLA_LAST_TX_DTE" AS "Last MSK Treatment Date", "t8"."PLA_LAST_APPT_DTE" AS "Last Appointment Date" FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED" "t1" JOIN "cte1" "t2" ON "t1"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t2"."PRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" JOIN "DV"."DATE" "t4" ON "t2"."PRPT_REPORT_DATE_ID" = "t4"."DT_DATE_ID" JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V" "t3" ON "t1"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t3"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_LATEST_ACTIVITY" "t8" ON "t1"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t8"."PLA_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" WHERE "t2"."HitCol1" <> 0 AND "t8"."PLA_LAST_TX_DTE" IS NOT NULL ), CDB AS (SELECT DISTINCT "PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID", "t5"."TCA_CASE_STS_DESC" AS "Case Status", "t5"."TCA_CLASS_OF_CASE" AS "Class of Case", "t6"."DT_DTE" AS "CDB Tumor Diagnosis Date" FROM PTS JOIN "DV"."CDB_TUMOR_V" "t9" ON "PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t9"."CDTM_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" JOIN "DV"."TUMOR_CASE_ATTRIBUTES" "t5" ON "t9"."CDTM_CASE_ATTR_ID" = "t5"."TUMOR_CASE_ATTR_ID" JOIN "DV"."DATE" "t6" ON "t9"."CDTM_DX_DATE_ID" = "t6"."DT_DATE_ID" JOIN "DV"."ICDO_SITE_CATALOG_V" "t7" ON "t9"."CDTM_SITE_CATALOG_ID" = "t7"."ICSC_SITE_CATALOG_ID" WHERE "t7"."ICSC_SITE_CD" IN ('C079', 'C080', 'C081', 'C088', 'C089') ) SELECT "MRN", "Last Name", "First Name", "Pathology Report Date", "Case Status", "Class of Case", "CDB Tumor Diagnosis Date", "Last MSK Treatment Date", "Last Appointment Date" FROM PTS LEFT JOIN CDB ON PTS."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = CDB."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID"

prompt: Provide a list of H- and S- cases with "T cell lymphoma" OR "T-cell lymphoma" OR "T cell lymphoproliferative disorder" OR "T-cell lymphoproliferative disorder" in Diagnosis section from 01/01/2019 to present.
completion: WITH DX AS (SELECT PT_FIRST_NAME FIRST_NAME, PT_LAST_NAME LAST_NAME, PT_MRN "MRN", PT_BIRTH_DTE "DOB", STRIP(PRPT_ACCESSION_NO) "H/S NUMBER", PRPT_REPORT, DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)DIAGNOSIS:[\w\W]*(?=BONE MARROW BIOPSY)', PRV.PRPT_REPORT) DIAGNOSIS_COMMENT1, DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)DIAGNOSIS:[\w\W]*(?=MORPHOLOGY)', PRV.PRPT_REPORT) DIAGNOSIS_COMMENT2, DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)DIAGNOSIS:[\w\W]*(?=I ATTEST)', PRV.PRPT_REPORT) DIAGNOSIS_COMMENT3, DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)DIAGNOSIS:[\w\W]*(?=NOTE:)', PRV.PRPT_REPORT) DIAGNOSIS_COMMENT4 FROM DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS PD JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V PRV ON PT_MRN = PRPT_MRN WHERE PRPT_REPORT IS NOT NULL AND SUBSTR(PRPT_ACCESSION_NO, 1, 1) IN ('H', 'S') AND CONTAINS("PRPT_REPORT", '("T cell lymphoma" OR "T-cell lymphoma" OR "T cell lymphoproliferative disorder" OR "T-cell lymphoproliferative disorder" )') = 1 AND PRPT_PROCEDURE_DTE >='2022-11-10' AND PRPT_PROCEDURE_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT_DATE- 30 DAYS AND CURRENT DATE ), DX2 AS (SELECT DX.*, CASE WHEN DIAGNOSIS_COMMENT1 <> '' THEN DIAGNOSIS_COMMENT1 WHEN DIAGNOSIS_COMMENT2 <> '' THEN DIAGNOSIS_COMMENT2 WHEN DIAGNOSIS_COMMENT3 <> '' THEN DIAGNOSIS_COMMENT3 WHEN DIAGNOSIS_COMMENT4 <> '' THEN DIAGNOSIS_COMMENT4 END AS DIAGNOSIS_COMMENT FROM DX) SELECT FIRST_NAME, LAST_NAME, "MRN", "DOB", "H/S NUMBER", PRPT_REPORT FROM DX2 WHERE 1=1 AND(UPPER(DIAGNOSIS_COMMENT) LIKE '%T CELL LYMPHOMA%' OR UPPER(DIAGNOSIS_COMMENT) LIKE '%T-CELL LYMPHOMA%' OR UPPER(DIAGNOSIS_COMMENT) LIKE '%T CELL LYMPHOPROLIFERATIVE DISORDER%' OR UPPER(DIAGNOSIS_COMMENT) LIKE '%T-CELL LYMPHOPROLIFERATIVE DISORDER%') AND UPPER(DIAGNOSIS_COMMENT) NOT LIKE '%NO DEFINITIVE MORPHOLOGIC OR IMMUNOPHENOTYPIC EVIDENCE OF RESIDUAL%' AND UPPER(DIAGNOSIS_COMMENT) NOT LIKE '%NO DIAGNOSTIC MORPHOLOGIC EVIDENCE OF T CELL%' AND UPPER(DIAGNOSIS_COMMENT) NOT LIKE '%NO MORPHOLOGIC EVIDENCE OF T CELL%' AND UPPER(DIAGNOSIS_COMMENT) NOT LIKE '%NO MORPHOLOGIC OR IMMUNOPHENOTYPIC EVIDENCE OF T CELL%' AND UPPER(DIAGNOSIS_COMMENT) NOT LIKE '%NO MORPHOLOGIC OR IMMUNOPHENOTYPIC EVIDENCE OF INVOLVEMENT BY%' AND UPPER(DIAGNOSIS_COMMENT) NOT LIKE '%NO DIAGNOSTIC MORPHOLOGIC OR REPORTED IMMUNOPHENOTYPIC EVIDENCE OF%' AND UPPER(DIAGNOSIS_COMMENT) NOT LIKE '%NO DIAGNOSTIC MORPHOLOGIC OR IMMUNOPHENOTYPIC INVOLVEMENT%' AND UPPER(DIAGNOSIS_COMMENT) NOT LIKE '%NO DIAGNOSTIC MORPHOLOGIC OR IMMUNOPHENOTYPIC EVIDENCE OF%'

prompt: Provide aggregated data on pediatric patients with a new diagnosis of cancer between January 2013 and June 2013.
completion: SELECT DISTINCT "t1"."PT_MRN" AS "MRN", "t1"."PT_VITAL_STATUS" AS "Vital Status", "t2"."DT_DTE" AS "Tumor Diagnosis Date", "t3"."PLA_LAST_CHEMO_YEAR" AS "Last MSK Chemo Year", "t3"."PLA_LAST_RT_YEAR" AS "Last MSK Radiation Therapy Year", "t1"."PT_BIRTH_DTE" AS "Date of Birth", "t4"."DXCC_ICD_CODE" AS "ICD-O Histology Code", "t4"."DXCC_ICD_MSK_DESC" AS "ICD-O Histology Description", "t5"."ICSC_SITE_CD" AS "ICD-O Site Code", "t5"."ICSC_ICDO_SITE_MSK_DESC" AS "ICD-O Site Description", YEAR("t2"."DT_DTE" - "t6"."DT_DTE") AS "Age at Tumor Diagnosis Date - years" FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V" "t1" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED" "t7" ON "t1"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t7"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."CDB_TUMOR_V" "t8" ON "t7"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t8"."CDTM_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" "t2" ON "t8"."CDTM_DX_DATE_ID" = "t2"."DT_DATE_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DIAGNOSIS_CODE_CAT_ICDO_V" "t4" ON "t8"."CDTM_DX_CATALOG_ID" = "t4"."DXCC_DX_CATALOG_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."ICDO_SITE_CATALOG_V" "t5" ON "t8"."CDTM_SITE_CATALOG_ID" = "t5"."ICSC_SITE_CATALOG_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_LATEST_ACTIVITY" "t3" ON "t1"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t3"."PLA_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" "t6" ON "t1"."PT_BIRTH_DTE" = "t6"."DT_DTE" WHERE ("t1"."PT_VITAL_STATUS" = 'ALIVE' AND ("t2"."DT_DTE" >= '2012-1-1' AND (("t3"."PLA_LAST_CHEMO_YEAR" IS NOT NULL OR "t3"."PLA_LAST_RT_YEAR" IS NOT NULL) AND YEAR("t2"."DT_DTE" - "t6"."DT_DTE") <= 17)))

prompt: provide a list of patients with "catenin" type liver lesions
completion: SELECT DISTINCT "t1"."PT_MRN" AS "MRN", "t2"."PRPT_ACCESSION_NO" AS "Pathology Report", "t3"."DT_DTE" AS "Pathology Report Date", "t4"."DT_DTE" AS "Pathology Procedure Date" FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V" "t1" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED" "t5" ON "t1"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t5"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V" "t2" ON "t5"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t2"."PRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" "t3" ON "t2"."PRPT_REPORT_DATE_ID" = "t3"."DT_DATE_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" "t4" ON "t2"."PRPT_PROCEDURE_DATE_ID" = "t4"."DT_DATE_ID" WHERE (CONTAINS("t2"."PRPT_REPORT", '("catenin" & ("hepatocellular adenoma" | "liver adenoma" | "hepatocellular lesion" | "well differentiated hepatocellular lesion"))') = 1 AND "t2"."PRPT_REPORT" IS NOT NULL)

prompt: Provide a list of patients diagnosed with Cribriform Morula.
completion: WITH CD AS (SELECT CDD_MRN, CDD_DOC_GUID, CDD_SERVICE_DTE, CDD_DOC_NAME, CDO_SECTION, CDO_CTLG_DISPL_NM, CDO_MSTR_ITEM_NM, CDO_ITEM_NAME, CDO_VALUE_TEXT FROM IDB.CD_DOCUMENT JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION ON CDO_DOC_GUID = CDD_DOC_GUID WHERE CDD_CANCEL_IND = '0' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND = '0' AND(LOCATE('CRIBRIFORM MORULA', UPPER(CAST(CDO_VALUE_TEXT AS VARCHAR(32000)))) > 0 OR LOCATE('CRIBIFORM MORULA', UPPER(CAST(CDO_VALUE_TEXT AS VARCHAR(32000)))) > 0 OR LOCATE('CRIBRIFORM-MORULA', UPPER(CAST(CDO_VALUE_TEXT AS VARCHAR(32000)))) > 0 OR LOCATE('CRIBIFORM-MORULA', UPPER(CAST(CDO_VALUE_TEXT AS VARCHAR(32000)))) > 0) AND CDD_SERVICE_DTE BETWEEN '1985-01-01' AND '2023-01-15' ) , PATH AS (SELECT DISTINCT "t1"."PT_MRN" AS "MRN", STRIP(PT_LAST_NAME) || ', ' || STRIP(PT_FIRST_NAME) AS NAME, PT_SEX, PT_BIRTH_DTE, PT_DEATH_DTE, "t2"."PRPT_ACCESSION_NO" AS "Pathology Report", "t3"."PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_DESC" AS "Pathology Report Type", "t4"."DT_DTE" AS "Pathology Procedure Date", UPPER(CASE WHEN LENGTH(PRPT_REPORT) <= 15000 THEN RTRIM(CAST(SUBSTR(PRPT_REPORT, 1, 15000) AS VARCHAR(15000))) ELSE CAST(SUBSTR(PRPT_REPORT, 1, 15000) AS VARCHAR(15000)) END) AS TXT, CASE WHEN UPPER(DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)DIAGNOSIS:[\w\W]*(?=I ATTEST)', PRPT_REPORT)) <> '' THEN UPPER(DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)DIAGNOSIS:[\w\W]*(?=I ATTEST)', PRPT_REPORT)) WHEN UPPER(DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)DIAGNOSIS:[\w\W]*(?=NOTE:)', PRPT_REPORT)) <> '' THEN UPPER(DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)DIAGNOSIS:[\w\W]*(?=NOTE:)', PRPT_REPORT)) WHEN UPPER(DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)DIAGNOSIS:[\w\W]*(?=REPORT ELECTRONICALLY SIGNED OUT )', PRPT_REPORT)) <> '' THEN UPPER(DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)DIAGNOSIS:[\w\W]*(?=REPORT ELECTRONICALLY SIGNED OUT )', PRPT_REPORT)) END AS DIAGNOSIS FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V" "t1" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED" "t6" ON "t1"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t6"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V" "t2" ON "t6"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t2"."PRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATH_RPRT_TYPE_LOOKUP" "t3" ON "t2"."PRPT_REPORT_TYPE" = "t3"."PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_CD" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" "t4" ON "t2"."PRPT_PROCEDURE_DATE_ID" = "t4"."DT_DATE_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" "t5" ON "t2"."PRPT_REPORT_DATE_ID" = "t5"."DT_DATE_ID" WHERE 1=1 AND "t2"."PRPT_REPORT" IS NOT NULL AND UPPER("t3"."PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_DESC") LIKE '%SURGICAL PATHOLOGY%' AND(LOCATE('CRIBRIFORM MORULA', UPPER(CAST("t2"."PRPT_REPORT" AS VARCHAR(32000)))) > 0 OR LOCATE('CRIBIFORM MORULA', UPPER(CAST("t2"."PRPT_REPORT" AS VARCHAR(32000)))) > 0 OR LOCATE('CRIBRIFORM-MORULA', UPPER(CAST("t2"."PRPT_REPORT" AS VARCHAR(32000)))) > 0 OR LOCATE('CRIBIFORM-MORULA', UPPER(CAST("t2"."PRPT_REPORT" AS VARCHAR(32000)))) > 0) AND "t4"."DT_DTE" BETWEEN '1985-01-01' AND '2023-01-15' ) SELECT DISTINCT COALESCE(CDD_MRN, "MRN") AS MRN, CASE WHEN "MRN" IS NOT NULL THEN 'Y' END AS "Surgical Pathology", CASE WHEN CDD_MRN IS NOT NULL THEN 'Y' END AS "ClinDoc" FROM CD FULL JOIN PATH ON CDD_MRN = "MRN"

prompt:
We would like to request additional data for previous DataLine Request SKI23259 which was completed in May 2021.



We had requested the list of all FDG-PET ordered between 1/1/2016 and 12/31/2020 by a designated list of attendings (list provided below in "Data Elements Section).



We would like to expand this request and obtain the same data: from 1/1/2010 to 1/1/2016 as well as from 12/31/2020 to 12/31/2021.
completion: SELECT OO_MRN MRN, STRIP(PT_LAST_NAME)||', '||PT_FIRST_NAME PT_NAME , YEAR(OO_ENTER_DTE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) AGE_AT_PET , OP_DISPLAY_NAME REQUESTER, OP_PROV_TYPE PROV_TYPE , OP_PVDR_NO PVDR_NO, OP_DISCIPLINE DISCIPLINE, DOC_SVC , SUBSTR(STRIP(CASE WHEN OO_ORD_NAME = 'Outside Radiology Order' THEN CASE WHEN RO.OUD_USER_DI_VALUE = 'Other' AND RI.OUD_USER_DI_VALUE IS NOT NULL THEN RI.OUD_USER_DI_VALUE ELSE COALESCE(RO.OUD_USER_DI_VALUE, OO_ORD_NAME) END WHEN COALESCE(MD.OUD_USER_DI_VALUE, CR.OUD_USER_DI_VALUE) IS NOT NULL THEN CASE WHEN COALESCE(MD.OUD_USER_DI_VALUE, CR.OUD_USER_DI_VALUE) LIKE '%:%' THEN COALESCE(MD.OUD_USER_DI_VALUE, CR.OUD_USER_DI_VALUE) ELSE STRIP(OO_ORD_NAME)||': '|| COALESCE(MD.OUD_USER_DI_VALUE, CR.OUD_USER_DI_VALUE) END ELSE OO_ORD_NAME END), 1, 155) AS RAD_TEST_NAME , OO_ENTER_DTE PLACEMENT_DATE, OO_PERFORMED_DTE SERVICE_DATE , OO_ORD_ID ORD_ID, OO_ANCIL_REF_CD REPORT_ACCESSION_NO , OO_ORD_STS_CD ORD_STS, OO_REQ_TME_PRIO TIME_PRIORITY , OO_SUMMARY_LINE SUMMARY_LINE FROM IDB.OMS_ORDER JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PT_MRN = OO_MRN JOIN IDB.OMS_PROVIDER ON OP_PVDR_GUID = OO_PVDR_GUID LEFT JOIN IDB.DOC ON OO_REQ_DR_NO = DOC_DR_NO LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_USER_DATA CR ON CR.OUD_ORD_GUID = OO_ORD_GUID AND CR.OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'RIS_Order - Current' LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_USER_DATA MD ON MD.OUD_ORD_GUID = OO_ORD_GUID AND MD.OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'RIS_Order - Modified' LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_USER_DATA RO ON RO.OUD_ORD_GUID = OO_ORD_GUID AND RO.OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'Rad_Outside_Test' LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_USER_DATA RI ON RI.OUD_ORD_GUID = OO_ORD_GUID AND RI.OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'RDR_Info' WHERE OO_PERFORMED_DTE BETWEEN '1/1/2010' AND '12/31/2021' AND OO_ORD_NAME LIKE 'PET%' AND OO_ORD_STS_CD NOT LIKE 'CAN%' AND OO_PVDR_GUID IN ('1008119001', '5000001281119001', '8000001311119001', '9000001032119001', '9000014743101190', '9000016510101190', '9000226891801190', '9001249613901190', '9001729852201190')

prompt: List of all patients who received a dose of pembrolizumab in the previous 24 hours.
completion: WITH AP AS (SELECT DISTINCT APR_MRN, CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME, APR_DIAGNOSIS_DESC, APR_START_DTE FROM IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX_V WHERE CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME = 'PEMBROLIZUMAB' AND APR_START_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT date -1 DAY AND CURRENT date ), LR AS (SELECT DISTINCT LR_MRN, LR_TEST_NAME, MAX(LR_PERFORMED_DTE) AS LAST_CMP FROM IDB.LAB_RESULTS JOIN AP ON APR_MRN= LR_MRN WHERE LR_TEST_NAME IN ('Comprehensive Metabolic Panel', 'Comprehensive Metabolic Panel, Plasma') GROUP BY LR_MRN, LR_TEST_NAME) SELECT DISTINCT APR_MRN, APR_START_DTE, APR_DIAGNOSIS_DESC, LR_TEST_NAME, LAST_CMP FROM AP JOIN LR ON APR_MRN = LR_MRN ORDER BY APR_MRN

prompt: Provide monthly list of patients with a radiation oncology metastatic disease outpatient consult order.
completion: WITH CONSULT AS (SELECT OO_MRN, OOC_ITEM_NAME, OO_SIGNIFICANT_DT, OSTS_STS_DESC, OUD_USER_DI_CD, OUD_USER_DI_VALUE, OCV_CURR_LOC FROM IDB.OMS_ORDER JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_CATALOG ON OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID = OOC_MSTR_ITEM_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_STATUS ON OO_ORD_STS_CD = OSTS_ORD_STS_CD JOIN IDB.OMS_CLIENT_VISIT ON OO_VISIT_GUID = OCV_VISIT_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_LOCATION ON OL_LOC_GUID = OCV_CURR_LOC_GUID LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_USER_DATA ON OUD_ORD_GUID = OO_ORD_GUID AND OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'Consult_RO_Locations' WHERE OOC_ITEM_NAME IN ('Radiation Oncology Metastatic Disease Outpatient Consult') AND OO_ORD_STS_CD NOT IN ('CANP', 'CANC', 'AUC3') AND (OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE >= (DATE('0001-01-01') + YEAR(CURRENT date) YEARS - 1 YEAR + MONTH(CURRENT date) MONTHS - 2 MONTHS) AND OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE < (DATE('0001-01-01') + YEAR(CURRENT date) YEARS - 1 YEAR + MONTH(CURRENT date) MONTHS - 1 MONTHS)) ) , APPTS AS (SELECT CPE_MRN AS "MRN", CPE_APPT_DT AS "Appt Date Time", CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 AS "Department", CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 AS "Service", CLD_DEPT_NAME AS "Department Name", CRE_RES_NAME AS "Appt Provider Name", CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME AS "Appt Visit Type", CLD_CLD_CENTER AS "Appt Site", ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY CPE_MRN ORDER BY CPE_ENC_DTE ASC) AS RANK FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID JOIN CONSULT ON CPE_MRN = OO_MRN WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp', 'Sch') AND CRE_RES_TYP IN ('Physician') AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 = 'RDO' AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_1 = 'REG' AND CPE_APPT_DT >= OO_SIGNIFICANT_DT ) , RADONC AS (SELECT RTC_TX_MRN , RTC_TX_START_DTE , RTC_TX_PLANNED_FRACTIONS , RTC_TX_DELIVERED_FRACTIONS , RTC_TX_PLAN_NAME FROM IDB.RADONC_TREATMENT_COURSE JOIN APPTS ON "MRN" = RTC_TX_MRN WHERE 1=1 AND RTC_TX_START_DTE BETWEEN DATE("Appt Date Time") AND DATE("Appt Date Time") + 42 DAYS AND RANK = 1 ) SELECT DISTINCT OO_MRN "MRN" , OO_SIGNIFICANT_DT "Order Date" , "Appt Date Time" , DAYS(DATE("Appt Date Time")) - DAYS(DATE(OO_SIGNIFICANT_DT)) AS "Date Difference" , "Appt Provider Name" , "Appt Visit Type" , "Appt Site" , TRIM(OUD_USER_DI_VALUE) "Order Destination Location" , OCV_CURR_LOC "Order Origin Location" , CASE WHEN RTC_TX_MRN IS NOT NULL THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS "Radiation Tx" FROM CONSULT JOIN APPTS ON OO_MRN = "MRN" AND RANK = 1 AND "Appt Date Time" >= OO_SIGNIFICANT_DT LEFT JOIN RADONC ON OO_MRN = RTC_TX_MRN JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON OO_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE OUD_USER_DI_VALUE <> 'Manhattan'

prompt: Provide a list of breast cancer female patients of Arab descent that are in active treatment or currently in follow-up. Please include age and country of origin.  Arab descent is defined by either self report language Arabic or Arab country of origin which include: Algeria, Bahrain, Comoros, Djibouti, Egypt, Iraq, Jordan, Kuwait, Lebanon, Libya, Mauritania, Morocco, Oman, Palestine, Qatar, Saudi Arabia, Somalia, Sudan, Syria, Tunisia, the United Arab Emirates and Yemen.
completion: WITH TUMOR AS (SELECT MRN , DX_DTE , STAGE , ER , PR , HER2_SUMMARY_RESULT , RANK() OVER(PARTITION BY MRN ORDER BY DX_DTE ASC) AS ARANK , RANK() OVER(PARTITION BY MRN ORDER BY DX_DTE DESC) AS DRANK FROM (SELECT CC_MRN AS MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS DX_DTE, '' AS STAGE, '' AS ER, '' AS PR, '' AS HER2_SUMMARY_RESULT FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF WHERE SUBSTR(CC_CLSF_CD, 1, 3) = 'C50' AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND (CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) GROUP BY CC_MRN HAVING MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) >= '2018-01-01' UNION SELECT TM_MRN AS MRN, TM_DX_DTE AS DX_DTE, TM_BEST_AJCC_STG AS STAGE, CASE WHEN TM_SSF1 = '000' THEN 'Test not done (test not ordered and not performed)' WHEN TM_SSF1 = '010' THEN 'Positive/elevated' WHEN TM_SSF1 = '020' THEN 'Negative/normal; within normal limits' WHEN TM_SSF1 = '030' THEN 'Borderline; undetermined whether positive or negative' WHEN TM_SSF1 = '080' THEN 'Ordered, but results not in chart' WHEN TM_SSF1 = '988' THEN 'Not applicable: Information not collected for this case' WHEN TM_SSF1 = '996' THEN 'Test ordered, results not interpretable' WHEN TM_SSF1 = '997' THEN 'Test ordered, results not in chart' WHEN TM_SSF1 = '998' THEN 'Test not done (test not ordered and not performed)' WHEN TM_SSF1 = '999' THEN 'Unknown or no information; not documented in patient record' ELSE '' END AS ER, CASE WHEN TM_SSF2 = '000' THEN 'Test not done (test not ordered and not performed)' WHEN TM_SSF2 = '010' THEN 'Positive/elevated' WHEN TM_SSF2 = '020' THEN 'Negative/normal; within normal limits' WHEN TM_SSF2 = '030' THEN 'Borderline; undetermined whether positive or negative' WHEN TM_SSF2 = '080' THEN 'Ordered, but results not in chart' WHEN TM_SSF2 = '988' THEN 'Not applicable: Information not collected for this case' WHEN TM_SSF2 = '996' THEN 'Test ordered, results not interpretable' WHEN TM_SSF2 = '997' THEN 'Test ordered, results not in chart' WHEN TM_SSF2 = '998' THEN 'Test not done (test not ordered and not performed)' WHEN TM_SSF2 = '999' THEN 'Unknown or no information; not documented in patient record' ELSE '' END AS PR, CASE WHEN TM_SSF15 = '010' THEN 'Positive/elevated; amplified' WHEN TM_SSF15 = '020' THEN 'Negative/normal; within normal limits; not amplified' WHEN TM_SSF15 = '030' THEN 'Borderline; equivocal; indeterminate; undetermined whether positive or negative' WHEN TM_SSF15 = '988' THEN 'Not applicable: Information not collected for this case' WHEN TM_SSF15 = '997' THEN 'Test ordered, results not in chart' WHEN TM_SSF15 = '998' THEN 'Test not done (test not ordered and not performed)' WHEN TM_SSF15 = '999' THEN 'Unknown or no information; not documented in patient record' ELSE '' END AS HER2_SUMMARY_RESULT FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND SUBSTR(TM_SITE_CD, 1, 3) = 'C50' )) SELECT DISTINCT PLA_MRN AS MRN, MIN(YEAR(DX_DTE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH)) AS AGE_AT_FIRST_DX, AV_DESC AS BIRTH_COUNTRY, PT_COUNTRY AS CURRENT_COUNTRY, PT_PRIMARY_LANG_DESC AS LANGUAGE, MIN(CASE WHEN ARANK = 1 THEN DX_DTE END) AS FIRST_DX_YEAR, MIN(CASE WHEN ARANK = 1 THEN STAGE END) AS FIRST_DX_STAGE, MIN(CASE WHEN ARANK = 1 THEN ER END) AS FIRST_DX_ER, MIN(CASE WHEN ARANK = 1 THEN PR END) AS FIRST_DX_PR, MIN(CASE WHEN ARANK = 1 THEN HER2_SUMMARY_RESULT END) AS FIRST_DX_HER2_SUMMARY_RESULT, MIN(CASE WHEN DRANK = 1 THEN DX_DTE END) AS LAST_DX_YEAR, MIN(CASE WHEN DRANK = 1 THEN STAGE END) AS LAST_DX_STAGE, MIN(CASE WHEN DRANK = 1 THEN ER END) AS LAST_DX_ER, MIN(CASE WHEN DRANK = 1 THEN PR END) AS LAST_DX_PR, MIN(CASE WHEN DRANK = 1 THEN HER2_SUMMARY_RESULT END) AS LAST_DX_HER2_SUMMARY_RESULT, YEAR(PLA_LST_APPT_DTE) AS LAST_APPT_YEAR, YEAR(MIN(F.CPE_ENC_DTE)) AS NEXT_APPT_YEAR, CASE WHEN P.CPE_ENC_DTE IS NOT NULL THEN 'Y' END AS APPT_IN_LAST_3MO FROM IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY JOIN IDB.PATIENT_V ON PT_MRN = PLA_MRN AND PT_SEX = 'F' JOIN IDB.CDB_PATIENT ON CP_MRN = PLA_MRN JOIN TUMOR ON PLA_MRN = MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER F ON PLA_MRN = F.CPE_MRN AND F.CPE_ENC_DTE >= CURRENT DATE AND F.CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Sch') LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER P ON PLA_MRN = P.CPE_MRN AND P.CPE_ENC_DTE >= CURRENT DATE - 3 MONTH AND P.CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS ON AV_ELEMENT = 'BIRTH_GEO_CD' AND AV_CODE = CP_BIRTH_GEO_CD AND AV_DESC IN ('ALGERIA', 'BAHRAIN', 'COMOROS', 'DJIBOUTI', 'EGYPT', 'IRAQ', 'JORDAN', 'KUWAIT', 'LEBANON', 'LIBYA', 'MAURITANIA', 'MOROCCO', 'OMAN', 'PALESTINE', 'QATAR', 'SAUDI ARABIA', 'SOMALIA', 'SUDAN', 'SYRIA', 'TUNISIA', 'UNITED ARAB EMIRATES', 'YEMEN') WHERE PLA_LST_APPT_DTE >= CURRENT date - 5 YEARS AND (AV_CODE IS NOT NULL OR PT_COUNTRY IN ('ALGERIA', 'BAHRAIN', 'COMOROS', 'DJIBOUTI', 'EGYPT', 'IRAQ', 'JORDAN', 'KUWAIT', 'LEBANON', 'LIBYA', 'MAURITANIA', 'MOROCCO', 'OMAN', 'PALESTINE', 'QATAR', 'SAUDI ARABIA', 'SOMALIA', 'SUDAN', 'SYRIA', 'TUNISIA', 'UNITED ARAB EMIRATES', 'YEMEN') OR PT_PRIMARY_LANG_DESC = 'ARABIC') GROUP BY PLA_MRN, AV_DESC, PT_COUNTRY, PT_PRIMARY_LANG_DESC, YEAR(PLA_LST_APPT_DTE), CASE WHEN P.CPE_ENC_DTE IS NOT NULL THEN 'Y' END

prompt: Provide a list of patients with radiation proctitis.
completion: SELECT DISTINCT "t1"."PT_MRN" AS "MRN", "t2"."PRPT_ACCESSION_NO" AS "Pathology Report", "t3"."PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_DESC" AS "Pathology Report Type", "t4"."DT_DTE" AS "Pathology Procedure Date", "t5"."DT_DTE" AS "Pathology Report Date", UPPER(CASE WHEN LENGTH(PRPT_REPORT) <= 15000 THEN RTRIM(CAST(SUBSTR(PRPT_REPORT, 1, 15000) AS VARCHAR(15000))) ELSE CAST(SUBSTR(PRPT_REPORT, 1, 15000) AS VARCHAR(15000)) END) "PRPT_REPORT" FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V" "t1" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED" "t6" ON "t1"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t6"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V" "t2" ON "t6"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t2"."PRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATH_RPRT_TYPE_LOOKUP" "t3" ON "t2"."PRPT_REPORT_TYPE" = "t3"."PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_CD" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" "t4" ON "t2"."PRPT_PROCEDURE_DATE_ID" = "t4"."DT_DATE_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" "t5" ON "t2"."PRPT_REPORT_DATE_ID" = "t5"."DT_DATE_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_IDENTIFICATION_MRN_V" "t7" ON "t1"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t7"."PI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" WHERE CONTAINS(PRPT_REPORT, '("radiation proctitis")') = 1

prompt: Requesting data on employees without additional COVID vaccine dose.
completion: WITH Q AS (SELECT EVI_EMPLOYEE_ID, CVP_NAME, VACCINE_STATUS, CEVE_CATEGORY, CVP_STATUS, CVP_SHORT_TERM_DIS_FLAG ON_LEAVE, CASE WHEN DOSE_ADDL_APPT_STATUS = 'PRE' THEN DATE(DOSE_ADDL_APPT_DT) ELSE NULL END AS ADDL_DOSE_APPT_DTE, FIRST_BOOSTER_ELIGIBLE_DTE, SP.SUPV_NAME, MEDICAL_EXEMPT, REMOTE_EXEMPT, FIRST_BOOSTER_COMPLIANT, FIRST_BOOSTER_DUE_DATE, CVP_WORK_LOCATION, CASE WHEN CVP_WORK_LOCATION IN ('Monmouth Data Center', '480 Red Hill Road (Monmouth)', '225 Summit Av (Montvale)', '136 Mountain View Blvd. (BR)', '1050 Wall Street West (NJDC)', 'New Jersey - Teleworker') THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS NJ_WORK_LOCATION FROM IDB.COVID19_EMPLOYEE_VACCINE_INFO LEFT JOIN IDB.COVID19_EMPLOYEE_VACCINE_EXEMPT_V ON EVI_EMPLOYEE_ID = EXEMPT_EMPLOYEE_ID JOIN IDB.COVID19_VACCINE_PERSON ON EVI_EMPLOYEE_ID = CVP_EMPLOYEE_ID LEFT JOIN (SELECT CVP_EMPLOYEE_ID SUPV_ID, CVP_NAME SUPV_NAME FROM IDB.COVID19_VACCINE_PERSON) SP ON CVP_SUPERVISOR_ID = SUPV_ID) SELECT EVI_EMPLOYEE_ID, CVP_NAME, VACCINE_STATUS, ADDL_DOSE_APPT_DTE, FIRST_BOOSTER_ELIGIBLE_DTE, FIRST_BOOSTER_DUE_DATE, SUPV_NAME, CASE WHEN ADDL_DOSE_APPT_DTE IS NOT NULL THEN 'Y' ELSE '' END AS SCHEDULED, FIRST_BOOSTER_COMPLIANT, CVP_WORK_LOCATION, NJ_WORK_LOCATION FROM Q WHERE CVP_STATUS = 'Active' AND CEVE_CATEGORY = 'Employees' AND COALESCE(ON_LEAVE, '') <> 'Y' AND COALESCE(MEDICAL_EXEMPT, '') <> 'Y' AND COALESCE(REMOTE_EXEMPT, '') <> 'Y'

prompt: Requesting a query ('view') to pull Pathology report data from IDB for patients enrolled in IRB #15-220 (sources of consent are IRB #s 06-107 or 12-245).
completion: WITH ALLOW_PTS AS (SELECT PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID AS ALLOW_PID, PT_MRN MRN FROM IDB.ACCRUALS JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON PT_MRN = AC_MRN WHERE AC_IRB_NO = '19-220' ) SELECT RRPT_MRN AS PRI_RRPT_MRN , RRPT_ORDER_STATUS_DESC AS PRI_RRPT_ORDER_STATUS_DESC , RRPT_ORDER_GROUP AS PRI_RRPT_ORDER_GROUP , RRPT_PROCEDURE_NAME AS PRI_RRPT_PROCEDURE_NAME , RRPT_ANC_CODE AS PRI_RRPT_ANC_CODE , RRPT_REQUESTER AS PRI_RRPT_REQUESTER , RRPT_REQUESTER_TYPE AS PRI_RRPT_REQUESTER_TYPE , RRPT_SVC_CD AS PRI_RRPT_SVC_CD , RRPT_SVC_DESC AS PRI_RRPT_SVC_DESC , RRPT_ORDER_LOCATION AS PRI_RRPT_ORDER_LOCATION , RRPT_FILM_DTE AS PRI_RRPT_FILM_DTE , RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE AS PRI_RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE , RRPT_REPORT_DTE AS PRI_RRPT_REPORT_DTE , RRPT_ACCESSION_NO AS PRI_RRPT_ACCESSION_NO , DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)IMPRESSION:[\w\W]*(?=DICTATED BY:)', RRPT_REPORT_TXT) AS PRI_IMPRESSION , DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)FINDINGS[:]*[\w\W]*(?=IMPRESSION:)', RRPT_REPORT_TXT) AS PRI_FINDINGS , RRPT_REPORT_TXT AS PRI_RRPT_REPORT_TXT , RRPT_MODIFIED_DT, RRPT_CONTENT_MODIFIED_DT FROM DV.RADIOLOGY_REPORT_V RAD JOIN ALLOW_PTS ON ALLOW_PID = RRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID

prompt: Provide a count of the number of new visits (NVs) and internal referrals (IRs) , including telehealth visits by quarter in STGI Medical Oncology, Radiation Oncology, and Surgery for pancreas cancer patients separated by department in 2019 and 2020.
completion: WITH DX AS (SELECT DISTINCT CC_MRN FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE SUBSTR(CC_CLSF_CD, 1, 3) IN ('C25') AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND (CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) ) SELECT YEAR(CPE_ENC_DTE) "Year", QUARTER(CPE_ENC_DTE) "Quarter", CASE WHEN CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR LIKE '%NV%' THEN 'NV' WHEN CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR LIKE '%IR%' THEN 'IR' END AS "Visit Type", CASE WHEN CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 = 'SRG' THEN 'SRG' ELSE CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 END AS "Service", COUNT(*) "Visits" FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID JOIN DX ON CPE_MRN = CC_MRN WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN '2019-01-01' AND CURRENT DATE AND (CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR LIKE '%NV%' OR CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR LIKE '%IR%') AND CASE WHEN CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 = 'SRG' THEN 1 WHEN CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 = 'GI' AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_7 = 'SOL' THEN 1 WHEN CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 = 'RDO' THEN 1 END = 1 GROUP BY YEAR(CPE_ENC_DTE), QUARTER(CPE_ENC_DTE), CASE WHEN CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR LIKE '%NV%' THEN 'NV' WHEN CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR LIKE '%IR%' THEN 'IR' END, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6, CASE WHEN CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 = 'SRG' THEN 'SRG' ELSE CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 END ORDER BY 1, 2, 3, 4

prompt: Add identified information to Darwin query named "Gastrointestinal Stromal Tumor".
completion: SELECT DISTINCT "t1"."PT_MRN" AS "MRN", "t2"."PRPT_ACCESSION_NO" AS "Pathology Report", YEAR("t3"."DT_DTE" - "t4"."DT_DTE") AS "Age at Pathology Procedure Date - years", "t1"."PT_SEX_DESC" AS "Gender", "t1"."PT_BIRTH_DTE" AS "Date of Birth", "t5"."DT_DTE" AS "Pathology Report Date" FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V" "t1" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED" "t6" ON "t1"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t6"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V" "t2" ON "t6"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t2"."PRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" "t3" ON "t2"."PRPT_PROCEDURE_DATE_ID" = "t3"."DT_DATE_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" "t5" ON "t2"."PRPT_REPORT_DATE_ID" = "t5"."DT_DATE_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" "t4" ON "t1"."PT_BIRTH_DTE" = "t4"."DT_DTE" WHERE (CONTAINS("t2"."PRPT_REPORT", '("gastrointestinal stromal tumor" & "GIST")') = 1 AND "t2"."PRPT_REPORT" IS NOT NULL)

"t1"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t4"."PTX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE" "t3" ON "t4"."PTX_PROC_DATE_ID" = "t3"."DT_DATE_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PHM_PT_MEDS_MQT" "t7" ON "t1"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t7"."POD_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PHM_INVENTORY_CATALOG" "t5" ON "t7"."POD_PHARMA_INVENTORY_CTLG_ID" = "t5"."PINC_INVENTORY_CTLG_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PHM_ORDER_DTL" "t8" ON "t7"."POD_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t8"."POD_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AND "t7"."POD_PHARMA_INVENTORY_CTLG_ID" = "t8"."POD_PHARMA_INVENTORY_CTLG_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PHM_ORDER_DISPENSE_OCCR" "t9" ON "t8"."POD_PHARMA_ORDER_DETAIL_ID" = "t9"."PDO_PHARMA_ORDER_DETAIL_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE" "t6" ON "t9"."PDO_DISPNS_DATE_ID" = "t6"."DT_DATE_ID" WHERE ("t4"."PROC_ID" IN (5531) AND "t5"."PINC_GENERIC_NAME" IN ('FLOXURIDINE', 'Floxuridine ')) GROUP BY "t1"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID", "t2"."PT_MRN", "t2"."PT_DEATH_DTE", "t2"."PT_FIRST_NAME", "t2"."PT_LAST_NAME", "t3"."DT_DTE", "t4"."PCC_CODE", "t4"."PCC_DESC", 'FLOXURIDINE') , PATH_POS AS (SELECT "t1".PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID, P.PRPT_ACCESSION_NO AS "Positive KRAS" FROM BASE "t1" INNER JOIN "DV"."PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V" P ON "t1"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = P."PRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" WHERE CONTAINS(P."PRPT_REPORT", '("positive for kras" | "positive for k-ras")') = 1 ) , PATH_NEG AS (SELECT "t1".PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID, P.PRPT_ACCESSION_NO AS "Negative KRAS" FROM BASE "t1" INNER JOIN "DV"."PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V" P ON "t1"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = P."PRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" WHERE CONTAINS(P."PRPT_REPORT", '("negative for kras" | "negative for k-ras")') = 1 ) , RESECT AS (SELECT DISTINCT "t1"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID", "t3"."DT_DTE" AS "Resection Date", RTRIM("t4"."PCC_CODE") AS "Resection Code", RTRIM("t4"."PCC_DESC") AS "Resection Desc" FROM BASE "t1" INNER JOIN "DV"."CPT_PBD_PATIENT_PROCEDURE" "t4" ON "t1"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t4"."PTX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE" "t3" ON "t4"."PTX_PROC_DATE_ID" = "t3"."DT_DATE_ID" WHERE ("t4"."PCC_CODE" IN ('47120', '47130', '47122', '32484', '47399') AND "t3"."DT_DTE" = "t1"."CPT Procedure Date - PBD") ) , LABS AS (SELECT DISTINCT "t1"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AS "Deident PT #", "t2"."LTC_SUBTEST_NAME" AS "Lab-Test Name", "t3"."LTC_SUBTEST_NAME" AS "Lab-Subtest Name", "t4"."DT_DTE" AS "Lab-Performed Date", "t5"."PLR_RESULT_VALUE" AS "Lab-Test Result Value", "t5"."PLR_UNIT_MEASURE" AS "Lab-Unit Measure", CAST("t5"."PLR_TEXT_RESULT"AS VARCHAR(2000)) AS "Lab-Test Result Notes" FROM BASE "t1" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_LAB_RESULT" "t5" ON "t1"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t5"."PLR_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."LAB_TEST_CATALOG" "t2" ON "t5"."PLR_LAB_TEST_CATALOG_ID" = "t2"."LTC_LAB_TEST_CATALOG_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."LAB_TEST_CATALOG" "t3" ON "t5"."PLR_LAB_SUBTEST_CATALOG_ID" = "t3"."LTC_LAB_TEST_CATALOG_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE" "t4" ON "t5"."PLR_PERFORMED_DATE_ID" = "t4"."DT_DATE_ID" WHERE "t1"."First Dispense Date" = "t4"."DT_DTE" AND (("t2"."LTC_SUBTEST_NAME" IN ('Albumin') AND "t3"."LTC_SUBTEST_NAME" IN ('Albumin')) OR ("t2"."LTC_SUBTEST_NAME" IN ('Alkaline Phosphatase') AND "t3"."LTC_SUBTEST_NAME" IN ('Alkaline Phosphatase')) OR ("t2"."LTC_SUBTEST_NAME" IN ('AST') AND "t3"."LTC_SUBTEST_NAME" IN ('AST')) OR ("t2"."LTC_SUBTEST_NAME" IN ('Basic Metabolic Panel') AND "t3"."LTC_SUBTEST_NAME" IN ('BUN')) OR ("t2"."LTC_SUBTEST_NAME" IN ('Basic Metabolic Panel') AND "t3"."LTC_SUBTEST_NAME" IN ('Creatinine')) OR ("t2"."LTC_SUBTEST_NAME" IN ('Basic Metabolic Panel') AND "t3"."LTC_SUBTEST_NAME" IN ('Glucose')) OR ("t2"."LTC_SUBTEST_NAME" IN ('Basic Metabolic Panel (old code)') AND "t3"."LTC_SUBTEST_NAME" IN ('BUN')) OR ("t2"."LTC_SUBTEST_NAME" IN ('Basic Metabolic Panel (old code)') AND "t3"."LTC_SUBTEST_NAME" IN ('Creatinine')) OR ("t2"."LTC_SUBTEST_NAME" IN ('Basic Metabolic Panel (old code)') AND "t3"."LTC_SUBTEST_NAME" IN ('Glucose')) OR ("t2"."LTC_SUBTEST_NAME" IN ('Bilirubin, Total') AND "t3"."LTC_SUBTEST_NAME" IN ('Bilirubin, Total')) OR ("t2"."LTC_SUBTEST_NAME" IN ('CBC.') AND "t3"."LTC_SUBTEST_NAME" IN ('Abs Neut')) OR ("t2"."LTC_SUBTEST_NAME" IN ('CBC.') AND "t3"."LTC_SUBTEST_NAME" IN ('HCT')) OR ("t2"."LTC_SUBTEST_NAME" IN ('CBC.') AND "t3"."LTC_SUBTEST_NAME" IN ('HGB')) OR ("t2"."LTC_SUBTEST_NAME" IN ('CBC.') AND "t3"."LTC_SUBTEST_NAME" IN ('Platelets.')) OR ("t2"."LTC_SUBTEST_NAME" IN ('CBC.') AND "t3"."LTC_SUBTEST_NAME" IN ('WBC')) OR ("t2"."LTC_SUBTEST_NAME" IN ('CEA') AND "t3"."LTC_SUBTEST_NAME" IN ('CEA')) OR ("t2"."LTC_SUBTEST_NAME" IN ('LDH') AND "t3"."LTC_SUBTEST_NAME" IN ('LDH'))) ) SELECT B."MRN", B."Deceased Date", B."First Name", B."Last Name", B."CPT Procedure Date - PBD", B."CPT Procedure Code - PBD", B."CPT Procedure Desc - PBD", B."Generic Drug Name", B."First Dispense Date", R."Resection Date", R."Resection Code", R."Resection Desc", P."Positive KRAS", N."Negative KRAS" FROM BASE B LEFT JOIN RESECT R ON B."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = R."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN PATH_POS P ON B."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = P."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN PATH_NEG N ON B."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = N."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID"

prompt: Radiology clinical trials opened from 2008-2018

prompt: Provide a report on patients who had kyphoplasty and percutaneous screw stabilization
completion: WITH SRG AS (SELECT DISTINCT SSE_MRN, SSE_LOG_ID, SSE_SURG_DTE, SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD, SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC, SSP_SURG_SVC_CD, STRIP(SSP_SURG_LAST_NM) || ', ' || STRIP(SSP_SURG_FIRST_NM) AS SURGEON FROM IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE ON SSE_LOG_ID = SSP_LOG_ID WHERE 1=1 AND SSE_SURG_DTE >= '2013-01-01' AND(STRIP(SSP_SURG_LAST_NM) || ', ' || STRIP(SSP_SURG_FIRST_NM) like '%BILSKY%' OR STRIP(SSP_SURG_LAST_NM) || ', ' || STRIP(SSP_SURG_FIRST_NM) like '%LAUFER%' OR STRIP(SSP_SURG_LAST_NM) || ', ' || STRIP(SSP_SURG_FIRST_NM) like '%BARZILAI%' OR STRIP(SSP_SURG_LAST_NM) || ', ' || STRIP(SSP_SURG_FIRST_NM) like '%NEWMAN%') ) , TMP AS (SELECT SSE_MRN FROM SRG GROUP BY SSE_MRN HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT SSE_LOG_ID) > 1) , X AS (SELECT DISTINCT SRG.* FROM SRG JOIN TMP ON SRG.SSE_MRN = TMP.SSE_MRN) SELECT SSE_MRN, SSE_LOG_ID, SURGEON, SSE_SURG_DTE, LISTAGG(COALESCE(STRIP(SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD), '') || ' | ' || COALESCE(STRIP(CAST(SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC AS VARCHAR(1000))), '') , CHR(13) || CHR(10)) WITHIN GROUP( ORDER BY SSE_MRN, SSE_SURG_DTE, SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD, SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC) AS SURGERIES FROM X GROUP BY SSE_MRN, SSE_LOG_ID, SURGEON, SSE_SURG_DTE

prompt: Please provide an updated version of DataLine Report SKI27912 with date range between 1/1/2022 to 12/31/2023.
