prompt: test
completion: WITH CONFIG AS (SELECT '(?i)....' AS DMP_SITE_PTR, '(?i)leukem|myelodys|mds|myeloid' AS DMP_TUMOR_PTR FROM SYSIBM.SYSDUMMY1) , CHT AS (SELECT CHT_COHORT_ID FROM DVCMS.COHORT WHERE CHT_COHORT_ID = 9018) , PTS AS (SELECT CHP_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID AS COHORT_PID, PT_MRN AS CHT_MRN, CHT_COHORT_ID, DATE(CHP_CREATED_DT) ID_DATE, DAYS(CURRENT date) - DAYS(CHP_CREATED_DT) AS DAYS_ON_COHORT FROM DVCMS.COHORT_PATIENT JOIN CHT ON CHP_COHORT_ID = CHT_COHORT_ID JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON CHP_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID ) , GENE_MATCH AS (SELECT DISTINCT PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID AS GENE_PID , PRPT_PATH_RPT_ID AS GENE_RID , PRPT_MODIFIED_DT, PATH_RPT_DATE , PT_MRN, GENE, PRPT_ACCESSION_NO, ABERRATIONTYPE, LOCUS, AA_CHANGE, NUCLEOTIDE, SEARCH_HIT2, METHOD, SEARCH_HIT1 FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_STRUCTURED_RESULTS_V WHERE 1=1 AND GENE IN ('NPM1', 'FLT3', 'IDH1', 'IDH2', 'TP53' ,'U2AF1' , 'SRSF2' , 'ZRSR2' , 'SF3B1' , 'EIF1AX' , 'PHF5A' , 'PCBP1' , 'HNRNPCL1' , 'RBM10' , 'FUBP1' ) AND (PATH_RPT_DATE >= CURRENT date - 8 DAYS OR DATE(PRPT_MODIFIED_DT) >= CURRENT date - 7 DAYS) ) , DMP_DX_PRE AS (SELECT DISTINCT PDRX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID AS P_ID, T.*, GENE_RID , PRPT_MODIFIED_DT, PATH_RPT_DATE , PT_MRN AS MRN, GENE, PRPT_ACCESSION_NO, ABERRATIONTYPE, LOCUS, AA_CHANGE, NUCLEOTIDE, SEARCH_HIT2, METHOD, SEARCH_HIT1 , PDRX_DMP_PATIENT_ID, PDRX_DMP_SAMPLE_ID FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML DT CROSS JOIN XMLTABLE('$c/root/*' PASSING DT.PDRX_XML_VALUE AS "c" COLUMNS PRIMARY_SITE VARCHAR(264) PATH '../meta-data/primary_site', TUMOR_TYPE_NAME VARCHAR(264) PATH '../meta-data/tumor_type_name' , GENE_PANEL VARCHAR(264) PATH '../meta-data/gene-panel' , PART_DESCRIPTION VARCHAR(264) PATH '../meta-data/part_description' , DT_PROCEDURE VARCHAR(100) PATH '../meta-data/dt_procedure') T JOIN GENE_MATCH ON GENE_RID = DT.PDRX_PATH_RPT_ID) , DMP_DX AS (SELECT DISTINCT DMP.* FROM DMP_DX_PRE DMP JOIN CONFIG ON DV.REGEX(DMP_TUMOR_PTR, TUMOR_TYPE_NAME, 'start') > 0) SELECT DISTINCT MRN, TRIM(PT_LAST_NAME) AS "Last Name", TRIM(PT_FIRST_NAME) AS "First Name", TRIM(PT_BIRTH_DTE) AS "Date of Birth", TRIM(PT_DEATH_DTE) AS "Deceased Date", TRIM(PT_VITAL_STATUS) AS "Vital Status", TRIM(PT_SEX_DESC) AS "Gender" , PATH_RPT_DATE AS "Report Date" , DATE(PRPT_MODIFIED_DT) AS "Modified Date" , TRIM(GENE) AS "Gene" , TRIM(PRPT_ACCESSION_NO) AS "Accession No" , TRIM(ABERRATIONTYPE) AS "Aberration Type" , TRIM(LOCUS) AS "Locus" , TRIM(AA_CHANGE) AS "Amino Acid Change" , TRIM(NUCLEOTIDE) AS "Nucleotide" , TRIM(SEARCH_HIT2) AS "Search Hit2" , TRIM(PART_DESCRIPTION) AS "Part Description" , TRIM(GENE_PANEL) AS "Gene Panel" , TRIM(DT_PROCEDURE) AS "dt_procedure" , TRIM(METHOD) AS "Method" , TRIM(SEARCH_HIT1) AS "Search Hit1" , PDRX_DMP_PATIENT_ID AS DMP_PATIENT_ID, PDRX_DMP_SAMPLE_ID AS DMP_SAMPLE_ID , DAYS_ON_COHORT AS "Days Pt on Cohort" FROM DMP_DX JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = P_ID LEFT JOIN PTS ON COHORT_PID = P_ID ORDER BY MRN, PATH_RPT_DATE, DATE(PRPT_MODIFIED_DT), "Gene", "Locus", "Amino Acid Change" ; SELECT DISTINCT "t1"."PT_MRN" AS "MRN" , "t2"."PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_DESC" AS "Pathology Report Type" , "t3"."DT_DTE" AS "Pathology Procedure Date" , "t4"."DT_DTE" AS "Pathology Report Date" , DATE(PRPT_CREATED_DT) AS "Created Date" , "t5"."PRPT_ACCESSION_NO" AS "Pathology Report" , VARCHAR(PRPT_REPORT, 32000) AS "Report Text" FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V" "t1" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED" "t6" ON "t1"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t6"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V" "t5" ON "t6"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t5"."PRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATH_RPRT_TYPE_LOOKUP" "t2" ON "t5"."PRPT_REPORT_TYPE" = "t2"."PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_CD" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" "t3" ON "t5"."PRPT_PROCEDURE_DATE_ID" = "t3"."DT_DATE_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" "t4" ON "t5"."PRPT_REPORT_DATE_ID" = "t4"."DT_DATE_ID" WHERE 1=1 AND "t2"."PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_DESC" IN ('Diagnostic Molecular Genetics', 'Diagnostic Molecular Pathology') AND CONTAINS("t5"."PRPT_REPORT", '"positive for flt3"') = 1 AND "t5"."PRPT_REPORT" IS NOT NULL AND (DATE(PRPT_CREATED_DT) >= CURRENT date - 8 DAYS OR PRPT_REPORT_DTE >= CURRENT date - 8 DAYS ) ORDER BY "t4"."DT_DTE" DESC ;

prompt: Identify all patients who have been seen in the Pediatrics Long Term Follow-up and Peds ASP clinics since 2010 who are alive, were initially diagnosed at 21 or younger, and have only had one cancer diagnosis.
completion: WITH APPT AS (SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CPE_ENC_DTE >= '2010-01-01' AND CLD_DEPT_NAME IN ('PEDS ASP 1275', 'PEDS ASP 53', 'PEDS ASP 53 NP', 'PEDS LONG TERM 1275', 'PEDS LT 1275 NP')), CDB AS (SELECT TM_MRN, TM_DX_DTE, TM_HIST_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS HIST_DESC FROM APPT JOIN IDB.CDB_TUMOR ON TM_MRN = CPE_MRN JOIN IDB.CLM ON CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PT_MRN = TM_MRN WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('3', '6', '7', '8') AND YEAR(TM_DX_DTE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) <= 21 AND PT_DATE_OF_DEATH IS NULL), MULTI AS (SELECT A.TM_MRN AS MULTI_MRN FROM CDB A JOIN IDB.CDB_TUMOR B ON A.TM_MRN = B.TM_MRN WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('3', '6', '7', '8') GROUP BY A.TM_MRN HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT TM_CDB_SEQ_NO) > 1) SELECT PT_MRN, A.AV_DESC AS RACE, PT_SEX, TM_HIST_CD, HIST_DESC, TM_DX_DTE, YEAR(TM_DX_DTE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) AS AGE_AT_DX, PLA_LST_APPT_DTE, DAYS(PLA_LST_APPT_DTE) - DAYS(TM_DX_DTE) AS DAYS_FROM_DX_TO_LST_APPT FROM CDB JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PT_MRN = TM_MRN JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY ON PLA_MRN = TM_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS A ON A.AV_ELEMENT = 'RACE' AND A.AV_CODE = PT_RACE LEFT JOIN MULTI ON MULTI_MRN = TM_MRN WHERE MULTI_MRN IS NULL

prompt: Identify specified types of melanoma patients in the Cancer Database and using pathology report free text searches.
completion: WITH PATH AS (SELECT PRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID AS PATH_DEID, "PRPT_ACCESSION_NO" AS "Pathology Report", "DT_DTE" AS "Pathology Report Date" FROM "DV"."PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V" JOIN "DV"."DATE" ON "PRPT_REPORT_DATE_ID" = "DT_DATE_ID" WHERE CONTAINS("PRPT_REPORT", '("melanoma" & "acral")') <> '0' AND "DT_DTE" BETWEEN '1995-1-1' AND '2010-12-31' ), CDB AS (SELECT "t1"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AS CDB_DEID, "t3"."DT_DTE" AS "CDB Tumor Diagnosis Date", "t4"."DXCC_ICD_CODE" AS "ICD-O Histology Code", "t4"."DXCC_ICD_MSK_DESC" AS "ICD-O Histology Desc", "t5"."ICSC_SITE_CD" AS "ICD-O Site Code", "t5"."ICSC_ICDO_SITE_MSK_DESC" AS "ICD-O Site Desc", "t6"."TCA_CASE_STS_DESC" AS "Case Status" FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED" "t1" JOIN "DV"."CDB_TUMOR_V" "t9" ON "t1"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t9"."CDTM_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" JOIN "DV"."DATE" "t3" ON "t9"."CDTM_DX_DATE_ID" = "t3"."DT_DATE_ID" JOIN "DV"."DIAGNOSIS_CODE_CAT_ICDO_V" "t4" ON "t9"."CDTM_DX_CATALOG_ID" = "t4"."DXCC_DX_CATALOG_ID" JOIN "DV"."ICDO_SITE_CATALOG_V" "t5" ON "t9"."CDTM_SITE_CATALOG_ID" = "t5"."ICSC_SITE_CATALOG_ID" JOIN "DV"."TUMOR_CASE_ATTRIBUTES" "t6" ON "t9"."CDTM_CASE_ATTR_ID" = "t6"."TUMOR_CASE_ATTR_ID" WHERE "t4"."DXCC_ICD_CODE" IN ('M8744/2', 'M8744/3') AND "t3"."DT_DTE" BETWEEN '1995-1-1' AND '2010-12-31' ) SELECT "PT_MRN" AS "MRN", "CDB Tumor Diagnosis Date", "ICD-O Histology Code", "ICD-O Histology Desc", "ICD-O Site Code", "ICD-O Site Desc", "Case Status", "Pathology Report", "Pathology Report Date" FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V" "t2" LEFT JOIN CDB ON PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = CDB_DEID LEFT JOIN PATH ON PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PATH_DEID WHERE COALESCE(CDB_DEID, PATH_DEID) IS NOT NULL

prompt: Provide a list of pediatric patients who have had IMPACT testing and whether they have had a Clinical Genetics Service visit or order.
completion: WITH IMPACT AS (SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN, PT_BIRTH_DTE AS DOB, YEAR(CURRENT DATE - PT_BIRTH_DTE) AS AGE, PDWS_DESCRIPTION, DATE(PDRX_CREATED_DT) AS CREATE_DATE, DT_PROCEDURE AS PROCEDURE_DATE FROM DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML DT ON PDRX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML_SETTINGS ON PDRX_PATH_DMP_RESULTS_XML_ID = PDRXS_PATH_DMP_RESULTS_XML_ID JOIN DVDMC.PATHOLOGY_DMP_WEBSVC_SETTINGS ON PDRXS_SETTING_ID = PDWS_SETTING_ID CROSS JOIN XMLTABLE('$c/root/*' PASSING DT.PDRX_XML_VALUE AS "c" COLUMNS DT_PROCEDURE VARCHAR(40) PATH '../meta-data/dt_procedure') T WHERE 1=1 AND PDWS_NAME like '%IMPACT%' AND YEAR(DATE(PDRX_CREATED_DT) - PT_BIRTH_DTE) <= 21 ) , CPE AS (SELECT CPE_MRN, CPE_ENC_DTE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CPE_MRN ORDER BY CPE_ENC_DTE DESC) AS RN FROM IMPACT JOIN IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER ON PT_MRN = CPE_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CRE_RES_TYP IN ('Physician') AND(CLD_DEPT_NAME like '%CLINICAL GENETICS%' OR CLD_DEPT_ABBR like '%CGS%' OR CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 = 'GNT') ) , OO AS (SELECT OO_MRN, OO_ENTER_DTE, OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE, OO_ORD_ID, OO_ORD_GUID, OO_ORD_NAME FROM IMPACT JOIN IDB.OMS_ORDER ON PT_MRN = OO_MRN WHERE OO_ORD_STS_CD NOT IN ('CANC', 'CANP', 'AUC3') AND OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID IN ('5000002541073000', '9000013641100730', '9000008014100730', '2000004514073020', '1000004404073020', '9000010362100730') ) SELECT IM.PT_MRN, DOB, AGE, PT_SEX, R.AV_DESC AS "Race", E.AV_DESC AS "Ethnicity", PDWS_DESCRIPTION, CREATE_DATE, PROCEDURE_DATE, MAX(CASE WHEN CPE_MRN IS NOT NULL THEN 'Y' END) AS "Clinical Genetics Visit", MAX(CASE WHEN OO_MRN IS NOT NULL THEN 'Y' END) AS "Order" FROM IMPACT IM JOIN IDB.PATIENT P ON IM.PT_MRN = P.PT_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS R ON PT_RACE = R.AV_CODE AND R.AV_ELEMENT = 'RACE' LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS E ON PT_PT_ETHNICITY = E.AV_CODE AND E.AV_ELEMENT = 'PT_ETHNICITY' LEFT JOIN CPE ON IM.PT_MRN = CPE_MRN LEFT JOIN OO ON IM.PT_MRN = OO_MRN GROUP BY IM.PT_MRN, DOB, AGE, PT_SEX, R.AV_DESC, E.AV_DESC, PDWS_DESCRIPTION, CREATE_DATE, PROCEDURE_DATE

prompt: Provide a list of patients diagnosed with liposarcoma between since 2010.
completion: WITH CTE AS (SELECT DISTINCT "t1"."PT_MRN" AS "MRN", "t1"."PT_BIRTH_DTE" AS "Date of Birth", "t2"."DXCC_ICD_CODE" AS "ICD-O Histology Code", "t2"."DXCC_ICD_MSK_DESC" AS "ICD-O Histology Description", "t3"."ICSC_SITE_CD" AS "ICD-O Site Code", "t3"."ICSC_ICDO_SITE_MSK_DESC" AS "ICD-O Site Description", "t4"."DT_DTE" AS "Tumor Diagnosis Date" FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V" "t1" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED" "t5" ON "t1"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t5"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."CDB_TUMOR_V" "t6" ON "t5"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t6"."CDTM_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DIAGNOSIS_CODE_CAT_ICDO_V" "t2" ON "t6"."CDTM_DX_CATALOG_ID" = "t2"."DXCC_DX_CATALOG_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."ICDO_SITE_CATALOG_V" "t3" ON "t6"."CDTM_SITE_CATALOG_ID" = "t3"."ICSC_SITE_CATALOG_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" "t4" ON "t6"."CDTM_DX_DATE_ID" = "t4"."DT_DATE_ID" WHERE ("t2"."DXCC_ICD_CODE" IN ('M8850/3', 'M8851/3', 'M8852/3', 'M8853/3', 'M8854/3', 'M8855/3', 'M8857/3', 'M8858/3', 'M8860/3') AND "t4"."DT_DTE" BETWEEN '2010-1-1' AND CURRENT date) ) SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN, GENE, RESULT FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_STRUCTURED_RESULTS_V IMP JOIN CTE ON MRN = PT_MRN WHERE METHOD = 'IMPACT'

prompt: Total visits - ambulatory sites - 7/1/2020 - 6/30/2021
completion: WITH Q AS (SELECT PT_MRN AS "MRN", DT_DTE AS "Encounter Date", PENC_PT_ENC_ID "Encounter ID", STS.EDC_DEPT_DESC AS "Encounter Status", DEPT.EDC_DEPT_DESC AS "Clinical Department", SVC.EDC_DEPT_DESC AS "Clinical Service", ENDP_DEPT_NAME AS "Department Name", ENDP_CENTER_FULL_NAME "Center Name", ENR_RES_NAME AS "Primary Resource Name", ENVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME AS "Visit Type Name" FROM DV.PATIENT_ENCOUNTER JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PENC_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID JOIN DV.DATE ON PENC_ENC_DATE_ID = DT_DATE_ID LEFT JOIN DV.ENCOUNTER_DESC_CATALOG STS ON PENC_APPT_STS = STS.EDC_DEPT_ABBREV AND STS.EDC_GROUP_ID = 'STS' JOIN DV.ENCOUNTER_DEPARTMENT ON PENC_DEPT_ID = ENDP_ENC_DEPT_ID JOIN DV.ENCOUNTER_SCHD_RESOURCES ON PENC_PT_ENC_ID = ENSR_PT_ENC_ID AND ENSR_PRIMARY_RES_IND = 'Y' JOIN DV.ENCOUNTER_RESOURCE ON ENSR_RES_ID = ENR_ENC_RES_ID JOIN DV.ENCOUNTER_VISIT_TYPE ON PENC_VISIT_TYPE_ID = ENVT_ENC_VISIT_TYPE_ID LEFT JOIN DV.ENCOUNTER_DESC_CATALOG DEPT ON ENDP_SERVICE_DEPT_GRP_6 = DEPT.EDC_DEPT_ABBREV AND DEPT.EDC_GROUP_ID = '6' LEFT JOIN DV.ENCOUNTER_DESC_CATALOG SVC ON ENDP_SERVICE_SPECIALTY_GRP_8 = SVC.EDC_DEPT_ABBREV AND SVC.EDC_GROUP_ID = '8' WHERE PENC_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND DT_DTE BETWEEN '2020-07-01' AND '2021-06-30' AND ((ENDP_CENTER_FULL_NAME IN ('MSK Commack', 'MSK Bergen', 'MSK Monmouth', 'MSK Nassau', 'MSK Basking Ridge', 'MSK Westchester', 'MSK-53rd St', 'MSK-1919 Madison')) OR (ENDP_CENTER_FULL_NAME = 'MSK-68th St' AND SVC.EDC_DEPT_DESC = 'Urology') OR (ENDP_CENTER_FULL_NAME = 'MSK-300 E66' AND SVC.EDC_DEPT_DESC = 'Breast')) ) SELECT "Center Name", "Clinical Department", "Clinical Service", "Department Name", "Primary Resource Name", "Visit Type Name", COUNT(DISTINCT "MRN") PATIENT_CT, COUNT(DISTINCT "Encounter ID") ENCOUNTER_CT FROM Q GROUP BY "Clinical Department", "Clinical Service", "Department Name", "Primary Resource Name", "Center Name", "Visit Type Name"

WITH POA AS (SELECT DISTINCT CLE_USER_ID POA_CLE_USER_ID, MEI_JOB_TITLE, MEI_MSK_DIVISION_DESC FROM IDB.CL_USER JOIN IDB.MSKCC_EMPLOYEE_INFO ON (SUBSTR(TRIM(CLE_EC_EMP_ID) || '0000000', 1, 9) = MEI_EMPLOYEE_ID OR SUBSTR(SUBSTR(CLE_EC_EMP_ID, 1, 5) || '0000000', 1, 9) = MEI_EMPLOYEE_ID) WHERE CLE_REC_STS = 'Active' AND UPPER(MEI_JOB_TITLE) LIKE 'OFFICE COORD%' ) SELECT DISTINCT OU_DISPLAY_NAME "Entered by", OU_OCCUPATION "OMS Occupation", MEI_JOB_TITLE "Workday Occupation", MEI_MSK_DIVISION_DESC "Workday Dept", OOC_REV_CAT_DEPT "Order Category Dept", OP_DISPLAY_NAME "Provider", COUNT(*) "Orders Placed" FROM IDB.OMS_ORDER JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_CATALOG ON OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID = OOC_MSTR_ITEM_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_STATUS ON OO_ORD_STS_CD = OSTS_ORD_STS_CD JOIN IDB.OMS_USER ON OO_USER_GUID = OU_USER_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_PROVIDER ON OO_PVDR_GUID = OP_PVDR_GUID JOIN POA ON OU_LOGON_ID = POA_CLE_USER_ID WHERE OO_ORD_STS_CD NOT IN ('CANP', 'CANC', 'AUC3') AND OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE BETWEEN '2018-08-01' AND '2019-07-31' GROUP BY OU_DISPLAY_NAME, OU_OCCUPATION, MEI_JOB_TITLE, MEI_MSK_DIVISION_DESC, OOC_REV_CAT_DEPT, OP_DISPLAY_NAME ORDER BY 1, 5

prompt: For Bone Marrow Transplant patients in 2010, 2011, 2012 provide average time in hours from  enter date of Inpatient Physicial or Occupational Therapy consult orders until the Initial Eval/Re-evaluation PT note is placed into Clin Doc.
completion: WITH BMT_PAT AS (SELECT CC_MRN, CC_ACCT_NO, YEAR(CC_EFF_DTE) AS BMT_YEAR, CS_HOSP_SVC FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CASE ON CS_ACCT_NO = CC_ACCT_NO WHERE CC_CLSF_CD IN ('41.0', '41.00', '41.01', '41.02', '41.03', '41.04', '41.05', '41.06', '41.07', '41.08', '41.09') AND CC_EFF_DTE BETWEEN '2012-10-01' AND '2012-12-31' ) , PT_OT_ORD AS (SELECT OO_MRN, OO_ACCT_NO, OO_ORD_GUID, OO_VISIT_GUID, OO_ORD_ID, OO_ORD_NAME, OOC_ITEM_DESC, OO_ENTER_DTE , OO_SUMMARY_LINE, OO_ORD_STS_CD FROM BMT_PAT JOIN IDB.OMS_ORDER ON CC_ACCT_NO = OO_ACCT_NO AND (OO_ORD_NAME = 'Occupational Therapy Inpatient Consult' OR OO_ORD_NAME = 'Physical Therapy Inpatient Consult') JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_CATALOG ON OOC_MSTR_ITEM_GUID = OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID AND UCASE(OOC_REV_CAT_DEPT) = 'REHABILITATION' JOIN IDB.OMS_CLIENT_VISIT ON OCV_VISIT_GUID = OO_VISIT_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_SERVICE ON OCV_SVC_GUID = OS_SVC_GUID JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON OO_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE OO_ORD_STS_CD IN ('AUC1', 'COMP', 'AUA2', 'DISC') ) , DOC AS (SELECT DISTINCT CDD_MRN MRN, CDD_ACCT_NO, CDD_DOC_NAME DOC_NAME, CDD_VISIT_GUID, CDD_ENTER_DTE DOC_ENTER_DTE, CDD_ENTER_DT, CDD_SIGNED_DTE DOC_SIGNED_DTE , CDD_AUTHORED_DTE DOC_AUTH_DTE, CDD_CREATE_DT, CDD_USER_GUID, OU_DISPLAY_NAME, OU_OCCUPATION, OU_ORD_ROLE_TYPE FROM PT_OT_ORD JOIN CDD_ENTER_DT CDD_ENTER_DT ON OO_MRN = CDD_MRN AND OO_ACCT_NO = CDD_ACCT_NO AND OO_VISIT_GUID = CDD_VISIT_GUID JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION ON CDO_DOC_GUID = CDD_DOC_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_USER ON CDD_USER_GUID = OU_USER_GUID WHERE CDD_DOC_NAME IN ('Initial Evaluation/Re-Evaluation - Occupational Therapy', 'Initial/Re-Eval - Physical Therapy') AND CDD_CANCEL_IND = '0' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND = '0' AND CDO_ENTER_DTE > '2008-01-01' ) SELECT OO_MRN, OO_ORD_ID, YEAR(OO_ENTER_DTE) ORD_YR, DOC_NAME, DOC_ENTER_DTE, (DAYS(CDD_ENTER_DT)*24*60 + HOUR(CDD_ENTER_DT)*60 + MINUTE(CDD_ENTER_DT))/60 - (DAYS(OO_ENTER_DT)*24*60 + HOUR(OO_ENTER_DT)*60 + MINUTE(OO_ENTER_DT))/60 DIFF_IN_HR FROM PT_OT_ORD LEFT JOIN DOC ON OO_MRN = MRN AND OO_ACCT_NO = CDD_ACCT_NO AND OO_VISIT_GUID = CDD_VISIT_GUID

prompt: Hemoglobin, absolute neutrophil count, absolute lymphocyte count, white blood cells, platelet, IL-2, IL-6, ferritin, IL-10, and CRP labs for subset of MRNs.
completion: SELECT * FROM IDB.LAB_RESULTS JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PT_MRN = LR_MRN WHERE LR_SUBTEST_NAME IN ('HGB', 'Hemoglobin, Total', 'Abs Lymph', 'Abs Neut', 'WBC', 'Platelets.', 'Platelets', 'Soluble IL2 Receptor serum, Viracor', 'Interleukin 6', 'Interleukin 6..', 'Interleukin-6 (IL-6) Serum', 'Interleukin 10', 'C-Reactive Protein') AND LR_PERFORMED_DTE = CURRENT date - 1 DAY ;

prompt:
Provide a list of stage IV esophagogastric patients patients with the following mutations:

EGFR or MET amplification on IMPACT / ACCESS

FGFR2 amplification, fusion. or mutation on IMPACT, ACCESS, or ARCHER
completion: WITH GENE AS (SELECT PT_MRN, PRPT_ACCESSION_NO, PATH_PROCEDURE_DATE, GENE, METHOD, ABERRATIONTYPE FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_STRUCTURED_RESULTS_V WHERE GENE = 'FGFR2' AND (METHOD IN ('IMPACT', 'Archer') OR METHOD like 'ACCESS%') UNION SELECT PT_MRN, PRPT_ACCESSION_NO, PATH_PROCEDURE_DATE, GENE, METHOD, ABERRATIONTYPE FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_STRUCTURED_RESULTS_V WHERE GENE IN ('EGFR', 'MET') AND (METHOD IN ('IMPACT') OR METHOD like 'ACCESS%') AND ABERRATIONTYPE = 'copy number gain' ) , CDB_P AS (SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN MRN, PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID DEID, 'CDB' SOURCE FROM DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS JOIN DV.CDB_TUMOR_V ON CDTM_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID JOIN DV.DATE_V ON CDTM_DX_DATE_ID = DT_DATE_ID JOIN DV.DIAGNOSIS_CODE_CAT_ICDO_V ON CDTM_DX_CATALOG_ID = DXCC_DX_CATALOG_ID JOIN DV.ICDO_SITE_CATALOG_V ON CDTM_SITE_CATALOG_ID = ICSC_SITE_CATALOG_ID JOIN DV.TUMOR_CASE_ATTRIBUTES_V ON CDTM_CASE_ATTR_ID = TUMOR_CASE_ATTR_ID JOIN DV.SEERGROUPING ON DV.SEERF_ICDO(ICSC_SITE_CD, DXCC_ICD_CODE) = RECODE WHERE (ICSC_SITE_CD like 'C15%' OR ICSC_SITE_CD like 'C16%') AND TCA_CASE_STS_DESC IN ('Completed', 'Consult only', 'Non-Index tumor', 'Pathology only') ) , ICD_P AS (SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN MRN , PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID DEID, 'ICD' SOURCE FROM DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS JOIN DV.PATIENT_DIAGNOSIS_FINAL_ALL_V ON PDX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID JOIN DV.DATE_V ON PDX_DX_DATE_ID = DT_DATE_ID JOIN DV.DIAGNOSIS_CATALOG ON PDX_DX_CATALOG_ID = DXCC_DX_CATALOG_ID WHERE (DXCC_ICD_CODE like 'C15%' OR DXCC_ICD_CODE like 'C16%') AND PT_MRN NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT MRN FROM CDB_P) ) , CLINDOC AS (SELECT DISTINCT CDD_MRN MRN , CDD_DEID DEID, 'CLINDOC' SOURCE FROM DV.CLINDOC_FULL_TEXT_V WHERE CONTAINS("CDD_DOCUMENT_FULL_TEXT", '("metastatic" OR "stage 4")') = 1 ) , PTS AS (SELECT MRN , DEID, SOURCE FROM CDB_P UNION SELECT MRN , DEID, SOURCE FROM ICD_P UNION SELECT MRN , DEID, SOURCE FROM CLINDOC) SELECT * FROM GENE JOIN PTS ON PT_MRN = MRN

prompt: Need a report for all MOSED cases performed in 2021 with the patient's MRN, date of service, radiologist name who performed the procedure, and procedure name.
completion: SELECT OL_MRN AS MRN, OL_SURG_DTE AS DOS, CRE_RES_NAME AS RADIOLOGIST, OP_PROC_NAME AS PROCEDURE_NAME FROM IDB.OR_LOG LEFT JOIN IDB.OR_LOG_ANES_TYPES ON OL_LOG_ID = OLAT_LOG_ID JOIN IDB.OR_LOG_ALL_SURG ON OL_LOG_ID = OLAS_LOG_ID AND OLAS_SURG_ROLE = 'Primary' AND OLAS_SURG_SVC = 'IR' JOIN IDB.OR_LOG_ALL_PROC ON OLAS_LOG_ID = OLAP_LOG_ID AND OLAS_PNL_NO = OLAP_PNL_NO JOIN IDB.OR_PROC ON OLAP_OR_PROC_ID = OP_OR_PROC_ID AND OP_OR_PROC_ID <> '4820' JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CRE_RES_ID = OLAS_RES_ID WHERE OL_SURG_DTE BETWEEN '2022-01-01' AND '2022-12-31' AND OL_LOG_STS_CD NOT IN ('4', '6') AND OLAT_LOG_ID IS NULL AND OLAP_ANES_TYPE ='MOSED' ; SELECT OL_MRN AS MRN, OL_SURG_DTE AS DOS, CRE_RES_NAME AS RADIOLOGIST, OP_PROC_NAME AS PROCEDURE_NAME FROM IDB.OR_LOG LEFT JOIN IDB.OR_LOG_ANES_TYPES ON OL_LOG_ID = OLAT_LOG_ID JOIN IDB.OR_LOG_ALL_SURG ON OL_LOG_ID = OLAS_LOG_ID AND OLAS_SURG_ROLE = 'Primary' AND OLAS_SURG_SVC = 'IR' JOIN IDB.OR_LOG_ALL_PROC ON OLAS_LOG_ID = OLAP_LOG_ID AND OLAS_PNL_NO = OLAP_PNL_NO JOIN IDB.OR_PROC ON OLAP_OR_PROC_ID = OP_OR_PROC_ID AND OP_OR_PROC_ID <> '4820' JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CRE_RES_ID = OLAS_RES_ID WHERE OL_SURG_DTE BETWEEN '2021-01-01' AND '2021-12-31' AND OL_LOG_STS_CD NOT IN ('4', '6') AND OLAT_LOG_ID IS NULL AND OLAP_ANES_TYPE ='MOSED' ; SELECT OL_MRN AS MRN, OL_SURG_DTE AS DOS, CRE_RES_NAME AS RADIOLOGIST, OP_PROC_NAME AS PROCEDURE_NAME FROM IDB.OR_LOG LEFT JOIN IDB.OR_LOG_ANES_TYPES ON OL_LOG_ID = OLAT_LOG_ID JOIN IDB.OR_LOG_ALL_SURG ON OL_LOG_ID = OLAS_LOG_ID AND OLAS_SURG_ROLE = 'Primary' AND OLAS_SURG_SVC = 'IR' JOIN IDB.OR_LOG_ALL_PROC ON OLAS_LOG_ID = OLAP_LOG_ID AND OLAS_PNL_NO = OLAP_PNL_NO JOIN IDB.OR_PROC ON OLAP_OR_PROC_ID = OP_OR_PROC_ID AND OP_OR_PROC_ID <> '4820' JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CRE_RES_ID = OLAS_RES_ID WHERE OL_SURG_DTE BETWEEN '2020-01-01' AND '2020-12-31' AND OL_LOG_STS_CD NOT IN ('4', '6') AND OLAT_LOG_ID IS NULL AND OLAP_ANES_TYPE ='MOSED' ;

prompt: Provide a daily list of scheduled bone marrow aspirates that also have a cytogenetics order
completion: WITH APPTS AS (SELECT CPE_MRN AS MRN, PT_LAST_NAME AS "Last Name", PT_FIRST_NAME AS "First Name" , CPE_ENC_DTE AS "Appt Date", TIME(CPE_APPT_DT) AS "Appt Time", CPE_CPE_APPT_STS AS APPT_STATUS , A.CLD_DEPT_NAME AS DEPT, B.CRE_RES_NAME AS MD, B.CRE_RES_ID AS MD_ID, A.CLD_CLD_PHY_LOC AS FLOOR , CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME AS "Visit Type Name" FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT A ON CPE_DEPT_ID = A.CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE B ON B.CRE_RES_ID = CPE_VST_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID AND CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME like '%BONE MAR%' AND CVT_REC_TYP = 'Visit Type' JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PT_MRN = CPE_MRN WHERE 1=1 AND CRE_RES_STS = 'Active' AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT date AND CURRENT date + 2 DAY AND CPE_MRN <> '' AND CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Sch') ) , ORDERS_PREP AS (SELECT DISTINCT OO_MRN AS MRN_PREP , OO_ORD_GUID AS PREP_OO_ORD_GUID FROM APPTS JOIN IDB.OMS_ORDER ON MRN = OO_MRN AND OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID IN ('2000001500073001' ,'9000008923100730' ) JOIN IDB.OMS_USER_ORDERS ON OO_ORD_GUID = OUO_ORD_GUID LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_FORM_FIELD ON OO_ENTRY_FRM_GUID = OFF_ENTRY_FRM_GUID LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_USER_DATA ON OUD_ORD_GUID = OO_ORD_GUID AND OFF_DI_CD = OUD_USER_DI_CD WHERE 1=1 AND OO_ORD_STS_CD NOT IN ('CANC', 'CANP', 'AUC3') AND OUO_REQ_FOR_DTE BETWEEN "Appt Date" AND "Appt Date" + 2 DAY AND OFF_FLD_LABEL = 'Clinical Diagnosis:' AND (UPPER(OUD_USER_DI_VALUE) like '%MULT%MYELOMA%' OR UPPER(OUD_USER_DI_VALUE) like '%PLASMA%CELL%NEOPLASM%' OR UPPER(OUD_USER_DI_VALUE) like 'MM %' ) ) , ORDERS_LISTAGG AS (SELECT OO_MRN AS MRN , "Last Name" , "First Name" , "Appt Date" , "Appt Time" , "Visit Type Name" , OUO_REQ_FOR_DTE AS "Order Requested For Date" , OO_ORD_NAME AS "Order Item Name" , OO_REQ_TME_PRIO AS "Time Priority" , OUO_STS_DESC AS "Status" , LISTAGG(COALESCE(TRIM(OFF_FLD_LABEL), '') || ' ' || COALESCE(TRIM(CAST(OUD_USER_DI_VALUE AS VARCHAR(32000))), '') , CHR(13) || CHR(10)) WITHIN GROUP( ORDER BY OO_MRN, OFF_FLD_LABEL) AS RESULT FROM ORDERS_PREP JOIN IDB.OMS_ORDER ON OO_ORD_GUID = PREP_OO_ORD_GUID AND OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID IN ('2000001500073001' ,'9000008923100730') JOIN APPTS ON MRN_PREP = MRN JOIN IDB.OMS_USER_ORDERS ON OO_ORD_GUID = OUO_ORD_GUID LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_FORM_FIELD ON OO_ENTRY_FRM_GUID = OFF_ENTRY_FRM_GUID LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_USER_DATA ON OUD_ORD_GUID = OO_ORD_GUID AND OFF_DI_CD = OUD_USER_DI_CD WHERE 1=1 AND OO_ORD_STS_CD NOT IN ('CANC', 'CANP', 'AUC3') AND OUO_REQ_FOR_DTE BETWEEN "Appt Date" AND "Appt Date" + 2 DAY GROUP BY OO_MRN , "Last Name" , "First Name" , "Appt Date" , "Appt Time" , "Visit Type Name" , OUO_REQ_FOR_DTE , OO_REQ_TME_PRIO , OO_ORD_NAME , OUO_STS_DESC ) SELECT MRN , TRIM("Last Name") AS "Last Name" , TRIM("First Name") AS "First Name" , "Appt Date" , "Appt Time" , TRIM("Visit Type Name") AS "Visit Type Name" , "Order Requested For Date" , TRIM("Order Item Name") AS "Order Item Name" , TRIM("Time Priority") AS "Time Priority" , TRIM("Status") AS "Status" , RESULT AS "All Order Details" FROM ORDERS_LISTAGG WHERE MRN IN (SELECT DISTINCT MRN FROM ORDERS_LISTAGG WHERE "Order Item Name" = 'Cytogenetics Testing Request (Combined)') ORDER BY MRN , "Appt Date" , "Appt Time" , "Visit Type Name" , "Order Requested For Date" , "Order Item Name" DESC , "Time Priority" , "Status" ; SELECT DISTINCT "t6"."PT_MRN" AS "MRN", SUBSTR(PT_FIRST_NAME, 1, 1) || SUBSTR(PT_LAST_NAME, 1, 1) AS "Initials", "t1"."PRPT_ACCESSION_NO" AS "Pathology Report", "t2"."DT_DTE" AS "Pathology Report Date", "t2"."DT_YEAR" AS "Pathology Report Year", "t3"."PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_DESC" AS "Pathology Report Type", "t4"."DT_DTE" AS "Pathology Procedure Date", "t5"."PRO_IRB_NO" AS "IRB Number" , CASE WHEN LENGTH(PRPT_REPORT) <= 15000 THEN RTRIM(CAST(SUBSTR(PRPT_REPORT, 1, 15000) AS VARCHAR(15000))) ELSE CAST(SUBSTR(PRPT_REPORT, 1, 15000) AS VARCHAR(15000)) END "path_prpt_p1", CASE WHEN LENGTH(PRPT_REPORT) > 15000 THEN RTRIM(CAST(SUBSTR(PRPT_REPORT, 15001, 15000) AS VARCHAR(15000))) ELSE '' END "path_prpt_p2" FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V" "t6" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED" "t8" ON "t6"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t8"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V" "t1" ON "t8"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t1"."PRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" "t2" ON "t1"."PRPT_REPORT_DATE_ID" = "t2"."DT_DATE_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATH_RPRT_TYPE_LOOKUP" "t3" ON "t1"."PRPT_REPORT_TYPE" = "t3"."PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_CD" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" "t4" ON "t1"."PRPT_PROCEDURE_DATE_ID" = "t4"."DT_DATE_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."ACCRUALS" "t7" ON "t8"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t7"."AC_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PROTOCOL" "t5" ON "t7"."AC_PROTOCOL_ID" = "t5"."PRO_PROTOCOL_ID" WHERE 1=1 AND "t3"."PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_DESC" IN ('Cytogenetics', 'Diagnostic Molecular Pathology', 'Flow Cytometry Report', 'Pathology-Bone Marrow', 'Special Procedure, Surgical', 'Surgical Pathology', 'Surgical Pathology Consult', 'Surgical Pathology Molecular Genetics', 'Surgical Submitted Slides') AND "t5"."PRO_IRB_NO" = '15-084' AND "t2"."DT_DTE" >= CURRENT date - 7 DAY AND "t4"."DT_DTE" >= CURRENT date - 7 DAY AND COALESCE("t7"."AC_OFF_STUDY_DTE", CURRENT date) >= CURRENT date - 7 DAY ORDER BY "t6"."PT_MRN", "t2"."DT_DTE", "t1"."PRPT_ACCESSION_NO" ;

prompt: Identify patients dispensed Clofarabine between 2005 and 2011 at age 0-21 years.
completion: SELECT "t4"."PT_MRN" AS "MRN", "t4"."PT_LAST_NAME" AS "Last Name", "t4"."PT_FIRST_NAME" AS "First Name", "t4"."PT_BIRTH_DTE" AS "Date of Birth", "t4"."PT_DEATH_DTE" AS "Deceased Date", "t5"."TCA_CASE_STS_DESC" AS "Case Status", "t6"."DT_DTE" AS "CDB Tumor Diagnosis Date", YEAR("t6"."DT_DTE" - "t4"."PT_BIRTH_DTE") AS "Age at Tumor Diagnosis Date", "t7"."DXCC_ICD_CODE" AS "ICD-O Histology Code", "t7"."DXCC_ICD_MSK_DESC" AS "ICD-O Histology Desc", "t8"."ICSC_SITE_CD" AS "ICD-O Site Code", "t8"."ICSC_ICDO_SITE_MSK_DESC" AS "ICD-O Site Desc", "t3"."DT_DTE" AS "Order Start Date", YEAR("t3"."DT_DTE" - "t4"."PT_BIRTH_DTE") AS "Age at Order Start Date" FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED" "t1" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PHM_PT_MEDS_MQT" "t9" ON "t1"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t9"."POD_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PHM_INVENTORY_CATALOG" "t2" ON "t9"."POD_PHARMA_INVENTORY_CTLG_ID" = "t2"."PINC_INVENTORY_CTLG_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PHM_ORDER_DTL" "t10" ON "t9"."POD_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t10"."POD_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AND "t9"."POD_PHARMA_INVENTORY_CTLG_ID" = "t10"."POD_PHARMA_INVENTORY_CTLG_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE" "t3" ON "t10"."POD_START_DATE_ID" = "t3"."DT_DATE_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V" "t4" ON "t1"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t4"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."CDB_TUMOR_V" "t11" ON "t1"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t11"."CDTM_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."TUMOR_CASE_ATTRIBUTES" "t5" ON "t11"."CDTM_CASE_ATTR_ID" = "t5"."TUMOR_CASE_ATTR_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE" "t6" ON "t11"."CDTM_DX_DATE_ID" = "t6"."DT_DATE_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DIAGNOSIS_CODE_CAT_ICDO_V" "t7" ON "t11"."CDTM_DX_CATALOG_ID" = "t7"."DXCC_DX_CATALOG_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."ICDO_SITE_CATALOG_V" "t8" ON "t11"."CDTM_SITE_CATALOG_ID" = "t8"."ICSC_SITE_CATALOG_ID" WHERE ("t2"."PINC_GENERIC_NAME" IN ('Clofarabine') AND "t3"."DT_YEAR" BETWEEN 2005 AND 2011) AND YEAR("t3"."DT_DTE" - "t4"."PT_BIRTH_DTE") <= 21

prompt: Provide a weekly list of pediatric patients ages 0 - 3 years old that are currently on the pediatric inpatient units
completion: WITH ADM AS (SELECT PT_MRN MRN, PT_LAST_NAME LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME FIRST_NAME, YEAR(CURRENT date - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) CURRENT_AGE, VIS_ROOM_NUM ROOM, VIS_ADM_DTE ADMIT_DATE, DAYS(CURRENT DATE) - DAYS(VIS_ADM_DTE) LOS, HOSP_SVC_DESC HOSP_SVC FROM IDB.VISIT_V JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON VIS_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE VIS_IP_OP_ADJUSTED_IND = 'I' AND VIS_VISIT_STATUS IN ('2') AND VIS_NURS_STA IN ('PICU', 'NS-9') AND YEAR(CURRENT date - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) BETWEEN 0 AND 3 ) , PRIM_DEPT AS (SELECT CPE_MRN, SERVICE, APPT_COUNT, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CPE_MRN ORDER BY APPT_COUNT DESC) RN FROM (SELECT CPE_MRN, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 SERVICE, COUNT(CPE_ENC_CSN_ID) APPT_COUNT FROM ADM JOIN IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER ON MRN = CPE_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CRE_RES_TYP IN ('Physician') AND (CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 = ('PED') OR CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_4 = ('PED') OR CLD_DEPT_NAME = 'ORTHOPEDICS 1275-9') AND CPE_CPE_IP_IND <> 'INPATIENT' GROUP BY CPE_MRN, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 )) SELECT ADM.*, SERVICE PRIMARY_SERVICE FROM ADM LEFT JOIN PRIM_DEPT ON MRN = CPE_MRN AND RN = 1

prompt: Request a list of patients between 1/1/2015 and 12/31/2015 who had a procedure with Dr. Nicola Fabbri.
completion: WITH PROCEDURES_0 AS (SELECT "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AS PT_DEID, "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_MRN" AS PT_MRN, "IDB"."SRG_SURG_EVENT"."SSE_LOG_ID" AS SUBJECT_ID, "IDB"."SRG_SURG_EVENT"."SSE_SURG_DTE" AS PROC_SURG_DATE, "IDB"."SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE"."SSP_SURG_SVC_CD" AS PROC_SURG_SERVICE, CAST(TRIM("IDB"."SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE"."SSP_SURG_LAST_NM") AS VARCHAR) || ', ' || CAST(TRIM("IDB"."SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE"."SSP_SURG_FIRST_NM") AS VARCHAR) AS SURGEON, "IDB"."SRG_SURG_EVENT"."SSE_SURG_LOC" AS SSE_SURG_LOC FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS" JOIN "IDB"."SRG_SURG_EVENT" ON "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_MRN" = "IDB"."SRG_SURG_EVENT"."SSE_MRN" JOIN "IDB"."SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE" ON "IDB"."SRG_SURG_EVENT"."SSE_LOG_ID" = "IDB"."SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE"."SSP_LOG_ID" WHERE "IDB"."SRG_SURG_EVENT"."SSE_SURG_DTE" BETWEEN '2015-01-01' AND '2015-12-31' AND "IDB"."SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE"."SSP_SURG_SVC_CD" IN ('ORTHO') AND CAST(TRIM("IDB"."SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE"."SSP_SURG_LAST_NM") AS VARCHAR) || ', ' || CAST(TRIM("IDB"."SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE"."SSP_SURG_FIRST_NM") AS VARCHAR) IN ('FABBRI, NICOLA') AND (("IDB"."SRG_SURG_EVENT"."SSE_SURG_LOC" NOT LIKE '%' || 'IR' || '%') AND ("IDB"."SRG_SURG_EVENT"."SSE_SURG_LOC" NOT LIKE '%' || 'ENDO' || '%'))), COHORT AS (SELECT PT_DEID AS PT_DEID FROM (SELECT PROCEDURES_0.PT_DEID AS PT_DEID FROM PROCEDURES_0)), COHORT_PROCEDURES AS (SELECT SUBJECT_ID AS SUBJECT_ID, PT_DEID AS PT_DEID FROM (SELECT PROCEDURES_0.SUBJECT_ID AS SUBJECT_ID, PROCEDURES_0.PT_DEID "IDB"."SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE" ON "IDB"."SRG_SURG_EVENT"."SSE_LOG_ID" = "IDB"."SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE"."SSP_LOG_ID" WHERE "IDB"."SRG_SURG_EVENT"."SSE_SURG_DTE" BETWEEN '2015-01-01' AND '2015-12-31' AND AS VARCHAR) IN ('FABBRI, NICOLA') AND (("IDB"."SRG_SURG_EVENT"."SSE_SURG_LOC" NOT LIKE '%' || 'IR' || '%') AND ("IDB"."SRG_SURG_EVENT"."SSE_SURG_LOC" NOT LIKE '%' || 'ENDO' || '%'))), COHORT AS (SELECT PT_DEID AS PT_DEID FROM (SELECT PROCEDURES_0.PT_DEID AS PT_DEID FROM PROCEDURES_0)), COHORT_PROCEDURES AS (SELECT SUBJECT_ID AS SUBJECT_ID, PT_DEID AS PT_DEID FROM (SELECT PROCEDURES_0.SUBJECT_ID AS SUBJECT_ID, PROCEDURES_0.PT_DEID AS PT_DEID FROM PROCEDURES_0)), KEYS AS (SELECT COHORT.PT_DEID AS COHORT_PT_DEID, COHORT_PROCEDURES.SUBJECT_ID AS COHORT_PROCEDURES_SUBJECT_ID, COHORT_PROCEDURES.PT_DEID AS COHORT_PROCEDURES_PT_DEID FROM COHORT LEFT OUTER JOIN COHORT_PROCEDURES ON COHORT_PROCEDURES.PT_DEID = COHORT.PT_DEID), PATHOLOGY_COLUMNS AS prompt: Provide number of patients who had breast cancer only treated with PARP inhibitors and patients who had breast cancer with metastasis treated with PARP inhibitors in the past 15 years.
completion: WITH PTS1 AS (SELECT CC_MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) METS_DX_DTE FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE SUBSTR(CC_CLSF_CD, 1, 3) IN ('C79', '196', '197', '198') AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' GROUP BY CC_MRN HAVING MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) BETWEEN CURRENT date - 15 YEARS AND CURRENT date) , PTS2 AS (SELECT CC_MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS BREAST_DX_DTE FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE 1=1 AND SUBSTR(CC_CLSF_CD, 1, 3) IN ('C50', '174', '175') AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' GROUP BY CC_MRN HAVING MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) BETWEEN CURRENT date - 15 YEARS AND CURRENT date) , PTS AS (SELECT DISTINCT A.CC_MRN, BREAST_DX_DTE, METS_DX_DTE FROM PTS1 A JOIN PTS2 B ON A.CC_MRN = B.CC_MRN AND A.METS_DX_DTE >= B.BREAST_DX_DTE) , PARP AS (SELECT DISTINCT APR_MRN FROM IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX JOIN IDB.CHEMO_DRUG_GENERIC ON APR_GENERIC_NAME = CDG_GENERIC_NAME WHERE APR_START_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT date - 15 YEARS AND CURRENT date AND CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME IN ('OLAPARIB', 'TALAZOPARIB') ) SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CC_MRN) FROM PTS JOIN PARP ON CC_MRN = APR_MRN ; WITH PTS1 AS (SELECT CC_MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) METS_DX_DTE FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE SUBSTR(CC_CLSF_CD, 1, 3) IN ('C79', '196', '197', '198') AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' GROUP BY CC_MRN HAVING MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) BETWEEN CURRENT date - 15 YEARS AND CURRENT date) , PTS2 AS (SELECT CC_MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS BREAST_DX_DTE FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE 1=1 AND SUBSTR(CC_CLSF_CD, 1, 3) IN ('C50', '174', '175') AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' GROUP BY CC_MRN HAVING MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) BETWEEN CURRENT date - 15 YEARS AND CURRENT date) , PTS AS (SELECT DISTINCT A.CC_MRN, BREAST_DX_DTE, METS_DX_DTE FROM PTS1 A JOIN PTS2 B ON A.CC_MRN = B.CC_MRN AND A.METS_DX_DTE >= B.BREAST_DX_DTE) , PARP AS (SELECT DISTINCT APR_MRN FROM IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX JOIN IDB.CHEMO_DRUG_GENERIC ON APR_GENERIC_NAME = CDG_GENERIC_NAME WHERE APR_START_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT date - 15 YEARS AND CURRENT date AND CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME IN ('OLAPARIB', 'TALAZOPARIB') ) SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT A.CC_MRN) FROM PTS2 A JOIN PARP ON A.CC_MRN = APR_MRN LEFT JOIN PTS B ON A.CC_MRN = B.CC_MRN WHERE B.CC_MRN IS NULL ;

prompt: Provide a list of patients diagnosed with follicular lymphoma grade 3 between 2018 and 2022 and include radiation treatment information if available. A previous request (RON 16528 was run for cases between 2018 and 2022) was run and we would like to update the list of patients with more recent cases.
completion: WITH CDB AS (SELECT TM_MRN, TM_DX_DTE, AV_DESC AS CASE_STATUS, TM_HIST_CD, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS HIST_DESC, TM_SITE_CD, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_DESC, TM_RAD_STRT_DTE, TM_RAD_END_DTE, TM_CLIN_STG_GRP AS CLINICAL_STAGE FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS ON AV_ELEMENT = 'CASE_STS' AND AV_CODE = TM_CASE_STS WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3') AND TM_HIST_CD = 'M9698/3' AND TM_DX_DTE BETWEEN '2018-01-01' AND '2022-09-30' ) , PATH AS (SELECT PT_MRN MRN, MIN(A.DT_DTE) "First Qualifying Path Report Date", MAX(A.DT_DTE) AS "Last Qualifying Path Report Date" FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V JOIN DV.DATE_V A ON PRPT_REPORT_DATE_ID = A.DT_DATE_ID JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V ON PRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID WHERE CONTAINS(PRPT_REPORT, '("FOLLICULAR"|"FOLLICLE CENTER"|"SMALL CLEAVED"|"SMALL AND LARGE CLEAVED") & "LYMPHOMA"&("GRADE 3" | "GRADE III")') = 1 GROUP BY PT_MRN) SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN MRN, PT_LAST_NAME "Last", PT_FIRST_NAME "First", PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH DOB, PLA_LST_TX_DTE AS "Last Activity Date", PT_DATE_OF_DEATH "Death Date", PT_SEX "Sex", R.AV_DESC AS "Race", E.AV_DESC AS "Ethnicity", TM_DX_DTE, CASE_STATUS, TM_HIST_CD, HIST_DESC, TM_SITE_CD, SITE_DESC, TM_RAD_STRT_DTE, TM_RAD_END_DTE, CLINICAL_STAGE, "First Qualifying Path Report Date", "Last Qualifying Path Report Date", RTC_TX_COURSE_NO, RTC_TX_START_DTE, RTC_TX_DELIVERED_FRACTIONS, RTC_TX_DELIVERED_DOSE, RTC_PRIMARY_REF_POINT FROM IDB.PATIENT JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY ON PT_MRN = PLA_MRN LEFT JOIN CDB ON PT_MRN = TM_MRN LEFT JOIN PATH ON PT_MRN = MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.RADONC_TREATMENT_COURSE ON TM_MRN = RTC_TX_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS R ON R.AV_ELEMENT = 'RACE' AND R.AV_CODE = PT_RACE LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS E ON E.AV_ELEMENT = 'PT_ETHNICITY' AND E.AV_CODE = PT_PT_ETHNICITY WHERE COALESCE(TM_MRN, MRN) IS NOT NULL ;

prompt:
This was a sample of recently posted ECC charges for QA purposes. 

Also found this in the Python report for description - Attached please find your monthly HIM-ECC charge QA for charges posted last month.  Where the RMS code is missing, ECC could not find a matching code for that service-HCPCS-modifier.  All entries should be audited for quality and accuracy of data.  This data is limited to the activity sent to RMS and does not verify posting in HPA.  This report runs on the first of the month.
completion: WITH HX AS (SELECT MRN, DOS, FMS_CDM, RMS_SVCCD, HCPCS, MOD1, MOD2, SUM(QTY) AS QTY, MAX(POSTDTE) AS MAX_POSTDTE FROM IDCIC.HIMECC_HX_D GROUP BY MRN, DOS, FMS_CDM, RMS_SVCCD, HCPCS, MOD1, MOD2 HAVING SUM(QTY) <> 0 AND MAX(POSTDTE) BETWEEN (CURRENT_DATE-DAY(CURRENT_DATE) DAYS+1 DAY-1 MONTH) AND (CURRENT_DATE-DAY(CURRENT_DATE) DAYS)), A AS (SELECT MIN(MRN||CHAR(DOS)||CHAR(MAX_POSTDTE)) AS MIN_MRN_DOS, FMS_CDM, RMS_SVCCD, HCPCS, MOD1, MOD2, QTY FROM HX GROUP BY FMS_CDM, RMS_SVCCD, HCPCS, MOD1, MOD2, QTY) SELECT MIN(CASE WHEN CC_MRN IS NOT NULL THEN 'HIM' ELSE 'ECC' END) AS HIM_ECC, CU_LAST_NAME, CU_FIRST_NAME, B.MRN, B.DOS, B.SVC, B.RMS_SVCCD, B.HCPCS, B.FMS_CDM, MAX(B.SVC_DESC) AS SVC_DESC, MAX(A.QTY) AS QTY, B.MOD1, B.MOD2, B.MOD3, B.MOD4, B.MOD5, B.SITE, B.DX1, B.DX2, B.DX3, B.DX4, B.DX5, B.OCC1, B.OCC1_DTE, B.OCC2, B.OCC2_DTE, B.OCC3, B.OCC3_DTE, MAX(B.POSTDTE) AS POSTDTE FROM A LEFT OUTER JOIN IDCIC.HIMECC_HX_D B ON B.MRN = SUBSTR(MIN_MRN_DOS, 1, 12) AND B.DOS = DATE(SUBSTR(MIN_MRN_DOS, 13, 10)) AND B.POSTDTE = DATE(SUBSTR(MIN_MRN_DOS, 23, 10)) AND B.FMS_CDM = A.FMS_CDM AND B.RMS_SVCCD = A.RMS_SVCCD AND B.HCPCS = A.HCPCS AND B.MOD1 = A.MOD1 AND B.MOD2 = A.MOD2 LEFT OUTER JOIN IDB.CTC_CLSF ON CC_MRN = B.MRN AND CC_EFF_DTE = B.DOS AND CC_CLSF_CD = B.HCPCS AND CC_MODIFIER1 = B.MOD1 AND CC_MODIFIER2 = B.MOD2 AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y' LEFT JOIN IDB.CTC_REC_HX ON CRH_VISIT_ID=CC_VISIT_ID AND CRH_TYPE = 'FNL' LEFT JOIN IDB.CTC_USERS ON CU_USER=CRH_CTC_CNG_USER WHERE B.QTY > 0 GROUP BY CU_LAST_NAME, CU_FIRST_NAME, B.MRN, B.DOS, B.SVC, B.SITE, B.FMS_CDM, B.RMS_SVCCD, B.DX1, B.DX2, B.DX3, B.DX4, B.DX5, B.HCPCS, B.MOD1, B.MOD2, B.MOD3, B.MOD4, B.MOD5, B.OCC1, B.OCC1_DTE, B.OCC2, B.OCC2_DTE, B.OCC3, B.OCC3_DTE ORDER BY 1 DESC, B.RMS_SVCCD, B.HCPCS, B.DOS, B.MRN, B.SVC ;

prompt: Provide a list of patients who presented at MSKCC with lymphoma after or while treated with dupilumab / dupixent  since  2017
completion: WITH PROV AS (SELECT DISTINCT CRE_RES_ID AS PROV_ID, CRE_RES_NAME AS PROV_NAME, 'cat2' AS CATEGORY, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 AS SVC FROM IDB.CL_DEPT JOIN IDB.CL_RES_DEPT ON CPD_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPD_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID WHERE CRE_RES_TYP IN ('Physician', 'Physician Assistant') AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 = 'LYM' AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 = 'MED' UNION SELECT DISTINCT CRE_RES_ID AS PROV_ID, CRE_RES_NAME AS PROV_NAME, 'cat1' AS CATEGORY, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 AS SVC FROM IDB.CL_DEPT JOIN IDB.CL_RES_DEPT ON CPD_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPD_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID WHERE CRE_RES_ID IN ('000612', '427412', '024380', '019927' ) ) , VIS AS (SELECT DISTINCT VIS_MRN, VIS_DTE, TRIM(PT_LAST_NAME) || ', ' || TRIM(PT_FIRST_NAME) AS PATIENT_NAME, VIS_ATN_DR_NO, X.DOC_NAME AS ATTENDING_DR FROM IDB.VISIT JOIN IDB.DOC X ON X.DOC_DR_NO = VIS_ATN_DR_NO JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PT_MRN = VIS_MRN WHERE 1=1 AND VIS_ATN_DR_NO IN (SELECT PROV_ID FROM PROV) AND VIS_PATIENT_TYPE IN ('IP', 'OP') AND VIS_DTE BETWEEN '2017-01-01' AND '2023-01-19' ) , CDD AS (SELECT CDD_MRN , PATIENT_NAME, CDD_SERVICE_DTE, CDD_DOC_NAME , ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CDD_MRN ORDER BY CDD_SERVICE_DTE ASC) CDD_RN, CDO_SECTION , CDO_ITEM_NAME , CDO_VALUE_TEXT FROM IDB.CD_DOCUMENT LEFT JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION ON CDD_DOC_GUID = CDO_DOC_GUID AND CDD_AUTHORED_DTE = CDO_AUTHORED_DTE AND CDO_VALUE_TEXT <> '' JOIN VIS ON VIS_MRN = CDD_MRN AND CDD_SERVICE_DTE = VIS_DTE WHERE CDD_CANCEL_IND <> '1' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND <> '1' AND CDD_SERVICE_DTE BETWEEN '2017-01-01' AND '2023-01-19' AND (INSTR(LOWER(CDO_VALUE_TEXT), 'etanercept') > 0 OR INSTR(LOWER(CDO_VALUE_TEXT), 'enbrel') > 0 OR INSTR(LOWER(CDO_VALUE_TEXT), 'adalimumab') > 0 OR INSTR(LOWER(CDO_VALUE_TEXT), 'humira') > 0 OR INSTR(LOWER(CDO_VALUE_TEXT), 'golimumab') > 0 OR INSTR(LOWER(CDO_VALUE_TEXT), 'simponi') > 0 OR INSTR(LOWER(CDO_VALUE_TEXT), 'certolizumab') > 0 OR INSTR(LOWER(CDO_VALUE_TEXT), 'cimzia') > 0) ) , DX AS (SELECT CC_MRN, LISTAGG (ICD, ',') AS ICD9_DESC FROM (SELECT DISTINCT CC_MRN, SUBSTR (TRIM(CC_CLSF_CD) || '-' || TRIM(CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK), 1, 100) AS ICD FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN CDD ON CDD_MRN = CC_MRN WHERE INSTR(CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK, 'LYMPHOMA') > 0 AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND (CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) ) GROUP BY CC_MRN) , PDX AS (SELECT DISTINCT PRPT_MRN AS MRN, PRPT_REPORT_DTE AS PATH_REPORT_DATE, UPPER(DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)DIAGNOSIS:[\w\W]*(?=NOTE:)', PRPT_REPORT)) AS DIAG_1, UPPER(DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)DIAGNOSIS:[\w\W]*(?=COMMENT:)', PRPT_REPORT)) AS DIAG_2, UPPER(DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)DIAGNOSIS:[\w\W]*(?=I ATTEST)', PRPT_REPORT)) AS DIAG_3, UPPER(DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)DIAGNOSIS:[\w\W]*(?=IATTEST)', PRPT_REPORT)) AS DIAG_4, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY PRPT_MRN ORDER BY PRPT_REPORT_DTE DESC) RN_P FROM CDD JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V T2 ON PRPT_MRN = CDD_MRN WHERE PRPT_ORD_DR_SVC = 'LYM' AND T2.PRPT_REPORT IS NOT NULL ) SELECT CDD_MRN, PATIENT_NAME, CDD_SERVICE_DTE, ICD9_DESC, CDO_VALUE_TEXT, CASE WHEN DIAG_1 <> '' THEN DIAG_1 ELSE CASE WHEN DIAG_2 <> '' THEN DIAG_2 ELSE CASE WHEN DIAG_3 <> '' THEN DIAG_3 ELSE CASE WHEN DIAG_4 <> '' THEN DIAG_4 END END END END AS PATH_DX FROM CDD D LEFT JOIN DX ON CC_MRN = CDD_MRN LEFT JOIN PDX ON CDD_MRN = MRN AND RN_P =1 WHERE CDD_RN =1 ;

prompt: Provide a list of patients who have a diagnosis of mesothelioma and have received immunotherapy.
completion: WITH DX AS (SELECT INC.PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID P_ID, PRIMARY_SITE, TUMOR_TYPE_NAME, PDRX_DMP_PATIENT_ID, PT_MRN, DTPROCPATHRPT.DT_DTE AS PROCEDUREDATE FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_STRUCTURED_RESULTS_V INC LEFT JOIN DV.DATE DTPROCPATHRPT ON PRPT_PROCEDURE_DATE_ID = DTPROCPATHRPT.DT_DATE_ID JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML DT ON INC.PRPT_PATH_RPT_ID = DT.PDRX_PATH_RPT_ID CROSS JOIN XMLTABLE('$c/root/meta-data' PASSING DT.PDRX_XML_VALUE AS "c" COLUMNS DT_PROCEDURE VARCHAR(40) PATH 'dt_procedure', PRIMARY_SITE VARCHAR(264) PATH 'primary_site', TUMOR_TYPE_NAME VARCHAR(264) PATH 'tumor_type_name' , TUMOR_TYPE_CODE VARCHAR(264) PATH 'tumor_type_code', IS_METASTASIS VARCHAR(3) PATH 'is_metastasis' , METASTASIS_SITE VARCHAR(264) PATH 'metastasis_site') T JOIN (SELECT T.TUMOR_TYPE_CODE TTC FROM TABLE(DV.STRING_SPLIT('PEMESO,PLMESO,TMESO', ',')) S CROSS JOIN TABLE(DV.ONCOTREE_CHILDREN(COLUMN_VALUES)) T) X ON T.TUMOR_TYPE_CODE = X.TTC WHERE 1=1 ) , IMMUNO AS (SELECT OO_MRN, OO_SET_NAME, OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY OO_MRN ORDER BY OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE ASC) AS ORDER_RANK FROM IDB.OMS_ORDER JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_CATALOG ON OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID = OOC_MSTR_ITEM_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_STATUS ON OO_ORD_STS_CD = OSTS_ORD_STS_CD JOIN DX ON OO_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE OO_SET_NAME IN ('THR_ALB-PACLI_wkly_CARBO_PEMBROlizumab_Cyc1', 'THR_ATEZOlizumab(1200)_Q3wk', 'THR_ATEZOlizumab(1680)_Q4wk', 'THR_Etoposide_CARBOplatin_ATEZOlizumab_Cyc1', 'THR_iPILimumab(1)_NIVOlumab(240)_Q3wk', 'THR_iPILimumab(1)_Q6wk_NIVOlumab(240)_Q2wk', 'THR_iPILimumab(3)_NIVOlumab(1)_Q3wk', 'THR_NIVOLUmab', 'THR_NIVOlumab(240)_Q2wk', 'THR_NIVOlumab(360)Q3wk_iPILimumab(1)Q6wk', 'THR_NIVOlumab(480)_Q4wk', 'THR_PACLI(200mg/m2)_CARBO_NIVOlumab(360)Q3wk_iPILimumab(1)Q6wk', 'THR_PACLI(FlatDose)_CARBO_NIVOlumab(360)Q3wk_iPILimumab(1)Q6wk', 'THR_PACLI_CARBO_ATEZOlizumab_bEVAcizumab_Cyc1', 'THR_PACLI_CARBO_PEMBROlizumab_Cyc1', 'THR_PEMBROlizumab', 'THR_PEMBROlizumab_Q3weeks', 'THR_PEMBROlizumab_Q6weeks', 'THR_pEMEtrexed_CARBO_NIVOlumab(360)Q3wk_iPILimumab(1)Q6wk', 'THR_pEMEtrexed_CARBOplatin_PEMBROlizumab_Cyc1', 'THR_pEMEtrexed_CISplatin_NIVOlumab(360)Q3wk_iPILimumab(1)Q6wk', 'THR_pEMEtrexed_CISplatin_PEMBROlizumab', 'IRB_#17-358_AVElumab') AND OO_ORD_STS_CD NOT IN ('CANP', 'CANC', 'AUC3') ) , IRB_CONSENT AS (SELECT MAX(CASE WHEN AC_IRB_NO = '06-107' THEN AC_IRB_NO END) AS "06-107" , AC_MRN FROM IDB.ACCRUALS JOIN DX ON PT_MRN = AC_MRN WHERE 1=1 AND AC_IRB_NO IN ('06-107') GROUP BY AC_MRN) SELECT DISTINCT A.PT_MRN , PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH , PT_DATE_OF_DEATH , CASE WHEN AC_MRN IS NOT NULL THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS "06-107 Consent" , OO_SET_NAME , OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE FROM DX A JOIN IMMUNO ON A.PT_MRN = OO_MRN AND ORDER_RANK = 1 JOIN IDB.PATIENT B ON A.PT_MRN = B.PT_MRN LEFT JOIN IRB_CONSENT ON A.PT_MRN = AC_MRN ;

prompt: Schedule a weekly report of MBC patients on 12-245 with pik3ca mutation on palbociclib or ribociclib or abemaciclib with upcoming scans or biopsies.
completion: WITH X AS (SELECT * FROM (SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN, RESULT, GENE, PDRX_ACCESSION_NO, T.* FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_STRUCTURED_RESULTS_V JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML DT ON PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PDRX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID CROSS JOIN XMLTABLE('$c/root/*' PASSING DT.PDRX_XML_VALUE AS "c" COLUMNS TUMOR_TYPE_NAME VARCHAR(264) PATH '../meta-data/tumor_type_name', PRIMARY_SITE VARCHAR(100) PATH '../meta-data/primary_site', IS_METASTASIS VARCHAR(10) PATH '../meta-data/is_metastasis', METASTASIS_SITE VARCHAR(100) PATH '../meta-data/metastasis_site') T WHERE GENE = 'PIK3CA' ) IMPACT WHERE UPPER(PRIMARY_SITE) like '%BREAST%' AND METASTASIS_SITE <> '' AND UPPER(METASTASIS_SITE) <> 'NA' AND UPPER(METASTASIS_SITE) NOT LIKE 'NOT%' ) , APR AS (SELECT APR_MRN, CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME, MIN(APR_START_DTE) AS START_DATE, MAX(APR_END_DTE) AS END_DATE FROM X JOIN IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX_V ON PT_MRN = APR_MRN WHERE UPPER(CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME) LIKE '%PALBOCICLIB%' OR UPPER(CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME) LIKE '%RIBOCICLIB%' OR UPPER(CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME) LIKE '%ABEMACICLIB%' GROUP BY APR_MRN, CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME ) , Y AS (SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN, RESULT, GENE, CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME, START_DATE, END_DATE FROM X JOIN APR ON PT_MRN = APR_MRN ) , Z AS (SELECT PT_MRN AS MRN, LISTAGG(COALESCE(STRIP(CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME), '') || ' | ' || COALESCE(STRIP(CAST(START_DATE AS VARCHAR(12000))), '') || ' | ' || COALESCE(STRIP(CAST(END_DATE AS VARCHAR(12000))), '') , CHR(13) || CHR(10)) WITHIN GROUP( ORDER BY PT_MRN, CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME, START_DATE, END_DATE) AS DRUG_NAME FROM Y GROUP BY PT_MRN) SELECT DISTINCT STRIP(CPE_MRN) AS MRN, STRIP(PT_LAST_NAME) || ', ' || STRIP(PT_FIRST_NAME) AS "Name", CPE_ENC_DTE AS "Appt Date", CRE_RES_NAME, CRE_RES_TYP, STRIP(CLD_DEPT_NAME) AS "Department", CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8, STRIP(CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME) AS "Visit Type", DRUG_NAME FROM Z JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER ON PT_MRN = CPE_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Sch') AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT DATE AND CURRENT DATE + 6 DAYS AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 IN ('NUC', 'RAD') AND(CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME LIKE 'CT%CH%' OR CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME LIKE 'CT%AB%' OR CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME LIKE 'CT%PE%' OR CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME LIKE '%PET%' OR CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME LIKE 'BI%' OR CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME LIKE '%BONE%') AND CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME NOT LIKE '%BONE%DENS%'

prompt: Provide count of patients who have Mandarin listed as their primary language and the listed race, ethnicity, and cancer dx proportion throughout MSK.
completion: WITH PTS AS (SELECT DISTINCT TRIM(L.AV_DESC) AS "Primary Language Description", TRIM(E.AV_DESC) "Ethnicity", TRIM(R.AV_DESC) "Race", VIS_MRN AS "MRN", YEAR(VIS_ADM_DTE) AS YEAR, MONTH(VIS_ADM_DTE) AS MONTH FROM IDB.VISIT_V JOIN IDB.PATIENT P ON VIS_MRN = P.PT_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS L ON P.PT_PRIMARY_LANG = L.AV_CODE AND L.AV_ELEMENT = 'PRIMARY_LANG' LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS E ON E.AV_ELEMENT = 'PT_ETHNICITY' AND E.AV_CODE = PT_PT_ETHNICITY LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS R ON R.AV_ELEMENT = 'RACE' AND R.AV_CODE = PT_RACE WHERE VIS_ADM_DTE BETWEEN '2019-01-01' AND CURRENT date AND VIS_VISIT_STATUS IN ('2', '3') ) , DX AS (SELECT TM_MRN, AV_DESC AS CASE_STS, TM_DX_DTE, TM_HIST_CD, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS HIST_DESC, TM_SITE_CD, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_DESC, CATEGORY1, CATEGORY2, CATEGORY3, CATEGORY4, TM_BEST_AJCC_STG, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY TM_MRN ORDER BY (TM_DX_DTE) DESC) AS RN FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.SEERGROUPING ON RECODE = IDB.SEERF_ICDO(TM_SITE_CD, TM_HIST_CD) JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS ON AV_ELEMENT = 'CASE_STS' AND AV_CODE = TM_CASE_STS AND TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') JOIN PTS ON TM_MRN = "MRN" ) SELECT DECIMAL(TRIM(COUNT(DISTINCT "MRN"))) AS COUNT, CASE WHEN "Primary Language Description" like '%CHINESE%' THEN "Primary Language Description" ELSE 'OTHER' END AS "Primary Language", "Ethnicity", "Race", YEAR, MONTH, TM_BEST_AJCC_STG, CATEGORY1 "SEER Dx Category" FROM PTS LEFT JOIN DX ON "MRN" = TM_MRN AND RN = 1 GROUP BY CASE WHEN "Primary Language Description" like '%CHINESE%' THEN "Primary Language Description" ELSE 'OTHER' END, "Ethnicity", "Race", YEAR, MONTH, CATEGORY1, TM_BEST_AJCC_STG ;

prompt: Quarterly report of retrospective colon cancer PTs for 20-378
completion: WITH DX AS (SELECT TM_MRN, MIN(TM_DX_DTE) TM_DX_DTE, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS HIST_DESC, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_DESC FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS ON AV_ELEMENT = 'CASE_STS' AND AV_CODE = TM_CASE_STS AND TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND TM_SITE_CD LIKE 'C18%' AND TM_DX_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT date - 5 YEARS AND CURRENT date GROUP BY TM_MRN, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK) , APPTS AS (SELECT CPE_MRN, TIME(CPE_APPT_DT) CPE_APPT_DT, CPE_ENC_DTE, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_1, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8, CLD_DEPT_NAME, CRE_RES_NAME, CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE 1=1 AND CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CRE_RES_TYP IN ('Physician') AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 = 'GI' AND (DATE(CPE_ENC_DTE) >= (DATE('0001-01-01') + YEAR(CURRENT date) YEARS - 1 YEAR + MONTH(CURRENT date) MONTHS - 4 MONTHS) AND DATE(CPE_ENC_DTE) < (DATE('0001-01-01') + YEAR(CURRENT date) YEARS - 1 YEAR + MONTH(CURRENT date) MONTHS - 1 MONTHS)) AND (CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR not LIKE '%NV%' AND CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR not LIKE '%IR%') AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_1 <> 'REG' ) , MAIN_LOC AS (SELECT 40.763909 AS LAT5, -73.956047 AS LON5, 'Main' AS LOC5 FROM SYSIBM.SYSDUMMY1) , FFPE AS (SELECT DISTINCT A.TBA_PROCUREMENT_DTE "Collection Date" , TRIM(B.PT_MRN) "MRN" , TRIM(A.TBA_ACCESSION_NUM) "Accession Number" , CASE WHEN TBD_UNIT_DESC = 'Cryomold' THEN 'OCT Embedded' WHEN TBD_UNIT_DESC = 'Nunc (Cryovial)' THEN 'Flash Frozen' WHEN TBD_UNIT_DESC = 'Paraffin Block' THEN 'Research FFPE' ELSE 'Other' END "Specimen Quality" FROM DV.TISSUE_BANK_ACCESSION A JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS B ON TBA_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = B.PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID JOIN DX ON TM_MRN = B.PT_MRN LEFT JOIN DV.TISSUE_BANK_DETAIL ON TBA_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = TBD_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID AND TBA_ACCESSION_NUM = TBD_ACCESSION_NUM AND TBA_PART_NUM = TBD_PART_NUM AND TBA_SUB_PART_NUM = TBD_SUB_PART_NUM WHERE A.TBA_DISEASE_DESC = 'Colon cancer' AND TBD_BANK_NUM IS NOT NULL AND COALESCE(TBD_RESERVED_REQUEST_ID, '') = '' AND TBD_DISTRIBUTION_DT IS NULL AND NOT A.TBA_HISTOLOGY_DESC like 'Benign%' AND (CASE WHEN TBD_UNIT_DESC = 'Cryomold' THEN 'OCT Embedded' WHEN TBD_UNIT_DESC = 'Nunc (Cryovial)' THEN 'Flash Frozen' WHEN TBD_UNIT_DESC = 'Paraffin Block' THEN 'Research FFPE' ELSE 'Other' END) = 'Research FFPE' ) , LAST_CHEMO AS (SELECT APR_MRN CHEMO_MRN, MAX(COALESCE(APR_END_DTE, APR_START_DTE)) LAST_CHEMO_DATE FROM IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX JOIN DX ON TM_MRN = APR_MRN GROUP BY APR_MRN) , LAST_HORMONE AS (SELECT APR_MRN HORMONE_MRN, MAX(COALESCE(APR_END_DTE, APR_START_DTE)) LAST_HORMONE_DATE FROM IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX JOIN IDB.CHEMO_DRUG_GENERIC ON APR_GENERIC_NAME = CDG_GENERIC_NAME JOIN DX ON TM_MRN = APR_MRN WHERE CDG_HORMONE_FLAG = 'Y' GROUP BY APR_MRN) , LAST_IMMUNO AS (SELECT APR_MRN IMMUNO_MRN, MAX(COALESCE(APR_END_DTE, APR_START_DTE)) LAST_IMMUNO_DATE FROM IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX JOIN IDB.CHEMO_DRUG_GENERIC ON APR_GENERIC_NAME = CDG_GENERIC_NAME JOIN DX ON TM_MRN = APR_MRN WHERE CDG_BIOLOGIC_IMMUNO_FLAG = 'Y' GROUP BY APR_MRN) , STAGING AS (SELECT CDD_MRN, MAX("T Stage")"T Stage", MAX("N Stage")"N Stage", MAX("M Stage")"M Stage", MAX("Stage/Other")"Stage/Other" FROM (SELECT CDD_MRN, CDD_SERVICE_DT, CDD_DOC_NAME, MAX(CASE WHEN CDO_ITEM_NAME IN ('Clinical Stage T:', 'Clinical T Stage') THEN TRIM(SUBSTR(CDO_VALUE_TEXT, 1, 200)) END) AS "T Stage", MAX(CASE WHEN CDO_ITEM_NAME IN ('Clinical Stage N:', 'Clinical N Stage') THEN TRIM(SUBSTR(CDO_VALUE_TEXT, 1, 200)) END) AS "N Stage", MAX(CASE WHEN CDO_ITEM_NAME IN ('Clinical Stage M:') THEN TRIM(SUBSTR(CDO_VALUE_TEXT, 1, 200)) END) AS "M Stage", MAX(CASE WHEN CDO_ITEM_NAME IN ('Clinical Stage:', 'Clinical Stage-Other:') THEN TRIM(SUBSTR(CDO_VALUE_TEXT, 1, 200)) END) AS "Stage/Other" FROM IDB.CD_DOCUMENT JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION ON CDD_DOC_GUID = CDO_DOC_GUID AND CDD_AUTHORED_DTE = CDO_AUTHORED_DTE JOIN DX ON TM_MRN = CDD_MRN WHERE 1=1 AND CDD_DOC_NAME like '%Colorect%' AND CDO_ITEM_NAME IN ('Clinical Stage M:', 'Clinical Stage N:', 'Clinical Stage T:', 'Clinical Stage:', 'Clinical Stage-Other:', 'Clinical T Stage', 'Clinical N Stage') AND CDD_CANCEL_IND <> '1' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND <> '1' AND CDO_LARGE_VALUE_TEXT_IND <> 'Y' AND CDD_SERVICE_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT date - 5 YEARS AND CURRENT date GROUP BY CDD_MRN, CDD_SERVICE_DT, CDD_DOC_NAME) A GROUP BY CDD_MRN) SELECT DISTINCT TM_MRN "MRN", PT_LAST_NAME "PT Last Name", PT_FIRST_NAME "PT First Name", PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH "DOB", CPE_ENC_DTE "Appt Date", TIME(CPE_APPT_DT) "Appt Time", CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME "Visit Type", YEAR(CPE_ENC_DTE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) "Age at Appt", ROUND(DEGREES(ACOS(SIN(RADIANS(ZC_LATITUDE)) *SIN(RADIANS(LAT5)) +COS(RADIANS(ZC_LATITUDE)) *COS(RADIANS(LAT5)) *COS(RADIANS(ZC_LONGITUDE-LON5))) * 69.09)) AS "Distance to Main", CRE_RES_NAME "Resource Name", TM_DX_DTE "Dx Date", SITE_DESC "Site", HIST_DESC "Histology", LAST_CHEMO_DATE "Last Chemo Date", LAST_HORMONE_DATE "Last Hormone Tx Date", LAST_IMMUNO_DATE "Last Immunotherapy Date", "T Stage", "N Stage", "M Stage", "Stage/Other", "Specimen Quality", "Collection Date", "Accession Number" FROM DX JOIN APPTS ON TM_MRN = CPE_MRN JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON TM_MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN FFPE ON TM_MRN = "MRN" LEFT JOIN LAST_CHEMO ON TM_MRN = CHEMO_MRN LEFT JOIN LAST_HORMONE ON TM_MRN = HORMONE_MRN LEFT JOIN LAST_IMMUNO ON TM_MRN = IMMUNO_MRN LEFT JOIN STAGING ON TM_MRN = CDD_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.ZIPCODE ON ZC_ZIP = LEFT(PT_ZIP_CD, 5), MAIN_LOC WHERE YEAR(CPE_ENC_DTE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) >= 18 AND PT_DATE_OF_DEATH IS NULL

prompt: Provide a list of patients diagnosed with high-grade glioma of the brain (anaplastic astrocytoma, anaplastic oligodendroglioma, anaplastic oligoastrocytoma, glioblastoma, gliosarcoma).
completion: WITH PTS AS (SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, PT_SEX, R.AV_DESC AS "Race (Reg)", PT_DATE_OF_DEATH FROM IDB.PATIENT LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS R ON R.AV_ELEMENT = 'RACE' AND R.AV_CODE = PT_RACE), TUMOR AS (SELECT DISTINCT TM_MRN, TM_DX_DTE, TM_HIST_CD, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE, TM_SITE_CD, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS HISTOLOGY, AV_DESC AS "Grade description" , PTS.* FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN PTS ON TM_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS ON AV_ELEMENT='HIST_CD_GRADE' AND AV_CODE= TM_HIST_CD_GRADE WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND TM_HIST_CD IN ('M9450/3', 'M9440/3', 'M9444/1', 'M9382/3', 'M9441/3', 'M9380/3', 'M9460/3', 'M9384/1', 'M9383/1', 'M9421/3', 'M9420/3', 'M9421/1', 'M9381/3', 'M9442/3', 'M9412/1', 'M9451/3', 'M9401/3', 'M9400/3', 'M9445/3', 'M9385/3', 'M9411/3') AND TM_DX_DTE BETWEEN '1995-01-01' AND '2022-04-04' ) , TREATMENT AS (SELECT DISTINCT RTC_TX_MRN, RTC_TX_START_DTE, RTC_TX_STOP_DTE, RTC_TX_COURSE_ID, RTC_TX_PLAN_NAME, RTC_TX_PLANNED_FRACTIONS, RTC_TX_DELIVERED_FRACTIONS, RTC_TX_PLANNED_DOSE, RTC_TX_DELIVERED_DOSE FROM IDB.RADONC_TREATMENT_COURSE JOIN TUMOR ON TM_MRN = RTC_TX_MRN) SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN AS "MRN", PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH AS "Date of birth", PT_SEX AS "Sex", "Race (Reg)", TM_DX_DTE AS "Diagnosis_date", TM_HIST_CD AS "ICD Histology Code", HISTOLOGY AS "Histology Description", TM_SITE_CD AS "Tumor Site Code", SITE AS "Tumor Site description", "Grade description", RTC_TX_START_DTE AS "Start Date", RTC_TX_STOP_DTE AS "Stop Date", RTC_TX_COURSE_ID AS "Course ID", RTC_TX_PLAN_NAME AS "Plan name", RTC_TX_PLANNED_FRACTIONS AS "Planned fractions", RTC_TX_DELIVERED_FRACTIONS AS "Delivered fractions", RTC_TX_PLANNED_DOSE AS "Planned dose", RTC_TX_DELIVERED_DOSE AS "Delivered dose", PT_DATE_OF_DEATH AS "Deceased date" FROM TUMOR LEFT JOIN TREATMENT ON PT_MRN = RTC_TX_MRN

prompt: A recurring data pull  of all mesothelioma patients who have consented to 1) a therapeutic protocol and/or 2) a non-therapeutic protocol (06-107 & 12-245) from  date  JULY-2017.
completion: WITH DX AS (SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN FROM IDB.PATIENT LEFT JOIN (SELECT TM_MRN, AV_DESC AS CASE_STS, TM_DX_DTE, TM_HIST_CD, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS HIST_DESC, TM_SITE_CD, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_DESC FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS ON AV_ELEMENT = 'CASE_STS' AND AV_CODE = TM_CASE_STS AND TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND TM_HIST_CD IN ('M9050/0', 'M9050/3', 'M9050/6', 'M9051/0', 'M9051/3', 'M9051/6', 'M9052/0', 'M9052/3', 'M9052/6', 'M9053/0', 'M9053/3', 'M9053/6', 'M9054/0', 'M9055/1' ) ) AS CDB ON TM_MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN (SELECT CC_MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS MIN_ICD9_EFF_DTE, CC_CLSF_CD AS ICD9_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS ICD9_DESC FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE CC_CLSF_CD IN ('C45', 'C45.0', 'C45.1', 'C45.2', 'C45.7', 'C45.9' ) AND CASE WHEN CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y' AND CC_PT_TYPE <> 'E' THEN 'Y' WHEN CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' AND YEAR(CC_EFF_DTE) < 2004 THEN 'Y' WHEN CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND YEAR(CC_EFF_DTE) < 2001 THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END = 'Y' GROUP BY CC_MRN, CC_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK ) AS ICD9 ON CC_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE COALESCE(TM_MRN, CC_MRN) IS NOT NULL ) SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN AS MRN, TRIM(AC_LAST_NAME) AS LAST_NAME, TRIM(AC_FIRST_NAME) AS FIRST_NAME, AC_IRB_NO, TRIM(PRO_PROTOCOL_TYPE) AS PROTOCOL_TYPE, ON_STUDYDATE, CASE WHEN PRO_PROTOCOL_TYPE LIKE 'Therapeutic%' THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS THERAPEUTIC_FLAG, AC_CONS_STAFF_NAME CONSENTING_STAFF, AC_PVDR_OF_RECORD_NAME AS "Provider of the Record", AC_CONS_DTE CONSENT_DATE FROM DX JOIN IDB.ACCRUALS A ON AC_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.PROTOCOL ON PRO_IRB_NO = AC_IRB_NO LEFT JOIN (SELECT SUBJECT_MRN, PROTOCOL_NO, ON_STUDYDATE FROM NN.SV_SUB_ONSTUDY WHERE SUBJECT_STATUS = 'ON STUDY' ) ON SUBJECT_MRN = AC_MRN AND AC_IRB_NO = PROTOCOL_NO WHERE 1=1 AND AC_CONS_DTE BETWEEN '2017-07-01' AND LAST_DAY(CURRENT date - 1 MONTH) ORDER BY MRN;

prompt: A one-time data pull of all mesothelioma patients who have consented to 1) a therapeutic protocol  and/or 2) a non-therapeutic protocol (06-107 & 12-245) from the date range 7/1/17 to 6/30/23.
completion: WITH MESO AS (SELECT DISTINCT TM_MRN AS MRN FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM H ON TM_HIST_CD = H.CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON TM_SITE_CD = S.CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND TM_HIST_CD IN ('M9050/0', 'M9050/3', 'M9050/6', 'M9051/0', 'M9051/3', 'M9051/6', 'M9052/0', 'M9052/3', 'M9052/6', 'M9053/0', 'M9053/3', 'M9053/6', 'M9054/0', 'M9055/1') UNION SELECT DISTINCT CC_MRN AS MRN FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND ((CC_PT_TYPE = 'I') OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) AND CC_CLSF_CD IN ('C45', 'C45.0', 'C45.1', 'C45.2', 'C45.7', 'C45.9') ) , IRB AS (SELECT * FROM MESO JOIN IDB.ACCRUALS_DATES ON MRN = ACD_MRN JOIN IDB.PROTOCOL ON ACD_IRB_NO = PRO_IRB_NO WHERE ACD_CONS_DTE BETWEEN '2017-07-01' AND '2023-06-30' AND (PRO_PROTOCOL_TYPE IN ('Therapeutic/QOL', 'Therapeutic') OR PRO_IRB_NO IN ('06-107', '12-245')) ) SELECT CASE WHEN PRO_PROTOCOL_TYPE IN ('Therapeutic/QOL', 'Therapeutic') THEN 'Therapeutic' WHEN PRO_IRB_NO IN ('06-107', '12-245') THEN 'Protocols 06-107 and 12-245' END CATEGORY, COUNT(DISTINCT MRN) PT_CNT FROM IRB GROUP BY CASE WHEN PRO_PROTOCOL_TYPE IN ('Therapeutic/QOL', 'Therapeutic') THEN 'Therapeutic' WHEN PRO_IRB_NO IN ('06-107', '12-245') THEN 'Protocols 06-107 and 12-245' END

prompt: Monitor all newly identified CNS lesions from 2014-2016 over a 2 year period for new onset hemorrhage. Correlate their natural history over the two year period to platelet count, transfusion therapy, coagulation parameters, anticoagulation, treatment, history or concurrent non-CNS hemorrhage or thrombosis.
completion: WITH PTS AS (SELECT PT_MRN MRN FROM DV.RADIOLOGY_REPORT_V JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V ON RRPT_MRN=PT_MRN WHERE (CONTAINS(RRPT_REPORT_TXT, '"tumor"') <> 0 OR CONTAINS(RRPT_REPORT_TXT, '"metastas"') <> 0 OR CONTAINS(RRPT_REPORT_TXT, '"lesion"') <> 0) AND CONTAINS(RRPT_REPORT_TXT, '"comparison: none"') <> 0 AND RRPT_ANC_CODE IN ('CTHD', 'CTHD1', 'CTHD2', 'MRBL', 'MRBL0', 'MRBL3T', 'MRBLFP', 'MRBLS', 'MRBLS0', 'MRBLS3T', 'MRBLSP', 'MRBLSS', 'MRHD', 'MRHD0P', 'MRHD1', 'MRHD13T', 'MRHD1P', 'MRHD2', 'MRHD23T', 'MRHD2P', 'MRHD3T', 'MRIACBL0', 'MRIACBL1', 'MRIACBL2', 'MRSBL0', 'MRSBL1', 'MRSBL2') AND RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE BETWEEN '2014-01-01' AND '2015-12-31' ) SELECT DISTINCT DXCC_ICD_CODE AS "ICD-9/10 Dx Code", DXCC_ICD_MSK_DESC AS "ICD-9/10 Dx Description" FROM PTS JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON MRN=PT_MRN JOIN DV.PATIENT_DIAGNOSIS_FINAL_ALL_V ON PDX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID JOIN DV.DATE_V ON PDX_DX_DATE_ID = DT_DATE_ID JOIN DV.DIAGNOSIS_CATALOG ON PDX_DX_CATALOG_ID = DXCC_DX_CATALOG_ID GROUP BY PT_MRN, DXCC_ICD_CODE, DXCC_ICD_MSK_DESC ; WITH PTS AS (SELECT RRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID, PT_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_BIRTH_DTE, RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE "CNS Lesion Date" FROM DV.RADIOLOGY_REPORT_V JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V ON RRPT_MRN=PT_MRN WHERE (CONTAINS(RRPT_REPORT_TXT, '"tumor"') <> 0 OR CONTAINS(RRPT_REPORT_TXT, '"metastas"') <> 0 OR CONTAINS(RRPT_REPORT_TXT, '"lesion"') <> 0) AND CONTAINS(RRPT_REPORT_TXT, '"comparison: none"') <> 0 AND RRPT_ANC_CODE IN ('CTHD', 'CTHD1', 'CTHD2', 'MRBL', 'MRBL0', 'MRBL3T', 'MRBLFP', 'MRBLS', 'MRBLS0', 'MRBLS3T', 'MRBLSP', 'MRBLSS', 'MRHD', 'MRHD0P', 'MRHD1', 'MRHD13T', 'MRHD1P', 'MRHD2', 'MRHD23T', 'MRHD2P', 'MRHD3T', 'MRIACBL0', 'MRIACBL1', 'MRIACBL2', 'MRSBL0', 'MRSBL1', 'MRSBL2') AND RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE BETWEEN '2014-01-01' AND '2015-12-31' ), LABS AS (SELECT PTS.*, SUBTEST.LTC_SUBTEST_NAME SUBTEST_1, MIN(PLR_RESULT_VALUE) MIN_1, MAX(PLR_RESULT_VALUE) MAX_1 FROM PTS JOIN DV.PATIENT_LAB_RESULT ON PLR_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID=RRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID JOIN DV.LAB_TEST_CATALOG_V AS TEST ON PLR_LAB_TEST_CATALOG_ID = TEST.LTC_LAB_TEST_CATALOG_ID JOIN DV.LAB_TEST_CATALOG_V AS SUBTEST ON PLR_LAB_SUBTEST_CATALOG_ID = SUBTEST.LTC_LAB_TEST_CATALOG_ID WHERE SUBTEST.LTC_SUBTEST_NAME IN ('Platelets.') AND UPPER(PLR_RESULT_VALUE) not like 'CLO%' AND PLR_RESULT_VALUE <> 'QNS' AND PLR_RESULT_VALUE <> '' AND DATE(PLR_PERFORMED_DT) BETWEEN "CNS Lesion Date" AND "CNS Lesion Date" + 2 YEARS GROUP BY RRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID, PT_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_BIRTH_DTE, "CNS Lesion Date", SUBTEST.LTC_SUBTEST_NAME) SELECT * FROM LABS

prompt: Provide data on pre-operative clearance visits completed in the General Internal Medicine Service on referrals from Neurology attendings.
completion: WITH NEURO AS (SELECT CPD_RES_ID FROM IDB.CL_RES_DEPT JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPD_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID WHERE CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 = 'NRS' ) SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN AS "MRN", CPE_ENC_DTE AS "Appt Date", VD.CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 AS "Department", VD.CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 AS "Service", VD.CLD_DEPT_NAME AS "Department Name", VR.CRE_RES_NAME AS "Provider Name", CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME AS "Visit Type", RR.CRE_RES_NAME AS "Referring Provider Name" FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE VR ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = VR.CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE RR ON CPE_REF_RES_ID = RR.CRE_RES_ID JOIN NEURO ON CPD_RES_ID = CPE_REF_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT VD ON CPE_DEPT_ID = VD.CLD_DEPT_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT RD ON CPE_REF_DEP_ID = RD.CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT date - 1 YEAR AND CURRENT date AND VD.CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 = 'GIM' AND CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME like '%CLEARANCE%' ; WITH NEURO AS (SELECT CPD_RES_ID FROM IDB.CL_RES_DEPT JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPD_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID WHERE CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 = 'NRS' ) , VIS AS (SELECT CPE_MRN AS "MRN", CPE_ENC_DTE AS "Appt Date", VD.CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 AS "Department", VD.CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 AS "Service", VD.CLD_DEPT_NAME AS "Department Name", VR.CRE_RES_NAME AS "Provider Name", CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME AS "Visit Type", RD.CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 AS "Referring Department", RD.CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 AS "Referring Service", RR.CRE_RES_NAME AS "Referring Provider Name" FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE VR ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = VR.CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE RR ON CPE_REF_RES_ID = RR.CRE_RES_ID JOIN NEURO ON CPD_RES_ID = CPE_REF_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT VD ON CPE_DEPT_ID = VD.CLD_DEPT_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT RD ON CPE_REF_DEP_ID = RD.CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT date - 1 YEAR AND CURRENT date AND VD.CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 = 'GIM' AND CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME like '%CLEARANCE%' ) SELECT DISTINCT VIS.*, SSE_SURG_DTE "Surgery Date", SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD "CPT Code", SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC "Procedure" FROM VIS JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT ON "MRN" = SSE_MRN JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE ON SSE_LOG_ID = SSP_LOG_ID AND SSE_ENC_CSN_ID = SSP_ENC_CSN_ID WHERE (SSE_SURG_LOC not like '%IR%' AND SSE_SURG_LOC not like '%ENDO%' AND SSE_SOURCE_TYPE <> 'E') AND SSE_SURG_DTE > "Appt Date" AND SSP_SURG_SVC_CD = 'NEURO' ;

prompt: Name, MRN and DOS for completed hepatic embolization from 1998 - 3/1/2009.
completion: SELECT DISTINCT "t1"."PT_MRN" AS "MRN", "t1"."PT_FIRST_NAME" AS "First Name", "t1"."PT_LAST_NAME" AS "Last Name", "t2"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AS "Deident PT #", "t3"."PCC_CODE" AS "CPT Procedure Code - PBD", "t3"."PCC_DESC" AS "CPT Procedure Desc - PBD", "t4"."DT_DTE" AS "CPT Procedure Date - PBD" FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED" "t2" INNER JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS" "t1" ON "t2"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t1"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."CPT_PBD_PATIENT_PROCEDURE" "t3" ON "t2"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t3"."PTX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE" "t4" ON "t3"."PTX_PROC_DATE_ID" = "t4"."DT_DATE_ID" WHERE ("t3"."PROC_ID" IN (5954, 10877) AND "t4"."DT_DTE" BETWEEN '1998-1-1' AND '2009-3-1' ) SELECT DISTINCT "t1"."PT_MRN" AS "MRN", "t1"."PT_FIRST_NAME" AS "First Name", "t1"."PT_LAST_NAME" AS "Last Name", "t2"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AS "Deident PT #", "t3"."PCC_CODE" AS "CPT Procedure Code - PBD", "t3"."PCC_DESC" AS "CPT Procedure Desc - PBD", "t4"."DT_DTE" AS "CPT Procedure Date - PBD", "t3a"."PCC_CODE" AS "CPT Procedure Code - PBD", "t3a"."PCC_DESC" AS "CPT Procedure Desc - PBD" FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED" "t2" INNER JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS" "t1" ON "t2"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t1"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."CPT_PBD_PATIENT_PROCEDURE" "t3" ON "t2"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t3"."PTX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE" "t4" ON "t3"."PTX_PROC_DATE_ID" = "t4"."DT_DATE_ID" FULL OUTER JOIN "DV"."CPT_PBD_PATIENT_PROCEDURE" "t3a" ON "t2"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t3a"."PTX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AND "t3"."PTX_PROC_DATE_ID" = "t3a"."PTX_PROC_DATE_ID" AND "t3a"."PROC_ID" = 5954 WHERE "t3"."PROC_ID" IN (10877) AND "t4"."DT_DTE" BETWEEN '1998-1-1' AND '2009-3-1' AND "t3a"."PROC_ID" IS NULL SELECT DISTINCT "t1"."PT_MRN" AS "MRN", "t1"."PT_FIRST_NAME" AS "First Name", "t1"."PT_LAST_NAME" AS "Last Name", "t2"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AS "Deident PT #", "t3"."PCC_CODE" AS "CPT Procedure Code - PBD", "t3"."PCC_DESC" AS "CPT Procedure Desc - PBD", "t4"."DT_DTE" AS "CPT Procedure Date - PBD", "t3a"."PCC_CODE" AS "CPT Procedure Code - PBD", "t3a"."PCC_DESC" AS "CPT Procedure Desc - PBD" FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED" "t2" INNER JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS" "t1" ON "t2"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t1"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."CPT_PBD_PATIENT_PROCEDURE" "t3" ON "t2"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t3"."PTX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE" "t4" ON "t3"."PTX_PROC_DATE_ID" = "t4"."DT_DATE_ID" FULL OUTER JOIN "DV"."CPT_PBD_PATIENT_PROCEDURE" "t3a" ON "t2"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t3a"."PTX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AND "t3"."PTX_PROC_DATE_ID" = "t3a"."PTX_PROC_DATE_ID" AND "t3a"."PROC_ID" = 10877 WHERE "t3"."PROC_ID" IN (5954) AND "t4"."DT_DTE" BETWEEN '1998-1-1' AND '2009-3-1' AND "t3a"."PROC_ID" IS NULL

prompt: Create a report which will provide the number of Sarcoma patients treated at MSKCC with Adriamycin in the last 2 years (can be mid 2008-mid 2010 if more recent info is not present)

"t1"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t2"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PHM_PT_MEDS_MQT" "t5" ON "t1"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t5"."POD_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN prompt: Provide pediatric inpatient and outpatient volume for ACGME Specialty-specific Application Questions for Patient Population and Oncologic Diagnoses and Disorders.
completion: WITH IP AS (SELECT D.ADMIT_ID, CALENDAR_DATE, D.ADMIT_DATE, D.DISCHARGE_DATE, TOTAL_LOS, SVC_ADMIT, A.SVC_DISCHARGE, SVC_MIDNIGHT, FLOOR_MIDNIGHT, D.MRN FROM IDB.INPATIENT_DAYS_V D JOIN IDB.INPATIENT_ADMISSIONS_V A ON D.ADMIT_ID = A.ADMIT_ID AND D.VIS_VISIT_ID = A.VIS_VISIT_ID WHERE CALENDAR_DATE BETWEEN '2017-07-01' AND '2020-06-30' AND D.INPATIENT_STATUS = 'Inpatient' AND SERVICE_MIDNIGHT ='Pediatrics' ) , DX AS (SELECT TM_MRN, TM_DX_DTE DX_DTE, TM_SITE_CD AS SITE_CODE, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_DESC, TM_HIST_CD AS HIST_CODE, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS HIST_DESC, CASE WHEN TM_HIST_CD IN ('M9060/3', 'M9061/3', 'M9062/3', 'M9063/3', 'M9064/2', 'M9064/3', 'M9065/3', 'M9070/3', 'M9071/3', 'M9072/3', 'M9080/0', 'M9080/1', 'M9080/3', 'M9081/3', 'M9082/3', 'M9083/3', 'M9084/3', 'M9085/3', 'M9100/3', 'M9101/3', 'M9102/3', 'M9105/3') THEN 'Germ cell tumor' WHEN TM_HIST_CD IN ('M8800/3', 'M8801/3', 'M8802/3', 'M8803/3', 'M8804/3', 'M8805/3', 'M8810/3', 'M8811/3', 'M8812/3', 'M8813/3', 'M8814/3', 'M8825/3', 'M8832/3', 'M8833/3', 'M8840/3', 'M8850/3', 'M8851/3', 'M8852/3', 'M8853/3', 'M8854/3', 'M8855/3', 'M8857/3', 'M8858/3', 'M8860/3', 'M8890/3', 'M8891/3', 'M8894/3', 'M8895/3', 'M8896/3', 'M8930/3', 'M8931/3', 'M8933/3', 'M8935/3', 'M8964/3', 'M8980/3', 'M8981/3', 'M8991/3', 'M9040/3', 'M9041/3', 'M9042/3', 'M9043/3', 'M9044/3', 'M9120/3', 'M9124/3', 'M9140/3', 'M9170/3', 'M9290/3', 'M9330/3', 'M9342/3', 'M9480/3', 'M9481/3', 'M9539/3', 'M9540/3', 'M9581/3', 'M9592/3', 'M9593/3', 'M9610/3', 'M9631/3', 'M9640/3', 'M9642/3', 'M9740/3', 'M9755/3', 'M9756/3', 'M9757/3', 'M9930/3', 'M9473/3', 'M9364/3') THEN 'Soft tissue sarcoma' WHEN TM_HIST_CD IN ('M8960/3') THEN 'Wilms tumor' WHEN TM_HIST_CD IN ('M9500/3') THEN 'Neuroblastoma' WHEN TM_HIST_CD IN ('M9510/3', 'M9511/3', 'M9512/3', 'M9513/3') THEN 'Retinoblastoma' WHEN CATEGORY3 IN ('Non-Hodgkin Lymphoma', 'NHL - Nodal', 'NHL - Extranodal') THEN 'Non-Hodgkin Lymphoma' ELSE CATEGORY3 END DX FROM (SELECT DISTINCT MRN FROM IP) JOIN IDB.CDB_TUMOR ON MRN = TM_MRN JOIN IDB.CLM H ON TM_HIST_CD = H.CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON TM_SITE_CD = S.CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.SEERGROUPING ON IDB.SEERF_ICDO(TM_SITE_CD, TM_HIST_CD) = RECODE WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7') UNION SELECT CC_MRN TM_MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) DX_DTE, '' AS SITE_CODE, '' AS SITE_DESC, '' AS HIST_CODE, '' AS HIST_DESC, 'MDS' DX FROM (SELECT DISTINCT MRN FROM IP) JOIN IDB.CTC_CLSF ON MRN = CC_MRN JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE (SUBSTR(CC_CLSF_CD, 1, 3) IN ('D46') OR CC_CLSF_CD like '238.7%') AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' GROUP BY CC_MRN ) , DX_1 AS (SELECT TM_MRN, SITE_CODE, SITE_DESC, HIST_CODE, HIST_DESC, DX_DTE, DX, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY TM_MRN ORDER BY DX_DTE DESC) RN FROM DX WHERE DX <> 'Miscellaneous' ) SELECT ADMIT_ID, CALENDAR_DATE, ADMIT_DATE, DISCHARGE_DATE, TOTAL_LOS, SVC_ADMIT, SVC_DISCHARGE, SVC_MIDNIGHT, FLOOR_MIDNIGHT, MRN, MAX(CASE WHEN RN = 1 THEN DX END) DX_1, MAX(CASE WHEN RN = 1 THEN TRIM(HIST_CODE) || ' ' || TRIM(HIST_DESC) END) HIST_1, MAX(CASE WHEN RN = 1 THEN DX_DTE END) DX_DTE_1, MAX(CASE WHEN RN = 2 THEN DX END) DX_2, MAX(CASE WHEN RN = 2 THEN TRIM(HIST_CODE) || ' ' || TRIM(HIST_DESC) END) HIST_2, MAX(CASE WHEN RN = 2 THEN DX_DTE END) DX_DTE_2, MAX(CASE WHEN RN = 3 THEN DX END) DX_3, MAX(CASE WHEN RN = 3 THEN TRIM(HIST_CODE) || ' ' || TRIM(HIST_DESC) END) HIST_3, MAX(CASE WHEN RN = 3 THEN DX_DTE END) DX_DTE_3 FROM IP LEFT JOIN DX_1 ON MRN = TM_MRN GROUP BY ADMIT_ID, CALENDAR_DATE, ADMIT_DATE, DISCHARGE_DATE, TOTAL_LOS, SVC_ADMIT, SVC_DISCHARGE, SVC_MIDNIGHT, FLOOR_MIDNIGHT, MRN ; WITH OP AS (SELECT CPE_MRN, CPE_ENC_DTE APPT_DATE, CASE WHEN CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN '2017-07-01' AND '2018-06-30' THEN 'ACADEMIC_YEAR_1' WHEN CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN '2017-07-01' AND '2020-06-30' AND (CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 = ('PED') OR CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_4 = ('PED') OR CLD_DEPT_NAME = 'ORTHOPEDICS 1275-9') AND CPE_CPE_IP_IND <> 'INPATIENT' AND CRE_RES_TYP = 'Physician' ) , DX AS (SELECT TM_MRN, TM_DX_DTE DX_DTE, TM_SITE_CD AS SITE_CODE, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_DESC, TM_HIST_CD AS HIST_CODE, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS HIST_DESC, CASE WHEN TM_HIST_CD IN ('M9060/3', 'M9061/3', 'M9062/3', 'M9063/3', 'M9064/2', 'M9064/3', 'M9065/3', 'M9070/3', 'M9071/3', 'M9072/3', 'M9080/0', 'M9080/1', 'M9080/3', 'M9081/3', 'M9082/3', 'M9083/3', 'M9084/3', 'M9085/3', 'M9100/3', 'M9101/3', 'M9102/3', 'M9105/3') THEN 'Germ cell tumor' WHEN TM_HIST_CD IN ('M8800/3', 'M8801/3', 'M8802/3', 'M8803/3', 'M8804/3', 'M8805/3', 'M8810/3', 'M8811/3', 'M8812/3', 'M8813/3', 'M8814/3', 'M8825/3', 'M8832/3', 'M8833/3', 'M8840/3', 'M8850/3', 'M8851/3', 'M8852/3', 'M8853/3', 'M8854/3', 'M8855/3', 'M8857/3', 'M8858/3', 'M8860/3', 'M8890/3', 'M8891/3', 'M8894/3', 'M8895/3', 'M8896/3', 'M8930/3', 'M8931/3', 'M8933/3', 'M8935/3', 'M8964/3', 'M8980/3', 'M8981/3', 'M8991/3', 'M9040/3', 'M9041/3', 'M9042/3', 'M9043/3', 'M9044/3', 'M9120/3', 'M9124/3', 'M9140/3', 'M9170/3', 'M9290/3', 'M9330/3', 'M9342/3', 'M9480/3', 'M9481/3', 'M9539/3', 'M9540/3', 'M9581/3', 'M9592/3', 'M9593/3', 'M9610/3', 'M9631/3', 'M9640/3', 'M9642/3', 'M9740/3', 'M9755/3', 'M9756/3', 'M9757/3', 'M9930/3', 'M9473/3', 'M9364/3') THEN 'Soft tissue sarcoma' WHEN TM_HIST_CD IN ('M8960/3') THEN 'Wilms tumor' WHEN TM_HIST_CD IN ('M9500/3') THEN 'Neuroblastoma' WHEN TM_HIST_CD IN ('M9510/3', 'M9511/3', 'M9512/3', 'M9513/3') THEN 'Retinoblastoma' WHEN CATEGORY3 IN ('Non-Hodgkin Lymphoma', 'NHL - Nodal', 'NHL - Extranodal') THEN 'Non-Hodgkin Lymphoma' ELSE CATEGORY3 END DX FROM (SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN FROM OP) JOIN IDB.CDB_TUMOR ON CPE_MRN = TM_MRN JOIN IDB.CLM H ON TM_HIST_CD = H.CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON TM_SITE_CD = S.CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.SEERGROUPING ON IDB.SEERF_ICDO(TM_SITE_CD, TM_HIST_CD) = RECODE WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7') UNION SELECT CC_MRN TM_MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) DX_DTE, ''
