prompt: Provide a list of patients from 3 protocols with stored tissue blocks and/or IMPACT testing.
completion: WITH AC AS (SELECT DISTINCT AC_IRB_NO, AC_MRN AS MRN, STRIP(PT_LAST_NAME)||', '||STRIP(PT_FIRST_NAME) AS NAME FROM IDB.PATIENT JOIN IDB.ACCRUALS AC ON PT_MRN = AC_MRN WHERE AC_IRB_NO IN ('18-431', '18-486') UNION SELECT DISTINCT AC_IRB_NO, AC_MRN AS MRN, STRIP(PT_LAST_NAME)||', '||STRIP(PT_FIRST_NAME) AS NAME FROM IDB.PATIENT JOIN IDB.ACCRUALS AC ON PT_MRN = AC_MRN WHERE AC_IRB_NO IN ('12-245') AND AC_MRN IN () ) , IMPACT AS (SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN, NAME, AC_IRB_NO, PDWS_DESCRIPTION, PDRX_ACCESSION_NO, T.* FROM AC JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON PT_MRN = MRN JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML DT ON PDRX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML_SETTINGS ON PDRX_PATH_DMP_RESULTS_XML_ID = PDRXS_PATH_DMP_RESULTS_XML_ID JOIN DVDMC.PATHOLOGY_DMP_WEBSVC_SETTINGS ON PDRXS_SETTING_ID = PDWS_SETTING_ID CROSS JOIN XMLTABLE('$c/root/*' PASSING DT.PDRX_XML_VALUE AS "c" COLUMNS DT_PROCEDURE VARCHAR(40) PATH '../meta-data/dt_procedure', DT_SIGNOUT VARCHAR(40) PATH '../meta-data/dt_signout', DT_ACCESSIONED VARCHAR(40) PATH '../meta-data/dt_accessioned') T WHERE 1=1 AND PDWS_NAME like '%IMPACT%' AND PT_MRN IN (SELECT MRN FROM AC) ) SELECT DISTINCT B.PT_MRN "MRN", NAME, AC_IRB_NO, TBA_PROCUREMENT_DTE "Procurement Date", TBA_ACCESSION_NUM "Accession Number", TBA_PART_NUM "Part Number", TBA_SUB_PART_NUM "Sub Part Number", TBD_BANK_NUM "Bank Number", TBA_TISSUE_TYPE_DESC "Tissue Type", TBA_DISEASE_DESC "Disease", TBA_SITE_DESC "Site", TBD_CATEGORY_DESC "Specimen Category", TBD_UNIT_DESC "Specimen Unit", TBD_QUALITY_DESC "Specimen Quality", TBD_SPECIMEN_TYPE_DESC "Specimen Type" FROM AC JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V ON PT_MRN = MRN JOIN DV.TISSUE_BANK_ACCESSION A ON TBA_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS B ON TBA_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = B.PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID JOIN DV.TISSUE_BANK_DETAIL ON TBA_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = TBD_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID AND TBA_ACCESSION_NUM = TBD_ACCESSION_NUM AND TBA_PART_NUM = TBD_PART_NUM AND TBA_SUB_PART_NUM = TBD_SUB_PART_NUM WHERE (TBD_RESERVED_REQUEST_ID IS NULL OR TBD_RESERVED_REQUEST_ID = '' ) AND TBD_DISTRIBUTION_DT IS NULL AND TBD_BANK_NUM IS NOT NULL AND SUBSTR(TBD_ACCESSION_NUM, 1, 1) IN ('A', 'H', 'S') AND TBD_QUALITY_DESC = 'Frozen Specimen' AND TBD_SPECIMEN_TYPE_DESC = 'Tissue'

prompt: update the ADCs to include patritumab deruxtecan
completion: WITH BRAIN_METS AS (SELECT DISTINCT CC_MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS INITIAL_METS_DATE, CLM_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND ((CC_PT_TYPE = 'I') OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) AND CC_CLSF_CD IN ('C79.3', 'C79.31', '198.3') GROUP BY CC_MRN, CLM_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK) , RADONC AS (SELECT DISTINCT RTC_TX_MRN, INITIAL_METS_DATE, MIN(RTC_TX_START_DTE) AS MIN_RAD_TX_DATE, MAX(RTC_TX_STOP_DTE) AS MAX_RAD_TX_DATE, PT_DATE_OF_DEATH, PLA_LST_DRVST_DTE FROM IDB.RADONC_TREATMENT_COURSE JOIN BRAIN_METS ON CC_MRN = RTC_TX_MRN AND RTC_TX_START_DTE BETWEEN '2018-01-01' AND '2022-01-01' JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PT_MRN=CC_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY ON PT_MRN =PLA_MRN GROUP BY RTC_TX_MRN, INITIAL_METS_DATE, PT_DATE_OF_DEATH, PLA_LST_DRVST_DTE ORDER BY 1, 2) , DRUG AS (SELECT DISTINCT APR_MRN, INITIAL_METS_DATE, MIN(APR_START_DTE) AS MIN_CHEMO_DATE, MAX(APR_END_DTE) AS MAX_CHEMO_DATE, CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME AS DRUG_NAME, PT_DATE_OF_DEATH AS DATE_OF_DEATH, PLA_LST_DRVST_DTE AS LAST_FOLLOWUP_DATE FROM RADONC JOIN IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX ON APR_MRN=RTC_TX_MRN JOIN IDB.CHEMO_DRUG_GENERIC ON APR_GENERIC_NAME = CDG_GENERIC_NAME WHERE(UPPER(CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME) LIKE ('%TRASTUZUMAB DERUXTECAN%') OR UPPER(CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME) LIKE ('%TRASTUZUMAB EMTANSINE%') OR UPPER(CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME) LIKE ('%SACITUZUMAB GOVITECAN%') OR UPPER(CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME) LIKE ('%ENFORTUMAB VEDOTIN%') OR UPPER(CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME) LIKE ('%PATRITUMAB DERUXTECAN (U3-1402)%')) AND APR_CHEMO_FLAG ='Y' GROUP BY APR_MRN, INITIAL_METS_DATE, CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME, PT_DATE_OF_DEATH, PLA_LST_DRVST_DTE ORDER BY 1, 3) SELECT * FROM DRUG ; WITH BRAIN_METS AS (SELECT DISTINCT CC_MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS INITIAL_METS_DATE, CLM_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND ((CC_PT_TYPE = 'I') OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) AND CC_CLSF_CD IN ('C79.3', 'C79.31', '198.3') GROUP BY CC_MRN, CLM_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK) , RADONC AS (SELECT DISTINCT RTC_TX_MRN, INITIAL_METS_DATE, MIN(RTC_TX_START_DTE) AS MIN_RAD_TX_DATE, MAX(RTC_TX_STOP_DTE) AS MAX_RAD_TX_DATE, PT_DATE_OF_DEATH, PLA_LST_DRVST_DTE FROM IDB.RADONC_TREATMENT_COURSE JOIN BRAIN_METS ON CC_MRN = RTC_TX_MRN AND RTC_TX_START_DTE BETWEEN '2018-01-01' AND '2022-01-01' JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PT_MRN=CC_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY ON PT_MRN =PLA_MRN GROUP BY RTC_TX_MRN, INITIAL_METS_DATE, PT_DATE_OF_DEATH, PLA_LST_DRVST_DTE ORDER BY 1, 2) , DRUG2 AS (SELECT DISTINCT APR_MRN, CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME AS DRUG_NAME, APR_START_DTE AS CHEMO_START_DATE, APR_END_DTE AS CHEMO_END_DATE, APR_TOTAL_GIVEN_DOSE, APR_DOSE_UOM FROM RADONC JOIN IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX ON APR_MRN=RTC_TX_MRN JOIN IDB.CHEMO_DRUG_GENERIC ON APR_GENERIC_NAME = CDG_GENERIC_NAME WHERE(UPPER(CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME) LIKE ('%TRASTUZUMAB DERUXTECAN%') OR UPPER(CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME) LIKE ('%TRASTUZUMAB EMTANSINE%') OR UPPER(CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME) LIKE ('%SACITUZUMAB GOVITECAN%') OR UPPER(CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME) LIKE ('%ENFORTUMAB VEDOTIN%') OR UPPER(CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME) LIKE ('%PATRITUMAB DERUXTECAN (U3-1402)%')) AND APR_CHEMO_FLAG ='Y' ORDER BY 1, 3) SELECT * FROM DRUG2 ; WITH BRAIN_METS AS (SELECT DISTINCT CC_MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS INITIAL_METS_DATE, CLM_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND ((CC_PT_TYPE = 'I') OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) AND CC_CLSF_CD IN ('C79.3', 'C79.31', '198.3') GROUP BY CC_MRN, CLM_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK) , RADONC AS (SELECT DISTINCT RTC_TX_MRN, INITIAL_METS_DATE, MIN(RTC_TX_START_DTE) AS MIN_RAD_TX_DATE, MAX(RTC_TX_STOP_DTE) AS MAX_RAD_TX_DATE, PT_DATE_OF_DEATH, PLA_LST_DRVST_DTE FROM IDB.RADONC_TREATMENT_COURSE JOIN BRAIN_METS ON CC_MRN = RTC_TX_MRN AND RTC_TX_START_DTE BETWEEN '2018-01-01' AND '2022-01-01' JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PT_MRN=CC_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY ON PT_MRN =PLA_MRN GROUP BY RTC_TX_MRN, INITIAL_METS_DATE, PT_DATE_OF_DEATH, PLA_LST_DRVST_DTE ORDER BY 1, 2) , RADONC2 AS (SELECT DISTINCT RTC_TX_MRN, RTC_TX_PLAN_NAME, RTC_TX_START_DTE, RTC_TX_STOP_DTE, RTC_TX_PLANNED_FRACTIONS, RTC_TX_DELIVERED_FRACTIONS, RTC_TX_PLANNED_DOSE, RTC_TX_DELIVERED_DOSE FROM IDB.RADONC_TREATMENT_COURSE JOIN BRAIN_METS ON CC_MRN = RTC_TX_MRN AND RTC_TX_START_DTE BETWEEN '2018-01-01' AND '2022-01-01' JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PT_MRN=CC_MRN ORDER BY 1, 3) SELECT * FROM RADONC2

prompt: request of all scheduled PST appts for patients of Dr. Ehdaie
completion: WITH APPOINTMENTS_0 AS (SELECT "DV"."PATIENT_ENCOUNTER"."PENC_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AS PT_DEID, CL_PT_ENCOUNTER."CPE_ENC_CSN_ID" AS SUBJECT_ID, CL_PT_ENCOUNTER."CPE_ENC_DTE" AS APPT_DATE, CL_PT_ENCOUNTER."CPE_CPE_APPT_STS" AS APPT_STATUS, CL_DEPT_DEPT_NAME."CLD_DEPT_NAME" AS DEPT_NAME, CL_RESOURCE_REF_PROV."CRE_RES_NAME" AS REFERRING_PROV FROM "DV"."PATIENT_ENCOUNTER" JOIN "IDB"."CL_PT_ENCOUNTER" AS CL_PT_ENCOUNTER ON "DV"."PATIENT_ENCOUNTER"."PENC_ENC_CSN_ID" = CL_PT_ENCOUNTER."CPE_ENC_CSN_ID" JOIN "IDB"."CL_DEPT" AS CL_DEPT_DEPT_NAME ON CL_PT_ENCOUNTER."CPE_DEPT_ID" = CL_DEPT_DEPT_NAME."CLD_DEPT_ID" JOIN "IDB"."CL_RESOURCE" AS CL_RESOURCE_REF_PROV ON CL_PT_ENCOUNTER."CPE_REF_RES_ID" = CL_RESOURCE_REF_PROV."CRE_RES_ID" WHERE CL_PT_ENCOUNTER."CPE_ENC_DTE" BETWEEN CURRENT_DATE AND CURRENT_DATE + 21 DAYS AND CL_PT_ENCOUNTER."CPE_CPE_APPT_STS" IN ('Sch') AND CL_DEPT_DEPT_NAME."CLD_DEPT_NAME" IN ('BER PST-2', 'BSK PST', 'CMK PST', 'MON PST-2', 'MON PST-C', 'MON PST-LC', 'NAS PST-2', 'PST 16 E60', 'PST 53', 'PST KOCH-17', 'PST WES', 'SUMMIT PST') AND CL_RESOURCE_REF_PROV."CRE_RES_NAME" IN ('EHDAIE, BEHFAR')), APPOINTMENTS_1 AS (SELECT "DV"."PATIENT_ENCOUNTER"."PENC_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AS PT_DEID, CL_PT_ENCOUNTER."CPE_ENC_CSN_ID" AS SUBJECT_ID, CL_PT_ENCOUNTER."CPE_ENC_DTE" AS APPT_DATE, CL_PT_ENCOUNTER."CPE_CPE_APPT_STS" AS APPT_STATUS, CL_VISIT_TYPE_AT."CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME" AS APPT_TYPE_NAME, CL_RESOURCE_REF_PROV."CRE_RES_NAME" AS REFERRING_PROV FROM "DV"."PATIENT_ENCOUNTER" JOIN "IDB"."CL_PT_ENCOUNTER" AS CL_PT_ENCOUNTER ON "DV"."PATIENT_ENCOUNTER"."PENC_ENC_CSN_ID" = CL_PT_ENCOUNTER."CPE_ENC_CSN_ID" JOIN "IDB"."CL_VISIT_TYPE" AS CL_VISIT_TYPE_AT ON CL_PT_ENCOUNTER."CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID" = CL_VISIT_TYPE_AT."CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID" JOIN "IDB"."CL_RESOURCE" AS CL_RESOURCE_REF_PROV ON CL_PT_ENCOUNTER."CPE_REF_RES_ID" = CL_RESOURCE_REF_PROV."CRE_RES_ID" WHERE CL_PT_ENCOUNTER."CPE_ENC_DTE" BETWEEN CURRENT_DATE - 21 DAYS AND CURRENT_DATE AND CL_PT_ENCOUNTER."CPE_CPE_APPT_STS" IN ('Sch') AND CL_VISIT_TYPE_AT."CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME" IN ('PST') AND CL_RESOURCE_REF_PROV."CRE_RES_NAME" IN ('EHDAIE, BEHFAR')), COHORT AS (SELECT PT_DEID AS PT_DEID FROM ( (SELECT APPOINTMENTS_0.PT_DEID FROM APPOINTMENTS_0 UNION SELECT APPOINTMENTS_1.PT_DEID FROM APPOINTMENTS_1))), COHORT_APPOINTMENTS AS (SELECT SUBJECT_ID AS SUBJECT_ID, PT_DEID AS PT_DEID FROM ( (SELECT APPOINTMENTS_0.SUBJECT_ID, APPOINTMENTS_0.PT_DEID FROM APPOINTMENTS_0 UNION SELECT APPOINTMENTS_1.SUBJECT_ID, APPOINTMENTS_1.PT_DEID FROM APPOINTMENTS_1))), KEYS AS (SELECT COHORT.PT_DEID AS COHORT_PT_DEID, COHORT_APPOINTMENTS.SUBJECT_ID AS COHORT_APPOINTMENTS_SUBJECT_ID, COHORT_APPOINTMENTS.PT_DEID AS COHORT_APPOINTMENTS_PT_DEID FROM COHORT LEFT OUTER JOIN COHORT_APPOINTMENTS ON COHORT_APPOINTMENTS.PT_DEID = COHORT.PT_DEID), DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS AS (SELECT DISTINCT "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AS PT_DEID, "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AS SUBJECT_ID, "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_MRN" AS PT_MRN FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"), APPOINTMENTS_COLUMNS AS (SELECT DISTINCT "DV"."PATIENT_ENCOUNTER"."PENC_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AS PT_DEID, CL_PT_ENCOUNTER."CPE_ENC_CSN_ID" AS SUBJECT_ID, CL_PT_ENCOUNTER."CPE_ENC_DTE" AS APPT_DATE, CL_PT_ENCOUNTER."CPE_CPE_APPT_STS" AS APPT_STATUS, CL_VISIT_TYPE_AT."CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME" AS APPT_TYPE_NAME, CL_DEPT_DEPT_NAME."CLD_DEPT_NAME" AS DEPT_NAME FROM "DV"."PATIENT_ENCOUNTER" JOIN "IDB"."CL_PT_ENCOUNTER" AS CL_PT_ENCOUNTER ON "DV"."PATIENT_ENCOUNTER"."PENC_ENC_CSN_ID" = CL_PT_ENCOUNTER."CPE_ENC_CSN_ID" JOIN "IDB"."CL_VISIT_TYPE" AS CL_VISIT_TYPE_AT ON CL_PT_ENCOUNTER."CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID" = CL_VISIT_TYPE_AT."CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID" JOIN "IDB"."CL_DEPT" AS CL_DEPT_DEPT_NAME ON CL_PT_ENCOUNTER."CPE_DEPT_ID" = CL_DEPT_DEPT_NAME."CLD_DEPT_ID") SELECT DISTINCT DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS.PT_MRN AS MRN, APPOINTMENTS_COLUMNS.APPT_DATE AS APPT_DATE, APPOINTMENTS_COLUMNS.APPT_STATUS AS APPT_STATUS, APPOINTMENTS_COLUMNS.APPT_TYPE_NAME AS APPT_TYPE, APPOINTMENTS_COLUMNS.DEPT_NAME AS APPT_DEPARTMENT FROM KEYS LEFT OUTER JOIN DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS ON DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS.PT_DEID = KEYS.COHORT_PT_DEID LEFT OUTER JOIN APPOINTMENTS_COLUMNS ON prompt: Outpatient visit volume for Head & Neck Surgery Faculty for Jan-Dec 2019, 2021 and 2022 (YTD) by month.
completion: WITH SURGEON AS (SELECT DISTINCT DOC_DR_NO, DOC_NAME AS SURGEON, DOC_ACDMC_DPT AS DEPARTMENT, DOC_ACDMC_SVC AS PROVIDER_SERVICE, DOC_SVC, MONTH(CPE_ENC_DTE) AS "MONTH", REPLACE(YEAR(CPE_ENC_DTE), ',') AS "YEAR", CPE_CPE_APPT_STS, CVT_IN_OUT_PT, CPE_MRN FROM IDB.DOC JOIN IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER ON DOC_DR_NO = CPE_VST_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE DOC_ACDMC_SVC LIKE ('%HEAD & NECK%') AND CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CVT_IN_OUT_PT = 'Outpatient' AND YEAR(CPE_ENC_DTE) IN ('2019', '2021', '2022')) SELECT DISTINCT SURGEON, PROVIDER_SERVICE, CVT_IN_OUT_PT INDICATOR, "MONTH", "YEAR" FROM SURGEON; WITH SURGEON AS (SELECT DISTINCT DOC_DR_NO, DOC_NAME AS SURGEON, DOC_ACDMC_DPT AS DEPARTMENT, DOC_ACDMC_SVC AS PROVIDER_SERVICE, DOC_SVC, MONTH(CPE_ENC_DTE) AS "MONTH", MONTH(CPE_ENC_DTE) AS MONTH_NUM, REPLACE(YEAR(CPE_ENC_DTE), ',') AS "YEAR", CPE_CPE_APPT_STS, CVT_IN_OUT_PT, CPE_MRN FROM IDB.DOC JOIN IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER ON DOC_DR_NO = CPE_VST_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE DOC_ACDMC_SVC LIKE ('%HEAD & NECK%') AND CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CVT_IN_OUT_PT = 'Outpatient' AND YEAR(CPE_ENC_DTE) IN ('2019', '2021', '2022')), FINAL AS (SELECT DISTINCT CASE WHEN "MONTH" = '1' THEN 'January' WHEN "MONTH" = '2' THEN 'February' WHEN "MONTH" = '3' THEN 'March' WHEN "MONTH" = '4' THEN 'April' WHEN "MONTH" = '5' THEN 'May' WHEN "MONTH" = '6' THEN 'June' WHEN "MONTH" = '7' THEN 'July' WHEN "MONTH" = '8' THEN 'Augest' WHEN "MONTH" = '9' THEN 'September' WHEN "MONTH" = '10' THEN 'October' WHEN "MONTH" = '11' THEN 'November' WHEN "MONTH" = '12' THEN 'December' ELSE NULL END AS MONTH_NAME, "MONTH", MONTH_NUM, "YEAR", COUNT(CPE_MRN) OVER (PARTITION BY "MONTH", "YEAR" ORDER BY "MONTH") PATIENTS_COUNT FROM SURGEON) SELECT DISTINCT YEAR, MONTH_NUM, MONTH_NAME, PATIENTS_COUNT FROM FINAL ORDER BY YEAR, MONTH_NUM

prompt: We hope to investigate and compare the incidence of subsequent skin cancers (Melanoma, Basal cell (BCC), Squamous cell (SCC)) observed in patients with skin cancer at baseline. We hope to compare across different self-reported race groups, age groups, etc to evaluate for any disparities.
completion: WITH ICD AS (SELECT CC_MRN, CC_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS MIN_ICD9_EFF_DTE FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE CC_CLSF_CD IN ('C44.01', 'C44.02', 'C44.111', 'C44.112', 'C44.1121', 'C44.1122', 'C44.119', 'C44.1191', 'C44.1192', 'C44.121', 'C44.122', 'C44.1221', 'C44.1222', 'C44.129', 'C44.1291', 'C44.1292', 'C44.211', 'C44.212', 'C44.219', 'C44.221', 'C44.222', 'C44.229', 'C44.310', 'C44.311', 'C44.319', 'C44.32', 'C44.320', 'C44.321', 'C44.329', 'C44.41', 'C44.42', 'C44.510', 'C44.511', 'C44.519', 'C44.520', 'C44.521', 'C44.529', 'C44.611', 'C44.612', 'C44.619', 'C44.621', 'C44.622', 'C44.629', 'C44.711', 'C44.712', 'C44.719', 'C44.721', 'C44.722', 'C44.729', 'C44.81', 'C44.82', 'C44.91', 'C44.92') AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND (CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) GROUP BY CC_MRN, CC_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK HAVING MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) >= '2015-01-01'), VISITS AS (SELECT MRN, LATEST_MD, LATEST_MD_DTE FROM (SELECT CPE_MRN AS MRN, CRE_RES_NAME AS LATEST_MD, CPE_ENC_DTE AS LATEST_MD_DTE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CPE_MRN ORDER BY CPE_APPT_DT DESC) AS RECENCY FROM ICD JOIN IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER ON CC_MRN = CPE_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CRE_RES_TYP = 'Physician' AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT date - 1 YEAR AND CURRENT date ) A WHERE RECENCY = 1 ) SELECT DISTINCT CC_MRN "MRN" , PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH "DATE OF BIRTH" , TRIM(A.AV_DESC) AS RACE , TRIM(B.AV_DESC) AS ETHNICITY , CC_CLSF_CD "ICD-10 CODE" , CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK "ICD-10 DESCRIPTION" , MIN_ICD9_EFF_DTE "DIAGNOSIS DATE" , LATEST_MD_DTE "LATEST MD DATE" , COALESCE(MAX(PLA_LST_APPT_DTE, PLA_LST_DSCH_DTE), PLA_LST_APPT_DTE, PLA_LST_DSCH_DTE) "LAST FOLLOW-UP DATE" FROM ICD JOIN VISITS V ON CC_MRN = V.MRN JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON CC_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY ON PT_MRN = PLA_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS A ON A.AV_ELEMENT = 'RACE' AND A.AV_CODE = PT_RACE LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS B ON B.AV_ELEMENT = 'PT_ETHNICITY' AND B.AV_CODE = PT_PT_ETHNICITY ;

prompt: Weekly list of patients enrolled in protocol 17-377 and scheduled for specific surgeries
completion: WITH PROTOCOL AS (SELECT DISTINCT AC_MRN, AC_CONS_DTE FROM IDB.ACCRUALS WHERE AC_IRB_NO = '17-377' ) SELECT DISTINCT OC_MRN "MRN", PT_LAST_NAME "Last Name", PT_FIRST_NAME "First Name", PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH "DOB", AC_CONS_DTE "Consent Date", OC_SURG_DTE "Surgery Date", CRE_RES_NAME "Primary Surgeon", CPX_PROC_CD "CPT Code", CPX_PROC_NAME "CPT Description" FROM IDB.OR_CASE JOIN IDB.OR_CASE_ALL_PROC ON OC_CASE_ID = OCAP_CASE_ID JOIN IDB.OR_CASE_ALL_SURG ON OCAP_CASE_ID = OCAS_CASE_ID AND OCAS_PNL_NO = OCAP_PNL_NO AND OCAS_SURG_ROLE = 'Primary' JOIN IDB.OR_PROC ON OCAP_OR_PROC_ID = OP_OR_PROC_ID JOIN IDB.OR_CL_PROC ON OP_OR_PROC_ID = OCP_OR_PROC_ID JOIN IDB.CL_PROC ON OCP_PROC_ID = CPX_PROC_ID JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CRE_RES_ID = OCAS_RES_ID JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON OC_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN PROTOCOL ON OC_MRN = AC_MRN WHERE OC_SURG_DTE >= CURRENT date AND OC_OR_CASE_STS_CD NOT IN ('2', '5') AND CPX_PROC_CD IN ('38999', '49906', '27618', '27327', '27047', '25075', '24075', '15757') ORDER BY OC_SURG_DTE DESC, OC_MRN

prompt: Respiratory pathogen test results from patients from 8/1/2014-1/13/2021.
completion: WITH PTS AS (SELECT LR_MRN AS MRN, PT_SEX AS GENDER, AV_DESC AS RACE, PT_ZIP_CD AS ZIP, LR_PERFORMED_DTE AS LAB_DTE, LR_PERFORMED_DT AS LAB_DT, LR_RESULT_GUID AS RESULT_GUID, LR_ACCESSION_NO AS ACCESSION_NO, LR_TEST_NAME AS TEST_NAME, LR_SUBTEST_NAME AS ASSAY, RTRIM(LTL_TEXT_RESULT) AS LAB_RESULTS, PT_LAST_NAME , PT_FIRST_NAME , YEAR(CURRENT date - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) AS AGE FROM IDB.LAB_RESULTS LEFT JOIN IDB.LAB_TEXT_LINE ON LTL_RESULT_GUID = LR_RESULT_GUID JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON LR_MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS ON AV_ELEMENT = 'RACE' AND AV_CODE = PT_RACE WHERE 1=1 AND LR_PERFORMED_DTE BETWEEN '2018-08-01' AND '2021-01-13' AND LR_TEST_NAME IN ('Respiratory NAT Panel', 'Influenza Virus Types A and B/Respiratory Syncytial Virus Qualitative RNA Naso', 'Respiratory NAT Panel with SARS-CoV-2', 'COVID-19/Flu A B/RSV Qual RNA Panel') ) , IP AS (SELECT DISTINCT VIS_MRN AS IP_MRN, 'IP' AS ENC_TYPE, GENDER, RACE, ZIP, LAB_DTE, LAB_DT, RESULT_GUID , ACCESSION_NO, TEST_NAME, ASSAY, LAB_RESULTS, PT_LAST_NAME , PT_FIRST_NAME , AGE FROM PTS JOIN IDB.VISIT_V ON VIS_MRN = MRN WHERE 1=1 AND LAB_DT BETWEEN VIS_ADM_DT AND VIS_DSCH_DT AND VIS_IP_OP_ADJUSTED_IND = 'I' ) SELECT DISTINCT MRN, 'OP' AS ENC_TYPE, GENDER, RACE, ZIP, LAB_DTE, LAB_DT, RESULT_GUID , ACCESSION_NO, TEST_NAME, ASSAY, LAB_RESULTS, PT_LAST_NAME , PT_FIRST_NAME , AGE FROM PTS X WHERE 1=1 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT A.MRN, A.ACCESSION_NO, A.RESULT_GUID FROM PTS A JOIN IP B ON IP_MRN = MRN AND A.ACCESSION_NO = B.ACCESSION_NO AND A.RESULT_GUID = B.RESULT_GUID WHERE A.MRN = X.MRN AND A.ACCESSION_NO = X.ACCESSION_NO AND A.RESULT_GUID = X.RESULT_GUID) UNION ALL SELECT * FROM IP

prompt: Provide a weekly list of newly diagnosed breast cancer patient who are scheduled for a breast MRI and CEM. Include the planned NAT appointment date if available
completion: WITH DX AS (SELECT DISTINCT CC_MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS MIN_ICD_EFF_DTE , LISTAGG(TRIM(CC_CLSF_CD) , ', ') AS ICD_CODES FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON CC_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE SUBSTR(CC_CLSF_CD, 1, 3) IN ('174', 'C50') AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND (CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) AND PT_SEX = 'F' AND YEAR(CURRENT DATE - PT_BIRTH_DTE) > 18 AND CC_EFF_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT DATE - 3 MONTH AND CURRENT DATE GROUP BY CC_MRN ) , CLIND AS (SELECT DISTINCT CDD_MRN , ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY CDD_MRN ORDER BY CDD_SERVICE_DTE ASC) AS RN, CDD_SERVICE_DTE , CDD_DOC_NAME AS "Document Name", OP_DISPLAY_NAME AS PROVIDER FROM DX JOIN IDB.CD_DOCUMENT ON CC_MRN = CDD_MRN AND CDD_SERVICE_DTE >= MIN_ICD_EFF_DTE LEFT JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION ON CDD_DOC_GUID = CDO_DOC_GUID AND CDD_AUTHORED_DTE = CDO_AUTHORED_DTE AND CDO_VALUE_TEXT <> '' JOIN IDB.OMS_PROVIDER ON CDD_AUTH_PROV_GUID = OP_PVDR_GUID WHERE CDD_CANCEL_IND <> '1' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND <> '1' AND CDD_DOC_NAME LIKE '%Initial%Consult%Med%Onc%' ) , APPTS AS (SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN, CPE_ENC_DTE, 'Scheduled Appt' AS APPT_STATUS, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 , CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 , CLD_DEPT_NAME AS "Department Name", CRE_RES_NAME AS CADENCE_PROVIDER, CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME AS "Visit Type" FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID JOIN DX ON CC_MRN = CPE_MRN AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT DATE AND CURRENT DATE + 7 DAYS WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Sch') AND (CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR LIKE '%NV%' OR CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR LIKE '%IR%') AND CRE_RES_TYP IN ('Physician', 'PhD', 'Psychologist', 'Nurse Practitioner', 'Physician Assistant', 'Advanced Practice Nurse') AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 IN ('SRG', 'MED') AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 IN ('BRE', 'MEDONC') ) , COMB AS (SELECT CDD_MRN AS MRN, CDD_SERVICE_DTE AS SERVICE_DATE, PROVIDER, 'Completed' AS APPT_STATUS FROM CLIND WHERE RN =1 UNION SELECT CPE_MRN, CPE_ENC_DTE, CADENCE_PROVIDER, APPT_STATUS FROM APPTS) SELECT CC_MRN, MIN_ICD_EFF_DTE, ICD_CODES, SERVICE_DATE, APPT_STATUS, PROVIDER FROM DX JOIN COMB ON MRN = CC_MRN ;

prompt: Provide a list of patients treated with Alpelisib / BYL719 until 7/31/2019
completion: WITH PTS AS (SELECT APR_MRN, MIN(APR_START_DTE) MIN_APR_START_DTE, MAX(APR_END_DTE) MAX_APR_END_DTE FROM IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX JOIN IDB.CHEMO_DRUG_GENERIC ON APR_GENERIC_NAME = CDG_GENERIC_NAME WHERE CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME IN ('ALPELISIB') GROUP BY APR_MRN HAVING MIN(APR_START_DTE) <= '2019-07-31') , CDB_R AS (SELECT TM_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, PT_DATE_OF_DEATH, PT_SEX, R.AV_DESC AS RACE, E.AV_DESC AS ETHNICITY, MIN_APR_START_DTE, MAX_APR_END_DTE, TM_DX_DTE, TM_SITE_CD AS SITE_CODE, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_DESC, TM_HIST_CD AS HIST_CODE, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS HIST_DESC, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY TM_MRN ORDER BY TM_DX_DTE DESC) RN FROM PTS JOIN IDB.CDB_TUMOR ON APR_MRN = TM_MRN JOIN IDB.CLM H ON TM_HIST_CD = H.CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON TM_SITE_CD = S.CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON TM_MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS R ON PT_RACE = R.AV_CODE AND R.AV_ELEMENT = 'RACE' LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS E ON PT_PT_ETHNICITY = E.AV_CODE AND E.AV_ELEMENT = 'PT_ETHNICITY' WHERE TM_DX_DTE <= MIN_APR_START_DTE ) , IRB AS (SELECT APR_MRN, LISTAGG(TRIM(ACD_IRB_NO), '; ') "Protocols" FROM PTS JOIN IDB.ACCRUALS_DATES ON APR_MRN = ACD_MRN GROUP BY APR_MRN) , LABS_R AS (SELECT LR_MRN, LR_PERFORMED_DTE, LR_TEST_NAME, LR_SUBTEST_NAME, LR_RESULT_VALUE FROM PTS P JOIN IDB.LAB_RESULTS ON APR_MRN = LR_MRN WHERE LR_PERFORMED_DTE BETWEEN MIN_APR_START_DTE - 7 DAYS AND MIN_APR_START_DTE + 30 DAYS AND (LR_SUBTEST_NAME IN ('ALT', 'Creatinine', 'WBC', 'Abs Neut', 'Abs Eos', 'Neutrophil', 'Lymph', 'Mono', 'Eos', 'Baso', 'Abs Lymph', 'Abs Mono', 'Abs Baso', 'C-Peptide') OR LR_SUBTEST_NAME like 'Glucose%') UNION SELECT LR_MRN, LR_PERFORMED_DTE, LR_TEST_NAME, LR_SUBTEST_NAME, LR_RESULT_VALUE FROM PTS P JOIN IDB.LAB_RESULTS ON APR_MRN = LR_MRN WHERE LR_PERFORMED_DTE BETWEEN MIN_APR_START_DTE - 60 DAYS AND MIN_APR_START_DTE + 30 DAYS AND LR_TEST_NAME IN ('HbA1c', 'Hemoglobin A1c (HGB-A1c)', 'Hemoglobin A1c-') ) SELECT LR_MRN, LR_PERFORMED_DTE, MAX(CASE WHEN LR_SUBTEST_NAME = 'ALT' THEN LR_RESULT_VALUE END) "ALT", MAX(CASE WHEN LR_SUBTEST_NAME = 'Creatinine' THEN LR_RESULT_VALUE END) "Creatinine", MAX(CASE WHEN LR_SUBTEST_NAME = 'WBC' THEN LR_RESULT_VALUE END) "WBC", MAX(CASE WHEN LR_SUBTEST_NAME = 'Abs Neut' THEN LR_RESULT_VALUE END) "Abs Neut", MAX(CASE WHEN LR_SUBTEST_NAME = 'Abs Eos' THEN LR_RESULT_VALUE END) "Abs Eos", MAX(CASE WHEN LR_SUBTEST_NAME = 'Neutrophil' THEN LR_RESULT_VALUE END) "Neutrophil", MAX(CASE WHEN LR_SUBTEST_NAME = 'Lymph' THEN LR_RESULT_VALUE END) "Lymph", MAX(CASE WHEN LR_SUBTEST_NAME = 'Mono' THEN LR_RESULT_VALUE END) "Mono", MAX(CASE WHEN LR_SUBTEST_NAME = 'Eos' THEN LR_RESULT_VALUE END) "Eos", MAX(CASE WHEN LR_SUBTEST_NAME = 'Baso' THEN LR_RESULT_VALUE END) "Baso", MAX(CASE WHEN LR_SUBTEST_NAME = 'Abs Lymph' THEN LR_RESULT_VALUE END) "Abs Lymph", MAX(CASE WHEN LR_SUBTEST_NAME = 'Abs Mono' THEN LR_RESULT_VALUE END) "Abs Mono", MAX(CASE WHEN LR_SUBTEST_NAME = 'Abs Baso' THEN LR_RESULT_VALUE END) "Abs Baso", MAX(CASE WHEN LR_SUBTEST_NAME = 'C-Peptide' THEN LR_RESULT_VALUE END) "C-Peptide", MAX(CASE WHEN LR_SUBTEST_NAME like 'Glucose%' THEN LR_RESULT_VALUE END) "Glucose", MAX(CASE WHEN LR_TEST_NAME IN ('HbA1c', 'Hemoglobin A1c (HGB-A1c)', 'Hemoglobin A1c-') THEN LR_RESULT_VALUE END) "HbA1c" FROM LABS_R GROUP BY LR_MRN, LR_PERFORMED_DTE

prompt: Update MKT24987 scheduled report to include NJ work location flag
completion: WITH Q AS (SELECT EVI_EMPLOYEE_ID, CVP_NAME, VACCINE_STATUS, CEVE_CATEGORY, CVP_STATUS, CVP_SHORT_TERM_DIS_FLAG ON_LEAVE, CASE WHEN DOSE_ADDL_APPT_STATUS = 'PRE' THEN DATE(DOSE_ADDL_APPT_DT) ELSE NULL END AS ADDL_DOSE_APPT_DTE, FIRST_BOOSTER_ELIGIBLE_DTE, SUPV_NAME, MEDICAL_EXEMPT, REMOTE_EXEMPT, FIRST_BOOSTER_COMPLIANT, FIRST_BOOSTER_DUE_DATE FROM IDB.COVID19_EMPLOYEE_VACCINE_INFO LEFT JOIN IDB.COVID19_EMPLOYEE_VACCINE_EXEMPT_V ON EVI_EMPLOYEE_ID = EXEMPT_EMPLOYEE_ID JOIN IDB.COVID19_VACCINE_PERSON ON EVI_EMPLOYEE_ID = CVP_EMPLOYEE_ID LEFT JOIN (SELECT CVP_EMPLOYEE_ID SUPV_ID, CVP_NAME SUPV_NAME FROM IDB.COVID19_VACCINE_PERSON) ON CVP_SUPERVISOR_ID = SUPV_ID) SELECT EVI_EMPLOYEE_ID, CVP_NAME, VACCINE_STATUS, ADDL_DOSE_APPT_DTE, FIRST_BOOSTER_ELIGIBLE_DTE, FIRST_BOOSTER_DUE_DATE, SUPV_NAME, CASE WHEN ADDL_DOSE_APPT_DTE IS NOT NULL THEN 'Y' ELSE '' END AS SCHEDULED, FIRST_BOOSTER_COMPLIANT FROM Q WHERE CVP_STATUS = 'Active' AND CEVE_CATEGORY = 'Employees' AND COALESCE(ON_LEAVE, '') <> 'Y' AND COALESCE(MEDICAL_EXEMPT, '') <> 'Y' AND COALESCE(REMOTE_EXEMPT, '') <> 'Y'

prompt: Provide the  total visits in breast and lung cancer clinics last year 2021
completion: WITH PTS AS (SELECT CDD_MRN MRN, STRIP(PT_LAST_NAME)||', '||PT_FIRST_NAME PT_NAME, PT_SEX_DESC SEX, PT_RACE_DESC RACE, PT_PT_ETHNICITY_DESC ETHNICITY, PT_MARITAL_STS_DESC MARITAL_STS, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH DOB, YEAR(CDD_SERVICE_DTE) SERVICE_YR, MIN(YEAR(CDD_SERVICE_DTE) - YEAR(PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH)) CURRENT_AGE, MIN (CDD_SERVICE_DTE) FIRST_VISIT_DTE, MAX (CDD_SERVICE_DTE) LAST_VISIT_DTE, MAX(CASE WHEN CDO_ITEM_NAME = 'Preferred Language' THEN SUBSTR(CDO_VALUE_TEXT, 1, 50) END) PREFERRED_LANG, CASE WHEN MAX(CASE WHEN CDO_ITEM_NAME = 'Preferred Language' THEN SUBSTR(CDO_VALUE_TEXT, 1, 50) END) <> 'English' THEN 'Non-English' ELSE 'English' END LANG_IND FROM IDB.CD_DOCUMENT JOIN IDB.PATIENT_V ON CDD_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION ON CDD_DOC_GUID = CDO_DOC_GUID WHERE CDD_CANCEL_IND = '0' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND = '0' AND PT_DATE_OF_DEATH IS NULL AND (CDD_DOC_NAME LIKE '%Breast%' OR CDD_DOC_NAME LIKE'%Thoracic%') GROUP BY CDD_MRN, STRIP(PT_LAST_NAME)||', '||PT_FIRST_NAME , PT_SEX_DESC , PT_RACE_DESC , PT_PT_ETHNICITY_DESC , PT_MARITAL_STS_DESC , PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, YEAR(CDD_SERVICE_DTE) HAVING MIN(YEAR(CDD_SERVICE_DTE) - YEAR(PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH)) >= 18) , DX AS (SELECT CC_MRN, CC_CLSF_CD DX_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK DX_DESC , CC_EFF_DTE FIRST_DX_DTE , DOC_NAME, DOC_SVC, DOC_ACDMC_DPT , ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CC_MRN ORDER BY CC_EFF_DTE) RN FROM PTS JOIN IDB.CTC_CLSF ON MRN = CC_MRN JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.DOC ON CC_RESP_PARTY = DOC_DR_NO WHERE (CC_CLSF_CD LIKE 'C50.%' OR CC_CLSF_CD LIKE 'C34.%') AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND (CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR(CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) ) , FINAL AS (SELECT MRN, PT_NAME, SEX, RACE, ETHNICITY, MARITAL_STS, DOB, CURRENT_AGE, FIRST_VISIT_DTE, LAST_VISIT_DTE, SERVICE_YR, PREFERRED_LANG, LANG_IND, DX_CD, DX_DESC, FIRST_DX_DTE, DOC_NAME, DOC_SVC, DOC_ACDMC_DPT FROM PTS JOIN DX ON MRN = CC_MRN AND RN = 1) SELECT SERVICE_YR, COUNT(*) TOTAL_COUNT, SUM(CASE WHEN LANG_IND = 'Non-English' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) "Non English Count", SUM(CASE WHEN LANG_IND = 'English' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) "English Count", SUM(CASE WHEN LANG_IND = 'Non-English' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)*1.0000/COUNT(*)*100 "Non English Percent", SUM(CASE WHEN LANG_IND = 'English' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)*1.0000/COUNT(*)*100 "English Percent" FROM FINAL WHERE SERVICE_YR >= 2015 GROUP BY SERVICE_YR ;

prompt: We are piloting the use of a CIS Clin Doc note-  "Dose Assignment and Modification – Research" within TOS and EDD research services. The note has 2 sections - Dose assignment and modification. We want to add to the existing report the entered date/time, authored date/time, Signed date/time and include whether it was a dose modification or dose assignment (data mining: pull from document itself). Also include the service by identifying most common service of the MD signee/author.
completion: SELECT CDD_DOC_GUID , CDD_MRN , PT_LAST_NAME , PT_FIRST_NAME , CDD_SERVICE_DTE , OS_SVC_GRP_CD , OS_SVC_DESC , OL_LOC_NAME , CDD_DOC_NAME , CDD_AUTH_PROV_NAME , CDD_DOCUMENT_FULL_TEXT , CDD_CREATE_DT , CDD_ENTER_DT , CDD_SIGNED_DT , CDD_AUTHORED_DT , CDD_LAST_UPD_DT FROM DV.CLINDOC_FULL_TEXT_V JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON CDD_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.OMS_CLIENT_VISIT ON CDD_VISIT_GUID = OCV_VISIT_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_SERVICE ON OCV_SVC_GUID = OS_SVC_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_LOCATION ON OCV_CURR_LOC_GUID = OL_LOC_GUID WHERE 1 = 1 AND CDD_CANCEL_IND = '0' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND = '0' AND UPPER(CDD_DOC_NAME) LIKE '%DOSE%ASSIGN%' ORDER BY CDD_MRN, CDD_DOC_GUID, CDD_CREATE_DT

prompt: Total COVID Inpatient Days for the year 2021
completion: SELECT COUNT(*) TOTAL_INPATIENT_DAYS FROM IDB.COVID19_PATIENT_INFO COVID JOIN IDB.INPATIENT_ADMISSIONS_V IP ON COVID.MRN = IP.MRN AND (RESULT = 'Positive' OR (RESULT = 'Resolved' AND MIN_RESOLVED_PROBLEM_DT > IP.ADMIT_DT)) JOIN IDB.INPATIENT_DAYS_V IPDAYS ON IP.ADMIT_ID = IPDAYS.ADMIT_ID AND CALENDAR_DATE BETWEEN DATE(MIN_IDENTIFIED_DT) AND COALESCE(DATE(MIN_RESOLVED_PROBLEM_DT), '2999-01-01') - 1 DAY WHERE YEAR(CALENDAR_DATE) = 2021

completion: WITH PATHOLOGY_0 AS (SELECT "DV"."PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V"."PRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AS PT_DEID, "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_MRN" AS PT_MRN, "DV"."PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V"."PRPT_PATH_RPT_ID" AS SUBJECT_ID, CAST("DV"."PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V"."PRPT_REPORT" AS VARCHAR(32500)) AS PATH_RPT_TEXT FROM "DV"."PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V" JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS" ON "DV"."PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V"."PRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" WHERE SYSIBM.REGEXP_LIKE("DV"."PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V"."PRPT_REPORT", 'melanoma[\s\S]{1,3}soft[\s\S]{1,3}parts', 'i')), PATHOLOGY_1 AS (SELECT "DV"."PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V"."PRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AS PT_DEID, "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_MRN" AS PT_MRN, "DV"."PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V"."PRPT_PATH_RPT_ID" AS SUBJECT_ID, CAST("DV"."PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V"."PRPT_REPORT" AS VARCHAR(32500)) AS PATH_RPT_TEXT FROM "DV"."PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V" JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS" ON "DV"."PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V"."PRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" WHERE SYSIBM.REGEXP_LIKE("DV"."PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V"."PRPT_REPORT", 'clear[\s\S]{1,3}cell[\s\S]{1,3}sarcoma', 'i')), COHORT AS (SELECT PT_DEID AS PT_DEID FROM ( (SELECT PATHOLOGY_0.PT_DEID FROM PATHOLOGY_0 UNION SELECT PATHOLOGY_1.PT_DEID FROM PATHOLOGY_1))), COHORT_PATHOLOGY AS (SELECT SUBJECT_ID AS SUBJECT_ID, PT_DEID AS PT_DEID FROM ( (SELECT PATHOLOGY_0.SUBJECT_ID, PATHOLOGY_0.PT_DEID FROM PATHOLOGY_0 UNION SELECT PATHOLOGY_1.SUBJECT_ID, PATHOLOGY_1.PT_DEID FROM PATHOLOGY_1))), KEYS AS (SELECT COHORT.PT_DEID AS COHORT_PT_DEID, COHORT_PATHOLOGY.SUBJECT_ID AS COHORT_PATHOLOGY_SUBJECT_ID, COHORT_PATHOLOGY.PT_DEID AS COHORT_PATHOLOGY_PT_DEID FROM COHORT LEFT OUTER JOIN COHORT_PATHOLOGY ON COHORT_PATHOLOGY.PT_DEID = COHORT.PT_DEID), DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS AS (SELECT DISTINCT "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AS PT_DEID, IDB_PATIENT."PT_MRN" AS PT_MRN, "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AS SUBJECT_ID, DMP_ID_TBL."PDRX_DMP_PATIENT_ID" AS DMP_ID, TRIM(IDB_PATIENT."PT_LAST_NAME") || ', ' || TRIM(IDB_PATIENT."PT_FIRST_NAME") AS PT_NAME, ALLOWVALS_SEX."AV_DESC" AS SEX, CASE WHEN (IDB_PATIENT."PT_DATE_OF_DEATH" IS NULL) THEN 'Alive' ELSE 'Deceased' END AS VITAL_STATS, IDB_PATIENT."PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH" AS DATE_OF_BIRTH, IDB_PATIENT."PT_DATE_OF_DEATH" AS DATE_OF_DEATH FROM "IDB"."PATIENT" AS IDB_PATIENT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS" ON IDB_PATIENT."PT_MRN" = "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_MRN" LEFT OUTER JOIN "DV"."PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML" AS DMP_ID_TBL ON DMP_ID_TBL."PDRX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT OUTER JOIN "IDB"."ALLOWVALS" AS ALLOWVALS_SEX ON IDB_PATIENT."PT_SEX" = ALLOWVALS_SEX."AV_CODE" AND ALLOWVALS_SEX."AV_ELEMENT" = 'SEX') SELECT DISTINCT DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS.PT_MRN AS MRN, DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS.DMP_ID AS DMP_ID, DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS.PT_NAME AS PT_NAME, DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS.SEX AS SEX, DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS.VITAL_STATS AS VITAL_STATUS, DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS.DATE_OF_BIRTH AS DATE_OF_BIRTH, DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS.DATE_OF_DEATH AS DATE_OF_DEATH FROM KEYS LEFT OUTER JOIN DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS ON DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS.PT_DEID = KEYS.COHORT_PT_DEID; WITH PATHOLOGY_0 AS (SELECT "DV"."PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V"."PRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AS PT_DEID, "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_MRN" AS PT_MRN, "DV"."PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V"."PRPT_PATH_RPT_ID" AS SUBJECT_ID, CAST("DV"."PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V"."PRPT_REPORT" AS VARCHAR(32500)) AS PATH_RPT_TEXT FROM "DV"."PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V" JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS" ON "DV"."PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V"."PRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" WHERE SYSIBM.REGEXP_LIKE("DV"."PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V"."PRPT_REPORT", 'melanoma[\s\S]{1,3}soft[\s\S]{1,3}parts', 'i')), PATHOLOGY_1 AS (SELECT "DV"."PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V"."PRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AS PT_DEID, "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_MRN" AS PT_MRN, "DV"."PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V"."PRPT_PATH_RPT_ID" AS SUBJECT_ID, CAST("DV"."PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V"."PRPT_REPORT" AS VARCHAR(32500)) AS PATH_RPT_TEXT FROM "DV"."PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V" JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS" ON "DV"."PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V"."PRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" WHERE SYSIBM.REGEXP_LIKE("DV"."PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V"."PRPT_REPORT", 'clear[\s\S]{1,3}cell[\s\S]{1,3}sarcoma', 'i')), COHORT AS (SELECT PT_DEID AS PT_DEID FROM ( (SELECT PATHOLOGY_0.PT_DEID FROM PATHOLOGY_0 UNION SELECT PATHOLOGY_1.PT_DEID FROM PATHOLOGY_1))), COHORT_PATHOLOGY AS (SELECT SUBJECT_ID AS SUBJECT_ID, PT_DEID AS PT_DEID FROM ( (SELECT PATHOLOGY_0.SUBJECT_ID, PATHOLOGY_0.PT_DEID FROM PATHOLOGY_0 UNION SELECT PATHOLOGY_1.SUBJECT_ID, PATHOLOGY_1.PT_DEID FROM PATHOLOGY_1))), KEYS AS (SELECT COHORT.PT_DEID AS COHORT_PT_DEID, COHORT_PATHOLOGY.SUBJECT_ID AS COHORT_PATHOLOGY_SUBJECT_ID, COHORT_PATHOLOGY.PT_DEID AS COHORT_PATHOLOGY_PT_DEID FROM COHORT LEFT OUTER JOIN COHORT_PATHOLOGY ON COHORT_PATHOLOGY.PT_DEID = COHORT.PT_DEID), DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS AS (SELECT DISTINCT "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AS PT_DEID, IDB_PATIENT."PT_MRN" AS PT_MRN, "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AS SUBJECT_ID FROM "IDB"."PATIENT" AS IDB_PATIENT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS" ON IDB_PATIENT."PT_MRN" = "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_MRN"), PATHOLOGY_COLUMNS AS (SELECT DISTINCT "DV"."PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V"."PRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AS PT_DEID, "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_MRN" AS PT_MRN, "DV"."PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V"."PRPT_PATH_RPT_ID" AS SUBJECT_ID, "DV"."PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V"."PRPT_PATH_RPT_ID" AS REPORT_ID, "DV"."PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V"."PRPT_ACCESSION_NO" AS ACCESSION_NO, "DV"."PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V"."PRPT_REPORT_TYPE_DESC" AS PATH_RPT_TYPE, prompt: Schedule a monthly compliance report to determine if billed ultrasound procedures have supporting documentation in the EMR.
completion: WITH PBD AS (SELECT PBD_MRN, CLM_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK, PBC_PBD_DESC, PBD_SVC_DTE, PBI_PERFORM_DR_NO, MIN(LP.DOC_DR_NO) AS PROVIDER_NO, MIN(LP.DOC_NAME) AS PROVIDER_NAME FROM IDB.PBD_DTL JOIN IDB.PBD_CODE ON PBD_PBD_CD = PBC_PBD_CD JOIN IDB.PBD_INVOICE ON PBI_MRN = PBD_MRN AND PBI_INV_NO = PBD_INV_NO JOIN IDB.DOC D1 ON PBI_PERFORM_DR_NO = D1.DOC_DR_NO JOIN IDB.DOC LP ON LP.DOC_NPI = D1.DOC_NPI JOIN IDB.CLM ON PBC_CPT_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE PBD_SVC_DTE BETWEEN '2017-01-01' AND CURRENT DATE AND PBI_PERFORM_DR_NO IN ('011528', '021063', '016899', '816899', '021360', '016881', '022533', '025239', '027094') AND CLM_CLSF_CD IN ('20526', '20550', '20551', '20552', '20553', '20606', '20611', '76942', '64615', '64616', '76882', '20604', '20661') GROUP BY PBD_MRN, CLM_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK, PBC_PBD_DESC, PBD_SVC_DTE, PBI_PERFORM_DR_NO ) , EMR AS (SELECT DISTINCT EAD_MRN, EADT_DOCTYPE, EADT_EMR_DESC, EAD_DOCUMENT_DTE, EAD_DOCTOR_NUM, DOC_NAME FROM IDB.EMR_AA_DOCUMENT JOIN IDB.EMR_AA_DOCTYPE ON EADT_DOCTYPE = EAD_DOCTYPE JOIN IDB.DOC ON EAD_DOCTOR_NUM = DOC_DR_NO WHERE EAD_DOCUMENT_DTE BETWEEN '2017-01-01' AND CURRENT DATE AND EADT_DOCTYPE IN ('PT1') ) , FINAL AS (SELECT DISTINCT PBD_MRN AS MRN, STRIP(CLM_CLSF_CD) AS "CPT Code", STRIP(CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK) AS "CPT Desc", STRIP(PBC_PBD_DESC) AS "PBD Desc", PBD_SVC_DTE AS "Service Date", STRIP(PBI_PERFORM_DR_NO) AS "Performing Dr No", STRIP(PBD.PROVIDER_NAME) AS "Performing Dr Name", STRIP(EADT_DOCTYPE) AS "Doc Type", STRIP(EADT_EMR_DESC) AS "EMR Desc", EAD_DOCUMENT_DTE AS "Doc Date", STRIP(EAD_DOCTOR_NUM) AS "Dr No", STRIP(EMR.DOC_NAME) AS "Dr Name", CASE WHEN EADT_DOCTYPE IS NULL AND PBD_SVC_DTE < CURRENT date + 1 DAYS - DAY(CURRENT date) DAYS - 1 MONTH THEN 1 WHEN EADT_DOCTYPE IS NULL AND PBD_SVC_DTE >= CURRENT date + 1 DAYS - DAY(CURRENT date) DAYS - 1 MONTH THEN 2 WHEN EADT_DOCTYPE IS NOT NULL THEN 3 END AS "Flag" FROM PBD LEFT JOIN EMR ON PBD_MRN = EAD_MRN AND PBD_SVC_DTE = EAD_DOCUMENT_DTE) SELECT * FROM FINAL WHERE "Flag" = 3 OR("Flag" IN (1, 2) AND "Service Date" >= CURRENT DATE - 6 MONTHS)

prompt: Provide weekly list of inpatient admissions on Myeloma service studies
completion: WITH PR AS (SELECT DISTINCT PRO_IRB_NO, PRO_IRB_TITLE, PRO_IRB_STS, PRO_PROTOCOL_TYPE, AC_MRN, AC_NON_MSK_INST, AC_LAST_NAME, AC_FIRST_NAME, AC_PVDR_OF_RECORD_NAME, ACD_REG_DTE, ACD_TX_ST_DTE, ACD_TX_END_DTE, ACD_OFF_STUDY_DTE, ACD_CONS_DTE FROM IDB.PROTOCOL JOIN IDB.ACCRUALS ON PRO_IRB_NO = AC_IRB_NO JOIN IDB.ACCRUALS_DATES ON AC_IRB_NO = ACD_IRB_NO AND AC_SUBJ_ID_NO = ACD_SUBJ_ID_NO AND AC_SUBJ_SEQ_NO = ACD_SUBJ_SEQ_NO WHERE 1=1 AND ACD_OFF_STUDY_DTE IS NULL ) SELECT DISTINCT VIS_MRN AS MRN, PT_LAST_NAME AS LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME AS FIRST_NAME, MGMT_GROUP_DESCRIPTION AS CTMS_MANAGEMENT_GROUP, PRIMARY AS PRIMARY_MGMT_GROUP, PRO_IRB_NO AS PROTOCOL, ACD_CONS_DTE AS CONSENT_DATE, ACD_TX_ST_DTE AS ON_TREATMENT_DATE, ACD_TX_END_DTE AS OFF_TREATMENT_DATE, VIS_ADM_DTE AS ADMISSION_DATE, NURS_STA_DESC AS NURSING_STAFF FROM IDB.VISIT_V JOIN PR ON AC_MRN = VIS_MRN JOIN NN.SV_PCL_MGMT_MGMTGROUP ON PROTOCOL_NO = PRO_IRB_NO JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PT_MRN = VIS_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS R ON R.AV_ELEMENT = 'RACE' AND R.AV_CODE = PT_RACE LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS E ON E.AV_ELEMENT = 'PT_ETHNICITY' AND E.AV_CODE = PT_PT_ETHNICITY WHERE VIS_IP_OP_ADJUSTED_IND = 'I' AND VIS_VISIT_STATUS IN ('2', '3') AND VIS_ADM_DTE >= CURRENT DATE - 7 DAYS AND LOWER(HOSP_SVC_DESC) LIKE '%myeloma%'

prompt: Provide a list of alive pituitary patients
completion: WITH BASE AS (SELECT CC_MRN FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE CC_CLSF_CD IN ('D35.2', 'E22.0', 'E23.0', 'E23.3', 'E24.0', 'E24.9' , '227.3', '253.0', '253.2', '253.3', '628.1', '253.9', '255.0') AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND (CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) GROUP BY CC_MRN ) SELECT CPP_MRN MRN, CPP_PT_NAME PT_NAME, CPP_EMAIL_ADDR EMAIL FROM BASE JOIN IDB.CL_PAS_PATIENT ON CC_MRN = CPP_MRN JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY ON CPP_MRN = PLA_MRN WHERE CPP_EMAIL_ADDR <> '' AND CPP_DEATH_DTE IS NULL AND PLA_DONOT_MAIL_IND <> 'Y'

prompt: Provide lab, medicine, admission, and flowsheet information for patients who were COVID-19 positive.
completion: WITH PTS AS (SELECT DISTINCT PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID AS PID , PT_MRN AS MRN , DATE(MIN_IDENTIFIED_DT) AS COVID_DTE FROM IDB.PATIENT_COVID_INFO_V JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON PT_MRN = MRN WHERE 1=1 AND RESULT IN ('Positive', 'Resolved') AND MRN > '' ) SELECT DISTINCT "t1"."PT_MRN" AS "MRN", "t2"."LTC_SUBTEST_NAME" AS "Lab-Test Name", "t3"."LTC_SUBTEST_NAME" AS "Lab-Subtest Name", "t4"."DT_DTE" AS LAB_DTE, "t5"."PLR_RESULT_VALUE" AS LAB_VALUE , COVID_DTE FROM PTS JOIN DV.PATIENT_IDENTIFICATION_MRN_V ON PI_SOURCE_SYSTEM_PT_ID = MRN JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V" "t1" ON "t1"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = PI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED" "t6" ON "t1"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t6"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_LAB_RESULT" "t5" ON "t6"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t5"."PLR_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."LAB_TEST_CATALOG_V" "t2" ON "t5"."PLR_LAB_TEST_CATALOG_ID" = "t2"."LTC_LAB_TEST_CATALOG_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."LAB_TEST_CATALOG_V" "t3" ON "t5"."PLR_LAB_SUBTEST_CATALOG_ID" = "t3"."LTC_LAB_TEST_CATALOG_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" "t4" ON "t5"."PLR_PERFORMED_DATE_ID" = "t4"."DT_DATE_ID" WHERE 1=1 AND "t4"."DT_DTE" >= '2020-01-01' AND (1=2 OR UPPER("t3"."LTC_SUBTEST_NAME") like '%ABS%LYMPH%' OR UPPER("t3"."LTC_SUBTEST_NAME") like '%ABS%NEUT%') AND "t5"."PLR_RESULT_VALUE" IS NOT NULL AND "t5"."PLR_RESULT_VALUE" <> '' ORDER BY "t1"."PT_MRN", "t4"."DT_DTE", "t5"."PLR_RESULT_VALUE" ; WITH PTS AS (SELECT DISTINCT MRN , PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID AS PID , DATE(MIN_IDENTIFIED_DT) AS COVID_DTE , POSITIVE_SOURCES , CASE WHEN POSITIVE_SOURCES like '%order_and_result%' THEN 'MSK' WHEN POSITIVE_SOURCES like '%hie%' THEN 'Non-MSK' END AS "Test Source" , RESULT , PT_DEATH_DTE FROM IDB.PATIENT_COVID_INFO_V JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON PT_MRN = MRN WHERE 1=1 AND RESULT IN ('Positive', 'Resolved') AND MRN > '' ) SELECT DISTINCT "t1"."PT_MRN" AS "MRN", "t2"."PINC_GENERIC_NAME" AS "Generic Drug Name", "t3"."DT_DTE" AS "Dispense Date", "t4"."PDO_DSPNS_DT" AS "Dispense DateTime", "t4"."PDO_DOSE" AS "Dosage", "t4"."PDO_DOSE_UNIT" AS "Dose Unit", "t4"."PDO_INV_QTY" AS "Dispensed Quantity" FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V" "t1" JOIN PTS ON PID = "t1"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED" "t5" ON "t1"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t5"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PHM_PT_MEDS_MQT" "t6" ON "t5"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t6"."POD_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PHM_ORDER_DTL" "t7" ON "t6"."POD_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t7"."POD_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AND "t6"."POD_PHARMA_INVENTORY_CTLG_ID" = "t7"."POD_PHARMA_INVENTORY_CTLG_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PHM_INVENTORY_CATALOG" "t2" ON "t7"."POD_PHARMA_INVENTORY_CTLG_ID" = "t2"."PINC_INVENTORY_CTLG_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PHM_ORDER_DISPENSE_OCCR" "t4" ON "t7"."POD_PHARMA_ORDER_DETAIL_ID" = "t4"."PDO_PHARMA_ORDER_DETAIL_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" "t3" ON "t4"."PDO_DISPNS_DATE_ID" = "t3"."DT_DATE_ID" WHERE 1=1 AND "t3"."DT_DTE" >= '2020-03-01' AND INTRAMUSCULAR', 'IMMUNE GLOBULIN INTRAVENOUS', 'IMMUNE GLOBULIN RHO (D)', 'IMMUNE GLOBULIN SUBCUTANEOUS', 'IMMUNE GLOBULIN', 'IMMUNE GLOBULIN (FLEBOGAMMA)', 'IMMUNE GLOBULIN (FLEBOGAMMA DIF)', 'IMMUNE
