GLOBULIN (POLYGAM S/D)', 'IMMUNE GLOBULIN IM', 'IMMUNE GLOBULIN', 'IMMUNE GLOBULIN,GAMMA', 'TOCILIZUMAB', 'TOCILIZUMAB INVEST', 'TOCILIZUMAB', 'FK463 VS. FLUCONAZOLE', 'VORICONAZOLE/FLUCONAZOLE/PLACEBO AM DOSE', 'VORICONAZOLE/FLUCONAZOLE/PLACEBO AM DOSE A', 'VORICONAZOLE/FLUCONAZOLE/PLACEBO AM DOSE B', 'VORICONAZOLE/FLUCONAZOLE/PLACEBO PM DOSE', 'VORICONAZOLE INVEST', 'VORICONAZOLE/FLUCONAZOLE/PLACEBO AM DOSE', 'VORICONAZOLE/FLUCONAZOLE/PLACEBO AM DOSE A', 'VORICONAZOLE/FLUCONAZOLE/PLACEBO AM DOSE B', 'VORICONAZOLE/FLUCONAZOLE/PLACEBO PM DOSE', 'POSACONAZOLE (SCH56592)') ORDER BY 1, 2, 7 ; WITH DT AS (SELECT DISTINCT MRN , PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID , DATE(MIN_IDENTIFIED_DT) AS COVID_DTE FROM IDB.PATIENT_COVID_INFO_V JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON PT_MRN = MRN WHERE 1=1 AND RESULT IN ('Positive', 'Resolved') AND MRN > '' ) , ADMISSIONS AS (SELECT VIS_MRN, COVID_DTE, VIS_ADM_DTE, VIS_DSCH_DTE, ADM_TYPE_DESC, HOSP_SVC_DESC, VIS_PATIENT_TYPE, TREATMENT_PLAN_DESC, VIS_DAYS_STAY FROM IDB.VISIT_V JOIN DT ON MRN = VIS_MRN WHERE 1=1 AND VIS_ADM_DTE >= '2020-01-01' AND VIS_IP_OP_ADJUSTED_IND = 'I' AND VIS_VISIT_STATUS IN ('2', '3') ) SELECT * FROM ADMISSIONS ORDER BY VIS_MRN, VIS_ADM_DTE ; WITH DT AS (SELECT DISTINCT MRN , PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID , DATE(MIN_IDENTIFIED_DT) AS COVID_DTE FROM IDB.PATIENT_COVID_INFO_V JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON PT_MRN = MRN WHERE 1=1 AND RESULT IN ('Positive', 'Resolved') AND MRN > '' ) SELECT CRRT_MRN, CRRT_DOCUMENT_NAME, CRRT_ENTERED_DT, CRRT_SECTION, CRRT_MODE, CRRT_DEVICE_STATUS, CRRT_CIRCUIT_CHANGE, CRRT_ET_CO2, CRRT_PULSE_OXMTR_DEVICE_STATUS, CRRT_TRANSCUTANEOUS_PC02, CRRT_CURRENT_BED, CRRT_CURRENT_NURS_STA, CRRT_ADMIT_DT, CRRT_DISCHARGE_DT, CRRT_ABNORMALITY_CODE, CRRT_LITER_FLOW, CRRT_FIO2 FROM IDB.COVID19_RT_RESPIRATORY_THERAPY_FLOWSHEET_V2 JOIN DT ON MRN = CRRT_MRN ORDER BY CRRT_MRN, CRRT_ENTERED_DT ;

prompt: Provide a list of patients with lung cancer who have/had an appt between 1/1/2017 - 5/31/21.
completion: WITH LUNG AS (SELECT DISTINCT TM_MRN, SM.AV_DESC SMOKING_HX, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY TM_MRN ORDER BY TM_DX_DTE DESC) RN FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.SEERGROUPING ON IDB.SEERF_ICDO(TM_SITE_CD, TM_HIST_CD) = RECODE LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS SM ON SM.AV_ELEMENT = 'SMOKING_HX' AND SM.AV_CODE = TM_SMOKING_HX WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND CATEGORY2 = 'Lung and Bronchus' ) , PTS AS (SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN AS "MRN", SMOKING_HX, PT_LAST_NAME LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME FIRST_NAME, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH DOB, CPP_EMAIL_ADDR EMAIL, CAV_NAME LANGUAGE, PLA_LST_APPT_DTE, CPE_ENC_DTE, CPE_CPE_APPT_STS FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN LUNG ON TM_MRN = CPE_MRN AND RN = 1 JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON CPE_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY ON CPE_MRN = PLA_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_PAS_PATIENT ON CPE_MRN = CPP_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_CATEGORY ON CAV_CATEGORY = 'LANG' AND CPP_LANG = CAV_ABBR WHERE 1=1 AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN '2015-01-01' AND '2021-05-31' AND PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH >= '1920-05-01' AND CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp', 'Sch') AND PT_DEATH_IND IN ('', 'A') AND PLA_DONOT_MAIL_IND <> 'Y' AND CPP_EMAIL_ADDR <> '' ) , NEXT_A AS (SELECT "MRN", CPE_ENC_DTE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY "MRN" ORDER BY CPE_ENC_DTE) RN FROM PTS WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS = 'Sch' ) , FINAL AS (SELECT DISTINCT P."MRN", LAST_NAME, FIRST_NAME, EMAIL, LANGUAGE, SMOKING_HX, PLA_LST_APPT_DTE LAST_APPT_DATE, N.CPE_ENC_DTE NEXT_APPT_DATE FROM PTS P LEFT JOIN NEXT_A N ON P."MRN" = N."MRN" AND RN = 1) SELECT * FROM FINAL

prompt: Provide a weekly list of Head and Neck cancer and localized Non-small Cell Lung cancer (stages I and IIA) patients.
completion: WITH TM AS (SELECT TM_MRN , TRIM(PT_LAST_NAME) || ', ' || TRIM(PT_FIRST_NAME) PT_NAME , YEAR(TM_DX_DTE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) AGE_AT_DX , PT_DATE_OF_DEATH , PT_SEX , PT_PHONE , PT_EMAIL_ADDRESS , PT_ADDR1 , PT_ADDR2 , PT_CITY , PT_STATE , PT_ZIP_CD , TM_DX_DTE , H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS HISTOLOGY , S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_DESC , TM_BEST_AJCC_STG STAGE FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON TM_MRN = PT_MRN AND YEAR(TM_DX_DTE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) >= 18 WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND TM_SITE_CD BETWEEN 'C000' AND 'C148' AND (LEFT(TM_BEST_AJCC_STG, 1) IN ('1', '2', '3') OR TRIM(TM_BEST_AJCC_STG) = '4' OR TM_BEST_AJCC_STG LIKE '4A%') AND RIGHT(TRIM(TM_HIST_CD), 1) = '3' AND TM_FIRST_RECUR_DTE IS NULL AND TM_FIRST_RECUR_TYP = '00' AND PT_PRIMARY_LANG = 'ENG' ) , PTS AS (SELECT TM_MRN MRN, COUNT(*) CNT FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT TM_MRN MRN FROM TM) ON TM_MRN = MRN WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') GROUP BY TM_MRN HAVING COUNT(*) = 1) , APR AS (SELECT APR_MRN , MAX(APR_START_DTE) LAST_CHEMO_DTE FROM IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX_V JOIN PTS ON MRN = APR_MRN WHERE CDG_CHEMO_FLAG = 'Y' GROUP BY APR_MRN HAVING MAX(APR_START_DTE) BETWEEN CURRENT DATE - 3 YEAR AND CURRENT DATE - 6 MONTH) , RT AS (SELECT RTC_TX_MRN , MAX(RTC_TX_STOP_DTE) LAST_RT_DTE FROM IDB.RADONC_TREATMENT_COURSE JOIN PTS ON MRN = RTC_TX_MRN GROUP BY RTC_TX_MRN HAVING MAX(RTC_TX_STOP_DTE) BETWEEN CURRENT DATE - 3 YEAR AND CURRENT DATE - 6 MONTH) , PAIN AS (SELECT EF_MRN , EF_SUBMISSION_DT , EFI_VALUE FROM IDB.EF_FORM JOIN PTS ON EF_MRN = MRN JOIN IDB.EF_FORM_ITEM ON EF_FORM_ID = EFI_FORM_ID AND EFI_ITEM_ALIAS = 'painaverage' WHERE EF_FORM_ALIAS = 'faceheadneckcancer' ) SELECT MRN , PT_NAME , AGE_AT_DX , PT_DATE_OF_DEATH DATE_OF_DEATH , PT_SEX SEX , PT_PHONE PHONE , PT_EMAIL_ADDRESS EMAIL , PT_ADDR1 ADDR1 , PT_ADDR2 ADDR2 , PT_CITY CITY , PT_STATE STATE , PT_ZIP_CD ZIPCODE , LAST_CHEMO_DTE , LAST_RT_DTE , 'HEAD AND NECK CANCER' AS CANCER , TM_DX_DTE CANCER_DX_DTE , STAGE , HISTOLOGY , SITE_DESC , EFI_VALUE AS PAIN_SCORE , DATE(EF_SUBMISSION_DT) PAIN_SCORE_DTE FROM PTS JOIN TM ON MRN = TM_MRN LEFT JOIN APR ON MRN = APR_MRN LEFT JOIN RT ON MRN = RTC_TX_MRN LEFT JOIN PAIN ON MRN = EF_MRN WHERE COALESCE(APR_MRN, RTC_TX_MRN) IS NOT NULL ; WITH TM AS (SELECT TM_MRN , TRIM(PT_LAST_NAME) || ', ' || TRIM(PT_FIRST_NAME) PT_NAME , YEAR(TM_DX_DTE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) AGE_AT_DX , PT_DATE_OF_DEATH , PT_SEX , PT_PHONE , PT_EMAIL_ADDRESS , PT_ADDR1 , PT_ADDR2 , PT_CITY , PT_STATE , PT_ZIP_CD , TM_DX_DTE , H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS HISTOLOGY , S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_DESC , TM_BEST_AJCC_STG STAGE FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON TM_MRN = PT_MRN AND YEAR(TM_DX_DTE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) >= 18 WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND TM_SITE_CD LIKE 'C34%' AND (LEFT(TM_BEST_AJCC_STG, 1) = '1' OR TM_BEST_AJCC_STG = '2' OR TM_BEST_AJCC_STG LIKE '2A%') AND TM_HIST_CD IN ('M8013/3', 'M8022/3', 'M8046/3', 'M8052/2', 'M8052/3', 'M8070/3', 'M8071/3', 'M8072/3', 'M8073/3', 'M8074/2', 'M8074/3', 'M8140/3', 'M8250/2', 'M8250/3', 'M8251/3', 'M8252/3', 'M8253/3', 'M8254/3', 'M8255/3', 'M8260/3', 'M8310/3', 'M8480/3', 'M8481/3', 'M8560/2', 'M8560/3', 'M8572/3', 'M8574/3') AND TM_FIRST_RECUR_DTE IS NULL AND TM_FIRST_RECUR_TYP = '00' AND PT_PRIMARY_LANG = 'ENG' ) , METS AS (SELECT CC_MRN, COUNT(*) MET_CNT FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT TM_MRN MRN FROM TM) ON CC_MRN = MRN WHERE (SUBSTR(CC_CLSF_CD, 1, 3) BETWEEN 'C77' AND 'C79' OR SUBSTR(CC_CLSF_CD, 1, 3) BETWEEN '196' AND '198') AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND (CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) GROUP BY CC_MRN ) , PTS AS (SELECT TM_MRN MRN, COUNT(*) CNT FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT TM_MRN MRN FROM TM) ON TM_MRN = MRN WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND TM_MRN NOT IN (SELECT CC_MRN FROM METS) GROUP BY TM_MRN HAVING COUNT(*) = 1) , APR AS (SELECT APR_MRN , MAX(APR_START_DTE) LAST_CHEMO_DTE FROM IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX_V JOIN PTS ON MRN = APR_MRN WHERE CDG_CHEMO_FLAG = 'Y' GROUP BY APR_MRN HAVING MAX(APR_START_DTE) BETWEEN CURRENT DATE - 3 YEAR AND CURRENT DATE - 6 MONTH) , RT AS (SELECT RTC_TX_MRN , MAX(RTC_TX_STOP_DTE) LAST_RT_DTE FROM IDB.RADONC_TREATMENT_COURSE JOIN PTS ON MRN = RTC_TX_MRN GROUP BY RTC_TX_MRN HAVING MAX(RTC_TX_STOP_DTE) BETWEEN CURRENT DATE - 3 YEAR AND CURRENT DATE - 6 MONTH) SELECT MRN , PT_NAME , AGE_AT_DX , PT_DATE_OF_DEATH DATE_OF_DEATH , PT_SEX SEX , PT_PHONE PHONE , PT_EMAIL_ADDRESS EMAIL , PT_ADDR1 ADDR1 , PT_ADDR2 ADDR2 , PT_CITY CITY , PT_STATE STATE , PT_ZIP_CD ZIPCODE , LAST_CHEMO_DTE , LAST_RT_DTE , 'NSCLC' AS CANCER , TM_DX_DTE CANCER_DX_DTE , STAGE , HISTOLOGY , SITE_DESC FROM PTS JOIN TM ON MRN = TM_MRN LEFT JOIN APR ON MRN = APR_MRN LEFT JOIN RT ON MRN = RTC_TX_MRN WHERE COALESCE(APR_MRN, RTC_TX_MRN) IS NOT NULL

prompt: List of breast surgical cases to screen for eligible patients for protocols 06-163 and 13-040/
completion: WITH SURG AS (SELECT OC_CASE_ID, OC_MRN, OC_SURG_DTE, CRE_RES_NAME, OP_PROC_NAME, CASE WHEN OCAP_LAT = 'B' THEN 'Bilateral' WHEN OCAP_LAT = 'L' THEN 'Left' WHEN OCAP_LAT = 'R' THEN 'Right' ELSE OCAP_LAT END AS LATERALITY FROM IDB.OR_CASE JOIN IDB.OR_CASE_ALL_PROC ON OC_CASE_ID = OCAP_CASE_ID JOIN IDB.OR_CASE_ALL_SURG ON OCAP_CASE_ID = OCAS_CASE_ID AND OCAS_PNL_NO = OCAP_PNL_NO AND OCAS_SURG_ROLE = 'Primary' JOIN IDB.OR_PROC ON OCAP_OR_PROC_ID = OP_OR_PROC_ID JOIN IDB.OR_CL_PROC ON OP_OR_PROC_ID = OCP_OR_PROC_ID JOIN IDB.CL_PROC ON OCP_PROC_ID = CPX_PROC_ID AND CPX_PROC_CD BETWEEN '19303' AND '19305' JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CRE_RES_ID = OCAS_RES_ID WHERE OC_SURG_DTE >= CURRENT date AND OC_OR_CASE_STS_CD NOT IN ('2', '5') ) , RECEPTORS AS (SELECT CDD_MRN, MAX(CASE WHEN CDO_ITEM_NAME = 'ER:' THEN SUBSTR(CDO_VALUE_TEXT, 1, 3) END) AS ER, MAX(CASE WHEN CDO_ITEM_NAME = 'PR:' THEN SUBSTR(CDO_VALUE_TEXT, 1, 3) END) AS PR, MAX(CASE WHEN CDO_ITEM_NAME = 'HER2:' THEN SUBSTR(CDO_VALUE_TEXT, 1, 3) END) AS HER2 FROM IDB.CD_DOCUMENT JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION ON CDD_DOC_GUID = CDO_DOC_GUID AND CDD_AUTHORED_DTE = CDO_AUTHORED_DTE WHERE 1=1 AND CDD_CANCEL_IND <> '1' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND <> '1' AND CDD_DOC_NAME = 'Follow Up - Breast Surgery' AND CDO_ITEM_NAME IN ('HER2:', 'ER:', 'PR:') GROUP BY CDD_MRN ) , CLINTRAC AS (SELECT CC_MRN, LISTAGG(TRIM(DX), CHR(13)||CHR(10)) DX FROM (SELECT DISTINCT CC_MRN, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS DX FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE ((CC_CLSF_CD BETWEEN 'C50.00' AND 'C50.919') OR (SUBSTR(CC_CLSF_CD, 1, 3) IN ('D05', 'D24'))) AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND (CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) ) GROUP BY CC_MRN) , BR AS (SELECT BP_MRN, BP_TUMOR_SIZE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY BP_MRN ORDER BY BP_CREATE_DT DESC) AS RANK FROM IDB.BR_PRIMARY WHERE BP_TUMOR_SIZE > 0 ) SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN AS MRN, PT_LAST_NAME "Patient Last Name", PT_FIRST_NAME "Patient First Name", PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH AS DOB, PT_SEX "Patient Sex", R.AV_DESC "Race", E.AV_DESC "Ethnicity", DX "Diagnosis", BP_TUMOR_SIZE AS "Tumor Size", ER, PR, HER2, OC_SURG_DTE "Surgery Date", CRE_RES_NAME "Surgeon Name", OP_PROC_NAME "Procedure", LATERALITY "Procedure Laterality", CASE WHEN APR_MRN IS NOT NULL THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END "Chemo Prior to Surg?" FROM IDB.PATIENT JOIN SURG ON PT_MRN = OC_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX ON PT_MRN = APR_MRN AND APR_START_DTE < OC_SURG_DTE AND APR_CHEMO_FLAG = 'Y' LEFT JOIN RECEPTORS ON PT_MRN = CDD_MRN LEFT JOIN BR ON PT_MRN = BP_MRN AND RANK = 1 LEFT JOIN CLINTRAC ON PT_MRN = CC_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS R ON R.AV_ELEMENT = 'RACE' AND R.AV_CODE = PT_RACE LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS E ON E.AV_ELEMENT = 'PT_ETHNICITY' AND E.AV_CODE = PT_PT_ETHNICITY

prompt: Total number of patients offered and total number of patient who received flu vaccine and pneumococcal vaccine for 2020-21 respiratory viral season, October 1 - present
completion: SELECT OO_MRN , PT_FIRST_NAME , PT_LAST_NAME , PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH , OO_ORD_GUID , OO_ENTER_DTE , OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE , OO_ORD_NAME , OSTS_STS_DESC ORDER_STATUS , OUD_USER_DI_VALUE FROM IDB.OMS_ORDER JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON OO_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_CATALOG ON OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID = OOC_MSTR_ITEM_GUID AND OOC_MSTR_ITEM_GUID IN ('1000001211073001', '1000003817073029', '9000005880100730', '9000008558100730', '9000008558200730', '9000008558300730', '1000004735073029') JOIN IDB.OMS_STATUS ON OO_ORD_STS_CD = OSTS_ORD_STS_CD LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_USER_ORDERS ON OUO_ORD_GUID = OO_ORD_GUID LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_USER_DATA ON OUD_ORD_GUID = OO_ORD_GUID WHERE 1 = 1 AND OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE >= '2020-10-01' ORDER BY OO_MRN, OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE; SELECT OO_MRN , PT_FIRST_NAME , PT_LAST_NAME , PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH , OO_ORD_GUID , OO_ENTER_DTE , OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE , OO_ORD_NAME , OO_ORD_STS_CD , OSTS_STS_DESC ORDER_STATUS , OUD_USER_DI_CD , OUD_USER_DI_VALUE FROM IDB.OMS_ORDER JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON OO_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_CATALOG ON OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID = OOC_MSTR_ITEM_GUID AND OOC_MSTR_ITEM_GUID IN ('6000003188073001', '9000001171073001', '9000006177100730', '9000006198400740', '9000006283200730', '9000006283300730', '1000004735073029') JOIN IDB.OMS_STATUS ON OO_ORD_STS_CD = OSTS_ORD_STS_CD LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_USER_ORDERS ON OUO_ORD_GUID = OO_ORD_GUID LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_USER_DATA ON OUD_ORD_GUID = OO_ORD_GUID WHERE 1 = 1 AND OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE >= '2020-10-01' ORDER BY OO_MRN, OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE;

prompt: Provide a list of PET/CT and PET/MRI scans performed on Pediatric patients from 1/1/22 to 9/30/23
completion: SELECT DISTINCT "t1"."PT_MRN" AS "MRN", PT_BIRTH_DTE AS DOB, YEAR("t2"."RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE" - PT_BIRTH_DTE) AS AGE, RRPT_REQUESTER, "t2"."RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE" AS "Radiology Performed Date", "t2"."RRPT_ORDER_GROUP" AS "Radiology Order Group", "t2"."RRPT_PROCEDURE_NAME" AS "Radiology Procedure Name" FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V" "t1" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED" "t3" ON "t1"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t3"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."RADIOLOGY_REPORT_V" "t2" ON "t3"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t2"."RRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_IDENTIFICATION_MRN_V" "t4" ON "t1"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t4"."PI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" WHERE 1=1 AND YEAR("t2"."RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE" - PT_BIRTH_DTE) <= 9 AND "t2"."RRPT_ORDER_GROUP" IN ('PET CT for Cancer', 'PET MR') AND "t2"."RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE" BETWEEN'2022-01-01' AND '2023-09-30'

prompt: Provide a list of patients diagnosed osteosarcoma and received treatment with cisplatin and doxorubicin at MSK from 2010-2020.
completion: WITH CIS AS (SELECT APR_MRN, CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME, APR_START_DTE, APR_END_DTE FROM IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX_V WHERE CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME IN ('CISPLATIN') AND APR_START_DTE BETWEEN '2010-01-01' AND '2019-06-15' ) , DOX AS (SELECT APR_MRN, CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME, APR_START_DTE, APR_END_DTE FROM IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX_V WHERE CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME IN ('DOXORUBICIN') AND APR_START_DTE BETWEEN '2010-01-01' AND '2019-06-15' ) , METHOTREXATE AS (SELECT APR_MRN, CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME, APR_START_DTE, APR_END_DTE FROM IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX_V WHERE CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME IN ('METHOTREXATE') AND APR_START_DTE BETWEEN '2010-01-01' AND '2019-06-15' ) , PTS AS (SELECT CIS.APR_MRN, CIS.CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME CISPLATIN_DRUG_NAME, CIS.APR_START_DTE CISPLATIN_START_DATE, CIS.APR_END_DTE CISPLATIN_END_DATE, DOX.CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME DOXORUBICIN_DRUG_NAME, DOX.APR_START_DTE DOXORUBICIN_START_DATE, DOX.APR_END_DTE DOXORUBICIN_END_DATE FROM CIS CIS JOIN DOX DOX ON CIS.APR_MRN = DOX.APR_MRN WHERE CIS.APR_START_DTE = DOX.APR_START_DTE ) , APPTS AS (SELECT CPE_MRN AS "MRN", PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, CASE WHEN PT_DEATH_IND IN ('X', 'C', 'D') THEN 'Deceased' ELSE 'Alive' END VITAL_STATUS, PT_DATE_OF_DEATH, CPE_ENC_DTE AS "Appt Date", CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 AS "Department", CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 AS "Service", CLD_DEPT_NAME AS "Department Name", CRE_RES_NAME AS "Provider Name", CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR AS "Visit Type Abbr", CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME AS "Visit Type" FROM (SELECT DISTINCT APR_MRN FROM PTS) JOIN IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER ON APR_MRN = CPE_MRN JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON CPE_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CRE_RES_TYP = 'Physician' AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 = 'SAR' AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN '2010-01-01' AND '2019-06-15' ) SELECT "MRN", PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, VITAL_STATUS, PT_DATE_OF_DEATH, "Appt Date", "Department", "Service", "Department Name", "Provider Name", "Visit Type Abbr", "Visit Type", LISTAGG(CHAR(CIS.APR_START_DTE) || ' to ' || CHAR(CIS.APR_END_DTE), CHR(13)||CHR(10)) CISPLATIN_DATES, LISTAGG(CHAR(DOX.APR_START_DTE) || ' to ' || CHAR(DOX.APR_END_DTE), CHR(13)||CHR(10)) DOXORUBICIN_DATES, LISTAGG(CHAR(METHOTREXATE.APR_START_DTE) || ' to ' || CHAR(METHOTREXATE.APR_END_DTE), CHR(13)||CHR(10)) METHOTREXATE_DATES FROM APPTS LEFT JOIN CIS CIS ON "MRN" = CIS.APR_MRN LEFT JOIN DOX DOX ON "MRN" = DOX.APR_MRN LEFT JOIN METHOTREXATE METHOTREXATE ON "MRN" = METHOTREXATE.APR_MRN GROUP BY "MRN", PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, VITAL_STATUS, PT_DATE_OF_DEATH, "Appt Date", "Department", "Service", "Department Name", "Provider Name", "Visit Type Abbr", "Visit Type" ; SELECT ACD_MRN, ACD_IRB_NO, ACD_TX_ST_DTE, ACD_TX_END_DTE FROM (SELECT DISTINCT "MRN" FROM APPTS) JOIN IDB.ACCRUALS_DATES ON "MRN" = ACD_MRN WHERE ACD_TX_ST_DTE BETWEEN '2010-01-01' AND '2019-06-15' ; SELECT PRPT_MRN, PRPT_PROCEDURE_DTE, PRPT_ACCESSION_NO, PRPT_REPORT_TYPE_DESC FROM (SELECT DISTINCT "MRN" FROM APPTS) JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V ON "MRN" = PRPT_MRN WHERE CONTAINS("PRPT_REPORT", '("anatomical descriptors/locations")') = 1 AND PRPT_PROCEDURE_DTE BETWEEN '2010-01-01' AND '2019-06-15' ; SELECT CDD_MRN, CDD_DOC_NAME, CDD_SERVICE_DTE FROM (SELECT DISTINCT "MRN" FROM APPTS) JOIN DV.CLINDOC_FULL_TEXT_V ON "MRN" = CDD_MRN WHERE CONTAINS(" CDD_DOCUMENT_FULL_TEXT", '("anatomical descriptors/locations")') = 1 AND CDD_DOC_NAME like 'Initial%' AND CDD_CANCEL_IND <> '1' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND <> '1' AND CDD_SERVICE_DTE BETWEEN '2010-01-01' AND '2019-06-15' ; SELECT SSE_MRN, SSE_SURG_DTE, SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD, SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC, SSP_SURG_LAST_NM, SSP_SURG_FIRST_NM, SSP_SURG_SVC_CD FROM (SELECT DISTINCT "MRN" FROM APPTS) JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT ON "MRN" = SSE_MRN JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE ON SSE_LOG_ID = SSP_LOG_ID AND SSE_ENC_CSN_ID = SSP_ENC_CSN_ID WHERE (SSE_SURG_LOC not like '%IR%' AND SSE_SURG_LOC not like '%ENDO%' AND SSE_SOURCE_TYPE <> 'E') AND SSE_SURG_DTE BETWEEN '2010-01-01' AND '2019-06-15' ; SELECT DISTINCT TM_MRN, TM_DX_DTE, TM_SITE_CD AS SITE_CODE, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_DESC, TM_HIST_CD AS HIST_CODE, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS HIST_DESC FROM (SELECT DISTINCT "MRN" FROM APPTS) JOIN IDB.CDB_TUMOR ON MRN = TM_MRN JOIN IDB.CLM H ON TM_HIST_CD = H.CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON TM_SITE_CD = S.CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7') AND TM_DX_DTE BETWEEN '2010-01-01' AND '2019-06-15' AND TM_HIST_CD IN ('M9180/3', 'M9181/3', 'M9182/3', 'M9183/3', 'M9184/3', 'M9185/3', 'M9186/3', 'M9187/3', 'M9190/3', 'M9192/3', 'M9193/3', 'M9194/3', 'M9195/3') ; SELECT OO_MRN, OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE ORDER_DATE, OO_ORD_NAME ORDER_NAME FROM (SELECT DISTINCT "MRN" FROM APPTS) JOIN IDB.OMS_ORDER ON MRN = OO_MRN WHERE OO_ORD_STS_CD NOT IN ('CANP', 'CANC', 'AUC3') AND OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE BETWEEN '2010-01-01' AND '2019-06-15' AND OO_ORD_NAME IN ('Hearing Consult Inpatient', 'Hearing Consult Outpatient', 'ECHO:2-D & M-Mode/Doppler', 'ECHO:Stress Echo with EKG', 'ECHO:Dobutamine Echo Stress Test (DEST)', 'ECHO:TEE', 'Pediatric Echo') ;

prompt: Provide ICD-10 coded data designating barotrauma (pneumothorax, pneumomediastinum, and subcutaneous emphysema) for patients who previously tested positive for COVID-19.
completion: WITH DT AS (SELECT DISTINCT MRN , PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID , DATE(MIN_IDENTIFIED_DT) AS COVID_DTE , POSITIVE_SOURCES , CASE WHEN POSITIVE_SOURCES like '%order_and_result%' THEN 'MSK' WHEN POSITIVE_SOURCES like '%hie%' THEN 'Non-MSK' END AS "Test Source" , RESULT , PT_DEATH_DTE FROM IDB.PATIENT_COVID_INFO_V JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON PT_MRN = MRN WHERE 1=1 AND RESULT IN ('Positive', 'Resolved') AND MRN > '' ) , ICD_PRE AS (SELECT MRN , ICD_DATE , ICD_CODE FROM (SELECT DISTINCT CC_MRN AS MRN , CC_EFF_DTE AS ICD_DATE , CC_CLSF_CD AS ICD_CODE FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN DT ON MRN = CC_MRN AND CC_EFF_DTE >= COVID_DTE AND CC_EFF_DTE BETWEEN '2-1-2020' AND '4-17-2020' WHERE 1=1 AND CC_CLSF_CD IN ( (SELECT CLM_CLSF_CD FROM IDB.CLM WHERE 1=1 AND CLM_CLSF_TYPE like 'I%' AND (1=2 OR CLM_CLSF_CD like 'J93%' OR CLM_CLSF_CD like 'J95%' OR CLM_CLSF_CD like 'S27%' OR CLM_CLSF_CD IN ('J98.2', 'P25.2', 'P25.3', 'T79') OR CLM_CLSF_CD like 'T81%') ) ) AND (CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR (CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y' AND CC_PT_TYPE = 'O')) ) UNION SELECT DISTINCT MRN , ICD_DATE , ICD_CODE FROM (SELECT DX_MRN AS MRN , PBD_SVC_DTE AS ICD_DATE , DX_CLSF_CD AS ICD_CODE FROM IDB.PBD_DX JOIN DT ON MRN = DX_MRN JOIN IDB.PBD_DTL ON DX_MRN = PBD_MRN AND DX_INV_NO = PBD_INV_NO AND PBD_SVC_DTE >= COVID_DTE AND PBD_SVC_DTE BETWEEN '2-1-2020' AND '4-17-2020' WHERE 1=1 AND DX_CLSF_CD IN ( (SELECT CLM_CLSF_CD FROM IDB.CLM WHERE 1=1 AND CLM_CLSF_TYPE like 'I%' AND (1=2 OR CLM_CLSF_CD like 'J93%' OR CLM_CLSF_CD like 'J95%' OR CLM_CLSF_CD like 'S27%' OR CLM_CLSF_CD IN ('J98.2', 'P25.2', 'P25.3', 'T79') OR CLM_CLSF_CD like 'T81%') )) )) SELECT PRE.MRN , PT_LAST_NAME AS "Last Name" , PT_FIRST_NAME AS "First Name" , PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH AS "Date of Birth" , PT_DATE_OF_DEATH AS "Date of Death" , CASE WHEN PT_DATE_OF_DEATH IS NULL THEN YEAR(CURRENT date - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) END AS "Current Age" , CASE WHEN PT_DATE_OF_DEATH IS NULL THEN 'Alive' ELSE 'Deceased' END AS "Vital Status" , PT_SEX AS "Gender" , COVID_DTE , ICD_DATE , DAYS(ICD_DATE) - DAYS(COVID_DTE) AS "Days Btw" , ICD_CODE , CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS ICD_DESC FROM ICD_PRE PRE JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PT_MRN = PRE.MRN JOIN DT DT ON DT.MRN = PRE.MRN JOIN IDB.CLM ON ICD_CODE = CLM_CLSF_CD ORDER BY MRN, ICD_DATE, ICD_CODE ;

prompt: Design a report of upcoming IR Biopsy or radiology scan appointments for metastatic patient cohort consented to 06-107 or 12-245
completion: SELECT DISTINCT STRIP(CPE_MRN) AS MRN, PT_DATE_OF_DEATH, CPE_ENC_DTE, CRE_RES_NAME, STRIP(CLD_DEPT_NAME) AS CLD_DEPT_NAME, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6, STRIP(CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME) AS CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CPE_MRN ORDER BY CPE_ENC_DTE DESC) AS RN FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PT_MRN = CPE_MRN AND PT_DATE_OF_DEATH IS NULL WHERE 1=1 AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 IN ('RAD', 'NUC') AND CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Sch') AND CPE_ENC_DTE >= CURRENT DATE AND CPE_MRN IN ()

prompt: Provide a weekly list of lymphoma patients who died the prior week.
completion: WITH PT AS (SELECT STRIP(PT_MRN) AS PT_MRN, STRIP(PT_LAST_NAME) AS PT_LAST_NAME, STRIP(PT_FIRST_NAME) AS PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_DATE_OF_DEATH, COALESCE(MAX(PLA_LST_APPT_DTE, PLA_LST_DSCH_DTE), PLA_LST_APPT_DTE, PLA_LST_DSCH_DTE) AS LAST_FU_DATE FROM IDB.PATIENT JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY ON PT_MRN = PLA_MRN WHERE PT_DATE_OF_DEATH >= CURRENT DATE - 7 DAYS ) , LYM AS (SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN AS MRN FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN PT ON PT_MRN = CPE_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CRE_RES_TYP IN ('Physician', 'PhD', 'Dentist', 'Psychologist') AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 = 'LYM' UNION SELECT VIS_MRN AS MRN FROM PT JOIN IDB.VISIT ON PT_MRN = VIS_MRN WHERE VIS_IP_OP_ADJUSTED_IND = 'I' AND VIS_VISIT_STATUS NOT IN ('1', '4') AND VIS_HOSP_SVC = 'LYM' ) , DX AS (SELECT TM_MRN AS MRN, TM_DX_DTE AS DX_DATE, STRIP(TM_HIST_CD) || '-' || STRIP(H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK) || ' | ' || STRIP(TM_SITE_CD) || '-' || STRIP(S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK) AS DX_CODE FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM H ON TM_HIST_CD = H.CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON TM_SITE_CD = S.CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.SEERGROUPING ON RECODE = IDB.SEERF_ICDO(TM_SITE_CD, TM_HIST_CD) AND CATEGORY1 = 'Lymphoma' WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND TM_MRN IN (SELECT MRN FROM LYM) UNION SELECT CC_MRN AS MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS DX_DATE, STRIP(CLM_CLSF_CD) || '-' || STRIP(CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK) AS DX_CODE FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.SEERGROUPING ON RECODE = MIN(IDB.SEERF_ICD9(CLM_CLSF_CD), IDB.SEERF_ICD10(CLM_CLSF_CD)) AND CATEGORY1 IN ('Lymphoma') WHERE CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND ((CC_PT_TYPE = 'I') OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) AND CC_MRN IN (SELECT MRN FROM LYM) GROUP BY CC_MRN, CLM_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK ) , CTE AS (SELECT MRN AS DX_MRN, DX_DATE, DX_CODE FROM DX) , CTE2 AS (SELECT * FROM CTE ORDER BY DX_MRN, DX_DATE, DX_CODE) , T1 AS (SELECT DX_MRN, DX_DATE, DX_CODE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY DX_MRN ORDER BY DX_DATE) AS RN FROM CTE2 ORDER BY DX_MRN, DX_DATE) , T2 (MRN, DX, RN1) AS (SELECT DX_MRN, CAST(DX_DATE AS VARCHAR(6000))||' | '||CAST(DX_CODE AS VARCHAR(100)), RN FROM T1 WHERE T1.RN = 1 UNION ALL SELECT DX_MRN, RTRIM(CAST(DX AS VARCHAR(4000))) || ', ' || CHR(13) || CHR(10) || CAST(DX_DATE AS VARCHAR(100))||' | '||RTRIM(CAST(DX_CODE AS VARCHAR(100))) , RN1 + 1 FROM T1, T2 WHERE DX_MRN = MRN AND RN = RN1+1 ) , T3 AS (SELECT MRN, MAX(RN1) RN FROM T2 GROUP BY MRN) , T4 AS (SELECT T2.MRN, RN, DX FROM T2 JOIN T3 ON T2.MRN = T3.MRN AND T2.RN1 = T3.RN) SELECT DISTINCT PT.*, DX FROM PT JOIN LYM ON PT_MRN = LYM.MRN LEFT JOIN T4 ON T4.MRN = LYM.MRN

prompt: Provide an amended version of report HA6201 on patients Breast DMT patients with updated disease status in ClinDoc.
completion: WITH CTE AS (SELECT BG_MRN, BG_DISEAS_STS_DESC AS DMT_STS, DATE(BG_DS_STS_CR_DT) AS DMT_DTE FROM IDB.BR_GENERAL ), CLINDOC AS (SELECT CDD_MRN, DMT_STS, DMT_DTE, CDD_SIGNED_DTE, CDD_DOC_NAME, CDO_ITEM_NAME, CDO_VALUE_TEXT FROM IDB.CD_DOCUMENT A JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION ON CDD_DOC_GUID = CDO_DOC_GUID JOIN CTE ON BG_MRN = CDD_MRN AND CDD_SIGNED_DTE > DMT_DTE WHERE CDD_CANCEL_IND <> '1' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND <> '1' AND CDD_DOC_NAME IN ('Follow Up - Breast Medicine', 'Breast Surgery Follow Up Patient', 'Follow Up Note - Breast Surgery', 'Follow Up, Breast, MD - Rad Onc') AND CDO_MSTR_ITEM_NM IN ('BRE_MED_TREAT_ImpressRespoPW ob', 'BRS_FU_Disease State obs', 'BRE_MED_TREAT_Impression 2 ob')), CD_MAX AS (SELECT CDD_MRN AS MAX_MRN, MAX(CDD_SIGNED_DTE) AS MAX_SIGNED_DTE FROM CLINDOC GROUP BY CDD_MRN) SELECT CDD_MRN AS "MRN", DMT_STS AS "DMT Disease Status", DMT_DTE AS "DMT Disease Status Date", CDD_SIGNED_DTE AS "Max ClinDoc Note Signed Date", CDD_DOC_NAME AS "ClinDoc Note Name", CDO_ITEM_NAME AS "ClinDoc Item Name", CDO_VALUE_TEXT AS "ClinDoc Value" FROM CLINDOC JOIN CD_MAX ON CDD_MRN = MAX_MRN AND CDD_SIGNED_DTE = MAX_SIGNED_DTE GROUP BY CDD_MRN, DMT_STS, DMT_DTE, CDD_SIGNED_DTE, CDD_DOC_NAME, CDO_ITEM_NAME, CDO_VALUE_TEXT

prompt: Patients age 60 or older with COVID-19 status of Positive or Resolved
completion: SELECT PT_MRN AS MRN, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH "Date of birth", PT_DATE_OF_DEATH "Date of death", YEAR(DATE(CASE WHEN PT_DATE_OF_DEATH IS NULL THEN CURRENT DATE ELSE PT_DATE_OF_DEATH END) - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) AS AGE, PT_SEX AS "Sex", R.AV_DESC AS RACE, RESULT AS "Result", MIN_RESULT_DT AS "MIN Result date" FROM IDB.COVID19_PATIENT_INFO LEFT JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS R ON R.AV_ELEMENT = 'RACE' AND R.AV_CODE = PT_RACE WHERE RESULT IN ('Positive', 'Resolved') AND YEAR(DATE(CURRENT DATE)-PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) >= 65 AND PT_MRN IS NOT NULL ;

prompt: Provide a list of patients with metastatic melanoma and are 75 years of age or older when they received either Pembrolizumab, Nivolumab, Ipilimumab between 01/01/2016 and 12/31/2018.  Provide treatment dates and performance data.
completion: WITH DX AS (SELECT DISTINCT CC_MRN MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) DX_DTE, CC_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE CC_CLSF_TYPE like 'DF%' AND SUBSTR(CC_CLSF_CD, 1, 5) IN ('C43.9', '172.9') GROUP BY CC_MRN, CC_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK) , MEDS AS (SELECT APR_MRN , APR_START_DTE , APR_END_DTE , CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME FROM (SELECT APR_MRN, APR_START_DTE, APR_END_DTE, CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY APR_MRN, CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME ORDER BY APR_START_DTE ASC) AS RANK FROM IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX JOIN IDB.CHEMO_DRUG_GENERIC ON APR_GENERIC_NAME = CDG_GENERIC_NAME JOIN DX ON MRN = APR_MRN WHERE 1=1 AND CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME IN ('PEMBROLIZUMAB', 'NIVOLUMAB', 'IPILIMUMAB') ) A WHERE 1=1 AND APR_START_DTE BETWEEN '2016-01-01' AND '2018-12-31' AND RANK = 1 ) , MEDS_LAST AS (SELECT APR_MRN L_APR_MRN , APR_START_DTE A_APR_START_DTE , APR_END_DTE L_APR_END_DTE , CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME L_CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME FROM (SELECT A.APR_MRN, A.APR_START_DTE, A.APR_END_DTE, C.CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY A.APR_MRN, C.CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME ORDER BY A.APR_START_DTE DESC) AS RANK1 FROM IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX A JOIN IDB.CHEMO_DRUG_GENERIC C ON A.APR_GENERIC_NAME = C.CDG_GENERIC_NAME JOIN MEDS B ON A.APR_MRN = B.APR_MRN WHERE 1=1 AND C.CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME IN ('PEMBROLIZUMAB', 'NIVOLUMAB', 'IPILIMUMAB') ) A WHERE 1=1 AND RANK1 = 1 ) SELECT DISTINCT MRN "MRN", PT_FIRST_NAME "PT Last Name", PT_LAST_NAME "PT First Name", PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH "DOB", YEAR(MIN(APR_START_DTE) - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) "Age at dose", PT_DATE_OF_DEATH "DOD", CC_CLSF_CD "ICD Code", CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK "Diagnosis", DX_DTE "Diagnosis Date", MAX(CASE WHEN CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME = 'PEMBROLIZUMAB' THEN APR_START_DTE END) AS "PEMBROLIZUMAB First Admin Date", MAX(CASE WHEN L_CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME = 'PEMBROLIZUMAB' THEN L_APR_END_DTE END) AS "PEMBROLIZUMAB Last Admin Date", MAX(CASE WHEN CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME = 'NIVOLUMAB' THEN APR_START_DTE END) AS "NIVOLUMAB First Admin Date", MAX(CASE WHEN L_CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME = 'NIVOLUMAB' THEN L_APR_END_DTE END) AS "NIVOLUMAB Last Admin Date", MAX(CASE WHEN CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME = 'IPILIMUMAB' THEN APR_START_DTE END) AS "IPILIMUMAB First Admin Date", MAX(CASE WHEN L_CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME = 'IPILIMUMAB' THEN L_APR_END_DTE END) AS "IPILIMUMAB Last Admin Date" FROM DX JOIN MEDS ON MRN = APR_MRN JOIN MEDS_LAST ON MRN = L_APR_MRN JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON MRN = PT_MRN WHERE 1=1 GROUP BY MRN, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, PT_DATE_OF_DEATH, CC_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK, DX_DTE HAVING YEAR(MAX(APR_START_DTE) - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) >= '75' ; WITH DX AS (SELECT DISTINCT CC_MRN MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) DX_DTE, CC_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE CC_CLSF_TYPE like 'DF%' AND SUBSTR(CC_CLSF_CD, 1, 5) IN ('C43.9', '172.9') GROUP BY CC_MRN, CC_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK) , MEDS AS (SELECT APR_MRN , APR_START_DTE , APR_END_DTE , CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME FROM (SELECT APR_MRN, APR_START_DTE, APR_END_DTE, CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY APR_MRN, CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME ORDER BY APR_START_DTE ASC) AS RANK FROM IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX JOIN IDB.CHEMO_DRUG_GENERIC ON APR_GENERIC_NAME = CDG_GENERIC_NAME JOIN DX ON MRN = APR_MRN WHERE 1=1 AND CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME IN ('PEMBROLIZUMAB', 'NIVOLUMAB', 'IPILIMUMAB') ) A WHERE 1=1 AND APR_START_DTE BETWEEN '2016-01-01' AND '2018-12-31' AND RANK = 1 ) , MEDS_LAST AS (SELECT APR_MRN L_APR_MRN , APR_START_DTE A_APR_START_DTE , APR_END_DTE L_APR_END_DTE , CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME L_CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME FROM (SELECT A.APR_MRN, A.APR_START_DTE, A.APR_END_DTE, C.CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY A.APR_MRN, C.CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME ORDER BY A.APR_START_DTE DESC) AS RANK1 FROM IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX A JOIN IDB.CHEMO_DRUG_GENERIC C ON A.APR_GENERIC_NAME = C.CDG_GENERIC_NAME JOIN MEDS B ON A.APR_MRN = B.APR_MRN WHERE 1=1 AND C.CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME IN ('PEMBROLIZUMAB', 'NIVOLUMAB', 'IPILIMUMAB') ) A WHERE 1=1 AND RANK1 = 1 ) , ECOG AS (SELECT DISTINCT CDD_MRN, CDD_SERVICE_DTE, CDO_ITEM_NAME, SUBSTR(CDO_VALUE_TEXT, 1, 200) AS CDO_VALUE_200 FROM DX JOIN IDB.CD_DOCUMENT ON CDD_MRN = MRN JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION ON CDO_DOC_GUID = CDD_DOC_GUID AND CDO_AUTHORED_DTE = CDD_AUTHORED_DTE AND CDO_VALUE_TEXT > '' WHERE 1=1 AND CDD_CANCEL_IND = '0' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND = '0' AND CDO_VALUE_TEXT <> 'Y' AND (UPPER(CDO_ITEM_NAME) LIKE '%KPS%' OR UPPER(CDO_ITEM_NAME) LIKE '%KARNOFSKY%' OR UPPER(CDO_ITEM_NAME) LIKE '%ECOG%') AND UPPER(CDO_ITEM_NAME) NOT LIKE '%PULMONARY FUNCTION%' ) SELECT DISTINCT MRN "MRN", PT_FIRST_NAME "PT Last Name", PT_LAST_NAME "PT First Name", CDO_ITEM_NAME "Performance Test", CDD_SERVICE_DTE "Service Date", CDO_VALUE_200 "Performance Score" FROM DX JOIN MEDS ON MRN = APR_MRN JOIN MEDS_LAST ON MRN = L_APR_MRN JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON MRN = PT_MRN JOIN ECOG ON MRN = CDD_MRN WHERE 1=1 AND YEAR(APR_START_DTE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) >= '75' ;

prompt: I am requesting data on patients who've been seen by a Urologist and have received intravesical therapy at MSKCC (BCG or mitomycin).
completion: WITH UROLOGY AS (SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 = 'SRG' AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 = 'URO' AND CRE_RES_TYP = 'Physician' ) SELECT CPE_MRN, PINC_GENERIC_NAME, DT_DTE DTE FROM UROLOGY JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON CPE_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN DV.PHM_ORDER_DTL ON POD_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID JOIN DV.PHM_INVENTORY_CATALOG ON POD_PHARMA_INVENTORY_CTLG_ID = PINC_INVENTORY_CTLG_ID LEFT JOIN DV.DATE ON DT_DATE_ID = POD_START_DATE_ID WHERE PINC_GENERIC_NAME IN ('BCG', 'BCG (Tice)', 'BCG (TICE) 10E5 CFU/0.1 ML', 'BCG (TICE) 10E6 CFU/0.1 ML', 'BCG Live Vaccine', 'BCG Live Vaccine (TICE)', 'BCG LIVE VACCINE', 'BCG Tokyo-172 Strain (Intradermal) INVEST', 'BCG Tokyo-172 Strain (Intravesical) INVEST', 'mitoMYCIN') ;

prompt: Weekly report of UCC notification orders, Koch to Main transfer request orders and Discharge Hospital transfer LIP orders for QA purposes
completion: SELECT DISTINCT OO_MRN AS "MRN", CONCAT(RTRIM(PT_LAST_NAME), CONCAT(', ', PT_FIRST_NAME)) "PATIENT NAME", OO_ENTER_DTE AS "ORDER DATE", DOC_NAME AS "REFERRING DOCTOR", DOC_ACDMC_SVC AS "REFERRING DOCTOR SVC", OUO_CURR_LOC AS "ORDER LOCATION", OUD_USER_DI_VALUE AS "REASON FOR REFERRAL" FROM IDB.OMS_ORDER JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_CATALOG ON OOC_MSTR_ITEM_GUID = OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_USER_DATA ON OUD_ORD_GUID = OO_ORD_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_FORM_FIELD ON OUD_USER_DI_CD = OFF_DI_CD AND OO_ENTRY_FRM_GUID = OFF_ENTRY_FRM_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_CLIENT_VISIT ON OCV_VISIT_GUID = OO_VISIT_GUID JOIN IDB.DOC ON OO_REQ_DR_NO = DOC_DR_NO JOIN IDB.OMS_USER_ORDERS ON OO_ORD_GUID = OUO_ORD_GUID JOIN IDB.LOCATION_GROUPS_REFERENCE ON OUO_CURR_LOC = LGR_LOC_NAME JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON OO_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE OOC_MSTR_ITEM_GUID = '9000013014100730' AND OO_ORD_STS_CD NOT IN ('CANP', 'CANC', 'AUC3') AND OO_ENTER_DTE >= CURRENT DATE - 7 DAYS AND UPPER(LGR_LOC_GRP) LIKE '%KOCH%' AND OFF_FLD_GUID = '9000101098700760' ; WITH ORDERS AS (SELECT DISTINCT OO_MRN AS "MRN", CONCAT(RTRIM(PT_LAST_NAME), CONCAT(', ', PT_FIRST_NAME)) "PATIENT NAME", OO_ENTER_DTE AS "ORDER DATE", DOC_NAME AS "REFERRING DOCTOR", DOC_ACDMC_SVC AS "REFERRING DOCTOR SVC", OUO_CURR_LOC AS "ORDER LOCATION", MAX(CASE WHEN OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'Requested For' THEN OUD_USER_DI_VALUE ELSE NULL END) AS "Requested For", MAX(CASE WHEN OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'OAMBtoIP_Service' THEN OUD_USER_DI_VALUE ELSE NULL END) AS "OAMBtoIP_Service", MAX(CASE WHEN OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'YES' THEN OUD_USER_DI_VALUE ELSE NULL END) AS "YES", MAX(CASE WHEN OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'OAMBtoIP_Admit_MD' THEN OUD_USER_DI_VALUE ELSE NULL END) AS "OAMBtoIP_Admit_MD" FROM IDB.OMS_ORDER JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_CATALOG ON OOC_MSTR_ITEM_GUID = OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_USER_DATA ON OUD_ORD_GUID = OO_ORD_GUID LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_STATUS ON OSTS_ORD_STS_CD = OO_ORD_STS_CD JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_FORM_FIELD ON OUD_USER_DI_CD = OFF_DI_CD AND OO_ENTRY_FRM_GUID = OFF_ENTRY_FRM_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_CLIENT_VISIT ON OCV_VISIT_GUID = OO_VISIT_GUID LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_SERVICE ON OCV_SVC_GUID = OS_SVC_GUID LEFT JOIN IDB.DOC ON OO_REQ_DR_NO = DOC_DR_NO JOIN IDB.OMS_USER_ORDERS ON OO_ORD_GUID = OUO_ORD_GUID LEFT JOIN IDB.LOCATION_GROUPS_REFERENCE ON OUO_CURR_LOC = LGR_LOC_NAME LEFT JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON OO_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE OOC_MSTR_ITEM_GUID = '9000014024200730' AND OO_ENTER_DTE >= CURRENT DATE - 7 DAYS AND OO_ORD_STS_CD NOT IN ('CANP', 'CANC', 'AUC3') GROUP BY OO_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, OO_ENTER_DTE, DOC_NAME, DOC_ACDMC_SVC, OUO_CURR_LOC) SELECT MRN, "PATIENT NAME", "ORDER DATE", DOC_NAME "PROVIDER MD", DOC_ACDMC_SVC "PRVIDER MD SVC", "ORDER LOCATION", "OAMBtoIP_Service" FROM ORDERS LEFT JOIN IDB.DOC ON RIGHT(TRIM("OAMBtoIP_Admit_MD"), 6) = DOC_DR_NO ; SELECT OO_MRN AS "MRN", CONCAT(RTRIM(PT_LAST_NAME), CONCAT(', ', PT_FIRST_NAME)) "PATIENT NAME", OO_ENTER_DTE AS "ORDER DATE", DOC_NAME AS "REFERRING DOCTOR", DOC_ACDMC_SVC AS "REFERRING DOCTOR SVC", OUO_CURR_LOC AS "ORDER LOCATION", MAX(CASE WHEN UPPER(OUD_USER_DI_CD) = 'HTO_TRANSFERTO' THEN OUD_USER_DI_VALUE ELSE NULL END) AS "TRANSFER TO", MAX(CASE WHEN UPPER(OUD_USER_DI_CD) = 'HTO_REASONSFORTRANSFER' THEN OUD_USER_DI_VALUE ELSE NULL END) AS "REASON FOR TRANSFER" FROM IDB.OMS_ORDER JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_CATALOG ON OOC_MSTR_ITEM_GUID = OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_USER_DATA ON OUD_ORD_GUID = OO_ORD_GUID LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_STATUS ON OSTS_ORD_STS_CD = OO_ORD_STS_CD JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_FORM_FIELD ON OUD_USER_DI_CD = OFF_DI_CD AND OO_ENTRY_FRM_GUID = OFF_ENTRY_FRM_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_CLIENT_VISIT ON OCV_VISIT_GUID = OO_VISIT_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_SERVICE ON OCV_SVC_GUID = OS_SVC_GUID LEFT JOIN IDB.DOC ON OO_REQ_DR_NO = DOC_DR_NO JOIN IDB.OMS_USER_ORDERS ON OO_ORD_GUID = OUO_ORD_GUID JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON OO_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE OOC_MSTR_ITEM_GUID = '9000005701100730' AND OO_ORD_STS_CD NOT IN ('CANP', 'CANC', 'AUC3') AND UPPER(OUO_CURR_LOC) LIKE '%KOCH%' AND OO_ENTER_DTE >= CURRENT DATE - 7 DAYS GROUP BY OO_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, OO_ENTER_DTE, DOC_NAME, DOC_ACDMC_SVC, OUO_CURR_LOC ;

prompt: Daily e-mail notification to guerciob@mskcc.org listing all MSK patients consented to specific research protocols the day prior.
completion: WITH CTE AS (SELECT PRO_IRB_NO, AC_MRN, MAX(ACD_CONS_DTE) AS "MAX_ACD_CONS_DTE", AC_LAST_NAME, AC_FIRST_NAME FROM IDB.PROTOCOL JOIN IDB.ACCRUALS ON PRO_IRB_NO = AC_IRB_NO JOIN IDB.ACCRUALS_DATES ON AC_IRB_NO = ACD_IRB_NO WHERE (PRO_IRB_NO IN ('17-294', '17-602', '18-319', '19-220', '16-1621', '20-262', '20-371', '19-255', '20-472')) AND (ACD_CONS_DTE = CURRENT date - 1 DAYS) AND ACD_OFF_STUDY_DTE IS NULL AND AC_MRN <> 'ZZZZZZZZ' GROUP BY AC_MRN, PRO_IRB_NO, AC_FIRST_NAME, AC_LAST_NAME) , ROW_CTE AS (SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ROW_MRN ORDER BY DT_DTE DESC) ROWNUM FROM (SELECT AC_MRN AS "ROW_MRN", ENR_RES_NAME, ENDP_SERVICE_SPECIALTY_GRP_8, MIN(DT_DTE) MIN_DTE, MAX(DT_DTE) DT_DTE, COUNT(DISTINCT DT_DTE) APPT_CT FROM DV.PATIENT_ENCOUNTER JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PENC_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID JOIN CTE ON PT_MRN = AC_MRN JOIN DV.DATE ON PENC_ENC_DATE_ID = DT_DATE_ID JOIN DV.ENCOUNTER_DEPARTMENT ON PENC_DEPT_ID = ENDP_ENC_DEPT_ID JOIN DV.ENCOUNTER_SCHD_RESOURCES ON PENC_PT_ENC_ID = ENSR_PT_ENC_ID AND ENSR_PRIMARY_RES_IND = 'Y' JOIN DV.ENCOUNTER_RESOURCE ON ENSR_RES_ID = ENR_ENC_RES_ID JOIN DV.ENCOUNTER_VISIT_TYPE ON PENC_VISIT_TYPE_ID = ENVT_ENC_VISIT_TYPE_ID WHERE ENR_RES_TYP = 'Physician' AND DT_DTE <= CURRENT DATE GROUP BY AC_MRN, ENR_RES_NAME, ENDP_SERVICE_SPECIALTY_GRP_8)) SELECT AC_MRN AS "MRN", PRO_IRB_NO AS "IRB Protocol Name", AC_LAST_NAME AS "Last Name", AC_FIRST_NAME AS "First Name", MAX_ACD_CONS_DTE AS "Consent Date", ENR_RES_NAME AS "Resource Name", ENDP_SERVICE_SPECIALTY_GRP_8 "Group", MIN_DTE "MIN Appt Date", DT_DTE AS "MAX Appt Date", APPT_CT "Appt Count" FROM CTE JOIN ROW_CTE ON AC_MRN = ROW_MRN WHERE ROWNUM <= 5

prompt: DQS runs a report on hospital discharges. They would like IS to take these reports over
completion: SELECT DISTINCT VIS_BED AS BED, VIS_HOSP_SVC AS SERVICE, VIS_MRN MRN, PT_FIRST_NAME AS "First Name", PT_LAST_NAME AS "Last Name", DOC_NAME AS ATTENDING, DATE(OO_ENTER_DT) AS "Order Date", TIME(OO_ENTER_DT) AS "Order Time", VIS_DSCH_DTE AS "Discharge Date", VIS_DSCH_TIME AS "Discharge Time", TIMESTAMPDIFF(4, CHAR(TIMESTAMP(VIS_DSCH_DTE, VIS_DSCH_TIME) -OO_ENTER_DT)) AS "Order to Discharge Minutes", VIS_DAYS_STAY AS "Length of Stay" FROM IDB.VISIT LEFT JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON VIS_MRN=PT_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_ORDER ON VIS_ADM_NUM = OO_ADM_NUM AND OO_MRN = VIS_MRN AND (LEFT(UPPER(OO_ORD_NAME), 19)='DISCHARGE PATIENT ') AND UPPER(OO_ORD_STS_CD) IN ('AUC1', 'AUC3', 'COMP', 'AUA2') LEFT JOIN IDB.DOC ON VIS_ATN_DR_NO = DOC_DR_NO WHERE VIS_DSCH_DTE = CURRENT DATE-2 DAY AND VIS_VISIT_STATUS IN ('2', '3') AND VIS_IP_OP_ADJUSTED_IND = 'I' AND TRIM(VIS_NURS_STA) IN ('NACU', 'NS-4', 'NS-5', 'NS-7', 'NS-8', 'NS-9', 'NS10', 'NS12', 'NS14', 'NS15', 'NS16', 'NS17', 'NS18', 'NS19', 'PICU', 'UCCP') AND VIS_DSCH_DISP like 'A%' ;

prompt: Provide oral and IV drugs administered at MSK for cohort of IMPACT-patients who received immunotherapy at MSK
completion: SELECT OO_MRN MRN , OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE DATE_ADMIN , OOC_ITEM_NAME ORDER_NAME , CASE WHEN NFN.OUD_USER_DI_VALUE IS NOT NULL THEN NFN.OUD_USER_DI_VALUE ELSE STRIP(OO_ORD_NAME)||' '||STRIP(OO_ORD_MODIFIER) END DRUG_NAME , OMD_ORD_ROUTE ROUTE , OOC_THERAPEUTIC_CAT THERAPEUTIC_CAT , OO_ORD_PRIO AS WHERE_TO_FILL , CASE WHEN OO_REQ_TME_PRIO IN ('NYS Paper', 'Outside Order', 'Fill at MSK', 'Medicaid') OR OO_IS_FOR_DSCH = 'Y' OR(OO_REQ_TME_PRIO = 'Routine' AND OCV_IP_OP_IND = 'O' AND OCV_CARE_LVL NOT IN ('AXR', 'UCO', 'OR', 'UCC')) THEN 'Rx' ELSE OCV_IP_OP_IND||'P' END AS ORD_TYPE FROM IDB.OMS_ORDER JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_CATALOG ON OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID = OOC_MSTR_ITEM_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_MED_DETAIL ON OMD_ORD_GUID = OO_ORD_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_CLIENT_VISIT ON OCV_VISIT_GUID = OO_VISIT_GUID LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_FORM_FIELD ON OO_ENTRY_FRM_GUID = OFF_ENTRY_FRM_GUID AND OFF_FLD_LABEL IN ('Non-Formulary Medication Name:', 'Medication Name:') LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_USER_DATA NFN ON NFN.OUD_ORD_GUID = OO_ORD_GUID AND OFF_DI_CD = NFN.OUD_USER_DI_CD WHERE OO_ORD_STS_CD NOT IN ('CANC', 'CANP', 'AUC3') AND TRIM(OMD_ORD_ROUTE) <> '' AND OO_MRN IN ({})

prompt: Please provide corresponding MRN information corresponding to the MSK-IMPACT IDs.
Inpatients seen by Infectious Disease APPs from 1/1/ 20 to 2/28/22
completion: WITH DOCS AS (SELECT DISTINCT CDD_MRN AS MRN, CDD_DOC_GUID AS DOC_GUID, CDD_DOC_NAME AS DOC_NAME, OU_DISPLAY_NAME AS PROVIDER, OU_OCCUPATION AS PROV_OCCUPATION, OU_ORD_ROLE_TYPE AS PROV_ROLE, CDD_SERVICE_DTE AS SERVICE_DTE, VIS_ADM_DTE AS ADM_DTE, VIS_DSCH_DTE AS DSCH_DTE FROM IDB.CD_DOCUMENT JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION ON CDO_DOC_GUID = CDD_DOC_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_USER ON CDO_USER_GUID = OU_USER_GUID JOIN IDB.VISIT_V ON CDD_MRN = VIS_MRN AND VIS_IP_OP_ADJUSTED_IND = 'I' AND CDD_SERVICE_DTE BETWEEN VIS_ADM_DTE AND COALESCE(VIS_DSCH_DTE, CURRENT DATE) WHERE 1=1 AND CDD_SERVICE_DTE BETWEEN '2020-01-01' AND '2022-02-28' AND CDD_CANCEL_IND = '0' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND = '0' AND CDD_DOC_NAME IN ('Initial Consult/Initial Visit, IP - DOM-Infectious Diseases', 'Follow Up Consultation - DOM-Infectious Diseases') ) , DOCS2 AS (SELECT DISTINCT A.MRN , A.DOC_GUID, A.DOC_NAME , A.SERVICE_DTE, A.ADM_DTE, A.DSCH_DTE, B.PROVIDER AS DR, B.PROV_OCCUPATION AS DR_OCC, C.PROVIDER AS OTH, C.PROV_OCCUPATION AS OTH_OCC FROM DOCS A LEFT JOIN DOCS B ON A.DOC_GUID = B.DOC_GUID AND B.PROV_ROLE = 'Attending' LEFT JOIN DOCS C ON A.DOC_GUID = C.DOC_GUID AND C.PROV_ROLE <> 'Attending') , DOCS3 AS (SELECT DISTINCT MRN, DOC_GUID, DOC_NAME, SERVICE_DTE, ADM_DTE, DSCH_DTE, DR, DR_OCC, OTH, OTH_OCC , X.PRIMARY_DX, CONSULT_REASON FROM DOCS2 LEFT JOIN (SELECT OUO_MRN, OUO_ENTER_DTE , OUO_REQ_FOR_DTE, OUO_ORD_NAME AS ORDER_NAME, OUD_USER_DI_VALUE AS PRIMARY_DX FROM IDB.OMS_USER_ORDERS JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_USER_DATA ON OUD_ORD_GUID = OUO_ORD_GUID AND OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'Consult_Infec Dx IP Primary') AS X ON X.OUO_MRN = MRN AND X.OUO_REQ_FOR_DTE = SERVICE_DTE LEFT JOIN (SELECT OUO_MRN, OUO_ENTER_DTE , OUO_REQ_FOR_DTE, OUO_ORD_NAME AS ORDER_NAME, OUD_USER_DI_VALUE AS CONSULT_REASON FROM IDB.OMS_USER_ORDERS JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_USER_DATA ON OUD_ORD_GUID = OUO_ORD_GUID AND OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'Consult_Infec Dx IP Reason') AS Y ON Y.OUO_MRN = MRN AND Y.OUO_REQ_FOR_DTE = SERVICE_DTE WHERE 1=1 AND (UPPER(DR) LIKE 'HOHL, TOBIAS%' OR UPPER(DR) LIKE 'SHAH, MONIKA%' OR UPPER(DR) LIKE 'LARACY, JUSTIN%' OR UPPER(DR) LIKE 'TAUR, YING%' OR UPPER(DR) LIKE 'MEAD, PETER%' OR UPPER(DR) LIKE 'PAPANICOLAOU, GENOVEFA%' OR UPPER(DR) LIKE 'LEE, YEON JOO%' OR UPPER(DR) LIKE 'FIGUEROA ORTIZ, CESAR%' OR UPPER(DR) LIKE 'MORJARIA, SEJAL%' OR UPPER(DR) LIKE 'NAMBIAR, PUJA%' OR UPPER(DR) LIKE 'SEO, SUSAN%' OR UPPER(DR) LIKE 'GLICKMAN, MICHAEL%' OR UPPER(DR) LIKE 'REDELMAN-SIDI, GIL%' OR UPPER(DR) LIKE 'KALTSAS, ANNA%' OR UPPER(DR) LIKE 'ROBILOTTI, ELIZABETH%' )) , DOCS4 AS (SELECT MRN, DOC_GUID, DOC_NAME, SERVICE_DTE, ADM_DTE, DSCH_DTE, DR, DR_OCC, OTH, OTH_OCC, PRIMARY_DX, CONSULT_REASON FROM DOCS3 WHERE 1=1 AND DOC_NAME = 'Initial Consult/Initial Visit, IP - DOM-Infectious Diseases' ) , DOCS5 AS (SELECT MRN , DOC_NAME, ADM_DTE, DSCH_DTE, COUNT (DOC_GUID) AS FR_COUNT FROM DOCS3 WHERE 1=1 AND DOC_NAME = 'Follow Up Consultation - DOM-Infectious Diseases' GROUP BY MRN, DOC_NAME, ADM_DTE, DSCH_DTE) SELECT A.MRN, A.DOC_GUID, A.DOC_NAME, SERVICE_DTE, A.ADM_DTE, A.DSCH_DTE, DR, DR_OCC, OTH, OTH_OCC, PRIMARY_DX, CONSULT_REASON, FR_COUNT FROM DOCS4 A LEFT JOIN DOCS5 B ON A.MRN = B.MRN AND A.ADM_DTE = B.ADM_DTE

prompt: Provide a comprehensive list of functional MRI studies performed at MSK, along with some additional patients identifiers. Please discuss with Chengcheng Gui before proceeding.
completion: WITH PT AS (SELECT DISTINCT RRPT_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, CASE WHEN RTC_TX_START_DTE IS NOT NULL THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS "RT Indicator(Y/N)", RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE, RRPT_RPT_ID, RRPT_ACCESSION_NO, RRPT_ORDER_GROUP, RRPT_PROCEDURE_NAME, VARCHAR(RRPT_REPORT_TXT, 32000) AS REPORT_TEXT FROM DV.RADIOLOGY_REPORT_V JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PT_MRN = RRPT_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.RADONC_TREATMENT_COURSE ON RRPT_MRN = RTC_TX_MRN WHERE RRPT_ORDER_GROUP = 'MR' AND RRPT_PROCEDURE_NAME IN ('FUNCTIONAL SHORT', 'Functional', 'Functional Long', 'Functional Short', 'MR FUNCTIONAL', 'MR FUNCTIONAL LONG', 'MR FUNCTIONAL SHORT') AND RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE <= '2023-09-01' ), DX AS (SELECT DISTINCT CC_MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS MIN_ICD9_EFF_DTE, CC_CLSF_CD AS ICD9_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS ICD9_DESC FROM PT LEFT JOIN IDB.CTC_CLSF ON RRPT_MRN = CC_MRN JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE CC_CLSF_CD IN ('198.3', 'C79.31') AND CASE WHEN CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y' AND CC_PT_TYPE <> 'E' THEN 'Y' WHEN CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' AND YEAR(CC_EFF_DTE) < 2004 THEN 'Y' WHEN CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND YEAR(CC_EFF_DTE) < 2001 THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END = 'Y' GROUP BY CC_MRN, CC_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK ) SELECT DISTINCT RRPT_MRN AS MRN, PT_LAST_NAME AS "Last Name", PT_FIRST_NAME AS "First Name", PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH AS "Date of Birth", "RT Indicator(Y/N)", CASE WHEN MIN_ICD9_EFF_DTE IS NOT NULL THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS "Brain Mets Indicator(Y/N)", RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE AS "Report Performed Date", RRPT_ACCESSION_NO AS "Accession Number", RRPT_ORDER_GROUP AS "Report Order Group", RRPT_PROCEDURE_NAME AS "Report Procedure Name", REPORT_TEXT AS "Report Text" FROM PT LEFT JOIN DX ON RRPT_MRN=CC_MRN ORDER BY RRPT_MRN

prompt: I need the 2024 visit data for all EDD service visits - including total visits per quarter broken down by type, location and MD sent at the end of each quarter.
completion: SELECT CPE_MRN MRN, CPE_ENC_DTE VST_DATE, CPE_ENC_CSN_ID CSN , QUARTER (CPE_ENC_DTE) VST_QTR , CPE_CL_PT_ID PT_ID, CPE_ENC_DTE_SEQ DTE_SEQ, CPE_RM_NO RM_NO , VD.CLD_DEPT_ID DEPT_ID, VD.CLD_DEPT_NAME DEPT_NAME , VD.CLD_CLD_CENTER CLD_CENTER , VD.CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_20 CLINIC, VD.CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 GRP6 , CPE_APPT_DT APPT_DT, CPE_CHK_IN_DT CHK_IN_DT , CPE_CHK_OUT_DT CHK_OUT_DT, CPE_WALK_IN_IND WALK_IN , VT.CRE_RES_NAME VST_MD, REF.CRE_RES_NAME REF_MD , CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR VST_ABBR, CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME VST_NAME , CVT_EXT_NAME VST_TYPE, CPE_RM_IN_DT RM_IN, CPE_RM_OUT_DT RM_OUT , SD.CLD_DEPT_NAME SEC_DEPT_NAME, REF.CRE_RES_ID , SR.CRE_RES_NAME SEC_RES, SR.CRE_RES_TYP SEC_RES_TYPE FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID = CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT VD ON CPE_DEPT_ID = VD.CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE VT ON VT.CRE_RES_ID = CPE_VST_RES_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE REF ON REF.CRE_RES_ID = CPE_REF_RES_ID AND REF.CRE_RES_TYP IN ('Physician', 'Dentist', 'Psychologist', 'PhD', 'Nurse Practitioner', 'Physician Assistant', 'Advanced Practice Nurse') LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_PT_APPT ON CPE_CL_PT_ID = CPA_CL_PT_ID AND CPE_ENC_DTE_SEQ = CPA_ENC_DTE_SEQ AND CPA_LINE_NO = 2 LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT SD ON CPA_DEPT_ID = SD.CLD_DEPT_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE SR ON SR.CRE_RES_ID = CPE_VST_RES_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_PATIENT ON CPE_PRK = CL_PRK WHERE CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN '2024-01-01' AND CURRENT date AND CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Comp', 'Arrived') AND CPE_ENC_TYP_CD = 50 AND VD.CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 = 'EDD' ; WITH X AS (SELECT CPE_MRN MRN, CPE_ENC_DTE VST_DATE, CPE_ENC_CSN_ID CSN , QUARTER (CPE_ENC_DTE) VST_QTR , CPE_CL_PT_ID PT_ID, CPE_ENC_DTE_SEQ DTE_SEQ, CPE_RM_NO RM_NO , VD.CLD_DEPT_ID DEPT_ID, VD.CLD_DEPT_NAME DEPT_NAME , VD.CLD_CLD_CENTER CLD_CENTER , VD.CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_20 CLINIC, VD.CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 GRP6 , CPE_APPT_DT APPT_DT, CPE_CHK_IN_DT CHK_IN_DT , CPE_CHK_OUT_DT CHK_OUT_DT, CPE_WALK_IN_IND WALK_IN , VT.CRE_RES_NAME VST_MD, REF.CRE_RES_NAME REF_MD , CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR VST_ABBR, CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME VST_NAME , CVT_EXT_NAME VST_TYPE, CPE_RM_IN_DT RM_IN, CPE_RM_OUT_DT RM_OUT , SD.CLD_DEPT_NAME SEC_DEPT_NAME, REF.CRE_RES_ID , SR.CRE_RES_NAME SEC_RES, SR.CRE_RES_TYP SEC_RES_TYPE FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID = CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT VD ON CPE_DEPT_ID = VD.CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE VT ON VT.CRE_RES_ID = CPE_VST_RES_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE REF ON REF.CRE_RES_ID = CPE_REF_RES_ID AND REF.CRE_RES_TYP IN ('Physician', 'Dentist', 'Psychologist', 'PhD', 'Nurse Practitioner', 'Physician Assistant', 'Advanced Practice Nurse') LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_PT_APPT ON CPE_CL_PT_ID = CPA_CL_PT_ID AND CPE_ENC_DTE_SEQ = CPA_ENC_DTE_SEQ AND CPA_LINE_NO = 2 LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT SD ON CPA_DEPT_ID = SD.CLD_DEPT_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE SR ON SR.CRE_RES_ID = CPE_VST_RES_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_PATIENT ON CPE_PRK = CL_PRK WHERE CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN '2024-01-01' AND CURRENT date AND CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Comp', 'Arrived') AND CPE_ENC_TYP_CD = 50 AND VD.CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 = 'EDD' ), X1 AS (SELECT DEPT_NAME, VST_MD, VST_NAME, COUNT(CASE WHEN VST_QTR = 1 THEN MRN END) AS QUATER1, COUNT(CASE WHEN VST_QTR = 2 THEN MRN END) AS QUATER2, COUNT(CASE WHEN VST_QTR = 3 THEN MRN END) AS QUATER3, COUNT(CASE WHEN VST_QTR = 4 THEN MRN END) AS QUATER4 FROM X GROUP BY DEPT_NAME, VST_MD, VST_NAME), X2 AS (SELECT DEPT_NAME, VST_MD||' '||VST_NAME FINAL_DATA FROM X1) , DOCUMENT AS (SELECT DISTINCT DEPT_NAME, VST_MD, LISTAGG(COALESCE(STRIP(CAST(VST_NAME AS VARCHAR(32000))), '') , CHR(13) || CHR(10)) WITHIN GROUP( ORDER BY DEPT_NAME, VST_MD) AS VST_NAMES FROM (SELECT DISTINCT DEPT_NAME, VST_MD, VST_NAME FROM X) GROUP BY DEPT_NAME, VST_MD) SELECT DISTINCT C.DEPT_NAME, D.VST_MD, C.VST_NAME, QUATER1, QUATER2, QUATER3, QUATER4, SUM(QUATER1+QUATER2+QUATER3+QUATER4) OVER(PARTITION BY C.DEPT_NAME, D.VST_MD, C.VST_NAME ORDER BY C.DEPT_NAME) TOTAL_COUNT FROM X1 C JOIN DOCUMENT D ON C.DEPT_NAME = D.DEPT_NAME AND C.VST_MD = D.VST_MD ORDER BY C.DEPT_NAME ; WITH X AS (SELECT CPE_MRN MRN, CPE_ENC_DTE VST_DATE, CPE_ENC_CSN_ID CSN , QUARTER (CPE_ENC_DTE) VST_QTR , CPE_CL_PT_ID PT_ID, CPE_ENC_DTE_SEQ DTE_SEQ, CPE_RM_NO RM_NO , VD.CLD_DEPT_ID DEPT_ID, VD.CLD_DEPT_NAME DEPT_NAME , VD.CLD_CLD_CENTER CLD_CENTER , VD.CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_20 CLINIC, VD.CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 GRP6 , CPE_APPT_DT APPT_DT, CPE_CHK_IN_DT CHK_IN_DT , CPE_CHK_OUT_DT CHK_OUT_DT, CPE_WALK_IN_IND WALK_IN , VT.CRE_RES_NAME VST_MD, REF.CRE_RES_NAME REF_MD , CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR VST_ABBR, CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME VST_NAME , CVT_EXT_NAME VST_TYPE, CPE_RM_IN_DT RM_IN, CPE_RM_OUT_DT RM_OUT , SD.CLD_DEPT_NAME SEC_DEPT_NAME, REF.CRE_RES_ID , SR.CRE_RES_NAME SEC_RES, SR.CRE_RES_TYP SEC_RES_TYPE FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID = CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT VD ON CPE_DEPT_ID = VD.CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE VT ON VT.CRE_RES_ID = CPE_VST_RES_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE REF ON REF.CRE_RES_ID = CPE_REF_RES_ID AND REF.CRE_RES_TYP IN ('Physician', 'Dentist', 'Psychologist', 'PhD', 'Nurse Practitioner', 'Physician Assistant', 'Advanced Practice Nurse') LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_PT_APPT ON CPE_CL_PT_ID = CPA_CL_PT_ID AND CPE_ENC_DTE_SEQ = CPA_ENC_DTE_SEQ AND CPA_LINE_NO = 2 LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT SD ON CPA_DEPT_ID = SD.CLD_DEPT_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE SR ON SR.CRE_RES_ID = CPE_VST_RES_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_PATIENT ON CPE_PRK = CL_PRK WHERE CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN '2024-01-01' AND CURRENT date AND CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Comp', 'Arrived') AND CPE_ENC_TYP_CD = 50 AND VD.CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 = 'EDD' ), X1 AS (SELECT DEPT_NAME, VST_MD, VST_NAME, COUNT(CASE WHEN VST_QTR = 1 THEN MRN END) AS QUATER1, COUNT(CASE WHEN VST_QTR = 2 THEN MRN END) AS QUATER2, COUNT(CASE WHEN VST_QTR = 3 THEN MRN END) AS QUATER3, COUNT(CASE WHEN VST_QTR = 4 THEN MRN END) AS QUATER4 FROM X GROUP BY DEPT_NAME, VST_MD, VST_NAME), VISIT AS (SELECT DISTINCT DEPT_NAME, COUNT(VST_QTR) TOTAL_COUNT_OF_VISIT FROM X GROUP BY DEPT_NAME) SELECT DISTINCT X1.DEPT_NAME, SUM(QUATER1) QUATER1_COUNT, SUM(QUATER2) QUATER2_COUNT, SUM(QUATER3) QUATER3_COUNT, SUM(QUATER4) QUATER3_COUNT, SUM(QUATER1+QUATER2+QUATER3+QUATER4) TOTAL_QUATER_COUNT_BY_DEPT FROM X1 GROUP BY X1.DEPT_NAME ORDER BY X1.DEPT_NAME ;

prompt: All Instances of CPT Codes 55870, 54505
completion: WITH PBD AS (SELECT PBD_MRN AS MRN, PBD_SVC_DTE AS "Service Date", PBC_CPT_CD AS "CPT Code", CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS "CPT Description", DOC_NAME AS "Doctor Name", DOC_SVC AS "Doctor Service", DX_CLSF_CD AS "ICD-9/10 Dx Code", CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS "ICD-9/10 Dx Desc", 'Physician Billing' AS "Source" FROM IDB.PBD_DTL JOIN IDB.PBD_INVOICE ON PBD_INV_NO = PBI_INV_NO JOIN IDB.PBD_CODE ON PBD_PBD_CD = PBC_PBD_CD JOIN IDB.PBD_DX ON PBD_INV_NO = DX_INV_NO JOIN IDB.CLM ON DX_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.DOC ON DOC_DR_NO = PBI_PERFORM_DR_NO WHERE PBC_CPT_CD IN ('55870', '54505') AND PBD_SVC_DTE BETWEEN '2003-01-01' AND '2020-07-01' GROUP BY PBD_MRN, PBD_SVC_DTE, PBC_CPT_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK, DOC_NAME, DOC_SVC, DX_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK) , SRG AS (SELECT SSE_MRN AS MRN, SSE_SURG_DTE AS "Service Date", SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD AS "CPT Code", SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC AS "CPT Description", TRIM(SSP_SURG_LAST_NM) ||', '|| TRIM(SSP_SURG_FIRST_NM) AS "Doctor Name", SSP_SURG_SVC_CD AS "Doctor Service", '' AS "ICD-9/10 Dx Code", '' AS "ICD-9/10 Dx Desc", 'OpTime' AS "Source" FROM IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE ON SSE_LOG_ID = SSP_LOG_ID LEFT JOIN PBD ON MRN = SSE_MRN AND "Service Date" = SSE_SURG_DTE WHERE SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD IN ('55870', '54505') AND SSE_SURG_DTE BETWEEN '2003-01-01' AND '2020-07-01' AND MRN IS NULL ) , COMBINED AS (SELECT * FROM PBD UNION ALL SELECT * FROM SRG) SELECT MRN, "Service Date", YEAR("Service Date" - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) AS "Age", "CPT Code", "CPT Description", "Doctor Name", "Doctor Service", PRE.CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME AS "Before Chemo Common Generic Name", MAX(PRE.APR_START_DTE) AS "Before Max Start Date", POST.CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME AS "After Chemo Common Generic Name", MIN(POST.APR_START_DTE) AS "After Min Start Date", "ICD-9/10 Dx Code", "ICD-9/10 Dx Desc", "Source" FROM COMBINED LEFT JOIN IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX_V AS PRE ON MRN = PRE.APR_MRN AND PRE.CDG_CHEMO_FLAG = 'Y' AND PRE.APR_START_DTE <= "Service Date" LEFT JOIN IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX_V AS POST ON MRN = POST.APR_MRN AND POST.CDG_CHEMO_FLAG = 'Y' AND POST.APR_START_DTE > "Service Date" JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PT_MRN = MRN GROUP BY MRN, "Service Date", YEAR("Service Date" - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH), "CPT Code", "CPT Description", "Doctor Name", "Doctor Service", PRE.CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME, POST.CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME, "ICD-9/10 Dx Code", "ICD-9/10 Dx Desc", "Source"

prompt: Could we get # of unique Ralph Lauren Center patients and # who have had Counseling Center (psychiatry) visits from 2019 to present?
completion: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CPE_MRN) AS "Count of MRN" FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN '2019-01-01' AND '2021-11-30' AND CLD_CLD_CENTER = '1919' ; SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CPE_MRN) AS "Count of MRN" FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN '2019-01-01' AND '2021-11-30' AND CLD_CLD_CENTER = '1919' AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 = 'PSY' ; SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CPE_MRN) AS "Count of MRN" FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN '2021-12-01' AND CURRENT DATE -1 DAY AND CLD_CLD_CENTER = '1919' ; SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CPE_MRN) AS "Count of MRN" FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN '2021-12-01' AND CURRENT DATE -1 DAY AND CLD_CLD_CENTER = '1919' AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 = 'PSY' ;

prompt: Add Lou-Anne Chichester to IDBDW groups
