prompt: Please provide a list of all patients who underwent hepatic artery embolization and ablation from 2010 to date and had flow cytometry performed before and after the procedure (within one month)
completion: WITH SRG AS (SELECT SSE_MRN, SSE_SURG_DTE, SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD, SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC FROM IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE ON SSE_LOG_ID = SSP_LOG_ID AND SSE_ENC_CSN_ID = SSP_ENC_CSN_ID WHERE SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC IN ('EMBOLIZATION, ARTERIAL TUMOR HEPATIC', 'ABLTJ 1/> LVR TUM PRQ RF') AND SSE_SURG_DTE >= '2010-01-01' ) SELECT PRPT_MRN AS MRN , SSE_SURG_DTE AS IR_DATE , SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC AS IR_DESC , PRPT_PROCEDURE_DTE AS PATH_PROCEDURE_DTE , PRPT_REPORT_DTE AS PATH_REPORT_DTE , PRPT_REPORT_TYPE_DESC AS PATH_REPORT_TYPE , PRPT_REPORT AS PATH_FULL_REPORT FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V JOIN SRG ON PRPT_MRN = SSE_MRN AND PRPT_PROCEDURE_DTE BETWEEN SSE_SURG_DTE AND SSE_SURG_DTE + 3 MONTH WHERE SUBSTR(PRPT_ACCESSION_NO, 1, 1) = 'F'

prompt: Weekly report of all BMT patients scheduled with appointments in the next month with Aetna insurance.
completion: WITH APPTS AS (SELECT CPE_MRN AS "MRN", CHAR(CPE_ENC_DTE) AS "Appt Date", CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 AS "Department", CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 AS "Service", CLD_DEPT_NAME AS "Department Name", CRE_RES_NAME AS "Provider Name", CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME AS "Visit Type", CHAR(CPE_APPT_MADE_DTE) "Appt Made Date", CPE_ENC_CSN_ID "Enc ID", CPE_CPE_APPT_STS "Appt Status" FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Sch') AND (CRE_RES_TYP IN ('Physician') OR CRE_RES_NAME IN ('KENNY, SHEILA A', 'GORELOV, JENNIFER SUSAN', 'SUPAN, CHRISTIANNE CANDA')) AND UPPER(CRE_RES_NAME) NOT LIKE '%JOFFE%' AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 = 'BMT' AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 = 'MED' AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT date AND CURRENT date + 31 DAYS ) , TRANSPLANT AS (SELECT ANSWR.AAQ_QUEST_ANSWER AS "Answer", ENCANS.CPQA_ENC_CSN_ID AS CSN_ID FROM IDB.AN_QFORM QFORM JOIN IDB.AN_QANSWER ANSID ON QFORM.AF_FORM_ID = ANSID.AA_FORM_ID JOIN IDB.AN_QANSWER_QA ANSWR ON ANSID.AA_ANSWER_ID = ANSWR.AAQ_ANSWER_ID JOIN IDB.CL_PT_QNRS_ANSWERS ENCANS ON ANSID.AA_ANSWER_ID = ENCANS.CPQA_QNRS_ANSWER_ID JOIN IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER ENC ON ENCANS.CPQA_ENC_CSN_ID = ENC.CPE_ENC_CSN_ID WHERE QFORM.AF_FORM_ID = '100129' AND ANSWR.AAQ_QUEST_ID = '100063' AND ENCANS.CPQA_ENC_CSN_ID IN (SELECT "Enc ID" FROM APPTS) ) , PREVIOUS AS (SELECT B.CPE_MRN "lmrn", B.CPE_ENC_CSN_ID, CHAR(B.CPE_ENC_DTE) "Last Visit", ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY B.CPE_MRN ORDER BY B.CPE_ENC_DTE DESC) AS RANK FROM APPTS JOIN IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER B ON "MRN" = B.CPE_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON B.CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON B.CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID WHERE B.CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND (CRE_RES_TYP IN ('Physician') OR CRE_RES_NAME IN ('KENNY, SHEILA A', 'GORELOV, JENNIFER SUSAN', 'SUPAN, CHRISTIANNE CANDA')) AND UPPER(CRE_RES_NAME) NOT LIKE '%JOFFE%' AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 = 'BMT' AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 = 'MED' AND B.CPE_ENC_DTE < CURRENT date ORDER BY MRN, RANK) SELECT APPTS.MRN, PT_FIRST_NAME "First", PT_LAST_NAME "Last", CHAR(PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) "DOB", INS_COMP_NAME, "Provider Name", "Appt Date", "Service", "Appt Made Date", "Visit Type", "Appt Status", "Answer", "Last Visit" FROM IDB.PATIENT_INSURANCE_V I JOIN APPTS ON APPTS.MRN = I.MRN LEFT JOIN PREVIOUS ON APPTS.MRN = "lmrn" AND RANK = 1 JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON APPTS.MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN TRANSPLANT ON CSN_ID = "Enc ID" WHERE ((UPPER(INS_COMP_NAME) like '%FIDELIS%' AND FSC_REP_CAT_NAME = 'MEDICARE') OR FSC_CODE IN ('GHX', 'HMD', 'HCP')) AND INS_COMP_NAME <> 'GHI MEDICAID' AND COALESCE(INS_EXP_DATE, "Appt Date") >= "Appt Date" AND FSC_PRIORITY = 1 ORDER BY "Answer" DESC, INS_COMP_NAME, "Visit Type"

prompt: We are seeking patients with enchondromas to review.
completion: WITH DIAGNOSIS_0 AS (SELECT "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AS PT_DEID, BASE_QUERY.PT_MRN AS PT_MRN, CAST(TRIM(BASE_QUERY.PT_MRN) AS VARCHAR) || CAST(TRIM(BASE_QUERY.DIAGNOSIS_DATE) AS VARCHAR) || CAST(TRIM(BASE_QUERY.ICD_CODES_ICD_CODE) AS VARCHAR) AS SUBJECT_ID, TRIM(BASE_QUERY.ICD_CODES_ICD_CODE) || '-' || TRIM("IDB"."CLM"."CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK") AS ICD_CODES_ICD_CODE_DESC, YEAR(BASE_QUERY.DIAGNOSIS_DATE - "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_BIRTH_DTE") AS AGE_AT_ICD_CODE_DATE FROM (SELECT "IDB"."CTC_CLSF"."CC_MRN" AS PT_MRN, "IDB"."CTC_CLSF"."CC_CLSF_CD" AS ICD_CODES_ICD_CODE, MIN("IDB"."CTC_CLSF"."CC_EFF_DTE") AS DIAGNOSIS_DATE FROM "IDB"."CTC_CLSF" WHERE "IDB"."CTC_CLSF"."CC_CLSF_TYPE" LIKE 'DF%' AND ("IDB"."CTC_CLSF"."CC_PT_TYPE" = 'I' OR ("IDB"."CTC_CLSF"."CC_PT_TYPE" = 'O' AND "IDB"."CTC_CLSF"."CC_FINALIZED_IND" = 'Y')) GROUP BY "IDB"."CTC_CLSF"."CC_MRN", "IDB"."CTC_CLSF"."CC_CLSF_CD") AS BASE_QUERY JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS" ON BASE_QUERY.PT_MRN = "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_MRN" JOIN "IDB"."CLM" ON BASE_QUERY.ICD_CODES_ICD_CODE = "IDB"."CLM"."CLM_CLSF_CD" WHERE BASE_QUERY.ICD_CODES_ICD_CODE IN ('Q78.4') AND YEAR(BASE_QUERY.DIAGNOSIS_DATE - "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_BIRTH_DTE") BETWEEN 18 AND 99), COHORT AS (SELECT PT_DEID AS PT_DEID FROM (SELECT DIAGNOSIS_0.PT_DEID AS PT_DEID FROM DIAGNOSIS_0)), COHORT_DIAGNOSIS AS (SELECT SUBJECT_ID AS SUBJECT_ID, PT_DEID AS PT_DEID FROM (SELECT DIAGNOSIS_0.SUBJECT_ID AS SUBJECT_ID, DIAGNOSIS_0.PT_DEID AS PT_DEID FROM DIAGNOSIS_0)), KEYS AS (SELECT COHORT.PT_DEID AS COHORT_PT_DEID, COHORT_DIAGNOSIS.SUBJECT_ID AS COHORT_DIAGNOSIS_SUBJECT_ID, COHORT_DIAGNOSIS.PT_DEID AS COHORT_DIAGNOSIS_PT_DEID FROM COHORT LEFT OUTER JOIN COHORT_DIAGNOSIS ON COHORT_DIAGNOSIS.PT_DEID = COHORT.PT_DEID), DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS AS (SELECT DISTINCT "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AS PT_DEID, IDB_PATIENT."PT_MRN" AS PT_MRN, "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AS SUBJECT_ID, DMP_ID_TBL."PDRX_DMP_PATIENT_ID" AS DMP_ID, TRIM(IDB_PATIENT."PT_LAST_NAME") || ', ' || TRIM(IDB_PATIENT."PT_FIRST_NAME") AS PT_NAME, ALLOWVALS_SEX."AV_DESC" AS SEX, CASE WHEN (IDB_PATIENT."PT_DATE_OF_DEATH" IS NULL) THEN 'Alive' ELSE 'Deceased' END AS VITAL_STATS, IDB_PATIENT."PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH" AS DATE_OF_BIRTH, IDB_PATIENT."PT_DATE_OF_DEATH" AS DATE_OF_DEATH, ALLOWVALS_RACE."AV_DESC" AS RACE, ALLOWVALS_ETHNICITY."AV_DESC" AS ETHNICITY, ALLOWVALS_LANGUAGE."AV_DESC" AS PRIMARY_LANGUAGE, LAST_ACTIVITY_DATE."PLA_LST_ACTV_DTE" AS LAST_ACTIVITY_DATE, LAST_CONTACT_DATE."PLA_LST_CON_DTE" AS LAST_CONTACT_DATE FROM "IDB"."PATIENT" AS IDB_PATIENT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS" ON IDB_PATIENT."PT_MRN" = "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_MRN" LEFT OUTER JOIN "DV"."PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML" AS DMP_ID_TBL ON DMP_ID_TBL."PDRX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT OUTER JOIN "IDB"."ALLOWVALS" AS ALLOWVALS_SEX ON IDB_PATIENT."PT_SEX" = ALLOWVALS_SEX."AV_CODE" AND ALLOWVALS_SEX."AV_ELEMENT" = 'SEX' LEFT OUTER JOIN "IDB"."ALLOWVALS" AS ALLOWVALS_RACE ON IDB_PATIENT."PT_RACE" = ALLOWVALS_RACE."AV_CODE" AND ALLOWVALS_RACE."AV_ELEMENT" = 'RACE' LEFT OUTER JOIN "IDB"."ALLOWVALS" AS ALLOWVALS_ETHNICITY ON IDB_PATIENT."PT_PT_ETHNICITY" = ALLOWVALS_ETHNICITY."AV_CODE" AND ALLOWVALS_ETHNICITY."AV_ELEMENT" = 'PT_ETHNICITY' LEFT OUTER JOIN "IDB"."ALLOWVALS" AS ALLOWVALS_LANGUAGE ON IDB_PATIENT."PT_PRIMARY_LANG" = ALLOWVALS_LANGUAGE."AV_CODE" AND ALLOWVALS_LANGUAGE."AV_ELEMENT" = 'PRIMARY_LANG' LEFT OUTER JOIN "IDB".PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY AS LAST_ACTIVITY_DATE ON IDB_PATIENT."PT_MRN" = LAST_ACTIVITY_DATE."PLA_MRN" LEFT OUTER JOIN "IDB".PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY AS LAST_CONTACT_DATE ON IDB_PATIENT."PT_MRN" = LAST_CONTACT_DATE."PLA_MRN") SELECT DISTINCT DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS.PT_MRN AS MRN, DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS.DMP_ID AS DMP_ID, DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS.PT_NAME AS PT_NAME, DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS.SEX AS SEX, DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS.VITAL_STATS AS VITAL_STATUS, DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS.DATE_OF_BIRTH AS DATE_OF_BIRTH, DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS.DATE_OF_DEATH AS DATE_OF_DEATH, DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS.RACE AS RACE, DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS.ETHNICITY AS ETHNICITY, DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS.PRIMARY_LANGUAGE AS PRIMARY_LANGUAGE, DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS.LAST_ACTIVITY_DATE AS LAST_ACTIVITY_DATE, DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS.LAST_CONTACT_DATE AS LAST_CONTACT_DATE FROM KEYS LEFT OUTER JOIN DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS ON DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS.PT_DEID = KEYS.COHORT_PT_DEID; WITH DIAGNOSIS_0 AS (SELECT "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AS PT_DEID, BASE_QUERY.PT_MRN AS PT_MRN, CAST(TRIM(BASE_QUERY.PT_MRN) AS VARCHAR) || CAST(TRIM(BASE_QUERY.DIAGNOSIS_DATE) AS VARCHAR) || CAST(TRIM(BASE_QUERY.ICD_CODES_ICD_CODE) AS VARCHAR) AS SUBJECT_ID, TRIM(BASE_QUERY.ICD_CODES_ICD_CODE) || '-' || TRIM("IDB"."CLM"."CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK") AS ICD_CODES_ICD_CODE_DESC, YEAR(BASE_QUERY.DIAGNOSIS_DATE - "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_BIRTH_DTE") AS AGE_AT_ICD_CODE_DATE FROM (SELECT "IDB"."CTC_CLSF"."CC_MRN" AS PT_MRN, "IDB"."CTC_CLSF"."CC_CLSF_CD" AS ICD_CODES_ICD_CODE, MIN("IDB"."CTC_CLSF"."CC_EFF_DTE") AS DIAGNOSIS_DATE FROM "IDB"."CTC_CLSF" WHERE "IDB"."CTC_CLSF"."CC_CLSF_TYPE" LIKE 'DF%' AND ("IDB"."CTC_CLSF"."CC_PT_TYPE" = 'I' OR ("IDB"."CTC_CLSF"."CC_PT_TYPE" = 'O' AND "IDB"."CTC_CLSF"."CC_FINALIZED_IND" = 'Y')) GROUP BY "IDB"."CTC_CLSF"."CC_MRN", "IDB"."CTC_CLSF"."CC_CLSF_CD") AS BASE_QUERY JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS" ON BASE_QUERY.PT_MRN = "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_MRN" JOIN "IDB"."CLM" ON BASE_QUERY.ICD_CODES_ICD_CODE = "IDB"."CLM"."CLM_CLSF_CD" WHERE BASE_QUERY.ICD_CODES_ICD_CODE IN ('Q78.4') AND YEAR(BASE_QUERY.DIAGNOSIS_DATE - "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_BIRTH_DTE") BETWEEN 18 AND 99), COHORT AS (SELECT PT_DEID AS PT_DEID FROM (SELECT DIAGNOSIS_0.PT_DEID AS PT_DEID FROM DIAGNOSIS_0)), COHORT_DIAGNOSIS AS (SELECT SUBJECT_ID AS SUBJECT_ID, PT_DEID AS PT_DEID FROM (SELECT DIAGNOSIS_0.SUBJECT_ID AS SUBJECT_ID, DIAGNOSIS_0.PT_DEID AS PT_DEID FROM DIAGNOSIS_0)), KEYS AS (SELECT COHORT.PT_DEID AS COHORT_PT_DEID, COHORT_DIAGNOSIS.SUBJECT_ID AS COHORT_DIAGNOSIS_SUBJECT_ID, COHORT_DIAGNOSIS.PT_DEID AS COHORT_DIAGNOSIS_PT_DEID FROM COHORT LEFT OUTER JOIN COHORT_DIAGNOSIS ON COHORT_DIAGNOSIS.PT_DEID = COHORT.PT_DEID), PATHOLOGY_COLUMNS AS (SELECT DISTINCT "DV"."PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V"."PRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AS PT_DEID, "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_MRN" AS PT_MRN, "DV"."PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V"."PRPT_PATH_RPT_ID" AS SUBJECT_ID, "DV"."PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V"."PRPT_PATH_RPT_ID" AS REPORT_ID, "DV"."PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V"."PRPT_ACCESSION_NO" AS ACCESSION_NO, "DV"."PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V"."PRPT_REPORT_TYPE_DESC" AS PATH_RPT_TYPE, "DV"."PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V"."PRPT_REPORT_DTE" AS REPORT_DATE, "DV"."PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V"."PRPT_PROCEDURE_DTE" AS PROCEDURE_DATE, CAST("DV"."PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V"."PRPT_REPORT" AS VARCHAR(32500)) AS PATH_RPT_TEXT FROM "DV"."PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V" JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS" ON "DV"."PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V"."PRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID"), DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS AS (SELECT DISTINCT "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AS PT_DEID, IDB_PATIENT."PT_MRN" AS PT_MRN, "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AS SUBJECT_ID FROM "IDB"."PATIENT" AS IDB_PATIENT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS" ON IDB_PATIENT."PT_MRN" = "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_MRN") SELECT DISTINCT DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS.PT_MRN AS MRN, PATHOLOGY_COLUMNS.REPORT_ID AS PATH_REPORT_ID, PATHOLOGY_COLUMNS.ACCESSION_NO AS ACCESSION_NO, PATHOLOGY_COLUMNS.PATH_RPT_TYPE AS PATH_RPT_TYPE, PATHOLOGY_COLUMNS.REPORT_DATE AS REPORT_DATE, PATHOLOGY_COLUMNS.PROCEDURE_DATE AS PROCEDURE_DATE, PATHOLOGY_COLUMNS.PATH_RPT_TEXT AS PATH_RPT_TEXT FROM KEYS LEFT OUTER JOIN PATHOLOGY_COLUMNS ON PATHOLOGY_COLUMNS.PT_DEID = KEYS.COHORT_PT_DEID LEFT OUTER JOIN DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS ON DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS.PT_DEID = KEYS.COHORT_PT_DEID;

prompt: Create a dashboard to compare SCC, UCC, and Triage Visits. It should also so number of Admissions.
completion: SELECT DISTINCT 'Volume' AS "Measure", CPE_ENC_CSN_ID AS "Visit ID", CPE_MRN AS "MRN", CPE_ENC_DTE AS "Appt Date", TRIM(CLD_CLD_CENTER) AS "Location", TRIM(CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6) AS "Department", TRIM(CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8) AS "Service", TRIM(DOC_NAME) AS "Provider Name", CASE WHEN CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME like '%TRIAGE%' AND CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME <> 'TRIAGE RN ONLY' AND CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME not like '%UCC%' THEN 'Y' ELSE '' END AS "Triage Visit", CASE WHEN CLD_DEPT_NAME like '%SCC%' AND CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME like '%SCC%' AND CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME not like '%REFERRAL%' THEN 'Y' ELSE '' END AS "SCC Visit", '' "Between 8am and 6pm", '' "Between 8am and 8pm", '' AS "Admit Source" FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID JOIN IDB.DOC ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = DOC_DR_NO WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CPE_ENC_DTE >= '2017-01-01' AND CRE_RES_TYP IN ('Physician', 'Nurse Practitioner', 'Physician Assistant') UNION ALL SELECT DISTINCT 'UCC' AS "Measure", CPE_ENC_CSN_ID AS "Visit ID", CPE_MRN AS "MRN", CPE_ENC_DTE AS "Appt Date", TRIM(CLD_CLD_CENTER) AS "Location", TRIM(CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6) AS "Department", TRIM(CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8) AS "Service", TRIM(DOC_NAME) AS "Provider Name", '' AS "Triage Visit", '' AS "SCC Visit", CASE WHEN TIME(CPE_CHK_IN_DT) BETWEEN '8:00' AND '18:00' THEN 'Y' ELSE '' END "Between 8am and 6pm", CASE WHEN TIME(CPE_CHK_IN_DT) BETWEEN '8:00' AND '20:00' THEN 'Y' ELSE '' END "Between 8am and 8pm", '' AS "Admit Source" FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_REF_DEP_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.DOC ON CPE_REF_RES_ID = DOC_DR_NO WHERE CPE_DEPT_ID = 230 AND CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CPE_ENC_DTE >= '2017-01-01' UNION ALL SELECT DISTINCT 'Admission' AS "Measure", VIS_VISIT_ID AS "Visit ID", VIS_MRN AS "MRN", VIS_DTE AS "Appt Date", 'zz Admissions' AS "Location", 'zz Admissions' AS "Department", 'zz Admissions' AS "Service", TRIM(ADM_DR_NAME) AS "Provider Name", '' AS "Triage Visit", '' AS "SCC Visit", '' "Between 8am and 6pm", '' "Between 8am and 8pm", TRIM(ADM_SOURCE_DESC) AS "Admit Source" FROM IDB.VISIT_V WHERE VIS_IP_OP_ADJUSTED_IND = 'I' AND VIS_VISIT_STATUS IN ('2', '3') AND VIS_DTE >= '2017-01-01'

prompt: Provide a weekly report of cases when a nurse completing an adult health screening note indicated the patient had smoked in the previous 30 days, but the nurse did not order a nursing smoking cessation referral.
completion: WITH NOTES AS (SELECT DISTINCT CDD_DOC_GUID, CDD_MRN, CDD_AUTHORED_DTE, CDD_VISIT_GUID, CDD_AUTH_PROV_GUID FROM IDB.CD_DOCUMENT JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION ON CDD_DOC_GUID = CDO_DOC_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_CLIENT_VISIT ON CDD_VISIT_GUID = OCV_VISIT_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_SERVICE ON OCV_SVC_GUID = OS_SVC_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_PROVIDER ON CDD_AUTH_PROV_GUID = OP_PVDR_GUID JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PT_MRN = CDD_MRN WHERE CDD_DOC_NAME IN ('Adult Health Screening (65+), Ambulatory - Nursing', 'Adult Health Screening, Ambulatory - Nursing') AND CDD_CANCEL_IND <> '1' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND <> '1' AND CDD_AUTHORED_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT date - 8 DAYS AND CURRENT date - 2 DAYS AND CDO_MSTR_ITEM_NM = 'AMB_AHS_AI_Tobacco Use RES' AND CDO_VALUE_TEXT = 'Patient has used tobacco products in the last 30 days'), RN_ORDER AS (SELECT DISTINCT CDD_DOC_GUID AS RN_ORDER_DOC_GUID FROM NOTES JOIN IDB.OMS_ORDER ON OO_MRN = CDD_MRN JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_CATALOG ON OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID = OOC_MSTR_ITEM_GUID WHERE OOC_ITEM_NAME = 'Nursing Ambulatory Ref Smoking Cessation' AND OO_ENTER_DTE BETWEEN CDD_AUTHORED_DTE AND CDD_AUTHORED_DTE + 1 DAY ), OTHER_ORDERS AS (SELECT CDD_DOC_GUID AS OTHER_ORDERS_DOC_GUID, MAX(CASE WHEN OO_ORD_NAME = 'Nursing Ambulatory Ref Smoking Cessation' THEN 'Y' END) AS "RN Order Placed within 30 Days Prior", MAX(CASE WHEN OO_ORD_NAME = 'Smoking Cessation MD/NP/PA Consult' THEN 'Y' END) AS "RN Placed MD/NP/PA Order" FROM NOTES JOIN IDB.OMS_ORDER ON OO_MRN = CDD_MRN JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_CATALOG ON OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID = OOC_MSTR_ITEM_GUID WHERE ((OOC_ITEM_NAME = 'Nursing Ambulatory Ref Smoking Cessation' AND OO_ENTER_DTE BETWEEN CDD_AUTHORED_DTE - 30 DAYS AND CDD_AUTHORED_DTE - 1 DAY) OR (OOC_ITEM_NAME = 'Smoking Cessation MD/NP/PA Consult' AND OO_ENTER_DTE BETWEEN CDD_AUTHORED_DTE AND CDD_AUTHORED_DTE + 1 DAY AND OO_USER_GUID = CDD_AUTH_PROV_GUID)) AND CDD_DOC_GUID NOT IN (SELECT RN_ORDER_DOC_GUID FROM RN_ORDER) GROUP BY CDD_DOC_GUID) SELECT STRIP(OP_DISPLAY_NAME) AS "Provider", STRIP(OS_SVC_DESC) AS "Service", CDD_AUTHORED_DTE AS "Authored Date", CDD_MRN AS "MRN", PT_LAST_NAME AS "Last Name", PT_FIRST_NAME AS "First Name", "RN Placed MD/NP/PA Order", "RN Order Placed within 30 Days Prior" FROM NOTES LEFT JOIN OTHER_ORDERS ON CDD_DOC_GUID = OTHER_ORDERS_DOC_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_CLIENT_VISIT ON CDD_VISIT_GUID = OCV_VISIT_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_SERVICE ON OCV_SVC_GUID = OS_SVC_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_PROVIDER ON CDD_AUTH_PROV_GUID = OP_PVDR_GUID JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PT_MRN = CDD_MRN WHERE CDD_DOC_GUID NOT IN (SELECT RN_ORDER_DOC_GUID FROM RN_ORDER)

prompt: Provide a list of MRNs of patients with endometrial cancers that are determined by pathology to be MLH1 hypermethylated.
completion: WITH CDD AS (SELECT CDD_MRN , CDD_SERVICE_DTE AS "Service Date", CDD_DOC_NAME AS "Document Name", CDD_DOC_GUID AS "Document Guid", CDO_ITEM_NAME, CDO_VALUE_TEXT FROM IDB.CD_DOCUMENT JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION ON CDD_MRN = CDO_MRN AND CDD_DOC_GUID = CDO_DOC_GUID AND CDD_AUTHORED_DTE = CDO_AUTHORED_DTE WHERE CDD_CANCEL_IND <> '1' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND <> '1' AND (LOCATE('endometrial', LOWER (CDO_VALUE_TEXT)) >= 1 OR LOCATE('uterine cancer', LOWER (CDO_VALUE_TEXT)) >= 1) AND LOCATE('lynch', LOWER (CDO_VALUE_TEXT)) >= 1 AND NOT LOCATE('non-lynch', LOWER (CDO_VALUE_TEXT)) >= 1 AND NOT LOCATE('rule out lynch', LOWER (CDO_VALUE_TEXT)) >= 1 AND (CDD_SERVICE_DTE BETWEEN '2015-03-01' AND '2022-01-01')), CHEMO AS (SELECT APR_MRN, APR_START_DTE, APR_END_DTE, CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME FROM IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX_V JOIN CDD ON CDD_MRN = APR_MRN WHERE CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME = 'PEMBROLIZUMAB') SELECT DISTINCT CDD_MRN AS MRN, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH AS DATE_OF_BIRTH, SSE_SURG_DTE AS DATE_OF_SURGERY FROM CDD JOIN CHEMO ON CDD_MRN =APR_MRN JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PT_MRN = CDD_MRN AND CDD_MRN NOT IN (SELECT AC_MRN FROM IDB.ACCRUALS WHERE AC_IRB_NO = '12-245') JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT ON CDD_MRN = SSE_MRN

prompt: Search pathology reports from 1999-01-01 to 2019-09-10 for specific diagnostic terms for use by Jee Baik
completion: SELECT PRPT_MRN "MRN", PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH "Date of birth", RTRIM(PT_FIRST_NAME) || ', ' || PT_LAST_NAME AS "Patient name", PRPT_REPORT_DTE "Report date", PRPT_REPORT_TYPE "Report type code", PRPT_REPORT_TYPE_DESC "Report type", PRPT_ACCESSION_NO "Accession no", LEFT(PRPT_REPORT, 29000) "Path report", CASE WHEN LOWER(LEFT(PRPT_REPORT, 29000)) like '%marginal zone lymphoma%' OR LOWER(LEFT(PRPT_REPORT, 29000)) like '%malt lymphoma%' OR LOWER(LEFT(PRPT_REPORT, 29000)) like '%amyloidosis%' OR LOWER(LEFT(PRPT_REPORT, 29000)) like '%amyloid%' OR LOWER(LEFT(PRPT_REPORT, 29000)) like '%amyloidoma%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS "Secondary search flag" FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PRPT_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE PRPT_REPORT IS NOT NULL AND LEFT(PRPT_ACCESSION_NO, 1) IN ('H', 'S') AND PRPT_REPORT_DTE BETWEEN '1999-01-01' AND '2019-09-10' AND CONTAINS(PRPT_REPORT, '("pulmonary" | "lung" | "bronchus" | "bronchiole" | "pleura" | "trachea")') = 1;

prompt: Inpatient GYN Surgeries Scheduled Cases Weekly
completion: WITH SRG AS (SELECT OC_MRN AS MRN, TRIM(PT_LAST_NAME) || ', ' || TRIM(PT_FIRST_NAME) AS PATIENT_NAME, OC_SURG_DTE AS SURGERY_DATE, OC_PT_CLASS, OC_CASE_ID AS CASE_ID, OC_PT_CLASS AS PATIENT_TYPE, OC_ADM_DTE AS ADMIT_DATE, TRIM(P.CRE_RES_NAME) AS PROVIDER, TRIM(M.CRE_RES_NAME) AS ROOM, PCE_CASE_CAMPUS, CPX_PROC_CD AS PROCEDURE_CODE, TRIM(CPX_PROC_NAME) AS PROCEDURE_NAME, OC_SURG_SVC AS SERVICE FROM IDB.OR_CASE JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PT_MRN = OC_MRN JOIN IDB.OR_CASE_ALL_PROC ON OC_CASE_ID = OCAP_CASE_ID JOIN IDB.OR_CASE_ALL_SURG ON OCAP_CASE_ID = OCAS_CASE_ID AND OCAS_PNL_NO = OCAP_PNL_NO AND OCAS_SURG_ROLE = 'Primary' JOIN IDB.OR_PROC ON OCAP_OR_PROC_ID = OP_OR_PROC_ID JOIN IDB.OR_CL_PROC ON OP_OR_PROC_ID = OCP_OR_PROC_ID JOIN IDB.CL_PROC ON OCP_PROC_ID = CPX_PROC_ID JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE P ON CRE_RES_ID = OCAS_RES_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE M ON M.CRE_RES_ID = OC_ROOM_RES_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS ON AV_CODE = OC_PT_CLASS AND AV_ELEMENT ='PT_CLASS' LEFT JOIN IDB.PERIOP_CASE_EVENT ON PCE_CASE_NO = OC_CASE_ID WHERE OC_SURG_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT date + 3 DAYS AND CURRENT date + 9 DAYS AND OC_OR_CASE_STS_CD NOT IN ('2', '5') AND OC_SURG_SVC = 'GYN' AND OC_PT_CLASS <> 'OP' AND PCE_CASE_CAMPUS ='MAIN' ) SELECT MRN, PATIENT_NAME, ADMIT_DATE, CASE_ID, PATIENT_TYPE, SURGERY_DATE, CASE WHEN DAYOFWEEK(SURGERY_DATE) = 1 THEN 'Sunday' WHEN DAYOFWEEK(SURGERY_DATE) = 2 THEN 'Monday' WHEN DAYOFWEEK(SURGERY_DATE) = 3 THEN 'Tuesday' WHEN DAYOFWEEK(SURGERY_DATE) = 4 THEN 'Wednesday' WHEN DAYOFWEEK(SURGERY_DATE) = 5 THEN 'Thursday' WHEN DAYOFWEEK(SURGERY_DATE) = 6 THEN 'Friday' WHEN DAYOFWEEK(SURGERY_DATE) = 7 THEN 'Saturday' END AS DAY_OF_WEEK, PCE_CASE_CAMPUS AS CAMPUS, ROOM, SERVICE, LISTAGG (DISTINCT PROVIDER, '~ ') AS SURGEONS, LISTAGG (DISTINCT PROCEDURE_NAME, '~ ') AS PROCEDURES FROM SRG GROUP BY MRN, PATIENT_NAME, ADMIT_DATE, CASE_ID, PATIENT_TYPE, SURGERY_DATE, PCE_CASE_CAMPUS, ROOM, SERVICE ORDER BY SURGERY_DATE ASC

prompt: Provide appointment data for patients who have had more than one completed appointment within a given service out of the following services: GU Med Onc, GI Med Onc, GYN Med Onc, Thoracic Med Onc, Lymphoma, Myeloma, Leukemia and BMT.
completion: WITH APPTS AS (SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN AS MRN, CPE_ENC_DTE AS "Appt Date", CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 AS "Department", CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 AS "Service", CLD_DEPT_NAME AS "Department Name", CRE_RES_NAME AS "Provider Name", CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME AS "Visit Type" , CRE_RES_TYP , CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR , ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CPE_MRN, CRE_RES_NAME, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 ORDER BY CPE_ENC_DTE DESC) RN FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PT_MRN = CPE_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE 1=1 AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 = 'MED' AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 IN ('MYL', 'GU', 'GI', 'LYM', 'THR', 'LEU', 'BMT', 'GMO') AND CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CRE_RES_TYP = 'Physician' AND CPE_ENC_DTE >= '2020-10-11' ) , PTS_QUALIFYING AS (SELECT MRN, "Service", "Provider Name" , COUNT(*) AS NUM_APPTS FROM APPTS GROUP BY MRN, "Service", "Provider Name" HAVING COUNT(*) > 1) SELECT APPTS.* , NUM_APPTS FROM APPTS APPTS JOIN PTS_QUALIFYING QUAL ON QUAL.MRN = APPTS.MRN AND QUAL."Service" = APPTS."Service" AND QUAL."Provider Name" = APPTS."Provider Name" ORDER BY MRN, "Service", "Provider Name"

prompt: Patients Admitted to a Pediatric Department in May and April of 2015
completion: SELECT DISTINCT "t1"."PT_MRN" AS "MRN", "t1"."PT_LAST_NAME" AS "Last Name", "t1"."PT_FIRST_NAME" AS "First Name", "t2"."DT_DTE" AS "Admission Date", "t3"."DT_DTE" AS "Discharge Date", "t4"."HSVC_HOSP_SVC_DESC" AS "Adm Hospital Service" FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V" "t1" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED" "t5" ON "t1"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t5"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."HOSPITAL_STAY" "t6" ON "t5"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t6"."HS_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" "t2" ON "t6"."HS_ADM_DATE_ID" = "t2"."DT_DATE_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" "t3" ON "t6"."HS_DSCH_DATE_ID" = "t3"."DT_DATE_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."COMBINED_ADMISSION_CENSUS_V" "t7" ON "t6"."HS_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t7"."CAC_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AND "t6"."HS_ACCT_NO" = "t7"."CAC_ACCT_NO" LEFT JOIN "DV"."HOSPITAL_SERVICE_V" "t4" ON "t7"."CAC_HOSP_SVC_ID" = "t4"."HSVC_HOSP_SVC_ID" WHERE ("t2"."DT_DTE" BETWEEN '2015-5-1' AND '2015-6-30' AND "t4"."HSVC_HOSP_SVC_DESC" IN ('PEDIATRICS', 'PEDIATRICS - BLUE TEAM', 'PEDIATRICS - GREEN TEAM', 'PEDIATRICS - OBSV UNIT', 'PEDIATRICS - PINK TEAM'))

EFI_ITEM_ALIAS = 'youngwomenbreastcancer_healthinfo_v5.2' THEN EFI_VALUE END) AS "youngwomenbreastcancer_healthinfo_v5.2", MAX(CASE WHEN EFI_ITEM_ALIAS = 'youngwomenbreastcancer_healthinfo_v5.3' THEN EFI_VALUE END) AS "youngwomenbreastcancer_healthinfo_v5.3", MAX(CASE WHEN EFI_ITEM_ALIAS = 'youngwomenbreastcancer_mybody1' THEN EFI_VALUE END) AS "youngwomenbreastcancer_mybody1", MAX(CASE WHEN EFI_ITEM_ALIAS = 'youngwomenbreastcancer_mybody2' THEN EFI_VALUE END) AS "youngwomenbreastcancer_mybody2", MAX(CASE WHEN EFI_ITEM_ALIAS = 'youngwomenbreastcancer_mybody3' THEN EFI_VALUE END) AS "youngwomenbreastcancer_mybody3", MAX(CASE WHEN EFI_ITEM_ALIAS = 'youngwomenbreastcancer_services' THEN EFI_VALUE END) AS "youngwomenbreastcancer_services", MAX(CASE WHEN EFI_ITEM_ALIAS = 'youngwomenbreastcancer_sexualhealth1' THEN EFI_VALUE END) AS "youngwomenbreastcancer_sexualhealth1", MAX(CASE WHEN EFI_ITEM_ALIAS = 'youngwomenbreastcancer_sexualhealth2' THEN EFI_VALUE END) AS "youngwomenbreastcancer_sexualhealth2", MAX(CASE WHEN EFI_ITEM_ALIAS = 'youngwomenbreastcancer_sexualhealth3' THEN EFI_VALUE END) AS "youngwomenbreastcancer_sexualhealth3", MAX(CASE WHEN EFI_ITEM_ALIAS = 'youngwomenbreastcancer_sexualhealth4' THEN EFI_VALUE END) AS "youngwomenbreastcancer_sexualhealth4", MAX(CASE WHEN EFI_ITEM_ALIAS = 'youngwomenbreastcancer_socialworker' THEN EFI_VALUE END) AS "youngwomenbreastcancer_socialworker", MAX(CASE WHEN EFI_ITEM_ALIAS = 'youngwomenbreastcancer_worries' THEN EFI_VALUE END) AS "youngwomenbreastcancer_worries", EF_FORM_NAME AS SURVEY_NAME FROM EF GROUP BY EF_MRN, PATIENT_NAME, EF_SUBMISSION_DT, EF_FORM_NAME ; WITH SRV AS (SELECT EAS_ASSESS_STS, EPI_MRN, EA_SUBM_DT, EA_ASSIGN_DT, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY EPI_MRN, EA_STS_ID ORDER BY EA_ASSIGN_DT) AS RN FROM IDB.EF_ASSESSMENT JOIN IDB.EF_ASSESSMENT_STS ON EA_STS_ID = EAS_ASSESS_STS_ID JOIN IDB.EF_PATIENT_INFO ON EA_PT_INFO_ID = EPI_PT_INFO_ID WHERE EA_SURV_ID = 171 AND EAS_ASSESS_STS NOT IN ('Cancelled') ) SELECT EAS_ASSESS_STS AS SURVEY_STATUS, COUNT(EPI_MRN) NO_OF_SURVEYS, COUNT(DISTINCT EPI_MRN) DISTINCT_PATIENTS FROM SRV WHERE RN =1 GROUP BY EAS_ASSESS_STS ; WITH EF AS (SELECT * FROM (SELECT EF_SUBMISSION_DT, EF_MRN, EF_FORM_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY EF_MRN, EFI_ITEM_ALIAS, EFI_ITEM_TEXT ORDER BY DATE(EF_SUBMISSION_DT) ASC) RN, TRIM(EFI_ITEM_TEXT) AS QUESTION1, TRIM(EFI_ITEM_ALIAS) AS QUESTION_ALIAS, CASE WHEN TRIM(EFI_ITEM_ALIAS) = 'youngwomenbreastcancer_familyhistory_sub1' THEN 'Do you have any blood relatives with a WHEN TRIM(EFI_ITEM_ALIAS) = 'youngwomenbreastcancer_futurechildren5_sub1' THEN 'Have you taken steps to protect your future fertility? Please specify:' ELSE TRIM(EFI_ITEM_TEXT) END AS QUESTION, TRIM(EFI_VALUE) AS PATIENT_RESPONSE FROM IDB.EF_FORM LEFT JOIN IDB.EF_FORM_ITEM ON EF_FORM_ID = EFI_FORM_ID WHERE EF_FORM_ALIAS = 'YoungWomen_with_BreastCancer' AND TRIM(EFI_VALUE) <> '' ) WHERE RN =1 ) SELECT QUESTION_ALIAS, QUESTION, COUNT(EF_MRN) AS COUNT_OF_PTS FROM EF GROUP BY QUESTION_ALIAS, QUESTION ;

prompt: NV/IR patients seen in colorectal service between 1/1/2007 and 12/31/2015 with rectal cancer diagnosis and biopsy performed on the same day.
completion: WITH "cte1" AS (SELECT * FROM DV.ENCOUNTER_SCHD_RESOURCES WHERE ENSR_PRIMARY_RES_IND = 'Y' ), "cte2" AS (SELECT EDC_DEPT_ABBREV, EDC_DEPT_DESC FROM DV.ENCOUNTER_DESC_CATALOG WHERE EDC_GROUP_ID = 'STS' ), "cte3" AS (SELECT DXCC_DX_CATALOG_ID, LTRIM(RTRIM(DXCC_ICD_CODE)) DXCC_ICD_CODE, LTRIM(RTRIM(DXCC_ICD_MSK_DESC)) DXCC_ICD_MSK_DESC, LTRIM(RTRIM(DXCC_ICD_CODE)) || ' - ' || LTRIM(RTRIM(DXCC_ICD_MSK_DESC)) AS DXCC_CODE_AND_MSK_DESC, LTRIM(RTRIM(DXCC_ICD_NATIONAL_DESC)) DXCC_ICD_NATIONAL_DESC, DXCC_DESC_LONG, CASE WHEN (DXCC_DX_TYPE = 'ICD9' AND DXCC_ICD_CODE BETWEEN '196' AND '198.99') OR (DXCC_DX_TYPE = 'ICD10' AND DXCC_ICD_CODE BETWEEN 'C77' AND 'C79.9') THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS DXCC_METS_INDICATOR, DXCC_CREATED_DT, DXCC_CREATED_BY, DXCC_MODIFIED_DT FROM DV.DIAGNOSIS_CATALOG WHERE DXCC_DX_TYPE IN ('ICD9', 'ICD10') ) SELECT DISTINCT "t1"."PT_MRN" AS "MRN", "t2"."DT_DTE" AS "Encounter Date", CASE WHEN "t3"."ENVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR" like '%NV%' THEN 'New Visit' WHEN "t3"."ENVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR" like '%IR%' THEN 'Internal Referral' ELSE 'Non-New Visit/Interal Referral' END AS "New Visit/Internal Referral Indicator", "t4"."ENR_RES_NAME" AS "Primary Resource Name", "t3"."ENVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR" AS "Visit Type Abbrev", "t1"."PT_FIRST_NAME" AS "First Name", "t1"."PT_LAST_NAME" AS "Last Name", "t5"."DT_DTE" AS "ICD-9 First Final Diagnosis Date", "t6"."PRPT_ACCESSION_NO" AS "Pathology Report", "t7"."DT_DTE" AS "Pathology Procedure Date", "t8"."PRO_IRB_NO" AS "IRB Number", "t9"."AC_CONS_DTE" AS "Consent Date", "t9"."AC_OFF_STUDY_DTE" AS "Off Study Date", "t9"."AC_TX_END_DTE" AS "Treatment End Date" FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V" "t1" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED" "t10" ON "t1"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t10"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_ENCOUNTER" "t11" ON "t10"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t11"."PENC_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" "t2" ON "t11"."PENC_ENC_DATE_ID" = "t2"."DT_DATE_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."ENCOUNTER_VISIT_TYPE" "t3" ON "t11"."PENC_VISIT_TYPE_ID" = "t3"."ENVT_ENC_VISIT_TYPE_ID" LEFT JOIN "cte1" "t12" ON "t11"."PENC_PT_ENC_ID" = "t12"."ENSR_PT_ENC_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."ENCOUNTER_RESOURCE" "t4" ON "t12"."ENSR_RES_ID" = "t4"."ENR_ENC_RES_ID" LEFT JOIN "cte2" "t13" ON "t11"."PENC_APPT_STS" = "t13"."EDC_DEPT_ABBREV" LEFT JOIN "DV"."ENCOUNTER_DEPARTMENT" "t14" ON "t11"."PENC_DEPT_ID" = "t14"."ENDP_ENC_DEPT_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DIAGNOSIS_FINAL_ALL_V" "t15" ON "t10"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t15"."PDX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DIAGNOSIS_FINAL_DATES_V" "t16" ON "t15"."PDX_DX_CATALOG_ID" = "t16"."PDX_DX_CATALOG_ID" AND "t15"."PDX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t16"."PDX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" "t5" ON "t16"."FIRST_DIAGNOSIS_DATE_ID" = "t5"."DT_DATE_ID" LEFT JOIN "cte3" "t17" ON "t15"."PDX_DX_CATALOG_ID" = "t17"."DXCC_DX_CATALOG_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V" "t6" ON "t10"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t6"."PRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" "t7" ON "t6"."PRPT_PROCEDURE_DATE_ID" = "t7"."DT_DATE_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATH_RPRT_TYPE_LOOKUP" "t18" ON "t6"."PRPT_REPORT_TYPE" = "t18"."PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_CD" LEFT JOIN "DV"."ACCRUALS" "t9" ON "t10"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t9"."AC_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PROTOCOL" "t8" ON "t9"."AC_PROTOCOL_ID" = "t8"."PRO_PROTOCOL_ID" WHERE (CASE WHEN "t3"."ENVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR" like '%NV%' THEN 'New Visit' WHEN "t3"."ENVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR" like '%IR%' THEN 'Internal Referral' ELSE 'Non-New Visit/Interal Referral' END IN ('Internal Referral', 'New Visit') AND (CASE WHEN "t13"."EDC_DEPT_DESC"IN ('Arrived', 'Completed') THEN 'Completed' WHEN "t13"."EDC_DEPT_DESC" IN ('Scheduled') THEN 'Scheduled' ELSE 'Non-Completed/Scheduled' END = 'Completed' AND ("t14"."ENDP_SERVICE_DEPT_GRP_6" = 'SRG' AND ("t14"."ENDP_SERVICE_SPECIALTY_GRP_8" = 'COL' AND ("t17"."DXCC_ICD_CODE" IN ('C20', '154.1') AND ("t18"."PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_DESC" IN ('Surgical Pathology', 'Surgical Pathology Breast') AND ("t8"."PRO_IRB_NO" = '06-107' AND (("t2"."DT_DTE" BETWEEN '2015-1-1' AND '2015-12-31' AND "t7"."DT_DTE" BETWEEN '2015-1-1' AND '2015-12-31') AND ABS(TIMESTAMPDIFF(16, CHAR(TIMESTAMP("t2"."DT_DTE", '00:00:00') - TIMESTAMP("t7"."DT_DTE", '00:00:00')))) >= 0))))))))

prompt: Provide a list of patients who had an outpatient radiology appointment at all campus' in Manhattan on 2/28/12.
completion: SELECT MRN, PT_NAME, VST_DTE, REF_MD, REF_MD_SVC, DEPT_NAME, CENTER , VST_NAME, VST_TYPE, GRP6, GRP20, ENTER_DATE , ORDID, MODALITY, MODIFIER, RIS_MODIFIED_TO, TEST_NAME , TEST_DATE, REASON_FOR_STUDY, PERT_SIGNS_SYMPTOMS , STUDY_INFO_DESIRED, STS_CD, STS_DESC, ANCIL_REFCD, TIME_PRIORITY , USER_NAME, USER_ROLE, USER_OCCUPATION , REQUESTER_NAME, REQUESTER_ROLE, SVC, VISIT_ATT_NAME , ORD_LOCATION, ORD_SOURCE, ENTRY_FORM, ORD_SUMMARY, ORDGUID FROM (SELECT CPE_MRN MRN , STRIP(PT_LAST_NAME)||', '||STRIP(PT_FIRST_NAME) PT_NAME , CPE_ENC_DTE VST_DTE, REF.CRE_RES_NAME REF_MD, RM.DOC_SVC REF_MD_SVC , CLD_DEPT_NAME DEPT_NAME, CLD_CLD_CENTER CENTER , CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME VST_NAME, CVT_EXT_NAME VST_TYPE , CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 GRP6, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_20 GRP20 , OO_ENTER_DTE ENTER_DATE, OO_ORD_ID ORDID , OO_ORD_NAME MODALITY, OO_ORD_MODIFIER MODIFIER , MD.OUD_USER_DI_VALUE RIS_MODIFIED_TO , REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(UPPER(OO_ORD_MODIFIER), 'OR:C-ARM ', ''), '-ULTRASOUND GUIDED', ''), 'LOWER', 'LWR'), 'PORTABLE', 'PORT'), 'BIOPSY', 'BX') MODIF , SUBSTR(STRIP(CASE WHEN MD.OUD_USER_DI_VALUE IS NOT NULL THEN MD.OUD_USER_DI_VALUE ELSE STRIP(OO_ORD_NAME)||' '|| COALESCE(CR.OUD_USER_DI_VALUE, OO_ORD_MODIFIER) END), 1, 155) AS TEST_NAME , OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE TEST_DATE , RFS.OUD_USER_DI_VALUE REASON_FOR_STUDY , RSS.OUD_USER_DI_VALUE PERT_SIGNS_SYMPTOMS , RID.OUD_USER_DI_VALUE STUDY_INFO_DESIRED , OO_ORD_STS_CD STS_CD, OSTS_STS_DESC STS_DESC , OO_ANCIL_REF_CD ANCIL_REFCD, OO_REQ_TME_PRIO TIME_PRIORITY , USR.OU_DISPLAY_NAME USER_NAME, OO_ENTER_ROLE USER_ROLE , USR.OU_OCCUPATION USER_OCCUPATION, PVD.OU_DISPLAY_NAME REQUESTER_NAME , PVD.OU_ORD_ROLE_TYPE REQUESTER_ROLE, RQ.DOC_SVC SVC , CASE WHEN PVD.OU_ORD_ROLE_TYPE <> 'Attending' AND PVD.OU_DISPLAY_NAME <> OCV_PVDR_NAME THEN OCV_PVDR_NAME END AS VISIT_ATT_NAME , OCV_CURR_LOC ORD_LOCATION, OO_ORD_SOURCE ORD_SOURCE , OEF_FORM_NAME ENTRY_FORM , OO_SUMMARY_LINE ORD_SUMMARY, OO_ORD_GUID ORDGUID , OO_PERFORMED_DTE, OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE , CASE WHEN OO_ORD_NAME = 'BI IR Breast' AND CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME LIKE '%ASP/FNA%' THEN 'Y' WHEN OO_ORD_NAME = 'XR' AND CVT_EXT_NAME = 'X-Ray' THEN 'Y' WHEN REPLACE(UPPER(OO_ORD_NAME), 'CARDIAC', '') = SUBSTR(CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME, 1, LENGTH(STRIP(REPLACE(UPPER(OO_ORD_NAME), 'CARDIAC', '')))) AND CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME NOT LIKE '%ASP/FNA%' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END MATCH_IND , CASE WHEN OO_REQ_DR_NO = CPE_REF_RES_ID OR CPE_REF_RES_ID = OCV_ATT_DR_NO THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END REQ_MATCH , CASE WHEN RM.DOC_SVC = RQ.DOC_SVC THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END SVC_MATCH FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_1 <> 'REG' AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 IN ('RAD', 'NUC', 'GDC') JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE VST ON VST.CRE_RES_ID = CPE_VST_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE REF ON REF.CRE_RES_ID = CPE_REF_RES_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.DOC RM ON RM.DOC_DR_NO = CPE_REF_RES_ID AND RM.DOC_SOURCE_DESC = 'SMS' JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID = CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID AND CVT_EXT_NAME <> 'Injection' JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PT_MRN = CPE_MRN JOIN IDB.OMS_ORDER ON OO_MRN = CPE_MRN AND OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE = CPE_ENC_DTE JOIN IDB.OMS_STATUS ON OO_ORD_STS_CD = OSTS_ORD_STS_CD JOIN IDB.OMS_CLIENT_VISIT ON OCV_VISIT_GUID = OO_VISIT_GUID AND OCV_IP_OP_IND = 'O' JOIN IDB.DOC RQ ON RQ.DOC_DR_NO = OO_REQ_DR_NO AND RQ.DOC_SOURCE_DESC = 'SMS' JOIN IDB.OMS_USER USR ON OO_USER_GUID = USR.OU_USER_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_USER PVD ON PVD.OU_USER_GUID = OO_PVDR_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_ENTRY_FORM ON OEF_ENTRY_FRM_GUID = OO_ENTRY_FRM_GUID AND OEF_FORM_NAME NOT IN ('RIS_Submitted', 'RIS_IR - Referral', 'Rad Outside') LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_USER_DATA CR ON CR.OUD_ORD_GUID = OO_ORD_GUID AND CR.OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'RIS_Order - Current' LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_USER_DATA MD ON MD.OUD_ORD_GUID = OO_ORD_GUID AND MD.OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'RIS_Order - Modified' LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_USER_DATA RFS ON RFS.OUD_ORD_GUID = OO_ORD_GUID AND RFS.OUD_USER_DI_CD LIKE 'RIS_%Reason For Study%' LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_USER_DATA RSS ON RSS.OUD_ORD_GUID = OO_ORD_GUID AND RSS.OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'RIS_Pert/Signs/Symptoms' LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_USER_DATA RID ON RID.OUD_ORD_GUID = OO_ORD_GUID AND RID.OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'RIS_Info Desired From Study' WHERE CPE_ENC_DTE = '2012-02-28' AND OO_CREATE_BY NOT LIKE '%interface%' AND CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Comp', 'Arrived') AND CPE_ENC_TYP_CD = 50 AND OO_ORD_STS_CD IN ('PERF', 'RESC', 'RESF', 'AUC1', 'COMP') AND OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID IN (SELECT OOC_MSTR_ITEM_GUID FROM IDB.OMS_ORD_CATALOG WHERE OOC_REV_CAT_DEPT = 'Radiology') ) CIS WHERE(REQ_MATCH = 'Y' OR(SVC_MATCH = 'Y' AND MATCH_IND = 'Y')) AND CASE WHEN SUBSTR(VST_NAME, 1, 5) = SUBSTR(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(UPPER(TEST_NAME), 'CARDIAC', ''), '/', ' '), '-', ' '), 1, 5) THEN 'Y' WHEN LOCATE(SUBSTR(VST_NAME, 1, 5), REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(UPPER(TEST_NAME), 'CARDIAC', ''), '/', ' '), '-', ' ')) > 0 THEN 'Y' WHEN LOCATE(UPPER(STRIP(MODIFIER)), UPPER(VST_NAME)) > 0 OR LOCATE(STRIP(SUBSTR(MODIF, 1, 7)), UPPER(VST_NAME)) > 0 THEN 'Y' WHEN VST_NAME LIKE '%CISTERNOG%' AND UPPER(TEST_NAME) LIKE '%CISTERNOG%' THEN 'Y' WHEN VST_NAME LIKE '%CH%ABD%PEL%' AND(UPPER(TEST_NAME) LIKE '%CAP %' OR UPPER(TEST_NAME) LIKE '%CH%ABD%PEL%') THEN 'Y' WHEN VST_NAME LIKE '%FOR STORAGE%' AND UPPER(TEST_NAME) LIKE '%FOR STORAGE%' THEN 'Y' WHEN VST_NAME LIKE '%VEIN%' AND UPPER(TEST_NAME) LIKE '%VEIN%' THEN 'Y' WHEN VST_NAME LIKE '%HEPAT%' AND UPPER(TEST_NAME) LIKE '%LIVER%' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END = 'Y'

prompt: Provide the full mailing address on the specified patients for a study on social determinants of health.
