prompt: Provide demographic, tumor, and pathology data for patients diagnosed with DSRCT.
completion: WITH "cte1" AS (SELECT TEXTTABLE.*, CONTAINS("PRPT_REPORT", '("Desmoplastic Small Round Cell Tumor" | ' || '"DSRCT")') AS "HitCol1" FROM "DV"."PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V" TEXTTABLE) SELECT DISTINCT "t1"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AS "Deident PT #", "t2"."PT_MRN" AS "MRN", "t2"."PT_BIRTH_DTE" AS "Date of Birth", "t2"."PT_DEATH_DTE" AS "Deceased Date", "t3"."DT_DTE" AS "Tumor Diagnosis Date", "t4"."DXCC_ICD_CODE" AS "ICD-O Histology Code", "t4"."DXCC_ICD_MSK_DESC" AS "ICD-O Histology Description", YEAR("t3"."DT_DTE" - "t5"."DT_DTE") AS "Age at Tumor Diagnosis Date - years", "t6"."ICSC_SITE_CD" AS "ICD-O Site Code", "t6"."ICSC_ICDO_SITE_MSK_DESC" AS "ICD-O Site Description", "t7"."PRPT_ACCESSION_NO" AS "Pathology Report", "t8"."DT_DTE" AS "Pathology Procedure Date", "t9"."DT_DTE" AS "Pathology Report Date" FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED" "t1" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V" "t2" ON "t1"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t2"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" "t5" ON "t2"."PT_BIRTH_DTE" = "t5"."DT_DTE" LEFT JOIN "DV"."CDB_TUMOR_V" "t10" ON "t1"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t10"."CDTM_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" "t3" ON "t10"."CDTM_DX_DATE_ID" = "t3"."DT_DATE_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DIAGNOSIS_CODE_CAT_ICDO_V" "t4" ON "t10"."CDTM_DX_CATALOG_ID" = "t4"."DXCC_DX_CATALOG_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."ICDO_SITE_CATALOG_V" "t6" ON "t10"."CDTM_SITE_CATALOG_ID" = "t6"."ICSC_SITE_CATALOG_ID" LEFT JOIN "cte1" "t7" ON "t1"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t7"."PRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" "t8" ON "t7"."PRPT_PROCEDURE_DATE_ID" = "t8"."DT_DATE_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" "t9" ON "t7"."PRPT_REPORT_DATE_ID" = "t9"."DT_DATE_ID" WHERE ("t4"."DXCC_ICD_CODE" IN ('M8806/3') OR "t7"."HitCol1" <> 0)

prompt: Provide a list of "Anaplastic large cell lymphoma" cases with any of these terms in the final diagnosis top line: "CD30" and "T-cell lymphoma", "CD30" and "T cell lymphoma", "CD30" and "lymphoproliferative disorder", "anaplastic large cell lymphoma" from 01/2011 to present.
completion: WITH X AS (SELECT DISTINCT "t1"."PT_MRN" AS "MRN", PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_BIRTH_DTE AS DOB, "t2"."PRPT_ACCESSION_NO" AS "Pathology Report", "t3"."PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_DESC" AS "Pathology Report Type", "t4"."DT_DTE" AS "Pathology Procedure Date", UPPER(CASE WHEN LENGTH(PRPT_REPORT) <= 18000 THEN RTRIM(CAST(SUBSTR(PRPT_REPORT, 1, 18000) AS VARCHAR(18000))) ELSE CAST(SUBSTR(PRPT_REPORT, 1, 18000) AS VARCHAR(18000)) END) AS TXT, UPPER(DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)DIAGNOSIS:[\w\W]*(?=COMMENT:)', UPPER(PRPT_REPORT))) AS "DIAGNOSIS1", UPPER(DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)DIAGNOSIS:[\w\W]*(?=NOTE:)', UPPER(PRPT_REPORT))) AS "DIAGNOSIS2", UPPER(DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)DIAGNOSIS:[\w\W]*(?=MORPHOLOGY)', UPPER(PRPT_REPORT))) AS "DIAGNOSIS3", UPPER(DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)DIAGNOSIS:[\w\W]*(?=I ATTEST)', UPPER(PRPT_REPORT))) AS "DIAGNOSIS4" FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V" "t1" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED" "t6" ON "t1"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t6"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V" "t2" ON "t6"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t2"."PRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATH_RPRT_TYPE_LOOKUP" "t3" ON "t2"."PRPT_REPORT_TYPE" = "t3"."PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_CD" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" "t4" ON "t2"."PRPT_PROCEDURE_DATE_ID" = "t4"."DT_DATE_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" "t5" ON "t2"."PRPT_REPORT_DATE_ID" = "t5"."DT_DATE_ID" WHERE 1=1 AND CONTAINS("t2"."PRPT_REPORT", '(("CD30" & "T-cell lymphoma") | ("CD30" & "T cell lymphoma") | ("CD30" & "lymphoproliferative disorder") | "anaplastic large cell lymphoma")') = 1 AND "t2"."PRPT_REPORT" IS NOT NULL AND "t4"."DT_DTE" >= '2011-01-01' AND("t2"."PRPT_ACCESSION_NO" LIKE 'H%' OR "t2"."PRPT_ACCESSION_NO" LIKE 'S%') ) , Y AS (SELECT "MRN", PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, DOB, "Pathology Report", "Pathology Report Type", "Pathology Procedure Date", TXT, CASE WHEN "DIAGNOSIS1" <> '' THEN "DIAGNOSIS1" WHEN "DIAGNOSIS2" <> '' THEN "DIAGNOSIS2" WHEN "DIAGNOSIS3" <> '' THEN "DIAGNOSIS3" WHEN "DIAGNOSIS4" <> '' THEN "DIAGNOSIS4" END AS "DIAGNOSIS:" FROM X) SELECT * FROM Y WHERE(UPPER(TXT) LIKE '%CD30%' AND UPPER(TXT) LIKE '%T%CELL%LYMPHOMA%') OR(UPPER(TXT) LIKE '%CD30%' AND UPPER(TXT) LIKE '%LYMPHOPROLIFERATIVE DISORDER%') OR UPPER(TXT) LIKE '%ANAPLASTIC LARGE CELL LYMPHOMA%'

prompt: Design a monthly report to help determine the volume and timing of patient care encounters for the inpatient dietitians.
completion: SELECT DISTINCT STRIP(CDD_MRN) AS CDD_MRN, OS_SVC_GRP_CD, OS_SVC_DESC, DATE(OCV_ADM_DT) AS ADM_DATE, DATE(OCV_DSCH_DT) AS DSCH_DATE, CDD_DOC_GUID, STRIP(CDD_DOC_NAME) AS CDD_DOC_NAME, CDD_SERVICE_DTE, CDD_SERVICE_DT, STRIP(OU_DISPLAY_NAME) AS "Electronic Signature", STRIP(CDO_VALUE_TEXT) AS RISK_LEVEL FROM IDB.CD_DOCUMENT LEFT JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION ON CDO_DOC_GUID = CDD_DOC_GUID AND CDO_AUTHORED_DTE = CDD_AUTHORED_DTE AND CDO_ITEM_NAME = 'Risk Level:' JOIN IDB.OMS_USER ON CDD_AUTH_PROV_GUID = OU_USER_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_CLIENT_VISIT ON OCV_VISIT_GUID = CDD_VISIT_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_SERVICE ON OCV_SVC_GUID = OS_SVC_GUID WHERE CDD_CANCEL_IND = '0' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND = '0' AND CDD_DOC_NAME = 'Initial Assessment - Nutrition' AND CDD_SERVICE_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT DATE - (DAY(CURRENT DATE) - 1) DAYS - 1 MONTH AND CURRENT DATE - (DAY(CURRENT DATE)) DAYS

prompt: Provide a list of patients with Pediatric Surgery notes and indicate time spent with providers
completion: WITH RAW AS (SELECT CDD_MRN MRN, PT_LAST_NAME LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME FIRST_NAME, CDD_DOC_GUID, CASE WHEN CDD_CANCEL_IND = 1 THEN 'CANCELLED' END CANCEL_IND, CASE WHEN CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND = 1 THEN 'INCOMPLETE' END INCOMPLETE_IND, CDD_SERVICE_DTE SERVICE_DATE, CDD_DOC_NAME DOCUMENT_NAME, OP_DISPLAY_NAME PROVIDER, CDO_SECTION SECTION, CDO_ITEM_NAME ITEM, CDO_VALUE_TEXT ITEM_VALUE FROM IDB.CD_DOCUMENT LEFT JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION ON CDD_DOC_GUID = CDO_DOC_GUID AND CDO_VALUE_TEXT <> '' JOIN IDB.OMS_PROVIDER ON CDD_AUTH_PROV_GUID = OP_PVDR_GUID JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON CDD_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE 1=1 AND CDD_DOC_NAME IN ('Follow Up - PACC Surgery', 'Initial Visit - PACC Surgery', 'Progress Note - Pediatric Surgery', 'Admission Note - Pediatric Surgery', 'Initial Consultation - Pediatric Surgery', 'Follow Up Consultation - Pediatric Surgery-Pediatric Surgery') AND (CDO_SECTION = 'TIME SPENT' OR UPPER(CDO_ITEM_NAME) like '%TIME SPENT%' OR CDO_ITEM_NAME = 'Performed in:') AND CDD_SERVICE_DTE BETWEEN '2022-04-01' AND '2023-03-31' ) SELECT R.MRN, LAST_NAME, FIRST_NAME, SERVICE_DATE, MAX(CASE WHEN ITEM IN ('Performed in:') THEN R.ITEM_VALUE END) LOCATION, DOCUMENT_NAME, CANCEL_IND, INCOMPLETE_IND, PROVIDER, MAX(CASE WHEN ITEM IN ('NP/PA Time Spent min', 'Time Spent - Total Time APP min') THEN R.ITEM_VALUE END) NP_APP_TIME, MAX(CASE WHEN ITEM IN ('Attending Time Spent min', 'Time Spent - Total Time Attending min') THEN R.ITEM_VALUE END) MD_TIME, MAX(CASE WHEN ITEM IN ('Telephone Time Spent:') THEN R.ITEM_VALUE END) PHONE_TIME, MAX(CASE WHEN ITEM IN ('Time Spent') THEN R.ITEM_VALUE END) TOTAL_TIME FROM RAW R GROUP BY R.MRN, LAST_NAME, FIRST_NAME, R.CDD_DOC_GUID, SERVICE_DATE, DOCUMENT_NAME, CANCEL_IND, INCOMPLETE_IND, PROVIDER

prompt: Provide list of patients and their eRFA status
completion: WITH ORDERS AS (SELECT DISTINCT OO_MRN, OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE FROM IDB.OMS_ORDER JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_CATALOG ON OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID = OOC_MSTR_ITEM_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_STATUS ON OO_ORD_STS_CD = OSTS_ORD_STS_CD WHERE OOC_ITEM_NAME IN ('Geriatric Outpatient Consult') AND OO_ORD_STS_CD NOT IN ('CANP', 'CANC', 'AUC3') ) , MSK_ENGAGE AS (SELECT EF_MRN, DATE(EF_SUBMISSION_DT) EF_SUBMISSION_DTE, MAX(CASE WHEN ENCV_NAME = 'ADL' THEN ENCV_VALUE END) "ADL", MAX(CASE WHEN ENCV_NAME = 'Depression' THEN ENCV_VALUE END) "Depression", MAX(CASE WHEN ENCV_NAME = 'iADL' THEN ENCV_VALUE END) "iADL", MAX(CASE WHEN ENCV_NAME = 'Limited Social Activity' THEN ENCV_VALUE END) "Limited Social Activity", MAX(CASE WHEN ENCV_NAME = 'Social Support' THEN ENCV_VALUE END) "Social Support" FROM IDB.EF_FORM JOIN IDB.ENAR_CALC_VALUE ON EF_FORM_EXTERNAL_ID = ENCV_ASSESSMENT_ID WHERE EF_FORM_NAME = 'Electronic Rapid Fitness Assessment (eRFA)' AND ENCV_NAME IN ('ADL', 'Depression', 'iADL', 'Limited Social Activity', 'Social Support') GROUP BY EF_MRN, DATE(EF_SUBMISSION_DT) ) SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN AS "MRN", CPE_ENC_DTE AS "Appt Date", CLD_DEPT_NAME AS "Department Name", CRE_RES_NAME AS "Provider Name", CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME AS "Visit Type", EF_SUBMISSION_DTE "eRFA Submission Date", "ADL", "Depression", "iADL", "Limited Social Activity", "Social Support", OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE "Geriatric Outpatient Consult Date" FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID LEFT JOIN ORDERS ON CPE_MRN = OO_MRN LEFT JOIN MSK_ENGAGE ON CPE_MRN = EF_MRN WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CPE_ENC_DTE >= '2019-05-01' AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 = 'BMT' AND CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME IN ('BMTMED IR', 'BMTMED NV')

prompt: Provide weekly list of patients scheduled for prostate biopsies along with lab appointment and 06-107 enrollment data.
completion: WITH BX_APPTS AS (SELECT CPE_MRN AS "MRN", CPE_ENC_DTE AS "Appt Date", CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 AS "Department", CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 AS "Service", CLD_DEPT_NAME AS "Department Name", CRE_RES_NAME AS "Provider Name", CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME AS "Visit Type", CLD_CLD_CENTER, CLD_CLD_PHY_LOC FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Sch') AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT date AND CURRENT date + 30 DAYS AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 = 'SRG' AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 = 'URO' AND CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME like '%BX%' ) , LAB_APPTS AS (SELECT CPE_MRN AS "MRN", CPE_ENC_DTE AS "Appt Date", CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 AS "Department", CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 AS "Service", CLD_DEPT_NAME AS "Department Name", CRE_RES_NAME AS "Provider Name", CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME AS "Visit Type" FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Sch') AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT date AND CURRENT date + 30 DAYS AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 = 'LAB' ) , PROTOCOL AS (SELECT PRO_IRB_NO, PRO_IRB_TITLE, PRO_IRB_STS, PRO_PROTOCOL_TYPE, AC_MRN, AC_NON_MSK_INST, AC_LAST_NAME, AC_FIRST_NAME, AC_PVDR_OF_RECORD_NAME, ACD_REG_DTE, ACD_TX_ST_DTE, ACD_TX_END_DTE, ACD_OFF_STUDY_DTE, ACD_CONS_DTE FROM IDB.PROTOCOL JOIN IDB.ACCRUALS ON PRO_IRB_NO = AC_IRB_NO JOIN IDB.ACCRUALS_DATES ON AC_IRB_NO = ACD_IRB_NO AND AC_SUBJ_ID_NO = ACD_SUBJ_ID_NO AND AC_SUBJ_SEQ_NO = ACD_SUBJ_SEQ_NO WHERE PRO_IRB_NO = '06-107' ) SELECT A."MRN", A."Appt Date", A."Department", A."Service", A."Department Name", A."Provider Name", A."Visit Type", A.CLD_CLD_CENTER "Location", B."Appt Date" "Lab Appt Dte", B."Provider Name" "Lab Provider Name", CASE WHEN A."Appt Date" = B."Appt Date" THEN 'Same Date' ELSE 'Different/Missing Date' END AS "Date Indicator", ACD_CONS_DTE "06-107 Consent Date", ACD_OFF_STUDY_DTE "06-107 Off Study Date" FROM BX_APPTS A LEFT JOIN LAB_APPTS B ON A."MRN" = B."MRN" LEFT JOIN PROTOCOL ON A."MRN" = AC_MRN ;

prompt: Patients with past appointments and no future appointment with Dr. John Mulhall, NP Joseph Narus, NP Raffi Bashlian, NP Andrea Martelli or Dr. Mulhall's Nurse.
completion: SELECT DISTINCT CRE_RES_NAME, A.CPE_MRN AS MRN, MAXDATE , CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, PT_DEATH_IND, AV_DESC , PT_LAST_NAME AS LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME AS FIRST_NAME FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER A JOIN (SELECT CPE_MRN, B.CPE_VST_RES_ID, MAX(CPE_ENC_DTE) AS MAXDATE FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER B JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_VST_RES_ID IN ('011080', '080127', '080630', '081174', '8808') AND CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN '2000-01-01' AND CURRENT DATE GROUP BY CPE_MRN, B.CPE_VST_RES_ID) AS X ON A.CPE_MRN = X.CPE_MRN AND A.CPE_VST_RES_ID = X.CPE_VST_RES_ID AND MAXDATE = CPE_ENC_DTE JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON A.CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PT_MRN = A.CPE_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS ON AV_CODE = PT_DEATH_IND AND AV_ELEMENT = 'DEATH_IND' WHERE A.CPE_VST_RES_ID IN ('011080', '080127', '080630', '081174', '8808') AND A.CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND A.CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN '2000-01-01' AND CURRENT DATE AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER F WHERE F.CPE_MRN = A.CPE_MRN AND F.CPE_VST_RES_ID IN ('011080', '080127', '080630', '081174', '8808') AND F.CPE_ENC_DTE > CURRENT DATE AND F.CPE_CPE_APPT_STS = 'Sch')

prompt: Complete list of all patients with Chronic Lymphocytic Leukemia and Xanthogranuloma (ICD-10: C91.10 and D76.3) from 1/1/2002 to 12/31/2022
completion: WITH DIAGNOSIS_0 AS (SELECT DISTINCT PT_DEID, PT_MRN, SUBJECT_ID, ICD_CODES_ICD_CODE, ICD_CODES_ICD_CODE_DESC FROM (SELECT "DV"."PATIENT_DIAGNOSIS_FINAL_ALL_V"."PDX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AS PT_DEID, "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_MRN" AS PT_MRN, CAST(TRIM("DV"."PATIENT_DIAGNOSIS_FINAL_ALL_V"."PDX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID") AS VARCHAR) || CAST(TRIM("DV"."PATIENT_DIAGNOSIS_FINAL_ALL_V"."PDX_DX_CATALOG_ID") AS VARCHAR) AS SUBJECT_ID, TRIM(ICD_CODE_DESC."DXCC_ICD_CODE") AS ICD_CODES_ICD_CODE, TRIM(ICD_CODE_DESC."DXCC_ICD_CODE") || '-' || TRIM(ICD_CODE_DESC."DXCC_ICD_MSK_DESC") AS ICD_CODES_ICD_CODE_DESC FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DIAGNOSIS_FINAL_ALL_V" JOIN "DV"."DIAGNOSIS_CATALOG" AS ICD_CODE_DESC ON "DV"."PATIENT_DIAGNOSIS_FINAL_ALL_V"."PDX_DX_CATALOG_ID" = ICD_CODE_DESC."DXCC_DX_CATALOG_ID" JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" AS DIAGNOSIS_DATE ON "DV"."PATIENT_DIAGNOSIS_FINAL_ALL_V"."PDX_DX_DATE_ID" = DIAGNOSIS_DATE."DT_DATE_ID" JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS" ON "DV"."PATIENT_DIAGNOSIS_FINAL_ALL_V"."PDX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" GROUP BY "DV"."PATIENT_DIAGNOSIS_FINAL_ALL_V"."PDX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID", "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_MRN", CAST(TRIM("DV"."PATIENT_DIAGNOSIS_FINAL_ALL_V"."PDX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID") AS VARCHAR) || CAST(TRIM("DV"."PATIENT_DIAGNOSIS_FINAL_ALL_V"."PDX_DX_CATALOG_ID") AS VARCHAR), ICD_CODE_DESC."DXCC_ICD_CODE", ICD_CODE_DESC."DXCC_ICD_MSK_DESC") WHERE ICD_CODES_ICD_CODE IN ('C91.10', 'D76.3')), COHORT AS (SELECT PT_DEID AS PT_DEID FROM (SELECT DIAGNOSIS_0.PT_DEID AS PT_DEID FROM DIAGNOSIS_0)), COHORT_DIAGNOSIS AS (SELECT SUBJECT_ID AS SUBJECT_ID, PT_DEID AS PT_DEID FROM (SELECT DIAGNOSIS_0.SUBJECT_ID AS SUBJECT_ID, DIAGNOSIS_0.PT_DEID AS PT_DEID FROM DIAGNOSIS_0)), KEYS AS (SELECT COHORT.PT_DEID AS COHORT_PT_DEID, COHORT_DIAGNOSIS.SUBJECT_ID AS COHORT_DIAGNOSIS_SUBJECT_ID, COHORT_DIAGNOSIS.PT_DEID AS COHORT_DIAGNOSIS_PT_DEID FROM COHORT LEFT OUTER JOIN COHORT_DIAGNOSIS ON COHORT_DIAGNOSIS.PT_DEID = COHORT.PT_DEID), DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS AS (SELECT DISTINCT "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AS PT_DEID, "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_MRN" AS PT_MRN, "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AS SUBJECT_ID FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"), DIAGNOSIS_COLUMNS AS (SELECT DISTINCT PT_DEID, PT_MRN, SUBJECT_ID, DIAGNOSIS_DATE, ICD_CODES_ICD_CODE, ICD_CODES_ICD_CODE_DESC, AGE_AT_ICD_CODE_DATE FROM (SELECT "DV"."PATIENT_DIAGNOSIS_FINAL_ALL_V"."PDX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AS PT_DEID, "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_MRN" AS PT_MRN, CAST(TRIM("DV"."PATIENT_DIAGNOSIS_FINAL_ALL_V"."PDX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID") AS VARCHAR) || CAST(TRIM("DV"."PATIENT_DIAGNOSIS_FINAL_ALL_V"."PDX_DX_CATALOG_ID") AS VARCHAR) AS SUBJECT_ID, MIN(DIAGNOSIS_DATE."DT_DTE") AS DIAGNOSIS_DATE, TRIM(ICD_CODE_DESC."DXCC_ICD_CODE") AS ICD_CODES_ICD_CODE, TRIM(ICD_CODE_DESC."DXCC_ICD_CODE") || '-' || TRIM(ICD_CODE_DESC."DXCC_ICD_MSK_DESC") AS ICD_CODES_ICD_CODE_DESC, YEAR(MIN(DIAGNOSIS_DATE."DT_DTE") - MIN("DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_BIRTH_DTE")) AS AGE_AT_ICD_CODE_DATE FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DIAGNOSIS_FINAL_ALL_V" JOIN "DV"."DIAGNOSIS_CATALOG" AS ICD_CODE_DESC ON "DV"."PATIENT_DIAGNOSIS_FINAL_ALL_V"."PDX_DX_CATALOG_ID" = ICD_CODE_DESC."DXCC_DX_CATALOG_ID" JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" AS DIAGNOSIS_DATE ON "DV"."PATIENT_DIAGNOSIS_FINAL_ALL_V"."PDX_DX_DATE_ID" = DIAGNOSIS_DATE."DT_DATE_ID" JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS" ON "DV"."PATIENT_DIAGNOSIS_FINAL_ALL_V"."PDX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" GROUP BY "DV"."PATIENT_DIAGNOSIS_FINAL_ALL_V"."PDX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID", "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_MRN", CAST(TRIM("DV"."PATIENT_DIAGNOSIS_FINAL_ALL_V"."PDX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID") AS VARCHAR) || CAST(TRIM("DV"."PATIENT_DIAGNOSIS_FINAL_ALL_V"."PDX_DX_CATALOG_ID") AS VARCHAR), ICD_CODE_DESC."DXCC_ICD_CODE", ICD_CODE_DESC."DXCC_ICD_MSK_DESC", ICD_CODE_DESC."DXCC_ICD_CODE", ICD_CODE_DESC."DXCC_ICD_MSK_DESC")) SELECT DISTINCT DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS.PT_MRN AS MRN, DIAGNOSIS_COLUMNS.DIAGNOSIS_DATE AS DIAGNOSIS_DATE, DIAGNOSIS_COLUMNS.ICD_CODES_ICD_CODE AS ICD_CODE, DIAGNOSIS_COLUMNS.ICD_CODES_ICD_CODE_DESC AS ICD_CODE_DESCRIPTION, DIAGNOSIS_COLUMNS.AGE_AT_ICD_CODE_DATE AS AGE_AT_ICD_CODE_DATE FROM KEYS LEFT OUTER JOIN DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS ON DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS.PT_DEID = KEYS.COHORT_PT_DEID LEFT OUTER JOIN DIAGNOSIS_COLUMNS ON DIAGNOSIS_COLUMNS.SUBJECT_ID = KEYS.COHORT_DIAGNOSIS_SUBJECT_ID;

prompt: Identify all GBM patients diagnosed between 1998 and 2010 and treated here, and provide their diagnosis date and death date (if applicable).
completion: SELECT DISTINCT "t1"."PT_MRN" AS "MRN", "t1"."PT_LAST_NAME" AS "Last Name", "t1"."PT_FIRST_NAME" AS "First Name", "t1"."PT_SEX" AS "Gender", "t1"."PT_BIRTH_DTE" AS "Date of Birth", "t1"."PT_DEATH_DTE" AS "Deceased Date", "t2"."DT_DTE" AS "CDB Tumor Diagnosis Date", "t3"."TCA_CLASS_OF_CASE" AS "Class of Case", "t4"."DXCC_ICD_CODE" AS "ICD-O Histology Code", "t4"."DXCC_ICD_MSK_DESC" AS "ICD-O Histology Desc", "t5"."ICSC_SITE_CD" AS "ICD-O Site Code", "t5"."ICSC_ICDO_SITE_MSK_DESC" AS "ICD-O Site Desc", "t6"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AS "Deident PT #" FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED" "t6" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V" "t1" ON "t6"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t1"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."CDB_TUMOR_V" "t7" ON "t6"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t7"."CDTM_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE" "t2" ON "t7"."CDTM_DX_DATE_ID" = "t2"."DT_DATE_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."TUMOR_CASE_ATTRIBUTES" "t3" ON "t7"."CDTM_CASE_ATTR_ID" = "t3"."TUMOR_CASE_ATTR_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DIAGNOSIS_CODE_CAT_ICDO_V" "t4" ON "t7"."CDTM_DX_CATALOG_ID" = "t4"."DXCC_DX_CATALOG_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."ICDO_SITE_CATALOG_V" "t5" ON "t7"."CDTM_SITE_CATALOG_ID" = "t5"."ICSC_SITE_CATALOG_ID" WHERE ("t3"."TCA_CASE_STS_DESC" IN ('Completed ') AND ("t3"."TCA_CLASS_OF_CASE" IN ('Dx elsewhere tx here ', 'Dx elsewhere Tx here ', 'Dx here tx here ') AND ("t4"."DXCC_ICD_CODE" IN ('M9440/3') AND "t2"."DT_DTE" BETWEEN '1998-1-1' AND '2010-12-31')))

prompt: List of patients with pathology confirmed ACTH tumor based on pathology report text search.
completion: WITH CTE AS (SELECT PRPT_MRN "MRN", H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS HIST_DESC, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_DESC, PRPT_REPORT "Path Report" FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V LEFT JOIN IDB.CDB_TUMOR ON TM_MRN = PRPT_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD LEFT JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD WHERE CONTAINS(PRPT_REPORT, '"ACTH"&"STAIN"&"POSITIVE"') = 1 OR CONTAINS(PRPT_REPORT, '"STAIN"&"ACTH%"&"POSITIVE"') = 1 OR CONTAINS(PRPT_REPORT, '"POSITIVE"&"ACTH%"') = 1 OR CONTAINS(PRPT_REPORT, '"STAIN"&"ACTH"') = 1 ) , PRO AS (SELECT AC_MRN, AC_IRB_NO FROM CTE JOIN IDB.ACCRUALS ON "MRN" = AC_MRN) , PROSUMMARY AS (SELECT AC_MRN, LISTAGG(AC_IRB_NO) "Protocols" FROM PRO GROUP BY AC_MRN)

prompt: Provide a list of pediatric patients who had an inpatient or outpatient encounter in 2019 or 2020 with psych providers, Dr. Marie Barnett, Dr. Laura Cimini, Dr. Megan Gilman, Dr. Julia Kearney and Dr. Meredith MacGregor.
completion: WITH CPE AS (SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN AS MRN, STRIP(PT_LAST_NAME) || ', ' || STRIP(PT_FIRST_NAME) AS NAME, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH AS DOB, YEAR(CPE_ENC_DTE) AS YR, CPE_ENC_DTE, YEAR(CPE_ENC_DTE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) AS AGE, CRE_RES_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CPE_MRN, YEAR(CPE_ENC_DTE) ORDER BY CPE_ENC_DTE DESC) AS RN FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON CPE_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CRE_RES_TYP IN ('Physician') AND YEAR(CPE_ENC_DTE) IN (2019, 2020) AND CRE_RES_ID IN ('013854', '026419', '023093', '026260', '020875') AND YEAR(CPE_ENC_DTE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) <= 21 ) SELECT * FROM CPE WHERE RN = 1 WITH CDD AS (SELECT DISTINCT CDD_MRN AS MRN, STRIP(PT_LAST_NAME) || ', ' || STRIP(PT_FIRST_NAME) AS NAME, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH AS DOB, YEAR(CDD_SERVICE_DTE) AS YR, CDD_SERVICE_DTE, YEAR(CDD_SERVICE_DTE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) AS AGE, CDD_DOC_NAME, CDD_DOC_GUID, OP_DISPLAY_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CDD_MRN, YEAR(CDD_SERVICE_DTE) ORDER BY CDD_SERVICE_DTE DESC) AS RN FROM IDB.CD_DOCUMENT JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON CDD_MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_PROVIDER ON CDD_AUTH_PROV_GUID = OP_PVDR_GUID WHERE CDD_CANCEL_IND = '0' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND = '0' AND YEAR(CDD_SERVICE_DTE) IN (2019, 2020) AND YEAR(CDD_SERVICE_DTE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) <= 21 AND OP_PVDR_NO IN ('013854', '026419', '023093', '026260', '020875') AND CDD_DOC_NAME IN ('Follow Up, Pediatric - Psychiatry', 'Initial Consult/Initial Visit, Pediatric - Psychiatry') ) SELECT * FROM CDD WHERE RN = 1

prompt: All newly entered patients in Tumor Registry in 2017 with demographics information
completion: SELECT YEAR(CURRENT date - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) "Current Age", YEAR(TM_DX_DTE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) "Age at Dx", PT_SEX "Gender", R.AV_DESC AS "Race (Reg)", CR.AV_DESC AS "Race (CDB)", E.AV_DESC AS "Ethnicity (Reg)", CE.AV_DESC AS "Ethnicity (CDB)", CASE WHEN PT_COUNTRY = '' THEN 'USA' ELSE PT_COUNTRY END AS "Country", TM_DX_DTE "Dx Date", TM_HIST_CD "Histology Code", H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS "Histology Description", TM_SITE_CD "Site Code", S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS "Site Description", CASE WHEN TM_CA_SURG_03_MSK = '00' THEN 'N' WHEN TM_CA_SURG_03_MSK = '' THEN 'Unknown' ELSE 'Y' END AS "Surgery at MSK?", FSC_NAME "Insurance Name", FSC_REP_CAT_NAME "Insurance Category", TM_OCCUPATION "Occupation", M.AV_DESC AS "Marital Status", RE.AV_DESC AS "Religion" FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PT_MRN = TM_MRN JOIN IDB.CDB_PATIENT ON CP_MRN = TM_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS R ON R.AV_ELEMENT = 'RACE' AND R.AV_CODE = PT_RACE LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS E ON E.AV_ELEMENT = 'PT_ETHNICITY' AND E.AV_CODE = PT_PT_ETHNICITY LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS CR ON CR.AV_ELEMENT = 'CDB_RACE' AND CR.AV_CODE = CP_CDB_RACE LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS CE ON CE.AV_ELEMENT = 'ETHNICITY' AND CE.AV_CODE = CP_ETHNICITY LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS RE ON RE.AV_ELEMENT = 'RELIGION' AND RE.AV_CODE = PT_RELIGION LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS M ON M.AV_ELEMENT = 'MARITAL_STS' AND M.AV_CODE = PT_MARITAL_STS LEFT JOIN IDB.PATIENT_INSURANCE_V ON TM_MRN = MRN AND FSC_PRIORITY = '1' WHERE 1=1 AND TM_CASE_STS IN ('3', '6', '7', '8') AND TM_DX_DTE BETWEEN '2017-01-01' AND '2017-12-31';

prompt: Please identify patients via pathology report search for all patients with serous borderline tumors and/or low grade serous ovarian carcinoma.
completion: SELECT DISTINCT "t1"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AS "Deident PT #", "t2"."PRPT_PATH_RPT_ID" AS "DE-ID Pathology Report", "t3"."DT_YEAR" AS "Pathology Report Year", "t3"."DT_DTE" AS "Pathology Report Date", "t4"."RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE" AS "Radiology Performed Date", "t4"."RRPT_ORDER_GROUP" AS "Radiology Order Group" FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED" "t1" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V" "t2" ON "t1"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t2"."PRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" "t3" ON "t2"."PRPT_REPORT_DATE_ID" = "t3"."DT_DATE_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."RADIOLOGY_REPORT_V" "t4" ON "t1"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t4"."RRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" WHERE ((CONTAINS("t2"."PRPT_DEID_REPORT", '((( ("serous" IN SAME SENTENCE AS "borderline") & ("serous" IN SAME SENTENCE AS "tumor") & ("serous" IN SAME SENTENCE AS "peritoneal") & ("serous" IN SAME SENTENCE AS "deposit") ) & ( ("low" IN SAME SENTENCE AS "malignant") & ("low" IN SAME SENTENCE AS "potential") )) | (( ("serous" IN SAME SENTENCE AS "borderline") & ("serous" IN SAME SENTENCE AS "tumor") ) & "invasive") | (( ("serous" IN SAME SENTENCE AS "borderline") & ("serous" IN SAME SENTENCE AS "tumor") ) & "non-invasive") | ( ("low" IN SAME SENTENCE AS "grade") & ("low" IN SAME SENTENCE AS "serous") & ("low" IN SAME SENTENCE AS "carcinoma") ) | ( ("low" IN SAME SENTENCE AS "grade") & ("low" IN SAME SENTENCE AS "serous") & ("low" IN SAME SENTENCE AS "ovarian") & ("low" IN SAME SENTENCE AS "cancer") ) | "LGSOC")') = 1 AND ("t4"."RRPT_ORDER_GROUP" = 'CT' AND (("t4"."RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE" BETWEEN '2011-7-1' AND '2015-6-30' AND "t3"."DT_DTE" BETWEEN '2012-1-1' AND '2014-12-31') AND ABS(TIMESTAMPDIFF(16, CHAR(TIMESTAMP("t4"."RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE", '00:00:00') - TIMESTAMP("t3"."DT_DTE", '00:00:00')))) <= 180))) AND "t2"."PRPT_DEID_REPORT" IS NOT NULL)

prompt: For the prior project, may you please also provide accession numbers in another column, extracted from each pathology report. These can be in the pathology tab.
completion: WITH APPT AS (SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN, CPE_ENC_DTE, CRE_RES_NAME, TRIM(R.AV_DESC) AS RACE, TRIM(E.AV_DESC) AS ETHNICITY, CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME AS VISIT_TYPE FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PT_MRN = CPE_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS R ON R.AV_ELEMENT = 'RACE' AND R.AV_CODE = PT_RACE LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS E ON E.AV_ELEMENT = 'PT_ETHNICITY' AND E.AV_CODE = PT_PT_ETHNICITY WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CRE_RES_ID IN ('000612', '007815', '016659', '019927', '024380', '427412', '029900') AND CRE_RES_TYP IN ('Physician') AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN '2013-01-01' AND '2023-01-19' ) SELECT DISTINCT TM_MRN AS MRN, RACE, ETHNICITY, CPE_ENC_DTE AS "Appt. Date", VISIT_TYPE AS "Appt.Visit Type", CASE WHEN VISIT_TYPE LIKE '%FR%' OR VISIT_TYPE LIKE '%FX%' THEN 'Follow-up' WHEN VISIT_TYPE LIKE '%NV%' OR VISIT_TYPE LIKE '%IR%' THEN 'New Visit' ELSE 'Other' END AS "Visit Category", CRE_RES_NAME AS "Provider seen during Appt", TM_DX_DTE AS "Diagnosis Date", TM_HIST_CD AS "Histology Code", H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS "Histology Desc", TM_SITE_CD AS "Site Code", S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS "Site Desc", DOC_NAME AS "Attending Dr at Dx", CATEGORY1, CATEGORY2, CATEGORY3, CATEGORY4 , TM_BEST_AJCC_STG AS "Stage" FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS ON AV_ELEMENT = 'CASE_STS' JOIN APPT ON CPE_MRN = TM_MRN AND AV_CODE = TM_CASE_STS INNER JOIN IDB.SEERGROUPING ON RECODE = IDB.SEERF_ICDO(TM_SITE_CD, TM_HIST_CD) JOIN IDB.DOC ON DOC_DR_NO = TM_ATN_DR_NO WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND TM_DX_DTE BETWEEN '2013-01-01' AND '2023-01-19' AND TM_ATN_DR_NO IN ('000612', '007815', '016659', '019927', '024380', '427412', '029900') ORDER BY TM_MRN, TM_DX_DTE ASC

prompt: Please provide a list of patients that had at least one of the following primary diagnoses: Breast, Multiple myeloma, and prostate cancer, that developed medication related osteonecrosis of the jaw.
completion: WITH PTS AS (SELECT DISTINCT TM_MRN MRN FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS ON AV_ELEMENT = 'CASE_STS' AND AV_CODE = TM_CASE_STS AND TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') WHERE (TM_SITE_CD LIKE 'C50%' OR TM_HIST_CD = 'M9732/3' OR TM_SITE_CD LIKE 'C61%' ) AND TM_DX_DTE BETWEEN '2004-01-01' AND '2017-12-31' ), OSTEONECROSIS AS (SELECT DISTINCT CC_MRN FROM PTS JOIN IDB.CTC_CLSF ON CC_MRN = MRN JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND (CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y') ) AND (CC_CLSF_CD = 'M87.180' OR CC_CLSF_CD = '733.45') GROUP BY CC_MRN, CC_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK ) SELECT PT_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_SEX, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, PT_DATE_OF_DEATH, PT_DEATH_IND FROM OSTEONECROSIS JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PT_MRN = CC_MRN ; WITH PTS AS (SELECT DISTINCT TM_MRN MRN FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS ON AV_ELEMENT = 'CASE_STS' AND AV_CODE = TM_CASE_STS AND TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') WHERE (TM_SITE_CD LIKE 'C50%' OR TM_HIST_CD = 'M9732/3' OR TM_SITE_CD LIKE 'C61%' ) AND TM_DX_DTE BETWEEN '2004-01-01' AND '2017-12-31' ), OSTEONECROSIS AS (SELECT CC_MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS MIN_ICD_EFF_DTE, CC_CLSF_CD AS ICD_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS ICD_DESC FROM PTS JOIN IDB.CTC_CLSF ON CC_MRN = MRN JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND (CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y') ) AND (CC_CLSF_CD = 'M87.180' OR CC_CLSF_CD = '733.45') GROUP BY CC_MRN, CC_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK ) SELECT * FROM OSTEONECROSIS ; WITH PTS AS (SELECT DISTINCT TM_MRN MRN FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS ON AV_ELEMENT = 'CASE_STS' AND AV_CODE = TM_CASE_STS AND TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') WHERE (TM_SITE_CD LIKE 'C50%' OR TM_HIST_CD = 'M9732/3' OR TM_SITE_CD LIKE 'C61%' ) AND TM_DX_DTE BETWEEN '2004-01-01' AND '2017-12-31' ), OSTEONECROSIS AS (SELECT DISTINCT CC_MRN FROM PTS JOIN IDB.CTC_CLSF ON CC_MRN = MRN JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND (CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y') ) AND (CC_CLSF_CD = 'M87.180' OR CC_CLSF_CD = '733.45') GROUP BY CC_MRN, CC_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK ) SELECT TM_MRN, AV_DESC AS CASE_STS, TM_DX_DTE, TM_HIST_CD, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS HIST_DESC, TM_SITE_CD, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_DESC FROM OSTEONECROSIS JOIN IDB.CDB_TUMOR ON CC_MRN = TM_MRN JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS ON AV_ELEMENT = 'CASE_STS' AND AV_CODE = TM_CASE_STS AND TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') ; WITH PTS AS (SELECT DISTINCT TM_MRN MRN FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS ON AV_ELEMENT = 'CASE_STS' AND AV_CODE = TM_CASE_STS AND TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') WHERE (TM_SITE_CD LIKE 'C50%' OR TM_HIST_CD = 'M9732/3' OR TM_SITE_CD LIKE 'C61%' ) AND TM_DX_DTE BETWEEN '2004-01-01' AND '2017-12-31' ), OSTEONECROSIS AS (SELECT DISTINCT CC_MRN MRN FROM PTS JOIN IDB.CTC_CLSF ON CC_MRN = MRN JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND (CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y') ) AND (CC_CLSF_CD = 'M87.180' OR CC_CLSF_CD = '733.45') GROUP BY CC_MRN, CC_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK ) SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN AS MRN, PIC.PINC_MNEMONIC AS MNEMONIC, PIC.PINC_GENERIC_NAME AS "Generic Drug Name", PIC.PINC_CHEMO_IND, MIN(D1.DT_DTE) AS "Order Start Date", MAX(D2.DT_DTE) AS "Order Stop Date", UPPER(POA.POA_ROUTE_ABBR) AS ROUTE FROM OSTEONECROSIS JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON MRN=PT_MRN LEFT JOIN DV.PHM_PT_MEDS_MQT PPMM ON PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PPMM.POD_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID LEFT JOIN DV.PHM_ORDER_DTL POD ON PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = POD.POD_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID AND PPMM.POD_PHARMA_INVENTORY_CTLG_ID = POD.POD_PHARMA_INVENTORY_CTLG_ID LEFT JOIN DV.PHM_INVENTORY_CATALOG PIC ON POD.POD_PHARMA_INVENTORY_CTLG_ID = PIC.PINC_INVENTORY_CTLG_ID LEFT JOIN DV.DATE_V D1 ON POD.POD_START_DATE_ID = D1.DT_DATE_ID LEFT JOIN DV.DATE_V D2 ON POD.POD_STOP_DATE_ID = D2.DT_DATE_ID LEFT JOIN DV.PHM_ORDER_ATTR POA ON POD.POD_PHARMA_ORD_ATTR_ID = POA.POA_PHARMA_ORDER_ATTR_ID GROUP BY PT_MRN, PIC.PINC_GENERIC_NAME, UPPER(POA.POA_ROUTE_ABBR), PIC.PINC_MNEMONIC, PIC.PINC_CHEMO_IND ; WITH PTS AS (SELECT DISTINCT TM_MRN MRN FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS ON AV_ELEMENT = 'CASE_STS' AND AV_CODE = TM_CASE_STS AND TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') WHERE (TM_SITE_CD LIKE 'C50%' OR TM_HIST_CD = 'M9732/3' OR TM_SITE_CD LIKE 'C61%' ) AND TM_DX_DTE BETWEEN '2004-01-01' AND '2017-12-31' ), OSTEONECROSIS AS (SELECT DISTINCT CC_MRN MRN FROM PTS JOIN IDB.CTC_CLSF ON CC_MRN = MRN JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND (CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y') ) AND (CC_CLSF_CD = 'M87.180' OR CC_CLSF_CD = '733.45') GROUP BY CC_MRN, CC_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK ) SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN AS "MRN", PT_LAST_NAME "LAST NAME", PT_FIRST_NAME "FIRST NAME", PCC_CODE AS "CPT CODE", PCC_DESC AS "CPT DESC", DT_DTE AS "PROCEDURE DATE" FROM OSTEONECROSIS JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V ON MRN = PT_MRN JOIN DV.CPT_PBD_PATIENT_PROCEDURE ON PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PTX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID JOIN DV.DATE ON PTX_PROC_DATE_ID = DT_DATE_ID WHERE PCC_CODE IN ('70355', '99201', '99202', '99203', '99204', '99205', '99212', '99213', '99214', '99215') ;

prompt:
Provide a daily list of all inpatients, patients admitted, and patients discharged with patient language and interpreter information.



Amendment:

Provide daily report on patient preferred language for scheduled OR visits in OR Main Campus and OR JRSC.
completion: SELECT DISTINCT VIS_ADM_DTE AS "Admitted Date", TRIM(L.AV_DESC) AS "Primary Language Description", RPT_U_INTERPRETER_IND AS "Interpreter Indicator", (TRIM(P.PT_LAST_NAME)||', '||TRIM(P.PT_FIRST_NAME)) AS "Patient Name", VIS_MRN AS "MRN", ADM_DR_NAME "Attending Physician", HOSP_SVC_DESC AS "Service", VIS_NURS_STA AS "Inpatient Floor", CASE WHEN VIS_ADM_DTE = CURRENT DATE - 1 DAY THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS "Admitted Yesterday", FLOOR((DAYS(CURRENT date) - DAYS(P.PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH))/365.25) AS "Age", PATIENT_TYPE_DESC "Patient Type", VIS_VISIT_STATUS, VISIT_STATUS_DESC FROM IDB.VISIT_V JOIN IDB.PATIENT P ON VIS_MRN = P.PT_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS L ON P.PT_PRIMARY_LANG = L.AV_CODE AND L.AV_ELEMENT = 'PRIMARY_LANG' JOIN IDB.RMS_PATIENT ON VIS_MRN = RPT_MRN WHERE VIS_ADM_DTE BETWEEN '2018-01-01' AND '2018-12-31' AND VIS_PATIENT_TYPE IN ('IP', 'OAMB', 'OAXR', 'OUCO') AND (RPT_U_INTERPRETER_IND = 'Y' OR COALESCE(PT_PRIMARY_LANG, '') <> 'ENG') ORDER BY TRIM(L.AV_DESC) ; SELECT "Primary Language Description", CAST(CAST(COUNT(*) * 100.0 AS DECIMAL(10, 4)) / CAST(SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER () AS DECIMAL(10, 4)) AS DECIMAL(10, 4)) AS "Percentage" FROM (SELECT DISTINCT VIS_ADM_DTE AS "Admitted Date", TRIM(L.AV_DESC) AS "Primary Language Description", RPT_U_INTERPRETER_IND AS "Interpreter Indicator", (TRIM(P.PT_LAST_NAME)||', '||TRIM(P.PT_FIRST_NAME)) AS "Patient Name", VIS_MRN AS "MRN", ADM_DR_NAME "Attending Physician", HOSP_SVC_DESC AS "Service", VIS_NURS_STA AS "Inpatient Floor", CASE WHEN VIS_ADM_DTE = CURRENT DATE - 1 DAY THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS "Admitted Yesterday", FLOOR((DAYS(CURRENT date) - DAYS(P.PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH))/365.25) AS "Age", PATIENT_TYPE_DESC "Patient Type", VIS_VISIT_STATUS, VISIT_STATUS_DESC FROM IDB.VISIT_V JOIN IDB.PATIENT P ON VIS_MRN = P.PT_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS L ON P.PT_PRIMARY_LANG = L.AV_CODE AND L.AV_ELEMENT = 'PRIMARY_LANG' JOIN IDB.RMS_PATIENT ON VIS_MRN = RPT_MRN WHERE VIS_ADM_DTE BETWEEN '2018-01-01' AND '2018-12-31' AND VIS_PATIENT_TYPE IN ('IP', 'OAMB', 'OAXR', 'OUCO') AND (RPT_U_INTERPRETER_IND = 'Y' OR COALESCE(PT_PRIMARY_LANG, '') <> 'ENG') ) A GROUP BY "Primary Language Description" ; SELECT DISTINCT VIS_ADM_DTE AS "Admitted Date", VIS_DSCH_DTE AS "Discharged Date", TRIM(L.AV_DESC) AS "Primary Language Description", RPT_U_INTERPRETER_IND AS "Interpreter Indicator", (TRIM(P.PT_LAST_NAME)||', '||TRIM(P.PT_FIRST_NAME)) AS "Patient Name", VIS_MRN AS "MRN", ADM_DR_NAME "Attending Physician", HOSP_SVC_DESC AS "Service", VIS_NURS_STA AS "Inpatient Floor", CASE WHEN VIS_ADM_DTE = CURRENT DATE - 1 DAY THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS "Admitted Yesterday", FLOOR((DAYS(CURRENT date) - DAYS(P.PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH))/365.25) AS "Age", PATIENT_TYPE_DESC "Patient Type", VIS_VISIT_STATUS, VISIT_STATUS_DESC FROM IDB.VISIT_V JOIN IDB.PATIENT P ON VIS_MRN = P.PT_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS L ON P.PT_PRIMARY_LANG = L.AV_CODE AND L.AV_ELEMENT = 'PRIMARY_LANG' JOIN IDB.RMS_PATIENT ON VIS_MRN = RPT_MRN WHERE VIS_ADM_DTE BETWEEN '2019-01-01' AND '2019-06-30' AND VIS_PATIENT_TYPE IN ('IP', 'OAMB', 'OAXR', 'OUCO') AND (RPT_U_INTERPRETER_IND = 'Y' OR COALESCE(PT_PRIMARY_LANG, '') <> 'ENG') ORDER BY TRIM(L.AV_DESC) ; SELECT "Primary Language Description", CAST(CAST(COUNT(*) * 100.0 AS DECIMAL(10, 4)) / CAST(SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER () AS DECIMAL(10, 4)) AS DECIMAL(10, 4)) AS "Percentage" FROM (SELECT DISTINCT VIS_ADM_DTE AS "Admitted Date", VIS_DSCH_DTE AS "Discharged Date", TRIM(L.AV_DESC) AS "Primary Language Description", RPT_U_INTERPRETER_IND AS "Interpreter Indicator", (TRIM(P.PT_LAST_NAME)||', '||TRIM(P.PT_FIRST_NAME)) AS "Patient Name", VIS_MRN AS "MRN", ADM_DR_NAME "Attending Physician", HOSP_SVC_DESC AS "Service", VIS_NURS_STA AS "Inpatient Floor", CASE WHEN VIS_ADM_DTE = CURRENT DATE - 1 DAY THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS "Admitted Yesterday", FLOOR((DAYS(CURRENT date) - DAYS(P.PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH))/365.25) AS "Age", PATIENT_TYPE_DESC "Patient Type", VIS_VISIT_STATUS, VISIT_STATUS_DESC FROM IDB.VISIT_V JOIN IDB.PATIENT P ON VIS_MRN = P.PT_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS L ON P.PT_PRIMARY_LANG = L.AV_CODE AND L.AV_ELEMENT = 'PRIMARY_LANG' JOIN IDB.RMS_PATIENT ON VIS_MRN = RPT_MRN WHERE VIS_ADM_DTE BETWEEN '2019-01-01' AND '2019-06-30' AND VIS_PATIENT_TYPE IN ('IP', 'OAMB', 'OAXR', 'OUCO') AND (RPT_U_INTERPRETER_IND = 'Y' OR COALESCE(PT_PRIMARY_LANG, '') <> 'ENG') ) A GROUP BY "Primary Language Description" ;

prompt: Email notification for when a surgical procedure is scheduled for the  list of MRNs who are under 15-200 study.
completion: WITH SURG AS (SELECT PATIENT_MRN, CASE_SURGERY_DTE, CASE_STATUS, CASE_PRIMARY_SURGEON_ID, CASE_PRIMARY_SURGEON FROM IDB.PERIOP_CASE_EVENT_V WHERE CASE_STATUS IN ('Scheduled', 'Not Scheduled') AND PATIENT_MRN IN (SELECT SUBJECT_MRN FROM NN.SV_SUB_ONSTUDY WHERE PROTOCOL_NO ='15-200' ) AND CASE_SURGERY_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT date AND CURRENT date + 60 DAYS AND CASE_PRIMARY_SURGEON_ID IN (840, 219211, 183031, 647, 707, 2912, 240430, 19974, 2849, 159979, 173958, 1038, 116209) ) , RAD AS (SELECT RRPT_MRN, RRPT_ORDER_GROUP, RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY RRPT_MRN ORDER BY RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE DESC) RN, DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)IMPRESSION[:]*[\w\W]*(?=DICTATED[ ]*BY:)', VARCHAR(RRPT_REPORT_TXT, 32000)) RAD_TEXT FROM DV.RADIOLOGY_REPORT_V JOIN SURG ON PATIENT_MRN = RRPT_MRN AND RRPT_ORDER_GROUP = 'CT' AND RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE >= CURRENT date - 60 DAYS AND RRPT_REPORT_TXT IS NOT NULL) , LABS AS (SELECT LR_MRN, LR_PERFORMED_DTE, LR_TEST_NAME, LR_SUBTEST_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY LR_MRN ORDER BY LR_PERFORMED_DTE DESC) LRN, LR_RESULT_VALUE FROM IDB.LAB_RESULTS JOIN SURG ON PATIENT_MRN = LR_MRN WHERE LR_TEST_NAME = 'Cancer Antigen 125 (CA 125)' AND LR_PERFORMED_DTE >= CURRENT date - 60 DAYS ) SELECT PATIENT_MRN AS MRN, PT_LAST_NAME AS LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME AS FIRST_NAME, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH AS DOB, CASE_SURGERY_DTE SURGERY_DATE, CASE_STATUS , CASE_PRIMARY_SURGEON SURGEON_NAME , LR_RESULT_VALUE AS "Cancer Antigen 125-Result Value", RAD_TEXT AS "Radiology Impression" FROM SURG JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PT_MRN = PATIENT_MRN LEFT JOIN LABS ON LR_MRN = PATIENT_MRN LEFT JOIN RAD ON RRPT_MRN = PATIENT_MRN AND RAD_TEXT IS NOT NULL AND RN=1

prompt: Provide a list of patients with positive culture for a rapidly growing mycobacteria from January 1st, 2010 to December 31, 2021
completion: SELECT LPC_MRN MRN, LPC_ACCESSION_NO ACCESSION_NO, LPC_PERFORMED_DTE PERFORMED_DATE, LPC_FINAL_DTE FINAL_DATE, LPC_ORGANISM_OBSERVATION , LPC_SPECIMEN_DESC SPECIMEN_DESCRIPTION FROM IDB.LAB_POSITIVE_CULTURES WHERE LPC_PERFORMED_DTE BETWEEN '1/1/2010' AND '12/31/2021' AND LOWER(LPC_ORGANISM_OBSERVATION) LIKE 'mycobacterium%' ;

prompt: Provide a list of new visits and internal referrals to the BMT service in 2020.
completion: SELECT CPE_ENC_CSN_ID AS "Encounter ID", CPE_MRN AS "MRN", PT_LAST_NAME AS "Last Name", PT_FIRST_NAME AS "First Name", PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH AS "DOB", CPE_ENC_DTE AS "Initial Consult", CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME AS "Visit Type", CLD_DEPT_NAME AS "Department Name", CR.CRE_RES_NAME AS "Provider Name", AR.CRE_RES_NAME AS "Referring Provider", D.DOC_NAME AS "Referring Provider Service", CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 AS "Service" FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE CR ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CR.CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON CPE_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_REFERRAL ON CR_MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.ACL_RESOURCE AR ON AR.CRE_REF_SRCE_TYP = 'Provider' AND AR.CRE_RES_ID = CR_REFERRING_PROV_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.DOC D ON D.DOC_NAME = AR.CRE_RES_NAME WHERE CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 LIKE '%BMT%' AND CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN '2020-01-01' AND '2020-12-31' AND (CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR LIKE '%NV%' OR CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR LIKE '%IR%')

prompt: Provide a weekly list of patients diagnosed with prostate cancer since 2019 who are being seen in clinic in the next two weeks.
completion: WITH DX AS (SELECT CC_MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS ICD_EFF_DTE, CC_CLSF_CD AS ICD_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS ICD_DESC FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE SUBSTR(CC_CLSF_CD, 1, 3) IN ('C61') AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' GROUP BY CC_MRN, CC_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK HAVING MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) >= '2019-01-01') , APPTS AS (SELECT CPE_MRN, CPE_ENC_DTE, CPE_APPT_DT, CRE_RES_NAME, CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CPE_MRN ORDER BY CPE_ENC_DTE ASC) AS RN FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID JOIN DX ON CPE_MRN = CC_MRN WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Sch') AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT date AND CURRENT date + 15 DAYS AND (CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID IN (921, 922, 2100, 3369, 3371, 3372, 5902, 5903) OR CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR IN ('TEL NV', 'PHONE FX', 'TEL FR', 'TEL AFX', 'TEL AFR', 'PHONE NV', 'FR', 'PO', 'CO')) AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 = 'SRG' AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 = 'URO' ) , BIOPSY AS (SELECT CPE_MRN BX_MRN, CPE_ENC_DTE BX_ENC_DTE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CPE_MRN ORDER BY CPE_ENC_DTE DESC) AS BX_RN FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CPE_ENC_DTE >= '2019-01-01' AND CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME = 'US URO-BX FUSION' ) , SURG AS (SELECT SSE_MRN, SSE_SURG_DTE, SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD, SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC, SSP_SURG_LAST_NM, SSP_SURG_FIRST_NM, SSP_SURG_SVC_CD, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY SSE_MRN ORDER BY SSE_SURG_DTE DESC) AS SURG_RN FROM IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE ON SSE_LOG_ID = SSP_LOG_ID AND SSE_ENC_CSN_ID = SSP_ENC_CSN_ID WHERE 1=1 AND SSE_SURG_DTE >= '2019-01-01' AND SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD IN ('999997', '55866') AND SSP_SURG_SVC_CD = 'URO' ) , RADONC AS (SELECT DISTINCT RTC_TX_MRN, RTC_TX_START_DTE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY RTC_TX_MRN ORDER BY RTC_TX_START_DTE DESC) AS RADONC_RN FROM IDB.RADONC_TREATMENT_COURSE JOIN DX ON RTC_TX_MRN = CC_MRN JOIN APPTS ON RTC_TX_MRN = CPE_MRN WHERE 1=1 AND RTC_TX_START_DTE >= '2019-01-01' ) , CLINDOC1 AS (SELECT CDD_MRN, CDD_SERVICE_DTE, MAX(CASE WHEN CDO_ITEM_NAME = 'Active Surveillance Date' THEN SUBSTR(CDO_VALUE_TEXT, 1, 500) END) AS ACTIVE_SURVEILLANCE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CDD_MRN ORDER BY CDD_SERVICE_DTE DESC) AS CLINDOC1_RN FROM IDB.CD_DOCUMENT JOIN DX ON CDD_MRN = CC_MRN JOIN APPTS ON CDD_MRN = CPE_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION ON CDD_DOC_GUID = CDO_DOC_GUID AND CDD_AUTHORED_DTE = CDO_AUTHORED_DTE AND CDO_VALUE_TEXT <> '' JOIN IDB.OMS_PROVIDER ON CDD_AUTH_PROV_GUID = OP_PVDR_GUID WHERE CDD_CANCEL_IND <> '1' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND <> '1' AND CDD_DOC_NAME = 'Active Surveillance, Prostate - Urology' AND CDO_ITEM_NAME = 'Active Surveillance Date' AND CDD_SERVICE_DTE >= '2019-01-01' GROUP BY CDD_MRN, CDD_SERVICE_DTE) , CLINDOC2 AS (SELECT CDD_MRN, CDD_SERVICE_DTE, MAX(CASE WHEN CDO_ITEM_NAME = 'Interval History' THEN SUBSTR(CDO_VALUE_TEXT, 1, 10500) END) AS GLEASON, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CDD_MRN ORDER BY CDD_SERVICE_DTE DESC) AS CLINDOC2_RN FROM IDB.CD_DOCUMENT JOIN DX ON CDD_MRN = CC_MRN JOIN APPTS ON CDD_MRN = CPE_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION ON CDD_DOC_GUID = CDO_DOC_GUID AND CDD_AUTHORED_DTE = CDO_AUTHORED_DTE AND CDO_VALUE_TEXT <> '' JOIN IDB.OMS_PROVIDER ON CDD_AUTH_PROV_GUID = OP_PVDR_GUID WHERE CDD_CANCEL_IND <> '1' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND <> '1' AND CDD_DOC_NAME = 'Active Surveillance, Prostate - Urology' AND ((CDO_ITEM_NAME IN ('Interval History') AND (LOWER(CDO_VALUE_TEXT) like '%gleason%' OR CDO_VALUE_TEXT like '%Gl%'))) AND CDD_SERVICE_DTE >= '2019-01-01' GROUP BY CDD_MRN, CDD_SERVICE_DTE) SELECT CC_MRN "MRN" , ICD_EFF_DTE "Dx Date" , PT_LAST_NAME "Last Name" , PT_FIRST_NAME "First Name" , CPE_ENC_DTE "Appt Date" , TIME(CPE_APPT_DT) "Appt Time" , CRE_RES_NAME "Provider" , CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME "Visit Type Name" , ACTIVE_SURVEILLANCE "Active Surveillance" , GLEASON "Gleason Data" , RTC_TX_START_DTE "Last Radonc Tx" , SSE_SURG_DTE "Last Surgery" , BX_ENC_DTE "Last Biopsy" FROM DX JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON CC_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN APPTS ON CC_MRN = CPE_MRN AND RN = 1 LEFT JOIN BIOPSY ON CC_MRN = BX_MRN AND BX_RN = 1 LEFT JOIN SURG ON CC_MRN = SSE_MRN AND SURG_RN = 1 LEFT JOIN CLINDOC1 A ON CC_MRN = A.CDD_MRN AND A.CLINDOC1_RN = 1 LEFT JOIN CLINDOC2 B ON CC_MRN = B.CDD_MRN AND B.CLINDOC2_RN = 1 LEFT JOIN RADONC ON CC_MRN = RTC_TX_MRN AND RADONC_RN = 1

prompt: Provide a one time list of patients diagnosed with a primary mediastinal germ cell tumor.
completion: SELECT DISTINCT "t1"."PT_MRN" AS "MRN", "t1"."PT_LAST_NAME" AS "Last Name", "t1"."PT_FIRST_NAME" AS "First Name", "t1"."PT_BIRTH_DTE" AS "Date of Birth", "t1"."PT_DEATH_DTE" AS "Deceased Date", "t1"."PT_VITAL_STATUS" AS "Vital Status", "t1"."PT_SEX_DESC" AS "Gender", "t2"."DT_DTE" AS "Tumor Diagnosis Date", "t3"."ICSC_SITE_CD" AS "ICD-O Site Code", "t3"."ICSC_ICDO_SITE_MSK_DESC" AS "ICD-O Site Description", "t4"."CDTM_CA_SURG_DTE" AS "Tumor Surgery Date", "t5"."DXCC_ICD_CODE" AS "ICD-O Histology Code", "t5"."DXCC_ICD_MSK_DESC" AS "ICD-O Histology Description", YEAR("t2"."DT_DTE" - "t6"."DT_DTE") AS "Age at Tumor Diagnosis Date - years" FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V" "t1" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED" "t7" ON "t1"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t7"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."CDB_TUMOR_V" "t4" ON "t7"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t4"."CDTM_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" "t2" ON "t4"."CDTM_DX_DATE_ID" = "t2"."DT_DATE_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."ICDO_SITE_CATALOG_V" "t3" ON "t4"."CDTM_SITE_CATALOG_ID" = "t3"."ICSC_SITE_CATALOG_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DIAGNOSIS_CODE_CAT_ICDO_V" "t5" ON "t4"."CDTM_DX_CATALOG_ID" = "t5"."DXCC_DX_CATALOG_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" "t6" ON "t1"."PT_BIRTH_DTE" = "t6"."DT_DTE" WHERE 1=1 AND "t5"."DXCC_ICD_CODE" IN ('M9060/3' ,'M9061/3' ,'M9062/3' ,'M9063/3' ,'M9064/3' ,'M9070/3' ,'M9071/3' ,'M9072/3' ,'M9073/1' ,'M9080/0' ,'M9080/1' ,'M9080/3' ,'M9081/3' ,'M9082/3' ,'M9083/3' ,'M9085/3' ,'M9100/3' ,'M9101/3' ,'M9102/3' , 'M9064/2' , 'M9065/3' , 'M9084/0' , 'M9084/3' ) AND "t2"."DT_DTE" BETWEEN '1990-01-01' AND '2023-11-25' AND YEAR("t2"."DT_DTE" - "t6"."DT_DTE") <= 25 ORDER BY PT_MRN, "t2"."DT_DTE"

prompt: Provide a list of pediatric patients (age 0-18 years) diagnosed with neutropenia and who have imaging confirmed appendicitis.
completion: WITH DX_9_10_APPENDICITIS AS (SELECT DISTINCT CC_MRN MRN FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PT_MRN = CC_MRN AND CC_EFF_DTE BETWEEN '2012-01-01' AND '2018-12-31' AND YEAR(CC_EFF_DTE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) <= 18 WHERE CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND (CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) AND CC_CLSF_CD IN ('K35.2', 'K35.20', 'K35.21', 'K35.3', 'K35.30', 'K35.31', 'K35.32', 'K35.33', 'K35.8', 'K35.80', 'K35.89', 'K35.890', 'K35.891', 'K36', '540', '540.0', '540.1', '540.9', '541', '542') ), DX_9_10_NEUTROPENIA AS (SELECT DISTINCT CC_MRN MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, PT_SEX, AV_DESC AS "RACE" FROM DX_9_10_APPENDICITIS JOIN IDB.CTC_CLSF ON CC_MRN = MRN JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PT_MRN = CC_MRN AND CC_EFF_DTE BETWEEN '2012-01-01' AND '2018-12-31' AND YEAR(CC_EFF_DTE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) <= 18 JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS ON AV_ELEMENT='RACE' AND PT_RACE=AV_CODE WHERE CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND (CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) AND CC_CLSF_CD IN ('288.03', 'D70.1', 'D70.2') ) SELECT CC_MRN MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, PT_SEX, RACE, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS MIN_ICD_EFF_DTE, CC_CLSF_CD AS ICD_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS ICD_DESC FROM DX_9_10_NEUTROPENIA JOIN IDB.CTC_CLSF ON CC_MRN = MRN JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND (CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y') ) AND CC_CLSF_CD IN ('K35.2', 'K35.20', 'K35.21', 'K35.3', 'K35.30', 'K35.31', 'K35.32', 'K35.33', 'K35.8', 'K35.80', 'K35.89', 'K35.890', 'K35.891', 'K36', '540', '540.0', '540.1', '540.9', '541', '542', '288.03', 'D70.1', 'D70.2') GROUP BY CC_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, PT_SEX, RACE, CC_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK ; WITH DX_9_10_APPENDICITIS AS (SELECT DISTINCT CC_MRN MRN FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PT_MRN = CC_MRN AND CC_EFF_DTE BETWEEN '2012-01-01' AND '2018-12-31' AND YEAR(CC_EFF_DTE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) <= 18 WHERE CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND (CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) AND CC_CLSF_CD IN ('K35.2', 'K35.20', 'K35.21', 'K35.3', 'K35.30', 'K35.31', 'K35.32', 'K35.33', 'K35.8', 'K35.80', 'K35.89', 'K35.890', 'K35.891', 'K36', '540', '540.0', '540.1', '540.9', '541', '542') ), DX_9_10_NEUTROPENIA AS (SELECT DISTINCT CC_MRN MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, PT_SEX, AV_DESC AS "RACE" FROM DX_9_10_APPENDICITIS JOIN IDB.CTC_CLSF ON CC_MRN = MRN JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PT_MRN = CC_MRN AND CC_EFF_DTE BETWEEN '2012-01-01' AND '2018-12-31' AND YEAR(CC_EFF_DTE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) <= 18 JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS ON AV_ELEMENT='RACE' AND PT_RACE=AV_CODE WHERE CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND (CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) AND CC_CLSF_CD IN ('288.03', 'D70.1', 'D70.2') ) SELECT APR_MRN MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, PT_SEX, RACE, APR_START_DTE, APR_GENERIC_NAME, APR_PRESCRIBED_DOSE, APR_ROUTE FROM DX_9_10_NEUTROPENIA JOIN IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX ON MRN = APR_MRN ; WITH DX_9_10_APPENDICITIS AS (SELECT DISTINCT CC_MRN MRN FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PT_MRN = CC_MRN AND CC_EFF_DTE BETWEEN '2012-01-01' AND '2018-12-31' AND YEAR(CC_EFF_DTE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) <= 18 WHERE CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND (CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) AND CC_CLSF_CD IN ('K35.2', 'K35.20', 'K35.21', 'K35.3', 'K35.30', 'K35.31', 'K35.32', 'K35.33', 'K35.8', 'K35.80', 'K35.89', 'K35.890', 'K35.891', 'K36', '540', '540.0', '540.1', '540.9', '541', '542') ), DX_9_10_NEUTROPENIA AS (SELECT DISTINCT CC_MRN MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, PT_SEX, AV_DESC AS "RACE" FROM DX_9_10_APPENDICITIS JOIN IDB.CTC_CLSF ON CC_MRN = MRN JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PT_MRN = CC_MRN AND CC_EFF_DTE BETWEEN '2012-01-01' AND '2018-12-31' AND YEAR(CC_EFF_DTE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) <= 18 JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS ON AV_ELEMENT='RACE' AND PT_RACE=AV_CODE WHERE CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND (CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) AND CC_CLSF_CD IN ('288.03', 'D70.1', 'D70.2') ) SELECT MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, PT_SEX, RACE, SSE_SURG_DTE, SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD, SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC, SSP_SURG_LAST_NM, SSP_SURG_FIRST_NM, SSP_SURG_SVC_CD FROM DX_9_10_NEUTROPENIA JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT ON SSE_MRN = MRN JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE ON SSE_LOG_ID = SSP_LOG_ID AND SSE_ENC_CSN_ID = SSP_ENC_CSN_ID WHERE (SSE_SURG_LOC not like '%IR%' AND SSE_SURG_LOC not like '%ENDO%' AND SSE_SOURCE_TYPE <> 'E') ;

prompt:
What is the ethnicity composition of patients with colorectal cancer seen at MSKCC?

prompt: Patterns of management for HN sarcoma, specifically treatment patterns (e.g. treatment plans, treatment start, treatment failures, etc.) for patients seen within the last 19 years. Dr. Tsai currently has the above retrospective protocol for all HN cancers, including sarcomas.
completion: SELECT DISTINCT TM_MRN, PT_SEX, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, TM_DX_DTE, TM_HIST_CD, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS HIST_DESC, TM_SITE_CD, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_DESC FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PT_MRN = TM_MRN JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS ON AV_ELEMENT = 'CASE_STS' AND AV_CODE = TM_CASE_STS WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND TM_SITE_CD BETWEEN 'C000' AND 'C149' AND TM_DX_DTE BETWEEN '2000-01-01' AND CURRENT date AND TM_HIST_CD IN ('M9757/3', 'M9540/3', 'M9473/3', 'M9260/3', 'M9231/3', 'M9220/3', 'M9180/3', 'M9140/3', 'M9120/3', 'M9043/3', 'M9041/3', 'M8980/3', 'M8963/3', 'M8920/3', 'M8912/3', 'M8910/3', 'M8901/3', 'M8900/3', 'M8895/3', 'M8890/3', 'M8858/3', 'M8851/3', 'M8850/3', 'M8830/3', 'M8811/3', 'M8806/3', 'M8805/3', 'M8802/3', 'M8801/3', 'M8800/3') ;
