SELECT DISTINCT TM_MRN, PT_SEX, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, RTC_TX_START_DTE, RTC_TX_STOP_DTE FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PT_MRN = TM_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.RADONC_TREATMENT_COURSE ON RTC_TX_MRN = TM_MRN JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS ON AV_ELEMENT = 'CASE_STS' AND AV_CODE = TM_CASE_STS WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND TM_SITE_CD BETWEEN 'C000' AND 'C149' AND TM_DX_DTE BETWEEN '2000-01-01' AND CURRENT date AND TM_HIST_CD IN ('M9757/3', 'M9540/3', 'M9473/3', 'M9260/3', 'M9231/3', 'M9220/3', 'M9180/3', 'M9140/3', 'M9120/3', 'M9043/3', 'M9041/3', 'M8980/3', 'M8963/3', 'M8920/3', 'M8912/3', 'M8910/3', 'M8901/3', 'M8900/3', 'M8895/3', 'M8890/3', 'M8858/3', 'M8851/3', 'M8850/3', 'M8830/3', 'M8811/3', 'M8806/3', 'M8805/3', 'M8802/3', 'M8801/3', 'M8800/3') ; SELECT DISTINCT TM_MRN, PT_SEX, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, SSE_SURG_DTE FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PT_MRN = TM_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX_V ON APR_MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.RADONC_TREATMENT_COURSE ON RTC_TX_MRN = TM_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT ON SSE_MRN = TM_MRN AND (SSE_SURG_LOC not like '%IR%' AND SSE_SURG_LOC not like '%ENDO%' AND SSE_SOURCE_TYPE <> 'E') JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS ON AV_ELEMENT = 'CASE_STS' AND AV_CODE = TM_CASE_STS WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND TM_SITE_CD BETWEEN 'C000' AND 'C149' AND TM_DX_DTE BETWEEN '2000-01-01' AND CURRENT date AND TM_HIST_CD IN ('M9757/3', 'M9540/3', 'M9473/3', 'M9260/3', 'M9231/3', 'M9220/3', 'M9180/3', 'M9140/3', 'M9120/3', 'M9043/3', 'M9041/3', 'M8980/3', 'M8963/3', 'M8920/3', 'M8912/3', 'M8910/3', 'M8901/3', 'M8900/3', 'M8895/3', 'M8890/3', 'M8858/3', 'M8851/3', 'M8850/3', 'M8830/3', 'M8811/3', 'M8806/3', 'M8805/3', 'M8802/3', 'M8801/3', 'M8800/3')

prompt: Patients who received salvage immunochemotherapy for relapsed or refractory diffuse large B-cell lymphoma.
completion: WITH DX AS (SELECT CC_MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS DX_DTE, CC_CLSF_CD AS ICD_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS ICD_DESC FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE SUBSTR(CC_CLSF_CD, 1, 5) IN ('200.7', 'C83.3') AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND (CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) GROUP BY CC_MRN, CC_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK ) , CHEMO AS (SELECT A.APR_MRN, 'DHAP' AS TREATMENT, MIN(A.APR_START_DTE) FIRST_START_DTE, MAX(A.APR_START_DTE) LAST_START_DTE FROM IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX_V A JOIN IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX_V B ON A.APR_MRN = B.APR_MRN AND B.CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME = 'CYTARABINE' AND B.APR_START_DTE BETWEEN A.APR_START_DTE AND A.APR_START_DTE + 30 DAYS WHERE A.CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME IN ('CISPLATIN') AND A.APR_START_DTE BETWEEN '2002-01-01' AND '2020-12-31' GROUP BY A.APR_MRN UNION ALL SELECT A.APR_MRN, 'ESHAP' AS TREATMENT, MIN(A.APR_START_DTE) FIRST_START_DTE, MAX(A.APR_START_DTE) LAST_START_DTE FROM IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX_V A JOIN IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX_V B ON A.APR_MRN = B.APR_MRN AND B.CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME = 'CYTARABINE' AND B.APR_START_DTE BETWEEN A.APR_START_DTE AND A.APR_START_DTE + 30 DAYS JOIN IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX_V C ON A.APR_MRN = C.APR_MRN AND C.CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME = 'CISPLATIN' AND C.APR_START_DTE BETWEEN A.APR_START_DTE AND A.APR_START_DTE + 30 DAYS WHERE A.CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME IN ('ETOPOSIDE') AND A.APR_START_DTE BETWEEN '2002-01-01' AND '2020-12-31' GROUP BY A.APR_MRN UNION ALL SELECT A.APR_MRN, 'MIME' AS TREATMENT, MIN(A.APR_START_DTE) FIRST_START_DTE, MAX(A.APR_START_DTE) LAST_START_DTE FROM IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX_V A JOIN IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX_V B ON A.APR_MRN = B.APR_MRN AND B.CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME = 'METHOTREXATE' AND B.APR_START_DTE BETWEEN A.APR_START_DTE AND A.APR_START_DTE + 30 DAYS JOIN IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX_V C ON A.APR_MRN = C.APR_MRN AND C.CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME = 'ETOPOSIDE' AND C.APR_START_DTE BETWEEN A.APR_START_DTE AND A.APR_START_DTE + 30 DAYS WHERE A.CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME IN ('IFOSFAMIDE') AND A.APR_START_DTE BETWEEN '2002-01-01' AND '2020-12-31' GROUP BY A.APR_MRN UNION ALL SELECT A.APR_MRN, 'CAR-T' AS TREATMENT, MIN(A.APR_START_DTE) FIRST_START_DTE, MAX(A.APR_START_DTE) LAST_START_DTE FROM IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX_V A WHERE A.CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME IN ('TISAGENLECLEUCEL') AND A.APR_START_DTE BETWEEN '2002-01-01' AND '2020-12-31' GROUP BY A.APR_MRN UNION ALL SELECT A.APR_MRN, 'ICE - R' AS TREATMENT, MIN(A.APR_START_DTE) FIRST_START_DTE, MAX(A.APR_START_DTE) LAST_START_DTE FROM IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX_V A JOIN IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX_V B ON A.APR_MRN = B.APR_MRN AND B.CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME = 'CARBOPLATIN' AND B.APR_START_DTE BETWEEN A.APR_START_DTE AND A.APR_START_DTE + 30 DAYS JOIN IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX_V C ON A.APR_MRN = C.APR_MRN AND C.CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME = 'ETOPOSIDE' AND C.APR_START_DTE BETWEEN A.APR_START_DTE AND A.APR_START_DTE + 30 DAYS JOIN IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX_V D ON A.APR_MRN = D.APR_MRN AND D.CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME <> 'RITUXIMAB' AND D.APR_START_DTE BETWEEN A.APR_START_DTE AND A.APR_START_DTE + 30 DAYS WHERE A.CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME IN ('IFOSFAMIDE') AND A.APR_START_DTE BETWEEN '2002-01-01' AND '2020-12-31' AND A.APR_MRN NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT A.APR_MRN FROM IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX_V A JOIN IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX_V B ON A.APR_MRN = B.APR_MRN AND B.CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME = 'CARBOPLATIN' AND B.APR_START_DTE BETWEEN A.APR_START_DTE AND A.APR_START_DTE + 30 DAYS JOIN IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX_V C ON A.APR_MRN = C.APR_MRN AND C.CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME = 'ETOPOSIDE' AND C.APR_START_DTE BETWEEN A.APR_START_DTE AND A.APR_START_DTE + 30 DAYS JOIN IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX_V D ON A.APR_MRN = D.APR_MRN AND D.CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME = 'RITUXIMAB' AND D.APR_START_DTE BETWEEN A.APR_START_DTE AND A.APR_START_DTE + 30 DAYS WHERE A.CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME IN ('IFOSFAMIDE') AND A.APR_START_DTE BETWEEN '2002-01-01' AND '2020-12-31' ) GROUP BY A.APR_MRN UNION ALL SELECT A.APR_MRN, 'ICE + R' AS TREATMENT, MIN(A.APR_START_DTE) FIRST_START_DTE, MAX(A.APR_START_DTE) LAST_START_DTE FROM IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX_V A JOIN IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX_V B ON A.APR_MRN = B.APR_MRN AND B.CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME = 'CARBOPLATIN' AND B.APR_START_DTE BETWEEN A.APR_START_DTE AND A.APR_START_DTE + 30 DAYS JOIN IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX_V C ON A.APR_MRN = C.APR_MRN AND C.CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME = 'ETOPOSIDE' AND C.APR_START_DTE BETWEEN A.APR_START_DTE AND A.APR_START_DTE + 30 DAYS JOIN IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX_V D ON A.APR_MRN = D.APR_MRN AND D.CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME = 'RITUXIMAB' AND D.APR_START_DTE BETWEEN A.APR_START_DTE AND A.APR_START_DTE + 30 DAYS WHERE A.CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME IN ('IFOSFAMIDE') AND A.APR_START_DTE BETWEEN '2002-01-01' AND '2020-12-31' GROUP BY A.APR_MRN UNION ALL SELECT A.APR_MRN, 'GDP' AS TREATMENT, MIN(A.APR_START_DTE) FIRST_START_DTE, MAX(A.APR_START_DTE) LAST_START_DTE FROM IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX_V A JOIN IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX_V B ON A.APR_MRN = B.APR_MRN AND B.CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME = 'CISPLATIN' AND B.APR_START_DTE BETWEEN A.APR_START_DTE AND A.APR_START_DTE + 30 DAYS WHERE A.CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME IN ('GEMCITABINE') AND A.APR_START_DTE BETWEEN '2002-01-01' AND '2020-12-31' GROUP BY A.APR_MRN UNION ALL SELECT A.APR_MRN, 'IVAD' AS TREATMENT, MIN(A.APR_START_DTE) FIRST_START_DTE, MAX(A.APR_START_DTE) LAST_START_DTE FROM IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX_V A JOIN IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX_V B ON A.APR_MRN = B.APR_MRN AND B.CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME = 'ETOPOSIDE' AND B.APR_START_DTE BETWEEN A.APR_START_DTE AND A.APR_START_DTE + 30 DAYS JOIN IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX_V C ON A.APR_MRN = C.APR_MRN AND C.CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME = 'CYTARABINE' AND C.APR_START_DTE BETWEEN A.APR_START_DTE AND A.APR_START_DTE + 30 DAYS WHERE A.CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME IN ('IFOSFAMIDE') AND A.APR_START_DTE BETWEEN '2002-01-01' AND '2020-12-31' GROUP BY A.APR_MRN UNION ALL SELECT A.APR_MRN, 'BEAM' AS TREATMENT, MIN(A.APR_START_DTE) FIRST_START_DTE, MAX(A.APR_START_DTE) LAST_START_DTE FROM IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX_V A JOIN IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX_V B ON A.APR_MRN = B.APR_MRN AND B.CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME = 'CYTARABINE' AND B.APR_START_DTE BETWEEN A.APR_START_DTE AND A.APR_START_DTE + 30 DAYS JOIN IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX_V C ON A.APR_MRN = C.APR_MRN AND C.CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME = 'MELPHALAN' AND C.APR_START_DTE BETWEEN A.APR_START_DTE AND A.APR_START_DTE + 30 DAYS WHERE A.CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME IN ('ETOPOSIDE') AND A.APR_START_DTE BETWEEN '2002-01-01' AND '2020-12-31' GROUP BY A.APR_MRN) SELECT DISTINCT CC_MRN, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, PT_DATE_OF_DEATH, DX_DTE, ICD_CD, ICD_DESC, TREATMENT, FIRST_START_DTE, LAST_START_DTE FROM DX JOIN CHEMO ON CC_MRN = APR_MRN JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON CC_MRN = PT_MRN ORDER BY CC_MRN, DX_DTE, FIRST_START_DTE

prompt:
Due to construction, need to understand patient volume for Pediatric patients with infection control headers being seen in the Pediatric Ophthalmology Suite.

Requesting for 1/1/2022 - 12/31/2022 the number of patients seen (completed visits) in the Cadence Department: Ophthalmic Onc 1275 with an active Infection Control Header of any kind. Additionally, second tab in excel would include any patient with a completed visit in this department who had a Respiratory Virus Panel sent on the same date of service as the visit (CIS order: "Respiratory NAT Panel with SARS-CoV-2")
completion: WITH APPT AS (SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN, CPE_ENC_DTE AS APPT_DATE, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 AS "Department", CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 AS "Service", CLD_DEPT_NAME AS "Department Name", CRE_RES_NAME AS "Provider Name", CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME AS "Visit Type" FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN '2022-01-01' AND '2022-12-31' AND CLD_DEPT_NAME = 'OPHTHALMIC ONC 1275' ) SELECT DISTINCT OHI_MRN AS MRN, TRIM(PT_LAST_NAME)||','||TRIM(PT_FIRST_NAME) AS "Patient Name", CASE WHEN PT_DATE_OF_DEATH IS NULL THEN YEAR(CURRENT date - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) END AS AGE, CASE WHEN PT_DATE_OF_DEATH IS NULL THEN 'Alive' ELSE 'Deceased' END AS "Vital Status", APPT_DATE AS "Visit Date", "Department", "Service", "Department Name", "Provider Name", "Visit Type", OHI_ONSET_DTE, OHI_STS_CD, OHI_TYPE_CD, OHI_SHORT_NAME, OHI_HI_DESCRIPTION, OHI_HI_TEXT FROM APPT JOIN IDB.OMS_HEALTH_ISSUE ON CPE_MRN = OHI_MRN JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON OHI_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE OHI_TYPE_CD = 'Inf Control' AND OHI_STS_CD = 'Active' ORDER BY OHI_MRN ; WITH APPT AS (SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN, CPE_ENC_DTE AS APPT_DATE, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 AS "Department", CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 AS "Service", CLD_DEPT_NAME AS "Department Name", CRE_RES_NAME AS "Provider Name", CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME AS "Visit Type" FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN '2022-01-01' AND '2022-12-31' AND CLD_DEPT_NAME = 'OPHTHALMIC ONC 1275' ), ORD AS (SELECT DISTINCT OO_MRN, OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE, OO_ORD_NAME FROM APPT JOIN IDB.OMS_ORDER ON CPE_MRN = OO_MRN AND OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE = APPT_DATE JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_CATALOG ON OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID = OOC_MSTR_ITEM_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_STATUS ON OO_ORD_STS_CD = OSTS_ORD_STS_CD WHERE OO_ORD_NAME = 'Respiratory NAT Panel with SARS-CoV-2' AND OO_ORD_STS_CD NOT IN ('CANP', 'CANC', 'AUC3') ) SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN AS MRN, TRIM(PT_LAST_NAME)||','||TRIM(PT_FIRST_NAME) AS "Patient Name", CASE WHEN PT_DATE_OF_DEATH IS NULL THEN YEAR(CURRENT date - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) END AS AGE, CASE WHEN PT_DATE_OF_DEATH IS NULL THEN 'Alive' ELSE 'Deceased' END AS "Vital Status", APPT_DATE AS "Appointment Date", "Department", "Service", "Department Name", "Provider Name", "Visit Type", OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE AS "Order Significant Date", OO_ORD_NAME AS "Order Name" FROM APPT JOIN ORD ON CPE_MRN = OO_MRN AND OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE = APPT_DATE JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON CPE_MRN = PT_MRN ORDER BY CPE_MRN ;

prompt: Provide a daily report with list of patients scheduled as an IR or a NV from current day through 1 year from current day who have previously seen another endocrinologist at MSKCC in the clinic.
completion: WITH SCH AS (SELECT CPE_MRN MRN, STRIP(PT_LAST_NAME)||', '||STRIP(PT_FIRST_NAME) AS PT_NAME, MIN(CPE_ENC_DTE) FST_SCH_DTE, CPE_CPE_IP_IND IP_OP, CPE_CPE_APPT_STS VST_STS, CRE_RES_NAME MD_NAME, CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME, CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR, CVT_EXT_NAME FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON CPE_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT DATE AND CURRENT DATE + 1 YEAR AND CRE_RES_ID = '011569' AND CPE_CPE_APPT_STS = 'Sch' AND CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR IN ('IR', 'NV') GROUP BY CPE_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, CPE_CPE_IP_IND , CPE_CPE_APPT_STS , CRE_RES_NAME , CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME, CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR, CVT_EXT_NAME) , ENDO AS (SELECT DOC_DR_NO RES_ID, DOC_NAME, DOC_SVC , DOC_ACDMC_DPT, DOC_ACDMC_SVC, DOC_DR_STS FROM IDB.DOC WHERE DOC_ACDMC_DPT = 'MEDICINE' AND DOC_ACDMC_SVC = 'ENDOCRINOLOGY' AND DOC_DR_NO <> '011569' AND DOC_PRIVILEGE_CD <> 'N/P' ) SELECT MRN, PT_NAME, FST_SCH_DTE, IP_OP, VST_STS, MD_NAME, PAST_VST_STS, DOC_NAME PAST_VST_MD, PAST_LST_VST_DTE FROM (SELECT MRN, PT_NAME, FST_SCH_DTE, IP_OP, VST_STS, MD_NAME, MAX(CPE_CPE_APPT_STS) PAST_VST_STS, MAX(CPE_ENC_DTE) PAST_LST_VST_DTE FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN SCH ON MRN = CPE_MRN AND CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') JOIN ENDO ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = RES_ID WHERE CPE_ENC_DTE < FST_SCH_DTE AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT DATE - 5 YEAR AND CURRENT DATE GROUP BY MRN, PT_NAME, FST_SCH_DTE, IP_OP, VST_STS, MD_NAME) AS A JOIN IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER ON MRN = CPE_MRN AND PAST_LST_VST_DTE = CPE_ENC_DTE AND CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') JOIN ENDO ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = RES_ID

prompt: Provide a monthly list of which patients live out of state.
completion: SELECT CPE_MRN AS "MRN", TRIM(CL_LAST_NAME) || ', ' || TRIM(CL_FIRST_NAME) AS "Patient", CL_STATE "Patient State", CPE_ENC_DTE AS "Appt Date", D.CAV_TITLE AS "Department Desc", CLD_DEPT_NAME AS "Department Name", S.CAV_TITLE AS "Service Desc", CRE_RES_TYP AS "Provider Type", CRE_RES_NAME AS "Provider Name", CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME AS "Visit Type" FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_PATIENT ON CL_PRK = CPE_PRK JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_USER ON CPE_ENTER_USER_ID = CLE_USER_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_CATEGORY D ON D.CAV_CATEGORY = 'CLD_RPT_GRP_6' AND D.CAV_ABBR = CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_CATEGORY S ON S.CAV_CATEGORY = 'CLD_RPT_GRP_8' AND S.CAV_ABBR = CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Sch') AND CRE_RES_TYP = 'Physician' AND CL_STATE <> 'NY' AND CL_DATE_OF_DEATH IS NULL AND CRE_RES_NAME = 'PALOMBA, MARIA LIA' AND S.CAV_TITLE = 'LYMPHOMA' AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT date AND CURRENT date + 30 DAY

prompt: Please search through pathology reports and provide a list of in-house bone marrow cases from January-June 2019.
completion: SELECT PT_MRN AS "MRN", PT_LAST_NAME AS "Last Name", PT_FIRST_NAME AS "First Name", PT_BIRTH_DTE AS "DOB", YEAR(CURRENT date - PT_BIRTH_DTE) AS "Current Age", PRPT_ACCESSION_NO AS "Path Accession Number", PRPT_REPORT_TYPE "Path Report Type", PRPT_REPORT AS "Path Report" FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT JOIN DV.DATE R ON R.DT_DATE_ID = PRPT_REPORT_DATE_ID JOIN DV.PATH_RPRT_TYPE_LOOKUP ON PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_CD = PRPT_REPORT_TYPE JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON PRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID WHERE 1=1 AND CONTAINS("PRPT_REPORT", '("bone marrow")') = 1 AND R.DT_DTE BETWEEN '2019-01-01' AND '2019-01-31' AND PRPT_REPORT IS NOT NULL AND (PRPT_ACCESSION_NO like 'H%') AND (PRPT_REPORT_TYPE like '%_R' OR PRPT_REPORT_TYPE like '%_HR')

prompt: Provide Breast Medicine and Breast Surgery patients who were treated at MSK since 2000 and are now deceased - name and DOB.
completion: SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME AS LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME AS FIRST_NAME , PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, PT_DATE_OF_DEATH FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CRE_RES_ID = CPE_VST_RES_ID AND CRE_RES_TYP IN ('Physician', 'PhD') JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PT_MRN = CPE_MRN AND PT_DEATH_IND IN ('C', 'D', 'X') WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Comp', 'Arrived') AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN '2000-01-01' AND '2011-08-31' AND ((CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 IN ('MED', 'SRG') AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 = 'BRE') OR (CRE_RES_ID IN ('002873', '006155', '006684', '008318', '008557', '010231', '013623', '014381', '014407')))

prompt: I already receive bi-weekly case reports for Y90 treatments (Sirsphere and Therasphere) The current report does display the patient's primary diagnosis, but I am wondering if I can also include the secondary diagnosis?
completion: WITH SRG AS (SELECT DISTINCT SSE_MRN MRN, CHAR(SSE_SURG_DTE) "Treatment Date", CHAR(PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) DOB, CHAR(PT_DATE_OF_DEATH) "Death Date", CHAR(PLA_LST_CON_DTE) "Last Contact Date", SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC "Proc Name", SSP_SURG_LAST_NM "Surgeon Last Name", SSP_SURG_FIRST_NM "Surgeon First Name" FROM IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE ON SSE_LOG_ID = SSP_LOG_ID JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PT_MRN = SSE_MRN JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY ON PLA_MRN=PT_MRN WHERE (UPPER(SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC) like '%SIRSPHERE%' OR UPPER(SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC) like '%THERASPHERE%') AND SSE_SURG_DTE >= CURRENT date - 1 YEAR ), REFER AS (SELECT CPE_MRN, CHAR("Treatment Date") TX_DTE, CRE_RES_NAME, CPE_ENC_DTE , ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY MRN, "Treatment Date" ORDER BY CPE_ENC_DTE DESC, CPE_REF_RES_ID DESC) AS RN FROM SRG JOIN IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER ON MRN = CPE_MRN AND "Treatment Date" > CPE_ENC_DTE AND CPE_CPE_APPT_STS = 'Comp' JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 = 'IR' JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE R ON CPE_REF_RES_ID = R.CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID AND (CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR like '%NV%' OR CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR like '%IR%')) , DX_AGG_0 AS (SELECT DISTINCT TM_MRN, TRIM(H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK) AS HIST_DESC, TRIM(S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK) AS SITE_DESC FROM REFER JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON PT_MRN=CPE_MRN JOIN IDB.CDB_TUMOR ON TM_MRN=CPE_MRN JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS CASE_STS ON CASE_STS.AV_ELEMENT = 'CASE_STS' AND CASE_STS.AV_CODE = TM_CASE_STS AND TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') ) , DX_AGG AS (SELECT DISTINCT TM_MRN, LISTAGG(TRIM(HIST_DESC), ' | ') WITHIN GROUP( ORDER BY TM_MRN) AS HIST_DESC, LISTAGG(TRIM(SITE_DESC), ' | ') WITHIN GROUP( ORDER BY TM_MRN) AS SITE_DESC FROM DX_AGG_0 GROUP BY TM_MRN) , SEC_DX_0 AS (SELECT DISTINCT CC_MRN, CC_CLSF_CD FROM REFER JOIN IDB.CTC_CLSF ON CPE_MRN = CC_MRN JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE (SUBSTR(CC_CLSF_CD, 1, 3) BETWEEN 'C77' AND 'C79' OR SUBSTR(CC_CLSF_CD, 1, 3) BETWEEN '196' AND '198') AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND (CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) ) , SEC_DX AS (SELECT CC_MRN, LISTAGG(TRIM(CC_CLSF_CD), ' | ') WITHIN GROUP( ORDER BY CC_MRN) AS SEC_DX_ICD_CD FROM SEC_DX_0 GROUP BY CC_MRN) SELECT SRG.*, CRE_RES_NAME "Referring MD", CHAR(CPE_ENC_DTE) "Referring Date", HIST_DESC, SITE_DESC, SEC_DX_ICD_CD FROM SRG LEFT JOIN REFER ON CPE_MRN=MRN AND "Treatment Date"=TX_DTE AND RN=1 LEFT JOIN DX_AGG ON TM_MRN=MRN LEFT JOIN SEC_DX ON MRN = CC_MRN ORDER BY 1, 2

prompt: Provide a list of H-cases with "adult T-cell leukemia/lymphoma" OR "adult T cell leukemia/lymphoma" OR "ATLL" or "HTLV-1/2" OR "HTLV-I/II" OR "HTLV" in the Diagnosis section from 01/01/2017 to present.
completion: WITH X AS (SELECT DISTINCT "t1"."PT_MRN" AS "MRN", PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_BIRTH_DTE AS DOB, "t2"."PRPT_ACCESSION_NO" AS "Pathology Report", PRPT_REPORT_TYPE, "t3"."PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_DESC" AS "Pathology Report Type", "t4"."DT_DTE" AS "Pathology Procedure Date", CASE WHEN UPPER(DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)DIAGNOSIS:[\w\W]*(?=NOTE:)', PRPT_REPORT)) <> '' THEN UPPER(DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)DIAGNOSIS:[\w\W]*(?=NOTE:)', PRPT_REPORT)) WHEN UPPER(DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)DIAGNOSIS:[\w\W]*(?=MORPHOLOGY)', PRPT_REPORT)) <> '' THEN UPPER(DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)DIAGNOSIS:[\w\W]*(?=MORPHOLOGY)', PRPT_REPORT)) WHEN UPPER(DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)DIAGNOSIS:[\w\W]*(?=I ATTEST)', PRPT_REPORT)) <> '' THEN UPPER(DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)DIAGNOSIS:[\w\W]*(?=I ATTEST)', PRPT_REPORT)) END AS DIAGNOSIS, UPPER(CASE WHEN LENGTH(PRPT_REPORT) <= 18000 THEN RTRIM(CAST(SUBSTR(PRPT_REPORT, 1, 18000) AS VARCHAR(18000))) ELSE CAST(SUBSTR(PRPT_REPORT, 1, 18000) AS VARCHAR(18000)) END) AS TXT FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V" "t1" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED" "t6" ON "t1"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t6"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V" "t2" ON "t6"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t2"."PRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATH_RPRT_TYPE_LOOKUP" "t3" ON "t2"."PRPT_REPORT_TYPE" = "t3"."PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_CD" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" "t4" ON "t2"."PRPT_PROCEDURE_DATE_ID" = "t4"."DT_DATE_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" "t5" ON "t2"."PRPT_REPORT_DATE_ID" = "t5"."DT_DATE_ID" WHERE 1=1 AND CONTAINS("t2"."PRPT_REPORT", '("adult T-cell leukemia/lymphoma" OR "adult T cell leukemia/lymphoma" OR "ATLL" OR "HTLV-1/2" OR "HTLV-I/II" OR "HTLV")') = 1 AND "t2"."PRPT_REPORT" IS NOT NULL AND "t4"."DT_DTE" >= '2017-01-01' AND "t2"."PRPT_ACCESSION_NO" LIKE 'H%' ) SELECT * FROM X WHERE UPPER(DIAGNOSIS) like '%ADULT T%CELL LEUKEMIA/LYMPHOMA%' OR UPPER(DIAGNOSIS) like '%ATLL%' OR UPPER(DIAGNOSIS) like '%HTLV%'

prompt: Design a daily report of PET procedure patients who present with a blood glucose of >=200 or <70 for Nassau.
completion: WITH X_TMP AS (SELECT DISTINCT STRIP(CPE_MRN) AS MRN, CPE_ENC_CSN_ID, CPE_RIS_EXTERNAL_ORD_ID, CPE_CPE_IP_IND, CPE_ENC_DTE AS "Appt Date", TIME(CPE_APPT_DT) AS "Appt Time", STRIP(CPE_CPE_APPT_STS) AS "Appt Status", STRIP(CPE_CPE_CANCEL_RSN) AS "Cancel Reason", STRIP(CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME) AS "Visit Type", STRIP(CRE_RES_NAME) AS CRE_RES_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CPE_MRN, CPE_ENC_DTE ORDER BY CPE_CPE_APPT_STS DESC) AS APPT_RN FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE 1=1 AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN '2020-10-01' AND '2021-03-31' AND CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME like '%FDG%' AND CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Can', 'Comp') ) , X AS (SELECT X_TMP.* FROM X_TMP LEFT JOIN IDB.VISIT_V ON MRN = VIS_MRN AND "Appt Date" BETWEEN VIS_ADM_DTE AND COALESCE(VIS_DSCH_DTE, CURRENT date) AND VIS_IP_OP_ADJUSTED_IND = 'I' WHERE VIS_MRN IS NULL ) , GL AS (SELECT DISTINCT STRIP(LR_MRN) AS MRN, CPE_ENC_CSN_ID, LR_PERFORMED_DTE AS PERFORMED_DTE, TIME(LR_PERFORMED_DT) AS PERFORMED_TIME, STRIP(LR_TEST_NAME) AS TEST_NAME, STRIP(LR_SUBTEST_NAME) AS SUBTEST_NAME, STRIP(LR_RESULT_VALUE) AS RESULT_VALUE, STRIP(LR_UNIT_MEASURE) AS UNIT_MEASURE FROM X JOIN IDB.LAB_RESULTS ON LR_MRN = MRN AND LR_PERFORMED_DTE = "Appt Date" LEFT JOIN IDB.LAB_TEXT_LINE ON LTL_RESULT_GUID = LR_RESULT_GUID WHERE UPPER(LR_SUBTEST_NAME) LIKE '%GLUCOSE%BEDSIDE%' AND UPPER(LR_SUBTEST_NAME) NOT LIKE '%URINE%' AND LR_RESULT_VALUE <> '' AND LR_RESULT_VALUE NOT IN ('Normal', 'Indeterminate') AND LR_RESULT_VALUE NOT LIKE '%<%' AND LR_RESULT_VALUE NOT LIKE '%>%' UNION SELECT DISTINCT STRIP(LR_MRN) AS MRN, CPE_ENC_CSN_ID, LR_PERFORMED_DTE AS PERFORMED_DTE, TIME(LR_PERFORMED_DT) AS PERFORMED_TIME, STRIP(LR_TEST_NAME) AS TEST_NAME, STRIP(LR_SUBTEST_NAME) AS SUBTEST_NAME, STRIP(LR_RESULT_VALUE) AS RESULT_VALUE, STRIP(LR_UNIT_MEASURE) AS UNIT_MEASURE FROM X JOIN IDB.LAB_RESULTS ON LR_MRN = MRN AND LR_PERFORMED_DTE = "Appt Date" LEFT JOIN IDB.LAB_TEXT_LINE ON LTL_RESULT_GUID = LR_RESULT_GUID WHERE UPPER(LR_SUBTEST_NAME) LIKE '%GLUCOSE%BEDSIDE%' AND UPPER(LR_SUBTEST_NAME) NOT LIKE '%URINE%' AND(LR_RESULT_VALUE LIKE '%<%' OR LR_RESULT_VALUE LIKE '%>%') ) , Y_TMP AS (SELECT X.*, PERFORMED_DTE, PERFORMED_TIME, TEST_NAME, SUBTEST_NAME, RESULT_VALUE, UNIT_MEASURE FROM X JOIN GL ON X.MRN = GL.MRN AND X.CPE_ENC_CSN_ID = GL.CPE_ENC_CSN_ID AND PERFORMED_DTE = "Appt Date" WHERE 1=1 AND(RESULT_VALUE like '%<%' OR RESULT_VALUE like '%>%') UNION SELECT X.*, PERFORMED_DTE, PERFORMED_TIME, TEST_NAME, SUBTEST_NAME, RESULT_VALUE, UNIT_MEASURE FROM X JOIN GL ON X.MRN = GL.MRN AND X.CPE_ENC_CSN_ID = GL.CPE_ENC_CSN_ID AND PERFORMED_DTE = "Appt Date" WHERE 1=1 AND NOT(RESULT_VALUE like '%<%' OR RESULT_VALUE like '%>%') AND NOT RESULT_VALUE BETWEEN 70 AND 200 ) , Y AS (SELECT Y_TMP.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CPE_ENC_CSN_ID ORDER BY PERFORMED_DTE, PERFORMED_TIME) AS RN FROM Y_TMP) , Z1 AS (SELECT MRN, CPE_ENC_CSN_ID, PERFORMED_TIME, TEST_NAME, SUBTEST_NAME, RESULT_VALUE, UNIT_MEASURE FROM Y WHERE RN = 1 ) , Z2 AS (SELECT MRN, CPE_ENC_CSN_ID, PERFORMED_TIME, TEST_NAME, SUBTEST_NAME, RESULT_VALUE, UNIT_MEASURE FROM Y WHERE RN = 2 ) , Z3 AS (SELECT MRN, CPE_ENC_CSN_ID, LISTAGG(COALESCE(STRIP(PERFORMED_TIME), '') || ' | ' || COALESCE(STRIP(CAST(RESULT_VALUE AS VARCHAR(12000))), '') || ' | ' || COALESCE(STRIP(CAST(UNIT_MEASURE AS VARCHAR(12000))), '') , CHR(13) || CHR(10)) WITHIN GROUP( ORDER BY MRN, CPE_ENC_CSN_ID, PERFORMED_TIME) AS GLUCOSE_VALUES_OTHER FROM Y WHERE RN >= 3 GROUP BY MRN, CPE_ENC_CSN_ID) SELECT DISTINCT Y.MRN, Y.CPE_ENC_CSN_ID, CPE_RIS_EXTERNAL_ORD_ID, CPE_CPE_IP_IND, "Appt Date", "Appt Time", "Appt Status", "Cancel Reason", "Visit Type", CRE_RES_NAME, Z1.PERFORMED_TIME AS FIRST_GLUCOSE_TIME, Z1.RESULT_VALUE AS FIRST_GLUCOSE_VALUE, Z1.UNIT_MEASURE AS FIRST_GLUCOSE_UNIT, Z2.PERFORMED_TIME AS SECOND_GLUCOSE_TIME, Z2.RESULT_VALUE AS SECOND_GLUCOSE_VALUE, Z2.UNIT_MEASURE AS SECOND_GLUCOSE_UNIT, GLUCOSE_VALUES_OTHER FROM Y LEFT JOIN Z1 ON Y.CPE_ENC_CSN_ID = Z1.CPE_ENC_CSN_ID LEFT JOIN Z2 ON Y.CPE_ENC_CSN_ID = Z2.CPE_ENC_CSN_ID LEFT JOIN Z3 ON Y.CPE_ENC_CSN_ID = Z3.CPE_ENC_CSN_ID WHERE APPT_RN = 1

prompt: Design an on demand report to pull the responses to pull the data under the Range of Motion questionnaire in the MSK Engage system
completion: WITH X AS (SELECT DISTINCT STRIP(EF_MRN) AS EF_MRN, EFI_FORM_ID, STRIP(EF_FORM_NAME) AS EF_FORM_NAME, EF_FORM_ALIAS, EF_SUBMISSION_DT, EFI_PARENT_ITEM_ID, EFI_ITEM_TEXT, EFI_ITEM_ALIAS, EFI_ITEM_SHORT_NAME, EFI_ITEM_EXTERNAL_ID, EFI_ITEM_SEQUENCE, STRIP(SUBSTR(EFI_VALUE, 1, 2000)) AS EFI_VALUE FROM IDB.EF_FORM JOIN IDB.EF_FORM_ITEM ON EFI_FORM_ID = EF_FORM_ID WHERE DATE(EF_SUBMISSION_DT) BETWEEN '2022-09-01' AND CURRENT date AND EF_FORM_NAME = 'Arm and Shoulder Range of Motion Questionnaire' ) SELECT DISTINCT X.EF_MRN, X.EF_FORM_NAME, X.EFI_FORM_ID, DATE(X.EF_SUBMISSION_DT) AS EF_SUBMISSION_DTE, X1.EFI_VALUE AS "In past 7 days, symptoms or problems with your shoulder, arm, or hand?", X2.EFI_VALUE AS "How much did problems get in the way of you opening a new or tight jar?", X3.EFI_VALUE AS "How much did problems make it hard to do heavy household chores?", X4.EFI_VALUE AS "How bad was your shoulder, arm, or hand pain at its worst?", X5.EFI_VALUE AS "How bad was your tingling in your shoulder, arm, or hand at its worst?", X6.EFI_VALUE AS "Do you have a job?", X7.EFI_VALUE AS "Did any of the following problems make it hard to do your job?", X8.EFI_VALUE AS "Do you play sports or a musical instrument?", X9.EFI_VALUE AS "Have any of the following problems made it hard to play sports or musical instrument?", X10.EFI_VALUE AS "Who completed this assessment?", X11.EFI_VALUE AS "Please describe" FROM X LEFT JOIN X X1 ON X1.EFI_FORM_ID = X.EFI_FORM_ID AND X1.EFI_ITEM_TEXT = 'In the past 7 days, have you had any of the following symptoms or problems because of trouble with your shoulder, arm, or hand?' LEFT JOIN X X2 ON X2.EFI_FORM_ID = X.EFI_FORM_ID AND X2.EFI_ITEM_TEXT = 'How much did problems with your shoulder, arm, or hand get in the way of you opening a new or tight jar?' LEFT JOIN X X3 ON X3.EFI_FORM_ID = X.EFI_FORM_ID AND X3.EFI_ITEM_TEXT = 'How much did problems with your shoulder, arm, or hand make it hard to do heavy household chores (such as wash walls or floors)?' LEFT JOIN X X4 ON X4.EFI_FORM_ID = X.EFI_FORM_ID AND X4.EFI_ITEM_TEXT = 'How bad was your shoulder, arm, or hand pain at its worst?' LEFT JOIN X X5 ON X5.EFI_FORM_ID = X.EFI_FORM_ID AND X5.EFI_ITEM_TEXT = 'How bad was your tingling (pins and needles) in your shoulder, arm, or hand at its worst?' LEFT JOIN X X6 ON X6.EFI_FORM_ID = X.EFI_FORM_ID AND X6.EFI_ITEM_TEXT = 'Do you have a job?' LEFT JOIN X X7 ON X7.EFI_FORM_ID = X.EFI_FORM_ID AND X7.EFI_ITEM_TEXT = 'Did any of the following problems make it hard to do your job?' LEFT JOIN X X8 ON X8.EFI_FORM_ID = X.EFI_FORM_ID AND X8.EFI_ITEM_TEXT = 'Do you play sports or a musical instrument?' LEFT JOIN X X9 ON X9.EFI_FORM_ID = X.EFI_FORM_ID AND X9.EFI_ITEM_TEXT = 'Have any of the following problems made it hard to play sports or a musical instrument?' LEFT JOIN X X10 ON X10.EFI_FORM_ID = X.EFI_FORM_ID AND X10.EFI_ITEM_TEXT = 'Who completed this assessment?' LEFT JOIN X X11 ON X11.EFI_FORM_ID = X.EFI_FORM_ID AND X11.EFI_ITEM_TEXT = 'Please describe' WHERE 1=1 AND DATE(X.EF_SUBMISSION_DT) BETWEEN DATE(#PROMPT('Start Date', 'STRING', '1993-01-01')#) AND DATE(#PROMPT ('End Date', 'STRING', '2040-12-31')#)

prompt: Provide daily list of patients I have visited as chaplain at Koch who are admitted at Main
completion: WITH AD AS (SELECT V.VIS_MRN, V.VIS_VISIT_ID, V.VIS_ADM_DTE, VIS_NURS_STA ADMIT_NURS_STA, VIS_BED ADMIT_BED, VIS_ROOM_NUM ADMIT_ROOM_NUM, UC_HOSP_SVC, AV_DESC HOSP_SVC_DESC, TRIM(UC_BED) AS CURR_BED , TRIM(SUBSTR(LTRIM(UC_BED), 1, CASE WHEN LOCATE('_', UC_BED) > 0 THEN LOCATE('_', UC_BED) - 1 WHEN LOCATE(' ', LTRIM(UC_BED)) > 0 THEN LOCATE(' ', LTRIM(UC_BED)) - 1 ELSE LENGTH(TRIM(UC_BED)) END)) AS CURR_ROOM FROM IDB.VISIT V JOIN IDB.UNIFIED_CENSUS A ON V.VIS_VISIT_ID = A.UC_VISIT_ID AND A.UC_END_DTE IS NULL JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS ON AV_CODE = UC_HOSP_SVC AND AV_ELEMENT = 'HOSP_SVC' WHERE 1=1 AND V.VIS_DSCH_DTE IS NULL AND (VIS_IP_OP_ADJUSTED_IND = 'I' OR VIS_PATIENT_TYPE IN ('OAXR', 'OUCO')) AND VIS_VISIT_STATUS IN ('2', '3') ) SELECT CDD_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, YEAR(CURRENT date - PT_BIRTH_DTE) CURR_AGE, PT_SEX_DESC, PT_GENDER GENDER_IDENTITY, UC_HOSP_SVC HOSP_SVC, HOSP_SVC_DESC, VIS_VISIT_ID, VIS_ADM_DTE, ADMIT_NURS_STA, ADMIT_BED, ADMIT_ROOM_NUM, CURR_BED, CURR_ROOM, LISTAGG(CDD_AUTHORED_DTE, ', ') WITHIN GROUP ( ORDER BY CDD_AUTHORED_DTE) CLINDOC_DATES, LISTAGG(DISTINCT CDD_DOCUMENT_TEMPLATE_NAME, ', ') AS CLINDOC_NAMES, CDD_AUTH_PROV_NAME FROM DV.CLINDOC_FULL_TEXT_V JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON PT_MRN=CDD_MRN JOIN AD ON CDD_MRN = VIS_MRN WHERE 1=1 AND CDD_AUTH_PROV_NAME IN ('Kelly, Brian') GROUP BY CDD_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, YEAR(CURRENT date - PT_BIRTH_DTE), PT_SEX_DESC, PT_GENDER, CDD_AUTH_PROV_NAME , VIS_VISIT_ID, VIS_ADM_DTE, ADMIT_NURS_STA, ADMIT_BED, ADMIT_ROOM_NUM, CURR_BED, CURR_ROOM, UC_HOSP_SVC, HOSP_SVC_DESC ORDER BY CDD_MRN

prompt: Provide a list of patients who received treatment with DS-8201a (Trastuzumab Deruxtecan) non-investigational.
completion: WITH CHEMO AS (SELECT DISTINCT CPO_MRN, CPO_ENTER_DTE, CPO_ORD_NAME, CPO_DRUG_NAME, CPO_START_DTE, CPO_STOP_DTE, CPO_SET_NAME, CPO_SET_FORM_NAME, CPO_TIME_PRIORITY, CPO_VERIFY_POLICY, CPO_LOC_NAME, CPO_LOC_CD, CPO_FREQ , CPO_SUMMARY_LINE, CPO_DOSE, CPO_DOSE_UNIT, CPO_MED_FORM, CPO_DOC_SVC, CPO_PROVIDER, CPO_PVDR_ROLE, CPO_ADMIN_CNT, CPO_EMAR_TTL_DOSE, CPO_GENERIC_NAME, CPO_INVESTIGATIVE_FLAG, CPO_STS_DESC FROM IDB.CHEMO_PERFORMED_ORDERS CPO WHERE 1=1 AND CPO_ORD_NAME = 'fam-TRAStuzumab DERUXtecan-nxki INJ' AND CPO_INVESTIGATIVE_FLAG = 'N' ) SELECT DISTINCT "t1"."PT_MRN" AS "MRN", "t1"."PT_LAST_NAME" AS "Last Name", "t1"."PT_FIRST_NAME" AS "First Name", "t1"."PT_BIRTH_DTE" AS "Date of Birth", "t1"."PT_DEATH_DTE" AS "Deceased Date", CASE WHEN "t1"."PT_DEATH_DTE" IS NULL THEN YEAR(CURRENT date - "t1"."PT_BIRTH_DTE") END AS "Cur Age", "t1"."PT_VITAL_STATUS" AS "Vital Status", "t1"."PT_SEX_DESC" AS "Gender", "t1"."PT_RACE_DESC" AS "Race", "t2"."CORE_ETHNICITY_DESC" AS "Ethnicity", "t3"."PLA_LAST_DRVST_DTE" AS "Last Dr Visit Date" FROM CHEMO JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS" "t1" ON PT_MRN = CPO_MRN LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_CORE_DEMOGRAPHICS" "t2" ON "t1"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t2"."CORE_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_LATEST_ACTIVITY" "t3" ON "t1"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t3"."PLA_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" ORDER BY PT_MRN ; WITH CHEMO AS (SELECT DISTINCT CPO_MRN, CPO_ENTER_DTE, CPO_ORD_NAME, CPO_DRUG_NAME, CPO_START_DTE, CPO_STOP_DTE, CPO_SET_NAME, CPO_SET_FORM_NAME, CPO_TIME_PRIORITY, CPO_VERIFY_POLICY, CPO_LOC_NAME, CPO_LOC_CD, CPO_FREQ , CPO_SUMMARY_LINE, CPO_DOSE, CPO_DOSE_UNIT, CPO_MED_FORM, CPO_DOC_SVC, CPO_PROVIDER, CPO_PVDR_ROLE, CPO_ADMIN_CNT, CPO_EMAR_TTL_DOSE, CPO_GENERIC_NAME, CPO_INVESTIGATIVE_FLAG, CPO_STS_DESC FROM IDB.CHEMO_PERFORMED_ORDERS CPO WHERE 1=1 AND CPO_ORD_NAME = 'fam-TRAStuzumab DERUXtecan-nxki INJ' AND CPO_INVESTIGATIVE_FLAG = 'N' ) SELECT * FROM CHEMO ORDER BY CPO_MRN, CPO_ENTER_DTE ;

prompt: Provide a list of blood draws for protocol patients

C.PROTOCOL_SUBJECT_ID = F.PROTOCOL_SUBJECT_ID WHERE OFF_STUDYDATE IS NULL GROUP BY C.SUBJECT_MRN ) , BLOOD_DRAW AS (SELECT RVCD_MRN, RVCD_SVC_DTE, VIS_ADM_NUM, VIS_IP_OP_ADJUSTED_IND , RVCD_VISIT_ID, DEPARTMENT_NUMBER, DEPARTMENT_MNEMONIC, DEPARTMENT_NAME, RVCD_CHARGE_CODE_REC_NO, CHARGE_CD, CHARGE_DESCRIPTION, REV_CODE, REV_CODE_DESC, HCPCS_REC_NO, HCPCS_CODE, HCPCS_DESC, RVCD_AMT, CASE WHEN (CHARGE_MOD1_CD = 'RS' OR CHARGE_MOD2_CD = 'RS' OR CHARGE_MOD3_CD = 'RS' OR CHARGE_MOD4_CD = 'RS' OR CHARGE_MOD5_CD = 'RS' OR CHARGE_MOD6_CD = 'RS' OR CHARGE_MOD7_CD = 'RS' OR CHARGE_MOD8_CD = 'RS' OR CHARGE_MOD9_CD = 'RS' OR CHARGE_MOD10_CD = 'RS') THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END "Blood Draw Modifer RS" FROM PTS JOIN IDB.RMS_VISIT_CHARGE_DTL_V CHG ON SUBJECT_MRN = RVCD_MRN AND RVCD_SVC_DTE BETWEEN FIRST_CONSENT_DATE AND CURRENT date WHERE VIS_ADM_NUM IN ('26449602', '25400724', '28008050') AND HCPCS_CODE IN ('36591', '36592', '36415') ) , QUALIFYING_BD AS (SELECT RVCD_MRN, RVCD_SVC_DTE, VIS_ADM_NUM, RVCD_VISIT_ID, COUNT(*) BD_COUNT, MIN("Blood Draw Modifer RS") MIN_BD_MODIFIER, MAX("Blood Draw Modifer RS") MAX_BD_MODIFIER FROM BLOOD_DRAW GROUP BY RVCD_MRN, RVCD_SVC_DTE, VIS_ADM_NUM, RVCD_VISIT_ID) , LABS AS (SELECT RVCD_MRN, RVCD_SVC_DTE, VIS_ADM_NUM, VIS_IP_OP_ADJUSTED_IND , RVCD_VISIT_ID, DEPARTMENT_NUMBER, DEPARTMENT_MNEMONIC, DEPARTMENT_NAME, RVCD_CHARGE_CODE_REC_NO, CHARGE_CD, CHARGE_DESCRIPTION, REV_CODE, REV_CODE_DESC, HCPCS_REC_NO, HCPCS_CODE, HCPCS_DESC, SUM(RVCD_AMT) RVCD_AMT, CASE WHEN (CHARGE_MOD1_CD = 'RS' OR CHARGE_MOD2_CD = 'RS' OR CHARGE_MOD3_CD = 'RS' OR CHARGE_MOD4_CD = 'RS' OR CHARGE_MOD5_CD = 'RS' OR CHARGE_MOD6_CD = 'RS' OR CHARGE_MOD7_CD = 'RS' OR CHARGE_MOD8_CD = 'RS' OR CHARGE_MOD9_CD = 'RS' OR CHARGE_MOD10_CD = 'RS') THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END "Lab Modifer RS" FROM PTS JOIN IDB.RMS_VISIT_CHARGE_DTL_V CHG ON SUBJECT_MRN = RVCD_MRN AND RVCD_SVC_DTE BETWEEN FIRST_CONSENT_DATE AND CURRENT date WHERE VIS_ADM_NUM IN ('26449602', '25400724', '28008050') AND HCPCS_CODE NOT IN ('36591', '36592', '36415') AND DEPARTMENT_NUMBER IN (05, 08, 10, 11, 14, 13, 20, 21, 24, 43) GROUP BY RVCD_MRN, RVCD_SVC_DTE, VIS_ADM_NUM, VIS_IP_OP_ADJUSTED_IND , RVCD_VISIT_ID, DEPARTMENT_NUMBER, DEPARTMENT_MNEMONIC, DEPARTMENT_NAME, RVCD_CHARGE_CODE_REC_NO, CHARGE_CD, CHARGE_DESCRIPTION, REV_CODE, REV_CODE_DESC, HCPCS_REC_NO, HCPCS_CODE, HCPCS_DESC, CASE WHEN (CHARGE_MOD1_CD = 'RS' OR CHARGE_MOD2_CD = 'RS' OR CHARGE_MOD3_CD = 'RS' OR CHARGE_MOD4_CD = 'RS' OR CHARGE_MOD5_CD = 'RS' OR CHARGE_MOD6_CD = 'RS' OR CHARGE_MOD7_CD = 'RS' OR CHARGE_MOD8_CD = 'RS' OR CHARGE_MOD9_CD = 'RS' OR CHARGE_MOD10_CD = 'RS') THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END HAVING SUM(RVCD_AMT) > 0) , QUALIFYING_LABS AS (SELECT RVCD_MRN, RVCD_SVC_DTE, VIS_ADM_NUM, RVCD_VISIT_ID, COUNT(*) LAB_COUNT, MIN("Lab Modifer RS") MIN_LAB_MODIFIER, MAX("Lab Modifer RS") MAX_LAB_MODIFIER FROM LABS GROUP BY RVCD_MRN, RVCD_SVC_DTE, VIS_ADM_NUM, RVCD_VISIT_ID) SELECT PT_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, BD.RVCD_SVC_DTE, BD.VIS_ADM_NUM, BD.HCPCS_CODE BLOOD_DRAW_HCPCS_CODE, BD.HCPCS_DESC BLOOD_DRAW_HCPCS_DESC, BD.RVCD_AMT BLOOD_DRAW_AMT, "Blood Draw Modifer RS", PROTOCOLS FROM BLOOD_DRAW BD JOIN QUALIFYING_BD QBD ON BD.RVCD_MRN = QBD.RVCD_MRN AND BD.RVCD_SVC_DTE = QBD.RVCD_SVC_DTE AND BD.RVCD_VISIT_ID = QBD.RVCD_VISIT_ID LEFT JOIN QUALIFYING_LABS L ON BD.RVCD_MRN = L.RVCD_MRN AND BD.RVCD_SVC_DTE = L.RVCD_SVC_DTE AND BD.RVCD_VISIT_ID = L.RVCD_VISIT_ID JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON BD.RVCD_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN PTS ON BD.RVCD_MRN = SUBJECT_MRN WHERE CASE WHEN BD_COUNT >= 2 THEN 1 WHEN BD_COUNT >= 1 AND L.RVCD_MRN IS NULL THEN 1 WHEN BD_COUNT = 1 AND MIN_BD_MODIFIER = 'N' AND MAX_BD_MODIFIER = 'N' AND MIN_LAB_MODIFIER = 'N' AND MAX_LAB_MODIFIER = 'N' THEN 0 WHEN BD_COUNT = 1 AND MIN_BD_MODIFIER = 'N' AND MAX_BD_MODIFIER = 'N' AND MAX_LAB_MODIFIER = 'Y' THEN 1 WHEN BD_COUNT = 1 AND MIN_BD_MODIFIER = 'Y' AND MAX_BD_MODIFIER = 'Y' AND MIN_LAB_MODIFIER = 'N' THEN 1 WHEN BD_COUNT = 1 AND MIN_BD_MODIFIER = 'Y' AND MAX_BD_MODIFIER = 'Y' AND MIN_LAB_MODIFIER = 'Y' AND MAX_LAB_MODIFIER = 'Y' THEN 0 ELSE 0 END = 1

prompt: Modify SKI17638  report to schedule Mon and Wed for the next week Mon - Fri.
completion: WITH SRG AS (SELECT PT_MRN MRN, STRIP(PT_LAST_NAME)||', '||STRIP(PT_FIRST_NAME) PT_NAME, OC_SURG_DTE SURG_DTE, OC_CASE_ID CASEID, OCAP_PNL_NO PANEL_NO, OC_OR_CASE_STS CASE_STS, LOC_LOC_NAME LOCATION, CPX_PROC_CD CPT_CODE, CPX_PROC_NAME PROC_NAME, OCAP_LAT LATERALITY, OC_SCH_DT SCH_DT, CRE_RES_NAME SURGEON, OCAS_SURG_ROLE SURG_ROLE, OCAS_SURG_SVC SURG_SVC FROM IDB.OR_CASE JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PT_MRN = OC_MRN JOIN IDB.OR_CASE_ALL_PROC ON OC_CASE_ID = OCAP_CASE_ID JOIN IDB.OR_CASE_ALL_SURG ON OCAP_CASE_ID = OCAS_CASE_ID AND OCAP_PNL_NO = OCAS_PNL_NO JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON OCAS_RES_ID=CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.OR_CL_PROC ON OCAP_OR_PROC_ID= OCP_OR_PROC_ID JOIN IDB.CL_PROC CL_PROC ON OCP_PROC_ID = CPX_PROC_ID JOIN IDB.CL_LOCATION ON OC_SURG_LOC_ID = LOC_LOC_ID WHERE OCAP_LAT_CD IN (1, 2) AND LOC_LOC_NAME = 'JOSIE ROBERTSON' AND OC_OR_CASE_STS='Sch' AND (OC_SURG_DTE BETWEEN CASE DAYOFWEEK(CURRENT date) WHEN 2 THEN CURRENT DATE + 7 DAY WHEN 4 THEN CURRENT DATE + 5 DAY END AND CASE DAYOFWEEK(CURRENT date) WHEN 2 THEN CURRENT DATE + 11 DAY WHEN 4 THEN CURRENT DATE + 9 DAY END) AND OCAS_SURG_ROLE='Primary' ) SELECT MRN, PT_NAME, CASEID, SURG_DTE, LOCATION, PROC_NAME, SURGEON FROM SRG WHERE CASEID NOT IN (SELECT CASEID FROM SRG WHERE SURG_SVC = 'PLA') AND CASEID IN (SELECT CASEID FROM SRG WHERE CPT_CODE = '19303')

prompt: Provide oral and IV drugs administered at MSK for cohort of IMPACT-patients who received immunotherapy at MSK
completion: SELECT OO_MRN MRN , OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE DATE_ADMIN , OOC_ITEM_NAME ORDER_NAME , CASE WHEN NFN.OUD_USER_DI_VALUE IS NOT NULL THEN NFN.OUD_USER_DI_VALUE ELSE STRIP(OO_ORD_NAME)||' '||STRIP(OO_ORD_MODIFIER) END DRUG_NAME , OMD_ORD_ROUTE ROUTE , OOC_THERAPEUTIC_CAT THERAPEUTIC_CAT , OO_ORD_PRIO AS WHERE_TO_FILL , CASE WHEN OO_REQ_TME_PRIO IN ('NYS Paper', 'Outside Order', 'Fill at MSK', 'Medicaid') OR OO_IS_FOR_DSCH = 'Y' OR(OO_REQ_TME_PRIO = 'Routine' AND OCV_IP_OP_IND = 'O' AND OCV_CARE_LVL NOT IN ('AXR', 'UCO', 'OR', 'UCC')) THEN 'Rx' ELSE OCV_IP_OP_IND||'P' END AS ORD_TYPE FROM IDB.OMS_ORDER JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_CATALOG ON OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID = OOC_MSTR_ITEM_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_MED_DETAIL ON OMD_ORD_GUID = OO_ORD_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_CLIENT_VISIT ON OCV_VISIT_GUID = OO_VISIT_GUID LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_FORM_FIELD ON OO_ENTRY_FRM_GUID = OFF_ENTRY_FRM_GUID AND OFF_FLD_LABEL IN ('Non-Formulary Medication Name:', 'Medication Name:') LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_USER_DATA NFN ON NFN.OUD_ORD_GUID = OO_ORD_GUID AND OFF_DI_CD = NFN.OUD_USER_DI_CD WHERE OO_ORD_STS_CD NOT IN ('CANC', 'CANP', 'AUC3') AND TRIM(OMD_ORD_ROUTE) <> '' AND OO_MRN IN ({})

prompt: Provide a report of Dr. Diamond's blood controls for IMPACT, MSK ACCESS.
completion: WITH X AS (SELECT DISTINCT OO_MRN AS MRN, STRIP(PT_LAST_NAME) || ', ' ||STRIP(PT_FIRST_NAME) AS NAME, OO_ENTER_DTE, OO_ORD_ID, OO_ORD_NAME, OUO_PVDR_NAME, OUO_ATN_PVDR_NAME, OO_ORD_STS_CD AS "Order Status", OSTS_STS_DESC AS "Status Description", '' AS OFF_FLD_LABEL, '' AS OUD_USER_DI_VALUE FROM IDB.PATIENT JOIN IDB.OMS_ORDER OO ON PT_MRN = OO_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_USER_ORDERS ON OO_ORD_GUID = OUO_ORD_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_STATUS ON OO_ORD_STS_CD = OSTS_ORD_STS_CD LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_USER_DATA ON OO_ORD_GUID = OUD_ORD_GUID WHERE OO_ORD_STS_CD NOT IN ('CANC', 'CANP', 'AUC3') AND OO_ORD_NAME = 'MSK-ACCESS cfDNA (for pts with Solid Tumor)' AND(UPPER(OUO_PVDR_NAME) like '%DIAMOND%ELI%' OR UPPER(OUO_ATN_PVDR_NAME) like '%DIAMOND%ELI%') ) , P AS (SELECT DISTINCT "t1"."PT_MRN" AS "MRN", "t2"."PRPT_ACCESSION_NO" AS "Pathology Report", "t3"."PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_DESC" AS "Pathology Report Type", "t4"."DT_DTE" AS "Pathology Procedure Date", UPPER(CASE WHEN LENGTH(PRPT_REPORT) <= 15000 THEN RTRIM(CAST(SUBSTR(PRPT_REPORT, 1, 15000) AS VARCHAR(15000))) ELSE CAST(SUBSTR(PRPT_REPORT, 1, 15000) AS VARCHAR(15000)) END) AS TXT, CASE WHEN UPPER(DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)INTERPRETATION[\w\W]*(?=MSK-ACCESS)', PRPT_REPORT)) <> '' THEN UPPER(DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)INTERPRETATION[\w\W]*(?=MSK-ACCESS)', PRPT_REPORT)) WHEN UPPER(DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)INTERPRETATION[\w\W]*(?=NOTE:)', PRPT_REPORT)) <> '' THEN UPPER(DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)INTERPRETATION[\w\W]*(?=NOTE:)', PRPT_REPORT)) END AS INTERPRETATION FROM X JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V" "t1" ON MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED" "t6" ON "t1"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t6"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V" "t2" ON "t6"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t2"."PRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATH_RPRT_TYPE_LOOKUP" "t3" ON "t2"."PRPT_REPORT_TYPE" = "t3"."PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_CD" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" "t4" ON "t2"."PRPT_PROCEDURE_DATE_ID" = "t4"."DT_DATE_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" "t5" ON "t2"."PRPT_REPORT_DATE_ID" = "t5"."DT_DATE_ID" WHERE 1=1 AND "t2"."PRPT_REPORT" IS NOT NULL AND "t4"."DT_DTE" BETWEEN OO_ENTER_DTE AND OO_ENTER_DTE + 7 DAYS AND UPPER("t3"."PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_DESC") LIKE '%DIAGNOSTIC%' AND CONTAINS("t2"."PRPT_REPORT", '(("INTERPRETATION"))') = 1 AND CONTAINS("t2"."PRPT_REPORT", '(("SUMMARY"))') = 1 ) SELECT DISTINCT X.* FROM X JOIN P ON X.MRN = P.MRN

prompt: On-demand report similar to  SKI28374  with a provision  to type in the Protocol number  and search for patients on protocol of interest with Consent discussion note.
completion: WITH CDD AS (SELECT CDD_MRN, CDD_SERVICE_DTE, CDD_DOC_GUID, U1.OU_DISPLAY_NAME AS AUTHOR, U1.OU_OCCUPATION AS OCCUPATION, U1.OU_ORD_ROLE_TYPE AS AUTH_ROLE, TRIM(UPPER(CDO_ITEM_NAME)) AS ITEM_NAME, TRIM(CDO_VALUE_TEXT) AS VALUE_TEXT FROM IDB.CD_DOCUMENT JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION ON CDD_DOC_GUID = CDO_DOC_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_USER U1 ON CDD_AUTH_PROV_GUID = U1.OU_USER_GUID WHERE 1=1 AND CDD_SERVICE_DTE >= '2023-01-01' AND CDD_DOC_NAME = 'Consent Discussion, Treatment/Protocol' AND CDO_SECTION = 'CONSENT DISCUSSION' AND UPPER(CDO_ITEM_NAME) IN ('CONSENT DISCUSSION: TREATMENT PLAN/PROTOCOL', 'CONSENT DISCUSSION: DATE OF CONSENT SIGNED', 'DISCUSSION SUMMARY', 'CONSENT REVIEWED', 'CONSENT/RECONSENT OPTIONS', 'STUDY DECLINED') AND CDD_CANCEL_IND <> '1' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND <> '1' ) SELECT DISTINCT C.CDD_MRN, TRIM(PT_LAST_NAME) || ', ' || TRIM(PT_FIRST_NAME) AS PATIENT_NAME, PT_SEX SEX, TRIM(R.AV_DESC) AS RACE, TRIM(E.AV_DESC) AS ETHNICITY, C.CDD_SERVICE_DTE, C.AUTHOR, C.OCCUPATION, C.AUTH_ROLE, LISTAGG(C1.VALUE_TEXT, ', ') AS PROTOCOL, MAX(C2.VALUE_TEXT) AS CONSENT, MAX(C3.VALUE_TEXT) AS STUDY_DECLINED, MAX(C4.VALUE_TEXT) AS DISCUSSION_SUMMARY, MAX(C5.VALUE_TEXT) AS CONSENT_DATE FROM CDD C JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON CDD_MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS R ON PT_RACE = R.AV_CODE AND R.AV_ELEMENT = 'RACE' LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS E ON PT_PT_ETHNICITY = E.AV_CODE AND E.AV_ELEMENT = 'PT_ETHNICITY' LEFT JOIN CDD C1 ON C1.CDD_DOC_GUID = C.CDD_DOC_GUID AND UPPER(C1.ITEM_NAME) = 'CONSENT DISCUSSION: TREATMENT PLAN/PROTOCOL' LEFT JOIN CDD C2 ON C2.CDD_DOC_GUID = C.CDD_DOC_GUID AND UPPER(C2.ITEM_NAME) = 'CONSENT/RECONSENT OPTIONS' LEFT JOIN CDD C3 ON C3.CDD_DOC_GUID = C.CDD_DOC_GUID AND UPPER(C3.ITEM_NAME) = 'STUDY DECLINED' LEFT JOIN CDD C4 ON C4.CDD_DOC_GUID = C.CDD_DOC_GUID AND UPPER(C4.ITEM_NAME) = 'DISCUSSION SUMMARY' LEFT JOIN CDD C5 ON C5.CDD_DOC_GUID = C.CDD_DOC_GUID AND UPPER(C5.ITEM_NAME) = 'CONSENT DISCUSSION: DATE OF CONSENT SIGNED' GROUP BY C.CDD_MRN, TRIM(PT_LAST_NAME) || ', ' || TRIM(PT_FIRST_NAME), PT_SEX, TRIM(R.AV_DESC), TRIM(E.AV_DESC), C.AUTHOR, C.OCCUPATION, C.AUTH_ROLE, C.CDD_SERVICE_DTE

prompt: Please search through pathology reports and provide a list of multiple myeloma cases from February 2019 onwards.
completion: SELECT PT_MRN AS "MRN", PT_LAST_NAME AS "Last Name", PT_FIRST_NAME AS "First Name", PT_BIRTH_DTE AS "DOB", PRPT_ACCESSION_NO AS "Path Accession Number", PRPT_REPORT AS "Path Report" FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT JOIN DV.DATE R ON R.DT_DATE_ID = PRPT_REPORT_DATE_ID JOIN DV.PATH_RPRT_TYPE_LOOKUP ON PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_CD = PRPT_REPORT_TYPE JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON PRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID WHERE (CONTAINS("PRPT_REPORT", '("multiple myeloma")') = 1 OR CONTAINS("PRPT_REPORT", '("plasma cell neoplasm")') = 1 OR CONTAINS("PRPT_REPORT", '("CD138")') = 1 OR CONTAINS("PRPT_REPORT", '("plasma cells")') = 1 OR CONTAINS("PRPT_REPORT", '("plasmacytoma")') = 1 OR CONTAINS("PRPT_REPORT", '("IgG4")') = 1 OR CONTAINS("PRPT_REPORT", '("light chain deposition")') = 1) AND R.DT_DTE >= '2019-02-01' AND PRPT_REPORT IS NOT NULL AND (PRPT_ACCESSION_NO like 'H%' OR PRPT_ACCESSION_NO like 'S%') AND (PRPT_REPORT_TYPE like '%_R' OR PRPT_REPORT_TYPE like '%_HR') ;

prompt: A list of Oral Cavity patients including their Name, MRN, DOB, Outcomes, Non-smokers/Non-drinkers, treated with radiation for oral cavity.
completion: WITH ORAL_CAVITY_COHORT AS (SELECT DISTINCT CC_MRN AS DX_MRN, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS MIN_ICD_EFF_DTE, RTC_TX_PLAN_NAME, CC_CLSF_CD AS ICD9_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS ICD9_DESC , RTC_TX_START_DTE FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.RADONC_TREATMENT_COURSE ON CC_MRN = RTC_TX_MRN JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON CC_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE CC_CLSF_CD IN ('C00.0', 'C00.1', 'C00.3', 'C00.4', 'C00.5', 'C00.6', 'C00.8', 'C00.2', 'C02.0', 'C02.1', 'C02.2', 'C02.3', 'C02.4', 'C02.8', 'C02.9', 'C03.0', 'C03.1', 'C03.9', 'C04.0', 'C04.1', 'C04.8', 'C04.9', 'C05.0', 'C05.1', 'C05.2', 'C05.8', 'C05.9', 'C06.0', 'C06.1', 'C06.2', 'C06.80', 'C06.89', 'C06.9') AND CASE WHEN CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y' AND CC_PT_TYPE <> 'E' THEN 'Y' WHEN CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' AND YEAR(CC_EFF_DTE) < 2004 THEN 'Y' WHEN CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND YEAR(CC_EFF_DTE) < 2001 THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END = 'Y' GROUP BY CC_MRN, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, RTC_TX_PLAN_NAME, RTC_TX_START_DTE, CC_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK HAVING RTC_TX_START_DTE > MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) ), SMOKING_HIST AS (SELECT A.CDD_MRN "SMRN", A.TOBACCO_USE FROM (SELECT CDD_MRN, CDD_AUTHORED_DTE, TU.CDO_VALUE_TEXT AS TOBACCO_USE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CDD_MRN ORDER BY CDD_AUTHORED_DTE DESC) SEQNUM FROM IDB.CD_DOCUMENT JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION TU ON CDD_DOC_GUID = TU.CDO_DOC_GUID AND TU.CDO_CTLG_DISPL_NM = 'Social History' AND TU.CDO_ITEM_NAME = 'Tobacco Use' JOIN ORAL_CAVITY_COHORT ON DX_MRN = CDD_MRN WHERE CDD_CANCEL_IND = '0' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND = '0' ) A WHERE A.SEQNUM = 1 ), ALCOHOL_HIST AS (SELECT A.CDD_MRN "AMRN", A.ALCOHOL_USE FROM (SELECT CDD_MRN, CDD_AUTHORED_DTE, TU.CDO_VALUE_TEXT AS ALCOHOL_USE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CDD_MRN ORDER BY CDD_AUTHORED_DTE DESC) SEQNUM FROM IDB.CD_DOCUMENT JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION TU ON CDD_DOC_GUID = TU.CDO_DOC_GUID AND TU.CDO_CTLG_DISPL_NM = 'Social History' AND LOWER(TU.CDO_ITEM_NAME) LIKE '%alcohol%' JOIN ORAL_CAVITY_COHORT ON DX_MRN = CDD_MRN WHERE CDD_CANCEL_IND = '0' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND = '0' ) A WHERE A.SEQNUM = 1 ) SELECT DISTINCT DX_MRN "MRN", PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH "DOB", RTC_TX_START_DTE "RADIATION START DT", RTC_TX_PLAN_NAME "RADIATION PLAN NAME", ICD9_CD "ICD CODE", ICD9_DESC "ICD DESC", ALCOHOL_USE "ALCOHOL STATUS", TOBACCO_USE "TOBACCO STATUS" FROM ORAL_CAVITY_COHORT LEFT JOIN ALCOHOL_HIST ON DX_MRN = AMRN LEFT JOIN SMOKING_HIST ON DX_MRN = SMRN

prompt: Provide a number of patients with arterial lines in M6 PACU from October 2018-present
completion: SELECT MRN, PT_NAME , DOC_NAME, SERVICE_DATE, LOCATION, ITEM_NAME, MAX(OBS_VALUE) PRESENT_INDICATOR FROM (SELECT B.CDD_MRN MRN, CPP_PT_NAME PT_NAME, B.CDD_DOC_GUID , B.CDD_DOC_NAME DOC_NAME, B.CDD_SERVICE_DTE SERVICE_DATE, B.CDD_VISIT_GUID , OCV_CURR_LOC LOCATION, CDO_CTLG_DISPL_NM, CDO_ITEM_NAME ITEM_NAME, SUBSTR(CDO_VALUE_TEXT, 1, 5) AS OBS_VALUE FROM (SELECT CPCD_GUID, CPCD_KTREE_ROOT_GUID, DATE('2018-01-01') AS BEGDTE, CURRENT_DATE AS ENDDTE, CURRENT_DATE - 1 DAY AS DAYEND, CURRENT_DATE AS RUNDTE FROM IDB.CD_CNFG_PAT_CARE_DOCUMENT WHERE UPPER(CPCD_NAME) LIKE '%PERIOPERATIVE%' AND CPCD_EXPIRY_DT IS NULL AND CPCD_ACTIVE_IND = '1' ) AS A LEFT OUTER JOIN IDB.CD_DOCUMENT B ON CDD_PTCAREDOC_GUID = CPCD_GUID AND CDD_FLOWSHEET_GUID = CPCD_KTREE_ROOT_GUID AND CDD_SIGNED_DTE >= BEGDTE AND CDD_AUTHORED_DTE >= BEGDTE AND CDD_SERVICE_DTE BETWEEN BEGDTE AND ENDDTE AND CDD_CANCEL_IND = '0' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND = '0' LEFT JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION ON CDD_DOC_GUID = CDO_DOC_GUID AND CDD_AUTHORED_DTE = CDO_AUTHORED_DTE LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_CLIENT_VISIT ON B.CDD_VISIT_GUID = OCV_VISIT_GUID LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_PAS_PATIENT ON CPP_MRN = CDD_MRN) AS A WHERE ITEM_NAME = 'Arterial Line Arterial Line Present' AND LOCATION LIKE 'M6 %' GROUP BY MRN, PT_NAME , DOC_NAME, SERVICE_DATE, LOCATION, ITEM_NAME ORDER BY 7, 4, 1

prompt: Please provide a report showing the COUNT of COVID-19 Positive Inpatients by Date and by Service from 3/1/2020 to 9/30/2020.
completion: WITH CTE AS (SELECT DISTINCT CALENDAR_DATE, COVID.MRN, COVID.LAST_NAME, COVID.FIRST_NAME, COVID.DATE_OF_BIRTH, COVID.DATE_OF_DEATH, RESULT, DATE(MIN_IDENTIFIED_DT) MIN_IDENTIFIED_DT, DATE(COVID.MIN_RESOLVED_PROBLEM_DT) MIN_RESOLVED_PROBLEM_DT, IP.ADMIT_DATE, IP.DISCHARGE_DATE, LOS, SERVICE_MIDNIGHT, CASE WHEN COVID.DATE_OF_DEATH <= IP.DISCHARGE_DATE THEN 'Y' ELSE '' END AS DISCHARGED_DECEASED, CASE WHEN SERVICE_MIDNIGHT = 'Intensive Care Unit' OR SVC_MIDNIGHT = 'PDU' THEN 'Y' ELSE '' END AS ICU FROM IDB.COVID19_PATIENT_INFO COVID JOIN IDB.INPATIENT_ADMISSIONS_V IP ON COVID.MRN = IP.MRN AND (RESULT = 'Positive' OR (RESULT = 'Resolved' AND MIN_RESOLVED_PROBLEM_DT > IP.ADMIT_DT)) JOIN IDB.INPATIENT_DAYS_V IPDAYS ON IP.ADMIT_ID = IPDAYS.ADMIT_ID AND CALENDAR_DATE BETWEEN DATE(MIN_IDENTIFIED_DT) AND COALESCE(DATE(MIN_RESOLVED_PROBLEM_DT), '2999-01-01') - 1 DAY ORDER BY CALENDAR_DATE, COVID.MRN) SELECT CALENDAR_DATE, SERVICE_MIDNIGHT, COUNT(DISTINCT MRN) COVID_CENSUS FROM CTE GROUP BY CALENDAR_DATE , SERVICE_MIDNIGHT ORDER BY 1, 2 ; WITH CTE AS (SELECT DISTINCT CALENDAR_DATE, COVID.MRN, COVID.LAST_NAME, COVID.FIRST_NAME, COVID.DATE_OF_BIRTH, COVID.DATE_OF_DEATH, RESULT, DATE(MIN_IDENTIFIED_DT) MIN_IDENTIFIED_DT, DATE(COVID.MIN_RESOLVED_PROBLEM_DT) MIN_RESOLVED_PROBLEM_DT, IP.ADMIT_DATE, IP.DISCHARGE_DATE, LOS, SERVICE_MIDNIGHT, CASE WHEN COVID.DATE_OF_DEATH <= IP.DISCHARGE_DATE THEN 'Y' ELSE '' END AS DISCHARGED_DECEASED, CASE WHEN SERVICE_MIDNIGHT = 'Intensive Care Unit' OR SVC_MIDNIGHT = 'PDU' THEN 'Y' ELSE '' END AS ICU FROM IDB.COVID19_PATIENT_INFO COVID JOIN IDB.INPATIENT_ADMISSIONS_V IP ON COVID.MRN = IP.MRN AND (RESULT = 'Positive' OR (RESULT = 'Resolved' AND MIN_RESOLVED_PROBLEM_DT > IP.ADMIT_DT)) JOIN IDB.INPATIENT_DAYS_V IPDAYS ON IP.ADMIT_ID = IPDAYS.ADMIT_ID AND CALENDAR_DATE BETWEEN DATE(MIN_IDENTIFIED_DT) AND COALESCE(DATE(MIN_RESOLVED_PROBLEM_DT), '2999-01-01') - 1 DAY ORDER BY CALENDAR_DATE, COVID.MRN) SELECT CALENDAR_DATE, COUNT(DISTINCT MRN) COVID_CENSUS FROM CTE GROUP BY CALENDAR_DATE ORDER BY 1

prompt: Please provide an update for SKI26207 with a different date range.
completion: WITH CDB AS (SELECT TM_MRN , STS.AV_DESC AS CASE_STS , TM_DX_DTE , TM_HIST_CD , H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS HIST_DESC , TM_SITE_CD , S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_DESC , GR.AV_DESC AS TM_HIST_CD_GRADE , TM_CA_SURG_DTE , TM_PATH_TEXT , TM_SURG_TEXT , TM_REGNODE_EXM_NO , TM_REGNODE_POS_NO , TM_HIST_TXT , TM_TUMOR_SIZE , TM_RESID_TUMOR_CD , TM_GENERAL_STG , TM_CLIN_TNM_T , TM_CLIN_TNM_N , TM_CLIN_TNM_M , TM_CLIN_STG_GRP , TM_PATH_TNM_T , TM_PATH_TNM_N , TM_PATH_TNM_M , TM_PATH_STG_GRP , REC.CDB_AV_DESC AS TM_FIRST_RECUR_TYP , STRIP(S03.AVSITE_DESC) TM_CA_SURG_03 , STRIP(S03M.AVSITE_DESC) TM_CA_SURG_03_MSK , SUBSTR(RS.AVSITE_DESC, 1, 100) TM_RGN_SCOP_03 , TM_REGNODE_SCOP_CD , TM_PRIM_SURGEON , TM_REASON_NO_RAD , TM_RAD_TX_MOD , TM_LOC_RAD_TX , TM_RAD_TX_VOL , SUBSTR(TS.AV_DESC, 1, 5) AS TM_TSTAGE , SUBSTR(NS.AV_DESC, 1, 5) AS TM_NSTAGE , SUBSTR(MS.AV_DESC, 1, 5) AS TM_MSTAGE , SUBSTR(TB.AV_DESC, 1, 25) AS TM_TBASIS , REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(CASE WHEN TM_AJCC_7 NOT IN ('', '888', '999') THEN AJCC7.AV_DESC WHEN TM_AJCC NOT IN ('', '88', '99') THEN AJCC.AV_DESC WHEN TM_GENERAL_STG = '0' AND LEFT(TM_BEST_AJCC_STG, 1) IN ('0', '1') THEN TM_BEST_AJCC_STG WHEN TM_GENERAL_STG BETWEEN '0' AND '1' THEN '1' WHEN TM_GENERAL_STG BETWEEN '2' AND '3' THEN '2' WHEN TM_GENERAL_STG BETWEEN '4' AND '5' THEN '3' WHEN TM_GENERAL_STG = '7' THEN '4' WHEN TM_PATH_STG_GRP NOT IN ('99', '88', '') THEN TM_PATH_STG_GRP WHEN TM_CLIN_STG_GRP NOT IN ('99', '88', '') THEN TM_CLIN_STG_GRP WHEN TM_GENERAL_STG IN (' ', '8', '9') AND LEFT(TM_BEST_AJCC_STG, 1) BETWEEN '0' AND '4' THEN TM_BEST_AJCC_STG WHEN TM_CLIN_STG_GRP = '88' THEN 'NA' WHEN TM_CLIN_STG_GRP IN ('9', '99') THEN 'UNK' WHEN TM_GENERAL_STG = '8' THEN 'NA' WHEN TM_GENERAL_STG = '9' THEN 'UNK' ELSE 'UNK' END, 'IV', '4'), 'III', '3'), 'II', '2'), 'I', '1') AS BEST_AJCC_STAGE FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS STS ON STS.AV_ELEMENT = 'CASE_STS' AND STS.AV_CODE = TM_CASE_STS LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS GR ON GR.AV_ELEMENT = 'HIST_CD_GRADE' AND GR.AV_CODE = TM_HIST_CD_GRADE LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS AJCC7 ON AJCC7.AV_ELEMENT = 'AJCC_7' AND AJCC7.AV_CODE = TM_AJCC_7 AND TM_AJCC_7 NOT IN ('', '888', '999') LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS AJCC ON AJCC.AV_ELEMENT = 'AJCC' AND AJCC.AV_CODE = TM_AJCC AND TM_AJCC NOT IN ('', '88', '99') LEFT JOIN IDB.CDB_ALLOWVALS REC ON REC.CDB_AV_CODE=TM_FIRST_RECUR_TYP AND REC.CDB_AV_ELEMENT='FIRST_RECUR_TYP' AND REC.CDB_AV_CD_STS = 'A' LEFT JOIN IDB.CDB_ALLOWVALS_SITE S03 ON S03.AVSITE_ELEMENT = 'CA_SURG_SUM_03' AND S03.AVSITE_CODE = TM_CA_SURG_03 AND S03.AVSITE_CD_STS = 'A' AND TM_SITE_CD BETWEEN S03.AVSITE_LOW_SITE AND S03.AVSITE_HIGH_SITE LEFT JOIN IDB.CDB_ALLOWVALS_SITE S03M ON S03M.AVSITE_ELEMENT = 'CA_SURG_SUM_03_MSK' AND S03M.AVSITE_CODE = TM_CA_SURG_03_MSK AND S03M.AVSITE_CD_STS = 'A' AND TM_SITE_CD BETWEEN S03M.AVSITE_LOW_SITE AND S03M.AVSITE_HIGH_SITE LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS TS ON TS.AV_ELEMENT = 'TSTAGE' AND TS.AV_CODE = TM_TSTAGE LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS NS ON NS.AV_ELEMENT = 'NSTAGE' AND NS.AV_CODE = TM_NSTAGE LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS MS ON MS.AV_ELEMENT = 'MSTAGE' AND MS.AV_CODE = TM_MSTAGE LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS TB ON TB.AV_ELEMENT = 'TBASIS' AND TB.AV_CODE = TM_TBASIS LEFT JOIN IDB.CDB_ALLOWVALS_SITE RS ON RS.AVSITE_ELEMENT = 'RGN_SCOP_03' AND RS.AVSITE_CODE = TM_RGN_SCOP_03 AND RS.AVSITE_CD_STS = 'A' WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND TM_SITE_CD = 'C739' AND (TM_HIST_CD_GRADE = '3' OR UPPER(TM_PATH_TEXT) LIKE '%POORLY DIFF%' OR UPPER(TM_SURG_TEXT) LIKE '%POORLY DIFF%' OR UPPER(TM_HIST_TXT) LIKE '%POORLY DIFF%') AND TM_DX_DTE BETWEEN '2021-01-01' AND '2023-01-15' ) , PBD AS (SELECT PBD_MRN, PBD_SVC_DTE SURG_DATE, PBD_PBD_CD PBD_CD, PBC_CPT_CD CPT_CD, PBC_PBD_DESC PBD_DESC , PBI_PERFORM_DR_NO, DOC_NAME SURGEON, DOC_SVC PBD_SVC FROM IDB.PBD_DTL_CHARGES JOIN CDB ON TM_MRN = PBD_MRN JOIN IDB.PBD_CODE ON PBD_PBD_CD = PBC_PBD_CD JOIN IDB.PBD_INVOICE ON PBD_INV_NO= PBI_INV_NO AND PBD_ACCT_NO= PBI_ACCT_NO AND PBD_MRN= PBI_MRN AND PBI_INV_STS = ' ' LEFT JOIN IDB.DOC ON prompt: Create an on-demand report that captures charge data for specified CPT codes.
completion: WITH CTE AS (SELECT DISTINCT PBD_MRN, PBD_SVC_DTE, PBD_PBD_CD, PBC_CPT_CD, PBC_PBD_DESC, PBI_SVC_LOC, PBDG_GRP_NAME, PBDD_DIV_NAME, DOC_NAME, PBD_SVC_AMT, PBD_SVC_QTY, VIS_DAYS_STAY, VIS_ADM_DTE, VIS_DSCH_DTE FROM IDB.PBD_DTL JOIN IDB.PBD_INVOICE ON PBD_INV_NO = PBI_INV_NO LEFT JOIN IDB.PBD_CODE ON PBD_PBD_CD = PBC_PBD_CD LEFT JOIN IDB.CLM ON PBC_CPT_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD LEFT JOIN IDB.DOC ON PBI_PERFORM_DR_NO = DOC_DR_NO LEFT JOIN IDB.PBD_GROUP ON PBI_GRP_ID = PBDG_GRP_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.PBD_DIVISION ON PBI_DIV_ID = PBDD_DIV_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.VISIT_V ON PBD_MRN = VIS_MRN AND VIS_VISIT_STATUS IN ('2', '3') AND VIS_ADM_DTE <= PBD_SVC_DTE AND COALESCE(VIS_DSCH_DTE, '2999-12-31') >= PBD_SVC_DTE AND VIS_IP_OP_ADJUSTED_IND = 'I' WHERE 1=1 #PROMPT('StartDate', '', ' ', ' and date(PBD_SVC_DTE) >= ', '', '') #PROMPT('EndDate', '', ' ', ' and date(PBD_SVC_DTE) <= ', '', '') #PROMPTMANY('CPT Code', 'String', ' ', ' and PBC_CPT_CD in (', '', ')')# #PROMPTMANY('Service', 'String', ' ', ' and PBI_SVC_LOC in (', '', ')')# #PROMPTMANY('Provider', 'String', ' ', ' and DOC_NAME in (', '', ')')# ) , CTE2 AS (SELECT PBD_MRN, PBC_CPT_CD, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY PBD_MRN) AS RN FROM (SELECT DISTINCT PBD_MRN, PBC_CPT_CD FROM CTE) A) , CTE3 AS (SELECT PBD_MRN, PBD_SVC_DTE, LISTAGG(PBC_CPT_CD, CHR(13) || CHR(10)) WITHIN GROUP( ORDER BY PBD_SVC_DTE) ALL_CPT_CD FROM (SELECT DISTINCT A.PBD_MRN, A.PBD_SVC_DTE, TRIM(C.PBC_CPT_CD) PBC_CPT_CD FROM IDB.PBD_DTL A JOIN IDB.PBD_INVOICE B ON A.PBD_INV_NO = B.PBI_INV_NO LEFT JOIN IDB.PBD_CODE C ON A.PBD_PBD_CD = C.PBC_PBD_CD JOIN CTE D ON A.PBD_MRN = D.PBD_MRN AND A.PBD_SVC_DTE = D.PBD_SVC_DTE WHERE C.PBC_CPT_CD <> D.PBC_CPT_CD ) A GROUP BY PBD_MRN, PBD_SVC_DTE) SELECT A.PBD_MRN "MRN" , TRIM(P.PT_LAST_NAME) "PT Last Name" , TRIM(P.PT_FIRST_NAME) "PT First Name" , TRIM(A.PBC_CPT_CD) "CPT Code" , A.PBD_SVC_DTE "Service Date" , TRIM(A.PBDD_DIV_NAME) "Service" , TRIM(A.DOC_NAME) "Provider" , TRIM(A.PBI_SVC_LOC) "Location" , TRIM(A.PBDG_GRP_NAME) "Location Name" , PBD_SVC_AMT "Amount" , PBD_SVC_QTY "Quantity" , ALL_CPT_CD "CPT codes on svc dt" , VIS_DAYS_STAY "InPt Days Stayed" , VIS_ADM_DTE "Admit Date" , VIS_DSCH_DTE "Discharge Date" , YEAR(CURRENT date - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) "Current Age" FROM CTE A JOIN CTE2 B ON A.PBD_MRN = B.PBD_MRN JOIN IDB.PATIENT P ON A.PBD_MRN = P.PT_MRN LEFT JOIN CTE3 C ON A.PBD_MRN = C.PBD_MRN AND A.PBD_SVC_DTE = C.PBD_SVC_DTE GROUP BY A.PBD_MRN , TRIM(P.PT_LAST_NAME) , TRIM(P.PT_FIRST_NAME) , TRIM(A.PBC_CPT_CD) , A.PBD_SVC_DTE , TRIM(A.PBDD_DIV_NAME) , TRIM(A.DOC_NAME) , TRIM(A.PBI_SVC_LOC) , TRIM(A.PBDG_GRP_NAME) , PBD_SVC_AMT , PBD_SVC_QTY , ALL_CPT_CD , VIS_DAYS_STAY , VIS_ADM_DTE , VIS_DSCH_DTE , YEAR(CURRENT date - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) HAVING MAX(RN) = #PROMPT('rn', 'string')# ;

prompt: Requesting a Data report for all Myeloma admissions between 2017, 2018, and 2019 to assess frequency of admissions for elderly patients (>65 years old)
completion: WITH PTS AS (SELECT CDD_ADM_NUM , CDD_MRN MRN , DATE_OF_BIRTH DOB , AGE_AT_ADMIT , ADMIT_DATE , LOS LOS_IN_DAYS , SUBSTR(CDO_VALUE_TEXT, 1, 45) DSCH_DX FROM IDB.CD_DOCUMENT JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION ON CDD_DOC_GUID = CDO_DOC_GUID AND CDD_AUTHORED_DTE = CDO_AUTHORED_DTE AND CDO_VALUE_TEXT <> '' JOIN IDB.INPATIENT_ADMISSIONS_V ON CDD_ADM_NUM = ADMIT_ID AND SVC_DISCHARGE = 'LYR' AND AGE_AT_ADMIT >= 65 WHERE CDD_CANCEL_IND <> '1' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND <> '1' AND CDD_DOC_NAME = 'Discharge Summary' AND CDO_ITEM_NAME = 'Discharge Diagnosis' AND ADMIT_DATE BETWEEN '2017-01-01' AND '2019-12-31' AND UPPER(CDO_VALUE_TEXT) LIKE '%MYELOMA%' ) , ADM_ORD AS (SELECT DISTINCT OO_ADM_NUM , OUD_USER_DI_VALUE RSN_ADMIT FROM IDB.OMS_ORDER JOIN PTS ON OO_ADM_NUM = CDD_ADM_NUM JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_CATALOG ON OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID = OOC_MSTR_ITEM_GUID AND OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID IN ('1000003944073029', '3000003643073029') JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_USER_DATA ON OO_ORD_GUID = OUD_ORD_GUID AND OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'Nsg Reason Admission' WHERE OO_ORD_STS_CD NOT IN ('CANP', 'CANC', 'AUC3') ) , DEMO AS (SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN, TRIM(PT_LAST_NAME) || ', ' || TRIM(PT_FIRST_NAME) PT_NAME, PT_SEX, CASE WHEN COALESCE(R.AV_DESC, CR.AV_DESC) IN ('WHITE', 'WHITE HISPANIC') THEN 'White' WHEN COALESCE(R.AV_DESC, CR.AV_DESC) IN ('BLACK OR AFRICAN AMERICAN', 'BLACK', 'BLACK HISPANIC') THEN 'Black' WHEN COALESCE(R.AV_DESC, CR.AV_DESC) IN ('ASIAN-FAR EAST/INDIAN SUBCONT', 'KAMPUCHEAN', 'LAOTIAN', 'VIETNAMESE', 'HMONG', 'CHINESE', 'ASIAN INDIAN PAKISTANI', 'JAPANESE', 'KOREAN', 'OTHER ASIAN', 'THAI') THEN 'Asian' WHEN COALESCE(R.AV_DESC, CR.AV_DESC) IN ('NATIVE AMERICAN-AM IND/ALASKA', 'AMER IND ALEUT ESKIMO') THEN 'Native American or Alaska Native' WHEN COALESCE(R.AV_DESC, CR.AV_DESC) IN ('NATIVE HAWAIIAN OR PACIFIC ISL', 'HAWAIIAN', 'MELANESIAN', 'MICRONESIAN', 'FIJI ISLANDER', 'FILIPINO', 'GUAMANIAN', 'PACIFIC ISLANDER') THEN 'Native Hawaiian or Other Pacific Islander' ELSE 'Unspecified' END AS PT_RACE, CASE WHEN COALESCE(CE.AV_DESC, E.AV_DESC) IN ('SPANISH NOS; HISPANIC NOS, LATINO NOS', 'HISPANIC OR LATINO', 'PUERTO RICAN', 'SOUTH/CENTRAL AMERICA (EXCEPT BRAZIL)', 'DOMINICAN REPUBLIC', 'OTHER SPANISH/HISPANIC(INCL EUROPEAN; EXCL DOM REP)', 'CUBAN', 'MEXICAN (INCLUDES CHICANO)') OR COALESCE(R.AV_DESC, CR.AV_DESC) IN ('WHITE HISPANIC', 'BLACK HISPANIC') THEN 'Hispanic' WHEN COALESCE(CE.AV_DESC, E.AV_DESC) IN ('NOT HISPANIC', 'SPANISH SURNAME ONLY', 'NON-SPANISH; NON-HISPANIC') THEN 'Non-Hispanic' ELSE 'Unspecified' END AS PT_ETHNICITY FROM IDB.PATIENT JOIN PTS ON MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS R ON R.AV_ELEMENT = 'RACE' AND R.AV_CODE = PT_RACE LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS E ON E.AV_ELEMENT = 'PT_ETHNICITY' AND E.AV_CODE = PT_PT_ETHNICITY LEFT JOIN IDB.CDB_PATIENT ON PT_MRN = CP_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS CR ON CR.AV_ELEMENT = 'CDB_RACE' AND CR.AV_CODE = CP_CDB_RACE LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS CE ON CE.AV_ELEMENT = 'ETHNICITY' AND CE.AV_CODE = CP_ETHNICITY) SELECT PT_NAME , MRN , PT_SEX , PT_RACE , PT_ETHNICITY , DOB , AGE_AT_ADMIT , ADMIT_DATE , RSN_ADMIT , DSCH_DX , LOS_IN_DAYS FROM PTS JOIN DEMO ON MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN ADM_ORD ON CDD_ADM_NUM = OO_ADM_NUM

prompt: Create a Tableau dashboard to capture metrics related to pediatric new patients.
completion: SELECT CPE_MRN AS "MRN", TRIM(PT_LAST_NAME) || ', ' || TRIM(PT_FIRST_NAME) "Patient Name", CPE_ENC_CSN_ID, CPE_ENC_DTE AS "Appt Date", CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 AS "Department", CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 AS "Service", CLD_DEPT_NAME AS "Department Name", CRE_RES_NAME AS "Provider Name", CASE WHEN CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR like 'TEL%' THEN 'TeleHealth' WHEN CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR like 'PHONE%' THEN 'Phone' ELSE 'In-Person' END AS "Visit Type Group", CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR AS "Visit Type Abbr", CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME AS "Visit Type", PFA_FST_CHEMO_MSK_DTE "First Chemo Date", PFA_FST_RT_MSK_DTE "First RT Date", PFA_FST_SRG_MSK_DTE "First Surgery Date", DAYS(PFA_FST_MSK_TX_DTE) - DAYS(CPE_ENC_DTE) "Days to Tx" FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON CPE_MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.PT_FIRST_ACTIVITY ON CPE_MRN = PFA_MRN WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN '2019-01-01' AND CURRENT date AND CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR LIKE '%NV%' AND (CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 = ('PED') OR CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_4 = ('PED') OR CLD_DEPT_NAME = 'ORTHOPEDICS 1275-9') AND CPE_CPE_IP_IND <> 'INPATIENT' AND CPE_ENC_DTE = PFA_FST_DRVST_DTE

prompt: Provide a list of prostate cancer patients consented to 12-245, who have received IMPACT testing.
completion: WITH AC AS (SELECT AC_IRB_NO, AC_MRN, AC_CONS_DTE FROM IDB.PATIENT JOIN IDB.ACCRUALS AC ON PT_MRN = AC_MRN WHERE AC_IRB_NO = '12-245' ) , IMPACT AS (SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_ZIP_CD, PDRX_DMP_PATIENT_ID, PDRX_DMP_SAMPLE_ID, PDWS_DESCRIPTION, PRIMARY_SITE, TUMOR_TYPE_NAME, AC_CONS_DTE, DT_PROCEDURE, DATE_TUMOR_SEQUENCING FROM AC JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON PT_MRN = AC_MRN JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML DT ON PDRX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML_SETTINGS ON PDRX_PATH_DMP_RESULTS_XML_ID = PDRXS_PATH_DMP_RESULTS_XML_ID JOIN DVDMC.PATHOLOGY_DMP_WEBSVC_SETTINGS ON PDRXS_SETTING_ID = PDWS_SETTING_ID CROSS JOIN XMLTABLE('$c/root/*' PASSING DT.PDRX_XML_VALUE AS "c" COLUMNS SAMPLEID VARCHAR(100) PATH '../meta-data/dmp_sample_id', PATIENTID VARCHAR(100) PATH '../meta-data/dmp_patient_id', TUMOR_TYPE_CODE VARCHAR(100) PATH '../meta-data/tumor_type_code', TUMOR_TYPE_NAME VARCHAR(255) PATH '../meta-data/tumor_type_name', IS_METASTASIS VARCHAR(10) PATH '../meta-data/is_metastasis', PRIMARY_SITE VARCHAR(255) PATH '../meta-data/primary_site', METASTASIS_SITE VARCHAR(255) PATH '../meta-data/metastasis_site', DATE_TUMOR_SEQUENCING VARCHAR(255) PATH '../meta-data/date_tumor_sequencing', DT_PROCEDURE VARCHAR(40) PATH '../meta-data/dt_procedure', DT_SIGNOUT VARCHAR(40) PATH '../meta-data/dt_signout', DT_ACCESSIONED VARCHAR(40) PATH '../meta-data/dt_accessioned', DT_ALYS_END_TIME VARCHAR(40) PATH '../meta-data/dt_alys_end_time', DT_DMS_START_TIME VARCHAR(40) PATH '../meta-data/dt_dms_start_time') T WHERE 1=1 AND PDWS_NAME like '%IMPACT%' AND(UPPER(PRIMARY_SITE) like '%PROSTATE%' OR UPPER(TUMOR_TYPE_NAME) like '%PROSTATE%') ) SELECT HCPR_MRN, HCPR_PRESCRIPTION_ID RX_ID , HCPR_CREATED_DTE RX_CREATE_DATE , DATE(HCPR_START_DT) START_DATE , HCPR_END_DT AS END_DATE , DATE(HCPR_DISCONTINUE_DT) AS DISCONTINUE_DATE , HCPR_DRUG_NAME AS DRUG_NAME , HGN_GENERIC_NAME AS GENERIC_NAME , HCPR_STATUS_TYPE_DESC AS PRESCRIPTION_STATUS , HCPR_PRESCRIPTION_TYPE_DESC AS RX_TYPE , HCPR_DOSE_AMT AS DOSE_AMT , UOM.HRUM_NAME UOM , UOM.HRUM_DESCRIPTION UOM_DESC , HCPR_ROUTE AS ROUTE , HCPR_NDC AS NDC FROM IDB.HML_CLIENT_PRESCRIPTION LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_CLIENT_VISIT ON OCV_VISIT_GUID = HCPR_VISIT_GUID LEFT JOIN IDB.HML_GENERIC_NAME ON HGN_GENERIC_NAME_ID = HCPR_GENERIC_NAME_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_USER USR ON USR.OU_USER_GUID = HCPR_USER_GUID LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_USER REQ ON REQ.OU_USER_GUID = HCPR_CARE_PROV_GUID LEFT JOIN IDB.HML_RX_UNIT_OF_MEASURE UOM ON UOM.HRUM_RXUOM_ID = HCPR_DOSE_UOM_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.HML_RX_UNIT_OF_MEASURE PKG ON PKG.HRUM_RXUOM_ID = HCPR_INNER_PACKAGE_SIZE_UOM_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.HML_SCRIPT_FREQUENCY ON HSF_SCRIPT_FREQ_ID = HCPR_SCRIPT_FREQ_ID WHERE HCPR_STATUS_TYPE NOT IN (4, 5, 8) AND HCPR_CREATED_DTE IS NOT NULL AND HCPR_PRESCRIPTION_TYPE = 3 AND HCPR_MRN IN (SELECT PT_MRN FROM IMPACT)

completion: WITH PTS AS (SELECT PT_MRN, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH DOB, CASE WHEN COALESCE(R.AV_DESC, CR.AV_DESC) IN ('WHITE', 'WHITE HISPANIC') THEN 'White' WHEN COALESCE(R.AV_DESC, CR.AV_DESC) IN ('BLACK OR AFRICAN AMERICAN', 'BLACK', 'BLACK HISPANIC') THEN 'Black' WHEN COALESCE(R.AV_DESC, CR.AV_DESC) IN ('ASIAN-FAR EAST/INDIAN SUBCONT', 'KAMPUCHEAN', 'LAOTIAN', 'VIETNAMESE', 'HMONG', 'CHINESE', 'ASIAN Alaska Native' WHEN COALESCE(R.AV_DESC, CR.AV_DESC) IN ('NATIVE HAWAIIAN OR PACIFIC ISL', 'HAWAIIAN', 'MELANESIAN', 'MICRONESIAN', 'FIJI ISLANDER', 'FILIPINO', 'GUAMANIAN', 'PACIFIC ISLANDER') THEN 'Native Hawaiian or Other Pacific Islander' ELSE 'Unspecified' END AS PT_RACE, CASE WHEN COALESCE(CE.AV_DESC, E.AV_DESC) IN ('SPANISH NOS; HISPANIC NOS, LATINO NOS', 'HISPANIC OR LATINO', 'PUERTO RICAN', 'SOUTH/CENTRAL AMERICA (EXCEPT BRAZIL)', 'DOMINICAN REPUBLIC', 'OTHER SPANISH/HISPANIC(INCL EUROPEAN; EXCL DOM REP)', 'CUBAN', 'MEXICAN (INCLUDES CHICANO)') OR COALESCE(R.AV_DESC, CR.AV_DESC) IN ('WHITE HISPANIC', 'BLACK HISPANIC') THEN 'Hispanic' WHEN COALESCE(CE.AV_DESC, E.AV_DESC) IN ('NOT HISPANIC', 'SPANISH SURNAME ONLY', 'NON-SPANISH; NON-HISPANIC') THEN 'Non-Hispanic' ELSE 'Unspecified' END AS PT_ETHNICITY, LEFT(PT_ZIP_CD, 5) PT_ZIPCODE FROM IDB.PATIENT LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS R ON R.AV_ELEMENT = 'RACE' AND R.AV_CODE = PT_RACE LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS E ON E.AV_ELEMENT = 'PT_ETHNICITY' AND E.AV_CODE = PT_PT_ETHNICITY LEFT JOIN IDB.CDB_PATIENT ON PT_MRN = CP_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS CR ON CR.AV_ELEMENT = 'CDB_RACE' AND CR.AV_CODE = CP_CDB_RACE LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS CE ON CE.AV_ELEMENT = 'ETHNICITY' AND CE.AV_CODE = CP_ETHNICITY WHERE PT_MRN IN ({MRNS}) ) , TM AS (SELECT TM_MRN , MIN(TM_DX_DTE) TM_DX_DTE , H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS HIST_DESC , S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_DESC , CATEGORY1 SEER_CAT1 , CATEGORY2 SEER_CAT2 , CATEGORY3 SEER_CAT3 , CATEGORY4 SEER_CAT4 FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD JOIN PTS ON TM_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.SEERGROUPING ON RECODE = IDB.SEERF_ICDO(TM_SITE_CD, TM_HIST_CD) WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') GROUP BY TM_MRN , H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK , S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK , CATEGORY1 , CATEGORY2 , CATEGORY3 , CATEGORY4 ) , CANCER AS (SELECT * FROM TM UNION ALL SELECT CC_MRN TM_MRN , MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS TM_DX_DTE , '' HIST_DESC , CLM_CLSF_CD AND CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK not like '%SECONDARY%' JOIN IDB.SEERGROUPING ON CLM_CLSF_RECODE = RECODE WHERE (SUBSTR(CC_CLSF_CD, 1, 3) BETWEEN 'C00' AND 'C76' OR SUBSTR(CC_CLSF_CD, 1, 3) BETWEEN
