TM_MRN ^ SELECT CDD_MRN , CDD_SERVICE_DTE , CDD_DOC_NAME , OP_DISPLAY_NAME , CDD_DOC_GUID , CDO_SECTION , CDO_ITEM_NAME , CDO_VALUE_TEXT FROM IDB.CD_DOCUMENT LEFT JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION ON CDD_DOC_GUID = CDO_DOC_GUID AND CDD_AUTHORED_DTE = CDO_AUTHORED_DTE AND CDO_VALUE_TEXT <> '' JOIN IDB.OMS_PROVIDER ON CDD_AUTH_PROV_GUID = OP_PVDR_GUID WHERE CDD_CANCEL_IND <> '1' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND <> '1' AND CDD_AUTH_PROV_GUID IN ('9000925226001190', '2000001020119001', '9001061126101190') AND CDD_DOC_NAME IN ('Treatment Visit, Psychotherapy - Psychiatry', 'Initial Evaluation - Psychiatry') AND CDD_SERVICE_DTE BETWEEN '2020-01-01' AND '2020-09-30' AND CDD_MRN IN ({MRNS}) ^ SELECT CPE_MRN MRN , CPE_ENC_DTE APPT_DTE , CPE_CPE_APPT_STS APPT_STS , CRE_RES_NAME PROVIDER , CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME VISIT_TYPE FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID AND CRE_RES_ID IN ('024927', '086850', '006387') JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp', 'Left', 'No Show', 'Sch') AND YEAR(CPE_ENC_DTE) = 2020 AND CPE_MRN IN({MRNS}) ^ SELECT OO_MRN MRN , OOC_ITEM_NAME DRUG_NAME , OO_ORD_NAME DRUG_NAME_EXT , OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE RX_ENTER_DTE , 'Order' SOURCE FROM IDB.OMS_ORDER JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_CATALOG ON OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID = OOC_MSTR_ITEM_GUID AND OOC_THERAPEUTIC_CAT_ID = '320' WHERE YEAR(OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE) = 2020 AND OO_MRN IN ({MRNS}) UNION ALL SELECT HCPR_MRN MRN , COALESCE(HGN_GENERIC_NAME, HCPR_DRUG_NAME) AS DRUG_NAME , HCPR_DRUG_NAME DRUG_NAME_EXT , DATE(COALESCE(HCPR_START_DT, HCPR_CREATED_DT)) RX_ENTER_DTE , 'Home med list' SOURCE FROM IDB.HML_CLIENT_PRESCRIPTION LEFT JOIN IDB.HML_GENERIC_NAME ON HCPR_GENERIC_NAME_ID = HGN_GENERIC_NAME_ID WHERE (HCPR_GENERIC_NAME_ID IN ('2565', '176') OR LOWER(HCPR_DRUG_NAME) like '%nicotine%') AND YEAR(DATE(COALESCE(HCPR_START_DT, HCPR_CREATED_DT))) = 2020 AND HCPR_MRN IN ({MRNS}) ^ SELECT EF_MRN MRN , DATE(EF_SUBMISSION_DT) SUBMISSION_DTE , EF_FORM_ID , EF_FORM_NAME , EFI_ITEM_TEXT , EFI_VALUE FROM IDB.EF_FORM JOIN IDB.EF_ASSESSMENT ON EF_FORM_EXTERNAL_ID = EA_ASSESS_ID AND EA_SURV_ID = 62 JOIN IDB.EF_FORM_ITEM ON EF_FORM_ID = EFI_FORM_ID WHERE DATE(EF_SUBMISSION_DT) BETWEEN '2020-01-01' AND '2020-09-01' AND EF_MRN IN ({MRNS})

prompt: All employees that received a dose after series complete but that dose did NOT qualify them as booster compliant.
completion: SELECT EVI_EMPLOYEE_ID, CEVE_CATEGORY, VACCINE_STATUS, DOSE_1_BRAND, DOSE_1_ADMIN_DTE, DOSE_2_BRAND, DOSE_2_ADMIN_DTE, DOSE_ADDL_BRAND, DOSE_ADDL_ADMIN_DTE, FIRST_BOOSTER_ELIGIBLE_DTE, DAYS(FIRST_BOOSTER_ELIGIBLE_DTE) - DAYS(DOSE_ADDL_ADMIN_DTE) DAYS_DIFF FROM IDB.COVID19_EMPLOYEE_VACCINE_INFO JOIN IDB.COVID19_VACCINE_PERSON ON EVI_EMPLOYEE_ID = CVP_EMPLOYEE_ID AND CVP_STATUS <> 'Terminated' WHERE FIRST_BOOSTER_ELIGIBLE_DTE <= CURRENT DATE AND FIRST_BOOSTER_COMPLIANT = '' AND ADDL_DOSE_FLAG = 1

prompt: Demographic and appointment report for Department of Medicine patients being seen at Nassau
completion: WITH BASE AS (SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN AS MRN, X.PT_LAST_NAME, X.PT_FIRST_NAME, LANG.AV_DESC AS PRIMARY_LANGUAGE, X.PT_SEX AS GENDER, ETH.AV_DESC AS ETHNICITY, RACE.AV_DESC AS RACE, A.CLD_DEPT_NAME AS DEPARTMENT, B.CRE_RES_NAME AS PROVIDER, CPE_ENC_DTE AS APPT_DTE, CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME AS VISIT_TYPE, TIME(CPE_APPT_DT) AS APPT_TIME, CASE WHEN P1.ACD_IRB_NO IS NOT NULL AND P1.ACD_OFF_STUDY_DTE IS NULL THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS STATUS_06_107, DAYOFWEEK(CURRENT date) AS DOW, PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID AS PID, P2.ACD_IRB_NO AS PROTOCOL, PRO_PROTOCOL_TYPE AS PROTOCOL_TYPE, P2.ACD_REG_DTE AS TX_START_DATE, P2.ACD_TX_END_DTE AS TX_END_DATE FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT A ON CPE_DEPT_ID = A.CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE B ON B.CRE_RES_ID = CPE_VST_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID JOIN IDB.PATIENT X ON CPE_MRN = X.PT_MRN JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V Y ON X.PT_MRN = Y.PT_MRN AND Y.PT_MRN <> '' LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS LANG ON PT_PRIMARY_LANG = LANG.AV_CODE AND LANG.AV_ELEMENT = 'PRIMARY_LANG' LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS ETH ON X.PT_PT_ETHNICITY = ETH.AV_CODE AND ETH.AV_ELEMENT = 'PT_ETHNICITY' LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS RACE ON X.PT_RACE = RACE.AV_CODE AND RACE.AV_ELEMENT = 'RACE' LEFT JOIN IDB.ACCRUALS_DATES P1 ON CPE_MRN = P1.ACD_MRN AND P1.ACD_IRB_NO = '06-107' LEFT JOIN IDB.ACCRUALS_DATES P2 ON CPE_MRN = P2.ACD_MRN AND (P2.ACD_OFF_STUDY_DTE IS NULL OR P2.ACD_TX_END_DTE < CURRENT DATE) AND P2.ACD_IRB_NO <> '06-107' LEFT JOIN IDB.PROTOCOL ON PRO_IRB_NO = P2.ACD_IRB_NO WHERE 1=1 AND CPE_ENC_DTE = CURRENT DATE + (CASE WHEN DAYOFWEEK(CURRENT DATE) = 6 THEN 3 ELSE 1 END) DAY AND A.CLD_CLD_CENTER = 'NAS' AND A.CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 = 'MED' AND CPE_CPE_APPT_STS = 'Sch' ) , IMPORD AS (SELECT DISTINCT PID, 'Ordered' AS ORDVAL FROM BASE INNER JOIN IDB.OMS_ORDER IMP ON MRN = IMP.OO_MRN JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_USER_DATA ORD_DATA ON (IMP.OO_ORD_GUID=ORD_DATA.OUD_ORD_GUID) JOIN IDB.OMS_CLIENT_VISIT ON IMP.OO_VISIT_GUID = OCV_VISIT_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_USER ON IMP.OO_PVDR_GUID = OU_USER_GUID JOIN IDB.DOC ON IMP.OO_REQ_DR_NO = DOC_DR_NO AND DOC_SOURCE_DESC = 'SMS' WHERE NOT (IMP.OO_ORD_STS_CD='CANC' OR IMP.OO_ORD_STS_CD='CANP') AND IMP.OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID = '7000003594073029' ) , IMPRES AS (SELECT DISTINCT PID, 'Resulted' AS RESVAL FROM BASE INNER JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_STRUCTURED_RESULTS_V ON PID = PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID WHERE METHOD = 'IMPACT') , IMPFAIL AS (SELECT DISTINCT BASE.PID, 'Failed' AS FAILVAL FROM BASE LEFT JOIN IMPRES ON BASE.PID = IMPRES.PID INNER JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT ON BASE.PID = PRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID INNER JOIN DV.PATH_RPRT_TYPE_LOOKUP ON PRPT_REPORT_TYPE = PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_CD WHERE IMPRES.PID IS NULL AND ((CONTAINS(PRPT_REPORT, '("TEST FAILURE" & "MSK-IMPACT")') = 1 AND PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_DESC = 'Diagnostic Molecular Pathology') AND PRPT_REPORT IS NOT NULL)) , IMPPROCESS AS (SELECT DISTINCT BASE.PID, 'In Process' AS INPVAL FROM BASE LEFT JOIN IMPRES ON BASE.PID = IMPRES.PID INNER JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT ON BASE.PID = PRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID INNER JOIN DV.PATH_RPRT_TYPE_LOOKUP ON PRPT_REPORT_TYPE = PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_CD WHERE IMPRES.PID IS NULL AND ((CONTAINS(PRPT_REPORT, '("MATCHED NORMAL" & "MSK-IMPACT")') = 1 AND PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_DESC = 'Diagnostic Molecular Pathology') AND PRPT_REPORT IS NOT NULL) ) , IMPBASE AS (SELECT DISTINCT BASE.PID, 'Registered' AS IMPCONS FROM BASE INNER JOIN DV.ACCRUALS ON AC_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = BASE.PID INNER JOIN DV.PROTOCOL ON AC_PROTOCOL_ID = PRO_PROTOCOL_ID WHERE PRO_IRB_NO = '12-245' ) , ALLIMP AS (SELECT BASE.PID AS ALLIMPPID, 'Registered' || CASE WHEN IMPRES.PID IS NOT NULL THEN CHR(13) || CHR(10) || ' ' || 'Resulted' WHEN IMPFAIL.PID IS NOT NULL THEN CHR(13) || CHR(10) || ' ' || 'Failed' WHEN IMPPROCESS.PID IS NOT NULL THEN CHR(13) || CHR(10) || ' ' || 'In Process' WHEN IMPORD.PID IS NOT NULL THEN CHR(13) || CHR(10) || ' ' || 'Ordered' ELSE '' END AS IMPSTATUS FROM IMPBASE AS BASE LEFT JOIN IMPPROCESS ON BASE.PID = IMPPROCESS.PID LEFT JOIN IMPFAIL ON BASE.PID = IMPFAIL.PID LEFT JOIN IMPRES ON BASE.PID = IMPRES.PID LEFT JOIN IMPORD ON BASE.PID = IMPORD.PID) SELECT DISTINCT MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, PRIMARY_LANGUAGE AS LANGUAGE , GENDER AS SEX, ETHNICITY, RACE, DEPARTMENT, PROVIDER, APPT_DTE, VISIT_TYPE, APPT_TIME, STATUS_06_107 , IMPSTATUS AS IMPACT_STATUS, PROTOCOL, PROTOCOL_TYPE, TX_START_DATE, TX_END_DATE FROM BASE LEFT JOIN ALLIMP ON BASE.PID = ALLIMPPID WHERE 1=1 ORDER BY APPT_DTE, APPT_TIME

prompt: All inpatient stays of more than one night from Jan. 1, 2013 going forward in daily report.
completion: WITH PTS AS (SELECT DISTINCT CS_MRN MRN, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH AS DOB , CASE WHEN PT_DATE_OF_DEATH BETWEEN CS_DSCH_DATE AND CS_DSCH_DATE + 90 DAY THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS DOD_3MOS_DSCH, PT_SEX AS SEX, CS_ACCT_NO AS ACCT_NO, CS_ADM_DATE AS ADM_DTE , CS_DSCH_DATE AS DSCH_DTE , RACE.AV_DESC AS RACE, ETHNIC.AV_DESC AS ETHNIC FROM IDB.CASE JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON CS_MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS RACE ON PT_RACE = RACE.AV_CODE AND RACE.AV_ELEMENT = 'RACE' LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS ETHNIC ON PT_PT_ETHNICITY = ETHNIC.AV_CODE AND ETHNIC.AV_ELEMENT = 'PT_ETHNICITY' WHERE CS_DAYS_STAY > 1 AND CS_ADM_DATE BETWEEN '2015-01-01' AND '2015-01-31' AND CS_PT_STS IN ('IA', 'IC') ) , C_DIFF AS (SELECT DISTINCT OHI_MRN, OHI_ACCT_NO, ADM_DTE, DSCH_DTE, OHI_HI_DESCRIPTION AS C_DIFF_IND FROM PTS JOIN IDB.OMS_HEALTH_ISSUE ON OHI_MRN = MRN AND OHI_ACCT_NO = ACCT_NO WHERE OHI_STS_CD IN ('Active', 'Inactive') AND OHI_TYPE_CD = 'Inf Control' AND OHI_HI_DESCRIPTION = 'Special Contact-C.Diff' AND OHI_CODE <> ' ' AND OHI_ONSET_DTE BETWEEN ADM_DTE AND DSCH_DTE ) , HIST AS (SELECT DISTINCT TM_MRN, AV_DESC AS TM_CASE_STS, TM_DX_DTE, TM_HIST_CD, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS HIST_DESC, TM_SITE_CD, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_DESC FROM PTS JOIN IDB.CDB_TUMOR ON TM_MRN = MRN JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS ON AV_ELEMENT = 'CASE_STS' AND AV_CODE = TM_CASE_STS WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('3', '6', '7') ) , SURGERY AS (SELECT SSE_MRN, SSE_SURG_DTE AS SURG_DTE, SSE_LOG_STS, SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD, SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC FROM C_DIFF JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT ON OHI_MRN = SSE_MRN AND SSE_SURG_DTE BETWEEN ADM_DTE - 30 DAY AND ADM_DTE - 1 DAY JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE ON SSE_LOG_ID = SSP_LOG_ID) , CHEMO AS (SELECT DISTINCT CPO_MRN, CPO_START_DTE, CPO_DRUG_NAME, CPO_VERIFY_POLICY, CPO_CHEMO_IND FROM C_DIFF JOIN IDB.CHEMO_PERFORMED_ORDERS ON OHI_MRN = CPO_MRN AND CPO_START_DTE BETWEEN ADM_DTE - 30 DAY AND ADM_DTE - 1 DAY) , RADONC AS (SELECT DISTINCT RTC_TX_MRN, RTC_TX_START_DTE, RTC_TX_PLAN_NAME FROM C_DIFF JOIN IDB.RADONC_TREATMENT_COURSE ON OHI_MRN = RTC_TX_MRN AND RTC_TX_START_DTE BETWEEN ADM_DTE - 30 DAY AND ADM_DTE - 1 DAY) SELECT DISTINCT MRN, DOB, SEX, RACE, ETHNIC, ACCT_NO, A.ADM_DTE, A.DSCH_DTE, DOD_3MOS_DSCH, C_DIFF_IND, TM_HIST_CD, TM_SITE_CD, SURG_DTE, SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD, SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC, CPO_START_DTE, CPO_DRUG_NAME , RTC_TX_START_DTE, RTC_TX_PLAN_NAME FROM PTS A LEFT JOIN C_DIFF ON MRN = OHI_MRN AND ACCT_NO = OHI_ACCT_NO LEFT JOIN HIST ON MRN = TM_MRN LEFT JOIN SURGERY ON OHI_MRN = SSE_MRN LEFT JOIN CHEMO ON CPO_MRN = OHI_MRN LEFT JOIN RADONC ON RTC_TX_MRN = OHI_MRN

prompt: Inverse dataline search: the research team has compiled a list of patients diagnosed with ALCL and treated with RT. Please provide information as requested under data elements for those given patients.
completion: WITH COHORT AS (SELECT PT_MRN , PT_LAST_NAME , PT_FIRST_NAME , PT_BIRTH_DTE AS DOB , PT_SEX AS SEX , PT_VITAL_STATUS AS VITAL_STATUS FROM DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS WHERE PT_MRN IN ('35425736', '35006756', '35367180', '00304082', '35160152', '35115320', '35226282', '35378257', '35503672', '35032382', '38007044', '35239455', '35500863', '35328904', '35212297', '35267805', '35313477', '00014844', '35306637', '00165743', '38062820', '00510870', '00016569', '35292249', '35153096', '00224185', '35303907 ', '00757361', '35317808', '00747886', '00660154', '35254277', '35357614', '00364207', '35310759', '00499491') ) , CLINTRAC AS (SELECT CC_MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS CC_DX_DTE FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN COHORT ON CC_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE SUBSTR(CC_CLSF_CD, 1, 5) IN ('C84.6', 'C84.7', '200.6') AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND (CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) GROUP BY CC_MRN ) , TUMOR AS (SELECT TM_MRN, TM_DX_DTE FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS ON AV_ELEMENT = 'CASE_STS' AND AV_CODE = TM_CASE_STS JOIN COHORT ON TM_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND TM_HIST_CD IN ('M9714/3', 'M9715/3', 'M9718/3') ) SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN AS MRN , PT_LAST_NAME , PT_FIRST_NAME , DOB , SEX , VITAL_STATUS , COALESCE(TM_DX_DTE, CC_DX_DTE) AS DX_DTE , CASE WHEN RTC_TX_MRN IS NOT NULL THEN 'Y' END AS RT_DATE_AVAIL FROM COHORT LEFT JOIN CLINTRAC ON PT_MRN = CC_MRN LEFT JOIN TUMOR ON PT_MRN = TM_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.RADONC_TREATMENT_COURSE ON PT_MRN = RTC_TX_MRN ; WITH COHORT AS (SELECT PT_MRN AS MRN , PT_LAST_NAME , PT_FIRST_NAME , PT_BIRTH_DTE AS DOB , PT_SEX AS SEX , PT_VITAL_STATUS AS VITAL_STATUS FROM DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS WHERE PT_MRN IN ('35425736', '35006756', '35367180', '00304082', '35160152', '35115320', '35226282', '35378257', '35503672', '35032382', '38007044', '35239455', '35500863', '35328904', '35212297', '35267805', '35313477', '00014844', '35306637', '00165743', '38062820', '00510870', '00016569', '35292249', '35153096', '00224185', '35303907 ', '00757361', '35317808', '00747886', '00660154', '35254277', '35357614', '00364207', '35310759', '00499491') ) SELECT PRPT_MRN AS MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, PRPT_PROCEDURE_DTE "Pathology Procedure Date", PRPT_REPORT_DTE "Pathology Report Date", PRPT_REPORT_TYPE_DESC "Report Type", PRPT_REPORT "Pathology Report" FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V JOIN COHORT ON PRPT_MRN = MRN WHERE PRPT_REPORT IS NOT NULL AND CONTAINS("PRPT_REPORT", '("LYMPH")') = 1 ; WITH COHORT AS (SELECT PT_MRN , PT_LAST_NAME , PT_FIRST_NAME , PT_BIRTH_DTE AS DOB , PT_SEX AS SEX , PT_VITAL_STATUS AS VITAL_STATUS FROM DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS WHERE PT_MRN IN ('35425736', '35006756', '35367180', '00304082', '35160152', '35115320', '35226282', '35378257', '35503672', '35032382', '38007044', '35239455', '35500863', '35328904', '35212297', '35267805', '35313477', '00014844', '35306637', '00165743', '38062820', '00510870', '00016569', '35292249', '35153096', '00224185', '35303907 ', '00757361', '35317808', '00747886', '00660154', '35254277', '35357614', '00364207', '35310759', '00499491') ) SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN AS MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, RTC_TX_PLAN_NAME "RT Site", RTC_TX_START_DTE "RT Start", RTC_TX_STOP_DTE "RT End", RTC_TX_PLANNED_FRACTIONS "Planned Fractions", RTC_TX_DELIVERED_FRACTIONS "Delivered Fractions", RTC_TX_PLANNED_DOSE "Planned Dose", RTC_TX_DELIVERED_DOSE "Delivered Dose" FROM COHORT LEFT JOIN IDB.RADONC_TREATMENT_COURSE ON PT_MRN = RTC_TX_MRN ; WITH COHORT AS (SELECT PT_MRN , PT_LAST_NAME , PT_FIRST_NAME , PT_BIRTH_DTE AS DOB , PT_SEX AS SEX , PT_VITAL_STATUS AS VITAL_STATUS FROM DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS WHERE PT_MRN IN ('35425736', '35006756', '35367180', '00304082', '35160152', '35115320', '35226282', '35378257', '35503672', '35032382', '38007044', '35239455', '35500863', '35328904', '35212297', '35267805', '35313477', '00014844', '35306637', '00165743', '38062820', '00510870', '00016569', '35292249', '35153096', '00224185', '35303907 ', '00757361', '35317808', '00747886', '00660154', '35254277', '35357614', '00364207', '35310759', '00499491') ) SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN AS MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, APR_START_DTE AS CHEMO_ADMIN_DTE, CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME AS CHEMO_NAME FROM COHORT LEFT JOIN IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX ON PT_MRN = APR_MRN AND APR_CHEMO_FLAG = 'Y' LEFT JOIN IDB.CHEMO_DRUG_GENERIC ON APR_GENERIC_NAME = CDG_GENERIC_NAME

prompt: Provide a list of patients whom Dr. Kalin have sent to UCC from 1/1/12 to present.
completion: SELECT OUO_MRN MRN, STRIP(PT_LAST_NAME)||', '||STRIP(PT_FIRST_NAME) PT_NAME, OUO_USER_NAME ENTEREDBY, OUO_PVDR_NAME PVDR_NAME, OUO_ENTER_DTE, OUO_ORD_NAME, OUO_ORD_ID, OUO_CURR_LOC LOCATION, OUO_ATN_PVDR_NAME ATT_NAME, OUO_IP_OP_IND IP_OP, OUO_ORD_STS_CD ORDSTS FROM IDB.OMS_USER_ORDERS JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PT_MRN - OUO_MRN WHERE OUO_ORD_NAME = 'UCC Notification' AND OUO_ENTER_DTE >= '2012-01-01' AND (OUO_USER_NAME = 'Kalin, Marcia' OR OUO_PVDR_NAME = 'Kalin, Marcia') AND OUO_IP_OP_IND = 'O' AND OUO_ORD_STS_CD not like 'CA%'

prompt: Patients seen in the breast service with a diagnosis of phyllodes tumor (at all time)
completion: WITH DX AS (SELECT PT_MRN, MIN (COALESCE(TM_DX_DTE, MIN_ICD9_EFF_DTE)) AS DX_DATE FROM IDB.PATIENT LEFT JOIN (SELECT TM_MRN, AV_DESC AS CASE_STS, TM_DX_DTE, TM_HIST_CD, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS HIST_DESC, TM_SITE_CD, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_DESC FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS ON AV_ELEMENT = 'CASE_STS' AND AV_CODE = TM_CASE_STS AND TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND TM_HIST_CD IN ('M9020/1', 'M9020/0', 'M9020/3') AND TM_DX_DTE BETWEEN '1950-01-01' AND '2017-05-15') AS CDB ON TM_MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN (SELECT CC_MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS MIN_ICD9_EFF_DTE, CC_CLSF_CD AS ICD9_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS ICD9_DESC FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE CC_CLSF_CD IN ('D24.1', 'D24.2', 'D24.9', 'D48.60', 'D48.61', 'D48.62', '217', '238.3' ) AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND (CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) GROUP BY CC_MRN, CC_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK HAVING MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) BETWEEN '1950-01-01' AND '2017-05-15') AS ICD9 ON CC_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE COALESCE(TM_MRN, CC_MRN) IS NOT NULL GROUP BY PT_MRN) SELECT CPE_MRN AS MRN , CPE_ENC_DTE AS "Appt Date", CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 AS "Department", CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 AS "Service", CLD_DEPT_NAME AS "Department Name", CRE_RES_NAME AS "Provider Name", CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME AS "Visit Type" FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN DX ON PT_MRN = CPE_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE 1=1 AND CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 = 'BRE' AND CRE_RES_TYP = 'Physician' AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN DATE('2017-05-15') - 5 YEARS AND '2017-05-15' ORDER BY 2 DESC ;

prompt: Provide two separate lists of cases including particular terms for IHC and specimen source for inclusion into our studies.
completion: SELECT PT_MRN AS "MRN", PT_LAST_NAME AS "Last Name", PT_FIRST_NAME AS "First Name", PT_BIRTH_DTE AS "DOB", PRPT_ACCESSION_NO AS "Accession Number", R.DT_DTE AS "Accession Date", PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_DESC AS "Report Type", CAST(TRIM(SUBSTR(CAST(PRPT_REPORT AS VARCHAR(18000)), CASE WHEN LOCATE('Specimens Submitted:', CAST(PRPT_REPORT AS VARCHAR(18000))) > 1 THEN LOCATE('Specimens Submitted:', CAST(PRPT_REPORT AS VARCHAR(18000))) END, LOCATE('DIAGNOSIS:', CAST(PRPT_REPORT AS VARCHAR(18000))) - CASE WHEN LOCATE('Specimens Submitted:', CAST(PRPT_REPORT AS VARCHAR(18000))) > 1 THEN LOCATE('Specimens Submitted:', CAST(PRPT_REPORT AS VARCHAR(18000))) END)) AS VARCHAR(1500)) "Specimen Source", CAST(PRPT_REPORT AS VARCHAR(32000)) AS "Path Report" FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT JOIN DV.DATE R ON R.DT_DATE_ID = PRPT_REPORT_DATE_ID JOIN DV.PATH_RPRT_TYPE_LOOKUP ON PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_CD = PRPT_REPORT_TYPE JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON PRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID WHERE 1=1 AND(LOCATE('tcr alpha', LOWER(CAST(PRPT_REPORT AS VARCHAR(18000)))) > 1 OR LOCATE('tcr-alpha', LOWER(CAST(PRPT_REPORT AS VARCHAR(18000)))) > 1) AND R.DT_DTE BETWEEN '1/1/2018' AND '05/17/2022' AND PRPT_REPORT IS NOT NULL AND LEFT(PRPT_ACCESSION_NO, 1) IN ('H'); SELECT PT_MRN AS "MRN", PT_LAST_NAME AS "Last Name", PT_FIRST_NAME AS "First Name", PT_BIRTH_DTE AS "DOB", PRPT_ACCESSION_NO AS "Accession Number", R.DT_DTE AS "Accession Date", PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_DESC AS "Report Type", CAST(TRIM(SUBSTR(CAST(PRPT_REPORT AS VARCHAR(18000)), CASE WHEN LOCATE('Specimens Submitted:', CAST(PRPT_REPORT AS VARCHAR(18000))) > 1 THEN LOCATE('Specimens Submitted:', CAST(PRPT_REPORT AS VARCHAR(18000))) END, LOCATE('DIAGNOSIS:', CAST(PRPT_REPORT AS VARCHAR(18000))) - CASE WHEN LOCATE('Specimens Submitted:', CAST(PRPT_REPORT AS VARCHAR(18000))) > 1 THEN LOCATE('Specimens Submitted:', CAST(PRPT_REPORT AS VARCHAR(18000))) END)) AS VARCHAR(1500)) "Specimen Source", CAST(PRPT_REPORT AS VARCHAR(32000)) AS "Path Report" FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT JOIN DV.DATE R ON R.DT_DATE_ID = PRPT_REPORT_DATE_ID JOIN DV.PATH_RPRT_TYPE_LOOKUP ON PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_CD = PRPT_REPORT_TYPE JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON PRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID WHERE 1=1 AND UPPER(CAST(PRPT_REPORT AS VARCHAR(32000))) like '%IGG4%' AND(LOCATE('retroperitoneum', LOWER(CAST(PRPT_REPORT AS VARCHAR(32000)))) > 1 OR LOCATE('paraaortic', LOWER(CAST(PRPT_REPORT AS VARCHAR(32000)))) > 1) AND R.DT_DTE BETWEEN '1/1/2015' AND '05/17/2022' AND PRPT_REPORT IS NOT NULL AND LEFT(PRPT_ACCESSION_NO, 1) IN ('H', 'S');

ACID', 'TRETINOIN', 'Tretinoin ') AND ("t6"."PDX_DX_CATALOG_ID" IN (6100) OR "t8"."DXCC_ICD_CODE" IN ('M9840/3', 'M9861/3', 'M9866/3', 'M9871/3', 'M9872/3', 'M9873/3', 'M9874/3', 'M9895/3', 'M9896/3', "t3"."DT_DATE_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DIAGNOSIS_CODE_CAT_ICDO_V" "t4" ON "t5"."CDTM_DX_CATALOG_ID" = "t4"."DXCC_DX_CATALOG_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PHM_PT_MEDS_MQT" "t6" ON "t1"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t6"."POD_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PHM_INVENTORY_CATALOG" "t7" ON "t6"."POD_PHARMA_INVENTORY_CTLG_ID" = "t7"."PINC_INVENTORY_CTLG_ID" WHERE ("t7"."PINC_GENERIC_NAME" IN ('ALL TRANS JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DIAGNOSIS_FINAL_DATES_V" "t5" ON "t4"."PDX_DX_CATALOG_ID" = "t5"."PDX_DX_CATALOG_ID" AND "t4"."PDX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t5"."PDX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE" "t3" ON "t5"."FIRST_DIAGNOSIS_DATE_ID" = "t3"."DT_DATE_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PHM_PT_MEDS_MQT" "t6" ON "t1"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t6"."POD_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN prompt: List of patients with visits canceled within 72 hours or less with the list of Pulmonary Attendings for 2021 and 1/1/22-7/31/22
completion: WITH ENCOUNTER AS (SELECT CPE_MRN, CPE_ENC_DTE AS ORIGINAL_APPOINTMENT_DATE, CPE_ENC_TYP_CD, CPE_ENC_TYP_TTL, CPE_VST_RES_ID, CPE_DEPT_ID, CPE_CPE_APPT_STS, CPE_APPT_DT, CPE_CANCEL_DTE, CPE_CPE_CANCEL_RSN, CRE_RES_ID, CRE_RES_NAME, CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR, CASE WHEN CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('CxlSameDay', 'No Show') THEN -1 ELSE (CPE_ENC_DTE - CPE_CANCEL_DTE) END AS DAYS_BEORE_CANCEL FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CRE_RES_ID = CPE_VST_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Can', 'CxlSameDay', 'No Show') AND CPE_ENC_DTE >= '01/01/2021' AND CPE_ENC_DTE <= '07/31/2022' AND UPPER(CRE_RES_NAME) IN ('GEYER, ALEXANDER IOSIF', 'HUSTA, BRYAN CHRISTOPHER', 'STOVER, DIANE', 'YOGIAVEETIL, ELIZABETH CHACKO', 'KHUSAINOVA, ELVINA', 'BEATTIE, JASON ANTHONY', 'SANTAMAURO, JEAN', 'VAN ELDEN, LEONTINE JULIE ROSE', 'FEINSTEIN, MARC', 'TAN, MIRANDA', 'CHAWLA, MOHIT', 'VANDER ELS, NICHOLAS', 'KALCHIEM-DEKEL, OR', 'KAPLAN, RANA', 'LEE, ROBERT') AND (CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR LIKE '%NV%' OR CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR LIKE '%IR%')), CANCELED_APPTS AS (SELECT * FROM ENCOUNTER WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('CxlSameDay', 'No Show') OR (DAYS_BEORE_CANCEL >= -1 AND DAYS_BEORE_CANCEL <= 3)), COMPLETED_APPOINTMENTS AS (SELECT CPE_MRN, CPE_ENC_DTE, CPE_ENC_TYP_CD, CPE_ENC_TYP_TTL, CPE_VST_RES_ID, CPE_DEPT_ID, CPE_CPE_APPT_STS, CPE_APPT_DT, CPE_CANCEL_DTE, CPE_CPE_CANCEL_RSN, CRE_RES_ID, CRE_RES_NAME, CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CRE_RES_ID = CPE_VST_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CPE_ENC_DTE >= '01/01/2021' AND CPE_ENC_DTE <= '07/31/2022' AND UPPER(CRE_RES_NAME) IN ('GEYER, ALEXANDER IOSIF', 'HUSTA, BRYAN CHRISTOPHER', 'STOVER, DIANE', 'YOGIAVEETIL, ELIZABETH CHACKO', 'KHUSAINOVA, ELVINA', 'BEATTIE, JASON ANTHONY', 'SANTAMAURO, JEAN', 'VAN ELDEN, LEONTINE JULIE ROSE', 'FEINSTEIN, MARC', 'TAN, MIRANDA', 'CHAWLA, MOHIT', 'VANDER ELS, NICHOLAS', 'KALCHIEM-DEKEL, OR', 'KAPLAN, RANA', 'LEE, ROBERT') AND (CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR LIKE '%NV%' OR CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR LIKE '%IR%') AND CPE_MRN IN (SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN FROM CANCELED_APPTS)) SELECT CANCLED.*, COMPLETED.CPE_ENC_DTE AS RESCHEDULED_DATE FROM CANCELED_APPTS AS CANCLED LEFT JOIN COMPLETED_APPOINTMENTS AS COMPLETED ON CANCLED.CPE_MRN = COMPLETED.CPE_MRN WHERE (COMPLETED.CPE_ENC_DTE IS NULL OR (COMPLETED.CPE_ENC_DTE - ORIGINAL_APPOINTMENT_DATE) > 3) ORDER BY 1;

prompt: Provide the list of patient MRN and demographics (date of birth, sex, race, and ethnicity) for all patients with a dermatology note by Dr. Liang Deng
completion: WITH DIAG AS (SELECT DISTINCT CC_MRN, CC_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK, AV_DESC AS CLSF_TYPE FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CLM_CLSF_CD = CC_CLSF_CD LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS ON AV_ELEMENT = 'CLSF_TYPE' AND AV_CODE = CC_CLSF_TYPE WHERE (CC_CLSF_CD LIKE '176%' OR CLM_CLSF_CD LIKE 'C46%') AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND (CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) ) SELECT DISTINCT CDD_MRN AS "MRN", PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH AS "DATE_OF_BIRTH", PT_SEX AS "SEX", R.AV_DESC AS "RACE", E.AV_DESC AS "ETHNICITY", OP_DISPLAY_NAME AS "DOCTOR_NAME" FROM IDB.CD_DOCUMENT JOIN IDB.OMS_PROVIDER ON CDD_AUTH_PROV_GUID = OP_PVDR_GUID JOIN DIAG ON CDD_MRN = CC_MRN JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON CDD_MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS R ON R.AV_ELEMENT = 'RACE' AND R.AV_CODE = PT_RACE LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS E ON E.AV_ELEMENT = 'PT_ETHNICITY' AND E.AV_CODE = PT_PT_ETHNICITY WHERE CDD_CANCEL_IND <> '1' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND <> '1' AND UPPER(CDD_DOC_NAME) LIKE '%DERM%' AND CDD_SERVICE_DTE BETWEEN '1966-04-01' AND '2022-01-01'

completion: WITH CTE AS (SELECT CRSR_RC_RECORD_ID, CRSR_RC_SURVEY_DT, CRSR_DATA, DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)(?<="request_type" : ")[^"]*', CRSR_DATA) REQUEST_TYPE, DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)(?<="first_name" : ")[^"]*', CRSR_DATA) FIRST_NAME, DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)(?<="last_name" : ")[^"]*', CRSR_DATA) LAST_NAME, DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)(?<="dob" : ")[^"]*', CRSR_DATA) DOB, DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)(?<="requester" : ")[^"]*', CRSR_DATA) REQUESTER, DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)(?<="visitor_first_name" : ")[^"]*', CRSR_DATA) VISITOR_FIRST_NAME, DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)(?<="visitor_last_name" : ")[^"]*', CRSR_DATA) VISITOR_LAST_NAME, DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)(?<="visitor_phone_visitor" : ")[^"]*', CRSR_DATA) VISITOR_PHONE_VISITOR, DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)(?<="visitor_email" : ")[^"]*', CRSR_DATA) VISITOR_EMAIL, DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)(?<="request_date" : ")[^"]*', CRSR_DATA) REQUEST_DATE, DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)(?<="request_timestamp" : ")[^"]*', CRSR_DATA) REQUEST_TIMESTAMP, DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)(?<="visitor_contact_visitor" : ")[^"]*', CRSR_DATA) VISITOR_CONTACT_VISITOR, DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)(?<="visitor_symptoms_visitor" : ")[^"]*', CRSR_DATA) VISITOR_SYMPTOMS_VISITOR, DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)(?<="visitor_states" : ")[^"]*', CRSR_DATA) VISITOR_STATES, DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)(?<="first_name_visitor" : ")[^"]*', CRSR_DATA) FIRST_NAME_VISITOR, DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)(?<="last_name_visitor" : ")[^"]*', CRSR_DATA) LAST_NAME_VISITOR, DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)(?<="phone_visitor" : ")[^"]*', CRSR_DATA) PHONE_VISITOR, DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)(?<="visitor_contact" : ")[^"]*', CRSR_DATA) VISITOR_CONTACT, DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)(?<="visitor_symptoms" : ")[^"]*', CRSR_DATA) VISITOR_SYMPTOMS, DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)(?<="states_visitor_14" : ")[^"]*', CRSR_DATA) STATES_VISITOR_14, DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)(?<="visitor_approved" : ")[^"]*', CRSR_DATA) VISITOR_APPROVED FROM IDB.COVID19_REDCAP_SURVEY_RSLT WHERE CRSR_RC_PROJ_ID = 1600 ) SELECT CRSR_RC_RECORD_ID, CRSR_RC_SURVEY_DT, REQUEST_TYPE, FIRST_NAME, LAST_NAME, DOB, REQUESTER, CASE WHEN REQUESTER = 'I am the patient' THEN FIRST_NAME_VISITOR ELSE VISITOR_FIRST_NAME END AS VISITOR_FIRST_NAME, CASE WHEN REQUESTER = 'I am the patient' THEN LAST_NAME_VISITOR ELSE VISITOR_LAST_NAME END AS VISITOR_LAST_NAME, VISITOR_PHONE_VISITOR, VISITOR_EMAIL, REQUEST_DATE, REQUEST_TIMESTAMP, CASE WHEN REQUESTER = 'I am the patient' THEN VISITOR_CONTACT ELSE VISITOR_CONTACT_VISITOR END AS VISITOR_CONTACT, CASE WHEN REQUESTER = 'I am the patient' THEN VISITOR_SYMPTOMS ELSE VISITOR_SYMPTOMS_VISITOR END AS VISITOR_SYMPTOMS, CASE WHEN REQUESTER = 'I am the patient' THEN STATES_VISITOR_14 ELSE VISITOR_STATES END AS VISITOR_STATES, PHONE_VISITOR, VISITOR_APPROVED, CRSR_DATA FROM CTE

prompt: Add additional worksheet to report AMB23668 to capture data for IEC (immune effector cell) collections.
completion: SELECT ORDER_MONTH "Month" , ORDER_YEAR "Year" , OP_DISPLAY_NAME "Requesting Provider" , COUNT(OO_ORD_GUID) AS "Count" , OUD_USER_DI_VALUE AS "Production Facility" FROM (SELECT DISTINCT OO_ORD_GUID, OO_MRN, MONTH(OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE) AS ORDER_MONTH, YEAR(OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE) AS ORDER_YEAR, OP_DISPLAY_NAME, OUD_USER_DI_VALUE FROM IDB.OMS_ORDER JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_CATALOG ON OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID = OOC_MSTR_ITEM_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_STATUS ON OO_ORD_STS_CD = OSTS_ORD_STS_CD JOIN IDB.OMS_PROVIDER ON OP_PVDR_GUID = OO_PVDR_GUID JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON OO_MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_USER_DATA ON OUD_ORD_GUID = OO_ORD_GUID WHERE 1=1 AND (OOC_ITEM_NAME = 'Immune Effector Cells (IEC) - MNC - A - Collection - Processing' ) AND OO_ORD_STS_CD NOT IN ('CANP', 'CANC', 'AUC3') AND OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE >= '2021-01-01' AND OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE < (DATE('0001-01-01') + YEAR(CURRENT date) YEARS - 1 YEAR + MONTH(CURRENT date) MONTHS - 1 MONTHS) AND YEAR(OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) >= 21 AND LOWER(OUD_USER_DI_CD) like '%facility%' ) A GROUP BY ORDER_MONTH, ORDER_YEAR, OP_DISPLAY_NAME, OUD_USER_DI_VALUE ORDER BY ORDER_YEAR, ORDER_MONTH, OP_DISPLAY_NAME ; SELECT ORDER_MONTH "Month" , ORDER_YEAR "Year" , OP_DISPLAY_NAME "Requesting Provider" , COUNT(OO_ORD_GUID) AS "Count" , OO_SET_NAME "Order Set Name" FROM (SELECT DISTINCT OO_ORD_GUID, OO_MRN, MONTH(OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE) AS ORDER_MONTH, YEAR(OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE) AS ORDER_YEAR, OO_SET_NAME, OP_DISPLAY_NAME FROM IDB.OMS_ORDER JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_CATALOG ON OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID = OOC_MSTR_ITEM_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_STATUS ON OO_ORD_STS_CD = OSTS_ORD_STS_CD JOIN IDB.OMS_PROVIDER ON OP_PVDR_GUID = OO_PVDR_GUID JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON OO_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE 1=1 AND (OOC_ITEM_NAME = 'Immune Effector Cells (IEC) - Thaw - Infusion Order' AND OO_SET_NAME IN ('Axicabtagene_Ciloleucel_INJ_Orderset', 'Brexucabtagene_Autoleucel_INJ_Orderset', 'Idecabtagene_Vicleucel_INJ_Orderset', 'Lisocabtagene_Maraleucel_INJ_Orderset', 'Tisagenlecleucel_INJ_Orderset')) AND OO_ORD_STS_CD NOT IN ('CANP', 'CANC', 'AUC3') AND OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE >= '2021-01-01' AND OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE < (DATE('0001-01-01') + YEAR(CURRENT date) YEARS - 1 YEAR + MONTH(CURRENT date) MONTHS - 1 MONTHS) AND YEAR(OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) >= 21 ) A GROUP BY ORDER_MONTH, ORDER_YEAR, OP_DISPLAY_NAME, OO_SET_NAME ORDER BY ORDER_YEAR, ORDER_MONTH, OP_DISPLAY_NAME ; SELECT ORDER_MONTH "Month" , ORDER_YEAR "Year" , OP_DISPLAY_NAME "Requesting Provider" , COUNT(OO_ORD_GUID) AS "Count" , DRUG_NAME "Drug Name" FROM (SELECT DISTINCT OO_ORD_GUID, OO_MRN, MONTH(OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE) AS ORDER_MONTH, YEAR(OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE) AS ORDER_YEAR, OOC_ITEM_NAME, OP_DISPLAY_NAME, TRIM(OUD_USER_DI_VALUE) AS DRUG_NAME FROM IDB.OMS_ORDER JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_CATALOG ON OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID = OOC_MSTR_ITEM_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_STATUS ON OO_ORD_STS_CD = OSTS_ORD_STS_CD JOIN IDB.OMS_PROVIDER ON OP_PVDR_GUID = OO_PVDR_GUID JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON OO_MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_USER_DATA A ON OUD_ORD_GUID = OO_ORD_GUID AND OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'Rx-CART_Drug' WHERE 1=1 AND OOC_ITEM_NAME IN ('Financial Clearance for CAR-T Cell') AND OO_ORD_STS_CD NOT IN ('CANP', 'CANC', 'AUC3') AND OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE >= '2021-01-01' AND OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE < (DATE('0001-01-01') + YEAR(CURRENT date) YEARS - 1 YEAR + MONTH(CURRENT date) MONTHS - 1 MONTHS) AND YEAR(OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) >= 21 ) A GROUP BY ORDER_MONTH, ORDER_YEAR, OP_DISPLAY_NAME, DRUG_NAME ORDER BY ORDER_YEAR, ORDER_MONTH, OP_DISPLAY_NAME ; SELECT ORDER_MONTH "Month" , ORDER_YEAR "Year" , OP_DISPLAY_NAME "Requesting Provider" , COUNT(OO_ORD_GUID) AS "Count" , "Dx" , "Referral To" , "Heme" FROM (SELECT DISTINCT OO_ORD_GUID, OO_MRN, MONTH(OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE) AS ORDER_MONTH, YEAR(OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE) AS ORDER_YEAR, OOC_ITEM_NAME, OP_DISPLAY_NAME, MAX(CASE WHEN OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'CTC_Dx' THEN TRIM(OUD_USER_DI_VALUE) END) AS "Dx", MAX(CASE WHEN OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'CTC_Referral To' THEN TRIM(OUD_USER_DI_VALUE) END) AS "Referral To", MAX(CASE WHEN OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'CTC_Heme Only' THEN TRIM(OUD_USER_DI_VALUE) END) AS "Heme" FROM IDB.OMS_ORDER JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_CATALOG ON OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID = OOC_MSTR_ITEM_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_STATUS ON OO_ORD_STS_CD = OSTS_ORD_STS_CD JOIN IDB.OMS_PROVIDER ON OP_PVDR_GUID = OO_PVDR_GUID JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON OO_MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_USER_DATA A ON OUD_ORD_GUID = OO_ORD_GUID AND OUD_USER_DI_CD IN ('CTC_Dx', 'CTC_Referral To', 'CTC_Heme Only') WHERE 1=1 AND OOC_ITEM_NAME IN ('CTS Referral') AND OO_ORD_STS_CD NOT IN ('CANP', 'CANC', 'AUC3') AND OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE >= '2021-01-01' AND OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE < (DATE('0001-01-01') + YEAR(CURRENT date) YEARS - 1 YEAR + MONTH(CURRENT date) MONTHS - 1 MONTHS) AND YEAR(OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) >= 21 GROUP BY OO_ORD_GUID, OO_MRN, MONTH(OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE), YEAR(OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE), OOC_ITEM_NAME, OP_DISPLAY_NAME) A GROUP BY ORDER_MONTH, ORDER_YEAR, OP_DISPLAY_NAME, "Dx", "Referral To", "Heme" ORDER BY ORDER_YEAR, ORDER_MONTH, OP_DISPLAY_NAME ;

prompt:
The project aims to identify patients with urothelial cancers who are treated here in mskcc, who develop brain metastases. 



This was previously requested back in 2020. We want to get updated number of cases. 

No changes in the nature or data elements of the request otherwise.
completion: WITH CA AS (SELECT TM_MRN CA_MRN FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND (TM_SITE_CD IN ('C659', 'C669') OR SUBSTR(TM_SITE_CD, 1, 3) IN ('C67', 'C68') OR TM_HIST_CD IN ('M8120/3', 'M8130/3', 'M8131/3')) AND RIGHT(TRIM(TM_HIST_CD), 1) = '3' UNION SELECT CC_MRN CA_MRN FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE (SUBSTR(CC_CLSF_CD, 1, 3) IN ('C67', 'C68') OR SUBSTR(CC_CLSF_CD, 1, 5) IN ('C65.9', 'C66.9')) AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND (CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) ) , TMT AS (SELECT TMT_MRN , MIN(MIN_TMT_DTE) AS MIN_TMT_DTE FROM (SELECT SSE_MRN TMT_MRN, MIN(SSE_SURG_DTE) MIN_TMT_DTE FROM IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT JOIN CA ON SSE_MRN = CA_MRN JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE ON SSE_LOG_ID = SSP_LOG_ID AND SSE_ENC_CSN_ID = SSP_ENC_CSN_ID WHERE (SSE_SURG_LOC not like '%IR%' AND SSE_SURG_LOC not like '%ENDO%' AND SSE_SOURCE_TYPE <> 'E') AND (SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC LIKE '%CRANIOTOMY%' OR SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC LIKE '%CRANIECTOMY%') GROUP BY SSE_MRN UNION SELECT RTC_TX_MRN TMT_MRN, MIN(RTC_TX_START_DTE) AS MIN_TMT_DTE FROM IDB.RADONC_TREATMENT_COURSE JOIN CA ON RTC_TX_MRN = CA_MRN WHERE RTC_TX_PLAN_NAME LIKE '%BRAIN%' OR RTC_TX_PLAN_NAME LIKE '%HEAD%' OR RTC_TX_PLAN_NAME LIKE '%BRN%' GROUP BY RTC_TX_MRN ) GROUP BY TMT_MRN) , GU AS (SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN CA ON CPE_MRN = CA_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 ='MED' AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 ='GU' ) , PATIENT AS (SELECT PT_MRN , CASE WHEN PLA_LST_DSCH_DTE >= PLA_LST_APPT_DTE THEN PLA_LST_DSCH_DTE ELSE PLA_LST_APPT_DTE END AS LAST_ENC_DTE , PT_DATE_OF_DEATH , MIN_TMT_DTE FROM IDB.PATIENT JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY ON PLA_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN GU ON PT_MRN = CPE_MRN JOIN TMT ON PT_MRN = TMT_MRN) SELECT APR_MRN AS MRN, LAST_ENC_DTE AS "Date of Last Follow up", PT_DATE_OF_DEATH AS "Date of Death", APR_START_DTE AS "Drug Start Date", APR_END_DTE AS "Drug End Date", CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME AS "Drug Name" FROM IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX_V JOIN PATIENT ON APR_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE CDG_CHEMO_FLAG = 'Y' ORDER BY APR_MRN ; WITH CA AS (SELECT TM_MRN CA_MRN FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND (TM_SITE_CD IN ('C659', 'C669') OR SUBSTR(TM_SITE_CD, 1, 3) IN ('C67', 'C68') OR TM_HIST_CD IN ('M8120/3', 'M8130/3', 'M8131/3')) AND RIGHT(TRIM(TM_HIST_CD), 1) = '3' UNION SELECT CC_MRN CA_MRN FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE (SUBSTR(CC_CLSF_CD, 1, 3) IN ('C67', 'C68') OR SUBSTR(CC_CLSF_CD, 1, 5) IN ('C65.9', 'C66.9')) AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND (CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) ) , TMT AS (SELECT TMT_MRN , MIN(MIN_TMT_DTE) AS MIN_TMT_DTE FROM (SELECT SSE_MRN TMT_MRN, MIN(SSE_SURG_DTE) MIN_TMT_DTE FROM IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT JOIN CA ON SSE_MRN = CA_MRN JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE ON SSE_LOG_ID = SSP_LOG_ID AND SSE_ENC_CSN_ID = SSP_ENC_CSN_ID WHERE (SSE_SURG_LOC not like '%IR%' AND SSE_SURG_LOC not like '%ENDO%' AND SSE_SOURCE_TYPE <> 'E') AND (SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC LIKE '%CRANIOTOMY%' OR SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC LIKE '%CRANIECTOMY%') GROUP BY SSE_MRN UNION SELECT RTC_TX_MRN TMT_MRN, MIN(RTC_TX_START_DTE) AS MIN_TMT_DTE FROM IDB.RADONC_TREATMENT_COURSE JOIN CA ON RTC_TX_MRN = CA_MRN WHERE RTC_TX_PLAN_NAME LIKE '%BRAIN%' OR RTC_TX_PLAN_NAME LIKE '%HEAD%' OR RTC_TX_PLAN_NAME LIKE '%BRN%' GROUP BY RTC_TX_MRN ) GROUP BY TMT_MRN) , GU AS (SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN CA ON CPE_MRN = CA_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 ='MED' AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 ='GU' ) , PATIENT AS (SELECT PT_MRN , CASE WHEN PLA_LST_DSCH_DTE >= PLA_LST_APPT_DTE THEN PLA_LST_DSCH_DTE ELSE PLA_LST_APPT_DTE END AS LAST_ENC_DTE , PT_DATE_OF_DEATH , MIN_TMT_DTE FROM IDB.PATIENT JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY ON PLA_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN GU ON PT_MRN = CPE_MRN JOIN TMT ON PT_MRN = TMT_MRN) , RAD AS (SELECT DISTINCT RRPT_MRN AS RAD_MRN, MIN_TMT_DTE AS RADONC_DATE, RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE AS REPORT_PERFORMED_DATE, RRPT_PROCEDURE_NAME AS REPORT_PROC_NAME, VARCHAR(RRPT_REPORT_TXT, 32000) AS REPORT_TEXT FROM PATIENT JOIN DV.RADIOLOGY_REPORT_V ON RRPT_MRN = PT_MRN AND RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE < MIN_TMT_DTE WHERE RRPT_ORDER_GROUP IN ('MR', 'CT') AND (UPPER(RRPT_PROCEDURE_NAME) LIKE '%BRAIN%' OR UPPER(RRPT_PROCEDURE_NAME) LIKE '%HEAD%') ), FIRSTRAD AS (SELECT DISTINCT RAD_MRN AS FIRST_RAD_MRN, REPORT_PERFORMED_DATE AS FIRST_RAD_DATE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY RAD_MRN ORDER BY REPORT_PERFORMED_DATE DESC) AS RN, REPORT_PROC_NAME, REPORT_TEXT FROM RAD WHERE REPORT_PERFORMED_DATE <= '2022-12-30' ) SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN AS MRN, LAST_ENC_DTE AS "Date of Last Follow up", PT_DATE_OF_DEATH AS "Date of Death", FIRST_RAD_DATE AS "Report Performed Date", REPORT_PROC_NAME AS "Report Procedure Name", REPORT_TEXT AS "Report Text" FROM PATIENT JOIN FIRSTRAD ON FIRST_RAD_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE RN = 1 ORDER BY PT_MRN ;

completion: SELECT DISTINCT ES_STAT_CYCLE_DTE "Cycle Date", DWMT_TARG_SUBJ_AREA "Subject Area", CASE WHEN ESM_TARGET_TABLE LIKE 'IDB.%' THEN SUBSTR(ESM_TARGET_TABLE, 5, 124) ELSE ESM_TARGET_TABLE END AS "Table Name", ES_STAT_VALUE "Rows" FROM DMC.ETL_STAT_MASTER INNER JOIN DMC.ETL_STATISTICS ON ES_STAT_MASTER_ID = ESM_STAT_MASTER_ID LEFT OUTER JOIN DMC.DATA_REFERENCE ON DWMT_TARG_TABLE_NAME = CASE WHEN ESM_TARGET_TABLE LIKE 'IDB.%' THEN SUBSTR(ESM_TARGET_TABLE, 5, 124) ELSE ESM_TARGET_TABLE END WHERE ESM_STAT_TYPE_CD IN ('AFT') AND ES_STAT_CYCLE_DTE BETWEEN (CURRENT date - 2 DAY) AND (CURRENT date - 1 DAY) AND DWMT_TARG_SCHEMA_NAME IS NOT NULL AND DWMT_TARG_DW = 'IDB' ORDER BY 1, 2, 3 ; SELECT DISTINCT ST_STAT_CYCLE_DTE "Cycle Date", DWMT_TARG_SUBJ_AREA "Subject Area", STM_TARGET_TABLE_NAME "Table Name", ST_STAT_VALUE "Rows" FROM DVDMC.STATISTICS_MASTER INNER JOIN DVDMC.STATISTICS ON STM_STAT_MASTER_ID = ST_STAT_MASTER_ID LEFT OUTER JOIN DMC.DATA_REFERENCE ON DWMT_TARG_TABLE_NAME = CASE WHEN STM_TARGET_TABLE_NAME LIKE 'DV.%' THEN SUBSTR(STM_TARGET_TABLE_NAME, 5, 124) ELSE STM_TARGET_TABLE_NAME END WHERE STM_STAT_TYPE_CD IN ('AFT') AND ST_STAT_CYCLE_DTE BETWEEN (CURRENT date - 2 DAY) AND (CURRENT date - 1 DAY) AND DWMT_TARG_SCHEMA_NAME IS NOT NULL AND DWMT_TARG_DW = 'DARWIN' ORDER BY ST_STAT_CYCLE_DTE, DWMT_TARG_SUBJ_AREA, STM_TARGET_TABLE_NAME ASC; ; SELECT DISTINCT ELM_PROCESS_DTE "Cycle Date", ESTD_SCHEMA_NAME "Subject Area", ESTD_TABLE_NAME "Table Name", EDPC_BEFORE_CNT "Rows" FROM FWDMC.ETL_LOAD_MASTER INNER JOIN FWDMC.ETL_JOBS ON ELM_JOB_ID = EJOB_JOB_ID INNER JOIN FWDMC.ETL_SEQUENCES ON ELM_SEQ_ID = ESEQ_SEQUENCE_ID INNER JOIN FWDMC.ETL_SEQ_TBL_DTL ON ESTD_SEQUENCE_ID = ESEQ_SEQUENCE_ID INNER JOIN FWDMC.ETL_DAILY_PRC_CNT ON EDPC_SEQ_TBL_ID = ESTD_SEQ_TBL_ID AND EDPC_PROCESS_DTE = ELM_PROCESS_DTE WHERE ELM_PROCESS_DTE BETWEEN (CURRENT date - 2 DAY) AND (CURRENT date - 1 DAY) AND ESTD_SCHEMA_NAME <> 'FWDMC' ORDER BY ELM_PROCESS_DTE, ESTD_TABLE_NAME ASC

prompt: Provide a one-time list of angioimmunoblastic T cell lymphoma patients.
completion: WITH CC AS (SELECT CC_MRN, CLM_CLSF_CD AS DX_CODE, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS DX_DESC, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS DX_DATE FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND ((CC_PT_TYPE = 'I') OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) AND CC_CLSF_CD = 'C86.5' GROUP BY CC_MRN, CLM_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK ) , X AS (SELECT CC_MRN AS MRN, STRIP(PT_LAST_NAME) || ', ' || STRIP(PT_FIRST_NAME) AS NAME, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH AS DOB, PT_SEX AS GENDER, R.AV_DESC AS "Race", E.AV_DESC AS "Ethnicity", DX_CODE, DX_DESC, DX_DATE FROM CC JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON CC_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY ON CC_MRN = PLA_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS R ON PT_RACE = R.AV_CODE AND R.AV_ELEMENT = 'RACE' LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS E ON PT_PT_ETHNICITY = E.AV_CODE AND E.AV_ELEMENT = 'PT_ETHNICITY' WHERE 1=1 ) , AC AS (SELECT AC_MRN, MAX(CASE WHEN AC_IRB_NO = '06-107' THEN AC_CONS_DTE END) AS "06-107 Consent Date", MAX(CASE WHEN AC_IRB_NO = '09-141' THEN AC_CONS_DTE END) AS "09-141 Consent Date", MAX(CASE WHEN AC_IRB_NO = '12-245' THEN AC_CONS_DTE END) AS "12-245 Consent Date" FROM IDB.ACCRUALS JOIN X ON AC_MRN = MRN WHERE AC_IRB_NO IN ('06-107', '09-141', '12-245') GROUP BY AC_MRN ) , Y AS (SELECT DISTINCT X.*, "06-107 Consent Date", "09-141 Consent Date", "12-245 Consent Date" FROM X LEFT JOIN AC ON MRN = AC_MRN) SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN, NAME, GENE, RESULT, METHOD, PATH_PROCEDURE_DATE FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_STRUCTURED_RESULTS_V JOIN Y ON PT_MRN = MRN

prompt: Provide a report of all patients diagnosed with "germ cell tumor", "mixed germ cell tumor", "yolk sac tumor", "seminoma", "germinoma", "dysgerminoma", "non-Seminomatous germ cell tumor", "choriocarcinoma", "embryonal carcinoma", "teratoma", "mature teratoma", or "immature teratoma" with at least one bone marrow biopsy done at MSK.
completion: WITH X AS (SELECT DISTINCT "t1"."PT_MRN" AS "MRN", "t1"."PT_LAST_NAME" AS "Last Name", "t1"."PT_FIRST_NAME" AS "First Name", "t1"."PT_BIRTH_DTE" AS "Date of Birth", "t2"."PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_DESC" AS "Pathology Report Type", "t3"."PRPT_ACCESSION_NO" AS "Pathology Report", "t4"."DT_DTE" AS "Pathology Report Date", UPPER(CASE WHEN LENGTH(PRPT_REPORT) <= 15000 THEN RTRIM(CAST(SUBSTR(PRPT_REPORT, 1, 15000) AS VARCHAR(15000))) ELSE CAST(SUBSTR(PRPT_REPORT, 1, 15000) AS VARCHAR(15000)) END) AS TXT, UPPER(DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)SPECIMENS SUBMITTED[\w\W]*(?=DIAGNOSIS:)', PRPT_REPORT)) AS "SPECIMENS SUBMITTED", UPPER(DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)SPECIMENS SUBMITTED[\w\W]*(?=DIAGNOSIS)', PRPT_REPORT)) AS "SPECIMENS SUBMITTED2" FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V" "t1" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED" "t5" ON "t1"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t5"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V" "t3" ON "t5"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t3"."PRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATH_RPRT_TYPE_LOOKUP" "t2" ON "t3"."PRPT_REPORT_TYPE" = "t2"."PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_CD" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" "t4" ON "t3"."PRPT_REPORT_DATE_ID" = "t4"."DT_DATE_ID" WHERE (CONTAINS("t3"."PRPT_REPORT", '("germ cell tumor" | "mixed germ cell tumor" | "yolk sac tumor" | "seminoma" | "germinoma" | "dysgerminoma" | "non-Seminomatous germ cell tumor" | "choriocarcinoma" | "embryonal carcinoma" | "teratoma" | "mature teratoma" | "immature teratoma")') = 1 AND CONTAINS("t3"."PRPT_REPORT", '("bone marrow")') = 1 AND "t3"."PRPT_REPORT" IS NOT NULL) AND("t3"."PRPT_ACCESSION_NO" LIKE 'H%' OR "t3"."PRPT_ACCESSION_NO" LIKE 'S%') ) SELECT * FROM X

prompt: Provide on demand list of notes entered by AYA (adolescent and young adult) providers.
completion: SELECT DISTINCT CDD_MRN, CDD_DOC_GUID , CDD_DOC_NAME , OP_DISPLAY_NAME, CDD_SERVICE_DTE , PT_SEX , PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH AS DOB , COALESCE(YEAR(PT_DATE_OF_DEATH), YEAR(CURRENT DATE)) - YEAR(PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) AS CURRENT_AGE, YEAR(CDD_SERVICE_DTE)- YEAR(PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) AS NOTE_AGE, SVC.CDO_VALUE_TEXT AS SERVICE FROM IDB.CD_DOCUMENT JOIN IDB.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V ON CDD_MRN = PT_MRN AND YEAR(CDD_SERVICE_DTE)- YEAR(PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) BETWEEN 15 AND 39 INNER JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION A ON A.CDO_DOC_GUID = CDD_DOC_GUID LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_USER ON A.CDO_USER_GUID = OU_USER_GUID LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_PROVIDER ON OP_USER_GUID = OU_USER_GUID LEFT JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION SVC ON SVC.CDO_DOC_GUID = A.CDO_DOC_GUID AND UPPER(SVC.CDO_ITEM_NAME) = 'SERVICE' WHERE CDD_SERVICE_DTE BETWEEN '2020-01-01' AND '2022-10-31' AND CDD_CANCEL_IND = '0' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND = '0' AND OP_DISPLAY_NAME IN ('Hightower, Heather', 'Sarro, Emily', 'Russo, Alexandra') AND ((CDD_DOC_NAME IN ('Evaluation Consultation, Adolescent and Young Adult', 'Evaluation Consultation, Adolescent and Young Adult-InPerson', 'Evaluation Consultation, Adolescent and Young Adult-Phone', 'Evaluation Consultation, Adolescent and Young Adult-Telemed', 'Follow Up - DOM-Sarcoma', 'Follow Up - PACC Sarcoma', 'Follow Up - PACC Sarcoma-Urgent', 'Follow Up Consultation, Adolescent and Young Adult', 'Follow Up Consultation, Adolescent and Young Adult v2-Follow', 'Initial Consultation, Adolescent and Young Adult', 'Miscellaneous Note - Pediatrics', 'Miscellaneous Note - Pediatrics-AYA', 'Miscellaneous/Discussion Note, Amb-DOM', 'Miscellaneous/Discussion Note, Amb-DOM Lymphoma', 'Miscellaneous/Discussion Note, Amb-DOM Sarcoma', 'Miscellaneous/Discussion Note, Amb-DOM Sarcoma - AYA', 'Miscellaneous/Discussion Note, Amb-MSK Koch', 'Miscellaneous/Discussion Note, Amb-Outpatient')) OR (CDD_DOC_NAME = 'Telephone/Electronic Communication, Nursing-Care Coordinate' AND A.CDO_ITEM_NAME = 'Service Other' AND A.CDO_VALUE_TEXT = 'Adolescent/Young Adult Program') OR (CDD_DOC_NAME = 'Psychosocial - Social Work' AND A.CDO_ITEM_NAME = 'Others:' AND A.CDO_VALUE_TEXT = 'Adolescent and Young Adult Program')) ORDER BY OP_DISPLAY_NAME, CDD_SERVICE_DTE, CDD_MRN

prompt: Based on a Darwin query, identify patients with chondrosarcoma who were dispensed Pazopanib.
completion: SELECT DISTINCT "t1"."PT_MRN" AS "MRN", "t1"."PT_LAST_NAME" AS "Last Name", "t1"."PT_BIRTH_DTE" AS "Date of Birth", "t1"."PT_DEATH_DTE" AS "Deceased Date", "t2"."DT_DTE" AS "Tumor Diagnosis Date" FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V" "t1" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED" "t3" ON "t1"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t3"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."CDB_TUMOR_V" "t4" ON "t3"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t4"."CDTM_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" "t2" ON "t4"."CDTM_DX_DATE_ID" = "t2"."DT_DATE_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DIAGNOSIS_CODE_CAT_ICDO_V" "t5" ON "t4"."CDTM_DX_CATALOG_ID" = "t5"."DXCC_DX_CATALOG_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PHM_PT_MEDS_MQT" "t6" ON "t3"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t6"."POD_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PHM_ORDER_DTL" "t7" ON "t6"."POD_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t7"."POD_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AND "t6"."POD_PHARMA_INVENTORY_CTLG_ID" = "t7"."POD_PHARMA_INVENTORY_CTLG_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PHM_INVENTORY_CATALOG" "t8" ON "t7"."POD_PHARMA_INVENTORY_CTLG_ID" = "t8"."PINC_INVENTORY_CTLG_ID" WHERE ("t5"."DXCC_ICD_CODE" IN ('M9220/3', 'M9231/3', 'M9240/3', 'M9242/3', 'M9243/3') AND UPPER("t8"."PINC_GENERIC_NAME") IN ('GW786034 (PAZOPANIB)', 'PAZOPANIB', 'PAZOPANIB OR PLACEBO'))

"t3"."DXCC_ICD_CODE" AS "ICD-O Histology Code", "t3"."DXCC_ICD_MSK_DESC" AS "ICD-O Histology Description", "t2"."ICSC_SITE_CD" AS "ICD-O Site Code", "t1"."PT_BIRTH_DTE" AS "Date of Birth", "t4"."PRPT_ACCESSION_NO" AS "Pathology Report", "t5"."DT_DTE" AS "Pathology Report Date", "t6"."PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_DESC" AS "Pathology Report Type" FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V" "t1" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED" "t7" ON "t1"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t7"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."CDB_TUMOR_V" "t8" ON "t7"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t8"."CDTM_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."ICDO_SITE_CATALOG_V" "t2" ON "t8"."CDTM_SITE_CATALOG_ID" = "t2"."ICSC_SITE_CATALOG_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DIAGNOSIS_CODE_CAT_ICDO_V" "t3" ON "t8"."CDTM_DX_CATALOG_ID" = "t3"."DXCC_DX_CATALOG_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" "t9" ON "t8"."CDTM_DX_DATE_ID" = "t9"."DT_DATE_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V" "t4" ON "t7"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t4"."PRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" "t5" ON "t4"."PRPT_REPORT_DATE_ID" = "t5"."DT_DATE_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATH_RPRT_TYPE_LOOKUP" "t6" ON "t9"."DT_YEAR" >= 1990) ) SELECT DISTINCT "t1"."PT_MRN" AS "MRN", "t1"."PT_LAST_NAME" AS "Last Name", "t1"."PT_FIRST_NAME" AS "First Name", "t2"."ICSC_ICDO_SITE_MSK_DESC" AS "ICD-O Site Description", "t3"."DXCC_ICD_CODE" AS "ICD-O Histology Code", "t3"."DXCC_ICD_MSK_DESC" AS "ICD-O Histology Description", "t2"."ICSC_SITE_CD" AS "ICD-O Site Code", "t1"."PT_BIRTH_DTE" AS "Date of Birth",
