prompt: OR Cases by the Orthopedic Service between 9/1/2017 to 1/31/2018
completion: SELECT DISTINCT SSE_MRN MRN, PT_LAST_NAME "Last Name", PT_FIRST_NAME "First Name", PT_SEX "Gender", PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH "Date of Birth", YEAR(SSE_SURG_DTE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) "Age at Surgery", SSE_SURG_DTE "Surgery Date", SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD "CPT4 Code", SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC "CPT4 Description", TRIM(SSP_SURG_LAST_NM) || ', ' || TRIM(SSP_SURG_FIRST_NM) "Surgeon", SSP_SURG_SVC_CD "Service", SSP_LATERALITY "Laterality", SSE_SURG_LOC "Location" FROM IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE ON SSE_LOG_ID = SSP_LOG_ID JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON SSE_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE SSE_SURG_DTE BETWEEN '2017-09-01' AND '2018-01-31' AND SSP_SURG_SVC_CD = 'ORTHO' ORDER BY 1 DESC, 7, 8 ; WITH SURG AS (SELECT DISTINCT SSE_MRN FROM IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE ON SSE_LOG_ID = SSP_LOG_ID JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON SSE_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE SSE_SURG_DTE BETWEEN '2017-09-01' AND '2018-01-31' AND SSP_SURG_SVC_CD = 'ORTHO' ) SELECT DISTINCT TM_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME "Last Name", PT_FIRST_NAME "First Name", PT_SEX "Gender", PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH "Date of Birth", TM_DX_DTE "Dx Date", TM_HIST_CD "ICD-O Code", H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK "ICD-O Description", TM_SITE_CD "Site Code", S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK "Site Description" FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS ON AV_ELEMENT = 'CASE_STS' AND AV_CODE = TM_CASE_STS JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON TM_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN SURG ON TM_MRN = SSE_MRN WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') ORDER BY 1 DESC, 6

prompt: Provide Pediatric "return to clinic" orders placed for Q1 and Q2 of 2019 vs. Q1 and Q2 of 2020.
completion: SELECT PT_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, OO_ORD_NAME, OO_ORD_STS_CD, OO_ENTER_DTE FROM IDB.OMS_ORDER JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON OO_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE OO_ORD_NAME IN ('PED_Return Visit - BMT', 'PED_Return Visit - CGS', 'PED_Return Visit - INTEGRATIVE MEDICINE', 'PED_Return Visit - LEUKEMIA / LYMPHOMA', 'PED_Return Visit - LTFU', 'PED_Return Visit - NEURO-ONCOLOGY', 'PED_Return Visit - NEUROBLASTOMA', 'PED_Return Visit - NEUROSURGERY', 'PED_Return Visit - PACT', 'PED_Return Visit - SARCOMA', 'PED_Return Visit - SURGERY') AND OO_ORD_STS_CD NOT IN ('CANP', 'CANC', 'AUC3') AND OO_ENTER_DTE BETWEEN '2019-01-01' AND '2019-12-31' ORDER BY PT_MRN, OO_ORD_NAME, OO_ENTER_DTE ; SELECT PT_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, OO_ORD_NAME, OO_ORD_STS_CD, OO_ENTER_DTE FROM IDB.OMS_ORDER JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON OO_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE OO_ORD_NAME IN ('PED_Return Visit - BMT', 'PED_Return Visit - CGS', 'PED_Return Visit - INTEGRATIVE MEDICINE', 'PED_Return Visit - LEUKEMIA / LYMPHOMA', 'PED_Return Visit - LTFU', 'PED_Return Visit - NEURO-ONCOLOGY', 'PED_Return Visit - NEUROBLASTOMA', 'PED_Return Visit - NEUROSURGERY', 'PED_Return Visit - PACT', 'PED_Return Visit - SARCOMA', 'PED_Return Visit - SURGERY') AND OO_ORD_STS_CD NOT IN ('CANP', 'CANC', 'AUC3') AND OO_ENTER_DTE BETWEEN '2020-01-01' AND '2020-12-31' ORDER BY PT_MRN, OO_ORD_NAME, OO_ENTER_DTE ; SELECT PT_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, OO_ORD_NAME, OO_ORD_STS_CD, OO_ENTER_DTE FROM IDB.OMS_ORDER JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON OO_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE OO_ORD_NAME IN ('PED_Return Visit - BMT', 'PED_Return Visit - CGS', 'PED_Return Visit - INTEGRATIVE MEDICINE', 'PED_Return Visit - LEUKEMIA / LYMPHOMA', 'PED_Return Visit - LTFU', 'PED_Return Visit - NEURO-ONCOLOGY', 'PED_Return Visit - NEUROBLASTOMA', 'PED_Return Visit - NEUROSURGERY', 'PED_Return Visit - PACT', 'PED_Return Visit - SARCOMA', 'PED_Return Visit - SURGERY') AND OO_ORD_STS_CD NOT IN ('CANP', 'CANC', 'AUC3') AND OO_ENTER_DTE BETWEEN '2021-01-01' AND '2021-12-31' ORDER BY PT_MRN, OO_ORD_NAME, OO_ENTER_DTE

prompt: Provide appointment data on patients registered to protocol 18-379.
completion: SELECT PT_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH DOB, CPE_ENC_DTE AS "Appt Date", CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 AS "Department", CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 AS "Service", CLD_DEPT_NAME AS "Department Name", CRE_RES_NAME AS "Provider Name", CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME AS "Visit Type" FROM IDB.ACCRUALS JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PT_MRN = AC_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER ON AC_MRN = CPE_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Sch') AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT date AND CURRENT date + 7 DAYS AND AC_IRB_NO = '18-379'

prompt: I am requesting the number of laparoscopic as well as robotic cases for GYN, GU, Colorectal, HPB, GMT, H&N at main campus.  I would like the start and end time of every case.  I would also like to know how many of these cases are done with and without a first assist APP (Physician Assistant)
completion: WITH LAPAROSCOPIC_SRG AS (SELECT LOG_NUMBER, PATIENT_MRN, PATIENT_NAME, PATIENT_AGE, PATIENT_SEX, OL_SURG_DTE SURG_DTE , SSE_SURG_STRT_DT, SSE_SURG_END_DT , LOG_NUMBER_OF_PANELS, LOG_PRIMARY_SERVICE, LOG_PRIMARY_SURGEON, LOG_LOCATION, LOG_CAMPUS, LOG_ROBOT_ASSISTED_FLAG, LOG_LAPAROSCOPIC_FLAG FROM IDB.OR_LOG JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT ON SSE_LOG_ID = OL_LOG_ID JOIN IDB.PERIOP_CASE_EVENT_V ON PATIENT_MRN = OL_MRN AND LOG_NUMBER = OL_LOG_ID AND LOG_SURGERY_DTE BETWEEN '2018-01-01' AND '2019-05-31' WHERE LOG_ROBOT_ASSISTED_FLAG = 'Robotic Assisted Surgery' AND LOG_CAMPUS = 'MAIN' AND OL_LOG_SVC IN ('HEP', 'CRS', 'THO', 'URO', 'GYN', 'HNS') AND NOT (OL_LOG_STS_CD IN ('4 ', '6 ')) ) , PNLTIME AS (SELECT OLAP_LOG_ID, OLAP_MRN , OLAP_PNL_NO PANEL_NO, MIN(S.OLPT_EVNT_IN_DT) PANEL_START_DT, MAX(E.OLPT_EVNT_IN_DT) PANEL_END_DT FROM LAPAROSCOPIC_SRG SRG JOIN IDB.OR_LOG_ALL_PROC ON LOG_NUMBER = OLAP_LOG_ID JOIN IDB.OR_LOG_PANEL_TIMES S ON S.OLPT_LOG_ID = LOG_NUMBER AND S.OLPT_PNL_NO = OLAP_PNL_NO AND S.OLPT_PNL_EVNT_CD = '100' JOIN IDB.OR_LOG_PANEL_TIMES E ON E.OLPT_LOG_ID = LOG_NUMBER AND E.OLPT_PNL_NO = OLAP_PNL_NO AND E.OLPT_PNL_EVNT_CD = '300' GROUP BY OLAP_LOG_ID, OLAP_MRN , OLAP_PNL_NO) , SURGEONS AS (SELECT A.OLAS_LOG_ID, A.OLAS_MRN, OLAS_PNL_NO, A.OLAS_LINE_NO LINE_NO, A.OLAS_SURG_ROLE SURG_ROLE, CRE_RES_NAME SURGEON_NAME FROM PNLTIME JOIN IDB.OR_LOG_ALL_SURG A ON OLAP_LOG_ID = A.OLAS_LOG_ID AND PANEL_NO = A.OLAS_PNL_NO JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON OLAS_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID) SELECT PATIENT_MRN, PATIENT_NAME, PATIENT_AGE, PATIENT_SEX, SURG_DTE , SSE_SURG_STRT_DT SURG_STRT_DT, SSE_SURG_END_DT SURG_END_DT, LOG_NUMBER_OF_PANELS, LOG_PRIMARY_SERVICE, LOG_PRIMARY_SURGEON, LOG_LOCATION, LOG_CAMPUS, LOG_ROBOT_ASSISTED_FLAG, LOG_LAPAROSCOPIC_FLAG, PANEL_NO, PANEL_START_DT, PANEL_END_DT, SURG_ROLE, SURGEON_NAME FROM LAPAROSCOPIC_SRG SRG JOIN PNLTIME ON LOG_NUMBER = OLAP_LOG_ID JOIN SURGEONS ON OLAS_LOG_ID = OLAP_LOG_ID AND OLAS_PNL_NO = PANEL_NO

prompt: Weekly List of Patients who expired while admitted in MSKCC
completion: SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN "MRN", PT_FIRST_NAME "First Name", PT_LAST_NAME "Last Name", PT_DATE_OF_DEATH "Date of Death", VIS_ADM_DTE "Admission Date", VIS_DSCH_DTE "Discharge Date" FROM IDB.VISIT JOIN IDB.PATIENT_V ON PT_MRN = VIS_MRN WHERE PT_DATE_OF_DEATH BETWEEN VIS_ADM_DTE AND VIS_DSCH_DTE AND PT_DATE_OF_DEATH BETWEEN CURRENT DATE - 7 DAYS AND CURRENT DATE

prompt: Provide a monthly summary of the number of commercial Car-T cell referral, financial clearance and infusion orders to determine workload volume for the clinical nurse coordinators.
completion: SELECT ORDER_MONTH "Month" , ORDER_YEAR "Year" , OP_DISPLAY_NAME "Requesting Provider" , COUNT(OO_ORD_GUID) AS "Count" , OUD_USER_DI_VALUE AS "Production Facility" FROM (SELECT DISTINCT OO_ORD_GUID, OO_MRN, MONTH(OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE) AS ORDER_MONTH, YEAR(OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE) AS ORDER_YEAR, OP_DISPLAY_NAME, OUD_USER_DI_VALUE FROM IDB.OMS_ORDER JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_CATALOG ON OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID = OOC_MSTR_ITEM_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_STATUS ON OO_ORD_STS_CD = OSTS_ORD_STS_CD JOIN IDB.OMS_PROVIDER ON OP_PVDR_GUID = OO_PVDR_GUID JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON OO_MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_USER_DATA ON OUD_ORD_GUID = OO_ORD_GUID WHERE 1=1 AND (OOC_ITEM_NAME = 'Immune Effector Cells (IEC) - MNC - A - Collection - Processing' ) AND OO_ORD_STS_CD NOT IN ('CANP', 'CANC', 'AUC3') AND OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE >= '2021-01-01' AND OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE < (DATE('0001-01-01') + YEAR(CURRENT date) YEARS - 1 YEAR + MONTH(CURRENT date) MONTHS - 1 MONTHS) AND YEAR(OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) >= 21 AND LOWER(OUD_USER_DI_CD) like '%facility%' ) A GROUP BY ORDER_MONTH, ORDER_YEAR, OP_DISPLAY_NAME, OUD_USER_DI_VALUE ORDER BY ORDER_YEAR, ORDER_MONTH, OP_DISPLAY_NAME ; SELECT ORDER_MONTH "Month" , ORDER_YEAR "Year" , OP_DISPLAY_NAME "Requesting Provider" , COUNT(OO_ORD_GUID) AS "Count" , OO_SET_NAME "Order Set Name" FROM (SELECT DISTINCT OO_ORD_GUID, OO_MRN, MONTH(OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE) AS ORDER_MONTH, YEAR(OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE) AS ORDER_YEAR, OO_SET_NAME, OP_DISPLAY_NAME FROM IDB.OMS_ORDER JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_CATALOG ON OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID = OOC_MSTR_ITEM_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_STATUS ON OO_ORD_STS_CD = OSTS_ORD_STS_CD JOIN IDB.OMS_PROVIDER ON OP_PVDR_GUID = OO_PVDR_GUID JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON OO_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE 1=1 AND (OOC_ITEM_NAME = 'Immune Effector Cells (IEC) - Thaw - Infusion Order' AND OO_SET_NAME IN ('Axicabtagene_Ciloleucel_INJ_Orderset', 'Brexucabtagene_Autoleucel_INJ_Orderset', 'Idecabtagene_Vicleucel_INJ_Orderset', 'Lisocabtagene_Maraleucel_INJ_Orderset', 'Tisagenlecleucel_INJ_Orderset')) AND OO_ORD_STS_CD NOT IN ('CANP', 'CANC', 'AUC3') AND OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE >= '2021-01-01' AND OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE < (DATE('0001-01-01') + YEAR(CURRENT date) YEARS - 1 YEAR + MONTH(CURRENT date) MONTHS - 1 MONTHS) AND YEAR(OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) >= 21 ) A GROUP BY ORDER_MONTH, ORDER_YEAR, OP_DISPLAY_NAME, OO_SET_NAME ORDER BY ORDER_YEAR, ORDER_MONTH, OP_DISPLAY_NAME ; SELECT ORDER_MONTH "Month" , ORDER_YEAR "Year" , OP_DISPLAY_NAME "Requesting Provider" , COUNT(OO_ORD_GUID) AS "Count" , DRUG_NAME "Drug Name" FROM (SELECT DISTINCT OO_ORD_GUID, OO_MRN, MONTH(OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE) AS ORDER_MONTH, YEAR(OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE) AS ORDER_YEAR, OOC_ITEM_NAME, OP_DISPLAY_NAME, TRIM(OUD_USER_DI_VALUE) AS DRUG_NAME FROM IDB.OMS_ORDER JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_CATALOG ON OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID = OOC_MSTR_ITEM_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_STATUS ON OO_ORD_STS_CD = OSTS_ORD_STS_CD JOIN IDB.OMS_PROVIDER ON OP_PVDR_GUID = OO_PVDR_GUID JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON OO_MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_USER_DATA A ON OUD_ORD_GUID = OO_ORD_GUID AND OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'Rx-CART_Drug' WHERE 1=1 AND OOC_ITEM_NAME IN ('Financial Clearance for CAR-T Cell') AND OO_ORD_STS_CD NOT IN ('CANP', 'CANC', 'AUC3') AND OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE >= '2021-01-01' AND OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE < (DATE('0001-01-01') + YEAR(CURRENT date) YEARS - 1 YEAR + MONTH(CURRENT date) MONTHS - 1 MONTHS) AND YEAR(OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) >= 21 ) A GROUP BY ORDER_MONTH, ORDER_YEAR, OP_DISPLAY_NAME, DRUG_NAME ORDER BY ORDER_YEAR, ORDER_MONTH, OP_DISPLAY_NAME ; SELECT ORDER_MONTH "Month" , ORDER_YEAR "Year" , OP_DISPLAY_NAME "Requesting Provider" , COUNT(OO_ORD_GUID) AS "Count" , "Dx" , "Referral To" , "Heme" FROM (SELECT DISTINCT OO_ORD_GUID, OO_MRN, MONTH(OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE) AS ORDER_MONTH, YEAR(OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE) AS ORDER_YEAR, OOC_ITEM_NAME, OP_DISPLAY_NAME, MAX(CASE WHEN OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'CTC_Dx' THEN TRIM(OUD_USER_DI_VALUE) END) AS "Dx", MAX(CASE WHEN OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'CTC_Referral To' THEN TRIM(OUD_USER_DI_VALUE) END) AS "Referral To", MAX(CASE WHEN OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'CTC_Heme Only' THEN TRIM(OUD_USER_DI_VALUE) END) AS "Heme" FROM IDB.OMS_ORDER JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_CATALOG ON OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID = OOC_MSTR_ITEM_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_STATUS ON OO_ORD_STS_CD = OSTS_ORD_STS_CD JOIN IDB.OMS_PROVIDER ON OP_PVDR_GUID = OO_PVDR_GUID JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON OO_MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_USER_DATA A ON OUD_ORD_GUID = OO_ORD_GUID AND OUD_USER_DI_CD IN ('CTC_Dx', 'CTC_Referral To', 'CTC_Heme Only') WHERE 1=1 AND OOC_ITEM_NAME IN ('CTS Referral') AND OO_ORD_STS_CD NOT IN ('CANP', 'CANC', 'AUC3') AND OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE >= '2021-01-01' AND OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE < (DATE('0001-01-01') + YEAR(CURRENT date) YEARS - 1 YEAR + MONTH(CURRENT date) MONTHS - 1 MONTHS) AND YEAR(OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) >= 21 GROUP BY OO_ORD_GUID, OO_MRN, MONTH(OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE), YEAR(OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE), OOC_ITEM_NAME, OP_DISPLAY_NAME) A GROUP BY ORDER_MONTH, ORDER_YEAR, OP_DISPLAY_NAME, "Dx", "Referral To", "Heme" ORDER BY ORDER_YEAR, ORDER_MONTH, OP_DISPLAY_NAME ;

prompt: Create a report to help understand the care needs of the patients post procedure from IR on call.
completion: WITH SRG AS (SELECT DISTINCT SSE_LOG_ID, SSE_MRN, SSE_SURG_DTE, SSE_SURG_STRT_DT, SSE_SURG_END_DT, CASE WHEN DAYOFWEEK(SSE_SURG_END_DT) = 1 THEN 'Sun' WHEN DAYOFWEEK(SSE_SURG_END_DT) = 2 THEN 'Mon' WHEN DAYOFWEEK(SSE_SURG_END_DT) = 3 THEN 'Tue' WHEN DAYOFWEEK(SSE_SURG_END_DT) = 4 THEN 'Wed' WHEN DAYOFWEEK(SSE_SURG_END_DT) = 5 THEN 'Thu' WHEN DAYOFWEEK(SSE_SURG_END_DT) = 6 THEN 'Fri' WHEN DAYOFWEEK(SSE_SURG_END_DT) = 7 THEN 'Sat' END AS SURG_END_DAY_OF_WEEK, SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD, SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC, SSE_SURG_LOC, SSP_SURG_SVC_CD FROM IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE ON SSE_LOG_ID = SSP_LOG_ID WHERE 1=1 AND(SSP_SURG_SVC_CD LIKE '%IR%' OR SSE_SURG_LOC LIKE '%IR%') AND SSE_SURG_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT DATE - 1 YEAR AND CURRENT DATE AND(TIME(SSE_SURG_END_DT) BETWEEN '20:30:00' AND '23:59:59' OR TIME(SSE_SURG_END_DT) BETWEEN '00:00:00' AND '07:00:00' OR DAYOFWEEK(DATE(SSE_SURG_END_DT)) IN (7, 1)) ) , CD AS (SELECT DISTINCT SRG.*, CDD_DOC_GUID, SSE_SURG_END_DT AS SURG_END_DT, CDD_SERVICE_DT, CDD_SERVICE_DTE, CDD_DOC_NAME, TIMESTAMPDIFF(4, CHAR(CDD_SERVICE_DT - SSE_SURG_END_DT)) AS MIN_DIFF FROM SRG LEFT JOIN IDB.CD_DOCUMENT ON SSE_MRN = CDD_MRN AND CDD_SERVICE_DT >= SSE_SURG_END_DT AND CDD_CANCEL_IND = '0' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND = '0' AND CDD_DOC_NAME = 'Initial Evaluation, Adult Team - Critical Care' AND TIMESTAMPDIFF(4, CHAR(CDD_SERVICE_DT - SSE_SURG_END_DT)) <= 360) , ICU AS (SELECT ICU_MRN, ICU_ICU_ADM_DT, ICU_ICU_DSCH_DT FROM IDB.ICU_CENSUS JOIN CD ON SSE_MRN = ICU_MRN WHERE ICU_ICU_ADM_DTE BETWEEN SSE_SURG_DTE - 30 DAYS AND SSE_SURG_DTE ) SELECT CD.*, ICU_ICU_ADM_DT, ICU_ICU_DSCH_DT FROM CD LEFT JOIN ICU ON SSE_MRN = ICU_MRN WHERE ICU_MRN IS NULL

prompt: Provide a list of patients who had a - Chemotherapy/Biotherapy-Initiated ClinDoc note yesterday that hadn't had a prior one in at least 6 months.
completion: WITH YEST AS (SELECT CDD_MRN, CDD_DOC_GUID, CDD_SERVICE_DTE, CDD_DOC_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CDD_MRN ORDER BY CDD_SERVICE_DTE DESC) RN FROM IDB.CD_DOCUMENT WHERE CDD_DOC_NAME = 'PEDF - Chemotherapy/Biotherapy-Initiated' AND CDD_CANCEL_IND <> '1' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND <> '1' AND CDD_SERVICE_DTE = CURRENT date - 1 DAY ) , NOTE_HIST AS (SELECT R.CDD_MRN, R.CDD_DOC_GUID YEST_DOC_GUID, R.CDD_SERVICE_DTE YEST_SERVICE_DTE, R.CDD_DOC_NAME YEST_DOC_NAME, C.CDD_DOC_GUID NOTE_HIST_DOC_GUID, C.CDD_SERVICE_DTE NOTE_HIST_SERVICE_DTE, C.CDD_DOC_NAME NOTE_HIST_DOC_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY R.CDD_MRN ORDER BY C.CDD_SERVICE_DTE DESC) RN FROM YEST R LEFT JOIN IDB.CD_DOCUMENT C ON R.CDD_MRN = C.CDD_MRN WHERE C.CDD_DOC_NAME = 'PEDF - Chemotherapy/Biotherapy-Initiated' AND C.CDD_CANCEL_IND <> '1' AND C.CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND <> '1' AND C.CDD_SERVICE_DTE < CURRENT date - 1 DAY ) SELECT DISTINCT Y.CDD_MRN MRN, PT_LAST_NAME LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME FIRST_NAME, PT_CITY CITY, PT_ZIP_CD ZIP, IIC_CATCHMENT CATCHMENT, PARTNER_HOSP, Y.CDD_SERVICE_DTE PRIOR_CLINDOC_DATE, NH.NOTE_HIST_SERVICE_DTE PRIOR6MONTH_CLINDOC_DATE FROM YEST Y LEFT JOIN NOTE_HIST NH ON Y.CDD_MRN = NH.CDD_MRN AND NH.RN = 1 JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON Y.CDD_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.CATCHMENT_PARTNER_HOSP_V ON PT_ZIP_CD = IIC_ZIP_CD WHERE COALESCE(NH.NOTE_HIST_SERVICE_DTE, '1900-01-01') < Y.CDD_SERVICE_DTE - 6 MONTHS

prompt: Determine volume of specific PBD-billed CPT codes.
completion: WITH "cte1" AS (SELECT UPPER(MP_FULL_NM) MP_FULL_NM_UPPER, M.* FROM DV.MEDPRO_V M) SELECT DISTINCT "t1"."PT_MRN" AS "MRN", "t2"."PCC_CODE" AS "CPT Procedure Code (PBD)", "t2"."PCC_DESC" AS "CPT Procedure Desc (PBD)", "t3"."DT_DTE" AS "CPT Procedure Date (PBD)", "t4"."MP_SERVICE_DESC" AS "CPT Proc Physician Service (PBD)", "t4"."MP_FULL_NM_UPPER" AS "CPT Procedure Physician (PBD)" FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V" "t1" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED" "t5" ON "t1"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t5"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."CPT_PBD_PATIENT_PROCEDURE" "t2" ON "t5"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t2"."PTX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" "t3" ON "t2"."PTX_PROC_DATE_ID" = "t3"."DT_DATE_ID" LEFT JOIN "cte1" "t4" ON "t2"."PTX_MEDPRO_ID" = "t4"."MP_MEDPRO_ID" WHERE ("t2"."PCC_CODE" IN ('31125', '31230', '61330', '61332', '61333', '61458', '61575', '61576', '61580', '61581', '61582', '61583', '61584', '61585', '61586', '61590', '61591', '61592', '61595', '61596', '61597', '61598', '61600', '61601', '61605', '61607', '61615', '61618', '61619', '62120', '62140', '62142', '62143', '62165', '65110', '65114') AND "t3"."DT_DTE" BETWEEN '2012-1-1' AND '2013-12-31')

prompt: Provide  pathology report data for Prostate cancer patients
completion: WITH DX AS (SELECT TM_MRN, AV_DESC AS CASE_STS, TM_DX_DTE, TM_HIST_CD, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS HIST_DESC, TM_SITE_CD, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_DESC, TM_BEST_AJCC_STG FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS ON AV_ELEMENT = 'CASE_STS' AND AV_CODE = TM_CASE_STS WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND TM_SITE_CD LIKE 'C61%' ) SELECT PRPT_MRN, PRPT_PROCEDURE_DTE, PRPT_REPORT_DTE, PRPT_REPORT_TYPE_DESC, PRPT_ORD_DR_SVC , PRPT_REPORT, PRPT_ORD_DR_SVC_DESC FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V JOIN DX ON TM_MRN = PRPT_MRN WHERE PRPT_REPORT IS NOT NULL AND PRPT_ORD_DR_SVC IN ('URO', 'GUO') AND PRPT_REPORT_TYPE_DESC LIKE 'Surgical%'

prompt: A list of H- and S- cases with specimen source: "thymus" OR "mediastinal mass" with no diagnosis criteria
completion: WITH PATHREPORT AS (SELECT DISTINCT DMP.PRPT_MRN AS MRN , PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_BIRTH_DTE, PT_VITAL_STATUS, PT_DEATH_DTE , CASE WHEN PT_DEATH_DTE IS NULL THEN YEAR(CURRENT date - PT_BIRTH_DTE) END AS "Current Age" , PDRX_DMP_PATIENT_ID , DMP.PRPT_ACCESSION_NO AS "Accession No" , DMP.PRPT_REPORT_DTE AS "Report Date" , DMP.PRPT_PROCEDURE_DTE AS "Procedure Date" , DMP.PRPT_REPORT_TYPE_DESC AS "Report Type" , XMLCAST(XMLQUERY('fn:substring-before(fn:substring-after($x,''SPECIMENS SUBMITTED:''), ''DIAGNOSIS'')' PASSING REPLACE(UPPER(DMP.PRPT_REPORT), CHR(26), '') AS "x") AS VARCHAR(32000)) AS "Specimens Submitted Section" , DMP.PRPT_REPORT_TYPE , DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)diag[\w\W]*(?=I ATTEST)', DMP.PRPT_REPORT) AS DIAGNOSIS_TEXT , VARCHAR(DMP.PRPT_REPORT, 32000) AS "Report Text (first 32000 characters)" , SRG.PRPT_ACCESSION_NO AS RELATED_ACC_NO , SRG_DATE.DT_DTE AS RELATED_PROC_DTE , (SELECT VARCHAR(PRPT_REPORT, 32000) AS REFERENCEDPATHTEXTFROM FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT WHERE PRPT_ACCESSION_NO = SRG.PRPT_ACCESSION_NO) AS REFERENCEDPATHTEXT FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V DMP LEFT JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML ON PDRX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = DMP.PRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID LEFT JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_REFERENCES ON PRPTR_CHILD_PATH_RPT_ID = DMP.PRPT_PATH_RPT_ID LEFT JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT SRG ON SRG.PRPT_PATH_RPT_ID = PRPTR_PATH_RPT_ID LEFT JOIN DV.DATE_V SRG_DATE ON SRG_DATE.DT_DATE_ID = SRG.PRPT_PROCEDURE_DATE_ID JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = DMP.PRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID WHERE 1=1 AND (DMP.PRPT_ACCESSION_NO like 'H%' OR DMP.PRPT_ACCESSION_NO like 'S%') AND (DMP.PRPT_REPORT_DTE >= '01/01/2013' OR DMP.PRPT_PROCEDURE_DTE >= '01/01/2013') AND CONTAINS(DMP.PRPT_REPORT, '("thymus" OR "mediastinal mass")') = 1 AND DMP.PRPT_REPORT IS NOT NULL ) SELECT DISTINCT MRN, PT_LAST_NAME AS "Patient Last Name", PT_FIRST_NAME AS "Patient First Name", PT_BIRTH_DTE AS "Date of Birth", PT_DEATH_DTE AS "Date of Death", PT_VITAL_STATUS AS "Vital Status", "Accession No", "Procedure Date", "Report Date", "Report Type", "Specimens Submitted Section", DIAGNOSIS_TEXT AS "Diagnosis Text", "Report Text (first 32000 characters)", RELATED_ACC_NO, RELATED_PROC_DTE, REFERENCEDPATHTEXT FROM PATHREPORT WHERE (REPLACE(LOWER("Specimens Submitted Section"), CHR(26), '') like '%thym%' OR REPLACE(LOWER("Specimens Submitted Section"), CHR(26), '') like '%mediasti%') ORDER BY 1, 8, 9

prompt: SSNs needed to complete sponsor request for Research-Related Injury Payment
completion: SELECT PTSS_MRN "MRN", PTSS_SSA_NO "SSN" FROM IDB.PATIENT_SSN WHERE 1=1 AND PTSS_MRN IN ('35323924', '38007899', '38038607')

prompt: Provide a monthly report of Engage Survey Data for the "Enhanced Telemedicine Satisfaction Survey" including date sent and whether the survey is in progress, completed or expired/not completed.
completion: SELECT DISTINCT STRIP(EPI_MRN) AS MRN, STRIP(EPI_LAST_NAME) || ', ' || STRIP(EPI_FIRST_NAME) AS "Name", A.EA_ASSESS_ID AS "Assessment ID", EA_SURV_ID AS "Survery ID", STRIP(ES_SURV_NAME) AS "Survey Name", STRIP(EAS_ASSESS_STS) AS "Assessment Status", STRIP(EC_COHORT_DESC) AS "Cohort Description", DATE(EA_SUBM_DT) AS "Submission Date", DATE(EA_ASSIGN_DT) AS "Assignment Date", DATE(EA_EXPIRY_DT) AS "Expiry Date" FROM IDB.EF_PATIENT_INFO PT JOIN IDB.EF_ASSESSMENT A ON A.EA_PT_INFO_ID = PT.EPI_PT_INFO_ID JOIN IDB.EF_SURVEY S ON A.EA_SURV_ID = S.ES_SURV_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.EF_ASSESSMENT_DTL AD ON A.EA_ASSESS_DTL_ID = AD.EAD_ASSESS_DTL_ID JOIN IDB.EF_ASSESSMENT_STS AS STS ON A.EA_STS_ID = STS.EAS_ASSESS_STS_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.EF_SCHEDULING_RULE B ON ESR_SCHED_RULE_ID = EA_SCHED_RULE_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.EF_COHORT C ON ESR_COHORT_ID = EC_COHORT_ID WHERE 1=1 AND EA_SURV_ID = '176'

prompt: We would  like a reconciliation of the provider tables of the following systems RMS ,EWS, CIS and RIS. (active vs. inactive)
completion: SELECT * FROM (SELECT RPD_NAME "RMS Name", RPD_NUMERIC_CODE "RMS Provider Number", RPD_INACTIVE_FLAG "RMS Inactive Flag", RPD_DEACTIVATION_DT "RMS Deactivation Date", RSVD_MSK_ADT_SYNONYM "RMS Service", RPD_CREATE_DTE "RMS Create Date" FROM IDB.RMS_PHYSICIAN_DICT_DN3 JOIN IDB.RMS_SERVICE_DICT_DN37 ON RPD_HIS_PRIMARY_SVC_REC_NO = RSVD_RECORD_NUMBER WHERE (RPD_HIS_PRIMARY_SVC_REC_NO<>0 OR (RPD_NUMERIC_CODE NOT IN ('', '000000') AND RPD_NUMERIC_CODE < '100000')) ) RMS FULL JOIN (SELECT CRE_RES_NAME "Cadence Name", CRE_RES_ID "Cadence Provider Number", CRE_RES_TYP "Cadence Type", CRE_RES_STS "Cadence Status" FROM IDB.CL_RESOURCE WHERE CRE_INT_EXT_TYP = 'Internal' AND CRE_RES_TYP IN ('Physician', 'Physician Assistant', 'PhD', 'Psychologist', 'Dentist', 'Nurse Practitioner') AND CRE_RES_ID NOT IN ('', '000000') AND CRE_RES_ID < '100000' ) CAD ON "Cadence Provider Number" = "RMS Provider Number" FULL JOIN (SELECT OP_DISPLAY_NAME "CIS Name", OP_PVDR_NO "CIS Provider Number", OP_PROV_TYPE "CIS Type", OP_ACTIVE_IND "CIS Inactive Flag", DATE(OP_CREATE_DT) AS "CIS Create Date" FROM IDB.OMS_PROVIDER WHERE OP_PVDR_NO NOT IN ('', '000000') AND OP_PVDR_NO < '100000' AND OP_PVDR_NO like '0%' AND OP_PROV_TYPE IN ('Physician', 'Nurse Practitioner', 'PhD', 'Physician Assistant', 'Advanced Practice Nurse') ) CIS ON "CIS Provider Number" = COALESCE("RMS Provider Number", "Cadence Provider Number")

prompt: Provide a list of appointments between Jan - June 2019 seen by Christianne Supan
completion: WITH APPTS AS (SELECT CPE_MRN, CPE_ENC_DTE, CLD_DEPT_NAME, CRE_RES_NAME, CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR, CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN '2019-01-01' AND '2019-06-30' AND CRE_RES_NAME = 'SUPAN, CHRISTIANNE CANDA' ) , BMT AS (SELECT CPE_MRN BMT_MRN, YEAR(CBM_TRANSPLANT_DTE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) AGE_AT_TRANSPLANT, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CPE_MRN ORDER BY CBM_TRANSPLANT_DTE) RN FROM (SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN FROM APPTS) A JOIN IDB.CRDB_BMT_MEDICINE ON CPE_MRN = CBM_MRN JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON CPE_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE CBM_TRANSPLANT_TYPE = 'ALLO' ) SELECT CPE_MRN MRN, CPE_ENC_DTE APPT_DATE, CLD_DEPT_NAME DEPT_NAME, CRE_RES_NAME RESOURCE_NAME, CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR VISIT_TYPE_ABBR, CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME VISIT_TYPE_NAME, AGE_AT_TRANSPLANT FROM APPTS LEFT JOIN BMT ON CPE_MRN = BMT_MRN AND RN = 1

prompt: Patients in the tobacco treatment program.
completion: SELECT DISTINCT CDD_MRN, CDD_SERVICE_DTE, CDD_DOC_NAME, OP_DISPLAY_NAME, CDD_DOC_GUID, CDO_SECTION, CDO_ITEM_NAME, CDO_VALUE_TEXT FROM IDB.CD_DOCUMENT JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION ON CDD_DOC_GUID = CDO_DOC_GUID AND CDD_AUTHORED_DTE = CDO_AUTHORED_DTE AND CDO_VALUE_TEXT <> '' JOIN IDB.OMS_PROVIDER ON CDD_AUTH_PROV_GUID = OP_PVDR_GUID WHERE CDD_CANCEL_IND <> '1' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND <> '1' AND CDD_SERVICE_DTE BETWEEN '2018-01-01' AND '2021-07-31' AND CASE WHEN CDD_DOC_NAME IN ('Intake, Tobacco Treatment - Psychiatry', 'Follow Up, Tobacco Treatment - Psychiatry') THEN 1 WHEN CDD_DOC_NAME IN ('Treatment Visit, Psychotherapy - Psychiatry', 'Initial Evaluation - Psychiatry') AND CDD_AUTH_PROV_GUID IN ('9000925226001190', '2000001020119001', '9001061126101190') THEN 1 END = 1 ; WITH CD AS (SELECT DISTINCT CDD_MRN FROM IDB.CD_DOCUMENT JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION ON CDD_DOC_GUID = CDO_DOC_GUID AND CDD_AUTHORED_DTE = CDO_AUTHORED_DTE AND CDO_VALUE_TEXT <> '' JOIN IDB.OMS_PROVIDER ON CDD_AUTH_PROV_GUID = OP_PVDR_GUID WHERE CDD_CANCEL_IND <> '1' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND <> '1' AND CDD_SERVICE_DTE BETWEEN '2018-01-01' AND '2021-07-31' AND CASE WHEN CDD_DOC_NAME IN ('Intake, Tobacco Treatment - Psychiatry', 'Follow Up, Tobacco Treatment - Psychiatry') THEN 1 WHEN CDD_DOC_NAME IN ('Treatment Visit, Psychotherapy - Psychiatry', 'Initial Evaluation - Psychiatry') AND CDD_AUTH_PROV_GUID IN ('9000925226001190', '2000001020119001', '9001061126101190') THEN 1 END = 1 ) SELECT TM_MRN, PT_SEX_DESC, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, PT_RACE_DESC, PT_PT_ETHNICITY_DESC, AV_DESC AS CASE_STS, TM_DX_DTE, TM_HIST_CD, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS HIST_DESC, TM_SITE_CD, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_DESC, TM_BEST_AJCC_STG FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS ON AV_ELEMENT = 'CASE_STS' AND AV_CODE = TM_CASE_STS JOIN IDB.PATIENT_V ON TM_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN CD ON TM_MRN = CDD_MRN WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') ; WITH CD AS (SELECT DISTINCT CDD_MRN FROM IDB.CD_DOCUMENT JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION ON CDD_DOC_GUID = CDO_DOC_GUID AND CDD_AUTHORED_DTE = CDO_AUTHORED_DTE AND CDO_VALUE_TEXT <> '' JOIN IDB.OMS_PROVIDER ON CDD_AUTH_PROV_GUID = OP_PVDR_GUID WHERE CDD_CANCEL_IND <> '1' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND <> '1' AND CDD_SERVICE_DTE BETWEEN '2018-01-01' AND '2021-07-31' AND CASE WHEN CDD_DOC_NAME IN ('Intake, Tobacco Treatment - Psychiatry', 'Follow Up, Tobacco Treatment - Psychiatry') THEN 1 WHEN CDD_DOC_NAME IN ('Treatment Visit, Psychotherapy - Psychiatry', 'Initial Evaluation - Psychiatry') AND CDD_AUTH_PROV_GUID IN ('9000925226001190', '2000001020119001', '9001061126101190') THEN 1 END = 1 ) SELECT EF_MRN, DATE(EF_SUBMISSION_DT) SUBMISSION_DTE, EF_FORM_ID, EF_FORM_NAME, EFI_ITEM_TEXT, EFI_VALUE FROM IDB.EF_FORM JOIN IDB.EF_ASSESSMENT ON EF_FORM_EXTERNAL_ID = EA_ASSESS_ID AND EA_SURV_ID = 62 JOIN IDB.EF_FORM_ITEM ON EF_FORM_ID = EFI_FORM_ID JOIN CD ON EF_MRN = CDD_MRN ; WITH CD AS (SELECT DISTINCT CDD_MRN FROM IDB.CD_DOCUMENT JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION ON CDD_DOC_GUID = CDO_DOC_GUID AND CDD_AUTHORED_DTE = CDO_AUTHORED_DTE AND CDO_VALUE_TEXT <> '' JOIN IDB.OMS_PROVIDER ON CDD_AUTH_PROV_GUID = OP_PVDR_GUID WHERE CDD_CANCEL_IND <> '1' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND <> '1' AND CDD_SERVICE_DTE BETWEEN '2018-01-01' AND '2021-07-31' AND CASE WHEN CDD_DOC_NAME IN ('Intake, Tobacco Treatment - Psychiatry', 'Follow Up, Tobacco Treatment - Psychiatry') THEN 1 WHEN CDD_DOC_NAME IN ('Treatment Visit, Psychotherapy - Psychiatry', 'Initial Evaluation - Psychiatry') AND CDD_AUTH_PROV_GUID IN ('9000925226001190', '2000001020119001', '9001061126101190') THEN 1 END = 1 ) SELECT OO_MRN MRN, OOC_ITEM_NAME DRUG_NAME, OO_ORD_NAME DRUG_NAME_EXT, OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE RX_ENTER_DTE, 'Order' SOURCE FROM IDB.OMS_ORDER JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_CATALOG ON OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID = OOC_MSTR_ITEM_GUID AND OOC_THERAPEUTIC_CAT_ID = '320' JOIN CD ON OO_MRN = CDD_MRN WHERE OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE BETWEEN '2018-01-01' AND '2021-07-31' UNION ALL SELECT HCPR_MRN MRN, COALESCE(HGN_GENERIC_NAME, HCPR_DRUG_NAME) AS DRUG_NAME, HCPR_DRUG_NAME DRUG_NAME_EXT, DATE(COALESCE(HCPR_START_DT, HCPR_CREATED_DT)) RX_ENTER_DTE, 'Home med list' SOURCE FROM IDB.HML_CLIENT_PRESCRIPTION LEFT JOIN IDB.HML_GENERIC_NAME ON HCPR_GENERIC_NAME_ID = HGN_GENERIC_NAME_ID JOIN CD ON HCPR_MRN = CDD_MRN WHERE (HCPR_GENERIC_NAME_ID IN ('2565', '176') OR LOWER(HCPR_DRUG_NAME) LIKE '%nicotine%') AND DATE(COALESCE(HCPR_START_DT, HCPR_CREATED_DT)) BETWEEN '2018-01-01' AND '2021-07-31'

prompt: Provide a count of patients who have the term "epidermoid cyst" in a pathology report since 01-01-2002.
completion: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT PRPT_MRN) AS COUNT FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V WHERE PRPT_REPORT IS NOT NULL AND PRPT_REPORT_DTE >= '2002-01-01' AND CONTAINS("PRPT_REPORT", '("epidermoid cyst")') = 1

prompt: Provide a report of patients who had a Serum Calcium level above normal between 7 and 30 days after receiving either pamidronate or zoledronic acid.
completion: SELECT PO_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, (POD_STRT_DTE) AS MED_STRT_DTE, PIN_GENERIC_NAME, A.LR_PERFORMED_DTE, A.LR_ORD_GUID, A.LR_RESULT_VALUE AS CALCIUM, B.LR_RESULT_VALUE AS ALBUMIN FROM (SELECT LR_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, LR_PERFORMED_DTE, LR_RESULT_VALUE, LR_ORD_GUID FROM IDB.LAB_RESULTS JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON LR_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE LR_SUBTEST_NAME = 'Calcium' AND DECIMAL(LR_RESULT_VALUE, 9, 1) > 10.5 AND LR_IDB_PRCS_DTE BETWEEN (CURRENT DATE - 7 DAYS) AND CURRENT DATE AND LR_RESULT_VALUE <> '' ) AS A LEFT JOIN (SELECT A.LR_MRN, A.LR_PERFORMED_DTE, A.LR_RESULT_VALUE, A.LR_ORD_GUID FROM IDB.LAB_RESULTS A JOIN (SELECT LR_MRN, LR_PERFORMED_DTE, LR_RESULT_VALUE, LR_ORD_GUID FROM IDB.LAB_RESULTS WHERE LR_SUBTEST_NAME = 'Calcium' AND DECIMAL(LR_RESULT_VALUE, 9, 1) > 10.5 AND LR_IDB_PRCS_DTE BETWEEN (CURRENT DATE - 6 DAYS) AND CURRENT DATE AND LR_RESULT_VALUE <> '' ) AS B ON A.LR_MRN = B.LR_MRN AND A.LR_ORD_GUID = B.LR_ORD_GUID WHERE LR_SUBTEST_NAME = 'Albumin' AND A.LR_RESULT_VALUE <> '' ) AS B ON A.LR_MRN = B.LR_MRN AND A.LR_ORD_GUID = B.LR_ORD_GUID JOIN IDB.PHM_ORDER ON A.LR_MRN = PO_MRN JOIN IDB.PHM_ORD_DTL ON PO_ORD_SEQ = POD_ORD_SEQ AND A.LR_PERFORMED_DTE - POD_STRT_DTE BETWEEN 7 AND 30 JOIN IDB.PHM_ORD_INV ON POD_ORD_SEQ = POI_ORD_SEQ AND POD_ITEM_NO = POI_ITEM_NO JOIN IDB.PHM_INVENTORY ON POI_INV_SEQ = PIN_INV_SEQ WHERE PO_ORD_STS NOT IN ('X', 'P') AND UCASE(PIN_GENERIC_NAME) IN ('PAMIDRONATE DISODIUM', 'ZOLEDRONIC ACID')

prompt: Need a report for all MOSED cases performed in 2021 with the patient's MRN, date of service, radiologist name who performed the procedure, and procedure name.
completion: SELECT OL_MRN AS MRN, OL_SURG_DTE AS DOS, CRE_RES_NAME AS RADIOLOGIST, OP_PROC_NAME AS PROCEDURE_NAME FROM IDB.OR_LOG LEFT JOIN IDB.OR_LOG_ANES_TYPES ON OL_LOG_ID = OLAT_LOG_ID JOIN IDB.OR_LOG_ALL_SURG ON OL_LOG_ID = OLAS_LOG_ID AND OLAS_SURG_ROLE = 'Primary' AND OLAS_SURG_SVC = 'IR' JOIN IDB.OR_LOG_ALL_PROC ON OLAS_LOG_ID = OLAP_LOG_ID AND OLAS_PNL_NO = OLAP_PNL_NO JOIN IDB.OR_PROC ON OLAP_OR_PROC_ID = OP_OR_PROC_ID AND OP_OR_PROC_ID <> '4820' JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CRE_RES_ID = OLAS_RES_ID WHERE OL_SURG_DTE BETWEEN '2020-01-01' AND '2020-12-31' AND OL_LOG_STS_CD NOT IN ('4', '6') AND OLAT_LOG_ID IS NULL AND OLAP_ANES_TYPE ='MOSED' ; SELECT OL_MRN AS MRN, OL_SURG_DTE AS DOS, CRE_RES_NAME AS RADIOLOGIST, OP_PROC_NAME AS PROCEDURE_NAME FROM IDB.OR_LOG LEFT JOIN IDB.OR_LOG_ANES_TYPES ON OL_LOG_ID = OLAT_LOG_ID JOIN IDB.OR_LOG_ALL_SURG ON OL_LOG_ID = OLAS_LOG_ID AND OLAS_SURG_ROLE = 'Primary' AND OLAS_SURG_SVC = 'IR' JOIN IDB.OR_LOG_ALL_PROC ON OLAS_LOG_ID = OLAP_LOG_ID AND OLAS_PNL_NO = OLAP_PNL_NO JOIN IDB.OR_PROC ON OLAP_OR_PROC_ID = OP_OR_PROC_ID AND OP_OR_PROC_ID <> '4820' JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CRE_RES_ID = OLAS_RES_ID WHERE OL_SURG_DTE BETWEEN '2021-01-01' AND '2021-12-31' AND OL_LOG_STS_CD NOT IN ('4', '6') AND OLAT_LOG_ID IS NULL AND OLAP_ANES_TYPE ='MOSED' ; SELECT OL_MRN AS MRN, OL_SURG_DTE AS DOS, CRE_RES_NAME AS RADIOLOGIST, OP_PROC_NAME AS PROCEDURE_NAME FROM IDB.OR_LOG LEFT JOIN IDB.OR_LOG_ANES_TYPES ON OL_LOG_ID = OLAT_LOG_ID JOIN IDB.OR_LOG_ALL_SURG ON OL_LOG_ID = OLAS_LOG_ID AND OLAS_SURG_ROLE = 'Primary' AND OLAS_SURG_SVC = 'IR' JOIN IDB.OR_LOG_ALL_PROC ON OLAS_LOG_ID = OLAP_LOG_ID AND OLAS_PNL_NO = OLAP_PNL_NO JOIN IDB.OR_PROC ON OLAP_OR_PROC_ID = OP_OR_PROC_ID AND OP_OR_PROC_ID <> '4820' JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CRE_RES_ID = OLAS_RES_ID WHERE OL_SURG_DTE BETWEEN '2022-01-01' AND '2022-12-31' AND OL_LOG_STS_CD NOT IN ('4', '6') AND OLAT_LOG_ID IS NULL AND OLAP_ANES_TYPE ='MOSED' ;

prompt: Provide a list of Thoracic Survivorship patients seen in Thoracic Surgery and has had a new diagnosis
completion: WITH THR_SVP AS (SELECT CPE_MRN AS "MRN", CPE_ENC_DTE AS "Appt Date", CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 AS "Department", CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 AS "Service", CLD_DEPT_NAME AS "Department Name", CRE_RES_NAME AS "Provider Name", CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME AS "Visit Type", ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CPE_MRN ORDER BY CPE_ENC_DTE) RN FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN '2016-09-01' AND '2021-08-31' AND CLD_DEPT_NAME IN ('THR 53 SURVIVORSHIP', 'THR KOCH-16 SVR') ) , SRG AS (SELECT CPE_MRN AS "MRN", "Appt Date" "SVP Appt Date", "Provider Name" "SVP Provider", CPE_ENC_DTE AS "Appt Date", CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 AS "Department", CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 AS "Service", CLD_DEPT_NAME AS "Department Name", CRE_RES_NAME AS "Provider Name", CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME AS "Visit Type", ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CPE_MRN ORDER BY CPE_ENC_DTE) RN FROM THR_SVP JOIN IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER ON "MRN" = CPE_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 = 'SRG' AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 = 'THR' AND CRE_RES_TYP = 'Physician' AND CLD_DEPT_NAME NOT IN ('THR 53 SURVIVORSHIP', 'THR KOCH-16 SVR') AND CPE_ENC_DTE >= "Appt Date" AND RN = 1 ) SELECT "MRN", PT_LAST_NAME "Last Name", PT_FIRST_NAME "First Name", "SVP Appt Date", "SVP Provider", "Appt Date" "THR SRG Appt Date", "Provider Name" "THR SRG Provider", PLA_LST_CHEMO_DTE "Last Chemo Date", PLA_LST_RT_DTE "Last RT Date", PLA_LST_SURG_DTE "Last Surg Date" FROM SRG S JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON "MRN" = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY ON "MRN" = PLA_MRN WHERE RN = 1 ; WITH THR_SVP AS (SELECT CPE_MRN AS "MRN", CPE_ENC_DTE AS "Appt Date", CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 AS "Department", CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 AS "Service", CLD_DEPT_NAME AS "Department Name", CRE_RES_NAME AS "Provider Name", CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME AS "Visit Type", ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CPE_MRN ORDER BY CPE_ENC_DTE) RN FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN '2016-09-01' AND '2021-08-31' AND CLD_DEPT_NAME IN ('THR 53 SURVIVORSHIP', 'THR KOCH-16 SVR') ) , DX AS (SELECT TM_MRN, TM_DX_DTE, TM_HIST_CD, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS HIST_DESC, TM_SITE_CD, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_DESC FROM THR_SVP JOIN IDB.CDB_TUMOR ON "MRN" = TM_MRN JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7') AND RN = 1 UNION SELECT DISTINCT CC_MRN TM_MRN, CC_EFF_DTE TM_DX_DTE, '' TM_HIST_CD, '' HIST_DESC, CLM_CLSF_CD TM_SITE_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK SITE_DESC FROM THR_SVP JOIN IDB.CTC_CLSF ON "MRN" = CC_MRN JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE 1=1 AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND (CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) AND (CC_CLSF_CD BETWEEN '140.00' AND '208.99' OR CC_CLSF_CD = '238.6' OR CC_CLSF_CD BETWEEN 'C00.00' AND 'C97.99') AND RN = 1 ) , FINAL AS (SELECT "MRN", PT_LAST_NAME "Last Name", PT_FIRST_NAME "First Name", "Appt Date" "SVP Appt Date", "Provider Name" "SVP Provider", TM_DX_DTE, TM_HIST_CD, HIST_DESC, TM_SITE_CD, SITE_DESC, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY "MRN" ORDER BY TM_DX_DTE DESC) RN, PLA_LST_CHEMO_DTE "Last Chemo Date", PLA_LST_RT_DTE "Last RT Date", PLA_LST_SURG_DTE "Last Surg Date" FROM THR_SVP JOIN DX ON "MRN" = TM_MRN JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON "MRN" = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY ON "MRN" = PLA_MRN WHERE RN = 1 AND TM_DX_DTE >= "Appt Date" ) SELECT "MRN", "Last Name", "First Name", "SVP Appt Date", "SVP Provider", LISTAGG(TRIM(CHAR(TM_DX_DTE)) || ': ' || TRIM(TM_HIST_CD) || ' ' || TRIM(HIST_DESC) || ' ' || TRIM(TM_SITE_CD) || ' ' || TRIM(SITE_DESC), CHR(13)||CHR(10)) DX, "Last Chemo Date", "Last RT Date", "Last Surg Date" FROM FINAL WHERE RN = 1 GROUP BY "MRN", "Last Name", "First Name", "SVP Appt Date", "SVP Provider", "Last Chemo Date", "Last RT Date", "Last Surg Date"

prompt: Provide a one time report for a list of chromophobe patients.
completion: WITH X AS (SELECT PT_MRN AS MRN, STRIP(PT_LAST_NAME) || ', ' || STRIP(PT_FIRST_NAME) AS NAME, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH AS DOB, PT_DATE_OF_DEATH AS DOD, COALESCE(MAX(PLA_LST_APPT_DTE, PLA_LST_DSCH_DTE), PLA_LST_APPT_DTE, PLA_LST_DSCH_DTE) AS LAST_FU_DATE FROM IDB.PATIENT JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY ON PT_MRN = PLA_MRN WHERE PT_MRN IN ('35226140', '38202735', '38223015', '38186350', '00732761', '38226319', '35578456', '35099508', '38093576', '38175986', '35586637', '38216616', '38222485', '38238375', '35422816', '35306251', '35446468', '35447273', '35451280', '35431730', '35221664', '35450021', '35404980', '35468932', '35468683', '35471349', '35469567', '35469404', '35471012', '35452064', '35153222', '35342852', '35484921', '35094012', '35467869', '35493400', '35092585', '35485964', '35517563', '35294193', '35545501', '35545004', '35546189', '35564399', '35550224', '35573652', '35562441', '38033051', '35578540', '38037956', '38054435', '35406836', '38051264', '38070130', '35226140', '35099508', '38069096', '35320575', '38100739', '38093576', '38022275', '35121187', '38132876', '38127489', '38154531', '38149725', '38153152', '38155928', '38165998', '35472604', '38176369', '38178416', '38157784', '38163283', '38193774', '38178300', '38202735', '38194070') ) , Y AS (SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN, PDRX_ACCESSION_NO, DV.REGEXSTR('(S|H|C|M|F|B|DMG)[0-9]{2}[\s|-][0-9]*', PART_DESCRIPTION) AS REFERENCEDACCESSION, DT_PROCEDURE, SAMPLEID, PATIENTID, TUMOR_TYPE_NAME, TUMOR_TYPE_CODE, PRIMARY_SITE, METASTASIS_SITE FROM DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML DT ON PDRX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID CROSS JOIN XMLTABLE('$c/root/*' PASSING DT.PDRX_XML_VALUE AS "c" COLUMNS DT_PROCEDURE VARCHAR(100) PATH 'fn:string-join(../meta-data/dt_procedure,",")' , SAMPLEID VARCHAR(100) PATH 'fn:string-join(../meta-data/dmp_sample_id,",")' , PATIENTID VARCHAR(100) PATH 'fn:string-join(../meta-data/dmp_patient_id,",")' , TUMOR_TYPE_NAME VARCHAR(100) PATH 'fn:string-join(../meta-data/tumor_type_name,",")' , TUMOR_TYPE_CODE VARCHAR(100) PATH 'fn:string-join(../meta-data/tumor_type_code,",")' , PRIMARY_SITE VARCHAR(255) PATH 'fn:string-join(../meta-data/primary_site,",")' , METASTASIS_SITE VARCHAR(255) PATH 'fn:string-join(../meta-data/metastasis_site,",")' , PART_DESCRIPTION VARCHAR(2000) PATH 'fn:string-join(../meta-data/part_description,",")') T WHERE 1=1 AND PT_MRN IN (SELECT MRN FROM X) AND TUMOR_TYPE_NAME = 'Chromophobe Renal Cell Carcinoma' ) , NN AS (SELECT MRN, MAX(CASE WHEN CRDB.PRT_ID = '12-245' AND REG_ID = '100' THEN DATE(CRDB.CRNT_CONSENT_DATE) END) "12-245 Part A Consent Date", MAX(CASE WHEN CRDB.PRT_ID = '12-245' AND REG_ID = '300' THEN DATE(CRDB.CRNT_CONSENT_DATE) END) "12-245 Part C Consent Date", MAX(CASE WHEN CRDB.PRT_ID = '06-107' THEN DATE(CRDB.CRNT_CONSENT_DATE) END) AS "06-107 Consent Date" FROM X JOIN NN.CRDB_DASH_PT_REG CRDB ON MRN = PT_MRN AND((CRDB.PRT_ID = '12-245' AND REG_ID IN ('100', '200', '300')) OR (CRDB.PRT_ID = '06-107')) AND CRNT_ELGBL_STATUS_DSCRP NOT IN ('Ineligible', 'Cancel') GROUP BY MRN) SELECT DISTINCT X.*, PDRX_ACCESSION_NO, REFERENCEDACCESSION, DT_PROCEDURE, SAMPLEID, PATIENTID, TUMOR_TYPE_NAME, TUMOR_TYPE_CODE, PRIMARY_SITE, METASTASIS_SITE, "12-245 Part A Consent Date", "12-245 Part C Consent Date", "06-107 Consent Date" FROM X LEFT JOIN Y ON X.MRN = Y.PT_MRN LEFT JOIN NN ON X.MRN = NN.MRN

prompt: Provide all Cytology-Non GYN urinary diversion & washing orders submitted by Dr. Eugene Cha, Dr. Jaspreet Sandhu, and Dr. Guido Dalbagni on a weekly basis.
completion: SELECT OO_MRN "MRN", PT_LAST_NAME "PT Last Name", PT_FIRST_NAME "PT First Name", PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH "DOB", MAX(CASE WHEN OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'Requested For' THEN DATE(REGEXP_SUBSTR(OO_SUMMARY_LINE, '[0-9]{1,}/[0-9]{1,}/[0-9]{2,}')) END) AS "Order Requested Date", OOC_ITEM_NAME "Order Name", OO_SUMMARY_LINE "Order Details", OSTS_STS_DESC "Order Status", DOC_NAME "Provider Name", CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME "Visit Type" FROM IDB.OMS_ORDER JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_CATALOG ON OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID = OOC_MSTR_ITEM_GUID JOIN IDB.DOC ON OO_REQ_DR_NO = DOC_DR_NO JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON OO_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.OMS_STATUS ON OO_ORD_STS_CD = OSTS_ORD_STS_CD JOIN IDB.OMS_CLIENT_VISIT ON OO_VISIT_GUID = OCV_VISIT_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_LOCATION ON OL_LOC_GUID = OCV_CURR_LOC_GUID LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER ON OCV_ENC_CSN_ID = CPE_ENC_CSN_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_USER_DATA ON OUD_ORD_GUID = OO_ORD_GUID WHERE OOC_ITEM_NAME IN('Cytology-Non GYN', 'Cytology-Non GYN Order') AND OO_REQ_DR_NO IN ('018572', '012526', '005165') AND (LOWER(OO_SUMMARY_LINE) like '%urinary diversion%' OR LOWER(OO_SUMMARY_LINE) like '%urethra%') AND LOWER(OCV_CURR_LOC) like '%bergen%' GROUP BY OO_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, OOC_ITEM_NAME, OO_SUMMARY_LINE, OSTS_STS_DESC, DOC_NAME, CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME HAVING MAX(DATE(REGEXP_SUBSTR(OO_SUMMARY_LINE, '[0-9]{1,}/[0-9]{1,}/[0-9]{2,}'))) BETWEEN CURRENT date AND CURRENT date + 14 DAYS

prompt: Provide a list of H- and S- cases with ["myeloproliferative neoplasm" OR "MPN"] AND ["chronic myelomonocytic leukemia" OR "CMML"] in Diagnosis section from 01/01/2014 to present.
completion: WITH DX AS (SELECT PT_FIRST_NAME FIRST_NAME, PT_LAST_NAME LAST_NAME, PT_MRN "MRN", PT_BIRTH_DTE "DOB", PRPT_PROCEDURE_DTE PROCEDURE_DATE, STRIP(PRPT_ACCESSION_NO) "H/S NUMBER", PRPT_REPORT, DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)DIAGNOSIS:[\w\W]*(?=BONE MARROW BIOPSY)', PRV.PRPT_REPORT) DIAGNOSIS_COMMENT1, DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)DIAGNOSIS:[\w\W]*(?=MORPHOLOGY)', PRV.PRPT_REPORT) DIAGNOSIS_COMMENT2, DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)DIAGNOSIS:[\w\W]*(?=I ATTEST)', PRV.PRPT_REPORT) DIAGNOSIS_COMMENT3, DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)DIAGNOSIS:[\w\W]*(?=NOTE:)', PRV.PRPT_REPORT) DIAGNOSIS_COMMENT4 FROM DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS PD JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V PRV ON PT_MRN = PRPT_MRN WHERE PRPT_REPORT IS NOT NULL AND SUBSTR(PRPT_ACCESSION_NO, 1, 1) IN ('H', 'S') AND CONTAINS("PRPT_REPORT", '("myeloproliferative neoplasm" OR "MPN")') = 1 AND CONTAINS("PRPT_REPORT", '("chronic myelomonocytic leukemia" OR "CMML")') = 1 AND PRPT_PROCEDURE_DTE BETWEEN '2014-01-01' AND CURRENT DATE ), DX2 AS (SELECT DX.*, CASE WHEN DIAGNOSIS_COMMENT1 <> '' THEN DIAGNOSIS_COMMENT1 WHEN DIAGNOSIS_COMMENT2 <> '' THEN DIAGNOSIS_COMMENT2 WHEN DIAGNOSIS_COMMENT3 <> '' THEN DIAGNOSIS_COMMENT3 WHEN DIAGNOSIS_COMMENT4 <> '' THEN DIAGNOSIS_COMMENT4 END AS DIAGNOSIS_COMMENT FROM DX) SELECT FIRST_NAME, LAST_NAME, "MRN", "DOB", PROCEDURE_DATE, "H/S NUMBER", PRPT_REPORT FROM DX2 WHERE 1=1 AND(UPPER(DIAGNOSIS_COMMENT) LIKE '%MYELOPROLIFERATIVE NEOPLASM%' OR UPPER(DIAGNOSIS_COMMENT) LIKE '%MPN%') AND (UPPER(DIAGNOSIS_COMMENT) LIKE '%CHRONIC MYELOMONOCYTIC LEUKEMIA%' OR UPPER(DIAGNOSIS_COMMENT) LIKE '%CMML%') AND UPPER(DIAGNOSIS_COMMENT) NOT LIKE '%NO DEFINITIVE MORPHOLOGIC OR IMMUNOPHENOTYPIC EVIDENCE OF RESIDUAL%' AND UPPER(DIAGNOSIS_COMMENT) NOT LIKE '%NO DIAGNOSTIC MORPHOLOGIC EVIDENCE OF MYELOID%' AND UPPER(DIAGNOSIS_COMMENT) NOT LIKE '%COMPLETE REMISSION%' AND UPPER(DIAGNOSIS_COMMENT) NOT LIKE '%NO MORPHOLOGIC EVIDENCE OF MPN%' AND UPPER(DIAGNOSIS_COMMENT) NOT LIKE '%NO MORPHOLOGIC OR IMMUNOPHENOTYPIC EVIDENCE OF MYELOID%' AND UPPER(DIAGNOSIS_COMMENT) NOT LIKE '%NO MORPHOLOGIC OR IMMUNOPHENOTYPIC EVIDENCE OF INVOLVEMENT BY%' AND UPPER(DIAGNOSIS_COMMENT) NOT LIKE '%NO DIAGNOSTIC MORPHOLOGIC OR REPORTED IMMUNOPHENOTYPIC EVIDENCE OF%' AND UPPER(DIAGNOSIS_COMMENT) NOT LIKE '%NO DIAGNOSTIC MORPHOLOGIC OR IMMUNOPHENOTYPIC INVOLVEMENT%' AND UPPER(DIAGNOSIS_COMMENT) NOT LIKE '%NO DIAGNOSTIC MORPHOLOGIC OR IMMUNOPHENOTYPIC EVIDENCE OF%'

prompt: We are interested in obtaining the outpatient and inpatient main hospital adult census from 2015 to 2019.
completion: SELECT T0.RPT_YEAR, INPATIENT_ADMISSIONS, OUTPATIENT_VISITS FROM (SELECT YEAR(ADMIT_DATE) RPT_YEAR, COUNT(DISTINCT ADMIT_ID) INPATIENT_ADMISSIONS FROM IDB.INPATIENT_ADMISSIONS_V T0 JOIN IDB.VISIT_V T1 ON T0.VIS_VISIT_ID = T1.VIS_VISIT_ID JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY ON MRN = PLA_MRN AND PLA_PED_IND <> 'Y' WHERE YEAR(VIS_ADM_DTE) IN (2015, 2016, 2017, 2018, 2019, 2020) AND AGE_AT_ADMIT >=18 AND DEPARTMENT_ADMIT <> 'Pediatric' AND INPATIENT_STATUS = 'Inpatient' AND VIS_IP_OP_ADJUSTED_IND = 'I' GROUP BY YEAR(ADMIT_DATE), PLA_PED_IND) T0 JOIN (SELECT YEAR(CPE_ENC_DTE) RPT_YEAR , COUNT(DISTINCT CPE_ENC_CSN_ID) OUTPATIENT_VISITS FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT VD ON CPE_DEPT_ID = VD.CLD_DEPT_ID AND CLD_CLD_CENTER = 'MAIN' JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY ON CPE_MRN = PLA_MRN AND PLA_PED_IND <> 'Y' WHERE YEAR(CPE_ENC_DTE) IN (2015, 2016, 2017, 2018, 2019, 2020) AND CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Comp', 'Arrived') AND CPE_ENC_TYP_CD = 50 AND CPE_CPE_IP_IND <> 'INPATIENT' GROUP BY YEAR(CPE_ENC_DTE)) AS T1 ON T1.RPT_YEAR = T0.RPT_YEAR ORDER BY 1;

prompt: Provide clinical data for 203 Lung MRNs to load into a REDCap database to facilitate chart abstraction.
completion: WITH SVC AS (SELECT PT_MRN AS SVC_MRN, SVC.EDC_DEPT_DESC AS "Service", COUNT(DISTINCT PENC_ENC_CSN_ID) CNT, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY PT_MRN ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT PENC_ENC_CSN_ID) DESC) RN FROM COTA.LUNG_MRNS JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON MRN = PT_MRN JOIN DV.PATIENT_ENCOUNTER ON PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PENC_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID JOIN DV.DATE ON PENC_ENC_DATE_ID = DT_DATE_ID LEFT JOIN DV.ENCOUNTER_DESC_CATALOG STS ON PENC_APPT_STS = STS.EDC_DEPT_ABBREV AND STS.EDC_GROUP_ID = 'STS' JOIN DV.ENCOUNTER_DEPARTMENT ON PENC_DEPT_ID = ENDP_ENC_DEPT_ID JOIN DV.ENCOUNTER_SCHD_RESOURCES ON PENC_PT_ENC_ID = ENSR_PT_ENC_ID AND ENSR_PRIMARY_RES_IND = 'Y' JOIN DV.ENCOUNTER_RESOURCE ON ENSR_RES_ID = ENR_ENC_RES_ID JOIN DV.ENCOUNTER_VISIT_TYPE ON PENC_VISIT_TYPE_ID = ENVT_ENC_VISIT_TYPE_ID LEFT JOIN DV.ENCOUNTER_DESC_CATALOG DEPT ON ENDP_SERVICE_DEPT_GRP_6 = DEPT.EDC_DEPT_ABBREV AND DEPT.EDC_GROUP_ID = '6' LEFT JOIN DV.ENCOUNTER_DESC_CATALOG SVC ON ENDP_SERVICE_SPECIALTY_GRP_8 = SVC.EDC_DEPT_ABBREV AND SVC.EDC_GROUP_ID = '8' WHERE PENC_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND ENR_RES_TYP = 'Physician' GROUP BY PT_MRN, SVC.EDC_DEPT_DESC ) SELECT PD.PT_MRN MRN, PD.PT_LAST_NAME "Last Name", PD.PT_FIRST_NAME "First Name", PD.PT_ZIP_CD "Zip Code", PD.PT_BIRTH_DTE "DOB", CASE WHEN PD.PT_DEATH_IND IN ('X', 'D', 'C') THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END "Vital Status", PD.PT_DEATH_DTE "DOD", PD.PT_SEX "Sex", PD.PT_RACE_DESC "Race", CORE_ETHNICITY_DESC "Ethnicity" , PLA_LAST_APPT_DTE "Last Appt Date", PLA_LAST_KNOWN_ALIVE_DTE "Last Known Alive Date", MAX(CASE WHEN AC_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID IS NOT NULL THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END) "On Therapeutic Protocol", "Service" "Primary Service" FROM COTA.LUNG_MRNS JOIN IDB.PATIENT P ON MRN = P.PT_MRN JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V PD ON MRN = PD.PT_MRN JOIN DV.PATIENT_CORE_DEMOGRAPHICS ON PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = CORE_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID JOIN DV.PATIENT_LATEST_ACTIVITY ON PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PLA_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID JOIN SVC ON MRN = SVC_MRN AND RN = 1 LEFT JOIN DV.ACCRUALS ON AC_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID LEFT JOIN DV.PROTOCOL ON AC_PROTOCOL_ID = PRO_PROTOCOL_ID AND PRO_PROTOCOL_TYPE IN ('Therapeutic', 'Therapeutic/QOL') GROUP BY PD.PT_MRN, PD.PT_LAST_NAME, PD.PT_FIRST_NAME, PD.PT_ZIP_CD, PD.PT_BIRTH_DTE, CASE WHEN PD.PT_DEATH_IND IN ('X', 'D', 'C') THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END, PD.PT_DEATH_DTE, PT_VITAL_STS_LAST_UPD_SOURCE, PD.PT_SEX, PD.PT_RACE_DESC, CORE_ETHNICITY_DESC , PLA_LAST_APPT_DTE, PLA_LAST_KNOWN_ALIVE_DTE, "Service" ; SELECT DISTINCT TM_MRN MRN, TM_DX_DTE "Dx Date", TM_FIRST_MSK_DTE "First MSK Date", TM_SITE_CD AS "Tumor Site Code", S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS "Tumor Site Desc", TM_HIST_CD AS "Tumor Hist Code", H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS "Tumor Hist Desc", TM_CASE_STS "Case Status Code", CS.AV_DESC AS "Case Status Desc", TM_LATERALITY_CD "Laterality Code", LAT.AV_DESC AS "Laterality Desc", TM_DX_CONFRM_CD "Dx Confirmation", TM_CLIN_TNM_T "Clinical T Stage", TM_CLIN_TNM_N "Clinical N Stage", TM_CLIN_TNM_M "Clinical M Stage", TM_CLIN_STG_GRP "Clinical Stage Group", TM_PATH_TNM_T "Pathologic T Stage", TM_PATH_TNM_N "Pathologic N Stage", TM_PATH_TNM_M "Pathologic M Stage", TM_PATH_STG_GRP "Pathologic Stage Group", TM_BEST_AJCC_STG FROM COTA.LUNG_MRNS JOIN IDB.CDB_TUMOR ON MRN = TM_MRN JOIN IDB.CLM H ON TM_HIST_CD = H.CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON TM_SITE_CD = S.CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON TM_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY ON PT_MRN = PLA_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS LAT ON LAT.AV_ELEMENT = 'LATERALITY_CD' AND LAT.AV_CODE = TM_LATERALITY_CD LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS CS ON CS.AV_ELEMENT = 'CASE_STS' AND CS.AV_CODE = TM_CASE_STS LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS R ON PT_RACE = R.AV_CODE AND R.AV_ELEMENT = 'RACE' LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS E ON PT_PT_ETHNICITY = E.AV_CODE AND E.AV_ELEMENT = 'PT_ETHNICITY' WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('3', '6', '7', '8') ; SELECT PRPT_MRN MRN, OO_ORD_ID "Order ID", PRPT_PROCEDURE_DTE "Procedure Date", PRPT_REPORT_DTE "Report Date", PRPT_ACCESSION_NO "Accession No", PRPT_REPORT_TYPE "Report Type", PRPT_REPORT_TYPE_DESC "Report Type Desc", PRPT_REPORT FROM COTA.LUNG_MRNS JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V ON MRN = PRPT_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_ORDER ON OO_ANCIL_REF_CD= PRPT_ACCESSION_NO WHERE PRPT_REPORT_TYPE like 'S%' ; SELECT RRPT_MRN MRN, RRPT_ORDER_STATUS_DESC "Order Status", RRPT_ORDER_GROUP "Order Group", RRPT_PROCEDURE_NAME "Procedure Name", RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE "Performed Date", RRPT_ACCESSION_NO "Accession No", RRPT_REPORT_DTE "Report Date", RRPT_ORDER_ID "Order ID", RRPT_REPORT_TXT FROM COTA.LUNG_MRNS JOIN DV.RADIOLOGY_REPORT_V ON MRN = RRPT_MRN ; SELECT PT_MRN AS MRN, PENC_ENC_CSN_ID "Encounter CSN ID", DT_DTE AS "Encounter Date", STS.EDC_DEPT_DESC AS "Encounter Status", DEPT.EDC_DEPT_DESC AS "Clinical Department", SVC.EDC_DEPT_DESC AS "Clinical Service", ENDP_DEPT_NAME AS "Department Name", ENR_RES_NAME AS "Primary Resource Name", ENVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME AS "Visit Type Name" FROM COTA.LUNG_MRNS JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON MRN = PT_MRN JOIN DV.PATIENT_ENCOUNTER ON PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PENC_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID JOIN DV.DATE ON PENC_ENC_DATE_ID = DT_DATE_ID LEFT JOIN DV.ENCOUNTER_DESC_CATALOG STS ON PENC_APPT_STS = STS.EDC_DEPT_ABBREV AND STS.EDC_GROUP_ID = 'STS' JOIN DV.ENCOUNTER_DEPARTMENT ON PENC_DEPT_ID = ENDP_ENC_DEPT_ID JOIN DV.ENCOUNTER_SCHD_RESOURCES ON PENC_PT_ENC_ID = ENSR_PT_ENC_ID AND ENSR_PRIMARY_RES_IND = 'Y' JOIN DV.ENCOUNTER_RESOURCE ON ENSR_RES_ID = ENR_ENC_RES_ID JOIN DV.ENCOUNTER_VISIT_TYPE ON PENC_VISIT_TYPE_ID = ENVT_ENC_VISIT_TYPE_ID LEFT JOIN DV.ENCOUNTER_DESC_CATALOG DEPT ON ENDP_SERVICE_DEPT_GRP_6 = DEPT.EDC_DEPT_ABBREV AND DEPT.EDC_GROUP_ID = '6' LEFT JOIN DV.ENCOUNTER_DESC_CATALOG SVC ON ENDP_SERVICE_SPECIALTY_GRP_8 = SVC.EDC_DEPT_ABBREV AND SVC.EDC_GROUP_ID = '8' WHERE PENC_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') SELECT MRN, LR_PERFORMED_DTE "Performed Date", LR_ORD_ID "Order ID", LR_TEST_NAME "Test Name", LR_SUBTEST_NAME "Subtest Name", LR_RESULT_VALUE "Result Value", LR_UNIT_MEASURE "Unit", LR_ABNORMALITY_CD "Abnormality Code" FROM COTA.LUNG_MRNS JOIN IDB.LAB_RESULTS ON MRN = LR_MRN ; SELECT DISTINCT TRIM(PT_MRN) MRN, TRIM(PT_LAST_NAME) "Last Name", TRIM(PT_FIRST_NAME) "First Name", PT_BIRTH_DTE "DOB", TRIM(M_ACCESSION_NUM) "Accession Number", D.DT_DTE "Report Date", TRIM(PRIMARY_SITE) "Primary Site", TRIM(TUMOR_TYPE_NAME) "Tumor Type", METASTASIS_SITE "Metastasis Site", DMP_ALYS_TASK_NAME "Task Name", DMP_SAMPLE_ID "Sample Id", PART_DESCRIPTION "Part Description" FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML X JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT P ON X.PDRX_ACCESSION_NO = P.PRPT_ACCESSION_NO JOIN DV.DATE D ON P.PRPT_REPORT_DATE_ID = D.DT_DATE_ID JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON X.PDRX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID JOIN COTA.LUNG_MRNS ON MRN = PT_MRN CROSS JOIN XMLTABLE('$c/root/*' PASSING PDRX_XML_VALUE AS "c" COLUMNS XXML XML PATH '.' , GENE_ID VARCHAR(200) PATH 'gene_id' , PRIMARY_SITE VARCHAR(264) PATH '../meta-data/primary_site' , TUMOR_TYPE_NAME VARCHAR(264) PATH '../meta-data/tumor_type_name' , METASTASIS_SITE VARCHAR(264) PATH '../meta-data/metastasis_site' , IS_METASTASIS VARCHAR(264) PATH '../meta-data/is_metastasis' , M_ACCESSION_NUM VARCHAR(264) PATH '../meta-data/m_accession_num' , DMP_ALYS_TASK_NAME VARCHAR(264) PATH '../meta-data/dmp_alys_task_name' , DMP_SAMPLE_ID VARCHAR(264) PATH '../meta-data/dmp_sample_id' , PART_DESCRIPTION VARCHAR(264) PATH '../meta-data/part_description') T

prompt: Patients who had a lumpectomy and a procedure with Plastic Surgery with the same laterality from 1/1/2010 to 6/30/2020.
completion: WITH L1 AS (SELECT DISTINCT SSE_MRN AS MRN, SSE_SURG_DTE AS SRG_DATE, SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD AS CPT_CODE, SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC AS CPT_DESC, SSP_LATERALITY AS LAT, SSP_SURG_SVC_CD AS SVC, SUBSTR(STRIP(SSP_SURG_LAST_NM)||', '||SSP_SURG_FIRST_NM, 1, 35) AS SURGEON FROM IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE ON SSE_LOG_ID = SSP_LOG_ID WHERE 1=1 AND SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD IN ('19301', '19302') AND SSE_SURG_DTE BETWEEN '2010-01-01' AND '2020-06-30' ) , MAST AS (SELECT DISTINCT SSE_MRN, SSE_SURG_DTE, SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD, SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC, SSP_LATERALITY, SSP_SURG_SVC_CD FROM L1 JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT ON SSE_MRN = MRN AND SSE_SURG_DTE BETWEEN SRG_DATE + 1 DAY AND SRG_DATE + 6 MONTHS AND SSP_LATERALITY = LAT JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE ON SSE_LOG_ID = SSP_LOG_ID WHERE 1=1 AND SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD IN ('19303', '19304', '19305', '19306', '19307', '19309') ) , L2 AS (SELECT L1.* FROM L1 WHERE MRN NOT IN (SELECT SSE_MRN FROM MAST) ) SELECT DISTINCT L2.*, SSE_SURG_DTE, SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD, SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC, SSP_LATERALITY, SSP_SURG_SVC_CD, SUBSTR(STRIP(SSP_SURG_LAST_NM)||', '||SSP_SURG_FIRST_NM, 1, 35) AS SURGEON FROM L2 JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT ON SSE_MRN = MRN JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE ON SSE_LOG_ID = SSP_LOG_ID AND SSP_LATERALITY = LAT WHERE 1=1 AND SSP_SURG_SVC_CD = 'PLA' AND SSE_SURG_DTE BETWEEN '2010-01-01' AND '2020-06-30' AND SSE_SURG_DTE BETWEEN SRG_DATE AND SRG_DATE + 6 MONTHS

prompt: Search pathology reports from 2012 - 2017 for specific diagnostic terms
completion: SELECT PRPT_MRN "MRN", PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH "Date of birth", RTRIM(PT_FIRST_NAME) || ', ' || PT_LAST_NAME AS "Patient name", PRPT_PROCEDURE_DTE "Procedure date", PRPT_REPORT_DTE "Report date", PRPT_REPORT_TYPE_DESC "Report type", PRPT_ACCESSION_NO "Accession no", PRPT_REPORT "Path report" FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PRPT_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE PRPT_REPORT IS NOT NULL AND LEFT(PRPT_ACCESSION_NO, 1) IN ('H', 'S') AND PRPT_REPORT_DTE BETWEEN '2012-01-01' AND '2017-12-31' AND CONTAINS(PRPT_REPORT, '("lcdd" | "light chain deposition")') = 1 ;

completion: SELECT LAB_SUBTEST_NAME, LAB_TEST_CATEGORY , LAB_SUBTEST_CATEGORY, LAB_LIMIT_UPPER , LAB_LIMIT_LOWER, LAB_UNIT_MEASURE, MIN(LAB_PERFORMED_DATE) AS EFF_DTE FROM DV.LABS_V1 WHERE LAB_PERFORMED_DATE BETWEEN '2016-01-01' AND CURRENT DATE AND (COALESCE(LAB_LIMIT_LOWER, '') > '' OR COALESCE(LAB_LIMIT_UPPER, '') > '') GROUP BY LAB_SUBTEST_NAME, LAB_TEST_CATEGORY , LAB_SUBTEST_CATEGORY, LAB_LIMIT_UPPER , LAB_LIMIT_LOWER, LAB_UNIT_MEASURE

prompt: On demand Darwin report that provides prescription information per medication and time frame specified.
completion: WITH GENDRUG AS (SELECT DISTINCT HGN_GENERIC_NAME, OCDX_DRUG_KEY CAT_DRUG_KEY, CASE WHEN (C2.ODC_CATEGORY_NAME = ' ' OR C2.ODC_CATEGORY_NAME IS NULL) THEN C1.ODC_CATEGORY_NAME WHEN (C3.ODC_CATEGORY_NAME = ' ' OR C3.ODC_CATEGORY_NAME IS NULL) THEN C2.ODC_CATEGORY_NAME CONCAT ' | ' CONCAT C1.ODC_CATEGORY_NAME ELSE C3.ODC_CATEGORY_NAME CONCAT ' | ' CONCAT C2.ODC_CATEGORY_NAME END AS CATEGORY_NAME FROM IDB.HML_GENERIC_NAME JOIN IDB.OMS_CATEGORY_DRUG_XREF ON HGN_DRUG_CATALOG_KEY = OCDX_DRUG_KEY JOIN IDB.OMS_DRUG_CATEGORIES C1 ON C1.ODC_MULTUM_CATEGORY_ID = OCDX_MULTUM_CATEGORY_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_CATEGORY_SUB_XREF L2 ON C1.ODC_MULTUM_CATEGORY_ID = L2.OCSX_SUB_CATEGORY_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_DRUG_CATEGORIES C2 ON C2.ODC_MULTUM_CATEGORY_ID = L2.OCSX_MULTUM_CATEGORY_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_CATEGORY_SUB_XREF L3 ON L2.OCSX_MULTUM_CATEGORY_ID = L3.OCSX_SUB_CATEGORY_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_DRUG_CATEGORIES C3 ON C3.ODC_MULTUM_CATEGORY_ID = L3.OCSX_MULTUM_CATEGORY_ID) , DRUGRN AS (SELECT DISTINCT CAT_DRUG_KEY, HGN_GENERIC_NAME, CATEGORY_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CAT_DRUG_KEY ORDER BY CATEGORY_NAME) RN FROM GENDRUG) , DRUGCAT AS (SELECT CAT_DRUG_KEY, HGN_GENERIC_NAME GENERIC_NAME, MAX(CASE WHEN RN = 1 THEN CATEGORY_NAME END)|| MAX(CASE WHEN RN = 2 THEN '; '||STRIP(CATEGORY_NAME) ELSE '' END)|| MAX(CASE WHEN RN = 3 THEN '; '||STRIP(CATEGORY_NAME) ELSE '' END)|| MAX(CASE WHEN RN = 4 THEN '; '||STRIP(CATEGORY_NAME) ELSE '' END) THERAP_CATEGORY FROM DRUGRN GROUP BY CAT_DRUG_KEY, HGN_GENERIC_NAME) SELECT STRIP(HCPR_MRN) AS "MRN" , DATE(HCPR_START_DT) AS "Start Date", DATE(HCPR_END_DT) AS "End Date", DATE(HCPR_RENEWAL_DT) AS "Renewal Date", DATE(HCPR_DISCONTINUE_DT) AS "Discontinued Date", STRIP(HCPR_DRUG_NAME) AS "Drug Name", STRIP(HGN_GENERIC_NAME) AS "Generic Name", STRIP(THERAP_CATEGORY) AS "Therapeutic Category" , CASE HCPR_STATUS_TYPE WHEN 1 THEN 'Active' WHEN 4 THEN 'Cancelled' WHEN 7 THEN 'Completed' WHEN 3 THEN 'Discontinued' WHEN 8 THEN 'EnteredInError' WHEN 2 THEN 'Inactive' WHEN 6 THEN 'NoLongerTaking' WHEN 5 THEN 'Unapproved' END AS "Prescription Status" , CASE WHEN HCPR_PRESCRIPTION_TYPE = 1 THEN 'e-Prescribe' WHEN HCPR_PRESCRIPTION_TYPE = 3 THEN 'Home Medication List' ELSE 'Other' END AS "Rx Type", STRIP(HCPR_DOSE_AMT) AS "Dose Amount", STRIP(HCPR_ROUTE) AS "Route", STRIP(UOM.HRUM_NAME) AS "Unit of Measure", STRIP(HSF_ABBREVIATIION) AS "Frequency" , TRIM(A.OP_DISPLAY_NAME) "Prescribed on behalf of", TRIM(A.OP_TASK_ROLE_TYPE) "Prescribed on behalf of Role", TRIM(B.OP_DISPLAY_NAME) "Visit Provider", TRIM(B.OP_TASK_ROLE_TYPE) "Visit Provider Role", TRIM(OCV_CURR_LOC) "Site", TRIM(OS_SVC_DESC) "Service", TRIM(RVP_PLAN_FSC_REC_NO) "Medical FSC #", TRIM(RVP_PLAN_DESCRIPTION) "Medical Insurance" FROM IDB.HML_CLIENT_PRESCRIPTION LEFT JOIN IDB.HML_GENERIC_NAME ON HGN_GENERIC_NAME_ID = HCPR_GENERIC_NAME_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.HML_RX_UNIT_OF_MEASURE UOM ON UOM.HRUM_RXUOM_ID = HCPR_DOSE_UOM_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.HML_RX_UNIT_OF_MEASURE PKG ON PKG.HRUM_RXUOM_ID = HCPR_INNER_PACKAGE_SIZE_UOM_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.HML_SCRIPT_FREQUENCY ON HSF_SCRIPT_FREQ_ID = HCPR_SCRIPT_FREQ_ID LEFT JOIN DRUGCAT ON CAT_DRUG_KEY = HGN_DRUG_CATALOG_KEY LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_PROVIDER A ON HCPR_CARE_PROV_GUID = A.OP_PVDR_GUID LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_CLIENT_VISIT ON HCPR_VISIT_GUID = OCV_VISIT_GUID LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_PROVIDER B ON OCV_ATT_PVDR_GUID = B.OP_PVDR_GUID LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_SERVICE ON OCV_SVC_GUID = OS_SVC_GUID LEFT JOIN IDB.RMS_VISIT ON OCV_ADM_NUM = RV_ADM_NUM LEFT JOIN IDB.RMS_VISIT_PLAN ON RV_VISIT_ID = RVP_VISIT_ID AND RVP_PLAN_NO = 1 WHERE HCPR_STATUS_TYPE NOT IN (4, 8) AND(HCPR_PRESCRIPTION_TYPE = 1 AND HCPR_TRANSMISSION_STATUS IN (1, 2, 5) OR HCPR_PRESCRIPTION_TYPE = 3)
