prompt: Create darwin cohort of patients with NTRK1, NTRK2 or NTRK3 fusions/rearrangements/intragenic deletions
completion: SELECT PSR.PT_MRN, PRPT_ACCESSION_NO, GENE, GENE2, METHOD, ABERRATIONTYPE, SEARCH_HIT2 FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_STRUCTURED_RESULTS_V PSR JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS PD ON PD.PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PSR.PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID WHERE 1=1 AND PT_DEATH_DTE IS NULL AND (((GENE IN ('NTRK1', 'NTRK2', 'NTRK3') AND ABERRATIONTYPE IN ('intragenic deletion', 'fusion', 'translocation', 'duplication', 'deletion', 'inversion')) OR (SEARCH_HIT2 like '%NTRK%' AND (UPPER(SEARCH_HIT2) like '%FUSION%' OR UPPER(SEARCH_HIT2) like '%TRANS%' OR UPPER(SEARCH_HIT2) like '%REARRAN%'))) ) ORDER BY PSR.PT_MRN, GENE ;

prompt: Dr, Mohit Chawla, Pulmonary Service Chief would like a report demonstrating when an inpatient BMT or Hematologic malignancy/Leukemia inpatient has a CT chest scan and further broken down to show which have had scan within 72 hours of admission and at any point to follow inpatient stay. Report should include any CT scan of the chest.
completion: WITH ADMITS AS (SELECT VIS_MRN, VIS_ADM_NUM, VIS_ADM_DTE, VIS_DSCH_DTE, ADM_HOSP_SVC, UC_BED FROM (SELECT DISTINCT VIS_MRN, VIS_ADM_NUM, VIS_ADM_DTE, VIS_DSCH_DTE, AV_DESC ADM_HOSP_SVC, UC_BED, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY UC_MRN ORDER BY UC_SEQ_NO DESC) AS RN FROM IDB.UNIFIED_CENSUS JOIN IDB.VISIT ON UC_VISIT_ID = VIS_VISIT_ID JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS ON AV_ELEMENT = 'SVC' AND AV_CD_STS = 'A' AND AV_CODE = UC_HOSP_SVC WHERE VIS_IP_OP_ADJUSTED_IND = 'I' AND VIS_VISIT_STATUS IN ('2', '3') AND VIS_ADM_DTE >= CURRENT date - 365 DAYS AND AV_CODE IN ('HAT', 'LKA', 'LKB', 'LYM', 'LYG', 'LYR', 'TRB', 'TRG', 'TRW') ) A WHERE RN = 1 ), ORDERS AS (SELECT OO_MRN, OO_ENTER_DT, OO_ORD_NAME, OO_SUMMARY_LINE FROM (SELECT OO_MRN, OO_ENTER_DT, OO_ORD_NAME, OO_SUMMARY_LINE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY OO_MRN ORDER BY OO_ENTER_DT) AS RN FROM ADMITS JOIN IDB.OMS_ORDER ON OO_MRN=VIS_MRN WHERE OO_ENTER_DTE >= VIS_ADM_DTE AND OO_ORD_NAME = 'CT' ) A WHERE RN=1 ), PULM_ORDER AS (SELECT DISTINCT OO_MRN PULM_MRN, OSTS_STS_DESC FROM ADMITS JOIN IDB.OMS_ORDER ON OO_MRN = VIS_MRN AND VIS_ADM_NUM = OO_ADM_NUM JOIN IDB.OMS_STATUS ON OO_ORD_STS_CD = OSTS_ORD_STS_CD WHERE OO_ORD_NAME = 'Pulmonary Inpatient Team Assignment' ) SELECT VIS_MRN MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, VIS_ADM_DTE "Admission Date", VIS_DSCH_DTE "Discharge Date", ADM_HOSP_SVC "Admitting Hospital Service", UC_BED "Bed at Midnight", COALESCE(OSTS_STS_DESC, 'none') "Pulmonary Order Status", OO_ENTER_DT "Order Entered Date", OO_ORD_NAME "Order Name", OO_SUMMARY_LINE "Order Summary", RRPT_PROCEDURE_NAME "Procedure Name", RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE "Procedure Performed Date", CASE WHEN RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE BETWEEN VIS_ADM_DTE AND VIS_ADM_DTE + 3 DAYS THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS "Within 3 Days of Admission" FROM ADMITS JOIN DV.RADIOLOGY_REPORT_V ON RRPT_MRN = VIS_MRN LEFT JOIN ORDERS ON VIS_MRN = OO_MRN JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PT_MRN=VIS_MRN LEFT JOIN PULM_ORDER ON PULM_MRN = VIS_MRN WHERE RRPT_ORDER_GROUP = 'CT' AND RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE >= CURRENT date - 3 DAYS AND RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE BETWEEN VIS_ADM_DTE AND COALESCE(VIS_DSCH_DTE, CURRENT date) AND UPPER(RRPT_PROCEDURE_NAME) like '%CH%' ORDER BY VIS_ADM_DTE, VIS_DSCH_DTE DESC ;

prompt: Provide a list of survivorship patients with Emblem health insurance
completion: WITH RAW AS (SELECT CPE_MRN, CPP_PT_NAME, CPP_DATE_OF_BIRTH, CPE_ENC_DTE, CPE_CPE_APPT_STS, CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME, FSC_REP_CAT_NAME AS INSURANCE, INS_CERTIFICATE_NUM AS MEMBERID, INS_COMP_NAME, R.CRE_RES_TYP, R.CRE_RES_NAME AS PROVIDER, CLD_DEPT_NAME AS PROVIDERLOCATION, LISTAGG(TRIM(PCP.CRE_RES_NAME), '; ') PCP_NAME FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER A JOIN IDB.CL_PAS_PATIENT ON CPP_MRN = CPE_MRN AND CPE_CL_PT_ID = CPP_CL_PT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CLD_DEPT_ID = CPE_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE R ON R.CRE_RES_ID = CPE_VST_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.PAS_REFERRAL ON PRF_CL_PT_ID = CPE_CL_PT_ID AND PRF_RFL_ID = CPE_RFL_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.PAS_EXT_REFERRING ON CPE_MRN = PER_MRN AND PER_MRN <> '' LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE PCP ON PER_RES_ID = PCP.CRE_RES_ID AND PCP.CRE_INT_EXT_TYP <> 'Internal' LEFT JOIN IDB.PATIENT_INSURANCE_V ON CPE_MRN = MRN JOIN IDB.RMS_PATIENT ON CPE_MRN = RPT_MRN WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp', 'Sch') AND (CLD_DEPT_NAME LIKE '%SVR%' OR CLD_DEPT_NAME LIKE '%SURVIVOR%' OR CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME LIKE '%SNP %' OR CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR like 'SAPP %') AND FSC_REP_CAT_NAME like '%EMBLEM%' AND FSC_PRIORITY = '1' AND CPE_ENC_DTE >= CURRENT date - 1 YEAR GROUP BY CPE_MRN, CPP_PT_NAME, CPP_DATE_OF_BIRTH, CPE_ENC_DTE, CPE_CPE_APPT_STS, CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME, FSC_REP_CAT_NAME, INS_CERTIFICATE_NUM, INS_COMP_NAME, R.CRE_RES_TYP, R.CRE_RES_NAME, CLD_DEPT_NAME ) , RECENT AS (SELECT * FROM (SELECT R.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CPE_MRN ORDER BY CPE_ENC_DTE DESC) MOST_RECENT_RANK_SVP FROM RAW R WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') ) WHERE MOST_RECENT_RANK_SVP = 1 ) , UPCOMING AS (SELECT CPE_MRN, LISTAGG(CHAR(CPE_ENC_DTE), '; ') UPCOMING_SVP_DTE FROM RAW R WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Sch') GROUP BY CPE_MRN ) SELECT RECENT.CPE_MRN, CPP_PT_NAME, CPP_DATE_OF_BIRTH, CPE_ENC_DTE, CPE_CPE_APPT_STS, CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME, INSURANCE, MEMBERID, INS_COMP_NAME, CRE_RES_TYP, PROVIDER, PROVIDERLOCATION, PCP_NAME, UPCOMING_SVP_DTE FROM RECENT RECENT LEFT JOIN UPCOMING UPCOMING ON RECENT.CPE_MRN = UPCOMING.CPE_MRN WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp')

prompt: requesting demographic data for a poster
completion: WITH DEMOGRAPHICS_0 AS (SELECT DISTINCT "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AS PT_DEID, IDB_PATIENT."PT_MRN" AS PT_MRN, "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AS SUBJECT_ID, ALLOWVALS_ETHNICITY."AV_DESC" AS ETHNICITY, ALLOWVALS_RACE."AV_DESC" AS RACE FROM "IDB"."PATIENT" AS IDB_PATIENT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS" ON IDB_PATIENT."PT_MRN" = "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_MRN" LEFT OUTER JOIN "IDB"."ALLOWVALS" AS ALLOWVALS_ETHNICITY ON IDB_PATIENT."PT_PT_ETHNICITY" = ALLOWVALS_ETHNICITY."AV_CODE" AND ALLOWVALS_ETHNICITY."AV_ELEMENT" = 'PT_ETHNICITY' LEFT OUTER JOIN "IDB"."ALLOWVALS" AS ALLOWVALS_RACE ON IDB_PATIENT."PT_RACE" = ALLOWVALS_RACE."AV_CODE" AND ALLOWVALS_RACE."AV_ELEMENT" = 'RACE' WHERE ALLOWVALS_ETHNICITY."AV_DESC" IN ('HISPANIC OR LATINO', 'NO VALUE ENTERED', 'NOT HISPANIC', 'UNKNOWN') AND ALLOWVALS_RACE."AV_DESC" IN ('ASIAN-FAR EAST/INDIAN SUBCONT', 'BLACK HISPANIC', 'BLACK OR AFRICAN AMERICAN', 'NATIVE AMERICAN-AM IND/ALASKA', 'NATIVE HAWAIIAN OR PACIFIC ISL', 'NO VALUE ENTERED', 'OTHER', 'PT REFUSED TO ANSWER', 'UNKNOWN', 'WHITE', 'WHITE HISPANIC')), PROTOCOL_1 AS (SELECT "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AS PT_DEID, "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_MRN" AS PT_MRN, CAST(TRIM("IDB"."ACCRUALS"."AC_CONS_DTE") AS VARCHAR) || CAST(TRIM("IDB"."ACCRUALS"."AC_MRN") AS VARCHAR) || CAST(TRIM("IDB"."ACCRUALS"."AC_IRB_NO") AS VARCHAR) AS SUBJECT_ID, "IDB"."ACCRUALS"."AC_IRB_NO" AS AC_IRB_NO FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS" JOIN "IDB"."ACCRUALS" ON "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_MRN" = "IDB"."ACCRUALS"."AC_MRN" WHERE "IDB"."ACCRUALS"."AC_NON_MSK_INST" = '' AND "IDB"."ACCRUALS"."AC_IRB_NO" IN ('20-316')), COHORT AS (SELECT PT_DEID AS PT_DEID FROM (SELECT DEMOGRAPHICS_0.PT_DEID AS PT_DEID FROM DEMOGRAPHICS_0 INTERSECT SELECT PROTOCOL_1.PT_DEID AS PT_DEID FROM PROTOCOL_1)), COHORT_PROTOCOL AS (SELECT SUBJECT_ID AS SUBJECT_ID, PT_DEID AS PT_DEID FROM (SELECT PROTOCOL_1.SUBJECT_ID AS SUBJECT_ID, PROTOCOL_1.PT_DEID AS PT_DEID FROM PROTOCOL_1)), KEYS AS (SELECT COHORT.PT_DEID AS COHORT_PT_DEID, COHORT_PROTOCOL.SUBJECT_ID AS COHORT_PROTOCOL_SUBJECT_ID, COHORT_PROTOCOL.PT_DEID AS COHORT_PROTOCOL_PT_DEID FROM COHORT LEFT OUTER JOIN COHORT_PROTOCOL ON COHORT_PROTOCOL.PT_DEID = COHORT.PT_DEID), DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS AS (SELECT DISTINCT "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AS PT_DEID, IDB_PATIENT."PT_MRN" AS PT_MRN, "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AS SUBJECT_ID, DMP_ID_TBL."PDRX_DMP_PATIENT_ID" AS DMP_ID, TRIM(IDB_PATIENT."PT_LAST_NAME") || ', ' || TRIM(IDB_PATIENT."PT_FIRST_NAME") AS PT_NAME, ALLOWVALS_SEX."AV_DESC" AS SEX, CASE WHEN (IDB_PATIENT."PT_DATE_OF_DEATH" IS NULL) THEN 'Alive' ELSE 'Deceased' END AS VITAL_STATS, IDB_PATIENT."PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH" AS DATE_OF_BIRTH, IDB_PATIENT."PT_DATE_OF_DEATH" AS DATE_OF_DEATH, ALLOWVALS_RACE."AV_DESC" AS RACE, ALLOWVALS_ETHNICITY."AV_DESC" AS ETHNICITY, ALLOWVALS_LANGUAGE."AV_DESC" AS PRIMARY_LANGUAGE, LAST_ACTIVITY_DATE."PLA_LST_ACTV_DTE" AS LAST_ACTIVITY_DATE, LAST_CONTACT_DATE."PLA_LST_CON_DTE" AS LAST_CONTACT_DATE FROM "IDB"."PATIENT" AS IDB_PATIENT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS" ON IDB_PATIENT."PT_MRN" = "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_MRN" LEFT OUTER JOIN "DV"."PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML" AS DMP_ID_TBL ON DMP_ID_TBL."PDRX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT OUTER JOIN "IDB"."ALLOWVALS" AS ALLOWVALS_SEX ON IDB_PATIENT."PT_SEX" = ALLOWVALS_SEX."AV_CODE" AND ALLOWVALS_SEX."AV_ELEMENT" = 'SEX' LEFT OUTER JOIN "IDB"."ALLOWVALS" AS ALLOWVALS_RACE ON IDB_PATIENT."PT_RACE" = ALLOWVALS_RACE."AV_CODE" AND ALLOWVALS_RACE."AV_ELEMENT" = 'RACE' LEFT OUTER JOIN "IDB"."ALLOWVALS" AS ALLOWVALS_ETHNICITY ON IDB_PATIENT."PT_PT_ETHNICITY" = ALLOWVALS_ETHNICITY."AV_CODE" AND ALLOWVALS_ETHNICITY."AV_ELEMENT" = 'PT_ETHNICITY' LEFT OUTER JOIN "IDB"."ALLOWVALS" AS ALLOWVALS_LANGUAGE ON IDB_PATIENT."PT_PRIMARY_LANG" = ALLOWVALS_LANGUAGE."AV_CODE" AND ALLOWVALS_LANGUAGE."AV_ELEMENT" = 'PRIMARY_LANG' LEFT OUTER JOIN "IDB".PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY AS LAST_ACTIVITY_DATE ON IDB_PATIENT."PT_MRN" = LAST_ACTIVITY_DATE."PLA_MRN" LEFT OUTER JOIN "IDB".PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY AS LAST_CONTACT_DATE ON IDB_PATIENT."PT_MRN" = LAST_CONTACT_DATE."PLA_MRN") SELECT DISTINCT DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS.PT_MRN AS MRN, DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS.DMP_ID AS DMP_ID, DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS.PT_NAME AS PT_NAME, DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS.SEX AS SEX, DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS.VITAL_STATS AS VITAL_STATUS, DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS.DATE_OF_BIRTH AS DATE_OF_BIRTH, DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS.DATE_OF_DEATH AS DATE_OF_DEATH, DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS.RACE AS RACE, DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS.ETHNICITY AS ETHNICITY, DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS.PRIMARY_LANGUAGE AS PRIMARY_LANGUAGE, DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS.LAST_ACTIVITY_DATE AS LAST_ACTIVITY_DATE, DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS.LAST_CONTACT_DATE AS LAST_CONTACT_DATE FROM KEYS LEFT OUTER JOIN DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS ON DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS.PT_DEID = KEYS.COHORT_PT_DEID; WITH DEMOGRAPHICS_0 AS (SELECT DISTINCT "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AS PT_DEID, IDB_PATIENT."PT_MRN" AS PT_MRN, "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AS SUBJECT_ID, ALLOWVALS_ETHNICITY."AV_DESC" AS ETHNICITY, ALLOWVALS_RACE."AV_DESC" AS RACE FROM "IDB"."PATIENT" AS IDB_PATIENT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS" ON IDB_PATIENT."PT_MRN" = "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_MRN" LEFT OUTER JOIN "IDB"."ALLOWVALS" AS ALLOWVALS_ETHNICITY ON IDB_PATIENT."PT_PT_ETHNICITY" = ALLOWVALS_ETHNICITY."AV_CODE" AND ALLOWVALS_ETHNICITY."AV_ELEMENT" = 'PT_ETHNICITY' LEFT OUTER JOIN "IDB"."ALLOWVALS" AS ALLOWVALS_RACE ON IDB_PATIENT."PT_RACE" = ALLOWVALS_RACE."AV_CODE" AND ALLOWVALS_RACE."AV_ELEMENT" = 'RACE' WHERE ALLOWVALS_ETHNICITY."AV_DESC" IN ('HISPANIC OR LATINO', 'NO VALUE ENTERED', 'NOT HISPANIC', 'UNKNOWN') AND ALLOWVALS_RACE."AV_DESC" IN ('ASIAN-FAR EAST/INDIAN SUBCONT', 'BLACK HISPANIC', 'BLACK OR AFRICAN AMERICAN', 'NATIVE AMERICAN-AM IND/ALASKA', 'NATIVE HAWAIIAN OR PACIFIC ISL', 'NO VALUE ENTERED', 'OTHER', 'PT REFUSED TO ANSWER', 'UNKNOWN', 'WHITE', 'WHITE HISPANIC')), PROTOCOL_1 AS (SELECT "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AS PT_DEID, "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_MRN" AS PT_MRN, CAST(TRIM("IDB"."ACCRUALS"."AC_CONS_DTE") AS VARCHAR) || CAST(TRIM("IDB"."ACCRUALS"."AC_MRN") AS VARCHAR) || CAST(TRIM("IDB"."ACCRUALS"."AC_IRB_NO") AS VARCHAR) AS SUBJECT_ID, "IDB"."ACCRUALS"."AC_IRB_NO" AS AC_IRB_NO FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS" JOIN "IDB"."ACCRUALS" ON "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_MRN" = "IDB"."ACCRUALS"."AC_MRN" WHERE "IDB"."ACCRUALS"."AC_NON_MSK_INST" = '' AND "IDB"."ACCRUALS"."AC_IRB_NO" IN ('20-316')), COHORT AS (SELECT PT_DEID AS PT_DEID FROM (SELECT DEMOGRAPHICS_0.PT_DEID AS PT_DEID FROM DEMOGRAPHICS_0 INTERSECT SELECT PROTOCOL_1.PT_DEID AS PT_DEID FROM PROTOCOL_1)), COHORT_PROTOCOL AS (SELECT SUBJECT_ID AS SUBJECT_ID, PT_DEID AS PT_DEID FROM (SELECT PROTOCOL_1.SUBJECT_ID AS SUBJECT_ID, PROTOCOL_1.PT_DEID AS PT_DEID FROM PROTOCOL_1)), KEYS AS (SELECT COHORT.PT_DEID AS COHORT_PT_DEID, COHORT_PROTOCOL.SUBJECT_ID AS COHORT_PROTOCOL_SUBJECT_ID, COHORT_PROTOCOL.PT_DEID AS COHORT_PROTOCOL_PT_DEID FROM COHORT LEFT OUTER JOIN COHORT_PROTOCOL ON COHORT_PROTOCOL.PT_DEID = COHORT.PT_DEID), DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS AS (SELECT DISTINCT "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AS PT_DEID, IDB_PATIENT."PT_MRN" AS PT_MRN, "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AS SUBJECT_ID FROM "IDB"."PATIENT" AS IDB_PATIENT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS" ON IDB_PATIENT."PT_MRN" = "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_MRN"), PROTOCOL_COLUMNS AS (SELECT DISTINCT "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AS PT_DEID, "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_MRN" AS PT_MRN, CAST(TRIM("IDB"."ACCRUALS"."AC_CONS_DTE") AS VARCHAR) || CAST(TRIM("IDB"."ACCRUALS"."AC_MRN") AS VARCHAR) || CAST(TRIM("IDB"."ACCRUALS"."AC_IRB_NO") AS VARCHAR) AS SUBJECT_ID, "IDB"."ACCRUALS"."AC_IRB_NO" AS AC_IRB_NO FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS" JOIN "IDB"."ACCRUALS" ON "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_MRN" = "IDB"."ACCRUALS"."AC_MRN") SELECT DISTINCT DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS.PT_MRN AS MRN, PROTOCOL_COLUMNS.AC_IRB_NO AS AC_IRB_NO FROM KEYS LEFT OUTER JOIN DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS ON DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS.PT_DEID = KEYS.COHORT_PT_DEID LEFT OUTER JOIN PROTOCOL_COLUMNS ON PROTOCOL_COLUMNS.SUBJECT_ID = KEYS.COHORT_PROTOCOL_SUBJECT_ID;

prompt: Provide weekly list of patients scheduled for a nephrectomy within the next 4 weeks.
completion: WITH ETO AS (SELECT OC_SURG_DTE DOS, OC_MRN MRN, STRIP(PT_LAST_NAME)||', '||PT_FIRST_NAME PT_NAME, YEAR(OC_SURG_DTE) - YEAR(PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) AGE_AT_SRG , OC_CASE_ID CASE_ID , OCAS_SURG_SVC SVC , CASE WHEN OC_PT_CLASS IN ('IP', 'PSC', 'SDA', 'PDH', 'EI', 'FSI') THEN 'IP' ELSE 'OP' END AS PT_IND, OC_PT_CLASS PT_CLASS, SUBSTR(CRE_RES_NAME, 1, 35) SURGEON, OCAP_PNL_NO PNL_NO, OCAP_LINE_NO PROC_SEQ_NO, OCAP_LAT LAT, OP_OR_PROC_ID OR_PROC_ID, OP_PROC_NAME OR_PROC_NAME, OCP_LINE_NO CPT_SEQ_NO, CPX_PROC_CD CPT, CPX_PROC_NAME CPT_DESC FROM IDB.OR_CASE JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON OC_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_LOCATION ON OC_SURG_LOC_ID = LOC_LOC_ID JOIN IDB.OR_CASE_ALL_PROC ON OC_CASE_ID = OCAP_CASE_ID JOIN IDB.OR_CASE_ALL_SURG ON OCAP_CASE_ID = OCAS_CASE_ID AND OCAS_PNL_NO = OCAP_PNL_NO JOIN IDB.OR_PROC ON OCAP_OR_PROC_ID = OP_OR_PROC_ID JOIN IDB.OR_CL_PROC ON OP_OR_PROC_ID = OCP_OR_PROC_ID AND(OCP_LINE_NO = 1 OR OCAS_SURG_SVC NOT IN ('PLA', 'ORTHO')) JOIN IDB.CL_PROC ON OCP_PROC_ID = CPX_PROC_ID JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CRE_RES_ID = OCAS_RES_ID WHERE OC_SURG_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT DATE AND CURRENT DATE + 28 DAY AND OC_OR_CASE_STS_CD NOT IN ('2', '5') AND OP_PROC_NAME LIKE '%NEPHRECTOMY%' AND SUBSTR(CRE_RES_NAME, 1, 35) IN ('RUSSO, PAUL', 'COLEMAN, JONATHAN A', 'HAKIMI, ABRAHAM') ) , IRB1 AS (SELECT ACD_MRN, ACD_IRB_NO, ACD_CONS_DTE FROM ETO JOIN IDB.ACCRUALS_DATES ON MRN = ACD_MRN WHERE ACD_IRB_NO IN ('12-245', '06-107') AND ACD_OFF_STUDY_DTE IS NULL ), IRB2 AS (SELECT ACD_MRN , SUBSTR(REPLACE(REPLACE(CAST(XMLSERIALIZE(CONTENT XMLAGG(XMLELEMENT(NAME "c", RTRIM(ACD_IRB_NO))) AS CLOB(100)) AS VARCHAR(100)), '<c>', ', '), '</c>', ''), 2) AS IRB FROM IRB1 GROUP BY ACD_MRN) SELECT DOS SURGERY_DTE, MRN, PT_NAME, AGE_AT_SRG , CASE_ID, SVC, PT_CLASS, SURGEON, PNL_NO, OR_PROC_NAME, CPT, CPT_DESC , LTRIM(RTRIM(IRB)) IRB FROM ETO T1 LEFT JOIN IRB2 T2 ON T1.MRN = T2.ACD_MRN ORDER BY SURGEON, DOS

prompt: Provide count of patients, grouped by age at procedure date, for each of the following populations for select procedures, drug dispenses and CIS orders.
completion: WITH AGES AS (SELECT DT_DATE_ID AGE FROM DV.DATE_V WHERE DT_DATE_ID BETWEEN 60 AND 90) , LUNG AS (SELECT DISTINCT "t6"."PT_MRN" , "t3"."DT_DTE" PROC_DATE, "t4"."DT_DTE" DOB, YEAR("t3"."DT_DTE" - "t4"."DT_DTE") AS "Age at CPT Procedure Date (PBD)- years" FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED" "t1" LEFT JOIN "DV"."CPT_PBD_PATIENT_PROCEDURE" "t2" ON "t1"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t2"."PTX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" "t3" ON "t2"."PTX_PROC_DATE_ID" = "t3"."DT_DATE_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V" "t6" ON "t1"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t6"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" "t4" ON "t6"."PT_BIRTH_DTE" = "t4"."DT_DTE" WHERE 1=1 AND "t2"."PCC_CODE" IN ('32442', '32445', '32480', '32482', '32484', '32486', '32488', '32500', '32540', '32657', '32663') AND YEAR("t3"."DT_DTE" - "t4"."DT_DTE") >= 60 AND "t3"."DT_YEAR" = 2011 ) , GA AS (SELECT DISTINCT "t6"."PT_MRN" , "t3"."DT_DTE" PROC_DATE, "t7a"."DT_DTE" GA_DATE, DAYS("t3"."DT_DTE") - DAYS("t7a"."DT_DTE") AS GA_DELTA FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED" "t1" LEFT JOIN "DV"."CPT_PBD_PATIENT_PROCEDURE" "t2" ON "t1"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t2"."PTX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" "t3" ON "t2"."PTX_PROC_DATE_ID" = "t3"."DT_DATE_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V" "t6" ON "t1"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t6"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" "t4" ON "t6"."PT_BIRTH_DTE" = "t4"."DT_DTE" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_ENCOUNTER" "t7" ON "t1"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t7"."PENC_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" "t7a" ON "t7"."PENC_ENC_DATE_ID" = "t7a"."DT_DATE_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."ENCOUNTER_VISIT_TYPE" "t5" ON "t7"."PENC_VISIT_TYPE_ID" = "t5"."ENVT_ENC_VISIT_TYPE_ID" LEFT JOIN DV.ENCOUNTER_DESC_CATALOG D ON "t7"."PENC_APPT_STS" = D."EDC_DEPT_ABBREV" AND EDC_GROUP_ID = 'STS' WHERE 1=1 AND "t2"."PCC_CODE" IN ('32442', '32445', '32480', '32482', '32484', '32486', '32488', '32500', '32540', '32657', '32663') AND YEAR("t3"."DT_DTE" - "t4"."DT_DTE") >= 60 AND "t3"."DT_YEAR" = 2011 AND (("t5"."ENVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME" IN ('GIM1275 CLEARANCE IR', 'AD HOC CLEARANCE FR', 'AD HOC CLEARANCE IR', 'GER1275 CLEARANCE FR', 'GER1275 CLEARANCE IR', 'GER1275 WALK IN CLEARANCE IR', 'GER53 CLEARANCE FR', 'GER53 CLEARANCE IR', 'GER53 WALK IN CLEARANCE IR') AND DAYS("t3"."DT_DTE") - DAYS("t7a"."DT_DTE") BETWEEN 0 AND 180 AND D."EDC_DEPT_DESC"IN ('Arrived', 'Completed'))) ) , MRI AS (SELECT DISTINCT "t6"."PT_MRN" , "t3"."DT_DTE" PROC_DATE, "t3a"."DT_DTE" MRI_DATE, DAYS("t3"."DT_DTE") - DAYS("t3a"."DT_DTE") MRI_DELTA FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED" "t1" LEFT JOIN "DV"."CPT_PBD_PATIENT_PROCEDURE" "t2" ON "t1"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t2"."PTX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" "t3" ON "t2"."PTX_PROC_DATE_ID" = "t3"."DT_DATE_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V" "t6" ON "t1"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t6"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" "t4" ON "t6"."PT_BIRTH_DTE" = "t4"."DT_DTE" LEFT JOIN "DV"."CPT_PBD_PATIENT_PROCEDURE" "t2a" ON "t1"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t2a"."PTX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" "t3a" ON "t2a"."PTX_PROC_DATE_ID" = "t3a"."DT_DATE_ID" WHERE 1=1 AND "t2"."PCC_CODE" IN ('32442', '32445', '32480', '32482', '32484', '32486', '32488', '32500', '32540', '32657', '32663') AND YEAR("t3"."DT_DTE" - "t4"."DT_DTE") >= 60 AND "t3"."DT_YEAR" = 2011 AND (("t2a"."PCC_CODE" IN ('70551', '70552', '70553', '70557', '70558', '70559') AND DAYS("t3"."DT_DTE") - DAYS("t3a"."DT_DTE") BETWEEN 0 AND 180)) ) , PHM AS (SELECT DISTINCT "t6"."PT_MRN" , "t3"."DT_DTE" PROC_DATE, "p7".* FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED" "t1" LEFT JOIN "DV"."CPT_PBD_PATIENT_PROCEDURE" "t2" ON "t1"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t2"."PTX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" "t3" ON "t2"."PTX_PROC_DATE_ID" = "t3"."DT_DATE_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V" "t6" ON "t1"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t6"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" "t4" ON "t6"."PT_BIRTH_DTE" = "t4"."DT_DTE" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PHM_ORDER_DTL" "p10" ON "t1"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "p10"."POD_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PHM_INVENTORY_CATALOG" "p7" ON "p10"."POD_PHARMA_INVENTORY_CTLG_ID" = "p7"."PINC_INVENTORY_CTLG_ID" WHERE 1=1 AND "t2"."PCC_CODE" IN ('32442', '32445', '32480', '32482', '32484', '32486', '32488', '32500', '32540', '32657', '32663') AND YEAR("t3"."DT_DTE" - "t4"."DT_DTE") >= 60 AND "t3"."DT_YEAR" = 2011 AND "p7"."PINC_AHFS" like ('28:16.08%') ) , "cte1" AS (SELECT L.*, CASE WHEN M.MRI_DATE IS NOT NULL AND G.GA_DATE IS NOT NULL THEN 'Both' WHEN M.MRI_DATE IS NOT NULL THEN 'MRI' WHEN G.GA_DATE IS NOT NULL THEN 'GA' ELSE 'Neither' END AS "MRI Geri Assess Ind", PINC_ITEM_NAME "Psych Ind", M.MRI_DATE, G.GA_DATE , M.MRI_DELTA , G.GA_DELTA FROM LUNG L LEFT JOIN MRI M ON L."PT_MRN" = M."PT_MRN" LEFT JOIN GA G ON L."PT_MRN" = G."PT_MRN" LEFT JOIN PHM P ON L."PT_MRN" = P."PT_MRN") , CTS AS (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT("t8"."PT_MRN")) AS "PT Count", "t8"."Age at CPT Procedure Date (PBD)- years" AS AGE, "MRI Geri Assess Ind", "Psych Ind" FROM "cte1" "t8" GROUP BY "t8"."Age at CPT Procedure Date (PBD)- years", "MRI Geri Assess Ind", "Psych Ind") SELECT A.AGE, CASE WHEN C."PT Count" IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE C."PT Count" END AS "PT Count", "MRI Geri Assess Ind", "Psych Ind" FROM AGES A LEFT JOIN CTS C ON A.AGE = C.AGE

prompt: Patients with sarcomatoid renal cell carcinoma listed in a pathology report
completion: SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN AS "MRN" , PT_LAST_NAME AS "Last Name" , PT_FIRST_NAME AS "First Name" , PT_SEX_DESC "Gender" , PT_BIRTH_DTE AS "Date of Birth" , PT_DEATH_DTE "Date of Death" , PLA_LAST_APPT_DTE "Last Appt Date" , DXCC_ICD_CODE AS "ICD-O Histology Code" , DXCC_ICD_MSK_DESC AS "ICD-O Histology Description" , ICSC_SITE_CD AS "ICD-O Site Code" , ICSC_ICDO_SITE_MSK_DESC AS "ICD-O Site Description" , TCLSA_CLIN_STG_GRP_DESC "Clinical Stage" , TPSA_PATH_STG_GRP_DESC "Path Stage" , DTEDX.DT_DTE AS "Tumor Diagnosis Date" , PRPT_ACCESSION_NO AS "Pathology Report" , PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_DESC "Path Report Type" , DTEPATH.DT_DTE AS "Pathology Report Date" FROM DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V LEFT JOIN DV.CDB_TUMOR_V ON PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = CDTM_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID LEFT JOIN DV.DIAGNOSIS_CODE_CAT_ICDO_V ON CDTM_DX_CATALOG_ID = DXCC_DX_CATALOG_ID LEFT JOIN DV.ICDO_SITE_CATALOG_V ON CDTM_SITE_CATALOG_ID = ICSC_SITE_CATALOG_ID LEFT JOIN DV.DATE_V DTEDX ON CDTM_DX_DATE_ID = DTEDX.DT_DATE_ID LEFT JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V ON PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID LEFT JOIN DV.DATE_V DTEPATH ON PRPT_REPORT_DATE_ID = DTEPATH.DT_DATE_ID LEFT JOIN DV.PATH_RPRT_TYPE_LOOKUP ON PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_CD = PRPT_REPORT_TYPE LEFT JOIN DV.PATIENT_LATEST_ACTIVITY ON PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PLA_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID LEFT JOIN DV.TUMOR_CLINICAL_STAGE_ATTRIBUTES ON CDTM_CLINICAL_STAGE_ATTR_ID = TCLSA_TM_CLIN_STAGE_ATTR_ID LEFT JOIN DV.TUMOR_PATH_STAGE_ATTRIBUTES ON CDTM_PATH_STAGE_ATTR_ID = TPSA_TM_PATH_STAGE_ATTR_ID WHERE ((CONTAINS(PRPT_REPORT, '("sarcomatoid" | "sarcomatous")') = 1 ) AND PRPT_REPORT IS NOT NULL) AND ((CONTAINS(PRPT_REPORT, '("renal cell")') = 1 ) AND PRPT_REPORT IS NOT NULL) ; SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN AS "MRN" , PT_LAST_NAME AS "Last Name" , PT_FIRST_NAME AS "First Name" , PT_SEX_DESC "Gender" , PT_BIRTH_DTE AS "Date of Birth" , PT_DEATH_DTE "Date of Death" , PLA_LAST_APPT_DTE "Last Appt Date" , DXCC_ICD_CODE AS "ICD-O Histology Code" , DXCC_ICD_MSK_DESC AS "ICD-O Histology Description" , ICSC_SITE_CD AS "ICD-O Site Code" , ICSC_ICDO_SITE_MSK_DESC AS "ICD-O Site Description" , TCLSA_CLIN_STG_GRP_DESC "Clinical Stage" , TPSA_PATH_STG_GRP_DESC "Path Stage" , DTEDX.DT_DTE AS "Tumor Diagnosis Date" , PRPT_ACCESSION_NO AS "Pathology Report" , PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_DESC "Path Report Type" , DTEPATH.DT_DTE AS "Pathology Report Date" FROM DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V LEFT JOIN DV.CDB_TUMOR_V ON PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = CDTM_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID LEFT JOIN DV.DIAGNOSIS_CODE_CAT_ICDO_V ON CDTM_DX_CATALOG_ID = DXCC_DX_CATALOG_ID LEFT JOIN DV.ICDO_SITE_CATALOG_V ON CDTM_SITE_CATALOG_ID = ICSC_SITE_CATALOG_ID LEFT JOIN DV.DATE_V DTEDX ON CDTM_DX_DATE_ID = DTEDX.DT_DATE_ID LEFT JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V ON PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID LEFT JOIN DV.DATE_V DTEPATH ON PRPT_REPORT_DATE_ID = DTEPATH.DT_DATE_ID LEFT JOIN DV.PATH_RPRT_TYPE_LOOKUP ON PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_CD = PRPT_REPORT_TYPE LEFT JOIN DV.PATIENT_LATEST_ACTIVITY ON PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PLA_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID LEFT JOIN DV.TUMOR_CLINICAL_STAGE_ATTRIBUTES ON CDTM_CLINICAL_STAGE_ATTR_ID = TCLSA_TM_CLIN_STAGE_ATTR_ID LEFT JOIN DV.TUMOR_PATH_STAGE_ATTRIBUTES ON CDTM_PATH_STAGE_ATTR_ID = TPSA_TM_PATH_STAGE_ATTR_ID WHERE ((CONTAINS(PRPT_REPORT, '("grade 4" | "grade four")') = 1 ) AND PRPT_REPORT IS NOT NULL) AND ((CONTAINS(PRPT_REPORT, '("renal cell")') = 1 ) AND PRPT_REPORT IS NOT NULL) ; SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN AS "MRN" , PT_LAST_NAME AS "Last Name" , PT_FIRST_NAME AS "First Name" , PT_SEX_DESC "Gender" , PT_BIRTH_DTE AS "Date of Birth" , PT_DEATH_DTE "Date of Death" , PLA_LAST_APPT_DTE "Last Appt Date" , DXCC_ICD_CODE AS "ICD-O Histology Code" , DXCC_ICD_MSK_DESC AS "ICD-O Histology Description" , ICSC_SITE_CD AS "ICD-O Site Code" , ICSC_ICDO_SITE_MSK_DESC AS "ICD-O Site Description" , TCLSA_CLIN_STG_GRP_DESC "Clinical Stage" , TPSA_PATH_STG_GRP_DESC "Path Stage" , DTEDX.DT_DTE AS "Tumor Diagnosis Date" , PRPT_ACCESSION_NO AS "Pathology Report" , PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_DESC "Path Report Type" , DTEPATH.DT_DTE AS "Pathology Report Date" FROM DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V LEFT JOIN DV.CDB_TUMOR_V ON PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = CDTM_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID LEFT JOIN DV.DIAGNOSIS_CODE_CAT_ICDO_V ON CDTM_DX_CATALOG_ID = DXCC_DX_CATALOG_ID LEFT JOIN DV.ICDO_SITE_CATALOG_V ON CDTM_SITE_CATALOG_ID = ICSC_SITE_CATALOG_ID LEFT JOIN DV.DATE_V DTEDX ON CDTM_DX_DATE_ID = DTEDX.DT_DATE_ID LEFT JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V ON PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID LEFT JOIN DV.DATE_V DTEPATH ON PRPT_REPORT_DATE_ID = DTEPATH.DT_DATE_ID LEFT JOIN DV.PATH_RPRT_TYPE_LOOKUP ON PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_CD = PRPT_REPORT_TYPE LEFT JOIN DV.PATIENT_LATEST_ACTIVITY ON PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PLA_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID LEFT JOIN DV.TUMOR_CLINICAL_STAGE_ATTRIBUTES ON CDTM_CLINICAL_STAGE_ATTR_ID = TCLSA_TM_CLIN_STAGE_ATTR_ID LEFT JOIN DV.TUMOR_PATH_STAGE_ATTRIBUTES ON CDTM_PATH_STAGE_ATTR_ID = TPSA_TM_PATH_STAGE_ATTR_ID WHERE ((CONTAINS(PRPT_REPORT, '("grade iv")') = 1 ) AND PRPT_REPORT IS NOT NULL) AND ((CONTAINS(PRPT_REPORT, '("renal cell")') = 1 ) AND PRPT_REPORT IS NOT NULL) ;

prompt:
Provide the number of patients visited 53rd facility within the last year categorized by type of service (floor)

e.x. number of patients visited Gynecological Oncology (6th Floor)
completion: SELECT A.CLD_CLD_PHY_LOC, COUNT(DISTINCT CPE_MRN) FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT A ON CPE_DEPT_ID = A.CLD_DEPT_ID AND A.CLD_CLD_CENTER = '53RD' WHERE CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN '2012-01-01' AND '2012-12-31' AND CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Comp', 'Arrived') GROUP BY A.CLD_CLD_PHY_LOC

prompt: Provide a list of 12-245 Part A cases signed out between 1/1/2014 and 5/31/2019
completion: WITH CVR_ELEMENTS AS (SELECT PDWS_NAME, PDRX_PATH_DMP_RESULTS_XML_ID, PDRX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID, PT_MRN, PDRX_PATH_RPT_ID, PDRX_ACCESSION_NO, PDRX_DMP_PATIENT_ID, PDRX_DMP_SAMPLE_ID, T.*, 'Element' AS NODETYPE FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML INNER JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V ON PDRX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID INNER JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML_SETTINGS ON PDRX_PATH_DMP_RESULTS_XML_ID = PDRXS_PATH_DMP_RESULTS_XML_ID INNER JOIN DVDMC.PATHOLOGY_DMP_WEBSVC_SETTINGS ON PDRXS_SETTING_ID = PDWS_SETTING_ID , XMLTABLE('$x/root//*' PASSING PDRX_XML_VALUE AS "x" COLUMNS NODEXML XML PATH '.', NODENAME VARCHAR(255) PATH 'local-name(.)', NODEVAL VARCHAR(4000) PATH '.', SEQNO FOR ORDINALITY, PARENTNODE VARCHAR(255) PATH '../local-name(.)') T WHERE 1=1 AND PARENTNODE = 'meta-data' AND PDWS_NAME IN ('IMPACT') AND (NODENAME like 'dt%' OR NODENAME IN ('part_description', 'retrieval_flags', 'tumor_type_name', 'primary_site', 'metastasis_site')) AND NODEVAL <> 'NA' ) , CVR AS (SELECT PT_MRN CVR_MRN, PDRX_ACCESSION_NO, MAX(CASE WHEN PDWS_NAME = 'IMPACT' AND NODENAME = 'tumor_type_name' THEN NODEVAL END) "IMPACT Tumor Type", MAX(CASE WHEN PDWS_NAME = 'IMPACT' AND NODENAME = 'primary_site' THEN NODEVAL END) "IMPACT Primary Site", MAX(CASE WHEN PDWS_NAME = 'IMPACT' AND NODENAME = 'dt_signout' THEN NODEVAL END) "IMPACT Date Signout" FROM CVR_ELEMENTS WHERE PDWS_NAME IN ('IMPACT') GROUP BY PT_MRN, PDRX_ACCESSION_NO) SELECT * FROM CVR WHERE "IMPACT Date Signout" BETWEEN '2014-01-01' AND '2019-05-31'

prompt: Report all oral investigational drugs entered by the listed neurology physicians between 11/1/2023-2/1/2024.
completion: SELECT OP_DISPLAY_NAME PROVIDER, CAO_ENTER_DTE ORDER_ENTER_DTE, STRIP(CAO_ORD_STS)||'-'||CAO_STS_DESC ORDSTATUS, CAO_MRN MRN, STRIP(PT_LAST_NAME)||', '||PT_FIRST_NAME PT_NAME, CAO_ORDID ORDID, CAO_ORD_NAME ORDNAME, CAO_DRUG_NAME DRUGNAME , CAO_TIME_PRIORITY TIME_PRIO, CAO_LOC_NAME LOCATION, CAO_FREQ ORD_FREQ, CAO_DOSE DOSE , CAO_DOSE_UNIT DOSE_UNIT, CAO_MED_FORM MEDFORM, CAO_ROUTE ROUTE FROM IDB.CHEMO_ALL_ORDERS JOIN IDB.OMS_ORDER ON CAO_ORD_GUID = OO_ORD_GUID LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_PROVIDER ON OO_PVDR_GUID = OP_PVDR_GUID JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON CAO_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE CAO_ENTER_DTE BETWEEN '2023-11-01' AND '2024-02-01' AND UPPER(CAO_ORD_NAME) like '%INVEST%' AND CAO_ORAL_CHEMO_IND = 'Y' AND OP_DISPLAY_NAME IN ('Nolan, Craig', 'Mellinghoff, Ingo', 'Kaley, Thomas', 'Stone, Jacqueline', 'Schaff, Lauren', 'Grommes, Christian', 'Gavrilovic, Igor', 'Boire, Adrienne', 'Budhu, Joshua', 'Coffee, Elizabeth', 'Diamond, Eli', 'Graham, Maya', 'Kotchetkov, Ivan', 'Lin, Andrew', 'Pentsova, Elena', 'Piotrowski, Anna', 'Santomasso, Bianca ', 'Wilcox, Jessica') ORDER BY OP_DISPLAY_NAME, CAO_ENTER_DTE, CAO_MRN ;

prompt: I would need the data of total number of outpatient clinics from 2022 for the GIM faculty individually.  The MDs are:  Dr. Shellie Gumbs, Dr. Robert Sidlow, Dr. Anna Marcelli, Dr. Adrienne Vincenzino and Dr. Amsale Ketema
completion: WITH APPOINTMENTS_0 AS (SELECT "DV"."PATIENT_ENCOUNTER"."PENC_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AS PT_DEID, CL_PT_ENCOUNTER."CPE_ENC_CSN_ID" AS SUBJECT_ID, CL_PT_ENCOUNTER."CPE_ENC_DTE" AS APPT_DATE, CL_PT_ENCOUNTER."CPE_CPE_APPT_STS" AS APPT_STATUS, CL_RESOURCE_PROV."CRE_RES_NAME" AS PROVIDER FROM "DV"."PATIENT_ENCOUNTER" JOIN "IDB"."CL_PT_ENCOUNTER" AS CL_PT_ENCOUNTER ON "DV"."PATIENT_ENCOUNTER"."PENC_ENC_CSN_ID" = CL_PT_ENCOUNTER."CPE_ENC_CSN_ID" JOIN "IDB"."CL_RESOURCE" AS CL_RESOURCE_PROV ON CL_PT_ENCOUNTER."CPE_VST_RES_ID" = CL_RESOURCE_PROV."CRE_RES_ID" WHERE CL_PT_ENCOUNTER."CPE_ENC_DTE" BETWEEN CURRENT_DATE - 3 MONTHS AND CURRENT_DATE AND CL_PT_ENCOUNTER."CPE_CPE_APPT_STS" IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CL_RESOURCE_PROV."CRE_RES_NAME" IN ('GUMBS, SHELLIE', 'KETEMA, AMSALE', 'MARCELLI, ANNA RITA', 'SIDLOW, ROBERT', 'VINCENZINO, ADRIENNE') ), COHORT AS (SELECT PT_DEID AS PT_DEID FROM (SELECT APPOINTMENTS_0.PT_DEID AS PT_DEID FROM APPOINTMENTS_0)), COHORT_APPOINTMENTS AS (SELECT SUBJECT_ID AS SUBJECT_ID, PT_DEID AS PT_DEID FROM (SELECT APPOINTMENTS_0.SUBJECT_ID AS SUBJECT_ID, APPOINTMENTS_0.PT_DEID AS PT_DEID FROM APPOINTMENTS_0)), KEYS AS (SELECT COHORT.PT_DEID AS COHORT_PT_DEID, COHORT_APPOINTMENTS.SUBJECT_ID AS COHORT_APPOINTMENTS_SUBJECT_ID, COHORT_APPOINTMENTS.PT_DEID AS COHORT_APPOINTMENTS_PT_DEID FROM COHORT LEFT OUTER JOIN COHORT_APPOINTMENTS ON COHORT_APPOINTMENTS.PT_DEID = COHORT.PT_DEID), DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS AS (SELECT DISTINCT "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AS PT_DEID, "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AS SUBJECT_ID, "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_MRN" AS PT_MRN FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"), APPOINTMENTS_COLUMNS AS (SELECT DISTINCT "DV"."PATIENT_ENCOUNTER"."PENC_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AS PT_DEID, CL_PT_ENCOUNTER."CPE_ENC_CSN_ID" AS SUBJECT_ID, CL_PT_ENCOUNTER."CPE_ENC_DTE" AS APPT_DATE, CL_PT_ENCOUNTER."CPE_CPE_APPT_STS" AS APPT_STATUS, CL_VISIT_TYPE_AT."CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME" AS APPT_TYPE_NAME, CL_PT_ENCOUNTER."CPE_ENC_CSN_ID" AS CSN_ID, CASE WHEN (CL_VISIT_TYPE_NV_IR."CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR" LIKE '%' || 'NV' || '%') THEN 'New visit' WHEN (CL_VISIT_TYPE_NV_IR."CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR" LIKE '%' || 'IR' || '%') THEN 'Internal referral' ELSE 'Non new visit/Internal referral' END AS NV_VS_IR, CL_DEPT_DEPT_NAME."CLD_DEPT_NAME" AS DEPT_NAME, CL_CATEGORY_DPT_CAT."CAV_NAME" AS DEPARTMENT, CL_RESOURCE_REF_PROV."CRE_RES_NAME" AS REFERRING_PROV, CL_CATEGORY_SVC."CAV_NAME" AS SERVICE, CL_CATEGORY_CENTER."CAV_NAME" AS CENTER, CL_RESOURCE_RES_TYPE."CRE_RES_TYP" AS RESOURCE_TYPE, CL_RESOURCE_PROV."CRE_RES_NAME" AS PROVIDER, CASE WHEN (CL_VISIT_TYPE_TH."CVT_CVT_RPT_GRP_17" = 'TELEHEALTH' OR (UPPER(CL_VISIT_TYPE_TH."CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME") LIKE '%' || 'PHONE' || '%') OR CL_DEPT_TH."CLD_DEPT_ID" IN (1382, 1354) OR UPPER(CL_VISIT_TYPE_TH."CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME") IN ('IC BUNDLED SERVICES', 'IC INTEG MED REVIEW', 'IC MEDICAL RECORDS REVIEW', 'IC MSK IMPACT', 'IC RADIOLOGY REVIEW', 'IC VIDEO CONSULT')) THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS TELE_HEALTH FROM "DV"."PATIENT_ENCOUNTER" JOIN "IDB"."CL_PT_ENCOUNTER" AS CL_PT_ENCOUNTER ON "DV"."PATIENT_ENCOUNTER"."PENC_ENC_CSN_ID" = CL_PT_ENCOUNTER."CPE_ENC_CSN_ID" JOIN "IDB"."CL_VISIT_TYPE" AS CL_VISIT_TYPE_AT ON CL_PT_ENCOUNTER."CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID" = CL_VISIT_TYPE_AT."CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID" LEFT OUTER JOIN "IDB"."CL_VISIT_TYPE" AS CL_VISIT_TYPE_NV_IR ON CL_PT_ENCOUNTER."CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID" = CL_VISIT_TYPE_NV_IR."CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID" JOIN "IDB"."CL_DEPT" AS CL_DEPT_DEPT_NAME ON CL_PT_ENCOUNTER."CPE_DEPT_ID" = CL_DEPT_DEPT_NAME."CLD_DEPT_ID" JOIN "IDB"."CL_DEPT" AS CL_DEPT_DEPT ON CL_PT_ENCOUNTER."CPE_DEPT_ID" = CL_DEPT_DEPT."CLD_DEPT_ID" LEFT OUTER JOIN "IDB"."CL_CATEGORY" AS CL_CATEGORY_DPT_CAT ON CL_DEPT_DEPT."CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6" = CL_CATEGORY_DPT_CAT."CAV_ABBR" AND CL_CATEGORY_DPT_CAT."CAV_CATEGORY" = 'CLD_RPT_GRP_6' JOIN "IDB"."CL_RESOURCE" AS CL_RESOURCE_REF_PROV ON CL_PT_ENCOUNTER."CPE_REF_RES_ID" = CL_RESOURCE_REF_PROV."CRE_RES_ID" JOIN "IDB"."CL_DEPT" AS CL_DEPT_SVC ON CL_PT_ENCOUNTER."CPE_DEPT_ID" = CL_DEPT_SVC."CLD_DEPT_ID" LEFT OUTER JOIN "IDB"."CL_CATEGORY" AS CL_CATEGORY_SVC ON CL_DEPT_SVC."CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8" = CL_CATEGORY_SVC."CAV_ABBR" AND CL_CATEGORY_SVC."CAV_CATEGORY" = 'CLD_RPT_GRP_8' JOIN "IDB"."CL_DEPT" AS CL_DEPT_CENTER ON CL_PT_ENCOUNTER."CPE_DEPT_ID" = CL_DEPT_CENTER."CLD_DEPT_ID" LEFT OUTER JOIN "IDB"."CL_CATEGORY" AS CL_CATEGORY_CENTER ON CL_CATEGORY_CENTER."CAV_ABBR" = CL_DEPT_CENTER."CLD_CLD_CENTER" AND CL_CATEGORY_CENTER."CAV_CATEGORY" = 'CLD_CENTER' JOIN "IDB"."CL_RESOURCE" AS CL_RESOURCE_RES_TYPE ON CL_PT_ENCOUNTER."CPE_VST_RES_ID" = CL_RESOURCE_RES_TYPE."CRE_RES_ID" JOIN "IDB"."CL_RESOURCE" AS CL_RESOURCE_PROV ON CL_PT_ENCOUNTER."CPE_VST_RES_ID" = CL_RESOURCE_PROV."CRE_RES_ID" JOIN "IDB"."CL_VISIT_TYPE" AS CL_VISIT_TYPE_TH ON CL_PT_ENCOUNTER."CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID" = CL_VISIT_TYPE_TH."CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID" JOIN "IDB"."CL_DEPT" AS CL_DEPT_TH ON CL_PT_ENCOUNTER."CPE_DEPT_ID" = CL_DEPT_TH."CLD_DEPT_ID") SELECT DISTINCT DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS.PT_MRN AS MRN, APPOINTMENTS_COLUMNS.APPT_DATE AS APPT_DATE, APPOINTMENTS_COLUMNS.APPT_STATUS AS APPT_STATUS, APPOINTMENTS_COLUMNS.APPT_TYPE_NAME AS APPT_TYPE, APPOINTMENTS_COLUMNS.CSN_ID AS CSN_ID, APPOINTMENTS_COLUMNS.NV_VS_IR AS NEW_VISIT_INTERNAL_REF, APPOINTMENTS_COLUMNS.DEPT_NAME AS APPT_DEPARTMENT, APPOINTMENTS_COLUMNS.DEPARTMENT AS APPT_DEPARTMENT_GRP6, APPOINTMENTS_COLUMNS.REFERRING_PROV AS REFERRING_PROV, APPOINTMENTS_COLUMNS.SERVICE AS APPT_SERVICE_GRP8, APPOINTMENTS_COLUMNS.CENTER AS APPT_CENTER, APPOINTMENTS_COLUMNS.RESOURCE_TYPE AS APPT_RESOURCE_TYPE, APPOINTMENTS_COLUMNS.PROVIDER AS APPT_PROVIDER, APPOINTMENTS_COLUMNS.TELE_HEALTH AS APPT_TELE_HEALTH FROM KEYS LEFT OUTER JOIN DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS ON DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS.PT_DEID = KEYS.COHORT_PT_DEID LEFT OUTER JOIN APPOINTMENTS_COLUMNS ON APPOINTMENTS_COLUMNS.SUBJECT_ID = KEYS.COHORT_APPOINTMENTS_SUBJECT_ID;

prompt: Provide all CA 125 levels taken within 100 days after starting chemotherapy
completion: WITH OVARIAN_CANCER_DX_0 AS (SELECT DISTINCT TM_MRN AS MRN, TM_DX_DTE AS DX_DATE, TM_SITE_CD AS SITE_CODE, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_DESC FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.SEERGROUPING ON RECODE = DV.SEERF_ICDO(TM_SITE_CD, TM_HIST_CD) AND CATEGORY2 = 'Ovary' JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD WHERE 1=1 AND TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND TM_DX_DTE BETWEEN '1990-01-01' AND '2023-10-15' UNION SELECT CC_MRN AS MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS DX_DATE, CLM_CLSF_CD AS SITE_CODE, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_DESC FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.SEERGROUPING ON RECODE = MIN(DV.SEERF_ICD9(CLM_CLSF_CD), DV.SEERF_ICD10(CLM_CLSF_CD)) AND CATEGORY2 = 'Ovary' WHERE 1 = 1 AND CASE WHEN CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y' AND CC_PT_TYPE <> 'E' THEN 'Y' WHEN CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' AND YEAR(CC_EFF_DTE) < 2004 THEN 'Y' WHEN CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND YEAR(CC_EFF_DTE) < 2001 THEN 'Y' AND CC_EFF_DTE BETWEEN '1990-01-01' AND '2023-10-15' ELSE 'N' END = 'Y' GROUP BY CC_MRN, CLM_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK ), OVARIAN_CANCER_DX AS (SELECT OVARIAN_CANCER_DX_0.* , ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY MRN ORDER BY DX_DATE ASC) OC_RN FROM OVARIAN_CANCER_DX_0), COHORT AS (SELECT MRN, DX_DATE, SITE_CODE, SITE_DESC FROM OVARIAN_CANCER_DX WHERE OC_RN = 1 ) SELECT * FROM COHORT; , CHEMO AS (SELECT MRN, APR_START_DTE, APR_END_DTE, CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME FROM IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX_V JOIN COHORT ON MRN = APR_MRN WHERE 1 = 1 AND CDG_CHEMO_FLAG = 'Y' ), CHEMO_CA_125 AS (SELECT MRN, LR_PERFORMED_DTE, LR_TEST_NAME, LR_SUBTEST_NAME, LR_RESULT_VALUE, LTL_TEXT_RESULT, LR_ABNORMALITY_CD FROM IDB.LAB_RESULTS JOIN CHEMO ON MRN = LR_MRN AND LR_PERFORMED_DTE - APR_START_DTE BETWEEN 0 AND 100 LEFT JOIN IDB.LAB_TEXT_LINE ON LTL_RESULT_GUID = LR_RESULT_GUID WHERE LR_TEST_NAME = 'Cancer Antigen 125 (CA 125)' ) SELECT DISTINCT * FROM CHEMO_CA_125; SELECT DISTINCT LR_MRN, LR_PERFORMED_DTE, APR_START_DTE, LR_PERFORMED_DTE - APR_START_DTE DAYS_CHECK, LR_TEST_NAME, LR_RESULT_VALUE FROM CA_125 JOIN CHEMO ON APR_MRN = LR_MRN AND LR_PERFORMED_DTE - APR_START_DTE BETWEEN 0 AND 100 ORDER BY LR_MRN, LR_PERFORMED_DTE, APR_START_DTE, DAYS_CHECK

prompt: Update the current Location field/column to the location where the medication was given in report NRS14093  - Weekly PCA report for select nursing leaders. Requirements and query discussed with Galina Yusim.
completion: WITH FUTASK AS (SELECT PT_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, OOTO_ORD_GUID FU_ORDGUID , OO_VISIT_GUID, OCV_CURR_LOC CURR_LOCATION, OO_ORD_ID FU_ORDERID, OO_ORD_NAME ORDNAME, OU_DISPLAY_NAME ENTEREDBY, OOTO_ENTERED_DT FU_ENTERED_DT, OOTO_PERF_FROM_DT FU_PERF_FROM_DT, COALESCE(OOTO_1ST_SCHED_DT, OOTO_SCHED_DT) AS SCHEDULEDFOR , OOTO_GUID , OOTO_ORD_TSK_GUID ORD_TSK_GUID FROM IDB.OAS_ORD_TASK_OCCR JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON OOTO_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.OAS_TASK_USER_DATA ON OOTO_GUID = OTUD_TASK_OCC_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_ORDER ON OO_ORD_GUID = OOTO_ORD_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_CLIENT_VISIT ON OO_VISIT_GUID = OCV_VISIT_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_USER ON OOTO_ENT_PVDR_GUID = OU_USER_GUID WHERE OTUD_VALUE = 'Independent Check' AND OOTO_PERF_FROM_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT DATE - 7 DAY AND CURRENT DATE ) , PERF_LOCATION AS (SELECT OVL_MRN, OVL_VISIT_GUID, OVL_VISIT_LOC_GUID, OOTO_GUID TASK_GUID, ORD_TSK_GUID, OVL_EFF_DT, OVL_CHNG_DT , OL_LOC_NAME "PerformedAtLocation" FROM FUTASK JOIN IDB.OMS_VISIT_LOCATION A ON PT_MRN = OVL_MRN AND OO_VISIT_GUID = OVL_VISIT_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_LOCATION ON OVL_LOC_GUID = OL_LOC_GUID WHERE A.OVL_VISIT_LOC_GUID = (SELECT MAX(B.OVL_VISIT_LOC_GUID) FROM IDB.OMS_VISIT_LOCATION B WHERE A.OVL_VISIT_GUID = B.OVL_VISIT_GUID AND B.OVL_EFF_DT <= FU_PERF_FROM_DT) ) SELECT OOTO_MRN AS MRN, FU_ORDERID, ORDNAME, OOTO_STATUS_CD, CURR_LOCATION, "PerformedAtLocation", OU_DISPLAY_NAME AS "Primary PerformedBy", COALESCE(OOTO_1ST_SCHED_DT, OOTO_SCHED_DT) AS "ScheduledFor", OOTO_PERF_TO_DT AS "Primary PerformedAt", OOTO_ENTERED_DT AS "Primary EnteredAt", ENTEREDBY AS "IDC PerformedBy", FU_PERF_FROM_DT AS "IDC PerformedAt", FU_ENTERED_DT AS "IDC EnteredAt", TIMESTAMPDIFF(2, CHAR(FU_ENTERED_DT - OOTO_ENTERED_DT)) DIFF FROM FUTASK JOIN PERF_LOCATION LOC ON PT_MRN = OVL_MRN AND OO_VISIT_GUID = OVL_VISIT_GUID AND FUTASK.OOTO_GUID = TASK_GUID JOIN IDB.OAS_ORD_TASK_OCCR TSK0 ON OOTO_ORD_GUID = FU_ORDGUID AND UPPER(OOTO_STATUS_CD) = 'PERFORMED' AND SCHEDULEDFOR = OOTO_PERF_TO_DT JOIN IDB.OAS_TASK_USER_DATA ON OTUD_TASK_OCC_GUID = TSK0.OOTO_GUID AND OTUD_USER_DATA_CD = ('PCA_Yes_No') JOIN IDB.OMS_USER ON OOTO_PER_PVDR_GUID = OU_USER_GUID WHERE TIMESTAMPDIFF(2, CHAR(FU_ENTERED_DT - OOTO_ENTERED_DT)) > 659

prompt: Provide the total missed appointments for patients 15 - 39 years old seen in 2019
completion: WITH PATIENT AS (SELECT PT_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH FROM IDB.PATIENT P WHERE PT_MRN <> ''), ENCOUNTER AS (SELECT CPE_MRN, CPE_ENC_DTE, CPE_VST_RES_ID, CPE_CPE_APPT_STS, CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID, CPE_DEPT_ID FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER CPE WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('No Show', 'CxlSameDay') AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN '2019-01-01' AND '2019-12-31'), DEPT AS (SELECT CLD_DEPT_NAME, CLD_DEPT_ID, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 FROM IDB.CL_DEPT) SELECT PT_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, CPE_ENC_DTE, CLD_DEPT_NAME, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8, CPE_CPE_APPT_STS, YEAR (Date (CPE_ENC_DTE) - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) AS "Age", COUNT (CPE_CPE_APPT_STS) AS MISSED FROM ENCOUNTER AS E JOIN PATIENT AS P ON E.CPE_MRN = P.PT_MRN JOIN DEPT AS D ON E.CPE_DEPT_ID = D.CLD_DEPT_ID WHERE YEAR (Date (CPE_ENC_DTE) - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) BETWEEN '15' AND '39' GROUP BY PT_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, CPE_ENC_DTE, CLD_DEPT_NAME, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8, CPE_CPE_APPT_STS ORDER BY PT_MRN, CPE_ENC_DTE

completion: SELECT PT_MRN AS MRN , STRIP(PT_LAST_NAME)||', '||STRIP(PT_FIRST_NAME) AS PT_NAME , OO_ORD_NAME AS ORD_NAME , OO_ORD_ID ORD_ID, OO_ENTER_DTE AS ORD_ENTER_DTE, OO_ENTER_ROLE , ' ' ORD_OPTION FROM IDB.OMS_ORDER JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON OO_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID = '1000004324073029' AND OO_ACCT_NO like '84%' AND OO_ENTER_DTE BETWEEN '2010-01-01' AND '2010-12-31' AND OO_ORD_STS_CD NOT LIKE 'CAN%' AND OO_ORD_STS_CD <> 'PEND' UNION SELECT PT_MRN AS MRN , STRIP(PT_LAST_NAME)||', '||STRIP(PT_FIRST_NAME) AS PT_NAME , OO_ORD_NAME AS ORD_NAME , OO_ORD_ID ORD_ID, OO_ENTER_DTE AS ORD_ENTER_DTE, OO_ENTER_ROLE , CASE WHEN A.OUD_USER_DI_VALUE = '1' THEN 'Suicide Precautions' END ORD_OPTION FROM IDB.OMS_ORDER JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON OO_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_USER_DATA A ON A.OUD_ORD_GUID = OO_ORD_GUID AND A.OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'NSG_Suicide_Ckbx' AND A.OUD_USER_DI_VALUE = '1' WHERE OO_ENTER_DTE BETWEEN '2010-01-01' AND '2010-12-31' AND OO_ACCT_NO like '84%' AND OO_ORD_NAME = 'Companion at Bedside' AND OO_ORD_STS_CD NOT IN ('CANC', 'CANP') AND (A.OUD_USER_DI_VALUE = '1')

prompt: Provide list of total laryngectomy patients since October 2017 with chemo, radiation, and admission data.
completion: WITH LARYN_SURG AS (SELECT SSE_MRN, SSE_LOG_ID, SSE_SURG_DTE, SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD, SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC, SSP_SURG_LAST_NM, SSP_SURG_FIRST_NM, SSP_SURG_SVC_CD, VIS_ADM_NUM, VIS_ADM_DTE, VIS_DAYS_STAY, VIS_DSCH_DTE, SSP_PROC_SEQ_NO, SSP_PNL_NO FROM IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE ON SSE_LOG_ID = SSP_LOG_ID AND SSE_ENC_CSN_ID = SSP_ENC_CSN_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.VISIT_V ON VIS_MRN = SSE_MRN AND VIS_VISIT_STATUS IN ('2', '3') AND VIS_ADM_DTE <= SSE_SURG_DTE AND COALESCE(VIS_DSCH_DTE, '2999-12-31') >= SSE_SURG_DTE WHERE 1=1 AND (SSE_SURG_LOC not like '%IR%' AND SSE_SURG_LOC not like '%ENDO%' AND SSE_SOURCE_TYPE <> 'E') AND SSE_SURG_DTE >= '2017-10-01' AND ((SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD IN ('31360', '31365', '31390', '31395', '42999') OR SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC IN ('LARYNGECTOMY; SUBTOTAL SUPRAGLOTTIC, W/O RADICAL NECK DISSECTION')) AND SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC <> 'UNLISTED PROC, PHARYNX/ADENOIDS/TONSILS') ) , READMIT AS (SELECT UC_MRN, UC_TRANSFER_DTE, UC_HOSP_SVC, SSE_SURG_DTE, UC_CNG_TYPE FROM IDB.UNIFIED_CENSUS JOIN LARYN_SURG ON SSE_MRN = UC_MRN WHERE UC_CNG_TYPE = 'A' AND UC_TRANSFER_DTE BETWEEN SSE_SURG_DTE AND SSE_SURG_DTE + 2 MONTHS AND VIS_ADM_NUM <> UC_ADM_NUM AND UC_HOSP_SVC IN ('HNS', 'PRS') ) , PLA_SURG AS (SELECT A.SSE_MRN, A.SSE_LOG_ID, B.SSE_SURG_DTE, C.SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD, C.SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC, C.SSP_SURG_LAST_NM, C.SSP_SURG_FIRST_NM, C.SSP_SURG_SVC_CD, C.SSP_PROC_SEQ_NO, C.SSP_PNL_NO FROM LARYN_SURG A JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT B ON B.SSE_LOG_ID = A.SSE_LOG_ID JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE C ON B.SSE_LOG_ID = C.SSP_LOG_ID AND B.SSE_ENC_CSN_ID = C.SSP_ENC_CSN_ID WHERE 1=1 AND (B.SSE_SURG_LOC not like '%IR%' AND B.SSE_SURG_LOC not like '%ENDO%' AND B.SSE_SOURCE_TYPE <> 'E') AND C.SSP_SURG_SVC_CD = 'PLA' ) , RADONC AS (SELECT DISTINCT RTC_TX_MRN, MIN(RTC_TX_START_DTE) RTC_TX_START_DTE, RTC_TX_STOP_DTE, RTC_TX_PLAN_NAME FROM IDB.RADONC_TREATMENT_COURSE JOIN LARYN_SURG ON SSE_MRN = RTC_TX_MRN GROUP BY RTC_TX_MRN, RTC_TX_STOP_DTE, RTC_TX_PLAN_NAME) , CHEMO AS (SELECT DISTINCT APR_MRN CHEMO_MRN, APR_GENERIC_NAME CHEMO_GENERIC, MIN(APR_START_DTE) APR_START_DTE FROM IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX JOIN RADONC ON RTC_TX_MRN = APR_MRN WHERE APR_GENERIC_NAME IN('CISPLATIN') AND APR_START_DTE BETWEEN RTC_TX_START_DTE AND RTC_TX_STOP_DTE GROUP BY APR_MRN, APR_GENERIC_NAME ) SELECT DISTINCT A.SSE_MRN "MRN", PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH "DOB", A.SSE_SURG_DTE "Surgery Date", A.SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC "Laryngectomy", A.SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD, A.SSP_SURG_SVC_CD "Laryngectomy Service", B.SSP_SURG_SVC_CD "Plastic Service", CASE WHEN A.SSE_MRN IS NOT NULL AND B.SSE_MRN IS NOT NULL THEN 'Reconstruction Surgery' WHEN A.SSE_MRN IS NOT NULL AND B.SSE_MRN IS NULL THEN 'Primary Closure' END AS "Surgery Type", RTC_TX_START_DTE "Radiation Start Date", RTC_TX_PLAN_NAME "Radiation Plan Name", CASE WHEN RTC_TX_START_DTE < A.SSE_SURG_DTE THEN 'Rad Pre-surgery' WHEN RTC_TX_START_DTE > A.SSE_SURG_DTE THEN 'Rad Post-surgery' WHEN RTC_TX_START_DTE = A.SSE_SURG_DTE THEN 'Rad Same Day' ELSE NULL END AS "Radiation Details", CASE WHEN CHEMO_MRN IS NOT NULL THEN 'Chemo with Radiation' END AS "Chemo Details", CHEMO_GENERIC "Chemo Drug Name", APR_START_DTE "Chemo Start Date", CASE WHEN A.SSE_SURG_DTE < RTC_TX_START_DTE AND A.SSE_SURG_DTE < APR_START_DTE THEN 'Primary Surgery' WHEN A.SSE_SURG_DTE > RTC_TX_START_DTE OR A.SSE_SURG_DTE > APR_START_DTE THEN 'Salvage Surgery' ELSE 'Primary Surgery' END AS "Salvage vs Primary Surgery", VIS_DAYS_STAY "LOS (Days)", UC_TRANSFER_DTE "Readmit Date", UC_HOSP_SVC "Readmit Service" FROM LARYN_SURG A LEFT JOIN PLA_SURG B ON A.SSE_LOG_ID = B.SSE_LOG_ID LEFT JOIN RADONC C ON A.SSE_MRN = C.RTC_TX_MRN LEFT JOIN CHEMO D ON A.SSE_MRN = D.CHEMO_MRN LEFT JOIN READMIT R ON A.SSE_MRN = UC_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON A.SSE_MRN = PT_MRN

prompt: Identify patients with gastric or gastro-esophageal (GE junction) cancer who had pre-operative chemotherapy and surgery, and further identify those had a pathologic complete response after surgery versus those who had residual tumor on their pathology specimens.
completion: SELECT PT_MRN AS MRN, PT_LAST_NAME AS "Last Name", PT_FIRST_NAME AS "First Name", TM_DX_DTE AS "Tumor Dx Date", TM_HIST_CD AS "ICD-O Histology Code", H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS "ICD-O Histology Desc", TM_SITE_CD AS "ICD-O Site Code", S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS "ICD-O Site Desc", TM_SYST_STRT_DTE AS "Chemo Start Date", CASE WHEN TM_CHEM_SUM_MSK = '00' THEN 'N' WHEN TM_CHEM_SUM_MSK = '' THEN '' ELSE 'Y' END AS "Chemo at MSK", TM_CA_SURG_DTE AS "Cancer Surgery Date", CASE WHEN TM_CA_SURG_03_MSK = '00' THEN 'N' WHEN TM_CA_SURG_03_MSK = '' THEN '' ELSE 'Y' END AS "Surgery at MSK", AV_DESC AS "Class of Case", TM_PATH_TNM_T AS "Pathologic TNM T" FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON TM_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS ON AV_ELEMENT = 'CLASS_OF_CASE' AND AV_CODE = TM_CLASS_OF_CASE WHERE TM_CASE_STS = '3' AND TM_DX_DTE >= '1995-01-01' AND TM_SITE_CD BETWEEN 'C160' AND 'C169' AND TM_HIST_CD IN ('M8010/3', 'M8021/3', 'M8140/3', 'M8144/3', 'M8145/3', 'M8211/3', 'M8255/3', 'M8260/3', 'M8480/3', 'M8481/3', 'M8490/3', 'M8560/3', 'M8574/3') AND TM_SYST_STRT_DTE < TM_CA_SURG_DTE

prompt: To provide a one time list of all patients at MSKCC with diagnosis of primary cancer of the trachea from earliest available date to present day.
completion: WITH DX AS (SELECT TM_MRN AS DX_MRN, TM_DX_DTE AS DX_DATE, TM_SITE_CD AS DX_CODE, TM_HIST_CD, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS DX_DESC FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM H ON TM_HIST_CD = H.CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON TM_SITE_CD = S.CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND TM_SITE_CD LIKE 'C33%' AND TM_DX_DTE BETWEEN '1980-01-01' AND CURRENT DATE UNION SELECT CC_MRN AS DX_MRN, (MIN(CC_EFF_DTE)) AS DX_DATE, CLM_CLSF_CD AS DX_CODE, '' AS TM_HIST_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS DX_DESC FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE CC_CLSF_CD IN ('D02.1', 'D38.1', 'C33') AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND ((CC_PT_TYPE = 'I') OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) GROUP BY CC_MRN, CLM_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK HAVING MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) BETWEEN '1980-01-01' AND CURRENT DATE), COHORT AS (SELECT DISTINCT DX_MRN , DX_DATE , DX_CODE , TM_HIST_CD , DX_DESC FROM (SELECT DISTINCT DX_MRN , DX_DATE , DX_CODE , DX_DESC , TM_HIST_CD , ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY DX_MRN ORDER BY DX_DATE ASC) AS RN FROM DX) WHERE RN = 1 ) SELECT * FROM COHORT

prompt: I would like to add an additional component to the already established tele dashboard: NRS18498. I would like to look at duration of time that patients are on telemetry and understand patient flow.
completion: SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN AS MRN, TEL_DT "Telemetry Time", MAX(CASE WHEN CARDS_MRN IS NOT NULL AND TIMESTAMPDIFF(4, CHAR("Cards Consult Start" - TEL_DT)) <= 1440 THEN TEL_DT ELSE NULL END) "Telemetry Time Prior to Consult", OSTS_STS_DESC "Telemetry Discontinuation", OO_STOP_DT "Telemetry Stop Date", MAX("Cards Consult Name") "Cards Consult Name", MAX("Cards Consult Start") "Cards Consult Start", ROW_NUMBER () OVER(PARTITION BY PT_MRN, TEL_DT) AS TEL_ORD_RN FROM IDB.PATIENT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT CDD_MRN AS T_MRN, CDD_SERVICE_DT AS TEL_DT FROM IDB.CD_DOCUMENT JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION ON CDD_DOC_GUID = CDO_DOC_GUID AND CDD_AUTHORED_DTE = CDO_AUTHORED_DTE JOIN IDB.OMS_PROVIDER ON CDD_AUTH_PROV_GUID = OP_PVDR_GUID WHERE CDD_CANCEL_IND <> '1' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND <> '1' AND CDD_DOC_NAME = 'Telemetry Review - Cardiology' AND CDD_SERVICE_DTE >= '2018-06-01' ) TELEMETRY ON PT_MRN = T_MRN LEFT JOIN (SELECT CDD_MRN AS CARDS_MRN, CDD_DOC_NAME "Cards Consult Name", CDD_CREATE_DT "Cards Consult Start" FROM IDB.CD_DOCUMENT JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION ON CDD_DOC_GUID = CDO_DOC_GUID AND CDD_AUTHORED_DTE = CDO_AUTHORED_DTE JOIN IDB.OMS_PROVIDER ON CDD_AUTH_PROV_GUID = OP_PVDR_GUID WHERE CDD_CANCEL_IND <> '1' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND <> '1' AND CDD_DOC_NAME IN ('Initial Consult/Initial Visit, IP - DOM-Cardiology', 'Initial Consult/Initial Visit, NP/PA, IP - DOM-Cardiology', 'Initial Consultation - Cardiology', 'Initial Consultation - PED-Cardiology', 'Initial Consultation, IP - Cardiology', 'Initial Consultation, IP - Cardiology-NP', 'Initial Consultation, IP - Cardiology-PA') ) CARDS ON PT_MRN = CARDS_MRN AND "Cards Consult Start" >= TEL_DT AND TIMESTAMPDIFF(4, CHAR("Cards Consult Start" - TEL_DT)) <= 1440 LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT OO_MRN, OOC_ITEM_NAME, OOC_ITEM_DESC, OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE, OSTS_STS_DESC, OO_ENTER_DT, OO_STOP_DT FROM IDB.OMS_ORDER JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_CATALOG ON OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID = OOC_MSTR_ITEM_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_STATUS ON OO_ORD_STS_CD = OSTS_ORD_STS_CD WHERE 1 = 1 AND UPPER(OOC_ITEM_NAME) LIKE '%TELEMETRY%' AND OO_ORD_STS_CD NOT IN ('CANP', 'CANC', 'AUC3') AND OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE >= '2018-06-01' AND OOC_ITEM_NAME NOT IN ('JRSC Telemetry Monitoring', 'Telemetry May be Off for Procedure/Tests') ORDER BY OO_MRN) DISC ON PT_MRN = OO_MRN AND OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE >= DATE(TEL_DT) GROUP BY PT_MRN, TEL_DT, OSTS_STS_DESC, OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE ORDER BY PT_MRN

URGENT request CRR is due, I would need this report by Friday 6/2 the latest



MRN, Gender, Race, ethnicity of patients with a consent discussion form, where Protocol/Treatment plan: 20-296 (verbal consent) for this BRP
completion: SELECT CDD_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_SEX, R.AV_DESC AS RACE, E.AV_DESC AS ETHNICITY, CDO_ITEM_NAME, CDO_VALUE_TEXT FROM IDB.CD_DOCUMENT JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION ON CDD_DOC_GUID = CDO_DOC_GUID JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON CDD_MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS R ON PT_RACE = R.AV_CODE AND R.AV_ELEMENT = 'RACE' LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS E ON PT_PT_ETHNICITY = E.AV_CODE AND E.AV_ELEMENT = 'PT_ETHNICITY' WHERE CDD_DOC_NAME = 'Consent Discussion, Treatment/Protocol' AND CDO_ITEM_NAME = 'CONSENT DISCUSSION: TREATMENT PLAN/PROTOCOL' AND CDO_VALUE_TEXT like '%20-296%' AND CDD_CANCEL_IND <> '1' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND <> '1' AND CDD_SERVICE_DTE >= '2020-01-01'

prompt: Create a weekly report of all scheduled surgical cases for patients with a primary dx of prostate cancer.
completion: SELECT DISTINCT OC_MRN AS MRN, RTRIM(CL_LAST_NAME)||', '||RTRIM(CL_FIRST_NAME) AS PATIENT_NAME, YEAR(CURRENT DATE - CL_DATE_OF_BIRTH) AS AGE, OC_SURG_DTE AS SURG_DATE, RTRIM(CPX_PROC_CD)||' - '||RTRIM(CPX_PROC_NAME) AS PROCEDURE, RTRIM(CRE_RES_NAME) AS SURGEON, OCAS_SURG_SVC AS SERVICE FROM IDB.OR_CASE JOIN IDB.CL_PATIENT ON OC_MRN = CL_MRN JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT CLSF_MRN FROM IDB.CLSF WHERE CLSF_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND CLSF_CLSF_CD = '185') CLSF ON CLSF_MRN = CL_MRN JOIN IDB.OR_CASE_ALL_PROC ON OC_CASE_ID = OCAP_CASE_ID JOIN IDB.OR_CASE_ALL_SURG ON OCAP_CASE_ID = OCAS_CASE_ID JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON OCAS_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.OR_PROC ON OCAP_OR_PROC_ID = OP_OR_PROC_ID JOIN IDB.OR_CL_PROC ON OP_OR_PROC_ID = OCP_OR_PROC_ID JOIN IDB.CL_PROC ON OCP_PROC_ID = CPX_PROC_ID WHERE OC_OR_CASE_STS_CD NOT IN ('2', '5') AND CPX_PROC_CD BETWEEN '10000' AND '69999' AND OC_SURG_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT DATE AND CURRENT DATE + 7 DAY AND OCAS_SURG_ROLE = 'Primary'

prompt: We are looking for information about what percentage of MSK patients are seen at main campus (NYC) and all regional sites. We would also like the demographic breakdown data on them as a whole.
completion: WITH P AS (SELECT CPE_MRN , CPE_ENC_DTE , CASE WHEN CTR.CAV_CODE IN ('7', '9', '17', '23', '31', '34', '35', '39', '42') THEN 'REGIONAL' ELSE 'MAIN' END SITE FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER A JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_CATEGORY CTR ON CTR.CAV_CATEGORY = 'CLD_CENTER' AND CTR.CAV_ABBR = CLD_CLD_CENTER WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND YEAR(CPE_ENC_DTE) = 2019 ) , TX AS (SELECT MRN , MIN(MIN_DTE) MIN_DTE FROM (SELECT APR_MRN MRN , MIN(APR_START_DTE) MIN_DTE FROM IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX_V JOIN P ON CPE_MRN = APR_MRN WHERE YEAR(APR_START_DTE) = 2019 GROUP BY APR_MRN UNION ALL SELECT MRN , MIN(SVC_DTE) MIN_DTE FROM IDB.RADIATION_CHARGES_V JOIN P ON CPE_MRN = MRN WHERE YEAR(SVC_DTE) = 2019 GROUP BY MRN UNION ALL SELECT SSE_MRN MRN , MIN(SSE_SURG_DTE) MIN_DTE FROM IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT JOIN P ON CPE_MRN = SSE_MRN WHERE YEAR(SSE_SURG_DTE) = 2019 GROUP BY SSE_MRN ) GROUP BY MRN) , PTS AS (SELECT P.* FROM P JOIN TX ON MRN = CPE_MRN AND MIN_DTE = CPE_ENC_DTE) , DEMO AS (SELECT PT_MRN, CASE WHEN COALESCE(R.AV_DESC, CR.AV_DESC) IN ('WHITE', 'WHITE HISPANIC') THEN 'White' WHEN COALESCE(R.AV_DESC, CR.AV_DESC) IN ('BLACK OR AFRICAN AMERICAN', 'BLACK', 'BLACK HISPANIC') THEN 'Black' WHEN COALESCE(R.AV_DESC, CR.AV_DESC) IN ('ASIAN-FAR EAST/INDIAN SUBCONT', 'KAMPUCHEAN', 'LAOTIAN', 'VIETNAMESE', 'HMONG', 'CHINESE', 'ASIAN INDIAN PAKISTANI', 'JAPANESE', 'KOREAN', 'OTHER ASIAN', 'THAI') THEN 'Asian' WHEN COALESCE(R.AV_DESC, CR.AV_DESC) IN ('NATIVE AMERICAN-AM IND/ALASKA', 'AMER IND ALEUT ESKIMO') THEN 'Native American or Alaska Native' WHEN COALESCE(R.AV_DESC, CR.AV_DESC) IN ('NATIVE HAWAIIAN OR PACIFIC ISL', 'HAWAIIAN', 'MELANESIAN', 'MICRONESIAN', 'FIJI ISLANDER', 'FILIPINO', 'GUAMANIAN', 'PACIFIC ISLANDER') THEN 'Native Hawaiian or Other Pacific Islander' ELSE 'Unspecified' END AS PT_RACE, CASE WHEN COALESCE(CE.AV_DESC, E.AV_DESC) IN ('SPANISH NOS; HISPANIC NOS, LATINO NOS', 'HISPANIC OR LATINO', 'PUERTO RICAN', 'SOUTH/CENTRAL AMERICA (EXCEPT BRAZIL)', 'DOMINICAN REPUBLIC', 'OTHER SPANISH/HISPANIC(INCL EUROPEAN; EXCL DOM REP)', 'CUBAN', 'MEXICAN (INCLUDES CHICANO)') OR COALESCE(R.AV_DESC, CR.AV_DESC) IN ('WHITE HISPANIC', 'BLACK HISPANIC') THEN 'Hispanic' WHEN COALESCE(CE.AV_DESC, E.AV_DESC) IN ('NOT HISPANIC', 'SPANISH SURNAME ONLY', 'NON-SPANISH; NON-HISPANIC') THEN 'Non-Hispanic' ELSE 'Unspecified' END AS PT_ETHNICITY, PT_SEX, 2019 - YEAR(PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) AGE, PT_STATE, L.AV_DESC LANGUAGE FROM IDB.PATIENT JOIN PTS ON PT_MRN = CPE_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS R ON R.AV_ELEMENT = 'RACE' AND R.AV_CODE = PT_RACE LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS E ON E.AV_ELEMENT = 'PT_ETHNICITY' AND E.AV_CODE = PT_PT_ETHNICITY LEFT JOIN IDB.CDB_PATIENT ON PT_MRN = CP_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS CR ON CR.AV_ELEMENT = 'CDB_RACE' AND CR.AV_CODE = CP_CDB_RACE LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS CE ON CE.AV_ELEMENT = 'ETHNICITY' AND CE.AV_CODE = CP_ETHNICITY JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS L ON L.AV_ELEMENT = 'PRIMARY_LANG' AND L.AV_CODE = PT_PRIMARY_LANG) SELECT SITE , PT_RACE RACE , PT_ETHNICITY ETHNICITY , PT_SEX SEX , AGE , LANGUAGE , CASE WHEN PT_STATE IN ('NY', 'NJ', 'CT') THEN 'NY/NJ/CT' ELSE 'OTHER STATES/COUNTRIES' END AS RESIDENCE , COUNT(DISTINCT CPE_MRN) AS COUNT FROM PTS JOIN DEMO ON CPE_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE AGE >= 18 GROUP BY SITE , PT_RACE , PT_ETHNICITY , PT_SEX , AGE , LANGUAGE , CASE WHEN PT_STATE IN ('NY', 'NJ', 'CT') THEN 'NY/NJ/CT' ELSE 'OTHER STATES/COUNTRIES' END

prompt: Lab Result details for the list of Patients who had Streptococcus Pneumoniae test in the past week.
completion: WITH LAB AS (SELECT DISTINCT LR_MRN LAB_MRN, LR_PERFORMED_DTE LAB_TEST_DATE , TRIM(PT_LAST_NAME) || ', ' || TRIM(PT_FIRST_NAME) AS PATIENT_NAME FROM IDB.LAB_RESULTS JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PT_MRN = LR_MRN WHERE LR_TEST_NAME = 'Streptococcus Pneumoniae AG (URINE)' AND LR_SUBTEST_NAME = 'Streptococcus Pneumoniae AG (URINE)' AND LR_PERFORMED_DTE >= CURRENT date - 7 DAYS ) SELECT DISTINCT LR_MRN AS MRN, PATIENT_NAME, TRIM(LR_TEST_NAME) AS LAB_TEST_NAME, LR_PERFORMED_DTE AS MRSA_TEST_DATE, CASE WHEN SUBSTR(LTL_TEXT_RESULT, 1, 12) LIKE 'Detected%' THEN 'Detected' WHEN SUBSTR(LTL_TEXT_RESULT, 1, 12) LIKE 'Not Detected%' THEN 'Not Detected' ELSE '' END AS LAB_RESULT FROM IDB.LAB_RESULTS LR JOIN LAB ON LAB_MRN = LR_MRN AND LR_PERFORMED_DTE BETWEEN LAB_TEST_DATE - 7 DAYS AND LAB_TEST_DATE + 7 DAYS LEFT JOIN IDB.LAB_TEXT_LINE TL1 ON TL1.LTL_RESULT_GUID = LR.LR_RESULT_GUID WHERE LR_TEST_NAME = 'MRSA Surveillance DNA Qualitative Nose' ; WITH LAB AS (SELECT DISTINCT LR_MRN LAB_MRN, LR_PERFORMED_DTE LAB_TEST_DATE , TRIM(PT_LAST_NAME) || ', ' || TRIM(PT_FIRST_NAME) AS PATIENT_NAME FROM IDB.LAB_RESULTS JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PT_MRN = LR_MRN WHERE LR_TEST_NAME = 'Streptococcus Pneumoniae AG (URINE)' AND LR_SUBTEST_NAME = 'Streptococcus Pneumoniae AG (URINE)' AND LR_PERFORMED_DTE >= CURRENT date - 7 DAYS ) SELECT VIS_MRN AS MRN, PATIENT_NAME AS "Patient Name", LAB_TEST_DATE AS "Lab Test Date", VIS_ADM_DT AS "Admission Date", VIS_DSCH_DT AS "Discharge Date", OCV_CURR_LOC AS "Admission Location", OCV_VISIT_STS AS "Visit Status", S.AV_DESC AS "Hospital Service" FROM IDB.VISIT JOIN LAB ON LAB_MRN = VIS_MRN AND VIS_ADM_DTE BETWEEN LAB_TEST_DATE - 7 DAYS AND LAB_TEST_DATE + 30 DAYS JOIN IDB.OMS_CLIENT_VISIT ON OCV_ADM_NUM = VIS_ADM_NUM LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS S ON S.AV_ELEMENT = 'HOSP_SVC' AND S.AV_CODE = VIS_HOSP_SVC ;

prompt: Identify all sarcoma patients treated with immune checkpoint blockade therapy over past 10 years
completion: WITH VST AS (SELECT CPE_MRN VST_MRN, MIN(CPE_ENC_DTE) MIN_VST_DATE, MAX(CPE_ENC_DTE) MAX_VST_DTE, COUNT(*) CNT FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID = CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT VD ON CPE_DEPT_ID = VD.CLD_DEPT_ID AND VD.CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 = 'SAR' JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE VT ON VT.CRE_RES_ID = CPE_VST_RES_ID AND VT.CRE_RES_TYP IN ('Physician', 'Dentist', 'Psychologist', 'PhD', 'Nurse Practitioner', 'Physician Assistant', 'Advanced Practice Nurse') AND VT.CRE_RES_ID IN ('027862', '016550', '016378', '015818', '083469', '016642', '082313', '022715', '011957', '029868', '025023', '025346', '026617', '082800', '016071', '026625') WHERE CPE_ENC_DTE >= '2003-01-01' AND CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Comp', 'Arrived') AND CPE_ENC_TYP_CD = 50 GROUP BY CPE_MRN HAVING COUNT(*) > 2) , DX AS (SELECT VST_MRN AS MCC_MRN FROM VST JOIN IDB.CDB_TUMOR ON TM_MRN = VST_MRN WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND TM_HIST_CD = 'M8247/3' UNION SELECT VST_MRN AS MCC_MRN FROM VST JOIN IDB.CTC_CLSF ON CC_MRN = VST_MRN WHERE CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND CASE WHEN CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y' THEN 'Y' WHEN CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' AND YEAR(CC_EFF_DTE) < 2004 THEN 'Y' WHEN CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND YEAR(CC_EFF_DTE) < 2001 THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END = 'Y' AND CC_CLSF_CD IN ('209.31', '209.32', '209.33', '209.34', '209.35', '209.36', 'C4A.0', 'C4A.10', 'C4A.11', 'C4A.12', 'C4A.20', 'C4A.21', 'C4A.22', 'C4A.30', 'C4A.31', 'C4A.39', 'C4A.4', 'C4A.60', 'C4A.61', 'C4A.62', 'C4A.70', 'C4A.71', 'C4A.72', 'C4A.51', 'C4A.52', 'C4A.59', 'C4A.8', 'C4A.9') ) , CHM AS (SELECT APR_MRN CHM_MRN, MIN(APR_START_DTE) AS MIN_CHM_DTE FROM IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX_V JOIN VST ON APR_MRN = VST_MRN LEFT JOIN DX ON APR_MRN = MCC_MRN WHERE 1=1 AND MCC_MRN IS NULL AND LOWER(APR_DIAGNOSIS_DESC) NOT LIKE '%mer%kel%' AND APR_DIAGNOSIS_DESC NOT LIKE '%MCC%' AND (CDG_IMMUNOTHERAPY_FLAG = 'Y' OR CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME = 'RELATLIMAB') GROUP BY APR_MRN HAVING MIN(APR_START_DTE) >= '1/1/2013') , FNL AS (SELECT APR_MRN MRN, PT_LAST_NAME LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME FIRST_NAME, PT_SEX GENDER, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH DOB, PT_DATE_OF_DEATH DATE_OF_DEATH, PT_LAST_KNOWN_ALIVE_DTE LAST_KNOWN_ALIVE_DTE, PLA_LST_CON_DTE LST_CON_DTE, CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME GENERIC_NAME, APR_SET_NAME IRB_NO, MIN(APR_START_DTE) MIN_START_DATE, MAX(APR_START_DTE) MAX_START_DATE, MAX(CASE WHEN APR_SET_NAME LIKE '%IRB%' THEN 'Y' END) IRB_FLAG , ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY APR_MRN ORDER BY MIN(APR_START_DTE), CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME) RN FROM CHM JOIN IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX_V ON CHM_MRN = APR_MRN JOIN IDB.CHEMO_PERFORMED_ORDERS ON CPO_PERFORMED_ORDERS_ID = APR_ORDER_SOURCE_ID AND APR_ORDER_SOURCE = 'CPO' JOIN IDB.CHEMO_VERIFICATIONS ON CPO_ORD_GUID = CV_ORD_GUID JOIN IDB.PATIENT_V ON APR_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY ON PLA_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE 1=1 AND APR_START_DTE >= '1/1/2013' AND LOWER(APR_DIAGNOSIS_DESC) NOT LIKE '%mer%kel%' AND APR_DIAGNOSIS_DESC NOT LIKE '%MCC%' AND LOWER(APR_DIAGNOSIS_DESC) NOT LIKE '%Melanoma%' AND(CDG_IMMUNOTHERAPY_FLAG = 'Y' OR CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME = 'RELATLIMAB') AND CV_VER_ATN_NO IN ('027862', '016550', '016378', '015818', '083469', '016642', '082313', '022715', '011957', '029868', '025023', '025346', '026617', '082800', '016071', '026625') GROUP BY APR_MRN, CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_SEX, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, PT_DATE_OF_DEATH, PT_LAST_KNOWN_ALIVE_DTE, APR_SET_NAME, PLA_LST_CON_DTE) SELECT MRN, LAST_NAME, FIRST_NAME, GENDER, DOB, DATE_OF_DEATH DOD, LAST_KNOWN_ALIVE_DTE, LST_CON_DTE , YEAR(MIN(MIN_START_DATE) - DOB) AGE_AT_FIRST_TX , MAX(CASE WHEN RN = 1 THEN GENERIC_NAME END) GENERIC1 , MAX(CASE WHEN RN = 1 THEN MIN_START_DATE END) MIN_START_DTE1 , MAX(CASE WHEN RN = 1 THEN MAX_START_DATE END) MAX_START_DTE1 , MAX(CASE WHEN RN = 1 THEN IRB_FLAG END) IRB_FLAG1 , MAX(CASE WHEN RN = 1 THEN IRB_NO END) IRB_NO1 , MAX(CASE WHEN RN = 2 THEN GENERIC_NAME END) GENERIC2 , MAX(CASE WHEN RN = 2 THEN MIN_START_DATE END) MIN_START_DTE2 , MAX(CASE WHEN RN = 2 THEN MAX_START_DATE END) MAX_START_DTE2 , MAX(CASE WHEN RN = 2 THEN IRB_FLAG END) IRB_FLAG2 , MAX(CASE WHEN RN = 2 THEN IRB_NO END) IRB_NO2 , MAX(CASE WHEN RN = 3 THEN GENERIC_NAME END) GENERIC3 , MAX(CASE WHEN RN = 3 THEN MIN_START_DATE END) MIN_START_DTE3 , MAX(CASE WHEN RN = 3 THEN MAX_START_DATE END) MAX_START_DTE3 , MAX(CASE WHEN RN = 3 THEN IRB_FLAG END) IRB_FLAG3 , MAX(CASE WHEN RN = 3 THEN IRB_NO END) IRB_NO3 , MAX(CASE WHEN RN = 4 THEN GENERIC_NAME END) GENERIC4 , MAX(CASE WHEN RN = 4 THEN MIN_START_DATE END) MIN_START_DTE4 , MAX(CASE WHEN RN = 4 THEN MAX_START_DATE END) MAX_START_DTE4 , MAX(CASE WHEN RN = 4 THEN IRB_FLAG END) IRB_FLAG4 , MAX(CASE WHEN RN = 4 THEN IRB_NO END) IRB_NO4 FROM FNL GROUP BY MRN, LAST_NAME, FIRST_NAME, GENDER, DOB, DATE_OF_DEATH, LAST_KNOWN_ALIVE_DTE, LST_CON_DTE, IRB_NO

prompt: Provide a report of patients prescribed zanubrutinib who had at least 2 testing instances of the ‘COVID-19 Spike Protein AntiBODY IgG’ testing with at least one positive
completion: WITH APR AS (SELECT DISTINCT APR_MRN, CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME, APR_DRUG_NAME, APR_START_DTE, APR_END_DTE, APR_ROUTE, APR_ORD_RX_TYPE FROM IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX_V WHERE 1=1 AND(UPPER(CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME) LIKE '%ZANUBRUTINIB%' OR UPPER(APR_GENERIC_NAME) LIKE '%ZANUBRUTINIB%' OR UPPER(APR_DRUG_NAME) LIKE '%ZANUBRUTINIB%') ) , LABS AS (SELECT DISTINCT LR_MRN AS MRN, LR_PERFORMED_DTE AS PERFORMED_DTE, LR_TEST_NAME AS TEST_NAME, LR_SUBTEST_NAME AS SUBTEST_NAME, LEFT(LTL_TEXT_RESULT, 8) AS TEXT_RESULT FROM APR JOIN IDB.LAB_RESULTS ON APR_MRN = LR_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.LAB_TEXT_LINE ON LTL_RESULT_GUID = LR_RESULT_GUID WHERE 1=1 AND LR_PERFORMED_DTE >= '2020-01-01' AND(LR_TEST_NAME IN ('COVID-19 Spike Protein AntiBODY IgG') OR LR_SUBTEST_NAME IN ('COVID-19 Spike Protein AntiBODY IgG')) AND(UPPER(LTL_TEXT_RESULT) like 'NEGATIVE%' OR UPPER(LTL_TEXT_RESULT) like 'POSITIVE%' OR UPPER(LTL_TEXT_RESULT) like 'NOT DETECT%' OR UPPER(LTL_TEXT_RESULT) like 'DETECT%') ) , Y1 AS (SELECT MRN, COUNT(*) AS LAB_COUNT FROM LABS GROUP BY MRN HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2) , Y2 AS (SELECT * FROM LABS WHERE UPPER(TEXT_RESULT) like 'POSITIVE%' OR UPPER(TEXT_RESULT) like 'DETECT%' ) , Z AS (SELECT DISTINCT LABS.* FROM LABS WHERE MRN IN (SELECT MRN FROM Y1) AND MRN IN (SELECT MRN FROM Y2) ) , AC AS (SELECT MRN, MAX(CASE WHEN AC_IRB_NO = '06-107' THEN 'Y' END) AS "06-107", MAX(CASE WHEN AC_IRB_NO = '12-245' THEN 'Y' END) AS "12-245", MAX(CASE WHEN AC_IRB_NO = '09-141' THEN 'Y' END) AS "09-141" FROM (SELECT DISTINCT MRN FROM Z) ZZ JOIN IDB.ACCRUALS ON MRN = AC_MRN WHERE AC_IRB_NO IN ('06-107', '12-245', '09-141') GROUP BY MRN ) , DX AS (SELECT DISTINCT TM_MRN AS MRN, TM_DX_DTE AS DX_DATE, TM_HIST_CD AS DX_CODE, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS DX_DESC FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.SEERGROUPING ON RECODE = DV.SEERF_ICDO(TM_SITE_CD, TM_HIST_CD) AND CATEGORY1 IN ('Lymphoma', 'Leukemia', 'Myeloma') JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD WHERE 1=1 AND TM_MRN IN (SELECT DISTINCT MRN FROM Z) AND TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') UNION SELECT CC_MRN AS MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS DX_DATE, CLM_CLSF_CD AS DX_CODE, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS DX_DESC FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND ((CC_PT_TYPE = 'I') OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) AND(CC_CLSF_CD BETWEEN 'C81' AND 'C96.99' OR CC_CLSF_CD BETWEEN '200' AND '208.99') AND CC_MRN IN (SELECT DISTINCT MRN FROM Z) GROUP BY CC_MRN, CLM_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK ) , DX2 AS (SELECT MRN, LISTAGG(COALESCE(STRIP(CAST(DX_DATE AS VARCHAR(12000))), '') || ' | ' || COALESCE(STRIP(CAST(DX_CODE AS VARCHAR(12000))), '') || ' - ' || COALESCE(STRIP(CAST(DX_DESC AS VARCHAR(12000))), '') , CHR(13) || CHR(10)) WITHIN GROUP( ORDER BY MRN, DX_DATE) AS HIST FROM DX GROUP BY MRN) SELECT DISTINCT Z.MRN, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH AS DOB, HIST, PERFORMED_DTE, TEST_NAME, SUBTEST_NAME, TEXT_RESULT, "06-107", "12-245", "09-141" FROM Z JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON Z.MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN DX2 ON Z.MRN = DX2.MRN LEFT JOIN AC ON Z.MRN = AC.MRN

prompt:
We would like the same identifiers used in the referenced MED23233 project for the following studies:

-18-528

-19-408

-19-471



MED23233 was focused on two investigators- Drs. Chow and Schoenfeld. However, for this request, we would like to expand the request to any individual who performed a protocol-related activity.
completion: WITH ORDERS_INFO AS (SELECT DISTINCT OO_MRN AS MRN, AC_CONS_DTE, AC_PVDR_OF_RECORD_NAME, AC_CONS_STAFF_NAME, AC_CR_DTE, OO_ENTER_DT AS "Enter DT", OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE AS "Significant Date", STRIP(OO_ORD_NAME) AS "Order Name", OO_SET_NAME AS "Set Name", OO_ORD_STS_CD AS "Order Status", OO_ORD_PRIO AS "Priority", OO_ORD_TYPE_CD, OUO_ORG_NAME, OUO_REV_CAT_DEPT, OO_SUMMARY_LINE AS "Summary Line", OUO_ATN_PVDR_NAME AS "Attending Name", OUO_PVDR_NAME AS "Provider Name", OUO_PVDR_ROLE_TYPE AS "Provider Role", OUO_USER_NAME AS "User Name", OUO_USER_ROLE_TYPE AS "User Role", OCV_CURR_LOC AS "Current Location", OO_ORD_ID AS "Order ID", OO_ORD_GUID AS "Order GUID" FROM IDB.OMS_ORDER OO JOIN IDB.ACCRUALS ON AC_MRN = OO_MRN AND AC_IRB_NO = '19-471' JOIN IDB.OMS_PROVIDER ON OO.OO_PVDR_GUID = OP_PVDR_GUID JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON OO_MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_USER_ORDERS OUO ON OO_ORD_GUID = OUO_ORD_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_CLIENT_VISIT ON OO_VISIT_GUID = OCV_VISIT_GUID WHERE OO_ORD_STS_CD NOT IN ('CANC', 'CANP', 'AUC3') AND OO.OO_ENTER_DTE >= '12/18/2019' ) SELECT * FROM ORDERS_INFO ORDER BY 1, 2, 3, 4 ; WITH CLINDOC_INFO AS (SELECT CDD_MRN AS MRN, CDD_SERVICE_DTE, CDD_SIGNED_DTE, CDD_DOC_NAME, OP_DISPLAY_NAME AS AUTHOR, CDD_DOC_GUID , AC_CONS_DTE, AC_PVDR_OF_RECORD_NAME, AC_CONS_STAFF_NAME, AC_CR_DTE FROM IDB.CD_DOCUMENT JOIN IDB.ACCRUALS ON AC_MRN = CDD_MRN AND AC_IRB_NO = '19-471' JOIN IDB.OMS_PROVIDER ON CDD_AUTH_PROV_GUID = OP_PVDR_GUID WHERE 1=1 AND CDD_CANCEL_IND <> '1' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND <> '1' AND CDD_SIGNED_DTE >= '12/18/2019' ) SELECT * FROM CLINDOC_INFO ORDER BY 1, 3, 2, 4 ;

prompt: Display the total number of pathology, radiology, IR and lab orders submitted. The report should be grouped by MD and POA.
completion: SELECT RPT_QTR, PHYSICIAN, DOC_SVC, USER_NAME, POA_IND , ORD_NAME, DEPT, STATUS, COUNT(*) ORD_CNT FROM (SELECT OO_MRN, OO_ENTER_DTE, UR.OU_LOGON_ID LOGON_ID , UR.OU_DISPLAY_NAME USER_NAME, UR.OU_OCCUPATION, OO_ENTER_ROLE , OP_DISPLAY_NAME AS PHYSICIAN, DOC_SVC , CASE WHEN POA.OU_USER_GUID IS NOT NULL THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS POA_IND , CASE WHEN OO_ENTER_DTE BETWEEN '2008-10-01' AND '2008-12-31' THEN '2008-Q4' WHEN OO_ENTER_DTE BETWEEN '2009-01-01' AND '2009-03-31' THEN '2009-Q1' ELSE '2009-Q2' END AS RPT_QTR , OO_ORD_NAME ORD_NAME, OOC_REV_CAT_DEPT DEPT , STRIP(OO_ORD_STS_CD)||'-'||STRIP(OSTS_STS_DESC) STATUS FROM IDB.OMS_ORDER JOIN IDB.OMS_PROVIDER ON OP_PVDR_GUID = OO_PVDR_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_USER UR ON UR.OU_USER_GUID = OO_USER_GUID LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_USER POA ON POA.OU_USER_GUID = OO_USER_GUID AND(POA.OU_LOGON_ID IN ('045831', '049825', '061689', '106781', '145102', '215806', '222554', '301150', '322701', '328583', '349183', '359653', '416909', '428565', '430017', '499269') OR POA.OU_OCCUPATION = 'POA') JOIN IDB.DOC ON OP_PVDR_NO = DOC_DR_NO JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_CATALOG ON OOC_MSTR_ITEM_GUID = OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID AND OOC_REV_CAT_DEPT IN ('Laboratory', 'Pathology', 'Radiology') AND LEFT(OOC_ITEM_NAME, 2) NOT IN ('FF', 'FR') AND OOC_ITEM_NAME <> 'Submitted Films' JOIN IDB.OMS_STATUS ON OO_ORD_STS_CD = OSTS_ORD_STS_CD WHERE OO_ENTER_DTE BETWEEN '2008-10-01' AND '2009-06-30' AND DOC_SVC = 'URO' AND UCASE(OO_CREATE_BY) <> '%INTERFACE%' ) CIS GROUP BY RPT_QTR, PHYSICIAN, DOC_SVC, USER_NAME, POA_IND, ORD_NAME, DEPT, STATUS
