LAST_FOLLOWUP_DATE FROM COLRECT JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY ON PT_MRN = PLA_MRN ORDER BY 1; WITH DX AS (

prompt: A list of Radiation oncologist visits in 2013 and 2014.
completion: SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN AS MRN , CS_ACCT_NO AS ACCT_NO, CPE_ENC_DTE AS APPT_DATE , CLD_DEPT_NAME AS DEPARTMENT, B.CRE_RES_NAME AS MD, CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME AS VT, CL_LAST_NAME AS LAST_NAME , CL_FIRST_NAME AS FIRST_NAME FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT A ON CPE_DEPT_ID = A.CLD_DEPT_ID AND A.CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 = 'RDO' JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE B ON B.CRE_RES_ID = CPE_VST_RES_ID AND CRE_RES_TYP IN ('Physician' , 'PhD') JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID JOIN IDB.CL_PATIENT ON CL_MRN = CPE_MRN JOIN IDB.CASE ON CS_MRN = CPE_MRN AND CS_PT_STS = 'OA' WHERE CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN '2013-01-01' AND '2014-06-06' AND CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Comp', 'Arrived') AND CPE_CPE_IP_IND <> 'INPATIENT'

prompt: Provide a list of F-# cases with specimen source containing "implant capsule" or "implant fluid" or "breast" from 2015 to present.
completion: WITH X AS (SELECT DISTINCT "t1"."PT_MRN" AS "MRN", PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_BIRTH_DTE AS DOB, "t2"."PRPT_ACCESSION_NO" AS "Pathology Report", "t3"."PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_DESC" AS "Pathology Report Type", "t4"."DT_DTE" AS "Pathology Procedure Date", "t5"."DT_DTE" AS "Pathology Report Date", UPPER(CASE WHEN LENGTH(PRPT_REPORT) <= 18000 THEN RTRIM(CAST(SUBSTR(PRPT_REPORT, 1, 18000) AS VARCHAR(18000))) ELSE CAST(SUBSTR(PRPT_REPORT, 1, 18000) AS VARCHAR(18000)) END) AS TXT, UPPER(DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)SPECIMEN SOURCE:[\w\W]*(?=FLOW CYTOMETRY)', UPPER(PRPT_REPORT))) AS "SPECIMEN SOURCE:", UPPER(DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)DIAGNOSIS:[\w\W]*(?=SPECIMEN SOURCE:)', UPPER(PRPT_REPORT))) AS "DIAGNOSIS1", UPPER(DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)DIAGNOSIS:[\w\W]*(?=FLOW CYTOMETRY)', UPPER(PRPT_REPORT))) AS "DIAGNOSIS2", UPPER(DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)DIAGNOSIS:[\w\W]*(?=I ATTEST)', UPPER(PRPT_REPORT))) AS "DIAGNOSIS3" FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V" "t1" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED" "t6" ON "t1"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t6"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V" "t2" ON "t6"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t2"."PRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATH_RPRT_TYPE_LOOKUP" "t3" ON "t2"."PRPT_REPORT_TYPE" = "t3"."PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_CD" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" "t4" ON "t2"."PRPT_PROCEDURE_DATE_ID" = "t4"."DT_DATE_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" "t5" ON "t2"."PRPT_REPORT_DATE_ID" = "t5"."DT_DATE_ID" WHERE 1=1 AND CONTAINS("t2"."PRPT_REPORT", '("implant capsule" | "implant fluid" | "breast")') = 1 AND "t2"."PRPT_REPORT" IS NOT NULL AND "t4"."DT_DTE" >= '2015-01-01' AND "t2"."PRPT_ACCESSION_NO" LIKE 'F%' ) , Y AS (SELECT "MRN", PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, DOB, "Pathology Report", "Pathology Report Type", "Pathology Procedure Date", "Pathology Report Date", TXT, "SPECIMEN SOURCE:", POSITION('SPECIMEN SOURCE:', "SPECIMEN SOURCE:", CODEUNITS32) AS POS1, POSITION('FLOW CYTOMETRY', "SPECIMEN SOURCE:", CODEUNITS32) AS POS2, CASE WHEN "DIAGNOSIS1" <> '' THEN "DIAGNOSIS1" WHEN "DIAGNOSIS2" <> '' THEN "DIAGNOSIS2" WHEN "DIAGNOSIS3" <> '' THEN "DIAGNOSIS3" END AS "DIAGNOSIS:" FROM X WHERE 1=1 AND("SPECIMEN SOURCE:" LIKE '%IMPLANT CAPSULE%' OR "SPECIMEN SOURCE:" LIKE '%IMPLANT FLUID%' OR "SPECIMEN SOURCE:" LIKE '%BREAST%') ) , Z AS (SELECT "MRN", PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, DOB, "Pathology Report", "Pathology Report Type", "Pathology Procedure Date", "Pathology Report Date", TXT, "SPECIMEN SOURCE:", POS1, POS2, CASE WHEN POS2 = 0 THEN 500 ELSE POS2-POS1 END AS LEN1, "DIAGNOSIS:" FROM Y) SELECT "MRN", PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, DOB, "Pathology Report", "Pathology Report Type", "Pathology Procedure Date", "Pathology Report Date", TXT, REPLACE(SUBSTRING(CAST(UPPER("SPECIMEN SOURCE:") AS VARCHAR(32000)), POS1, LEN1, CODEUNITS32), ' ', '') AS "SPECIMEN SOURCE:", "DIAGNOSIS:" FROM Z

prompt: Identify patients with NUT midline carcinoma based on pathology report and ClinDoc search.
completion: WITH APPTS AS (SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN AS "MRN" FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 = 'SRG' AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 = 'HNS' ) , PATH AS (SELECT DISTINCT PRPT_MRN, MIN(PRPT_REPORT_DTE) "First Path" FROM APPTS JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V ON "MRN" = PRPT_MRN WHERE CONTAINS(PRPT_REPORT, '"%NUT midline carcinoma%"|"%Nut carcinoma%"') = 1 GROUP BY PRPT_MRN) , CLINDOC AS (SELECT DISTINCT MIN(CDD_SERVICE_DTE) AS "First Clindoc", CDD_MRN FROM APPTS JOIN IDB.CD_DOCUMENT ON CDD_MRN = "MRN" JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION ON CDD_DOC_GUID = CDO_DOC_GUID AND CDD_AUTHORED_DTE = CDO_AUTHORED_DTE WHERE LOCATE('nut midline carcinoma', LOWER(CDO_VALUE_TEXT)) >0 OR LOCATE('nut carcinoma', LOWER(CDO_VALUE_TEXT)) >0 GROUP BY CDD_MRN) SELECT "MRN", PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, TM_HIST_CD, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS HIST_DESC, TM_SITE_CD, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_DESC, "First Path", "First Clindoc" FROM APPTS LEFT JOIN PATH ON PRPT_MRN = "MRN" LEFT JOIN CLINDOC ON CDD_MRN = "MRN" JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PT_MRN = "MRN" LEFT JOIN IDB.CDB_TUMOR ON TM_MRN = "MRN" LEFT JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD LEFT JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD

prompt:
A list of H-/S- cases with



Part Description: ["bone biopsy" OR "bone excision" OR "bone curettage" OR "bone resection"]



AND Diagnosis: ["follicular lymphoma" OR "FL" OR "low grade B cell lymphoma" OR "LGBCL" OR "B cell lymphoma" OR "atypical B cell" OR "marginal zone lymphoma" OR "MZL" OR "lymphoplasmacytic lymphoma"]



from 01/01/2000 to present.
completion: WITH PD AS (SELECT DISTINCT PD_MRN , H_S_CASE_NUMBER , PROCEDURE_DATE , H_S_REPORT_TEXT , RELATED_CASE_NUMBER , RELATED_REPORT_TEXT , PART_DESCRIPTION , PATHOLOGY_REPORT_DATE , DIAGNOSIS_TEXT FROM (SELECT DISTINCT DMP.PRPT_MRN AS PD_MRN , DMP.PRPT_ACCESSION_NO AS H_S_CASE_NUMBER , DMP.PRPT_PROCEDURE_DTE AS PROCEDURE_DATE , VARCHAR(DMP.PRPT_REPORT, 32000) AS H_S_REPORT_TEXT , SRG.PRPT_ACCESSION_NO AS RELATED_CASE_NUMBER , (SELECT VARCHAR(PRPT_REPORT, 32000) FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT WHERE PRPT_ACCESSION_NO = SRG.PRPT_ACCESSION_NO) AS RELATED_REPORT_TEXT , DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)diag[\w\W]*(?=I ATTEST)', DMP.PRPT_REPORT) AS DIAGNOSIS_TEXT , DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)Specimens Submitted:[\w\W]*(?=DIAGNOSIS:)', DMP.PRPT_REPORT) AS PART_DESCRIPTION , DMP.PRPT_REPORT_DTE AS PATHOLOGY_REPORT_DATE FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V DMP LEFT JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_REFERENCES ON PRPTR_CHILD_PATH_RPT_ID = DMP.PRPT_PATH_RPT_ID LEFT JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT SRG ON SRG.PRPT_PATH_RPT_ID = PRPTR_PATH_RPT_ID AND (SRG.PRPT_ACCESSION_NO LIKE 'F%' OR SRG.PRPT_ACCESSION_NO LIKE 'CG%' OR SRG.PRPT_ACCESSION_NO LIKE 'M%') WHERE 1=1 AND (DMP.PRPT_ACCESSION_NO LIKE 'H%' OR DMP.PRPT_ACCESSION_NO LIKE 'S%') AND DMP.PRPT_REPORT_DTE >= '01/01/2000' AND DMP.PRPT_REPORT IS NOT NULL AND CONTAINS(DMP.PRPT_REPORT, '("follicular lymphoma" OR "FL" OR "low grade B cell lymphoma" OR "LGBCL" OR "B cell lymphoma" OR "atypical B cell" OR "marginal zone lymphoma" OR "MZL" OR "lymphoplasmacytic lymphoma")') = 1 )), DATA AS (SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN AS MRN , PT_LAST_NAME AS LAST_NAME , PT_FIRST_NAME AS FIRST_NAME , PT_BIRTH_DTE AS DATE_OF_BIRTH , PT_SEX_DESC AS SEX , PATHOLOGY_REPORT_DATE , PROCEDURE_DATE AS DATE_OF_SPECIMEN , PDRX_DMP_PATIENT_ID AS DMP_ID , H_S_CASE_NUMBER , H_S_REPORT_TEXT , RELATED_CASE_NUMBER , RELATED_REPORT_TEXT , PART_DESCRIPTION , DIAGNOSIS_TEXT FROM (SELECT PT_MRN , PT_LAST_NAME , PT_FIRST_NAME , PT_BIRTH_DTE , PT_SEX_DESC , PART_DESCRIPTION , PROCEDURE_DATE , H_S_CASE_NUMBER , H_S_REPORT_TEXT , RELATED_CASE_NUMBER , RELATED_REPORT_TEXT , DIAGNOSIS_TEXT , PDRX_DMP_PATIENT_ID , PATHOLOGY_REPORT_DATE FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML INNER JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML_SETTINGS ON PDRX_PATH_DMP_RESULTS_XML_ID = PDRXS_PATH_DMP_RESULTS_XML_ID INNER JOIN DVDMC.PATHOLOGY_DMP_WEBSVC_SETTINGS ON PDRXS_SETTING_ID = PDWS_SETTING_ID INNER JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON PDRX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID LEFT JOIN PD ON PT_MRN = PD_MRN WHERE 1=1 AND (LOCATE('follicular lymphoma', LOWER (DIAGNOSIS_TEXT)) >= 1 OR LOCATE('fl', LOWER (DIAGNOSIS_TEXT)) >= 1 OR LOCATE('low grade b cell lymphoma', LOWER (DIAGNOSIS_TEXT)) >= 1 OR LOCATE('lgbcl', LOWER (DIAGNOSIS_TEXT)) >= 1 OR LOCATE('b cell lymphoma', LOWER (DIAGNOSIS_TEXT)) >= 1 OR LOCATE('atypical b cell', LOWER (DIAGNOSIS_TEXT)) >= 1 OR LOCATE('marginal zone lymphoma', LOWER (DIAGNOSIS_TEXT)) >= 1 OR LOCATE('mzl', LOWER (DIAGNOSIS_TEXT)) >= 1 OR LOCATE('lymphoplasmacytic lymphoma', LOWER (DIAGNOSIS_TEXT)) >= 1) AND (LOCATE('bone biopsy', LOWER (PART_DESCRIPTION)) >= 1 OR LOCATE('bone excision', LOWER (PART_DESCRIPTION)) >= 1 OR LOCATE('bone curettage', LOWER (PART_DESCRIPTION)) >= 1 OR LOCATE('bone resection', LOWER (PART_DESCRIPTION)) >= 1) )) SELECT DISTINCT A.MRN , A.LAST_NAME , A.FIRST_NAME , A.DATE_OF_BIRTH , A.SEX , A.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_DATE , A.DATE_OF_SPECIMEN , A.DMP_ID , A.H_S_CASE_NUMBER , A.H_S_REPORT_TEXT , A.DIAGNOSIS_TEXT , A.PART_DESCRIPTION , B.RELATED_CASE_NUMBER AS F_CASE_NUMBER , B.RELATED_REPORT_TEXT AS RELATED_F_REPORT_TEXT , C.RELATED_CASE_NUMBER AS CG_CASE_NUMBER , C.RELATED_REPORT_TEXT AS RELATED_CG_REPORT_TEXT , D.RELATED_CASE_NUMBER AS M_CASE_NUMBER , D.RELATED_REPORT_TEXT AS RELATED_M_REPORT_TEXT FROM DATA A LEFT JOIN DATA B ON A.MRN = B.MRN AND B.RELATED_CASE_NUMBER LIKE 'F%' LEFT JOIN DATA C ON A.MRN = C.MRN AND C.RELATED_CASE_NUMBER LIKE 'CG%' LEFT JOIN DATA D ON A.MRN = D.MRN AND D.RELATED_CASE_NUMBER LIKE 'M%'

prompt: Chemomart data from all chemo orders placed in the past month for people consented to 12-245 or 06-107
completion: SELECT APR_MRN, APR_ORDER_SOURCE, APR_GENERIC_NAME, APR_DRUG_NAME, APR_START_DTE, APR_END_DTE, APR_SET_NAME, APR_SET_FORM_NAME, APR_DIAGNOSIS_DESC , MAX(CASE WHEN AC_IRB_NO = '12-245' THEN AC_CONS_DTE END) AS CON_12_245 , MAX(CASE WHEN AC_IRB_NO = '06-107' THEN AC_CONS_DTE END) AS CON_06_107 FROM IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX JOIN IDB.ACCRUALS ON AC_MRN = APR_MRN AND AC_IRB_NO IN ('12-245', '06-107') WHERE 1=1 AND APR_START_DTE BETWEEN '7/1/2019' AND '7/31/2019' GROUP BY APR_MRN, APR_ORDER_SOURCE, APR_GENERIC_NAME, APR_DRUG_NAME, APR_START_DTE, APR_END_DTE, APR_SET_NAME, APR_SET_FORM_NAME, APR_DIAGNOSIS_DESC

prompt: Provide a list of patients with any of the following terms in their pathology reports from 1992 to 2012:  "Pineal", "Pineoblastoma" or "Pineocytoma" and a list of patients diagnosed with PINEAL GLAND CA (ICD-9 194.4) from 1992 to 2012
completion: WITH CTE AS (SELECT CC_MRN, CC_EFF_DTE, CASE WHEN ((CC_PT_TYPE = 'I') OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS CIC_CODED FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF INNER JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND CC_EFF_DTE BETWEEN '1992-01-01' AND '2012-12-31' AND CC_CLSF_CD = '194.4' GROUP BY CC_MRN, CC_EFF_DTE, CASE WHEN ((CC_PT_TYPE = 'I') OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END ), Y AS (SELECT CC_MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS EFF_DATE, CIC_CODED FROM CTE WHERE CIC_CODED = 'Y' GROUP BY CC_MRN, CIC_CODED ), N AS (SELECT CC_MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS EFF_DATE, CIC_CODED FROM CTE WHERE CIC_CODED = 'N' AND CC_MRN NOT IN (SELECT CC_MRN FROM Y) GROUP BY CC_MRN, CIC_CODED ) SELECT CC_MRN, YEAR(EFF_DATE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) AS AGE, '' AS CIC FROM Y JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON CC_MRN = PT_MRN UNION SELECT CC_MRN, YEAR(EFF_DATE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) AS AGE, 'NOT CIC-CODED' AS CIC FROM N JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON CC_MRN = PT_MRN

prompt: Provide data on patients diagnosed with lacrimal gland cancer.
completion: WITH DX AS (SELECT TM_MRN MRN, TM_DX_DTE DX_DTE, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_DESC, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS HIST_DESC FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS ON AV_ELEMENT = 'CASE_STS' AND AV_CODE = TM_CASE_STS WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND TM_SITE_CD = 'C695' AND H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK like '%SQUAMOUS%' AND TM_DX_DTE > '1980-01-01' UNION ALL SELECT DISTINCT CC_MRN MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS DX_DTE, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_DESC, 'NOT YET RECORDED' AS HIST_DESC FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE SUBSTR(CC_CLSF_CD, 1, 5) IN ('C69.5') AND CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK LIKE '%LACRIMAL%' AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND (CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) GROUP BY CC_MRN, CC_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK HAVING MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) BETWEEN '2018-03-30' AND CURRENT date) SELECT DX.*, PLA_LST_APPT_DTE "Last Appointment", LISTAGG(SSE_SURG_DTE, '; ') WITHIN GROUP ( ORDER BY SSE_SURG_DTE) AS "Surg Dates" FROM DX JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY ON PLA_MRN = MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT ON SSE_MRN = MRN AND SSE_SURG_LOC not like '%IR%' AND SSE_SURG_LOC not like '%ENDO%' AND SSE_SOURCE_TYPE <> 'E' GROUP BY MRN, DX_DTE, SITE_DESC, HIST_DESC, PLA_LST_APPT_DTE

prompt: List  of patients with the mention of "epithelioid hemangioendothelioma" or "EHE" in their path reports, and that have received anti PD-1, anti-PD-L1, or anti-CTLA4 based therapies.
completion: WITH PTR AS (SELECT PRPT_MRN, PRPT_PROCEDURE_DTE, PRPT_REPORT_DTE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY PRPT_MRN ORDER BY PRPT_PROCEDURE_DTE ASC) RN FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V WHERE 1=1 AND (INSTR (CAST(PRPT_REPORT AS VARCHAR(32000)), '(EHE') > 0 OR INSTR (CAST(PRPT_REPORT AS VARCHAR(32000)), ',EHE') > 0 OR INSTR (CAST(PRPT_REPORT AS VARCHAR(32000)), ' EHE,') > 0 OR INSTR (CAST(PRPT_REPORT AS VARCHAR(32000)), ' EHE.') > 0 OR INSTR (LOWER(CAST(PRPT_REPORT AS VARCHAR(32000))) , 'epithelioid hemangioendothelioma') > 0) AND PRPT_REPORT IS NOT NULL ) , APR AS (SELECT APR_MRN, CDG_THERAPEUTIC_CATEGORY, CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME, MIN(APR_START_DTE) AS IMMUNOTHERAPY_START, MAX(APR_END_DTE) AS IMMUNOTHERAPY_END FROM IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX_V JOIN PTR ON PRPT_MRN = APR_MRN AND RN =1 WHERE CDG_THERAPEUTIC_CATEGORY IN ('antineoplastics | anti-pd-1 monoclonal antibodies', 'antineoplastics | anti-ctla-4 monoclonal antibodies') OR CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME IN ('ATEZOLIZUMAB', 'AVELUMAB', 'DURVALUMAB' ) GROUP BY APR_MRN, CDG_THERAPEUTIC_CATEGORY, CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME) SELECT PRPT_MRN AS MRN, TRIM(PT_LAST_NAME) || ', ' || TRIM(PT_FIRST_NAME) AS PATIENT_NAME, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH AS DOB, PRPT_PROCEDURE_DTE AS FIRST_PROCEDURE_DATE, PRPT_REPORT_DTE AS FIRST_PATH_REPORT_DATE, CDG_THERAPEUTIC_CATEGORY, CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME, IMMUNOTHERAPY_START, IMMUNOTHERAPY_END FROM PTR JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PT_MRN = PRPT_MRN JOIN APR ON APR_MRN = PRPT_MRN WHERE RN=1

prompt: We would like to setup automatic emails to oncologists cc'd to us notifying them of patients with specific tumor molecular features (CCNE1 amplication, FBXW7 deleterious mutations, and PPP2R1A deleterious mutations)
completion: WITH STRUCTURED_QUAL AS (SELECT DISTINCT INC.PRPT_PATH_RPT_ID AS RID FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_STRUCTURED_RESULTS_V INC JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS REC ON REC.PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = INC.PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID WHERE 1=1 AND PT_VITAL_STATUS = 'ALIVE' AND (((INC.GENE IN ('CCNE1') OR INC.GENE2 IN ('CCNE1')) AND INC.FOLD_CHANGE >= 2) OR ((INC.GENE IN ('FBXW7', 'PPP2R1A') OR INC.GENE2 IN ('FBXW7', 'PPP2R1A')) AND INC.FOLD_CHANGE <= -2) ) ) , DEID AS (SELECT DISTINCT PDRX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID AS P_ID FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML DT JOIN STRUCTURED_QUAL ON RID = DT.PDRX_PATH_RPT_ID CROSS JOIN XMLTABLE('$c/root/meta-data' PASSING DT.PDRX_XML_VALUE AS "c" COLUMNS TUMOR_TYPE_CODE VARCHAR(26) PATH 'tumor_type_code') T WHERE 1=1 AND TUMOR_TYPE_CODE IN ('TTC', 'HGONEC', 'UCS', 'OCS', 'ICEMU', 'BTOV', 'MXOV', 'UAS', 'UPECOMA', 'VSC', 'CACC', 'OEC', 'OIMT', 'UUC', 'OUSARC', 'VGCE', 'EOV', 'LGSOC', 'OVARY', 'VOEC', 'VPE', 'FT', 'OGBL', 'OSMBT', 'VA', 'VPDC', 'SCCE' , 'SCT', 'CABC', 'OYST', 'CEAIS', 'CECC', 'CEVG', 'PEMESO', 'PSEC', 'UDDC', 'UMNC', 'VMA', 'BTMOV', 'CCBOV', 'OCNOS', 'USTUMP', 'OSMAD', 'CEAS', 'ECAD', 'SBMOV', 'UEC', 'UNEC', 'CEEN', 'BTBOV', 'MBOV', 'OPE', 'LGESS', 'OSMCA' , 'USC', 'ESS', 'USARC', 'CEAD', 'CEGCC', 'CESC', 'SCEMU', 'EBOV', 'HGSFT', 'OVT', 'UMC', 'UMEC', 'UPDC', 'USMT', 'VYST', 'CENE', 'CESE', 'BTBEOV', 'PERITONEUM', 'CCOV', 'VULVA', 'GCEMU', 'OMGCT', 'UELMS', 'VDYS', 'VGCT', 'VMM' , 'CEMN', 'CERVIX', 'GRCT', 'MOV', 'OGCT', 'OMT', 'OOVC', 'SLCT', 'VMGCT', 'CEMU', 'ODYS', 'SBOV', 'SCST', 'VMT', 'CELI', 'CERMS', 'SOC', 'UASC', 'UCCC', 'HGESS', 'UMLMS', 'VIMT', 'MCCE', 'SCCO', 'UCEC', 'ULM', 'UUS', 'HGSOC', 'ULMS') )

prompt: Engage Family History Questionnaire data for patients participating in the EfFORT Study
completion: SELECT EF_SUBMISSION_DT, AC_LAST_NAME AS LAST_NAME, AC_FIRST_NAME AS FIRST_NAME, EF_MRN, EF_FORM_NAME, EFI_ITEM_TEXT, EFI_ITEM_ALIAS, EFI_VALUE FROM IDB.EF_FORM LEFT JOIN IDB.EF_FORM_ITEM ON EF_FORM_ID = EFI_FORM_ID JOIN IDB.ACCRUALS ON AC_MRN = EF_MRN WHERE EF_FORM_NAME = 'Family History Questionnaire'

prompt: Provide MRNs for all Hodgkin lymphoma survivors treated with mantle field irradiation, then later on had breast cancer that was managed by implant based breast reconstruction(performed by Dr.Peter Cordeiro).
completion: WITH HL AS (SELECT TM_MRN MRN, TM_DX_DTE DX_DTE, TM_SITE_CD SITE_CD, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_DESC FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS ON AV_ELEMENT = 'CASE_STS' AND AV_CODE = TM_CASE_STS WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND TM_HIST_CD IN ('M9596/3', 'M9650/3', 'M9651/3', 'M9652/3', 'M9659/3', 'M9665/3', 'M9999/9') UNION SELECT CC_MRN MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS DX_DTE, CC_CLSF_CD AS SITE_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_DESC FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE SUBSTR(CC_CLSF_CD, 1, 3) IN ('201', 'C81') AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND (CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) GROUP BY CC_MRN, CC_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK ) , SURG AS (SELECT SSE_MRN, SSE_SURG_DTE, SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD, SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC, SSP_SURG_LAST_NM, SSP_SURG_FIRST_NM, SSP_SURG_SVC_CD FROM IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE ON SSE_LOG_ID = SSP_LOG_ID AND SSE_ENC_CSN_ID = SSP_ENC_CSN_ID WHERE SSP_SURG_LAST_NM = 'CORDEIRO' AND SSP_SURG_FIRST_NM = 'PETER' ) SELECT * FROM SURG JOIN HL ON MRN = SSE_MRN ;

prompt: Create a Tableau dashboard to capture metrics related to pediatric surgery new patients.
completion: SELECT CPE_MRN AS "MRN", TRIM(PT_LAST_NAME) || ', ' || TRIM(PT_FIRST_NAME) "Patient Name", CPE_ENC_CSN_ID, CPE_ENC_DTE AS "Appt Date", CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 AS "Department", CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 AS "Service", CLD_DEPT_NAME AS "Department Name", CRE_RES_NAME AS "Provider Name", CASE WHEN CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR like 'TEL%' THEN 'TeleHealth' WHEN CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR like 'PHONE%' THEN 'Phone' ELSE 'In-Person' END AS "Visit Type Group", CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR AS "Visit Type Abbr", CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME AS "Visit Type", PFA_FST_CHEMO_MSK_DTE "First Chemo Date", PFA_FST_RT_MSK_DTE "First RT Date", PFA_FST_SRG_MSK_DTE "First Surgery Date", DAYS(PFA_FST_MSK_TX_DTE) - DAYS(CPE_ENC_DTE) "Days to Tx" FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON CPE_MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.PT_FIRST_ACTIVITY ON CPE_MRN = PFA_MRN WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN '2019-01-01' AND CURRENT date AND CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR LIKE '%NV%' AND (CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 = ('PED') OR CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_4 = ('PED') OR CLD_DEPT_NAME = 'ORTHOPEDICS 1275-9') AND CPE_CPE_IP_IND <> 'INPATIENT' AND CPE_ENC_DTE = PFA_FST_DRVST_DTE

prompt: Provide a list of all cases with TRBC1 on flow performed.
completion: WITH FLOW AS (SELECT DISTINCT DFP.PRPT_MRN AS FLOW_MRN, DFP.PRPT_PROCEDURE_DTE AS FLOW_PROCEDURE_DATE, DFP.PRPT_ACCESSION_NO AS FLOW_NO, UPPER(CASE WHEN LENGTH(PRPT_REPORT) <= 15000 THEN RTRIM(CAST(SUBSTR(PRPT_REPORT, 1, 15000) AS VARCHAR(15000))) ELSE CAST(SUBSTR(PRPT_REPORT, 1, 15000) AS VARCHAR(15000)) END) AS FLOW_TXT FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V DFP WHERE DFP.PRPT_REPORT IS NOT NULL AND PRPT_PROCEDURE_DTE>= '2017-10-01' AND CONTAINS(DFP.PRPT_REPORT, '("TRBC1" OR "TCRbeta1" OR "TCRB1" OR "TCRCbeta1")') = 1 AND LEFT(DFP.PRPT_ACCESSION_NO, 1) IN ('F') ) SELECT DISTINCT D.PRPT_MRN AS MRN, FLOW_PROCEDURE_DATE, D.PRPT_PROCEDURE_DTE AS H_S_PROCEDURE_DATE, FLOW_NO, D.PRPT_ACCESSION_NO AS H_S_NO, FLOW_TXT FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V D JOIN FLOW ON D.PRPT_MRN = FLOW_MRN WHERE D.PRPT_REPORT IS NOT NULL AND D.PRPT_PROCEDURE_DTE BETWEEN (FLOW_PROCEDURE_DATE- 7 DAYS) AND (FLOW_PROCEDURE_DATE + 7 DAYS) AND LEFT(D.PRPT_ACCESSION_NO, 1) IN ('H', 'S')

prompt: Amend Workday Report for Employee Vaccine Status
completion: WITH DUPS AS (SELECT EVI_EMPLOYEE_ID AS EID, COUNT(DISTINCT EVI_MRN) AS CT FROM IDB.COVID19_EMPLOYEE_VACCINE_INFO WHERE CEVE_CATEGORY IN ('Employees', 'Contingents', 'Pre-hires') AND ELIGIBLE_DTE IS NOT NULL GROUP BY EVI_EMPLOYEE_ID HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT EVI_MRN) > 1) , EMP AS (SELECT EVI_EMPLOYEE_ID, CEVE_CATEGORY, DOSE_1_BRAND, DOSE_1_ADMIN_DTE, DOSE_2_BRAND, DOSE_2_ADMIN_DTE, VACCINE_EXEMPTION_REASON, VACCINE_EXEMPTION_DTE, VACCINE_EXEMPTION_EXP_DTE, DOSE_1_APPT_DT, DOSE_1_APPT_STATUS, DOSE_2_APPT_DT, DOSE_2_APPT_STATUS FROM IDB.COVID19_EMPLOYEE_VACCINE_INFO WHERE CEVE_CATEGORY IN ('Employees', 'Contingents', 'Pre-hires') AND ELIGIBLE_DTE IS NOT NULL AND EVI_EMPLOYEE_ID NOT IN (SELECT EID FROM DUPS) UNION ALL SELECT EVI_EMPLOYEE_ID, CEVE_CATEGORY, MAX(DOSE_1_BRAND) DOSE_1_BRAND, MAX(DOSE_1_ADMIN_DTE) DOSE_1_ADMIN_DTE, MAX(DOSE_2_BRAND) DOSE_2_BRAND, MAX(DOSE_2_ADMIN_DTE) DOSE_2_ADMIN_DTE, MAX(VACCINE_EXEMPTION_REASON) VACCINE_EXEMPTION_REASON, MAX(VACCINE_EXEMPTION_DTE) VACCINE_EXEMPTION_DTE, MAX(VACCINE_EXEMPTION_EXP_DTE) VACCINE_EXEMPTION_EXP_DTE, MAX(DOSE_1_APPT_DT) DOSE_1_APPT_DT, MAX(DOSE_1_APPT_STATUS) DOSE_1_APPT_STATUS, MAX(DOSE_2_APPT_DT) DOSE_2_APPT_DT, MAX(DOSE_2_APPT_STATUS) DOSE_2_APPT_STATUS FROM IDB.COVID19_EMPLOYEE_VACCINE_INFO JOIN DUPS ON EVI_EMPLOYEE_ID = EID WHERE CEVE_CATEGORY IN ('Employees', 'Contingents', 'Pre-hires') AND ELIGIBLE_DTE IS NOT NULL GROUP BY EVI_EMPLOYEE_ID, CEVE_CATEGORY) , FIN AS (SELECT A.*, TRIM(CVP_NAME) CVP_NAME, CASE WHEN (DOSE_1_BRAND LIKE 'Janssen%' AND DOSE_1_ADMIN_DTE IS NOT NULL) OR (DOSE_2_ADMIN_DTE IS NOT NULL) THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS VACCINE_SERIES_COMPLETE, CASE WHEN VACCINE_EXEMPTION_DTE <= CURRENT DATE AND (VACCINE_EXEMPTION_EXP_DTE IS NULL OR VACCINE_EXEMPTION_EXP_DTE >= CURRENT DATE) THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS "Exemption Flag", CASE WHEN DOSE_1_ADMIN_DTE IS NOT NULL THEN 'Completed' WHEN DOSE_1_ADMIN_DTE IS NULL AND DOSE_1_APPT_STATUS = 'PRE' THEN 'MSK Scheduled' ELSE 'No Record' END AS DOSE_1, CASE WHEN DOSE_2_ADMIN_DTE IS NOT NULL THEN 'Completed' WHEN DOSE_2_ADMIN_DTE IS NULL AND DOSE_2_APPT_STATUS = 'PRE' THEN 'MSK Scheduled' ELSE 'No Record' END AS DOSE_2, CASE WHEN CVP_VACC_REMT_EXMP_IND = 'Y' THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS REMOTE_FLAG, CVP_VACC_REMT_EXMP_EFF_DTE AS REMOTE_EFFECTIVE_DATE FROM EMP A JOIN IDB.COVID19_VACCINE_PERSON ON EVI_EMPLOYEE_ID = CVP_EMPLOYEE_ID) SELECT DISTINCT TRIM(EVI_EMPLOYEE_ID) "Employee ID", TRIM(CVP_NAME) "Employee Name", VACCINE_SERIES_COMPLETE "Vaccine Series Complete", "Exemption Flag", DOSE_1, DOSE_2, REMOTE_FLAG "Remote Worker Flag", REMOTE_EFFECTIVE_DATE "Date Effective" FROM FIN

prompt: Please provide the following documentation for report request NRS7875: (1) original request submitted by user; (2) relevant specification documentation; and (3) distribution list.
completion: SELECT DISTINCT CHM.CPO_ORD_GUID AS ORD_GUID, CHM.CPO_START_DTE AS START_DATE, CHM.CPO_YR AS RPT_YEAR, CHM.CPO_IP_OP_IND AS SITE_GRP, CHM.CPO_LOC_GRP AS LOCATION_GROUPS, CHM.CPO_SVC_TYPE AS PAT_TYPE, CASE WHEN CHM.CPO_ORAL_CHEMO_IND = 'Y' THEN 'ORAL' ELSE 'NON_ORAL' END CHEMO_TYPE, CHM.CPO_CHEMO_IND AS CHEMO_IND , CHM.CPO_ADMIN_CNT CNT FROM IDB.CHEMO_PERFORMED_ORDERS CHM WHERE CHM.CPO_YR BETWEEN YEAR(CURRENT DATE) - 3 AND YEAR(CURRENT DATE) - 1 AND(CHM.CPO_CHEMO_IND = 'Y' OR CHM.CPO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID IN ('2000004686073029', '9000009472200730'))

prompt: Create an on demand report for biopsies, on core biopsy, fine needle aspirate, site procedure, pathology results.
completion: WITH SRG AS (SELECT DISTINCT SSE_MRN, SSE_SURG_DTE, SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD, SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC, SSP_LATERALITY FROM IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE ON SSE_LOG_ID = SSP_LOG_ID WHERE 1=1 AND SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD IN ('19300', '19301', '19302', '19303', '19304', '19305', '19306', '19307', '19309', '38500', '38510', '38525', '38530', '38740', '38745') AND SSE_MRN IN (#PROMPTMANY('MRN', 'STRING')#) ) SELECT DISTINCT STRIP("t1"."PT_MRN") AS "MRN", SSE_SURG_DTE AS "Surgical Procedure Date", STRIP(SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD) AS "CPT Code", STRIP(SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC) AS "Procedure Description", STRIP(SSP_LATERALITY) AS "Laterality", STRIP("t2"."PRPT_ACCESSION_NO") AS "Pathology Report", "t3"."DT_DTE" AS "Pathology Procedure Date", "t5"."PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_DESC" AS "Pathology Report Type" , STRIP(CASE WHEN UPPER(DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)DIAGNOSIS:[\w\W]*(?=I ATTEST)', PRPT_REPORT)) <> '' THEN UPPER(DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)DIAGNOSIS:[\w\W]*(?=I ATTEST)', PRPT_REPORT)) WHEN UPPER(DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)DIAGNOSIS:[\w\W]*(?=NOTE:)', PRPT_REPORT)) <> '' THEN UPPER(DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)DIAGNOSIS:[\w\W]*(?=NOTE:)', PRPT_REPORT)) WHEN UPPER(DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)DIAGNOSIS:[\w\W]*(?=REPORT ELECTRONICALLY SIGNED OUT )', PRPT_REPORT)) <> '' THEN UPPER(DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)DIAGNOSIS:[\w\W]*(?=REPORT ELECTRONICALLY SIGNED OUT )', PRPT_REPORT)) END) AS DIAGNOSIS FROM SRG JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V" "t1" ON PT_MRN = SSE_MRN LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED" "t6" ON "t1"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t6"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V" "t2" ON "t6"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t2"."PRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" "t3" ON "t2"."PRPT_PROCEDURE_DATE_ID" = "t3"."DT_DATE_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" "t4" ON "t2"."PRPT_REPORT_DATE_ID" = "t4"."DT_DATE_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATH_RPRT_TYPE_LOOKUP" "t5" ON "t2"."PRPT_REPORT_TYPE" = "t5"."PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_CD" WHERE 1=1 AND "t5"."PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_DESC" like ('Surgical Pathology%') AND CONTAINS("t2"."PRPT_REPORT", '("ASPIRATE" OR "FNA" OR "FINE NEEDLE" OR "CORE BIOPSY" OR "INCISIONAL BIOPSY" OR "EXCISIONAL BIOPSY")') = 1 AND "t4"."DT_DTE" < SSE_SURG_DTE

prompt: We are attempting to compile a list of patients with Richters Transformation - please provide a one time list of patients with the ICD-10 diagnosis codes for CLL or SLL (as well as any patients who have an additional diagnosis code for DLBCL)
completion: WITH DIAG AS (SELECT DISTINCT CC_MRN, TRIM(PT_LAST_NAME) || ', ' || PT_FIRST_NAME AS PT_NAME, CC_EFF_DTE FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.PATIENT_V ON PT_MRN = CC_MRN WHERE 1=1 AND CC_CLSF_CD LIKE 'C91.1%' AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND (CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) AND CC_EFF_DTE <= '2022-11-23' ) SELECT DISTINCT CC_MRN AS MRN, PT_NAME FROM DIAG; WITH CLL AS (SELECT DISTINCT CC_MRN AS CLL_MRN, TRIM(PT_LAST_NAME) || ', ' || PT_FIRST_NAME AS PT_NAME, CC_EFF_DTE FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.PATIENT_V ON PT_MRN = CC_MRN WHERE 1=1 AND CC_CLSF_CD LIKE 'C91.1%' AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND (CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) AND CC_EFF_DTE <= '2022-11-23' ) , DLBCL AS (SELECT DISTINCT CC_MRN AS DLBCL_MRN, CC_EFF_DTE FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.PATIENT_V ON PT_MRN = CC_MRN WHERE 1=1 AND CC_CLSF_CD LIKE 'C83.3%' AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND (CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) AND CC_EFF_DTE <= '2022-11-23' ) SELECT DISTINCT CLL_MRN AS MRN, PT_NAME FROM CLL JOIN DLBCL ON CLL_MRN = DLBCL_MRN;

prompt: Design a report on patients treated with brain radiation followed by surgical resection and whether they had necrosis.
completion: WITH X AS (SELECT DISTINCT "t1"."PT_MRN" AS "MRN", PRPT_ORD_DR_NAME, "t2"."PRPT_ACCESSION_NO" AS "Pathology Report", "t3"."PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_DESC" AS "Pathology Report Type", "t4"."DT_DTE" AS "Pathology Procedure Date", CASE WHEN CONTAINS("t2"."PRPT_REPORT", '("treatment effect" OR "necrosis")') = 1 THEN 'Y' END AS "Tx effect or necrosis", CASE WHEN UPPER(DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)DIAGNOSIS:[\w\W]*(?=I ATTEST)', PRPT_REPORT)) <> '' THEN UPPER(DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)DIAGNOSIS:[\w\W]*(?=I ATTEST)', PRPT_REPORT)) WHEN UPPER(DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)DIAGNOSIS:[\w\W]*(?=NOTE:)', PRPT_REPORT)) <> '' THEN UPPER(DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)DIAGNOSIS:[\w\W]*(?=NOTE:)', PRPT_REPORT)) WHEN UPPER(DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)DIAGNOSIS:[\w\W]*(?=REPORT ELECTRONICALLY SIGNED OUT )', PRPT_REPORT)) <> '' THEN UPPER(DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)DIAGNOSIS:[\w\W]*(?=REPORT ELECTRONICALLY SIGNED OUT )', PRPT_REPORT)) END AS DIAGNOSIS, CASE WHEN UPPER(DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)SPECIMENS SUBMITTED[\w\W]*(?=DIAGNOSIS:)', PRPT_REPORT)) <> '' THEN UPPER(DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)SPECIMENS SUBMITTED[\w\W]*(?=DIAGNOSIS:)', PRPT_REPORT)) WHEN UPPER(DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)SPECIMENSSUBMITTED[\w\W]*(?=DIAGNOSIS:)', PRPT_REPORT)) <> '' THEN UPPER(DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)SPECIMENSSUBMITTED[\w\W]*(?=DIAGNOSIS:)', PRPT_REPORT)) END AS "SPECIMENS SUBMITTED" FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V" "t1" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED" "t6" ON "t1"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t6"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V" "t2" ON "t6"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t2"."PRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATH_RPRT_TYPE_LOOKUP" "t3" ON "t2"."PRPT_REPORT_TYPE" = "t3"."PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_CD" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" "t4" ON "t2"."PRPT_PROCEDURE_DATE_ID" = "t4"."DT_DATE_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" "t5" ON "t2"."PRPT_REPORT_DATE_ID" = "t5"."DT_DATE_ID" WHERE 1=1 AND "t2"."PRPT_REPORT" IS NOT NULL AND UPPER("t3"."PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_DESC") LIKE '%SURGICAL PATHOLOGY%' AND "t4"."DT_DTE" BETWEEN '2010-01-01' AND CURRENT date AND PRPT_ORD_DR_NAME IN ('BRENNAN MD,CAMERON W', 'GREENFIELD MD,JEFFREY P', 'GUTIN MD,PHILIP', 'HOLLAND MD,ERIC', 'MOSS MD,NELSON', 'SOUWEIDANE MD,MARK M', 'TABAR MD,VIVIANE S.', 'YU MD,KENNETH H') ) , RT AS (SELECT DISTINCT MRN, "Tx effect or necrosis", "Pathology Procedure Date", RTC_TX_PLAN_NAME, RTC_PRIMARY_REF_POINT, RTC_TX_START_DTE, RTC_TX_STOP_DTE, RTC_TX_ELAPSED_DAYS, RTC_TX_PLANNED_FRACTIONS, RTC_TX_DELIVERED_FRACTIONS, RTC_TX_PLANNED_DOSE, RTC_TX_DELIVERED_DOSE, RTC_DOSE_CORRECTION FROM IDB.RADONC_TREATMENT_COURSE JOIN X ON RTC_TX_MRN = MRN AND RTC_TX_START_DTE < "Pathology Procedure Date" AND UPPER(RTC_TX_PLAN_NAME) not like '%LUN%' AND UPPER(RTC_TX_PLAN_NAME) not like '%ABD%' AND UPPER(RTC_TX_PLAN_NAME) not like '%CH%' AND UPPER(RTC_TX_PLAN_NAME) not like '%PEL%' AND UPPER(RTC_TX_PLAN_NAME) not like '%ESOP%' AND UPPER(RTC_TX_PLAN_NAME) not like '%TEST%' AND UPPER(RTC_TX_PLAN_NAME) not like '%BREAST%' AND UPPER(RTC_TX_PLAN_NAME) not like '%BRST%' AND UPPER(RTC_TX_PLAN_NAME) not like '%PAN%' AND UPPER(RTC_TX_PLAN_NAME) not like '%LIVER%' AND UPPER(RTC_TX_PLAN_NAME) not like '%PROS%' AND UPPER(RTC_TX_PLAN_NAME) not like '%RECT%' AND UPPER(RTC_TX_PLAN_NAME) not like '%ANAL%' AND UPPER(RTC_TX_PLAN_NAME) not like '%BLAD%' AND UPPER(RTC_TX_PLAN_NAME) not like '%GE J%' AND UPPER(RTC_TX_PLAN_NAME) not like '%GEJ%' AND UPPER(RTC_TX_PLAN_NAME) not like '%GAS%' AND UPPER(RTC_TX_PLAN_NAME) not like '%HAWB%' AND UPPER(RTC_TX_PLAN_NAME) not like '%HIP%' AND UPPER(RTC_TX_PLAN_NAME) not like '%LEG%' AND UPPER(RTC_TX_PLAN_NAME) not like '%STERNUM%' AND UPPER(RTC_TX_PLAN_NAME) not like '%ANKLE%' AND UPPER(RTC_TX_PLAN_NAME) not like '%KIDNEY%' AND UPPER(RTC_TX_PLAN_NAME) not like '%SHOULDER%' AND UPPER(RTC_TX_PLAN_NAME) not like '%SCAPULA%' AND UPPER(RTC_TX_PLAN_NAME) not like '%ARM%' AND UPPER(RTC_TX_PLAN_NAME) not like '%MEDIASTIN%' AND UPPER(RTC_TX_PLAN_NAME) not like '%FEMUR%' AND UPPER(RTC_TX_PLAN_NAME) not like '%KNEE%' AND UPPER(RTC_TX_PLAN_NAME) not like '%ELBOW%' AND UPPER(RTC_TX_PLAN_NAME) not like '%RIB%' AND UPPER(RTC_TX_PLAN_NAME) not like '%THIGH%') , MAIN AS (SELECT DISTINCT X."MRN", X."Tx effect or necrosis", PT_SEX AS GENDER, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH AS DOB, PT_DATE_OF_DEATH AS DOD, COALESCE(MAX(PLA_LST_APPT_DTE, PLA_LST_DSCH_DTE), PLA_LST_APPT_DTE, PLA_LST_DSCH_DTE) AS LAST_FU_DATE, PRPT_ORD_DR_NAME, "Pathology Report", "Pathology Report Type", X."Pathology Procedure Date", DIAGNOSIS, "SPECIMENS SUBMITTED" FROM X JOIN RT ON RT.MRN = X.MRN AND RT.RTC_TX_START_DTE < X."Pathology Procedure Date" JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON RT.MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY ON RT.MRN = PLA_MRN) , TM AS (SELECT DISTINCT TM_MRN, "Tx effect or necrosis", TM_DX_DTE AS DX_DATE, CATEGORY2, TM_SITE_CD AS SITE_CODE, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_DESC, TM_HIST_CD AS HIST_CODE, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS HIST_DESC FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.SEERGROUPING ON RECODE = DV.SEERF_ICDO(TM_SITE_CD, TM_HIST_CD) JOIN MAIN ON TM_MRN = MRN JOIN IDB.CLM H ON TM_HIST_CD = H.CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON TM_SITE_CD = S.CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') ) SELECT DISTINCT APR_MRN, CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME, APR_GENERIC_NAME, APR_DRUG_NAME, APR_START_DTE, APR_END_DTE, APR_ORD_RX_TYPE FROM IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX_V JOIN MAIN ON APR_MRN = MRN WHERE CDG_CHEMO_FLAG = 'Y' AND(UPPER(APR_GENERIC_NAME) LIKE '%AVASTIN%' OR UPPER(APR_GENERIC_NAME) LIKE '%BEVACIZUMAB%' OR UPPER(APR_DRUG_NAME) LIKE '%AVASTIN%' OR UPPER(APR_DRUG_NAME) LIKE '%BEVACIZUMAB%')

prompt: Data regarding emergency surgical consults to NYP-Cornell, including intra-operative OR consults for vascular surgical events.
completion: SELECT DISTINCT CDD_MRN AS "MRN", CDD_SERVICE_DTE AS "Service Date", CDD_DOC_NAME AS "Document Name", OP_DISPLAY_NAME AS "Provider", CDD_DOC_GUID AS "Document Guid", CDO_SECTION AS "Section", CDO_ITEM_NAME AS "Item", CDO_VALUE_TEXT AS "Value" FROM IDB.CD_DOCUMENT LEFT JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION ON CDD_DOC_GUID = CDO_DOC_GUID AND CDD_AUTHORED_DTE = CDO_AUTHORED_DTE AND CDO_VALUE_TEXT <> '' JOIN IDB.OMS_PROVIDER ON CDD_AUTH_PROV_GUID = OP_PVDR_GUID WHERE CDD_CANCEL_IND <> '1' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND <> '1' AND UPPER(CDD_DOC_NAME) like '%OPERAT%' AND (UPPER(OP_DISPLAY_NAME) LIKE '%AGRUSA%' OR UPPER(OP_DISPLAY_NAME) LIKE '%CONNOLLY%PETER%' OR UPPER(OP_DISPLAY_NAME) LIKE '%DERUBERTIS%' OR UPPER(OP_DISPLAY_NAME) LIKE '%ELLOZY%') ORDER BY 4, 2, 1

prompt: Provide a list of Dr. Robert Allen, Jr.'s patients who have had an appointment with him at Monmouth (MON PLA).
completion: WITH PTS AS (SELECT DISTINCT CPP_CL_PT_ID, CPE_ENC_CSN_ID, CPE_ENC_DTE_SEQ, CPE_MRN, CPE_ENC_DTE, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8, CLD_DEPT_NAME, CRE_RES_NAME, CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME, CVT_EXT_NAME, CASE WHEN CPE_CPE_APPT_STS = 'Sch' THEN 'Scheduled' ELSE 'Completed' END AS TYPE, CPP_PT_NAME, CPP_ADDR1, CPP_ADDR2, CPP_CITY, CPP_STATE, CPP_ZIP_CD, CPP_PP_LST_LGN_DTE, CPP_DEATH_DTE, AV_DESC AS PRIMARY_LANG, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID JOIN IDB.CL_PAS_PATIENT ON CPP_CL_PT_ID = CPE_CL_PT_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PT_MRN = CPE_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS ON PT_PRIMARY_LANG = AV_CODE AND AV_ELEMENT = 'PRIMARY_LANG' WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp', 'Sch') AND CRE_RES_ID = '021204' AND CLD_CLD_CENTER = 'MON' AND CPP_DEATH_DTE IS NULL ) , MOST_RECENT AS (SELECT CPP_CL_PT_ID, CPE_ENC_DTE_SEQ, CPE_ENC_CSN_ID, CPE_MRN, CPE_ENC_DTE, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8, CLD_DEPT_NAME, CRE_RES_NAME, CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME, CVT_EXT_NAME, TYPE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CPP_CL_PT_ID ORDER BY CPE_ENC_DTE DESC) AS RN FROM PTS WHERE TYPE = 'Completed' ) , NEXT_VISIT AS (SELECT CPP_CL_PT_ID, CPE_ENC_DTE_SEQ, CPE_ENC_CSN_ID, CPE_MRN, CPE_ENC_DTE, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8, CLD_DEPT_NAME, CRE_RES_NAME, CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME, CVT_EXT_NAME, TYPE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CPP_CL_PT_ID ORDER BY CPE_ENC_DTE DESC) AS RN FROM PTS WHERE TYPE = 'Scheduled' ) , NEXT_VISIT_AGGREGATES AS (SELECT CPP_CL_PT_ID, CPE_MRN, CRE_RES_NAME, TRIM(LISTAGG(TRIM(CPE_ENC_DTE) || ', ') WITHIN GROUP( ORDER BY CPP_CL_PT_ID)) AS CPE_ENC_DTE, TRIM(LISTAGG(TRIM(CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME) || ', ') WITHIN GROUP( ORDER BY CPP_CL_PT_ID)) AS CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME FROM NEXT_VISIT GROUP BY CPP_CL_PT_ID, CPE_MRN, CRE_RES_NAME) SELECT DISTINCT A.CPE_MRN "MRN", A.CRE_RES_NAME "Provider", A.PT_LAST_NAME "PT Last Name", A.PT_FIRST_NAME "PT First Name", A.CPP_ADDR1 "Address 1", A.CPP_ADDR2 "Address 2", A.CPP_CITY "City", A.CPP_STATE "State", A.CPP_ZIP_CD "Zip Code", A.PRIMARY_LANG "Language", B.CPE_ENC_DTE "Last Appt Dte", B.CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 "Last Appt Dept", B.CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME "Last Appt Visit Type", C.CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 "Next Appt Dept", C1.CRE_RES_NAME "Next Appt Provider", C1.CPE_ENC_DTE "Next Appt Dte", C1.CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME "Next Appt Visit Type", PLA.PLA_DONOT_MAIL_IND "Do Not Mail Ind" FROM (SELECT DISTINCT CPP_CL_PT_ID, CPE_MRN, CRE_RES_NAME, CPP_ADDR1, CPP_ADDR2, CPP_CITY, CPP_STATE, CPP_ZIP_CD, CPP_PP_LST_LGN_DTE, PRIMARY_LANG, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME FROM PTS) A LEFT JOIN MOST_RECENT B ON A.CPP_CL_PT_ID = B.CPP_CL_PT_ID AND B.RN = 1 LEFT JOIN NEXT_VISIT C ON A.CPP_CL_PT_ID = C.CPP_CL_PT_ID AND C.RN = 1 LEFT JOIN NEXT_VISIT_AGGREGATES C1 ON C.CPP_CL_PT_ID = C1.CPP_CL_PT_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY PLA ON A.CPE_MRN = PLA.PLA_MRN ;

prompt: Please provide a list of all new breast medicine and breast surgery visits per week.
completion: SELECT DISTINCT TRIM(PT_MRN) AS PT_MRN, TRIM(PT_LAST_NAME) || ', ' || TRIM(PT_FIRST_NAME) AS PATIENTS_NAME, CPE_ENC_DTE AS NEXT_APPT_DATE, TRIM(CRE_EXT_RES_NAME) AS EXT_RES_NAME, CLD_DEPT_NAME, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 FROM IDB.PATIENT JOIN IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER ON PT_MRN = CPE_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 = 'BRE' AND CRE_RES_TYP = 'Physician' AND CPE_CPE_APPT_STS = 'Sch' AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 IN ('SRG', 'MED') AND CPE_ENC_DTE = CURRENT DATE + 7 DAY

prompt: Provide a list of patients with metastatic disease to bone who have had "failure" of radiation therapy treatment to a metastasis.
completion: WITH DX AS (SELECT TM_MRN AS MRN, TM_DX_DTE AS DX_DATE, TM_HIST_CD AS HIST_CODE, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS HIST_DESC, TM_SITE_CD AS SITE_CODE, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_DESC FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM H ON TM_HIST_CD = H.CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON TM_SITE_CD = S.CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND TM_DX_DTE BETWEEN '2015-01-01' AND '2018-12-31' ) , METS AS (SELECT DISTINCT DX.*, CLM_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK, INIT_METS_DATE FROM (SELECT CC_MRN, CLM_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS INIT_METS_DATE FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND ((CC_PT_TYPE = 'I') OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) AND (CC_CLSF_CD = 'C79.51' OR CC_CLSF_CD = '198.5') GROUP BY CC_MRN, CLM_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK HAVING MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) BETWEEN '2015-01-01' AND '2018-12-31') M JOIN DX ON MRN = CC_MRN) , RT AS (SELECT DISTINCT RTC_TX_MRN AS MRN, RTC_TX_PLAN_NAME, RTC_PRIMARY_REF_POINT, RTC_TX_START_DTE, RTC_TX_STOP_DTE, RTC_TX_ELAPSED_DAYS, RTC_TX_PLANNED_FRACTIONS, RTC_TX_DELIVERED_FRACTIONS, RTC_TX_PLANNED_DOSE, RTC_TX_DELIVERED_DOSE, RTC_DOSE_CORRECTION FROM IDB.RADONC_TREATMENT_COURSE JOIN METS ON RTC_TX_MRN = MRN) SELECT CLM_CLSF_CD AS CPT_CODE, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS CPT_DESC, COUNT(DISTINCT PBD_MRN) FROM RT JOIN IDB.PBD_DTL ON MRN = PBD_MRN JOIN IDB.PBD_CODE ON PBD_PBD_CD = PBC_PBD_CD JOIN IDB.CLM ON PBC_CPT_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE(PBC_CPT_CD BETWEEN '77401' AND '77416' OR PBC_CPT_CD BETWEEN '77385' AND '77386' OR PBC_CPT_CD IN ('77373', '77387', 'G6001', 'G6002', 'G6017', '77014')) GROUP BY CLM_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK SELECT CLM_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC, COUNT(DISTINCT CC_MRN) FROM RT JOIN IDB.CTC_CLSF ON MRN = CC_MRN JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE CC_CLSF_CD IN ('Z51.0') OR CC_CLSF_CD LIKE '%DP00%' OR CC_CLSF_CD LIKE '%DP01%' OR CC_CLSF_CD LIKE '%DP02%' OR CC_CLSF_CD LIKE '%DP03%' OR CC_CLSF_CD LIKE '%DP04%' OR CC_CLSF_CD LIKE '%DP05%' OR CC_CLSF_CD LIKE '%DP06%' OR CC_CLSF_CD LIKE '%DP07%' OR CC_CLSF_CD LIKE '%DP08%' OR CC_CLSF_CD LIKE '%DP09%' OR CC_CLSF_CD LIKE '%DP0B%' OR CC_CLSF_CD LIKE '%DP0C%' OR CC_CLSF_CD LIKE '%0P0%' OR CC_CLSF_CD LIKE '%0P1%' OR CC_CLSF_CD LIKE '%0P2%' OR CC_CLSF_CD LIKE '%0P3%' OR CC_CLSF_CD LIKE '%0P4%' OR CC_CLSF_CD LIKE '%0P5%' OR CC_CLSF_CD LIKE '%0P6%' OR CC_CLSF_CD LIKE '%0P7%' OR CC_CLSF_CD LIKE '%0P8%' OR CC_CLSF_CD LIKE '%0P9%' OR CC_CLSF_CD LIKE '%0PB%' OR CC_CLSF_CD LIKE '%0PC%' OR CC_CLSF_CD LIKE '%0Q0%' OR CC_CLSF_CD LIKE '%0Q1%' OR CC_CLSF_CD LIKE '%0Q2%' OR CC_CLSF_CD LIKE '%0Q3%' OR CC_CLSF_CD LIKE '%0Q4%' OR CC_CLSF_CD LIKE '%0Q5%' OR CC_CLSF_CD LIKE '%0Q6%' OR CC_CLSF_CD LIKE '%0Q7%' OR CC_CLSF_CD LIKE '%0Q8%' OR CC_CLSF_CD LIKE '%0Q9%' OR CC_CLSF_CD LIKE '%0QB%' OR CC_CLSF_CD LIKE '%0QC%' GROUP BY CLM_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC

prompt: Provide a list of patients with Merkel cell carcinoma, diagnosed between 2000-2019, separated by Caucasian and non-Caucasian per provided demographic data
completion: WITH DX AS (SELECT TM_MRN, CS.AV_DESC AS CASE_STS, TM_DX_DTE, TM_HIST_CD, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS HIST_DESC, TM_SITE_CD, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_DESC, TM_BEST_AJCC_STG, TM_FIRST_RECUR_DTE, R.AV_DESC AS RECUR_TYPE FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS CS ON CS.AV_ELEMENT = 'CASE_STS' AND CS.AV_CODE = TM_CASE_STS JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS R ON TM_FIRST_RECUR_TYP = R.AV_CODE AND R.AV_ELEMENT = 'FIRST_RECUR_TYP' WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK like '%MERKEL%' AND TM_DX_DTE BETWEEN '2000-01-01' AND '2019-12-31' ) , DEMO AS (SELECT PT_MRN , PT_LAST_NAME AS "Last Name" , PT_FIRST_NAME AS "First Name" , PT_SEX AS "Gender" , PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH AS "Date of Birth" , PT_DATE_OF_DEATH AS "Date of Death" , R.AV_DESC AS "Race (Reg)" , E.AV_DESC AS "Ethnicity (Reg)" , CR.AV_DESC AS "Race (CDB)" , CE.AV_DESC AS "Ethnicity (CDB)" , PLA_LST_APPT_DTE FROM IDB.PATIENT LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS R ON R.AV_ELEMENT = 'RACE' AND R.AV_CODE = PT_RACE LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS E ON E.AV_ELEMENT = 'PT_ETHNICITY' AND E.AV_CODE = PT_PT_ETHNICITY LEFT JOIN IDB.CDB_PATIENT ON PT_MRN = CP_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS CR ON CR.AV_ELEMENT = 'CDB_RACE' AND CR.AV_CODE = CP_CDB_RACE LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS CE ON CE.AV_ELEMENT = 'ETHNICITY' AND CE.AV_CODE = CP_ETHNICITY LEFT JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY ON PT_MRN = PLA_MRN) SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN AS "MRN", "Date of Birth", "Date of Death", "Gender", "Race (Reg)", "Ethnicity (Reg)", PLA_LST_APPT_DTE "Last Appt Date", HIST_DESC "Histology", SITE_DESC "Site", TM_DX_DTE "Diagnosis Date", TM_BEST_AJCC_STG "Best Stage", TM_FIRST_RECUR_DTE "Recurrence Date", RECUR_TYPE "Recurrence Type" FROM DEMO JOIN DX ON DEMO.PT_MRN = DX.TM_MRN

prompt: Provide a list of IMPACT blood and IMPACT nails reports for Dr. Diamond between March 2020- present.
completion: SELECT D.PT_MRN, D.PT_LAST_NAME, D.PT_FIRST_NAME, A.PRPT_ACCESSION_NO, A.PRPT_ORD_DR_NAME, A.PRPT_PROCEDURE_DTE, B.GENE, B.GENE2, ABERRATIONTYPE, SEARCH_HIT2 FROM DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V D LEFT JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V A ON PT_MRN = PRPT_MRN LEFT JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_STRUCTURED_RESULTS_V B ON A.PRPT_ACCESSION_NO = B.PRPT_ACCESSION_NO WHERE 1=1 AND CONTAINS(A."PRPT_REPORT", '("MSK-IMPACT")') = 1 AND CONTAINS(A."PRPT_REPORT", '("blood" | "nail")') = 1 AND A.PRPT_PROCEDURE_DTE >= '2020-03-01' AND A.PRPT_ORD_DR_NAME = 'DIAMOND MD,ELI L'

prompt: Provide specified information from Social Work ClinDoc notes.
completion: WITH X AS (SELECT DISTINCT CDD_MRN, CDD_DOC_GUID, MONTH(CDD_SERVICE_DTE) AS MTH, CDD_SERVICE_DTE, CDD_DOC_NAME, CDO_SECTION, CDO_CTLG_DISPL_NM, CDO_MSTR_ITEM_NM, CDO_ITEM_NAME, STRIP(SUBSTR(CDO_VALUE_TEXT, 1, 500)) AS VALUE_TEXT FROM IDB.CD_DOCUMENT JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION ON CDO_DOC_GUID = CDD_DOC_GUID AND CDO_AUTHORED_DTE = CDD_AUTHORED_DTE WHERE CDD_CANCEL_IND = '0' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND = '0' AND CDD_DOC_NAME = 'Nursing Health Assessment - Outpatient' AND CDO_MSTR_ITEM_NM IN ('NUR_Psych made the patient feel afraid RES', 'NUR_Psych stopped the patient from getting food RES', 'NUR_Psych taken advantage of pt RES') AND CDD_SERVICE_DTE BETWEEN '2019-08-01' AND '2019-10-31' ) , X1 AS (SELECT CDD_MRN, CDD_DOC_GUID, CDD_SERVICE_DTE, MTH, CDD_DOC_NAME, MAX(CASE WHEN CDO_MSTR_ITEM_NM = 'NUR_Psych stopped the patient from getting food RES' THEN VALUE_TEXT END) AS "Stopped the patient from getting food", MAX(CASE WHEN CDO_MSTR_ITEM_NM = 'NUR_Psych made the patient feel afraid RES' THEN VALUE_TEXT END) AS "Made the patient feel afraid", MAX(CASE WHEN CDO_MSTR_ITEM_NM = 'NUR_Psych taken advantage of pt RES' THEN VALUE_TEXT END) AS "Taken advantage of pt" FROM X GROUP BY CDD_MRN, CDD_DOC_GUID, CDD_SERVICE_DTE, MTH, CDD_DOC_NAME) , X2 AS (SELECT X1.* FROM X1 WHERE "Stopped the patient from getting food" = 'Yes' OR "Made the patient feel afraid" = 'Yes' OR "Taken advantage of pt" = 'Yes' ) SELECT MTH, COUNT(DISTINCT CDD_MRN) AS "Nursing Health Assessment" FROM X2 GROUP BY MTH WITH Y AS (SELECT DISTINCT CDD_MRN, CDD_DOC_GUID, CDD_SERVICE_DTE, MONTH(CDD_SERVICE_DTE) AS MTH, CDD_DOC_NAME, CDO_SECTION, CDO_CTLG_DISPL_NM, CDO_MSTR_ITEM_NM, CDO_ITEM_NAME, STRIP(SUBSTR(CDO_VALUE_TEXT, 1, 500)) AS VALUE_TEXT FROM IDB.CD_DOCUMENT JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION ON CDO_DOC_GUID = CDD_DOC_GUID AND CDO_AUTHORED_DTE = CDD_AUTHORED_DTE WHERE CDD_CANCEL_IND = '0' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND = '0' AND CDD_DOC_NAME = 'Psychosocial - Social Work' AND CDO_MSTR_ITEM_NM IN ('SW_refer_reas abuse res', 'SW Initial IP Abuse res') AND CDD_SERVICE_DTE BETWEEN '2019-08-01' AND '2019-10-31' ) , YY AS (SELECT CDD_MRN, CDD_DOC_GUID, CDD_SERVICE_DTE, MTH, CDD_DOC_NAME, MAX(CASE WHEN CDO_MSTR_ITEM_NM = 'SW_refer_reas abuse res' THEN VALUE_TEXT END) AS "Referral Reason: Abuse/Neglect:", MAX(CASE WHEN CDO_MSTR_ITEM_NM = 'SW Initial IP Abuse res' THEN VALUE_TEXT END) AS "Psychosocial Assessment and Plan: Abuse/Neglect:" FROM Y GROUP BY CDD_MRN, CDD_DOC_GUID, CDD_SERVICE_DTE, MTH, CDD_DOC_NAME) , YYY AS (SELECT CDD_MRN, CDD_DOC_GUID, CDD_SERVICE_DTE, MTH, CDD_DOC_NAME, MAX(CASE WHEN "Referral Reason: Abuse/Neglect:" LIKE '%At-risk for Domestic Violence%' THEN 'Y' END) AS "At-risk for Domestic Violence", MAX(CASE WHEN "Referral Reason: Abuse/Neglect:" LIKE '%At-risk for Child Abuse/Neglect%' THEN 'Y' END) AS "At-risk for Child Abuse/Neglect", MAX(CASE WHEN "Referral Reason: Abuse/Neglect:" LIKE '%At-risk for Elder Abuse/Neglect%' THEN 'Y' END) AS "At-risk for Elder Abuse/Neglect", MAX(CASE WHEN "Psychosocial Assessment and Plan: Abuse/Neglect:" LIKE '%Assessed Child Abuse/Neglect%' THEN 'Y' END) AS "Assessed Child Abuse/Neglect", MAX(CASE WHEN "Psychosocial Assessment and Plan: Abuse/Neglect:" LIKE '%Assessed for Domestic Violence%' THEN 'Y' END) AS "Assessed for Domestic Violence", MAX(CASE WHEN "Psychosocial Assessment and Plan: Abuse/Neglect:" LIKE '%Assessed for Elder Abuse/Neglect%' THEN 'Y' END) AS "Assessed for Elder Abuse/Neglect" FROM YY GROUP BY CDD_MRN, CDD_DOC_GUID, CDD_SERVICE_DTE, MTH, CDD_DOC_NAME) , YYY1 AS (SELECT * FROM YYY WHERE "At-risk for Domestic Violence" = 'Y' OR "At-risk for Child Abuse/Neglect" = 'Y' OR "At-risk for Elder Abuse/Neglect" = 'Y' ) SELECT MTH, COUNT(DISTINCT CDD_DOC_GUID) AS "At-risk for" FROM YYY1 GROUP BY MTH , YYY2 AS (SELECT * FROM YYY WHERE "Assessed Child Abuse/Neglect" = 'Y' OR "Assessed for Domestic Violence" = 'Y' OR "Assessed for Elder Abuse/Neglect" = 'Y' ) SELECT MTH, COUNT(DISTINCT CDD_DOC_GUID) AS "Assessed for" FROM YYY2 GROUP BY MTH

prompt: Provide a list of patients who had a Pediatric Return to Clinic - Surgery order placed and released between 9/1/2021 - 4/30/23 and what their next follow up date or most recent visit date was
completion: WITH ORDERS AS (SELECT DISTINCT TRIM(OO_MRN) AS OO_MRN, OO_ORD_ID AS "Order ID", OO_ORD_GUID AS "Order GUID", OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE AS "Order Date", OSTS_STS_DESC "Order Status", OSH_CREATE_DTE AS "Order Release Date", OO_ORD_NAME AS "Order Name", CASE WHEN OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'PDH_Return_Date' THEN UPPER(OUD_USER_DI_VALUE) ELSE SUBSTR(OO_ORD_NAME, 20) END NEXT_APPT FROM IDB.OMS_ORDER LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_STS_HX ON OO_ORD_GUID = OSH_ORD_GUID AND OSH_FUNCTION_CD = '105' JOIN IDB.OMS_STATUS ON OO_ORD_STS_CD = OSTS_ORD_STS_CD LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_USER_DATA ON OO_MRN = OUD_MRN AND OO_ORD_GUID = OUD_ORD_GUID AND OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'PDH_Return_Date' JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_FORM_FIELD ON OUD_USER_DI_CD = OFF_DI_CD AND OO_ENTRY_FRM_GUID = OFF_ENTRY_FRM_GUID WHERE OO_ORD_STS_CD NOT IN ('CANC', 'CANP', 'AUC3') AND OSH_CREATE_DTE BETWEEN '2021-09-01' AND '2023-04-30' AND OO_ORD_NAME IN ('PED_Return Visit - SURGERY') ) , LAST_PEDS AS (SELECT CPE_MRN, CPE_ENC_DTE, CRE_RES_NAME, CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME, CLD_DEPT_NAME, CLD_CLD_CENTER, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CPE_MRN ORDER BY CPE_APPT_DT DESC) RN FROM (SELECT DISTINCT OO_MRN FROM ORDERS) JOIN IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER ON OO_MRN = CPE_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND (CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 = ('PED') OR CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_4 = ('PED') OR CLD_DEPT_NAME = 'ORTHOPEDICS 1275-9') AND CPE_CPE_IP_IND <> 'INPATIENT' AND CRE_RES_TYP = 'Physician' ) , NEXT_PEDS_MED AS (SELECT CPE_MRN, CPE_ENC_DTE, CRE_RES_NAME, CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME, CLD_DEPT_NAME, CLD_CLD_CENTER, CASE WHEN ((CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 = ('PED') OR CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_4 = ('PED') OR CLD_DEPT_NAME = 'ORTHOPEDICS 1275-9') AND CPE_CPE_IP_IND <> 'INPATIENT') THEN 'PED' WHEN CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 = 'MED' THEN 'MED' END PED_OR_MED, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CPE_MRN, CASE WHEN ((CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 = ('PED') OR CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_4 = ('PED') OR CLD_DEPT_NAME = 'ORTHOPEDICS 1275-9') AND CPE_CPE_IP_IND <> 'INPATIENT') THEN 'PED' WHEN CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 = 'MED' THEN 'MED' END ORDER BY CPE_APPT_DT DESC) RN FROM (SELECT DISTINCT OO_MRN FROM ORDERS) JOIN IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER ON OO_MRN = CPE_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Sch') AND (((CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 = ('PED') OR CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_4 = ('PED') OR CLD_DEPT_NAME = 'ORTHOPEDICS 1275-9') AND CPE_CPE_IP_IND <> 'INPATIENT') OR CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 = 'MED') AND CRE_RES_TYP = 'Physician' ) SELECT O.*, PT_LAST_NAME LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME FIRST_NAME, L.CPE_ENC_DTE LAST_PEDS_APPT_DATE, L.CRE_RES_NAME LAST_PEDS_MD_SEEN, L.CLD_DEPT_NAME LAST_PEDS_DEPT_SEEN, CASE WHEN PED_OR_MED = 'PED' THEN N.CPE_ENC_DTE END NEXT_PEDS_APPT_DATE, CASE WHEN PED_OR_MED = 'PED' THEN N.CRE_RES_NAME END NEXT_PEDS_MD_SEEN, CASE WHEN PED_OR_MED = 'PED' THEN N.CLD_DEPT_NAME END NEXT_PEDS_DEPT_SEEN, CASE WHEN PED_OR_MED = 'MED' THEN N.CPE_ENC_DTE END NEXT_MED_APPT_DATE, CASE WHEN PED_OR_MED = 'MED' THEN N.CRE_RES_NAME END NEXT_MED_MD_SEEN, CASE WHEN PED_OR_MED = 'MED' THEN N.CLD_DEPT_NAME END NEXT_MED_DEPT_SEEN FROM ORDERS O JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON OO_MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN LAST_PEDS L ON OO_MRN = L.CPE_MRN AND L.RN = 1 LEFT JOIN NEXT_PEDS_MED N ON OO_MRN = N.CPE_MRN AND N.RN = 1

prompt:
Create a query in CIS, for patient with:

visits that contain %Waiting Room% or %Reception%,

and was CANCELLED the previous day,

and have orders with status of ACTIVE or HOLD.
completion: SELECT OCV_MRN, OCV_VISIT_GUID, CHAR(OCV_VISIT_DTE) OCV_VISIT_DTE, CHAR(DATE(OCV_PRCS_DT)) CANCELLED_DTE, OCV_VISIT_STS, OCV_CURR_LOC, OO_REQ_DR_NO, DOC_NAME ORDER_REQ_DR_NAME, OCV_PVDR_NAME VISIT_PROVIDER, OO_ORD_GUID, OO_ORD_NAME, CHAR(OCV_CLOSE_DT) OCV_CLOSE_DT FROM IDB.OMS_CLIENT_VISIT JOIN IDB.OMS_ORDER ON OO_VISIT_GUID = OCV_VISIT_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_STATUS ON OO_ORD_STS_CD = OSTS_ORD_STS_CD JOIN IDB.DOC ON OO_REQ_DR_NO = DOC_DR_NO WHERE (UPPER(OCV_CURR_LOC) LIKE '%WAITING ROOM%' OR UPPER(OCV_CURR_LOC) LIKE '%RECEPTION%') AND OCV_VISIT_DTE > CURRENT date - 3 DAYS AND OCV_VISIT_STS = 'CAN' AND OSTS_STS_DESC IN ('Active', 'Hold') AND DATE(OCV_CLOSE_DT) + 1 DAY = OCV_VISIT_DTE ORDER BY 1

prompt: Provide a weekly list of patients scheduled for a Cystectomy or Nephrectomy procedure within the next 4 weeks for accruing to 23-290.
completion: WITH PROCS AS (SELECT OC_CASE_ID, OC_MRN, OC_SURG_DTE, CRE_RES_NAME, CPX_PROC_CD, CPX_PROC_NAME, OP_OR_PROC_ID, OP_PROC_NAME, OCP_OR_PROC_ID, OCP_LINE_NO, OCP_PROC_ID FROM IDB.OR_CASE JOIN IDB.OR_CASE_ALL_PROC ON OC_CASE_ID = OCAP_CASE_ID JOIN IDB.OR_CASE_ALL_SURG ON OCAP_CASE_ID = OCAS_CASE_ID AND OCAS_PNL_NO = OCAP_PNL_NO AND OCAS_SURG_ROLE = 'Primary' JOIN IDB.OR_PROC ON OCAP_OR_PROC_ID = OP_OR_PROC_ID JOIN IDB.OR_CL_PROC ON OP_OR_PROC_ID = OCP_OR_PROC_ID JOIN IDB.CL_PROC ON OCP_PROC_ID = CPX_PROC_ID JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CRE_RES_ID = OCAS_RES_ID WHERE OC_SURG_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT date AND CURRENT date + 28 DAYS AND OC_OR_CASE_STS_CD NOT IN ('2', '5') AND (CPX_PROC_CD IN ('51550' , '51570' , '51580' , '51555' , '51565' , '51590' , '51575' , '51596' , '51585' , '51595' , '51597' , '50820') OR CPX_PROC_NAME LIKE '%CYSTECTOMY%' OR OP_PROC_NAME LIKE '%CYSTECTOMY%') AND NOT (CPX_PROC_NAME LIKE '%CHOLECYSTECTOMY%' OR OP_PROC_NAME LIKE '%CHOLECYSTECTOMY%') ) , CONSENTS AS (SELECT AC_MRN , MAX(CASE WHEN AC_IRB_NO = '12-245' THEN AC_CONS_DTE END) AS "12-245 Date" , MAX(CASE WHEN AC_IRB_NO = '06-107' THEN AC_CONS_DTE END) AS "06-107 Date" FROM IDB.ACCRUALS JOIN PROCS ON OC_MRN = AC_MRN WHERE AC_IRB_NO IN ('12-245', '06-107') GROUP BY AC_MRN) , PROCS_OUT AS (SELECT DISTINCT STRIP(OC_MRN) AS MRN, STRIP(PT_LAST_NAME) || ', ' || STRIP(PT_FIRST_NAME) AS "Name", PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH AS "Birth Date", CASE WHEN PT_DATE_OF_DEATH IS NULL THEN YEAR(CURRENT date - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) END AS "Cur Age", PLA_LST_CHEMO_DTE AS "Last Chemo Date", OC_SURG_DTE AS "Cystectomy Date", STRIP(CRE_RES_NAME) AS "Surgeon Name" FROM PROCS JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON OC_MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY ON PLA_MRN = PT_MRN ) , LAST_APPT1 AS (SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN, CPE_ENC_DTE, CRE_RES_NAME, CRE_RES_TYP, CLD_DEPT_NAME, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8, CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CPE_MRN ORDER BY CPE_ENC_DTE DESC) AS RN FROM PROCS_OUT JOIN IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER ON CPE_MRN = MRN JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CRE_RES_TYP IN ('Physician') AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 = 'URO' ) , LAST_APPT2 AS (SELECT * FROM LAST_APPT1 WHERE RN = 1 ) , NEXT_APPT1 AS (SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN, CPE_ENC_DTE, CRE_RES_NAME, CRE_RES_TYP, CLD_DEPT_NAME, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8, CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR, CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CPE_MRN ORDER BY CPE_ENC_DTE ASC) AS RN FROM PROCS_OUT JOIN IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER ON CPE_MRN = MRN JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Sch') AND CRE_RES_TYP IN ('Physician') AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 = 'URO' ) , NEXT_APPT2 AS (SELECT * FROM NEXT_APPT1 WHERE RN = 1 ) SELECT DISTINCT P.*, LA2.CPE_ENC_DTE AS "Last URO Appt Date", STRIP(LA2.CRE_RES_NAME) AS "Last URO Physician", NA2.CPE_ENC_DTE AS "Next URO Appt Date", STRIP(NA2.CRE_RES_NAME) AS "Next URO Physician" , "12-245 Date" , "06-107 Date" FROM PROCS_OUT P LEFT JOIN LAST_APPT2 LA2 ON MRN = LA2.CPE_MRN LEFT JOIN NEXT_APPT2 NA2 ON MRN = NA2.CPE_MRN LEFT JOIN CONSENTS ON AC_MRN = MRN ORDER BY "Cystectomy Date", MRN ; WITH PROCS AS (SELECT OC_CASE_ID, OC_MRN, OC_SURG_DTE, CRE_RES_NAME, CPX_PROC_CD, CPX_PROC_NAME, OP_OR_PROC_ID, OP_PROC_NAME, OCP_OR_PROC_ID, OCP_LINE_NO, OCP_PROC_ID FROM IDB.OR_CASE JOIN IDB.OR_CASE_ALL_PROC ON OC_CASE_ID = OCAP_CASE_ID JOIN IDB.OR_CASE_ALL_SURG ON OCAP_CASE_ID = OCAS_CASE_ID AND OCAS_PNL_NO = OCAP_PNL_NO AND OCAS_SURG_ROLE = 'Primary' JOIN IDB.OR_PROC ON OCAP_OR_PROC_ID = OP_OR_PROC_ID JOIN IDB.OR_CL_PROC ON OP_OR_PROC_ID = OCP_OR_PROC_ID JOIN IDB.CL_PROC ON OCP_PROC_ID = CPX_PROC_ID JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CRE_RES_ID = OCAS_RES_ID WHERE OC_SURG_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT date AND CURRENT date + 28 DAYS AND OC_OR_CASE_STS_CD NOT IN ('2', '5') AND (CPX_PROC_CD IN ('50220' , '50225' , '50230' , '50234' , '50236' , '50240' , '50543' , '50545' , '50546' , '50548') OR CPX_PROC_NAME LIKE '%NEPHRECTOMY%' OR OP_PROC_NAME LIKE '%NEPHRECTOMY%') ) , CONSENTS AS (SELECT AC_MRN , MAX(CASE WHEN AC_IRB_NO = '12-245' THEN AC_CONS_DTE END) AS "12-245 Date" , MAX(CASE WHEN AC_IRB_NO = '06-107' THEN AC_CONS_DTE END) AS "06-107 Date" FROM IDB.ACCRUALS JOIN PROCS ON OC_MRN = AC_MRN WHERE AC_IRB_NO IN ('12-245', '06-107') GROUP BY AC_MRN) , PROCS_OUT AS (SELECT DISTINCT STRIP(OC_MRN) AS MRN, STRIP(PT_LAST_NAME) || ', ' || STRIP(PT_FIRST_NAME) AS "Name", PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH AS "Birth Date", CASE WHEN PT_DATE_OF_DEATH IS NULL THEN YEAR(CURRENT date - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) END AS "Cur Age", PLA_LST_CHEMO_DTE AS "Last Chemo Date", OC_SURG_DTE AS "Nephrectomy Date", STRIP(CRE_RES_NAME) AS "Surgeon Name" FROM PROCS JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON OC_MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY ON PLA_MRN = PT_MRN ) , LAST_APPT1 AS (SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN, CPE_ENC_DTE, CRE_RES_NAME, CRE_RES_TYP, CLD_DEPT_NAME, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8, CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CPE_MRN ORDER BY CPE_ENC_DTE DESC) AS RN FROM PROCS_OUT JOIN IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER ON CPE_MRN = MRN JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CRE_RES_TYP IN ('Physician') AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 = 'URO' ) , LAST_APPT2 AS (SELECT * FROM LAST_APPT1 WHERE RN = 1 ) , NEXT_APPT1 AS (SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN, CPE_ENC_DTE, CRE_RES_NAME, CRE_RES_TYP, CLD_DEPT_NAME, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8, CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR, CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CPE_MRN ORDER BY CPE_ENC_DTE ASC) AS RN FROM PROCS_OUT JOIN IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER ON CPE_MRN = MRN JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Sch') AND CRE_RES_TYP IN ('Physician') AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 = 'URO' ) , NEXT_APPT2 AS (SELECT * FROM NEXT_APPT1 WHERE RN = 1 ) SELECT DISTINCT P.*, LA2.CPE_ENC_DTE AS "Last URO Appt Date", STRIP(LA2.CRE_RES_NAME) AS "Last URO Physician", NA2.CPE_ENC_DTE AS "Next URO Appt Date", STRIP(NA2.CRE_RES_NAME) AS "Next URO Physician" , "12-245 Date" , "06-107 Date" FROM PROCS_OUT P LEFT JOIN LAST_APPT2 LA2 ON MRN = LA2.CPE_MRN LEFT JOIN NEXT_APPT2 NA2 ON MRN = NA2.CPE_MRN LEFT JOIN CONSENTS ON AC_MRN = MRN ORDER BY "Nephrectomy Date", MRN

prompt: Provide an email list of all patients currently on 22-175
completion: SELECT DISTINCT AC_MRN, PT_EMAIL_ADDRESS, AC_NON_MSK_INST, AC_LAST_NAME, AC_FIRST_NAME, AC_IRB_NO, AC_CONS_DTE, ACD_OFF_STUDY_DTE, AC_PVDR_OF_RECORD_NAME FROM IDB.ACCRUALS JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON AC_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.ACCRUALS_DATES ON AC_MRN = ACD_MRN AND AC_IRB_NO = ACD_IRB_NO WHERE AC_IRB_NO IN ('22-175') ;

prompt: List of all patients diagnosed with PTCL AND T-LGL
completion: WITH CTE AS (SELECT DISTINCT CC_MRN MRN FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE (SUBSTR(CC_CLSF_CD, 1, 3) IN ('C84') OR SUBSTR(CC_CLSF_CD, 1, 5) IN ('202.7')) AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND (CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) ) SELECT DISTINCT CC_MRN "MRN", MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS "Dx Coding Date", CC_CLSF_CD AS "ICD Code", CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS "ICD Description" FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN CTE ON CC_MRN = MRN WHERE SUBSTR(CC_CLSF_CD, 1, 5) IN ('C91.Z', 'C91.9', '204.8', '204.9') AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND (CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) GROUP BY CC_MRN, CC_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK

prompt: Provide a notification when a patient potentially qualifies for 22-166 based on tumor type and scheduled scans.
completion: WITH PREP AS (SELECT OTR_RELEASE_NAME, OTR_RELEASE_DATE, OTTT_CODE, OTTT_NAME, OTTT_MAINTYPENAME, OTTT_TISSUE FROM (SELECT OTR_RELEASE_NAME, OTR_RELEASE_DATE, OTTT_CODE, OTTT_NAME, OTTT_MAINTYPENAME, OTTT_TISSUE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY OTTT_CODE ORDER BY CASE WHEN OTR_RELEASE_NAME = 'oncotree_latest_stable' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END DESC, OTR_RELEASE_DATE DESC) RN FROM DSGTOOLS.ONCOTREE_TUMORTYPE_V WHERE OTR_RELEASE_NAME NOT IN ('oncotree_development', 'oncotree_candidate_release') ) WHERE RN = 1 ) , X AS (SELECT PDWS_NAME, PDRX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID AS DEID, PT_MRN, PT_BIRTH_DTE AS DOB, PDRX_ACCESSION_NO, PDRX_DMP_PATIENT_ID, PDRX_DMP_SAMPLE_ID, OTR_RELEASE_NAME, OTTT_TISSUE, OTTT_MAINTYPENAME, TUMOR_TYPE_CODE, TUMOR_TYPE_NAME, PRIMARY_SITE, IS_METASTASIS, METASTASIS_SITE, MSI_TYPE, MSI_SCORE, DV.TODATE(DT_PROCEDURE) AS "Procedure Date" FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML INNER JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML_SETTINGS ON PDRX_PATH_DMP_RESULTS_XML_ID = PDRXS_PATH_DMP_RESULTS_XML_ID INNER JOIN DVDMC.PATHOLOGY_DMP_WEBSVC_SETTINGS ON PDRXS_SETTING_ID = PDWS_SETTING_ID INNER JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON PDRX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID, XMLTABLE('$c/root/meta-data' PASSING PDRX_XML_VALUE AS "c" COLUMNS TUMOR_TYPE_CODE VARCHAR(100) PATH 'tumor_type_code', TUMOR_TYPE_NAME VARCHAR(255) PATH 'tumor_type_name', MSI_SCORE VARCHAR(100) PATH 'msi-score', MSI_TYPE VARCHAR(100) PATH 'msi-type', MSI_COMMENT VARCHAR(100) PATH 'msi-comment', PRIMARY_SITE VARCHAR(255) PATH 'primary_site', IS_METASTASIS VARCHAR(10) PATH 'is_metastasis', METASTASIS_SITE VARCHAR(255) PATH 'metastasis_site', DT_PROCEDURE VARCHAR(40) PATH '../meta-data/dt_procedure') T INNER JOIN PREP ON TUMOR_TYPE_CODE = OTTT_CODE WHERE 1=1 AND PDWS_NAME not like '%HEME%' AND(TUMOR_TYPE_CODE IN ('CCRCC', 'MEL', 'NSCLC') OR(UPPER(OTTT_MAINTYPENAME) like '%OVARIAN CANCER%' AND TUMOR_TYPE_CODE NOT IN ('OGCT', 'SCST', 'SCCO', 'OCS', 'BTOV', 'MBOV', 'CCBOV', 'MOV', 'SBOV', 'SBMOV')) OR(UPPER(OTTT_MAINTYPENAME) like '%CERVICAL CANCER%' AND TUMOR_TYPE_CODE NOT IN ('CELI', 'CERMS', 'CENE', 'GCEMU', 'SCCE')) OR(TUMOR_TYPE_CODE = 'HNSC' AND UPPER(PRIMARY_SITE) not like '%SALIVARY GLAND%' AND UPPER(PRIMARY_SITE) not like '%NASOPHARYNX%' AND UPPER(PRIMARY_SITE) not like '%NEUROENDOCRINE%') OR UPPER(MSI_TYPE) like '%INSTABLE%') AND TUMOR_TYPE_NAME <> 'Tubular Adenoma of the Colon' ) , Y AS (SELECT DISTINCT X.DEID, X.PT_MRN, X.TUMOR_TYPE_CODE, GENE, RESULT, METHOD FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_STRUCTURED_RESULTS_V V JOIN X ON V.PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = X.DEID WHERE TUMOR_TYPE_CODE = 'NSCLC' AND GENE IN ('EGFR', 'ALK', 'RET', 'ROS1') ) , Z AS (SELECT DISTINCT X.* FROM X LEFT JOIN Y ON X.DEID = Y.DEID AND X.TUMOR_TYPE_CODE = Y.TUMOR_TYPE_CODE WHERE Y.DEID IS NULL AND Y.TUMOR_TYPE_CODE IS NULL ) SELECT DISTINCT Z.* FROM Z

prompt: Provide the number of patients diagnosed with metastatic melanoma to the liver between January 1993 and January 2013
completion: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT MMS_MRN) FROM IDB.MEL_METASTAT_SITES WHERE MMS_SITE_DESC = 'Liver' AND DATE(MMS_SITE_DT) BETWEEN '1993-01-01' AND '2012-12-31'

prompt: IS21345 Prod Monthly (Every Month)
completion: WITH TIMES AS (SELECT OL_LOG_ID, OL_MRN, OL_SURG_DTE AS SURGDATE, OLAS_PNL_NO, CRE_RES_ID, CRE_RES_NAME AS SURGEON, OLAS_SURG_ROLE, OLAS_SURG_SVC AS SURGSVC, OL_NO_OF_PNLS TTL_PANELS, SSE_PT_IN_DT AS PT_IN_ROOM_TIME, MIN(CASE WHEN OLPT_PNL_EVNT_CD = '100' THEN OLPT_EVNT_IN_DT END) AS PREP_START_TIME, MIN(CASE WHEN OLAS_PNL_NO = 1 THEN SSE_PT_IN_DT ELSE CASE WHEN OLPT_PNL_EVNT_CD = '100' THEN OLPT_EVNT_IN_DT END END) AS START_TIME, MAX(CASE WHEN OLPT_PNL_EVNT_CD = '300' THEN OLPT_EVNT_IN_DT END) AS END_TIME FROM IDB.OR_LOG JOIN IDB.OR_LOG_ALL_SURG ON OL_LOG_ID = OLAS_LOG_ID JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON OLAS_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.OR_LOG_PANEL_TIMES ON OLPT_LOG_ID = OL_LOG_ID AND OLPT_PNL_NO = OLAS_PNL_NO JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT ON OL_LOG_ID = SSE_LOG_ID WHERE OL_LOG_STS_CD NOT IN ('4', '6') AND OL_SURG_DTE >= CURRENT DATE - (DAYOFYEAR(CURRENT DATE)-1)DAY AND OLAS_SURG_ROLE IN ('Assist', 'Co-Surgeon', 'Cons Surgeon', 'Ext Attend', 'Primary') AND OLAS_SURG_SVC NOT IN ('IR', 'ANES') GROUP BY OL_LOG_ID, OL_MRN, OL_SURG_DTE, OL_NO_OF_PNLS, OLAS_PNL_NO, CRE_RES_ID, CRE_RES_NAME, OLAS_SURG_ROLE, OLAS_SURG_SVC, SSE_PT_IN_DT ) , SURGEON AS (SELECT OL_LOG_ID LOG_ID , MAX(CASE WHEN OLAS_PNL_NO = 1 AND OLAS_SURG_ROLE = 'Primary' THEN SURGEON END) PRIMARY_SURGEON , MAX(CASE WHEN OLAS_PNL_NO = 1 AND OLAS_SURG_ROLE = 'Co-Surgeon' THEN SURGEON END) PNL1_COSURGEON , MAX(CASE WHEN OLAS_PNL_NO = 1 AND OLAS_SURG_ROLE = 'Assist' THEN SURGEON END) PNL1_ASSIST , MAX(CASE WHEN OLAS_PNL_NO = 2 AND OLAS_SURG_ROLE = 'Primary' THEN SURGEON END) PNL2_SURGEON , MAX(CASE WHEN OLAS_PNL_NO = 2 AND OLAS_SURG_ROLE = 'Co-Surgeon' THEN SURGEON END) PNL2_COSURGEON , MAX(CASE WHEN OLAS_PNL_NO = 2 AND OLAS_SURG_ROLE = 'Assist' THEN SURGEON END) PNL2_ASSIST , MAX(CASE WHEN OLAS_PNL_NO = 3 AND OLAS_SURG_ROLE = 'Primary' THEN SURGEON END) PNL3_SURGEON , MAX(CASE WHEN OLAS_PNL_NO = 3 AND OLAS_SURG_ROLE = 'Co-Surgeon' THEN SURGEON END) PNL3_COSURGEON , MAX(CASE WHEN OLAS_PNL_NO = 3 AND OLAS_SURG_ROLE = 'Assist' THEN SURGEON END) PNL3_ASSIST , MAX(CASE WHEN OLAS_PNL_NO = 4 AND OLAS_SURG_ROLE = 'Primary' THEN SURGEON END) PNL4_SURGEON , MAX(CASE WHEN OLAS_PNL_NO = 4 AND OLAS_SURG_ROLE = 'Co-Surgeon' THEN SURGEON END) PNL4_COSURGEON , MAX(CASE WHEN OLAS_PNL_NO = 4 AND OLAS_SURG_ROLE = 'Assist' THEN SURGEON END) PNL4_ASSIST FROM TIMES GROUP BY OL_LOG_ID) SELECT DISTINCT A.OL_LOG_ID AS "Log ID", A.OL_MRN AS MRN, A.SURGDATE AS "Surgery Date", A.TTL_PANELS AS " Total Panels", C.PRIMARY_SURGEON "Primary Surgeon", C.PNL1_COSURGEON "Panel 1 Co-Surgeon", C.PNL1_ASSIST "Panel 1 Assist", C.PNL2_SURGEON "Panel 2 Surgeon", C.PNL2_COSURGEON "Panel 2 Co-Surgeon", C.PNL2_ASSIST "Panel 2 Assist", C.PNL3_SURGEON "Panel 3 Surgeon", C.PNL3_COSURGEON "Panel 3 Co-Surgeon", C.PNL3_ASSIST "Panel 3 Assist", C.PNL4_SURGEON "Panel 4 Surgeon", C.PNL4_COSURGEON "Panel 4 Co-Surgeon", C.PNL4_ASSIST "Panel 4 Assist", A.OLAS_PNL_NO AS "Panel Number", A.SURGEON AS "Surgeon", A.OLAS_SURG_ROLE AS "Role", A.SURGSVC AS "Service", A.START_TIME AS "Start Timestamp", A.END_TIME AS "End Timestamp", B.OL_LOG_ID AS "Log ID", B.SURGDATE AS "Surgery Date", B.TTL_PANELS AS " Total Panels", D.PRIMARY_SURGEON "Primary Surgeon", D.PNL1_COSURGEON "Panel 1 Co-Surgeon", D.PNL1_ASSIST "Panel 1 Assist", D.PNL2_SURGEON "Panel 2 Surgeon", D.PNL2_COSURGEON "Panel 2 Co-Surgeon", D.PNL2_ASSIST "Panel 2 Assist", D.PNL3_SURGEON "Panel 3 Surgeon", D.PNL3_COSURGEON "Panel 3 Co-Surgeon", D.PNL3_ASSIST "Panel 3 Assist", D.PNL4_SURGEON "Panel 4 Surgeon", D.PNL4_COSURGEON "Panel 4 Co-Surgeon", D.PNL4_ASSIST "Panel 4 Assist", B.OLAS_PNL_NO AS "Panel Number", B.SURGEON AS "Surgeon", B.OLAS_SURG_ROLE AS "Role", B.SURGSVC AS "Service", B.START_TIME AS "Start Timestamp", B.END_TIME AS "End Timestamp" FROM TIMES A JOIN TIMES B ON A.CRE_RES_ID = B.CRE_RES_ID LEFT JOIN SURGEON C ON A.OL_LOG_ID = C.LOG_ID LEFT JOIN SURGEON D ON B.OL_LOG_ID = D.LOG_ID WHERE ((DATE(A.END_TIME) = DATE(B.START_TIME) - 1 DAY AND TIME(A.END_TIME) > '23:29:59') OR (DATE(A.END_TIME) = DATE(B.START_TIME) AND TIME(A.END_TIME) < '08:00:00' AND NOT (DATE(A.START_TIME) = DATE(B.START_TIME) AND TIME(A.START_TIME) >= '05:00:00'))) AND TIME(B.START_TIME) BETWEEN '05:00:00' AND '8:00:00' ORDER BY A.OL_LOG_ID, A.OLAS_PNL_NO, A.OLAS_SURG_ROLE DESC, B.START_TIME, B.OL_LOG_ID, B.OLAS_SURG_ROLE DESC ; WITH DTL AS (SELECT OL_LOG_ID, OL_SURG_DTE AS SURGDATE, OLAS_PNL_NO, CRE_RES_ID, CRE_RES_NAME AS SURGEON, OLAS_SURG_ROLE, OLAS_SURG_SVC AS SURGSVC, SSE_PT_IN_DT AS PT_IN_ROOM_TIME, MIN(CASE WHEN OLPT_PNL_EVNT_CD = '100' THEN OLPT_EVNT_IN_DT END) AS PREP_START_TIME, MIN(CASE WHEN OLAS_PNL_NO = 1 THEN SSE_PT_IN_DT ELSE CASE WHEN OLPT_PNL_EVNT_CD = '100' THEN OLPT_EVNT_IN_DT END END) AS START_TIME, MAX(CASE WHEN OLPT_PNL_EVNT_CD = '300' THEN OLPT_EVNT_IN_DT END) AS END_TIME FROM IDB.OR_LOG JOIN IDB.OR_LOG_ALL_SURG ON OL_LOG_ID = OLAS_LOG_ID JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON OLAS_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.OR_LOG_PANEL_TIMES ON OLPT_LOG_ID = OL_LOG_ID AND OLPT_PNL_NO = OLAS_PNL_NO JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT ON OL_LOG_ID = SSE_LOG_ID WHERE OL_LOG_STS_CD NOT IN ('4', '6') AND OL_SURG_DTE OLAS_SURG_ROLE, OLAS_SURG_SVC, SSE_PT_IN_DT) SELECT SURGSVC, COUNT(*) AS SVC_CASE_COUNT , COUNT(CASE WHEN OLAS_PNL_NO= 1 THEN OL_LOG_ID END) CASE_VOLUME_CNT FROM DTL GROUP BY SURGSVC ORDER BY 1;

prompt: Provide a list of patients who received extended rectal resections.

prompt: Provide a review of 2020 and 2021 inpatient endoscopies and IR procedures performed that were subsequently discharged within 48 hours.
completion: SELECT OO_MRN AS "MRN", OO_ORD_STS_CD, OO_SET_NAME, OOC_ITEM_NAME, VIS_ADM_DTE AS ADMISSION_DATE, OO_ENTER_DTE AS "ORDER_ENTERED_DATE", OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE AS "ENDOSCOPY_DATE", CASE WHEN DAYOFWEEK(OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE) = 2 THEN 'Monday' WHEN DAYOFWEEK(OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE) = 3 THEN 'Tuesday' ELSE 'na' END "ENDOSCOPY_DAY", VIS_DSCH_DTE AS "DISCHARGE_DATE", CASE WHEN DAYOFWEEK(VIS_DSCH_DTE) = 1 THEN 'Sunday' WHEN DAYOFWEEK(VIS_DSCH_DTE) = 2 THEN 'Monday' WHEN DAYOFWEEK(VIS_DSCH_DTE) = 3 THEN 'Tuesday' WHEN DAYOFWEEK(VIS_DSCH_DTE) = 4 THEN 'Wednesday' WHEN DAYOFWEEK(VIS_DSCH_DTE) = 5 THEN 'Thursday' WHEN DAYOFWEEK(VIS_DSCH_DTE) = 6 THEN 'Friday' WHEN DAYOFWEEK(VIS_DSCH_DTE) = 7 THEN 'Saturday' ELSE '' END "DISCHARGE_DAY" FROM IDB.OMS_ORDER JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_CATALOG ON OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID = OOC_MSTR_ITEM_GUID LEFT JOIN IDB.VISIT ON VIS_MRN = OO_MRN WHERE 1=1 AND (OOC_ITEM_NAME IN ('Endoscopy Inpatient Request') OR OO_SET_NAME = 'Interventional Radiology') AND VIS_VISIT_STATUS IN ('2', '3') AND VIS_IP_OP_ADJUSTED_IND = 'I' AND OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE BETWEEN VIS_ADM_DTE AND VIS_DSCH_DTE AND OO_ORD_STS_CD NOT IN ('CANP', 'CANC', 'AUC3') AND YEAR(OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE) = '2021' AND DAYOFWEEK(OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE) IN (2, 3)

prompt: The number of Pediatric admissions from  July 1, 2012 to June 30, 2015
completion: WITH "cte1" AS (SELECT DISTINCT "t1"."PT_MRN" AS "MRN", "t2"."DT_DTE" AS "Admission Date", "t3"."HSVC_HOSP_SVC_DESC" AS "Adm Hospital Service", "t2"."DT_YEAR" AS "Admission Year" FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V" "t1" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED" "t4" ON "t1"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t4"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."HOSPITAL_STAY" "t5" ON "t4"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t5"."HS_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" "t2" ON "t5"."HS_ADM_DATE_ID" = "t2"."DT_DATE_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."COMBINED_ADMISSION_CENSUS_V" "t6" ON "t5"."HS_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t6"."CAC_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AND "t5"."HS_ACCT_NO" = "t6"."CAC_ACCT_NO" LEFT JOIN "DV"."HOSPITAL_SERVICE_V" "t3" ON "t6"."CAC_HOSP_SVC_ID" = "t3"."HSVC_HOSP_SVC_ID" WHERE ("t2"."DT_DTE" BETWEEN '2012-7-1' AND '2015-6-30' AND "t3"."HSVC_HOSP_SVC_DESC" IN ('PEDIATRICS', 'PEDIATRICS - BLUE TEAM', 'PEDIATRICS - GREEN TEAM', 'PEDIATRICS - OBSV UNIT', 'PEDIATRICS - PINK TEAM')) ) SELECT "t7"."Admission Year" AS "Admission Year-LBL-2", COUNT(DISTINCT("t7"."MRN")) AS "UNIQUE COUNT (MRN)" FROM "cte1" "t7" GROUP BY "t7"."Admission Year"

prompt: Investigate Employee and Patient COVID Vaccine mismatch
completion: WITH P AS (SELECT CEVE_MRN AS MRN FROM IDB.COVID19_PATIENT_CP_VACCINE_EMAR JOIN IDB.COVID19_EMPLOYEE_VACCINE_EMAR ON CPVE_MRN = CEVE_MRN) , PT AS (SELECT CPVE_MRN, CPVE_PT_TYPE, CPVE_ADMIN_DT, CPVE_DOSE_NUM FROM IDB.COVID19_PATIENT_CP_VACCINE_EMAR JOIN P ON CPVE_MRN = MRN WHERE CPVE_TASK_STATUS_CD = 'Performed' ) , EMP AS (SELECT CEVE_MRN, CEVE_PT_TYPE, CEVE_ADMIN_DT, CEVE_DOSE_NUM FROM IDB.COVID19_EMPLOYEE_VACCINE_EMAR JOIN P ON CEVE_MRN = MRN WHERE CEVE_TASK_STATUS_CD = 'Performed' ) , CTE AS (SELECT DISTINCT MRN, CASE WHEN CMDM_EMPLOYEE_ID IS NOT NULL THEN 'Y' ELSE '' END AS IS_EMPLOYEE, PT1.CPVE_PT_TYPE AS DOSE1_PT_TYPE, PT1.CPVE_ADMIN_DT AS DOSE1_PT_ADMIN_DT, PT2.CPVE_PT_TYPE AS DOSE2_PT_TYPE, PT2.CPVE_ADMIN_DT AS DOSE2_PT_ADMIN_DT, EMP1.CEVE_PT_TYPE AS DOSE1_EMP_TYPE, EMP1.CEVE_ADMIN_DT AS DOSE1_EMP_ADMIN_DT, EMP2.CEVE_PT_TYPE AS DOSE2_EMP_TYPE, EMP2.CEVE_ADMIN_DT AS DOSE2_EMP_ADMIN_DT FROM P LEFT JOIN PT PT1 ON MRN = PT1.CPVE_MRN AND PT1.CPVE_DOSE_NUM = 'Dose #1' LEFT JOIN PT PT2 ON MRN = PT2.CPVE_MRN AND PT2.CPVE_DOSE_NUM = 'Dose #2' LEFT JOIN EMP EMP1 ON MRN = EMP1.CEVE_MRN AND EMP1.CEVE_DOSE_NUM = 'Dose #1' LEFT JOIN EMP EMP2 ON MRN = EMP2.CEVE_MRN AND EMP2.CEVE_DOSE_NUM = 'Dose #2' LEFT JOIN IDB.COVID19_MDM_MATCH ON MRN = CMDM_MRN) , DATA AS (SELECT DISTINCT MRN, IS_EMPLOYEE, COALESCE(DOSE1_PT_TYPE, DOSE1_EMP_TYPE) AS DOSE1_PT_TYPE, DATE(COALESCE(DOSE1_PT_ADMIN_DT, DOSE1_EMP_ADMIN_DT)) AS DOSE1_ADMIN_DT, COALESCE(DOSE2_PT_TYPE, DOSE2_EMP_TYPE) AS DOSE2_PT_TYPE, DATE(COALESCE(DOSE2_PT_ADMIN_DT, DOSE2_EMP_ADMIN_DT)) AS DOSE2_ADMIN_DT FROM CTE) , VISIT_PRE AS (SELECT CEVV_MRN AS VIS_MRN, DATE(CEVV_VISIT_DT) AS VIS_DTE, CEVV_MSK_VISIT_TYPE AS VIS_TYPE, CLE_NAME FROM IDB.COVID19_EMPLOYEE_VACCINE_VISIT JOIN DATA ON CEVV_MRN = MRN JOIN IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER ON CEVV_VISIT_ID_CODE = CPE_ENC_CSN_ID JOIN IDB.CL_USER ON CPE_ENTER_USER_ID = CLE_USER_ID WHERE CEVV_VISIT_STATUS IN ('ADM', 'DSC') UNION ALL SELECT CPVV_MRN AS VIS_MRN, DATE(CPVV_VISIT_DT) AS VIS_DTE, CPVV_MSK_VISIT_TYPE AS VIS_TYPE, CLE_NAME FROM IDB.COVID19_PATIENT_CP_VACCINE_VISIT JOIN DATA ON CPVV_MRN = MRN JOIN IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER ON CPVV_VISIT_ID_CODE = CPE_ENC_CSN_ID JOIN IDB.CL_USER ON CPE_ENTER_USER_ID = CLE_USER_ID WHERE CPVV_VISIT_STATUS IN ('ADM', 'DSC') ) SELECT D.*, VIS_DTE, VIS_TYPE, CLE_NAME AS ENTERING_USER FROM DATA D CDD_SERVICE_DTE LEFT JOIN GLUCOSE ON OC_MRN = LR_MRN AND OC_SURG_DTE = LR_PERFORMED_DTE AND GLUCOSE_RANK = 1 LEFT JOIN DIABETES ON OC_MRN = CC_MRN ;
