prompt: Provide list of outpatient lymphedema therapy patients since 2014.
completion: WITH APPTS AS (SELECT CPE_MRN, YEAR(CPE_ENC_DTE) AS YEAR, CPE_ENC_DTE, CLD_CLD_CENTER FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CPE_ENC_DTE >= '2014-01-01' AND CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID IN ('9327', '12019', '9505', '580', '10868', '12120', '12000', '12594', '12591', '12096', '12099') ) , DOCS AS (SELECT CDD_SERVICE_DTE, CDD_MRN, CDO_SECTION, CDO_ITEM_NAME, CDO_VALUE_TEXT FROM IDB.CD_DOCUMENT LEFT JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION ON CDD_DOC_GUID = CDO_DOC_GUID AND CDD_AUTHORED_DTE = CDO_AUTHORED_DTE AND CDO_VALUE_TEXT <> '' JOIN APPTS ON CDD_MRN = CPE_MRN AND CPE_ENC_DTE = CDD_SERVICE_DTE WHERE CDD_CANCEL_IND <> '1' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND <> '1' AND CDD_DOC_NAME IN ('Follow Up, Lymphedema Therapy - Rehabilitation', 'Initial/Re-Eval, Lymphedema Therapy - Rehabilitation', 'Initial/ReEval/ReAssess, Lymphedema Therapy - Rehabilitation') AND CDO_SECTION = 'Involved Location' AND CDD_SERVICE_DTE >= '2014-01-01' ) , DX AS (SELECT PT_MRN, TUMOR_REG_DATA, ICD_DATA FROM IDB.PATIENT LEFT JOIN (SELECT TM_MRN, LISTAGG(CHAR(TM_DX_DTE, ISO) || ' | ' || TRIM(SITE_DESC) || ' | ' || TRIM(HIST_DESC), CHR(13) || CHR(10)) WITHIN GROUP( ORDER BY TM_DX_DTE) AS TUMOR_REG_DATA FROM (SELECT DISTINCT TM_MRN, AV_DESC AS CASE_STS, TM_DX_DTE, TM_HIST_CD, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS HIST_DESC, TM_SITE_CD, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_DESC FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS ON AV_ELEMENT = 'CASE_STS' AND AV_CODE = TM_CASE_STS AND TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') ) A GROUP BY TM_MRN) AS CDB ON TM_MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN (SELECT CC_MRN, LISTAGG(CHAR(MIN_ICD9_EFF_DTE, ISO) || ' | ' || TRIM(ICD9_CD) || ' | ' || TRIM(ICD9_DESC), CHR(13) || CHR(10)) WITHIN GROUP( ORDER BY MIN_ICD9_EFF_DTE) AS ICD_DATA FROM (SELECT DISTINCT CC_MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS MIN_ICD9_EFF_DTE, CC_CLSF_CD AS ICD9_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS ICD9_DESC FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE 1=1 AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND ((CC_CLSF_CD BETWEEN '140' AND '239.99') OR (CC_CLSF_CD BETWEEN 'C00' AND 'D49')) GROUP BY CC_MRN, CC_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK ) A GROUP BY CC_MRN) AS ICD9 ON CC_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE COALESCE(TM_MRN, CC_MRN) IS NOT NULL ) , DX_FINAL AS (SELECT PT_MRN DX_MRN, TUMOR_REG_DATA, ICD_DATA FROM DX JOIN APPTS ON CPE_MRN = PT_MRN) SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN "MRN", CPE_ENC_DTE "Appt Date", CDD_SERVICE_DTE "Service Date", MAX(CASE WHEN CDO_ITEM_NAME IN ('At-risk limb(s) or location(s):', 'At-risk limbs/locations other:') THEN TRIM(SUBSTR(CDO_VALUE_TEXT, 1, 200)) END) AS "At Risk Location", MAX(CASE WHEN CDO_ITEM_NAME IN ('Involved limb(s) or location(s):', 'Involved limbs/location other:') THEN TRIM(SUBSTR(CDO_VALUE_TEXT, 1, 200)) END) AS "Involved Limbs / Location", MAX(CASE WHEN CDO_ITEM_NAME IN ('Hand dominance:') THEN TRIM(SUBSTR(CDO_VALUE_TEXT, 1, 200)) END) AS "Hand Dominance", MAX(CASE WHEN CDO_ITEM_NAME IN ('Ambidextrous:') THEN TRIM(SUBSTR(CDO_VALUE_TEXT, 1, 200)) END) AS "Ambidextrous", TUMOR_REG_DATA "Dx - Tumor Registry", ICD_DATA "Dx - ICD Data" FROM APPTS LEFT JOIN DOCS ON CPE_MRN = CDD_MRN AND CPE_ENC_DTE = CDD_SERVICE_DTE LEFT JOIN DX_FINAL ON CPE_MRN = DX_MRN GROUP BY CPE_MRN, CPE_ENC_DTE, CDD_SERVICE_DTE, TUMOR_REG_DATA, ICD_DATA ;

prompt: Provide a list of patients with prescribing physician names for whom  2 separate eATO order sets were COMPLETED in July - December 2013 on the same date.
completion: WITH TASK AS (SELECT DISTINCT OO_MRN MRN , STRIP(PT_LAST_NAME)||', '||PT_FIRST_NAME PT_NAME , OO_SET_NAME SET_NAME , OO_ORD_ID ORDID , OO_ORD_GUID ORDGUID , OO_ORD_NAME ORD_NAME, OO_SUMMARY_LINE , OO_ORD_TYPE_CD ORD_TYPE , OUO_PVDR_NAME REQUESTEDBY , OCV_CURR_LOC CURR_LOC , OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE COMP_DTE , OOTO_SIGNIFIC_DTE , OOTO_STATUS_CD FROM IDB.OMS_ORDER JOIN IDB.OMS_USER_ORDERS ON OUO_ORD_GUID = OO_ORD_GUID AND OO_ORD_STS_CD NOT IN ('COMP', 'AUC1') AND OO_ORD_TYPE_CD = 'Medication' JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PT_MRN = OO_MRN JOIN IDB.OMS_CLIENT_VISIT ON OO_VISIT_GUID = OCV_VISIT_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_SERVICE ON OCV_SVC_GUID = OS_SVC_GUID JOIN IDB.OAS_ORD_TASK_OCCR ON OOTO_ORD_GUID = OO_ORD_GUID AND OOTO_STATUS_CD = 'Performed' AND OOTO_SIGNIFIC_DTE BETWEEN '2013-11-01' AND '2013-12-31' JOIN IDB.OAS_CTLG_ITEM_TASK ON OOTO_CAT_ITEM_GUID = OCIT_GUID JOIN IDB.OAS_TASK_TYPE ON OCIT_TASK_TYP_GUID = OTT_GUID WHERE OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE BETWEEN '2013-10-01' AND '2013-12-31' AND OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID IN (SELECT OOC_MSTR_ITEM_GUID FROM IDB.OMS_ORD_CATALOG WHERE OOC_REV_CAT_DEPT ='Chemotherapy' ) AND OO_SET_NAME > '') SELECT X.MRN , X.PT_NAME , X.SET_NAME , X.COMP_DTE , X.REQUESTEDBY , X.CURR_LOC FROM (SELECT MRN, PT_NAME , COMP_DTE , COUNT(*) AS SET_CNT FROM (SELECT DISTINCT MRN, PT_NAME , SET_NAME , COMP_DTE FROM TASK) AS A GROUP BY MRN, PT_NAME , COMP_DTE HAVING COUNT(*) > 1) AS B JOIN TASK X ON X.MRN = B.MRN AND X.COMP_DTE = B.COMP_DTE ORDER BY 1, 2, 4, 3

prompt: Provide cohort of BRCA mutation patients MSK who have had bilateral prophylactic mastectomy
completion: WITH BRCA AS (SELECT PRPT_MRN, PRPT_PROCEDURE_DTE, PRPT_REPORT_DTE, PRPT_REPORT_TYPE_DESC, PRPT_ACCESSION_NO, PRPT_REPORT, PRPT_ORD_DR_NAME, PRPT_ORD_DR_SVC_DESC FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V WHERE PRPT_REPORT IS NOT NULL AND CONTAINS("PRPT_REPORT", '(("BRCA1" | "BRCA2" | "BRCA" | "BRCA+" | "BRCA1+" | "BRCA2+") & "mastectomy")') = 1 AND UPPER(PRPT_REPORT_TYPE_DESC) like '%SURGICAL%' ) , MSTC AS (SELECT DISTINCT SSE_MRN, SSE_SURG_DTE, SSE_LOG_ID, SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD, SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC, SSP_SURG_LAST_NM, SSP_SURG_FIRST_NM, SSP_SURG_SVC_CD, OP_PROC_NAME FROM IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE ON SSE_LOG_ID = SSP_LOG_ID AND SSE_ENC_CSN_ID = SSP_ENC_CSN_ID JOIN IDB.OR_CASE ON SSE_LOG_ID = OC_CASE_ID JOIN IDB.OR_CASE_ALL_PROC ON OC_CASE_ID = OCAP_CASE_ID JOIN IDB.OR_PROC ON OCAP_OR_PROC_ID = OP_OR_PROC_ID JOIN IDB.OR_CL_PROC ON OP_OR_PROC_ID = OCP_OR_PROC_ID JOIN IDB.CL_PROC ON OCP_PROC_ID = CPX_PROC_ID AND SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD = CPX_PROC_CD WHERE 1=1 AND (SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD IN ('19303') OR (OP_PROC_NAME IN ('BILATERAL MASTECTOMY SIMPLE/COMPLETE (INCLUDING NIPPLE)', 'BILATERAL MASTECTOMY SUBCUTANEOUS WITH NIPPLE SPARING', 'BILATERAL MASTECTOMY SIMPLE/COMPLETE WITH NIPPLE SPARING', 'MASTECTOMY, BILATERAL, NIPPLE SPARING', 'MASTECTOMY, BILATERAL, NIPPLE SPARING, WITH SENTINEL LYMPH NODE BIOPSY', 'MASTECTOMY, BILATERAL, SIMPLE', 'MASTECTOMY, BILATERAL, SIMPLE, WITH SENTINEL LYMPH NODE BIOPSY') AND OC_OR_CASE_STS_CD NOT IN ('2', '5'))) ) , CLINDOC1 AS (SELECT DISTINCT CDD_MRN, CDD_SERVICE_DTE, CDD_DOC_NAME, OP_DISPLAY_NAME, CDD_DOC_GUID, MAX(CASE WHEN CDO_SECTION = 'GYN HISTORY' AND CDO_ITEM_NAME = 'Menopausal Status' THEN CDO_VALUE_TEXT END) AS "Menopausal status", MAX(CASE WHEN CDO_SECTION = 'GYN HISTORY' AND CDO_ITEM_NAME = 'Last Menstrual Period' THEN CDO_VALUE_TEXT END) AS "Last Menstrual Period", MAX(CASE WHEN CDO_SECTION = 'GYN HISTORY' AND CDO_ITEM_NAME = 'Hormone Exposure Details' THEN CDO_VALUE_TEXT END) AS "Hormone Exposure Details", MAX(CASE WHEN CDO_SECTION = 'GYN HISTORY' AND CDO_ITEM_NAME = 'Hormones' THEN CDO_VALUE_TEXT END) AS "Hormones", MAX(CASE WHEN CDO_SECTION = 'FAMILY HISTORY' AND CDO_ITEM_NAME = 'Family History Breast Cancer' THEN CDO_VALUE_TEXT END) AS "Family History Breast Cancer", MAX(CASE WHEN CDO_SECTION = 'FAMILY HISTORY' AND CDO_ITEM_NAME = 'Family History Ovarian Cancer' THEN CDO_VALUE_TEXT END) AS "Family History Ovarian Cancer", MAX(CASE WHEN CDO_SECTION = 'FAMILY HISTORY' AND CDO_ITEM_NAME IN ('Family History Other', 'Family History') THEN CDO_VALUE_TEXT END) AS "Family History Other", MAX(CASE WHEN CDO_SECTION = 'FAMILY HISTORY' AND CDO_ITEM_NAME = 'Ashkenazi Jewish' THEN CDO_VALUE_TEXT END) AS "Ashkenazi Jewish", MAX(CASE WHEN CDO_SECTION = 'FAMILY HISTORY' AND CDO_ITEM_NAME IN ('Genetic Testing', 'Genetic Testing Other') THEN CDO_VALUE_TEXT END) AS "Genetic Testing" , ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CDD_MRN ORDER BY CDD_SERVICE_DTE DESC) RANK FROM IDB.CD_DOCUMENT JOIN BRCA ON CDD_MRN = PRPT_MRN JOIN MSTC ON CDD_MRN = SSE_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION ON CDD_DOC_GUID = CDO_DOC_GUID AND CDD_AUTHORED_DTE = CDO_AUTHORED_DTE AND CDO_VALUE_TEXT <> '' AND ((CDO_SECTION = 'GYN HISTORY' AND CDO_ITEM_NAME IN ('Menopausal Status', 'Hormone Exposure Details', 'Hormones', 'Last Menstrual Period')) OR (CDO_SECTION = 'FAMILY HISTORY' AND CDO_ITEM_NAME IN ('Family History Breast Cancer', 'Family History Ovarian Cancer', 'Family History Other', 'Family History', 'Ashkenazi Jewish', 'Genetic Testing', 'Genetic Testing Other'))) JOIN IDB.OMS_PROVIDER ON CDD_AUTH_PROV_GUID = OP_PVDR_GUID WHERE CDD_CANCEL_IND <> '1' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND <> '1' AND CDD_DOC_NAME = 'Initial Consult/Initial Visit - Breast Surgery' AND CDD_SERVICE_DTE < SSE_SURG_DTE GROUP BY CDD_MRN, CDD_SERVICE_DTE, CDD_DOC_NAME, OP_DISPLAY_NAME, CDD_DOC_GUID) , CLINDOC2 AS (SELECT DISTINCT CDD_MRN, CDD_SERVICE_DTE, CDD_DOC_NAME, OP_DISPLAY_NAME, CDD_DOC_GUID, CDO_SECTION, CDO_ITEM_NAME, CDO_VALUE_TEXT, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CDD_MRN ORDER BY CDD_SERVICE_DTE DESC) RANK FROM IDB.CD_DOCUMENT JOIN BRCA ON CDD_MRN = PRPT_MRN JOIN MSTC ON CDD_MRN = SSE_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION ON CDD_DOC_GUID = CDO_DOC_GUID AND CDD_AUTHORED_DTE = CDO_AUTHORED_DTE AND CDO_VALUE_TEXT <> '' AND ((CDO_SECTION = 'HISTORY OF PRESENT ILLNESS' AND CDO_ITEM_NAME IN ('HPI')) OR (CDO_SECTION = 'PMSFH' AND CDO_ITEM_NAME IN ('Gynecological')) OR (CDO_SECTION = 'Initial Consultaton' AND CDO_ITEM_NAME IN ('Past Medical History'))) JOIN IDB.OMS_PROVIDER ON CDD_AUTH_PROV_GUID = OP_PVDR_GUID WHERE CDD_CANCEL_IND <> '1' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND <> '1' AND CDD_DOC_NAME IN ('History & Physical - Pre-Surgical', 'Initial Consultation – Surgery', 'Initial Consult/Initial Visit - Surgery-Breast', 'Initial Consult/Initial Visit - Surgery-Plastic and Reconstr', 'Initial Consult/Initial Visit, AMB - DOM-Breast Medicine') AND CDD_SERVICE_DTE < SSE_SURG_DTE GROUP BY CDD_MRN, CDD_SERVICE_DTE, CDD_DOC_NAME, OP_DISPLAY_NAME, CDD_DOC_GUID, CDO_SECTION, CDO_ITEM_NAME, CDO_VALUE_TEXT) , CLINDOC3 AS (SELECT DISTINCT CDD_MRN, CDD_SERVICE_DTE, CDD_DOC_NAME, MAX(CASE WHEN CDO_ITEM_NAME = 'Prophylactic Laterality' THEN TRIM(CDO_VALUE_TEXT) END) AS "Prophylactic Laterality", MAX(CASE WHEN CDO_ITEM_NAME = 'Pre-Op Diagnosis:' THEN TRIM(CDO_VALUE_TEXT) END) AS "Pre-Op Diagnosis:", ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CDD_MRN ORDER BY CDD_SERVICE_DTE DESC) RANK FROM IDB.CD_DOCUMENT JOIN BRCA ON PRPT_MRN = CDD_MRN JOIN MSTC ON CDD_MRN = SSE_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION ON CDD_DOC_GUID = CDO_DOC_GUID AND CDD_AUTHORED_DTE = CDO_AUTHORED_DTE AND CDO_VALUE_TEXT <> '' JOIN IDB.OMS_PROVIDER ON CDD_AUTH_PROV_GUID = OP_PVDR_GUID WHERE CDD_CANCEL_IND <> '1' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND <> '1' AND CDD_DOC_NAME = 'Operative Report - Breast' AND ((CDO_ITEM_NAME = 'Prophylactic Laterality' AND CDO_VALUE_TEXT = 'Bilateral') OR (CDO_ITEM_NAME = 'Pre-Op Diagnosis:' AND (CDO_VALUE_TEXT like '%GEN SUSCEPT MALIG NEOPLASM BREAST%' OR LOWER(CDO_VALUE_TEXT) like '%genetic susceptibility to malignant neoplasm of breast%' OR UPPER(CDO_VALUE_TEXT) like '%FAMILY HX%' OR UPPER(CDO_VALUE_TEXT) like '%FAMILY HISTORY%'))) GROUP BY CDD_MRN, CDD_SERVICE_DTE, CDD_DOC_NAME) SELECT DISTINCT PRPT_MRN "MRN", PT_SEX "Gender", PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH "DOB" , SSE_SURG_DTE "Procedure Date" , OP_PROC_NAME "Procedure Name", A.CDD_SERVICE_DTE "Date of Visit" , "Menopausal status", B.CDO_VALUE_TEXT "Last Menstrual Period Details", "Hormone Exposure Details", "Hormones", "Family History Breast Cancer", "Family History Ovarian Cancer", "Family History Other", "Ashkenazi Jewish", "Genetic Testing", "Prophylactic Laterality", "Pre-Op Diagnosis:" FROM BRCA JOIN MSTC ON PRPT_MRN = SSE_MRN JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PRPT_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN CLINDOC3 C ON PRPT_MRN = C.CDD_MRN AND C.RANK = 1 LEFT JOIN CLINDOC1 A ON PRPT_MRN = A.CDD_MRN AND A.RANK = 1 LEFT JOIN CLINDOC2 B ON PRPT_MRN = B.CDD_MRN AND B.RANK = 1

prompt: Patients with solid tumor cancers diagnosed at age 21 years old or younger
Extract tumor stage and histological grade information for a cohort of 45 patients.
completion: WITH DX AS (SELECT DISTINCT TM_MRN, C.AV_DESC AS CASE_STS, TM_DX_DTE, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS HIST_DESC, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_DESC, TM_PATH_TNM_T, TM_PATH_TNM_N, TM_PATH_TNM_M, G.AV_DESC AS HIST_GRADE FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS C ON C.AV_ELEMENT = 'CASE_STS' AND C.AV_CODE = TM_CASE_STS LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS G ON G.AV_ELEMENT = 'HIST_CD_GRADE' AND G.AV_CODE = TM_HIST_CD_GRADE WHERE 1=1 AND TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND TM_MRN IN ('00939155', '35165625', '35267218', '35295040', '35299074', '35301953', '35319271', '35322164', '35339003', '35342139', '35343238', '35353049', '35353049', '35353049', '35382734', '35408992', '35408992', '35411413', '35411950', '35413540', '35427482', '35430859', '35439587', '35439777', '35439910', '35462707', '35481526', '35482746', '35500277', '35504093', '35526198', '35527626', '35530259', '35537099', '35538903', '35562500', '35569440', '00834050', '35317646', '35339003', '35347779', '35357877', '35378530', '35442674') ) , XML_DATA AS (SELECT DISTINCT PDRX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID, TM_MRN, PDWS_NAME, PT_MRN, PDRX_ACCESSION_NO, PDRX_DMP_PATIENT_ID, PDRX_PATH_RPT_ID, T.* FROM DX JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON TM_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML ON PDRX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID INNER JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML_SETTINGS ON PDRX_PATH_DMP_RESULTS_XML_ID = PDRXS_PATH_DMP_RESULTS_XML_ID INNER JOIN DVDMC.PATHOLOGY_DMP_WEBSVC_SETTINGS ON PDRXS_SETTING_ID = PDWS_SETTING_ID , XMLTABLE('$c/root/*' PASSING PDRX_XML_VALUE AS "c" COLUMNS DT_PROCEDURE VARCHAR(100) PATH 'dt_procedure', SITE1_GENE VARCHAR(100) PATH 'site1_gene', SITE2_GENE VARCHAR(100) PATH 'site2_gene', GENE_ID VARCHAR(100) PATH 'gene_id', EXON_NUM VARCHAR(100) PATH 'exon_num', AA_CHANGE VARCHAR(100) PATH 'aa_change', CDNA_CHANGE VARCHAR(100) PATH 'cDNA_change', MAFREQ VARCHAR(100) PATH 'mafreq_1000g', GENE_FOLD_CHANGE VARCHAR(100) PATH 'gene_fold_change', VARIANT_TYPE VARCHAR(100) PATH './local-name(.)', TUMOR_TYPE_NAME VARCHAR(255) PATH '../meta-data/tumor_type_name', PRIMARY_SITE VARCHAR(255) PATH '../meta-data/primary_site', IMPACT_PANEL VARCHAR(255) PATH '../meta-data/gene-panel', TMB_COUNT DECIMAL(5, 1) PATH '../meta-data/tmb-count') T WHERE VARIANT_TYPE <> 'meta-data' ) , DT AS (SELECT DISTINCT TM_MRN, PDRX_PATH_RPT_ID, PDRX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID, PT_MRN, PDRX_DMP_PATIENT_ID, PDRX_ACCESSION_NO, TUMOR_TYPE_NAME, PRIMARY_SITE FROM XML_DATA ) , PETCT AS (SELECT RRPT_MRN, MIN(RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE) MIN_RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE, LISTAGG(RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE, CHR(13) || CHR(10)) WITHIN GROUP( ORDER BY RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE) AS RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE FROM (SELECT DISTINCT RRPT_MRN, RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE FROM DV.RADIOLOGY_REPORT_V JOIN DX ON TM_MRN = RRPT_MRN WHERE 1=1 AND RRPT_ORDER_GROUP IN ('PET', 'PET for Cancer', 'PET CT for Cancer') AND RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE BETWEEN '2010-01-01' AND CURRENT date AND RRPT_ORDER_STATUS_CD IN ('PERF', 'RESC', 'RESF', 'RESI') ) A GROUP BY RRPT_MRN) , GENEINFO AS (SELECT DISTINCT B.TM_MRN, A.PT_MRN, PRPT_ACCESSION_NO, PRPT_PATH_RPT_ID, PATH_RPT_DATE, PATH_PROCEDURE_DATE, SUBSTR(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(CAST(XMLSERIALIZE(CONTENT XMLAGG(XMLELEMENT(NAME "c", R.GENE || ' | ' || COALESCE(R.GENE2, '') || ' | ' || COALESCE(R.ABERRATIONTYPE, '') || ' | ' || COALESCE(R.LOCUS, '') || ' | ' || COALESCE(R.AA_CHANGE, '') || ' | ' || COALESCE(R.NUCLEOTIDE, '') || CHR(13) || CHR(10)) ORDER BY A.PT_MRN) AS CLOB(32000)) AS VARCHAR(32000)), '<c>', ','), '</c>', ''), '', ''), '<c/>', ''), ',', ''), '&', '&'), '<', '<'), '>', '>'), 1) AS GENE_INFO FROM DX B LEFT JOIN DT A ON B.TM_MRN = A.PT_MRN LEFT JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_STRUCTURED_RESULTS_V R ON A.TM_MRN = R.PT_MRN AND PDRX_PATH_RPT_ID = PRPT_PATH_RPT_ID AND PDRX_ACCESSION_NO = PRPT_ACCESSION_NO GROUP BY A.PT_MRN, PRPT_ACCESSION_NO, PRPT_PATH_RPT_ID, PATH_RPT_DATE, PATH_PROCEDURE_DATE, B.TM_MRN) , GENEINFODATE AS (SELECT PT_MRN, MIN(PATH_PROCEDURE_DATE) MIN_PATH_PROCEDURE_DATE FROM GENEINFO GROUP BY PT_MRN) , CRP_G AS (SELECT DISTINCT TM_MRN, LR_MRN, LR_PERFORMED_DTE, PATH_RPT_DATE, ABS(DAYS(LR_PERFORMED_DTE) - DAYS(PATH_RPT_DATE)) ABS_DIFF, LR_TEST_NAME, LR_SUBTEST_NAME, LR_RESULT_VALUE, LR_UNIT_MEASURE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY LR_MRN ORDER BY ABS(DAYS(LR_PERFORMED_DTE) - DAYS(PATH_RPT_DATE)) ASC) AS ROW_NUM FROM GENEINFO LEFT JOIN IDB.LAB_RESULTS ON TM_MRN = LR_MRN WHERE LR_SUBTEST_NAME IN ('C-Reactive Protein', 'C-Reactive Protein', 'C-Reactive Protein, High Sensitivity', 'C-Reactive Protein, High Sensitivity') ) SELECT DISTINCT Z.TM_MRN "MRN", PT_LAST_NAME "Last Name", PT_FIRST_NAME "First Name", PT_BIRTH_DTE "DOB", TM_DX_DTE "DX Date", HIST_DESC "Histology", SITE_DESC "Site", TM_PATH_TNM_T "T Stage", TM_PATH_TNM_N "N Stage", TM_PATH_TNM_M "M Stage", HIST_GRADE "Histology Grade", G.PRPT_ACCESSION_NO "Accession No", G.PRPT_PATH_RPT_ID "Path Report ID", G.PATH_PROCEDURE_DATE "Path Procedure Date", G.PATH_RPT_DATE "Path Report Date", GENE_INFO "Gene Info", MIN_RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE "First PETCT Scan Date", RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE "PET/CT Scan Date", LR_PERFORMED_DTE "Lab Performed Date", LR_TEST_NAME "Lab Test Name", LR_RESULT_VALUE "Lab Result", LR_UNIT_MEASURE "Lab Unit" FROM DX Z LEFT JOIN DT A ON Z.TM_MRN = A.PT_MRN LEFT JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS D ON Z.TM_MRN = D.PT_MRN LEFT JOIN GENEINFO G ON Z.TM_MRN = G.PT_MRN LEFT JOIN GENEINFODATE GD ON Z.TM_MRN = GD.PT_MRN LEFT JOIN PETCT ON Z.TM_MRN = RRPT_MRN LEFT JOIN CRP_G C ON Z.TM_MRN = C.LR_MRN AND ROW_NUM = 1 ;

prompt: Provide number and percentage of patients currently between the ages of 18-29 who have an email addresses on file. Only inlcude patients that have a confirmed cancer diagnosis (any disease).
completion: SELECT PT_MRN, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, PT_DATE_OF_DEATH , PT_DEATH_IND, CPP_EMAIL_ADDR , YEAR(CURRENT DATE) - YEAR(PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) AS CURR_AGE , MIN(CC_CLSF_CD) AS CA_DX, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS FX_DTE FROM IDB.PATIENT JOIN IDB.CL_PAS_PATIENT ON CPP_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.CTC_CLSF ON CC_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE CC_CLSF_CD BETWEEN '140' AND '239.99' AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND (CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y') AND PT_DATE_OF_DEATH IS NULL AND PT_DEATH_IND NOT IN ('D', 'X', 'C') AND YEAR(CURRENT DATE) - YEAR(PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) >= 18 AND YEAR(CURRENT DATE) - YEAR(PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) < 30 GROUP BY PT_MRN, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, PT_DATE_OF_DEATH, PT_DEATH_IND, CPP_EMAIL_ADDR

prompt: Create a report of multiple myeloma patients with a HOTB sample.
completion: WITH DX AS (SELECT TM_MRN AS MRN, TM_DX_DTE AS DX_DATE, TM_HIST_CD AS DX_CODE, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS DX_DESC FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM H ON TM_HIST_CD = H.CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON TM_SITE_CD = S.CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('3', '6', '7', '8') AND TM_HIST_CD IN ('M9731/3', 'M9732/3', 'M9734/3') UNION SELECT CC_MRN AS MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS DX_DATE, CLM_CLSF_CD AS DX_CODE, CLM_CLSF_DESC AS DX_DESC FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND ((CC_PT_TYPE = 'I') OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) AND CC_CLSF_CD IN ('203', '203.0', '203.00', '203.01', '203.02', '238.6', 'C90.0', 'C90.00', 'C90.01', 'C90.02', 'C90.2', 'C90.20', 'C90.21', 'C90.22', 'C90.30', 'C90.31', 'C90.32') GROUP BY CC_MRN, CLM_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC ) , CTE AS (SELECT MRN AS DX_MRN, DX_DATE, STRIP(DX_CODE) || '-' || STRIP(DX_DESC) AS DX_CODE FROM DX) , CTE2 AS (SELECT * FROM CTE ORDER BY DX_MRN, DX_DATE, DX_CODE) , T1 AS (SELECT DX_MRN, DX_DATE, DX_CODE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY DX_MRN ORDER BY DX_DATE) AS RN FROM CTE2 ORDER BY DX_MRN, DX_DATE) , T2 (MRN, DX, RN1) AS (SELECT DX_MRN, CAST(DX_DATE AS VARCHAR(6000))||' | '||CAST(DX_CODE AS VARCHAR(100)), RN FROM T1 WHERE T1.RN = 1 UNION ALL SELECT DX_MRN, RTRIM(CAST(DX AS VARCHAR(4000))) || ', ' || CHR(13) || CHR(10) || CAST(DX_DATE AS VARCHAR(100))||' | '||RTRIM(CAST(DX_CODE AS VARCHAR(100))) , RN1 + 1 FROM T1, T2 WHERE DX_MRN = MRN AND RN = RN1+1 ) , T3 AS (SELECT MRN, MAX(RN1) RN FROM T2 GROUP BY MRN) , T4 AS (SELECT T2.MRN, RN, DX FROM T2 JOIN T3 ON T2.MRN = T3.MRN AND T2.RN1 = T3.RN) , HOTB AS (SELECT DISTINCT "t1"."PT_MRN" AS "MRN", "t2"."DT_DTE" AS "Collection Date", ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY "t1"."PT_MRN" ORDER BY "t2"."DT_DTE") AS RN_HOTB FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V" "t1" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED" "t8" ON "t1"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t8"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."HOTB_SPECIMEN" "t3" ON "t8"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t3"."HS_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" "t2" ON "t3"."HS_COLLECTION_DATE_ID" = "t2"."DT_DATE_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."HOTB_SOURCE_DETAIL_CODES" "t4" ON "t3"."HS_SOURCE_DETAIL_CODE_ID" = "t4"."HSDC_SOURCE_DETAIL_CODE_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."HOTB_CELL_TYPE_CODES" "t5" ON "t3"."HS_CELL_TYPE_CODE_ID" = "t5"."HCTC_CELL_TYPE_CODE_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."HOTB_STATUS_CODES" "t6" ON "t3"."HS_STATUS_CODE_ID" = "t6"."HSC_STATUS_CODE_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."HOTB_TREATMENT_CODES" "t7" ON "t3"."HS_TREATMENT_CODE_ID" = "t7"."HTC_TREATMENT_CODE_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_IDENTIFICATION_MRN_V" "t9" ON "t1"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t9"."PI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" WHERE "t9"."PI_SOURCE_SYSTEM_PT_ID" IN (SELECT MRN FROM DX) ) , X AS (SELECT T4.MRN, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH AS DOB, DX, "Collection Date" AS "Initial HOTB Collection Date" FROM IDB.PATIENT JOIN T4 ON MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN HOTB ON T4.MRN = HOTB.MRN AND RN_HOTB = 1) , CHEMO AS (SELECT DISTINCT APR_MRN, APR_DRUG_NAME, APR_START_DTE, APR_END_DTE, APR_ORD_RX_TYPE, APR_ORDER_SOURCE, APR_ORDER_SOURCE_ID FROM IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX JOIN IDB.CHEMO_DRUG_GENERIC ON APR_GENERIC_NAME = CDG_GENERIC_NAME WHERE APR_MRN IN (SELECT MRN FROM X) AND CDG_CHEMO_FLAG = 'Y' ) , APR AS (SELECT APR_MRN, APR_DRUG_NAME, MIN(APR_START_DTE) APR_START_DATE, MAX(APR_END_DTE) AS APR_END_DATE FROM CHEMO GROUP BY APR_MRN, APR_DRUG_NAME) , A0 AS (SELECT DISTINCT APR_MRN, STRIP(APR_DRUG_NAME) || ' | ' || STRIP(CHAR(APR_START_DATE)) || ' - ' ||STRIP(CHAR(APR_END_DATE)) AS APR_DRUG_NAME FROM APR) , A1 AS (SELECT APR_MRN, APR_DRUG_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY APR_MRN ORDER BY APR_DRUG_NAME) AS RN FROM A0 ORDER BY APR_MRN, APR_DRUG_NAME) , A2 (MRN, DRUG_NAME, RN1) AS (SELECT APR_MRN, CAST(APR_DRUG_NAME AS VARCHAR(4000)), RN FROM A1 WHERE A1.RN = 1 UNION ALL SELECT APR_MRN, RTRIM(CAST(DRUG_NAME AS VARCHAR(12000))) || ', ' || CHR(13) || CHR(10) || CAST(APR_DRUG_NAME AS VARCHAR(4000)) , RN1 + 1 FROM A1, A2 WHERE APR_MRN = MRN AND RN = RN1+1 ) , A3 AS (SELECT MRN, MAX(RN1) RN FROM A2 GROUP BY MRN) , A4 AS (SELECT A2.MRN, RN, DRUG_NAME FROM A2 JOIN A3 ON A2.MRN = A3.MRN AND A2.RN1 = A3.RN) , CHEMO_INIT AS (SELECT APR_MRN, MIN(APR_START_DTE) AS APR_START_DTE_INIT FROM CHEMO GROUP BY APR_MRN) , CHEMO_INIT2 AS (SELECT DISTINCT CHEMO.APR_MRN, APR_DRUG_NAME, APR_START_DTE_INIT FROM CHEMO JOIN CHEMO_INIT ON CHEMO.APR_MRN = CHEMO_INIT.APR_MRN AND APR_START_DTE = APR_START_DTE_INIT) , C1 AS (SELECT APR_MRN, APR_DRUG_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY APR_MRN ORDER BY APR_DRUG_NAME) AS RN FROM CHEMO_INIT2 ORDER BY APR_MRN, APR_DRUG_NAME) , C2 (MRN, CHEMO, RN1) AS (SELECT APR_MRN, CAST(APR_DRUG_NAME AS VARCHAR(400)), RN FROM C1 WHERE C1.RN = 1 UNION ALL SELECT APR_MRN, RTRIM(CAST(CHEMO AS VARCHAR(4000))) || ', ' || CHR(13) || CHR(10) || CAST(APR_DRUG_NAME AS VARCHAR(400)) , RN1 + 1 FROM C1, C2 WHERE APR_MRN = MRN AND RN = RN1+1 ) , C3 AS (SELECT MRN, MAX(RN1) RN FROM C2 GROUP BY MRN) , C4 AS (SELECT C2.MRN, RN, CHEMO FROM C2 JOIN C3 ON C2.MRN = C3.MRN AND C2.RN1 = C3.RN) SELECT X.*, APR_START_DTE_INIT AS INITIAL_TX_DATE, CHEMO AS INITIAL_TX_DRUG, DRUG_NAME FROM X LEFT JOIN CHEMO_INIT2 ON X.MRN = CHEMO_INIT2.APR_MRN LEFT JOIN C4 ON X.MRN = C4.MRN LEFT JOIN A4 ON X.MRN = A4.MRN

prompt: Provide every dermatology surgical pathology report from 1-1-2021 to 6-30-2021.
completion: WITH COHORT AS (SELECT OO_MRN , OO_ANCIL_REF_CD , OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE FROM IDB.OMS_ORDER WHERE OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID = '9000009659100730' AND OO_ORD_STS_CD NOT IN ('CANP', 'CANC', 'AUC3') AND TRIM(OO_ANCIL_REF_CD) <> '' AND OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE BETWEEN '2021-01-01' AND '2021-06-30' ) SELECT OO_MRN MRN , PRPT_ORD_DR_NAME ORD_DR_NAME , PRPT_ORD_DR_SVC ORD_DR_SVC , PRPT_ORD_DR_SVC_DESC ORD_DR_SVC_DESC , PRPT_ACCESSION_NO ACCESSION_NO , PRPT_PROCEDURE_DTE PROCEDURE_DTE , PRPT_REPORT_DTE REPORT_DTE , PRPT_REPORT_TYPE_DESC REPORT_TYPE_DESC , PRPT_REPORT REPORT_TEXT FROM COHORT JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V ON OO_MRN = PRPT_MRN AND OO_ANCIL_REF_CD = PRPT_ACCESSION_NO

VST_ABBR, CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME VST_NAME , CVT_EXT_NAME VST_TYPE , SD.CLD_DEPT_NAME SEC_DEPT_NAME, REF.CRE_RES_ID, SR.CRE_RES_NAME SEC_RES, SR.CRE_RES_TYP SEC_RES_TYPE , VD.CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_1 AS SCH_GRP_01 , CASE WHEN VD.CLD_CLD_CENTER IN ('MON', 'BER', 'BSK') THEN 'NJ' ELSE 'NY' END SCH_STATE, SUBSTR(REPLACE(REPLACE(CAST(XMLSERIALIZE(CONTENT XMLAGG(XMLELEMENT(NAME "c", RTRIM(LTRIM(CHM.CCH_CHEMO_NAME)))) AS CLOB(255)) AS VARCHAR(255)), '<c>', ','), '</c>', ''), 2) AS CHEMO_NAME FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID = CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT VD ON CPE_DEPT_ID = VD.CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE VT ON VT.CRE_RES_ID = CPE_VST_RES_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE REF ON REF.CRE_RES_ID = CPE_REF_RES_ID AND REF.CRE_RES_TYP IN ('Physician', 'Dentist', 'Psychologist', 'PhD', 'Nurse Practitioner', 'Physician Assistant', 'Advanced Practice Nurse') LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_PT_APPT ON CPE_CL_PT_ID = CPA_CL_PT_ID AND CPE_ENC_DTE_SEQ = CPA_ENC_DTE_SEQ AND CPA_LINE_NO = 2 LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT SD ON CPA_DEPT_ID = SD.CLD_DEPT_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE SR ON SR.CRE_RES_ID = CPE_VST_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_PT_CHEMO PTCHM ON CPE_CL_PT_ID = PTCHM.CPC_CL_PT_ID AND CPE_ENC_DTE_SEQ = PTCHM.CPC_ENC_DTE_SEQ JOIN IDB.CL_CHEMO CHM ON PTCHM.CPC_CHEMO_ID = CHM.CCH_CHEMO_ID WHERE CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT DATE AND CURRENT DATE + 7 DAY AND CPE_CPE_APPT_STS = 'Sch' AND CPE_ENC_TYP_CD = 50 AND CPE_CPE_IP_IND <> 'INPATIENT' AND NOT (VT.CRE_RES_ABBR = 'TX PREP') AND NOT (CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR = 'EV') AND VT.CRE_RES_TYP = 'Chemotherapy Unit' AND CVT_CVT_RPT_GRP_3 = '' GROUP BY CPE_MRN, CPE_ENC_DTE, CPE_ENC_CSN_ID , VD.CLD_DEPT_ID, VD.CLD_DEPT_NAME, VD.CLD_CLD_CENTER , VD.CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_20, VD.CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 , CPE_APPT_DT, CPE_APPT_MADE_DT, VD.CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_1 , VT.CRE_RES_NAME, REF.CRE_RES_NAME , CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR, CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME , CVT_EXT_NAME, SD.CLD_DEPT_NAME, REF.CRE_RES_ID, SR.CRE_RES_NAME, SR.CRE_RES_TYP) , PRIO AS (SELECT PRI_MRN, PRI_VST_DATE, CSN , PRI_DEPT_ID, PRI_DEPT_NAME , PRI_CLD_CENTER , PRI_CLINIC, PRI_GRP6 , PRI_APPT_DT , PRI_VST_RESOURCE, PRI_REF_MD , PRI_VST_ABBR, PRI_VST_NAME , PRI_VST_TYPE, PRI_GRP_01, PRI_STATE FROM (SELECT MRN PRI_MRN, SCH_VST_DATE, CPE_ENC_DTE PRI_VST_DATE, CPE_ENC_CSN_ID CSN , VD.CLD_DEPT_ID PRI_DEPT_ID, VD.CLD_DEPT_NAME PRI_DEPT_NAME, VD.CLD_CLD_CENTER PRI_CLD_CENTER, VD.CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_20 PRI_CLINIC, VD.CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 PRI_GRP6 , CPE_APPT_DT PRI_APPT_DT , VT.CRE_RES_NAME PRI_VST_RESOURCE, REF.CRE_RES_NAME PRI_REF_MD, CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR PRI_VST_ABBR, CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME PRI_VST_NAME , CVT_EXT_NAME PRI_VST_TYPE , VD.CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_1 AS PRI_GRP_01 , CASE WHEN VD.CLD_CLD_CENTER IN ('MON', 'BER', 'BSK') THEN 'NJ' ELSE 'NY' END PRI_STATE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CPE_MRN ORDER BY CPE_APPT_DT DESC) RN FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN ETO ON MRN = CPE_MRN AND SCH_VST_DATE > CPE_ENC_DTE JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID = CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT VD ON CPE_DEPT_ID = VD.CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE VT ON VT.CRE_RES_ID = CPE_VST_RES_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE REF ON REF.CRE_RES_ID = CPE_REF_RES_ID AND REF.CRE_RES_TYP IN ('Physician', 'Dentist', 'Psychologist', 'PhD', 'Nurse Practitioner', 'Physician Assistant', 'Advanced Practice Nurse') JOIN IDB.CL_PT_CHEMO PTCHM ON CPE_CL_PT_ID = PTCHM.CPC_CL_PT_ID AND CPE_ENC_DTE_SEQ = PTCHM.CPC_ENC_DTE_SEQ JOIN IDB.CL_CHEMO CHM ON PTCHM.CPC_CHEMO_ID = CHM.CCH_CHEMO_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Comp', 'Arrived') AND CPE_ENC_TYP_CD = 50 AND CPE_CPE_IP_IND <> 'INPATIENT' AND NOT (VT.CRE_RES_ABBR = 'TX PREP') AND NOT (CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR = 'EV') AND VT.CRE_RES_TYP = 'Chemotherapy Unit' AND CVT_CVT_RPT_GRP_3 = '' ) A WHERE RN= 1 ) SELECT prompt: Prostate patients treated Radiation between 2012 and 2015
completion: WITH CTE AS (SELECT DISTINCT TM_MRN FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND TM_SITE_CD LIKE 'C61%' ) , CHEMO AS (SELECT DISTINCT APR_MRN FROM IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX JOIN IDB.CHEMO_DRUG_GENERIC ON APR_GENERIC_NAME = CDG_GENERIC_NAME WHERE CDG_HORMONE_FLAG = 'Y' ) , RAD AS (SELECT DISTINCT RTC_TX_MRN, RTC_TX_START_DTE, RTC_TX_PLAN_NAME, RTC_PRIMARY_REF_POINT FROM IDB.RADONC_TREATMENT_COURSE JOIN CTE ON RTC_TX_MRN = TM_MRN JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON RTC_TX_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE YEAR(RTC_TX_START_DTE) BETWEEN 2012 AND 2015 AND RTC_TX_MRN NOT IN (SELECT * FROM CHEMO) AND UPPER(RTC_TX_PLAN_NAME) LIKE '%PR%' ) SELECT DISTINCT PRPT_MRN "MRN", PRPT_PROCEDURE_DTE "Path Procedure Date", MIN(RTC_TX_START_DTE) "First Radiation Date" FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V JOIN RAD ON PRPT_MRN = RTC_TX_MRN AND PRPT_PROCEDURE_DTE <= RTC_TX_START_DTE WHERE PRPT_REPORT IS NOT NULL AND CONTAINS("PRPT_REPORT", '("Total Gleason score:7" | "Total Gleason score: 7")') = 1 GROUP BY PRPT_MRN, PRPT_PROCEDURE_DTE

prompt: Weekly list of patients scheduled to receive mitomycin through hepatic pump.
completion: SELECT CURRENT DATE + 3 DAY AS RPT_START, CURRENT DATE + 9 DAY AS RPT_END, CPE_MRN VST_MRN, STRIP(CL_LAST_NAME)||', '||STRIP(CL_FIRST_NAME) PT_NAME, CPE_ENC_DTE VST_DATE , VD.CLD_DEPT_NAME DEPT_NAME , CPE_APPT_DT APPT_DT , TIME(CPE_APPT_DT) APPT_TIME, CPE_APPT_MADE_DTE APPT_MADE_DTE , VT.CRE_RES_NAME VST_RESOURCE, REF.CRE_RES_NAME REF_MD, REFD.CLD_DEPT_NAME REF_DEPT_NAME, CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID, CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR VST_ABBR, CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME VST_NAME , CVT_EXT_NAME VST_TYPE, CHMNAME.CCH_CHEMO_NAME AS DRUG, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CPE_MRN, ENC.CPE_ENC_CSN_ID ORDER BY CHMNAME.CCH_CHEMO_NAME) VRN FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER ENC JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID = CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT VD ON CPE_DEPT_ID = VD.CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE VT ON VT.CRE_RES_ID = CPE_VST_RES_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE REF ON REF.CRE_RES_ID = CPE_REF_RES_ID AND REF.CRE_RES_TYP IN ('Physician', 'Dentist', 'Psychologist', 'PhD', 'Nurse Practitioner', 'Physician Assistant', 'Advanced Practice Nurse') JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT REFD ON CPE_REF_DEP_ID= REFD.CLD_DEPT_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_PT_APPT ON CPE_CL_PT_ID = CPA_CL_PT_ID AND CPE_ENC_DTE_SEQ = CPA_ENC_DTE_SEQ AND CPA_LINE_NO = 2 LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT SD ON CPA_DEPT_ID = SD.CLD_DEPT_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE SR ON SR.CRE_RES_ID = CPE_VST_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_PT_CHEMO CHM ON ENC.CPE_CL_PT_ID = CHM.CPC_CL_PT_ID AND ENC.CPE_ENC_DTE_SEQ = CHM.CPC_ENC_DTE_SEQ JOIN IDB.CL_CHEMO CHMNAME ON CHM.CPC_CHEMO_ID = CHMNAME.CCH_CHEMO_ID AND CHMNAME.CCH_CHEMO_NAME LIKE '%MITOMYCIN%' JOIN IDB.CL_PATIENT PAT ON ENC.CPE_MRN = PAT.CL_MRN WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN('Sch') AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT DATE + 3 DAY AND CURRENT DATE + 9 DAY AND CHMNAME.CCH_CHEMO_NAME <> 'INTRAVESICAL MITOMYCIN ONLY'

prompt: Upcoming appointments for Fall Precaution patients at Monmouth
completion: WITH FALL AS (SELECT DISTINCT OHI_MRN, LISTAGG(OHI_SHORT_NAME, ', ') WITHIN GROUP( ORDER BY OHI_ONSET_DTE) OHI_SHORT_NAME FROM IDB.OMS_HEALTH_ISSUE WHERE OHI_TYPE_CD = 'Falls Risk' AND OHI_STS_CD = 'Active' GROUP BY OHI_MRN) SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN "MRN", PT_LAST_NAME "Last Name", PT_FIRST_NAME "First Name", CPE_ENC_DTE "Appt Date", CLD_CLD_CENTER "Center", CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 "Department", CLD_DEPT_NAME "Department Name", CRE_RES_NAME "Provider Name", CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME "Visit Type", OHI_SHORT_NAME "Falls Risk" FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID JOIN FALL ON CPE_MRN = OHI_MRN JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON CPE_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Sch') AND CLD_CLD_CENTER = 'MON' AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT DATE + 1 DAY AND CURRENT DATE + 2 DAY ORDER BY CPE_ENC_DTE, CLD_CLD_CENTER, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6, CLD_DEPT_NAME, CPE_MRN ; WITH FALL AS (SELECT DISTINCT OHI_MRN FROM IDB.OMS_HEALTH_ISSUE WHERE OHI_TYPE_CD = 'Falls Risk' AND OHI_STS_CD = 'Active' ) SELECT CPE_ENC_DTE "Appt Date", COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN OHI_MRN IS NOT NULL THEN CPE_MRN END) "Fall Patients at BSK", COUNT(DISTINCT CPE_MRN) "All Patients at BSK" FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID LEFT JOIN FALL ON CPE_MRN = OHI_MRN JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON CPE_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Sch') AND CLD_CLD_CENTER = 'MON' AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT DATE + 1 DAY AND CURRENT DATE + 2 DAY GROUP BY CPE_ENC_DTE

prompt: Create Darwin On Demand report for appointment data with capability to search by provider, visit type, department, and date.
completion: SELECT CPE_MRN AS "MRN", TRIM(PT_LAST_NAME) AS "Pt Last Name", TRIM(PT_FIRST_NAME) AS "Pt First Name", CPE_ENC_DTE AS "Appt Date", TRIM(CPE_CPE_APPT_STS) AS "Appt Status", TRIM(CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6) AS "Department", TRIM(CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8) AS "Service", TRIM(CLD_DEPT_NAME) AS "Department Name", TRIM(CRE_RES_NAME) AS "Provider Name", TRIM(CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME) AS "Visit Type", TRIM(CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR) AS "Visit Type Abbreviation", TRIM(CCH_CHEMO_NAME) AS "Scheduling Code Name", TRIM(CCH_CHEMO_ID) AS "Scheduling Code" FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON CPE_MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_PT_CHEMO ON CPE_CL_PT_ID = CPC_CL_PT_ID AND CPE_ENC_DTE_SEQ = CPC_ENC_DTE_SEQ LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_CHEMO ON CPC_CHEMO_ID = CCH_CHEMO_ID WHERE 1=1 #PROMPT('StartDate', '', ' ', ' and date(CPE_ENC_DTE) >= ', '', '') #PROMPT('EndDate', '', ' ', ' and date(CPE_ENC_DTE) <= ', '', '') #PROMPTMANY('Resource', 'String', ' ', ' and CRE_RES_NAME in (', '', ')')# #PROMPTMANY('Visit Type', 'String', ' ', ' and CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME in (', '', ')')# #PROMPTMANY('Department', 'String', ' ', ' and CLD_DEPT_NAME in (', '', ')')#

prompt: Create a monthly report based on MED17437 listing  all past month entered  'Geriatric Inpatient Consult' orders
completion: SELECT OUO_MRN MRN, STRIP(PT_LAST_NAME)||', '||STRIP(PT_FIRST_NAME) PT_NAME, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH DOB, PT_SEX_DESC GENDER, YEAR(OUO_ENTER_DTE) - YEAR(PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) AGE_AT_ORD, OUO_ENTER_DTE ORD_ENTER_DTE, OUO_CURR_LOC PT_LOCATION, OUO_ORD_NAME ORD_NAME, OUO_ORD_ID ORD_ID, OUO_STS_DESC ORD_STATUS , OUO_ATN_PVDR_NAME PVDR_NAME, OUO_OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE ORD_PERFORMED_DTE, MAX(CASE WHEN OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'Consult_Cancer Dx:' THEN OUD_USER_DI_VALUE ELSE '' END) CANCER_DX, MAX(CASE WHEN OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'Consult_Geriatric Reason for'THEN OUD_USER_DI_VALUE ELSE '' END) CONSULT_REASON FROM IDB.OMS_USER_ORDERS JOIN IDB.PATIENT_V ON OUO_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_USER_DATA ON OUO_ORD_GUID = OUD_ORD_GUID WHERE OUO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID = '9000008080100730' AND OUO_OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE BETWEEN LAST_DAY(CURRENT date - 2 MONTH) AND LAST_DAY(CURRENT date - 1 MONTH) + 1 DAY GROUP BY OUO_MRN , STRIP(PT_LAST_NAME)||', '||STRIP(PT_FIRST_NAME) , PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH , PT_SEX_DESC , YEAR(OUO_ENTER_DTE) - YEAR(PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) , OUO_ENTER_DTE, OUO_CURR_LOC , OUO_ORD_NAME , OUO_ORD_ID , OUO_STS_DESC , OUO_ATN_PVDR_NAME , OUO_OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE ;

prompt:
Requesting the following MSKEngage data in excel format:

Name: "Telehealth Satisfaction Survey"

Status: "Completed"

Providers: "Pfister, David", "Sherman, Eric J", "Ho, Alan", "Dunn, Lara Ann", "Kriplani, Anuja", "Michel, Loren Scott". "Fetten, James Vincent"

Date From: "01/01/2020"

Date To: "12/31/2020" (Present)

PHI request: Yes - including all PHI available for each response (Patient name, MRN, DOB, Age, Sex, Submission date, etc.)
completion: WITH SURV AS (SELECT EF_MRN , EA_SOURCE_ID , EF_FORM_NAME , EF_SUBMISSION_DT , EFI_ITEM_TEXT , EFI_ITEM_ALIAS , EFI_VALUE FROM IDB.EF_FORM JOIN IDB.EF_FORM_ITEM ON EF_FORM_ID = EFI_FORM_ID JOIN IDB.EF_ASSESSMENT ON EF_FORM_EXTERNAL_ID = EA_ASSESS_ID WHERE EF_FORM_NAME = 'Telehealth Satisfaction Survey' AND DATE(EF_SUBMISSION_DT) >= '2020-01-01' ) , APPT AS (SELECT CPE_MRN , CPE_ENC_CSN_ID , CPE_ENC_DTE , CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 AS DEPT , CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 AS SERVICE , CLD_DEPT_NAME AS DEPT_NAME , CRE_RES_NAME AS PROVIDER , CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME AS VISIT_TYPE FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.DOC ON CRE_RES_ID = DOC_DR_NO AND DOC_DR_NO IN ('002816', '017962', '014217', '015024', '024406', '019984', '006981', '020446', '022558', '010421', '005538', '007039', '008441', '016816', '020842', '012211', '005157', '024679', '014522', '017996', '011064', '018077', '019521', '019513', '024174') JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT EF_MRN, EA_SOURCE_ID FROM SURV) A ON CPE_ENC_CSN_ID = EA_SOURCE_ID AND CPE_MRN = EF_MRN WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') ) SELECT EF_MRN MRN , TRIM(PT_LAST_NAME) || ', ' || TRIM(PT_FIRST_NAME) PATIENT_NAME , PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH DOB , YEAR(DATE(EF_SUBMISSION_DT) - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) AGE_AT_SUBMISSION , PT_SEX SEX , CPE_ENC_DTE APPT_DTE , DEPT , SERVICE , DEPT_NAME , PROVIDER , VISIT_TYPE , DATE(EF_SUBMISSION_DT) SUBMISSION_DTE , EFI_ITEM_TEXT , EFI_VALUE FROM SURV JOIN APPT ON EF_MRN = CPE_MRN AND EA_SOURCE_ID = CPE_ENC_CSN_ID JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON EF_MRN = PT_MRN

prompt: Provide a list of MRNs for specified list of de-identified IDs
Daily list of new patients prescribed olaparib, rucaparib, pembrolizumab in the last 2 weeks
completion: WITH DRUG AS (SELECT HCPR_MRN, MIN(DATE(HCPR_START_DT)) HCPR_START_DT, OP_DISPLAY_NAME AS PROVIDER, HGN_GENERIC_NAME FROM IDB.HML_CLIENT_PRESCRIPTION JOIN IDB.HML_GENERIC_NAME ON HCPR_GENERIC_NAME_ID = HGN_GENERIC_NAME_ID JOIN IDB.OMS_PROVIDER ON HCPR_CARE_PROV_GUID = OP_PVDR_GUID WHERE HGN_GENERIC_NAME IN ('olaparib', 'rucaparib', 'pembrolizumab', 'niraparib', 'talazoparib', 'veliparib') GROUP BY HCPR_MRN, OP_DISPLAY_NAME, HGN_GENERIC_NAME HAVING MIN(DATE(HCPR_START_DT)) >= CURRENT DATE - 14 DAYS) , SCH AS (SELECT CPE_MRN, MIN(CPE_ENC_DTE) CPE_ENC_DTE, MIN(CPE_APPT_DT) CPE_APPT_DT, CLD_DEPT_NAME AS "Upcoming Appt Dept", CRE_RES_NAME AS "Upcoming Appt Provider", CRE_RES_TYP FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID JOIN DRUG ON HCPR_MRN = CPE_MRN AND CRE_RES_TYP IN ('Physician', 'Nurse Practitioner', 'Physician Assistant', 'Advanced Practice Nurse') WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Sch') AND CPE_ENC_DTE >= CURRENT DATE GROUP BY CPE_MRN, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6, CLD_DEPT_NAME, CRE_RES_NAME, CRE_RES_TYP ) , SCHB AS (SELECT SCH.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CPE_MRN ORDER BY CPE_APPT_DT) ROWNUM FROM SCH) , PROTOCOL AS (SELECT AC_MRN, AC_CONS_DTE FROM IDB.ACCRUALS JOIN DRUG ON HCPR_MRN = AC_MRN WHERE AC_IRB_NO = '12-245' ) SELECT DISTINCT HCPR_MRN "MRN", PT_LAST_NAME "Last Name", HCPR_START_DT "First Prescribe Date", PROVIDER "Prescriber", HGN_GENERIC_NAME AS "Generic Name", CPE_ENC_DTE AS "Upcoming Appt Date", "Upcoming Appt Dept", "Upcoming Appt Provider", AC_CONS_DTE "12-245 Consent Date" FROM DRUG JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON HCPR_MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN SCHB ON HCPR_MRN = CPE_MRN AND ROWNUM = 1 LEFT JOIN PROTOCOL ON HCPR_MRN = AC_MRN

prompt: Provide a list of all active MSK Departments and their services
completion: SELECT CLD_DEPT_NAME DEPT_NAME, CLD_CLD_CENTER LOCATION, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 DEPT_GRP6_CODE, C6.CAV_NAME DEPT_GRP6_DESC, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 DEPT_GRP8_CODE, C8.CAV_NAME DEPT_GRP8_DESC, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_1 FROM IDB.CL_DEPT LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_CATEGORY C6 ON CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 = C6.CAV_ABBR AND C6.CAV_CATEGORY = 'CLD_RPT_GRP_6' LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_CATEGORY C8 ON CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 = C8.CAV_ABBR AND C8.CAV_CATEGORY = 'CLD_RPT_GRP_8' WHERE CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_1 NOT IN ('Reg', 'REG') AND CLD_REC_STS <> 'Inactive' AND CLD_CLD_CENTER NOT IN ('BER', 'BSK', 'CMK', 'DNV', 'DVR', 'ERW', 'HAU', 'MON', 'NAS', 'RVC', 'SLH', 'WES', 'WHP', 'YON')

prompt: Total amount of drug dispensed per patient from start of trial enrollment (IRB: 12-045) until off-study. Arm A patients: cisplatin, gemcitabine, veliparib. Arm B patients: cisplatin and gemcitabine.
completion: WITH ETO AS (SELECT DISTINCT ACD_IRB_NO IRBNO, ACD_MRN MRN, AC_LAST_NAME LAST_NAME, AC_FIRST_NAME FIRST_NAME, AC_DOB DOB, AC_RACE RACE, AC_SEX SEX, ACD_CONS_DTE CONSENT_DATE, AC_CONS_DTE, ACD_OFF_STUDY_DTE OFF_STUDY_DTE, ACD_TX_ST_DTE , ACD_TX_END_DTE FROM IDB.ACCRUALS_DATES JOIN IDB.ACCRUALS ON ACD_IRB_NO = AC_IRB_NO AND ACD_MRN = AC_MRN WHERE ACD_IRB_NO = '12-045' AND ACD_MRN <> 'ZZZZZZZZ' ), CHEMO AS (SELECT IRBNO, MRN, STRIP(LAST_NAME)||', '||STRIP(FIRST_NAME) PT_NAME, DOB, RACE, SEX, CONSENT_DATE, OFF_STUDY_DTE, CPO_ORD_GUID, CPO_ORDID, CPO_ORD_NAME , CPO_DRUG_NAME, CPO_START_DTE , CPO_SET_GUID, CPO_SET_NAME , CASE WHEN COALESCE(CPO_SET_NAME, '') > '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END NO_SET , DEC(TRANSLATE(LTRIM(RTRIM(TRANSLATE(CHAR(CASE WHEN RTRIM(LTRIM(CPO_QUANTITY)) IN ('') THEN NULL WHEN RTRIM(LTRIM(TRANSLATE(RTRIM(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(CPO_QUANTITY, '%', ''), '+', ''), '-', ''), '>', ''), '<', '')), '*', ' 1234567890'))) IN ('', '.') THEN DEC(RTRIM(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE (REPLACE (CPO_QUANTITY, '%', ''),'+', ''), '-', ''), '>', ''), '<', '')), 20, 5) ELSE NULL END), ' ', '0'))), '0', ' ')|| '0', 12, 5) AS QTY , DEC(TRANSLATE(LTRIM(RTRIM(TRANSLATE(CHAR(CASE WHEN RTRIM(LTRIM(CPO_DOSE)) IN ('') THEN NULL WHEN RTRIM(LTRIM(TRANSLATE(RTRIM(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(CPO_DOSE, '%', ''), '+', ''), '-', ''), '>', ''), '<', '')), '*', ' 1234567890'))) IN ('', '.') THEN DEC(RTRIM(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE (REPLACE (CPO_DOSE, '%', ''),'+', ''), '-', ''), '>', ''), '<', '')), 20, 5) ELSE NULL END), ' ', '0'))), '0', ' ')|| '0', 12, 5)AS DOSE, CPO_TIME_PRIORITY, CPO_FREQ, CPO_GENERIC_NAME, CPO_DURATION, CPO_QUANTITY QUANTITY, CPO_DOSE_UNIT DOSE_UNIT, CPO_MED_FORM, CPO_ROUTE FROM ETO JOIN IDB.CHEMO_PERFORMED_ORDERS ON MRN = CPO_MRN WHERE CPO_START_DTE BETWEEN CONSENT_DATE AND COALESCE(OFF_STUDY_DTE, CURRENT DATE) ) , FINAL AS (SELECT T0.IRBNO, T0.MRN, T0.PT_NAME, T0.DOB, T0.RACE, T0.SEX, T0.CONSENT_DATE, T0.OFF_STUDY_DTE , T0.CPO_DRUG_NAME , T0.CPO_GENERIC_NAME, CPO_MED_FORM, CPO_ROUTE, MIN(T0.CPO_START_DTE) START_DATE, MAX(T0.CPO_START_DTE) END_DATE, SUM(T0.NO_SET) NO_ORD_SETS , SUM(T0.DOSE) SUM_DOSE , T0.DOSE_UNIT , SUM(T0.QTY) TOTAL_QTY, SUM(COALESCE(T0.QTY, 1))* SUM(T0.DOSE) TOTAL_DOSE FROM CHEMO T0 WHERE (UPPER(T0.CPO_GENERIC_NAME) like '%CISPLATIN%' OR UCASE(T0.CPO_GENERIC_NAME) LIKE '%GEMCITABINE%' OR UCASE(T0.CPO_GENERIC_NAME) LIKE '%VELIPARIB%' OR UCASE(T0.CPO_GENERIC_NAME) = 'ABT-888') GROUP BY T0.IRBNO, T0.MRN, T0.PT_NAME, T0.DOB, T0.RACE, T0.SEX, T0.CONSENT_DATE, T0.OFF_STUDY_DTE , T0.CPO_DRUG_NAME , T0.CPO_GENERIC_NAME, T0.DOSE_UNIT , CPO_MED_FORM, CPO_ROUTE ) SELECT T0.IRBNO "IRB Number", T0.MRN "MRN", T0.PT_NAME "Patient Name", T0.DOB "Date of Birth", T0.RACE "Race", T0.SEX "Sex", T0.CONSENT_DATE "Consent Date", T0.OFF_STUDY_DTE "Off study date", T0.CPO_DRUG_NAME "Drug Name", T0.CPO_GENERIC_NAME "Generic Name", CPO_MED_FORM "Med Form", CPO_ROUTE "Route", START_DATE "Start Date", END_DATE "End Date", NO_ORD_SETS "Number of Order Sets", SUM_DOSE "Sum Dose", TOTAL_DOSE "Total Dose", T0.DOSE_UNIT "Dose Unit", TOTAL_QTY "Total Quantity" FROM FINAL T0 ;

prompt: Provide a spreadsheet of patients who have a diagnosis of spinal cord ependymoma and have undergone RT.
completion: WITH TM AS (SELECT DISTINCT TM_MRN AS MRN, TM_DX_DTE AS DX_DATE, TM_HIST_CD AS HIST_CODE, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS HIST_DESC, TM_SITE_CD AS SITE_CODE, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_DESC, CASE WHEN TM_BEST_AJCC_STG NOT IN ('', '88', '9', '99') THEN TM_BEST_AJCC_STG WHEN TM_AJCC_7 NOT IN ('', '888', '999') THEN AJCC7.AV_DESC WHEN TM_AJCC NOT IN ('', '88', '99') THEN AJCC.AV_DESC WHEN TM_GENERAL_STG NOT IN ('', '9') THEN GS.AV_DESC WHEN TM_PATH_STG_GRP NOT IN ('', '88', '9', '99') THEN TM_PATH_STG_GRP ELSE CLIN.AV_DESC END AS STAGE FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM H ON TM_HIST_CD = H.CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON TM_SITE_CD = S.CLM_CLSF_CD LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS AJCC7 ON AJCC7.AV_ELEMENT = 'AJCC_7' AND AJCC7.AV_CODE = TM_AJCC_7 LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS AJCC ON AJCC.AV_ELEMENT = 'AJCC' AND AJCC.AV_CODE = TM_AJCC LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS GS ON GS.AV_ELEMENT = 'GENERAL_STG' AND GS.AV_CODE = TM_GENERAL_STG LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS CLIN ON CLIN.AV_ELEMENT = 'CLIN_STG_DSCR' AND CLIN.AV_CODE = TM_CLIN_STG_DSCR WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND TM_HIST_CD IN ('M9391/3', 'M9392/3', 'M9393/3', 'M9383/1', 'M9394/1') AND TM_SITE_CD IN ('C720', 'C721', 'C729', 'C701', 'C809') ) , DX AS (SELECT * FROM TM ) , RT AS (SELECT DISTINCT RTC_TX_MRN, RTC_TX_PLAN_NAME, RTC_PRIMARY_REF_POINT, RTC_TX_START_DTE, RTC_TX_STOP_DTE, RTC_TX_ELAPSED_DAYS, RTC_TX_PLANNED_FRACTIONS, RTC_TX_DELIVERED_FRACTIONS, RTC_TX_PLANNED_DOSE, RTC_TX_DELIVERED_DOSE, RTC_DOSE_CORRECTION FROM IDB.RADONC_TREATMENT_COURSE JOIN DX ON MRN = RTC_TX_MRN) SELECT * FROM RT , X AS (SELECT DISTINCT DX.* FROM DX JOIN RT ON MRN = RTC_TX_MRN) , MAIN AS (SELECT PT_MRN, STRIP(PT_LAST_NAME) || ', ' || STRIP(PT_FIRST_NAME) AS NAME, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH AS DOB, PT_SEX AS GENDER, R.AV_DESC AS "Race", E.AV_DESC AS "Ethnicity", PT_DATE_OF_DEATH AS DOD, COALESCE(MAX(PLA_LST_APPT_DTE, PLA_LST_DSCH_DTE), PLA_LST_APPT_DTE, PLA_LST_DSCH_DTE) AS LAST_FU_DATE, HIST_CODE, HIST_DESC, SITE_CODE, SITE_DESC, DX_DATE, STAGE FROM X JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PT_MRN = MRN JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY ON PT_MRN = PLA_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS R ON PT_RACE = R.AV_CODE AND R.AV_ELEMENT = 'RACE' LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS E ON PT_PT_ETHNICITY = E.AV_CODE AND E.AV_ELEMENT = 'PT_ETHNICITY') , CHEMO AS (SELECT APR_MRN, CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME, MIN(APR_START_DTE) AS START_DATE, MAX(APR_END_DTE) AS END_DATE, APR_ORD_RX_TYPE FROM X JOIN IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX_V ON APR_MRN = MRN WHERE CDG_CHEMO_FLAG = 'Y' GROUP BY APR_MRN, CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME, APR_ORD_RX_TYPE ) , SRG AS (SELECT DISTINCT SSE_MRN, SSE_SURG_DTE, SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD, SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC FROM X JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT ON SSE_MRN = MRN JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE ON SSE_LOG_ID = SSP_LOG_ID WHERE 1=1 ) SELECT * FROM SRG

prompt: Identify all patients with mucosal melanoma of the nasal cavity and paranasal sinuses since 1/1/1992
completion: WITH "cte1" AS (SELECT TEXTTABLE.*, CONTAINS("PRPT_REPORT", '(("ethmoid" | "maxilla" | "nose" | ' || '"nasal" | "sinus") & ("Mucosal Melanoma" | ' || '"Primary Mucosal Melanoma" | ' || '"Extracutaneous Malignant Melanoma" | ' || '"Mucosal Melanoma of the Head and Neck" | ' || '"Primary Sinonasal Mucosal Melanoma" | ' || '("mucosa%" & "melano%")))') AS "HitCol1" FROM "DV"."PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V" TEXTTABLE) SELECT DISTINCT "t1"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AS "Deident PT #", "t2"."PT_MRN" AS "MRN", "t2"."PT_LAST_NAME" AS "Last Name", "t2"."PT_FIRST_NAME" AS "First Name" FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED" "t1" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V" "t2" ON "t1"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t2"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."CDB_TUMOR_V" "t3" ON "t1"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t3"."CDTM_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."TUMOR_CASE_ATTRIBUTES" "t4" ON "t3"."CDTM_CASE_ATTR_ID" = "t4"."TUMOR_CASE_ATTR_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE" "t5" ON "t3"."CDTM_DX_DATE_ID" = "t5"."DT_DATE_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DIAGNOSIS_CODE_CAT_ICDO_V" "t6" ON "t3"."CDTM_DX_CATALOG_ID" = "t6"."DXCC_DX_CATALOG_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."ICDO_SITE_CATALOG_V" "t7" ON "t3"."CDTM_SITE_CATALOG_ID" = "t7"."ICSC_SITE_CATALOG_ID" LEFT JOIN "cte1" "t8" ON "t1"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t8"."PRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE" "t9" ON "t8"."PRPT_REPORT_DATE_ID" = "t9"."DT_DATE_ID" WHERE (("t4"."TCA_CASE_STS_DESC" IN ('Completed ', 'Consult only ', 'Non-Index tumor ', 'Pathology only ') AND ("t5"."DT_DTE" >= '1992-1-1' AND ("t6"."DXCC_ICD_CODE" IN ('M8720/3', 'M8721/3', 'M8722/3', 'M8723/3', 'M8728/3', 'M8730/3', 'M8740/3', 'M8741/3', 'M8742/3', 'M8743/3', 'M8744/3', 'M8745/3', 'M8746/3', 'M8761/3', 'M8770/3', 'M8771/3', 'M8772/3', 'M8773/3', 'M8774/3', 'M8775/3', 'M8780/3') AND "t7"."ICSC_SITE_CD" IN ('C300', 'C301', 'C310', 'C311', 'C312', 'C313', 'C318', 'C319')))) OR ("t9"."DT_DTE" >= '1992-1-1' AND "t8"."HitCol1" <> 0))

prompt: Provide a list of tumor characteristics variables of all tumors of MSK patients who consented for the IMAPCT study and who had more than one primary breast cancers.
completion: WITH MIN_BR_CONSENT AS (SELECT BPE_MRN AS MIN_BPE_MRN FROM IDB.BR_PT_EVENT BPE JOIN IDB.BR_PRIMARY ON BP_MRN =BPE_MRN AND BPE_PRIM_SEQ_NO=BP_PRIM_SEQ_NO JOIN IDB.ACCRUALS A ON AC_MRN= BPE_MRN AND AC_CONS_DTE IS NOT NULL AND AC_IRB_NO ='12-245' GROUP BY BPE_MRN HAVING COUNT(*)>1), BR_CONSENT AS (SELECT MIN_BPE_MRN, BPE_PRIM_SEQ_NO AS FOLLOWUP_PRIM_SEQ_NO, BPE_DX_ID AS FOLLOWUP_DX_ID, DATE(BPE_DX_DT) AS FOLLOWUP_DX_DTE FROM MIN_BR_CONSENT JOIN IDB.BR_PT_EVENT BPE ON BPE_MRN =MIN_BPE_MRN JOIN IDB.BR_PRIMARY ON BP_MRN =BPE_MRN AND BPE_PRIM_SEQ_NO=BP_PRIM_SEQ_NO ) , MIN_TM_CONSENT AS (SELECT TM_MRN AS MRN FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.ACCRUALS A ON AC_MRN= TM_MRN AND AC_CONS_DTE IS NOT NULL AND AC_IRB_NO ='12-245' WHERE 1=1 AND TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND TM_TUMOR_SEQ NOT IN('M0', '00') AND TM_SITE_CD IN ('C500', 'C501', 'C502', 'C503', 'C504', 'C505', 'C506', 'C508', 'C509') GROUP BY TM_MRN HAVING COUNT(*)>1), TM_CONSENT AS (SELECT DISTINCT TM_MRN AS MRN, TM_TUMOR_SEQ AS TUMOR_SEQ, TM_DX_DTE AS DX_DTE FROM MIN_TM_CONSENT JOIN IDB.CDB_TUMOR ON TM_MRN=MRN JOIN IDB.ACCRUALS A ON AC_MRN= TM_MRN AND AC_CONS_DTE IS NOT NULL AND AC_IRB_NO ='12-245' WHERE 1=1 AND TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') ), TUMOR AS (SELECT TM_MRN, TM_TUMOR_SEQ, TS.AV_DESC AS TUMOR_SEQ_DESCRIPTION, YEAR(TM_DX_DTE-PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) AS AGE_AT_DX, CS.AV_DESC AS "Case Status", TM_HIST_CD AS "ICD-O Histology Code", H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS "ICD-O Histology Desc", TM_SITE_CD AS "ICD-O Site Code", S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS "ICD-O Site Desc", L.AV_DESC AS "Laterality", CASE WHEN TM_SSF1 = '000' THEN 'Test not done (test not ordered and not performed)' WHEN TM_SSF1 = '010' THEN 'Positive/elevated' WHEN TM_SSF1 = '020' THEN 'Negative/normal; within normal limits' WHEN TM_SSF1 = '030' THEN 'Borderline; undetermined whether positive or negative' WHEN TM_SSF1 = '080' THEN 'Ordered, but results not in chart' WHEN TM_SSF1 = '988' THEN 'Not applicable: Information not collected for this case' WHEN TM_SSF1 = '996' THEN 'Test ordered, results not interpretable' WHEN TM_SSF1 = '997' THEN 'Test ordered, results not in chart' WHEN TM_SSF1 = '998' THEN 'Test not done (test not ordered and not performed)' WHEN TM_SSF1 = '999' THEN 'Unknown or no information; not documented in patient record' ELSE '' END AS "ER", CASE WHEN TM_SSF2 = '000' THEN 'Test not done (test not ordered and not performed)' WHEN TM_SSF2 = '010' THEN 'Positive/elevated' WHEN TM_SSF2 = '020' THEN 'Negative/normal; within normal limits' WHEN TM_SSF2 = '030' THEN 'Borderline; undetermined whether positive or negative' WHEN TM_SSF2 = '080' THEN 'Ordered, but results not in chart' WHEN TM_SSF2 = '988' THEN 'Not applicable: Information not collected for this case' WHEN TM_SSF2 = '996' THEN 'Test ordered, results not interpretable' WHEN TM_SSF2 = '997' THEN 'Test ordered, results not in chart' WHEN TM_SSF2 = '998' THEN 'Test not done (test not ordered and not performed)' WHEN TM_SSF2 = '999' THEN 'Unknown or no information; not documented in patient record' ELSE '' END AS "PR", CASE WHEN TM_SSF15 = '010' THEN 'Positive/elevated; amplified' WHEN TM_SSF15 = '020' THEN 'Negative/normal; within normal limits; not amplified' WHEN TM_SSF15 = '030' THEN 'Borderline; equivocal; indeterminate; undetermined whether positive or negative' WHEN TM_SSF15 = '988' THEN 'Not applicable: Information not collected for this case' WHEN TM_SSF15 = '997' THEN 'Test ordered, results not in chart' WHEN TM_SSF15 = '998' THEN 'Test not done (test not ordered and not performed)' WHEN TM_SSF15 = '999' THEN 'Unknown or no information; not documented in patient record' ELSE '' END AS "HER2 Summary Result", TM_HIST_CD_GRADE, G.AV_DESC AS GRADE, TM_CLIN_TNM_T AS "Clinical T Stage", TM_CLIN_TNM_N AS "Clinical N Stage", TM_CLIN_TNM_M AS "Clinical M Stage", TM_CLIN_STG_GRP AS "Clinical Group Stage", TM_PATH_TNM_T AS "Pathologic T Stage", TM_PATH_TNM_N AS "Pathologic N Stage", TM_PATH_TNM_M AS "Pathologic M Stage", TM_PATH_STG_GRP AS "Pathologic Group Stage" , TM_BEST_AJCC_STG AJCC_STAGE FROM TM_CONSENT JOIN IDB.CDB_TUMOR ON MRN = TM_MRN AND TUMOR_SEQ=TM_TUMOR_SEQ JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PT_MRN=TM_MRN JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS CS ON CS.AV_ELEMENT = 'CASE_STS' AND CS.AV_CODE = TM_CASE_STS LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS TS ON TS.AV_ELEMENT = 'TUMOR_SEQ' AND TS.AV_CODE = TM_TUMOR_SEQ LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS G ON G.AV_ELEMENT = 'HIST_CD_GRADE' AND G.AV_CODE = TM_HIST_CD_GRADE JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS L ON L.AV_ELEMENT = 'LATERALITY_CD' AND L.AV_CODE = TM_LATERALITY_CD LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS T ON T.AV_ELEMENT='TSTAGE_7' AND T.AV_CODE = TM_TSTAGE_7 LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS N ON N.AV_ELEMENT='NSTAGE_7' AND N.AV_CODE = TM_NSTAGE_7 LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS M ON M.AV_ELEMENT='MSTAGE_7' AND M.AV_CODE = TM_MSTAGE_7 LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS A ON A.AV_ELEMENT='AJCC_7' AND A.AV_CODE = TM_AJCC_7), BP AS (SELECT BP_MRN, BP_PRIM_SEQ_NO, BP_DX_ID, YEAR(FOLLOWUP_DX_DTE) AS DX_YEAR, BP_AGE_AT_DX, BP_TUMOR_SIZE, BP_PATH_TM_SIZE, BP_PRIM_SITE_CD, BP_PRIM_SITE_DESC, BP_SURG_MARG_DESC, BP_TUMOR_SIDE_CD, BP_TUMOR_SIDE_DESC, BP_MRI_DESC, BP_ESTRG_RCR_CD, BP_ESTRG_RCR_DESC, BP_PRGSTR_RCP_DESC, BP_HER2_DESC, BP_FISH_DESC, BP_DCIS_COMD_DESC, BP_DCIS_CONF_DESC, BP_STAGE_GRD_DESC, BP_DCISHX_GRD_DESC, BP_NUCL_GRD_DESC, BP_EXT_SITE_DESC, BP_EXT_TYP_DESC, BP_CLN_STG_T_DESC, BP_CLN_STG_N_DESC, BP_CLN_STG_M_DESC, BP_PATH_STG_T_DESC, BP_PATH_STG_N_DESC, BP_PATH_STG_M_DESC, BP_ONCO_DX_DESC, BP_ER_PCT, BP_ER_NOT_DEF_DESC, BP_PR_PCT, BP_PR_NOT_DEF_DESC, BP_HER2_VALUE_DESC, BP_HER2_NOT_DEF_DESC, BP_FISH_NOT_DEF_DESC FROM BR_CONSENT JOIN IDB.BR_PT_EVENT BPE ON BPE_MRN =MIN_BPE_MRN AND BPE_PRIM_SEQ_NO = FOLLOWUP_PRIM_SEQ_NO JOIN IDB.BR_PRIMARY ON BP_MRN = BPE_MRN AND FOLLOWUP_PRIM_SEQ_NO=BP_PRIM_SEQ_NO AND FOLLOWUP_DX_ID=BP_DX_ID), DEID_MRN AS (SELECT BPTM_MRN AS DEID_CTE_BP_MRN, ROW_NUMBER() OVER( ORDER BY BPTM_MRN)AS DEID_BPTM_MRN FROM (SELECT BP_MRN AS BPTM_MRN FROM BP UNION SELECT TM_MRN AS BPTM_MRN FROM TUMOR) AS DEID_DEID_BPMRN) SELECT DEID_BPTM_MRN AS DEID_ID, MAX(CASE WHEN CRDB.PRT_ID = '12-245' AND CRNT_CONSENT_STATUS='Yes' THEN YEAR(CRDB.CRNT_CONSENT_DATE) END) "Impact Consent year", MAX(CASE WHEN CRDB.PRT_ID = '12-245' AND REG_ID = '100' THEN YEAR(CRDB.REGISTRATION_DATETIME) END) "12-245 Part A Reg year", MAX(CASE WHEN CRDB.PRT_ID = '12-245' AND REG_ID = '300' THEN YEAR(CRDB.REGISTRATION_DATETIME) END) "12-245 Part C Reg year" FROM NN.CRDB_DASH_PT_REG CRDB JOIN DEID_MRN ON DEID_CTE_BP_MRN=PT_MRN WHERE 1=1 AND (CRDB.PRT_ID = '12-245' AND REG_ID IN ('100', '300')) AND CRNT_ELGBL_STATUS_DSCRP NOT IN ('Ineligible', 'Cancel') GROUP BY DEID_BPTM_MRN

prompt: Provide all path reports in the past 3 years (2009-present) that contain the diagnosis of pigmented Basal cell carcinoma or pigmented BCC.
completion: SELECT DISTINCT "t1"."PT_MRN" AS "MRN", "t2"."DT_YEAR" AS "Pathology Report Year", "t3"."PRPT_ACCESSION_NO" AS "Pathology Report" FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V" "t1" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED" "t4" ON "t1"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t4"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V" "t3" ON "t4"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t3"."PRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" "t2" ON "t3"."PRPT_REPORT_DATE_ID" = "t2"."DT_DATE_ID" WHERE (("t2"."DT_YEAR" >= 2009 AND CONTAINS("t3"."PRPT_REPORT", '("pigmented Basal cell carcinoma" | "pigmented BCC")') = 1) AND "t3"."PRPT_REPORT" IS NOT NULL)

prompt: Provide pediatric rhabdomyosarcoma, and osteosarcoma patient names, who treated specified chemotherapy regimen from 2013 to 7/2020
completion: SELECT MRN MRN, PT_NAME, DOB, DOD, AGE_AT_FIRST_CHEMO, DRUG_NAME , APR_START_DTE START_DATE, APR_END_DTE END_DATE, DOSE FIRST_DOSE, DOSE_UOM, "Cancer Diagnosis", APR_ROUTE ROUTE, APR_SET_NAME SET_NAME FROM (SELECT APR_MRN MRN, STRIP(PT_LAST_NAME)||', '||STRIP(PT_FIRST_NAME) PT_NAME, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH DOB, PT_DATE_OF_DEATH DOD , YEAR(APR_START_DTE) - YEAR(PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) AS AGE_AT_FIRST_CHEMO, CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME DRUG_NAME , APR_START_DTE, APR_END_DTE, APR_PRESCRIBED_DOSE DOSE, LOWER(APR_DOSE_UOM) DOSE_UOM, R1.OUD_USER_DI_VALUE "Cancer Diagnosis", R2.OUD_USER_DI_VALUE "Tx Profile", APR_ROUTE , APR_SET_NAME , OO_SUMMARY_LINE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY APR_MRN ORDER BY APR_START_DTE) RN FROM IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX JOIN IDB.CHEMO_DRUG_GENERIC ON APR_GENERIC_NAME = CDG_GENERIC_NAME JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PT_MRN = APR_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_ORDER ON APR_SET_GUID = OO_SET_GUID AND APR_MRN = OO_MRN AND OO_ORD_NAME = 'Chemo Tx' JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_USER_DATA R1 ON OO_ORD_GUID = R1.OUD_ORD_GUID AND R1.OUD_USER_DI_CD= 'Cancer Diagnosis' JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_USER_DATA R2 ON OO_ORD_GUID = R2.OUD_ORD_GUID AND R2.OUD_USER_DI_CD= 'Chemo_Rx_Tx profile' WHERE CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME IN('CYCLOPHOSPHAMIDE') AND UPPER(APR_SET_NAME) like '%D9803%' AND (LOWER(OO_SUMMARY_LINE)like '%rhabdomyosarcoma%' OR LOWER(OO_SUMMARY_LINE)like '%erms%')) AS A WHERE RN = 1 AND AGE_AT_FIRST_CHEMO BETWEEN 0 AND 21 AND APR_START_DTE BETWEEN '2013-01-01' AND '2020-07-01' ; SELECT MRN MRN, PT_NAME, DOB, DOD, AGE_AT_FIRST_CHEMO, DRUG_NAME , APR_START_DTE START_DATE , DOSE, DOSE_UOM, "Cancer Diagnosis", APR_ROUTE ROUTE, APR_SET_NAME SET_NAME, "Tx Profile" FROM (SELECT APR_MRN MRN, STRIP(PT_LAST_NAME)||', '||STRIP(PT_FIRST_NAME) PT_NAME, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH DOB, PT_DATE_OF_DEATH DOD , YEAR(APR_START_DTE) - YEAR(PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) AS AGE_AT_FIRST_CHEMO, CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME DRUG_NAME , APR_START_DTE, APR_END_DTE, APR_PRESCRIBED_DOSE DOSE, LOWER(APR_DOSE_UOM) DOSE_UOM, R1.OUD_USER_DI_VALUE "Cancer Diagnosis", R2.OUD_USER_DI_VALUE "Tx Profile", APR_ROUTE , APR_SET_NAME , ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY APR_MRN ORDER BY APR_START_DTE) RN FROM IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX JOIN IDB.CHEMO_DRUG_GENERIC ON APR_GENERIC_NAME = CDG_GENERIC_NAME JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PT_MRN = APR_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_ORDER ON APR_SET_GUID = OO_SET_GUID AND APR_MRN = OO_MRN AND OO_ORD_NAME = 'Chemo Tx' JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_USER_DATA R1 ON OO_ORD_GUID = R1.OUD_ORD_GUID AND R1.OUD_USER_DI_CD= 'Cancer Diagnosis' JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_USER_DATA R2 ON OO_ORD_GUID = R2.OUD_ORD_GUID AND R2.OUD_USER_DI_CD= 'Chemo_Rx_Tx profile' WHERE CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME IN('METHOTREXATE', 'CISPLATIN') AND (OO_SUMMARY_LINE) like '%03-074%' AND UPPER(APR_SET_NAME) LIKE 'PEDS%' AND (LOWER(OO_SUMMARY_LINE)like '%osteosarcoma%' OR LOWER(OO_SUMMARY_LINE)like '%osarcoma%' OR LOWER(OO_SUMMARY_LINE)like '%ossteosarcoma%') ) AS A WHERE RN = 1 AND AGE_AT_FIRST_CHEMO BETWEEN 0 AND 21 ;

prompt: To update the dataline and to add a sheet for all of the radiology scans since start date of polatuzumab to 60 days after treatment end.
completion: WITH ICD AS (SELECT CC_MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS MIN_ICD9_EFF_DTE, CC_CLSF_CD AS ICD9_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS ICD9_DESC FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE (SUBSTR(CC_CLSF_CD, 1, 5) IN ('C83.3') OR CC_CLSF_CD like ('200%')) AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND (CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) GROUP BY CC_MRN, CC_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK ) SELECT DISTINCT APR_MRN, ICD9_CD, ICD9_DESC, APR_START_DTE, APR_END_DTE, CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME, APR_GENERIC_NAME, APR_PRESCRIBED_DOSE, APR_ROUTE FROM ICD LEFT JOIN IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX ON CC_MRN = APR_MRN JOIN IDB.CHEMO_DRUG_GENERIC ON APR_GENERIC_NAME = CDG_GENERIC_NAME WHERE (LOWER(CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME) LIKE '%polatuzumab%' OR (UPPER(CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME) LIKE '%TISAGENLECLEUCEL%' OR UPPER(CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME) LIKE '%AXICABTAGENE CILOLEUCEL%' OR UPPER(CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME) LIKE '%BREXUCABTAGENE AUTOLEUCEL%' OR UPPER(CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME) LIKE '%LISOCABTAGENE MARALEUCEL%' OR UPPER(CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME) LIKE '%IDECABTAGENE VICLEUCEL%' OR UPPER(CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME) LIKE '%CILTACABTAGENE AUTOLEUCEL%') ) ; WITH ICD AS (SELECT CC_MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS MIN_ICD9_EFF_DTE, CC_CLSF_CD AS ICD9_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS ICD9_DESC FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE SUBSTR(CC_CLSF_CD, 1, 5) IN ('C83.3') AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND (CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) GROUP BY CC_MRN, CC_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK ), FN AS (SELECT DISTINCT APR_MRN, ICD9_CD, ICD9_DESC, APR_START_DTE, APR_END_DTE, CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME, APR_GENERIC_NAME, APR_PRESCRIBED_DOSE, APR_ROUTE FROM ICD LEFT JOIN IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX ON CC_MRN = APR_MRN JOIN IDB.CHEMO_DRUG_GENERIC ON APR_GENERIC_NAME = CDG_GENERIC_NAME WHERE LOWER(CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME) LIKE '%polatuzumab%' ) SELECT DISTINCT RRPT_MRN, RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE, RRPT_ORDER_GROUP, RRPT_PROCEDURE_NAME, CAST(RRPT_REPORT_TXT AS VARCHAR(12000)) AS "REPORT" FROM DV.RADIOLOGY_REPORT_V JOIN FN ON APR_MRN = RRPT_MRN WHERE RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE<= '2023-12-28' ;
