prompt: Need daily report of Geriatrics patients that are scheduled for surgery same as the report date.
completion: WITH X AS (SELECT DISTINCT * FROM (SELECT CPE_MRN AS "MRN", CPE_ENC_DTE AS "Appt Date", CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 AS "Department", CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 AS "Service", CLD_DEPT_NAME AS "Department Name", CRE_RES_NAME AS "Provider Name", DOC_NAME, DOC_SVC, DOC_ACDMC_SVC, CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME AS "Visit Type", ROWNUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY CPE_MRN ORDER BY CPE_ENC_DTE DESC) RN FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID JOIN IDB.DOC ON CPE_REF_RES_ID=DOC_DR_NO WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CRE_RES_TYP IN ('Physician', 'PhD', 'Dentist', 'Psychologist') AND CPE_VST_RES_ID IN ('014811', '024505', '015594', '018895') AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT DATE - 3 MONTHS AND CURRENT DATE ) WHERE RN =1 ), FIN AS (SELECT DISTINCT STRIP(OC_MRN) AS MRN, STRIP(PT_LAST_NAME) || ', ' || STRIP(PT_FIRST_NAME) AS "Name", YEAR(CURRENT DATE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) AS AGE, STRIP(OC_CASE_ID) AS "Case ID", "Appt Date" LAST_GER_APP_DATE, "Provider Name" LAST_SEEN_GERIATRIC_PROVIDER, "Department", "Service", OC_SURG_DTE AS "Upcoming Surgery Date", STRIP(O.CRE_RES_NAME) AS "Surgeon", OP_REC_CR_DTE, STRIP(CPX_PROC_CD)||'/'||STRIP(CPX_PROC_NAME) AS "CPT Description", OP_OR_PROC_ID||' -'||STRIP(OP_PROC_NAME) AS "Procedure Name", OC_OR_CASE_STS_CD, OC_OR_CASE_STS FROM X JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON "MRN" = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.OR_CASE ON PT_MRN = OC_MRN JOIN IDB.OR_CASE_ALL_PROC ON OC_CASE_ID = OCAP_CASE_ID JOIN IDB.OR_CASE_ALL_SURG ON OCAP_CASE_ID = OCAS_CASE_ID AND OCAS_PNL_NO = OCAP_PNL_NO JOIN IDB.OR_PROC ON OCAP_OR_PROC_ID = OP_OR_PROC_ID JOIN IDB.OR_CL_PROC ON OP_OR_PROC_ID = OCP_OR_PROC_ID JOIN IDB.CL_PROC ON OCP_PROC_ID = CPX_PROC_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE O ON O.CRE_RES_ID = OCAS_RES_ID WHERE OC_SURG_DTE = CURRENT date AND OC_OR_CASE_STS_CD NOT IN ('2', '5') ), CPT_DATA AS (SELECT MRN CPT_MRN, LISTAGG(COALESCE(STRIP(CAST("CPT Description" AS VARCHAR(32000))), '') , CHR(13) || CHR(10)) WITHIN GROUP( ORDER BY MRN, "CPT Description") AS CPT_DATA FROM (SELECT DISTINCT MRN, "CPT Description" FROM FIN) GROUP BY MRN), PROCEDURE_NAMES AS (SELECT MRN PROC_MRN, LISTAGG(COALESCE(STRIP(CAST("Procedure Name" AS VARCHAR(32000))), '') , CHR(13) || CHR(10)) WITHIN GROUP( ORDER BY MRN, "Procedure Name") AS PROCEDURE_DATA FROM (SELECT DISTINCT MRN, "Procedure Name" FROM FIN) GROUP BY MRN) SELECT DISTINCT MRN, "Name", AGE, CPT_DATA, "Surgeon", "Upcoming Surgery Date", LAST_GER_APP_DATE, LAST_SEEN_GERIATRIC_PROVIDER, "Department", "Service", PROCEDURE_DATA, OC_OR_CASE_STS_CD, OC_OR_CASE_STS FROM FIN LEFT JOIN CPT_DATA ON MRN = CPT_MRN LEFT JOIN PROCEDURE_NAMES ON MRN = PROC_MRN ; WITH X AS (SELECT DISTINCT * FROM (SELECT CPE_MRN AS "MRN", CPE_ENC_DTE AS "Appt Date", CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 AS "Department", CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 AS "Service", CLD_DEPT_NAME AS "Department Name", CRE_RES_NAME AS "Provider Name", DOC_NAME, DOC_SVC, DOC_ACDMC_SVC, CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME AS "Visit Type", ROWNUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY CPE_MRN ORDER BY CPE_ENC_DTE DESC) RN FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID JOIN IDB.DOC ON CPE_REF_RES_ID=DOC_DR_NO WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CRE_RES_TYP IN ('Physician', 'PhD', 'Dentist', 'Psychologist') AND CPE_VST_RES_ID IN ('014811', '024505', '015594', '018895') AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT DATE - 3 MONTHS AND CURRENT DATE ) WHERE RN =1 ), FIN AS (SELECT DISTINCT STRIP(OC_MRN) AS MRN, STRIP(PT_LAST_NAME) || ', ' || STRIP(PT_FIRST_NAME) AS "Name", YEAR(CURRENT DATE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) AS AGE, STRIP(OC_CASE_ID) AS "Case ID", "Appt Date" LAST_GER_APP_DATE, "Provider Name" LAST_SEEN_GERIATRIC_PROVIDER, "Department", "Service", OC_SURG_DTE AS "Upcoming Surgery Date", STRIP(O.CRE_RES_NAME) AS "Surgeon", OP_REC_CR_DTE, STRIP(CPX_PROC_CD)||'/'||STRIP(CPX_PROC_NAME) AS "CPT Description", OP_OR_PROC_ID||' -'||STRIP(OP_PROC_NAME) AS "Procedure Name", OC_OR_CASE_STS_CD, OC_OR_CASE_STS FROM X JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON "MRN" = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.OR_CASE ON PT_MRN = OC_MRN JOIN IDB.OR_CASE_ALL_PROC ON OC_CASE_ID = OCAP_CASE_ID JOIN IDB.OR_CASE_ALL_SURG ON OCAP_CASE_ID = OCAS_CASE_ID AND OCAS_PNL_NO = OCAP_PNL_NO JOIN IDB.OR_PROC ON OCAP_OR_PROC_ID = OP_OR_PROC_ID JOIN IDB.OR_CL_PROC ON OP_OR_PROC_ID = OCP_OR_PROC_ID JOIN IDB.CL_PROC ON OCP_PROC_ID = CPX_PROC_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE O ON O.CRE_RES_ID = OCAS_RES_ID WHERE OC_SURG_DTE = CURRENT date AND OC_OR_CASE_STS_CD IN ('2', '5') ), CPT_DATA AS (SELECT MRN CPT_MRN, LISTAGG(COALESCE(STRIP(CAST("CPT Description" AS VARCHAR(32000))), '') , CHR(13) || CHR(10)) WITHIN GROUP( ORDER BY MRN, "CPT Description") AS CPT_DATA FROM (SELECT DISTINCT MRN, "CPT Description" FROM FIN) GROUP BY MRN), PROCEDURE_NAMES AS (SELECT MRN PROC_MRN, LISTAGG(COALESCE(STRIP(CAST("Procedure Name" AS VARCHAR(32000))), '') , CHR(13) || CHR(10)) WITHIN GROUP( ORDER BY MRN, "Procedure Name") AS PROCEDURE_DATA FROM (SELECT DISTINCT MRN, "Procedure Name" FROM FIN) GROUP BY MRN) SELECT DISTINCT MRN, "Name", AGE, CPT_DATA, "Surgeon", "Upcoming Surgery Date", LAST_GER_APP_DATE, LAST_SEEN_GERIATRIC_PROVIDER, "Department", "Service", PROCEDURE_DATA, OC_OR_CASE_STS_CD, OC_OR_CASE_STS FROM FIN LEFT JOIN CPT_DATA ON MRN = CPT_MRN LEFT JOIN PROCEDURE_NAMES ON MRN = PROC_MRN ;

prompt: Provide a list of patients seen at MSK with pleomorphic rhabdomyosarcoma
completion: SELECT TM_MRN, TRIM(PT_LAST_NAME) "PATIENT LAST NAME", TRIM(PT_FIRST_NAME) AS "PATIENT FIRST NAME", TRIM(G.AV_DESC) AS GENDER, CASE WHEN PT_DEATH_IND IN ('', 'A') THEN 'ALIVE' ELSE 'DECEASED' END AS VITAL_STATUS, PT_DATE_OF_DEATH "DATE OF DEATH", CS.AV_DESC AS CASE_STS, TM_DX_DTE, TM_HIST_CD, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS HIST_DESC, TM_SITE_CD, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_DESC, PFA_FST_DRVST_DTE "First MSK Visit Date", PLA_LST_DRVST_DTE "Last MSK Visit Date", CASE WHEN AP.APR_MRN IS NULL THEN 'NO' ELSE 'YES' END AS "CHEMO FLAG" FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON TM_MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS G ON G.AV_CODE = PT_SEX AND G.AV_ELEMENT = 'SEX' JOIN IDB.PT_FIRST_ACTIVITY ON PT_MRN = PFA_MRN JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY ON PT_MRN = PLA_MRN JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS CS ON CS.AV_ELEMENT = 'CASE_STS' AND CS.AV_CODE = TM_CASE_STS LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT APR_MRN FROM IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX_V WHERE CDG_CHEMO_FLAG = 'Y') AP ON TM_MRN = AP.APR_MRN WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND TM_HIST_CD = 'M8901/3' AND TM_DX_DTE BETWEEN '2013-01-01' AND '2023-06-07' ORDER BY TM_MRN ; WITH DEM AS (SELECT TM_MRN, AV_DESC AS CASE_STS, TM_DX_DTE, TM_HIST_CD, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS HIST_DESC, TM_SITE_CD, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_DESC, TM_BEST_AJCC_STG, CASE WHEN AP.APR_MRN IS NULL THEN 'NO' ELSE 'YES' END AS "CHEMO FLAG" FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS ON AV_ELEMENT = 'CASE_STS' AND AV_CODE = TM_CASE_STS LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT APR_MRN FROM IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX_V WHERE CDG_CHEMO_FLAG = 'Y') AP ON TM_MRN = AP.APR_MRN WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND TM_HIST_CD = 'M8901/3' AND TM_DX_DTE BETWEEN '2013-01-01' AND '2023-06-07' ) SELECT DISTINCT APR_MRN, CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME, APR_START_DTE, APR_END_DTE FROM IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX_V JOIN DEM ON TM_MRN = APR_MRN WHERE CDG_CHEMO_FLAG = 'Y' AND APR_START_DTE BETWEEN '2013-01-01' AND '2023-06-07' ORDER BY APR_MRN ; SELECT PRPT_MRN, PRPT_PROCEDURE_DTE, PRPT_REPORT_TYPE_DESC, PRPT_ACCESSION_NO, PRPT_REPORT FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V WHERE PRPT_REPORT IS NOT NULL AND PRPT_PROCEDURE_DTE BETWEEN '2013-01-01' AND '2023-06-07' AND (CONTAINS("PRPT_REPORT", '("pleomorphic rhabdomyosarcoma")') = 1 OR CONTAINS("PRPT_REPORT", '(“spindle cell” AND “rhabdomyosarcoma”)') = 1 OR CONTAINS("PRPT_REPORT", '(“sclerosing” AND “rhabdomyosarcoma”)') = 1) ORDER BY PRPT_MRN ;

prompt: Provide a list of patients who had peripheral sensory neuropathy and peripheral motor neuropathy during treatment.
completion: WITH GUID AS (SELECT CDD_DOC_GUID FROM IDB.CD_DOCUMENT JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION ON CDD_DOC_GUID = CDO_DOC_GUID AND CDD_MRN = CDO_MRN AND CDD_AUTHORED_DTE = CDO_AUTHORED_DTE WHERE CDD_DOC_NAME = 'Toxicity Grading' AND CDO_ITEM_NAME = 'Protocol #' AND CDO_VALUE_TEXT = '13-034' AND CDD_CANCEL_IND <> '1' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND <> '1' ) SELECT CDO_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_SEX, CDO_DOC_GUID, CDO_SECTION, CDO_ITEM_NAME, CDO_VALUE_TEXT FROM GUID JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION ON CDD_DOC_GUID = CDO_DOC_GUID JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON CDO_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE CDO_SECTION = 'Nervous System Disorders' ; SELECT DISTINCT CRAE_MRN AS "MRN", PT_LAST_NAME "Last Name", PT_FIRST_NAME "First Name", PT_SEX "Gender", CRAE_IRB_NO AS "IRB No", CRAE_START_DTE AS "Start Date", CRAE_STOP_DTE AS "Stop Date", CRAE_ONGOING_IND AS "Ongoing Indicator", CRAE_INTERVENTION AS "Intervention", CRAE_GRADE AS "Grade", CRTX_GRADE_DESCRIPTION AS "Grade Description", CRTX_SYSTEM AS "System", CRTX_TOXICITY AS "Toxicity", CRAA_ATTRIBUTION AS "Attribution" FROM IDB.CLNR_ADVERSE_EVENT JOIN IDB.CLNR_TOXICITY34 ON CRAE_VERSION = CRTX_VERSION AND CRAE_CTC_AE_IX = CRTX_CTC_AE_IX AND CRAE_GRADE = CRTX_GRADE JOIN IDB.CLNR_ADVERSE_ATTRIBUTION ON CRAA_MRN = CRAE_MRN AND CRAA_IRB_NO = CRAE_IRB_NO AND CRAA_ADVERSE_EVENT_NO = CRAE_ADVERSE_EVENT_NO AND CRAA_ADVERSE_EVENT_SEQ_NO = CRAE_ADVERSE_EVENT_SEQ_NO JOIN IDB.OMS_USER AS OU1 ON CRAE_ACTION_BY = OU1.OU_LOGON_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_USER AS OU2 ON CRAE_ASSIGNED_INVESTIGATOR = OU2.OU_LOGON_ID AND CRAE_ASSIGNED_INVESTIGATOR <> '' JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON CRAE_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE CRAE_IRB_NO = '13-034' AND CRTX_SYSTEM='Nervous system disorders'

prompt: Provide list of patients seen by Dr. Talia Zaider documented as "couple/family therapy" in clindoc checkbox between January, 2013 and December, 2013.
completion: WITH ETC AS (SELECT CDD_DOC_NAME DOCNAME, CDO_MRN MRN, STRIP(PT_LAST_NAME)||', '||STRIP(PT_FIRST_NAME) PT_NAME, MIN(CDO_ENTER_DTE) DOC_ENT_DTE, ENT.OU_DISPLAY_NAME AS ENTREDBY, ENT.OU_ORD_ROLE_TYPE ENTBY_ROLE, AUTH.OU_DISPLAY_NAME AS AUTH, AUTH.OU_ORD_ROLE_TYPE SVC_PVDR_ROLE, OCV_VISIT_DTE CIS_VISIT_DTE, OCV_IP_OP_IND, MAX(STRIP(CASE WHEN CDO_ITEM_NAME = 'Type of Therapy' THEN CDO_VALUE_TEXT ELSE '' END)) CPL_FAM FROM IDB.CD_OBSERVATION JOIN IDB.CD_DOCUMENT ON CDO_DOC_GUID = CDD_DOC_GUID JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON CDO_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.OMS_CLIENT_VISIT ON OCV_VISIT_GUID = CDD_VISIT_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_USER ENT ON CDD_USER_GUID = ENT.OU_USER_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_USER AUTH ON CDD_AUTH_PROV_GUID = AUTH.OU_USER_GUID WHERE CDD_AUTHORED_DTE >= '2013-01-01' AND CDD_DOC_NAME = 'Treatment Visit, Psychotherapy - Psychiatry' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND = '0' AND CDD_CANCEL_IND = '0' AND (AUTH.OU_DISPLAY_NAME = 'Zaider, Talia' OR ENT.OU_DISPLAY_NAME= 'Zaider, Talia') GROUP BY CDD_DOC_NAME , CDO_MRN , PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME , OCV_VISIT_DTE, ENT.OU_DISPLAY_NAME , ENT.OU_ORD_ROLE_TYPE , AUTH.OU_DISPLAY_NAME , AUTH.OU_ORD_ROLE_TYPE, OCV_IP_OP_IND HAVING MAX(CASE WHEN CDO_ITEM_NAME = 'Type of Therapy' THEN CDO_VALUE_TEXT ELSE '' END) = 'Couple/Family') , VST_CNT AS (SELECT MRN, COUNT(DISTINCT CIS_VISIT_DTE) VST_CNT FROM ETC GROUP BY MRN) SELECT COUNT(*) FROM VST_CNT SELECT DOCNAME, X.MRN, PT_NAME, DOC_ENT_DTE, ENTREDBY, ENTBY_ROLE, AUTH, SVC_PVDR_ROLE, CIS_VISIT_DTE, OCV_IP_OP_IND, CPL_FAM, Y.VST_CNT TOTAL_VST FROM ETC X JOIN VST_CNT Y ON X.MRN = Y.MRN

prompt: Provide a list of GYN malignancies with ARID1A, ARID1B, SMARCA4, SMARCA2, SMARCB1, PBRM1 mutation on IMPACT
completion: WITH GENE AS (SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_STRUCTURED_RESULTS_V WHERE GENE IN ('ARID1A', 'ARID1B', 'SMARCA4', 'SMARCA2', 'SMARCB1', 'PBRM1') AND PATH_PROCEDURE_DATE >= '2015-01-01' ) SELECT G.PT_MRN, P.PT_LAST_NAME, P.PT_FIRST_NAME, P.PT_SEX, P.PT_BIRTH_DTE, P.PT_DEATH_DTE, DT_DTE AS "Tumor Diagnosis Date", DXCC_ICD_CODE AS "ICD-O Histology Code", DXCC_ICD_MSK_DESC AS "ICD-O Histology Description", ICSC_SITE_CD AS "ICD-O Site Code", ICSC_ICDO_SITE_MSK_DESC AS "ICD-O Site Description", TCA_CASE_STS_DESC AS "Case Status" FROM GENE G JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS P ON G.PT_MRN = P.PT_MRN JOIN DV.CDB_TUMOR_V ON CDTM_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID JOIN DV.DATE_V ON CDTM_DX_DATE_ID = DT_DATE_ID JOIN DV.DIAGNOSIS_CODE_CAT_ICDO_V ON CDTM_DX_CATALOG_ID = DXCC_DX_CATALOG_ID JOIN DV.ICDO_SITE_CATALOG_V ON CDTM_SITE_CATALOG_ID = ICSC_SITE_CATALOG_ID JOIN DV.TUMOR_CASE_ATTRIBUTES_V ON CDTM_CASE_ATTR_ID = TUMOR_CASE_ATTR_ID JOIN DV.SEERGROUPING ON DV.SEERF_ICDO(ICSC_SITE_CD, DXCC_ICD_CODE) = RECODE WHERE TCA_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7') AND CATEGORY1 = 'Female Genital System' ; WITH GENE AS (SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_STRUCTURED_RESULTS_V WHERE GENE IN ('ARID1A', 'ARID1B', 'SMARCA4', 'SMARCA2', 'SMARCB1', 'PBRM1') AND PATH_PROCEDURE_DATE >= '2015-01-01' ) , PTS AS (SELECT G.PT_MRN, P.PT_LAST_NAME, P.PT_FIRST_NAME, P.PT_SEX, P.PT_BIRTH_DTE, P.PT_DEATH_DTE, DT_DTE AS "Tumor Diagnosis Date", DXCC_ICD_CODE AS "ICD-O Histology Code", DXCC_ICD_MSK_DESC AS "ICD-O Histology Description", ICSC_SITE_CD AS "ICD-O Site Code", ICSC_ICDO_SITE_MSK_DESC AS "ICD-O Site Description", TCA_CASE_STS_DESC AS "Case Status" FROM GENE G JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS P ON G.PT_MRN = P.PT_MRN JOIN DV.CDB_TUMOR_V ON CDTM_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID JOIN DV.DATE_V ON CDTM_DX_DATE_ID = DT_DATE_ID JOIN DV.DIAGNOSIS_CODE_CAT_ICDO_V ON CDTM_DX_CATALOG_ID = DXCC_DX_CATALOG_ID JOIN DV.ICDO_SITE_CATALOG_V ON CDTM_SITE_CATALOG_ID = ICSC_SITE_CATALOG_ID JOIN DV.TUMOR_CASE_ATTRIBUTES_V ON CDTM_CASE_ATTR_ID = TUMOR_CASE_ATTR_ID JOIN DV.SEERGROUPING ON DV.SEERF_ICDO(ICSC_SITE_CD, DXCC_ICD_CODE) = RECODE WHERE TCA_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7') AND CATEGORY1 = 'Female Genital System' ) SELECT PT_MRN, CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME, MIN(APR_START_DTE) FIRST_START_DATE, MAX(APR_START_DTE) LAST_START_DATE FROM PTS JOIN IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX_V ON PT_MRN = APR_MRN WHERE CDG_CHEMO_FLAG = 'Y' OR CDG_BIOLOGIC_IMMUNO_FLAG = 'Y' OR CDG_TARGETED_FLAG = 'Y' OR CDG_HORMONE_FLAG = 'Y' GROUP BY PT_MRN, CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME ; WITH GENE AS (SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_STRUCTURED_RESULTS_V WHERE GENE IN ('ARID1A', 'ARID1B', 'SMARCA4', 'SMARCA2', 'SMARCB1', 'PBRM1') AND PATH_PROCEDURE_DATE >= '2015-01-01' ) , PTS AS (SELECT G.PT_MRN, P.PT_LAST_NAME, P.PT_FIRST_NAME, P.PT_SEX, P.PT_BIRTH_DTE, P.PT_DEATH_DTE, DT_DTE AS "Tumor Diagnosis Date", DXCC_ICD_CODE AS "ICD-O Histology Code", DXCC_ICD_MSK_DESC AS "ICD-O Histology Description", ICSC_SITE_CD AS "ICD-O Site Code", ICSC_ICDO_SITE_MSK_DESC AS "ICD-O Site Description", TCA_CASE_STS_DESC AS "Case Status" FROM GENE G JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS P ON G.PT_MRN = P.PT_MRN JOIN DV.CDB_TUMOR_V ON CDTM_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID JOIN DV.DATE_V ON CDTM_DX_DATE_ID = DT_DATE_ID JOIN DV.DIAGNOSIS_CODE_CAT_ICDO_V ON CDTM_DX_CATALOG_ID = DXCC_DX_CATALOG_ID JOIN DV.ICDO_SITE_CATALOG_V ON CDTM_SITE_CATALOG_ID = ICSC_SITE_CATALOG_ID JOIN DV.TUMOR_CASE_ATTRIBUTES_V ON CDTM_CASE_ATTR_ID = TUMOR_CASE_ATTR_ID JOIN DV.SEERGROUPING ON DV.SEERF_ICDO(ICSC_SITE_CD, DXCC_ICD_CODE) = RECODE WHERE TCA_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7') AND CATEGORY1 = 'Female Genital System' ) SELECT P.PT_MRN, S.PRPT_ACCESSION_NO, S.PRPT_REPORT_TYPE, S.PATH_RPT_DATE, S.PATH_PROCEDURE_DATE, S.GENE, S.LOCUS, S.AA_CHANGE, S.NUCLEOTIDE, S.METHOD FROM PTS P JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_STRUCTURED_RESULTS_V S ON P.PT_MRN = S.PT_MRN WHERE PATH_PROCEDURE_DATE >= '2015-01-01' ; SELECT DISTINCT DMP.PRPT_MRN, DIAG.PRPT_ACCESSION_NO IMPACT_ACCESSION_NO, SRG.PRPT_ACCESSION_NO SRG_ACCESSION_NO, RTRIM(CAST(SUBSTR(SRG.PRPT_REPORT, 1, 32672) AS VARCHAR(32672))) SRG_PATH_TEXT FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V DMP JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT PRPT_ACCESSION_NO FROM IMPACT) DIAG ON DIAG.PRPT_ACCESSION_NO = DMP.PRPT_ACCESSION_NO JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_REFERENCES ON PRPTR_CHILD_PATH_RPT_ID = DMP.PRPT_PATH_RPT_ID LEFT JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V SRG ON SRG.PRPT_PATH_RPT_ID = PRPTR_PATH_RPT_ID

prompt:
Please include Jewish patients with pancreatic cancer/seeing pancreatic center physicians.

Dr. Kelsen, Dr. O'Reilly, Dr. Varghese, Dr. Khalil, Dr. Park, Dr. Yu, Dr. Ku, Dr. Connell, Dr. El Dika, Dr. Epstein.
completion: SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN "MRN", PT_FIRST_NAME "First", PT_LAST_NAME "Last", PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH "DOB", PT_RELIGION "Religion", CPE_ENC_DTE, TIME(CPE_APPT_DT) "Appt Time", CRE_RES_NAME "Physician Name", CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 "Service", CLD_DEPT_NAME "Department Name", I.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS ICD10_DESC, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS CDB_SITE_DESC, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS CDB_HIST_DESC, CLD_CLD_CENTER FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID JOIN IDB.CTC_CLSF ON CC_MRN = CPE_MRN JOIN IDB.CLM I ON CC_CLSF_CD = I.CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON CPE_MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.CDB_TUMOR ON CC_MRN = TM_MRN AND TM_SITE_CD LIKE 'C25%' AND TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') LEFT JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD LEFT JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Sch') AND NOT (CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR LIKE '%NV%' OR CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR LIKE '%IR%') AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT date AND CURRENT date + 14 DAYS AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 = 'MED' AND CRE_RES_TYP = 'Physician' AND SUBSTR(CC_CLSF_CD, 1, 3) = 'C25' AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND PT_RELIGION = 'JEW' AND CLD_CLD_CENTER NOT IN ('BER', 'BSK', 'CMK', 'HAU', 'MON', 'NAS', 'WES')

prompt: HR+ HER2- breast cancer that has progressed following treatment with a CDK4/6 inhibitor
completion: WITH PTS AS (SELECT PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID PID FROM DV.PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED) , DT_1 AS (SELECT PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID AS P_ID FROM DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS REC LEFT JOIN DV.PATIENT_CORE_DEMOGRAPHICS ON PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = CORE_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID WHERE 1=1 AND PT_VITAL_STATUS IN ('ALIVE') ) , DT_2 AS (SELECT INC.PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID P_ID FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_STRUCTURED_RESULTS_V INC JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML DT ON INC.PRPT_PATH_RPT_ID = DT.PDRX_PATH_RPT_ID CROSS JOIN XMLTABLE('$c/root/meta-data' PASSING DT.PDRX_XML_VALUE AS "c" COLUMNS PRIMARY_SITE VARCHAR(264) PATH 'primary_site', TUMOR_TYPE_NAME VARCHAR(264) PATH 'tumor_type_name' , TUMOR_TYPE_CODE VARCHAR(264) PATH 'tumor_type_code', IS_METASTASIS VARCHAR(3) PATH 'is_metastasis' , METASTASIS_SITE VARCHAR(264) PATH 'metastasis_site' , MSI_COMMENT VARCHAR(264) PATH 'msi-comment' , MSI_SCORE VARCHAR(264) PATH 'msi-score' , MSI_TYPE VARCHAR(264) PATH 'msi-type' , TMB_SCORE VARCHAR(25) PATH 'tmb_score' , TMB_COUNT VARCHAR(25) PATH 'tmb-count', COSMIC_ID VARCHAR(5000) PATH 'cosmic_id') T JOIN (SELECT T.TUMOR_TYPE_CODE TTC FROM TABLE(DV.STRING_SPLIT('BREAST', DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V ON APR_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE 1=1 AND CDG_THERAPEUTIC_CATEGORY = 'antineoplastics | cdk 4/6 inhibitors' ) , PREP AS (SELECT P_ID AS DEID, CAST(UPPER(RIGHT("t2"."PRPT_REPORT", 32000)) AS VARCHAR(32000)) AS PRPT_REPORT FROM DT_2 INNER JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V ON P_ID = PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID INNER JOIN "DV"."PATHOLOGY_REPORT" "t2" ON P_ID = "t2"."PRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" INNER JOIN "DV"."PATH_RPRT_TYPE_LOOKUP" "t21" ON "t2"."PRPT_REPORT_TYPE" = "t21"."PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_CD" INNER JOIN DV.PATIENT_LATEST_ACTIVITY ON P_ID = PLA_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID WHERE (CONTAINS("t2"."PRPT_REPORT", '"breast"') = 1 AND (CONTAINS("t2"."PRPT_REPORT", '"ESTROGEN RECEPTOR"') = 1 OR CONTAINS("t2"."PRPT_REPORT", '"ER-ICA"') = 1) AND PT_DEATH_DTE IS NULL AND PT_VITAL_STATUS = 'ALIVE' ) , GETVALS AS (SELECT PREP.* , LTRIM(RTRIM(XMLCAST(XMLQUERY('fn:substring-before(fn:substring-after($x, ''ESTROGEN RECEPTOR''), ''PROGESTERONE RECEPTOR'')' PASSING XMLTEXT(REPLACE(LEFT(PRPT_REPORT, 32000), CHR(26), '')) AS "x") AS VARCHAR(32000)))) AS ERTEXT , LTRIM(RTRIM(XMLCAST(XMLQUERY('fn:substring-before(fn:substring-after($x, ''ER-ICA''), ''PR-ICA'')' PASSING XMLTEXT(REPLACE(LEFT(PRPT_REPORT, 32000), CHR(26), '')) AS "x") AS VARCHAR(32000)))) AS ERICATEXT , LTRIM(RTRIM(XMLCAST(XMLQUERY('fn:substring-before(fn:substring-after($x, ''PROGESTERONE RECEPTOR''), ''HER2'')' PASSING XMLTEXT(REPLACE(LEFT(PRPT_REPORT, 32000), CHR(26), '')) AS "x") AS VARCHAR(32000)))) AS PRTEXT , LTRIM(RTRIM(XMLCAST(XMLQUERY('fn:substring-before(fn:substring-after($x, ''PR-ICA''), ''HER2/NEU'')' PASSING XMLTEXT(REPLACE(LEFT(PRPT_REPORT, 32000), CHR(26), '')) AS "x") AS VARCHAR(32000)))) AS PRICATEXT , LTRIM(RTRIM(XMLCAST(XMLQUERY('fn:substring-after(fn:substring-after($x, ''PROGESTERONE RECEPTOR''), ''HER2'')' PASSING XMLTEXT(REPLACE(LEFT(PRPT_REPORT, 32000), CHR(26), '')) AS "x") AS VARCHAR(32000)))) AS HER2TEXT , LTRIM(RTRIM(XMLCAST(XMLQUERY('fn:substring-after(fn:substring-after($x, ''PR-ICA''), ''HER2/NEU'')' PASSING XMLTEXT(REPLACE(LEFT(PRPT_REPORT, 32000), CHR(26), '')) AS "x") AS VARCHAR(32000)))) AS HER2ICATEXT , LTRIM(RTRIM(XMLCAST(XMLQUERY('fn:substring-before(fn:substring-after($x, ''DIAGNOSIS:''), ''I ATTEST'')' PASSING XMLTEXT(REPLACE(LEFT(PRPT_REPORT, 32000), CHR(26), '')) AS "x") AS VARCHAR(32000)))) AS DXTEXT FROM PREP) , PARSEVALS AS (SELECT GETVALS.*, DV.REGEXSTR('\d*(?=%)', COALESCE(ERTEXT, '')) ERNUM, DV.REGEXSTR('\d*(?=%)', COALESCE(ERICATEXT, '')) ERICANUM, DV.REGEXSTR('(i?)(NEGATIVE|POSITIVE)', COALESCE(ERTEXT, '')) ERVAL, DV.REGEXSTR('(i?)(NEGATIVE|POSITIVE)', COALESCE(ERICATEXT, '')) ERICAVAL, DV.REGEXSTR('\d*(?=%)', COALESCE(PRTEXT, '')) PRNUM, DV.REGEXSTR('\d*(?=%)', COALESCE(PRICATEXT, '')) PRICANUM, DV.REGEXSTR('(i?)(NEGATIVE|POSITIVE)', COALESCE(PRTEXT, '')) PRVAL, DV.REGEXSTR('(i?)(NEGATIVE|POSITIVE)', COALESCE(PRICATEXT, '')) PRICAVAL, DV.REGEXSTR('\d*(?=\+)', COALESCE(HER2TEXT, '')) HER2NUM, DV.REGEXSTR('\d*(?=\+)', COALESCE(HER2ICATEXT, '')) HER2ICANUM, DV.REGEXSTR('(i?)(NEGATIVE|POSITIVE)', COALESCE(HER2TEXT, '')) HER2VAL, DV.REGEXSTR('(i?)(NEGATIVE|POSITIVE)', COALESCE(HER2ICATEXT, '')) HER2ICAVAL FROM GETVALS) , POPVALS AS (SELECT PARSEVALS.*, CASE WHEN ERICANUM <> '' THEN ERICANUM WHEN ERNUM <> '' THEN ERNUM WHEN ERICAVAL <> '' THEN ERICAVAL ELSE ERVAL END ERRESULT, CASE WHEN PRICANUM <> '' THEN PRICANUM WHEN PRNUM <> '' THEN PRNUM WHEN PRICAVAL <> '' THEN PRICAVAL ELSE PRVAL END PRRESULT, CASE WHEN HER2ICANUM <> '' THEN HER2ICANUM WHEN HER2NUM <> '' THEN HER2NUM WHEN HER2ICAVAL <> '' THEN HER2ICAVAL ELSE HER2VAL END HER2RESULT FROM PARSEVALS WHERE (ERNUM <> '' OR ERICANUM <> '' OR ERVAL <>'' OR ERICAVAL <>'') AND (PRNUM <> '' OR PRICANUM <> '' OR PRVAL <>'' OR PRICAVAL <>'') AND (HER2NUM <> '' OR HER2ICANUM <> '' OR HER2VAL <>'' OR HER2ICAVAL <>'') ) , DEIDENT_PATH AS (SELECT DISTINCT DEID P_ID FROM POPVALS WHERE (ERRESULT NOT IN ('0', '1', 'NEGATIVE') OR PRRESULT NOT IN ('0', '1', 'NEGATIVE')) AND HER2RESULT IN ('0', '1', 'NEGATIVE') ) , DEID AS (SELECT DISTINCT P_ID FROM (SELECT P_ID FROM DT_1 INTERSECT SELECT P_ID FROM DT_2 INTERSECT SELECT P_ID FROM DT_3 INTERSECT SELECT P_ID FROM DEIDENT_PATH ))

prompt: List of patients with Diffuse Large B-cell Lymphoma or High-grade B-cell Lymphoma who were treated with polatuzumab
completion: WITH ICD AS (SELECT CC_MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS MIN_ICD9_EFF_DTE, CC_CLSF_CD AS ICD9_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS ICD9_DESC FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE SUBSTR(CC_CLSF_CD, 1, 5) IN ('C83.3') AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND (CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) GROUP BY CC_MRN, CC_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK ) SELECT DISTINCT APR_MRN, ICD9_CD, ICD9_DESC, APR_START_DTE, APR_END_DTE, CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME, APR_GENERIC_NAME, APR_PRESCRIBED_DOSE, APR_ROUTE FROM ICD LEFT JOIN IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX ON CC_MRN = APR_MRN JOIN IDB.CHEMO_DRUG_GENERIC ON APR_GENERIC_NAME = CDG_GENERIC_NAME WHERE LOWER(CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME) LIKE '%polatuzumab%'

prompt: Provide a biweekly list of Metastatic Triple Negative Breast Cancer patients, actively on saci/t-dxd/carbo/taxane with a BMI >27
completion: WITH X AS (SELECT PRPT_MRN MRN, PRPT_PROCEDURE_DTE, PRPT_REPORT, PRPT_REPORT_DTE, PRPT_ACCESSION_NO, ROW_NUMBER () OVER (PARTITION BY PRPT_MRN ORDER BY PRPT_REPORT_DTE) RN, DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)Estrogen receptor[\w\W]*(?=Progesterone receptor)', VARCHAR(PRPT_REPORT, 32000)) AS ER_STATUS, DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)Progesterone receptor[\w\W]*(?=HER2 )', VARCHAR(PRPT_REPORT, 32000)) AS PR_STATUS, DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)HER2[\w\W]*(?=Report )', VARCHAR(PRPT_REPORT, 32000)) AS HER_STATUS, DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)HER2[\w\W]*(?=)', VARCHAR(PRPT_REPORT, 32000)) AS HER_STATUS1 FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V WHERE 1=1 AND (CONTAINS(PRPT_REPORT, '"HER2"AND "PROGESTERONE" AND "ESTROGEN"') = 1 AND PRPT_REPORT IS NOT NULL) ) , TM AS (SELECT * FROM (SELECT DISTINCT TM_MRN, TM_DX_DTE AS DX_DATE, TM_HIST_CD AS HIST_CODE, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS HIST_DESC, TM_SITE_CD AS SITE_CODE, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_DESC, CASE WHEN TM_SSF1 = '000' THEN 'Test not done test not ordered and not performed' WHEN TM_SSF1 = '010' THEN 'Positive or elevated' WHEN TM_SSF1 = '020' THEN 'Negative or normal within normal limits' WHEN TM_SSF1 = '030' THEN 'Borderline undetermined whether positive or negative' WHEN TM_SSF1 = '080' THEN 'Ordered, but results not in chart' WHEN TM_SSF1 = '988' THEN 'Not applicable Information not collected for this case' WHEN TM_SSF1 = '996' THEN 'Test ordered, results not interpretable' WHEN TM_SSF1 = '997' THEN 'Test ordered, results not in chart' WHEN TM_SSF1 = '998' THEN 'Test not done test not ordered and not performed' WHEN TM_SSF1 = '999' THEN 'Unknown or no information not documented in patient record' ELSE '' END AS "ER", CASE WHEN TM_SSF2 = '000' THEN 'Test not done test not ordered and not performed' WHEN TM_SSF2 = '010' THEN 'Positive or elevated' WHEN TM_SSF2 = '020' THEN 'Negative or normal within normal limits' WHEN TM_SSF2 = '030' THEN 'Borderline undetermined whether positive or negative' WHEN TM_SSF2 = '080' THEN 'Ordered, but results not in chart' WHEN TM_SSF2 = '988' THEN 'Not applicable Information not collected for this case' WHEN TM_SSF2 = '996' THEN 'Test ordered, results not interpretable' WHEN TM_SSF2 = '997' THEN 'Test ordered, results not in chart' WHEN TM_SSF2 = '998' THEN 'Test not done test not ordered and not performed' WHEN TM_SSF2 = '999' THEN 'Unknown or no information not documented in patient record' ELSE '' END AS "PR", CASE WHEN TM_SSF15 = '010' THEN 'Positive or elevated amplified' WHEN TM_SSF15 = '020' THEN 'Negative or normal within normal limits not amplified' WHEN TM_SSF15 = '030' THEN 'Borderline equivocal indeterminate undetermined whether positive or negative' WHEN TM_SSF15 = '988' THEN 'Not applicable Information not collected for this case' WHEN TM_SSF15 = '997' THEN 'Test ordered, results not in chart' WHEN TM_SSF15 = '998' THEN 'Test not done test not ordered and not performed' WHEN TM_SSF15 = '999' THEN 'Unknown or no information not documented in patient record' ELSE '' END AS "HER2" FROM X JOIN IDB.CDB_TUMOR ON TM_MRN = MRN JOIN IDB.CLM H ON TM_HIST_CD = H.CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON TM_SITE_CD = S.CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.SEERGROUPING ON RECODE = DV.SEERF_ICDO(TM_SITE_CD, TM_HIST_CD) WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND CATEGORY2 = 'Breast') B WHERE UPPER("ER") like '%NEGATIVE%' AND UPPER("PR") like '%NEGATIVE%' AND UPPER("HER2") like '%NEGATIVE%' ) , BP AS (SELECT BP_MRN AS MRN, DATE(BPE_DX_DT) AS DX_DATE, CASE WHEN BP_ESTRG_RCR_DESC = 'Negative' AND BP_PRGSTR_RCP_DESC = 'Negative' AND BP_HER2_DESC = 'Negative' AND (BP_RATIO IS NULL OR BP_RATIO < 2) THEN 'Y' ELSE '' END AS "Triple Negative Indicator", BP_ESTRG_RCR_DESC "ER", BP_PRGSTR_RCP_DESC "PR", BP_HER2_DESC "HER2", STRIP(BP_HER2_VALUE_DESC) "HER2 Description", BP_RATIO "HER2 Ratio by FISH" FROM IDB.BR_PRIMARY JOIN X ON BP_MRN = MRN JOIN IDB.BR_PT_EVENT BPE ON BPE_DX_ID = BP_DX_ID WHERE(BP_ESTRG_RCR_DESC = 'Negative' AND BP_PRGSTR_RCP_DESC = 'Negative' AND BP_HER2_DESC = 'Negative')) , ER_PR_HER AS (SELECT DISTINCT CDD_MRN, CDD_DOC_GUID, CDD_DOC_NAME, CDD_SERVICE_DTE, CDO_ITEM_NAME, CDO_VALUE_TEXT FROM X JOIN IDB.CD_DOCUMENT ON CDD_MRN = MRN JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION ON CDD_DOC_GUID = CDO_DOC_GUID AND CDD_AUTHORED_DTE = CDO_AUTHORED_DTE WHERE 1=1 AND CDD_CANCEL_IND <> '1' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND <> '1' AND UPPER(CDD_DOC_NAME) like '%BREAST%' AND CDO_ITEM_NAME IN ('HER2:', 'ER:', 'PR:', 'T', 'T:', 'N', 'N:', 'M', 'M:', 'Staging') ) , ER AS (SELECT CDD_MRN ER_MRN, CDD_SERVICE_DTE, CDO_VALUE_TEXT ER FROM (SELECT CDD_MRN, CDD_SERVICE_DTE, CDO_VALUE_TEXT, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CDD_MRN ORDER BY CDD_SERVICE_DTE DESC) RN FROM ER_PR_HER WHERE CDO_ITEM_NAME = 'ER:' ) WHERE RN = 1 ) , PR AS (SELECT CDD_MRN PR_MRN, CDD_SERVICE_DTE, CDO_VALUE_TEXT PR FROM (SELECT CDD_MRN, CDD_SERVICE_DTE, CDO_VALUE_TEXT, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CDD_MRN ORDER BY CDD_SERVICE_DTE DESC) RN FROM ER_PR_HER WHERE CDO_ITEM_NAME = 'PR:' ) WHERE RN = 1 ) , HER2 AS (SELECT CDD_MRN HER2_MRN, CDD_SERVICE_DTE, CDO_VALUE_TEXT HER2 FROM (SELECT CDD_MRN, CDD_SERVICE_DTE, CDO_VALUE_TEXT, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CDD_MRN ORDER BY CDD_SERVICE_DTE DESC) RN FROM ER_PR_HER WHERE CDO_ITEM_NAME = 'HER2:' ) WHERE RN = 1 ) , CD AS (SELECT DISTINCT MRN, ER AS "ER", PR AS "PR", HER2 AS "HER2" FROM X LEFT JOIN ER ON MRN = ER_MRN LEFT JOIN PR ON MRN = PR_MRN LEFT JOIN HER2 ON MRN = HER2_MRN WHERE ER = 'Negative' AND PR = 'Negative' AND HER2 = 'Negative' ) , FIN AS (SELECT TM_MRN, CASE WHEN ER like '%Negative%' THEN 'Negative' END AS ER, CASE WHEN PR like '%Negative%' THEN 'Negative' END AS PR, CASE WHEN HER2 like '%Negative%' THEN 'Negative' END AS HER2, '' AS "HER2 Description", NULL AS "HER2 Ratio by FISH" FROM TM UNION SELECT MRN, ER, PR, HER2, "HER2 Description", "HER2 Ratio by FISH" FROM BP UNION SELECT MRN, ER, PR, HER2, '' AS "HER2 Description", NULL AS "HER2 Ratio by FISH" FROM CD) , DRUG AS (SELECT DISTINCT STRIP(APR_MRN) AS APR_MRN, ER, PR, HER2, "HER2 Description", STRIP(CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME) AS "Drug Name", APR_START_DTE, APR_END_DTE, STRIP(APR_DOC_SVC) AS "Service", APR_GENERIC_NAME, APR_DRUG_NAME, APR_PRESCRIBED_DOSE, APR_DOSE_UOM FROM FIN JOIN IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX_V ON TM_MRN = APR_MRN WHERE CDG_CHEMO_FLAG = 'Y' AND(UPPER(APR_GENERIC_NAME) LIKE '%SACITUZUMAB%' OR UPPER(APR_GENERIC_NAME) LIKE '%TRASTUZUMAB%' OR UPPER(APR_GENERIC_NAME) LIKE '%DERUXTECAN%' OR UPPER(APR_GENERIC_NAME) LIKE '%CARBOPLATIN%' OR UPPER(APR_GENERIC_NAME) LIKE '%TAXANE%' OR UPPER(APR_DRUG_NAME) LIKE '%SACITUZUMAB%' OR UPPER(APR_DRUG_NAME) LIKE '%TRASTUZUMAB%' OR UPPER(APR_DRUG_NAME) LIKE '%DERUXTECAN%' OR UPPER(APR_DRUG_NAME) LIKE '%CARBOPLATIN%' OR UPPER(APR_DRUG_NAME) LIKE '%TAXANE%') AND Name", APR_START_DTE, APR_END_DTE, APR_PRESCRIBED_DOSE, APR_DOSE_UOM, PMH_MEASURE_DTE, PMH_BMI, LR_TEST_NAME, LR_SUBTEST_NAME, LR_RESULT_VALUE FROM DRUG LEFT JOIN IDB.PT_MEASURES_HX ON APR_MRN= PMH_MRN AND PMH_MEASURE_DTE = APR_START_DTE LEFT JOIN LAB ON APR_MRN = LR_MRN AND PMH_BMI > 27

completion: WITH DX AS (SELECT CC_MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) DX_DTE, CC_CLSF_CD ICD_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK ICD_DESC FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE SUBSTR(CC_CLSF_CD, 1, 3) IN ('C25') AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND (CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) GROUP BY CC_MRN, CC_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK HAVING MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) BETWEEN CURRENT DATE - 7 DAYS AND CURRENT DATE) SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN "MRN", PT_LAST_NAME "Last Name", PT_FIRST_NAME "First Name", PT_SEX "Gender", PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH "Date of Birth", YEAR(DX_DTE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) "Age at Dx", PT_RACE_DESC "Race", PT_PT_ETHNICITY_DESC "Ethnicity", PT_RELIGION_DESC "Religion", DX_DTE "Diagnosis Date", ICD_CD "ICD Code", ICD_DESC "ICD Description" FROM DX JOIN IDB.PATIENT_V ON CC_MRN = PT_MRN ORDER BY PT_MRN DESC, DX_DTE ; WITH DX AS (SELECT CC_MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) DX_DTE, CC_CLSF_CD ICD_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK ICD_DESC FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE SUBSTR(CC_CLSF_CD, 1, 3) IN ('K86') AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND (CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) GROUP BY CC_MRN, CC_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK HAVING MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) BETWEEN CURRENT DATE - 7 DAYS AND CURRENT DATE) SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN "MRN", PT_LAST_NAME "Last Name", PT_FIRST_NAME "First Name", PT_SEX "Gender", PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH "Date of Birth", YEAR(DX_DTE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) "Age at Dx", PT_RACE_DESC "Race", PT_PT_ETHNICITY_DESC "Ethnicity", PT_RELIGION_DESC "Religion", DX_DTE "Diagnosis Date", ICD_CD "ICD Code", ICD_DESC "ICD Description" FROM DX JOIN IDB.PATIENT_V ON CC_MRN = PT_MRN ORDER BY PT_MRN DESC, DX_DTE

completion: WITH CHEMO AS (SELECT DISTINCT APR_MRN FROM IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX_V WHERE 1=1 AND CDG_CHEMO_FLAG = 'Y' AND CDG_IMMUNOTHERAPY_FLAG = 'Y' ) SELECT DISTINCT TM_MRN , PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_SEX, PT_RACE_DESC, PT_PT_ETHNICITY_DESC, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, PT_DATE_OF_DEATH, TM_DX_DTE "Diagnosis Date", TM_HIST_CD "Histology", H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK "Histology Description", TM_SITE_CD "Site Code", S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK "Site Description", TM_BEST_AJCC_STG FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD JOIN CHEMO ON TM_MRN = APR_MRN JOIN IDB.PATIENT_V ON TM_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND TM_DX_DTE BETWEEN '2015-01-01' AND CURRENT DATE AND TM_SITE_CD LIKE 'C34%' AND TM_HIST_CD IN ('M8013/3', 'M8014/3', 'M8022/3', 'M8030/3', 'M8031/3', 'M8032/3', 'M8033/3', 'M8046/3', 'M8052/2', 'M8052/3', 'M8070/2', 'M8070/3', 'M8071/2', 'M8071/3', 'M8072/3', 'M8073/3', 'M8074/2', 'M8074/3', 'M8083/3', 'M8140/2', 'M8140/3', 'M8250/2', 'M8250/3', 'M8251/3', 'M8252/3', 'M8253/3', 'M8254/3', 'M8255/3', 'M8260/2', 'M8260/3', 'M8310/3', 'M8333/3', 'M8480/2', 'M8480/3', 'M8481/3', 'M8490/2', 'M8490/3', 'M8560/2', 'M8560/3', 'M8572/3', 'M8574/3', 'M8972/3', 'M8973/3', 'M8980/3') ORDER BY TM_MRN, TM_DX_DTE, TM_HIST_CD ;

prompt: Looking for all of the results of the Engage VICOS Questionnaire
completion: SELECT DISTINCT EPI_MRN, STRIP(EPI_LAST_NAME) || ', ' || STRIP(EPI_FIRST_NAME) AS "Name", A.EA_ASSESS_ID AS "Assessment ID", EA_SURV_ID AS "Survery ID", STRIP(ES_SURV_NAME) AS "Survey Name", EF.EF_FORM_ALIAS AS "Survey Alias Name", STRIP(EAS_ASSESS_STS) AS "Assessment Status", STRIP(SUBSTR(EFI_ITEM_TEXT, 1, 400)) AS QUESTIONFULLTEXT, STRIP(SUBSTR(EFI_VALUE, 1, 400)) AS ANSWERVALUE, CASE WHEN EAS_ASSESS_STS = 'To Do' THEN 'Not yet opened' WHEN EAS_ASSESS_STS = 'Missed' THEN 'Survey expired because the patientd did not complete it' WHEN EAS_ASSESS_STS = 'In Progress' THEN 'They started it but not yet completed' WHEN EAS_ASSESS_STS = 'Cancelled 'THEN 'The appointment was cancelled which would then mean the survey is cancelled' WHEN EAS_ASSESS_STS = 'Read Only' THEN 'Just opened and read it' WHEN EAS_ASSESS_STS = 'Completed' THEN 'Completed and Submitted' END AS STATUS, DATE(EA_SUBM_DT) AS "Submission Date", DATE(EA_ASSIGN_DT) AS "Assignment Date", DATE(EA_EXPIRY_DT) AS "Expiry Date" FROM IDB.EF_PATIENT_INFO PT JOIN IDB.EF_ASSESSMENT A ON A.EA_PT_INFO_ID = PT.EPI_PT_INFO_ID JOIN IDB.EF_SURVEY S ON A.EA_SURV_ID = S.ES_SURV_ID JOIN IDB.EF_ASSESSMENT_STS AS STS ON A.EA_STS_ID = STS.EAS_ASSESS_STS_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.EF_FORM EF ON A.EA_SURV_ID = EF.EF_SURVEY_ID JOIN IDB.EF_FORM_ITEM EI ON EF_FORM_ID = EFI_FORM_ID WHERE 1=1 AND UPPER(EF_FORM_ALIAS) like ('%VICOS%');

prompt: Provide a list of patients diagnosed with angiosarcoma from 2000-2019
completion: WITH CDB AS (SELECT TM_MRN, TM_DX_DTE, TM_HIST_CD, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS HIST_DESC, TM_SITE_CD, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_DESC, SM.AV_DESC AS SMOKING_HX, TM_FIRST_RECUR_DTE, TM_FIRST_RECUR_TYP FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS C ON C.AV_ELEMENT = 'CASE_STS' AND C.AV_CODE = TM_CASE_STS LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS SM ON SM.AV_ELEMENT = 'SMOKING_HX' AND SM.AV_CODE = TM_SMOKING_HX WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK like '%ANGIOSARCOMA%' AND TM_DX_DTE BETWEEN '2000-01-01' AND CURRENT date ) , PATH AS (SELECT PRPT_MRN, PRPT_PROCEDURE_DTE FROM (SELECT PRPT_MRN, PRPT_PROCEDURE_DTE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY PRPT_MRN ORDER BY PRPT_PROCEDURE_DTE ASC) AS RANK FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V WHERE PRPT_REPORT IS NOT NULL AND PRPT_REPORT_DTE BETWEEN '2000-01-01' AND CURRENT date AND CONTAINS("PRPT_REPORT", '("angiosarcoma")') = 1 ) A WHERE RANK = 1 ) , PTS AS (SELECT DISTINCT MRN, COALESCE(TM_DX_DTE, PRPT_PROCEDURE_DTE) DX_DTE, HIST_DESC, SITE_DESC, SMOKING_HX FROM (SELECT TM_MRN AS MRN FROM CDB UNION SELECT PRPT_MRN AS MRN FROM PATH) A LEFT JOIN CDB ON MRN = TM_MRN LEFT JOIN PATH ON MRN = PRPT_MRN) , CLINDOC_SM AS (SELECT * FROM (SELECT DISTINCT CDD_MRN, CDD_SERVICE_DTE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CDD_MRN ORDER BY CDD_SERVICE_DTE DESC) AS SMOKING_RANK, STRIP(SUBSTR(CDO_VALUE_TEXT, 1, 200)) AS SMOKING_HIST FROM IDB.CD_DOCUMENT JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION ON CDO_DOC_GUID = CDD_DOC_GUID AND CDO_AUTHORED_DTE = CDD_AUTHORED_DTE JOIN PTS ON MRN = CDD_MRN WHERE CDD_CANCEL_IND = '0' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND = '0' AND(CDO_MSTR_ITEM_NM = 'Smoking Status RES' OR CDO_MSTR_ITEM_NM = 'D_UCC_Tobacco use' OR CDO_MSTR_ITEM_NM = 'D_UCC_Tobacco products') ) A WHERE SMOKING_RANK = 1 ) , ALC AS (SELECT MRN ALC_MRN , SERVICE_DT, ITEM_NAME ALC_Q, ALCOHOL_USE FROM (SELECT MRN, CDD_DOC_NAME DOCNAME, CDD_SERVICE_DT SERVICE_DT, CDO_ITEM_NAME ITEM_NAME, TRIM(SUBSTR(CDO_VALUE_TEXT, 1, 200)) ALCOHOL_USE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CDD_MRN ORDER BY CDD_SERVICE_DT DESC) RN FROM PTS JOIN IDB.CD_DOCUMENT ON MRN = CDD_MRN JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION ON CDD_DOC_GUID = CDO_DOC_GUID AND CDD_AUTHORED_DTE = CDO_AUTHORED_DTE WHERE 1=1 AND (CDD_DOC_NAME LIKE 'Follow Up%' OR CDD_DOC_NAME LIKE 'Initial%') AND (CDO_ITEM_NAME IN ('Do you drink alcohol?', 'Pattern of Alcohol use') OR UPPER(CDO_ITEM_NAME) like '%DRINK%') AND CDD_CANCEL_IND <> '1' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND <> '1' ) AS A WHERE RN = 1 ) , RADONC AS (SELECT RTC_TX_MRN, LISTAGG(DATE(RTC_TX_START_DTE) || ' | ' || DATE(RTC_TX_STOP_DTE) || ' | ' || TRIM(RTC_TX_PLAN_NAME) || ' | ' || TRIM(RTC_TX_DELIVERED_FRACTIONS) || ' | ' || TRIM(RTC_TX_DELIVERED_DOSE), CHR(13) || CHR(10)) WITHIN GROUP( ORDER BY DATE(RTC_TX_START_DTE)) AS "Radonc: Start/End Dt | Area | Fraction | Dose" FROM (SELECT DISTINCT RTC_TX_MRN, RTC_TX_COURSE_NO, RTC_TX_PLANSETUP_NO, RTC_TX_COURSE_ID, RTC_TX_PLAN_NAME, RTC_TX_PLANNED_FRACTIONS, RTC_TX_DELIVERED_FRACTIONS, RTC_TX_PLANNED_DOSE, RTC_TX_DELIVERED_DOSE, RTC_TX_START_DTE, RTC_TX_STOP_DTE, RTC_TX_ELAPSED_DAYS, RTC_PRIMARY_REF_POINT, RTC_DOSE_CORRECTION FROM IDB.RADONC_TREATMENT_COURSE JOIN PTS ON MRN = RTC_TX_MRN ) A GROUP BY RTC_TX_MRN) , CHEMO AS (SELECT APR_MRN, SUBSTR(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(CAST(XMLSERIALIZE(CONTENT XMLAGG(XMLELEMENT(NAME "c", '| '||DATE(APR_START_DTE) || ' | ' || DATE(APR_END_DTE) || ' | ' || TRIM(CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME) || ' | ' || TRIM(APR_PRESCRIBED_DOSE)||' |'|| CHR(13) || CHR(10)) ORDER BY DATE(APR_START_DTE)) AS CLOB(32000)) AS VARCHAR(32000)), '<c>', ','), '</c>', ''), '', ''), '<c/>', ''), ',', ''), 1) AS "Chemo: Start/End Dt | Generic Drug | Dose" FROM (SELECT DISTINCT APR_MRN, APR_START_DTE, APR_END_DTE, CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME, APR_PRESCRIBED_DOSE FROM IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX JOIN IDB.CHEMO_DRUG_GENERIC ON APR_GENERIC_NAME = CDG_GENERIC_NAME JOIN PTS ON MRN = APR_MRN) A GROUP BY APR_MRN) , SURG AS (SELECT SSE_MRN, SUBSTR(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(CAST(XMLSERIALIZE(CONTENT XMLAGG(XMLELEMENT(NAME "c", '| '||DATE(SSE_SURG_DTE) || ' | ' || TRIM(SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD) || ' | ' || STRIP(SUBSTR(SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC, 1, 250)) ||' |'|| CHR(13) || CHR(10)) ORDER BY DATE(SSE_SURG_DTE)) AS CLOB(32000)) AS VARCHAR(32000)), '<c>', ','), '</c>', ''), '', ''), '<c/>', ''), ',', ''), 1) AS "Surg: Date | CPT Code | Description" FROM (SELECT DISTINCT SSE_MRN, SSE_SURG_DTE, SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD, SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC FROM IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE ON SSE_LOG_ID = SSP_LOG_ID AND SSE_ENC_CSN_ID = SSP_ENC_CSN_ID JOIN PTS ON MRN = SSE_MRN WHERE (SSE_SURG_LOC not like '%IR%' AND SSE_SURG_LOC not like '%ENDO%' AND SSE_SOURCE_TYPE <> 'E') ) A GROUP BY SSE_MRN) , REOCCUR AS (SELECT DISTINCT APR_MRN AS REOCCUR_MRN FROM IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX JOIN PTS ON APR_MRN = MRN WHERE APR_START_DTE >= DX_DTE + 1 YEAR UNION SELECT DISTINCT RTC_TX_MRN AS REOCCUR_MRN FROM IDB.RADONC_TREATMENT_COURSE JOIN PTS ON RTC_TX_MRN = MRN WHERE RTC_TX_START_DTE >= DX_DTE + 1 YEAR ) SELECT MRN "MRN", DX_DTE "Dx Date", HIST_DESC "Histology", SITE_DESC "Site", COALESCE(SMOKING_HX, SMOKING_HIST) "Smoking History", ALC_Q "Alcohol Question", ALCOHOL_USE "Alcohol Use", "Radonc: Start/End Dt | Area | Fraction | Dose", "Chemo: Start/End Dt | Generic Drug | Dose", "Surg: Date | CPT Code | Description" , CASE WHEN REOCCUR_MRN IS NOT NULL THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS "Reoccurrence", TRIM(R.AV_DESC) "Race", CASE WHEN PT_DATE_OF_DEATH IS NULL THEN 'Alive' ELSE 'Deceased' END AS "Vital Status" FROM PTS LEFT JOIN CLINDOC_SM ON MRN = CDD_MRN LEFT JOIN ALC ON MRN = ALC_MRN LEFT JOIN RADONC ON MRN = RTC_TX_MRN LEFT JOIN CHEMO ON MRN = APR_MRN LEFT JOIN SURG ON MRN = SSE_MRN LEFT JOIN REOCCUR ON MRN = REOCCUR_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS R ON R.AV_ELEMENT = 'RACE' AND R.AV_CODE = PT_RACE ; SELECT PRPT_MRN "MRN", PRPT_PROCEDURE_DTE "Procedure Date", PRPT_REPORT_DTE "Report Date", PRPT_REPORT_TYPE_DESC "Report Description", PRPT_REPORT "Full Text Report" FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V WHERE PRPT_REPORT IS NOT NULL AND PRPT_REPORT_DTE BETWEEN '2000-01-01' AND CURRENT date AND CONTAINS("PRPT_REPORT", '("angiosarcoma")') = 1

prompt: Provide a list of patients with a breast cancer diagnosis or an increased risk of breast cancer who underwent tissue-expander placement from December 2016 to December 2018.
completion: WITH X AS (SELECT DISTINCT PBD_MRN, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH AS DOB, CLM_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK, PBC_PBD_DESC, PBD_SVC_DTE FROM IDB.PBD_DTL JOIN IDB.PBD_CODE ON PBD_PBD_CD = PBC_PBD_CD JOIN IDB.CLM ON PBC_CPT_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PBD_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE CLM_CLSF_CD IN ('19357') AND PBD_SVC_DTE BETWEEN '2016-12-01' AND '2018-12-01' ) , Y AS (SELECT PBD_MRN, DOB, CLM_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK, PBC_PBD_DESC, PBD_SVC_DTE, CDD_MRN, CDD_DOC_GUID, CDD_SERVICE_DTE, CDD_DOC_NAME, CDO_SECTION, CDO_CTLG_DISPL_NM, CDO_MSTR_ITEM_NM, CDO_ITEM_NAME, STRIP(SUBSTR(CDO_VALUE_TEXT, 1, 2000)) AS CDO_VALUE_TEXT FROM X LEFT JOIN IDB.CD_DOCUMENT ON CDD_MRN = PBD_MRN AND CDD_CANCEL_IND = '0' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND = '0' AND CDD_DOC_NAME = 'Operative Report, Tissue Expander - Plastic' AND CDD_SERVICE_DTE BETWEEN '2016-12-01' AND '2018-12-01' LEFT JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION ON CDO_DOC_GUID = CDD_DOC_GUID AND CDO_AUTHORED_DTE = CDD_AUTHORED_DTE ) , CD AS (SELECT DISTINCT CDD_MRN, CDD_DOC_GUID, CDD_SERVICE_DTE, CDD_DOC_NAME, CDO_MSTR_ITEM_NM, CDO_ITEM_NAME, CDO_VALUE_TEXT FROM Y WHERE CDD_DOC_GUID <> '' ) , CD1 AS (SELECT CDD_DOC_GUID, CDO_VALUE_TEXT AS "Procedure" FROM CD WHERE CDO_MSTR_ITEM_NM IN ('PLA_OP_IF_ProcedureDisplay1', 'PLA_OP_IF_ProcedureDisplay2') ) , CD2 AS (SELECT CDD_DOC_GUID, CDO_VALUE_TEXT AS "Indications" FROM CD WHERE CDO_MSTR_ITEM_NM IN ('OP_PLA_Indications FT') ) , CD3 AS (SELECT CDD_DOC_GUID, CDO_VALUE_TEXT AS "AlloDerm Position" FROM CD WHERE CDO_MSTR_ITEM_NM IN ('OP_PLA_TE_AlloDerm position (other) FT') ) , CD4 AS (SELECT CDD_DOC_GUID, CDO_VALUE_TEXT AS "Muscle(s) elevated" FROM CD WHERE CDO_MSTR_ITEM_NM IN ('OP_PLA_Muscle(s) elevated with Electrocautery RES') ) , CD5 AS (SELECT CDD_DOC_GUID, CDO_VALUE_TEXT AS "Other Muscles Elevated" FROM CD WHERE CDO_MSTR_ITEM_NM IN ('OP_PLA_Other Muscles Elevated FT') ) , CD6 AS (SELECT CDD_DOC_GUID, CDO_VALUE_TEXT AS "Muscle Closure" FROM CD WHERE CDO_MSTR_ITEM_NM IN ('OP_PLA_Muscle Closure (other) FT') ) , CD7 AS (SELECT CDD_DOC_GUID, CDO_VALUE_TEXT AS "Additional Details" FROM CD WHERE CDO_MSTR_ITEM_NM IN ('OP_PLA_Additional Details FT') ) , CD_FINAL AS (SELECT DISTINCT CD.CDD_MRN, CD.CDD_DOC_GUID, CD.CDD_SERVICE_DTE, CD.CDD_DOC_NAME, "Procedure", "Indications", "AlloDerm Position", "Muscle(s) elevated", "Other Muscles Elevated", "Muscle Closure", "Additional Details" FROM CD LEFT JOIN CD1 ON CD.CDD_DOC_GUID = CD1.CDD_DOC_GUID LEFT JOIN CD2 ON CD.CDD_DOC_GUID = CD2.CDD_DOC_GUID LEFT JOIN CD3 ON CD.CDD_DOC_GUID = CD3.CDD_DOC_GUID LEFT JOIN CD4 ON CD.CDD_DOC_GUID = CD4.CDD_DOC_GUID LEFT JOIN CD5 ON CD.CDD_DOC_GUID = CD5.CDD_DOC_GUID LEFT JOIN CD6 ON CD.CDD_DOC_GUID = CD6.CDD_DOC_GUID LEFT JOIN CD7 ON CD.CDD_DOC_GUID = CD7.CDD_DOC_GUID) SELECT DISTINCT Y.PBD_MRN, DOB, CLM_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK, PBC_PBD_DESC, PBD_SVC_DTE, CD_FINAL.CDD_DOC_GUID, CD_FINAL.CDD_DOC_NAME, CD_FINAL.CDD_SERVICE_DTE, DAYS(CD_FINAL.CDD_SERVICE_DTE) - DAYS(PBD_SVC_DTE) AS DAYS_DIFF, "Muscle(s) elevated", "Other Muscles Elevated", "Muscle Closure", "Procedure", "Indications", "AlloDerm Position", "Additional Details" FROM Y LEFT JOIN CD_FINAL ON CD_FINAL.CDD_MRN = Y.CDD_MRN

prompt: PACC appointments completed in the prior month in an exam room or bed area

AND CLD_DEPT_ID IN (343, 17, 278, 279, 247, 248, 161, 460, 462, 463, 464, 465, 466, 467, 468, 581, 582, 575, 576, 720, 179, 993, 992, 249, 281)

prompt: Provide a list of patients that received > 40mL/kg of blood components and had chemo/hsct recently
completion: WITH CHEMO AS (SELECT APR_MRN MRN, MAX(APR_START_DTE)CHEMO_DATE FROM IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX_V WHERE CDG_CHEMO_FLAG = 'Y' AND APR_START_DTE >= CURRENT date - 6 MONTHS GROUP BY APR_MRN ) , BMT AS (SELECT CDD_MRN MRN, MAX(CDD_SERVICE_DTE) HSCT_DATE FROM IDB.CD_DOCUMENT JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION ON CDD_MRN = CDO_MRN AND CDD_DOC_GUID = CDO_DOC_GUID WHERE CDD_DOC_NAME IN ('Cell Infusion - BMT', 'Cell Infusion - BMT/CTS') AND CDD_CANCEL_IND <> '1' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND <> '1' AND CDD_SERVICE_DTE >= CURRENT date - 12 MONTHS GROUP BY CDD_MRN ) , IP AS (SELECT MRN, CHEMO_DATE, NULL HSCT_DATE FROM CHEMO UNION SELECT MRN, NULL CHEMO_DATE, HSCT_DATE FROM BMT) , BLOOD_R AS (SELECT DISTINCT CDD_MRN, CHEMO_DATE, HSCT_DATE, STRIP(OCV_CURR_LOC) AS OCV_CURR_LOC, CDD_DOC_GUID, CDD_SERVICE_DTE, CDD_SERVICE_DT, STRIP(CDD_DOC_NAME) AS CDD_DOC_NAME, CDO_ITEM_SEQ, CDO_SECTION, CDO_CTLG_DISPL_NM, CDO_MSTR_ITEM_NM, CDO_ITEM_NAME, CDO_VALUE_TEXT, OCV_IP_OP_IND, OCV_ADM_DT, OCV_DSCH_DT FROM IP JOIN IDB.CD_DOCUMENT ON MRN = CDD_MRN JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION ON CDO_DOC_GUID = CDD_DOC_GUID AND CDO_AUTHORED_DTE = CDD_AUTHORED_DTE LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_CLIENT_VISIT ON OCV_VISIT_GUID = CDD_VISIT_GUID JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON MRN = PT_MRN WHERE CDD_CANCEL_IND = '0' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND = '0' AND CDD_DOC_NAME = 'I & O Flowsheet' AND CDO_SECTION = 'Blood Products' AND CDO_ITEM_NAME IN ('Platelets', 'PRBC', 'Fresh Frozen Plasma (FFP)', 'Convalescent Plasma') AND DATE(OCV_ADM_DT) BETWEEN '2017-01-01' AND '2021-12-31' AND OCV_IP_OP_IND = 'I' AND YEAR(CDD_SERVICE_DTE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) <= 21 AND CDO_VALUE_TEXT <> '' ) , TOTAL_VOLUME AS (SELECT CDD_MRN, CHEMO_DATE, HSCT_DATE, CDD_SERVICE_DTE, DATE(OCV_ADM_DT) ADMIT_DATE, DATE(OCV_DSCH_DT) DSCH_DATE, SUM(FLOAT(CDO_VALUE_TEXT)) TOTAL_VOLUME FROM BLOOD_R GROUP BY CDD_MRN, CHEMO_DATE, HSCT_DATE, CDD_SERVICE_DTE, DATE(OCV_ADM_DT), DATE(OCV_DSCH_DT)) , WT AS (SELECT PMH_MRN, CHEMO_DATE, HSCT_DATE, ADMIT_DATE, DSCH_DATE, CDD_SERVICE_DTE, TOTAL_VOLUME, PMH_MEASURE_DTE, PMH_WT_KG, ABS(DAYS(PMH_MEASURE_DTE) - DAYS(CDD_SERVICE_DTE)) DAYS_FROM_WT_TO_BLOOD, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY PMH_MRN, CDD_SERVICE_DTE ORDER BY ABS(DAYS(PMH_MEASURE_DTE) - DAYS(CDD_SERVICE_DTE))) RN FROM TOTAL_VOLUME JOIN IDB.PT_MEASURES_HX ON CDD_MRN = PMH_MRN) , BLOOD_PER_KG_40 AS (SELECT PMH_MRN, CHEMO_DATE, HSCT_DATE, ADMIT_DATE, DSCH_DATE, CDD_SERVICE_DTE, TOTAL_VOLUME, PMH_MEASURE_DTE, PMH_WT_KG, RN, DAYS_FROM_WT_TO_BLOOD, TOTAL_VOLUME/PMH_WT_KG BLOOD_PER_KG FROM WT WHERE RN = 1 AND TOTAL_VOLUME/PMH_WT_KG >= 40.0 ) , DIED AS (SELECT PMH_MRN DIED_MRN, CDD_SERVICE_DTE FROM WT JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PMH_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE PT_DEATH_IND IN ('X', 'C', 'D') AND PT_DATE_OF_DEATH BETWEEN CDD_SERVICE_DTE AND CDD_SERVICE_DTE + 1 DAY ) , PTS_F AS (SELECT PMH_MRN MRN, CDD_SERVICE_DTE FROM BLOOD_PER_KG_40 UNION SELECT DIED_MRN MRN, CDD_SERVICE_DTE FROM DIED) SELECT MRN, PT_LAST_NAME LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME FIRST_NAME, CHEMO_DATE, HSCT_DATE, LISTAGG(DISTINCT CHAR(ADMIT_DATE), '; ') ADMIT_DATES FROM PTS_F JOIN WT ON MRN = PMH_MRN AND PTS_F.CDD_SERVICE_DTE = WT.CDD_SERVICE_DTE AND RN = 1 JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON MRN = PT_MRN GROUP BY MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, CHEMO_DATE, HSCT_DATE

prompt: Provide a report of completed and referred appts for Dr. Alicia Latham.
completion: SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, CPE_ENC_DTE, CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME, CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR, CLD_CLD_CENTER, CASE WHEN CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR LIKE '%NV%' OR CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR LIKE '%IR%' THEN 'NV' END AS NV_IND, CRE_RES_NAME, PK_ICD10_DX1, PK_ICD10_DX1_DESCRIPTION FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON CPE_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.PATIENT_KEEPER ON CPE_MRN = PK_MRN AND CPE_ENC_DTE = PK_SVC_DTE WHERE 1=1 AND CRE_RES_NAME like 'LATHAM%' AND CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CPE_ENC_DTE >= '2019-01-01' AND CLD_CLD_CENTER = '53RD' ; SELECT CPE_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, CPE_ENC_DTE, CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME, CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR, CASE WHEN CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR LIKE '%NV%' OR CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR LIKE '%IR%' THEN 'NV' END AS NV_IND, CRE_RES_NAME REFERRING_NAME FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CRE_RES_ID = CPE_REF_RES_ID JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON CPE_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 = 'SRG' AND CRE_RES_NAME like 'LATHAM%' AND CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CPE_ENC_DTE >= '2019-01-01'; SELECT OP_DISPLAY_NAME, OOC_ITEM_NAME, COUNT(*) FROM IDB.OMS_ORDER JOIN IDB.OMS_PROVIDER ON OO_PVDR_GUID = OP_PVDR_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_CATALOG ON OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID = OOC_MSTR_ITEM_GUID WHERE OP_DISPLAY_NAME like 'Latham%' AND OO_ENTER_DTE >= '2019-01-01' AND OO_ORD_STS_CD NOT IN ('CANP', 'CANC', 'AUC3') AND (UPPER(OOC_ITEM_NAME) like '%ENDOSCOPY%' OR UPPER(OOC_ITEM_NAME) like '%COLONOSCOPY%') AND OOC_ITEM_NAME IN ('Endo-Colonoscopy', 'Endo-Upper GI Endoscopy') GROUP BY OP_DISPLAY_NAME, OOC_ITEM_NAME ;

prompt: Provide data on patients diagnosed with invasive urothelial carcinoma at stage T2 and above between 2006 and 2011.
completion: SELECT TM_MRN AS "MRN", PT_LAST_NAME "Last Name", PT_FIRST_NAME "First Name", PT_SEX AS "Gender", PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH "Date of Birth", PT_DATE_OF_DEATH "Date of Death", R.AV_DESC AS "Race (Patient Reg)", CR.AV_DESC AS "Race (CDB)", E.AV_DESC AS "Ethnicity (Patient Reg)", CE.AV_DESC AS "Ethnicity (CDB)", CS.AV_DESC AS "Case Status", TM_DX_DTE AS "Tumor Diagnosis Date", TM_HIST_CD AS "ICD-O Histology Code", H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS "ICD-O Histology Desc", TM_SITE_CD AS "ICD-O Site Code", S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS "ICD-O Site Desc", TM_CLIN_TNM_T AS "Clinical T Stage", TM_CLIN_TNM_N AS "Clinical N Stage", TM_CLIN_TNM_M AS "Clinical M Stage", TM_CLIN_STG_GRP AS "Clinical Collaborative Stage", TM_PATH_TNM_T AS "Pathologic T Stage", TM_PATH_TNM_N AS "Pathologic N Stage", TM_PATH_TNM_M AS "Pathologic M Stage", TM_PATH_STG_GRP AS "Pathologic Collaborative Stage", TM_SMOKING_HX AS "Smoking History", PLA_LST_APPT_DTE AS "Last MSK Appointment Date", PLA_LST_DSCH_DTE AS "Last MSK Discharge Date", PLA_LST_CHEMO_DTE AS "Last MSK Chemo Date" FROM IDB.PATIENT JOIN IDB.CDB_TUMOR ON TM_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.CDB_PATIENT ON CP_MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD LEFT JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS CS ON CS.AV_ELEMENT = 'CASE_STS' AND CS.AV_CODE = TM_CASE_STS LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS R ON R.AV_ELEMENT = 'RACE' AND R.AV_CODE = PT_RACE LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS CR ON CR.AV_ELEMENT = 'CDB_RACE' AND CR.AV_CODE = CP_CDB_RACE LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS E ON E.AV_ELEMENT = 'PT_ETHNICITY' AND E.AV_CODE = PT_PT_ETHNICITY LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS CE ON CE.AV_ELEMENT = 'ETHNICITY' AND CE.AV_CODE = CP_ETHNICITY JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY ON PLA_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE TM_DX_DTE BETWEEN '2006-01-01' AND '2011-12-31' AND TM_HIST_CD = 'M8120/3' AND TM_SITE_CD <> 'C649' AND TM_CASE_STS NOT IN ('4', '5') AND (TM_CLIN_TNM_T IN ('T2', 'T2A', 'T2B', 'T3', 'T3A', 'T3B', 'T4', 'T4A', 'T4B') OR TM_PATH_TNM_T IN ('T2', 'T2A', 'T2B', 'T3', 'T3A', 'T3B', 'T4', 'T4A', 'T4B')) AND TM_GENERAL_STG = '1' AND PLA_LST_CHEMO_DTE >= TM_DX_DTE

prompt: Requesting a dataline report for Breast Survivorship patients scheduled for same day imaging at BAIC
completion: WITH IMAGE AS (SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN AS "MRN", CPE_ENC_DTE AS "Appt Date", CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME "Modality" FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Sch') AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN '2020-01-01' AND '2020-12-31' AND CLD_CLD_CENTER = '300 E66' AND CLD_DEPT_NAME IN ('RADIOLOGY (ADV)300 E66', 'GEN RAD 300 E66') ) SELECT CPE_MRN AS "MRN", PT_FIRST_NAME FIRST, PT_LAST_NAME LAST, "Appt Date", "Modality", CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 AS "Department", CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 AS "Service", CLD_DEPT_NAME AS "Department Name", CRE_RES_NAME AS "Provider Name", CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME AS "Visit Type" FROM IMAGE JOIN IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER ON "MRN" = CPE_MRN AND "Appt Date" = CPE_ENC_DTE JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PT_MRN = CPE_MRN WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Sch') AND CLD_DEPT_NAME = 'BREAST DMT 300 E66 SVR' AND CRE_RES_NAME IN ('CAGNEY, JENNIFER M', 'COGNETTI, KRISTEN', 'DUNNE, MEGAN', 'DEVIGNE, AMY ROSE', 'KEENAN, KATHLEEN', 'LERNER, RACHAEL A')

prompt: Please provide weekly list of newly diagnosed follicular Lymphoma patients. Patients should not have received any prior line of therapy and are scheduled visit to consider treatment options.
completion: WITH ETO AS (SELECT PT_MRN AS MRN, STRIP(PT_LAST_NAME)||', '||PT_FIRST_NAME PT_NAME, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH DOB, PT_SEX_DESC SEX, CC_EFF_DTE FIRST_DX_DTE, CC_CLSF_CD FIRST_DX_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK DX_DESC FROM (SELECT CC_MRN, CC_CLSF_CD, CC_EFF_DTE, CC_RESP_PARTY, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK , PLA_LST_CHEMO_DTE, PLA_LST_RT_DTE, PLA_LST_SURG_DTE, PLA_LST_TX_DTE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CC_MRN ORDER BY CC_EFF_DTE) RN FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CLM_CLSF_CD = CC_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY ON CC_MRN = PLA_MRN AND PLA_DECEASED_IND = '' WHERE CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'D%' AND CC_CLSF_CD LIKE 'C82.%' AND (CC_FINALIZED_IND= 'Y' OR CC_PT_TYPE = 'I') AND PLA_LST_TX_DTE IS NULL ) A JOIN IDB.PATIENT_V ON CC_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE RN = 1 AND CC_EFF_DTE >= '2019-01-01' AND PT_DEATH_IND = '' AND PT_DATE_OF_DEATH IS NULL ) SELECT MRN, PT_NAME, DOB, SEX, FIRST_DX_DTE, FIRST_DX_CD, DX_DESC, CPE_CPE_APPT_STS, CPE_ENC_DTE, CLD_DEPT_NAME, CRE_RES_NAME, CRE_RES_TYP, CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME, CVT_EXT_NAME FROM ETO JOIN IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER ON MRN = CPE_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS = 'Sch' ;

prompt: Provide a daily list of patients who received pembrolizumab for an MSI-high solid tumor in the previous 24 hours and had a CMP performed in the last 48 hours.
completion: SELECT DISTINCT APR_MRN, CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME, APR_DIAGNOSIS_DESC, MIN(APR_START_DTE) AS START_DT FROM IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX_V WHERE LOWER(CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME) like ('%pembrolizumab%') GROUP BY APR_MRN, CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME, APR_DIAGNOSIS_DESC HAVING MIN(APR_START_DTE) BETWEEN CURRENT date - 1 DAY AND CURRENT date

prompt: Design a monthly report to follow IMPACT orders sent from the cutaneous lymphoma clinic.
completion: WITH CPE AS (SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN, CPE_ENC_DTE, CRE_RES_NAME, CRE_RES_TYP, CLD_DEPT_NAME, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8, CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CRE_RES_TYP IN ('Physician') AND CRE_RES_ID IN ('000612', '020453', '029900', '024380') ) , DM AS (SELECT PT_MRN, PRPT_ACCESSION_NO, PATH_PROCEDURE_DATE, GENE FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_STRUCTURED_RESULTS_V JOIN CPE ON CPE_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE PATH_PROCEDURE_DATE BETWEEN CURRENT DATE - (DAY(CURRENT DATE) - 1) DAYS - 1 MONTH AND CURRENT DATE - (DAY(CURRENT DATE)) DAYS ) , G AS (SELECT PT_MRN, LISTAGG(COALESCE(STRIP(CAST(GENE AS VARCHAR(2000))), '') , CHR(13) || CHR(10)) WITHIN GROUP( ORDER BY PT_MRN, GENE) AS GENES FROM (SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN, GENE FROM DM) D GROUP BY PT_MRN) , X AS (SELECT DISTINCT STRIP(CPE_MRN) AS MRN, STRIP(PT_LAST_NAME) || ', ' || STRIP(PT_FIRST_NAME) AS NAME, PRPT_ACCESSION_NO, PATH_PROCEDURE_DATE, GENES FROM CPE JOIN DM ON CPE_MRN = DM.PT_MRN JOIN G ON CPE_MRN = G.PT_MRN JOIN IDB.PATIENT P ON CPE_MRN = P.PT_MRN) , P AS (SELECT DISTINCT "t1"."PT_MRN" AS "MRN", STRIP(PRPT_ORD_DR_NAME) AS PRPT_ORD_DR_NAME, "t2"."PRPT_ACCESSION_NO" AS "Pathology Report", "PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_DESC" AS "Pathology Report Type", "t3"."DT_DTE" AS "Pathology Procedure Date", UPPER(CASE WHEN LENGTH(PRPT_REPORT) <= 15000 THEN RTRIM(CAST(SUBSTR(PRPT_REPORT, 1, 15000) AS VARCHAR(15000))) ELSE CAST(SUBSTR(PRPT_REPORT, 1, 15000) AS VARCHAR(15000)) END) AS TXT FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V" "t1" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED" "t5" ON "t1"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t5"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V" "t2" ON "t5"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t2"."PRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" "t3" ON "t2"."PRPT_PROCEDURE_DATE_ID" = "t3"."DT_DATE_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATH_RPRT_TYPE_LOOKUP" "t4" ON "t2"."PRPT_REPORT_TYPE" = "t4"."PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_CD" WHERE 1=1 AND "t2"."PRPT_REPORT" IS NOT NULL AND "t2"."PRPT_ACCESSION_NO" IN (SELECT PRPT_ACCESSION_NO FROM X) ) SELECT X.*, PRPT_ORD_DR_NAME, TXT FROM X LEFT JOIN P ON X.MRN = P.MRN AND X.PRPT_ACCESSION_NO = P."Pathology Report"

prompt: Provide data on Ruxolitinib administration for the specified list of patients.
completion: SELECT DISTINCT APR_MRN, APR_GENERIC_NAME, APR_DRUG_NAME, APR_START_DTE, APR_END_DTE, APR_ROUTE, APR_PRESCRIBED_DOSE, APR_DOSE_UOM, APR_ORD_RX_TYPE FROM IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX_V WHERE 1=1 AND(UPPER(CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME) LIKE '%RUXOLITINIB%' OR UPPER(APR_GENERIC_NAME) LIKE '%RUXOLITINIB%' OR UPPER(APR_DRUG_NAME) LIKE '%RUXOLITINIB%') AND APR_MRN IN ()

prompt: Yesterday's New COVID Inpatients
completion: WITH POSITIVE_COVID_ADMISSIONS AS (SELECT IP_ADMITS.MRN, ADMIT_ID, ADMIT_DT, DISCHARGE_DT, DISCHARGE_DISPOSITION, LOS, RESULT, MIN_IDENTIFIED_DT, MIN_RESOLVED_PROBLEM_DT, IP_ADMITS.DISCHARGE_DT_FOR_CALCS, DAYS(MIN_IDENTIFIED_DT) - DAYS(ADMIT_DT) AS DAYS_ADMIT_TO_IDENTIFIED, CASE WHEN ADMIT_DT >= MIN_IDENTIFIED_DT THEN ADMIT_DT WHEN MIN_IDENTIFIED_DT > ADMIT_DT THEN MIN_IDENTIFIED_DT END AS MAX_OF_ADMIT_AND_TEST, SERVICE_DISCHARGE, DEPARTMENT_ADMIT, DIVISION_ADMIT, SERVICE_ADMIT, SURGERY_SERVICE, ADMIT_TYPE_GROUPED, ADM_TYPE_DESC, INPATIENT_STATUS, AXR_TO_IP_FLAG, TREATMENT_PLAN_DESC, ADM_SOURCE_DESC, TRANSPLANT_TYPE, DEPARTMENT_DISCHARGE, DIVISION_DISCHARGE, PRIMARY_DIAGNOSIS_DRG, SURGERY_VISIT_TYPE, ADMITTING_DIAGNOSIS, ADM_DIAG_DESC, FINAL_DIAGNOSIS, FINAL_DIAG_DESC, INTERIM_DIAGNOSIS, INT_DIAG_DESC, POSITIVE_SOURCES, CASE WHEN POSITIVE_SOURCES like '%order_and_result%' THEN 'Y' ELSE '' END AS LAB_POSITIVE FROM IDB.INPATIENT_ADMISSIONS_V AS IP_ADMITS JOIN IDB.COVID19_PATIENT_INFO AS COVID ON IP_ADMITS.MRN = COVID.MRN AND COVID.MIN_IDENTIFIED_DT <= IP_ADMITS.DISCHARGE_DT_FOR_CALCS AND (COVID.RESULT = 'Positive' OR (COVID.RESULT = 'Resolved' AND MIN_RESOLVED_PROBLEM_DT > IP_ADMITS.ADMIT_DT)) WHERE DISCHARGE_DT_FOR_CALCS >= '2020-03-01 00:00:00' ) , MAIN_RESULTS AS (SELECT MRN AS "MRN", TRIM(PT_LAST_NAME) || ', ' || TRIM(PT_FIRST_NAME) AS "Patient Name", RESULT AS "COVID Status", MIN_IDENTIFIED_DT, DATE(MIN_IDENTIFIED_DT) AS "COVID Identified Date", DATE(MIN_RESOLVED_PROBLEM_DT) AS "COVID Resolved Date", DATE(ADMIT_DT) AS "Admission Date", ADMIT_DT, DATE(DISCHARGE_DT) AS "Discharge Date", DISCHARGE_DT, DISCHARGE_DISPOSITION AS "Current/Discharge Disposition", DEPARTMENT_ADMIT AS "Department on Admission", DIVISION_ADMIT AS "Division on Admission", SERVICE_ADMIT AS "Service on Admission", TREATMENT_PLAN_DESC AS "RMS Treatment Plan Value", ADM_DIAG_DESC AS "Admitting Dx", FINAL_DIAG_DESC AS "Final Dx", ADMIT_ID, ADMIT_ID AS "RMS Admit Number", MAX_OF_ADMIT_AND_TEST, POSITIVE_SOURCES, LAB_POSITIVE FROM POSITIVE_COVID_ADMISSIONS JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PT_MRN = MRN WHERE DATE(MAX_OF_ADMIT_AND_TEST) = CURRENT date - 1 DAY ) , POS_TESTS AS (SELECT COR_MRN AS POS_MRN, LISTAGG(POSITIVE_DATE, ', ') AS POSITIVE_DATES FROM (SELECT DISTINCT COR_MRN, VARCHAR_FORMAT(DATE(COR_SIGNIFICANT_DT), 'MM/DD/YYYY') AS POSITIVE_DATE FROM MAIN_RESULTS JOIN IDB.COVID19_ORDER_AND_RESULT ON MRN = COR_MRN WHERE COR_ORDER_STATUS_CODE IN ('RESF', 'RESC') AND COR_ORDER_NAME IN ('COVID-19 Qualitative RNA', 'COVID-19 Rapid Qualitative RNA') AND (COR_RESULT_TEXT like 'Positive%' OR COR_RESULT_TEXT like 'Detected%') ) A GROUP BY COR_MRN) , NEG_TESTS AS (SELECT COR_MRN AS NEG_MRN, LISTAGG(NEGATIVE_DATE, ', ') AS NEGATIVE_DATES FROM (SELECT DISTINCT COR_MRN, VARCHAR_FORMAT(DATE(COR_SIGNIFICANT_DT), 'MM/DD/YYYY') AS NEGATIVE_DATE FROM MAIN_RESULTS JOIN IDB.COVID19_ORDER_AND_RESULT ON MRN = COR_MRN WHERE COR_ORDER_STATUS_CODE IN ('RESF', 'RESC') AND COR_ORDER_NAME IN ('COVID-19 Qualitative RNA', 'COVID-19 Rapid Qualitative RNA') AND (COR_RESULT_TEXT like 'Negative%' OR COR_RESULT_TEXT like 'Not Detected%') ) A GROUP BY COR_MRN) , OTHER_ADMISSIONS AS (SELECT ADMIT_ID_FOR_OTHER, LISTAGG(CASE WHEN OTHER_ADMIT_DT < THIS_ADMIT_DT THEN VARCHAR_FORMAT(OTHER_ADMIT_DT, 'MM/DD/YYYY') END, ', ') AS "Prior Admissions", LISTAGG(CASE WHEN OTHER_ADMIT_DT < THIS_ADMIT_DT AND MIN_IDENTIFIED_DT < OTHER_DISCHARGE_DT THEN VARCHAR_FORMAT(OTHER_ADMIT_DT, 'MM/DD/YYYY') END, ', ') AS "Prior COVID Admissions", LISTAGG(CASE WHEN OTHER_ADMIT_DT > THIS_ADMIT_DT THEN VARCHAR_FORMAT(OTHER_ADMIT_DT, 'MM/DD/YYYY') END, ', ') AS "Later Admissions" FROM (SELECT DISTINCT B.ADMIT_ID AS ADMIT_ID_FOR_OTHER, A.ADMIT_DT AS OTHER_ADMIT_DT, A.DISCHARGE_DT AS OTHER_DISCHARGE_DT, B.ADMIT_DT AS THIS_ADMIT_DT, MIN_IDENTIFIED_DT FROM IDB.INPATIENT_ADMISSIONS_V A JOIN MAIN_RESULTS B ON A.MRN = B.MRN AND A.ADMIT_ID <> B."RMS Admit Number" WHERE A.ADMIT_DATE >= '2020-03-01' AND A.ADMIT_DATE <> B."Admission Date" ) A GROUP BY ADMIT_ID_FOR_OTHER) SELECT MRN, "Patient Name", "COVID Status", "COVID Identified Date", "COVID Resolved Date", POSITIVE_DATES AS "COVID Positive Dates", NEGATIVE_DATES AS "COVID Negative Dates", "Admission Date", "Discharge Date", "Prior Admissions", "Prior COVID Admissions", "Later Admissions", "Current/Discharge Disposition", "Department on Admission", "Division on Admission", "Service on Admission", "RMS Treatment Plan Value", "Admitting Dx", "Final Dx", "RMS Admit Number" FROM MAIN_RESULTS M LEFT JOIN POS_TESTS ON MRN = POS_MRN LEFT JOIN NEG_TESTS ON MRN = NEG_MRN LEFT JOIN OTHER_ADMISSIONS ON ADMIT_ID = ADMIT_ID_FOR_OTHER ORDER BY DATE(MAX_OF_ADMIT_AND_TEST), "Patient Name" ;

prompt: Please provide a list of MOSED cases performed by each radiologist
list of patients with MGUS diagnosis seen at MSKCC
completion: WITH DIAGNOSIS_0 AS (SELECT "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AS PT_DEID, BASE_QUERY.PT_MRN AS PT_MRN, CAST(TRIM(BASE_QUERY.PT_MRN) AS VARCHAR) || CAST(TRIM(BASE_QUERY.DIAGNOSIS_DATE) AS VARCHAR) || CAST(TRIM(BASE_QUERY.ICD_CODES_ICD_CODE) AS VARCHAR) AS SUBJECT_ID, TRIM(BASE_QUERY.ICD_CODES_ICD_CODE) || '-' || TRIM("IDB"."CLM"."CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK") AS ICD_CODES_ICD_CODE_DESC FROM (SELECT "IDB"."CTC_CLSF"."CC_MRN" AS PT_MRN, "IDB"."CTC_CLSF"."CC_CLSF_CD" AS ICD_CODES_ICD_CODE, MIN("IDB"."CTC_CLSF"."CC_EFF_DTE") AS DIAGNOSIS_DATE FROM "IDB"."CTC_CLSF" WHERE "IDB"."CTC_CLSF"."CC_CLSF_TYPE" LIKE 'DF%' AND ("IDB"."CTC_CLSF"."CC_PT_TYPE" = 'I' OR ("IDB"."CTC_CLSF"."CC_PT_TYPE" = 'O' AND "IDB"."CTC_CLSF"."CC_FINALIZED_IND" = 'Y')) GROUP BY "IDB"."CTC_CLSF"."CC_MRN", "IDB"."CTC_CLSF"."CC_CLSF_CD") AS BASE_QUERY JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS" ON BASE_QUERY.PT_MRN = "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_MRN" JOIN "IDB"."CLM" ON BASE_QUERY.ICD_CODES_ICD_CODE = "IDB"."CLM"."CLM_CLSF_CD" WHERE BASE_QUERY.ICD_CODES_ICD_CODE IN ('273.1', 'D47.2')), DIAGNOSIS_TR_1 AS (SELECT "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AS PT_DEID, "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_MRN" AS PT_MRN, CAST(TRIM("IDB"."CDB_TUMOR"."TM_MRN") AS VARCHAR) || CAST(TRIM("IDB"."CDB_TUMOR"."TM_TUMOR_SEQ") AS VARCHAR) || CAST(TRIM("IDB"."CDB_TUMOR"."TM_DX_DTE") AS VARCHAR) AS SUBJECT_ID, "IDB"."ALLOWVALS"."AV_DESC" AS DX_TR_CASE_STATUS, TRIM("IDB"."CDB_TUMOR"."TM_SITE_CD") || ' - ' || TRIM(CLM_SITE."CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK") AS DX_TR_SITE FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS" JOIN "IDB"."CDB_TUMOR" ON "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_MRN" = "IDB"."CDB_TUMOR"."TM_MRN" JOIN "IDB"."ALLOWVALS" ON "IDB"."ALLOWVALS"."AV_CODE" = "IDB"."CDB_TUMOR"."TM_CASE_STS" AND "IDB"."ALLOWVALS"."AV_ELEMENT" = 'CASE_STS' JOIN "IDB"."CLM" AS CLM_SITE ON CLM_SITE."CLM_CLSF_CD" = "IDB"."CDB_TUMOR"."TM_SITE_CD" WHERE "IDB"."ALLOWVALS"."AV_DESC" IN ('COMPLETED', 'CONSULT ONLY', 'INCOMPLETE', 'NON-INDEX', 'PATHOLOGY ONLY') AND "IDB"."CDB_TUMOR"."TM_SITE_CD" IN ('C421')), COHORT AS (SELECT PT_DEID AS PT_DEID FROM (SELECT DIAGNOSIS_0.PT_DEID AS PT_DEID FROM DIAGNOSIS_0 INTERSECT SELECT DIAGNOSIS_TR_1.PT_DEID AS PT_DEID FROM DIAGNOSIS_TR_1)), COHORT_DIAGNOSIS AS (SELECT SUBJECT_ID AS SUBJECT_ID, PT_DEID AS PT_DEID FROM (SELECT DIAGNOSIS_0.SUBJECT_ID AS SUBJECT_ID, DIAGNOSIS_0.PT_DEID AS PT_DEID FROM DIAGNOSIS_0)), COHORT_DIAGNOSIS_TR AS (SELECT SUBJECT_ID AS SUBJECT_ID, PT_DEID AS PT_DEID FROM (SELECT DIAGNOSIS_TR_1.SUBJECT_ID AS SUBJECT_ID, DIAGNOSIS_TR_1.PT_DEID AS PT_DEID FROM DIAGNOSIS_TR_1)), KEYS AS (SELECT COHORT.PT_DEID AS COHORT_PT_DEID, COHORT_DIAGNOSIS.SUBJECT_ID AS COHORT_DIAGNOSIS_SUBJECT_ID, COHORT_DIAGNOSIS.PT_DEID AS COHORT_DIAGNOSIS_PT_DEID, COHORT_DIAGNOSIS_TR.SUBJECT_ID AS COHORT_DIAGNOSIS_TR_SUBJECT_ID, COHORT_DIAGNOSIS_TR.PT_DEID AS COHORT_DIAGNOSIS_TR_PT_DEID FROM COHORT LEFT OUTER JOIN COHORT_DIAGNOSIS ON COHORT_DIAGNOSIS.PT_DEID = COHORT.PT_DEID LEFT OUTER JOIN COHORT_DIAGNOSIS_TR ON COHORT_DIAGNOSIS_TR.PT_DEID = COHORT.PT_DEID), DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS AS (SELECT DISTINCT "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AS PT_DEID, IDB_PATIENT."PT_MRN" AS PT_MRN, "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AS SUBJECT_ID, DMP_ID_TBL."PDRX_DMP_PATIENT_ID" AS DMP_ID, TRIM(IDB_PATIENT."PT_LAST_NAME") || ', ' || TRIM(IDB_PATIENT."PT_FIRST_NAME") AS PT_NAME, ALLOWVALS_SEX."AV_DESC" AS SEX, CASE WHEN (IDB_PATIENT."PT_DATE_OF_DEATH" IS NULL) THEN 'Alive' ELSE 'Deceased' END AS VITAL_STATS, IDB_PATIENT."PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH" AS DATE_OF_BIRTH, IDB_PATIENT."PT_DATE_OF_DEATH" AS DATE_OF_DEATH, ALLOWVALS_RACE."AV_DESC" AS RACE, ALLOWVALS_ETHNICITY."AV_DESC" AS ETHNICITY, ALLOWVALS_LANGUAGE."AV_DESC" AS PRIMARY_LANGUAGE, LAST_ACTIVITY_DATE."PLA_LST_ACTV_DTE" AS LAST_ACTIVITY_DATE, LAST_CONTACT_DATE."PLA_LST_CON_DTE" AS LAST_CONTACT_DATE FROM "IDB"."PATIENT" AS IDB_PATIENT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS" ON IDB_PATIENT."PT_MRN" = "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_MRN" LEFT OUTER JOIN "DV"."PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML" AS DMP_ID_TBL ON DMP_ID_TBL."PDRX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT OUTER JOIN "IDB"."ALLOWVALS" AS ALLOWVALS_SEX ON IDB_PATIENT."PT_SEX" = ALLOWVALS_SEX."AV_CODE" AND ALLOWVALS_SEX."AV_ELEMENT" = 'SEX' LEFT OUTER JOIN "IDB"."ALLOWVALS" AS ALLOWVALS_RACE ON IDB_PATIENT."PT_RACE" = ALLOWVALS_RACE."AV_CODE" AND ALLOWVALS_RACE."AV_ELEMENT" = 'RACE' LEFT OUTER JOIN "IDB"."ALLOWVALS" AS ALLOWVALS_ETHNICITY ON IDB_PATIENT."PT_PT_ETHNICITY" = ALLOWVALS_ETHNICITY."AV_CODE" AND ALLOWVALS_ETHNICITY."AV_ELEMENT" = 'PT_ETHNICITY' LEFT OUTER JOIN "IDB"."ALLOWVALS" AS ALLOWVALS_LANGUAGE ON IDB_PATIENT."PT_PRIMARY_LANG" = ALLOWVALS_LANGUAGE."AV_CODE" AND ALLOWVALS_LANGUAGE."AV_ELEMENT" = 'PRIMARY_LANG' LEFT OUTER JOIN "IDB".PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY AS LAST_ACTIVITY_DATE ON IDB_PATIENT."PT_MRN" = LAST_ACTIVITY_DATE."PLA_MRN" LEFT OUTER JOIN "IDB".PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY AS LAST_CONTACT_DATE ON IDB_PATIENT."PT_MRN" = LAST_CONTACT_DATE."PLA_MRN") SELECT DISTINCT DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS.PT_MRN AS MRN, DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS.DMP_ID AS DMP_ID, DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS.PT_NAME AS PT_NAME, DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS.SEX AS SEX, DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS.VITAL_STATS AS VITAL_STATUS, DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS.DATE_OF_BIRTH AS DATE_OF_BIRTH, DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS.DATE_OF_DEATH AS DATE_OF_DEATH, DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS.RACE AS RACE, DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS.ETHNICITY AS ETHNICITY, DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS.PRIMARY_LANGUAGE AS PRIMARY_LANGUAGE, DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS.LAST_ACTIVITY_DATE AS LAST_ACTIVITY_DATE, DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS.LAST_CONTACT_DATE AS LAST_CONTACT_DATE FROM KEYS LEFT OUTER JOIN DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS ON DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS.PT_DEID = KEYS.COHORT_PT_DEID;

prompt: Our Clinical Director (Alina Markova, MD) is looking for a report to determine appropriate patients that may be appropriate for continued dermatologic follow-up in their local community to improve access within the Dermatology Service.
completion: WITH LAST_APPT_DATE AS (SELECT PT_MRN, TRIM(PT_LAST_NAME) || ', ' || TRIM(PT_FIRST_NAME) AS PATIENT_NAME, PLA_LST_APPT_DTE AS LAST_APPT_DATE, CPE_CPE_APPT_STS AS STATUS, CPE_DEPT_ID, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 AS SERVICE, CLD_DEPT_NAME AS DEPARTMENT_NAME, CPE_VST_RES_ID, CRE_RES_NAME AS PROVIDER_NAME, CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID, CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME AS VISIT_TYPE, CAST(CDD_DOCUMENT_FULL_TEXT AS VARCHAR(3200)) AS FULL_TEXT FROM DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY ON PT_MRN = PLA_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER ON PT_MRN = CPE_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID JOIN DV.CLINDOC_FULL_TEXT_V ON PT_MRN = CDD_MRN WHERE 1=1 AND PT_MRN IS NOT NULL AND PLA_LST_APPT_DTE IS NOT NULL AND CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 = 'DER' AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN '2023-11-01' AND CURRENT_DATE ), NEXT_APPT_DATE AS (SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN, CPE_ENC_DTE AS NEXT_APPT_DATE, CRE_RES_NAME AS PROVIDER_NAME, CPE_CPE_APPT_STS AS STATUS, CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME AS VISIT_TYPE FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON CPE_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE 1 = 1 AND CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Sch') AND CRE_RES_TYP IN ('Physician') AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 = 'DER' AND CPE_MRN IS NOT NULL ) SELECT PT_MRN, PATIENT_NAME, DEPARTMENT_NAME, A.PROVIDER_NAME, A.VISIT_TYPE, A.STATUS, FULL_TEXT, NEXT_APPT_DATE, B.PROVIDER_NAME, B.STATUS, B.VISIT_TYPE FROM LAST_APPT_DATE A JOIN NEXT_APPT_DATE B ON A.PT_MRN = B.CPE_MRN

prompt: Provide a weekly list of new head and neck cancer patient visits and patients receiving cisplatin for the first time.
completion: WITH ETO AS (SELECT CPE_MRN NV_MRN, PAT.CPP_PT_NAME PT_NAME, CPE_ENC_DTE VST_DATE , VD.CLD_CLD_CENTER, VD.CLD_DEPT_NAME DEPT_NAME , CPE_APPT_DT APPT_DT , TIME(CPE_APPT_DT) APPT_TIME, CPE_APPT_MADE_DTE APPT_MADE_DTE , VT.CRE_RES_NAME VST_RESOURCE, CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME VST_NAME , CVT_EXT_NAME VST_TYPE FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER ENC JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID = CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT VD ON CPE_DEPT_ID = VD.CLD_DEPT_ID AND VD.CLD_CLD_CENTER = 'KOCH' JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE VT ON VT.CRE_RES_ID = CPE_VST_RES_ID AND VT.CRE_RES_ID IN ('015024', '017962', '002816', '024406', '014217') JOIN IDB.CL_PAS_PATIENT PAT ON ENC.CPE_MRN = PAT.CPP_MRN AND PAT.CPP_MRN > '' WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN('Sch') AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT DATE AND CURRENT DATE + 21 DAY AND CVT_EXT_NAME = 'New Visit' AND CPE_ENC_TYP_CD = 50 AND CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME LIKE 'STHN%' ) , SCH_CIS AS (SELECT CIS_MRN, PT_NAME, VST_DATE, CLD_CLD_CENTER, DEPT_NAME , APPT_DT, APPT_TIME, APPT_MADE_DTE, VST_RESOURCE, REF_MD, REF_DEPT_NAME, VST_NAME, VST_TYPE, DRUG FROM (SELECT CPE_MRN CIS_MRN, STRIP(CL_LAST_NAME)||', '||STRIP(CL_FIRST_NAME) PT_NAME, CPE_ENC_DTE VST_DATE , VD.CLD_CLD_CENTER , VD.CLD_DEPT_NAME DEPT_NAME , CPE_APPT_DT APPT_DT , TIME(CPE_APPT_DT) APPT_TIME, CPE_APPT_MADE_DTE APPT_MADE_DTE , VT.CRE_RES_NAME VST_RESOURCE, REF.CRE_RES_NAME REF_MD, REFD.CLD_DEPT_NAME REF_DEPT_NAME, CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR VST_ABBR, CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME VST_NAME , CVT_EXT_NAME VST_TYPE, CHMNAME.CCH_CHEMO_NAME AS DRUG, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CPE_MRN ORDER BY CPE_APPT_DT) RN FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER ENC JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID = CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT VD ON CPE_DEPT_ID = VD.CLD_DEPT_ID AND VD.CLD_CLD_CENTER = 'KOCH' JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE VT ON VT.CRE_RES_ID = CPE_VST_RES_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE REF ON REF.CRE_RES_ID = CPE_REF_RES_ID AND REF.CRE_RES_TYP IN ('Physician', 'Dentist', 'Psychologist', 'PhD', 'Nurse Practitioner', 'Physician Assistant', 'Advanced Practice Nurse') JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT REFD ON CPE_REF_DEP_ID= REFD.CLD_DEPT_ID AND REFD.CLD_DEPT_NAME LIKE 'ST HN KOCH%' LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_PT_APPT ON CPE_CL_PT_ID = CPA_CL_PT_ID AND CPE_ENC_DTE_SEQ = CPA_ENC_DTE_SEQ AND CPA_LINE_NO = 2 LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT SD ON CPA_DEPT_ID = SD.CLD_DEPT_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE SR ON SR.CRE_RES_ID = CPE_VST_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_PT_CHEMO CHM ON ENC.CPE_CL_PT_ID = CHM.CPC_CL_PT_ID AND ENC.CPE_ENC_DTE_SEQ = CHM.CPC_ENC_DTE_SEQ JOIN IDB.CL_CHEMO CHMNAME ON CHM.CPC_CHEMO_ID = CHMNAME.CCH_CHEMO_ID AND CHMNAME.CCH_CHEMO_NAME LIKE '%CISPLATIN%' JOIN IDB.CL_PATIENT PAT ON ENC.CPE_MRN = PAT.CL_MRN WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN('Sch') AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT DATE AND CURRENT DATE + 21 DAY ) AS A WHERE RN = 1 ), COMP_CIS AS (SELECT CIS_MRN AS CMP_MRN, VST_DATE LAST_CIS_DTE FROM (SELECT CPE_MRN CIS_MRN, CPE_ENC_DTE VST_DATE , VD.CLD_CLD_CENTER, VD.CLD_DEPT_NAME DEPT_NAME , CPE_APPT_DT APPT_DT , VT.CRE_RES_NAME VST_RESOURCE, CHMNAME.CCH_CHEMO_NAME AS DRUG, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CPE_MRN ORDER BY CPE_APPT_DT DESC) RN FROM SCH_CIS JOIN IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER ENC ON CIS_MRN = CPE_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT VD ON CPE_DEPT_ID = VD.CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE VT ON VT.CRE_RES_ID = CPE_VST_RES_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_PT_APPT ON CPE_CL_PT_ID = CPA_CL_PT_ID AND CPE_ENC_DTE_SEQ = CPA_ENC_DTE_SEQ AND CPA_LINE_NO = 2 LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT SD ON CPA_DEPT_ID = SD.CLD_DEPT_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE SR ON SR.CRE_RES_ID = CPE_VST_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_PT_CHEMO CHM ON ENC.CPE_CL_PT_ID = CHM.CPC_CL_PT_ID AND ENC.CPE_ENC_DTE_SEQ = CHM.CPC_ENC_DTE_SEQ JOIN IDB.CL_CHEMO CHMNAME ON CHM.CPC_CHEMO_ID = CHMNAME.CCH_CHEMO_ID AND CHMNAME.CCH_CHEMO_NAME LIKE '%CISPLATIN%' AND CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Comp', 'Arrived') AND CPE_ENC_TYP_CD = 50) AS A WHERE RN = 1 ) SELECT NV_MRN MRN, PT_NAME, VST_DATE , CLD_CLD_CENTER VISIT_CENTER, DEPT_NAME , APPT_DT, APPT_TIME, VST_RESOURCE, VST_NAME, VST_TYPE, '' AS DRUG, 'NEW VISIT' AS PT_TYPE FROM ETO UNION SELECT CIS_MRN MRN, PT_NAME, VST_DATE, CLD_CLD_CENTER VISIT_CENTER, DEPT_NAME , APPT_DT, APPT_TIME, REF_MD AS VST_RESOURCE, VST_NAME, VST_TYPE, DRUG, 'FIRST CISPLATIN' AS PT_TYPE FROM SCH_CIS LEFT JOIN COMP_CIS ON CMP_MRN = CIS_MRN WHERE CMP_MRN IS NULL

prompt: Provide a report similar to NRS6795 of protocol patients for the entire month of October 2013 for the specified services.
completion: WITH TASK AS (SELECT OO_MRN MRN, OO_ORD_ID ORDID , OO_ORD_GUID ORDGUID , STRIP(PT_LAST_NAME)||', '||PT_FIRST_NAME PT_NAME , OO_SET_NAME SET_NAME , OO_ORD_NAME ORD_NAME, OO_SUMMARY_LINE , OS_SVC_GRP_CD SVC, OS_SVC_DESC AS SVC_DESC , OU_DISPLAY_NAME PERFORMED_BY , OO_ORD_TYPE_CD ORD_TYPE , OOTO_ENTERED_DT AS DOCUMENTED_DT , OCV_CURR_LOC CURR_LOC , OUD_USER_DI_CD, OUD_USER_DI_VALUE ORD_INFUSE_OVER , OOTO_TASK_ROUTE_CD , OOTO_STATUS_CD , CASE WHEN OUD_USER_DI_CD LIKE '%(hrs)%' THEN 'HRS' WHEN OUD_USER_DI_CD LIKE '%(min)%' THEN 'MIN' END INFUSE_OVER_MEASURE , DECIMAL(OUD_USER_DI_VALUE) * (CASE WHEN OUD_USER_DI_CD LIKE '%(hrs)%' THEN 60 WHEN OUD_USER_DI_CD LIKE '%(min)%' THEN 1 END) INFUSE_OVER_MIN , OO_ORD_FREQ FROM IDB.OMS_ORDER JOIN IDB.OMS_USER_ORDERS ON OUO_ORD_GUID = OO_ORD_GUID AND OO_ORD_STS_CD NOT IN ('CANC', 'CANP', 'HOLD', 'PEND', 'SCHD') AND UPPER(OO_SET_NAME) LIKE '%IRB%' AND OO_ORD_TYPE_CD = 'Medication' JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PT_MRN = OO_MRN JOIN IDB.OMS_CLIENT_VISIT ON OO_VISIT_GUID = OCV_VISIT_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_SERVICE ON OCV_SVC_GUID = OS_SVC_GUID JOIN IDB.OAS_ORD_TASK_OCCR ON OOTO_ORD_GUID = OO_ORD_GUID AND OOTO_STATUS_CD = 'Performed' AND OOTO_SIGNIFIC_DTE BETWEEN '2013-10-01' AND '2013-10-05' AND OOTO_TASK_ROUTE_CD lIKE 'IV%' JOIN IDB.OAS_CTLG_ITEM_TASK ON OOTO_CAT_ITEM_GUID = OCIT_GUID JOIN IDB.OAS_TASK_TYPE ON OCIT_TASK_TYP_GUID = OTT_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_USER ON OOTO_PER_PVDR_GUID = OU_USER_GUID LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_USER_DATA ON OO_ORD_GUID = OUD_ORD_GUID AND OUD_USER_DI_CD IN('Rx - Chemo IV OVER (hrs)', 'Rx - Chemo IV OVER (min)') WHERE OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE BETWEEN '2013-09-20' AND '2013-10-05' AND OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID IN (SELECT OOC_MSTR_ITEM_GUID FROM IDB.OMS_ORD_CATALOG WHERE OOC_REV_CAT_DEPT ='Chemotherapy' ) ) SELECT MRN, ORDID , ORDGUID , PT_NAME , SET_NAME , ORD_NAME , SVC, SVC_DESC , PERFORMED_BY , ORD_TYPE , DOCUMENTED_DT , CURR_LOC , FREQ , MEASURE , INFUSE_OVER_MIN , ORD_ROUTE , TASK_STS , MOA_START , MOA_END , CASE WHEN DATE(MOA_START) = DATE(MOA_END) THEN (INTEGER((TIME(MOA_END) - TIME(MOA_START))/10000)*60) + (INTEGER (TIME(MOA_END) - TIME(MOA_START)) - (INTEGER((TIME(MOA_END) - TIME(MOA_START))/10000)*10000))/100 WHEN DATE(MOA_START) < DATE(MOA_END) THEN ((INTEGER((TIME('24.00.00') -TIME(MOA_START))/10000)*60) + (INTEGER (TIME('24.00.00') -TIME(MOA_START)) -
