(INTEGER((TIME('24.00.00') -TIME(MOA_START))/10000)*10000))/100) + ((INTEGER((TIME(MOA_END) -TIME('00.00.00'))/10000)*60) + (INTEGER (TIME(MOA_END) -TIME('00.00.00')) - (INTEGER((TIME(MOA_END) -TIME('00.00.00'))/10000)*10000))/100) + CASE WHEN DATE(MOA_START + 2 DAYS) = DATE(MOA_END) THEN 1*(24*60) WHEN DATE(MOA_START + 3 DAYS) = DATE(MOA_END) THEN 2*(24*60) WHEN DATE(MOA_START + 4 DAYS) = DATE(MOA_END) THEN 3*(24*60) WHEN DATE(MOA_START + 5 DAYS) = DATE(MOA_END) THEN 4*(24*60) WHEN DATE(MOA_START + 6 DAYS) = DATE(MOA_END) THEN 5*(24*60) ELSE 0 END ELSE 0 END AS MOA_MINUTES FROM (SELECT MRN, ORDID , ORDGUID , PT_NAME , SET_NAME , ORD_NAME , SVC, SVC_DESC , PERFORMED_BY , ORD_TYPE , DOCUMENTED_DT , CURR_LOC , MAX(OO_ORD_FREQ) FREQ , MAX(INFUSE_OVER_MEASURE) MEASURE , MAX(INFUSE_OVER_MIN) INFUSE_OVER_MIN , MAX(TOCC.OOTO_TASK_ROUTE_CD) AS ORD_ROUTE, MAX(TOCC.OOTO_STATUS_CD) AS TASK_STS, CASE WHEN MAX(TOCC.OOTO_TASK_ROUTE_CD) = 'IVCI' THEN MIN(TOCC.OOTO_PERF_TO_DT) ELSE MIN(TOCC.OOTO_PERF_FROM_DT) END AS MOA_START, VALUE(MAX(CASE WHEN OCIT_TASK_TYP_GUID = '9000001005102870' THEN TOCC.OOTO_PERF_FROM_DT END), MAX(TOCC.OOTO_PERF_TO_DT), MAX(TOCC.OOTO_PERF_FROM_DT)) AS MOA_END FROM TASK JOIN IDB.OAS_ORD_TASK_OCCR TOCC ON TOCC.OOTO_ORD_GUID = ORDGUID AND TOCC.OOTO_MRN = MRN AND TOCC.OOTO_STATUS_CD = 'Performed' JOIN IDB.OAS_CTLG_ITEM_TASK ON TOCC.OOTO_CAT_ITEM_GUID = OCIT_GUID GROUP BY MRN, ORDID , ORDGUID , PT_NAME , SET_NAME , ORD_NAME , SVC, SVC_DESC , PERFORMED_BY , ORD_TYPE , DOCUMENTED_DT , CURR_LOC) AS X WHERE FREQ= 'once'

prompt: Create a cohort with all kidney cancer patients that a BAP1 germline mutation
completion: WITH DX AS (SELECT CC_MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS MIN_ICD_EFF_DTE, CC_CLSF_CD AS ICD_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS ICD_DESC FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE 1=1 AND (SUBSTR(CC_CLSF_CD, 1, 3) IN ('C64') OR CC_CLSF_CD = '189.0') AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' GROUP BY CC_MRN, CC_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK HAVING MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) BETWEEN '1990-01-01' AND '2022-06-16'), PATH AS (SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN , PRPT_ACCESSION_NO , PATH_PROCEDURE_DATE FROM DX JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_STRUCTURED_RESULTS_V ON CC_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE 1=1 AND (GENE = 'BAP1' OR GENE2 = 'BAP1') AND PATH_PROCEDURE_DATE BETWEEN '1990-01-01' AND '2022-06-16' AND CONTAINS("PRPT_REPORT", '("germline" AND "BAP1")') = 1 ) , CLINDOC AS (SELECT CDD_MRN, CDD_DOC_NAME, CDD_SERVICE_DTE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY CDD_MRN ORDER BY CDD_SERVICE_DTE) AS RN, CDD_DOCUMENT_FULL_TEXT FROM DX JOIN DV.CLINDOC_FULL_TEXT_V ON CC_MRN = CDD_MRN WHERE CDD_CANCEL_IND <> '1' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND <> '1' AND CDD_SERVICE_DTE BETWEEN '1990-01-01' AND '2022-06-16' AND (CDD_DOC_NAME like 'Follow Up%' AND (CDD_DOC_NAME like '%DOM%' OR CDD_DOC_NAME like '%Kidney%' OR CDD_DOC_NAME like '%Uro%' OR CDD_DOC_NAME like '%AMB%')) AND CONTAINS(CDD_DOCUMENT_FULL_TEXT, '("germline" AND "BAP1")') = 1 ) SELECT DISTINCT CC_MRN , CDD_DOC_NAME , CDD_SERVICE_DTE FROM DX JOIN CLINDOC ON CC_MRN = CDD_MRN AND RN = 1

prompt: Daily report of COVID positive patient tested outside of MSK within the past day with prior and future appointment data.
completion: WITH PTS AS (SELECT MRN, LAST_NAME, CASE WHEN POSITIVE_SOURCES like '%problem list%' THEN '|' || LISTAGG('problem list: ' || CHAR(TRIM(CPL_PROBLEM_CODE)), '| ') || '|' ELSE 'Not Documented' END AS PROBLEM_LIST_POSITIVE, POSITIVE_SOURCES, NEGATIVE_SOURCES, PENDING_SOURCES, CMHC_EXTERNAL_VISIT_FACILITY, CMHC_HIE_VISIT_TYPE, CMHC_TEST_DT FROM IDB.PATIENT_COVID_INFO_V JOIN (SELECT A.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CMHC_MRN ORDER BY (CMHC_TEST_DT) DESC) AS RN FROM IDB.COVID19_MSK_HIE_CASES A) A ON MRN = CMHC_MRN AND A.RN = 1 LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM IDB.COVID19_PROBLEM_LIST WHERE CPL_PROBLEM_CODE IN ('DROPCOVID-19', 'ACNCOV') AND LOWER(CPL_PROBLEM_STATUS) not like '%entered in error%' ) B ON MRN = CPL_MRN WHERE 1=1 AND RESULT = 'Positive' AND POSITIVE_SOURCES like '%hie%' AND MIN_RESULT_DT >= CURRENT date - 1 DAY GROUP BY MRN, LAST_NAME, CASE WHEN POSITIVE_SOURCES like '%hie%' THEN 'Y' ELSE '' END, POSITIVE_SOURCES, NEGATIVE_SOURCES, PENDING_SOURCES, CMHC_EXTERNAL_VISIT_FACILITY, CMHC_HIE_VISIT_TYPE, CMHC_TEST_DT) , LAST_VISIT AS (SELECT CPE_MRN, CPE_ENC_DTE, CPE_APPT_DT, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8, CLD_DEPT_NAME, CLD_CLD_CENTER, CRE_RES_NAME, CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CPE_MRN ORDER BY (CPE_APPT_DT) DESC) AS RN FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID JOIN PTS ON MRN = CPE_MRN WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CPE_ENC_DTE >= CURRENT date - 2 YEARS ) , NEXT_VISIT AS (SELECT CPE_MRN, CPE_ENC_DTE, CPE_APPT_DT, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8, CLD_DEPT_NAME, CLD_CLD_CENTER, CRE_RES_NAME, CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CPE_MRN ORDER BY (CPE_APPT_DT) ASC) AS RN FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID JOIN PTS ON MRN = CPE_MRN WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Sch') AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT date AND CURRENT date + 1 YEAR ) SELECT MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, YEAR(CURRENT date - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) AS CURRENT_AGE, PROBLEM_LIST_POSITIVE PROBLEM_LIST, POSITIVE_SOURCES COVID_POSITIVE_SOURCES, CMHC_EXTERNAL_VISIT_FACILITY HIE_EXTERNAL_VISIT_FACILITY, CMHC_HIE_VISIT_TYPE HIE_VISIT_TYPE, CMHC_TEST_DT HIE_TEST_DT, A.CPE_ENC_DTE LAST_VISIT_DTE, A.CLD_CLD_CENTER LAST_VISIT_CENTER, A.CLD_DEPT_NAME LAST_VISIT_DEPT, A.CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME LAST_VISIT_TYP, B.CPE_ENC_DTE NEXT_VISIT_DTE, B.CLD_CLD_CENTER NEXT_VISIT_CENTER, B.CLD_DEPT_NAME NEXT_VISIT_DEPT, B.CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME NEXT_VISIT_TYP FROM PTS LEFT JOIN LAST_VISIT A ON MRN = A.CPE_MRN AND A.RN = 1 LEFT JOIN NEXT_VISIT B ON MRN = B.CPE_MRN AND B.RN = 1 LEFT JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON MRN = PT_MRN ORDER BY CMHC_TEST_DT ;

prompt: I am looking for a way to join from EMAR administered drugs to the IDB.SRX_GENERIC_ITEM table. Can someone provide guidance on how to achieve this. Marina & Galina maybe able to assist in this effort.
completion: SELECT DISTINCT OOTO_GUID, OOTO_MRN, OO_VISIT_GUID, OO_ORD_GUID, OOTO_SIGNIFIC_DTE AS ADMIN_DATE, OOTO_SIGNIFIC_DT AS ADMIN_DT, OOC_ITEM_NAME AS DRUG_NAME, SGI_GI_NAME GENERIC_DRUG_NAME, OOTO_TASK_DOSE, OOTO_TASK_UOM, OOTO_TASK_ROUTE_CD, OOC_REV_CAT_DEPT AS REVIEW_CATEGORY FROM IDB.OAS_ORD_TASK_OCCR SO JOIN IDB.OAS_CTLG_ITEM_TASK ON OOTO_CAT_ITEM_GUID = OCIT_GUID AND OCIT_LEVEL_NO = 0 AND OOTO_STATUS_CD = 'Performed' JOIN IDB.OMS_USER USR ON OOTO_PER_PVDR_GUID = OU_USER_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_CATALOG ON OCIT_MST_ITEM_GUID = OOC_MSTR_ITEM_GUID AND OOC_REV_CAT_DEPT IN ('Chemotherapy', 'Pharmacy', 'IV Fluids', 'TPN') JOIN IDB.OMS_MED_DETAIL ON OMD_ORD_GUID = OOTO_ORD_GUID AND OMD_ORD_ROUTE NOT IN ('oral') JOIN IDB.OMS_ORDER ON OO_ORD_GUID = OOTO_ORD_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_CLIENT_VISIT ON OO_VISIT_GUID = OCV_VISIT_GUID LEFT JOIN IDB.SRX_ORD_TASK_OCCR_ADM ON SOTOA_ORD_TASK_OCCR_GUID = SO.OOTO_GUID LEFT JOIN IDB.SRX_ORDER ON SO_ORD_GUID = OO_ORD_GUID AND SOTOA_ORD_TASK_OCCR_GUID IS NULL LEFT JOIN IDB.SRX_BILLED_TRANSACTION ON SO.OOTO_GUID = SBT_ORD_TASK_OCCR_GUID AND SBT_ORD_ID = SO_ORD_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.SRX_STOCK_ITEM_PRODUCT ON SSIP_STOCK_ITEM_PROD_ID = SBT_STOCK_ITEM_PROD_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.SRX_PRODUCT ON SNP_PROD_ID = COALESCE(SOTOA_PROD_ID, SSIP_PROD_ID) LEFT JOIN IDB.SRX_PRODUCT_PACKAGE ON SNP_PROD_ID = SPP_PROD_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.SRX_GENERIC_ITEM ON SNP_GI_ID = SGI_GI_ID WHERE 1 = 1 AND OOTO_SIGNIFIC_DTE >= DATE('2024-03-01')

prompt: Provide a bi-weekly list of breast cancer patients scheduled for NV1, NV3 or IR appointments in the upcoming two weeks who do not have metastatic disease.
completion: WITH CTE AS (SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN AS "CTE_MRN", DT_DTE AS "DT_DTE", DEPT.EDC_DEPT_DESC AS "dept.EDC_DEPT_DESC", SVC.EDC_DEPT_DESC AS "svc.EDC_DEPT_DESC", ENDP_DEPT_NAME AS "ENDP_DEPT_NAME", ENR_RES_NAME AS "ENR_RES_NAME", ENVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME AS "ENVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME", ENVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR AS "ENVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR", PT_LAST_NAME AS "PT_LAST_NAME", PT_FIRST_NAME AS "PT_FIRST_NAME" FROM DV.PATIENT_ENCOUNTER JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PENC_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID JOIN DV.DATE ON PENC_ENC_DATE_ID = DT_DATE_ID LEFT JOIN DV.ENCOUNTER_DESC_CATALOG STS ON PENC_APPT_STS = STS.EDC_DEPT_ABBREV AND STS.EDC_GROUP_ID = 'STS' JOIN DV.ENCOUNTER_DEPARTMENT ON PENC_DEPT_ID = ENDP_ENC_DEPT_ID JOIN DV.ENCOUNTER_SCHD_RESOURCES ON PENC_PT_ENC_ID = ENSR_PT_ENC_ID AND ENSR_PRIMARY_RES_IND = 'Y' JOIN DV.ENCOUNTER_RESOURCE ON ENSR_RES_ID = ENR_ENC_RES_ID JOIN DV.ENCOUNTER_VISIT_TYPE ON PENC_VISIT_TYPE_ID = ENVT_ENC_VISIT_TYPE_ID LEFT JOIN DV.ENCOUNTER_DESC_CATALOG DEPT ON ENDP_SERVICE_DEPT_GRP_6 = DEPT.EDC_DEPT_ABBREV AND DEPT.EDC_GROUP_ID = '6' LEFT JOIN DV.ENCOUNTER_DESC_CATALOG SVC ON ENDP_SERVICE_SPECIALTY_GRP_8 = SVC.EDC_DEPT_ABBREV AND SVC.EDC_GROUP_ID = '8' JOIN DV.PATIENT_DIAGNOSIS_FINAL_ALL_V ON PDX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID JOIN DV.DIAGNOSIS_CATALOG ON PDX_DX_CATALOG_ID = DXCC_DX_CATALOG_ID WHERE PENC_APPT_STS IN ('Sch') AND (ENVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR = 'NV1' OR ENVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR = 'NV3' OR ENVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR = 'IR') AND DT_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT date + 0 DAYS AND CURRENT date + 14 DAYS AND DXCC_ICD_CODE LIKE 'C50%' ORDER BY PT_MRN, DT_DTE) , CTE2 AS (SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN AS "CTE2_MRN" FROM DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS JOIN DV.PATIENT_DIAGNOSIS_FINAL_ALL_V ON PDX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID JOIN DV.DIAGNOSIS_CATALOG ON PDX_DX_CATALOG_ID = DXCC_DX_CATALOG_ID JOIN CTE ON PT_MRN = CTE_MRN WHERE DXCC_ICD_CODE LIKE 'C77%' OR DXCC_ICD_CODE LIKE 'C78%' OR DXCC_ICD_CODE LIKE 'C79%' ) SELECT DISTINCT CTE_MRN AS "MRN", CTE.DT_DTE AS "Visit Date", CTE.ENR_RES_NAME AS "Primary Resource Name", CTE.PT_FIRST_NAME AS "First Name", CTE.PT_LAST_NAME AS "Last Name" FROM CTE WHERE CTE_MRN NOT IN (SELECT CTE2_MRN FROM CTE2) ORDER BY 2, 1

prompt: Provide the total number of patients seen by Dr. Jewell in the last two years with a diagnosis of Gestational Trophoblastic Disease.
completion: SELECT DISTINCT MRN, LAST_NAME, FIRST_NAME , CC_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK FROM (SELECT DISTINCT CRE_RES_NAME AS DOC, CLD_DEPT_NAME AS DEPT, CPE_MRN AS MRN , CPE_ENC_DTE AS date, CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME AS VT, CC_CLSF_CD AS ICD9, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS DESC , PT_LAST_NAME AS LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME AS FIRST_NAME FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CRE_RES_ID = CPE_VST_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PT_MRN = CPE_MRN JOIN IDB.CTC_CLSF ON CPE_MRN = CC_MRN AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND CC_CLSF_CD IN ('236.1') AND (CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) JOIN IDB.CLM ON CLM_CLSF_CD = CC_CLSF_CD WHERE CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN '2008-08-01' AND '2010-08-31' AND CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CPE_VST_RES_ID = '015164' ) AS X JOIN IDB.CTC_CLSF ON MRN = CC_MRN AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND CC_CLSF_CD BETWEEN '143.0' AND '239.9' AND NOT CC_CLSF_CD BETWEEN '196' AND '199.9' AND (CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) JOIN IDB.CLM ON CLM_CLSF_CD = CC_CLSF_CD

prompt: Report that gets data for patients receiving Touch and Music Therapy orders for the past 30 days. For that group of patients, it then checks for relevant Cadence appointment types: IM1275 MUSIC THERAPY FR-IP, IM1275 MUSIC THERAPY NV-IP, IM1275 MUSIC THRPY RE-ADMIT-IP, IM1275 ACUPUNCTURE FR-IP, IM1275 ACUPUNCTURE NV-IP, IM1275 ACUPUNCTURE RE-ADMIT-IP, IM1275 MASSAGE FR-IP, IM1275 MASSAGE NV-IP, IM1275 MASSAGE RE-ADMIT-IP, IM1275 REIKI FR-IP, IM1275 REIKI NV-IP, IM1275 REIKI RE-ADMIT-IP that took place within the last 30 days or scheduled 7 days in the future with patients that have a length of stay >= 14 days.
completion: WITH PTS AS (SELECT DISTINCT OO_MRN FROM IDB.OMS_ORDER WHERE OO_ENTER_DTE > CURRENT date - 30 DAYS AND OO_ORD_NAME IN ('Integrative Medicine Inpatient Consult', 'Nursing Referral Integrative Medicine Inpt') AND (OO_SUMMARY_LINE like '%Touch Therapy%' OR OO_SUMMARY_LINE like '%Music Therapy%') ) SELECT DISTINCT PT_LAST_NAME "Patient Last Name", PT_FIRST_NAME "Patient First Name", VARCHAR_FORMAT(VIS_ADM_DTE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS "Admit Date", VARCHAR_FORMAT(CPE_ENC_DTE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS "Appointment Date", CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME AS "Appointment Type", VIS_BED AS "Patient Location", VIS_DAYS_STAY AS "Days Stay", VIS_DSCH_DTE "Discharged Date" FROM PTS JOIN IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER ON OO_MRN=CPE_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID JOIN IDB.VISIT ON VIS_MRN = CPE_MRN AND (VIS_DSCH_DTE IS NULL OR CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN VIS_ADM_DTE AND VIS_DSCH_DTE) JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PT_MRN = CPE_MRN WHERE VIS_IP_OP_ADJUSTED_IND = 'I' AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT date - 30 DAYS AND CURRENT date + 7 DAYS AND CLD_DEPT_NAME = 'INTEG MED 1275' AND CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME IN ('IM1275 MUSIC THERAPY FR-IP', 'IM1275 MUSIC THERAPY NV-IP', 'IM1275 MUSIC THRPY RE-ADMIT-IP', 'IM1275 ACUPUNCTURE FR-IP', 'IM1275 ACUPUNCTURE NV-IP', 'IM1275 ACUPUNCTURE RE-ADMIT-IP', 'IM1275 MASSAGE FR-IP', 'IM1275 MASSAGE NV-IP', 'IM1275 MASSAGE RE-ADMIT-IP', 'IM1275 REIKI FR-IP', 'IM1275 REIKI NV-IP', 'IM1275 REIKI RE-ADMIT-IP') AND VIS_DAYS_STAY >= 14 ORDER BY 1, 2, 3, 4

prompt: Provide the number of visits for patients accrued to specific protocols
completion: WITH DTS AS (SELECT DISTINCT SUBSTR(CHAR(CPE_ENC_DTE), 1, 7) MNTH FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER WHERE CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN '2018-01-01' AND CURRENT date - 1 DAY ) SELECT ACD_IRB_NO IRB, MNTH, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN (MNTH >= SUBSTR(CHAR(ACD_TX_ST_DTE), 1, 7) AND MNTH < SUBSTR(CHAR(COALESCE(ACD_TX_END_DTE, '2999-12-31')), 1, 7)) THEN ACD_MRN END) "Patients on Protocol" FROM DTS LEFT JOIN IDB.ACCRUALS_DATES ON 1=1 WHERE ACD_TX_ST_DTE >= '2018-01-01' AND ACD_IRB_NO IN ('05-080', '08-121', '10-216', '11-107', '12-018', '12-130', '13-006', '13-064', '14-055', '14-105', '14-144', '14-206', '14-274', '15-129', '15-168', '15-294', '15-310', '15-326', '16-1662', '17-284', '17-324', '17-352', '17-569', '17-622', '18-046', '18-048', '18-077', '18-117', '18-220', '18-274', '18-353', '18-396', '18-421', '19-088', '19-210', '19-212', '19-258', '19-266', '19-284', '19-324', '19-334', '19-339', '19-422', '19-446', '20-074', '20-084') GROUP BY ACD_IRB_NO, MNTH ORDER BY 1, 2 ; SELECT AC_IRB_NO IRB, SUBSTR(CHAR(CPE_ENC_DTE), 1, 7) AS "Appt Month", CLD_DEPT_NAME AS "Department Name", CRE_RES_NAME AS "Provider Name", CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME AS "Visit Type", COUNT(DISTINCT CPE_MRN) "Patient Count", COUNT(DISTINCT CPE_ENC_CSN_ID) "Visit Count" FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID JOIN IDB.ACCRUALS ON CPE_MRN = AC_MRN WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CRE_RES_TYP IN ('Physician', 'Registered Nurse', 'Advanced Practice Nurse', 'Nurse Practitioner') AND CPE_ENC_DTE >= '2018-01-01' AND (CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 = 'MYL' OR CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_1 IN ('Reg', 'REG')) AND AC_IRB_NO IN ('05-080', '08-121', '10-216', '11-107', '12-018', '12-130', '13-006', '13-064', '14-055', '14-105', '14-144', '14-206', '14-274', '15-129', '15-168', '15-294', '15-310', '15-326', '16-1662', '17-284', '17-324', '17-352', '17-569', '17-622', '18-046', '18-048', '18-077', '18-117', '18-220', '18-274', '18-353', '18-396', '18-421', '19-088', '19-210', '19-212', '19-258', '19-266', '19-284', '19-324', '19-334', '19-339', '19-422', '19-446', '20-074', '20-084') GROUP BY AC_IRB_NO, SUBSTR(CHAR(CPE_ENC_DTE), 1, 7), CLD_DEPT_NAME, CRE_RES_NAME, CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME ORDER BY 1, 2

prompt: Identify patients and frequency of Urology Attendings sending their patients to the UCC.
completion: SELECT OO_MRN MRN, STRIP(PT_LAST_NAME)||', '||STRIP(PT_FIRST_NAME) PT_MANE , OO_ENTER_DTE ENTER_DATE, OO_ORD_NAME ORD_NAME, OP_DISPLAY_NAME PHYSICIAN , STRIP(OO_ORD_STS_CD)||'-'||STRIP(OSTS_STS_DESC) ORD_STATUS , OO_SUMMARY_LINE AS PRIMARY_DX, OUD_USER_DI_VALUE AS UCC_REF_REASON FROM IDB.OMS_ORDER JOIN IDB.OMS_PROVIDER ON OO_PVDR_GUID = OP_PVDR_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_STATUS ON OSTS_ORD_STS_CD = OO_ORD_STS_CD JOIN IDB.DOC ON OP_PVDR_NO = DOC_DR_NO AND DOC_SVC = 'URO' JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PT_MRN = OO_MRN JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_USER_DATA ON OUD_ORD_GUID = OO_ORD_GUID AND OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'UCC Referral Reason' WHERE OO_ENTER_DTE BETWEEN '2008-01-01' AND '2009-12-31' AND OO_ORD_NAME = 'UCC Notification' AND OO_ORD_TYPE_CD = 'Other' AND OO_ORD_STS_CD NOT IN ('CANC', 'CANP')

prompt: Provide data on patients diagnosed with penile cancer.
completion: WITH PTS AS (SELECT DISTINCT TM_MRN FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('3', '6', '7', '8') AND TM_SITE_CD IN ('C601', 'C602', 'C608', 'C609') ) SELECT PA_MRN AS MRN, CDM_SVC_CD AS SVC_CD, CDM_SVC_DESC AS SVC_DESC, SVC_DTE, 'Hospital Charge' AS SOURCE FROM (SELECT HXD_MRN AS PA_MRN, CDM_SVC_CD, CDM_SVC_DESC, HXD_SVC_DTE AS SVC_DTE FROM PTS JOIN IDB.HX_PA_DETAIL ON TM_MRN = HXD_MRN JOIN IDB.CDM ON HXD_SVC_CD = CDM_SVC_CD WHERE HXD_DTL_TYPE = 'C' AND CDM_DPT_CD IN ('4', '10', '16', '28', '50', '51', '91') GROUP BY HXD_MRN, CDM_SVC_CD, CDM_SVC_DESC, HXD_SVC_DTE HAVING SUM(HXD_SVC_QTY) > 0 UNION ALL SELECT DTL_MRN AS PA_MRN, CDM_SVC_CD, CDM_SVC_DESC, DTL_SVC_DTE AS SVC_DTE FROM PTS JOIN IDB.PA_DETAIL ON TM_MRN = DTL_MRN JOIN IDB.CDM ON DTL_SVC_CD = CDM_SVC_CD WHERE DTL_DTL_TYPE = 'C' AND CDM_DPT_CD IN ('4', '10', '16', '28', '50', '51', '91') GROUP BY DTL_MRN, CDM_SVC_CD, CDM_SVC_DESC, DTL_SVC_DTE HAVING SUM(DTL_SVC_QTY) > 0) AS A UNION ALL SELECT PBD_MRN AS MRN, CLM_CLSF_CD AS SVC_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SVC_DESC, PBD_SVC_DTE AS SVC_DTE, 'Physician Billing' AS SOURCE FROM PTS JOIN IDB.PBD_DTL ON TM_MRN = PBD_MRN JOIN IDB.PBD_CODE ON PBD_PBD_CD = PBC_PBD_CD LEFT JOIN IDB.CLM ON PBC_CPT_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE PBC_CPT_CD LIKE '7%'

prompt: Total CPET (cardiopulmonary exercise test) volume for the year 2023 across all sites based on Date of Service and Referring MD on CIS order
completion: WITH CPET_ORDERS AS (SELECT DISTINCT OP_DISPLAY_NAME, OO_ORD_NAME, OO_ORD_ID, OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE, OO_MRN FROM IDB.OMS_ORDER JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_USER_DATA U ON OUD_ORD_GUID = OO_ORD_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_CATALOG OC ON OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID = OOC_MSTR_ITEM_GUID AND OO_ORD_GUID = U.OUD_ORD_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_PROVIDER ON OO_PVDR_GUID = OP_PVDR_GUID AND LOWER(OO_ORD_NAME) LIKE '%cpet%' AND OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE >= '2023-01-01' AND OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE <= '2023-12-31' AND OO_ORD_STS_CD NOT IN ('CANP', 'CANC', 'AUC3') UNION SELECT DISTINCT OP_DISPLAY_NAME, OO_ORD_NAME, OO_ORD_ID, OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE, OO_MRN FROM IDB.OMS_ORDER JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_USER_DATA U ON OUD_ORD_GUID = OO_ORD_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_CATALOG OC ON OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID = OOC_MSTR_ITEM_GUID AND OO_ORD_GUID = U.OUD_ORD_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_PROVIDER ON OO_PVDR_GUID = OP_PVDR_GUID AND OO_ORD_NAME = 'Outside Referral' AND OUD_USER_DI_VALUE = 'CPET' AND OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE >= '2023-01-01' AND OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE <= '2023-12-31' AND OO_ORD_STS_CD NOT IN ('CANP', 'CANC', 'AUC3')) SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT OO_ORD_ID) "Count of Orders", OP_DISPLAY_NAME "MD Name", OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE "Service Date" FROM CPET_ORDERS GROUP BY OP_DISPLAY_NAME, OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE ORDER BY OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE ASC

prompt: Create a Darwin cohort of patients who have received specified immunotherapy drugs to allow requester to conduct identified Darwin ad-hoc queries.
completion: WITH DEID AS (SELECT DISTINCT PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID AS P_ID FROM IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON APR_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE APR_GENERIC_NAME IN ('IPILIMUMAB', 'NIVOLUMAB', 'PEMBROLIZUMAB', 'AVELUMAB', 'DURVALUMAB', 'ATEZOLIZUMAB', 'TREMELIMUMAB', 'CEMIPLIMAB') )

prompt: A list of patients who had been seen at MSK by any Neurologist in the past 3 years and also has been diagnosed with primary CNS Lymphoma during the same period.
completion: WITH PATIENT_COHORT AS (SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN, MIN_ICD9_EFF_DTE FROM IDB.PATIENT LEFT JOIN (SELECT CC_MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS MIN_ICD9_EFF_DTE, CC_CLSF_CD AS ICD9_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS ICD9_DESC FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE CC_CLSF_CD IN ('202.80', 'C85.89') AND CASE WHEN CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y' AND CC_PT_TYPE <> 'E' THEN 'Y' WHEN CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' AND YEAR(CC_EFF_DTE) < 2004 THEN 'Y' WHEN CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND YEAR(CC_EFF_DTE) < 2001 THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END = 'Y' GROUP BY CC_MRN, CC_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK HAVING MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) > CURRENT DATE - 3 YEARS) AS ICD9 ON CC_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE CC_MRN IS NOT NULL), NEURO_APPOINTMENTS AS (SELECT CPE_MRN AS "MRN", CPE_ENC_DTE AS "Appt Date", CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 AS "Department", CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 AS "Service", CLD_DEPT_NAME AS "Department Name", CRE_RES_NAME AS "Provider Name", CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME AS "Visit Type", CVT_EXT_NAME AS "Visit Type External", CRE_RES_TYP FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID LEFT JOIN PATIENT_COHORT ON CPE_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CRE_RES_TYP = 'Physician' AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 = 'NEU' AND CPE_ENC_DTE > CURRENT DATE - 3 YEARS ) SELECT DISTINCT PC.*, PDV.PT_FIRST_NAME, PDV.PT_LAST_NAME, PDV.PT_SEX, PDV.RACE, PDV.ETHNICITY FROM PATIENT_COHORT PC LEFT JOIN IDB.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V PDV ON PC.PT_MRN = PDV.PT_MRN LEFT JOIN NEURO_APPOINTMENTS NAPP ON PC.PT_MRN = NAPP.MRN

prompt: Provide a list of CLL patients who were diagnosed on or after 1/1/2012, at the age of 18 or older, and were treated with chemotherapy or immunotherapy after 2/12/2014.
completion: WITH CLL AS (SELECT TM_MRN AS MRN, TM_DX_DTE AS DX_DATE, TM_HIST_CD AS DX_CODE, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS DX_DESC FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.SEERGROUPING ON RECODE = IDB.SEERF_ICDO(TM_SITE_CD, TM_HIST_CD) AND CATEGORY3 IN ('Chronic Lymphocytic Leukemia') JOIN IDB.CLM H ON TM_HIST_CD = H.CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON TM_SITE_CD = S.CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') UNION SELECT CC_MRN AS MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS DX_DATE, CLM_CLSF_CD AS DX_CODE, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS DX_DESC FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND ((CC_PT_TYPE = 'I') OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) AND CC_CLSF_CD IN ('C91.1', 'C91.10', 'C91.11', 'C91.12', '204.1', '204.10', '204.11', '204.12') GROUP BY CC_MRN, CLM_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK ) , X AS (SELECT MRN, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH AS DOB, DX_DATE, YEAR(DX_DATE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) AS DX_AGE, DX_CODE, DX_DESC FROM CLL JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON MRN = PT_MRN WHERE YEAR(DX_DATE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) >= 18 AND DX_DATE >= '2012-01-01' ) , CTE AS (SELECT MRN AS DX_MRN, DX_DATE, STRIP(DX_CODE) || '-' || STRIP(DX_DESC) AS DX_CODE FROM X) , CTE2 AS (SELECT * FROM CTE ORDER BY DX_MRN, DX_DATE, DX_CODE) , T1 AS (SELECT DX_MRN, DX_DATE, DX_CODE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY DX_MRN ORDER BY DX_DATE) AS RN FROM CTE2 ORDER BY DX_MRN, DX_DATE) , T2 (MRN, DX, RN1) AS (SELECT DX_MRN, CAST(DX_DATE AS VARCHAR(6000))||' | '||CAST(DX_CODE AS VARCHAR(100)), RN FROM T1 WHERE T1.RN = 1 UNION ALL SELECT DX_MRN, RTRIM(CAST(DX AS VARCHAR(4000))) || ', ' || CHR(13) || CHR(10) || CAST(DX_DATE AS VARCHAR(100))||' | '||RTRIM(CAST(DX_CODE AS VARCHAR(100))) , RN1 + 1 FROM T1, T2 WHERE DX_MRN = MRN AND RN = RN1+1 ) , T3 AS (SELECT MRN, MAX(RN1) RN FROM T2 GROUP BY MRN) , T4 AS (SELECT T2.MRN, RN, DX FROM T2 JOIN T3 ON T2.MRN = T3.MRN AND T2.RN1 = T3.RN) , Y AS (SELECT DISTINCT X.MRN, DOB, DX FROM X JOIN T4 ON X.MRN = T4.MRN) , Z AS (SELECT DISTINCT Y.*, APR_GENERIC_NAME, APR_DRUG_NAME, APR_START_DTE, APR_END_DTE, APR_ORD_RX_TYPE, CDG_CHEMO_FLAG, CDG_IMMUNOTHERAPY_FLAG FROM Y JOIN IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX_V ON MRN = APR_MRN WHERE 1=1 AND(CDG_CHEMO_FLAG = 'Y' OR CDG_IMMUNOTHERAPY_FLAG = 'Y') AND APR_START_DTE > '2014-02-12' ) , CPE AS (SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN, CPE_ENC_DTE, CRE_RES_NAME, CRE_RES_TYP, CLD_DEPT_NAME, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8, CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CPE_MRN ORDER BY CPE_ENC_DTE DESC) AS RN FROM Z JOIN IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER ON CPE_MRN = MRN JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 = 'LEU' AND CRE_RES_TYP IN ('Physician') ) SELECT DISTINCT Z.*, CRE_RES_NAME FROM Z LEFT JOIN CPE ON CPE_MRN = MRN AND RN = 1

prompt: Provide monthly list of all patients charted on by dietitian in inpatient and outpatient pediatrics.
completion: SELECT DISTINCT CDD_MRN, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_LAST_NAME, CDD_SERVICE_DTE DOCUMENT_DATE , NRL.CDO_VALUE_TEXT RISK_LEVEL , CASE WHEN F.VIS_IP_OP_ADJUSTED_IND = 'I' THEN 'INPATIENT' ELSE 'OUTPATIENT' END AS LOCATION, CASE TRIM(OUD_USER_DI_VALUE) WHEN 'Peds BMT' THEN 'Peds BMT' WHEN 'Peds Leukemia / Lymphoma' THEN 'Peds Leukemia / Lymphoma' WHEN 'Peds Neuro - Oncology' THEN 'Peds Neuro - Oncology' WHEN 'Peds Neuro - Surgery' THEN 'Peds Neuro - Surgery' WHEN 'Peds Neuroblastoma' THEN 'Peds Neuroblastoma' WHEN 'Peds Sarcoma' THEN 'Peds Sarcoma' END PRIMARY_SERVICE FROM IDB.CD_DOCUMENT LEFT JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION NRL ON CDD_DOC_GUID = NRL.CDO_DOC_GUID AND CDD_MRN = NRL.CDO_MRN AND NRL.CDO_ITEM_NAME = 'Nutrition Risk Level' JOIN IDB.OMS_USER U1 ON CDD_AUTH_PROV_GUID = U1.OU_USER_GUID LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_USER_DATA OUD ON CDD_MRN = OUD.OUD_MRN AND UPPER(OUD_USER_DI_CD) IN ('PEDSCREENING_SERVICE') JOIN IDB.PATIENT P ON CDD_MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.VISIT_V F ON CDD_MRN = F.VIS_MRN AND CDD_SERVICE_DTE BETWEEN F.VIS_ADM_DTE AND F.VIS_DSCH_DTE AND F.VIS_IP_OP_ADJUSTED_IND = 'I' WHERE OU_DISPLAY_NAME IN ('Husby, Hannah', 'Gilfillan, Erin', 'Hoffman, Kate') AND CDD_SERVICE_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT DATE - 1 MONTH AND CURRENT date AND CDD_DOC_NAME IN ('Assessment, Pediatric - Nutrition')

prompt: Provide report of all patients from 2010 - present for whom a breast transition note (doc type KB8) was submitted and then who  had a subsequent appointment with either a Breast medical oncologist, Breast surgeon, or one of the Breast Survivorship Nurse Practitioners .
completion: WITH PTS AS (SELECT EPD_MRN MRN, STRIP(PT_LAST_NAME)||', '||STRIP(PT_FIRST_NAME) AS PT_NAME , DOC_DR_NO MD_NUM , DOC_NAME MD_NAME, DOC_SVC MD_SVC, DOC_ACDMC_DPT MD_DEPT , EPD_DOCTYPE DOCTYPE, EMD_EMR_DESC DOCUMENT , EPD_DOC_DTE DOC_DTE, EPD_CREATE_DTE, EPD_VIEW_LEVEL FROM IDB.EMR_PT_DOCUMENT JOIN IDB.EMR_PT_DOCTYPE ON EPD_DOCTYPE = EMD_DOCTYPE JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON EPD_MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.DOC ON STRIP(EPD_DOCTOR_NUM) = DOC_DR_NO WHERE EPD_DOC_DTE >= '2010-01-01' AND EPD_DOCTYPE = 'KB8' AND EPD_VIEW_LEVEL = 20 ), VST AS (SELECT MRN, PT_NAME , CPE_ENC_DTE VST_DTE, CLD_DEPT_NAME VST_DEPT_NAME , DOC_NAME VST_MD, DOC_SVC VST_SVC, CVT_EXT_NAME VST_NAME, CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME VST_TYPE FROM PTS JOIN IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER ON MRN = CPE_MRN AND CPE_ENC_DTE > DOC_DTE AND CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.DOC ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = DOC_DR_NO AND DOC_SVC IN ('BRE', 'BRM') JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID) SELECT DISTINCT PTS.MRN, PTS.PT_NAME , PTS.MD_NAME, PTS.MD_SVC, PTS.MD_DEPT , PTS.DOCTYPE, PTS.DOCUMENT, PTS.DOC_DTE , VST.VST_DTE, VST.VST_DEPT_NAME, VST.VST_MD , VST.VST_SVC, VST.VST_NAME, VST.VST_TYPE FROM PTS LEFT JOIN VST ON PTS.MRN = VST.MRN AND PTS.DOC_DTE < VST.VST_DTE ORDER BY 1, 2, 8, 9

prompt: Provide a list of pediatrics calls received during weeknights and weekends
completion: WITH GUID AS (SELECT CDD_DOC_GUID FROM IDB.CD_DOCUMENT JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION ON CDD_MRN = CDO_MRN AND CDD_DOC_GUID = CDO_DOC_GUID AND CDD_AUTHORED_DTE = CDO_AUTHORED_DTE WHERE CDD_CANCEL_IND <> '1' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND <> '1' AND CDD_DOC_NAME = 'Telephone/Electronic Communication - PED' AND CDD_SERVICE_DTE BETWEEN '2022-01-01' AND '2022-06-30' AND LOCATE('Nights/Weekends', CDO_VALUE_TEXT) >= 1 ) SELECT CDD_MRN MRN, PT_LAST_NAME LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME FIRST_NAME, CDD_SERVICE_DTE SERVICE_DATE, CDD_DOC_NAME CLINDOC_NAME, OP_DISPLAY_NAME AUTHORING_PROVIDER, OP_TASK_ROLE_TYPE AUTHORING_PROVIDER_ROLE, DT_DAY_NAME DAY_OF_WEEK, MAX(CASE WHEN CDO_ITEM_NAME = 'Date / Time' THEN TRIM(CDO_VALUE_TEXT) END) "Date / Time", MAX(CASE WHEN CDO_ITEM_NAME = 'Providers' THEN TRIM(CDO_VALUE_TEXT) END) "Providers", MAX(CASE WHEN CDO_ITEM_NAME = 'Pediatric Team' THEN TRIM(CDO_VALUE_TEXT) END) "Pediatric Team", MAX(CASE WHEN CDO_ITEM_NAME = 'Reason for Call' THEN TRIM(CDO_VALUE_TEXT) END) "Reason for Call", MAX(CASE WHEN CDO_ITEM_NAME = 'Reason for Call - Other' THEN TRIM(CDO_VALUE_TEXT) END) "Reason for Call - Other", MAX(CASE WHEN CDO_ITEM_NAME = 'Telephone Disposition' THEN TRIM(CDO_VALUE_TEXT) END) "Telephone Disposition", MAX(CASE WHEN CDO_ITEM_NAME = 'Telephone - Description of Call' THEN TRIM(CDO_VALUE_TEXT) END) "Telephone - Description of Call", MAX(CASE WHEN CDO_ITEM_NAME = 'Telephone Impression/Plan' THEN TRIM(CDO_VALUE_TEXT) END) "Telephone Impression/Plan" FROM GUID JOIN IDB.CD_DOCUMENT CD ON GUID.CDD_DOC_GUID = CD.CDD_DOC_GUID JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION ON CDD_MRN = CDO_MRN AND CD.CDD_DOC_GUID = CDO_DOC_GUID AND CDD_AUTHORED_DTE = CDO_AUTHORED_DTE JOIN IDB.OMS_PROVIDER ON CDD_AUTH_PROV_GUID = OP_PVDR_GUID JOIN DV.DATE_V ON CDD_SERVICE_DTE = DT_DTE JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON CDD_MRN = PT_MRN GROUP BY CDD_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, CDD_SERVICE_DTE, GUID.CDD_DOC_GUID, CDD_DOC_NAME, DT_DAY_NAME, OP_DISPLAY_NAME, OP_TASK_ROLE_TYPE

prompt: Provide a list of patients who had ureteroscopy.
completion: SELECT DISTINCT "t1"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AS "Deident PT #", "t2"."PCC_CODE" AS "CPT Procedure Code (PBD)", "t2"."PCC_DESC" AS "CPT Procedure Desc (PBD)", "t3"."PT_MRN" AS "MRN", "t4"."DT_DTE" AS "CPT Procedure Date (PBD)" FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED" "t1" LEFT JOIN "DV"."CPT_PBD_PATIENT_PROCEDURE" "t2" ON "t1"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t2"."PTX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" "t4" ON "t2"."PTX_PROC_DATE_ID" = "t4"."DT_DATE_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V" "t3" ON "t1"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t3"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" WHERE "t2"."PCC_CODE" IN ('52341', '52342', '52343', '52344', '52345', '52346', '52351', '52352', '52353', '52354', '52355')

prompt: Provide list of metastatic breast cancer patients scheduled for a biopsy in the upcoming week.
completion: WITH PTS AS (SELECT CC_MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS BREAST_DX_DTE, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON CC_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE 1=1 AND SUBSTR(CC_CLSF_CD, 1, 3) IN ('C50', '174', '175') AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' GROUP BY CC_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME) , PRIMARY_MEDONC AS (SELECT CPE_MRN AS PM_MRN , CRE_RES_NAME AS PM_CRE_RES_NAME , COUNT(DISTINCT CPE_ENC_CSN_ID) AS PM_APPT_COUNT , ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY CPE_MRN ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT CPE_ENC_CSN_ID) DESC) AS PM_RN FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN PTS ON CPE_MRN = CC_MRN WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 = 'MED' AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 = 'BRE' GROUP BY CPE_MRN, CRE_RES_NAME) SELECT DISTINCT CC_MRN "MRN" , PT_LAST_NAME "Last Name" , PT_FIRST_NAME "First Name" , CASE WHEN D.AC_MRN IS NOT NULL THEN D.AC_CONS_DTE END AS "12-245 Consent Date" , CASE WHEN E.AC_MRN IS NOT NULL THEN E.AC_CONS_DTE END AS "06-107 Consent Date" , PM_CRE_RES_NAME AS "Primary Breast MedOnc Provider" , LOC_LOC_NAME "Location" , OC_SURG_DTE "Procedure Date" , CPX_PROC_NAME "Procedure Name" , "Appt Date" , "Provider Name" , "Visit Type" FROM PTS A JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT OC_MRN, OC_SURG_DTE, OC_OR_CASE_STS, OC_OR_CASE_STS_CD, CRE_RES_NAME, CPX_PROC_NAME, OC_CASE_ID, OCAP_OR_PROC_ID, LOC_LOC_NAME, OCAS_PNL_NO, CPX_PROC_CD FROM IDB.OR_CASE JOIN IDB.OR_CASE_ALL_PROC ON OC_CASE_ID = OCAP_CASE_ID JOIN IDB.OR_CASE_ALL_SURG ON OCAP_CASE_ID = OCAS_CASE_ID AND OCAS_PNL_NO = OCAP_PNL_NO AND OCAS_SURG_ROLE = 'Primary' JOIN IDB.OR_PROC ON OCAP_OR_PROC_ID = OP_OR_PROC_ID JOIN IDB.OR_CL_PROC ON OP_OR_PROC_ID = OCP_OR_PROC_ID JOIN IDB.CL_PROC ON OCP_PROC_ID = CPX_PROC_ID JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CRE_RES_ID = OCAS_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_LOCATION ON OC_SURG_LOC_ID = LOC_LOC_ID WHERE OC_MRN <> '' AND OC_OR_CASE_STS_CD NOT IN ('2', '5') AND OC_SURG_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT date AND CURRENT date + 7 DAYS AND (UPPER(CPX_PROC_NAME) like '%IR PROCEDURE%' OR UPPER(CPX_PROC_NAME) LIKE '%BX%' OR UPPER(CPX_PROC_NAME) LIKE '%BIOPSY%') AND CPX_PROC_CD NOT IN ('38525', '999992', '631', '3133', '11147') AND UPPER(CPX_PROC_NAME) not like '%COLONOSCOPY%' AND UPPER(CPX_PROC_NAME) not like '%BRONCHOSCOPY%' ) B ON A.CC_MRN = OC_MRN LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN AS "MRN", CPE_ENC_DTE AS "Appt Date", CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 AS "Department", CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 AS "Service", CLD_DEPT_NAME AS "Department Name", CRE_RES_NAME AS "Provider Name", CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME AS "Visit Type", CLD_CLD_CENTER "Location" FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID JOIN PTS ON CC_MRN = CPE_MRN WHERE 1=1 AND CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Sch') AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT date AND CURRENT date + 7 DAYS AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 = 'MED' AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 = 'BRE' ) C ON B.OC_MRN = "MRN" AND "Appt Date" BETWEEN CURRENT date AND OC_SURG_DTE LEFT JOIN IDB.ACCRUALS D ON A.CC_MRN = D.AC_MRN AND D.AC_IRB_NO = '12-245' LEFT JOIN IDB.ACCRUALS E ON A.CC_MRN = E.AC_MRN AND E.AC_IRB_NO = '06-107' LEFT JOIN PRIMARY_MEDONC ON A.CC_MRN = PM_MRN AND PM_RN = 1 WHERE 1=1 ORDER BY OC_SURG_DTE, CC_MRN ASC ;

prompt: Provide a weekly list of melanoma patients who have submitted and/or received financial clearance for T-VEC injection (Talimogene laherparepvec).
completion: WITH X AS (SELECT OO_MRN, OO_ENTER_DTE, OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE AS START_DATE, OO_ORD_ID, OO_ORD_NAME , OP_DISPLAY_NAME FROM IDB.OMS_ORDER LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_PROVIDER ON OO_PVDR_GUID = OP_PVDR_GUID WHERE OO_ORD_STS_CD NOT IN ('CANC', 'CANP', 'AUC3') AND OO_ORD_NAME = 'Talimogene laherparepvec INJ' AND OO_ENTER_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT date - 7 DAYS AND CURRENT date ) , Y AS (SELECT DISTINCT STRIP(OO.OO_MRN) AS OO_MRN, X.OO_ENTER_DTE AS "Last 7 Day Order Date", OO.OO_ENTER_DTE AS "T-Vec treatment order date", OO.OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE AS "T-Vec treatment date", STRIP(OP_DISPLAY_NAME) AS "Provider Name" FROM X JOIN IDB.OMS_ORDER OO ON X.OO_MRN = OO.OO_MRN WHERE OO.OO_ORD_STS_CD NOT IN ('CANC', 'CANP', 'AUC3') AND OO.OO_ORD_NAME = 'Talimogene laherparepvec INJ' ) , MEL AS (SELECT DISTINCT TM_MRN AS MRN, TM_DX_DTE AS DX_DATE, TM_HIST_CD AS HIST_CODE, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS HIST_DESC, TM_SITE_CD AS SITE_CODE, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_DESC FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.SEERGROUPING ON RECODE = DV.SEERF_ICDO(TM_SITE_CD, TM_HIST_CD) AND CATEGORY2 = 'Melanoma of the Skin' JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD WHERE 1=1 AND TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND TM_MRN IN (SELECT DISTINCT OO_MRN FROM Y) UNION SELECT CC_MRN AS MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS DX_DATE, CLM_CLSF_CD AS HIST_CODE, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS HIST_CODE, '' AS SITE_CODE, '' AS SITE_DESC FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.SEERGROUPING ON RECODE = MIN(DV.SEERF_ICD9(CLM_CLSF_CD), DV.SEERF_ICD10(CLM_CLSF_CD)) AND CATEGORY2 = 'Melanoma of the Skin' WHERE CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND ((CC_PT_TYPE = 'I') OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) AND CC_MRN IN (SELECT DISTINCT OO_MRN FROM Y) GROUP BY CC_MRN, CLM_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK ) , MEL2 AS (SELECT MRN, LISTAGG(COALESCE(STRIP(CAST(DX_DATE AS VARCHAR(12000))), '') || ' : ' || COALESCE(STRIP(CAST(HIST_CODE AS VARCHAR(12000))), '') || ' - ' || COALESCE(STRIP(CAST(HIST_DESC AS VARCHAR(12000))), '') || ' | ' || COALESCE(STRIP(CAST(HIST_CODE AS VARCHAR(12000))), '') || ' - ' || COALESCE(STRIP(CAST(HIST_DESC AS VARCHAR(12000))), '') , CHR(13) || CHR(10)) WITHIN GROUP( ORDER BY MRN, DX_DATE) AS DX FROM MEL GROUP BY MRN) SELECT DISTINCT Y.*, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH AS DOB, PT_SEX AS GENDER, DX FROM Y JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON OO_MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN MEL2 ON OO_MRN = MRN WITH X AS (SELECT OO_MRN, OO_ENTER_DTE, OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE AS START_DATE, OO_ORD_ID, OO_ORD_NAME , OP_DISPLAY_NAME FROM IDB.OMS_ORDER LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_PROVIDER ON OO_PVDR_GUID = OP_PVDR_GUID WHERE OO_ORD_STS_CD NOT IN ('CANC', 'CANP', 'AUC3') AND OO_ORD_NAME = 'Talimogene laherparepvec INJ' AND OO_ENTER_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT date - 7 DAYS AND CURRENT date ) , Y AS (SELECT DISTINCT STRIP(OO.OO_MRN) AS OO_MRN, X.OO_ENTER_DTE AS "Last 7 Day Order Date", OO.OO_ENTER_DTE AS "T-Vec treatment order date", OO.OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE AS "T-Vec treatment date", STRIP(OP_DISPLAY_NAME) AS "Provider Name" FROM X JOIN IDB.OMS_ORDER OO ON X.OO_MRN = OO.OO_MRN WHERE OO.OO_ORD_STS_CD NOT IN ('CANC', 'CANP', 'AUC3') AND OO.OO_ORD_NAME = 'Talimogene laherparepvec INJ' ) , Z AS (SELECT DISTINCT "t1"."PT_MRN" AS "MRN", "t2"."PRPT_ACCESSION_NO" AS "Pathology Report", "t3"."PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_DESC" AS "Pathology Report Type", "t4"."DT_DTE" AS "Pathology Procedure Date", "t5"."DT_DTE" AS "Pathology Report Date", UPPER(CASE WHEN LENGTH(PRPT_REPORT) <= 15000 THEN RTRIM(CAST(SUBSTR(PRPT_REPORT, 1, 15000) AS VARCHAR(15000))) ELSE CAST(SUBSTR(PRPT_REPORT, 1, 15000) AS VARCHAR(15000)) END) AS TXT FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V" "t1" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED" "t6" ON "t1"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t6"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V" "t2" ON "t6"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t2"."PRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATH_RPRT_TYPE_LOOKUP" "t3" ON "t2"."PRPT_REPORT_TYPE" = "t3"."PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_CD" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" "t4" ON "t2"."PRPT_PROCEDURE_DATE_ID" = "t4"."DT_DATE_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" "t5" ON "t2"."PRPT_REPORT_DATE_ID" = "t5"."DT_DATE_ID" WHERE 1=1 AND "t2"."PRPT_REPORT" IS NOT NULL AND "t1"."PT_MRN" = '38032186' AND UPPER("t3"."PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_DESC") like '%SURGICAL PATHOLOGY%' AND "t1"."PT_MRN" IN (SELECT DISTINCT OO_MRN FROM Y) ) SELECT Z.*, CASE WHEN DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)DIAGNOSIS:[\w\W]*(?=NOTE:)', TXT) <> '' THEN DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)DIAGNOSIS:[\w\W]*(?=NOTE:)', TXT) WHEN DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)DIAGNOSIS:[\w\W]*(?=IMMUNOHISTOCHEMISTRY)', TXT) <> '' THEN DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)DIAGNOSIS:[\w\W]*(?=IMMUNOHISTOCHEMISTRY)', TXT) WHEN DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)DIAGNOSIS:[\w\W]*(?=I ATTEST)', TXT) <> '' THEN DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)DIAGNOSIS:[\w\W]*(?=I ATTEST)', TXT) END AS DIAGNOSIS FROM Z WHERE UPPER(TXT) like '%MELANOMA%'

prompt: Provide a list of Pathology personal consult cases (link CO/HCO/PSSL specimen classes in CoPath and corresponding MRN Request visit type in Cadence) that had follow up visits in Cadence with an MSK MD.
completion: WITH VISITS AS (SELECT CPE_MRN, CPE_ENC_CSN_ID, CPE_ENC_DTE, CPE_APPT_MADE_DTE, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8, CLD_DEPT_NAME, CRE_RES_NAME, CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME, CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR, CVT_EXT_NAME FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp', 'Sch') AND CPE_ENC_DTE >= CURRENT date - 30 DAYS AND CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME = 'MRN REQUEST' ), APPTS AS (SELECT CPE_MRN, CPE_ENC_CSN_ID, CPE_ENC_DTE, CPE_APPT_MADE_DTE, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8, CLD_DEPT_NAME, CRE_RES_NAME, CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME, CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR, CVT_EXT_NAME, CPE_CPE_APPT_STS FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp', 'Sch') AND CRE_RES_TYP IN ('Physician') AND CPE_ENC_DTE >= CURRENT date - 30 DAYS ) SELECT * FROM (SELECT DISTINCT OO_MRN "MRN", OOC_ITEM_NAME "Order Item Name", OOC_ITEM_DESC "AnciCode", OO_ORD_ID "Order ID", OO_ANCIL_REF_CD "Accession Number", OSTS_ORD_STS_CD "Result Item Name", OSTS_STS_DESC "Result Item Code", CHAR(OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE) "Date Results Available", A.CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME "Visit Type Name", CHAR(A.CPE_APPT_MADE_DTE) "MRN Request Visit Created", B.CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME "Followup Visit Type Name", CHAR(B.CPE_ENC_DTE) "Doctor Visit Date", B.CRE_RES_NAME "Doctor Name", B.CPE_CPE_APPT_STS "Appt Status", ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY OO_MRN ORDER BY A.CPE_APPT_MADE_DTE, B.CPE_ENC_DTE) AS RN FROM IDB.OMS_ORDER JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_CATALOG ON OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID = OOC_MSTR_ITEM_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_STATUS ON OO_ORD_STS_CD = OSTS_ORD_STS_CD JOIN VISITS A ON OO_MRN = A.CPE_MRN JOIN APPTS B ON OO_MRN=B.CPE_MRN AND OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE < B.CPE_ENC_DTE WHERE OOC_ITEM_NAME IN ('Surgical Pathology Consults', 'Cytology-Private Submitted Slides', 'Hematopathology Personal Consult') AND OO_ORD_STS_CD NOT IN ('CANP', 'CANC', 'AUC3') AND OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE >= CURRENT date - 30 DAYS ) A WHERE RN = 1 ORDER BY MRN ;

prompt: Provide pediatric patients between 2011 and 2021 who were treated with Romiplostim or Eltrombopag.
completion: WITH PTS AS (SELECT CPE_MRN AS "MRN", CPE_ENC_DTE AS "Appt Date", CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 AS "Department", CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 AS "Service", CLD_DEPT_NAME AS "Department Name", CRE_RES_NAME AS "Provider Name", CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME AS "Visit Type" FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 = 'PED' AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN '2011-01-01' AND CURRENT date ) , HML AS (SELECT DISTINCT HCPR_MRN, HCPR_PRESCRIPTION_ID RX_ID , HCPR_CREATED_DTE RX_CREATE_DATE , DATE(HCPR_START_DT) START_DATE , HCPR_END_DT AS END_DATE , DATE(HCPR_DISCONTINUE_DT) AS DISCONTINUE_DATE , HCPR_DRUG_NAME AS DRUG_NAME , HGN_GENERIC_NAME AS GENERIC_NAME , HCPR_STATUS_TYPE_DESC AS PRESCRIPTION_STATUS , HCPR_PRESCRIPTION_TYPE_DESC AS RX_TYPE , HCPR_DOSE_AMT AS DOSE_AMT , UOM.HRUM_NAME UOM , UOM.HRUM_DESCRIPTION UOM_DESC , HCPR_ROUTE AS ROUTE , HCPR_NDC AS NDC FROM IDB.HML_CLIENT_PRESCRIPTION JOIN PTS ON "MRN" = HCPR_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_CLIENT_VISIT ON OCV_VISIT_GUID = HCPR_VISIT_GUID LEFT JOIN IDB.HML_GENERIC_NAME ON HGN_GENERIC_NAME_ID = HCPR_GENERIC_NAME_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_USER USR ON USR.OU_USER_GUID = HCPR_USER_GUID LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_USER REQ ON REQ.OU_USER_GUID = HCPR_CARE_PROV_GUID LEFT JOIN IDB.HML_RX_UNIT_OF_MEASURE UOM ON UOM.HRUM_RXUOM_ID = HCPR_DOSE_UOM_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.HML_RX_UNIT_OF_MEASURE PKG ON PKG.HRUM_RXUOM_ID = HCPR_INNER_PACKAGE_SIZE_UOM_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.HML_SCRIPT_FREQUENCY ON HSF_SCRIPT_FREQ_ID = HCPR_SCRIPT_FREQ_ID WHERE HCPR_STATUS_TYPE NOT IN (4, 5, 8) AND HCPR_CREATED_DTE IS NOT NULL AND HCPR_STATUS_TYPE NOT IN (4, 5, 8) AND HCPR_PRESCRIPTION_TYPE = 3 AND HCPR_TRANSMISSION_STATUS IN (1, 2, 5) AND (LOWER(HGN_GENERIC_NAME) like '%romiplostim%' OR LOWER(HGN_GENERIC_NAME) like '%eltrombopag%') ) , ORDERS AS (SELECT DISTINCT OO_MRN, OOC_ITEM_NAME, OOC_ITEM_DESC, OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE, OSTS_STS_DESC FROM IDB.OMS_ORDER JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_CATALOG ON OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID = OOC_MSTR_ITEM_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_STATUS ON OO_ORD_STS_CD = OSTS_ORD_STS_CD JOIN PTS ON "MRN" = OO_MRN WHERE 1=1 AND (LOWER(OOC_ITEM_NAME) like '%romiplostim%' OR LOWER(OOC_ITEM_NAME) like '%eltrombopag%') AND OO_ORD_STS_CD NOT IN ('CANP', 'CANC', 'AUC3') ) , FINAL_PTS AS (SELECT HCPR_MRN AS MRN , MIN(START_DATE) AS START_DTE FROM HML GROUP BY HCPR_MRN UNION SELECT OO_MRN AS MRN , MIN(OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE) AS START_DTE FROM ORDERS GROUP BY OO_MRN) , CDB AS (SELECT TM_MRN, AV_DESC AS CASE_STS, TM_DX_DTE, TM_HIST_CD, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS HIST_DESC, TM_SITE_CD, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_DESC, TM_BEST_AJCC_STG FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS ON AV_ELEMENT = 'CASE_STS' AND AV_CODE = TM_CASE_STS JOIN FINAL_PTS ON TM_MRN = MRN WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') ) SELECT MRN , PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH "Date of birth" , PT_SEX "Gender" , START_DTE "First tx date" , YEAR(START_DTE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) AS "Age at first tx" , TM_DX_DTE "Dx Date" , HIST_DESC "Dx Histology" , SITE_DESC "Dx Site" FROM FINAL_PTS JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN CDB ON MRN = TM_MRN ; WITH PTS AS (SELECT CPE_MRN AS "MRN", CPE_ENC_DTE AS "Appt Date", CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 AS "Department", CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 AS "Service", CLD_DEPT_NAME AS "Department Name", CRE_RES_NAME AS "Provider Name", CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME AS "Visit Type" FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 = 'PED' AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN '2011-01-01' AND CURRENT date ) , HML AS (SELECT DISTINCT HCPR_MRN, HCPR_PRESCRIPTION_ID RX_ID , HCPR_CREATED_DTE RX_CREATE_DATE , DATE(HCPR_START_DT) START_DATE , HCPR_END_DT AS END_DATE , DATE(HCPR_DISCONTINUE_DT) AS DISCONTINUE_DATE , HCPR_DRUG_NAME AS DRUG_NAME , HGN_GENERIC_NAME AS GENERIC_NAME , HCPR_STATUS_TYPE_DESC AS PRESCRIPTION_STATUS , HCPR_PRESCRIPTION_TYPE_DESC AS RX_TYPE , HCPR_DOSE_AMT AS DOSE_AMT , UOM.HRUM_NAME UOM , UOM.HRUM_DESCRIPTION UOM_DESC , HCPR_ROUTE AS ROUTE , HCPR_NDC AS NDC FROM IDB.HML_CLIENT_PRESCRIPTION JOIN PTS ON "MRN" = HCPR_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_CLIENT_VISIT ON OCV_VISIT_GUID = HCPR_VISIT_GUID LEFT JOIN IDB.HML_GENERIC_NAME ON HGN_GENERIC_NAME_ID = HCPR_GENERIC_NAME_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_USER USR ON USR.OU_USER_GUID = HCPR_USER_GUID LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_USER REQ ON REQ.OU_USER_GUID = HCPR_CARE_PROV_GUID LEFT JOIN IDB.HML_RX_UNIT_OF_MEASURE UOM ON UOM.HRUM_RXUOM_ID = HCPR_DOSE_UOM_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.HML_RX_UNIT_OF_MEASURE PKG ON PKG.HRUM_RXUOM_ID = HCPR_INNER_PACKAGE_SIZE_UOM_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.HML_SCRIPT_FREQUENCY ON HSF_SCRIPT_FREQ_ID = HCPR_SCRIPT_FREQ_ID WHERE HCPR_STATUS_TYPE NOT IN (4, 5, 8) AND HCPR_CREATED_DTE IS NOT NULL AND HCPR_STATUS_TYPE NOT IN (4, 5, 8) AND HCPR_PRESCRIPTION_TYPE = 3 AND HCPR_TRANSMISSION_STATUS IN (1, 2, 5) AND (LOWER(HGN_GENERIC_NAME) like '%romiplostim%' OR LOWER(HGN_GENERIC_NAME) like '%eltrombopag%') ) , ORDERS AS (SELECT DISTINCT OO_MRN, OOC_ITEM_NAME, OOC_ITEM_DESC, OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE, OSTS_STS_DESC FROM IDB.OMS_ORDER JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_CATALOG ON OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID = OOC_MSTR_ITEM_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_STATUS ON OO_ORD_STS_CD = OSTS_ORD_STS_CD JOIN PTS ON "MRN" = OO_MRN WHERE 1=1 AND (LOWER(OOC_ITEM_NAME) like '%romiplostim%' OR LOWER(OOC_ITEM_NAME) like '%eltrombopag%') AND OO_ORD_STS_CD NOT IN ('CANP', 'CANC', 'AUC3') ) , FINAL_PTS AS (SELECT HCPR_MRN AS MRN , MIN(START_DATE) AS START_DTE FROM HML GROUP BY HCPR_MRN UNION SELECT OO_MRN AS MRN , MIN(OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE) AS START_DTE FROM ORDERS GROUP BY OO_MRN) SELECT DISTINCT LR_MRN "MRN", LR_PERFORMED_DTE "Lab Perform Dte", LR_TEST_NAME "Test Name", LR_SUBTEST_NAME "Subtest Name", LR_RESULT_VALUE "Test Value" FROM IDB.LAB_RESULTS LEFT JOIN IDB.LAB_TEXT_LINE ON LTL_RESULT_GUID = LR_RESULT_GUID JOIN FINAL_PTS ON LR_MRN = MRN WHERE LR_TEST_NAME IN ('Complete Blood Count (CBC), with ANC only', 'Complete Blood Count (CBC), Standard', 'Complete Blood Count (CBC), With Differential', 'Complete Blood Count (CBC), WITH Differential') AND LR_PERFORMED_DTE >= START_DTE AND LR_SUBTEST_NAME = 'Platelets.' ;

prompt: Provide a list of patients who received at least one dose of the Johnson&Johnson covid vaccine from MSK or from an outside provider.

prompt: COVID-19 NJ Employee Vaccination Data request for Regulatory Reporting (Submission Deadline Tues Dec 14 12pm)
completion: SELECT EVI_EMPLOYEE_ID EMPLOYEE_ID, CVP_JOB_FAMILY JOB_FAMILY, CVP_JOB_TITLE JOB_TITLE, CEVE_CATEGORY CATEGORY, CVP_WORK_LOCATION WORK_LOCATION, CASE WHEN CVP_VACC_REMT_EXMP_IND = 'Y' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS REMOTE_EXEMPT, CASE WHEN CVP_SHORT_TERM_DIS_FLAG = 'Y' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS ON_LEAVE, VACCINE_STATUS FROM IDB.COVID19_EMPLOYEE_VACCINE_INFO LEFT JOIN IDB.COVID19_VACCINE_PERSON ON EVI_EMPLOYEE_ID = CVP_EMPLOYEE_ID WHERE CEVE_CATEGORY IN ('Contingents', 'Employees') AND (CVP_WORK_LOCATION like '%(BR)%' OR CVP_WORK_LOCATION like '%(Montvale)%' OR CVP_WORK_LOCATION like '%(Monmouth)%') ;

prompt: To create a list of New Visits in Leukemia who were seen by Dr. Mato and Dr. Roeker between 1/1/21-10/31/21
completion: WITH ACCR AS (SELECT L.MRN ACCR_MRN, ACD_OFF_STUDY_DTE, PRO_PROTOCOL_TYPE FROM SESSION.MED_24404_PAT L JOIN IDB.ACCRUALS_DATES D ON D.ACD_MRN = L.MRN AND D.ACD_IRB_NO = '06-107' JOIN IDB.PROTOCOL ON PRO_IRB_NO = ACD_IRB_NO) , GRP_IRB AS (SELECT AC_MRN, LISTAGG(TRIM(PRO_IRB_NO), '; ') PROTOCOL_LIST FROM (SELECT AC_MRN , PRO_IRB_NO FROM IDB.PROTOCOL JOIN IDB.ACCRUALS ON PRO_IRB_NO = AC_IRB_NO JOIN SESSION.MED_24404_PAT L ON L.MRN = AC_MRN) GROUP BY AC_MRN) , ORDPREP AS (SELECT OO_MRN MRN, OUO.OUO_REQ_FOR_DTE "Ordered For Dte", STRIP(OO_ORD_NAME) OO_ORD_NAME, STRIP(OO_REQ_TME_PRIO) "Ordered Loc", OO_SUMMARY_LINE FROM SESSION.MED_24404_PAT P JOIN IDB.OMS_ORDER ON P.MRN = OO_MRN JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_USER_DATA ON OO_MRN = OUD_MRN AND OO_ORD_GUID = OUD_ORD_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_USER_ORDERS OUO ON OO_ORD_GUID = OUO.OUO_ORD_GUID AND P.APPOINTMENT_DATE = OUO.OUO_REQ_FOR_DTE INNER JOIN IDB.OMS_STATUS ON OO_ORD_STS_CD = OSTS_ORD_STS_CD WHERE (OO_ORD_TYPE_CD = 'Diagnostic' OR OO_ORD_NAME = 'DTU Research Charges') AND OO_ORD_STS_CD NOT IN ('CANC', 'CANP', 'AUC3') AND OUO.OUO_REQ_FOR_DTE IS NOT NULL GROUP BY OO_MRN, OUO.OUO_REQ_FOR_DTE, STRIP(OO_ORD_NAME), STRIP(OO_REQ_TME_PRIO), OO_SUMMARY_LINE ), AGG_ORD AS (SELECT MRN MRN_ORD, "Ordered For Dte", LISTAGG("Ordered Loc" || ':' || CHR(13) || CHR(10) || LOCORDS, CHR(13) || CHR(10)) WITHIN GROUP ( ORDER BY "Ordered Loc", LOCORDS) AS ORD_DS FROM (SELECT MRN, "Ordered For Dte", "Ordered Loc", LISTAGG(' ' || OO_ORD_NAME, CHR(13) || CHR(10)) WITHIN GROUP ( ORDER BY OO_ORD_NAME) LOCORDS FROM ORDPREP GROUP BY MRN, "Ordered For Dte", "Ordered Loc") GROUP BY MRN, "Ordered For Dte") , IMPORD AS (SELECT DISTINCT PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID IMPORD_PID, 'Ordered' ORDVAL , OO_ORD_NAME FROM DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS D JOIN SESSION.MED_24404_PAT R ON R.MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_ORDER ON OO_MRN = PT_MRN) , IMPBASE1 AS (SELECT SUBJECT_MRN MRN , PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID AS PID, 'Registered' AS IMPCONS, MAX(CASE WHEN ARM_CODE = 'A' AND PROTOCOL_NO = '06-107' THEN ON_ARM_DATE END) "Part A Registration Date", MAX(CASE WHEN ARM_CODE = 'C' AND PROTOCOL_NO = '06-107' THEN ON_ARM_DATE END) "Part C Registration Date" FROM NN.SV_SUB_TREATMENT N JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS D ON N.SUBJECT_MRN = D.PT_MRN WHERE N.PROTOCOL_NO IN ('12-245', '06-107') GROUP BY SUBJECT_MRN, PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID ) , IMPBASE AS (SELECT B.*, CASE WHEN (REG_NETWORK_DSCRP <> 'Memorial Sloan-Kettering Cancer Center' OR REGNET_CODE IS NOT NULL OR REGNETTX_FLAG = 'Yes') THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END REG_PT_FLAG FROM IMPBASE1 B LEFT JOIN NN.CRDB_DASH_PT R ON B.MRN = R.PT_MRN) , IMPRES AS (SELECT DISTINCT PID AS IMPRES_PID, 'Resulted' AS RESVAL FROM IMPBASE JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_STRUCTURED_RESULTS_V ON PID = PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID WHERE METHOD = 'IMPACT' ) , IMPFAIL AS (SELECT DISTINCT PID AS IMPFAIL_PID, 'Failed' AS FAILVAL FROM IMPBASE JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT ON PID = PRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID LEFT JOIN IMPRES ON PID = IMPRES_PID JOIN DV.PATH_RPRT_TYPE_LOOKUP ON PRPT_REPORT_TYPE = PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_CD WHERE IMPRES_PID IS NULL AND CONTAINS(PRPT_REPORT, '("TEST FAILURE" AND "MSK-IMPACT")') = 1 AND PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_DESC = 'Diagnostic Molecular Pathology' AND PRPT_REPORT IS NOT NULL) , IMPPROCESS AS (SELECT DISTINCT PID AS IMPPROCESS_PID, 'In Process' AS INPVAL FROM IMPBASE JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT ON PID = PRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID LEFT JOIN IMPRES ON PID = IMPRES_PID JOIN DV.PATH_RPRT_TYPE_LOOKUP ON PRPT_REPORT_TYPE = PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_CD WHERE IMPRES_PID IS NULL AND CONTAINS(PRPT_REPORT, '("MATCHED NORMAL" AND "MSK-IMPACT")') = 1 AND PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_DESC = 'Diagnostic Molecular Pathology' AND PRPT_REPORT IS NOT NULL ) SELECT FR.*, PROTOCOL_LIST, BASE.REG_PT_FLAG, "Part A Registration Date", "Part C Registration Date", CASE WHEN IMPRES_PID IS NOT NULL THEN 'Resulted' WHEN IMPFAIL_PID IS NOT NULL THEN 'Failed' WHEN IMPPROCESS_PID IS NOT NULL THEN 'In Process' WHEN IMPORD_PID IS NOT NULL THEN 'Ordered' ELSE '' END AS "IMPACT Result Status", CASE WHEN A.ACD_OFF_STUDY_DTE IS NULL AND A.PRO_PROTOCOL_TYPE = 'Therapeutic' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS "On Study for Therapeutic Protocol" FROM SESSION.MED_24404_PAT FR LEFT JOIN GRP_IRB I ON I.AC_MRN = FR.MRN LEFT JOIN AGG_ORD R ON MRN_ORD = FR.MRN LEFT JOIN ACCR A ON ACCR_MRN = FR.MRN LEFT JOIN IMPBASE AS BASE ON BASE.MRN = FR.MRN LEFT JOIN IMPPROCESS ON BASE.PID = IMPPROCESS_PID LEFT JOIN IMPFAIL ON BASE.PID = IMPFAIL_PID LEFT JOIN IMPRES ON BASE.PID = IMPRES_PID LEFT JOIN IMPORD ON BASE.PID = IMPORD_PID WHERE FR.APPOINTMENT_DATE BETWEEN '2021-01-01' AND CURRENT date

prompt: Number of appointments scheduled in Donor Room on Tuesdays, Wednesdays, Thursdays after 3:00pm from date range 1/1/20-8/31/20
completion: SELECT CLD_DEPT_NAME, CASE WHEN DAYOFWEEK(CPE_ENC_DTE) = 1 THEN 'Sunday' WHEN DAYOFWEEK(CPE_ENC_DTE) = 2 THEN 'Monday' WHEN DAYOFWEEK(CPE_ENC_DTE) = 3 THEN 'Tuesday' WHEN DAYOFWEEK(CPE_ENC_DTE) = 4 THEN 'Wednesday' WHEN DAYOFWEEK(CPE_ENC_DTE) = 5 THEN 'Thursday' WHEN DAYOFWEEK(CPE_ENC_DTE) = 6 THEN 'Friday' WHEN DAYOFWEEK(CPE_ENC_DTE) = 7 THEN 'Saturday' ELSE 'Error' END AS DOW, COUNT(*) "Appointments" FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CLD_DEPT_NAME = 'DONOR ROOM' AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN '2020-01-01' AND '2020-08-31' AND DAYOFWEEK(CPE_ENC_DTE) IN (3, 4, 5) AND TIME(CPE_APPT_DT) >= TIME('15:00:00') GROUP BY CLD_DEPT_NAME, DAYOFWEEK(CPE_ENC_DTE), CASE WHEN DAYOFWEEK(CPE_ENC_DTE) = 1 THEN 'Sunday' WHEN DAYOFWEEK(CPE_ENC_DTE) = 2 THEN 'Monday' WHEN DAYOFWEEK(CPE_ENC_DTE) = 3 THEN 'Tuesday' WHEN DAYOFWEEK(CPE_ENC_DTE) = 4 THEN 'Wednesday' WHEN DAYOFWEEK(CPE_ENC_DTE) = 5 THEN 'Thursday' WHEN DAYOFWEEK(CPE_ENC_DTE) = 6 THEN 'Friday' WHEN DAYOFWEEK(CPE_ENC_DTE) = 7 THEN 'Saturday' ELSE 'Error' END ORDER BY DAYOFWEEK(CPE_ENC_DTE)

prompt: Whole genome sequencing of baseline and relapsed biopsy samples from patients with PMBL to identify factors associated with risk of treatment failure.
completion: WITH PMBCL_PATH AS (SELECT DISTINCT DMP.PRPT_MRN AS MRN , PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_BIRTH_DTE, PT_DEATH_DTE, PT_VITAL_STATUS, PT_SEX , COALESCE(MAX(PLA_LST_APPT_DTE, PLA_LST_DRVST_DTE), PLA_LST_APPT_DTE, PLA_LST_DRVST_DTE) AS LAST_FOLLOWUP_DATE , YEAR(DMP.PRPT_PROCEDURE_DTE - PT_BIRTH_DTE) AS "Proc Age" , DMP.PRPT_PROCEDURE_DTE AS "Procedure Date" , DMP.PRPT_REPORT_DTE AS "Report Date" , DMP.PRPT_ACCESSION_NO AS "Accession No" , DMP.PRPT_REPORT_TYPE_DESC AS "Report Type" , DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)diag[\w\W]*(?=I ATTEST)', DMP.PRPT_REPORT) AS DIAGNOSIS_TEXT , VARCHAR(DMP.PRPT_REPORT, 32000) AS "Report Text (first 32000 characters)" , (SELECT VARCHAR(PRPT_REPORT, 32000) AS REFERENCEDPATHTEXTFROM FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT WHERE PRPT_ACCESSION_NO = SRG.PRPT_ACCESSION_NO) AS REFERENCEDPATHTEXT FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V DMP LEFT JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_REFERENCES ON PRPTR_CHILD_PATH_RPT_ID = DMP.PRPT_PATH_RPT_ID LEFT JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT SRG ON SRG.PRPT_PATH_RPT_ID = PRPTR_PATH_RPT_ID LEFT JOIN DV.DATE_V SRG_DATE ON SRG_DATE.DT_DATE_ID = SRG.PRPT_PROCEDURE_DATE_ID JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = DMP.PRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY ON PT_MRN = PLA_MRN WHERE 1=1 AND CONTAINS(DMP.PRPT_REPORT, '(("primary mediastinal large B-cell lymphoma" OR "primary mediastinal large B cell lymphoma" OR "PMBCL" OR " relapsed disease primary mediastinal B-cell lymphoma" OR "refractory disease mediastinal B-cell lymphoma" OR " relapsed primary mediastinal B cell lymphoma" OR "refractory mediastinal B cell lymphoma" OR " relapsed primary mediastinal B-cell lymphoma" OR "refractory primary mediastinal B-cell lymphoma" OR " relapsed disease primary mediastinal B cell lymphoma" OR "refractory disease mediastinal B cell lymphoma" OR "primary mediastinal B-cell lymphoma" OR "primary mediastinal (thymic) large B-cell lymphoma" OR "primary mediastinal"))') = 1 AND DMP.PRPT_REPORT IS NOT NULL AND DMP.PRPT_REPORT_DTE BETWEEN '1/1/2010' AND CURRENT DATE AND YEAR(DMP.PRPT_PROCEDURE_DTE - PT_BIRTH_DTE) >= 18) SELECT * FROM PMBCL_PATH ORDER BY 1 ; WITH PMBCL AS (SELECT DISTINCT TM_MRN AS MRN, TM_DX_DTE AS DX_DATE, TM_HIST_CD AS DX_CODE, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS DX_DESC FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.SEERGROUPING ON RECODE = IDB.SEERF_ICDO(TM_SITE_CD, TM_HIST_CD) AND CATEGORY1 = 'Lymphoma' JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD WHERE 1=1 AND TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND TM_DX_DTE BETWEEN '1/1/2010' AND CURRENT DATE AND TM_HIST_CD IN ('M9679/3') UNION SELECT CC_MRN AS MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS DX_DATE, CLM_CLSF_CD AS DX_CODE, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS DX_DESC FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND ((CC_PT_TYPE = 'I') OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) AND CC_CLSF_CD IN ('C85.2', 'C85.20', 'C85.21', 'C85.22', 'C85.23', 'C85.24', 'C85.25', 'C85.26', 'C85.27', 'C85.28', 'C85.29') AND CC_EFF_DTE BETWEEN '1/1/2010' AND CURRENT DATE GROUP BY CC_MRN, CLM_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK ) , PMBCL2 AS (SELECT DISTINCT MRN FROM PMBCL JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON MRN=PT_MRN WHERE YEAR(DX_DATE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) >= 18 ) , PMBCL_PATH AS (SELECT DISTINCT DMP.PRPT_MRN AS MRN , PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_BIRTH_DTE, PT_DEATH_DTE, PT_VITAL_STATUS, PT_SEX , COALESCE(MAX(PLA_LST_APPT_DTE, PLA_LST_DRVST_DTE), PLA_LST_APPT_DTE, PLA_LST_DRVST_DTE) AS LAST_FOLLOWUP_DATE , YEAR(DMP.PRPT_PROCEDURE_DTE - PT_BIRTH_DTE) AS "Proc Age" , DMP.PRPT_PROCEDURE_DTE AS "Procedure Date" , DMP.PRPT_REPORT_DTE AS "Report Date" , DMP.PRPT_ACCESSION_NO AS "Accession No" , DMP.PRPT_REPORT_TYPE_DESC AS "Report Type" , DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)diag[\w\W]*(?=I ATTEST)', DMP.PRPT_REPORT) AS DIAGNOSIS_TEXT , VARCHAR(DMP.PRPT_REPORT, 32000) AS "Report Text (first 32000 characters)" , (SELECT VARCHAR(PRPT_REPORT, 32000) AS REFERENCEDPATHTEXTFROM FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT WHERE PRPT_ACCESSION_NO = SRG.PRPT_ACCESSION_NO) AS REFERENCEDPATHTEXT FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V DMP LEFT JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_REFERENCES ON PRPTR_CHILD_PATH_RPT_ID = DMP.PRPT_PATH_RPT_ID LEFT JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT SRG ON SRG.PRPT_PATH_RPT_ID = PRPTR_PATH_RPT_ID LEFT JOIN DV.DATE_V SRG_DATE ON SRG_DATE.DT_DATE_ID = SRG.PRPT_PROCEDURE_DATE_ID JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = DMP.PRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY ON PT_MRN = PLA_MRN WHERE 1=1 AND CONTAINS(DMP.PRPT_REPORT, '(("primary mediastinal large B-cell lymphoma" OR "primary mediastinal large B cell lymphoma" OR "PMBCL" OR " relapsed disease primary mediastinal B-cell lymphoma" OR "refractory disease mediastinal B-cell lymphoma" OR " relapsed primary mediastinal B cell lymphoma" OR "refractory mediastinal B cell lymphoma" OR " relapsed primary mediastinal B-cell lymphoma" OR "refractory primary mediastinal B-cell lymphoma" OR " relapsed disease primary mediastinal B cell lymphoma" OR "refractory disease mediastinal B cell lymphoma" OR "primary mediastinal B-cell lymphoma" OR "primary mediastinal (thymic) large B-cell lymphoma" OR "primary mediastinal"))') = 1 AND DMP.PRPT_REPORT IS NOT NULL AND DMP.PRPT_REPORT_DTE BETWEEN '1/1/2010' AND CURRENT DATE AND YEAR(DMP.PRPT_PROCEDURE_DTE - PT_BIRTH_DTE) >= 18) , CDB_NOTPATH AS (SELECT DISTINCT MRN FROM PMBCL2 WHERE MRN NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT MRN FROM PMBCL_PATH)) SELECT PT_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_SEX, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, PT_DATE_OF_DEATH , CASE WHEN PT_DATE_OF_DEATH IS NOT NULL THEN 'DECEASED' ELSE 'ALIVE' END VITAL_STATUS , COALESCE(MAX(PLA_LST_APPT_DTE, PLA_LST_DRVST_DTE), PLA_LST_APPT_DTE, PLA_LST_DRVST_DTE) AS LAST_FOLLOWUP_DATE FROM IDB.PATIENT JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY ON PT_MRN=PLA_MRN WHERE PT_MRN IN (SELECT DISTINCT MRN FROM CDB_NOTPATH) ORDER BY 1

prompt: Request a Top 200 Lab Orders by Service Statistics Report to be scheduled to run every six months.
completion: SELECT OO_ORD_NAME "Order Name", OAN_ANC_NAME "Ancillary Code", OS_SVC_GRP_CD "Service Code", OS_SVC_DESC "Service Description", CNT "Order Count" FROM (SELECT A.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY OS_SVC_GRP_CD ORDER BY CNT DESC) AS RN FROM (SELECT OO_ORD_NAME, OAN_ANC_NAME, OS_SVC_GRP_CD, OS_SVC_DESC, COUNT(*) CNT FROM IDB.OMS_ORDER JOIN IDB.OMS_STATUS ON OO_ORD_STS_CD = OSTS_ORD_STS_CD LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_CLIENT_VISIT ON OCV_VISIT_GUID = OO_VISIT_GUID LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_SERVICE ON OCV_SVC_GUID = OS_SVC_GUID LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_CATALOG ON OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID = OOC_MSTR_ITEM_GUID LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_ANCILLARY_NAME ON OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID = OAN_MSTR_ITEM_GUID WHERE OO_ORD_STS_CD NOT IN ('CANP', 'CANC', 'AUC3') AND OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE >= CURRENT date - 6 MONTHS AND OOC_REV_CAT_DEPT IN ('Laboratory', 'Blood Bank') GROUP BY OO_ORD_NAME, OAN_ANC_NAME, OS_SVC_GRP_CD, OS_SVC_DESC) A) B WHERE RN <= 200 ORDER BY 4, 5 DESC

prompt: Provide a one time list of patients aged 15 - 39 seen at MSK with DSRCT
completion: WITH PTS AS (SELECT TM_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, TM_DX_DTE, YEAR(TM_DX_DTE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) AGE_AT_DX, TM_HIST_CD, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS HIST_DESC, TM_SITE_CD, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_DESC, AV_DESC AS CASE_STS FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS ON AV_ELEMENT = 'CASE_STS' AND AV_CODE = TM_CASE_STS JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON TM_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.PT_FIRST_ACTIVITY ON TM_MRN = PFA_MRN WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND TM_HIST_CD ='M8806/3' AND (YEAR(TM_DX_DTE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) BETWEEN 15 AND 39 OR YEAR(PFA_FST_DRVST_DTE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) BETWEEN 15 AND 39) AND PFA_FST_DRVST_DTE BETWEEN '1999-01-01' AND '2020-12-31' ) , FIRST_VISIT AS (SELECT CPE_MRN AS "MRN", CPE_ENC_DTE AS "Appt Date", YEAR(CPE_ENC_DTE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) "Age at Appt", CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 AS "Department", CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 AS "Service", CLD_DEPT_NAME AS "Department Name", CRE_RES_NAME AS "Provider Name", CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME AS "Visit Type", ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CPE_MRN ORDER BY CPE_ENC_DTE) RN FROM PTS JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON TM_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER ON TM_MRN = CPE_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CRE_RES_TYP IN ('Physician') ) SELECT P.*, "Appt Date" "First Appt Date", "Age at Appt" "First Appt Age", "Department" "First Appt Dept", "Service" "First Appt Service" FROM PTS P LEFT JOIN FIRST_VISIT ON TM_MRN = MRN AND RN = 1

prompt: Provide list of patients with a metastatic disease consult order that have a subsequent appointment with a radonc provider in a regional site.
completion: WITH CONSULT AS (SELECT OO_MRN, OOC_ITEM_NAME, OO_SIGNIFICANT_DT, OSTS_STS_DESC FROM IDB.OMS_ORDER JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_CATALOG ON OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID = OOC_MSTR_ITEM_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_STATUS ON OO_ORD_STS_CD = OSTS_ORD_STS_CD WHERE OOC_ITEM_NAME IN ('Radiation Oncology Metastatic Disease Outpatient Consult') AND OO_ORD_STS_CD NOT IN ('CANP', 'CANC', 'AUC3') AND OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE >= CURRENT DATE - 1 YEAR ) , APPTS AS (SELECT CPE_MRN AS "MRN", CPE_APPT_DT AS "Appt Date Time", CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 AS "Department", CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 AS "Service", CLD_DEPT_NAME AS "Department Name", CRE_RES_NAME AS "Provider Name", CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME AS "Visit Type", CLD_CLD_CENTER AS "Site", ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY CPE_MRN ORDER BY CPE_ENC_DTE ASC) AS RANK FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID JOIN CONSULT ON CPE_MRN = OO_MRN WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp', 'Sch') AND CRE_RES_TYP IN ('Physician') AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 = 'RDO' AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_1 = 'REG' AND CPE_APPT_DT >= OO_SIGNIFICANT_DT ) SELECT OO_MRN "MRN" , OO_SIGNIFICANT_DT "Order Date" , "Appt Date Time" , DAYS(DATE("Appt Date Time")) - DAYS(DATE(OO_SIGNIFICANT_DT)) AS "Date Difference" , "Provider Name" , "Visit Type" , "Site" FROM CONSULT JOIN APPTS ON OO_MRN = "MRN" AND RANK = 1 AND "Appt Date Time" >= OO_SIGNIFICANT_DT ;

prompt: Provide a weekly scheduled report for female patients scheduled for RO set up at Westchester (aged 11-50) within the next 2 weeks that will need pregnancy test.
completion: SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN "MRN", PT_LAST_NAME "Last Name", PT_FIRST_NAME "First Name", A.CRE_RES_NAME "Resource", B.CRE_RES_NAME "Referring Provider", CLD_CLD_CENTER "Location", CPE_ENC_DTE "Appt Date", TIME(CPE_APPT_DT) AS "Appt Time", CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME "Visit Type", OOC_ITEM_DESC "Order", OSTS_STS_DESC "Order Status" FROM IDB.PATIENT JOIN IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER ON PT_MRN = CPE_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE A ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = A.CRE_RES_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE B ON CPE_REF_RES_ID = B.CRE_RES_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_ORDER ON OO_MRN = PT_MRN AND OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID = '9000006089100730' LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_STATUS ON OO_ORD_STS_CD = OSTS_ORD_STS_CD LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_CATALOG ON OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID = OOC_MSTR_ITEM_GUID WHERE PT_SEX = 'F' AND YEAR(CPE_ENC_DTE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) BETWEEN 11 AND 50 AND CPE_CPE_APPT_STS = 'Sch' AND CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID IN ('5108', '5110', '5111', '5112', '5113', '5103', '5104', '5105', '5106', '5107', '6650', '6648', '11472', '6649', '6653', '11879', '6651', '11470', '6652', '11458', '11459', '11460', '11461', '11463', '11464', '11465', '11570', '11571', '11564', '11565', '11567', '11568', '11569', '11468', '11469', '6647', '11477') AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT DATE + 1 DAY AND CURRENT date + 14 DAYS AND CLD_CLD_CENTER = 'WES' ;
