prompt: Provide a list of  Mantle Cell Lymphoma patients with CNS from January 2013,  chemo treatments received, Hematopathology reports, Biopsy details and Lab-test Results
completion: SELECT PT_MRN, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, PT_SEX AS GENDER, PLA_LST_KNOWN_ALIVE_DTE AS LAST_KNOWN_ALIVE, TM_DX_DTE , HIST_DESC AS HISTOLOGY , SITE_DESC AS SITE , MIN_ICD9_EFF_DTE AS EFFECTIVE_DATE , ICD9_CD , ICD9_DESC FROM IDB.PATIENT JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY ON PLA_MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN (SELECT TM_MRN, AV_DESC AS CASE_STS, TM_DX_DTE, TM_HIST_CD, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS HIST_DESC, TM_SITE_CD, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_DESC FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS ON AV_ELEMENT = 'CASE_STS' AND AV_CODE = TM_CASE_STS AND TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND (SUBSTR(TM_SITE_CD, 1, 6) IN ('C79.49', 'C85.89', 'C79.49', 'C85.89', 'C85.99') OR SUBSTR(TM_SITE_CD, 1, 5) IN ('G96.9', 'C72.9', 'D49.7') OR SUBSTR(TM_SITE_CD, 1, 7) = 'G98.198' ) AND TM_DX_DTE >= '2013-01-01') AS CDB ON TM_MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN (SELECT CC_MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS MIN_ICD9_EFF_DTE, CC_CLSF_CD AS ICD9_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS ICD9_DESC FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE CC_CLSF_CD IN ('G98.198', 'C79.49', 'G96.9', 'C72.9', 'C85.89', 'C79.49', 'C85.89', 'C85.99', 'D49.7') AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND (CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) GROUP BY CC_MRN, CC_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK HAVING MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) >= '2013-01-01') AS ICD9 ON CC_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE COALESCE(TM_MRN, CC_MRN) IS NOT NULL

prompt: Provide a weekly list of the neuroblastoma and osteosarcoma patients with HLA-A*02:01, HLA-A*02:02, HLA-A*02:03 or HLA A*02:06 allele.
completion: WITH X AS (SELECT DISTINCT STRIP(PT_MRN) AS MRN, STRIP(PT_LAST_NAME) || ', ' || STRIP(PT_FIRST_NAME) AS "Name", PT_BIRTH_DTE AS DOB, PT_SEX AS "Gender", PT_DEATH_DTE AS DOD, PT_VITAL_STATUS AS "Vital Status", PDRX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID AS PT_ID, T.* FROM DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML DT ON PDRX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID CROSS JOIN XMLTABLE('$c/root/*' PASSING DT.PDRX_XML_VALUE AS "c" COLUMNS PATIENTID VARCHAR(100) PATH '../meta-data/dmp_patient_id', SAMPLEID VARCHAR(100) PATH '../meta-data/dmp_sample_id', TUMOR_TYPE_CODE VARCHAR(100) PATH '../meta-data/tumor_type_code', TUMOR_TYPE_NAME VARCHAR(255) PATH '../meta-data/tumor_type_name', PRIMARY_SITE VARCHAR(255) PATH '../meta-data/primary_site') T WHERE TUMOR_TYPE_CODE IN ('MPNST', 'NBL', 'SYNS', 'OS', 'OSOS') ) , Y AS (SELECT DISTINCT MRN, "Name", DOB, "Gender", STRIP(R.AV_DESC) AS "Race", STRIP(E.AV_DESC) AS "Ethnicity", DOD, "Vital Status", PT_ID, PATIENTID AS "DMP Patient ID", STRIP(SAMPLEID) || ' [' || STRIP(TUMOR_TYPE_CODE) || '] ' || STRIP(TUMOR_TYPE_NAME) AS "DMP Samples", PLA_LST_SURG_DTE AS "Last Surgery Date", STRIP(PHLA_A1) AS HLA_A1, STRIP(PHLA_A2) AS HLA_A2 FROM X LEFT JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_HLA ON PT_ID = PHLA_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS R ON PT_RACE = R.AV_CODE AND R.AV_ELEMENT = 'RACE' LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS E ON PT_PT_ETHNICITY = E.AV_CODE AND E.AV_ELEMENT = 'PT_ETHNICITY' LEFT JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY ON MRN = PLA_MRN WHERE(PHLA_A1 like '%hla_a_02%' OR PHLA_A2 like '%hla_a_02%') AND PHLA_A1 not like '%hla_a_02_05%' AND PHLA_A2 not like '%hla_a_02_05%') , SAMPLES AS (SELECT MRN, LISTAGG(COALESCE(STRIP(CAST("DMP Samples" AS VARCHAR(2000))), '') , CHR(13) || CHR(10)) WITHIN GROUP( ORDER BY "DMP Samples") AS "DMP Samples" FROM Y GROUP BY MRN) SELECT DISTINCT Y.MRN, "Name", DOB, "Gender", "Race", "Ethnicity", DOD, "Vital Status", PT_ID, "DMP Patient ID", S."DMP Samples", "Last Surgery Date", HLA_A1, HLA_A2 FROM Y LEFT JOIN SAMPLES S ON Y.MRN = S.MRN

prompt: Provide numbers for inpatient and outpatient visits for peds leukmia/lymphoma by research vs non-research patients.
completion: WITH OUTP AS (SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN, CPE_ENC_DTE, CVT_IN_OUT_PT, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND YEAR(CPE_ENC_DTE) IN ('2020', '2021', '2022', '2023') AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 = ('PED') AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 IN ('LEU', 'LYM') AND CPE_CPE_IP_IND <> 'INPATIENT' UNION SELECT DISTINCT VIS_MRN, VIS_ADM_DTE, VIS_IP_OP_ADJUSTED_IND, VIS_HOSP_SVC, NULL AS SERVICE FROM IDB.VISIT WHERE VIS_HOSP_SVC IN ('PDB', 'PDG', 'PDP', 'PDR', 'PDU', 'PED', 'PDS') AND VIS_IP_OP_ADJUSTED_IND = 'I' AND VIS_VISIT_STATUS IN ('2', '3') AND YEAR(VIS_ADM_DTE) IN ('2020', '2021', '2022', '2023') ), DIAG AS (SELECT PT_MRN, CASE_STS, TRIM(TM_DX_DTE)|| '= '|| TRIM(TM_SITE_CD) ||'- ' || TRIM(SITE_DESC) AS ICDO_DETAILS, TRIM(MIN_ICD9_EFF_DTE)|| '= '|| TRIM(ICD9_CD)||'- '|| TRIM(ICD9_DESC) AS ICD9_DETAILS FROM IDB.PATIENT LEFT JOIN (SELECT TM_MRN, AV_DESC AS CASE_STS, TM_DX_DTE, TM_HIST_CD, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS HIST_DESC, TM_SITE_CD, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_DESC FROM OUTP LEFT JOIN IDB.CDB_TUMOR ON CPE_MRN =TM_MRN JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS ON AV_ELEMENT = 'CASE_STS' AND AV_CODE = TM_CASE_STS AND TM_CASE_STS IN ('3', '6', '7', '8') AND YEAR(TM_DX_DTE) IN ('2020', '2021', '2022', '2023')) AS CDB ON TM_MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN (SELECT CC_MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS MIN_ICD9_EFF_DTE, CC_CLSF_CD AS ICD9_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS ICD9_DESC FROM OUTP LEFT JOIN IDB.CTC_CLSF ON CPE_MRN = CC_MRN JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE CASE WHEN CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y' AND CC_PT_TYPE <> 'E' THEN 'Y' WHEN CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' AND YEAR(CC_EFF_DTE) < 2004 THEN 'Y' WHEN CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND YEAR(CC_EFF_DTE) < 2001 THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END = 'Y' GROUP BY CC_MRN, CC_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK HAVING YEAR(MIN(CC_EFF_DTE)) IN ('2020', '2021', '2022', '2023')) AS ICD9 ON CC_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE COALESCE(TM_MRN, CC_MRN) IS NOT NULL ) , ICDO AS (SELECT PT_MRN AS ICDO_MRN, LISTAGG(COALESCE(STRIP(CAST(ICDO_DETAILS AS VARCHAR(32000))), '') , CHR(13) || CHR(10)) WITHIN GROUP( ORDER BY PT_MRN, ICDO_DETAILS) AS ICDO_DATA FROM (SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN, ICDO_DETAILS FROM DIAG) GROUP BY PT_MRN) , ICD9 AS (SELECT PT_MRN AS ICD9_MRN, LISTAGG(COALESCE(STRIP(CAST(ICD9_DETAILS AS VARCHAR(32000))), '') , CHR(13) || CHR(10)) WITHIN GROUP( ORDER BY PT_MRN, ICD9_DETAILS) AS ICD9_DATA FROM (SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN, ICD9_DETAILS FROM DIAG) GROUP BY PT_MRN) , INCNT AS (SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN IN_MRN, COUNT(CVT_IN_OUT_PT) INP_COUNT FROM (SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN, CVT_IN_OUT_PT, CPE_ENC_DTE FROM OUTP WHERE CVT_IN_OUT_PT= 'I') GROUP BY CPE_MRN) SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8, CVT_IN_OUT_PT, AC_MRN AS X_MRN, INP_COUNT INPATIENT_ADMISSION_COUNT, ICD9_DATA, ICDO_DATA, ACD_CONS_DTE AS X_CONS_DTE, ACD_OFF_STUDY_DTE, PRO_IRB_NO AS X_IRB_NO, CASE WHEN LOWER(PRO_PROTOCOL_TYPE) LIKE '%therapeutic%' THEN 'yes' ELSE 'no' END AS THERAPEUTIC_STATUS FROM OUTP LEFT JOIN IDB.ACCRUALS ON CPE_MRN = AC_MRN LEFT JOIN INCNT ON CPE_MRN = IN_MRN LEFT JOIN ICD9 ON CPE_MRN = ICD9_MRN LEFT JOIN ICDO ON CPE_MRN =ICDO_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.PROTOCOL ON PRO_IRB_NO = AC_IRB_NO LEFT JOIN IDB.ACCRUALS_DATES ON AC_IRB_NO = ACD_IRB_NO AND AC_SUBJ_ID_NO = ACD_SUBJ_ID_NO AND AC_SUBJ_SEQ_NO = ACD_SUBJ_SEQ_NO ; SELECT DISTINCT VIS_MRN, VIS_ADM_DTE, VIS_IP_OP_ADJUSTED_IND, VIS_HOSP_SVC, VIS_ADM_DTE, VIS_DSCH_DTE, VIS_DAYS_STAY FROM IDB.VISIT WHERE VIS_HOSP_SVC IN ('PDB', 'PDG', 'PDP', 'PDR', 'PDU', 'PED', 'PDS') AND VIS_IP_OP_ADJUSTED_IND = 'I' AND VIS_VISIT_STATUS IN ('2', '3') AND YEAR(VIS_ADM_DTE) IN ('2020', '2021', '2022', '2023') ; WITH OUTP AS (SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN, CPE_ENC_DTE, CVT_IN_OUT_PT, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8, CAST(NULL AS DATE) ADMIT_DATE, CAST(NULL AS DATE) DISCHARGE_DATE FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND YEAR(CPE_ENC_DTE) IN ('2020', '2021', '2022', '2023') AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 = ('PED') AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 IN ('LEU', 'LYM') AND CPE_CPE_IP_IND <> 'INPATIENT' UNION SELECT DISTINCT VIS_MRN, VIS_ADM_DTE, VIS_IP_OP_ADJUSTED_IND, VIS_HOSP_SVC, NULL AS SERVICE, VIS_ADM_DTE, VIS_DSCH_DTE FROM IDB.VISIT WHERE VIS_HOSP_SVC IN ('PDB', 'PDG', 'PDP', 'PDR', 'PDU', 'PED', 'PDS') AND VIS_IP_OP_ADJUSTED_IND = 'I' AND VIS_VISIT_STATUS IN ('2', '3') AND YEAR(VIS_ADM_DTE) IN ('2020', '2021', '2022', '2023') ) SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CPE_MRN) MRN_COUNT, YEAR_WISE, CVT_IN_OUT_PT FROM (SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN, YEAR(CPE_ENC_DTE) YEAR_WISE, CVT_IN_OUT_PT FROM OUTP) GROUP BY CVT_IN_OUT_PT, YEAR_WISE ORDER BY YEAR_WISE

prompt: Provide a list of hpv positive oropharynx cancer patients with hpv negative OPC recurrence.
completion: WITH DX AS (SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN, PT_SEX GENDER, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH DOB, PT_DATE_OF_DEATH DOD, MIN (COALESCE (TM_DX_DTE, MIN_ICD9_EFF_DTE)) DX_DATE FROM IDB.PATIENT LEFT JOIN (SELECT TM_MRN, TM_DX_DTE, TM_SITE_CD, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_DESC FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD AND TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND TM_SITE_CD IN ('C019', ' C028', ' C051', 'C052', 'C058', 'C090', 'C091', 'C099', 'C0100', 'C0101', 'C0102', 'C0103', 'C0108') AND TM_DX_DTE BETWEEN '2000-01-01' AND '2022-04-01') AS CDB ON TM_MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN (SELECT CC_MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS MIN_ICD9_EFF_DTE, CC_CLSF_CD AS ICD9_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS ICD9_DESC FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE CC_CLSF_CD IN ('141.0', '141.5', '145.3', '145.4', '145.5', '146', '146.0', '146.1', '146.2', '146.3', '146.4', '146.5', '146.6', '146.7', '146.8', '146.9', '149', '149.8', 'C01.9', 'C02.4', 'C05.1', 'C05.2', 'C09.0', 'C09.1', 'C09.8', 'C09.9', 'C10.0', 'C10.2', 'C10.3', 'C10.8', 'C10.9', 'C11.1') AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND (CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) GROUP BY CC_MRN, CC_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK HAVING MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) BETWEEN '2000-01-01' AND '2022-04-01') AS ICD9 ON CC_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE COALESCE(TM_MRN, CC_MRN) IS NOT NULL GROUP BY PT_MRN, PT_SEX, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, PT_DATE_OF_DEATH ) , APPT AS (SELECT CPE_MRN , CPE_ENC_DTE , ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CPE_MRN ORDER BY CPE_ENC_DTE DESC) LAT_APPT FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN DX ON CPE_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CRE_RES_TYP = 'Physician' AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 = 'HNS' AND CPE_CPE_IP_IND <> 'INPATIENT' ) , POS_PATH AS (SELECT POS_MRN, MIN(POS_RPT_DATE) AS POS_RPT_DATE, FLAG_POSITIVE FROM (SELECT DISTINCT PRPT_MRN POS_MRN, PRPT_REPORT_DTE AS POS_RPT_DATE, CASE WHEN REGEXP_SUBSTR(LOWER (CAST (PRPT_REPORT AS VARCHAR(18000))), '(?:[^.]|^)[^.]*(?:hpv|p16)[^.]*positive[^.]*') IS NOT NULL OR REGEXP_SUBSTR(LOWER (CAST (PRPT_REPORT AS VARCHAR(18000))), '(?:[^.]|^)[^.]*positive[^.]*(?:hpv|p16)[^.]*') IS NOT NULL THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS FLAG_POSITIVE FROM DX JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V ON PRPT_MRN = PT_MRN) WHERE FLAG_POSITIVE ='Y' GROUP BY POS_MRN, FLAG_POSITIVE) , NEG_PATH AS (SELECT NEG_MRN, MIN(NEG_RPT_DATE) AS NEG_RPT_DATE, FLAG_NEGATIVE FROM (SELECT DISTINCT PRPT_MRN AS NEG_MRN, PRPT_REPORT_DTE AS NEG_RPT_DATE, CASE WHEN REGEXP_SUBSTR(LOWER (CAST (PRPT_REPORT AS VARCHAR(18000))), '(?:[^.]|^)[^.]*(?:hpv|p16)[^.]*negative[^.]*') IS NOT NULL OR REGEXP_SUBSTR(LOWER (CAST (PRPT_REPORT AS VARCHAR(18000))), '(?:[^.]|^)[^.]*negative[^.]*(?:hpv|p16)[^.]*') IS NOT NULL THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS FLAG_NEGATIVE FROM POS_PATH JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V N ON PRPT_MRN = POS_MRN AND N.PRPT_REPORT_DTE >= POS_RPT_DATE + 365 ) WHERE FLAG_NEGATIVE = 'Y' GROUP BY NEG_MRN, FLAG_NEGATIVE) SELECT D.*, CPE_ENC_DTE AS LAST_APPOINTMENT, POS_RPT_DATE, FLAG_POSITIVE, NEG_RPT_DATE, FLAG_NEGATIVE FROM DX D LEFT JOIN APPT ON CPE_MRN = PT_MRN AND LAT_APPT =1 LEFT JOIN POS_PATH P ON PT_MRN = POS_MRN LEFT JOIN NEG_PATH N ON PT_MRN = NEG_MRN

prompt: Patients with adenocarcinoma of the bladder
completion: WITH APPT AS (SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN '2000-01-01' AND '2020-08-14' AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 = 'GU' AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_7 = 'SOL' ) SELECT DISTINCT TM_MRN, PT_SEX, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, PT_DATE_OF_DEATH, PLA_LST_APPT_DTE, AV_DESC AS CASE_STS, TM_DX_DTE, TM_HIST_CD, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS HIST_DESC, TM_SITE_CD, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_DESC, TM_BEST_AJCC_STG FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS ON AV_ELEMENT = 'CASE_STS' AND AV_CODE = TM_CASE_STS JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON TM_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY ON TM_MRN = PLA_MRN JOIN APPT ON TM_MRN = CPE_MRN WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND TM_SITE_CD LIKE 'C67%' AND TM_DX_DTE BETWEEN '2000-01-01' AND '2020-08-14' AND TM_HIST_CD IN ('M8144/3', 'M8255/3', 'M8210/3', 'M8261/3', 'M8574/3', 'M8140/2', 'M8140/3', 'M8560/3', 'M8310/3', 'M8480/3', 'M8481/3', 'M8260/3') ORDER BY TM_MRN, TM_DX_DTE ; WITH APPT AS (SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN '2000-01-01' AND '2020-08-14' AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 = 'GU' AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_7 = 'SOL' ) , DX AS (SELECT DISTINCT TM_MRN, TM_DX_DTE FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN APPT ON TM_MRN = CPE_MRN WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND TM_SITE_CD LIKE 'C67%' AND TM_DX_DTE BETWEEN '2000-01-01' AND '2020-08-14' AND TM_HIST_CD IN ('M8144/3', 'M8255/3', 'M8210/3', 'M8261/3', 'M8574/3', 'M8140/2', 'M8140/3', 'M8560/3', 'M8310/3', 'M8480/3', 'M8481/3', 'M8260/3') ) SELECT SSE_MRN, TM_DX_DTE, SSE_SURG_DTE, SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD, SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC, SSP_SURG_LAST_NM, SSP_SURG_FIRST_NM, SSP_SURG_SVC_CD FROM IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE ON SSE_LOG_ID = SSP_LOG_ID AND SSE_ENC_CSN_ID = SSP_ENC_CSN_ID JOIN DX ON SSE_MRN = TM_MRN WHERE (SSE_SURG_LOC not like '%IR%' AND SSE_SURG_LOC not like '%ENDO%' AND SSE_SOURCE_TYPE <> 'E') AND SSE_SURG_DTE BETWEEN '2000-01-01' AND '2020-08-14' ORDER BY 1, 2, 3 ; WITH APPT AS (SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN '2000-01-01' AND '2020-08-14' AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 = 'GU' AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_7 = 'SOL' ) , DX AS (SELECT DISTINCT TM_MRN, TM_DX_DTE FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN APPT ON TM_MRN = CPE_MRN WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND TM_SITE_CD LIKE 'C67%' AND TM_DX_DTE BETWEEN '2000-01-01' AND '2020-08-14' AND TM_HIST_CD IN ('M8144/3', 'M8255/3', 'M8210/3', 'M8261/3', 'M8574/3', 'M8140/2', 'M8140/3', 'M8560/3', 'M8310/3', 'M8480/3', 'M8481/3', 'M8260/3') ) SELECT APR_MRN, CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME, MIN(APR_START_DTE) AS FIRST_START_DTE, MAX(APR_START_DTE) AS LAST_START_DTE FROM IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX JOIN IDB.CHEMO_DRUG_GENERIC ON APR_GENERIC_NAME = CDG_GENERIC_NAME JOIN DX ON APR_MRN = TM_MRN WHERE APR_START_DTE BETWEEN '2000-01-01' AND '2020-08-14' AND CDG_CHEMO_FLAG = 'Y' GROUP BY APR_MRN, CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME ORDER BY APR_MRN, CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME

prompt: EGFR mutated Lung Cancer Patients
completion: WITH DX AS (SELECT PT_MRN AS DX_MRN, MIN(DT_DTE) AS DX_DTE FROM DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS JOIN DV.PATIENT_DIAGNOSIS_FINAL_ALL_V ON PDX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID JOIN DV.DATE_V ON PDX_DX_DATE_ID = DT_DATE_ID JOIN DV.DIAGNOSIS_CATALOG ON PDX_DX_CATALOG_ID = DXCC_DX_CATALOG_ID WHERE SUBSTR(DXCC_ICD_CODE, 1, 3) IN ('162', 'C34') GROUP BY PT_MRN) , GENE AS (SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN DX_MRN, DX_DTE FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_STRUCTURED_RESULTS_V JOIN DX ON DX_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE GENE = 'EGFR' ) , PRO06107 AS (SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN PRO06107_MRN, AC_CONS_DTE PRO06107_CONS_DTE FROM DV.PROTOCOL JOIN DV.ACCRUALS ON PRO_PROTOCOL_ID = AC_PROTOCOL_ID JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON AC_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID JOIN GENE ON PT_MRN = DX_MRN WHERE PRO_IRB_NO = '06-107' ) , PRO12245 AS (SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN PRO12245_MRN, AC_CONS_DTE PRO12245_CONS_DTE FROM DV.PROTOCOL JOIN DV.ACCRUALS ON PRO_PROTOCOL_ID = AC_PROTOCOL_ID JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON AC_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID JOIN GENE ON PT_MRN = DX_MRN WHERE PRO_IRB_NO = '12-245' ) SELECT PRPT_MRN "MRN", PT_LAST_NAME "Last Name", PT_FIRST_NAME "First Name", PT_BIRTH_DTE "Date of Birth", DX_DTE "Tumor Dx Date", PRO06107_CONS_DTE "06-107 Consent", PRO12245_CONS_DTE "12-245 Consent", PRPT_PROCEDURE_DTE "Report Procedure Date", PRPT_REPORT_DTE "Report Date", PRPT_REPORT_TYPE_DESC "Report Type", PRPT_ACCESSION_NO "Accession No", PRPT_REPORT "Report Text" FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V JOIN GENE ON PRPT_MRN = DX_MRN JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON PRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID LEFT JOIN PRO06107 ON PRPT_MRN = PRO06107_MRN LEFT JOIN PRO12245 ON PRPT_MRN = PRO12245_MRN WHERE PRPT_REPORT IS NOT NULL AND CONTAINS("PRPT_REPORT", '(("squamous" OR "adenosquamous") AND "lung")') = 1 ORDER BY 1 DESC, 5 DESC, 8 DESC

prompt: Provide a list of patients with specified gene fusions as shown on DMP testing at MSK.
completion: SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN, GENE, GENE2, METHOD, ABERRATIONTYPE FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_STRUCTURED_RESULTS_V WHERE ((GENE = 'EWSR1' OR GENE2 = 'EWSR1') AND (GENE = 'ERG' OR GENE2 = 'ERG')) OR ((GENE = 'FUS' OR GENE2 = 'FUS') AND (GENE = 'ERG' OR GENE2 = 'ERG')) OR ((GENE = 'EWSR1' OR GENE2 = 'EWSR1') AND (GENE = 'FEV' OR GENE2 = 'FEV')) OR ((GENE = 'FUS' OR GENE2 = 'FUS') AND (GENE = 'FEV' OR GENE2 = 'FEV'))

prompt: Would like to know the number of current smokers that we see at the Ralph Lauren Center ()all providers) that are current smokers for the period: April 1, 2019 to present
completion: WITH APPT AS (SELECT CPE_MRN FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID AND CLD_CLD_CENTER = '1919' JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') ) , SMOKE AS (SELECT CDD_MRN, CDD_SERVICE_DTE, CDO_VALUE_TEXT, ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY CDD_MRN ORDER BY CDD_SERVICE_DTE DESC) AS RN FROM IDB.CD_DOCUMENT JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION ON CDD_DOC_GUID = CDO_DOC_GUID AND CDD_AUTHORED_DTE = CDO_AUTHORED_DTE AND CDO_VALUE_TEXT <> '' JOIN APPT ON CDD_MRN = CPE_MRN WHERE CDD_CANCEL_IND <> '1' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND <> '1' AND CDD_SERVICE_DTE >= '2019-04-01' AND CDO_ITEM_NAME IN ('Smoking Status', 'Smoking status') AND CDO_VALUE_TEXT IN ('Current some day smoker', 'Current every day smoker') ) SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CDD_MRN) AS "Number of Current Smoker" , COUNT(DISTINCT CPE_MRN) AS "Total RL Patients" FROM APPT LEFT JOIN SMOKE ON CPE_MRN = CDD_MRN AND RN = 1

prompt: Patients at all sites (Main + regionals) that have suspected or confirmed stage IB - IIIA lung cancer (NSCLC). Pathology report or IMPACT report must be EGFR or ALK positive.
completion: SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN AS "MRN", PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, CPE_ENC_DTE AS "Appt Date", CLD_DEPT_NAME AS "Department Name", CRE_RES_NAME AS "Provider Name", CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME AS "Visit Type", SSE_SURG_DTE SURG_DTE, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS HIST_DESC, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_DESC, CASE WHEN S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK IS NULL THEN I.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK END AS ICD_DESC FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID JOIN IDB.PATIENT A ON A.PT_MRN = CPE_MRN JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_STRUCTURED_RESULTS_V B ON B.PT_MRN = A.PT_MRN AND B.GENE IN ('EGFR', 'EGFR vIII', 'EGFR VIII', 'EGFRvIII', 'ALK') LEFT JOIN IDB.CDB_TUMOR ON CPE_MRN = TM_MRN AND TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') LEFT JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD LEFT JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD LEFT JOIN IDB.CTC_CLSF ON CC_MRN = CPE_MRN AND CC_CLSF_CD like 'C%' AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND (CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) LEFT JOIN IDB.CLM I ON CC_CLSF_CD = I.CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT ON SSE_MRN = CPE_MRN AND SSE_SURG_DTE > CURRENT date - 75 DAYS JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE ON SSE_LOG_ID = SSP_LOG_ID AND SSP_SURG_SVC_CD = 'THO' WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Sch', 'Arrived', 'Comp') AND CRE_RES_TYP IN ('Physician') AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 = 'SRG' AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 = 'THR' AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT date AND CURRENT date + 14 DAYS

prompt: Patients 18 years old and older diagnosed with stage I,II, or III breast, colorectal or gynecological cancer less than 5 years ago
completion: SELECT TM_MRN "MRN", PT_LAST_NAME "Last Name", PT_FIRST_NAME "First Name", PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH "DOB", PT_SEX "Gender", YEAR(CURRENT DATE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) "Current Age", PT_ADDR1 "Address 1", PT_ADDR2 "Address 2", PT_CITY "City", PT_STATE "State", PT_ZIP_CD "Zip", CPP_LANG "Language", TM_DX_DTE "Tumor Dx Date", TM_PATH_TNM_T "Path T Stage", TM_PATH_TNM_N "Path N Stage", TM_PATH_TNM_M "Path M Stage", TM_PATH_STG_GRP "Path Stage Group", TM_SITE_CD AS "Tumor Site Code", S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS "Tumor Site Desc", TM_HIST_CD AS "Tumor Histology Code", H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS "Tumor Histology Desc", TM_CASE_STS "Tumor Case Status Code", CS.AV_DESC AS "Tumor Case Status Desc" FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM H ON TM_HIST_CD = H.CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON TM_SITE_CD = S.CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.SEERGROUPING ON IDB.SEERF_ICDO(TM_SITE_CD, TM_HIST_CD) = RECODE JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON TM_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_PAS_PATIENT ON TM_MRN = CPP_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS CS ON CS.AV_ELEMENT = 'CASE_STS' AND CS.AV_CODE = TM_CASE_STS WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7') AND (CATEGORY1 IN ('Breast', 'Female Genital System') OR CATEGORY2 = 'Colon and Rectum') AND YEAR(CURRENT DATE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) >= 18 AND YEAR(CURRENT DATE - TM_DX_DTE) < 5 AND CPP_LANG IN ('ENG', '') AND TM_PATH_STG_GRP NOT LIKE '4%' ;

prompt: Provide pathology, antineoplastic, smoking, performance, and demographic data for patients with pathology search terms related to "thoracic SMARCA4- deficient undifferentiated tumor" detection (rare).
completion: WITH PATH AS (SELECT DISTINCT PRPT_MRN, PRPT_PATH_RPT_ID AS RID , PRPT_ACCESSION_NO, PRPT_REPORT_DTE, PRPT_PROCEDURE_DTE, PRPT_REPORT_TYPE_DESC , TRIM(DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)(?<=(^|[\.]))[^\.]*(smarca-1|smarca1|smarca-2|smarca2|smarca-3|smarca3|smarca-4|smarca4)[^\.]*', PRPT_REPORT)) AS TARGET_EXTRACT , VARCHAR(PRPT_REPORT, 32000) AS "Report Text (first 32000 characters)" FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V WHERE 1=1 AND UPPER(PRPT_REPORT_TYPE_DESC) like '%SURG%' AND CONTAINS(PRPT_REPORT, '("smarca-1" OR "smarca1" OR "smarca-2" OR "smarca2" OR "smarca-3" OR "smarca3" OR "smarca-4" OR "smarca4" ) AND "deficient"') = 1 AND PRPT_REPORT IS NOT NULL ) , REFS AS (SELECT PRPTR_PATH_RPT_ID AS SRG_RID, PRPTR_CHILD_PATH_RPT_ID AS ASSOC_RID FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_REFERENCES WHERE PRPTR_PATH_RPT_ID IN (SELECT RID FROM PATH) ) , PATH_FROM_REFS AS (SELECT PATH.PRPT_MRN, RID, ASSOC_RID , PATH.PRPT_ACCESSION_NO, PATH.PRPT_REPORT_DTE, PATH.PRPT_PROCEDURE_DTE, PATH.PRPT_REPORT_TYPE_DESC , TARGET_EXTRACT , "Report Text (first 32000 characters)" , ASSOC.PRPT_ACCESSION_NO AS "Assoc Accession" , ASSOC.PRPT_REPORT_TYPE AS "Assoc Type" FROM PATH JOIN REFS ON SRG_RID = RID JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT ASSOC ON ASSOC.PRPT_PATH_RPT_ID = ASSOC_RID ) , DMP_ATTRIBUTES_FROM_REFS AS (SELECT DISTINCT PATH.PRPT_MRN, RID, ASSOC_RID , PATH.PRPT_ACCESSION_NO, PATH.PRPT_REPORT_DTE, PATH.PRPT_PROCEDURE_DTE, PATH.PRPT_REPORT_TYPE_DESC , TARGET_EXTRACT , "Report Text (first 32000 characters)" , ASSOC.PRPT_ACCESSION_NO AS "Assoc Accession" , T.* , PDRX_DMP_PATIENT_ID , PDRX_DMP_SAMPLE_ID FROM PATH JOIN REFS ON SRG_RID = RID JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT ASSOC ON ASSOC.PRPT_PATH_RPT_ID = ASSOC_RID LEFT JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML DT ON PDRX_PATH_RPT_ID = ASSOC_RID CROSS JOIN XMLTABLE('$c/root/ *' PASSING DT.PDRX_XML_VALUE AS "c" COLUMNS DT_PROCEDURE VARCHAR(100) PATH '../meta-data/dt_procedure' , PRIMARY_SITE VARCHAR(264) PATH '../meta-data/primary_site' , TUMOR_TYPE_NAME VARCHAR(264) PATH '../meta-data/tumor_type_name' , M_ACCESSION_NUM VARCHAR(264) PATH '../meta-data/m_accession_num' , GENE_PANEL VARCHAR(264) PATH '../meta-data/gene-panel' , PART_DESCRIPTION VARCHAR(264) PATH '../meta-data/part_description') T) , DT AS (SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN AS MRN , PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID FROM PATH JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON PT_MRN = PRPT_MRN) , ANTINEO_PRE AS (SELECT APR_MRN , APR_GENERIC_NAME , MIN(COALESCE(APR_START_DTE, APR_ORD_CREATE_DTE)) AS MIN_START_DTE_VAR , MAX(APR_END_DTE) AS MAX_END_DTE FROM IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX_V JOIN DT ON APR_MRN = MRN WHERE 1=1 GROUP BY APR_MRN , APR_GENERIC_NAME) , ANTINEO_LISTAGG AS (SELECT APR_MRN, LISTAGG(COALESCE(TRIM(APR_GENERIC_NAME), '') || ' | ' || COALESCE(TRIM(CAST(MIN_START_DTE_VAR AS VARCHAR(12000))), '') || ' | ' || COALESCE(TRIM(MAX_END_DTE), '') , CHR(13) || CHR(10)) WITHIN GROUP( ORDER BY MIN_START_DTE_VAR) AS "Antineoplastic Source" FROM ANTINEO_PRE GROUP BY APR_MRN) , ANTINEO_DETAIL AS (SELECT DISTINCT APR_MRN AS MRN , APR_START_DTE AS "Start Date", APR_END_DTE AS "End Date", APR_ORD_CREATE_DTE AS "Create Date" , CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME AS "Common Generic Name" , APR_DRUG_NAME AS "Drug Name" , APR_ORD_RX_TYPE AS "Rx Type" , APR_ROUTE AS "Route" , CASE WHEN APR_DRUG_PROCESS_STAGE = 'A' THEN 'ADMIN' WHEN APR_DRUG_PROCESS_STAGE = 'P' THEN 'PRESCRIPTION' WHEN APR_DRUG_PROCESS_STAGE = 'D' THEN 'DISPENSE' WHEN APR_DRUG_PROCESS_STAGE = 'H' THEN 'HOME MEDS' WHEN APR_DRUG_PROCESS_STAGE = 'S' THEN 'ASSUMED ADMIN' END AS "Drug Process Stage" , APR_QTY AS "Qty", APR_FREQ AS "Freq", APR_DURATION AS "Duration", APR_DIAGNOSIS_DESC AS "Diagnosis Desc", APR_PROVIDER_NAME AS "Provider Name", APR_PROVIDER_ROLE AS "Provider Role" , APR_TOTAL_GIVEN_DOSE AS "Given Dose" , APR_PERFORMED_ORDERS_QTY_TEXT AS "Performed Orders QTY" , APR_SET_NAME AS "Set Name", APR_SET_FORM_NAME AS "Set Form Name" , APR_INVESTIGATIVE_FLAG AS "Investigative Flag", APR_PLACEBO_FLAG AS "Placebo", APR_TOPICAL_FLAG AS "Topical", CDG_CLASSIC_CHEMO_FLAG AS "Classic Chemo", CDG_BIOLOGIC_IMMUNO_FLAG AS "Biologic" , CDG_TARGETED_FLAG AS "Targeted", CDG_HORMONE_FLAG AS "Hormone", CDG_BONE_AGENTS_FLAG AS "Bone Agents", CDG_THERAPEUTIC_CATEGORY AS "Therapeutic Category" FROM IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX_V APR JOIN DT DT ON MRN = APR_MRN) SELECT * FROM ANTINEO_DETAIL ORDER BY MRN, "Common Generic Name", "Start Date" ;

prompt: Provide additional information in columns to this previously generated report
completion: WITH DSCH AS (SELECT VIS_VISIT_ID, VIS_ADM_NUM, VIS_MRN, VIS_ADM_DTE, VIS_DSCH_DTE, ADM_TYPE_DESC, DSCH_DISP_DESC DSCH_DISPOSITION, HOSP_SVC_DESC DSCH_HOSP_SERVICE, VIS_DAYS_STAY DAYS_STAY FROM IDB.VISIT_V WHERE VIS_VISIT_STATUS IN ('3') AND VIS_DSCH_DTE BETWEEN '2019-01-01' AND '2019-12-31' AND VIS_IP_OP_ADJUSTED_IND = 'I' ) , VST AS (SELECT MRN, MD_NAME, RES_TYP , VIS_ADM_NUM ADMNUM, APPT_DATE, DEPT , VISIT_TYPE FROM (SELECT CPE_MRN MRN, CRE_RES_NAME AS MD_NAME, CRE_RES_TYP AS RES_TYP , VIS_ADM_DTE, VIS_DSCH_DTE, VIS_ADM_NUM, CPE_ENC_DTE AS APPT_DATE , CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME AS VISIT_TYPE, CLD_CLD_CENTER AS SITE , CLD_DEPT_NAME DEPT , ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CPE_MRN, VIS_ADM_NUM ORDER BY CPE_ENC_DTE) RN FROM DSCH JOIN IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER ON CPE_MRN = VIS_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID = CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID WHERE CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN VIS_DSCH_DTE AND VIS_DSCH_DTE + 365 DAY AND CPE_CPE_IP_IND <> 'INPATIENT' AND CPE_ENC_TYP_CD = 50 AND CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Comp', 'Arrived') ) AS A WHERE RN = 1 ) , DSCH_SUM AS (SELECT CDD_DOC_GUID, CDD_MRN, CDD_ADM_NUM, DOCUMENT_NAME, CDD_ENTER_DT ENTERED_DT, CDD_SIGNED_DT SIGNED_DT, CASE WHEN CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND = '0' THEN 'Complete' WHEN CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND = '1' THEN 'Incomplete' END COMPLETE_IND FROM (SELECT CDD_DOC_GUID, CDD_MRN, CDD_ADM_NUM, ADM_TYPE_DESC, DSCH_DISPOSITION, DSCH_HOSP_SERVICE, CDD_DOC_NAME DOCUMENT_NAME, VIS_ADM_DTE, VIS_DSCH_DTE , CDD_SIGNED_DT, CDD_ENTER_DT, CDD_AUTHORED_DTE , CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND, ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY CDD_MRN, CDD_ADM_NUM ORDER BY CASE WHEN CDD_DOC_NAME = 'Discharge Summary' THEN 1 WHEN CDD_DOC_NAME like 'Discharge Summary -%' THEN 2 WHEN CDD_DOC_NAME like 'Discharge Note/Summary%' THEN 3 ELSE 4 END) RN FROM IDB.CD_DOCUMENT JOIN DSCH ON VIS_MRN = CDD_MRN AND VIS_ADM_NUM = CDD_ADM_NUM WHERE CDD_CANCEL_IND = '0' AND (CDD_DOC_NAME = 'Discharge Summary' OR CDD_DOC_NAME like 'Discharge Note/Summary%' OR CDD_DOC_NAME like 'Discharge Note%' OR CDD_DOC_NAME like 'Discharge Summary -%') ) AS A WHERE RN = 1 ) SELECT VIS_ADM_NUM ADM_NUM, VIS_MRN MRN, VIS_ADM_DTE ADM_DTE, VIS_DSCH_DTE DSCH_DTE, ADM_TYPE_DESC, DSCH_DISPOSITION, DSCH_HOSP_SERVICE, DAYS_STAY, DOCUMENT_NAME, ENTERED_DT, SIGNED_DT, COMPLETE_IND, MD_NAME, RES_TYP , APPT_DATE, DEPT , VISIT_TYPE FROM DSCH T0 LEFT JOIN VST T1 ON VIS_MRN = MRN AND VIS_ADM_NUM = ADMNUM LEFT JOIN DSCH_SUM T1 ON VIS_MRN = CDD_MRN AND VIS_ADM_NUM = CDD_ADM_NUM

prompt: Patient Lab results for HLA chimerism test post transplant results
completion: SELECT LR_MRN AS "MRN", TRIM(PT_LAST_NAME) || ', ' || TRIM(PT_FIRST_NAME) AS "Patient Name", LR_PERFORMED_DTE AS "Lab Test Date", LR_TEST_NAME AS "Lab Test Name", LR_SUBTEST_NAME AS "Lab Sub-test Name", LR_RESULT_VALUE AS "Result Value", LTL_TEXT_RESULT AS "Text Result" FROM IDB.LAB_RESULTS LEFT JOIN IDB.LAB_TEXT_LINE ON LTL_RESULT_GUID = LR_RESULT_GUID JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PT_MRN =LR_MRN WHERE 1=1 AND (LR_TEST_NAME LIKE '%Chimerism%' OR LR_TEST_NAME LIKE '%Post Transplant%')

prompt: All patients with DLBCL treated with brentuximab vedotin (Bv).
completion: WITH LYM AS (SELECT DISTINCT TM_MRN AS MRN, TM_DX_DTE AS DX_DATE, TM_HIST_CD AS DX_CODE, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS DX_DESC, CASE WHEN TM_AJCC_7 NOT IN ('', '888', '999') THEN AJCC7.AV_DESC WHEN TM_AJCC NOT IN ('', '88', '99') THEN AJCC.AV_DESC WHEN TM_GENERAL_STG NOT IN ('', '9') THEN GS.AV_DESC WHEN TM_PATH_STG_GRP NOT IN ('', '88', '9', '99') THEN TM_PATH_STG_GRP ELSE CLIN.AV_DESC END AS "Stage" FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.SEERGROUPING ON RECODE = IDB.SEERF_ICDO(TM_SITE_CD, TM_HIST_CD) AND CATEGORY1 = 'Lymphoma' JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS AJCC7 ON AJCC7.AV_ELEMENT = 'AJCC_7' AND AJCC7.AV_CODE = TM_AJCC_7 LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS AJCC ON AJCC.AV_ELEMENT = 'AJCC' AND AJCC.AV_CODE = TM_AJCC LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS GS ON GS.AV_ELEMENT = 'GENERAL_STG' AND GS.AV_CODE = TM_GENERAL_STG LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS CLIN ON CLIN.AV_ELEMENT = 'CLIN_STG_DSCR' AND CLIN.AV_CODE = TM_CLIN_STG_DSCR WHERE 1=1 AND TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND TM_HIST_CD IN ('M9679/3', 'M9680/3', 'M9681/3', 'M9688/3', 'M9714/3', 'M9738/3') AND TM_DX_DTE <= '2020-01-01' UNION SELECT CC_MRN AS MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS DX_DATE, CLM_CLSF_CD AS DX_CODE, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS DX_DESC, '' AS "Stage" FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND ((CC_PT_TYPE = 'I') OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) AND CC_CLSF_CD IN ('C83.30', 'C83.31', 'C83.32', 'C83.33', 'C83.34', 'C83.35', 'C83.36', 'C83.37', 'C83.38', 'C83.39') GROUP BY CC_MRN, CLM_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK, '' HAVING MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) <= '2020-01-01') , T4 AS (SELECT * FROM LYM) , APR AS (SELECT APR_MRN, APR_GENERIC_NAME, APR_DRUG_NAME, APR_SET_NAME, MIN(APR_START_DTE) AS APR_START_DTE, MAX(APR_END_DTE) AS APR_END_DTE, APR_DIAGNOSIS_DESC FROM (SELECT APR_MRN, APR_GENERIC_NAME, APR_DRUG_NAME, APR_START_DTE, APR_END_DTE, APR_DIAGNOSIS_DESC, APR_SET_NAME FROM T4 JOIN IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX_V ON MRN = APR_MRN WHERE(UPPER(APR_DRUG_NAME) LIKE '%BRENTUXIMAB VEDOTIN%' OR UPPER(APR_GENERIC_NAME) LIKE '%BRENTUXIMAB VEDOTIN%') AND(APR_START_DTE BETWEEN '2008-01-01' AND '2020-01-01') UNION SELECT APR_MRN, APR_GENERIC_NAME, APR_DRUG_NAME, APR_START_DTE, APR_END_DTE, APR_DIAGNOSIS_DESC, APR_SET_NAME FROM IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX_V WHERE(UPPER(APR_DRUG_NAME) LIKE '%BRENTUXIMAB VEDOTIN%' OR UPPER(APR_GENERIC_NAME) LIKE '%BRENTUXIMAB VEDOTIN%') AND(UPPER(APR_DIAGNOSIS_DESC) LIKE '%DIFFUSE%' OR UPPER(APR_DIAGNOSIS_DESC) LIKE '%DLBCL%' OR UPPER(APR_DIAGNOSIS_DESC) LIKE '%LARGE%B%CELL%') AND(APR_START_DTE BETWEEN '2008-01-01' AND '2020-01-01')) CH GROUP BY APR_MRN, APR_GENERIC_NAME, APR_DRUG_NAME, APR_SET_NAME, APR_DIAGNOSIS_DESC ) , X AS (SELECT DISTINCT APR_MRN AS MRN, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH AS DOB, PT_SEX AS GENDER, R.AV_DESC AS "Race", E.AV_DESC AS "Ethnicity", COALESCE(MAX(PLA_LST_APPT_DTE, PLA_LST_DSCH_DTE), PLA_LST_APPT_DTE, PLA_LST_DSCH_DTE) AS LAST_FU_DATE, PT_DATE_OF_DEATH AS DOD, DX_DATE, DX_CODE, DX_DESC, "Stage", APR_GENERIC_NAME, APR_DRUG_NAME, APR_SET_NAME, APR_START_DTE, APR_END_DTE, APR_DIAGNOSIS_DESC FROM APR LEFT JOIN T4 ON APR_MRN = MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON APR_MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY ON APR_MRN = PLA_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS R ON PT_RACE = R.AV_CODE AND R.AV_ELEMENT = 'RACE' LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS E ON PT_PT_ETHNICITY = E.AV_CODE AND E.AV_ELEMENT = 'PT_ETHNICITY') , BMT AS (SELECT CBM_MRN AS MRN, CBM_TRANSPLANT_TYPE AS TRANSPLANT_TYPE, CBM_TRANSPLANT_DTE AS TRANSPLANT_DATE FROM IDB.CRDB_BMT_MEDICINE JOIN X ON MRN = CBM_MRN AND CBM_TRANSPLANT_DTE <= '2020-01-01' UNION SELECT CBP_MRN AS MRN, CBP_TRANSPLANT_TYPE AS TRANSPLANT_TYPE, CBP_TRANSPLANT_DTE AS TRANSPLANT_DATE FROM IDB.CRDB_BMT_PEDIATRICS JOIN X ON MRN = CBP_MRN AND CBP_TRANSPLANT_DTE <= '2020-01-01') , Y AS (SELECT DISTINCT X.*, TRANSPLANT_TYPE, TRANSPLANT_DATE FROM X LEFT JOIN BMT ON X.MRN = BMT.MRN) SELECT * FROM Y

prompt: Patients with an appointment at Survivorship Breast Clinic
completion: WITH BASE AS (SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN AS MRN , TRIM(CLD_DEPT_NAME) AS DEPARTMENTNAME , CPE_ENC_DTE AS EVENT_DATE , CPE_APPT_DT AS EVENT_DT , 'Appointment' AS EVENT_TYPE , 'DV.PATIENT_ENCOUNTER' AS EVENT_SOURCE , CPE_ENC_CSN_ID AS EVENT_ID , TRIM(CRE_RES_NAME) EVENT_RESOURCE_NAME , TRIM(CRE_RES_ID) EVENT_RESOURCE_ID , TRIM(MP_EMAIL_ADDR) EVENT_RESOURCE_EMAIL , 1 EVENT_RESOURCE_PRIMARY_IND , TRIM(MP_SERVICE_DESC) EVENT_RESOURCE_SERVICE_DESC, TRIM(MP_SERVICE_CD) EVENT_RESOURCE_SERVICE_CODE , TRIM(MP_ACADEMIC_SVC_DESC) EVENT_RESOURCE_ACADEMIC_SERVICE, TRIM(MP_ACADEMIC_DEPT_DESC) EVENT_RESOURCE_ACADEMIC_DEPT , CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME, CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID = CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CLD_DEPT_ID = CPE_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON CPE_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN DV.MEDPRO ON MP_SOURCE_PROVIDER_NO = CPE_VST_RES_ID WHERE 1=1 AND CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('ApptReassgn', 'Arrived', 'Comp', 'Sch') AND CLD_DEPT_ID = 617 AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT date - 7 DAYS AND CURRENT date +7 DAYS ) , ADDITIONAL_DETAILS_PRE AS (SELECT MRN, EVENT_ID, EVENT_DATE, EVENT_DT , 'DepartmentName' AS NAME, DEPARTMENTNAME AS VALUE FROM BASE) , ADDITIONAL_DETAILS_VALIDATION AS (SELECT DISTINCT MRN, EVENT_ID, EVENT_DATE, EVENT_DT, NAME, VALUE FROM ADDITIONAL_DETAILS_PRE) , RESOURCES_VALIDATION AS (SELECT DISTINCT MRN, EVENT_ID, EVENT_DATE, EVENT_DT, EVENT_RESOURCE_ID, EVENT_RESOURCE_NAME, EVENT_RESOURCE_EMAIL, EVENT_RESOURCE_SERVICE_CODE, EVENT_RESOURCE_SERVICE_DESC, EVENT_RESOURCE_ACADEMIC_DEPT, EVENT_RESOURCE_ACADEMIC_SERVICE, EVENT_RESOURCE_PRIMARY_IND FROM BASE) , EVENTS_VALIDATION AS (SELECT DISTINCT MRN, EVENT_ID, EVENT_DATE, EVENT_DT, EVENT_TYPE, EVENT_SOURCE FROM BASE) , ADDITIONAL_DETAILS_XML AS (SELECT MRN, EVENT_ID, EVENT_DATE, EVENT_DT, XMLELEMENT(NAME "row", XMLCONCAT(XMLELEMENT(NAME NAME, NAME), XMLELEMENT(NAME VALUE, VALUE))) ADDITIONAL_DETAILS FROM ADDITIONAL_DETAILS_VALIDATION WHERE NAME <> '' ) , RESOURCES_XML AS (SELECT MRN, EVENT_ID, EVENT_DATE, EVENT_DT, XMLROW(EVENT_RESOURCE_ID, EVENT_RESOURCE_NAME, EVENT_RESOURCE_EMAIL, EVENT_RESOURCE_SERVICE_CODE, EVENT_RESOURCE_SERVICE_DESC, EVENT_RESOURCE_ACADEMIC_DEPT, EVENT_RESOURCE_ACADEMIC_SERVICE, EVENT_RESOURCE_PRIMARY_IND) EVENT_RESOURCES FROM RESOURCES_VALIDATION) , PRE_XML AS (SELECT TRIM(E.MRN) AS MRN , E.EVENT_TYPE , E.EVENT_SOURCE , E.EVENT_ID , E.EVENT_DATE , E.EVENT_DT , R.EVENT_RESOURCES , A.ADDITIONAL_DETAILS , VARCHAR_FORMAT(E.EVENT_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD-HH24-MI') ORDER_BY FROM EVENTS_VALIDATION E JOIN RESOURCES_XML R ON E.MRN = R.MRN AND E.EVENT_ID = R.EVENT_ID AND E.EVENT_DATE = R.EVENT_DATE AND E.EVENT_DT = R.EVENT_DT LEFT JOIN ADDITIONAL_DETAILS_XML A ON E.MRN = A.MRN AND E.EVENT_ID = A.EVENT_ID AND E.EVENT_DATE = A.EVENT_DATE AND E.EVENT_DT = A.EVENT_DT) , DEID AS ( SELECT PI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID P_ID , XMLDOCUMENT(XMLELEMENT(NAME COHORT_INCLUSION_EVENTS, XMLAGG(XMLROW(EVENT_TYPE, EVENT_SOURCE, EVENT_ID, EVENT_DATE, EVENT_DT, ORDER_BY, EVENT_RESOURCES, ADDITIONAL_DETAILS)))) $xmldata$ from dv.PATIENT_IDENTIFICATION join pre_xml on PI_SOURCE_SYSTEM_PT_ID = mrn and PI_PT_IDENTIFICATION_TYPE = 'MRN' GROUP BY pi_pt_deidentification_id )--select p_id, $xmldata$ FROM DEID

prompt: Provide survey data from Breast-Q MSK Engage Survey on a specified group of patients.
completion: SELECT DISTINCT EF_MRN "MRN", EF_FORM_ID "Survey ID", DATE(EF_SUBMISSION_DT) "Survey Date", EFI_ITEM_TEXT "Question", EFI_VALUE "Answer" FROM IDB.EF_ASSESSMENT LEFT JOIN IDB.EF_SCHEDULING_RULE ON EA_SCHED_RULE_ID = ESR_SCHED_RULE_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.EF_COHORT ON ESR_COHORT_ID = EC_COHORT_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.EF_FORM ON EF_FORM_EXTERNAL_ID = EA_ASSESS_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.EF_FORM_ITEM ON EF_FORM_ID = EFI_FORM_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.ENAR_CALC_VALUE ON EF_FORM_EXTERNAL_ID = ENCV_ASSESSMENT_ID WHERE 1=1 AND EF_FORM_NAME = 'Breast-Q' AND ENCV_SITE IN ('Plastic', 'TE', 'Implant') AND DATE(EF_SUBMISSION_DT) >= CURRENT date - 7 DAYS ORDER BY MRN, EF_FORM_ID, EFI_ITEM_TEXT

prompt: Provide and analyze the data from the Urgent Care Center and UCC-SCC Haupt 1275 over the last 12 months to see if the time of pregnancy testing results in radiology delays.
completion: WITH ORD AS (SELECT DISTINCT OO_MRN , OO_ORD_GUID , OO_ORD_NAME , OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE , OO_SIGNIFICANT_DT , OO_SIGNIF_TME_TXT , OCV_CURR_LOC , OCV_VISIT_DTE AS DATE_OF_VISIT, TRIAGE_TIME, "TIME OF PREGNANCY TEST RESULTS" FROM IDB.OMS_ORDER JOIN IDB.OMS_CLIENT_VISIT OCV ON OO_VISIT_GUID = OCV_VISIT_GUID AND OCV_CURR_LOC IN ('UCC 1275', 'UCC-SCC 1275 Haupt 4') LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT CDD_MRN, CDD_SERVICE_DTE, TIME(CDD_SERVICE_DT) AS TRIAGE_TIME FROM IDB.CD_DOCUMENT WHERE CDD_CANCEL_IND = '0' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND = '0' AND CDD_DOC_NAME = 'Triage Note - UCC') CD ON OO_MRN = CDD_MRN AND CDD_SERVICE_DTE = OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT LR_MRN, LR_TEST_NAME, LR_PERFORMED_DTE, LR_ENTER_DT "TIME OF PREGNANCY TEST RESULTS" FROM IDB.LAB_RESULTS WHERE LR_TEST_NAME IN ('Pregnancy Test, Blood', 'Pregnancy Test, Urine') ) LB ON OO_MRN = LR_MRN AND LR_PERFORMED_DTE BETWEEN OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE AND OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE + 1 DAY WHERE OO_ORD_NAME IN ('Pregnancy Test, Blood', 'Pregnancy Test, Urine') AND OO_ORD_STS_CD NOT IN ('CANP', 'CANC', 'AUC3') AND OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT DATE -12 MONTH AND CURRENT DATE ), RAD AS (SELECT RRPT_MRN FROM DV.RADIOLOGY_REPORT_V JOIN ORD ON OO_MRN = RRPT_MRN ) SELECT DISTINCT OO_MRN "MRN" , OO_ORD_NAME "ORDER NAME" , DATE_OF_VISIT "DATE OF VISIT" , TRIAGE_TIME , OO_SIGNIFICANT_DT "ORDER SIGNIFICANT DATE/TIME" , "TIME OF PREGNANCY TEST RESULTS" , CASE WHEN RAD.RRPT_MRN IS NULL THEN 'N' ELSE 'Y' END "WAS RADIOLOGY SCAN ORDERED" FROM ORD LEFT JOIN RAD ON OO_MRN = RRPT_MRN

prompt: Provide a weekly list of breast cancer patients scheduled for biopsies.
completion: WITH PTS AS (SELECT CPE_MRN AS "MRN", PT_LAST_NAME AS "LAST_NAME", PT_FIRST_NAME AS "FIRST_NAME", CPE_ENC_DTE AS "FIRST_APPOINTMENT_DATE", CLD_DEPT_NAME AS "DEPARTMENT_NAME", CLD_CLD_CENTER AS "CENTER", CRE_RES_NAME AS "RESOURCE_NAME", CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME AS "VISIT_TYPE_NAME" FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON CPE_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Sch') AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT date AND CURRENT date + 14 DAYS AND CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID IN (7570 , 7565 , 7567 , 7571 , 7578 , 7586 , 7597 , 7579 , 7587 , 7595 , 7593 , 7588 , 7590 , 7582 , 7576 , 7584 , 7572 , 7594 , 7589 , 7591 , 7577 , 7585 , 7573 , 7581 , 7580 , 7581 , 7583 , 7592 , 7563 , 7560 , 7564 , 7559 , 7561 , 8006 , 8007 , 3385 , 3386 , 8471 , 8470 , 10379 , 10378 , 7994) ) , FOL_APPT AS (SELECT FPT.CPE_MRN FOLLOWUP_MRN, FPT.CPE_ENC_DTE FOLLOWUP_APPT_DT, FD.CLD_DEPT_NAME FOLLOWUP_DEPT, FR.CRE_RES_NAME FOLLOWUP_RESOURCE, FV.CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME FOLLOWUP_VISIT_TYPE, FPT.CPE_ENC_CSN_ID FOLLOWUP_CSN_ID, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY FPT.CPE_MRN ORDER BY FPT.CPE_ENC_DTE ASC) FF_DT FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER FPT JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE FR ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT FD ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE FV ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID JOIN PTS ON MRN = FPT.CPE_MRN WHERE 1=1 AND CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Sch') AND CPE_ENC_DTE > PTS.FIRST_APPOINTMENT_DATE AND CRE_RES_TYP = 'Physician' ), RAD AS (SELECT RRPT_MRN, RRPT_ORDER_GROUP, RRPT_PROCEDURE_NAME, RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY RRPT_MRN ORDER BY RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE DESC) RN FROM PTS JOIN DV.RADIOLOGY_REPORT_V V ON MRN = RRPT_MRN WHERE RRPT_ORDER_GROUP IN ('PET', 'CT') ) SELECT P.*, R.RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE AS "RADIOLOGY_DATE", R.RRPT_ORDER_GROUP AS "RADIOLOGY_ORDER_GROUP", R.RRPT_PROCEDURE_NAME AS "RADIOLOGY_PROCEDURE_NAME", F.FOLLOWUP_APPT_DT AS "FOLLOWUP_DATE", F.FOLLOWUP_DEPT AS "FOLLOWUP_DEPARTMENT", F.FOLLOWUP_RESOURCE AS "FOLLOWUP_RESOURCE", F.FOLLOWUP_VISIT_TYPE AS "FOLLOWUP_VISIT_TYPE" FROM PTS P LEFT JOIN RAD R ON P.MRN = R.RRPT_MRN AND R.RN = 1 LEFT JOIN FOL_APPT F ON F.FOLLOWUP_MRN = P.MRN AND F.FF_DT =1

prompt: Provide a weekly list of CIS orders that do not have a corresponding Cadence appointment scheduled for Rehab Therapy.
completion: WITH OMS AS (SELECT OO_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, OO_ORD_GUID, OO_ORD_NAME, MP_EXTERNAL_NM , MAX(CASE WHEN OFF_FLD_LABEL IN ('Site Requested:') THEN OUD_USER_DI_VALUE ELSE NULL END) SITE_REQUESTED , MAX(CASE WHEN OFF_FLD_LABEL IN ('Requested For:') THEN OUD_USER_DI_VALUE ELSE NULL END) AS REQUESTED_FOR , MAX(CASE WHEN OFF_FLD_LABEL IN ('Primary MD:') THEN OUD_USER_DI_VALUE ELSE NULL END) AS PRIMARY_MD , MAX(CASE WHEN OFF_FLD_LABEL IN ('Reason For Referral:', 'Reason for Referral:') THEN OUD_USER_DI_VALUE ELSE NULL END) AS REASON , MAX(CASE WHEN OFF_FLD_LABEL IN ('Precaution Details:', 'Precuation Details:') THEN OUD_USER_DI_VALUE ELSE NULL END) AS PRECUATION_DETAILS , MAX(CASE WHEN OFF_FLD_LABEL IN ('Precautions/Contraindications:') THEN OUD_USER_DI_VALUE ELSE NULL END) AS PRECAUTIONS , MAX(CASE WHEN OFF_FLD_LABEL IN ('Additional Information:') THEN OUD_USER_DI_VALUE ELSE NULL END) AS ADDITIONAL_INFO FROM IDB.OMS_ORDER JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PT_MRN = OO_MRN JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_CATALOG ON OOC_MSTR_ITEM_GUID = OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_PROVIDER ON OO_PVDR_GUID = OP_PVDR_GUID JOIN DV.MEDPRO ON MP_SOURCE_PROVIDER_NO = OP_PVDR_NO LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_USER_DATA ON OUD_ORD_GUID = OO_ORD_GUID LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_STATUS ON OSTS_ORD_STS_CD = OO_ORD_STS_CD LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_FORM_FIELD ON OUD_USER_DI_CD = OFF_DI_CD AND OO_ENTRY_FRM_GUID = OFF_ENTRY_FRM_GUID WHERE 1=1 AND OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID IN ('9000004916800730', '9000005174100730', '1000004839073029') AND OFF_FLD_LABEL IN ('Site Requested:', 'Requested For:', 'Primary MD:', 'Reason For Referral:', 'Reason for Referral:', 'Precuation Details:', 'Precautions/Contraindications:', 'Precaution Details:', 'Additional Information:') AND OO_ENTER_DTE >= CURRENT date - 30 DAYS AND OO_ORD_STS_CD NOT IN ('CANP', 'CANC', 'AUC3') GROUP BY OO_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, OO_ORD_GUID, OO_ORD_NAME, MP_EXTERNAL_NM) , BMI AS (SELECT B.BMI_MRN, BMI_MEASURE_DTE, BMI, BSA, WT_KG, HT_CM FROM (SELECT PMH_MRN BMI_MRN, PMH_MEASURE_DTE BMI_MEASURE_DTE, PMH_WT_KG WT_KG, PMH_HT_CM HT_CM, PMH_BSA BSA, PMH_BMI BMI, PMH_MEASURE_SYS , ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY PMH_MRN ORDER BY PMH_MEASURE_DTE DESC) RNK FROM IDB.PT_MEASURES_HX JOIN OMS ON OO_MRN = PMH_MRN) B WHERE RNK =1 ) , APPTS AS (SELECT DISTINCT PENC_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID P_ID, TRIM(PT_MRN) APPT_MRN , RANK() OVER(PARTITION BY PENC_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID ORDER BY CASE WHEN DATE(PENC_ENC_DT) < CURRENT date THEN NULL ELSE PENC_ENC_DT END) RANK_FUTURE , RANK() OVER(PARTITION BY PENC_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID ORDER BY CASE WHEN DATE(PENC_ENC_DT) > CURRENT date THEN NULL ELSE PENC_ENC_DT END DESC) RANK_PAST , ENDP_DEPT_NAME, ENDP_DEPT_ABBR , DT_DAY_ABBREVIATION, RTRIM(ENR_EXT_RES_NAME) ENR_EXT_RES_NAME, VARCHAR_FORMAT(PENC_ENC_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') PENC_ENC_DT, RTRIM(ENDP_CENTER_ABBR) ENDP_CENTER_ABBR, RTRIM(ENDP_PHY_LOC) ENDP_PHY_LOC , VARCHAR_FORMAT(PENC_ENC_DT, 'DD Mon YY') AS ENC_DATE_DISP , VARCHAR_FORMAT(PENC_ENC_DT, 'YYYYMMDDHH24MI') ORDER_BY_ASC_CHAR, VARCHAR_FORMAT(PENC_ENC_DT, 'HH24:MI') TIME_DISP , TRIM(ENVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME) VISIT_TYPE_NAME, TRIM(ER.ENR_RES_NAME) ENR_RES_NAME , CASE WHEN ENR_RES_TYP IN ('Physician', 'PhD', 'Dentist', 'Psychologist') AND EVT.ENVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR like '%IR%' THEN 'New Visit' WHEN ENR_RES_TYP IN ('Physician', 'PhD', 'Dentist', 'Psychologist') AND EVT.ENVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR like '%NV%' THEN 'New Visit' ELSE'' END NEWVISITIND , CASE WHEN EVT."ENVT_EXT_NAME" like 'CT%' OR EVT."ENVT_EXT_NAME" like 'MR%' OR EVT."ENVT_EXT_NAME" like 'PET%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS SCAN_INDICATOR , CASE WHEN ENR_RES_TYP IN ('Dentist', 'Nurse Practitioner', 'PhD', 'Physician', 'Psychologist') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END DR_VISIT_INDICATOR , CASE WHEN UPPER(T3."ENDP_REG_DEPT_GRP1") IN ('REG') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS REGIONALSITEINDICATOR , DAYS(PENC_ENC_DT) - DAYS(CURRENT date) AS DAYS_FROM_TODAY , DAYS(CURRENT date) - DAYS(PENC_MODIFIED_DT) AS DAYS_SINCE_APPT_MODIFIED , CASE WHEN YEAR(PENC_MODIFIED_DT) = YEAR(CURRENT date) THEN VARCHAR_FORMAT(PENC_MODIFIED_DT, 'Mon DD') ELSE VARCHAR_FORMAT(PENC_MODIFIED_DT, 'Mon DD YYYY') END PENC_MODIFIED_DISP , VARCHAR_FORMAT(PENC_MODIFIED_DT, 'YYYYMMDD HH24MI') PENC_MODIFIED_DT , TRIM(ENDP_SERVICE_DEPT_GRP_6) DEPT_GRP_6 , TRIM(ENDP_SERVICE_SPECIALTY_GRP_8) RPT_GRP_8 , TRIM(T2.EDC_DEPT_DESC) APPT_STATUS_DESC , CASE WHEN NOT(TRIM(REF_MP.MP_FULL_NM) = 'NO DOCTOR INFO AVAILABLE') THEN TRIM(REF_MP.MP_LAST_NM)||', '||TRIM(REF_MP.MP_FIRST_NM) ELSE NULL END REFERRINGPROVIDER , TRIM(REF_MP.MP_EMAIL_ADDR) REFERRINGPROVIDER_EMAIL , TRIM(MP.MP_FULL_NM) AS MEDPRO_FULL_NAME , TRIM(MP.MP_EMAIL_ADDR) AS MEDPRO_EMAIL , PT_BIRTH_DTE , PT_DEATH_DTE , PT_SEX , TRIM(PT_RACE_DESC) PT_RACE_DESC FROM DV.PATIENT_ENCOUNTER T6 INNER JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON PENC_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID JOIN OMS ON OO_MRN = PT_MRN INNER JOIN DV.ENCOUNTER_SCHD_RESOURCES SR ON T6.PENC_PT_ENC_ID = SR."ENSR_PT_ENC_ID" INNER JOIN DV.ENCOUNTER_RESOURCE ER ON SR."ENSR_RES_ID" = ER."ENR_ENC_RES_ID" INNER JOIN DV.ENCOUNTER_VISIT_TYPE EVT ON T6.PENC_VISIT_TYPE_ID = EVT.ENVT_ENC_VISIT_TYPE_ID INNER JOIN DV.ENCOUNTER_DESC_CATALOG T2 ON EDC_GROUP_ID = 'STS' AND T6.PENC_APPT_STS = T2.EDC_DEPT_ABBREV INNER JOIN DV.ENCOUNTER_DEPARTMENT T3 ON T6.PENC_DEPT_ID = T3.ENDP_ENC_DEPT_ID JOIN (SELECT TRIM(COLUMN_VALUES) VISIT_T_ID FROM TABLE(DV.STRING_SPLIT('12585,12588,12594,12591', ',')) T) T ON VISIT_T_ID = ENVT_ENC_VISIT_TYPE_ID JOIN (SELECT TRIM(COLUMN_VALUES) VISIT_D_ID FROM TABLE(DV.STRING_SPLIT('182,1198,1584,412,1603,859,1318,1157,1073', ',')) T) D ON VISIT_D_ID = ENDP_ENC_DEPT_ID INNER JOIN DV.DATE_V T4 ON T6.PENC_ENC_DATE_ID = T4.DT_DATE_ID INNER JOIN DV.MEDPRO REF_MP ON PENC_REF_PROVIDER_ID = REF_MP.MP_MEDPRO_ID LEFT JOIN DV.MEDPRO MP ON ENR_SRC_RES_ID = MP.MP_SOURCE_PROVIDER_NO WHERE 1=1 AND T2.EDC_DEPT_DESC IN ('Scheduled') AND SR.ENSR_PRIMARY_RES_IND = 'Y' ) SELECT OMS.*, BMI.HT_CM, BMI.WT_KG, VISIT_TYPE_NAME, ENR_EXT_RES_NAME, ENDP_DEPT_ABBR, ENDP_DEPT_NAME, PENC_ENC_DT FROM OMS LEFT JOIN BMI ON BMI_MRN = OO_MRN JOIN APPTS ON APPT_MRN = OO_MRN ;

prompt: I would like the time-of-day for nivolumab infusions as well as radiotherapy delivery (e.g. 9:23 AM infusion start) for a list of patient MRNs for patients treated on protocol 15-253.  This research will be under the retrospective research protocol 16-933
Schedule a weekly list of biopsy orders by the lymphoma service.
completion: SELECT DISTINCT STRIP(OO_MRN) AS MRN, OO_ENTER_DTE, STRIP(DOC_SVC) AS "Service", STRIP(OUO_USER_NAME) AS USER_NAME, STRIP(OUO_ATN_PVDR_NAME) AS "Attending", STRIP(OUO_PVDR_NAME) AS "Provider", OO_ORD_ID, OO_ORD_GUID, STRIP(OO_ORD_NAME) AS "Order Name" FROM IDB.OMS_ORDER LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_USER_ORDERS ON OO_ORD_GUID = OUO_ORD_GUID LEFT JOIN IDB.DOC ON OO_REQ_DR_NO = DOC_DR_NO WHERE OO_ORD_STS_CD NOT IN ('CANC', 'CANP', 'AUC3') AND OO_ENTER_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT DATE - 7 DAYS AND CURRENT DATE - 1 DAY AND DOC_SVC = 'LYM' AND OO_ORD_NAME IN ('BMA Biopsy and Aspirate Procedure Request', 'IP_IR_Biopsy', 'IR - Protocol Biopsy Requests', 'IR - Referral Protocol Biopsy', 'US:Guided Soft Tissue Core Biopsy', 'US:Guided Soft Tissue FNA Biopsy', 'BM Aspirate', 'IR - Referral')

prompt: Combine ADM5836 SRx and CRx report into one monthly report with the requested changes to the reporting fields.
completion: WITH VST AS (SELECT CPE_MRN MRN, CPE_ENC_DTE CHEMO_DTE, CPE_ENC_CSN_ID CSNID , CLD_DEPT_NAME DEPT_NAME, CLD_CLD_CENTER CENTER , CLD_CLD_PHY_LOC LOCATION , CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME VISIT_NAME, CVT_EXT_NAME VISIT_TYPE , CPE_CHK_IN_DT CHK_IN, CPE_CHK_OUT_DT CHK_OUT , CPE_CHK_OUT_END_DT CHK_OUT_END_DT , CPE_RM_IN_DT RM_IN, CPE_RM_OUT_DT RM_OUT , CPE_TX_PREMIX_IND PREMIX_IND , CPE_DAY_BEFORE_BLOODS CHEMO_READY , CASE WHEN CLD_CLD_CENTER = 'BKLYN' THEN 'Brooklyn' WHEN CLD_CLD_CENTER = '68TH' THEN 'Kimmel' WHEN CLD_CLD_CENTER = '1919' THEN '1919 Madison' WHEN CLD_CLD_CENTER = 'KOCH' THEN 'Koch' ELSE CLD_CLD_CENTER END CHEMO_LOCATION FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID AND CLD_CLD_CENTER IN ('BKLYN', '205 E64', '68TH', '1919', 'KOCH') AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 IN ('CHM', 'ETU') JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CRE_RES_ID = CPE_VST_RES_ID AND CRE_RES_TYP = 'Chemotherapy Unit' JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID = CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID AND CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME<>'BKLN DISCONNECT ONLY' AND CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME<>'BKLN FIRST VISIT' AND CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME<>'BKLN LAB 30' AND CVT_EXT_NAME NOT IN ('Lab Visit', 'Transfusion') WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Comp', 'Arrived') AND CPE_ENC_TYP_CD = 50 AND CPE_MRN > ' ' AND CPE_ENC_DTE >= DATE(SUBSTR(CHAR(YEAR(CURRENT DATE - 1 MONTH)), 1, 4)||'-'|| CASE WHEN MONTH(CURRENT DATE - 1 MONTH) < 10 THEN '0'||SUBSTR(CHAR(MONTH(CURRENT DATE - 1 MONTH)), 1, 1) ELSE SUBSTR(CHAR(MONTH(CURRENT DATE - 1 MONTH)), 1, 2) END||'-21') AND CPE_ENC_DTE <= DATE(SUBSTR(CHAR(YEAR(CURRENT DATE)), 1, 4)||'-'|| CASE WHEN MONTH(CURRENT DATE) < 10 THEN '0'||SUBSTR(CHAR(MONTH(CURRENT DATE)), 1, 1) ELSE SUBSTR(CHAR(MONTH(CURRENT DATE)), 1, 2) END||'-20') ) SELECT MRN, CHEMO_DTE, CHEMO_LOCATION, SPD_ORD_NO ORD_NO , SPD_DRUG_NAME DRUG_NAME, SPD_GI_NAME ITEM_NAME , STRIP(SPD_SVC_CODE) SVC_CODE , SPD_INVEST_IND INVEST_IND , SUM(SPD_TRANS_TYPE*SPD_DOSE_NO) TTL_DOSE , SPD_DOSE_UOM DOSE_UOM, SUM(SPD_TRANS_TYPE) AS DISP_QTY , CASE WHEN COALESCE(SPD_ML_CONV, 0) <> 0 THEN SPD_ML_CONV END VOLUME , CASE WHEN COALESCE(SPD_ML_CONV, 0) <> 0 THEN 'ml' END VOLUME_UOM , SPD_ROUTE_CD ROUTE, 'SRx' ORD_SOURCE , SUBSTR(SPD_ORD_DESC, 1, 255) DIRECTIONS , OP_DISPLAY_NAME PROVIDER, DOC_SVC SMS_SVC FROM VST JOIN IDB.SRX_PHARMACY_DETAIL ON SPD_MRN = MRN AND CHEMO_DTE = SPD_BILLED_DTE LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_PROVIDER ON SPD_PVDR_GUID = OP_PVDR_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_ORDER ON SPD_ORD_GUID = OO_ORD_GUID LEFT JOIN IDB.DOC ON OO_REQ_DR_NO = DOC_DR_NO WHERE SPD_IP_OP_IND = 'O' AND SPD_DRUG_NAME <> 'base solution' GROUP BY MRN, CHEMO_DTE, CHEMO_LOCATION, SPD_ORD_NO, SPD_DRUG_NAME , SPD_ML_CONV, SPD_SVC_CODE, SPD_DOSE_UOM, SPD_ROUTE_CD , SPD_ORD_DESC, SPD_GI_NAME, SPD_INVEST_IND , OP_DISPLAY_NAME, DOC_SVC HAVING SUM(SPD_TRANS_TYPE) <> 0

prompt: Dataline search on Burkitt Lymphoma patients treated with RT between 1/1/2000-12/31/2023.
completion: WITH PT AS (SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN, CASE_STS, COALESCE(TM_DX_DTE, MIN_ICD9_EFF_DTE) AS DX_DTE, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH AS "Date of Birth", PT_DATE_OF_DEATH AS "Date of Death", CASE WHEN PT_DATE_OF_DEATH IS NULL THEN 'Alive' ELSE 'Deceased' END AS "Vital Status", TM_DX_DTE, TM_HIST_CD, HIST_DESC, TM_SITE_CD, SITE_DESC, MIN_ICD9_EFF_DTE, ICD9_CD, ICD9_DESC FROM IDB.PATIENT LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT TM_MRN, AV_DESC AS CASE_STS, TM_DX_DTE, TM_HIST_CD, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS HIST_DESC, TM_SITE_CD, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_DESC FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS ON AV_ELEMENT = 'CASE_STS' AND AV_CODE = TM_CASE_STS AND TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND TM_HIST_CD IN ('M9687/3')) AS CDB ON TM_MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT CC_MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS MIN_ICD9_EFF_DTE, CC_CLSF_CD AS ICD9_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS ICD9_DESC FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE CC_CLSF_CD IN ('200.2', '200.20', '200.21', '200.22', '200.23', '200.24', '200.25', '200.26', '200.27', '200.28', 'C83.7', 'C83.70', 'C83.71', 'C83.72', 'C83.73', 'C83.74', 'C83.75', 'C83.76', 'C83.77', 'C83.78', 'C83.79') AND CASE WHEN CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y' AND CC_PT_TYPE <> 'E' THEN 'Y' WHEN CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' AND YEAR(CC_EFF_DTE) < 2004 THEN 'Y' WHEN CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND YEAR(CC_EFF_DTE) < 2001 THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END = 'Y' GROUP BY CC_MRN, CC_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK ) AS ICD9 ON CC_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE COALESCE(TM_MRN, CC_MRN) IS NOT NULL ) SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN MRN, "Date of Birth", "Date of Death", "Vital Status", COALESCE(MAX(PLA_LST_APPT_DTE, PLA_LST_DSCH_DTE), PLA_LST_APPT_DTE, PLA_LST_DSCH_DTE) AS "DATE OF LAST FOLLOW UP", TM_DX_DTE AS "Tumor Diagnosis Date", TM_HIST_CD AS "Histology Code", HIST_DESC AS "Histology Description", TM_SITE_CD AS "Site Code", SITE_DESC AS "Site Description", MIN_ICD9_EFF_DTE AS "ICD Date", ICD9_CD AS "ICD Code", ICD9_DESC AS "ICD Description" FROM PT JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY ON PT_MRN = PLA_MRN ORDER BY PT_MRN ; WITH DX AS (SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN, CASE_STS, COALESCE(TM_DX_DTE, MIN_ICD9_EFF_DTE) AS DX_DTE, TM_DX_DTE, TM_HIST_CD, HIST_DESC, TM_SITE_CD, SITE_DESC, MIN_ICD9_EFF_DTE, ICD9_CD, ICD9_DESC FROM IDB.PATIENT LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT TM_MRN, AV_DESC AS CASE_STS, TM_DX_DTE, TM_HIST_CD, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS HIST_DESC, TM_SITE_CD, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_DESC FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS ON AV_ELEMENT = 'CASE_STS' AND AV_CODE = TM_CASE_STS AND TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND TM_HIST_CD IN ('M9687/3')) AS CDB ON TM_MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT CC_MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS MIN_ICD9_EFF_DTE, CC_CLSF_CD AS ICD9_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS ICD9_DESC FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE CC_CLSF_CD IN ('200.2', '200.20', WHEN CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y' AND CC_PT_TYPE <> 'E' THEN 'Y' WHEN CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' AND YEAR(CC_EFF_DTE) < 2004 THEN 'Y' WHEN CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND YEAR(CC_EFF_DTE) < 2001 THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END = 'Y' GROUP BY CC_MRN, CC_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK ) AS ICD9 ON CC_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE COALESCE(TM_MRN, CC_MRN) IS NOT NULL ), RT AS (SELECT DISTINCT RTC_TX_MRN, DX_DTE, RTC_TX_COURSE_NO, RTC_TX_PLANSETUP_NO, RTC_TX_COURSE_ID, RTC_TX_PLAN_NAME, RTC_TX_PLANNED_FRACTIONS, RTC_TX_DELIVERED_FRACTIONS, RTC_TX_PLANNED_DOSE, RTC_TX_DELIVERED_DOSE, RTC_TX_START_DTE, RTC_TX_STOP_DTE, RTC_TX_ELAPSED_DAYS, RTC_PRIMARY_REF_POINT, RTC_DOSE_CORRECTION FROM DX JOIN IDB.RADONC_TREATMENT_COURSE ON RTC_TX_MRN = PT_MRN AND DX_DTE <= RTC_TX_START_DTE WHERE RTC_TX_START_DTE BETWEEN '2000-01-01' AND '2023-12-31' ) SELECT DISTINCT RTC_TX_MRN AS "MRN", RTC_TX_START_DTE AS "Treatment Start Date", RTC_TX_STOP_DTE AS "Treatment End Date", RTC_TX_COURSE_ID AS "Treatment Course ID", RTC_TX_PLAN_NAME AS "Treatment Plan Name", RTC_TX_PLANNED_FRACTIONS AS "Treatment Planne Fractions", RTC_TX_DELIVERED_FRACTIONS AS "Treatment Delivered Fractions", RTC_TX_PLANNED_DOSE AS "Treatment Planned Dose", RTC_TX_DELIVERED_DOSE AS "Treatment Delivered Dose", RTC_TX_ELAPSED_DAYS AS "Treatment Elapsed Days", RTC_PRIMARY_REF_POINT AS "Primary Ref Point", RTC_DOSE_CORRECTION AS "Treatment Dose Correction" FROM RT ORDER BY RTC_TX_MRN ; WITH DX AS (SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN, CASE_STS, COALESCE(TM_DX_DTE, MIN_ICD9_EFF_DTE) AS DX_DTE, TM_DX_DTE, TM_HIST_CD, HIST_DESC, TM_SITE_CD, SITE_DESC, MIN_ICD9_EFF_DTE, ICD9_CD, ICD9_DESC FROM IDB.PATIENT LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT TM_MRN, AV_DESC AS CASE_STS, TM_DX_DTE, TM_HIST_CD, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS HIST_DESC, TM_SITE_CD, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_DESC FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS ON AV_ELEMENT = 'CASE_STS' AND AV_CODE = TM_CASE_STS AND TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND TM_HIST_CD IN ('M9687/3')) AS CDB ON TM_MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT CC_MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS MIN_ICD9_EFF_DTE, CC_CLSF_CD AS ICD9_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS ICD9_DESC FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE CC_CLSF_CD IN ('200.2', '200.20', '200.21', '200.22', '200.23', '200.24', '200.25', '200.26', '200.27', '200.28', 'C83.7', 'C83.70', 'C83.71', 'C83.72', 'C83.73', 'C83.74', 'C83.75', 'C83.76', 'C83.77', 'C83.78', 'C83.79') AND CASE WHEN CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y' AND CC_PT_TYPE <> 'E' THEN 'Y' WHEN CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' AND YEAR(CC_EFF_DTE) < 2004 THEN 'Y' WHEN CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND YEAR(CC_EFF_DTE) < 2001 THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END = 'Y' GROUP BY CC_MRN, CC_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK ) AS ICD9 ON CC_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE COALESCE(TM_MRN, CC_MRN) IS NOT NULL ), RT AS (SELECT DISTINCT RTC_TX_MRN, DX_DTE, RTC_TX_COURSE_NO, RTC_TX_PLANSETUP_NO, RTC_TX_COURSE_ID, RTC_TX_PLAN_NAME, RTC_TX_PLANNED_FRACTIONS, RTC_TX_DELIVERED_FRACTIONS, RTC_TX_PLANNED_DOSE, RTC_TX_DELIVERED_DOSE, RTC_TX_START_DTE, RTC_TX_STOP_DTE, RTC_TX_ELAPSED_DAYS, RTC_PRIMARY_REF_POINT, RTC_DOSE_CORRECTION FROM DX JOIN IDB.RADONC_TREATMENT_COURSE ON RTC_TX_MRN = PT_MRN AND DX_DTE <= RTC_TX_START_DTE WHERE RTC_TX_START_DTE BETWEEN '2000-01-01' AND '2023-12-31' ) SELECT DISTINCT APR_MRN MRN, APR_START_DTE AS "APR Start Date", APR_END_DTE AS "APR End Date", CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME AS "Generic Name", APR_PRESCRIBED_DOSE AS "Prescribed Dose", APR_ROUTE AS "Route" FROM RT JOIN IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX ON APR_MRN = prompt: Provide real time update of any patient with a pathologic diagnosis of mesothelioma and an upcoming CT scan/PET scan
completion: WITH DT_1 AS (SELECT DISTINCT INC.PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID P_ID , PT_MRN FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_STRUCTURED_RESULTS_V INC JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML DT ON INC.PRPT_PATH_RPT_ID = DT.PDRX_PATH_RPT_ID CROSS JOIN XMLTABLE('$c/root/meta-data' PASSING DT.PDRX_XML_VALUE AS "c" COLUMNS PRIMARY_SITE VARCHAR(264) PATH 'primary_site', TUMOR_TYPE_NAME VARCHAR(264) PATH 'tumor_type_name' , TUMOR_TYPE_CODE VARCHAR(264) PATH 'tumor_type_code', IS_METASTASIS VARCHAR(3) PATH 'is_metastasis' , METASTASIS_SITE VARCHAR(264) PATH 'metastasis_site') T JOIN (SELECT T.TUMOR_TYPE_CODE TTC FROM TABLE(DV.STRING_SPLIT('PEMESO,PLMESO,TMESO', ',')) S CROSS JOIN TABLE(DV.ONCOTREE_CHILDREN(COLUMN_VALUES)) T) X ON T.TUMOR_TYPE_CODE = X.TTC WHERE 1=1 UNION SELECT DISTINCT PRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID P_ID , PRPT_MRN PT_MRN FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V WHERE PRPT_REPORT IS NOT NULL AND PRPT_REPORT_DTE >= '2008-01-01' AND CONTAINS("PRPT_REPORT", '("mesothelioma")') = 1 ) , DT_2 AS (SELECT PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID AS P_ID FROM DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS REC WHERE 1=1 AND PT_VITAL_STATUS IN ('ALIVE') ) , DEID AS (SELECT DISTINCT A.P_ID FROM DT_1 A JOIN DT_2 B ON A.P_ID = B.P_ID)

PBD", YEAR("t13"."DT_DTE") AS "CPT Procedure Year - PBD", "t11"."PT_MRN" AS "MRN", "t13"."DT_DTE" AS "CPT Procedure Date - PBD2" FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED" "t10" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS" "t11" ON "t10"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t11"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."CPT_PBD_PATIENT_PROCEDURE" "t12" ON "t10"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t12"."PTX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE" "t13" ON "t12"."PTX_PROC_DATE_ID" = "t13"."DT_DATE_ID" WHERE ("t11"."PT_SEX" IN ('F') AND ("t12"."PROC_ID" IN (6827, 7162, 6828, 6830, 168, 503, 23689, 484) AND ("t13"."DT_DTE" BETWEEN DATE('2004-01-31') AND DATE('2009-01-31') AND "t10"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" NOT IN (SELECT "Deident PT #" FROM (SELECT DISTINCT "t1"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AS "Deident PT #" FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED" "t1" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS" "t2" ON "t1"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t2"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."CPT_PBD_PATIENT_PROCEDURE" "t3" ON "t1"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t3"."PTX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE" "t4" ON "t3"."PTX_PROC_DATE_ID" = "t4"."DT_DATE_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DIAGNOSIS_FINAL_ALL_V" "t7" ON "t1"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t7"."PDX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DIAGNOSIS_CODE_CAT_ICD9_V" "t5" ON "t7"."PDX_DX_CATALOG_ID" = "t5"."DXCC_DX_CATALOG_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DIAGNOSIS_FINAL_DATES_V" "t8" ON "t7"."PDX_DX_CATALOG_ID" = "t8"."PDX_DX_CATALOG_ID" AND "t7"."PDX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t8"."PDX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE" "t6" ON "t8"."FIRST_DIAGNOSIS_DATE_ID" = "t6"."DT_DATE_ID" WHERE ("t2"."PT_SEX" IN ('F') AND ("t3"."PROC_ID" IN (6827, 7162, 6828, 6830, 168, 503, 23689, 484) AND ("t4"."DT_DTE" BETWEEN DATE('2004-01-31') AND DATE('2009-01-31') AND ("t7"."PDX_DX_CATALOG_ID" IN (5853, 5910, 5854, 5911, 5855, 5912, 5856, 5913, 5857, 5858, 5915, 5859, 5916, 5860, 5917, 5861, 5918, 5919, 5920) AND DAYS("t6"."DT_DTE") - DAYS("t4"."DT_DTE") <= 0)))) ) AS "t9"))))

completion: SELECT DISTINCT STRIP(OO_MRN) AS MRN, STRIP(PT_LAST_NAME) || ', ' || STRIP(PT_FIRST_NAME) AS "PT Name", PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH AS DOB, OO_ENTER_DTE AS "Order Entered Date", OO_PERFORMED_DTE AS "Performed Date", OO_ORD_ID, STRIP(OUO_ORG_NAME) AS "Dept", STRIP(OO_ORD_NAME) AS "Order Name", OO_SUMMARY_LINE AS "Summary Line", STRIP(OUO_PVDR_NAME) AS "Provider" FROM IDB.OMS_ORDER JOIN IDB.OMS_USER_ORDERS ON OO_ORD_GUID = OUO_ORD_GUID JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PT_MRN = OO_MRN WHERE OO_ORD_STS_CD NOT IN ('CANC', 'CANP', 'AUC3') AND OO_PERFORMED_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT DATE - 7 DAYS AND CURRENT DATE AND OUO_PVDR_NAME IN ('Mulhall, John', 'Flores Martinez, Jose', 'Cime, Karene', 'Housen, Ashley', 'Huwe, Victor', 'Strumeier, Samantha') AND OUO_ORG_NAME IN ('CT', 'MRI', 'Ultrasound', 'Mammography')

prompt: We would like a list of OR cases by day performed by our Neurosurgeons so we can see the date of each case
