prompt: I want to see how many Chinese-speaking cancer patients and survivors are seen at MSK each year, and break down that # by cancer stage (early, i.e. 0-II and late, i.e. III-IV) and treatment course (i.e., whether they are in active treatment or post-treatment/survivorship).
completion: WITH PTS AS (SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN AS MRN, TRIM(PT_LAST_NAME) CONCAT ', ' CONCAT TRIM(PT_FIRST_NAME) PT_NAME, L.AV_DESC AS PRIM_LANG, PT_STATE, YEAR(CURRENT DATE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) CURR_AGE FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON CPE_MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS L ON PT_PRIMARY_LANG = L.AV_CODE AND L.AV_ELEMENT = 'PRIMARY_LANG' WHERE 1 = 1 AND CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND L.AV_DESC IN ('CHINESE', 'CHINESE, CANTONESE', 'CHINESE, MANDARIN') AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN '2022-09-01' AND '2023-08-31' AND YEAR(CURRENT DATE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) >= 18 AND PT_DEATH_IND IN ('', 'A') AND PT_STATE IN ('NJ', 'NY') ), CANCER_DX AS (SELECT TM_MRN, AV_DESC AS CASE_STS, TM_DX_DTE, TM_HIST_CD, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS HIST_DESC, TM_SITE_CD, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_DESC, TM_BEST_AJCC_STG, ROW_NUMBER () OVER(PARTITION BY TM_MRN ORDER BY TM_DX_DTE DESC) AS DX_RN FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS ON AV_ELEMENT = 'CASE_STS' AND AV_CODE = TM_CASE_STS WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') ), ANTINEOPLASTICS AS (SELECT DISTINCT APR_MRN, APR_GENERIC_NAME, APR_START_DTE, APR_END_DTE FROM IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX JOIN IDB.CHEMO_DRUG_GENERIC ON APR_GENERIC_NAME = CDG_GENERIC_NAME WHERE 1 = 1 AND CURRENT DATE >= APR_START_DTE AND APR_END_DTE >= CURRENT DATE ), RX AS (SELECT RTC_TX_MRN, RTC_TX_PLAN_NAME, RTC_TX_START_DTE, RTC_TX_STOP_DTE FROM IDB.RADONC_TREATMENT_COURSE WHERE 1 = 1 AND CURRENT DATE >= RTC_TX_START_DTE AND RTC_TX_STOP_DTE >= CURRENT DATE - 1 ), SVR AS (SELECT CPE_MRN AS MRN, CPE_ENC_DTE AS "Appt Date", CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 AS "Department", CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 AS "Service", CLD_DEPT_NAME AS "Department Name", CLD_CLD_CENTER AS "Location", CRE_RES_NAME AS "Provider Name", CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME AS "Visit Type" FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE 1 = 1 AND CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp', 'Sch') AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT DATE -180 AND CURRENT DATE + 180 AND UPPER(CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6) LIKE '%SVR%' ), SURG AS (SELECT SSE_MRN, SSE_SURG_DTE, SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD, SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC, SSP_SURG_LAST_NM, SSP_SURG_FIRST_NM, SSP_SURG_SVC_CD FROM IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE ON SSE_LOG_ID = SSP_LOG_ID AND SSE_ENC_CSN_ID = SSP_ENC_CSN_ID WHERE (SSE_SURG_LOC not like '%IR%' AND SSE_SURG_LOC not like '%ENDO%' AND SSE_SOURCE_TYPE <> 'E') ) SELECT DISTINCT PTS.*, TM_DX_DTE, TM_SITE_CD, SITE_DESC, TM_BEST_AJCC_STG, CASE WHEN PTS.MRN IN (SELECT APR_MRN FROM ANTINEOPLASTICS) THEN 'Yes' WHEN PTS.MRN IN (SELECT RTC_TX_MRN FROM RX) THEN 'Yes' WHEN PTS.MRN IN (SELECT SVR.MRN FROM SVR) THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END ACTIVE_TX FROM PTS JOIN CANCER_DX ON PTS.MRN = TM_MRN AND DX_RN = 1 LEFT JOIN SURG ON PTS.MRN = SSE_MRN WHERE 1 = 1 ORDER BY PTS.MRN SELECT PTS.MRN, PTS.PT_NAME, SSE_SURG_DTE, SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD, SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC, APR_GENERIC_NAME, APR_START_DTE, APR_END_DTE, RTC_TX_PLAN_NAME, RTC_TX_START_DTE, RTC_TX_STOP_DTE, SVR."Department Name", SVR."Appt Date" FROM PTS JOIN SURG ON MRN = SSE_MRN LEFT JOIN ANTINEOPLASTICS ON PTS.MRN = APR_MRN AND APR_START_DTE > SSE_SURG_DTE LEFT JOIN RX ON PTS.MRN = RTC_TX_MRN AND RTC_TX_START_DTE > SSE_SURG_DTE LEFT JOIN SVR ON PTS.MRN = SVR.MRN AND SVR."Appt Date" > SSE_SURG_DTE

prompt: Provide a daily list of surgeries done 24 hours ago where the corresponding operative reports have not been entered by the surgeon.
completion: WITH SURG AS (SELECT DISTINCT SSE_MRN , SSE_LOG_ID , SSE_SURG_DTE , SSE_SURG_LOC , SSE_PT_TYPE , SSP_SURG_SVC_CD , SSP_PNL_NO , TRIM(SSP_SURG_LAST_NM) || ', ' || TRIM(SSP_SURG_FIRST_NM) SURGEON FROM IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT LEFT JOIN IDB.CD_DOCUMENT ON CDD_MRN = SSE_MRN AND CDD_SERVICE_DTE = SSE_SURG_DTE LEFT JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE ON SSE_LOG_ID = SSP_LOG_ID AND SSE_ENC_CSN_ID = SSP_ENC_CSN_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_PROVIDER ON CDD_AUTH_PROV_GUID = OP_PVDR_GUID AND OP_PVDR_NO = SSP_RES_ID WHERE (SSE_SURG_LOC not like '%IR%' AND SSE_SURG_LOC not like '%ENDO%' AND SSE_SOURCE_TYPE <> 'E') AND SSE_SURG_DTE = CASE WHEN DAYOFWEEK(CURRENT date) = 2 THEN CURRENT DATE - 3 DAY ELSE CURRENT DATE - 1 DAY END AND SSP_PNL_NO >= 1 ) , SURG_PNL_CT AS (SELECT SSE_LOG_ID, SSP_PNL_NO, COUNT(*) PANEL_COUNT FROM IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT LEFT JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE ON SSE_LOG_ID = SSP_LOG_ID AND SSE_ENC_CSN_ID = SSP_ENC_CSN_ID WHERE (SSE_SURG_LOC not like '%IR%' AND SSE_SURG_LOC not like '%ENDO%' AND SSE_SOURCE_TYPE <> 'E') AND SSE_SURG_DTE = CASE WHEN DAYOFWEEK(CURRENT date) = 2 THEN CURRENT DATE - 3 DAY ELSE CURRENT DATE - 1 DAY END AND SSP_PNL_NO >= 1 GROUP BY SSE_LOG_ID, SSP_PNL_NO) , DOC AS (SELECT DISTINCT CDD_MRN AS "MRN", CDD_SERVICE_DTE AS "Service Date", CDD_AUTHORED_DTE, CDD_DOC_NAME AS "Document Name", OP_DISPLAY_NAME AS "Provider", CDD_DOC_GUID AS DOC_GUID, CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND AS INCOMPLETE_IND FROM IDB.CD_DOCUMENT LEFT JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION ON CDD_DOC_GUID = CDO_DOC_GUID AND CDD_AUTHORED_DTE = CDO_AUTHORED_DTE AND CDO_VALUE_TEXT <> '' JOIN IDB.OMS_PROVIDER ON CDD_AUTH_PROV_GUID = OP_PVDR_GUID WHERE CDD_CANCEL_IND <> '1' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND <> '1' AND CDD_SERVICE_DTE = CASE WHEN DAYOFWEEK(CURRENT date) = 2 THEN CURRENT DATE - 3 DAY ELSE CURRENT DATE - 1 DAY END AND (CDD_DOC_NAME like 'Operative%' OR CDD_DOC_NAME like 'Endoscopy Proc%' OR CDD_DOC_NAME like 'Procedure Note%' OR CDD_DOC_NAME like '%Procedure Rep%') ) , X AS (SELECT DISTINCT SURG.SSE_MRN MRN, SURG.SSE_LOG_ID SURG_LOG_ID, SURG.SSE_SURG_DTE SURG_DATE, SURG.SSE_SURG_LOC SURG_LOCATION, SURG.SSE_PT_TYPE SURG_PT_TYPE, SURG.SURGEON SURG_SURGEON, SURG.SSP_SURG_SVC_CD SURG_SERVICE, SURG.SSP_PNL_NO, PANEL_COUNT, CASE WHEN PANEL_COUNT > 1 THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS MULTIPLE_PANEL FROM SURG LEFT JOIN SURG_PNL_CT ON SURG.SSE_LOG_ID = SURG_PNL_CT.SSE_LOG_ID AND SURG.SSP_PNL_NO = SURG_PNL_CT.SSP_PNL_NO ) , Y AS (SELECT DISTINCT X.*, DOC."Document Name" DOC_DOCUMENT_NAME, DOC."Provider" DOV_PROVIDER, CDD_AUTHORED_DTE DOC_AUTHORED_DTE, DOC_GUID, CASE WHEN DOC_GUID IS NULL THEN 'Missing' WHEN INCOMPLETE_IND = 1 THEN 'Incomplete' WHEN INCOMPLETE_IND = 0 THEN 'Complete' END AS "Documentation Status" FROM X LEFT JOIN DOC ON X.MRN = DOC.MRN AND X.SURG_DATE = DOC."Service Date" WHERE DOC.MRN IS NULL AND DOC."Service Date" IS NULL ) SELECT * FROM Y

prompt: Identify all patients with esophageal cancer who have received preoperative chemotherapy and radiation followed by curative surgery (esophagectomy) at MSKCC.
completion: WITH CTE AS (SELECT PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID AS DEID, ICD9_DX_DTE, CDB_DX_DTE FROM DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS LEFT JOIN (SELECT PDX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID AS ICD9_DEID, MIN(DT_DTE) AS ICD9_DX_DTE FROM DV.PATIENT_DIAGNOSIS_FINAL_ALL_V JOIN DV.DIAGNOSIS_CATALOG ON DXCC_DX_CATALOG_ID = PDX_DX_CATALOG_ID JOIN DV.DATE ON DT_DATE_ID = PDX_DX_DATE_ID WHERE DXCC_ICD_CODE BETWEEN '150' AND '151.9' AND DXA_CIC_CDER_INIT = 'YES' GROUP BY PDX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID ) AS ICD9 ON ICD9_DEID = PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID LEFT JOIN (SELECT CDTM_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID AS CDB_DEID, DT_DTE AS CDB_DX_DTE FROM DV.CDB_TUMOR_V JOIN DV.ICDO_SITE_CATALOG_V ON CDTM_SITE_CATALOG_ID = ICSC_SITE_CATALOG_ID JOIN DV.DATE ON DT_DATE_ID = CDTM_DX_DATE_ID WHERE ICSC_SITE_CD BETWEEN 'C150' AND 'C169' ) AS CDB ON CDB_DEID = PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID WHERE COALESCE(ICD9_DEID, CDB_DEID) IS NOT NULL ), CHEMO AS (SELECT DEID AS CHEMO_DEID, MIN("t4"."DT_DTE") AS "Min Chemo Dispense Date" FROM CTE JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON DEID = PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID JOIN "DV"."PHM_PT_MEDS_MQT" "t5" ON DEID = "t5"."POD_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" JOIN "DV"."PHM_ORDER_DTL" "t6" ON "t5"."POD_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t6"."POD_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AND "t5"."POD_PHARMA_INVENTORY_CTLG_ID" = "t6"."POD_PHARMA_INVENTORY_CTLG_ID" JOIN "DV"."PHM_ORDER_DISPENSE_OCCR" "t7" ON "t6"."POD_PHARMA_ORDER_DETAIL_ID" = "t7"."PDO_PHARMA_ORDER_DETAIL_ID" JOIN "DV"."DATE" "t4" ON "t7"."PDO_DISPNS_DATE_ID" = "t4"."DT_DATE_ID" JOIN "DV"."PHM_INVENTORY_CATALOG" "t3" ON "t5"."POD_PHARMA_INVENTORY_CTLG_ID" = "t3"."PINC_INVENTORY_CTLG_ID" WHERE "t3"."PINC_CHEMO_IND" IN ('Y') GROUP BY DEID), RT_APPT AS (SELECT DISTINCT PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID AS RT_DEID, MIN(DT_DTE) AS "Min Rad Onc NV or IR Appt" FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V" "t1" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED" "t6" ON "t1"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t6"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_ENCOUNTER" "t7" ON "t6"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t7"."PENC_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."ENCOUNTER_DEPARTMENT" "t3" ON "t7"."PENC_DEPT_ID" = "t3"."ENDP_ENC_DEPT_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."ENCOUNTER_VISIT_TYPE" "t5" ON "t7"."PENC_VISIT_TYPE_ID" = "t5"."ENVT_ENC_VISIT_TYPE_ID" JOIN DV.DATE ON PENC_ENC_DATE_ID = DT_DATE_ID WHERE "t7"."PENC_APPT_STS" IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND "t3"."ENDP_SERVICE_DEPT_GRP_6" = 'RDO' AND ("t5"."ENVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR" LIKE '%IR%' OR "t5"."ENVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR" LIKE '%NV%') AND PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID IN (SELECT DEID FROM CTE) GROUP BY PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID ), SURG AS (SELECT DEID AS SURG_DEID, CDB_DX_DTE, ICD9_DX_DTE, "Min Chemo Dispense Date", "Min Rad Onc NV or IR Appt", "t2"."PCC_CODE" AS "Surg CPT Procedure Code", "t2"."PCC_DESC" AS "Surg CPT Procedure Desc", MIN(DT_DTE) AS "Min Surg CPT Procedure Date" FROM CTE JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V" "t1" ON DEID = "t1"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" JOIN "DV"."CPT_PBD_PATIENT_PROCEDURE" "t2" ON "t1"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t2"."PTX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" JOIN DV.DATE ON DT_DATE_ID = PTX_PROC_DATE_ID JOIN CHEMO ON CHEMO_DEID = "t1"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" JOIN RT_APPT ON RT_DEID = "t1"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" WHERE "t2"."PCC_CODE" IN ('43100', '43101', '43105', '43106', '43107', '43108', '43110', '43111', '43112', '43113', '43115', '43116', '43117', '43118', '43119', '43120', '43121', '43122', '43123', '43124', '43130', '43135', '43605', '43606', '43610', '43611', '43620', '43621', '43622', '43625', '43630', '43631', '43632', '43633', '43634', '43635', '43638', '43639', '43640', '43641') AND DT_DTE >= "Min Chemo Dispense Date" AND DT_DTE >= "Min Rad Onc NV or IR Appt" GROUP BY DEID, CDB_DX_DTE, ICD9_DX_DTE, "Min Chemo Dispense Date", "Min Rad Onc NV or IR Appt", "t2"."PCC_CODE", "t2"."PCC_DESC"), MIN_SURG AS (SELECT SURG_DEID, MIN("Min Surg CPT Procedure Date") AS MIN_SURG_DTE FROM SURG GROUP BY SURG_DEID), ENDO AS (SELECT DEID AS ENDO_DEID, "t2"."PCC_CODE" AS "Endo CPT Procedure Code", "t2"."PCC_DESC" AS "Endo CPT Procedure Desc", MIN(DT_DTE) AS "Min Endo CPT Procedure Date" FROM CTE JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V" "t1" ON DEID = "t1"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" JOIN "DV"."CPT_PBD_PATIENT_PROCEDURE" "t2" ON "t1"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t2"."PTX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" JOIN DV.DATE ON DT_DATE_ID = PTX_PROC_DATE_ID JOIN MIN_SURG ON SURG_DEID = "t1"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" WHERE "t2"."PCC_CODE" IN ('43200', '43201', '43202', '43204', '43205', '43215', '43216', '43217', '43219', '4322F', '43220', '43226', '43227', '43228', '43231', '43232', '43234', '43235', '43236', '43237', '43238', '43239', '4324F', '43240', '43241', '43242', '43243', '43244', '43245', '43246', '43247', '43248', '43249', '4325F', '43250', '43251', '43255', '43256', '43257', '43258', '43259', '4326F', '43260', '43261', '43262', '43263', '43264', '43265', '43267', '43268', '43269', '43271', '43272', '43273') AND DT_DTE >= MIN_SURG_DTE GROUP BY DEID, "t2"."PCC_CODE", "t2"."PCC_DESC") SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN AS "MRN", PT_LAST_NAME AS "Last Name", PT_FIRST_NAME AS "First Name", PT_BIRTH_DTE AS "Date of Birth", CDB_DX_DTE AS "CDB Tumor Diagnosis Date", ICD9_DX_DTE AS "First ICD-9 Effective Date", "Min Chemo Dispense Date", "Min Rad Onc NV or IR Appt", "Surg CPT Procedure Code", "Surg CPT Procedure Desc", "Min Surg CPT Procedure Date", "Endo CPT Procedure Code", "Endo CPT Procedure Desc", "Min Endo CPT Procedure Date" FROM SURG LEFT JOIN ENDO ON SURG_DEID = ENDO_DEID JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON SURG_DEID = PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID

prompt: Provide a one-time report of all AML and ALL patients with NPM1 or MLL mutations.
completion: WITH DX AS (SELECT CC_MRN AS MRN, CLM_CLSF_CD AS DX_CODE, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS DX_DESC, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS DX_DATE FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND ((CC_PT_TYPE = 'I') OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) AND CC_CLSF_CD IN ('204', '204.0', '204.00', '204.01', '204.02', '205.0', '205.00', '205.01', '205.02', '206', '206.0', '206.00', '206.01', '206.02', '207', '207.0', '207.00', '207.01', '207.02', '207.2', '207.20', '207.21', '207.22', 'C91.0', 'C91.00', 'C91.01', 'C91.02', 'C92.0', 'C92.00', 'C92.01', 'C92.02', 'C92.5', 'C92.50', 'C92.51', 'C92.52', 'C93.0', 'C93.00', 'C93.01', 'C93.02', 'C94.0', 'C94.00', 'C94.01', 'C94.02', 'C94.2', 'C94.20', 'C94.21', 'C94.22') AND CC_EFF_DTE BETWEEN '2016-07-01' AND '2021-06-21' GROUP BY CC_MRN, CLM_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK UNION SELECT TM_MRN AS MRN, TM_HIST_CD AS DX_CODE, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS DX_DESC, TM_DX_DTE AS DX_DATE FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM H ON TM_HIST_CD = H.CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON TM_SITE_CD = S.CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND TM_DX_DTE BETWEEN '2016-07-01' AND '2021-06-21' AND TM_HIST_CD IN ('M9811/3', 'M9812/3', 'M9813/3', 'M9814/3', 'M9815/3', 'M9816/3', 'M9821/3', 'M9826/3', 'M9835/3', 'M9836/3', 'M9837/3', 'M9840/3', 'M9861/3', 'M9865/3', 'M9867/3', 'M9869/3', 'M9871/3', 'M9872/3', 'M9873/3', 'M9874/3', 'M9891/3', 'M9895/3', 'M9896/3', 'M9897/3', 'M9910/3', 'M9911/3', 'M9920/3') ) , DX1 AS (SELECT MRN, LISTAGG(COALESCE(STRIP(CAST(DX_DATE AS VARCHAR(12000))), '') || ' | ' || COALESCE(STRIP(CAST(DX_CODE AS VARCHAR(12000))), '') || ' | ' || COALESCE(STRIP(CAST(DX_DESC AS VARCHAR(12000))), '') , CHR(13) || CHR(10)) WITHIN GROUP( ORDER BY MRN, DX_DATE, DX_CODE) AS DX FROM DX GROUP BY MRN) , G AS (SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN, GENE FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_STRUCTURED_RESULTS_V JOIN DX1 ON PT_MRN = MRN WHERE(GENE like '%NPM1%' OR GENE like '%MLL%')) , G1 AS (SELECT PT_MRN, LISTAGG(COALESCE(STRIP(CAST(GENE AS VARCHAR(12000))), '') , CHR(13) || CHR(10)) WITHIN GROUP( ORDER BY GENE) AS GENE FROM (SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN, GENE FROM G) G2 GROUP BY PT_MRN) , Y AS (SELECT PT_MRN, DX, GENE FROM DX1 JOIN G1 ON DX1.MRN = G1.PT_MRN) SELECT DISTINCT CDD_MRN, CDD_DOC_GUID, CDD_SERVICE_DTE, CDD_DOC_NAME, CDO_SECTION, CDO_CTLG_DISPL_NM, CDO_MSTR_ITEM_NM, CDO_ITEM_NAME, CDO_VALUE_TEXT FROM IDB.CD_DOCUMENT JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION ON CDO_DOC_GUID = CDD_DOC_GUID AND CDO_AUTHORED_DTE = CDD_AUTHORED_DTE WHERE CDD_CANCEL_IND = '0' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND = '0' AND(CDO_VALUE_TEXT LIKE '%AML%' OR CDO_VALUE_TEXT LIKE '%ALL%') AND(CDO_VALUE_TEXT LIKE '%NPM1%' OR CDO_VALUE_TEXT LIKE '%MLL%') AND(UPPER(CDO_VALUE_TEXT) LIKE '%RELAPSE%' OR UPPER(CDO_VALUE_TEXT) LIKE '%REFRACTORY%') AND CDD_SERVICE_DTE BETWEEN '2016-07-01' AND '2021-06-21' AND CDD_MRN NOT IN (SELECT PT_MRN FROM Y) AND UPPER(CDD_DOC_NAME) not like '%INIT%'

prompt: Provide requested data points for a pre-made list of 55 unique MRNs (Pediatric patients diagnosed with Hepatocellular Carcinoma - Michele Cavalli will provide this list)
Create a Tableau dashboard to capture metrics related to pediatric new patients.
completion: SELECT CPE_MRN AS "MRN", TRIM(PT_LAST_NAME) || ', ' || TRIM(PT_FIRST_NAME) "Patient Name", CPE_ENC_CSN_ID, CPE_ENC_DTE AS "Appt Date", CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 AS "Department", CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 AS "Service", CLD_DEPT_NAME AS "Department Name", CRE_RES_NAME AS "Provider Name", CASE WHEN CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR like 'TEL%' THEN 'TeleHealth' WHEN CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR like 'PHONE%' THEN 'Phone' ELSE 'In-Person' END AS "Visit Type Group", CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR AS "Visit Type Abbr", CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME AS "Visit Type", PFA_FST_CHEMO_MSK_DTE "First Chemo Date", PFA_FST_RT_MSK_DTE "First RT Date", PFA_FST_SRG_MSK_DTE "First Surgery Date", DAYS(PFA_FST_MSK_TX_DTE) - DAYS(CPE_ENC_DTE) "Days to Tx" FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON CPE_MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.PT_FIRST_ACTIVITY ON CPE_MRN = PFA_MRN WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN '2019-01-01' AND CURRENT date AND CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR LIKE '%NV%' AND (CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 = ('PED') OR CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_4 = ('PED') OR CLD_DEPT_NAME = 'ORTHOPEDICS 1275-9') AND CPE_CPE_IP_IND <> 'INPATIENT' AND CPE_ENC_DTE = PFA_FST_DRVST_DTE

prompt: Provide a report on Pre-Surgical Testing appointments by region.
completion: SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN AS MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, CPE_APPT_MADE_DTE, CPE_ENC_DTE, DAYS(CPE_ENC_DTE) - DAYS(CPE_APPT_MADE_DTE) AS DAY_DIFF, CLD_DEPT_NAME FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PT_MRN = CPE_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 = 'PST' AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN '2021-01-01' AND CURRENT DATE

prompt: I am requesting at daily Data Excel Spreadsheet of patients admitted to Main each day who have had a previous chaplain contact from 53rd street chaplains (Atsede Elegba and Mary Brett Koplen)
completion: WITH AD AS (SELECT V.VIS_MRN, V.VIS_VISIT_ID, V.VIS_ADM_DTE, VIS_NURS_STA ADMIT_NURS_STA, VIS_BED ADMIT_BED, VIS_ROOM_NUM ADMIT_ROOM_NUM, UC_HOSP_SVC, AV_DESC HOSP_SVC_DESC, TRIM(UC_BED) AS CURR_BED , TRIM(SUBSTR(LTRIM(UC_BED), 1, CASE WHEN LOCATE('_', UC_BED) > 0 THEN LOCATE('_', UC_BED) - 1 WHEN LOCATE(' ', LTRIM(UC_BED)) > 0 THEN LOCATE(' ', LTRIM(UC_BED)) - 1 ELSE LENGTH(TRIM(UC_BED)) END)) AS CURR_ROOM FROM IDB.VISIT V JOIN IDB.UNIFIED_CENSUS A ON V.VIS_VISIT_ID = A.UC_VISIT_ID AND A.UC_END_DTE IS NULL JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS ON AV_CODE = UC_HOSP_SVC AND AV_ELEMENT = 'HOSP_SVC' WHERE 1=1 AND V.VIS_DSCH_DTE IS NULL AND (VIS_IP_OP_ADJUSTED_IND = 'I' OR VIS_PATIENT_TYPE IN ('OAXR', 'OUCO')) AND VIS_VISIT_STATUS IN ('2', '3') ) SELECT CDD_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, YEAR(CURRENT date - PT_BIRTH_DTE) CURR_AGE, PT_SEX_DESC, PT_GENDER GENDER_IDENTITY, UC_HOSP_SVC HOSP_SVC, HOSP_SVC_DESC, VIS_VISIT_ID, VIS_ADM_DTE, ADMIT_NURS_STA, ADMIT_BED, ADMIT_ROOM_NUM, CURR_BED, CURR_ROOM, LISTAGG(CDD_AUTHORED_DTE, ', ') WITHIN GROUP ( ORDER BY CDD_AUTHORED_DTE) CLINDOC_DATES, LISTAGG(DISTINCT CDD_DOCUMENT_TEMPLATE_NAME, ', ') AS CLINDOC_NAMES, CDD_AUTH_PROV_NAME FROM DV.CLINDOC_FULL_TEXT_V JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON PT_MRN=CDD_MRN JOIN AD ON CDD_MRN = VIS_MRN WHERE 1=1 AND CDD_AUTH_PROV_NAME IN ('Elegba, Atsede') GROUP BY CDD_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, YEAR(CURRENT date - PT_BIRTH_DTE), PT_SEX_DESC, PT_GENDER, CDD_AUTH_PROV_NAME , VIS_VISIT_ID, VIS_ADM_DTE, ADMIT_NURS_STA, ADMIT_BED, ADMIT_ROOM_NUM, CURR_BED, CURR_ROOM, UC_HOSP_SVC, HOSP_SVC_DESC ORDER BY CDD_MRN ; WITH AD AS (SELECT V.VIS_MRN, V.VIS_VISIT_ID, V.VIS_ADM_DTE, VIS_NURS_STA ADMIT_NURS_STA, VIS_BED ADMIT_BED, VIS_ROOM_NUM ADMIT_ROOM_NUM, UC_HOSP_SVC, AV_DESC HOSP_SVC_DESC, TRIM(UC_BED) AS CURR_BED , TRIM(SUBSTR(LTRIM(UC_BED), 1, CASE WHEN LOCATE('_', UC_BED) > 0 THEN LOCATE('_', UC_BED) - 1 WHEN LOCATE(' ', LTRIM(UC_BED)) > 0 THEN LOCATE(' ', LTRIM(UC_BED)) - 1 ELSE LENGTH(TRIM(UC_BED)) END)) AS CURR_ROOM FROM IDB.VISIT V JOIN IDB.UNIFIED_CENSUS A ON V.VIS_VISIT_ID = A.UC_VISIT_ID AND A.UC_END_DTE IS NULL JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS ON AV_CODE = UC_HOSP_SVC AND AV_ELEMENT = 'HOSP_SVC' WHERE 1=1 AND V.VIS_DSCH_DTE IS NULL AND (VIS_IP_OP_ADJUSTED_IND = 'I' OR VIS_PATIENT_TYPE IN ('OAXR', 'OUCO')) AND VIS_VISIT_STATUS IN ('2', '3') ) SELECT CDD_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, YEAR(CURRENT date - PT_BIRTH_DTE) CURR_AGE, PT_SEX_DESC, PT_GENDER GENDER_IDENTITY, UC_HOSP_SVC HOSP_SVC, HOSP_SVC_DESC, VIS_VISIT_ID, VIS_ADM_DTE, ADMIT_NURS_STA, ADMIT_BED, ADMIT_ROOM_NUM, CURR_BED, CURR_ROOM, LISTAGG(CDD_AUTHORED_DTE, ', ') WITHIN GROUP ( ORDER BY CDD_AUTHORED_DTE) CLINDOC_DATES, LISTAGG(DISTINCT CDD_DOCUMENT_TEMPLATE_NAME, ', ') AS CLINDOC_NAMES, CDD_AUTH_PROV_NAME FROM DV.CLINDOC_FULL_TEXT_V JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON PT_MRN=CDD_MRN JOIN AD ON CDD_MRN = VIS_MRN WHERE 1=1 AND CDD_AUTH_PROV_NAME IN ('Koplen, Mary') GROUP BY CDD_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, YEAR(CURRENT date - PT_BIRTH_DTE), PT_SEX_DESC, PT_GENDER, CDD_AUTH_PROV_NAME , VIS_VISIT_ID, VIS_ADM_DTE, ADMIT_NURS_STA, ADMIT_BED, ADMIT_ROOM_NUM, CURR_BED, CURR_ROOM, UC_HOSP_SVC, HOSP_SVC_DESC ORDER BY CDD_MRN ;

prompt: Survivorship patients seen since 2017 that have a pathology report after their survivorship appointment
completion: WITH APPT AS (SELECT CPE_MRN, CPE_ENC_CSN_ID, CPE_ENC_DTE, CLD_DEPT_NAME, CRE_RES_TYP, CRE_RES_NAME, CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR, CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME, CLD_CLD_CENTER, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_1 FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN '2017-01-01' AND '2018-12-31' AND (CLD_DEPT_NAME LIKE '%SVR%' OR CLD_DEPT_NAME LIKE '%SURVIVOR%' OR CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME LIKE '%SNP %' OR CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR like 'SAPP %') ) SELECT CPE_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, CPE_ENC_CSN_ID, CPE_ENC_DTE, CLD_DEPT_NAME, CRE_RES_TYP, CRE_RES_NAME, CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR, CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME, CLD_CLD_CENTER, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_1, PRPT_REPORT_TYPE_DESC, PRPT_PROCEDURE_DTE FROM APPT JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V ON CPE_MRN = PRPT_MRN AND PRPT_PROCEDURE_DTE >= CPE_ENC_DTE JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V ON CPE_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE PRPT_REPORT_TYPE_DESC NOT IN ('Diagnostic Molecular Genetics', 'Diagnostic Molecular Pathology') AND PRPT_PROCEDURE_DTE >= '2017-01-01'

prompt: Please provide list of patients with appendiceal neoplasm (primary or metastatic) OR Colon and Rectal Cancer with peritoneal mets  from 1/12007 to 6/30/2023.
completion: WITH MAIN AS (SELECT DISTINCT TM_MRN AS DX_MRN, TM_DX_DTE AS DX_DATE, TM_SITE_CD AS DX_CODE, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS DX_DESC FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM H ON TM_HIST_CD = H.CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON TM_SITE_CD = S.CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE TM_CASE_STS = '3' AND TM_SITE_CD IN ('C182', 'C183', 'C184', 'C185', 'C186', 'C187', 'C188', 'C189', 'C180', 'C181', 'C199', 'C209', 'C218', 'C218') AND TM_DX_DTE BETWEEN '2007-01-01' AND '2023-06-30' UNION SELECT CC_MRN AS DX_MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS DX_DATE, CLM_CLSF_CD AS DX_CODE, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS DX_DESC FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND ((CC_PT_TYPE = 'I') OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) AND CC_MRN IN (SELECT DISTINCT CC_MRN FROM (SELECT DISTINCT CC_MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS MIN_DT FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF WHERE CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND ((CC_PT_TYPE = 'I') OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) AND CC_CLSF_CD IN ('C78.6', '197.6') GROUP BY CC_MRN HAVING MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) BETWEEN '2007-01-01' AND '2023-06-30')) AND (CC_CLSF_CD IN ('153', '153.1', '153.2', '153.3', '153.4', '153.5', '153.6', '153.7', '153.8', '153.9', '154.8', '154') OR CC_CLSF_CD IN ('C18.0', 'C18.1 ', 'C18.2 ', 'C18.3 ', 'C18.4 ', 'C18.5 ', 'C18.6 ', 'C18.7 ', 'C18.8 ', 'C18.9 ', 'C20', 'C49.A5', 'C7A.026')) GROUP BY CC_MRN, CLM_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK HAVING MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) BETWEEN '2007-01-01' AND '2023-06-30') , CH AS (SELECT DISTINCT DX_MRN, DX_DATE, DX_CODE, DX_DESC FROM MAIN) SELECT PDWS_NAME, PT_MRN, PDRX_ACCESSION_NO, DTRPT.DT_DTE AS REPORTDATE_PATHCLIN, DTPROCPATHRPT.DT_DTE AS PROCEDUREDATE_PATHCLIN, TOTAL_NUMBER_VARIANTS, VARIANT_CLASS, SITE1_GENE, SITE2_GENE, GENE_ID, EXON_NUM, AA_CHANGE, CDNA_CHANGE, GENE_FOLD_CHANGE, CASE WHEN GENE_FOLD_CHANGE IS NULL THEN 'N/A' WHEN LEFT(LTRIM(RTRIM(GENE_FOLD_CHANGE)), 1) = '-' THEN 'Deletion' ELSE 'Amplification' END AS AMPLIFICATION_DELETION_INDICATOR, CHROMOSOME, IS_HOTSPOT, CONFIDENCE_CV_ID, TRANSCRIPT_ID, NORMAL_DP, TUMOR_DP, NORMAL_AD, TUMOR_AD, TUMOR_VFREQ, DBSNP_ID, START_POSITION, ALT_ALLELE, REF_ALLELE, MAF_VARIANT_TYPE, MAF_NP_COUNT, MAF_START_POSITION, MAF_END_POSITION, MAF_REF_ALLELE, MAF_ALT_ALLELE, MAF_T_REF_COUNT, MAF_VARIANT_CLASSIFICATION, TMB_COHORT_PERCENTILE, TMB_TT_COHORT, TMBSCORE, TMB_TT_PERCENTILE, TMBCOHORT, VARIANT_TYPE, GENE_PANEL, PART_DESCRIPTION, DV.REGEXSTR('(S|H|C|M|F|B|DMG)[0-9]{2}[\s|-][0-9]*', XMLCAST(XMLQUERY('$x/root/meta-data/part_description' PASSING PDRX_XML_VALUE AS "x") AS VARCHAR(2000))) AS REFERENCEDACCESSION, PROJECT, SAMPLEID, PATIENTID, TUMOR_TYPE_CODE, TUMOR_TYPE_NAME, IS_METASTASIS, PRIMARY_SITE, METASTASIS_SITE, DT_PROCEDURE, DT_SIGNOUT, DT_ACCESSIONED, DT_ALYS_END_TIME, DT_DMS_START_TIME FROM DVDMC.PATHOLOGY_DMP_WEBSVC_SETTINGS ON PDRXS_SETTING_ID = PDWS_SETTING_ID INNER JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON PDRX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID JOIN CH ON PT_MRN = DX_MRN, PATH 'tmb_cohort_percentile', TMB_TT_COHORT VARCHAR(25) PATH 'tmb_tt_cohort', TMBSCORE VARCHAR(25) PATH 'tmb_score', TMB_TT_PERCENTILE VARCHAR(25) PATH 'tmb_tt_percentile', TMBCOHORT VARCHAR(25) PATH 'tmb_cohort', VARIANT_TYPE VARCHAR(100) PATH './local-name(.)', GENE_PANEL VARCHAR(100) PATH '../meta-data/gene-panel', PART_DESCRIPTION VARCHAR(2000) PATH '../meta-data/part_description', PROJECT VARCHAR(100) PATH '../meta-data/dmp_alys_task_name', SAMPLEID VARCHAR(100) PATH '../meta-data/dmp_sample_id', PATIENTID VARCHAR(100) PATH '../meta-data/dmp_patient_id', TUMOR_TYPE_CODE VARCHAR(100) prompt: Identify patients with stage I testis cancer.
completion: SELECT DISTINCT "t1"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AS "Deident PT #", "t2"."PT_MRN" AS "MRN", "t2"."PT_LAST_NAME" AS "Last Name", "t3"."TCA_CLASS_OF_CASE" AS "Class of Case", "t4"."DXCC_ICD_CODE" AS "ICD-O Histology Code", "t4"."DXCC_ICD_MSK_DESC" AS "ICD-O Histology Desc", "t5"."ICSC_SITE_CD" AS "ICD-O Site Code", "t5"."ICSC_ICDO_SITE_MSK_DESC" AS "ICD-O Site Desc", "t6"."DT_DTE" AS "CDB Tumor Diagnosis Date", "t7"."TCLSA_CLIN_TNM_N_DESC" AS "Clinical Nodes", "t8"."TPSA_PATH_TNM_N_DESC" AS "Path Nodes" FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED" "t1" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V" "t2" ON "t1"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t2"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."CDB_TUMOR_V" "t9" ON "t1"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t9"."CDTM_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."TUMOR_CASE_ATTRIBUTES" "t3" ON "t9"."CDTM_CASE_ATTR_ID" = "t3"."TUMOR_CASE_ATTR_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DIAGNOSIS_CODE_CAT_ICDO_V" "t4" ON "t9"."CDTM_DX_CATALOG_ID" = "t4"."DXCC_DX_CATALOG_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."ICDO_SITE_CATALOG_V" "t5" ON "t9"."CDTM_SITE_CATALOG_ID" = "t5"."ICSC_SITE_CATALOG_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE" "t6" ON "t9"."CDTM_DX_DATE_ID" = "t6"."DT_DATE_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."TUMOR_CLINICAL_STAGE_ATTRIBUTES" "t7" ON "t9"."CDTM_CLINICAL_STAGE_ATTR_ID" = "t7"."TCLSA_TM_CLIN_STAGE_ATTR_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."TUMOR_PATH_STAGE_ATTRIBUTES" "t8" ON "t9"."CDTM_PATH_STAGE_ATTR_ID" = "t8"."TPSA_TM_PATH_STAGE_ATTR_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."TUMOR_OTHER_STAGE_ATTRIBUTES" "t10" ON "t9"."CDTM_TM_OTHER_STAGE_ATTR_ID" = "t10"."TOSA_TM_OTHER_STAGE_ATTR_ID" WHERE ("t5"."ICSC_SITE_CD" IN ('C620', 'C621', 'C629') AND ("t10"."TOSA_SEER_SUM_STAGE_DESC" IN ('Localized ') AND "t3"."TCA_CASE_STS_DESC" IN ('Completed ')))

prompt: Need an email list of patients with diagnosis of Bladder Cancer, for a future bladder cancer education event with clinicians.
completion: WITH PTS AS (SELECT DISTINCT CC_MRN AS MRN, PT_LAST_NAME AS LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME AS FIRST_NAME, PT_EMAIL_ADDRESS AS PT_EMAIL , CC_CLSF_CD AS DX_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS DX_DESC FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.SEERGROUPING ON RECODE = CLM_CLSF_RECODE JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON CC_MRN = PT_MRN AND PT_DEATH_IND NOT IN ('C', 'D', 'X') WHERE CLM_CLSF_TYPE IN ('I9', 'I0') AND CLM_CD_TYPE = 'D' AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND (CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) AND CC_EFF_DTE >= '2019-01-01' AND CATEGORY2 = 'Urinary Bladder' ) , APPT AS (SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN , CLD_DEPT_NAME AS DEPT_NAME, CRE_RES_NAME AS RES_NAME, CPE_ENC_DTE AS APPT_DTE, CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME AS VT, CPE_CPE_APPT_STS AS STATUS FROM PTS JOIN IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER ON MRN = CPE_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CRE_RES_ID = CPE_VST_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE 1=1 AND CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Sch', 'Comp', 'Arrived') AND CPE_CPE_IP_IND <> 'INPATIENT' AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT DATE - 2 YEAR AND CURRENT DATE + 2 YEAR ) , LAST_APPT AS (SELECT CPE_MRN AS L_MRN, MAX(APPT_DTE) AS LAST_APPT_DTE FROM APPT WHERE STATUS IN ('Comp', 'Arrived') GROUP BY CPE_MRN) , NEXT_APPT AS (SELECT CPE_MRN AS N_MRN, MIN(APPT_DTE) AS NEXT_APPT_DTE FROM APPT WHERE STATUS IN ('Sch') GROUP BY CPE_MRN) SELECT MRN, LAST_NAME, FIRST_NAME, PT_EMAIL, DX_CD, DX_DESC, LAST_APPT_DTE, NEXT_APPT_DTE FROM PTS LEFT JOIN LAST_APPT ON MRN = L_MRN LEFT JOIN NEXT_APPT ON MRN = N_MRN

prompt: Provide a list of all electroencephalography notes authored by Saman Zafar since July 1, 2019.

prompt: Provide a one time summary of pediatric patients diagnosed and cared for surgically at MSKCC with a sacrococcygeal teratoma.
completion: WITH PT AS (SELECT PRPT_MRN, PRPT_PROCEDURE_DTE, PRPT_REPORT_DTE, PRPT_REPORT_TYPE_DESC, PRPT_ACCESSION_NO, PRPT_REPORT AS REPORT, PRPT_ORD_DR_NAME, PRPT_ORD_DR_SVC_DESC FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V WHERE PRPT_REPORT IS NOT NULL AND PRPT_PROCEDURE_DTE BETWEEN '1960-01-01' AND CURRENT DATE AND CONTAINS("PRPT_REPORT", '("sacrococcygeal" OR "coccyx")') = 1 ) SELECT P.PRPT_MRN, R.PRPT_PROCEDURE_DTE, R.PRPT_REPORT_DTE, R.PRPT_REPORT_TYPE_DESC, R.PRPT_ACCESSION_NO, R.PRPT_REPORT, R.PRPT_ORD_DR_NAME, R.PRPT_ORD_DR_SVC_DESC FROM PT P JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V R ON P.PRPT_MRN = R.PRPT_MRN WHERE R.PRPT_REPORT IS NOT NULL AND R.PRPT_PROCEDURE_DTE BETWEEN '1960-01-01' AND CURRENT DATE AND (CONTAINS("PRPT_REPORT", '("presacral")') = 1 OR CONTAINS("PRPT_REPORT", '("presacral mass")') = 1 OR CONTAINS("PRPT_REPORT", '("sacrococcygeal teratoma")') = 1 OR CONTAINS("PRPT_REPORT", '("SCT")') = 1 OR CONTAINS("PRPT_REPORT", '("Altman")') = 1 OR CONTAINS("PRPT_REPORT", '("teratoma")') = 1 OR CONTAINS("PRPT_REPORT", '("germ cell")') = 1 OR CONTAINS("PRPT_REPORT", '("yolk sac tumor")') = 1 OR CONTAINS("PRPT_REPORT", '("teratocarcinoma")') = 1 OR CONTAINS("PRPT_REPORT", '("endodermal sinus tumor")') = 1 OR CONTAINS("PRPT_REPORT", '("YST")') = 1) ; WITH SRG AS (SELECT SSE_MRN, SSE_SURG_DTE, SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD, SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC, SSP_SURG_LAST_NM, SSP_SURG_FIRST_NM, SSP_SURG_SVC_CD FROM IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE ON SSE_LOG_ID = SSP_LOG_ID AND SSE_ENC_CSN_ID = SSP_ENC_CSN_ID WHERE (SSE_SURG_LOC not like '%IR%' AND SSE_SURG_LOC not like '%ENDO%' AND SSE_SOURCE_TYPE <> 'E') AND SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD IN ('49215', '27080') AND SSE_SURG_DTE BETWEEN '1960-01-01' AND CURRENT DATE ) SELECT S.SSE_MRN, R.SSE_SURG_DTE, P.SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD, P.SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC, P.SSP_SURG_LAST_NM, P.SSP_SURG_FIRST_NM, P.SSP_SURG_SVC_CD FROM SRG S JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT R ON S.SSE_MRN = R.SSE_MRN JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE P ON R.SSE_LOG_ID = P.SSP_LOG_ID AND R.SSE_ENC_CSN_ID = P.SSP_ENC_CSN_ID WHERE (R.SSE_SURG_LOC not like '%IR%' AND R.SSE_SURG_LOC not like '%ENDO%' AND R.SSE_SOURCE_TYPE <> 'E') AND P.SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD IN ('49000', '27040', '27041', '27043', '27045', '27047', '27048', '27049', '27059') AND R.SSE_SURG_DTE BETWEEN '1960-01-01' AND CURRENT DATE ;

prompt: Provide a list of both Adult and Pediatric patients who (1) received a hematopoietic stem cell transplant since 2014 and (2) received Foscarnet post transplant.
completion: WITH BMT AS (SELECT CBM_MRN AS MRN, CBM_TRANSPLANT_TYPE AS BMT_TYPE, CBM_TRANSPLANT_DTE AS BMT_DATE FROM IDB.CRDB_BMT_MEDICINE WHERE CBM_TRANSPLANT_DTE BETWEEN '2014-01-01' AND '2018-08-01' AND CBM_TRANSPLANT_TYPE = 'ALLO' UNION SELECT CBP_MRN AS MRN, CBP_TRANSPLANT_TYPE AS BMT_TYPE, CBP_TRANSPLANT_DTE AS BMT_DATE FROM IDB.CRDB_BMT_PEDIATRICS WHERE CBP_TRANSPLANT_DTE BETWEEN '2014-01-01' AND '2018-08-01' AND CBP_TRANSPLANT_TYPE = 'ALLO' ) SELECT HCPR_MRN , STRIP(PT_LAST_NAME) || ', ' || STRIP(PT_FIRST_NAME) AS NAME , BMT_TYPE , BMT_DATE , YEAR(BMT_DATE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) AS AGE , HCPR_PRESCRIPTION_TYPE_DESC AS RX_TYPE , HGN_GENERIC_NAME AS GENERIC_NAME , HCPR_DRUG_NAME AS DRUG_NAME , CHAR(HCPR_PRESCRIPTION_ID) AS RX_ORD_ID , HCPR_CREATED_DTE AS CREATE_DATE , DATE(HCPR_START_DT) AS START_DATE FROM BMT JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PT_MRN = MRN JOIN IDB.HML_CLIENT_PRESCRIPTION ON HCPR_MRN = MRN AND HCPR_CREATED_DTE BETWEEN '2014-01-01' AND '2018-08-01' LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_CLIENT_VISIT ON OCV_VISIT_GUID = HCPR_VISIT_GUID LEFT JOIN IDB.HML_GENERIC_NAME ON HGN_GENERIC_NAME_ID = HCPR_GENERIC_NAME_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_USER USR ON USR.OU_USER_GUID = HCPR_USER_GUID LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_USER REQ ON REQ.OU_USER_GUID = HCPR_CARE_PROV_GUID LEFT JOIN IDB.HML_RX_UNIT_OF_MEASURE UOM ON UOM.HRUM_RXUOM_ID = HCPR_DOSE_UOM_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.HML_RX_UNIT_OF_MEASURE PKG ON PKG.HRUM_RXUOM_ID = HCPR_INNER_PACKAGE_SIZE_UOM_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.HML_SCRIPT_FREQUENCY ON HSF_SCRIPT_FREQ_ID = HCPR_SCRIPT_FREQ_ID WHERE HCPR_STATUS_TYPE NOT IN (4, 5, 8) AND HCPR_CREATED_DTE IS NOT NULL AND(HCPR_PRESCRIPTION_TYPE = 1 AND HCPR_TRANSMISSION_STATUS IN (1, 2, 5) OR HCPR_PRESCRIPTION_TYPE = 3) AND(UPPER(HCPR_DRUG_NAME) LIKE '%FOSCARNET%' OR UPPER(HGN_GENERIC_NAME) LIKE '%FOSCARNET%') UNION SELECT DISTINCT OO_MRN , STRIP(PT_LAST_NAME) || ', ' || STRIP(PT_FIRST_NAME) AS NAME , BMT_TYPE , BMT_DATE , YEAR(BMT_DATE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) AS AGE , 'CIS' AS RX_TYPE , OO_ORD_NAME AS GENERIC_NAME, '' AS DRUG_NAME , OO_ORD_ID AS RX_ORD_ID , OO_ENTER_DTE AS CREATE_DATE , OOTO_SIGNIFIC_DTE AS START_DATE FROM BMT JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PT_MRN = MRN JOIN IDB.OMS_ORDER ON OO_MRN = MRN AND UPPER(OO_ORD_NAME) LIKE '%FOSCARNET%' AND OO_ORD_STS_CD NOT IN ('CANC', 'CANP', 'AUC3') AND OO_ENTER_DTE BETWEEN '2014-01-01' AND '2018-08-01' LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_MED_DETAIL ON OO_ORD_GUID = OMD_ORD_GUID LEFT JOIN IDB.OAS_ORD_TASK_OCCR ON OOTO_ORD_GUID = OO_ORD_GUID AND OOTO_STATUS_CD = 'Performed' LEFT JOIN IDB.OAS_CTLG_ITEM_TASK ON OOTO_CAT_ITEM_GUID = OCIT_GUID AND OCIT_LEVEL_NO = 0

prompt: Provide the list of Thoracic, Lymphoma and Breast cancer patients, including ethnicity, race and gender.
completion: WITH DEID AS (SELECT CHP_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID AS P_ID FROM DVCMS.COHORT_PATIENT REC JOIN DVCMS.COHORT ON CHP_COHORT_ID = CHT_COHORT_ID WHERE CHP_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID > 0 AND CHP_COHORT_ID IN (10079, 10078, 10077, 9724, 9723, 9722)) , FIN AS (SELECT PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID P_ID , TRIM(REC.PT_SEX) PT_SEX , TRIM(PT_RACE_DESC) PT_RACE_DESC , TRIM(CORE_RACE_DESC) CORE_RACE_DESC , TRIM(CORE_CDB_RACE) CORE_CDB_RACE , TRIM(CORE_ETHNICITY_DESC) CORE_ETHNICITY_DESC FROM DEID JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS REC ON DEID.P_ID = PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID JOIN IDB.PATIENT I ON I.PT_MRN = REC.PT_MRN JOIN DV.PATIENT_LATEST_ACTIVITY ON PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PLA_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID LEFT JOIN DV.PATIENT_CORE_DEMOGRAPHICS ON PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = CORE_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID) SELECT * FROM FIN

prompt: Update DataLine project SUR3788 to include the specified ileostomy closure and colorectal resections.
completion: SELECT SURG.* FROM (SELECT DISTINCT PBD_MRN AS MRN, PBD_SVC_DTE AS SURG_DATE, PBC_CPT_CD CPT_CD, PBD_PBD_CD PBD_CD, PBC_PBD_DESC AS SURG_DESC, DOC_SVC, TIMESTAMP(CS_ADM_DATE, CS_ADM_TIME) AS ADMIT_DT, TIMESTAMP(CS_DSCH_DATE, CS_DSCH_TIME) AS DISCH_DT, DOC_NAME AS SURGEON, SUBSTR(CHAR(PBD_SVC_DTE), 1, 5)|| CASE WHEN MONTH(PBD_SVC_DTE) BETWEEN 1 AND 3 THEN 'Q1' WHEN MONTH(PBD_SVC_DTE) BETWEEN 4 AND 6 THEN 'Q2' WHEN MONTH(PBD_SVC_DTE) BETWEEN 7 AND 9 THEN 'Q3' ELSE 'Q4' END AS SURG_YEAR, CASE WHEN CS_DSCH_DATE IS NOT NULL THEN INT(CS_DAYS_STAY) ELSE DAYS(CURRENT DATE) - DAYS(PBD_SVC_DTE) END LOS, CASE WHEN PBC_CPT_CD IN ('44204', '44205') THEN 'Lap colon resection' WHEN PBC_CPT_CD IN ('44140', '44160') THEN 'Open colon resection' WHEN PBC_CPT_CD IN ('44620') THEN 'Ileostomy closure' WHEN PBC_CPT_CD IN ('44143', '44145', '44146', '45110', '45111', '45112', '45119', '45123') THEN 'Rectal' ELSE 'Other' END SURG_TYPE, PBD_PBD_CD FROM IDB.PBD_DTL_CHARGES JOIN IDB.PBD_CODE ON PBC_PBD_CD = PBD_PBD_CD JOIN IDB.CLM ON CLM_CLSF_CD = PBC_CPT_CD JOIN IDB.PBD_INVOICE ON PBI_MRN = PBD_MRN AND PBI_ACCT_NO = PBD_ACCT_NO AND PBI_INV_NO = PBD_INV_NO AND PBI_INV_STS = ' ' JOIN IDB.DOC ON PBI_PERFORM_DR_NO = DOC_DR_NO JOIN IDB.CASE ON CS_MRN = PBD_MRN AND PBD_SVC_DTE BETWEEN CS_ADM_DATE AND CS_DSCH_DATE AND CS_ACCT_NO LIKE '84%' AND CS_PT_STS <> 'IP' WHERE PBD_SVC_DTE >= CASE WHEN MONTH(CURRENT DATE) IN (1, 2) THEN DATE(STRIP(CHAR(YEAR(CURRENT_DATE) - 1))||'-01-01') ELSE DATE(STRIP(CHAR(YEAR(CURRENT_DATE)))||'-01-01') END AND PBD_SVC_DTE <= DATE(CURRENT_DATE - 1 MONTH - DAY(CURRENT_DATE) DAY) AND PBC_CPT_CD IN ('44140', '44204', '44160', '44205', '44620', '44143', '44145', '44146', '45110', '45111', '45112', '45119', '45123') AND PBC_PBD_DESC LIKE 'COLOR%' ) SURG LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT PBD_MRN, PBD_SVC_DTE, 'Y' HEPATECTOMY_IND FROM IDB.PBD_DTL JOIN IDB.PBD_CODE ON PBC_PBD_CD = PBD_PBD_CD WHERE PBD_SVC_DTE >= CASE WHEN MONTH(CURRENT DATE) IN (1, 2) THEN DATE(STRIP(CHAR(YEAR(CURRENT_DATE) - 1))||'-01-01') ELSE DATE(STRIP(CHAR(YEAR(CURRENT_DATE)))||'-01-01') END AND PBD_SVC_DTE <= DATE(CURRENT_DATE - 1 MONTH - DAY(CURRENT_DATE) DAY) AND PBC_CPT_CD IN ('47120', '47122', '47125', '47130') ) B ON MRN = PBD_MRN AND SURG_DATE = PBD_SVC_DTE WHERE HEPATECTOMY_IND IS NULL

prompt: Provide a monthly list of Clinical Research Enrollment Order (Myeloma) orders released in the prior month.
completion: SELECT OO_MRN MRN, PT_LAST_NAME LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME FIRST_NAME, OO_ORD_NAME, OO_ORD_STS_CD ORDER_STATUS, OSH_CREATE_DTE AS "Order Release Date" FROM IDB.OMS_ORDER JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON OO_MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_STS_HX ON OO_ORD_GUID = OSH_ORD_GUID AND OSH_FUNCTION_CD = '105' WHERE OO_ORD_NAME IN ('Clinical Research Enrollment Order (Myeloma)', 'Myeloma Protocol Referral') AND OSH_CREATE_DTE >= CURRENT date - 1 MONTH AND OO_ORD_STS_CD NOT IN ('CANP', 'CANC', 'AUC3')

prompt: Provide number of breast cancer patients who had surgery (mastectomy or lumpectomy) at MSKCC and have been on anti-estrogen receptor treatment and chemo after surgery from 2013 to 2015
completion: WITH SRG AS (SELECT DISTINCT BS_MRN, DATE(BS_STRT_DT) BS_STRT_DT FROM IDB.BR_SURGERY WHERE YEAR(BS_STRT_DT) BETWEEN 2013 AND 2015 AND UPPER(BS_SURG_TYP_DESC) LIKE '%MASTECTOMY%' ) , HORMONE AS (SELECT APR_MRN AS MRN, BS_STRT_DT FROM IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX JOIN IDB.CHEMO_DRUG_GENERIC ON APR_GENERIC_NAME = CDG_GENERIC_NAME JOIN SRG ON APR_MRN = BS_MRN AND APR_START_DTE >= BS_STRT_DT WHERE CDG_HORMONE_FLAG = 'Y' ) SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT APR_MRN) FROM IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX JOIN IDB.CHEMO_DRUG_GENERIC ON APR_GENERIC_NAME = CDG_GENERIC_NAME JOIN HORMONE ON APR_MRN = MRN AND APR_START_DTE >= BS_STRT_DT JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY ON APR_MRN = PLA_MRN JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON APR_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE CDG_CHEMO_FLAG = 'Y' AND CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME IN ('CYCLOPHOSPHAMIDE', 'DOXORUBICIN')

prompt: Provide a list of of patients with diffuse intrinsic pontine glioma who have had a biopsy at MSK or diagnosed at an outside hospital
completion: WITH PATH AS (SELECT DISTINCT "t1"."PT_MRN" AS "MRN", "t2"."PRPT_ACCESSION_NO" AS "Pathology Report", "t3"."DT_DTE" AS DX_DATE, "t4"."DT_DTE" AS "Pathology Report Date", "t5"."PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_DESC" AS "Pathology Report Type" FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V" "t1" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED" "t6" ON "t1"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t6"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V" "t2" ON "t6"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t2"."PRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" "t3" ON "t2"."PRPT_PROCEDURE_DATE_ID" = "t3"."DT_DATE_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" "t4" ON "t2"."PRPT_REPORT_DATE_ID" = "t4"."DT_DATE_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATH_RPRT_TYPE_LOOKUP" "t5" ON "t2"."PRPT_REPORT_TYPE" = "t5"."PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_CD" WHERE (CONTAINS("t2"."PRPT_REPORT", '("DIPG" | "diffuse intrinsic pontine glioma")') = 1 AND "t2"."PRPT_REPORT" IS NOT NULL) AND "t3"."DT_DTE" BETWEEN '1985-01-01' AND '2020-06-30' AND YEAR("t3"."DT_DTE" - PT_BIRTH_DTE) <= 30 ) , CC AS (SELECT CC_MRN AS MRN, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH AS DOB, YEAR(MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) AS DX_AGE, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS DX_DATE, CLM_CLSF_CD AS DX_CODE, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS DX_DESC FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON CC_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND ((CC_PT_TYPE = 'I') OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) AND CC_CLSF_CD IN ('191.7', 'C71.7') GROUP BY CC_MRN, CLM_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH HAVING YEAR(MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) <= 30 AND MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) BETWEEN '1985-01-01' AND '2020-06-30') , TM AS (SELECT TM_MRN AS MRN, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH AS DOB, TM_DX_DTE AS DX_DATE, YEAR(TM_DX_DTE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) AS DX_AGE, TM_SITE_CD AS SITE_CODE, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_DESC, TM_HIST_CD AS HIST_CODE, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS HIST_DESC FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON TM_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.CLM H ON TM_HIST_CD = H.CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON TM_SITE_CD = S.CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND TM_SITE_CD = 'C717' AND YEAR(TM_DX_DTE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) <= 30 AND TM_DX_DTE BETWEEN '1985-01-01' AND '2020-06-30' ) , X AS (SELECT MRN, DX_DATE, STRIP("Pathology Report") AS DX_CODE FROM PATH UNION SELECT MRN, DX_DATE, STRIP(DX_CODE) || ' - ' || STRIP(DX_DESC) AS DX_CODE FROM CC UNION SELECT MRN, DX_DATE, STRIP(SITE_CODE) || ' - ' || STRIP(SITE_DESC) || ' | ' || STRIP(HIST_CODE) || ' - ' || STRIP(HIST_DESC) AS DX_CODE FROM TM) SELECT MRN, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH AS DOB, PT_DATE_OF_DEATH AS DOD, LISTAGG(COALESCE(STRIP(CAST(DX_DATE AS VARCHAR(12000))), '') || ' : ' || COALESCE(STRIP(CAST(DX_CODE AS VARCHAR(12000))), '') , CHR(13) || CHR(10)) WITHIN GROUP( ORDER BY MRN, DX_DATE, DX_CODE) AS DX FROM X JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON MRN = PT_MRN GROUP BY MRN, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, PT_DATE_OF_DEATH SELECT DISTINCT SSE_MRN, SSE_LOG_ID, SSE_SURG_DTE, SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD, SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC, DATE(SAE_TOX_OCCR_DT) AS COMP_DATE, SAE_TOXICITY_NAME AS COMP_NAME, SAE_TOX_GRADE AS COMP_GRADE, SAE_TOX_GRADE_NAME AS COMP_CRITERIA FROM IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE ON SSE_LOG_ID = SSP_LOG_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.SRG_ADVERSE_EVENT ON SSE_LOG_ID = SAE_SURG_LOG_ID AND SAE_PROC_SEQ_NO = SSP_PROC_SEQ_NO AND SAE_TOX_GRADE > '0' WHERE SSE_MRN IN (SELECT MRN FROM X) SELECT DISTINCT RTC_TX_MRN, RTC_TX_PLAN_NAME, RTC_PRIMARY_REF_POINT, RTC_TX_START_DTE, RTC_TX_STOP_DTE, RTC_TX_ELAPSED_DAYS, RTC_TX_PLANNED_FRACTIONS, RTC_TX_DELIVERED_FRACTIONS, RTC_TX_PLANNED_DOSE, RTC_TX_DELIVERED_DOSE, RTC_DOSE_CORRECTION FROM IDB.RADONC_TREATMENT_COURSE WHERE RTC_TX_MRN IN (SELECT MRN FROM X)

prompt:
A list of all surgical cases since 7/1/08 by Dr. Dennis Kraus (head and neck) that are the following:

any thyroidectomy

any neck dissection

any parotidectomy

prompt: Provide comprehensive list of appointments scheduled under Televirtual Resource in Cadence. That provider ID is 300461.

prompt: To determine incidence of endocarditis in patient population with cancer diagnosis and their overall outcomes.
completion: WITH ENDOCARDITIS AS (SELECT DISTINCT CC_MRN FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE SUBSTR(CC_CLSF_CD, 1, 3) IN ('I38', 'I38', '421') AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' ), ECHO AS (SELECT PBD_MRN FROM ENDOCARDITIS JOIN IDB.PBD_DTL ON CC_MRN = PBD_MRN JOIN IDB.PBD_CODE ON PBD_PBD_CD = PBC_PBD_CD WHERE PBC_PBD_CD IN ('5193306' ,'9593306' ,'5193307' ,'5193302' ,'5193799' ,'4593307' ,'5193308' ,'9503308' ,'5193300' ,'5193325' ,'9693325' ,'4593321' ,'9503321' ,'4593320' ,'9693320' ,'9632026' ,'5132026' ,'9532026' ,'4593312' ,'5130026' ,'4593309' ,'5193309' ,'5193312' ,'4593010' ,'9593010' ,'9693010' ,'1093010' ,'4593300' ,'9593350' ,'1093350' ,'5193351' ,'5199340' ,'4593350' ,'5193350' ,'5199335') ), BLOOD_CULTURE AS (SELECT DISTINCT LR_MRN AS "MRN" FROM ECHO JOIN IDB.LAB_RESULTS ON LR_MRN = PBD_MRN WHERE UPPER(LR_TEST_NAME) LIKE '%CULTURE%' AND UPPER(LR_TEST_NAME) LIKE '%BLOOD%' ) SELECT "MRN", PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, PT_DATE_OF_DEATH FROM BLOOD_CULTURE JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PT_MRN = "MRN" ; WITH ENDOCARDITIS AS (SELECT DISTINCT CC_MRN FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE SUBSTR(CC_CLSF_CD, 1, 3) IN ('I38', 'I38', '421') AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' ), ECHO AS (SELECT PBD_MRN FROM ENDOCARDITIS JOIN IDB.PBD_DTL ON CC_MRN = PBD_MRN JOIN IDB.PBD_CODE ON PBD_PBD_CD = PBC_PBD_CD WHERE PBC_PBD_CD IN ('5193306' ,'9593306' ,'5193307' ,'5193302' ,'5193799' ,'4593307' ,'5193308' ,'9503308' ,'5193300' ,'5193325' ,'9693325' ,'4593321' ,'9503321' ,'4593320' ,'9693320' ,'9632026' ,'5132026' ,'9532026' ,'4593312' ,'5130026' ,'4593309' ,'5193309' ,'5193312' ,'4593010' ,'9593010' ,'9693010' ,'1093010' ,'4593300' ,'9593350' ,'1093350' ,'5193351' ,'5199340' ,'4593350' ,'5193350' ,'5199335') ), BLOOD_CULTURE AS (SELECT DISTINCT LR_MRN AS "MRN" FROM ECHO JOIN IDB.LAB_RESULTS ON LR_MRN = PBD_MRN WHERE UPPER(LR_TEST_NAME) LIKE '%CULTURE%' AND UPPER(LR_TEST_NAME) LIKE '%BLOOD%' ) SELECT TM_MRN, AV_DESC AS CASE_STS, TM_DX_DTE, TM_HIST_CD, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS HIST_DESC, TM_SITE_CD, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_DESC FROM BLOOD_CULTURE JOIN IDB.CDB_TUMOR ON "MRN"=TM_MRN JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS ON AV_ELEMENT = 'CASE_STS' AND AV_CODE = TM_CASE_STS AND TM_CASE_STS IN ('3', '6', '7', '8') ;

prompt: Darwin query to identify newly diagnosed brain mets in patients across the institution, or within EDD (would like to discuss with Michael Eubank)
completion: WITH COHORT AS (SELECT PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID AS P_ID FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON CC_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE SUBSTR(CC_CLSF_CD, 1, 5) = 'C79.3' AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND (CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) GROUP BY PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID HAVING MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) >= '2019-10-28') , RAD_REPORT AS (SELECT MRN, RAD_P_ID, PERFORMED_DTE, REPORT_DTE, IMPRESSION FROM (SELECT RRPT_MRN AS MRN, RRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID AS RAD_P_ID, RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE AS PERFORMED_DTE, RRPT_REPORT_DTE AS REPORT_DTE, DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)IMPRESSION:[\w\W]*(?=DICTATED BY:)', RRPT_REPORT_TXT) AS IMPRESSION, ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY RRPT_MRN ORDER BY RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE DESC) AS RN FROM DV.RADIOLOGY_REPORT_V JOIN COHORT ON RRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = P_ID WHERE RRPT_REPORT_TXT IS NOT NULL AND RRPT_ANC_CODE LIKE 'MR%' AND (UPPER(RRPT_PROCEDURE_NAME) LIKE '%BRAIN%' OR UPPER(RRPT_PROCEDURE_NAME) LIKE '%HEAD%') ) WHERE RN = 1 ) , CDB AS (SELECT PT_MRN, DXCC_ICD_MSK_DESC AS TUMOR_HISTOLOGY FROM DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS JOIN DV.CDB_TUMOR_V ON CDTM_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID JOIN DV.DATE_V ON CDTM_DX_DATE_ID = DT_DATE_ID JOIN DV.DIAGNOSIS_CODE_CAT_ICDO_V ON CDTM_DX_CATALOG_ID = DXCC_DX_CATALOG_ID JOIN DV.ICDO_SITE_CATALOG_V ON CDTM_SITE_CATALOG_ID = ICSC_SITE_CATALOG_ID JOIN DV.TUMOR_CASE_ATTRIBUTES_V ON CDTM_CASE_ATTR_ID = TUMOR_CASE_ATTR_ID) , DEID AS (SELECT DISTINCT P_ID FROM COHORT)

prompt: Provide a list of hpv positive oropharynx cancer patients with hpv negative OPC recurrence.
completion: WITH DX AS (SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN, PT_SEX GENDER, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH DOB, PT_DATE_OF_DEATH DOD, MIN (COALESCE (TM_DX_DTE, MIN_ICD9_EFF_DTE)) DX_DATE FROM IDB.PATIENT LEFT JOIN (SELECT TM_MRN, TM_DX_DTE, TM_SITE_CD, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_DESC FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD AND TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND TM_SITE_CD IN ('C019', ' C028', ' C051', 'C052', 'C058', 'C090', 'C091', 'C099', 'C0100', 'C0101', 'C0102', 'C0103', 'C0108') AND TM_DX_DTE BETWEEN '2000-01-01' AND '2022-04-01') AS CDB ON TM_MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN (SELECT CC_MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS MIN_ICD9_EFF_DTE, CC_CLSF_CD AS ICD9_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS ICD9_DESC FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE CC_CLSF_CD IN ('141.0', '141.5', '145.3', '145.4', '145.5', '146', '146.0', '146.1', '146.2', '146.3', '146.4', '146.5', '146.6', '146.7', '146.8', '146.9', '149', '149.8', 'C01.9', 'C02.4', 'C05.1', 'C05.2', 'C09.0', 'C09.1', 'C09.8', 'C09.9', 'C10.0', 'C10.2', 'C10.3', 'C10.8', 'C10.9', 'C11.1') AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND (CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) GROUP BY CC_MRN, CC_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK HAVING MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) BETWEEN '2000-01-01' AND '2022-04-01') AS ICD9 ON CC_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE COALESCE(TM_MRN, CC_MRN) IS NOT NULL AND PT_MRN IN ('00185682', '00396692' ) GROUP BY PT_MRN, PT_SEX, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, PT_DATE_OF_DEATH ) , APPT AS (SELECT CPE_MRN , CPE_ENC_DTE , ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CPE_MRN ORDER BY CPE_ENC_DTE DESC) LAT_APPT FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN DX ON CPE_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CRE_RES_TYP = 'Physician' AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 = 'HNS' AND CPE_CPE_IP_IND <> 'INPATIENT' ) , POS_PATH AS (SELECT POS_MRN, MIN(POS_RPT_DATE) AS POS_RPT_DATE, FLAG_POSITIVE FROM (SELECT DISTINCT PRPT_MRN POS_MRN, PRPT_REPORT_DTE AS POS_RPT_DATE, CASE WHEN REGEXP_SUBSTR(LOWER (CAST (PRPT_REPORT AS VARCHAR(18000))), '(?:[^.]|^)[^.]*(?:hpv|p16)[^.]*positive[^.]*') IS NOT NULL THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS FLAG_POSITIVE FROM DX JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V ON PRPT_MRN = PT_MRN) WHERE FLAG_POSITIVE ='Y' GROUP BY POS_MRN, FLAG_POSITIVE) , NEG_PATH AS (SELECT NEG_MRN, MIN(NEG_RPT_DATE) AS NEG_RPT_DATE, FLAG_NEGATIVE FROM (SELECT DISTINCT PRPT_MRN AS NEG_MRN, PRPT_REPORT_DTE AS NEG_RPT_DATE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY NEG_MRN ORDER BY FLAG_NEGATIVE ASC) AS RN CASE WHEN REGEXP_SUBSTR(LOWER (CAST (PRPT_REPORT AS VARCHAR(18000))), '(?:[^.]|^)[^.]*(?:hpv|p16)[^.]*negative[^.]*') IS NOT NULL THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS FLAG_NEGATIVE FROM POS_PATH JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V N ON PRPT_MRN = POS_MRN AND N.PRPT_REPORT_DTE >= POS_RPT_DATE + 356 ) WHERE FLAG_NEGATIVE = 'Y' GROUP BY NEG_MRN, FLAG_NEGATIVE) SELECT D.*, CPE_ENC_DTE AS LAST_APPOINTMENT, POS_RPT_DATE, FLAG_POSITIVE, NEG_RPT_DATE, FLAG_NEGATIVE FROM DX D LEFT JOIN APPT ON CPE_MRN = PT_MRN AND LAT_APPT =1 LEFT JOIN POS_PATH P ON PT_MRN = POS_MRN LEFT JOIN NEG_PATH N ON PT_MRN = NEG_MRN

prompt: Identify skin/cutaneous lymphoma patients who were treated with radiation therapy (24Gy or lower)
completion: WITH CDB AS (SELECT DISTINCT TM_MRN, TM_DX_DTE, TRIM(TM_SITE_CD) SITE_CODE, TRIM(S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK) SITE_DESC, TRIM(TM_HIST_CD) HIST_CODE, TRIM(H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK) HIST_DESC FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM H ON TM_HIST_CD = H.CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON TM_SITE_CD = S.CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND TM_SITE_CD like 'C44%' AND TM_HIST_CD IN ('M9597/3', 'M9700/3', 'M9701/3', 'M9708/3', 'M9709/3', 'M9718/3', 'M9725/3', 'M9726/3') ) , ICD AS (SELECT CC_MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS CC_DX_DTE, CLM_CLSF_CD AS SITE_CODE, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_DESC, '' HIST_CODE, '' HIST_DESC FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND ((CC_PT_TYPE = 'I') OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) AND CC_CLSF_CD IN ('202.10', '202.11', '202.12', '202.13', '202.14', '202.15', '202.16', '202.17', '202.18', '202.20', '202.21', '202.22', '202.23', '202.24', '202.25', '202.26', '202.27', '202.28', 'C84.00', 'C84.01', 'C84.02', 'C84.03', 'C84.04', 'C84.05', 'C84.06', 'C84.07', 'C84.08', 'C84.09', 'C84.10', 'C84.11', 'C84.12', 'C84.13', 'C84.14', 'C84.15', 'C84.16', 'C84.17', 'C84.18', 'C84.19', 'C84.A0', 'C84.A1', 'C84.A2', 'C84.A3', 'C84.A4', 'C84.A5', 'C84.A6', 'C84.A7', 'C84.A8', 'C84.A9') AND CC_MRN NOT IN (SELECT TM_MRN FROM CDB) GROUP BY CC_MRN, CLM_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK ) , DX AS (SELECT TM_MRN, DX_DTE, TRIM(PT_LAST_NAME) || ', ' || TRIM(PT_FIRST_NAME) AS PATIENT_NAME, PT_SEX AS GENDER, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH AS DATE_OF_BIRTH, AV_DESC AS VITAL_STATUS FROM (SELECT TM_MRN, MIN(TM_DX_DTE) DX_DTE FROM (SELECT TM_MRN, TM_DX_DTE FROM CDB UNION SELECT CC_MRN AS TM_MRN, CC_DX_DTE AS TM_DX_DTE FROM ICD) GROUP BY TM_MRN ) JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PT_MRN = TM_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS ON AV_ELEMENT = 'DEATH_IND' AND AV_CODE = PT_DEATH_IND) SELECT TM_MRN AS MRN, PATIENT_NAME, DATE_OF_BIRTH, GENDER, VITAL_STATUS, DX_DTE AS DIAGNOSIS_DATE , RTC_TX_PLANNED_FRACTIONS AS PLANNED_FRACTIONS, RTC_TX_DELIVERED_FRACTIONS AS DELIVERED_FRACTIONS, RTC_TX_PLANNED_DOSE AS PLANNED_DOSE, RTC_TX_DELIVERED_DOSE AS DELIVERED_DOSE, RTC_TX_START_DTE AS TX_START_DATE, RTC_TX_STOP_DTE AS TX_STOP_DATE FROM IDB.RADONC_TREATMENT_COURSE JOIN DX ON TM_MRN = RTC_TX_MRN WHERE RTC_TX_DELIVERED_FRACTIONS <= 24 AND DX_DTE BETWEEN '1990-01-01' AND '2022-03-07' AND RTC_TX_START_DTE BETWEEN '1990-01-01' AND '2022-03-07' AND RTC_TX_STOP_DTE BETWEEN '1990-01-01' AND '2022-03-07'

prompt: Identify internal referrals seen by specified providers in 2012.
completion: SELECT CPE_MRN AS "MRN", PT_LAST_NAME AS "Last Name", PT_FIRST_NAME AS "First Name", CPE_ENC_DTE AS "Appt Date", PRI.CRE_RES_NAME AS "Physician", CLD_DEPT_NAME AS "Dept Name", REF.CRE_RES_NAME AS "Referring Provider", MIN_CTC_DTE AS "Min MGUS Date (Clintrac)", MIN_PBD_DTE AS "Min MGUS Date (PBD)" FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PT_MRN = CPE_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE PRI ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = PRI.CRE_RES_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE REF ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = REF.CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID LEFT JOIN (SELECT CC_MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS MIN_CTC_DTE FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF WHERE CC_CLSF_TYPE like 'DF%' AND CC_CLSF_CD = '273.1' GROUP BY CC_MRN) AS CTC ON CC_MRN = CPE_MRN LEFT JOIN (SELECT DX_MRN, MIN(PBD_SVC_DTE) AS MIN_PBD_DTE FROM IDB.PBD_DX JOIN IDB.PBD_DTL ON PBD_MRN = DX_MRN AND PBD_INV_NO = DX_INV_NO WHERE DX_CLSF_CD = '273.1' GROUP BY DX_MRN) AS PBD ON DX_MRN = CPE_MRN WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND PRI.CRE_RES_NAME IN ('HASSOUN, HANI', 'LESOKHIN, ALEXANDER M', 'LENDVAI, NIKOLETTA', 'GIRALT, SERGIO', 'LANDAU, HEATHER J', 'CHUNG, DAVID J', 'KOEHNE, GUENTHER') AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN '2012-01-01' AND '2012-12-31' AND CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR LIKE '%IR%'

other services, who have experienced DTs (ICD9 291.0) postoperatively since April 2010.

CS_ADM_DATE ADM_DTE, CS_DSCH_DATE DSCH_DTE, CS_HOSP_SVC HOSP_SVC FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.CASE ON CC_MRN = CS_MRN AND CC_ACCT_NO = CS_ACCT_NO WHERE CC_CLSF_CD = '291.0' AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND (CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) AND CC_EFF_DTE >= '2010-04-01' ) , SRGDT AS (SELECT DISTINCT MRN, PT_NAME, ACCT_NO, HOSP_SVC, AV_DESC AS HOSP_SVC_DESC, ADM_DTE, DSCH_DTE, SSE_SURG_DTE SURG_DTE, DX_DTE , DX_CD, DX_DESC , SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC PROC_DESC FROM IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT A JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE ON A.SSE_LOG_ID = SSP_LOG_ID JOIN ALLDT B ON MRN = SSE_MRN AND A.SSE_SURG_DTE BETWEEN ADM_DTE AND DSCH_DTE JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS ON HOSP_SVC = AV_CODE AND AV_ELEMENT = 'HOSP_SVC' AND AV_CD_STS = 'A' WHERE SSE_SURG_DTE = (SELECT MAX(SSE_SURG_DTE) FROM IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT WHERE SSE_MRN = A.SSE_MRN AND SSE_SURG_DTE BETWEEN B.ADM_DTE AND B.DSCH_DTE AND SSE_SURG_DTE <= DX_DTE) ) SELECT HOSP_SVC, HOSP_SVC_DESC, COUNT(DISTINCT MRN) AS PT_CNT FROM SRGDT GROUP BY HOSP_SVC, HOSP_SVC_DESC WITH ALLDT AS (SELECT CC_MRN MRN , STRIP(CS_LAST_NAME)||', '||STRIP(CS_FIRST_NAME) PT_NAME, CC_ACCT_NO ACCT_NO, CC_EFF_DTE DX_DTE, CC_CLSF_CD DX_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS DX_DESC, CS_ADM_DATE ADM_DTE, CS_DSCH_DATE DSCH_DTE, CS_HOSP_SVC HOSP_SVC FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.CASE ON CC_MRN = CS_MRN AND CC_ACCT_NO = CS_ACCT_NO WHERE CC_CLSF_CD = '291.0' AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND (CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) AND CC_EFF_DTE >= '2010-04-01' ) , SRGDT AS (SELECT DISTINCT MRN, PT_NAME, ACCT_NO, HOSP_SVC, AV_DESC AS HOSP_SVC_DESC, ADM_DTE, DSCH_DTE, SSE_SURG_DTE SURG_DTE, DX_DTE, DX_CD, DX_DESC, SSE_SURG_LOC SURG_LOC FROM IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE ON SSE_LOG_ID = SSP_LOG_ID JOIN ALLDT ON MRN = SSE_MRN AND SSE_SURG_DTE BETWEEN ADM_DTE AND DSCH_DTE AND DX_DTE >= SSE_SURG_DTE JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS ON HOSP_SVC = AV_CODE AND AV_ELEMENT = 'HOSP_SVC' AND AV_CD_STS = 'A') SELECT HOSP_SVC, HOSP_SVC_DESC, COUNT(DISTINCT MRN) AS PT_CNT FROM SRGDT GROUP BY HOSP_SVC, HOSP_SVC_DESC

prompt: Provide a list of Sheila Kenny's upcoming appointments from Jan - Mar 2020
completion: WITH APPTS AS (SELECT CPE_MRN AS "MRN", PT_LAST_NAME "Last Name", PT_FIRST_NAME "First Name", PT_STATE "State of Residence", CPE_ENC_DTE AS "Appt Date", CPE_APPT_DT, CPP_PP_LST_LGN_DTE "Last Portal Login Date" FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON CPE_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_PAS_PATIENT ON CPE_MRN = CPP_MRN WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Sch') AND CRE_RES_NAME = 'KENNY, SHEILA A' AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN DATE('2019-11-01') + 2 MONTHS AND DATE('2019-11-01') - 1 DAY + 5 MONTHS ) , BMT AS (SELECT CPE_MRN BMT_MRN, CPE_ENC_DTE, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8, CRE_RES_NAME "Last BMT Appt Resource", ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CPE_MRN ORDER BY CPE_ENC_DTE DESC) RN FROM (SELECT DISTINCT "MRN" FROM APPTS) A JOIN IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER ON "MRN" = CPE_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON CPE_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CRE_RES_TYP = 'Physician' AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 = 'MED' AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 = 'BMT' ) , OTH_APPT_RAW AS (SELECT CPE_MRN, E.CPE_ENC_DTE, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8, CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME, CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR, CRE_RES_NAME FROM APPTS A JOIN IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER E ON "MRN" = CPE_MRN AND A."Appt Date" = E.CPE_ENC_DTE JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON CPE_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Sch') AND CRE_RES_NAME <> 'KENNY, SHEILA A' AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 <> 'LAB' ) , OTH_APPT AS (SELECT CPE_MRN, LISTAGG(TRIM(CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6) || ' ' || TRIM(CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8) || ' ' || TRIM(CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME) || ' ' || TRIM(CRE_RES_NAME), CHR(13)||CHR(10)) "Other same day appts" FROM OTH_APPT_RAW GROUP BY CPE_MRN) , DX AS (SELECT TM_MRN DX_MRN, TM_DX_DTE DX_DTE, TM_SITE_CD AS SITE_CODE, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_DESC, TM_HIST_CD AS HIST_CODE, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS HIST_DESC FROM (SELECT DISTINCT "MRN" FROM APPTS) A JOIN IDB.CDB_TUMOR ON "MRN" = TM_MRN JOIN IDB.CLM H ON TM_HIST_CD = H.CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON TM_SITE_CD = S.CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') ) SELECT "MRN", '' "Telemed Eligible", "Last Name", "First Name", "Appt Date", "State of Residence", "Last Portal Login Date", "Other same day appts", CBM_TRANSPLANT_TYPE "Transplant Type", CBM_TRANSPLANT_DTE "Transplant Date", CASE WHEN CBM_TRANSPLANT_DTE BETWEEN "Appt Date" - 18 MONTHS + 1 DAY AND "Appt Date" - 9 MONTHS THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END "12 month post transplant date", "Last BMT Appt Resource" FROM APPTS A LEFT JOIN BMT ON "MRN" = BMT_MRN AND RN = 1 LEFT JOIN IDB.CRDB_BMT_MEDICINE ON "MRN" = CBM_MRN LEFT JOIN DX ON "MRN" = DX_MRN LEFT JOIN OTH_APPT OA ON "MRN" = OA.CPE_MRN ORDER BY CPE_APPT_DT

prompt: Provide a list of ER+ HER- patients who have had a hysterectomy and scheduled appointment with Dept of Surgery / Breast Service.
completion: WITH ERHER AS (SELECT * FROM (SELECT DISTINCT CDD_MRN, MAX(CASE WHEN CDO_ITEM_NAME = 'HER2:' THEN TRIM(CDO_VALUE_TEXT) END) AS HER2, MAX(CASE WHEN CDO_ITEM_NAME = 'ER:'THEN TRIM(CDO_VALUE_TEXT) END) AS ER FROM IDB.CD_DOCUMENT JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION ON CDD_DOC_GUID = CDO_DOC_GUID AND CDD_AUTHORED_DTE = CDO_AUTHORED_DTE WHERE 1=1 AND CDD_CANCEL_IND <> '1' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND <> '1' AND CDD_DOC_NAME like '%Breast%' AND CDO_ITEM_NAME IN ('HER2:', 'ER:') AND CDO_LARGE_VALUE_TEXT_IND <> 'Y' GROUP BY CDD_MRN)A WHERE HER2 = 'Negative' AND ER = 'Positive' ) , SURG AS (SELECT SSE_MRN, SSE_SURG_DTE, SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD, SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC, SSP_SURG_LAST_NM, SSP_SURG_FIRST_NM, SSP_SURG_SVC_CD FROM IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE ON SSE_LOG_ID = SSP_LOG_ID AND SSE_ENC_CSN_ID = SSP_ENC_CSN_ID JOIN ERHER ON SSE_MRN = CDD_MRN WHERE (SSE_SURG_LOC not like '%IR%' AND SSE_SURG_LOC not like '%ENDO%' AND SSE_SOURCE_TYPE <> 'E') AND SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC like '%HYSTERECTOMY%' ) , APPT AS (SELECT CPE_MRN, CPE_ENC_DTE, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8, CLD_DEPT_NAME, CRE_RES_NAME, CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID JOIN SURG ON SSE_MRN = CPE_MRN WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Sch') AND CPE_ENC_DTE >= CURRENT date AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 = 'SRG' AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 = 'BRE' AND CRE_RES_TYP IN ('Physician') ) SELECT DISTINCT CDD_MRN "MRN" , PT_LAST_NAME "PT Last Name" , PT_FIRST_NAME "PT First Name" , CPE_ENC_DTE "Scheduled Appt Date" , CRE_RES_NAME "Scheduled Appt Physician" FROM ERHER JOIN SURG ON CDD_MRN = SSE_MRN JOIN APPT ON CDD_MRN = CPE_MRN JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON CDD_MRN = PT_MRN

prompt: number of new visits with dx of uterine sarcoma seen by GMO by year…..from Jan 1998 to Feb 2024

(SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN, CPE_ENC_CSN_ID, CPE_ENC_DTE FROM APPTS) A JOIN IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER E ON A.CPE_MRN = E.CPE_MRN AND A.CPE_ENC_CSN_ID <> E.CPE_ENC_CSN_ID JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE R ON (NOT (CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME LIKE '%SNP %' OR CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME LIKE '%SAPP %') AND CRE_RES_NAME IN ('KEENAN, KATHLEEN')) THEN 0 WHEN (CLD_DEPT_NAME LIKE '%SVR%' OR CLD_DEPT_NAME LIKE '%SURVIVOR%' OR CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME LIKE '%SNP %' OR CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR like 'SAPP %') THEN 1 WHEN CLD_DEPT_NAME IN ('GEN INTERNAL MED 53-5', 'GEN INT MED 53-5 APP') THEN 1 WHEN CRE_RES_NAME = 'PAISLEY, KATHLEEN M' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END = 1 ) , PRIOR_MD_APPT AS (SELECT A.CPE_MRN LAST_MD_APPT_MRN, A.CPE_ENC_DTE, E.CPE_ENC_CSN_ID, E.CPE_ENC_DTE LAST_MD_APPT_DATE, R.CRE_RES_NAME LAST_MD_APPT_RESOURCE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY A.CPE_MRN, A.CPE_ENC_DTE ORDER BY E.CPE_ENC_DTE DESC) RN FROM (SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN, CPE_ENC_CSN_ID, CPE_ENC_DTE FROM APPTS) A JOIN IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER E ON A.CPE_MRN = E.CPE_MRN AND A.CPE_ENC_CSN_ID <> E.CPE_ENC_CSN_ID JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE R ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT D ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE V ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = D.CLD_DEPT_NAME, R.CRE_RES_NAME FROM APPTS A JOIN IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER E ON A.CPE_MRN = E.CPE_MRN AND A.CPE_ENC_DTE = E.CPE_ENC_DTE AND A.CPE_ENC_CSN_ID <> E.CPE_ENC_CSN_ID JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE R ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT D ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE V ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Sch') ORDER BY A.CPE_MRN, E.CPE_APPT_DT) , OTH_APPT AS (SELECT CPE_MRN, LISTAGG(TRIM(CPE_APPT_DT) || ': ' || TRIM(CLD_DEPT_NAME) || ' ' || TRIM(CRE_RES_NAME), CHR(13)||CHR(10)) "Other same day appts" FROM OTH_APPT_RAW GROUP BY CPE_MRN) SELECT A.CPE_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_STATE, CPP_PP_LST_LGN_DTE, A.CPE_ENC_DTE, A.CLD_DEPT_NAME, A.CRE_RES_NAME, A.CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR, A.CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME, A.CLD_CLD_CENTER, LAST_SVP_APPT_DATE, CASE WHEN LAST_SVP_APPT_MRN IS NULL THEN LAST_MD_APPT_DATE END LAST_MD_APPT_DATE, CASE WHEN LAST_SVP_APPT_MRN IS NULL THEN LAST_MD_APPT_RESOURCE END LAST_MD_APPT_RESOURCE, CASE WHEN DAYS(A.CPE_ENC_DTE) - DAYS(COALESCE(LAST_SVP_APPT_DATE, LAST_MD_APPT_DATE)) <= 274 THEN 'Last SVP/MD Appt <= 9 months' WHEN DAYS(A.CPE_ENC_DTE) - DAYS(COALESCE(LAST_SVP_APPT_DATE, LAST_MD_APPT_DATE)) >= 275 THEN 'Last SVP/MD Appt >= 10 months' END LAST_SVP_MD_GROUP FROM APPTS A JOIN IDB.CL_PAS_PATIENT ON A.CPE_MRN = CPP_MRN JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON A.CPE_MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN PRIOR_SVP_APPT SVP ON A.CPE_MRN = LAST_SVP_APPT_MRN AND A.CPE_ENC_DTE = SVP.CPE_ENC_DTE AND SVP.RN = 1 LEFT JOIN PRIOR_MD_APPT MD ON A.CPE_MRN = LAST_MD_APPT_MRN AND A.CPE_ENC_DTE = MD.CPE_ENC_DTE AND MD.RN = 1 LEFT JOIN OTH_APPT OA ON A.CPE_MRN = OA.CPE_MRN ORDER BY CPE_APPT_DT

LAST_CONTACT_DATE, PLA_LST_CHEMO_DTE AS LAST_CHEMO_DATE, PLA_LST_RT_DTE AS LAST_RAD_TX_DATE, PLA_LST_SURG_DTE AS LAST_SURG_DATE, PLA_LST_TX_DTE AS LAST_TX_DATE, PLA_LST_ACTV_DTE AS LAST_ACTV_DATE, TM_HIST_CD AS HIST_CODE, HIST.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS HIST_DESC, TM_SITE_CD AS SITE_CODE, SITE.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_DESC, TM_DX_DTE AS DX_DATE, TM_CLIN_STG_GRP AS CLINICAL_GRP, TM_CLIN_TNM_T AS CLIN_TMN_T, TM_CLIN_TNM_N AS CLIN_TNM_N, TM_CLIN_TNM_M AS CLIN_TNM_M, TM_PATH_STG_GRP AS PATH_GRP, TM_PATH_TNM_T AS PATH_TNM_T, TM_PATH_TNM_N AS PATH_TNM_N, TM_PATH_TNM_M AS PATH_TNM_M, COC.AV_DESC AS CLASS_OF_CASE, CASE WHEN TM_SMOKING_HX = '0' THEN 'Never used' WHEN TM_SMOKING_HX = '1' THEN 'Cigarette smoker current' WHEN TM_SMOKING_HX = '2' THEN 'Cigar/pipe smoker current' WHEN TM_SMOKING_HX = '3' THEN 'Snuff/chew/smokeless current' WHEN TM_SMOKING_HX = '4' THEN 'Combination use current' WHEN TM_SMOKING_HX = '5' THEN 'Previous use' WHEN TM_SMOKING_HX = '9' THEN 'Unknown' ELSE TM_SMOKING_HX END AS SMOKING_HX, TM_HIST_CD_GRADE AS HIST_CD_GRADE, TM_REGNODE_EXM_NO AS REGNODE_EXM_NO, TM_REGNODE_POS_NO AS REGNODE_POS_NO, TM_TUMOR_SIZE AS TUMOR_SIZE, TM_CSSIZE AS CSSIZE, TM_FIRST_RECUR_DTE AS FIRST_RECUR_DATE, TM_FIRST_RECUR_TYP AS FIRST_RECUR_TYP, TM_FIRST_TX_DTE AS FIRST_TX_DATE, TM_CA_SURG_98 AS CA_SURG_98, TM_CA_SURG_98_MSK AS CA_SURG_98_MSK, TM_CA_SURG_03 AS CA_SURG_03, TM_CA_SURG_03_MSK AS CA_SURG_03_MSK, TM_OTH_SURG_98 AS OTH_SURG_98, TM_OTH_SURG_98_MSK AS OTH_SURG_98_MSK, TM_OTH_SURG_03 AS OTH_SURG_03, TM_OTH_SURG_03_MSK AS OTH_SURG_03_MSK, TM_OTH_SURG_CD AS OTH_SURG_CD, TM_RGN_SCOP_98 AS RGN_SCOP_98, TM_RGN_SCOP_98_MSK AS RGN_SCOP_98_MSK, TM_RGN_SCOP_03 AS RGN_SCOP_03, TM_RGN_SCOP_03_MSK AS RGN_SCOP_03_MSK, TM_REGNODE_SCOP_CD AS REGNODE_SCOP_CD, TM_RECON_SURG AS RECON_SURG, TM_CA_SURG_DTE AS CA_SURG_DATE, TM_SURG_DEF_DTE AS SURG_DEF_DATE, DOC_NAME AS SURGEON, TM_RAD_STRT_DTE AS RAD_STRT_DATE, TM_RAD_END_DTE AS RAD_END_DATE, TM_RAD_TX_MOD AS RAD_TX_MOD, TM_BOOST_RAD_MOD AS BOOST_RAD_MOD, TM_NUM_TX_THIS_VOL AS NUM_TX_THIS_VOL, TM_REG_RAD_DOSE AS REG_RAD_DOSE, TM_BOOST_RAD_DOSE AS BOOST_RAD_DOSE, TM_RAD_SURG_SEQ AS RAD_SURG_SEQ, TM_SYST_STRT_DTE AS SYST_STRT_DATE, TM_OTH_STRT_DTE AS OTH_STRT_DTE, CASE WHEN TM_CHEM_SUM = '00' THEN 'None. Contraindicated' WHEN TM_CHEM_SUM = '85' THEN 'Chemo not administered. Patient died' WHEN TM_CHEM_SUM = '86' THEN 'Chemo not administered but recommended. No reason' WHEN TM_CHEM_SUM = '87' THEN 'Chemo not administered. Recommended. Refused' WHEN TM_CHEM_SUM = '88' THEN 'Chemo recommended. Unknown if administered' WHEN TM_CHEM_SUM = '99' THEN 'Unknown or DCO' ELSE TM_CHEM_SUM END AS CHEM_SUM, CASE WHEN TM_CHEM_SUM_MSK = '00' THEN 'None. Not part of planned 1st course of tx' WHEN TM_CHEM_SUM_MSK = '01' THEN 'Chemo admin. Type & # of agents not documented' WHEN TM_CHEM_SUM_MSK = '02' THEN 'Single agent' WHEN TM_CHEM_SUM_MSK = '03' THEN 'Multi agent' WHEN TM_CHEM_SUM_MSK = '82' THEN 'Chemo not recommend/administered. Contraindicated' WHEN TM_CHEM_SUM_MSK = '85' THEN 'Chemo not administered. Patient died' WHEN TM_CHEM_SUM_MSK = '86' THEN 'Chemo not administered but recommended. IDB.PATIENT JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY ON PT_MRN = PLA_MRN JOIN IDB.CDB_TUMOR ON PT_MRN = TM_MRN JOIN IDB.CLM HIST ON HIST.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM SITE ON SITE.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS RACE ON RACE.AV_ELEMENT = 'RACE' AND RACE.AV_CODE = PT_RACE LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS COC ON COC.AV_ELEMENT = 'CLASS_OF_CASE' AND COC.AV_CODE = TM_CLASS_OF_CASE LEFT JOIN IDB.DOC ON TM_PRIM_SURGEON = DOC_DR_NO WHERE TM_CASE_STS = '3' AND TM_SITE_CD IN ('C090', 'C091', 'C098', 'C099', 'C019', 'C100', 'C101', 'C102', 'C103', 'C051', 'C108', 'C109') AND TM_DX_DTE BETWEEN '1985-01-01' AND '2005-12-31' SELECT PBD_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, PBC_CPT_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK, DOC_NAME, MIN(PBD_SVC_DTE) AS MIN_SVC_DATE FROM IDB.PBD_DTL JOIN IDB.PBD_INVOICE ON PBD_INV_NO = PBI_INV_NO JOIN IDB.PBD_CODE ON PBD_PBD_CD = PBC_PBD_CD JOIN IDB.DOC ON PBI_PERFORM_DR_NO = DOC_DR_NO JOIN IDB.CLM ON PBC_CPT_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PBD_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE PBD_MRN IN (SELECT TM_MRN FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR WHERE TM_CASE_STS = '3' AND TM_SITE_CD IN ('C090', 'C091', 'C098', 'C099', 'C019', 'C100', 'C101', 'C102', 'C103', 'C051', 'C108', 'C109') AND TM_DX_DTE BETWEEN '1985-01-01' AND '2005-12-31') GROUP BY PBD_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, PBC_CPT_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK, DOC_NAME SELECT DISTINCT "t1"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AS "Deident PT #", "t2"."PT_MRN" AS "MRN", "t2"."PT_LAST_NAME" AS "Last Name", "t2"."PT_FIRST_NAME" AS "First Name", "t3"."PRPT_ACCESSION_NO" AS "Pathology Report", "t4"."DT_DTE" AS "Pathology Report Date" FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED" "t1" INNER JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS" "t2" ON "t1"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t2"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V" "t3" ON "t1"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t3"."PRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE" "t4" ON "t3"."PRPT_REPORT_DATE_ID" = "t4"."DT_DATE_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_ICDO_DIAGNOSIS_V" "t5" ON "t1"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t5"."PDX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE" "t6" ON "t5"."PDX_DX_DATE_ID" = "t6"."DT_DATE_ID" WHERE ("t5"."ICSC_SITE_CD" IN ('C090', 'C091', 'C098', prompt: Updates needed to MED3201 - A weekly report of patients with hospital-acquired pneumonia
completion: WITH HAP AS (SELECT PT_MRN AS MRN, RTRIM(PT_LAST_NAME)||', '||RTRIM(PT_FIRST_NAME) AS PT_NAME , DOC_NAME AS ATN_DR_NAME, VIS_ADM_DTE AS ADM_DATE, VIS_DSCH_DTE AS DSCH_DATE , INTEGER(VIS_DAYS_STAY) AS LOS, RTRIM(DTH.AV_DESC) AS DEATH_IND , PT_DATE_OF_DEATH AS DEATH_DATE, VIS_NURS_STA AS NURS_STA , CC_EFF_DTE AS ICD10_EFF_DATE, VST.VIS_ADM_NUM IP_ADM_NUM , RTRIM(CC_CLSF_CD)||' - '||RTRIM(CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK) AS ICD10_CD_DESC , CURRENT DATE - 21 DAY AS RPT_START_DATE, CURRENT DATE - 15 DAY AS RPT_END_DATE FROM IDB.PATIENT JOIN IDB.VISIT VST ON VIS_MRN = PT_MRN AND VST.VIS_IP_OP_ADJUSTED_IND = 'I' AND VST.VIS_VISIT_STATUS NOT IN ('1', '4') AND VIS_DSCH_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT DATE - 21 DAY AND CURRENT DATE - 15 DAY JOIN IDB.CTC_CLSF ON CC_MRN = VIS_MRN AND CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' AND CC_EFF_DTE BETWEEN VIS_ADM_DTE AND VIS_DSCH_DTE AND CC_CLSF_TYPE IN ('DF2', 'DF3', 'DF4', 'DFN', 'DFY') JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD AND CC_CLSF_CD IN ('482.84', '486', 'J18.9', 'J18.8', 'A48.1') JOIN IDB.DOC DOC ON VIS_ATN_DR_NO = DOC_DR_NO LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS DTH ON DTH.AV_ELEMENT = 'DEATH_IND' AND DTH.AV_CODE = PT_DEATH_IND) , CX AS (SELECT TST.LR_MRN, IP_ADM_NUM LR_ADM_NUM , MAX(CASE WHEN LCI_ANCIL_NAME LIKE 'LEGU%' THEN 'Y' END) LEG_ANTIGEN , MAX(CASE WHEN LCI_ANCIL_NAME LIKE 'LEGU%' AND UPPER(CR.LTL_TEXT_RESULT) LIKE 'POSITIVE%' THEN 'Y' END) LEG_ANTIGEN_POSITIVE , MAX(CASE WHEN UPPER(TST.LR_TEST_NAME) LIKE '%CULT%URINE%' THEN 'Y' END) URINE_CX , MAX(CASE WHEN UPPER(TST.LR_TEST_NAME) LIKE '%CULT%URINE%' AND UPPER(CR.LTL_TEXT_RESULT) LIKE '%LEGION%' THEN 'Y' END) URINE_CX_LEG_POSITIVE , MAX(CASE WHEN UPPER(TST.LR_TEST_NAME) LIKE '%CULT%RESP%' THEN 'Y' END) RESP_CX , MAX(CASE WHEN UPPER(TST.LR_TEST_NAME) LIKE '%CULT%RESP%' AND UPPER(CR.LTL_TEXT_RESULT) LIKE '%LEGION%' THEN 'Y' END) RESP_CX_LEG_POSITIVE , MAX(CASE WHEN UPPER(TST.LR_TEST_NAME) LIKE '%CULT%TISSUE%' THEN 'Y' END) TISSUE_CX , MAX(CASE WHEN UPPER(TST.LR_TEST_NAME) LIKE '%CULT%TISSUE%' AND UPPER(CR.LTL_TEXT_RESULT) LIKE '%LEGION%' THEN 'Y' END) TISSUE_CX_LEG_POSITIVE , MAX(CASE WHEN UPPER(TST.LR_TEST_NAME) LIKE '%CULT%FLUID%' THEN 'Y' END) FLUID_CX , MAX(CASE WHEN UPPER(TST.LR_TEST_NAME) LIKE '%CULT%FLUID%' AND UPPER(CR.LTL_TEXT_RESULT) LIKE '%LEGION%' THEN 'Y' END) FLUID_CX_LEG_POSITIVE FROM HAP JOIN IDB.LAB_RESULTS TST ON MRN = TST.LR_MRN AND TST.LR_PERFORMED_DTE BETWEEN ADM_DATE AND DSCH_DATE AND TST.LR_CTLG_ITEM_GUID IN ('9000005114101010', '3000001230101001') JOIN IDB.LAB_CATALOG_ITEM ON TST.LR_ORD_MSTR_ITEM_GUID = LCI_ORD_MSTR_GUID LEFT JOIN IDB.LAB_TEXT_LINE CR ON TST.LR_RESULT_GUID = CR .LTL_RESULT_GUID AND CR.LTL_LINE_NO = 1 WHERE(UPPER(TST.LR_TEST_NAME) LIKE '%CULT%URINE%' OR UPPER(TST.LR_TEST_NAME) LIKE '%CULT%RESP%' OR UPPER(TST.LR_TEST_NAME) LIKE '%CULT%TISSUE%' OR UPPER(TST.LR_TEST_NAME) LIKE '%CULT%FLUID%' OR UPPER(TST.LR_TEST_NAME) LIKE '%LEGION%') GROUP BY LR_MRN, IP_ADM_NUM) SELECT MRN, PT_NAME, ATN_DR_NAME, ADM_DATE, DSCH_DATE, LOS , DEATH_IND, DEATH_DATE, NURS_STA, ICD10_EFF_DATE , ICD10_CD_DESC, RPT_START_DATE, RPT_END_DATE , COALESCE(LEG_ANTIGEN, '') LEG_ANTIGEN , COALESCE(LEG_ANTIGEN_POSITIVE, '') LEG_ANTIGEN_POSITIVE , COALESCE(URINE_CX, '') URINE_CX , COALESCE(URINE_CX_LEG_POSITIVE, '') URINE_CX_LEG_POSITIVE , COALESCE(RESP_CX, '') RESP_CX , COALESCE(RESP_CX_LEG_POSITIVE, '') RESP_CX_LEG_POSITIVE , COALESCE(TISSUE_CX, '') TISSUE_CX , COALESCE(TISSUE_CX_LEG_POSITIVE, '') TISSUE_CX_LEG_POSITIVE , COALESCE(FLUID_CX, '') FLUID_CX , COALESCE(FLUID_CX_LEG_POSITIVE, '') FLUID_CX_LEG_POSITIVE FROM HAP LEFT JOIN CX ON MRN = LR_MRN AND IP_ADM_NUM = LR_ADM_NUM

prompt: Chemo drug dose dispensed from July 1, 2008 to December 31, 2008 at 4 Regional Site: Sleepy Hollow, Commack, Rockville Cntr, Baskig Ridge.
completion: SELECT LOCATION, PRESCRIBER, DRUG_NAME, SUM(DOSE*DISPENSES) TOTAL_DOSE, DOSE_UNIT, SUM(DISPENSES) TOTAL_DISPENSES, COUNT(*) TOTAL_ORDERS, COUNT(DISTINCT PO_MRN) TOTAL_PATIENTS FROM (SELECT PO_MRN, PO_RX_NO AS RX_NO, POD_ITEM_DESC AS DRUG_NAME, POD_STRT_DTE AS START_DATE, POI_DOSE AS DOSE, POI_DOSE_UNIT AS DOSE_UNIT, PO_DR_NAME AS PRESCRIBER, CASE WHEN POI_NET_PT_DOSE = 0 THEN 1 ELSE POI_NET_PT_DOSE END AS DISPENSES, CASE WHEN PO_DISP_LOC_NAME = 'Mercy' THEN 'Rockville Centre' WHEN PO_DISP_LOC_NAME = 'Phelps' THEN 'Sleepy Hollow' ELSE PO_DISP_LOC_NAME END AS LOCATION FROM IDB.PHM_ORDER JOIN IDB.PHM_ORD_DTL ON PO_ORD_SEQ = POD_ORD_SEQ JOIN IDB.PHM_ORD_INV ON POD_ITEM_NO = POI_ITEM_NO AND POD_ORD_SEQ = POI_ORD_SEQ JOIN IDB.PHM_INVENTORY ON POI_INV_SEQ = PIN_INV_SEQ WHERE POD_STRT_DTE BETWEEN '2008-07-01' AND '2008-12-31' AND POD_ITEM_STS NOT IN('X', 'P') AND PO_DISP_LOC_NAME IN ('Basking Ridge', 'Phelps', 'Commack', 'Mercy') AND POD_ATT_FLAG LIKE '%CHEMO%' AND (POI_AHFS LIKE '10:%' OR POI_AHFS IN ('08:18.24.00.00', '88:04.01.00.20', '92:01.01.03.09')) ) RX GROUP BY LOCATION, PRESCRIBER, DRUG_NAME, DOSE_UNIT
