prompt: Provide a one time list of Pediatric Service patients who have had a ClinDoc “ Nursing Extravasation Assessment” form entered since January 2021
completion: WITH CLIND AS (SELECT DISTINCT CDD_MRN , TRIM(PT_LAST_NAME) || ', ' || TRIM(PT_FIRST_NAME) AS PATIENT_NAME, CDD_SERVICE_DTE, CDD_DOC_NAME, OP_DISPLAY_NAME AS PROVIDER FROM IDB.CD_DOCUMENT LEFT JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION ON CDD_DOC_GUID = CDO_DOC_GUID AND CDD_AUTHORED_DTE = CDO_AUTHORED_DTE AND CDO_VALUE_TEXT <> '' JOIN IDB.OMS_PROVIDER ON CDD_AUTH_PROV_GUID = OP_PVDR_GUID JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PT_MRN = CDD_MRN WHERE CDD_CANCEL_IND <> '1' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND <> '1' AND CDD_DOC_NAME = 'Nursing Extravasation Assessment' AND CDD_SERVICE_DTE >= '2021-01-01' ), APPT AS (SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN CLIND ON CDD_MRN = CPE_MRN WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CRE_RES_TYP IN ('Physician', 'PhD', 'Psychologist', 'Dentist', 'Nurse Practitioner', 'Physician Assistant', 'Advanced Practice Nurse' ) AND (CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 = 'PED' OR CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_4 = 'PED') ) SELECT CDD_MRN AS MRN, PATIENT_NAME, CDD_DOC_NAME AS CLINDOC_NAME, CDD_SERVICE_DTE AS SERVICE_DATE, PROVIDER, CASE WHEN CPE_MRN IS NOT NULL THEN 'Y' END AS PED_FLAG FROM CLIND C LEFT JOIN APPT ON CPE_MRN = CDD_MRN ;

prompt: Provide a monthly report of the number of orders placed on the sameday that a patient had an "arrived" or "completed" MD visit at 205 E64th St.
completion: SELECT DISTINCT MRN, VST_DTE, MD_NAME, MD_ID , DEPT, LOCATION , OO_ORD_NAME, OO_ORD_ID , OU_DISPLAY_NAME ENT_BY_NAME , OU_ORD_ROLE_TYPE ENT_BY_ROLE_TYPE , OO_ENTER_ROLE ENTER_BY_ROLE, OO_ORD_SOURCE FROM (SELECT CPE_MRN MRN, CPE_ENC_DTE VST_DTE , CRE_RES_NAME AS MD_NAME, CRE_RES_ID AS MD_ID , CLD_DEPT_NAME DEPT, CLD_CLD_PHY_LOC LOCATION FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID AND CPE_VST_RES_TTL = 'MD' WHERE CLD_CLD_CENTER = '205 E64' AND CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CPE_ENC_DTE >= CURRENT DATE - 1 MONTH - DAY(CURRENT DATE - 1 MONTHS)DAYS + 1 DAYS AND CPE_ENC_DTE <= LAST_DAY(CURRENT DATE - 1 MONTHS) AND CPE_CPE_IP_IND <> 'INPATIENT' ) AS VST JOIN IDB.OMS_ORDER ON MRN = OO_MRN AND VST_DTE = OO_ENTER_DTE AND OO_ORD_STS_CD NOT LIKE 'CAN%' JOIN IDB.OMS_USER ON OO_USER_GUID = OU_USER_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_PROVIDER ON MD_ID = OP_PVDR_NO AND OO_PVDR_GUID = OP_PVDR_GUID

prompt: When we added the boosters on 12/02/21 it generated charges only within 30 days which means it picked up 11/02/21 and forward. I need a report that covers from 09/22/21-11/01/21 of these same boosters that need to be posted.
completion: WITH EMAR AS (SELECT OOTO_ORD_GUID ORD_GUID, OOTO_SIGNIFIC_DTE DOS , OOTO_TASK_DOSE DOSE, OOTO_TASK_UOM UOM, OCIT_MST_ITEM_GUID FROM IDB.OAS_ORD_TASK_OCCR JOIN IDB.OAS_CTLG_ITEM_TASK ON OOTO_CAT_ITEM_GUID = OCIT_GUID AND OCIT_LEVEL_NO = 0 JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT ITEM_GUID FROM IDCIC.VP_ECC_VACCINE_CODE) VAC ON OCIT_MST_ITEM_GUID = ITEM_GUID WHERE OOTO_SIGNIFIC_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT DATE - 90 DAY AND CURRENT date AND OOTO_STATUS_CD = 'Performed' ) , ORD AS (SELECT DISTINCT OO_MRN AS MRN, DOS, TRIM(OO_ORD_NAME) OO_ORD_NAME , 'COV' SVC, TRIM(LGR_AMB_LOCATION) SITE, VAX_DOSE , HCPCS FROM EMAR JOIN IDB.OMS_ORDER Z ON Z.OO_ORD_GUID = ORD_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_CLIENT_VISIT ON OO_VISIT_GUID = OCV_VISIT_GUID LEFT JOIN IDB.LOCATION_GROUPS_REFERENCE ON OCV_CURR_LOC_GUID = LGR_LOC_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_USER_DATA ON OUD_ORD_GUID = OO_ORD_GUID JOIN IDCIC.VP_ECC_VACCINE_CODE T0 ON OCIT_MST_ITEM_GUID = T0.ITEM_GUID AND CASE WHEN OCIT_MST_ITEM_GUID = '9000015417100730' AND 'COVID_VAX_DOSE#' NOT IN (SELECT OUD_USER_DI_CD FROM IDB.OMS_ORD_USER_DATA X WHERE OUD_ORD_GUID = Z.OO_ORD_GUID ) THEN '' ELSE OUD_USER_DI_VALUE END = VAX_DOSE UNION SELECT DISTINCT OO_MRN AS MRN, DOS, TRIM(OO_ORD_NAME) OO_ORD_NAME , 'COV' SVC, TRIM(LGR_AMB_LOCATION) SITE, T1.VAX_DOSE , '0031A' AS HCPCS FROM EMAR JOIN IDB.OMS_ORDER Z ON OO_ORD_GUID = ORD_GUID JOIN IDCIC.HIMECC_AGED_D_PY ON AGED_MRN = OO_MRN AND AGED_DOS = DOS JOIN IDB.OMS_CLIENT_VISIT ON OO_VISIT_GUID = OCV_VISIT_GUID JOIN IDB.LOCATION_GROUPS_REFERENCE ON OCV_CURR_LOC_GUID = LGR_LOC_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_USER_DATA X1 ON X1.OUD_ORD_GUID = OO_ORD_GUID JOIN IDCIC.VP_ECC_VACCINE_CODE T1 ON T1.ITEM_GUID = OCIT_MST_ITEM_GUID AND CASE WHEN OCIT_MST_ITEM_GUID = '9000015417100730' AND 'COVID_VAX_DOSE#' NOT IN (SELECT OUD_USER_DI_CD FROM IDB.OMS_ORD_USER_DATA X WHERE OUD_ORD_GUID = Z.OO_ORD_GUID ) THEN '' ELSE OUD_USER_DI_VALUE END = VAX_DOSE) , DTL AS (SELECT DISTINCT TRIM(RCDD_CHARGE_CD) RCDD_CHARGE_CD, TRIM(RMHD_MEDICARE_HCPCS_CODE) RMHD_MEDICARE_HCPCS_CODE, COALESCE(RCDD_SYSTEM_EFFECTIVE_DTE, DATE('2017-01-01')) EFFECTIVE_DTE, COALESCE(RCDD_SYSTEM_EXPIRATION_DTE, CURRENT date) EXPIRATION_DTE FROM IDB.RMS_MEDICARE_HCPCS_DICT_DN1280 LEFT JOIN IDB.RMS_CHARGE_CODE_DICT_DN1240 ON RMHD_RECORD_NUMBER = RCDD_CPT4_HCPCS_CD_REC_NO WHERE RMHD_MEDICARE_HCPCS_CODE IN ( (SELECT DISTINCT HCPCS FROM IDCIC.VP_ECC_VACCINE_CODE)) ) , CHRG AS (SELECT X.RVCD_MRN, X.RVCD_SVC_DTE, Y.RVCD_POST_DTE POST_DATE, X.CHARGE_CD, Y.CHARGE_DESCRIPTION, Y.REV_CODE, Y.REV_CODE_DESC , Y.HCPCS_CODE RMS_HCPCS, Y.HCPCS_DESC RMS_HCPCS_DESC, Y.RVCD_AMT, RVCD_UNITS FROM IDB.RMS_VISIT_CHARGE_DTL_V Y JOIN (SELECT RVCD_MRN, RVCD_SVC_DTE, CHARGE_CD , SUM(COALESCE(RVCD_AMT, 0)) FROM ORD JOIN IDB.RMS_VISIT_CHARGE_DTL_V ON RVCD_MRN = MRN AND RVCD_SVC_DTE = DOS AND CHARGE_CD LIKE 'MOA%' AND REV_CODE = '771' JOIN DTL ON RCDD_CHARGE_CD = CHARGE_CD GROUP BY RVCD_MRN, RVCD_SVC_DTE, CHARGE_CD HAVING SUM(COALESCE(RVCD_AMT, 0)) > 0) AS X ON X.RVCD_MRN = Y.RVCD_MRN AND X.RVCD_SVC_DTE = Y.RVCD_SVC_DTE AND X.CHARGE_CD = Y.CHARGE_CD WHERE Y.CHARGE_CD LIKE 'MOA%' AND Y.REV_CODE = '771' ) SELECT DISTINCT MRN, DOS, OO_ORD_NAME, SVC, SITE, VAX_DOSE, HCPCS , RVCD_SVC_DTE, POST_DATE, CHARGE_CD, CHARGE_DESCRIPTION, REV_CODE, REV_CODE_DESC , RMS_HCPCS, RMS_HCPCS_DESC, RVCD_AMT, RVCD_UNITS FROM ORD LEFT JOIN CHRG ON RVCD_MRN = MRN AND RVCD_SVC_DTE = DOS ;

prompt: Requiring an updated data pull surrounding employee COVID-19 booster vaccine data.
completion: WITH Q AS (SELECT EVI_EMPLOYEE_ID, CVP_NAME, VACCINE_STATUS, CEVE_CATEGORY, CVP_STATUS, CVP_SHORT_TERM_DIS_FLAG ON_LEAVE, CASE WHEN DOSE_ADDL_APPT_STATUS = 'PRE' THEN DATE(DOSE_ADDL_APPT_DT) ELSE NULL END AS ADDL_DOSE_APPT_DTE, FIRST_BOOSTER_ELIGIBLE_DTE, SUPV_NAME, MEDICAL_EXEMPT, REMOTE_EXEMPT, FIRST_BOOSTER_COMPLIANT, FIRST_BOOSTER_DUE_DATE FROM IDB.COVID19_EMPLOYEE_VACCINE_INFO LEFT JOIN IDB.COVID19_EMPLOYEE_VACCINE_EXEMPT_V ON EVI_EMPLOYEE_ID = EXEMPT_EMPLOYEE_ID JOIN IDB.COVID19_VACCINE_PERSON ON EVI_EMPLOYEE_ID = CVP_EMPLOYEE_ID LEFT JOIN (SELECT CVP_EMPLOYEE_ID SUPV_ID, CVP_NAME SUPV_NAME FROM IDB.COVID19_VACCINE_PERSON) ON CVP_SUPERVISOR_ID = SUPV_ID) SELECT EVI_EMPLOYEE_ID, CVP_NAME, VACCINE_STATUS, ADDL_DOSE_APPT_DTE, FIRST_BOOSTER_ELIGIBLE_DTE, FIRST_BOOSTER_DUE_DATE, SUPV_NAME, CASE WHEN ADDL_DOSE_APPT_DTE IS NOT NULL THEN 'Y' ELSE '' END AS SCHEDULED, FIRST_BOOSTER_COMPLIANT FROM Q WHERE CVP_STATUS = 'Active' AND CEVE_CATEGORY = 'Employees' AND COALESCE(ON_LEAVE, '') <> 'Y' AND COALESCE(MEDICAL_EXEMPT, '') <> 'Y' AND COALESCE(REMOTE_EXEMPT, '') <> 'Y'

prompt: Provide a weekly list of patients scheduled to be seen in the Neuroblastoma clinic
completion: WITH PTS AS (SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN AS "MRN" FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PT_MRN=CPE_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY ON PLA_MRN=PT_MRN WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Sch') AND CRE_RES_TYP IN ('Physician', 'PhD', 'Dentist', 'Psychologist') AND CLD_DEPT_NAME = 'PEDS NEUROBLAST 1275' AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT date + 7 DAYS AND CURRENT date + 14 DAYS ), LAST_MIBG AS (SELECT CPE_MRN LST_MRN, MAX(CPE_ENC_DTE) LST_ENC_DTE FROM PTS JOIN IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER ON MRN=CPE_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME IN ('NM MIBG SCAN 24HRS I123', 'NM MIBG 123 Injection') AND CPE_ENC_DTE < CURRENT date GROUP BY CPE_MRN) SELECT "MRN", PT_LAST_NAME "Last Name", PT_FIRST_NAME "First Name", PT_SEX "Sex", PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH "Date of Birth", YEAR(CURRENT date - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) AGE, VARCHAR_FORMAT(CPE_APPT_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS "Appt Date", CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME AS "Visit Type", CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 AS "Department", CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 AS "Service", CLD_DEPT_NAME AS "Department Name", CRE_RES_NAME AS "Provider Name", CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME AS "Visit Type", VARCHAR_FORMAT(PLA_LST_APPT_DTE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') "Last Appointment Date", VARCHAR_FORMAT(PLA_LST_SURG_DTE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') "Last Surgery Date", VARCHAR_FORMAT(PLA_LST_PED_APPT_DTE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') "Last PED Appointment Date", VARCHAR_FORMAT(LST_ENC_DTE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') "Last MIBG Scan Date", TRIM(A.CPAN_NOTE) "Note Line 1", TRIM(B.CPAN_NOTE) "Note Line 2", TRIM(C.CPAN_NOTE) "Note Line 3" FROM PTS JOIN IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER ON MRN=CPE_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PT_MRN=CPE_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY ON PLA_MRN=PT_MRN LEFT JOIN LAST_MIBG ON LST_MRN=MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_PT_APPT_NOTES A ON CPE_CL_PT_ID = A.CPAN_CL_PT_ID AND CPE_ENC_DTE_SEQ = A.CPAN_ENC_DTE_SEQ AND A.CPAN_LINE_NO = 1 LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_PT_APPT_NOTES B ON CPE_CL_PT_ID = B.CPAN_CL_PT_ID AND CPE_ENC_DTE_SEQ = B.CPAN_ENC_DTE_SEQ AND B.CPAN_LINE_NO = 2 LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_PT_APPT_NOTES C ON CPE_CL_PT_ID = C.CPAN_CL_PT_ID AND CPE_ENC_DTE_SEQ = C.CPAN_ENC_DTE_SEQ AND C.CPAN_LINE_NO = 3 WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Sch') AND CRE_RES_TYP IN ('Physician', 'PhD', 'Dentist', 'Psychologist') AND (CLD_DEPT_NAME = 'PEDS NEUROBLAST 1275' OR CRE_RES_NAME IN ('BASU, ELLEN', 'KRAMER, KIM', 'KUSHNER, BRIAN', 'MODAK, SHAKEEL', 'ROBERTS, STEPHEN S')) AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT date + 7 DAYS AND CURRENT date + 14 DAYS ORDER BY CPE_APPT_DT, PT_LAST_NAME

prompt: Provide information from Orthotic Prescription entered in CIS from Jan 1, 2022 to June 30, 2023
completion: SELECT DISTINCT OO_ORD_GUID, OO_MRN, TRIM(PT_LAST_NAME) || ',' || TRIM(PT_FIRST_NAME) PT_NAME, OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE, OOC_ITEM_NAME, CASE WHEN OFF_FLD_LABEL = 'Orthotic Rx Suggestions:' THEN 'ORTHOTIC_RX' WHEN OFF_FLD_LABEL = 'Orthotic Rx:' THEN 'ORTHOTIC_RX' WHEN OFF_FLD_LABEL = 'Requested For:' THEN 'REQUESTED_FOR' WHEN OFF_FLD_LABEL = 'Orthotic Vendor:' THEN 'ORTHOTIC_VENDOR' WHEN OFF_FLD_LABEL = 'Specifications:' THEN 'SPECIFICATIONS' WHEN OFF_FLD_LABEL = 'Precautions/Special Considerations:' THEN 'PRECAUTIONS_CONSIDERATIONS' WHEN OFF_FLD_LABEL = 'Extremity:' THEN 'EXTREMITY' ELSE OFF_FLD_LABEL END FIELD_LABEL, OUD_USER_DI_VALUE FROM IDB.OMS_ORDER JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_CATALOG ON OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID = OOC_MSTR_ITEM_GUID JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON OO_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_USER_DATA ON OO_MRN = OUD_MRN AND OO_ORD_GUID = OUD_ORD_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_FORM_FIELD ON OUD_USER_DI_CD = OFF_DI_CD AND OO_ENTRY_FRM_GUID = OFF_ENTRY_FRM_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_STATUS ON OO_ORD_STS_CD = OSTS_ORD_STS_CD WHERE OO_ORD_NAME = 'Orthotic Prescription' AND OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE BETWEEN '2019-01-01' AND '2023-10-15' AND OO_ORD_STS_CD NOT IN ('CANP', 'CANC', 'AUC3') AND OFF_FLD_LABEL IN('Requested For:', 'Orthotic Rx Suggestions:', 'Orthotic Rx:', 'Orthotic Vendor:', 'Specifications:', 'Precautions/Special Considerations:', 'Extremity:') ORDER BY OO_ORD_GUID, OO_MRN, OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE

prompt: Updates to RLC Screening dashboard
completion: SELECT CDD_MRN AS "MRN", CDD_SERVICE_DTE AS "Service Date", CDD_DOC_NAME AS "Document Name", OP_DISPLAY_NAME AS "Provider", CDD_DOC_GUID AS "Document Guid", CDO_SECTION AS "Section", CDO_ITEM_NAME AS "Item", CDO_VALUE_TEXT AS "Value" FROM IDB.CD_DOCUMENT LEFT JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION ON CDD_DOC_GUID = CDO_DOC_GUID AND CDD_AUTHORED_DTE = CDO_AUTHORED_DTE AND CDO_VALUE_TEXT <> '' JOIN IDB.OMS_PROVIDER ON CDD_AUTH_PROV_GUID = OP_PVDR_GUID WHERE CDD_CANCEL_IND <> '1' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND <> '1' AND CDD_DOC_NAME = 'History & Intervention - Screening' AND CDD_MRN = '00041042' ; SELECT RVCD_MRN, RVCD_SVC_DTE, DEPARTMENT_NAME, CHARGE_CD, CHARGE_DESCRIPTION, RVCD_UNITS, V.HOSP_SVC_DESC, V.VIS_NURS_STA, V.NURS_STA_DESC FROM IDB.RMS_VISIT_CHARGE_DTL_V JOIN IDB.VISIT_V V ON RVCD_VISIT_ID = VIS_VISIT_ID WHERE RVCD_MRN = '00041042'

prompt: Patients with SMARCB1 mutation on IMPACT results with primary or metastatic breast cancer.
completion: SELECT PDWS_NAME, A.PT_MRN, A.PT_FIRST_NAME, A.PT_LAST_NAME, A.PT_BIRTH_DTE, C.PRPT_REPORT_DTE, PDRX_ACCESSION_NO, PDRX_DMP_PATIENT_ID, PDRX_DMP_SAMPLE_ID FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML INNER JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML_SETTINGS ON PDRX_PATH_DMP_RESULTS_XML_ID = PDRXS_PATH_DMP_RESULTS_XML_ID INNER JOIN DVDMC.PATHOLOGY_DMP_WEBSVC_SETTINGS ON PDRXS_SETTING_ID = PDWS_SETTING_ID INNER JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS A ON PDRX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = A.PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V C ON PDRX_ACCESSION_NO = C.PRPT_ACCESSION_NO , XMLTABLE('$c/root/*' PASSING PDRX_XML_VALUE AS "c" COLUMNS VARIANT_CLASS VARCHAR(100) PATH 'variant_class', SITE1_GENE VARCHAR(100) PATH 'site1_gene', SITE2_GENE VARCHAR(100) PATH 'site2_gene', GENE_ID VARCHAR(100) PATH 'gene_id', EXON_NUM VARCHAR(100) PATH 'exon_num', AA_CHANGE VARCHAR(100) PATH 'aa_change', CDNA_CHANGE VARCHAR(100) PATH 'cDNA_change', GENE_FOLD_CHANGE VARCHAR(100) PATH 'gene_fold_change', VARIANT_TYPE VARCHAR(100) PATH './local-name(.)', PROJECT VARCHAR(100) PATH '../meta-data/dmp_alys_task_name', SAMPLEID VARCHAR(100) PATH '../meta-data/dmp_sample_id', PATIENTID VARCHAR(100) PATH '../meta-data/dmp_patient_id', TUMOR_TYPE_CODE VARCHAR(100) PATH '../meta-data/tumor_type_code', TUMOR_TYPE_NAME VARCHAR(255) PATH '../meta-data/tumor_type_name', IS_METASTASIS VARCHAR(10) PATH '../meta-data/is_metastasis', PRIMARY_SITE VARCHAR(255) PATH '../meta-data/primary_site', METASTASIS_SITE VARCHAR(255) PATH '../meta-data/metastasis_site') T WHERE (UPPER(PRIMARY_SITE) like '%BREAST%' OR UPPER(METASTASIS_SITE) like '%BREAST%') AND (SITE1_GENE = 'SMARCB1' OR SITE2_GENE = 'SMARCB1' OR GENE_ID = 'SMARCB1')

prompt: Provide a list of female breast cancer patients that have an MSK appointment next week.
completion: WITH BREAST AS (SELECT TM_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, CPP_LANG, PT_ZIP_CD, YEAR(CURRENT date - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) "Current Age", MAX(CASE WHEN TM_BEST_AJCC_STG like '0%' THEN '0' WHEN TM_BEST_AJCC_STG like '1%' THEN '1' WHEN TM_BEST_AJCC_STG like '2%' THEN '2' WHEN TM_BEST_AJCC_STG like '3%' THEN '3' WHEN TM_BEST_AJCC_STG like '4%' THEN '4' WHEN TM_BEST_AJCC_STG IN ('', '88', '99') THEN 'No Stage' END) STAGE, LISTAGG(CHAR(TM_DX_DTE), '; ') TM_DX_DTE FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.SEERGROUPING ON IDB.SEERF_ICDO(TM_SITE_CD, TM_HIST_CD) = RECODE JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON TM_MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_PAS_PATIENT ON TM_MRN = CPP_MRN WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND CATEGORY2 = 'Breast' AND PT_SEX = 'F' GROUP BY TM_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, CPP_LANG, PT_ZIP_CD, YEAR(CURRENT date - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) ) , APPTS AS (SELECT CPE_MRN TM_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, CPP_LANG, PT_ZIP_CD, "Current Age", TM_DX_DTE, STAGE, CPE_ENC_DTE AS "Appt Date", TIME(CPE_APPT_DT) "Appt Time", CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 AS "Department", CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 AS "Service", CLD_CLD_CENTER "Location", CLD_DEPT_NAME AS "Department Name", CRE_RES_NAME AS "Provider Name", CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME AS "Visit Type" FROM BREAST JOIN IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER ON TM_MRN = CPE_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Sch') AND (CLD_CLD_CENTER = '300 E66' OR UPPER(CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME) LIKE '%TELEH%' OR UPPER(CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME) LIKE '%PHONE%' OR UPPER(CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME) LIKE '%VIDEO%') AND CRE_RES_TYP = 'Physician' AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 = 'MED' AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 = 'BRE' AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT date AND CURRENT date + 7 DAYS ) , LOCS AS (SELECT '300 E66' ML_LOC_GRP, '300 E66' ML_LOC_CD, '300 E66th St' ML_ADDR, 'New York' ML_CITY, 'NY' ML_STATE, '10065' ML_ZIP_CD, 40.671400 ML_LATITUDE, -73.986165 ML_LONGITUDE FROM SYSIBM.SYSDUMMY1) , DISTANCE AS (SELECT TM_MRN DIST_MRN, ML_LOC_CD DIST_LOC_CD, ROUND(DEGREES(ACOS(SIN(RADIANS(LAT1)) *SIN(RADIANS(ML_LATITUDE)) +COS(RADIANS(LAT1)) *COS(RADIANS(ML_LATITUDE)) *COS(RADIANS(LON1-ML_LONGITUDE))) * 69.09)) AS "Distance from E66" FROM (SELECT DISTINCT TM_MRN, ZC_LATITUDE LAT1, ZC_LONGITUDE AS LON1 FROM APPTS JOIN IDB.ZIPCODE ON ZC_ZIP=PT_ZIP_CD) A, LOCS) , ER_PR_HER AS (SELECT CDD_MRN, CDD_DOC_GUID, CDD_SERVICE_DTE, CDO_ITEM_NAME, CDO_VALUE_TEXT FROM APPTS JOIN IDB.CD_DOCUMENT ON TM_MRN = CDD_MRN JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION ON CDD_DOC_GUID = CDO_DOC_GUID AND CDD_AUTHORED_DTE = CDO_AUTHORED_DTE WHERE 1=1 AND CDD_CANCEL_IND <> '1' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND <> '1' AND CDD_DOC_NAME IN ('Follow Up Note - Breast Surgery', 'Follow Up, NP - Breast Surgery', 'Follow Up - Breast Surgery', 'Follow Up - Surgery-Breast', 'Follow Up, NP/PA - Breast Surgery') AND CDO_ITEM_NAME IN ('HER2:', 'ER:', 'PR:') ) , ER AS (SELECT CDD_MRN ER_MRN, CDD_SERVICE_DTE, CDO_VALUE_TEXT ER FROM (SELECT CDD_MRN, CDD_SERVICE_DTE, CDO_VALUE_TEXT, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CDD_MRN ORDER BY CDD_SERVICE_DTE DESC) RN FROM ER_PR_HER WHERE CDO_ITEM_NAME = 'ER:' ) WHERE RN = 1 ) , PR AS (SELECT CDD_MRN PR_MRN, CDD_SERVICE_DTE, CDO_VALUE_TEXT PR FROM (SELECT CDD_MRN, CDD_SERVICE_DTE, CDO_VALUE_TEXT, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CDD_MRN ORDER BY CDD_SERVICE_DTE DESC) RN FROM ER_PR_HER WHERE CDO_ITEM_NAME = 'PR:' ) WHERE RN = 1 ) , HER2 AS (SELECT CDD_MRN HER2_MRN, CDD_SERVICE_DTE, CDO_VALUE_TEXT HER2 FROM (SELECT CDD_MRN, CDD_SERVICE_DTE, CDO_VALUE_TEXT, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CDD_MRN ORDER BY CDD_SERVICE_DTE DESC) RN FROM ER_PR_HER WHERE CDO_ITEM_NAME = 'HER2:' ) WHERE RN = 1 ) , MENO AS (SELECT CDD_MRN MENO_MRN, CDD_DOC_GUID, CDD_SERVICE_DTE, CDD_DOC_NAME, CDO_VALUE_TEXT FROM (SELECT CDD_MRN, CDD_DOC_GUID, CDD_SERVICE_DTE, CDD_DOC_NAME, CDO_VALUE_TEXT, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CDD_MRN ORDER BY CDD_SERVICE_DT DESC) AS RN FROM APPTS JOIN IDB.CD_DOCUMENT ON CDD_MRN = TM_MRN JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION ON CDO_DOC_GUID = CDD_DOC_GUID AND CDO_AUTHORED_DTE = CDD_AUTHORED_DTE WHERE CDD_CANCEL_IND <> '1' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND <> '1' AND(UPPER(CDO_ITEM_NAME) LIKE '%MENOPAUS%' OR UPPER(CDO_VALUE_TEXT) LIKE '%MENOPAUS%') ) WHERE RN = 1 ) SELECT TM_MRN MRN, PT_LAST_NAME "Last Name", PT_FIRST_NAME "First Name", "Current Age", CPP_LANG "Language", "Appt Date", "Appt Time", "Provider Name", "Location", TM_DX_DTE "Tumor Dx Date", STAGE, "Distance from E66", ER, PR, HER2, CDO_VALUE_TEXT "Menopasaul ClinDoc Text" FROM APPTS LEFT JOIN DISTANCE ON TM_MRN = DIST_MRN LEFT JOIN ER ON TM_MRN = ER_MRN LEFT JOIN PR ON TM_MRN = PR_MRN LEFT JOIN HER2 ON TM_MRN = HER2_MRN LEFT JOIN MENO ON TM_MRN = MENO_MRN ! WITH APPTS AS (SELECT PT_MRN MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_ZIP_CD, YEAR(CURRENT date - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) "Current Age", CPP_LANG, CRE_RES_NAME "Provider Name", CLD_DEPT_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY PT_MRN ORDER BY CPE_ENC_DTE DESC) RN, TM_DX_DTE "Tumor Dx Date", TM_BEST_AJCC_STG STAGE FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON CPE_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_PAS_PATIENT ON CPE_MRN = CPP_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CDB_TUMOR ON CPE_MRN = TM_MRN JOIN IDB.SEERGROUPING ON IDB.SEERF_ICDO(TM_SITE_CD, TM_HIST_CD) = RECODE WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND (CRE_RES_TYP IN ('Physician') OR CLD_DEPT_NAME like '%APP%') AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT date - 1 YEAR AND CURRENT date AND YEAR(CPE_ENC_DTE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) BETWEEN 50 AND 72 AND TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7') AND YEAR(TM_DX_DTE) BETWEEN 2015 AND 2019 AND CATEGORY1 = 'Breast' AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 = 'MED' AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 = 'BRE' ) , LOCS AS (SELECT '300 E66' ML_LOC_GRP, '300 E66' ML_LOC_CD, '300 E66th St' ML_ADDR, 'New York' ML_CITY, 'NY' ML_STATE, '10065' ML_ZIP_CD, 40.671400 ML_LATITUDE, -73.986165 ML_LONGITUDE FROM SYSIBM.SYSDUMMY1) , DISTANCE AS (SELECT MRN DIST_MRN, ML_LOC_CD DIST_LOC_CD, ROUND(DEGREES(ACOS(SIN(RADIANS(LAT1)) *SIN(RADIANS(ML_LATITUDE)) +COS(RADIANS(LAT1)) *COS(RADIANS(ML_LATITUDE)) *COS(RADIANS(LON1-ML_LONGITUDE))) * 69.09)) AS "Distance from E66" FROM (SELECT DISTINCT MRN, ZC_LATITUDE LAT1, ZC_LONGITUDE AS LON1 FROM (SELECT DISTINCT MRN, PT_ZIP_CD FROM APPTS) A JOIN IDB.ZIPCODE ON ZC_ZIP=PT_ZIP_CD) A, LOCS) , MENO AS (SELECT CDD_MRN MENO_MRN, CDD_DOC_GUID, CDD_SERVICE_DTE, CDD_DOC_NAME, CDO_VALUE_TEXT FROM (SELECT CDD_MRN, CDD_DOC_GUID, CDD_SERVICE_DTE, CDD_DOC_NAME, CDO_VALUE_TEXT, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CDD_MRN ORDER BY CDD_SERVICE_DT DESC) AS RN FROM (SELECT DISTINCT MRN FROM APPTS) A JOIN IDB.CD_DOCUMENT ON CDD_MRN = MRN JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION ON CDO_DOC_GUID = CDD_DOC_GUID AND CDO_AUTHORED_DTE = CDD_AUTHORED_DTE WHERE CDD_CANCEL_IND <> '1' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND <> '1' AND(UPPER(CDO_ITEM_NAME) LIKE '%MENOPAUS%' OR UPPER(CDO_VALUE_TEXT) LIKE '%MENOPAUS%') ) WHERE RN = 1 ) SELECT MRN, PT_LAST_NAME "Last Name", PT_FIRST_NAME "First Name", "Current Age", CPP_LANG "Language", "Provider Name", "Tumor Dx Date", STAGE, "Distance from E66", CDO_VALUE_TEXT "Menopausal ClinDoc Text" FROM APPTS LEFT JOIN DISTANCE ON MRN = DIST_MRN LEFT JOIN MENO ON MRN = MENO_MRN WHERE RN = 1

TM_PATH_TNM_N AS "Pathologic N Stage", TM_PATH_TNM_M AS "Pathologic M Stage", TM_PATH_STG_GRP AS "Pathologic Group Stage", PRO_DATE AS "12-245 Consent Date", "12-245 IRB Title", PRO1_DATE AS "06-107 Consent Date", "06-107 IRB Title", SCHEDULED_SCAN_DATE AS "Scheduled Scan Date", SCHEDULED_SCAN_TYPE AS "Scheduled Scan Type", BEFORE_SCAN_DATE AS "Before Scan Date", BEFORE_SCAN_TYPE AS "Before Scan Type", OC_SURG_DTE AS "Upcoming Surgery Date", OCAS_SURG_SVC_CD AS "Surgery Service Code", OCAS_SURG_SVC AS "Surgery Service" FROM APPT LEFT JOIN TM ON APPT_MRN = TM_MRN LEFT JOIN PROTOCOL ON APPT_MRN = PRO_MRN LEFT JOIN PROTOCOL1 ON APPT_MRN = PRO1_MRN LEFT JOIN SCANS ON APPT_MRN = SCAN_MRN LEFT JOIN BEFORESCANS ON APPT_MRN = SCANB_MRN LEFT JOIN SURG ON APPT_MRN = OC_MRN ORDER BY APPT_MRN

prompt: Provide a list of patients diagnosed with thyroid cancer since 1/1/1985.
completion: SELECT CC_MRN AS MRN FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF INNER JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND ((CC_PT_TYPE = 'I') OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) AND CC_CLSF_CD IN ('193', 'V10.87') UNION SELECT TM_MRN AS MRN FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR INNER JOIN IDB.CLM H ON TM_HIST_CD = H.CLM_CLSF_CD INNER JOIN IDB.CLM S ON TM_SITE_CD = S.CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('3', '6', '7', '8') AND TM_SITE_CD = 'C739'

prompt: Provide a list of patients seen in Pediatrics in 2018, 2019, and 2020 in order to distribute information about MSK Kids updates as a result of COVID-19
completion: WITH PEDS AS (SELECT CPE_MRN PEDS_MRN FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN '2018-01-01' AND CURRENT date AND (CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 = ('PED') OR CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_4 = ('PED') OR CLD_DEPT_NAME = 'ORTHOPEDICS 1275-9') AND CPE_CPE_IP_IND <> 'INPATIENT' UNION SELECT VIS_MRN PEDS_MRN FROM IDB.VISIT WHERE VIS_HOSP_SVC IN ('PDB', 'PDG', 'PDP', 'PDR', 'PDU', 'PED', 'PDS') AND VIS_IP_OP_ADJUSTED_IND = 'I' AND VIS_VISIT_STATUS IN ('2', '3') AND VIS_ADM_DTE BETWEEN '2018-01-01' AND CURRENT date ) , PTS AS (SELECT PEDS_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, YEAR(CURRENT date - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) CURRENT_AGE, PT_ADDR1, PT_ADDR2, PT_CITY, PT_STATE, PT_ZIP_CD, CPP_EMAIL_ADDR FROM PEDS JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PEDS_MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_PAS_PATIENT ON PEDS_MRN = CPP_MRN JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY ON PEDS_MRN = PLA_MRN WHERE PT_DEATH_IND IN ('A', '') AND PLA_DONOT_MAIL_IND <> 'Y' ) , CDB AS (SELECT TM_MRN, LISTAGG(TM_DX_DTE || ': ' || TRIM(TM_SITE_CD) || '-' || TRIM(S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK) || ' ' || TRIM(TM_HIST_CD) || '-' || TRIM(H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK), CHR(13)||CHR(10)) TUMOR_DX FROM PTS JOIN IDB.CDB_TUMOR ON PEDS_MRN = TM_MRN JOIN IDB.CLM H ON TM_HIST_CD = H.CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON TM_SITE_CD = S.CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') GROUP BY TM_MRN ) , FIRST_LAST_OP_PEDS AS (SELECT CPE_MRN, CPE_ENC_DTE, CRE_RES_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CPE_MRN ORDER BY CPE_APPT_DT) RN_FIRST_OP, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CPE_MRN ORDER BY CPE_APPT_DT DESC) RN_LAST_OP FROM PTS JOIN IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER ON PEDS_MRN = CPE_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND (CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 = ('PED') OR CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_4 = ('PED') OR CLD_DEPT_NAME = 'ORTHOPEDICS 1275-9') AND CPE_CPE_IP_IND <> 'INPATIENT' AND CRE_RES_TYP = 'Physician' ) , LAST_APPT AS (SELECT CPE_MRN, CPE_ENC_DTE, CLD_CLD_CENTER, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CPE_MRN ORDER BY CPE_ENC_DTE DESC) RN FROM PTS JOIN IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER ON PEDS_MRN = CPE_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') ) SELECT PEDS_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, CURRENT_AGE, PT_ADDR1, PT_ADDR2, PT_CITY, PT_STATE, PT_ZIP_CD, CPP_EMAIL_ADDR, TUMOR_DX, FOP.CPE_ENC_DTE FIRST_PEDS_APPT, FOP.CRE_RES_NAME FIRST_PEDS_APPT_MD, LOP.CPE_ENC_DTE LAST_PEDS_APPT, LOP.CRE_RES_NAME LAST_PEDS_APPT_MD, L.CPE_ENC_DTE, L.CLD_CLD_CENTER FROM PTS LEFT JOIN CDB ON PEDS_MRN = TM_MRN JOIN FIRST_LAST_OP_PEDS FOP ON PEDS_MRN = FOP.CPE_MRN AND FOP.RN_FIRST_OP = 1 JOIN FIRST_LAST_OP_PEDS LOP ON PEDS_MRN = LOP.CPE_MRN AND LOP.RN_LAST_OP = 1 JOIN LAST_APPT L ON PEDS_MRN = L.CPE_MRN AND RN = 1

prompt: Provide an ongoing list of MSK patients per the criteria below.
completion: WITH PTS AS (SELECT CPE_MRN AS "MRN", PT_LAST_NAME LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME FIRST_NAME, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH DOB, PT_STATE STATE, CPP_EMAIL_ADDR EMAIL, CAV_NAME LANGUAGE, CPE_ENC_DTE, CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME, CPP_PP_LST_LGN_DTE FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON CPE_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY ON CPE_MRN = PLA_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_PAS_PATIENT ON CPE_MRN = CPP_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_CATEGORY ON CAV_CATEGORY = 'LANG' AND CPP_LANG = CAV_ABBR WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp', 'Sch') AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN '2017-01-01' AND YEAR(CURRENT date) || '-12-31' AND CPE_ENC_DTE >= CURRENT date - 3 YEARS AND PT_DEATH_IND IN ('', 'A') AND PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH >= '1920-01-01' AND PLA_DONOT_MAIL_IND <> 'Y' AND CPP_EMAIL_ADDR <> '' UNION SELECT VIS_MRN AS "MRN", PT_LAST_NAME LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME FIRST_NAME, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH DOB, PT_STATE STATE, CPP_EMAIL_ADDR EMAIL, CAV_NAME LANGUAGE, VIS_ADM_DTE CPE_ENC_DTE, 'INPATIENT' CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME, CPP_PP_LST_LGN_DTE FROM IDB.VISIT_V JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON VIS_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY ON VIS_MRN = PLA_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_PAS_PATIENT ON VIS_MRN = CPP_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_CATEGORY ON CAV_CATEGORY = 'LANG' AND CPP_LANG = CAV_ABBR WHERE VIS_IP_OP_ADJUSTED_IND = 'I' AND VIS_VISIT_STATUS IN ('2', '3') AND VIS_ADM_DTE BETWEEN '2017-01-01' AND YEAR(CURRENT date) || '-12-31' AND VIS_ADM_DTE >= CURRENT date - 21 DAYS AND PT_DEATH_IND IN ('', 'A') AND PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH >= '1920-01-01' AND PLA_DONOT_MAIL_IND <> 'Y' AND CPP_EMAIL_ADDR <> '' ) , EHS AS (SELECT MRN, CASE WHEN CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME like 'EHS%' THEN 'EHS' ELSE 'Other' END EHS_FLAG, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY MRN ORDER BY CASE WHEN CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME like 'EHS%' THEN 'EHS' ELSE 'Other' END DESC) RN FROM PTS) SELECT A.MRN, A.LAST_NAME, A.FIRST_NAME, A.DOB, A.EMAIL, A.STATE, A.LANGUAGE, MIN(CPE_ENC_DTE) MIN_APPT_DATE, MAX(CPE_ENC_DTE) MAX_APPT_DATE, MAX(CPP_PP_LST_LGN_DTE) PORTAL_LAST_LOGIN_DATE FROM PTS A LEFT JOIN EHS E ON A.MRN = E.MRN AND EHS_FLAG = 'EHS' AND RN = 1 WHERE E.MRN IS NULL GROUP BY A.MRN, A.LAST_NAME, A.FIRST_NAME, A.DOB, A.EMAIL, A.STATE, A.LANGUAGE

prompt: Provide a list of patients seen by Survivorship APPs over past 2 years and who they were referred by to the Survivorship program
completion: WITH MAIN AS (SELECT CPE_MRN AS "MRN", CPE_ENC_DTE AS "Appt Date", CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME AS "Visit Type", D.CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 AS "Department", D.CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 AS "Service", D.CLD_DEPT_NAME AS "Department Name", R.CRE_RES_NAME AS "Provider Name", REF.CRE_RES_NAME AS "Ref Provider Name", REF.CRE_RES_TYP "Ref Provider Type", D1.CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 AS "Ref Department", D1.CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 AS "Ref Service", D1.CLD_DEPT_NAME AS "Ref Department Name", TRIM(CDO_VALUE_TEXT) "Ref Provider Clindoc" FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE R ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = R.CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE REF ON CPE_REF_RES_ID = REF.CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT D ON CPE_DEPT_ID = D.CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT D1 ON CPE_REF_DEP_ID = D1.CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID LEFT JOIN (SELECT CDD_MRN, CDD_SERVICE_DTE, OP_PVDR_NO, CDO_SECTION, CDO_VALUE_TEXT, CDD_DOC_NAME FROM IDB.CD_DOCUMENT LEFT JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION ON CDD_DOC_GUID = CDO_DOC_GUID AND CDD_AUTHORED_DTE = CDO_AUTHORED_DTE AND CDO_VALUE_TEXT <> '' JOIN IDB.OMS_PROVIDER ON CDD_AUTH_PROV_GUID = OP_PVDR_GUID WHERE CDO_SECTION = 'REFERRING MD' ) A ON CPE_MRN = CDD_MRN AND CPE_ENC_DTE = CDD_SERVICE_DTE AND OP_PVDR_NO = R.CRE_RES_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CPE_ENC_DTE >= '2020-01-01' AND R.CRE_RES_NAME IN ('CORREA, ZANA', 'OCHMAN, STEPHANIE MARIE', 'LYNCH, PEGGY GERALYN', 'BERKOWITZ-HERGIANTO, ALISON', 'DEVIGNE, AMY ROSE', 'TUCCI, ROSEANN', 'CANDELA, JOANNE', 'LEUNG-JOB, CHRISTINA') ) , NEXT_APPT AS (SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN SCH_MRN, CPE_ENC_DTE SCH_DTE, CRE_RES_NAME SCH_NAME FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE R ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = R.CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT D ON CPE_DEPT_ID = D.CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID JOIN MAIN ON CPE_MRN = "MRN" WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Sch') AND CPE_ENC_DTE >= CURRENT date AND R.CRE_RES_NAME IN ('CORREA, ZANA', 'OCHMAN, STEPHANIE MARIE', 'LYNCH, PEGGY GERALYN', 'BERKOWITZ-HERGIANTO, ALISON', 'DEVIGNE, AMY ROSE', 'TUCCI, ROSEANN', 'CANDELA, JOANNE', 'LEUNG-JOB, CHRISTINA') ) SELECT "MRN", "Appt Date", "Visit Type", "Department", "Service", "Department Name", "Provider Name", "Ref Provider Name", "Ref Department", "Ref Service", "Ref Department Name", "Ref Provider Clindoc", MIN(SCH_DTE) "Next Visit Date" FROM MAIN A LEFT JOIN NEXT_APPT ON A."MRN" = SCH_MRN AND A."Provider Name" = SCH_NAME GROUP BY "MRN", "Appt Date", "Visit Type", "Department", "Service", "Department Name", "Provider Name", "Ref Provider Name", "Ref Department", "Ref Service", "Ref Department Name", "Ref Provider Clindoc", SCH_NAME ;

prompt: We require the total number of kidney cancer patient encounters in the GU Medicine and Urology clinics for each year between 2019 and 2022.
completion: WITH DIAGNOSIS_TR_0 AS (SELECT "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AS PT_DEID, CAST(TRIM("IDB"."CDB_TUMOR"."TM_MRN") AS VARCHAR) || CAST(TRIM("IDB"."CDB_TUMOR"."TM_TUMOR_SEQ") AS VARCHAR) || CAST(TRIM("IDB"."CDB_TUMOR"."TM_DX_DTE") AS VARCHAR) AS SUBJECT_ID, "IDB"."ALLOWVALS"."AV_DESC" AS DX_TR_CASE_STATUS, TRIM("IDB"."CDB_TUMOR"."TM_HIST_CD") || ' - ' || TRIM(CLM_HIST."CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK") AS DX_TR_HISTOLOGY, TRIM("IDB"."CDB_TUMOR"."TM_SITE_CD") || ' - ' || TRIM(CLM_SITE."CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK") AS DX_TR_SITE FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS" JOIN "IDB"."CDB_TUMOR" ON "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_MRN" = "IDB"."CDB_TUMOR"."TM_MRN" JOIN "IDB"."ALLOWVALS" ON "IDB"."ALLOWVALS"."AV_CODE" = "IDB"."CDB_TUMOR"."TM_CASE_STS" AND "IDB"."ALLOWVALS"."AV_ELEMENT" = 'CASE_STS' JOIN "IDB"."CLM" AS CLM_HIST ON CLM_HIST."CLM_CLSF_CD" = "IDB"."CDB_TUMOR"."TM_HIST_CD" JOIN "IDB"."CLM" AS CLM_SITE ON CLM_SITE."CLM_CLSF_CD" = "IDB"."CDB_TUMOR"."TM_SITE_CD" WHERE "IDB"."ALLOWVALS"."AV_DESC" IN ('COMPLETED', 'CONSULT ONLY', 'INCOMPLETE', 'NON-INDEX', 'PATHOLOGY ONLY') AND "IDB"."CDB_TUMOR"."TM_HIST_CD" IN ('M8005/3', 'M8084/3', 'M8174/3', 'M8310/3', 'M8311/3', 'M8312/3', 'M8316/3', 'M8317/3', 'M8318/3', 'M8319/3', 'M8964/3') AND "IDB"."CDB_TUMOR"."TM_SITE_CD" IN ('C649')), APPOINTMENTS_1 AS (SELECT "DV"."PATIENT_ENCOUNTER"."PENC_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AS PT_DEID, CL_PT_ENCOUNTER."CPE_ENC_CSN_ID" AS SUBJECT_ID, CL_PT_ENCOUNTER."CPE_ENC_DTE" AS APPT_DATE, CL_PT_ENCOUNTER."CPE_CPE_APPT_STS" AS APPT_STATUS FROM "DV"."PATIENT_ENCOUNTER" JOIN "IDB"."CL_PT_ENCOUNTER" AS CL_PT_ENCOUNTER ON "DV"."PATIENT_ENCOUNTER"."PENC_ENC_CSN_ID" = CL_PT_ENCOUNTER."CPE_ENC_CSN_ID" WHERE CL_PT_ENCOUNTER."CPE_ENC_DTE" BETWEEN '2019-01-01' AND '2022-12-29' AND CL_PT_ENCOUNTER."CPE_CPE_APPT_STS" IN ('Comp')), COHORT AS (SELECT PT_DEID AS PT_DEID FROM (SELECT DIAGNOSIS_TR_0.PT_DEID AS PT_DEID FROM DIAGNOSIS_TR_0 INTERSECT SELECT APPOINTMENTS_1.PT_DEID AS PT_DEID FROM APPOINTMENTS_1)), COHORT_DIAGNOSIS_TR AS (SELECT SUBJECT_ID AS SUBJECT_ID, PT_DEID AS PT_DEID FROM (SELECT DIAGNOSIS_TR_0.SUBJECT_ID AS SUBJECT_ID, DIAGNOSIS_TR_0.PT_DEID AS PT_DEID FROM DIAGNOSIS_TR_0)), COHORT_APPOINTMENTS AS (SELECT SUBJECT_ID AS SUBJECT_ID, PT_DEID AS PT_DEID FROM (SELECT APPOINTMENTS_1.SUBJECT_ID AS SUBJECT_ID, APPOINTMENTS_1.PT_DEID AS PT_DEID FROM APPOINTMENTS_1)), KEYS AS (SELECT COHORT.PT_DEID AS COHORT_PT_DEID, COHORT_DIAGNOSIS_TR.SUBJECT_ID AS COHORT_DIAGNOSIS_TR_SUBJECT_ID, COHORT_DIAGNOSIS_TR.PT_DEID AS COHORT_DIAGNOSIS_TR_PT_DEID, COHORT_APPOINTMENTS.SUBJECT_ID AS COHORT_APPOINTMENTS_SUBJECT_ID, COHORT_APPOINTMENTS.PT_DEID AS COHORT_APPOINTMENTS_PT_DEID FROM COHORT LEFT OUTER JOIN COHORT_DIAGNOSIS_TR ON COHORT_DIAGNOSIS_TR.PT_DEID = COHORT.PT_DEID LEFT OUTER JOIN COHORT_APPOINTMENTS ON COHORT_APPOINTMENTS.PT_DEID = COHORT.PT_DEID), APPOINTMENTS_COLUMNS AS (SELECT DISTINCT "DV"."PATIENT_ENCOUNTER"."PENC_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AS PT_DEID, CL_PT_ENCOUNTER."CPE_ENC_CSN_ID" AS SUBJECT_ID, CL_PT_ENCOUNTER."CPE_ENC_DTE" AS APPT_DATE, CL_DEPT_DEPT_NAME."CLD_DEPT_NAME" AS DEPT_NAME, CASE WHEN (CL_VISIT_TYPE_TH."CVT_CVT_RPT_GRP_17" = 'TELEHEALTH' OR (UPPER(CL_VISIT_TYPE_TH."CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME") LIKE '%' || 'PHONE' || '%') OR CL_DEPT_TH."CLD_DEPT_ID" IN (1382, 1354) OR UPPER(CL_VISIT_TYPE_TH."CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME") IN ('IC BUNDLED SERVICES', 'IC INTEG MED REVIEW', 'IC MEDICAL RECORDS REVIEW', 'IC MSK IMPACT', 'IC RADIOLOGY REVIEW', 'IC VIDEO CONSULT')) THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS TELE_HEALTH, CASE WHEN (CL_VISIT_TYPE_NV_IR."CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR" LIKE '%' || 'NV' || '%') THEN 'New visit' WHEN (CL_VISIT_TYPE_NV_IR."CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR" LIKE '%' || 'IR' || '%') THEN 'Internal referral' ELSE 'Non new visit/Internal referral' END AS NV_VS_IR FROM "DV"."PATIENT_ENCOUNTER" JOIN "IDB"."CL_PT_ENCOUNTER" AS CL_PT_ENCOUNTER ON "DV"."PATIENT_ENCOUNTER"."PENC_ENC_CSN_ID" = CL_PT_ENCOUNTER."CPE_ENC_CSN_ID" JOIN "IDB"."CL_DEPT" AS CL_DEPT_DEPT_NAME ON CL_PT_ENCOUNTER."CPE_DEPT_ID" = CL_DEPT_DEPT_NAME."CLD_DEPT_ID" JOIN "IDB"."CL_VISIT_TYPE" AS CL_VISIT_TYPE_TH ON CL_PT_ENCOUNTER."CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID" = CL_VISIT_TYPE_TH."CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID" JOIN "IDB"."CL_DEPT" AS CL_DEPT_TH ON CL_PT_ENCOUNTER."CPE_DEPT_ID" = CL_DEPT_TH."CLD_DEPT_ID" LEFT OUTER JOIN "IDB"."CL_VISIT_TYPE" AS CL_VISIT_TYPE_NV_IR ON CL_PT_ENCOUNTER."CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID" = CL_VISIT_TYPE_NV_IR."CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID"), DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS AS (SELECT DISTINCT "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AS PT_DEID, "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AS SUBJECT_ID, "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_MRN" AS PT_MRN FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS") SELECT APPOINTMENTS_COLUMNS.APPT_DATE AS APPT_DATE, APPOINTMENTS_COLUMNS.DEPT_NAME AS APPT_DEPARTMENT, APPOINTMENTS_COLUMNS.TELE_HEALTH AS APPT_TELE_HEALTH, APPOINTMENTS_COLUMNS.NV_VS_IR AS NEW_VISIT_INTERNAL_REF FROM KEYS LEFT OUTER JOIN APPOINTMENTS_COLUMNS ON APPOINTMENTS_COLUMNS.SUBJECT_ID = KEYS.COHORT_APPOINTMENTS_SUBJECT_ID LEFT OUTER JOIN DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS ON DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS.PT_DEID = KEYS.COHORT_PT_DEID;

prompt: Provide a darwin cohort of living MYC amplification patients
completion: WITH PTS AS (SELECT PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID PID FROM DV.PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED) , DT_1 AS (SELECT PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID AS P_ID FROM DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS REC LEFT JOIN DV.PATIENT_CORE_DEMOGRAPHICS ON PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = CORE_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID WHERE 1=1 ) , DT_2 AS (SELECT INC.PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID P_ID FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_STRUCTURED_RESULTS_V INC LEFT JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_STRUCTURED_RESULTS_V EX ON INC.PRPT_PATH_RPT_ID = EX.PRPT_PATH_RPT_ID AND EX.GENE IN ('TP53') JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML DT ON INC.PRPT_PATH_RPT_ID = DT.PDRX_PATH_RPT_ID CROSS JOIN XMLTABLE('$c/root/meta-data' PASSING DT.PDRX_XML_VALUE AS "c" COLUMNS PRIMARY_SITE VARCHAR(264) PATH 'primary_site', TUMOR_TYPE_NAME VARCHAR(264) PATH 'tumor_type_name' , TUMOR_TYPE_CODE VARCHAR(264) PATH 'tumor_type_code', IS_METASTASIS VARCHAR(3) PATH 'is_metastasis' , METASTASIS_SITE VARCHAR(264) PATH 'metastasis_site' , MSI_COMMENT VARCHAR(264) PATH 'msi-comment' , MSI_SCORE VARCHAR(264) PATH 'msi-score' , MSI_TYPE VARCHAR(264) PATH 'msi-type' , TMB_SCORE VARCHAR(25) PATH 'tmb_score' , TMB_COUNT VARCHAR(25) PATH 'tmb-count', COSMIC_ID VARCHAR(5000) PATH 'cosmic_id') T JOIN (SELECT T.TUMOR_TYPE_CODE TTC FROM TABLE(DV.STRING_SPLIT('NSCLC,GRC,BLAD,UA,UAD,PAAD,MEL', ',')) S CROSS JOIN TABLE(DV.ONCOTREE_CHILDREN(COLUMN_VALUES)) T) X ON T.TUMOR_TYPE_CODE = TRIM(X.TTC) WHERE 1=1 AND (INC.GENE IN ('MDM2') OR INC.GENE2 IN ('MDM2')) AND INC.FOLD_CHANGE <= 5 AND INC.FOLD_CHANGE >= 2 AND EX.PRPT_PATH_RPT_ID IS NULL ) , DT_3 AS (SELECT PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID AS P_ID FROM DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS REC LEFT JOIN DV.PATIENT_CORE_DEMOGRAPHICS ON PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = CORE_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID WHERE 1=1 AND PT_VITAL_STATUS IN ('ALIVE') AND YEAR(COALESCE(PT_DEATH_DTE, CURRENT date) - PT_BIRTH_DTE) >= 18 ) SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT P_ID) FROM (SELECT P_ID FROM DT_1 INTERSECT SELECT P_ID FROM DT_2 INTERSECT SELECT P_ID FROM DT_3 ) ; WITH PTS AS (SELECT PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID PID FROM DV.PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED) , DT_1 AS (SELECT PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID AS P_ID FROM DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS REC LEFT JOIN DV.PATIENT_CORE_DEMOGRAPHICS ON PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = CORE_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID WHERE 1=1 ) , DT_2 AS (SELECT INC.PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID P_ID FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_STRUCTURED_RESULTS_V INC LEFT JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_STRUCTURED_RESULTS_V EX ON INC.PRPT_PATH_RPT_ID = EX.PRPT_PATH_RPT_ID AND EX.GENE IN ('TP53') JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML DT ON INC.PRPT_PATH_RPT_ID = DT.PDRX_PATH_RPT_ID CROSS JOIN XMLTABLE('$c/root/meta-data' PASSING DT.PDRX_XML_VALUE AS "c" COLUMNS PRIMARY_SITE VARCHAR(264) PATH 'primary_site', TUMOR_TYPE_NAME VARCHAR(264) PATH 'tumor_type_name' , TUMOR_TYPE_CODE VARCHAR(264) PATH 'tumor_type_code', IS_METASTASIS VARCHAR(3) PATH 'is_metastasis' , METASTASIS_SITE VARCHAR(264) PATH 'metastasis_site' , MSI_COMMENT VARCHAR(264) PATH 'msi-comment' , MSI_SCORE VARCHAR(264) PATH prompt: List of Mesothelioma Patients based on the Tumor Registry Database
completion: WITH DX AS (SELECT DISTINCT TM_MRN, TM_DX_DTE, TM_HIST_CD, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS HIST_DESC, TM_SITE_CD, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_DESC FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND (TM_SITE_CD LIKE 'C34%' OR TM_SITE_CD LIKE 'C38%' OR TM_SITE_CD LIKE 'C37%') AND TM_HIST_CD BETWEEN 'M9050/0' AND 'M9055/1' ) , RAD AS (SELECT DISTINCT RTC_TX_MRN, RTC_TX_PLAN_NAME, RTC_TX_DELIVERED_FRACTIONS, RTC_TX_DELIVERED_DOSE, RTC_TX_START_DTE, RTC_TX_STOP_DTE, RTC_PRIMARY_REF_POINT FROM IDB.RADONC_TREATMENT_COURSE JOIN DX ON RTC_TX_MRN = TM_MRN) SELECT DISTINCT TM_MRN "MRN", PT_LAST_NAME "Last Name", PT_FIRST_NAME "First Name", PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH "Date of Birth", TM_DX_DTE "Tumor Dx Date", TM_HIST_CD "Histology Code", HIST_DESC "Histology Description", TM_SITE_CD "Site Code", SITE_DESC "Site Description", RTC_TX_PLAN_NAME "Rad Site", RTC_TX_DELIVERED_FRACTIONS "Delivered Fraction", RTC_TX_DELIVERED_DOSE "Delivered Dose", RTC_TX_START_DTE "Rad Start Date", RTC_TX_STOP_DTE "Rad Stop Date", RTC_PRIMARY_REF_POINT "Rad Primary Ref Point" FROM DX JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON TM_MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN RAD ON TM_MRN = RTC_TX_MRN ORDER BY 1 DESC, 13 ; WITH DX AS (SELECT DISTINCT TM_MRN, TM_DX_DTE, TM_HIST_CD, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS HIST_DESC, TM_SITE_CD, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_DESC FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND (TM_SITE_CD LIKE 'C34%' OR TM_SITE_CD LIKE 'C38%' OR TM_SITE_CD LIKE 'C37%') AND TM_HIST_CD BETWEEN 'M9050/0' AND 'M9055/1' ) , LABS AS (SELECT DISTINCT LR_MRN, LR_PERFORMED_DTE, LR_SUBTEST_NAME, LR_RESULT_VALUE, LTL_TEXT_RESULT FROM IDB.LAB_RESULTS JOIN DX ON LR_MRN = TM_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.LAB_TEXT_LINE ON LTL_RESULT_GUID = LR_RESULT_GUID WHERE LR_SUBTEST_NAME = 'Soluble Mesothelin Related Peptide' ) SELECT DISTINCT TM_MRN "MRN", PT_LAST_NAME "Last Name", PT_FIRST_NAME "First Name", PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH "Date of Birth", TM_DX_DTE "Tumor Dx Date", TM_HIST_CD "Histology Code", HIST_DESC "Histology Description", TM_SITE_CD "Site Code", SITE_DESC "Site Description", LR_PERFORMED_DTE "Lab Performed Date", LR_SUBTEST_NAME "Lab Subtest Name", LR_RESULT_VALUE "Lab Result Value", LTL_TEXT_RESULT "Lab Result Text" FROM DX JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON TM_MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN LABS ON TM_MRN = LR_MRN ORDER BY 1 DESC, 10

prompt: Provide a report on patients who had an initial nutrition visit with counseling by the dietitian on weight reduction/management, from January 2022 - June 2022.
completion: SELECT DISTINCT CDD_MRN, CDD_DOC_GUID, CDD_SERVICE_DTE, CDD_DOC_NAME, X1.CDO_ITEM_NAME, X1.CDO_VALUE_TEXT, X2.CDO_ITEM_NAME, X2.CDO_VALUE_TEXT FROM IDB.CD_DOCUMENT JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION X1 ON X1.CDO_DOC_GUID = CDD_DOC_GUID AND X1.CDO_AUTHORED_DTE = CDD_AUTHORED_DTE AND X1.CDO_ITEM_NAME IN ('Reason for Consult:', 'Reason for Consult - Other:') AND X1.CDO_VALUE_TEXT like '%Weight reduction/management%' JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION X2 ON X2.CDO_DOC_GUID = CDD_DOC_GUID AND X2.CDO_AUTHORED_DTE = CDD_AUTHORED_DTE AND X2.CDO_ITEM_NAME IN ('Visit Type:') AND X2.CDO_VALUE_TEXT like '%Initial%' WHERE CDD_CANCEL_IND = '0' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND = '0' AND CDD_DOC_NAME = 'Initial Assessment/Reassessment Amb - Nutrition' AND CDD_SERVICE_DTE BETWEEN '2022-01-01' AND '2022-06-30'

prompt: Provide a list of patients who received spinal radiation therapy and checkpoint inhibitors between 1/1/2010 and 6/1/2019.
completion: WITH RT AS (SELECT DISTINCT RTC_TX_MRN AS MRN, RTC_TX_PLAN_NAME, RTC_PRIMARY_REF_POINT, RTC_TX_START_DTE, RTC_TX_STOP_DTE, RTC_TX_ELAPSED_DAYS, RTC_TX_PLANNED_FRACTIONS, RTC_TX_DELIVERED_FRACTIONS, RTC_TX_PLANNED_DOSE, RTC_TX_DELIVERED_DOSE, RTC_DOSE_CORRECTION FROM IDB.RADONC_TREATMENT_COURSE WHERE RTC_TX_START_DTE BETWEEN '2010-01-01' AND '2019-06-01' AND(UPPER(RTC_TX_PLAN_NAME) like '%SPIN%' OR UPPER(RTC_TX_PLAN_NAME) like '%SPN%') ) , IMMUN AS (SELECT DISTINCT APR_MRN, APR_GENERIC_NAME, APR_DRUG_NAME, APR_START_DTE, APR_END_DTE, APR_ORD_RX_TYPE, APR_ORDER_SOURCE, CDG_BIOLOGIC_IMMUNO_FLAG FROM RT JOIN IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX_V ON MRN = APR_MRN WHERE CDG_BIOLOGIC_IMMUNO_FLAG = 'Y' AND APR_START_DTE BETWEEN '2010-01-01' AND '2019-06-01' AND APR_GENERIC_NAME IN ('AVELUMAB', 'BMS-936558', 'DURVALUMAB', 'IPILIMUMAB', 'MDX-010', 'MDX-1106', 'MK-3475', 'NIVOLUMAB', 'PEMBROLIZUMAB') ) , X AS (SELECT DISTINCT RT.* FROM RT JOIN IMMUN ON MRN = APR_MRN) , DX AS (SELECT DISTINCT TM_MRN, TM_DX_DTE AS DX_DATE, TM_HIST_CD AS HIST_CODE, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS HIST_DESC, TM_SITE_CD AS SITE_CODE, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_DESC FROM X LEFT JOIN IDB.CDB_TUMOR ON MRN = TM_MRN AND TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') LEFT JOIN IDB.CLM H ON TM_HIST_CD = H.CLM_CLSF_CD LEFT JOIN IDB.CLM S ON TM_SITE_CD = S.CLM_CLSF_CD) , ICD AS (SELECT CC_MRN AS MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS DX_DATE, CLM_CLSF_CD AS DX_CODE, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS DX_DESC FROM X JOIN IDB.CTC_CLSF ON MRN = CC_MRN JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND ((CC_PT_TYPE = 'I') OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) AND(CC_CLSF_CD IN ('G04.91', 'G95.89', 'G95.9', '323.9', '336.8', '336.9') OR CC_CLSF_CD LIKE 'G04%' OR CC_CLSF_CD LIKE 'G05%' OR CC_CLSF_CD LIKE '323%') GROUP BY CC_MRN, CLM_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK ) SELECT * FROM ICD

prompt: CIS orders placed for Companion at Bedside from 2017
completion: SELECT DISTINCT OOC_ITEM_NAME "Item Name", OO_MRN MRN, OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE "Start Date", OO_STOP_DTE "Stop Date", OO_SUMMARY_LINE "Summary Line", OSTS_STS_DESC "Order Status", OL_LOC_NAME "Location" FROM IDB.OMS_ORDER JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_CATALOG ON OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID = OOC_MSTR_ITEM_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_STATUS ON OO_ORD_STS_CD = OSTS_ORD_STS_CD JOIN IDB.OMS_VISIT_LOCATION ON OVL_VISIT_GUID = OO_VISIT_GUID AND OVL_EFF_DT = (SELECT MAX(OVL_EFF_DT) AS MAX_OVL_EFF_DT FROM IDB.OMS_VISIT_LOCATION WHERE OVL_EFF_DT <= OO_SIGNIFICANT_DT AND OVL_VISIT_GUID = OO_VISIT_GUID) JOIN IDB.OMS_LOCATION ON OVL_LOC_GUID = OL_LOC_GUID WHERE OOC_ITEM_NAME = 'Companion at Bedside, Chair-side or Table-side' AND YEAR(OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE) >= 2017

prompt: Provide a list of MRN and MRI brain reports for all patients with pathological diagnosis of bladder cancer between 2000 to 2023 in order to identify patients with bladder cancer brain metastasis.
completion: WITH X AS (SELECT DISTINCT TM_MRN AS MRN, TM_DX_DTE AS DX_DATE, TM_SITE_CD AS DX_CODE, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS DX_DESC FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.SEERGROUPING ON RECODE = DV.SEERF_ICDO(TM_SITE_CD, TM_HIST_CD) JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD WHERE 1=1 AND TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND TM_DX_DTE BETWEEN '2000-01-01' AND '2023-06-01' AND CATEGORY2 = 'Urinary Bladder' UNION SELECT CC_MRN AS MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS DX_DATE, CLM_CLSF_CD AS DX_CODE, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS DX_DESC FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD AND CLM_CLSF_CD IN ('188', '188.0', '188.1', '188.2', '188.3', '188.4', '188.5', '188.6', '188.7', '188.8', '188.9', 'C67', 'C67.0', 'C67.1', 'C67.2', 'C67.3', 'C67.4', 'C67.5', 'C67.6', 'C67.7', 'C67.8', 'C67.9') WHERE CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND CASE WHEN CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y' THEN 'Y' WHEN CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' AND YEAR(CC_EFF_DTE) < 2004 THEN 'Y' WHEN CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND YEAR(CC_EFF_DTE) < 2001 THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END = 'Y' AND CC_PT_TYPE <> 'E' GROUP BY CC_MRN, CLM_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK HAVING MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) BETWEEN '2000-01-01' AND '2023-06-01') , Y AS (SELECT MRN, LISTAGG(COALESCE(STRIP(CAST(DX_DATE AS VARCHAR(1000))), '') || ' | ' || COALESCE(STRIP(CAST(DX_CODE AS VARCHAR(1000))), '') || ' | ' || COALESCE(STRIP(CAST(DX_DESC AS VARCHAR(1000))), '') , CHR(13) || CHR(10)) WITHIN GROUP( ORDER BY MRN, DX_DATE) AS DX FROM X GROUP BY MRN) SELECT DISTINCT "t1"."PT_MRN" AS "MRN", DX, "t2"."RRPT_ACCESSION_NO" AS "Radiology Accession Number", "t2"."RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE" AS "Radiology Performed Date", "t2"."RRPT_REPORT_DTE" AS "Radiology Report Date", "t2"."RRPT_ORDER_GROUP" AS "Radiology Order Group", "t2"."RRPT_PROCEDURE_NAME" AS "Radiology Procedure Name", UPPER(DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)IMPRESSION:[\w\W]*(?=DICTATED BY:)', RRPT_REPORT_TXT)) AS IMPRESSION, UPPER(CASE WHEN LENGTH(RRPT_REPORT_TXT) <= 15000 THEN RTRIM(CAST(SUBSTR(RRPT_REPORT_TXT, 1, 15000) AS VARCHAR(15000))) ELSE CAST(SUBSTR(RRPT_REPORT_TXT, 1, 15000) AS VARCHAR(15000)) END) AS "PRPT_REPORT" FROM Y JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V" "t1" ON PT_MRN = MRN LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED" "t3" ON "t1"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t3"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."RADIOLOGY_REPORT_V" "t2" ON "t3"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t2"."RRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_IDENTIFICATION_MRN_V" "t4" ON "t1"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t4"."PI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" WHERE 1=1 AND "t2"."RRPT_ORDER_GROUP" = 'MR' AND(UPPER("t2"."RRPT_PROCEDURE_NAME") like '%BRAIN%' OR UPPER("t2"."RRPT_PROCEDURE_NAME") like '%BRN%' OR UPPER("t2"."RRPT_PROCEDURE_NAME") like '%HEAD%' OR UPPER("t2"."RRPT_PROCEDURE_NAME") like '%SELLA%')

prompt: Provide a list of patients who received high dose methotrexate on the neurology service from 1/1/2010-1/1/2018
completion: WITH DRUG AS (SELECT DISTINCT CPO_MRN, CPO_SET_NAME, CPO_ORD_NAME, CPO_FST_ADMIN_DT, CPO_LST_ADMIN_DT, CPO_ORD_GUID FROM IDB.CHEMO_PERFORMED_ORDERS WHERE UPPER(CPO_ORD_NAME) LIKE '%METHOTREXATE%' AND CPO_START_DTE BETWEEN '2010-01-01' AND '2018-01-01' AND CPO_SET_NAME LIKE 'NEU%' AND CPO_SET_NAME <> 'NEU_IT_Methotrexate' ) , CREATININE AS (SELECT A.* FROM (SELECT DRUG.*, LR_MRN, LR_RESULT_VALUE "Creatinine Value", LR_PERFORMED_DT "Creatinine Date", ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY LR_MRN, CPO_ORD_GUID ORDER BY LR_PERFORMED_DT DESC) RN FROM DRUG JOIN IDB.LAB_RESULTS ON LR_MRN = CPO_MRN AND LR_SUBTEST_NAME = 'Creatinine' AND LR_PERFORMED_DTE <= DATE(CPO_FST_ADMIN_DT)) A WHERE RN = 1 ) , LABS AS (SELECT CREATININE.*, CPO_ORD_GUID, OUD_USER_DI_VALUE, LR_RESULT_VALUE FROM CREATININE JOIN IDB.OMS_ORDER ON OO_MRN = CPO_MRN AND OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE BETWEEN DATE(CPO_FST_ADMIN_DT) AND DATE(CPO_FST_ADMIN_DT) + 7 DAYS JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_CATALOG ON OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID = OOC_MSTR_ITEM_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_USER_DATA ON OO_ORD_GUID = OUD_ORD_GUID LEFT JOIN IDB.LAB_RESULTS ON OO_ORD_GUID = LR_ORD_GUID AND LR_SUBTEST_NAME = 'Methotrexate Level.' WHERE OOC_ITEM_NAME = 'Methotrexate Level' AND OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'LBRZ_MTXHR' ) SELECT CPO_MRN AS "MRN", PT_LAST_NAME "Last Name", PT_FIRST_NAME "First Name", PT_SEX "Sex", AV_DESC "Race", YEAR(DATE(CPO_FST_ADMIN_DT) - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) "Age at Methotrexate", CPO_SET_NAME AS "Order Set Name", CPO_ORD_NAME AS "Order Name", CPO_FST_ADMIN_DT AS "Order Admin Date", "Creatinine Value", "Creatinine Date", MAX(CASE WHEN OUD_USER_DI_VALUE = '24' OR OUD_USER_DI_VALUE = '24 hours' THEN LR_RESULT_VALUE END) AS "24 Hours", MAX(CASE WHEN OUD_USER_DI_VALUE = '48' OR OUD_USER_DI_VALUE = '48 hours' THEN LR_RESULT_VALUE END) AS "48 Hours", MAX(CASE WHEN OUD_USER_DI_VALUE = '72' OR OUD_USER_DI_VALUE = '72 hours' THEN LR_RESULT_VALUE END) AS "72 Hours", MAX(CASE WHEN OUD_USER_DI_VALUE = '96' OR OUD_USER_DI_VALUE = '96 hours' THEN LR_RESULT_VALUE END) AS "96 Hours", MAX(CASE WHEN OUD_USER_DI_VALUE = '120' OR OUD_USER_DI_VALUE = '120 hours' THEN LR_RESULT_VALUE END) AS "120 Hours" FROM LABS A JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PT_MRN=CPO_MRN JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS ON AV_ELEMENT='RACE' AND AV_CODE=PT_RACE GROUP BY CPO_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_SEX, AV_DESC, CPO_SET_NAME, CPO_ORD_NAME, CPO_FST_ADMIN_DT, "Creatinine Value", "Creatinine Date", YEAR(DATE(CPO_FST_ADMIN_DT) - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) ORDER BY CPO_MRN, CPO_FST_ADMIN_DT ;

prompt: Provide a list of patients who have received atezolizumab for non-small cell((NSCLC) with all lung cancer.
completion: WITH INIT AS (SELECT DISTINCT TM_MRN, AV_DESC AS CASE_STS, TM_DX_DTE, TM_HIST_CD, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS HIST_DESC, TM_SITE_CD, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_DESC, TM_BEST_AJCC_STG FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS ON AV_ELEMENT = 'CASE_STS' AND AV_CODE = TM_CASE_STS WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND TM_SITE_CD LIKE 'C34%' ), APR AS (SELECT TM_HIST_CD, HIST_DESC, TM_SITE_CD, SITE_DESC, APR_MRN, APR_START_DTE, CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME, APR_GENERIC_NAME, APR_PRESCRIBED_DOSE, APR_ROUTE FROM INIT JOIN IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX ON TM_MRN = APR_MRN JOIN IDB.CHEMO_DRUG_GENERIC ON APR_GENERIC_NAME = CDG_GENERIC_NAME WHERE APR_START_DTE >= '2021-01-01' AND UPPER(CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME) like '%ATEZOLIZUMAB%' ) SELECT DISTINCT APR_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, PT_SEX, APR_GENERIC_NAME, MIN(APR_START_DTE) OVER(PARTITION BY APR_MRN) AS MIN_APR_START_DTE, HIST_DESC, TM_SITE_CD, SITE_DESC FROM APR LEFT JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON APR_MRN = PT_MRN ;

prompt: Provide a report of all splenectomies performed with postop complications and diagnoses.
completion: WITH SPL AS (SELECT CC_MRN MRN , STRIP(PT_LAST_NAME)||', '||STRIP(PT_FIRST_NAME) AS PT_NAME , PT_SEX SEX , YEAR(CC_EFF_DTE) - YEAR(PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) AS AGE_AT_SURG , CC_ACCT_NO ACCT_NO , CC_CLSF_CD PROC_CD , SUBSTR(CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK, 1, 35) AS PROC_DESC , CC_RESP_PARTY DOC_NO, DOC_NAME , CC_EFF_DTE PROC_DTE FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON CC_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.DOC ON CC_RESP_PARTY = DOC_DR_NO WHERE CC_CLSF_CD IN ('41.5', '41.43') AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'P%' AND (CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y' OR CC_PT_TYPE = 'I') ) , COMP AS (SELECT DISTINCT SSE_MRN COMP_MRN, SSE_SURG_DTE SURG_DATE , SSE_LOG_ID, SAE_TOX_OCCR_DT COMP_DT , SSP_PNL_NO COMPL_PNL, SUBSTR(SSP_SURG_SVC_CD, 1, 3) SVC , SUBSTR(STRIP(SSP_SURG_LAST_NM)||', '||SSP_SURG_FIRST_NM, 1, 35) SURGEON , DATE(SAE_TOX_OCCR_DT) AS COMP_DATE , SAE_TOXICITY_NAME AS COMP_NAME , SAE_TOX_GRADE AS COMP_GRADE , SAE_TOX_GRADE_NAME AS COMP_CRITERIA FROM IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE ON SSE_LOG_ID = SSP_LOG_ID JOIN SPL ON MRN = SSE_MRN AND SSE_SURG_DTE = PROC_DTE JOIN IDB.SRG_ADVERSE_EVENT ON SSP_LOG_ID = SAE_SURG_LOG_ID AND SAE_PROC_SEQ_NO = SSP_PROC_SEQ_NO AND SAE_TOX_GRADE > '0' WHERE SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD IN ('38120', '38101', '38115', '38100', '38102') ) SELECT SPL.*, CC_CLSF_CD AS DX_CD, SUBSTR(CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK, 1, 35) DX_DESC FROM SPL JOIN IDB.CTC_CLSF ON ACCT_NO = CC_ACCT_NO AND CC_EFF_DTE = PROC_DTE AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'D%' AND CC_CLSF_CD BETWEEN '140' AND '239.99' JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE (CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y' OR CC_PT_TYPE = 'I') WITH SPL AS (SELECT CC_MRN MRN , STRIP(PT_LAST_NAME)||', '||STRIP(PT_FIRST_NAME) AS PT_NAME , PT_SEX SEX , YEAR(CC_EFF_DTE) - YEAR(PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) AS AGE_AT_SURG , CC_ACCT_NO ACCT_NO , CC_CLSF_CD PROC_CD , SUBSTR(CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK, 1, 35) AS PROC_DESC , CC_RESP_PARTY DOC_NO, DOC_NAME , CC_EFF_DTE PROC_DTE FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON CC_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.DOC ON CC_RESP_PARTY = DOC_DR_NO WHERE CC_CLSF_CD IN ('41.5', '41.43') AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'P%' AND (CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y' OR CC_PT_TYPE = 'I') ) , COMP AS (SELECT DISTINCT SSE_MRN COMP_MRN, SSE_SURG_DTE SURG_DATE , SSE_LOG_ID, SAE_TOX_OCCR_DT COMP_DT , SSP_PNL_NO COMPL_PNL, SUBSTR(SSP_SURG_SVC_CD, 1, 3) SVC , SUBSTR(STRIP(SSP_SURG_LAST_NM)||', '||SSP_SURG_FIRST_NM, 1, 35) SURGEON , DATE(SAE_TOX_OCCR_DT) AS COMP_DATE , SAE_TOXICITY_NAME AS COMP_NAME , SAE_TOX_GRADE AS COMP_GRADE , SAE_TOX_GRADE_NAME AS COMP_CRITERIA FROM IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE ON SSE_LOG_ID = SSP_LOG_ID JOIN SPL ON MRN = SSE_MRN AND SSE_SURG_DTE = PROC_DTE JOIN IDB.SRG_ADVERSE_EVENT ON SSP_LOG_ID = SAE_SURG_LOG_ID AND SAE_PROC_SEQ_NO = SSP_PROC_SEQ_NO AND SAE_TOX_GRADE > '0' WHERE SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD IN ('38120', '38101', '38115', '38100', '38102') ) SELECT SPL.*, CC_CLSF_CD AS DX_CD, SUBSTR(CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK, 1, 35) DX_DESC FROM SPL JOIN IDB.CTC_CLSF ON ACCT_NO = CC_ACCT_NO AND CC_EFF_DTE = PROC_DTE AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'D%' AND CC_CLSF_CD BETWEEN '140' AND '239.99' JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE (CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y' OR CC_PT_TYPE = 'I')

prompt: Provide a list of patients with pancreatic cancer with appointments between '2018-10-01'and '2021-10-01'
completion: WITH PTS AS (SELECT DISTINCT TM_MRN, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY TM_MRN ORDER BY TM_DX_DTE DESC) RN FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.SEERGROUPING ON IDB.SEERF_ICDO(TM_SITE_CD, TM_HIST_CD) = RECODE WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND CATEGORY2 = 'Pancreas' ) SELECT DISTINCT TM_MRN MRN, PT_LAST_NAME LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME FIRST_NAME, PT_CITY CITY, PT_STATE STATE, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH DOB, CPP_MOBILE_PHONE MOBILE_PHONE, CPP_EMAIL_ADDR EMAIL FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN PTS ON TM_MRN = CPE_MRN AND RN = 1 JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON CPE_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY ON CPE_MRN = PLA_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_PAS_PATIENT ON CPE_MRN = CPP_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_CATEGORY ON CAV_CATEGORY = 'LANG' AND CPP_LANG = CAV_ABBR WHERE 1=1 AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN '2018-10-01'AND '2021-10-01' AND CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp', 'Sch') AND PT_DEATH_IND IN ('', 'A') AND PLA_DONOT_MAIL_IND <> 'Y' AND CPP_EMAIL_ADDR <> ''

prompt: Provide a list of patients with new visits in Myeloma since 2018.
completion: WITH APPT AS (SELECT PT_MRN MRN, PT_LAST_NAME "Last Name", PT_FIRST_NAME "First Name", CPE_ENC_DTE AS "Appt Date", CLD_DEPT_NAME AS "Department Name", CRE_RES_NAME AS "Provider Name", CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME AS "Visit Type" FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON CPE_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CRE_RES_TYP IN ('Physician', 'Registered Nurse', 'Advanced Practice Nurse', 'Nurse Practitioner') AND CPE_ENC_DTE >= '2018-01-01' AND (CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 = 'MYL') AND (CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR LIKE '%NV%' OR CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR LIKE '%IR%') ) , IRB AS (SELECT AC_MRN, PRO_IRB_NO, AC_CONS_DTE FROM APPT JOIN IDB.ACCRUALS ON MRN = AC_MRN JOIN IDB.PROTOCOL ON AC_IRB_NO = PRO_IRB_NO WHERE PRO_PROTOCOL_TYPE IN ('Therapeutic', 'Therapeutic/QOL') ) SELECT APPT.*, PRO_IRB_NO, AC_CONS_DTE FROM APPT LEFT JOIN IRB ON MRN = AC_MRN

prompt: Provide a weekly report providing all future lab appointments for the patient cohort housed in "18-288: CH Germline Carrier Serial Sampling".
completion: WITH REDCAPCONFIG AS (SELECT 'https://redcap.mskcc.org/api/' AS URL , 'token=5F7E844C82A8F356EDDD7D70DF239EA3' || '&content=record&format=xml&type=flat&rawOrLabel=raw&rawOrLabelHeaders=raw&exportCheckboxLabel=false&returnFormat=json&fields[0]=project_cohort&fields[1]=mrn' GETTABLE , CAST('<' || 'httpHeader><' || 'header name="Content-Type" value="application/x-www-form-urlencoded; charset=UTF-8"><' || '/header><' || 'header name="Cache-Control" value="no-cache"><' || '/header><' || '/httpHeader>' AS CLOB(1K)) AS HEADER FROM SYSIBM.SYSDUMMY1) , REDCAP_DATA_PRE AS (SELECT T.* FROM REDCAPCONFIG CROSS JOIN XMLTABLE('$c/records/item' PASSING XMLPARSE(DOCUMENT DB2XML.HTTPPOSTCLOB(URL, HEADER, GETTABLE)) AS "c" COLUMNS MRN VARCHAR(12) PATH 'mrn' , PROJECT_COHORT VARCHAR(10) PATH 'project_cohort') T) , REDCAP_DATA AS (SELECT DISTINCT CAST(MRN AS CHAR(12)) AS MRN , PROJECT_COHORT FROM REDCAP_DATA_PRE WHERE PROJECT_COHORT <> '3' ) , DT_PRE AS (SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN AS MRN , PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID FROM REDCAP_DATA JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON PT_MRN = MRN) , APPT_INFO AS (SELECT CPE_MRN, CPE_ENC_DTE AS "Appt Date", VARCHAR_FORMAT(CPE_APPT_DT, 'HH24:MI') AS "Appt Time", CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 AS "Department", CLD_DEPT_NAME AS "Department Name", CR.CRE_RES_NAME AS "Resource Name", REFER.CRE_RES_NAME AS "Referred By", CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME AS "Visit Type" , CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR AS "Visit Abbrev" FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN DT_PRE ON MRN = CPE_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE CR ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CR.CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE REFER ON CPE_REF_RES_ID = REFER.CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE 1=1 AND CLD_DEPT_NAME like '%LAB%' AND CPE_CPE_APPT_STS ='Sch' AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT date AND CURRENT date + 31 DAYS AND DAYOFWEEK(CPE_ENC_DTE) <> 6 ) , DT AS (SELECT DISTINCT MRN , PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID FROM DT_PRE JOIN APPT_INFO ON CPE_MRN = MRN) , PROTOCOL_INFO AS (SELECT PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID AS PROT_PID, LISTAGG(VARCHAR_FORMAT(AC_CONS_DTE, 'mm/dd/yyyy') || ' ' || RTRIM(PRO_IRB_NO) || CASE WHEN AC_OFF_STUDY_DTE IS NOT NULL THEN ' ' || COALESCE(VARCHAR_FORMAT(AC_OFF_STUDY_DTE, 'mm/dd/yyyy'), '') ELSE '' END || CASE WHEN AC_TX_STRT_DTE IS NOT NULL THEN ' tx start:' || COALESCE(VARCHAR_FORMAT(AC_TX_STRT_DTE, 'mm/dd/yyyy'), '') ELSE '' END || CASE WHEN AC_TX_END_DTE IS NOT NULL THEN ' tx end:' || COALESCE(VARCHAR_FORMAT(AC_TX_END_DTE, 'mm/dd/yyyy'), '') ELSE '' END , CHR(13) || CHR(10)) WITHIN GROUP ( ORDER BY AC_CONS_DTE, PRO_IRB_NO) AS "Protocols" FROM DT INNER JOIN DV.ACCRUALS ON PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = AC_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID INNER JOIN DV.PROTOCOL ON AC_PROTOCOL_ID = PRO_PROTOCOL_ID WHERE PRO_IRB_NO IN ('06-107', '09-141', '12-245') GROUP BY PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID) SELECT DISTINCT "t1"."PT_MRN" AS "MRN", "t1"."PT_LAST_NAME" AS "Last Name", "t1"."PT_FIRST_NAME" AS "First Name", "t1"."PT_BIRTH_DTE" AS "Date of Birth", CASE WHEN "t1"."PT_DEATH_DTE" IS NULL THEN YEAR(CURRENT date - "t1"."PT_BIRTH_DTE") END AS "Cur Age", "t1"."PT_VITAL_STATUS" AS "Vital Status", "t1"."PT_SEX_DESC" AS "Gender", "Appt Date", "Appt Time", "Department", "Department Name", "Resource Name", "Referred By", "Visit Type" , "Visit Abbrev" , "Protocols" FROM DT DT JOIN APPT_INFO ON CPE_MRN = MRN JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS" "t1" ON "t1"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = DT.PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_CORE_DEMOGRAPHICS" "t2" ON "t1"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t2"."CORE_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_LATEST_ACTIVITY" "t3" ON "t1"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t3"."PLA_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN PROTOCOL_INFO ON PROT_PID = DT.PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID WHERE 1=1 ORDER BY MRN, "Appt Date", "Appt Time"

prompt: Looking for a report in whatever format is best for positive troponins on patients 48 hours post surgery.
completion: WITH SURGERY AS (SELECT DISTINCT SSE_MRN , SSE_SURG_DTE, SSE_PT_OUT_DT, SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD, SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC, SSP_SURG_LAST_NM FROM IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE ON SSE_LOG_ID = SSP_LOG_ID AND SSE_ENC_CSN_ID = SSP_ENC_CSN_ID WHERE 1=1 AND SSE_SURG_DTE BETWEEN '07/01/2023' AND '09/30/2023') SELECT DISTINCT SSE_MRN AS MRN, SSE_SURG_DTE AS "Surgery Date", VARCHAR_FORMAT(SSE_PT_OUT_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') "Room Out Date/Time", VARCHAR_FORMAT(LR_PERFORMED_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS "Lab Date/Time" , TIMESTAMPDIFF(8, CHAR(LR_PERFORMED_DT-SSE_PT_OUT_DT)) AS "Hours Difference" , CASE WHEN LR_RESULT_VALUE > '0.64' THEN 'Positive' ELSE 'Negative' END AS INDICATOR , LR_RESULT_VALUE AS "Lab Result" FROM SURGERY JOIN IDB.LAB_RESULTS ON LR_MRN = SSE_MRN WHERE LR_CTLG_ITEM_GUID = '1000002812101001' AND LR_PERFORMED_DTE BETWEEN SSE_SURG_DTE AND SSE_SURG_DTE + 2 DAY AND LR_PERFORMED_DT BETWEEN SSE_PT_OUT_DT AND SSE_PT_OUT_DT + 48 HOUR AND LENGTH(TRIM(LR_RESULT_VALUE)) > 0 AND RIGHT(TRIM(LR_RESULT_VALUE), 1) BETWEEN '0' AND '9' AND UPPER(LEFT(TRIM(LR_RESULT_VALUE), 1)) NOT BETWEEN 'A' AND 'Z' AND REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(TRIM(LR_RESULT_VALUE), '<', ''), '>', ''), '<=', ''), '>=', '') > '0.64' ORDER BY 2, 1, 5

prompt: Provide a list of "Platelet Antibody Screen" requested on inpatient since 1/1/2020
completion: WITH X AS (SELECT OO_MRN, OO_ENTER_DTE, OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE, OO_ORD_ID, OO_ORD_GUID, OO_ORD_NAME, OCV_IP_OP_IND, OO_SUMMARY_LINE, COUNT(OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE) OVER(PARTITION BY OO_MRN) DATE_COUNT FROM IDB.OMS_ORDER JOIN IDB.OMS_CLIENT_VISIT ON OCV_VISIT_GUID = OO_VISIT_GUID WHERE OO_ORD_STS_CD NOT IN ('CANC', 'CANP', 'AUC3') AND OO_ENTER_DTE BETWEEN '2020-01-01' AND CURRENT date AND OO_ORD_NAME = 'Platelet Antibody Screen' ), ORDER AS (SELECT DISTINCT * FROM (SELECT OO_MRN, OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE ORDER_DATE1, OO_ORD_NAME, OCV_IP_OP_IND, DATE_COUNT, LEAD(OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY OO_MRN ORDER BY OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE) ORDER_DATE2 FROM (SELECT DISTINCT OO_MRN, OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE, OO_ORD_NAME, OCV_IP_OP_IND, DATE_COUNT FROM X)) WHERE ORDER_DATE2 IS NOT NULL ) , FINAL AS (SELECT DISTINCT BBP_MRN, ORDER_DATE1, ORDER_DATE2, OO_ORD_NAME, DATE_COUNT, BBP_TRANSACTION_DTE AS TRANSFUSION_DATE, TIME(BBP_TRANSACTION_DT) AS TRANSFUSION_TIME, BBP_TRANSACTION_DT AS TRANSFUSION_DT, BBP_PRODUCT_ABRV, BBP_PRODUCT_DESC, BBP_UNIT_VOLUME, BBP_UNITS_IN_POOL, BBP_BLOOD_TYPE, BBP_PVDR_GUID, BBP_PVDR_NO, BBP_PVDR_NAME FROM IDB.TRANSFUSED_BLOOD_PRODUCTS_V JOIN ORDER ON OO_MRN = BBP_MRN WHERE BBP_PRODUCT_DESC = 'Platelets' AND BBP_TRANSACTION_DTE BETWEEN ORDER_DATE1 AND ORDER_DATE2 ) SELECT DISTINCT BBP_MRN, DAYS_BETWEEN (ORDER_DATE2, ORDER_DATE1) TIME_INTERVAL, DATE_COUNT REPEAT_TESTING, ORDER_DATE1, ORDER_DATE2, OO_ORD_NAME, COUNT(TRANSFUSION_DATE) OVER (PARTITION BY BBP_MRN, ORDER_DATE1, ORDER_DATE2) TRANSFUSION_COUNT FROM FINAL

prompt: We are interested in identifying patients with RET-fusions on IMPACT testing who also have a diagnosis of deep vein thrombosis or pulmonary embolism
completion: WITH RET AS (SELECT PT_MRN RET_MRN , PATH_PROCEDURE_DATE , PATH_RPT_DATE , PRPT_ACCESSION_NO , GENE , LOCUS , AA_CHANGE , NUCLEOTIDE , SEARCH_HIT2 , ABERRATIONTYPE , FOLD_CHANGE , GENE2 FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_STRUCTURED_RESULTS_V WHERE (GENE = 'RET' OR GENE2 = 'RET') AND METHOD = 'IMPACT' ) , ICD AS (SELECT PT_MRN, DXCC_ICD_CODE AS ICD_CODE, DXCC_ICD_MSK_DESC AS ICD_DESC, MIN(DT_DTE) AS MAX_ICD_CODE_DTE FROM DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS JOIN DV.PATIENT_DIAGNOSIS_FINAL_ALL_V ON PDX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID JOIN DV.DATE_V ON PDX_DX_DATE_ID = DT_DATE_ID JOIN DV.DIAGNOSIS_CATALOG ON PDX_DX_CATALOG_ID = DXCC_DX_CATALOG_ID JOIN RET ON PT_MRN = RET_MRN WHERE SUBSTR(DXCC_ICD_CODE, 1, 3) IN ('I26', 'I82', '415', '453') GROUP BY PT_MRN, DXCC_ICD_CODE, DXCC_ICD_MSK_DESC ) , PBD AS (SELECT PBD_MRN, PBD_SVC_DTE, PBC_CPT_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK FROM IDB.PBD_DTL JOIN IDB.PBD_CODE ON PBD_PBD_CD = PBC_PBD_CD JOIN IDB.CLM ON PBC_CPT_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN RET ON PBD_MRN = RET_MRN WHERE PBC_CPT_CD IN ('93970', '71275') ) , RAD AS (SELECT * FROM (SELECT RRPT_MRN, RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE, DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)IMPRESSION:[\w\W]*(?=DICTATED BY:)', RRPT_REPORT_TXT) AS IMPRESSION FROM DV.RADIOLOGY_REPORT_V JOIN PBD ON RRPT_MRN = PBD_MRN AND RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE = PBD_SVC_DTE)A WHERE UPPER(IMPRESSION) like '%PULM%EMBO%' OR UPPER(IMPRESSION) like '% PE%' OR UPPER(IMPRESSION) like '% P/E%' OR UPPER(IMPRESSION) like '% P-E%' OR UPPER(IMPRESSION) like '%THROMB%' OR UPPER(IMPRESSION) like '%DVT%' OR UPPER(IMPRESSION) like '%DEEP%VE%' ) , APR AS (SELECT APR_MRN , MAX(APR_START_DTE) AS LAST_SELPERCATINIB FROM IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX_V JOIN RET ON APR_MRN = RET_MRN WHERE CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME = 'SELPERCATINIB' GROUP BY APR_MRN ) , AC AS (SELECT AC_MRN , MIN(CASE WHEN AC_IRB_NO = '17-256' THEN 'Y' END) "17-256" , MIN(CASE WHEN AC_IRB_NO = '18-487' THEN 'Y' END) "18-487" , MIN(CASE WHEN AC_IRB_NO = '19-257' THEN 'Y' END) "19-257" , MIN(CASE WHEN AC_IRB_NO = '20-045' THEN 'Y' END) "20-045" FROM IDB.ACCRUALS JOIN RET ON AC_MRN = RET_MRN WHERE AC_IRB_NO IN ('17-256', '18-487', '19-257', '20-045') GROUP BY AC_MRN ) SELECT RET_MRN AS MRN , PATH_PROCEDURE_DATE , PATH_RPT_DATE , PRPT_ACCESSION_NO ACCESSION_NO , GENE , LOCUS , AA_CHANGE , NUCLEOTIDE , SEARCH_HIT2 , ABERRATIONTYPE , FOLD_CHANGE , GENE2 , ICD_CODE , ICD_DESC , MAX_ICD_CODE_DTE , PBD_SVC_DTE CPT_SVC_DTE , PBC_CPT_CD CPT_CODE , CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK CPT_DESC , IMPRESSION , LAST_SELPERCATINIB , "17-256" , "18-487" , "19-257" , "20-045" FROM RET LEFT JOIN ICD ON RET_MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN PBD ON RET_MRN = PBD_MRN LEFT JOIN RAD ON RRPT_MRN = PBD_MRN AND RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE = PBD_SVC_DTE LEFT JOIN APR ON RET_MRN = APR_MRN LEFT JOIN AC ON RET_MRN = AC_MRN WHERE COALESCE(PT_MRN, PBD_MRN) IS NOT NULL

prompt: Provide a list of all patients diagnosed with primary urinary tract or urethral cancers.

prompt: Provide diagnosis, pathology, genetic, billing, and demographic data for patients who have are IDH1 or IDH2 with specific histologies.
completion: WITH DMP_DX_PRE AS (SELECT DISTINCT PDRX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID P_ID, PT_MRN AS DMP_MRN, T.*, DT.PDRX_PATH_RPT_ID AS R_ID FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML DT CROSS JOIN XMLTABLE('$c/root/*' PASSING DT.PDRX_XML_VALUE AS "c" COLUMNS DMP_PATIENT_ID VARCHAR(264) PATH '../meta-data/dmp_patient_id', DMP_SAMPLE_ID VARCHAR(264) PATH '../meta-data/dmp_sample_id', PRIMARY_SITE VARCHAR(264) PATH '../meta-data/primary_site', TUMOR_TYPE_NAME VARCHAR(264) PATH '../meta-data/tumor_type_name' , M_ACCESSION_NUM VARCHAR(264) PATH '../meta-data/m_accession_num' , GENE_PANEL VARCHAR(264) PATH '../meta-data/gene-panel' , PART_DESCRIPTION VARCHAR(264) PATH '../meta-data/part_description') T JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PDRX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID) , DMP_INFO AS (SELECT DMP.* FROM DMP_DX_PRE DMP WHERE TUMOR_TYPE_NAME IN ('Diffuse Glioma' , 'Oligodendroglioma' , 'Low-Grade Glioma, NOS') ) , PATHOLOGY AS (SELECT PRPT_MRN, PRPT_PROCEDURE_DTE, PRPT_REPORT_DTE, PRPT_ACCESSION_NO , VARCHAR(PRPT_REPORT, 32000) AS "Path Report partial" , PRPT_ORD_DR_NAME FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V PATH JOIN DMP_INFO ON R_ID = PRPT_PATH_RPT_ID WHERE 1=1 ) , GENE_PRE AS (SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN AS GENE_MRN FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_STRUCTURED_RESULTS_V JOIN DMP_INFO ON PRPT_PATH_RPT_ID = R_ID WHERE GENE IN ('IDH1', 'IDH2') ) , DT AS (SELECT DISTINCT P_ID, PT_MRN AS MRN FROM DMP_INFO JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = P_ID) , NEU_VISIT_INFO AS (SELECT CPE_MRN , MIN(CPE_ENC_DTE) AS "First Neuro Visit" FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN DT DT ON MRN = CPE_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID WHERE 1=1 AND CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CRE_RES_TYP IN ('Physician', 'PhD', 'Dentist', 'Psychologist') AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 IN ('NEU') GROUP BY CPE_MRN) , ICD_CODING AS (SELECT MRN AS ICD_MRN , MIN(EFF_DTE) AS MIN_ICD_DTE FROM (SELECT CC_MRN AS MRN , CC_EFF_DTE AS EFF_DTE FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN DT ON MRN = CC_MRN WHERE 1=1 AND CC_CLSF_CD IN ('780.39' , 'G40' , 'G40.0' , 'G40.00' , 'G40.001' , 'G40.009' , 'G40.01' , 'G40.011' , 'G40.019' , 'G40.1' , 'G40.10' , 'G40.101' , 'G40.109' , 'G40.11' , 'G40.111' , 'G40.119' , 'G40.2' , 'G40.20' , 'G40.201' , 'G40.209' , 'G40.21' , 'G40.211' , 'G40.219' , 'G40.3' , 'G40.30' , 'G40.301' , 'G40.309' , 'G40.31' , 'G40.311' , 'G40.319' , 'G40.4' , 'G40.40' , 'G40.401' , 'G40.409' , 'G40.41' , 'G40.411' , 'G40.419' , 'G40.5' , 'G40.50' , 'G40.501' , 'G40.509' , 'G40.511' , 'G40.519' , 'G40.8' , 'G40.80' , 'G40.801' , 'G40.802' , 'G40.803' , 'G40.804' , 'G40.809' , 'G40.81' , 'G40.811' , 'G40.812' , 'G40.813' , 'G40.814' , 'G40.819' , 'G40.82' , 'G40.821' , 'G40.822' , 'G40.823' , 'G40.824' , 'G40.89' , 'G40.9' , 'G40.90' , 'G40.901' , 'G40.909' , 'G40.91' , 'G40.911' , 'G40.919' , 'G40.A' , 'G40.A0' , 'G40.A01' , 'G40.A09' , 'G40.A1' , 'G40.A11' , 'G40.A19' , 'G40.B' , 'G40.B0' , 'G40.B01' , 'G40.B09' , 'G40.B1' , 'G40.B11' , 'G40.B19' , 'R56.9' ) ) DX GROUP BY MRN) SELECT DISTINCT "t1"."PT_MRN" AS "MRN", "t1"."PT_LAST_NAME" AS "Last Name", "t1"."PT_FIRST_NAME" AS "First Name", "t1"."PT_BIRTH_DTE" AS "Date of Birth", "t1"."PT_DEATH_DTE" AS "Deceased Date", CASE WHEN "t1"."PT_DEATH_DTE" IS NULL THEN YEAR(CURRENT date - "t1"."PT_BIRTH_DTE") END AS "Cur Age", "t1"."PT_VITAL_STATUS" AS "Vital Status", "t1"."PT_SEX_DESC" AS "Gender" , "First Neuro Visit" , MIN_ICD_DTE AS "Seizure Min Date" , CASE WHEN GENE_MRN IS NOT NULL THEN 'Y' END AS "IDH+ Indicator" FROM DT DT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS" "t1" ON "t1"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = DT.P_ID LEFT JOIN NEU_VISIT_INFO ON CPE_MRN = DT.MRN LEFT JOIN ICD_CODING ON ICD_MRN = DT.MRN LEFT JOIN GENE_PRE ON GENE_MRN = DT.MRN WHERE 1=1 ORDER BY "t1"."PT_MRN" ;

prompt: we are trying to capture how many patients underwent hysteroscopy prior to they staging procedure from 2000 to 2021. to identify whether hysteroscopy is associated with positive peritoneal cytology.
completion: WITH PROCEDURES_0 AS (SELECT "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AS PT_DEID, "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_MRN" AS PT_MRN, "IDB"."SRG_SURG_EVENT"."SSE_LOG_ID" AS SUBJECT_ID, "IDB"."SRG_SURG_EVENT"."SSE_SURG_DTE" AS PROC_SURG_DATE, CAST(TRIM("IDB"."SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE"."SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD") AS VARCHAR) || ' - ' || CAST(TRIM("IDB"."SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE"."SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC") AS VARCHAR) AS PROC_CODE_DESC FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS" JOIN "IDB"."SRG_SURG_EVENT" ON "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_MRN" = "IDB"."SRG_SURG_EVENT"."SSE_MRN" JOIN "IDB"."SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE" ON "IDB"."SRG_SURG_EVENT"."SSE_LOG_ID" = "IDB"."SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE"."SSP_LOG_ID" WHERE "IDB"."SRG_SURG_EVENT"."SSE_SURG_DTE" BETWEEN CURRENT_DATE - 23 YEARS AND CURRENT_DATE AND "IDB"."SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE"."SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD" IN ('58555')), DIAGNOSIS_1 AS (SELECT "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AS PT_DEID, BASE_QUERY.PT_MRN AS PT_MRN, CAST(TRIM(BASE_QUERY.PT_MRN) AS VARCHAR) || CAST(TRIM(BASE_QUERY.DIAGNOSIS_DATE) AS VARCHAR) || CAST(TRIM(BASE_QUERY.ICD_CODES_ICD_CODE) AS VARCHAR) AS SUBJECT_ID, TRIM(BASE_QUERY.ICD_CODES_ICD_CODE) || '-' || TRIM("IDB"."CLM"."CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK") AS ICD_CODES_ICD_CODE_DESC FROM (SELECT "IDB"."CTC_CLSF"."CC_MRN" AS PT_MRN, "IDB"."CTC_CLSF"."CC_CLSF_CD" AS ICD_CODES_ICD_CODE, MIN("IDB"."CTC_CLSF"."CC_EFF_DTE") AS DIAGNOSIS_DATE FROM "IDB"."CTC_CLSF" WHERE "IDB"."CTC_CLSF"."CC_CLSF_TYPE" LIKE 'DF%' AND ("IDB"."CTC_CLSF"."CC_PT_TYPE" = 'I' OR ("IDB"."CTC_CLSF"."CC_PT_TYPE" = 'O' AND "IDB"."CTC_CLSF"."CC_FINALIZED_IND" = 'Y')) GROUP BY "IDB"."CTC_CLSF"."CC_MRN", "IDB"."CTC_CLSF"."CC_CLSF_CD") AS BASE_QUERY JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS" ON BASE_QUERY.PT_MRN = "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_MRN" JOIN "IDB"."CLM" ON BASE_QUERY.ICD_CODES_ICD_CODE = "IDB"."CLM"."CLM_CLSF_CD" WHERE BASE_QUERY.ICD_CODES_ICD_CODE IN ('621.3', '621.30', 'C54.1', 'D07.0')), COHORT AS (SELECT PT_DEID AS PT_DEID FROM (SELECT PROCEDURES_0.PT_DEID AS PT_DEID FROM PROCEDURES_0 INTERSECT SELECT DIAGNOSIS_1.PT_DEID AS PT_DEID FROM DIAGNOSIS_1)), COHORT_PROCEDURES AS (SELECT SUBJECT_ID AS SUBJECT_ID, PT_DEID AS PT_DEID FROM (SELECT PROCEDURES_0.SUBJECT_ID AS SUBJECT_ID, PROCEDURES_0.PT_DEID AS PT_DEID FROM PROCEDURES_0)), COHORT_DIAGNOSIS AS (SELECT SUBJECT_ID AS SUBJECT_ID, PT_DEID AS PT_DEID FROM (SELECT DIAGNOSIS_1.SUBJECT_ID AS SUBJECT_ID, DIAGNOSIS_1.PT_DEID AS PT_DEID FROM DIAGNOSIS_1)), KEYS AS (SELECT COHORT.PT_DEID AS COHORT_PT_DEID, COHORT_PROCEDURES.SUBJECT_ID AS COHORT_PROCEDURES_SUBJECT_ID, COHORT_PROCEDURES.PT_DEID AS COHORT_PROCEDURES_PT_DEID, COHORT_DIAGNOSIS.SUBJECT_ID AS COHORT_DIAGNOSIS_SUBJECT_ID, COHORT_DIAGNOSIS.PT_DEID AS COHORT_DIAGNOSIS_PT_DEID FROM COHORT LEFT OUTER JOIN COHORT_PROCEDURES ON COHORT_PROCEDURES.PT_DEID = COHORT.PT_DEID LEFT OUTER JOIN COHORT_DIAGNOSIS ON COHORT_DIAGNOSIS.PT_DEID = COHORT.PT_DEID), DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS AS (SELECT DISTINCT "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AS PT_DEID, IDB_PATIENT."PT_MRN" AS PT_MRN, "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AS SUBJECT_ID, DMP_ID_TBL."PDRX_DMP_PATIENT_ID" AS DMP_ID, TRIM(IDB_PATIENT."PT_LAST_NAME") || ', ' || TRIM(IDB_PATIENT."PT_FIRST_NAME") AS PT_NAME, CASE WHEN (IDB_PATIENT."PT_DATE_OF_DEATH" IS NULL) THEN 'Alive' ELSE 'Deceased' END AS VITAL_STATS, IDB_PATIENT."PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH" AS DATE_OF_BIRTH, IDB_PATIENT."PT_DATE_OF_DEATH" AS DATE_OF_DEATH, ALLOWVALS_RACE."AV_DESC" AS RACE, ALLOWVALS_ETHNICITY."AV_DESC" AS ETHNICITY, LAST_ACTIVITY_DATE."PLA_LST_ACTV_DTE" AS LAST_ACTIVITY_DATE, LAST_CONTACT_DATE."PLA_LST_CON_DTE" AS LAST_CONTACT_DATE FROM "IDB"."PATIENT" AS IDB_PATIENT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS" ON IDB_PATIENT."PT_MRN" = "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_MRN" LEFT OUTER JOIN "DV"."PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML" AS DMP_ID_TBL ON DMP_ID_TBL."PDRX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT OUTER JOIN "IDB"."ALLOWVALS" AS ALLOWVALS_RACE ON IDB_PATIENT."PT_RACE" = ALLOWVALS_RACE."AV_CODE" AND ALLOWVALS_RACE."AV_ELEMENT" = 'RACE' LEFT OUTER JOIN "IDB"."ALLOWVALS" AS ALLOWVALS_ETHNICITY ON IDB_PATIENT."PT_PT_ETHNICITY" = ALLOWVALS_ETHNICITY."AV_CODE" AND ALLOWVALS_ETHNICITY."AV_ELEMENT" = 'PT_ETHNICITY' LEFT OUTER JOIN "IDB".PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY AS LAST_ACTIVITY_DATE ON IDB_PATIENT."PT_MRN" = LAST_ACTIVITY_DATE."PLA_MRN" LEFT OUTER JOIN "IDB".PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY AS LAST_CONTACT_DATE ON IDB_PATIENT."PT_MRN" = LAST_CONTACT_DATE."PLA_MRN") SELECT DISTINCT DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS.PT_MRN AS MRN, DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS.DMP_ID AS DMP_ID, DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS.PT_NAME AS PT_NAME, DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS.VITAL_STATS AS VITAL_STATUS, DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS.DATE_OF_BIRTH AS DATE_OF_BIRTH, DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS.DATE_OF_DEATH AS DATE_OF_DEATH, DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS.RACE AS RACE, DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS.ETHNICITY AS ETHNICITY, DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS.LAST_ACTIVITY_DATE AS LAST_ACTIVITY_DATE, DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS.LAST_CONTACT_DATE AS LAST_CONTACT_DATE FROM KEYS LEFT OUTER JOIN DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS ON DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS.PT_DEID = KEYS.COHORT_PT_DEID;

prompt: Create a scheduled version of AMB5007 report to run monthly. Provide data for Q1 and Q2 2011.
completion: SELECT OUO_MRN MRN, STRIP(PT_LAST_NAME)||', '||STRIP(PT_FIRST_NAME) PT_NAME , OUO_ENTER_DT ENTER_DT, OUO_ORD_NAME ORD_NAME , OUO_ANC_NAME BATTERY, OUO_ORD_ID ORDID , STRIP(OUO_ORD_STS_CD)||'-'||STRIP(OUO_STS_DESC) ORD_STS , OUO_REV_CAT_DEPT DEPT, OO_SET_NAME SETNAME , OUO_CURR_LOC LOC, OUO_REQ_TME_PRIO REQ_TME_PRIO , TIMESTAMP(SUBSTR(CHAR(OSH_CREATE_DT), 1, 17)||'00.000000') RELEASED_DT , OO_PERFORMED_DT COLLECTED_DT , CASE WHEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(4, CHAR(OO_PERFORMED_DT - OSH_CREATE_DT)) >= 0 THEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(4, CHAR(OO_PERFORMED_DT - OSH_CREATE_DT)) END MTS , SUBSTR(CASE WHEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(4, CHAR(OO_PERFORMED_DT - OSH_CREATE_DT))/60 BETWEEN 0 AND 9 THEN '0'||STRIP(CHAR(TIMESTAMPDIFF(4, CHAR(OO_PERFORMED_DT - OSH_CREATE_DT))/60)) ELSE STRIP(CHAR(TIMESTAMPDIFF(4, CHAR(OO_PERFORMED_DT - OSH_CREATE_DT))/60)) END ||':'||RIGHT(DIGITS(MOD((TIMESTAMPDIFF(4, CHAR(OO_PERFORMED_DT - OSH_CREATE_DT))),60)), 2), 1, 8) TIMEDIFF , LAST_DAY(CURRENT DATE - 1 MONTH) RPTDATE FROM IDB.OMS_USER_ORDERS JOIN IDB.OMS_ORDER ON OUO_ORD_GUID = OO_ORD_GUID JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PT_MRN = OUO_MRN JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_STS_HX ON OSH_ORD_GUID = OO_ORD_GUID AND OSH_ORD_STS_CD = 'PEND' AND OSH_FUNCTION_CD = '105' WHERE OSH_CREATE_DTE BETWEEN LAST_DAY(CURRENT DATE - 2 MONTH)+ 1 DAY AND LAST_DAY(CURRENT DATE - 1 MONTH) AND OUO_ORD_STS_CD NOT IN ('CANC', 'CANP', 'DISC', 'AUC1') AND OUO_REV_CAT_DEPT IN ('Laboratory', 'Blood Bank') AND OO_ACCT_NO NOT LIKE '84%' AND OO_PERFORMED_DT IS NOT NULL AND OUO_IP_OP_IND = 'O' AND OUO_CURR_LOC LIKE '%53%'

prompt: Update project MED22937: Provide list of alive patients with breast cancer who have any Notch alteration detected on IMPACT at MSK.
