completion: WITH NOTCH AS (SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN GENE_MRN , GENE , GENE2 , AA_CHANGE , LOCUS , NUCLEOTIDE , SEARCH_HIT2 FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_STRUCTURED_RESULTS_V WHERE 1=1 AND METHOD IN ('IMPACT', 'IMPACTHeme') AND (GENE like 'NOTCH%' OR GENE2 like 'NOTCH%') ) , PRIMARY_MD AS (SELECT CPE_MRN , COUNT , CRE_RES_NAME , ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CPE_MRN ORDER BY COUNT DESC) RANK FROM (SELECT CPE_MRN , COUNT(DISTINCT CPE_ENC_CSN_ID) AS COUNT , CRE_RES_NAME FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID JOIN NOTCH ON CPE_MRN = GENE_MRN WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CRE_RES_TYP IN ('Physician') AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 = 'BRE' GROUP BY CPE_MRN, CRE_RES_NAME) A GROUP BY CPE_MRN , COUNT , CRE_RES_NAME) , SCH_APPT AS (SELECT CPE_MRN , CPE_ENC_DTE , CPE_APPT_DT , CRE_RES_NAME , CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME , ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CPE_MRN ORDER BY CPE_APPT_DT ASC) RANK FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID JOIN NOTCH ON CPE_MRN = GENE_MRN WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Sch') AND CPE_ENC_DTE >= CURRENT date AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 = 'BRE' AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 = 'MED' GROUP BY CPE_MRN, CPE_ENC_DTE, CPE_APPT_DT, CRE_RES_NAME, CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME) SELECT DISTINCT GENE_MRN "MRN" , PT_LAST_NAME "PT Last Name" , PT_FIRST_NAME "PT First Name" , GENE "Gene" , GENE2 "Gene2" , LOCUS "Location" , NUCLEOTIDE "Alteration" , SEARCH_HIT2 "Additional Info" , P.CRE_RES_NAME "Primary Breast MD" , S.CPE_APPT_DT "Next Appt Date" , S.CRE_RES_NAME "Next Appt Resource" , S.CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME "Next Appt Visit Type" FROM NOTCH LEFT JOIN PRIMARY_MD P ON GENE_MRN = P.CPE_MRN AND P.RANK = 1 LEFT JOIN SCH_APPT S ON GENE_MRN = S.CPE_MRN AND S.RANK = 1 LEFT JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON GENE_MRN = PT_MRN ;

prompt: Identify all patients who had a colon resection on the colorectal service.
completion: SELECT MRN, SURG_DATE, SURGEON, LOS, COUNT(CPT_CD) CPT_CNT, HEPATECTOMY_IND FROM (SELECT DISTINCT PBD_MRN AS MRN, PBD_SVC_DTE AS SURG_DATE, PBC_CPT_CD CPT_CD, PBC_PBD_DESC AS SURG_DESC, DOC_SVC, TIMESTAMP(CS_ADM_DATE, CS_ADM_TIME) AS ADMIT_DT, TIMESTAMP(CS_DSCH_DATE, CS_DSCH_TIME) AS DISCH_DT, DOC_NAME AS SURGEON, SUBSTR(CHAR(PBD_SVC_DTE), 1, 4)AS SURG_YEAR, CASE WHEN CS_DSCH_DATE IS NOT NULL THEN INT(CS_DAYS_STAY) ELSE DAYS(CURRENT DATE) - DAYS(PBD_SVC_DTE) END LOS FROM IDB.PBD_DTL JOIN IDB.PBD_CODE ON PBC_PBD_CD = PBD_PBD_CD JOIN IDB.CLM ON CLM_CLSF_CD = PBC_CPT_CD JOIN IDB.PBD_INVOICE ON PBI_MRN = PBD_MRN AND PBI_ACCT_NO = PBD_ACCT_NO AND PBI_INV_NO = PBD_INV_NO JOIN IDB.DOC ON PBI_PERFORM_DR_NO = DOC_DR_NO JOIN IDB.CASE ON CS_MRN = PBD_MRN AND PBD_SVC_DTE BETWEEN CS_ADM_DATE AND CS_DSCH_DATE AND CS_ACCT_NO LIKE '84%' AND CS_PT_STS <> 'IP' WHERE YEAR(PBD_SVC_DTE) IN (2007, 2008) AND PBC_CPT_CD IN ('44140', '44141', '44143', '44144', '44145', '44146', '44150', '44153', '44155', '44158', '44160', '44204', '44205', '44207', '44208', '44210', '44211') AND PBC_PBD_DESC LIKE 'COLOR%' ) SURG LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT PBD_MRN, PBD_SVC_DTE, 'Y' HEPATECTOMY_IND FROM IDB.PBD_DTL JOIN IDB.PBD_CODE ON PBC_PBD_CD = PBD_PBD_CD WHERE YEAR(PBD_SVC_DTE) IN (2007, 2008) AND PBC_CPT_CD IN ('47120', '47122', '47125', '47130') ) B ON MRN = PBD_MRN AND SURG_DATE = PBD_SVC_DTE GROUP BY MRN, SURG_DATE, SURGEON, LOS, HEPATECTOMY_IND

prompt: provide a list of my patients who have allergy to docetaxel/taxotere, neulasta, cyclophosphamide, fosaprepitant
completion: WITH PTS AS (SELECT CPE_MRN , MAX(CPE_ENC_DTE) LAST_VISIT FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID AND CRE_RES_ID = '012294' JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND YEAR(CPE_ENC_DTE) >= 2005 GROUP BY CPE_MRN ) SELECT OPA_MRN MRN , TRIM(PT_LAST_NAME) || ', ' || TRIM(PT_FIRST_NAME) PATIENT_NAME , LAST_VISIT , OPA_ALRGN_CD ALLERGY_NAME , OPA_ALGY_REACT REACTION FROM IDB.OMS_PT_ALLERGY JOIN PTS ON OPA_MRN = CPE_MRN JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON OPA_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE (LOWER(OPA_ALRGN_CD) like 'docetaxel%' OR LOWER(OPA_ALRGN_CD) like 'pegfilgrastim%' OR LOWER(OPA_ALRGN_CD) like 'cyclophosphamide%' OR LOWER(OPA_ALRGN_CD) like 'fosaprepitant%') AND OPA_ALGY_STS = 'Active'

prompt: List of all brain radiology scans (radiology) and CSF flow or brain biopsy (pathology) for all patients with a DLBCL diagnosis
completion: SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN AS MRN, TM_DX_DTE AS "Tumor Diagnosis Date", TM_HIST_CD AS "Histology Code", HIST_DESC AS "Histology Description", TM_SITE_CD AS "Site Code", SITE_DESC AS "Site Description", MIN_ICD9_EFF_DTE AS "ICD Date", ICD9_CD AS "ICD Code", ICD9_DESC AS "ICD Description" FROM IDB.PATIENT LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT TM_MRN, TM_DX_DTE, TM_HIST_CD, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS HIST_DESC, TM_SITE_CD, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_DESC FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS ON AV_ELEMENT = 'CASE_STS' AND AV_CODE = TM_CASE_STS AND TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND TM_HIST_CD IN ('M9679/3', 'M9680/3', 'M9681/3', 'M9688/3', 'M9714/3', 'M9738/3' ) ) AS CDB ON TM_MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT CC_MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS MIN_ICD9_EFF_DTE, CC_CLSF_CD AS ICD9_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS ICD9_DESC FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE CC_CLSF_CD IN ('C83.30', 'C83.31', 'C83.32', 'C83.33', 'C83.34', 'C83.35', 'C83.36', 'C83.37', 'C83.38', 'C83.39', '200.00', '200.01', '200.02', '200.03', '200.04', '200.06', '200.07', '200.08') AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND (CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) GROUP BY CC_MRN, CC_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK ) AS ICD9 ON CC_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE COALESCE(TM_MRN, CC_MRN) IS NOT NULL ; WITH DX AS (SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN, TM_DX_DTE AS "Tumor Diagnosis Date", TM_HIST_CD AS "Histology Code", HIST_DESC AS "Histology Description", TM_SITE_CD AS "Site Code", SITE_DESC AS "Site Description", MIN_ICD9_EFF_DTE AS "ICD Date", ICD9_CD AS "ICD Code", ICD9_DESC AS "ICD Description" FROM IDB.PATIENT LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT TM_MRN, TM_DX_DTE, TM_HIST_CD, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS HIST_DESC, TM_SITE_CD, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_DESC FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS ON AV_ELEMENT = 'CASE_STS' AND AV_CODE = TM_CASE_STS AND TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND TM_HIST_CD IN ('M9679/3', 'M9680/3', 'M9681/3', 'M9688/3', 'M9714/3', 'M9738/3' ) ) AS CDB ON TM_MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT CC_MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS MIN_ICD9_EFF_DTE, CC_CLSF_CD AS ICD9_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS ICD9_DESC FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE CC_CLSF_CD IN ('C83.30', 'C83.31', 'C83.32', 'C83.33', 'C83.34', 'C83.35', 'C83.36', 'C83.37', 'C83.38', 'C83.39', '200.00', '200.01', '200.02', '200.03', '200.04', '200.06', '200.07', '200.08') AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND (CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) GROUP BY CC_MRN, CC_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK ) AS ICD9 ON CC_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE COALESCE(TM_MRN, CC_MRN) IS NOT NULL ), PATH AS (SELECT DISTINCT PRPT_MRN , PRPT_ACCESSION_NO AS "Accession No" , PRPT_REPORT_DTE AS "Pathology Report Date" , PRPT_PROCEDURE_DTE AS "Pathology Procedure Date" , PRPT_REPORT_TYPE_DESC AS "Pathology Report Type Description" , PRPT_REPORT_TYPE , DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)diag[\w\W]*(?=I ATTEST)', PRPT_REPORT) AS DIAGNOSIS_TEXT , VARCHAR(PRPT_REPORT, 32000) AS "Report Text" FROM DX JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V ON PRPT_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID WHERE PRPT_REPORT IS NOT NULL ) SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN AS MRN, "Accession No", "Pathology Report Date", "Pathology Report Type Description", PRPT_REPORT_TYPE AS "Pathology Report Type", DIAGNOSIS_TEXT AS "Diagnosis Text", "Report Text" FROM DX JOIN PATH ON PT_MRN = PRPT_MRN ORDER BY PT_MRN ; WITH DX AS (SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN, TM_DX_DTE AS "Tumor Diagnosis Date", TM_HIST_CD AS "Histology Code", HIST_DESC AS "Histology Description", TM_SITE_CD AS "Site Code", SITE_DESC AS "Site Description", MIN_ICD9_EFF_DTE AS "ICD Date", ICD9_CD AS "ICD Code", ICD9_DESC AS "ICD Description" FROM IDB.PATIENT LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT TM_MRN, TM_DX_DTE, TM_HIST_CD, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS HIST_DESC, TM_SITE_CD, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_DESC FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS ON AV_ELEMENT = 'CASE_STS' AND AV_CODE = TM_CASE_STS AND TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND TM_HIST_CD IN ('M9679/3', 'M9680/3', 'M9681/3', 'M9688/3', 'M9714/3', 'M9738/3' ) ) AS CDB ON TM_MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT CC_MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS MIN_ICD9_EFF_DTE, CC_CLSF_CD AS ICD9_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS ICD9_DESC FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE CC_CLSF_CD IN ('C83.30', 'C83.31', 'C83.32', 'C83.33', 'C83.34', 'C83.35', 'C83.36', 'C83.37', 'C83.38', 'C83.39', '200.00', '200.01', '200.02', '200.03', '200.04', '200.06', '200.07', '200.08') AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND (CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) GROUP BY CC_MRN, CC_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK ) AS ICD9 ON CC_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE COALESCE(TM_MRN, CC_MRN) IS NOT NULL ) SELECT DISTINCT RRPT_MRN AS MRN, RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE AS "Report Performed Date", RRPT_ACCESSION_NO AS "Accession Number", RRPT_ORDER_GROUP AS "Report Order Group", RRPT_PROCEDURE_NAME AS "Report Procedure Name", VARCHAR(RRPT_REPORT_TXT, 32000) AS "Report Text" FROM DX JOIN DV.RADIOLOGY_REPORT_V ON RRPT_MRN = PT_MRN ORDER BY RRPT_MRN ;

prompt: Provide a list of Peripheral T-Cell Lymphoma patients who have had at least one lumbar puncture procedure that is positive for malignant cells.
completion: WITH DX AS (SELECT TM_MRN AS MRN, TM_DX_DTE AS DX_DATE, TM_HIST_CD AS DX_CODE, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS DX_DESC FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM H ON TM_HIST_CD = H.CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON TM_SITE_CD = S.CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND TM_HIST_CD IN ('M9413/3', 'M9702/3', 'M9705/3', 'M9708/3', 'M9714/3', 'M9716/3', 'M9717/3', 'M9718/3', 'M9719/3', 'M9724/3', 'M9726/3', 'M9827/3', 'M9831/3', 'M9834/3') UNION SELECT CC_MRN AS MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS DX_DATE, CLM_CLSF_CD AS DX_CODE, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS DX_DESC FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND ((CC_PT_TYPE = 'I') OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) AND CC_CLSF_CD IN ('200.60', '200.61', '200.62', '200.63', '200.64', '200.65', '200.66', '200.67', '200.68', '202.70', '202.71', '202.72', '202.73', '202.74', '202.75', '202.76', '202.77', '202.78', 'C84.40', 'C84.41', 'C84.42', 'C84.43', 'C84.44', 'C84.45', 'C84.46', 'C84.47', 'C84.48', 'C84.49', 'C84.60', 'C84.61', 'C84.62', 'C84.63', 'C84.64', 'C84.65', 'C84.66', 'C84.67', 'C84.68', 'C84.69', 'C84.70', 'C84.71', 'C84.72', 'C84.73', 'C84.74', 'C84.75', 'C84.76', 'C84.77', 'C84.78', 'C84.79', 'C84.90', 'C84.91', 'C84.92', 'C84.93', 'C84.94', 'C84.95', 'C84.96', 'C84.97', 'C84.98', 'C84.99', 'C84.A0', 'C84.A2', 'C84.A3', 'C84.A6', 'C84.A7', 'C84.A8', 'C84.Z0', 'C84.Z1', 'C84.Z2', 'C84.Z3', 'C84.Z4', 'C84.Z5', 'C84.Z6', 'C84.Z7', 'C84.Z8', 'C84.Z9', 'C86.0', 'C86.1', 'C86.2', 'C86.3', 'C86.5', 'C86.6') GROUP BY CC_MRN, CLM_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK ) , PATH AS (SELECT P.*, UPPER(DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)CYTOLOGIC DIAGNOSIS: [\w\W]*(?=ADEQUACY ASSESSMENT:)', TXT)) AS CYTOLOGIC_DIAGNOSIS1, UPPER(DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)CYTOLOGIC DIAGNOSIS: [\w\W]*(?=STATEMENT OF ADEQUACY:)', TXT)) AS CYTOLOGIC_DIAGNOSIS2, POSITION('DIAGNOSIS:', TXT, CODEUNITS32) AS DX_POS1 FROM (SELECT DISTINCT "t1"."PT_MRN" AS "MRN", "t2"."PRPT_ACCESSION_NO" AS "Pathology Report", "t3"."DT_DTE" AS "Pathology Procedure Date", "t4"."PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_DESC" AS "Pathology Report Type", UPPER(CASE WHEN LENGTH(PRPT_REPORT) <= 15000 THEN RTRIM(CAST(SUBSTR(PRPT_REPORT, 1, 15000) AS VARCHAR(15000))) ELSE CAST(SUBSTR(PRPT_REPORT, 1, 15000) AS VARCHAR(15000)) END) AS TXT FROM DX LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V" "t1" ON "t1"."PT_MRN" = MRN LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED" "t5" ON "t1"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t5"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V" "t2" ON "t5"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t2"."PRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" "t3" ON "t2"."PRPT_PROCEDURE_DATE_ID" = "t3"."DT_DATE_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATH_RPRT_TYPE_LOOKUP" "t4" ON "t2"."PRPT_REPORT_TYPE" = "t4"."PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_CD" WHERE (("t4"."PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_DESC" IN ('Cytology-Non GYN', 'Flow Cytometry Report', 'Hematopathology Report', 'Surgical Pathology') AND CONTAINS("t2"."PRPT_REPORT", '("LUMBAR" | "CSF")') = 1) AND "t2"."PRPT_REPORT" IS NOT NULL) ) P) , X AS (SELECT PATH.*, CASE WHEN CYTOLOGIC_DIAGNOSIS1 = '' THEN CYTOLOGIC_DIAGNOSIS2 ELSE CYTOLOGIC_DIAGNOSIS1 END AS CYTOLOGIC_DIAGNOSIS, REPLACE(SUBSTRING(CAST(UPPER(TXT) AS VARCHAR(32000)), DX_POS1, 200, CODEUNITS32), ' ', '') AS DIAGNOSIS FROM PATH) , Y AS (SELECT X.* FROM X WHERE(LOCATE('POSITIVE', UPPER(CYTOLOGIC_DIAGNOSIS)) > 0 OR LOCATE('ABNORMAL T-CELL POPULATION DETECTED', UPPER(DIAGNOSIS)) > 0) AND LOCATE('NO ABNORMAL T-CELL POPULATION DETECTED', UPPER(DIAGNOSIS)) = 0) , DX2 AS (SELECT MRN AS DX_MRN, LISTAGG(COALESCE(STRIP(DX_CODE), '') || ' | ' || COALESCE(STRIP(CAST(DX_DESC AS VARCHAR(12000))), '') || ' | ' || COALESCE(STRIP(CAST(DX_DATE AS VARCHAR(12000))), '') , CHR(13) || CHR(10)) WITHIN GROUP( ORDER BY MRN, DX_DATE, DX_CODE, DX_DESC) AS CA_DX FROM DX WHERE MRN IN (SELECT MRN FROM Y) GROUP BY MRN) SELECT DISTINCT MRN, STRIP(PT_LAST_NAME) || ', ' || STRIP(PT_FIRST_NAME) AS NAME, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH AS DOB, PT_SEX AS GENDER, R.AV_DESC AS "Race", E.AV_DESC AS "Ethnicity", PT_DATE_OF_DEATH AS DOD, COALESCE(MAX(PLA_LST_APPT_DTE, PLA_LST_DSCH_DTE), PLA_LST_APPT_DTE, PLA_LST_DSCH_DTE) AS LAST_FU_DATE, CA_DX, "Pathology Report", "Pathology Procedure Date", "Pathology Report Type", CASE WHEN CYTOLOGIC_DIAGNOSIS = '' THEN DIAGNOSIS ELSE CYTOLOGIC_DIAGNOSIS END AS "Diagnosis" FROM Y JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY ON PT_MRN = PLA_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS R ON PT_RACE = R.AV_CODE AND R.AV_ELEMENT = 'RACE' LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS E ON PT_PT_ETHNICITY = E.AV_CODE AND E.AV_ELEMENT = 'PT_ETHNICITY' JOIN DX2 ON MRN = DX_MRN

prompt: Provide a list of Transplants for patients consented to 20-506
completion: WITH X AS (SELECT DISTINCT AC_MRN, AC_IRB_NO FROM IDB.ACCRUALS WHERE AC_IRB_NO IN ('20-506') AND AC_MRN not like '%ZZZZZZZZ%' ) , HCT AS (SELECT STRIP(CBM_MRN) AS MRN, STRIP(PT_LAST_NAME) || ', ' || STRIP(PT_FIRST_NAME) AS NAME, STRIP(CBM_TRANSPLANT_TYPE) AS BMT_TYPE, CBM_TRANSPLANT_DTE AS BMT_DATE FROM IDB.CRDB_BMT_MEDICINE JOIN X ON CBM_MRN = AC_MRN JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON AC_MRN = PT_MRN UNION SELECT STRIP(CBP_MRN) AS MRN, STRIP(PT_LAST_NAME) || ', ' || STRIP(PT_FIRST_NAME) AS NAME, STRIP(CBP_TRANSPLANT_TYPE) AS BMT_TYPE, CBP_TRANSPLANT_DTE AS BMT_DATE FROM IDB.CRDB_BMT_PEDIATRICS JOIN X ON CBP_MRN = AC_MRN JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON AC_MRN = PT_MRN) SELECT * FROM HCT

prompt: Provide a list of all thyroidectomy surgeries done at MSK from 2017-now
completion: WITH BASE AS (SELECT PBD_MRN , PT_LAST_NAME , PT_FIRST_NAME , PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH , PBD_SVC_DTE , PBC_CPT_CD , CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK , DOC_NAME FROM IDB.PBD_DTL JOIN IDB.PBD_CODE ON PBD_PBD_CD = PBC_PBD_CD JOIN IDB.CLM ON PBC_CPT_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.PBD_INVOICE ON PBD_INV_NO = PBI_INV_NO JOIN IDB.DOC ON PBI_PERFORM_DR_NO = DOC_DR_NO JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PBD_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE YEAR(PBD_SVC_DTE) >= 2017 AND PBC_CPT_CD IN ('60254', '60500', '60271', '60252', '60502', '60260', '60240') ) , CYT AS (SELECT PRPT_MRN CYT_MRN , PRPT_PROCEDURE_DTE NON_GYN_CYT_DTE , PRPT_REPORT NON_GYN_CYT_REPORT FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V JOIN BASE ON PRPT_MRN = PBD_MRN WHERE PRPT_REPORT_TYPE_DESC = 'Cytology-Non GYN' AND PRPT_PROCEDURE_DTE < PBD_SVC_DTE ) , PTH AS (SELECT PRPT_MRN , PRPT_PROCEDURE_DTE , PRPT_REPORT FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V JOIN BASE ON PRPT_MRN = PBD_MRN WHERE PRPT_REPORT_TYPE_DESC = 'Surgical Pathology' AND PRPT_PROCEDURE_DTE = PBD_SVC_DTE ) SELECT PBD_MRN MRN , PT_LAST_NAME , PT_FIRST_NAME , PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH DOB , PBD_SVC_DTE PROC_DTE , PBC_CPT_CD CPT_CODE , CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK CPT_DESC , DOC_NAME SURGEON , PRPT_REPORT SURG_PTH_REPORT , NON_GYN_CYT_DTE , NON_GYN_CYT_REPORT FROM BASE LEFT JOIN PTH ON PBD_MRN = PRPT_MRN AND PBD_SVC_DTE = PRPT_PROCEDURE_DTE LEFT JOIN CYT ON PBD_MRN = CYT_MRN AND NON_GYN_CYT_DTE < PBD_SVC_DTE

prompt: Provide a list of all cases of surgical submitted slides (slide review performed for second opinion pathology review at MSKCC) by procedural dermatologists at MSKCC.
completion: SELECT DISTINCT PRPT_MRN AS MRN, PRPT_REPORT_DTE AS "Report Date", PRPT_ORD_DR_NAME AS "Provider Name", PRPT_ORD_DR_SVC_DESC AS "Provider Service Description", PRPT_REPORT_TYPE_DESC AS "Report Type Description", PRPT_ACCESSION_NO AS "Accession Number", VARCHAR(PRPT_REPORT, 32000) AS "Report Text" FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V WHERE PRPT_REPORT IS NOT NULL AND PRPT_REPORT_DTE BETWEEN '2022-01-01' AND '2022-12-31' AND PRPT_REPORT_TYPE_DESC = 'Surgical Submitted Slides' AND PRPT_ORD_DR_NAME IN ('CONNOLLY MD,KAREN L', 'NEHAL MD,KISHWER S.', 'LEE MD,ERICA', 'ROSSI MD,ANTHONY M', 'CHEN MD,CHIH-SHAN J', 'WANG MD,STEVEN Q') ORDER BY PRPT_MRN

prompt: Please re-run query SKI29326 with additional cpt codes
completion: WITH DX AS (SELECT DISTINCT TM_MRN, CASE WHEN PT_DATE_OF_DEATH IS NULL THEN YEAR(CURRENT date - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) END AS AGE, G.AV_DESC AS GENDER, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH AS "Date of Birth", PT_DATE_OF_DEATH AS "Date of Death", R.AV_DESC AS RACE, E.AV_DESC AS ETHNICITY, TM_DX_DTE, TM_HIST_CD, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS HIST_DESC, TM_SITE_CD, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_DESC, TM_CLIN_TNM_T AS "Clinical T Stage", TM_CLIN_TNM_N AS "Clinical N Stage", TM_CLIN_TNM_M AS "Clinical M Stage", TM_CLIN_STG_GRP AS "Clinical Group Stage", TM_PATH_TNM_T AS "Pathologic T Stage", TM_PATH_TNM_N AS "Pathologic N Stage", TM_PATH_TNM_M AS "Pathologic M Stage", TM_PATH_STG_GRP AS "Pathologic Group Stage" FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON TM_MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS R ON R.AV_ELEMENT = 'RACE' AND R.AV_CODE = PT_RACE LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS G ON G.AV_ELEMENT = 'SEX' AND G.AV_CODE = PT_SEX LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS E ON E.AV_ELEMENT = 'PT_ETHNICITY' AND E.AV_CODE = PT_PT_ETHNICITY WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND TM_HIST_CD IN ('M9500/3', 'M8970/3', 'M9195/3', 'M9182/3', 'M9187/3', 'M9192/3', 'M8960/3') AND CASE WHEN PT_DATE_OF_DEATH IS NULL THEN YEAR(CURRENT date - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) END <= '18' AND TM_DX_DTE BETWEEN '2021-01-01' AND '2023-12-31' ) SELECT DISTINCT TM_MRN MRN, AGE, GENDER, "Date of Birth", "Date of Death", RACE, ETHNICITY, TM_DX_DTE AS "Tumor Diagnosis Date", TM_HIST_CD AS "Histology Code", HIST_DESC AS "Histology Description", TM_SITE_CD AS "Site Code", SITE_DESC AS "Site Description", "Clinical T Stage", "Clinical N Stage", "Clinical M Stage", "Clinical Group Stage", "Pathologic T Stage", "Pathologic N Stage", "Pathologic M Stage", "Pathologic Group Stage" FROM DX ORDER BY TM_MRN ; WITH DX AS (SELECT DISTINCT TM_MRN, CASE WHEN PT_DATE_OF_DEATH IS NULL THEN YEAR(CURRENT date - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) END AS AGE, G.AV_DESC AS GENDER, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH AS "Date of Birth", PT_DATE_OF_DEATH AS "Date of Death", R.AV_DESC AS RACE, E.AV_DESC AS ETHNICITY, TM_DX_DTE, TM_HIST_CD, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS HIST_DESC, TM_SITE_CD, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_DESC, TM_CLIN_TNM_T AS "Clinical T Stage", TM_CLIN_TNM_N AS "Clinical N Stage", TM_CLIN_TNM_M AS "Clinical M Stage", TM_CLIN_STG_GRP AS "Clinical Group Stage", TM_PATH_TNM_T AS "Pathologic T Stage", TM_PATH_TNM_N AS "Pathologic N Stage", TM_PATH_TNM_M AS "Pathologic M Stage", TM_PATH_STG_GRP AS "Pathologic Group Stage" FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON TM_MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS R ON R.AV_ELEMENT = 'RACE' AND R.AV_CODE = PT_RACE LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS G ON G.AV_ELEMENT = 'SEX' AND G.AV_CODE = PT_SEX LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS E ON E.AV_ELEMENT = 'PT_ETHNICITY' AND E.AV_CODE = PT_PT_ETHNICITY WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND TM_HIST_CD IN ('M9500/3', 'M8970/3', 'M9195/3', 'M9182/3', 'M9187/3', 'M9192/3', 'M8960/3') AND CASE WHEN PT_DATE_OF_DEATH IS NULL THEN YEAR(CURRENT date - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) END <= '18' AND TM_DX_DTE BETWEEN '2021-01-01' AND '2023-12-31' ), SURG AS (SELECT DISTINCT SSE_MRN MRN, SSE_SURG_DTE AS "Surgery Date", SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD AS "Surgery CPT Code", SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC AS "Surgery CPT Description", SSP_SURG_SVC_CD AS "Surgery Service Group" FROM DX JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT ON TM_MRN = SSE_MRN JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE ON SSE_LOG_ID = SSP_LOG_ID AND SSE_ENC_CSN_ID = SSP_ENC_CSN_ID ) SELECT * FROM SURG ORDER BY MRN ;

prompt: Hello, we would like a weekly list of potentially eligible patients
completion: WITH MAIN AS (SELECT CC_MRN, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH "DATE OF BIRTH", PLA_LST_SURG_DTE, PLA_LST_RT_DTE, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS MIN_ICD_EFF_DTE, CC_CLSF_CD AS ICD_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS ICD_DESC FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PT_MRN = CC_MRN JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY ON PT_MRN = PLA_MRN WHERE CC_CLSF_CD IN ('C79.2', 'C44.501') AND CC_MRN IN (SELECT CC_MRN FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE (CC_CLSF_CD like ('C50%') OR CC_CLSF_CD like ('D05%')) ) AND CASE WHEN CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y' AND CC_PT_TYPE <> 'E' THEN 'Y' WHEN CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' AND YEAR(CC_EFF_DTE) < 2004 THEN 'Y' WHEN CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND YEAR(CC_EFF_DTE) < 2001 THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END = 'Y' GROUP BY CC_MRN, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, PLA_LST_SURG_DTE, PLA_LST_RT_DTE, CC_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK HAVING MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) BETWEEN CURRENT date - 7 DAY AND CURRENT date), PRIM_ONC AS (SELECT CPE_MRN PRIM_ONC_MRN, TRIM(CRE_RES_NAME) AS CRE_RES_NAME FROM (SELECT CPE_MRN, CRE_RES_NAME FROM MAIN JOIN IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER ON CC_MRN = CPE_MRN AND CPE_ENC_DTE = MIN_ICD_EFF_DTE JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') GROUP BY CPE_MRN, CRE_RES_NAME ) A ) SELECT DISTINCT CC_MRN, "DATE OF BIRTH", MIN_ICD_EFF_DTE, ICD_CD, ICD_DESC, PLA_LST_SURG_DTE "LAST SURGERY DATE", PLA_LST_RT_DTE "LAST RADIATION DATE", CRE_RES_NAME "Physician Name" FROM MAIN LEFT JOIN PRIM_ONC ON CC_MRN = PRIM_ONC_MRN ; WITH MAIN AS (SELECT CC_MRN, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH "DATE OF BIRTH", PLA_LST_SURG_DTE, PLA_LST_RT_DTE, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS MIN_ICD_EFF_DTE, CC_CLSF_CD AS ICD_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS ICD_DESC FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PT_MRN = CC_MRN JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY ON PT_MRN = PLA_MRN WHERE CC_CLSF_CD IN ('C79.2', 'C44.501') AND CC_MRN IN (SELECT CC_MRN FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE (CC_CLSF_CD like ('C50%') OR CC_CLSF_CD like ('D05%')) ) AND CASE WHEN CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y' AND CC_PT_TYPE <> 'E' THEN 'Y' WHEN CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' AND YEAR(CC_EFF_DTE) < 2004 THEN 'Y' WHEN CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND YEAR(CC_EFF_DTE) < 2001 THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END = 'Y' GROUP BY CC_MRN, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, PLA_LST_SURG_DTE, PLA_LST_RT_DTE, CC_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK HAVING MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) BETWEEN CURRENT date - 7 DAY AND CURRENT date) SELECT DISTINCT APR_MRN, CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME, APR_START_DTE, APR_END_DTE, APR_ROUTE FROM MAIN JOIN IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX_V ON CC_MRN = APR_MRN WHERE CDG_CHEMO_FLAG = 'Y' ;

prompt: Weekly report of Glucose, Whole Blood, Glucose, Plasma and Fingerstick Insulin orders including order set and order summary
completion: SELECT OO_MRN MRN , OO_PERFORMED_DT PERFORMED_DT, LR_PERFORMED_DT SPECIMEN_COLLECTION, OO_ORD_STS_CD ORDER_STATUS, OO_ORD_ID ORDER_ID, OO_ORD_NAME ORDER_NAME, LR_RESULT_VALUE RESULT_VALUE, LR_UNIT_MEASURE UOM, OO_REQ_TME_PRIO TIME_PRIO, OP_DISPLAY_NAME ATTENDING, OP_DISCIPLINE, OP_PROV_TYPE ATTENDING_ROLE, DOC_NAME REQUESTED_BY , DOC_ACDMC_SVC REQUESTED_BY_SVC, OL_LOC_NAME PATIENT_LOCATION, OS_SVC_GRP_CD SVC_GROUP, OS_SVC_DESC SVC_DESC FROM IDB.OMS_ORDER JOIN IDB.LAB_RESULTS ON OO_MRN = LR_MRN AND OO_ORD_GUID = LR_ORD_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_CLIENT_VISIT ON OO_VISIT_GUID = OCV_VISIT_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_PROVIDER ON OCV_ATT_PVDR_GUID = OP_PVDR_GUID JOIN IDB.DOC ON OO_REQ_DR_NO = DOC_DR_NO JOIN IDB.OMS_SERVICE ON OCV_SVC_GUID = OS_SVC_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_VISIT_LOCATION ON OVL_VISIT_GUID = OCV_VISIT_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_LOCATION ON OVL_LOC_GUID = OL_LOC_GUID WHERE OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT date - 7 DAY AND CURRENT date - 1 DAY AND OO_ORD_STS_CD like 'RE%' AND(UPPER(LR_TEST_NAME) like '%GLUCOSE%' OR UPPER(LR_SUBTEST_NAME) like '%GLUCOSE%') AND OVL_VISIT_LOC_GUID = (SELECT MAX(OVL_VISIT_LOC_GUID) FROM IDB.OMS_VISIT_LOCATION WHERE OVL_VISIT_GUID = OO_VISIT_GUID AND LR_PERFORMED_DT BETWEEN OVL_EFF_DT AND OVL_CHNG_DT) ; SELECT OO_MRN MRN, CASE WHEN (OO_ORD_NAME) = 'Fingerstick/Blood Glucose' THEN 'Fingerstick' WHEN (OO_ORD_NAME) LIKE 'Insulin INJ%' OR (OO_ORD_NAME) LIKE 'Insulin Pump%' OR (OO_ORD_NAME) LIKE 'Insulin REGULAR%' THEN 'Insulin Regular' WHEN (OO_ORD_NAME) LIKE 'Insulin Sliding Scal%' THEN 'Insulin Sliding Scale' END ORDER_GRP, OO_ORD_ID ORDERID, OO_ORD_NAME ORDNAME, OO_SET_NAME SETNAME, OO_SUMMARY_LINE SUMMARY_LINE, OOTO_SIGNIFIC_DT "Performed DT", OOTO_TASK_DOSE DOSE, OOTO_TASK_UOM UOM , OUO_REQ_TME_PRIO TIME_PRIO, OUO_PVDR_NAME REQUESTED_BY, OUO_PVDR_ROLE_TYPE REQUESTEDBY_ROLE, OP_DISPLAY_NAME ATTENDING, OP_DISCIPLINE, OP_PROV_TYPE ATTENDING_ROLE, OP_DISPLAY_NAME, OP_DISCIPLINE, OP_TASK_ROLE_TYPE, OL_LOC_NAME PATIENT_LOCATION, OS_SVC_GRP_CD SERVICE_GROUP, OS_SVC_DESC SERVICE_DESC FROM IDB.OAS_ORD_TASK_OCCR JOIN IDB.OMS_USER_ORDERS ON OOTO_ORD_GUID = OUO_ORD_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_ORDER ON OOTO_ORD_GUID = OO_ORD_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_CLIENT_VISIT ON OO_VISIT_GUID = OCV_VISIT_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_PROVIDER ON OCV_ATT_PVDR_GUID = OP_PVDR_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_SERVICE ON OCV_SVC_GUID = OS_SVC_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_VISIT_LOCATION ON OVL_VISIT_GUID = OCV_VISIT_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_LOCATION ON OVL_LOC_GUID = OL_LOC_GUID JOIN IDB.OAS_CTLG_ITEM_TASK ON OOTO_CAT_ITEM_GUID = OCIT_GUID AND OCIT_LEVEL_NO = 0 WHERE OOTO_SIGNIFIC_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT date - 7 DAY AND CURRENT date - 1 DAY AND OOTO_STATUS_CD = 'Performed' AND (UPPER(OO_ORD_NAME) LIKE '%INSULIN%' OR UPPER(OO_ORD_NAME) LIKE 'FINGERSTICK%') AND OVL_VISIT_LOC_GUID = (SELECT MAX(OVL_VISIT_LOC_GUID) FROM IDB.OMS_VISIT_LOCATION WHERE OVL_VISIT_GUID = OO_VISIT_GUID AND OOTO_SIGNIFIC_DT BETWEEN OVL_EFF_DT AND OVL_CHNG_DT) ORDER BY OO_MRN, OOTO_SIGNIFIC_DT , CASE WHEN (OO_ORD_NAME) = 'Fingerstick/Blood Glucose' THEN 'Fingerstick' WHEN (OO_ORD_NAME) LIKE 'Insulin INJ%' OR (OO_ORD_NAME) LIKE 'Insulin Pump%' OR (OO_ORD_NAME) LIKE 'Insulin REGULAR%' THEN 'Insulin Regular' WHEN (OO_ORD_NAME) LIKE 'Insulin Sliding Scal%' THEN 'Insulin Sliding Scale' END;

prompt: Patients with a diagnosis of Extramammary Paget's Disease (EMPD) that are scheduled for a surgical procedure within the next 14 days
completion: WITH SRG AS (SELECT OC_MRN "MRN", PT_LAST_NAME "Last Name", PT_FIRST_NAME "First Name", PT_BIRTH_DTE "Date of Birth", PT_RACE_DESC "Race", PT_SEX_DESC "Sex", OC_REC_CR_DTE "Procedure Scheduled Date", OC_SURG_DTE SURG_DTE, LOC_LOC_NAME SRG_LOCATION, CPX_PROC_CD CPT_CODE, CPX_PROC_NAME PROC_NAME, OCAS_SURG_SVC SURG_SVC FROM IDB.OR_CASE JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V" ON "PT_MRN" = OC_MRN JOIN IDB.OR_CASE_ALL_PROC ON OC_CASE_ID = OCAP_CASE_ID JOIN IDB.OR_CASE_ALL_SURG ON OCAP_CASE_ID = OCAS_CASE_ID AND OCAP_PNL_NO = OCAS_PNL_NO JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON OCAS_RES_ID=CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.OR_CL_PROC ON OCAP_OR_PROC_ID= OCP_OR_PROC_ID JOIN IDB.CL_PROC CL_PROC ON OCP_PROC_ID = CPX_PROC_ID JOIN IDB.CL_LOCATION ON OC_SURG_LOC_ID = LOC_LOC_ID WHERE OC_OR_CASE_STS='Sch' AND (OC_SURG_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT DATE AND CURRENT DATe + 14 DAYS) AND OCAS_SURG_ROLE='Primary' ), CLSF AS (SELECT CC_MRN, DX_DTE, DX_CD, DX_DESC FROM (SELECT CC_MRN , DX.CC_EFF_DTE DX_DTE , DX.CC_CLSF_CD DX_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS DX_DESC , ROW_NUMBER () OVER (PARTITION BY DX.CC_MRN, DX.CC_CLSF_CD ORDER BY DX.CC_EFF_DTE) RN FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF DX JOIN SRG T1 ON T1."MRN" = CC_MRN JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'D%' AND (CC_FINALIZED_IND= 'Y' OR CC_PT_TYPE = 'I') AND CLM_CLSF_CD LIKE 'C44.59%') AS A WHERE RN = 1 ) , CHEMO AS (SELECT OO_MRN, OO_ENTER_DTE, OO_SIGNIFICANT_DT, OO_ORD_NAME, OO_SUMMARY_LINE FROM SRG JOIN IDB.OMS_ORDER ON "MRN" = OO_MRN WHERE UPPER(OO_SUMMARY_LINE)like '%PAGET%' OR UPPER(OO_SUMMARY_LINE) like '%EMPD%' OR UPPER(OO_SUMMARY_LINE) like '%EXTRAMAMMARY %' ) , PATH_DX AS (SELECT DISTINCT "t1"."PT_MRN" AS "PT_MRN", "t2"."PRPT_ACCESSION_NO" AS "Pathology Report", "t3"."DT_DTE" AS "Pathology Report Date", "t4"."PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_DESC" AS "Pathology Report Type", "t5"."DT_DTE" AS "Pathology Procedure Date" FROM SRG JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V" "t1" ON "t1"."PT_MRN" = "MRN" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED" "t6" ON "t1"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t6"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V" "t2" ON "t6"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t2"."PRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" "t3" ON "t2"."PRPT_REPORT_DATE_ID" = "t3"."DT_DATE_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATH_RPRT_TYPE_LOOKUP" "t4" ON "t2"."PRPT_REPORT_TYPE" = "t4"."PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_CD" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" "t5" ON "t2"."PRPT_PROCEDURE_DATE_ID" = "t5"."DT_DATE_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_IDENTIFICATION_MRN_V" "t7" ON "t1"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t7"."PI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" WHERE CONTAINS("t2"."PRPT_REPORT", '"EMPD" | "PAGET" | "EXTRAMAMMARY "') = 1 AND "t2"."PRPT_REPORT" IS NOT NULL AND "t1"."PT_DEATH_DTE" IS NULL ) SELECT DISTINCT "MRN", "Last Name", "First Name", "Date of Birth", "Procedure Scheduled Date", SURG_DTE "Surgery Date", CPT_CODE "CPT Code", PROC_NAME "Procedure Name", SRG_LOCATION "Surgery Location" FROM SRG LEFT JOIN PATH_DX ON "PT_MRN" = "MRN" LEFT JOIN CHEMO ON OO_MRN = "MRN" LEFT JOIN CLSF ON CC_MRN = "MRN" WHERE "PT_MRN" IS NOT NULL OR CC_MRN IS NOT NULL OR OO_MRN IS NOT NULL

prompt: Provide list of patients in Breast service Survivorship Departments who are added in clin doc transition to community data  added end Jan 2022.
completion: WITH APPTS AS (SELECT CPE_MRN, TRIM(PT_LAST_NAME) || ', ' || TRIM(PT_FIRST_NAME) AS PATIENT_NAME, TRIM(CRE_RES_NAME) AS PROVIDER_NAME, TRIM(CLD_DEPT_NAME) AS DEPARTMENT, TRIM(CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME) AS VISIT_TYPE, CPE_ENC_DTE AS APPOINTMENT_DATE FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.PATIENT P ON P.PT_MRN = CPE_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN '2022-02-01' AND CURRENT date AND CLD_DEPT_NAME IN ('BAIC 300 E66', 'CMK SURVIVORSHIP', 'NAS SURVIVORSHIP-2', 'BSK SURVIVORSHIP-4', 'MON BRE DMT-2 SVR', 'MON BRE DMT-C SVR', 'MON BRE DMT-LC SVR', 'BREAST DMT WES SVR', 'BRE MED 300 E66 SVRSHP', 'BREAST 300 E66 SVRSHP', 'BREAST DMT 300 E66 SVR') AND CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR NOT IN ('FX', 'INJ', 'TEL APP IR', 'TEL APP AFR') ) , EAD AS (SELECT EAD_MRN, EADT_EMR_DESC, A.CPE_MRN AS MRN FROM APPTS A JOIN (SELECT EAD_MRN, EADT_EMR_DESC FROM IDB.EMR_AA_DOCUMENT JOIN IDB.EMR_AA_DOCTYPE ON EAD_DOCTYPE = EADT_DOCTYPE AND VALUE(EAD_RIGHT_ID, EADT_RIGHT_ID) = 167 AND EAD_DOCTYPE = 'WB5') E ON E.EAD_MRN = A.CPE_MRN) , Q1 AS (SELECT DISTINCT CDD_MRN Q1_MRN, TRIM(CDO_ITEM_NAME) AS Q1, TRIM(CDO_VALUE_TEXT) AS Q1_VALUE FROM APPTS JOIN IDB.CD_DOCUMENT ON CDD_MRN = CPE_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION ON CDD_DOC_GUID = CDO_DOC_GUID AND CDD_AUTHORED_DTE = CDO_AUTHORED_DTE WHERE CDD_CANCEL_IND <> '1' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND <> '1' AND CDD_DOC_NAME like 'Follow Up, APP, AMB - Survivorship%' AND CDD_SERVICE_DTE >= '2022-02-01' AND CDO_SECTION = 'MEDICAL DECISION MAKING' AND CDO_ITEM_NAME ='Is patient eligible (per Breast Survivorship Guidelines) for transition of care to local PCP/Provider?' ) , Q2 AS (SELECT DISTINCT CDD_MRN Q2_MRN, TRIM(CDO_ITEM_NAME) AS Q2, TRIM(CDO_VALUE_TEXT) AS Q2_VALUE FROM APPTS JOIN IDB.CD_DOCUMENT ON CDD_MRN = CPE_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION ON CDD_DOC_GUID = CDO_DOC_GUID AND CDD_AUTHORED_DTE = CDO_AUTHORED_DTE WHERE CDD_CANCEL_IND <> '1' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND <> '1' AND CDD_DOC_NAME like 'Follow Up, APP, AMB - Survivorship%' AND CDD_SERVICE_DTE >= '2022-01-01' AND CDO_SECTION = 'MEDICAL DECISION MAKING' AND CDO_ITEM_NAME = 'Did patient accept?' ) , Q3 AS (SELECT DISTINCT CDD_MRN Q3_MRN, TRIM(CDO_ITEM_NAME) AS Q3, TRIM(CDO_VALUE_TEXT) AS Q3_VALUE FROM APPTS JOIN IDB.CD_DOCUMENT ON CDD_MRN = CPE_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION ON CDD_DOC_GUID = CDO_DOC_GUID AND CDD_AUTHORED_DTE = CDO_AUTHORED_DTE WHERE CDD_CANCEL_IND <> '1' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND <> '1' AND CDD_DOC_NAME like 'Follow Up, APP, AMB - Survivorship%' AND CDD_SERVICE_DTE >= '2022-01-01' AND CDO_SECTION = 'MEDICAL DECISION MAKING' AND CDO_ITEM_NAME = 'Reason declines' ) SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN , PATIENT_NAME , PROVIDER_NAME, DEPARTMENT, VISIT_TYPE, APPOINTMENT_DATE, CASE WHEN EAD_MRN IS NOT NULL THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS "Transition to community?" , Q1 AS QUESTION_1, Q1_VALUE AS Q_1_RESPONSE , Q2 AS QUESTION_2, Q2_VALUE AS Q_2_RESPONSE FROM APPTS A LEFT JOIN EAD E ON EAD_MRN = A.CPE_MRN LEFT JOIN Q1 ON Q1_MRN = CPE_MRN LEFT JOIN Q2 ON Q2_MRN = CPE_MRN

prompt: Provide a list of breast cancer patients with a specific string found in any pathology report.
completion: WITH CLINTRAC AS (SELECT CC_MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS MIN_ICD9_EFF_DTE, CC_CLSF_CD AS ICD9_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS ICD9_DESC FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE SUBSTR(CC_CLSF_CD, 1, 3) IN ('C50', '174', '175') AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' GROUP BY CC_MRN, CC_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK ) , CDB AS (SELECT TM_MRN, AV_DESC AS CASE_STS, TM_DX_DTE, TM_HIST_CD, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS HIST_DESC, TM_SITE_CD, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_DESC, TM_CA_SURG_DTE, TM_SYST_STRT_DTE FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS ON AV_ELEMENT = 'CASE_STS' AND AV_CODE = TM_CASE_STS AND TM_CASE_STS IN ('3', '6', '7', '8') AND TM_SITE_CD LIKE 'C50%' ) , PTS AS (SELECT CC_MRN MRN FROM CLINTRAC UNION SELECT TM_MRN MRN FROM CDB) , PATH AS (SELECT PT_MRN AS MRN, P.DT_DTE AS PATH_PROC_DTE, R.DT_DTE AS PATH_RPT_DTE, MP_FULL_NM AS ORD_PROVIDER, MP_SERVICE_DESC AS ORD_PROVIDER_SVC_DESC, PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_DESC AS PATH_RPT_TYPE, PRPT_ACCESSION_NO AS PATH_ACCESSION_NO, PRPT_REPORT AS PATH_RPT FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT JOIN DV.DATE P ON P.DT_DATE_ID = PRPT_PROCEDURE_DATE_ID JOIN DV.DATE R ON R.DT_DATE_ID = PRPT_REPORT_DATE_ID JOIN DV.PATH_RPRT_TYPE_LOOKUP ON PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_CD = PRPT_REPORT_TYPE JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON PRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID JOIN DV.MEDPRO ON PRPT_ORDERING_MEDPRO_ID = MP_MEDPRO_ID WHERE CONTAINS("PRPT_REPORT", '("perineural invasion" | "PNI" | "peri-neural invasion")') = 1 AND PRPT_REPORT IS NOT NULL ) SELECT A.MRN, PATH_ACCESSION_NO, PATH_RPT FROM PTS A JOIN PATH B ON A.MRN = B.MRN

prompt: Provide a report of covid positive patients who had both constant care active order and suicide order
completion: WITH CC AS (SELECT DISTINCT OO_MRN AS CC_MRN FROM IDB.OMS_ORDER JOIN IDB.OMS_STATUS ON OO_ORD_STS_CD = OSTS_ORD_STS_CD WHERE OO_ORD_STS_CD NOT IN ('CANP', 'CANC', 'AUC3') AND OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE BETWEEN '2020-03-01' AND '2020-06-30' AND OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID = '9000009725600730' ) , COVID AS (SELECT DISTINCT MRN, MIN_IDENTIFIED_DT, MIN_RESULT_DT FROM IDB.COVID19_PATIENT_INFO WHERE RESULT IN ('Positive', 'Resolved') ) SELECT DISTINCT OO_MRN AS MRN, CASE WHEN MRN IS NOT NULL THEN 'Y' ELSE '' END AS COVID_POSITIVE, DATE(MIN_IDENTIFIED_DT) AS COVID_IDENTIFIED, DATE(MIN_RESULT_DT) AS COVID_RESULT, OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE AS SUICIDE_START, OO_STOP_DTE AS SUICIDE_STOP, OSTS_STS_DESC AS SUICIDE_STATUS, OL_LOC_NAME AS SUICIDE_ORDER_LOCATION FROM IDB.OMS_ORDER JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_CATALOG ON OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID = OOC_MSTR_ITEM_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_STATUS ON OO_ORD_STS_CD = OSTS_ORD_STS_CD JOIN CC ON OO_MRN = CC_MRN LEFT JOIN COVID ON OO_MRN = MRN JOIN IDB.OMS_VISIT_LOCATION ON OVL_VISIT_GUID = OO_VISIT_GUID AND OVL_EFF_DT = (SELECT MAX(OVL_EFF_DT) AS MAX_OVL_EFF_DT FROM IDB.OMS_VISIT_LOCATION WHERE OVL_EFF_DT <= OO_SIGNIFICANT_DT AND OVL_VISIT_GUID = OO_VISIT_GUID) JOIN IDB.OMS_LOCATION ON OVL_LOC_GUID = OL_LOC_GUID WHERE OO_ORD_STS_CD NOT IN ('CANP', 'CANC', 'AUC3') AND OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE BETWEEN '2020-03-01' AND '2020-06-30' AND OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID = '9000006945100730' ORDER BY 1, 5

prompt: Toks/Alana Data access Views
completion: WITH PBD AS (SELECT PBD_MRN AS MRN, PBC_CPT_CD AS CPT_CODE, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS CPT_DESC, PBD_SVC_DTE AS SVC_DATE, DOC_NAME FROM IDB.PBD_DTL JOIN IDB.PBD_INVOICE ON PBD_INV_NO = PBI_INV_NO JOIN IDB.PBD_CODE ON PBD_PBD_CD = PBC_PBD_CD JOIN IDB.DOC ON PBI_PERFORM_DR_NO = DOC_DR_NO JOIN IDB.CLM ON PBC_CPT_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PBD_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE PBC_CPT_CD IN ('60200', '60210', '60212', '60220', '60225', '60240', '60245', '60246', '60252', '60254', '60260', '60261', '60270', '60271') AND PBD_SVC_DTE >= '2021-01-01'), CPT AS (SELECT MRN, CPT_CODE, CPT_DESC, SVC_DATE, DOC_NAME, 'PBD' AS SOURCE FROM PBD UNION ALL SELECT OL_MRN AS MRN, SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD AS CPT_CODE, SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC AS CPT_DESC, OL_SURG_DTE AS SVC_DATE, CRE_RES_NAME AS DOC_NAME, 'OR' AS SOURCE FROM IDB.SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE JOIN IDB.OR_LOG ON SSP_LOG_ID = OL_LOG_ID JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON SSP_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID WHERE SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD IN ('60200', '60210', '60212', '60220', '60225', '60240', '60245', '60246', '60252', '60254', '60260', '60261', '60270', '60271') AND OL_MRN NOT IN (SELECT MRN FROM PBD) AND OL_SURG_DTE >= '2021-01-01'), ICD910 AS (SELECT CC_MRN AS MRN, CC_CLSF_CD AS CPT_CODE, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS CPT_DESC, CC_EFF_DTE AS SVC_DATE, DOC_NAME FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.DOC ON CC_RESP_PARTY = DOC_DR_NO WHERE CC_CLSF_CD IN ('06.2', '06.31', '06.39', '06.4', '06.50', '06.51', '06.52', '06.6', '06.91', '06.92', '06.93', '06.94', '06.98', '0GTG0ZZ', '0GTG4ZZ', '0GTH0ZZ', '0GTH4ZZ', '0G5K0ZZ', '0G5K3ZZ', '0G5K4ZZ', '0GBG0ZZ', '0GBG3ZZ', '0GBG4ZZ', '0GBH0ZZ', '0GBH3ZZ', '0GBH4ZZ', '0GBJ0ZZ', '0GBJ3ZZ', '0GBJ4ZZ', '0GTJ0ZZ', '0GTJ4ZZ', '0GTK0ZZ', '0GTK4ZZ', '0CB70ZZ', '0G8J0ZZ', '0G8J3ZZ', '0G8J4ZZ') AND CC_CLSF_TYPE = 'PC' AND CC_EFF_DTE >= '2021-01-01'), PBD_ICD AS (SELECT MRN, CPT_CODE, CPT_DESC, SVC_DATE, DOC_NAME, 'pbd' AS SOURCE FROM CPT UNION ALL SELECT MRN, CPT_CODE, CPT_DESC, SVC_DATE, DOC_NAME, 'dia' AS SOURCE FROM ICD910), COHORT AS (SELECT MRN, PT_SEX, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, (YEAR(SVC_DATE) - YEAR(PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH)) AS AGE, DOC_NAME, SVC_DATE, CPT_DESC, CPT_CODE FROM PBD_ICD LEFT JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON MRN = PT_MRN), CH AS (SELECT DISTINCT CDD_MRN , CDD_DOC_NAME , CDO_ITEM_NAME , CDO_VALUE_TEXT FROM IDB.CD_DOCUMENT JOIN COHORT C ON CDD_MRN = C.MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION ON CDD_DOC_GUID = CDO_DOC_GUID AND CDD_AUTHORED_DTE = CDO_AUTHORED_DTE AND CDO_VALUE_TEXT <> '' WHERE CDD_DOC_NAME like ('Operative Report%') AND CDD_SERVICE_DTE = SVC_DATE AND CDD_CANCEL_IND = '0' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND = '0' AND CDO_ITEM_NAME IN ('Abnormal Neck Nodes:', 'Left Lobe Extra Extension:', 'Right Lobe Extra Extension:', 'Total Thyroidectomy:', 'Resection of Strap Muscles:', 'Recurrent Laryngeal Nerve Left:', 'Recurrent Laryngeal Nerve Right:', 'Management of Trachea:', 'Management of Larynx:', 'Management of Esophagus/Pharynx:', 'Gross Residual Disease:') ) SELECT MRN , PT_SEX , PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH , AGE , DOC_NAME , SVC_DATE , CPT_DESC , CPT_CODE , CDD_DOC_NAME "Document Name" , MAX(CASE WHEN CDO_ITEM_NAME = 'Abnormal Neck Nodes:' THEN SUBSTR(CDO_VALUE_TEXT, 1, 150) ELSE '' END) "Abnormal Neck Nodes" , MAX(CASE WHEN CDO_ITEM_NAME = 'Left Lobe Extra Extension:' THEN SUBSTR(CDO_VALUE_TEXT, 1, 150) ELSE '' END) "Left Lobe Extra Extension" , MAX(CASE WHEN CDO_ITEM_NAME = 'Right Lobe Extra Extension:' THEN SUBSTR(CDO_VALUE_TEXT, 1, 150) ELSE '' END) "Right Lobe Extra Extension" , MAX(CASE WHEN CDO_ITEM_NAME = 'Total Thyroidectomy:' THEN SUBSTR(CDO_VALUE_TEXT, 1, 150) ELSE '' END) "Total Thyroidectomy" , MAX(CASE WHEN CDO_ITEM_NAME = 'Resection of Strap Muscles:' THEN SUBSTR(CDO_VALUE_TEXT, 1, 150) ELSE '' END) "Resection of Strap Muscles" , MAX(CASE WHEN CDO_ITEM_NAME = 'Recurrent Laryngeal Nerve Left:' THEN SUBSTR(CDO_VALUE_TEXT, 1, 150) ELSE '' END) "Recurrent Laryngeal Nerve Left" , MAX(CASE WHEN CDO_ITEM_NAME = 'Management of Trachea:' THEN SUBSTR(CDO_VALUE_TEXT, 1, 150) ELSE '' END) "Management of Trachea" , MAX(CASE WHEN CDO_ITEM_NAME = 'Management of Larynx:' THEN SUBSTR(CDO_VALUE_TEXT, 1, 150) ELSE '' END) "Management of Larynx" , MAX(CASE WHEN CDO_ITEM_NAME = 'Management of Esophagus/Pharynx:' THEN SUBSTR(CDO_VALUE_TEXT, 1, 150) ELSE '' END) "Management of Esophagus/Pharynx" , MAX(CASE WHEN CDO_ITEM_NAME = 'Gross Residual Disease:' THEN SUBSTR(CDO_VALUE_TEXT, 1, 150) ELSE '' END) "Gross Residual Disease" FROM COHORT JOIN CH ON MRN = CDD_MRN GROUP BY MRN , PT_SEX , PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH , AGE , DOC_NAME , SVC_DATE , CPT_DESC , CPT_CODE , CDD_DOC_NAME ;

prompt: Provide a list of patients with keywords in their pathology reports.
completion: WITH SURGPATH AS (SELECT PRPT_MRN AS "SurgPath MRN", PRPT_ACCESSION_NO "Pathology Accession Number", PRPT_REPORT_DTE AS "Pathology Report Date", CAST(PRPT_REPORT AS VARCHAR(32000)) AS "Pathology Report" FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V WHERE PRPT_REPORT IS NOT NULL AND CONTAINS("PRPT_REPORT", '("dermoid" OR "teratoma")') = 1 AND CONTAINS("PRPT_REPORT", '("carcinoma" OR "sarcoma")') = 1 AND PRPT_REPORT_DTE BETWEEN '2008-01-01' AND '2023-09-01' ) , RADIOLOGY AS (SELECT DISTINCT RRPT_MRN AS "Radiology MRN", RRPT_ACCESSION_NO AS "Radiology Accession Number", RRPT_PROCEDURE_NAME AS "Radiology Procedure Name", RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE AS "Radiology Performed Date", CAST(RRPT_REPORT_TXT AS VARCHAR(32000)) AS "Radiology Report Text" FROM DV.RADIOLOGY_REPORT_V RRV JOIN SURGPATH ON "SurgPath MRN" = RRPT_MRN WHERE RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE BETWEEN '2008-01-01' AND '2023-09-01' ) , CANREG AS (SELECT DISTINCT TM_MRN "Tumor MRN", TM_DX_DTE "Tumor Diagnosis Date", TM_HIST_CD "Tumor Histology Code", H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS "Tumor Histology Description", TM_SITE_CD "Tumor Site Code", S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS "Tumor Site Description" FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD JOIN SURGPATH ON "SurgPath MRN" = TM_MRN WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND TM_DX_DTE BETWEEN '2008-01-01' AND '2023-09-01' ) SELECT IPV.PT_MRN AS "MRN", IPV.PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH AS "Date of Birth", IPV.PT_SEX AS "Sex Assigned at Birth", CASE WHEN IPV.PT_DATE_OF_DEATH IS NOT NULL THEN 'Deceased' ELSE 'Alive' END AS "Vital Status", IPV.PT_DATE_OF_DEATH AS "Date of Death", "Pathology Accession Number", "Pathology Report Date", "Pathology Report" FROM SURGPATH JOIN IDB.PATIENT_V IPV ON "SurgPath MRN" = PT_MRN WHERE PT_SEX = 'F' ! WITH SURGPATH AS (SELECT PRPT_MRN AS "SurgPath MRN", PRPT_ACCESSION_NO "Pathology Accession Number", PRPT_REPORT_DTE AS "Pathology Report Date", CAST(PRPT_REPORT AS VARCHAR(32000)) AS "Pathology Report" FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V WHERE PRPT_REPORT IS NOT NULL AND CONTAINS("PRPT_REPORT", '("dermoid" OR "teratoma")') = 1 AND CONTAINS("PRPT_REPORT", '("carcinoma" OR "sarcoma")') = 1 AND PRPT_REPORT_DTE BETWEEN '2008-01-01' AND '2023-09-01' ) , RADIOLOGY AS (SELECT DISTINCT RRPT_MRN AS "Radiology MRN", RRPT_ACCESSION_NO AS "Radiology Accession Number", RRPT_PROCEDURE_NAME AS "Radiology Procedure Name", RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE AS "Radiology Performed Date", CAST(RRPT_REPORT_TXT AS VARCHAR(32000)) AS "Radiology Report Text" FROM DV.RADIOLOGY_REPORT_V RRV JOIN SURGPATH ON "SurgPath MRN" = RRPT_MRN WHERE RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE BETWEEN '2008-01-01' AND '2023-09-01' ) , CANREG AS (SELECT DISTINCT TM_MRN "Tumor MRN", TM_DX_DTE "Tumor Diagnosis Date", TM_HIST_CD "Tumor Histology Code", H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS "Tumor Histology Description", TM_SITE_CD "Tumor Site Code", S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS "Tumor Site Description" FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD JOIN SURGPATH ON "SurgPath MRN" = TM_MRN WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND TM_DX_DTE BETWEEN '2008-01-01' AND '2023-09-01' ) SELECT DISTINCT IPV.PT_MRN AS "MRN", IPV.PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH AS "Date of Birth", IPV.PT_SEX AS "Sex Assigned at Birth", CASE WHEN IPV.PT_DATE_OF_DEATH IS NOT NULL THEN 'Deceased' ELSE 'Alive' END AS "Vital Status", IPV.PT_DATE_OF_DEATH AS "Date of Death", "Radiology Accession Number", "Radiology Procedure Name", "Radiology Performed Date", "Radiology Report Text" FROM SURGPATH JOIN IDB.PATIENT_V IPV ON "SurgPath MRN" = PT_MRN JOIN RADIOLOGY ON "SurgPath MRN" = "Radiology MRN" WHERE PT_SEX = 'F' ! WITH SURGPATH AS (SELECT PRPT_MRN AS "SurgPath MRN", PRPT_ACCESSION_NO "Pathology Accession Number", PRPT_REPORT_DTE AS "Pathology Report Date", CAST(PRPT_REPORT AS VARCHAR(32000)) AS "Pathology Report" FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V WHERE PRPT_REPORT IS NOT NULL AND CONTAINS("PRPT_REPORT", '("dermoid" OR "teratoma")') = 1 AND CONTAINS("PRPT_REPORT", '("carcinoma" OR "sarcoma")') = 1 AND PRPT_REPORT_DTE BETWEEN '2008-01-01' AND '2023-09-01' ) , RADIOLOGY AS (SELECT DISTINCT RRPT_MRN AS "Radiology MRN", RRPT_ACCESSION_NO AS "Radiology Accession Number", RRPT_PROCEDURE_NAME AS "Radiology Procedure Name", RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE AS "Radiology Performed Date", CAST(RRPT_REPORT_TXT AS VARCHAR(32000)) AS "Radiology Report Text" FROM DV.RADIOLOGY_REPORT_V RRV JOIN SURGPATH ON "SurgPath MRN" = RRPT_MRN WHERE RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE BETWEEN '2008-01-01' AND '2023-09-01' ) , CANREG AS (SELECT DISTINCT TM_MRN "Tumor MRN", TM_DX_DTE "Tumor Diagnosis Date", TM_HIST_CD "Tumor Histology Code", H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS "Tumor Histology Description", TM_SITE_CD "Tumor Site Code", S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS "Tumor Site Description" FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD JOIN SURGPATH ON "SurgPath MRN" = TM_MRN WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND TM_DX_DTE BETWEEN '2008-01-01' AND '2023-09-01' ) SELECT DISTINCT IPV.PT_MRN AS "MRN", IPV.PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH AS "Date of Birth", IPV.PT_SEX AS "Sex Assigned at Birth", CASE WHEN IPV.PT_DATE_OF_DEATH IS NOT NULL THEN 'Deceased' ELSE 'Alive' END AS "Vital Status", IPV.PT_DATE_OF_DEATH AS "Date of Death", "Tumor Diagnosis Date", "Tumor Histology Description", "Tumor Histology Code", "Tumor Site Code", "Tumor Site Description" FROM SURGPATH JOIN IDB.PATIENT_V IPV ON "SurgPath MRN" = PT_MRN JOIN CANREG ON "SurgPath MRN" = "Tumor MRN" WHERE PT_SEX = 'F'

prompt: Provide Full report path for liver cancer patients under ICB
completion: WITH DX AS (SELECT DISTINCT CC_MRN AS DX_MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS DX_DTE, CC_CLSF_CD AS ICD_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS ICD_DESC FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE CC_CLSF_CD IN ('C22.0') AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND (CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) GROUP BY CC_MRN, CC_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK ), APR AS (SELECT DISTINCT APR_MRN, APR_START_DTE, APR_END_DTE, APR_GENERIC_NAME FROM DX JOIN IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX ON DX_MRN = APR_MRN WHERE APR_GENERIC_NAME IN ('BOTENSILIMAB', 'TREMELIMUMAB', 'RELATLIMAB', 'BALSTILIMAB', 'NIVOLUMAB', 'PEMBROLIZUMAB', 'ATEZOLIZUMAB', 'DURVALUMAB') ) , PATH AS (SELECT DISTINCT PRPT_MRN PATH_MRN, PRPT_REPORT_DTE, PRPT_ACCESSION_NO, PRPT_REPORT_TYPE_DESC, VARCHAR(PRPT_REPORT, 32000) AS REPORT_TEXT FROM APR JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V ON APR_MRN = PRPT_MRN WHERE PRPT_REPORT IS NOT NULL ) SELECT DISTINCT PATH_MRN AS MRN, PRPT_REPORT_DTE AS "Pathology Report Date", PRPT_ACCESSION_NO AS "Accession Number", PRPT_REPORT_TYPE_DESC AS "Pathology Report Type Desc", CASE WHEN UPPER(REPORT_TEXT) LIKE '%FIBROSIS%' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS "Fibrosis Indicator(Y/N)", CASE WHEN UPPER(REPORT_TEXT) LIKE '%CIRRHOSIS%' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS "Cirrhosis Indicator(Y/N)", CASE WHEN UPPER(REPORT_TEXT) LIKE '%STEATOSIS%' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS "Steatosis Indicator(Y/N)", CASE WHEN UPPER(REPORT_TEXT) LIKE '%BEVACIZUMAB%' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS "BEVACIZUMAB Indicator(Y/N)", REPORT_TEXT AS "Report Text" FROM PATH ORDER BY PATH_MRN, PRPT_REPORT_DTE

prompt: Provide a report on patients who had an MR/CT/PET and were administered either Lorazepam, Diazepam, Hydromorphone or Morphine either within 90 minutes of the start of the scan or during the scan.
completion: WITH RIS AS (SELECT DISTINCT "t1"."PT_MRN" AS MRN, RRPT_ORDER_GUID AS ORD_GUID, RRPT_ORDER_ID, "t2"."RRPT_ACCESSION_NO" AS "Radiology Accession Number", "t2"."RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE" AS "Radiology Performed Date", "t2"."RRPT_PERFORMED_DT" AS "Radiology Performed Datetime", "t2"."RRPT_ORDER_GROUP" AS "Radiology Order Group", "t2"."RRPT_PROCEDURE_NAME" AS "Radiology Procedure Name" FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V" "t1" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED" "t3" ON "t1"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t3"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."RADIOLOGY_REPORT_V" "t2" ON "t3"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t2"."RRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_IDENTIFICATION_MRN_V" "t4" ON "t1"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t4"."PI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" WHERE 1=1 AND("t2"."RRPT_ORDER_GROUP" LIKE '%MR%' OR "t2"."RRPT_ORDER_GROUP" LIKE '%CT%' OR "t2"."RRPT_ORDER_GROUP" LIKE '%PET%') AND "t2"."RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE" >= '2018-01-01' ) , X AS (SELECT MRN, ORD_GUID, "Radiology Accession Number", "Radiology Performed Date", "Radiology Performed Datetime", "Radiology Order Group", "Radiology Procedure Name" , OUO_IP_OP_IND , MAX(CASE WHEN OMH_TO_VALUE = 'In Progress' AND (DATE(OMH_CREATE_DT) = "Radiology Performed Date" OR (DATE(OMH_CREATE_DT) = "Radiology Performed Date" - 1 DAY AND TIME(OMH_CREATE_DT) >= '22:00:00')) THEN OMH_CREATE_DT END) RIS_START_DT , MAX(CASE WHEN OMH_TO_VALUE = 'Completed' THEN OMH_CREATE_DT END) RIS_END_DT FROM RIS LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_MOD_HX ON OMH_ORD_GUID = ORD_GUID LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_USER_ORDERS ON OUO_ORD_GUID = ORD_GUID GROUP BY MRN, ORD_GUID, "Radiology Accession Number", "Radiology Performed Date", "Radiology Performed Datetime", "Radiology Order Group", "Radiology Procedure Name" , OUO_IP_OP_IND) , Y AS (SELECT X.*, TIMESTAMPDIFF(4, CHAR("Radiology Performed Datetime" - RIS_START_DT)) AS SCAN_DURATION FROM X) , PRE_SCAN AS (SELECT DISTINCT MRN, "Radiology Accession Number" , OO_ORD_NAME, OOTO_SIGNIFIC_DTE, OOTO_SIGNIFIC_DT, OMD_ORD_ROUTE , OMD_DOSE_LOW AS "Dose", OMD_DOSE_UNIT AS "Unit" , TIMESTAMPDIFF(4, CHAR(RIS_START_DT - OOTO_SIGNIFIC_DT)) AS MINS_PRE_SCAN FROM Y JOIN IDB.OMS_ORDER ON MRN = OO_MRN AND OO_ORD_STS_CD NOT IN ('CANC', 'CANP', 'AUC3') AND(UPPER(OO_ORD_NAME) LIKE '%LORAZEPAM%' OR UPPER(OO_ORD_NAME) LIKE '%DIAZEPAM%' OR UPPER(OO_ORD_NAME) LIKE '%HYDROMORPHONE%' OR UPPER(OO_ORD_NAME) LIKE '%MORPHINE%') JOIN IDB.OMS_MED_DETAIL ON OO_ORD_GUID = OMD_ORD_GUID JOIN IDB.OAS_ORD_TASK_OCCR ON OOTO_ORD_GUID = OO_ORD_GUID AND OOTO_STATUS_CD = 'Performed' AND(TIMESTAMPDIFF(4, CHAR(RIS_START_DT - OOTO_SIGNIFIC_DT)) BETWEEN 0 AND 90) JOIN IDB.OAS_CTLG_ITEM_TASK ON OOTO_CAT_ITEM_GUID = OCIT_GUID AND OCIT_LEVEL_NO = 0 WHERE OO_ORD_NAME NOT IN ('diAZEpam (C-IV) Oral Solution', 'EXALGO (HYDROmorphone) (C-II) Extended Release', 'HYDROmorphone (C-II)', 'HYDROmorphone Epidural PCA 16 mcg/mL + Bupivacaine PF 0.05%, 250 mL', 'HYDROmorphone Epidural PCA 4 mcg/mL + Bupivacaine PF 0.075%, 250 mL', 'HYDROmorphone Epidural PCA 8 mcg/mL + Bupivacaine PF 0.035%, 250 mL', 'HYDROmorphone Epidural PCA 8 mcg/mL + Bupivacaine PF 0.05%, 250 mL', 'HYDROmorphone Epidural PCA 8 mcg/mL, 250 mL', 'HYDROmorphone IV PCA', 'HYDROmorphone IV PCA (UNRESTRICTED)', 'HYDROmorphone IVCI', 'LORazepam (C-IV)', 'LORazepam IVCI in NS (C-IV)', 'avinza (morphine Extended Release)', 'Kadian (morphine Extended Release)', 'Morphine Sulfate Immediate Release', 'Morphine Sulfate IV PCA', 'Morphine Sulfate IV PCA (UNRESTRICTED)', 'morphine sulfate Oral solution', 'morphine sulfate solution (CONCENTRATE)', 'MS Contin (Morphine Extended Release)', 'Opium Tincture (morphine 10 mg/mL) (C-II)') ) , Z AS (SELECT Y.* , CASE WHEN UPPER(OO_ORD_NAME) LIKE '%DIAZEPAM%' THEN 'DIAZEPAM' WHEN UPPER(OO_ORD_NAME) LIKE '%HYDROMORPHONE%' THEN 'HYDROMORPHONE' WHEN UPPER(OO_ORD_NAME) LIKE '%LORAZEPAM%' THEN 'LORAZEPAM' WHEN UPPER(OO_ORD_NAME) LIKE '%MORPHINE%' THEN 'MORPHINE' END AS DRUG , OO_ORD_NAME, OOTO_SIGNIFIC_DTE, OOTO_SIGNIFIC_DT, OMD_ORD_ROUTE , "Dose", "Unit" , MINS_PRE_SCAN FROM Y LEFT JOIN PRE_SCAN ON Y."Radiology Accession Number" = PRE_SCAN."Radiology Accession Number") SELECT DRUG, "Radiology Order Group", COUNT(DISTINCT "Radiology Accession Number") AS SCAN_COUNT, COUNT(DISTINCT MRN) AS MRN_COUNT FROM Z GROUP BY DRUG, "Radiology Order Group" , DURING_SCAN AS (SELECT DISTINCT Y.* , OO_ORD_NAME, OOTO_SIGNIFIC_DTE, OOTO_SIGNIFIC_DT, OMD_ORD_ROUTE , OMD_DOSE_LOW AS "Dose", OMD_DOSE_UNIT AS "Unit" FROM Y JOIN IDB.OMS_ORDER ON MRN = OO_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_MED_DETAIL ON OO_ORD_GUID = OMD_ORD_GUID JOIN IDB.OAS_ORD_TASK_OCCR ON OOTO_ORD_GUID = OO_ORD_GUID AND OOTO_STATUS_CD = 'Performed' JOIN IDB.OAS_CTLG_ITEM_TASK ON OOTO_CAT_ITEM_GUID = OCIT_GUID AND OCIT_LEVEL_NO = 0 WHERE OO_ORD_STS_CD NOT IN ('CANC', 'CANP', 'AUC3') AND(UPPER(OO_ORD_NAME) LIKE '%LORAZEPAM%' OR UPPER(OO_ORD_NAME) LIKE '%DIAZEPAM%' OR UPPER(OO_ORD_NAME) LIKE '%HYDROMORPHONE%' OR UPPER(OO_ORD_NAME) LIKE '%MORPHINE%') AND OOTO_SIGNIFIC_DT BETWEEN RIS_START_DT AND "Radiology Performed Datetime" AND OO_ORD_NAME NOT IN ('diAZEpam (C-IV) Oral Solution', 'EXALGO (HYDROmorphone) (C-II) Extended Release', 'HYDROmorphone (C-II)', 'HYDROmorphone Epidural PCA 16 mcg/mL + Bupivacaine PF 0.05%, 250 mL', 'HYDROmorphone Epidural PCA 4 mcg/mL + Bupivacaine PF 0.075%, 250 mL', 'HYDROmorphone Epidural PCA 8 mcg/mL + Bupivacaine PF 0.035%, 250 mL', 'HYDROmorphone Epidural PCA 8 mcg/mL + Bupivacaine PF 0.05%, 250 mL', 'HYDROmorphone Epidural PCA 8 mcg/mL, 250 mL', 'HYDROmorphone IV PCA', 'HYDROmorphone IV PCA (UNRESTRICTED)', 'HYDROmorphone IVCI', 'LORazepam (C-IV)', 'LORazepam IVCI in NS (C-IV)', 'avinza (morphine Extended Release)', 'Kadian (morphine Extended Release)', 'Morphine Sulfate Immediate Release', 'Morphine Sulfate IV PCA', 'Morphine Sulfate IV PCA (UNRESTRICTED)', 'morphine sulfate Oral solution', 'morphine sulfate solution (CONCENTRATE)', 'MS Contin (Morphine Extended Release)', 'Opium Tincture (morphine 10 mg/mL) (C-II)') ) , Z AS (SELECT Y.* , CASE WHEN UPPER(OO_ORD_NAME) LIKE '%DIAZEPAM%' THEN 'DIAZEPAM' WHEN UPPER(OO_ORD_NAME) LIKE '%HYDROMORPHONE%' THEN 'HYDROMORPHONE' WHEN UPPER(OO_ORD_NAME) LIKE '%LORAZEPAM%' THEN 'LORAZEPAM' WHEN UPPER(OO_ORD_NAME) LIKE '%MORPHINE%' THEN 'MORPHINE' END AS DRUG , OO_ORD_NAME, OOTO_SIGNIFIC_DTE, OOTO_SIGNIFIC_DT, OMD_ORD_ROUTE , "Dose", "Unit" FROM Y LEFT JOIN DURING_SCAN ON Y."Radiology Accession Number" = DURING_SCAN."Radiology Accession Number") SELECT DRUG, "Radiology Order Group", COUNT(DISTINCT "Radiology Accession Number") AS SCAN_COUNT, COUNT(DISTINCT MRN) AS MRN_COUNT FROM Z GROUP BY DRUG, "Radiology Order Group"

prompt: Identify all patients with esophageal and gastroesophageal junction cancers treated with gemcitabine at MSKCC between 1997 and 2012.
completion: WITH CTE AS (SELECT PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID AS DEID, ICD9_DX_DTE, CDB_DX_DTE FROM DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS LEFT JOIN (SELECT PDX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID AS ICD9_DEID, MIN(DT_DTE) AS ICD9_DX_DTE FROM DV.PATIENT_DIAGNOSIS_FINAL_ALL_V JOIN DV.DIAGNOSIS_CATALOG ON DXCC_DX_CATALOG_ID = PDX_DX_CATALOG_ID JOIN DV.DATE ON DT_DATE_ID = PDX_DX_DATE_ID WHERE DXCC_ICD_CODE BETWEEN '150' AND '151.9' AND DXA_CIC_CDER_INIT = 'YES' GROUP BY PDX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID ) AS ICD9 ON ICD9_DEID = PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID LEFT JOIN (SELECT CDTM_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID AS CDB_DEID, DT_DTE AS CDB_DX_DTE FROM DV.CDB_TUMOR_V JOIN DV.ICDO_SITE_CATALOG_V ON CDTM_SITE_CATALOG_ID = ICSC_SITE_CATALOG_ID JOIN DV.DATE ON DT_DATE_ID = CDTM_DX_DATE_ID WHERE ICSC_SITE_CD BETWEEN 'C150' AND 'C169' ) AS CDB ON CDB_DEID = PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID WHERE COALESCE(ICD9_DEID, CDB_DEID) IS NOT NULL ) SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN AS "MRN", PT_LAST_NAME AS "Last Name", PT_FIRST_NAME AS "First Name", PT_BIRTH_DTE AS "Date of Birth", CDB_DX_DTE AS "CDB Tumor Diagnosis Date", ICD9_DX_DTE AS "First ICD-9 Effective Date", MIN("t4"."DT_DTE") AS "First Date of Gemcitabine Dispense", MAX("t4"."DT_DTE") "Last Date of Gemcitabine Dispense" FROM CTE JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON DEID = PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID JOIN "DV"."PHM_PT_MEDS_MQT" "t5" ON DEID = "t5"."POD_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" JOIN "DV"."PHM_ORDER_DTL" "t6" ON "t5"."POD_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t6"."POD_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AND "t5"."POD_PHARMA_INVENTORY_CTLG_ID" = "t6"."POD_PHARMA_INVENTORY_CTLG_ID" JOIN "DV"."PHM_ORDER_DISPENSE_OCCR" "t7" ON "t6"."POD_PHARMA_ORDER_DETAIL_ID" = "t7"."PDO_PHARMA_ORDER_DETAIL_ID" JOIN "DV"."DATE" "t4" ON "t7"."PDO_DISPNS_DATE_ID" = "t4"."DT_DATE_ID" JOIN "DV"."PHM_INVENTORY_CATALOG" "t3" ON "t5"."POD_PHARMA_INVENTORY_CTLG_ID" = "t3"."PINC_INVENTORY_CTLG_ID" WHERE "t4"."DT_DTE" >= '1997-1-1' AND "t3"."PINC_GENERIC_NAME" IN ('GEMCITABINE', 'GEMCITABINE HCL', 'Gemcitabine HCl') GROUP BY PT_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_BIRTH_DTE, CDB_DX_DTE, ICD9_DX_DTE

prompt: Provide a list of patients who underwent biopsies to confirm or rule out amyloidosis.
completion: WITH AMYLOIDPATHOLOGY AS (SELECT PRPT_MRN AS "MRN", PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH AS "Date of Birth", PT_SEX AS "Sex", PRPT_REPORT_DTE AS "Pathology report date", PRPT_ACCESSION_NO AS "Report Accession Number", PRPT_REPORT_TYPE_DESC AS "Report Type", PRPT_REPORT AS "Pathology Report Txt" FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V JOIN IDB.PATIENT P ON PT_MRN = PRPT_MRN WHERE PRPT_REPORT IS NOT NULL AND PRPT_REPORT_TYPE_DESC <> 'Autopsy Report' AND PRPT_REPORT_DTE BETWEEN '2018-01-01' AND '2022-03-31' AND CONTAINS("PRPT_REPORT", '("amyloid" AND "congo")') = 1 ) SELECT * FROM AMYLOIDPATHOLOGY

prompt: Provide a list of patients with prostate cancer with spine metastases.
completion: WITH PROSTATE_DX AS (SELECT CC_MRN, LISTAGG(CC_EFF_DTE, CHR(13) || CHR(10)) WITHIN GROUP( ORDER BY CC_EFF_DTE) AS EFF_DTE FROM (SELECT DISTINCT CC_MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) CC_EFF_DTE FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE SUBSTR(CC_CLSF_CD, 1, 3) IN ('C61', '185') AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' GROUP BY CC_MRN, CC_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK HAVING MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) BETWEEN '2014-01-01' AND '2019-12-31') A GROUP BY CC_MRN) , SPINE_METS AS (SELECT CC_MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS EFF_DTE, CC_CLSF_CD AS ICD_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS ICD_DESC FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE CC_CLSF_CD IN ('C79.49', '198.4') AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' GROUP BY CC_MRN, CC_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK HAVING MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) BETWEEN '2014-01-01' AND '2019-12-31') , PTS AS (SELECT DISTINCT P.CC_MRN DX_MRN, RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE, RRPT_PROCEDURE_NAME FROM PROSTATE_DX P JOIN SPINE_METS S ON P.CC_MRN = S.CC_MRN JOIN DV.RADIOLOGY_REPORT_V ON P.CC_MRN = RRPT_MRN WHERE 1=1 AND RRPT_ORDER_GROUP = 'MR' AND UPPER(RRPT_PROCEDURE_NAME) like '%SPINE%' ) SELECT DISTINCT DX_MRN "MRN", PT_LAST_NAME "Last Name", PT_FIRST_NAME "First Name", PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH "DOB", PT_SEX "Gender", PT_DATE_OF_DEATH "DOD", EFF_DTE "Prostate Dx Dates", LISTAGG(DATE(RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE), CHR(13) || CHR(10)) WITHIN GROUP( ORDER BY DATE(RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE)) AS "MRI Dates" FROM PTS JOIN PROSTATE_DX ON DX_MRN = CC_MRN JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON DX_MRN = PT_MRN GROUP BY DX_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, PT_SEX, PT_DATE_OF_DEATH, EFF_DTE ; WITH PROSTATE_DX AS (SELECT CC_MRN, LISTAGG(CC_EFF_DTE, CHR(13) || CHR(10)) WITHIN GROUP( ORDER BY CC_EFF_DTE) AS EFF_DTE FROM (SELECT DISTINCT CC_MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) CC_EFF_DTE FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE SUBSTR(CC_CLSF_CD, 1, 3) IN ('C61', '185') AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' GROUP BY CC_MRN, CC_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK HAVING MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) BETWEEN '2014-01-01' AND '2019-12-31') A GROUP BY CC_MRN) , SPINE_METS AS (SELECT CC_MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS EFF_DTE, CC_CLSF_CD AS ICD_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS ICD_DESC FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE CC_CLSF_CD IN ('C79.49', '198.4') AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' GROUP BY CC_MRN, CC_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK HAVING MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) BETWEEN '2014-01-01' AND '2019-12-31') , PTS AS (SELECT DISTINCT P.CC_MRN DX_MRN FROM PROSTATE_DX P JOIN SPINE_METS S ON P.CC_MRN = S.CC_MRN JOIN DV.RADIOLOGY_REPORT_V ON P.CC_MRN = RRPT_MRN WHERE 1=1 AND RRPT_ORDER_GROUP = 'MR' AND UPPER(RRPT_PROCEDURE_NAME) like '%SPINE%' ) , PROSTATE_PATH AS (SELECT PRPT_MRN "MRN", PRPT_PROCEDURE_DTE "Pathology Procedure Date", PRPT_REPORT "Pathology Report" FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V JOIN PTS ON DX_MRN = PRPT_MRN WHERE PRPT_REPORT IS NOT NULL AND CONTAINS("PRPT_REPORT", '("prostate cancer")') = 1 ) SELECT * FROM PROSTATE_PATH ; WITH PROSTATE_DX AS (SELECT CC_MRN, LISTAGG(CC_EFF_DTE, CHR(13) || CHR(10)) WITHIN GROUP( ORDER BY CC_EFF_DTE) AS EFF_DTE FROM (SELECT DISTINCT CC_MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) CC_EFF_DTE FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE SUBSTR(CC_CLSF_CD, 1, 3) IN ('C61', '185') AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' GROUP BY CC_MRN, CC_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK HAVING MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) BETWEEN '2014-01-01' AND '2019-12-31') A GROUP BY CC_MRN) , SPINE_METS AS (SELECT CC_MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS EFF_DTE, CC_CLSF_CD AS ICD_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS ICD_DESC FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE CC_CLSF_CD IN ('C79.49', '198.4') AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' GROUP BY CC_MRN, CC_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK HAVING MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) BETWEEN '2014-01-01' AND '2019-12-31') , PTS AS (SELECT DISTINCT P.CC_MRN DX_MRN FROM PROSTATE_DX P JOIN SPINE_METS S ON P.CC_MRN = S.CC_MRN JOIN DV.RADIOLOGY_REPORT_V ON P.CC_MRN = RRPT_MRN WHERE 1=1 AND RRPT_ORDER_GROUP = 'MR' AND UPPER(RRPT_PROCEDURE_NAME) like '%SPINE%' ) , SPINE_PATH AS (SELECT PRPT_MRN "MRN", PRPT_PROCEDURE_DTE "Path Procedure Date", PRPT_REPORT "Pathology Report" FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V JOIN PTS ON DX_MRN = PRPT_MRN WHERE PRPT_REPORT IS NOT NULL AND CONTAINS("PRPT_REPORT", '("spine")') = 1 ) SELECT * FROM SPINE_PATH ; WITH PROSTATE_DX AS (SELECT CC_MRN, LISTAGG(CC_EFF_DTE, CHR(13) || CHR(10)) WITHIN GROUP( ORDER BY CC_EFF_DTE) AS EFF_DTE FROM (SELECT DISTINCT CC_MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) CC_EFF_DTE FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE SUBSTR(CC_CLSF_CD, 1, 3) IN ('C61', '185') AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' GROUP BY CC_MRN, CC_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK HAVING MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) BETWEEN '2014-01-01' AND '2019-12-31') A GROUP BY CC_MRN) , SPINE_METS AS (SELECT CC_MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS EFF_DTE, CC_CLSF_CD AS ICD_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS ICD_DESC FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE CC_CLSF_CD IN ('C79.49', '198.4') AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' GROUP BY CC_MRN, CC_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK HAVING MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) BETWEEN '2014-01-01' AND '2019-12-31') , PTS AS (SELECT DISTINCT P.CC_MRN DX_MRN FROM PROSTATE_DX P JOIN SPINE_METS S ON P.CC_MRN = S.CC_MRN JOIN DV.RADIOLOGY_REPORT_V ON P.CC_MRN = RRPT_MRN WHERE 1=1 AND RRPT_ORDER_GROUP = 'MR' AND UPPER(RRPT_PROCEDURE_NAME) like '%SPINE%' ) , IMPACT AS (SELECT PT_MRN "MRN", PATH_RPT_DATE "IMPACT Report Date", PRPT_REPORT "IMPACT Report", GENE, GENE2, ABERRATIONTYPE FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_STRUCTURED_RESULTS_V JOIN PTS ON DX_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE 1=1 AND METHOD IN ('IMPACT', 'IMPACTHeme') ) SELECT * FROM IMPACT ;

prompt: Provide a list of patients diagnosed with lymphoma of the palate.
completion: SELECT TM_MRN, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, TM_SITE_CD, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_DESC, TM_HIST_CD, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS HIST_DESC FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM H ON TM_HIST_CD = H.CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON TM_SITE_CD = S.CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON TM_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('3', '6', '7', '8') AND TM_SITE_CD IN ('C050', 'C051', 'C058', 'C059') AND TM_HIST_CD BETWEEN 'M9590/3' AND 'M9729/3'

prompt: Provide a list of all oral cavity patients from July 2019 to November 2021.
completion: SELECT DISTINCT TM_MRN, TRIM(PT_LAST_NAME) || ', ' || TRIM(PT_FIRST_NAME) AS PATIENT_NAME, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH AS DATE_OF_BIRTH, CATEGORY1 ANATOMY_CATEGORY, CATEGORY2 SUB_CATEGORY, TM_DX_DTE DIAGNOSIS_DATE, TM_SITE_CD AS SITE_CODE, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_DESC, TM_HIST_CD AS HIST_CODE, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS HIST_DESC FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM H ON TM_HIST_CD = H.CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON TM_SITE_CD = S.CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.SEERGROUPING G ON IDB.SEERF_ICDO(TM_SITE_CD, TM_HIST_CD) = G.RECODE JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PT_MRN = TM_MRN WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND CATEGORY1 = 'Oral Cavity and Pharynx' AND TM_DX_DTE BETWEEN '2019-07-01' AND '2021-11-30' ; WITH DX AS (SELECT DISTINCT TM_MRN, TRIM(PT_LAST_NAME) || ', ' || TRIM(PT_FIRST_NAME) AS PATIENT_NAME , TM_DX_DTE DIAGNOSIS_DATE FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM H ON TM_HIST_CD = H.CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON TM_SITE_CD = S.CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.SEERGROUPING G ON IDB.SEERF_ICDO(TM_SITE_CD, TM_HIST_CD) = G.RECODE JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PT_MRN = TM_MRN WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND CATEGORY1 = 'Oral Cavity and Pharynx' AND TM_DX_DTE BETWEEN '2019-07-01' AND '2021-11-30' ) SELECT TM_MRN, PATIENT_NAME, SSE_SURG_DTE, SSE_LOG_ID, SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD, SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC FROM IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE ON SSE_LOG_ID = SSP_LOG_ID AND SSE_ENC_CSN_ID = SSP_ENC_CSN_ID JOIN DX ON TM_MRN = SSE_MRN WHERE (SSE_SURG_LOC not like '%IR%' AND SSE_SURG_LOC not like '%ENDO%' AND SSE_SOURCE_TYPE <> 'E') AND SSE_SURG_DTE >= DIAGNOSIS_DATE AND SSE_SURG_DTE BETWEEN DIAGNOSIS_DATE AND DIAGNOSIS_DATE + 6 MONTHS AND SSE_SURG_DTE <= '2021-11-30' AND SSP_SURG_SVC_CD ='HNS' ORDER BY TM_MRN ;

prompt: Provide a weekly list of patients scheduled for lobectomy surgery (all related CPT codes) 1-3 weeks in the future.
completion: WITH PREP AS (SELECT OTR_RELEASE_NAME, OTR_RELEASE_DATE, OTTT_CODE, OTTT_NAME, OTTT_MAINTYPENAME, OTTT_TISSUE FROM (SELECT OTR_RELEASE_NAME, OTR_RELEASE_DATE, OTTT_CODE, OTTT_NAME, OTTT_MAINTYPENAME, OTTT_TISSUE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY OTTT_CODE ORDER BY CASE WHEN OTR_RELEASE_NAME = 'oncotree_latest_stable' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END DESC, OTR_RELEASE_DATE DESC) RN FROM DSGTOOLS.ONCOTREE_TUMORTYPE_V WHERE OTR_RELEASE_NAME NOT IN ('oncotree_development', 'oncotree_candidate_release') ) WHERE RN = 1 ), DIAGNOSIS AS (SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN, PDRX_ACCESSION_NO, PDRX_DMP_PATIENT_ID, PDRX_DMP_SAMPLE_ID, TUMOR_TYPE_CODE, TUMOR_TYPE_NAME, OTTT_MAINTYPENAME, OTTT_TISSUE, OTR_RELEASE_NAME, IS_METASTASIS, PRIMARY_SITE, METASTASIS_SITE, PART_DESCRIPTION FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML INNER JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML_SETTINGS ON PDRX_PATH_DMP_RESULTS_XML_ID = PDRXS_PATH_DMP_RESULTS_XML_ID INNER JOIN DVDMC.PATHOLOGY_DMP_WEBSVC_SETTINGS ON PDRXS_SETTING_ID = PDWS_SETTING_ID INNER JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON PDRX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID, XMLTABLE('$c/root/meta-data' PASSING PDRX_XML_VALUE AS "c" COLUMNS TUMOR_TYPE_CODE VARCHAR(100) PATH 'tumor_type_code', TUMOR_TYPE_NAME VARCHAR(255) PATH 'tumor_type_name', IS_METASTASIS VARCHAR(10) PATH 'is_metastasis', PRIMARY_SITE VARCHAR(255) PATH 'primary_site', METASTASIS_SITE VARCHAR(255) PATH 'metastasis_site', PART_DESCRIPTION VARCHAR(2000) PATH 'part_description') T INNER JOIN PREP ON TUMOR_TYPE_CODE = OTTT_CODE WHERE OTTT_MAINTYPENAME = 'Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer' ) SELECT OC_CASE_ID , OC_MRN , TRIM(PT_LAST_NAME) CONCAT ', ' CONCAT TRIM(PT_FIRST_NAME) PT_NAME , CASE WHEN OCAS_SURG_ROLE = 'Primary' THEN CRE_RES_NAME END PRIMARY_SURGEON , CASE WHEN OCAS_SURG_ROLE = 'Assissting' THEN CRE_RES_NAME END CO_SURGEON , OC_SURG_DTE , CPX_PROC_CD , CPX_PROC_NAME , OTTT_MAINTYPENAME , TUMOR_TYPE_CODE , TUMOR_TYPE_NAME FROM IDB.OR_CASE JOIN IDB.OR_CASE_ALL_PROC ON OC_CASE_ID = OCAP_CASE_ID JOIN IDB.OR_CASE_ALL_SURG ON OCAP_CASE_ID = OCAS_CASE_ID AND OCAS_PNL_NO = OCAP_PNL_NO JOIN IDB.OR_PROC ON OCAP_OR_PROC_ID = OP_OR_PROC_ID JOIN IDB.OR_CL_PROC ON OP_OR_PROC_ID = OCP_OR_PROC_ID JOIN IDB.CL_PROC ON OCP_PROC_ID = CPX_PROC_ID JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CRE_RES_ID = OCAS_RES_ID JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON OC_MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN DIAGNOSIS ON OC_MRN = DIAGNOSIS.PT_MRN WHERE 1 = 1 AND (OC_SURG_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT date AND CURRENT date + 21) AND OC_OR_CASE_STS_CD NOT IN ('2', '5') AND ((CPX_PROC_CD BETWEEN '32440' AND '32549' AND CPX_PROC_CD <> '32491') OR (CPX_PROC_CD IN ('32663', '32657', '32669', '32670', '7502999', '532480', '7532482', '7532483', '7532484', '7532486', '7532489', '7532500', '7532501', '7532502', '7532506', '7532507', '7532515', '7532657', '7532667'))) GROUP BY OC_CASE_ID , OC_MRN , TRIM(PT_LAST_NAME) CONCAT ', ' CONCAT TRIM(PT_FIRST_NAME) , OCAS_SURG_ROLE , CRE_RES_NAME , CASE WHEN OCAS_SURG_ROLE = 'Primary' THEN CRE_RES_NAME END , CASE WHEN OCAS_SURG_ROLE = 'Co-Surgeon' THEN CRE_RES_NAME END , OC_SURG_DTE , CPX_PROC_CD , CPX_PROC_NAME , OTTT_MAINTYPENAME , TUMOR_TYPE_CODE , TUMOR_TYPE_NAME ORDER BY OC_CASE_ID, OC_SURG_DTE ASC

prompt: Geriatric patients seen in the survivorship clinics with a social work or psychiatry referral
completion: WITH APPTS AS (SELECT CPE_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, CPE_ENC_DTE, CLD_DEPT_NAME, CRE_RES_ID, CRE_RES_NAME, CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON CPE_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND (CLD_DEPT_NAME LIKE '%SVR%' OR CLD_DEPT_NAME LIKE '%SURVIVOR%' OR CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME LIKE '%SNP %' OR CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR like 'SAPP %') AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN '2018-01-01' AND '2018-12-31' AND YEAR(CPE_ENC_DTE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) > 70 AND NOT (CLD_DEPT_NAME like 'BMT%' OR CLD_DEPT_NAME like 'LYM%') ) , PTS AS (SELECT CPE_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, CPE_ENC_DTE, CLD_DEPT_NAME, CRE_RES_ID, CRE_RES_NAME, CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR, OO_MRN, OO_ENTER_DTE, OO_ORD_NAME, DOC_NAME, DOC_SVC FROM APPTS JOIN IDB.OMS_ORDER ON CPE_MRN = OO_MRN JOIN IDB.DOC ON CRE_RES_ID = DOC_DR_NO AND OO_REQ_DR_NO = DOC_DR_NO WHERE OO_ORD_STS_CD NOT IN ('CANP', 'CANC', 'AUC3') AND OO_ORD_NAME IN ('Social Work Consult', 'Social Work Inpatient Consult', 'Psychiatry Consult', 'Psychiatry Inpatient Consult', 'Psychiatry Outpatient Consult') ) , ENGAGE AS (SELECT EF_MRN, DATE(EF_SUBMISSION_DT) SUBMISSION_DTE, SUM(INT(SUBSTR(EFI_VALUE_ALIAS, LOCATE('option_', EFI_VALUE_ALIAS)+7, 1))) PHQ2_SCORE FROM (SELECT DISTINCT OO_MRN FROM PTS) A JOIN IDB.EF_FORM ON OO_MRN = EF_MRN JOIN IDB.EF_FORM_ITEM ON EF_FORM_ID = EFI_FORM_ID WHERE EF_FORM_NAME like 'Survivorship Patient Self Assessment%' AND EFI_ITEM_ALIAS like 'PHQ2%' GROUP BY EF_MRN, DATE(EF_SUBMISSION_DT) HAVING SUM(INT(SUBSTR(EFI_VALUE_ALIAS, LOCATE('option_', EFI_VALUE_ALIAS)+7, 1))) >= 3) SELECT CPE_MRN MRN, PT_LAST_NAME "Last Name", PT_FIRST_NAME "First Name", CPE_ENC_DTE "SVP Appt Date", CLD_DEPT_NAME "SVP Dept", CRE_RES_NAME "SVP Resource", CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR "SVP Visit Type", OO_ENTER_DTE "Social Work/Psychiatry Order Enter Date", OO_ORD_NAME "Order Name", DOC_NAME "Requesting Resource Name", DOC_SVC "Service", SUBMISSION_DTE "Submission Date", PHQ2_SCORE "PHQ2 Score" FROM PTS LEFT JOIN ENGAGE ON CPE_MRN = EF_MRN

prompt: Provide a weekly list of Thoracic Surgery NSCLC PO patients with EGFR and/or ALK mutation
completion: WITH Q AS (SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN AS "MRN", PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, CPE_ENC_DTE AS "Appt Date", CLD_DEPT_NAME AS "Department Name", CRE_RES_NAME AS "Provider Name", CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME AS "Visit Type", SSE_SURG_DTE SURG_DTE, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS HIST_DESC, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_DESC, CASE WHEN S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK IS NULL THEN I.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK END AS ICD_DESC FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID JOIN IDB.PATIENT A ON A.PT_MRN = CPE_MRN JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_STRUCTURED_RESULTS_V B ON B.PT_MRN = A.PT_MRN AND B.GENE IN ('EGFR', 'EGFR vIII', 'EGFR VIII', 'EGFRvIII', 'ALK') LEFT JOIN IDB.CDB_TUMOR ON CPE_MRN = TM_MRN AND TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') LEFT JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD LEFT JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD LEFT JOIN IDB.CTC_CLSF ON CC_MRN = CPE_MRN AND CC_CLSF_CD like 'C%' AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND (CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) LEFT JOIN IDB.CLM I ON CC_CLSF_CD = I.CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT ON SSE_MRN = CPE_MRN AND SSE_SURG_DTE > CURRENT date - 75 DAYS JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE ON SSE_LOG_ID = SSP_LOG_ID AND SSP_SURG_SVC_CD = 'THO' WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Sch', 'Arrived', 'Comp') AND CRE_RES_TYP IN ('Physician') AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 = 'SRG' AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 = 'THR' AND (S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK like '%LUNG%' OR CASE WHEN S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK IS NULL THEN I.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK END like '%LUNG%') AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT date AND CURRENT date + 14 DAYS ) SELECT MRN, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, "Appt Date", "Department Name", "Provider Name", "Visit Type", SURG_DTE, LISTAGG(TRIM(HIST_DESC), ' | ') HIST_DESC, LISTAGG(TRIM(SITE_DESC), ' | ') SITE_DESC, LISTAGG(TRIM(ICD_DESC), ' | ') ICD_DESC FROM Q GROUP BY MRN, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, "Appt Date", "Department Name", "Provider Name", "Visit Type", SURG_DTE ORDER BY "Appt Date"

prompt: List of all patients who received neoadjuvant chemotherapy +/- pembrolizumab for TNBC breast cancer from June 2021-June 2023 -- Please do not include anyone who is metastatic or Stage 1
completion: WITH APR AS (SELECT DISTINCT APR_MRN, CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME, APR_START_DTE, APR_TOTAL_GIVEN_DOSE, APR_PRESCRIBED_DOSE FROM IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX_V WHERE UPPER(CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME) LIKE ('%PEMBROLIZUMAB%') AND APR_START_DTE BETWEEN '2021-06-01' AND '2023-06-01' ), ICD AS (SELECT DISTINCT CC_MRN AS DX_MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS DX_DATE, CLM_CLSF_CD AS DX_CODE, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS DX_DESC FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN APR ON APR_MRN = CC_MRN JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND ((CC_PT_TYPE = 'I') OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) AND CC_CLSF_CD LIKE ('C50%') GROUP BY CC_MRN, CLM_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK), COH AS (SELECT DISTINCT APR_MRN , TRIM(PT_LAST_NAME)||', '||TRIM(PT_FIRST_NAME) AS NAME , PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH , CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME , APR_START_DTE "PEMBROLIZUMAB START DATE" , APR_TOTAL_GIVEN_DOSE "PEMBROLIZUMAB TOTAL DOSE" , APR_PRESCRIBED_DOSE "PEMBROLIZUMAB PRESCRIBED DOSE" , DX_DATE , DX_CODE , DX_DESC , CASE WHEN PT_DATE_OF_DEATH IS NULL THEN YEAR(CURRENT DATE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) END AS AGE , YEAR(DX_DATE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) AS AGE_AT_DIAGNOSIS FROM APR JOIN ICD ON APR_MRN = DX_MRN JOIN IDB.PATIENT prompt: Provide all cases at MSK with a diagnosis of esthesioneuroblastoma.
completion: WITH "cte1" AS (SELECT TEXTTABLE.*, CONTAINS("PRPT_REPORT", '"esthesioneuroblastoma" | "olfactory"') AS "HitCol1" FROM "DV"."PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V" TEXTTABLE) SELECT DISTINCT "t2"."PT_MRN" AS "MRN", "t2"."PT_LAST_NAME" AS "Last Name", "t2"."PT_FIRST_NAME" AS "First Name", "t2"."PT_BIRTH_DTE" AS "Date of Birth", "t2"."PT_VITAL_STATUS" AS "Vital Status", "t3"."PRPT_ACCESSION_NO" AS "Pathology Report", "t4"."DT_DTE" AS "Pathology Report Date", "t5"."DT_DTE" AS "ICD-9 First Dx Date" FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED" "t1" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V" "t2" ON "t1"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t2"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "cte1" "t3" ON "t1"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t3"."PRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE" "t4" ON "t3"."PRPT_REPORT_DATE_ID" = "t4"."DT_DATE_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DIAGNOSIS_FINAL_ALL_V" "t6" ON "t1"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t6"."PDX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AND "t6"."PDX_DX_CATALOG_ID" IN (5685) AND "t6"."DXA_CIC_CDER_INIT" IN ('YES') LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DIAGNOSIS_FINAL_DATES_V" "t7" ON "t6"."PDX_DX_CATALOG_ID" = "t7"."PDX_DX_CATALOG_ID" AND "t6"."PDX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t7"."PDX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE" "t5" ON "t7"."FIRST_DIAGNOSIS_DATE_ID" = "t5"."DT_DATE_ID" WHERE "t3"."HitCol1" <> 0

prompt: Provide a list of patients with upper tract urothelial carcinoma who have received enfortumab as a treatment.
completion: SELECT DISTINCT "t1"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AS "Deident PT #", "t2"."PT_MRN" AS "MRN", "t3"."PINC_ITEM_NAME" AS "Drug Name", "t4"."DXCC_ICD_CODE" AS "ICD-O Histology Code", "t4"."DXCC_ICD_MSK_DESC" AS "ICD-O Histology Description", "t5"."ICSC_SITE_CD" AS "ICD-O Site Code", "t5"."ICSC_ICDO_SITE_MSK_DESC" AS "ICD-O Site Description", "t6"."DT_DTE" AS "Tumor Diagnosis Date", "t7"."CDTM_CA_SURG_DTE" AS "Tumor Surgery Date" FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED" "t1" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V" "t2" ON "t1"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t2"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PHM_PT_MEDS_MQT" "t8" ON "t1"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t8"."POD_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PHM_ORDER_DTL" "t9" ON "t8"."POD_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t9"."POD_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AND "t8"."POD_PHARMA_INVENTORY_CTLG_ID" = "t9"."POD_PHARMA_INVENTORY_CTLG_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PHM_INVENTORY_CATALOG" "t3" ON "t9"."POD_PHARMA_INVENTORY_CTLG_ID" = "t3"."PINC_INVENTORY_CTLG_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."CDB_TUMOR_V" "t7" ON "t1"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t7"."CDTM_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DIAGNOSIS_CODE_CAT_ICDO_V" "t4" ON "t7"."CDTM_DX_CATALOG_ID" = "t4"."DXCC_DX_CATALOG_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."ICDO_SITE_CATALOG_V" "t5" ON "t7"."CDTM_SITE_CATALOG_ID" = "t5"."ICSC_SITE_CATALOG_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" "t6" ON "t7"."CDTM_DX_DATE_ID" = "t6"."DT_DATE_ID" WHERE (UPPER("t3"."PINC_ITEM_NAME") IN ('ENFORTUMAB VEDOTIN (ASG-22CE) INVEST INJECTION 10 MG/ML', 'ENFORTUMAB VEDOTIN-EJFV INJECTION 10 MG/ML, 2 ML VIAL', 'ENFORTUMAB VEDOTIN-EJFV INJECTION 10 MG/ML, 2 ML VIAL (PFS)', 'ENFORTUMAB VEDOTIN-EJFV INJECTION 10 MG/ML, 3 ML VIAL', 'ENFORTUMAB VEDOTIN-EJFV INJECTION 10 MG/ML, 3 ML VIAL (PFS)', 'AGS-22M6E INV, 30 MG', 'AGS-22M6E INVEST INJECTION 10 MG/ML (NO)') AND ("t5"."ICSC_SITE_CD" IN ('C659', 'C669', 'C676') OR "t5"."ICSC_SITE_CD" IN ('C688', 'C689')))

prompt: Everything about the report can stay the same, but I would like to extend the date to current date/most recent date available
