DOM-Sarcoma', 'Follow Up - PACC Sarcoma', 'Follow Up - PACC Sarcoma-Urgent', 'Follow Up Consultation, Adolescent and Young Adult', 'Follow Up Consultation, Adolescent and Young Adult v2-Follow', 'Initial Consultation, Adolescent and Young Adult', 'Miscellaneous Note - Pediatrics', 'Miscellaneous Note - Pediatrics-AYA', 'Miscellaneous/Discussion Note, Amb-DOM', 'Miscellaneous/Discussion Note, Amb-DOM Lymphoma', 'Miscellaneous/Discussion Note, Amb-DOM Sarcoma', 'Miscellaneous/Discussion Note, Amb-DOM Sarcoma - AYA', 'Miscellaneous/Discussion Note, Amb-MSK Koch', 'Miscellaneous/Discussion Note, Amb-Outpatient', 'Telephone/Electronic Communication, MD, PhD, APP')) OR (OP_DISPLAY_NAME = 'Hightower, Heather' AND CDD_SERVICE_DTE BETWEEN '2021-12-15' AND CURRENT DATE AND CDD_DOC_NAME IN ('Nursing Event Note - Inpatient-Psychosocial', 'Nursing Event Note - Outpatient-Other', 'Nursing Event Note - Outpatient-Psychosocial', 'Telephone/Electronic Communication, Nursing-Care Coordinate', 'Telephone/Electronic Communication, Nursing-Symptom Mgt', 'Telephone/Electronic Communication, Nursing-Treatment Care')) OR (OP_DISPLAY_NAME = 'Russo, Alexandra' AND CDD_SERVICE_DTE BETWEEN '2021-07-01' AND CURRENT DATE AND CDD_DOC_NAME = 'Psychosocial - prompt: C3i Data Report (just run the two previous requests for Jan 1, 2020 to June 30, 2020)
completion: SELECT TRIM(CDD_MRN) AS MRN, TRIM(CDD_DOC_NAME) CDD_DOC_NAME, TRIM(OP_DISPLAY_NAME) AS PROVIDER, CDD_SERVICE_DTE, CDD_DOC_GUID, TRIM(CDO_SECTION) CDO_SECTION, TRIM(CDO_ITEM_NAME) CDO_ITEM_NAME, TRIM(CDO_VALUE_TEXT) CDO_VALUE_TEXT FROM IDB.CD_DOCUMENT JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION ON CDD_DOC_GUID = CDO_DOC_GUID AND CDD_AUTHORED_DTE = CDO_AUTHORED_DTE AND CDO_VALUE_TEXT <> '' JOIN Treatment - Psychiatry') AND CDD_SERVICE_DTE BETWEEN '2020-01-01' AND '2020-06-30' ; WITH PTS AS (SELECT VIS_MRN , VIS_ADM_NUM , PT_LAST_NAME , PT_FIRST_NAME , PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH , PT_SEX , PT_RACE_DESC , PT_PT_ETHNICITY_DESC , VIS_DTE , AV_DESC AS HOSP_SVC FROM IDB.VISIT_V JOIN IDB.PATIENT_V ON VIS_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS ON AV_ELEMENT = 'HOSP_SVC' AND AV_CODE = VIS_HOSP_SVC WHERE VIS_DTE = '{}' AND YEAR(VIS_DTE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) >= 14 ) , INS AS (SELECT * FROM (SELECT MRN, MSK_ADT_INSURANCE_IND, INS_EFF_DATE, INS_CODE, INS_COMP_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY MRN ORDER BY AS MIN_ICD_EFF_DTE, CATEGORY1 AS ICD_SEER_GROUP1, CATEGORY2 AS ICD_SEER_GROUP2 FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.SEERGROUPING ON CLM_CLSF_RECODE = RECODE AND CLM_CLSF_TYPE IN ('I9', 'I0') AND CLM_CD_TYPE = 'D' JOIN PTS ON CC_MRN = VIS_MRN WHERE SUBSTR(CC_CLSF_CD, 1, 3) BETWEEN 'C00' AND 'D48' AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND (CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) AND CATEGORY1 NOT IN ('Non-Cancer', 'Miscellaneous') GROUP BY CC_MRN, CATEGORY1, CATEGORY2 ) , TUMOR AS (SELECT TM_MRN, MIN(TM_DX_DTE) TM_DX_DTE, CATEGORY1 AS REG_SEER_GROUP1, CATEGORY2 AS REG_SEER_GROUP2 FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN PTS ON TM_MRN = VIS_MRN JOIN IDB.CLM ON CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD JOIN IDB.SEERGROUPING ON IDB.SEERF_ICDO(TM_SITE_CD, TM_HIST_CD) = RECODE WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND CATEGORY1 NOT IN ('Non-Cancer', 'Miscellaneous') GROUP BY TM_MRN, CATEGORY1, CATEGORY2 ) SELECT VIS_MRN , VIS_ADM_NUM , PT_LAST_NAME , PT_FIRST_NAME , PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH , PT_SEX , PT_RACE_DESC , PT_PT_ETHNICITY_DESC , VIS_DTE , HOSP_SVC , INS_CODE , INS_COMP_NAME , MIN_ICD_EFF_DTE , ICD_SEER_GROUP1 , ICD_SEER_GROUP2 , TM_DX_DTE , REG_SEER_GROUP1 , REG_SEER_GROUP2 FROM PTS LEFT JOIN INS ON VIS_MRN = MRN LEFT JOIN ICD_CA ON VIS_MRN = CC_MRN LEFT JOIN TUMOR ON VIS_MRN = TM_MRN ; WITH PTS AS (SELECT VIS_MRN , VIS_DTE FROM HGN_GENERIC_NAME, CATEGORY_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CAT_DRUG_KEY ORDER BY CATEGORY_NAME) RN FROM (SELECT HGN_GENERIC_NAME, OCDX_DRUG_KEY CAT_DRUG_KEY, CASE WHEN (C2.ODC_CATEGORY_NAME = ' ' OR C2.ODC_CATEGORY_NAME IS NULL) THEN C1.ODC_CATEGORY_NAME WHEN (C3.ODC_CATEGORY_NAME = ' ' OR C3.ODC_CATEGORY_NAME IS NULL) THEN C2.ODC_CATEGORY_NAME CONCAT ' | ' CONCAT C1.ODC_CATEGORY_NAME ELSE IDB.OMS_DRUG_CATEGORIES C2 ON C2.ODC_MULTUM_CATEGORY_ID = L2.OCSX_MULTUM_CATEGORY_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_CATEGORY_SUB_XREF L3 ON L2.OCSX_MULTUM_CATEGORY_ID = L3.OCSX_SUB_CATEGORY_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_DRUG_CATEGORIES C3 ON C3.ODC_MULTUM_CATEGORY_ID = L3.OCSX_MULTUM_CATEGORY_ID)) , DRUGCAT AS (SELECT CAT_DRUG_KEY, HGN_GENERIC_NAME GENERIC_NAME , MAX(CASE WHEN RN = 1 THEN CATEGORY_NAME END)|| MAX(CASE WHEN RN = 2 THEN ', '||STRIP(CATEGORY_NAME) ELSE '' END)|| MAX(CASE WHEN RN = 3 THEN ', '||STRIP(CATEGORY_NAME) ELSE '' END)|| MAX(CASE WHEN RN = 4 THEN ', '||STRIP(CATEGORY_NAME) ELSE '' STRIP(THERAP_CATEGORY) AS THERAPEUTIC_CAT , CASE WHEN HCPR_PRESCRIPTION_TYPE = 1 THEN 'eRx' WHEN HCPR_PRESCRIPTION_TYPE = 3 THEN 'HML' ELSE 'Oth' END AS RX_TYPE FROM IDB.HML_CLIENT_PRESCRIPTION JOIN completion: WITH COVID AS (SELECT DISTINCT V.MRN PT_MRN, CPP_PT_NAME, TRIM(G.CAV_NAME) AS LANG, CPP_EMAIL_ADDR, DATE(V.MIN_RESULT_DT) AS COVID_DATE FROM IDB.PATIENT_COVID_INFO_V V JOIN IDB.CL_PAS_PATIENT P ON CPP_MRN = V.MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_CATEGORY G ON G.CAV_ABBR = CPP_LANG AND G.CAV_CATEGORY = 'LANG' WHERE TRIM(CPP_CL_PT_STS) = 'Alive' AND CPP_MRN <> '' AND DATE(MIN_RESULT_DT) BETWEEN '2020-03-01' AND '2021-10-31' AND V.RESULT IN ('Positive', 'Resolved') ), TUMOR AS (SELECT TM_MRN, HIST_DESC, TM_DATE FROM (SELECT TM_MRN, date (TM_DX_DTE) TM_DATE, TM_HIST_CD, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS HIST_DESC, TM_SITE_CD , ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY TM_MRN ORDER BY TM_DX_DTE) RN FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS ON AV_ELEMENT = 'CASE_STS' AND AV_CODE = TM_CASE_STS AND TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND TM_SITE_CD BETWEEN 'C00' AND 'D49') WHERE RN =1 ) , REP1 AS (SELECT AC_MRN, AC_IRB_NO AS IRB1, AC_CONS_DTE IRB1_DT, CASE WHEN AC_CONS_DTE IS NULL AND AC_IRB_NO = '06-107' THEN 'N' WHEN AC_CONS_DTE IS NOT NULL AND AC_IRB_NO = '06-107' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'NA' END AS CONSENT_06_107 FROM IDB.ACCRUALS WHERE AC_IRB_NO='06-107' ) , REP2 AS (SELECT AC_MRN, AC_IRB_NO AS IRB2, AC_CONS_DTE IRB2_DT, CASE WHEN AC_CONS_DTE IS NULL AND AC_IRB_NO = '09-141' THEN 'N' WHEN AC_CONS_DTE IS NOT NULL AND AC_IRB_NO = '09-141' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'NA' END AS CONSENT_09_141 FROM IDB.ACCRUALS WHERE AC_IRB_NO='09-141' ) SELECT * FROM (SELECT DISTINCT C.PT_MRN AS "MRN", CPP_PT_NAME AS "PATIENT NAME", COALESCE(LANG, 'English') AS "PREFERRED LANGUAGE", CPP_EMAIL_ADDR AS "EMAIL ADDRESS", COVID_DATE AS "COVID_DIAGNOSIS_DATE", HIST_DESC AS "CANCER_DIAGNOSIS", TM_DATE AS "CANCER_DIAGNOSIS_DATE", IRB1, "CONSENT_06_107", IRB2, "CONSENT_09_141" FROM COVID C JOIN TUMOR T ON T.TM_MRN = C.PT_MRN LEFT JOIN REP1 ON REP1.AC_MRN=C.PT_MRN LEFT JOIN REP2 ON REP2.AC_MRN=C.PT_MRN ) WHERE IRB1 IS NOT NULL OR IRB2 IS NOT NULL

prompt: Provide an automated report every other week of cases where IMPACT results are available for specimens from Cerebrospinal Fluid.
completion: WITH DMP AS (SELECT A.PT_MRN, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_BIRTH_DTE, PATH_PROCEDURE_DATE, DT_DTE REPORT_DATE, PRIMARY_SITE, TUMOR_TYPE_CODE, TUMOR_TYPE_NAME, PART_DESCRIPTION, GENE, LOCUS, AA_CHANGE, ABERRATIONTYPE, DV.TODATE(DV.REGEXSTR('[0-9]*[\-|\.|\/][0-9]*[\-|\.|\/][0-9]*', T.DT_PROCEDURE)) AS PROCEDUREDATE, MAINRPT.DT_DTE REPORT_DTE FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML INNER JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML_SETTINGS ON PDRX_PATH_DMP_RESULTS_XML_ID = PDRXS_PATH_DMP_RESULTS_XML_ID INNER JOIN DVDMC.PATHOLOGY_DMP_WEBSVC_SETTINGS ON PDRXS_SETTING_ID = PDWS_SETTING_ID INNER JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS A ON PDRX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID LEFT JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_STRUCTURED_RESULTS_V B ON PDRX_PATH_RPT_ID = B.PRPT_PATH_RPT_ID JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V MAINPATH ON MAINPATH.PRPT_PATH_RPT_ID = PDRX_PATH_RPT_ID JOIN DV.DATE_V MAINRPT ON MAINRPT.DT_DATE_ID = MAINPATH.PRPT_REPORT_DATE_ID, XMLTABLE('$c/root/meta-data' PASSING PDRX_XML_VALUE AS "c" COLUMNS TUMOR_TYPE_CODE VARCHAR(100) PATH 'tumor_type_code', TUMOR_TYPE_NAME VARCHAR(255) PATH 'tumor_type_name', IS_METASTASIS VARCHAR(10) PATH 'is_metastasis', PRIMARY_SITE VARCHAR(255) PATH 'primary_site', METASTASIS_SITE VARCHAR(255) PATH 'metastasis_site', PART_DESCRIPTION VARCHAR(2000) PATH 'part_description', DT_PROCEDURE VARCHAR(40) PATH 'dt_procedure') T WHERE UPPER(PART_DESCRIPTION) like '%CEREBROSPINAL%' ) SELECT * FROM DMP WHERE REPORT_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT date - 14 DAYS AND CURRENT date

prompt: Instances When A Surgeon Finished After 11:30 pm and Started Again Between 5am and 8am
completion: WITH TIMES AS (SELECT OL_LOG_ID, OL_MRN, OL_SURG_DTE AS SURGDATE, OLAS_PNL_NO, CRE_RES_ID, CRE_RES_NAME AS SURGEON, OLAS_SURG_ROLE, OLAS_SURG_SVC AS SURGSVC, OL_NO_OF_PNLS TTL_PANELS, SSE_PT_IN_DT AS PT_IN_ROOM_TIME, MIN(CASE WHEN OLPT_PNL_EVNT_CD = '100' THEN OLPT_EVNT_IN_DT END) AS PREP_START_TIME, MIN(CASE WHEN OLAS_PNL_NO = 1 THEN SSE_PT_IN_DT ELSE CASE WHEN OLPT_PNL_EVNT_CD = '100' THEN OLPT_EVNT_IN_DT END END) AS START_TIME, MAX(CASE WHEN OLPT_PNL_EVNT_CD = '300' THEN OLPT_EVNT_IN_DT END) AS END_TIME FROM IDB.OR_LOG JOIN IDB.OR_LOG_ALL_SURG ON OL_LOG_ID = OLAS_LOG_ID JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON OLAS_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.OR_LOG_PANEL_TIMES ON OLPT_LOG_ID = OL_LOG_ID AND OLPT_PNL_NO = OLAS_PNL_NO JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT ON OL_LOG_ID = SSE_LOG_ID WHERE OL_LOG_STS_CD NOT IN ('4', '6') AND OL_SURG_DTE >= CURRENT DATE - (DAYOFYEAR(CURRENT DATE)-1)DAY AND OLAS_SURG_ROLE IN ('Assist', 'Co-Surgeon', 'Cons Surgeon', 'Ext Attend', 'Primary') AND OLAS_SURG_SVC NOT IN ('IR', 'ANES') GROUP BY OL_LOG_ID, OL_MRN, OL_SURG_DTE, OL_NO_OF_PNLS, OLAS_PNL_NO, CRE_RES_ID, CRE_RES_NAME, OLAS_SURG_ROLE, OLAS_SURG_SVC, SSE_PT_IN_DT ) , SURGEON AS (SELECT OL_LOG_ID LOG_ID , MAX(CASE WHEN OLAS_PNL_NO = 1 AND OLAS_SURG_ROLE = 'Primary' THEN SURGEON END) PRIMARY_SURGEON , MAX(CASE WHEN OLAS_PNL_NO = 1 AND OLAS_SURG_ROLE = 'Co-Surgeon' THEN SURGEON END) PNL1_COSURGEON , MAX(CASE WHEN OLAS_PNL_NO = 1 AND OLAS_SURG_ROLE = 'Assist' THEN SURGEON END) PNL1_ASSIST , MAX(CASE WHEN OLAS_PNL_NO = 2 AND OLAS_SURG_ROLE = 'Primary' THEN SURGEON END) PNL2_SURGEON , MAX(CASE WHEN OLAS_PNL_NO = 2 AND OLAS_SURG_ROLE = 'Co-Surgeon' THEN SURGEON END) PNL2_COSURGEON , MAX(CASE WHEN OLAS_PNL_NO = 2 AND OLAS_SURG_ROLE = 'Assist' THEN SURGEON END) PNL2_ASSIST , MAX(CASE WHEN OLAS_PNL_NO = 3 AND OLAS_SURG_ROLE = 'Primary' THEN SURGEON END) PNL3_SURGEON , MAX(CASE WHEN OLAS_PNL_NO = 3 AND OLAS_SURG_ROLE = 'Co-Surgeon' THEN SURGEON END) PNL3_COSURGEON , MAX(CASE WHEN OLAS_PNL_NO = 3 AND OLAS_SURG_ROLE = 'Assist' THEN SURGEON END) PNL3_ASSIST , MAX(CASE WHEN OLAS_PNL_NO = 4 AND OLAS_SURG_ROLE = 'Primary' THEN SURGEON END) PNL4_SURGEON , MAX(CASE WHEN OLAS_PNL_NO = 4 AND OLAS_SURG_ROLE = 'Co-Surgeon' THEN SURGEON END) PNL4_COSURGEON , MAX(CASE WHEN OLAS_PNL_NO = 4 AND OLAS_SURG_ROLE = 'Assist' THEN SURGEON END) PNL4_ASSIST FROM TIMES GROUP BY OL_LOG_ID) SELECT DISTINCT A.OL_LOG_ID AS "Log ID", A.OL_MRN AS MRN, A.SURGDATE AS "Surgery Date", A.TTL_PANELS AS " Total Panels", C.PRIMARY_SURGEON "Primary Surgeon", C.PNL1_COSURGEON "Panel 1 Co-Surgeon", C.PNL1_ASSIST "Panel 1 Assist", C.PNL2_SURGEON "Panel 2 Surgeon", C.PNL2_COSURGEON "Panel 2 Co-Surgeon", C.PNL2_ASSIST "Panel 2 Assist", C.PNL3_SURGEON "Panel 3 Surgeon", C.PNL3_COSURGEON "Panel 3 Co-Surgeon", C.PNL3_ASSIST "Panel 3 Assist", C.PNL4_SURGEON "Panel 4 Surgeon", C.PNL4_COSURGEON "Panel 4 Co-Surgeon", C.PNL4_ASSIST "Panel 4 Assist", A.OLAS_PNL_NO AS "Panel Number", A.SURGEON AS "Surgeon", A.OLAS_SURG_ROLE AS "Role", A.SURGSVC AS "Service", A.START_TIME AS "Start Timestamp", A.END_TIME AS "End Timestamp", B.OL_MRN AS MRN, B.OL_LOG_ID AS "Log ID", B.SURGDATE AS "Surgery Date", B.TTL_PANELS AS " Total Panels", D.PRIMARY_SURGEON "Primary Surgeon", D.PNL1_COSURGEON "Panel 1 Co-Surgeon", D.PNL1_ASSIST "Panel 1 Assist", D.PNL2_SURGEON "Panel 2 Surgeon", D.PNL2_COSURGEON "Panel 2 Co-Surgeon", D.PNL2_ASSIST "Panel 2 Assist", D.PNL3_SURGEON "Panel 3 Surgeon", D.PNL3_COSURGEON "Panel 3 Co-Surgeon", D.PNL3_ASSIST "Panel 3 Assist", D.PNL4_SURGEON "Panel 4 Surgeon", D.PNL4_COSURGEON "Panel 4 Co-Surgeon", D.PNL4_ASSIST "Panel 4 Assist", B.OLAS_PNL_NO AS "Panel Number", B.SURGEON AS "Surgeon", B.OLAS_SURG_ROLE AS "Role", B.SURGSVC AS "Service", B.START_TIME AS "Start Timestamp", B.END_TIME AS "End Timestamp" FROM TIMES A JOIN TIMES B ON A.CRE_RES_ID = B.CRE_RES_ID LEFT JOIN SURGEON C ON A.OL_LOG_ID = C.LOG_ID LEFT JOIN SURGEON D ON B.OL_LOG_ID = D.LOG_ID WHERE ((DATE(A.END_TIME) = DATE(B.START_TIME) - 1 DAY AND TIME(A.END_TIME) > '23:29:59') OR (DATE(A.END_TIME) = DATE(B.START_TIME) AND TIME(A.END_TIME) < '08:00:00' AND NOT (DATE(A.START_TIME) = DATE(B.START_TIME) AND TIME(A.START_TIME) >= '05:00:00'))) AND TIME(B.START_TIME) BETWEEN '05:00:00' AND '8:00:00' ORDER BY A.OL_LOG_ID, A.OLAS_PNL_NO, A.OLAS_SURG_ROLE DESC, B.START_TIME, B.OL_LOG_ID, B.OLAS_SURG_ROLE DESC ; WITH DTL AS (SELECT OL_LOG_ID, OL_SURG_DTE AS SURGDATE, OLAS_PNL_NO, CRE_RES_ID, CRE_RES_NAME AS SURGEON, OLAS_SURG_ROLE, OLAS_SURG_SVC AS SURGSVC, SSE_PT_IN_DT AS PT_IN_ROOM_TIME, MIN(CASE WHEN OLPT_PNL_EVNT_CD = '100' THEN OLPT_EVNT_IN_DT END) AS PREP_START_TIME, MIN(CASE WHEN OLAS_PNL_NO = 1 THEN SSE_PT_IN_DT ELSE CASE WHEN OLPT_PNL_EVNT_CD = '100' THEN OLPT_EVNT_IN_DT END END) AS START_TIME, MAX(CASE WHEN OLPT_PNL_EVNT_CD = '300' THEN OLPT_EVNT_IN_DT END) AS END_TIME FROM IDB.OR_LOG JOIN IDB.OR_LOG_ALL_SURG ON OL_LOG_ID = OLAS_LOG_ID JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON OLAS_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.OR_LOG_PANEL_TIMES ON OLPT_LOG_ID = OL_LOG_ID AND OLPT_PNL_NO = OLAS_PNL_NO JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT ON OL_LOG_ID = SSE_LOG_ID WHERE OL_LOG_STS_CD NOT IN ('4', '6') AND OL_SURG_DTE >= CURRENT DATE - (DAYOFYEAR(CURRENT DATE)-1)DAY AND OLAS_SURG_ROLE IN ('Primary') AND OLAS_SURG_SVC NOT IN ('IR', 'ANES') GROUP BY OL_LOG_ID, OL_SURG_DTE, OLAS_PNL_NO, CRE_RES_ID, CRE_RES_NAME, OLAS_SURG_ROLE, OLAS_SURG_SVC, SSE_PT_IN_DT) SELECT SURGSVC, COUNT(*) AS SVC_CASE_COUNT , COUNT(CASE WHEN OLAS_PNL_NO= 1 THEN OL_LOG_ID END) CASE_VOLUME_CNT FROM DTL GROUP BY SURGSVC ORDER BY 1;

prompt: Provide a quarterly list of patients ruled out for blue dye reaction, in Post Op Assessment and PACU Event notes.
completion: WITH X AS (SELECT DISTINCT STRIP(CDD_MRN) AS MRN, CDD_SERVICE_DTE AS "Service Date", STRIP(CDD_DOC_NAME) AS "Document Name", STRIP(SUBSTR(CDO_VALUE_TEXT, 1, 200)) AS "Event" FROM IDB.CD_DOCUMENT JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION ON CDO_DOC_GUID = CDD_DOC_GUID AND CDO_AUTHORED_DTE = CDD_AUTHORED_DTE WHERE CDD_CANCEL_IND = '0' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND = '0' AND CDD_DOC_NAME IN ('Assessment, Post Operative, MD/NP/PA - Surgery', 'Event Note, NP/PA - PACU-Outpatient') AND CDD_SERVICE_DTE BETWEEN '2021-08-01' AND CURRENT date AND CDO_MSTR_ITEM_NM IN ('23-H_MD_Events Since Surgery_RES', 'NUR_PACU Event RES') AND UPPER(CDO_VALUE_TEXT) LIKE '%R/O BLUE DYE%' ) , SRG AS (SELECT DISTINCT OL_MRN, OL_SURG_DTE AS "Surgery Date", TIME(ARS_AN_START_DT) AS "Anesthesia Start DateTime", TIME(ARS_AN_STOP_DT) AS "Anesthesia End DateTime", STRIP(CRE_RES_NAME) AS "Surgeon Name", OL_LOG_ID, OLAP_OR_PROC_ID, OP_PROC_NAME FROM IDB.OR_LOG JOIN X ON OL_MRN = MRN AND "Service Date" BETWEEN OL_SURG_DTE AND OL_SURG_DTE + 1 DAY JOIN IDB.OR_LOG_ALL_PROC ON OL_LOG_ID = OLAP_LOG_ID JOIN IDB.OR_PROC ON OLAP_OR_PROC_ID = OP_OR_PROC_ID JOIN IDB.OR_CL_PROC ON OP_OR_PROC_ID = OCP_OR_PROC_ID JOIN IDB.CL_PROC ON OCP_PROC_ID = CPX_PROC_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.OR_LOG_ALL_SURG ON OLAP_LOG_ID = OLAS_LOG_ID AND OLAP_PNL_NO = OLAS_PNL_NO AND OLAS_SURG_ROLE = 'Primary' LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CRE_RES_ID = OLAS_RES_ID JOIN IDB.AN_RECORD_SUMMARY ON OL_LOG_ID = ARS_AN_CASELOG_ID WHERE OL_LOG_STS NOT IN ('Canceled', 'Voided') AND OP_PROC_NAME like '%SENTINEL%' ) , Y AS (SELECT DISTINCT X.*, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH AS DOB, YEAR("Surgery Date" - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) AS "Age", PT_SEX AS "Sex", "Surgery Date", "Anesthesia Start DateTime", "Anesthesia End DateTime", "Surgeon Name", OLAP_OR_PROC_ID "OR Procedure ID", STRIP(OP_PROC_NAME) AS "Procedure Name" FROM X JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PT_MRN = MRN LEFT JOIN SRG ON OL_MRN = MRN AND "Service Date" BETWEEN "Surgery Date" AND "Surgery Date" + 1 DAY) , T1 AS (SELECT DISTINCT LR_MRN AS MRN, "Surgery Date", LR_PERFORMED_DTE AS PERFORMED_DTE, LR_PERFORMED_DT AS PERFORMED_DT, TIME(LR_PERFORMED_DT) AS PERFORMED_TME, LR_TEST_NAME AS TEST_NAME, LR_SUBTEST_NAME AS SUBTEST_NAME, LR_RESULT_VALUE AS RESULT_VALUE, LR_UNIT_MEASURE AS UNIT_MEASURE FROM Y JOIN IDB.LAB_RESULTS ON LR_MRN = MRN AND "Surgery Date" BETWEEN "Surgery Date" AND "Service Date" WHERE UPPER(LR_SUBTEST_NAME) LIKE '%TRYPTASE%' ) , T2 AS (SELECT MRN, "Surgery Date", LISTAGG(COALESCE(STRIP(CAST(PERFORMED_DTE AS VARCHAR(12000))), '') || ' | ' || COALESCE(STRIP(CAST(PERFORMED_TME AS VARCHAR(12000))), '') || ' | ' || COALESCE(STRIP(CAST(SUBTEST_NAME AS VARCHAR(12000))), '') || ' | ' || COALESCE(STRIP(CAST(RESULT_VALUE AS VARCHAR(12000))), '') || ' ' || COALESCE(STRIP(CAST(UNIT_MEASURE AS VARCHAR(12000))), '') , CHR(13) || CHR(10)) WITHIN GROUP( ORDER BY MRN, PERFORMED_DTE, PERFORMED_TME) AS TRYPTASE FROM T1 GROUP BY MRN, "Surgery Date") SELECT DISTINCT Y.*, TRYPTASE FROM Y LEFT JOIN T2 ON Y.MRN = T2.MRN AND Y."Surgery Date" = T2."Surgery Date" WITH X AS (SELECT DISTINCT STRIP(OO_MRN) AS MRN, OO_ENTER_DTE AS "Order Date", OO_ORD_ID, OO_ORD_GUID, OO_SET_GUID, STRIP(OO_SET_NAME) AS "Set Name", STRIP(OO_ORD_NAME) AS "Order Name" FROM IDB.OMS_ORDER WHERE OO_ORD_STS_CD NOT IN ('CANC', 'CANP', 'AUC3') AND OO_ENTER_DTE BETWEEN '2021-08-01' AND CURRENT date AND UPPER(OO_SET_NAME) LIKE '%BLUE DYE%' ) , Y AS (SELECT MRN, "Order Date", OO_SET_GUID, "Set Name", LISTAGG(COALESCE(STRIP(CAST("Order Name" AS VARCHAR(12000))), '') , CHR(13) || CHR(10)) WITHIN GROUP( ORDER BY MRN, OO_SET_GUID, UPPER("Order Name")) AS "Order Names" FROM X GROUP BY MRN, "Order Date", OO_SET_GUID, "Set Name") , Z AS (SELECT DISTINCT Y.*, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH AS DOB, YEAR("Order Date" - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) AS "Age", PT_SEX AS "Sex" FROM Y JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PT_MRN = MRN) , T1 AS (SELECT DISTINCT LR_MRN AS MRN, "Order Date", LR_PERFORMED_DTE AS PERFORMED_DTE, LR_PERFORMED_DT AS PERFORMED_DT, TIME(LR_PERFORMED_DT) AS PERFORMED_TME, LR_TEST_NAME AS TEST_NAME, LR_SUBTEST_NAME AS SUBTEST_NAME, LR_RESULT_VALUE AS RESULT_VALUE, LR_UNIT_MEASURE AS UNIT_MEASURE FROM Z JOIN IDB.LAB_RESULTS ON LR_MRN = MRN WHERE UPPER(LR_SUBTEST_NAME) LIKE '%TRYPTASE%' ) , T2 AS (SELECT MRN, "Order Date", LISTAGG(COALESCE(STRIP(CAST(PERFORMED_DTE AS VARCHAR(12000))), '') || ' | ' || COALESCE(STRIP(CAST(PERFORMED_TME AS VARCHAR(12000))), '') || ' | ' || COALESCE(STRIP(CAST(SUBTEST_NAME AS VARCHAR(12000))), '') || ' | ' || COALESCE(STRIP(CAST(UNIT_MEASURE AS VARCHAR(12000))), '') , CHR(13) || CHR(10)) WITHIN GROUP( ORDER BY MRN, PERFORMED_DTE, PERFORMED_TME) AS TRYPTASE FROM T1 GROUP BY MRN, "Order Date") SELECT DISTINCT Z.*, TRYPTASE FROM Z LEFT JOIN T2 ON Z.MRN = T2.MRN AND Z."Order Date" = T2."Order Date" WITH X AS (SELECT DISTINCT STRIP(OO_MRN) AS MRN, OO_ENTER_DTE AS "Order Date", OO_ORD_ID, OO_ORD_GUID, STRIP(OO_ORD_NAME) AS "Order Name" , STRIP(D1.OUD_USER_DI_VALUE) AS "Reason for Admit/Transfer" , STRIP(D2.OUD_USER_DI_VALUE) AS "Special Inst/Additional Information" FROM IDB.OMS_ORDER LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_USER_DATA D1 ON OO_ORD_GUID = D1.OUD_ORD_GUID AND D1.OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'JXR_Reason for Admit' LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_USER_DATA D2 ON OO_ORD_GUID = D2.OUD_ORD_GUID AND D2.OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'JXR_Specify/INST' WHERE OO_ORD_STS_CD NOT IN ('CANC', 'CANP', 'AUC3') AND OO_ENTER_DTE BETWEEN '2021-08-01' AND CURRENT date AND UPPER(OO_ORD_NAME) LIKE '%JRSC ADMIT/TRANSFER%' ) , Y AS (SELECT DISTINCT X.*, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH AS DOB, YEAR("Order Date" - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) AS "Age", PT_SEX AS "Sex" FROM X JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PT_MRN = MRN) , T1 AS (SELECT DISTINCT LR_MRN AS MRN, "Order Date", LR_PERFORMED_DTE AS PERFORMED_DTE, LR_PERFORMED_DT AS PERFORMED_DT, TIME(LR_PERFORMED_DT) AS PERFORMED_TME, LR_TEST_NAME AS TEST_NAME, LR_SUBTEST_NAME AS SUBTEST_NAME, LR_RESULT_VALUE AS RESULT_VALUE, LR_UNIT_MEASURE AS UNIT_MEASURE FROM Y JOIN IDB.LAB_RESULTS ON LR_MRN = MRN AND "Order Date" = LR_PERFORMED_DTE WHERE UPPER(LR_SUBTEST_NAME) LIKE '%TRYPTASE%' ) , T2 AS (SELECT MRN, "Order Date", LISTAGG(COALESCE(STRIP(CAST(PERFORMED_DTE AS VARCHAR(12000))), '') || ' | ' || COALESCE(STRIP(CAST(PERFORMED_TME AS VARCHAR(12000))), '') || ' | ' || COALESCE(STRIP(CAST(SUBTEST_NAME AS VARCHAR(12000))), '') || ' | ' || COALESCE(STRIP(CAST(UNIT_MEASURE AS VARCHAR(12000))), '') , CHR(13) || CHR(10)) WITHIN GROUP( ORDER BY MRN, PERFORMED_DTE, PERFORMED_TME) AS TRYPTASE FROM T1 GROUP BY MRN, "Order Date") SELECT DISTINCT Y.*, TRYPTASE FROM Y LEFT JOIN T2 ON Y.MRN = T2.MRN AND Y."Order Date" = T2."Order Date" SELECT DISTINCT STRIP(OO_MRN) AS MRN, OO_ENTER_DTE AS "Order Date", OO_ORD_ID, OO_ORD_GUID, STRIP(OO_ORD_NAME) AS "Order Name" , STRIP(D1.OUD_USER_DI_VALUE) AS "Service" , STRIP(D2.OUD_USER_DI_VALUE) AS "Time/Priority" , STRIP(D3.OUD_USER_DI_VALUE) AS "Service2" , STRIP(D4.OUD_USER_DI_VALUE) AS "Transfer Pt To" FROM IDB.OMS_ORDER LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_USER_DATA D1 ON OO_ORD_GUID = D1.OUD_ORD_GUID AND D1.OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'Housestaff_Teams' LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_USER_DATA D2 ON OO_ORD_GUID = D2.OUD_ORD_GUID AND D2.OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'Nursing Information' LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_USER_DATA D3 ON OO_ORD_GUID = D3.OUD_ORD_GUID AND D3.OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'AI_Services' LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_USER_DATA D4 ON OO_ORD_GUID = D4.OUD_ORD_GUID AND D4.OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'Nursing Floor Locations' WHERE OO_ORD_STS_CD NOT IN ('CANC', 'CANP', 'AUC3') AND OO_ENTER_DTE BETWEEN '2021-08-01' AND CURRENT date AND UPPER(OO_ORD_NAME) LIKE '%TRANSFER%PATIENT%'

prompt: Provide a list of patients seen at MSK with GIST diagnosis in the last 2 weeks
completion: WITH PTS AS (SELECT TM_MRN MRN FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND TM_HIST_CD = 'M8936/3' UNION SELECT CC_MRN MRN FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE CC_CLSF_CD IN ('C49.A2', '171.5') AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND (CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) GROUP BY CC_MRN, CC_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK ) , APPTS AS (SELECT CPE_MRN, CPE_ENC_DTE, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8, CLD_DEPT_NAME, CRE_RES_NAME, CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CPE_MRN ORDER BY CPE_APPT_DT DESC) RN FROM PTS JOIN IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER ON MRN = CPE_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CRE_RES_TYP = 'Physician' AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT date - 14 DAY AND CURRENT date ) , PATH AS (SELECT PRPT_MRN, PRPT_PROCEDURE_DTE, PRPT_REPORT_TYPE_DESC, PRPT_ACCESSION_NO, PRPT_REPORT, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY PRPT_MRN ORDER BY PRPT_REPORT_DTE DESC) RN FROM PTS JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V ON MRN = PRPT_MRN) SELECT MRN, CPE_ENC_DTE MOST_RECENT_APPT_DATE, CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME MOST_RECENT_VISIT_TYPE, PRPT_REPORT_TYPE_DESC PATH_REPORT_TYPE, PRPT_PROCEDURE_DTE PATH_PROCEDURE_DATE, PRPT_REPORT PATH_REPORT_TEXT FROM PTS P JOIN APPTS A ON P.MRN = A.CPE_MRN AND A.RN = 1 LEFT JOIN PATH PATH ON P.MRN = PATH.PRPT_MRN AND PATH.RN = 1 JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON P.MRN = PT_MRN

prompt: We would like to know the number of all patients seen with multiple myeloma at the MSK main site and regionals, including demographics (race/ethnicity, gender) in 2021. Please report data for MSK main and regional sites separately.
completion: WITH MYM AS (SELECT PT_MRN, TRIM (A.AV_DESC) AS PT_RACE, TRIM(B.AV_DESC) AS GENDER FROM IDB.PATIENT LEFT JOIN (SELECT TM_MRN, AV_DESC AS CASE_STS FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.SEERGROUPING ON IDB.SEERF_ICDO(TM_SITE_CD, TM_HIST_CD) = RECODE JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS ON AV_ELEMENT = 'CASE_STS' AND AV_CODE = TM_CASE_STS WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND CATEGORY1 IN ('Myeloma')) AS CDB ON TM_MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN (SELECT CC_MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS MIN_ICD9_EFF_DTE FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE SUBSTR(CC_CLSF_CD, 1, 3) IN ('C90', '203') AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND (CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) GROUP BY CC_MRN, CC_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK) AS ICD9 ON CC_MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS A ON A.AV_CODE = PT_RACE AND A.AV_ELEMENT = 'RACE' LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS B ON B.AV_CODE = PT_SEX AND B.AV_ELEMENT = 'SEX' WHERE COALESCE(TM_MRN, CC_MRN) IS NOT NULL ) SELECT CLD_CLD_CENTER AS CENTER, PT_RACE, GENDER, COUNT(DISTINCT CPE_MRN) PT_CNT FROM MYM JOIN IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER ON PT_MRN = CPE_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID WHERE CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN ('2021-01-01') AND ('2021-12-31') AND CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Comp', 'Arrived') AND CRE_RES_TYP = 'Physician' GROUP BY CLD_CLD_CENTER, PT_RACE, GENDER ORDER BY CLD_CLD_CENTER

prompt: provide diagnosis, diagnostic molecular, and demographic data for patients with acinar carcinoma of the pancreas.
completion: WITH PHI (PHI) AS ( VALUES ('Y')) , ICD9DXCODES AS (SELECT DXA_ATTRIBUTE_ID FROM DV.DIAGNOSIS_ATTRIBUTE WHERE DXA_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND DXA_CIC_CDER_INIT = 'YES') , ICD0 AS (SELECT DISTINCT "t17"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AS PID, "t11"."DT_DTE" FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS" "t1" INNER JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED" "t17" ON "t1"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t17"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" INNER JOIN "DV"."CDB_TUMOR_V" "t12" ON "t17"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t12"."CDTM_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" INNER JOIN "DV"."TUMOR_CASE_ATTRIBUTES_V" "t4a" ON "t12"."CDTM_CASE_ATTR_ID" = "t4a"."TUMOR_CASE_ATTR_ID" INNER JOIN "DV"."ICDO_SITE_CATALOG_V" "t2" ON "t12"."CDTM_SITE_CATALOG_ID" = "t2"."ICSC_SITE_CATALOG_ID" INNER JOIN "DV"."DIAGNOSIS_CODE_CAT_ICDO_V" "t3" ON "t12"."CDTM_DX_CATALOG_ID" = "t3"."DXCC_DX_CATALOG_ID" INNER JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" "t11" ON "t12"."CDTM_DX_DATE_ID" = "t11"."DT_DATE_ID" WHERE DXCC_ICD_CODE IN ('M8550/0' ,'M8550/1' ,'M8550/3' ,'M8550/6' ,'M8551/3') AND ICSC_SITE_CD IN ('C250' ,'C251' ,'C252' ,'C253' ,'C254' ,'C257' ,'C258' ,'C259' ,'C809') ) , DMP_DX AS (SELECT DISTINCT PDRX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID AS P_ID, PT_MRN AS MRN , DV.REGEXSTR('(S|H|C|M|F|B|DMG)[0-9]{2}[\s|-][0-9]*', XMLCAST(XMLQUERY('$x/root/meta-data/part_description' PASSING PDRX_XML_VALUE AS "x") AS VARCHAR(2000))) AS REFERENCEDACCESSION , T.*, DT.PDRX_PATH_RPT_ID , PDRX_DMP_SAMPLE_ID AS DMP_SAMPLE_ID, PDRX_DMP_PATIENT_ID AS DMP_PATIENT_ID , DV.TODATE(DT_PROCEDURE) AS "Procedure Date" , VARCHAR(PRPT_REPORT, 32000) AS "Molecular Path Text" FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML DT CROSS JOIN XMLTABLE('$c/root/*' PASSING DT.PDRX_XML_VALUE AS "c" COLUMNS TUMOR_TYPE_NAME VARCHAR(264) PATH '../meta-data/tumor_type_name' , TUMOR_TYPE_CODE VARCHAR(264) PATH '../meta-data/tumor_type_code' , M_ACCESSION_NUM VARCHAR(264) PATH '../meta-data/m_accession_num' , GENE_PANEL VARCHAR(264) PATH '../meta-data/gene-panel' , DT_PROCEDURE VARCHAR(100) PATH '../meta-data/dt_procedure') T INNER JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML_SETTINGS ON PDRX_PATH_DMP_RESULTS_XML_ID = PDRXS_PATH_DMP_RESULTS_XML_ID INNER JOIN DVDMC.PATHOLOGY_DMP_WEBSVC_SETTINGS ON PDRXS_SETTING_ID = PDWS_SETTING_ID INNER JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON PDRX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID LEFT JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V MAINPATH ON MAINPATH.PRPT_PATH_RPT_ID = PDRX_PATH_RPT_ID LEFT JOIN DV.DATE_V MAINRPT ON MAINRPT.DT_DATE_ID = MAINPATH.PRPT_REPORT_DATE_ID JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT T.TUMOR_TYPE_CODE TTC FROM TABLE(DV.STRING_SPLIT('PAAC,ACN', ',')) S CROSS JOIN TABLE(DV.ONCOTREE_CHILDREN(TRIM(COLUMN_VALUES))) T) X ON T.TUMOR_TYPE_CODE = X.TTC) , DMP_LISTAGG AS (SELECT P_ID AS DMP_PID, LISTAGG(COALESCE(TUMOR_TYPE_NAME, '') || ' | ' || COALESCE(TRIM(CAST(M_ACCESSION_NUM AS VARCHAR(12000))), '') || ' | ' || COALESCE(TRIM(GENE_PANEL), '') || ' | ' || COALESCE(TRIM(DMP_SAMPLE_ID), '') , CHR(13) || CHR(10)) WITHIN GROUP( ORDER BY P_ID, M_ACCESSION_NUM) AS "DMP Information" FROM DMP_DX GROUP BY P_ID) , DX AS (SELECT P_ID FROM DMP_DX UNION SELECT PID AS P_ID FROM ICD0) , DT AS (SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN AS MRN , PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID FROM DX JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = P_ID) , PART_A_C AS (SELECT TRIM(CRDB.PT_MRN) AS PART_A_C_MRN, MAX(CASE WHEN REG_ID = '100' THEN DATE(CRDB.REGISTRATION_DATETIME) END) "Part A Registration Date", MAX(CASE WHEN REG_ID = '100' THEN DATE(CRDB.CRNT_CONSENT_DATE) END) "Part A Consent Date", MAX(CASE WHEN REG_ID = '100' THEN CRDB.PHYSICIAN_OF_RECORD END) "Part A Treating MD", MAX(CASE WHEN REG_ID = '300' THEN DATE(CRDB.REGISTRATION_DATETIME) END) "Part C Registration Date", MAX(CASE WHEN REG_ID = '300' THEN DATE(CRDB.CRNT_CONSENT_DATE) END) "Part C Consent Date", MAX(CASE WHEN REG_ID = '300' THEN CRDB.PHYSICIAN_OF_RECORD END) "Part C Treating MD" FROM NN.CRDB_DASH_PT_REG CRDB JOIN DT DT ON DT.MRN = CRDB.PT_MRN JOIN NN.CRDB_DASH_PT PT ON CRDB.PRT_ID = PT.PRT_ID AND CRDB.PT_MRN = PT.PT_MRN JOIN IDB.PATIENT P ON CRDB.PT_MRN = P.PT_MRN WHERE CRDB.PRT_ID = '12-245' AND REG_ID IN ('100', '300') AND CRNT_ELGBL_STATUS_DSCRP NOT IN ('Ineligible', 'Cancel') GROUP BY CRDB.PT_MRN ) , CDBS AS (SELECT DISTINCT "t11"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" PID_CDB, CAST(RTRIM("t2"."ICSC_CODE_AND_MSK_DESC") AS VARCHAR(500)) AS "ICD-O Site Code", RTRIM("t3"."DXCC_CODE_AND_MSK_DESC") AS "ICD-O Histology Code", CASE WHEN PHI.PHI = 'Y' THEN CAST("t9"."DT_DTE" AS VARCHAR(500)) ELSE CAST("t9"."DT_YEAR" AS VARCHAR(500)) END AS "Tumor Diagnosis Date", CAST(RTRIM("t10"."MP_FULL_NM") AS VARCHAR(500)) AS "Tumor Medical Oncologist" , CAST(RTRIM("t12"."CDTM_SMOKING_HX_DESC") AS VARCHAR(500)) AS "Smoking Hx" , CASE WHEN TM_AJCC_7 NOT IN ('', '888', '999') THEN AJCC7.AV_DESC WHEN TM_AJCC NOT IN ('', '88', '99') THEN AJCC.AV_DESC WHEN TM_GENERAL_STG NOT IN ('', '9') THEN GS.AV_DESC WHEN TM_PATH_STG_GRP NOT IN ('', '88', '9', '99') THEN TM_PATH_STG_GRP ELSE CLIN.AV_DESC END AS "Best Stage" FROM DT "t11" INNER JOIN "DV"."CDB_TUMOR_V" "t12" ON "t11"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t12"."CDTM_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" JOIN IDB.CDB_TUMOR CDB ON TM_MRN = "t11".MRN AND TM_CDB_SEQ_NO = CDTM_CDB_SEQ_NO LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS AJCC7 ON AJCC7.AV_ELEMENT = 'AJCC_7' AND AJCC7.AV_CODE = TM_AJCC_7 LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS AJCC ON AJCC.AV_ELEMENT = 'AJCC' AND AJCC.AV_CODE = TM_AJCC LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS GS ON GS.AV_ELEMENT = 'GENERAL_STG' AND GS.AV_CODE = TM_GENERAL_STG LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS CLIN ON CLIN.AV_ELEMENT = 'CLIN_STG_DSCR' AND CLIN.AV_CODE = TM_CLIN_STG_DSCR LEFT JOIN "DV"."TUMOR_CASE_ATTRIBUTES_V" "t4a" ON "t12"."CDTM_CASE_ATTR_ID" = "t4a"."TUMOR_CASE_ATTR_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."ICDO_SITE_CATALOG_V" "t2" ON "t12"."CDTM_SITE_CATALOG_ID" = "t2"."ICSC_SITE_CATALOG_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DIAGNOSIS_CODE_CAT_ICDO_V" "t3" ON "t12"."CDTM_DX_CATALOG_ID" = "t3"."DXCC_DX_CATALOG_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" "t9" ON "t12"."CDTM_DX_DATE_ID" = "t9"."DT_DATE_ID" LEFT JOIN DV.MEDPRO_V "t10" ON "t12"."CDTM_ONCOLOGY_DR_ID" = "t10"."MP_MEDPRO_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."TUMOR_OTHER_STAGE_ATTRIBUTES_V" "t6" ON "t12"."CDTM_TM_OTHER_STAGE_ATTR_ID" = "t6"."TOSA_TM_OTHER_STAGE_ATTR_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."TUMOR_COLLAB_STAGE_ATTRIBUTES_V" "t7" ON "t12"."CDTM_COLLAB_STAGE_ATTR_ID" = "t7"."TCSA_TM_COLLAB_STAGE_ATTR_ID" , PHI WHERE "TCA_CASE_STS_DESC" <> 'Non-Index Tumor' ) , CDB_LISTAGG AS (SELECT PID_CDB, LISTAGG(COALESCE("Tumor Diagnosis Date", '') || ' | ' || COALESCE(TRIM(CAST("ICD-O Site Code" AS VARCHAR(12000))), '') || ' | ' || COALESCE(TRIM("ICD-O Histology Code"), '') || ' | ' || COALESCE(TRIM("Best Stage"), '') || ' | ' || COALESCE(TRIM("Smoking Hx"), '') , CHR(13) || CHR(10)) WITHIN GROUP( ORDER BY PID_CDB, "Tumor Diagnosis Date") AS CDB_DXS FROM CDBS GROUP BY PID_CDB) , MAIN AS (SELECT DISTINCT "t1"."PT_MRN" AS "MRN", "t1"."PT_LAST_NAME" AS "Last Name", "t1"."PT_FIRST_NAME" AS "First Name", "t1"."PT_BIRTH_DTE" AS "Date of Birth", "t1"."PT_DEATH_DTE" AS "Deceased Date", CASE WHEN "t1"."PT_DEATH_DTE" IS NULL THEN YEAR(CURRENT date - "t1"."PT_BIRTH_DTE") END AS "Cur Age", "t1"."PT_VITAL_STATUS" AS "Vital Status", "t1"."PT_SEX_DESC" AS "Gender", "t1"."PT_RACE_DESC" AS "Race", "t2"."CORE_ETHNICITY_DESC" AS "Ethnicity", "t3"."PLA_LAST_DRVST_DTE" AS "Last Dr Visit Date" , CDB_DXS AS "CDB Diagnoses" , "DMP Information" , "Part A Registration Date" , "Part A Consent Date" , "Part A Treating MD" , "Part C Registration Date" , "Part C Consent Date" , "Part C Treating MD" FROM DT DT LEFT JOIN PART_A_C ON PART_A_C_MRN = DT.MRN JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS" "t1" ON "t1"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = DT.PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID LEFT JOIN CDB_LISTAGG ON PID_CDB = DT.PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_CORE_DEMOGRAPHICS" "t2" ON "t1"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t2"."CORE_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_LATEST_ACTIVITY" "t3" ON "t1"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t3"."PLA_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN DMP_LISTAGG ON DMP_PID = DT.PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID) SELECT DMP.* , (SELECT VARCHAR(PRPT_REPORT, 32000) AS REFERENCEDPATHTEXTFROM FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V WHERE PRPT_ACCESSION_NO = REFERENCEDACCESSION) AS REFERENCEDPATHTEXT FROM DMP_DX DMP ORDER BY 1, 2 ;

prompt: One time request.
completion: WITH HCT AS (SELECT CBM_MRN AS MRN, CBM_TRANSPLANT_DTE AS HCT_DT, CBM_TRANSPLANT_TYPE AS HCT_TYPE FROM IDB.CRDB_BMT_MEDICINE WHERE CBM_TRANSPLANT_TYPE = 'ALLO' AND CBM_TRANSPLANT_DTE BETWEEN '01/01/2016' AND '06/01/2022' UNION SELECT CBP_MRN AS MRN, CBP_TRANSPLANT_DTE AS HCT_DT, CBP_TRANSPLANT_TYPE AS HCT_TYPE FROM IDB.CRDB_BMT_PEDIATRICS WHERE CBP_TRANSPLANT_TYPE = 'ALLO' AND CBP_TRANSPLANT_DTE BETWEEN '01/01/2016' AND '06/01/2022' ), RAD AS (SELECT RRPT_MRN , RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE , RRPT_REPORT_TXT , (RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE + 30 DAYS) AS PDTE , (RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE - 30 DAYS) AS MDTE FROM HCT JOIN DV.RADIOLOGY_REPORT_V ON HCT.MRN = RRPT_MRN WHERE RRPT_PROCEDURE_NAME = 'Bone Densitometry Axial Skel, 1 Or Mor' AND RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE > HCT.HCT_DT ), VIT AS (SELECT LR_MRN, LAB_PERFORMED_DT, LR_SUBTEST_NAME, LAB_RESULT_VALUE FROM (SELECT DISTINCT LR_MRN, LR_PERFORMED_DTE AS LAB_PERFORMED_DT, LR_SUBTEST_NAME, LR_RESULT_VALUE AS LAB_RESULT_VALUE, LTL_TEXT_RESULT AS TEXT_RESULT, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY LR_MRN ORDER BY ABS(DAYS(RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE) - DAYS(LR_PERFORMED_DTE)) ASC) RNK FROM RAD JOIN IDB.LAB_RESULTS ON RRPT_MRN = LR_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.LAB_TEXT_LINE ON LTL_RESULT_GUID = LR_RESULT_GUID WHERE LR_SUBTEST_NAME = 'Vitamin D 25 Hydroxy' AND LR_RESULT_VALUE IS NOT NULL AND LR_RESULT_VALUE <> '' AND LR_RESULT_VALUE NOT IN ('canceled', 'Canceled', 'Lipemic', 'UHE') ) WHERE RNK = 1 ), PTH AS (SELECT LR_MRN, LAB_PERFORMED_DT, LR_SUBTEST_NAME, LAB_RESULT_VALUE FROM (SELECT DISTINCT LR_MRN, LR_PERFORMED_DTE AS LAB_PERFORMED_DT, LR_SUBTEST_NAME, LR_RESULT_VALUE AS LAB_RESULT_VALUE, LTL_TEXT_RESULT AS TEXT_RESULT, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY LR_MRN ORDER BY ABS(DAYS(RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE) - DAYS(LR_PERFORMED_DTE)) ASC) RNK FROM RAD JOIN IDB.LAB_RESULTS ON RRPT_MRN = LR_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.LAB_TEXT_LINE ON LTL_RESULT_GUID = LR_RESULT_GUID WHERE UPPER(LR_SUBTEST_NAME) LIKE 'PTH%' AND LR_RESULT_VALUE IS NOT NULL AND LR_RESULT_VALUE <> '' AND LR_RESULT_VALUE NOT IN ('Azygos', 'Site 1', 'Site 2', 'SEE NOTE', 'Thymic', 'TNP') ) WHERE RNK = 1 ), ALB AS (SELECT LR_MRN, LAB_PERFORMED_DT, LAB_CAT, LAB_RESULT_VALUE FROM (SELECT DISTINCT LR_MRN, LR_PERFORMED_DTE AS LAB_PERFORMED_DT, CASE WHEN LR_SUBTEST_NAME IN ('Albumin', 'Albumin, Plasma') THEN 'Albumin' END AS LAB_CAT, LR_RESULT_VALUE AS LAB_RESULT_VALUE, LTL_TEXT_RESULT AS TEXT_RESULT, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY LR_MRN ORDER BY ABS(DAYS(RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE) - DAYS(LR_PERFORMED_DTE)) ASC) RNK FROM RAD JOIN IDB.LAB_RESULTS ON RRPT_MRN = LR_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.LAB_TEXT_LINE ON LTL_RESULT_GUID = LR_RESULT_GUID WHERE LR_SUBTEST_NAME IN ('Albumin', 'Albumin, Plasma') AND LR_RESULT_VALUE IS NOT NULL AND LR_RESULT_VALUE <> '' AND LR_RESULT_VALUE NOT IN ('canceled', 'see note', 'Cancel', 'Error-Disregard', 'FOOTNOTE', 'Hemolyzed', 'Lipemic', 'QNS', 'See note') ) WHERE RNK = 1 ), ALBU AS (SELECT LR_MRN, LAB_PERFORMED_DT, MAX(CASE WHEN LAB_CAT = 'Albumin' THEN LAB_RESULT_VALUE END) AS ALBUMIN FROM ALB GROUP BY LR_MRN, LAB_PERFORMED_DT), WEI AS (SELECT PMH_MRN, PMH_MEASURE_DTE, WT_KG FROM (SELECT PMH_MRN, PMH_MEASURE_DTE, PMH_WT_KG WT_KG, PMH_MEASURE_SYS , ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY PMH_MRN ORDER BY ABS(DAYS(RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE) - DAYS(PMH_MEASURE_DTE)) ASC) RNK FROM RAD JOIN IDB.PT_MEASURES_HX ON RRPT_MRN = PMH_MRN) WHERE RNK =1 ) SELECT DISTINCT MRN , STRIP(PT_FIRST_NAME) ||' '||STRIP(PT_LAST_NAME) AS NAME , PT_BIRTH_DTE AS DATE_OF_BIRTH , RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE , W.WT_KG "weight" , V.LAB_RESULT_VALUE "vitamin d 25 hydroxy" , P.LAB_RESULT_VALUE "pth" , A.ALBUMIN FROM HCT JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN RAD ON MRN = RRPT_MRN LEFT JOIN VIT V ON RRPT_MRN = V.LR_MRN AND V.LAB_PERFORMED_DT >= MDTE AND V.LAB_PERFORMED_DT <= PDTE LEFT JOIN PTH P ON RRPT_MRN = P.LR_MRN AND P.LAB_PERFORMED_DT >= MDTE AND P.LAB_PERFORMED_DT <= PDTE LEFT JOIN ALBU A ON RRPT_MRN = A.LR_MRN AND A.LAB_PERFORMED_DT >= MDTE AND A.LAB_PERFORMED_DT <= PDTE LEFT JOIN WEI W ON RRPT_MRN = W.PMH_MRN

prompt: Patients diagnosed with non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC) with bone metastases between 1/1/2014-1/1/2018
completion: WITH APPT AS (SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 = 'ORT' ) , ICD AS (SELECT CC_MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) BONE_METS_DTE FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN APPT ON CC_MRN = CPE_MRN WHERE CC_CLSF_CD IN ('C79.51', '198.5') GROUP BY CC_MRN ) SELECT DISTINCT TM_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME "Last Name", PT_FIRST_NAME "First Name", PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH "Date of Birth", C.AV_DESC "Case Status", TM_DX_DTE "Diagnosis Date", TM_HIST_CD "Histology", H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK "Hitology Description", TM_SITE_CD "Site Code", S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK "Site Description", BONE_METS_DTE "Bone Mets Date" FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS C ON C.AV_ELEMENT = 'CASE_STS' AND C.AV_CODE = TM_CASE_STS JOIN ICD ON TM_MRN = CC_MRN JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON TM_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('3', '6', '7', '8') AND TM_SITE_CD LIKE 'C34%' AND TM_DX_DTE BETWEEN '2018-01-01' AND '2020-01-01' AND TM_HIST_CD IN ('M8013/3', 'M8014/3', 'M8022/3', 'M8030/3', 'M8031/3', 'M8032/3', 'M8033/3', 'M8046/3', 'M8052/2', 'M8052/3', 'M8070/2', 'M8070/3', 'M8071/2', 'M8071/3', 'M8072/3', 'M8073/3', 'M8074/2', 'M8074/3', 'M8083/3', 'M8140/2', 'M8140/3', 'M8250/2', 'M8250/3', 'M8251/3', 'M8252/3', 'M8253/3', 'M8254/3', 'M8255/3', 'M8260/2', 'M8260/3', 'M8310/3', 'M8333/3', 'M8480/2', 'M8480/3', 'M8481/3', 'M8490/2', 'M8490/3', 'M8560/2', 'M8560/3', 'M8572/3', 'M8574/3', 'M8972/3', 'M8973/3', 'M8980/3') ; WITH APPT AS (SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 = 'ORT' ) , ICD AS (SELECT CC_MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) BONE_METS_DTE FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN APPT ON CC_MRN = CPE_MRN WHERE CC_CLSF_CD IN ('C79.51', '198.5') GROUP BY CC_MRN ) , DX AS (SELECT DISTINCT TM_MRN, Description", TM_SITE_CD "Site Code", S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK "Site Description", BONE_METS_DTE "Bone Mets Date" FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON prompt: Requesting a tableau dashboard to be developed to report 74th Street Coordinated appointment activity.
completion: WITH SEVEN AS (SELECT PROV.CRE_RES_NAME AS PROVIDER, DEP.CLD_DEPT_NAME AS DEPARTMENT , ENC.CPE_MRN AS MRN, ENC.CPE_ENC_DTE AS APPT_DATE , DEP.CLD_CLD_CENTER AS CENTER , DEP.CLD_DEPT_NAME AS DEPT_NAME, VT.CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME AS VT_NAME, ENC.CPE_ENC_CSN_ID AS CSN_ID, ENC.CPE_CPE_APPT_STS AS APPT_STATUS FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER ENC JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE PROV ON ENC.CPE_VST_RES_ID = PROV.CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE VT ON ENC.CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = VT.CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT DEP ON ENC.CPE_DEPT_ID = DEP.CLD_DEPT_ID WHERE ENC.CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN '2019-01-01' AND CURRENT date AND ENC.CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Comp', 'Arrived') AND (DEP.CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 IN ('BMT', 'LYM', 'MYL', 'LEU', 'HEM', 'EDD', 'ITC', 'THR', 'DER', 'PLA', 'IR', 'HNS', 'DEN', 'PUL', 'END') OR DEP.CLD_DEPT_NAME LIKE 'RO 1275 APP%' OR DEP.CLD_DEPT_NAME LIKE '%HN ENDO%' OR (DEP.CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 ='NUR' AND DEP.CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 ='IR')) AND DEP.CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 NOT IN ('CHM', 'PED') AND DEP.CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_1 <> 'REG' AND ENC.CPE_ENC_TYP_CD = 50 ) , SAMEDAY AS (SELECT B.MRN AS SD_MRN, E.CPE_ENC_DTE AS SD_APPT_DATE, E.CPE_ENC_CSN_ID AS SD_CSN_ID, MD.CRE_RES_NAME AS SD_PROVIDER_NAME, V.CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME AS SD_VT_NAME , D.CLD_DEPT_NAME AS SD_DEPT_NAME, E.CPE_CPE_APPT_STS AS SD_APPT_STATUS, D.CLD_CLD_CENTER AS SD_CENTER FROM SEVEN B JOIN IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER E ON B.MRN = E.CPE_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE MD ON E.CPE_VST_RES_ID = MD.CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE V ON E.CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = V.CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT D ON E.CPE_DEPT_ID = D.CLD_DEPT_ID WHERE E.CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN B.APPT_DATE - 3 DAY AND B.APPT_DATE + 3 DAY AND NOT (D.CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 IN ('BMT', 'LYM', 'MYL', 'LEU', 'HEM', 'EDD', 'ITC', 'THR', 'DER', 'PLA', 'IR', 'HNS', 'DEN', 'PUL', 'END') OR D.CLD_DEPT_NAME LIKE 'RO 1275 APP%' OR D.CLD_DEPT_NAME LIKE '%HN ENDO%' OR (D.CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 ='NUR' AND D.CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 ='IR')) AND D.CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 NOT IN ('CHM', 'PED') AND E.CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Comp', 'Arrived') AND D.CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_1 <> 'REG' AND B.CSN_ID <> E.CPE_ENC_CSN_ID ) SELECT DISTINCT CSN_ID, MRN , PROVIDER, APPT_DATE , DEPT_NAME, VT_NAME, CENTER , APPT_STATUS, SD_MRN, SD_APPT_DATE, SD_CSN_ID, SD_PROVIDER_NAME, SD_VT_NAME , SD_DEPT_NAME, SD_CENTER, SD_APPT_STATUS FROM SEVEN JOIN SAMEDAY ON MRN = SD_MRN AND APPT_DATE BETWEEN SD_APPT_DATE - 3 DAY AND SD_APPT_DATE + 3 DAY

prompt: left diaphragm mesh closure
completion: WITH CLINDOC_0 AS (SELECT "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AS PT_DEID, "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_MRN" AS PT_MRN, "IDB"."CD_DOCUMENT"."CDD_DOC_GUID" AS SUBJECT_ID, "IDB"."CD_DOCUMENT"."CDD_DOC_NAME" AS CD_DOCUMENT_NAME, "IDB"."OMS_PROVIDER"."OP_DISPLAY_NAME" AS CD_PROVIDER_NAME, "IDB"."CD_OBSERVATION"."CDO_ITEM_NAME" AS CD_ITEM FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS" JOIN "IDB"."CD_DOCUMENT" ON "IDB"."CD_DOCUMENT"."CDD_MRN" = "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_MRN" JOIN "IDB"."OMS_PROVIDER" ON "IDB"."CD_DOCUMENT"."CDD_AUTH_PROV_GUID" = "IDB"."OMS_PROVIDER"."OP_PVDR_GUID" JOIN "IDB"."CD_OBSERVATION" ON "IDB"."CD_DOCUMENT"."CDD_DOC_GUID" = "IDB"."CD_OBSERVATION"."CDO_DOC_GUID" AND "IDB"."CD_DOCUMENT"."CDD_AUTHORED_DTE" = "IDB"."CD_OBSERVATION"."CDO_AUTHORED_DTE" AND "IDB"."CD_OBSERVATION"."CDO_VALUE_TEXT" != '' WHERE "IDB"."CD_DOCUMENT"."CDD_CANCEL_IND" != '1' AND "IDB"."CD_DOCUMENT"."CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND" != '1' AND "IDB"."CD_DOCUMENT"."CDD_DOC_NAME" IN ('Operative Report - GYN', 'Operative Report - Surgery', 'Operative Report - Surgery-Gynecology') AND SYSIBM.REGEXP_LIKE("IDB"."OMS_PROVIDER"."OP_DISPLAY_NAME", 'Broach,\D*Vance\D*', 'i') AND "IDB"."CD_OBSERVATION"."CDO_ITEM_NAME" IN ('Diaphragm Closed with Mesh:', 'Left Diaphragm Closed with Mesh:', 'Right Diaphragm Closed with Mesh:')), COHORT AS (SELECT PT_DEID AS PT_DEID FROM (SELECT CLINDOC_0.PT_DEID AS PT_DEID FROM CLINDOC_0)), COHORT_CLINDOC AS (SELECT SUBJECT_ID AS SUBJECT_ID, PT_DEID AS PT_DEID FROM (SELECT CLINDOC_0.SUBJECT_ID AS SUBJECT_ID, CLINDOC_0.PT_DEID AS PT_DEID FROM CLINDOC_0)), KEYS AS (SELECT COHORT.PT_DEID AS COHORT_PT_DEID, COHORT_CLINDOC.SUBJECT_ID AS COHORT_CLINDOC_SUBJECT_ID, COHORT_CLINDOC.PT_DEID AS COHORT_CLINDOC_PT_DEID FROM COHORT LEFT OUTER JOIN COHORT_CLINDOC ON COHORT_CLINDOC.PT_DEID = COHORT.PT_DEID), DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS AS (SELECT DISTINCT "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AS PT_DEID, IDB_PATIENT."PT_MRN" AS PT_MRN, "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AS SUBJECT_ID, TRIM(IDB_PATIENT."PT_LAST_NAME") || ', ' || TRIM(IDB_PATIENT."PT_FIRST_NAME") AS PT_NAME FROM "IDB"."PATIENT" AS IDB_PATIENT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS" ON IDB_PATIENT."PT_MRN" = "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_MRN") SELECT DISTINCT DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS.PT_MRN AS MRN, DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS.PT_NAME AS PT_NAME FROM KEYS LEFT OUTER JOIN DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS ON DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS.PT_DEID = KEYS.COHORT_PT_DEID;

prompt: Provide a daily list of upcoming research patient visits and location for all sarcoma studies.
completion: WITH APPT AS (SELECT CPE_MRN, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_LAST_NAME, CPE_ENC_DTE AS APPT_DATE, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 AS DEPARTMENT, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 AS SERVICE, CLD_DEPT_NAME AS DEPARTMENT_NAME, CLD_CLD_CENTER AS VISIT_LOCATION, CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME AS VISIT_TYPE, CPE_ENC_DTE_SEQ, CPE_MSK_RESCH_IND, AC_IRB_NO, CLD_CLD_CENTER, CPE_CPE_APPT_STS, CPE_APPT_MADE_DTE, CPE_CANCEL_DTE FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.ACCRUALS ON AC_MRN = CPE_MRN AND AC_CONS_DTE IS NOT NULL JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PT_MRN = CPE_MRN WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS = 'Can' AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8= 'SAR' AND CPE_ENC_DTE = CURRENT DATE ) SELECT A.CPE_MRN AS MRN, A.PT_LAST_NAME AS LAST_NAME, A.PT_FIRST_NAME AS FIRST_NAME, LISTAGG(TRIM(A.AC_IRB_NO), ',') AS IRB_NO, A.DEPARTMENT_NAME, A.VISIT_LOCATION, B.CPE_CPE_APPT_STS AS APPT_STS, A.CPE_APPT_MADE_DTE AS MADE_DATE, A.CPE_CANCEL_DTE AS CANCEL_DATE, B.CPE_ENC_DTE AS SCH_APPT_DATE, B.CPE_APPT_DT AS SCH_APPT_TIME FROM APPT A JOIN IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER B ON A.CPE_MRN = B.CPE_MRN AND B.CPE_CPE_APPT_STS = 'Sch' AND A.CPE_MSK_RESCH_IND = B.CPE_ENC_DTE_SEQ GROUP BY A.CPE_MRN, A.PT_LAST_NAME, A.PT_FIRST_NAME, A.VISIT_LOCATION, B.CPE_CPE_APPT_STS, A.CPE_CANCEL_DTE, B.CPE_ENC_DTE, B.CPE_APPT_DT, A.CPE_APPT_MADE_DTE, A.DEPARTMENT_NAME

prompt: Identify all synoptic pathology reports for a set of patient MRNs.
completion: WITH "cte1" AS (SELECT DISTINCT RL.PRX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID, RL.PRX_PATHOLOGY_REPORT_ID, RL.PRX_GRP_NO, RL.PRX_SYNOPTIC_REPORT_ID FROM DV.SYNOPTIC_PATHOLOGY_REPORT_LINE RL) , "cte2" AS (SELECT DISTINCT LINE.PRX_SYNOPTIC_REPORT_ID, WKS.PWD_NAME WORKSHEET_NAME, LINE.PRX_GRP_NO FROM DV.SYNOPTIC_PATHOLOGY_REPORT_LINE LINE INNER JOIN DV.SYNOPTIC_PATHOLOGY_WORKSHEET_DICTIONARY WKS ON WKS.PWD_WORKSHEET_DICT_ID=LINE.PRX_WORKSHEET_DICT_ID) , "cte3" AS (SELECT LINE.PRX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID, LINE.PRX_SYNOPTIC_REPORT_ID, LINE.PRX_GRP_NO, LINE.PRX_PWD_IDENTIFIER WKS_ID, LINE.PRX_PCD_IDENTIFIER CAT_ID, LINE.PRX_PVD_IDENTIFIER VAL_ID, CASE WHEN RTRIM(LINE.PRX_FILLIN) <> '' AND LOCATE(':', VAL.PVD_PRE_TEXT) = 0 THEN RTRIM(RTRIM(VAL.PVD_PRE_TEXT) || ': ' || UPPER(RTRIM(LINE.PRX_FILLIN)) || ' ' || RTRIM(VAL.PVD_POST_TEXT)) WHEN RTRIM(LINE.PRX_FILLIN) <> '' THEN RTRIM(RTRIM(VAL.PVD_PRE_TEXT) || ' ' || UPPER(RTRIM(LINE.PRX_FILLIN)) || ' ' || RTRIM(VAL.PVD_POST_TEXT)) ELSE RTRIM(VAL.PVD_PRE_TEXT) END VALUE_NAME , RTRIM(VAL.PVD_PRE_TEXT) VALUE_NAME_OMIT_OTHER , LINE.PRX_NUM_FILLIN NUM_FILLIN , LINE.PRX_FILLIN_UNIT NUM_FILLIN_UNIT , LINE.PRX_FILLIN FILLIN FROM DV.SYNOPTIC_PATHOLOGY_REPORT_LINE LINE INNER JOIN DV.SYNOPTIC_PATHOLOGY_VALUE_DICTIONARY VAL ON LINE.PRX_VALUE_DICT_ID=VAL.PVD_VALUE_DICT_ID ) SELECT DISTINCT "t1"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AS "Deident PT #", "t2"."PT_MRN" AS "MRN", "t3"."Molecular Testing-Immunohis c1" AS "Molecular Testing-Immunohis c1", "t4"."Tumor Type" AS "Tumor Type", "t5"."WHO Grade" AS "WHO Grade", "t6"."WORKSHEET_NAME" AS "Worksheet", "t7"."PRPT_ACCESSION_NO" AS "Pathology Report", "t8"."DT_DTE" AS "Pathology Report Date", "t9"."PRX_GRP_NO" AS "Part" FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED" "t1" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V" "t2" ON "t1"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t2"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V" "t7" ON "t1"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t7"."PRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "cte1" "t9" ON "t7"."PRPT_PATH_RPT_ID" = "t9"."PRX_PATHOLOGY_REPORT_ID" LEFT JOIN "cte2" "t6" ON "t9"."PRX_SYNOPTIC_REPORT_ID" = "t6"."PRX_SYNOPTIC_REPORT_ID" AND "t9"."PRX_GRP_NO" = "t6"."PRX_GRP_NO" LEFT JOIN (SELECT "t10"."VALUE_NAME" AS "Molecular Testing-Immunohis c1", CHAR("t10"."PRX_SYNOPTIC_REPORT_ID") || CHAR("t10"."PRX_GRP_NO") AS "ID", "t10"."PRX_SYNOPTIC_REPORT_ID", "t10"."PRX_GRP_NO" FROM "cte3" "t10" WHERE ("t10"."WKS_ID" = 'msk51' AND "t10"."CAT_ID" = 'tmsk591') ) "t3" ON "t9"."PRX_SYNOPTIC_REPORT_ID" = "t3"."PRX_SYNOPTIC_REPORT_ID" AND "t9"."PRX_GRP_NO" = "t3"."PRX_GRP_NO" LEFT JOIN (SELECT "t11"."VALUE_NAME" AS "Tumor Type", CHAR("t11"."PRX_SYNOPTIC_REPORT_ID") || CHAR("t11"."PRX_GRP_NO") AS "ID", "t11"."PRX_SYNOPTIC_REPORT_ID", "t11"."PRX_GRP_NO" FROM "cte3" "t11" WHERE ("t11"."WKS_ID" = 'msk51' AND "t11"."CAT_ID" = 'cop2') ) "t4" ON "t9"."PRX_SYNOPTIC_REPORT_ID" = "t4"."PRX_SYNOPTIC_REPORT_ID" AND "t9"."PRX_GRP_NO" = "t4"."PRX_GRP_NO" LEFT JOIN (SELECT "t12"."VALUE_NAME" AS "WHO Grade", CHAR("t12"."PRX_SYNOPTIC_REPORT_ID") || CHAR("t12"."PRX_GRP_NO") AS "ID", "t12"."PRX_SYNOPTIC_REPORT_ID", "t12"."PRX_GRP_NO" FROM "cte3" "t12" WHERE ("t12"."WKS_ID" = 'msk51' AND "t12"."CAT_ID" = 'tmsk491') ) "t5" ON "t9"."PRX_SYNOPTIC_REPORT_ID" = "t5"."PRX_SYNOPTIC_REPORT_ID" AND "t9"."PRX_GRP_NO" = "t5"."PRX_GRP_NO" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE" "t8" ON "t7"."PRPT_REPORT_DATE_ID" = '35270182', '00995204', '35276365', '35239148', '35278444', '35281105', '35272634', '35262525', '35277571', '35272043', '35272911', '35275070', '35272053', '35278016', '35271525', '35272290', prompt: Request to pull all scans preformed on all research patients on 21-206 while on the research protocol.
completion: WITH AC AS (SELECT AC_IRB_NO, AC_MRN FROM IDB.ACCRUALS WHERE AC_IRB_NO = '21-206' ) SELECT DISTINCT "t1"."PT_MRN" AS "MRN", "t2"."RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE" AS "Radiology Performed Date", "t2"."RRPT_REPORT_DTE" AS "Radiology Report Date", "t2"."RRPT_ORDER_GROUP" AS "Radiology Order Group", "t2"."RRPT_PROCEDURE_NAME" AS "Radiology Procedure Name", UPPER(DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)IMPRESSION:[\w\W]*(?=DICTATED BY:)', RRPT_REPORT_TXT)) AS IMPRESSION, UPPER(CASE WHEN LENGTH(RRPT_REPORT_TXT) <= 15000 THEN RTRIM(CAST(SUBSTR(RRPT_REPORT_TXT, 1, 15000) AS VARCHAR(15000))) ELSE CAST(SUBSTR(RRPT_REPORT_TXT, 1, 15000) AS VARCHAR(15000)) END) AS "PRPT_REPORT" FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V" "t1" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED" "t3" ON "t1"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t3"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."RADIOLOGY_REPORT_V" "t2" ON "t3"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t2"."RRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_IDENTIFICATION_MRN_V" "t4" ON "t1"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t4"."PI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" WHERE "t4"."PI_SOURCE_SYSTEM_PT_ID" IN (SELECT AC_MRN FROM AC) AND("t2"."RRPT_ORDER_GROUP" IN ('MR', 'CT') OR "t2"."RRPT_PROCEDURE_NAME" like '%MIBG%')

prompt: Search for cases with a diagnosis of "Microglandular adenosis" in the breast
