prompt: Provide patients with Multiple Myeloma who had or were currently on systemic treatment (immunotherapy, chemotherapy, and/or chemotherapy) prior to radiation therapy treatment start.
completion: WITH X AS (SELECT DISTINCT CC_MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS MIN_ICD9_EFF_DTE, CC_CLSF_CD AS ICD9_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS ICD9_DESC FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE (CC_CLSF_CD) IN ('203', '203.0', '203.00', '203.01', '203.02', 'C90', 'C90.00', 'C90.01', 'C90.02', 'C90.10', 'C90.11', 'C90.12', 'C90.20', 'C90.21', 'C90.22', 'C90.30', 'C90.31', 'C90.32') AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND (CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) GROUP BY CC_MRN, CC_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK ), RAD AS (SELECT DISTINCT RTC_TX_MRN, RTC_TX_COURSE_ID, RTC_TX_PLAN_NAME, RTC_TX_DELIVERED_FRACTIONS, RTC_TX_DELIVERED_DOSE, RTC_TX_START_DTE, RTC_TX_STOP_DTE, RTC_DOSE_CORRECTION FROM X JOIN IDB.RADONC_TREATMENT_COURSE ON X.CC_MRN = RTC_TX_MRN WHERE RTC_TX_START_DTE BETWEEN '2010-01-01' AND '2022-12-31' ) , BMT AS (SELECT DISTINCT CDD_MRN BMT_MRN, CDD_SERVICE_DTE AS BMT_DATE, CDD_DOC_NAME AS "Document Name", OP_DISPLAY_NAME AS "Provider", CDO_SECTION AS "Section", CDO_ITEM_NAME AS "Item", CDO_VALUE_TEXT AS "Value" FROM RAD JOIN IDB.CD_DOCUMENT ON RTC_TX_MRN= CDD_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION ON CDD_DOC_GUID = CDO_DOC_GUID AND CDD_AUTHORED_DTE = CDO_AUTHORED_DTE AND CDO_VALUE_TEXT <> '' JOIN IDB.OMS_PROVIDER ON CDD_AUTH_PROV_GUID = OP_PVDR_GUID WHERE CDD_CANCEL_IND <> '1' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND <> '1' AND ((CDD_DOC_NAME) IN 'Cell Infusion - BMT') AND CDD_SERVICE_DTE <=RTC_TX_START_DTE ) , CHEMO AS (SELECT DISTINCT * FROM (SELECT APR_MRN CHEMO_MRN, APR_START_DTE CHEMO_DATE, APR_END_DTE, CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME, APR_GENERIC_NAME, CDG_CHEMO_FLAG, APR_PRESCRIBED_DOSE, APR_ROUTE, ROWNUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY APR_MRN ORDER BY APR_START_DTE DESC) RN FROM RAD JOIN IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX_V ON RTC_TX_MRN= APR_MRN WHERE APR_START_DTE <=RTC_TX_START_DTE AND CDG_CHEMO_FLAG = 'Y' ) WHERE RN=1 ) , IMMUNO AS (SELECT DISTINCT * FROM (SELECT DISTINCT APR_MRN IMMUNO_MRN , APR_START_DTE IMMUNO_DATE, APR_END_DTE, CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME, APR_GENERIC_NAME, APR_PRESCRIBED_DOSE, CDG_BIOLOGIC_IMMUNO_FLAG, APR_ROUTE, ROWNUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY APR_MRN ORDER BY APR_START_DTE DESC) RN FROM RAD JOIN IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX ON RTC_TX_MRN =APR_MRN JOIN IDB.CHEMO_DRUG_GENERIC ON APR_GENERIC_NAME = CDG_GENERIC_NAME WHERE CDG_BIOLOGIC_IMMUNO_FLAG = 'Y' AND CDG_THERAPEUTIC_CATEGORY like '%anti-%' ) WHERE RN=1 ) , NOTE AS (SELECT DISTINCT CDD_MRN, MD_NOTE_DATE FROM (SELECT DISTINCT CDD_MRN, CDD_SERVICE_DTE AS MD_NOTE_DATE, CDD_DOC_NAME AS "Document Name", OP_DISPLAY_NAME AS "Provider", CDD_DOC_GUID AS "Document Guid", CDO_SECTION AS "Section", CDO_ITEM_NAME AS "Item", CDO_VALUE_TEXT AS "Value", ROWNUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY CDD_MRN ORDER BY CDD_SERVICE_DTE DESC) RNK FROM RAD JOIN IDB.CD_DOCUMENT ON RTC_TX_MRN= CDD_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION ON CDD_DOC_GUID = CDO_DOC_GUID AND CDD_AUTHORED_DTE = CDO_AUTHORED_DTE AND CDO_VALUE_TEXT <> '' JOIN IDB.OMS_PROVIDER ON CDD_AUTH_PROV_GUID = OP_PVDR_GUID WHERE CDD_CANCEL_IND <> '1' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND <> '1' AND (UPPER(CDD_DOC_NAME) like 'FOLLOW%UP%' OR UPPER(CDD_DOC_NAME) like 'PROGRESS%NOTE%BMT%') ) WHERE RNK=1 ) SELECT DISTINCT RTC_TX_MRN MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, PT_RACE, PT_SEX, RTC_TX_PLAN_NAME, RTC_TX_DELIVERED_FRACTIONS, RTC_TX_DELIVERED_DOSE, RTC_TX_START_DTE, RTC_TX_STOP_DTE, CHEMO_DATE, BMT_DATE, IMMUNO_DATE, MD_NOTE_DATE, PT_DEATH_IND, PT_DATE_OF_DEATH FROM RAD LEFT JOIN BMT ON RTC_TX_MRN = BMT_MRN LEFT JOIN CHEMO ON RTC_TX_MRN = CHEMO_MRN LEFT JOIN IMMUNO ON RTC_TX_MRN = IMMUNO_MRN LEFT JOIN NOTE ON RTC_TX_MRN = CDD_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON RTC_TX_MRN = PT_MRN

prompt: Provide a list all patients who have Albumin-Bound PACLItaxel INJ order in CIS that was ordered in the past 6 months by an STGI doctor.
completion: SELECT OO_ORD_GUID , OO_ACCT_NO ACCT_NO , OO_MRN MRN, STRIP(PT_LAST_NAME)||', '||STRIP(PT_FIRST_NAME) PT_NAME , OO_ENTER_DTE ORD_ENTER_DTE, OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE START_DTE , OO_ORD_ID ORDID , OO_ORD_NAME ORD_NAME , OO_ORD_STS_CD ORD_STS , OP_DISPLAY_NAME PVDR_NAME , OCV_CURR_LOC LOCATION , OO_SUMMARY_LINE FROM IDB.OMS_ORDER JOIN IDB.OMS_PROVIDER ON OO_PVDR_GUID = OP_PVDR_GUID JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON OO_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.OMS_CLIENT_VISIT ON OO_VISIT_GUID = OCV_VISIT_GUID WHERE OO_ENTER_DTE >= CURRENT DATE - 6 MONTH AND OO_ORD_STS_CD NOT LIKE 'CA%' AND OO_ORD_NAME = 'Albumin-Bound PACLItaxel INJ' AND OP_PVDR_NO IN ('006635', '010124', '015487', '012104', '017178', '004283', '015016', '003509', '003699', '017202', '016782', '014035', '002766', '016360', '015677') ORDER BY 9, 3

prompt: Create a list of patients who had surgery performed in the Breast service.
completion: SELECT DISTINCT STRIP(SSE_MRN) AS MRN, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH AS DOB, SSE_SURG_DTE AS "Surgery Date", STRIP(SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD) AS "CPT Code", STRIP(SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC) AS "Surgery Description", STRIP(SSP_LATERALITY) AS "Laterality" FROM IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE ON SSE_LOG_ID = SSP_LOG_ID JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PT_MRN = SSE_MRN WHERE 1=1 AND SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD IN ('19301', '19302', '19303', '19304', '19307', '38500', '38525', '38530', '38740', '38745')

prompt: Provide a list of patients with a diagnosis of small cell lung cancer evaluated at MSKCC from 2008 to the present.
completion: WITH TPS AS (SELECT DISTINCT "t4"."PRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID", "t2"."TBA_PART_NUM" , "t2"."TBA_TISSUE_TYPE_DESC", "t2"."TBA_SITE_DESC" , "t2"."TBA_HISTOLOGY_DESC" , "t3"."TBD_CATEGORY_DESC" , "t3"."TBD_QUALITY_DESC" , "t4"."PRPT_ACCESSION_NO" FROM "DV"."PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V" "t4" LEFT JOIN "DV"."TISSUE_BANK_ACCESSION" "t2" ON "t4"."PRPT_PATH_RPT_ID" = "t2"."TBA_REPORT_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."TISSUE_BANK_DETAIL" "t3" ON "t2"."TBA_REPORT_ID" = "t3"."TBD_REPORT_ID" AND "t2"."TBA_PART_NUM" = "t3"."TBD_PART_NUM" AND "t2"."TBA_SUB_PART_NUM" = "t3"."TBD_SUB_PART_NUM" WHERE "t3"."TBD_REPORT_ID" IS NOT NULL AND TBA_CANCER_CONSENT = 'Yes' AND TBA_OTHER_CONSENT = 'Yes' AND TBA_GENETIC_CONSENT = 'Yes' ) SELECT DISTINCT "t2"."PT_MRN" AS "MRN", "t2"."PT_SEX" AS "Gender", "t2"."PT_RACE_DESC" AS "Race", "t2"."PT_VITAL_STATUS" AS "Vital Status", MIN("t4"."DT_DTE") AS "Min Encounter Date", MAX("t4"."DT_DTE") AS "Max Encounter Date", "t5"."DT_DTE" AS "Tumor Diagnosis Date", "t3"."DXCC_ICD_CODE" AS "ICD-O Histology Code", "t3"."DXCC_ICD_MSK_DESC" AS "ICD-O Histology Desc", "t3"."ICSC_SITE_CD" AS "ICD-O Site Code", "t3"."ICSC_ICDO_SITE_MSK_DESC" AS "ICD-O Site Desc", T."PRPT_ACCESSION_NO" AS "Path Report Accession", T."TBA_PART_NUM" AS "Part Number", T."TBA_TISSUE_TYPE_DESC" AS "Tissue Type Desc", T."TBA_SITE_DESC" AS "Site Desc", T."TBA_HISTOLOGY_DESC" AS "Histology Desc", T."TBD_CATEGORY_DESC" AS "Category Desc", T."TBD_QUALITY_DESC" AS "Quality Desc" FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED" "t1" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V" "t2" ON "t1"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t2"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_ICDO_DIAGNOSIS_V" "t3" ON "t1"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t3"."PDX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE" "t5" ON "t3"."PDX_DX_DATE_ID" = "t5"."DT_DATE_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_ENCOUNTER" "t6" ON "t1"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t6"."PENC_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE" "t4" ON "t6"."PENC_ENC_DATE_ID" = "t4"."DT_DATE_ID" LEFT JOIN TPS T ON "t1"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = T."PRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" WHERE ("t3"."DXCC_ICD_CODE" IN ('M8041/3') AND ("t3"."ICSC_SITE_CD" IN ('C341', 'C342', 'C343', 'C348', 'C349') AND "t4"."DT_YEAR" BETWEEN 2008 AND 2012)) GROUP BY "t2"."PT_MRN" , "t2"."PT_SEX" , "t2"."PT_RACE_DESC", "t2"."PT_VITAL_STATUS" , "t5"."DT_DTE", "t3"."DXCC_ICD_CODE", "t3"."DXCC_ICD_MSK_DESC", "t3"."ICSC_SITE_CD", "t3"."ICSC_ICDO_SITE_MSK_DESC", T."PRPT_ACCESSION_NO", T."TBA_PART_NUM", T."TBA_TISSUE_TYPE_DESC", T."TBA_SITE_DESC", T."TBA_HISTOLOGY_DESC", T."TBD_CATEGORY_DESC", T."TBD_QUALITY_DESC"

prompt: list of protocol patients who are alive as of their last visit at MSK
completion: SELECT ACD_MRN AS MRN, TRIM(PT_LAST_NAME) || ', ' || TRIM(PT_FIRST_NAME) PATIENT_NAME, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, PT_DATE_OF_DEATH, PLA_LST_APPT_DTE AS LAST_APPT_DTE, ACD_TX_ST_DTE AS TX_START_DTE, ACD_TX_END_DTE AS TX_END_DTE, ACD_CONS_DTE AS CONSENT_DTE FROM IDB.ACCRUALS_DATES JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON ACD_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY ON ACD_MRN = PLA_MRN WHERE ACD_IRB_NO = '94-018'; SELECT ACD_MRN AS MRN, TRIM(PT_LAST_NAME) || ', ' || TRIM(PT_FIRST_NAME) PATIENT_NAME, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, PT_DATE_OF_DEATH, PLA_LST_APPT_DTE AS LAST_APPT_DTE, ACD_TX_ST_DTE AS TX_START_DTE, ACD_TX_END_DTE AS TX_END_DTE, ACD_CONS_DTE AS CONSENT_DTE FROM IDB.ACCRUALS_DATES JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON ACD_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY ON ACD_MRN = PLA_MRN WHERE ACD_IRB_NO = '03-077'; SELECT ACD_MRN AS MRN, TRIM(PT_LAST_NAME) || ', ' || TRIM(PT_FIRST_NAME) PATIENT_NAME, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, PT_DATE_OF_DEATH, PLA_LST_APPT_DTE AS LAST_APPT_DTE, ACD_TX_ST_DTE AS TX_START_DTE, ACD_TX_END_DTE AS TX_END_DTE, ACD_CONS_DTE AS CONSENT_DTE FROM IDB.ACCRUALS_DATES JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON ACD_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY ON ACD_MRN = PLA_MRN WHERE ACD_IRB_NO = '12-230'; SELECT ACD_MRN AS MRN, TRIM(PT_LAST_NAME) || ', ' || TRIM(PT_FIRST_NAME) PATIENT_NAME, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, PT_DATE_OF_DEATH, PLA_LST_APPT_DTE AS LAST_APPT_DTE, ACD_TX_ST_DTE AS TX_START_DTE, ACD_TX_END_DTE AS TX_END_DTE, ACD_CONS_DTE AS CONSENT_DTE FROM IDB.ACCRUALS_DATES JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON ACD_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY ON ACD_MRN = PLA_MRN WHERE ACD_IRB_NO = '16-1643'; SELECT ACD_MRN AS MRN, TRIM(PT_LAST_NAME) || ', ' || TRIM(PT_FIRST_NAME) PATIENT_NAME, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, PT_DATE_OF_DEATH, PLA_LST_APPT_DTE AS LAST_APPT_DTE, ACD_TX_ST_DTE AS TX_START_DTE, ACD_TX_END_DTE AS TX_END_DTE, ACD_CONS_DTE AS CONSENT_DTE FROM IDB.ACCRUALS_DATES JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON ACD_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY ON ACD_MRN = PLA_MRN WHERE ACD_IRB_NO = '13-260';

prompt: Provide a list of patients who were diagnosed with epithelial tumors (pleomorphic adenoma, adenoid cystic carcinoma, or pleomorphic carcinoma).
completion: WITH X AS (SELECT DISTINCT "t1"."PT_MRN" AS "MRN", STRIP(PT_LAST_NAME) AS "Last Name", STRIP(PT_FIRST_NAME) AS "First Name", PT_DEATH_DTE AS DOD, "t3"."DT_DTE" AS "Pathology Procedure Date", "t4"."DT_DTE" AS "Pathology Report Date", "t5"."PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_DESC" AS "Pathology Report Type", "t2"."PRPT_ACCESSION_NO" AS "Pathology Report", UPPER(CASE WHEN LENGTH(PRPT_REPORT) <= 15000 THEN RTRIM(CAST(SUBSTR(PRPT_REPORT, 1, 15000) AS VARCHAR(15000))) ELSE CAST(SUBSTR(PRPT_REPORT, 1, 15000) AS VARCHAR(15000)) END) AS FULL_TEXT, UPPER(DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)SPECIMENS SUBMITTED:[\w\W]*(?=DIAGNOSIS:)', PRPT_REPORT)) AS "Specimens Submitted", UPPER(DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)DIAGNOSIS:[\w\W]*(?=I ATTEST)', PRPT_REPORT)) AS "Diagnosis" FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V" "t1" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED" "t6" ON "t1"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t6"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V" "t2" ON "t6"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t2"."PRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" "t3" ON "t2"."PRPT_PROCEDURE_DATE_ID" = "t3"."DT_DATE_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" "t4" ON "t2"."PRPT_REPORT_DATE_ID" = "t4"."DT_DATE_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATH_RPRT_TYPE_LOOKUP" "t5" ON "t2"."PRPT_REPORT_TYPE" = "t5"."PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_CD" WHERE ((CONTAINS("t2"."PRPT_REPORT", '("pleomorphic adenoma" | "adenoid cystic carcinoma" | "pleomorphic carcinoma")') = 1 AND CONTAINS("t2"."PRPT_REPORT", '("lacrimal" | "eye")') = 1) AND ("t2"."PRPT_REPORT" IS NOT NULL AND "t2"."PRPT_REPORT" IS NOT NULL)) ) , DMP AS (SELECT DISTINCT PDRX_DMP_PATIENT_ID, PT_MRN FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_STRUCTURED_RESULTS_V SR JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML XM ON PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PDRX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID WHERE 1=1 AND PT_MRN IN (SELECT MRN FROM X) ) , CPE AS (SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN, CPE_ENC_DTE, CRE_RES_NAME, CRE_RES_TYP, CLD_DEPT_NAME, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8, CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CPE_MRN ORDER BY CPE_ENC_DTE) AS RN FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp', 'Sch') AND CRE_RES_TYP IN ('Physician') AND CPE_ENC_DTE >= CURRENT DATE AND CPE_MRN IN (SELECT MRN FROM X) ) , MAIN AS (SELECT X."MRN", PDRX_DMP_PATIENT_ID, "Last Name", "First Name", DOD, CPE_ENC_DTE AS NEXT_APPT, CRE_RES_NAME AS NEXT_APPT_MD, "Pathology Procedure Date", "Pathology Report Date", "Pathology Report Type", "Pathology Report", "Specimens Submitted", "Diagnosis", FULL_TEXT FROM X LEFT JOIN DMP ON MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN CPE ON X.MRN = CPE_MRN AND RN = 1) , AC AS (SELECT AC_MRN AS MRN, MAX(CASE WHEN AC_IRB_NO = '06-107' THEN AC_CONS_DTE END) AS "06-107", MAX(CASE WHEN AC_IRB_NO = '12-245' THEN AC_CONS_DTE END) AS "12-245" FROM MAIN JOIN IDB.ACCRUALS AC ON MRN = AC_MRN WHERE AC_IRB_NO IN ('06-107', '12-245') GROUP BY AC_MRN ) , Y AS (SELECT MRN, MAX(CASE WHEN CRDB.PRT_ID = '12-245' AND REG_ID = '100' THEN DATE(CRDB.CRNT_CONSENT_DATE) END) "12-245 Part A Consent Date", MAX(CASE WHEN CRDB.PRT_ID = '12-245' AND REG_ID = '300' THEN DATE(CRDB.CRNT_CONSENT_DATE) END) "12-245 Part C Consent Date", MAX(CASE WHEN CRDB.PRT_ID = '06-107' THEN DATE(CRDB.CRNT_CONSENT_DATE) END) AS "06-107 Consent Date" FROM MAIN JOIN NN.CRDB_DASH_PT_REG CRDB ON MRN = PT_MRN AND((CRDB.PRT_ID = '12-245' AND REG_ID IN ('100', '200', '300')) OR (CRDB.PRT_ID = '06-107')) AND CRNT_ELGBL_STATUS_DSCRP NOT IN ('Ineligible', 'Cancel') GROUP BY MRN) SELECT MAIN.*, "06-107", "12-245", "12-245 Part A Consent Date", "12-245 Part C Consent Date" FROM MAIN LEFT JOIN AC ON MAIN.MRN = AC.MRN LEFT JOIN Y ON MAIN.MRN = Y.MRN

prompt: Provide a Darwin cohort of patients for the given criteria along with access to the patients in the Darwin Digital Platform.
completion: WITH PTS AS (SELECT PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID PID FROM DV.PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED) , DT_1 AS (SELECT PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID AS P_ID FROM DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS REC LEFT JOIN DV.PATIENT_CORE_DEMOGRAPHICS ON PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = CORE_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID WHERE 1=1 AND PT_VITAL_STATUS IN ('ALIVE') ) , DT_2 AS (SELECT INC.PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID P_ID FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_STRUCTURED_RESULTS_V INC LEFT JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_STRUCTURED_RESULTS_V EX ON INC.PRPT_PATH_RPT_ID = EX.PRPT_PATH_RPT_ID AND EX.GENE IN ('TP53') JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML DT ON INC.PRPT_PATH_RPT_ID = DT.PDRX_PATH_RPT_ID CROSS JOIN XMLTABLE('$c/root/meta-data' PASSING DT.PDRX_XML_VALUE AS "c" COLUMNS PRIMARY_SITE VARCHAR(264) PATH 'primary_site', TUMOR_TYPE_NAME VARCHAR(264) PATH 'tumor_type_name' , TUMOR_TYPE_CODE VARCHAR(264) PATH 'tumor_type_code', IS_METASTASIS VARCHAR(3) PATH 'is_metastasis' , METASTASIS_SITE VARCHAR(264) PATH 'metastasis_site' , MSI_COMMENT VARCHAR(264) PATH 'msi-comment' , MSI_SCORE VARCHAR(264) PATH 'msi-score' , MSI_TYPE VARCHAR(264) PATH 'msi-type' , TMB_SCORE VARCHAR(25) PATH 'tmb_score' , TMB_COUNT VARCHAR(25) PATH 'tmb-count', COSMIC_ID VARCHAR(5000) PATH 'cosmic_id') T JOIN (SELECT T.TUMOR_TYPE_CODE TTC FROM TABLE(DV.STRING_SPLIT('BILIARY_TRACT,PANCREAS,AMPULLA_OF_VATER,CUP', ',')) S CROSS JOIN TABLE(DV.ONCOTREE_CHILDREN(COLUMN_VALUES)) T) X ON T.TUMOR_TYPE_CODE = TRIM(X.TTC) WHERE 1=1 AND (INC.GENE IN ('MDM2') OR INC.GENE2 IN ('MDM2')) AND INC.FOLD_CHANGE >= 2 AND EX.PRPT_PATH_RPT_ID IS NULL AND CASE WHEN INC.METHOD = 'IMPACT' THEN 'IMPACT' WHEN INC.METHOD like 'IMPACTv%' THEN 'IMPACT' WHEN INC.METHOD = 'ArcherHeme' THEN 'ArcherHeme' WHEN INC.METHOD like 'ArcherHemeV%' THEN 'ArcherHeme' WHEN LOWER(INC.METHOD) like LOWER('ArcherPanHemeV%') THEN 'ArcherPanHeme' WHEN INC.METHOD = 'Archer' THEN 'Archer' WHEN LOWER(INC.METHOD) like 'archerv%' THEN 'Archer' WHEN INC.METHOD like 'ACCESSv%' THEN 'ACCESS' WHEN INC.METHOD like 'IMPACTHv%' THEN 'IMPACTHeme' WHEN INC.METHOD like 'RDTB%' THEN 'RDTB' WHEN INC.METHOD like 'RDTS%' THEN 'RDTS' ELSE INC.METHOD END IN ('IMPACT', 'ACCESS') ) , DEID AS (SELECT DISTINCT P_ID FROM (SELECT P_ID FROM DT_1 INTERSECT SELECT P_ID FROM DT_2 )) SELECT * FROM DEID

prompt: Patient MRNs identified as COVID-positive without lab results
completion: SELECT MRN, POSITIVE_SOURCES FROM IDB.PATIENT_COVID_INFO_V WHERE UPPER(POSITIVE_SOURCES) NOT LIKE '%ORDER_AND_RESULT%' AND RESULT IN ('Positive', 'Resolved')

prompt: To provide information about thyroid cancer patients who went through surgeries since 2015
completion: WITH CDB AS (SELECT TM_MRN, TM_DX_DTE DX_DTE, STRIP(TM_SITE_CD)||'-'||S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK DX_CODE, STRIP(TM_HIST_CD)||'-'||H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK DX_DESC, TM_CA_SURG_DTE CA_SURG_DTE , TM_PATH_TNM_T PATH_TNM_T, TM_PATH_TNM_N PATH_TNM_N, TM_PATH_TNM_M PATH_TNM_M FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM H ON TM_HIST_CD = H.CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON TM_SITE_CD = S.CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('3') AND TM_SITE_CD = 'C739' AND TM_DX_DTE BETWEEN '2015-01-01' AND '2019-12-31' ) , CLSF AS (SELECT MRN, DX_DTE, DX_CODE, DX_DESC FROM (SELECT T.CC_MRN MRN, T.CC_EFF_DTE AS DX_DTE, T.CC_CLSF_CD AS DX_CODE, T1.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS DX_DESC, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY T.CC_MRN ORDER BY T.CC_EFF_DTE) RN FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF T JOIN IDB.CLM T1 ON T.CC_CLSF_CD = T1.CLM_CLSF_CD LEFT JOIN CDB ON TM_MRN = CC_MRN WHERE TM_MRN IS NULL AND SUBSTR(T.CC_CLSF_CD, 1, 3) IN ('C73', '193') AND T.CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND (T.CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y' OR T.CC_PT_TYPE = 'I') ) AS A WHERE RN = 1 AND DX_DTE BETWEEN '2015-01-01' AND '2019-12-31' ) , STAGING AS (SELECT CDD_MRN, MAX(TNM_T)TNM_T, MAX(TNM_N)TNM_N, MAX(TNM_M)TNM_M, MAX(STAGE)STAGE FROM (SELECT CDD_MRN, CDD_SERVICE_DT, MAX(CASE WHEN CDO_ITEM_NAME IN ('T', 'T:', 'Stage T:', 'T Stage', 'T Stage:') THEN SUBSTR(STRIP(CDO_VALUE_TEXT), 1, 200) END) AS TNM_T, MAX(CASE WHEN CDO_ITEM_NAME IN ('N', 'N Stage', 'N:', 'Stage N') THEN SUBSTR(STRIP(CDO_VALUE_TEXT), 1, 200) END) AS TNM_N, MAX(CASE WHEN CDO_ITEM_NAME IN ('M', 'M Stage', 'M:', 'Staging M') THEN SUBSTR(STRIP(CDO_VALUE_TEXT), 1, 200) END) AS TNM_M, MAX(CASE WHEN CDO_ITEM_NAME IN ('Stage of Disease:', 'Stage', 'Stage:', 'STAGE:', 'Staging') THEN SUBSTR(STRIP(CDO_VALUE_TEXT), 1, 200) END) AS STAGE FROM IDB.CD_DOCUMENT JOIN CLSF ON MRN = CDD_MRN JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION ON CDD_DOC_GUID = CDO_DOC_GUID AND CDD_AUTHORED_DTE = CDO_AUTHORED_DTE WHERE 1=1 AND CDO_ITEM_NAME IN ('M', 'M Stage', 'M:', 'Staging M', 'N', 'N Stage', 'N:', 'Stage N', 'Stage of Disease:', 'Stage', 'Stage:', 'STAGE:', 'Staging', 'T', 'T Stage', 'T Stage:', 'T:', 'Stage T:') AND CDD_CANCEL_IND <> '1' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND <> '1' AND CDO_LARGE_VALUE_TEXT_IND <> 'Y' GROUP BY CDD_MRN, CDD_SERVICE_DT) A GROUP BY CDD_MRN) , PTS AS (SELECT TM_MRN MRN, DX_DTE, DX_CODE, DX_DESC, CA_SURG_DTE, PATH_TNM_T, PATH_TNM_N, PATH_TNM_M FROM CDB UNION SELECT MRN, DX_DTE, DX_CODE, DX_DESC, CAST(NULL AS DATE) CA_SURG_DTE, COALESCE(TNM_T, '')PATH_TNM_T, COALESCE(TNM_N, '') PATH_TNM_N, COALESCE(TNM_M, '') PATH_TNM_M FROM CLSF LEFT JOIN STAGING ON MRN = CDD_MRN) , SRG AS (SELECT DISTINCT MRN, STRIP(PT_LAST_NAME)||', '||PT_FIRST_NAME PT_NAME, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH DOB, PT_DATE_OF_DEATH DOD, YEAR(COALESCE(PT_DATE_OF_DEATH, CURRENT DATE)) - YEAR(PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) "Current Age or at death", PT_SEX_DESC SEX, PT_RACE_DESC RACE, PT_PT_ETHNICITY_DESC ETHNICITY, DX_DTE, DX_CODE, DX_DESC , PATH_TNM_T, PATH_TNM_N, PATH_TNM_M, OL_LOG_ID LOGID, OL_CASE_CLASS CASE_CLASS, LOC_LOC_NAME SURGERY_LOCATION, OL_ASA_RATING ASA_RATING, OL_SURG_DTE SURG_DTE, CA_SURG_DTE, CRE_RES_NAME PRIMARY_SURGEON, CPX_PROC_CD PROC_CD, CPX_PROC_NAME PROC_NAME, OL_LOG_SVC SVC FROM IDB.OR_LOG JOIN PTS ON MRN = OL_MRN AND OL_SURG_DTE >= COALESCE(CA_SURG_DTE, DX_DTE) JOIN IDB.PATIENT_V ON MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_LOCATION ON OL_SURG_LOC_ID = LOC_LOC_ID JOIN IDB.OR_LOG_ALL_PROC ON OL_LOG_ID = OLAP_LOG_ID JOIN IDB.OR_LOG_ALL_SURG ON OLAP_LOG_ID = OLAS_LOG_ID AND OLAP_PNL_NO = OLAS_PNL_NO AND OLAS_SURG_ROLE = 'Primary' JOIN IDB.OR_PROC ON OLAP_OR_PROC_ID = OP_OR_PROC_ID JOIN IDB.OR_CL_PROC ON OP_OR_PROC_ID = OCP_OR_PROC_ID JOIN IDB.CL_PROC ON OCP_PROC_ID = CPX_PROC_ID JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CRE_RES_ID = OLAS_RES_ID WHERE OL_LOG_STS IN ('Posted', 'Unposted') AND OL_LOG_SVC = 'HNS' ) , RT AS (SELECT RTCA_TX_MRN, RTCA_TX_COURSE_NO, RTCA_TX_PLAN_NAME, RTCA_TX_DELIVERED_FRACTIONS, RTCA_TX_DELIVERED_DOSE, RTCA_TX_START_DTE, RTCA_TX_STOP_DTE, RTCA_PRIMARY_REF_POINT FROM SRG JOIN IDB.RADONC_TREATMENT_COURSE_ALLPLANS ON MRN = RTCA_TX_MRN WHERE RTCA_TX_START_DTE >= SURG_DTE) SELECT DISTINCT MRN, PT_NAME, DOB, DOD, "Current Age or at death", SEX, RACE, ETHNICITY, DX_DTE, DX_CODE, DX_DESC, PATH_TNM_T, PATH_TNM_N, PATH_TNM_M, LOGID, CASE_CLASS, SURGERY_LOCATION, ASA_RATING, SURG_DTE, PRIMARY_SURGEON, PROC_CD, PROC_NAME, SVC, RTCA_TX_PLAN_NAME RT_PLAN_NAME, RTCA_TX_DELIVERED_FRACTIONS DELIVERED_FRACTIONS, RTCA_TX_DELIVERED_DOSE DELIVERED_DOSE, RTCA_TX_START_DTE RT_START_DTE, RTCA_TX_STOP_DTE RT_STOP_DTE, RTCA_PRIMARY_REF_POINT REF_POINT , SVC FROM SRG LEFT JOIN RT ON MRN = RTCA_TX_MRN

prompt: Radiology Reports for a list of patients
Provide a list of all patients who received liposomal doxorubicin and had a diagnosis of plantar palmar erythrodysesthesia (PPE)in 2019-2022
completion: WITH APR AS (SELECT APR_MRN, APR_START_DTE, APR_GENERIC_NAME, APR_TOTAL_GIVEN_DOSE, APR_DOSE_UOM, APR_ROUTE FROM IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX JOIN IDB.CHEMO_DRUG_GENERIC ON APR_GENERIC_NAME = CDG_GENERIC_NAME WHERE APR_START_DTE >= '2019-01-01' AND CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME LIKE '%DOXORUBICIN LIPOSOMAL%' AND CDG_CHEMO_FLAG = 'Y' AND APR_TOTAL_GIVEN_DOSE IS NOT NULL ), APR_MIN_2019 AS (SELECT APR_MRN DOX_MRN, MIN(APR_START_DTE) AS DOX_MIN_START_DTE FROM APR GROUP BY APR_MRN), APR_MIN AS (SELECT DOX_MRN AS APR_MRN, MIN(DOX_MIN_START_DTE) AS MIN_START_DTE FROM APR_MIN_2019 D JOIN IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX A ON D.DOX_MRN = A.APR_MRN JOIN IDB.CHEMO_DRUG_GENERIC ON APR_GENERIC_NAME = CDG_GENERIC_NAME WHERE CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME LIKE '%DOXORUBICIN LIPOSOMAL%' AND CDG_CHEMO_FLAG = 'Y' GROUP BY DOX_MRN HAVING MIN(APR_START_DTE) >= '2019-01-01') , APR_MAX AS (SELECT E.APR_MRN AS MAX_MRN, MAX(APR_END_DTE) AS MAX_ORD_END_DATE FROM APR_MIN E JOIN IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX F ON E.APR_MRN =F.APR_MRN JOIN IDB.CHEMO_DRUG_GENERIC ON APR_GENERIC_NAME = CDG_GENERIC_NAME WHERE CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME LIKE '%DOXORUBICIN LIPOSOMAL%' AND CDG_CHEMO_FLAG = 'Y' GROUP BY E.APR_MRN), APR_MINMAX_DETAILS_ALL AS (SELECT B.APR_MRN, APR_START_DTE, MIN_START_DTE, MAX_ORD_END_DATE, APR_GENERIC_NAME, SUM(APR_TOTAL_GIVEN_DOSE) AS APR_TOTAL_GIVEN_DOSE, APR_DOSE_UOM, APR_ROUTE FROM APR_MIN B JOIN APR A ON A.APR_MRN = B.APR_MRN JOIN APR_MAX J ON J.MAX_MRN=B.APR_MRN GROUP BY B.APR_MRN, APR_START_DTE, MIN_START_DTE, MAX_ORD_END_DATE, APR_GENERIC_NAME, APR_DOSE_UOM, APR_ROUTE) , APR_MINMAX_DETAILS AS (SELECT DISTINCT APR_MRN, APR_START_DTE, MIN_START_DTE, MAX_ORD_END_DATE, APR_GENERIC_NAME, APR_TOTAL_GIVEN_DOSE, APR_DOSE_UOM, APR_ROUTE FROM APR_MINMAX_DETAILS_ALL A WHERE APR_START_DTE = (SELECT MAX(APR_START_DTE) FROM APR_MINMAX_DETAILS_ALL B WHERE A.APR_MRN=B.APR_MRN)) , APR_PEN2 AS (SELECT A.APR_MRN AS PEN_MRN, APR_START_DTE AS PEN_START_DTE FROM APR_MINMAX_DETAILS_ALL A WHERE APR_START_DTE = (SELECT MAX(APR_START_DTE) FROM APR_MINMAX_DETAILS_ALL B WHERE A.APR_MRN=B.APR_MRN AND B.APR_START_DTE<MAX_ORD_END_DATE)) , APR_PEN AS (SELECT A.APR_MRN AS PEN_MRN, PEN_START_DTE FROM APR_MIN A LEFT JOIN APR_PEN2 ON A.APR_MRN=PEN_MRN) , PPE_DIAG AS (SELECT APR_MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS MIN_ICD_EFF_DTE, MIN_START_DTE, PEN_START_DTE, MAX_ORD_END_DATE FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN APR_MIN ON CC_MRN = APR_MRN JOIN APR_MAX ON CC_MRN=MAX_MRN JOIN APR_PEN ON CC_MRN=PEN_MRN WHERE CC_CLSF_CD IN ('L27.1', '693.0') AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND (CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) GROUP BY APR_MRN, MIN_START_DTE, PEN_START_DTE, MAX_ORD_END_DATE HAVING MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) >= MIN_START_DTE) , NEXT_VISIT AS (SELECT CPE_MRN, MIN_ICD_EFF_DTE AS "PPE first episodic date", CPE_ENC_DTE AS "Next Appt Date", CLD_DEPT_NAME, CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME, CRE_RES_NAME, CRE_RES_TYP FROM PPE_DIAG JOIN IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER S ON APR_MRN =CPE_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Sch') AND CRE_RES_TYP IN ('Physician', 'Nurse Practitioner', 'Physician Assistant', 'Advanced Practice Nurse') AND CPE_ENC_DTE >= CURRENT date AND CPE_ENC_DTE = (SELECT MIN(CPE_ENC_DTE) FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER M WHERE APR_MRN=M.CPE_MRN AND M.CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Sch') AND CRE_RES_TYP IN ('Physician', 'Nurse Practitioner', 'Physician Assistant', 'Advanced Practice Nurse') AND M.CPE_ENC_DTE >= CURRENT date) ) SELECT A.APR_MRN, "PPE first episodic date", APR_GENERIC_NAME AS "Drug Name", A.MIN_START_DTE AS "Drug Start Date", APR_TOTAL_GIVEN_DOSE AS "Total Dose", APR_DOSE_UOM AS "UOM", B.PEN_START_DTE AS "Penultimate Drug Date", A.MAX_ORD_END_DATE AS "Last Drug Date", "Next Appt Date", CLD_DEPT_NAME AS "Next Appt Dept", CRE_RES_TYP AS "Next Appt Prov" FROM APR_MINMAX_DETAILS A JOIN PPE_DIAG B ON A.APR_MRN=B.APR_MRN JOIN NEXT_VISIT C ON C.CPE_MRN=A.APR_MRN LEFT JOIN APR_PEN D ON D.PEN_MRN=A.APR_MRN

prompt: I would like to query a list of all patients who saw Pediatric Heme service from 2022 to current with African/African American ancestry as Race.
completion: SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN AS "MRN", PT_RACE_DESC, CPE_ENC_DTE AS "Appt Date", CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 AS "Department", CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 AS "Service", CLD_DEPT_NAME AS "Department Name", CRE_RES_NAME AS "Provider Name", CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME AS "Visit Type" FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID JOIN IDB.PATIENT_V ON PT_MRN = CPE_MRN WHERE 1 = 1 AND CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND (CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR LIKE '%NV%' CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR LIKE '%IR%') AND CRE_RES_NAME IN ('SULIS, MARIA LUISA', 'SHUKLA, NEERAV', 'RAMASWAMY, KAVITHA', 'TRIPPETT, TANYA', 'FORLENZA, CHRISTOPHER J') AND CPE_ENC_DTE >= '2022-01-01' AND PT_RACE_DESC = 'BLACK OR AFRICAN AMERICAN'

prompt: Identify patients w/ benign biliary stricture using Provation and Physician Billing
completion: WITH DX AS (SELECT TM_MRN, TM_DX_DTE, TM_HIST_CD, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS HIST_DESC, TM_SITE_CD, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_DESC FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') ) SELECT PT_MRN "MRN", PT_LAST_NAME "Last Name", PT_FIRST_NAME "First Name", PT_BIRTH_DTE "Date of Birth", MRPT_PERFORMED_DTE "Performed Date", RCI_ITEM_NAME "Procedure Name", MRPT_MED_REPORT_TXT "Report Text", TM_DX_DTE "Dx Date", TM_HIST_CD "Histology Code", HIST_DESC "Histology Description", TM_SITE_CD "Site Code", SITE_DESC "Site Description" FROM DV.MEDICAL_REPORTS JOIN DV.RESULT_CATALOG_ITEM ON MPRT_RESULT_CATALOG_ITEM_ID = RCI_RESULT_CATALOG_ITEM_ID JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON MRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID LEFT JOIN DX ON PT_MRN = TM_MRN WHERE RCI_MASTER_CATEGORY = 'Endoscopy' AND CONTAINS(MRPT_MED_REPORT_TXT, '("ERCP")') = 1 ORDER BY 1, 5 ; WITH DX AS (SELECT TM_MRN, TM_DX_DTE, TM_HIST_CD, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS HIST_DESC, TM_SITE_CD, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_DESC FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') ) SELECT DISTINCT PBD_MRN "MRN", PT_LAST_NAME "Last Name", PT_FIRST_NAME "First Name", PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH "Date of Birth", PBD_SVC_DTE "Service Date", PBC_CPT_CD "CPT Code", CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK "CPT Description", TM_DX_DTE "Dx Date", TM_HIST_CD "Histology Code", HIST_DESC "Histology Description", TM_SITE_CD "Site Code", SITE_DESC "Site Description" FROM IDB.PBD_DTL JOIN IDB.PBD_CODE ON PBD_PBD_CD = PBC_PBD_CD JOIN IDB.CLM ON PBC_CPT_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.PBD_INVOICE ON PBD_INV_NO = PBI_INV_NO JOIN IDB.DOC ON PBI_PERFORM_DR_NO = DOC_DR_NO JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PBD_MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN DX ON PBD_MRN = TM_MRN WHERE PBC_CPT_CD BETWEEN '43260' AND '43278' ORDER BY 1, 5

prompt: Provide a list of patients diagnosed with retinoblastoma between 1995 and 2019.
completion: WITH COHORT AS (SELECT TM_MRN AS MRN, TM_DX_DTE AS RET_DX_DTE, TM_HIST_CD AS RET_HIST_CD, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS RET_HIST_DESC, TM_SITE_CD AS RET_SITE_CD, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS RET_SITE_DESC FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND TM_DX_DTE BETWEEN '1995-01-01' AND '2019-12-31' AND SUBSTR(TM_HIST_CD, 1, 5) BETWEEN 'M9510' AND 'M9514' ) , OSTEO AS (SELECT TM_MRN, TM_DX_DTE AS OSTEO_DX_DTE, TM_HIST_CD AS OSTEO_HIST_CD, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS OSTEO_HIST_DESC, TM_SITE_CD AS OSTEO_SITE_CD, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS OSTEO_SITE_DESC FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN COHORT ON TM_MRN = MRN AND TM_DX_DTE > RET_DX_DTE JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND TM_DX_DTE BETWEEN '1995-01-01' AND '2019-12-31' AND SUBSTR(TM_HIST_CD, 1, 4) IN ('M918', 'M919') ) , SRG AS (SELECT SSE_MRN, SSE_SURG_DTE AS SURGERY_DTE, SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD AS CPT_CODE, SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC AS CPT_DESC, SSP_SURG_LAST_NM AS SURGEON_LAST_NAME, SSP_SURG_FIRST_NM AS SURGEON_FIRST_NAME FROM IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE ON SSE_LOG_ID = SSP_LOG_ID AND SSE_ENC_CSN_ID = SSP_ENC_CSN_ID JOIN COHORT ON SSE_MRN = MRN JOIN OSTEO ON SSE_MRN = TM_MRN WHERE (SSE_SURG_LOC not like '%IR%' AND SSE_SURG_LOC not like '%ENDO%' AND SSE_SOURCE_TYPE <> 'E') ) , PATIENT AS (SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN , PT_LAST_NAME , PT_FIRST_NAME , PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH , PT_SEX , CASE WHEN COALESCE(R.AV_DESC, CR.AV_DESC) IN ('WHITE', 'WHITE HISPANIC') THEN 'White' WHEN COALESCE(R.AV_DESC, CR.AV_DESC) IN ('BLACK OR AFRICAN AMERICAN', 'BLACK', 'BLACK HISPANIC') THEN 'Black' WHEN COALESCE(R.AV_DESC, CR.AV_DESC) IN ('ASIAN-FAR EAST/INDIAN SUBCONT', 'KAMPUCHEAN', 'LAOTIAN', 'VIETNAMESE', 'HMONG', 'CHINESE', 'ASIAN INDIAN PAKISTANI', 'JAPANESE', 'KOREAN', 'OTHER ASIAN', 'THAI') THEN 'Asian' WHEN COALESCE(R.AV_DESC, CR.AV_DESC) IN ('NATIVE AMERICAN-AM IND/ALASKA', 'AMER IND ALEUT ESKIMO') THEN 'Native American or Alaska Native' WHEN COALESCE(R.AV_DESC, CR.AV_DESC) IN ('NATIVE HAWAIIAN OR PACIFIC ISL', 'HAWAIIAN', 'MELANESIAN', 'MICRONESIAN', 'FIJI ISLANDER', 'FILIPINO', 'GUAMANIAN', 'PACIFIC ISLANDER') THEN 'Native Hawaiian or Other Pacific Islander' ELSE 'Unspecified' END AS PT_RACE , CASE WHEN COALESCE(CE.AV_DESC, E.AV_DESC) IN ('SPANISH NOS; HISPANIC NOS, LATINO NOS', 'HISPANIC OR LATINO', 'PUERTO RICAN', 'SOUTH/CENTRAL AMERICA (EXCEPT BRAZIL)', 'DOMINICAN REPUBLIC', 'OTHER SPANISH/HISPANIC(INCL EUROPEAN; EXCL DOM REP)', 'CUBAN', 'MEXICAN (INCLUDES CHICANO)') OR COALESCE(R.AV_DESC, CR.AV_DESC) IN ('WHITE HISPANIC', 'BLACK HISPANIC') THEN 'Hispanic' WHEN COALESCE(CE.AV_DESC, E.AV_DESC) IN ('NOT HISPANIC', 'SPANISH SURNAME ONLY', 'NON-SPANISH; NON-HISPANIC') THEN 'Non-Hispanic' ELSE 'Unspecified' END AS PT_HISPANIC FROM IDB.PATIENT JOIN COHORT ON PT_MRN = MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS R ON R.AV_ELEMENT = 'RACE' AND R.AV_CODE = PT_RACE LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS E ON E.AV_ELEMENT = 'PT_ETHNICITY' AND E.AV_CODE = PT_PT_ETHNICITY LEFT JOIN IDB.CDB_PATIENT ON PT_MRN = CP_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS CR ON CR.AV_ELEMENT = 'CDB_RACE' AND CR.AV_CODE = CP_CDB_RACE LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS CE ON CE.AV_ELEMENT = 'ETHNICITY' AND CE.AV_CODE = CP_ETHNICITY) SELECT DISTINCT MRN , PT_LAST_NAME , PT_FIRST_NAME , PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH , PT_SEX , PT_RACE , RET_DX_DTE , RET_HIST_CD , RET_HIST_DESC , RET_SITE_CD , RET_SITE_DESC , OSTEO_DX_DTE , OSTEO_HIST_CD , OSTEO_HIST_DESC , OSTEO_SITE_CD , OSTEO_SITE_DESC , SURGERY_DTE , CPT_CODE , CPT_DESC , SURGEON_LAST_NAME , SURGEON_FIRST_NAME FROM COHORT JOIN PATIENT ON MRN = PT_MRN JOIN OSTEO ON MRN = TM_MRN LEFT JOIN SRG ON MRN = SSE_MRN ;

prompt: Provide Date of Death and date of last follow-up for patients on 12-245.
completion: SELECT PT_MRN, PT_DATE_OF_DEATH, COALESCE(MAX(PLA_LST_APPT_DTE, PLA_LST_DSCH_DTE), PLA_LST_APPT_DTE, PLA_LST_DSCH_DTE) AS LAST_FU_DATE FROM IDB.PATIENT JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY ON PT_MRN = PLA_MRN WHERE PT_MRN IN ()

prompt: Provide a list of patients seen in clinics of Dr. Alison Moskowitz, Dr. Niloufer Khan, Dr. Steven Horwitz and was treated with Anti CD20 or Anti CD19 therapy in the past 6 months AND/OR who have had COVID antibodies measured.
completion: WITH APPTS AS (SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN AS MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_SEX, A.CLD_DEPT_NAME AS DEPT, A.CLD_CLD_CENTER AS SITE, B.CRE_RES_NAME AS PROVIDER, CPE_ENC_DTE AS APPT_DTE, CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME AS VT_NAME, CPE_CPE_APPT_STS AS APPT_STS FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT A ON CPE_DEPT_ID = A.CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE B ON B.CRE_RES_ID = CPE_VST_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON CPE_MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT C ON C.CLD_DEPT_ID = CPE_REF_DEP_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE D ON D.CRE_RES_ID = CPE_REF_RES_ID WHERE 1=1 AND CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Sch', 'Comp', 'Arrived') AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN '2021-07-01' AND '2022-12-31' AND CPE_MRN <> '' AND CPE_VST_RES_ID IN ('010322', '027151', '015578') ) , LAST_APPT AS (SELECT MRN, MAX(APPT_DTE) AS LAST_APPT_DTE FROM APPTS WHERE 1=1 AND APPT_STS IN ('Comp', 'Arrived') GROUP BY MRN) , NEXT_APPT AS (SELECT A.MRN, MIN(APPT_DTE) AS NEXT_APPT_DTE FROM LAST_APPT A JOIN APPTS B ON A.MRN = B.MRN AND APPT_STS = 'Sch' AND APPT_DTE >= CURRENT DATE GROUP BY A.MRN) , PTS AS (SELECT A.MRN, LAST_APPT_DTE, C.PROVIDER, C.DEPT, NEXT_APPT_DTE, C.PT_LAST_NAME, C.PT_FIRST_NAME, C.PT_SEX FROM LAST_APPT A JOIN APPTS C ON A.MRN = C.MRN AND LAST_APPT_DTE = C.APPT_DTE LEFT JOIN NEXT_APPT B ON A.MRN = B.MRN LEFT JOIN APPTS D ON B.MRN = D.MRN AND NEXT_APPT_DTE = D.APPT_DTE) , DRUG AS (SELECT APR_MRN, APR_DRUG_NAME, MIN(APR_START_DTE) AS START_DTE, MAX(APR_END_DTE) AS END_DTE FROM PTS JOIN IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX_V ON MRN = APR_MRN AND APR_START_DTE BETWEEN '2021-07-01' AND CURRENT DATE AND (UPPER(APR_DRUG_NAME) LIKE '%OBINUTUZUMAB%' OR UPPER(APR_DRUG_NAME) LIKE '%RITUXIMAB%' OR UPPER(APR_DRUG_NAME) LIKE '%LONCASTUXIMAB%' OR UPPER(APR_DRUG_NAME) LIKE '%OFATUMUMAB%' OR UPPER(APR_DRUG_NAME) LIKE '%TAFASITAMA%') WHERE 1=1 GROUP BY APR_MRN, APR_DRUG_NAME) , LAB AS (SELECT * FROM (SELECT LR_MRN, LR_ACCESSION_NO AS ACCSS_NO, LR_RESULT_VALUE AS RESULT_VALUE, LTL_TEXT_RESULT AS RESULT_TEXT, LR_PERFORMED_DTE AS RESULT_DATE, LR_TEST_NAME , LR_SUBTEST_NAME, LR_CREATE_DT, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY LR_MRN ORDER BY LR_ACCESSION_NO DESC) AS ROW FROM PTS JOIN IDB.LAB_RESULTS ON MRN = LR_MRN AND LR_PERFORMED_DTE BETWEEN '2021-07-01' AND CURRENT DATE AND LR_TEST_NAME = 'COVID-19 Spike Protein AntiBODY IgG' AND LR_SUBTEST_NAME = 'SARS-CoV-2 RBD S1 Ab IgG semi-Quan' JOIN IDB.LAB_TEXT_LINE ON LTL_MRN = LR_MRN AND LTL_RESULT_GUID = LR_RESULT_GUID) AS X WHERE ROW = 1 ) SELECT * FROM (SELECT MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_SEX, PROVIDER, DEPT, LAST_APPT_DTE, NEXT_APPT_DTE, APR_DRUG_NAME, START_DTE, END_DTE, ACCSS_NO, RESULT_DATE, RESULT_VALUE, RESULT_TEXT FROM PTS LEFT JOIN DRUG ON MRN = APR_MRN LEFT JOIN LAB ON MRN = LR_MRN) AS X WHERE 1=1 AND (APR_DRUG_NAME IS NOT NULL OR ACCSS_NO IS NOT NULL)

prompt:
We would like a list of prostate cancer pts with an intact prostate (i.e. did not have prostatectomy) that are lymph node positive that received EBRT (a type of radiation therapy) with brachytherapy boost. Their clinical staging, any T-stage, N1, M0

We also need another list of prostate cancer patients with an intact prostate (i.e. did not have prostatectomy). Their clinical staging should be T3b, any N stage who received EBRT (a type of radiation therapy) with brachytherapy boost.

We would like to also know from both groups how many have at least 5 years of follow up from their end date of EBRT.
completion: WITH PROSTATE_CANCER_DX_0 AS (SELECT DISTINCT TM_MRN AS MRN, TM_DX_DTE AS DX_DATE, TM_CLIN_TNM_T, TM_CLIN_TNM_N, TM_CLIN_TNM_M FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.SEERGROUPING ON RECODE = DV.SEERF_ICDO(TM_SITE_CD, TM_HIST_CD) AND CATEGORY2 = 'Prostate' JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD WHERE 1=1 AND TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND TM_DX_DTE BETWEEN '1990-01-01' AND '2004-01-09' ) , PROSTATECTOMY AS (SELECT SSE_MRN, SSE_SURG_DTE, SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD, SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC, SSP_SURG_LAST_NM, SSP_SURG_FIRST_NM, SSP_SURG_SVC_CD FROM IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE ON SSE_LOG_ID = SSP_LOG_ID AND SSE_ENC_CSN_ID = SSP_ENC_CSN_ID WHERE 1 = 1 AND (SSE_SURG_LOC not like '%IR%' AND SSE_SURG_LOC not like '%ENDO%' AND SSE_SOURCE_TYPE <> 'E') AND SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD IN ('55899', '38570', '49321', '55845', '55866', '55700', '52354', '55821', '55705', '52204', '55706') AND SSE_SURG_DTE BETWEEN '1990-01-01' AND '2004-01-01' ), RT_FROM_PA_PRE AS (SELECT MRN, SVC_DTE, RAD_TYPE, SOURCE_IND, SVC_CD, SVC_DESC, DPT_CD, DPT_DESC, IP_OP_IND, SUM(AMT) AS SVC_AMT, SUM(QTY) AS SVC_QTY, RMS_VISIT_ID, RMS_ADM_NUM, SMS_ACCT_NO FROM (SELECT DTL_MRN AS MRN, DTL_SVC_DTE AS SVC_DTE, RAD_TYPE, 'SMS' AS SOURCE_IND, DTL_SVC_CD AS SVC_CD, CDM_SVC_DESC AS SVC_DESC, CDM_DPT_CD AS DPT_CD, AV_DESC AS DPT_DESC, DTL_IP_OP_IND AS IP_OP_IND, DTL_SVC_AMT AS AMT, DTL_SVC_QTY AS QTY, 0 AS RMS_VISIT_ID, DTL_ACCT_NO AS RMS_ADM_NUM, DTL_ACCT_NO AS SMS_ACCT_NO FROM IDB.PA_DETAIL JOIN IDB.CDM ON CDM_SVC_CD = DTL_SVC_CD JOIN IDB.RADIATION_TYPES ON RAD_SVC_CD = DTL_SVC_CD AND RAD_SOURCE = 'SMS' LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS ON CDM_DPT_CD = AV_CODE AND AV_ELEMENT = 'DPT_CD' WHERE DTL_DTL_TYPE = 'C' AND DTL_SVC_DTE BETWEEN '1990-01-01' AND '2004-01-01' UNION ALL SELECT RVCD_MRN AS MRN, RVCD_SVC_DTE AS SVC_DTE, RAD_TYPE, 'RMS' AS SOURCE_IND, RCDD_CHARGE_CD AS SVC_CD, RCDD_CHARGE_DESCRIPTION AS SVC_DESC, RDPD_DEPARTMENT_MNEMONIC AS DPT_CD, RDPD_DEPARTMENT_NAME AS DPT_DESC, VIS_IP_OP_ADJUSTED_IND AS IP_OP_IND, RVCD_AMT AS AMT, RVCD_UNITS AS QTY, VIS_VISIT_ID AS RMS_VISIT_ID, VIS_ADM_NUM AS RMS_ADM_NUM, ' ' AS SMS_ACCT_NO FROM IDB.RMS_VISIT_CHARGE_DTL JOIN IDB.VISIT ON RVCD_VISIT_ID = VIS_VISIT_ID JOIN IDB.RMS_CHARGE_CODE_DICT_DN1240 ON RVCD_CHARGE_CODE_REC_NO = RCDD_RECORD_NUMBER JOIN IDB.RMS_DEPARTMENT_DICT_DN1301 ON RVCD_CHARGE_DEPT_REC_NO = RDPD_RECORD_NUMBER JOIN IDB.RADIATION_TYPES ON RAD_SVC_CD = RCDD_CHARGE_CD AND RAD_SOURCE = 'RMS' WHERE RVCD_SVC_DTE BETWEEN '1990-01-01' AND '2004-01-01' ) A GROUP BY MRN, SVC_DTE, A.RAD_TYPE, SOURCE_IND, SVC_CD, SVC_DESC, DPT_CD, DPT_DESC, IP_OP_IND, RMS_VISIT_ID, RMS_ADM_NUM, SMS_ACCT_NO HAVING SUM(QTY) > 0) , EBRT AS (SELECT MRN, RAD_TYPE EBRT_TYPE, MIN(SVC_DTE) EBRT_START, MAX(SVC_DTE) EBRT_STOP FROM RT_FROM_PA_PRE WHERE RAD_TYPE IN ('EBRT', 'IMRT', 'STEREOTACTIC') GROUP BY MRN, RAD_TYPE) , BRACHY AS (SELECT MRN, RAD_TYPE BRACHY_TYPE, MIN(SVC_DTE) BRACHY_START, MAX(SVC_DTE) BRACHY_STOP FROM RT_FROM_PA_PRE WHERE RAD_TYPE IN ('BRACHY', 'BRACHY IMPLANT', 'HDR BRACHY') ) SELECT * FROM BRACHY ORDER BY MRN; , PROST_CAN_INTACT_PROST AS (SELECT PROSTATE_CANCER_DX_0.* FROM PROSTATE_CANCER_DX_0 WHERE MRN NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT SSE_MRN FROM PROSTATECTOMY) ) SELECT PROST_CAN_INTACT_PROST.* EBRT_TYPE, EBRT_START, EBRT_STOP, BRACHY.RAD_TYPE BRACHY_TYPE, BRACHY.SVC_DTE BRACHY_DATE, PT_DEATH_IND_DESC PT_VITAL_STS, PT_DATE_OF_DEATH FROM PROST_CAN_INTACT_PROST JOIN EBRT ON PROST_CAN_INTACT_PROST.MRN = EBRT.MRN JOIN BRACHY ON PROST_CAN_INTACT_PROST.MRN = BRACHY.MRN JOIN IDB.PATIENT_V ON PROST_CAN_INTACT_PROST.MRN = PT_MRN

prompt: Create a list of patients who have had a PET scan after being treated with Avitene or Floseal.
completion: SELECT MRN, MIN(FIRSTDT) AS PROC_DT, MIN(PBD_SVC_DTE) AS PET_DT, PROCDESC AS PROC_TYPE FROM (SELECT DTL_MRN AS MRN, CDM_SVC_DESC AS PROCDESC, DTL_SVC_DTE AS FIRSTDT FROM IDB.PA_DETAIL P INNER JOIN IDB.CDM C ON P.DTL_SVC_CD = C.CDM_SVC_CD WHERE DTL_SVC_CD IN ('02722650', '02728673', '61390050', '61390068', '61390076', '61929907', '66390055', '66390063', '66390071', '66929902', '78929908', '78980034', '78980042', '78980059') GROUP BY DTL_MRN, CDM_SVC_DESC, DTL_SVC_DTE HAVING SUM(P.DTL_SVC_QTY) > 0) AS P INNER JOIN IDB.PBD_DETAIL D ON D.PBD_MRN = P.MRN INNER JOIN IDB.PBD_CODE C ON C.PBC_PBD_CD = D.PBD_PBD_CD WHERE C.PBC_CPT_CD IN ('78306', '78320', '78459', '78492', '78608', '78609', '78810', '78811', '78812', '78813', '78814', '78815', '78816', 'G0126', 'G0210', 'G0219', 'G0220', 'G0230', 'G0235', 'G0252') AND PBD_SVC_DTE > FIRSTDT GROUP BY MRN, PROCDESC ORDER BY MRN

prompt: I would like to be able to run a report that will list all the inpatient referrals placed, released or cancelled for the Geriatrics service.
completion: SELECT OUO_MRN MRN, STRIP(PT_LAST_NAME)||', '||STRIP(PT_FIRST_NAME) PT_NAME, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH DOB, PT_SEX_DESC GENDER, YEAR(OUO_ENTER_DTE) - YEAR(PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) AGE_AT_ORD, OUO_ENTER_DTE ORD_ENTER_DTE, OUO_CURR_LOC PT_LOCATION, OUO_ORD_NAME ORD_NAME, OUO_ORD_ID ORD_ID, OUO_STS_DESC ORD_STATUS , OUO_ATN_PVDR_NAME PVDR_NAME, OUO_OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE ORD_PERFORMED_DTE, MAX(CASE WHEN OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'Consult_Cancer Dx:' THEN OUD_USER_DI_VALUE ELSE '' END) CANCER_DX, MAX(CASE WHEN OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'Consult_Geriatric Reason for'THEN OUD_USER_DI_VALUE ELSE '' END) CONSULT_REASON FROM IDB.OMS_USER_ORDERS JOIN IDB.PATIENT_V ON OUO_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_USER_DATA ON OUO_ORD_GUID = OUD_ORD_GUID WHERE OUO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID = '9000008080100730' GROUP BY OUO_MRN , STRIP(PT_LAST_NAME)||', '||STRIP(PT_FIRST_NAME) , PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH , PT_SEX_DESC , YEAR(OUO_ENTER_DTE) - YEAR(PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) , OUO_ENTER_DTE, OUO_CURR_LOC , OUO_ORD_NAME , OUO_ORD_ID , OUO_STS_DESC , OUO_ATN_PVDR_NAME , OUO_OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE

prompt: Daily list of upcoming thoracic patients appointments with distress thermometer score
completion: WITH APPT AS (SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN AS MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_PRIMARY_LANG, CPE_ENC_DTE AS APPT_DTE, TO_CHAR(CPE_APPT_DT, 'HH:MI AM') AS APPT_TIME, CLD_DEPT_NAME AS DEPT_NAME, CRE_RES_NAME AS PROVIDER, CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME AS VISIT_TYPE FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON CPE_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Sch') AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT DATE + 1 DAY AND CURRENT DATE + 3 DAY AND NOT ((CVT_CVT_RPT_GRP_17 = 'TELEHEALTH' OR UPPER(CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME) LIKE '%PHONE%') OR (CLD_DEPT_ID IN (1382, 1354)) OR UPPER(CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME) IN ('IC BUNDLED SERVICES', 'IC INTEG MED REVIEW', 'IC MEDICAL RECORDS REVIEW', 'IC MSK IMPACT', 'IC RADIOLOGY REVIEW', 'IC VIDEO CONSULT')) AND CRE_RES_NAME IN ('ADUSUMILLI, PRASAD S', 'BOTT, MATTHEW J', 'HUANG, JAMES', 'SIHAG, SMITA', 'ISBELL, JAMES MICHAEL', 'JONES, DAVID R', 'MOLENA, DANIELA', 'PARK, BERNARD J.', 'ROCCO, GAETANO', 'GRAY, KATHERINE D.') ) , CYTOLOGY_RPT AS (SELECT PRPT_MRN, MAX(PRPT_REPORT_DTE) LAST_CYTOLOGY_PATH FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V JOIN APPT ON PRPT_MRN = MRN WHERE PRPT_REPORT_TYPE_DESC IN ('Cytology-Non GYN', 'Cytology-Private Non-GYN', 'Cytology-Private Submitted Slides', 'Cytology-Submitted Slides') GROUP BY PRPT_MRN) , SRG_PATH_RPT AS (SELECT PRPT_MRN, MAX(PRPT_REPORT_DTE) LAST_SRG_PATH FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V JOIN APPT ON PRPT_MRN = MRN WHERE PRPT_REPORT_TYPE_DESC IN ('Surgical Pathology', 'Surgical Pathology Consult', 'Surgical Submitted Slides') GROUP BY PRPT_MRN) , LUNG_DX AS (SELECT CC_MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS FIRST_LUNG_DX FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN APPT ON CC_MRN = MRN WHERE SUBSTR(CC_CLSF_CD, 1, 3) IN ('162', 'C34') AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND (CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) GROUP BY CC_MRN ) , DISTRESS AS (SELECT CDD_MRN, CDD_SERVICE_DTE LAST_DISTRESS_DTE, CDO_VALUE_TEXT LAST_DISTRESS_SCORE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CDD_MRN ORDER BY CDD_SERVICE_DTE DESC) AS RN FROM IDB.CD_DOCUMENT LEFT JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION ON CDD_DOC_GUID = CDO_DOC_GUID AND CDD_AUTHORED_DTE = CDO_AUTHORED_DTE AND CDO_VALUE_TEXT <> '' JOIN APPT ON CDD_MRN = MRN WHERE CDD_CANCEL_IND <> '1' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND <> '1' AND CDO_ITEM_NAME IN ('Patient has selected the following on the Distress thermometer', 'Score from distress scale 0-10') AND CDD_DOC_NAME IN ('Nursing Health Assessment - Outpatient', 'Adult Health Screening, Ambulatory - Nursing', 'Adult Health Screening (65+), Ambulatory - Nursing') ) SELECT A.*, FIRST_LUNG_DX, LAST_SRG_PATH, LAST_CYTOLOGY_PATH, LAST_DISTRESS_DTE, LAST_DISTRESS_SCORE FROM APPT A LEFT JOIN CYTOLOGY_RPT B ON MRN = B.PRPT_MRN LEFT JOIN SRG_PATH_RPT C ON MRN = C.PRPT_MRN LEFT JOIN LUNG_DX ON MRN = CC_MRN LEFT JOIN DISTRESS ON MRN = CDD_MRN AND RN = 1 ORDER BY APPT_DTE, PT_LAST_NAME ; WITH APPT AS (SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN AS MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON CPE_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Sch') AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT DATE + 1 DAY AND CURRENT DATE + 3 DAY AND NOT ((CVT_CVT_RPT_GRP_17 = 'TELEHEALTH' OR UPPER(CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME) LIKE '%PHONE%') OR (CLD_DEPT_ID IN (1382, 1354)) OR UPPER(CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME) IN ('IC BUNDLED SERVICES', 'IC INTEG MED REVIEW', 'IC MEDICAL RECORDS REVIEW', 'IC MSK IMPACT', 'IC RADIOLOGY REVIEW', 'IC VIDEO CONSULT')) AND CRE_RES_NAME IN ('ADUSUMILLI, PRASAD S', 'BOTT, MATTHEW J', 'HUANG, JAMES', 'SIHAG, SMITA', 'ISBELL, JAMES MICHAEL', 'JONES, DAVID R', 'MOLENA, DANIELA', 'PARK, BERNARD J.', 'ROCCO, GAETANO', 'GRAY, KATHERINE D.') ) , LUNG_DX AS (SELECT CC_MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS FIRST_DX_DTE, CC_CLSF_CD AS ICD_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS ICD_DESC FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN APPT ON CC_MRN = MRN WHERE SUBSTR(CC_CLSF_CD, 1, 3) IN ('162', 'C34') AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND (CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) GROUP BY CC_MRN, CC_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK ) SELECT DISTINCT MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, FIRST_DX_DTE, ICD_CD, ICD_DESC FROM APPT A LEFT JOIN LUNG_DX ON MRN = CC_MRN ORDER BY PT_LAST_NAME, FIRST_DX_DTE, ICD_CD

prompt: Provide a list of patients who have undergone CTC testing and/or MSK-IMPACT in CSF from April 2016 to January 2021
completion: WITH CSF AS (SELECT OO_MRN, STRIP(PT_LAST_NAME) || ', ' || STRIP(PT_FIRST_NAME) AS NAME, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH AS DOB, PT_DATE_OF_DEATH AS DOD, OO_ENTER_DTE, OO_ORD_ID, OO_ORD_NAME, DM.OUD_USER_DI_VALUE AS PATH_STATUS FROM IDB.PATIENT JOIN IDB.OMS_ORDER ON PT_MRN = OO_MRN JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_CATALOG ON OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID = OOC_MSTR_ITEM_GUID LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_USER_DATA DM ON OO_ORD_GUID = DM.OUD_ORD_GUID AND OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'Diag Mole ST - Path Status' WHERE OO_ORD_STS_CD NOT IN ('CANC', 'CANP', 'AUC3') AND OO_ORD_NAME = 'Diag Molecular Path (Solid Tumor)Order' AND DM.OUD_USER_DI_VALUE LIKE '%CSF%' AND OO_ENTER_DTE BETWEEN '2016-04-01' AND '2021-01-15' AND YEAR(OO_ENTER_DTE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) >= 18 ) , PATH AS (SELECT P.*, UPPER(DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)CYTOLOGIC DIAGNOSIS: [\w\W]*(?=ADEQUACY ASSESSMENT:)', TXT)) AS CYTOLOGIC_DIAGNOSIS FROM (SELECT DISTINCT "t1"."PT_MRN" AS "MRN", "t2"."PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_DESC" AS "Pathology Report Type", "t3"."DT_DTE" AS "Pathology Report Date", "t4"."DT_DTE" AS "Pathology Procedure Date", "t5"."PRPT_ACCESSION_NO" AS "Pathology Report", UPPER(CASE WHEN LENGTH(PRPT_REPORT) <= 15000 THEN RTRIM(CAST(SUBSTR(PRPT_REPORT, 1, 15000) AS VARCHAR(15000))) ELSE CAST(SUBSTR(PRPT_REPORT, 1, 15000) AS VARCHAR(15000)) END) AS TXT FROM CSF LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V" "t1" ON PT_MRN = OO_MRN LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED" "t6" ON "t1"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t6"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V" "t5" ON "t6"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t5"."PRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATH_RPRT_TYPE_LOOKUP" "t2" ON "t5"."PRPT_REPORT_TYPE" = "t2"."PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_CD" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" "t3" ON "t5"."PRPT_REPORT_DATE_ID" = "t3"."DT_DATE_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" "t4" ON "t5"."PRPT_PROCEDURE_DATE_ID" = "t4"."DT_DATE_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_IDENTIFICATION_MRN_V" "t7" ON "t1"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t7"."PI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" WHERE 1=1 AND "t2"."PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_DESC" = 'Cytology-Non GYN' AND "t4"."DT_DTE" = OO_ENTER_DTE ) P) , X AS (SELECT TM_MRN, TM_DX_DTE, TM_SITE_CD AS SITE_CODE, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_DESC, TM_HIST_CD AS HIST_CODE, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS HIST_DESC FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM H ON TM_HIST_CD = H.CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON TM_SITE_CD = S.CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND TM_MRN IN (SELECT OO_MRN FROM CSF) ) , CTE AS (SELECT TM_MRN AS DX_MRN, TM_DX_DTE AS DX_DATE, STRIP(SITE_CODE) || '-' || STRIP(SITE_DESC) || '|' || STRIP(HIST_CODE) || '-' || STRIP(HIST_DESC) AS DX_CODE FROM X) , CTE2 AS (SELECT * FROM CTE ORDER BY DX_MRN, DX_DATE, DX_CODE) , T1 AS (SELECT DX_MRN, DX_DATE, DX_CODE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY DX_MRN ORDER BY DX_DATE) AS RN FROM CTE2 ORDER BY DX_MRN, DX_DATE) , T2 (MRN, DX, RN1) AS (SELECT DX_MRN, CAST(DX_DATE AS VARCHAR(6000))||' | '||CAST(DX_CODE AS VARCHAR(100)), RN FROM T1 WHERE T1.RN = 1 UNION ALL SELECT DX_MRN, RTRIM(CAST(DX AS VARCHAR(4000))) || ', ' || CHR(13) || CHR(10) || CAST(DX_DATE AS VARCHAR(100))||' | '||RTRIM(CAST(DX_CODE AS VARCHAR(100))) , RN1 + 1 FROM T1, T2 WHERE DX_MRN = MRN AND RN = RN1+1 ) , T3 AS (SELECT MRN, MAX(RN1) RN FROM T2 GROUP BY MRN) , T4 AS (SELECT T2.MRN, RN, DX FROM T2 JOIN T3 ON T2.MRN = T3.MRN AND T2.RN1 = T3.RN) SELECT CSF.*, DX, CYTOLOGIC_DIAGNOSIS FROM CSF LEFT JOIN T4 ON CSF.OO_MRN = T4.MRN LEFT JOIN PATH ON CSF.OO_MRN = PATH.MRN AND OO_ENTER_DTE ="Pathology Procedure Date" SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN, GENE, RESULT, METHOD FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_STRUCTURED_RESULTS_V WHERE PT_MRN IN (SELECT OO_MRN FROM CSF) WITH CTC AS (SELECT DISTINCT LR_MRN, STRIP(PT_LAST_NAME) || ', ' || STRIP(PT_FIRST_NAME) AS NAME, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH AS DOB, PT_DATE_OF_DEATH AS DOD, LR_PERFORMED_DTE AS PERFORMED_DTE, LR_TEST_NAME AS TEST_NAME, LR_SUBTEST_NAME AS SUBTEST_NAME, LR_RESULT_VALUE AS RESULT_VALUE, LR_UNIT_MEASURE AS UNIT_MEASURE FROM IDB.LAB_RESULTS JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON LR_MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.LAB_TEXT_LINE ON LTL_RESULT_GUID = LR_RESULT_GUID WHERE 1=1 AND LR_SUBTEST_NAME = 'Circulating Tumor Cells, CSF' AND LR_PERFORMED_DTE BETWEEN '2016-04-01' AND '2021-01-15' AND YEAR(LR_PERFORMED_DTE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) >= 18 AND LR_RESULT_VALUE <> '' ) , PATH AS (SELECT P.*, UPPER(DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)CYTOLOGIC DIAGNOSIS: [\w\W]*(?=ADEQUACY ASSESSMENT:)', TXT)) AS CYTOLOGIC_DIAGNOSIS FROM (SELECT DISTINCT "t1"."PT_MRN" AS "MRN", "t2"."PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_DESC" AS "Pathology Report Type", "t3"."DT_DTE" AS "Pathology Report Date", "t4"."DT_DTE" AS "Pathology Procedure Date", "t5"."PRPT_ACCESSION_NO" AS "Pathology Report", UPPER(CASE WHEN LENGTH(PRPT_REPORT) <= 15000 THEN RTRIM(CAST(SUBSTR(PRPT_REPORT, 1, 15000) AS VARCHAR(15000))) ELSE CAST(SUBSTR(PRPT_REPORT, 1, 15000) AS VARCHAR(15000)) END) AS TXT FROM CTC LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V" "t1" ON PT_MRN = LR_MRN LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED" "t6" ON "t1"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t6"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V" "t5" ON "t6"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t5"."PRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATH_RPRT_TYPE_LOOKUP" "t2" ON "t5"."PRPT_REPORT_TYPE" = "t2"."PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_CD" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" "t3" ON "t5"."PRPT_REPORT_DATE_ID" = "t3"."DT_DATE_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" "t4" ON "t5"."PRPT_PROCEDURE_DATE_ID" = "t4"."DT_DATE_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_IDENTIFICATION_MRN_V" "t7" ON "t1"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t7"."PI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" WHERE 1=1 AND "t2"."PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_DESC" = 'Cytology-Non GYN' AND "t4"."DT_DTE" = PERFORMED_DTE ) P) , X AS (SELECT TM_MRN, TM_DX_DTE, TM_SITE_CD AS SITE_CODE, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_DESC, TM_HIST_CD AS HIST_CODE, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS HIST_DESC FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM H ON TM_HIST_CD = H.CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON TM_SITE_CD = S.CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND TM_MRN IN (SELECT LR_MRN FROM CTC) ) , CTE AS (SELECT TM_MRN AS DX_MRN, TM_DX_DTE AS DX_DATE, STRIP(SITE_CODE) || '-' || STRIP(SITE_DESC) || '|' || STRIP(HIST_CODE) || '-' || STRIP(HIST_DESC) AS DX_CODE FROM X) , CTE2 AS (SELECT * FROM CTE ORDER BY DX_MRN, DX_DATE, DX_CODE) , T1 AS (SELECT DX_MRN, DX_DATE, DX_CODE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY DX_MRN ORDER BY DX_DATE) AS RN FROM CTE2 ORDER BY DX_MRN, DX_DATE) , T2 (MRN, DX, RN1) AS (SELECT DX_MRN, CAST(DX_DATE AS VARCHAR(6000))||' | '||CAST(DX_CODE AS VARCHAR(100)), RN FROM T1 WHERE T1.RN = 1 UNION ALL SELECT DX_MRN, RTRIM(CAST(DX AS VARCHAR(4000))) || ', ' || CHR(13) || CHR(10) || CAST(DX_DATE AS VARCHAR(100))||' | '||RTRIM(CAST(DX_CODE AS VARCHAR(100))) , RN1 + 1 FROM T1, T2 WHERE DX_MRN = MRN AND RN = RN1+1 ) , T3 AS (SELECT MRN, MAX(RN1) RN FROM T2 GROUP BY MRN) , T4 AS (SELECT T2.MRN, RN, DX FROM T2 JOIN T3 ON T2.MRN = T3.MRN AND T2.RN1 = T3.RN) SELECT CTC.*, DX, CYTOLOGIC_DIAGNOSIS FROM CTC LEFT JOIN T4 ON CTC.LR_MRN = T4.MRN LEFT JOIN PATH ON CTC.LR_MRN = PATH.MRN AND PERFORMED_DTE = "Pathology Procedure Date" SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN, GENE, RESULT, METHOD FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_STRUCTURED_RESULTS_V WHERE PT_MRN IN (SELECT LR_MRN FROM CTC)

prompt: Create a report of adult ALLO stem cell transplants between 1/1/2018 and 12/31/2019.
completion: WITH HCT AS (SELECT CBM_MRN AS MRN, CBM_TRANSPLANT_TYPE AS BMT_TYPE, CBM_TRANSPLANT_DTE AS BMT_DATE FROM IDB.CRDB_BMT_MEDICINE WHERE CBM_TRANSPLANT_DTE BETWEEN '2018-01-01' AND '2019-12-31' AND CBM_TRANSPLANT_TYPE = 'ALLO' ) , V AS (SELECT DISTINCT MRN, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH AS DOB, BMT_DATE, BMT_TYPE, VIS_ADM_DTE, VIS_DSCH_DTE, VIS_PATIENT_TYPE FROM HCT JOIN IDB.VISIT_V ON VIS_MRN = MRN JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PT_MRN = MRN WHERE 1=1 AND BMT_DATE BETWEEN VIS_ADM_DTE AND COALESCE(VIS_DSCH_DTE, CURRENT date) ) SELECT MRN, DOB, BMT_DATE, BMT_TYPE, VIS_ADM_DTE, VIS_DSCH_DTE, MIN(VIS_PATIENT_TYPE) AS VIS_PATIENT_TYPE FROM V GROUP BY MRN, DOB, BMT_DATE, BMT_TYPE, VIS_ADM_DTE, VIS_DSCH_DTE

prompt: Bi-weekly list of patients scheduled for RES GYN SURG.
completion: SELECT CPE_MRN AS "MRN", PT_LAST_NAME "Last Name", PT_FIRST_NAME "First Name", CPE_ENC_DTE AS "Appt Date", CLD_DEPT_NAME AS "Department Name", CRE_RES_NAME AS "Provider Name", CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME AS "Visit Type", CPE_CPE_APPT_STS "Appointment Status", CLD_CLD_CENTER "Location", MAX(CASE WHEN AC_IRB_NO = '12-245' THEN AC_CONS_DTE END) AS "12-245 Consent Date", MAX(CASE WHEN AC_IRB_NO = '06-107' THEN AC_CONS_DTE END) AS "06-107 Consent Date" FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.ACCRUALS A ON CPE_MRN = AC_MRN AND AC_IRB_NO IN ('12-245', '06-107') JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON CPE_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE 1=1 AND CRE_RES_NAME = 'RES GYN SURG' AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT date - 15 DAYS AND CURRENT date - 1 DAY GROUP BY CPE_MRN, CPE_ENC_DTE, CLD_DEPT_NAME, CRE_RES_NAME, CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME, CPE_CPE_APPT_STS, CLD_CLD_CENTER, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_LAST_NAME

TMB_TT_COHORT VARCHAR(25) PATH 'tmb_tt_cohort', TMBSCORE VARCHAR(25) PATH 'tmb_score', TMB_TT_PERCENTILE VARCHAR(25) PATH 'tmb_tt_percentile', TMBCOHORT VARCHAR(25) PATH 'tmb_cohort', VARIANT_TYPE VARCHAR(100) PATH './local-name(.)', GENE_PANEL VARCHAR(100) PATH '../meta-data/gene-panel', PART_DESCRIPTION VARCHAR(2000) PATH '../meta-data/part_description', PROJECT VARCHAR(100) PATH '../meta-data/dmp_alys_task_name', SAMPLEID VARCHAR(100) PATH '../meta-data/dmp_sample_id', PATIENTID VARCHAR(100) PATH '../meta-data/dmp_patient_id', TUMOR_TYPE_CODE VARCHAR(100) PATH '../meta-data/tumor_type_code', TUMOR_TYPE_NAME VARCHAR(255) PATH '../meta-data/tumor_type_name', IS_METASTASIS VARCHAR(10) PATH '../meta-data/is_metastasis', PRIMARY_SITE VARCHAR(255) PATH prompt: Provide a list of retinoblastoma patients who have had a cell free DNA (cfDNA) specimen collected and who developed metastatic disease.
completion: WITH RB1 AS (SELECT DISTINCT STRIP(TM_MRN) AS MRN, TM_DX_DTE AS DX_DATE, STRIP(TM_HIST_CD) AS HIST_CODE, STRIP(H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK) AS HIST_DESC, STRIP(TM_SITE_CD) AS SITE_CODE, STRIP(S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK) AS SITE_DESC, STRIP(LAT.AV_DESC) AS LATERALITY FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM H ON TM_HIST_CD = H.CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON TM_SITE_CD = S.CLM_CLSF_CD LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS LAT ON LAT.AV_CODE = TM_LATERALITY_CD AND LAT.AV_ELEMENT = 'LATERALITY_CD' WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND TM_HIST_CD IN ('M9510/3', 'M9511/3', 'M9512/3', 'M9513/3') ) , RB2 AS (SELECT * FROM (SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN AS MRN, PDWS_NAME, PDRX_ACCESSION_NO, PDRX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID, PDRX_DMP_PATIENT_ID, DV.TODATE(DT_PROCEDURE) AS "Procedure Date", T.* FROM DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML DT ON PDRX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML_SETTINGS ON PDRX_PATH_DMP_RESULTS_XML_ID = PDRXS_PATH_DMP_RESULTS_XML_ID JOIN DVDMC.PATHOLOGY_DMP_WEBSVC_SETTINGS ON PDRXS_SETTING_ID = PDWS_SETTING_ID CROSS JOIN XMLTABLE('$c/root/*' PASSING DT.PDRX_XML_VALUE AS "c" COLUMNS SAMPLEID VARCHAR(100) PATH '../meta-data/dmp_sample_id', PATIENTID VARCHAR(100) PATH '../meta-data/dmp_patient_id', TUMOR_TYPE_CODE VARCHAR(100) PATH '../meta-data/tumor_type_code', TUMOR_TYPE_NAME VARCHAR(255) PATH '../meta-data/tumor_type_name', IS_METASTASIS VARCHAR(10) PATH '../meta-data/is_metastasis', PRIMARY_SITE VARCHAR(255) PATH '../meta-data/primary_site', METASTASIS_SITE VARCHAR(255) PATH '../meta-data/metastasis_site', DT_PROCEDURE VARCHAR(40) PATH '../meta-data/dt_procedure') T) R WHERE TUMOR_TYPE_NAME like '%Retinoblastoma%' ) , RB AS (SELECT MRN FROM RB1 JOIN IDB.OMS_ORDER ON MRN = OO_MRN AND OO_ORD_STS_CD NOT IN ('CANC', 'CANP', 'AUC3') AND UPPER(OO_ORD_NAME) like '%CFDNA%' AND UPPER(OO_SUMMARY_LINE) like '%SHUKLA%' UNION SELECT MRN FROM RB2 JOIN IDB.OMS_ORDER ON MRN = OO_MRN AND OO_ORD_STS_CD NOT IN ('CANC', 'CANP', 'AUC3') AND UPPER(OO_ORD_NAME) like '%CFDNA%' AND UPPER(OO_SUMMARY_LINE) like '%SHUKLA%') , METS AS (SELECT STRIP(CC_MRN) AS MRN, STRIP(CLM_CLSF_CD) AS "Mets Code", STRIP(CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK) AS "Mets Description", MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS "Initial Effective Date" FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND ((CC_PT_TYPE = 'I') OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) AND (CC_CLSF_CD BETWEEN '196' AND '198.99' OR CC_CLSF_CD BETWEEN 'C77' AND 'C79.99') AND CC_MRN IN (SELECT MRN FROM RB) GROUP BY CC_MRN, CLM_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK ) , X AS (SELECT DISTINCT STRIP(RB.MRN) AS MRN, STRIP(PT_LAST_NAME) || ', ' || STRIP(PT_FIRST_NAME) AS "Name", PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH AS DOB, PT_SEX AS "Gender", PT_DATE_OF_DEATH AS DOD, DX_DATE AS "Dx Date", STRIP(HIST_CODE) AS "ICD-O Histology Code", STRIP(HIST_DESC) AS "ICD-O Histology Description", STRIP(SITE_CODE) AS "ICD-O Site Code", STRIP(SITE_DESC) AS "ICD-O Site Description", STRIP(LATERALITY) AS "Laterality", STRIP(TUMOR_TYPE_NAME) AS "Tumor Type", STRIP(PRIMARY_SITE) AS "Primary Site" FROM RB JOIN METS ON RB.MRN = METS.MRN LEFT JOIN RB1 ON RB.MRN = RB1.MRN LEFT JOIN RB2 ON RB.MRN = RB2.MRN JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON RB.MRN = PT_MRN ) , CFDNA AS (SELECT DISTINCT STRIP(OO_MRN) AS MRN, OO_ENTER_DTE AS "order Date", OO_ORD_ID, STRIP(OO_ORD_NAME) AS "Order Name", STRIP(OO_SUMMARY_LINE) AS "Summary Line" FROM RB JOIN METS ON RB.MRN = METS.MRN JOIN IDB.OMS_ORDER ON RB.MRN = OO_MRN AND OO_ORD_STS_CD NOT IN ('CANC', 'CANP', 'AUC3') AND UPPER(OO_ORD_NAME) like '%CFDNA%' AND UPPER(OO_SUMMARY_LINE) like '%SHUKLA%') , DM AS (SELECT DISTINCT STRIP(PT_MRN) AS MRN, STRIP(GENE) AS GENE, STRIP(RESULT) AS "Result", STRIP(METHOD) AS "Method" FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_STRUCTURED_RESULTS_V WHERE PT_MRN IN (SELECT MRN FROM RB) AND PT_MRN IN (SELECT MRN FROM METS) ) SELECT PT_MRN, LISTAGG(COALESCE(STRIP(CAST(GENE AS VARCHAR(12000))), '') , CHR(13) || CHR(10)) WITHIN GROUP( ORDER BY GENE) AS "Diagnostic Molecular" FROM (SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN, GENE FROM DM) D GROUP BY PT_MRN

prompt: Provide the number of CIS Wound order sets and Wound Vac Initiate Therapy since January 2011, grouped by service and month.
completion: SELECT DISTINCT OO_MRN, OO_ACCT_NO, OO_ENTER_DTE, OO_ORD_GUID , YEAR(OO_ENTER_DTE) AS ORD_YR , MONTH(OO_ENTER_DTE) AS ORD_MON , OO_ORD_ID, OO_ORD_NAME ORD_NAME, OO_SET_NAME SET_NAME , OS_SVC_GRP_CD SVC_CD, OS_SVC_DESC SVC_DESC, OO_ORD_STS_CD ORD_STS FROM IDB.OMS_ORDER JOIN IDB.OMS_CLIENT_VISIT ON OO_VISIT_GUID = OCV_VISIT_GUID AND OO_ORD_STS_CD NOT LIKE 'CAN%' JOIN IDB.OMS_SERVICE ON OCV_SVC_GUID = OS_SVC_GUID WHERE (OO_ORD_NAME IN ('Wound Vac, Initiate Therapy', 'Wound (deep) Order Set') OR OO_SET_NAME IN ('Wound Vac, Initiate Therapy', 'Wound (deep) Order Set')) AND OO_ENTER_DTE >= '2011-01-01'

prompt: I would like to be notified if a certain subset of patients are scheduled for a surgical procedure.
completion: WITH PTS AS (SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME FROM DVCMS.COHORT JOIN DVCMS.COHORT_PATIENT ON CHP_COHORT_ID = CHT_COHORT_ID JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON CHP_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID WHERE CHT_COHORT_ID = 5997 ) SELECT OC_MRN MRN, PT_LAST_NAME "Patient Last Name", PT_FIRST_NAME "Patient First Name", OC_SURG_DTE "Procedure Date", CPX_PROC_NAME "Procedure Name" FROM PTS JOIN IDB.OR_CASE ON MRN = OC_MRN JOIN IDB.OR_CASE_ALL_PROC ON OC_CASE_ID = OCAP_CASE_ID JOIN IDB.OR_CASE_ALL_SURG ON OCAP_CASE_ID = OCAS_CASE_ID AND OCAS_PNL_NO = OCAP_PNL_NO AND OCAS_SURG_ROLE = 'Primary' JOIN IDB.OR_PROC ON OCAP_OR_PROC_ID = OP_OR_PROC_ID JOIN IDB.OR_CL_PROC ON OP_OR_PROC_ID = OCP_OR_PROC_ID JOIN IDB.CL_PROC ON OCP_PROC_ID = CPX_PROC_ID JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CRE_RES_ID = OCAS_RES_ID WHERE OC_SURG_DTE >= CURRENT date AND OC_OR_CASE_STS_CD NOT IN ('2', '5') ; WITH PTS AS (SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME FROM DVCMS.COHORT JOIN DVCMS.COHORT_PATIENT ON CHP_COHORT_ID = CHT_COHORT_ID JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON CHP_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID WHERE CHT_COHORT_ID = 5997 ) SELECT CPE_MRN MRN, PT_LAST_NAME "Patient First Name", PT_FIRST_NAME "Patient Last Name", LISTAGG (CPE_ENC_DTE, ' | ') "UCC Visit Dates" FROM PTS JOIN IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER ON MRN = CPE_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID WHERE CLD_DEPT_NAME = 'UCC 1275' AND CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT date - 14 DAYS AND CURRENT date GROUP BY CPE_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME

prompt:
This request is submitted on behalf of Dr. Modak.



We would like to obtain the list of all FDG-PET ordered between 1/1/2016 and 12/31/2020 by a designated list of attendings (list provided below).
completion: SELECT OO_MRN MRN, STRIP(PT_LAST_NAME)||', '||PT_FIRST_NAME PT_NAME , YEAR(OO_ENTER_DTE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) AGE_AT_PET , OP_DISPLAY_NAME REQUESTER, OP_PROV_TYPE PROV_TYPE , OP_PVDR_NO PVDR_NO, OP_DISCIPLINE DISCIPLINE, DOC_SVC , SUBSTR(STRIP(CASE WHEN OO_ORD_NAME = 'Outside Radiology Order' THEN CASE WHEN RO.OUD_USER_DI_VALUE = 'Other' AND RI.OUD_USER_DI_VALUE IS NOT NULL THEN RI.OUD_USER_DI_VALUE ELSE COALESCE(RO.OUD_USER_DI_VALUE, OO_ORD_NAME) END WHEN COALESCE(MD.OUD_USER_DI_VALUE, CR.OUD_USER_DI_VALUE) IS NOT NULL THEN CASE WHEN COALESCE(MD.OUD_USER_DI_VALUE, CR.OUD_USER_DI_VALUE) LIKE '%:%' THEN COALESCE(MD.OUD_USER_DI_VALUE, CR.OUD_USER_DI_VALUE) ELSE STRIP(OO_ORD_NAME)||': '|| COALESCE(MD.OUD_USER_DI_VALUE, CR.OUD_USER_DI_VALUE) END ELSE OO_ORD_NAME END), 1, 155) AS RAD_TEST_NAME , OO_ENTER_DTE PLACEMENT_DATE, OO_PERFORMED_DTE SERVICE_DATE , OO_ORD_ID ORD_ID, OO_ANCIL_REF_CD REPORT_ACCESSION_NO , OO_ORD_STS_CD ORD_STS, OO_REQ_TME_PRIO TIME_PRIORITY , OO_SUMMARY_LINE SUMMARY_LINE, OO_ORD_GUID FROM IDB.OMS_ORDER JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PT_MRN = OO_MRN JOIN IDB.OMS_PROVIDER ON OP_PVDR_GUID = OO_PVDR_GUID LEFT JOIN IDB.DOC ON OO_REQ_DR_NO = DOC_DR_NO LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_USER_DATA CR ON CR.OUD_ORD_GUID = OO_ORD_GUID AND CR.OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'RIS_Order - Current' LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_USER_DATA MD ON MD.OUD_ORD_GUID = OO_ORD_GUID AND MD.OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'RIS_Order - Modified' LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_USER_DATA RO ON RO.OUD_ORD_GUID = OO_ORD_GUID AND RO.OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'Rad_Outside_Test' LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_USER_DATA RI ON RI.OUD_ORD_GUID = OO_ORD_GUID AND RI.OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'RDR_Info' WHERE OO_PERFORMED_DTE BETWEEN '1/1/2016' AND '12/31/2020' AND OO_ORD_NAME LIKE 'PET%' AND OO_ORD_STS_CD NOT LIKE 'CAN%' AND OO_PVDR_GUID IN ('8000003705119029', '9000014743101190', '9000001032119001', '4000005197119029', '2000001464119001', '9000515557701190', '9001249613901190', '4000007243119029', '5000001281119001', '9000226891801190', '1008119001', '7000001340119001', '1000004774119029', '8000001311119001', '9000016510101190', '9000798462101190', '5052119029')

prompt: Retrospective review of airway complications of cancer therapy
Provide a one time list of non-Hodgkin lymphoma patients who previously were started on R+/-EPOCH administered with 24 hour bags and were transitioned to R+/-EPOCH administered with 48 hour bags.
completion: WITH PAIENTS AS (SELECT TRIM(PT_MRN) AS PT_MRN, TRIM(PT_LAST_NAME) || ', ' || TRIM(PT_FIRST_NAME) AS PATIENTS_NAME, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, PT_SEX, R.AV_DESC AS RACE_REG, E.AV_DESC AS ETHICITY_REG FROM IDB.PATIENT LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS R ON R.AV_ELEMENT = 'RACE' AND R.AV_CODE = PT_RACE LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS E ON E.AV_ELEMENT = 'PT_ETHNICITY' AND E.AV_CODE = PT_PT_ETHNICITY), DIAGNOSIS AS (SELECT CC_MRN, CLM_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK, CC_EFF_DTE FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CLM_CLSF_CD = CC_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS ON AV_CODE = CC_CLSF_TYPE WHERE AV_ELEMENT = 'CLSF_TYPE' AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND CLM_CLSF_CD BETWEEN 'C83.30' AND 'C83.39' AND CC_EFF_DTE BETWEEN '2022-03-01' AND '2022-06-30' ), EPOCH AS (SELECT APR_MRN, APR_START_DTE, CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME, APR_GENERIC_NAME, APR_SET_NAME, APR_PRESCRIBED_DOSE, APR_ROUTE FROM IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX JOIN IDB.CHEMO_DRUG_GENERIC ON APR_GENERIC_NAME = CDG_GENERIC_NAME WHERE UPPER(APR_SET_NAME) LIKE '%EPOC%' AND APR_START_DTE BETWEEN '2022-03-01' AND '2022-06-30' ) SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN, PATIENTS_NAME, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, PT_SEX, RACE_REG, ETHICITY_REG, CLM_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK, APR_SET_NAME, APR_ROUTE, APR_START_DTE FROM PAIENTS JOIN DIAGNOSIS ON PT_MRN = CC_MRN JOIN EPOCH ON PT_MRN = APR_MRN

prompt: Patient Report search with "PD-L1 (clone SP-142, Ventana)" in the report
