prompt: Provide a list of patients who have had fine needle aspiration of the thyroid categorized as a Bethesda III.
Provide frozen tissue sample data for patients consented on 00-144.
completion: SELECT D.TBD_ACCESSION_NUM, D.TBD_QUALITY_DESC, D.TBD_CATEGORY_DESC, A.TBA_DISEASE_DESC, A.TBA_PROCUREMENT_DTE, A.TBA_SITE_DESC, A.TBA_SUB_SITE_DESC FROM DV.TISSUE_BANK_ACCESSION_CONSENT_V A INNER JOIN DV.ACCRUALS AC ON A.TBA_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = AC.AC_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID INNER JOIN DV.PROTOCOL P ON AC.AC_PROTOCOL_ID = P.PRO_PROTOCOL_ID AND P.PRO_IRB_NO = '00-144' LEFT JOIN DV.TISSUE_BANK_DETAIL_CONSENT_V D ON A.TBA_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = D.TBD_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID AND A.TBA_ACCESSION_NUM = D.TBD_ACCESSION_NUM AND A.TBA_PART_NUM = D.TBD_PART_NUM AND A.TBA_SUB_PART_NUM = D.TBD_SUB_PART_NUM AND A.TBA_REPORT_ID = D.TBD_REPORT_ID WHERE D.TBD_QUALITY_DESC IN ('Frozen Specimen') AND A.TBA_DISEASE_DESC IN ('Melanoma') AND D.TBD_CATEGORY_DESC IN ('Tumor')

prompt: Provide the number of patients diagnosed with Hepatocellular Carcinoma between 2000 and 2010 who underwent an embolization.
completion: WITH TNM_STAGE1B AS (SELECT TM_MRN, TM_DX_DTE, TM_SITE_CD, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_DESC, TM_HIST_CD, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS HIST_DESC FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR INNER JOIN IDB.CLM H ON TM_HIST_CD = H.CLM_CLSF_CD INNER JOIN IDB.CLM S ON TM_SITE_CD = S.CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('3', '6', '7', '8') AND TM_HIST_CD IN ('M8175/3', 'M8174/3', 'M8173/3', 'M8172/3', 'M8170/3') AND TM_DX_DTE BETWEEN '2000-01-01' AND '2010-12-31' AND (TM_CLIN_TNM_N = 'N1' OR TM_CLIN_TNM_M = 'M1') ), EMBOLIZATION1B AS (SELECT DISTINCT TM_MRN, TM_DX_DTE, TM_SITE_CD, SITE_DESC, TM_HIST_CD, HIST_DESC, PBD_SVC_DTE, PBC_CPT_CD, PBC_PBD_DESC FROM TNM_STAGE1B INNER JOIN IDB.PBD_DTL_CHARGES ON TM_MRN = PBD_MRN INNER JOIN IDB.PBD_CODE ON PBD_PBD_CD = PBC_PBD_CD WHERE PBC_CPT_CD IN ('37204', '61626') AND PBD_SVC_DTE >= TM_DX_DTE AND PBD_SVC_QTY > 0 ) SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT TM_MRN) FROM EMBOLIZATION1B WITH TNM_STAGE2 AS (SELECT TM_MRN, TM_DX_DTE, TM_CLIN_TNM_N, TM_CLIN_TNM_M FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR INNER JOIN IDB.CLM H ON TM_HIST_CD = H.CLM_CLSF_CD INNER JOIN IDB.CLM S ON TM_SITE_CD = S.CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('3', '6', '7', '8') AND TM_HIST_CD IN ('M8175/3', 'M8174/3', 'M8173/3', 'M8172/3', 'M8170/3') AND TM_DX_DTE BETWEEN '2000-01-01' AND '2010-12-31' ) SELECT TM_CLIN_TNM_N, TM_CLIN_TNM_M, COUNT(DISTINCT TM_MRN) FROM TNM_STAGE2 INNER JOIN IDB.PBD_DTL_CHARGES ON TM_MRN = PBD_MRN INNER JOIN IDB.PBD_CODE ON PBD_PBD_CD = PBC_PBD_CD WHERE PBC_CPT_CD IN ('37204', '61626') AND PBD_SVC_QTY > 0 GROUP BY TM_CLIN_TNM_N, TM_CLIN_TNM_M ORDER BY TM_CLIN_TNM_N, TM_CLIN_TNM_M

prompt: Provide an active patient list of Dr. Danielle Zimmerman's Basking Ridge patients
completion: WITH PTS_R AS (SELECT CPE_MRN AS "MRN", PT_LAST_NAME "Last Name", PT_FIRST_NAME "First Name", PT_ADDR1 , PT_ADDR2 ADDR2, PT_CITY CITY, PT_STATE STATE, PT_ZIP_CD ZIP, CPE_ENC_DTE AS "Appt Date", CLD_CLD_CENTER "Location", CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 AS "Department", CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 AS "Service", CLD_DEPT_NAME AS "Department Name", CRE_RES_NAME AS "Provider Name", CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME AS "Visit Type" FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON CPE_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CRE_RES_NAME = 'ZIMMERMAN, DANIELLE ELISE' AND CLD_CLD_CENTER = 'BSK' ) , PTS AS (SELECT DISTINCT "MRN", "Last Name", "First Name", PT_ADDR1 ADDR1, ADDR2, CITY, STATE, ZIP FROM PTS_R) , NEXT_APPT AS (SELECT CPE_MRN, CPE_ENC_DTE, CRE_RES_TYP, CRE_RES_NAME, CLD_DEPT_NAME, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CPE_MRN ORDER BY CPE_ENC_DTE) NEXT_APPT, CASE WHEN CRE_RES_TYP = 'Physician' THEN ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CPE_MRN, CRE_RES_TYP ORDER BY CPE_ENC_DTE) END NEXT_MD_APPT, CASE WHEN CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 = 'CHM' THEN ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CPE_MRN, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 ORDER BY CPE_ENC_DTE) END NEXT_CHM_APPT FROM (SELECT DISTINCT "MRN" FROM PTS) A JOIN IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER ON "MRN" = CPE_MRN JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON CPE_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Sch') ) SELECT P.*, NA.CPE_ENC_DTE NEXT_APPT_DATE, MD.CPE_ENC_DTE NEXT_MD_APPT_DATE, CHM.CPE_ENC_DTE NEXT_CHM_APPT_DATE FROM PTS P LEFT JOIN NEXT_APPT NA ON "MRN" = NA.CPE_MRN AND NA.NEXT_APPT = 1 LEFT JOIN NEXT_APPT MD ON "MRN" = MD.CPE_MRN AND MD.NEXT_MD_APPT = 1 LEFT JOIN NEXT_APPT CHM ON "MRN" = CHM.CPE_MRN AND CHM.NEXT_CHM_APPT = 1

prompt: Provide a list of patients with blood cancers who have/had an appt between 1/1/2017 - 12/31/20
completion: WITH RAW AS (SELECT CPE_MRN AS "MRN", CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8, CLD_DEPT_NAME, CPE_CPE_APPT_STS, CASE WHEN (CLD_DEPT_NAME LIKE '%SVR%' OR CLD_DEPT_NAME LIKE '%SURVIVOR%' OR CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME LIKE '%SNP %' OR CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR like 'SAPP %') THEN 'SVP' END SVP, PT_LAST_NAME LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME FIRST_NAME, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH DOB, CPP_EMAIL_ADDR EMAIL, CAV_NAME LANGUAGE, CPE_ENC_DTE FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON CPE_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY ON CPE_MRN = PLA_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_PAS_PATIENT ON CPE_MRN = CPP_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_CATEGORY ON CAV_CATEGORY = 'LANG' AND CPP_LANG = CAV_ABBR WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp', 'Sch') AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN '2017-01-01' AND '2020-12-31' AND PT_DEATH_IND IN ('', 'A') AND PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH >= '1920-05-01' AND PLA_DONOT_MAIL_IND <> 'Y' AND CPP_EMAIL_ADDR <> '' AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 <> 'NUR' AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 IN ('BMT', 'LEU', 'LYM', 'MYL') ) SELECT "MRN", LAST_NAME, FIRST_NAME, DOB, EMAIL, LANGUAGE, MAX(CASE WHEN CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') THEN CPE_ENC_DTE END) LAST_VISIT_DATE, MIN(CASE WHEN CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Sch') THEN CPE_ENC_DTE END) NEXT_VISIT_DATE, MAX(CASE WHEN CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 IN ('PED', 'MED') AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 = 'BMT' THEN 'Y' END) BMT, MAX(CASE WHEN CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 IN ('PED', 'MED') AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 = 'MYL' THEN 'Y' END) MYL, MAX(CASE WHEN CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 IN ('PED', 'MED') AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 = 'LEU' THEN 'Y' END) LEU, MAX(CASE WHEN CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 IN ('PED', 'MED') AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 = 'LYM' THEN 'Y' END) LYM, MAX(CASE WHEN CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 IN ('PED', 'MED') AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 = 'BMT' AND SVP = 'SVP' THEN 'Y' END) BMT_SVP FROM RAW GROUP BY "MRN", LAST_NAME, FIRST_NAME, DOB, EMAIL, LANGUAGE

prompt: Provide a Darwin cohort of patients for the given criteria along with access to the patients in the Darwin Digital Platform.
completion: WITH PTS AS (SELECT PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID PID FROM DV.PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED) , DT_1 AS (SELECT PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID AS P_ID FROM DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS REC LEFT JOIN DV.PATIENT_CORE_DEMOGRAPHICS ON PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = CORE_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID WHERE 1=1 ) , DT_2 AS (SELECT PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID AS P_ID FROM DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS REC LEFT JOIN DV.PATIENT_CORE_DEMOGRAPHICS ON PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = CORE_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID WHERE 1=1 AND PT_VITAL_STATUS IN ('ALIVE') ) , DT_3 AS (SELECT PDRX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID P_ID FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML INNER JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML_SETTINGS ON PDRX_PATH_DMP_RESULTS_XML_ID = PDRXS_PATH_DMP_RESULTS_XML_ID INNER JOIN DVDMC.PATHOLOGY_DMP_WEBSVC_SETTINGS ON PDRXS_SETTING_ID = PDWS_SETTING_ID INNER JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON PDRX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID, XMLTABLE('$c/root/*' PASSING PDRX_XML_VALUE AS "c" COLUMNS VARIANT_CLASS VARCHAR(100) PATH 'variant_class', SITE1_GENE VARCHAR(100) PATH 'site1_gene', SITE2_GENE VARCHAR(100) PATH 'site2_gene', GENE_ID VARCHAR(100) PATH 'gene_id', EXON_NUM VARCHAR(100) PATH 'exon_num', AA_CHANGE VARCHAR(100) PATH 'aa_change', CDNA_CHANGE VARCHAR(100) PATH 'cDNA_change', IS_HOTSPOT VARCHAR(100) PATH 'is_hotspot', GENE_FOLD_CHANGE VARCHAR(100) PATH 'gene_fold_change', VARIANT_TYPE VARCHAR(100) PATH './local-name(.)', PROJECT VARCHAR(100) PATH '../meta-data/dmp_alys_task_name', SAMPLEID VARCHAR(100) PATH '../meta-data/dmp_sample_id', PATIENTID VARCHAR(100) PATH '../meta-data/dmp_patient_id', TUMOR_TYPE_CODE VARCHAR(100) PATH '../meta-data/tumor_type_code', TUMOR_TYPE_NAME VARCHAR(255) PATH '../meta-data/tumor_type_name', IS_METASTASIS VARCHAR(10) PATH '../meta-data/is_metastasis', PRIMARY_SITE VARCHAR(255) PATH '../meta-data/primary_site', METASTASIS_SITE VARCHAR(255) PATH '../meta-data/metastasis_site') T JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT T.TUMOR_TYPE_CODE TTC FROM TABLE(DV.STRING_SPLIT('UCEC', ',')) S CROSS JOIN TABLE(DV.ONCOTREE_CHILDREN(TRIM(COLUMN_VALUES))) T) X ON T.TUMOR_TYPE_CODE = X.TTC WHERE (GENE_ID IN ('KRAS', 'NRAS', 'HRAS', 'BRAF', 'MEK1', 'MEK2', 'NF1') OR SITE1_GENE IN ('KRAS', 'NRAS', 'HRAS', 'BRAF', 'MEK1', 'MEK2', 'NF1') OR SITE2_GENE IN ('KRAS', 'NRAS', 'HRAS', 'BRAF', 'MEK1', 'MEK2', 'NF1')) AND IS_HOTSPOT = 1 ) , DEID AS (SELECT DISTINCT P_ID FROM (SELECT P_ID FROM DT_1 INTERSECT SELECT P_ID FROM DT_2 INTERSECT SELECT P_ID FROM DT_3 )) SELECT * FROM DEID

prompt:
A list of H- and S- cases with report dates from 01/01/2022-present with diagnosis containing has any of the following search terms: 

 The diagnosis section has any of the following search terms:

 "Low-grade B-cell lymphoma with plasmacytic differentiation" OR  "Lymphoplasmacytic lymphoma" OR "Involvement by lymphoplasmacytic lymphoma"

 The specimens submitted section has any of the following search terms:

 "Peripheral blood"
completion: WITH PATHREPORT AS (SELECT DISTINCT DMP.PRPT_MRN AS MRN, PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID AS PID , PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_BIRTH_DTE, PT_VITAL_STATUS, PT_DEATH_DTE , CASE WHEN PT_DEATH_DTE IS NULL THEN YEAR(CURRENT date - PT_BIRTH_DTE) END AS "Current Age" , DMP.PRPT_ACCESSION_NO AS "Accession No" , DMP.PRPT_REPORT_DTE AS "Report Date" , DMP.PRPT_PROCEDURE_DTE AS "Procedure Date" , DMP.PRPT_REPORT_TYPE_DESC AS "Report Type" , DMP.PRPT_REPORT_TYPE , DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)diag[\w\W]*(?=I ATTEST)', DMP.PRPT_REPORT) AS DIAGNOSIS , VARCHAR(DMP.PRPT_REPORT, 32000) AS "Report Text (first 32000 characters)" , UPPER(DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)SPECIMENS( )*SUBMITTED[\w\W]*(?=DIAGNOSIS:)', VARCHAR(DMP.PRPT_REPORT, 30000))) AS "SPECIMENS SUBMITTED" , SRG.PRPT_ACCESSION_NO AS RELATED_ACC_NO , SRG_DATE.DT_DTE AS RELATED_PROC_DTE , (SELECT VARCHAR(PRPT_REPORT, 32000) AS REFERENCEDPATHTEXTFROM FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT WHERE PRPT_ACCESSION_NO = SRG.PRPT_ACCESSION_NO) AS REFERENCEDPATHTEXT FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V DMP LEFT JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_REFERENCES ON PRPTR_CHILD_PATH_RPT_ID = DMP.PRPT_PATH_RPT_ID LEFT JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT SRG ON SRG.PRPT_PATH_RPT_ID = PRPTR_PATH_RPT_ID LEFT JOIN DV.DATE_V SRG_DATE ON SRG_DATE.DT_DATE_ID = SRG.PRPT_PROCEDURE_DATE_ID JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = DMP.PRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID WHERE 1=1 AND SUBSTR(DMP.PRPT_ACCESSION_NO, 1, 1) IN ('H', 'S') AND (DMP.PRPT_REPORT_DTE >= '01/01/2022' OR DMP.PRPT_PROCEDURE_DTE >= '01/01/2022') AND CONTAINS(DMP.PRPT_REPORT, '("low-grade B-cell lymphoma with plasmacytic differentiation" OR "low-grade B cell lymphoma with plasmacytic differentiation" OR "low grade B-cell lymphoma with plasmacytic differentiation" OR "low grade B cell lymphoma with plasmacytic differentiation" OR "low-grade b-cell lymphoma with plasmacytic differentiation" OR "Lymphoplasmacytic lymphoma" OR "Involvement by lymphoplasmacytic lymphoma" )') = 1 AND DMP.PRPT_REPORT IS NOT NULL ORDER BY 1, 9, 8) , DX AS (SELECT * FROM PATHREPORT WHERE(UPPER(DIAGNOSIS) LIKE '%LOW-GRADE B-CELL LYMPHOMA WITH PLASMACYTIC DIFFERENTIATION%' OR UPPER(DIAGNOSIS) LIKE '%LOW-GRADE B CELL LYMPHOMA WITH PLASMACYTIC DIFFERENTIATION%' OR UPPER(DIAGNOSIS) LIKE '%LOW GRADE B-CELL LYMPHOMA WITH PLASMACYTIC DIFFERENTIATION%' OR UPPER(DIAGNOSIS) LIKE '%LOW GRADE B CELL LYMPHOMA WITH PLASMACYTIC DIFFERENTIATION%' OR UPPER(DIAGNOSIS) LIKE '%LYMPHOPLASMACYTIC LYMPHOMA%' OR UPPER(DIAGNOSIS) LIKE '%INVOLVEMENT BY LYMPHOPLASMACYTIC LYMPHOMA%')) , SS AS (SELECT * FROM DX WHERE "SPECIMENS SUBMITTED" LIKE '%PERIPHERAL%BLOOD%' ) SELECT * FROM SS

prompt: Psych Orders and PT/OT IR Appointments referred by the Plastics Service three months before the procedure to one year after the procedure.
completion: WITH CTE1 AS (SELECT OO_MRN, OO_ENTER_DTE, OO_VISIT_GUID , OO_ORD_NAME, CASE WHEN OO_ORD_NAME = 'Psychiatry Outpatient Consult' THEN 'PSYCH' ELSE OO_ORD_NAME END AS REF_SVC, OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID , CR.OUD_USER_DI_CD, CR.OUD_USER_DI_VALUE , SUBSTR(CR.OUD_USER_DI_VALUE, LOCATE('/', VARCHAR(CR.OUD_USER_DI_VALUE)) + 1) AS REFMDID, OOC_REV_CAT_DEPT DEPT, STRIP(OO_ORD_STS_CD)||'-'||STRIP(OSTS_STS_DESC) STATUS FROM IDB.OMS_ORDER JOIN IDB.OMS_PROVIDER ON OP_PVDR_GUID = OO_PVDR_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_CATALOG ON OOC_MSTR_ITEM_GUID = OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_STATUS ON OO_ORD_STS_CD = OSTS_ORD_STS_CD LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_USER_DATA CR ON CR.OUD_ORD_GUID = OO_ORD_GUID AND CR.OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'Consult_PsychOP_Referring MD' WHERE 1=1 AND OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE BETWEEN '2020-01-01' AND '2020-12-31' AND LOWER(OO_ORD_NAME) IN ('psychiatry outpatient consult') AND OO_ORD_STS_CD NOT IN ('CANC', 'CANP') ) , REFMDNAME AS (SELECT OO_MRN, OO_ENTER_DTE, OO_VISIT_GUID , OO_ORD_NAME, REF_SVC, OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID , OUD_USER_DI_CD, OUD_USER_DI_VALUE, REFMDID, RPD_NUMERIC_CODE, RPD_NAME, RPD_MSK_ACADEMIC_SERVICE, RPD_MSK_ACADEMIC_DEPARTMENT FROM CTE1 JOIN IDB.RMS_PHYSICIAN_DICT_DN3 ON RPD_NUMERIC_CODE = REFMDID WHERE RPD_MSK_ACADEMIC_SERVICE IN ('PLASTIC & RECONSTRUCTIVE', 'PLASTIC AND RECONSTRUCTIVE') ) SELECT RPD_NAME AS PLASTIC_MD, REF_SVC, COUNT(OO_VISIT_GUID) AS TOTAL FROM (SELECT DISTINCT OO_MRN, OO_ENTER_DTE, SSE_SURG_DTE, SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD, SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC, SSP_LOG_ID, SSP_PROC_START_DT, SSP_SURG_LAST_NM, RPD_NAME, SSE_SOURCE_TYPE, REF_SVC, OO_VISIT_GUID FROM REFMDNAME JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT ON SSE_MRN = OO_MRN AND OO_ENTER_DTE BETWEEN SSE_SURG_DTE - 3 MONTH AND SSE_SURG_DTE + 1 YEAR JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE ON SSE_LOG_ID = SSP_LOG_ID AND SSE_SOURCE_TYPE = SSP_SOURCE_TYPE AND SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD IN (19357, 19364) WHERE 1=1 ) AS X GROUP BY RPD_NAME, REF_SVC UNION ALL SELECT PLASTIC_MD, REF_SVC, SUM(SUBTOTAL) AS TOTAL FROM (SELECT RPD_NAME AS PLASTIC_MD , CASE WHEN CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME like 'OT%' THEN 'OT' WHEN CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME like 'PT%' THEN 'PT' ELSE 'OTHER' END AS REF_SVC , COUNT(DISTINCT CPE_ENC_CSN_ID) AS SUBTOTAL FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT C ON CPE_DEPT_ID = C.CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE D ON D.CRE_RES_ID = CPE_VST_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID AND CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR LIKE '%IR%' JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE REFMD ON CPE_REF_RES_ID = REFMD.CRE_RES_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.RMS_PHYSICIAN_DICT_DN3 ON RPD_NUMERIC_CODE = REFMD.CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT REFDPT ON CPE_REF_DEP_ID = REFDPT.CLD_DEPT_ID AND REFDPT.CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 IN ('PLA') JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT ON SSE_MRN = CPE_MRN JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE ON SSE_LOG_ID = SSP_LOG_ID AND SSE_SOURCE_TYPE = SSP_SOURCE_TYPE AND SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD IN ('19357', '19364') WHERE 1=1 AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN '2020-01-01' AND '2020-12-31' AND C.CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 IN ('OT', 'PT') AND CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Comp', 'Arrived') AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN SSE_SURG_DTE - 3 MONTH AND SSE_SURG_DTE + 1 YEAR GROUP BY RPD_NAME, CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME) AS X GROUP BY PLASTIC_MD, REF_SVC

prompt: Provide a report of ClinDoc notes documenting patients with malnutrition.
completion: SELECT DISTINCT CDD_MRN, CDD_DOC_GUID, CDD_DOC_NAME, CDD_SERVICE_DTE, CDO_SECTION, CDO_CTLG_DISPL_NM, CDO_MSTR_ITEM_NM, CDO_ITEM_NAME, CDO_VALUE_TEXT FROM IDB.CD_DOCUMENT JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION ON CDO_DOC_GUID = CDD_DOC_GUID AND CDO_AUTHORED_DTE = CDD_AUTHORED_DTE WHERE CDD_CANCEL_IND = '0' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND = '0' AND CDD_DOC_NAME = 'Initial Assessment - Nutrition' AND CDD_SERVICE_DTE BETWEEN '2020-12-10' AND CURRENT DATE AND CDO_MSTR_ITEM_NM = 'Initial_NUTASSMT_Problem-1aaa SUG' AND UPPER(CDO_VALUE_TEXT) LIKE '%MALNUTRITION%' SELECT DISTINCT CDD_MRN, CDD_DOC_GUID, CDD_DOC_NAME, CDD_SERVICE_DTE, CDO_SECTION, CDO_CTLG_DISPL_NM, CDO_MSTR_ITEM_NM, CDO_ITEM_NAME, CDO_VALUE_TEXT FROM IDB.CD_DOCUMENT JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION ON CDO_DOC_GUID = CDD_DOC_GUID AND CDO_AUTHORED_DTE = CDD_AUTHORED_DTE WHERE CDD_CANCEL_IND = '0' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND = '0' AND CDD_DOC_NAME = 'Progress Note - Nutrition' AND CDD_SERVICE_DTE BETWEEN '2020-12-10' AND CURRENT DATE AND CDO_MSTR_ITEM_NM = 'Initial_NUTASSMT_Problem-1aaa SUG' AND UPPER(CDO_VALUE_TEXT) LIKE '%MALNUTRITION%'

prompt: Identify patients for whom Dr Kalin transmitted a prescription for metformin during the past 30 days.
completion: SELECT DISTINCT HCPR_MRN MRN, STRIP(PT_LAST_NAME)||', '||PT_FIRST_NAME PT_NAME , HGN_GENERIC_NAME GENERIC_NAME, HCPR_CREATED_DTE RX_CREATE_DATE, DATE(HCPR_START_DT) START_DATE, CASE WHEN HCPR_STATUS_TYPE_DESC <> 'Active' THEN COALESCE(DATE(HCPR_DISCONTINUE_DT), DATE(HCPR_END_DT), NO_LONGER_TAKING_DTE, DATE(HCPR_UPD_DT)) END END_DATE, RX.HCPR_PRESCRIPTION_TYPE_DESC PRESCRIPTION_TYPE, RX.HCPR_TRANSMISSION_STATUS_DESC TRANSMISSION_STATUS, RX.HCPR_SEL_SUBM_METHOD_TYPE_DESC METHOD_TYPE_DESC, RX.HCPR_STATUS_TYPE_DESC STATUS_TYPE FROM IDB.HML_CLIENT_PRESCRIPTION RX JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PT_MRN = HCPR_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_CLIENT_VISIT ON OCV_VISIT_GUID = HCPR_VISIT_GUID LEFT JOIN IDB.HML_GENERIC_NAME ON HGN_GENERIC_NAME_ID = HCPR_GENERIC_NAME_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_PROVIDER REQ ON REQ.OP_PVDR_GUID = HCPR_CARE_PROV_GUID AND REQ.OP_PVDR_GUID = '1000004982119029' LEFT JOIN IDB.DOC ON OP_PVDR_NO = DOC_DR_NO LEFT JOIN IDB.HML_RX_UNIT_OF_MEASURE UOM ON UOM.HRUM_RXUOM_ID = HCPR_DOSE_UOM_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.HML_RX_UNIT_OF_MEASURE PKG ON PKG.HRUM_RXUOM_ID = HCPR_INNER_PACKAGE_SIZE_UOM_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.HML_SCRIPT_FREQUENCY ON HSF_SCRIPT_FREQ_ID = HCPR_SCRIPT_FREQ_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.RXW_PHARMACY ON HCPR_PHARMACY_ID = RPH_PHARMACY_ID LEFT JOIN (SELECT HCPX_PRESCRIPTION_ID, DATE(MAX(HCPX_UPD_DT)) AS NO_LONGER_TAKING_DTE , MAX(HCPX_UPD_DT) AS NO_LONGER_TAKING_DT FROM IDB.HML_CLIENT_PRESCRIPTION_HX WHERE HCPX_FIELD_NAME = 'StatusType' AND HCPX_FROM_VALUE = '1' AND HCPX_MODIFICATION_REASON LIKE 'Med Review - No Longer%' GROUP BY HCPX_PRESCRIPTION_ID) X ON HCPX_PRESCRIPTION_ID = HCPR_PRESCRIPTION_ID AND HCPR_STATUS_TYPE_DESC = 'NoLongerTaking' WHERE HCPR_CREATED_DTE >= '2020-04-01' AND(LOWER(HCPR_DRUG_NAME) like '%metformin%') ;

prompt: Provide a monthly report of patients who have consented to 12-245 A&C with a GYN surgeon and whether or not the Part A and/or Part C report has resulted yet.
completion: WITH PTS AS (SELECT TRIM(CRDB.PT_MRN) MRN, PT.LAST_NAME "Last Name", PT.FIRST_NAME "First Name", CASE WHEN PT_DEATH_IND IN ('X', 'C', 'D') THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END "Deceased", MAX(CASE WHEN REG_ID = '100' THEN DATE(CRDB.REGISTRATION_DATETIME) END) "Part A Registration Date", MAX(CASE WHEN REG_ID = '100' THEN DATE(CRDB.CRNT_CONSENT_DATE) END) "Part A Consent Date", MAX(CASE WHEN REG_ID = '100' THEN CRDB.PHYSICIAN_OF_RECORD END) "Part A Treating MD", MAX(CASE WHEN REG_ID = '100' THEN CRDB.CONSENT_PRFSNL END) "Part A Consenting Professional", MAX(CASE WHEN REG_ID = '300' THEN DATE(CRDB.REGISTRATION_DATETIME) END) "Part C Registration Date", MAX(CASE WHEN REG_ID = '300' THEN DATE(CRDB.CRNT_CONSENT_DATE) END) "Part C Consent Date", MAX(CASE WHEN REG_ID = '300' THEN CRDB.PHYSICIAN_OF_RECORD END) "Part C Treating MD", MAX(CASE WHEN REG_ID = '300' THEN CRDB.CONSENT_PRFSNL END) "Part C Consenting Professional" FROM NN.CRDB_DASH_PT_REG CRDB JOIN NN.CRDB_DASH_PT PT ON CRDB.PRT_ID = PT.PRT_ID AND CRDB.PT_MRN = PT.PT_MRN JOIN IDB.PATIENT P ON CRDB.PT_MRN = P.PT_MRN WHERE CRDB.PRT_ID = '12-245' AND COALESCE(REG_ID, '') IN ('100', '300') AND CRNT_ELGBL_STATUS_DSCRP NOT IN ('Ineligible', 'Cancel') GROUP BY TRIM(CRDB.PT_MRN), PT.LAST_NAME, PT.FIRST_NAME, YEAR(CURRENT date - P.PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH), CASE WHEN PT_DEATH_IND IN ('X', 'C', 'D') THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END, CRDB.PRT_ID HAVING ((MAX(CASE WHEN REG_ID = '100' THEN CRDB.PHYSICIAN_OF_RECORD END) IN ('ABU-RUSTUM, NADEEM R', 'AVIKI, EMELINE', 'BROACH, VANCE ANDREW', 'BROWN, CAROL L', 'CHI, DENNIS S', 'GARDNER, GINGER J', 'JEWELL, ELIZABETH', 'LEITAO, MARIO M', 'LONG ROCHE, KARA', 'MUELLER, JENNIFER', 'SONODA, YUKIO', 'ZIVANOVIC, OLIVER', 'AL-NIAIMI, AHMED', 'SMITH, EVAN S.')) OR (MAX(CASE WHEN REG_ID = '300' THEN CRDB.PHYSICIAN_OF_RECORD END) IN ('ABU-RUSTUM, NADEEM R', 'AVIKI, EMELINE', 'BROACH, VANCE ANDREW', 'BROWN, CAROL L', 'CHI, DENNIS S', 'GARDNER, GINGER J', 'JEWELL, ELIZABETH', 'LEITAO, MARIO M', 'LONG ROCHE, KARA', 'MUELLER, JENNIFER', 'SONODA, YUKIO', 'ZIVANOVIC, OLIVER', 'AL-NIAIMI, AHMED', 'SMITH, EVAN', 'KIM, SARAH'))) AND (MAX(CASE WHEN REG_ID = '100' THEN CRDB.CRNT_CONSENT_DATE END) >= '2019-01-01' OR MAX(CASE WHEN REG_ID = '300' THEN CRDB.CRNT_CONSENT_DATE END) >= '2019-01-01')) , IMPACT AS (SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN, PDWS_NAME, PDRX_ACCESSION_NO FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML INNER JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML_SETTINGS ON PDRX_PATH_DMP_RESULTS_XML_ID = PDRXS_PATH_DMP_RESULTS_XML_ID INNER JOIN DVDMC.PATHOLOGY_DMP_WEBSVC_SETTINGS ON PDRXS_SETTING_ID = PDWS_SETTING_ID INNER JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V ON PDRX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID INNER JOIN PTS ON PT_MRN = MRN, XMLTABLE('$c/root/*' PASSING PDRX_XML_VALUE AS "c" COLUMNS SITE1_GENE VARCHAR(100) PATH 'site1_gene', SITE2_GENE VARCHAR(100) PATH 'site2_gene', GENE_ID VARCHAR(100) PATH 'gene_id') T WHERE PDWS_NAME IN ('IMPACT', 'IMPACT GERMLINE SECONDARY') ) SELECT MRN, "Last Name", "First Name", "Deceased", "Part A Registration Date", "Part A Consent Date", "Part A Treating MD", "Part A Consenting Professional", MAX(CASE WHEN PDWS_NAME = 'IMPACT' THEN PDRX_ACCESSION_NO END) "Part A Accession No", "Part C Registration Date", "Part C Consent Date", "Part C Treating MD", "Part C Consenting Professional", MAX(CASE WHEN PDWS_NAME = 'IMPACT GERMLINE SECONDARY' THEN PDRX_ACCESSION_NO END) "Part C Resulted Accession No" FROM PTS LEFT JOIN IMPACT ON MRN = PT_MRN GROUP BY MRN, "Last Name", "First Name", "Deceased", "Part A Registration Date", "Part A Consent Date", "Part A Treating MD", "Part A Consenting Professional", "Part C Registration Date", "Part C Consent Date", "Part C Treating MD", "Part C Consenting Professional" ;

prompt: requesting an addition to the Koch Inpatient Unit Metrics Tableau to include a tab for consults. Would like to be able to visualtize the number of K5 consults created in CIS by discipline/service (neurology, dental, orthopepcis, patient representative, social work, etc)
completion: WITH Q AS (SELECT OO_MRN MRN, TRIM(PT_LAST_NAME) || ', ' || TRIM(PT_FIRST_NAME) PATIENT_NAME, OCV_CURR_LOC CURRENT_LOC, OU_DISPLAY_NAME ENTERED_BY, OS_SVC_DESC SVC, OO_ORD_NAME ORDER_NAME, OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE ORDER_DTE, OSTS_STS_DESC ORDER_STATUS FROM IDB.OMS_ORDER JOIN IDB.OMS_CLIENT_VISIT OCV ON OO_VISIT_GUID = OCV_VISIT_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_CATALOG ON OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID = OOC_MSTR_ITEM_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_STATUS ON OO_ORD_STS_CD = OSTS_ORD_STS_CD JOIN IDB.OMS_USER ON OU_USER_GUID = OO_PVDR_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_SERVICE ON OCV_SVC_GUID = OS_SVC_GUID LEFT JOIN IDB.DOC ON OO_REQ_DR_NO = DOC_DR_NO JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON OO_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE 1=1 AND OO_ORD_STS_CD NOT IN ('CANC', 'CANP', 'AUC3') AND OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT_DATE - 7 DAYS AND CURRENT_DATE AND (OCV_CURR_LOC like '%Koch 5%') AND OO_ORD_NAME like '%Consult%' ) SELECT * FROM Q

prompt: Provide MRN's of patients who've had nephrectomy (partial or radical) at MSKCC with histology of cystic renal cell carcinoma (cystic RCC)
completion: SELECT DISTINCT "t1"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AS "Deident PT #", "t2"."PT_MRN" AS "MRN", "t3"."PRPT_PATH_RPT_ID" AS "DE-ID Pathology Report", "t4"."DT_YEAR" AS "Pathology Report Year", "t5"."DT_YEAR" AS "Pathology Procedure Year" FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED" "t1" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V" "t2" ON "t1"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t2"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V" "t3" ON "t1"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t3"."PRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" "t4" ON "t3"."PRPT_REPORT_DATE_ID" = "t4"."DT_DATE_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" "t5" ON "t3"."PRPT_PROCEDURE_DATE_ID" = "t5"."DT_DATE_ID" WHERE (CONTAINS("t3"."PRPT_DEID_REPORT", '("cystic RCC" | "cystic renal cell carcinoma")') = 1 AND "t3"."PRPT_DEID_REPORT" IS NOT NULL ) SELECT DISTINCT "t1"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AS "Deident PT #", "t2"."PT_MRN" AS "MRN", "t3"."PRPT_PATH_RPT_ID" AS "DE-ID Pathology Report", "t4"."DT_YEAR" AS "Pathology Report Year", "t5"."DT_YEAR" AS "Pathology Procedure Year" FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED" "t1" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V" "t2" ON "t1"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t2"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V" "t3" ON "t1"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t3"."PRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" "t4" ON "t3"."PRPT_REPORT_DATE_ID" = "t4"."DT_DATE_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" "t5" ON "t3"."PRPT_PROCEDURE_DATE_ID" = "t5"."DT_DATE_ID" WHERE (CONTAINS("t3"."PRPT_DEID_REPORT", '("cystic RCC" | "cystic renal cell carcinoma")') = 1 AND "t3"."PRPT_DEID_REPORT" IS NOT NULL)

prompt: Create a list of all patients who had a breast surgery (core and excision, in-house and outside) from 1992-1999.
completion: WITH "cte1" AS (SELECT TEXTTABLE.*, CONTAINS("PRPT_REPORT", '(("CARCINOMA" IN SAME PARAGRAPH AS "COLLOID" ) & ("CARCINOMA" IN SAME PARAGRAPH AS "BREAST" ) & ("COLLOID" IN SAME PARAGRAPH AS "BREAST" ))') AS "HitCol1" FROM "DV"."PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V" TEXTTABLE) , DT AS (SELECT DISTINCT "t1"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID", "t2"."PRPT_ACCESSION_NO" AS "Pathology Report", D.DT_DTE AS "Report Date", CASE WHEN (LOCATE('Date of Collection/Procedure/Outside Report:', "t2".PRPT_REPORT)) > 0 THEN SUBSTR(VARCHAR("t2".PRPT_REPORT, 1999), (LOCATE('Date of Collection/Procedure/Outside Report:', "t2".PRPT_REPORT))+LENGTH('Date of Collection/Procedure/Outside Report: '), 10) ELSE NULL END AS EXTRACTED_PROCEDURE_DATE FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED" "t1" LEFT JOIN "cte1" "t2" ON "t1"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t2"."PRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" INNER JOIN DV."DATE" D ON "t2"."PRPT_REPORT_DATE_ID" = D.DT_DATE_ID WHERE "t2"."HitCol1" <> 0 ) SELECT "Pathology Report" , PT_MRN AS "MRN", "Report Date", YEAR("Report Date" - D.PT_BIRTH_DTE) AS "Age at Report", CASE WHEN YEAR("Report Date" - D.PT_BIRTH_DTE) > 40 THEN '>40' ELSE '' END AS "Over 40", CASE WHEN LOCATE('/', EXTRACTED_PROCEDURE_DATE) > 0 THEN EXTRACTED_PROCEDURE_DATE ELSE NULL END AS "Extracted Procedure Date" FROM DT DT INNER JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V D ON DT.PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = D.PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID

prompt: Provide a daily report for upcoming appointments for 12-245 patients and a weekly report for 12-245 patients with missing orders/accession dates
completion: WITH PTS AS (SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN TM_MRN FROM DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS JOIN DV.CDB_TUMOR_V ON CDTM_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID JOIN DV.DATE_V ON CDTM_DX_DATE_ID = DT_DATE_ID JOIN DV.DIAGNOSIS_CODE_CAT_ICDO_V ON CDTM_DX_CATALOG_ID = DXCC_DX_CATALOG_ID JOIN DV.ICDO_SITE_CATALOG_V ON CDTM_SITE_CATALOG_ID = ICSC_SITE_CATALOG_ID JOIN DV.TUMOR_CASE_ATTRIBUTES_V ON CDTM_CASE_ATTR_ID = TUMOR_CASE_ATTR_ID JOIN DV.SEERGROUPING ON DV.SEERF_ICDO(ICSC_SITE_CD, DXCC_ICD_CODE) = RECODE WHERE CATEGORY2 IN ('Esophagus', 'Stomach') ) , IRB AS (SELECT PT_MRN IRB_MRN, AC_CONS_DTE FROM PTS JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V ON TM_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN DV.ACCRUALS ON PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = AC_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID JOIN DV.PROTOCOL ON AC_PROTOCOL_ID = PRO_PROTOCOL_ID WHERE PRO_IRB_NO = '12-245' ) SELECT PT_MRN AS "MRN", PT_LAST_NAME "Last Name", PT_FIRST_NAME "First Name", DT_DTE AS "Encounter Date", DEPT.EDC_DEPT_DESC AS "Clinical Department", SVC.EDC_DEPT_DESC AS "Clinical Service", ENDP_DEPT_NAME AS "Department Name", ENR_RES_NAME AS "Primary Resource Name" FROM PTS JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V ON TM_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN DV.PATIENT_ENCOUNTER ON PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PENC_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID JOIN DV.DATE ON PENC_ENC_DATE_ID = DT_DATE_ID JOIN DV.ENCOUNTER_DEPARTMENT ON PENC_DEPT_ID = ENDP_ENC_DEPT_ID JOIN DV.ENCOUNTER_SCHD_RESOURCES ON PENC_PT_ENC_ID = ENSR_PT_ENC_ID AND ENSR_PRIMARY_RES_IND = 'Y' JOIN DV.ENCOUNTER_RESOURCE ON ENSR_RES_ID = ENR_ENC_RES_ID JOIN DV.ENCOUNTER_VISIT_TYPE ON PENC_VISIT_TYPE_ID = ENVT_ENC_VISIT_TYPE_ID LEFT JOIN DV.ENCOUNTER_DESC_CATALOG DEPT ON ENDP_SERVICE_DEPT_GRP_6 = DEPT.EDC_DEPT_ABBREV AND DEPT.EDC_GROUP_ID = '6' LEFT JOIN DV.ENCOUNTER_DESC_CATALOG SVC ON ENDP_SERVICE_SPECIALTY_GRP_8 = SVC.EDC_DEPT_ABBREV AND SVC.EDC_GROUP_ID = '8' LEFT JOIN IRB ON TM_MRN = IRB_MRN WHERE PENC_APPT_STS IN ('Sch') AND DT_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT date AND CURRENT date + 7 DAY AND IRB_MRN IS NULL ; WITH PTS AS (SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN TM_MRN FROM DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS JOIN DV.CDB_TUMOR_V ON CDTM_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID JOIN DV.DATE_V ON CDTM_DX_DATE_ID = DT_DATE_ID JOIN DV.DIAGNOSIS_CODE_CAT_ICDO_V ON CDTM_DX_CATALOG_ID = DXCC_DX_CATALOG_ID JOIN DV.ICDO_SITE_CATALOG_V ON CDTM_SITE_CATALOG_ID = ICSC_SITE_CATALOG_ID JOIN DV.TUMOR_CASE_ATTRIBUTES_V ON CDTM_CASE_ATTR_ID = TUMOR_CASE_ATTR_ID JOIN DV.SEERGROUPING ON DV.SEERF_ICDO(ICSC_SITE_CD, DXCC_ICD_CODE) = RECODE WHERE CATEGORY2 IN ('Esophagus', 'Stomach') ) , IRB AS (SELECT TRIM(CRDB.PT_MRN) PT_MRN, PT.LAST_NAME "Last Name", CRDB.PRT_ID "Protocol", MAX(CASE WHEN REG_ID = '100' THEN CRDB.CRNT_CONSENT_DATE END) "Part A Consent Date", MAX(CASE WHEN REG_ID = '100' THEN CRDB.CONSENT_PRFSNL END) "Part A Consenting Professional", MAX(CASE WHEN REG_ID = '100' THEN CRDB.PHYSICIAN_OF_RECORD END) "Part A Treating MD", MAX(CASE WHEN REG_ID = '300' THEN CRDB.CRNT_CONSENT_DATE END) "Part C Consent Date", MAX(CASE WHEN REG_ID = '300' THEN CRDB.CONSENT_PRFSNL END) "Part C Consenting Professional", MAX(CASE WHEN REG_ID = '300' THEN CRDB.PHYSICIAN_OF_RECORD END) "Part C Treating MD" FROM PTS JOIN NN.CRDB_DASH_PT_REG CRDB ON TM_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN NN.CRDB_DASH_PT PT ON CRDB.PRT_ID = PT.PRT_ID AND CRDB.PT_MRN = PT.PT_MRN JOIN IDB.PATIENT P ON CRDB.PT_MRN = P.PT_MRN WHERE CRDB.PRT_ID = '12-245' AND REG_ID IN ('100', '300') AND CRNT_ELGBL_STATUS_DSCRP NOT IN ('Ineligible', 'Cancel') GROUP BY TRIM(CRDB.PT_MRN), PT.LAST_NAME, CRDB.PRT_ID ) SELECT PT_MRN, "Protocol", "Last Name", "Part A Consent Date", "Part A Consenting Professional", "Part A Treating MD", "Part C Consent Date", "Part C Consenting Professional", "Part C Treating MD", OO_ORD_NAME "Order Name", OO_ENTER_DTE "Order Enter Date" FROM IRB LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_ORDER ON PT_MRN = OO_MRN AND OO_ORD_STS_CD NOT IN ('CANC', 'CANP', 'AUC3') AND OO_ORD_NAME IN ('Diag Molecular Path (Solid Tumor) Order', 'Diag Molecular Path (Solid Tumor)Order', 'Secondary germline MSK-IMPACT') ; WITH PTS AS (SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN TM_MRN FROM DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS JOIN DV.CDB_TUMOR_V ON CDTM_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID JOIN DV.DATE_V ON CDTM_DX_DATE_ID = DT_DATE_ID JOIN DV.DIAGNOSIS_CODE_CAT_ICDO_V ON CDTM_DX_CATALOG_ID = DXCC_DX_CATALOG_ID JOIN DV.ICDO_SITE_CATALOG_V ON CDTM_SITE_CATALOG_ID = ICSC_SITE_CATALOG_ID JOIN DV.TUMOR_CASE_ATTRIBUTES_V ON CDTM_CASE_ATTR_ID = TUMOR_CASE_ATTR_ID JOIN DV.SEERGROUPING ON DV.SEERF_ICDO(ICSC_SITE_CD, DXCC_ICD_CODE) = RECODE WHERE CATEGORY2 IN ('Esophagus', 'Stomach') ) , IRB AS (SELECT TRIM(CRDB.PT_MRN) PT_MRN, PT.LAST_NAME "Last Name", CRDB.PRT_ID "Protocol", MAX(CASE WHEN REG_ID = '100' THEN CRDB.CRNT_CONSENT_DATE END) "Part A Consent Date", MAX(CASE WHEN REG_ID = '100' THEN CRDB.CONSENT_PRFSNL END) "Part A Consenting Professional", MAX(CASE WHEN REG_ID = '100' THEN CRDB.PHYSICIAN_OF_RECORD END) "Part A Treating MD", MAX(CASE WHEN REG_ID = '300' THEN CRDB.CRNT_CONSENT_DATE END) "Part C Consent Date", MAX(CASE WHEN REG_ID = '300' THEN CRDB.CONSENT_PRFSNL END) "Part C Consenting Professional", MAX(CASE WHEN REG_ID = '300' THEN CRDB.PHYSICIAN_OF_RECORD END) "Part C Treating MD" FROM PTS JOIN NN.CRDB_DASH_PT_REG CRDB ON TM_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN NN.CRDB_DASH_PT PT ON CRDB.PRT_ID = PT.PRT_ID AND CRDB.PT_MRN = PT.PT_MRN JOIN IDB.PATIENT P ON CRDB.PT_MRN = P.PT_MRN WHERE CRDB.PRT_ID = '12-245' AND REG_ID IN ('100', '300') AND CRNT_ELGBL_STATUS_DSCRP NOT IN ('Ineligible', 'Cancel') GROUP BY TRIM(CRDB.PT_MRN), PT.LAST_NAME, CRDB.PRT_ID ) , ORD AS (SELECT PT_MRN, "Protocol", "Part A Consent Date", "Part A Consenting Professional", "Part A Treating MD", "Part C Consent Date", "Part C Consenting Professional", "Part C Treating MD", OO_ORD_NAME, OO_ENTER_DTE FROM IRB JOIN IDB.OMS_ORDER ON PT_MRN = OO_MRN AND OO_ORD_STS_CD NOT IN ('CANC', 'CANP', 'AUC3') AND OO_ORD_NAME IN ('Diag Molecular Path (Solid Tumor) Order', 'Diag Molecular Path (Solid Tumor)Order', 'Secondary germline MSK-IMPACT')) , CVR_ELEMENTS AS (SELECT PDWS_NAME, PDRX_PATH_DMP_RESULTS_XML_ID, PDRX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID, P.PT_MRN, PDRX_PATH_RPT_ID, PDRX_ACCESSION_NO, PDRX_DMP_PATIENT_ID, PDRX_DMP_SAMPLE_ID, T.*, 'Element' AS NODETYPE FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML ON INNER JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V P ON PDRX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID INNER JOIN ORD O ON P.PT_MRN = O.PT_MRN INNER JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML_SETTINGS ON PDRX_PATH_DMP_RESULTS_XML_ID = PDRXS_PATH_DMP_RESULTS_XML_ID INNER JOIN DVDMC.PATHOLOGY_DMP_WEBSVC_SETTINGS ON PDRXS_SETTING_ID = PDWS_SETTING_ID , XMLTABLE('$x/root//*' PASSING PDRX_XML_VALUE AS "x" COLUMNS NODEXML XML PATH '.', NODENAME VARCHAR(255) PATH 'local-name(.)', NODEVAL VARCHAR(4000) PATH '.', SEQNO FOR ORDINALITY, PARENTNODE VARCHAR(255) PATH '../local-name(.)') T WHERE 1=1 AND PARENTNODE = 'meta-data' AND PDWS_NAME IN ('IMPACT', 'IMPACT GERMLINE SECONDARY') AND NODENAME IN ('dt_accessioned') AND NODEVAL <> 'NA' ) SELECT PT_MRN CVR_MRN, PDRX_ACCESSION_NO, MAX(CASE WHEN PDWS_NAME = 'IMPACT' AND NODENAME = 'dt_accessioned' THEN NODEVAL END) "IMPACT Date Accessioned", MAX(CASE WHEN PDWS_NAME = 'IMPACT GERMLINE SECONDARY' AND NODENAME = 'dt_accessioned' THEN NODEVAL END) "IMPACT Part C Date Accessioned" FROM CVR_ELEMENTS WHERE PDWS_NAME IN ('IMPACT', 'IMPACT GERMLINE SECONDARY') GROUP BY PT_MRN, PDRX_ACCESSION_NO

prompt: Identify patients who had a MR breast biopsy or needle localization at the main hospital and patients who had a breast MRI at 55th Street.
completion: SELECT CL_MRN, CL_LAST_NAME, CL_FIRST_NAME, CPE_ENC_DTE, CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_PATIENT ON CPE_MRN = CL_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CRE_RES_ID = CPE_VST_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 ='RAD' AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_1 <> 'REG' JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID = CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID AND (((CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME LIKE 'MR BREAST BIOPSY%' OR CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME LIKE '%NEEDLE LOC%') AND CLD_CLD_CENTER = 'MAIN') OR CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME LIKE '%MR BREAST%' AND CLD_CLD_CENTER = '301') WHERE CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN '2009-06-04' AND '2009-09-01' AND CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Comp', 'Arrived') ORDER BY CL_LAST_NAME, CL_FIRST_NAME, CPE_ENC_DTE

prompt: Provide a number of admissions on M8 by month from 2009 to present.
completion: SELECT LOCATION, YEAR, MONTH, COUNT(MRN) FROM (SELECT CS_MRN AS MRN, CS_NURS_STA AS LOCATION, YEAR(CS_ADM_DATE) AS YEAR, MONTH(CS_ADM_DATE) AS MONTH FROM IDB.CASE JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PT_MRN = CS_MRN WHERE CS_ADM_DATE BETWEEN '2009-01-01' AND '2013-05-31' AND CS_PT_STS IN ('IC', 'IA') AND CS_NURS_STA = 'NS-8' ) AS X GROUP BY LOCATION, YEAR, MONTH

prompt: Provide a list of completed BSK lab and infusion appointments between 11/1/20 through 3/26/21.
completion: SELECT A.CPE_MRN AS "MRN", A.CPE_ENC_CSN_ID "Encounter ID", PT_LAST_NAME "Last Name", PT_FIRST_NAME "First Name", A.CPE_ENC_DTE AS "Appt Date", CASE WHEN DAYOFWEEK(A.CPE_ENC_DTE) = '1' THEN 'Sunday' WHEN DAYOFWEEK(A.CPE_ENC_DTE) = '2' THEN 'Monday' WHEN DAYOFWEEK(A.CPE_ENC_DTE) = '3' THEN 'Tuesday' WHEN DAYOFWEEK(A.CPE_ENC_DTE) = '4' THEN 'Wednesday' WHEN DAYOFWEEK(A.CPE_ENC_DTE) = '5' THEN 'Thursday' WHEN DAYOFWEEK(A.CPE_ENC_DTE) = '6' THEN 'Friday' WHEN DAYOFWEEK(A.CPE_ENC_DTE) = '7' THEN 'Saturday' END AS "Day of Week", D.CLD_DEPT_NAME AS "Department Name", D.CLD_CLD_CENTER "Location", V.CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME "Visit Type Name", DR.CLD_DEPT_NAME AS "Referring Department Name", DR.CLD_CLD_CENTER "Referring Location", R.CRE_RES_NAME AS "Referring Provider Name" , B.CPE_ENC_CSN_ID "Same Day Encounter ID", B.CPE_ENC_DTE "Same Day Appt", B.CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 "Same Day Appt Dept", B.CLD_DEPT_NAME "Same Day Appt Dept Name", B.CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 "Same Day Appt Svc", B.CRE_RES_NAME "Same Day Appt Resource", B.CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME "Same Day Visit Type" FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER A JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE R ON A.CPE_REF_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT D ON A.CPE_DEPT_ID = D.CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT DR ON A.CPE_REF_DEP_ID = DR.CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE V ON A.CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON A.CPE_MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN (SELECT CPE_MRN, CPE_ENC_CSN_ID, CPE_ENC_DTE, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8, CLD_DEPT_NAME, CRE_RES_NAME, CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN '2020-11-01' AND '2021-03-26' AND CLD_DEPT_NAME NOT IN ('BSK CHEMO', 'BSK LAB') ) B ON A.CPE_MRN = B.CPE_MRN AND A.CPE_ENC_DTE = B.CPE_ENC_DTE AND A.CPE_ENC_CSN_ID <> B.CPE_ENC_CSN_ID WHERE 1=1 AND A.CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND A.CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN '2020-11-01' AND '2021-03-26' AND D.CLD_DEPT_NAME IN ('BSK CHEMO', 'BSK LAB') ;

prompt: RMS D3 Provider Dictionary Problems (please include results in body of email as well as in Excel attachment)
completion: SELECT DN3.RPD_NUMERIC_CODE MD_NUMBER, RPD_NAME MD_NAME, RPD_MNEMONIC MNEMONIC, DN3.RPD_NPI_NUMBER NPI_NUMBER, RSVD_MSK_ADT_SYNONYM PRIMARY_SVC, CASE WHEN RPD_HIS_ALLOWABLE_SVC_REC_NO<>0 THEN 'EXIST' ELSE 'NONE' END SECONDARY_SVC, RPD_HIS_ADMIT_PRIVILEGES_STS HIS_ADMIT_PRIVILEGES_STS, CASE WHEN DN3.RPD_NPI_NUMBER<>'' AND NPI_OCCUR>1 THEN 'NPI NUMBER not unique (in use by another record)' WHEN RPD_HIS_PRIMARY_SVC_REC_NO=0 AND RPD_HIS_ADMIT_PRIVILEGES_STS='1' THEN 'Has ADMIT PRIVILEGES but no HIS PRIMARY SERVICE' WHEN (RPD_HIS_PRIMARY_SVC_REC_NO<>0 OR RPD_HIS_ALLOWABLE_SVC_REC_NO<>0) AND RPD_HIS_ADMIT_PRIVILEGES_STS<>'1' THEN 'Non-RMS (PBD) Provider with PRIMARY/ALLOWABLE SERVICES' WHEN DN3.RPD_NUMERIC_CODE LIKE '0%' AND RPD_HIS_ADMIT_PRIVILEGES_STS<>'1' THEN 'RMS Provider W/O ADMIT PRIVILEGES' WHEN DN3.RPD_NUMERIC_CODE NOT LIKE '0%' AND COALESCE(RPD_MSK_ADT_PRIORITY, '1')='1' AND RPD_HIS_ADMIT_PRIVILEGES_STS='1' THEN 'PBD Provider W ADMIT PRIVILEGES' END PROBLEM FROM IDB.RMS_PHYSICIAN_DICT_DN3 DN3 LEFT JOIN IDB.RMS_SERVICE_DICT_DN37 ON RPD_HIS_PRIMARY_SVC_REC_NO=RSVD_RECORD_NUMBER LEFT JOIN IDB.DOC ON DOC_DR_NO=RPD_NUMERIC_CODE LEFT JOIN (SELECT RPD_NPI_NUMBER, COUNT(*) NPI_OCCUR FROM IDB.RMS_PHYSICIAN_DICT_DN3 WHERE RPD_HIS_ADMIT_PRIVILEGES_STS='1' AND RPD_INACTIVE_FLAG='N' GROUP BY RPD_NPI_NUMBER) NPI ON DN3.RPD_NPI_NUMBER=NPI.RPD_NPI_NUMBER WHERE DN3.RPD_NUMERIC_CODE NOT IN ('000018', '1053', '1399', '99999', '999998') AND RPD_INACTIVE_FLAG='N' AND RPD_DELETION_FLAG='N' AND ((DN3.RPD_NPI_NUMBER<>'' AND NPI_OCCUR>1) OR (RPD_HIS_PRIMARY_SVC_REC_NO=0 AND RPD_HIS_ADMIT_PRIVILEGES_STS='1') OR ((RPD_HIS_PRIMARY_SVC_REC_NO<>0 OR RPD_HIS_ALLOWABLE_SVC_REC_NO<>0) AND RPD_HIS_ADMIT_PRIVILEGES_STS<>'1') OR (RPD_NUMERIC_CODE LIKE '0%' AND RPD_HIS_ADMIT_PRIVILEGES_STS<>'1') OR (RPD_NUMERIC_CODE NOT LIKE '0%' AND RPD_HIS_ADMIT_PRIVILEGES_STS='1')) ORDER BY 8, NPI_NUMBER, MD_NUMBER

prompt: Provide number of new visit patients seen by gynecologic medical oncology service  in 2021.
completion: SELECT DISTINCT CLD_CLD_CENTER AS "Clinic Site", COUNT(DISTINCT CPE_MRN) AS "Count of MRN" FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON CPE_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 = 'GMO' AND YEAR(CPE_ENC_DTE) = '2021' AND (CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR LIKE '%NV%' OR CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR LIKE '%IR%') GROUP BY CLD_CLD_CENTER ; SELECT DISTINCT PT_RACE_DESC AS "Race", COUNT(DISTINCT CPE_MRN) AS "Count of MRN" FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON CPE_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 = 'GMO' AND YEAR(CPE_ENC_DTE) = '2021' AND (CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR LIKE '%NV%' OR CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR LIKE '%IR%') GROUP BY PT_RACE_DESC ; WITH RES AS (SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN, CASE WHEN CC_CLSF_CD = 'C54.1' THEN 'endometrial cancer' WHEN CC_CLSF_CD = 'C56.9' THEN 'ovarian cancer' ELSE 'Others' END AS "Disease" FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON CPE_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.CTC_CLSF ON CPE_MRN = CC_MRN JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 = 'GMO' AND YEAR(CPE_ENC_DTE) = '2021' AND (CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR LIKE '%NV%' OR CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR LIKE '%IR%') ) SELECT DISTINCT "Disease", COUNT(DISTINCT CPE_MRN) AS "Count of MRN" FROM RES GROUP BY "Disease" ; SELECT DISTINCT CLD_CLD_CENTER AS "Clinic Site", CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS "Disease", PT_RACE_DESC AS "Race", COUNT(DISTINCT CPE_MRN) AS "Count of MRN" FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON CPE_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.CTC_CLSF ON CPE_MRN = CC_MRN JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 = 'GMO' AND YEAR(CPE_ENC_DTE) = '2021' AND (CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR LIKE '%NV%' OR CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR LIKE '%IR%') AND CC_CLSF_CD IN ('C54.1') AND PT_RACE_DESC like '%BLACK%' GROUP BY CLD_CLD_CENTER, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK, PT_RACE_DESC ;

prompt: Weekly report for patient's fingerstick values, and insulin orders before and after CIS updates meant to treat diabetes and hyper/hypoglycemia.
completion: SELECT OOTO_ORD_GUID ORD_GUID, OO_VISIT_GUID VISIT_GUID, OO_MRN MRN, CASE WHEN (OO_ORD_NAME) = 'Fingerstick/Blood Glucose' THEN 'Fingerstick' WHEN (OO_ORD_NAME) LIKE 'Insulin INJ%' OR (OO_ORD_NAME) LIKE 'Insulin Pump%' OR (OO_ORD_NAME) LIKE 'Insulin REGULAR%' THEN 'Insulin Regular' WHEN (OO_ORD_NAME) LIKE 'Insulin Sliding Scal%' THEN 'Insulin Sliding Scale' END ORDER_GRP, OO_ORD_ID ORDERID, OO_ORD_NAME ORDNAME, OOTO_SIGNIFIC_DT "Performed DT", OOTO_TASK_DOSE DOSE, OOTO_TASK_UOM UOM , OUO_REQ_TME_PRIO TIME_PRIO, OUO_PVDR_NAME REQUESTED_BY, OUO_PVDR_ROLE_TYPE REQUESTEDBY_ROLE, OP_DISPLAY_NAME ATTENDING, OP_DISCIPLINE, OP_PROV_TYPE ATTENDING_ROLE, OP_DISPLAY_NAME, OP_DISCIPLINE, OP_TASK_ROLE_TYPE, OL_LOC_NAME PATIENT_LOCATION, OS_SVC_GRP_CD, OS_SVC_DESC FROM IDB.OAS_ORD_TASK_OCCR JOIN IDB.OMS_USER_ORDERS ON OOTO_ORD_GUID = OUO_ORD_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_ORDER ON OOTO_ORD_GUID = OO_ORD_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_CLIENT_VISIT ON OO_VISIT_GUID = OCV_VISIT_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_PROVIDER ON OCV_ATT_PVDR_GUID = OP_PVDR_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_SERVICE ON OCV_SVC_GUID = OS_SVC_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_VISIT_LOCATION ON OVL_VISIT_GUID = OCV_VISIT_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_LOCATION ON OVL_LOC_GUID = OL_LOC_GUID JOIN IDB.OAS_CTLG_ITEM_TASK ON OOTO_CAT_ITEM_GUID = OCIT_GUID AND OCIT_LEVEL_NO = 0 WHERE OOTO_SIGNIFIC_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT date - 7 DAY AND CURRENT date AND OOTO_STATUS_CD = 'Performed' AND (UPPER(OO_ORD_NAME) LIKE '%INSULIN%' OR UPPER(OO_ORD_NAME) LIKE 'FINGERSTICK%') AND OVL_VISIT_LOC_GUID = (SELECT MAX(OVL_VISIT_LOC_GUID) FROM IDB.OMS_VISIT_LOCATION WHERE OVL_VISIT_GUID = OO_VISIT_GUID AND OOTO_SIGNIFIC_DT BETWEEN OVL_EFF_DT AND OVL_CHNG_DT) ORDER BY OO_MRN, OOTO_SIGNIFIC_DT, CASE WHEN (OO_ORD_NAME) = 'Fingerstick/Blood Glucose' THEN 'Fingerstick' WHEN (OO_ORD_NAME) LIKE 'Insulin INJ%' OR (OO_ORD_NAME) LIKE 'Insulin Pump%' OR (OO_ORD_NAME) LIKE 'Insulin REGULAR%' THEN 'Insulin Regular' WHEN (OO_ORD_NAME) LIKE 'Insulin Sliding Scal%' THEN 'Insulin Sliding Scale' END;

prompt: Identify patients who received capecitabine and had a brain MRI.
completion: WITH CTE AS (SELECT T1.PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID AS DEIDENT, T6.PT_MRN AS "MRN", MIN(T7.DT_DTE) AS "Min Capecitabine Order Start Date", MAX(T7.DT_DTE) AS "Max Capecitabine Order Start Date" FROM DV.PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED T1 JOIN DV.PHM_PT_MEDS_MQT T8 ON T1.PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = T8.POD_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID JOIN DV.PHM_INVENTORY_CATALOG T2 ON T8.POD_PHARMA_INVENTORY_CTLG_ID = T2.PINC_INVENTORY_CTLG_ID JOIN DV.DATE T3 ON T8.FIST_START_DATE_ID = T3.DT_DATE_ID JOIN DV.PHM_ORDER_DTL T9 ON T8.POD_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = T9.POD_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID AND T8.POD_PHARMA_INVENTORY_CTLG_ID = T9.POD_PHARMA_INVENTORY_CTLG_ID JOIN DV.DATE T7 ON T9.POD_START_DATE_ID = T7.DT_DATE_ID JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V T6 ON T1.PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = T6.PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID WHERE T2.PINC_GENERIC_NAME IN ('CAPECITABINE', 'Capecitabine ') AND T3.DT_DTE >= '1998-1-1' GROUP BY T1.PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID, T6.PT_MRN ) SELECT "MRN", "Min Capecitabine Order Start Date", "Max Capecitabine Order Start Date", CASE WHEN "Max Capecitabine Order Start Date" > "Min Capecitabine Order Start Date" + 6 MONTHS THEN 'Y' ELSE '' END AS ">6 Months between Min and Max", T5.DT_DTE AS "Brain MRI Date" FROM CTE JOIN DV.CPT_PBD_PATIENT_PROCEDURE T4 ON DEIDENT = T4.PTX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID JOIN DV.DATE T5 ON T4.PTX_PROC_DATE_ID = T5.DT_DATE_ID WHERE T4.PROC_ID IN (10223, 10558, 10224, 10559, 10225, 10547) AND T5.DT_DTE >= "Min Capecitabine Order Start Date" WITH CTE AS (SELECT T1.PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID AS DEIDENT, T6.PT_MRN AS "MRN", MIN(T7.DT_DTE) AS "Min Capecitabine Order Start Date", MAX(T7.DT_DTE) AS "Max Capecitabine Order Start Date" FROM DV.PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED T1 JOIN DV.PHM_PT_MEDS_MQT T8 ON T1.PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = T8.POD_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID JOIN DV.PHM_INVENTORY_CATALOG T2 ON T8.POD_PHARMA_INVENTORY_CTLG_ID = T2.PINC_INVENTORY_CTLG_ID JOIN DV.DATE T3 ON T8.FIST_START_DATE_ID = T3.DT_DATE_ID JOIN DV.PHM_ORDER_DTL T9 ON T8.POD_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = T9.POD_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID AND T8.POD_PHARMA_INVENTORY_CTLG_ID = T9.POD_PHARMA_INVENTORY_CTLG_ID JOIN DV.DATE T7 ON T9.POD_START_DATE_ID = T7.DT_DATE_ID JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V T6 ON T1.PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = T6.PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID WHERE T2.PINC_GENERIC_NAME IN ('CAPECITABINE', 'Capecitabine ') AND T3.DT_DTE >= '1998-1-1' GROUP BY T1.PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID, T6.PT_MRN ) SELECT "MRN", "Min Capecitabine Order Start Date", "Max Capecitabine Order Start Date", CASE WHEN "Max Capecitabine Order Start Date" > "Min Capecitabine Order Start Date" + 6 MONTHS THEN 'Y' ELSE '' END AS ">6 Months between Min and Max", MIN(T5.DT_DTE) AS "Min Brain MRI Date", MAX(T5.DT_DTE) AS "Max Brain MRI Date" FROM CTE JOIN DV.CPT_PBD_PATIENT_PROCEDURE T4 ON DEIDENT = T4.PTX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID JOIN DV.DATE T5 ON T4.PTX_PROC_DATE_ID = T5.DT_DATE_ID WHERE T4.PROC_ID IN (10223, 10558, 10224, 10559, 10225, 10547) AND T5.DT_DTE >= "Min Capecitabine Order Start Date" GROUP BY "MRN", "Min Capecitabine Order Start Date", "Max Capecitabine Order Start Date", CASE WHEN "Max Capecitabine Order Start Date" > "Min Capecitabine Order Start Date" + 6 MONTHS THEN 'Y' ELSE '' END

prompt: Generate report of recently resulted brain MRIs for patients I treated with brain radiotherapy.
