prompt: COVID Testing Surveillance Tracking Report for Unvaccinated Employees
completion: WITH EMP AS (SELECT MEI_EMPLOYEE_ID AS EID, MEI_FIRST_NAME, MEI_LAST_NAME, MEI_CC_ID FROM IDB.MSKCC_EMPLOYEE_INFO WHERE MEI_STATUS <> 'Terminated' AND MEI_CC_ID IN ('20100', '20110', '24814', '24871', '24910', '23793') ) , EMP_EXCLUDE AS (SELECT EVI_EMPLOYEE_ID AS EID_EX FROM IDB.COVID19_EMPLOYEE_VACCINE_INFO JOIN EMP ON EVI_EMPLOYEE_ID = EID WHERE DAYS(CURRENT DATE) - DAYS(DATE(DOSE_2_EMAR_ADMIN_DT)) > 14 AND COALESCE(UPPER(DOSE_1_EMAR_MFG_NAME), '') NOT LIKE '%JANSSEN%' UNION ALL SELECT EVI_EMPLOYEE_ID AS EID_EX FROM IDB.COVID19_EMPLOYEE_VACCINE_INFO JOIN EMP ON EVI_EMPLOYEE_ID = EID WHERE DAYS(CURRENT DATE) - DAYS(DATE(DOSE_1_EMAR_ADMIN_DT)) > 14 AND UPPER(DOSE_1_EMAR_MFG_NAME) LIKE '%JANSSEN%' UNION ALL SELECT EVI_EMPLOYEE_ID AS EID_EX FROM IDB.COVID19_EMPLOYEE_VACCINE_INFO JOIN EMP ON EVI_EMPLOYEE_ID = EID WHERE DAYS(CURRENT DATE) - DAYS(DATE(DOSE_2_EXTERNAL_ADMIN_DTE)) > 14 AND COALESCE(UPPER(DOSE_1_EXTERNAL_BRAND), '') NOT LIKE '%JANSSEN%' UNION ALL SELECT EVI_EMPLOYEE_ID AS EID_EX FROM IDB.COVID19_EMPLOYEE_VACCINE_INFO JOIN EMP ON EVI_EMPLOYEE_ID = EID WHERE DAYS(CURRENT DATE) - DAYS(DATE(DOSE_1_EXTERNAL_ADMIN_DTE)) > 14 AND UPPER(DOSE_1_EXTERNAL_BRAND) LIKE '%JANSSEN%' UNION ALL SELECT EMPLOYEE_ID AS EID_EX FROM IDB.EMPLOYEE_COVID_INFO_V JOIN EMP ON EMPLOYEE_ID = EID WHERE RESULT IN ('Positive', 'Resolved') AND DAYS(CURRENT DATE) - DAYS(DATE(MIN_IDENTIFIED_DT)) < 120 ) , EMP_COHORT AS (SELECT EID, CMDM_MRN FROM EMP LEFT JOIN IDB.COVID19_MDM_MATCH ON EID = CMDM_EMPLOYEE_ID AND CMDM_CIS_ACTIVE_IND = 1 WHERE EID NOT IN (SELECT * FROM EMP_EXCLUDE) ) , POS_TEST AS (SELECT COR_MRN AS POS_MRN, DATE(COR_SIGNIFICANT_DT) TEST_DATE_POSITIVE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY COR_MRN ORDER BY DATE(COR_SIGNIFICANT_DT) DESC) RN FROM IDB.COVID19_ORDER_AND_RESULT JOIN EMP_COHORT ON COR_MRN = CMDM_MRN WHERE COR_ORDER_STATUS_CODE NOT IN ('CANP', 'CANC', 'HOLD', 'AUC3', 'DISC', 'PEND') AND COR_ORDER_NAME IN ('COVID-19 Qualitative RNA', 'COVID-19 Rapid Qualitative RNA', 'COVID-19/Flu A B/RSV Qual RNA Panel', 'Respiratory NAT Panel with SARS-CoV-2') AND (LOWER(COR_RESULT_TEXT) like 'detected%' OR (COR_ORDER_NAME IN ('COVID-19 Rapid Qualitative RNA', 'COVID-19/Flu A B/RSV Qual RNA Panel', 'Respiratory NAT Panel with SARS-CoV-2') AND LOWER(COR_RESULT_TEXT) like 'positive%')) ) , NEG_TEST AS (SELECT COR_MRN AS NEG_MRN, DATE(COR_SIGNIFICANT_DT) TEST_DATE_NEGATIVE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY COR_MRN ORDER BY DATE(COR_SIGNIFICANT_DT) DESC) RN FROM IDB.COVID19_ORDER_AND_RESULT JOIN EMP_COHORT ON COR_MRN = CMDM_MRN WHERE COR_ORDER_STATUS_CODE NOT IN ('CANP', 'CANC', 'HOLD', 'AUC3', 'DISC', 'PEND') AND COR_ORDER_NAME IN ('COVID-19 Qualitative RNA', 'COVID-19 Rapid Qualitative RNA', 'COVID-19/Flu A B/RSV Qual RNA Panel', 'Respiratory NAT Panel with SARS-CoV-2') AND (LOWER(COR_RESULT_TEXT) like 'not detected%' OR (COR_ORDER_NAME IN ('COVID-19 Rapid Qualitative RNA', 'COVID-19/Flu A B/RSV Qual RNA Panel', 'Respiratory NAT Panel with SARS-CoV-2') AND LOWER(COR_RESULT_TEXT) like 'negative%') ) ) SELECT DISTINCT TRIM(EMP.MEI_CC_ID) AS COST_CENTER_ID, TRIM(EMP.MEI_CC_DESC) AS COST_CENTER_DESC, TRIM(SUP.MEI_FIRST_NAME) || ' ' || TRIM(SUP.MEI_LAST_NAME) AS SUPERVISOR, TRIM(SUP.MEI_EMAIL_ADDR) SUPERVISOR_EMAIL, CMDM_MRN AS MRN, PT.TEST_DATE_POSITIVE AS LAST_POSITIVE, EID, TRIM(EMP.MEI_FIRST_NAME) AS EMP_FIRST_NAME, TRIM(EMP.MEI_LAST_NAME) AS EMP_LAST_NAME, TRIM(EMP.MEI_JOB_TITLE) AS JOB_TITLE, NT1.TEST_DATE_NEGATIVE AS LAST_TEST_DATE1, NT2.TEST_DATE_NEGATIVE AS LAST_TEST_DATE2, NT3.TEST_DATE_NEGATIVE AS LAST_TEST_DATE3 FROM EMP_COHORT JOIN IDB.MSKCC_EMPLOYEE_INFO EMP ON EID = EMP.MEI_EMPLOYEE_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.MSKCC_EMPLOYEE_INFO SUP ON EMP.MEI_SUPERVISOR_ID = SUP.MEI_EMPLOYEE_ID LEFT JOIN POS_TEST PT ON CMDM_MRN = PT.POS_MRN AND PT.RN = 1 LEFT JOIN NEG_TEST NT1 ON CMDM_MRN = NT1.NEG_MRN AND NT1.RN = 1 LEFT JOIN NEG_TEST NT2 ON CMDM_MRN = NT2.NEG_MRN AND NT2.RN = 2 LEFT JOIN NEG_TEST NT3 ON CMDM_MRN = NT3.NEG_MRN AND NT3.RN = 3 ORDER BY 1, 7

prompt:
Integrative Medicine Service client and patient list of individuals who have visited in the past 12 months but whose last visit was either October, November or December 2009.  

Please include e-mail addresses.

Please remove all deceased individuals from the list and those who indicate they do not wish to be contacted through e-mail.  

The list should include patients, non-patients, and staff members.
completion: SELECT PRK, MRN, LAST_VISIT, EMAIL, NAME, ADDR1, ADDR2, CITY, ST, ZIP FROM (SELECT CPE_PRK AS PRK, CPE_MRN AS MRN , MAX(CPE_ENC_DTE) AS LAST_VISIT , CPP_PT_NAME AS NAME, CPP_EMAIL_ADDR AS EMAIL , CPP_ADDR1 AS ADDR1, CPP_ADDR2 AS ADDR2 , CPP_CITY AS CITY, CPP_STATE AS ST, CPP_ZIP_CD AS ZIP , PLA_DONOT_MAIL_IND, PLA_DECEASED_IND FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT B ON CPE_DEPT_ID = B.CLD_DEPT_ID AND B.CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 = 'IM' JOIN IDB.CL_PAS_PATIENT ON CPP_CL_PT_ID = CPE_CL_PT_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY ON CPE_MRN = PLA_MRN WHERE CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN '2009-07-01' AND '2010-07-21' AND CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') GROUP BY CPE_PRK, CPE_MRN, CPP_PT_NAME, CPP_EMAIL_ADDR , CPP_ADDR1, CPP_ADDR2, CPP_CITY, CPP_STATE, CPP_ZIP_CD , PLA_DONOT_MAIL_IND, PLA_DECEASED_IND) AS X WHERE (PLA_DONOT_MAIL_IND IS NULL OR PLA_DONOT_MAIL_IND <> 'Y' OR PLA_DECEASED_IND IS NULL OR PLA_DECEASED_IND <> 'Y') AND LAST_VISIT BETWEEN '2009-10-01' AND '2009-12-31'

prompt: Provide a report that captures patients who have a Home Lab Collection visit (info in cadence) and a chemotherapy appt scheduled the next day.
completion: WITH HOME AS (SELECT CPE_MRN AS HOME_MRN, CPE_APPT_DT HOME_APPT, CPE_ENC_DTE AS HOME_APPT_DATE, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 AS "Department", CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 AS "Service", CLD_DEPT_NAME AS "Department Name", CRE_RES_NAME AS "Provider Name", CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME AS "Visit Type", CVT_EXT_NAME AS "Visit Type External" FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Sch') AND CRE_RES_ID = '300581' AND CPE_ENC_DTE = CURRENT DATE ) SELECT CPE_MRN AS "MRN", P.PT_LAST_NAME, P.PT_FIRST_NAME, HOME_APPT, CPE_APPT_DT CHEMO_APPT, CLD_DEPT_NAME, P.PT_PHONE, PT_WORK_PHONE, PT_MOBILE_PHONE, STRIP(R1.CRE_RES_NAME) AS INT_REF_PVDR FROM HOME LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER ON HOME_MRN = CPE_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.PATIENT P ON HOME_MRN = P.PT_MRN LEFT JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS D ON HOME_MRN = D.PT_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE R1 ON CPE_REF_RES_ID = R1.CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE R2 ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = R2.CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Sch') AND CPE_ENC_DTE = HOME_APPT_DATE + 1 DAY AND CLD_DEPT_NAME IN ('BER CHEMO', 'CHEMO WES') ORDER BY CPE_APPT_DT

prompt: Provide a list of patients who have been prescribed paxlovid or  molnupiravir (ie listed on HML or eprescribed)
completion: WITH CTE_BMT_CART AS (SELECT DISTINCT CBM_MRN AS MRN, 'BMT' AS PATIENT_TYPE FROM IDB.CRDB_BMT_MEDICINE UNION SELECT DISTINCT CBP_MRN AS MRN, 'BMT' AS PATIENT_TYPE FROM IDB.CRDB_BMT_PEDIATRICS UNION SELECT DISTINCT CDD_MRN AS MRN, 'CAR-T' AS PATIENT_TYPE FROM IDB.CD_DOCUMENT JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION ON CDD_MRN = CDO_MRN AND CDD_DOC_GUID = CDO_DOC_GUID AND CDD_AUTHORED_DTE = CDO_AUTHORED_DTE WHERE CDD_DOC_NAME LIKE 'Cell Infusion%' AND CDD_CANCEL_IND = '0' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND = '0' AND CDO_ITEM_NAME = 'BMT_Cell INF_PI_Cell Source RES' AND CDO_VALUE_TEXT = 'Chimeric Antigen Receptor (CAR)' AND CDD_SERVICE_DTE >= '2015-01-01' UNION SELECT APR_MRN AS MRN, 'CAR-T' AS PATIENT_TYPE FROM IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX_V WHERE CDG_CHEMO_FLAG = ' ' AND CDG_BIOLOGIC_IMMUNO_FLAG = 'Y' AND APR_START_DTE >= '2015-01-01' UNION SELECT CC_MRN AS MRN, 'CAR-T' AS PATIENT_TYPE FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE CC_EFF_DTE >= '2015-01-01' AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'P%' AND CC_CLSF_CD IN ('XW033C3', 'XW043C3') AND(CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y' OR CC_PT_TYPE ='I') ) , CTE_PRESCRIPTION AS (SELECT HCPR_MRN MRN , STRIP(PT_LAST_NAME)||', '||PT_FIRST_NAME PT_NAME , PATIENT_TYPE , HCPR_CREATED_DT DATE_OF_PRESCRIPTION , CASE WHEN HCPR_STATUS_TYPE = 1 THEN 'Active' WHEN HCPR_STATUS_TYPE = 2 THEN 'Inactive' WHEN HCPR_STATUS_TYPE = 3 THEN 'Discontinued' WHEN HCPR_STATUS_TYPE = 4 THEN 'Cancelled' WHEN HCPR_STATUS_TYPE = 5 THEN 'Unapproved' WHEN HCPR_STATUS_TYPE = 6 THEN 'NoLongerTaking' WHEN HCPR_STATUS_TYPE = 7 THEN 'Completed' WHEN HCPR_STATUS_TYPE = 8 THEN 'EnteredInError' END RX_STATUS , HCPR_DRUG_NAME ITEM_DESCRIPTION , HCPR_PRESCRIPTION_TYPE_DESC RX_TYPE , HCPR_DOSE_AMT DOSE, UOM.HRUM_NAME DOSE_UOM, HCPR_ROUTE ROUTE , CAST(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(CHAR(HCPR_QTY_AMT), '00000', ''), '0000', '') , '000', ''), '00', '') AS VARCHAR(25)) QTY, HSF_ABBREVIATIION FREQ , CHAR(INT(HCPR_DURATION_AMT)) DURATION , HCPR_INSTRUCTIONS MEDICATION_INSTRUCTIONS FROM IDB.HML_CLIENT_PRESCRIPTION RX JOIN CTE_BMT_CART CBC ON CBC.MRN = HCPR_MRN JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PT_MRN = HCPR_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.HML_RX_UNIT_OF_MEASURE UOM ON UOM.HRUM_RXUOM_ID = HCPR_DOSE_UOM_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.HML_SCRIPT_FREQUENCY ON HSF_SCRIPT_FREQ_ID = HCPR_SCRIPT_FREQ_ID WHERE 1=1 AND HCPR_CREATED_DTE >= '1/1/2013' AND HCPR_PRESCRIPTION_TYPE = 1 AND HCPR_TRANSMISSION_STATUS IN (1, 5) AND(UPPER(HCPR_DRUG_NAME) LIKE '%PAXLOVID%' OR UPPER(HCPR_DRUG_NAME) LIKE '%MOLNUPIRAVIR%' OR UPPER(HCPR_DRUG_NAME) LIKE '%NIRMATRELVIR%' OR UPPER(HCPR_DRUG_NAME) LIKE '%RITONAVIR%') UNION SELECT OO_MRN MRN, STRIP(PT_LAST_NAME)||', '||PT_FIRST_NAME PT_NAME , PATIENT_TYPE , OO_ENTER_DT DATE_OF_PRESCRIPTION , OSTS_STS_DESC AS RX_STATUS , CASE WHEN NFN.OUD_USER_DI_VALUE IS NOT NULL THEN NFN.OUD_USER_DI_VALUE ELSE STRIP(OO_ORD_NAME)||' '||STRIP(OO_ORD_MODIFIER) END ITEM_DESCRIPTION , 'eRx' RX_TYPE , CASE WHEN STRIP(OMD_DOSE_LOW) > '0' THEN CAST(STRIP(OMD_DOSE_LOW) AS DECIMAL(18, 6)) END DOSE , OMD_DOSE_UNIT DOSE_UOM, OMD_ORD_ROUTE ROUTE, STRIP(QTY.OUD_USER_DI_VALUE) QTY , OO_ORD_FREQ FREQ, DUR.OUD_USER_DI_VALUE DURATION , INS.OUD_USER_DI_VALUE MEDICATION_INSTRUCTIONS FROM IDB.OMS_ORDER JOIN CTE_BMT_CART CBC ON CBC.MRN = OO_MRN JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON OO_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.OMS_STATUS ON OO_ORD_STS_CD = OSTS_ORD_STS_CD JOIN IDB.OMS_CLIENT_VISIT ON OCV_VISIT_GUID = OO_VISIT_GUID LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_ORDER_SET ON OO_SET_GUID = OOS_SET_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_MED_DETAIL ON OMD_ORD_GUID = OO_ORD_GUID LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_USER_DATA QTY ON QTY.OUD_ORD_GUID = OO_ORD_GUID AND QTY.OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'Rx - Quantity' LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_USER_DATA DUR ON OO_ORD_GUID = DUR.OUD_ORD_GUID AND DUR.OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'Duration' LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_FORM_FIELD ON OO_ENTRY_FRM_GUID = OFF_ENTRY_FRM_GUID AND OFF_FLD_LABEL IN ('Non-Formulary Medication Name:', 'Medication Name:') LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_USER_DATA NFN ON NFN.OUD_ORD_GUID = OO_ORD_GUID AND OFF_DI_CD = NFN.OUD_USER_DI_CD LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_USER_DATA INS ON INS.OUD_ORD_GUID = OO_ORD_GUID AND INS.OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'Rx - Instructions' WHERE OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE >= '1/1/2007' AND((UPPER(NFN.OUD_USER_DI_VALUE) LIKE '%PAXLOVID%' OR UPPER(NFN.OUD_USER_DI_VALUE) LIKE '%MOLNUPIRAVIR%' OR UPPER(NFN.OUD_USER_DI_VALUE) LIKE '%NIRMATRELVIR%' OR UPPER(NFN.OUD_USER_DI_VALUE) LIKE '%RITONAVIR%') OR (UPPER(OO_ORD_NAME) LIKE '%PAXLOVID%' OR UPPER(OO_ORD_NAME) LIKE '%MOLNUPIRAVIR%' OR UPPER(OO_ORD_NAME) LIKE '%NIRMATRELVIR%' OR UPPER(OO_ORD_NAME) LIKE '%RITONAVIR%') ) AND OO_ORD_STS_CD IN ('AUA2', 'AUC1', 'COMP', 'COMPT') AND CASE WHEN OO_REQ_TME_PRIO IN ('Medicaid', 'NYS Paper', 'Fill at MSK', 'Outside Order') OR OO_IS_FOR_DSCH = 'Y' OR (OO_REQ_TME_PRIO = 'Routine' AND OCV_IP_OP_IND = 'O' AND OCV_CARE_LVL NOT IN ('AXR', 'UCO', 'OR', 'UCC') AND COALESCE(OOS_VERIFY_POLICY_CD, '') = '') THEN 'Rx' ELSE OCV_IP_OP_IND END = 'Rx' ) SELECT MRN, PT_NAME "PATIENT NAME", PATIENT_TYPE "PATIENT TYPE", DATE_OF_PRESCRIPTION "DATE OF PRESCRIPTION", RX_STATUS "Status of Prescription", ITEM_DESCRIPTION "ITEM DESCRIPTION", RX_TYPE "RX TYPE", DOSE, DOSE_UOM "DOSE UOM", ROUTE, QTY, FREQ, DURATION, MEDICATION_INSTRUCTIONS FROM (SELECT T.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY MRN, ITEM_DESCRIPTION ORDER BY DATE_OF_PRESCRIPTION DESC) AS RN FROM CTE_PRESCRIPTION T) S WHERE RN = 1 ORDER BY MRN, ITEM_DESCRIPTION

prompt: Requesting the demographics of patients enrolled in 20-316
completion: WITH PROTOCOL_0 AS (SELECT "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AS PT_DEID, "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_MRN" AS PT_MRN, CAST(TRIM("IDB"."ACCRUALS"."AC_CONS_DTE") AS VARCHAR) || CAST(TRIM("IDB"."ACCRUALS"."AC_MRN") AS VARCHAR) || CAST(TRIM("IDB"."ACCRUALS"."AC_IRB_NO") AS VARCHAR) AS SUBJECT_ID, "IDB"."ACCRUALS"."AC_IRB_NO" AS AC_IRB_NO FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS" JOIN "IDB"."ACCRUALS" ON "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_MRN" = "IDB"."ACCRUALS"."AC_MRN" WHERE "IDB"."ACCRUALS"."AC_NON_MSK_INST" = '' AND "IDB"."ACCRUALS"."AC_IRB_NO" IN ('20-316')), COHORT AS (SELECT PT_DEID AS PT_DEID FROM (SELECT PROTOCOL_0.PT_DEID AS PT_DEID FROM PROTOCOL_0)), COHORT_PROTOCOL AS (SELECT SUBJECT_ID AS SUBJECT_ID, PT_DEID AS PT_DEID FROM (SELECT PROTOCOL_0.SUBJECT_ID AS SUBJECT_ID, PROTOCOL_0.PT_DEID AS PT_DEID FROM PROTOCOL_0)), KEYS AS (SELECT COHORT.PT_DEID AS COHORT_PT_DEID, COHORT_PROTOCOL.SUBJECT_ID AS COHORT_PROTOCOL_SUBJECT_ID, COHORT_PROTOCOL.PT_DEID AS COHORT_PROTOCOL_PT_DEID FROM COHORT LEFT OUTER JOIN COHORT_PROTOCOL ON COHORT_PROTOCOL.PT_DEID = COHORT.PT_DEID), DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS AS (SELECT DISTINCT "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AS PT_DEID, IDB_PATIENT."PT_MRN" AS PT_MRN, "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AS SUBJECT_ID, TRIM(IDB_PATIENT."PT_LAST_NAME") || ', ' || TRIM(IDB_PATIENT."PT_FIRST_NAME") AS PT_NAME, ALLOWVALS_SEX."AV_DESC" AS SEX, CASE WHEN (IDB_PATIENT."PT_DATE_OF_DEATH" IS NULL) THEN 'Alive' ELSE 'Deceased' END AS VITAL_STATS, ALLOWVALS_RACE."AV_DESC" AS RACE, ALLOWVALS_ETHNICITY."AV_DESC" AS ETHNICITY, LAST_ACTIVITY_DATE."PLA_LST_ACTV_DTE" AS LAST_ACTIVITY_DATE, LAST_CONTACT_DATE."PLA_LST_CON_DTE" AS LAST_CONTACT_DATE FROM "IDB"."PATIENT" AS IDB_PATIENT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS" ON IDB_PATIENT."PT_MRN" = "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_MRN" LEFT OUTER JOIN "IDB"."ALLOWVALS" AS ALLOWVALS_SEX ON IDB_PATIENT."PT_SEX" = ALLOWVALS_SEX."AV_CODE" AND ALLOWVALS_SEX."AV_ELEMENT" = 'SEX' LEFT OUTER JOIN "IDB"."ALLOWVALS" AS ALLOWVALS_RACE ON IDB_PATIENT."PT_RACE" = ALLOWVALS_RACE."AV_CODE" AND ALLOWVALS_RACE."AV_ELEMENT" = 'RACE' LEFT OUTER JOIN "IDB"."ALLOWVALS" AS ALLOWVALS_ETHNICITY ON IDB_PATIENT."PT_PT_ETHNICITY" = ALLOWVALS_ETHNICITY."AV_CODE" AND ALLOWVALS_ETHNICITY."AV_ELEMENT" = 'PT_ETHNICITY' LEFT OUTER JOIN "IDB".PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY AS LAST_ACTIVITY_DATE ON IDB_PATIENT."PT_MRN" = LAST_ACTIVITY_DATE."PLA_MRN" LEFT OUTER JOIN "IDB".PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY AS LAST_CONTACT_DATE ON IDB_PATIENT."PT_MRN" = LAST_CONTACT_DATE."PLA_MRN") SELECT DISTINCT DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS.PT_MRN AS MRN, DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS.PT_NAME AS PT_NAME, DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS.SEX AS SEX, DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS.VITAL_STATS AS VITAL_STATUS, DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS.RACE AS RACE, DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS.ETHNICITY AS ETHNICITY, DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS.LAST_ACTIVITY_DATE AS LAST_ACTIVITY_DATE, DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS.LAST_CONTACT_DATE AS LAST_CONTACT_DATE FROM KEYS LEFT OUTER JOIN DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS ON DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS.PT_DEID = KEYS.COHORT_PT_DEID;

prompt:
Provide a list of all patients at MSK treated from January 1, 2010 and later who have a note with the words "Gastrointestinal Oncology" in the text of the note AND a pathology report with the words "DLL3" or "delta-like ligand 3" in the text of the pathology report.



As a check, four MRNs which should be included in this request once completed are: 

38296769

35234592

35549751

35529652
completion: WITH DX1 AS (SELECT DISTINCT PRPT_MRN , PRPT_REPORT_DTE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY PRPT_MRN ORDER BY PRPT_REPORT_DTE DESC) PATH_RN FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V WHERE PRPT_REPORT IS NOT NULL AND PRPT_REPORT_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT DATE - 30 DAYS AND CURRENT DATE AND (INSTR(LOWER(CAST (PRPT_REPORT AS VARCHAR(12000))), 'delta-like ligand 3') >0 OR INSTR(LOWER(CAST (PRPT_REPORT AS VARCHAR(12000))), 'dll3') >0) ) , EMR AS (SELECT EAD_MRN, EAD_DOCUMENT_DTE FROM IDB.EMR_AA_DOCUMENT D JOIN IDB.EMR_AA_DOCTYPE ON EAD_DOCTYPE = EADT_DOCTYPE JOIN DX1 ON PRPT_MRN = EAD_MRN WHERE VALUE(EAD_RIGHT_ID, EADT_RIGHT_ID) = 167 AND EAD_DOCTYPE = 'M18' AND EAD_DOCUMENT_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT DATE - 30 DAYS AND CURRENT DATE AND EADT_EMR_DESC LIKE '%DOM%' AND EADT_CATEGORY ='Assessments' ) , DX2 AS (SELECT DISTINCT CDD_MRN, OP_DISCIPLINE, CDD_SERVICE_DTE, CDD_DOC_GUID, CDD_DOC_NAME, CDO_SECTION, CDO_ITEM_NAME, CDO_VALUE_TEXT FROM IDB.CD_DOCUMENT LEFT JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION ON CDD_DOC_GUID = CDO_DOC_GUID AND CDD_AUTHORED_DTE = CDO_AUTHORED_DTE AND CDO_VALUE_TEXT <> '' JOIN EMR ON EAD_MRN = CDD_MRN AND CDD_SERVICE_DTE = EAD_DOCUMENT_DTE JOIN IDB.OMS_PROVIDER ON CDD_AUTH_PROV_GUID = OP_PVDR_GUID WHERE CDD_CANCEL_IND <> '1' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND <> '1' AND CDD_DOC_NAME like '%DOM-Gastrointestinal Oncology%' AND UPPER(CDO_ITEM_NAME) ='SERVICE' AND CDO_VALUE_TEXT = 'Gastrointestinal Oncology' AND OP_DISCIPLINE IN ('Medicine', 'Hematology') AND CDD_SERVICE_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT DATE - 30 DAYS AND CURRENT DATE ) SELECT DISTINCT CDD_MRN AS MRN , PRPT_REPORT_DTE AS PATH_REPORT_DATE FROM DX1 JOIN DX2 ON CDD_MRN = PRPT_MRN AND PATH_RN =1 ; WITH DX1 AS (SELECT DISTINCT PRPT_MRN , PRPT_REPORT_DTE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY PRPT_MRN ORDER BY PRPT_REPORT_DTE DESC) PATH_RN FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V WHERE PRPT_REPORT IS NOT NULL AND PRPT_REPORT_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT DATE - 30 DAYS AND CURRENT DATE AND INSTR(LOWER(CAST (PRPT_REPORT AS VARCHAR(12000))), 'sez6') >0 ) , EMR AS (SELECT EAD_MRN, EAD_DOCUMENT_DTE FROM IDB.EMR_AA_DOCUMENT D JOIN IDB.EMR_AA_DOCTYPE ON EAD_DOCTYPE = EADT_DOCTYPE JOIN DX1 ON PRPT_MRN = EAD_MRN WHERE VALUE(EAD_RIGHT_ID, EADT_RIGHT_ID) = 167 AND EAD_DOCTYPE = 'M18' AND EAD_DOCUMENT_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT DATE - 30 DAYS AND CURRENT DATE AND EADT_EMR_DESC LIKE '%DOM%' AND EADT_CATEGORY ='Assessments' ) , DX2 AS (SELECT DISTINCT CDD_MRN, OP_DISCIPLINE, CDD_SERVICE_DTE, CDD_DOC_GUID, CDD_DOC_NAME, CDO_SECTION, CDO_ITEM_NAME, CDO_VALUE_TEXT FROM IDB.CD_DOCUMENT LEFT JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION ON CDD_DOC_GUID = CDO_DOC_GUID AND CDD_AUTHORED_DTE = CDO_AUTHORED_DTE AND CDO_VALUE_TEXT <> '' JOIN EMR ON EAD_MRN = CDD_MRN AND CDD_SERVICE_DTE = EAD_DOCUMENT_DTE JOIN IDB.OMS_PROVIDER ON CDD_AUTH_PROV_GUID = OP_PVDR_GUID WHERE CDD_CANCEL_IND <> '1' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND <> '1' AND CDD_DOC_NAME like '%DOM-Gastrointestinal Oncology%' AND UPPER(CDO_ITEM_NAME) ='SERVICE' AND CDO_VALUE_TEXT = 'Gastrointestinal Oncology' AND OP_DISCIPLINE IN ('Medicine', 'Hematology') AND CDD_SERVICE_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT DATE - 30 DAYS AND CURRENT DATE ) SELECT DISTINCT CDD_MRN AS MRN , PRPT_REPORT_DTE AS PATH_REPORT_DATE FROM DX1 JOIN DX2 ON CDD_MRN = PRPT_MRN AND PATH_RN =1 ;

prompt: Provide a list of all follicular lymphoma patients who had a visit in the past year and haven't been treated at MSK.
completion: WITH DX AS (SELECT DISTINCT TM_MRN AS MRN, TM_DX_DTE AS DX_DATE, TM_HIST_CD AS DX_CODE, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS DX_DESC, CS.AV_DESC AS CASE_STATUS, COC.AV_DESC AS CLASS_OF_CASE FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS CS ON TM_CASE_STS = CS.AV_CODE AND CS.AV_ELEMENT = 'CASE_STS' JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS COC ON TM_CLASS_OF_CASE = COC.AV_CODE AND COC.AV_ELEMENT = 'CLASS_OF_CASE' WHERE 1=1 AND TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND TM_HIST_CD IN ('M9595/3', 'M9597/3', 'M9690/3', 'M9691/3', 'M9695/3', 'M9698/3') ) , "cte1" AS (SELECT * FROM DV.ENCOUNTER_SCHD_RESOURCES WHERE ENSR_PRIMARY_RES_IND = 'Y' ) , "cte2" AS (SELECT EDC_DEPT_DESC, EDC_DEPT_ABBREV FROM DV.ENCOUNTER_DESC_CATALOG WHERE EDC_GROUP_ID = '8' ) , "cte3" AS (SELECT EDC_DEPT_ABBREV, EDC_DEPT_DESC FROM DV.ENCOUNTER_DESC_CATALOG WHERE EDC_GROUP_ID = 'STS' ) , PATH AS (SELECT "t1"."PT_MRN" AS "MRN", MIN("t2"."DT_DTE") AS "Dx Date" FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V" "t1" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED" "t9" ON "t1"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t9"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V" "t3" ON "t9"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t3"."PRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" "t2" ON "t3"."PRPT_PROCEDURE_DATE_ID" = "t2"."DT_DATE_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_ENCOUNTER" "t10" ON "t9"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t10"."PENC_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" "t4" ON "t10"."PENC_ENC_DATE_ID" = "t4"."DT_DATE_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."ENCOUNTER_DEPARTMENT" "t5" ON "t10"."PENC_DEPT_ID" = "t5"."ENDP_ENC_DEPT_ID" LEFT JOIN "cte1" "t11" ON "t10"."PENC_PT_ENC_ID" = "t11"."ENSR_PT_ENC_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."ENCOUNTER_DEPARTMENT" "t12" ON "t11"."ENSR_DEPT_ID" = "t12"."ENDP_ENC_DEPT_ID" LEFT JOIN "cte2" "t6" ON "t12"."ENDP_SERVICE_SPECIALTY_GRP_8" = "t6"."EDC_DEPT_ABBREV" LEFT JOIN "DV"."ENCOUNTER_RESOURCE" "t8" ON "t11"."ENSR_RES_ID" = "t8"."ENR_ENC_RES_ID" LEFT JOIN "cte3" "t7" ON "t10"."PENC_APPT_STS" = "t7"."EDC_DEPT_ABBREV" WHERE ((CONTAINS("t3"."PRPT_REPORT", '"FOLLICULAR"') = 1 AND ("t4"."DT_DTE" >= '2019-12-9' AND ("t5"."ENDP_SERVICE_SPECIALTY_GRP_8" = 'LYM' AND (CASE WHEN "t7"."EDC_DEPT_DESC"IN ('Arrived', 'Completed') THEN 'Completed' WHEN "t7"."EDC_DEPT_DESC" IN ('Scheduled') THEN 'Scheduled' ELSE 'Non-Completed/Scheduled' END = 'Completed' AND "t8"."ENR_RES_TYP" IN ('Physician', 'Telehealth'))))) AND "t3"."PRPT_REPORT" IS NOT NULL) AND "t1"."PT_MRN" NOT IN (SELECT MRN FROM DX) GROUP BY "t1"."PT_MRN" ) , CPE AS (SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN, CPE_ENC_DTE, CRE_RES_NAME, CRE_RES_TYP, CLD_DEPT_NAME, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8, CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CRE_RES_TYP IN ('Physician', 'Telehealth') AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT DATE - 1 YEAR AND CURRENT DATE AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 = 'LYM' AND(CPE_MRN IN (SELECT MRN FROM DX) OR CPE_MRN IN (SELECT MRN FROM PATH)) ) , Y AS (SELECT DISTINCT MRN, "Dx Date" AS DX_DATE, '' AS DX_CODE, '' AS DX_DESC, '' AS CASE_STATUS, '' AS CLASS_OF_CASE FROM PATH JOIN CPE ON MRN = CPE_MRN UNION SELECT DX.* FROM DX JOIN CPE ON MRN = CPE_MRN) , APR1 AS (SELECT APR_MRN, CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME, MIN(APR_START_DTE) AS START_DATE, MAX(APR_END_DTE) AS END_DATE FROM Y JOIN IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX_V ON MRN = APR_MRN AND(CDG_CHEMO_FLAG = 'Y' OR CDG_BIOLOGIC_IMMUNO_FLAG = 'Y') WHERE APR_START_DTE >= DX_DATE GROUP BY APR_MRN, CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME ) , APR2 AS (SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY APR_MRN ORDER BY START_DATE) AS RN FROM APR1) , RT1 AS (SELECT DISTINCT RTC_TX_MRN, RTC_TX_PLAN_NAME, RTC_PRIMARY_REF_POINT, RTC_TX_START_DTE, RTC_TX_STOP_DTE, RTC_TX_ELAPSED_DAYS, RTC_TX_PLANNED_FRACTIONS, RTC_TX_DELIVERED_FRACTIONS, RTC_TX_PLANNED_DOSE, RTC_TX_DELIVERED_DOSE, RTC_DOSE_CORRECTION, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY RTC_TX_MRN ORDER BY RTC_TX_START_DTE) AS RN FROM Y JOIN IDB.RADONC_TREATMENT_COURSE ON RTC_TX_MRN = MRN WHERE RTC_TX_START_DTE >= DX_DATE ) SELECT Y.*, CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME, START_DATE, END_DATE, RTC_TX_PLAN_NAME, RTC_TX_START_DTE, RTC_TX_STOP_DTE FROM Y LEFT JOIN APR2 ON MRN = APR_MRN AND APR2.RN = 1 LEFT JOIN RT1 ON MRN = RTC_TX_MRN AND RT1.RN = 1

prompt: A list of all the patients seen by the lymphoma service who were diagnosed with DLBCL and were CD20 negative
completion: WITH DX AS (SELECT DISTINCT TM_MRN FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS ON AV_ELEMENT = 'CASE_STS' AND AV_CODE = TM_CASE_STS AND TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND TM_HIST_CD = 'M9680/3') SELECT PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID "Patient De-ID", PRPT_DEID_REPORT "De-Identified Report" FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT JOIN DV.DATE P ON P.DT_DATE_ID = PRPT_PROCEDURE_DATE_ID JOIN DV.DATE R ON R.DT_DATE_ID = PRPT_REPORT_DATE_ID JOIN DV.PATH_RPRT_TYPE_LOOKUP ON PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_CD = PRPT_REPORT_TYPE JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON PRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID JOIN DX ON PT_MRN = TM_MRN JOIN DV.MEDPRO ON PRPT_ORDERING_MEDPRO_ID = MP_MEDPRO_ID WHERE CONTAINS("PRPT_REPORT", '("CD20")') = 1 AND PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_DESC IN ('Hematopathology Consult', 'Hematopathology Departmental Consult', 'Hematopathology Report') AND PRPT_REPORT IS NOT NULL ORDER BY 1 DESC

prompt: Identify alll patients who received the following procedures on the Urology Service for the time period 2007-2008:  Prostectomy ,Cystectomy, Nephrectomy, Nephrouretecrectomy, RPLND.
completion: SELECT MRN, SURG_DATE , CASE WHEN MAX(ROBOT_ASST) = 'Y' THEN STRIP(MAX(SURG_DESC))||'/W ROBOTIC ASST' ELSE STRIP(MAX(SURG_DESC)) END AS SURG_DESC , ADMIT_DT, DISCH_DT, SURGEON, SURG_YEAR, LOS , CASE WHEN MIN(SURG_TYPE) = 'Prostatectomy Lap' AND MAX(ROBOT_ASST) = 'Y' THEN 'Prostatectomy Robotic Lap' ELSE MIN(SURG_TYPE) END AS SURG_TYPE FROM (SELECT DISTINCT PBD_MRN AS MRN, PBD_SVC_DTE AS SURG_DATE, STRIP(PBC_CPT_CD)||'-'||PBC_PBD_DESC AS SURG_DESC, TIMESTAMP(CS_ADM_DATE, CS_ADM_TIME) AS ADMIT_DT, TIMESTAMP(CS_DSCH_DATE, CS_DSCH_TIME) AS DISCH_DT, DOC_NAME AS SURGEON, SUBSTR(CHAR(PBD_SVC_DTE), 1, 5)|| CASE WHEN MONTH(PBD_SVC_DTE) BETWEEN 1 AND 3 THEN 'Q1' WHEN MONTH(PBD_SVC_DTE) BETWEEN 4 AND 6 THEN 'Q2' WHEN MONTH(PBD_SVC_DTE) BETWEEN 7 AND 9 THEN 'Q3' ELSE 'Q4' END AS SURG_YEAR, CASE WHEN CS_DSCH_DATE IS NOT NULL THEN INT(CS_DAYS_STAY) ELSE DAYS(CURRENT DATE) - DAYS(PBD_SVC_DTE) END LOS, CASE WHEN PBC_CPT_CD BETWEEN '50220' AND '50230' THEN 'Nephrectomy Open' WHEN PBC_CPT_CD = '50545' THEN 'Nephrectomy Lap' WHEN PBC_CPT_CD = '50240' THEN 'Nephrectomy Partial Open' WHEN PBC_CPT_CD = '50543' THEN 'Nephrectomy Partial Lap' WHEN PBC_CPT_CD = '50234' THEN 'Nephroureterectomy Open' WHEN PBC_CPT_CD BETWEEN '50546' AND '50548' THEN 'Nephroureterectomy Lap' WHEN PBC_CPT_CD = '38580' THEN 'RPLND Open' WHEN PBC_CPT_CD = '38570' THEN 'RPLND Lap' WHEN PBC_CPT_CD BETWEEN '51550' AND '51565' THEN 'Cystectomy Partial' WHEN PBC_CPT_CD BETWEEN '51570' AND '51580' THEN 'Cystectomy Complete' WHEN PBC_CPT_CD BETWEEN '51590' AND '51595' THEN 'Cystectomy w/Conduit' WHEN PBC_CPT_CD = '51596' THEN 'Cystectomy w/Diversion' WHEN PBC_CPT_CD = '51999' THEN 'Cystectomy Lap' WHEN PBC_CPT_CD BETWEEN '55866' AND '55899' AND CC_MRN IS NOT NULL AND PBC_PBD_DESC NOT LIKE '%ROBOT%' THEN 'Prostatectomy Lap' WHEN PBC_CPT_CD = '55899' AND CC_MRN IS NOT NULL AND PBC_PBD_DESC LIKE '%ROBOT%' THEN 'Prostatectomy Robotic Lap' WHEN PBC_CPT_CD BETWEEN '55821' AND '55845' AND CC_MRN IS NOT NULL THEN 'Prostatectomy Open' ELSE 'ZZOther' END AS SURG_TYPE, CASE WHEN PBC_CPT_CD = 'S2900' THEN 'Y' END ROBOT_ASST FROM IDB.PBD_DTL_CHARGES JOIN IDB.PBD_CODE ON PBC_PBD_CD = PBD_PBD_CD JOIN IDB.CLM ON CLM_CLSF_CD = PBC_CPT_CD JOIN IDB.PBD_INVOICE ON PBI_MRN = PBD_MRN AND PBI_ACCT_NO = PBD_ACCT_NO AND PBI_INV_NO = PBD_INV_NO AND PBI_INV_STS = ' ' JOIN IDB.DOC ON PBI_PERFORM_DR_NO = DOC_DR_NO AND DOC_SVC = 'URO' JOIN IDB.CASE ON CS_MRN = PBD_MRN AND PBD_SVC_DTE BETWEEN CS_ADM_DATE AND CS_DSCH_DATE AND CS_ACCT_NO LIKE '84%' AND CS_PT_STS <> 'IP' LEFT JOIN IDB.CTC_CLSF ON CS_MRN = CC_MRN AND CS_ACCT_NO = CC_ACCT_NO AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'P%' AND CC_CLSF_CD LIKE '60.%' AND CC_CLSF_PRIO = '001' JOIN IDB.OR_LOG ON PBD_MRN = OL_MRN AND PBD_SVC_DTE = OL_SURG_DTE JOIN IDB.OR_LOG_ALL_SURG ON OLAS_LOG_ID = OL_LOG_ID AND OLAS_SURG_ROLE = 'Primary' AND OLAS_RES_ID = PBI_PERFORM_DR_NO WHERE PBD_SVC_DTE >= CASE WHEN MONTH(CURRENT DATE) IN (1, 2) THEN DATE(CURRENT_DATE-(DAYOFYEAR(CURRENT DATE)-1)DAY)-1 YEAR ELSE DATE(CURRENT_DATE-(DAYOFYEAR(CURRENT DATE)-1)DAY) END AND PBD_SVC_DTE <= DATE(CURRENT_DATE - 1 MONTH - DAY(CURRENT_DATE) DAY) AND PBC_CPT_CD IN ('50220', '50230', '50545', '50240', '50543', '50234', '50546', '50548', '38780', '38570', '55821', '55831', '55840', '55845', '55866', '55899', '51550', '51555', '51565', '51570', '51575', '51580', '51590', '51595', '51596', '51999', 'S2900') ) SURG GROUP BY MRN, SURG_DATE, ADMIT_DT, DISCH_DT, SURGEON, SURG_YEAR, LOS HAVING MIN(SURG_TYPE) <> 'ZZOther'

prompt: Provide a list of trials open to Adolescents and young adults (AYA) with pediatric sarcoma patients
completion: SELECT DISTINCT PRO_IRB_NO, PRO_IRB_STS_DESC, PRO_IRB_STS_DTE, PRO_OPEN_ACCR_DTE , PRO_PROTOCOL_TYPE, PRO_PROTO_CATEGORY, PRO_IRB_TITLE, PRO_SPON_NAME, PRU_INVESTIGATOR_TYPE, PRU_USER_LAST_NM, PRU_USER_FIRST_NM, PRO_MIN_AGE, PRO_CONSENT_TYPE, PRO_CHILDREN_FLAG, PRO_CANC_TRAL_FLAG, PRO_TRANS_CONSENT, PRO_HUMAN_INV, PRO_FND_SPCMNS, PRO_RSRCH_SPCMNS, PRO_MSK_PTS, PRO_NRML_VLNTRS, PRO_INVST_DVCE_TST, PRO_INVST_DRGS_TST , PRO_RNDM_TRIAL, PRO_CNSNT_FORM_REQ, PRO_INDUST_CNTR FROM DV.PROTOCOL LEFT JOIN DV.PROTOCOL_USER ON PRO_PROTOCOL_ID = PRU_PROTOCOL_ID AND PRU_INVESTIGATOR_TYPE = 'Principal Investigator' WHERE PRO_IRB_STS_DESC = 'Open for Accrual' AND (PRO_MIN_AGE >= 15 OR PRO_MIN_AGE >= 18) AND ((PRO_SPON_NAME LIKE 'Glade Bender, Ju%' OR PRO_SPON_NAME LIKE 'Dela Cruz, File%' OR PRO_SPON_NAME LIKE 'Kinnaman%Micha%' OR PRO_SPON_NAME LIKE 'Ortiz, Micha%' OR PRO_SPON_NAME LIKE 'Slotkin, Emi%' OR PRO_SPON_NAME LIKE 'Meyers, Pau%' OR PRO_SPON_NAME LIKE 'Wexler, Leon%' OR PRO_SPON_NAME LIKE 'Tap, Willi%' OR PRO_SPON_NAME LIKE 'Dickson, Ma%' OR PRO_SPON_NAME LIKE 'Keohan, Ma%' OR PRO_SPON_NAME LIKE 'D%Angelo, San%' OR PRO_SPON_NAME LIKE 'Nacev%Benja%' OR PRO_SPON_NAME LIKE 'Chi, Pin%' OR PRO_SPON_NAME LIKE 'Gounder, Mrin%' OR PRO_SPON_NAME LIKE 'Kelly, Cia%' OR PRO_SPON_NAME LIKE 'Moova%Suj%') OR LOWER(PRO_IRB_TITLE) LIKE '%sarcoma%')

prompt: Provide a report of Advanced Directive/Health Care Proxy documentation in the EMR by Ethlouise Banks in the last 5 weeks.
completion: WITH X AS (SELECT CDD_MRN AS MRN, CDD_DOC_GUID AS DOC_GUID, CDD_SERVICE_DTE AS SVC_DATE, CDD_DOC_NAME AS DOC_NAME, OU_DISPLAY_NAME AS AUTHOR, CDO_SECTION, CDO_CTLG_DISPL_NM, CDO_MSTR_ITEM_NM, CDO_ITEM_NAME, STRIP(SUBSTR(CDO_VALUE_TEXT, 1, 1000)) AS VALUE_TEXT FROM IDB.CD_DOCUMENT JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION ON CDO_DOC_GUID = CDD_DOC_GUID AND CDO_AUTHORED_DTE = CDD_AUTHORED_DTE JOIN IDB.OMS_USER ON CDD_AUTH_PROV_GUID = OU_USER_GUID AND OU_USER_GUID = '2000006007119029' WHERE CDD_CANCEL_IND = '0' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND = '0' AND CDD_DOC_NAME LIKE '%Patient Representative Documentation%' AND CDD_SERVICE_DTE BETWEEN '2020-03-01' AND CURRENT DATE ) , Y AS (SELECT DOC_GUID, MAX(CASE WHEN CDO_MSTR_ITEM_NM = 'Pt_Rp_AdvDir_Pt Location Ob' THEN VALUE_TEXT END) AS "Patient Location", MAX(CASE WHEN CDO_MSTR_ITEM_NM IN ('Pt_Rp_AdvDir_1 RES', 'Pt_Rp_AdvDir_2 RES', 'Pt_Rp_AdvDir_3 RES') THEN VALUE_TEXT END) AS "Patient Advance Directive", MAX(CASE WHEN CDO_MSTR_ITEM_NM = 'Pt_Rp_AdvDir_Comments ob' THEN VALUE_TEXT END) AS "Advance Directives Comments", MAX(CASE WHEN CDO_MSTR_ITEM_NM = 'Pt_Rp_HCA Primary Proxy FT' THEN VALUE_TEXT END) AS "Primary Proxy", MAX(CASE WHEN CDO_MSTR_ITEM_NM = 'Pt_Rp_HCA Primary Proxy Relationship to Pt FT' THEN VALUE_TEXT END) AS "Primary Proxy Relationship to Pt", MAX(CASE WHEN CDO_MSTR_ITEM_NM = 'Pt_Rp_HCA Primary Proxy Contact Information FT' THEN VALUE_TEXT END) AS "Primary Proxy Contact Information", MAX(CASE WHEN CDO_MSTR_ITEM_NM = 'Pt_Rp_HCA Secondary Proxy FT' THEN VALUE_TEXT END) AS "Secondary Proxy", MAX(CASE WHEN CDO_MSTR_ITEM_NM = 'Pt_Rp_HCA Secondary Proxy Relationship to Pt FT' THEN VALUE_TEXT END) AS "Secondary Proxy Relationship to Pt", MAX(CASE WHEN CDO_MSTR_ITEM_NM = 'Pt_Rp_HCA Secondary Proxy Contact Information FT' THEN VALUE_TEXT END) AS "Secondary Proxy Contact Information", MAX(CASE WHEN CDO_MSTR_ITEM_NM = 'Pt_Rp_HCA Healh Care Agent Mandatory RES' THEN VALUE_TEXT END) AS "Health Care Agent Mandatory" FROM X GROUP BY DOC_GUID) SELECT DISTINCT MRN, STRIP(PT_LAST_NAME) || ', ' || STRIP(PT_FIRST_NAME) AS NAME, X.DOC_GUID, DOC_NAME, SVC_DATE, AUTHOR, "Patient Location", "Patient Advance Directive", "Advance Directives Comments", "Primary Proxy", "Primary Proxy Relationship to Pt", "Primary Proxy Contact Information", "Secondary Proxy", "Secondary Proxy Relationship to Pt", "Secondary Proxy Contact Information", "Health Care Agent Mandatory" FROM X JOIN Y ON X.DOC_GUID = Y.DOC_GUID JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON X.MRN = PT_MRN

prompt: Updated RON15882 for diagnoses since 2018.
completion: WITH LUNG_CDB AS (SELECT TM_MRN, TM_DX_DTE, AV_DESC AS CASE_STS, TM_HIST_CD, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS HIST_DESC, TM_SITE_CD, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_DESC FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS ON AV_ELEMENT = 'CASE_STS' AND AV_CODE = TM_CASE_STS JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('3', '6', '7', '8') AND SUBSTR(TM_SITE_CD, 1, 3) = 'C34' AND TM_DX_DTE BETWEEN '2018-01-01' AND CURRENT date ) , HN_CDB AS (SELECT TM_MRN, TM_DX_DTE, AV_DESC AS CASE_STS, TM_HIST_CD, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS HIST_DESC, TM_SITE_CD, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_DESC FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS ON AV_ELEMENT = 'CASE_STS' AND AV_CODE = TM_CASE_STS JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('3', '6', '7', '8') AND SUBSTR(TM_SITE_CD, 1, 3) BETWEEN 'C00' AND 'C14' AND TM_DX_DTE BETWEEN '2018-01-01' AND CURRENT date ) , LUNG_CTC AS (SELECT CC_MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS MIN_DX_DTE FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE SUBSTR(CC_CLSF_CD, 1, 3) IN ('C34', '162') AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND (CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) GROUP BY CC_MRN HAVING MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) BETWEEN '2018-01-01' AND CURRENT date) , HN_CTC AS (SELECT CC_MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS MIN_DX_DTE FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE (SUBSTR(CC_CLSF_CD, 1, 3) BETWEEN 'C00' AND 'C14' OR SUBSTR(CC_CLSF_CD, 1, 3) BETWEEN '140' AND '149') AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND (CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) GROUP BY CC_MRN HAVING MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) BETWEEN '2018-01-01' AND CURRENT date) SELECT PT_MRN AS "MRN", PT_LAST_NAME AS "Last Name", PT_FIRST_NAME AS "First Name", PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH AS "Date of Birth", LUNG_CDB.CASE_STS AS "Lung Cancer Case Status", LUNG_CDB.TM_DX_DTE AS "Lung Cancer Tumor Diagnosis Date", LUNG_CDB.TM_HIST_CD AS "Lung Cancer ICD-O Histology Code", LUNG_CDB.HIST_DESC AS "Lung Cancer ICD-O Histology Desc", LUNG_CDB.TM_SITE_CD AS "Lung Cancer ICD-O Site Code", LUNG_CDB.SITE_DESC AS "Lung Cancer ICD-O Site Desc", LUNG_CTC.MIN_DX_DTE AS "Lung Cancer ICD-9/10 Min Date", HN_CDB.CASE_STS AS "Head and Neck Cancer Case Status", HN_CDB.TM_DX_DTE AS "Head and Neck Cancer Tumor Diagnosis Date", HN_CDB.TM_HIST_CD AS "Head and Neck Cancer ICD-O Histology Code", HN_CDB.HIST_DESC AS "Head and Neck Cancer ICD-O Histology Desc", HN_CDB.TM_SITE_CD AS "Head and Neck Cancer ICD-O Site Code", HN_CDB.SITE_DESC AS "Head and Neck Cancer ICD-O Site Desc", HN_CTC.MIN_DX_DTE AS "Head and Neck Cancer ICD-9/10 Min Date" FROM IDB.PATIENT LEFT JOIN LUNG_CDB ON PT_MRN = LUNG_CDB.TM_MRN LEFT JOIN HN_CDB ON PT_MRN = HN_CDB.TM_MRN LEFT JOIN LUNG_CTC ON PT_MRN = LUNG_CTC.CC_MRN LEFT JOIN HN_CTC ON PT_MRN = HN_CTC.CC_MRN WHERE COALESCE(HN_CDB.TM_DX_DTE, HN_CTC.MIN_DX_DTE) BETWEEN COALESCE(LUNG_CDB.TM_DX_DTE, LUNG_CTC.MIN_DX_DTE) - 6 MONTHS AND COALESCE(LUNG_CDB.TM_DX_DTE, LUNG_CTC.MIN_DX_DTE) + 6 MONTHS

prompt: Provide a weekly notification report generated for all IMPACT DMP results within Neurology and Neurosurgery that is available in the EMR.
completion: WITH MDX_ANNOTS AS (SELECT DISTINCT PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID PTID, PRPT_PATH_RPT_ID "MDPRA_PRPT_PATH_RPT_ID" , PDMR_MODIFIED_DT "MDPRA_MODIFIED_DT" FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_STRUCTURED_RESULTS_V WHERE METHOD = 'IMPACT' ) SELECT DISTINCT ORD.OO_MRN MRN, PR.DT_DTE AS "Procedure Date", ORD.OO_ENTER_DTE "OMS Order Date", DATE(PRPT_MODIFIED_DT) "Path Modified Date", PRPT_ACCESSION_NO AS "Accession Number", DAYS(DATE(PRPT_MODIFIED_DT)) - DAYS(ORD.OO_ENTER_DTE) AS "# days between Order and Pathology", OP_DISPLAY_NAME AS "OMS Request By", DOC_SVC AS "Doctor Service", PDRX_DMP_PATIENT_ID AS "DMP Patient ID", PDRX_DMP_SAMPLE_ID AS "DMP Sample ID" FROM IDB.OMS_ORDER ORD LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_USER_DATA ORD_DATA ON (ORD.OO_ORD_GUID=ORD_DATA.OUD_ORD_GUID) AND ORD_DATA.OUD_USER_DI_CD='Genetic Lesion Susp-ST' LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_USER_DATA ORD_DATA5 ON (ORD.OO_ORD_GUID=ORD_DATA5.OUD_ORD_GUID) AND ORD_DATA5.OUD_USER_DI_CD='Diag Mole ST - Platform' JOIN IDB.OMS_PROVIDER ON OO_PVDR_GUID = OP_PVDR_GUID JOIN IDB.DOC ON OP_PVDR_NO = DOC_DR_NO JOIN IDB.OMS_STATUS ON ORD.OO_ORD_STS_CD = OSTS_ORD_STS_CD JOIN DV.PATIENT_IDENTIFICATION_MRN_V ON PI_SOURCE_SYSTEM_PT_ID = OO_MRN JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V PT ON PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID= PI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V ON PRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID= PI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID AND PRPT_REPORT_TYPE IN ('M_DM', 'M_MPATH', 'URLMP') AND ORD.OO_ENTER_DTE <= DATE(PRPT_MODIFIED_DT) JOIN MDX_ANNOTS ON PRPT_PATH_RPT_ID="MDPRA_PRPT_PATH_RPT_ID" LEFT JOIN DV.DATE_V PR ON PR.DT_DATE_ID=PRPT_PROCEDURE_DATE_ID LEFT JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML ON PDRX_PATH_RPT_ID=PRPT_PATH_RPT_ID WHERE 1=1 AND NOT (ORD.OO_ORD_STS_CD='CANC' OR ORD.OO_ORD_STS_CD='CANP') AND ORD.OO_ORD_NAME='Diag Molecular Path (Solid Tumor)Order' AND DOC_SVC IN ('NEU', 'NRS') AND ORD_DATA5.OUD_USER_DI_VALUE like '%IMPACT%' AND OO_ENTER_DTE >= CURRENT date - 180 DAYS AND DATE(PRPT_MODIFIED_DT) >= CURRENT date - 7 DAY

prompt: I'd like to request imaging data for 04-070 FMISO patients from the years 2004-2011.
completion: WITH ACC AS (SELECT AC_MRN, AC_NON_MSK_INST, AC_LAST_NAME, AC_FIRST_NAME, AC_CONS_DTE, AC_PVDR_OF_RECORD_NAME FROM IDB.ACCRUALS WHERE AC_IRB_NO = '04-070' ), RAD AS (SELECT DISTINCT RRPT_MRN, RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE, RRPT_RPT_ID, RRPT_ACCESSION_NO, RRPT_ORDER_GROUP, RRPT_PROCEDURE_NAME, CAST(RRPT_REPORT_TXT AS VARCHAR(32000)) AS PET_REPORT FROM DV.RADIOLOGY_REPORT_V JOIN ACC ON AC_MRN = RRPT_MRN WHERE RRPT_ORDER_GROUP LIKE ('PET%') AND YEAR(RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE) BETWEEN '2004' AND '2011' ) SELECT DISTINCT AC_MRN, RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE, RRPT_ACCESSION_NO, RRPT_ORDER_GROUP, RRPT_PROCEDURE_NAME, PET_REPORT FROM ACC JOIN RAD ON AC_MRN = RRPT_MRN

prompt: Provide a list of breast cancer patients with IR procedures since 2015
completion: WITH SRG AS (SELECT PI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID PID, OC_MRN AS MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, OC_SURG_DTE AS BX_SCHD_DATE, OC_CASE_ID CASE_ID, CDX_DX_NAME, OC_OR_CASE_STS CASE_STS, OP_PROC_DESC AS PROC_NAME, CASE WHEN OC_PT_CLASS IN ('IP', 'PSC', 'SDA', 'PDH', 'EI', 'FSI') THEN 'IP' ELSE 'OP' END AS PT_TYPE, MD.CRE_RES_NAME AS SURGEON, RF.CRE_RES_NAME REF_MD FROM IDB.OR_CASE ORC JOIN DV.PATIENT_IDENTIFICATION_MRN_V ON PI_SOURCE_SYSTEM_PT_ID = OC_MRN JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V ON PI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID JOIN IDB.OR_CASE_ALL_PROC ON OC_CASE_ID = OCAP_CASE_ID JOIN IDB.OR_CASE_ALL_SURG ON OCAP_CASE_ID = OCAS_CASE_ID AND OCAS_SURG_ROLE = 'Primary' JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE MD ON OCAS_RES_ID = MD.CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.OR_PROC ON OCAP_OR_PROC_ID = OP_OR_PROC_ID JOIN IDB.OR_CL_PROC ON OP_OR_PROC_ID = OCP_OR_PROC_ID JOIN IDB.CL_PROC ON OCP_PROC_ID = CPX_PROC_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE RF ON OC_REF_RES_ID = RF.CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.OR_CASE_DX_CODES ON OCD_CASE_ID = OC_CASE_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_DX DX ON DX.CDX_DX_ID = OCD_DX_ID WHERE 1=1 AND OC_SURG_DTE >= '2015-01-01' AND OCAS_SURG_SVC = 'IR' AND OC_OR_CASE_STS_CD NOT IN ('2', '5') AND(UCASE(OP_PROC_NAME) LIKE '%BIOPSY%' OR UCASE(OP_PROC_NAME) LIKE '%BX%') AND RF.CRE_RES_NAME IN ('BAO, TING', 'BLINDER, VICTORIA S', 'BROCKWAY-MARCHELLO, JULIA P.', 'BROMBERG, JACQUELINE', 'CHANDARLAPATY, SARAT', 'COMEN, ELIZABETH', 'D''ANDREA, GABRIELLA', 'DANG, CHAU', 'DOS ANJOS, CARLOS HENRIQUE', 'DRAGO, JOSHUA ZACHARY', 'DRULLINSKY, PAMELA', 'FORNIER, MONICA N', 'GAJRIA, DEVIKA', 'GOLDFARB, SHARI', 'GUCALP, AYCA', 'HUDIS, CLIFFORD', 'IYENGAR, NEIL M', 'JHAVERI, KOMAL LACHHMAN', 'LAKE, DIANA E.', 'LIGRESTI, LOUISE G E', 'MODI, SHANU', 'NORTON, LARRY', 'PARK, SUE JUNG', 'RIZK, VICTORIA TEWFIK ELIAS', 'ROBSON, MARK', 'ROSEN, EZRA YEHIEL', 'SANFORD, RACHEL', 'SCHWEBER, SARAH JOAN', 'SEIDMAN, ANDREW', 'SINGH, JASMEET CHADHA', 'SKLARIN, NANCY', 'SUGARMAN, STEVEN', 'TRAINA, TIFFANY', 'VAHDAT, LINDA THERESA', 'VASAN, NEIL', 'WANG, RUI', 'WONG, SERENA TSAN-LAI', 'ZHI, WANQING IRIS') ) , IRB AS (SELECT MRN, MAX(CASE WHEN PRO_IRB_NO = '12-245' THEN AC_CONS_DTE END) "12-245 Consent Date", MAX(CASE WHEN PRO_IRB_NO = '06-107' THEN AC_CONS_DTE END) "06-107 Consent Date" FROM (SELECT DISTINCT PID, MRN FROM SRG) JOIN DV.ACCRUALS ON PID = AC_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID JOIN DV.PROTOCOL ON AC_PROTOCOL_ID = PRO_PROTOCOL_ID WHERE PRO_IRB_NO IN ('12-245', '06-107') GROUP BY MRN ) , APPT AS (SELECT MRN, DT_DTE "Appt Date", DEPT.EDC_DEPT_DESC AS "Clinical Department", SVC.EDC_DEPT_DESC AS "Clinical Service", ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY MRN ORDER BY DT_DTE) RN FROM (SELECT DISTINCT PID, MRN FROM SRG) JOIN DV.PATIENT_ENCOUNTER ON PID = PENC_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID JOIN DV.DATE ON PENC_ENC_DATE_ID = DT_DATE_ID JOIN DV.ENCOUNTER_DEPARTMENT ON PENC_DEPT_ID = ENDP_ENC_DEPT_ID JOIN DV.ENCOUNTER_SCHD_RESOURCES ON PENC_PT_ENC_ID = ENSR_PT_ENC_ID AND ENSR_PRIMARY_RES_IND = 'Y' JOIN DV.ENCOUNTER_RESOURCE ON ENSR_RES_ID = ENR_ENC_RES_ID JOIN DV.ENCOUNTER_VISIT_TYPE ON PENC_VISIT_TYPE_ID = ENVT_ENC_VISIT_TYPE_ID LEFT JOIN DV.ENCOUNTER_DESC_CATALOG DEPT ON ENDP_SERVICE_DEPT_GRP_6 = DEPT.EDC_DEPT_ABBREV AND DEPT.EDC_GROUP_ID = '6' LEFT JOIN DV.ENCOUNTER_DESC_CATALOG SVC ON ENDP_SERVICE_SPECIALTY_GRP_8 = Date", "Clinical Department", "Clinical Service" FROM SRG S LEFT JOIN IRB I ON S.MRN = I.MRN LEFT JOIN APPT A ON S.MRN = A.MRN AND RN = 1

prompt:
To determine the incidence of eosinophilic folliculitis (EF) in autologous and allogeneic hematopoietic stem cell transplantation (HSCT) recipients. 

Secondary Aims

1.	To explore the association of patient and disease characteristics with the development of EF in HSCT recipients.

2.	To explore the association of histopathologic characteristics with treatment responsiveness.
completion: WITH EOS AS (SELECT LR_MRN, LR_PERFORMED_DTE, LR_TEST_NAME, LR_SUBTEST_NAME, LR_RESULT_VALUE FROM IDB.LAB_RESULTS WHERE LR_SUBTEST_NAME IN ('Abs Eos', 'Absolute Eosinophil', 'Eos', 'Eosinophils', 'Eosinophils %, Quest', 'Eosinophils Absolute, Quest', 'Eosinophil %', 'Eosinophils, Percent, Quest') AND LR_ABNORMALITY_CD IN ('H', 'HH') AND LR_PERFORMED_DTE BETWEEN '2009-01-01' AND '2018-12-31' ) , WBC AS (SELECT W.LR_MRN AS WBC_MRN, W.LR_PERFORMED_DTE AS WBC_PERFORMED_DTE, W.LR_RESULT_VALUE AS WBC FROM IDB.LAB_RESULTS W JOIN EOS ON W.LR_MRN = EOS.LR_MRN AND W.LR_PERFORMED_DTE = EOS.LR_PERFORMED_DTE WHERE W.LR_SUBTEST_NAME = 'WBC' AND W.LR_PERFORMED_DTE BETWEEN '2009-01-01' AND '2018-12-31' ) , DERM AS (SELECT CC_MRN AS DERM_MRN, CC_EFF_DTE AS DERM_DX_DATE, CC_CLSF_CD AS DERM_ICD_CODE, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS DERM_DX_DESC FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN EOS ON LR_MRN = CC_MRN AND CC_EFF_DTE BETWEEN LR_PERFORMED_DTE - 14 DAYS AND LR_PERFORMED_DTE + 14 DAYS WHERE (SUBSTR(CC_CLSF_CD, 1, 3) BETWEEN 'L70' AND 'L73' OR SUBSTR(CC_CLSF_CD, 1, 3) BETWEEN 'R20' AND 'R23' OR SUBSTR(CC_CLSF_CD, 1, 3) BETWEEN '680' AND '698' OR SUBSTR(CC_CLSF_CD, 1, 3) BETWEEN '704' AND '706' OR SUBSTR(CC_CLSF_CD, 1, 3) IN ('709', '782', 'L29') OR SUBSTR(CC_CLSF_CD, 1, 5) IN ('L08.9', 'L30.3')) AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND (CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) ) , BMT AS (SELECT CBP_MRN AS BMT_MRN , CBP_TRANSPLANT_DTE AS HSCT_DATE FROM IDB.CRDB_BMT_PEDIATRICS JOIN DERM ON CBP_MRN = DERM_MRN JOIN EOS ON CBP_MRN = LR_MRN WHERE LR_PERFORMED_DTE BETWEEN CBP_TRANSPLANT_DTE AND CBP_TRANSPLANT_DTE + 1 YEAR UNION SELECT CBM_MRN AS BMT_MRN , CBM_TRANSPLANT_DTE AS HSCT_DATE FROM IDB.CRDB_BMT_MEDICINE JOIN DERM ON CBM_MRN = DERM_MRN JOIN EOS ON CBM_MRN = LR_MRN WHERE LR_PERFORMED_DTE BETWEEN CBM_TRANSPLANT_DTE AND CBM_TRANSPLANT_DTE + 1 YEAR ) , TUMOR AS (SELECT TM_MRN, TM_DX_DTE, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS HIST_DESC, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_DESC FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN BMT ON TM_MRN = BMT_MRN JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND TM_DX_DTE < HSCT_DATE + 14 DAYS ) , CLINTRAC AS (SELECT CC_MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS MIN_ICD9_EFF_DTE, CC_CLSF_CD AS ICD_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS ICD_DESC, CATEGORY2 AS ICD_SITE FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.SEERGROUPING ON CLM_CLSF_RECODE = RECODE JOIN BMT ON CC_MRN = BMT_MRN WHERE (SUBSTR(CC_CLSF_CD, 1, 3) BETWEEN 'C00' AND 'C76' OR SUBSTR(CC_CLSF_CD, 1, 3) BETWEEN 'C80' AND 'C96' OR SUBSTR(CC_CLSF_CD, 1, 3) = 'C7A') AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND (CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) GROUP BY CC_MRN, CC_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK, CATEGORY2, HSCT_DATE HAVING MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) < HSCT_DATE + 14 DAYS) SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN AS MRN , PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH AS DOB , COALESCE(TM_DX_DTE, MIN_ICD9_EFF_DTE) AS CA_DX_DTE , COALESCE(HIST_DESC, ICD_DESC) AS CA_DX_HIST , COALESCE(SITE_DESC, ICD_SITE) AS CA_DX_SITE , HSCT_DATE , LR_PERFORMED_DTE AS EOS_DATE , LR_RESULT_VALUE AS EOS_VALUE , DERM_DX_DATE , DERM_ICD_CODE , DERM_DX_DESC FROM IDB.PATIENT JOIN BMT ON PT_MRN = BMT_MRN JOIN EOS ON PT_MRN = LR_MRN AND LR_PERFORMED_DTE BETWEEN HSCT_DATE AND HSCT_DATE + 1 YEAR JOIN DERM ON PT_MRN = DERM_MRN LEFT JOIN TUMOR ON PT_MRN = TM_MRN LEFT JOIN CLINTRAC ON PT_MRN = CC_MRN ; SELECT PRPT_MRN AS MRN, PRPT_PROCEDURE_DTE AS PROCEDURE_DTE, PRPT_REPORT_DTE AS REPORT_DTE, PRPT_REPORT_TYPE_DESC AS REPORT_TYPE, PRPT_REPORT AS PATH_REPORT FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V WHERE PRPT_REPORT IS NOT NULL AND PRPT_REPORT_TYPE_DESC = 'Surgical Pathology' AND (UPPER(DV.REGEXSTR('(?<=DIAGNOSIS:)[\s\S]*(?=I ATTEST THAT THE ABOVE DIAGNOSIS)', PRPT_REPORT)) LIKE '%SKIN%' OR UPPER(DV.REGEXSTR('(?<=DIAGNOSIS:)[\s\S]*(?=I ATTEST THAT THE ABOVE DIAGNOSIS)', PRPT_REPORT)) LIKE '%DERM%') AND PRPT_PROCEDURE_DTE BETWEEN '{}' AND '{}'

CPP_DATE_OF_BIRTH) AS "Age at Appt", CPE_ENC_DTE AS "Appt Date", CHAR(TIME(CPE_APPT_DT), USA) AS "Appt Time", TRIM(CRE_RES_NAME) AS "Oncologist", TRIM(CLD_DEPT_NAME) AS "Dept Name", TRIM(D.CLD_CLD_CENTER) AS "Center", TRIM(CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME) AS "Visit Type Name", TRIM(CAV_NAME) "Language" FROM IDB.CL_PAS_PATIENT JOIN IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER CPE ON CPE_CL_PT_ID = CPP_CL_PT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT D ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_CATEGORY ON CAV_CATEGORY = 'LANG' AND CAV_ABBR = CPP_LANG WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS = 'Sch' AND CRE_RES_TYP = 'Physician' AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT DATE + 4 DAYS AND CURRENT DATE + 15 DAYS AND (CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR LIKE '%NV%' OR CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR LIKE '%IR%') AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 = 'MED' AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 = 'BRE' AND YEAR(CPE_ENC_DTE - prompt: Provide a list of patients consented under 06-107 or 12-245 who had a dermatologic toxicity to immune checkpoint inhibitors that were then treated with ustekinumab
completion: SELECT APR_MRN, TRIM(PT_LAST_NAME) CONCAT ', ' CONCAT TRIM(PT_FIRST_NAME) PT_NAME, PT_SEX SEX, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH DOB, R.AV_DESC AS "Race (Reg)", CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME, MIN(APR_START_DTE) DRUG_START_DATE, MAX(APR_END_DTE) DRUG_END_DATE, CASE WHEN SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD IS NULL THEN 'NO' ELSE 'YES' END SKIN_BX, SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD SKIN_BX_CD, SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC SKIN_BX_DESC FROM IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX JOIN IDB.CHEMO_DRUG_GENERIC ON APR_GENERIC_NAME = CDG_GENERIC_NAME JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON APR_MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS R ON R.AV_ELEMENT = 'RACE' AND R.AV_CODE = PT_RACE LEFT JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT ON APR_MRN = SSE_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE ON SSE_LOG_ID = SSP_LOG_ID AND SSE_ENC_CSN_ID = SSP_ENC_CSN_ID WHERE 1 = 1 AND UPPER(CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME) IN ('DURVALUMAB', 'AVELUMAB', 'ATEZOLIZUMAB', 'CEMIPLIMAB', 'NIVOLUMAB', 'PEMBROLIZUMAB', 'IPILIMUMAB') AND APR_START_DTE BETWEEN '2017-01-01' AND '2022-09-30' AND (SSE_SURG_LOC not like '%IR%' AND SSE_SURG_LOC not like '%ENDO%' AND SSE_SOURCE_TYPE <> 'E') AND (SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD IN ('11106', '11107', '11104', '11100', '11101') OR SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD IS NULL) AND APR_MRN IN (SELECT DISTINCT VIS_MRN FROM IDB.VISIT_V JOIN IDB.ACCRUALS ON AC_MRN = VIS_MRN WHERE 1 = 1 AND VIS_VISIT_STATUS IN ('2', '3') AND VIS_ADM_DTE BETWEEN '2017-01-01' AND '2022-09-30' AND AC_IRB_NO IN ('06-107', '12-245')) GROUP BY APR_MRN, TRIM(PT_LAST_NAME) CONCAT ', ' CONCAT TRIM(PT_FIRST_NAME), PT_SEX, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, R.AV_DESC, CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME, CASE WHEN SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD IS NULL THEN 'NO' ELSE 'YES' END, SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD, SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC ORDER BY APR_MRN; WITH EMAR AS (SELECT DISTINCT OO_MRN AS MRN, OO_ORD_NAME AS DRUG_NAME, DATE(OO_SIGNIFICANT_DT) DRUG_START_DATE, DATE(OO_STOP_DT) DRUG_STOP_DATE FROM IDB.OMS_ORDER JOIN IDB.OAS_ORD_TASK_OCCR ON OOTO_ORD_GUID = OO_ORD_GUID AND OOTO_STATUS_CD = 'Performed' JOIN IDB.OAS_CTLG_ITEM_TASK ON OOTO_CAT_ITEM_GUID = OCIT_GUID AND OCIT_LEVEL_NO = 0 WHERE OO_ORD_STS_CD NOT IN ('CANC', 'CANP', 'AUC3') AND(UPPER(OO_ORD_NAME) LIKE '%USTEKINUMAB%' OR UPPER(OO_ORD_NAME) LIKE '%STELARA%') AND OO_SIGNIFICANT_DT BETWEEN '2017-01-01' AND '2022-09-30' ), HML AS (SELECT HCPR_MRN AS MRN , HCPR_DRUG_NAME AS DRUG_NAME , DATE(HCPR_START_DT) DRUG_START_DATE , CASE WHEN (HCPR_STATUS_TYPE_DESC = 'Discontinued' AND HCPR_END_DT IS NULL) THEN DATE(HCPR_DISCONTINUE_DT) ELSE DATE(HCPR_END_DT) END AS DRUG_STOP_DATE FROM IDB.HML_CLIENT_PRESCRIPTION LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_CLIENT_VISIT ON OCV_VISIT_GUID = HCPR_VISIT_GUID LEFT JOIN IDB.HML_GENERIC_NAME ON HGN_GENERIC_NAME_ID = HCPR_GENERIC_NAME_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_USER USR ON USR.OU_USER_GUID = HCPR_USER_GUID LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_USER REQ ON REQ.OU_USER_GUID = HCPR_CARE_PROV_GUID LEFT JOIN IDB.HML_RX_UNIT_OF_MEASURE UOM ON UOM.HRUM_RXUOM_ID = HCPR_DOSE_UOM_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.HML_RX_UNIT_OF_MEASURE PKG ON PKG.HRUM_RXUOM_ID = HCPR_INNER_PACKAGE_SIZE_UOM_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.HML_SCRIPT_FREQUENCY ON HSF_SCRIPT_FREQ_ID = HCPR_SCRIPT_FREQ_ID WHERE HCPR_STATUS_TYPE NOT IN (4, 5, 8) AND HCPR_CREATED_DTE IS NOT NULL AND DATE(HCPR_START_DT) BETWEEN '2017-01-01' AND '2022-09-30' AND(HCPR_PRESCRIPTION_TYPE = 1 AND HCPR_TRANSMISSION_STATUS IN (1, 2, 5) OR HCPR_PRESCRIPTION_TYPE = 3) AND(UPPER(HCPR_DRUG_NAME) LIKE '%USTEKINUMAB%' OR UPPER(HCPR_DRUG_NAME) LIKE '%STELARA%' OR UPPER(HGN_GENERIC_NAME) LIKE '%USTEKINUMAB%' OR UPPER(HGN_GENERIC_NAME) LIKE '%STELARA%') ), DRUG AS (SELECT MRN, DRUG_NAME, DRUG_START_DATE, DRUG_STOP_DATE FROM EMAR UNION SELECT MRN, DRUG_NAME, DRUG_START_DATE, DRUG_STOP_DATE FROM HML) SELECT APR_MRN, TRIM(PT_LAST_NAME) CONCAT ', ' CONCAT TRIM(PT_FIRST_NAME) PT_NAME, PT_SEX SEX, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH DOB, R.AV_DESC AS "Race (Reg)", CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME, MIN(APR_START_DTE) DRUG_START_DATE, MAX(APR_END_DTE) DRUG_END_DATE, CASE WHEN SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD IS NULL THEN 'NO' ELSE 'YES' END SKIN_BX, SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD SKIN_BX_CD, SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC SKIN_BX_DESC, DRUG_NAME STELARA_TYPE, YEAR(DRUG_START_DATE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) STELARA_START_AGE, DRUG_START_DATE STELARA_START_DATE, DRUG_STOP_DATE STELARA_END_DATE FROM IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX JOIN IDB.CHEMO_DRUG_GENERIC ON APR_GENERIC_NAME = CDG_GENERIC_NAME JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON APR_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN DRUG ON APR_MRN = MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS R ON R.AV_ELEMENT = 'RACE' AND R.AV_CODE = PT_RACE LEFT JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT ON APR_MRN = SSE_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE ON SSE_LOG_ID = SSP_LOG_ID AND SSE_ENC_CSN_ID = SSP_ENC_CSN_ID WHERE 1 = 1 AND UPPER(CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME) IN ('DURVALUMAB', 'AVELUMAB', 'ATEZOLIZUMAB', 'CEMIPLIMAB', 'NIVOLUMAB', 'PEMBROLIZUMAB', 'IPILIMUMAB') AND APR_START_DTE BETWEEN '2017-01-01' AND '2022-09-30' AND (SSE_SURG_LOC not like '%IR%' AND SSE_SURG_LOC not like '%ENDO%' AND SSE_SOURCE_TYPE <> 'E') AND (SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD IN ('11106', '11107', '11104', '11100', '11101') OR SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD IS NULL) AND APR_MRN IN (SELECT DISTINCT VIS_MRN FROM IDB.VISIT_V JOIN IDB.ACCRUALS ON AC_MRN = VIS_MRN WHERE 1 = 1 AND VIS_VISIT_STATUS IN ('2', '3') AND VIS_ADM_DTE BETWEEN '2017-01-01' AND '2022-09-30' AND AC_IRB_NO IN ('06-107', '12-245')) GROUP BY APR_MRN, TRIM(PT_LAST_NAME) CONCAT ', ' CONCAT TRIM(PT_FIRST_NAME), PT_SEX, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, R.AV_DESC, CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME, CASE WHEN SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD IS NULL THEN 'NO' ELSE 'YES' END, SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD,
