TM_BEST_AJCC_STG NOT IN ('', '88', '9', '99') THEN TM_BEST_AJCC_STG WHEN TM_AJCC_7 NOT IN ('', '888', '999') THEN AJCC7.AV_DESC WHEN TM_AJCC NOT IN ('', '88', '99') THEN AJCC.AV_DESC WHEN TM_GENERAL_STG NOT IN ('', '9') THEN GS.AV_DESC WHEN TM_PATH_STG_GRP NOT IN ('', '88', '9', '99') THEN TM_PATH_STG_GRP ELSE CLIN.AV_DESC END AS STAGE FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM H ON TM_HIST_CD = H.CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON TM_SITE_CD = S.CLM_CLSF_CD LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS AJCC7 ON AJCC7.AV_ELEMENT = 'AJCC_7' AND AJCC7.AV_CODE = TM_AJCC_7 LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS AJCC ON AJCC.AV_ELEMENT = 'AJCC' AND AJCC.AV_CODE = TM_AJCC LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS GS ON GS.AV_ELEMENT = 'GENERAL_STG' AND GS.AV_CODE = TM_GENERAL_STG LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS CLIN ON CLIN.AV_ELEMENT = 'CLIN_STG_DSCR' AND CLIN.AV_CODE = TM_CLIN_STG_DSCR WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND TM_DX_DTE BETWEEN '4/1/2013' AND '1/31/2022' AND TM_HIST_CD IN ('M9679/3', 'M9680/3', 'M9681/3', 'M9688/3', 'M9714/3', 'M9738/3') ) , PMBL AS (SELECT DISTINCT "t1"."PT_MRN" AS "MRN", "t2"."PRPT_ACCESSION_NO" AS "Pathology Report", "t3"."PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_DESC" AS "Pathology Report Type", "t4"."DT_DTE" AS "Pathology Procedure Date", UPPER(CASE WHEN LENGTH(PRPT_REPORT) <= 15000 THEN RTRIM(CAST(SUBSTR(PRPT_REPORT, 1, 15000) AS VARCHAR(15000))) ELSE CAST(SUBSTR(PRPT_REPORT, 1, 15000) AS VARCHAR(15000)) END) AS TXT, CASE WHEN UPPER(DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)DIAGNOSIS:[\w\W]*(?=I ATTEST)', PRPT_REPORT)) <> '' THEN UPPER(DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)DIAGNOSIS:[\w\W]*(?=I ATTEST)', PRPT_REPORT)) WHEN UPPER(DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)DIAGNOSIS:[\w\W]*(?=NOTE:)', PRPT_REPORT)) <> '' THEN UPPER(DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)DIAGNOSIS:[\w\W]*(?=NOTE:)', PRPT_REPORT)) WHEN UPPER(DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)DIAGNOSIS:[\w\W]*(?=REPORT ELECTRONICALLY SIGNED OUT )', PRPT_REPORT)) <> '' THEN UPPER(DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)DIAGNOSIS:[\w\W]*(?=REPORT ELECTRONICALLY SIGNED OUT )', PRPT_REPORT)) END AS DIAGNOSIS FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V" "t1" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED" "t6" ON "t1"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t6"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V" "t2" ON "t6"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t2"."PRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATH_RPRT_TYPE_LOOKUP" "t3" ON "t2"."PRPT_REPORT_TYPE" = "t3"."PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_CD" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" "t4" ON "t2"."PRPT_PROCEDURE_DATE_ID" = "t4"."DT_DATE_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" "t5" ON "t2"."PRPT_REPORT_DATE_ID" = "t5"."DT_DATE_ID" WHERE 1=1 AND CONTAINS("t2"."PRPT_REPORT", '("PMBL" OR "PMBCL" OR "Primary Mediastinal" OR "Mediastinal Large Cell Lymphoma")') = 1 AND "t2"."PRPT_REPORT" IS NOT NULL AND UPPER("t3"."PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_DESC") LIKE '%SURGICAL PATHOLOGY%' AND "t4"."DT_DTE" BETWEEN '4/1/2013' AND '1/31/2022' AND PT_MRN IN (SELECT TM_MRN FROM TM) ) , X AS (SELECT DISTINCT TM.*, CASE WHEN PMBL.MRN IS NOT NULL THEN 'Y' END AS PMBL FROM TM JOIN PMBL ON TM_MRN = MRN) , ETO AS (SELECT DISTINCT APR_MRN, CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME, APR_GENERIC_NAME, APR_DRUG_NAME, APR_ROUTE, APR_START_DTE, APR_END_DTE, APR_ORD_RX_TYPE FROM IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX_V JOIN X ON APR_MRN = TM_MRN WHERE CDG_CHEMO_FLAG = 'Y' AND(UPPER(CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME) LIKE '%ETOPOSIDE%' OR UPPER(APR_GENERIC_NAME) LIKE '%ETOPOSIDE%' OR UPPER(APR_DRUG_NAME) LIKE '%ETOPOSIDE%') AND APR_ROUTE = 'IVCI' ) , DOX AS (SELECT DISTINCT APR_MRN, CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME, APR_GENERIC_NAME, APR_DRUG_NAME, APR_ROUTE, APR_START_DTE, APR_END_DTE, APR_ORD_RX_TYPE FROM IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX_V JOIN X ON APR_MRN = TM_MRN WHERE CDG_CHEMO_FLAG = 'Y' AND(UPPER(CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME) LIKE '%DOXORUBICIN%' OR UPPER(APR_GENERIC_NAME) LIKE '%DOXORUBICIN%' OR UPPER(APR_DRUG_NAME) LIKE '%DOXORUBICIN%') AND APR_ROUTE = 'IVCI' ) , VIN AS (SELECT DISTINCT APR_MRN, CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME, APR_GENERIC_NAME, APR_DRUG_NAME, APR_ROUTE, APR_START_DTE, APR_END_DTE, APR_ORD_RX_TYPE FROM IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX_V JOIN X ON APR_MRN = TM_MRN WHERE CDG_CHEMO_FLAG = 'Y' AND(UPPER(CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME) LIKE '%VINCRISTINE%' OR UPPER(APR_GENERIC_NAME) LIKE '%VINCRISTINE%' OR UPPER(APR_DRUG_NAME) LIKE '%VINCRISTINE%') AND APR_ROUTE = 'IVCI' ) , CD_ECOG AS (SELECT DISTINCT CDD_MRN, DX_DATE, CDD_SERVICE_DTE, CDD_DOC_GUID, ABS(DAYS(CDD_SERVICE_DTE) - DAYS(DX_DATE)) AS DAY_DIFF, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CDD_MRN ORDER BY ABS(DAYS(CDD_SERVICE_DTE) - DAYS(DX_DATE)) ASC) AS RN, CDO_ITEM_NAME, CDO_VALUE_TEXT, CASE WHEN CDO_VALUE_TEXT like '%/ 0%' THEN '0' WHEN CDO_VALUE_TEXT like '%/ 1%' THEN '1' WHEN CDO_VALUE_TEXT like '%/ 2%' THEN '2' WHEN CDO_VALUE_TEXT like '%/ 3%' THEN '3' WHEN CDO_VALUE_TEXT like '%/ 4%' THEN '4' WHEN CDO_VALUE_TEXT = '0' THEN '0' WHEN CDO_VALUE_TEXT = '1' THEN '1' WHEN CDO_VALUE_TEXT = '2' THEN '2' WHEN CDO_VALUE_TEXT = '3' THEN '3' WHEN CDO_VALUE_TEXT = '4' THEN '4' WHEN CDO_VALUE_TEXT = '0 - Asymptomatic' THEN '0' WHEN CDO_VALUE_TEXT = '1 - Symptomatic, but completely ambulatory' THEN '1' WHEN CDO_VALUE_TEXT = '2 - Symptomatic' THEN '2' WHEN CDO_VALUE_TEXT = '3 - Symptomatic >50% in bed during the day' THEN '3' WHEN CDO_VALUE_TEXT = '4 - Bedbound' THEN '4' END AS ECOG FROM (SELECT DISTINCT TM_MRN, DX_DATE FROM X) X JOIN IDB.CD_DOCUMENT ON CDD_MRN = TM_MRN JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION ON CDO_DOC_GUID = CDD_DOC_GUID WHERE CDD_CANCEL_IND = '0' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND = '0' AND(UPPER(CDO_ITEM_NAME) LIKE '%ECOG%') AND UPPER(CDO_VALUE_TEXT) not like 'INTACT%' AND UPPER(CDO_VALUE_TEXT) not like 'ACTIVE%' AND CDO_VALUE_TEXT <> '' AND CDO_VALUE_TEXT NOT IN ('ECOG:', 'Impaired', 'Inactivated', 'Patient/caregiver states how to recognize the risks for suicide') ) , LDH1 AS (SELECT DISTINCT LR_MRN, DX_DATE, LR_PERFORMED_DTE AS PERFORMED_DTE, LR_TEST_NAME AS TEST_NAME, LR_SUBTEST_NAME AS SUBTEST_NAME, LR_RESULT_VALUE AS RESULT_VALUE, LR_UNIT_MEASURE AS UNIT_MEASURE FROM X JOIN IDB.LAB_RESULTS ON LR_MRN = TM_MRN WHERE 1=1 AND LR_SUBTEST_NAME LIKE 'LDH%' AND LR_RESULT_VALUE <> '' ) , LDH2 AS (SELECT DISTINCT LR_MRN, DX_DATE, PERFORMED_DTE, ABS(DAYS(PERFORMED_DTE) - DAYS(DX_DATE)) AS DAY_DIFF, TEST_NAME, SUBTEST_NAME, RESULT_VALUE, UNIT_MEASURE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY LR_MRN ORDER BY ABS(DAYS(PERFORMED_DTE) - DAYS(DX_DATE))) AS RN_LDH FROM LDH1) , LDH3 AS (SELECT * FROM LDH2) , Y AS (SELECT DISTINCT X.TM_MRN, STRIP(PT_LAST_NAME) || ', ' || STRIP(PT_FIRST_NAME) AS NAME, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH AS DOB, X.DX_DATE, HIST_CODE, HIST_DESC, SITE_CODE, SITE_DESC, STAGE, E.APR_START_DTE, E.APR_DRUG_NAME AS DRUG_NAME1, E.APR_ROUTE AS ROUTE1, D.APR_DRUG_NAME AS DRUG_NAME2, D.APR_ROUTE AS ROUTE2, V.APR_DRUG_NAME AS DRUG_NAME3, V.APR_ROUTE AS ROUTE3, CDD_SERVICE_DTE AS ECOG_DATE, ECOG, PERFORMED_DTE AS LDH_DATE, RESULT_VALUE AS LDH_VALUE, UNIT_MEASURE FROM X JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PT_MRN = TM_MRN JOIN ETO E ON E.APR_MRN = TM_MRN JOIN DOX D ON D.APR_MRN = TM_MRN JOIN VIN V ON V.APR_MRN = TM_MRN LEFT JOIN CD_ECOG ON CDD_MRN = TM_MRN AND RN = 1 LEFT JOIN LDH3 ON LR_MRN = TM_MRN AND RN_LDH = 1 WHERE E.APR_START_DTE = D.APR_START_DTE AND E.APR_START_DTE = V.APR_START_DTE AND D.APR_START_DTE = V.APR_START_DTE ) SELECT * FROM Y

prompt: Return a list of patients who have any active/pending/completed orders of the "DOS cancellation order" .
completion: WITH DOSCO AS (SELECT DISTINCT OO_MRN MRN, STRIP(PT_LAST_NAME) PT_LST_NM , 'DOSC' AS OO_ORD_NAME, OO_ENTER_DTE "ORDER DATE", (RTRIM(SUBSTRING(PSN.OUD_USER_DI_VALUE, 1, 3))) AS "CX", OU_DISPLAY_NAME AS "ENT", RSN.OUD_USER_DI_VALUE AS REASON, OTH.OUD_USER_DI_VALUE AS OTHER_COMMENTS, OCV_CURR_LOC ORD_LOC FROM IDB.OMS_ORDER OO LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_USER_DATA RSN ON OO_ORD_GUID = RSN.OUD_ORD_GUID AND RSN.OUD_USER_DI_CD= 'DOS Cancellation Order' LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_USER_DATA PSN ON OO_ORD_GUID = PSN.OUD_ORD_GUID AND PSN.OUD_USER_DI_CD='DOS Cancellation Order_2' LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_USER_DATA OTH ON OO_ORD_GUID = OTH.OUD_ORD_GUID AND OTH.OUD_USER_DI_CD='0_Dos Cancellation order' LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_USER ON OO_USER_GUID = OU_USER_GUID LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_STATUS ON OO_ORD_STS_CD = OSTS_ORD_STS_CD LEFT JOIN IDB.PATIENT PTS ON OO_MRN = PTS.PT_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_CLIENT_VISIT ON OO_VISIT_GUID = OCV_VISIT_GUID WHERE OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID='9000017478100730' AND OO_ENTER_DTE BETWEEN '2024-01-01' AND CURRENT DATE AND OO_ORD_STS_CD NOT IN ('CANP', 'CANC', 'HOLD', 'AUC3', 'DISC') ) SELECT DISTINCT MRN, PT_LST_NM, OO_ORD_NAME AS ORD, "ORDER DATE" AS ORD_DT, "CX", "ENT", REASON, OTHER_COMMENTS, ORD_LOC, OL_LOG_SVC AS SRG_SVC, L.CRE_RES_NAME AS SURGEON FROM DOSCO LEFT JOIN IDB.OR_LOG ON MRN=OL_MRN AND "ORDER DATE"= OL_SURG_DTE LEFT JOIN IDB.OR_LOG_ALL_SURG ON OL_LOG_ID = OLAS_LOG_ID AND OL_LOG_STS IN ('Posted', 'Unposted') LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE L ON OLAS_RES_ID = L.CRE_RES_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.OR_CASE ON OC_MRN= MRN AND "ORDER DATE"= OC_SURG_DTE ORDER BY 4

prompt: List of patients discharged from the Colorectal service in the last 30 days, after the CPT code is generated
completion: WITH X AS (SELECT DISTINCT SSE_MRN AS MRN, SSE_LOG_ID AS LOG_ID, SSE_SURG_DTE AS SRG_DTE, SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD AS CPT_CD, SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC AS CPT_DESC, SSP_PROC_NAME AS PROC_NAME, SSP_SURG_LAST_NM AS SURG_LAST_NAME, SSP_SURG_FIRST_NM AS SURG_FIRST_NAME, SSP_SURG_SVC_CD AS SVC_CODE FROM IDB.SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT ON SSE_LOG_ID = SSP_LOG_ID AND SSE_ENC_CSN_ID = SSP_ENC_CSN_ID WHERE SSE_SURG_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT date - 30 DAYS AND CURRENT date AND SSP_SURG_SVC_CD = 'CRS' ) , Y AS (SELECT DISTINCT SSE_MRN MRN, SSE_LOG_ID, SSE_SURG_DTE, SSP_PNL_NO, SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD, SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC, SSP_PROC_NAME, SSP_SURG_LAST_NM, SSP_SURG_FIRST_NM, SSP_SURG_SVC_CD, DATE(SAE_TOX_OCCR_DT) AS COMP_DATE, SAE_TOXICITY_NAME AS COMP_NAME, SAE_TOX_GRADE AS COMP_GRADE, SAE_TOX_GRADE_NAME AS COMP_CRITERIA, VIS_ADM_DTE, VIS_DSCH_DTE, VIS_DAYS_STAY FROM X JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE ON SSP_LOG_ID = LOG_ID JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT ON SSE_LOG_ID = SSP_LOG_ID AND SSE_ENC_CSN_ID = SSP_ENC_CSN_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.SRG_ADVERSE_EVENT ON SSE_LOG_ID = SAE_SURG_LOG_ID AND SAE_PROC_SEQ_NO = SSP_PROC_SEQ_NO AND SAE_TOX_GRADE > '0' LEFT JOIN IDB.VISIT ON VIS_MRN = SSE_MRN AND VIS_IP_OP_ADJUSTED_IND = 'I' AND VIS_VISIT_STATUS IN ('2', '3') AND SSE_SURG_DTE BETWEEN VIS_ADM_DTE AND COALESCE(VIS_DSCH_DTE, CURRENT date)) SELECT * FROM Y

prompt: Provide a recurring list of patients who are consented to protocol 18-280 in the TMIST REDCap project that have an upcoming procedure.
completion: WITH REDCAPCONFIG AS (SELECT 'https://redcap.mskcc.org/api/' AS URL , 'token=99AEA076EF87AD520CA09D9193681D78&url=https://redcap.mskcc.org/api/' || '&content=record&format=xml&type=flat&rawOrLabel=raw&rawOrLabelHeaders=raw&exportCheckboxLabel=false&exportSurveyFields=false&exportDataAccessGroups=false&returnFormat=json&forms[0]=consent&forms[1]=demographics' GETTABLE , CAST('<' || 'httpHeader><' || 'header name="Content-Type" value="application/x-www-form-urlencoded; charset=UTF-8"><' || '/header><' || 'header name="Cache-Control" value="no-cache"><' || '/header><' || '/httpHeader>' AS CLOB(1K)) AS HEADER FROM SYSIBM.SYSDUMMY1) , REDCAP_DATA AS (SELECT T.* FROM REDCAPCONFIG CROSS JOIN XMLTABLE('$c/records/item' PASSING XMLPARSE(DOCUMENT DB2XML.HTTPPOSTCLOB(URL, HEADER, GETTABLE)) AS "c" COLUMNS CONSENT_YN VARCHAR(12) PATH 'consent_yn' , RC_MRN VARCHAR(12) PATH 'mrn' , DATE_OF_CONSENT VARCHAR(12) PATH 'date_of_consent') T WHERE DATE_OF_CONSENT > '' ) , SURG_DETAIL AS (SELECT PT_MRN, RTRIM("Last Name") AS "Last Name", RTRIM("First Name") AS "First Name", DR.CRE_RES_NAME AS DOCTOR, OC_SURG_DTE, OC_OR_CASE_STS, OCAP_LINE_NO, OCAP_LAT, CPX_PROC_CD, CASE WHEN OCAS_SURG_SVC = 'IR' THEN OP_PROC_NAME ELSE CPX_PROC_NAME END PROC_DESC, OC_SCH_DT, OC_CASE_ID, OCAS_SURG_SVC, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH , STRIP(CASE WHEN DX1.CDX_ICD9 > ' ' THEN DX1.CDX_ICD9 ELSE DX1.CDX_ICD10 END)||' - '||DX1.CDX_DX_NAME DX1 , STRIP(CASE WHEN DX2.CDX_ICD9 > ' ' THEN DX2.CDX_ICD9 ELSE DX2.CDX_ICD10 END)||' - '||DX2.CDX_DX_NAME DX2 , OC_ROOM_RES_ID , LOC_LOC_NAME AS LOCATION , ROOM.CRE_RES_NAME AS ROOM FROM IDB.OR_CASE_ALL_PROC JOIN REDCAP_DATA ON RC_MRN = OCAP_MRN INNER JOIN IDB.OR_CASE ON OCAP_CASE_ID=OC_CASE_ID INNER JOIN IDB.OR_CASE_ALL_SURG ON OCAP_CASE_ID=OCAS_CASE_ID AND OCAP_PNL_NO=OCAS_PNL_NO AND OC_CASE_ID=OCAS_CASE_ID AND OCAS_SURG_ROLE = 'Primary' JOIN IDB.OR_PROC ON OCAP_OR_PROC_ID = OP_OR_PROC_ID INNER JOIN IDB.OR_CL_PROC ON OP_OR_PROC_ID=OCP_OR_PROC_ID INNER JOIN IDB.CL_PROC ON OCP_PROC_ID= CPX_PROC_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE DR ON OCAS_RES_ID=DR.CRE_RES_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ROOM ON OC_ROOM_RES_ID=ROOM.CRE_RES_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_LOCATION ON LOC_LOC_ID = OC_SURG_LOC_ID INNER JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PT_MRN=OC_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.OR_CASE_DX_CODES LN1 ON LN1.OCD_CASE_ID = OC_CASE_ID AND LN1.OCD_LINE_NO = 1 LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_DX DX1 ON DX1.CDX_DX_ID = LN1.OCD_DX_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.OR_CASE_DX_CODES LN2 ON LN2.OCD_CASE_ID = OC_CASE_ID AND LN2.OCD_LINE_NO = 2 LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_DX DX2 ON DX2.CDX_DX_ID = LN2.OCD_DX_ID WHERE 1=1 AND OC_OR_CASE_STS_CD NOT IN ('2', '5') AND OC_SURG_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT date AND CURRENT date + 7 DAY AND (CPX_PROC_CD BETWEEN '10000' AND '69999' OR OCAS_SURG_SVC = 'IR' ) ) SELECT PT_MRN AS MRN , "Last Name" , "First Name" , OC_SURG_DTE AS "Surgery Date", TIME(OC_SCH_DT) AS "Time" , COALESCE(TRIM(CPX_PROC_CD), '') AS "CPT Code" , COALESCE(TRIM(PROC_DESC), '') AS "CPT Description" , COALESCE(TRIM(OCAS_SURG_SVC), '') AS "Service" , COALESCE(TRIM(DOCTOR), '') AS "Doctor Name" , COALESCE(TRIM(OCAP_LINE_NO), '') AS "Line No" , COALESCE(TRIM(OCAP_LAT), '') AS "Laterality" , COALESCE(TRIM(LOCATION), '') AS "Location" , COALESCE(TRIM(ROOM), '') AS "Room" , COALESCE(TRIM(DX1), '') || ' ' || COALESCE(TRIM(DX2), '') AS "Diagnosis" , COALESCE(TRIM(OC_OR_CASE_STS), '') AS "Case Status" FROM SURG_DETAIL ORDER BY OC_SCH_DT, PT_MRN, OCAP_LINE_NO

prompt: Please provide a one-time list of patients who received more than one dose of mogamulizumab between 2010 to present.
completion: WITH CHM AS (SELECT APR_MRN MRN, PT_LAST_NAME LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME FIRST_NAME, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH DOB, PT_SEX SEX , APR_DRUG_NAME DRUG_NAME, APR_START_DTE START_DATE, APR_DIAGNOSIS_DESC SET_DIAGNOSIS, APR_SET_NAME SET_NAME , APR_PROVIDER_NAME PROVIDER_NAME, APR_PROVIDER_ROLE PROVIDER_ROLE, APR_TOTAL_GIVEN_DOSE TOTAL_GIVEN_DOSE, APR_DOSE_UOM DOSE_UOM , ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY APR_MRN ORDER BY APR_START_DTE) RN FROM IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX_V JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON APR_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME = 'MOGAMULIZUMAB' AND APR_DRUG_PROCESS_STAGE <> 'H' ) , CTE AS (SELECT A.MRN, A.LAST_NAME, A.FIRST_NAME, A.DOB, A.SEX, A.DRUG_NAME, A.START_DATE, A.SET_DIAGNOSIS, A.SET_NAME, A.PROVIDER_NAME , A.PROVIDER_ROLE, A.TOTAL_GIVEN_DOSE, A.DOSE_UOM, 0 DAYS_DIFF, 1 RN FROM CHM A WHERE A.RN = 1 UNION SELECT B.MRN, B.LAST_NAME, B.FIRST_NAME, B.DOB, B.SEX, B.DRUG_NAME, B.START_DATE, B.SET_DIAGNOSIS, B.SET_NAME, B.PROVIDER_NAME , B.PROVIDER_ROLE, B.TOTAL_GIVEN_DOSE, B.DOSE_UOM, DAYS(B.START_DATE) - DAYS(A.START_DATE) DAYS_DIFF , ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY B.MRN ORDER BY B.START_DATE) + 1 RN FROM CHM A JOIN CHM B ON A.MRN = B.MRN AND A.RN < B.RN AND B.RN = A.RN + 1 WHERE DAYS(B.START_DATE) - DAYS(A.START_DATE) >= 60 ) , CNT AS (SELECT DISTINCT MRN RPT_MRN FROM CTE WHERE RN > 1 ) , CDB AS (SELECT TM_MRN, TM_DX_DTE, TRIM(TM_SITE_CD)||' - '||S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS TM_SITE_DESC , TRIM(TM_HIST_CD)||' - '||H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS TM_HIST_DESC, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY TM_MRN ORDER BY TM_DX_DTE) TRN FROM CNT JOIN IDB.TM_TUMOR ON TM_MRN = RPT_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.CLM H ON TM_HIST_CD = H.CLM_CLSF_CD LEFT JOIN IDB.CLM S ON TM_SITE_CD = S.CLM_CLSF_CD) SELECT A.MRN, A.LAST_NAME, A.FIRST_NAME, A.DOB, A.SEX, A.DRUG_NAME MOGO1_DRUG_NAME, A.START_DATE MOGO1_START_DATE, A.SET_DIAGNOSIS MOGO1_SET_DIAGNOSIS , A.SET_NAME MOGO1_SET_NAME, A.PROVIDER_NAME MOGO1_PROVIDER, A.PROVIDER_ROLE MOGO1_PROVIDER_ROLE, A.TOTAL_GIVEN_DOSE MOGO1_DOSE, A.DOSE_UOM MOGO1_UOM , B.DRUG_NAME MOGO2_DRUG_NAME, B.START_DATE MOGO2_START_DATE, B.SET_DIAGNOSIS MOGO2_SET_DIAGNOSIS, B.SET_NAME MOGO2_SET_NAME, B.PROVIDER_NAME MOGO2_PROVIDER , B.PROVIDER_ROLE MOGO2_PROVIDER_ROLE, B.TOTAL_GIVEN_DOSE MOGO2_DOSE, B.DOSE_UOM MOGO2_UOM, C.DRUG_NAME MOGO3_DRUG_NAME, C.START_DATE MOGO3_START_DATE , C.SET_DIAGNOSIS MOGO3_SET_DIAGNOSIS, C.SET_NAME MOGO3_SET_NAME, C.PROVIDER_NAME MOGO3_PROVIDER, C.PROVIDER_ROLE MOGO3_PROVIDER_ROLE , C.TOTAL_GIVEN_DOSE MOGO3_DOSE, C.DOSE_UOM MOGO3_UOM, D.TM_DX_DTE TUMOR1_DX_DATE, D.TM_SITE_DESC TUMOR1_SITE_DESC, D.TM_HIST_DESC TUMOR1_HIST_DESC , E.TM_DX_DTE TUMOR2_DX_DATE, E.TM_SITE_DESC TUMOR2_SITE_DESC, E.TM_HIST_DESC TUMOR2_HIST_DESC FROM CNT JOIN CTE A ON RPT_MRN = A.MRN AND A.RN = 1 JOIN CTE B ON RPT_MRN = B.MRN AND B.RN = 2 LEFT JOIN CTE C ON RPT_MRN = C.MRN AND C.RN = 3 JOIN CDB D ON D.TM_MRN = RPT_MRN AND D.TRN = 1 LEFT JOIN CDB E ON E.TM_MRN = RPT_MRN AND E.TRN = 2

prompt: Looking for IR procedures done in clinic since 2016.
completion: WITH PROCEDURES AS (SELECT PBD_MRN, PBD_SVC_DTE, PBC_CPT_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK, DOC_NAME, PBC_PBD_CD FROM IDB.PBD_DTL JOIN IDB.PBD_CODE ON PBD_PBD_CD = PBC_PBD_CD JOIN IDB.CLM ON PBC_CPT_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.PBD_INVOICE ON PBD_INV_NO = PBI_INV_NO JOIN IDB.DOC ON PBI_PERFORM_DR_NO = DOC_DR_NO WHERE PBD_SVC_DTE BETWEEN '2016-01-01' AND '2018-08-31' AND (CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK LIKE '%BIOPSY%' OR CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK LIKE '%REMOVAL%' OR CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK LIKE '%CATHETER%' OR CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK LIKE '%PARACENTESIS%') ), VISITS AS (SELECT CPE_MRN, CPE_ENC_DTE, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8, CLD_DEPT_NAME, CRE_RES_NAME, CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME, CLD_DEPT_ID FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CLD_DEPT_ID IN ('802') AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN '2016-01-01' AND '2018-08-31' ) SELECT PBD_MRN "MRN", PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, PBD_SVC_DTE "Service Date", DOC_NAME "Billing Provider", CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK "Procedure Name" FROM VISITS JOIN PROCEDURES ON PBD_MRN = CPE_MRN AND PBD_SVC_DTE = CPE_ENC_DTE JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PT_MRN = PBD_MRN ;

prompt: List of patients who underwent yttrium 90 embolization and had genomic sequencing of their malignancies between Jan 2018 and Aug 2019
completion: WITH PTS AS (SELECT DISTINCT RRPT_MRN MRN, RRPT_ACCESSION_NO FROM DV.RADIOLOGY_REPORT_V JOIN IDB.OMS_ORDER ON RRPT_MRN = OO_MRN JOIN IDB.OMS_STATUS ON OO_ORD_STS_CD = OSTS_ORD_STS_CD WHERE RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE BETWEEN '2018-01-01' AND '2019-07-31' AND (UPPER(RRPT_PROCEDURE_NAME) like '%SIRSPHERE TREATMENT%' OR UPPER(RRPT_PROCEDURE_NAME) like '%THERASPHERE TREATMENT%') AND OO_SET_NAME = 'MSK-IMPACT' AND OSTS_STS_DESC NOT IN ('Cancelled', 'Expired', 'Pending') ) SELECT PT_MRN, DT_DTE AS "Tumor Diagnosis Date", DXCC_ICD_CODE AS "ICD-O Histology Code", DXCC_ICD_MSK_DESC AS "ICD-O Histology Description", ICSC_SITE_CD AS "ICD-O Site Code", ICSC_ICDO_SITE_MSK_DESC AS "ICD-O Site Description", TCA_CASE_STS_DESC AS "Case Status" FROM PTS JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON MRN = PT_MRN JOIN DV.CDB_TUMOR_V ON CDTM_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID JOIN DV.DATE_V ON CDTM_DX_DATE_ID = DT_DATE_ID JOIN DV.DIAGNOSIS_CODE_CAT_ICDO_V ON CDTM_DX_CATALOG_ID = DXCC_DX_CATALOG_ID JOIN DV.ICDO_SITE_CATALOG_V ON CDTM_SITE_CATALOG_ID = ICSC_SITE_CATALOG_ID JOIN DV.TUMOR_CASE_ATTRIBUTES_V ON CDTM_CASE_ATTR_ID = TUMOR_CASE_ATTR_ID ; WITH PTS AS (SELECT DISTINCT RRPT_MRN MRN, RRPT_ACCESSION_NO FROM DV.RADIOLOGY_REPORT_V JOIN IDB.OMS_ORDER ON RRPT_MRN = OO_MRN JOIN IDB.OMS_STATUS ON OO_ORD_STS_CD = OSTS_ORD_STS_CD WHERE RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE BETWEEN '2018-01-01' AND '2019-07-31' AND (UPPER(RRPT_PROCEDURE_NAME) like '%SIRSPHERE TREATMENT%' OR UPPER(RRPT_PROCEDURE_NAME) like '%THERASPHERE TREATMENT%') AND OO_SET_NAME = 'MSK-IMPACT' AND OSTS_STS_DESC NOT IN ('Cancelled', 'Expired', 'Pending') ), RADIO AS (SELECT RRPT_MRN, PTS.RRPT_ACCESSION_NO, RRPT_PROCEDURE_NAME, RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE, RRPT_REPORT_DTE, RRPT_REPORT_TXT FROM PTS JOIN DV.RADIOLOGY_REPORT_V R ON MRN = RRPT_MRN AND PTS.RRPT_ACCESSION_NO = R.RRPT_ACCESSION_NO ), FOLLOWUP AS (SELECT MRN, PTS.RRPT_ACCESSION_NO, MAX(FOLLOWUP.RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE) PET_DTE FROM PTS JOIN DV.RADIOLOGY_REPORT_V FOLLOWUP ON MRN = FOLLOWUP.RRPT_MRN WHERE UPPER(FOLLOWUP.RRPT_PROCEDURE_NAME) like '%PET%' AND UPPER(FOLLOWUP.RRPT_PROCEDURE_NAME) not like '%PETROUS%' GROUP BY MRN, PTS.RRPT_ACCESSION_NO) SELECT RADIO.RRPT_MRN AS MRN, RADIO.RRPT_ACCESSION_NO AS "Accession Number", RADIO.RRPT_PROCEDURE_NAME "Procedure Name", RADIO.RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE "Procedure Date", RADIO.RRPT_REPORT_DTE "Report Date", RADIO.RRPT_REPORT_TXT "Report Text", CASE WHEN FOLLOWUP.PET_DTE >= RADIO.RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS "Pet Followup", CASE WHEN FOLLOWUP.PET_DTE >= RADIO.RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE THEN FOLLOWUP.PET_DTE ELSE NULL END AS "Pet Followup Date" FROM RADIO LEFT JOIN FOLLOWUP ON FOLLOWUP.RRPT_ACCESSION_NO = RADIO.RRPT_ACCESSION_NO ; WITH PTS AS (SELECT DISTINCT RRPT_MRN MRN FROM DV.RADIOLOGY_REPORT_V JOIN IDB.OMS_ORDER ON RRPT_MRN = OO_MRN JOIN IDB.OMS_STATUS ON OO_ORD_STS_CD = OSTS_ORD_STS_CD WHERE RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE BETWEEN '2018-01-01' AND '2019-07-31' AND (UPPER(RRPT_PROCEDURE_NAME) like '%SIRSPHERE TREATMENT%' OR UPPER(RRPT_PROCEDURE_NAME) like '%THERASPHERE TREATMENT%') AND OO_SET_NAME = 'MSK-IMPACT' AND OSTS_STS_DESC NOT IN ('Cancelled', 'Expired', 'Pending') ) SELECT PT_MRN, PDRX_DMP_PATIENT_ID, PDRX_DMP_SAMPLE_ID, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_BIRTH_DTE, PT_DEATH_DTE, PT_VITAL_STATUS, PDRX_ACCESSION_NO, PDRX_DV_PROCESS_DTE, T.* FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML INNER JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML_SETTINGS ON PDRX_PATH_DMP_RESULTS_XML_ID = PDRXS_PATH_DMP_RESULTS_XML_ID INNER JOIN DVDMC.PATHOLOGY_DMP_WEBSVC_SETTINGS ON PDRXS_SETTING_ID = PDWS_SETTING_ID INNER JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON PDRX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID INNER JOIN PTS ON MRN = PT_MRN, XMLTABLE('$c/root/*' PASSING PDRX_XML_VALUE AS "c" COLUMNS VARIANT_CLASS VARCHAR(100) PATH 'variant_class', SITE1_GENE VARCHAR(100) PATH 'site1_gene', SITE2_GENE VARCHAR(100) PATH 'site2_gene', GENE_ID VARCHAR(100) PATH 'gene_id', EXON_NUM VARCHAR(100) PATH 'exon_num', AA_CHANGE VARCHAR(100) PATH 'aa_change', CDNA_CHANGE VARCHAR(100) PATH 'cDNA_change', GENE_FOLD_CHANGE VARCHAR(100) PATH 'gene_fold_change', VARIANT_TYPE VARCHAR(100) PATH './local-name(.)', PROJECT VARCHAR(100) PATH '../meta-data/dmp_alys_task_name', SAMPLEID VARCHAR(100) PATH '../meta-data/dmp_sample_id', PATIENTID VARCHAR(100) PATH '../meta-data/dmp_patient_id', TUMOR_TYPE_CODE VARCHAR(100) PATH '../meta-data/tumor_type_code', TUMOR_TYPE_NAME VARCHAR(255) PATH '../meta-data/tumor_type_name', IS_METASTASIS VARCHAR(10) PATH '../meta-data/is_metastasis', PRIMARY_SITE VARCHAR(255) PATH '../meta-data/primary_site', METASTASIS_SITE VARCHAR(255) PATH '../meta-data/metastasis_site') T WHERE VARIANT_TYPE <> 'meta-data' ;

prompt: Provide contact information for the parents of deceased patients and data about those patients.
completion: SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN, TRIM(PT_LAST_NAME) AS LAST_NAME, TRIM(PT_FIRST_NAME) AS FIRST_NAME, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH AS DOB, PT_DATE_OF_DEATH AS DOD, YEAR(COALESCE(PT_DATE_OF_DEATH, CURRENT DATE) - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) AS AGE_AT_DOD, PT_ADDR1 AS ADD1, PT_ADDR2 AS ADD2, PT_CITY AS CITY, PT_STATE AS STATE, PT_ZIP_CD AS ZIP_CD, TRIM(PT_COUNTRY) AS COUNTRY, PT_PHONE AS PHONE, M.CON_NAME AS MOTHER_NAME, F.CON_NAME AS FATHER_NAME, CASE WHEN PT_DEATH_IND IN ('C', 'D') THEN 'Y' ELSE '' END AS DEATH_AT_MSK_IND, TM_HIST_CD AS HIST_CD, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS HIST_DESC, TM_SITE_CD AS SITE_CODE, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_DESC, TM_DX_DTE AS DX_DATE, A.AV_DESC AS CASE_STATUS, B.AV_DESC AS CLASS_OF_CASE FROM IDB.PATIENT JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY ON PT_MRN = PLA_MRN JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTV_DTL ON PT_MRN = LAD_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.CONTACT F ON PT_MRN = F.CON_MRN AND F.CON_REL_IND = 'F' LEFT JOIN IDB.CONTACT M ON PT_MRN = M.CON_MRN AND M.CON_REL_IND = 'M' LEFT JOIN IDB.CDB_TUMOR ON PT_MRN = TM_MRN AND TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7') LEFT JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD LEFT JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS A ON A.AV_ELEMENT = 'CASE_STS' AND A.AV_CODE = TM_CASE_STS LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS B ON B.AV_ELEMENT = 'CLASS_OF_CASE' AND B.AV_CODE = TM_CLASS_OF_CASE WHERE PT_DATE_OF_DEATH BETWEEN '2019-07-01' AND CURRENT date - 6 MONTHS AND DATE(PT_DATE_OF_DEATH_UPD_DT) >= CURRENT date - 1 MONTH AND PT_STATE IN ('NY', 'NJ') AND PLA_NPP_IND = 'Y' ; WITH PATIENT AS (SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN, TRIM(PT_LAST_NAME) AS LAST_NAME, TRIM(PT_FIRST_NAME) AS FIRST_NAME, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH AS DOB, PT_DATE_OF_DEATH AS DOD, YEAR(COALESCE(PT_DATE_OF_DEATH, CURRENT DATE) - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) AS AGE_AT_DOD, PT_ADDR1 AS ADD1, PT_ADDR2 AS ADD2, PT_CITY AS CITY, PT_STATE AS STATE, PT_ZIP_CD AS ZIP_CD, TRIM(PT_COUNTRY) AS COUNTRY, PT_PHONE AS PHONE, M.CON_NAME AS MOTHER_NAME, F.CON_NAME AS FATHER_NAME, CASE WHEN PT_DEATH_IND IN ('C', 'D') THEN 'Y' ELSE '' END AS DEATH_AT_MSK_IND FROM IDB.PATIENT JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY ON PT_MRN = PLA_MRN JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTV_DTL ON PT_MRN = LAD_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.CONTACT F ON PT_MRN = F.CON_MRN AND F.CON_REL_IND = 'F' LEFT JOIN IDB.CONTACT M ON PT_MRN = M.CON_MRN AND M.CON_REL_IND = 'M' WHERE PT_DATE_OF_DEATH BETWEEN '2019-07-01' AND CURRENT date - 6 MONTHS AND DATE(PT_DATE_OF_DEATH_UPD_DT) >= CURRENT date - 1 MONTH AND PT_STATE IN ('NY', 'NJ') AND PLA_NPP_IND = 'Y' ), ICD AS (SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN, CC_CLSF_CD AS ICD9_CODE, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS ICD9_DESC, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS ICD9_MIN_EFF_DATE FROM IDB.PATIENT LEFT JOIN IDB.CTC_CLSF ON PT_MRN = CC_MRN AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND (CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) AND CC_CLSF_CD BETWEEN '140' AND '239.9' LEFT JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD GROUP BY PT_MRN, CC_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK) SELECT DISTINCT P.*, I.ICD9_CODE, I.ICD9_DESC, I.ICD9_MIN_EFF_DATE FROM PATIENT P JOIN ICD I ON P.PT_MRN = I.PT_MRN AND I.ICD9_MIN_EFF_DATE IS NOT NULL ; SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN, TRIM(PT_LAST_NAME) AS LAST_NAME, TRIM(PT_FIRST_NAME) AS FIRST_NAME, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH AS DOB, PT_DATE_OF_DEATH AS DOD, YEAR(COALESCE(PT_DATE_OF_DEATH, CURRENT DATE) - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) AS AGE_AT_DOD, PT_ADDR1 AS ADD1, PT_ADDR2 AS ADD2, PT_CITY AS CITY, PT_STATE AS STATE, PT_ZIP_CD AS ZIP_CD, TRIM(PT_COUNTRY) AS COUNTRY, PT_PHONE AS PHONE, M.CON_NAME AS MOTHER_NAME, F.CON_NAME AS FATHER_NAME, CASE WHEN PT_DEATH_IND IN ('C', 'D') THEN 'Y' ELSE '' END AS DEATH_AT_MSK_IND, PLA_LST_TX_DTE AS LAST_TREATMENT_DT, PLA_LST_CHEMO_DTE AS LAST_CHEMO_DT, PLA_LST_RT_DTE AS LAST_RADIO_DT, PLA_LST_SURG_DTE AS LAST_SURG_DT FROM IDB.PATIENT JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY ON PT_MRN = PLA_MRN JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTV_DTL ON PT_MRN = LAD_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.CONTACT F ON PT_MRN = F.CON_MRN AND F.CON_REL_IND = 'F' LEFT JOIN IDB.CONTACT M ON PT_MRN = M.CON_MRN AND M.CON_REL_IND = 'M' WHERE PT_DATE_OF_DEATH BETWEEN '2019-07-01' AND CURRENT date - 6 MONTHS AND DATE(PT_DATE_OF_DEATH_UPD_DT) >= CURRENT date - 1 MONTH AND PT_STATE IN ('NY', 'NJ') AND PLA_NPP_IND = 'Y' ;

prompt: Requesting a list of all APL patients seen at MSK
completion: SELECT TM_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_SEX, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, PT_DATE_OF_DEATH, PT_DEATH_IND_DESC, PT_RACE_DESC, PT_PT_ETHNICITY_DESC, PLA_LST_APPT_DTE, PLA_LST_CON_DTE FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.PATIENT_V ON TM_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY ON TM_MRN = PLA_MRN WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND TM_HIST_CD = 'M9866/3' AND TM_DX_DTE BETWEEN '2000-01-01' AND '2023-05-01' ORDER BY 1 ; SELECT TM_MRN, AV_DESC AS CASE_STS, TM_DX_DTE, TM_HIST_CD, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS HIST_DESC, TM_SITE_CD, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_DESC, TM_BEST_AJCC_STG FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS ON AV_ELEMENT = 'CASE_STS' AND AV_CODE = TM_CASE_STS WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND TM_HIST_CD = 'M9866/3' AND TM_DX_DTE BETWEEN '2000-01-01' AND '2023-05-01' ORDER BY 1, 3 ; WITH CTE AS (SELECT DISTINCT TM_MRN FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND TM_HIST_CD = 'M9866/3' AND TM_DX_DTE BETWEEN '2000-01-01' AND '2023-05-01' ) SELECT TM_MRN, A.PT_LAST_NAME, PATH_PROCEDURE_DATE, PATH_RPT_DATE, PRPT_REPORT_TYPE, PRPT_ACCESSION_NO, METHOD, GENE, LOCUS, AA_CHANGE, NUCLEOTIDE, SEARCH_HIT1, SEARCH_HIT2, ABERRATIONTYPE, FOLD_CHANGE, GENE2, PRPT_REPORT FROM CTE JOIN IDB.PATIENT A ON TM_MRN = A. PT_MRN LEFT JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_STRUCTURED_RESULTS_V B ON TM_MRN = B.PT_MRN AND PATH_RPT_DATE BETWEEN '2000-01-01' AND '2023-05-01' ORDER BY TM_MRN, PATH_PROCEDURE_DATE, GENE

prompt: Provide a list of all patients diagnosed with anaplastic thyroid cancer from 2003-present
completion: SELECT PRPT_MRN, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, PRPT_PROCEDURE_DTE, PRPT_REPORT_TYPE_DESC, PRPT_REPORT FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PRPT_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE CONTAINS("PRPT_REPORT", '("anaplastic thyroid")') = 1 AND YEAR(PRPT_PROCEDURE_DTE) BETWEEN '2003' AND '2023'; SELECT CDD_MRN, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, CDD_DOC_NAME, CDD_SERVICE_DTE, CDD_DOCUMENT_FULL_TEXT FROM DV.CLINDOC_FULL_TEXT_V JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON CDD_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE YEAR(CDD_SERVICE_DTE) BETWEEN '2003' AND '2023' AND CONTAINS("CDD_DOCUMENT_FULL_TEXT", '("anaplastic thyroid")') = 1 AND CONTAINS("CDD_DOCUMENT_FULL_TEXT", '("BRAF STATUS")') = 1 AND CDD_CANCEL_IND = '0' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND = '0' ; SELECT PRPT_MRN, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, PRPT_PROCEDURE_DTE, PRPT_REPORT_TYPE_DESC, PRPT_REPORT FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PRPT_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE CONTAINS("PRPT_REPORT", '("anaplastic thyroid")') = 1 AND YEAR(PRPT_PROCEDURE_DTE) BETWEEN '2018' AND '2023'; WITH MAIN AS (SELECT CDD_MRN, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, CDD_DOC_NAME, CDD_SERVICE_DTE, CDD_DOCUMENT_FULL_TEXT FROM DV.CLINDOC_FULL_TEXT_V JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON CDD_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE YEAR(CDD_SERVICE_DTE) BETWEEN '2018' AND '2023' AND CONTAINS("CDD_DOCUMENT_FULL_TEXT", '("anaplastic thyroid")') = 1 AND CONTAINS("CDD_DOCUMENT_FULL_TEXT", '("BRAF STATUS")') = 1 AND CDD_CANCEL_IND = '0' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND = '0' ), APR AS (SELECT DISTINCT APR_MRN, CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME, MIN(APR_START_DTE) AS DRUG_START FROM IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX_V WHERE LOWER(CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME) like ('%dabrafenib%') OR LOWER(CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME) like ('%trametinib%') GROUP BY APR_MRN, CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME) SELECT CDD_MRN, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, CDD_DOC_NAME, CDD_SERVICE_DTE, CDD_DOCUMENT_FULL_TEXT, CASE WHEN APR_MRN IS NOT NULL THEN CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME END AS DRUG, CASE WHEN APR_MRN IS NOT NULL THEN DRUG_START END AS DRUG_START_DT FROM MAIN LEFT JOIN APR ON CDD_MRN = APR_MRN ;

prompt: Provide hematology and chemistry labs and vital signs for 18-516 patients.
completion: WITH PTS AS (SELECT AC_MRN , CASE WHEN AC_MRN = '38090300' THEN '2019-11-12' WHEN AC_MRN = '35570408' THEN '2020-01-24' WHEN AC_MRN = '38100331' THEN '2020-01-24' END AS TX_START_DTE , CASE WHEN AC_MRN = '38090300' THEN '2019-12-12' WHEN AC_MRN = '35570408' THEN '2020-02-24' WHEN AC_MRN = '38100331' THEN '2020-02-24' END AS TX_END_DTE FROM IDB.ACCRUALS JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON AC_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE 1=1 AND AC_IRB_NO = '18-516' AND AC_MRN IN ('38090300', '35570408', '38100331') ) SELECT AC_MRN, LR_PERFORMED_DT, LR_TEST_NAME, LR_SUBTEST_NAME, LR_RESULT_VALUE, LR_UNIT_MEASURE FROM IDB.LAB_RESULTS JOIN PTS ON AC_MRN = LR_MRN WHERE 1=1 AND DATE(LR_PERFORMED_DT) BETWEEN TX_START_DTE AND TX_END_DTE

prompt: We want to include the results of renal function tests in our project studying the potential side effects of entrectinib.
completion: WITH DRUG AS (SELECT APR_MRN, CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME AS MEDICINE, APR_START_DTE AS MEDICATION_START_DATE FROM IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX_V V WHERE TRIM(V.CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME) IN ('RXDX-101', 'ENTRECTINIB', 'Rozlytrek') ) , DEMO AS (SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN , PT_LAST_NAME LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME FIRST_NAME, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH AS DATE_OF_BIRTH, PT_SEX AS GENDER, R.AV_DESC AS RACE, E.AV_DESC AS ETHNICITY FROM IDB.PATIENT C JOIN DRUG ON C.PT_MRN = APR_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS R ON R.AV_ELEMENT = 'RACE' AND R.AV_CODE = PT_RACE LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS E ON E.AV_ELEMENT = 'PT_ETHNICITY' AND E.AV_CODE = PT_PT_ETHNICITY) SELECT * FROM DEMO ; SELECT TM_MRN MRN, TM_DX_DTE TUMOR_DIAGNOSIS_DATE, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS HISTOLOGY_DESC, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_NAME FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS ON AV_ELEMENT = 'CASE_STS' AND AV_CODE = TM_CASE_STS WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND TM_MRN IN (SELECT APR_MRN FROM IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX_V V WHERE TRIM(V.CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME) IN ('RXDX-101', 'ENTRECTINIB', 'Rozlytrek')) ORDER BY TM_MRN, TM_DX_DTE ; SELECT CDD_MRN AS CDD_MRN, CDD_SERVICE_DTE AS SERVICE_DATE , CDO_SECTION AS DOCUMENT_SECTION, TRIM(CDO_ITEM_NAME) AS PAST_MEDICAL_HISTORY_ITEM, TRIM(CDO_VALUE_TEXT) AS PAST_MEDICAL_HISTORY_TEXT FROM IDB.CD_DOCUMENT LEFT JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION ON CDD_DOC_GUID = CDO_DOC_GUID AND CDD_AUTHORED_DTE = CDO_AUTHORED_DTE AND CDO_VALUE_TEXT <> '' WHERE CDD_CANCEL_IND <> '1' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND <> '1' AND CDO_SECTION LIKE 'Past%Medical%History%' AND CDD_MRN IN (SELECT APR_MRN FROM IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX_V V WHERE TRIM(V.CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME) IN ('RXDX-101', 'ENTRECTINIB', 'Rozlytrek')) ORDER BY CDD_MRN, CDD_SERVICE_DTE, CDO_SECTION; SELECT CDD_MRN AS CDD_MRN, CDD_SERVICE_DTE AS SERVICE_DATE , CDO_SECTION AS DOCUMENT_SECTION, CDO_ITEM_NAME AS MEDICAL_INSTRUCTIONS_ITEM, CDO_VALUE_TEXT AS MEDICAL_INSTRUCTIONS_TEXT FROM IDB.CD_DOCUMENT LEFT JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION ON CDD_DOC_GUID = CDO_DOC_GUID AND CDD_AUTHORED_DTE = CDO_AUTHORED_DTE AND CDO_VALUE_TEXT <> '' WHERE CDD_CANCEL_IND <> '1' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND <> '1' AND CDO_SECTION LIKE '%Medication%Instructions%' AND CDD_MRN IN (SELECT APR_MRN FROM IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX_V V WHERE TRIM(V.CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME) IN ('RXDX-101', 'ENTRECTINIB', 'Rozlytrek')) ORDER BY CDD_MRN, CDD_SERVICE_DTE, CDO_SECTION ; SELECT DISTINCT LR_MRN, LR_PERFORMED_DTE, LR_TEST_NAME, LR_SUBTEST_NAME, LR_RESULT_VALUE FROM IDB.LAB_RESULTS WHERE 1=1 AND (LR_SUBTEST_NAME = 'Creatinine' OR LR_TEST_NAME LIKE '%Cystatin%GFR%' OR LR_SUBTEST_NAME like '%Estimated%GFR%') AND LR_MRN IN (SELECT APR_MRN FROM IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX_V V WHERE TRIM(V.CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME) IN ('RXDX-101', 'ENTRECTINIB', 'Rozlytrek')) ORDER BY LR_MRN, LR_PERFORMED_DTE, LR_TEST_NAME; SELECT PMH_MRN, PMH_MEASURE_DTE "PMH_MEASURE_DATE", PMH_WT_KG "WEIGHT_IN_KG", PMH_HT_CM " HEIGHT_IN_CM", PMH_BMI "BMI" FROM IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX_V V JOIN IDB.PT_MEASURES_HX H ON H.PMH_MRN = APR_MRN AND TRIM(V.CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME) IN ('RXDX-101', 'ENTRECTINIB', 'Rozlytrek') ORDER BY PMH_MRN, PMH_MEASURE_DTE;

prompt: I will give a list of patients, and I would like to know if they have received prostate biopsies 18 months post-treatment.

Provide a list of patients who have disclosed sexual orientation within the institution in the last 5 years (entered in MSK engage). We are also looking to see what type of cancer these patients have and their other general demographic data (such as age, gender race & ethnicity, etc).
completion: WITH ENGAGE AS (SELECT EF_MRN, EF_FORM_ID, DATE(EF_SUBMISSION_DT) EF_SUBMISSION_DT, EFI_ITEM_TEXT, EFI_VALUE_SHORT_NAME, EFI_VALUE FROM IDB.EF_FORM JOIN IDB.EF_FORM_ITEM ON EF_FORM_ID = EFI_FORM_ID WHERE EF_FORM_NAME = 'Care Questionnaire' AND EFI_ITEM_SHORT_NAME = 'SOC_ORIE_SexualOrientation' AND DATE(EF_SUBMISSION_DT) >= CURRENT date - 5 YEARS ) , DX AS (SELECT PT_MRN, TUMOR_REG_DATA, ICD_DATA FROM IDB.PATIENT LEFT JOIN (SELECT TM_MRN, LISTAGG(TM_DX_DTE || ' | ' || TRIM(SITE_DESC) || ' | ' || TRIM(HIST_DESC), CHR(13) || CHR(10)) WITHIN GROUP( ORDER BY TM_DX_DTE) AS TUMOR_REG_DATA FROM (SELECT DISTINCT TM_MRN, AV_DESC AS CASE_STS, TM_DX_DTE, TM_HIST_CD, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS HIST_DESC, TM_SITE_CD, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_DESC FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS ON AV_ELEMENT = 'CASE_STS' AND AV_CODE = TM_CASE_STS AND TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') ) A GROUP BY TM_MRN) AS CDB ON TM_MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN (SELECT CC_MRN, LISTAGG(MIN_ICD9_EFF_DTE || ' | ' || TRIM(ICD9_CD) || ' | ' || TRIM(ICD9_DESC), CHR(13) || CHR(10)) WITHIN GROUP( ORDER BY MIN_ICD9_EFF_DTE) AS ICD_DATA FROM (SELECT DISTINCT CC_MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS MIN_ICD9_EFF_DTE, CC_CLSF_CD AS ICD9_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS ICD9_DESC FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE 1=1 AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND ((CC_CLSF_CD BETWEEN '140' AND '239.99') OR (CC_CLSF_CD BETWEEN 'C00' AND 'D49')) GROUP BY CC_MRN, CC_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK ) A GROUP BY CC_MRN) AS ICD9 ON CC_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE COALESCE(TM_MRN, CC_MRN) IS NOT NULL ) , DX_FINAL AS (SELECT PT_MRN DX_MRN, TUMOR_REG_DATA, ICD_DATA FROM DX JOIN ENGAGE ON EF_MRN = PT_MRN) SELECT DISTINCT EF_MRN "MRN", EFI_VALUE "Sexual Orientation", TUMOR_REG_DATA "Tumor Registry Dx Data", ICD_DATA "ICD Dx Data", TRIM(R.AV_DESC) AS "Race", TRIM(E.AV_DESC) AS "Ethnicity", PT_SEX "Gender", PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH "DOB" FROM ENGAGE LEFT JOIN DX_FINAL ON EF_MRN = DX_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.PATIENT P ON EF_MRN = P.PT_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS R ON R.AV_ELEMENT = 'RACE' AND R.AV_CODE = P.PT_RACE LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS E ON E.AV_ELEMENT = 'PT_ETHNICITY' AND E.AV_CODE = P.PT_PT_ETHNICITY

prompt: Provide all patients from January 1, 2022-June 30, 2022 that had specific head and neck surgeries (based on CPT codes). Schedule delivery of individuals having those surgeries each week from October 1, 2022-March 31, 2023.

prompt: Provide a list of breast medicine patients with ER+ breast cancer that had a screening order submitted for between 10/1/2021-12/31/21.
completion: WITH ORDER_DETAILS AS (SELECT PT_MRN AS "MRN", PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH AS "DOB", OO_ENTER_DTE, OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE, OO_MRN FROM IDB.OMS_ORDER JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON OO_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE OO_ORD_NAME LIKE 'Breast Medicine Research Screening%' AND OO_ORD_STS_CD NOT IN ('CANP', 'CANC', 'AUC3') AND OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE BETWEEN '2021-10-01' AND '2021-12-31' ) SELECT DISTINCT OD.MRN, TRIM(OD.PT_LAST_NAME)||', ' || TRIM(OD.PT_FIRST_NAME) AS "Patient Name", OD.DOB, 'ER+' AS "Breast Cancer Type", OD.OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE AS "Date of Screening order" FROM IDB.CD_DOCUMENT JOIN ORDER_DETAILS OD ON CDD_MRN = OD.OO_MRN JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION ON CDD_DOC_GUID = CDO_DOC_GUID AND CDD_AUTHORED_DTE = CDO_AUTHORED_DTE WHERE 1=1 AND CDD_CANCEL_IND <> '1' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND <> '1' AND CDD_DOC_NAME IN ('Follow Up Note - Breast Surgery', 'Follow Up, NP - Breast Surgery', 'Follow Up - Breast Surgery', 'Follow Up - Surgery-Breast', 'Follow Up, NP/PA - Breast Surgery') AND CDO_ITEM_NAME = 'ER:' AND CDO_VALUE_TEXT = 'Positive'

prompt: Provide a list of patients seen in the breast medicine or surgery services
completion: SELECT CPE_MRN AS "MRN", PT_LAST_NAME LAST_NANME, PT_FIRST_NAME FIRST_NAME, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH DOB, CPP_EMAIL_ADDR EMAIL, CAV_NAME LANGUAGE, MIN(CPE_ENC_DTE) AS MIN_APPT_DATE, MAX(CPE_ENC_DTE) AS MAX_APPT_DATE FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON CPE_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY ON CPE_MRN = PLA_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_PAS_PATIENT ON CPE_MRN = CPP_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_CATEGORY ON CAV_CATEGORY = 'LANG' AND CPP_LANG = CAV_ABBR WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp', 'Sch') AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN '2018-01-01' AND '2020-12-31' AND PT_DEATH_IND IN ('', 'A') AND PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH >= '1920-01-01' AND PLA_DONOT_MAIL_IND <> 'Y' AND CPP_EMAIL_ADDR <> '' AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 IN ('MED', 'SRG') AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 = 'BRE' GROUP BY CPE_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, CPP_EMAIL_ADDR, CAV_NAME ;

prompt: IR visits within 10 days of Venous Access placement from May 2013 to October 2013
completion: WITH VA AS (SELECT OL_LOG_ID AS LOGID, CL_MRN AS MRN, OL_SURG_DTE AS PROCDTE, CRE_RES_NAME AS SURGEON, OP_PROC_NAME AS PROCNAME FROM IDB.OR_LOG JOIN IDB.OR_LOG_ALL_SURG ON OL_LOG_ID = OLAS_LOG_ID JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON OLAS_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_PATIENT ON OL_MRN = CL_MRN JOIN IDB.OR_LNLG_DX ON OLAS_PNL_NO = OLLD_DX_PROC_PNL AND OLAS_LOG_ID = OLLD_LOG_ID AND OL_LOG_ID = OLLD_LOG_ID JOIN IDB.OR_PROC ON OLLD_DX_OR_PROC = OP_OR_PROC_ID JOIN IDB.OR_CL_PROC ON OP_OR_PROC_ID = OCP_OR_PROC_ID JOIN IDB.CL_PROC ON OCP_PROC_ID = CPX_PROC_ID WHERE OLAS_SURG_ROLE = 'Primary' AND OL_LOG_STS_CD NOT IN ('4', '6') AND OL_SURG_DTE BETWEEN '2013-10-01' AND '2013-10-22' AND CPX_PROC_NAME = 'IR PROCEDURE' AND OP_PROC_NAME LIKE 'VA %' AND OL_PT_TYPE NOT LIKE 'I%') , IR AS (SELECT CLD_DEPT_NAME AS IR_DEPT, CRE_RES_NAME AS IR_RES, CPE_MRN AS IR_MRN , CPE_ENC_DTE AS IR_APPT_DTE , CPE_APPT_MADE_DTE AS IR_MADEDTE, TIME(CPE_APPT_DT) AS IR_APPT_TIME, TIME(CPE_CHK_IN_DT) AS IR_CKIN, TIME(CPE_RM_IN_DT) AS IR_RMIN, TIME(CPE_RM_OUT_DT) AS IR_RMOUT FROM VA JOIN IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER ON MRN = CPE_MRN AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN PROCDTE - 14 DAY AND PROCDTE AND CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Comp', 'Arrived') JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID AND CLD_CLD_CENTER = 'MAIN' AND (CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 = 'IR' OR CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 = 'IR') JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CRE_RES_ID = CPE_VST_RES_ID AND CRE_RES_TYP <> 'Resource') , REFVIS AS (SELECT CLD_DEPT_NAME AS REF_DEPT, CRE_RES_NAME AS REF_RES, CPE_MRN AS REF_MRN , CPE_ENC_DTE AS REF_APPT_DTE , CPE_APPT_MADE_DTE AS REF_MADEDTE, TIME(CPE_APPT_DT) AS REF_APPT_TIME, TIME(CPE_CHK_IN_DT) AS REF_CKIN, TIME(CPE_RM_IN_DT) AS REF_RMIN, TIME(CPE_RM_OUT_DT) AS REF_RMOUT FROM IR JOIN IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER ON IR_MRN = CPE_MRN AND CPE_ENC_DTE = IR_APPT_DTE AND CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Comp', 'Arrived') JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID AND NOT (CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 IN ('PFS', 'IR') OR CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 = 'IR') JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CRE_RES_ID = CPE_VST_RES_ID WHERE IR_MADEDTE = IR_APPT_DTE ) SELECT DISTINCT LOGID, MRN, PROCDTE, SURGEON, PROCNAME, IR_DEPT, IR_RES, IR_APPT_DTE, IR_MADEDTE, IR_APPT_TIME, IR_CKIN, IR_RMIN, IR_RMOUT, REF_DEPT, REF_RES, REF_APPT_TIME , REF_CKIN, REF_RMIN, REF_RMOUT FROM VA JOIN IR ON MRN = IR_MRN LEFT JOIN REFVIS ON REF_MRN = IR_MRN AND REF_APPT_DTE = IR_APPT_DTE

prompt: Provide the specific clinical data for all patients with gliomas who harbored H3F3A, H3F3B and HIST1H3B mutations as found in cBioPortal.
completion: WITH DM AS (SELECT PT_MRN AS MRN, GENE FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_STRUCTURED_RESULTS_V WHERE GENE IN ('H3F3A', 'H3F3B', 'HIST1H3B') ) , IMPACT AS (SELECT DISTINCT MRN, GENE, PT_SEX, PT_BIRTH_DTE, PT_DEATH_DTE, PDRX_ACCESSION_NO, DV.REGEXSTR('(S|H|C|M|F|B|DMG)[0-9]{2}[\s|-][0-9]*', PART_DESCRIPTION) AS REFERENCEDACCESSION, DV.TODATE(DT_PROCEDURE) AS "Procedure Date", T.* FROM DM JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON MRN = PT_MRN JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML DT ON PDRX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID CROSS JOIN XMLTABLE('$c/root/*' PASSING DT.PDRX_XML_VALUE AS "c" COLUMNS SAMPLEID VARCHAR(100) PATH '../meta-data/dmp_sample_id', PATIENTID VARCHAR(100) PATH '../meta-data/dmp_patient_id', TUMOR_TYPE_CODE VARCHAR(100) PATH '../meta-data/tumor_type_code', TUMOR_TYPE_NAME VARCHAR(255) PATH '../meta-data/tumor_type_name', PRIMARY_SITE VARCHAR(255) PATH '../meta-data/primary_site', METASTASIS_SITE VARCHAR(255) PATH '../meta-data/metastasis_site', DT_PROCEDURE VARCHAR(40) PATH '../meta-data/dt_procedure', PART_DESCRIPTION VARCHAR(2000) PATH '../meta-data/part_description') T WHERE 1=1 AND TUMOR_TYPE_NAME IN ('Anaplastic Astrocytoma', 'Astrocytoma', 'Diffuse Astrocytoma', 'Diffuse Glioma', 'Glioblastoma', 'Glioblastoma Multiforme', 'Glioma, NOS', 'High-Grade Glioma, NOS', 'High-Grade Neuroepithelial Tumor') ) , MR AS (SELECT DISTINCT "t1"."PT_MRN" AS "MRN", "t2"."RRPT_ACCESSION_NO" AS "Radiology Accession Number", "t2"."RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE" AS "Radiology Performed Date", "t2"."RRPT_REPORT_DTE" AS "Radiology Report Date", "t2"."RRPT_ORDER_GROUP" AS "Radiology Order Group", "t2"."RRPT_PROCEDURE_NAME" AS "Radiology Procedure Name", UPPER(DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)IMPRESSION:[\w\W]*(?=DICTATED BY:)', RRPT_REPORT_TXT)) AS IMPRESSION, UPPER(CASE WHEN LENGTH(RRPT_REPORT_TXT) <= 15000 THEN RTRIM(CAST(SUBSTR(RRPT_REPORT_TXT, 1, 15000) AS VARCHAR(15000))) ELSE CAST(SUBSTR(RRPT_REPORT_TXT, 1, 15000) AS VARCHAR(15000)) END) AS "PRPT_REPORT", ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY "t1"."PT_MRN" ORDER BY "t2"."RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE") AS RN FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V" "t1" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED" "t3" ON "t1"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t3"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."RADIOLOGY_REPORT_V" "t2" ON "t3"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t2"."RRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_IDENTIFICATION_MRN_V" "t4" ON "t1"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t4"."PI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" WHERE "t4"."PI_SOURCE_SYSTEM_PT_ID" IN (SELECT MRN FROM IMPACT) AND "t2"."RRPT_ORDER_GROUP" = 'MR' AND(UPPER("t2"."RRPT_PROCEDURE_NAME") like '%BRAIN%' OR UPPER("t2"."RRPT_PROCEDURE_NAME") like '%BRN%' OR UPPER("t2"."RRPT_PROCEDURE_NAME") like '%SPINE%') ) SELECT DISTINCT IMPACT.*, "Radiology Performed Date", "Radiology Procedure Name", IMPRESSION FROM IMPACT LEFT JOIN MR ON IMPACT.MRN = MR.MRN AND RN = 1 WITH PT AS (SELECT PT_MRN AS MRN FROM IDB.PATIENT WHERE PT_MRN IN () ) , CHEMO AS (SELECT DISTINCT APR_MRN, CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME, APR_START_DTE, APR_END_DTE, APR_ORD_RX_TYPE, APR_ROUTE, APR_PRESCRIBED_DOSE, APR_DOSE_UOM FROM IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX_V WHERE 1=1 AND CDG_CHEMO_FLAG = 'Y' AND APR_MRN IN (SELECT MRN FROM PT) ) , RT AS (SELECT DISTINCT RTC_TX_MRN, RTC_TX_PLAN_NAME, RTC_PRIMARY_REF_POINT, RTC_TX_START_DTE, RTC_TX_STOP_DTE, RTC_TX_ELAPSED_DAYS, RTC_TX_PLANNED_FRACTIONS, RTC_TX_DELIVERED_FRACTIONS, RTC_TX_PLANNED_DOSE, RTC_TX_DELIVERED_DOSE, RTC_DOSE_CORRECTION FROM IDB.RADONC_TREATMENT_COURSE WHERE 1=1 AND RTC_TX_MRN IN (SELECT MRN FROM PT) )

prompt: Provide weekly report on patients consented to #15-021 in the past week who will be used for research under #18-065. The report should provide clinical and demographic information as in SKI19879
completion: WITH ETO AS (SELECT ACD_IRB_NO, ACD_MRN MRN, STRIP(PT_LAST_NAME)||', '||STRIP(PT_FIRST_NAME) PT_NAME, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH DOB, PT_DATE_OF_DEATH DOD, PT_RACE_DESC, PT_PT_ETHNICITY_DESC, PT_RELIGION_DESC, PT_EMAIL_ADDRESS, PT_LAST_KNOWN_ALIVE_DTE, ACD_CONS_DTE, ACD_OFF_STUDY_DTE FROM IDB.ACCRUALS_DATES JOIN IDB.PATIENT_V ON ACD_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE ACD_IRB_NO = '15-021' ) , CDB AS (SELECT TM_MRN, PT_NAME, DOD, YEAR(TM_DX_DTE) - YEAR(DOB) AS AGE_AT_DX, TM_DX_DTE DX_DTE, TM_HIST_CD HIST_CD, HS.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK HIST_DESC, TM_SITE_CD DX_CD, ST.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK DX_DESC , SZ.CDB_AV_DESC GEN_STAGE, TM_BEST_AJCC_STG AJCC_STAGE, CC.CDB_AV_DESC CLASS_OF_CASE FROM ETO AS A JOIN IDB.CDB_TUMOR ON MRN = TM_MRN JOIN IDB.CLM HS ON TM_HIST_CD = HS.CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.CLM ST ON TM_SITE_CD = ST.CLM_CLSF_CD LEFT JOIN IDB.CDB_ALLOWVALS SZ ON TM_GENERAL_STG = SZ.CDB_AV_CODE AND SZ.CDB_AV_ELEMENT = 'GENERAL_STG' AND SZ.CDB_AV_CD_STS = 'A' LEFT JOIN IDB.CDB_ALLOWVALS CC ON TM_CLASS_OF_CASE = CC.CDB_AV_CODE AND CC.CDB_AV_ELEMENT = 'CLASS_OF_CASE' AND CC.CDB_AV_CD_STS = 'A' WHERE TM_CASE_STS = '3' ), CLSF AS (SELECT MRN , AGE_AT_DX, PT_NAME, DOD, DX_DTE, DX_CD, DX_DESC FROM (SELECT T1.MRN, T1.PT_NAME, T1.DOD, YEAR(CC_EFF_DTE) - YEAR(DOB) AGE_AT_DX , DX.CC_EFF_DTE DX_DTE , DX.CC_CLSF_CD DX_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS DX_DESC , ROW_NUMBER () OVER (PARTITION BY DX.CC_MRN, DX.CC_CLSF_CD ORDER BY DX.CC_EFF_DTE) RN FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF DX JOIN ETO T1 ON T1.MRN = CC_MRN LEFT JOIN CDB ON CDB.TM_MRN = CC_MRN JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE (DX.CC_CLSF_CD BETWEEN '149' AND '239.99' OR DX.CC_CLSF_CD BETWEEN 'C00' AND 'D49.9999') AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'D%' AND (CC_FINALIZED_IND= 'Y' OR CC_PT_TYPE = 'I') AND CDB.TM_MRN IS NULL ) AS A WHERE RN = 1 ) SELECT TM_MRN MRN, PT_NAME, DOD, DX_DTE, AGE_AT_DX , DAYS(COALESCE(DOD, CURRENT DATE)) - DAYS(DX_DTE) SURV_IN_DAYS , DX_CD, DX_DESC, HIST_CD, HIST_DESC, AJCC_STAGE STAGE FROM CDB UNION SELECT MRN, PT_NAME, DOD, DX_DTE, AGE_AT_DX, DAYS(COALESCE(DOD, CURRENT DATE)) - DAYS(DX_DTE) SURV_IN_DAYS , DX_CD, DX_DESC, '' HIST_CD, '' HIST_DESC, '' STAGE FROM CLSF ; WITH ETO AS (SELECT ACD_IRB_NO, ACD_MRN MRN, STRIP(PT_LAST_NAME)||', '||STRIP(PT_FIRST_NAME) PT_NAME FROM IDB.ACCRUALS_DATES JOIN IDB.PATIENT_V ON ACD_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE ACD_IRB_NO = '15-021' ) SELECT MRN, PT_NAME, APR_DRUG_NAME DRUG_NAME, APR_START_DTE START_DATE, APR_END_DTE END_DATE, APR_PRESCRIBED_DOSE PRESCRIBED_DOSE, APR_DOSE_UOM UOM, APR_DISPENSE_CNT DISPENSE_CNT, APR_TOTAL_GIVEN_DOSE TOTAL_GIVEN_DOSE, APR_ROUTE ROUTE, APR_FREQ FREQ, APR_SET_NAME SET_NAME, GEN.CDG_THERAPEUTIC_CATEGORY, GEN.CDG_CHEMO_FLAG, GEN.CDG_BIOLOGIC_IMMUNO_FLAG, GEN.CDG_HORMONE_FLAG, GEN.CDG_BONE_AGENTS_FLAG FROM ETO JOIN IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX RX ON MRN = APR_MRN JOIN IDB.CHEMO_DRUG_GENERIC GEN ON APR_GENERIC_NAME = CDG_GENERIC_NAME WHERE RX.APR_DRUG_PROCESS_STAGE <> 'H' ; WITH ETO AS (SELECT DISTINCT ACD_IRB_NO, ACD_MRN MRN, STRIP(PT_LAST_NAME)||', '||STRIP(PT_FIRST_NAME) PT_NAME FROM IDB.ACCRUALS_DATES JOIN IDB.PATIENT_V ON ACD_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE ACD_IRB_NO = '15-021' ) SELECT MRN, PT_NAME, RX.APR_GENERIC_NAME GENERIC_NAME, MIN(APR_START_DTE) START_DATE, MAX(APR_END_DTE) STOP_DATE, SUM(APR_PRESCRIBED_DOSE) SUM_PRESCRIBED_DOSE, LOWER(APR_DOSE_UOM) DOSE_UOM, SUM(APR_DISPENSE_CNT) SUM_DISPENSE_CNT, SUM(APR_TOTAL_GIVEN_DOSE) SUM_TOTAL_GIVEN_DOSE, UPPER(APR_ROUTE) ROUTE FROM ETO JOIN IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX RX ON MRN = APR_MRN JOIN IDB.CHEMO_DRUG_GENERIC GEN ON APR_GENERIC_NAME = CDG_GENERIC_NAME WHERE RX.APR_DRUG_PROCESS_STAGE <> 'H' GROUP BY MRN, PT_NAME, RX.APR_GENERIC_NAME, LOWER(APR_DOSE_UOM) , UPPER(APR_ROUTE) ; WITH ETO AS (SELECT DISTINCT ACD_IRB_NO, ACD_MRN MRN, STRIP(PT_LAST_NAME)||', '||STRIP(PT_FIRST_NAME) PT_NAME FROM IDB.ACCRUALS_DATES JOIN IDB.PATIENT_V ON ACD_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE ACD_IRB_NO = '15-021' ) SELECT MRN, PT_NAME, RTC_TX_COURSE_NO, RTC_TX_PLAN_NAME, RTC_TX_PLANNED_FRACTIONS, RTC_TX_DELIVERED_FRACTIONS, RTC_TX_PLANNED_DOSE, RTC_TX_DELIVERED_DOSE, RTC_TX_START_DTE, RTC_TX_STOP_DTE, RTC_TX_ELAPSED_DAYS, RTC_PRIMARY_REF_POINT, RTC_DOSE_CORRECTION FROM ETO JOIN IDB.RADONC_TREATMENT_COURSE ON MRN = RTC_TX_MRN ; WITH ETO AS (SELECT DISTINCT ACD_IRB_NO, ACD_MRN MRN, STRIP(PT_LAST_NAME)||', '||STRIP(PT_FIRST_NAME) PT_NAME FROM IDB.ACCRUALS_DATES JOIN IDB.PATIENT_V ON ACD_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE ACD_IRB_NO = '15-021' ) SELECT DISTINCT SSP_LOG_ID LOGID, MRN, PT_NAME, SSE_SURG_DTE, SSE_SURG_LOC, SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD CPT_CODE, SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC CPT_DESC, SSE_LOG_STS FROM ETO JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT ON MRN = SSE_MRN JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE ON SSE_LOG_ID = SSP_LOG_ID WHERE SSE_LOG_STS IN ('Posted', 'Unposted') ;

prompt:
Provide a list of comorbidities based on ICD9/10 codes and 

Adult Health Screening questionnaire to calculate MSK-FI (MSK frailty index)
completion: WITH PT AS (SELECT * FROM IDB.PATIENT WHERE PT_MRN IN () ) SELECT CC_MRN AS MRN, STRIP(CC_CLSF_CD) AS "ICD-9/ICD-10 Code", STRIP(CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK) AS "ICD-9/ICD-10 Desc", MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS "Initial Effective Date" FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND ((CC_PT_TYPE = 'I') OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) AND CC_MRN IN (SELECT PT_MRN FROM PT) GROUP BY CC_MRN, STRIP(CC_CLSF_CD), STRIP(CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK) ORDER BY MRN SELECT MRN, DOC_GUID, DOC_NAME, SERVICE_DATE, MAX(CASE WHEN VALUE_TEXT LIKE '%NONE%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "NONE", MAX(CASE WHEN VALUE_TEXT LIKE '%DRESSING%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "DRESSING", MAX(CASE WHEN VALUE_TEXT LIKE '%GROOMING%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "GROOMING", MAX(CASE WHEN VALUE_TEXT LIKE '%EATING%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "EATING", MAX(CASE WHEN VALUE_TEXT LIKE '%WALKING%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "WALKING", MAX(CASE WHEN VALUE_TEXT LIKE '%BATHING%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "BATHING", MAX(CASE WHEN VALUE_TEXT LIKE '%USING THE TOILET%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "USING THE TOILET", MAX(CASE WHEN VALUE_TEXT LIKE '%USING THE PHONE%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "USING THE PHONE", MAX(CASE WHEN VALUE_TEXT LIKE '%SHOPPING FOR GROCERIES%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "SHOPPING FOR GROCERIES", MAX(CASE WHEN VALUE_TEXT LIKE '%PREPARING MEALS%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "PREPARING MEALS", MAX(CASE WHEN VALUE_TEXT LIKE '%DOING SIMPLE CLEANING%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "DOING SIMPLE CLEANING", MAX(CASE WHEN VALUE_TEXT LIKE '%DOING YOUR OWN LAUNDRY%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "DOING YOUR OWN LAUNDRY", MAX(CASE WHEN VALUE_TEXT LIKE '%MANAGING FINANCES%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "MANAGING FINANCES", MAX(CASE WHEN VALUE_TEXT LIKE '%HANDLING YOU OWN MEDICINE%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "HANDLING YOU OWN MEDICINE", MAX(CASE WHEN VALUE_TEXT LIKE '%VISITING YOUR DOCTOR%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "VISITING YOUR DOCTOR" FROM (SELECT DISTINCT CDD_MRN AS MRN, CDD_DOC_GUID AS DOC_GUID, CDD_DOC_NAME AS DOC_NAME, CDD_SERVICE_DTE AS SERVICE_DATE, CDO_SECTION AS "Section", CDO_CTLG_DISPL_NM AS CTLG_DISPL_NM, CDO_MSTR_ITEM_NM AS MSTR_ITEM_NM, CDO_ITEM_NAME AS ITEM_NAME, UPPER(STRIP(SUBSTR(CDO_VALUE_TEXT, 1, 2000))) AS VALUE_TEXT FROM PT JOIN IDB.CD_DOCUMENT ON CDD_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION ON CDD_DOC_GUID = CDO_DOC_GUID WHERE CDD_DOC_NAME IN ('Adult Health Screening (65+), Ambulatory - Nursing', 'Adult Health Screening, Ambulatory - Nursing', 'Nursing Adult Health Screening 65+, Patient/RN - Outpatient', 'Nursing Adult Health Screening, Patient/RN - Outpatient') AND CDD_CANCEL_IND <> '1' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND <> '1' ) AHS GROUP BY MRN, DOC_GUID, DOC_NAME, SERVICE_DATE

prompt: Provide a weekly list of patients scheduled for a surgical GI procedure in the next 2 weeks and are consented to 06-107 or 09-141.
completion: WITH X AS (SELECT OC_CASE_ID, STRIP(OC_MRN) AS MRN, STRIP(PT_LAST_NAME) || ', ' || STRIP(PT_FIRST_NAME) AS "Name", OC_SURG_DTE, TIME(OC_SCH_DT) AS OC_SURG_TME, CR1.CRE_RES_NAME, OP_OR_PROC_ID, OP_PROC_NAME, L1.LOC_LOC_NAME, CASE WHEN DX1.CDX_ICD9 > ' ' THEN STRIP(DX1.CDX_ICD9) ELSE STRIP(DX1.CDX_ICD10) END ||' - '||DX1.CDX_DX_NAME DX_L1, CASE WHEN DX2.CDX_ICD9 > ' ' THEN STRIP(DX2.CDX_ICD9) ELSE STRIP(DX2.CDX_ICD10) END ||' - '||DX2.CDX_DX_NAME DX_L2 FROM IDB.OR_CASE JOIN IDB.OR_CASE_ALL_PROC ON OC_CASE_ID = OCAP_CASE_ID JOIN IDB.OR_CASE_ALL_SURG ON OCAP_CASE_ID = OCAS_CASE_ID AND OCAS_PNL_NO = OCAP_PNL_NO AND OCAS_SURG_ROLE = 'Primary' JOIN IDB.OR_PROC ON OCAP_OR_PROC_ID = OP_OR_PROC_ID JOIN IDB.OR_CL_PROC ON OP_OR_PROC_ID = OCP_OR_PROC_ID JOIN IDB.CL_PROC ON OCP_PROC_ID = CPX_PROC_ID JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE CR1 ON CR1.CRE_RES_ID = OCAS_RES_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_LOCATION L1 ON OC_SURG_LOC_ID = L1.LOC_LOC_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ROOM ON OC_ROOM_RES_ID = ROOM.CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON OC_MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.OR_CASE_DX_CODES LN1 ON LN1.OCD_CASE_ID = OC_CASE_ID AND LN1.OCD_LINE_NO = 1 LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_DX DX1 ON DX1.CDX_DX_ID = LN1.OCD_DX_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.OR_CASE_DX_CODES LN2 ON LN2.OCD_CASE_ID = OC_CASE_ID AND LN2.OCD_LINE_NO = 2 LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_DX DX2 ON DX2.CDX_DX_ID = LN2.OCD_DX_ID WHERE OC_SURG_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT date AND CURRENT date + 14 DAYS AND OC_SURG_SVC = 'GI' AND OC_OR_CASE_STS_CD NOT IN ('2', '5') ) , AC AS (SELECT AC_MRN, MAX(CASE WHEN AC_IRB_NO = '09-141' THEN AC_CONS_DTE END) AS "09-141 Consent Date", MAX(CASE WHEN AC_IRB_NO = '06-107' THEN AC_CONS_DTE END) AS "06-107 Consent Date" FROM X JOIN IDB.ACCRUALS ON MRN = AC_MRN AND AC_IRB_NO IN ('09-141', '06-107') GROUP BY AC_MRN) , CDB AS (SELECT TM_MRN AS DX_MRN, TM_DX_DTE AS DX_DATE, TM_SITE_CD AS SITE_CODE, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_DESC, TM_HIST_CD AS HIST_CODE, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS HIST_DESC FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM H ON TM_HIST_CD = H.CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON TM_SITE_CD = S.CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND TM_MRN IN (SELECT MRN FROM X) UNION SELECT CC_MRN AS DX_MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS DX_DATE, CLM_CLSF_CD AS SITE_CODE, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_DESC, '' AS HIST_CODE, '' AS HIST_DESC FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND ((CC_PT_TYPE = 'I') OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) AND CC_MRN IN (SELECT MRN FROM X) AND(CLM_CLSF_CD BETWEEN '140' AND '239.99' OR CLM_CLSF_CD BETWEEN 'C00' AND 'C99.99') GROUP BY CC_MRN, CLM_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK, '', '' ) , CTE AS (SELECT DX_MRN, DX_DATE, STRIP(SITE_CODE) || '-' || STRIP(SITE_DESC) || '|' || STRIP(HIST_CODE) || '-' || STRIP(HIST_DESC) AS DX_CODE FROM CDB) , CTE2 AS (SELECT * FROM CTE ORDER BY DX_MRN, DX_DATE DESC, DX_CODE) , T1 AS (SELECT DX_MRN, DX_DATE, DX_CODE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY DX_MRN ORDER BY DX_DATE DESC) AS RN FROM CTE2 ORDER BY DX_MRN, DX_DATE DESC) , T2 (MRN, DX, RN1) AS (SELECT DX_MRN, CAST(DX_DATE AS VARCHAR(6000))||' | '||CAST(DX_CODE AS VARCHAR(100)), RN FROM T1 WHERE T1.RN = 1 UNION ALL SELECT DX_MRN, RTRIM(CAST(DX AS VARCHAR(4000))) || ', ' || CHR(13) || CHR(10) || CAST(DX_DATE AS VARCHAR(100))||' | '||RTRIM(CAST(DX_CODE AS VARCHAR(100))) , RN1 + 1 FROM T1, T2 WHERE DX_MRN = MRN AND RN = RN1+1 ) , T3 AS (SELECT MRN, MAX(RN1) RN FROM T2 GROUP BY MRN) , T4 AS (SELECT T2.MRN, RN, REPLACE(DX, '|-, ', '') AS DX FROM T2 JOIN T3 ON T2.MRN = T3.MRN AND T2.RN1 = T3.RN) , PLT AS (SELECT DISTINCT LR_MRN AS MRN, LR_PERFORMED_DTE AS PERFORMED_DTE, LR_PERFORMED_DT AS PERFORMED_DT, LR_TEST_NAME AS TEST_NAME, LR_SUBTEST_NAME AS SUBTEST_NAME, LR_RESULT_VALUE AS RESULT_VALUE, LR_UNIT_MEASURE AS UNIT_MEASURE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY LR_MRN ORDER BY LR_PERFORMED_DT DESC) AS RN FROM X JOIN IDB.LAB_RESULTS ON LR_MRN = MRN WHERE UPPER(LR_SUBTEST_NAME) LIKE '%PLATELET%' AND LR_RESULT_VALUE <> '' ) SELECT DISTINCT X.*, DX_L1, DX_L2, "06-107 Consent Date", "09-141 Consent Date", DX, SUBTEST_NAME, PERFORMED_DTE, RESULT_VALUE, UNIT_MEASURE FROM X LEFT JOIN AC ON X.MRN = AC_MRN LEFT JOIN T4 ON X.MRN = T4.MRN LEFT JOIN PLT ON X.MRN = PLT.MRN AND PLT.RN = 1 WHERE "06-107 Consent Date" IS NOT NULL OR "09-141 Consent Date" IS NOT NULL

prompt: Purpose to determine if mitogen testing should continue on current and successor protocol
completion: SELECT DISTINCT LR_MRN AS MRN, LR_PERFORMED_DTE AS TEST_DATE, LR_TEST_NAME AS TEST_NAME, LR_SUBTEST_NAME AS SUBTEST_NAME, LR_RESULT_VALUE AS RESULT_VALUE, AC_IRB_NO AS IRB_NO FROM (SELECT DISTINCT LR_MRN, LR_PERFORMED_DTE, LR_TEST_NAME, LR_SUBTEST_NAME, LR_RESULT_VALUE, AC_IRB_NO FROM IDB.LAB_RESULTS JOIN IDB.ACCRUALS ON AC_MRN = LR_MRN AND AC_IRB_NO = '05-075' WHERE 1=1 AND LR_TEST_NAME IN ('Mitogen (PHA) with physician interpretation', 'Mitogens', 'Mitogens Panel', 'Mitogen Proliferation', 'Mitogen Package.', 'Mitogen Proliferation Panel', 'Mitogen (PHA only)', 'Unstimulated Mitogen', 'Mitogen (PHA)') AND LR_RESULT_VALUE <> ' ' AND LR_PERFORMED_DTE BETWEEN '2009-05-27' AND '2021-09-15' ) ORDER BY LR_MRN;

prompt: Provide a monthly report of patients who have consented to 12-245 A&C with a thoracic surgeon and whether or not the Part A and/or Part C report has resulted yet.
completion: WITH PTS AS (SELECT TRIM(CRDB.PT_MRN) MRN, PT.LAST_NAME "Last Name", PT.FIRST_NAME "First Name", CASE WHEN PT_DEATH_IND IN ('X', 'C', 'D') THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END "Deceased", MAX(CASE WHEN REG_ID = '100' THEN DATE(CRDB.REGISTRATION_DATETIME) END) "Part A Registration Date", MAX(CASE WHEN REG_ID = '100' THEN DATE(CRDB.CRNT_CONSENT_DATE) END) "Part A Consent Date", MAX(CASE WHEN REG_ID = '100' THEN CRDB.PHYSICIAN_OF_RECORD END) "Part A Treating MD", MAX(CASE WHEN REG_ID = '300' THEN DATE(CRDB.REGISTRATION_DATETIME) END) "Part C Registration Date", MAX(CASE WHEN REG_ID = '300' THEN DATE(CRDB.CRNT_CONSENT_DATE) END) "Part C Consent Date", MAX(CASE WHEN REG_ID = '300' THEN CRDB.PHYSICIAN_OF_RECORD END) "Part C Treating MD" FROM NN.CRDB_DASH_PT_REG CRDB JOIN NN.CRDB_DASH_PT PT ON CRDB.PRT_ID = PT.PRT_ID AND CRDB.PT_MRN = PT.PT_MRN JOIN IDB.PATIENT P ON CRDB.PT_MRN = P.PT_MRN WHERE CRDB.PRT_ID = '12-245' AND COALESCE(REG_ID, '') IN ('100', '300') AND CRNT_ELGBL_STATUS_DSCRP NOT IN ('Ineligible', 'Cancel') GROUP BY TRIM(CRDB.PT_MRN), PT.LAST_NAME, PT.FIRST_NAME, YEAR(CURRENT date - P.PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH), CASE WHEN PT_DEATH_IND IN ('X', 'C', 'D') THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END, CRDB.PRT_ID HAVING ((MAX(CASE WHEN REG_ID = '100' THEN CRDB.PHYSICIAN_OF_RECORD END) IN ('JONES, DAVID R', 'ADUSUMILLI, PRASAD', 'HUANG, JAMES', 'BAINS, MANJIT S', 'ISBELL, JAMES MICHAEL', 'BOTT, MATTHEW', 'DOWNEY, ROBERT J', 'MOLENA, DANIELA', 'SIHAG, SMITA', 'RUSCH, VALERIE W', 'ROCCO, GAETANO', 'PARK, BERNARD J')) OR (MAX(CASE WHEN REG_ID = '300' THEN CRDB.PHYSICIAN_OF_RECORD END) IN ('JONES, DAVID R', 'ADUSUMILLI, PRASAD', 'HUANG, JAMES', 'BAINS, MANJIT S', 'ISBELL, JAMES MICHAEL', 'BOTT, MATTHEW', 'DOWNEY, ROBERT J', 'MOLENA, DANIELA', 'SIHAG, SMITA', 'RUSCH, VALERIE W', 'ROCCO, GAETANO', 'PARK, BERNARD J'))) AND (MAX(CASE WHEN REG_ID = '100' THEN CRDB.CRNT_CONSENT_DATE END) >= '2019-01-01' OR MAX(CASE WHEN REG_ID = '300' THEN CRDB.CRNT_CONSENT_DATE END) >= '2019-01-01')) , IMPACT AS (SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN, PDWS_NAME, PDRX_ACCESSION_NO FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML INNER JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML_SETTINGS ON PDRX_PATH_DMP_RESULTS_XML_ID = PDRXS_PATH_DMP_RESULTS_XML_ID INNER JOIN DVDMC.PATHOLOGY_DMP_WEBSVC_SETTINGS ON PDRXS_SETTING_ID = PDWS_SETTING_ID INNER JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V ON PDRX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID INNER JOIN PTS ON PT_MRN = MRN, XMLTABLE('$c/root/*' PASSING PDRX_XML_VALUE AS "c" COLUMNS SITE1_GENE VARCHAR(100) PATH 'site1_gene', SITE2_GENE VARCHAR(100) PATH 'site2_gene', GENE_ID VARCHAR(100) PATH 'gene_id') T WHERE PDWS_NAME IN ('IMPACT', 'IMPACT GERMLINE SECONDARY') ) SELECT MRN, "Last Name", "First Name", "Deceased", "Part A Registration Date", "Part A Consent Date", "Part A Treating MD", MAX(CASE WHEN PDWS_NAME = 'IMPACT' THEN PDRX_ACCESSION_NO END) "Part A Accession No", "Part C Registration Date", "Part C Consent Date", "Part C Treating MD", MAX(CASE WHEN PDWS_NAME = 'IMPACT GERMLINE SECONDARY' THEN PDRX_ACCESSION_NO END) "Part C Resulted Accession No" FROM PTS LEFT JOIN IMPACT ON MRN = PT_MRN GROUP BY MRN, "Last Name", "First Name", "Deceased", "Part A Registration Date", "Part A Consent Date", "Part A Treating MD", "Part C Registration Date", "Part C Consent Date", "Part C Treating MD" ;

prompt: List of all patients who signed consent for protocol 19-292 or 21-329 in the previous 48 hours.
completion: SELECT DISTINCT ACD_MRN, PRO_IRB_NO, ACD_CONS_DTE AS CONSENT_DTE, AC_CONS_STAFF_NAME, AC_CONS_DTE FROM IDB.PROTOCOL JOIN IDB.ACCRUALS_DATES ON PRO_IRB_NO = ACD_IRB_NO JOIN IDB.ACCRUALS ON ACD_MRN = AC_MRN WHERE 1 = 1 AND PRO_IRB_NO IN ('19-292', '21-329') AND AC_CONS_DTE = ACD_CONS_DTE AND ACD_CONS_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT DATE AND CURRENT DATE - 14 DAYS ORDER BY ACD_CONS_DTE DESC, AC_CONS_DTE DESC

prompt: Provide a list by outpatient chemotherapy infusion site of the volume of specific drugs that were completed in EMAR by drug infusion duration.
completion: WITH ETO AS (SELECT IP_OP_IND, VISIT_GUID, CURR_LOC, MRN, ORD_GUID, SRX_ORD_ID , ORD_NAME, START_DATE, DRUG_NAME, DOSE, DOSE_UOM, INFUSION_RATE, BILLED_COST FROM IDB.SRX_PHARMACY_SUM WHERE START_DATE BETWEEN '2018-09-01' AND '2019-09-30' AND (UPPER(DRUG_NAME) LIKE 'PACLITAXEL%' OR UPPER(DRUG_NAME) LIKE 'DOCETAXEL%' OR UPPER(DRUG_NAME) LIKE 'ALBUM%B%PACLITAXEL%') AND IP_OP_IND = 'O' ) SELECT MRN, START_DATE, ORD_GUID, ORD_NAME, CURR_LOC, DRUG_NAME, DOSE, DOSE_UOM , INFUSION_RATE, ORD_ROUTE, TASK_STS, CASE WHEN DATE(MOA_START) = DATE(MOA_END) THEN (INTEGER((TIME(MOA_END) - TIME(MOA_START))/10000)*60) + (INTEGER (TIME(MOA_END) - TIME(MOA_START)) - (INTEGER((TIME(MOA_END) - TIME(MOA_START))/10000)*10000))/100 WHEN DATE(MOA_START) < DATE(MOA_END) THEN ((INTEGER((TIME('24.00.00') -TIME(MOA_START))/10000)*60) + (INTEGER (TIME('24.00.00') -TIME(MOA_START)) - (INTEGER((TIME('24.00.00') -TIME(MOA_START))/10000)*10000))/100) + ((INTEGER((TIME(MOA_END) -TIME('00.00.00'))/10000)*60) + (INTEGER (TIME(MOA_END) -TIME('00.00.00')) - (INTEGER((TIME(MOA_END) -TIME('00.00.00'))/10000)*10000))/100) + CASE WHEN DATE(MOA_START + 2 DAYS) = DATE(MOA_END) THEN 1*(24*60) WHEN DATE(MOA_START + 3 DAYS) = DATE(MOA_END) THEN 2*(24*60) WHEN DATE(MOA_START + 4 DAYS) = DATE(MOA_END) THEN 3*(24*60) WHEN DATE(MOA_START + 5 DAYS) = DATE(MOA_END) THEN 4*(24*60) WHEN DATE(MOA_START + 6 DAYS) = DATE(MOA_END) THEN 5*(24*60) ELSE 0 END ELSE 0 END AS ACTUAL_ADMIN_MINUTES FROM (SELECT MRN, START_DATE, ORD_GUID, ORD_NAME, CURR_LOC, DRUG_NAME, DOSE, DOSE_UOM, INFUSION_RATE, MAX(OOTO_TASK_ROUTE_CD) AS ORD_ROUTE, MAX(OOTO_BODY_SITE) AS BODY_SITE, OCIT_PERF_POL_NAME AS ORD_POL, OCIT_REV_CAT_CD AS ORD_REV, MAX(OOTO_STATUS_CD) AS TASK_STS, CASE WHEN MAX(OOTO_TASK_ROUTE_CD) = 'IVCI' THEN MIN(OOTO_PERF_TO_DT) ELSE MIN(OOTO_PERF_FROM_DT) END AS MOA_START, VALUE(MAX(CASE WHEN OCIT_TASK_TYP_GUID = '9000001005102870' THEN OOTO_PERF_FROM_DT END), MAX(OOTO_PERF_TO_DT), MAX(OOTO_PERF_FROM_DT)) AS MOA_END FROM ETO INNER JOIN IDB.OAS_ORD_TASK_OCCR ON OOTO_ORD_GUID = ORD_GUID AND OOTO_MRN = MRN AND OOTO_STATUS_CD = 'Performed' AND OOTO_PERF_FROM_DTE = START_DATE INNER JOIN IDB.OAS_CTLG_ITEM_TASK ON OOTO_CAT_ITEM_GUID = OCIT_GUID WHERE DATE(OOTO_PERF_FROM_DT) = START_DATE GROUP BY MRN, START_DATE, DRUG_NAME, DOSE, DOSE_UOM, INFUSION_RATE, ORD_GUID, ORD_NAME, CURR_LOC, OCIT_PERF_POL_NAME, OCIT_REV_CAT_CD) AS A

prompt: Identify patients with invasive lobular carcinoma, alveolar type.

prompt: Provide Notes, Order, EMR, protocol, and demographic data for Drs. Adam Schoenfeld and Andrew Chow since May, 2020.
completion: WITH EMR_INFO AS (SELECT A.EAD_MRN, A.EAD_DOCUMENT_DTE, A.EAD_CREATE_DTE, A.EAD_TOT_PAGES, A.EAD_EXTERNAL_SYSTEM_NAME , CASE WHEN EAD_DOCTOR_NUM IN ('826559', '026559') THEN 'Andrew Chow' WHEN EAD_DOCTOR_NUM IN ('026518' , '518' , '826518' , '726518' , '126518') THEN 'Adam Schoenfeld' ELSE 'unknown' END AS "Doctor" , B.EADT_DOCTYPE, B.EADT_EMR_DESC, B.EADT_CATEGORY, B.EADT_DOC_LEVEL FROM IDB.EMR_AA_DOCUMENT A JOIN IDB.EMR_AA_DOCTYPE B ON A.EAD_DOCTYPE=B.EADT_DOCTYPE WHERE A.EAD_RIGHT_ID = 167 AND A.EAD_DOCUMENT_DTE >= '5/1/2020' AND A.EAD_DOCTOR_NUM IN ('826559' , '026559' , '026518' , '518' , '826518' , '726518' , '126518') ) , PROTOCOL_PRE AS (SELECT DISTINCT "t1"."PT_MRN" AS "MRN", "t2"."PRO_IRB_NO" AS "IRB Number", "t2"."PRO_IRB_TITLE" AS "IRB Title", "t3"."AC_CONS_DTE" AS "Consent Date", "t3"."AC_OFF_STUDY_DTE" AS "Off Study Date", "t3"."AC_TX_STRT_DTE" AS "Treatment Start Date", "t3"."AC_TX_END_DTE" AS "Treatment End Date" FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS" "t1" JOIN EMR_INFO ON EAD_MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED" "t4" ON "t1"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t4"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" JOIN "DV"."ACCRUALS" "t3" ON "t4"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t3"."AC_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PROTOCOL" "t2" ON "t3"."AC_PROTOCOL_ID" = "t2"."PRO_PROTOCOL_ID") , PROTOCOLS_LISTAGG AS (SELECT MRN AS PRO_MRN, LISTAGG(COALESCE(TRIM("IRB Number"), '') || ' | ' || COALESCE(TRIM(CAST("Consent Date" AS VARCHAR(12000))), '') || COALESCE(CASE WHEN "Off Study Date" IS NOT NULL THEN ' off: ' || CAST("Off Study Date" AS VARCHAR(12000)) END, '') || COALESCE(CASE WHEN "Treatment Start Date" IS NOT NULL THEN ' tx start: ' || CAST("Treatment Start Date" AS VARCHAR(12000)) END, '') || COALESCE(CASE WHEN "Treatment End Date" IS NOT NULL THEN ' tx end: ' || CAST("Treatment End Date" AS VARCHAR(12000)) END, '') , CHR(13) || CHR(10)) WITHIN GROUP( ORDER BY MRN, "Consent Date") AS "Protocols" FROM PROTOCOL_PRE GROUP BY MRN) SELECT E.* , "Protocols" , PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID AS PID, PT_LAST_NAME AS "Last Name", PT_FIRST_NAME AS "First Name", PT_BIRTH_DTE AS "Date of Birth", PT_DEATH_DTE AS "Deceased Date", CASE WHEN PT_DEATH_DTE IS NULL THEN YEAR(CURRENT date - PT_BIRTH_DTE) END AS "Cur Age", PT_VITAL_STATUS AS "Vital Status", PT_SEX_DESC AS "Gender" FROM EMR_INFO E LEFT JOIN PROTOCOLS_LISTAGG ON PRO_MRN = EAD_MRN JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON PT_MRN = EAD_MRN ORDER BY 1, 2, 3, 4 ;

prompt: Provide a list of patients with head/neck cancer since 1996 who had surgery and not radiation therapy.
completion: SELECT PT_MRN AS "MRN", PT_LAST_NAME AS "Last Name", PT_FIRST_NAME AS "First Name", PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH AS "Date of Birth", PT_DATE_OF_DEATH AS "Date of Death", PT_SEX AS "Sex", TM_DX_DTE AS "Tumor Diagnosis Date", CC.AV_DESC AS "Class of Case", TM_HIST_CD AS "ICD-O Histology Code", H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS "ICD-O Histology Description", TM_SITE_CD "ICD-O Site Code", S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS "ICD-O Site Description", TM_FIRST_RECUR_DTE "First Recurrence Date", TM_RAD_STRT_DTE AS "Rad Therapy Start Date", TM_RAD_END_DTE "Rad Therapy End Date", TM_CA_SURG_DTE "Cancer Surgery Date", TM_SURG_DEF_DTE AS "Definitive Cancer Surgery Date", CASE WHEN TM_CA_SURG_03 = '' THEN '' WHEN TM_CA_SURG_03 = '00' THEN 'None' ELSE A.AVSITE_DESC END AS "Surgery Description", CASE WHEN TM_CA_SURG_03_MSK = '' THEN '' WHEN TM_CA_SURG_03_MSK = '00' THEN 'None' ELSE B.AVSITE_DESC END AS "MSK Surgery Description", PLA_LST_SURG_DTE "Last MSK Surgery Date" FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON TM_MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD LEFT JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS CS ON CS.AV_ELEMENT = 'CASE_STS' AND CS.AV_CODE = TM_CASE_STS LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS CC ON CC.AV_ELEMENT = 'CLASS_OF_CASE' AND CC.AV_CODE = TM_CLASS_OF_CASE JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY ON TM_MRN = PLA_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.CDB_ALLOWVALS_SITE A ON A.AVSITE_ELEMENT = 'CA_SURG_SUM_03' AND A.AVSITE_CODE = TM_CA_SURG_03 AND A.AVSITE_CD_STS = 'A' AND TM_SITE_CD BETWEEN A.AVSITE_LOW_SITE AND A.AVSITE_HIGH_SITE LEFT JOIN IDB.CDB_ALLOWVALS_SITE B ON B.AVSITE_ELEMENT = 'CA_SURG_SUM_03_MSK' AND B.AVSITE_CODE = TM_CA_SURG_03_MSK AND B.AVSITE_CD_STS = 'A' AND TM_SITE_CD BETWEEN B.AVSITE_LOW_SITE AND B.AVSITE_HIGH_SITE WHERE TM_DX_DTE >= '1996-01-01' AND TM_CASE_STS = '3' AND (TM_SITE_CD BETWEEN 'C000' AND 'C148' OR TM_SITE_CD BETWEEN 'C300' AND 'C329') AND NOT TM_SITE_CD BETWEEN 'C110' AND 'C119' AND PLA_LST_RT_DTE IS NULL AND PLA_LST_SURG_DTE IS NOT NULL

prompt: Provide a list of cases scrubbed by Sara Moufarrij in GYN since 1/1/2022.
completion: SELECT DISTINCT OL_LOG_ID, OL_MRN, STRIP(PT_LAST_NAME) || ', ' || STRIP(PT_FIRST_NAME) AS PT_NAME, OL_SURG_DTE, X.OLAS_PNL_NO AS PNL_NO, X.OLAS_SURG_SVC AS SRG_SVC, R_X.CRE_RES_ID AS SURGEON_ID, R_X.CRE_RES_TYP AS RES_TYPE1, R_X.CRE_RES_NAME AS SURGEON, R_Y.CRE_RES_ID AS FELLOW_ID, R_Y.CRE_RES_TYP AS RES_TYPE2, R_Y.CRE_RES_NAME AS FELLOW FROM IDB.OR_LOG JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON OL_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.OR_LOG_ALL_SURG X ON X.OLAS_LOG_ID = OL_LOG_ID AND X.OLAS_SURG_ROLE = 'Primary' JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE R_X ON R_X.CRE_RES_ID = X.OLAS_RES_ID JOIN IDB.OR_LOG_ALL_SURG Y ON Y.OLAS_LOG_ID = X.OLAS_LOG_ID AND Y.OLAS_PNL_NO = X.OLAS_PNL_NO JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE R_Y ON R_Y.CRE_RES_ID = Y.OLAS_RES_ID AND R_Y.CRE_RES_ID = '2236751' WHERE OL_SURG_DTE BETWEEN '2022-01-01' AND CURRENT date AND OL_LOG_STS IN ('Posted', 'Unposted') AND X.OLAS_SURG_SVC = 'GYN'

prompt: Provie a weekly list of breast CA with METS to any site who have been dispensed select hormones.
completion: WITH "cte1" AS (SELECT DXCC_DX_CATALOG_ID, LTRIM(RTRIM(DXCC_ICD_CODE)) DXCC_ICD_CODE, LTRIM(RTRIM(DXCC_ICD_MSK_DESC)) DXCC_ICD_MSK_DESC, LTRIM(RTRIM(DXCC_ICD_CODE)) || ' - ' || LTRIM(RTRIM(DXCC_ICD_MSK_DESC)) AS DXCC_CODE_AND_MSK_DESC, LTRIM(RTRIM(DXCC_ICD_NATIONAL_DESC)) DXCC_ICD_NATIONAL_DESC, DXCC_DESC_LONG, CASE WHEN DXCC_ICD_CODE BETWEEN '196' AND '196.99' OR DXCC_ICD_CODE BETWEEN '197' AND '197.99' OR DXCC_ICD_CODE BETWEEN '198' AND '198.99' THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS DXCC_METS_INDICATOR, DXCC_CREATED_DT, DXCC_CREATED_BY, DXCC_MODIFIED_DT FROM DV.DIAGNOSIS_CATALOG WHERE DXCC_DX_TYPE = 'ICD9' ) SELECT DISTINCT "t5"."PT_MRN" AS "MRN", "t6"."ICSC_SITE_CD" AS "ICD-O Site Code", "t6"."ICSC_ICDO_SITE_MSK_DESC" AS "ICD-O Site Description", "t7"."DXCC_METS_INDICATOR" AS "ICD-9 Final METS CA Indicator", "t8"."DXA_CIC_CDER_INIT" AS "ICD-9 CIC Coded Indicator", "t9"."PINC_GENERIC_NAME" AS "Generic Drug Name", "t10"."DT_YEAR" AS "Last Order Stop Year", "t11"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AS "Deident PT #", "t7"."DXCC_ICD_CODE" AS "ICD-9 Final Dx Code", "t7"."DXCC_ICD_MSK_DESC" AS "ICD-9 Final Dx Description" FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V" "t5" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED" "t11" ON "t5"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t11"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."CDB_TUMOR_V" "t12" ON "t11"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t12"."CDTM_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."ICDO_SITE_CATALOG_V" "t6" ON "t12"."CDTM_SITE_CATALOG_ID" = "t6"."ICSC_SITE_CATALOG_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DIAGNOSIS_FINAL_ALL_V" "t8" ON "t11"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t8"."PDX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "cte1" "t7" ON "t8"."PDX_DX_CATALOG_ID" = "t7"."DXCC_DX_CATALOG_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PHM_PT_MEDS_MQT" "t13" ON "t11"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t13"."POD_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PHM_ORDER_DTL" "t14" ON "t13"."POD_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t14"."POD_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AND "t13"."POD_PHARMA_INVENTORY_CTLG_ID" = "t14"."POD_PHARMA_INVENTORY_CTLG_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PHM_INVENTORY_CATALOG" "t9" ON "t14"."POD_PHARMA_INVENTORY_CTLG_ID" = "t9"."PINC_INVENTORY_CTLG_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" "t10" ON "t13"."LAST_STOP_DATE_ID" = "t10"."DT_DATE_ID" WHERE ("t6"."ICSC_SITE_CD" IN ('C500', 'C501', 'C502', 'C503', 'C504', 'C505', 'C506', 'C508', 'C509') AND ("t7"."DXCC_METS_INDICATOR" = 'Yes' AND ("t8"."DXA_CIC_CDER_INIT" = 'YES' AND (UPPER("t9"."PINC_GENERIC_NAME") IN ('ANASTROZOLE', 'ANASTROZOLE', 'LETROZOLE', 'LETROZOLE', 'EXEMESTANE', 'EXEMESTANE', 'EVEROLIMUS', 'EVEROLIMUS (RAD001)') AND ("t10"."DT_YEAR" >= 2013 AND (1 = 1 AND "t11"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" NOT IN (SELECT "t1"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AS "Deident PT #" FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED" "t1" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PHM_PT_MEDS_MQT" "t2" ON "t1"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t2"."POD_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PHM_ORDER_DTL" "t3" ON "t2"."POD_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t3"."POD_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AND "t2"."POD_PHARMA_INVENTORY_CTLG_ID" = "t3"."POD_PHARMA_INVENTORY_CTLG_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PHM_INVENTORY_CATALOG" "t4" ON "t3"."POD_PHARMA_INVENTORY_CTLG_ID" = "t4"."PINC_INVENTORY_CTLG_ID" WHERE UPPER("t4"."PINC_GENERIC_NAME") IN ('FULVESTRANT', 'FULVESTRANT') )))))))

prompt: Daily report of patients on restricted IV OPIOID PCAs from July 2020 till January 2021.
completion: SELECT OO_MRN CIS_MRN, OO_ACCT_NO CIS_ACCT_NO, OO_ORD_ID ORDER_ID , OO_ORD_GUID ORD_GUID , STRIP(PT_LAST_NAME)||', '||STRIP(PT_FIRST_NAME) PT_NAME , OO_ENTER_DTE ENTER_DATE, OO_ENTER_DT ENTER_DT , STRIP(OO_ORD_NAME)||' '||STRIP(OO_ORD_MODIFIER) ITEM_NAME , OO_REQUESTED_DTE REQUESTED_DATE, OO_STOP_DTE STOP_DATE , STRIP(OO_ORD_STS_CD)||' - '||OSTS_STS_DESC STATUS , OO_SUMMARY_LINE ORD_SUMMARY, OO_REQ_TME_PRIO TIME_PRIORITY , OMD_ORD_ROUTE ORD_ROUTE, OU_DISPLAY_NAME REQUESTER_NAME , OU_ORD_ROLE_TYPE REQUESTER_ROLE, DOC_SVC , OCV_IP_OP_IND PT_TYPE, OCV_CURR_LOC CURR_LOC , DECIMAL(COALESCE(NULLIF(RTRIM(DD.OUD_USER_DI_VALUE), ''), '0'), 7, 2) DEMAND_DOSE , DECIMAL(COALESCE(NULLIF(RTRIM(BR.OUD_USER_DI_VALUE), ''), '0'), 7, 2) BASAL_RATE , UOM.OUD_USER_DI_VALUE UOM FROM IDB.OMS_ORDER JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PT_MRN = OO_MRN JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_CATALOG ON OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID = OOC_MSTR_ITEM_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_STATUS ON OO_ORD_STS_CD = OSTS_ORD_STS_CD JOIN IDB.OMS_CLIENT_VISIT ON OCV_VISIT_GUID = OO_VISIT_GUID LEFT JOIN IDB.DOC ON DOC_DR_NO = OO_REQ_DR_NO JOIN IDB.OMS_USER PVD ON OU_USER_GUID = OO_PVDR_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_MED_DETAIL ON OMD_ORD_GUID = OO_ORD_GUID LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_USER_DATA DD ON OO_ORD_GUID = DD.OUD_ORD_GUID AND DD.OUD_USER_DI_CD IN ('Rx - Epi Demand Dose', 'Rx - PCA IV Dilaudid Demand') LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_USER_DATA UOM ON OO_ORD_GUID = UOM.OUD_ORD_GUID AND UOM.OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'Rx_PCA IV_ContInfUOM' LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_USER_DATA BR ON OO_ORD_GUID = BR.OUD_ORD_GUID AND BR.OUD_USER_DI_CD IN('Rx - Epi Cont Infus Rate', 'Rx - PCA IV Dilaudid Cont Inf') WHERE OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE BETWEEN LAST_DAY(CURRENT DATE - 2 MONTH) + 1 DAY AND LAST_DAY(CURRENT DATE - 1 MONTH) AND OO_ORD_STS_CD NOT IN ('CANC', 'CANP', 'AUC3') AND OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID IN ('1000004130073029', '1000004737073029', '4000003649073029', '5000003649073029', '7000003649073029', '8000003649073029', '9000006098100730') AND UCASE(OO_ORD_NAME) LIKE '%IV PCA%' AND CASE WHEN UCASE(OO_ORD_NAME) LIKE 'FENTANYL IV PCA%' AND(DECIMAL(COALESCE(NULLIF(RTRIM(DD.OUD_USER_DI_VALUE), ''), '0'), 7, 2) > 50 OR DECIMAL(COALESCE(NULLIF(RTRIM(BR.OUD_USER_DI_VALUE), ''), '0'), 7, 2) > 50) THEN 'Y' WHEN UCASE(OO_ORD_NAME) LIKE 'HYDROMORPHONE IV PCA%' AND(DECIMAL(COALESCE(NULLIF(RTRIM(DD.OUD_USER_DI_VALUE), ''), '0'), 7, 2) > 0.4 OR DECIMAL(COALESCE(NULLIF(RTRIM(BR.OUD_USER_DI_VALUE), ''), '0'), 7, 2) > 0.4) THEN 'Y' WHEN UCASE(OO_ORD_NAME) LIKE 'MORPHINE SULFATE IV PCA%' AND(DECIMAL(COALESCE(NULLIF(RTRIM(DD.OUD_USER_DI_VALUE), ''), '0'), 7, 2) > 3 OR DECIMAL(COALESCE(NULLIF(RTRIM(BR.OUD_USER_DI_VALUE), ''), '0'), 7, 2) > 3) THEN 'Y' WHEN UCASE(OO_ORD_NAME) LIKE 'METHADONE IV PCA%' AND(DECIMAL(COALESCE(NULLIF(RTRIM(DD.OUD_USER_DI_VALUE), ''), '0'), 7, 2) > 5 OR DECIMAL(COALESCE(NULLIF(RTRIM(BR.OUD_USER_DI_VALUE), ''), '0'), 7, 2) > 5) THEN 'Y' WHEN UCASE(OO_ORD_NAME) LIKE 'OXYMORPHONE IV PCA%' AND(DECIMAL(COALESCE(NULLIF(RTRIM(DD.OUD_USER_DI_VALUE), ''), '0'), 7, 2) > 1 OR DECIMAL(COALESCE(NULLIF(RTRIM(BR.OUD_USER_DI_VALUE), ''), '0'), 7, 2) > 1) THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END = 'Y'

prompt: Provide a daily report for upcoming appointments for 12-245 patients and a weekly report for 12-245 patients with missing orders/accession dates
completion: WITH PTS AS (SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN TM_MRN FROM DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS JOIN DV.CDB_TUMOR_V ON CDTM_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID JOIN DV.DATE_V ON CDTM_DX_DATE_ID = DT_DATE_ID JOIN DV.DIAGNOSIS_CODE_CAT_ICDO_V ON CDTM_DX_CATALOG_ID = DXCC_DX_CATALOG_ID JOIN DV.ICDO_SITE_CATALOG_V ON CDTM_SITE_CATALOG_ID = ICSC_SITE_CATALOG_ID JOIN DV.TUMOR_CASE_ATTRIBUTES_V ON CDTM_CASE_ATTR_ID = TUMOR_CASE_ATTR_ID JOIN DV.SEERGROUPING ON DV.SEERF_ICDO(ICSC_SITE_CD, DXCC_ICD_CODE) = RECODE WHERE CATEGORY2 IN ('Esophagus', 'Stomach') ) , IRB AS (SELECT PT_MRN IRB_MRN, AC_CONS_DTE FROM PTS JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V ON TM_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN DV.ACCRUALS ON PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = AC_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID JOIN DV.PROTOCOL ON AC_PROTOCOL_ID = PRO_PROTOCOL_ID WHERE PRO_IRB_NO = '12-245' ) SELECT PT_MRN AS "MRN", PT_LAST_NAME "Last Name", PT_FIRST_NAME "First Name", DT_DTE AS "Encounter Date", DEPT.EDC_DEPT_DESC AS "Clinical Department", SVC.EDC_DEPT_DESC AS "Clinical Service", ENDP_DEPT_NAME AS "Department Name", ENR_RES_NAME AS "Primary Resource Name" FROM PTS JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V ON TM_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN DV.PATIENT_ENCOUNTER ON PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PENC_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID JOIN DV.DATE ON PENC_ENC_DATE_ID = DT_DATE_ID JOIN DV.ENCOUNTER_DEPARTMENT ON PENC_DEPT_ID = ENDP_ENC_DEPT_ID JOIN DV.ENCOUNTER_SCHD_RESOURCES ON PENC_PT_ENC_ID = ENSR_PT_ENC_ID AND ENSR_PRIMARY_RES_IND = 'Y' JOIN DV.ENCOUNTER_RESOURCE ON ENSR_RES_ID = ENR_ENC_RES_ID JOIN DV.ENCOUNTER_VISIT_TYPE ON PENC_VISIT_TYPE_ID = ENVT_ENC_VISIT_TYPE_ID LEFT JOIN DV.ENCOUNTER_DESC_CATALOG DEPT ON ENDP_SERVICE_DEPT_GRP_6 = DEPT.EDC_DEPT_ABBREV AND DEPT.EDC_GROUP_ID = '6' LEFT JOIN DV.ENCOUNTER_DESC_CATALOG SVC ON ENDP_SERVICE_SPECIALTY_GRP_8 = SVC.EDC_DEPT_ABBREV AND SVC.EDC_GROUP_ID = '8' LEFT JOIN IRB ON TM_MRN = IRB_MRN WHERE PENC_APPT_STS IN ('Sch') AND DT_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT date AND CURRENT date + 7 DAY AND IRB_MRN IS NULL ; WITH PTS
