DV.DIAGNOSIS_CODE_CAT_ICDO_V ON CDTM_DX_CATALOG_ID = DXCC_DX_CATALOG_ID JOIN DV.ICDO_SITE_CATALOG_V ON CDTM_SITE_CATALOG_ID = ICSC_SITE_CATALOG_ID JOIN DV.TUMOR_CASE_ATTRIBUTES_V ON CDTM_CASE_ATTR_ID = TUMOR_CASE_ATTR_ID JOIN DV.SEERGROUPING ON DV.SEERF_ICDO(ICSC_SITE_CD, DXCC_ICD_CODE) = RECODE WHERE CATEGORY2 IN ('Esophagus', 'Stomach') ) , IRB AS (SELECT TRIM(CRDB.PT_MRN) PT_MRN, PT.LAST_NAME "Last Name", CRDB.PRT_ID "Protocol", MAX(CASE WHEN REG_ID = '100' THEN CRDB.CRNT_CONSENT_DATE END) "Part A Consent Date", MAX(CASE WHEN REG_ID = '100' THEN CRDB.CONSENT_PRFSNL END) "Part A Consenting Professional", MAX(CASE WHEN REG_ID = '100' THEN CRDB.PHYSICIAN_OF_RECORD END) "Part A Treating MD", MAX(CASE WHEN REG_ID = '300' THEN CRDB.CRNT_CONSENT_DATE END) "Part C Consent Date", MAX(CASE WHEN REG_ID = '300' THEN CRDB.CONSENT_PRFSNL END) "Part C Consenting Professional", MAX(CASE WHEN REG_ID = '300' THEN CRDB.PHYSICIAN_OF_RECORD END) "Part C Treating MD" FROM PTS JOIN NN.CRDB_DASH_PT_REG CRDB ON TM_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN NN.CRDB_DASH_PT PT ON CRDB.PRT_ID = PT.PRT_ID AND CRDB.PT_MRN = PT.PT_MRN JOIN IDB.PATIENT P ON CRDB.PT_MRN = P.PT_MRN WHERE CRDB.PRT_ID = '12-245' AND REG_ID IN ('100', '300') AND CRNT_ELGBL_STATUS_DSCRP NOT IN ('Ineligible', 'Cancel') GROUP BY TRIM(CRDB.PT_MRN), PT.LAST_NAME, CRDB.PRT_ID ) SELECT PT_MRN, "Protocol", "Last Name", "Part A Consent Date", "Part A Consenting Professional", "Part A Treating MD", "Part C Consent Date", "Part C Consenting Professional", "Part C Treating MD", OO_ORD_NAME "Order Name", OO_ENTER_DTE "Order Enter Date" FROM IRB LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_ORDER ON PT_MRN = OO_MRN AND OO_ORD_STS_CD NOT IN ('CANC', 'CANP', 'AUC3') AND OO_ORD_NAME IN ('Diag Molecular Path (Solid Tumor) Order', 'Diag Molecular Path (Solid Tumor)Order', ON CDTM_DX_DATE_ID = DT_DATE_ID JOIN DV.DIAGNOSIS_CODE_CAT_ICDO_V ON CDTM_DX_CATALOG_ID = DXCC_DX_CATALOG_ID JOIN DV.ICDO_SITE_CATALOG_V ON CDTM_SITE_CATALOG_ID = ICSC_SITE_CATALOG_ID JOIN DV.TUMOR_CASE_ATTRIBUTES_V ON CDTM_CASE_ATTR_ID = TUMOR_CASE_ATTR_ID JOIN DV.SEERGROUPING ON DV.SEERF_ICDO(ICSC_SITE_CD, DXCC_ICD_CODE) = RECODE WHERE CATEGORY2 IN ('Esophagus', 'Stomach') ) , IRB AS (SELECT TRIM(CRDB.PT_MRN) PT_MRN, PT.LAST_NAME "Last Name", CRDB.PRT_ID "Protocol", MAX(CASE WHEN REG_ID = '100' THEN CRDB.CRNT_CONSENT_DATE END) "Part A Consent Date", MAX(CASE WHEN REG_ID = '100' THEN CRDB.CONSENT_PRFSNL END) "Part A Consenting Professional", MAX(CASE WHEN REG_ID = '100' THEN CRDB.PHYSICIAN_OF_RECORD END) "Part A Treating MD", MAX(CASE WHEN REG_ID = '300' THEN CRDB.PHYSICIAN_OF_RECORD END) "Part C Treating MD" FROM PTS JOIN NN.CRDB_DASH_PT_REG CRDB ON TM_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN NN.CRDB_DASH_PT PT ON CRDB.PRT_ID = PT.PRT_ID AND CRDB.PT_MRN = PT.PT_MRN JOIN Treating MD", OO_ORD_NAME, OO_ENTER_DTE FROM IRB JOIN IDB.OMS_ORDER ON PT_MRN = OO_MRN AND OO_ORD_STS_CD NOT IN ('CANC', 'CANP', 'AUC3') AND OO_ORD_NAME IN ('Diag Molecular Path (Solid Tumor) Order', prompt: Create a report that will list the diagnosis and treatment of primary non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC) and/or pulmonary carcinoid for patients who are at least one year post thoracic surgical resection.
completion: SELECT PT_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, CPP_LANG, PT_ADDR1, PT_ADDR2, PT_CITY, PT_STATE, PT_ZIP_CD, PT_COUNTRY, PT_PHONE, PT_SEX, TM_SITE_CD, TM_SITE_TXT, B.CLM_CLSF_DESC AS SITEDESC, TM_HIST_CD, A.CLM_CLSF_DESC AS HISTOLOGYDESC, CASE WHEN TM_PATH_STG_GRP = '99' OR TM_PATH_STG_GRP = '88' THEN CASE WHEN TM_CLIN_STG_GRP = '88' THEN 'N/A' WHEN TM_CLIN_STG_GRP = '99' THEN 'UNKNOWN' ELSE TM_CLIN_STG_GRP END ELSE TM_PATH_STG_GRP END AS STAGE, DOC_NAME, SSE_SURG_DTE, SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC FROM IDB.PATIENT P INNER JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY PL ON P.PT_MRN = PL.PLA_MRN INNER JOIN IDB.CDB_TUMOR T ON T.TM_MRN = P.PT_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.CLM A ON A.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD LEFT JOIN IDB.CLM B ON B.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD INNER JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT ON SSE_MRN = PT_MRN INNER JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE ON SSE_LOG_ID = SSP_LOG_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_PAS_PATIENT ON CPP_MRN = PT_MRN INNER JOIN IDB.DOC ON SSP_RES_ID = DOC_DR_NO WHERE PLA_DONOT_MAIL_IND <> 'Y' AND TM_SITE_CD IN ('C341', 'C342', 'C343', 'C348', 'C349') AND TM_HIST_CD_GRADE = '3' AND TM_HIST_CD NOT IN ('M8041/3', 'M8043/3', 'M8044/3') AND PT_DEATH_IND = 'A' AND SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD IN ('32440', '32442', '32445', '32480', '32482', '32484', '32486', '32488', '32500', '32501', '32504', '32520', '32522', '32525', '32657', '32663', '32700') AND SSE_SURG_DTE BETWEEN '1/1/2003' AND '10/30/2008' AND PT_MRN NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT SSE_MRN FROM IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT INNER JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE ON SSE_LOG_ID = SSP_LOG_ID WHERE SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD IN ('32440', '32442', '32445', '32480', '32482', '32484', '32486', '32488', '32500', '32501', '32504', '32520', '32522', '32525', '32657', '32663', '32700') AND SSE_SURG_DTE > '10/30/2008' ) ORDER BY PT_LAST_NAME, PT_MRN

DV.DATE R ON R.DT_DATE_ID = PRPT_REPORT_DATE_ID JOIN DV.PATH_RPRT_TYPE_LOOKUP ON PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_CD = PRPT_REPORT_TYPE JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON PRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID JOIN DV.MEDPRO ON PRPT_ORDERING_MEDPRO_ID = MP_MEDPRO_ID WHERE CONTAINS("PRPT_REPORT", '("sarcoma")') = 1 AND PRPT_REPORT IS NOT NULL ) , PTS_F AS (SELECT DISTINCT MRN FROM PTS JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER ON MRN = CPE_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS JOIN IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER ON MRN = CPE_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = BY CPE_MRN ) , PED_SAR_NV AS (SELECT CPE_MRN AS PED_MRN, MIN(CPE_ENC_DTE) AS "First Ped/Sarcoma Appt Date" FROM PTS_F JOIN IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER ON MRN = CPE_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND (CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR LIKE '%NV%' OR CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR LIKE '%IR%') AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 = 'PED' AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 = 'SAR' GROUP BY CPE_MRN ) , MED_PED_SAR_MOST_RECENT AS (SELECT CPE_MRN AS MR_MRN, MAX(CPE_ENC_DTE) AS "First Med/Ped Sarcoma Appt Date" FROM PTS_F JOIN IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER ON MRN = CPE_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 IN ('MED', 'PED') AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 = 'SAR' GROUP BY CPE_MRN ) , PRIM_PHY AS (SELECT CPE_MRN, CRE_RES_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT CPE_ENC_CSN_ID) CNT, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CPE_MRN ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT CPE_ENC_CSN_ID) DESC) RN FROM PTS_F JOIN IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER ON MRN = CPE_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 IN ('MED', 'PED') AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 = 'SAR' AND CRE_RES_TYP = 'Physician' GROUP BY CPE_MRN, CRE_RES_NAME ) , APPTS AS (SELECT CPE_MRN AS "MRN", CPE_ENC_DTE AS "Appt Date", CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 AS "Department", CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 AS "Service", CLD_DEPT_NAME AS "Department Name", CRE_RES_NAME AS "Provider Name", CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR AS "Visit Type" FROM PTS_F JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER ON MRN = CPE_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND PT_DEATH_IND NOT IN ('X', 'C', 'D') AND CPE_ENC_DTE AND CURRENT date - 6 MONTHS AND CURRENT date AND YEAR(CPE_ENC_DTE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) BETWEEN 15 AND 39 AND CRE_RES_NAME IN ('TAP, WILLIAM', 'DICKSON, MARK A', 'GOUNDER, MRINAL M', 'D''ANGELO, SANDRA P') ) SELECT TM_MRN "MRN", PT_LAST_NAME "Last Name", PT_FIRST_NAME "First Name", PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH "DOB", YEAR(CURRENT date - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) "Current Age", PD.PT_BIRTH_YEAR "Year of Birth", YEAR(CURRENT date - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) "Current Age", YEAR(TM_DX_DTE) "Tumor Dx Year", TM_SITE_CD AS "Tumor Site Code", S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS "Tumor Site Desc", TM_HIST_CD AS "Tumor Histology Code", H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS "Tumor Histology Desc", TM_CASE_STS "Case Status", YEAR("First Med/Sarcoma Appt Date") "First Med/Sarcoma Appt Year", YEAR("First Ped/Sarcoma Appt Date") "First Ped/Sarcoma Appt Year" FROM PTS_F JOIN IDB.PATIENT P ON MRN = P.PT_MRN JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS PD ON P.PT_MRN = PD.PT_MRN JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY ON MRN = PLA_MRN JOIN IDB.CDB_TUMOR ON MRN = TM_MRN JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD LEFT JOIN APPTS_AGG AA ON MRN = AA.APPT_MRN LEFT JOIN MED_SAR_NV MED ON MRN = MED.MED_MRN LEFT JOIN PED_SAR_NV PED ON MRN = PED.PED_MRN WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8')

prompt: Provide a review of 2021 inpatient endoscopies performed on a Monday or Tuesday that were subsequently discharged within 48 hours.
completion: SELECT OO_MRN AS "MRN", OO_ORD_STS_CD, OO_SET_NAME, OOC_ITEM_NAME, OO_ENTER_DTE AS "ORDER_ENTERED_DATE", OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE AS "ENDOSCOPY_DATE", CASE WHEN DAYOFWEEK(OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE) = 2 THEN 'Monday' WHEN DAYOFWEEK(OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE) = 3 THEN 'Tuesday' ELSE 'na' END "ENDOSCOPY_DAY", VIS_DSCH_DTE AS "DISCHARGE_DATE", CASE WHEN DAYOFWEEK(VIS_DSCH_DTE) = 1 THEN 'Sunday' WHEN DAYOFWEEK(VIS_DSCH_DTE) = 2 THEN 'Monday' WHEN DAYOFWEEK(VIS_DSCH_DTE) = 3 THEN 'Tuesday' WHEN DAYOFWEEK(VIS_DSCH_DTE) = 4 THEN 'Wednesday' WHEN DAYOFWEEK(VIS_DSCH_DTE) = 5 THEN 'Thursday' WHEN DAYOFWEEK(VIS_DSCH_DTE) = 6 THEN 'Friday' WHEN DAYOFWEEK(VIS_DSCH_DTE) = 7 THEN 'Saturday' ELSE '' END "DISCHARGE_DAY" FROM IDB.OMS_ORDER JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_CATALOG ON OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID = OOC_MSTR_ITEM_GUID LEFT JOIN IDB.VISIT ON VIS_MRN = OO_MRN WHERE 1=1 AND (OOC_ITEM_NAME IN ('Endoscopy Inpatient Request') OR OO_SET_NAME = 'Interventional Radiology') AND VIS_VISIT_STATUS IN ('2', '3') AND VIS_IP_OP_ADJUSTED_IND = 'I' AND OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE BETWEEN VIS_ADM_DTE AND VIS_DSCH_DTE AND OO_ORD_STS_CD NOT IN ('CANP', 'CANC', 'AUC3') AND YEAR(OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE) = '2021' AND DAYOFWEEK(OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE) IN (2, 3)

prompt: Provide a list of patients for the GUP outpatient clinics with one of the following mutations: AR F877L, AR L702H.
completion: WITH PTS AS (SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN "MRN", PDWS_NAME "Test Name", T.* FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML INNER JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT ON PDRX_PATH_RPT_ID = PRPT_PATH_RPT_ID LEFT JOIN DV.DATE DTRPT ON PRPT_REPORT_DATE_ID = DTRPT.DT_DATE_ID LEFT JOIN DV.DATE DTPROCPATHRPT ON PRPT_PROCEDURE_DATE_ID = DTPROCPATHRPT.DT_DATE_ID INNER JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML_SETTINGS ON PDRX_PATH_DMP_RESULTS_XML_ID = PDRXS_PATH_DMP_RESULTS_XML_ID INNER JOIN DVDMC.PATHOLOGY_DMP_WEBSVC_SETTINGS ON PDRXS_SETTING_ID = PDWS_SETTING_ID INNER JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON PDRX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID, XMLTABLE('$c/root/*' PASSING PDRX_XML_VALUE AS "c" COLUMNS VARIANT_TYPE VARCHAR(100) PATH './local-name(.)', VARIANT_CLASS VARCHAR(100) PATH 'variant_class', GENE_ID VARCHAR(100) PATH 'gene_id', EXON_NUM VARCHAR(100) PATH 'exon_num', AA_CHANGE VARCHAR(100) PATH 'aa_change', CDNA_CHANGE VARCHAR(100) PATH 'cDNA_change') T WHERE 1=1 AND GENE_ID = 'AR' AND AA_CHANGE IN ('p.L702H', 'p.F877L') ) , APPT AS (SELECT CPE_MRN AS "NA_MRN", MIN(CPE_ENC_DTE) AS "Next Appt Date" FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Sch') GROUP BY CPE_MRN) SELECT PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, PTS.*, CPE_ENC_DTE AS "Appt Date", CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 AS "Department", CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 AS "Service", CLD_DEPT_NAME AS "Department Name", CRE_RES_NAME AS "Provider Name", CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME AS "Visit Type" FROM PTS JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON "MRN" = PT_MRN AND PT_DATE_OF_DEATH IS NULL LEFT JOIN APPT ON "NA_MRN" = "MRN" LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER ON "MRN" = CPE_MRN AND CPE_ENC_DTE = "Next Appt Date" AND CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Sch') LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID

prompt: Provide a daily list of patients who have been hospitalized and have tested positive for COVID-19
completion: SELECT MRN , LAST_NAME, FIRST_NAME, RESULT, CCV_ADMIT_DT ADMIT_DT, CCV_DISCHARGE_DT DISCHARGE_DT, TIMESTAMP(MIN_IDENTIFIED_DT) COVID_POSITIVE_DATETIME FROM IDB.COVID19_CLIENT_VISIT JOIN IDB.OMS_LOCATION ON CCV_CURRENT_LOCATION_GUID = OL_LOC_GUID JOIN IDB.PATIENT_COVID_INFO_V ON MRN = CCV_MRN WHERE CCV_CARE_LEVEL_CODE <> 'Inpt Schedule' AND CCV_VISIT_STATUS IN ('ADM', 'DSC') AND CCV_VISIT_TYPE = 'Inpatient' AND (RESULT = 'Positive' OR (RESULT = 'Resolved' AND MIN_RESOLVED_PROBLEM_DT > CCV_ADMIT_DT)) AND CCV_ADMIT_DT >= MIN_IDENTIFIED_DT AND (DATE(CCV_ADMIT_DT) >= CURRENT date - 1 DAY OR DATE(CCV_DISCHARGE_DT) >= CURRENT date - 1 DAY)

prompt: Provide all deaths in the hospital within the last 6 months, wherein any orders ordered from the End Of Life Orderset was initiated.
completion: SELECT MRN FROM DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V WHERE 1=2

prompt: Provide a list of HRD positive patients and patients on PARP inhibitors and CDK 4/6 inhibitors
completion: WITH CVR AS (SELECT PDWS_NAME, PT_MRN, PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID DEID, PDRX_ACCESSION_NO, DTRPT.DT_DTE AS REPORTDATE, DTPROCPATHRPT.DT_DTE AS PROCEDUREDATE, TOTAL_NUMBER_VARIANTS, VARIANT_CLASS, SITE1_GENE, SITE2_GENE, GENE_ID, EXON_NUM, AA_CHANGE, CDNA_CHANGE, GENE_FOLD_CHANGE, CASE WHEN GENE_FOLD_CHANGE IS NULL THEN 'N/A' WHEN LEFT(LTRIM(RTRIM(GENE_FOLD_CHANGE)), 1) = '-' THEN 'Deletion' ELSE 'Amplification' END AS AMPLIFICATION_DELETION_INDICATOR, CHROMOSOME, IS_HOTSPOT, CONFIDENCE_CV_ID, TRANSCRIPT_ID, NORMAL_DP, TUMOR_DP, NORMAL_AD, TUMOR_AD, TUMOR_VFREQ, DBSNP_ID, START_POSITION, ALT_ALLELE, REF_ALLELE, MAF_VARIANT_TYPE, MAF_NP_COUNT, MAF_START_POSITION, MAF_END_POSITION, MAF_REF_ALLELE, MAF_ALT_ALLELE, MAF_T_REF_COUNT, MAF_VARIANT_CLASSIFICATION, TMB_COHORT_PERCENTILE, TMB_TT_COHORT, TMBSCORE, TMB_TT_PERCENTILE, TMBCOHORT, ONCOKB_INTERPRETATION, VARIANT_TYPE, GENE_PANEL, PART_DESCRIPTION, DV.REGEXSTR('(S|H|C|M|F|B|DMG)[0-9]{2}[\s|-][0-9]*', XMLCAST(XMLQUERY('$x/root/meta-data/part_description' PASSING PDRX_XML_VALUE AS "x") AS VARCHAR(2000))) AS REFERENCEDACCESSION, PROJECT, SAMPLEID, PATIENTID, TUMOR_TYPE_CODE, TUMOR_TYPE_NAME, IS_METASTASIS, PRIMARY_SITE, METASTASIS_SITE, DT_PROCEDURE, DT_SIGNOUT, DT_ACCESSIONED, DT_ALYS_END_TIME, DT_DMS_START_TIME FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML INNER JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V ON PDRX_PATH_RPT_ID = PRPT_PATH_RPT_ID LEFT JOIN DV.DATE DTRPT ON PRPT_REPORT_DATE_ID = DTRPT.DT_DATE_ID LEFT JOIN DV.DATE DTPROCPATHRPT ON PRPT_PROCEDURE_DATE_ID = DTPROCPATHRPT.DT_DATE_ID INNER JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML_SETTINGS ON PDRX_PATH_DMP_RESULTS_XML_ID = PDRXS_PATH_DMP_RESULTS_XML_ID INNER JOIN DVDMC.PATHOLOGY_DMP_WEBSVC_SETTINGS ON PDRXS_SETTING_ID = PDWS_SETTING_ID INNER JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON PDRX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID, XMLTABLE('$c/root/*' PASSING PDRX_XML_VALUE AS "c" COLUMNS TOTAL_NUMBER_VARIANTS int PATH 'count(../*[not(name()=''meta-data'')])', VARIANT_CLASS VARCHAR(100) PATH 'variant_class', SITE1_GENE VARCHAR(100) PATH 'site1_gene', SITE2_GENE VARCHAR(100) PATH 'site2_gene', GENE_ID VARCHAR(100) PATH 'gene_id', EXON_NUM VARCHAR(100) PATH 'exon_num', AA_CHANGE VARCHAR(100) PATH 'aa_change', CDNA_CHANGE VARCHAR(100) PATH 'cDNA_change', GENE_FOLD_CHANGE VARCHAR(100) PATH 'gene_fold_change', VARIANT_ID VARCHAR(255) PATH 'snp_indel_variant_id|cnv_variant_id|sv_variant_id', CHROMOSOME VARCHAR(100) PATH 'chromosome', IS_HOTSPOT VARCHAR(100) PATH 'is_hotspot', CONFIDENCE_CV_ID VARCHAR(100) PATH 'confidence_cv_id', TRANSCRIPT_ID VARCHAR(100) PATH 'transcript_id', NORMAL_DP VARCHAR(100) PATH 'normal_dp', TUMOR_DP VARCHAR(100) PATH 'tumor_dp', NORMAL_AD VARCHAR(100) PATH 'normal_ad', TUMOR_AD VARCHAR(100) PATH 'tumor_ad', TUMOR_VFREQ VARCHAR(100) PATH 'tumor_vfreq', DBSNP_ID VARCHAR(100) PATH 'dbSNP_id', START_POSITION int PATH 'start_position', ALT_ALLELE VARCHAR(255) PATH 'alt_allele', REF_ALLELE VARCHAR(255) PATH 'ref_allele', TMB_COHORT_PERCENTILE VARCHAR(25) PATH 'tmb_cohort_percentile', TMB_TT_COHORT VARCHAR(25) PATH 'tmb_tt_cohort', TMBSCORE VARCHAR(25) PATH 'tmb_score', TMB_TT_PERCENTILE VARCHAR(25) PATH 'tmb_tt_percentile', TMBCOHORT VARCHAR(25) PATH 'tmb_cohort', ONCOKB_INTERPRETATION VARCHAR(255) PATH 'oncokb_interpretation', VARIANT_TYPE VARCHAR(100) PATH './local-name(.)', GENE_PANEL VARCHAR(100) PATH '../meta-data/gene-panel', PART_DESCRIPTION VARCHAR(2000) PATH '../meta-data/part_description', PROJECT VARCHAR(100) PATH '../meta-data/dmp_alys_task_name', SAMPLEID VARCHAR(100) PATH '../meta-data/dmp_sample_id', PATIENTID VARCHAR(100) PATH '../meta-data/dmp_patient_id', TUMOR_TYPE_CODE VARCHAR(100) PATH '../meta-data/tumor_type_code', TUMOR_TYPE_NAME VARCHAR(255) PATH '../meta-data/tumor_type_name', IS_METASTASIS VARCHAR(10) PATH '../meta-data/is_metastasis', PRIMARY_SITE VARCHAR(255) PATH '../meta-data/primary_site', METASTASIS_SITE VARCHAR(255) PATH '../meta-data/metastasis_site', DT_PROCEDURE VARCHAR(40) PATH '../meta-data/dt_procedure', DT_SIGNOUT VARCHAR(40) PATH '../meta-data/dt_signout', DT_ACCESSIONED VARCHAR(40) PATH '../meta-data/dt_accessioned', DT_ALYS_END_TIME VARCHAR(40) PATH '../meta-data/dt_alys_end_time', DT_DMS_START_TIME VARCHAR(40) PATH '../meta-data/dt_dms_start_time') T CROSS JOIN TABLE(DV.DMP_XML_MAF(VARIANT_TYPE, REF_ALLELE, ALT_ALLELE, START_POSITION, TUMOR_DP, TUMOR_AD, VARIANT_CLASS)) WHERE 1=1 AND GENE_ID IN ('BRCA1', 'BRCA2', 'PALB2', 'RAD51B', 'RAD51C', 'CHEK2', 'ATR', 'ATM') ) SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN MRN, PDRX_ACCESSION_NO ACCESSION_NO, PDWS_NAME METHOD, PROCEDUREDATE PROCEDURE_DATE, TUMOR_TYPE_CODE, PRIMARY_SITE, GENE_ID, EXON_NUM, AA_CHANGE , CDNA_CHANGE, GENE_PANEL FROM CVR JOIN DV.ACCRUALS ON DEID = AC_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID JOIN DV.PROTOCOL ON AC_PROTOCOL_ID = PRO_PROTOCOL_ID AND PRO_IRB_NO IN ('12-245', '06-107') ; SELECT APR_MRN MRN, CDG_THERAPEUTIC_CATEGORY THERAPEUTIC_CATEGORY, CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME DRUG_NAME, MIN(APR_START_DTE) FIRST_START_DATE, MAX(APR_END_DTE) LAST_END_DATE FROM IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX_V JOIN IDB.ACCRUALS_DATES ON APR_MRN = ACD_MRN AND ACD_IRB_NO IN ('12-245', '06-107') WHERE CDG_THERAPEUTIC_CATEGORY IN ('antineoplastics | PARP inhibitors', 'antineoplastics | CDK 4/6 inhibitors') GROUP BY APR_MRN, CDG_THERAPEUTIC_CATEGORY, CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME ;

prompt: CPT codes for patients who have undergone duodenal stenting followed by endoscopic  biliary stenting or interventional radiology biliary stenting/ external biliary catheter insertion
completion: WITH DUODENAL_STENT AS (SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN, OL_SURG_DTE, COALESCE(PBC_CPT_CD, MN.CPX_PROC_CD) AS DUO_CPT_CODE, DAYS(VIS_DSCH_DTE) - DAYS(VIS_ADM_DTE) AS LENGTH_OF_STAY FROM IDB.OR_LOG JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PT_MRN=OL_MRN JOIN IDB.OR_LOG_ALL_SURG ON OLAS_LOG_ID = OL_LOG_ID AND OLAS_SURG_ROLE = 'Primary' LEFT JOIN IDB.VISIT_V ON VIS_MRN = OL_MRN AND OL_SURG_DTE BETWEEN VIS_ADM_DTE - 1 DAY AND COALESCE(VIS_DSCH_DTE, CURRENT DATE) JOIN IDB.OR_LNLG_DX ON OLLD_LOG_ID = OLAS_LOG_ID AND OLLD_DX_PROC_PNL = OLAS_PNL_NO JOIN IDB.OR_PROC ON OLLD_DX_OR_PROC = OP_OR_PROC_ID AND OP_OR_PROC_ID <> '4820' JOIN IDB.OR_CL_PROC ON OP_OR_PROC_ID = OCP_OR_PROC_ID JOIN IDB.CL_PROC MN ON OCP_PROC_ID = MN.CPX_PROC_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_PROC IX ON OLLD_DX_CPT2_ID = IX.CPX_PROC_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.PBD_CODE ON PBC_PBD_CD = IX.CPX_PROC_CD WHERE OL_LOG_STS_CD NOT IN ('4', '6') AND COALESCE(PBC_CPT_CD, MN.CPX_PROC_CD) IN ('43256', '43266', '44370', '44379') ), ERCP_OR_IR_BILI AS (SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN, OL_SURG_DTE, COALESCE(PBC_CPT_CD, MN.CPX_PROC_CD) AS ERCP_IR_CPT_CODE, DAYS(VIS_DSCH_DTE) - DAYS(VIS_ADM_DTE) AS ERCP_IR_LENGTH_OF_STAY FROM IDB.OR_LOG JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PT_MRN=OL_MRN JOIN IDB.OR_LOG_ALL_SURG ON OLAS_LOG_ID = OL_LOG_ID AND OLAS_SURG_ROLE = 'Primary' LEFT JOIN IDB.VISIT_V ON VIS_MRN = OL_MRN AND OL_SURG_DTE BETWEEN VIS_ADM_DTE - 1 DAY AND COALESCE(VIS_DSCH_DTE, CURRENT DATE) JOIN IDB.OR_LNLG_DX ON OLLD_LOG_ID = OLAS_LOG_ID AND OLLD_DX_PROC_PNL = OLAS_PNL_NO JOIN IDB.OR_PROC ON OLLD_DX_OR_PROC = OP_OR_PROC_ID AND OP_OR_PROC_ID <> '4820' JOIN IDB.OR_CL_PROC ON OP_OR_PROC_ID = OCP_OR_PROC_ID JOIN IDB.CL_PROC MN ON OCP_PROC_ID = MN.CPX_PROC_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_PROC IX ON OLLD_DX_CPT2_ID = IX.CPX_PROC_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.PBD_CODE ON PBC_PBD_CD = IX.CPX_PROC_CD WHERE OL_LOG_STS_CD NOT IN ('4', '6') AND COALESCE(PBC_CPT_CD, MN.CPX_PROC_CD) BETWEEN '43235' AND '43259' AND COALESCE(PBC_CPT_CD, MN.CPX_PROC_CD) <> '43246' ) SELECT DISTINCT DUO.PT_MRN, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH AS "DATE OF BIRTH", PT_SEX, AV_DESC AS "RACE", LISTAGG(TRIM(TM_SITE_CD), '|') WITHIN GROUP( ORDER BY TM_DX_DTE) AS "TUMOR SITE CODE", LISTAGG(CAST(TRIM(S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK) AS VARCHAR(32000)), '|') WITHIN GROUP( ORDER BY TM_DX_DTE) AS "TUMOR SITE DESC", DUO.OL_SURG_DTE AS "DUODENAL SURGERY DATE", IR.OL_SURG_DTE AS ERCP_IR_SURG_DATE, PT_DATE_OF_DEATH, LENGTH_OF_STAY AS "LENGTH OF HOSPITAL STAY DURING DUODENAL", ERCP_IR_LENGTH_OF_STAY AS "LENGTH OF HOSPITAL STAY DURING ERCP / IR" FROM DUODENAL_STENT DUO JOIN ERCP_OR_IR_BILI IR ON IR.PT_MRN=DUO.PT_MRN AND DUO.OL_SURG_DTE < IR.OL_SURG_DTE JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON DUO.PT_MRN=IDB.PATIENT.PT_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.CDB_TUMOR ON TM_MRN=DUO.PT_MRN JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS ON AV_ELEMENT='RACE' AND PT_RACE=AV_CODE GROUP BY DUO.PT_MRN, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, PT_SEX, AV_DESC, DUO.OL_SURG_DTE, IR.OL_SURG_DTE, PT_DATE_OF_DEATH, LENGTH_OF_STAY, ERCP_IR_LENGTH_OF_STAY

prompt: We are submitting a retrospective analysis of patients admitted for bleeding who require transfusions, to see if palliative radiation reduces the rate of transfusions needed.
completion: WITH DX AS (SELECT CV_MRN, YEAR(CURRENT DATE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) AS "CURRENT AGE", TRIM(G.AV_DESC) AS GENDER, TRIM(R.AV_DESC) AS RACE, TRIM(E.AV_DESC) AS ETHNICITY, PT_DATE_OF_DEATH "DATE OF DEATH", PT_PRIMARY_LANG"PRIMARY LANGUAGE", CV_VISIT_NO, MIN(CV_ADM_DTE) OVER(PARTITION BY CV_VISIT_NO) AS CV_ADM_DTE, MIN(TIMESTAMP(CV_ADM_DTE, CV_ADM_TME)) OVER(PARTITION BY CV_VISIT_NO) AS CV_ADM_DT, MAX(CV_DSCH_DTE) OVER(PARTITION BY CV_VISIT_NO) AS CV_DSCH_DTE, MAX(TIMESTAMP(CV_DSCH_DTE, CV_DSCH_TME)) OVER(PARTITION BY CV_VISIT_NO) AS CV_DSCH_DT, CV_CTC_VISIT_TYPE, CC_CLSF_TYPE, D.AV_DESC AS DX_TYPE, CC_CLSF_CD AS DX_CODE, CLM_CLSF_DESC AS DX_DESC, CV_RMS_VISIT_TYPE, INS1.INS_PLAN_PRIO INS1_PRIO, INS1.INS_PLAN_CD INS1_CD, INS1.INS_PLAN_DESC INS1_DESC, INS2.INS_PLAN_PRIO INS2_PRIO, INS2.INS_PLAN_CD INS2_CD, INS2.INS_PLAN_DESC INS2_DESC, INS3.INS_PLAN_PRIO INS3_PRIO, INS3.INS_PLAN_CD INS3_CD, INS3.INS_PLAN_DESC INS3_DESC FROM IDB.CTC_VISIT JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PT_MRN = CV_MRN AND YEAR(CURRENT DATE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) > 18 JOIN IDB.CTC_CLSF ON CV_VISIT_ID = CC_VISIT_ID JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS D ON D.AV_ELEMENT = 'CLSF_TYPE' AND D.AV_CODE = CC_CLSF_TYPE LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS G ON G.AV_CODE = PT_SEX AND G.AV_ELEMENT = 'SEX' LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS R ON R.AV_CODE = PT_RACE AND R.AV_ELEMENT = 'RACE' LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS E ON E.AV_CODE = PT_PT_ETHNICITY AND E.AV_ELEMENT = 'PT_ETHNICITY' LEFT JOIN IDB.INSURANCE INS1 ON INS1.INS_MRN = PT_MRN AND INS1.INS_PLAN_PRIO = '1' AND INS1.INS_VERIFY_IND = 'Y' LEFT JOIN IDB.INSURANCE INS2 ON INS2.INS_MRN = PT_MRN AND INS2.INS_PLAN_PRIO = '2' AND INS2.INS_VERIFY_IND = 'Y' LEFT JOIN IDB.INSURANCE INS3 ON INS3.INS_MRN = PT_MRN AND INS3.INS_PLAN_PRIO = '3' AND INS3.INS_VERIFY_IND = 'Y' WHERE CV_ADM_DTE BETWEEN '2020-01-01' AND '2021-02-15' AND CV_CTC_VISIT_TYPE = 'I' AND CC_CLSF_CD = 'D68.9' ORDER BY CV_ADM_DTE DESC), TRA AS (SELECT BBP_MRN, BBP_TRANSACTION_DTE, BBP_PRODUCT_ABRV, BBP_PRODUCT_DESC, BBP_UNIT_VOLUME, BBP_BLOOD_TYPE FROM IDB.TRANSFUSED_BLOOD_PRODUCTS_V JOIN DX ON BBP_MRN = CV_MRN WHERE BBP_PRODUCT_ABRV = 'RBC' AND BBP_TRANSACTION_DTE BETWEEN '2020-01-01' AND '2021-02-15' ), FN AS (SELECT DISTINCT CV_MRN, "CURRENT AGE", GENDER, RACE, ETHNICITY, "DATE OF DEATH", "PRIMARY LANGUAGE", CV_VISIT_NO, CV_ADM_DTE, CV_ADM_DT, CV_DSCH_DTE, CV_DSCH_DT, DAYS(CV_DSCH_DTE) - DAYS(CV_ADM_DTE) AS "LENGTH OF STAY", CV_CTC_VISIT_TYPE, CC_CLSF_TYPE, DX_TYPE, DX_CODE, DX_DESC, CV_RMS_VISIT_TYPE, INS1_PRIO, INS1_CD, INS1_DESC, INS2_PRIO, INS2_CD, INS2_DESC, INS3_PRIO, INS3_CD, INS3_DESC, BBP_TRANSACTION_DTE, BBP_PRODUCT_ABRV, BBP_PRODUCT_DESC, BBP_UNIT_VOLUME, BBP_BLOOD_TYPE FROM DX JOIN TRA ON DX.CV_MRN = TRA.BBP_MRN) SELECT DISTINCT CV_MRN, CDD_SERVICE_DTE, CAST(CDD_DOCUMENT_FULL_TEXT AS VARCHAR(32000)) AS "DISCHARGE SUMMARY" FROM FN JOIN DV.CLINDOC_FULL_TEXT_V ON CV_MRN = CDD_MRN WHERE CDD_DOC_NAME = 'Discharge Summary' AND CDD_CANCEL_IND = '0' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND = '0' AND (CDD_SERVICE_DTE) BETWEEN '2020-01-01' AND '2021-02-15' ;

prompt: Provide a file containing demographic  information and study IDs for a list of MRNs.
We are requesting to identify patients who have a history of bladder cancer and subsequently developed either uterine or cervical cancer.
completion: WITH UB AS (SELECT DISTINCT PBD_MRN AS UBMRN, MIN(PBD_SVC_DTE) AS UB_DX_DTE FROM IDB.PBD_DTL JOIN IDB.PBD_DX ON DX_INV_NO = PBD_INV_NO AND DX_MRN = PBD_MRN JOIN IDB.CLM ON CLM_CLSF_CD = DX_CLSF_CD AND CLM_CD_TYPE = 'D' JOIN IDB.SEERGROUPING A ON RECODE = MIN(IDB.SEERF_ICD9(CLM_CLSF_CD), IDB.SEERF_ICD10(CLM_CLSF_CD)) WHERE 1=1 AND A.CATEGORY2 = 'Urinary Bladder' GROUP BY PBD_MRN) , GYN AS (SELECT PBD_MRN AS GYNMRN, MIN(PBD_SVC_DTE) AS GYN_DX_DTE FROM UB JOIN IDB.PBD_DTL ON UBMRN = PBD_MRN JOIN IDB.PBD_DX ON DX_INV_NO = PBD_INV_NO AND DX_MRN = PBD_MRN JOIN IDB.CLM ON CLM_CLSF_CD = DX_CLSF_CD AND CLM_CD_TYPE = 'D' JOIN IDB.SEERGROUPING A ON RECODE = MIN(IDB.SEERF_ICD9(CLM_CLSF_CD), IDB.SEERF_ICD10(CLM_CLSF_CD)) WHERE 1=1 AND A.CATEGORY1 IN ('Female Genital System') GROUP BY PBD_MRN) SELECT UBMRN, UB_DX_DTE, GYN_DX_DTE FROM UB JOIN GYN ON UBMRN = GYNMRN AND UB_DX_DTE BETWEEN '2000-01-01' AND '2021-11-30' AND UB_DX_DTE <= GYN_DX_DTE

prompt: Patients prescribed Nivolumab and have had Urogram scans in the last two years
completion: WITH PHARM AS (SELECT PT_MRN AS MRN, PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID AS DEID, PINC_GENERIC_NAME AS "Generic Drug Name", CAT.PINC_CHEMO_IND AS "Chemo Indicator", DT_DTE AS "Order Start Date" FROM DV.PHM_ORDER_DTL DTL JOIN DV.PHM_INVENTORY_CATALOG CAT ON DTL.POD_PHARMA_INVENTORY_CTLG_ID = PINC_INVENTORY_CTLG_ID JOIN DV.DATE_V ON DTL.POD_START_DATE_ID = DT_DATE_ID JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = POD_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID WHERE 1=1 AND LOWER(PINC_GENERIC_NAME) LIKE '%nivolumab%' ) SELECT RRPT_MRN AS "MRN", RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE AS "Performed date", RRPT_DV_PROCESS_DTE AS "Processed date", RRPT_RPT_ID AS "Report ID", RRPT_ACCESSION_NO AS "Accession number", RRPT_ORDER_GROUP AS "Order group", RRPT_PROCEDURE_NAME AS "Procedure name", RRPT_ANC_CODE AS "ANC Code", RRPT_REPORT_TXT AS "Report text" FROM DV.RADIOLOGY_REPORT_V JOIN PHARM ON MRN = RRPT_MRN WHERE "Order Start Date" BETWEEN RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE - 180 DAYS AND RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE + 180 DAYS AND RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE >= '2018-01-01' AND LOWER(RRPT_PROCEDURE_NAME) LIKE '%urogram%'

prompt: Provide diagnosis, pathology, accrual, tissue, and demographic data for patients diagnosed with ALL at or under 18 years, for specific racial criteria.
completion: WITH DXS AS (SELECT MRN , MIN(EFF_DTE) AS MIN_DX_DTE FROM (SELECT CC_MRN AS MRN , CC_EFF_DTE AS EFF_DTE FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF WHERE 1=1 AND CC_CLSF_CD IN ('C91.A' , 'C91.A0' , 'C91.A1' , 'C91.A2' , 'C91.Z' , 'C91.Z0' , 'C91.Z1' , 'C91.Z2' , 'C91.0' , 'C91.00' , 'C91.01' , 'C91.02' , 'C91.3' , 'C91.30' , 'C91.31' , 'C91.32' , 'C91.4' , 'C91.40' , 'C91.41' , 'C91.42' , 'C91.6' , 'C91.60' , 'C91.61' , 'C91.62' , 'C91.9' , 'C91.90' , 'C91.91' , 'C91.92' , 'C95.0' , 'C95.00' , 'C95.01' , 'C95.02' , 'C95.9' , 'C95.90' , 'C95.91' , 'C95.92' , '204.0' , '204.00' , '204.01' , '204.02' , '204.2' , '204.20' , '204.21' , '204.22' , '204.8' , '204.80' , '204.81' , '204.82' , '204.9' , '204.90' , '204.91' , '204.92') AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND (CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR (CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y' AND CC_PT_TYPE = 'O')) UNION SELECT DX_MRN AS MRN , PBD_SVC_DTE AS EFF_DTE FROM IDB.PBD_DX JOIN IDB.PBD_DTL ON DX_MRN = PBD_MRN AND DX_INV_NO = PBD_INV_NO WHERE 1=1 AND DX_CLSF_CD IN ('C91.A' , 'C91.A0' , 'C91.A1' , 'C91.A2' , 'C91.Z' , 'C91.Z0' , 'C91.Z1' , 'C91.Z2' , 'C91.0' , 'C91.00' , 'C91.01' , 'C91.02' , 'C91.3' , 'C91.30' , 'C91.31' , 'C91.32' , 'C91.4' , 'C91.40' , 'C91.41' , 'C91.42' , 'C91.6' , 'C91.60' , 'C91.61' , 'C91.62' , 'C91.9' , 'C91.90' , 'C91.91' , 'C91.92' , 'C95.0' , 'C95.00' , 'C95.01' , 'C95.02' , 'C95.9' , 'C95.90' , 'C95.91' , 'C95.92' , '204.0' , '204.00' , '204.01' , '204.02' , '204.2' , '204.20' , '204.21' , '204.22' , '204.8' , '204.80' , '204.81' , '204.82' , '204.9' , '204.90' , '204.91' , '204.92') ) DX GROUP BY MRN) , PROTOCOL_PRE AS (SELECT DISTINCT "t1"."PT_MRN" AS "MRN", "t2"."PRO_IRB_NO" AS "IRB Number", "t2"."PRO_IRB_TITLE" AS "IRB Title", "t3"."AC_CONS_DTE" AS "Consent Date", "t3"."AC_OFF_STUDY_DTE" AS "Off Study Date", "t3"."AC_TX_STRT_DTE" AS "Treatment Start Date", "t3"."AC_TX_END_DTE" AS "Treatment End Date" FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS" "t1" JOIN DXS ON MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED" "t4" ON "t1"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t4"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" JOIN "DV"."ACCRUALS" "t3" ON "t4"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t3"."AC_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PROTOCOL" "t2" ON "t3"."AC_PROTOCOL_ID" = "t2"."PRO_PROTOCOL_ID") , PROTOCOLS_LISTAGG AS (SELECT MRN AS PRO_MRN, LISTAGG(COALESCE(TRIM("IRB Number"), '') || ' | ' || COALESCE(TRIM(CAST("Consent Date" AS VARCHAR(12000))), '') || ' ' || CASE WHEN "Off Study Date" IS NOT NULL THEN ' off: ' || "Off Study Date" ELSE ' ' END , CHR(13) || CHR(10)) WITHIN GROUP( ORDER BY MRN, "Consent Date") AS "Protocols" FROM PROTOCOL_PRE GROUP BY MRN) , MAIN_POP AS (SELECT MRN , PT_LAST_NAME AS "Last Name" , PT_FIRST_NAME AS "First Name" , PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH AS "Date of Birth" , PT_DATE_OF_DEATH AS "Date of Death" , CASE WHEN PT_DATE_OF_DEATH IS NULL THEN YEAR(CURRENT date - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) END AS "Current Age" , CASE WHEN PT_DATE_OF_DEATH IS NULL THEN 'Alive' ELSE 'Deceased' END AS "Vital Status" , PT_SEX AS "Gender" , PT_RACE , R.AV_DESC AS "Race" , YEAR(MIN_DX_DTE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) AS "Dx Age" , MIN_DX_DTE AS "Min Dx Date" , "Protocols" FROM DXS JOIN AS "Radiology Report Date", "t2"."RRPT_ORDER_GROUP" AS "Radiology Order Group", "t2"."RRPT_PROCEDURE_NAME" AS "Radiology Procedure Name", UPPER(CASE WHEN LENGTH(RRPT_REPORT_TXT) <= 15000 THEN RTRIM(CAST(SUBSTR(RRPT_REPORT_TXT, 1, 15000) AS VARCHAR(15000))) ELSE CAST(SUBSTR(RRPT_REPORT_TXT, 1, 15000) AS VARCHAR(15000)) END) AS "PRPT_REPORT" FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V" "t1" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED" "t3" ON "t1"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t3"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."RADIOLOGY_REPORT_V" "t2" ON "t3"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = prompt: To identify cutaneous plasmacytosis patients and characterize their clinical and laboratory presentation and treatment response.
completion: WITH CLINDOC AS (SELECT CDD_MRN AS MRN, TRIM(PT_LAST_NAME) || ', ' || TRIM(PT_FIRST_NAME) AS PATIENT_NAME, PT_SEX_DESC AS GENDER, CDD_DOC_NAME AS DOCUMENT_NAME, CDD_SERVICE_DTE AS SERVICE_DATE, TRIM(DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)(?<=(^|[\.]))[^\.]*(plasmacytosis|cutaneous plasmacytosis)[^\.]*', CDD_DOCUMENT_FULL_TEXT)) AS TARGET_SENTENCE, CDD_DOCUMENT_FULL_TEXT, 'CLINDOC' AS SOURCE FROM DV.CLINDOC_FULL_TEXT_V JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON CDD_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE 1 = 1 AND CONTAINS(CDD_DOCUMENT_FULL_TEXT, '("plasmacytosis" OR "cutaneous plasmacytosis")') = 1 AND CDD_ENTER_DTE BETWEEN '1966-04-01' AND '2023-04-01' ), PATH_REPORT AS (SELECT A.PT_MRN AS MRN, TRIM(PT_LAST_NAME) || ', ' || TRIM(PT_FIRST_NAME) AS PATIENT_NAME, PT_SEX_DESC AS GENDER, C.PRPT_ACCESSION_NO, C.PRPT_REPORT_TYPE_DESC AS DOCUMENT_NAME, C.PRPT_REPORT, C.PRPT_PROCEDURE_DTE AS SERVICE_DATE, C.PRPT_REPORT_DTE, 'Path Report' AS SOURCE FROM DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS A JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V C ON A.PT_MRN = PRPT_MRN WHERE 1 = 1 AND PRPT_REPORT_TYPE_DESC = 'Surgical Pathology' AND CONTAINS(C."PRPT_REPORT", '("plasmacytosis" OR "cutaneous plasmacytosis")') = 1 AND C.PRPT_REPORT_DTE BETWEEN '1966-04-01' AND '2023-04-01' ) SELECT DISTINCT MRN, SOURCE, PATIENT_NAME, GENDER, '' AS PRPT_ACCESSION_NO, DOCUMENT_NAME, SERVICE_DATE, NULL AS PRPT_REPORT_DTE, TARGET_SENTENCE, CAST(CDD_DOCUMENT_FULL_TEXT AS VARCHAR(32000)), NULL AS PRPT_REPORT FROM CLINDOC UNION ALL SELECT DISTINCT MRN, SOURCE, PATIENT_NAME, GENDER, PRPT_ACCESSION_NO, DOCUMENT_NAME, SERVICE_DATE, PRPT_REPORT_DTE, '' AS TARGET_SENTENCE, NULL AS CDD_DOCUMENT_FULL_TEXT, CAST(PRPT_REPORT AS VARCHAR(32000)) FROM PATH_REPORT

prompt: Provide the number of patients who were 55+ years at diagnosis of Stage 1-3 breast cancer, and are now more than 5 years post-diagnosis with no evidence of disease.
completion: WITH CTE1 AS (SELECT PT_MRN, PT_PT_ETHNICITY AS ETHNICITY, AV_DESC AS RACE, BST_STG_GRP_NAME AS STAGE, CASE WHEN BG_SMOKING_HX = '1' THEN 'YES' WHEN BG_SMOKING_HX = '0' THEN 'NO' WHEN BG_SMOKING_HX = '-1' THEN 'UNKNOWN' ELSE '' END AS SMOKING_HISTORY, CASE WHEN BG_CHEMO_THERAPY = '1' THEN 'YES' WHEN BG_CHEMO_THERAPY = '0' THEN 'NO' WHEN BG_CHEMO_THERAPY = '-1' THEN 'UNKNOWN' ELSE '' END AS CHEMO, CASE WHEN BG_RADIATION = '1' THEN 'YES' WHEN BG_RADIATION = '0' THEN 'NO' WHEN BG_RADIATION = '-1' THEN 'UNKNOWN' ELSE '' END AS RADIATION_THERAPY, CASE WHEN (BP_ESTRG_RCR_CD = '1' OR BP_PRGSTR_RCP_CD = '1') AND BG_HORMONE = '1' THEN '1.YES' WHEN (BP_ESTRG_RCR_CD = '1' OR BP_PRGSTR_RCP_CD = '1') AND BG_HORMONE = '0' THEN '2.NO' WHEN (BP_ESTRG_RCR_CD = '1' OR BP_PRGSTR_RCP_CD = '1') AND BG_HORMONE = '-1' THEN '3.UNKNOWN' ELSE '4.' END AS HORMONAL_THERAPY FROM IDB.PATIENT INNER JOIN IDB.BR_GENERAL ON PT_MRN = BG_MRN INNER JOIN IDB.BR_PT_EVENT ON BG_MRN = BPE_MRN INNER JOIN IDB.BR_PRIMARY ON BPE_MRN = BP_MRN AND BPE_DX_ID = BP_DX_ID AND BPE_PRIM_SEQ_NO = BP_PRIM_SEQ_NO INNER JOIN IDB.BR_STAGING ON BPE_MRN = BST_MRN AND BPE_DX_ID = BST_DX_ID AND BST_AJCC_YEAR = '2002' LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS ON PT_RACE = AV_CODE AND AV_ELEMENT = 'RACE' WHERE BG_DISEAS_STS_DESC = 'NED' AND YEAR(BG_DS_STS_CR_DT - BPE_DX_DT) >= 5 AND (BPE_DX_CD BETWEEN '174' AND '174.9' OR BPE_DX_CD IN ('175.0', '175.9')) AND BP_AGE_AT_DX >= 55 AND BST_STG_GRP_NAME IN ('I', 'IIA', 'IIB', 'IIIA', 'IIIB', 'IIIC') AND BPE_TYP = 1 ) , CTE2 AS (SELECT PT_MRN, MIN(HORMONAL_THERAPY) AS HT FROM CTE1 GROUP BY PT_MRN) SELECT HT, COUNT(DISTINCT PT_MRN) AS HT_COUNT FROM CTE2 GROUP BY HT

prompt: Provide a list of patients with biopsy-proven penile cancer from 2001-2020
completion: WITH DX1 AS (SELECT TM_MRN AS MRN, TM_DX_DTE AS DX_DATE, TM_SITE_CD AS SITE_CODE, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_DESC, TM_HIST_CD AS HIST_CODE, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS HIST_DESC, SM.AV_DESC AS "Smoking Hx" FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM H ON TM_HIST_CD = H.CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON TM_SITE_CD = S.CLM_CLSF_CD LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS SM ON SM.AV_ELEMENT = 'SMOKING_HX' AND SM.AV_CODE = TM_SMOKING_HX WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND TM_SITE_CD IN ('C600', 'C601', 'C602', 'C608', 'C609') AND TM_DX_DTE >= '2001-01-01' UNION SELECT CC_MRN AS MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS DX_DATE, CLM_CLSF_CD AS SITE_CODE, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_DESC, '' AS HIST_CODE, '' AS HIST_DESC, '' AS "Smoking Hx" FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND ((CC_PT_TYPE = 'I') OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) AND CC_CLSF_CD IN ('187.1', '187.2', '187.3', '187.4', 'C60', 'C60.0', 'C60.1', 'C60.2', 'C60.8', 'C60.9') GROUP BY CC_MRN, CLM_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK HAVING MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) >= '2001-01-01') , DX AS (SELECT DISTINCT MRN FROM DX1) , DX AS (SELECT DISTINCT MRN FROM DX1) , SRG AS (SELECT DISTINCT SSE_MRN, SSE_SURG_DTE, SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD, SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC FROM IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT JOIN DX ON SSE_MRN = MRN JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE ON SSE_LOG_ID = SSP_LOG_ID) , CHEMO AS (SELECT DISTINCT APR_MRN, APR_GENERIC_NAME, APR_DRUG_NAME, APR_START_DTE, APR_END_DTE, APR_TOTAL_GIVEN_DOSE, APR_PRESCRIBED_DOSE, APR_DOSE_UOM FROM IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX_V JOIN DX ON APR_MRN = MRN WHERE CDG_CHEMO_FLAG = 'Y' ) , RT AS (SELECT DISTINCT RTC_TX_MRN, RTC_TX_PLAN_NAME, RTC_PRIMARY_REF_POINT, RTC_TX_START_DTE, RTC_TX_STOP_DTE, RTC_TX_ELAPSED_DAYS, RTC_TX_PLANNED_FRACTIONS, RTC_TX_DELIVERED_FRACTIONS, RTC_TX_PLANNED_DOSE, RTC_TX_DELIVERED_DOSE, RTC_DOSE_CORRECTION FROM IDB.RADONC_TREATMENT_COURSE JOIN DX ON RTC_TX_MRN = MRN) , FINAL AS (SELECT MRN, STRIP(PT_LAST_NAME) || ', ' || STRIP(PT_FIRST_NAME) AS NAME, R.AV_DESC AS "Race", E.AV_DESC AS "Ethnicity", PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH AS DOB, PT_DATE_OF_DEATH AS DOD, COALESCE(MAX(PLA_LST_APPT_DTE, PLA_LST_DSCH_DTE), PLA_LST_APPT_DTE, PLA_LST_DSCH_DTE) AS LAST_FU_DATE, DX_DATE, SITE_CODE, SITE_DESC, HIST_CODE, HIST_DESC, "Smoking Hx" FROM DX1 JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY ON MRN = PLA_MRN JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS R ON PT_RACE = R.AV_CODE AND R.AV_ELEMENT = 'RACE' JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS E ON PT_PT_ETHNICITY = E.AV_CODE AND E.AV_ELEMENT = 'PT_ETHNICITY' WHERE MRN IN (SELECT SSE_MRN FROM SRG) OR MRN IN (SELECT APR_MRN FROM CHEMO) OR MRN IN (SELECT RTC_TX_MRN FROM RT) ) SELECT CHEMO.* FROM CHEMO WHERE APR_MRN IN (SELECT MRN FROM FINAL) SELECT CC_MRN, CLM_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS INIT_EFF_DATE FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND ((CC_PT_TYPE = 'I') OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) AND CC_CLSF_CD IN ('079.4', 'B97.7') AND CC_MRN IN () GROUP BY CC_MRN, CLM_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK SELECT DISTINCT "t1"."PT_MRN" AS "MRN", "t2"."RRPT_ACCESSION_NO" AS "Radiology Accession Number", "t2"."RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE" AS "Radiology Performed Date", "t2"."RRPT_REPORT_DTE" AS "Radiology Report Date", "t2"."RRPT_ORDER_GROUP" AS "Radiology Order Group", "t2"."RRPT_PROCEDURE_NAME" AS "Radiology Procedure Name", UPPER(CASE WHEN LENGTH(RRPT_REPORT_TXT) <= 15000 THEN RTRIM(CAST(SUBSTR(RRPT_REPORT_TXT, 1, 15000) AS VARCHAR(15000))) ELSE CAST(SUBSTR(RRPT_REPORT_TXT, 1, 15000) AS VARCHAR(15000)) END) AS "PRPT_REPORT" FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V" "t1" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED" "t3" ON "t1"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t3"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."RADIOLOGY_REPORT_V" "t2" ON "t3"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t2"."RRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_IDENTIFICATION_MRN_V" "t4" ON "t1"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t4"."PI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" WHERE 1=1 AND "t2"."RRPT_PROCEDURE_NAME" LIKE '%FDG%' AND LOCATE('FDG', UPPER(RRPT_REPORT_TXT)) > 0 AND "t1"."PT_MRN" IN () SELECT DISTINCT CDD_MRN, CDD_SERVICE_DTE, CDO_ITEM_NAME, CDO_VALUE_TEXT FROM IDB.CD_DOCUMENT JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION ON CDO_DOC_GUID = CDD_DOC_GUID AND CDO_AUTHORED_DTE = CDD_AUTHORED_DTE WHERE CDD_CANCEL_IND = '0' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND = '0' AND(UPPER(CDO_ITEM_NAME) LIKE '%HPV%' OR UPPER(CDO_ITEM_NAME) LIKE '%HUMAN%PAPILLOMAVIRUS%' OR UPPER(CDO_VALUE_TEXT) LIKE '%HPV%' OR UPPER(CDO_VALUE_TEXT) LIKE '%HUMAN%PAPILLOMAVIRUS%') AND CDD_MRN IN () WITH DX2 AS (SELECT TM_MRN AS MRN, TM_DX_DTE AS DX_DATE, TM_SITE_CD AS SITE_CODE, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_DESC, TM_HIST_CD AS HIST_CODE, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS HIST_DESC FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM H ON TM_HIST_CD = H.CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON TM_SITE_CD = S.CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND TM_SITE_CD NOT IN ('C600', 'C601', 'C602', 'C608', 'C609') AND TM_HIST_CD LIKE '%/3%' AND TM_MRN IN () UNION SELECT CC_MRN AS MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS DX_DATE, CLM_CLSF_CD AS SITE_CODE, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_DESC, '' AS HIST_CODE, '' AS HIST_DESC FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND ((CC_PT_TYPE = 'I') OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) AND CC_CLSF_CD NOT IN ('187.1', '187.2', '187.3', '187.4', 'C60', 'C60.0', 'C60.1', 'C60.2', 'C60.8', 'C60.9') AND(CLM_CLSF_CD BETWEEN '140' AND '239.99' OR CLM_CLSF_CD LIKE 'C%' OR CLM_CLSF_CD LIKE 'D%') AND CC_MRN IN () GROUP BY CC_MRN, CLM_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK ) SELECT * FROM DX2

prompt:
Need demographics on list of MRNs. 



Demographics: gender, ethnicity, race
Provide a list of pediatric patients age 1-20 years old at time of surgery who were diagnosed with sarcoma of the chest wall, surgery dates between 1/1/2008-12/31-2017.
completion: WITH DX_O AS (SELECT DISTINCT TM_MRN MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, PT_SEX, AV_DESC AS CASE_STS, TM_DX_DTE, TM_HIST_CD, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS HIST_DESC, TM_SITE_CD, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_DESC FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS ON AV_ELEMENT = 'CASE_STS' AND AV_CODE = TM_CASE_STS AND TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND TM_HIST_CD IN ('M9180/3', 'M9260/3', 'M9220/3', 'M9040/3', 'M8900/3', 'M8800/3') JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PT_MRN = TM_MRN) , SRG AS (SELECT DISTINCT SSE_MRN MRN FROM DX_O D JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT ON MRN = SSE_MRN JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE ON SSE_LOG_ID = SSP_LOG_ID AND SSE_ENC_CSN_ID = SSP_ENC_CSN_ID JOIN IDB.PATIENT P ON P.PT_MRN = MRN AND YEAR(SSE_SURG_DTE - P.PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) <= 20 AND SSE_SURG_DTE >= P.PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH WHERE (SSE_SURG_LOC not like '%IR%' AND SSE_SURG_LOC not like '%ENDO%' AND SSE_SOURCE_TYPE <> 'E') AND SSE_SURG_DTE BETWEEN '2008-01-01' AND '2017-12-31' ) , PATH AS (SELECT DISTINCT PRPT_MRN MRN FROM SRG JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V ON MRN = PRPT_MRN WHERE PRPT_REPORT IS NOT NULL AND CONTAINS(PRPT_REPORT, '("Primary Osteosarcoma" | "Ewing Sarcoma" | "Chondrosarcoma" | "Synovial sarcoma" | "Rhabdomyosarcoma" | "Sarcoma")') = 1 ) SELECT D.* FROM PATH P JOIN DX_O D ON P.MRN = D.MRN ; WITH DX_O AS (SELECT DISTINCT TM_MRN MRN FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS ON AV_ELEMENT = 'CASE_STS' AND AV_CODE = TM_CASE_STS AND TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND TM_HIST_CD IN ('M9180/3', 'M9260/3', 'M9220/3', 'M9040/3', 'M8900/3', 'M8800/3')), SRG AS (SELECT DISTINCT SSE_MRN MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, PT_SEX, YEAR(SSE_SURG_DTE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) AGE_AT_SRG, SSE_SURG_DTE, SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD, SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC, SSP_SURG_LAST_NM, SSP_SURG_FIRST_NM, SSP_SURG_SVC_CD FROM DX_O JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT ON MRN = SSE_MRN JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE ON SSE_LOG_ID = SSP_LOG_ID AND SSE_ENC_CSN_ID = SSP_ENC_CSN_ID JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PT_MRN = MRN AND YEAR(SSE_SURG_DTE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) <= 20 AND SSE_SURG_DTE >= PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH WHERE (SSE_SURG_LOC not like '%IR%' AND SSE_SURG_LOC not like '%ENDO%' AND SSE_SOURCE_TYPE <> 'E') AND SSE_SURG_DTE BETWEEN '2008-01-01' AND '2017-12-31' ) , PATH AS (SELECT DISTINCT PRPT_MRN MRN FROM SRG JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V ON MRN = PRPT_MRN WHERE PRPT_REPORT IS NOT NULL AND CONTAINS(PRPT_REPORT, '("Primary Osteosarcoma" | "Ewing Sarcoma" | "Chondrosarcoma" | "Synovial sarcoma" | "Rhabdomyosarcoma" | "Sarcoma")') = 1 ) SELECT S.* FROM PATH P JOIN SRG S ON S.MRN = P.MRN ;

prompt: Provide a list of patients diagnosed with rhabdomyosarcoma with bone marrow involvement from 1/1/2007 to present.
completion: WITH RHABDOMYOSARCOMA AS (SELECT DISTINCT TM_MRN, AV_DESC AS CASE_STS, TM_DX_DTE "Diagnosis Date", TM_HIST_CD "Tumor Histology Code", H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS "Tumor Histology Description", TM_SITE_CD "Tumor Site Code", S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS "Tumor Site Description" FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS ON AV_ELEMENT = 'CASE_STS' AND AV_CODE = TM_CASE_STS AND TM_CASE_STS IN ('3', '6', '7', '8') AND TM_HIST_CD IN ('M8900/0', 'M8900/3', 'M8901/3', 'M8902/3', 'M8903/0', 'M8904/0', 'M8905/0', 'M8910/3', 'M8912/3', 'M8920/3', 'M8921/3', 'M8963/3', 'M9508/3') AND TM_DX_DTE >= '1998-01-01'), ICD AS (SELECT CC_MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS MIN_ICD9_EFF_DTE, CC_CLSF_CD AS ICD9_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS ICD9_DESC FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE CC_CLSF_CD IN ('C49.9', '171.9', 'C79.5', 'C79.51', '198.5', 'C79.52') AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND (CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) GROUP BY CC_MRN, CC_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK HAVING MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) >= '1998-01-01') SELECT PT_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, PT_SEX, CASE_STS, "Diagnosis Date", "Tumor Histology Code", "Tumor Histology Description", "Tumor Site Code", "Tumor Site Description", MIN_ICD9_EFF_DTE ICD_EFF_DTE, ICD9_CD "ICD 9/10 Code", ICD9_DESC "ICD 9/10 Description" FROM IDB.PATIENT JOIN RHABDOMYOSARCOMA AS CDB ON TM_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN ICD ON CC_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE COALESCE(TM_MRN, CC_MRN) IS NOT NULL

prompt: Provide a list of chondrosarcoma patients seen at MSK since 1/1/2000.
completion: WITH TM AS (SELECT DISTINCT TM_MRN, TM_HIST_CD AS HIST_CODE, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS HIST_DESC, TM_SITE_CD AS SITE_CODE, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_DESC, TM_DX_DTE AS DX_DATE FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM H ON TM_HIST_CD = H.CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON TM_SITE_CD = S.CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY ON TM_MRN = PLA_MRN AND COALESCE(MAX(PLA_LST_APPT_DTE, PLA_LST_DSCH_DTE), PLA_LST_APPT_DTE, PLA_LST_DSCH_DTE) >= '2000-01-01' WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND TM_HIST_CD IN ('M9240/3', 'M9220/3', 'M9231/3', 'M9243/3', 'M9221/3', 'M9242/3') ) , X AS (SELECT PT_MRN AS MRN, STRIP(PT_LAST_NAME) || ', ' || STRIP(PT_FIRST_NAME) AS NAME, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH AS DOB, PT_SEX AS GENDER, R.AV_DESC AS "Race", E.AV_DESC AS "Ethnicity", PT_DATE_OF_DEATH AS DOD, COALESCE(MAX(PLA_LST_APPT_DTE, PLA_LST_DSCH_DTE), PLA_LST_APPT_DTE, PLA_LST_DSCH_DTE) AS LAST_FU_DATE FROM IDB.PATIENT JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY ON PT_MRN = PLA_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS R ON PT_RACE = R.AV_CODE AND R.AV_ELEMENT = 'RACE' LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS E ON PT_PT_ETHNICITY = E.AV_CODE AND E.AV_ELEMENT = 'PT_ETHNICITY' WHERE PT_MRN IN (SELECT TM_MRN FROM TM) ) , DX AS (SELECT DISTINCT TM_MRN, TM_HIST_CD AS HIST_CODE, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS HIST_DESC, TM_SITE_CD AS SITE_CODE, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_DESC, TM_DX_DTE AS DX_DATE, TM_TUMOR_SIZE FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN X ON TM_MRN = MRN JOIN IDB.CLM H ON TM_HIST_CD = H.CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON TM_SITE_CD = S.CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY ON TM_MRN = PLA_MRN AND COALESCE(MAX(PLA_LST_APPT_DTE, PLA_LST_DSCH_DTE), PLA_LST_APPT_DTE, PLA_LST_DSCH_DTE) >= '2000-01-01' WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND TM_HIST_CD IN ('M9240/3', 'M9220/3', 'M9231/3', 'M9243/3', 'M9221/3', 'M9242/3') ) , PATH AS (SELECT DISTINCT "t1"."PT_MRN" AS "MRN", "t2"."PRPT_ACCESSION_NO" AS "Pathology Report", "t3"."PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_DESC" AS "Pathology Report Type", "t4"."DT_DTE" AS "Pathology Procedure Date" FROM X JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V" "t1" ON PT_MRN = MRN LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED" "t6" ON "t1"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t6"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V" "t2" ON "t6"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t2"."PRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATH_RPRT_TYPE_LOOKUP" "t3" ON "t2"."PRPT_REPORT_TYPE" = "t3"."PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_CD" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" "t4" ON "t2"."PRPT_PROCEDURE_DATE_ID" = "t4"."DT_DATE_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" "t5" ON "t2"."PRPT_REPORT_DATE_ID" = "t5"."DT_DATE_ID" WHERE 1=1 AND "t2"."PRPT_REPORT" IS NOT NULL AND UPPER("t3"."PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_DESC") LIKE '%SURGICAL PATHOLOGY%' AND CONTAINS("t2"."PRPT_REPORT", '("Chondrosarcoma")') = 1 ) , SRG1 AS (SELECT DISTINCT SSE_MRN, SSE_SURG_DTE, SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD, SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC FROM PATH LEFT JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT ON MRN = SSE_MRN AND SSE_SURG_DTE = "Pathology Procedure Date" LEFT JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE ON SSE_LOG_ID = SSP_LOG_ID WHERE 1=1 ) , SRG2 AS (SELECT SSE_MRN, SSE_SURG_DTE, LISTAGG(COALESCE(STRIP(SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD), '') || ' | ' || COALESCE(STRIP(CAST(SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC AS VARCHAR(12000))), '') , CHR(13) || CHR(10)) WITHIN GROUP( ORDER BY SSE_MRN, SSE_SURG_DTE, SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD) AS CPT FROM SRG1 GROUP BY SSE_MRN, SSE_SURG_DTE) , PATH2 AS (SELECT DISTINCT PATH.*, CPT FROM PATH LEFT JOIN SRG2 ON MRN = SSE_MRN AND "Pathology Procedure Date" = SSE_SURG_DTE) , RT AS (SELECT DISTINCT RTC_TX_MRN, RTC_TX_PLAN_NAME, RTC_PRIMARY_REF_POINT, RTC_TX_START_DTE, RTC_TX_STOP_DTE, RTC_TX_ELAPSED_DAYS, RTC_TX_PLANNED_FRACTIONS, RTC_TX_DELIVERED_FRACTIONS, RTC_TX_PLANNED_DOSE, RTC_TX_DELIVERED_DOSE, RTC_DOSE_CORRECTION FROM IDB.RADONC_TREATMENT_COURSE JOIN X ON completion: WITH CTE AS (SELECT CPE_MRN MRN, CPP_PT_NAME PT_NAME, CPE_ENC_DTE VST_DATE, CPE_ENC_CSN_ID CSNID, VD.CLD_DEPT_ID DEPT_ID, VD.CLD_DEPT_NAME DEPT_NAME , VD.CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 AS "Visit Service", S.CAV_TITLE AS "Visit Service Desc", VD.CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 GRP6 , CPE_APPT_DT APPT_DT , VT.CRE_RES_NAME VST_MD, REF.CRE_RES_NAME REF_MD, REF.CRE_RES_TYP REF_TYPE, CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR VST_ABBR FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID = CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID JOIN IDB.CL_PAS_PATIENT ON CPE_MRN = CPP_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT VD ON CPE_DEPT_ID = VD.CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE VT ON VT.CRE_RES_ID = CPE_VST_RES_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_CATEGORY S ON S.CAV_CATEGORY = 'CLD_RPT_GRP_8' AND S.CAV_ABBR = VD.CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE REF ON REF.CRE_RES_ID = CPE_REF_RES_ID AND REF.CRE_RES_TYP IN ('Physician', 'PhD', 'Nurse Practitioner', 'Physician Assistant', 'Advanced Practice Nurse', 'Resident', 'Fellow', 'Physician Activity') WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Comp', 'Arrived') AND CPE_ENC_TYP_CD = 50 AND CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME = 'SCC FR' AND VD.CLD_DEPT_NAME <> 'UCC 1275' AND CPE_ENC_DTE >= '2023-08-01' ) SELECT DISTINCT MRN, PT_NAME, VST_DATE, DEPT_NAME VISIT_DEPT, "Visit Service", "Visit Service Desc", GRP6 , APPT_DT , VST_ABBR , OP_DISPLAY_NAME AUTHORIZED_PROVIDER, OP_PROV_TYPE, CDD_DOC_NAME DOCNAME, CDD_SERVICE_DTE DOC_SERVICE_DTE, CDD_SIGNATURE_STATUS_DESC SIGNATURE_STATUS FROM CTE JOIN IDB.CD_DOCUMENT ON MRN = CDD_MRN AND VST_DATE BETWEEN CDD_SERVICE_DTE - 1 DAY AND CDD_SERVICE_DTE + 2 DAY JOIN IDB.CD_DOCUMENT_HISTORY CDH1 ON CDD_DOC_GUID = CDH1.CDH_CLIENT_DOC_GUID AND CDH1.CDH_GUID = (SELECT MAX(X.CDH_GUID) FROM IDB.CD_DOCUMENT_HISTORY X WHERE X.CDH_CLIENT_DOC_GUID = CDD_DOC_GUID ) LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_PROVIDER ON CDH1.CDH_USER_GUID = OP_PVDR_GUID WHERE CDD_CANCEL_IND = '0' AND CDD_DOC_NAME IN('Procedure Note, Adult - Paracentesis', 'Procedure Note - Paracentesis, AMB') ORDER BY 3

prompt: Provide a list of patients (MRN) that underwent endoscopic resection of esophageal cancer after definitive chemotherapy and/or radiotherapy
completion: WITH SRG AS (SELECT SSE_LOG_ID, SSE_MRN , STRIP(PT_LAST_NAME)||', '||PT_FIRST_NAME PT_NAME, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH DOB, PT_DATE_OF_DEATH "DATE OF DEATH", YEAR(SSE_SURG_DTE) - YEAR(PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) "AGE AT SURGERY", SSE_SURG_DTE "SURGERY DATE", SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD "CPT CODE", SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC "PROCEDURE DESCRIPTION" FROM IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON SSE_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE ON SSE_LOG_ID = SSP_LOG_ID WHERE SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD IN('43211', '43254', '43499') AND SSE_SURG_DTE >= '2000-01-01' ) , CHEMO AS (SELECT APR_MRN , MIN(APR_START_DTE) CHEMO_START, MAX(APR_END_DTE) CHEMO_END FROM SRG JOIN IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX ON SSE_MRN = APR_MRN WHERE APR_DRUG_PROCESS_STAGE <>'H' AND APR_CHEMO_FLAG = 'Y' GROUP BY APR_MRN) , RADONC AS (SELECT MRN , MIN(SVC_DTE) RT_START, MAX(SVC_DTE) RT_END FROM IDB.RADIATION_CHARGES_V JOIN SRG ON SSE_MRN = MRN GROUP BY MRN) SELECT SSE_LOG_ID, SSE_MRN AS MRN, PT_NAME, DOB, "DATE OF DEATH", "AGE AT SURGERY", "SURGERY DATE", "CPT CODE", "PROCEDURE DESCRIPTION", RT_START, RT_END, CHEMO_START, CHEMO_END FROM SRG LEFT JOIN CHEMO ON SSE_MRN = APR_MRN LEFT JOIN RADONC ON SSE_MRN = MRN WHERE COALESCE(MAX(CHEMO_END, RT_END), '1900-01-01') < "SURGERY DATE" AND (CHEMO_END IS NOT NULL OR RT_END IS NOT NULL) ;

prompt: Identify patients who have positive results of specified Epstein-Barr lab tests, and identify patients who were diagnosed with lymphoma with specified involvement and HIV.
completion: SELECT "t6"."PT_MRN" AS "MRN", "t6"."PT_LAST_NAME" AS "Last Name", "t6"."PT_BIRTH_DTE" AS "Date of Birth", "t6"."PT_SEX_DESC" AS "Gender", "t4"."DT_DTE" AS "Lab-Performed Date", "ICD-9 First Dx Date" FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED" "t1" JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_LAB_RESULT" "t5" ON "t1"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t5"."PLR_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" JOIN "DV"."LAB_TEST_CATALOG" "t2" ON "t5"."PLR_LAB_TEST_CATALOG_ID" = "t2"."LTC_LAB_TEST_CATALOG_ID" JOIN "DV"."LAB_TEST_CATALOG" "t3" ON "t5"."PLR_LAB_SUBTEST_CATALOG_ID" = "t3"."LTC_LAB_TEST_CATALOG_ID" JOIN "DV"."DATE" "t4" ON "t5"."PLR_PERFORMED_DATE_ID" = "t4"."DT_DATE_ID" JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V" "t6" ON "t1"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t6"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN (SELECT "t8"."PDX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID", MIN("t9"."DT_DTE") AS "ICD-9 First Dx Date" FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DIAGNOSIS_FINAL_ALL_V" "t8" JOIN "DV"."DIAGNOSIS_CODE_CAT_ICD9_V" "t7" ON "t8"."PDX_DX_CATALOG_ID" = "t7"."DXCC_DX_CATALOG_ID" JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DIAGNOSIS_FINAL_DATES_V" "t10" ON "t8"."PDX_DX_CATALOG_ID" = "t10"."PDX_DX_CATALOG_ID" AND "t8"."PDX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t10"."PDX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" JOIN "DV"."DATE" "t9" ON "t10"."FIRST_DIAGNOSIS_DATE_ID" = "t9"."DT_DATE_ID" WHERE "t7"."DXCC_ICD_CODE" BETWEEN '200.10' AND '202.99' AND "t8"."DXA_CIC_CDER_INIT" IN ('YES') GROUP BY "t8"."PDX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID") AS A ON "t1"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = A."PDX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" WHERE "t2"."LTC_SUBTEST_NAME" IN ('Epstein-Barr Virus AB, CSF', 'Epstein-Barr Virus PCR, Qualitative(CSF)') AND "t3"."LTC_SUBTEST_NAME" IN ('Epstein-Barr Virus PCR. ') AND "t4"."DT_DTE" BETWEEN '2000-1-1' AND '2010-12-31' AND UPPER(CAST("t5"."PLR_TEXT_RESULT" AS VARCHAR(2000))) LIKE '%POSITIVE%' PART 2: WITH LYMPHOMA AS (SELECT DISTINCT "t1"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AS LYMPHOMA_DEID, MIN("t4"."DT_DTE") AS "Min Lymphoma Effective Date" FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED" "t1" JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DIAGNOSIS_FINAL_ALL_V" "t3" ON "t1"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t3"."PDX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" JOIN "DV"."DIAGNOSIS_CODE_CAT_ICD9_V" "t2" ON "t3"."PDX_DX_CATALOG_ID" = "t2"."DXCC_DX_CATALOG_ID" JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DIAGNOSIS_FINAL_DATES_V" "t6" ON "t3"."PDX_DX_CATALOG_ID" = "t6"."PDX_DX_CATALOG_ID" AND "t3"."PDX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t6"."PDX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" JOIN "DV"."DATE" "t4" ON "t6"."FIRST_DIAGNOSIS_DATE_ID" = "t4"."DT_DATE_ID" JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V" "t5" ON "t1"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t5"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" WHERE "t2"."DXCC_ICD_CODE" BETWEEN '200.10' AND '202.99' AND "t3"."DXA_CIC_CDER_INIT" IN ('YES') AND "t4"."DT_DTE" BETWEEN '2000-1-1' AND '2010-12-31' GROUP BY "t1"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID"), CNS AS (SELECT DISTINCT "t1"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AS CNS_DEID, "Min Lymphoma Effective Date", MIN("t4"."DT_DTE") AS "Min CNS Effective Date" FROM LYMPHOMA JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED" "t1" ON "t1"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = LYMPHOMA_DEID JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DIAGNOSIS_FINAL_ALL_V" "t3" ON "t1"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t3"."PDX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" JOIN "DV"."DIAGNOSIS_CODE_CAT_ICD9_V" "t2" ON "t3"."PDX_DX_CATALOG_ID" = "t2"."DXCC_DX_CATALOG_ID" JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DIAGNOSIS_FINAL_DATES_V" "t6" ON "t3"."PDX_DX_CATALOG_ID" = "t6"."PDX_DX_CATALOG_ID" AND "t3"."PDX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t6"."PDX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" JOIN "DV"."DATE" "t4" ON "t6"."FIRST_DIAGNOSIS_DATE_ID" = "t4"."DT_DATE_ID" JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V" "t5" ON "t1"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t5"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" WHERE "t2"."DXCC_ICD_CODE" IN ('198.3', '198.4', '200.5', '200.50', '200.51', '200.52', '200.53', '200.54', '200.55', '200.56', '200.57', '200.58') AND "t3"."DXA_CIC_CDER_INIT" IN ('YES') GROUP BY "t1"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID", "Min Lymphoma Effective Date") SELECT "t5"."PT_MRN" AS "MRN", "t5"."PT_LAST_NAME" AS "Last Name", "t5"."PT_BIRTH_DTE" AS "Date of Birth", "t5"."PT_SEX" AS "Gender", "Min Lymphoma Effective Date", "Min CNS Effective Date", MIN("t4"."DT_DTE") AS "Min HIV Effective Date" FROM CNS JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED" "t1" ON "t1"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = CNS_DEID JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DIAGNOSIS_FINAL_ALL_V" "t3" ON "t1"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t3"."PDX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" JOIN "DV"."DIAGNOSIS_CODE_CAT_ICD9_V" "t2" ON "t3"."PDX_DX_CATALOG_ID" = "t2"."DXCC_DX_CATALOG_ID" JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DIAGNOSIS_FINAL_DATES_V" "t6" ON "t3"."PDX_DX_CATALOG_ID" = "t6"."PDX_DX_CATALOG_ID" AND "t3"."PDX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t6"."PDX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" JOIN "DV"."DATE" "t4" ON "t6"."FIRST_DIAGNOSIS_DATE_ID" = "t4"."DT_DATE_ID" JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V" "t5" ON "t1"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t5"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" WHERE "t2"."DXCC_ICD_CODE" IN ('V08', 'V65.44', '042', '042.0', '042.1', '042.2', '043', '043.0', '043.1', '043.2', '043.3', '044', '044.0', '044.9', '079.53', '795.71') AND "t3"."DXA_CIC_CDER_INIT" IN ('YES') GROUP BY "t5"."PT_MRN", "t5"."PT_LAST_NAME", "t5"."PT_BIRTH_DTE", "t5"."PT_SEX", "Min Lymphoma Effective Date", "Min CNS Effective Date"

prompt: Weekly list of patients with early-stage resectable lung adenocarcinoma.
completion: WITH DX AS (SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME AS "Last Name", PT_FIRST_NAME AS "First Name", PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH AS "Date of Birth", G.AV_CODE AS GENDER, R.AV_DESC AS RACE, E.AV_DESC AS ETHNICITY, TM_DX_DTE AS "Tumor Diagnosis Date", TM_HIST_CD AS "Histology Code", HIST_DESC AS "Histology Description", TM_SITE_CD AS "Site Code", SITE_DESC AS "Site Description", BEST_STAGE AS "Best Stage", MIN_ICD9_EFF_DTE AS "ICD Date", ICD9_CD AS "ICD Code", ICD9_DESC AS "ICD Description" FROM IDB.PATIENT LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS R ON R.AV_ELEMENT = 'RACE' AND R.AV_CODE = PT_RACE LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS E ON E.AV_ELEMENT = 'PT_ETHNICITY' AND E.AV_CODE = PT_PT_ETHNICITY LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS G ON G.AV_ELEMENT = 'SEX' AND G.AV_CODE = PT_SEX LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT TM_MRN, TM_DX_DTE, TM_HIST_CD, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS HIST_DESC, TM_SITE_CD, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_DESC, CASE WHEN TM_AJCC_7 NOT IN ('', '888', '999') THEN AJCC7.AV_DESC WHEN TM_AJCC NOT IN ('', '88', '99') THEN AJCC.AV_DESC WHEN TM_GENERAL_STG NOT IN ('', '9') THEN GS.AV_DESC WHEN TM_PATH_STG_GRP NOT IN ('', '88', '9', '99') THEN TM_PATH_STG_GRP ELSE CLIN.AV_DESC END AS BEST_STAGE, CASE WHEN TM_AJCC_7 NOT IN ('', '888', '999') THEN 'AJCC_7' WHEN TM_AJCC NOT IN ('', '88', '99') THEN 'AJCC' WHEN TM_GENERAL_STG NOT IN ('', '9') THEN 'GeneralStage' WHEN TM_PATH_STG_GRP NOT IN ('', '88', '9', '99') THEN 'PathStage' ELSE 'ClinicalStage' END AS BEST_STAGE_SOURCE FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS AL ON AL.AV_ELEMENT = 'CASE_STS' AND AL.AV_CODE = TM_CASE_STS LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS AJCC7 ON AJCC7.AV_ELEMENT = 'AJCC_7' AND AJCC7.AV_CODE = TM_AJCC_7 LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS AJCC ON AJCC.AV_ELEMENT = 'AJCC' AND AJCC.AV_CODE = TM_AJCC LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS GS ON GS.AV_ELEMENT = 'GENERAL_STG' AND GS.AV_CODE = TM_GENERAL_STG LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS CLIN ON CLIN.AV_ELEMENT = 'CLIN_STG_DSCR' AND CLIN.AV_CODE = TM_CLIN_STG_DSCR WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('3', '6', '7', '8') AND TM_SITE_CD LIKE 'C34%' ) AS CDB ON TM_MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT CC_MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS MIN_ICD9_EFF_DTE, CC_CLSF_CD AS ICD9_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS ICD9_DESC FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE (CC_CLSF_CD LIKE '162%' OR CC_CLSF_CD LIKE 'C34%') AND CASE WHEN CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y' AND CC_PT_TYPE <> 'E' THEN 'Y' WHEN CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' AND YEAR(CC_EFF_DTE) < 2004 THEN 'Y' WHEN CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND YEAR(CC_EFF_DTE) < 2001 THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END = 'Y' GROUP BY CC_MRN, CC_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK ) AS ICD9 ON CC_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE COALESCE(TM_MRN, CC_MRN) IS NOT NULL ), APPT AS (SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN APPT_MRN, CPE_ENC_DTE AS "Appt Date", CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 AS "Department", CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 AS "Service", CLD_DEPT_NAME AS "Department Name", CRE_RES_NAME AS "Provider Name", CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME AS "Visit Type", CVT_EXT_NAME AS "Visit Type External" FROM DX JOIN IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER ON PT_MRN = CPE_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CRE_RES_TYP = 'Physician' AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT_DATE - 7 DAY AND CURRENT_DATE -1 DAY AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 = 'THR' ) , RAD AS (SELECT DISTINCT RAD_MRN, "Last Radiology Performed Date", "Accession Number", "Report Order Group", "Report Procedure Name", "Report Text" FROM (SELECT DISTINCT RRPT_MRN AS RAD_MRN, RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE AS "Last Radiology Performed Date", ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY RRPT_MRN ORDER BY RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE DESC) AS RN, RRPT_ACCESSION_NO AS "Accession Number", RRPT_ORDER_GROUP AS "Report Order Group", RRPT_PROCEDURE_NAME AS "Report Procedure Name", VARCHAR(RRPT_REPORT_TXT, 32000) AS "Report Text" FROM APPT JOIN DV.RADIOLOGY_REPORT_V ON RRPT_MRN = APPT_MRN WHERE RRPT_ORDER_GROUP IN ('CT', 'PET CT for Cancer') )A WHERE RN = 1 ) , RADAPPT AS (SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN AS RAD_APPT_MRN, CPE_ENC_DTE AS RAD_APPT_DATE, CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME AS RAD_VISITI_TYPE, CVT_EXT_NAME AS RAD_VISITI_TYPE_EXT FROM APPT JOIN IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER ON APPT_MRN = CPE_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Sch') AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 = 'RAD' AND CVT_EXT_NAME IN ('Pet Scan', 'CT Scan') AND CPE_ENC_DTE > CURRENT DATE ) , CHEMO AS (SELECT DISTINCT CHEMO_MRN, "Chemotherapy Start Date", "Chemotherapy End Date", "Chemotherapy Generic Name", "Chemotherapy Prescribed Dose", "Chemotherapy Route" FROM (SELECT DISTINCT APR_MRN CHEMO_MRN, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY APR_MRN ORDER BY APR_START_DTE DESC) AS RN, APR_START_DTE AS "Chemotherapy Start Date", APR_END_DTE AS "Chemotherapy End Date", CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME AS "Chemotherapy Generic Name", APR_PRESCRIBED_DOSE AS "Chemotherapy Prescribed Dose", APR_ROUTE AS "Chemotherapy Route" FROM APPT JOIN IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX_V ON APPT_MRN = APR_MRN WHERE CDG_CHEMO_FLAG = 'Y' ) A WHERE RN = 1 ) , IMMUNO AS (SELECT DISTINCT IMMUNO_MRN, "Immunotherapy Start Date", "Immunotherapy End Date", "Immunotherapy Generic Name", "Immunotherapy Prescribed Dose", "Immunotherapy Route" FROM (SELECT DISTINCT APR_MRN IMMUNO_MRN, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY APR_MRN ORDER BY APR_START_DTE DESC) AS RN, APR_START_DTE AS "Immunotherapy Start Date", APR_END_DTE AS "Immunotherapy End Date", CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME AS "Immunotherapy Generic Name", APR_PRESCRIBED_DOSE AS "Immunotherapy Prescribed Dose", APR_ROUTE AS "Immunotherapy Route" FROM APPT JOIN IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX_V ON APPT_MRN = APR_MRN WHERE CDG_IMMUNOTHERAPY_FLAG = 'Y' ) A WHERE RN = 1 ), CARD AS (SELECT DISTINCT CC_MRN CARD_MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS MIN_ICD9_EFF_DTE, CC_CLSF_CD AS ICD9_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS ICD9_DESC FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE CC_CLSF_CD = 'Z95.0' AND CASE WHEN CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y' AND CC_PT_TYPE <> 'E' THEN 'Y' WHEN CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' AND YEAR(CC_EFF_DTE) < 2004 THEN 'Y' WHEN CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND YEAR(CC_EFF_DTE) < 2001 THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END = 'Y' GROUP BY CC_MRN, CC_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK ) SELECT DISTINCT APPT_MRN MRN, "Last Name", "First Name", "Date of Birth", GENDER, RACE, ETHNICITY, "Tumor Diagnosis Date", "Histology Code", "Histology Description", "Site Code", "Site Description", "Best Stage", "ICD Date", "ICD Code", "ICD Description", "Appt Date", "Department", "Service", "Department Name", "Provider Name", "Visit Type", "Visit Type External", "Chemotherapy Start Date", "Chemotherapy End Date", "Chemotherapy Generic Name", "Chemotherapy Prescribed Dose", "Chemotherapy Route", "Immunotherapy Start Date", "Immunotherapy End Date", "Immunotherapy Generic Name", "Immunotherapy Prescribed Dose", "Immunotherapy Route", RAD_APPT_DATE AS "Upcoming PET or CT Scan Date", RAD_VISITI_TYPE AS "Upcoming Scan Type", "Last Radiology Performed Date", "Accession Number", "Report Order Group", "Report Procedure Name", "Report Text" FROM DX JOIN APPT ON APPT_MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN CHEMO ON APPT_MRN = CHEMO_MRN LEFT JOIN IMMUNO ON APPT_MRN = IMMUNO_MRN LEFT JOIN RAD ON APPT_MRN = RAD_MRN LEFT JOIN RADAPPT ON APPT_MRN = RAD_APPT_MRN ORDER BY APPT_MRN

prompt: Provide clinical information about the ~500 patients with esophageal adenocarcinoma that we have IMPACT data on
completion: WITH PATH_REFS_PRE AS (SELECT PRPTR_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID, PRPTR_PATH_RPT_ID, PRPTR_CHILD_PATH_RPT_ID FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_REFERENCES) SELECT TRIM(C.PRPT_MRN) AS MRN , TRIM(C.PRPT_ACCESSION_NO) AS "Accession number" , C.PRPT_PROCEDURE_DTE AS IMPACT_PROC_DTE , C.PRPT_REPORT_DTE AS IMPACT_RPT_DTE , S.PRPT_PROCEDURE_DTE AS ASSOC_PTH_PROC_DTE , S.PRPT_REPORT_DTE AS ASSOC_PTH_RPT_DTE FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V C LEFT JOIN PATH_REFS_PRE ON C.PRPT_PATH_RPT_ID = PRPTR_CHILD_PATH_RPT_ID LEFT JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V S ON S.PRPT_PATH_RPT_ID = PRPTR_PATH_RPT_ID WHERE SUBSTR(C.PRPT_ACCESSION_NO, 1, 1) = 'M' AND C.PRPT_ACCESSION_NO IN ({})

prompt: Provide a report of all CIS orders for Urology Inpatient Consult, August-October 2009.
completion: SELECT OO_MRN, OO_ENTER_DTE, OP_DISPLAY_NAME AS REQUESTED_BY , OU_DISPLAY_NAME AS USER_NAME, OU_OCCUPATION AS USER_ROLE , OO_ORD_NAME AS ORDER_NAME, OOC_REV_CAT_DEPT DEPT , STRIP(OO_ORD_STS_CD)||'-'||STRIP(OSTS_STS_DESC) STATUS , CASE WHEN OU_OCCUPATION = 'POA' AND OU_LOGON_ID NOT IN ('284315', '406686', '414151', '419309', '438465', '440321') THEN 'POA' WHEN OU_LOGON_ID IN ('045831', '049825', '061689', '106781', '145102', '215806', '222554', '301150', '322701', '328583', '349183', '359653', '416909', '428565', '430017', '499269', '300913', '117069', '418764', '219642', '508036', '142034', '416099', '117739', '125633', '130369', '125641', '192401', '313254', '321166', '495697', '668202', '066472', '632331', '215798', '128579', '259176', '638684', '481937') THEN 'POA' ELSE 'Other' END AS POA_IND , OO_SUMMARY_LINE ORDER_SUMMARY , RP.OUD_USER_DI_VALUE AS ORDERING_MD , CASE WHEN MONTH(OO_ENTER_DTE) = 8 THEN 'August' WHEN MONTH(OO_ENTER_DTE) = 9 THEN 'September' ELSE 'October' END AS RPT_MONTH FROM IDB.OMS_ORDER JOIN IDB.OMS_PROVIDER ON OP_PVDR_GUID = OO_PVDR_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_USER ON OU_USER_GUID = OO_USER_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_CATALOG ON OOC_MSTR_ITEM_GUID = OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID AND OOC_REV_CAT_DEPT = 'Consultations' AND OOC_MSTR_ITEM_GUID = '9000005769100730' JOIN IDB.OMS_STATUS ON OO_ORD_STS_CD = OSTS_ORD_STS_CD LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_USER_DATA RP ON RP.OUD_ORD_GUID = OO_ORD_GUID AND RP.OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'Uro Inpt Ref Req By' WHERE OO_ENTER_DTE BETWEEN '2009-08-01' AND '2009-10-31'

prompt: Provide a list of patients who were diagnosed at 0-30 years old with dermatofibrosarcoma.
