prompt: Dr. Haaris Beg in Hospital Medicine is requesting his procedure/case logs for the last 2 years
completion: WITH CDOC AS (SELECT DISTINCT CDD_MRN, CDD_SERVICE_DTE, CDD_DOC_NAME, OP_DISPLAY_NAME, CDD_DOC_GUID, CDO_SECTION, CDO_ITEM_NAME, CDO_VALUE_TEXT FROM IDB.CD_DOCUMENT LEFT JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION ON CDD_DOC_GUID = CDO_DOC_GUID AND CDD_AUTHORED_DTE = CDO_AUTHORED_DTE JOIN IDB.OMS_PROVIDER ON CDD_AUTH_PROV_GUID = OP_PVDR_GUID WHERE CDD_CANCEL_IND <> '1' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND <> '1' AND CDD_DOC_NAME = 'Initial Consult/Initial Visit, IP - DOM-Hospital Medicine' AND CDD_SERVICE_DTE BETWEEN '2021-01-01' AND '2022-12-31' AND OP_PVDR_NO = '025510' ) , ICD AS (SELECT DISTINCT CC_MRN, YEAR(CC_EFF_DTE) AS YEAR_ICD_DIAGNOSIS, SERVICE_YEAR, ICD_DIAGNOSIS, OP_DISPLAY_NAME FROM (SELECT DISTINCT CC_MRN, CC_EFF_DTE, OP_DISPLAY_NAME, YEAR(CDD_SERVICE_DTE) AS SERVICE_YEAR, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CC_MRN, CC_CLSF_CD ORDER BY CC_EFF_DTE DESC) AS RN, CONCAT(CONCAT(RTRIM(CC_CLSF_CD), '-'), CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK) AS ICD_DIAGNOSIS FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN CDOC ON CC_MRN = CDD_MRN AND CC_EFF_DTE <= CDD_SERVICE_DTE WHERE 1=1 AND NOT (CC_CLSF_CD BETWEEN '196' AND '198.99') AND NOT (CC_CLSF_CD BETWEEN 'C77' AND 'C79.99') AND (CC_CLSF_CD BETWEEN '140' AND '239.99' OR CC_CLSF_CD BETWEEN 'C' AND 'D49.99') AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND (CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) ) WHERE RN = 1 ) SELECT OP_DISPLAY_NAME AS DOCTOR_NAME, YEAR_ICD_DIAGNOSIS AS DIAGNOSIS_YEAR, SERVICE_YEAR, ICD_DIAGNOSIS AS DIAGNOSIS_CODE_DESC FROM ICD;

prompt: List of all DCIS (no invasive cancer) patient visits for upcoming week, to be provided on a weekly basis.
completion: WITH APPTS AS (SELECT CPE_MRN AS "MRN", CPP_PT_NAME "Patient Name", CPE_ENC_DTE AS "Appt Date", TIME(CPE_APPT_DT) AS "Appt Time", CRE_RES_NAME AS "Provider Name", CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME AS "Visit Type", CPE_CL_PT_ID FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_PAS_PATIENT ON CPP_CL_PT_ID = CPE_CL_PT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Sch') AND CRE_RES_TYP = 'Physician' AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 = 'SRG' AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 = 'BRE' AND CLD_CLD_CENTER = '300 E66' AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT date + 1 DAY AND CURRENT date + 8 DAYS AND CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR NOT IN ('PO', 'FR') ) , APPT_NOTES AS (SELECT DISTINCT CPAN_CL_PT_ID FROM IDB.CL_PT_APPT_NOTES WHERE (UPPER(CPAN_NOTE) like '%DCIS%' OR UPPER(CPAN_NOTE) like '%DUCTAL CARCINOMA IN SITU%') ) , PATH AS (SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON PRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID WHERE (CONTAINS(PRPT_REPORT, '"DCIS" | "DUCTAL CARCINOMA IN SITU"') = 1) AND (CONTAINS(PRPT_REPORT, '"IDC" | "INVASIVE CARCINOMA"') = 0) ) , DX AS (SELECT DISTINCT CC_MRN FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF WHERE CC_CLSF_CD like 'D05%' ) SELECT "MRN", "Patient Name", "Appt Date", "Appt Time", "Provider Name", "Visit Type" FROM APPTS WHERE CPE_CL_PT_ID IN (SELECT CPAN_CL_PT_ID FROM APPT_NOTES) OR MRN IN (SELECT PT_MRN FROM PATH) OR MRN IN (SELECT CC_MRN FROM DX) ORDER BY "Appt Date", "Appt Time"

prompt: Provide a tabulation of gender, race, and ethnicity between January 1, 2020 to present for all patients who had an encounter with the Orthopaedic service.
completion: SELECT PT_SEX GENDER, COUNT(DISTINCT PT_MRN) AS COUNT_INFO FROM IDB.PATIENT_V JOIN IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER ON PT_MRN = CPE_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID WHERE CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN '2020-01-01' AND CURRENT DATE AND CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Comp', 'Arrived') AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 = 'SRG' AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 = 'ORT' GROUP BY PT_SEX ; SELECT PT_RACE_DESC RACE, COUNT(DISTINCT PT_MRN) AS COUNT_INFO FROM IDB.PATIENT_V JOIN IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER ON PT_MRN = CPE_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID WHERE CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN '2020-01-01' AND CURRENT DATE AND CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Comp', 'Arrived') AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 = 'SRG' AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 = 'ORT' GROUP BY PT_RACE_DESC ; SELECT PT_PT_ETHNICITY_DESC ETHNICITY, COUNT(DISTINCT PT_MRN) AS COUNT_INFO FROM IDB.PATIENT_V JOIN IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER ON PT_MRN = CPE_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID WHERE CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN '2020-01-01' AND CURRENT DATE AND CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Comp', 'Arrived') AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 = 'SRG' AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 = 'ORT' GROUP BY PT_PT_ETHNICITY_DESC ;

prompt: Provide census data for M14.
completion: WITH ADMISSIONS AS (SELECT YEAR(A.CH_EFF_DATE) AS YR, MONTH(A.CH_EFF_DATE) AS MONTH, COUNT(A.CH_EFF_DATE) AS ADMISSIONS FROM IDB.CENSUS A LEFT JOIN IDB.CENSUS B ON A.CH_MRN = B.CH_MRN AND A.CH_ACCT_NO = B.CH_ACCT_NO AND A.CH_SEQ_NO = B.CH_SEQ_NO + 1 AND B.CH_CNG_TYPE = 'A' AND B.CH_NURS_STA IN ('PERI', 'SDH', 'UCC') WHERE A.CH_EFF_DATE BETWEEN '2010-10-01' AND '2011-09-30' AND A.CH_NURS_STA = 'NS14' AND (A.CH_CNG_TYPE = 'A' OR B.CH_MRN IS NOT NULL) GROUP BY YEAR(A.CH_EFF_DATE), MONTH(A.CH_EFF_DATE) ), TRANSFERS_IN AS (SELECT YEAR(A.CH_EFF_DATE) AS YR, MONTH(A.CH_EFF_DATE) AS MONTH, COUNT(A.CH_EFF_DATE) AS TRANSFERS_IN FROM IDB.CENSUS A LEFT JOIN IDB.CENSUS B ON A.CH_MRN = B.CH_MRN AND A.CH_ACCT_NO = B.CH_ACCT_NO AND A.CH_SEQ_NO = B.CH_SEQ_NO + 1 AND B.CH_CNG_TYPE = 'A' AND B.CH_NURS_STA IN ('PERI', 'SDH', 'UCC') WHERE A.CH_EFF_DATE BETWEEN '2010-10-01' AND '2011-09-30' AND A.CH_NURS_STA = 'NS14' AND A.CH_CNG_TYPE = 'T' AND B.CH_MRN IS NULL GROUP BY YEAR(A.CH_EFF_DATE), MONTH(A.CH_EFF_DATE) ), TRANSFERS_OUT AS (SELECT YEAR(B.CH_EFF_DATE) AS YR, MONTH(B.CH_EFF_DATE) AS MONTH, COUNT(B.CH_EFF_DATE) AS TRANSFERS_OUT FROM IDB.CENSUS A JOIN IDB.CENSUS B ON A.CH_MRN = B.CH_MRN AND A.CH_ACCT_NO = B.CH_ACCT_NO AND A.CH_SEQ_NO + 1 = B.CH_SEQ_NO AND B.CH_EFF_DATE BETWEEN '2010-10-01' AND '2011-09-30' AND B.CH_NURS_STA <> 'NS14' WHERE A.CH_NURS_STA = 'NS14' GROUP BY YEAR(B.CH_EFF_DATE), MONTH(B.CH_EFF_DATE) ), DISCHARGES AS (SELECT YEAR(CS_DSCH_DATE) AS YR, MONTH(CS_DSCH_DATE) AS MONTH, COUNT(CS_DSCH_DATE) AS DISCHARGES FROM IDB.CASE WHERE CS_DSCH_DATE BETWEEN '2010-10-01' AND '2011-09-30' AND CS_NURS_STA = 'NS14' GROUP BY YEAR(CS_DSCH_DATE), MONTH(CS_DSCH_DATE) ) SELECT ADMISSIONS.YR, ADMISSIONS.MONTH, ADMISSIONS, TRANSFERS_IN, TRANSFERS_OUT, DISCHARGES FROM ADMISSIONS A JOIN TRANSFERS_IN B ON A.YR = B.YR AND A.MONTH = B.MONTH JOIN TRANSFERS_OUT C ON A.YR = C.YR AND A.MONTH = C.MONTH JOIN DISCHARGES D ON A.YR = D.YR AND A.MONTH = D.MONTH

prompt: Looking at patients with EH/CAH/EIN receiving care at MSKCC
completion: WITH DIAGNOSIS_0 AS (SELECT "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AS PT_DEID, BASE_QUERY.PT_MRN AS PT_MRN, CAST(TRIM(BASE_QUERY.PT_MRN) AS VARCHAR) || CAST(TRIM(BASE_QUERY.DIAGNOSIS_DATE) AS VARCHAR) || CAST(TRIM(BASE_QUERY.ICD_CODES_ICD_CODE) AS VARCHAR) AS SUBJECT_ID, BASE_QUERY.DIAGNOSIS_DATE AS DIAGNOSIS_DATE, TRIM(BASE_QUERY.ICD_CODES_ICD_CODE) || '-' || TRIM("IDB"."CLM"."CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK") AS ICD_CODES_ICD_CODE_DESC FROM (SELECT "IDB"."CTC_CLSF"."CC_MRN" AS PT_MRN, "IDB"."CTC_CLSF"."CC_CLSF_CD" AS ICD_CODES_ICD_CODE, MIN("IDB"."CTC_CLSF"."CC_EFF_DTE") AS DIAGNOSIS_DATE FROM "IDB"."CTC_CLSF" WHERE "IDB"."CTC_CLSF"."CC_CLSF_TYPE" LIKE 'DF%' AND ("IDB"."CTC_CLSF"."CC_PT_TYPE" = 'I' OR ("IDB"."CTC_CLSF"."CC_PT_TYPE" = 'O' AND "IDB"."CTC_CLSF"."CC_FINALIZED_IND" = 'Y')) GROUP BY "IDB"."CTC_CLSF"."CC_MRN", "IDB"."CTC_CLSF"."CC_CLSF_CD") AS BASE_QUERY JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS" ON BASE_QUERY.PT_MRN = "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_MRN" JOIN "IDB"."CLM" ON BASE_QUERY.ICD_CODES_ICD_CODE = "IDB"."CLM"."CLM_CLSF_CD" WHERE BASE_QUERY.DIAGNOSIS_DATE BETWEEN '2000-01-01' AND '2023-01-01' AND BASE_QUERY.ICD_CODES_ICD_CODE IN ('621.2', '621.3', '621.30', '621.31', '621.32', '621.33', '621.34', '621.35', 'D07.0', 'N85.00', 'N85.01', 'N85.02', 'N85.2')), COHORT AS (SELECT PT_DEID AS PT_DEID FROM (SELECT DIAGNOSIS_0.PT_DEID AS PT_DEID FROM DIAGNOSIS_0)), COHORT_DIAGNOSIS AS (SELECT SUBJECT_ID AS SUBJECT_ID, PT_DEID AS PT_DEID FROM (SELECT DIAGNOSIS_0.SUBJECT_ID AS SUBJECT_ID, DIAGNOSIS_0.PT_DEID AS PT_DEID FROM DIAGNOSIS_0)), KEYS AS (SELECT COHORT.PT_DEID AS COHORT_PT_DEID, COHORT_DIAGNOSIS.SUBJECT_ID AS COHORT_DIAGNOSIS_SUBJECT_ID, COHORT_DIAGNOSIS.PT_DEID AS COHORT_DIAGNOSIS_PT_DEID FROM COHORT LEFT OUTER JOIN COHORT_DIAGNOSIS ON COHORT_DIAGNOSIS.PT_DEID = COHORT.PT_DEID), DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS AS (SELECT DISTINCT "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AS PT_DEID, IDB_PATIENT."PT_MRN" AS PT_MRN, "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AS SUBJECT_ID FROM "IDB"."PATIENT" AS IDB_PATIENT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS" ON IDB_PATIENT."PT_MRN" = "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_MRN"), ANTINEOPLASTICS_COLUMNS AS (SELECT DISTINCT "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AS PT_DEID, "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_MRN" AS PT_MRN, CAST(TRIM("IDB"."ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX_V"."APR_ORDER_SOURCE_ID") AS VARCHAR) || CAST(TRIM("IDB"."ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX_V"."APR_MRN") AS VARCHAR) AS SUBJECT_ID, "IDB"."CHEMO_DRUG_GENERIC"."CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME" AS CHEMO_DRUG_NAME, "IDB"."CHEMO_DRUG_GENERIC"."CDG_DRUG_TYPE" AS CHEMO_DRUG_TYPE, "IDB"."ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX_V"."APR_START_DTE" AS CHEMO_START_DATE, "IDB"."ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX_V"."APR_END_DTE" AS CHEMO_END_DATE, "IDB"."ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX_V"."APR_ORD_RX_TYPE" AS CHEMO_RX_TYPE, "IDB"."CHEMO_DRUG_GENERIC"."CDG_CHEMO_FLAG" AS CHEMO_FLAG_CHEMO, "IDB"."CHEMO_DRUG_GENERIC"."CDG_BIOLOGIC_IMMUNO_FLAG" AS CHEMO_FLAG_BIO_IMMUNO, "IDB"."CHEMO_DRUG_GENERIC"."CDG_HORMONE_FLAG" AS CHEMO_FLAG_HORMONE, "IDB"."CHEMO_DRUG_GENERIC"."CDG_TARGETED_FLAG" AS CHEMO_FLAG_TARGETED, "IDB"."CHEMO_DRUG_GENERIC"."CDG_BONE_AGENTS_FLAG" AS CHEMO_FLAG_BONE_AGENT, CASE WHEN ("IDB"."ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX_V"."CDG_IMMUNOTHERAPY_FLAG" = 'Y') THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS CHEMO_FLAG_IMMUNO, "IDB"."ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX_V"."APR_ORAL_FLAG" AS CHEMO_FLAG_ORAL, "IDB"."ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX_V"."APR_PLACEBO_FLAG" AS CHEMO_FLAG_PLACEBO, "IDB"."ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX_V"."APR_INVESTIGATIVE_FLAG" AS CHEMO_FLAG_INVESTIGATIVE FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS" JOIN "IDB"."ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX_V" ON "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_MRN" = "IDB"."ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX_V"."APR_MRN" JOIN "IDB"."CHEMO_DRUG_GENERIC" ON "IDB"."ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX_V"."APR_GENERIC_NAME" = "IDB"."CHEMO_DRUG_GENERIC"."CDG_GENERIC_NAME") SELECT DISTINCT DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS.PT_MRN AS MRN, ANTINEOPLASTICS_COLUMNS.CHEMO_DRUG_NAME AS CHEMO_DRUG_NAME, ANTINEOPLASTICS_COLUMNS.CHEMO_DRUG_TYPE AS CHEMO_DRUG_TYPE, ANTINEOPLASTICS_COLUMNS.CHEMO_START_DATE AS CHEMO_START_DATE, ANTINEOPLASTICS_COLUMNS.CHEMO_END_DATE AS CHEMO_END_DATE, ANTINEOPLASTICS_COLUMNS.CHEMO_RX_TYPE AS CHEMO_RX_TYPE, ANTINEOPLASTICS_COLUMNS.CHEMO_FLAG_CHEMO AS CHEMO_FLAG_CHEMO, ANTINEOPLASTICS_COLUMNS.CHEMO_FLAG_BIO_IMMUNO AS CHEMO_FLAG_BIO_IMMUNO, ANTINEOPLASTICS_COLUMNS.CHEMO_FLAG_HORMONE AS CHEMO_FLAG_HORMONE, ANTINEOPLASTICS_COLUMNS.CHEMO_FLAG_TARGETED AS CHEMO_FLAG_TARGETED, ANTINEOPLASTICS_COLUMNS.CHEMO_FLAG_BONE_AGENT AS CHEMO_FLAG_BONE_AGENT, ANTINEOPLASTICS_COLUMNS.CHEMO_FLAG_IMMUNO AS CHEMO_FLAG_IMMUNO, ANTINEOPLASTICS_COLUMNS.CHEMO_FLAG_ORAL AS CHEMO_FLAG_ORAL, ANTINEOPLASTICS_COLUMNS.CHEMO_FLAG_PLACEBO AS CHEMO_FLAG_PLACEBO, ANTINEOPLASTICS_COLUMNS.CHEMO_FLAG_INVESTIGATIVE AS CHEMO_FLAG_INVESTIGATIVE FROM KEYS LEFT OUTER JOIN DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS ON DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS.PT_DEID = KEYS.COHORT_PT_DEID LEFT OUTER JOIN ANTINEOPLASTICS_COLUMNS ON ANTINEOPLASTICS_COLUMNS.PT_DEID = KEYS.COHORT_PT_DEID;

prompt:
I would like to receive a Monthly list of patients admitted to the Solid Tumor Red, GU Med or thoracic medicine services and discharged to hospice (inpatient or outpatient hospice including Calvary) from the past month.



I would like the  If it can be broken up into discharges to home or facility.
completion: SELECT IIPA_ADM_ID, IIPA_MRN, IIPA_ADM_DT, IIPA_DISCH_DT, IIPA_ADM_SVC_CD, IIPA_ADM_SVC_DESC, IIPA_DISCH_SVC_CD, IIPA_DISCH_SVC_DESC, IIPA_DISCH_DISP_SHORT_DESC, TRIM(SV.AV_DESC) AS DISCHARGE_DESCRIPTION, CASE TRIM(SV.AV_DESC) WHEN 'DSCHD TO HOSPICE-HOME' THEN 'Home Hospice' ELSE 'Other Facility' END AS HOME, IIPA_LOS FROM IDB.ID_IP_ADMISSIONS IIA LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS SV ON SV.AV_ELEMENT = 'DSCH_DISP' AND SV.AV_CODE = IIA.IIPA_DISCH_DISP_CD WHERE IIPA_DISCH_SVC_CD IN ('GUO', 'STR', 'LUN') AND IIPA_DISCH_DISP_SHORT_DESC = 'HOSPICE' AND IIA.IIPA_ADM_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT date - 2 MONTHS AND CURRENT date -1 MONTH AND IIA.IIPA_DISCH_DT IS NOT NULL ORDER BY IIA.IIPA_ADM_DTE, IIPA_DISCH_SVC_CD; SELECT IIPA_DISCH_SVC_CD, DISCHARGESHORTDESCRIPTION, DISCHARGE_DESCRIPTION, AVG(IIPA_LOS) AS AVG_LOS, COUNT(IIPA_MRN) AS NUMBEROFDISCHARGES FROM (SELECT IIPA_MRN, IIPA_ADM_DT, IIPA_DISCH_DT, IIPA_DISCH_SVC_CD, IIPA_DISCH_SVC_DESC, IIPA_DISCH_DISP_SHORT_DESC AS DISCHARGESHORTDESCRIPTION, TRIM(SV.AV_DESC) AS DISCHARGE_DESCRIPTION, IIPA_LOS FROM IDB.ID_IP_ADMISSIONS IIA LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS SV ON SV.AV_ELEMENT = 'DSCH_DISP' AND SV.AV_CODE = IIA.IIPA_DISCH_DISP_CD WHERE IIPA_DISCH_SVC_CD IN ('GUO', 'STR', 'LUN') AND IIA.IIPA_ADM_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT date - 2 MONTHS AND CURRENT date -1 MONTH) GROUP BY IIPA_DISCH_SVC_CD, DISCHARGESHORTDESCRIPTION, DISCHARGE_DESCRIPTION ORDER BY IIPA_DISCH_SVC_CD, AVG(IIPA_LOS) DESC;

prompt: Provide the number of patients treated with checkpoint inhibitors in the last 3 years and the total number of patients that received treatment in the last 3 years, for (a) Soft tissues sarcomas (b) Osteosarcomas (c) Glioma (d) Melanoma and (e) Hodgkin’s Lymphoma
Design a weekly report of patients scheduled for a ANS JRSC KETAMINE appointment who do not have an ANESTH_PACU_Ketamine_Infusion_Orderset ordered for the same date as the scheduled appointment.
completion: WITH APPT AS (SELECT DISTINCT CPE_ENC_DTE AS APPT_DATE, TIME(CPE_APPT_DT) AS APPT_TIME, CPE_MRN AS MRN, STRIP(PT_LAST_NAME) || ', ' || STRIP(PT_FIRST_NAME) AS NAME, STRIP(R1.CRE_RES_NAME) AS INT_REF_PVDR, R1.CRE_RES_TYP AS INT_REF_PVDR_TYPE, R2.CRE_RES_NAME AS PVDR, R2.CRE_RES_TYP AS PVDR_TYPE, CLD_DEPT_NAME, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8, STRIP(CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME) AS CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME, CPE_CPE_APPT_STS FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE R1 ON CPE_REF_RES_ID = R1.CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE R2 ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = R2.CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON CPE_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE 1=1 AND CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Sch') AND CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID = 12361 AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT DATE AND CURRENT DATE + 30 DAYS ) , X AS (SELECT DISTINCT APPT_DATE, APPT_TIME, MRN, NAME, INT_REF_PVDR, CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME, STRIP(OO_SET_NAME) AS OO_SET_NAME, OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE, CASE WHEN OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE IS NOT NULL THEN 'Y' WHEN OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE IS NULL THEN 'N' END AS "Order present (Y/N)", CASE WHEN OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE = APPT_DATE THEN 'correct date' WHEN OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE <> APPT_DATE THEN 'wrong date' END AS FLAG FROM APPT LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_ORDER ON OO_MRN = MRN AND OO_ORD_STS_CD IN ('AUA2', 'HOLD') AND OO_SET_NAME = 'ANESTH_PACU_Ketamine_Infusion_Orderset' ) , Y AS (SELECT X.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY MRN, APPT_DATE ORDER BY FLAG) RN FROM X) , Z AS (SELECT * FROM Y WHERE RN = 1 AND("Order present (Y/N)" = 'N' OR FLAG = 'wrong date') ) SELECT Z.*, CASE WHEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Z) = 0 THEN CAST('X' AS REAL) ELSE CAST(1 AS REAL) END AS "Run/Fail" FROM Z

prompt: Design a Tableau dashboard to track Telephone and Telemed visits compared to other services.
completion: SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN AS MRN, CPE_PRK AS PRK, CPE_ENC_CSN_ID, CPE_ENC_DTE AS "Visit Date", DAYOFWEEK(CPE_ENC_DTE) AS DOW, CASE WHEN DAYOFWEEK(CPE_ENC_DTE) = 1 THEN 'Sunday' WHEN DAYOFWEEK(CPE_ENC_DTE) = 2 THEN 'Monday' WHEN DAYOFWEEK(CPE_ENC_DTE) = 3 THEN 'Tuesday' WHEN DAYOFWEEK(CPE_ENC_DTE) = 4 THEN 'Wednesday' WHEN DAYOFWEEK(CPE_ENC_DTE) = 5 THEN 'Thursday' WHEN DAYOFWEEK(CPE_ENC_DTE) = 6 THEN 'Friday' WHEN DAYOFWEEK(CPE_ENC_DTE) = 7 THEN 'Saturday' ELSE '' END AS DAYNAME, D1.CLD_DEPT_ID AS DEPT_ID, D1.CLD_DEPT_NAME AS DEPT_NAME, D1.CLD_CLD_CENTER AS DEPT_ABBR, D1.CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 AS GRP6, D1.CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 AS GRP8, CASE WHEN D1.CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 = '' THEN D1.CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 ELSE D1.CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 END AS SVC, R1.CRE_RES_NAME AS ATTENDING, R1.CRE_RES_TYP, CASE WHEN CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME LIKE '%NV%' OR CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME LIKE '%IR%' THEN 'NV/IR' WHEN CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME LIKE '%FR%' THEN 'FR' WHEN CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME LIKE '%CONSULT%' THEN 'CONSULT' WHEN CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME LIKE '%PR%' OR CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME = 'PUMP REFILL' THEN 'PR' ELSE 'OTHER' END AS "VISIT TYPE ROLLUP", CASE WHEN UPPER(CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME) LIKE '%TELEHEALTH%' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS "Telehealth", CASE WHEN UPPER(CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME) LIKE '%PHONE%' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS "Phone", CASE WHEN UPPER(CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME) LIKE '%TELEHEALTH%' THEN 'Telehealth' WHEN UPPER(CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME) LIKE '%PHONE%' THEN 'Phone' ELSE 'In-Clinic' END "Visit Type", CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME AS VISIT_TYPE_NAME, CPE_CPE_APPT_STS AS VISIT_STATUS FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE R1 ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = R1.CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT D1 ON CPE_DEPT_ID = D1.CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp', 'Sch') AND R1.CRE_RES_TYP IN ('Physician', 'Nurse Practitioner') AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN '2020-01-01' AND CURRENT DATE + 3 MONTHS AND R1.CRE_RES_NAME not like '%EHS SCREENING%'

prompt: Daily report to track mobile cart usage for Bergen
completion: SELECT RTRIM(PT_LAST_NAME) || ', ' || PT_FIRST_NAME AS "Patient Name", APPT.CPA_MRN AS "MRN", APPT.CPA_ENC_DTE AS "Appt date", TIME(APPT.CPA_RES_STRT_DT) AS "Appt time", CPE_CPE_APPT_STS AS "Appt Status", PVD.CRE_RES_NAME AS "Provider Name", REF_PVD.CRE_RES_NAME AS "Referring Provider Name" FROM IDB.CL_PT_APPT APPT LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE PVD ON APPT.CPA_RES_ID = PVD.CRE_RES_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER ON APPT.CPA_ENC_CSN_ID = CPE_ENC_CSN_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE REF_PVD ON CPE_REF_RES_ID = REF_PVD.CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON APPT.CPA_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS <> 'Can' AND PVD.CRE_RES_ABBR LIKE 'BERMOBILE%' AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT DATE AND CURRENT DATE + 7 DAYS ORDER BY APPT.CPA_ENC_DTE, TIME(APPT.CPA_RES_STRT_DT)

prompt: Provide the CMP and CBC lab results of all patients enrolled in IRB# 15-178 during their chemotherapy regimen.
completion: WITH CTE AS (SELECT ACD_IRB_NO IRB_NO, ACD_MRN, O.AC_LAST_NAME LAST_NAME, O.AC_FIRST_NAME FIRST_NAME, O.AC_DOB DOB, O.AC_RACE RACE, O.AC_SEX SEX , ACD_CONS_DTE CONSENT_DATE, ACD_OFF_STUDY_DTE OFF_STUDY_DATE FROM IDB.ACCRUALS_DATES JOIN IDB.ACCRUALS O ON ACD_IRB_NO = O.AC_IRB_NO AND ACD_MRN = O.AC_MRN WHERE ACD_IRB_NO = '15-178' AND ACD_MRN <> 'ZZZZZZZZZZZZ' ) , CHEMO AS (SELECT APR_MRN CHEMO_MRN , MIN(APR_START_DTE) CHEMO_START , MAX(APR_END_DTE) CHEMO_END FROM CTE JOIN IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX_V ON ACD_MRN = APR_MRN WHERE CDG_CHEMO_FLAG = 'Y' GROUP BY APR_MRN) SELECT DISTINCT IRB_NO, LR_MRN MRN, LAST_NAME, FIRST_NAME, DOB, RACE, SEX , CONSENT_DATE, OFF_STUDY_DATE, CHEMO_START, CHEMO_END, LR_ACCESSION_NO ACCESSION_NO, LR_PERFORMED_DTE COLLECTION_DTE , LR_TEST_NAME PANEL_NAME, LR_SUBTEST_NAME TEST_NAME, LR_RESULT_VALUE RESULT_VALUE, LR_UNIT_MEASURE UNIT_MEASURE, LR_TEST_UP_LIMIT UP_LIMIT, LR_TEST_LOW_LIMIT LOW_LIMIT, CASE LR_ABNORMALITY_CD WHEN 'U' THEN '' WHEN 'L' THEN 'Low' WHEN 'H' THEN 'High' END ABNORMALITY_FLAG , LTL_TEXT_RESULT AS COMMENTS FROM CHEMO JOIN CTE ON CHEMO_MRN = ACD_MRN JOIN IDB.LAB_RESULTS ON CHEMO_MRN = LR_MRN AND LR_PERFORMED_DTE BETWEEN CHEMO_START - 1 MONTH AND CHEMO_END + 1 MONTH LEFT JOIN IDB.LAB_TEXT_LINE ON LR_MRN = LTL_MRN AND LR_RESULT_GUID = LTL_RESULT_GUID AND LTL_LINE_NO = 1 WHERE LR_TEST_NAME IN ('Complete Blood Count', 'Complete Blood Count (CBC), Standard', 'Complete Blood Count (CBC), with ANC only' , 'Complete Blood Count (CBC), With Differential', 'Complete Blood Count (CBC), WITH Differential', 'Comprehensive Metabolic Panel', 'Comprehensive Metabolic Panel, Plasma') AND LR_RESULT_VALUE > '' AND LR_SUBTEST_NAME NOT IN ('Differential Comment', 'Differential Type', 'Review Blood Smear', 'Review Smear.', 'Type');

prompt: Radiographic diagnosis of pancreatic cystic neoplasm
completion: WITH DX AS (SELECT CC_MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS DX_DTE, CC_CLSF_CD AS ICD_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS ICD_DESC FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE (CC_CLSF_CD like 'K86.2%' OR CC_CLSF_CD like 'D13.6%') AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND (CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) GROUP BY CC_MRN, CC_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK HAVING MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) BETWEEN '1998-01-01' AND '2021-08-06') SELECT RRPT_MRN, PT_SEX, PT_BIRTH_DTE, FAD_FST_APPT_DTE, DX_DTE, ICD_CD, ICD_DESC, RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE, RRPT_ORDER_GROUP, RRPT_PROCEDURE_NAME, RRPT_REPORT_TXT FROM DV.RADIOLOGY_REPORT_V JOIN DX ON CC_MRN = RRPT_MRN JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON RRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID JOIN DV.PATIENT_FIRST_ACTV_DTL ON RRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = FAD_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID WHERE RRPT_ORDER_GROUP IN ('CT', 'MR') AND CONTAINS("RRPT_REPORT_TXT", '("ipmn" OR "intraductal papillary mucinous neoplasm")') = 1 AND RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE BETWEEN '1998-01-01' AND '2021-08-06' ; WITH DX AS (SELECT CC_MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS DX_DTE, CC_CLSF_CD AS ICD_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS ICD_DESC FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE (CC_CLSF_CD like 'K86.2%' OR CC_CLSF_CD like 'D13.6%') AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND (CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) GROUP BY CC_MRN, CC_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK HAVING MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) BETWEEN '1998-01-01' AND '2021-08-06') , MR AS (SELECT DISTINCT RRPT_MRN, PT_SEX, PT_BIRTH_DTE, FAD_FST_APPT_DTE, DX_DTE, ICD_CD, ICD_DESC, RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE FROM DV.RADIOLOGY_REPORT_V JOIN DX ON CC_MRN = RRPT_MRN JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON RRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID JOIN DV.PATIENT_FIRST_ACTV_DTL ON RRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = FAD_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID WHERE RRPT_ORDER_GROUP IN ('CT', 'MR') AND CONTAINS("RRPT_REPORT_TXT", '("ipmn" OR "intraductal papillary mucinous neoplasm")') = 1 AND RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE BETWEEN '1998-01-01' AND '2021-08-06' ) SELECT DISTINCT SSE_MRN, DX_DTE, SSE_SURG_DTE, SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD, SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC, SSP_SURG_SVC_CD FROM IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE ON SSE_LOG_ID = SSP_LOG_ID AND SSE_ENC_CSN_ID = SSP_ENC_CSN_ID JOIN MR ON SSE_MRN = RRPT_MRN WHERE SSP_SURG_SVC_CD IN ('GI', 'GMT', 'HEP', 'IR') AND SSE_SURG_DTE BETWEEN '1998-01-01' AND '2021-08-06' ; WITH DX AS (SELECT CC_MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS DX_DTE, CC_CLSF_CD AS ICD_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS ICD_DESC FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE (CC_CLSF_CD like 'K86.2%' OR CC_CLSF_CD like 'D13.6%') AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND (CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) GROUP BY CC_MRN, CC_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK HAVING MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) BETWEEN '1998-01-01' AND '2021-08-06') , MR AS (SELECT DISTINCT RRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID, RRPT_MRN, PT_SEX, PT_BIRTH_DTE, FAD_FST_APPT_DTE, DX_DTE, ICD_CD, ICD_DESC, RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE FROM DV.RADIOLOGY_REPORT_V JOIN DX ON CC_MRN = RRPT_MRN JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON RRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID JOIN DV.PATIENT_FIRST_ACTV_DTL ON RRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = FAD_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID WHERE RRPT_ORDER_GROUP IN ('CT', 'MR') AND CONTAINS("RRPT_REPORT_TXT", '("ipmn" OR "intraductal papillary mucinous neoplasm")') = 1 AND RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE BETWEEN '1998-01-01' AND '2021-08-06' ) SELECT PRPT_MRN, DX_DTE, PRPT_PROCEDURE_DTE, PRPT_REPORT_DTE, PRPT_REPORT_TYPE_DESC, PRPT_ACCESSION_NO, PRPT_REPORT FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V JOIN MR ON PRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = RRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID WHERE PRPT_REPORT IS NOT NULL AND CONTAINS("PRPT_REPORT", '("pancreas" OR "pancreatic")') = 1 AND PRPT_REPORT_TYPE_DESC IN ('Surgical Pathology', 'Cytology-Non GYN', 'Cytology-Private Non-GYN', 'Cytology-Private Submitted Slides', 'Cytolology-Private-GYN') AND PRPT_REPORT_DTE BETWEEN '1998-01-01' AND '2021-08-06'

prompt: Amend Workday Report for Employee Vaccine Status
completion: WITH DUPS AS (SELECT EVI_EMPLOYEE_ID AS EID, COUNT(DISTINCT EVI_MRN) AS CT FROM IDB.COVID19_EMPLOYEE_VACCINE_INFO WHERE CEVE_CATEGORY IN ('Employees', 'Contingents', 'Pre-hires') AND ELIGIBLE_DTE IS NOT NULL GROUP BY EVI_EMPLOYEE_ID HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT EVI_MRN) > 1) , EMP AS (SELECT EVI_EMPLOYEE_ID, CEVE_CATEGORY, DOSE_1_BRAND, DOSE_1_ADMIN_DTE, DOSE_2_BRAND, DOSE_2_ADMIN_DTE, VACCINE_EXEMPTION_REASON, VACCINE_EXEMPTION_DTE, VACCINE_EXEMPTION_EXP_DTE, DOSE_1_APPT_DT, DOSE_1_APPT_STATUS, DOSE_2_APPT_DT, DOSE_2_APPT_STATUS FROM IDB.COVID19_EMPLOYEE_VACCINE_INFO WHERE CEVE_CATEGORY IN ('Employees', 'Contingents', 'Pre-hires') AND ELIGIBLE_DTE IS NOT NULL AND EVI_EMPLOYEE_ID NOT IN (SELECT EID FROM DUPS) UNION ALL SELECT EVI_EMPLOYEE_ID, CEVE_CATEGORY, MAX(DOSE_1_BRAND) DOSE_1_BRAND, MAX(DOSE_1_ADMIN_DTE) DOSE_1_ADMIN_DTE, MAX(DOSE_2_BRAND) DOSE_2_BRAND, MAX(DOSE_2_ADMIN_DTE) DOSE_2_ADMIN_DTE, MAX(VACCINE_EXEMPTION_REASON) VACCINE_EXEMPTION_REASON, MAX(VACCINE_EXEMPTION_DTE) VACCINE_EXEMPTION_DTE, MAX(VACCINE_EXEMPTION_EXP_DTE) VACCINE_EXEMPTION_EXP_DTE, MAX(DOSE_1_APPT_DT) DOSE_1_APPT_DT, MAX(DOSE_1_APPT_STATUS) DOSE_1_APPT_STATUS, MAX(DOSE_2_APPT_DT) DOSE_2_APPT_DT, MAX(DOSE_2_APPT_STATUS) DOSE_2_APPT_STATUS FROM IDB.COVID19_EMPLOYEE_VACCINE_INFO JOIN DUPS ON EVI_EMPLOYEE_ID = EID WHERE CEVE_CATEGORY IN ('Employees', 'Contingents', 'Pre-hires') AND ELIGIBLE_DTE IS NOT NULL GROUP BY EVI_EMPLOYEE_ID, CEVE_CATEGORY) , FIN AS (SELECT A.*, TRIM(CVP_NAME) CVP_NAME, CASE WHEN (DOSE_1_BRAND LIKE 'Janssen%' AND DOSE_1_ADMIN_DTE IS NOT NULL) OR (DOSE_2_ADMIN_DTE IS NOT NULL) THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS VACCINE_SERIES_COMPLETE, CASE WHEN VACCINE_EXEMPTION_DTE <= CURRENT DATE AND (VACCINE_EXEMPTION_EXP_DTE IS NULL OR VACCINE_EXEMPTION_EXP_DTE >= CURRENT DATE) THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS "Exemption Flag", CASE WHEN DOSE_1_ADMIN_DTE IS NOT NULL THEN 'Completed' WHEN DOSE_1_ADMIN_DTE IS NULL AND DOSE_1_APPT_STATUS = 'PRE' THEN 'MSK Scheduled' ELSE 'No Record' END AS DOSE_1, CASE WHEN DOSE_2_ADMIN_DTE IS NOT NULL THEN 'Completed' WHEN DOSE_2_ADMIN_DTE IS NULL AND DOSE_2_APPT_STATUS = 'PRE' THEN 'MSK Scheduled' ELSE 'No Record' END AS DOSE_2, CASE WHEN CVP_VACC_REMT_EXMP_IND = 'Y' THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS REMOTE_FLAG, CVP_VACC_REMT_EXMP_EFF_DTE AS REMOTE_EFFECTIVE_DATE FROM EMP A JOIN IDB.COVID19_VACCINE_PERSON ON EVI_EMPLOYEE_ID = CVP_EMPLOYEE_ID) SELECT DISTINCT TRIM(EVI_EMPLOYEE_ID) "Employee ID", TRIM(CVP_NAME) "Employee Name", VACCINE_SERIES_COMPLETE "Vaccine Series Complete", "Exemption Flag", DOSE_1, DOSE_2, REMOTE_FLAG "Remote Worker Flag", REMOTE_EFFECTIVE_DATE "Date Effective" FROM FIN

prompt: Provide a list of pediatric patients receiving scans with and without anesthesia based on scan type and patient demographics
completion: WITH SCAN AS (SELECT CPE_MRN AS "MRN", PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_SEX, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, YEAR(CPE_ENC_DTE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) "Age at scan", CPE_ENC_DTE AS "Appt Date", CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 AS "Department", CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 AS "Service", CLD_DEPT_NAME AS "Department Name", CRE_RES_NAME AS "Provider Name", CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME AS "Visit Type" FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON CPE_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN '2018-07-01' AND '2019-07-31' AND CLD_DEPT_NAME IN ('RADIOLOGY (ADV) 1275', 'NUCLEAR MEDICINE 1275') AND YEAR(CPE_ENC_DTE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) BETWEEN 5 AND 23 AND (CRE_RES_NAME LIKE '%CT %' OR CRE_RES_NAME LIKE '%MRI %' OR CRE_RES_NAME LIKE '%PET %' OR CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME = 'NM MIBG SCAN 24HRS I123') ) , ANES AS (SELECT CPE_MRN AS "MRN", CPE_ENC_DTE AS "Appt Date" FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON CPE_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN '2018-07-01' AND '2019-07-31' AND CLD_DEPT_NAME IN ('PACC PROC RM 1275') AND YEAR(CPE_ENC_DTE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) BETWEEN 5 AND 23 ) , CDB AS (SELECT TM_MRN, LISTAGG(TM_DX_DTE || ': ' || TRIM(TM_SITE_CD) || ' - ' || TRIM(SI.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK) || ' ' || TRIM(TM_HIST_CD) || ' - ' || TRIM(H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK) || ' ' || TRIM(TM_CASE_STS) || ' - ' || TRIM(CS.AV_DESC), CHR(13) || CHR(10)) "Tumor" FROM (SELECT DISTINCT "MRN" FROM SCAN) S JOIN IDB.CDB_TUMOR ON "MRN" = TM_MRN JOIN IDB.CLM H ON TM_HIST_CD = H.CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.CLM SI ON TM_SITE_CD = SI.CLM_CLSF_CD LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS CS ON CS.AV_ELEMENT = 'CASE_STS' AND CS.AV_CODE = TM_CASE_STS WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7') GROUP BY TM_MRN ) SELECT DISTINCT S."MRN", PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_SEX, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, "Age at scan", S."Appt Date", "Department", "Service", "Department Name", "Provider Name", "Visit Type", CASE WHEN A."MRN" IS NOT NULL THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END "With Anesthesia", "Tumor" FROM SCAN S LEFT JOIN ANES A ON S."MRN" = A."MRN" AND S."Appt Date" = A."Appt Date" LEFT JOIN CDB ON S."MRN" = TM_MRN

prompt: Upcoming appointments  of  the patients who had  appointments with Dr. Luke Pike
completion: WITH COMP AS (SELECT CPE_MRN P_MRN , CPE_ENC_DTE P_DATE, 'Completed' APPT_STS FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CRE_RES_ID = '027201' AND CPE_ENC_DTE >= CURRENT Date - 15 MONTHS ) , SCH AS (SELECT CPE_MRN , CPE_ENC_DTE , 'Scheduled' AS APT_STS FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS = 'Sch' AND CRE_RES_ID = '027201' AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT date AND CURRENT Date + 1 MONTH ) , PIKE AS (SELECT * FROM COMP UNION SELECT * FROM SCH) SELECT CPE_MRN , TRIM(PT_LAST_NAME) || ', ' || TRIM(PT_FIRST_NAME) AS "Patient Name", CPE_ENC_DTE AS "Appointment Date", 'Scheduled' AS "Appointment Status", CLD_DEPT_NAME AS "Department", CASE WHEN CRE_RES_TYP IN ('Physician', 'PhD', 'Psychologist', 'Dentist', 'Nurse Practitioner', 'Physician Assistant', 'Advanced Practice Nurse', 'Fellow') THEN 'MD Appt - ' || TRIM(CRE_RES_NAME) ELSE 'Other - ' || TRIM(CRE_RES_NAME) END AS "Provider / Resource", CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME AS "Visit Type" FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID JOIN PIKE ON P_MRN = CPE_MRN JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PT_MRN = CPE_MRN WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS = 'Sch' AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT date AND CURRENT Date + 15 DAYS

prompt: Provide a monthly list of "collect to result" for CBC and BMP in the Urgent Care Center to main laboratory
completion: WITH X AS (SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN, CPE_ENC_DTE FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID WHERE CLD_DEPT_NAME = 'UCC 1275' AND CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') ), X1 AS (SELECT DISTINCT LR_MRN, LR_PERFORMED_DT PERFORMED_DATE_AND_TIME, LR_ENTER_DT RESULT_DATE_AND_TIME, FLOOR(LR_ENTER_DT -LR_PERFORMED_DT) RESULT_RECEIVED_DATE, LR_TEST_NAME, LR_SUBTEST_NAME, LR_RESULT_VALUE, LTL_TEXT_RESULT, LR_ABNORMALITY_CD FROM X JOIN IDB.LAB_RESULTS ON CPE_MRN = LR_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.LAB_TEXT_LINE ON LTL_RESULT_GUID = LR_RESULT_GUID WHERE (LR_TEST_NAME IN 'Basic Metabolic Panel' OR UPPER(LR_TEST_NAME) like '%CBC%') AND LR_PERFORMED_DTE BETWEEN DATE('2023-10-13') - 30 DAYS AND DATE('2023-10-13') ), FIN AS (SELECT DISTINCT LR_MRN, PERFORMED_DATE_AND_TIME, RESULT_DATE_AND_TIME, RESULT_RECEIVED_DATE, LR_TEST_NAME, LPAD(RESULT_RECEIVED_DATE, 6, 0) COMPL, LR_SUBTEST_NAME, LR_RESULT_VALUE, LTL_TEXT_RESULT, LR_ABNORMALITY_CD FROM X1) SELECT DISTINCT LR_MRN, PERFORMED_DATE_AND_TIME, RESULT_DATE_AND_TIME, RESULT_RECEIVED_DATE, COMPL, LR_TEST_NAME, SUBSTR(COMPL, 1, 2) ||'hr' || SUBSTR(COMPL, 3, 2) || 'mins '|| SUBSTR(COMPL, 5, 2) AS DIFF_TIME, LR_SUBTEST_NAME, LR_RESULT_VALUE, LTL_TEXT_RESULT, LR_ABNORMALITY_CD FROM FIN

prompt: Provide race, ethnicity, and gender for a list of MRNs.
Identify patients who had an NV/IR visit to colorectal surgery since 2012 and have had DMP testing done.
completion: SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN AS "MRN", CPE_ENC_DTE AS "Appt Date", CLD_DEPT_NAME AS "Department Name", CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME AS "Visit Type", ACD_CONS_DTE "Consent Date", METHOD, PATH_RPT_DATE, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_DESC FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.ACCRUALS_DATES ON ACD_MRN = CPE_MRN AND ACD_IRB_NO = '12-245' JOIN IDB.PATIENT A ON CPE_MRN = A.PT_MRN JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_STRUCTURED_RESULTS_V B ON B.PT_MRN = A.PT_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.CDB_TUMOR ON TM_MRN = A.PT_MRN AND (TM_SITE_CD like 'C18%' OR TM_SITE_CD like 'C19%' OR TM_SITE_CD like 'C20%') LEFT JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 = 'COL' AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 = 'SRG' AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN '2012-01-01' AND CURRENT date AND (CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR LIKE '%NV%' OR CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR LIKE '%IR%') AND METHOD = 'IMPACT' ;

prompt: Provide a list of light chain deposition cases from May 2009 to present and a list of NLPHL cases from January 2019 to present.
completion: SELECT PT_MRN AS "MRN", PT_LAST_NAME AS "Last Name", PT_FIRST_NAME AS "First Name", PT_BIRTH_DTE AS "DOB", PRPT_ACCESSION_NO AS "Path Accession Number", PRPT_REPORT_TYPE "Path Report Type", PRPT_REPORT AS "Path Report" FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT JOIN DV.DATE R ON R.DT_DATE_ID = PRPT_REPORT_DATE_ID JOIN DV.PATH_RPRT_TYPE_LOOKUP ON PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_CD = PRPT_REPORT_TYPE JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON PRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID WHERE CONTAINS("PRPT_REPORT", '("light chain deposition")') = 1 AND R.DT_DTE >= '2009-01-01' AND PRPT_REPORT IS NOT NULL AND (PRPT_ACCESSION_NO like 'H%' OR PRPT_ACCESSION_NO like 'S%') ; SELECT PT_MRN AS "MRN", PT_LAST_NAME AS "Last Name", PT_FIRST_NAME AS "First Name", PT_BIRTH_DTE AS "DOB", PRPT_ACCESSION_NO AS "Path Accession Number", PRPT_REPORT AS "Path Report" FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT JOIN DV.DATE R ON R.DT_DATE_ID = PRPT_REPORT_DATE_ID JOIN DV.PATH_RPRT_TYPE_LOOKUP ON PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_CD = PRPT_REPORT_TYPE JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON PRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID WHERE (CONTAINS("PRPT_REPORT", '("nodular lymphocyte predominant Hodgkin lymphoma")') = 1 OR CONTAINS("PRPT_REPORT", '("nodular lymphocyte predominent Hodgkin lymphoma")') = 1) AND R.DT_DTE >= '2019-01-01' AND PRPT_REPORT IS NOT NULL AND (PRPT_ACCESSION_NO like 'H%' OR PRPT_ACCESSION_NO like 'S%') ; SELECT PT_MRN AS "MRN", PT_LAST_NAME AS "Last Name", PT_FIRST_NAME AS "First Name", PT_BIRTH_DTE AS "DOB", PRPT_ACCESSION_NO AS "Path Accession Number", PRPT_REPORT AS "Path Report" FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT JOIN DV.DATE R ON R.DT_DATE_ID = PRPT_REPORT_DATE_ID JOIN DV.PATH_RPRT_TYPE_LOOKUP ON PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_CD = PRPT_REPORT_TYPE JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON PRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID WHERE (CONTAINS("PRPT_REPORT", '("progressive transformation of germinal centers")') = 1 OR CONTAINS("PRPT_REPORT", '("PTGC")') = 1) AND R.DT_DTE >= '2015-01-01' AND PRPT_REPORT IS NOT NULL AND (PRPT_ACCESSION_NO like 'H%' OR PRPT_ACCESSION_NO like 'S%') AND (PRPT_REPORT_TYPE like '%_R' OR PRPT_REPORT_TYPE like '%_HR') ; SELECT PT_MRN AS "MRN", PT_LAST_NAME AS "Last Name", PT_FIRST_NAME AS "First Name", PT_BIRTH_DTE AS "DOB", PRPT_ACCESSION_NO AS "Path Accession Number", PRPT_REPORT AS "Path Report" FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT JOIN DV.DATE R ON R.DT_DATE_ID = PRPT_REPORT_DATE_ID JOIN DV.PATH_RPRT_TYPE_LOOKUP ON PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_CD = PRPT_REPORT_TYPE JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON PRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID WHERE (CONTAINS("PRPT_REPORT", '("T cell histiocyte rich large B cell lymphoma")') = 1 OR CONTAINS("PRPT_REPORT", '("THRLBCL")') = 1) AND R.DT_DTE >= '2015-01-01' AND PRPT_REPORT IS NOT NULL AND (PRPT_ACCESSION_NO like 'H%' OR PRPT_ACCESSION_NO like 'S%') AND (PRPT_REPORT_TYPE like '%_R' OR PRPT_REPORT_TYPE like '%_HR') ;

prompt: Provide a count of ovarian cancer patients.
completion: WITH "cte1" AS (SELECT DISTINCT "t1"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AS "Deident PT #", "t2"."DXCC_ICD_CODE" AS "ICD-9 Code", "t2"."DXCC_ICD_MSK_DESC" AS "ICD-9 MSK code description", "t3"."DXA_CIC_CDER_INIT" AS "ICD-9 CIC Coded Indicator" FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED" "t1" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DIAGNOSIS_FINAL_ALL_V" "t3" ON "t1"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t3"."PDX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DIAGNOSIS_CODE_CAT_ICD9_V" "t2" ON "t3"."PDX_DX_CATALOG_ID" = "t2"."DXCC_DX_CATALOG_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE" "t4" ON "t3"."PDX_DX_DATE_ID" = "t4"."DT_DATE_ID" WHERE (("t3"."PDX_DX_CATALOG_ID" IN (5800) AND "t3"."DXA_CIC_CDER_INIT" IN ('YES')) AND "t4"."DT_DTE" BETWEEN '2006-1-1' AND '2009-7-28') ) SELECT COUNT("t1"."Deident PT #") AS "COUNT( Deident PT # )", "t1"."ICD-9 MSK code description" AS "ICD-9 MSK code description" FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED" "t2" INNER JOIN "cte1" "t1" ON "t2"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t1"."Deident PT #" GROUP BY "t1"."ICD-9 MSK code description"

prompt: Provide a list of the most frequently used ORAL medications in the Department of Pediatrics.
completion: SELECT CASE WHEN PIN_GENERIC_NAME = '' THEN '[Non-formulary drugs]' ELSE PIN_GENERIC_NAME END AS GENERIC_NAME, COUNT(*) AS DISPENSES FROM IDB.PHM_ORDER JOIN IDB.PHM_ORD_DTL ON PO_ORD_SEQ = POD_ORD_SEQ JOIN IDB.PHM_ORD_INV ON POD_ORD_SEQ = POI_ORD_SEQ AND POD_ITEM_NO = POI_ITEM_NO JOIN IDB.PHM_INVENTORY ON POI_INV_SEQ = PIN_INV_SEQ JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PO_MRN = PT_MRN AND YEAR(POD_STRT_DTE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) <= 18 AND MONTH(POD_STRT_DTE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) >= 1 WHERE PO_ORD_STS NOT IN ('X', 'P') AND (CURRENT date - 6 MONTHS) <= POD_STRT_DTE AND PO_ROUTE_ABBR = 'ORAL' GROUP BY PIN_GENERIC_NAME ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC

prompt: Provide a list of patients with Hodgkin lymphoma, >18 years of age, who are receiving first salvage chemotherapy from 1/1/2013 ? 12/31/2017
completion: WITH CLINTRAC AS (SELECT CC_MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS MIN_ICD9_EFF_DTE FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE SUBSTR(CC_CLSF_CD, 1, 3) IN ('C81', '201') AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND (CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) GROUP BY CC_MRN ) , TUMOR AS (SELECT DISTINCT TM_MRN, TM_DX_DTE FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS ON AV_ELEMENT = 'CASE_STS' AND AV_CODE = TM_CASE_STS AND TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND TM_HIST_CD BETWEEN 'M9650/3' AND 'M9667/3') , CHEMO AS (SELECT APR_MRN, APR_START_DTE AS CHEMO_START_DTE, CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME AS CHEMO_NAME FROM IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX JOIN IDB.CHEMO_DRUG_GENERIC ON APR_GENERIC_NAME = CDG_GENERIC_NAME WHERE (APR_START_DTE BETWEEN '2013-01-01' AND '2017-12-31') AND CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME IN ('BENDAMUSTINE', 'BRENTUXIMAB VEDOTIN', 'CARBOPLATIN', 'CARMUSTINE', 'CISPLATIN', 'CYCLOPHOSPHAMIDE', 'CYTARABINE', 'DOXORUBICIN LIPOSOMAL', 'ETOPOSIDE', 'EVEROLIMUS', 'GEMCITABINE', 'IFOSFAMIDE', 'LENALIDOMIDE', 'MELPHALAN', 'NIVOLUMAB', 'PEMBROLIZUMAB', 'PROCARBAZINE', 'RITUXIMAB', 'VINCRISTINE', 'VINORELBINE') ) SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, PT_SEX, TM_DX_DTE, MIN_ICD9_EFF_DTE, YEAR(COALESCE(TM_DX_DTE, MIN_ICD9_EFF_DTE) - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) AGE, CHEMO_START_DTE, CHEMO_NAME FROM IDB.PATIENT JOIN CHEMO ON PT_MRN = APR_MRN LEFT JOIN TUMOR ON PT_MRN = TM_MRN LEFT JOIN CLINTRAC ON PT_MRN = CC_MRN WHERE COALESCE(TM_MRN, CC_MRN) IS NOT NULL AND YEAR(COALESCE(TM_DX_DTE, MIN_ICD9_EFF_DTE) - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) >= 18

prompt: Provide mailing addresses of all patients who have had activity in the last 36 months, are not deceased and are over 18 years of age
completion: SELECT DISTINCT CL_PRK AS DEID , CL_LAST_NAME AS LAST_NAME , CL_FIRST_NAME AS FIRST_NAME , CL_ADDR1 AS ADDR1, CL_ADDR2 AS ADDR2, CL_CITY AS CITY , CL_STATE AS STATE, CL_ZIP AS ZIP_CD FROM IDB.CL_PATIENT JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY ON PLA_MRN = CL_MRN AND CL_MRN > ' ' AND PLA_DONOT_MAIL_IND = ' ' AND PLA_LST_ACTV_DTE >= CURRENT DATE - 3 YEARS AND CL_DATE_OF_BIRTH < CURRENT DATE - 18 YEARS JOIN IDB.EMR_PT_DOCUMENT ON CL_MRN = EPD_MRN AND EPD_DOCTYPE IN ('A78', 'A79', 'A80')

prompt: Tableau dashboard for security to distribute COVID-19 Vaccine stickers for employee ID badges.
