prompt: Provide a report of patients who had a Prostate Cipro Screen Culture order in CIS from 1/1/2015 until 12/31/2018 and had a biopsy at least 3 days later.
completion: WITH X AS (SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN AS MRN, PT_SEX AS GENDER, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH AS DOB, YEAR(OO_ENTER_DTE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) AS AGE, R.AV_DESC AS "Race", E.AV_DESC AS "Ethnicity", PT_ZIP_CD AS "Zip Code", OO_ENTER_DTE AS SCREEN_DATE, OO_ORD_NAME AS SCREEN_ORDER FROM IDB.PATIENT JOIN IDB.OMS_ORDER ON OO_MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS R ON PT_RACE = R.AV_CODE AND R.AV_ELEMENT = 'RACE' LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS E ON PT_PT_ETHNICITY = E.AV_CODE AND E.AV_ELEMENT = 'PT_ETHNICITY' WHERE OO_ORD_STS_CD NOT IN ('CANC', 'CANP', 'AUC3') AND OO_ENTER_DTE BETWEEN '2015-01-01' AND '2018-12-31' AND OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID = '9000008144200730' ) , BX AS (SELECT * FROM (SELECT DISTINCT X.*, CPE_ENC_DTE AS BX_DATE, DAYS(CPE_ENC_DTE) - DAYS(SCREEN_DATE) AS DAYS_FROM_ORDER, CRE_RES_NAME, CRE_RES_TYP, CLD_DEPT_NAME, CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY MRN, SCREEN_DATE ORDER BY CPE_ENC_DTE) AS RN_BX FROM X JOIN IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER ON CPE_MRN = MRN AND CPE_ENC_DTE >= SCREEN_DATE + 3 DAYS AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN '2015-01-01' AND '2018-12-31' JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR like 'KUS%' ) BX1 WHERE RN_BX = 1 ) , TMP AS (SELECT DISTINCT CDD_MRN , CDD_SERVICE_DTE , CDD_SERVICE_DT , STRIP(SUBSTR(CDO_VALUE_TEXT, 1, 2000)) AS "Temperature (C)" , CASE WHEN CDO_VALUE_TEXT >= '38.0' THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS "Fever" FROM BX JOIN IDB.CD_DOCUMENT ON CDD_MRN = MRN AND CDD_SERVICE_DTE BETWEEN BX_DATE AND BX_DATE + 30 DAYS AND CDD_CANCEL_IND = '0' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND = '0' JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION ON CDD_DOC_GUID = CDO_DOC_GUID AND CDO_ITEM_NAME IN ('Temperature Temp C') AND CDO_VALUE_TEXT <> '') , MAIN AS (SELECT DISTINCT BX.*, CDD_SERVICE_DT, "Temperature (C)", "Fever" FROM BX LEFT JOIN TMP ON CDD_MRN = MRN AND CDD_SERVICE_DTE BETWEEN BX_DATE AND BX_DATE + 30 DAYS) , LABS AS (SELECT DISTINCT LR_MRN AS MRN, BX_DATE, LR_PERFORMED_DTE AS PERFORMED_DTE, LR_TEST_NAME AS TEST_NAME, LR_SUBTEST_NAME AS SUBTEST_NAME, LR_RESULT_VALUE AS RESULT_VALUE, LR_UNIT_MEASURE AS UNIT_MEASURE, LTL_TEXT_RESULT AS TEXT_RESULT FROM BX JOIN IDB.LAB_RESULTS ON LR_MRN = MRN AND LR_PERFORMED_DTE BETWEEN BX_DATE AND BX_DATE + 30 DAYS LEFT JOIN IDB.LAB_TEXT_LINE ON LTL_RESULT_GUID = LR_RESULT_GUID WHERE(UPPER(LR_TEST_NAME) LIKE '%URINALYSIS%' OR LR_TEST_NAME = 'Bacterial/Fungal Culture, Urine')) , UCC_TRIAGE AS (SELECT DISTINCT CDD_MRN, BX_DATE, CDD_SERVICE_DTE, CDD_DOC_GUID, CDD_DOC_NAME FROM BX JOIN IDB.CD_DOCUMENT ON CDD_MRN = MRN AND CDD_SERVICE_DTE BETWEEN BX_DATE AND BX_DATE + 30 DAYS WHERE CDD_CANCEL_IND = '0' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND = '0' AND UPPER(CDD_DOC_NAME) LIKE '%UCC%' AND UPPER(CDD_DOC_NAME) LIKE '%TRIAGE%' ) , ERX AS (SELECT HCPR_MRN, BX_DATE , HCPR_CREATED_DTE RX_CREATE_DATE , DATE(HCPR_START_DT) START_DATE , HCPR_END_DT AS END_DATE , DATE(HCPR_DISCONTINUE_DT) AS DISCONTINUE_DATE , HCPR_DRUG_NAME AS DRUG_NAME , HGN_GENERIC_NAME AS GENERIC_NAME , HCPR_STATUS_TYPE_DESC AS PRESCRIPTION_STATUS , HCPR_PRESCRIPTION_TYPE_DESC AS RX_TYPE FROM BX JOIN IDB.HML_CLIENT_PRESCRIPTION ON HCPR_MRN = MRN AND DATE(HCPR_START_DT) BETWEEN BX_DATE - 3 MONTHS AND BX_DATE LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_CLIENT_VISIT ON OCV_VISIT_GUID = HCPR_VISIT_GUID LEFT JOIN IDB.HML_GENERIC_NAME ON HGN_GENERIC_NAME_ID = HCPR_GENERIC_NAME_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_USER USR ON USR.OU_USER_GUID = HCPR_USER_GUID LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_USER REQ ON REQ.OU_USER_GUID = HCPR_CARE_PROV_GUID LEFT JOIN IDB.HML_RX_UNIT_OF_MEASURE UOM ON UOM.HRUM_RXUOM_ID = HCPR_DOSE_UOM_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.HML_RX_UNIT_OF_MEASURE PKG ON PKG.HRUM_RXUOM_ID = HCPR_INNER_PACKAGE_SIZE_UOM_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.HML_SCRIPT_FREQUENCY ON HSF_SCRIPT_FREQ_ID = HCPR_SCRIPT_FREQ_ID WHERE HCPR_STATUS_TYPE NOT IN (4, 5, 8) AND HCPR_CREATED_DTE IS NOT NULL AND(HCPR_PRESCRIPTION_TYPE = 1 AND HCPR_TRANSMISSION_STATUS IN (1, 2, 5) OR HCPR_PRESCRIPTION_TYPE = 3) AND(UPPER(HCPR_DRUG_NAME) LIKE '%CIPROFLOXACIN%' OR UPPER(HCPR_DRUG_NAME) LIKE '%CEFTIN%' OR UPPER(HCPR_DRUG_NAME) LIKE '%CEFUROXIME%' OR UPPER(HCPR_DRUG_NAME) LIKE '%SUPRAX%' OR UPPER(HCPR_DRUG_NAME) LIKE '%CEFIXIME%' OR UPPER(HCPR_DRUG_NAME) LIKE '%BACTRIM%' OR UPPER(HCPR_DRUG_NAME) LIKE '%SULFAMETHOXAZOLE%' OR UPPER(HCPR_DRUG_NAME) LIKE '%TRIMETHOPRIM%' OR UPPER(HGN_GENERIC_NAME) LIKE '%CIPROFLOXACIN%' OR UPPER(HGN_GENERIC_NAME) LIKE '%CEFTIN%' OR UPPER(HGN_GENERIC_NAME) LIKE '%CEFUROXIME%' OR UPPER(HGN_GENERIC_NAME) LIKE '%SUPRAX%' OR UPPER(HGN_GENERIC_NAME) LIKE '%CEFIXIME%' OR UPPER(HGN_GENERIC_NAME) LIKE '%BACTRIM%' OR UPPER(HGN_GENERIC_NAME) LIKE '%SULFAMETHOXAZOLE%' OR UPPER(HGN_GENERIC_NAME) LIKE '%TRIMETHOPRIM%') ) , EMAR AS (SELECT DISTINCT OO_MRN AS MRN, BX_DATE , OOTO_SIGNIFIC_DTE, OO_ORD_NAME , OMD_DOSE_LOW AS "Dose", OMD_DOSE_UNIT AS "Unit" , OOTO_TASK_DOSE AS "DOSE (EMAR)", OOTO_TASK_UOM AS "Unit (EMAR)" FROM BX JOIN IDB.OMS_ORDER ON OO_MRN = MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_MED_DETAIL ON OO_ORD_GUID = OMD_ORD_GUID JOIN IDB.OAS_ORD_TASK_OCCR ON OOTO_ORD_GUID = OO_ORD_GUID AND OOTO_STATUS_CD = 'Performed' JOIN IDB.OAS_CTLG_ITEM_TASK ON OOTO_CAT_ITEM_GUID = OCIT_GUID AND OCIT_LEVEL_NO = 0 WHERE OO_ORD_STS_CD NOT IN ('CANC', 'CANP', 'AUC3') AND OOTO_SIGNIFIC_DTE BETWEEN BX_DATE - 3 MONTHS AND BX_DATE AND UPPER(OO_ORD_NAME) LIKE '%MEROPENEM%' ) SELECT CDD_MRN, BX_DATE, CDD_SERVICE_DTE, CDD_DOC_NAME, CDO_SECTION, CDO_CTLG_DISPL_NM, CDO_MSTR_ITEM_NM, CDO_ITEM_NAME, CDO_VALUE_TEXT FROM BX JOIN IDB.CD_DOCUMENT ON CDD_MRN = MRN AND CDD_SERVICE_DTE BETWEEN BX_DATE - 6 MONTHS AND BX_DATE JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION ON CDO_DOC_GUID = CDD_DOC_GUID AND CDO_AUTHORED_DTE = CDD_AUTHORED_DTE WHERE CDD_CANCEL_IND = '0' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND = '0' AND(UPPER(CDD_DOC_NAME) LIKE '%TELEPHONE%' OR UPPER(CDD_DOC_NAME) LIKE '%NURSING%ENCOUNTER%') AND UPPER(CDO_VALUE_TEXT) LIKE '%PROPHYLACTIC%ABX%SCREEN%:%'

prompt: Design a report for a protocol to identify patients that had a hernia following prostatectomy.
completion: WITH SRG AS (SELECT DISTINCT SSE_MRN AS MRN, SSE_SURG_DTE AS RP_DATE, STRIP(SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD) AS CPT_CODE, STRIP(SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC) AS CPT_DESC FROM IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE ON SSE_LOG_ID = SSP_LOG_ID WHERE SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD IN ('55840', '55845', '55866', '55899') #PROMPTMANY('MRN', 'String', ' ', ' and SSE_MRN in (', '', ')') ) , X AS (SELECT DISTINCT CDD_MRN AS MRN, RP_DATE, CPT_CODE, CPT_DESC, CDD_SERVICE_DTE AS "Service Date", CDD_DOC_GUID AS DOC_GUID, CDD_DOC_NAME AS "Document Name", CDO_SECTION, CDO_CTLG_DISPL_NM, CDO_MSTR_ITEM_NM, CDO_ITEM_NAME, STRIP(SUBSTR(CDO_VALUE_TEXT, 1, 200)) AS VALUE_TEXT FROM SRG JOIN IDB.CD_DOCUMENT ON CDD_MRN = MRN JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION ON CDO_DOC_GUID = CDD_DOC_GUID AND CDO_AUTHORED_DTE = CDD_AUTHORED_DTE WHERE CDD_CANCEL_IND = '0' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND = '0' AND CDD_DOC_NAME = 'Follow Up, Prostate - Urology' AND CDO_SECTION = 'Physical Exam' AND CDD_SERVICE_DTE > RP_DATE ) , Y AS (SELECT X.DOC_GUID, MAX(CASE WHEN CDO_MSTR_ITEM_NM = 'URO_PROC_FU_PE Gen RES' THEN VALUE_TEXT END) AS GEN1, MAX(CASE WHEN CDO_MSTR_ITEM_NM = 'URO_PROC_FU_PE_Nrm Gen RES' THEN VALUE_TEXT END) AS GEN2, MAX(CASE WHEN CDO_MSTR_ITEM_NM = 'URO_PROC_FU_PE_Normal General FT' THEN VALUE_TEXT END) AS GEN3, MAX(CASE WHEN CDO_MSTR_ITEM_NM = 'URO_PROC_FU_PE_Abnorm General FT' THEN VALUE_TEXT END) AS GEN4, MAX(CASE WHEN CDO_MSTR_ITEM_NM = 'URO_PROC_FU_PE Abdomen RES' THEN VALUE_TEXT END) AS ABD1, MAX(CASE WHEN CDO_MSTR_ITEM_NM = 'URO_PROC_FU_PE_Nrm Abd RES' THEN VALUE_TEXT END) AS ABD2, MAX(CASE WHEN CDO_MSTR_ITEM_NM = 'URO_PROC_FU_PE_Normal Abdomen FT' THEN VALUE_TEXT END) AS ABD3, MAX(CASE WHEN CDO_MSTR_ITEM_NM = 'URO_PROC_FU_PE_Abnorm Abdomen FT' THEN VALUE_TEXT END) AS ABD4, MAX(CASE WHEN CDO_MSTR_ITEM_NM = 'URO_PROC_FU_PE GU RES' THEN VALUE_TEXT END) AS GU1, MAX(CASE WHEN CDO_MSTR_ITEM_NM = 'URO_PROC_FU_PE_Nrm GU RES' THEN VALUE_TEXT END) AS GU2, MAX(CASE WHEN CDO_MSTR_ITEM_NM = 'URO_PROC_FU_PE_Normal GU FT' THEN VALUE_TEXT END) AS GU3, MAX(CASE WHEN CDO_MSTR_ITEM_NM = 'URO_PROC_FU_PE_Abnorm GU FT' THEN VALUE_TEXT END) AS GU4, MAX(CASE WHEN CDO_MSTR_ITEM_NM = 'URO_PROC_FU_PE C/V RES' THEN VALUE_TEXT END) AS CV1, MAX(CASE WHEN CDO_MSTR_ITEM_NM = 'URO_PROC_FU_PE_Nrm C/V RES' THEN VALUE_TEXT END) AS CV2, MAX(CASE WHEN CDO_MSTR_ITEM_NM = 'URO_PROC_FU_PE_Normal C/V FT' THEN VALUE_TEXT END) AS CV3, MAX(CASE WHEN CDO_MSTR_ITEM_NM = 'URO_PROC_FU_PE_Abnorm C/V FT' THEN VALUE_TEXT END) AS CV4, MAX(CASE WHEN CDO_MSTR_ITEM_NM = 'URO_PROC_FU_PE Other FT' THEN VALUE_TEXT END) AS OTHER FROM X GROUP BY X.DOC_GUID) , Y1 AS (SELECT DOC_GUID, STRIP(CASE WHEN GEN1 IS NULL THEN '' ELSE GEN1 END) AS GEN1, STRIP(CASE WHEN GEN2 IS NULL THEN '' ELSE GEN2 END) AS GEN2, STRIP(CASE WHEN GEN3 IS NULL THEN '' ELSE GEN3 END) AS GEN3, STRIP(CASE WHEN GEN4 IS NULL THEN '' ELSE GEN4 END) AS GEN4, STRIP(CASE WHEN ABD1 IS NULL THEN '' ELSE ABD1 END) AS ABD1, STRIP(CASE WHEN ABD2 IS NULL THEN '' ELSE ABD2 END) AS ABD2, STRIP(CASE WHEN ABD3 IS NULL THEN '' ELSE ABD3 END) AS ABD3, STRIP(CASE WHEN ABD4 IS NULL THEN '' ELSE ABD4 END) AS ABD4, STRIP(CASE WHEN GU1 IS NULL THEN '' ELSE GU1 END) AS GU1, STRIP(CASE WHEN GU2 IS NULL THEN '' ELSE GU2 END) AS GU2, STRIP(CASE WHEN GU3 IS NULL THEN '' ELSE GU3 END) AS GU3, STRIP(CASE WHEN GU4 IS NULL THEN '' ELSE GU4 END) AS GU4, STRIP(CASE WHEN CV1 IS NULL THEN '' ELSE CV1 END) AS CV1, STRIP(CASE WHEN CV2 IS NULL THEN '' ELSE CV2 END) AS CV2, STRIP(CASE WHEN CV3 IS NULL THEN '' ELSE CV3 END) AS CV3, STRIP(CASE WHEN CV4 IS NULL THEN '' ELSE CV4 END) AS CV4, STRIP(CASE WHEN OTHER IS NULL THEN '' ELSE OTHER END) AS OTHER FROM Y) , Y2 AS (SELECT DOC_GUID, GEN1 || ' ' || GEN2 AS "General", GEN3 || ' ' || GEN4 AS "General Comments", ABD1 || ' ' || ABD2 AS "Abdomen", ABD3 || ' ' || ABD4 AS "Abdomen Comments", GU1 || ' ' || GU2 AS "GU", GU3 || ' ' || GU4 AS "GU Comments", CV1 || ' ' || CV2 AS "Cardiovascular", CV3 || ' ' || CV4 AS "Cardiovascular Comments", OTHER FROM Y1) SELECT DISTINCT STRIP(X.MRN) AS MRN, RP_DATE, CPT_CODE, CPT_DESC, X."Service Date", X.DOC_GUID, X."Document Name", STRIP("General") AS "General", STRIP("General Comments") AS "General Comments", STRIP("Abdomen") AS "Abdomen", STRIP("Abdomen Comments") AS "Abdomen Comments", STRIP("GU") AS "GU", STRIP("GU Comments") AS "GU Comments", STRIP("Cardiovascular") AS "Cardiovascular", STRIP("Cardiovascular Comments") AS "Cardiovascular Comments", STRIP(OTHER) AS OTHER FROM X JOIN Y2 ON X.DOC_GUID = Y2.DOC_GUID

prompt: Daily list of Stage III and IV English and Spanish speaking cancer patients
completion: WITH DX AS (SELECT TM_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_PT_ETHNICITY_DESC, PT_PRIMARY_LANG_DESC, AV_DESC AS CASE_STS, TM_DX_DTE, TM_HIST_CD, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS HIST_DESC, TM_SITE_CD, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_DESC, TM_BEST_AJCC_STG FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS ON AV_ELEMENT = 'CASE_STS' AND AV_CODE = TM_CASE_STS JOIN IDB.PATIENT_V ON TM_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND PT_DATE_OF_DEATH IS NULL AND PT_PRIMARY_LANG_DESC IN ('ENGLISH', 'SPANISH') AND (TM_BEST_AJCC_STG LIKE '3%' OR TM_BEST_AJCC_STG LIKE '4%') ) SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN AS "MRN", PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_PT_ETHNICITY_DESC, PT_PRIMARY_LANG_DESC, TM_DX_DTE, TM_HIST_CD, HIST_DESC, TM_SITE_CD, SITE_DESC, TM_BEST_AJCC_STG, CPE_ENC_DTE AS "Appt Date", CLD_CLD_CENTER, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 AS "Department", CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 AS "Service", CLD_DEPT_NAME AS "Department Name", CRE_RES_NAME AS "Provider Name", CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME AS "Visit Type", CVT_EXT_NAME AS "Visit Type External" FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID JOIN DX ON CPE_MRN = TM_MRN WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Sch') AND CPE_ENC_DTE = CURRENT DATE + 1 DAY AND (CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 IN ('BRE', 'SUP', 'GU') OR CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 = 'PSY' OR CLD_CLD_CENTER = '1919') ORDER BY PT_LAST_NAME, TM_DX_DTE, TM_HIST_CD, TM_SITE_CD, CLD_CLD_CENTER, CLD_DEPT_NAME, CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME

prompt: Provide a monthly report of all patients who have a completed outpatient MD and CT appointments on the same day with review of time frames for results and appointments.
completion: SELECT MD_APPT.MRN, MD_APPT_DTE, MD_CHK_IN_DT , MD_CHK_IN_DT, MD_RM_IN_DT, MD_RM_OUT_DT, MD_DEPT , MD_NAME, MD_VST_NAME, MD_VST_TYPE, CT_APPT_DTE, CT_CHK_IN_DT , CT_CHK_IN_DT, CT_RM_IN_DT , CT_RM_OUT_DT, CT_DEPT , CT_NAME, CT_VST_NAME, CT_VST_TYPE , ORD.OO_ENTER_DTE, OO_ORD_NAME, OO_ORD_MODIFIER , PREL.OSH_CREATE_DT AS PREL_RSLT , MAX(FNL.OSH_CREATE_DT) AS FNL_RSLT FROM (SELECT CPE_MRN AS MRN , CPE_ENC_DTE AS MD_APPT_DTE , CPE_CHK_IN_DT MD_CHK_IN_DT , CPE_CHK_OUT_DT MD_CHK_OUT_DT , CPE_RM_IN_DT MD_RM_IN_DT , CPE_RM_OUT_DT MD_RM_OUT_DT , CLD_DEPT_NAME MD_DEPT , CRE_RES_NAME MD_NAME , CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME MD_VST_NAME , CVT_EXT_NAME MD_VST_TYPE FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER MD JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON MD.CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON MD.CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON MD.CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE MD.CPE_ENC_DTE = '2011-04-19' AND MD.CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CRE_RES_TYP IN ('Physician', 'PhD', 'Psychologist', 'Dentist', 'Nurse Practitioner') AND CPE_CPE_IP_IND <> 'INPATIENT' ) AS MD_APPT JOIN (SELECT CPE_MRN AS MRN , CPE_ENC_DTE AS CT_APPT_DTE , CPE_CHK_IN_DT CT_CHK_IN_DT , CPE_CHK_OUT_DT CT_CHK_OUT_DT , CPE_RM_IN_DT CT_RM_IN_DT , CPE_RM_OUT_DT CT_RM_OUT_DT , CLD_DEPT_NAME CT_DEPT , CRE_RES_NAME CT_NAME , CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME CT_VST_NAME , CVT_EXT_NAME CT_VST_TYPE FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER CT JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CT.CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CT.CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CT.CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CT.CPE_ENC_DTE = '2011-04-19' AND CT.CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CVT_EXT_NAME IN ('CT Scan') AND CPE_CPE_IP_IND <> 'INPATIENT' ) AS CT_SCAN ON MD_APPT.MRN = CT_SCAN.MRN AND MD_APPT.MD_APPT_DTE = CT_SCAN.CT_APPT_DTE JOIN IDB.OMS_ORDER ORD ON MD_APPT.MRN = OO_MRN AND OO_ORD_TYPE_CD = 'Diagnostic' AND OO_ORD_NAME = 'CT' AND OO_ORD_STS_CD like 'RE%' AND MD_APPT.MD_APPT_DTE = DATE(OO_REQUESTED_DT) LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_STS_HX PREL ON ORD.OO_ORD_GUID = PREL.OSH_ORD_GUID AND PREL.OSH_ORD_STS_CD = 'RESI' LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_STS_HX FNL ON ORD.OO_ORD_GUID = FNL.OSH_ORD_GUID AND FNL.OSH_ORD_STS_CD IN('RESF', 'RESC') GROUP BY MD_APPT.MRN, MD_APPT_DTE, MD_CHK_IN_DT , MD_CHK_IN_DT, MD_RM_IN_DT, MD_RM_OUT_DT, MD_DEPT , MD_NAME, MD_VST_NAME, MD_VST_TYPE, CT_APPT_DTE, CT_CHK_IN_DT , CT_CHK_IN_DT, CT_RM_IN_DT , CT_RM_OUT_DT, CT_DEPT , CT_NAME, CT_VST_NAME, CT_VST_TYPE , ORD.OO_ENTER_DTE, OO_ORD_NAME, OO_ORD_MODIFIER , PREL.OSH_CREATE_DT

prompt: Patients diagnosed with CRC from 2009 to 2019 with a secondary CRC within 6 months to 3.5 years
completion: WITH P AS (SELECT CC_MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS MIN_ICD9_EFF_DTE, CC_CLSF_CD AS ICD9_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS ICD9_DESC, ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY CC_MRN ORDER BY MIN(CC_EFF_DTE)) AS RN FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE (SUBSTR(CC_CLSF_CD, 1, 3) IN ('153', 'C18') OR CC_CLSF_CD IN ('C18.9', 'C19.9', 'C20.9', 'C20.9', 'C21.8', '154.0', '154.1', '154.2', '154.3', '154.8')) AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND (CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) GROUP BY CC_MRN, CC_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK HAVING MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) BETWEEN '2009-01-01' AND '2019-10-31') , S AS (SELECT CC_MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS MIN_ICD9_EFF_DTE, CC_CLSF_CD AS ICD9_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS ICD9_DESC FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE (CC_CLSF_CD IN ('197.5', 'C78.5')) AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND (CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) GROUP BY CC_MRN, CC_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK HAVING MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) BETWEEN '2009-01-01' AND '2019-10-31') , JOINED AS (SELECT M.CC_MRN AS P_CC_MRN, M.ICD9_CD AS P_ICD, M.ICD9_DESC AS P_ICD_DESC, M.MIN_ICD9_EFF_DTE AS P_EFF_DTE, S.CC_MRN AS S_CC_MRN, S.ICD9_CD AS S_ICD, S.ICD9_DESC AS S_ICD_DESC, S.MIN_ICD9_EFF_DTE AS S_EFF_DTE, RN FROM P AS M JOIN S AS S ON M.CC_MRN = S.CC_MRN WHERE RN = 1 ) , COHORT AS (SELECT P_CC_MRN AS "MRN", P_ICD AS "Primary ICD", P_ICD_DESC AS "Primary ICD description", MIN(P_EFF_DTE) AS "Primary diagnosis date", S_ICD AS "Secondary ICD", S_ICD_DESC AS "Secondary ICD description", MIN(S_EFF_DTE) AS "Secondary diagnosis date" FROM JOINED GROUP BY P_CC_MRN, S_ICD, S_ICD_DESC, P_ICD, P_ICD_DESC HAVING MIN(S_EFF_DTE) BETWEEN ADD_MONTHS(MIN(P_EFF_DTE), 6) AND ADD_MONTHS(MIN(P_EFF_DTE), 42)) , IBD_DX AS (SELECT PBD_MRN, MIN(PBD_SVC_DTE) AS MIN_DTE, DX_CLSF_CD AS ICD9_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS ICD9_DESC, 'PBD' AS SOURCE FROM IDB.PBD_DTL JOIN IDB.PBD_DX ON PBD_MRN = DX_MRN AND PBD_INV_NO = DX_INV_NO JOIN IDB.CLM ON DX_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN COHORT ON PBD_MRN = MRN WHERE DX_CLSF_CD IN ('K51.90', '556.9') AND PBD_SVC_DTE BETWEEN '2009-01-01' AND '2019-10-31' GROUP BY PBD_MRN, DX_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK ) , FAP_DX AS (SELECT PBD_MRN, MIN(PBD_SVC_DTE) AS MIN_DTE, DX_CLSF_CD AS ICD9_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS ICD9_DESC, 'PBD' AS SOURCE FROM IDB.PBD_DTL JOIN IDB.PBD_DX ON PBD_MRN = DX_MRN AND PBD_INV_NO = DX_INV_NO JOIN IDB.CLM ON DX_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN COHORT ON PBD_MRN = MRN WHERE DX_CLSF_CD IN ('Z83.71', 'V18.51') AND PBD_SVC_DTE BETWEEN '2009-01-01' AND '2019-10-31' GROUP BY PBD_MRN, DX_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK ) , APP_DX AS (SELECT PBD_MRN, MIN(PBD_SVC_DTE) AS MIN_DTE, DX_CLSF_CD AS ICD9_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS ICD9_DESC, 'PBD' AS SOURCE FROM IDB.PBD_DTL JOIN IDB.PBD_DX ON PBD_MRN = DX_MRN AND PBD_INV_NO = DX_INV_NO JOIN IDB.CLM ON DX_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN COHORT ON PBD_MRN = MRN WHERE DX_CLSF_CD IN ('C18.1', '153.5') AND PBD_SVC_DTE BETWEEN '2009-01-01' AND '2019-10-31' GROUP BY PBD_MRN, DX_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK ) , COLON AS (SELECT SSE_MRN, MIN(SSE_SURG_DTE) MIN_PROC_DTE FROM IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE ON SSE_LOG_ID = SSP_LOG_ID AND SSE_ENC_CSN_ID = SSP_ENC_CSN_ID JOIN COHORT ON SSE_MRN = MRN WHERE SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC like '%COLONOSCOPY%' AND SSE_SURG_DTE BETWEEN '2009-01-01' AND '2019-10-31' GROUP BY SSE_MRN) SELECT C.MRN, P.PT_SEX, P.PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, YEAR(CURRENT_DATE - P.PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) AGE, P.PT_RACE_DESC, MIN(IBD.MIN_DTE) AS IBD_DX_DTE, MIN(FAP.MIN_DTE) AS FAP_DTE, MIN(APP.MIN_DTE) AS APPEN_DX, MIN(COL.MIN_PROC_DTE) AS COL_DTE FROM COHORT C LEFT JOIN IDB.PATIENT_V P ON MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN IBD_DX IBD ON IBD.PBD_MRN = C.MRN LEFT JOIN FAP_DX FAP ON FAP.PBD_MRN = C.MRN LEFT JOIN APP_DX APP ON APP.PBD_MRN = C.MRN LEFT JOIN COLON COL ON COL.SSE_MRN = C.MRN GROUP BY C.MRN, P.PT_SEX, P.PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, YEAR(CURRENT_DATE - P.PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH), P.PT_RACE_DESC ;

prompt: Please provide a weekly list of patients scheduled for outpatient dermatology at Koch who are Non-White (Black, Hispanic, Asian, Pacific Islander, Native American) and/or  Middle Eastern and North African
completion: WITH INIT AS (SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN AS "MRN", DATE(CPE_ENC_DTE) AS "Appt Date", TIME(CPE_APPT_DT) AS APPT_TIME, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 AS "Department", CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 AS "Service", CLD_DEPT_NAME AS "Department Name", CRE_RES_NAME AS "Provider Name", CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME AS "Visit Type", CVT_EXT_NAME AS "Visit Type External", CVT_IN_OUT_PT FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Sch') AND UPPER(CLD_DEPT_NAME) LIKE '%KOCH%' AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 = 'DER' AND CVT_IN_OUT_PT = 'Outpatient' AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT DATE AND CURRENT DATE + 7 DAYS ) SELECT DISTINCT "MRN", PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_LAST_NAME, "Service", "Appt Date", APPT_TIME, "Provider Name", "Department Name", CVT_IN_OUT_PT, PT_PHONE, R.AV_DESC AS "Race", E.AV_DESC AS "Ethnicity" , CR.AV_DESC AS "Race (CDB)" , CE.AV_DESC AS "Ethnicity (CDB)" FROM INIT LEFT JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON "MRN" = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS R ON PT_RACE = R.AV_CODE AND R.AV_ELEMENT = 'RACE' LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS E ON PT_PT_ETHNICITY = E.AV_CODE AND E.AV_ELEMENT = 'PT_ETHNICITY' LEFT JOIN IDB.CDB_PATIENT ON PT_MRN = CP_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS CR ON CR.AV_ELEMENT = 'CDB_RACE' AND CR.AV_CODE = CP_CDB_RACE LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS CE ON CE.AV_ELEMENT = 'ETHNICITY' AND CE.AV_CODE = CP_ETHNICITY WHERE R.AV_DESC <> 'WHITE' AND CR.AV_DESC <> 'WHITE'

prompt: Update the Darwin structured report SKI24830 with ASA scores for the specified list of MRNs and breast surgery date range..
completion: WITH PTS AS (SELECT PT_MRN AS MRN FROM IDB.PATIENT WHERE 1=1 #PROMPTMANY('MRN', 'String', ' ', ' and PT_MRN in (', '', ')')# ) SELECT STRIP(OL_MRN) AS MRN, OL_SURG_DTE AS "Surgery Date", OL_LOG_ID AS "Case No", OLAP_PNL_NO, OLAS_SURG_SVC, OLAP_LINE_NO, OLAP_OR_PROC_ID, OP_IMO_CD, STRIP(OP_PROC_NAME) AS "Procedure Name", OCP_LINE_NO, STRIP(CPX_PROC_CD) AS "CPT Code", STRIP(CPX_PROC_NAME) AS "CPT Description", STRIP(OL_ASA_RATING) AS "ASA" FROM PTS JOIN IDB.OR_LOG ON OL_MRN = MRN JOIN IDB.OR_LOG_ALL_PROC ON OL_LOG_ID = OLAP_LOG_ID JOIN IDB.OR_PROC ON OLAP_OR_PROC_ID = OP_OR_PROC_ID JOIN IDB.OR_CL_PROC ON OP_OR_PROC_ID = OCP_OR_PROC_ID JOIN IDB.CL_PROC ON OCP_PROC_ID = CPX_PROC_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.OR_LOG_ALL_SURG ON OLAP_LOG_ID = OLAS_LOG_ID AND OLAP_PNL_NO = OLAS_PNL_NO AND OLAS_SURG_ROLE = 'Primary' LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CRE_RES_ID = OLAS_RES_ID WHERE OL_LOG_STS NOT IN ('Canceled', 'Voided') AND CPX_PROC_CD IN ('19301', '19302', '19303', '19304', '19307', '38500', '38525', '38530', '38740', '38745', '19303', '19304', '19307', '19301', '19302', '38500', '38525', '38530', '38740', '38745') AND OL_SURG_DTE BETWEEN DATE(#PROMPT('Start Date', 'STRING', '2010-01-01')#) AND DATE(#PROMPT ('End Date', 'STRING', '2099-12-31')#)

prompt: Provide a list of admin/operations DataLine requests
completion: SELECT "Project Code", "Project Request Type", "Project Description", "Request Description", "Request Purpose", "Project Request Date", "Project Delivery Date", "Project Delivery Desc", "Schedule Status", "Requester First Name" || ' ' || "Requester Last Name" "Requester Name", "Department Name" "Requester Department Name", CASE WHEN P."Developer Primary" = 'LONGD' THEN 'Dwayne Long' WHEN P."Developer Primary" = 'LEWISF' THEN 'Frank Lewis' WHEN P."Developer Primary" = 'POONC' THEN 'Chester Poon' ELSE DISPLAYNAME END "Developer", P."Developer Primary" FROM DSG.PROJECTS P LEFT JOIN DSG.REQUESTR R ON REQUESTER_ID = "Requester ID" LEFT JOIN DSG.DEVELOPER_NAMES D ON P."Developer Primary" = D."Developer Primary" WHERE "Project Request Type" = 'Administrative/Operations' AND COALESCE("Project Completion Status", '') NOT IN ('Cancelled', 'On hold') AND SUBSTR("Project Code", 1, 3) NOT IN ('COM', 'IDB', 'SPL') AND SUBSTR("Project Code", 1, 2) NOT IN ('IS') AND "Project IRB/Waiver #" IS NULL AND UPPER("Project Description") not like '%BOXI MIGRATION%' AND "Project Request Date" >= CURRENT date - 7 DAYS AND "Project Delivery Date" IS NULL ORDER BY "Project Request Date"

prompt:
Provide a weekly list of retinoblastoma patients who have an appointment in LTFU (Long-Term Follow Up)

ex. Visit Type: PEDLT LONG TERM FR [1101]

     Provider: Friedman, Danielle Novetsky [017095]

     Department: PEDLT [281]
completion: WITH SCH AS (SELECT CPE_MRN AS "CPE_MRN", CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME, CRE_RES_NAME, MIN(CPE_ENC_DTE) AS "Next Appt Date" FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Sch') AND CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME IN ('PEDLT LONG TERM FR', 'PEDLT ENDO LONG TERM FR') AND CLD_DEPT_NAME IN ('PEDS LONG TERM 1275') AND CRE_RES_NAME IN ('FRIEDMAN, DANIELLE NOVETSK', 'ANTAL, ZOLTAN') GROUP BY CPE_MRN, CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME, CRE_RES_NAME HAVING MIN(CPE_ENC_DTE) BETWEEN CURRENT_DATE AND LAST_DAY(CURRENT_DATE)) , DX_ALL AS (SELECT TM_MRN AS DX_MRN, TM_HIST_CD AS DX_CODE, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS DX_DESC FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN SCH ON CPE_MRN = TM_MRN JOIN IDB.CLM H ON TM_HIST_CD = H.CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON TM_SITE_CD = S.CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND TM_HIST_CD IN ('M9510/3', 'M9510/6', 'M9511/3', 'M9511/6', 'M9512/3', 'M9513/3', 'M9514/1') UNION SELECT CC_MRN AS DX_MRN, CLM_CLSF_CD AS DX_CODE, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS DX_DESC FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN SCH ON CPE_MRN = CC_MRN JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND ((CC_PT_TYPE = 'I') OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) AND CC_CLSF_CD IN ('C69.20' ,'C69.21' ,'C69.22') ), COHORT AS (SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN , "Next Appt Date" , CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME , CRE_RES_NAME , DX_CODE , DX_DESC FROM SCH JOIN DX_ALL ON SCH.CPE_MRN = DX_ALL.DX_MRN) , PATH AS (SELECT DISTINCT PRPT_MRN , PRPT_REPORT_TYPE_DESC , CAST (PRPT_REPORT AS VARCHAR(32500)) AS PATH_REPORT FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V JOIN COHORT ON PRPT_MRN = CPE_MRN WHERE PRPT_REPORT_TYPE_DESC = 'Diagnostic Molecular Genetics' AND PRPT_REPORT IS NOT NULL ) SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN , PT_LAST_NAME "LAST NAME" , PT_FIRST_NAME "FIRST NAME" , PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH "DATE OF BIRTH" , "Next Appt Date" , CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME "VISIT TYPE" , CRE_RES_NAME "PROVIDER" , DX_CODE , DX_DESC , PATH_REPORT FROM COHORT LEFT JOIN PATH ON CPE_MRN = PRPT_MRN JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON CPE_MRN = PT_MRN

prompt: Provide a report of patients diagnosed with HER2+ breast cancer since 1/1/2006.
completion: WITH DX AS (SELECT DISTINCT TM_MRN, PT_SEX AS GENDER, R.AV_DESC AS "Race", E.AV_DESC AS "Ethnicity", PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH AS DOB, PT_DATE_OF_DEATH AS DOD, TM_DX_DTE, TM_SITE_CD AS SITE_CODE, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_DESC, TM_HIST_CD AS HIST_CODE, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS HIST_DESC, STRIP(CASE WHEN TM_AJCC_7 NOT IN ('', '888', '999') THEN AJCC7.AV_DESC WHEN TM_AJCC NOT IN ('', '88', '99') THEN AJCC.AV_DESC WHEN TM_GENERAL_STG NOT IN ('', '9') THEN GS.AV_DESC WHEN TM_PATH_STG_GRP NOT IN ('', '88', '9', '99') THEN TM_PATH_STG_GRP ELSE CLIN.AV_DESC END) AS STAGE, TM_CLIN_TNM_T, TM_CLIN_TNM_N, TM_CLIN_TNM_M, TM_CLIN_STG_GRP, TM_PATH_TNM_T, TM_PATH_TNM_N, TM_PATH_TNM_M, TM_PATH_STG_GRP, CASE WHEN TM_SSF1 = '000' THEN 'Test not done (test not ordered and not performed)' WHEN TM_SSF1 = '010' THEN 'Positive/elevated' WHEN TM_SSF1 = '020' THEN 'Negative/normal; within normal limits' WHEN TM_SSF1 = '030' THEN 'Borderline; undetermined whether positive or negative' WHEN TM_SSF1 = '080' THEN 'Ordered, but results not in chart' WHEN TM_SSF1 = '988' THEN 'Not applicable: Information not collected for this case' WHEN TM_SSF1 = '996' THEN 'Test ordered, results not interpretable' WHEN TM_SSF1 = '997' THEN 'Test ordered, results not in chart' WHEN TM_SSF1 = '998' THEN 'Test not done (test not ordered and not performed)' WHEN TM_SSF1 = '999' THEN 'Unknown or no information; not documented in patient record' ELSE '' END AS "ER", CASE WHEN TM_SSF2 = '000' THEN 'Test not done (test not ordered and not performed)' WHEN TM_SSF2 = '010' THEN 'Positive/elevated' WHEN TM_SSF2 = '020' THEN 'Negative/normal; within normal limits' WHEN TM_SSF2 = '030' THEN 'Borderline; undetermined whether positive or negative' WHEN TM_SSF2 = '080' THEN 'Ordered, but results not in chart' WHEN TM_SSF2 = '988' THEN 'Not applicable: Information not collected for this case' WHEN TM_SSF2 = '996' THEN 'Test ordered, results not interpretable' WHEN TM_SSF2 = '997' THEN 'Test ordered, results not in chart' WHEN TM_SSF2 = '998' THEN 'Test not done (test not ordered and not performed)' WHEN TM_SSF2 = '999' THEN 'Unknown or no information; not documented in patient record' ELSE '' END AS "PR", CASE WHEN TM_SSF15 = '010' THEN 'Positive/elevated; amplified' WHEN TM_SSF15 = '020' THEN 'Negative/normal; within normal limits; not amplified' WHEN TM_SSF15 = '030' THEN 'Borderline; equivocal; indeterminate; undetermined whether positive or negative' WHEN TM_SSF15 = '988' THEN 'Not applicable: Information not collected for this case' WHEN TM_SSF15 = '997' THEN 'Test ordered, results not in chart' WHEN TM_SSF15 = '998' THEN 'Test not done (test not ordered and not performed)' WHEN TM_SSF15 = '999' THEN 'Unknown or no information; not documented in patient record' ELSE '' END AS "HER2 Summary Result" FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON TM_MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS R ON PT_RACE = R.AV_CODE AND R.AV_ELEMENT = 'RACE' LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS E ON PT_PT_ETHNICITY = E.AV_CODE AND E.AV_ELEMENT = 'PT_ETHNICITY' JOIN IDB.CLM H ON TM_HIST_CD = H.CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON TM_SITE_CD = S.CLM_CLSF_CD LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS AJCC7 ON AJCC7.AV_ELEMENT = 'AJCC_7' AND AJCC7.AV_CODE = TM_AJCC_7 LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS AJCC ON AJCC.AV_ELEMENT = 'AJCC' AND AJCC.AV_CODE = TM_AJCC LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS GS ON GS.AV_ELEMENT = 'GENERAL_STG' AND GS.AV_CODE = TM_GENERAL_STG LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS CLIN ON CLIN.AV_ELEMENT = 'CLIN_STG_DSCR' AND CLIN.AV_CODE = TM_CLIN_STG_DSCR WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND TM_DX_DTE >= '2006-01-01' AND TM_SITE_CD IN ('C500', 'C501', 'C502', 'C503', 'C504', 'C505', 'C506', 'C508', 'C509') AND CASE WHEN TM_SSF15 = '010' THEN 'Positive/elevated; amplified' WHEN TM_SSF15 = '020' THEN 'Negative/normal; within normal limits; not amplified' WHEN TM_SSF15 = '030' THEN 'Borderline; equivocal; indeterminate; undetermined whether positive or negative' WHEN TM_SSF15 = '988' THEN 'Not applicable: Information not collected for this case' WHEN TM_SSF15 = '997' THEN 'Test ordered, results not in chart' WHEN TM_SSF15 = '998' THEN 'Test not done (test not ordered and not performed)' WHEN TM_SSF15 = '999' THEN 'Unknown or no information; not documented in patient record' ELSE '' END LIKE 'Positive%' ) , CC AS (SELECT CC_MRN, CLM_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS INIT_EFF_DATE FROM DX JOIN IDB.CTC_CLSF ON CC_MRN = TM_MRN JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND ((CC_PT_TYPE = 'I') OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) AND CC_CLSF_CD IN ('198.3', '198.4', 'C79.3', 'C79.31', 'C79.32', 'C79.4', 'C79.40', 'C79.49') AND CC_MRN IN (SELECT TM_MRN FROM DX) GROUP BY CC_MRN, CLM_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK ) , CC2 AS (SELECT CC_MRN, LISTAGG(COALESCE(STRIP(CAST(INIT_EFF_DATE AS VARCHAR(12000))), '') || ' | ' || COALESCE(STRIP(CLM_CLSF_CD), '') || ' | ' || COALESCE(STRIP(CAST(CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS VARCHAR(12000))), '') , CHR(13) || CHR(10)) WITHIN GROUP( ORDER BY CC_MRN, INIT_EFF_DATE, CLM_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK) AS METS FROM CC GROUP BY CC_MRN) , APR AS (SELECT APR_MRN, CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME, MIN(APR_START_DTE) AS START_DATE, MAX(APR_END_DTE) AS END_DATE FROM (SELECT DISTINCT APR_MRN, CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME, APR_GENERIC_NAME, APR_DRUG_NAME, APR_START_DTE, APR_END_DTE, APR_ORD_RX_TYPE, APR_PRESCRIBED_DOSE, APR_DOSE_UOM FROM DX JOIN IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX_V ON APR_MRN = TM_MRN WHERE 1=1 AND UPPER(CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME) IN ('TRASTUZUMAB', 'ADO-TRASTUZUMAB EMTANSINE', 'PERTUZUMAB') ) A GROUP BY APR_MRN, CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME) , APR2 AS (SELECT APR_MRN, MAX(CASE WHEN CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME = 'TRASTUZUMAB' THEN START_DATE END) AS "TRASTUZUMAB Start Date", MAX(CASE WHEN CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME = 'TRASTUZUMAB' THEN END_DATE END) AS "TRASTUZUMAB End Date", MAX(CASE WHEN CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME = 'ADO-TRASTUZUMAB EMTANSINE' THEN START_DATE END) AS "TRASTUZUMAB EMTANSINE Start Date", MAX(CASE WHEN CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME = 'ADO-TRASTUZUMAB EMTANSINE' THEN END_DATE END) AS "TRASTUZUMAB EMTANSINE End Date", MAX(CASE WHEN CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME = 'PERTUZUMAB' THEN START_DATE END) AS "PERTUZUMAB Start Date", MAX(CASE WHEN CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME = 'PERTUZUMAB' THEN END_DATE END) AS "PERTUZUMAB End Date" FROM APR GROUP BY APR_MRN) , OTHER_CHEMO AS (SELECT APR_MRN, CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME, MIN(APR_START_DTE) AS START_DATE, MAX(APR_END_DTE) AS END_DATE FROM (SELECT DISTINCT APR_MRN, CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME, APR_GENERIC_NAME, APR_DRUG_NAME, APR_START_DTE, APR_END_DTE FROM DX JOIN IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX_V ON APR_MRN = TM_MRN WHERE 1=1 AND CDG_CHEMO_FLAG = 'Y' AND UPPER(CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME) NOT IN ('TRASTUZUMAB', 'ADO-TRASTUZUMAB EMTANSINE', 'PERTUZUMAB') ) A GROUP BY APR_MRN, CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME) , OTHER_CHEMO2 AS (SELECT APR_MRN, LISTAGG(COALESCE(STRIP(CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME), '') || ' | ' || COALESCE(STRIP(CAST(START_DATE AS VARCHAR(12000))), '') || ' | ' || COALESCE(STRIP(CAST(END_DATE AS VARCHAR(12000))), '') , CHR(13) || CHR(10)) WITHIN GROUP( ORDER BY APR_MRN, CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME, START_DATE, END_DATE) AS OTHER_CHEMO FROM OTHER_CHEMO GROUP BY APR_MRN) SELECT DX.*, METS, "TRASTUZUMAB Start Date", "TRASTUZUMAB End Date", "TRASTUZUMAB EMTANSINE Start Date", "TRASTUZUMAB EMTANSINE End Date", "PERTUZUMAB Start Date", "PERTUZUMAB End Date", OTHER_CHEMO FROM DX LEFT JOIN CC2 ON TM_MRN = CC_MRN LEFT JOIN APR2 APR2 ON TM_MRN = APR2.APR_MRN LEFT JOIN OTHER_CHEMO2 CH2 ON TM_MRN = CH2.APR_MRN

prompt: Please provide Pathology reports for Dermatology for all patients and biopsies taken since the year 2000 - Present
completion: SELECT PT_MRN AS MRN, P.DT_DTE AS PATH_PROC_DTE, MP_FULL_NM AS ORD_PROVIDER, MP_SERVICE_DESC AS ORD_PROVIDER_SVC_DESC, MP_ACADEMIC_SVC_DESC AS ORD_PROVIDER_ACADEMIC_SVC_DESC, PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_DESC AS PATH_RPT_TYPE, PRPT_ACCESSION_NO AS PATH_ACCESSION_NO, PRPT_REPORT AS PATH_RPT FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT JOIN DV.DATE P ON P.DT_DATE_ID = PRPT_PROCEDURE_DATE_ID JOIN DV.PATH_RPRT_TYPE_LOOKUP ON PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_CD = PRPT_REPORT_TYPE JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON PRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID JOIN DV.MEDPRO ON PRPT_ORDERING_MEDPRO_ID = MP_MEDPRO_ID WHERE MP_ACADEMIC_SVC_DESC = 'DERMATOLOGY' AND DT_DTE >= '2000-01-01';

prompt: Provide data on patients with non-small cell lung cancer with exon 20 mutations, including mutations from R761 till R823 and point mutations in S7681.
completion: SELECT DISTINCT "t1"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AS "Deident PT #", "t2"."PDMR_GENE" AS "Gene", "t2"."PDMR_RESULT" AS "Result", "t2"."PDMR_LOCUS" AS "Locus", "t2"."PDMR_AA_CHANGE" AS "Amino Acid", "t3"."PRPT_PATH_RPT_ID" AS "DE-ID Pathology Report", "t4"."PT_SEX_DESC" AS "Gender", "t4"."PT_RACE_DESC" AS "Race", "t5"."DT_YEAR" AS "Year of Birth", "t4"."PT_DEATH_YEAR" AS "Deceased Year", "t4"."PT_MRN" AS "MRN", "t4"."PT_BIRTH_DTE" AS "Date of Birth", "t4"."PT_DEATH_DTE" AS "Deceased Date" FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED" "t1" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V" "t3" ON "t1"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t3"."PRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATHOLOGY_DIAG_MOLECULAR_RESULTS" "t2" ON "t3"."PRPT_PATH_RPT_ID" = "t2"."PDMR_PRPT_PATH_RPT_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V" "t4" ON "t1"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t4"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" "t5" ON "t4"."PT_BIRTH_DTE" = "t5"."DT_DTE" WHERE ((1 = 1 AND ("t2"."PDMR_GENE" = 'EGFR' AND ("t2"."PDMR_RESULT" = 'POSITIVE' AND ("t2"."PDMR_LOCUS" IN ('EXON 20', 'R776', 'R882', 'S768') AND (CONTAINS("t3"."PRPT_DEID_REPORT", '(("lung" & NOT "The mutation is T790M.") & NOT "T790M is present")') = 1 AND ("t2"."PDMR_AA_CHANGE" NOT IN ('T790 M', 'T790M') AND "t3"."PRPT_PATH_RPT_ID" NOT IN (1665751, 1701960, 1922712))))))) AND "t3"."PRPT_DEID_REPORT" IS NOT NULL)

prompt: Provide a list of patients with clinical stage II and III rectal adenocarcinoma newly diagnosed between January 2008 and December 2019 who underwent neoadjuvant therapy and had surgical resection.
completion: WITH TM AS (SELECT DISTINCT TM_MRN AS MRN , PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH AS DOB, PT_DATE_OF_DEATH AS DOD, PT_SEX, R.AV_DESC AS "Race", E.AV_DESC AS "Ethnicity" , TM_DX_DTE , TM_SITE_CD AS SITE_CD , SITE.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_CD_DESC , TM_HIST_CD AS HIST_CD , HIST.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS HIST_CD_DESC , CASE WHEN TM_AJCC_7 NOT IN ('', '888', '999') THEN AJCC7.AV_DESC WHEN TM_AJCC NOT IN ('', '88', '99') THEN AJCC.AV_DESC WHEN TM_GENERAL_STG NOT IN ('', '9') THEN GS.AV_DESC WHEN TM_PATH_STG_GRP NOT IN ('', '88', '9', '99') THEN TM_PATH_STG_GRP ELSE CLIN.AV_DESC END AS "Stage" , GR.AV_DESC AS GRADE_DESC, TM_TUMOR_SIZE AS TUMOR_SIZE , TM_PATH_TNM_T AS PATH_TNM_T, TM_PATH_TNM_N AS PATH_TNM_N, TM_PATH_TNM_M AS PATH_TNM_M, PS.AV_DESC AS PATH_STG_GRP , TM_CLIN_TNM_T AS CLIN_TNM_T, TM_CLIN_TNM_N AS CLIN_TNM_N, TM_CLIN_TNM_M AS CLIN_TNM_M, CLINSTG.AV_DESC AS CLIN_STG_GRP FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.SEERGROUPING ON RECODE = IDB.SEERF_ICDO(TM_SITE_CD, TM_HIST_CD) AND CATEGORY3 = 'Rectum and Rectosigmoid Junction' JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON TM_MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS R ON PT_RACE = R.AV_CODE AND R.AV_ELEMENT = 'RACE' LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS E ON PT_PT_ETHNICITY = E.AV_CODE AND E.AV_ELEMENT = 'PT_ETHNICITY' LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS AJCC7 ON AJCC7.AV_ELEMENT = 'AJCC_7' AND AJCC7.AV_CODE = TM_AJCC_7 LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS AJCC ON AJCC.AV_ELEMENT = 'AJCC' AND AJCC.AV_CODE = TM_AJCC LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS GS ON GS.AV_ELEMENT = 'GENERAL_STG' AND GS.AV_CODE = TM_GENERAL_STG LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS CLIN ON CLIN.AV_ELEMENT = 'CLIN_STG_DSCR' AND CLIN.AV_CODE = TM_CLIN_STG_DSCR LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS CS ON CS.AV_ELEMENT = 'CASE_STS' AND CS.AV_CODE = TM_CASE_STS LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS GR ON GR.AV_ELEMENT = 'HIST_CD_GRADE' AND GR.AV_CODE = TM_HIST_CD_GRADE LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS PS ON PS.AV_ELEMENT = 'PATH_STG_GRP' AND PS.AV_CODE = TM_PATH_STG_GRP LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS CLINSTG ON CLINSTG.AV_ELEMENT = 'CLIN_STG_GRP' AND CLINSTG.AV_CODE = TM_CLIN_STG_GRP LEFT JOIN IDB.CLM HIST ON HIST.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD LEFT JOIN IDB.CLM SITE ON SITE.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD WHERE 1=1 AND TM_DX_DTE BETWEEN '2008-01-01' AND '2019-12-31' AND TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') ) , X AS (SELECT * FROM TM WHERE 1=1 AND "Stage" NOT IN ('0', '1', 'I') AND "Stage" not like 'IV%' AND "Stage" not like '4%' AND "Stage" <> 'DISTANT METASTASES/SYSTEMIC DISEASE' ) , SRG1 AS (SELECT OL_MRN, OL_SURG_DTE, OL_LOG_ID, OLAP_PNL_NO, OLAS_SURG_SVC, OLAP_LINE_NO, OLAP_OR_PROC_ID, OP_IMO_CD, OP_PROC_NAME, OCP_LINE_NO, CPX_PROC_CD, CPX_PROC_NAME, CRE_RES_NAME FROM X JOIN IDB.OR_LOG ON OL_MRN = MRN JOIN IDB.OR_LOG_ALL_PROC ON OL_LOG_ID = OLAP_LOG_ID JOIN IDB.OR_PROC ON OLAP_OR_PROC_ID = OP_OR_PROC_ID JOIN IDB.OR_CL_PROC ON OP_OR_PROC_ID = OCP_OR_PROC_ID JOIN IDB.CL_PROC ON OCP_PROC_ID = CPX_PROC_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.OR_LOG_ALL_SURG ON OLAP_LOG_ID = OLAS_LOG_ID AND OLAP_PNL_NO = OLAS_PNL_NO AND OLAS_SURG_ROLE = 'Primary' LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CRE_RES_ID = OLAS_RES_ID WHERE OL_LOG_STS NOT IN ('Canceled', 'Voided') AND OL_SURG_DTE BETWEEN '2008-01-01' AND '2020-10-15' AND CPX_PROC_CD IN ('44140', '44141', '44143', '44144', '44145', '44146', '44147', '44150', '44153', '44155', '44157', '44158', '44160', '44204', '44205', '44206', '44207', '44208', '44209', '44210', '44211', '44212', '44227', '44239', '44395', '44397', '45100', '45110', '45111', '45112', '45113', '45114', '45116', '45119', '45121', '45123', '45160', '45171', '45172', '45190', '45300', '45305', '45349', '45395', '45397', '45499', '45990', '45999', '0184T') ) , SRG2 AS (SELECT OL_MRN, OL_SURG_DTE, OL_LOG_ID, OLAP_PNL_NO, OLAS_SURG_SVC, OLAP_LINE_NO, OLAP_OR_PROC_ID, OP_IMO_CD, OP_PROC_NAME, OCP_LINE_NO, CPX_PROC_CD, CPX_PROC_NAME, CRE_RES_NAME FROM X JOIN IDB.OR_LOG ON OL_MRN = MRN JOIN IDB.OR_LOG_ALL_PROC ON OL_LOG_ID = OLAP_LOG_ID JOIN IDB.OR_PROC ON OLAP_OR_PROC_ID = OP_OR_PROC_ID JOIN IDB.OR_CL_PROC ON OP_OR_PROC_ID = OCP_OR_PROC_ID JOIN IDB.CL_PROC ON OCP_PROC_ID = CPX_PROC_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.OR_LOG_ALL_SURG ON OLAP_LOG_ID = OLAS_LOG_ID AND OLAP_PNL_NO = OLAS_PNL_NO AND OLAS_SURG_ROLE = 'Primary' LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CRE_RES_ID = OLAS_RES_ID WHERE OL_LOG_STS NOT IN ('Canceled', 'Voided') AND OL_SURG_DTE BETWEEN '2008-01-01' AND '2020-10-15' AND CPX_PROC_CD IN ('999997') AND OL_LOG_ID IN (SELECT OL_LOG_ID FROM SRG1) ) , SRG AS (SELECT SRG1.* FROM SRG1 UNION SELECT SRG2.* FROM SRG2) , RT AS (SELECT DISTINCT RTC_TX_MRN, OL_SURG_DTE, RTC_TX_PLAN_NAME, RTC_PRIMARY_REF_POINT, RTC_TX_START_DTE, RTC_TX_STOP_DTE, RTC_TX_ELAPSED_DAYS, RTC_TX_PLANNED_FRACTIONS, RTC_TX_DELIVERED_FRACTIONS, RTC_TX_PLANNED_DOSE, RTC_TX_DELIVERED_DOSE, RTC_DOSE_CORRECTION FROM SRG JOIN IDB.RADONC_TREATMENT_COURSE ON RTC_TX_MRN = OL_MRN AND RTC_TX_START_DTE <= OL_SURG_DTE) , CHEMO AS (SELECT DISTINCT APR_MRN, OL_SURG_DTE, CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME, APR_START_DTE, APR_END_DTE, APR_ORD_RX_TYPE FROM SRG JOIN IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX_V ON APR_MRN = OL_MRN AND APR_START_DTE <= OL_SURG_DTE WHERE CDG_CHEMO_FLAG = 'Y' ) , MRI AS (SELECT DISTINCT PBD_MRN AS MRN, CLM_CLSF_CD AS CPT_CODE, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS CPT_DESC, PBC_PBD_DESC AS PBD_DESC, PBD_SVC_DTE AS SVC_DATE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY PBD_MRN ORDER BY PBD_SVC_DTE) AS RN FROM X JOIN IDB.PBD_DTL ON PBD_MRN = MRN AND PBD_SVC_DTE >= TM_DX_DTE JOIN IDB.PBD_CODE ON PBD_PBD_CD = PBC_PBD_CD JOIN IDB.CLM ON PBC_CPT_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE 1=1 AND CLM_CLSF_CD IN ('72195', '72196', '72197') ) SELECT * FROM MRI WHERE RN = 1

prompt: Patient surgery details who were admitted for elective colorectal surgery.
completion: WITH SURG AS (SELECT DISTINCT PATIENT_MRN, PATIENT_NAME, PATIENT_SEX , LOG_SURGERY_DTE AS DOS FROM IDB.PERIOP_CASE_EVENT_V WHERE LOG_PRIMARY_SERVICE = 'Colorectal' AND LOG_SURGERY_DTE BETWEEN '2019-03-01' AND '2021-03-12' ) , SMOKE AS (SELECT ASH_MRN, ASH_SMOKELESS_TOB_USE, ASH_TOBACCO_USED_YEARS, ASH_CIGARETTES_IND, ASH_PIPES_IND, ASH_CIGARS_IND, ASH_SNUFF_IND, ASH_CHEW_IND FROM (SELECT DISTINCT ASH_MRN, ARS_AN_DTE AS AN_DATE, ASH_ENC_DTE, ASH_CL_PT_ID AS PAT_ID, ASH_ENC_CSN_ID AS PAT_ENC_CSN_ID, ASH_TOBACCO_USER_CD, ASH_TOBACCO_USER, ASH_SMOKELESS_TOB_USE_CD, ASH_SMOKELESS_TOB_USE, ASH_SMOKING_TOB_USE_CD, ASH_SMOKING_TOB_USE, ASH_SMOKELESS_QUIT_DTE, ASH_TOBACO_SRC_CD, ASH_TOBACO_SRC, ASH_TOBACCO_PAK_PER_DAY, ASH_TOBACCO_USED_YEARS, ASH_TOBACCO_COMMENT, ASH_SMOKING_QUIT_DTE, ASH_CIGARETTES_IND, ASH_PIPES_IND, ASH_CIGARS_IND, ASH_SNUFF_IND, ASH_CHEW_IND, ASH_YEARS_EDUCATION , ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY ASH_MRN ORDER BY ASH_ENC_CSN_ID DESC) AS RK FROM IDB.AN_RECORD_SUMMARY JOIN IDB.AN_SOCIAL_HX SOC ON ARS_AN_CL_PT_ID = ASH_CL_PT_ID JOIN SURG ON PATIENT_MRN = ASH_MRN AND ARS_AN_DTE BETWEEN DOS - 1 DAY AND DOS +1 DAY) X WHERE RK=1 ) SELECT DISTINCT PATIENT_MRN AS MRN, PATIENT_NAME AS "Patient Name", PATIENT_SEX AS "Gender", PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH AS "Date of Birth", TRIM(M.AV_DESC) AS "Marital Status", TRIM(L.AV_DESC) AS "Language", TRIM(R.AV_DESC) AS "Race", TRIM(E.AV_DESC) AS "Ethnicity", INS1.INS_PLAN_DESC AS "Insurance", ASH_SMOKELESS_TOB_USE AS "Tobacco smokeless Use", ASH_TOBACCO_USED_YEARS AS "Tobacco Used Yrs" FROM SURG LEFT JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PT_MRN = PATIENT_MRN LEFT JOIN SMOKE ON ASH_MRN = PATIENT_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS R ON R.AV_ELEMENT = 'RACE' AND R.AV_CODE = PT_RACE LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS E ON E.AV_ELEMENT = 'PT_ETHNICITY' AND E.AV_CODE = PT_PT_ETHNICITY LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS M ON M.AV_ELEMENT = 'MARITAL_STS' AND M.AV_CODE = PT_MARITAL_STS LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS L ON L.AV_ELEMENT = 'PRIMARY_LANG' AND L.AV_CODE = PT_PRIMARY_LANG LEFT JOIN IDB.INSURANCE INS1 ON INS1.INS_MRN = PT_MRN AND INS1.INS_PLAN_PRIO = '1' AND INS1.INS_VERIFY_IND = 'Y' ; WITH SURG AS (SELECT DISTINCT PATIENT_MRN, PATIENT_NAME, PATIENT_AGE, PATIENT_SEX, LOG_NUMBER AS LOG_ID, LOG_SURGERY_DTE AS DOS, LOG_PRIMARY_SURGEON AS SURGEON, ANESTHESIA_START_TIME_ACTUAL, ANESTHESIA_END_TIME_ACTUAL, ANESTHESIA_TYPE, ASA_RATING, FIRST_PROCED_START_TIME_ACTUAL, LAST_PROCEDURE_END_TIME_ACTUAL, SURGERY_DURATION, TRIM(LOG_LAPAROSCOPIC_FLAG) ||'-' || TRIM(LOG_MIN_INVASIVE_FLAG) ||'-' || TRIM(LOG_ROBOT_ASSISTED_FLAG) AS SURG_TYPE, LOG_VISIT_TYPE FROM IDB.PERIOP_CASE_EVENT_V WHERE LOG_PRIMARY_SERVICE = 'Colorectal' AND LOG_SURGERY_DTE BETWEEN '2019-03-01' AND '2021-03-12' ) , ADM AS (SELECT SSE_MRN AS VIS_MRN, ADM_DOS, LISTAGG(CPT4_CODE , ', ') CPT_CODE, LISTAGG(TRIM(CPT4_DESC), ', ') AS CPT_DESC, VIS_ADM_DTE, VIS_DSCH_DTE, VIS_ADM_NUM, SSE_SURG_DTE, DSCH_DESC, VIS_HOSP_SVC FROM (SELECT SSE_MRN , DOS AS ADM_DOS, VIS_ADM_NUM, SSE_SURG_DTE, SSE_SURG_STRT_DT, SSE_SURG_END_DT, TRIM(SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD) AS CPT4_CODE, TRIM(SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC) AS CPT4_DESC, SSP_SURG_SVC_CD, VIS_ADM_DTE, VIS_HOSP_SVC, VIS_DSCH_DTE, S.AV_DESC AS DSCH_DESC FROM IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE ON SSE_LOG_ID = SSP_LOG_ID AND SSE_ENC_CSN_ID = SSP_ENC_CSN_ID JOIN SURG ON SSE_LOG_ID = LOG_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.VISIT ON VIS_MRN = SSE_MRN AND VIS_VISIT_STATUS IN ('2', '3') AND VIS_IP_OP_ADJUSTED_IND = 'I' AND VIS_ADM_DTE <= SSE_SURG_DTE AND COALESCE(VIS_DSCH_DTE, '2999-12-31') >= SSE_SURG_DTE LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS S ON TRIM(S.AV_ELEMENT) = 'DSCH_DISP' AND S.AV_CODE = VIS_DSCH_DISP WHERE (SSE_SURG_LOC not like '%IR%' AND SSE_SURG_LOC not like '%ENDO%' AND SSE_SOURCE_TYPE <> 'E') AND SSE_SURG_DTE = DOS AND VIS_HOSP_SVC IN ('COL', 'REC') AND TRIM(SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD) IS NOT NULL ) GROUP BY SSE_MRN, VIS_ADM_DTE, VIS_DSCH_DTE, VIS_ADM_NUM, ADM_DOS, SSE_SURG_DTE, DSCH_DESC, VIS_HOSP_SVC) , RE_ADM AS (SELECT R.VIS_MRN RADM_MRN, SSE_SURG_DTE AS SURG_DATE, F.VIS_ADM_DTE, F.VIS_DSCH_DTE, CASE WHEN R.VIS_MRN IS NOT NULL THEN 'Y' END AS RADM_FLAG, R.VIS_ADM_DTE RADM_ADM_DTE, R.VIS_DSCH_DTE RADM_DSCH_DTE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY F.VIS_MRN, F.VIS_ADM_NUM ORDER BY R.VIS_ADM_DTE ASC) AS RADM, CPE_ENC_DTE AS UCC_VISIT, CASE WHEN CPE_MRN IS NOT NULL THEN 'Y' END AS UCC_FLAG FROM ADM F LEFT JOIN IDB.VISIT R ON R.VIS_MRN = F.VIS_MRN AND R.VIS_HOSP_SVC = F.VIS_HOSP_SVC AND R.VIS_ADM_NUM <> F.VIS_ADM_NUM LEFT JOIN (SELECT CPE_MRN, CPE_ENC_DTE FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID WHERE CLD_DEPT_NAME = 'UCC 1275' AND CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN '2019-03-01' AND '2021-04-12' ) U ON CPE_MRN = F.VIS_MRN AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN SSE_SURG_DTE + 1 DAY AND SSE_SURG_DTE + 30 DAYS WHERE R.VIS_ADM_DTE BETWEEN SSE_SURG_DTE + 1 DAY AND SSE_SURG_DTE + 30 DAYS ) , ANES AS (SELECT PATIENT_MRN ANES_MRN, DOS AS ANES_DOS, LOG_ID AS ANES_LOG_ID, SURGEON AS SURGEON_NAME, SUM(CASE WHEN AIFM_FLO_MEAS_ID = '400620' THEN CAST(STRIP(AIFM_MEAS_VALUE) AS DECIMAL(9, 2)) END) AS AN_EBL_ML FROM SURG JOIN IDB.AN_RECORD_SUMMARY ON LOG_ID = ARS_AN_CASELOG_ID JOIN IDB.AN_IP_DATA_STORE ON ARS_AN_CL_PT_ID = AIDS_CL_PT_ID JOIN IDB.AN_HSB_LINKED_DOC_CSN ON ARS_AN_EPISODE_ID = AHLDC_SUMMARY_BLOCK_ID AND AHLDC_LINKED_DOC_CSN = AIDS_ENC_CSN_ID JOIN IDB.AN_IP_FLOWSHEET_REC ON AIFRC_INPATIENT_DATA_ID = AIDS_INPATIENT_DATA_ID JOIN IDB.AN_IP_FLOWSHEET_MEAS ON AIFRC_FSD_ID = AIFM_FSD_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.AN_IP_FLOWSHEET_GP_DATA ON AIFM_FLO_MEAS_ID = AIFGD_FLO_MEAS_ID WHERE AIFM_FLO_MEAS_ID = '400620' AND AIFM_MEAS_VALUE > ' ' GROUP BY PATIENT_MRN, DOS, LOG_ID , SURGEON) , CLIND AS (SELECT CDD_MRN, CDD_SERVICE_DTE , ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CDD_MRN, DOS ORDER BY CDD_SERVICE_DTE DESC) AS RN , CDO_VALUE_TEXT AS SITE FROM IDB.CD_DOCUMENT LEFT JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION ON CDD_DOC_GUID = CDO_DOC_GUID AND CDD_AUTHORED_DTE = CDO_AUTHORED_DTE AND CDO_VALUE_TEXT <> '' JOIN SURG ON PATIENT_MRN = CDD_MRN WHERE CDD_CANCEL_IND <> '1' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND <> '1' AND CDD_DOC_NAME = 'Operative Report - Colorectal' AND CDO_SECTION IN ('Colorectal Procedures') AND CDO_ITEM_NAME IN ('Stoma Type:', 'Stoma') AND CDD_SERVICE_DTE BETWEEN DOS - 2 DAYS AND DOS + 3 DAYS ) , BMI AS (SELECT PMH_MRN, PMH_MEASURE_DTE, DOS AS SURG_DATE, PMH_WT_KG, PMH_HT_CM, PMH_BSA, PMH_BMI, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY PMH_MRN, DOS ORDER BY PMH_MEASURE_DTE DESC) BRN FROM IDB.PT_MEASURES_HX JOIN SURG ON PMH_MRN = PATIENT_MRN AND PMH_MEASURE_DTE < DOS) SELECT DISTINCT PATIENT_MRN AS MRN, PATIENT_NAME AS "Patient Name", PATIENT_AGE AS "Age as of Surgery Date", PATIENT_SEX AS "Gender", CPT_CODE AS "CPT Code", CPT_DESC AS "CPT Description", SURGEON, SITE, DOS AS "Date of Surgery", A.VIS_ADM_DTE AS "Admission Date", A.VIS_DSCH_DTE AS "Discharge Date", DSCH_DESC AS "Discharge Destination", ANESTHESIA_TYPE AS "Anesthesia Type", ASA_RATING AS "ASA Rating", AN_EBL_ML AS "EBL (ml)", ANESTHESIA_START_TIME_ACTUAL AS "Anesthesia Start Time", ANESTHESIA_END_TIME_ACTUAL AS "Anesthesia End Time", FIRST_PROCED_START_TIME_ACTUAL AS "Surgery Start Time", LAST_PROCEDURE_END_TIME_ACTUAL AS "Surgery End Time", SURGERY_DURATION AS "Surgery Duration", SURG_TYPE AS "Surgery Type", LOG_VISIT_TYPE AS "Patient Type", RADM_FLAG AS "Re-admission Flag", RADM_ADM_DTE AS "Re-admission Date", RADM_DSCH_DTE AS "Re-adm Discharge Date", UCC_FLAG, UCC_VISIT AS "UCC Visit Date", PMH_MEASURE_DTE AS BMI_DATE, PMH_WT_KG AS "Weight in KG", PMH_HT_CM AS "Height in CM", PMH_BMI AS BMI FROM SURG S LEFT JOIN ANES ON LOG_ID = ANES_LOG_ID LEFT JOIN ADM A ON A.VIS_MRN = PATIENT_MRN AND ADM_DOS = DOS LEFT JOIN BMI ON PMH_MRN = PATIENT_MRN AND BRN =1 AND DOS = SURG_DATE LEFT JOIN CLIND ON CDD_MRN = PATIENT_MRN AND RN =1 LEFT JOIN RE_ADM ON RADM_MRN = PATIENT_MRN WHERE CPT_CODE IS NOT NULL;

prompt: Find patients consented to 19-292 and 21-329
completion: WITH PROTOCOL_0 AS (SELECT "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AS PT_DEID, "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_MRN" AS PT_MRN, CAST(TRIM("IDB"."ACCRUALS"."AC_CONS_DTE") AS VARCHAR) || CAST(TRIM("IDB"."ACCRUALS"."AC_MRN") AS VARCHAR) || CAST(TRIM("IDB"."ACCRUALS"."AC_IRB_NO") AS VARCHAR) AS SUBJECT_ID, "IDB"."ACCRUALS"."AC_IRB_NO" AS AC_IRB_NO FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS" JOIN "IDB"."ACCRUALS" ON "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_MRN" = "IDB"."ACCRUALS"."AC_MRN" WHERE "IDB"."ACCRUALS"."AC_NON_MSK_INST" = '' AND "IDB"."ACCRUALS"."AC_IRB_NO" IN ('19-292', '21-329')), COHORT AS (SELECT PT_DEID AS PT_DEID FROM (SELECT PROTOCOL_0.PT_DEID AS PT_DEID FROM PROTOCOL_0)), COHORT_PROTOCOL AS (SELECT SUBJECT_ID AS SUBJECT_ID, PT_DEID AS PT_DEID FROM (SELECT PROTOCOL_0.SUBJECT_ID AS SUBJECT_ID, PROTOCOL_0.PT_DEID AS PT_DEID FROM PROTOCOL_0)), KEYS AS (SELECT COHORT.PT_DEID AS COHORT_PT_DEID, COHORT_PROTOCOL.SUBJECT_ID AS COHORT_PROTOCOL_SUBJECT_ID, COHORT_PROTOCOL.PT_DEID AS COHORT_PROTOCOL_PT_DEID FROM COHORT LEFT OUTER JOIN COHORT_PROTOCOL ON COHORT_PROTOCOL.PT_DEID = COHORT.PT_DEID), DIAGNOSIS_COLUMNS AS (SELECT DISTINCT "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AS PT_DEID, BASE_QUERY.PT_MRN AS PT_MRN, CAST(TRIM(BASE_QUERY.PT_MRN) AS VARCHAR) || CAST(TRIM(BASE_QUERY.DIAGNOSIS_DATE) AS VARCHAR) || CAST(TRIM(BASE_QUERY.ICD_CODES_ICD_CODE) AS VARCHAR) AS SUBJECT_ID, BASE_QUERY.ICD_CODES_ICD_CODE AS ICD_CODES_ICD_CODE, TRIM(BASE_QUERY.ICD_CODES_ICD_CODE) || '-' || TRIM("IDB"."CLM"."CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK") AS ICD_CODES_ICD_CODE_DESC FROM (SELECT "IDB"."CTC_CLSF"."CC_MRN" AS PT_MRN, "IDB"."CTC_CLSF"."CC_CLSF_CD" AS ICD_CODES_ICD_CODE, MIN("IDB"."CTC_CLSF"."CC_EFF_DTE") AS DIAGNOSIS_DATE FROM "IDB"."CTC_CLSF" WHERE "IDB"."CTC_CLSF"."CC_CLSF_TYPE" LIKE 'DF%' AND ("IDB"."CTC_CLSF"."CC_PT_TYPE" = 'I' OR ("IDB"."CTC_CLSF"."CC_PT_TYPE" = 'O' AND "IDB"."CTC_CLSF"."CC_FINALIZED_IND" = 'Y')) GROUP BY "IDB"."CTC_CLSF"."CC_MRN", "IDB"."CTC_CLSF"."CC_CLSF_CD") AS BASE_QUERY JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS" ON BASE_QUERY.PT_MRN = "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_MRN" JOIN "IDB"."CLM" ON BASE_QUERY.ICD_CODES_ICD_CODE = "IDB"."CLM"."CLM_CLSF_CD"), DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS AS (SELECT DISTINCT "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AS PT_DEID, IDB_PATIENT."PT_MRN" AS PT_MRN, "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AS SUBJECT_ID FROM "IDB"."PATIENT" AS IDB_PATIENT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS" ON IDB_PATIENT."PT_MRN" = "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_MRN") SELECT DISTINCT DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS.PT_MRN AS MRN, DIAGNOSIS_COLUMNS.ICD_CODES_ICD_CODE AS ICD_CODE, DIAGNOSIS_COLUMNS.ICD_CODES_ICD_CODE_DESC AS ICD_CODE_DESCRIPTION FROM KEYS LEFT OUTER JOIN DIAGNOSIS_COLUMNS ON DIAGNOSIS_COLUMNS.PT_DEID = KEYS.COHORT_PT_DEID LEFT OUTER JOIN DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS ON DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS.PT_DEID = KEYS.COHORT_PT_DEID;

prompt: For all patients with HLA data, provide deidentified immunotherapy, genetic, and DMP data.
completion: SELECT * FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_HLA ; SELECT DISTINCT PHLA_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID, YEAR(APR_START_DTE) AS START_YR , CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME, APR_DRUG_NAME, APR_ORD_RX_TYPE, APR_ROUTE, APR_QTY, APR_FREQ, APR_DURATION , APR_TOTAL_GIVEN_DOSE, APR_PRESCRIBED_DOSE, APR_DOSE_UOM, APR_DISPENSE_CNT, APR_ORAL_FLAG, APR_DIAGNOSIS_DESC, APR_PERFORMED_ORDERS_QTY_TEXT , APR_VISIT_GUID FROM IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX_V JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON PT_MRN = APR_MRN JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_HLA ON PHLA_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID WHERE CDG_IMMUNOTHERAPY_FLAG = 'Y' ORDER BY 1, 2, 3 ; SELECT PHLA_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID, PRPT_PATH_RPT_ID, YEAR(PATH_RPT_DATE) AS PATH_REPORT_YR, GENE, RESULT, LOCUS, AA_CHANGE, NUCLEOTIDE, METHOD, ABERRATIONTYPE, SEARCH_HIT1, SEARCH_HIT2 FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_STRUCTURED_RESULTS_V JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_HLA ON PHLA_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID WHERE 1=1 ORDER BY 1, 2, 4, 6, 7 ; SELECT DISTINCT PDRX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID P_ID, RPT.DT_DTE AS REPORT_DATE , T.*, DT.PDRX_PATH_RPT_ID FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML DT JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_HLA ON PHLA_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PDRX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID CROSS JOIN XMLTABLE('$c/root/ *' PASSING DT.PDRX_XML_VALUE AS "c" COLUMNS DMP_PATIENT_ID VARCHAR(264) PATH '../meta-data/dmp_patient_id', DMP_SAMPLE_ID VARCHAR(264) PATH '../meta-data/dmp_sample_id', PRIMARY_SITE VARCHAR(264) PATH '../meta-data/primary_site' , GENE_PANEL VARCHAR(264) PATH '../meta-data/gene-panel', TUMOR_TYPE_NAME VARCHAR(264) PATH '../meta-data/tumor_type_name' , TUMOR_TYPE_CODE VARCHAR(264) PATH '../meta-data/tumor_type_code' , PART_DESCRIPTION VARCHAR(264) PATH '../meta-data/part_description' , METASTASIS_SITE VARCHAR(264) PATH '../meta-data/metastasis_site') T JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V ON PRPT_PATH_RPT_ID = PDRX_PATH_RPT_ID JOIN DV.DATE_V RPT ON RPT.DT_DATE_ID = PRPT_REPORT_DATE_ID ORDER BY 1, 2, 3, 4 ;

prompt: We are looking to pull a dataline report of patients seen by sleep medicine (either in clinic or via home sleep study) and relevant demographics for our upcoming accreditation this year.
completion: WITH DX AS (SELECT CC_MRN MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS DX_DATE, CC_CLSF_CD AS CODE, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS DESCRIPTION, TRIM(CC_CLSF_CD) || ':' || TRIM(CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK) AS DX_DESC FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE CC_CLSF_CD IN ('200.60', '200.61', '200.62', '200.63', '200.64', '200.65', '200.66', '200.67', '200.68', '202.10', '202.11', '202.12', '202.13', '202.14', '202.15', '202.16', '202.17', '202.18', '202.20', '202.21', '202.22', '202.23', '202.24', '202.25', '202.26', '202.27', '202.28', '202.70', '202.71', '202.72', '202.73', '202.74', '202.75', '202.76', '202.77', '202.78', 'C84.00', 'C84.01', 'C84.02', 'C84.03', 'C84.04', 'C84.05', 'C84.06', 'C84.07', 'C84.08', 'C84.09', 'C84.10', 'C84.11', 'C84.12', 'C84.13', 'C84.14', 'C84.15', 'C84.16', 'C84.17', 'C84.18', 'C84.19', 'C84.40', 'C84.41', 'C84.42', 'C84.43', 'C84.44', 'C84.45', 'C84.46', 'C84.47', 'C84.48', 'C84.49', 'C84.60', 'C84.61', 'C84.62', 'C84.63', 'C84.64', 'C84.65',
