'C84.96', 'C84.97', 'C84.98', 'C84.99', 'C84.A0', 'C84.A1', 'C84.A2', 'C84.A3', 'C84.A4', 'C84.A5', 'C84.A6', 'C84.A7', 'C84.A8', 'C84.A9', 'C84.Z0', 'C84.Z1', 'C84.Z2', 'C84.Z3', 'C84.Z4', 'C84.Z5', 'C84.Z6', 'C84.Z7', 'C84.Z8', 'C84.Z9', 'C86.0', 'C86.1', 'C86.2', 'C86.3', 'C86.4', 'C86.5', 'C86.6') AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND (CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) GROUP BY CC_MRN, CC_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK UNION SELECT TM_MRN MRN, TM_DX_DTE DX_DATE, TM_HIST_CD CODE, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS DESCRIPTION, TRIM(TM_HIST_CD) || ':' || TRIM(H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK) DX_DESC FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS ON AV_ELEMENT = 'CASE_STS' AND AV_CODE = TM_CASE_STS WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND TM_HIST_CD IN ('M9413/3', 'M9700/3', 'M9701/3', 'M9702/3', 'M9705/3', 'M9706/3', 'M9707/3', 'M9708/3', 'M9709/3', 'M9714/3', 'M9716/3', 'M9717/3', 'M9718/3', 'M9719/3', 'M9724/3', 'M9726/3', 'M9729/3', 'M9827/3', 'M9831/3', 'M9834/3', 'M9837/3') ) , LA AS (SELECT MRN, LISTAGG(COALESCE(STRIP(CAST(DX_DESC AS VARCHAR(12000))), '') , CHR(13) || CHR(10)) WITHIN GROUP( ORDER BY MRN, DX_DESC) AS DX_CODES FROM DX GROUP BY MRN) , ONLY_APPT AS (SELECT CPE_MRN AS OA_MRN FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN DX ON DX.MRN = CPE_MRN GROUP BY CPE_MRN HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT CPE_ENC_DTE) = 1) , Q AS (SELECT CPE_MRN AS "MRN", TRIM(PT_LAST_NAME) || ', ' || TRIM(PT_FIRST_NAME) PT_NAME, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH DATE_OF_BIRTH, PT_DATE_OF_DEATH DATE_OF_DEATH, R.AV_DESC RACE, PT_SEX AS GENDER, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, CPE_ENC_DTE AS "Appt Date", ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CPE_MRN, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 ORDER BY CPE_ENC_DTE DESC) RN, S.CAV_TITLE AS "Service Desc", CLD_DEPT_NAME AS "Department Name", CRE_RES_NAME AS "Provider Name", CRE_RES_TYP, CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME AS "Visit Type", CASE WHEN (CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR LIKE '%NV%' OR CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR LIKE '%IR%') THEN 'NV' ELSE '' END AS "New Visit", LA.DX_CODES, CASE WHEN OA_MRN IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE NULL END AS "One visit only" FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN LA ON MRN = CPE_MRN LEFT JOIN ONLY_APPT ON OA_MRN = CPE_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_PATIENT ON CL_PRK = CPE_PRK JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_USER ON CPE_ENTER_USER_ID = CLE_USER_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_CATEGORY D ON D.CAV_CATEGORY = 'CLD_RPT_GRP_6' AND D.CAV_ABBR = CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_CATEGORY S ON S.CAV_CATEGORY = 'CLD_RPT_GRP_8' AND S.CAV_ABBR = CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 LEFT JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON CPE_MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS R ON R.AV_ELEMENT = 'RACE' AND R.AV_CODE = PT_RACE WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Comp') AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 IN ('LYM', 'LEU', 'LEULYM', 'BMT', 'DER') AND CRE_RES_TYP = 'Physician' AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN '2016-01-01' AND '2016-12-31' ) SELECT MRN, PT_NAME "Name", DATE_OF_BIRTH "Date of Birth", DATE_OF_DEATH "Date of Death", RACE "Race", GENDER "Gender", "Appt Date", "Service Desc", "Department Name", "Provider Name", CRE_RES_TYP "Resource Type", "Visit Type", "New Visit", DX_CODES, "One visit only" FROM Q WHERE RN = 1;

prompt: All patients undergoing rituximab or obinutuzumab or ofatumumab undergoing desensitization to the drug
completion: SELECT APR_MRN AS MRN, MIN(APR_START_DTE) AS FIRST_DESENSITIZATION, CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME AS DRUG_NAME FROM IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX_V JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON APR_MRN = PT_MRN AND YEAR(APR_START_DTE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) >= 18 WHERE CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME IN ('RITUXIMAB', 'OBINUTUZUMAB', 'OFATUMUMAB') AND APR_PRESCRIBED_DOSE < 50 GROUP BY APR_MRN, CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME HAVING MIN(APR_START_DTE) >='2019-11-01'

prompt: would like to know how many scripts for alpelisib have been submitted in the last 2 years?
completion: SELECT ORD_YEAR, COUNT(OO_MRN) AS COUNTS FROM (SELECT OO_MRN , YEAR(OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE) ORD_YEAR, OO_ORD_NAME AS ORDER_NAME FROM IDB.OMS_ORDER JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_CATALOG ON OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID = OOC_MSTR_ITEM_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_MED_DETAIL ON OMD_ORD_GUID = OO_ORD_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_STATUS ON OO_ORD_STS_CD = OSTS_ORD_STS_CD WHERE LOWER(OOC_ITEM_NAME) like 'alpelisib%' AND OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE BETWEEN '2016-01-01' AND CURRENT date AND OO_ORD_STS_CD NOT IN ('CANC', 'CANP', 'AUC3') ) GROUP BY ORD_YEAR

prompt: Provide a daily report of all adult patients admitted to Memorial Hospital who identify as Hindu, Buddhist, or Sikh.
completion: WITH X AS (SELECT STRIP(VIS_MRN) AS MRN, STRIP(PT_LAST_NAME) || ', ' || STRIP(PT_FIRST_NAME) AS "Name", PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH AS DOB, VIS_ADM_DTE AS "Admission Date", VIS_DSCH_DTE AS "Discharge Date", VIS_PATIENT_TYPE, VIS_HOSP_SVC AS "Hospital Service", VIS_NURS_STA AS "Nursing Station", VIS_BED AS "Bed", STRIP(RE.AV_DESC) AS "Religion", PT_PRIMARY_LANG, STRIP(LA.AV_DESC) AS "Primary Language" FROM IDB.VISIT JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON VIS_MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS RE ON RE.AV_CODE = PT_RELIGION AND RE.AV_ELEMENT = 'RELIGION' LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS LA ON LA.AV_CODE = PT_PRIMARY_LANG AND LA.AV_ELEMENT = 'PRIMARY_LANG' WHERE VIS_IP_OP_ADJUSTED_IND = 'I' AND VIS_VISIT_STATUS IN ('2', '3') AND VIS_ADM_DTE = CURRENT date - 1 DAY ) , CDD AS (SELECT CDD_MRN, CDD_DOC_GUID, CDD_SERVICE_DTE, CDD_DOC_NAME, CDO_SECTION, CDO_CTLG_DISPL_NM, CDO_MSTR_ITEM_NM, CDO_ITEM_NAME, CDO_VALUE_TEXT FROM X JOIN IDB.CD_DOCUMENT ON MRN = CDD_MRN JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION ON CDO_DOC_GUID = CDD_DOC_GUID AND CDO_AUTHORED_DTE = CDD_AUTHORED_DTE WHERE CDD_CANCEL_IND = '0' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND = '0' AND (LOCATE('BUDDHIST', UPPER(CDO_VALUE_TEXT)) > 0 OR LOCATE('HINDU', UPPER(CDO_VALUE_TEXT)) > 0 OR LOCATE('JAIN', UPPER(CDO_VALUE_TEXT)) > 0 OR LOCATE('SIKH', UPPER(CDO_VALUE_TEXT)) > 0) ) SELECT * FROM X WHERE "Religion" IN ('BUDDHIST', 'HINDU', 'SIKH') OR MRN IN (SELECT CDD_MRN FROM CDD)

prompt: Provide 2 reports - retrospective from 8/1/2013 to current and going forward monthly report on Pulmonary ClinDoc notes
completion: WITH MDCLINDOC AS (SELECT DISTINCT CDO_DOC_GUID DOCGUID, CDD_DOC_NAME DOCNAME, CDO_MRN MRN, STRIP(PT_LAST_NAME)||', '||STRIP(PT_FIRST_NAME) PT_NAME, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH DOB, OCV_CURR_LOC VISIT_LOC, OCV_PVDR_NAME PVDR_NAME, CDO_ENTER_DTE DOC_ENT_DTE, ENT.OU_DISPLAY_NAME AS ENTREDBY, ENT.OU_ORD_ROLE_TYPE ENTBY_ROLE, AUTH.OU_DISPLAY_NAME AS AUTH, AUTH.OU_ORD_ROLE_TYPE SVC_PVDR_ROLE, CDD_AUTHORED_DTE SVCDTE, OCV_VISIT_DTE VST_DATE, CDO_ITEM_NAME ITEM_LBL, CDO_VALUE_TEXT VALUE_TXT FROM IDB.CD_OBSERVATION JOIN IDB.CD_DOCUMENT ON CDO_DOC_GUID = CDD_DOC_GUID JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON CDO_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.OMS_CLIENT_VISIT ON CDD_VISIT_GUID = OCV_VISIT_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_USER ENT ON CDD_USER_GUID = ENT.OU_USER_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_USER AUTH ON CDD_AUTH_PROV_GUID = AUTH.OU_USER_GUID LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_USER PTCARE ON CDD_PTCAREDOC_GUID = PTCARE.OU_USER_GUID WHERE CDD_AUTHORED_DTE >= '2013-12-10' AND CDD_DOC_NAME IN ('Progress Note - Pulmonary', 'Initial Consult/Initial Visit - Pulmonary', 'Follow Up - Pulmonary', 'Follow Up Consultation - DOM-Pulmonary') AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND = '0' AND CDD_CANCEL_IND = '0' ) SELECT DOCGUID, DOCNAME, MRN, PT_NAME, DOB, VISIT_LOC, PVDR_NAME, DOC_ENT_DTE, ENTREDBY, ENTBY_ROLE, AUTH, SVC_PVDR_ROLE, SVCDTE, VST_DATE , MAX(CASE WHEN ITEM_LBL= 'Consult Reason' THEN COALESCE(VALUE_TXT, '') ELSE '' END) CONSULTREASON , MAX(CASE WHEN ITEM_LBL= 'Consult Reason: Other' THEN COALESCE(VALUE_TXT, '') ELSE '' END) CONSULTREASONOTHER , MAX(CASE WHEN ITEM_LBL= 'Pulmonary Diagnosis' THEN COALESCE(VALUE_TXT, '') ELSE '' END) PULMONARYDX , MAX(CASE WHEN ITEM_LBL= 'Primary Cancer Diagnosis' THEN COALESCE(VALUE_TXT, '') ELSE '' END) PRIMARYDX , MAX(CASE WHEN ITEM_LBL= 'Attending Physician Statement' THEN COALESCE(VALUE_TXT, '') ELSE '' END) ATTPHYSSTMT , MAX(CASE WHEN ITEM_LBL= 'Consult Requested by' THEN COALESCE(VALUE_TXT, '') ELSE '' END) REQUESTEDBY FROM MDCLINDOC GROUP BY DOCGUID, DOCNAME, MRN, PT_NAME, DOB, VISIT_LOC, PVDR_NAME, DOC_ENT_DTE, ENTREDBY, ENTBY_ROLE, AUTH, SVC_PVDR_ROLE, SVCDTE, VST_DATE

prompt: Provide a list of patients with newly diagnosed multiple myeloma treated with MSK between 2015 to 2022.
completion: WITH MM AS (SELECT DISTINCT TM_MRN AS MRN , TM_DX_DTE AS DX_DATE , TM_HIST_CD AS DX_CODE , H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS DX_DESC FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM H ON TM_HIST_CD = H.CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON TM_SITE_CD = S.CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND TM_HIST_CD IN ('M9731/3', 'M9732/3', 'M9734/3') AND TM_DX_DTE BETWEEN '2015-01-01' AND '2022-12-31' UNION SELECT DISTINCT CC_MRN AS MRN , MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS DX_DATE , CLM_CLSF_CD AS DX_CODE , CLM_CLSF_DESC AS DX_DESC FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND ((CC_PT_TYPE = 'I') OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) AND CC_CLSF_CD IN ('203', '203.0', '203.00', '203.01', '203.02', '238.6', 'C90.0', 'C90.00', 'C90.01', 'C90.02', 'C90.2', 'C90.20', 'C90.21', 'C90.22', 'C90.30', 'C90.31', 'C90.32') GROUP BY CC_MRN, CLM_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC HAVING MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) BETWEEN '2015-01-01' AND '2022-12-31'), PAT AS (SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN , PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH AS DOB , STRIP(A.AV_DESC) AS GENDER , STRIP(B.AV_DESC) AS ETHNICITY , DX_DATE , STRIP(DX_CODE) AS DX_CODE , PT_DATE_OF_DEATH AS DOD , COALESCE(MAX(PLA_LST_APPT_DTE, PLA_LST_DSCH_DTE), PLA_LST_APPT_DTE, PLA_LST_DSCH_DTE) AS LAST_FU_DATE, ROW_NUMBER () OVER (PARTITION BY MRN ORDER BY DX_DATE) AS RN FROM MM M1 JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON M1.MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY ON M1.MRN = PLA_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS A ON A.AV_ELEMENT = 'SEX' AND A.AV_CODE = PT_SEX LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS B ON B.AV_ELEMENT = 'PT_ETHNICITY' AND B.AV_CODE = PT_PT_ETHNICITY), CHEMO AS (SELECT DISTINCT APR_MRN, APR_GENERIC_NAME, CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME, MIN (APR_START_DTE) OVER (PARTITION BY MRN, CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME) AS ANP_START, MAX(APR_START_DTE) OVER (PARTITION BY MRN, CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME) AS ANP_END FROM MM M2 JOIN IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX_V ON M2.MRN = APR_MRN AND CDG_CHEMO_FLAG = 'Y' WHERE LOWER(CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME) IN ('carfilzomib', 'bortezomib', 'daratumumab', 'daratumumab-hyaluronidase') ), HCT AS (SELECT CBM_MRN AS MRN, CBM_TRANSPLANT_TYPE AS BMT_TYPE, CBM_TRANSPLANT_DTE AS BMT_DATE FROM IDB.CRDB_BMT_MEDICINE JOIN MM M3 ON CBM_MRN = M3.MRN UNION SELECT CBP_MRN AS MRN, CBP_TRANSPLANT_TYPE AS BMT_TYPE, CBP_TRANSPLANT_DTE AS BMT_DATE FROM IDB.CRDB_BMT_PEDIATRICS JOIN MM M3 ON CBP_MRN = M3.MRN ) SELECT DISTINCT MM.MRN "MRN" , DOB "DATE OF BIRTH" , DX_DESC "DIAGNOSIS" , GENDER "GENDER" , ETHNICITY "ETHNICITY" , CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME "DRUG NAME" , ANP_START "DRUG START DTE" , ANP_END "DRUG END DTE" , BMT_DATE "BMT DATE" , DOD "DATE OF DEATH" , LAST_FU_DATE "LAST FOLLOW-UP DATE" FROM MM LEFT JOIN PAT ON MM.MRN = PT_MRN AND RN = 1 LEFT JOIN CHEMO ON MM.MRN = APR_MRN LEFT JOIN HCT ON MM.MRN = HCT.MRN ; WITH MM AS (SELECT DISTINCT TM_MRN AS MRN , TM_DX_DTE AS DX_DATE , TM_HIST_CD AS DX_CODE , H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS DX_DESC FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM H ON TM_HIST_CD = H.CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON TM_SITE_CD = S.CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND TM_HIST_CD IN ('M9731/3', 'M9732/3', 'M9734/3') AND TM_DX_DTE BETWEEN '2015-01-01' AND '2022-12-31' UNION SELECT DISTINCT CC_MRN AS MRN , MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS DX_DATE , CLM_CLSF_CD AS DX_CODE , CLM_CLSF_DESC AS DX_DESC FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND ((CC_PT_TYPE = 'I') OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) AND CC_CLSF_CD IN ('203', '203.0', '203.00', '203.01', '203.02', '238.6', 'C90.0', 'C90.00', 'C90.01', 'C90.02', 'C90.2', 'C90.20', 'C90.21', 'C90.22', 'C90.30', 'C90.31', 'C90.32') GROUP BY CC_MRN, CLM_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC HAVING MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) BETWEEN '2015-01-01' AND '2022-12-31'), PATH AS (SELECT DISTINCT PRPT_MRN , UPPER(CASE WHEN LENGTH(PRPT_REPORT) <= 15000 THEN RTRIM(CAST(SUBSTR(PRPT_REPORT, 1, 15000) AS VARCHAR(15000))) ELSE CAST(SUBSTR(PRPT_REPORT, 1, 15000) AS VARCHAR(15000)) END) AS TXT , PRPT_PROCEDURE_DTE FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V JOIN MM ON PRPT_MRN = MRN WHERE PRPT_REPORT IS NOT NULL AND PRPT_REPORT_TYPE_DESC = 'Cytogenetics' ) SELECT DISTINCT MRN , DX_CODE "DIAGNOSIS" , DX_DESC "DIAGNOSIS DESC" , PRPT_PROCEDURE_DTE "PROCEDURE DATE" , TXT "REPORT TEXT" FROM MM JOIN PATH ON MRN = PRPT_MRN WHERE 1=1 AND LOCATE('fish', LOWER(TXT)) > 0 AND LOCATE('diagnostic interpretation', LOWER(TXT)) > 0 ;

prompt: Provide a list of patients on immunotherapy who also received ustekinumab (Stelara)
completion: SELECT APR_MRN, TRIM(PT_LAST_NAME) CONCAT ', ' CONCAT TRIM(PT_FIRST_NAME) PT_NAME, PT_SEX SEX, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH DOB, R.AV_DESC AS "Race (Reg)", CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME, MIN(APR_START_DTE) DRUG_START_DATE, MAX(APR_END_DTE) DRUG_END_DATE, CASE WHEN SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD IS NULL THEN 'NO' ELSE 'YES' END SKIN_BX, SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD SKIN_BX_CD, SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC SKIN_BX_DESC FROM IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX JOIN IDB.CHEMO_DRUG_GENERIC ON APR_GENERIC_NAME = CDG_GENERIC_NAME JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON APR_MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS R ON R.AV_ELEMENT = 'RACE' AND R.AV_CODE = PT_RACE LEFT JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT ON APR_MRN = SSE_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE ON SSE_LOG_ID = SSP_LOG_ID AND SSE_ENC_CSN_ID = SSP_ENC_CSN_ID WHERE 1 = 1 AND UPPER(CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME) IN ('DURVALUMAB', 'AVELUMAB', 'ATEZOLIZUMAB', 'CEMIPLIMAB', 'NIVOLUMAB', 'PEMBROLIZUMAB', 'IPILIMUMAB') AND APR_START_DTE BETWEEN '2017-01-01' AND '2022-09-30' AND (SSE_SURG_LOC not like '%IR%' AND SSE_SURG_LOC not like '%ENDO%' AND SSE_SOURCE_TYPE <> 'E') AND (SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD IN ('11106', '11107', '11104', '11100', '11101') OR SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD IS NULL) AND APR_MRN IN (SELECT DISTINCT VIS_MRN FROM IDB.VISIT_V JOIN IDB.ACCRUALS ON AC_MRN = VIS_MRN WHERE 1 = 1 AND VIS_VISIT_STATUS IN ('2', '3') AND VIS_ADM_DTE BETWEEN '2017-01-01' AND '2022-09-30' AND AC_IRB_NO IN ('06-107', '12-245')) GROUP BY APR_MRN, TRIM(PT_LAST_NAME) CONCAT ', ' CONCAT TRIM(PT_FIRST_NAME), PT_SEX, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, R.AV_DESC, CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME, CASE WHEN SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD IS NULL THEN 'NO' ELSE 'YES' END, SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD, SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC ORDER BY APR_MRN

prompt: Provide an update daily csv file PRP25783 to include patients who had a disposition of "Home with outpatient services",
completion: SELECT DISTINCT CL_MRN , CL_LAST_NAME, CL_FIRST_NAME, CL_MOBILE_PHONE, CL_PHONE, CL_EMAIL_ADDRESS, CL_DATE_OF_BIRTH, CL_SEX, CL_ZIP, PREF_LANG, UNIQUE_VISIT_ID, REFERRING_MD, REFERRING_MD AS PROVIDER_ID, ADM_DATE, DSCH_DATE, DISPOSITION, HOSPITAL FROM (SELECT DISTINCT CL_MRN , CL_LAST_NAME, CL_FIRST_NAME, CL_MOBILE_PHONE, CL_PHONE, CL_EMAIL_ADDRESS, CL_DATE_OF_BIRTH, CL_SEX, CL_ZIP, CAV_TITLE AS PREF_LANG, CDD_DOC_GUID AS UNIQUE_VISIT_ID, REFMD.CDO_VALUE_TEXT AS REFERRING_MD , CAST(RTRIM(ADM_DTE.CDO_VALUE_TEXT) AS date) AS ADM_DATE , CAST (RTRIM(DSCH_DTE.CDO_VALUE_TEXT) AS date) AS DSCH_DATE, DSCH.CDO_VALUE_TEXT AS DISPOSITION , HOSP.CDO_VALUE_TEXT AS HOSPITAL , PLA_DONOT_MAIL_IND, PLA_DECEASED_IND FROM IDB.CD_DOCUMENT JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION DSCH ON DSCH.CDO_DOC_GUID = CDD_DOC_GUID LEFT JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION DSCH_DTE ON DSCH_DTE.CDO_DOC_GUID = CDD_DOC_GUID AND DSCH_DTE.CDO_ITEM_NAME = 'Actual Inpatient Discharge Date' LEFT JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION ADM_DTE ON ADM_DTE.CDO_DOC_GUID = CDD_DOC_GUID AND ADM_DTE.CDO_ITEM_NAME = 'ED Admission' LEFT JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION DR ON DR.CDO_DOC_GUID = CDD_DOC_GUID AND DR.CDO_ITEM_NAME = 'MSK Comm Primary LIP' LEFT JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION HOSP ON HOSP.CDO_DOC_GUID = CDD_DOC_GUID AND HOSP.CDO_ITEM_NAME = 'Hospitals' LEFT JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION REFMD ON REFMD.CDO_DOC_GUID = CDD_DOC_GUID AND REFMD.CDO_ITEM_NAME = 'MSK Comm Primary LIP' LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_USER ON DSCH.CDO_USER_GUID = OU_USER_GUID LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_PROVIDER ON OP_USER_GUID = OU_USER_GUID LEFT JOIN IDB.DOC ON OP_PVDR_NO = DOC_DR_NO JOIN IDB.CL_PATIENT ON CDD_MRN = CL_MRN JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY ON CDD_MRN = PLA_MRN AND (PLA_DONOT_MAIL_IND <> 'Y' OR PLA_DECEASED_IND <> 'Y') LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_CATEGORY ON CL_PRIMARY_LANG = CAV_ABBR WHERE 1=1 AND CDD_ENTER_DTE = CURRENT DATE - 1 AND CDD_CANCEL_IND = '0' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND = '0' AND CDD_DOC_NAME = 'External Communication - Shared Care-Discharge Summary' AND DSCH.CDO_ITEM_NAME = 'Discharged to' AND DSCH.CDO_VALUE_TEXT IN ('Home', 'Home with home services') ) AS X WHERE 1=1 AND DSCH_DATE IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT DISTINCT CL_MRN , CL_LAST_NAME, CL_FIRST_NAME, CL_MOBILE_PHONE, CL_PHONE, CL_EMAIL_ADDRESS, CL_DATE_OF_BIRTH, CL_SEX, CL_ZIP, CAV_TITLE AS PREF_LANG, OUO_ORD_GUID AS UNIQUE_VISIT_ID, REFERRING_MD, REFERRING_MD AS PROVIDER_ID, ADM_DTE, DISCH_DTE, DISPOSITION, HOSPITAL FROM (SELECT DISTINCT OUO_MRN, OUO_ENTER_DTE , OUO_ORD_GUID , OUO_ORD_NAME , HOSP.OUD_USER_DI_CD, HOSP.OUD_USER_DI_VALUE AS HOSP, DSCH.OUD_USER_DI_CD, CAST (RTRIM(DSCH.OUD_USER_DI_VALUE) AS date) AS DSCH_DTE FROM IDB.OMS_USER_ORDERS JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_CATALOG ON OOC_MSTR_ITEM_GUID = OUO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_USER_DATA HOSP ON HOSP.OUD_ORD_GUID = OUO_ORD_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_USER_DATA DSCH ON DSCH.OUD_ORD_GUID = OUO_ORD_GUID AND DSCH.OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'External_Hospital_Discharge_Date' WHERE 1=1 AND OUO_ENTER_DTE = CURRENT DATE - 1 AND OUO_ORD_STS_CD NOT IN ('CANC', 'CANP') AND OUO_ORD_NAME = 'External Hospital Discharge' AND HOSP.OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'External_Hospital_Location' ) AS X JOIN IDACS.PARTNER_HOSP_ADMISSIONS ON OUO_MRN = MRN AND DSCH_DTE = DISCH_DTE AND UPPER(DISPOSITION) IN ('HOME', 'HOME WITH HOME SERVICES', 'HOME WITH OUTPATIENT SERVICES') JOIN IDB.CL_PATIENT ON MRN = CL_MRN JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY ON MRN = PLA_MRN AND (PLA_DONOT_MAIL_IND <> 'Y' OR PLA_DECEASED_IND <> 'Y') LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_CATEGORY ON CL_PRIMARY_LANG = CAV_ABBR

prompt: Please provide a list of all lymphoma patients treated with radiation dose of 200 cGY x 2 fractions (total dose of 400 cGY) from January 1  2023 to October 1 2023.
completion: WITH LYM AS (SELECT CC_MRN, CC_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS LYM_EFF_DT FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CLM_CLSF_CD = CC_CLSF_CD WHERE 1=1 AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND (CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) AND ((CC_CLSF_CD LIKE 'C82%' OR CC_CLSF_CD LIKE 'C83%' OR CC_CLSF_CD LIKE 'C85%' OR CC_CLSF_CD LIKE 'C88%') OR (CC_CLSF_CD LIKE '200%' OR CC_CLSF_CD LIKE '202%') OR (CC_CLSF_CD IN ('203.80', '203.81', '203.82', '238.79', '273.3'))) GROUP BY CC_MRN, CC_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK ) , IRB AS (SELECT AC_MRN FROM IDB.ACCRUALS WHERE AC_IRB_NO = '12-245' ) SELECT DISTINCT RTC_TX_MRN, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH "DATE OF BIRTH", PT_GENDER "SEX", CASE WHEN PT_DEATH_IND IN ('', 'A') THEN 'ALIVE' ELSE 'DECEASED' END AS "VITAL STATUS", RTC_TX_COURSE_NO, RTC_TX_PLANSETUP_NO, RTC_TX_COURSE_ID, RTC_TX_PLAN_NAME, RTC_TX_PLANNED_FRACTIONS, RTC_TX_DELIVERED_FRACTIONS, RTC_TX_PLANNED_DOSE, RTC_TX_DELIVERED_DOSE, RTC_TX_START_DTE, RTC_TX_STOP_DTE, RTC_TX_ELAPSED_DAYS, RTC_PRIMARY_REF_POINT, RTC_DOSE_CORRECTION, CASE WHEN AC_MRN IS NULL THEN 'No' ELSE 'Yes' END AS CONSENT FROM IDB.RADONC_TREATMENT_COURSE JOIN LYM ON CC_MRN = RTC_TX_MRN LEFT JOIN IRB ON RTC_TX_MRN = AC_MRN JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON RTC_TX_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE 1=1 AND RTC_TX_DELIVERED_DOSE IN ('200', '400') AND RTC_TX_DELIVERED_FRACTIONS IN ('2', '1') AND RTC_TX_START_DTE BETWEEN '2023-01-01' AND '2023-10-01'

prompt: Provide the numbers of unique patients seen annually at MSK with a diagnosis of cutaneous T-cell lymphoma, and referrals to supportive care and/or psychiatry for these patients.
completion: WITH PTS AS (SELECT DISTINCT TM_MRN FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR WHERE TM_HIST_CD IN ('M9700/3', 'M9701/3', 'M9709/3', 'M9718/1', 'M9718/3', 'M9726/3') AND TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') ) , VISITS AS (SELECT YEAR(CPE_ENC_DTE) VIS_YR , COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN (CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR LIKE '%NV%' OR CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR LIKE '%IR%') THEN CPE_MRN END) NUM_NV_IR_PTS , COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN NOT (CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR LIKE '%NV%' OR CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR LIKE '%IR%') THEN CPE_MRN END) NUM_FU_PTS FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN PTS ON CPE_MRN = TM_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND YEAR(CPE_ENC_DTE) < 2021 GROUP BY YEAR(CPE_ENC_DTE) ) , ORD AS (SELECT YEAR(OO_ENTER_DTE) ORD_YR , COUNT(DISTINCT OO_MRN) NUM_CONS_PTS FROM IDB.OMS_ORDER JOIN PTS ON OO_MRN = TM_MRN WHERE OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID IN ('9000008448100730', '9000013797200730', '9000011140100730', '9000011140200730', '9000006901200730', '9000009225100730', '9000010979100730', '1032073001', '1152073001', '2000004078073029', '9000007556200730') AND OO_ORD_STS_CD NOT IN ('CANP', 'CANC', 'AUC3', 'DISC') AND YEAR(OO_ENTER_DTE) BETWEEN 2000 AND 2020 GROUP BY YEAR(OO_ENTER_DTE) ) SELECT VIS_YR YR , NUM_NV_IR_PTS , NUM_FU_PTS , NUM_CONS_PTS FROM VISITS LEFT JOIN ORD ON VIS_YR = ORD_YR ORDER BY 1 ; WITH PTS AS (SELECT DISTINCT TM_MRN FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR WHERE TM_HIST_CD IN ('M9700/3', 'M9701/3', 'M9709/3', 'M9718/1', 'M9718/3', 'M9726/3') AND TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') ) , VISITS AS (SELECT YEAR(CPE_ENC_DTE) VIS_YR , COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN (CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR LIKE '%NV%' OR CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR LIKE '%IR%') THEN CPE_MRN END) NUM_NV_IR_PTS , COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN NOT (CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR LIKE '%NV%' OR CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR LIKE '%IR%') THEN CPE_MRN END) NUM_FU_PTS FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN PTS ON CPE_MRN = TM_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND YEAR(CPE_ENC_DTE) < 2021 GROUP BY YEAR(CPE_ENC_DTE) ) SELECT YEAR(OO_ENTER_DTE) ORD_YR , CASE WHEN OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID IN ('9000008448100730', '9000013797200730', '9000007556200730') THEN 'Supportive Care' WHEN OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID IN ('9000011140100730', '9000011140200730', '2000004078073029', '1032073001') THEN 'Psych' WHEN OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID IN ('9000006901200730', '9000009225100730', '9000010979100730', '1152073001') THEN 'Palliative' END CONSULT_ORD_TYP , COUNT(DISTINCT OO_MRN) NUM_CONS_PTS FROM IDB.OMS_ORDER JOIN PTS ON OO_MRN = TM_MRN WHERE OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID IN ('9000008448100730', '9000013797200730', '9000011140100730', '9000011140200730', '9000006901200730', '9000009225100730', '9000010979100730', '1032073001', '1152073001', '2000004078073029', '9000007556200730') AND OO_ORD_STS_CD NOT IN ('CANP', 'CANC', 'AUC3', 'DISC') AND YEAR(OO_ENTER_DTE) BETWEEN 2000 AND 2020 GROUP BY YEAR(OO_ENTER_DTE) , CASE WHEN OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID IN ('9000008448100730', '9000013797200730', '9000007556200730') THEN 'Supportive Care' WHEN OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID IN ('9000011140100730', '9000011140200730', '2000004078073029', '1032073001') THEN 'Psych' WHEN OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID IN ('9000006901200730', '9000009225100730', '9000010979100730', '1152073001') THEN 'Palliative' END ORDER BY 1

prompt: Design a weekly report of metastatic breast cancer patients with PIK3CA mutations who have been treated with palbo and have an upcoming CT, PET, biopsy or bone scan.
completion: WITH X AS (SELECT * FROM (SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN, RESULT, GENE, PDRX_ACCESSION_NO, T.* FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_STRUCTURED_RESULTS_V JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML DT ON PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PDRX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID CROSS JOIN XMLTABLE('$c/root/*' PASSING DT.PDRX_XML_VALUE AS "c" COLUMNS TUMOR_TYPE_NAME VARCHAR(264) PATH '../meta-data/tumor_type_name', PRIMARY_SITE VARCHAR(100) PATH '../meta-data/primary_site', IS_METASTASIS VARCHAR(10) PATH '../meta-data/is_metastasis', METASTASIS_SITE VARCHAR(100) PATH '../meta-data/metastasis_site') T WHERE GENE = 'PIK3CA' ) IMPACT WHERE UPPER(PRIMARY_SITE) like '%BREAST%' AND METASTASIS_SITE <> '' AND UPPER(METASTASIS_SITE) <> 'NA' AND UPPER(METASTASIS_SITE) NOT LIKE 'NOT%' ) , APR AS (SELECT APR_MRN, CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME, MIN(APR_START_DTE) AS START_DATE, MAX(APR_END_DTE) AS END_DATE FROM X JOIN IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX_V ON PT_MRN = APR_MRN WHERE UPPER(CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME) LIKE '%PALBO%' GROUP BY APR_MRN, CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME ) , Y AS (SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN, RESULT, GENE, CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME, START_DATE, END_DATE FROM X JOIN APR ON PT_MRN = APR_MRN) SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN AS MRN, CPE_ENC_DTE, CRE_RES_NAME, CRE_RES_TYP, CLD_DEPT_NAME, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8, CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CPE_MRN ORDER BY CPE_ENC_DTE DESC) AS RN FROM Y JOIN IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER ON PT_MRN = CPE_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Sch') AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT DATE AND CURRENT DATE + 6 DAYS AND((CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 = 'BRE' AND CRE_RES_TYP IN ('Physician')) OR (CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 IN ('NUC', 'RAD') AND (CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME LIKE 'CT%CH%' OR CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME LIKE 'CT%AB%' OR CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME LIKE 'CT%PE%' OR CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME LIKE '%PET%' OR CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME LIKE 'BI%' OR CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME LIKE '%BONE%')))

prompt: Provide a list of future visits for Kathleen Keenan, NP.
completion: WITH PATIENT AS (SELECT PT_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, PT_ADDR1, PT_ADDR2, PT_CITY, PT_STATE, PT_ZIP_CD FROM IDB.PATIENT), ENCOUNTER AS (SELECT CPE_MRN, CPE_ENC_DTE, CPE_VST_RES_ID, CPE_ENC_TYP_CD, CPE_CPE_APPT_STS, CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID, CPE_DEPT_ID FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER CPE WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Sch') AND CPE_ENC_DTE > CURRENT date ), VISIT AS (SELECT CVT_REC_TYP, CVT_EXT_NAME, CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID, CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME FROM IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE), RESOURSE AS (SELECT CRE_RES_ID, CRE_RES_NAME FROM IDB.CL_RESOURCE WHERE CRE_RES_NAME = 'KEENAN, KATHLEEN' AND CRE_RES_ID = '080085' ), DEPT AS (SELECT CLD_DEPT_NAME, CLD_DEPT_ID FROM IDB.CL_DEPT), PTACTIVITY AS (SELECT PLA_MRN, PLA_DONOT_MAIL_IND FROM IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY) SELECT PT_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, PT_ADDR1, PT_ADDR2, PT_CITY, PT_STATE, PT_ZIP_CD, CPE_MRN, CPE_ENC_DTE, CVT_REC_TYP, CVT_EXT_NAME, CRE_RES_ID, CRE_RES_NAME, CLD_DEPT_NAME, CLD_DEPT_ID, PLA_MRN, PLA_DONOT_MAIL_IND FROM ENCOUNTER AS E JOIN PATIENT AS P ON E.CPE_MRN = P.PT_MRN JOIN DEPT AS D ON E.CPE_DEPT_ID = D.CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN PTACTIVITY AS A ON E.CPE_MRN = A.PLA_MRN JOIN VISIT AS V ON E.CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = V.CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID JOIN RESOURSE AS R ON E.CPE_VST_RES_ID = R.CRE_RES_ID

prompt: Provide a report of the check-boxes selected on the Initial Assessment - Nutrition note in ClinDoc for the past 3 months.

FROM IDB.CD_DOCUMENT JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION ON CDO_DOC_GUID = CDD_DOC_GUID AND CDO_AUTHORED_DTE = CDD_AUTHORED_DTE WHERE CDD_CANCEL_IND = '0' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND = '0' AND CDD_DOC_NAME = 'Initial Assessment - Nutrition' AND CDD_SERVICE_DTE BETWEEN '2019-07-01' AND '2019-09-30' ) SELECT DISTINCT X.CDD_MRN, X.CDD_DOC_GUID, X.CDD_SERVICE_DTE, X.CDD_DOC_NAME, Y1.VALUE_TEXT AS "Appetite/Intake:", Y2.VALUE_TEXT AS "GI Tract:", Y3.VALUE_TEXT AS "Oral/Swallowing:", Y4.VALUE_TEXT AS "Physical Findings:", Y5.VALUE_TEXT AS "Psychosocial:", Y6.VALUE_TEXT AS "Problem1", Y7.VALUE_TEXT AS "Problem2", Y8.VALUE_TEXT AS "Problem3", Y9.VALUE_TEXT AS "Problem4", Y10.VALUE_TEXT AS "Needs1:", Y11.VALUE_TEXT AS "Weight gain:", Y12.VALUE_TEXT AS "Patient will consume >=:", Y13.VALUE_TEXT AS "Needs2:", Y14.VALUE_TEXT AS "Oral diet:", Y15.VALUE_TEXT AS "Insure adequacy of intake via:", Y16.VALUE_TEXT AS "Promote wound healing via:", Y17.VALUE_TEXT AS "Patient will meet 100% of estimated daily fluid needs via:", Y18.VALUE_TEXT AS "Prevent or correct nutrient deficiencies via supplementation with:", Y19.VALUE_TEXT AS "Diet:", Y20.VALUE_TEXT AS "Lab values", Y21.VALUE_TEXT AS "Promote pre-meal blood glucose", Y22.VALUE_TEXT AS "Minimize gastrointestinal-related symptoms via:", Y23.VALUE_TEXT AS "Minimize risk of developing signs and symptoms of refeeding syndrome via:", Y24.VALUE_TEXT AS "The following nutrition indicators will be monitored and evaluated upon follow-up:", Y25.VALUE_TEXT AS "Anthro Measurements:", Y26.VALUE_TEXT AS "Initial_NUTASSMT_MON Bioc SUG", Y27.VALUE_TEXT AS "Fluids:", Y28.VALUE_TEXT AS "Food and Nutrition", Y29.VALUE_TEXT AS "Followup as per policy", Y30.VALUE_TEXT AS "Food Knowledge:", Y31.VALUE_TEXT AS "Physical:" FROM X LEFT JOIN X Y1 ON Y1.CDD_DOC_GUID = X.CDD_DOC_GUID AND Y1.CDO_MSTR_ITEM_NM = 'Initial_NUTRISK_Factors App RES' LEFT JOIN X Y2 ON Y2.CDD_DOC_GUID = X.CDD_DOC_GUID AND Y2.CDO_MSTR_ITEM_NM = 'Initial_NUTRISK_Factors GI RES' LEFT JOIN X Y3 ON Y3.CDD_DOC_GUID = X.CDD_DOC_GUID AND Y3.CDO_MSTR_ITEM_NM = 'Initial_NUTRISK_Factors Ora RES' LEFT JOIN X Y4 ON Y4.CDD_DOC_GUID = X.CDD_DOC_GUID AND Y4.CDO_MSTR_ITEM_NM = 'Initial_NUTRISK_Phy Find RES' LEFT JOIN X Y5 ON Y5.CDD_DOC_GUID = X.CDD_DOC_GUID AND Y5.CDO_MSTR_ITEM_NM = 'Initial_NUTRISK_Psych RES' LEFT JOIN X Y6 ON Y6.CDD_DOC_GUID = X.CDD_DOC_GUID AND Y6.CDO_MSTR_ITEM_NM = 'Initial_NUTASSMT_Problem-1aaa SUG' LEFT JOIN X Y7 ON Y7.CDD_DOC_GUID = X.CDD_DOC_GUID AND Y7.CDO_MSTR_ITEM_NM = 'Initial_NUTASSMT_Problem-2aaa SUG' LEFT JOIN X Y8 ON Y8.CDD_DOC_GUID = X.CDD_DOC_GUID AND Y8.CDO_MSTR_ITEM_NM = 'Initial_NUTASSMT_Problem-3aaa SUG' LEFT JOIN X Y9 ON Y9.CDD_DOC_GUID = X.CDD_DOC_GUID AND Y9.CDO_MSTR_ITEM_NM = 'Initial_NUTASSMT_Problem-4aaa SUG' LEFT JOIN X Y10 ON Y10.CDD_DOC_GUID = X.CDD_DOC_GUID AND Y10.CDO_MSTR_ITEM_NM = 'Initial_NUT_Goals_Needs_1 RES' LEFT JOIN X Y11 ON Y11.CDD_DOC_GUID = X.CDD_DOC_GUID AND Y11.CDO_MSTR_ITEM_NM = 'Initial_NUT_Goals_Needs_1.2_FT' LEFT JOIN X Y12 ON Y12.CDD_DOC_GUID = X.CDD_DOC_GUID AND Y12.CDO_MSTR_ITEM_NM = 'Initial_NUT_Goals_Needs_1_FT' LEFT JOIN X Y13 ON RES' LEFT JOIN X Y15 ON Y15.CDD_DOC_GUID = X.CDD_DOC_GUID AND Y15.CDO_MSTR_ITEM_NM = 'Initial_NUT_Goals_Needs_4 RES' LEFT JOIN X Y16 ON Y16.CDD_DOC_GUID = X.CDD_DOC_GUID AND Y16.CDO_MSTR_ITEM_NM = 'Initial_NUT_Goals_Needs_5 RES' LEFT JOIN X Y17 ON Y17.CDD_DOC_GUID = X.CDD_DOC_GUID AND Y17.CDO_MSTR_ITEM_NM = 'Initial_NUT_Goals_Needs_6 RES' LEFT JOIN X Y18 ON Y18.CDD_DOC_GUID = X.CDD_DOC_GUID AND
