prompt: Create a Darwin report to pull PBD and SRG Coding History
completion: SELECT DISTINCT SSE_MRN "MRN", SSE_SURG_DTE "SRG Surgery Date", SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD "SRG CPT Code", SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC "SRG CPT Description", TRIM(SSP_SURG_LAST_NM) || ', ' || TRIM(SSP_SURG_FIRST_NM) "SRG Surgeon", SSP_SURG_SVC_CD "SRG Service" FROM IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE ON SSE_LOG_ID = SSP_LOG_ID AND SSE_ENC_CSN_ID = SSP_ENC_CSN_ID WHERE (SSE_SURG_LOC not like '%IR%' AND SSE_SURG_LOC not like '%ENDO%' AND SSE_SOURCE_TYPE <> 'E') AND SSE_SURG_DTE BETWEEN '2019-12-01' AND '2019-12-02' ORDER BY 1, 2, 3 ; SELECT DISTINCT PBD_MRN "MRN", PBD_SVC_DTE "PBD Service Date", PBC_CPT_CD "PBD CPT Code", CPT.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK "PBD CPT Description", DOC_NAME "PBD Surgeon", DOC_ACDMC_SVC "Surgeon Academic Service", DOC_SVC "Surgeon Service", DX_CLSF_PRIO "PBD ICD Priority", DX_CLSF_CD "PBD ICD Code", ICD.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK "PBD ICD Description" FROM IDB.PBD_DTL JOIN IDB.PBD_CODE ON PBD_PBD_CD = PBC_PBD_CD JOIN IDB.CLM CPT ON PBC_CPT_CD = CPT.CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.PBD_INVOICE ON PBD_INV_NO = PBI_INV_NO JOIN IDB.PBD_DX ON PBD_INV_NO = DX_INV_NO AND DX_CLSF_PRIO IN ('001', '002', '003') JOIN IDB.CLM ICD ON DX_CLSF_CD = ICD.CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.DOC ON PBI_PERFORM_DR_NO = DOC_DR_NO WHERE 1=1 AND PBD_SVC_DTE BETWEEN '2019-12-01' AND '2019-12-02' ORDER BY 1, 2, 3, 8

prompt: Provide data on Breast Radiation Acute Toxicity PRO Survey.
completion: SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN MRN, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, DATE(EA_ASSIGN_DT) "Survey Assigned Date", DATE(EF_SUBMISSION_DT) "Survey Submit Date", R.AV_DESC AS "Race (Reg)", E.AV_DESC AS "Ethnicity (Reg)", CPP_LANG "Language", CPP_ZIP_CD "Zip Code", MAX(TRIM(CASE WHEN EFI_ITEM_ALIAS = 'breastenlargementq' THEN SUBSTR(SUBSTR(EFI_VALUE, 1, 100), 1, 100) ELSE '' END)) AS BREASTENLARGEMENTQ, MAX(TRIM(CASE WHEN EFI_ITEM_ALIAS = 'fatigueinterfereq' THEN SUBSTR(EFI_VALUE, 1, 100) ELSE '' END)) AS FATIGUEINTERFEREQ, MAX(TRIM(CASE WHEN EFI_ITEM_ALIAS = 'paininterferedailyq' THEN SUBSTR(EFI_VALUE, 1, 100) ELSE '' END)) AS PAININTERFEREDAILYQ, MAX(TRIM(CASE WHEN EFI_ITEM_ALIAS = 'painradiatedareaq' THEN SUBSTR(EFI_VALUE, 1, 100) ELSE '' END)) AS PAINRADIATEDAREAQ, MAX(TRIM(CASE WHEN EFI_ITEM_ALIAS = 'nervousanxiousq' THEN SUBSTR(EFI_VALUE, 1, 100) ELSE '' END)) AS NERVOUSANXIOUSQ, MAX(TRIM(CASE WHEN EFI_ITEM_ALIAS = 'controlworryingq' THEN SUBSTR(EFI_VALUE, 1, 100) ELSE '' END)) AS CONTROLWORRYINGQ, MAX(TRIM(CASE WHEN EFI_ITEM_ALIAS = 'breastseverityq' THEN SUBSTR(EFI_VALUE, 1, 100) ELSE '' END)) AS BREASTSEVERITYQ, MAX(TRIM(CASE WHEN EFI_ITEM_ALIAS = 'breasttendernessq' THEN SUBSTR(EFI_VALUE, 1, 100) ELSE '' END)) AS BREASTTENDERNESSQ, MAX(TRIM(CASE WHEN EFI_ITEM_ALIAS = 'raddryskinq' THEN SUBSTR(EFI_VALUE, 1, 100) ELSE '' END)) AS RADDRYSKINQ, MAX(TRIM(CASE WHEN EFI_ITEM_ALIAS = 'fatigueseverityq' THEN SUBSTR(EFI_VALUE, 1, 100) ELSE '' END)) AS FATIGUESEVERITYQ, MAX(TRIM(CASE WHEN EFI_ITEM_ALIAS = 'raditchyskinq' THEN SUBSTR(EFI_VALUE, 1, 100) ELSE '' END)) AS RADITCHYSKINQ, MAX(TRIM(CASE WHEN EFI_ITEM_ALIAS = 'painseverityq' THEN SUBSTR(EFI_VALUE, 1, 100) ELSE '' END)) AS PAINSEVERITYQ, MAX(TRIM(CASE WHEN EFI_ITEM_ALIAS = 'painswallowingq' THEN SUBSTR(EFI_VALUE, 1, 100) ELSE '' END)) AS PAINSWALLOWINGQ, MAX(TRIM(CASE WHEN EFI_ITEM_ALIAS = 'radsensationchangeq' THEN SUBSTR(EFI_VALUE, 1, 100) ELSE '' END)) AS RADSENSATIONCHANGEQ, MAX(TRIM(CASE WHEN EFI_ITEM_ALIAS = 'radskinbreakq' THEN SUBSTR(EFI_VALUE, 1, 100) ELSE '' END)) AS RADSKINBREAKQ, MAX(TRIM(CASE WHEN EFI_ITEM_ALIAS = 'radskincolorchangeq' THEN SUBSTR(EFI_VALUE, 1, 100) ELSE '' END)) AS RADSKINCOLORCHANGEQ, MAX(TRIM(CASE WHEN EFI_ITEM_ALIAS = 'radskineffectsq' THEN SUBSTR(EFI_VALUE, 1, 100) ELSE '' END)) AS RADSKINEFFECTSQ, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 AS "Department", CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 AS "Service", CLD_DEPT_NAME AS "Department Name", CRE_RES_NAME AS "Provider Name", MAX(CASE WHEN SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD = '19301' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END) AS "Lumpectomy?", MAX(CASE WHEN SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD IN ('19303', '19307', '19180') THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END) AS "Mastectomy?", MAX(CASE WHEN SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD = '19304' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END) AS "Mast Subq?" FROM IDB.EF_ASSESSMENT LEFT JOIN IDB.EF_FORM ON EA_ASSESS_ID = EF_FORM_EXTERNAL_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.EF_FORM_ITEM ON EFI_FORM_ID = EF_FORM_ID JOIN IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER ON EA_SOURCE_ID = CPE_ENC_CSN_ID JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON CPE_MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS R ON R.AV_ELEMENT = 'RACE' AND R.AV_CODE = PT_RACE LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS E ON E.AV_ELEMENT = 'PT_ETHNICITY' AND E.AV_CODE = PT_PT_ETHNICITY LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_PAS_PATIENT ON CPP_MRN = CPE_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT ON SSE_MRN = CPE_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE ON SSE_LOG_ID = SSP_LOG_ID AND SSE_ENC_CSN_ID = SSP_ENC_CSN_ID AND SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD IN ('19301', '19303', '19307', '19304', '19180') WHERE EA_SURV_ID = '41' AND DATE(EA_ASSIGN_DT) BETWEEN '2019-06-03' AND CURRENT date GROUP BY CPE_MRN, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, DATE(EA_ASSIGN_DT), DATE(EF_SUBMISSION_DT), CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8, CLD_DEPT_NAME, CRE_RES_NAME, R.AV_DESC, E.AV_DESC, CPP_LANG, CPP_ZIP_CD ;

prompt: Create a Cority feed for employee COVID vaccine data
completion: WITH VACCINE AS (SELECT COALESCE(EVI_EMPLOYEE_ID, CMDM_EMPLOYEE_ID) "EmployeeNumber" , EVI_MRN , DATE(DOSE_1_EMAR_ADMIN_DT) "DoseDate" , 'COVID19-V1' "Immunization.Code" , CASE WHEN DOSE_1_CIS_ORDER_NAME like 'Pfizer%' THEN 'COVID19-PFIZER' ELSE 'COVID19-MODERNA' END "VaccineCode" , DOSE_1_EMAR_LOT "VaccineLotNumber" , DOSE_1_EMAR_LOT_EXP_DTE "ExpirationDate" FROM IDB.COVID19_EMPLOYEE_VACCINE_INFO JOIN IDB.COVID19_MDM_MATCH ON EVI_MRN = CMDM_MRN WHERE DOSE_1_EMAR_ADMIN_DT IS NOT NULL UNION SELECT COALESCE(EVI_EMPLOYEE_ID, CMDM_EMPLOYEE_ID) "EmployeeNumber" , EVI_MRN , DATE(DOSE_2_EMAR_ADMIN_DT) "DoseDate" , 'COVID19-V2' "Immunization.Code" , CASE WHEN DOSE_2_CIS_ORDER_NAME like 'Pfizer%' THEN 'COVID19-PFIZER' ELSE 'COVID19-MODERNA' END "VaccineCode" , DOSE_2_EMAR_LOT "VaccineLotNumber" , DOSE_2_EMAR_LOT_EXP_DTE "ExpirationDate" FROM IDB.COVID19_EMPLOYEE_VACCINE_INFO JOIN IDB.COVID19_MDM_MATCH ON EVI_MRN = CMDM_MRN WHERE DOSE_2_EMAR_ADMIN_DT IS NOT NULL ) , HM AS (SELECT MRN , ACTION_DTE , HSEO_ROUTE_CD , SITE FROM IDB.COVID19_EMPLOYEE_VACCINE_HM JOIN VACCINE ON MRN = EVI_MRN AND "DoseDate" = ACTION_DTE) SELECT "EmployeeNumber" , "DoseDate" , "Immunization.Code" , "VaccineCode" , UPPER("VaccineLotNumber") "VaccineLotNumber" , "ExpirationDate" , CASE WHEN HSEO_ROUTE_CD IS NULL THEN 'IM' ELSE HSEO_ROUTE_CD END "ImmunizationRoute.Code" , CASE WHEN SITE like '%right%' THEN 'DR' WHEN SITE like '%left%' THEN 'DL' ELSE SITE END "InjectionSite.Code" , 'MSKOFFSITE' AS "HealthCenter.Code" FROM VACCINE LEFT JOIN HM ON EVI_MRN = MRN AND "DoseDate" = ACTION_DTE WHERE "DoseDate" < CURRENT date

prompt: Patients with prostate cancer (C61) who received RT to the spine (C79.31) and who have IMPACT data
completion: WITH CLINTRAC AS (SELECT PT_MRN AS CC_MRN, DXCC_ICD_CODE AS "ICD-9/10 Dx Code", DXCC_ICD_MSK_DESC AS "ICD-9/10 Dx Description", MIN(DT_DTE) AS "ICD-9/10 Min Dx Date" FROM DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS JOIN DV.PATIENT_DIAGNOSIS_FINAL_ALL_V ON PDX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID JOIN DV.DATE_V ON PDX_DX_DATE_ID = DT_DATE_ID JOIN DV.DIAGNOSIS_CATALOG ON PDX_DX_CATALOG_ID = DXCC_DX_CATALOG_ID WHERE (DXCC_ICD_CODE LIKE 'C61%' OR DXCC_ICD_CODE LIKE '185%') GROUP BY PT_MRN, DXCC_ICD_CODE, DXCC_ICD_MSK_DESC ) , TUMOR AS (SELECT PT_MRN AS TM_MRN, DT_DTE AS "Tumor Diagnosis Date", DXCC_ICD_CODE AS "ICD-O Histology Code", DXCC_ICD_MSK_DESC AS "ICD-O Histology Description", ICSC_SITE_CD AS "ICD-O Site Code", ICSC_ICDO_SITE_MSK_DESC AS SITE_DESC, TCA_CASE_STS_DESC AS "Case Status" FROM DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS JOIN DV.CDB_TUMOR_V ON CDTM_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID JOIN DV.DATE_V ON CDTM_DX_DATE_ID = DT_DATE_ID JOIN DV.DIAGNOSIS_CODE_CAT_ICDO_V ON CDTM_DX_CATALOG_ID = DXCC_DX_CATALOG_ID JOIN DV.ICDO_SITE_CATALOG_V ON CDTM_SITE_CATALOG_ID = ICSC_SITE_CATALOG_ID JOIN DV.TUMOR_CASE_ATTRIBUTES_V ON CDTM_CASE_ATTR_ID = TUMOR_CASE_ATTR_ID WHERE ICSC_SITE_CD LIKE 'C61%' ) , IMPACT AS (SELECT PT_MRN AS I_MRN, DV.REGEXSTR('(?<=Specimens Submitted:)([\S\s]*?)(?=(?=Test)|DIAGNOS)', PRPT_REPORT) "IMPACT Specimen", PATH_PROCEDURE_DATE, LOCUS, AA_CHANGE, NUCLEOTIDE, CASE WHEN SEARCH_HIT1 = '' THEN SEARCH_HIT2 WHEN SEARCH_HIT2 = '' THEN SEARCH_HIT1 WHEN SEARCH_HIT1 = SEARCH_HIT2 THEN SEARCH_HIT1 WHEN SEARCH_HIT2 <> '' AND SEARCH_HIT1 <> '' THEN CONCAT(CONCAT(SEARCH_HIT1, '; '), SEARCH_HIT2) END AS SH, FOLD_CHANGE, GENE, ABERRATIONTYPE, GENE2 FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_STRUCTURED_RESULTS_V) , RADONC AS (SELECT RTC_TX_MRN, LISTAGG(RTC_TX_PLAN_NAME, '; ') WITHIN GROUP( ORDER BY RTC_TX_PLAN_NAME) AS RTC_TX_PLAN_NAME FROM (SELECT DISTINCT RTC_TX_MRN, RTC_TX_PLAN_NAME FROM IDB.RADONC_TREATMENT_COURSE WHERE DV.REGEXSTR('[ctsl][0-9] *[-_ ] *[cstl]*[0-9]*|spine|sacrum|coccyx', LOWER(RTC_TX_PLAN_NAME)) <> '' ) GROUP BY RTC_TX_MRN) SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN AS MRN, PT_BIRTH_DTE AS DOB, SITE_DESC "Tumor Site", MIN(COALESCE("Tumor Diagnosis Date", "ICD-9/10 Min Dx Date")) "Diagnosis Date", RTC_TX_PLAN_NAME "RT Location", PATH_PROCEDURE_DATE "IMPACT Test Date", "IMPACT Specimen", LOCUS, AA_CHANGE, NUCLEOTIDE, SH, FOLD_CHANGE, GENE, ABERRATIONTYPE, GENE2 FROM DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V JOIN IMPACT ON PT_MRN = I_MRN JOIN RADONC ON PT_MRN = RTC_TX_MRN LEFT JOIN CLINTRAC ON PT_MRN = CC_MRN LEFT JOIN TUMOR ON PT_MRN = TM_MRN WHERE COALESCE(TM_MRN, CC_MRN) IS NOT NULL GROUP BY PT_MRN, PT_BIRTH_DTE, SITE_DESC, RTC_TX_PLAN_NAME, PATH_PROCEDURE_DATE, "IMPACT Specimen", LOCUS, AA_CHANGE, NUCLEOTIDE, SH, FOLD_CHANGE, GENE, ABERRATIONTYPE, GENE2

prompt: Provide a list of patients from LI and Queens who have been seen by Dr. Sandhu and Dr. Leddy since 1/1/2019.
completion: SELECT DISTINCT STRIP(CPE_MRN) AS MRN, CPE_CL_PT_ID, STRIP(CPP_PT_NAME) AS "Name", CPP_CITY AS "City", CPP_ZIP_CD AS "Zip Code", CPP_COUNTY AS "County", CPE_ENC_DTE AS "Visit Date", CRE_RES_NAME AS "Physician", CLD_CLD_CENTER AS "Site", CLD_DEPT_NAME AS "Department", CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME AS "Visit Type", ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CPE_MRN ORDER BY CPE_ENC_DTE DESC) AS RN FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_PAS_PATIENT ON CPP_CL_PT_ID = CPE_CL_PT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CRE_RES_TYP IN ('Physician') AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN '2019-01-01' AND CURRENT DATE AND CRE_RES_ID IN ('012526', '019620') AND CPP_COUNTY IN ('NASSAU', 'SUFFOLK', 'QUEENS')

prompt: Schedule a daily report of melanoma NV appointments scheduled for the next 7 days.
completion: SELECT DISTINCT STRIP(CPE_MRN) AS MRN, STRIP(CPP_PT_NAME) AS "Name", CPE_ENC_DTE AS "Appt Date", CPE_APPT_MADE_DTE AS "Appt Made Date", STRIP(CRE_RES_NAME) AS "Physician", STRIP(CLD_DEPT_NAME) AS "Department", STRIP(CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME) AS "Visit Type", ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CPE_MRN ORDER BY CPE_ENC_DTE DESC) AS RN, STRIP(CPP_ADDR1) AS "Address", STRIP(CPP_CITY) AS "City", STRIP(CPP_STATE) AS "State", STRIP(CPP_COUNTRY) AS "Country", CPP_ZIP_CD, CPP_HOME_PHONE, CPP_WORK_PHONE FROM IDB.PATIENT JOIN IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER ON CPE_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_PAS_PATIENT ON CPP_PRK = CPE_PRK JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Sch') AND CRE_RES_TYP IN ('Physician') AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT DATE AND CURRENT DATE + 7 DAYS AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 = 'MEL' AND(CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME LIKE '%NV%' OR CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME LIKE '%IR%') AND CPE_APPT_MADE_DTE >= CURRENT date - 1 DAY

prompt: Recurring list of patients seen at MSK with diagnosis of Epithelioid Hemangioednothelioma (EHE) on pathology report. Report to be sent out on the 3rd of every month
completion: WITH PAT AS (SELECT PT_MRN, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_BIRTH_DTE, PT_SEX_DESC FROM DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS) , TUMOR AS (SELECT DISTINCT T_MRN, LISTAGG(TRIM(HIST_DESC) || ' - SITE: ' || TRIM(SITE_DESC), ' || ') WITHIN GROUP( ORDER BY HIST_DESC) "Histology/Site" FROM (SELECT DISTINCT TM_MRN AS T_MRN, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS HIST_DESC, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_DESC FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS ON AV_ELEMENT = 'CASE_STS' AND AV_CODE = TM_CASE_STS AND TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8')) GROUP BY T_MRN) , ENC AS (SELECT CPE_MRN, "Appt Date", LISTAGG(TRIM(CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME), ' / ') WITHIN GROUP( ORDER BY CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME) AS "Appt Visit Type" FROM (SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN, CPE_ENC_DTE AS "Appt Date", CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') ) GROUP BY CPE_MRN, "Appt Date") , VIS AS (SELECT VIS_MRN, VIS_ADM_DTE, VIS_DSCH_DTE, LISTAGG(TRIM(PATIENT_TYPE_DESC), ' / ') WITHIN GROUP( ORDER BY PATIENT_TYPE_DESC) "RMS Visit Type" FROM IDB.VISIT_V WHERE VIS_VISIT_STATUS IN ('2', '3') GROUP BY VIS_MRN, VIS_ADM_DTE, VIS_DSCH_DTE ) SELECT PRPT_MRN AS MRN, PT_FIRST_NAME "Patient First Name", PT_LAST_NAME "Patient Last Name", PT_BIRTH_DTE AS DOB, PT_SEX_DESC "Sex", "Histology/Site", PRPT_PROCEDURE_DTE "Pathology Date", PRPT_REPORT "Pathology Report", "Appt Visit Type", "RMS Visit Type" FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V JOIN PAT ON PRPT_MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN TUMOR ON PRPT_MRN = T_MRN LEFT JOIN ENC ON PRPT_MRN = CPE_MRN AND PRPT_PROCEDURE_DTE = "Appt Date" LEFT JOIN VIS ON PRPT_MRN = VIS_MRN AND PRPT_PROCEDURE_DTE BETWEEN VIS_ADM_DTE AND VIS_DSCH_DTE WHERE CONTAINS(PRPT_REPORT, '("Epithelioid Hemangioendothelioma" | "(EHE)" | "Epithelioid Hemangio endothelioma" | "Hemangioendothelioma")') = 1 AND PRPT_REPORT IS NOT NULL AND PRPT_PROCEDURE_DTE BETWEEN (CURRENT DATE - DAY(CURRENT DATE) DAYS + 1 DAY - 1 MONTH) AND (CURRENT DATE - DAY(CURRENT DATE) DAYS)

prompt: provide a list of all patients treated at Ralph Lauren center with a diagnosis code for mucositis, with list of their corresponding cancer diagnosis and cancer therapies used during their treatment.
completion: WITH CDB AS (SELECT CC_MRN AS DX_MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS DX_DATE, CLM_CLSF_CD AS DX_CODE, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS DX_DESC FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND ((CC_PT_TYPE = 'I') OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) AND CC_CLSF_CD IN ('528.00', '528.01', '528.02', '528.09', '538', '616.81', 'K12.30', 'K12.31', 'K12.33', 'K12.32', 'K12.1', 'K12.39', 'K92.81', 'N76.81') GROUP BY CC_MRN, CLM_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK), APPTS AS (SELECT CPE_MRN, CPE_ENC_DTE FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID JOIN CDB C ON CPE_MRN= DX_MRN WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CLD_CLD_CENTER = '1919' ), FN AS (SELECT DISTINCT DX_MRN, DX_DATE, DX_CODE, DX_DESC FROM CDB JOIN APPTS ON DX_MRN = CPE_MRN) SELECT DISTINCT DX_MRN "MRN", DX_DATE "MUCOSITIS DX DATE", DX_CODE "MUCOSITIS DX CODE", DX_DESC "MUCOSITIS DX DESCRIPTION", CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME "COMMON GENERIC NAME", APR_DRUG_NAME "DRUG NAME", APR_START_DTE "DRUG START DATE", APR_END_DTE "DRUG END DATE", APR_ROUTE "ROUTE", APR_PRESCRIBED_DOSE "PRESCRIBED DOSE", APR_TOTAL_GIVEN_DOSE "TOTAL GIVEN DOSE", APR_DOSE_UOM "DOSE UOM", APR_QTY "QTY" FROM FN JOIN IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX_V ON DX_MRN = APR_MRN ; WITH CDB AS (SELECT CC_MRN, CC_EFF_DTE AS DX_DATE, CLM_CLSF_CD AS DX_CODE, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS DX_DESC FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND ((CC_PT_TYPE = 'I') OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) AND CC_CLSF_CD IN ('528.00', '528.01', '528.02', '528.09', '538', '616.81', 'K12.30', 'K12.31', 'K12.33', 'K12.32', 'K12.1', 'K12.39', 'K92.81', 'N76.81') ), APPTS AS (SELECT CPE_MRN, CPE_ENC_DTE FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID JOIN CDB C ON CPE_MRN= CC_MRN WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CLD_CLD_CENTER = '1919' ), FN AS (SELECT DISTINCT CC_MRN, DX_DATE, DX_CODE, DX_DESC FROM CDB JOIN APPTS ON CC_MRN = CPE_MRN) , DX_ALL AS (SELECT TM_MRN AS DX_MRN, TM_DX_DTE AS DX_DATE, TM_HIST_CD AS DX_CODE, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS DX_DESC FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM H ON TM_HIST_CD = H.CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON TM_SITE_CD = S.CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN FN ON CC_MRN = TM_MRN WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') UNION SELECT CC.CC_MRN AS DX_MRN, MIN(CC.CC_EFF_DTE) AS DX_DATE, CL.CLM_CLSF_CD AS DX_CODE, CL.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS DX_DESC FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF CC JOIN IDB.CLM CL ON CC.CC_CLSF_CD = CL.CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN FN A ON A.CC_MRN = CC.CC_MRN WHERE CC.CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND ((CC.CC_PT_TYPE = 'I') OR (CC.CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC.CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) GROUP BY CC.CC_MRN, CL.CLM_CLSF_CD, CL.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK), DX_LST AS (SELECT DX_MRN, LISTAGG(COALESCE(STRIP(DX_DATE), '') || ' : ' || COALESCE(STRIP(DX_CODE), '') || ' : ' || COALESCE(STRIP(CAST(DX_DESC AS VARCHAR(12000))), '') , CHR(13) || CHR(10)) WITHIN GROUP( ORDER BY DX_MRN, DX_DATE, DX_CODE, DX_DESC) AS DIAGNOSIS FROM DX_ALL GROUP BY DX_MRN) SELECT DISTINCT DX_MRN "MRN", DX_DATE "MUCOSITIS DX DATE", DX_CODE "MUCOSITIS DX CODE", DX_DESC "MUCOSITIS DX DESCRIPTION", DIAGNOSIS "CANCER DIAGNOSIS" FROM FN JOIN DX_LST ON CC_MRN = DX_MRN ;

prompt: A report on all CIS orders for Nursing Referral Smoking Cessation, Smoking Cessation Attending Consult and Smoking Cessation Program Referral.
completion: SELECT YEAR, REQUESTED_BY, ROLE_TYPE, SOURCE, ORDER_NAME, IS_FOR_DSCH, PT_IND, COUNT(*) AS TOTAL_ORDERS FROM (SELECT YEAR(OO_ENTER_DTE) AS YEAR, OO_MRN AS MRN, OO_ENTER_DTE, CASE WHEN OO_ACCT_NO LIKE '84%' THEN 'I' ELSE 'O' END AS PT_IND, OO_ORD_GUID, OO_ORD_NAME AS ORDER_NAME, OO_SUMMARY_LINE, OO_ORD_STS_CD, OU_DISPLAY_NAME AS REQUESTED_BY, OO_ORD_FREQ, OU_ORD_ROLE_TYPE AS ROLE_TYPE, OO_ORD_SOURCE AS SOURCE, OO_SET_HEADING, OO_SET_NAME, OO_IS_FOR_DSCH AS IS_FOR_DSCH FROM IDB.OMS_ORDER JOIN IDB.OMS_USER ON OO_PVDR_GUID = OU_USER_GUID WHERE OO_ENTER_DTE >= '2006-01-01' AND OO_ORD_STS_CD NOT IN ('CANC', 'CANP', 'HOLD', 'PEND') AND (OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID IN ('4000001130073001' ,'2000004291073029' ,'1000004257073029' ,'1000003771073029' ,'3000004291073029' ,'1000004672073029' ,'2000004672073029' ,'1000004124073029' ,'1000004133073029' ,'8000001064073001') OR (UCASE(OO_SET_NAME) = 'PSYCH_SMOKING_CESSATION_PHARMACOTHERAPY' AND OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID IN ('6000002537073001' ,'1000004685073029' ,'2000003835073029' ,'1000004533073029')))) AS ORDERS GROUP BY YEAR, REQUESTED_BY, ROLE_TYPE, SOURCE, ORDER_NAME, IS_FOR_DSCH, PT_IND

prompt: Provide a one time list of all patients with brain metastases who received Bevacizumab.
completion: WITH DX AS (SELECT DISTINCT CC_MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS MIN_ICD9_EFF_DTE, CC_CLSF_CD AS ICD9_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS ICD9_DESC FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE CC_CLSF_CD IN ('198.3', 'C79.31') AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND (CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) GROUP BY CC_MRN, CC_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK ) , APR AS (SELECT DISTINCT APR_MRN, APR_START_DTE, APR_END_DTE, CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME FROM DX JOIN IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX_V ON CC_MRN = APR_MRN WHERE CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME = 'BEVACIZUMAB' ) SELECT DISTINCT APR_MRN AS MRN FROM APR ORDER BY APR_MRN

prompt: Provide a monthly list of patients with "nephrogenic rest" identified in the path report.
completion: WITH X AS (SELECT DISTINCT STRIP("t1"."PT_MRN") AS "MRN", STRIP(PT_LAST_NAME) AS "Last Name", STRIP(PT_FIRST_NAME) AS "First Name", PT_BIRTH_DTE AS DOB, "t2"."PRPT_ACCESSION_NO" AS "Surgical Accession Number", STRIP("t3"."PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_DESC") AS "Pathology Report Type", "t4"."DT_DTE" AS "Pathology Procedure Date", YEAR("t4"."DT_DTE" - PT_BIRTH_DTE) AS "Age", "t5"."DT_DTE" AS "Pathology Report Date", UPPER(CASE WHEN LENGTH(PRPT_REPORT) <= 15000 THEN RTRIM(CAST(SUBSTR(PRPT_REPORT, 1, 15000) AS VARCHAR(15000))) ELSE CAST(SUBSTR(PRPT_REPORT, 1, 15000) AS VARCHAR(15000)) END) AS TXT FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V" "t1" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED" "t6" ON "t1"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t6"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V" "t2" ON "t6"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t2"."PRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATH_RPRT_TYPE_LOOKUP" "t3" ON "t2"."PRPT_REPORT_TYPE" = "t3"."PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_CD" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" "t4" ON "t2"."PRPT_PROCEDURE_DATE_ID" = "t4"."DT_DATE_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" "t5" ON "t2"."PRPT_REPORT_DATE_ID" = "t5"."DT_DATE_ID" WHERE 1=1 AND "PRPT_REPORT" IS NOT NULL AND "t5"."DT_DTE" BETWEEN CURRENT DATE - (DAY(CURRENT DATE) - 1) DAYS - 1 MONTH AND CURRENT DATE - (DAY(CURRENT DATE)) DAYS AND CONTAINS("t2"."PRPT_REPORT", '(("NEPHROGENIC REST"))') = 1 AND UPPER("t3"."PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_DESC") LIKE '%SURGICAL PATHOLOGY%' ) , FIRST_APPT AS (SELECT * FROM (SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN, CPE_ENC_DTE, CRE_RES_NAME, CRE_RES_TYP, CLD_DEPT_NAME, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_4, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8, CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CPE_MRN ORDER BY CPE_ENC_DTE) AS RN FROM X JOIN IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER ON MRN = CPE_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CRE_RES_TYP IN ('Physician') ) C WHERE RN = 1 ) , PED_APPT AS (SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN, CPE_ENC_DTE, CRE_RES_NAME, CRE_RES_TYP, CLD_DEPT_NAME, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_4, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8, CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CPE_MRN ORDER BY CPE_ENC_DTE) AS RN FROM X JOIN IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER ON MRN = CPE_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CRE_RES_TYP IN ('Physician') AND(CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 = ('PED') OR CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_4 = ('PED')) ) SELECT DISTINCT X.*, FA.CPE_ENC_DTE AS "First Appt Date", STRIP(FA.CRE_RES_NAME) AS "First Appt Attending", STRIP(FA.CLD_DEPT_NAME) AS "First Appt Dept", STRIP(FA.CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME) AS "First Appt Visit Type", CASE WHEN PA.CPE_MRN IS NOT NULL THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS "PEDS (Y/N)" FROM X LEFT JOIN FIRST_APPT FA ON X.MRN = FA.CPE_MRN LEFT JOIN PED_APPT PA ON X.MRN = PA.CPE_MRN

prompt: Provide Quality of Life Symptom Survey results from MSK Engage Portal for given list of MRNs who consented to  the protocols
completion: WITH SURVEY AS (SELECT DISTINCT PT.EPI_MRN AS MRN, PT.EPI_BIRTH_DTE AS DATE_OF_BIRTH, 'Quality of Life Symptom Survey' AS SURVEY_NAME , ASS.EA_SUBM_DT AS SUBMISSION_DATE, ASS.EA_ASSIGN_DT AS ASSIGNMENT_DATE , EQ_SHORT_NAME AS QUESTION , A.EA_SHORT_NAME AS ANSWER , TR.ETBR_TEXT AS TEXTBLOCKRESPONSE , NR.ENR_NO AS NUMBERRESPONSE FROM IDB.EF_ASSESSMENT AS ASS JOIN IDB.EF_ASSESSMENT_DTL AS AD ON AD.EAD_ASSESS_DTL_ID = ASS.EA_ASSESS_DTL_ID JOIN IDB.EF_PATIENT_INFO PT ON ASS.EA_PT_INFO_ID = PT.EPI_PT_INFO_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.EF_RESPONSE R ON R.ERESP_ASSESS_ID = ASS.EA_ASSESS_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.EF_ANSWER A ON A.EA_ANSWER_ID = R.ERESP_ANSWER_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.EF_QUESTION Q ON Q.EQ_QUESTION_ID = A.EA_QUESTION_ID JOIN IDB.EF_SURVEY_ELEMENT SE ON A.EA_QUESTION_ID = SE.ESE_IDENTITY_ID LEFT OUTER JOIN IDB.EF_TEXT_BOX_RESPONSE TR ON TR.ETBR_ID =R.ERESP_ID LEFT OUTER JOIN IDB.EF_NUMERIC_RESPONSE NR ON NR.ENR_ID =R.ERESP_ID WHERE ASS.EA_SURV_ID ='106' AND ASS.EA_STS_ID = 3 ) SELECT S.*, AC_CONS_DTE AS "Consent Date(21-135)", CASE WHEN AC_CONS_DTE IS NULL AND AC_IRB_NO = '21-135' THEN 'N' WHEN AC_CONS_DTE IS NOT NULL AND AC_IRB_NO = '21-135' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'NA' END AS CONSENT_21_135 FROM SURVEY S LEFT JOIN IDB.ACCRUALS ON S.MRN = AC_MRN WHERE AC_IRB_NO = '21-135' AND AC_MRN IN ('38141148', '35282509', '38086130', '38083843', '35423469', '38118166', '35503074', '38058728', '38194399', '38202587', '38205488', '38206105', '38085198', '38205986', '35570873', '35565667', '38215797', '38204149', '38085198', '38218445') ; WITH SRV AS (SELECT DISTINCT PT.EPI_MRN AS MRN , PT.EPI_BIRTH_DTE AS DATE_OF_BIRTH, 'Quality of Life Symptom Survey' AS SURVEY_NAME , ASS.EA_SUBM_DT AS SUBMISSION_DATE, ASS.EA_ASSIGN_DT AS ASSIGNMENT_DATE , EQ_SHORT_NAME AS QUESTION , A.EA_SHORT_NAME AS ANSWER , TR.ETBR_TEXT AS TEXTBLOCKRESPONSE , NR.ENR_NO AS NUMBERRESPONSE FROM IDB.EF_ASSESSMENT AS ASS JOIN IDB.EF_ASSESSMENT_DTL AS AD ON AD.EAD_ASSESS_DTL_ID = ASS.EA_ASSESS_DTL_ID JOIN IDB.EF_PATIENT_INFO PT ON ASS.EA_PT_INFO_ID = PT.EPI_PT_INFO_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.EF_RESPONSE R ON R.ERESP_ASSESS_ID = ASS.EA_ASSESS_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.EF_ANSWER A ON A.EA_ANSWER_ID = R.ERESP_ANSWER_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.EF_QUESTION Q ON Q.EQ_QUESTION_ID = A.EA_QUESTION_ID JOIN IDB.EF_SURVEY_ELEMENT SE ON A.EA_QUESTION_ID = SE.ESE_IDENTITY_ID LEFT OUTER JOIN IDB.EF_TEXT_BOX_RESPONSE TR ON TR.ETBR_ID =R.ERESP_ID LEFT OUTER JOIN IDB.EF_NUMERIC_RESPONSE NR ON NR.ENR_ID =R.ERESP_ID WHERE ASS.EA_SURV_ID ='106' AND ASS.EA_STS_ID = 3 ) SELECT V.*, AC_CONS_DTE AS "Consent Date(20-198)", CASE WHEN AC_CONS_DTE IS NULL AND AC_IRB_NO = '20-198' THEN 'N' WHEN AC_CONS_DTE IS NOT NULL AND AC_IRB_NO = '20-198' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'NA' END AS CONSENT_20_198 FROM SRV V LEFT JOIN IDB.ACCRUALS ON V.MRN = AC_MRN WHERE AC_IRB_NO = '20-198' AND AC_MRN IN ('00397464', '35534938', '38103962', '00024210', '38080124', '38096248', '38113908', '38112649', '38118539', '38133062', '35525192', '38137364', '38103408', '38029291', '38121079', '35590243', '38115974', '38106547', '38003129', '00367301', '35451037', '38120981', '38132221', '38145475', '38126235', '38158132', '38147017', '38152478', '38150518', '38140614', '35507986', '38059938', '38173338', '38166618', '38190636');

prompt: Design an on demand report of Supportive Care outpatient Consult orders.
completion: SELECT STRIP(OO_MRN) AS MRN, OO_ENTER_DTE AS "Order Date", OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE, OO_ORD_ID, OO_ORD_GUID, STRIP(OO_ORD_NAME) AS "Order Name" FROM IDB.OMS_ORDER WHERE OO_ORD_STS_CD NOT IN ('CANC', 'CANP', 'AUC3') AND OO_ENTER_DTE BETWEEN DATE(#PROMPT('Start Date', 'STRING', '2013-01-01')#) AND DATE(#PROMPT ('End Date', 'STRING', '2099-12-31')#) AND OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID IN ('9000013797200730')

prompt: Provide a list of patients who received Ifosfamide + Etoposide on the Sarcoma services
completion: WITH PTS AS (SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 = 'SAR' AND CRE_RES_TYP = 'Physician' ) , X AS (SELECT DISTINCT OO_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, YEAR(OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) AGE_AT_REGIMEN, CASE WHEN YEAR(OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) < 15 THEN '< 15' WHEN YEAR(OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) BETWEEN 15 AND 39 THEN '15 - 39' WHEN YEAR(OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) > 39 THEN '> 39' END AGE_GROUPING, OO_ORD_ID, OO_ORD_GUID, OO_SET_GUID, OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE, OO_SET_NAME, OOC_ITEM_NAME, OO_REQUESTED_DTE, OO_STOP_DTE FROM PTS JOIN IDB.OMS_ORDER ON CPE_MRN = OO_MRN JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_CATALOG ON OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID = OOC_MSTR_ITEM_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_STATUS ON OO_ORD_STS_CD = OSTS_ORD_STS_CD JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON CPE_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE 1=1 AND OO_ORD_STS_CD NOT IN ('CANP', 'CANC', 'AUC3') AND OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE BETWEEN '2015-01-01' AND '2021-06-30' AND OO_SET_NAME IN ('SAR_Etoposide_Ifosfamide', 'IRB_#13-068_Local_Cycle_4-6_IE', 'PEDSA_AEWS0031_ETOP_IFOS', 'PEDSA_EFT_ETOP_IFOS', 'PEDSA_ETOP_IFOS_Blank_Dose', 'PEDSA_03-099_Cy._8,9,11,12_VCR_IFOS_ETOP', 'PEDSA_10-091_C6,7,8_ETOP_IFOS', 'PEDSA_ETOP_IFOS_HD', 'PEDSA_ETOP_IFOS_Standard', 'SAR_Ifosfamide_Etoposide', 'IRB_#10-091_C6,7,8_ETOP_IFOS', 'IRB_#13-068_Mets_Cycle_6,9,12_IE') AND (UPPER(OOC_ITEM_NAME) like '%ETOP%' OR UPPER(OOC_ITEM_NAME) like '%IFOS%') ) SELECT OO_MRN MRN, PT_LAST_NAME LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME FIRST_NAME, AGE_AT_REGIMEN, AGE_GROUPING, OO_ORD_ID ORDER_ID, OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE ORDER_SIGNIFICANT_DATE, OO_REQUESTED_DTE REQUESTED_DATE, OO_STOP_DTE STOP_DATE, OO_SET_NAME ORDER_SET_NAME, OOC_ITEM_NAME ORDER_NAME FROM X

prompt: Provide a list of patients with upcoming appointments in LYMPHOMA 205 E64 [655] LYMPHOMA 205 E64 [772] and  without "surgical pathology submitted slides" order
completion: WITH PATH AS (SELECT OO_MRN FROM IDB.OMS_ORDER JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_CATALOG ON OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID = OOC_MSTR_ITEM_GUID WHERE OOC_ITEM_NAME IN ('Surgical Pathology Submitted Slides Order', 'Surgical Submitted Slides') AND OO_ORD_STS_CD NOT IN ('CANP', 'CANC', 'AUC3') ) SELECT CPE_MRN AS "MRN", CPP_PT_NAME AS "Patient Name", CPE_ENC_DTE AS "Appt Date", CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 AS "Department", CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 AS "Service", CLD_DEPT_NAME AS "Department Name", CRE_RES_NAME AS "Provider Name", CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME AS "Visit Type", CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR AS "Visit Type Abbr" FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID AND CLD_DEPT_ID IN (655, 722) JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID JOIN IDB.CL_PAS_PATIENT ON CPE_CL_PT_ID = CPP_CL_PT_ID LEFT JOIN PATH ON CPE_MRN = OO_MRN WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS = 'Sch' AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT DATE AND CURRENT DATE + 14 DAYS AND (CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR LIKE '%NV%' OR CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR LIKE '%IR%' OR CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR LIKE '%AFR%' OR CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR LIKE '%MDTX%') AND OO_MRN IS NULL ORDER BY CPE_ENC_DTE

prompt: Identify a list of all patients treated with enfortumab vedotin
completion: WITH X AS (SELECT DISTINCT APR_MRN, APR_START_DTE, CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME, APR_PRESCRIBED_DOSE, APR_ROUTE FROM IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX JOIN IDB.CHEMO_DRUG_GENERIC ON APR_GENERIC_NAME = CDG_GENERIC_NAME WHERE LOWER(CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME) like '%enfortumab%' ) , ALLBWEI AS (SELECT APR_MRN AS ALLWE_MRN, PMH_MEASURE_DTE AS ALLWEI_MEASURE_DTE, APR_PRESCRIBED_DOSE, X.CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME, PMH_WT_KG AS ALLWEI_WEI, X.APR_START_DTE, ABS(DAYS(PMH_MEASURE_DTE) - DAYS(X.APR_START_DTE)) AS ABS_DAYS_DIFF_BMI_DX FROM X LEFT JOIN IDB.PT_MEASURES_HX V ON X.APR_MRN = V.PMH_MRN AND PMH_WT_KG IS NOT NULL), CLOSESTBMI AS (SELECT DISTINCT ALLWE_MRN AS CLOSEST_WEI_MRN, ALLWEI_MEASURE_DTE AS CLOSEST_WEI_MEASURE_DTE, ALLWEI_WEI AS CLOSEST_WEI, CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME, APR_START_DTE, APR_PRESCRIBED_DOSE, ABS_DAYS_DIFF_BMI_DX FROM ALLBWEI A WHERE COALESCE(ABS_DAYS_DIFF_BMI_DX, 999999) = (SELECT COALESCE(MIN(ABS_DAYS_DIFF_BMI_DX), 999999) FROM ALLBWEI M WHERE A.ALLWE_MRN = M.ALLWE_MRN AND A.APR_START_DTE = M.APR_START_DTE) ) SELECT DISTINCT CLOSEST_WEI_MRN MRN, APR_START_DTE, CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME, APR_PRESCRIBED_DOSE, PLA_LST_CON_DTE, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, PT_DATE_OF_DEATH, CLOSEST_WEI_MEASURE_DTE MEASURE_DATE, CLOSEST_WEI WEIGHT FROM CLOSESTBMI LEFT JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON CLOSEST_WEI_MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY ON CLOSEST_WEI_MRN= PLA_MRN

prompt: Provide one-time list of multiple myeloma pts imaging history at MSKCC with treatment details (radiotherapy and/or transplant if applicable)
completion: WITH DIAG AS (SELECT DISTINCT CC_MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS MIN_ICD9_EFF_DTE, CC_CLSF_CD AS ICD9_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS ICD9_DESC FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON CC_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE (CC_CLSF_CD IN ('203.0', '203.00', '203.01', '203.02') OR SUBSTR(CC_CLSF_CD, 1, 3) = 'C90') AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND (CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) AND YEAR(CURRENT DATE) - YEAR(PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) > '18' GROUP BY CC_MRN, CC_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK ), RAD AS (SELECT DISTINCT RRPT_MRN, RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE, RRPT_RPT_ID, RRPT_ACCESSION_NO, RRPT_ORDER_GROUP, RRPT_PROCEDURE_NAME, VARCHAR(RRPT_REPORT_TXT, 32000) AS RRPT_REPORT_TXT FROM DIAG JOIN DV.RADIOLOGY_REPORT_V ON CC_MRN = RRPT_MRN JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON CC_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE RRPT_ORDER_GROUP IN ('MR', 'PET', 'CT') AND RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE BETWEEN '01-01-2000' AND '12-31-2022' ) , PT AS (SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN AS MRN, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH AS DOB, YEAR(CURRENT DATE) - YEAR(PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) AS AGE, PT_SEX, R.AV_DESC AS "Race", E.AV_DESC AS "Ethnicity", PT_DATE_OF_DEATH AS DOD FROM RAD JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON RRPT_MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS R ON PT_RACE = R.AV_CODE AND R.AV_ELEMENT = 'RACE' LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS E ON PT_PT_ETHNICITY = E.AV_CODE AND E.AV_ELEMENT = 'PT_ETHNICITY') , RADIATION AS (SELECT DISTINCT RTC_TX_MRN, RTC_TX_COURSE_NO, RTC_TX_PLANSETUP_NO, RTC_TX_COURSE_ID, RTC_TX_PLAN_NAME, RTC_TX_PLANNED_FRACTIONS, RTC_TX_DELIVERED_FRACTIONS, RTC_TX_PLANNED_DOSE, RTC_TX_DELIVERED_DOSE, RTC_TX_START_DTE, RTC_TX_STOP_DTE, RTC_TX_ELAPSED_DAYS, RTC_PRIMARY_REF_POINT, RTC_DOSE_CORRECTION FROM PT JOIN IDB.RADONC_TREATMENT_COURSE ON MRN = RTC_TX_MRN) , BMT AS (SELECT CBM_MRN AS MRN, CBM_TRANSPLANT_TYPE AS BMT_TYPE, CBM_TRANSPLANT_DTE AS BMT_DATE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CBM_MRN ORDER BY CBM_TRANSPLANT_DTE DESC) AS RN FROM IDB.CRDB_BMT_MEDICINE WHERE CBM_MRN IN (SELECT MRN FROM PT) UNION SELECT CBP_MRN AS MRN, CBP_TRANSPLANT_TYPE AS BMT_TYPE, CBP_TRANSPLANT_DTE AS BMT_DATE , ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CBP_MRN ORDER BY CBP_TRANSPLANT_DTE DESC) AS RN FROM IDB.CRDB_BMT_PEDIATRICS WHERE CBP_MRN IN (SELECT MRN FROM PT) ) , BMT_MULTIPLE_ROWS AS (SELECT MRN, COUNT(*) AS CNT FROM BMT GROUP BY MRN HAVING COUNT(*) > 1) SELECT B.MRN, BMT_TYPE, BMT_DATE FROM BMT B JOIN BMT_MULTIPLE_ROWS BM ON B.MRN = BM.MRN ;

prompt: Slightly edit report MED12587 to expand organism list.
completion: SELECT LPC_MRN MRN, STRIP(PT_LAST_NAME)||', '||STRIP(PT_FIRST_NAME) PT_NAME, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH DOB, PT_SEX SEX, DOC_SVC AS SVC, LPC_ACCESSION_NO, LPC_PERFORMED_DT , LPC_ORGANISM_OBSERVATION, LPC_PERFORMED_DT COLLECTION_DT , OO_PERFORMED_DT COLLECTION_DT , LPC_FINAL_DT, LPC_SPECIMEN_LOC_ABBR, LPC_SPECIMEN_DESC, LPC_BATTERY_CD FROM IDB.LAB_POSITIVE_CULTURES JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON LPC_MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_ORDER ON LPC_MRN = OO_MRN AND LPC_ACCESSION_NO = OO_ANCIL_REF_CD LEFT JOIN IDB.DOC ON OO_REQ_DR_NO = DOC_DR_NO WHERE LPC_PERFORMED_DTE BETWEEN LAST_DAY(CURRENT DATE - 7 MONTH) + 1 DAY AND LAST_DAY(CURRENT DATE - 1 MONTH) AND (UPPER(LPC_ORGANISM_OBSERVATION) LIKE '%RHIZOP%' OR UPPER(LPC_ORGANISM_OBSERVATION) LIKE '%MUCOR%' OR UPPER(LPC_ORGANISM_OBSERVATION) LIKE '%CUNNINGHAME%' OR UPPER(LPC_ORGANISM_OBSERVATION) LIKE '%BERTHOLLETI%' OR UPPER(LPC_ORGANISM_OBSERVATION) LIKE '%APOPHYSOMY%' OR UPPER(LPC_ORGANISM_OBSERVATION) LIKE '%LICHTHEI%' OR UPPER(LPC_ORGANISM_OBSERVATION) LIKE 'MUCOR%' OR UPPER(LPC_ORGANISM_OBSERVATION) LIKE 'RHIZ%')

prompt:
Provide a weekly list of patients who meet the following criteria:

1.	Stage III or IV cancer (per self-report or on the MSKCC EMR). 

For the first/ initial request, let's include all current patients who meet this criteria, then go only newly registered patients from week to week.

2.	Age 18 or older

3.	Of Chinese descent

4.	Mandarin-speaking

5.	Resides in New York State
completion: WITH CTE AS (SELECT PT_MRN MRN, STRIP(PT_LAST_NAME)||', '||PT_FIRST_NAME PT_NAME , PT_PT_ETHNICITY_DESC ETHNICITY, PT_RACE_DESC RACE, PT_PRIMARY_LANG_DESC PRIM_LANGUAGE, PT_SEX_DESC SEX, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH DATE_OF_BIRTH, YEAR(CURRENT DATE) - YEAR(PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) CURRENT_AGE, PT_ADDR1 ADDR1, PT_ADDR2 ADDR2, PT_CITY CITY, PT_STATE STATE, PT_ZIP_CD ZIPCD, PT_PHONE, PT_EMAIL_ADDRESS EMAIL, PT_DISTRICT_DESC DISTRICT, PLA_LST_DRVST_DTE FROM IDB.PATIENT_V JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY ON PT_MRN = PLA_MRN AND PLA_LST_DRVST_DTE >= '2023-02-23' WHERE PT_PRIMARY_LANG_DESC = 'CHINESE, MANDARIN' AND PT_DATE_OF_DEATH IS NULL AND YEAR(CURRENT DATE) - YEAR(PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) >= 18 AND PT_STATE = 'NY' ) SELECT CTE.*, T0.TM_CASE_EFF_DTE, TM_BEST_AJCC_STG AJCC_STAGE, DOC_NAME, DOC_SVC, DOC_ACDMC_SVC FROM CTE JOIN IDB.CDB_TUMOR T0 ON MRN = TM_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.DOC ON T0.TM_ATN_DR_NO = DOC_DR_NO WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('3', '6', '7') AND TM_BEST_AJCC_STG LIKE '3%' OR TM_BEST_AJCC_STG LIKE '4%'

prompt: Biweekly report of discharges from HPB Surgery service with any complications.
completion: WITH PTS AS (SELECT DISTINCT VIS_MRN, VIS_ADM_NUM, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, (TRIM(PT_LAST_NAME) CONCAT ', ' CONCAT TRIM(PT_FIRST_NAME)) AS PT_NAME, VIS_ADM_DTE, VIS_DSCH_DTE, VIS_DAYS_STAY, VIS_IP_OP_ADJUSTED_IND, ADM_DR_NAME, ATN_DR_NAME, LISTAGG(' | ' || TRIM(CC_CLSF_CD) || ' - ' || TRIM(CLM_CLSF_DESC) || ' | ', CHR(13) || CHR(10)) WITHIN GROUP( ORDER BY CC_CLSF_CD) AS DX FROM IDB.VISIT_V JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON VIS_MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.CTC_VISIT ON VIS_ADM_NUM = CV_ADM_NUM LEFT JOIN IDB.CTC_CLSF ON CV_VISIT_ID = CC_VISIT_ID AND CC_CLSF_CD BETWEEN 'C00' AND 'D49' LEFT JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' WHERE VIS_DSCH_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT date - 14 DAYS AND CURRENT date - 1 DAY AND VIS_HOSP_SVC = 'HEP' AND VIS_IP_OP_ADJUSTED_IND = 'I' GROUP BY VIS_MRN, VIS_ADM_NUM, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, (TRIM(PT_LAST_NAME) CONCAT ', ' CONCAT TRIM(PT_FIRST_NAME)), VIS_ADM_DTE, VIS_DSCH_DTE, VIS_DAYS_STAY, VIS_IP_OP_ADJUSTED_IND, ADM_DR_NAME, ATN_DR_NAME) , PROCEDURES AS (SELECT DISTINCT SSE_MRN, SSE_SURG_DTE, SSE_SURG_LOC, SSE_LOG_ID, SSE_LOG_STS, SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD, SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC, SSP_PROC_NAME, SSP_PROC_SEQ_NO, (TRIM(SSP_SURG_LAST_NM) CONCAT ', ' CONCAT TRIM(SSP_SURG_FIRST_NM)) AS SURG_NAME, SSP_SURG_LAST_NM, SSP_SURG_FIRST_NM, SSP_SURG_SVC_CD, VIS_DSCH_DTE, VIS_HOSP_SVC, VIS_IP_OP_ADJUSTED_IND FROM IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE ON SSE_LOG_ID = SSP_LOG_ID AND SSP_SURG_SVC_CD = 'HEP' JOIN IDB.VISIT_V ON VIS_MRN = SSE_MRN WHERE VIS_DSCH_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT date - 14 DAYS AND CURRENT date - 1 DAY AND VIS_HOSP_SVC = 'HEP' AND VIS_IP_OP_ADJUSTED_IND = 'I' AND SSE_SURG_DTE BETWEEN VIS_ADM_DTE AND VIS_DSCH_DTE ) , COMPLICATIONS AS (SELECT SAE_MRN, SAE_TOX_OCCR_DT, SAE_TOXICITY_NAME, SAE_TOX_GRADE, SAE_TOX_GRADE_NAME FROM IDB.SRG_ADVERSE_EVENT WHERE 1=1 AND DATE(SAE_TOX_OCCR_DT) BETWEEN CURRENT date - 90 DAYS AND CURRENT date ) SELECT DISTINCT A.VIS_MRN "MRN", TRIM(A.PT_NAME) "PT Name", A.VIS_ADM_DTE "Admit Dte", A.VIS_DSCH_DTE "Discharge Dte", TRIM(A.VIS_DAYS_STAY) "Days stayed", TRIM(A.ATN_DR_NAME) "Attending Name", ADM_DR_NAME, TRIM(DX) "Dx", B.SSE_SURG_DTE "Procedure Date", TRIM(B.SURG_NAME) "Surgeon Name", TRIM(B.SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC) "Procedure Name", SAE_TOX_OCCR_DT "Complication Dte", TRIM(SAE_TOXICITY_NAME) "Complication Name", TRIM(SAE_TOX_GRADE) "Complication Grade", TRIM(SAE_TOX_GRADE_NAME) "Complication Grade Name" FROM PTS A LEFT JOIN PROCEDURES B ON A.VIS_MRN = B.SSE_MRN LEFT JOIN COMPLICATIONS ON A.VIS_MRN = SAE_MRN ORDER BY VIS_MRN, SSE_SURG_DTE ;

prompt: One time report of inpatients that have orders for tacrolimus levels.
completion: WITH ORDER AS (SELECT DISTINCT OO_MRN, OOC_ITEM_NAME, OOC_ITEM_DESC, OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE, PT_STATE, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 AS DEPARTMENT FROM IDB.OMS_ORDER JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_CATALOG ON OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID = OOC_MSTR_ITEM_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_STATUS ON OO_ORD_STS_CD = OSTS_ORD_STS_CD JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON OO_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER ON OO_MRN = CPE_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE OOC_ITEM_NAME IN ('Tacrolimus Level', 'Tacrolimus, Plasma') AND OO_ORD_STS_CD NOT IN ('CANP', 'CANC', 'AUC3') AND OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE BETWEEN '2022-06-01' AND '2022-11-30' AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 <> 'PED' AND CVT_IN_OUT_PT = 'Inpatient' ) , LABS AS (SELECT DISTINCT LR_MRN, LR_PERFORMED_DTE, LR_TEST_NAME, LR_SUBTEST_NAME, LR_RESULT_VALUE FROM ORDER JOIN IDB.LAB_RESULTS ON OO_MRN = LR_MRN WHERE LR_SUBTEST_NAME IN ('Tacrolimus, Plasma', 'Tacrolimus Level', 'ALT, Plasma', 'ALT', 'Alanine Aminotransferase (ALT)', 'Alanine Aminotransferase (ALT), Plasma', 'Aspartate Aminotransferase (AST)', 'Aspartate Aminotransferase (AST), Plasma', 'AST', 'AST, Plasma', 'Bilirubin, Total', 'Bilirubin, Total Plasma', 'Total Bilirubin.', 'Creatinine, Plasma', 'Creatinine', 'Creatinine.') AND LR_PERFORMED_DTE = OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE ) SELECT DISTINCT OO_MRN AS MRN, OOC_ITEM_NAME AS "Order Item Name", OOC_ITEM_DESC AS "Order Item Description", OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE AS "Order Significant Date", PT_STATE AS "Patient State", DEPARTMENT, LR_PERFORMED_DTE AS "Lab Performed Date", LR_TEST_NAME AS "Lab Test Name", LR_SUBTEST_NAME AS "Lab Subtest Name", LR_RESULT_VALUE AS "Lab Result Value" FROM ORDER JOIN LABS ON OO_MRN = LR_MRN AND LR_PERFORMED_DTE = OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE

prompt: A list of all H-/S- cases with diagnosis "AML" OR "acute myeloid leukemia" from 01/01/2014-present.
completion: SELECT FIRST_NAME, LAST_NAME, "MRN", "DOB", "H/S NUMBER", "H-/S- CASE PATHOLOGY TEXT" FROM (SELECT PT_FIRST_NAME FIRST_NAME, PT_LAST_NAME LAST_NAME, PT_MRN "MRN", PT_BIRTH_DTE "DOB", STRIP(PRPT_ACCESSION_NO) "H/S NUMBER", PRPT_REPORT "H-/S- CASE PATHOLOGY TEXT", DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)DIAGNOSIS:[\w\W]*(?=BONE MARROW BIOPSY)', PRV.PRPT_REPORT) DIAGNOSIS_COMMENT FROM DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS PD JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V PRV ON PT_MRN = PRPT_MRN WHERE PRPT_REPORT IS NOT NULL AND SUBSTR(PRPT_ACCESSION_NO, 1, 1) IN ('H', 'S') AND(LOCATE('AML', PRPT_REPORT) >=1 OR LOCATE('acute myeloid leukemia', PRPT_REPORT) >=1) AND PRPT_PROCEDURE_DTE BETWEEN '2014-01-01' AND CURRENT DATE ) WHERE LOCATE('AML', DIAGNOSIS_COMMENT) >=1 OR LOCATE('acute myeloid leukemia', DIAGNOSIS_COMMENT) >=1

prompt: Number of Liver, Pancreatic, and Ovarian Cancer Patients who received Chemo and Radiation since 2022
completion: WITH DX AS (SELECT CC_MRN, CC_CLSF_CD AS ICD_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS ICD_DESC FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE SUBSTR(CC_CLSF_CD, 1, 3) IN ('C25', 'C56', 'C22') AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND (CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) GROUP BY CC_MRN, CC_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK HAVING MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) BETWEEN '2022-01-01' AND CURRENT DATE) SELECT CASE WHEN ICD_CD LIKE 'C22%' THEN 'Liver' WHEN ICD_CD LIKE 'C25%' THEN 'Pancreas' WHEN ICD_CD LIKE 'C56%' THEN 'Ovary' END AS SITE, ICD_CD, ICD_DESC, CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT APR_MRN) PT_COUNT FROM IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX_V JOIN DX ON APR_MRN = CC_MRN WHERE APR_START_DTE BETWEEN '2022-01-01' AND CURRENT DATE AND CDG_CHEMO_FLAG = 'Y' GROUP BY CASE WHEN ICD_CD LIKE 'C22%' THEN 'LIVER' WHEN ICD_CD LIKE 'C25%' THEN 'PANCREAS' WHEN ICD_CD LIKE 'C56%' THEN 'OVARY' END, ICD_CD, ICD_DESC, CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME ORDER BY ICD_CD, CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME ; WITH DX AS (SELECT CC_MRN, CC_CLSF_CD AS ICD_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS ICD_DESC FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE SUBSTR(CC_CLSF_CD, 1, 3) IN ('C25', 'C56', 'C22') AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND (CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) GROUP BY CC_MRN, CC_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK HAVING MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) BETWEEN '2022-01-01' AND CURRENT DATE) SELECT CASE WHEN ICD_CD LIKE 'C22%' THEN 'Liver' WHEN ICD_CD LIKE 'C25%' THEN 'Pancreas' WHEN ICD_CD LIKE 'C56%' THEN 'Ovary' END AS SITE, ICD_CD, ICD_DESC, COUNT(DISTINCT RTC_TX_MRN) PT_COUNT FROM IDB.RADONC_TREATMENT_COURSE JOIN DX ON RTC_TX_MRN = CC_MRN WHERE RTC_TX_START_DTE BETWEEN '2022-01-01' AND CURRENT DATE GROUP BY CASE WHEN ICD_CD LIKE 'C22%' THEN 'LIVER' WHEN ICD_CD LIKE 'C25%' THEN 'PANCREAS' WHEN ICD_CD LIKE 'C56%' THEN 'OVARY' END, ICD_CD, ICD_DESC ORDER BY ICD_CD ; WITH DX AS (SELECT CC_MRN, CC_CLSF_CD AS ICD_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS ICD_DESC FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE SUBSTR(CC_CLSF_CD, 1, 3) IN ('C25', 'C56', 'C22') AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND (CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) GROUP BY CC_MRN, CC_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK HAVING MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) BETWEEN '2022-01-01' AND CURRENT DATE) SELECT CASE WHEN ICD_CD LIKE 'C22%' THEN 'Liver' WHEN ICD_CD LIKE 'C25%' THEN 'Pancreas' WHEN ICD_CD LIKE 'C56%' THEN 'Ovary' END AS SITE, ICD_CD, ICD_DESC, COUNT(DISTINCT CC_MRN) PT_COUNT FROM DX GROUP BY CASE WHEN ICD_CD LIKE 'C22%' THEN 'LIVER' WHEN ICD_CD LIKE 'C25%' THEN 'PANCREAS' WHEN ICD_CD LIKE 'C56%' THEN 'OVARY' END, ICD_CD, ICD_DESC ORDER BY ICD_CD

prompt: Identify patients with malignant mesothelioma associated with prior radiation
completion: WITH X AS (SELECT DISTINCT "t1"."PT_MRN" AS "MRN", PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_BIRTH_DTE, PT_SEX, PT_DEATH_DTE, PT_VITAL_STATUS, "t2"."PRPT_ACCESSION_NO" AS "Pathology Report", PRPT_REPORT_TYPE, "t3"."PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_DESC" AS "Pathology Report Type", "t4"."DT_DTE" AS "Pathology Procedure Date", "t5"."DT_DTE" AS "Pathology Report Date", UPPER(DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)DIAGNOSIS:[\w\W]*(?=COMMENT:)', UPPER(PRPT_REPORT))) AS "DIAGNOSIS1", UPPER(DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)DIAGNOSIS:[\w\W]*(?=NOTE:)', UPPER(PRPT_REPORT))) AS "DIAGNOSIS2", UPPER(DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)DIAGNOSIS:[\w\W]*(?=MORPHOLOGY)', UPPER(PRPT_REPORT))) AS "DIAGNOSIS3", UPPER(DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)DIAGNOSIS:[\w\W]*(?=I ATTEST)', UPPER(PRPT_REPORT))) AS "DIAGNOSIS4", UPPER(DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)CLINICAL DIAGNOSIS AND HISTORY:[\w\W]*(?=SPECIMENS SUBMITTED:)', UPPER(PRPT_REPORT))) AS "DIAGNOSIS5", UPPER(DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)CLINICAL DIAGNOSIS AND HISTORY:[\w\W]*(?=SPECIMENSSUBMITTED:)', UPPER(PRPT_REPORT))) AS "DIAGNOSIS6", UPPER(DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)CLINICAL DIAGNOSIS & HISTORY:[\w\W]*(?=SPECIMENS SUBMITTED:)', UPPER(PRPT_REPORT))) AS "DIAGNOSIS7" FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V" "t1" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED" "t6" ON "t1"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t6"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V" "t2" ON "t6"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t2"."PRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATH_RPRT_TYPE_LOOKUP" "t3" ON "t2"."PRPT_REPORT_TYPE" = "t3"."PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_CD" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" "t4" ON "t2"."PRPT_PROCEDURE_DATE_ID" = "t4"."DT_DATE_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" "t5" ON "t2"."PRPT_REPORT_DATE_ID" = "t5"."DT_DATE_ID" WHERE 1=1 AND PRPT_REPORT IS NOT NULL AND CONTAINS("PRPT_REPORT", '("mesothelioma")') = 1 AND("PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_DESC" LIKE 'S%' OR "PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_DESC" LIKE 'C%') ) , Y AS (SELECT "MRN", PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_BIRTH_DTE, PT_SEX, PT_DEATH_DTE, PT_VITAL_STATUS, "Pathology Report", PRPT_REPORT_TYPE, "Pathology Report Type", "Pathology Procedure Date", "Pathology Report Date", CASE WHEN "DIAGNOSIS1" <> '' THEN "DIAGNOSIS1" WHEN "DIAGNOSIS2" <> '' THEN "DIAGNOSIS2" WHEN "DIAGNOSIS3" <> '' THEN "DIAGNOSIS3" WHEN "DIAGNOSIS4" <> '' THEN "DIAGNOSIS4" WHEN "DIAGNOSIS5" <> '' THEN "DIAGNOSIS5" WHEN "DIAGNOSIS6" <> '' THEN "DIAGNOSIS6" WHEN "DIAGNOSIS7" <> '' THEN "DIAGNOSIS7" END AS "DIAGNOSIS" FROM X) , Y2 AS (SELECT * FROM Y WHERE UPPER("DIAGNOSIS") like '%MESOTHELIOMA%' ) , CD AS (SELECT Z.* FROM (SELECT DISTINCT CDD_MRN, CDD_DOC_GUID, CDD_SERVICE_DTE, CDD_DOC_NAME, CDO_SECTION, CDO_CTLG_DISPL_NM, CDO_MSTR_ITEM_NM, CDO_ITEM_NAME, CDO_VALUE_TEXT, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CDD_MRN ORDER BY CDD_SERVICE_DT) AS RN FROM Y2 JOIN IDB.CD_DOCUMENT ON CDD_MRN = MRN JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION ON CDO_DOC_GUID = CDD_DOC_GUID AND CDO_AUTHORED_DTE = CDD_AUTHORED_DTE WHERE CDD_CANCEL_IND = '0' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND = '0' AND UPPER(CDD_DOC_NAME) LIKE '%INIT%' AND(UPPER(CDD_DOC_NAME) LIKE '%CONS%' OR UPPER(CDD_DOC_NAME) LIKE '%VISIT%') AND UPPER(CDO_SECTION) NOT LIKE '%FAM%HISTORY%' AND UPPER(CDO_CTLG_DISPL_NM) NOT LIKE '%FAM%HISTORY%' AND UPPER(CDO_MSTR_ITEM_NM) NOT LIKE '%FAM%HISTORY%' AND UPPER(CDO_ITEM_NAME) NOT LIKE '%FAM%HISTORY%' AND UPPER(CDO_CTLG_DISPL_NM) NOT LIKE '%FAM%HX%' AND UPPER(CDO_MSTR_ITEM_NM) NOT LIKE '%FAM%HX%' AND UPPER(CDO_ITEM_NAME) NOT LIKE '%FAM%HX%' AND(UPPER(CDO_VALUE_TEXT) like '%RADIATION%' OR UPPER(CDO_VALUE_TEXT) like '%DLBCL%' OR UPPER(CDO_VALUE_TEXT) like '%DIFFUSE LARGE B CELL LYMPHOMA%' OR UPPER(CDO_VALUE_TEXT) like '%DIFFUSE LARGE B-CELL LYMPHOMA%' OR UPPER(CDO_VALUE_TEXT) like '%LYMPHOMA%' OR UPPER(CDO_VALUE_TEXT) like '%HL%' OR UPPER(CDO_VALUE_TEXT) like '%HODGKIN%' OR UPPER(CDO_VALUE_TEXT) like '%NHL%' OR UPPER(CDO_VALUE_TEXT) like '%MANTLE%' OR UPPER(CDO_VALUE_TEXT) like '%BREAST CA%' OR UPPER(CDO_VALUE_TEXT) like '%LUNG CA%' OR UPPER(CDO_VALUE_TEXT) like '%HEAD AND NECK%' OR UPPER(CDO_VALUE_TEXT) like '%HEAD & NECK%' OR UPPER(CDO_VALUE_TEXT) like '%HEAD&NECK%' OR UPPER(CDO_VALUE_TEXT) like '%ORAL CAVITY%' OR UPPER(CDO_VALUE_TEXT) like '%PROSTATE CA%' OR UPPER(CDO_VALUE_TEXT) like '%RECTAL CA%' OR UPPER(CDO_VALUE_TEXT) like '%CERVICAL CA%' OR UPPER(CDO_VALUE_TEXT) like '%COLORECTAL CA%' OR UPPER(CDO_VALUE_TEXT) like '%CRC%' OR UPPER(CDO_VALUE_TEXT) like '%SRS%' OR UPPER(CDO_VALUE_TEXT) like '%STEREOTACTIC RADIATION%' OR UPPER(CDO_VALUE_TEXT) like '%EBRT%' OR UPPER(CDO_VALUE_TEXT) like '%EXTERNAL BEAM%' OR UPPER(CDO_VALUE_TEXT) like '%PROTON%' OR UPPER(CDO_VALUE_TEXT) like '%PHOTON%') ) Z WHERE RN = 1 ) , Z AS (SELECT Y2.* FROM Y2 JOIN CD ON MRN = CDD_MRN) , AC AS (SELECT AC_MRN, MAX(CASE WHEN AC_IRB_NO = '06-107' THEN 'Y' END) AS "06-107", MAX(CASE WHEN AC_IRB_NO = '12-245' THEN 'Y' END) AS "12-245" FROM Z JOIN IDB.ACCRUALS ON MRN = AC_MRN WHERE AC_IRB_NO IN ('06-107', '12-245') GROUP BY AC_MRN ) SELECT DISTINCT Z.*, "06-107", "12-245" FROM Z LEFT JOIN AC ON MRN = AC_MRN

prompt: Provide a list of patients with choroidal hemangiomas who had ICG angiography.
completion: WITH DX AS (SELECT CC_MRN, CLM_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS INIT_DX_DATE FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND ((CC_PT_TYPE = 'I') OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) AND CC_CLSF_CD IN ('C69.31', 'C69.32', 'D18.09', 'D31.31', 'D31.32', '190.6', '224.6', '228.03', '228.09') GROUP BY CC_MRN, CLM_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK ) , PBD AS (SELECT DISTINCT PBD_MRN, CLM_CLSF_CD AS CPT_CODE, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS CPT_DESC, PBC_PBD_DESC AS PBD_DESC, PBD_SVC_DTE AS SVC_DATE FROM IDB.PBD_DTL JOIN IDB.PBD_CODE ON PBD_PBD_CD = PBC_PBD_CD JOIN IDB.CLM ON PBC_CPT_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE PBC_CPT_CD IN ('92240', '92242') AND PBD_MRN IN (SELECT CC_MRN FROM DX) ) , X AS (SELECT DISTINCT DX.*, CPT_CODE, CPT_DESC, PBD_DESC, SVC_DATE FROM DX JOIN PBD ON PBD_MRN = CC_MRN) , CPE AS (SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN, CPE_ENC_DTE, CRE_RES_NAME, CRE_RES_TYP, CLD_DEPT_NAME, CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CPE_MRN ORDER BY CPE_ENC_DTE DESC) AS RN FROM X JOIN IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER ON CPE_MRN = CC_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CRE_RES_TYP IN ('Physician') ) , AC AS (SELECT DISTINCT AC_MRN, STRIP(AC_IRB_NO) AS AC_IRB_NO FROM X JOIN IDB.ACCRUALS ON CC_MRN = AC_MRN) , CTE AS (SELECT AC_MRN, AC_IRB_NO FROM AC) , CTE2 AS (SELECT * FROM CTE ORDER BY AC_MRN, AC_IRB_NO) , T1 AS (SELECT AC_MRN, AC_IRB_NO, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY AC_MRN ORDER BY AC_IRB_NO) AS RN FROM CTE2 ORDER BY AC_MRN, AC_IRB_NO) , T2 (MRN, IRB_NO, RN1) AS (SELECT AC_MRN, CAST(AC_IRB_NO AS VARCHAR(100)), RN FROM T1 WHERE T1.RN = 1 UNION ALL SELECT AC_MRN, RTRIM(CAST(IRB_NO AS VARCHAR(1000))) || ', ' || CHR(13) || CHR(10) || CAST(AC_IRB_NO AS VARCHAR(100)) , RN1 + 1 FROM T1, T2 WHERE AC_MRN = MRN AND RN = RN1+1 ) , T3 AS (SELECT MRN, MAX(RN1) RN FROM T2 GROUP BY MRN) , T4 AS (SELECT T2.MRN AS AC_MRN, IRB_NO FROM T2 JOIN T3 ON T2.MRN = T3.MRN AND T2.RN1 = T3.RN) SELECT PT_MRN, STRIP(PT_LAST_NAME) || ', ' || STRIP(PT_FIRST_NAME) AS NAME, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH AS DOB, PT_SEX AS GENDER, R.AV_DESC AS "Race", E.AV_DESC AS "Ethnicity", PT_DATE_OF_DEATH AS DOD, COALESCE(MAX(PLA_LST_APPT_DTE, PLA_LST_DSCH_DTE), PLA_LST_APPT_DTE, PLA_LST_DSCH_DTE) AS LAST_FU_DATE, CLM_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK, INIT_DX_DATE, CPT_CODE, CPT_DESC, PBD_DESC, SVC_DATE, CPE_ENC_DTE, CRE_RES_NAME, CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME, CLD_DEPT_NAME, IRB_NO FROM X JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON CC_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY ON PT_MRN = PLA_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS R ON PT_RACE = R.AV_CODE AND R.AV_ELEMENT = 'RACE' LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS E ON PT_PT_ETHNICITY = E.AV_CODE AND E.AV_ELEMENT = 'PT_ETHNICITY' LEFT JOIN CPE ON PT_MRN = CPE_MRN AND RN = 1 LEFT JOIN T4 ON CC_MRN = AC_MRN

prompt: Dr. Chakraborty will use this data to request de-identified CT scans from radiology
completion: WITH DEMOGRAPHICS_0 AS (SELECT DISTINCT "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AS PT_DEID, IDB_PATIENT."PT_MRN" AS PT_MRN, "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AS SUBJECT_ID FROM "IDB"."PATIENT" AS IDB_PATIENT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS" ON IDB_PATIENT."PT_MRN" = "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_MRN" WHERE IDB_PATIENT."PT_MRN" IN ('00173009', '00306215', '00323474', '00356465', '00757833', '00975183', '35153097', '35527269', '35528340', '35566009', '38228840', '38242133', '38249808', '38252522', '38261741', '38262029', '38262381', '38264977', '38265709', '38266553', '38267248', '38267930', '38271277', '38272431', '38275760', '38278006', '38278449', '38279864', '38282446', '38287490', '38288480', '38289803', '38290536', '38291212', '38291815', '38292501', '38294598', '38297012', '38298111', '38299052', '38299409', '38299794', '38301192', '38302622', '38266073')), RADIOLOGY_1 AS (SELECT "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AS PT_DEID, "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_MRN" AS PT_MRN, CAST(TRIM("DV"."RADIOLOGY_REPORT_V"."RRPT_RPT_ID") AS VARCHAR) || CAST(TRIM("DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_MRN") AS VARCHAR) AS SUBJECT_ID, "DV"."RADIOLOGY_REPORT_V"."RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE" AS RRPT_PERFORMED_DATE FROM "DV"."RADIOLOGY_REPORT_V" JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS" ON "DV"."RADIOLOGY_REPORT_V"."RRPT_MRN" = "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_MRN" WHERE "DV"."RADIOLOGY_REPORT_V"."RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE" BETWEEN '2023-01-01' AND '2023-11-01'), COHORT AS (SELECT PT_DEID AS PT_DEID FROM (( (SELECT DEMOGRAPHICS_0.PT_DEID FROM DEMOGRAPHICS_0)) INTERSECT ( (SELECT RADIOLOGY_1.PT_DEID FROM RADIOLOGY_1)))), COHORT_RADIOLOGY AS (SELECT SUBJECT_ID AS SUBJECT_ID, PT_DEID AS PT_DEID FROM ( (SELECT RADIOLOGY_1.SUBJECT_ID, RADIOLOGY_1.PT_DEID FROM RADIOLOGY_1))), KEYS AS (SELECT COHORT.PT_DEID AS COHORT_PT_DEID, COHORT_RADIOLOGY.SUBJECT_ID AS COHORT_RADIOLOGY_SUBJECT_ID, COHORT_RADIOLOGY.PT_DEID AS COHORT_RADIOLOGY_PT_DEID FROM COHORT LEFT IDB_PATIENT."PT_MRN" AS PT_MRN, "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AS SUBJECT_ID FROM "IDB"."PATIENT" AS IDB_PATIENT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS" ON IDB_PATIENT."PT_MRN" = prompt: Please add the following criteria to the "Financial Clearance" sheet (sheet 1) criteria: APR_DIAGNOSIS_DESC = "%Prostate%"
completion: WITH ORD AS (SELECT OO_MRN, OOC_ITEM_NAME, OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE, OSTS_STS_DESC, OO_REQ_DR_NO, DOC_NAME FROM IDB.OMS_ORDER JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_CATALOG ON OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID = OOC_MSTR_ITEM_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_STATUS ON OO_ORD_STS_CD = OSTS_ORD_STS_CD JOIN IDB.OMS_PROVIDER ON OO_PVDR_GUID = OP_PVDR_GUID JOIN IDB.DOC ON OP_PVDR_NO = DOC_DR_NO WHERE OOC_ITEM_NAME = 'Financial Clearance for Chemotherapy (Genitourinary)' AND OO_ORD_STS_CD NOT IN ('CANP', 'CANC', 'AUC3') AND OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE >= CURRENT DATE - 1 DAY ) , APPT AS (SELECT CPE_MRN , CPE_ENC_DTE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CPE_MRN ORDER BY CPE_ENC_DTE ASC) RN FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID JOIN ORD ON OO_MRN = CPE_MRN WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Sch') AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 ='GU' AND (CLD_DEPT_NAME LIKE 'ST GU' OR CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME LIKE '%STGU%') ) , DX AS (SELECT DISTINCT CC_MRN FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN ORD ON OO_MRN = CC_MRN WHERE SUBSTR(CC_CLSF_CD, 1, 3) IN ('185', 'C61') AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND (CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) ) SELECT OO_MRN AS MRN, CASE WHEN CC_MRN IS NOT NULL THEN 'Y' END AS PROTSATE_FLAG, TRIM(PT_LAST_NAME) || ', ' || TRIM(PT_FIRST_NAME) AS PATIENT_NAME, OOC_ITEM_NAME AS ORDER_NAME, OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE AS ORDER_DATE, TRIM(OSTS_STS_DESC) AS ORDER_STATUS, OO_REQ_DR_NO || ' - ' || TRIM(DOC_NAME) AS ORDERED_BY, CPE_ENC_DTE AS NEXT_GU_APPOINTMENT FROM ORD LEFT JOIN APPT ON CPE_MRN = OO_MRN AND RN =1 LEFT JOIN DX ON CC_MRN = OO_MRN JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PT_MRN = OO_MRN ; SELECT APR_MRN AS MRN, APR_ORD_CREATE_DTE AS ORDER_CREATED_DATE, APR_START_DTE AS ORDER_START_DATE, CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME AS DRUG_NAME, APR_DIAGNOSIS_DESC AS DIAGNOSIS_TEXT FROM IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX_V WHERE APR_ORD_CREATE_DTE = CURRENT date - 1 DAY AND CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME ='PEMBROLIZUMAB' AND CDG_CHEMO_FLAG = 'Y' AND UPPER(APR_DIAGNOSIS_DESC) LIKE '%PROSTATE%' ;

"DV"."PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED" "t3" ON "t1"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t3"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V" "t2" ON "t3"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = STRIP(PT_FIRST_NAME) AS "Name", CPE_ENC_DTE, CRE_RES_NAME FROM Z JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PT_MRN = MRN JOIN IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER ON CPE_MRN = MRN JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN prompt: Provide list of patients for Dr. Bhuvanesh Singh for thyroid and neck dissection procedures since 2014.

SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD IN ('60210', '60212', '60220', '60225', '60240', '60252', '60254', '60260', '60271') AND SSP_RES_ID = '008623' ) , ALL_PROCEDURES AS (SELECT SSE_MRN_ALL, SSE_SURG_DTE_ALL, SUBSTR(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(CAST(XMLSERIALIZE(CONTENT XMLAGG(XMLELEMENT(NAME "c", '| '||SSE_SURG_DTE_ALL || ' | ' || TRIM(SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD_ALL) || ' | ' || TRIM(SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC_ALL)||' |'|| CHR(13) || CHR(10)) ORDER BY SSE_SURG_DTE_ALL) AS CLOB(32000)) AS VARCHAR(32000)), '<c>', ','), '</c>', ''), '', ''), '<c/>', ''), ',', ''), 1) AS ALL_PROCS FROM (SELECT DISTINCT B.SSE_MRN SSE_MRN_ALL, B.SSE_SURG_DTE SSE_SURG_DTE_ALL, C.SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD_ALL, C.SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC_ALL FROM IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT B JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE C ON B.SSE_LOG_ID = C.SSP_LOG_ID AND B.SSE_ENC_CSN_ID = C.SSP_ENC_CSN_ID JOIN PROCEDURES A ON A.SSE_MRN = B.SSE_MRN AND A.SSE_SURG_DTE = B.SSE_SURG_DTE) A GROUP BY SSE_MRN_ALL, CONTAINS(CDD_DOCUMENT_FULL_TEXT, '("Hypocalcemia" | "hypocalcemic" | "voice issues" | "vocal cord paralysis" | "vocal cord paresis" | "hoarseness")') = 1 ) , SURGERY_NOTE AS (SELECT CDD_DOC_NAME, CDD_SERVICE_DTE, CDD_MRN, CDD_DOC_GUID, CDO_SECTION, CDO_ITEM_NAME, CDO_VALUE_TEXT, CDO_MSTR_ITEM_NM FROM IDB.CD_DOCUMENT JOIN PROCEDURES ON SSE_MRN = CDD_MRN AND SSE_SURG_DTE = CDD_SERVICE_DTE LEFT JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION ON CDD_DOC_GUID = CDO_DOC_GUID AND CDD_AUTHORED_DTE = CDO_AUTHORED_DTE AND CDO_VALUE_TEXT <> '' WHERE CDD_CANCEL_IND <> '1' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND <> '1' AND CDD_DOC_NAME IN MAX(PI_MODIFIED_DT) FROM DV.PATIENT_IDENTIFICATION) FROM SYSIBM.SYSDUMMY1 UNION ALL SELECT 'DV', 'PATIENT_LATEST_ACTIVITY', -1 , -1, (SELECT MAX(DATE(PLA_MODIFIED_DT)) FROM SYSIBM.SYSDUMMY1 UNION ALL SELECT 'DV', 'ENCOUNTER_DESC_CATALOG', -1 , -1, CURRENT date, TIMESTAMP(CURRENT date) FROM SYSIBM.SYSDUMMY1) , MSTR_CLEAN AS (SELECT M.* , REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(STRIP(TRIM(STM_TARGET_TABLE_NAME)) , CHR(19), ''), CHR(10), ''), CHR(13), '') , 'DV.', '') TABLE_NAME_CLEANED , LENGTH (STRIP(STM_TARGET_TABLE_NAME)) LN , prompt: Provide the CAGE-AID positive patients identified in at presurgical testing, how many had medical consult order placed within the week of their presurgical testing appointment.

prompt: Provide a list of patients seen within the breast medicine service or solid tumor GU in 2019.
completion: WITH BREAST AS (SELECT CPE_MRN AS "MRN", PT_LAST_NAME LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME FIRST_NAME, TIMESTAMPDIFF (256, CHAR(TIMESTAMP(CURRENT timestamp)- TIMESTAMP(TM_DX_DTE))) YRS_FROM_DX, TM_DX_DTE, CATEGORY2, CPE_ENC_DTE AS "Appt Date", CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 AS "Department", CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 AS "Service", CLD_CLD_CENTER "Location", CLD_DEPT_NAME AS "Department Name", CRE_RES_NAME AS "Provider Name", CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME AS "Visit Type", ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CPE_MRN ORDER BY CPE_ENC_DTE) RN FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON CPE_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID JOIN IDB.CDB_TUMOR ON CPE_MRN = TM_MRN JOIN IDB.SEERGROUPING ON IDB.SEERF_ICDO(TM_SITE_CD, TM_HIST_CD) = RECODE WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN '2019-01-01' AND '2019-12-31' AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 = 'MED' AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 = 'BRE' AND TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') ) SELECT "MRN", LAST_NAME, FIRST_NAME, LISTAGG(TRIM(CHAR(YRS_FROM_DX)) || ' YRS FROM DX (Dx Date: ' || CHAR(TM_DX_DTE) || ') ' || CATEGORY2, CHR(13)||CHR(10)) DX, "Appt Date", "Location", "Department Name", "Provider Name" FROM BREAST WHERE RN = 1 GROUP BY "MRN", LAST_NAME, FIRST_NAME, "Appt Date", "Location", "Department Name", "Provider Name" ; WITH GU AS (SELECT CPE_MRN AS "MRN", PT_LAST_NAME LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME FIRST_NAME, TIMESTAMPDIFF (256, CHAR(TIMESTAMP(CURRENT timestamp)- TIMESTAMP(TM_DX_DTE))) YRS_FROM_DX, TM_DX_DTE, CATEGORY2, CPE_ENC_DTE AS "Appt Date", CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 AS "Department", CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 AS "Service", CLD_CLD_CENTER "Location", CLD_DEPT_NAME AS "Department Name", CRE_RES_NAME AS "Provider Name", CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME AS "Visit Type", ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CPE_MRN ORDER BY CPE_ENC_DTE) RN FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON CPE_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID JOIN IDB.CDB_TUMOR ON CPE_MRN = TM_MRN JOIN IDB.SEERGROUPING ON IDB.SEERF_ICDO(TM_SITE_CD, TM_HIST_CD) = RECODE WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN '2019-01-01' AND '2019-12-31' AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 = 'MED' AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 = 'GU' AND TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') ) SELECT "MRN", LAST_NAME, FIRST_NAME, LISTAGG(TRIM(CHAR(YRS_FROM_DX)) || ' YRS FROM DX (Dx Date: ' || CHAR(TM_DX_DTE) || ') ' || CATEGORY2, CHR(13)||CHR(10)) DX, "Appt Date", "Location", "Department Name", "Provider Name" FROM GU WHERE RN = 1 GROUP BY "MRN", LAST_NAME, FIRST_NAME, "Appt Date", "Location", "Department Name", "Provider Name" ;

prompt: Provide list of outpatients from 1/1/12-present for whom Dr. Kalin is an author or a provider on a ClinDoc note.
completion: WITH CLINDOC AS (SELECT DISTINCT CDD_DOC_NAME AS DOCUMENT_NAME, USR.OU_DISPLAY_NAME ENTEREDBY, OP_DISPLAY_NAME AS SERVICE_PVDR, CDD_ENTER_DTE ENTERED_DTE, CDD_AUTHORED_DTE AS SVC_DTE, CDD_MRN AS MRN, STRIP(PT_LAST_NAME)||', '||STRIP(PT_FIRST_NAME) AS PT_NAME, CDO_SECTION AS "SECTION", CDO_ITEM_NAME AS "ITEM", CDO_VALUE_TEXT AS "VALUE", OCV_CURR_LOC LOCATION , OCV_PVDR_NAME PT_PVDR_NAME, OS_SVC_GRP_CD PVDR_SVC_GRP, OS_SVC_DESC PVDR_SVC, CDO_USER_GUID, CSN.OU_DISPLAY_NAME AS COSIGNER FROM IDB.CD_DOCUMENT JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION ON CDD_DOC_GUID = CDO_DOC_GUID JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON CDD_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.OMS_PROVIDER ON CDD_AUTH_PROV_GUID = OP_PVDR_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_USER USR ON USR.OU_USER_GUID = CDD_USER_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_USER CSN ON CSN.OU_USER_GUID = CDO_USER_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_CLIENT_VISIT ON CDD_VISIT_GUID = OCV_VISIT_GUID AND OCV_IP_OP_IND = 'I' JOIN IDB.OMS_SERVICE ON OCV_SVC_GUID = OS_SVC_GUID WHERE CDD_CANCEL_IND = '0' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND = '0' AND CDD_ENTER_DTE >= '2012-01-01' AND CDO_USER_GUID = '1000004982119029' ) , PBD AS (SELECT PBD_MRN, PBD_SVC_DTE, PBD_ACCT_NO, PBI_BILLING_AREA, PBI_SVC_LOC, PBC_CPT_CD, PBC_PBD_DESC , DOC_NAME FROM CLINDOC JOIN IDB.PBD_DTL ON MRN = PBD_MRN AND SVC_DTE = PBD_SVC_DTE JOIN IDB.PBD_INVOICE ON PBD_MRN = PBI_MRN AND PBD_ACCT_NO = PBI_ACCT_NO AND PBD_INV_NO = PBI_INV_NO AND PBI_SVC_LOC = 'INP' JOIN IDB.PBD_CODE ON PBD_PBD_CD = PBC_PBD_CD JOIN IDB.DOC ON DOC_DR_NO = PBI_PERFORM_DR_NO WHERE DOC_NAME = 'KALIN MARCIA F' AND PBD_SVC_DTE = '2012-01-01' ) SELECT MRN, PT_NAME, DOCUMENT_NAME, SVC_DTE, ENTEREDBY, SERVICE_PVDR, COSIGNER, ENTERED_DTE, LOCATION, PT_PVDR_NAME, PVDR_SVC_GRP, PVDR_SVC, DOC_NAME AS PBD_ENTERED, PBC_CPT_CD, PBC_PBD_DESC FROM CLINDOC LEFT JOIN PBD ON MRN = PBD_MRN AND SVC_DTE = PBD_SVC_DTE

completion: WITH PT AS (SELECT PT_MRN AS MRN, PT_DATE_OF_DEATH FROM IDB.PATIENT WHERE PT_MRN IN () ) SELECT * FROM PT , PATH AS (SELECT DISTINCT "t1"."PT_MRN" AS "MRN", "t2"."PRPT_ACCESSION_NO" AS "Pathology Report", "t3"."PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_DESC" AS "Pathology Report Type", "t4"."DT_DTE" AS "Pathology Procedure Date", CASE WHEN UPPER(DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)DIAGNOSIS:[\w\W]*(?=NOTE:)', PRPT_REPORT)) <> '' THEN UPPER(DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)DIAGNOSIS:[\w\W]*(?=NOTE:)', PRPT_REPORT)) WHEN UPPER(DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)DIAGNOSIS:[\w\W]*(?=I ATTEST)', PRPT_REPORT)) <> '' THEN UPPER(DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)DIAGNOSIS:[\w\W]*(?=I ATTEST)', PRPT_REPORT)) WHEN UPPER(DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)DIAGNOSIS:[\w\W]*(?=REPORT ELECTRONICALLY SIGNED OUT )', PRPT_REPORT)) <> '' THEN UPPER(DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)DIAGNOSIS:[\w\W]*(?=REPORT ELECTRONICALLY SIGNED OUT )', PRPT_REPORT)) END AS "DIAGNOSIS" FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V" "t1" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED" "t6" ON "t1"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t6"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V" "t2" ON "t6"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t2"."PRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATH_RPRT_TYPE_LOOKUP" "t3" ON "t2"."PRPT_REPORT_TYPE" = "t3"."PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_CD" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" "t4" ON "t2"."PRPT_PROCEDURE_DATE_ID" = "t4"."DT_DATE_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" "t5" ON "t2"."PRPT_REPORT_DATE_ID" = "t5"."DT_DATE_ID" WHERE 1=1 AND "t2"."PRPT_REPORT" IS NOT NULL AND UPPER("t3"."PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_DESC") like '%SURGICAL PATHOLOGY%' AND "t1"."PT_MRN" IN (SELECT MRN FROM PT) ) , APR AS (SELECT APR_MRN, APR_DRUG_NAME, APR_ROUTE, MIN(APR_START_DTE) AS START_DATE, MAX(APR_END_DTE) AS END_DATE, APR_ORD_RX_TYPE FROM IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX_V JOIN PT ON APR_MRN = MRN WHERE CDG_CHEMO_FLAG = 'Y' AND(APR_ROUTE like 'IV%' OR UPPER(APR_ROUTE) like '%INTRAVENOUS%') GROUP BY APR_MRN, APR_DRUG_NAME, APR_ROUTE, APR_ORD_RX_TYPE ) , RT AS (SELECT DISTINCT RTC_TX_MRN, RTC_TX_PLAN_NAME, RTC_PRIMARY_REF_POINT, RTC_TX_START_DTE, RTC_TX_STOP_DTE, RTC_TX_ELAPSED_DAYS, RTC_TX_PLANNED_FRACTIONS, RTC_TX_DELIVERED_FRACTIONS, RTC_TX_PLANNED_DOSE, RTC_TX_DELIVERED_DOSE, RTC_DOSE_CORRECTION FROM IDB.RADONC_TREATMENT_COURSE JOIN PT ON RTC_TX_MRN = MRN) SELECT * FROM RT

prompt: Provide a report of patients who have had the Massive Transfusion Protocol initiated in the hospital excluding the OR.
completion: WITH X AS (SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN, STRIP(PT_LAST_NAME) || ', ' || STRIP(PT_FIRST_NAME) AS NAME, OO_ORD_ID, OOC_ITEM_NAME, OOC_ITEM_DESC, OO_ORD_NAME, OO_ENTER_DTE, OO_ENTER_DT, TIME(OO_ENTER_DT) AS OO_ENTER_TME, DATE(OCV_ADM_DT) AS ADM_DATE, OCV_CURR_LOC FROM IDB.PATIENT JOIN IDB.OMS_ORDER ON PT_MRN = OO_MRN JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_CATALOG ON OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID = OOC_MSTR_ITEM_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_CLIENT_VISIT ON OO_VISIT_GUID = OCV_VISIT_GUID WHERE OO_ORD_STS_CD NOT IN ('CANC', 'CANP', 'AUC3') AND OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID = '9000008725200730' ) , Y AS (SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN AS MRN, NAME, OO_ORD_ID, OOC_ITEM_NAME, OOC_ITEM_DESC, OO_ORD_NAME, OO_ENTER_DTE, OO_ENTER_DT, OO_ENTER_TME, ADM_DATE, OCV_CURR_LOC, CDD_DOC_GUID, CDD_SERVICE_DT, CDD_SERVICE_DTE, CDD_DOC_NAME, CDO_SECTION, CDO_CTLG_DISPL_NM, CDO_MSTR_ITEM_NM, CDO_ITEM_NAME, STRIP(CDO_ITEM_NAME) || ' | ' || STRIP(CDO_MSTR_ITEM_NM) AS ITEM, STRIP(SUBSTR(CDO_VALUE_TEXT, 1, 2000)) AS TEXT, ABS(TIMESTAMPDIFF(2, CHAR(CDD_SERVICE_DT - OO_ENTER_DT))) AS DIFF1 FROM X JOIN IDB.CD_DOCUMENT ON CDD_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION ON CDO_DOC_GUID = CDD_DOC_GUID WHERE CDD_CANCEL_IND = '0' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND = '0' AND CDO_MSTR_ITEM_NM IN ('CVAD_Catheter type RES', 'CVAD_Catheter type v.2 RES', 'PROC_CVC_CentralCathType 2 ob', 'PROC_CVC_CentralCathType ob') AND CDD_SERVICE_DT BETWEEN OO_ENTER_DT - 180 DAYS AND OO_ENTER_DT + 12 HOURS ) , Y1 AS (SELECT OO_ORD_ID, MIN(DIFF1) AS MIN_DIFF1 FROM Y GROUP BY OO_ORD_ID) , Z AS (SELECT DISTINCT Y.OO_ORD_ID, CDD_DOC_GUID, CDD_SERVICE_DT, CDD_SERVICE_DTE, CDD_DOC_NAME, ITEM, TEXT FROM Y JOIN Y1 ON Y.OO_ORD_ID = Y1.OO_ORD_ID AND Y.DIFF1 = Y1.MIN_DIFF1) SELECT X.PT_MRN, X.NAME, X.OO_ORD_ID, X.OOC_ITEM_NAME, X.OOC_ITEM_DESC, X.OO_ORD_NAME, X.OO_ENTER_DT, X.OO_ENTER_DTE, X.OO_ENTER_TME, X.ADM_DATE, X.OCV_CURR_LOC, CDD_DOC_GUID, CDD_SERVICE_DT, CDD_SERVICE_DTE, CDD_DOC_NAME, MAX(CASE WHEN ITEM = 'Non-Tunneled Catheter type | CVAD_Catheter type RES' THEN TEXT END) AS "Non-Tunneled Catheter type | CVAD_Catheter type RES", MAX(CASE WHEN ITEM = 'Catheter type | CVAD_Catheter type v.2 RES' THEN TEXT END) AS "Catheter type | CVAD_Catheter type v.2 RES", MAX(CASE WHEN ITEM = 'Catheter Type | PROC_CVC_CentralCathType 2 ob' THEN TEXT END) AS "Catheter Type | PROC_CVC_CentralCathType 2 ob", MAX(CASE WHEN ITEM = 'Catheter Type: | PROC_CVC_CentralCathType ob' THEN TEXT END) AS "Catheter Type: | PROC_CVC_CentralCathType ob" FROM X LEFT JOIN Z ON X.OO_ORD_ID = Z.OO_ORD_ID WHERE X.PT_MRN NOT IN ('22222222', '55555555') GROUP BY X.PT_MRN, X.NAME, X.OO_ORD_ID, X.OOC_ITEM_NAME, X.OOC_ITEM_DESC, X.OO_ORD_NAME, X.OO_ENTER_DT, X.OO_ENTER_DTE, X.OO_ENTER_TME, X.ADM_DATE, X.OCV_CURR_LOC, CDD_DOC_GUID, CDD_SERVICE_DT, CDD_SERVICE_DTE, CDD_DOC_NAME
