prompt: Provide a one time list of all new patients with biliary cancer seen at MSK over the past 3 years.
completion: WITH CC AS (SELECT CC_MRN, CLM_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS INIT_EFF_DATE FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND ((CC_PT_TYPE = 'I') OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) AND CC_CLSF_CD IN ('C22.0', 'C22.1', 'C23', 'C24.9') GROUP BY CC_MRN, CLM_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK ) , X AS (SELECT PT_MRN AS MRN, STRIP(PT_LAST_NAME) || ', ' || STRIP(PT_FIRST_NAME) AS "Name", CLM_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK, INIT_EFF_DATE FROM CC JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON CC_MRN = PT_MRN) SELECT DISTINCT X.*, CPE_ENC_DTE, CRE_RES_NAME, CRE_RES_TYP, CLD_DEPT_NAME, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8, CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CPE_MRN ORDER BY CPE_ENC_DTE DESC) AS RN FROM X JOIN IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER ON CPE_MRN = MRN JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp', 'Sch') AND CRE_RES_TYP IN ('Physician') AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN '2018-01-01' AND '2021-12-31' AND(CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME LIKE '%NV%' OR CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME LIKE '%IR%')

prompt: Monthly list of new visits (NV1, NV2, IR) with diagnosis seen by thoracic oncology providers
completion: WITH APPTS AS (SELECT DISTINCT CPE_ENC_DTE AS APPT_DTE, TIME(CPE_APPT_DT) AS APPT_TIME, CPE_MRN AS MRN, CL_LAST_NAME AS LAST_NAME, CL_FIRST_NAME AS FIRST_NAME, YEAR (CPE_ENC_DTE - CL_DATE_OF_BIRTH) AS AGE, CLD_CLD_CENTER AS SITE, CLD_DEPT_NAME AS DEPT, A.CRE_RES_NAME AS PROVIDER, A.CRE_RES_ID AS RES_ID, CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME AS VT_NAME, CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID, CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR, CPE_ENC_CSN_ID AS CSN FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID AND CLD_CLD_CENTER IN ('KOCH') AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 IN ('MED') AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 = 'THR' JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE A ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = A.CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID AND (CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR LIKE '%NV%' OR CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR LIKE '%IR%') JOIN IDB.CL_PATIENT ON CPE_PRK = CL_PRK WHERE 1=1 AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN LAST_DAY(CURRENT DATE - 2 MONTH) + 1 DAY AND LAST_DAY(CURRENT DATE - 1 MONTH) AND CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') ) , PBD AS (SELECT DISTINCT PBD_MRN, PBD_SVC_DTE, PBI_PERFORM_DR_NO, CLM_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK FROM APPTS JOIN IDB.PBD_DTL ON MRN = PBD_MRN JOIN IDB.PBD_INVOICE ON PBI_MRN = PBD_MRN AND PBI_INV_NO = PBD_INV_NO JOIN IDB.PBD_DX ON DX_MRN = PBI_MRN AND DX_INV_NO = PBI_INV_NO JOIN IDB.CLM ON DX_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD LEFT JOIN IDB.DOC ON PBI_PERFORM_DR_NO = DOC_DR_NO WHERE APPT_DTE = PBD_SVC_DTE AND RES_ID = PBI_PERFORM_DR_NO ) SELECT DISTINCT MRN, LAST_NAME, FIRST_NAME, APPT_DTE, VT_NAME, PROVIDER, DEPT, SITE, CLM_CLSF_CD AS DX_CODE, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS DX_DESC FROM APPTS LEFT JOIN PBD ON MRN = PBD_MRN AND PBD_SVC_DTE = APPT_DTE AND RES_ID = PBI_PERFORM_DR_NO ORDER BY 4, 1 ; WITH APPTS AS (SELECT DISTINCT CPE_ENC_DTE AS APPT_DTE, TIME(CPE_APPT_DT) AS APPT_TIME, CPE_MRN AS MRN, CL_LAST_NAME AS LAST_NAME, CL_FIRST_NAME AS FIRST_NAME, YEAR (CPE_ENC_DTE - CL_DATE_OF_BIRTH) AS AGE, CLD_CLD_CENTER AS SITE, CLD_DEPT_NAME AS DEPT, A.CRE_RES_NAME AS PROVIDER, A.CRE_RES_ID AS RES_ID, CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME AS VT_NAME, CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID, CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR, CPE_ENC_CSN_ID AS CSN FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID AND NOT CLD_CLD_CENTER IN ('KOCH') AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 IN ('MED') AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 = 'THR' JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE A ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = A.CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID AND (CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR LIKE '%NV%' OR CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR LIKE '%IR%') JOIN IDB.CL_PATIENT ON CPE_PRK = CL_PRK WHERE 1=1 AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN LAST_DAY(CURRENT DATE - 2 MONTH) + 1 DAY AND LAST_DAY(CURRENT DATE - 1 MONTH) AND CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') ) , PBD AS (SELECT DISTINCT PBD_MRN, PBD_SVC_DTE, PBI_PERFORM_DR_NO, CLM_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK FROM APPTS JOIN IDB.PBD_DTL ON MRN = PBD_MRN JOIN IDB.PBD_INVOICE ON PBI_MRN = PBD_MRN AND PBI_INV_NO = PBD_INV_NO JOIN IDB.PBD_DX ON DX_MRN = PBI_MRN AND DX_INV_NO = PBI_INV_NO JOIN IDB.CLM ON DX_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD LEFT JOIN IDB.DOC ON PBI_PERFORM_DR_NO = DOC_DR_NO WHERE APPT_DTE = PBD_SVC_DTE AND RES_ID = PBI_PERFORM_DR_NO ) SELECT DISTINCT MRN, LAST_NAME, FIRST_NAME, APPT_DTE, VT_NAME, PROVIDER, DEPT, SITE, CLM_CLSF_CD AS DX_CODE, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS DX_DESC FROM APPTS LEFT JOIN PBD ON MRN = PBD_MRN AND PBD_SVC_DTE = APPT_DTE AND RES_ID = PBI_PERFORM_DR_NO ORDER BY 4, 1

prompt: Provide a list of patients who had a stem cell harvest between 1/1/2016 and 5/31/2019 and a diagnosis of multiple myeloma
completion: WITH PTS AS (SELECT PBD_MRN MRN, PBD_SVC_DTE SVC_DTE FROM IDB.PBD_DTL_CHARGES JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PT_MRN = PBD_MRN JOIN IDB.PBD_CODE ON PBD_PBD_CD = PBC_PBD_CD JOIN IDB.PBD_INVOICE ON PBD_MRN = PBD_MRN AND PBD_INV_NO = PBI_INV_NO AND PBD_ACCT_NO = PBI_ACCT_NO JOIN IDB.PBD_DX ON PBI_MRN = DX_MRN AND PBI_ACCT_NO = DX_ACCT_NO AND PBI_INV_NO = DX_INV_NO JOIN IDB.CLM ON DX_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE PBD_SVC_DTE BETWEEN '2016-01-01' AND '2019-05-31' AND PBC_CPT_CD IN('38230') UNION SELECT SSE_MRN MRN, SSE_SURG_DTE SVC_DTE FROM IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE ON SSE_LOG_ID = SSP_LOG_ID JOIN IDB.OR_CASE ON OC_CASE_ID = SSE_LOG_ID WHERE SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD = '38230' AND SSE_SURG_DTE BETWEEN '2016-01-01' AND '2019-05-31' UNION SELECT CDD_MRN MRN, CDD_SERVICE_DTE SVC_DTE FROM IDB.CD_DOCUMENT WHERE CDD_DOC_NAME = 'Operative Report - Bone Marrow Harvesting' AND CDD_CANCEL_IND <> '1' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND <> '1' AND CDD_SERVICE_DTE BETWEEN '2016-01-01' AND '2019-05-31' UNION SELECT CDD_MRN MRN, CDD_SERVICE_DTE SVC_DTE FROM IDB.CD_DOCUMENT LEFT JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION ON CDD_DOC_GUID = CDO_DOC_GUID WHERE CDD_DOC_NAME = 'Procedure Note - Lab Medicine' AND CDO_ITEM_NAME IN ('Procedure Performed', 'Lab Med_Donor Room_Procedure Performed_RES') AND CDO_VALUE_TEXT IN ('AUTO HEMATOPOIETIC PROGENITOR CELLS, APHERESIS (HPC-A) COLLECTION') AND CDD_CANCEL_IND <> '1' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND <> '1' AND CDD_SERVICE_DTE BETWEEN '2016-01-01' AND '2019-05-31' UNION SELECT EAD_MRN MRN, EAD_DOCUMENT_DTE SVC_DTE FROM IDB.EMR_AA_DOCUMENT JOIN IDB.EMR_AA_DOCTYPE ON EAD_DOCTYPE = EADT_DOCTYPE WHERE VALUE(EAD_RIGHT_ID, EADT_RIGHT_ID) = 167 AND EADT_CATEGORY = 'Flowsheet/Meds' AND EADT_EMR_DESC ='Apheresis Procedure Record' AND EAD_DOCUMENT_DTE BETWEEN '2016-01-01' AND '2019-05-31' ) SELECT MRN, PT_LAST_NAME "Last Name", PT_FIRST_NAME "First Name", SVC_DTE "Collection Date", CATEGORY1 "Diagnosis", TM_DX_DTE "Tumor Dx Date", TRANSPLANT_TYPE "Transplant Type", TRANSPLANT_DATE "Transplant Date" FROM PTS JOIN IDB.CDB_TUMOR ON MRN = TM_MRN JOIN DV.SEERGROUPING ON DV.SEERF_ICDO(TM_SITE_CD, TM_HIST_CD) = RECODE LEFT JOIN NN.CRDB_BMT_MEDICINE C ON MRN = C.PT_MRN JOIN IDB.PATIENT P ON MRN = P.PT_MRN WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND CATEGORY1 = 'Myeloma'

prompt:
A list of H- and S- cases with report dates from 01/01/2022-present with diagnosis containing has any of the following search terms: "Hairy cell leukemia" 

The specimens submitted section has any of the following search terms: "Peripheral blood"
completion: WITH PATHREPORT AS (SELECT DISTINCT DMP.PRPT_MRN AS MRN, PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID AS PID , PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_BIRTH_DTE, PT_VITAL_STATUS, PT_DEATH_DTE , CASE WHEN PT_DEATH_DTE IS NULL THEN YEAR(CURRENT date - PT_BIRTH_DTE) END AS "Current Age" , DMP.PRPT_ACCESSION_NO AS "Accession No" , DMP.PRPT_REPORT_DTE AS "Report Date" , DMP.PRPT_PROCEDURE_DTE AS "Procedure Date" , DMP.PRPT_REPORT_TYPE_DESC AS "Report Type" , DMP.PRPT_REPORT_TYPE , DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)diag[\w\W]*(?=I ATTEST)', DMP.PRPT_REPORT) AS DIAGNOSIS , VARCHAR(DMP.PRPT_REPORT, 32000) AS "Report Text (first 32000 characters)" , UPPER(DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)SPECIMENS( )*SUBMITTED[\w\W]*(?=DIAGNOSIS:)', VARCHAR(DMP.PRPT_REPORT, 30000))) AS "SPECIMENS SUBMITTED" , SRG.PRPT_ACCESSION_NO AS RELATED_ACC_NO , SRG_DATE.DT_DTE AS RELATED_PROC_DTE , (SELECT VARCHAR(PRPT_REPORT, 32000) AS REFERENCEDPATHTEXTFROM FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT WHERE PRPT_ACCESSION_NO = SRG.PRPT_ACCESSION_NO) AS REFERENCEDPATHTEXT FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V DMP LEFT JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_REFERENCES ON PRPTR_CHILD_PATH_RPT_ID = DMP.PRPT_PATH_RPT_ID LEFT JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT SRG ON SRG.PRPT_PATH_RPT_ID = PRPTR_PATH_RPT_ID LEFT JOIN DV.DATE_V SRG_DATE ON SRG_DATE.DT_DATE_ID = SRG.PRPT_PROCEDURE_DATE_ID JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = DMP.PRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID WHERE 1=1 AND SUBSTR(DMP.PRPT_ACCESSION_NO, 1, 1) IN ('H', 'S') AND (DMP.PRPT_REPORT_DTE >= '01/01/2022' OR DMP.PRPT_PROCEDURE_DTE >= '01/01/2022') AND CONTAINS(DMP.PRPT_REPORT, '("hairy cell leukemia")') = 1 AND DMP.PRPT_REPORT IS NOT NULL ORDER BY 1, 9, 8) , DX AS (SELECT * FROM PATHREPORT WHERE(UPPER(DIAGNOSIS) LIKE '%HAIRY CELL LEUKEMIA%')) , SS AS (SELECT * FROM DX WHERE "SPECIMENS SUBMITTED" LIKE '%PERIPHERAL%BLOOD%' ) SELECT * FROM SS ORDER BY 1, 10

prompt: Update AMB10079 report that displays daily IP and OP discharges from GMT Service.
completion: SELECT OCV_MRN, OCV_ACCT_NO, OCV_VISIT_DTE, OCV_ADM_DT, OCV_DSCH_DT , OCV_VISIT_STS, OCV_IP_OP_IND, OCV_CARE_LVL , OCV_CURR_LOC, OCV_PVDR_NAME, OS_SVC_GRP_CD, OS_SVC_DESC , PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME FROM IDB.OMS_CLIENT_VISIT JOIN IDB.OMS_SERVICE ON OCV_SVC_GUID = OS_SVC_GUID JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT ON OCV_MRN = SSE_MRN AND SSE_SURG_DTE = OCV_VISIT_DTE JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PT_MRN = OCV_MRN WHERE OCV_VISIT_DTE = CURRENT DATE - 1 DAY AND OS_SVC_GRP_CD = 'GMT' AND OCV_IP_OP_IND = 'O' UNION ALL SELECT OCV_MRN, OCV_ACCT_NO, OCV_VISIT_DTE, OCV_ADM_DT, OCV_DSCH_DT , OCV_VISIT_STS, OCV_IP_OP_IND, OCV_CARE_LVL , OCV_CURR_LOC, OCV_PVDR_NAME, OS_SVC_GRP_CD, OS_SVC_DESC , PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME FROM (SELECT OCV_MRN, OCV_ACCT_NO, OCV_VISIT_DTE, OCV_ADM_DT, OCV_DSCH_DT , OCV_VISIT_STS, OCV_IP_OP_IND, OCV_CARE_LVL , OCV_CURR_LOC, OCV_PVDR_NAME, OS_SVC_GRP_CD, OS_SVC_DESC , PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME , ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY OCV_MRN, OCV_ACCT_NO, OCV_VISIT_DTE ORDER BY OCV_MRN, OCV_ACCT_NO, OCV_VISIT_DTE, OCV_DSCH_DT DESC) RN FROM IDB.OMS_CLIENT_VISIT JOIN IDB.OMS_SERVICE ON OCV_SVC_GUID = OS_SVC_GUID JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PT_MRN = OCV_MRN WHERE OCV_VISIT_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT DATE - 6 MONTH AND CURRENT DATE AND OS_SVC_GRP_CD = 'GMT' AND OCV_IP_OP_IND = 'I' AND DATE(OCV_DSCH_DT) = CURRENT DATE - 1 DAY ) IP WHERE RN = 1

prompt: Working to create a tool to assess acuity levels in solid tumor medicine inpatients. By creating a functional tool it will help us to improve staffing models
completion: WITH IP AS (SELECT DISTINCT VIS_MRN, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH "DATE OF BIRTH", CASE WHEN PT_DATE_OF_DEATH IS NULL THEN YEAR(CURRENT DATE) - YEAR(PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) ELSE YEAR(PT_DATE_OF_DEATH) - YEAR(PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) END AS AGE, VIS_HOSP_SVC "Service", HOSP_SVC_DESC "Service Desc", MIN(VIS_ADM_DTE) "Admitted Date" FROM IDB.VISIT_V JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON VIS_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE VIS_IP_OP_ADJUSTED_IND = 'I' AND VIS_HOSP_SVC IN ('BMS', 'BRM', 'GIA', 'GIB', 'GIC', 'GID', 'GMO', 'GTL', 'GUO', 'HMA', 'HMB', 'HMS', 'HNM', 'LUN', 'SAR', 'SOL', 'STG', 'STP', 'STR') GROUP BY VIS_MRN, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, CASE WHEN PT_DATE_OF_DEATH IS NULL THEN YEAR(CURRENT DATE) - YEAR(PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) ELSE YEAR(PT_DATE_OF_DEATH) - YEAR(PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) END, VIS_HOSP_SVC, HOSP_SVC_DESC HAVING MIN(VIS_ADM_DTE) >= CURRENT date - 8 MONTH), GRP AS (SELECT DISTINCT CDD_MRN AS GRP_MRN, CDD_DOC_NAME AS GRP_DOC FROM IP JOIN IDB.CD_DOCUMENT ON CDD_MRN = VIS_MRN WHERE CDD_DOC_NAME IN ('Initial Evaluation, Adult Team - Critical Care', 'Initial Evaluation, Adult Team-Critical Care', 'Nursing Event Note - Inpatient-RRT RN') ) , SERV AS (SELECT DISTINCT CDD_MRN AS SERV_MRN , COUNT(CDD_MRN) OVER (PARTITION BY CDD_MRN) AS CNT FROM GRP JOIN IDB.CD_DOCUMENT ON CDD_MRN = GRP_MRN WHERE CDD_DOC_NAME IN ('Initial Consult/Initial Visit, NP/PA, IP - DOM-Cardiology', 'Initial Consultation, IP - Cardiology', 'Initial Consult/Initial Visit, IP - DOM-Gastroenterology', 'Initial Consult/Initial Visit, NP/PA, IP - DOM-Gastroenterol', 'Initial Consult/Initial Visit, NP/PA, IP - DOM-Pulmonary', 'Initial Consultation, IP - Pulmonary-Interventional', 'Initial Consultation, IP - Pulmonary-Medicine', 'Initial Consult/Initial Visit, IP - DOM-Infectious Diseases', 'Initial Consult/Initial Visit, IP - DOM-Supportive Care', 'Behavioral Rapid Response Team - Psychiatry', 'Initial Consultation - Psychiatry', 'Consultation Note - Ethics') ) SELECT DISTINCT VIS_MRN , "DATE OF BIRTH" , AGE , "Admitted Date" , "Service" , "Service Desc" FROM IP LEFT JOIN GRP ON IP.VIS_MRN = GRP_MRN LEFT JOIN SERV ON IP.VIS_MRN = SERV_MRN AND CNT > 2

prompt: Provide a list of   patients seen at the Counseling Center in the Dept. of Psychiatry for years 2016-2021, non regional centers
completion: SELECT R.AV_DESC AS RACE, COUNT(MRN) AS NO_OF_PATIENTS FROM (SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN AS MRN FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN '2016-01-01' AND '2021-12-31' AND CLD_CLD_CENTER NOT IN ('Reg', 'REG') AND (CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 = 'PSY' OR CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 = 'PSY') UNION SELECT DISTINCT OO_MRN AS MRN FROM IDB.OMS_ORDER JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_CATALOG ON OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID = OOC_MSTR_ITEM_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_STATUS ON OO_ORD_STS_CD = OSTS_ORD_STS_CD WHERE OOC_ITEM_NAME ='Psychiatry Inpatient Consult' AND OO_ORD_STS_CD NOT IN ('CANP', 'CANC', 'AUC3') AND OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE BETWEEN '2016-01-01' AND '2021-12-31' ) B JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PT_MRN = B.MRN JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS R ON R.AV_ELEMENT = 'RACE' AND R.AV_CODE = PT_RACE GROUP BY R.AV_DESC; SELECT E.AV_DESC AS ETHNICITY, COUNT(MRN) AS NO_OF_PATIENTS FROM (SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN AS MRN FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN '2016-01-01' AND '2021-12-31' AND CLD_CLD_CENTER NOT IN ('Reg', 'REG') AND (CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 = 'PSY' OR CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 = 'PSY') UNION SELECT DISTINCT OO_MRN AS MRN FROM IDB.OMS_ORDER JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_CATALOG ON OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID = OOC_MSTR_ITEM_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_STATUS ON OO_ORD_STS_CD = OSTS_ORD_STS_CD WHERE OOC_ITEM_NAME ='Psychiatry Inpatient Consult' AND OO_ORD_STS_CD NOT IN ('CANP', 'CANC', 'AUC3') AND OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE BETWEEN '2016-01-01' AND '2021-12-31' ) B JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PT_MRN = B.MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS E ON E.AV_ELEMENT = 'PT_ETHNICITY' AND E.AV_CODE = PT_PT_ETHNICITY GROUP BY E.AV_DESC; SELECT CPP_LANG AS LANGUAGE_PREFERRED, COUNT(MRN) AS NO_OF_PATIENTS FROM (SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN AS MRN FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN '2016-01-01' AND '2021-12-31' AND CLD_CLD_CENTER NOT IN ('Reg', 'REG') AND (CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 = 'PSY' OR CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 = 'PSY') UNION SELECT DISTINCT OO_MRN AS MRN FROM IDB.OMS_ORDER JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_CATALOG ON OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID = OOC_MSTR_ITEM_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_STATUS ON OO_ORD_STS_CD = OSTS_ORD_STS_CD WHERE OOC_ITEM_NAME ='Psychiatry Inpatient Consult' AND OO_ORD_STS_CD NOT IN ('CANP', 'CANC', 'AUC3') AND OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE BETWEEN '2016-01-01' AND '2021-12-31' ) B JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PT_MRN = B.MRN JOIN IDB.CL_PAS_PATIENT ON CPP_MRN = B.MRN WHERE TRIM(CPP_LANG) <> '' GROUP BY CPP_LANG;

prompt: Provide a list of patients diagnosed with a pheochromocytoma and resected since 1980.
completion: WITH DX AS (SELECT DISTINCT "t1"."PT_MRN" AS "MRN", "t2"."PRPT_ACCESSION_NO" AS "Pathology Report", "t3"."DT_DTE" AS "Pathology Procedure Date", "t4"."DT_DTE" AS "Pathology Report Date", CASE WHEN "t3"."DT_DTE" IS NULL THEN "t4"."DT_DTE" ELSE "t3"."DT_DTE" END AS DX_DATE, "t5"."PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_DESC" AS "Pathology Report Type" FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V" "t1" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED" "t6" ON "t1"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t6"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V" "t2" ON "t6"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t2"."PRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" "t3" ON "t2"."PRPT_PROCEDURE_DATE_ID" = "t3"."DT_DATE_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" "t4" ON "t2"."PRPT_REPORT_DATE_ID" = "t4"."DT_DATE_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATH_RPRT_TYPE_LOOKUP" "t5" ON "t2"."PRPT_REPORT_TYPE" = "t5"."PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_CD" WHERE ((CONTAINS("t2"."PRPT_REPORT", '"pheochromocytoma"') = 1 AND "t5"."PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_DESC" = 'Surgical Pathology') AND "t2"."PRPT_REPORT" IS NOT NULL) ) , CDB AS (SELECT DISTINCT DX.*, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, PT_SEX, TM_DX_DTE, TM_SITE_CD AS SITE_CODE, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_DESC, TM_HIST_CD AS DX_CODE, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS DX_DESC, AV_DESC AS LATERALITY, TM_TUMOR_SIZE FROM DX JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.CDB_TUMOR ON MRN = TM_MRN AND TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND TM_HIST_CD IN ('M8700/0', 'M8700/3', 'M8700/6') LEFT JOIN IDB.CLM H ON TM_HIST_CD = H.CLM_CLSF_CD LEFT JOIN IDB.CLM S ON TM_SITE_CD = S.CLM_CLSF_CD LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS ON AV_ELEMENT = 'LATERALITY_CD' AND TM_LATERALITY_CD = AV_CODE) SELECT DISTINCT CDB.*, SSE_SURG_DTE, DAYS(DX_DATE) - DAYS(SSE_SURG_DTE) AS DAY_DIFF, SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD, SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC, SSP_LATERALITY FROM CDB LEFT JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT ON SSE_MRN = MRN AND SSE_SURG_DTE BETWEEN DX_DATE - 60 DAYS AND DX_DATE LEFT JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE ON SSE_LOG_ID = SSP_LOG_ID

prompt: Provide names of patients who were treated with first line VRd and did not receive a transplant (with high dose melphalan) between 1/2020 to 6/2021.
completion: WITH DX AS (SELECT TM_MRN AS DX_MRN, MIN(TM_DX_DTE) AS DX_DATE, TM_HIST_CD AS DX_CODE, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS DX_DESC FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM H ON TM_HIST_CD = H.CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON TM_SITE_CD = S.CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND TM_HIST_CD = 'M9732/3' AND TM_DX_DTE BETWEEN '2020-01-01' AND '2021-06-30' GROUP BY TM_MRN, TM_HIST_CD, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK UNION SELECT CC_MRN AS DX_MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS DX_DATE, CLM_CLSF_CD AS DX_CODE, CLM_CLSF_DESC AS DX_DESC FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND ((CC_PT_TYPE = 'I') OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) AND CC_CLSF_CD IN ('203', '203.0', '203.00', '203.01', '203.02', 'C90.0', 'C90.00', 'C90.01', 'C90.02') AND CC_EFF_DTE BETWEEN '2020-01-01' AND '2021-06-30' GROUP BY CC_MRN, CLM_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC) , STEMCELL AS (SELECT * FROM DX WHERE DX_MRN NOT IN (SELECT CB.CBM_MRN AS TRANSPLANT_MRN FROM DX JOIN IDB.CRDB_BMT_MEDICINE CB ON DX_MRN = CBM_MRN JOIN IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX_V A ON CBM_MRN = A.APR_MRN WHERE CB.CBM_TRANSPLANT_DTE BETWEEN '2020-01-01' AND '2021-06-30' AND A.CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME = 'MELPHALAN' AND A.APR_START_DTE BETWEEN CB.CBM_TRANSPLANT_DTE - 3 DAY AND CB.CBM_TRANSPLANT_DTE UNION SELECT CP.CBP_MRN AS TRANSPLANT_MRN FROM DX JOIN IDB.CRDB_BMT_PEDIATRICS CP ON CBP_MRN = DX_MRN JOIN IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX_V B ON CBP_MRN = B.APR_MRN WHERE CP.CBP_TRANSPLANT_DTE BETWEEN '2020-01-01' AND '2021-06-30' AND B.CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME = 'MELPHALAN' AND B.APR_START_DTE BETWEEN CP.CBP_TRANSPLANT_DTE - 3 DAY AND CP.CBP_TRANSPLANT_DTE ) ), BORTEZOMIB AS (SELECT DISTINCT APR_MRN AS VEL_MRN, APR_DRUG_NAME AS VEL_DRUG_NAME FROM STEMCELL JOIN IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX_V ON DX_MRN = APR_MRN WHERE LOWER(APR_DRUG_NAME) like '%bortezomib%' AND APR_START_DTE >= '2020-01-01' AND APR_END_DTE <= '2021-06-30' ) , LENALIDOMIDE AS (SELECT DISTINCT APR_MRN AS REV_MRN, APR_DRUG_NAME AS REV_DRUG_NAME FROM STEMCELL JOIN IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX_V ON DX_MRN = APR_MRN WHERE LOWER(APR_DRUG_NAME) like '%lenalidomide%' AND APR_START_DTE >= '2020-01-01' AND APR_END_DTE <= '2021-06-30' ) , DEXA AS (SELECT DISTINCT MRN AS DEXA_MRN, ORD_GUID, DRUG_NAME FROM STEMCELL JOIN IDB.SRX_PHARMACY_SUM ON MRN = DX_MRN WHERE LOWER(DRUG_NAME) like 'dexamethasone%' AND START_DATE >= '2020-01-01' AND STOP_DATE <= '2021-06-30' ) , VRD AS (SELECT DISTINCT DX_MRN AS VRD_MRN FROM STEMCELL JOIN BORTEZOMIB ON DX_MRN = VEL_MRN JOIN LENALIDOMIDE ON DX_MRN = REV_MRN JOIN DEXA ON DX_MRN = DEXA_MRN) SELECT DISTINCT VRD_MRN AS MRN, PT_LAST_NAME AS "Last Name", PT_FIRST_NAME AS "First Name" FROM VRD JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON VRD_MRN = PT_MRN

prompt: Create daily report of BMT patients prescribed topical steroids on or after +100 days after allogeneic HSCT
completion: SELECT "MRN", PT_NAME, DOB, SEX, RACE, ETHNICITY , "Document Name", "Service Date", "HSCT Date", "Day pre/post", "Donor Type", RX_CREATED_DATE, RX_DAYS_AFTER_HSCT, ORD_NAME, DOSE, UOM, FREQ, ROUTE, ORD_SOURCE FROM (SELECT T1."MRN", STRIP(PT_LAST_NAME)||', '||STRIP(PT_FIRST_NAME) PT_NAME , PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH DOB , PT_SEX_DESC SEX, PT_RACE_DESC RACE, PT_PT_ETHNICITY_DESC ETHNICITY , "Document Name", "Service Date", "HSCT Date", "Day pre/post", "Donor Type" , RX_CREATED_DATE, RX_DAYS_AFTER_HSCT, ORD_NAME , DOSE, UOM, FREQ, ROUTE, ORD_SOURCE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY T1."MRN" ORDER BY RX_CREATED_DATE DESC) RN FROM CTE T1 JOIN IDB.PATIENT_V ON T1."MRN" = PT_MRN JOIN COMB T2 ON T2.MRN = T1."MRN") AS A WHERE RN = 1

prompt: Esophageal Cancer Patients diagnosed between 1/1/2005 to 6/25/2020
completion: WITH GENE AS (SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN GENE_MRN FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_STRUCTURED_RESULTS_V WHERE METHOD = 'IMPACT' ) , PT AS (SELECT DISTINCT TM_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_SEX, RACE.AV_DESC AS RACE, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, PT_DATE_OF_DEATH, PLA_LST_APPT_DTE, YEAR(TM_DX_DTE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) AGE_AT_DX, TM_DX_DTE, CS.AV_DESC AS CASE_STS, TM_HIST_CD, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS HIST_DESC, TM_SITE_CD, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_DESC, TM_HIST_CD_GRADE, G.AV_DESC AS GRADE, CASE WHEN GENE_MRN IS NOT NULL THEN 'Y' ELSE '' END AS IMPACT FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS CS ON CS.AV_ELEMENT = 'CASE_STS' AND CS.AV_CODE = TM_CASE_STS LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS G ON G.AV_ELEMENT = 'HIST_CD_GRADE' AND G.AV_CODE = TM_HIST_CD_GRADE JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON TM_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS RACE ON RACE.AV_ELEMENT = 'RACE' AND RACE.AV_CODE = PT_RACE JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY ON TM_MRN = PLA_MRN LEFT JOIN GENE ON TM_MRN = GENE_MRN WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3') AND SUBSTR(TM_SITE_CD, 1, 3) IN ('C15') AND TM_DX_DTE BETWEEN '2005-01-01' AND '2020-06-25' AND YEAR(TM_DX_DTE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) >= 18 AND TM_HIST_CD IN ('M8010/2', 'M8010/3', 'M8020/3', 'M8140/2', 'M8140/3', 'M8142/3', 'M8144/3', 'M8145/3', 'M8210/2', 'M8210/3', 'M8211/3', 'M8244/3', 'M8255/3', 'M8260/3', 'M8263/3', 'M8310/3', 'M8323/3', 'M8480/3', 'M8481/3', 'M8490/3', 'M8510/3', 'M8512/3', 'M8560/3', 'M8574/3', 'M8980/3') ) , HT AS (SELECT PMH_MRN, TM_DX_DTE DX_DTE, PMH_MEASURE_DTE, PMH_WT_KG, PMH_HT_CM, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY PMH_MRN, TM_DX_DTE ORDER BY ABS(DAYS(PMH_MEASURE_DTE) - DAYS(TM_DX_DTE))) RN FROM IDB.PT_MEASURES_HX JOIN PT ON TM_MRN = PMH_MRN) SELECT PT.*, PMH_MEASURE_DTE, PMH_WT_KG, PMH_HT_CM FROM PT LEFT JOIN HT ON TM_MRN = PMH_MRN AND TM_DX_DTE = DX_DTE AND RN = 1 ; WITH DX AS (SELECT DISTINCT TM_MRN, TM_DX_DTE FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON TM_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3') AND SUBSTR(TM_SITE_CD, 1, 3) IN ('C15') AND TM_DX_DTE BETWEEN '2005-01-01' AND '2020-06-25' AND YEAR(TM_DX_DTE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) >= 18 AND TM_HIST_CD IN ('M8010/2', 'M8010/3', 'M8020/3', 'M8140/2', 'M8140/3', 'M8142/3', 'M8144/3', 'M8145/3', 'M8210/2', 'M8210/3', 'M8211/3', 'M8244/3', 'M8255/3', 'M8260/3', 'M8263/3', 'M8310/3', 'M8323/3', 'M8480/3', 'M8481/3', 'M8490/3', 'M8510/3', 'M8512/3', 'M8560/3', 'M8574/3', 'M8980/3') ) SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN MRN, TM_DX_DTE, PRPT_ACCESSION_NO, PDRX_DMP_SAMPLE_ID, PATH_RPT_DATE, PATH_PROCEDURE_DATE FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_STRUCTURED_RESULTS_V JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML ON PRPT_PATH_RPT_ID = PDRX_PATH_RPT_ID JOIN DX ON PT_MRN = TM_MRN WHERE METHOD = 'IMPACT' ORDER BY 1 ; WITH DX AS (SELECT DISTINCT TM_MRN, TM_DX_DTE FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON TM_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3') AND SUBSTR(TM_SITE_CD, 1, 3) IN ('C15') AND TM_DX_DTE BETWEEN '2005-01-01' AND '2020-06-25' AND YEAR(TM_DX_DTE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) >= 18 AND TM_HIST_CD IN ('M8010/2', 'M8010/3', 'M8020/3', 'M8140/2', 'M8140/3', 'M8142/3', 'M8144/3', 'M8145/3', 'M8210/2', 'M8210/3', 'M8211/3', 'M8244/3', 'M8255/3', 'M8260/3', 'M8263/3', 'M8310/3', 'M8323/3', 'M8480/3', 'M8481/3', 'M8490/3', 'M8510/3', 'M8512/3', 'M8560/3', 'M8574/3', 'M8980/3') ) SELECT PRPT_MRN MRN, TM_DX_DTE, PRPT_PROCEDURE_DTE, PRPT_ACCESSION_NO, PRPT_REPORT FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V JOIN DX ON PRPT_MRN = TM_MRN WHERE PRPT_REPORT IS NOT NULL AND PRPT_REPORT_TYPE_DESC = 'Surgical Pathology' AND CONTAINS("PRPT_REPORT", '("pylori")') = 1

prompt: Provide a list of endometrial cancer patients who have been treated with anti-HER2 tyrosine kinase inhibitors from 2013-present
completion: WITH DX AS (SELECT CC_MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS MIN_ICD_EFF_DTE, CC_CLSF_CD AS ICD_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS ICD_DESC FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE 1=1 AND CC_CLSF_CD IN ('182.0', 'C54.1') AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' GROUP BY CC_MRN, CC_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK ) , DX2 AS (SELECT CC_MRN BDX_MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS BDX_EFF_DTE, CC_CLSF_CD AS BDX_ICD_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS BDX_ICD_DESC FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE 1=1 AND SUBSTR(CC_CLSF_CD, 1, 3) IN ('174', 'C50') AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' GROUP BY CC_MRN, CC_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK ) , TX AS (SELECT APR_MRN, APR_START_DTE, CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME, APR_GENERIC_NAME, APR_PRESCRIBED_DOSE, APR_ROUTE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY APR_MRN ORDER BY APR_START_DTE ASC) AS RANK1, ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY APR_MRN ORDER BY APR_START_DTE DESC) AS RANK2 FROM IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX JOIN DX ON CC_MRN = APR_MRN JOIN IDB.CHEMO_DRUG_GENERIC ON APR_GENERIC_NAME = CDG_GENERIC_NAME WHERE APR_START_DTE >= '2013-01-01' AND CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME IN ('LAPATINIB', 'PYROTINIB', 'NERATINIB', 'TUCATINIB') ) , WEIGHT AS (SELECT PMH_MRN , PMH_MEASURE_DTE , PMH_WT_KG , ABS(DAYS(PMH_MEASURE_DTE) - DAYS(MIN_ICD_EFF_DTE)) AS "Date Difference" , ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY PMH_MRN ORDER BY ABS(DAYS(PMH_MEASURE_DTE) - DAYS(MIN_ICD_EFF_DTE)) ASC) AS WEIGHT_RANK FROM IDB.PT_MEASURES_HX JOIN TX ON PMH_MRN = APR_MRN JOIN DX ON PMH_MRN = CC_MRN AND RANK1 = 1) SELECT DISTINCT CC_MRN "MRN" , PT_LAST_NAME "Last Name" , PT_FIRST_NAME "First Name" , PT_DATE_OF_DEATH "Date of Death" , PMH_WT_KG "Weight KG" , MIN_ICD_EFF_DTE "Dx Date" , ICD_CD "Dx Code" , ICD_DESC "Dx Description" , MAX(CASE WHEN RANK1 = 1 THEN APR_START_DTE END) "Tx Start Date" , MAX(CASE WHEN RANK1 = 1 THEN CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME END) "Tx Start Name" , MAX(CASE WHEN RANK2 = 1 THEN APR_START_DTE END) "Tx End Date" , MAX(CASE WHEN RANK2 = 1 THEN CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME END) "Tx End Name" , CASE WHEN BDX_MRN IS NOT NULL THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS "Breast Cancer Dx" FROM DX JOIN TX ON CC_MRN = APR_MRN LEFT JOIN DX2 ON CC_MRN = BDX_MRN JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON CC_MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN WEIGHT ON CC_MRN = PMH_MRN AND WEIGHT_RANK = 1 WHERE 1=1 GROUP BY CC_MRN , PT_LAST_NAME , PT_FIRST_NAME , PT_DATE_OF_DEATH , MIN_ICD_EFF_DTE , PMH_WT_KG , ICD_CD , ICD_DESC , CASE WHEN BDX_MRN IS NOT NULL THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END

prompt: Tumor archive charges associated with all Research Non-Billable MSK IMPACT.
completion: SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN , PATH1.RPT_PAT_NAME PAT_NAME , PATH1.RVCD_SVC_DTE RAD_SVC_DTE , PATH1.RVCD_POST_DTE RAD_POST_DTE , PATH1.CHARGE_CD RAD_CHARGE_CD , PATH1.CHARGE_DESCRIPTION RAD_CHARGE_DESCRIPTION , RES.RVCD_SVC_DTE RES_SVC_DTE , RES.RVCD_POST_DTE RES_POST_DTE , RES.CHARGE_CD RES_CHARGE_CD , RES.CHARGE_DESCRIPTION RES_CHARGE_DESCRIPTION , PATH1.CHARGE_MOD1_CD AS RAD_CHARGE_MOD1 , RES.CHARGE_MOD1_CD RES_CHARGE_MOD1 , RES.RVCD_AMT RES_CHARGE_AMT FROM IDB.PATIENT JOIN IDB.RMS_VISIT_CHARGE_DTL_V PATH1 ON PT_MRN = PATH1.RVCD_MRN JOIN IDB.RMS_VISIT_CHARGE_DTL_V RES ON PT_MRN = RES.RVCD_MRN AND RES.RVCD_SVC_DTE BETWEEN PATH1.RVCD_SVC_DTE - 60 DAY AND PATH1.RVCD_SVC_DTE + 60 DAY AND RES.CHARGE_CD = 'PTH000016' LEFT JOIN IDB.RMS_VISIT_CHARGE_DTL_V RES2 ON RES.RVCD_MRN = RES2.RVCD_MRN AND RES.CHARGE_CD = RES2.CHARGE_CD AND RES.RVCD_SVC_DTE = RES2.RVCD_SVC_DTE AND RES.RVCD_AMT = (RES2.RVCD_AMT)*-1 AND RES.CHARGE_MOD1_CD = RES2.CHARGE_MOD1_CD LEFT JOIN IDB.RMS_VISIT_CHARGE_DTL_V RAD2 ON PATH1.RVCD_MRN = RAD2.RVCD_MRN AND PATH1.CHARGE_CD = RAD2.CHARGE_CD AND PATH1.RVCD_SVC_DTE = RAD2.RVCD_SVC_DTE AND PATH1.RVCD_AMT = (RAD2.RVCD_AMT)*-1 AND PATH1.CHARGE_MOD1_CD = RAD2.CHARGE_MOD1_CD WHERE PATH1.RVCD_SVC_DTE >= LAST_DAY(CURRENT DATE - 24 MONTH) AND RES.RVCD_POST_DTE BETWEEN LAST_DAY(CURRENT DATE - 2 MONTH) + 1 DAY AND LAST_DAY(CURRENT DATE - 1 MONTH) AND RAD2.RVCD_MRN IS NULL AND RES2.RVCD_MRN IS NULL AND PATH1.CHARGE_MOD1_CD = 'RS' AND PATH1.CHARGE_DESCRIPTION LIKE '%IMPACT%' AND RES.CHARGE_MOD1_CD <> 'RS' ORDER BY 1, 3

prompt: Provide a daily list of patients being referred to IR for portal vein embolization.
completion: WITH APPTS AS (SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN AS MRN, DPT.CLD_DEPT_NAME AS DEPT_NAME, MD.CRE_RES_NAME AS PROVIDER, CPE_ENC_DTE AS APPT_DTE, CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR AS VT_ABBR, CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME AS VISIT_TYPE_NAME, REF.CRE_RES_NAME AS REF_MD, REF.CRE_RES_ID AS REF_MD_ID, REFDPT.CLD_DEPT_NAME AS REF_DEPT, AV_DESC AS TM_CASE_STS, TM_DX_DTE , TM_HIST_CD, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS HIST_DESC, TM_SITE_CD, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_DESC, CPE_ENC_CSN_ID AS CSN, CPE_CPE_APPT_STS AS APPT_STS FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT DPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = DPT.CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE MD ON MD.CRE_RES_ID = CPE_VST_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE REF ON CPE_REF_RES_ID = REF.CRE_RES_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT REFDPT ON CPE_REF_DEP_ID = REFDPT.CLD_DEPT_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.CDB_TUMOR ON CPE_MRN = TM_MRN AND TM_CASE_STS IN ('3', '6', '7') LEFT JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD LEFT JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS ON AV_CODE = TM_CASE_STS AND AV_ELEMENT = 'CASE_STS' WHERE 1=1 AND CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Sch') AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT date AND CURRENT date + 30 DAYS AND CPE_DEPT_ID = 1530 AND CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR like '%IR%' ) , REFAPPT AS (SELECT DISTINCT * FROM (SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN AS REFMRN, CLD_DEPT_NAME , CRE_RES_NAME, CPE_ENC_DTE , CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR , CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME , ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CPE_MRN ORDER BY CPE_ENC_DTE DESC) AS ROW FROM APPTS JOIN IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER ON MRN = CPE_MRN AND CPE_VST_RES_ID = REF_MD_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CRE_RES_ID = CPE_VST_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE 1=1 AND CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Comp', 'Arrived') AND CPE_ENC_DTE < APPT_DTE ) AS X WHERE ROW = 1 ) SELECT MRN, DEPT_NAME, PROVIDER, APPT_DTE, VT_ABBR, VISIT_TYPE_NAME, CRE_RES_NAME AS REF_MD, CLD_DEPT_NAME AS REF_DEPT, TM_CASE_STS, TM_DX_DTE , TM_HIST_CD, HIST_DESC, TM_SITE_CD, SITE_DESC FROM APPTS JOIN REFAPPT ON MRN = REFMRN

prompt:
Patients with biopsy proven pancreatic cancer

Less than or equal to 50 years of age at diagnosis

Diagnosed since 2015 (diagnosed in 2015 and afterwards)
completion: SELECT TM_MRN, PT_FIRST_NAME "First", PT_LAST_NAME "Last", PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH "DOB", PT_SEX "Sex", YEAR(TM_DX_DTE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) "Age at Diagnosis", TM_DX_DTE "Diagnosis Date" FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON TM_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND TM_SITE_CD LIKE 'C25%' AND TM_DX_DTE >= '2015-01-01' AND YEAR(TM_DX_DTE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) <= 50;

prompt: Number of MSK employees who have received RNA (swab test) and serology (antibody) on the same day - by result.
completion: WITH CTE AS (SELECT CASE WHEN COR_ORDER_NAME IN ('COVID-19 Qualitative RNA', 'COVID-19 Rapid Qualitative RNA') THEN 'Swab' ELSE 'Antibody' END AS TYPE, COR_MRN AS MRN, DATE(COR_SIGNIFICANT_DT) AS PERFORMED_DTE, COR_SIGNIFICANT_DT, CASE WHEN LOWER(COR_RESULT_TEXT) like 'detected%' THEN 'Positive' WHEN LOWER(COR_RESULT_TEXT) like 'not detected%' THEN 'Negative' WHEN LOWER(COR_RESULT_TEXT) like 'positive%' THEN 'Positive' WHEN LOWER(COR_RESULT_TEXT) like 'negative%' THEN 'Negative' END AS RESULT FROM IDB.COVID19_ORDER_AND_RESULT JOIN IDB.COVID19_EMPLOYEE_INFO ON COR_MRN = MRN WHERE COR_ORDER_NAME IN ('COVID-19 antiBODY Qualitative IgG', 'COVID-19 Qualitative RNA', 'COVID-19 Rapid Qualitative RNA') AND COR_ORDER_STATUS_CODE IN ('RESC', 'RESF') AND DATE(COR_SIGNIFICANT_DT) >= '2020-04-29' AND (LOWER(COR_RESULT_TEXT) like 'detected%' OR LOWER(COR_RESULT_TEXT) like 'positive%' OR LOWER(COR_RESULT_TEXT) like 'negative%' OR LOWER(COR_RESULT_TEXT) like 'not detected%') ) SELECT CASE WHEN S.RESULT = 'Positive' THEN 'Swab Positive' ELSE 'Swab Negative' END AS "Swab Result", COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN A.RESULT = 'Positive' THEN A.MRN || CHAR(A.PERFORMED_DTE) END) AS "Antibody Positive", COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN A.RESULT = 'Negative' THEN A.MRN || CHAR(A.PERFORMED_DTE) END) AS "Antibody Negative" FROM CTE S JOIN CTE A ON S.MRN = A.MRN AND S.PERFORMED_DTE = A.PERFORMED_DTE AND A.TYPE = 'Antibody' WHERE S.TYPE = 'Swab' GROUP BY CASE WHEN S.RESULT = 'Positive' THEN 'Swab Positive' ELSE 'Swab Negative' END

prompt: Provide data on patients billed for intercostal nerve block and neurolysis between 2/8/2013 and 12/31/2013.
completion: WITH "cte1" AS (SELECT UPPER(MP_FULL_NM) MP_FULL_NM_UPPER, M.* FROM DV.MEDPRO_V M) SELECT DISTINCT "t1"."PT_MRN" AS "MRN", "t1"."PT_LAST_NAME" AS "Last Name", "t1"."PT_FIRST_NAME" AS "First Name", "t1"."PT_BIRTH_DTE" AS "Date of Birth", "t1"."PT_DEATH_DTE" AS "Deceased Date", "t2"."PCC_CODE" AS "CPT Procedure Code (PBD)", "t2"."PCC_DESC" AS "CPT Procedure Desc (PBD)", "t3"."MP_FULL_NM_UPPER" AS "CPT Procedure Physician (PBD)" FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V" "t1" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED" "t4" ON "t1"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t4"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."CPT_PBD_PATIENT_PROCEDURE" "t2" ON "t4"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t2"."PTX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "cte1" "t3" ON "t2"."PTX_MEDPRO_ID" = "t3"."MP_MEDPRO_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" "t5" ON "t2"."PTX_PROC_DATE_ID" = "t5"."DT_DATE_ID" WHERE ("t2"."PCC_CODE" IN ('64420', '64421', '64620') AND "t5"."DT_DTE" BETWEEN '2013-2-8' AND '2013-12-31')

prompt: Provide a list of patients with ophthalmic tumors of neurofibromatosis (NF).
completion: WITH CC AS (SELECT CC_MRN AS MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS DX_DATE, CLM_CLSF_CD AS DX_CODE, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS DX_DESC FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND ((CC_PT_TYPE = 'I') OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) AND CC_CLSF_CD IN ('237.7', '237.70', '237.71', '237.72', '237.73', '237.79', 'Q85.0', 'Q85.00', 'Q85.01', 'Q85.02', 'Q85.03', 'Q85.09') GROUP BY CC_MRN, CLM_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK HAVING MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) <= '2020-08-20') , X AS (SELECT MRN, LISTAGG(COALESCE(STRIP(DX_CODE), '') || ' | ' || COALESCE(STRIP(CAST(DX_DESC AS VARCHAR(12000))), '') || ' | ' || COALESCE(STRIP(CAST(DX_DATE AS VARCHAR(12000))), '') , CHR(13) || CHR(10)) WITHIN GROUP( ORDER BY MRN, DX_DATE, DX_CODE, DX_DESC) AS ICD FROM CC GROUP BY MRN) , Y AS (SELECT * FROM (SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN AS MRN, ICD, CPE_ENC_DTE, CRE_RES_NAME, CLD_DEPT_NAME, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8, CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CPE_MRN ORDER BY CPE_ENC_DTE DESC) AS RN FROM X JOIN IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER ON CPE_MRN = MRN JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CRE_RES_TYP IN ('Physician') AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 = 'OPH') CPE WHERE RN = 1 ) , CDB AS (SELECT DISTINCT TM_MRN, TM_DX_DTE, TM_HIST_CD AS HIST_CODE, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS HIST_DESC, TM_SITE_CD AS SITE_CODE, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_DESC FROM Y JOIN IDB.CDB_TUMOR ON MRN = TM_MRN JOIN IDB.CLM H ON TM_HIST_CD = H.CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON TM_SITE_CD = S.CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') ) , CTE AS (SELECT TM_MRN AS DX_MRN, TM_DX_DTE AS DX_DATE, STRIP(SITE_CODE) || '-' || STRIP(SITE_DESC) || '|' || STRIP(HIST_CODE) || '-' || STRIP(HIST_DESC) AS DX_CODE FROM CDB) , CTE2 AS (SELECT * FROM CTE ORDER BY DX_MRN, DX_DATE, DX_CODE) , T1 AS (SELECT DX_MRN, DX_DATE, DX_CODE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY DX_MRN ORDER BY DX_DATE) AS RN FROM CTE2 ORDER BY DX_MRN, DX_DATE) , T2 (MRN, DX, RN1) AS (SELECT DX_MRN, CAST(DX_DATE AS VARCHAR(6000))||' | '||CAST(DX_CODE AS VARCHAR(100)), RN FROM T1 WHERE T1.RN = 1 UNION ALL SELECT DX_MRN, RTRIM(CAST(DX AS VARCHAR(4000))) || ', ' || CHR(13) || CHR(10) || CAST(DX_DATE AS VARCHAR(100))||' | '||RTRIM(CAST(DX_CODE AS VARCHAR(100))) , RN1 + 1 FROM T1, T2 WHERE DX_MRN = MRN AND RN = RN1+1 ) , T3 AS (SELECT MRN, MAX(RN1) RN FROM T2 GROUP BY MRN) , T4 AS (SELECT T2.MRN, RN, DX FROM T2 JOIN T3 ON T2.MRN = T3.MRN AND T2.RN1 = T3.RN) SELECT Y.*, DX FROM Y LEFT JOIN T4 ON Y.MRN = T4.MRN

prompt: We are looking for a list of all Brentuximab Vedotin dose modifications and delays for 13-034 patients.
completion: WITH CTE AS (SELECT AC_IRB_NO, ACD_MRN, AC_LAST_NAME, AC_FIRST_NAME, AC_DOB, AC_RACE, AC_SEX, AC_CONS_DTE, ACD_REG_DTE, ACD_TX_ST_DTE , ACD_TX_END_DTE, ACD_OFF_STUDY_DTE FROM IDB.ACCRUALS JOIN IDB.ACCRUALS_DATES ON ACD_IRB_NO = AC_IRB_NO AND ACD_MRN = AC_MRN WHERE AC_IRB_NO = '13-034' AND ACD_MRN <> 'ZZZZZZZZ' ), CHEMO AS (SELECT MRN, PT_NAME, PT_AGE, CURR_LOC, ORD_NAME, ORD_GUID, DRUG_NAME, START_DATE, DOSE, DOSE_UOM, ROUTE, TIME_PRIORITY , PT_WT, PT_HT, PT_BSA , ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY MRN, DRUG_NAME ORDER BY START_DATE) RN FROM CTE JOIN IDB.SRX_PHARMACY_SUM ON ACD_MRN = MRN WHERE UPPER(DRUG_NAME) LIKE '%BRENTUXIMA%' OR UPPER(DRUG_NAME) LIKE '%DACARBAZINE%' ) , NEXT_CHEMO AS (SELECT PREV_CHEMO.ORD_GUID PREV_ORD_GUID , NEXT_CHEMO.ORD_GUID AS NEXT_ORD_GUID, NEXT_CHEMO.START_DATE NEXT_START_DATE, DAYS(NEXT_CHEMO.START_DATE) - DAYS(PREV_CHEMO.START_DATE) AS DAYS_TO_NEXT_CHEMO FROM CHEMO PREV_CHEMO LEFT JOIN CHEMO NEXT_CHEMO ON PREV_CHEMO.RN+1 = NEXT_CHEMO.RN AND PREV_CHEMO.MRN = NEXT_CHEMO.MRN AND PREV_CHEMO.DRUG_NAME = NEXT_CHEMO.DRUG_NAME) SELECT MRN, PT_NAME, PT_AGE, CURR_LOC, ORD_NAME , DRUG_NAME, START_DATE, DOSE, DOSE_UOM, ROUTE, TIME_PRIORITY , PT_WT, PT_HT, PT_BSA, NEXT_START_DATE, DAYS_TO_NEXT_CHEMO FROM CHEMO LEFT JOIN NEXT_CHEMO ON NEXT_CHEMO.PREV_ORD_GUID=CHEMO.ORD_GUID ORDER BY MRN, DRUG_NAME, START_DATE ;

prompt: Create a report of patients identified from a DAVInCI query for an Ileal-Ureter Cystoplasty project.
Create a new Notification for study 21-389
completion: WITH PTS AS (SELECT PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID PID FROM DV.PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED) , DT_1 AS (SELECT PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID AS P_ID FROM DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS REC LEFT JOIN DV.PATIENT_CORE_DEMOGRAPHICS ON PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = CORE_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID WHERE 1 = 1) , DT_2 AS (SELECT DISTINCT PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID AS P_ID FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML INNER JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML_SETTINGS ON PDRX_PATH_DMP_RESULTS_XML_ID = PDRXS_PATH_DMP_RESULTS_XML_ID INNER JOIN DVDMC.PATHOLOGY_DMP_WEBSVC_SETTINGS ON PDRXS_SETTING_ID = PDWS_SETTING_ID INNER JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON PDRX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID , XMLTABLE('$c/root/*' PASSING PDRX_XML_VALUE AS "c" COLUMNS SITE1_GENE VARCHAR(100) PATH 'site1_gene', SITE2_GENE VARCHAR(100) PATH 'site2_gene', GENE_ID VARCHAR(100) PATH 'gene_id', AA_CHANGE VARCHAR(100) PATH 'aa_change', TUMOR_TYPE_CODE VARCHAR(100) PATH '../meta-data/tumor_type_code', TUMOR_TYPE_NAME VARCHAR(255) PATH '../meta-data/tumor_type_name') T JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT T.TUMOR_TYPE_CODE TTC FROM TABLE(DV.STRING_SPLIT('COADREAD', ',')) S CROSS JOIN TABLE(DV.ONCOTREE_CHILDREN(TRIM(COLUMN_VALUES))) T) X ON T.TUMOR_TYPE_CODE = X.TTC WHERE (SITE1_GENE IN ('KRAS') OR SITE2_GENE IN ('KRAS') OR GENE_ID IN ('KRAS')) AND LOCATE('G12C', AA_CHANGE) >= 1) , DT_3 AS (SELECT PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID AS P_ID FROM DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS REC LEFT JOIN DV.PATIENT_CORE_DEMOGRAPHICS ON PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = CORE_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID WHERE 1 = 1 AND PT_VITAL_STATUS IN ('ALIVE')) , DT_4 AS (SELECT PENC_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID AS P_ID FROM (SELECT PENC_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID , TRIM(ENDP_SERVICE_DEPT_GRP_6) DEPT_GRP_6 , TRIM(ENDP_SVC_CLINIC_SUB_DEPT_GRP_7) DIV_GRP_7 , TRIM(ENDP_SERVICE_SPECIALTY_GRP_8) RPT_GRP_8 , TRIM(ENDP_CENTER_FULL_NAME) CENTER_FULL_NAME , TRIM(ENDP_DEPT_NAME) DEPT_NAME , TRIM(T2.EDC_DEPT_DESC) APPT_STATUS_DESC , CASE WHEN ENVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR like '%NV%' THEN 'New Visit' WHEN ENVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR like '%IR%' THEN 'Internal Referral' ELSE 'Non-New Visit/Interal Referral' END AS IRNV_IND , PENC_ENC_DT , PENC_MODIFIED_DT FROM DV.PATIENT_ENCOUNTER T6 INNER JOIN DV.ENCOUNTER_SCHD_RESOURCES SR ON T6.PENC_PT_ENC_ID = SR.ENSR_PT_ENC_ID INNER JOIN DV.ENCOUNTER_RESOURCE ER ON SR.ENSR_RES_ID = ER.ENR_ENC_RES_ID INNER JOIN DV.ENCOUNTER_VISIT_TYPE EVT ON T6.PENC_VISIT_TYPE_ID = EVT.ENVT_ENC_VISIT_TYPE_ID INNER JOIN DV.ENCOUNTER_DESC_CATALOG T2 ON EDC_GROUP_ID = 'STS' AND T6.PENC_APPT_STS = T2.EDC_DEPT_ABBREV INNER JOIN DV.ENCOUNTER_DEPARTMENT T3 ON T6.PENC_DEPT_ID = T3.ENDP_ENC_DEPT_ID INNER JOIN DV.DATE_V REC ON T6.PENC_ENC_DATE_ID = REC.DT_DATE_ID WHERE 1 = 1 AND ((T2.EDC_DEPT_DESC IN ('Completed', 'Scheduled') AND DT_DTE <= CURRENT date + (7 - (DAYOFWEEK_ISO(CURRENT date))) DAYS AND DT_DTE >= CURRENT date - (DAYOFWEEK_ISO(CURRENT date) - 1) DAYS) OR (T2.EDC_DEPT_DESC IN ('Completed') AND DT_DTE >= DATE('2021-12-15') )) ) T WHERE 1 = 1) , DEID AS (SELECT DISTINCT P_ID FROM (SELECT P_ID FROM DT_1 INTERSECT SELECT P_ID FROM DT_2 INTERSECT SELECT P_ID FROM DT_3 INTERSECT SELECT P_ID FROM DT_4 ))

prompt: Provide a weekly list of urine cytology specimens that have urothelial carcinoma.
completion: WITH X AS (SELECT DISTINCT "t1"."PT_MRN" AS "MRN", "t2"."PRPT_ACCESSION_NO" AS "Pathology Report", "t3"."DT_DTE" AS "Pathology Procedure Date", "t4"."PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_DESC" AS "Pathology Report Type" FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V" "t1" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED" "t5" ON "t1"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t5"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V" "t2" ON "t5"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t2"."PRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" "t3" ON "t2"."PRPT_PROCEDURE_DATE_ID" = "t3"."DT_DATE_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATH_RPRT_TYPE_LOOKUP" "t4" ON "t2"."PRPT_REPORT_TYPE" = "t4"."PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_CD" WHERE CONTAINS("t2"."PRPT_REPORT", '("high-grade urothelial carcinoma" OR "high grade urothelial carcinoma")') = 1 AND "t3"."DT_DTE" >= '2021-10-1' AND "t4"."PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_DESC" IN ('Cytology-Non GYN', 'Cytology-Private Non-GYN') AND "t2"."PRPT_REPORT" IS NOT NULL ) , Y AS (SELECT DISTINCT "t1"."PT_MRN" AS "MRN", "t2"."PRPT_ACCESSION_NO" AS "Pathology Report", "t3"."DT_DTE" AS "Pathology Procedure Date", "t4"."PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_DESC" AS "Pathology Report Type" FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V" "t1" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED" "t5" ON "t1"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t5"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V" "t2" ON "t5"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t2"."PRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" "t3" ON "t2"."PRPT_PROCEDURE_DATE_ID" = "t3"."DT_DATE_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATH_RPRT_TYPE_LOOKUP" "t4" ON "t2"."PRPT_REPORT_TYPE" = "t4"."PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_CD" WHERE CONTAINS("t2"."PRPT_REPORT", '("negative for high-grade urothelial carcinoma" OR "negative for high grade urothelial carcinoma")') = 1 AND "t3"."DT_DTE" >= '2021-10-1' AND "t4"."PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_DESC" IN ('Cytology-Non GYN', 'Cytology-Private Non-GYN') AND "t2"."PRPT_REPORT" IS NOT NULL ) , Z AS (SELECT X.* FROM X LEFT JOIN Y ON X."Pathology Report" = Y."Pathology Report" WHERE Y."Pathology Report" IS NULL ) SELECT DISTINCT Z.* FROM Z JOIN IDB.ACCRUALS ON MRN = AC_MRN AND AC_IRB_NO IN ('06-107', '12-245')

completion: WITH PREP AS (SELECT OTR_RELEASE_NAME, OTR_RELEASE_DATE, OTTT_CODE, OTTT_NAME, OTTT_MAINTYPENAME, OTTT_TISSUE FROM (SELECT OTR_RELEASE_NAME, OTR_RELEASE_DATE, OTTT_CODE, OTTT_NAME, OTTT_MAINTYPENAME, OTTT_TISSUE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY OTTT_CODE ORDER BY CASE WHEN OTR_RELEASE_NAME = 'oncotree_latest_stable' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END DESC, OTR_RELEASE_DATE DESC) RN FROM DSGTOOLS.ONCOTREE_TUMORTYPE_V WHERE OTR_RELEASE_NAME NOT IN ('oncotree_development', 'oncotree_candidate_release') ) WHERE RN = 1 ), DIAGNOSIS AS (SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN, PDRX_ACCESSION_NO, PDRX_DMP_PATIENT_ID, PDRX_DMP_SAMPLE_ID, TUMOR_TYPE_CODE, TUMOR_TYPE_NAME, OTTT_MAINTYPENAME, OTTT_TISSUE, OTR_RELEASE_NAME, IS_METASTASIS, PRIMARY_SITE, METASTASIS_SITE, PART_DESCRIPTION FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML INNER JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML_SETTINGS ON PDRX_PATH_DMP_RESULTS_XML_ID = PDRXS_PATH_DMP_RESULTS_XML_ID INNER JOIN DVDMC.PATHOLOGY_DMP_WEBSVC_SETTINGS ON PDRXS_SETTING_ID = PDWS_SETTING_ID INNER JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON PDRX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID, XMLTABLE('$c/root/meta-data' PASSING PDRX_XML_VALUE AS "c" COLUMNS TUMOR_TYPE_CODE VARCHAR(100) PATH 'tumor_type_code', TUMOR_TYPE_NAME VARCHAR(255) PATH 'tumor_type_name', IS_METASTASIS VARCHAR(10) PATH 'is_metastasis', PRIMARY_SITE VARCHAR(255) PATH 'primary_site', METASTASIS_SITE VARCHAR(255) PATH 'metastasis_site', PART_DESCRIPTION VARCHAR(2000) PATH 'part_description') T INNER JOIN PREP ON TUMOR_TYPE_CODE = OTTT_CODE WHERE OTTT_MAINTYPENAME = 'Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer' ) SELECT OC_CASE_ID , OC_MRN , TRIM(PT_LAST_NAME) CONCAT ', ' CONCAT TRIM(PT_FIRST_NAME) PT_NAME , CASE WHEN OCAS_SURG_ROLE = 'Primary' THEN CRE_RES_NAME END PRIMARY_SURGEON , CASE WHEN OCAS_SURG_ROLE = 'Assissting' THEN CRE_RES_NAME END CO_SURGEON , OC_SURG_DTE , CPX_PROC_CD , CPX_PROC_NAME , OTTT_MAINTYPENAME , TUMOR_TYPE_CODE , TUMOR_TYPE_NAME FROM IDB.OR_CASE JOIN IDB.OR_CASE_ALL_PROC ON OC_CASE_ID = OCAP_CASE_ID JOIN IDB.OR_CASE_ALL_SURG ON OCAP_CASE_ID = OCAS_CASE_ID AND OCAS_PNL_NO = OCAP_PNL_NO JOIN IDB.OR_PROC ON OCAP_OR_PROC_ID = OP_OR_PROC_ID JOIN IDB.OR_CL_PROC ON OP_OR_PROC_ID = OCP_OR_PROC_ID JOIN IDB.CL_PROC ON OCP_PROC_ID = CPX_PROC_ID JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CRE_RES_ID = OCAS_RES_ID JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON OC_MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN DIAGNOSIS ON OC_MRN = DIAGNOSIS.PT_MRN WHERE 1 = 1 AND (OC_SURG_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT date AND CURRENT date + 21) AND OC_OR_CASE_STS_CD NOT IN ('2', '5') AND ((CPX_PROC_CD BETWEEN '32440' AND '32549' AND CPX_PROC_CD <> '32491') OR (CPX_PROC_CD IN ('60240', '32663', '32657', '32669', '32670', '7502999', '532480', '7532482', '7532483', '7532484', '7532486', '7532489', '7532500', '7532501', '7532502', '7532506', '7532507', '7532515', '7532657', '7532667'))) GROUP BY OC_CASE_ID , OC_MRN , TRIM(PT_LAST_NAME) CONCAT ', ' CONCAT TRIM(PT_FIRST_NAME) , OCAS_SURG_ROLE , CRE_RES_NAME , CASE WHEN OCAS_SURG_ROLE = 'Primary' THEN CRE_RES_NAME END , CASE WHEN OCAS_SURG_ROLE = 'Co-Surgeon' THEN CRE_RES_NAME END , OC_SURG_DTE , CPX_PROC_CD , CPX_PROC_NAME , OTTT_MAINTYPENAME , TUMOR_TYPE_CODE , prompt: Identify patients with mesothelioma (pleural, peritoneal, pericardial) with upcoming biopsies.
completion: WITH PTS AS (SELECT PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID PID FROM DV.PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED) , DT_1 AS (SELECT INC.PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID P_ID, PRIMARY_SITE, TUMOR_TYPE_NAME, PDRX_DMP_PATIENT_ID, PT_MRN FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_STRUCTURED_RESULTS_V INC JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML DT ON INC.PRPT_PATH_RPT_ID = DT.PDRX_PATH_RPT_ID CROSS JOIN XMLTABLE('$c/root/meta-data' PASSING DT.PDRX_XML_VALUE
