OOC_ITEM_NAME, OOC_ITEM_DESC, OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE, OO_ENTER_DTE, OO_SCHEDULED_DT, OO_REQUESTED_DT, OSTS_STS_DESC, OU_DISPLAY_NAME, OU_ORD_ROLE_TYPE, DOC_SVC, OO_REQ_DR_NO FROM IDB.OMS_ORDER JOIN DT_3 ON PT_MRN = OO_MRN JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_CATALOG ON OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID = OOC_MSTR_ITEM_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_STATUS ON OO_ORD_STS_CD = OSTS_ORD_STS_CD JOIN IDB.OMS_USER ON OU_USER_GUID = OO_PVDR_GUID LEFT JOIN IDB.DOC ON OO_REQ_DR_NO = DOC_DR_NO WHERE OOC_ITEM_NAME IN ('Pulmonary Outpatient Referral', 'IR - Referral', 'IR - Referral Protocol Biopsy', 'IR Return to Clinic Visit', 'Thoracic/Surgery Consult', 'Thoracic Surgery Inpatient Consult', 'Thoracic Surgery Outpatient Follow Up Visit', 'Pulmonary Outpatient Referral', 'Pulmonary Outpatient Follow up Visit', 'Interventional Pulmonology Outpatient Referral (Pulmonary Outpatient Referral)') AND OO_ORD_STS_CD NOT IN ('CANP', 'CANC', 'AUC3') AND OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE >= CURRENT date - 70 DAYS ; WITH PTS AS (SELECT PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID PID FROM DV.PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED) , DT_1 AS (SELECT INC.PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID P_ID, PRIMARY_SITE, TUMOR_TYPE_NAME, PDRX_DMP_PATIENT_ID, PT_MRN FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_STRUCTURED_RESULTS_V INC JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML DT ON INC.PRPT_PATH_RPT_ID = DT.PDRX_PATH_RPT_ID CROSS JOIN XMLTABLE('$c/root/meta-data' PASSING DT.PDRX_XML_VALUE AS "c" COLUMNS PRIMARY_SITE VARCHAR(264) PATH 'primary_site', TUMOR_TYPE_NAME VARCHAR(264) PATH 'tumor_type_name' , TUMOR_TYPE_CODE VARCHAR(264) PATH 'tumor_type_code', IS_METASTASIS VARCHAR(3) PATH 'is_metastasis' , METASTASIS_SITE VARCHAR(264) PATH 'metastasis_site') T JOIN (SELECT T.TUMOR_TYPE_CODE TTC FROM TABLE(DV.STRING_SPLIT('PEMESO,PLMESO,TMESO', ',')) S CROSS JOIN TABLE(DV.ONCOTREE_CHILDREN(COLUMN_VALUES)) T) X ON T.TUMOR_TYPE_CODE = X.TTC WHERE 1=1 ) , DT_2 AS (SELECT PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID AS P_ID FROM DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS REC WHERE 1=1 AND PT_VITAL_STATUS IN ('ALIVE') ) , DT_3 AS (SELECT DISTINCT A.P_ID , A.PT_MRN , A.PDRX_DMP_PATIENT_ID FROM DT_1 A JOIN DT_2 B ON A.P_ID = B.P_ID AND A.PT_MRN = '38078693') SELECT CPE_MRN AS "MRN", CPE_ENC_DTE AS "Appt Date", CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 AS "Department", CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 AS "Service", CLD_DEPT_NAME AS "Department Name", CRE_RES_NAME AS "Provider Name", CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME AS "Visit Type" FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN DT_3 ON PT_MRN = CPE_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE 1=1 AND CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Sch') AND ((CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 = 'MED' AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 = 'PUL') OR (CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 = 'IR') OR (CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 = 'SRG' AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 = 'THR')) AND CPE_ENC_DTE >= CURRENT date ; WITH PTS AS (SELECT PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID PID FROM DV.PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED) , DT_1 AS (SELECT INC.PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID P_ID, PRIMARY_SITE, TUMOR_TYPE_NAME, PDRX_DMP_PATIENT_ID, PT_MRN FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_STRUCTURED_RESULTS_V INC JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML DT ON INC.PRPT_PATH_RPT_ID = DT.PDRX_PATH_RPT_ID CROSS JOIN XMLTABLE('$c/root/meta-data' PASSING DT.PDRX_XML_VALUE AS "c" COLUMNS PRIMARY_SITE VARCHAR(264) PATH 'primary_site', TUMOR_TYPE_NAME VARCHAR(264) PATH 'tumor_type_name' , TUMOR_TYPE_CODE VARCHAR(264) PATH 'tumor_type_code', IS_METASTASIS VARCHAR(3) PATH 'is_metastasis' , METASTASIS_SITE VARCHAR(264) PATH 'metastasis_site') T JOIN (SELECT T.TUMOR_TYPE_CODE TTC FROM TABLE(DV.STRING_SPLIT('PEMESO,PLMESO,TMESO', ',')) S CROSS JOIN TABLE(DV.ONCOTREE_CHILDREN(COLUMN_VALUES)) T) X ON T.TUMOR_TYPE_CODE = X.TTC WHERE 1=1 ) , DT_2 AS (SELECT PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID AS P_ID FROM DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS REC WHERE 1=1 AND PT_VITAL_STATUS IN ('ALIVE') ) , DT_3 AS (SELECT DISTINCT A.P_ID , A.PT_MRN , A.PDRX_DMP_PATIENT_ID FROM DT_1 A JOIN DT_2 B ON A.P_ID = B.P_ID AND A.PT_MRN = '00338640') SELECT DISTINCT P_ID, PT_MRN, PDRX_DMP_PATIENT_ID, OC_SURG_DTE, OC_SCH_DT, OC_OR_CASE_STS, OC_OR_CASE_STS_CD, OC_CASE_ID, LOC_LOC_NAME FROM IDB.OR_CASE JOIN IDB.OR_CASE_ALL_PROC ON OC_CASE_ID = OCAP_CASE_ID JOIN IDB.OR_CASE_ALL_SURG ON OCAP_CASE_ID = OCAS_CASE_ID AND OCAS_PNL_NO = OCAP_PNL_NO AND OCAS_SURG_ROLE = 'Primary' JOIN IDB.OR_PROC ON OCAP_OR_PROC_ID = OP_OR_PROC_ID JOIN IDB.OR_CL_PROC ON OP_OR_PROC_ID = OCP_OR_PROC_ID JOIN IDB.CL_PROC ON OCP_PROC_ID = CPX_PROC_ID JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CRE_RES_ID = OCAS_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_LOCATION ON OC_SURG_LOC_ID = LOC_LOC_ID JOIN DT_3 ON OC_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE OC_MRN <> '' AND OC_OR_CASE_STS_CD NOT IN ('2', '5') AND OC_SURG_DTE >= CURRENT date AND (LOC_LOC_NAME not like '%IR%' AND LOC_LOC_NAME not like '%ENDO%')

prompt: Provide the number of patients with specified CPT codes performed by a Head and Neck physician during Feb-Apr 2012, broken down by month, day of week, and physician.
completion: SELECT MONTH(PBD_SVC_DTE) AS MO, DOC_NAME, COUNT(*) AS COUNT FROM IDB.PBD_DTL JOIN IDB.PBD_CODE ON PBD_PBD_CD = PBC_PBD_CD JOIN IDB.PBD_INVOICE ON PBI_INV_NO = PBD_INV_NO JOIN IDB.DOC ON PBI_PERFORM_DR_NO = DOC_DR_NO WHERE PBC_CPT_CD IN ('31231', '31535', '31570', '31575') AND PBD_SVC_DTE BETWEEN '2012-02-01' AND '2012-04-30' AND DOC_NAME IN ('BOYLE JAY O', 'GANLY IAN', 'KRAUS DENNIS H', 'PATEL SNEHAL', 'SHAH JATIN P', 'SHAHA ASHOK R', 'SINGH BHUVANESH', 'WONG RICHARD J') GROUP BY MONTH(PBD_SVC_DTE), DOC_NAME

prompt: Provide demographic and chemotherapy info for patients enrolled on IRB: 04-020.
completion: WITH CTE AS (SELECT AC_IRB_NO AS IRB_NO , AC_MRN AS MRN , AC_CONS_DTE AS CONS_DTE , MAX(ACD_OFF_STUDY_DTE) AS OFF_STUDY_DTE FROM IDB.ACCRUALS JOIN IDB.ACCRUALS_DATES ON AC_IRB_NO = ACD_IRB_NO AND ACD_CONS_DTE = AC_CONS_DTE WHERE AC_IRB_NO = '04-020' GROUP BY AC_IRB_NO , AC_MRN, AC_CONS_DTE) SELECT PO_MRN MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME , UCASE(PIN_GENERIC_NAME) AS DRUG_NAME , PT_ADDR1, PT_ADDR2, PT_CITY, PT_STATE, PT_ZIP_CD, PT_COUNTRY, PT_PHONE , POD_STRT_DTE AS TX_START_DATE, CONS_DTE, OFF_STUDY_DTE , SUM(POI_DOSE) AS DOSE, POI_DOSE_UNIT AS DOSE_UNIT , COUNT(*) AS DISPENSES FROM CTE JOIN IDB.PHM_ORDER ON MRN = PO_MRN JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PT_MRN = MRN JOIN IDB.PHM_ORD_DTL ON PO_ORD_SEQ = POD_ORD_SEQ JOIN IDB.PHM_ORD_INV ON POD_ORD_SEQ = POI_ORD_SEQ AND POD_ITEM_NO = POI_ITEM_NO JOIN IDB.PHM_INVENTORY ON POI_INV_SEQ = PIN_INV_SEQ AND PIN_ATT_FLAG LIKE '%CHEMO%' WHERE POD_STRT_DTE BETWEEN CONS_DTE AND OFF_STUDY_DTE AND PO_ORD_STS <>'X' GROUP BY PO_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME , POI_DOSE_UNIT , PIN_GENERIC_NAME , POD_STRT_DTE, CONS_DTE, OFF_STUDY_DTE , PT_ADDR1, PT_ADDR2, PT_CITY, PT_STATE, PT_ZIP_CD, PT_COUNTRY, PT_PHONE

prompt: Provide tumor and demographic data for patients with advanced stage (stage III or IV) or pancreatic cancer, are at least 18 years old, are alive, and speak English.
completion: SELECT PT_MRN , PT_LAST_NAME AS "Last Name" , PT_FIRST_NAME AS "First Name" , PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH AS "Date of Birth" , PT_DATE_OF_DEATH AS "Date of Death" , CASE WHEN PT_DATE_OF_DEATH IS NULL THEN YEAR(CURRENT date - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) END AS "Current Age" , CASE WHEN PT_DATE_OF_DEATH IS NULL THEN 'Alive' ELSE 'Deceased' END AS "Vital Status" , PT_ADDR1, PT_ADDR2, PT_CITY, PT_STATE, PT_ZIP_CD, PT_COUNTRY , PT_SEX AS "Gender" , R.AV_DESC AS "Race" , E.AV_DESC AS "Ethnicity" , PLA_LST_DRVST_DTE AS "Last Dr Visit Date" , TM_DX_DTE , CASE WHEN TM_SITE_CD IN ('C250' ,'C251' ,'C252' ,'C253' ,'C254' ,'C257' ,'C258' ,'C259') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS PANCREAS_IND , TM_HIST_CD, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS HIST_DESC, TM_SITE_CD, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_DESC , CASE WHEN TM_BEST_AJCC_STG NOT IN ('', '888', '999', '88', '99') THEN TM_BEST_AJCC_STG WHEN TM_AJCC_7 NOT IN ('', '888', '999', '88', '99') THEN AJCC7.AV_DESC WHEN TM_AJCC NOT IN ('', '88', '99') THEN AJCC.AV_DESC WHEN TM_GENERAL_STG NOT IN ('', '9') THEN GS.AV_DESC WHEN TM_PATH_STG_GRP NOT IN ('', '88', '9', '99') THEN TM_PATH_STG_GRP ELSE CLIN.AV_DESC END AS "Best Stage" , CASE WHEN TM_AJCC_7 NOT IN ('', '888', '999') THEN AJCC7.AV_DESC WHEN TM_AJCC NOT IN ('', '88', '99') THEN AJCC.AV_DESC WHEN TM_GENERAL_STG NOT IN ('', '9') THEN GS.AV_DESC WHEN TM_PATH_STG_GRP NOT IN ('', '88', '9', '99') THEN TM_PATH_STG_GRP ELSE CLIN.AV_DESC END AS "Best Stage Orig" , CS.AV_DESC AS CASE_STATUS , TM_CA_SURG_DTE , CATEGORY1, CATEGORY2, CATEGORY3, CATEGORY4 , TM_CDB_SEQ_NO FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PT_MRN = TM_MRN JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY ON PLA_MRN = TM_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS AJCC7 ON AJCC7.AV_ELEMENT = 'AJCC_7' AND AJCC7.AV_CODE = TM_AJCC_7 LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS AJCC ON AJCC.AV_ELEMENT = 'AJCC' AND AJCC.AV_CODE = TM_AJCC LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS GS ON GS.AV_ELEMENT = 'GENERAL_STG' AND GS.AV_CODE = TM_GENERAL_STG LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS CLIN ON CLIN.AV_ELEMENT = 'CLIN_STG_DSCR' AND CLIN.AV_CODE = TM_CLIN_STG_DSCR LEFT JOIN IDB.SEERGROUPING SG ON IDB.SEERF_ICDO(TM_SITE_CD, TM_HIST_CD) = SG.RECODE LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS CS ON CS.AV_ELEMENT = 'CASE_STS' AND CS.AV_CODE = TM_CASE_STS LEFT JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD LEFT JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS R ON R.AV_ELEMENT = 'RACE' AND R.AV_CODE = PT_RACE LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS E ON E.AV_ELEMENT = 'PT_ETHNICITY' AND E.AV_CODE = PT_PT_ETHNICITY WHERE 1=1 AND PT_DATE_OF_DEATH IS NULL AND YEAR(CURRENT date - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) BETWEEN 18 AND 100 AND PLA_DONOT_MAIL_IND <> 'Y' AND PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH >= '1890-01-01' AND (PT_PRIMARY_LANG = 'ENG' OR PT_PRIMARY_LANG = '' ) AND TM_CASE_STS IN ('2', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND (TM_SITE_CD IN ('C250' ,'C251' ,'C252' ,'C253' ,'C254' ,'C257' ,'C258' ,'C259' ) OR SUBSTR(CASE WHEN TM_BEST_AJCC_STG NOT IN ('', '888', '999', '88', '99') THEN TM_BEST_AJCC_STG WHEN TM_AJCC_7 NOT IN ('', '888', '999', '88', '99') THEN AJCC7.AV_DESC WHEN TM_AJCC NOT IN ('', '88', '99') THEN AJCC.AV_DESC WHEN TM_GENERAL_STG NOT IN ('', '9') THEN GS.AV_DESC WHEN TM_PATH_STG_GRP NOT IN ('', '88', '9', '99') THEN TM_PATH_STG_GRP ELSE CLIN.AV_DESC END, 1, 1) IN ('3' , '4' ) OR CASE WHEN TM_BEST_AJCC_STG NOT IN ('', '888', '999', '88', '99') THEN TM_BEST_AJCC_STG WHEN TM_AJCC_7 NOT IN ('', '888', '999', '88', '99') THEN AJCC7.AV_DESC WHEN TM_AJCC NOT IN ('', '88', '99') THEN AJCC.AV_DESC WHEN TM_GENERAL_STG NOT IN ('', '9') THEN GS.AV_DESC WHEN TM_PATH_STG_GRP NOT IN ('', '88', '9', '99') THEN TM_PATH_STG_GRP ELSE CLIN.AV_DESC END IN ('3' , '3:0' , '3:8' , '3A' , '3A1' , '3A2' , '3B' , '3C' , '3C1' , '3C2' , '4' , '4A' , '4B' , '4C' , 'DISTANT METASTASES/SYSTEMIC DISEASE' , 'III' , 'IIIA' , 'IIIB' , 'IIIC' , 'IIIC1' , 'IIIC2' , 'IIIE' , 'IIIEA' , 'IIIEB' , 'IIIESA' , 'IIIESB' , 'IIINOS' , 'IIISA' , 'IIISB' , 'IV' , 'IVA' , 'IVA1' , 'IVA2' , 'IVB' , 'IVC' , 'IVNOS' , 'REGIONAL BY DIRECT EXTENSION')) AND TM_SITE_CD NOT IN ('C379' , 'C770' , 'C771' , 'C772' , 'C773' , 'C774' , 'C775' , 'C778' , 'C779') ORDER BY PT_MRN, TM_DX_DTE, TM_CDB_SEQ_NO

prompt: list of protocol patients who are alive as of their last visit at MSK
completion: SELECT PLA_LST_APPT_DTE AS LAST_VISIT, PT_DATE_OF_DEATH, COUNT(ACD_MRN) AS PATIENT_COUNT FROM IDB.ACCRUALS_DATES JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON ACD_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY ON ACD_MRN = PLA_MRN WHERE 1 =1 AND ACD_IRB_NO = '94-018' GROUP BY PT_DATE_OF_DEATH, PLA_LST_APPT_DTE ; SELECT ACD_MRN AS MRN, TRIM(PT_LAST_NAME) || ', ' || TRIM(PT_FIRST_NAME) PATIENT_NAME, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, PT_DATE_OF_DEATH, PLA_LST_APPT_DTE AS LAST_APPT_DTE, ACD_TX_ST_DTE AS TX_START_DTE, ACD_TX_END_DTE AS TX_END_DTE, ACD_CONS_DTE AS CONSENT_DTE FROM IDB.ACCRUALS_DATES JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON ACD_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY ON ACD_MRN = PLA_MRN WHERE ACD_IRB_NO = '03-077'; SELECT ACD_MRN AS MRN, TRIM(PT_LAST_NAME) || ', ' || TRIM(PT_FIRST_NAME) PATIENT_NAME, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, PT_DATE_OF_DEATH, PLA_LST_APPT_DTE AS LAST_APPT_DTE, ACD_TX_ST_DTE AS TX_START_DTE, ACD_TX_END_DTE AS TX_END_DTE, ACD_CONS_DTE AS CONSENT_DTE FROM IDB.ACCRUALS_DATES JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON ACD_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY ON ACD_MRN = PLA_MRN WHERE ACD_IRB_NO = '12-230'; SELECT ACD_MRN AS MRN, TRIM(PT_LAST_NAME) || ', ' || TRIM(PT_FIRST_NAME) PATIENT_NAME, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, PT_DATE_OF_DEATH, PLA_LST_APPT_DTE AS LAST_APPT_DTE, ACD_TX_ST_DTE AS TX_START_DTE, ACD_TX_END_DTE AS TX_END_DTE, ACD_CONS_DTE AS CONSENT_DTE FROM IDB.ACCRUALS_DATES JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON ACD_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY ON ACD_MRN = PLA_MRN WHERE ACD_IRB_NO = '16-1643'; SELECT ACD_MRN AS MRN, TRIM(PT_LAST_NAME) || ', ' || TRIM(PT_FIRST_NAME) PATIENT_NAME, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, PT_DATE_OF_DEATH, PLA_LST_APPT_DTE AS LAST_APPT_DTE, ACD_TX_ST_DTE AS TX_START_DTE, ACD_TX_END_DTE AS TX_END_DTE, ACD_CONS_DTE AS CONSENT_DTE FROM IDB.ACCRUALS_DATES JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON ACD_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY ON ACD_MRN = PLA_MRN WHERE ACD_IRB_NO = '13-260';

prompt: Looking for any correlation between alteplase administration and CLABSI
completion: WITH ALTEPLASE AS (SELECT DISTINCT OCV_CURR_LOC, OS_SVC_DESC, OO.* FROM IDB.OMS_ORDER OO JOIN IDB.OMS_CLIENT_VISIT ON OO_VISIT_GUID = OCV_VISIT_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_SERVICE ON OCV_SVC_GUID = OS_SVC_GUID WHERE UPPER(OO_ORD_NAME) LIKE '%ALTEPLASE%' AND OO_ORD_STS_CD NOT IN ('CANC', 'CANP', 'AUC3') AND OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE >= '2018-01-01' ), CVAD AS (SELECT DISTINCT CDD_MRN, CDD_AUTHORED_DTE FROM ALTEPLASE JOIN IDB.CD_DOCUMENT ON CDD_MRN = OO_MRN JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION ON CDD_DOC_GUID = CDO_DOC_GUID AND CDD_AUTHORED_DTE = CDO_AUTHORED_DTE WHERE CDD_CANCEL_IND <> '1' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND <> '1' AND CDO_ITEM_NAME IN ('Central Venous Access Device (CVAD) Present', 'Does the patient have a Central Venous Access Device?', 'CVAD Assessment 1 Central Venous Access Device (CVAD) Present', 'CVAD Assessment 2 Central Venous Access Device (CVAD) Present', 'Central Venous Access Device Type') AND CDO_VALUE_TEXT = 'Yes' ) SELECT * FROM CVAD

prompt: Provide a daily report of all IR Referrals orders where RNB was checked or Protocol number is filled in.
completion: SELECT OO_ORD_GUID, OO_MRN MRN, STRIP(PT_LAST_NAME)||', '||STRIP(PT_FIRST_NAME) AS PT_NAME, OO_ENTER_DTE AS REQUEST_DTE, OO_ORD_STS_CD, OSTS_STS_DESC, OO_ORD_NAME ORD_NAME, OO_ORD_ID, OO_SUMMARY_LINE, OU_DISPLAY_NAME AS ENTER_NAME, OU_ORD_ROLE_TYPE ENTER_ROLE, MAX(CASE WHEN OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'RIS_Research Billing' THEN COALESCE(OUD_USER_DI_VALUE, '') END) AS RNB, MAX(CASE WHEN OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'RIS_IR-Biopsy Purpose Protocol' THEN COALESCE(OUD_USER_DI_VALUE, '') END) AS PROTOCOL FROM IDB.OMS_ORDER JOIN IDB.OMS_USER ON OU_USER_GUID = OO_USER_GUID JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON OO_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_USER_DATA A ON OO_ORD_GUID = OUD_ORD_GUID AND OO_ORD_NAME = 'IR - Referral' JOIN IDB.OMS_STATUS ON OO_ORD_STS_CD = OSTS_ORD_STS_CD WHERE OO_ORD_STS_CD NOT LIKE 'CA%' AND OO_ENTER_DTE >= '2012-09-01' AND OUD_USER_DI_CD IN ('RIS_Research Billing', 'RIS_IR-Biopsy Purpose Protocol') GROUP BY OO_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, OO_ORD_GUID, OO_ORD_ID, OO_ENTER_DTE, OO_ORD_STS_CD, OO_SUMMARY_LINE, OO_ORD_NAME, OU_DISPLAY_NAME, OU_ORD_ROLE_TYPE, OSTS_STS_DESC

prompt: Provide the number of inpatient and outpatient EMG procedures preformed by psychiatrists Michael Stubblefield, Christian Custodio and Jonas Sokolof from 1/1/09 through 6/30/09 and from 1/1/10 through 6/30/10.
completion: SELECT DOC_NAME, PBD_MRN, PBD_ACCT_NO, PBD_SVC_DTE, PBD_SVC_AMT, PBC_CPT_CD, PBC_PBD_DESC FROM IDB.PBD_DTL JOIN IDB.PBD_INVOICE ON PBI_MRN = PBD_MRN AND PBI_ACCT_NO = PBD_ACCT_NO AND PBI_INV_NO = PBD_INV_NO JOIN IDB.DOC ON DOC_DR_NO = PBI_PERFORM_DR_NO JOIN IDB.PBD_CODE ON PBD_PBD_CD = PBC_PBD_CD WHERE PBC_CPT_CD IN ('95860', '95861', '95863', '95864', '95869', '95870', '95867', '95868', '95900', '95903', '95904', '95937', '95934') AND (PBD_SVC_DTE BETWEEN '2009-01-01' AND '2009-06-30' OR PBD_SVC_DTE BETWEEN '2010-01-01' AND '2010-06-30')

prompt: A list of H- and S- cases (specimen class "HR" and "R" respectively) with "plasma cell neoplasm" in diagnosis text from 8/01/2021 to 10/31/2021.
completion: SELECT DISTINCT PRPT_MRN AS MRN , PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_BIRTH_DTE, PT_VITAL_STATUS, PT_DEATH_DTE , PRPT_ACCESSION_NO AS "Accession No" , PRPT_REPORT_DTE AS "Report Date" , PRPT_PROCEDURE_DTE AS "Procedure Date" , PRPT_REPORT_TYPE_DESC AS "Report Type", PRPT_REPORT_TYPE , DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)diag[\w\W]*(?=I ATTEST)', PRPT_REPORT) AS DIAGNOSIS_TEXT , VARCHAR(PRPT_REPORT, 32000) AS "Report Text (first 32000 characters)" FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID WHERE 1=1 AND SUBSTR(PRPT_ACCESSION_NO, 1, 1) IN ('H', 'S') AND (PRPT_REPORT_DTE BETWEEN '08/01/2021' AND '10/31/2021' OR PRPT_PROCEDURE_DTE BETWEEN '08/01/2021' AND '10/31/2021') AND CONTAINS(PRPT_REPORT, '("plasma cell neoplasm")') = 1 AND PRPT_REPORT IS NOT NULL ORDER BY PRPT_MRN, PRPT_REPORT_DTE, PRPT_PROCEDURE_DTE ;

prompt: Provide a weekly list of Genetics Appointment Request orders for the Genetics team to triage and schedule patients.
completion: SELECT DISTINCT OO_MRN AS MRN, PT_LAST_NAME AS "Last Name", PT_FIRST_NAME AS "First Name", PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH AS DOB, PT_SEX AS "Gender", DATE(OO_ENTER_DT) AS "Enter Date", OO_ORD_NAME AS "Order Name", OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE, OO_SUMMARY_LINE AS "Summary Line", OO_ORD_STS_CD AS "Order Status", OO_ORD_PRIO AS "Priority", OUO_USER_NAME AS "User Name", OUO_USER_ROLE_TYPE AS "User Role", OCV_CURR_LOC AS "Visit Location" , OO_ORD_ID AS "Order ID", OO_ORD_GUID AS "Order GUID" , OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID FROM IDB.OMS_ORDER OO JOIN IDB.OMS_PROVIDER ON OO.OO_PVDR_GUID = OP_PVDR_GUID JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON OO_MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_USER_ORDERS OUO ON OO_ORD_GUID = OUO_ORD_GUID LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_CLIENT_VISIT ON OO_VISIT_GUID = OCV_VISIT_GUID WHERE 1=1 AND OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID IN ('9000014134100730' , '9000013641100730' , '9000010362100730' ) ORDER BY "Enter Date" DESC, MRN ;

prompt: Provide a weekly list of patients with metastatic breast cancer with scheduled OR procedures or outpatient Surgery appts
completion: WITH PTS1 AS (SELECT CC_MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) METS_DX_DTE FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE SUBSTR(CC_CLSF_CD, 1, 3) IN ('C79', '196', '197', '198') AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' GROUP BY CC_MRN ) , PTS2 AS (SELECT CC_MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS BREAST_DX_DTE FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE 1=1 AND SUBSTR(CC_CLSF_CD, 1, 3) IN ('C50', '174', '175') AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' GROUP BY CC_MRN) , PTS AS (SELECT DISTINCT A.CC_MRN, BREAST_DX_DTE, METS_DX_DTE FROM PTS1 A JOIN PTS2 B ON A.CC_MRN = B.CC_MRN AND A.METS_DX_DTE >= B.BREAST_DX_DTE) , PROTOCOLS AS (SELECT PRO_IRB_NO, PRO_IRB_TITLE, PRO_IRB_STS, PRO_PROTOCOL_TYPE, AC_MRN, AC_NON_MSK_INST, AC_LAST_NAME, AC_FIRST_NAME, AC_PVDR_OF_RECORD_NAME, ACD_REG_DTE, ACD_TX_ST_DTE, ACD_TX_END_DTE, ACD_OFF_STUDY_DTE, ACD_CONS_DTE FROM IDB.PROTOCOL JOIN IDB.ACCRUALS ON PRO_IRB_NO = AC_IRB_NO JOIN IDB.ACCRUALS_DATES ON AC_IRB_NO = ACD_IRB_NO AND AC_SUBJ_ID_NO = ACD_SUBJ_ID_NO AND AC_SUBJ_SEQ_NO = ACD_SUBJ_SEQ_NO WHERE PRO_IRB_NO IN ('06-107', '06-163', '12-245') AND ACD_OFF_STUDY_DTE IS NULL ) SELECT DISTINCT CC_MRN "MRN" , LOC_LOC_NAME "Location" , OC_SURG_DTE "Procedure Date" , CRE_RES_NAME "Surgeon" , CPX_PROC_NAME "Procedure Name" FROM PTS A JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT OC_MRN, OC_SURG_DTE, OC_OR_CASE_STS, OC_OR_CASE_STS_CD, CRE_RES_NAME, CPX_PROC_NAME, OC_CASE_ID, OCAP_OR_PROC_ID, LOC_LOC_NAME, OCAS_PNL_NO FROM IDB.OR_CASE JOIN IDB.OR_CASE_ALL_PROC ON OC_CASE_ID = OCAP_CASE_ID JOIN IDB.OR_CASE_ALL_SURG ON OCAP_CASE_ID = OCAS_CASE_ID AND OCAS_PNL_NO = OCAP_PNL_NO AND OCAS_SURG_ROLE = 'Primary' JOIN IDB.OR_PROC ON OCAP_OR_PROC_ID = OP_OR_PROC_ID JOIN IDB.OR_CL_PROC ON OP_OR_PROC_ID = OCP_OR_PROC_ID JOIN IDB.CL_PROC ON OCP_PROC_ID = CPX_PROC_ID JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CRE_RES_ID = OCAS_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_LOCATION ON OC_SURG_LOC_ID = LOC_LOC_ID WHERE OC_MRN <> '' AND OC_OR_CASE_STS_CD NOT IN ('2', '5') AND OC_SURG_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT date AND CURRENT date + 7 DAYS ) B ON A.CC_MRN = OC_MRN JOIN PROTOCOLS ON A.CC_MRN = AC_MRN WHERE 1=1 AND LOC_LOC_NAME NOT IN ('WESTCHESTER IR', 'COMMACK IR', 'MONMOUTH OR') ORDER BY OC_SURG_DTE, CC_MRN ASC ; WITH PTS1 AS (SELECT CC_MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) METS_DX_DTE FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE SUBSTR(CC_CLSF_CD, 1, 3) IN ('C79', '196', '197', '198') AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' GROUP BY CC_MRN ) , PTS2 AS (SELECT CC_MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS BREAST_DX_DTE FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE 1=1 AND SUBSTR(CC_CLSF_CD, 1, 3) IN ('C50', '174', '175') AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' GROUP BY CC_MRN) , PTS AS (SELECT DISTINCT A.CC_MRN, BREAST_DX_DTE, METS_DX_DTE FROM PTS1 A JOIN PTS2 B ON A.CC_MRN = B.CC_MRN AND A.METS_DX_DTE >= B.BREAST_DX_DTE) , PROTOCOLS AS (SELECT PRO_IRB_NO, PRO_IRB_TITLE, PRO_IRB_STS, PRO_PROTOCOL_TYPE, AC_MRN, AC_NON_MSK_INST, AC_LAST_NAME, AC_FIRST_NAME, AC_PVDR_OF_RECORD_NAME, ACD_REG_DTE, ACD_TX_ST_DTE, ACD_TX_END_DTE, ACD_OFF_STUDY_DTE, ACD_CONS_DTE FROM IDB.PROTOCOL JOIN IDB.ACCRUALS ON PRO_IRB_NO = AC_IRB_NO JOIN IDB.ACCRUALS_DATES ON AC_IRB_NO = ACD_IRB_NO AND AC_SUBJ_ID_NO = ACD_SUBJ_ID_NO AND AC_SUBJ_SEQ_NO = ACD_SUBJ_SEQ_NO WHERE PRO_IRB_NO IN ('06-107', '06-163', '12-245') AND ACD_OFF_STUDY_DTE IS NULL ) SELECT CPE_MRN AS "MRN", CPE_ENC_DTE AS "Appt Date", CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 AS "Department", CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 AS "Service", CLD_DEPT_NAME AS "Department Name", CRE_RES_NAME AS "Provider Name", CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME AS "Visit Type", CLD_CLD_CENTER "Location" FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID JOIN PTS ON CC_MRN = CPE_MRN JOIN PROTOCOLS ON CC_MRN = AC_MRN WHERE 1=1 AND CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Sch') AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT date AND CURRENT date + 7 DAYS AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 = 'SRG' AND UPPER(CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_1) <> 'REG' ORDER BY CPE_ENC_DTE, CPE_MRN ASC ;

prompt: Provide a list of patients with positive BRCA result in their EMR, either via IMPACT or outside pathology. These patients should have or have had pancreatic cancer. Ideally we would like this to be narrowed to germline BRCA mutations.
completion: WITH GI AS (SELECT * FROM (SELECT CPE_MRN, CRE_RES_NAME, CPE_ENC_DTE "Date of next visit", CLD_DEPT_NAME "Department", ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CPE_MRN ORDER BY CPE_ENC_DTE ASC) RN FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE RES ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID WHERE UPPER(CPE_CPE_APPT_STS) IN ('SCH') AND (UPPER(CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8) IN ('GI') OR UPPER(CLD_DEPT_NAME) LIKE '%ST GI%') AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT date AND CURRENT date + 1 MONTH ) WHERE RN = 1 ) , IMPACT_1 AS (SELECT Y.PT_MRN, GENE, RESULT, METHOD, T.*, GI.* FROM DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS X JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_STRUCTURED_RESULTS_V Y ON X.PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = Y.PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID AND(GENE like '%BRCA%') JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML DT ON PRPT_PATH_RPT_ID = PDRX_PATH_RPT_ID JOIN GI ON CPE_MRN = Y.PT_MRN CROSS JOIN XMLTABLE('$c/root/*' PASSING DT.PDRX_XML_VALUE AS "c" COLUMNS TUMOR_TYPE_CODE VARCHAR(100) PATH '../meta-data/tumor_type_code', TUMOR_TYPE_NAME VARCHAR(255) PATH '../meta-data/tumor_type_name', PRIMARY_SITE VARCHAR(255) PATH '../meta-data/primary_site') T WHERE 1=1 AND (UPPER(PRIMARY_SITE) LIKE '%PANCREAS%' OR UPPER(TUMOR_TYPE_NAME) LIKE '%PANCR%') AND PT_VITAL_STATUS = 'ALIVE' AND METHOD = 'IMPACT' ) SELECT DISTINCT STRIP(IMPACT.PT_MRN) AS MRN, STRIP(PT_LAST_NAME) || ', ' || STRIP(PT_FIRST_NAME) AS NAME, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH AS DOB, STRIP(CRE_RES_NAME) AS "Provider", STRIP("Department") AS "Department", STRIP(IMPACT.TUMOR_TYPE_NAME) AS "Cancer Type", STRIP(IMPACT.GENE) AS "Genetic Testing Result", "Date of next visit" FROM IDB.PATIENT P JOIN IMPACT_1 IMPACT ON IMPACT.PT_MRN = P.PT_MRN WITH UR

prompt: List of pediatric patient who died from the 1st day of the month to the last day of the month
completion: WITH TABLE1 AS (SELECT CPE_MRN MRN, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_SEX GENDER, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, PT_DATE_OF_DEATH, YEAR(PT_DATE_OF_DEATH - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) AS AGE_OF_DEATH, MIN(YEAR(CPE_ENC_DTE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH)) AS "AGE_INITIAL_ENCOUNTER", PT_ADDR1, PT_ADDR2, PT_CITY, PT_STATE, PT_ZIP_CD, PT_EMAIL_ADDRESS, PT_PHONE, CPP_MOBILE_PHONE, CPP_LANG AS "LANGUAGE", PLA_DONOT_MAIL_IND FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON CPE_MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_PAS_PATIENT ON PT_MRN = CPP_MRN JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY ON CPE_MRN = PLA_MRN WHERE 1=1 AND CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CRE_RES_TYP IN ('Physician') AND (CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 = ('PED') OR CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_4 = ('PED') OR CLD_DEPT_NAME = 'ORTHOPEDICS 1275-9') AND CPE_CPE_IP_IND <> 'INPATIENT' AND PT_DATE_OF_DEATH BETWEEN LAST_DAY(CURRENT DATE - 2 MONTH) + 1 DAY AND LAST_DAY(CURRENT DATE - 1 MONTH) GROUP BY CPE_MRN, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_SEX, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, PT_DATE_OF_DEATH, YEAR(PT_DATE_OF_DEATH - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH), PT_ADDR1, PT_ADDR2, PT_CITY, PT_STATE, PT_ZIP_CD, PT_EMAIL_ADDRESS, PT_PHONE, CPP_MOBILE_PHONE, CPP_LANG, PLA_DONOT_MAIL_IND ORDER BY CPE_MRN), APPT_5PLUS AS (SELECT CPE_MRN AS "MRN", CPE_ENC_DTE AS "Appt Date", CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 AS "Department", CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 AS "Service", CLD_DEPT_NAME AS "Department Name", CRE_RES_NAME AS "Provider Name", CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME AS "Visit Type", ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CPE_MRN ORDER BY CPE_ENC_DTE DESC) RN FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CRE_RES_TYP IN ('Physician') AND (CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 = ('PED') OR CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_4 = ('PED') OR CLD_DEPT_NAME = 'ORTHOPEDICS 1275-9') AND CPE_CPE_IP_IND <> 'INPATIENT' ORDER BY CPE_MRN), PRIM_DOC AS (SELECT CPE_MRN PRIM_MRN, SERVICE PRIM_SERVICE, CRE_RES_NAME PRIM_DR FROM (SELECT CPE_MRN, SERVICE, CRE_RES_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CPE_MRN ORDER BY CNT DESC) RN FROM (SELECT CPE_MRN, CAV_TITLE SERVICE, CRE_RES_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT CPE_ENC_CSN_ID) CNT FROM TABLE1 JOIN IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER ON MRN = CPE_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_CATEGORY ON CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 = CAV_ABBR AND CAV_CATEGORY = 'CLD_RPT_GRP_8' WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CRE_RES_TYP = 'Physician' GROUP BY CPE_MRN, CAV_TITLE, CRE_RES_NAME ) A) B WHERE RN = 1 ), SW AS (SELECT OCV_MRN, OP_DISPLAY_NAME SOCIAL_WORKER FROM (SELECT OCV_MRN, OCV_VISIT_DTE, OP_DISPLAY_NAME, OP_DISCIPLINE, OP_PROV_TYPE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY OCV_MRN ORDER BY OCV_VISIT_DTE DESC) RN FROM IDB.OMS_CLIENT_VISIT JOIN IDB.OMS_CARE_PROV_VISIT_ROLE CP ON OCPVR_VISIT_GUID = OCV_VISIT_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_PROVIDER ON OP_PVDR_GUID = OCPVR_PVDR_GUID WHERE OP_PROV_TYPE = 'Social Worker' ) WHERE RN = 1 ) SELECT DISTINCT TABLE1.MRN, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_LAST_NAME, GENDER, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, PT_DATE_OF_DEATH, AGE_OF_DEATH, AGE_INITIAL_ENCOUNTER, PT_ADDR1, PT_ADDR2, PT_CITY, PT_STATE, PT_ZIP_CD, PT_EMAIL_ADDRESS, PT_PHONE, CPP_MOBILE_PHONE MOBILE_PHONE, LANGUAGE, PLA_DONOT_MAIL_IND DO_NOT_MAIL_IND, PRIM_SERVICE, SOCIAL_WORKER FROM TABLE1 JOIN APPT_5PLUS ON TABLE1.MRN = APPT_5PLUS."MRN" LEFT JOIN PRIM_DOC ON TABLE1.MRN = PRIM_MRN LEFT JOIN SW ON TABLE1.MRN = OCV_MRN WHERE RN >= 5

prompt: Provide a list of all patients seen within the last 10 years that have been diagnosed with hematospermia and have had an MRI done.
completion: WITH LASTAPPT AS (SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN AS MRN , CPE_ENC_DTE AS LASTMDDATE , A.CLD_DEPT_NAME AS DEPT, B.CRE_RES_NAME AS PROVIDER, PT_LAST_NAME AS LASTNAME , PT_FIRST_NAME AS FIRSTNAME , PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH AS DOB FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT A ON CPE_DEPT_ID = A.CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE B ON B.CRE_RES_ID = CPE_VST_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CTC_CLSF ON CPE_MRN = CC_MRN AND CC_EFF_DTE BETWEEN '2003-01-01' AND '2013-11-11' AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND CC_CLSF_CD = '608.82' AND (CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PT_MRN = CPE_MRN JOIN (SELECT C.CPE_MRN AS MAXMRN, MAX(C.CPE_ENC_DTE) AS MAXDTE FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER C WHERE C.CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN '2003-01-01' AND '2013-11-11' AND C.CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Comp', 'Arrived') AND C.CPE_VST_RES_ID IN ('011080', '080127', '080630', '081174', '8808') GROUP BY C.CPE_MRN) AS X ON CPE_MRN = MAXMRN AND CPE_ENC_DTE = MAXDTE WHERE CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN '2003-01-01' AND '2013-11-11' AND CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Comp', 'Arrived') AND CPE_VST_RES_ID IN ('011080', '080127', '080630', '081174', '8808')) , LASTMRI AS (SELECT DISTINCT PBD_MRN AS MRIMRN, MAX(PBD_SVC_DTE) AS MRIMAXDTE FROM LASTAPPT JOIN IDB.PBD_DTL ON MRN = PBD_MRN JOIN IDB.PBD_CODE ON PBD_PBD_CD = PBC_PBD_CD AND PBC_CPT_CD IN ('A4643', 'C8903', 'C8904', 'C8905', 'C8906', 'C8907', 'C8908', 'D0369', 'D0385', 'G8242', 'G8243', 'L0859', 'S8042', '0159T', '01922', '3111F', '3112F', '3324F', '70540', '70542', '70543', '70551', '70552', '70553', '70554', '70555', '70557', '70558', '70559', '71550', '71551', '71552', '71555', '72141', '72142', '72146', '72147', '72148', '72149', '72156', '72157', '72158', '72195', '72196', '72197', '73218', '73219', '73220', '73221', '73222', '73223', '73718', '73719', '73720', '73721', '73722', '73723', '74181', '74182', '74183', '74185', '75552', '75553', '75554', '75555', '75556', '75557', '75558', '75559', '75560', '75561', '75562', '75563', '75564', '75565', '76394', '76498', '77022', '77058', '77059') WHERE PBD_SVC_DTE BETWEEN '2003-01-01' AND '2013-11-11' GROUP BY PBD_MRN) SELECT MRN, LASTNAME, FIRSTNAME, DOB, LASTMDDATE , DEPT, PROVIDER, MRIMAXDTE FROM LASTAPPT LEFT JOIN LASTMRI ON MRIMRN = MRN

prompt: Requesting a list of patients with Coats Disease ("non-retinoblastoma" cohort)
completion: WITH DIAGNOSIS_0 AS (SELECT "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AS PT_DEID, BASE_QUERY.PT_MRN AS PT_MRN, CAST(TRIM(BASE_QUERY.PT_MRN) AS VARCHAR) || CAST(TRIM(BASE_QUERY.DIAGNOSIS_DATE) AS VARCHAR) || CAST(TRIM(BASE_QUERY.ICD_CODES_ICD_CODE) AS VARCHAR) AS SUBJECT_ID, BASE_QUERY.DIAGNOSIS_DATE AS DIAGNOSIS_DATE, TRIM(BASE_QUERY.ICD_CODES_ICD_CODE) || '-' || TRIM("IDB"."CLM"."CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK") AS ICD_CODES_ICD_CODE_DESC FROM (SELECT "IDB"."CTC_CLSF"."CC_MRN" AS PT_MRN, "IDB"."CTC_CLSF"."CC_CLSF_CD" AS ICD_CODES_ICD_CODE, MIN("IDB"."CTC_CLSF"."CC_EFF_DTE") AS DIAGNOSIS_DATE FROM "IDB"."CTC_CLSF" WHERE "IDB"."CTC_CLSF"."CC_CLSF_TYPE" LIKE 'DF%' AND ("IDB"."CTC_CLSF"."CC_PT_TYPE" = 'I' OR ("IDB"."CTC_CLSF"."CC_PT_TYPE" = 'O' AND "IDB"."CTC_CLSF"."CC_FINALIZED_IND" = 'Y')) GROUP BY "IDB"."CTC_CLSF"."CC_MRN", "IDB"."CTC_CLSF"."CC_CLSF_CD") AS BASE_QUERY JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS" ON BASE_QUERY.PT_MRN = "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_MRN" JOIN "IDB"."CLM" ON BASE_QUERY.ICD_CODES_ICD_CODE = "IDB"."CLM"."CLM_CLSF_CD" WHERE BASE_QUERY.DIAGNOSIS_DATE BETWEEN '2013-01-01' AND '2023-06-20' AND BASE_QUERY.ICD_CODES_ICD_CODE IN ('H35.021', 'H35.022', 'H35.023', 'H35.029')), COHORT AS (SELECT PT_DEID AS PT_DEID FROM (SELECT DIAGNOSIS_0.PT_DEID AS PT_DEID FROM DIAGNOSIS_0)), COHORT_DIAGNOSIS AS (SELECT SUBJECT_ID AS SUBJECT_ID, PT_DEID AS PT_DEID FROM (SELECT DIAGNOSIS_0.SUBJECT_ID AS SUBJECT_ID, DIAGNOSIS_0.PT_DEID AS PT_DEID FROM DIAGNOSIS_0)), KEYS AS (SELECT COHORT.PT_DEID AS COHORT_PT_DEID, COHORT_DIAGNOSIS.SUBJECT_ID AS COHORT_DIAGNOSIS_SUBJECT_ID, COHORT_DIAGNOSIS.PT_DEID AS COHORT_DIAGNOSIS_PT_DEID FROM COHORT LEFT OUTER JOIN COHORT_DIAGNOSIS ON COHORT_DIAGNOSIS.PT_DEID = COHORT.PT_DEID), DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS AS (SELECT DISTINCT "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AS PT_DEID, IDB_PATIENT."PT_MRN" AS PT_MRN, "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AS SUBJECT_ID FROM "IDB"."PATIENT" AS IDB_PATIENT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS" ON IDB_PATIENT."PT_MRN" = "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_MRN"), DIAGNOSIS_COLUMNS AS (SELECT DISTINCT "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AS PT_DEID, BASE_QUERY.PT_MRN AS PT_MRN, CAST(TRIM(BASE_QUERY.PT_MRN) AS VARCHAR) || CAST(TRIM(BASE_QUERY.DIAGNOSIS_DATE) AS VARCHAR) || CAST(TRIM(BASE_QUERY.ICD_CODES_ICD_CODE) AS VARCHAR) AS SUBJECT_ID, BASE_QUERY.DIAGNOSIS_DATE AS DIAGNOSIS_DATE, BASE_QUERY.ICD_CODES_ICD_CODE AS ICD_CODES_ICD_CODE, TRIM(BASE_QUERY.ICD_CODES_ICD_CODE) || '-' || TRIM("IDB"."CLM"."CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK") AS ICD_CODES_ICD_CODE_DESC, YEAR(BASE_QUERY.DIAGNOSIS_DATE - "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_BIRTH_DTE") AS AGE_AT_ICD_CODE_DATE FROM (SELECT "IDB"."CTC_CLSF"."CC_MRN" AS PT_MRN, "IDB"."CTC_CLSF"."CC_CLSF_CD" AS ICD_CODES_ICD_CODE, MIN("IDB"."CTC_CLSF"."CC_EFF_DTE") AS DIAGNOSIS_DATE FROM "IDB"."CTC_CLSF" WHERE "IDB"."CTC_CLSF"."CC_CLSF_TYPE" LIKE 'DF%' AND ("IDB"."CTC_CLSF"."CC_PT_TYPE" = 'I' OR ("IDB"."CTC_CLSF"."CC_PT_TYPE" = 'O' AND "IDB"."CTC_CLSF"."CC_FINALIZED_IND" = 'Y')) GROUP BY "IDB"."CTC_CLSF"."CC_MRN", "IDB"."CTC_CLSF"."CC_CLSF_CD") AS BASE_QUERY JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS" ON BASE_QUERY.PT_MRN = "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_MRN" JOIN "IDB"."CLM" ON BASE_QUERY.ICD_CODES_ICD_CODE = "IDB"."CLM"."CLM_CLSF_CD") SELECT DISTINCT DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS.PT_MRN AS MRN, DIAGNOSIS_COLUMNS.DIAGNOSIS_DATE AS DIAGNOSIS_DATE, DIAGNOSIS_COLUMNS.ICD_CODES_ICD_CODE AS ICD_CODE, DIAGNOSIS_COLUMNS.ICD_CODES_ICD_CODE_DESC AS ICD_CODE_DESCRIPTION, DIAGNOSIS_COLUMNS.AGE_AT_ICD_CODE_DATE AS AGE_AT_ICD_CODE_DATE FROM KEYS LEFT OUTER JOIN DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS ON DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS.PT_DEID = KEYS.COHORT_PT_DEID LEFT OUTER JOIN DIAGNOSIS_COLUMNS ON DIAGNOSIS_COLUMNS.SUBJECT_ID = KEYS.COHORT_DIAGNOSIS_SUBJECT_ID;

prompt: Provide a list of basic characteristics of patients with ATM mutations treated with radiation therapy.
completion: SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN, STRIP(PT_LAST_NAME) || ', ' || STRIP(PT_FIRST_NAME) AS NAME, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH AS DOB, PT_DATE_OF_DEATH AS DOD, APR_GENERIC_NAME, APR_DRUG_NAME, APR_START_DTE, APR_END_DTE, APR_ROUTE, APR_ORD_RX_TYPE, APR_ORDER_SOURCE, APR_ORDER_SOURCE_ID FROM IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX_V JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON APR_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE CDG_CHEMO_FLAG = 'Y' AND APR_MRN IN ()

prompt: Provide a list of new patients diagnosed with mesothelioma who were seen by Dr. Lee Krug between 2003 and 2008.
