AND (CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR like '%NV%' OR CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR like '%IR%')

prompt: Melanoma patients who received NIVOLUMAB and IPILIMUMAB on the same day
completion: WITH DX AS (SELECT TM_MRN, MIN(TM_DX_DTE) TM_DX_DTE FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD JOIN IDB.SEERGROUPING ON RECODE = IDB.SEERF_ICDO(TM_SITE_CD, TM_HIST_CD) WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND CATEGORY2 = 'Melanoma of the Skin' GROUP BY TM_MRN) , CHEMO AS (SELECT DISTINCT APR_MRN AS MRN, APR_START_DTE START_DATE FROM IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX JOIN IDB.CHEMO_DRUG_GENERIC ON APR_GENERIC_NAME = CDG_GENERIC_NAME JOIN DX ON APR_MRN = TM_MRN WHERE CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME IN ('IPILIMUMAB') AND APR_START_DTE BETWEEN '2012-01-01' AND '2020-12-29' ) SELECT DISTINCT APR_MRN "MRN", PT_LAST_NAME "Last Name", PT_FIRST_NAME "First Name", PT_SEX "Gender", PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH "Date of Birth", PT_DATE_OF_DEATH "Date of Death", MIN(APR_START_DTE) "First Start Date", MAX(APR_START_DTE) "Last Start Date", DAYS(MAX(APR_START_DTE)) - DAYS(MIN(APR_START_DTE)) "Days Between First & Last", COUNT(*) "Number of Doses" FROM IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX JOIN IDB.CHEMO_DRUG_GENERIC ON APR_GENERIC_NAME = CDG_GENERIC_NAME JOIN CHEMO ON APR_MRN = MRN AND APR_START_DTE = START_DATE JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON APR_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME IN ('NIVOLUMAB') GROUP BY APR_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_SEX, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, PT_DATE_OF_DEATH HAVING COUNT(*) > 4 ; WITH DX AS (SELECT TM_MRN, MIN(TM_DX_DTE) TM_DX_DTE FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD JOIN IDB.SEERGROUPING ON RECODE = IDB.SEERF_ICDO(TM_SITE_CD, TM_HIST_CD) WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND CATEGORY2 = 'Melanoma of the Skin' GROUP BY TM_MRN) , CHEMO AS (SELECT DISTINCT APR_MRN AS MRN, APR_START_DTE START_DATE FROM IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX JOIN IDB.CHEMO_DRUG_GENERIC ON APR_GENERIC_NAME = CDG_GENERIC_NAME JOIN DX ON APR_MRN = TM_MRN WHERE CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME IN ('IPILIMUMAB') AND APR_START_DTE BETWEEN '2012-01-01' AND '2020-12-29' ) SELECT DISTINCT APR_MRN "MRN", PT_LAST_NAME "Last Name", PT_FIRST_NAME "First Name", PT_SEX "Gender", PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH "Date of Birth", PT_DATE_OF_DEATH "Date of Death", MIN(APR_START_DTE) "First Start Date", MAX(APR_START_DTE) "Last Start Date", DAYS(MAX(APR_START_DTE)) - DAYS(MIN(APR_START_DTE)) "Days Between First & Last", COUNT(*) "Number of Doses" FROM IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX JOIN IDB.CHEMO_DRUG_GENERIC ON APR_GENERIC_NAME = CDG_GENERIC_NAME JOIN CHEMO ON APR_MRN = MRN AND APR_START_DTE = START_DATE JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON APR_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME IN ('NIVOLUMAB') GROUP BY APR_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_SEX, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, PT_DATE_OF_DEATH HAVING COUNT(*) BETWEEN 2 AND 4 AND DAYS(MAX(APR_START_DTE)) - DAYS(MIN(APR_START_DTE)) >= 180

prompt: Provide a list of ovarian cancer patients who underwent a cytoreductive surgery with the pathology report stating: "complete pathologic response".
completion: SELECT DISTINCT "t1"."PT_MRN" AS "MRN", "t2"."PRPT_ACCESSION_NO" AS "Pathology Report", "t3"."DT_DTE" AS "Pathology Procedure Date", "t4"."DT_DTE" AS "Pathology Report Date", "t5"."PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_DESC" AS "Pathology Report Type", UPPER(CASE WHEN LENGTH(PRPT_REPORT) <= 15000 THEN RTRIM(CAST(SUBSTR(PRPT_REPORT, 1, 15000) AS VARCHAR(15000))) ELSE CAST(SUBSTR(PRPT_REPORT, 1, 15000) AS VARCHAR(15000)) END) AS TXT FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V" "t1" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED" "t6" ON "t1"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t6"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V" "t2" ON "t6"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t2"."PRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" "t3" ON "t2"."PRPT_PROCEDURE_DATE_ID" = "t3"."DT_DATE_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" "t4" ON "t2"."PRPT_REPORT_DATE_ID" = "t4"."DT_DATE_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATH_RPRT_TYPE_LOOKUP" "t5" ON "t2"."PRPT_REPORT_TYPE" = "t5"."PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_CD" WHERE 1=1 AND CONTAINS("t2"."PRPT_REPORT", '"ovary" OR "ovaries" OR "ovarian"') = 1 AND CONTAINS("t2"."PRPT_REPORT", '"chemotherapy response score 3" OR "CRS 3" OR "CRS3"') = 1 AND "t2"."PRPT_REPORT" IS NOT NULL AND "t3"."DT_DTE" >= '2006-01-01' AND "t5"."PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_DESC" = 'Surgical Pathology'

prompt: Schedule a weekly report of female breast cancer patients, 18 and older, who began chemotherapy treatment in the last 7 days, whose primary language is English.
completion: WITH X AS (SELECT TM_MRN AS MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, CASE WHEN PT_PRIMARY_LANG = '' THEN CPP_LANG ELSE PT_PRIMARY_LANG END AS LANG, PFA_FST_CHEMO_MSK_DTE, TM_DX_DTE AS DX_DATE, TM_SITE_CD AS SITE_CODE, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_DESC, TM_HIST_CD AS HIST_CODE, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS HIST_DESC, CASE WHEN TM_AJCC_7 NOT IN ('', '888', '999') THEN AJCC7.AV_DESC WHEN TM_AJCC NOT IN ('', '88', '99') THEN AJCC.AV_DESC WHEN TM_GENERAL_STG NOT IN ('', '9') THEN GS.AV_DESC WHEN TM_PATH_STG_GRP NOT IN ('', '88', '9', '99') THEN TM_PATH_STG_GRP ELSE CLIN.AV_DESC END AS STAGE FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON TM_MRN = PT_MRN AND YEAR(TM_DX_DTE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) >= 18 AND PT_SEX = 'F' JOIN IDB.PT_FIRST_ACTIVITY ON PT_MRN = PFA_MRN AND PFA_FST_CHEMO_MSK_DTE >= CURRENT DATE - 7 DAYS LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_PAS_PATIENT ON PT_MRN = CPP_MRN JOIN IDB.SEERGROUPING ON RECODE = IDB.SEERF_ICDO(TM_SITE_CD, TM_HIST_CD) JOIN IDB.CLM H ON TM_HIST_CD = H.CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON TM_SITE_CD = S.CLM_CLSF_CD LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS AJCC7 ON AJCC7.AV_ELEMENT = 'AJCC_7' AND AJCC7.AV_CODE = TM_AJCC_7 LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS AJCC ON AJCC.AV_ELEMENT = 'AJCC' AND AJCC.AV_CODE = TM_AJCC LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS GS ON GS.AV_ELEMENT = 'GENERAL_STG' AND GS.AV_CODE = TM_GENERAL_STG LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS CLIN ON CLIN.AV_ELEMENT = 'CLIN_STG_DSCR' AND CLIN.AV_CODE = TM_CLIN_STG_DSCR WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('3', '6', '7', '8') AND CATEGORY1 = 'Breast' AND CASE WHEN TM_AJCC_7 NOT IN ('', '888', '999') THEN AJCC7.AV_DESC WHEN TM_AJCC NOT IN ('', '88', '99') THEN AJCC.AV_DESC WHEN TM_GENERAL_STG NOT IN ('', '9') THEN GS.AV_DESC WHEN TM_PATH_STG_GRP NOT IN ('', '88', '9', '99') THEN TM_PATH_STG_GRP ELSE CLIN.AV_DESC END NOT IN ('DISTANT METASTASES/SYSTEMIC DISEASE', '4', 'IV', 'NO VALUE ENTERED', 'NONE', 'UNKNOWN') AND (PT_PRIMARY_LANG = 'ENG' OR CPP_LANG = 'ENG') UNION SELECT CC_MRN AS MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, CASE WHEN PT_PRIMARY_LANG = '' THEN CPP_LANG ELSE PT_PRIMARY_LANG END AS LANG, PFA_FST_CHEMO_MSK_DTE, DX_DATE, DX_CODE AS SITE_CODE, DX_DESC AS SITE_DESC, '' AS HIST_CODE, '' AS HIST_DESC, '' AS STAGE FROM (SELECT CC.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CC_MRN ORDER BY DX_DATE) AS RN_CC FROM (SELECT CC_MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS DX_DATE, CLM_CLSF_CD AS DX_CODE, CLM_CLSF_DESC AS DX_DESC FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND ((CC_PT_TYPE = 'I') OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) AND CC_CLSF_CD IN (SELECT DISTINCT CLM_CLSF_CD FROM IDB.CLM LEFT JOIN IDB.SEERGROUPING ON RECODE = MIN(IDB.SEERF_ICD9(CLM_CLSF_CD), IDB.SEERF_ICD10(CLM_CLSF_CD)) WHERE CATEGORY1 IN ('Breast') AND CLM_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'I%') AND CC_MRN NOT IN (SELECT TM_MRN AS MRN FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.SEERGROUPING ON RECODE = IDB.SEERF_ICDO(TM_SITE_CD, TM_HIST_CD) JOIN IDB.CLM H ON TM_HIST_CD = H.CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON TM_SITE_CD = S.CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('3', '6', '7', '8') AND CATEGORY1 = 'Breast') GROUP BY CC_MRN, CLM_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC ) CC) CC2 JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON CC_MRN = PT_MRN AND YEAR(DX_DATE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) >= 18 AND PT_SEX = 'F' JOIN IDB.PT_FIRST_ACTIVITY ON PT_MRN = PFA_MRN AND PFA_FST_CHEMO_MSK_DTE >= CURRENT DATE - 7 DAYS LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_PAS_PATIENT ON PT_MRN = CPP_MRN WHERE (PT_PRIMARY_LANG = 'ENG' OR CPP_LANG = 'ENG') AND RN_CC = 1 ) , GYN AS (SELECT DISTINCT CDD_MRN, CDD_DOC_NAME AS "Note Name", CDD_SERVICE_DTE, CDO_VALUE_TEXT AS "GYN History" FROM IDB.CD_DOCUMENT JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION ON CDO_DOC_GUID = CDD_DOC_GUID AND CDO_AUTHORED_DTE = CDD_AUTHORED_DTE WHERE CDD_CANCEL_IND = '0' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND = '0' AND UPPER(CDD_DOC_NAME) like '%INITIAL%' AND UPPER(CDD_DOC_NAME) like '%DOM%' AND CDO_ITEM_NAME = 'GYN History' AND(UPPER(CDO_VALUE_TEXT) LIKE '%LMP%' OR UPPER(CDO_VALUE_TEXT) LIKE '%LAST%MEN%') AND CDD_MRN IN (SELECT MRN FROM X) ) , APPT AS (SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN, CPE_ENC_DTE, CRE_RES_NAME, CRE_RES_TYP, CLD_DEPT_NAME, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8, CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CPE_MRN ORDER BY CPE_ENC_DTE DESC) AS RN_APPT FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CRE_RES_TYP IN ('Physician') AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 = 'BRE' AND(CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR LIKE '%NV%' OR CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR LIKE '%IR%') AND CPE_MRN IN (SELECT MRN FROM X) ) SELECT DISTINCT X.*, CRE_RES_NAME AS "Most Recent Attending", "Note Name", "GYN History", CDD_SERVICE_DTE FROM X LEFT JOIN GYN ON MRN = CDD_MRN LEFT JOIN APPT ON MRN = CPE_MRN AND RN_APPT = 1

prompt: List of patients in Mario Lacouture's DERM clinic at New Visit and first Follow up visit
completion: WITH FR AS (SELECT CPE_MRN AS MRN, CLD_DEPT_NAME AS DEPT, CRE_RES_NAME AS RESOURCE, CRE_RES_ID AS RES_ID, CPE_ENC_DTE AS FR_DTE, CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR AS FR_VT, CPE_ENC_CSN_ID AS FR_CSN, CPE_CPE_APPT_STS AS FR_STS FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER A JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CRE_RES_ID = CPE_VST_RES_ID AND CRE_RES_ID = '015271' JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID AND NOT CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR like '%NV%' WHERE 1=1 AND CPE_ENC_DTE >= CURRENT date AND CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Sch') ) SELECT MRN, DEPT, RESOURCE, RES_ID, FR_DTE, FR_VT, FR_STS, A.CPE_ENC_DTE, A.CPE_CPE_APPT_STS, CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR , FR_CSN, A.CPE_ENC_CSN_ID AS NV_CSN FROM FR JOIN IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER A ON A.CPE_MRN = MRN JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON A.CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID AND CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR like '%NV%' WHERE A.CPE_VST_RES_ID = '015271' AND A.CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT DATE - 1 YEAR AND CURRENT DATE AND A.CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Comp', 'Arrived') AND EXISTS (SELECT B.CPE_MRN, COUNT(B.CPE_ENC_CSN_ID) FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER B WHERE A.CPE_MRN = B.CPE_MRN AND B.CPE_VST_RES_ID = '015271' AND B.CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT DATE - 1 YEAR AND CURRENT DATE AND B.CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Comp', 'Arrived') GROUP BY B.CPE_MRN HAVING COUNT(B.CPE_ENC_CSN_ID) = 1)

prompt: List of all non-chemo medications ordered over the past 6 months that have been routed to or verified by "R5 Pharmacy - Main".
completion: SELECT MRN, PT_NAME, ORD_NAME , DRUG_NAME, DOSE, DOSE_UOM , INFUSION_RATE, START_DATE , DISP_LOCATION, DISP_SUBTYPE, CHEMO_IND, CHEMO_SUPPORT_IND FROM IDB.SRX_PHARMACY_SUM WHERE START_DATE BETWEEN '2019-04-21' AND '2019-10-21' AND CHEMO_IND = 'N' AND DISP_LOCATION= 'R5 Pharmacy-Main'

prompt: Provide dataset of IR procedures with and without e-consent used. This is an updated run of RAD24970.
completion: WITH SURG AS (SELECT DISTINCT PATIENT_MRN , PATIENT_NAME, PATIENT_SEX , COALESCE(TOES_IN_TIME_PLANNED, TOES_IN_TIME_SCHEDULED) SCHEDULED_START_TIME , FIRST_PROCED_START_TIME_ACTUAL FIRST_PROCEDURE_START_TIME , CASE_SURGERY_DTE, LOG_SURGERY_DTE , LOG_LOCATION , STRIP(SSP_SURG_LAST_NM)||', '|| SSP_SURG_FIRST_NM SURGEON, TRIM(SSP_PROC_NAME) SSP_PROC , TRIM(SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD) || ' - ' || TRIM(SSP_PROC_NAME) AS OR_PROC_NAME , COALESCE(VIS_IP_OP_ADJUSTED_IND, 'O') IP_OP_IND FROM IDB.PERIOP_CASE_EVENT_V JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE ON LOG_NUMBER = SSP_LOG_ID AND SSP_SOURCE_TYPE = 'O' LEFT JOIN IDB.VISIT_V ON PATIENT_MRN = VIS_MRN AND VIS_VISIT_STATUS IN ('2', '3') AND VIS_IP_OP_ADJUSTED_IND = 'I' AND LOG_SURGERY_DTE BETWEEN COALESCE(VIS_IN_BED_DTE, VIS_ADM_DTE) AND COALESCE(VIS_DSCH_DTE, CURRENT DATE) LEFT JOIN IDB.AN_RECORD_SUMMARY ON ARS_AN_CASELOG_ID = LOG_NUMBER LEFT JOIN IDB.OR_CASE ON OC_CASE_ID = CASE_NUMBER WHERE LOG_SURGERY_DTE BETWEEN '2021-01-01' AND '2022-10-01' AND SSP_SURG_SVC_CD = 'IR' AND LOG_OPER_ROOM_VIRT_FLAG = 'Physical' AND LOG_OPERATING_ROOM NOT LIKE '%CIGI%' AND LOG_COMPLETION_FLAG = 'Completed Case' AND (LOG_LOCATION LIKE '%WESTCHESTER%IR%' OR LOG_LOCATION LIKE '%KOCH%IR%' OR LOG_LOCATION LIKE '%WESTCHESTER%IR%' OR LOG_LOCATION LIKE '%MONMOUTH%IR%' OR LOG_LOCATION LIKE '%COMMACK%IR%' OR LOG_LOCATION LIKE '%MAIN%' ) ) , RAD AS (SELECT DISTINCT RRPT_MRN, RRPT_ACCESSION_NO , ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY RRPT_MRN ORDER BY RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE DESC) RAD_RN FROM DV.RADIOLOGY_REPORT_V JOIN SURG ON RRPT_MRN = PATIENT_MRN AND RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE = LOG_SURGERY_DTE WHERE RRPT_ORDER_GROUP ='IR' ) , EAD AS (SELECT EAD_MRN, EAD_DOCUMENT_DTE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY EAD_MRN ORDER BY EAD_DOCUMENT_DTE DESC) EAD_RN FROM SURG P JOIN IDB.EMR_AA_DOCUMENT ON PATIENT_MRN = EAD_MRN JOIN IDB.EMR_AA_DOCTYPE ON EAD_DOCTYPE = EADT_DOCTYPE WHERE VALUE(EAD_RIGHT_ID, EADT_RIGHT_ID) = 167 AND EADT_CATEGORY = 'Admin/Legal' AND EADT_EMR_DESC IN ('Consent-Dx/Therap Proc') AND EAD_DOCUMENT_DTE <= CASE_SURGERY_DTE AND EAD_DOCUMENT_DTE BETWEEN '2021-01-01' AND '2022-10-01' ) , PROC_DET AS (SELECT PATIENT_MRN AS PROC_MRN, LOG_SURGERY_DTE AS PROC_DATE, OR_PROC_NAME AS PROC_NAME , ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY PATIENT_MRN, LOG_SURGERY_DTE ORDER BY OR_PROC_NAME) PROC_RN FROM SURG G) SELECT DISTINCT PATIENT_MRN MRN, PATIENT_NAME, PATIENT_SEX SEX, LOG_LOCATION LOCATION, RRPT_ACCESSION_NO AS "Accession No", LOG_SURGERY_DTE AS "IR Procedure Date", SCHEDULED_START_TIME AS "Scheduled Start Time", FIRST_PROCEDURE_START_TIME AS "Actual Start Time (First Proc)", SURGEON AS "Surgeon Name", IP_OP_IND, EAD_DOCUMENT_DTE AS "e-Consent Date", CASE WHEN EAD_MRN IS NOT NULL THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS "e-Consent Flag", P1.PROC_NAME PROCEDURE1 , P2.PROC_NAME PROCEDURE2, P3.PROC_NAME PROCEDURE3, P4.PROC_NAME PROCEDURE4, P5.PROC_NAME PROCEDURE5, P6.PROC_NAME PROCEDURE6, P7.PROC_NAME PROCEDURE7, P8.PROC_NAME PROCEDURE8, P9.PROC_NAME PROCEDURE9, P10.PROC_NAME PROCEDURE10, P11.PROC_NAME PROCEDURE11, P12.PROC_NAME PROCEDURE12 FROM SURG S LEFT JOIN EAD ON EAD_MRN = PATIENT_MRN AND EAD_RN = 1 LEFT JOIN RAD ON RRPT_MRN = PATIENT_MRN AND RAD_RN=1 LEFT JOIN PROC_DET P1 ON P1.PROC_MRN = S.PATIENT_MRN AND S.LOG_SURGERY_DTE = P1.PROC_DATE AND P1.PROC_RN = 1 LEFT JOIN PROC_DET P2 ON P2.PROC_MRN = S.PATIENT_MRN AND S.LOG_SURGERY_DTE = P2.PROC_DATE AND P2.PROC_RN = 2 LEFT JOIN PROC_DET P3 ON P3.PROC_MRN = S.PATIENT_MRN AND S.LOG_SURGERY_DTE = P3.PROC_DATE AND P3.PROC_RN = 3 LEFT JOIN PROC_DET P4 ON P4.PROC_MRN = S.PATIENT_MRN AND S.LOG_SURGERY_DTE = P4.PROC_DATE AND P4.PROC_RN = 4 LEFT JOIN PROC_DET P5 ON P5.PROC_MRN = S.PATIENT_MRN AND S.LOG_SURGERY_DTE = P5.PROC_DATE AND P5.PROC_RN = 5 LEFT JOIN PROC_DET P6 ON P6.PROC_MRN = S.PATIENT_MRN AND S.LOG_SURGERY_DTE = P6.PROC_DATE AND P6.PROC_RN = 6 LEFT JOIN PROC_DET P7 ON P7.PROC_MRN = S.PATIENT_MRN AND S.LOG_SURGERY_DTE = P7.PROC_DATE AND P7.PROC_RN = 7 LEFT JOIN PROC_DET P8 ON P8.PROC_MRN = S.PATIENT_MRN AND S.LOG_SURGERY_DTE = P8.PROC_DATE AND P8.PROC_RN = 8 LEFT JOIN PROC_DET P9 ON P9.PROC_MRN = S.PATIENT_MRN AND S.LOG_SURGERY_DTE = P9.PROC_DATE AND P9.PROC_RN = 9 LEFT JOIN PROC_DET P10 ON P10.PROC_MRN = S.PATIENT_MRN AND S.LOG_SURGERY_DTE = P10.PROC_DATE AND P10.PROC_RN = 10 LEFT JOIN PROC_DET P11 ON P11.PROC_MRN = S.PATIENT_MRN AND S.LOG_SURGERY_DTE = P11.PROC_DATE AND P11.PROC_RN = 11 LEFT JOIN PROC_DET P12 ON P12.PROC_MRN = S.PATIENT_MRN AND S.LOG_SURGERY_DTE = P12.PROC_DATE AND P12.PROC_RN = 12

prompt: Provide report on  total numbers of CIS "pulmonary inpatient consult'' and ''pulmonary inpatient consult UCC'' orders by reason,  order status,  'yes' for anticipated procedure grouped  by time of day.
completion: SELECT DISTINCT OO_ORD_GUID, OO_MRN MRN, OO_ENTER_DT AS ENTER_DT, OO_ORD_STS_CD, OSTS_STS_DESC, OO_ORD_NAME ORD_NAME, OO_ORD_ID, OO_SUMMARY_LINE, CASE WHEN UPPER(A.OUD_USER_DI_VALUE) = 'PLEURAL EFFUSION' OR UPPER(F.OUD_USER_DI_VALUE) like '%PLEURAL%EFFUSION%') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END PLEURALEFFUSION, A.OUD_USER_DI_VALUE AS CONSULTREASON, B.OUD_USER_DI_VALUE AS REASONCONS, C.OUD_USER_DI_VALUE AS REASONFORREFERRAL, D.OUD_USER_DI_VALUE AS ANTICIPATEDPROC, F.OUD_USER_DI_VALUE AS INSTRUCTIONS, OO_ENTER_DTE , DAYOFWEEK(OO_ENTER_DTE) DAYOFWEEK, TIME(OO_ENTER_DT) ENTER_TIME, CASE WHEN (TIME(OO_ENTER_DT) BETWEEN '09:00:00' AND '16:59:59') AND (DAYOFWEEK(OO_ENTER_DTE) IN (1, 2, 3, 4, 5)) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END SHIFT1, CASE WHEN (TIME(OO_ENTER_DT) >= '17:00:00' OR TIME(OO_ENTER_DT) <= '08:59:59') AND (DAYOFWEEK(OO_ENTER_DTE) IN (1, 2, 3, 4)) OR (TIME(OO_ENTER_DT) <= '08:59:59' AND DAYOFWEEK(OO_ENTER_DTE)=5) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END SHIFT2, CASE WHEN ((DAYOFWEEK(OO_ENTER_DTE)= 5 AND TIME(OO_ENTER_DT) BETWEEN '17:00:00' AND '08:59:59') OR DAYOFWEEK(OO_ENTER_DTE) IN (6, 7) OR (DAYOFWEEK(OO_ENTER_DTE) = 1 AND TIME(OO_ENTER_DT) BETWEEN '00:00:00' AND '08:59:59')) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END SHIFT3 FROM IDB.OMS_ORDER JOIN IDB.OMS_STATUS ON OO_ORD_STS_CD = OSTS_ORD_STS_CD LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_USER_DATA A ON OO_ORD_GUID = A.OUD_ORD_GUID AND A.OUD_USER_DI_CD IN ('Consult_Pulm Reason for') LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_USER_DATA B ON OO_ORD_GUID = B.OUD_ORD_GUID AND B.OUD_USER_DI_CD IN ('Reason for Referral') LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_USER_DATA C ON OO_ORD_GUID = C.OUD_ORD_GUID AND C.OUD_USER_DI_CD IN ('Consult_Pulm Procedure') LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_USER_DATA D ON OO_ORD_GUID = D.OUD_ORD_GUID AND D.OUD_USER_DI_CD IN ('Consult_Pulm Anticipated Proc') LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_USER_DATA F ON OO_ORD_GUID = F.OUD_ORD_GUID AND F.OUD_USER_DI_CD IN ('Instructions_Spl') WHERE OO_ORD_STS_CD IN ('AUC1', 'COMP') AND OO_ENTER_DTE >= CURRENT date - 15 DAY AND OO_ORD_NAME IN ('Pulmonary Consult', 'Pulmonary Inpatient Consult')

prompt: Provide a one-time list of all MSK multiple myeloma pts with diagnosis date
completion: WITH X AS (SELECT CC_MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS MIN_ICD9_EFF_DTE, CC_CLSF_CD AS ICD9_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS ICD9_DESC FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE (CC_CLSF_CD IN ('C90.00', 'C90.01', 'C90.02') OR CC_CLSF_CD IN ('203.0', '203.00', '203.01', '203.02')) AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND (CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) GROUP BY CC_MRN, CC_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK ) SELECT DISTINCT CC_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, PT_DATE_OF_DEATH, PT_SEX, R.AV_DESC AS "Race", E.AV_DESC AS "Ethnicity", CASE WHEN PT_DATE_OF_DEATH IS NULL THEN 'Alive' ELSE 'Deceased' END AS "Vital Status", MIN_ICD9_EFF_DTE, ICD9_CD, ICD9_DESC FROM X LEFT JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON CC_MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS R ON PT_RACE = R.AV_CODE AND R.AV_ELEMENT = 'RACE' LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS E ON PT_PT_ETHNICITY = E.AV_CODE AND E.AV_ELEMENT = 'PT_ETHNICITY'

prompt: Provide a list of patients who received Gemcitabine by the intravesical route between 2/1/2000 and 11/30/2011
completion: WITH CTE AS (SELECT DISTINCT POD_MRN AS MRN FROM IDB.PHM_ORDER INNER JOIN IDB.PHM_ORD_DTL ON PO_ORD_SEQ = POD_ORD_SEQ INNER JOIN IDB.PHM_ORD_INV ON POD_ORD_SEQ = POI_ORD_SEQ AND POD_ITEM_NO = POI_ITEM_NO INNER JOIN IDB.PHM_INVENTORY ON POI_INV_SEQ = PIN_INV_SEQ WHERE UPPER(PIN_GENERIC_NAME) LIKE '%GEMCITABINE%' AND PO_ORD_STS NOT IN ('X', 'P') AND POD_STRT_DTE BETWEEN '2000-02-01' AND '2011-11-30' AND PO_ROUTE_ABBR IN ('IRRIG', 'INTVESICAL') UNION SELECT DISTINCT CM_MRN AS MRN FROM IDB.CHEMO INNER JOIN IDB.SVM ON CM_SVM_CD = SVM_SVM_CD WHERE UPPER(CM_SVM_DESC) LIKE '%GEMCITABINE%' AND CM_ORD_STRT_DTE BETWEEN '2000-02-01' AND '2011-11-30' AND CM_ROUTE IN ('BLADDER', 'INTRAVES') ) SELECT PT_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME FROM CTE INNER JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON MRN = PT_MRN

prompt: Provide billing, surgery, radiation therapy, patient account, and demographic data for patients with pathological vertebral fractures between January 1, 2010 to July 1, 2021.
completion: WITH PHI (PHI) AS ( VALUES ('Y')) , ICD9DXCODES AS (SELECT DXA_ATTRIBUTE_ID FROM DV.DIAGNOSIS_ATTRIBUTE WHERE DXA_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND DXA_CIC_CDER_INIT = 'YES') , ICD9_10_DXS AS (SELECT DISTINCT PD.PDX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID AS PID, DXD.DT_DTE , DCC.DXCC_ICD_CODE, DCC.DXCC_ICD_MSK_DESC FROM DV.PATIENT_DIAGNOSIS PD INNER JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS D ON PD.PDX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = D.PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID INNER JOIN DV.DATE_V DXD ON PD.PDX_DX_DATE_ID = DXD.DT_DATE_ID INNER JOIN ICD9DXCODES DA ON PD.PDX_DIAGNOSIS_ATTRIBUTE_ID = DA.DXA_ATTRIBUTE_ID INNER JOIN DV.DIAGNOSIS_CATALOG DCC ON PD.PDX_DX_CATALOG_ID = DCC.DXCC_DX_CATALOG_ID AND DCC.DXCC_DX_TYPE IN ('ICD9', 'ICD10') WHERE 1=1 AND DCC.DXCC_ICD_CODE IN ('M48.50XA' , 'M84.48XA' , 'M84.58' , 'M84.68XA' , '733.13') AND DXD.DT_DTE BETWEEN '1/1/2010' AND '7/1/2021' ) , DX_LISTAGG AS (SELECT PID AS DX_PID, LISTAGG(COALESCE(DT_DTE, '') || ' | ' || COALESCE(TRIM(CAST(DXCC_ICD_CODE AS VARCHAR(32000))), '') || ' | ' || COALESCE(TRIM(DXCC_ICD_MSK_DESC), '') , CHR(13) || CHR(10)) WITHIN GROUP( ORDER BY DT_DTE, DXCC_ICD_CODE) AS "Targeted Billing Codes" FROM ICD9_10_DXS GROUP BY PID) , DT AS (SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN AS MRN , PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID FROM ICD9_10_DXS JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS PDV ON PDV.PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PID) , SURGERY AS (SELECT DISTINCT SSE_MRN, SSE_SURG_DTE AS "Surgery Date", SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD AS "CPT Code", SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC AS "CPT Description", SSP_SURG_LAST_NM AS "Surgeon Last Name" FROM IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT JOIN DT ON MRN = SSE_MRN JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE ON SSE_LOG_ID = SSP_LOG_ID WHERE 1=1 ) , SURGERY_LISTAGG AS (SELECT SSE_MRN, LISTAGG(COALESCE("Surgery Date", '') || ' | ' || COALESCE(TRIM(CAST("Surgeon Last Name" AS VARCHAR(32000))), '') || ' | ' || COALESCE(TRIM("CPT Code"), '') || ' | ' || COALESCE(TRIM("CPT Description"), '') , CHR(13) || CHR(10)) WITHIN GROUP( ORDER BY SSE_MRN, "Surgery Date", "CPT Code") AS "Surgeries" FROM SURGERY GROUP BY SSE_MRN) , RT_FROM_PA_PRE AS (SELECT MRN, SVC_DTE, RAD_TYPE, SOURCE_IND, SVC_CD, SVC_DESC, DPT_CD, DPT_DESC, IP_OP_IND, SUM(AMT) AS SVC_AMT, SUM(QTY) AS SVC_QTY, RMS_VISIT_ID, RMS_ADM_NUM, SMS_ACCT_NO FROM (SELECT DTL_MRN AS MRN, DTL_SVC_DTE AS SVC_DTE, RAD_TYPE, 'SMS' AS SOURCE_IND, DTL_SVC_CD AS SVC_CD, CDM_SVC_DESC AS SVC_DESC, CDM_DPT_CD AS DPT_CD, AV_DESC AS DPT_DESC, DTL_IP_OP_IND AS IP_OP_IND, DTL_SVC_AMT AS AMT, DTL_SVC_QTY AS QTY, 0 AS RMS_VISIT_ID, DTL_ACCT_NO AS RMS_ADM_NUM, DTL_ACCT_NO AS SMS_ACCT_NO FROM DT DT JOIN IDB.PA_DETAIL ON MRN = DTL_MRN JOIN IDB.CDM ON CDM_SVC_CD = DTL_SVC_CD JOIN IDB.RADIATION_TYPES ON RAD_SVC_CD = DTL_SVC_CD AND RAD_SOURCE = 'SMS' LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS ON CDM_DPT_CD = AV_CODE AND AV_ELEMENT = 'DPT_CD' WHERE DTL_DTL_TYPE = 'C' AND DTL_SVC_DTE <= '2018-12-31' UNION ALL SELECT RVCD_MRN AS MRN, RVCD_SVC_DTE AS SVC_DTE, RAD_TYPE, 'RMS' AS SOURCE_IND, RCDD_CHARGE_CD AS SVC_CD, RCDD_CHARGE_DESCRIPTION AS SVC_DESC, RDPD_DEPARTMENT_MNEMONIC AS DPT_CD, RDPD_DEPARTMENT_NAME AS DPT_DESC, VIS_IP_OP_ADJUSTED_IND AS IP_OP_IND, RVCD_AMT AS AMT, RVCD_UNITS AS QTY, VIS_VISIT_ID AS RMS_VISIT_ID, VIS_ADM_NUM AS RMS_ADM_NUM, ' ' AS SMS_ACCT_NO FROM DT DT JOIN IDB.RMS_VISIT_CHARGE_DTL ON MRN = RVCD_MRN JOIN IDB.VISIT ON RVCD_VISIT_ID = VIS_VISIT_ID JOIN IDB.RMS_CHARGE_CODE_DICT_DN1240 ON RVCD_CHARGE_CODE_REC_NO = RCDD_RECORD_NUMBER JOIN IDB.RMS_DEPARTMENT_DICT_DN1301 ON RVCD_CHARGE_DEPT_REC_NO = RDPD_RECORD_NUMBER JOIN IDB.RADIATION_TYPES ON RAD_SVC_CD = RCDD_CHARGE_CD AND RAD_SOURCE = 'RMS' WHERE RVCD_SVC_DTE >= '2017-11-01' ) A GROUP BY MRN, SVC_DTE, A.RAD_TYPE, SOURCE_IND, SVC_CD, SVC_DESC, DPT_CD, DPT_DESC, IP_OP_IND, RMS_VISIT_ID, RMS_ADM_NUM, SMS_ACCT_NO HAVING SUM(QTY) > 0) , RT_FROM_PA AS (SELECT MRN, MIN(SVC_DTE) AS MIN_DTE, MAX(SVC_DTE) AS MAX_DTE, RAD_TYPE, SVC_DESC FROM RT_FROM_PA_PRE GROUP BY MRN, RAD_TYPE, SVC_DESC) , RT_FROM_PA_LISTAGG AS (SELECT MRN AS RT_FROM_PA_MRN, LISTAGG(COALESCE(MIN_DTE, '') || ' | ' || COALESCE(MAX_DTE, '') || ' | ' || COALESCE(TRIM(CAST(RAD_TYPE AS VARCHAR(32000))), '') || ' | ' || COALESCE(TRIM(SVC_DESC), ''), CHR(13) || CHR(10)) WITHIN GROUP( ORDER BY MRN, MIN_DTE) AS "RT Info from Patient Accounts" FROM RT_FROM_PA GROUP BY MRN) , RADONC AS (SELECT DISTINCT MRN, RTC_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID AS RT_ID, RTC_TX_DELIVERED_DOSE AS "Delivered Dose" , CASE WHEN PHI.PHI = 'Y' THEN CAST(START_D.DT_DTE AS VARCHAR(1000)) ELSE CAST(YEAR(START_D.DT_DTE) AS VARCHAR(1000)) END AS "Start Date" , CASE WHEN PHI.PHI = 'Y' THEN CAST(STOP_D.DT_DTE AS VARCHAR(1000)) ELSE CAST(YEAR(STOP_D.DT_DTE) AS VARCHAR(1000)) END AS "Stop Date" , REF_CAT.RFC_REFERENCE_POINT AS "Reference Point/Site" FROM DV.RADONC_TREATMENT_COURSE JOIN DT ON PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = RTC_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID LEFT JOIN DV.DATE_V START_D ON RTC_TX_START_DATE_ID = START_D.DT_DATE_ID LEFT JOIN DV.DATE_V STOP_D ON RTC_TX_STOP_DATE_ID = STOP_D.DT_DATE_ID LEFT JOIN DV.REFERENCE_POINT_CATALOG REF_CAT ON REF_CAT.RFC_BEAM_THERAPY_ID = RTC_REFERENCE_POINT_ID , PHI) , RADONC_LISTAGG AS (SELECT RT_ID, LISTAGG(COALESCE("Start Date", '') || ' | ' || COALESCE("Stop Date", '') || ' | ' || COALESCE(TRIM(CAST("Reference Point/Site" AS VARCHAR(32000))), '') || ' | ' || COALESCE(TRIM("Delivered Dose"), '') , CHR(13) || CHR(10)) WITHIN GROUP( ORDER BY RT_ID, "Start Date", "Reference Point/Site") AS "Radiation Therapy" FROM RADONC GROUP BY RT_ID) SELECT DISTINCT "t1"."PT_MRN" AS "MRN", "t1"."PT_LAST_NAME" AS "Last Name", "t1"."PT_FIRST_NAME" AS "First Name", "t1"."PT_BIRTH_DTE" AS "Date of Birth", "t1"."PT_DEATH_DTE" AS "Deceased Date", CASE WHEN "t1"."PT_DEATH_DTE" IS NULL THEN YEAR(CURRENT date - "t1"."PT_BIRTH_DTE") END AS "Cur Age", "t1"."PT_VITAL_STATUS" AS "Vital Status", "t1"."PT_SEX_DESC" AS "Gender" , "Targeted Billing Codes" , "Surgeries" , "RT Info from Patient Accounts" , "Radiation Therapy" FROM DT DT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS" "t1" ON "t1"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = DT.PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID LEFT JOIN DX_LISTAGG ON DX_PID = DT.PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_CORE_DEMOGRAPHICS" "t2" ON "t1"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t2"."CORE_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_LATEST_ACTIVITY" "t3" ON "t1"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t3"."PLA_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN SURGERY_LISTAGG ON SSE_MRN = DT.MRN LEFT JOIN RADONC_LISTAGG ON RT_ID = DT.PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID LEFT JOIN RT_FROM_PA_LISTAGG ON RT_FROM_PA_MRN = DT.MRN WHERE 1=1 ORDER BY "t1"."PT_MRN" ;

prompt: Design an on-demand structured report on neurosurgery patients.
completion: WITH NRS AS (SELECT DISTINCT STRIP(CPE_MRN) AS CPE_MRN, CPE_ENC_DTE AS "First Neurosurgery Visit Date", STRIP(CRE_RES_NAME) AS "MD", STRIP(CLD_DEPT_NAME) AS "Department Name", STRIP(CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME) AS "Visit Type", ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CPE_MRN ORDER BY CPE_ENC_DTE) AS RN FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CRE_RES_TYP IN ('Physician') AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN '2002-01-01' AND CURRENT DATE AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 = 'NRS' ) , NRS2 AS (SELECT NRS.* FROM NRS WHERE RN = 1 ) , AC AS (SELECT AC_MRN, MAX(CASE WHEN AC_IRB_NO = '06-107' THEN 'Y' END) AS "06-107 Consent", MAX(CASE WHEN AC_IRB_NO = '12-245' THEN 'Y' END) AS "12-245 Consent" FROM IDB.ACCRUALS WHERE AC_IRB_NO IN ('06-107', '12-245') AND AC_MRN IN (SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN FROM NRS2) GROUP BY AC_MRN ) SELECT DISTINCT NRS2.*, "06-107 Consent", "12-245 Consent" FROM NRS2 LEFT JOIN AC ON CPE_MRN = AC_MRN WITH SRG AS (SELECT DISTINCT SSE_MRN, SSE_LOG_ID, SSE_SURG_DTE, STRIP(SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD) AS "CPT Code", STRIP(SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC) AS "Procedure Description", STRIP(SSP_SURG_LAST_NM) || ', ' || STRIP(SSP_SURG_FIRST_NM) AS SURGEON FROM IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE ON SSE_LOG_ID = SSP_LOG_ID WHERE 1=1 ) , SRG2 AS (SELECT STRIP(SSE_MRN) AS MRN, SSE_LOG_ID AS "Log ID", SSE_SURG_DTE AS "Surgery Date", SURGEON, LISTAGG(COALESCE(STRIP(CAST("CPT Code" AS VARCHAR(2000))), '') || ' | ' || COALESCE(STRIP(CAST("Procedure Description" AS VARCHAR(2000))), '') , CHR(13) || CHR(10)) WITHIN GROUP( ORDER BY SSE_MRN, SSE_LOG_ID, SSE_SURG_DTE, SURGEON, "CPT Code") AS "Surgical Procedures" FROM SRG GROUP BY STRIP(SSE_MRN), SSE_LOG_ID, SSE_SURG_DTE, SURGEON) , PATH AS (SELECT MRN, "Log ID", "Surgery Date", SURGEON, "Surgical Procedures", "Pathology Report", "Pathology Report Type", "Pathology Procedure Date", CASE WHEN DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)DIAGNOSIS:[\w\W]*(?=NOTE:)', DIAGNOSIS) <> '' THEN DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)DIAGNOSIS:[\w\W]*(?=NOTE:)', DIAGNOSIS) ELSE DIAGNOSIS END AS DIAGNOSIS, "SPECIMENS SUBMITTED" FROM (SELECT DISTINCT "t1"."PT_MRN" AS "MRN", "Log ID", "Surgery Date", SURGEON, "Surgical Procedures", "t2"."PRPT_ACCESSION_NO" AS "Pathology Report", "t3"."PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_DESC" AS "Pathology Report Type", "t4"."DT_DTE" AS "Pathology Procedure Date", CASE WHEN UPPER(DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)DIAGNOSIS:[\w\W]*(?=I ATTEST)', PRPT_REPORT)) <> '' THEN UPPER(DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)DIAGNOSIS:[\w\W]*(?=I ATTEST)', PRPT_REPORT)) WHEN UPPER(DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)DIAGNOSIS:[\w\W]*(?=NOTE:)', PRPT_REPORT)) <> '' THEN UPPER(DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)DIAGNOSIS:[\w\W]*(?=NOTE:)', PRPT_REPORT)) WHEN UPPER(DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)DIAGNOSIS:[\w\W]*(?=REPORT ELECTRONICALLY SIGNED OUT )', PRPT_REPORT)) <> '' THEN UPPER(DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)DIAGNOSIS:[\w\W]*(?=REPORT ELECTRONICALLY SIGNED OUT )', PRPT_REPORT)) END AS DIAGNOSIS, CASE WHEN UPPER(DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)SPECIMENS SUBMITTED[\w\W]*(?=DIAGNOSIS:)', PRPT_REPORT)) <> '' THEN UPPER(DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)SPECIMENS SUBMITTED[\w\W]*(?=DIAGNOSIS:)', PRPT_REPORT)) WHEN UPPER(DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)SPECIMENSSUBMITTED[\w\W]*(?=DIAGNOSIS:)', PRPT_REPORT)) <> '' THEN UPPER(DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)SPECIMENSSUBMITTED[\w\W]*(?=DIAGNOSIS:)', PRPT_REPORT)) END AS "SPECIMENS SUBMITTED" FROM SRG2 JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V" "t1" ON PT_MRN = MRN LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED" "t6" ON "t1"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t6"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V" "t2" ON "t6"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t2"."PRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATH_RPRT_TYPE_LOOKUP" "t3" ON "t2"."PRPT_REPORT_TYPE" = "t3"."PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_CD" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" "t4" ON "t2"."PRPT_PROCEDURE_DATE_ID" = "t4"."DT_DATE_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" "t5" ON "t2"."PRPT_REPORT_DATE_ID" = "t5"."DT_DATE_ID" WHERE 1=1 AND "t4"."DT_DTE" = "Surgery Date" AND "t2"."PRPT_REPORT" IS NOT NULL AND UPPER("t3"."PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_DESC") LIKE '%SURGICAL PATHOLOGY%' ) D ) SELECT DISTINCT SRG2.*, "Pathology Report", "Pathology Procedure Date", "Pathology Report Type", DIAGNOSIS FROM SRG2 LEFT JOIN PATH ON SRG2."Log ID" = PATH."Log ID" SELECT DISTINCT STRIP(RTC_TX_MRN) AS RTC_TX_MRN, STRIP(RTC_TX_PLAN_NAME) AS "Plan Name", STRIP(RTC_PRIMARY_REF_POINT) AS "Primary Referefence Point", RTC_TX_START_DTE AS "Start Date", RTC_TX_STOP_DTE AS "Stop Date", RTC_TX_ELAPSED_DAYS AS "Elapsed Days", RTC_TX_PLANNED_FRACTIONS AS "Planned Fractions", RTC_TX_DELIVERED_FRACTIONS AS "Delivered Fractions", RTC_TX_PLANNED_DOSE AS "Planned Dose", RTC_TX_DELIVERED_DOSE AS "Delivered Dose", RTC_DOSE_CORRECTION AS "Dose Correction" FROM IDB.RADONC_TREATMENT_COURSE WHERE 1=1

prompt: Detailed information for 09-025 Patients
completion: WITH PRO AS (SELECT AC_MRN FROM IDB.ACCRUALS WHERE AC_IRB_NO = '09-025' AND AC_NON_MSK_INST = '' ) , FAM_HX AS (SELECT CC_MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) CODING_DATE, CC_CLSF_CD AS ICD_CODE, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS ICD_DESC FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN PRO ON CC_MRN = AC_MRN WHERE CC_CLSF_CD LIKE 'Z80%' OR CC_CLSF_CD LIKE 'V16%' AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND (CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) GROUP BY CC_MRN, CC_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK ) , FH AS (SELECT CDD_MRN, CDD_SERVICE_DTE, CASE WHEN CDD_DOC_NAME LIKE '%DOM%' THEN 'DOM Notes' ELSE 'All Other' END DOM_FLAG, CDD_DOC_NAME, CDO_SECTION, CDO_ITEM_NAME, CDO_VALUE_TEXT, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CDD_MRN ORDER BY CDD_SERVICE_DTE DESC) RN FROM IDB.CD_DOCUMENT JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION ON CDD_MRN = CDO_MRN AND CDD_DOC_GUID = CDO_DOC_GUID AND CDD_AUTHORED_DTE = CDO_AUTHORED_DTE JOIN PRO ON CDD_MRN = AC_MRN WHERE CDD_CANCEL_IND <> '1' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND <> '1' AND UPPER(CDO_ITEM_NAME) = 'FAMILY HISTORY' ) , CLINDOC_FH AS (SELECT * FROM FH WHERE RN = 1 ) , DX AS (SELECT TM_MRN, TM_DX_DTE, TM_HIST_CD, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS HIST_DESC, TM_SITE_CD, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_DESC, LAT.AV_DESC AS "Laterality", SMOKE.AV_DESC AS SMOKING_HX_DESC, TM_OCCUPATION FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS SMOKE ON SMOKE.AV_ELEMENT = 'SMOKING_HX' AND SMOKE.AV_CODE = TM_SMOKING_HX JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS LAT ON LAT.AV_CODE = TM_LATERALITY_CD AND LAT.AV_ELEMENT = 'LATERALITY_CD' JOIN PRO ON TM_MRN = AC_MRN WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') ) , CHEMO AS (SELECT APR_MRN CHEMO_MRN, MIN(APR_START_DTE) CHEMO_START FROM IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX JOIN IDB.CHEMO_DRUG_GENERIC ON APR_GENERIC_NAME = CDG_GENERIC_NAME JOIN PRO ON APR_MRN = AC_MRN WHERE CDG_CHEMO_FLAG = 'Y' GROUP BY APR_MRN ) , IMMUNO AS (SELECT APR_MRN IMMUNO_MRN, MIN(APR_START_DTE) IMMUNO_START FROM IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX JOIN IDB.CHEMO_DRUG_GENERIC ON APR_GENERIC_NAME = CDG_GENERIC_NAME JOIN PRO ON APR_MRN = AC_MRN WHERE CDG_BIOLOGIC_IMMUNO_FLAG = 'Y' GROUP BY APR_MRN ) SELECT DISTINCT AC_MRN MRN, PT_LAST_NAME "Last Name", PT_FIRST_NAME "First Name", PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH "Date of Birth", PT_DEATH_IND_DESC "Death Indicator", PT_RACE_DESC "Race", PT_PT_ETHNICITY_DESC "Ethnicity", PT_RELIGION_DESC "Religion", TM_OCCUPATION "Occupation", CODING_DATE "ICD Coding Date", ICD_CODE "ICD Code", ICD_DESC "ICD Description", TM_DX_DTE "Tumor Dx Date", TM_HIST_CD "Histology Code", HIST_DESC "Histology Description", TM_SITE_CD "Site Code", SITE_DESC "Site Description", "Laterality", SMOKING_HX_DESC "Smoking History", CHEMO_START "Chemo Start", IMMUNO_START "Immuno Start", CDD_SERVICE_DTE "ClinDoc Service Date", DOM_FLAG "DOM Flag", CDD_DOC_NAME "Document Name", CDO_SECTION "Document Section", CDO_ITEM_NAME "Item Name", CDO_VALUE_TEXT "ClinDoc Text" FROM PRO JOIN IDB.PATIENT_V ON AC_MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN FAM_HX ON AC_MRN = CC_MRN LEFT JOIN DX ON AC_MRN = TM_MRN LEFT JOIN CHEMO ON AC_MRN = CHEMO_MRN LEFT JOIN IMMUNO ON AC_MRN = IMMUNO_MRN LEFT JOIN CLINDOC_FH ON AC_MRN = CDD_MRN

prompt: Provide a list of patients who have ClinDoc completed by the Plastics service.
completion: WITH PLASTIC AS (SELECT CDD_MRN , CDD_SERVICE_DTE, CDD_DOC_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CDD_MRN, CDD_SERVICE_DTE ORDER BY CDD_SERVICE_DTE DESC) RN, CDD_DOC_GUID, CDO_SECTION, CDO_ITEM_NAME, CDO_VALUE_TEXT FROM IDB.CD_DOCUMENT LEFT JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION ON CDD_DOC_GUID = CDO_DOC_GUID AND CDD_AUTHORED_DTE = CDO_AUTHORED_DTE AND CDO_VALUE_TEXT <> '' WHERE CDD_CANCEL_IND <> '1' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND <> '1' AND CDD_DOC_NAME IN ('Operative Report - DIEP Flap Breast Reconstruction', 'Operative Report, Tissue Expander - Plastic') AND CDO_SECTION = 'Record of Operation' AND CDO_ITEM_NAME IN ('Procedure', 'Date of Surgery') AND CDD_SERVICE_DTE BETWEEN '2000-01-01' AND '2022-02-15' AND CDD_MRN IN (SELECT DISTINCT EF_MRN FROM IDB.EF_ASSESSMENT JOIN IDB.EF_FORM ON EF_FORM_EXTERNAL_ID = EA_ASSESS_ID WHERE EF_FORM_NAME = 'Breast-Q' AND EA_SURV_ID = 19 AND DATE(EA_ASSIGN_DT) BETWEEN '2000-01-01' AND '2022-02-15' ) ) SELECT PT_MRN, C.CDD_SERVICE_DTE AS "Service Date", C.CDD_DOC_NAME AS "Document Name", P1.CDO_VALUE_TEXT AS "Procedure Name", P2.CDO_VALUE_TEXT AS "Procedure Date" FROM PLASTIC C JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PT_MRN = C.CDD_MRN LEFT JOIN PLASTIC P1 ON P1.CDD_MRN = C.CDD_MRN AND P1.CDD_DOC_GUID = C.CDD_DOC_GUID AND P1.CDO_SECTION = 'Record of Operation' AND P1.CDO_ITEM_NAME = 'Procedure' LEFT JOIN PLASTIC P2 ON P2.CDD_MRN = C.CDD_MRN AND P2.CDD_DOC_GUID = C.CDD_DOC_GUID AND P2.CDO_SECTION ='Record of Operation' AND P2.CDO_ITEM_NAME = 'Date of Surgery'

prompt: Design a Darwin structured report to track patients with whom particular staff members have been in contact.
completion: SELECT DISTINCT CDD_MRN AS MRN, STRIP(PT_LAST_NAME) || ', ' || STRIP(PT_FIRST_NAME) AS "Patient Name", CDD_DOC_GUID, CDD_SERVICE_DTE AS "Service Date", STRIP(CDD_DOC_NAME) AS "Note Name", STRIP(OU_DISPLAY_NAME) AS "Chaplain Name", STRIP(SUBSTR(CDO_VALUE_TEXT, 1, 1000)) AS "Comments", RESULT AS "COVID-19 Result", DATE(MIN_RESULT_DT) AS "COVID-19 Result Date" FROM IDB.CD_DOCUMENT LEFT JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION ON CDO_DOC_GUID = CDD_DOC_GUID AND CDO_AUTHORED_DTE = CDD_AUTHORED_DTE AND CDO_MSTR_ITEM_NM = 'CHP_Brief Comments FT' JOIN IDB.OMS_USER ON CDD_AUTH_PROV_GUID = OU_USER_GUID JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON CDD_MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.COVID19_PATIENT_INFO ON CDD_MRN = MRN WHERE CDD_CANCEL_IND = '0' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND = '0' AND CDD_SERVICE_DTE BETWEEN DATE(#PROMPT('Start Date', 'STRING', '1993-01-01')#) AND DATE(#PROMPT ('End Date', 'STRING', '2040-12-31')#) AND OU_USER_GUID IN ('9000014820501190', '9000008306101190', '9000199056201190', '9000008306301190', '9000882546201190', '9000981829101190', '9000712334001190', '9000397512601190', '9000647645001190', '9000867593101190', '9000014385101190', '9001044337201190', '9001044337301190') AND STRIP(OU_DISPLAY_NAME) IN (#PROMPTMANY('ChaplainX', 'STRING')#)

prompt: Appointment, procedure, protocol participation and diagnosis data on patients matching a pathology report search for neurofibromatosis.
completion: WITH PATH AS (SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT A JOIN DV.DATE ON PRPT_REPORT_DATE_ID = DT_DATE_ID JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON PRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID WHERE CONTAINS (PRPT_REPORT, '"neurofibromatosis"|"plexiform neurofibroma"|"perineuriomas"|"malignant soft tissue sarcoma"|"neurofibromatosis type 1"')=1 ) , DX AS (SELECT DISTINCT CC_MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS MIN_EFF_DTE, CC_CLSF_CD AS ICD9_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS ICD9_DESC FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE CC_CLSF_CD IN ('Q85.00', 'Q85.01', 'Q85.02', 'Q85.09', 'D36.10', 'D36.11', 'D36.12', 'D36.13', 'D36.14', 'D36.15', 'D36.16', 'D36.17', 'C49.9', 'C46.1', '237.70', '237.71', '237.72', '237.79', '215.9', '171.9', '176.1') AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND CC_MRN IN (SELECT PT_MRN FROM PATH) GROUP BY CC_MRN, CC_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK) , SURG AS (SELECT DISTINCT PBD_MRN, PBD_SVC_DTE, DOC_NAME, DOC_SVC FROM IDB.PBD_DTL JOIN IDB.PBD_INVOICE ON PBD_INV_NO = PBI_INV_NO JOIN IDB.DOC ON PBI_PERFORM_DR_NO = DOC_DR_NO WHERE PBD_MRN IN (SELECT CC_MRN FROM DX) AND PBD_SVC_DTE BETWEEN '2016-01-01' AND CURRENT date) IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT IDB.SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE SELECT PT_MRN MRN, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH DOB, CPE_ENC_DTE "NV/IR Date", CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 AS "Service", MIN(MIN_EFF_DTE) "Min Diagnosis Date", AC_IRB_NO "IRB", AC_CONS_DTE "Consent Date", PBD_SVC_DTE "Surg Date", DOC_NAME "Surgeon", DOC_SVC "Surg Service" FROM DX LEFT JOIN SURG ON PBD_MRN = CC_MRN JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON CC_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER ON CPE_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.ACCRUALS ON AC_MRN = PT_MRN AND AC_IRB_NO IN ('12-245', '06-107') WHERE (CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR LIKE '%NV%' OR CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR LIKE '%IR%') GROUP BY PT_MRN, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, CPE_ENC_DTE, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8, AC_IRB_NO, AC_CONS_DTE, PBD_SVC_DTE, DOC_NAME, DOC_SVC ;

prompt: Please provide a one-time list of relapsed or refractory disease primary mediastinal B-cell lymphoma (PMBL) patients diagnosed between 1/1/2000 and 12/31/2021.
completion: SELECT DISTINCT DMP.PRPT_MRN AS MRN , PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_BIRTH_DTE, PT_VITAL_STATUS, PT_DEATH_DTE , YEAR(DMP.PRPT_PROCEDURE_DTE - PT_BIRTH_DTE) AS "Proc Age" , CASE WHEN PT_DEATH_DTE IS NULL THEN YEAR(CURRENT date - PT_BIRTH_DTE) END AS "Current Age" , DMP.PRPT_ACCESSION_NO AS "Accession No" , DMP.PRPT_REPORT_DTE AS "Report Date" , DMP.PRPT_PROCEDURE_DTE AS "Procedure Date" , SRG.PRPT_ACCESSION_NO AS RELATED_ACC_NO , SRG_DATE.DT_DTE AS RELATED_PROC_DTE , DMP.PRPT_REPORT_TYPE_DESC AS "Report Type" , DMP.PRPT_REPORT_TYPE , DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)diag[\w\W]*(?=I ATTEST)', DMP.PRPT_REPORT) AS DIAGNOSIS_TEXT , VARCHAR(DMP.PRPT_REPORT, 32000) AS "Report Text (first 32000 characters)" , (SELECT VARCHAR(PRPT_REPORT, 32000) AS REFERENCEDPATHTEXTFROM FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT WHERE PRPT_ACCESSION_NO = SRG.PRPT_ACCESSION_NO) AS REFERENCEDPATHTEXT FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V DMP LEFT JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_REFERENCES ON PRPTR_CHILD_PATH_RPT_ID = DMP.PRPT_PATH_RPT_ID LEFT JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT SRG ON SRG.PRPT_PATH_RPT_ID = PRPTR_PATH_RPT_ID LEFT JOIN DV.DATE_V SRG_DATE ON SRG_DATE.DT_DATE_ID = SRG.PRPT_PROCEDURE_DATE_ID JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = DMP.PRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID WHERE 1=1 AND CONTAINS(DMP.PRPT_REPORT, '((" relapsed disease primary mediastinal B-cell lymphoma" OR "refractory disease mediastinal B-cell lymphoma" OR " relapsed primary mediastinal B cell lymphoma" OR "refractory mediastinal B cell lymphoma" OR " relapsed primary mediastinal B-cell lymphoma" OR "refractory primary mediastinal B-cell lymphoma" OR " relapsed disease primary mediastinal B cell lymphoma" OR "refractory disease mediastinal B cell lymphoma" ))') = 1 AND DMP.PRPT_REPORT IS NOT NULL AND DMP.PRPT_REPORT_DTE BETWEEN '1/1/2000' AND '12/31/2021' AND YEAR(DMP.PRPT_PROCEDURE_DTE - PT_BIRTH_DTE) > 18

prompt: Provide weekly list of patients with hand foot skin reaction and history/current use of VEGFR inhibitor
completion: WITH APR AS (SELECT APR_MRN , MIN(APR_START_DTE) FIRST_ADMIN FROM IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX_V WHERE CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME IN ('AXITINIB', 'CABOZANTINIB', 'LENVATINIB', 'PAZOPANIB', 'REGORAFENIB', 'SUNITINIB') OR LOWER(CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME) like '%nintedanib%' GROUP BY APR_MRN ) , PTS AS (SELECT CC_MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS MIN_ICD_EFF_DTE FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN APR ON CC_MRN = APR_MRN WHERE CC_CLSF_CD IN ('L27.1', '693.0') AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND (CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) GROUP BY CC_MRN , FIRST_ADMIN HAVING FIRST_ADMIN <= MIN(CC_EFF_DTE)) SELECT CPE_MRN MRN , TRIM(PT_LAST_NAME) || ', ' || TRIM(PT_FIRST_NAME) PATIENT_NAME , PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH DOB , CRE_RES_NAME PROVIDER_NAME , CRE_RES_TYP PROVIDER_TYPE , CPE_ENC_DTE VISIT_DTE , CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 DEPT , CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 SVC FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN PTS ON CC_MRN = CPE_MRN JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PT_MRN = CPE_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 IN ('GI', 'GU') JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID WHERE CPE_ENC_DTE >= CURRENT DATE - 7 DAY AND CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') ORDER BY CPE_MRN , CPE_ENC_DTE ; WITH APR AS (SELECT DISTINCT APR_MRN , APR_START_DTE FROM IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX_V WHERE (CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME IN ('AXITINIB', 'CABOZANTINIB', 'LENVATINIB', 'PAZOPANIB', 'REGORAFENIB', 'SUNITINIB') OR LOWER(CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME) like '%nintedanib%') AND APR_START_DTE >= CURRENT date - 7 DAY ) SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN MRN , TRIM(PT_LAST_NAME) || ', ' || TRIM(PT_FIRST_NAME) PATIENT_NAME , PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH DOB , CRE_RES_NAME PROVIDER_NAME , CRE_RES_TYP PROVIDER_TYPE , CPE_ENC_DTE VISIT_DTE , CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 DEPT , CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 SVC FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN APR ON APR_MRN = CPE_MRN JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PT_MRN = CPE_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 IN ('GI', 'GU') JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID WHERE CPE_ENC_DTE >= CURRENT DATE - 7 DAY AND CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') ORDER BY CPE_MRN , CPE_ENC_DTE ; WITH APR AS (SELECT APR_MRN , MIN(APR_START_DTE) FIRST_ADMIN FROM IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX_V WHERE CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME IN ('AXITINIB', 'CABOZANTINIB', 'LENVATINIB', 'PAZOPANIB', 'REGORAFENIB', 'SUNITINIB') OR LOWER(CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME) like '%nintedanib%' GROUP BY APR_MRN ) , PTS AS (SELECT CC_MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS MIN_ICD_EFF_DTE FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN APR ON CC_MRN = APR_MRN WHERE CC_CLSF_CD IN ('L27.1', '693.0') AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND (CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) GROUP BY CC_MRN , FIRST_ADMIN HAVING FIRST_ADMIN <= MIN(CC_EFF_DTE)) , APPTS AS (SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN PTS ON CC_MRN = CPE_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 IN ('GI', 'GU') WHERE CPE_ENC_DTE >= CURRENT DATE - 7 DAY AND CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') ) SELECT APR_MRN MRN , APR_START_DTE ADMIN_DTE , CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME DRUG_NAME FROM IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX_V JOIN APPTS ON APR_MRN = CPE_MRN WHERE CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME IN ('AXITINIB', 'CABOZANTINIB', 'LENVATINIB', 'PAZOPANIB', 'REGORAFENIB', 'SUNITINIB') OR LOWER(CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME) like '%nintedanib%' ORDER BY APR_MRN , CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME , APR_START_DTE ; WITH APR AS (SELECT APR_MRN , MIN(APR_START_DTE) FIRST_ADMIN FROM IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX_V WHERE CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME IN ('AXITINIB', 'CABOZANTINIB', 'LENVATINIB', 'PAZOPANIB', 'REGORAFENIB', 'SUNITINIB') OR LOWER(CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME) like '%nintedanib%' GROUP BY APR_MRN ) , PTS AS (SELECT CC_MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS FIRST_HAND_FT_DTE FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN APR ON CC_MRN = APR_MRN WHERE CC_CLSF_CD IN ('L27.1', '693.0') AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND (CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) GROUP BY CC_MRN , FIRST_ADMIN HAVING FIRST_ADMIN <= MIN(CC_EFF_DTE)) SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN MRN , FIRST_HAND_FT_DTE FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN PTS ON CC_MRN = CPE_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 IN ('GI', 'GU') WHERE CPE_ENC_DTE >= CURRENT DATE - 7 DAY AND CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp')

prompt: Provide a list of patients who have had a schwannoma specimen tested for IMPACT.
completion: WITH X AS (SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN, PT_BIRTH_DTE AS DOB, PT_DEATH_DTE AS DOD, PLA_LST_KNOWN_ALIVE_DTE, PDRX_ACCESSION_NO, T.* FROM DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML DT ON PDRX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY ON PT_MRN = PLA_MRN CROSS JOIN XMLTABLE('$c/root/*' PASSING DT.PDRX_XML_VALUE AS "c" COLUMNS DT_PROCEDURE VARCHAR(40) PATH '../meta-data/dt_procedure', TUMOR_TYPE_NAME VARCHAR(264) PATH '../meta-data/tumor_type_name', TUMOR_TYPE_CODE VARCHAR(100) PATH '../meta-data/tumor_type_code', PRIMARY_SITE VARCHAR(100) PATH '../meta-data/primary_site', METASTASIS_SITE VARCHAR(100) PATH '../meta-data/metastasis_site', PART_DESCRIPTION VARCHAR(2000) PATH '../meta-data/part_description') T) , Y AS (SELECT * FROM X WHERE UPPER(TUMOR_TYPE_NAME) like '%SCHWANNOMA%' ) SELECT DISTINCT RTC_TX_MRN, RTC_TX_PLAN_NAME, RTC_PRIMARY_REF_POINT, RTC_TX_START_DTE, RTC_TX_STOP_DTE, RTC_TX_ELAPSED_DAYS, RTC_TX_PLANNED_FRACTIONS, RTC_TX_DELIVERED_FRACTIONS, RTC_TX_PLANNED_DOSE, RTC_TX_DELIVERED_DOSE, RTC_DOSE_CORRECTION FROM IDB.RADONC_TREATMENT_COURSE JOIN Y ON PT_MRN = RTC_TX_MRN

prompt: Upcoming Same Day Visits for Bergen Radiology Patients
completion: WITH CTE AS (SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN AS RAD_MRN, CPE_ENC_DTE AS RAD_APPT_DTE, CHAR(TIME(CPE_APPT_DT), USA) AS RAD_APPT_TIME, CLD_DEPT_NAME AS RAD_DEPT, CRE_RES_NAME AS RAD_RES FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Sch') AND CLD_CLD_CENTER = 'BER' AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 = 'RAD' AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT date AND CURRENT date + 3 DAYS ) , OTHER_APPT AS (SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN, CPE_ENC_DTE, CHAR(TIME(CPE_APPT_DT), USA) AS "Other Appt Time", CLD_DEPT_NAME AS "Other Dept", CRE_RES_NAME AS "Other Provider" FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID JOIN CTE ON CPE_MRN = RAD_MRN AND CPE_ENC_DTE = RAD_APPT_DTE WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Sch') AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 <> 'RAD' ORDER BY CPE_MRN, CPE_ENC_DTE) SELECT DISTINCT RAD_MRN "MRN", PT_LAST_NAME "Last Name", PT_FIRST_NAME "First Name", RAD_APPT_DTE "Rad Appt Date", RAD_DEPT "Rad Dept", RAD_RES "Rad Provider", RAD_APPT_TIME "Rad Appt Time", "Other Appt Time", "Other Dept", "Other Provider" FROM CTE JOIN OTHER_APPT ON CPE_MRN = RAD_MRN AND CPE_ENC_DTE = RAD_APPT_DTE JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON RAD_MRN = PT_MRN ORDER BY 1, 4, 7, 8

prompt: Please provide a summary from 2020 of breast NVs scheduled identifying benign dx, cancerous dx, and RISE appointments.
completion: SELECT CPE_MRN AS "MRN", CPE_ENC_DTE AS "Appt Date", CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 AS "Department", CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 AS "Service", CLD_DEPT_NAME AS "Department Name", CLD_CLD_CENTER "Location", CRE_RES_NAME AS "Provider Name", CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME AS "Visit Type" FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN '2020-01-01' AND '2020-12-31' AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 = 'SRG' AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 = 'BRE' AND CRE_RES_TYP IN ('Physician') AND CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME IN ('BRE NV2', 'BRE IR2', 'OVBK IR2', 'TELEHEALTH NV2') ; SELECT CPE_MRN AS "MRN", CPE_ENC_DTE AS "Appt Date", CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 AS "Department", CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 AS "Service", CLD_DEPT_NAME AS "Department Name", CLD_CLD_CENTER "Location", CRE_RES_NAME AS "Provider Name", CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME AS "Visit Type" FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN '2020-01-01' AND '2020-12-31' AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 = 'SRG' AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 = 'BRE' AND CRE_RES_TYP IN ('Physician') AND CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME IN ('BRE IR1', 'BRE JOINT NV', 'BRE NEO NV1', 'BRE NV1', 'BRE NV3', 'BRE WALK IN IR1', 'E2P PHONE IR', 'IR NV 30 MIN', 'OVBK IR1', 'OVBK NV1', 'PHONE IR', 'PHONE NV', 'TELEHEALTH IR', 'TELEHEALTH NV', 'TELEHEALTH NV1') ; SELECT CPE_MRN AS "MRN", CPE_ENC_DTE AS "Appt Date", CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 AS "Department", CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 AS "Service", CLD_DEPT_NAME AS "Department Name", CLD_CLD_CENTER "Location", CRE_RES_NAME AS "Provider Name", CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME AS "Visit Type" FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN '2020-01-01' AND '2020-12-31' AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 = 'SRG' AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 = 'BRE' AND CRE_RES_TYP IN ('Physician') AND CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME IN ('RISE IR', 'RISE NV') ;

prompt: Provide a list of patients who underwent surgical repair with a skin substitute (graft) between 2016 and 2019.
completion: WITH CTE AS (SELECT PBD_MRN MRN, PT_LAST_NAME "Last Name", PT_FIRST_NAME "First Name", PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH "DOB", PT_SEX "Sex", R.AV_DESC "Race", E.AV_DESC "Ethnicity", PBD_SVC_DTE "Procedure Date", PBC_CPT_CD "CPT Code", CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK "CPT Description", DOC_NAME "Physician Name", DOC_NPI "NPI" FROM IDB.PBD_DTL JOIN IDB.PBD_CODE ON PBD_PBD_CD = PBC_PBD_CD JOIN IDB.CLM ON PBC_CPT_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.PBD_INVOICE ON PBD_INV_NO = PBI_INV_NO JOIN IDB.DOC ON PBI_PERFORM_DR_NO = DOC_DR_NO JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PBD_MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS R ON R.AV_ELEMENT = 'RACE' AND R.AV_CODE = PT_RACE LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS E ON E.AV_ELEMENT = 'PT_ETHNICITY' AND E.AV_CODE = PT_PT_ETHNICITY WHERE PBC_CPT_CD IN ('15271', '15272', '15273', '15274', '15275', '15276', '15277', '15278', '15278', '15260', '15240', '15241') AND PBD_SVC_DTE >= '2016-03-01' ) , SVC AS (SELECT DOC_NPI, MAX(DOC_SVC) DOC_SVC FROM IDB.DOC JOIN CTE ON DOC_NPI = "NPI" GROUP BY DOC_NPI) SELECT MRN, "Last Name", "First Name", "DOB", "Sex", "Race", "Ethnicity", "Procedure Date", "CPT Code", "CPT Description", "Physician Name", S.AV_DESC "Physician Service" FROM CTE LEFT JOIN SVC ON "NPI" = DOC_NPI LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS S ON S.AV_ELEMENT = 'SVC' AND S.AV_CODE = DOC_SVC

prompt: Requesting patients undergoing salvage neck procedures at MSK past 2 years
completion: WITH PROCEDURES_0 AS (SELECT "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AS PT_DEID, "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_MRN" AS PT_MRN, "IDB"."SRG_SURG_EVENT"."SSE_LOG_ID" AS SUBJECT_ID, "IDB"."SRG_SURG_EVENT"."SSE_SURG_DTE" AS PROC_SURG_DATE, CAST(TRIM("IDB"."SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE"."SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD") AS VARCHAR) || ' - ' || CAST(TRIM("IDB"."SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE"."SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC") AS VARCHAR) AS PROC_CODE_DESC FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS" JOIN "IDB"."SRG_SURG_EVENT" ON "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_MRN" = "IDB"."SRG_SURG_EVENT"."SSE_MRN" JOIN "IDB"."SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE" ON "IDB"."SRG_SURG_EVENT"."SSE_LOG_ID" = "IDB"."SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE"."SSP_LOG_ID" WHERE "IDB"."SRG_SURG_EVENT"."SSE_SURG_DTE" BETWEEN '2021-01-01' AND '2023-03-22' AND "IDB"."SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE"."SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD" IN ('15732', '15819', '38700', '38720', '38724')), COHORT AS (SELECT PT_DEID AS PT_DEID FROM ( (SELECT PROCEDURES_0.PT_DEID FROM PROCEDURES_0))), COHORT_PROCEDURES AS (SELECT SUBJECT_ID AS SUBJECT_ID, PT_DEID AS PT_DEID FROM ( (SELECT PROCEDURES_0.SUBJECT_ID, PROCEDURES_0.PT_DEID FROM PROCEDURES_0))), KEYS AS (SELECT COHORT.PT_DEID AS COHORT_PT_DEID, COHORT_PROCEDURES.SUBJECT_ID AS COHORT_PROCEDURES_SUBJECT_ID, COHORT_PROCEDURES.PT_DEID AS COHORT_PROCEDURES_PT_DEID FROM COHORT LEFT OUTER JOIN COHORT_PROCEDURES ON COHORT_PROCEDURES.PT_DEID = COHORT.PT_DEID), DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS AS (SELECT DISTINCT "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AS PT_DEID, "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_MRN" AS PT_MRN, "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AS SUBJECT_ID, TRIM("DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_LAST_NAME") || ', ' || TRIM("DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_FIRST_NAME") AS PT_NAME FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS") SELECT DISTINCT DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS.PT_MRN AS MRN, DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS.PT_NAME AS PT_NAME FROM KEYS LEFT OUTER JOIN DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS ON DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS.PT_DEID = KEYS.COHORT_PT_DEID; WITH PROCEDURES_0 AS (SELECT "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AS PT_DEID, "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_MRN" AS PT_MRN, "IDB"."SRG_SURG_EVENT"."SSE_LOG_ID" AS SUBJECT_ID, "IDB"."SRG_SURG_EVENT"."SSE_SURG_DTE" AS PROC_SURG_DATE, CAST(TRIM("IDB"."SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE"."SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD") AS VARCHAR) || ' - ' || CAST(TRIM("IDB"."SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE"."SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC") AS VARCHAR) AS PROC_CODE_DESC FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS" JOIN "IDB"."SRG_SURG_EVENT" ON "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_MRN" = "IDB"."SRG_SURG_EVENT"."SSE_MRN" JOIN "IDB"."SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE" ON "IDB"."SRG_SURG_EVENT"."SSE_LOG_ID" = "IDB"."SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE"."SSP_LOG_ID" WHERE "IDB"."SRG_SURG_EVENT"."SSE_SURG_DTE" BETWEEN '2021-01-01' AND '2023-03-22' AND "IDB"."SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE"."SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD" IN ('15732', '15819', '38700', '38720', '38724')), COHORT AS (SELECT PT_DEID AS PT_DEID FROM ( (SELECT PROCEDURES_0.PT_DEID FROM PROCEDURES_0))), COHORT_PROCEDURES AS (SELECT SUBJECT_ID AS SUBJECT_ID, PT_DEID AS PT_DEID FROM ( (SELECT PROCEDURES_0.SUBJECT_ID, PROCEDURES_0.PT_DEID FROM PROCEDURES_0))), KEYS AS (SELECT COHORT.PT_DEID AS COHORT_PT_DEID, COHORT_PROCEDURES.SUBJECT_ID AS COHORT_PROCEDURES_SUBJECT_ID, COHORT_PROCEDURES.PT_DEID AS COHORT_PROCEDURES_PT_DEID FROM COHORT LEFT OUTER JOIN COHORT_PROCEDURES ON COHORT_PROCEDURES.PT_DEID = COHORT.PT_DEID), PROCEDURES_COLUMNS AS (SELECT DISTINCT "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AS PT_DEID, "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_MRN" AS PT_MRN, "IDB"."SRG_SURG_EVENT"."SSE_LOG_ID" AS SUBJECT_ID, "IDB"."SRG_SURG_EVENT"."SSE_SURG_DTE" AS PROC_SURG_DATE, "IDB"."SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE"."SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD" AS PROC_CODE, CAST(TRIM("IDB"."SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE"."SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD") AS VARCHAR) || ' - ' || CAST(TRIM("IDB"."SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE"."SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC") AS VARCHAR) AS PROC_CODE_DESC, "IDB"."SRG_SURG_EVENT"."SSE_LOG_STS" AS SSE_LOG_STS, "IDB"."SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE"."SSP_SURG_SVC_CD" AS PROC_SURG_SERVICE, "IDB"."SRG_SURG_EVENT"."SSE_SURG_LOC" AS SSE_SURG_LOC, CAST(TRIM("IDB"."SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE"."SSP_SURG_LAST_NM") AS VARCHAR) || ', ' || CAST(TRIM("IDB"."SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE"."SSP_SURG_FIRST_NM") AS VARCHAR) AS SURGEON FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS" JOIN "IDB"."SRG_SURG_EVENT" ON "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_MRN" = "IDB"."SRG_SURG_EVENT"."SSE_MRN" JOIN "IDB"."SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE" ON "IDB"."SRG_SURG_EVENT"."SSE_LOG_ID" = "IDB"."SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE"."SSP_LOG_ID"), DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS AS (SELECT DISTINCT "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AS PT_DEID, "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_MRN" AS PT_MRN, "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AS SUBJECT_ID FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS") SELECT DISTINCT DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS.PT_MRN AS MRN, PROCEDURES_COLUMNS.PROC_SURG_DATE AS PROC_SURG_DATE, PROCEDURES_COLUMNS.PROC_CODE AS PROC_CODE, PROCEDURES_COLUMNS.PROC_CODE_DESC AS PROC_CODE_DESC, PROCEDURES_COLUMNS.SSE_LOG_STS AS SSE_LOG_STS, PROCEDURES_COLUMNS.PROC_SURG_SERVICE AS PROC_SURG_SERVICE, PROCEDURES_COLUMNS.SSE_SURG_LOC AS SSE_SURG_LOC, PROCEDURES_COLUMNS.SURGEON AS SURGEON FROM KEYS LEFT OUTER JOIN PROCEDURES_COLUMNS ON PROCEDURES_COLUMNS.SUBJECT_ID = KEYS.COHORT_PROCEDURES_SUBJECT_ID LEFT OUTER JOIN DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS ON DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS.PT_DEID = KEYS.COHORT_PT_DEID;

prompt: provide a weekly update of surgical procedures that patients will be undergoing in a list that we will manually maintain on DDP.
completion: SELECT STRIP(OC_MRN) AS MRN, STRIP(PT_LAST_NAME) || ', ' || STRIP(PT_FIRST_NAME) AS "Name", STRIP(OC_CASE_ID) AS "Case ID", OC_SURG_DTE AS "Surgery Date", STRIP(CRE_RES_NAME) AS "Surgeon", STRIP(CPX_PROC_CD) AS "CPT Code", STRIP(CPX_PROC_NAME) AS "CPT Description" FROM IDB.PATIENT JOIN IDB.OR_CASE ON PT_MRN = OC_MRN JOIN IDB.OR_CASE_ALL_PROC ON OC_CASE_ID = OCAP_CASE_ID JOIN IDB.OR_CASE_ALL_SURG ON OCAP_CASE_ID = OCAS_CASE_ID AND OCAS_PNL_NO = OCAP_PNL_NO AND OCAS_SURG_ROLE = 'Primary' JOIN IDB.OR_PROC ON OCAP_OR_PROC_ID = OP_OR_PROC_ID JOIN IDB.OR_CL_PROC ON OP_OR_PROC_ID = OCP_OR_PROC_ID JOIN IDB.CL_PROC ON OCP_PROC_ID = CPX_PROC_ID JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CRE_RES_ID = OCAS_RES_ID WHERE OC_SURG_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT date AND CURRENT DATE + 7 DAY AND OC_OR_CASE_STS_CD NOT IN ('2', '5') AND OC_MRN IN ('38126995', '38147207', '38141119', '38134329', '38160363', '38103414', '38166342', '35594584', '38175422', '38171281', '38110804', '38188271')

PST.ALV_LOG_ID AND PST.ALV_VERIF_TYPE_CD = 105 JOIN IDB.CL_USER PSTU ON PST.ALV_VERIF_STAFF_ID = PSTU.CLE_USER_ID JOIN IDB.AN_LOG_VERIF PSC ON OL_LOG_ID = PSC.ALV_LOG_ID AND PSC.ALV_VERIF_TYPE_CD = prompt: Provide a list of operating room patients with RBC between October 1 2016 and March 1 2017 or April 1 2017 and Sept 30 2017
completion: WITH SRG AS (SELECT PT_MRN MRN, SSE_SURG_DTE SURG_DATE, SSE_LOG_ID LOG_ID, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH DOB , OLAT_LOG_ANESTH_TYPE ANESTH_TYPE, ARS_AN_PROC_NAME PROC_NAME , SSE_PT_OUT_DT ROOM_OUT , SUBSTR(CASE WHEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(4, CHAR(SSE_SURG_END_DT - SSE_SURG_STRT_DT))/60 BETWEEN 0 AND 9 THEN '0'|| STRIP(CHAR(TIMESTAMPDIFF(4, CHAR(SSE_SURG_END_DT - SSE_SURG_STRT_DT))/60)) ELSE STRIP(CHAR(TIMESTAMPDIFF(4, CHAR(SSE_SURG_END_DT - SSE_SURG_STRT_DT))/60)) END||':'|| RIGHT(DIGITS(MOD((TIMESTAMPDIFF(4, CHAR(SSE_SURG_END_DT - SSE_SURG_STRT_DT))),60)), 2), 1, 8) AS OR_TIME , TIMESTAMPDIFF(4, CHAR(SSE_SURG_END_DT - SSE_SURG_STRT_DT)) OR_MINUTES , SUBSTR(CASE WHEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(4, CHAR(ARS_AN_STOP_DT - ARS_AN_START_DT))/60 BETWEEN 0 AND 9 THEN '0'||STRIP(CHAR(TIMESTAMPDIFF(4, CHAR(ARS_AN_STOP_DT - ARS_AN_START_DT))/60)) ELSE STRIP(CHAR(TIMESTAMPDIFF(4, CHAR(ARS_AN_STOP_DT - ARS_AN_START_DT))/60)) END||':'|| RIGHT(DIGITS(MOD((TIMESTAMPDIFF(4, CHAR(ARS_AN_STOP_DT - ARS_AN_START_DT))),60)), 2), 1, 8) AS ANES_TIME , TIMESTAMPDIFF(4, CHAR(ARS_AN_STOP_DT - ARS_AN_START_DT)) ANES_MINUTES , COALESCE(PACU1_IN.OLCT_EVNT_IN_DT, PACU2_IN.OLCT_EVNT_IN_DT) PACU_IN , COALESCE(PACU2_OUT.OLCT_EVNT_IN_DT, PACU1_OUT.OLCT_EVNT_IN_DT) PACU_OUT , STRIP(CHAR(INT(SUM(CAST(CASE WHEN AIFM_FLO_MEAS_ID = '400620' THEN AIFM_MEAS_VALUE END AS DECIMAL(7, 1))))))||' ml' AS AN_EBL , STRIP(CHAR(INT(SUM(CAST(CASE WHEN AIFM_FLO_MEAS_ID = '7070009' THEN AIFM_MEAS_VALUE END AS DECIMAL(7, 1))))))||' ml' AS AN_IV_FLUIDS , COALESCE(VIS_IP_OP_ADJUSTED_IND, 'O') IP_OP_IND , COALESCE(VIS_DSCH_DT, PACU2_OUT.OLCT_EVNT_IN_DT, PACU1_OUT.OLCT_EVNT_IN_DT) PT_DC_DT FROM IDB.PATIENT LEFT JOIN IDB.VISIT_V ON PT_MRN = VIS_MRN AND VIS_VISIT_STATUS NOT IN ('1', '4') JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT ON PT_MRN = SSE_MRN AND SSE_SURG_DTE BETWEEN VIS_ADM_DTE AND VIS_DSCH_DT AND SSE_SOURCE_TYPE = 'O' LEFT JOIN IDB.OR_LOG_CASE_TIMES PACU1_IN ON SSE_LOG_ID=PACU1_IN.OLCT_LOG_ID AND PACU1_IN.OLCT_TRACK_EVNT_CD='1100' LEFT JOIN IDB.OR_LOG_CASE_TIMES PACU1_OUT ON SSE_LOG_ID=PACU1_OUT.OLCT_LOG_ID AND PACU1_OUT.OLCT_TRACK_EVNT_CD='1400' LEFT JOIN IDB.OR_LOG_CASE_TIMES PACU2_IN ON SSE_LOG_ID=PACU2_IN.OLCT_LOG_ID AND PACU2_IN.OLCT_TRACK_EVNT_CD='1500' LEFT JOIN IDB.OR_LOG_CASE_TIMES PACU2_OUT ON SSE_LOG_ID=PACU2_OUT.OLCT_LOG_ID AND PACU2_OUT.OLCT_TRACK_EVNT_CD='1700' LEFT JOIN IDB.AN_RECORD_SUMMARY ON SSE_LOG_ID = ARS_AN_CASELOG_ID AND ARS_AN_START_DT IS NOT NULL LEFT JOIN IDB.OR_LOG_ANES_TYPES ON SSE_LOG_ID = OLAT_LOG_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.AN_IP_DATA_STORE ON ARS_AN_CL_PT_ID = AIDS_CL_PT_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.AN_HSB_LINKED_DOC_CSN ON ARS_AN_EPISODE_ID = AHLDC_SUMMARY_BLOCK_ID
