AMAI_ORDER_MED_ID AND AOM_ENC_CSN_ID = AMAI_MAR_ENC_CSN_ID JOIN IDB.AN_CLARITY_MEDICATION ON AOM_MEDICATION_ID = ACM_MED_ID JOIN IDB.CL_USER ON AMAI_USER_ID = CLE_USER_ID JOIN IDB.AN_ORDER_MED_INFO ON AMAI_ORDER_MED_ID = AOMI_ORDER_MED_ID JOIN IDB.AN_IP_FLOWSHEET_ORD_IX ON AOMI_ORDER_MED_ID = AIFOI_IX_FLOW_RW_ORD_ID JOIN IDB.AN_IP_FLOWSHEET_REC ON AIFOI_INPATIENT_DATA_ID = AIFRC_INPATIENT_DATA_ID JOIN IDB.AN_IP_FLOWSHEET_MEAS ON AIFRC_FSD_ID = AIFM_FSD_ID AND AIFOI_GROUP_LINE_NO = AIFM_OCCURANCE AND AMAI_TAKEN_DT = AIFM_RECORDED_DT JOIN IDB.AN_IP_FLOWSHEET_GP_DATA ON AIFM_FLO_MEAS_ID = AIFGD_FLO_MEAS_ID JOIN SRG ON LOG_ID = ARS_AN_CASELOG_ID JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V ON MRN = PT_MRN WHERE ACM_MED_ID IN (112229) AND AIFGD_VALUE_TYPE_CD = '1' AND AIFM_MEAS_VALUE > ' '

prompt: De-identified patient info, Goals of care conversations by race for a grant application
completion: WITH DX AS (SELECT DISTINCT TM_MRN, CASE WHEN TM_BEST_AJCC_STG NOT IN ('', '88', '9', '99') THEN TM_BEST_AJCC_STG WHEN TM_AJCC_7 NOT IN ('', '888', '999') THEN AJCC7.AV_DESC WHEN TM_AJCC NOT IN ('', '88', '99') THEN AJCC.AV_DESC WHEN TM_GENERAL_STG NOT IN ('', '9') THEN GS.AV_DESC WHEN TM_PATH_STG_GRP NOT IN ('', '88', '9', '99') THEN TM_PATH_STG_GRP ELSE CLIN.AV_DESC END AS STAGE FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.SEERGROUPING SG ON IDB.SEERF_ICDO(TM_SITE_CD, TM_HIST_CD) = SG.RECODE LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS AJCC7 ON AJCC7.AV_ELEMENT = 'AJCC_7' AND AJCC7.AV_CODE = TM_AJCC_7 LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS AJCC ON AJCC.AV_ELEMENT = 'AJCC' AND AJCC.AV_CODE = TM_AJCC LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS GS ON GS.AV_ELEMENT = 'GENERAL_STG' AND GS.AV_CODE = TM_GENERAL_STG LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS CLIN ON CLIN.AV_ELEMENT = 'CLIN_STG_DSCR' AND CLIN.AV_CODE = TM_CLIN_STG_DSCR WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') ) , METS AS (SELECT DISTINCT CC_MRN FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN DX ON TM_MRN = CC_MRN AND (STAGE LIKE 'III%' OR STAGE LIKE 'IV%' OR STAGE LIKE '3%' OR STAGE LIKE '4%' ) WHERE CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND ((CC_PT_TYPE = 'I') OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) AND (CC_CLSF_CD BETWEEN '196' AND '198.99' OR CC_CLSF_CD BETWEEN 'C77' AND 'C79.99') ) , GOALS AS (SELECT CDD_MRN, LISTAGG(SVC_YR, ', ') AS GOC_YRS FROM (SELECT DISTINCT CDD_MRN, CAST (YEAR(CDD_SERVICE_DTE) AS VARCHAR(5)) AS SVC_YR FROM IDB.CD_DOCUMENT JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION ON CDD_DOC_GUID = CDO_DOC_GUID JOIN DX ON TM_MRN = CDD_MRN AND (STAGE LIKE 'III%' OR STAGE LIKE 'IV%' OR STAGE LIKE '3%' OR STAGE LIKE '4%') WHERE CDD_CANCEL_IND <> '1' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND <> '1' AND (CDO_SET_DISPL_NM IN ('Goal of Discussion', 'Goals of Care Discussion', 'Discussion Note, Patient/Family') OR CDO_MSTR_ITEM_NM = 'GOC_Discussion FT' OR CDD_FLOWSHEET_GUID = '9000001669103050') ) GROUP BY CDD_MRN) , VISIT AS (SELECT DISTINCT TM_MRN VIS_MRN, MIN_DATE, OCV_VISIT_DTE, OCV_IP_OP_IND AS VISIT_FLAG FROM DX JOIN (SELECT CDD_MRN, MIN (CDD_SERVICE_DTE) MIN_DATE FROM IDB.CD_DOCUMENT JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION ON CDD_DOC_GUID = CDO_DOC_GUID JOIN DX ON TM_MRN = CDD_MRN AND (STAGE LIKE 'III%' OR STAGE LIKE 'IV%' OR STAGE LIKE '3%' OR STAGE LIKE '4%') WHERE CDD_CANCEL_IND <> '1' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND <> '1' AND (CDO_SET_DISPL_NM IN ('Goal of Discussion', 'Goals of Care Discussion', 'Discussion Note, Patient/Family') OR CDO_MSTR_ITEM_NM = 'GOC_Discussion FT' OR CDD_FLOWSHEET_GUID = '9000001669103050') GROUP BY CDD_MRN) ON CDD_MRN = TM_MRN JOIN IDB.OMS_CLIENT_VISIT ON OCV_MRN = CDD_MRN AND OCV_VISIT_DTE = MIN_DATE) , RLC AS (SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN DX ON TM_MRN = CPE_MRN WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CRE_RES_TYP IN ('Physician', 'Fellow', 'PhD', 'Physician Assistant', 'Nurse Practitioner', 'Advanced Practice Nurse', 'Dentist', 'Psychologist') AND CLD_CLD_CENTER = '1919' ) SELECT DISTINCT CAST(PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID AS VARCHAR(20)) PT_DEID_ID, PT_RACE_DESC, CASE WHEN CC_MRN IS NOT NULL THEN 'Y' END AS METASTASIS_FLAG , CASE WHEN (STAGE LIKE 'III%' OR STAGE LIKE 'IV%' OR STAGE LIKE '3%' OR STAGE LIKE '4%') THEN 'Y' END AS "Stage3 or 4", CASE WHEN CDD_MRN IS NOT NULL THEN 'Y' END AS GOALS_OF_CARE_FLAG, GOC_YRS AS GOALS_OF_CARE_YRS, VISIT_FLAG, CASE WHEN CPE_MRN IS NOT NULL THEN 'Y' END AS RLC_FLAG FROM DX D JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V ON PT_MRN = TM_MRN LEFT JOIN METS ON CC_MRN = TM_MRN LEFT JOIN GOALS ON CDD_MRN = TM_MRN LEFT JOIN VISIT ON VIS_MRN = TM_MRN LEFT JOIN RLC ON CPE_MRN = TM_MRN WHERE (D.STAGE LIKE 'III%' OR D.STAGE LIKE 'IV%' OR D.STAGE LIKE '3%' OR D.STAGE LIKE '4%')

prompt: Provide count of patients by race, ethnicity, and gender who have had an appt at Ralph Lauren Center in the past year, with treatment in past 6 months and is age 65+.
completion: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CPE_MRN) AS COUNT, TRIM(E.AV_DESC) ETHNICITY, TRIM(R.AV_DESC) RACE, PT_SEX AS GENDER FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY ON CPE_MRN = PLA_MRN JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON CPE_MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS E ON E.AV_ELEMENT = 'PT_ETHNICITY' AND E.AV_CODE = PT_PT_ETHNICITY LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS R ON R.AV_ELEMENT = 'RACE' AND R.AV_CODE = PT_RACE WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CPE_ENC_DTE >= CURRENT date - 1 YEAR AND PLA_LST_TX_DTE >= CURRENT date - 6 MONTHS AND CLD_CLD_CENTER = '1919' AND YEAR(CURRENT date - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) >= 65 GROUP BY TRIM(E.AV_DESC), TRIM(R.AV_DESC), PT_SEX ORDER BY TRIM(E.AV_DESC), TRIM(R.AV_DESC), PT_SEX ;

prompt: Provide a count of the number of new visits (NVs) and internal referrals (IRs), including telehealth visits by quarter and location and type of visit (Telehealth vs in person) in STGI Medical Oncology, Radiation Oncology, and Surgery for pancreas cancer patients separated by department in 2019 and 2020.
completion: WITH DX AS (SELECT DISTINCT CC_MRN FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE SUBSTR(CC_CLSF_CD, 1, 3) IN ('C25') AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND (CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) ) SELECT YEAR(CPE_ENC_DTE) "Year", QUARTER(CPE_ENC_DTE) "Quarter", CLD_CLD_CENTER "Center", CASE WHEN CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR LIKE '%NV%' THEN 'NV' WHEN CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR LIKE '%IR%' THEN 'IR' END AS "Visit Type", CASE WHEN ((CVT_CVT_RPT_GRP_17 = 'TELEHEALTH' OR UPPER(CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME) LIKE '%PHONE%') OR (CLD_DEPT_ID IN (1382, 1354)) OR UPPER(CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME) IN ('IC BUNDLED SERVICES', 'IC INTEG MED REVIEW', 'IC MEDICAL RECORDS REVIEW', 'IC MSK IMPACT', 'IC RADIOLOGY REVIEW', 'IC VIDEO CONSULT')) THEN 'Telehealth' ELSE 'In-Person' END AS "Telehealth Type", CASE WHEN CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 = 'SRG' THEN 'SRG' ELSE CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 END AS "Service", COUNT(*) "Visits" FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID JOIN DX ON CPE_MRN = CC_MRN WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN '2019-01-01' AND CURRENT DATE AND (CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR LIKE '%NV%' OR CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR LIKE '%IR%') AND CASE WHEN CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 = 'SRG' THEN 1 WHEN CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 = 'GI' AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_7 = 'SOL' THEN 1 WHEN CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 = 'RDO' THEN 1 END = 1 GROUP BY YEAR(CPE_ENC_DTE), QUARTER(CPE_ENC_DTE), CLD_CLD_CENTER, CASE WHEN CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR LIKE '%NV%' THEN 'NV' WHEN CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR LIKE '%IR%' THEN 'IR' END, CASE WHEN ((CVT_CVT_RPT_GRP_17 = 'TELEHEALTH' OR UPPER(CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME) LIKE '%PHONE%') OR (CLD_DEPT_ID IN (1382, 1354)) OR UPPER(CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME) IN ('IC BUNDLED SERVICES', 'IC INTEG MED REVIEW', 'IC MEDICAL RECORDS REVIEW', 'IC MSK IMPACT', 'IC RADIOLOGY REVIEW', 'IC VIDEO CONSULT')) THEN 'Telehealth' ELSE 'In-Person' END, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6, CASE WHEN CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 = 'SRG' THEN 'SRG' ELSE CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 END ORDER BY 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6

prompt: Provide all patients with chromophobe renal cell carcinoma/chromophobe kidney cancer with AT LEAST ONE visit with any of the given medical oncologists:
completion: WITH X AS (SELECT DISTINCT CC_MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS MIN_ICD9_EFF_DTE, CC_CLSF_CD AS ICD9_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS ICD9_DESC FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE SUBSTR(CC_CLSF_CD, 1, 5) IN ('C64.9') AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND (CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) GROUP BY CC_MRN, CC_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK ) SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN AS "MRN", PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, PT_SEX, R.AV_DESC AS "Race", E.AV_DESC AS "Ethnicity", MIN_ICD9_EFF_DTE, ICD9_CD, ICD9_DESC, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 AS "Service", CLD_DEPT_NAME AS "Department Name", CRE_RES_NAME AS "Provider Name" FROM X LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER ON CC_MRN = CPE_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON CPE_MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS R ON PT_RACE = R.AV_CODE AND R.AV_ELEMENT = 'RACE' LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS E ON PT_PT_ETHNICITY = E.AV_CODE AND E.AV_ELEMENT = 'PT_ETHNICITY' WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CRE_RES_TYP IN ('Physician', 'PhD', 'Psychologist', 'Dentist', 'Nurse Practitioner', 'Physician Assistant', 'Advanced Practice Nurse' ) ; WITH X AS (SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN, PDRX_ACCESSION_NO, PDRX_DMP_PATIENT_ID, PDRX_DMP_SAMPLE_ID, TUMOR_TYPE_CODE, TUMOR_TYPE_NAME, IS_METASTASIS, PRIMARY_SITE, METASTASIS_SITE, PART_DESCRIPTION, DV.REGEXSTR('[S|H|C][0-9]{2}\-[0-9]*', XMLCAST(XMLQUERY('$x/root/meta-data/part_description' PASSING PDRX_XML_VALUE AS "x") AS VARCHAR(2000))) AS REFERENCEDACCESSION FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML INNER JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML_SETTINGS ON PDRX_PATH_DMP_RESULTS_XML_ID = PDRXS_PATH_DMP_RESULTS_XML_ID INNER JOIN DVDMC.PATHOLOGY_DMP_WEBSVC_SETTINGS ON PDRXS_SETTING_ID = PDWS_SETTING_ID INNER JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON PDRX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID, XMLTABLE('$c/root/meta-data' PASSING PDRX_XML_VALUE AS "c" COLUMNS TUMOR_TYPE_CODE VARCHAR(100) PATH 'tumor_type_code', TUMOR_TYPE_NAME VARCHAR(255) PATH 'tumor_type_name', IS_METASTASIS VARCHAR(10) PATH 'is_metastasis', PRIMARY_SITE VARCHAR(255) PATH 'primary_site', METASTASIS_SITE VARCHAR(255) PATH 'metastasis_site', PART_DESCRIPTION VARCHAR(2000) PATH 'part_description') T WHERE LOWER(TUMOR_TYPE_NAME) LIKE '%chromophobe%' ) SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN AS "MRN", PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, PT_SEX, R.AV_DESC AS "Race", E.AV_DESC AS "Ethnicity", TUMOR_TYPE_CODE, TUMOR_TYPE_NAME, IS_METASTASIS, PRIMARY_SITE, METASTASIS_SITE, PART_DESCRIPTION, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 AS "Service", CLD_DEPT_NAME AS "Department Name", CRE_RES_NAME AS "Provider Name" FROM X LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER ON X.PT_MRN = CPE_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID JOIN IDB.PATIENT P ON CPE_MRN = P.PT_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS R ON PT_RACE = R.AV_CODE AND R.AV_ELEMENT = 'RACE' LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS E ON PT_PT_ETHNICITY = E.AV_CODE AND E.AV_ELEMENT = 'PT_ETHNICITY' WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CRE_RES_TYP IN ('Physician', 'PhD', 'Psychologist', 'Dentist', 'Nurse Practitioner', 'Physician Assistant', 'Advanced Practice Nurse')

prompt: List of patients with colorectal adenocarcinoma who had molecular pathology reports and underwent PET/CT guided biopsies of the liver (Exam Code= NBLIVPET) from 1/1/2010 -6/6/2018.
completion: WITH XML_DATA AS (SELECT DISTINCT PDRX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID, PDWS_NAME, PT_MRN, PDRX_ACCESSION_NO, PDRX_DMP_PATIENT_ID, PDRX_PATH_RPT_ID, T.* FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML INNER JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML_SETTINGS ON PDRX_PATH_DMP_RESULTS_XML_ID = PDRXS_PATH_DMP_RESULTS_XML_ID INNER JOIN DVDMC.PATHOLOGY_DMP_WEBSVC_SETTINGS ON PDRXS_SETTING_ID = PDWS_SETTING_ID INNER JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON PDRX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID, XMLTABLE('$c/root/*' PASSING PDRX_XML_VALUE AS "c" COLUMNS DT_PROCEDURE VARCHAR(100) PATH 'dt_procedure', SITE1_GENE VARCHAR(100) PATH 'site1_gene', SITE2_GENE VARCHAR(100) PATH 'site2_gene', GENE_ID VARCHAR(100) PATH 'gene_id', EXON_NUM VARCHAR(100) PATH 'exon_num', AA_CHANGE VARCHAR(100) PATH 'aa_change', CDNA_CHANGE VARCHAR(100) PATH 'cDNA_change', MAFREQ VARCHAR(100) PATH 'mafreq_1000g', GENE_FOLD_CHANGE VARCHAR(100) PATH 'gene_fold_change', VARIANT_TYPE VARCHAR(100) PATH './local-name(.)', TUMOR_TYPE_NAME VARCHAR(255) PATH '../meta-data/tumor_type_name', PRIMARY_SITE VARCHAR(255) PATH '../meta-data/primary_site', IMPACT_PANEL VARCHAR(255) PATH '../meta-data/gene-panel', TMB_COUNT DECIMAL(5, 1) PATH '../meta-data/tmb-count') T WHERE VARIANT_TYPE <> 'meta-data' ) , DT AS (SELECT DISTINCT PDRX_PATH_RPT_ID, PDRX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID, PT_MRN, PDRX_DMP_PATIENT_ID, PDRX_ACCESSION_NO, TUMOR_TYPE_NAME, PRIMARY_SITE FROM XML_DATA WHERE LOWER(PRIMARY_SITE) like '%colon%' ) , PETCT AS (SELECT DISTINCT RRPT_MRN, MIN(RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE) MIN_RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE, LISTAGG(RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE, CHR(13) || CHR(10)) WITHIN GROUP( ORDER BY RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE) AS RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE FROM (SELECT DISTINCT RRPT_MRN, RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE FROM DV.RADIOLOGY_REPORT_V JOIN DT ON PT_MRN = RRPT_MRN WHERE 1=1 AND RRPT_ANC_CODE = 'NBLIVPET' AND RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE BETWEEN '2010-01-01' AND '2019-04-15' AND RRPT_ORDER_STATUS_CD IN ('PERF', 'RESC', 'RESF', 'RESI') ) A GROUP BY RRPT_MRN) , LIVER_SURG_PRE AS (SELECT DISTINCT SSE_MRN, SSE_SURG_DTE, SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD, SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC, SSP_SURG_LAST_NM, SSP_SURG_FIRST_NM, SSP_SURG_SVC_CD FROM IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE ON SSE_LOG_ID = SSP_LOG_ID AND SSE_ENC_CSN_ID = SSP_ENC_CSN_ID JOIN DT ON PT_MRN = SSE_MRN WHERE 1=1 AND SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC IN ('NBB NEEDLE BIOPSY BODY LIVER PET') AND SSE_SURG_DTE BETWEEN '2010-01-01' AND '2019-04-15' ) , LIVER_SURG AS (SELECT SSE_MRN, MIN(SSE_SURG_DTE) MIN_SSE_SURG_DTE, LISTAGG(SSE_SURG_DTE, CHR(13) || CHR(10)) WITHIN GROUP( ORDER BY SSE_SURG_DTE) AS SSE_SURG_DTE FROM LIVER_SURG_PRE GROUP BY SSE_MRN) , CT_SURG AS (SELECT NULL SSE_MRN, NULL MIN_SSE_SURG_DTE, NULL SSE_SURG_DTE, RRPT_MRN, MIN_RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE, RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE FROM PETCT UNION SELECT SSE_MRN, MIN_SSE_SURG_DTE, SSE_SURG_DTE, NULL RRPT_MRN, NULL MIN_RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE, NULL RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE FROM LIVER_SURG) , CT_SURG_F AS (SELECT COALESCE(SSE_MRN, RRPT_MRN) CT_SURG_MRN, COALESCE(MIN_SSE_SURG_DTE, MIN_RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE) CT_SURG_MIN_DTE, COALESCE(SSE_SURG_DTE, RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE) CT_SURG_DTE, MIN_SSE_SURG_DTE, SSE_SURG_DTE, MIN_RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE, RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE FROM CT_SURG) , GENEINFO AS (SELECT DISTINCT A.PT_MRN, PRPT_ACCESSION_NO, PRPT_PATH_RPT_ID, PATH_RPT_DATE, PATH_PROCEDURE_DATE, SUBSTR(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(CAST(XMLSERIALIZE(CONTENT XMLAGG(XMLELEMENT(NAME "c", R.GENE || ' | ' || COALESCE(R.GENE2, '') || ' | ' || COALESCE(R.ABERRATIONTYPE, '') || ' | ' || COALESCE(R.LOCUS, '') || ' | ' || COALESCE(R.AA_CHANGE, '') || ' | ' || COALESCE(R.NUCLEOTIDE, '') || CHR(13) || CHR(10)) ORDER BY A.PT_MRN) AS CLOB(32000)) AS VARCHAR(32000)), '<c>', ','), '</c>', ''), '', ''), '<c/>', ''), ',', ''), '&', '&'), '<', '<'), '>', '>'), 1) AS GENE_INFO FROM DT A JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_STRUCTURED_RESULTS_V R ON A.PT_MRN = R.PT_MRN AND PDRX_PATH_RPT_ID = PRPT_PATH_RPT_ID AND PDRX_ACCESSION_NO = PRPT_ACCESSION_NO GROUP BY A.PT_MRN, PRPT_ACCESSION_NO, PRPT_PATH_RPT_ID, PATH_RPT_DATE, PATH_PROCEDURE_DATE) , CRP_EXACT AS (SELECT DISTINCT LR_TEST_NAME, LR_SUBTEST_NAME FROM IDB.LAB_RESULTS WHERE 1=1 AND LOWER(LR_SUBTEST_NAME) like '%protein%' ) , CRP_G AS (SELECT DISTINCT LR_MRN, LR_PERFORMED_DTE, PATH_RPT_DATE, ABS(DAYS(LR_PERFORMED_DTE) - DAYS(PATH_RPT_DATE)) ABS_DIFF, LR_TEST_NAME, LR_SUBTEST_NAME, LR_RESULT_VALUE, LR_UNIT_MEASURE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY LR_MRN ORDER BY ABS(DAYS(LR_PERFORMED_DTE) - DAYS(PATH_RPT_DATE)) ASC) AS ROW_NUM FROM GENEINFO LEFT JOIN IDB.LAB_RESULTS ON LR_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE LR_SUBTEST_NAME IN ('C-Reactive Protein', 'C-Reactive Protein', 'C-Reactive Protein, High Sensitivity', 'C-Reactive Protein, High Sensitivity') ) SELECT DISTINCT A.PT_MRN "MRN", PRPT_ACCESSION_NO "Accession No", G.PRPT_PATH_RPT_ID "Path Report ID", G.PATH_RPT_DATE "Path Report Date", PATH_PROCEDURE_DATE "Path Procedure Date", MAX(PT_BIRTH_DTE) "DOB", MAX(PT_LAST_NAME) "Last Name", MAX(PT_FIRST_NAME) "First Name", MAX(RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE) "PET/CT Scan Date", MAX(MIN_SSE_SURG_DTE) "First Surgery Date", MAX(SSE_SURG_DTE) "Surgery Date", MAX(A.TUMOR_TYPE_NAME) "Disease Type", MAX(A.PRIMARY_SITE) "Primary Site", MAX(GENE_INFO) "Gene Info", MAX(LR_PERFORMED_DTE) "Lab Performed Date", MAX(ABS(DAYS(LR_PERFORMED_DTE) - DAYS(MIN_RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE))) "CRP Lab to PETCT Scan Day Diff", MAX(LR_TEST_NAME) "Lab Test Name", MAX(LR_RESULT_VALUE) "Lab Result", MAX(LR_UNIT_MEASURE) "Lab Unit" FROM DT A JOIN CT_SURG_F ON A.PT_MRN = CT_SURG_MRN LEFT JOIN GENEINFO G ON A.PT_MRN = G.PT_MRN LEFT JOIN CRP_G C ON A.PT_MRN = C.LR_MRN AND ROW_NUM = 1 LEFT JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS D ON A.PT_MRN = D.PT_MRN GROUP BY A.PT_MRN, PRPT_ACCESSION_NO, G.PRPT_PATH_RPT_ID, G.PATH_RPT_DATE, PATH_PROCEDURE_DATE ;

prompt: BRAF Class I/II/III mutations
completion: WITH PTS AS (SELECT PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID PID FROM DV.PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED) , DT_1 AS (SELECT PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID AS P_ID FROM DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS REC LEFT JOIN DV.PATIENT_CORE_DEMOGRAPHICS ON PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = CORE_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID WHERE 1=1 ) , DT_2 AS (SELECT INC.PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID P_ID FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_STRUCTURED_RESULTS_V INC WHERE 1=1 AND (INC.GENE IN ('BRAF') OR INC.GENE2 IN ('BRAF')) AND CASE WHEN INC.METHOD = 'IMPACT' THEN 'IMPACT' WHEN INC.METHOD like 'IMPACTv%' THEN 'IMPACT' WHEN INC.METHOD = 'ArcherHeme' THEN 'ArcherHeme' WHEN INC.METHOD like 'ArcherHemeV%' THEN 'ArcherHeme' WHEN LOWER(INC.METHOD) like LOWER('ArcherPanHemeV%') THEN 'ArcherPanHeme' WHEN INC.METHOD = 'Archer' THEN 'Archer' WHEN LOWER(INC.METHOD) like 'archerv%' THEN 'Archer' WHEN INC.METHOD like 'ACCESSv%' THEN 'ACCESS' WHEN INC.METHOD like 'IMPACTHv%' THEN 'IMPACTHeme' WHEN INC.METHOD like 'RDTB%' THEN 'RDTB' WHEN INC.METHOD like 'RDTS%' THEN 'RDTS' ELSE INC.METHOD END IN ('IMPACT') AND (UPPER(AA_CHANGE) like '%V600D%' OR UPPER(AA_CHANGE) like '%V600E%' OR UPPER(AA_CHANGE) like '%V600K%' OR UPPER(AA_CHANGE) prompt: Please provide a weekly list of same-week patient visits (inpatient and outpatient) for patients who are registered "on-study" on CTMS for 17-445.
completion: WITH CTE AS (SELECT PRO_IRB_NO, AC_MRN, AC_PVDR_OF_RECORD_NAME, ACD_TX_ST_DTE, ACD_TX_END_DTE, ACD_CONS_DTE, ACD_OFF_STUDY_DTE FROM IDB.PROTOCOL JOIN IDB.ACCRUALS ON PRO_IRB_NO = AC_IRB_NO JOIN IDB.ACCRUALS_DATES ON AC_IRB_NO = ACD_IRB_NO AND AC_SUBJ_ID_NO = ACD_SUBJ_ID_NO AND AC_SUBJ_SEQ_NO = ACD_SUBJ_SEQ_NO WHERE PRO_IRB_NO = '12-245' ) , CTE2 AS (SELECT PT_MRN, DT_DTE, PENC_ENC_DT, ENDP_CENTER_FULL_NAME, ENVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME, MP_FULL_NM FROM DV.PATIENT_ENCOUNTER JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PENC_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID JOIN DV.DATE ON PENC_ENC_DATE_ID = DT_DATE_ID LEFT JOIN DV.ENCOUNTER_DESC_CATALOG STS ON PENC_APPT_STS = STS.EDC_DEPT_ABBREV AND STS.EDC_GROUP_ID = 'STS' JOIN DV.ENCOUNTER_DEPARTMENT ON PENC_DEPT_ID = ENDP_ENC_DEPT_ID JOIN DV.ENCOUNTER_SCHD_RESOURCES ON PENC_PT_ENC_ID = ENSR_PT_ENC_ID AND ENSR_PRIMARY_RES_IND = 'Y' JOIN DV.ENCOUNTER_RESOURCE ON ENSR_RES_ID = ENR_ENC_RES_ID JOIN DV.ENCOUNTER_VISIT_TYPE ON PENC_VISIT_TYPE_ID = ENVT_ENC_VISIT_TYPE_ID LEFT JOIN DV.ENCOUNTER_DESC_CATALOG DEPT ON ENDP_SERVICE_DEPT_GRP_6 = DEPT.EDC_DEPT_ABBREV AND DEPT.EDC_GROUP_ID = '6' LEFT JOIN DV.ENCOUNTER_DESC_CATALOG SVC ON ENDP_SERVICE_SPECIALTY_GRP_8 = SVC.EDC_DEPT_ABBREV AND SVC.EDC_GROUP_ID = '8' JOIN DV.MEDPRO_V ON PENC_REF_PROVIDER_ID = MP_MEDPRO_ID WHERE PENC_APPT_STS IN ('Sch') AND DT_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT date AND CURRENT date + 7 DAYS ) SELECT PT_MRN AS "MRN", DT_DTE AS "DATE", PENC_ENC_DT AS "DATE/TIME", ENDP_CENTER_FULL_NAME AS "LOCATION", ENVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME "VISIT TYPE", MP_FULL_NM AS "REFERRING MD", PRO_IRB_NO, ACD_TX_ST_DTE AS "TREATMENT START", ACD_TX_END_DTE AS "TREATMENT END", ACD_CONS_DTE AS "CONSENT DATE", ACD_OFF_STUDY_DTE AS "OFF STUDY" FROM CTE2 JOIN CTE ON PT_MRN = AC_MRN

prompt: Provide monthly summary of incoming referrals to Benign Hematology
completion: WITH HEM_CONSULT_ORDERS AS (SELECT DISTINCT OO_MRN, OO_ORD_ID AS "Order ID", OO_ENTER_DTE AS "Order Enter Date", OO_REQUESTED_DTE AS "Order Requested Date", OO_ORD_NAME AS "Order Name", SVC.OUD_USER_DI_VALUE AS "Service Requested", RSN.OUD_USER_DI_VALUE AS "Reason for Consult", MEDYN.OUD_USER_DI_VALUE AS "Patient on Anticoagulant", MED.OUD_USER_DI_VALUE AS "Name of Medication", REFMD.OUD_USER_DI_VALUE AS "Referring Provider" FROM IDB.OMS_ORDER LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_PROVIDER ON OO_PVDR_GUID = OP_PVDR_GUID LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_USER_DATA SVC ON OO_ORD_GUID = SVC.OUD_ORD_GUID AND SVC.OUD_USER_DI_CD= 'Consult_ACM_Service' LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_USER_DATA RSN ON OO_ORD_GUID = RSN.OUD_ORD_GUID AND RSN.OUD_USER_DI_CD='Consult_ACM_Reason' LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_USER_DATA MEDYN ON OO_ORD_GUID = MEDYN.OUD_ORD_GUID AND MEDYN.OUD_USER_DI_CD='Consult_ACM_Pt on Medications' LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_USER_DATA MED ON OO_ORD_GUID = MED.OUD_ORD_GUID AND MED.OUD_USER_DI_CD='Consult_ACM_Medications' LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_USER_DATA REFMD ON OO_ORD_GUID = REFMD.OUD_ORD_GUID AND REFMD.OUD_USER_DI_CD='Consult_ACM_Referring MD' LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_USER ON OO_USER_GUID = OU_USER_GUID LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_STATUS ON OO_ORD_STS_CD = OSTS_ORD_STS_CD WHERE OO_ORD_STS_CD NOT IN ('CANC', 'CANP', 'AUC3') AND OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID ='9000008762100730' AND OO_REQUESTED_DTE BETWEEN '2024-01-01' AND CURRENT date) , BENIGN_HEM_VISIT AS (SELECT CPE_MRN AS "MRN", CPE_ENC_DTE AS "Appt Date", CLD_DEPT_NAME, CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME, CRE_RES_NAME FROM (SELECT DISTINCT OO_MRN FROM HEM_CONSULT_ORDERS) ORDERS_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER ON OO_MRN =CPE_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Comp', 'Arrived', 'Sch') AND CRE_RES_ID IN ('008615', '015396', '017442', '021105', '023713') ) SELECT "OO_MRN" AS MRN, "Order ID", "Order Enter Date", "Order Requested Date", "Order Name", "Service Requested", "Reason for Consult", "Patient on Anticoagulant", "Name of Medication", "Referring Provider", "Appt Date", "CLD_DEPT_NAME" AS "Dept Name", "CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME" AS "Visit Type", "CRE_RES_NAME" AS "Provider" FROM HEM_CONSULT_ORDERS LEFT JOIN BENIGN_HEM_VISIT ON MRN=OO_MRN ORDER BY 4, 14

prompt: I would like to complete a database on primary mediastinal germ cell tumors for which I have previously made a DataLine request a few years ago.
completion: SELECT DISTINCT "t1"."PT_MRN" AS "MRN", "t1"."PT_LAST_NAME" AS "Last Name", "t1"."PT_FIRST_NAME" AS "First Name", "t1"."PT_BIRTH_DTE" AS "Date of Birth", "t1"."PT_DEATH_DTE" AS "Deceased Date", "t1"."PT_VITAL_STATUS" AS "Vital Status", "t1"."PT_SEX_DESC" AS "Gender", "t2"."DT_DTE" AS "Tumor Diagnosis Date", "t3"."ICSC_SITE_CD" AS "ICD-O Site Code", "t3"."ICSC_ICDO_SITE_MSK_DESC" AS "ICD-O Site Description", "t4"."CDTM_CA_SURG_DTE" AS "Tumor Surgery Date", "t5"."DXCC_ICD_CODE" AS "ICD-O Histology Code", "t5"."DXCC_ICD_MSK_DESC" AS "ICD-O Histology Description", YEAR("t2"."DT_DTE" - "t6"."DT_DTE") AS "Age at Tumor Diagnosis Date - years" FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V" "t1" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED" "t7" ON "t1"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t7"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."CDB_TUMOR_V" "t4" ON "t7"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t4"."CDTM_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" "t2" ON "t4"."CDTM_DX_DATE_ID" = "t2"."DT_DATE_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."ICDO_SITE_CATALOG_V" "t3" ON "t4"."CDTM_SITE_CATALOG_ID" = "t3"."ICSC_SITE_CATALOG_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DIAGNOSIS_CODE_CAT_ICDO_V" "t5" ON "t4"."CDTM_DX_CATALOG_ID" = "t5"."DXCC_DX_CATALOG_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" "t6" ON "t1"."PT_BIRTH_DTE" = "t6"."DT_DTE" WHERE 1=1 AND "t5"."DXCC_ICD_CODE" IN ('M9060/3' ,'M9061/3' ,'M9062/3' ,'M9063/3' ,'M9064/3' ,'M9070/3' ,'M9071/3' ,'M9072/3' ,'M9073/1' ,'M9080/0' ,'M9080/1' ,'M9080/3' ,'M9081/3' ,'M9082/3' ,'M9083/3' ,'M9085/3' ,'M9100/3' ,'M9101/3' ,'M9102/3' , 'M9064/2' , 'M9065/3' , 'M9084/0' , 'M9084/3') AND "t2"."DT_DTE" >= '1975-1-1' AND YEAR("t2"."DT_DTE" - "t6"."DT_DTE") <= 22 ORDER BY PT_MRN, "t2"."DT_DTE"

prompt: Provide a report supplementing research data collected through MSK Engage with clinical and demographic data from the EMR for a retrospective research protocol.
completion: SELECT DISTINCT EF_MRN, EFI_FORM_ID, EF_SUBMISSION_DT, EF_FORM_NAME, EF_FORM_ALIAS, SUBSTR(EFI_ITEM_SEQUENCE, 1, LENGTH(EFI_ITEM_SEQUENCE) - 3) AS ITEM_SEQUENCE, EFI_ITEM_TEXT, EFI_VALUE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY EF_MRN, EFI_ITEM_TEXT ORDER BY SUBSTR(EFI_ITEM_SEQUENCE, 1, LENGTH(EFI_ITEM_SEQUENCE) - 3)) AS RN FROM IDB.EF_FORM JOIN IDB.EF_FORM_ITEM ON EFI_FORM_ID = EF_FORM_ID WHERE 1=1 AND EF_FORM_ALIAS = 'survivorship_research'

prompt: A weekly prospective list of patients with lung cancer referred for neurosurgical consultations.
completion: WITH PTS AS (SELECT DISTINCT PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID P_ID, PT_MRN FROM DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS PT JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML DT ON PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PDRX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID CROSS JOIN XMLTABLE('$c/root/*' PASSING DT.PDRX_XML_VALUE AS "c" COLUMNS DMP_PATIENT_ID VARCHAR(264) PATH '../meta-data/dmp_patient_id', DMP_SAMPLE_ID VARCHAR(264) PATH '../meta-data/dmp_sample_id', PRIMARY_SITE VARCHAR(264) PATH '../meta-data/primary_site', TUMOR_TYPE_NAME VARCHAR(264) PATH '../meta-data/tumor_type_name' , METASTASIS_SITE VARCHAR(264) PATH '../meta-data/metastasis_site') T WHERE LOWER(PRIMARY_SITE) IN ('lung') AND PT_VITAL_STATUS = 'ALIVE' ) , NEUROSURGERY AS (SELECT DISTINCT P_ID FROM PTS JOIN IDB.OMS_ORDER ON OO_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_CATALOG ON OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID = OOC_MSTR_ITEM_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_STATUS ON OO_ORD_STS_CD = OSTS_ORD_STS_CD WHERE OOC_ITEM_NAME IN ('Neurosurgery External Consult', 'Neurosurgery Inpatient Consult', 'Brain Ambulatory Consult') AND OO_ORD_STS_CD NOT IN ('CANP', 'CANC', 'AUC3') ) , DEID AS (SELECT P_ID FROM NEUROSURGERY) SELECT * FROM DEID

prompt: A list of patients who have an outpatient appt and retail pharmacy activity on the same date of service from 1/1/10 to 3/31/10.
completion: SELECT PT_MRN, RTRIM(PT_LAST_NAME)||', '||RTRIM(PT_FIRST_NAME) AS PT_NAME, CPE_ENC_DTE APPT_DATE, CLD_DEPT_NAME APPT_DEPT, CRE_RES_NAME APPT_MD, CLD_CLD_CENTER DEPT_LOCATION, CLD_SPECIALTY SPECIALTY, SUBSTR(CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6, 1, 3) DEPT_SVC, SUBSTR(COALESCE(DOC_SVC, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_4), 1, 3) DOC_SVC, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_20 CLINIC_SP, PO_RX_NO RX_NO, PO_DR_NAME AS PRESCRIBER, POD_ITEM_DESC ITEM_DESC, PO_CR_DTE CREATE_DATE, PO_DIRECTIONS DIRECTIONS, POD_STRT_DTE START_DATE, PO_DISP_LOC_NAME DISP_LOC FROM IDB.PATIENT JOIN IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER ON PT_MRN = CPE_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CRE_RES_ID = CPE_VST_RES_ID AND CRE_RES_TYP IN ('Physician', 'Dentist', 'Psychologist', 'PhD') LEFT JOIN IDB.DOC ON CRE_RES_ID = DOC_DR_NO JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.PHM_ORD_DTL ON POD_MRN = CPE_MRN AND POD_STRT_DTE = CPE_ENC_DTE JOIN IDB.PHM_ORDER ON PO_ORD_SEQ = POD_ORD_SEQ AND POD_MRN = PO_MRN WHERE CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN '2010-01-01' AND '2010-03-31' AND CPE_ENC_TYP_CD = 50 AND CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND PO_ORD_STS NOT IN ('X', 'P') AND PO_CARE_CLASS = 'AMB' AND PO_ORD_CLASS = 'AMB'

prompt: Provide the number (no MRNs) of patients who have been prescribed the drug elacestrant
completion: SELECT CASE WHEN HCPR_PRESCRIPTION_TYPE =1 THEN 'eRx' WHEN HCPR_PRESCRIPTION_TYPE = 3 THEN 'HML' ELSE 'Other' END AS RX_TYPE, COUNT(1) AS COUNTS FROM IDB.HML_CLIENT_PRESCRIPTION HCPR LEFT JOIN (SELECT HCPX_PRESCRIPTION_ID AS HX_RX_ID, HCPX_FROM_VALUE AS HX_STATUS, ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY HCPX_PRESCRIPTION_ID ORDER BY HCPX_UPD_DT ASC) AS RK FROM IDB.PATIENT JOIN IDB.HML_CLIENT_PRESCRIPTION ON HCPR_MRN=PT_MRN JOIN IDB.HML_CLIENT_PRESCRIPTION_HX ON HCPR_PRESCRIPTION_ID=HCPX_PRESCRIPTION_ID WHERE HCPX_FIELD_NAME='StatusType' AND LOWER(HCPR_DRUG_NAME) like '%elacestrant%' ) HX ON HCPR_PRESCRIPTION_ID = HX_RX_ID AND RK=1 WHERE HCPR_GENERIC_NAME_ID != -100 AND (HCPR_PRESCRIPTION_TYPE = 1 AND HCPR_TRANSMISSION_STATUS IN (1, 2, 5) OR HCPR_PRESCRIPTION_TYPE = 3) AND LOWER(HCPR_DRUG_NAME) like '%elacestrant%' GROUP BY HCPR_PRESCRIPTION_TYPE ; SELECT HCPR_STATUS_TYPE_DESC AS "Rx Status", COUNT(1) AS COUNTS FROM IDB.HML_CLIENT_PRESCRIPTION HCPR LEFT JOIN (SELECT HCPX_PRESCRIPTION_ID AS HX_RX_ID, HCPX_FROM_VALUE AS HX_STATUS, ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY HCPX_PRESCRIPTION_ID ORDER BY HCPX_UPD_DT ASC) AS RK FROM IDB.PATIENT JOIN IDB.HML_CLIENT_PRESCRIPTION ON HCPR_MRN=PT_MRN JOIN IDB.HML_CLIENT_PRESCRIPTION_HX ON HCPR_PRESCRIPTION_ID=HCPX_PRESCRIPTION_ID WHERE HCPX_FIELD_NAME='StatusType' AND LOWER(HCPR_DRUG_NAME) like '%elacestrant%' ) HX ON HCPR_PRESCRIPTION_ID = HX_RX_ID AND RK=1 WHERE HCPR_GENERIC_NAME_ID != -100 AND (HCPR_PRESCRIPTION_TYPE = 1 AND HCPR_TRANSMISSION_STATUS IN (1, 2, 5) OR HCPR_PRESCRIPTION_TYPE = 3) AND LOWER(HCPR_DRUG_NAME) like '%elacestrant%' GROUP BY HCPR_STATUS_TYPE_DESC ;

prompt: Provide pathology and demographic data for flow cytometry reports matching specific search terms.
completion: SELECT DISTINCT DMP.PRPT_MRN AS MRN , PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_BIRTH_DTE, PT_VITAL_STATUS, PT_DEATH_DTE , CASE WHEN PT_DEATH_DTE IS NULL THEN YEAR(CURRENT date - PT_BIRTH_DTE) END AS "Current Age" , DMP.PRPT_ACCESSION_NO AS "Accession No" , DMP.PRPT_REPORT_DTE AS "Report Date" , DMP.PRPT_PROCEDURE_DTE AS "Procedure Date" , SRG.PRPT_ACCESSION_NO AS RELATED_ACC_NO , SRG.PRPT_PROCEDURE_DTE AS RELATED_PROC_DTE , DMP.PRPT_REPORT_TYPE_DESC AS "Report Type" , DMP.PRPT_REPORT_TYPE , DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)diag[\w\W]*(?=I ATTEST)', DMP.PRPT_REPORT) AS DIAGNOSIS_TEXT , VARCHAR(DMP.PRPT_REPORT, 32000) AS "Report Text (first 32000 characters)" , (SELECT VARCHAR(PRPT_REPORT, 32000) AS REFERENCEDPATHTEXTFROM FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V WHERE PRPT_ACCESSION_NO = SRG.PRPT_ACCESSION_NO) AS REFERENCEDPATHTEXT FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V DMP LEFT JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_REFERENCES ON PRPTR_PATH_RPT_ID = DMP.PRPT_PATH_RPT_ID LEFT JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V SRG ON SRG.PRPT_PATH_RPT_ID = PRPTR_CHILD_PATH_RPT_ID JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = DMP.PRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID WHERE 1=1 AND DMP.PRPT_ACCESSION_NO like 'F%' AND (DMP.PRPT_REPORT_DTE >= '11/01/2020' OR DMP.PRPT_PROCEDURE_DTE >= '11/01/2020' ) AND (CONTAINS(DMP.PRPT_REPORT, '("abnormal plasma cell" OR "abnormal myeloid blast" OR "expanded abnormal myeloid blast")') = 1 AND CONTAINS(DMP.PRPT_REPORT, '("no abnormal plasma cell" OR "no abnormal myeloid blast" OR "no expanded abnormal myeloid blast")') = 0) AND DMP.PRPT_REPORT IS NOT NULL ORDER BY 1, 9, 8

prompt: Pediatric patients who received RBC or platelet transfusions
completion: WITH VITALS AS (SELECT DISTINCT CDD_MRN, CDD_SERVICE_DTE, CAST(TRIM(CDO_VALUE_TEXT) AS DECIMAL(5, 1)) AS TEMPERATURE FROM IDB.CD_DOCUMENT JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION ON CDD_DOC_GUID = CDO_DOC_GUID AND CDD_AUTHORED_DTE = CDO_AUTHORED_DTE AND CDO_VALUE_TEXT <> '' WHERE CDD_CANCEL_IND <> '1' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND <> '1' AND UPPER(CDD_DOC_NAME) LIKE '%VITAL%' AND CDO_ITEM_NAME = 'Temperature Temp C' AND CAST(TRIM(CDO_VALUE_TEXT) AS DECIMAL(5, 1)) > 38 ) SELECT DISTINCT BBP_MRN, PT_SEX, YEAR(BBP_TRANSACTION_DTE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) AGE, BBP_PRODUCT_ABRV, BBP_TRANSACTION_DTE, CASE WHEN TEMPERATURE IS NOT NULL THEN 'Y' ELSE '' END AS TEMP_ABOVE_38 FROM IDB.TRANSFUSED_BLOOD_PRODUCTS_V JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON BBP_MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN VITALS ON BBP_MRN = CDD_MRN AND BBP_TRANSACTION_DTE = CDD_SERVICE_DTE WHERE BBP_TRANSACTION_DTE BETWEEN '2021-01-01' AND '2021-04-01' AND YEAR(BBP_TRANSACTION_DTE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) < 18 AND BBP_PRODUCT_ABRV IN ('PLT', 'RBC') ORDER BY BBP_MRN, BBP_TRANSACTION_DTE ; WITH CTE AS (SELECT BBP_MRN, PT_SEX, YEAR(BBP_TRANSACTION_DTE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) AGE, BBP_PRODUCT_ABRV, BBP_TRANSACTION_DTE FROM IDB.TRANSFUSED_BLOOD_PRODUCTS_V JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON BBP_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE BBP_TRANSACTION_DTE BETWEEN '2021-01-01' AND '2021-04-01' AND YEAR(BBP_TRANSACTION_DTE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) < 18 AND BBP_PRODUCT_ABRV IN ('PLT', 'RBC') ) SELECT CC_MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS MIN_ICD_EFF_DTE, CC_CLSF_CD AS ICD_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS ICD_DESC FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN CTE ON BBP_MRN = CC_MRN WHERE CC_CLSF_CD LIKE 'C%' AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND (CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) GROUP BY CC_MRN, CC_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK ORDER BY 1, 2, 3 ; WITH CTE AS (SELECT BBP_MRN, PT_SEX, YEAR(BBP_TRANSACTION_DTE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) AGE, BBP_PRODUCT_ABRV, BBP_TRANSACTION_DTE FROM IDB.TRANSFUSED_BLOOD_PRODUCTS_V JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON BBP_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE BBP_TRANSACTION_DTE BETWEEN '2021-01-01' AND '2021-04-01' AND YEAR(BBP_TRANSACTION_DTE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) < 18 AND BBP_PRODUCT_ABRV IN ('PLT', 'RBC') ) SELECT DISTINCT BBP_MRN, PT_SEX, AGE, BBP_PRODUCT_ABRV, BBP_TRANSACTION_DTE, OPA_ALGY_TEXT, OPA_TYPE_OTHER, OPA_ALGY_REACT, OPA_ALGY_STS FROM IDB.OMS_PT_ALLERGY JOIN CTE ON BBP_MRN = OPA_MRN WHERE (UPPER(OPA_ALGY_TEXT) LIKE '%PLATELETS%' OR UPPER(OPA_ALGY_TEXT) LIKE '%BLOOD%' OR UPPER(OPA_ALGY_TEXT) LIKE '%RBC%') ; WITH CTE AS (SELECT BBP_MRN, PT_SEX, YEAR(BBP_TRANSACTION_DTE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) AGE, BBP_TRANSACTION_DTE, BBP_PRODUCT_ABRV, BBP_PRODUCT_DESC FROM IDB.TRANSFUSED_BLOOD_PRODUCTS_V JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON BBP_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE BBP_TRANSACTION_DTE BETWEEN '2021-01-01' AND '2021-04-01' AND YEAR(BBP_TRANSACTION_DTE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) < 18 AND BBP_PRODUCT_ABRV IN ('PLT', 'RBC') ) SELECT DISTINCT OO_MRN, PT_SEX, AGE, BBP_PRODUCT_ABRV, BBP_TRANSACTION_DTE, OOC_ITEM_NAME, OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE FROM IDB.OMS_ORDER JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_CATALOG ON OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID = OOC_MSTR_ITEM_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_STATUS ON OO_ORD_STS_CD = OSTS_ORD_STS_CD JOIN CTE ON OO_MRN = BBP_MRN WHERE OO_ORD_STS_CD NOT IN ('CANP', 'CANC', 'AUC3') AND OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID = '9000010906100730' ORDER BY OO_MRN, BBP_TRANSACTION_DTE, OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE ; WITH CTE AS (SELECT BBP_MRN, PT_SEX, YEAR(BBP_TRANSACTION_DTE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) AGE, BBP_TRANSACTION_DTE, BBP_TRANSACTION_DT, BBP_PRODUCT_ABRV, BBP_PRODUCT_DESC FROM IDB.TRANSFUSED_BLOOD_PRODUCTS_V JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON BBP_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE BBP_TRANSACTION_DTE BETWEEN '2021-01-01' AND '2021-04-01' AND YEAR(BBP_TRANSACTION_DTE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) < 18 AND BBP_PRODUCT_ABRV IN ('PLT', 'RBC') ) SELECT DISTINCT BBP_MRN, PT_SEX, AGE, BBP_PRODUCT_ABRV, BBP_PRODUCT_DESC, BBP_TRANSACTION_DTE, BBP_TRANSACTION_DT, OO_ORD_NAME, PROCEDURE_START, PROCEDURE_END, ORD_ROUTE FROM IDCIC.HIMVP_D02 JOIN CTE ON OO_MRN = BBP_MRN AND DATE(PROCEDURE_START) = BBP_TRANSACTION_DTE WHERE (UPPER(OO_ORD_NAME) LIKE '%ACETAMINOPHEN%' OR UPPER(OO_ORD_NAME) LIKE '%DIPHENHYDRAMINE%' OR UPPER(OO_ORD_NAME) LIKE '%HYDROCORTISONE%')

prompt: Provide BRAF/MEK inhibitor start and end dates for the provided list patients with thyroid cancers and subsequent brain metastasis.
completion: SELECT APR_MRN, CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME, MIN(APR_START_DTE) AS START_DATE, MAX(APR_END_DTE) AS END_DATE FROM IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX_V WHERE CDG_CHEMO_FLAG = 'Y' AND APR_START_DTE BETWEEN '1985-01-01' AND '2023-05-01' AND APR_END_DTE BETWEEN '1985-01-01' AND '2023-05-01' AND(UPPER(APR_GENERIC_NAME) LIKE '%VEMURAFENIB%' OR UPPER(APR_GENERIC_NAME) LIKE '%DABRAFENIB%' OR UPPER(APR_GENERIC_NAME) LIKE '%ENCORAFENIB%' OR UPPER(APR_GENERIC_NAME) LIKE '%TRAMETINIB%' OR UPPER(APR_GENERIC_NAME) LIKE '%COBIMETINIB%' OR UPPER(APR_GENERIC_NAME) LIKE '%BINIMETINIB%' OR UPPER(APR_DRUG_NAME) LIKE '%VEMURAFENIB%' OR UPPER(APR_DRUG_NAME) LIKE '%DABRAFENIB%' OR UPPER(APR_DRUG_NAME) LIKE '%ENCORAFENIB%' OR UPPER(APR_DRUG_NAME) LIKE '%TRAMETINIB%' OR UPPER(APR_DRUG_NAME) LIKE '%COBIMETINIB%' OR UPPER(APR_DRUG_NAME) LIKE '%BINIMETINIB%') AND APR_MRN IN () GROUP BY APR_MRN, CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME

prompt: Provide a one time list of Outpatient Injection only visits associated w/ vital signs for the last 6 months.
completion: WITH OUTPATIENT_INJ AS (SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN, CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID, CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME, CPE_ENC_DTE FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER CPE JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE (CPE_CPE_IP_IND <> 'INPATIENT') AND CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT date - 6 MONTHS AND CURRENT date AND CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID = 3534), VITAL_SIGNS AS (SELECT DISTINCT CDD_MRN MRN, CPE_ENC_DTE APPT_DATE, CDD_SERVICE_DTE SERVICE_DTE, CDD_AUTHORED_DT CLINDOC_AUTHORED_DT , OCV_IP_OP_IND OUTPATIENT_IND , CAST(MAX(CASE WHEN CDO_OBS_CTLG_MSTR_ITEM_GUID = '9000002617502890' THEN SUBSTR(CDO_VALUE_TEXT, 1, 6) END) AS INT) BP_SYSTOLIC , CAST(MAX(CASE WHEN CDO_OBS_CTLG_MSTR_ITEM_GUID = '9000002617302890' THEN SUBSTR(CDO_VALUE_TEXT, 1, 6) END) AS INT) BP_DIASTOLIC , CAST(MAX(CASE WHEN CDO_OBS_CTLG_MSTR_ITEM_GUID = '9000002618702890' THEN SUBSTR(CDO_VALUE_TEXT, 1, 6) END) AS INT) HEART_RATE , CAST(MAX(CASE WHEN CDO_OBS_CTLG_MSTR_ITEM_GUID = '9000002626102890' THEN SUBSTR(CDO_VALUE_TEXT, 1, 6) END) AS INT) RESP_RATE , CAST(MAX(CASE WHEN CDO_OBS_CTLG_MSTR_ITEM_GUID = '9000002626302890' THEN SUBSTR(CDO_VALUE_TEXT, 1, 6) END) AS INT) PULSE_OX , CAST(MAX(CASE WHEN CDO_OBS_CTLG_MSTR_ITEM_GUID = '9000002620502890' THEN SUBSTR(CDO_VALUE_TEXT, 1, 6) END) AS DECIMAL(7, 2)) TEMP_C , CAST(MAX(CASE WHEN CDO_OBS_CTLG_MSTR_ITEM_GUID = '9000002629302890' THEN SUBSTR(CDO_VALUE_TEXT, 1, 6) END) AS DECIMAL(7, 2)) TEMP_F , CAST(MAX(CASE WHEN CDO_MSTR_ITEM_NM LIKE 'Weight%' THEN SUBSTR(CDO_VALUE_TEXT, 1, 6) END) AS DECIMAL(7, 3)) PT_WT_KG , CAST(MAX(CASE WHEN CDO_MSTR_ITEM_NM LIKE 'Height%' THEN SUBSTR(CDO_VALUE_TEXT, 1, 6) END) AS DECIMAL(7, 3)) PT_HT_CM FROM (SELECT CDD_DOC_GUID, CDD_MRN, CDD_AUTHORED_DTE AUTH_DTE, CDD_SERVICE_DTE, CDD_DOC_NAME , CDD_AUTHORED_DT, CDD_VISIT_GUID FROM IDB.CD_DOCUMENT WHERE CDD_CANCEL_IND = '0' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND = '0' AND CDD_SERVICE_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT date - 6 MONTHS AND CURRENT date AND(CDD_DOC_NAME LIKE '%Vital Signs%' OR CDD_DOC_NAME = 'Nursing Assessment - JRSC' OR CDD_DOC_NAME = 'Nursing Perioperative Flowsheet' OR CDD_DOC_NAME LIKE '%Triage%')) A JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION ON CDD_DOC_GUID = CDO_DOC_GUID AND CDO_AUTHORED_DTE = AUTH_DTE JOIN IDB.OMS_CLIENT_VISIT ON CDD_VISIT_GUID = OCV_VISIT_GUID JOIN OUTPATIENT_INJ ON CDD_MRN=CPE_MRN AND CPE_ENC_DTE=CDD_SERVICE_DTE WHERE CDO_OBS_CTLG_MSTR_ITEM_GUID IN ('9000001189502890', '9000105100002890', '9000001188702890', '9000002626102890', '9000002626302890', '9000002620502890', '9000002617502890', '9000002617302890', '9000002618702890', '9000002629302890') AND(CDO_VALUE_TEXT > '0' OR(CDO_OBS_CTLG_MSTR_ITEM_GUID IN ('9000011478902890', '9000109369002890', '9000002627902890') AND CDO_VALUE_TEXT > '')) AND CDO_ITEM_NAME NOT LIKE '%Comment%' GROUP BY CDD_MRN, AUTH_DTE, CDD_AUTHORED_DT, CDD_DOC_GUID , OCV_IP_OP_IND, CDD_SERVICE_DTE, CPE_ENC_DTE ORDER BY 1, 2, 3, 4) SELECT * FROM VITAL_SIGNS

prompt: Get upcoming appointments for patients that need to re-submit a germline sample.
completion: WITH APPTS AS (SELECT CPE_MRN, CPE_ENC_DTE AS "Appt Date", TIME(CPE_APPT_DT) AS "Appt Time", CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 AS "Department", CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 AS "Service", CLD_DEPT_NAME AS "Department Name", CRE_RES_NAME AS "Provider Name", CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME AS "Visit Type" FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp', 'Sch') AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT date + 1 DAY AND CURRENT date + 5 DAY AND CRE_RES_NAME IN ('HORWITZ, STEVEN M.', 'MOSKOWITZ, ALISON', 'KHAN, NILOUFER', 'DAVEY, THERESA ANN', 'HANCOCK, HELEN JANE', 'LEE, DIANE EUNKYONG', 'DEPAOLA, NADIA E.K.') ) , HEMEPATH AS (SELECT PRPT_MRN, MAX(PRPT_PROCEDURE_DTE) DTE FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V WHERE PRPT_REPORT IS NOT NULL AND (LOCATE('nails', LOWER(CAST(PRPT_REPORT AS VARCHAR(32000)))) <> 0 AND LOCATE('matched', LOWER(CAST(PRPT_REPORT AS VARCHAR(32000)))) <> 0) GROUP BY PRPT_MRN) , IRB AS (SELECT ACD_MRN, MAX(ACD_CONS_DTE) CONS_DTE FROM IDB.ACCRUALS_DATES WHERE ACD_IRB_NO = '12-245' GROUP BY ACD_MRN) SELECT A.CPE_MRN AS MRN, P.PT_LAST_NAME AS "Last Name", P.PT_FIRST_NAME AS "First Name", P.PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH AS "Date of Birth", CASE WHEN H.PRPT_MRN IS NULL THEN '' ELSE 'Y' END AS PATH_NAILS, H.DTE NAILS_LATEST_DTE, CASE WHEN I.ACD_MRN IS NULL THEN '' ELSE 'Y' END AS IRB_12245, A."Appt Date", A."Appt Time", A."Department", A."Service", A."Department Name", A."Provider Name", A."Visit Type" FROM APPTS A LEFT JOIN HEMEPATH H ON A.CPE_MRN = H.PRPT_MRN LEFT JOIN IRB I ON A.CPE_MRN = I.ACD_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.PATIENT P ON A.CPE_MRN = P.PT_MRN

prompt: Provide a list of patient with anaplastic thyroid cancer treated at MSKCC between 2013 - present
completion: WITH PATH AS (SELECT DISTINCT A.PRPT_MRN "MRN" , PART_DESCRIPTION "Part Description" , PRIMARY_SITE "Primary Site" , TUMOR_TYPE_NAME "Tumor Type Name" , A.PRPT_ACCESSION_NO "Accession Number" , A.PRPT_PROCEDURE_DTE "Procedure Date" , CASE WHEN B.PT_MRN IS NOT NULL THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS "BRAF (Y/N)" FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V A JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML ON A.PRPT_PATH_RPT_ID = PDRX_PATH_RPT_ID AND A.PRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PDRX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID CROSS JOIN XMLTABLE('$c/root/*' PASSING PDRX_XML_VALUE AS "c" COLUMNS DT_PROCEDURE VARCHAR(40) PATH 'dt_procedure', PRIMARY_SITE VARCHAR(264) PATH 'primary_site', PART_DESCRIPTION varchar (264) PATH 'part_description', TUMOR_TYPE_NAME VARCHAR(264) PATH 'tumor_type_name' , TUMOR_TYPE_CODE VARCHAR(264) PATH 'tumor_type_code', IS_METASTASIS VARCHAR(3) PATH 'is_metastasis' , METASTASIS_SITE VARCHAR(264) PATH 'metastasis_site') T JOIN (SELECT T.TUMOR_TYPE_CODE TTC FROM TABLE(DV.STRING_SPLIT('THAP', ',')) S CROSS JOIN TABLE(DV.ONCOTREE_CHILDREN(COLUMN_VALUES)) T) X ON T.TUMOR_TYPE_CODE = X.TTC LEFT JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_STRUCTURED_RESULTS_V B ON A.PRPT_MRN = B.PT_MRN AND (GENE = 'BRAF' OR GENE2 = 'BRAF') WHERE 1=1 AND A.PRPT_PROCEDURE_DTE >= '2013-01-01' ) SELECT DISTINCT A."MRN" , PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH "DOB" , PT_DATE_OF_DEATH "DOD" , "Primary Site" , "Tumor Type Name" , "BRAF (Y/N)" , PLA_LST_APPT_DTE "Last Appt Date" FROM PATH A JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON A."MRN" = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY ON A."MRN" = PLA_MRN WHERE 1=1 ; WITH PATH AS (SELECT DISTINCT A.PRPT_MRN , PART_DESCRIPTION , PRIMARY_SITE , TUMOR_TYPE_NAME , A.PRPT_ACCESSION_NO , A.PRPT_PROCEDURE_DTE FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V A JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML ON A.PRPT_PATH_RPT_ID = PDRX_PATH_RPT_ID AND A.PRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PDRX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID CROSS JOIN XMLTABLE('$c/root/*' PASSING PDRX_XML_VALUE AS "c" COLUMNS DT_PROCEDURE VARCHAR(40) PATH 'dt_procedure', PRIMARY_SITE VARCHAR(264) PATH 'primary_site', PART_DESCRIPTION varchar (264) PATH 'part_description', TUMOR_TYPE_NAME VARCHAR(264) PATH 'tumor_type_name' , TUMOR_TYPE_CODE VARCHAR(264) PATH 'tumor_type_code', IS_METASTASIS VARCHAR(3) PATH 'is_metastasis' , METASTASIS_SITE VARCHAR(264) PATH 'metastasis_site') T JOIN (SELECT T.TUMOR_TYPE_CODE TTC FROM TABLE(DV.STRING_SPLIT('THAP', ',')) S CROSS JOIN TABLE(DV.ONCOTREE_CHILDREN(COLUMN_VALUES)) T) X ON T.TUMOR_TYPE_CODE = X.TTC WHERE 1=1 AND A.PRPT_PROCEDURE_DTE >= '2013-01-01' ) SELECT DISTINCT A.PRPT_MRN "MRN" , RTC_TX_PLAN_NAME "Tx Plan Name" , RTC_PRIMARY_REF_POINT "Primary Reference Point" , RTC_TX_START_DTE "Start Date" , RTC_TX_STOP_DTE "End Date" , RTC_TX_DELIVERED_DOSE "Delivered Dose" , RTC_TX_DELIVERED_FRACTIONS "Delivered Fraction" FROM PATH A LEFT JOIN IDB.RADONC_TREATMENT_COURSE ON PRPT_MRN = RTC_TX_MRN AND RTC_TX_START_DTE >= PRPT_PROCEDURE_DTE WHERE 1=1 ; WITH PATH AS (SELECT DISTINCT A.PRPT_MRN "MRN" , PART_DESCRIPTION "Part Description" , PRIMARY_SITE "Primary Site" , TUMOR_TYPE_NAME "Tumor Type Name" , A.PRPT_ACCESSION_NO "Accession Number" , A.PRPT_PROCEDURE_DTE "Procedure Date" , CASE WHEN B.PT_MRN IS NOT NULL THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS "BRAF (Y/N)" FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V A JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML ON A.PRPT_PATH_RPT_ID = PDRX_PATH_RPT_ID AND A.PRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PDRX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID CROSS JOIN XMLTABLE('$c/root/*' PASSING PDRX_XML_VALUE AS "c" COLUMNS DT_PROCEDURE VARCHAR(40) PATH 'dt_procedure', PRIMARY_SITE VARCHAR(264) PATH 'primary_site', PART_DESCRIPTION varchar (264) PATH 'part_description', TUMOR_TYPE_NAME VARCHAR(264) PATH 'tumor_type_name' , TUMOR_TYPE_CODE VARCHAR(264) PATH 'tumor_type_code', IS_METASTASIS VARCHAR(3) PATH 'is_metastasis' , METASTASIS_SITE VARCHAR(264) PATH 'metastasis_site') T JOIN (SELECT T.TUMOR_TYPE_CODE TTC FROM TABLE(DV.STRING_SPLIT('THAP', ',')) S CROSS JOIN TABLE(DV.ONCOTREE_CHILDREN(COLUMN_VALUES)) T) X ON T.TUMOR_TYPE_CODE = X.TTC LEFT JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_STRUCTURED_RESULTS_V B ON A.PRPT_MRN = B.PT_MRN AND (GENE = 'BRAF' OR GENE2 = 'BRAF') WHERE 1=1 AND A.PRPT_PROCEDURE_DTE >= '2013-01-01' ) SELECT DISTINCT A."MRN" , APR_START_DTE "Start Date" , APR_END_DTE "End Date" , CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME "Drug Name" FROM PATH A LEFT JOIN IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX ON A."MRN" = APR_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.CHEMO_DRUG_GENERIC ON APR_GENERIC_NAME = CDG_GENERIC_NAME AND CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME IN ('DABRAFENIB', 'TRAMETINIB') AND APR_START_DTE >= "Procedure Date" WHERE 1=1 ; WITH PATH AS (SELECT DISTINCT A.PRPT_MRN "MRN" , PART_DESCRIPTION "Part Description" , PRIMARY_SITE "Primary Site" , TUMOR_TYPE_NAME "Tumor Type Name" , A.PRPT_ACCESSION_NO "Accession Number" , A.PRPT_PROCEDURE_DTE "Procedure Date" , CASE WHEN B.PT_MRN IS NOT NULL THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS "BRAF (Y/N)" FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V A JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML ON A.PRPT_PATH_RPT_ID = PDRX_PATH_RPT_ID AND A.PRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PDRX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID CROSS JOIN XMLTABLE('$c/root/*' PASSING PDRX_XML_VALUE AS "c" COLUMNS DT_PROCEDURE VARCHAR(40) PATH 'dt_procedure', PRIMARY_SITE VARCHAR(264) PATH 'primary_site', PART_DESCRIPTION varchar (264) PATH 'part_description', TUMOR_TYPE_NAME VARCHAR(264) PATH 'tumor_type_name' , TUMOR_TYPE_CODE VARCHAR(264) PATH 'tumor_type_code', IS_METASTASIS VARCHAR(3) PATH 'is_metastasis' , METASTASIS_SITE VARCHAR(264) PATH 'metastasis_site') T JOIN (SELECT T.TUMOR_TYPE_CODE TTC FROM TABLE(DV.STRING_SPLIT('THAP', ',')) S CROSS JOIN TABLE(DV.ONCOTREE_CHILDREN(COLUMN_VALUES)) T) X ON T.TUMOR_TYPE_CODE = X.TTC LEFT JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_STRUCTURED_RESULTS_V B ON A.PRPT_MRN = B.PT_MRN AND (GENE = 'BRAF' OR GENE2 = 'BRAF') WHERE 1=1 AND A.PRPT_PROCEDURE_DTE >= '2013-01-01' ) SELECT DISTINCT A."MRN" , SSE_SURG_DTE "Procedure Date" , SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD "CPT Code" , SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC "CPT Desc" FROM PATH A LEFT JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT ON A."MRN" = SSE_MRN AND SSE_SURG_DTE >= "Procedure Date" LEFT JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE ON SSE_LOG_ID = SSP_LOG_ID AND SSE_ENC_CSN_ID = SSP_ENC_CSN_ID AND (SSE_SURG_LOC not like '%IR%' AND SSE_SURG_LOC not like '%ENDO%' AND SSE_SOURCE_TYPE <> 'E') WHERE 1=1 ;

prompt: Provide a list of patients with the diagnosis of monoclonal gammopathy of uncertain significance (aka MGUS) who have also had an MRI or PET scan.
completion: WITH MGUS AS (SELECT X.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY MRN ORDER BY DX_DATE) AS RN FROM (SELECT CC_MRN AS MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS DX_DATE, CLM_CLSF_CD AS DX_CODE, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS DX_DESC FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND ((CC_PT_TYPE = 'I') OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) AND CLM_CLSF_CD IN ('273.1', 'D47.2') GROUP BY CC_MRN, CLM_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK ) X) , X AS (SELECT DISTINCT MRN, DX_DATE, DX_CODE, DX_DESC FROM MGUS WHERE RN = 1 AND DX_DATE BETWEEN '2000-01-01' AND '2020-01-31' ) , Y AS (SELECT DISTINCT "t1"."PT_MRN" AS "MRN", "t2"."RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE" AS "Radiology Performed Date", "t2"."RRPT_ORDER_GROUP" AS "Radiology Order Group", "t2"."RRPT_PROCEDURE_NAME" AS "Radiology Procedure Name" FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V" "t1" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED" "t3" ON "t1"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t3"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."RADIOLOGY_REPORT_V" "t2" ON "t3"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t2"."RRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_IDENTIFICATION_MRN_V" "t4" ON "t1"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t4"."PI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" WHERE "t4"."PI_SOURCE_SYSTEM_PT_ID" IN (SELECT MRN FROM X) AND("t2"."RRPT_ORDER_GROUP" LIKE '%MR%' OR "t2"."RRPT_ORDER_GROUP" LIKE '%PET%') AND "t2"."RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE" BETWEEN '2000-01-01' AND '2020-01-31' ) , Z AS (SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN AS MRN, PT_SEX AS GENDER, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH AS DOB, PT_DATE_OF_DEATH AS DOD, COALESCE(MAX(PLA_LST_APPT_DTE, PLA_LST_DSCH_DTE), PLA_LST_APPT_DTE, PLA_LST_DSCH_DTE) AS LAST_FU_DATE, DX_DATE, DX_CODE, DX_DESC FROM IDB.PATIENT JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY ON PT_MRN = PLA_MRN JOIN X ON PT_MRN = X.MRN JOIN Y ON PT_MRN = Y.MRN) SELECT DISTINCT Y.* FROM Y JOIN Z ON Y.MRN = Z.MRN SELECT APR_MRN, APR_GENERIC_NAME, MIN(APR_START_DTE) AS START_DATE, MAX(APR_END_DTE) AS END_DATE FROM IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX_V JOIN Z ON APR_MRN = MRN WHERE CDG_CHEMO_FLAG = 'Y' AND APR_START_DTE BETWEEN '2000-01-01' AND '2020-01-31' GROUP BY APR_MRN, APR_GENERIC_NAME

prompt: Provide a report on the Arm and Shoulder Range of Motion Questionnaires from MSK Engage from 9/1/2022 to present
completion: WITH X AS (SELECT DISTINCT EF_MRN, EFI_FORM_ID, EF_FORM_NAME, EF_FORM_ALIAS, EF_SUBMISSION_DT, EFI_PARENT_ITEM_ID, EFI_ITEM_TEXT, EFI_ITEM_ALIAS, EFI_ITEM_SHORT_NAME, EFI_ITEM_EXTERNAL_ID, EFI_ITEM_SEQUENCE, LEFT(EFI_VALUE, 400) AS EFI_VALUE FROM IDB.EF_FORM JOIN IDB.EF_FORM_ITEM ON EFI_FORM_ID = EF_FORM_ID WHERE DATE(EF_SUBMISSION_DT) BETWEEN '2022-09-01' AND '2023-11-13' AND EF_FORM_NAME = 'Arm and Shoulder Range of Motion Questionnaire' ) SELECT DISTINCT X.EF_MRN, X.EF_FORM_NAME, X.EFI_FORM_ID, DATE(X.EF_SUBMISSION_DT) AS EF_SUBMISSION_DTE, X1.EFI_VALUE AS "In past 7 days, symptoms or problems with your shoulder, arm, or hand?", X2.EFI_VALUE AS "How much did problems get in the way of you opening a new or tight jar?", X3.EFI_VALUE AS "How much did problems make it hard to do heavy household chores?", X4.EFI_VALUE AS "How much did problems get in the way of you carrying a shopping bag or briefcase?", X5.EFI_VALUE AS "How much did problems get in the way of you washing your back?", X6.EFI_VALUE AS "How much did problems get in the way of you using a knife to cut food?", X7.EFI_VALUE AS "How much did problems get in the way of you doing recreational activities?", X8.EFI_VALUE AS "How much did problems get in the way of you doing social activities?", X9.EFI_VALUE AS "How much did problems get in the way of you doing regular daily activities", X10.EFI_VALUE AS "How bad was your shoulder, arm, or hand pain at its worst?", X11.EFI_VALUE AS "How bad was your tingling in your shoulder, arm, or hand at its worst?", X12.EFI_VALUE AS "How bad was your trouble sleeping at its worst?", X13.EFI_VALUE AS "Do you have a job?", X14.EFI_VALUE AS "Did any of the following problems make it hard to do your job?", X15.EFI_VALUE AS "Do you play sports or prompt: Provide a list of patients discharged to hospice from the GI Oncology service within December 2010.
completion: SELECT DISTINCT CS_MRN MRN, CS_ACCT_NO ACCT, CS_ADM_DATE ADM_DATE , CS_DSCH_DATE DC_DATE, CS_HOSP_SVC DC_SVC , STRIP(CS_DSCH_DISP)||' - '||SUBSTR(STRIP(DD.AV_DESC), 1, 63) DC_DIS , COALESCE(ENTER_DATE, OO_ENTER_DTE) ENTER_DATE , COALESCE(DC_ORD_NAME, CASE WHEN OUD_USER_DI_VALUE IS NOT NULL THEN SUBSTR(STRIP(OO_ORD_NAME)||': '||OUD_USER_DI_VALUE, 1, 125) ELSE OO_ORD_NAME END) AS DC_ORD_NAME, COALESCE(ORD_STS, OO_ORD_STS_CD) AS STS , COALESCE(ORDSUMMARY, OO_SUMMARY_LINE) AS ORDSUMMARY , COALESCE(REQUESTED_DT, OO_REQUESTED_DT) AS REQUESTED_DT FROM IDB.CASE JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS DD ON DD.AV_ELEMENT = 'CV_DSCH_STS' AND DD.AV_CODE = CS_DSCH_DISP AND CS_DSCH_DISP LIKE 'A%' AND CS_DSCH_DATE BETWEEN '2010-12-01' AND '2010-12-31' AND CS_ACCT_NO LIKE '84%' AND CS_PT_STS <> 'IP' AND CS_HOSP_SVC IN ('GIA', 'GIB') LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_ORDER ON OO_MRN = CS_MRN AND OO_ACCT_NO = CS_ACCT_NO AND OO_ORD_STS_CD NOT IN ('CANC', 'CANP', 'DISC') AND(OO_ORD_NAME LIKE 'Discharge Case M%' OR OO_ORD_NAME = 'Discharge Hospital Transfer LIP') LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_USER_DATA ON OUD_ORD_GUID = OO_ORD_GUID AND OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'HTO_TransferTo' LEFT JOIN (SELECT CS_MRN CM_MRN, CS_ACCT_NO CM_ACCT, OUO_ENTER_DTE ENTER_DATE , STRIP(OUO_ORD_STS_CD)||'-'|| OUO_STS_DESC ORD_STS , CASE WHEN OUD_USER_DI_VALUE IS NOT NULL THEN SUBSTR(STRIP(OUO_ORD_NAME)||': '||OUD_USER_DI_VALUE, 1, 125) ELSE OUO_ORD_NAME END AS DC_ORD_NAME , OO_SUMMARY_LINE ORDSUMMARY, OO_REQUESTED_DT REQUESTED_DT FROM IDB.CASE JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS DD ON DD.AV_ELEMENT = 'CV_DSCH_STS' AND DD.AV_CODE = CS_DSCH_DISP AND CS_DSCH_DISP LIKE 'A%' JOIN IDB.OMS_USER_ORDERS ON CS_MRN = OUO_MRN AND OUO_ENTER_DTE BETWEEN CS_ADM_DATE AND CS_DSCH_DATE AND OUO_IP_OP_IND = 'I' AND CS_DSCH_DATE BETWEEN '2010-12-01' AND '2010-12-31' AND CS_ACCT_NO LIKE '84%' AND CS_PT_STS <> 'IP' AND CS_HOSP_SVC IN ('GIA', 'GIB') AND OUO_ORD_STS_CD NOT IN ('CANC', 'CANP', 'DISC') AND OUO_REV_CAT_DEPT IN ('Nursing', 'Case Management') JOIN IDB.OMS_ORDER ON OUO_ORD_GUID = OO_ORD_GUID LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_USER_DATA ON OUD_ORD_GUID = OO_ORD_GUID AND OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'HTO_TransferTo' AND UCASE(OUD_USER_DI_VALUE) LIKE '%HOSPICE%' WHERE(OUO_ORD_NAME IN ('Discharge Case Mgmt Palliative/Inpt Hosp', 'Discharge Case Mgmt Home Hospice') OR(OUO_ORD_NAME LIKE 'Discharge Case M%' AND UCASE(OO_SUMMARY_LINE) LIKE '%HOSPICE%') OR(OUO_ORD_NAME = 'Discharge Hospital Transfer LIP' AND OUD_USER_DI_CD IS NOT NULL)) AND DATE(OO_STOP_DT) >= CS_DSCH_DATE) CM ON CS_MRN = CM_MRN AND CS_ACCT_NO = CM_ACCT WHERE(CS_DSCH_DISP IN ('AHH', 'ATD', 'ATC') OR CM_MRN IS NOT NULL)

prompt: Patients seen in survivorship in 2018 that have an appointment in survivorship scheduled
completion: WITH PAST_APPT AS (SELECT CPE_MRN AS "MRN", CPE_ENC_DTE AS "Appt Date", CLD_DEPT_NAME AS "Department Name", CRE_RES_NAME AS "Provider Name", CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME AS "Visit Type" FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CLD_DEPT_NAME IN ('BREAST DMT 300 E66 SVR', 'BSK SURVIVORSHIP-4', 'NAS SURVIVORSHIP-2', 'CMK SURVIVORSHIP') AND (CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR LIKE '%NV%' OR CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR LIKE '%IR%') AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN '2018-01-01' AND '2019-01-31' ) , NEXT_APPT AS (SELECT CPE_MRN AS "MRN", CPE_ENC_DTE AS "Appt Date", CLD_DEPT_NAME AS "Department Name", CRE_RES_NAME AS "Provider Name", CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME AS "Visit Type" FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Sch') AND CLD_DEPT_NAME IN ('BREAST DMT 300 E66 SVR', 'BSK SURVIVORSHIP-4', 'NAS SURVIVORSHIP-2', 'CMK SURVIVORSHIP') ) SELECT PA."MRN", PT_LAST_NAME "Last Name", PT_FIRST_NAME "First Name", PA."Appt Date" "Past Appt Date", PA."Department Name" "Past Appt Dept Name", PA."Provider Name" "Past Appt Provider", PA."Visit Type" "Past Appt Visit Type", NA."Appt Date" "Next Sch Appt Date", NA."Department Name" "Next Sch Appt Dept Name", NA."Provider Name" "Next Sch Appt Provider", NA."Visit Type" "Next Sch Appt Visit Type" FROM PAST_APPT PA JOIN NEXT_APPT NA ON PA."MRN" = NA."MRN" JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PA."MRN" = PT_MRN

prompt: Provide a list of patients with pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma (PDAC) cancer, from (01/01/2012-10/12/2022) that had both CT and MRI done for staging within +/- 4 months of diagnosis date.
completion: WITH DIAGNOSIS AS (SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME AS "Last Name" , PT_FIRST_NAME AS "First Name" , G.AV_DESC AS GENDER , PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH AS "Date of Birth" , PT_DATE_OF_DEATH AS "Date of Death", CASE WHEN PT_DATE_OF_DEATH IS NULL THEN 'Alive' ELSE 'Deceased' END AS "Vital Status" , R.AV_DESC AS RACE , E.AV_DESC AS ETHNICITY, COALESCE(MAX(PLA_LST_APPT_DTE, PLA_LST_DSCH_DTE), PLA_LST_APPT_DTE, PLA_LST_DSCH_DTE) AS "DATE OF LAST FOLLOW UP", TM_DX_DTE, TM_HIST_CD, HIST_DESC, TM_SITE_CD, SITE_DESC, BEST_STAGE, BEST_STAGE_SOURCE, MIN_ICD9_EFF_DTE, ICD9_CD, ICD9_DESC, COALESCE(TM_DX_DTE, MIN_ICD9_EFF_DTE) AS DX_DTE FROM IDB.PATIENT JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY ON PT_MRN = PLA_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS R ON R.AV_ELEMENT = 'RACE' AND R.AV_CODE = PT_RACE LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS G ON G.AV_ELEMENT = 'SEX' AND G.AV_CODE = PT_SEX LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS E ON E.AV_ELEMENT = 'PT_ETHNICITY' AND E.AV_CODE = PT_PT_ETHNICITY LEFT JOIN (SELECT TM_MRN, CS.AV_DESC AS CASE_STS, TM_DX_DTE, TM_HIST_CD, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS HIST_DESC, TM_SITE_CD, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_DESC, CASE WHEN TM_AJCC_7 NOT IN ('', '888', '999') THEN AJCC7.AV_DESC WHEN TM_AJCC NOT IN ('', '88', '99') THEN AJCC.AV_DESC WHEN TM_GENERAL_STG NOT IN ('', '9') THEN GS.AV_DESC WHEN TM_PATH_STG_GRP NOT IN ('', '88', '9', '99') THEN TM_PATH_STG_GRP ELSE CLIN.AV_DESC END AS BEST_STAGE, CASE WHEN TM_AJCC_7 NOT IN ('', '888', '999') THEN 'AJCC_7' WHEN TM_AJCC NOT IN ('', '88', '99') THEN 'AJCC' WHEN TM_GENERAL_STG NOT IN ('', '9') THEN 'GeneralStage' WHEN TM_PATH_STG_GRP NOT IN ('', '88', '9', '99') THEN 'PathStage' ELSE 'ClinicalStage' END AS BEST_STAGE_SOURCE FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS CS ON CS.AV_ELEMENT = 'CASE_STS' AND CS.AV_CODE = TM_CASE_STS LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS AJCC7 ON AJCC7.AV_ELEMENT = 'AJCC_7' AND AJCC7.AV_CODE = TM_AJCC_7 LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS AJCC ON AJCC.AV_ELEMENT = 'AJCC' AND AJCC.AV_CODE = TM_AJCC LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS GS ON GS.AV_ELEMENT = 'GENERAL_STG' AND GS.AV_CODE = TM_GENERAL_STG LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS CLIN ON CLIN.AV_ELEMENT = 'CLIN_STG_DSCR' AND CLIN.AV_CODE = TM_CLIN_STG_DSCR WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND TM_SITE_CD IN ('C250', 'C251', 'C252', 'C253', 'C257', 'C258', 'C259') AND TM_HIST_CD IN ('M8140/3', 'M8140/6', 'M8370/3', 'M8244/3', 'M8560/3', 'M8310/3', 'M8480/3') AND TM_DX_DTE BETWEEN '2012-01-01' AND '2022-10-12') AS CDB ON TM_MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN (SELECT CC_MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS MIN_ICD9_EFF_DTE, CC_CLSF_CD AS ICD9_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS ICD9_DESC FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE (CC_CLSF_CD LIKE 'C25.%' OR CC_CLSF_CD like '157.%') AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND (CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) GROUP BY CC_MRN, CC_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK HAVING MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) BETWEEN '2012-01-01' AND '2022-10-12') AS ICD9 ON CC_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE COALESCE(TM_MRN, CC_MRN) IS NOT NULL ), CTMR AS (SELECT DISTINCT RRPT_MRN, RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE, RRPT_ACCESSION_NO, RRPT_ORDER_GROUP, RRPT_PROCEDURE_NAME, RRPT_ANC_CODE, VARCHAR(RRPT_REPORT_TXT, 32000) AS REPORT_TXT FROM DIAGNOSIS JOIN DV.RADIOLOGY_REPORT_V ON PT_MRN = RRPT_MRN WHERE (RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE BETWEEN TM_DX_DTE AND TM_DX_DTE + 4 MONTH OR RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE BETWEEN TM_DX_DTE - 4 MONTH AND TM_DX_DTE) AND (RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE BETWEEN MIN_ICD9_EFF_DTE AND MIN_ICD9_EFF_DTE + 4 MONTH OR RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE BETWEEN MIN_ICD9_EFF_DTE - 4 MONTH AND MIN_ICD9_EFF_DTE) AND RRPT_ANC_CODE IN ('CTAPC', 'CTAPNC', 'CTAPCC', 'CTA2P', 'CTA2WCP', 'CTA2WP', 'CTADP', 'CTAB1', 'CTAB', 'CTAB4', 'CTCAPCE', 'CTCAPCC', 'CTCAPNC', 'CTAB2WC', 'FCDAP', 'FCDCTABPL', 'FFCDCTAP', 'FFCDCTCAP', 'CTAP3L', 'CTA3L', 'CTCACC', 'CTCAC', 'CTCANC', 'CTCAPCE', 'CTCAPCC', 'CTCAPNC', 'CTCA3L', 'CTCA3CH', 'CTCAPC', 'FCDCTCAP', 'CTAP', 'CTAPWC', 'CTAPWCP', 'CTAPWP', 'MRABPELC', 'MRABPELNC', 'MRABPELCC', 'MRABD1', 'MRABD0', 'MRABD2', 'MRADREN1', 'MRADREN', 'MRWB1', 'MRWB1', 'MRWB', 'MRWB2', 'FCDMRAP', 'FCDWB') ) SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN AS MRN, "Last Name", "First Name", GENDER, "Date of Birth", "Date of Death", "Vital Status", RACE, ETHNICITY, "DATE OF LAST FOLLOW UP", YEAR(DX_DTE - "Date of Birth") AS "Age at Diagnosis", TM_DX_DTE AS "Tumor Diagnosis Date", TM_HIST_CD AS "Histology Code", HIST_DESC AS "Histology Description", TM_SITE_CD AS "Site Code", SITE_DESC AS "Site Description", BEST_STAGE "Cancer Stage", BEST_STAGE_SOURCE AS "Cancer Stage Source", MIN_ICD9_EFF_DTE AS "ICD Date", ICD9_CD AS "ICD Code", ICD9_DESC AS "ICD Description", RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE AS "Report Performed Date", RRPT_ACCESSION_NO AS "Report Accession Number", RRPT_ORDER_GROUP AS "Report Order Group", RRPT_ANC_CODE AS "Report ANC Code", RRPT_PROCEDURE_NAME AS "Report Procedure Name", REPORT_TXT AS "Report Text" FROM DIAGNOSIS JOIN CTMR ON PT_MRN = RRPT_MRN

prompt: Provide daily census list per unit of patients with CVC
completion: SELECT CDD_DEID, OCV_IP_OP_IND, CDD_VISIT_GUID, CDD_DOC_GUID, CDD_AUTHORED_DTE, CDD_AUTH_PROV_NAME, CDD_DOC_NAME, CDD_DOCUMENT_TEXT_LENGTH, CDD_DOCUMENT_FULL_TEXT, CASE WHEN UPPER(CDD_DOCUMENT_FULL_TEXT) LIKE '%CENTRAL VENOUS ACCESS DEVICE (CVAD) PRESENT: YES%' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END CVAD_PRESENT, CASE WHEN UPPER(CDD_DOCUMENT_FULL_TEXT) LIKE '%CATHETER TYPE: TUNNELED CVC%%' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END TUNNELED_CVC, CASE WHEN UPPER(CDD_DOCUMENT_FULL_TEXT) LIKE '%CATHETER TYPE: NON%TUNNELED CVC%%' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END NON_TUNNELED_CVC, CASE WHEN UPPER(CDD_DOCUMENT_FULL_TEXT) LIKE '%CATHETER TYPE: IMPLANT%' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END IMP_PORT, OCV_CURR_LOC FROM DV.CLINDOC_FULL_TEXT_V JOIN IDB.OMS_CLIENT_VISIT ON CDD_VISIT_GUID = OCV_VISIT_GUID WHERE 1 = 1 AND CDD_DOC_NAME IN ('Nursing Ongoing Assessment-Inpatient', 'Nursing Initial Assessment, Post-Surgery/Procedure', 'Initial Assessment, IP - Nursing', 'Initial Assessment, Post-Surgery/Procedure, IP - Nursing') AND UPPER(CDD_DOCUMENT_FULL_TEXT) LIKE '%CVAD ASSESSMENT%' LIMIT 1000

prompt: Prostate patients that meet certain radiation and brachy therapy requirements. To update a clinical dataset.
completion: WITH DX AS (SELECT PT_MRN AS DX_MRN, PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID, DXCC_ICD_CODE AS "ICD-9/10 Dx Code", DXCC_ICD_MSK_DESC AS "ICD-9/10 Dx Description", MIN(DT_DTE) AS "ICD-9/10 Min Dx Date" FROM DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS JOIN DV.PATIENT_DIAGNOSIS_FINAL_ALL_V ON PDX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID JOIN DV.DATE_V ON PDX_DX_DATE_ID = DT_DATE_ID JOIN DV.DIAGNOSIS_CATALOG ON PDX_DX_CATALOG_ID = DXCC_DX_CATALOG_ID WHERE DXCC_ICD_CODE LIKE 'C61%' OR DXCC_ICD_CODE LIKE '185%' AND DT_DTE >= '2015-01-01' GROUP BY PT_MRN, DXCC_ICD_CODE, DXCC_ICD_MSK_DESC, PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID ) , BRACHY AS (SELECT PT_MRN, DT_DTE, BSC_IMPLANT_SITE, BRT_IMPLANT_TYPE, BRT_ISOTOPE, BRT_TOTAL_DOSE, BRT_DOSE_UNIT FROM DV.RADONC_BRACHY_THERAPY JOIN DV.BRACHY_SITE_CATALOG ON BRT_IMPLANT_SITE_ID = BSC_BEAM_THERAPY_ID JOIN DV.DATE ON BRT_TX_COMPL_DATE_ID = DT_DATE_ID JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON BRT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID WHERE DT_YEAR BETWEEN 2008 AND 2016 AND BSC_IMPLANT_SITE = 'Prostate' ) , BEAM AS (SELECT RTC_TX_MRN, RTC_TX_PLAN_NAME, RTC_TX_PLANNED_DOSE, RTC_TX_DELIVERED_DOSE, RTC_TX_START_DTE, RTC_TX_STOP_DTE FROM IDB.RADONC_TREATMENT_COURSE WHERE RTC_TX_PLAN_NAME = 'PROSTATE' AND YEAR(RTC_TX_START_DTE) BETWEEN 2008 AND 2016 ) , HORMONE AS (SELECT APR_MRN, APR_START_DTE, APR_END_DTE, CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME FROM IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX_V WHERE CDG_HORMONE_FLAG = 'Y' ) SELECT DISTINCT BRACHY.PT_MRN AS "MRN", BRACHY.DT_DTE AS "Brachy date", BRACHY.BSC_IMPLANT_SITE AS "Brachy site", BRACHY.BRT_IMPLANT_TYPE AS "Implant type", BRACHY.BRT_ISOTOPE AS "Isotope", BRACHY.BRT_TOTAL_DOSE AS "Total dose", BRACHY.BRT_DOSE_UNIT AS "Unit", BEAM.RTC_TX_PLAN_NAME AS "Beam Plan name", BEAM.RTC_TX_DELIVERED_DOSE AS "Beam delivered dose", BEAM.RTC_TX_START_DTE AS "Start date", BEAM.RTC_TX_STOP_DTE AS "Stop date", HORMONE.APR_START_DTE AS "Hormone start date", HORMONE.APR_END_DTE AS "Hormone end date", HORMONE.CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME AS "Hormone", DAY(APR_START_DTE - RTC_TX_START_DTE) AS "Days from radiation", CASE WHEN BRT_TOTAL_DOSE >= 8100 THEN 1 ELSE NULL END AS BRT_8100 FROM DX LEFT JOIN BRACHY ON DX_MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN BEAM ON DX_MRN = RTC_TX_MRN LEFT JOIN HORMONE ON DX_MRN = APR_MRN AND APR_START_DTE BETWEEN RTC_TX_START_DTE - 180 DAYS AND RTC_TX_START_DTE + 30 DAYS WHERE BRACHY.PT_MRN IS NOT NULL AND BEAM.RTC_TX_MRN IS NOT NULL ; WITH DX AS (SELECT PT_MRN AS DX_MRN, PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID, DXCC_ICD_CODE AS "ICD-9/10 Dx Code", DXCC_ICD_MSK_DESC AS "ICD-9/10 Dx Description", MIN(DT_DTE) AS "ICD-9/10 Min Dx Date" FROM DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS JOIN DV.PATIENT_DIAGNOSIS_FINAL_ALL_V ON PDX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID JOIN DV.DATE_V ON PDX_DX_DATE_ID = DT_DATE_ID JOIN DV.DIAGNOSIS_CATALOG ON PDX_DX_CATALOG_ID = DXCC_DX_CATALOG_ID WHERE DXCC_ICD_CODE LIKE 'C61%' OR DXCC_ICD_CODE LIKE '185%' AND DT_DTE >= '2015-01-01' GROUP BY PT_MRN, DXCC_ICD_CODE, DXCC_ICD_MSK_DESC, PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID ) , BRACHY AS (SELECT PT_MRN, DT_DTE, BSC_IMPLANT_SITE, BRT_IMPLANT_TYPE, BRT_ISOTOPE, BRT_TOTAL_DOSE, BRT_DOSE_UNIT FROM DV.RADONC_BRACHY_THERAPY JOIN DV.BRACHY_SITE_CATALOG ON BRT_IMPLANT_SITE_ID = BSC_BEAM_THERAPY_ID JOIN DV.DATE ON BRT_TX_COMPL_DATE_ID = DT_DATE_ID JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON BRT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID WHERE DT_YEAR BETWEEN 2008 AND 2016 AND BSC_IMPLANT_SITE = 'Prostate' ) , BEAM AS (SELECT RTC_TX_MRN, RTC_TX_PLAN_NAME, RTC_TX_PLANNED_FRACTIONS, RTC_TX_DELIVERED_FRACTIONS, RTC_TX_PLANNED_DOSE, RTC_TX_DELIVERED_DOSE, RTC_TX_START_DTE, RTC_TX_STOP_DTE FROM IDB.RADONC_TREATMENT_COURSE WHERE RTC_TX_PLAN_NAME = 'PROSTATE' AND YEAR(RTC_TX_START_DTE) BETWEEN 2008 AND 2016 ) SELECT DISTINCT DX.DX_MRN AS "MRN", DX."ICD-9/10 Dx Code" AS "DX Code", DX."ICD-9/10 Dx Description" AS "DX Description", DX."ICD-9/10 Min Dx Date" AS "DX Date" FROM DX LEFT JOIN BRACHY ON DX_MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN BEAM ON DX_MRN = RTC_TX_MRN WHERE BRACHY.PT_MRN IS NOT NULL AND BEAM.RTC_TX_MRN IS NOT NULL ;

prompt: A monthly report of all chemo doses administered similar to those reported in the related project
completion: SELECT DISTINCT CHM.CPO_START_DTE, CHM.CPO_YR, CHM.CPO_QTR , LAST_DAY(CURRENT DATE - 2 MONTHS)+ 1 DAYS START_DTE, LAST_DAY(CURRENT DATE - 1 MONTHS) END_DTE , CHM.CPO_CURR_LOC AS CURR_LOC, CHM.CPO_LOC_GRP AS LOCATION_GROUPS , CASE WHEN CHM.CPO_IP_OP_IND = 'I' THEN 'INPATIENT' WHEN CHM.CPO_IP_OP_IND = 'O' THEN 'OUTPATIENT' ELSE 'OTHER' END AS SITE_GRP , CHM.CPO_IP_OP_IND, CHM.CPO_ORD_TYPE , CHM.CPO_MRN MRN , CHM.CPO_ORD_GUID AS ORD_GUID, CHM.CPO_ORDID AS ORDID , CHM.CPO_ORD_NAME ORD_NAME, CHM.CPO_SET_NAME AS SET_NAME , CHM.CPO_SVC_TYPE AS PAT_TYPE , CASE WHEN CHM.CPO_ORAL_CHEMO_IND = 'Y' THEN 'ORAL' ELSE 'PARENTERAL' END CHEMO_TYPE , 1 AS ORD_CNT , CHM.CPO_ADMIN_CNT FROM IDB.CHEMO_PERFORMED_ORDERS CHM WHERE CHM.CPO_START_DTE >= LAST_DAY(CURRENT DATE - 2 MONTHS)+ 1 DAYS AND CHM.CPO_START_DTE <= LAST_DAY(CURRENT DATE - 1 MONTHS) AND(CHM.CPO_CHEMO_IND = 'Y' OR CHM.CPO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID IN ('2000004686073029', '9000009472200730'))

prompt: Provide a list of all patients diagnosed with IDC10 codes related to Barrett's esophagus.
completion: WITH DIAG AS (SELECT DISTINCT CC_MRN AS MRN, CC_CLSF_CD AS ICD9_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS ICD9_DESC FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE CC_CLSF_CD IN ('K22.70', 'K22.71', 'K22.710', 'K22.711', 'K22.719') AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND (CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) ) , PROCE AS (SELECT SSE_MRN AS MRN, SSE_SURG_DTE, SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD, SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC, SSP_SURG_LAST_NM, SSP_SURG_FIRST_NM, SSP_SURG_SVC_CD FROM DIAG JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT ON MRN = SSE_MRN JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE ON SSE_LOG_ID = SSP_LOG_ID AND SSE_ENC_CSN_ID = SSP_ENC_CSN_ID WHERE (SSE_SURG_LOC not like '%IR%' AND SSE_SURG_LOC not like '%ENDO%' AND SSE_SOURCE_TYPE <> 'E') AND SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD IN ('43235', '43202', '74220') AND SSP_SURG_LAST_NM IN ('MOLENA', 'SIHAG', 'SCHATTNER', 'GERDES', 'SHAH') AND SSP_SURG_FIRST_NM IN ('DANIELA', 'SMITA', 'MARK', 'HANS', 'PARI MAYANK') ), PAT AS (SELECT MRN, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, PT_SEX FROM PROCE LEFT JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON MRN = PT_MRN) , VISIT AS (SELECT MRN, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, PT_SEX, MIN(CPE_ENC_DTE) AS "Date of First Visit", CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME AS "Visit Type", CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 AS "Department", CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 AS "Service", CLD_DEPT_NAME AS "Department Name", CRE_RES_NAME AS "Provider Name", CLD_CLD_CENTER AS "Location" FROM PAT LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER ON MRN = CPE_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN '2018-01-01' AND CURRENT DATE GROUP BY MRN, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, PT_SEX, CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8, CLD_DEPT_NAME, CRE_RES_NAME, CLD_CLD_CENTER ) SELECT * FROM VISIT ;

prompt: Provide data on patients who had MRI/MRSI between July 2003 and December 2007 and a Radical Prostatectomy since July 2003.
completion: WITH CTE AS (SELECT PT_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, PBC_CPT_CD AS MRI_CPT_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS MRI_CPT_DESC, PBD_SVC_DTE AS MRI_SVC_DTE FROM IDB.PBD_DTL JOIN IDB.PBD_INVOICE ON PBD_INV_NO = PBI_INV_NO JOIN IDB.PBD_CODE ON PBD_PBD_CD = PBC_PBD_CD JOIN IDB.CLM ON PBC_CPT_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PBD_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE PBD_SVC_DTE BETWEEN '2003-07-01' AND '2007-12-31' AND PBC_CPT_CD IN ('72195', '72196', '72197', '76390') ) SELECT PT_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, MRI_CPT_CD, MRI_CPT_DESC, MRI_SVC_DTE, PBC_CPT_CD AS RP_CPT_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK RP_CPT_DESC, PBD_SVC_DTE RP_SVC_DTE FROM IDB.PBD_DTL JOIN CTE ON PBD_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.PBD_INVOICE ON PBD_INV_NO = PBI_INV_NO JOIN IDB.PBD_CODE ON PBD_PBD_CD = PBC_PBD_CD JOIN IDB.CLM ON PBC_CPT_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE PBD_SVC_DTE >= '2003-07-01' AND PBC_CPT_CD IN ('55810', '55812', '55815', '55840', '55842', '55845', '55862', '55865', '55866')

prompt: Create a list of all neuroblastoma patients seen at MSK
completion: WITH CDB1 AS (SELECT DISTINCT TM_MRN AS MRN, TM_DX_DTE AS DX_DATE, TM_SITE_CD AS SITE_CODE, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_DESC, TM_HIST_CD AS HIST_CODE, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS HIST_DESC, STRIP(H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK) || ' | ' || STRIP(S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK) AS ICDO_DX FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD WHERE 1=1 AND TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND TM_HIST_CD IN ('M9500/3', 'M9500/6') ) , CDB2 AS (SELECT MRN, LISTAGG(COALESCE(STRIP(CAST(ICDO_DX AS VARCHAR(12000))), '') , CHR(13) || CHR(10)) WITHIN GROUP( ORDER BY MRN) AS ICDO_DX FROM (SELECT DISTINCT MRN, ICDO_DX FROM CDB1) D GROUP BY MRN) , CC AS (SELECT CC_MRN AS MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS DX_DATE, CLM_CLSF_CD AS DX_CODE, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS DX_DESC FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND CASE WHEN CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y' THEN 'Y' WHEN CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' AND YEAR(CC_EFF_DTE) < 2004 THEN 'Y' WHEN CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND YEAR(CC_EFF_DTE) < 2001 THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END = 'Y' AND CC_PT_TYPE <> 'E' AND CC_CLSF_CD IN ('C74.00', 'C74.01', 'C74.02', 'C74.10', 'C74.11', 'C74.12', 'C74.90', 'C74.91', 'C74.92', '194.0') GROUP BY CC_MRN, CLM_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK ) , CC2 AS (SELECT MRN, LISTAGG(COALESCE(STRIP(CAST(DX_CODE AS VARCHAR(1000))), '') || ' | ' || COALESCE(STRIP(CAST(DX_DESC AS VARCHAR(1000))), '') , CHR(13) || CHR(10)) WITHIN GROUP( ORDER BY MRN, DX_DATE, DX_CODE) AS ICD10_DX FROM CC GROUP BY MRN) , IMPACT AS (SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN AS MRN, TUMOR_TYPE_NAME, TUMOR_TYPE_CODE, PRIMARY_SITE FROM DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML DT ON PDRX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID CROSS JOIN XMLTABLE('$c/root/*' PASSING DT.PDRX_XML_VALUE AS "c" COLUMNS SAMPLEID VARCHAR(100) PATH '../meta-data/dmp_sample_id', PATIENTID VARCHAR(100) PATH '../meta-data/dmp_patient_id', TUMOR_TYPE_CODE VARCHAR(100) PATH '../meta-data/tumor_type_code', TUMOR_TYPE_NAME VARCHAR(255) PATH '../meta-data/tumor_type_name', PRIMARY_SITE VARCHAR(255) PATH '../meta-data/primary_site') T WHERE 1=1 AND TUMOR_TYPE_CODE like '%NBL%' ) , IMPACT2 AS (SELECT MRN, LISTAGG(STRIP(TUMOR_TYPE_NAME) || ' | ' || STRIP(PRIMARY_SITE) , CHR(13) || CHR(10)) WITHIN GROUP( ORDER BY MRN, TUMOR_TYPE_NAME, PRIMARY_SITE) AS IMPACT_TUMOR_TYPE FROM IMPACT GROUP BY MRN) , PATH AS (SELECT DISTINCT "t1"."PT_MRN" AS "MRN", "t2"."PRPT_ACCESSION_NO" AS "Pathology Report", "t3"."PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_DESC" AS "Pathology Report Type", "t4"."DT_DTE" AS "Pathology Procedure Date", UPPER(CASE WHEN LENGTH(PRPT_REPORT) <= 15000 THEN RTRIM(CAST(SUBSTR(PRPT_REPORT, 1, 15000) AS VARCHAR(15000))) ELSE CAST(SUBSTR(PRPT_REPORT, 1, 15000) AS VARCHAR(15000)) END) AS TXT, CASE WHEN UPPER(DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)DIAGNOSIS:[\w\W]*(?=I ATTEST)', PRPT_REPORT)) <> '' THEN UPPER(DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)DIAGNOSIS:[\w\W]*(?=I ATTEST)', PRPT_REPORT)) WHEN UPPER(DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)DIAGNOSIS:[\w\W]*(?=NOTE:)', PRPT_REPORT)) <> '' THEN UPPER(DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)DIAGNOSIS:[\w\W]*(?=NOTE:)', PRPT_REPORT)) WHEN UPPER(DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)DIAGNOSIS:[\w\W]*(?=REPORT ELECTRONICALLY SIGNED OUT )', PRPT_REPORT)) <> '' THEN UPPER(DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)DIAGNOSIS:[\w\W]*(?=REPORT ELECTRONICALLY SIGNED OUT )', PRPT_REPORT)) END AS DIAGNOSIS FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V" "t1" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED" "t6" ON "t1"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t6"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V" "t2" ON "t6"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t2"."PRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATH_RPRT_TYPE_LOOKUP" "t3" ON "t2"."PRPT_REPORT_TYPE" = "t3"."PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_CD" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" "t4" ON "t2"."PRPT_PROCEDURE_DATE_ID" = "t4"."DT_DATE_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" "t5" ON "t2"."PRPT_REPORT_DATE_ID" = "t5"."DT_DATE_ID" WHERE 1=1 AND CONTAINS("t2"."PRPT_REPORT", '("NEUROBLASTOMA" OR "NBL")') = 1 AND "t2"."PRPT_REPORT" IS NOT NULL ) , X AS (SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN AS MRN, STRIP(PT_LAST_NAME) || ', ' || STRIP(PT_FIRST_NAME) AS NAME, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH AS DOB, PT_SEX AS GENDER, R.AV_DESC AS "Race", E.AV_DESC AS "Ethnicity", PT_DATE_OF_DEATH AS DOD, COALESCE(MAX(PLA_LST_APPT_DTE, PLA_LST_DSCH_DTE), PLA_LST_APPT_DTE, PLA_LST_DSCH_DTE) AS LAST_FU_DATE, ICDO_DX, ICD10_DX, IMPACT_TUMOR_TYPE, CASE WHEN PATH.MRN IS NOT NULL THEN 'Y' END AS PATH_REPORT FROM IDB.PATIENT JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY ON PT_MRN = PLA_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS R ON PT_RACE = R.AV_CODE AND R.AV_ELEMENT = 'RACE' LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS E ON PT_PT_ETHNICITY = E.AV_CODE AND E.AV_ELEMENT = 'PT_ETHNICITY' LEFT JOIN CDB2 ON PT_MRN = CDB2.MRN LEFT JOIN CC2 ON PT_MRN = CC2.MRN LEFT JOIN IMPACT2 ON PT_MRN = IMPACT2.MRN LEFT JOIN PATH ON PT_MRN = PATH.MRN WHERE 1=1 AND(CDB2.MRN IS NOT NULL OR CC2.MRN IS NOT NULL OR IMPACT2.MRN IS NOT NULL OR PATH.MRN IS NOT NULL) ) , SRG AS (SELECT DISTINCT SSE_MRN, STRIP(SSP_SURG_LAST_NM) || ', ' || STRIP(SSP_SURG_FIRST_NM) || ' | ' || STRIP(SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD) || ' - ' || STRIP(SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC) AS SURGERY FROM IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT JOIN X ON SSE_MRN = MRN JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE ON SSE_LOG_ID = SSP_LOG_ID WHERE 1=1 AND SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD NOT LIKE '9999%' AND SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD NOT LIKE '0000%' AND SSE_SURG_LOC not like '%IR%' AND SSE_SURG_LOC not like '%ENDO%' AND SSE_SOURCE_TYPE <> 'E' ) , SRG2 AS (SELECT SSE_MRN, LISTAGG(COALESCE(STRIP(CAST(SURGERY AS VARCHAR(8000))), '') , CHR(13) || CHR(10)) WITHIN GROUP( ORDER BY SSE_MRN, SURGERY) AS SURGERIES FROM SRG GROUP BY SSE_MRN) SELECT X.*, SURGERIES FROM X LEFT JOIN SRG2 ON MRN = SSE_MRN

prompt: PET scans and results for select MRN list

completion: SELECT RVCD_MRN "MRN", VIS_IP_OP_ADJUSTED_IND "IP_OP_ADJUSTED_IND", VIS_PATIENT_TYPE "PATIENT TYPE", RVCD_SVC_DTE "SERVICE DATE", CHARGE_CD, CHARGE_DESCRIPTION FROM IDB.RMS_VISIT_CHARGE_DTL_V WHERE CHARGE_CD IN ('LAB001528', 'LAB001522', 'LAB001521', 'LAB001891', 'LAB001523', 'LAB001525', 'LAB 001526', 'LAB001713', 'LAB001527') AND RVCD_SVC_DTE BETWEEN '1/1/2023' AND '3/31/2023' ; SELECT DISTINCT CDD_MRN AS "MRN", CDD_SERVICE_DTE AS "Service Date", CDD_DOC_NAME AS "Document Name", CDO_SECTION AS "Section" FROM IDB.CD_DOCUMENT LEFT JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION ON CDD_DOC_GUID = CDO_DOC_GUID AND CDD_AUTHORED_DTE = CDO_AUTHORED_DTE AND CDO_VALUE_TEXT <> '' WHERE CDD_CANCEL_IND <> '1' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND <> '1' AND CDD_DOC_NAME = 'Nursing Procedure - Lab Medicine' AND CDO_SECTION = 'Reason For Visit: Procedure' AND CDD_SERVICE_DTE BETWEEN '2023-01-01' AND '2023-03-31' ;

prompt: Provide a one-time report that includes demographics for pediatric patients (defined as < 21 years of age) enrolled on to therapeutic clinical trials in the last 5 years. Please assign Cynthia Chu to this request. Data to be sent to Rodriguez-Hernandez, Alexandra (rodria17@mskcc.org).
completion: WITH RAW AS (SELECT PT_MRN, R.AV_DESC AS RACE, E.AV_DESC AS ETHNICITY, ACD_IRB_NO, ACD_CONS_DTE, YEAR(ACD_CONS_DTE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) AGE_AT_CONSENT FROM IDB.ACCRUALS_DATES JOIN IDB.PROTOCOL ON ACD_IRB_NO = PRO_IRB_NO JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON ACD_MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS R ON PT_RACE = R.AV_CODE AND R.AV_ELEMENT = 'RACE' LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS E ON PT_PT_ETHNICITY = E.AV_CODE AND E.AV_ELEMENT = 'PT_ETHNICITY' WHERE PRO_PROTOCOL_TYPE IN ('Therapeutic', 'Therapeutic/QOL') AND YEAR(ACD_CONS_DTE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) < 21 AND ACD_CONS_DTE BETWEEN '2018-01-01' AND '2022-12-31' ) SELECT ACD_IRB_NO PROTOCOL, RACE, ETHNICITY, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN YEAR(ACD_CONS_DTE) = '2018' THEN PT_MRN END) CONSENT_2018, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN YEAR(ACD_CONS_DTE) = '2019' THEN PT_MRN END) CONSENT_2019, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN YEAR(ACD_CONS_DTE) = '2020' THEN PT_MRN END) CONSENT_2020, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN YEAR(ACD_CONS_DTE) = '2021' THEN PT_MRN END) CONSENT_2021, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN YEAR(ACD_CONS_DTE) = '2022' THEN PT_MRN END) CONSENT_2022 FROM RAW GROUP BY ACD_IRB_NO, RACE, ETHNICITY ORDER BY ACD_IRB_NO, RACE, ETHNICITY
