'M8022/3', 'M8030/3', 'M8031/3', 'M8032/3', 'M8033/3', 'M8046/3', 'M8052/2', 'M8052/3', 'M8070/2', 'M8070/3', 'M8071/2', 'M8071/3', 'M8072/3', 'M8073/3', 'M8074/2', 'M8074/3', 'M8083/3', 'M8140/2', 'M8140/3', 'M8250/2', 'M8250/3', 'M8251/3', 'M8252/3', 'M8253/3', 'M8254/3', 'M8255/3', 'M8260/2', 'M8260/3', 'M8310/3', 'M8333/3', 'M8480/2', 'M8480/3', 'M8481/3', 'M8490/2', 'M8490/3', 'M8560/2', 'M8560/3', 'M8572/3', 'M8574/3', 'M8972/3', 'M8973/3', 'M8980/3') ) SELECT PT_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_BIRTH_DTE, PT_DEATH_DTE, PT_SEX_DESC, DTRPT.DT_DTE AS REPORTDATE, SITE1_GENE, SITE2_GENE, GENE_ID, AA_CHANGE, CDNA_CHANGE, GENE_FOLD_CHANGE, EXON_NUM, TUMOR_TYPE_NAME, PRIMARY_SITE, METASTASIS_SITE FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML INNER JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML_SETTINGS ON PDRX_PATH_DMP_RESULTS_XML_ID = PDRXS_PATH_DMP_RESULTS_XML_ID INNER JOIN DVDMC.PATHOLOGY_DMP_WEBSVC_SETTINGS ON PDRXS_SETTING_ID = PDWS_SETTING_ID INNER JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON PDRX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID INNER JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT ON PDRX_PATH_RPT_ID = PRPT_PATH_RPT_ID LEFT JOIN DV.DATE DTRPT ON PRPT_REPORT_DATE_ID = DTRPT.DT_DATE_ID, XMLTABLE('$c/root/*' PASSING PDRX_XML_VALUE AS "c" COLUMNS VARIANT_CLASS VARCHAR(100) PATH 'variant_class', SITE1_GENE VARCHAR(100) PATH 'site1_gene', SITE2_GENE VARCHAR(100) PATH 'site2_gene', GENE_ID VARCHAR(100) PATH 'gene_id', EXON_NUM VARCHAR(100) PATH 'exon_num', AA_CHANGE VARCHAR(100) PATH 'aa_change', CDNA_CHANGE VARCHAR(100) PATH 'cDNA_change', GENE_FOLD_CHANGE VARCHAR(100) PATH 'gene_fold_change', VARIANT_TYPE VARCHAR(100) PATH './local-name(.)', PROJECT VARCHAR(100) PATH '../meta-data/dmp_alys_task_name', SAMPLEID VARCHAR(100) PATH '../meta-data/dmp_sample_id', PATIENTID VARCHAR(100) PATH '../meta-data/dmp_patient_id', TUMOR_TYPE_CODE VARCHAR(100) PATH '../meta-data/tumor_type_code', TUMOR_TYPE_NAME VARCHAR(255) PATH '../meta-data/tumor_type_name', IS_METASTASIS VARCHAR(10) PATH '../meta-data/is_metastasis', PRIMARY_SITE VARCHAR(255) PATH '../meta-data/primary_site', METASTASIS_SITE VARCHAR(255) PATH '../meta-data/metastasis_site') T WHERE PDWS_NAME = 'IMPACT' AND TUMOR_TYPE_CODE IN ('NSCLC', 'NSCLCPD') AND (GENE_ID IN ('YES1', 'YAP1') OR SITE1_GENE IN ('YES1', 'YAP1') OR SITE2_GENE IN ('YES1', 'YAP1')) AND VARIANT_TYPE <> 'meta-data' AND PT_MRN IN (SELECT TM_MRN FROM DX) ;

prompt: Breast Surgery 2021 and O6-107 Consenting Success

prompt: Create a report on older AML patients referred to a tertiary academic transplant center (MSKCC).
completion: WITH AML AS (SELECT TM_MRN AS MRN, TM_DX_DTE AS DX_DATE, TM_HIST_CD AS DX_CODE, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS DX_DESC FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.SEERGROUPING ON RECODE = IDB.SEERF_ICDO(TM_SITE_CD, TM_HIST_CD) AND CATEGORY3 = 'Acute Myeloid Leukemia' JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD WHERE 1=1 AND TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') UNION SELECT CC_MRN AS MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS DX_DATE, CLM_CLSF_CD AS DX_CODE, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS DX_DESC FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.SEERGROUPING ON RECODE = MIN(IDB.SEERF_ICD9(CLM_CLSF_CD), IDB.SEERF_ICD10(CLM_CLSF_CD)) AND CATEGORY3 = 'Acute Myeloid Leukemia' WHERE CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND ((CC_PT_TYPE = 'I') OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) GROUP BY CC_MRN, CLM_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK ) , CTE AS (SELECT MRN AS DX_MRN, DX_DATE, STRIP(DX_CODE) || '-' || STRIP(DX_DESC) AS DX_CODE FROM AML) , CTE2 AS (SELECT * FROM CTE ORDER BY DX_MRN, DX_DATE, DX_CODE) , T1 AS (SELECT DX_MRN, DX_DATE, DX_CODE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY DX_MRN ORDER BY DX_DATE) AS RN FROM CTE2 ORDER BY DX_MRN, DX_DATE) , T2 (MRN, DX, RN1) AS (SELECT DX_MRN, CAST(DX_DATE AS VARCHAR(6000))||' | '||CAST(DX_CODE AS VARCHAR(100)), RN FROM T1 WHERE T1.RN = 1 UNION ALL SELECT DX_MRN, RTRIM(CAST(DX AS VARCHAR(4000))) || ', ' || CHR(13) || CHR(10) || CAST(DX_DATE AS VARCHAR(100))||' | '||RTRIM(CAST(DX_CODE AS VARCHAR(100))) , RN1 + 1 FROM T1, T2 WHERE DX_MRN = MRN AND RN = RN1+1 ) , T3 AS (SELECT MRN, MAX(RN1) RN FROM T2 GROUP BY MRN) , T4 AS (SELECT T2.MRN, RN, DX FROM T2 JOIN T3 ON T2.MRN = T3.MRN AND T2.RN1 = T3.RN) , ALLO AS (SELECT CBM_MRN, MIN(CBM_TRANSPLANT_DTE) AS BMT_DATE FROM IDB.CRDB_BMT_MEDICINE JOIN T4 ON CBM_MRN = MRN WHERE 1=1 AND CBM_TRANSPLANT_TYPE = 'ALLO' GROUP BY CBM_MRN ) , BMT AS (SELECT DISTINCT CDD_MRN, CDD_SERVICE_DTE, CDD_DOC_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CDD_MRN ORDER BY CDD_SERVICE_DTE) AS RN FROM IDB.CD_DOCUMENT JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PT_MRN = CDD_MRN WHERE CDD_CANCEL_IND = '0' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND = '0' AND CDD_DOC_NAME IN ('Initial Consult/Initial Visit - BMT', 'Initial Consult/Initial Visit, AMB - DOM-Bone Marrow Trans', 'Initial Consult/Initial Visit, AMB - DOM-Bone Marrow Transpl', 'Initial Consult/Initial Visit, IP - DOM-Bone Marrow Transpla', 'Initial Consultation - BMT') AND CDD_MRN IN (SELECT DISTINCT MRN FROM AML) AND CDD_SERVICE_DTE BETWEEN '2010-08-01' AND '2019-05-15' AND YEAR(CDD_SERVICE_DTE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) >= 65 ) , BMT_INIT AS (SELECT * FROM BMT WHERE RN = 1 ) , GER AS (SELECT DISTINCT CDD_MRN, CDD_SERVICE_DTE, CDD_DOC_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CDD_MRN ORDER BY CDD_SERVICE_DTE) AS RN FROM IDB.CD_DOCUMENT JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION ON CDO_DOC_GUID = CDD_DOC_GUID AND CDO_AUTHORED_DTE = CDD_AUTHORED_DTE WHERE CDD_CANCEL_IND = '0' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND = '0' AND CDD_DOC_NAME IN ('Initial Consult/Initial Visit - Geriatric', 'Initial Consult/Initial Visit, AMB - DOM-Geriatrics', 'Initial Consult/Initial Visit, AMB - DOM-Geriatrics', 'Initial Consult/Initial Visit, IP - DOM-Geriatrics') AND CDD_MRN IN (SELECT DISTINCT MRN FROM AML) ) , GER_INIT AS (SELECT * FROM GER WHERE RN = 1 ) , EF1 AS (SELECT DISTINCT EF_MRN, EFI_FORM_ID, EF_FORM_NAME, EF_FORM_ALIAS, DATE(EF_SUBMISSION_DT) AS EF_DATE, EFI_ITEM_TEXT, EFI_ITEM_ALIAS, EFI_VALUE FROM IDB.EF_FORM JOIN IDB.EF_FORM_ITEM ON EF_FORM_ID = EFI_FORM_ID WHERE EF_FORM_ALIAS = 'erfa' AND EF_MRN IN (SELECT DISTINCT CDD_MRN FROM BMT) ) , EF2 AS (SELECT DISTINCT EF_MRN, EFI_FORM_ID, EF_FORM_ALIAS, EF_DATE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY EF_MRN ORDER BY EF_DATE, EFI_FORM_ID) AS RN FROM EF1) , EF3 AS (SELECT * FROM EF2 WHERE RN = 1 ) , EF4 AS (SELECT EF1.* FROM EF1 JOIN EF3 ON EF1.EF_MRN = EF3.EF_MRN AND EF1.EFI_FORM_ID = EF3.EFI_FORM_ID) , FINAL AS (SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN AS MRN, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH AS DOB, PT_DATE_OF_DEATH AS DOD, PT_SEX AS GENDER, DX, BMT_DATE, BI.CDD_DOC_NAME AS DOC_NAME1, BI.CDD_SERVICE_DTE AS CDD_SERVICE_DTE1, YEAR(BI.CDD_SERVICE_DTE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) AS AGE, GI.CDD_DOC_NAME AS DOC_NAME2, GI.CDD_SERVICE_DTE AS CDD_SERVICE_DTE2, EF_FORM_ALIAS, EF_DATE FROM IDB.PATIENT JOIN T4 ON PT_MRN = T4.MRN JOIN BMT_INIT BI ON PT_MRN = BI.CDD_MRN LEFT JOIN GER_INIT GI ON PT_MRN = GI.CDD_MRN LEFT JOIN EF3 ON PT_MRN = EF3.EF_MRN LEFT JOIN ALLO ON PT_MRN = ALLO.CBM_MRN ) SELECT * FROM FINAL

prompt: Provide a one-time list of all patients with adrenal cortical carcinoma (ACC) who have received pembrolizumab at MSKCC from 2015 to the present
completion: WITH DIAG AS (SELECT DISTINCT CC_MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS MIN_ICD9_EFF_DTE, CC_CLSF_CD AS ICD9_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS ICD9_DESC FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE 1=1 AND CC_CLSF_CD IN ('C74.00', 'C74.01', 'C74.02', 'C74.10', 'C74.11', 'C74.12', 'C74.90', 'C74.91', 'C74.92', '194.0') AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND (CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) GROUP BY CC_MRN, CC_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK ) SELECT DISTINCT APR_MRN AS MRN, FIRST_NAME, LAST_NAME, DRUG_START_DATE FROM (SELECT APR_MRN, PT_FIRST_NAME AS FIRST_NAME, PT_LAST_NAME AS LAST_NAME, APR_START_DTE AS DRUG_START_DATE, ICD9_DESC, ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY APR_MRN ORDER BY APR_START_DTE ASC) AS RN FROM IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX JOIN IDB.CHEMO_DRUG_GENERIC ON APR_GENERIC_NAME = CDG_GENERIC_NAME JOIN DIAG ON CC_MRN = APR_MRN JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PT_MRN = APR_MRN JOIN IDB.ACCRUALS ON AC_MRN = APR_MRN WHERE 1=1 AND CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME IN('PEMBROLIZUMAB' ) AND APR_START_DTE BETWEEN '2015-01-01' AND '2022-10-18' ) WHERE RN = 1

prompt: Provide a list of oral cavity cancer patients who meet specific diagnostic criteria and who underwent induction chemotherapy prior to surgery for the 5 years ending on 2021 Oct 5
completion: WITH SURG AS (SELECT DISTINCT PBD_MRN AS S_MRN, PBD_INV_NO, PBD_SVC_DTE AS ORAL_SURG_DTE, PBC_CPT_CD AS "Surgery Procedure Code", CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS "Surgery Procedure Description", DOC_NAME AS "Surgeon Name" FROM IDB.PBD_DTL_CHARGES PDC JOIN IDB.PBD_CODE ON PBD_PBD_CD = PBC_PBD_CD JOIN IDB.CLM ON PBC_CPT_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.PBD_INVOICE ON PBD_INV_NO = PBI_INV_NO JOIN IDB.DOC ON PBI_PERFORM_DR_NO = DOC_DR_NO AND PBI_INV_STS = '' WHERE PBD_SVC_DTE BETWEEN DATE('2021-10-05') - 5 YEAR AND DATE('2021-10-05') AND PBC_CPT_CD IN ('21025', '21040', '21044', '21045', '21198', '40810', '40812', '40814', '40818', '41110', '41112', '41113', '41 DOC_IDB_PRCS_DTE116', '41120', '41130', '41135', '41140', '41150', '41153', '41155', '31225', '31230')), FLAP AS (SELECT DISTINCT PBD_MRN AS F_MRN, PBD_SVC_DTE AS FLAP_SURG_DTE, PBC_CPT_CD AS "Flap Procedure code", CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS "Flap Procedure Description" FROM IDB.PBD_DTL_CHARGES PDC JOIN IDB.PBD_CODE ON PBD_PBD_CD = PBC_PBD_CD JOIN IDB.CLM ON PBC_CPT_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.PBD_INVOICE ON PBD_INV_NO = PBI_INV_NO AND PBI_INV_STS = '' WHERE PBD_SVC_DTE BETWEEN DATE('2021-10-05') - 5 YEAR AND DATE('2021-10-05') AND PBC_CPT_CD IN ('15756', '15757', '20955', '20970', '20962') ), SURGANDFLAP AS (SELECT DISTINCT S_MRN, ORAL_SURG_DTE, PBD_INV_NO, "Surgery Procedure Code", "Surgery Procedure Description", "Surgeon Name", FLAP."Flap Procedure code", FLAP."Flap Procedure Description" FROM SURG LEFT JOIN FLAP ON S_MRN = F_MRN AND ORAL_SURG_DTE = FLAP_SURG_DTE), ICD AS (SELECT DISTINCT DX_MRN, DX_INV_NO, DX_CLSF_CD AS "Billing ICD Code", CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS "Billing ICD Description" FROM SURGANDFLAP JOIN IDB.PBD_DX ON S_MRN = DX_MRN AND PBD_INV_NO = DX_INV_NO JOIN IDB.CLM ON DX_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE DX_CLSF_CD IN ('D10.1', 'D10.2', 'D10.30', 'D10.39', 'C02.0', 'C04.0', 'C04.1', 'C04.8', 'C06.0', 'C06.2', 'D16.5', 'M27.2', 'C03.1', 'C41.1', 'D16.4', 'C05.0', 'C03.0') ), CHEMO AS (SELECT DISTINCT APR_MRN, ORAL_SURG_DTE AS CH_ORAL_SURG_DTE, APR_START_DTE AS "Start Date of Chemotherapy", APR_END_DTE AS "End Date of Chemotherapy", APR_GENERIC_NAME AS "Chemotherapy Name" FROM SURGANDFLAP JOIN IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX_V ON APR_MRN = S_MRN WHERE APR_START_DTE <= ORAL_SURG_DTE - 1 DAY AND APR_END_DTE >= ORAL_SURG_DTE - 2 MONTHS AND CDG_CHEMO_FLAG = 'Y' ), PT AS (SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN, PT_SEX AS SEX FROM SURGANDFLAP JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PT_MRN = S_MRN) SELECT S_MRN AS MRN, SEX, ORAL_SURG_DTE AS "Surgery Date", "Surgeon Name", "Surgery Procedure Code", "Surgery Procedure Description", "Flap Procedure code", "Flap Procedure Description", "Billing ICD Code", "Billing ICD Description", "Start Date of Chemotherapy", "End Date of Chemotherapy", "Chemotherapy Name" FROM PT JOIN SURGANDFLAP ON PT_MRN = S_MRN JOIN ICD ON DX_MRN = S_MRN AND PBD_INV_NO = DX_INV_NO JOIN CHEMO ON APR_MRN = S_MRN AND ORAL_SURG_DTE = CH_ORAL_SURG_DTE

prompt: Provide all completed EDD visits with Physicians and NPs between 2009-2018
completion: SELECT DISTINCT CPE_ENC_DTE AS "Appt Date", CLD_DEPT_NAME AS "Department Name", CRE_RES_NAME AS "Provider Name", CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME AS "Visit Type" FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CRE_RES_TYP IN ('Physician', 'Nurse Practitioner') AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN '2009-01-01' AND '2018-12-31' AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 IN ('EDD', 'ITC') AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 = 'MED'

prompt: Provide a report on C. Difficile rates in the last 2 years.
completion: WITH X AS (SELECT DISTINCT LR_MRN AS MRN, LR_PERFORMED_DTE AS PERFORMED_DTE, LR_PERFORMED_DT AS PERFORMED_DT, LR_ORD_ID AS ORDER_ID, LR_TEST_NAME AS TEST_NAME, LR_SUBTEST_NAME AS SUBTEST_NAME, LR_RESULT_VALUE AS RESULT_VALUE, CASE WHEN LR_SUBTEST_NAME = 'Result' AND LR_RESULT_VALUE <> '' THEN STRIP(LR_RESULT_VALUE) || ': ' || LTL_TEXT_RESULT WHEN LR_SUBTEST_NAME = 'Result' AND LR_RESULT_VALUE = '' THEN LTL_TEXT_RESULT ELSE LTL_TEXT_RESULT END AS TEXT_RESULT, LTL_LINE_NO FROM IDB.LAB_RESULTS LEFT JOIN IDB.LAB_TEXT_LINE ON LTL_RESULT_GUID = LR_RESULT_GUID WHERE 1=1 AND LR_PERFORMED_DTE >= '2019-08-01' AND(LR_SUBTEST_NAME IN ('C. Difficile Assay', 'C. Difficile PCR', 'C.difficile Qual DNA-Research Only', 'Clostridium Difficile Toxin - Stool') OR UPPER(LR_TEST_NAME) like '%C%DIFFICILE%' OR UPPER(LR_SUBTEST_NAME) like '%C%DIFFICILE%') ) , Y AS (SELECT MRN, PERFORMED_DTE, PERFORMED_DT, ORDER_ID, TEST_NAME, SUBTEST_NAME, LISTAGG(COALESCE(STRIP(CAST(TEXT_RESULT AS VARCHAR(12000))), '') , '') WITHIN GROUP( ORDER BY LTL_LINE_NO) AS TEXT_RESULT FROM X GROUP BY MRN, PERFORMED_DTE, PERFORMED_DT, ORDER_ID, TEST_NAME, SUBTEST_NAME) SELECT MRN, PERFORMED_DTE, TIME(PERFORMED_DT) AS PERFORMED_TIME, ORDER_ID, TEST_NAME, MAX(CASE WHEN SUBTEST_NAME = 'Specimen Description' THEN TEXT_RESULT END) AS "Specimen Description", MAX(CASE WHEN SUBTEST_NAME = 'Result' THEN TEXT_RESULT END) AS "Result" FROM Y GROUP BY MRN, PERFORMED_DTE, TIME(PERFORMED_DT), ORDER_ID, TEST_NAME

prompt:
Provide number of patients at MSK who meet the following criteria:

1. Diagnosis of pneumonia due to Pneumocystis jiroveci.

2. Received at least one Beta-D Glucan Serum (whether positive, negative or intermediate) BD Glucans, or Beta-D-Glucan lab within one week of the pneumonia diagnosis (i.e. between 7 days before and 7 days after).
completion: WITH PULM AS (SELECT CC_MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS ICD9_EFF_DTE, CC_CLSF_CD AS ICD9_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS ICD9_DESC FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE CC_CLSF_CD IN ('136.3', 'B59') AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND (CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) GROUP BY CC_MRN, CC_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK HAVING MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) >= '2017-01-01'), GLUCAN AS (SELECT LR_MRN, LR_PERFORMED_DTE, LR_TEST_NAME, LR_SUBTEST_NAME, LR_RESULT_VALUE, LTL_TEXT_RESULT, LR_ABNORMALITY_CD FROM IDB.LAB_RESULTS LEFT JOIN IDB.LAB_TEXT_LINE ON LTL_RESULT_GUID = LR_RESULT_GUID WHERE LR_SUBTEST_NAME IN ('Beta-D-Glucan Result', 'BD Glucans', 'BD Glucan Result', 'BD Glucans (Serum)') ORDER BY LR_MRN, LR_PERFORMED_DTE) SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CC_MRN) FROM PULM JOIN GLUCAN ON CC_MRN = LR_MRN WHERE (ICD9_EFF_DTE - LR_PERFORMED_DTE) BETWEEN -7 AND 7

prompt: Characterize micronutrient deficiencies in cancer patients with dermatologic conditions
completion: WITH PTS AS (SELECT CPE_MRN AS "MRN", CPE_ENC_DTE AS "Appt Date", CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 AS "Department", CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 AS "Service", CLD_DEPT_NAME AS "Department Name", CRE_RES_NAME AS "Provider Name", CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME AS "Visit Type" FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 = 'MED' AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 = 'DER' AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN '2016-01-01' AND '2020-03-31' ) , OP_RES AS (SELECT OO_MRN, OO_ORD_ID, OOC_ITEM_NAME, OOC_ITEM_DESC, OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE, OSTS_STS_DESC, OO_SET_NAME, LR_PERFORMED_DTE, LR_TEST_NAME, LR_SUBTEST_NAME, LR_RESULT_VALUE FROM IDB.OMS_ORDER JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_CATALOG ON OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID = OOC_MSTR_ITEM_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_STATUS ON OO_ORD_STS_CD = OSTS_ORD_STS_CD JOIN IDB.LAB_RESULTS ON OO_ORD_ID = LR_ORD_ID AND OO_ORD_GUID = LR_ORD_GUID JOIN PTS ON LR_MRN = "MRN" WHERE OO_ORD_STS_CD NOT IN ('CANP', 'CANC', 'AUC3') AND OO_SET_NAME = 'Dermatology Micronutrient Panel' AND LR_PERFORMED_DTE BETWEEN "Appt Date" - 3 MONTHS AND "Appt Date" + 3 MONTHS ) , IP AS (SELECT OO_MRN IP_MRN, OOC_ITEM_NAME IP_ORD_NAME, OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE IP_SIGNIFICANT_DTE, OSTS_STS_DESC IP_ORD_STS FROM IDB.OMS_ORDER JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_CATALOG ON OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID = OOC_MSTR_ITEM_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_STATUS ON OO_ORD_STS_CD = OSTS_ORD_STS_CD WHERE OO_ORD_NAME IN ('Dermatology Consultation (Inpatient)', 'Dermatology Inpatient / Urgent Care Center Consult') AND OO_ORD_STS_CD NOT IN ('CANP', 'CANC', 'AUC3') AND OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE BETWEEN '2016-01-01' AND '2020-03-31' ) , IP_RES AS (SELECT OO_MRN, OO_ORD_ID, OOC_ITEM_NAME, OOC_ITEM_DESC, OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE, OSTS_STS_DESC, OO_SET_NAME, LR_PERFORMED_DTE, LR_TEST_NAME, LR_SUBTEST_NAME, LR_RESULT_VALUE FROM IDB.OMS_ORDER JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_CATALOG ON OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID = OOC_MSTR_ITEM_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_STATUS ON OO_ORD_STS_CD = OSTS_ORD_STS_CD JOIN IDB.LAB_RESULTS ON OO_ORD_ID = LR_ORD_ID AND OO_ORD_GUID = LR_ORD_GUID JOIN IP ON LR_MRN = IP_MRN WHERE OO_ORD_STS_CD NOT IN ('CANP', 'CANC', 'AUC3') AND OO_SET_NAME = 'Dermatology Micronutrient Panel' AND LR_PERFORMED_DTE BETWEEN IP_SIGNIFICANT_DTE - 3 MONTHS AND IP_SIGNIFICANT_DTE + 3 MONTHS ) SELECT * FROM OP_RES UNION SELECT * FROM IP_RES ;

prompt: Add all services to NRS4596
completion: WITH APPTS AS (SELECT CPE_MRN AS MRN, CASE WHEN CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_1 = 'REG' THEN RTRIM(CLD_CLD_CENTER)||' '||RTRIM(CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6) ELSE RTRIM(CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6)||' ' ||RTRIM(CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8) END AS DEPT, CRE_RES_NAME AS PHYSICIAN, CPE_ENC_DTE AS APPTDATE, CPE_ENC_CSN_ID AS CSN, CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR AS VT, CPE_APPT_DT AS APPTDT, PT_LAST_NAME AS LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME AS FIRST_NAME FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 IN ('RDO', 'MED', 'SRG', 'NEU', 'NRS') AND CLD_REC_STS <> 'Inactive' JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID AND CRE_RES_TYP IN ('Physician', 'PhD', 'Psychologist') JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID = CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PT_MRN = CPE_MRN AND YEAR(CURRENT DATE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) > 18 WHERE CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT DATE - DAY(CURRENT DATE) DAYS + 1 DAY - 4 MONTH AND CURRENT DATE - DAY(CURRENT DATE) DAYS AND CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Comp', 'Arrived') ) , APPTCOUNT AS (SELECT MRN, DEPT, COUNT(CSN) AS CNT FROM APPTS GROUP BY MRN, DEPT HAVING COUNT(CSN) = 2) SELECT A.MRN AS NVMRN, A.LAST_NAME, A.FIRST_NAME, A.DEPT AS NVDEPT, A.APPTDATE AS NVDATE, A.PHYSICIAN AS NVRES, A.VT AS NVVT, B.DEPT AS FRDEPT, B.APPTDATE AS FRDATE, B.PHYSICIAN AS FRRES, B.VT AS FRVT FROM APPTCOUNT X JOIN APPTS A ON A.MRN = X.MRN AND A.DEPT = X.DEPT AND (A.VT LIKE '%NV%' OR A.VT LIKE '%IR%') JOIN APPTS B ON B.MRN = A.MRN AND B.DEPT = A.DEPT AND B.APPTDATE BETWEEN CURRENT DATE - DAY(CURRENT DATE) DAYS + 1 DAY - 1 MONTH AND CURRENT DATE - DAY(CURRENT DATE) DAYS AND NOT(B.VT LIKE '%NV%' OR B.VT LIKE '%IR%') WHERE A.APPTDATE < B.APPTDATE

prompt: Identify inpatient deaths in 2010.
completion: SELECT SERVICE, COUNT(MRN) AS TOTAL FROM (SELECT CS_MRN MRN, PT_DATE_OF_DEATH DOD, CS_HOSP_SVC HOSP_SVC, CASE WHEN B.DOC_ACDMC_SVC = '' THEN B.DOC_ACDMC_DPT ELSE B.DOC_ACDMC_SVC END AS SERVICE FROM IDB.PATIENT JOIN IDB.CASE ON CS_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.DOC B ON CS_ATN_DR_NO = B.DOC_DR_NO WHERE PT_DEATH_IND IN ('C', 'D') AND PT_DATE_OF_DEATH BETWEEN '2010-01-01' AND '2010-12-31' AND (CS_DSCH_DISP like 'C%' OR CS_DSCH_DISP like 'D%') ) AS X GROUP BY SERVICE

prompt: Provide a list of all patient admitted to the Breast Medicine Service between January 1, 2021 and December 31, 2021 who received at least one opioid during the admission.
completion: WITH MAIN AS (SELECT DISTINCT OO_MRN AS MRN , VIS_ADM_DTE AS ADM_DT , CASE WHEN UPPER(OO_ORD_NAME) LIKE 'FENTANYL%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS FENT , CASE WHEN UPPER(OO_ORD_NAME) LIKE 'MORPHINE%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS MORP , CASE WHEN UPPER(OO_ORD_NAME) LIKE 'HYDROMORPHONE%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS HYDR , CASE WHEN UPPER(OO_ORD_NAME) LIKE 'OXYCODONE%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS OXYC , CASE WHEN UPPER(OO_ORD_NAME) LIKE 'METHADONE%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS METH , CASE WHEN UPPER(OO_ORD_NAME) LIKE '%SENNA%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS SENN , CASE WHEN UPPER(OO_ORD_NAME) LIKE '%POLYETHYLENE GLYCOL 3350%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS POLY , CASE WHEN UPPER(OO_ORD_NAME) LIKE '%DOCUSATE SODIUM%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS DOCU , CASE WHEN UPPER(OO_ORD_NAME) LIKE '%LACTULOSE%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS LACT , CASE WHEN UPPER(OO_ORD_NAME) LIKE '%BISACODYL%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS BISA , CASE WHEN UPPER(OO_ORD_NAME) LIKE '%MAGNESIUM CITRATE%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS MAGN FROM IDB.VISIT_V JOIN IDB.OMS_ORDER ON OO_MRN = VIS_MRN AND (UPPER(OO_ORD_NAME) LIKE 'FENTANYL%' OR UPPER(OO_ORD_NAME) LIKE 'MORPHINE%' OR UPPER(OO_ORD_NAME) LIKE 'HYDROMORPHONE%' OR UPPER(OO_ORD_NAME) LIKE 'OXYCODONE%' OR UPPER(OO_ORD_NAME) LIKE 'METHADONE%' OR UPPER(OO_ORD_NAME) LIKE '%SENNA%' OR UPPER(OO_ORD_NAME) LIKE '%POLYETHYLENE GLYCOL 3350%' OR UPPER(OO_ORD_NAME) LIKE '%DOCUSATE SODIUM%' OR UPPER(OO_ORD_NAME) LIKE '%LACTULOSE%' OR UPPER(OO_ORD_NAME) LIKE '%BISACODYL%' OR UPPER(OO_ORD_NAME) LIKE '%MAGNESIUM CITRATE%') AND OO_ORD_STS_CD <> 'CANC' AND YEAR(OO_ENTER_DTE) = '2021' AND OO_ENTER_DTE BETWEEN VIS_ADM_DTE AND COALESCE(VIS_DSCH_DTE, '4712-12-31') WHERE YEAR(VIS_ADM_DTE) = '2021' AND VIS_IP_OP_ADJUSTED_IND = 'I' AND VIS_VISIT_STATUS IN ('2', '3') AND VIS_HOSP_SVC = 'BMS' ) SELECT DISTINCT MRN, ADM_DT , CASE WHEN SUM(FENT) OVER (PARTITION BY MRN, ADM_DT) >= 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS FENTANYL , CASE WHEN SUM(MORP) OVER (PARTITION BY MRN, ADM_DT) >= 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS MORPHINE , CASE WHEN SUM(HYDR) OVER (PARTITION BY MRN, ADM_DT) >= 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS HYDROMORPHONE , CASE WHEN SUM(OXYC) OVER (PARTITION BY MRN, ADM_DT) >= 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS OXYCODONE , CASE WHEN SUM(METH) OVER (PARTITION BY MRN, ADM_DT) >= 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS METHADONE , CASE WHEN SUM(SENN) OVER (PARTITION BY MRN, ADM_DT) >= 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS SENNA , CASE WHEN SUM(POLY) OVER (PARTITION BY MRN, ADM_DT) >= 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS POLYETHYLENE_GLYCOL_3350 , CASE WHEN SUM(DOCU) OVER (PARTITION BY MRN, ADM_DT) >= 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS DOCUSATE_SODIUM , CASE WHEN SUM(LACT) OVER (PARTITION BY MRN, ADM_DT) >= 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS LACTULOSE , CASE WHEN SUM(BISA) OVER (PARTITION BY MRN, ADM_DT) >= 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS BISACODYL , CASE WHEN SUM(MAGN) OVER (PARTITION BY MRN, ADM_DT) >= 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS MAGNESIUM_CITRATE FROM MAIN

prompt: Provide a one-time list of patients with colitis and colorectal cancer (CRC).
completion: WITH ICD AS (SELECT CC_MRN MRN, PT_LAST_NAME LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME FIRST_NAME, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH DOB, CCS_ICD_CODE ICD_CODE, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK ICD_DESC, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS FIRST_EFF_DTE FROM IDB.CCS_HIER LEFT JOIN IDB.CLM ON CCS_ICD_CODE = CLM_CLSF_CD AND CLM_CD_TYPE = 'D' INNER JOIN IDB.CTC_CLSF ON CLM_CLSF_CD = CC_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON CC_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE 1=1 AND CCS_ICD_CODE IN ('555', '555.1', '555.2', '555.9', '556', '556', '556.1', '556.2', '556.3', '556.4', '556.5', '556.6', '556.8', '556.9', 'K50.00', 'K50.012', 'K50.013', 'K50.018', 'K50.10', 'K50.111', 'K50.112', 'K50.113', 'K50.118', 'K50.80', 'K50.811', 'K50.812', 'K50.813', 'K50.814', 'K50.818', 'K50.819', 'K50.90', 'K50.911', 'K50.912', 'K50.913', 'K50.918', 'K50.919', 'K51.00', 'K51.011', 'K51.013', 'K51.018', 'K51.20', 'K51.211', 'K51.212', 'K51.214', 'K51.218', 'K51.30', 'K51.311', 'K51.314', 'K51.318', 'K51.50', 'K51.511', 'K51.514', 'K51.518', 'K51.80', 'K51.811', 'K51.812', 'K51.813', 'K51.814', 'K51.818', 'K51.90', 'K51.911', 'K51.912', 'K51.913', 'K51.914', 'K51.918', 'K51.919') AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND (CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) GROUP BY CC_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, CCS_ICD_CODE, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK) , APPTS AS (SELECT CPE_MRN, YEAR(CPE_ENC_DTE) YEAR_FIRST_SEEN_IN_GI, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CPE_MRN ORDER BY CPE_APPT_DT) RN FROM ICD JOIN IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER ON MRN = CPE_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON MRN = PT_MRN WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp', 'Sch') AND CRE_RES_TYP = 'Physician' AND CPE_ENC_DTE >= '2000-01-01' AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 = 'GI' ) , CANCER_DX AS (SELECT DISTINCT TM_MRN SEER_MRN, TM_DX_DTE, TM_SITE_CD AS SITE_CODE, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_DESC, TM_HIST_CD AS HIST_CODE, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS HIST_DESC FROM ICD JOIN IDB.CDB_TUMOR ON MRN = TM_MRN JOIN IDB.CLM H ON TM_HIST_CD = H.CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON TM_SITE_CD = S.CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.SEERGROUPING ON DV.SEERF_ICDO(TM_SITE_CD, TM_HIST_CD) = RECODE WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7') AND CATEGORY2 = 'Colon and Rectum' ) , IRB AS (SELECT SUBJECT_MRN, MAX(CASE WHEN PROTOCOL_NO = '06-107' THEN ON_ARM_DATE END) "06-107 Registration Date", MAX(CASE WHEN PROTOCOL_NO = '12-245' AND ARM_CODE = 'A' THEN ON_ARM_DATE END) "Part A Registration Date", MAX(CASE WHEN PROTOCOL_NO = '12-245' AND ARM_CODE = 'C' THEN ON_ARM_DATE END) "Part C Registration Date" FROM (SELECT DISTINCT MRN FROM ICD) P JOIN NN.SV_SUB_TREATMENT ON MRN = SUBJECT_MRN WHERE PROTOCOL_NO IN ('06-107', '12-245') GROUP BY SUBJECT_MRN ) , SRG AS (SELECT DISTINCT OC_CASE_ID, OC_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, OC_SURG_DTE, OC_SURG_SVC, CRE_RES_NAME, CPX_PROC_CD, CPX_PROC_NAME FROM ICD JOIN IDB.OR_CASE ON MRN = OC_MRN JOIN IDB.OR_CASE_ALL_PROC ON OC_CASE_ID = OCAP_CASE_ID JOIN IDB.OR_CASE_ALL_SURG ON OCAP_CASE_ID = OCAS_CASE_ID AND OCAS_PNL_NO = OCAP_PNL_NO AND OCAS_SURG_ROLE = 'Primary' JOIN IDB.OR_PROC ON OCAP_OR_PROC_ID = OP_OR_PROC_ID JOIN IDB.OR_CL_PROC ON OP_OR_PROC_ID = OCP_OR_PROC_ID JOIN IDB.CL_PROC ON OCP_PROC_ID = CPX_PROC_ID JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CRE_RES_ID = OCAS_RES_ID JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON OC_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE OC_SURG_SVC = 'GI' AND OC_OR_CASE_STS_CD NOT IN ('2', '5') ) , SRG_AGG AS (SELECT OC_MRN, LISTAGG(CHAR(OC_SURG_DTE) || ': ' || TRIM(CPX_PROC_NAME), CHR(13)||CHR(10)) SURGERY_HISTORY FROM SRG GROUP BY OC_MRN) SELECT I.*, PLA_LST_CON_DTE LAST_CONTACT_DATE, YEAR_FIRST_SEEN_IN_GI, TM_DX_DTE, SITE_CODE, SITE_DESC, HIST_CODE, HIST_DESC, "06-107 Registration Date", "Part A Registration Date", "Part C Registration Date", SURGERY_HISTORY FROM ICD I JOIN APPTS ON I.MRN = CPE_MRN AND RN = 1 JOIN CANCER_DX ON I.MRN = SEER_MRN JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY ON I.MRN = PLA_MRN LEFT JOIN IRB ON I.MRN = SUBJECT_MRN LEFT JOIN SRG_AGG ON I.MRN = OC_MRN

prompt: Develop a tableau dashboard to view scheduled surgeries and related information including from CRDB and CTMS
completion: WITH DATA AS (SELECT OC_MRN, PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID P_ID, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, YEAR(OC_SURG_DTE - PT_BIRTH_DTE) "Age", OC_ADM_DTE, DATE(OC_SCH_DT) || ' ' || TIME(OC_SCH_DT) || ' ' || ROOM.CRE_RES_NAME "Last Sch Info", OC_OR_CASE_DUR "Length (min)", OC_REC_CR_DTE "Created", OC_CASE_ID AS LOGID, OC_OR_CASE_STS AS SURGSTATUS, OC_SURG_DTE AS SURGDATE, OC_SCH_DT AS SURGDATETIME, TIME(OC_SCH_DT) AS SURGTIME, RES.CRE_RES_NAME AS SURGEON, OCAS_SURG_SVC AS SURGSVC, OP_PROC_NAME AS SURG_DESC, LOC_LOC_NAME SURG_LOCATION FROM IDB.OR_CASE JOIN IDB.OR_CASE_ALL_SURG ON OC_CASE_ID = OCAS_CASE_ID JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE RES ON OCAS_RES_ID = RES.CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ROOM ON OC_ROOM_RES_ID = ROOM.CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.OR_CASE_ALL_PROC ON OC_CASE_ID = OCAP_CASE_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.OR_PROC ON OCAP_OR_PROC_ID = OP_OR_PROC_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.OR_CL_PROC ON OP_OR_PROC_ID = OCP_OR_PROC_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_LOCATION ON OC_SURG_LOC_ID = LOC_LOC_ID JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS P ON OC_MRN = P.PT_MRN WHERE OC_OR_CASE_STS IN ('Sch', 'Not Sch') AND OC_SURG_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT DATE AND CURRENT DATE + 21 DAYS AND OCAS_SURG_SVC IN ('CRS', 'GMT', 'GI', 'GYN', 'HEP', 'HNS', 'IR', 'NEURO', 'OPTH', 'ORTHO', 'PEDS', 'PULM', 'THO') AND LOC_LOC_NAME IN ('ENDO OR', 'IR', 'MAIN OR', 'SDH OR', 'JOSIE ROBERTSON', 'KOCH IR', 'WESTCHESTER IR') ) , PTS AS (SELECT OC_MRN, P_ID, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, "Age", OC_ADM_DTE, LOGID, SURGSTATUS, SURGDATE, SURGDATETIME, SURGTIME, SURGEON, SURGSVC, LISTAGG(TRIM(SURG_DESC), CHR(13)||CHR(10)) PROCEDURE, "Last Sch Info", "Length (min)", "Created" FROM DATA GROUP BY OC_MRN, P_ID, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, "Age", OC_ADM_DTE, LOGID, SURGSTATUS, SURGDATE, SURGDATETIME, SURGTIME, SURGEON, SURGSVC, "Last Sch Info", "Length (min)", "Created") , CTMS AS (SELECT R.PT_MRN, PRT_ID, REG_ID, CONSENT_DATE FROM NN.CRDB_DASH_PT_REG R JOIN PTS P ON R.PT_MRN = P.OC_MRN WHERE PRT_ID IN ('06-107', '00-109', '12-245', '02-060', '00-032') ) , CDB AS (SELECT TM_MRN, LISTAGG(TM_DX_DTE || ': ' || TRIM(TM_SITE_CD) || ' ' || TRIM(S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK) || ' ' || TRIM(TM_HIST_CD) || ' ' || TRIM(H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK), CHR(1)||CHR(10)) "Dx" FROM PTS JOIN IDB.CDB_TUMOR ON OC_MRN = TM_MRN JOIN IDB.CLM H ON TM_HIST_CD = H.CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON TM_SITE_CD = S.CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') GROUP BY TM_MRN ) SELECT OC_MRN MRN, P_ID, TRIM(PT_LAST_NAME) || ', ' || TRIM(PT_FIRST_NAME) "Patient Name", "Age", "Dx", LOGID, SURGSTATUS "Surgery Status", SURGDATE "Surgery Date", SURGTIME "Surgery Time", SURGEON "Surgeon", SURGSVC "Surgeon Service", PROCEDURE "Procedure", "Last Sch Info", "Length (min)", "Created", MAX(CASE WHEN PRT_ID = '06-107' THEN CONSENT_DATE END) "06-107 Consent Date", MAX(CASE WHEN PRT_ID = '00-109' THEN CONSENT_DATE END) "00-109 Consent Date", MAX(CASE WHEN PRT_ID = '12-245' AND REG_ID = '100' THEN CONSENT_DATE END) "12-245 Part A Consent Date", MAX(CASE WHEN PRT_ID = '12-245' AND REG_ID = '300' THEN CONSENT_DATE END) "12-245 Part C Consent Date", MAX(CASE WHEN PRT_ID = '02-060' THEN CONSENT_DATE END) "02-060 Consent Date", MAX(CASE WHEN PRT_ID = '00-032' THEN CONSENT_DATE END) "00-032 Consent Date" FROM PTS LEFT JOIN CTMS C ON OC_MRN = C.PT_MRN LEFT JOIN CDB CDB ON OC_MRN = TM_MRN GROUP BY OC_MRN, P_ID, TRIM(PT_LAST_NAME) || ', ' || TRIM(PT_FIRST_NAME), "Age", "Dx", OC_ADM_DTE, LOGID, SURGSTATUS, SURGDATE, SURGDATETIME, SURGTIME, SURGEON, SURGSVC, PROCEDURE, "Last Sch Info", "Length (min)", "Created"

prompt: Provide a Darwin cohort of patients for the given criteria along with access to the patients in the Darwin Digital Platform.
completion: WITH PTS AS (SELECT PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID PID FROM DV.PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED) , DT_1 AS (SELECT INC.PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID P_ID , INC.GENE, INC.GENE2, ABERRATIONTYPE FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_STRUCTURED_RESULTS_V INC JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML DT ON INC.PRPT_PATH_RPT_ID = DT.PDRX_PATH_RPT_ID JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V DEMO ON INC.PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = DEMO.PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID CROSS JOIN XMLTABLE('$c/root/*' PASSING DT.PDRX_XML_VALUE AS "c" COLUMNS PRIMARY_SITE VARCHAR(264) PATH 'primary_site', TUMOR_TYPE_NAME VARCHAR(264) PATH 'tumor_type_name' , TUMOR_TYPE_CODE VARCHAR(264) PATH 'tumor_type_code', IS_METASTASIS VARCHAR(3) PATH 'is_metastasis' , METASTASIS_SITE VARCHAR(264) PATH 'metastasis_site' , MSI_COMMENT VARCHAR(264) PATH 'msi-comment' , MSI_SCORE VARCHAR(264) PATH 'msi-score' , MSI_TYPE VARCHAR(264) PATH 'msi-type' , TMB_SCORE VARCHAR(25) PATH 'tmb_score' , TMB_COUNT VARCHAR(25) PATH 'tmb-count', COSMIC_ID VARCHAR(5000) PATH 'cosmic_id') T WHERE 1=1 AND (INC.GENE IN ('TRIM37', 'RAD51C', 'PPM1D', 'BRIP1', 'RNF43') OR INC.GENE2 IN ('TRIM37', 'RAD51C', 'PPM1D', 'BRIP1', 'RNF43')) AND (INC.ABERRATIONTYPE IN ('amplification', 'copy number gain') OR CASE WHEN 'fusion' IN ('amplification', 'copy number gain') AND (UPPER(SEARCH_HIT2) like '%FUSION%' OR UPPER(SEARCH_HIT2) like '%TRANSLOCATION%' OR UPPER(SEARCH_HIT2) like '%REARRAN%' OR UPPER(SEARCH_HIT2) like '%INVERSION%') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END = 1) AND PT_VITAL_STATUS IN ('ALIVE') ) , DT_2 AS (SELECT INC.PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID P_ID , INC.GENE, INC.GENE2, ABERRATIONTYPE FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_STRUCTURED_RESULTS_V INC JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML DT ON INC.PRPT_PATH_RPT_ID = DT.PDRX_PATH_RPT_ID JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V DEMO ON INC.PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = DEMO.PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID CROSS JOIN XMLTABLE('$c/root/*' PASSING DT.PDRX_XML_VALUE AS "c" COLUMNS PRIMARY_SITE VARCHAR(264) PATH 'primary_site', TUMOR_TYPE_NAME VARCHAR(264) PATH 'tumor_type_name' , TUMOR_TYPE_CODE VARCHAR(264) PATH 'tumor_type_code', IS_METASTASIS VARCHAR(3) PATH 'is_metastasis' , METASTASIS_SITE VARCHAR(264) PATH 'metastasis_site' , MSI_COMMENT VARCHAR(264) PATH 'msi-comment' , MSI_SCORE VARCHAR(264) PATH 'msi-score' , MSI_TYPE VARCHAR(264) PATH 'msi-type' , TMB_SCORE VARCHAR(25) PATH 'tmb_score' , TMB_COUNT VARCHAR(25) PATH 'tmb-count', COSMIC_ID VARCHAR(5000) PATH 'cosmic_id') T WHERE 1=1 AND SEARCH_HIT2 like '%17q23%' AND PT_VITAL_STATUS IN ('ALIVE') ) , DEID AS (SELECT P_ID FROM DT_1 UNION SELECT P_ID FROM DT_2)

prompt: Provide retrospective Care Team Widget data from April 2019 entered for patients on M4.
completion: WITH X AS (SELECT DISTINCT * FROM IDB.UNIFIED_CENSUS WHERE UC_NURS_STA = 'NS-4' AND UC_TRANSFER_DTE <= '2019-04-30' AND UC_END_DTE >= '2019-04-01' AND UC_CNG_TYPE IN ('A', 'T') ) SELECT DISTINCT UC_MRN, UC_ADM_NUM, DATE(OCV_ADM_DT) AS ADM_DATE, DATE(OCV_DSCH_DT) AS DSCH_DATE, OCPVR_ROLE_CD, OCPVR_STATUS_CD, DATE(OCPVR_FROM_DT) AS OCPVR_FROM_DT, DATE(OCPVR_TO_DT) AS OCPVR_TO_DT, OP_DISPLAY_NAME, OP_DISCIPLINE, OU_ORD_ROLE_TYPE, OU_OCCUPATION FROM X JOIN IDB.OMS_CLIENT_VISIT ON UC_MRN = OCV_MRN AND UC_ADM_NUM = OCV_ADM_NUM AND OCV_IP_OP_IND = 'I' AND OCV_VISIT_STS NOT IN ('CAN', 'PRE') JOIN IDB.OMS_CARE_PROV_VISIT_ROLE CP ON OCPVR_VISIT_GUID = OCV_VISIT_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_PROVIDER ON OP_PVDR_GUID = OCPVR_PVDR_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_USER ON OU_USER_GUID = OCPVR_PVDR_GUID

prompt: Please re-run SKI27499 from 1/1/2016-2/28/2019
completion: WITH SURG AS (SELECT DISTINCT PATIENT_MRN, PATIENT_NAME, PATIENT_SEX , LOG_SURGERY_DTE AS DOS FROM IDB.PERIOP_CASE_EVENT_V WHERE LOG_PRIMARY_SERVICE = 'Colorectal' AND LOG_SURGERY_DTE BETWEEN '2016-01-01' AND '2019-02-28' ) , SMOKE AS (SELECT ASH_MRN, ASH_SMOKELESS_TOB_USE, ASH_TOBACCO_USED_YEARS, ASH_CIGARETTES_IND, ASH_PIPES_IND, ASH_CIGARS_IND, ASH_SNUFF_IND, ASH_CHEW_IND FROM (SELECT DISTINCT ASH_MRN, ARS_AN_DTE AS AN_DATE, ASH_ENC_DTE, ASH_CL_PT_ID AS PAT_ID, ASH_ENC_CSN_ID AS PAT_ENC_CSN_ID, ASH_TOBACCO_USER_CD, ASH_TOBACCO_USER, ASH_SMOKELESS_TOB_USE_CD, ASH_SMOKELESS_TOB_USE, ASH_SMOKING_TOB_USE_CD, ASH_SMOKING_TOB_USE, ASH_SMOKELESS_QUIT_DTE, ASH_TOBACO_SRC_CD, ASH_TOBACO_SRC, ASH_TOBACCO_PAK_PER_DAY, ASH_TOBACCO_USED_YEARS, ASH_TOBACCO_COMMENT, ASH_SMOKING_QUIT_DTE, ASH_CIGARETTES_IND, ASH_PIPES_IND, ASH_CIGARS_IND, ASH_SNUFF_IND, ASH_CHEW_IND, ASH_YEARS_EDUCATION , ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY ASH_MRN ORDER BY ASH_ENC_CSN_ID DESC) AS RK FROM IDB.AN_RECORD_SUMMARY JOIN IDB.AN_SOCIAL_HX SOC ON ARS_AN_CL_PT_ID = ASH_CL_PT_ID JOIN SURG ON PATIENT_MRN = ASH_MRN AND ARS_AN_DTE BETWEEN DOS - 1 DAY AND DOS +1 DAY) X WHERE RK=1 ) SELECT DISTINCT PATIENT_MRN AS MRN, PATIENT_NAME AS "Patient Name", PATIENT_SEX AS "Gender", PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH AS "Date of Birth", TRIM(M.AV_DESC) AS "Marital Status", TRIM(L.AV_DESC) AS "Language", TRIM(R.AV_DESC) AS "Race", TRIM(E.AV_DESC) AS "Ethnicity", INS1.INS_PLAN_DESC AS "Insurance", ASH_SMOKELESS_TOB_USE AS "Tobacco smokeless Use", ASH_TOBACCO_USED_YEARS AS "Tobacco Used Yrs" FROM SURG LEFT JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PT_MRN = PATIENT_MRN LEFT JOIN SMOKE ON ASH_MRN = PATIENT_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS R ON R.AV_ELEMENT = 'RACE' AND R.AV_CODE = PT_RACE LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS E ON E.AV_ELEMENT = 'PT_ETHNICITY' AND E.AV_CODE = PT_PT_ETHNICITY LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS M ON M.AV_ELEMENT = 'MARITAL_STS' AND M.AV_CODE = PT_MARITAL_STS LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS L ON L.AV_ELEMENT = 'PRIMARY_LANG' AND L.AV_CODE = PT_PRIMARY_LANG LEFT JOIN IDB.INSURANCE INS1 ON INS1.INS_MRN = PT_MRN AND INS1.INS_PLAN_PRIO = '1' AND INS1.INS_VERIFY_IND = 'Y' ; WITH SURG AS (SELECT DISTINCT PATIENT_MRN, PATIENT_NAME, PATIENT_AGE, PATIENT_SEX, LOG_NUMBER AS LOG_ID, LOG_SURGERY_DTE AS DOS, LOG_PRIMARY_SURGEON AS SURGEON, ANESTHESIA_START_TIME_ACTUAL, ANESTHESIA_END_TIME_ACTUAL, ANESTHESIA_TYPE, ASA_RATING, FIRST_PROCED_START_TIME_ACTUAL, LAST_PROCEDURE_END_TIME_ACTUAL, SURGERY_DURATION, TRIM(LOG_LAPAROSCOPIC_FLAG) ||'-' || TRIM(LOG_MIN_INVASIVE_FLAG) ||'-' || TRIM(LOG_ROBOT_ASSISTED_FLAG) AS SURG_TYPE, LOG_VISIT_TYPE FROM IDB.PERIOP_CASE_EVENT_V WHERE LOG_PRIMARY_SERVICE = 'Colorectal' AND LOG_SURGERY_DTE BETWEEN '2016-01-01' AND '2019-02-28' ) , ADM AS (SELECT SSE_MRN AS VIS_MRN, ADM_DOS, LISTAGG(CPT4_CODE , ', ') CPT_CODE, LISTAGG(TRIM(CPT4_DESC), ', ') AS CPT_DESC, VIS_ADM_DTE, VIS_DSCH_DTE, VIS_ADM_NUM, SSE_SURG_DTE, DSCH_DESC, VIS_HOSP_SVC FROM (SELECT SSE_MRN , DOS AS ADM_DOS, VIS_ADM_NUM, SSE_SURG_DTE, SSE_SURG_STRT_DT, SSE_SURG_END_DT, TRIM(SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD) AS CPT4_CODE, TRIM(SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC) AS CPT4_DESC, SSP_SURG_SVC_CD, VIS_ADM_DTE, VIS_HOSP_SVC, VIS_DSCH_DTE, S.AV_DESC AS DSCH_DESC FROM IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE ON SSE_LOG_ID = SSP_LOG_ID AND SSE_ENC_CSN_ID = SSP_ENC_CSN_ID JOIN SURG ON SSE_LOG_ID = LOG_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.VISIT ON VIS_MRN = SSE_MRN AND VIS_VISIT_STATUS IN ('2', '3') AND VIS_IP_OP_ADJUSTED_IND = 'I' AND VIS_ADM_DTE <= SSE_SURG_DTE AND COALESCE(VIS_DSCH_DTE, '2999-12-31') >= SSE_SURG_DTE LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS S ON TRIM(S.AV_ELEMENT) = 'DSCH_DISP' AND S.AV_CODE = VIS_DSCH_DISP WHERE (SSE_SURG_LOC not like '%IR%' AND SSE_SURG_LOC not like '%ENDO%' AND SSE_SOURCE_TYPE <> 'E') AND SSE_SURG_DTE = DOS AND VIS_HOSP_SVC IN ('COL', 'REC') AND TRIM(SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD) IS NOT NULL ) GROUP BY SSE_MRN, VIS_ADM_DTE, VIS_DSCH_DTE, VIS_ADM_NUM, ADM_DOS, SSE_SURG_DTE, DSCH_DESC, VIS_HOSP_SVC) , RE_ADM AS (SELECT R.VIS_MRN RADM_MRN, SSE_SURG_DTE AS SURG_DATE, F.VIS_ADM_DTE, F.VIS_DSCH_DTE, CASE WHEN R.VIS_MRN IS NOT NULL THEN 'Y' END AS RADM_FLAG, R.VIS_ADM_DTE RADM_ADM_DTE, R.VIS_DSCH_DTE RADM_DSCH_DTE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY F.VIS_MRN, F.VIS_ADM_NUM ORDER BY R.VIS_ADM_DTE ASC) AS RADM, CPE_ENC_DTE AS UCC_VISIT, CASE WHEN CPE_MRN IS NOT NULL THEN 'Y' END AS UCC_FLAG FROM ADM F LEFT JOIN IDB.VISIT R ON R.VIS_MRN = F.VIS_MRN AND R.VIS_HOSP_SVC = F.VIS_HOSP_SVC AND R.VIS_ADM_NUM <> F.VIS_ADM_NUM LEFT JOIN (SELECT CPE_MRN, CPE_ENC_DTE FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID WHERE CLD_DEPT_NAME = 'UCC 1275' AND CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN '2016-01-01' AND '2019-03-31' ) U ON CPE_MRN = F.VIS_MRN AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN SSE_SURG_DTE + 1 DAY AND SSE_SURG_DTE + 30 DAYS WHERE R.VIS_ADM_DTE BETWEEN SSE_SURG_DTE + 1 DAY AND SSE_SURG_DTE + 30 DAYS ) , ANES AS (SELECT PATIENT_MRN ANES_MRN, DOS AS ANES_DOS, LOG_ID AS ANES_LOG_ID, SURGEON AS SURGEON_NAME, SUM(CASE WHEN AIFM_FLO_MEAS_ID = '400620' THEN CAST(STRIP(AIFM_MEAS_VALUE) AS DECIMAL(9, 2)) END) AS AN_EBL_ML FROM SURG JOIN IDB.AN_RECORD_SUMMARY ON LOG_ID = ARS_AN_CASELOG_ID JOIN IDB.AN_IP_DATA_STORE ON ARS_AN_CL_PT_ID = AIDS_CL_PT_ID JOIN IDB.AN_HSB_LINKED_DOC_CSN ON ARS_AN_EPISODE_ID = AHLDC_SUMMARY_BLOCK_ID AND AHLDC_LINKED_DOC_CSN = AIDS_ENC_CSN_ID JOIN IDB.AN_IP_FLOWSHEET_REC ON AIFRC_INPATIENT_DATA_ID = AIDS_INPATIENT_DATA_ID JOIN IDB.AN_IP_FLOWSHEET_MEAS ON AIFRC_FSD_ID = AIFM_FSD_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.AN_IP_FLOWSHEET_GP_DATA ON AIFM_FLO_MEAS_ID = AIFGD_FLO_MEAS_ID WHERE AIFM_FLO_MEAS_ID = '400620' AND AIFM_MEAS_VALUE > ' ' GROUP BY PATIENT_MRN, DOS, LOG_ID , SURGEON) , CLIND AS (SELECT CDD_MRN, CDD_SERVICE_DTE , ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CDD_MRN, DOS ORDER BY CDD_SERVICE_DTE DESC) AS RN , CDO_VALUE_TEXT AS SITE FROM IDB.CD_DOCUMENT LEFT JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION ON CDD_DOC_GUID = CDO_DOC_GUID AND CDD_AUTHORED_DTE = CDO_AUTHORED_DTE AND CDO_VALUE_TEXT <> '' JOIN SURG ON PATIENT_MRN = CDD_MRN WHERE CDD_CANCEL_IND <> '1' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND <> '1' AND CDD_DOC_NAME = 'Operative Report - Colorectal' AND CDO_SECTION IN ('Colorectal Procedures') AND CDO_ITEM_NAME IN ('Stoma Type:', 'Stoma') AND CDD_SERVICE_DTE BETWEEN DOS - 2 DAYS AND DOS + 3 DAYS ) , BMI AS (SELECT PMH_MRN, PMH_MEASURE_DTE, DOS AS SURG_DATE, PMH_WT_KG, PMH_HT_CM, PMH_BSA, PMH_BMI, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY PMH_MRN, DOS ORDER BY PMH_MEASURE_DTE DESC) BRN FROM IDB.PT_MEASURES_HX JOIN SURG ON PMH_MRN = PATIENT_MRN AND PMH_MEASURE_DTE < DOS) SELECT DISTINCT PATIENT_MRN AS MRN, PATIENT_NAME AS "Patient Name", PATIENT_AGE AS "Age as of Surgery Date", PATIENT_SEX AS "Gender", CPT_CODE AS "CPT Code", CPT_DESC AS "CPT Description", SURGEON, SITE, DOS AS "Date of Surgery", A.VIS_ADM_DTE AS "Admission Date", A.VIS_DSCH_DTE AS "Discharge Date", DSCH_DESC AS "Discharge Destination", ANESTHESIA_TYPE AS "Anesthesia Type", ASA_RATING AS "ASA Rating", AN_EBL_ML AS "EBL (ml)", ANESTHESIA_START_TIME_ACTUAL AS "Anesthesia Start Time", ANESTHESIA_END_TIME_ACTUAL AS "Anesthesia End Time", FIRST_PROCED_START_TIME_ACTUAL AS "Surgery Start Time", LAST_PROCEDURE_END_TIME_ACTUAL AS "Surgery End Time", SURGERY_DURATION AS "Surgery Duration", SURG_TYPE AS "Surgery Type", LOG_VISIT_TYPE AS "Patient Type", RADM_FLAG AS "Re-admission Flag", RADM_ADM_DTE AS "Re-admission Date", RADM_DSCH_DTE AS "Re-adm Discharge Date", UCC_FLAG, UCC_VISIT AS "UCC Visit Date", PMH_MEASURE_DTE AS BMI_DATE, PMH_WT_KG AS "Weight in KG", PMH_HT_CM AS "Height in CM", PMH_BMI AS BMI FROM SURG S LEFT JOIN ANES ON LOG_ID = ANES_LOG_ID LEFT JOIN ADM A ON A.VIS_MRN = PATIENT_MRN AND ADM_DOS = DOS LEFT JOIN BMI ON PMH_MRN = PATIENT_MRN AND BRN =1 AND DOS = SURG_DATE LEFT JOIN CLIND ON CDD_MRN = PATIENT_MRN AND RN =1 LEFT JOIN RE_ADM ON RADM_MRN = PATIENT_MRN WHERE CPT_CODE IS NOT NULL;

prompt: Provide a monthly report of all open outpatient referrals for chaplaincy services.
completion: WITH ETO AS (SELECT ORDSTATUS, ENTER_DTE, ORDID, ORDNAME, OO_MRN MRN, STRIP(PT_LAST_NAME)||', '||STRIP(PT_FIRST_NAME) PT_NAME, PT_SEX_DESC SEX, LOCATION, "Entered By", "Requested For", "Chaplaincy Religion" FROM (SELECT STRIP(OO_ORD_STS_CD)||'-'||STRIP(OSTS_STS_DESC) ORDSTATUS, OO_ENTER_DTE ENTER_DTE, OCV_CURR_LOC LOCATION, OCV_IP_OP_IND , OO_ORD_ID ORDID, OO_ORD_NAME ORDNAME, OO_MRN, MAX(CASE WHEN OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'Chaplaincy Other' THEN OUD_USER_DI_VALUE ELSE '' END) "Entered By", MAX(CASE WHEN OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'Requested For' THEN OUD_USER_DI_VALUE ELSE '' END) "Requested For", MAX(CASE WHEN OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'Chaplaincy Religion' THEN OUD_USER_DI_VALUE ELSE '' END) "Chaplaincy Religion" FROM IDB.OMS_ORDER JOIN IDB.OMS_CLIENT_VISIT ON OO_VISIT_GUID = OCV_VISIT_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_USER ON OO_USER_GUID = OU_USER_GUID LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_USER_DATA ON OO_ORD_GUID = OUD_ORD_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_STATUS ON OO_ORD_STS_CD = OSTS_ORD_STS_CD WHERE OO_ORD_NAME IN ('Nursing Referral Chaplaincy Inpatient', 'Chaplain Consult', 'Nursing Ambulatory Referral Chaplaincy') AND OO_ORD_STS_CD = 'AUA2' AND OO_ENTER_DTE BETWEEN LAST_DAY(CURRENT DATE - 2 MONTH) + 1 DAY AND LAST_DAY(CURRENT DATE - 1 MONTH) GROUP BY OO_ORD_STS_CD, OSTS_STS_DESC, OO_ENTER_DTE, OCV_CURR_LOC, OCV_IP_OP_IND, OO_ORD_ID, OO_ORD_NAME , OO_MRN) AS A JOIN IDB.PATIENT_V ON OO_MRN = PT_MRN) , ENTEREDBY AS (SELECT CDD_DOC_GUID, CDD_MRN, CDD_SERVICE_DTE, CDD_DOC_NAME, CDO_SECTION, CDO_CTLG_DISPL_NM, CDO_ITEM_NAME, CDO_VALUE_TEXT, OU_DISPLAY_NAME ENTEREDBY, OU_OCCUPATION ENTEREDBYROLE FROM ETO JOIN IDB.CD_DOCUMENT ON MRN = CDD_MRN JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION ON CDD_DOC_GUID = CDO_DOC_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_USER ON CDO_USER_GUID = OU_USER_GUID WHERE CDD_SERVICE_DTE BETWEEN LAST_DAY(CURRENT DATE - 2 MONTH) + 1 DAY AND LAST_DAY(CURRENT DATE - 1 MONTH) AND CDD_CANCEL_IND = '0' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND = '0' AND CDO_ITEM_NAME = 'Chaplaincy Referral' ) SELECT ORDSTATUS, ENTER_DTE, ORDID, ORDNAME, MRN, PT_NAME, SEX, LOCATION, CASE WHEN ENTEREDBY IS NULL THEN "Entered By" ELSE ENTEREDBY END "Entered By", ENTEREDBYROLE, "Requested For", "Chaplaincy Religion" FROM ETO LEFT JOIN ENTEREDBY ON MRN = CDD_MRN ;

prompt: Provide a number of chaplaincy referral orders in CIS on a monthly basis.
completion: SELECT OOC_ITEM_NAME, OU_OCCUPATION, COUNT(1) AS NUMBER_OF_ORDERS FROM (SELECT OO_MRN, OUO_ORD_ID, OUO_ORD_SOURCE, OO_ENTER_DTE, OO_ORD_NAME, OO_ORD_TYPE_CD, OOC_ITEM_NAME, OU_OCCUPATION FROM IDB.OMS_ORDER JOIN IDB.OMS_USER_ORDERS ON OO_ORD_GUID = OUO_ORD_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_CATALOG ON OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID = OOC_MSTR_ITEM_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_USER ON OO_USER_GUID = OU_USER_GUID WHERE OOC_ITEM_NAME IN ('Chaplain Consult', 'Nursing Referral Chaplaincy Inpatient', 'Nursing PERIOP Referral Chaplaincy', 'Nursing Ambulatory Referral Chaplaincy') AND OO_ORD_STS_CD NOT IN ('CANP', 'CANC', 'AUC3') AND OO_ENTER_DTE > CURRENT DATE - 1 MONTH ) GROUP BY OOC_ITEM_NAME, OU_OCCUPATION

prompt: Patients aged 80 years and older undergoing Spinal Surgery
completion: WITH DX AS (SELECT TM_MRN, TM_DX_DTE, TM_HIST_CD, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS HIST_DESC, TM_SITE_CD, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_DESC FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS ON AV_ELEMENT = 'CASE_STS' AND AV_CODE = TM_CASE_STS AND TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') ) , RAD AS (SELECT DISTINCT RTC_TX_MRN, RTC_TX_PLAN_NAME, RTC_TX_DELIVERED_FRACTIONS, RTC_TX_DELIVERED_DOSE, RTC_TX_START_DTE, RTC_TX_STOP_DTE, RTC_PRIMARY_REF_POINT FROM IDB.RADONC_TREATMENT_COURSE) , PANEL_TIME AS (SELECT OLPT_LOG_ID, OLPT_PNL_NO, MAX(CASE WHEN OLPT_PNL_EVNT_CD = '200' THEN TIME(OLPT_EVNT_IN_DT) END) PANEL_START, MAX(CASE WHEN OLPT_PNL_EVNT_CD = '300' THEN TIME(OLPT_EVNT_IN_DT) END) PANEL_END FROM IDB.OR_LOG_PANEL_TIMES GROUP BY OLPT_LOG_ID, OLPT_PNL_NO) SELECT DISTINCT SSE_MRN MRN, PT_LAST_NAME "Last Name", PT_FIRST_NAME "First Name", PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH "Date of Birth", PT_DATE_OF_DEATH "Date of Death", PLA_LST_APPT_DTE "Last Appointment Date", PLA_LST_DSCH_DTE "Last Discharge Date", YEAR(SSE_SURG_DTE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) "Age at Surgery", VIS_ADM_DTE "Admission Date", VIS_DSCH_DTE "Discharge Date", VIS_DAYS_STAY "Length of Stay", SSE_SURG_DTE "Surgery Date", TIME(SSE_SURG_STRT_DT) "Surgery Start", TIME(SSE_SURG_END_DT) "Surgery End", PANEL_START "Panel Start", PANEL_END "Panel End", SSP_PNL_NO "Panel No", SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD "CPT Code", SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC "CPT Description", TRIM(SSP_SURG_LAST_NM) || ', ' || TRIM(SSP_SURG_FIRST_NM) "Surgeon", SSP_SURG_SVC_CD "Service", SAE_TOXICITY_NAME "Toxicity Name", SAE_TOX_CAT_NAME "Toxicity Category", SAE_TOX_GRADE_NAME "Toxicity Grade", TM_DX_DTE "Tumor Diagnosis Date", TM_HIST_CD "Histology Code", HIST_DESC "Histology Description", TM_SITE_CD "Site Code", SITE_DESC "Site Description", RTC_TX_START_DTE "Radiation Start", RTC_TX_STOP_DTE "Radiation End", RTC_TX_PLAN_NAME "Rad Plan Name", RTC_TX_DELIVERED_FRACTIONS "Delivered Fraction", RTC_TX_DELIVERED_DOSE "Delivered Dose", RTC_PRIMARY_REF_POINT "Primary Reference Point" FROM IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE ON SSE_LOG_ID = SSP_LOG_ID AND SSE_ENC_CSN_ID = SSP_ENC_CSN_ID JOIN PANEL_TIME ON SSP_LOG_ID = OLPT_LOG_ID AND SSP_PNL_NO = OLPT_PNL_NO JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON SSE_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY ON PT_MRN = PLA_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.VISIT ON VIS_MRN = SSE_MRN AND VIS_VISIT_STATUS IN ('2', '3') AND VIS_ADM_DTE <= SSE_SURG_DTE AND COALESCE(VIS_DSCH_DTE, '2999-12-31') >= SSE_SURG_DTE LEFT JOIN IDB.SRG_ADVERSE_EVENT ON SSE_LOG_ID = SAE_SURG_LOG_ID AND SAE_PROC_SEQ_NO = SSP_PROC_SEQ_NO AND SAE_TOX_GRADE > '0' LEFT JOIN DX ON SSE_MRN = TM_MRN LEFT JOIN RAD ON SSE_MRN = RTC_TX_MRN WHERE YEAR(SSE_SURG_DTE) >= 2009 AND SSP_SURG_LAST_NM IN ('BILSKY', 'LAUFER', 'BARZILAI') AND YEAR(SSE_SURG_DTE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) >= 80 ORDER BY SSE_MRN, SSE_SURG_DTE, SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD, RTC_TX_START_DTE

prompt: Identify patients with peripheral T-cell lymphoma treated at MSK.
completion: SELECT DISTINCT "t1"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AS "Deident PT #", "t2"."PT_MRN" AS "MRN", "t2"."PT_LAST_NAME" AS "Last Name", "t2"."PT_FIRST_NAME" AS "First Name", "t3"."DT_DTE" AS "CDB Tumor Diagnosis Date", "t4"."TCA_CLASS_OF_CASE" AS "Class of Case", "t5"."DXCC_ICD_CODE" AS "ICD-O Histology Code", "t5"."DXCC_ICD_MSK_DESC" AS "ICD-O Histology Desc", "t6"."ICSC_SITE_CD" AS "ICD-O Site Code", "t6"."ICSC_ICDO_SITE_MSK_DESC" AS "ICD-O Site Desc" FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED" "t1" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V" "t2" ON "t1"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t2"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."CDB_TUMOR_V" "t7" ON "t1"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t7"."CDTM_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE" "t3" ON "t7"."CDTM_DX_DATE_ID" = "t3"."DT_DATE_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."TUMOR_CASE_ATTRIBUTES" "t4" ON "t7"."CDTM_CASE_ATTR_ID" = "t4"."TUMOR_CASE_ATTR_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DIAGNOSIS_CODE_CAT_ICDO_V" "t5" ON "t7"."CDTM_DX_CATALOG_ID" = "t5"."DXCC_DX_CATALOG_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."ICDO_SITE_CATALOG_V" "t6" ON "t7"."CDTM_SITE_CATALOG_ID" = "t6"."ICSC_SITE_CATALOG_ID" WHERE ("t5"."DXCC_ICD_CODE" IN ('M9700/3', 'M9702/3') AND ("t4"."TCA_CLASS_OF_CASE" IN ('Dx elsewhere tx here ', 'Dx elsewhere Tx here ', 'Dx here tx here ') AND "t3"."DT_DTE" >= '2000-1-1'))

JOIN IDB.ACCRUALS ON SSE_MRN = AC_MRN JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTV_DTL ON PT_MRN = LAD_MRN WHERE AC_IRB_NO IN ('06-107') ), PREOP_MEDS AS (SELECT CPO_MRN PREOPMEDS_MRN, CPO_DRUG_NAME PREOPMED_NAME, MIN(CPO_START_DTE) PREOPMED_START_DATE, MAX(CPO_STOP_DTE) PREOPMED_STOP_DATE FROM IDB.CHEMO_PERFORMED_ORDERS WHERE (UPPER(CPO_DRUG_NAME) LIKE '%PERTUZUMAB%' OR UPPER(CPO_DRUG_NAME) LIKE '%TRASTUZUMAB%') AND UPPER(CPO_DRUG_NAME) NOT LIKE '%ADO-TRASTUZUMAB%EMTANSINE%' AND UPPER(CPO_DRUG_NAME) NOT LIKE '%FAM-TRASTUZUMAB%' AND CPO_START_DTE BETWEEN '2013-01-01' AND '2022-03-31' GROUP BY CPO_MRN, CPO_DRUG_NAME ORDER BY CPO_MRN), POSTOP_MEDS AS (SELECT CPO_MRN POSTOPMEDS_MRN, CPO_DRUG_NAME POSTOPMED_NAME, MIN(CPO_START_DTE) POSTOPMED_START_DATE, MAX(CPO_STOP_DTE) POSTOPMED_STOP_DATE FROM IDB.CHEMO_PERFORMED_ORDERS GROUP BY CPO_MRN, CPO_DRUG_NAME ORDER BY CPO_MRN) SELECT MRN, LAST_NAME, FIRST_NAME, DOB, SURGERY_DATE, PROC_CODE, PROC_DESC, PT_LATEST_FOLLOWUP, PREOPMED_NAME, MIN(PREOPMED_START_DATE) PREOPMED_START_DATE, MAX(PREOPMED_STOP_DATE) PREOPMED_STOP_DATE FROM ELIGIBLE_PTS JOIN PREOP_MEDS ON MRN = PREOPMEDS_MRN AND SURGERY_DATE > PREOPMED_STOP_DATE JOIN POSTOP_MEDS ON MRN = POSTOPMEDS_MRN AND POSTOPMED_START_DATE > SURGERY_DATE GROUP BY MRN, LAST_NAME, FIRST_NAME, DOB, SURGERY_DATE, PROC_CODE, PROC_DESC, PT_LATEST_FOLLOWUP, PREOPMED_NAME ORDER BY MRN, SURGERY_DATE, PREOPMED_NAME, PREOPMED_STOP_DATE; WITH ELIGIBLE_PTS AS (SELECT SSE_MRN MRN, PT_LAST_NAME LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME FIRST_NAME, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH DOB, SSE_SURG_DTE SURGERY_DATE, SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD PROC_CODE, SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC PROC_DESC, LAD_FU_COMPL_DTE PT_LATEST_FOLLOWUP FROM IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE ON SSE_LOG_ID = SSP_LOG_ID AND SSE_ENC_CSN_ID = SSP_ENC_CSN_ID JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON SSE_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.ACCRUALS ON SSE_MRN = AC_MRN JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTV_DTL ON PT_MRN = LAD_MRN WHERE AC_IRB_NO IN ('06-107') ), PREOP_MEDS AS (SELECT CPO_MRN PREOPMEDS_MRN, CPO_DRUG_NAME PREOPMED_NAME, MIN(CPO_START_DTE) PREOPMED_START_DATE, MAX(CPO_STOP_DTE) PREOPMED_STOP_DATE FROM IDB.CHEMO_PERFORMED_ORDERS WHERE (UPPER(CPO_DRUG_NAME) LIKE '%PERTUZUMAB%' OR UPPER(CPO_DRUG_NAME) LIKE '%TRASTUZUMAB%') AND UPPER(CPO_DRUG_NAME) NOT LIKE '%ADO-TRASTUZUMAB%EMTANSINE%' AND UPPER(CPO_DRUG_NAME) NOT LIKE '%FAM-TRASTUZUMAB%' AND CPO_START_DTE BETWEEN '2013-01-01' AND '2022-03-31' GROUP BY CPO_MRN, CPO_DRUG_NAME ORDER BY CPO_MRN), POSTOP_MEDS AS (SELECT CPO_MRN POSTOPMEDS_MRN, CPO_DRUG_NAME POSTOPMED_NAME, MIN(CPO_START_DTE) POSTOPMED_START_DATE, MAX(CPO_STOP_DTE) POSTOPMED_STOP_DATE FROM IDB.CHEMO_PERFORMED_ORDERS GROUP BY CPO_MRN, CPO_DRUG_NAME ORDER BY CPO_MRN) SELECT MRN, LAST_NAME, FIRST_NAME, DOB, SURGERY_DATE, PROC_CODE, PROC_DESC PT_LATEST_FOLLOWUP, POSTOPMED_NAME, MIN(POSTOPMED_START_DATE) POSTOPMED_START_DATE, MAX(POSTOPMED_STOP_DATE) POSTOPMED_STOP_DATE FROM ELIGIBLE_PTS JOIN PREOP_MEDS ON MRN = PREOPMEDS_MRN AND SURGERY_DATE > PREOPMED_STOP_DATE JOIN POSTOP_MEDS ON MRN = POSTOPMEDS_MRN AND POSTOPMED_START_DATE > SURGERY_DATE GROUP BY MRN, LAST_NAME, FIRST_NAME, DOB, SURGERY_DATE, PROC_CODE, PROC_DESC, PT_LATEST_FOLLOWUP, POSTOPMED_NAME ORDER BY MRN, SURGERY_DATE, POSTOPMED_NAME, POSTOPMED_START_DATE; WITH ELIGIBLE_PTS AS (SELECT SSE_MRN MRN, PT_LAST_NAME LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME FIRST_NAME, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH DOB, SSE_SURG_DTE SURGERY_DATE, SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD PROC_CODE, SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC PROC_DESC, LAD_FU_COMPL_DTE PT_LATEST_FOLLOWUP FROM IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE ON SSE_LOG_ID = SSP_LOG_ID AND SSE_ENC_CSN_ID = SSP_ENC_CSN_ID JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON SSE_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.ACCRUALS ON SSE_MRN = AC_MRN JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTV_DTL ON PT_MRN = LAD_MRN WHERE AC_IRB_NO IN ('06-107') ), PREOP_MEDS AS (SELECT CPO_MRN PREOPMEDS_MRN, CPO_DRUG_NAME PREOPMED_NAME, MIN(CPO_START_DTE) PREOPMED_START_DATE, MAX(CPO_STOP_DTE) PREOPMED_STOP_DATE FROM IDB.CHEMO_PERFORMED_ORDERS WHERE (UPPER(CPO_DRUG_NAME) LIKE '%PERTUZUMAB%' OR UPPER(CPO_DRUG_NAME) LIKE '%TRASTUZUMAB%') AND UPPER(CPO_DRUG_NAME) NOT LIKE '%ADO-TRASTUZUMAB%EMTANSINE%' AND UPPER(CPO_DRUG_NAME) NOT LIKE '%FAM-TRASTUZUMAB%' AND CPO_START_DTE BETWEEN '2013-01-01' AND '2022-03-31' GROUP BY CPO_MRN, CPO_DRUG_NAME ORDER BY CPO_MRN), STATUS AS (SELECT CDD_MRN STATUS_MRN, CDD_SERVICE_DTE STATUS_DATE, CDD_DOC_GUID, CDD_DOC_NAME, CDO_ITEM_NAME STATUS_NAME, CDO_VALUE_TEXT STATUS_VALUE FROM IDB.CD_DOCUMENT JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION ON CDD_DOC_GUID = CDO_DOC_GUID AND CDD_AUTHORED_DTE = CDO_AUTHORED_DTE WHERE 1=1 AND CDD_CANCEL_IND <> '1' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND <> '1' AND (CDD_DOC_NAME IN ('Follow Up Note - Breast Surgery', 'Follow Up, NP - Breast Surgery', 'Follow Up - Breast Surgery', 'Follow Up - Surgery-Breast', 'Follow Up, NP/PA - Breast Surgery') AND CDO_ITEM_NAME IN ('HER2:', 'ER:', 'PR:')) ORDER BY CDD_MRN), AXI_DISS AS (SELECT CDD_MRN AD_MRN, CDD_SERVICE_DTE AD_DATE, CDD_DOC_GUID, CDD_DOC_NAME, CDO_ITEM_NAME, CDO_VALUE_TEXT FROM IDB.CD_DOCUMENT JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION ON CDD_DOC_GUID = CDO_DOC_GUID AND CDD_AUTHORED_DTE = CDO_AUTHORED_DTE WHERE 1=1 AND CDD_CANCEL_IND <> '1' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND <> '1' AND UPPER(CDO_ITEM_NAME) LIKE 'AXILLARY DISSECTION%' ORDER BY CDD_MRN) SELECT DISTINCT MRN, LAST_NAME, FIRST_NAME, DOB, SURGERY_DATE, PROC_CODE, PROC_DESC PT_LATEST_FOLLOWUP, CASE WHEN (STATUS_NAME IN ('HER2:', 'ER:', 'PR:') AND STATUS_VALUE IS NOT NULL) THEN CONCAT(TRIM(STATUS_NAME), TRIM(STATUS_VALUE)) ELSE ' ' END HER_ER_PR_STATUS, CASE WHEN (UPPER(CDO_ITEM_NAME) LIKE 'AXILLARY DISSECTION%' AND CDO_VALUE_TEXT IS NOT NULL) THEN 'YES' ELSE 'NO' END AXILLARY_DISSECTION, CASE WHEN RTC_TX_PLAN_NAME IS NOT NULL THEN 'YES' ELSE 'NO' END RAD_TREATMENT FROM ELIGIBLE_PTS JOIN PREOP_MEDS ON MRN = PREOPMEDS_MRN AND SURGERY_DATE > PREOPMED_STOP_DATE LEFT JOIN STATUS ON MRN = STATUS_MRN AND STATUS_DATE > SURGERY_DATE LEFT JOIN AXI_DISS ON MRN = AD_MRN AND AD_DATE = SURGERY_DATE LEFT JOIN IDB.RADONC_TREATMENT_COURSE ON MRN = RTC_TX_MRN AND RTC_TX_START_DTE > SURGERY_DATE ORDER BY MRN, SURGERY_DATE

prompt: Tableau Dashboard to track how many telemetry notes generate an initial cardiology consult.
completion: SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN AS MRN, TEL_DT "Telemetry Time", MAX(CASE WHEN CARDS_MRN IS NOT NULL AND TIMESTAMPDIFF(4, CHAR("Cards Consult Start" - TEL_DT)) <= 1440 THEN TEL_DT ELSE NULL END) "Telemetry Time Prior to Consult", MAX("Cards Consult Name") "Cards Consult Name", MAX("Cards Consult Start") "Cards Consult Start" FROM IDB.PATIENT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT CDD_MRN AS T_MRN, CDD_SERVICE_DT AS TEL_DT FROM IDB.CD_DOCUMENT JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION ON CDD_DOC_GUID = CDO_DOC_GUID AND CDD_AUTHORED_DTE = CDO_AUTHORED_DTE JOIN IDB.OMS_PROVIDER ON CDD_AUTH_PROV_GUID = OP_PVDR_GUID WHERE CDD_CANCEL_IND <> '1' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND <> '1' AND CDD_DOC_NAME = 'Telemetry Review - Cardiology' AND CDD_SERVICE_DTE >= '2018-06-01' ) TELEMETRY ON PT_MRN = T_MRN LEFT JOIN (SELECT CDD_MRN AS CARDS_MRN, CDD_DOC_NAME "Cards Consult Name", CDD_CREATE_DT "Cards Consult Start" FROM IDB.CD_DOCUMENT JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION ON CDD_DOC_GUID = CDO_DOC_GUID AND CDD_AUTHORED_DTE = CDO_AUTHORED_DTE JOIN IDB.OMS_PROVIDER ON CDD_AUTH_PROV_GUID = OP_PVDR_GUID WHERE CDD_CANCEL_IND <> '1' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND <> '1' AND CDD_DOC_NAME IN ('Initial Consult/Initial Visit, IP - DOM-Cardiology', 'Initial Consult/Initial Visit, NP/PA, IP - DOM-Cardiology', 'Initial Consultation - Cardiology', 'Initial Consultation - PED-Cardiology', 'Initial Consultation, IP - Cardiology', 'Initial Consultation, IP - Cardiology-NP', 'Initial Consultation, IP - Cardiology-PA') ) CARDS ON PT_MRN = CARDS_MRN AND "Cards Consult Start" >= TEL_DT AND TIMESTAMPDIFF(4, CHAR("Cards Consult Start" - TEL_DT)) <= 1440 GROUP BY PT_MRN, TEL_DT ORDER BY PT_MRN

prompt: Daily reports of orders submitted in the previous 24 hours for "Financial Clearance for Chemotherapy (Neurology)" including regional sites.
completion: WITH ORDERS AS (SELECT DISTINCT OO_MRN, OOC_ITEM_NAME, OO_ENTER_DTE, OO_SUMMARY_LINE, DOC_NAME REQ_DR_NAME, DOC_ACDMC_SVC REQ_DR_SVC, OO_ORD_STS_CD FROM IDB.OMS_ORDER JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_CATALOG ON OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID = OOC_MSTR_ITEM_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_STATUS ON OO_ORD_STS_CD = OSTS_ORD_STS_CD JOIN IDB.DOC ON DOC_DR_NO = OO_REQ_DR_NO JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PT_MRN = OO_MRN WHERE OOC_ITEM_NAME IN ('bEVAcizumab INJ', 'Financial Clearance for Chemotherapy (Neurology)') AND OO_ORD_STS_CD NOT IN ('CANP', 'CANC', 'AUC3') AND OO_ENTER_DTE BETWEEN (SELECT DISTINCT CASE WHEN DAYOFWEEK(CURRENT date) = 2 THEN CURRENT date - 3 DAYS ELSE CURRENT date - 1 DAY END FROM SYSIBM.SYSDUMMY1) AND (SELECT DISTINCT CASE WHEN DAYOFWEEK(CURRENT date) = 2 THEN CURRENT date - 1 DAYS ELSE CURRENT date - 1 DAY END FROM SYSIBM.SYSDUMMY1) ) , CNS AS (SELECT DISTINCT TM_MRN MRN, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS HIST_DESC, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_DESC FROM ORDERS JOIN IDB.CDB_TUMOR ON TM_MRN = OO_MRN JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS ON AV_ELEMENT = 'CASE_STS' AND AV_CODE = TM_CASE_STS AND TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') WHERE TM_SITE_CD LIKE 'C71%' OR TM_SITE_CD = 'C729' UNION SELECT DISTINCT CC_MRN MRN, 'NA' AS HIST_DESC, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_DESC FROM ORDERS JOIN IDB.CTC_CLSF ON CC_MRN = OO_MRN JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND (CC_CLSF_CD IN ('C72.9') OR SUBSTR(CC_CLSF_CD, 1, 3) = ('C71')) ) , CHEMO AS (SELECT DISTINCT APR_MRN, APR_GENERIC_NAME, APR_END_DTE "Last Chemo Date", ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY APR_MRN ORDER BY APR_END_DTE DESC) AS RANK FROM CNS JOIN IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX_V ON APR_MRN = MRN WHERE APR_END_DTE IS NOT NULL ) SELECT DISTINCT OO_MRN MRN, SITE_DESC, HIST_DESC, CHAR(OO_ENTER_DTE) ENTERED_DATE, OOC_ITEM_NAME ITEM_NAME, OO_SUMMARY_LINE SUMMARY_LINE, REQ_DR_NAME ORDER_DOCTOR, OO_ORD_STS_CD STATUS, CHAR(PLA_LST_RT_DTE) LAST_RT_DATE, CHAR("Last Chemo Date") LAST_CHEMO_DATE, APR_GENERIC_NAME "Chemo Name" FROM ORDERS JOIN CNS ON MRN = OO_MRN JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY ON PLA_MRN = OO_MRN LEFT JOIN CHEMO ON APR_MRN = OO_MRN AND RANK = 1 ; SELECT DISTINCT TM_MRN MRN, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS HIST_DESC, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_DESC, TM_DX_DTE AS DX_DTE FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS ON AV_ELEMENT = 'CASE_STS' AND AV_CODE = TM_CASE_STS AND TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') WHERE (TM_SITE_CD LIKE 'C71%' OR TM_SITE_CD = 'C729') AND TM_DX_DTE >= CURRENT date - 14 DAY UNION SELECT DISTINCT CC_MRN MRN, 'NA' AS HIST_DESC, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_DESC, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) DX_DTE FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND (CC_CLSF_CD IN ('C72.9') OR SUBSTR(CC_CLSF_CD, 1, 3) = ('C71')) GROUP BY CC_MRN, 'NA', CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK HAVING MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) >= CURRENT date - 14 DAY ;

prompt: Design a report of patients with the specified diagnoses who had a metastatic resection of the brain in the past month.
completion: WITH PATH AS (SELECT DISTINCT "t1"."PT_MRN" AS "MRN", PRPT_ORD_DR_NAME, "t2"."PRPT_ACCESSION_NO" AS "Pathology Report", "t3"."PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_DESC" AS "Pathology Report Type", "t4"."DT_DTE" AS "Pathology Procedure Date", UPPER(CASE WHEN LENGTH(PRPT_REPORT) <= 15000 THEN RTRIM(CAST(SUBSTR(PRPT_REPORT, 1, 15000) AS VARCHAR(15000))) ELSE CAST(SUBSTR(PRPT_REPORT, 1, 15000) AS VARCHAR(15000)) END) AS TXT, CASE WHEN UPPER(DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)DIAGNOSIS:[\w\W]*(?=I ATTEST)', PRPT_REPORT)) <> '' THEN UPPER(DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)DIAGNOSIS:[\w\W]*(?=I ATTEST)', PRPT_REPORT)) WHEN UPPER(DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)DIAGNOSIS:[\w\W]*(?=NOTE:)', PRPT_REPORT)) <> '' THEN UPPER(DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)DIAGNOSIS:[\w\W]*(?=NOTE:)', PRPT_REPORT)) WHEN UPPER(DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)DIAGNOSIS:[\w\W]*(?=REPORT ELECTRONICALLY SIGNED OUT )', PRPT_REPORT)) <> '' THEN UPPER(DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)DIAGNOSIS:[\w\W]*(?=REPORT ELECTRONICALLY SIGNED OUT )', PRPT_REPORT)) END AS DIAGNOSIS, CASE WHEN UPPER(DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)SPECIMENS SUBMITTED[\w\W]*(?=DIAGNOSIS:)', PRPT_REPORT)) <> '' THEN UPPER(DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)SPECIMENS SUBMITTED[\w\W]*(?=DIAGNOSIS:)', PRPT_REPORT)) WHEN UPPER(DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)SPECIMENSSUBMITTED[\w\W]*(?=DIAGNOSIS:)', PRPT_REPORT)) <> '' THEN UPPER(DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)SPECIMENSSUBMITTED[\w\W]*(?=DIAGNOSIS:)', PRPT_REPORT)) END AS "SPECIMENS SUBMITTED" FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V" "t1" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED" "t6" ON "t1"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t6"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V" "t2" ON "t6"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t2"."PRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATH_RPRT_TYPE_LOOKUP" "t3" ON "t2"."PRPT_REPORT_TYPE" = "t3"."PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_CD" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" "t4" ON "t2"."PRPT_PROCEDURE_DATE_ID" = "t4"."DT_DATE_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" "t5" ON "t2"."PRPT_REPORT_DATE_ID" = "t5"."DT_DATE_ID" WHERE 1=1 AND CONTAINS("t2"."PRPT_REPORT", '("BRAIN")') = 1 AND "t2"."PRPT_REPORT" IS NOT NULL AND UPPER("t3"."PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_DESC") LIKE '%SURGICAL PATHOLOGY%' AND "t4"."DT_DTE" BETWEEN CURRENT DATE - (DAY(CURRENT DATE) - 1) DAYS - 1 MONTH AND CURRENT DATE - (DAY(CURRENT DATE)) DAYS ) , DX AS (SELECT DISTINCT TM_MRN AS MRN, CATEGORY2 FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN PATH ON MRN = TM_MRN JOIN IDB.SEERGROUPING ON RECODE = IDB.SEERF_ICDO(TM_SITE_CD, TM_HIST_CD) AND CATEGORY2 IN ('Esophagus', 'Stomach', 'Breast', 'Lung and Bronchus', 'Colon and Rectum') JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD WHERE 1=1 AND TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') UNION SELECT CC_MRN AS MRN, CATEGORY2 FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN PATH ON MRN = CC_MRN JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.SEERGROUPING ON RECODE = MIN(IDB.SEERF_ICD9(CLM_CLSF_CD), IDB.SEERF_ICD10(CLM_CLSF_CD)) AND CATEGORY2 IN ('Esophagus', 'Stomach', 'Breast', 'Lung and Bronchus', 'Colon and Rectum') WHERE CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND CASE WHEN CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y' THEN 'Y' WHEN CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' AND YEAR(CC_EFF_DTE) < 2004 THEN 'Y' WHEN CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND YEAR(CC_EFF_DTE) < 2001 THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END = 'Y' AND CC_PT_TYPE <> 'E' GROUP BY CC_MRN, CATEGORY2 ) SELECT DISTINCT P.*, CATEGORY2 AS DX FROM PATH P JOIN DX D ON P.MRN = D.MRN

prompt: Provide a list of all patients, 18 and older, with gliomas.
completion: WITH X AS (SELECT DISTINCT "t1"."PT_MRN" AS "MRN", STRIP(PT_LAST_NAME) || ', ' || STRIP(PT_FIRST_NAME) AS NAME, PT_SEX, PT_BIRTH_DTE, PT_DEATH_DTE, "t2"."PRPT_ACCESSION_NO" AS "Pathology Report", "t3"."PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_DESC" AS "Pathology Report Type", "t4"."DT_DTE" AS "Pathology Procedure Date", UPPER(CASE WHEN LENGTH(PRPT_REPORT) <= 15000 THEN RTRIM(CAST(SUBSTR(PRPT_REPORT, 1, 15000) AS VARCHAR(15000))) ELSE CAST(SUBSTR(PRPT_REPORT, 1, 15000) AS VARCHAR(15000)) END) AS TXT, CASE WHEN UPPER(DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)DIAGNOSIS:[\w\W]*(?=I ATTEST)', PRPT_REPORT)) <> '' THEN UPPER(DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)DIAGNOSIS:[\w\W]*(?=I ATTEST)', PRPT_REPORT)) WHEN UPPER(DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)DIAGNOSIS:[\w\W]*(?=NOTE:)', PRPT_REPORT)) <> '' THEN UPPER(DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)DIAGNOSIS:[\w\W]*(?=NOTE:)', PRPT_REPORT)) WHEN UPPER(DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)DIAGNOSIS:[\w\W]*(?=REPORT ELECTRONICALLY SIGNED OUT )', PRPT_REPORT)) <> '' THEN UPPER(DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)DIAGNOSIS:[\w\W]*(?=REPORT ELECTRONICALLY SIGNED OUT )', PRPT_REPORT)) END AS DIAGNOSIS FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V" "t1" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED" "t6" ON "t1"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t6"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V" "t2" ON "t6"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t2"."PRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATH_RPRT_TYPE_LOOKUP" "t3" ON "t2"."PRPT_REPORT_TYPE" = "t3"."PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_CD" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" "t4" ON "t2"."PRPT_PROCEDURE_DATE_ID" = "t4"."DT_DATE_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" "t5" ON "t2"."PRPT_REPORT_DATE_ID" = "t5"."DT_DATE_ID" WHERE 1=1 AND CONTAINS("t2"."PRPT_REPORT", '("GLIOMA" OR "ASTROCYTOMA" OR "GLIOBLASTOMA")') = 1 AND "t2"."PRPT_REPORT" IS NOT NULL AND UPPER("t3"."PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_DESC") LIKE '%SURGICAL PATHOLOGY%' AND "t4"."DT_DTE" BETWEEN '2007-01-01' AND CURRENT date AND YEAR("t4"."DT_DTE" - PT_BIRTH_DTE) >= 18 ) , Y AS (SELECT "MRN", NAME, PT_SEX, PT_BIRTH_DTE, PT_DEATH_DTE, "Pathology Report", "Pathology Report Type", "Pathology Procedure Date", TXT, DIAGNOSIS FROM X WHERE 1=1 AND(LOCATE('GLIOMA', UPPER(DIAGNOSIS)) > 0 OR LOCATE('ASTROCYTOMA', UPPER(DIAGNOSIS)) > 0 OR LOCATE('GLIOBLASTOMA', UPPER(DIAGNOSIS)) > 0) ) SELECT DISTINCT RTC_TX_MRN, RTC_TX_PLAN_NAME, RTC_PRIMARY_REF_POINT, RTC_TX_START_DTE, RTC_TX_STOP_DTE, RTC_TX_ELAPSED_DAYS, RTC_TX_PLANNED_FRACTIONS, RTC_TX_DELIVERED_FRACTIONS, RTC_TX_PLANNED_DOSE, RTC_TX_DELIVERED_DOSE, RTC_DOSE_CORRECTION FROM IDB.RADONC_TREATMENT_COURSE JOIN Y ON RTC_TX_MRN = MRN

prompt: Provide a weekly list of Thoracic, GI, Head and Neck and Neuro patients receiving concurrent chemo and radiation therapy.
completion: WITH MAIN AS (SELECT A.* , ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY MAIN_MRN, MAIN_RPT_GRP_8 ORDER BY COUNT DESC) AS ORDER_RANK FROM (SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN MAIN_MRN, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 MAIN_RPT_GRP_8, CRE_RES_NAME MAIN_RES_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT CPE_ENC_CSN_ID) AS COUNT FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CRE_RES_TYP IN ('Physician') AND CPE_ENC_DTE >= CURRENT date - 18 MONTHS AND ((CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 = 'MED' AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 IN ('THR', 'GI', 'HNS')) OR (CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 = 'NEU' AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 = 'NEU')) GROUP BY CPE_MRN, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8, CRE_RES_NAME) A) , CHM_APPTS AS (SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN, CPE_ENC_DTE, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8, CLD_DEPT_NAME, R.CRE_RES_NAME, CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME, R1.CRE_RES_NAME AS CHM_REF_PROVIDER, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CPE_MRN ORDER BY CPE_ENC_DTE ASC) AS CHM_RANK FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN MAIN ON MAIN_MRN = CPE_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE R ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = R.CRE_RES_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE R1 ON CPE_REF_RES_ID = R1.CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Sch') AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT date AND CURRENT date +14 DAYS AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 = 'CHM' ) , RDO_APPTS AS (SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN, CPE_ENC_DTE, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8, CLD_DEPT_NAME, R.CRE_RES_NAME, CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME, R1.CRE_RES_NAME AS RDO_REF_PROVIDER, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CPE_MRN ORDER BY CPE_ENC_DTE ASC) AS RDO_RANK FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN MAIN ON MAIN_MRN = CPE_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE R ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = R.CRE_RES_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE R1 ON CPE_REF_RES_ID = R1.CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Sch') AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT date AND CURRENT date +14 DAYS AND (CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 = 'RDO' AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 = 'RO TX') ) , THERAPEUTICS AS (SELECT DISTINCT ACD_MRN , MAX(CASE WHEN ACD_TX_END_DTE IS NULL THEN ACD_MRN END) AS ACTIVE_ACD_MRN FROM IDB.ACCRUALS_DATES AD JOIN IDB.PROTOCOL PR ON PR.PRO_IRB_NO = AD.ACD_IRB_NO JOIN MAIN ON MAIN_MRN = ACD_MRN AND PR.PRO_PROTOCOL_TYPE IN ('Diagnostic', 'Psychosocial', 'Quality of Life', 'Therapeutic', 'Therapeutic/QOL') GROUP BY ACD_MRN) , PROTOCOLS AS (SELECT DISTINCT AC_MRN , LISTAGG('| ' || TRIM(AC_IRB_NO) || ' |', CHR(13) || CHR(10)) WITHIN GROUP( ORDER BY AC_CONS_DTE) AS PROTOCOLS FROM (SELECT DISTINCT AC_MRN, AC_IRB_NO, AC_CONS_DTE FROM IDB.ACCRUALS JOIN MAIN ON MAIN_MRN = AC_MRN) A GROUP BY AC_MRN) SELECT DISTINCT MAIN_MRN "MRN", PT_LAST_NAME AS "Last Name", PT_FIRST_NAME AS "First Name", TRIM(L.AV_DESC) AS "Language", MAIN_RPT_GRP_8 AS "Service", MAIN_RES_NAME AS "Provider", C.CPE_ENC_DTE AS "CHM Appt Date", C.CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 AS "CHM Service", C.CHM_REF_PROVIDER "CHM Provider", C.CRE_RES_NAME AS "CHM Resource", C.CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME AS "CHM Visit Type", R.CPE_ENC_DTE AS "RDO Appt Date", R.CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 AS "RDO Service", R.RDO_REF_PROVIDER "RDO Provider", R.CRE_RES_NAME AS "RDO Resource", R.CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME AS "RDO Visit Type", CASE WHEN ACTIVE_ACD_MRN IS NOT NULL THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS "Active Therapeutics Protocol", PROTOCOLS AS "Protocols" FROM MAIN JOIN CHM_APPTS C ON MAIN_MRN = C.CPE_MRN JOIN RDO_APPTS R ON MAIN_MRN = R.CPE_MRN LEFT JOIN THERAPEUTICS ON MAIN_MRN = ACD_MRN LEFT JOIN PROTOCOLS ON MAIN_MRN = AC_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON MAIN_MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS L ON PT_PRIMARY_LANG = L.AV_CODE AND L.AV_ELEMENT = 'PRIMARY_LANG' WHERE 1=1 AND ORDER_RANK = 1 AND ((C.CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN R.CPE_ENC_DTE - 14 DAYS AND R.CPE_ENC_DTE + 14 DAYS) OR (R.CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN C.CPE_ENC_DTE - 14 DAYS AND C.CPE_ENC_DTE + 14 DAYS)) AND CHM_RANK = 1 AND RDO_RANK = 1 ;

prompt: This request seeks to identify all adult recipients of allogeneic HCT at MSKCC during 2021-2022.
completion: WITH SURG AS (SELECT DISTINCT CBM_MRN, CBM_TRANSPLANT_DTE, CBM_TRANSPLANT_TYPE, CBM_DISEASE FROM IDB.CRDB_BMT_MEDICINE WHERE CBM_TRANSPLANT_TYPE = 'ALLO' AND CBM_TRANSPLANT_DTE BETWEEN '2021-01-01' AND '2022-12-31' ) , EMPLOYED AS (SELECT DISTINCT CDD_MRN, CDD_SERVICE_DTE, LISTAGG(COALESCE(STRIP(CAST(CDO_ITEM_NAME AS VARCHAR(12000))), '')||' - '|| COALESCE(STRIP(CAST(CDO_VALUE_TEXT AS VARCHAR(12000))), '')|| ' | ', CHR(13) || CHR(10)) WITHIN GROUP ( ORDER BY CDO_ITEM_NAME) AS INCOME_STATUS FROM (SELECT DISTINCT CDD_MRN, CDD_SERVICE_DTE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY CDD_MRN, CDO_ITEM_NAME ORDER BY CDD_SERVICE_DTE DESC) AS RN_INC, CDD_DOC_NAME, CDO_SECTION, CDO_ITEM_NAME, CDO_VALUE_TEXT FROM IDB.CD_DOCUMENT LEFT JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION ON CDD_DOC_GUID = CDO_DOC_GUID AND CDD_AUTHORED_DTE = CDO_AUTHORED_DTE JOIN IDB.OMS_PROVIDER ON CDD_AUTH_PROV_GUID = OP_PVDR_GUID JOIN SURG ON CBM_MRN = CDD_MRN WHERE CDD_CANCEL_IND <> '1' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND <> '1' AND (UPPER(CDD_DOC_NAME) LIKE '%SOCIAL%' OR UPPER(CDO_SECTION) LIKE '%SOCIAL%') AND CDO_ITEM_NAME IN ('Occupation', 'Patient Employment Status:', 'Mother Employment:', 'Mother Employment Status:', 'Father Employment Status:', 'Employment Status') ) WHERE RN_INC = 1 GROUP BY CDD_MRN, CDD_SERVICE_DTE) , INCOME AS (SELECT DISTINCT E.CDD_MRN AS MRN_INCOME, INCOME_DOC_DATE, INCOME_STATUS FROM (SELECT DISTINCT CDD_MRN, MAX(CDD_SERVICE_DTE) AS INCOME_DOC_DATE FROM EMPLOYED GROUP BY CDD_MRN) X JOIN EMPLOYED E ON X.CDD_MRN = E.CDD_MRN AND INCOME_DOC_DATE = E.CDD_SERVICE_DTE) , FINANCIAL_REFERRAL AS (SELECT DISTINCT CDD_MRN AS MRN_REFERRAL, MAX(CDD_SERVICE_DTE) AS REFERRAL_DOC_DATE, CDO_ITEM_NAME AS REFERRAL_ITEM_NAME, CDO_VALUE_TEXT AS REFERRAL_STATUS FROM IDB.CD_DOCUMENT LEFT JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION ON CDD_DOC_GUID = CDO_DOC_GUID AND CDD_AUTHORED_DTE = CDO_AUTHORED_DTE AND CDO_VALUE_TEXT <> '' JOIN SURG ON CBM_MRN = CDD_MRN WHERE CDD_CANCEL_IND <> '1' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND <> '1' AND CDO_VALUE_TEXT= 'Patient Financial Services' GROUP BY CDD_MRN, CDO_ITEM_NAME, CDO_VALUE_TEXT ) , MARRIED AS (SELECT * FROM (SELECT DISTINCT CDD_MRN AS MRN_MARRIED, CDD_SERVICE_DTE AS MARRIED_DOC_DATE, CDD_DOC_NAME AS MARRIED_DOC_NAME, CDO_SECTION AS MARRIED_SECTION, CDO_ITEM_NAME AS MARRIED_ITEM_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY CDD_MRN ORDER BY CDD_SERVICE_DTE DESC) AS RN_MAR, CDO_VALUE_TEXT AS MARRIED_STATUS FROM IDB.CD_DOCUMENT LEFT JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION ON CDD_DOC_GUID = CDO_DOC_GUID AND CDD_AUTHORED_DTE = CDO_AUTHORED_DTE AND CDO_VALUE_TEXT <> '' JOIN IDB.OMS_PROVIDER ON CDD_AUTH_PROV_GUID = OP_PVDR_GUID JOIN SURG ON CBM_MRN = CDD_MRN WHERE CDD_CANCEL_IND <> '1' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND <> '1' AND CDO_ITEM_NAME IN ('Marital Status:', 'Marital Status') ) WHERE RN_MAR = 1 ) , FAMILY AS (SELECT * FROM (SELECT DISTINCT CDD_MRN AS MRN_FAMILY, ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY CDD_MRN ORDER BY CDD_SERVICE_DTE DESC) AS RN_FAM, CDD_DOC_NAME AS FAMILY_DOC_NAME, CDO_SECTION AS FAMILY_SECTION, CDO_ITEM_NAME AS FAMILY_ITEM_NAME, CDD_SERVICE_DTE AS FAMILY_DOC_DATE, CDO_VALUE_TEXT AS FAMILY_STATUS FROM IDB.CD_DOCUMENT LEFT JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION ON CDD_DOC_GUID = CDO_DOC_GUID AND CDD_AUTHORED_DTE = CDO_AUTHORED_DTE AND CDO_VALUE_TEXT <> '' JOIN IDB.OMS_PROVIDER ON CDD_AUTH_PROV_GUID = OP_PVDR_GUID JOIN SURG ON CBM_MRN = CDD_MRN WHERE CDD_CANCEL_IND <> '1' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND <> '1' AND CDO_ITEM_NAME IN ('Family History') ) WHERE RN_FAM = 1 ) , INSURANCE AS (SELECT * FROM (SELECT DISTINCT MRN AS MRN_INSURANCE, INS_CODE, INS_COMP_NAME, INS_EFF_DATE, INS_EXP_DATE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY MRN ORDER BY INS_EFF_DATE DESC) AS RN_INS FROM IDB.PATIENT_INSURANCE_V JOIN SURG ON CBM_MRN = MRN WHERE INS_CODE <> ' ' ) WHERE RN_INS = 1 ) SELECT DISTINCT CBM_MRN AS MRN, CBM_TRANSPLANT_DTE AS TRANSPLANT_DATE, CBM_TRANSPLANT_TYPE AS TRANSPLANT_TYPE, CBM_DISEASE AS DISEASE, CASE WHEN PT_DATE_OF_DEATH IS NOT NULL THEN 'DECEASED' ELSE 'ALIVE' END AS SURVIVAL_STATUS, INCOME_STATUS, REFERRAL_STATUS, MARRIED_STATUS, FAMILY_STATUS, INS_COMP_NAME, INS_EFF_DATE, INS_EXP_DATE FROM SURG JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PT_MRN = CBM_MRN LEFT JOIN INCOME ON CBM_MRN = MRN_INCOME LEFT JOIN FINANCIAL_REFERRAL ON CBM_MRN = MRN_REFERRAL LEFT JOIN MARRIED ON CBM_MRN = MRN_MARRIED LEFT JOIN FAMILY ON CBM_MRN = MRN_FAMILY LEFT JOIN INSURANCE ON CBM_MRN = MRN_INSURANCE ORDER BY CBM_MRN;

prompt: Please add dates linked to distant metastasis and local recurrence from Breast Surgery Follow Up ClinDoc.
completion: SELECT CDD_MRN, CDD_DOC_GUID, CDD_SERVICE_DTE, CDD_DOC_NAME , MAX(CASE WHEN CDO_OBS_CTLG_MSTR_ITEM_GUID = '9000098313402890' THEN STRIP(SUBSTR(CDO_VALUE_TEXT, 1, 200)) END) AS "Local Recurrence" , MAX(CASE WHEN CDO_OBS_CTLG_MSTR_ITEM_GUID = '9000098313802890' THEN STRIP(SUBSTR(CDO_VALUE_TEXT, 1, 200)) END) AS "Local Recurrence Date" FROM IDB.CD_DOCUMENT JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION ON CDO_DOC_GUID = CDD_DOC_GUID WHERE 1=1 AND CDD_MRN IN ('00018710', '35593448') AND CDD_CANCEL_IND = '0' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND = '0' AND CDD_DOC_NAME IN ('Follow Up - Breast Surgery' , 'Follow Up - Surgery-Breast' , 'Follow Up Note - Breast Surgery' , 'Follow Up, AMB - Breast Surgery' , 'Follow Up, APP, AMB - Breast Surgery' , 'Follow Up, NP - Breast Surgery' , 'Follow Up, NP/PA - Breast Surgery') AND CDO_OBS_CTLG_MSTR_ITEM_GUID IN ('9000098313402890' , '9000098313802890') AND CDO_VALUE_TEXT IS NOT NULL AND CDO_VALUE_TEXT > '' GROUP BY CDD_MRN, CDD_DOC_GUID, CDD_SERVICE_DTE, CDD_DOC_NAME ORDER BY CDD_MRN, CDD_DOC_GUID, CDD_SERVICE_DTE ; SELECT CDD_MRN, CDD_DOC_GUID, CDD_SERVICE_DTE, CDD_DOC_NAME , STRIP(SUBSTR(CDO_VALUE_TEXT, 1, 200)) AS "Local Recurrence" ; SELECT CDD_MRN, CDD_DOC_GUID, CDD_SERVICE_DTE, CDD_DOC_NAME , CDO_ITEM_NAME , STRIP(SUBSTR(CDO_VALUE_TEXT, 1, 200)) AS "Text", CDO_OBS_CTLG_MSTR_ITEM_GUID , CDO_SECTION, CDO_CTLG_DISPL_NM , CDO_MSTR_ITEM_NM FROM IDB.CD_DOCUMENT JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION ON CDO_DOC_GUID = CDD_DOC_GUID WHERE 1=1 AND CDD_MRN IN ('00018710', '35593448') AND CDD_CANCEL_IND = '0' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND = '0' AND CDD_DOC_NAME IN ('Follow Up - Breast Surgery' , 'Follow Up - Surgery-Breast' , 'Follow Up Note - Breast Surgery' , 'Follow Up, AMB - Breast Surgery' , 'Follow Up, APP, AMB - Breast Surgery' , 'Follow Up, NP - Breast Surgery' , 'Follow Up, NP/PA - Breast Surgery' ) AND CDO_OBS_CTLG_MSTR_ITEM_GUID IN ('9000098313802890', '9000098314402890') AND CDO_VALUE_TEXT IS NOT NULL AND CDO_VALUE_TEXT > '' AND CDD_MRN IN ('00018710', '35593448') ORDER BY CDD_MRN, CDD_DOC_GUID, CDD_SERVICE_DTE ;
