AND CDD_MRN IN ('00004716', '00004745', '00005046', '00005578', '00005630', '00005785', '00005787', '00006351', '00006541', '00006660', '00006680', '00006793', '00006831', '00006995', '00006997', '00007511', '00007627', '00007735') ;

prompt: Patients diagnosed with leiomyosarcoma since 2008.
completion: WITH X AS (SELECT DISTINCT TM_MRN, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, TM_HIST_CD AS HIST_CODE, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS HIST_DESC, TM_SITE_CD AS SITE_CODE, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_DESC, TM_DX_DTE AS DX_DATE FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM H ON TM_HIST_CD = H.CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON TM_SITE_CD = S.CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON TM_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('3', '6', '7', '8') AND TM_HIST_CD IN ('M8890/0', 'M8890/1', 'M8890/3', 'M8890/6') AND TM_DX_DTE >= '2008-01-01' ) SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN, GENE, RESULT, METHOD FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_STRUCTURED_RESULTS_V WHERE PT_MRN IN (SELECT TM_MRN FROM X) AND METHOD = 'IMPACT'

prompt: All cytology reports for a subset of pre-identified patients
Provide information on Cardiology Inpatient Consult order from 6/24/13-Present.
completion: SELECT OO_MRN MRN, STRIP(PT_LAST_NAME)||', '||STRIP(PT_FIRST_NAME) AS PT_NAME , OO_ENTER_DT ORDER_ENTER_DT , OO_SIGNIFICANT_DT ORD_COMPLETE_DT , DOC_NAME AS ATTENDING, OU_DISPLAY_NAME REQUESTEDBY, MAX(CASE WHEN OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'Consult_Cardio IP Dx CF' THEN OUD_USER_DI_VALUE ELSE '' END) CARDIODX, MAX(CASE WHEN OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'Consult_Cardio IP Reason' THEN OUD_USER_DI_VALUE ELSE '' END) REASONFORCONSULT, MAX(CASE WHEN OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'RequestedTime' THEN OUD_USER_DI_VALUE ELSE '' END) TIMEPRIORITY, MAX(CASE WHEN OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'Requested For' THEN OUD_USER_DI_VALUE ELSE '' END) REQUESTEDFOR FROM IDB.OMS_ORDER JOIN IDB.OMS_USER ON OO_PVDR_GUID = OU_USER_GUID JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON OO_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.DOC ON OO_REQ_DR_NO = DOC_DR_NO JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_USER_DATA ON OO_ORD_GUID = OUD_ORD_GUID WHERE OO_ORD_NAME = 'Cardiology Inpatient Consult' AND OO_ORD_STS_CD NOT LIKE 'CAN%' AND OO_ENTER_DTE >= '2013-06-24' GROUP BY OO_MRN, OO_ENTER_DT , OO_SIGNIFICANT_DT , DOC_NAME , PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, OU_DISPLAY_NAME

prompt: Volume of oncology patients with an outpatient visit at Ralph Lauren Center in 2022 under age 65 and over or equal to age 65 by disease type.
completion: WITH FIRST_COUNT AS (SELECT DISTINCT CASE WHEN YEAR(DATE(CC_EFF_DTE) - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) <= 65 THEN 'Under 65' ELSE 'Over 65' END AS AGE, CLM_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK, CLD_CLD_CENTER AS LOCATION, PT_MRN FROM IDB.PATIENT P JOIN IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER ON PT_MRN = CPE_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CTC_CLSF ON PT_MRN = CC_MRN JOIN IDB.CLM ON CLM_CLSF_CD = CC_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS ON AV_CODE = CC_CLSF_TYPE WHERE AV_ELEMENT = 'CLSF_TYPE' AND CPE_CPE_IP_IND <> 'INPATIENT' AND CC_EFF_DTE BETWEEN '2022-01-01' AND '2022-12-31' AND TRIM(CLD_CLD_CENTER) = '1919' AND (CC_CLSF_CD BETWEEN 'C00' AND 'D49' OR CC_CLSF_CD BETWEEN '140' AND '239.99') ) SELECT AGE, LOCATION, CLM_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK, COUNT(DISTINCT PT_MRN) AS PATIENT_COUNT FROM FIRST_COUNT GROUP BY AGE, LOCATION, CLM_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK ORDER BY AGE; WITH FIRST_COUNT AS (SELECT DISTINCT CASE WHEN YEAR(DATE(CC_EFF_DTE) - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) <= 65 THEN 'Under 65' ELSE 'Over 65' END AS AGE, CLD_CLD_CENTER AS LOCATION, PT_MRN FROM IDB.PATIENT P JOIN IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER ON PT_MRN = CPE_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CTC_CLSF ON PT_MRN = CC_MRN JOIN IDB.CLM ON CLM_CLSF_CD = CC_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS ON AV_CODE = CC_CLSF_TYPE WHERE AV_ELEMENT = 'CLSF_TYPE' AND CPE_CPE_IP_IND <> 'INPATIENT' AND CC_EFF_DTE BETWEEN '2022-01-01' AND '2022-12-31' AND TRIM(CLD_CLD_CENTER) = '1919' AND (CC_CLSF_CD BETWEEN 'C00' AND 'D49' OR CC_CLSF_CD BETWEEN '140' AND '239.99') ) SELECT AGE, LOCATION, COUNT(DISTINCT PT_MRN) AS PATIENT_COUNT FROM FIRST_COUNT GROUP BY AGE, LOCATION ORDER BY AGE

prompt: Provide a report on patients prescribed with probiotics.
completion: SELECT DISTINCT OO_MRN, OOC_THERAPEUTIC_CAT, OO_ORD_NAME, OOTO_SIGNIFIC_DTE, STRIP(OP_DISPLAY_NAME) AS "Requested By:" FROM IDB.PATIENT JOIN IDB.OMS_ORDER ON PT_MRN = OO_MRN JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_CATALOG ON OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID = OOC_MSTR_ITEM_GUID JOIN IDB.OAS_ORD_TASK_OCCR ON OOTO_ORD_GUID = OO_ORD_GUID AND OOTO_STATUS_CD = 'Performed' JOIN IDB.OAS_CTLG_ITEM_TASK ON OOTO_CAT_ITEM_GUID = OCIT_GUID AND OCIT_LEVEL_NO = 0 JOIN IDB.OMS_PROVIDER ON OP_PVDR_GUID = OO_PVDR_GUID WHERE OO_ORD_STS_CD NOT IN ('CANC', 'CANP', 'AUC3') AND UPPER(OOC_THERAPEUTIC_CAT) like '%PROBIOTIC%' WITH GENDRUG AS (SELECT DISTINCT HGN_GENERIC_NAME, OCDX_DRUG_KEY CAT_DRUG_KEY, CASE WHEN (C2.ODC_CATEGORY_NAME = ' ' OR C2.ODC_CATEGORY_NAME IS NULL) THEN C1.ODC_CATEGORY_NAME WHEN (C3.ODC_CATEGORY_NAME = ' ' OR C3.ODC_CATEGORY_NAME IS NULL) THEN C2.ODC_CATEGORY_NAME CONCAT ' | ' CONCAT C1.ODC_CATEGORY_NAME ELSE C3.ODC_CATEGORY_NAME CONCAT ' | ' CONCAT C2.ODC_CATEGORY_NAME END AS CATEGORY_NAME FROM IDB.HML_GENERIC_NAME JOIN IDB.OMS_CATEGORY_DRUG_XREF ON HGN_DRUG_CATALOG_KEY = OCDX_DRUG_KEY JOIN IDB.OMS_DRUG_CATEGORIES C1 ON C1.ODC_MULTUM_CATEGORY_ID = OCDX_MULTUM_CATEGORY_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_CATEGORY_SUB_XREF L2 ON C1.ODC_MULTUM_CATEGORY_ID = L2.OCSX_SUB_CATEGORY_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_DRUG_CATEGORIES C2 ON C2.ODC_MULTUM_CATEGORY_ID = L2.OCSX_MULTUM_CATEGORY_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_CATEGORY_SUB_XREF L3 ON L2.OCSX_MULTUM_CATEGORY_ID = L3.OCSX_SUB_CATEGORY_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_DRUG_CATEGORIES C3 ON C3.ODC_MULTUM_CATEGORY_ID = L3.OCSX_MULTUM_CATEGORY_ID), DRUGRN AS (SELECT DISTINCT CAT_DRUG_KEY, HGN_GENERIC_NAME, CATEGORY_NAME , ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CAT_DRUG_KEY ORDER BY CATEGORY_NAME) RN FROM GENDRUG), DRUGCAT AS (SELECT CAT_DRUG_KEY, HGN_GENERIC_NAME GENERIC_NAME , MAX(CASE WHEN RN = 1 THEN CATEGORY_NAME END)|| MAX(CASE WHEN RN = 2 THEN '; '||STRIP(CATEGORY_NAME) ELSE '' END)|| MAX(CASE WHEN RN = 3 THEN '; '||STRIP(CATEGORY_NAME) ELSE '' END)|| MAX(CASE WHEN RN = 4 THEN '; '||STRIP(CATEGORY_NAME) ELSE '' END) THERAP_CATEGORY FROM DRUGRN GROUP BY CAT_DRUG_KEY, HGN_GENERIC_NAME) SELECT HCPR_MRN , HCPR_PRESCRIPTION_ID RX_ID , HCPR_CREATED_DTE RX_CREATE_DATE , DATE(HCPR_START_DT) START_DATE , HCPR_END_DT AS END_DATE , DATE(HCPR_DISCONTINUE_DT) AS DISCONTINUE_DATE , HCPR_DRUG_NAME AS DRUG_NAME , HGN_GENERIC_NAME AS GENERIC_NAME , HCPR_STATUS_TYPE_DESC AS PRESCRIPTION_STATUS , HCPR_PRESCRIPTION_TYPE_DESC AS RX_TYPE , THERAP_CATEGORY , HCPR_DOSE_AMT AS DOSE_AMT , UOM.HRUM_NAME UOM , HCPR_ROUTE AS ROUTE , HCPR_NDC AS NDC , REQ.OU_DISPLAY_NAME AS "Requester", REQ.OU_ORD_ROLE_TYPE AS "Requester Role" FROM IDB.HML_CLIENT_PRESCRIPTION LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_CLIENT_VISIT ON OCV_VISIT_GUID = HCPR_VISIT_GUID LEFT JOIN IDB.HML_GENERIC_NAME ON HGN_GENERIC_NAME_ID = HCPR_GENERIC_NAME_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_USER USR ON USR.OU_USER_GUID = HCPR_USER_GUID LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_USER REQ ON REQ.OU_USER_GUID = HCPR_CARE_PROV_GUID LEFT JOIN IDB.HML_RX_UNIT_OF_MEASURE UOM ON UOM.HRUM_RXUOM_ID = HCPR_DOSE_UOM_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.HML_RX_UNIT_OF_MEASURE PKG ON PKG.HRUM_RXUOM_ID = HCPR_INNER_PACKAGE_SIZE_UOM_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.HML_SCRIPT_FREQUENCY ON HSF_SCRIPT_FREQ_ID = HCPR_SCRIPT_FREQ_ID LEFT JOIN DRUGCAT ON CAT_DRUG_KEY = HGN_DRUG_CATALOG_KEY WHERE HCPR_STATUS_TYPE NOT IN (4, 5, 8) AND HCPR_CREATED_DTE IS NOT NULL AND((HCPR_PRESCRIPTION_TYPE = 1 AND HCPR_TRANSMISSION_STATUS IN (1, 2, 5) ) OR HCPR_PRESCRIPTION_TYPE = 3) AND UPPER(THERAP_CATEGORY) LIKE '%PROBIOTIC%'

prompt: Provide a demographic, diagnostic and procedural list of pediatric oncology patients who were diagnosed with fever, neutropenia, and subsequent enterocolitis as identified in the DAVInCI adhoc report Neutropenic Enterocolitis in Pediatric Patients.
completion: SELECT DISTINCT "t3"."PT_MRN" AS "MRN", "t3"."PT_SEX" AS "Gender", "t3"."PT_BIRTH_DTE" AS "Date of Birth", YEAR("t3"."PT_BIRTH_DTE") AS "Year of Birth", "t5"."DT_DTE" AS "ICD-9 First Dx Date", YEAR("t5"."DT_DTE") AS "ICD-9 First Dx Year", "t7"."DXCC_ICD_CODE" AS "ICD-9 Code", "t7"."DXCC_ICD_MSK_DESC" AS "ICD-9 Description", "t6"."DT_DTE" AS "ICD9 Procedure Date", YEAR("t6"."DT_DTE") AS "ICD9 Procedure Year", "t4"."PCC_CODE" AS "ICD9 Procedure Code", "t4"."PCC_DESC" AS "ICD9 Procedure Desc", "t2"."DT_DTE" AS "Tumor Diagnosis Date", YEAR("t2"."DT_DTE") AS "Tumor Diagnosis Year", YEAR("t2"."DT_DTE"-"t3"."PT_BIRTH_DTE") AS "Age at Dx - in years" FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED" "t1" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_ICDO_DIAGNOSIS_V" "t8" ON "t1"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t8"."PDX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE" "t2" ON "t8"."PDX_DX_DATE_ID" = "t2"."DT_DATE_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V" "t3" ON "t1"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t3"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."ICD9_PATIENT_PROCEDURE" "t4" ON "t1"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t4"."PTX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE" "t6" ON "t4"."PTX_PROC_DATE_ID" = "t6"."DT_DATE_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DIAGNOSIS_FINAL_ALL_V" "t9" ON "t1"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t9"."PDX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DIAGNOSIS_FINAL_DATES_V" "t10" ON "t9"."PDX_DX_CATALOG_ID" = "t10"."PDX_DX_CATALOG_ID" AND "t9"."PDX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t10"."PDX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE" "t5" ON "t10"."FIRST_DIAGNOSIS_DATE_ID" = "t5"."DT_DATE_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DIAGNOSIS_CODE_CAT_ICD9_V" "t7" ON "t9"."PDX_DX_CATALOG_ID" = "t7"."DXCC_DX_CATALOG_ID" WHERE ((("t7"."DXCC_ICD_CODE" = '555.1' OR "t7"."DXCC_ICD_CODE" = '558.2') OR "t7"."DXCC_ICD_CODE" = '558.9') AND (YEAR("t2"."DT_DTE"-"t3"."PT_BIRTH_DTE") <= 21 AND (("t4"."PROC_ID" IN (6873, 7208, 6874, 7209, 6875, 7210) OR "t4"."PROC_ID" IN (6869, 6870, 7205, 6871, 7206, 6872, 7207, 6880, 6882)) AND YEAR("t2"."DT_DTE") >= 1990)))

prompt: We are looking to evaluate differential outcomes between patients receiving weekly versus high dose chemotherapy for NPC.
completion: WITH NPC_PTS AS (SELECT DISTINCT TM_MRN , TM_DX_DTE, TM_HIST_CD, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS HIST_DESC, TM_SITE_CD, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_DESC , ROW_NUMBER () OVER (PARTITION BY TM_MRN ORDER BY TM_DX_DTE ASC) DX_RN FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS ON AV_ELEMENT = 'CASE_STS' AND AV_CODE = TM_CASE_STS WHERE 1 = 1 AND TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND TM_SITE_CD LIKE 'C11%' AND TM_DX_DTE >= '2003-01-01' ) , CHEMO_PTS AS (SELECT APR_MRN, MIN(APR_START_DTE) APR_START_DTE, MAX(APR_END_DTE) APR_END_DTE, CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME FROM IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX_V WHERE APR_START_DTE >= '2003-01-01' AND CDG_CHEMO_FLAG = 'Y' AND APR_MRN IN (SELECT DISTINCT TM_MRN FROM NPC_PTS) GROUP BY APR_MRN, CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME) , LIST1 AS (SELECT PT_MRN, TRIM(PT_LAST_NAME) || ',' || TRIM(PT_FIRST_NAME) PT_NAME, TM_DX_DTE DX_DATE, TM_HIST_CD DX_CD, HIST_DESC DX_DESC, SITE_DESC DX_SITE_DESC FROM NPC_PTS JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON TM_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE PT_MRN IN (SELECT DISTINCT APR_MRN FROM CHEMO_PTS) ) , LIST2 AS (SELECT APR_MRN, PT_NAME, APR_START_DTE, APR_END_DTE, CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME FROM CHEMO_PTS JOIN LIST1 ON PT_MRN = APR_MRN AND APR_START_DTE > DX_DATE) SELECT * FROM LIST2

prompt: Identify all female patients who have had their MRI biopsies cancelled on the day of the procedure since January 2000. This will be a monthly request as the waiver is resubmitted to the IRB each month to extend the date range of the patient population to be reviewed.
completion: SELECT MRN, PT_NAME, APPT_DATE, DEPT_NAME, COMP_VISIT_NAME, BX_VISIT_NAME , BX_CANCEL_DTE, BX_CANCEL_RSN, MAMMO_VISIT_NAME, MAMMO_CANCEL_RSN , FU_APPT_DATE, FU_APPT_STS, FU_DEPT_NAME, FU_VISIT_NAME , FU_MADE_DTE, DAYS(FU_MADE_DTE) - DAYS(BX_CANCEL_DTE) SCH_WITHIN_DAYS FROM (SELECT CPE_MRN MRN, STRIP(CL_LAST_NAME)||', '||STRIP(CL_FIRST_NAME) PT_NAME , CPE_ENC_DTE APPT_DATE, SUBSTR(CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME, 1, 35) COMP_VISIT_NAME , STRIP(CHAR(CLD_DEPT_ID))||'-'||SUBSTR(CLD_DEPT_NAME, 1, 20) DEPT_NAME FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_PATIENT ON CL_MRN = CPE_MRN AND CL_SEX = 'F' JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CLD_DEPT_ID = CPE_DEPT_ID AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 = 'RAD' JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID AND CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR like '%MRBR%' WHERE CPE_ENC_DTE >= DATE(CURRENT_DATE - DAY(CURRENT_DATE - 1 DAY) DAY) - 1 MONTH AND CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Comp', 'Arrived') ) VST JOIN (SELECT CPE_MRN BX_MRN, CPE_ENC_DTE BX_APPT_DATE, CPE_CANCEL_DTE BX_CANCEL_DTE , SUBSTR(CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME, 1, 35) BX_VISIT_NAME, CPE_CPE_CANCEL_RSN BX_CANCEL_RSN FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_PATIENT ON CL_MRN = CPE_MRN AND CL_SEX = 'F' JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CLD_DEPT_ID = CPE_DEPT_ID AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 = 'RAD' JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID AND CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR like '%MRBRBX%' WHERE CPE_ENC_DTE >= DATE(CURRENT_DATE - DAY(CURRENT_DATE - 1 DAY) DAY) - 1 MONTH AND CPE_CPE_APPT_STS = 'Can' ) BX ON MRN = BX_MRN AND APPT_DATE = BX_APPT_DATE AND APPT_DATE = BX_CANCEL_DTE JOIN (SELECT CPE_MRN MAMMO_MRN, CPE_ENC_DTE MAMMO_APPT_DATE, CPE_CANCEL_DTE MAMMO_CANCEL_DTE , SUBSTR(CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME, 1, 35) MAMMO_VISIT_NAME , CPE_CPE_CANCEL_RSN MAMMO_CANCEL_RSN FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_PATIENT ON CL_MRN = CPE_MRN AND CL_SEX = 'F' JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CLD_DEPT_ID = CPE_DEPT_ID AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 = 'RAD' JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID AND CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR like '%BXMRD%' WHERE CPE_ENC_DTE >= DATE(CURRENT_DATE - DAY(CURRENT_DATE - 1 DAY) DAY) - 1 MONTH AND CPE_CPE_APPT_STS = 'Can' ) MAMMO ON BX_MRN = MAMMO_MRN AND BX_APPT_DATE = MAMMO_APPT_DATE AND BX_CANCEL_DTE = MAMMO_CANCEL_DTE LEFT JOIN (SELECT CPE_MRN FU_MRN, CPE_ENC_DTE FU_APPT_DATE, CPE_CPE_APPT_STS FU_APPT_STS , STRIP(CHAR(CLD_DEPT_ID))||'-'||SUBSTR(CLD_DEPT_NAME, 1, 20) FU_DEPT_NAME , SUBSTR(CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME, 1, 35) FU_VISIT_NAME, CPE_APPT_MADE_DTE FU_MADE_DTE FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_PATIENT ON CL_MRN = CPE_MRN AND CL_SEX = 'F' JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CLD_DEPT_ID = CPE_DEPT_ID AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 = 'RAD' JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID AND CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR like '%BR%' AND CPE_ENC_DTE >= DATE(CURRENT_DATE - DAY(CURRENT_DATE - 1 DAY) DAY) - 1 MONTH AND CPE_CPE_APPT_STS <> 'Can') FU ON MRN = FU_MRN AND FU_APPT_DATE > BX_APPT_DATE AND DAYS(FU_MADE_DTE) - DAYS(BX_CANCEL_DTE) BETWEEN 0 AND 15

prompt: Provide a list of patient's returning to thoracic surgery clinic who are diagnosed with Non-small cell lung cancer, stratified by stage. Also provide date of last thoracic surgery visit.
completion: WITH TUMOR AS (SELECT TM_MRN, TM_DX_DTE, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS HIST_DESC, LISTAGG(TRIM(S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK), ' | ') WITHIN GROUP( ORDER BY S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK) AS SITE_DESC FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND TM_HIST_CD IN ('M8013/3', 'M8014/3', 'M8022/3', 'M8030/3', 'M8031/3', 'M8032/3', 'M8033/3', 'M8046/3', 'M8052/2', 'M8052/3', 'M8070/2', 'M8070/3', 'M8071/2', 'M8071/3', 'M8072/3', 'M8073/3', 'M8074/2', 'M8074/3', 'M8083/3', 'M8140/2', 'M8140/3', 'M8250/2', 'M8250/3', 'M8251/3', 'M8252/3', 'M8253/3', 'M8254/3', 'M8255/3', 'M8260/2', 'M8260/3', 'M8310/3', 'M8333/3', 'M8480/2', 'M8480/3', 'M8481/3', 'M8490/2', 'M8490/3', 'M8560/2', 'M8560/3', 'M8572/3', 'M8574/3', 'M8972/3', 'M8973/3', 'M8980/3') AND TM_SITE_CD LIKE 'C34%' AND TM_DX_DTE >= '2019-01-01' GROUP BY TM_MRN, TM_DX_DTE, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK ) , CONSENT_APPT AS (SELECT CPE_MRN AS CONSENT_MRN, CPE_ENC_DTE AS CONSENT_APPT_DTE FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN TUMOR ON CPE_MRN = TM_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME = 'THR CONSENT ONLY' AND CLD_DEPT_NAME IN ('THORACIC 53-10', 'THORACIC 53-9') AND CPE_ENC_DTE >= '2019-01-01' ) , THR AS (SELECT CPE_MRN AS THR_MRN, MAX(CPE_ENC_DTE) AS LAST_THR_APPT_DTE FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN TUMOR ON CPE_MRN = TM_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 = 'SRG' AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 = 'THR' AND CPE_ENC_DTE >= '2019-01-01' GROUP BY CPE_MRN ) SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN AS MRN , PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH AS DOB , HIST_DESC AS PRIMARY_TUMOR_HIST , SITE_DESC AS PRIMARY_TUMOR_SITE , TM_DX_DTE AS CANCER_DX_DTE , CONSENT_APPT_DTE , LAST_THR_APPT_DTE , CASE WHEN AC_IRB_NO IS NOT NULL THEN 'Y' END AS "12-245?" FROM IDB.PATIENT JOIN TUMOR ON PT_MRN = TM_MRN LEFT JOIN CONSENT_APPT ON PT_MRN = CONSENT_MRN LEFT JOIN THR ON PT_MRN = THR_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.ACCRUALS ON PT_MRN = AC_MRN AND AC_IRB_NO = '12-245' ; WITH TUMOR AS (SELECT TM_MRN, TM_DX_DTE, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS HIST_DESC, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_DESC FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND TM_HIST_CD IN ('M8013/3', 'M8014/3', 'M8022/3', 'M8030/3', 'M8031/3', 'M8032/3', 'M8033/3', 'M8046/3', 'M8052/2', 'M8052/3', 'M8070/2', 'M8070/3', 'M8071/2', 'M8071/3', 'M8072/3', 'M8073/3', 'M8074/2', 'M8074/3', 'M8083/3', 'M8140/2', 'M8140/3', 'M8250/2', 'M8250/3', 'M8251/3', 'M8252/3', 'M8253/3', 'M8254/3', 'M8255/3', 'M8260/2', 'M8260/3', 'M8310/3', 'M8333/3', 'M8480/2', 'M8480/3', 'M8481/3', 'M8490/2', 'M8490/3', 'M8560/2', 'M8560/3', 'M8572/3', 'M8574/3', 'M8972/3', 'M8973/3', 'M8980/3') AND TM_SITE_CD LIKE 'C34%' AND TM_DX_DTE >= '2019-01-01' ) , CONSENT_APPT AS (SELECT CPE_MRN AS CONSENT_MRN, CPE_ENC_DTE AS CONSENT_APPT_DTE FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN TUMOR ON CPE_MRN = TM_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE 1=1 AND CPE_CPE_APPT_STS = 'Sch' AND CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME = 'THR CONSENT ONLY' AND CLD_DEPT_NAME IN ('THORACIC 53-10', 'THORACIC 53-9') AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT DATE AND CURRENT DATE + 21 DAYS ) , THR AS (SELECT CPE_MRN AS THR_MRN, MAX(CPE_ENC_DTE) AS LAST_THR_APPT_DTE FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN TUMOR ON CPE_MRN = TM_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 = 'SRG' AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 = 'THR' AND CPE_ENC_DTE >= '2019-01-01' GROUP BY CPE_MRN ) SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN AS MRN , PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH AS DOB , HIST_DESC AS PRIMARY_TUMOR_HIST , SITE_DESC AS PRIMARY_TUMOR_SITE , TM_DX_DTE AS CANCER_DX_DTE , CONSENT_APPT_DTE , LAST_THR_APPT_DTE , CASE WHEN AC_IRB_NO IS NOT NULL THEN 'Y' END AS "12-245?" FROM IDB.PATIENT JOIN TUMOR ON PT_MRN = TM_MRN JOIN CONSENT_APPT ON PT_MRN = CONSENT_MRN LEFT JOIN THR ON PT_MRN = THR_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.ACCRUALS ON PT_MRN = AC_MRN AND AC_IRB_NO = '12-245'

prompt: New Jersey COVID Vaccine Reporting (Running in HI22363 Python Script)
completion: WITH HM AS (SELECT MRN, ACTION_DTE, SITE, HSEO_ROUTE_CD, DOSE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY MRN ORDER BY SCHED_EVENT_OCCR_ID DESC) MAX_RN, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY MRN ORDER BY SCHED_EVENT_OCCR_ID ASC) MIN_RN FROM IDB.COVID19_EMPLOYEE_VACCINE_HM WHERE STATUS_TYPE_DESC = 'Completed' ) , HM_DOSE AS (SELECT MRN, ACTION_DTE, SITE, HSEO_ROUTE_CD, DOSE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY MRN ORDER BY ACTION_DTE ASC) DOSE_NUM FROM HM WHERE (MAX_RN = 1 OR MIN_RN = 1) ) , RACE_ETHNICITY AS (SELECT PT_MRN RE_MRN, CASE WHEN R.AV_CODE = '1' THEN 'White' WHEN R.AV_CODE = '2' THEN 'Black or African-American' WHEN R.AV_CODE = '3' THEN 'American Indian OR Alaska Native' WHEN R.AV_CODE = '4' THEN 'Asian' WHEN R.AV_CODE = '5' THEN 'Native Hawaiian or Other Pacific Islander' WHEN R.AV_CODE = '8' THEN 'Other Race' ELSE 'Prefer not to Specify' END AS RE_RACE, CASE WHEN E.AV_CODE = 'HIS' THEN 'Hispanic or Latino' WHEN E.AV_CODE = 'NON' THEN 'Not Hispanic' ELSE 'Prefer not to Specify' END RE_ETHNICITY, E.AV_CODE FROM IDB.PATIENT LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS R ON R.AV_ELEMENT = 'RACE' AND R.AV_CODE = PT_RACE LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS E ON E.AV_ELEMENT = 'PT_ETHNICITY' AND E.AV_CODE = PT_PT_ETHNICITY LEFT JOIN IDB.CDB_PATIENT ON PT_MRN = CP_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS CE ON CE.AV_ELEMENT = 'ETHNICITY' AND CE.AV_CODE = CP_ETHNICITY) SELECT '' "NJIIS_Facility_ID", RTRIM(CAST(PT_LAST_NAME AS CHAR(50))) "Patient_Last_Name", RTRIM(CAST(COALESCE(PT_FIRST_NAME, 'NO FIRST NAME') AS CHAR(50))) "Patient_First_Name", LEFT(CAST(PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH AS CHAR(10)), 4) || LEFT(RIGHT(CAST(PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH AS CHAR(10)), 5), 2) || RIGHT(CAST(PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH AS CHAR(10)), 2) "Patient_Date_of_Birth_YYYYMMDD", CASE WHEN PT_SEX NOT IN ('M', 'F') THEN 'U' ELSE CAST(PT_SEX AS CHAR(1)) END "Administrative_Sex", RE_RACE "Race", RTRIM(CAST(PT_ADDR1 AS CHAR(55))) "Patient_Address_Street_or_Mailing_Address", RTRIM(CAST(PT_ADDR2 AS CHAR(55))) "Patient_Address_line_2", RTRIM(CAST(PT_CITY AS CHAR(52))) "Patient_Address_City", RTRIM(CAST(PT_STATE AS CHAR(2))) "Patient_Address_State", RTRIM(CAST(PT_ZIP_CD AS CHAR(9))) "Patient_Address_Zip", 'Home' "Patient_Address_Type", LEFT(CAST(PT_PHONE AS CHAR(12)), 3) + LEFT(RIGHT(CAST(PT_PHONE AS CHAR(12)), 8), 3) || RIGHT(RIGHT(CAST(PT_PHONE AS CHAR(12)), 8), 4) "Phone_Number", RE_ETHNICITY "Ethnic_Group", LEFT(CAST(DATE(CEVE_ADMIN_DT) AS CHAR(10)), 4) || LEFT(RIGHT(CAST(DATE(CEVE_ADMIN_DT) AS CHAR(10)), 5), 2) || RIGHT(CAST(DATE(CEVE_ADMIN_DT) AS CHAR(10)), 2) "Date_of_Administration_YYYYMMDD", DOSE "Vaccine_Administered_Amount", CEVE_LOT "Vaccine_Lot_Number", LEFT(CAST(DATE(CEVE_LOT_EXP_DTE) AS CHAR(10)), 4) || LEFT(RIGHT(CAST(DATE(CEVE_LOT_EXP_DTE) AS CHAR(10)), 5), 2) || RIGHT(CAST(DATE(CEVE_LOT_EXP_DTE) AS CHAR(10)), 2) "Vaccine_Expiration_Date_YYYYMMDD", CEVE_MFG_NAME "Vaccine_Manufacturer_Name", CASE WHEN HSEO_ROUTE_CD like '%IM%' THEN 'Intramuscular' ELSE 'Other' END "Vaccine_Route_of_Administration", CASE WHEN SITE like '%Deltoid%' AND SITE like '%right%' THEN 'Right Deltoid' WHEN SITE like '%Deltoid%' AND SITE like '%left%' THEN 'Left Deltoid' ELSE 'Other' END "Vaccine_Administration_Site" FROM (SELECT CEVE_MRN, 'Employee' CEVE_COHORT, CEVE_ORDER_GUID, CEVE_PT_TYPE, CEVE_ADMIN_DT, CEVE_TASK_STATUS_CD, CEVE_ORDER_NAME, CEVE_DOSE_NUM, CEVE_MFG_NAME, CEVE_LOT, CEVE_LOT_EXP_DTE, CEVE_LOCATION_DESC FROM IDB.COVID19_EMPLOYEE_VACCINE_EMAR WHERE CEVE_PT_TYPE = 'Employee' AND CEVE_TASK_STATUS_CD = 'Performed' UNION SELECT CPVE_MRN CEVE_MRN, 'Patient' CEVE_COHORT, CPVE_ORDER_GUID CEVE_ORDER_GUID, CPVE_PT_TYPE CEVE_PT_TYPE, CPVE_ADMIN_DT CEVE_ADMIN_DT, CPVE_TASK_STATUS_CD CEVE_TASK_STATUS_CD, CPVE_ORDER_NAME CEVE_ORDER_NAME, CPVE_DOSE_NUM CEVE_DOSE_NUM, CPVE_MFG_NAME CEVE_MFG_NAME, CPVE_LOT CEVE_LOT, CPVE_LOT_EXP_DTE CEVE_LOT_EXP_DTE, CPVE_LOCATION_DESC CEVE_LOCATION_DESC FROM IDB.COVID19_PATIENT_CP_VACCINE_EMAR WHERE CPVE_TASK_STATUS_CD = 'Performed' ) JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON CEVE_MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN HM_DOSE ON MRN = CEVE_MRN AND RIGHT(CEVE_DOSE_NUM, 1) = DOSE_NUM LEFT JOIN RACE_ETHNICITY ON MRN = RE_MRN WHERE CEVE_TASK_STATUS_CD = 'Performed' AND DATE(CEVE_ADMIN_DT) >= CURRENT date - 1 DAY AND HSEO_ROUTE_CD IS NOT NULL

prompt: I just want to obtain a list of patients (MRN, accession number, ID) with urothelial cancer (bladder or upper tract) with MSK-IMPACT and MSK-ACCESS testing performed between 4/2022 and present day.
completion: SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN AS MRN , PDRX_DMP_PATIENT_ID AS DMP_PATIENT_ID, PDRX_DMP_SAMPLE_ID AS DMP_SAMPLE_ID , PRPT_ACCESSION_NO AS "M Accession" , PRPT_REPORT_DTE AS "Report Date" , DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)(S|H|C|M|F|B|DMG)[0-9]{2}[\s|-][0-9]*', XMLCAST(XMLQUERY('$x/root/meta-data/part_description' PASSING PDRX_XML_VALUE AS "x") AS VARCHAR(2000))) AS "Ref Accession" , DV.TODATE(DT_PROCEDURE) AS "Procedure Date" , T.* FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML DT CROSS JOIN XMLTABLE('$c/root/ *' PASSING DT.PDRX_XML_VALUE AS "c" COLUMNS PRIMARY_SITE VARCHAR(264) PATH '../meta-data/primary_site', TUMOR_TYPE_CODE VARCHAR(264) PATH '../meta-data/tumor_type_code' , TUMOR_TYPE_NAME VARCHAR(264) PATH '../meta-data/tumor_type_name' , METASTASIS_SITE VARCHAR(264) PATH '../meta-data/metastasis_site' , GENE_PANEL VARCHAR(264) PATH '../meta-data/gene-panel' , PART_DESCRIPTION VARCHAR(264) PATH '../meta-data/part_description' , DT_PROCEDURE VARCHAR(100) PATH '../meta-data/dt_procedure') T JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT T.TUMOR_TYPE_CODE TTC FROM TABLE(DV.STRING_SPLIT('BLADDER', ',')) S CROSS JOIN TABLE(DV.ONCOTREE_CHILDREN(TRIM(COLUMN_VALUES))) T) X ON T.TUMOR_TYPE_CODE = X.TTC JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PDRX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V ON PRPT_PATH_RPT_ID = PDRX_PATH_RPT_ID WHERE 1=1 ORDER BY MRN

prompt: Requesting all "HLA Antibody Screen, Class I and Class II" CIS results from MSK Histocompatibility Lab from 7/1/2021 to 5/1/2022.
completion: WITH X AS (SELECT DISTINCT PT_FIRST_NAME FIRST_NAME, PT_LAST_NAME LAST_NAME, LR_MRN MRN, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH DATE_OF_BIRTH, LR_TEST_NAME TEST_NAME, LR_SUBTEST_NAME SUBTEST_NAME, LR_PERFORMED_DTE TEST_DATE, LR_RESULT_VALUE RESULT_VALUE, LTL_TEXT_RESULT TEXT_RESULTS, LR_RESULT_TYPE_CD RESULT_TYPE_CD, LR_RESULT_STS_CD RESULT_STATUS_CD, LR_RESULT_GUID GUID, LR_ACCESSION_NO ACCNO FROM IDB.LAB_RESULTS LEFT JOIN IDB.LAB_TEXT_LINE ON LTL_RESULT_GUID = LR_RESULT_GUID JOIN IDB.PATIENT P ON LR_MRN =PT_MRN WHERE LR_PERFORMED_DTE BETWEEN '2021-07-01' AND '2022-06-23' AND LR_TEST_NAME = ('HLA AntiBODY Screen, Class I and Class II') AND LR_SUBTEST_NAME IN ('HLA Class I AntiBODY Screen Result', 'HLA Class II AntiBODY Screen Result', 'Test Comments', 'Performed Date', 'HLA Class I Antibodies MFI 1000-4000', 'HLA Class I Antibodies MFI 4001-10000 ', 'HLA Class I Antibodies MFI >10000', 'HLA Class I Antibody Interpretation', 'HLA CLASS I Antibody ID Performed Date', 'HLA Class II Antibodies MFI 1000-4000', 'HLA Class II Antibodies MFI 4001-10000 ', 'HLA Class II Antibodies MFI >10000', 'HLA Class II Antibody Interpretation', 'HLA Class II Antibody ID Performed Date', 'Test Methodology', 'HLA Methodology Comments', 'HLA Blood Specimen Source', 'Adult or Pediatric Service', 'Recipient Diagnosis', 'ASHI Laboratory Director') ) SELECT DISTINCT X.MRN, X.ACCNO, X.TEST_NAME, X.TEST_DATE, A.SUBTEST_NAME AS HLA_CLASS_I_AB_SCREEN_RESULT, A.RESULT_VALUE AS RESULT, A.TEXT_RESULTS , A.RESULT_TYPE_CD, A.RESULT_STATUS_CD, B.SUBTEST_NAME AS HLA_CLASS_II_AB_SCREEN_RESULT, D.SUBTEST_NAME AS PERFORMED_DATE, D.RESULT_VALUE AS RESULT, D.TEXT_RESULTS , D.RESULT_TYPE_CD, D.RESULT_STATUS_CD, E.SUBTEST_NAME AS HLA_CLASS_I_AB_MFI_1000_4000, E.RESULT_VALUE AS RESULT, E.TEXT_RESULTS , E.RESULT_TYPE_CD, E.RESULT_STATUS_CD, F.SUBTEST_NAME AS HLA_CLASS_I_AB_MFI_4001_10000, F.RESULT_VALUE AS RESULT, F.TEXT_RESULTS , F.RESULT_TYPE_CD, F.RESULT_STATUS_CD, G.SUBTEST_NAME AS HLA_CLASS_I_AB_MFI_10000, G.RESULT_VALUE AS RESULT, G.TEXT_RESULTS , G.RESULT_TYPE_CD, G.RESULT_STATUS_CD, H.SUBTEST_NAME AS HLA_CLASS_I_AB_INTERPRETATION, H.RESULT_VALUE AS RESULT, H.TEXT_RESULTS , H.RESULT_TYPE_CD, H.RESULT_STATUS_CD, I.SUBTEST_NAME AS HLA_CLASS_I_AB_ID_PERFORMED_DATE, I.RESULT_VALUE AS RESULT, I.TEXT_RESULTS , I.RESULT_TYPE_CD, I.RESULT_STATUS_CD, J.SUBTEST_NAME AS HLA_CLASS_II_AB_MFI_1000_4000, J.RESULT_VALUE AS RESULT, J.TEXT_RESULTS , J.RESULT_VALUE, J.RESULT_TYPE_CD, J.RESULT_STATUS_CD, K.SUBTEST_NAME AS HLA_CLASS_II_AB_MFI_4001_10000, K.RESULT_VALUE AS RESULT, K.TEXT_RESULTS , K.RESULT_TYPE_CD, K.RESULT_STATUS_CD, L.SUBTEST_NAME AS HLA_CLASS_II_AB_MFI_10000, L.RESULT_VALUE AS RESULT, L.TEXT_RESULTS , L.RESULT_TYPE_CD, L.RESULT_STATUS_CD, M.SUBTEST_NAME AS HLA_CLASS_II_AB_INTERPRETATION, M.RESULT_VALUE AS RESULT, M.TEXT_RESULTS , M.RESULT_TYPE_CD, M.RESULT_STATUS_CD, N.SUBTEST_NAME AS HLA_CLASS_II_AB_ID_PERFORMED_DATE, N.RESULT_VALUE AS RESULT, N.TEXT_RESULTS , N.RESULT_TYPE_CD, N.RESULT_STATUS_CD, O.SUBTEST_NAME AS TEST_METHODOLOGY, O.RESULT_VALUE AS RESULT, O.TEXT_RESULTS , O.RESULT_TYPE_CD, O.RESULT_STATUS_CD, P.SUBTEST_NAME AS HLA_METHODOLOGY_COMMENTS, P.RESULT_VALUE AS RESULT, P.TEXT_RESULTS , P.RESULT_TYPE_CD, P.RESULT_STATUS_CD, Q.SUBTEST_NAME AS HLA_BLOOD_SPECIMEN_SOURCE, Q.RESULT_VALUE AS RESULT, Q.TEXT_RESULTS , Q.RESULT_TYPE_CD, Q.RESULT_STATUS_CD, R.SUBTEST_NAME AS ADULT_OR_PEDIATRIC_SERVICE, R.RESULT_VALUE AS RESULT, R.TEXT_RESULTS, R.RESULT_TYPE_CD, R.RESULT_STATUS_CD, S.SUBTEST_NAME AS RECIPIENT_DIAGNOSIS, S.RESULT_VALUE AS RESULT, S.TEXT_RESULTS , S.RESULT_TYPE_CD, S.RESULT_STATUS_CD, T.SUBTEST_NAME AS ASHI_LABORATORY_DIRECTOR, T.RESULT_VALUE AS RESULT, T.TEXT_RESULTS , T.RESULT_TYPE_CD, T.RESULT_STATUS_CD FROM X LEFT OUTER JOIN X A ON A.MRN = X.MRN AND X.ACCNO= A.ACCNO AND A.SUBTEST_NAME = 'HLA Class I AntiBODY Screen Result' LEFT OUTER JOIN X B ON B.MRN = X.MRN AND
