Antibodies MFI >10000' LEFT OUTER JOIN X H ON H.MRN = X.MRN AND X.ACCNO= H.ACCNO AND H.SUBTEST_NAME = 'HLA Class I Antibody Interpretation' LEFT OUTER JOIN X I ON I.MRN = X.MRN AND X.ACCNO= I.ACCNO AND I.SUBTEST_NAME = 'HLA CLASS I Antibody ID Performed Date' LEFT OUTER JOIN X J ON J.MRN = X.MRN AND X.ACCNO= J.ACCNO AND J.SUBTEST_NAME = 'HLA Class II Antibodies MFI 1000-4000' LEFT OUTER JOIN X K ON K.MRN = X.MRN AND X.ACCNO= K.ACCNO AND K.SUBTEST_NAME = 'HLA Class II Antibodies MFI 4001-10000' LEFT OUTER JOIN X L ON L.MRN = X.MRN AND X.ACCNO= L.ACCNO AND L.SUBTEST_NAME = 'HLA Class II Antibodies MFI >10000' LEFT OUTER JOIN X M ON M.MRN = X.MRN AND X.ACCNO= M.ACCNO AND M.SUBTEST_NAME = 'HLA Class II Antibody Interpretation' LEFT OUTER JOIN X N ON N.MRN = X.MRN AND X.ACCNO= N.ACCNO AND N.SUBTEST_NAME = 'HLA Class II Antibody ID Performed Date' LEFT OUTER JOIN X O ON O.MRN = X.MRN AND X.ACCNO= O.ACCNO AND O.SUBTEST_NAME = 'Test Methodology' LEFT OUTER JOIN X P ON P.MRN = X.MRN AND X.ACCNO= P.ACCNO AND P.SUBTEST_NAME = 'HLA Methodology Comments' LEFT OUTER JOIN X Q ON Q.MRN = X.MRN AND X.ACCNO= Q.ACCNO AND Q.SUBTEST_NAME = 'HLA Blood Specimen Source' LEFT OUTER JOIN X R ON R.MRN = X.MRN AND X.ACCNO= R.ACCNO AND R.SUBTEST_NAME = 'Adult or Pediatric Service' LEFT OUTER JOIN X S ON S.MRN = X.MRN AND X.ACCNO= S.ACCNO AND S.SUBTEST_NAME = 'Recipient Diagnosis' LEFT OUTER JOIN X T ON T.MRN = X.MRN AND X.ACCNO= T.ACCNO AND T.SUBTEST_NAME = 'ASHI Laboratory Director'

prompt: Provide a report of Dr. Mauro's active patients and their diagnoses to help track specimen management
completion: WITH CPE_COMP AS (SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN AS MRN, CPE_ENC_DTE AS "Initial Appt Date", STRIP(CLD_DEPT_NAME) AS "Initial Appt Dept", STRIP(CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR) AS "Initial Visit Type", ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CPE_MRN ORDER BY CPE_ENC_DTE) AS RN FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON CPE_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CRE_RES_TYP IN ('Physician') AND CPE_ENC_DTE >= CURRENT DATE - 2 YEAR AND CRE_RES_ID = '018341' ) , CPE_SCH AS (SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN AS MRN, CPE_ENC_DTE AS "Next Appt Date", STRIP(CLD_DEPT_NAME) AS "Next Appt Dept", STRIP(CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR) AS "Next Visit Type", ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CPE_MRN ORDER BY CPE_ENC_DTE) AS RN FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Sch') AND CRE_RES_TYP IN ('Physician') AND CPE_ENC_DTE >= CURRENT DATE AND CRE_RES_ID = '018341' ) , CPE_X AS (SELECT Y.MRN, "Initial Appt Date", "Initial Appt Dept", "Initial Visit Type", "Next Appt Date", "Next Appt Dept", "Next Visit Type" FROM (SELECT MRN FROM CPE_COMP UNION SELECT MRN FROM CPE_SCH) Y LEFT JOIN CPE_COMP ON Y.MRN = CPE_COMP.MRN AND CPE_COMP.RN = 1 LEFT JOIN CPE_SCH ON Y.MRN = CPE_SCH.MRN AND CPE_SCH.RN = 1) , CPE AS (SELECT STRIP(CPE_X.MRN) AS MRN, STRIP(PT_LAST_NAME) || ', ' || STRIP(PT_FIRST_NAME) AS "Name", STRIP(PT_ADDR1) AS "Address 1", STRIP(PT_ADDR2) AS "Address 2", STRIP(PT_CITY) AS "City", STRIP(PT_STATE) AS "State", STRIP(PT_ZIP_CD) AS "Zip Code", STRIP(PT_COUNTRY) AS "Country", "Initial Appt Date", "Initial Appt Dept", "Initial Visit Type", "Next Appt Date", "Next Appt Dept", "Next Visit Type" FROM CPE_X JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON CPE_X.MRN = PT_MRN) , X AS (SELECT TM_MRN AS MRN, TM_DX_DTE AS DX_DATE, TM_HIST_CD AS DX_CODE, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS DX_DESC FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM H ON TM_HIST_CD = H.CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON TM_SITE_CD = S.CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.SEERGROUPING ON RECODE = IDB.SEERF_ICDO(TM_SITE_CD, TM_HIST_CD) AND CATEGORY1 = 'Leukemia' WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND TM_MRN IN (SELECT MRN FROM CPE) UNION SELECT CC_MRN AS MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS DX_DATE, CLM_CLSF_CD AS DX_CODE, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS DX_DESC FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.SEERGROUPING ON RECODE = MIN(IDB.SEERF_ICD9(CLM_CLSF_CD), IDB.SEERF_ICD10(CLM_CLSF_CD)) AND CATEGORY1 = 'Leukemia' WHERE CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND ((CC_PT_TYPE = 'I') OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) AND CC_MRN IN (SELECT MRN FROM CPE) GROUP BY CC_MRN, CLM_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK ) , CTE AS (SELECT MRN AS DX_MRN, DX_DATE AS DX_DATE, STRIP(DX_CODE) || '-' || STRIP(DX_DESC) AS DX_CODE FROM X) , CTE2 AS (SELECT * FROM CTE ORDER BY DX_MRN, DX_DATE, DX_CODE) , T1 AS (SELECT DX_MRN, DX_DATE, DX_CODE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY DX_MRN ORDER BY DX_DATE) AS RN FROM CTE2 ORDER BY DX_MRN, DX_DATE) , T2 (MRN, DX, RN1) AS (SELECT DX_MRN, CAST(DX_DATE AS VARCHAR(6000))||' | '||CAST(DX_CODE AS VARCHAR(100)), RN FROM T1 WHERE T1.RN = 1 UNION ALL SELECT DX_MRN, RTRIM(CAST(DX AS VARCHAR(4000))) || ', ' || CHR(13) || CHR(10) || CAST(DX_DATE AS VARCHAR(100))||' | '||RTRIM(CAST(DX_CODE AS VARCHAR(100))) , RN1 + 1 FROM T1, T2 WHERE DX_MRN = MRN AND RN = RN1+1 ) , T3 AS (SELECT MRN, MAX(RN1) RN FROM T2 GROUP BY MRN) , T4 AS (SELECT T2.MRN, RN, DX FROM T2 JOIN T3 ON T2.MRN = T3.MRN AND T2.RN1 = T3.RN) SELECT CPE.*, DX FROM CPE LEFT JOIN T4 ON CPE.MRN = T4.MRN

prompt: Surgical results between 2018 and 2021 of patients diagnosed with ICD-10 code beginning with C67.
completion: WITH OPRPT AS (SELECT DISTINCT CDD_MRN, CDD_SERVICE_DTE FROM IDB.CD_DOCUMENT WHERE CDD_DOC_NAME like 'Operative Report%' AND CDD_SERVICE_DTE BETWEEN '2018-01-01' AND '2021-12-31' ), C67 AS (SELECT DISTINCT CC_MRN, CC_EFF_DTE FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF WHERE CC_EFF_DTE BETWEEN '2018-01-01' AND '2021-12-31' AND CC_CLSF_CD like 'C67.%' AND CC_CLSF_TYPE like 'DF%' AND(CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR(CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y'))), C67OPRPT AS (SELECT * FROM OPRPT JOIN C67 ON CDD_MRN = CC_MRN AND CDD_SERVICE_DTE = CC_EFF_DTE) , DX AS (SELECT DISTINCT PBD_MRN AS DX_MRN, PBD_SVC_DTE AS DX_SVC_DATE, DOC_NAME AS DX_DOC_NAME, PBD_INV_NO AS DX_INV_NO FROM OPRPT JOIN IDB.PBD_DTL ON PBD_MRN = CDD_MRN AND PBD_SVC_DTE = CDD_SERVICE_DTE JOIN IDB.PBD_INVOICE ON PBD_INV_NO = PBI_INV_NO JOIN IDB.DOC ON PBI_PERFORM_DR_NO = DOC_DR_NO JOIN IDB.PBD_DX ON PBD_INV_NO = DX_INV_NO AND DX_CLSF_CD like 'C67.%') , PBD AS (SELECT DISTINCT PBD_MRN, PBD_SVC_DTE, DX_DOC_NAME, CLM_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK FROM DX JOIN IDB.PBD_DTL ON PBD_MRN = DX_MRN AND DX_INV_NO = PBD_INV_NO AND PBD_SVC_DTE = DX_SVC_DATE JOIN IDB.PBD_CODE ON PBD_PBD_CD = PBC_PBD_CD AND PBC_CPT_CD BETWEEN '10000' AND '69999' JOIN IDB.CLM ON PBC_CPT_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD) , CLINTRACC67ONLY AS (SELECT CDD_MRN, CDD_SERVICE_DTE, DOC_NAME, CLM_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK FROM C67OPRPT JOIN IDB.PBD_DTL ON PBD_MRN = CDD_MRN AND PBD_SVC_DTE = CDD_SERVICE_DTE JOIN IDB.PBD_CODE ON PBD_PBD_CD = PBC_PBD_CD AND PBC_CPT_CD BETWEEN '10000' AND '69999' JOIN IDB.CLM ON PBC_CPT_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.PBD_INVOICE ON PBI_MRN = CDD_MRN AND PBD_INV_NO = PBI_INV_NO JOIN IDB.DOC ON PBI_PERFORM_DR_NO = DOC_DR_NO WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM DX WHERE CDD_MRN = DX_MRN AND CDD_SERVICE_DTE = DX_SVC_DATE) ), PBDANDCLINTRAC AS (SELECT PBD_MRN AS PBDCT_MRN, PBD_SVC_DTE AS PBDCT_SVC_DTE, DX_DOC_NAME AS PBDCT_SURGEON_NAME, CLM_CLSF_CD AS PBDCT_CPT_CODE, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS PBDCT_CPT_DESC FROM PBD UNION SELECT CDD_MRN AS PBDCT_MRN, CDD_SERVICE_DTE AS PBDCT_SVC_DTE, DOC_NAME AS PBDCT_SURGEON_NAME, CLM_CLSF_CD AS PBDCT_CPT_CODE, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS PBDCT_CPT_DESC FROM CLINTRACC67ONLY) SELECT PBDCT_MRN AS MRN, PBDCT_SVC_DTE AS "Surgery Date", PBDCT_SURGEON_NAME AS "Surgeon Name", PBDCT_CPT_CODE AS "Surgery CPT Code", PBDCT_CPT_DESC AS "Surgery CPT Description" FROM PBDANDCLINTRAC

prompt: List of new patients flagged for PFS review and the time until action was taken on their account
completion: SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN AS MRN, CLE_NAME AS USER_NAME, CPE_APPT_MADE_DT AS APPT_MADE_DATE_TIME, CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME AS VISIT_TYPE, PCL_CON_DT AS CONTACT_DATE_TIME FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID JOIN IDB.PAS_CONTACT_LOG ON CPE_CL_PT_ID = PCL_CL_PT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_USER CU ON PCL_USER_ID = CLE_USER_ID WHERE 1=1 AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN '2023-01-01' AND '2023-04-01' AND PCL_CON_DISP= 'PFS: Virtual Registration Pending' AND PCL_USER_ID IN ('100037798', '100037800', '100037801', '100037803', '100037805') AND UPPER(CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME) like '%NV%' ORDER BY CPE_MRN ;

prompt: Provide a list of patients scheduled for a Glossectomy.
completion: WITH X AS (SELECT STRIP(OC_MRN) AS MRN, STRIP(PT_LAST_NAME) || ', ' || STRIP(PT_FIRST_NAME) AS "Name", STRIP(OC_CASE_ID) AS "Case ID", OC_SURG_DTE AS "Surgery Date", STRIP(CRE_RES_NAME) AS "Surgeon", STRIP(CPX_PROC_CD) AS "CPT Code", STRIP(CPX_PROC_NAME) AS "CPT Description", CASE WHEN AC_MRN IS NOT NULL THEN 'Y' END AS "06-107" FROM IDB.PATIENT JOIN IDB.OR_CASE ON PT_MRN = OC_MRN JOIN IDB.OR_CASE_ALL_PROC ON OC_CASE_ID = OCAP_CASE_ID JOIN IDB.OR_CASE_ALL_SURG ON OCAP_CASE_ID = OCAS_CASE_ID AND OCAS_PNL_NO = OCAP_PNL_NO AND OCAS_SURG_ROLE = 'Primary' JOIN IDB.OR_PROC ON OCAP_OR_PROC_ID = OP_OR_PROC_ID JOIN IDB.OR_CL_PROC ON OP_OR_PROC_ID = OCP_OR_PROC_ID JOIN IDB.CL_PROC ON OCP_PROC_ID = CPX_PROC_ID JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CRE_RES_ID = OCAS_RES_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.ACCRUALS ON PT_MRN = AC_MRN AND AC_IRB_NO = '06-107' WHERE OC_SURG_DTE >= CURRENT date AND OC_OR_CASE_STS_CD NOT IN ('2', '5') AND CPX_PROC_CD IN ('41120', '41130', '41135', '41140', '41150', '41153', '41155') ) , Y AS (SELECT DISTINCT TM_MRN AS MRN, TM_DX_DTE AS DX_DATE, TM_SITE_CD AS DX_CODE, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS DX_DESC FROM X JOIN IDB.CDB_TUMOR ON TM_MRN = MRN JOIN IDB.SEERGROUPING ON RECODE = IDB.SEERF_ICDO(TM_SITE_CD, TM_HIST_CD) JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD WHERE 1=1 AND TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') UNION SELECT CC_MRN AS MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS DX_DATE, CLM_CLSF_CD AS DX_CODE, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS DX_DESC FROM X JOIN IDB.CTC_CLSF ON CC_MRN = MRN JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.SEERGROUPING ON RECODE = MIN(IDB.SEERF_ICD9(CLM_CLSF_CD), IDB.SEERF_ICD10(CLM_CLSF_CD)) WHERE CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND ((CC_PT_TYPE = 'I') OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) AND CLM_CLSF_CD BETWEEN 'C' AND 'D49.99' GROUP BY CC_MRN, CLM_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK ) , YY AS (SELECT MRN, LISTAGG(COALESCE(STRIP(DX_DATE), '') || ' | ' || COALESCE(STRIP(CAST(DX_CODE AS VARCHAR(12000))), '') || ' | ' || COALESCE(STRIP(CAST(DX_DESC AS VARCHAR(12000))), '') , CHR(13) || CHR(10)) WITHIN GROUP( ORDER BY MRN, DX_DATE, DX_CODE, DX_DESC) AS DX FROM Y GROUP BY MRN) , Z AS (SELECT DISTINCT X.*, DX FROM X LEFT JOIN YY ON X.MRN = YY.MRN) , APPT AS (SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN, CPE_ENC_DTE AS "Next Scheduled Surgery Appt", STRIP(CRE_RES_NAME) AS "Physician Name", CRE_RES_TYP, STRIP(CLD_DEPT_NAME) AS "Department", CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6, STRIP(CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8) AS "Service", CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CPE_MRN ORDER BY CPE_ENC_DTE) AS RN FROM Z JOIN IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER ON CPE_MRN = MRN JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Sch') AND CRE_RES_TYP IN ('Physician') AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 = 'SRG' ) SELECT DISTINCT Z.*, "Next Scheduled Surgery Appt", "Physician Name", "Department", "Service" FROM Z LEFT JOIN APPT ON CPE_MRN = MRN AND RN = 1

prompt: Provide diagnosis and demographic data for a list of MRNs.
completion: WITH "cte1" AS (SELECT * FROM DV.ENCOUNTER_SCHD_RESOURCES WHERE ENSR_PRIMARY_RES_IND = 'Y' ), "cte2" AS (SELECT EDC_DEPT_DESC, EDC_DEPT_ABBREV FROM DV.ENCOUNTER_DESC_CATALOG WHERE EDC_GROUP_ID = '8' ), "cte3" AS (SELECT EDC_DEPT_ABBREV, EDC_DEPT_DESC FROM DV.ENCOUNTER_DESC_CATALOG WHERE EDC_GROUP_ID = 'STS' ), "cte4" AS (SELECT DXCC_DX_CATALOG_ID, LTRIM(RTRIM(DXCC_ICD_CODE)) DXCC_ICD_CODE, LTRIM(RTRIM(DXCC_ICD_MSK_DESC)) DXCC_ICD_MSK_DESC, LTRIM(RTRIM(DXCC_ICD_CODE)) || ' - ' || LTRIM(RTRIM(DXCC_ICD_MSK_DESC)) AS DXCC_CODE_AND_MSK_DESC, LTRIM(RTRIM(DXCC_ICD_NATIONAL_DESC)) DXCC_ICD_NATIONAL_DESC, DXCC_DESC_LONG, CASE WHEN DXCC_ICD_CODE BETWEEN '196' AND '196.99' OR DXCC_ICD_CODE BETWEEN '197' AND '197.99' OR DXCC_ICD_CODE BETWEEN '198' AND '198.99' THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS DXCC_METS_INDICATOR, DXCC_CREATED_DT, DXCC_CREATED_BY, DXCC_MODIFIED_DT FROM DV.DIAGNOSIS_CATALOG WHERE DXCC_DX_TYPE = 'ICD9' ) SELECT DISTINCT "t1"."PT_MRN" AS "MRN", "t1"."PT_LAST_NAME" AS "Last Name", "t1"."PT_FIRST_NAME" AS "First Name", "t2"."ENDP_SERVICE_SPECIALTY_GRP_8" AS "Clinical Service (Group 8)", "t3"."EDC_DEPT_DESC" AS "Clinical Service Desc (Group 8)", "t4"."ENR_RES_NAME" AS "Primary Resource Name", CASE WHEN "t5"."EDC_DEPT_DESC"IN ('Arrived', 'Completed') THEN 'Completed' WHEN "t5"."EDC_DEPT_DESC" IN ('Scheduled') THEN 'Scheduled' ELSE 'Non-Completed/Scheduled' END AS "Completed/Scheduled Indicator", "t6"."DT_DTE" AS "Encounter Date" FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V" "t1" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED" "t7" ON "t1"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t7"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_ENCOUNTER" "t8" ON "t7"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t8"."PENC_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."ENCOUNTER_DEPARTMENT" "t2" ON "t8"."PENC_DEPT_ID" = "t2"."ENDP_ENC_DEPT_ID" LEFT JOIN "cte1" "t9" ON "t8"."PENC_PT_ENC_ID" = "t9"."ENSR_PT_ENC_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."ENCOUNTER_DEPARTMENT" "t10" ON "t9"."ENSR_DEPT_ID" = "t10"."ENDP_ENC_DEPT_ID" LEFT JOIN "cte2" "t3" ON "t10"."ENDP_SERVICE_SPECIALTY_GRP_8" = "t3"."EDC_DEPT_ABBREV" LEFT JOIN "DV"."ENCOUNTER_RESOURCE" "t4" ON "t9"."ENSR_RES_ID" = "t4"."ENR_ENC_RES_ID" LEFT JOIN "cte3" "t5" ON "t8"."PENC_APPT_STS" = "t5"."EDC_DEPT_ABBREV" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" "t6" ON "t8"."PENC_ENC_DATE_ID" = "t6"."DT_DATE_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."CDB_TUMOR_V" "t11" ON "t7"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t11"."CDTM_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."ICDO_SITE_CATALOG_V" "t12" ON "t11"."CDTM_SITE_CATALOG_ID" = "t12"."ICSC_SITE_CATALOG_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DIAGNOSIS_FINAL_ALL_V" "t13" ON "t7"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t13"."PDX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "cte4" "t14" ON "t13"."PDX_DX_CATALOG_ID" = "t14"."DXCC_DX_CATALOG_ID" WHERE (("t12"."ICSC_SITE_CD" IN ('C250', 'C251', 'C252', 'C253', 'C254', 'C257', 'C258', 'C259') OR "t14"."DXCC_ICD_CODE" IN ('157', '157.0', '157.1', '157.2', '157.3', '157.4', '157.8', '157.9')) AND ("t2"."ENDP_SERVICE_SPECIALTY_GRP_8" = 'GNT' AND (CASE WHEN "t5"."EDC_DEPT_DESC"IN ('Arrived', 'Completed') THEN 'Completed' WHEN "t5"."EDC_DEPT_DESC" IN ('Scheduled') THEN 'Scheduled' ELSE 'Non-Completed/Scheduled' END = 'Completed' AND "t6"."DT_DTE" BETWEEN '2014-1-1' AND '2014-7-31')))

prompt: Daily morning report of pts seen in Radiation Oncology that are pending/resulted COVID19
completion: SELECT * FROM (SELECT DISTINCT R.COR_MRN , CASE WHEN LOWER(COR_RESULT_TEXT) like 'detected%' THEN 'Positive' WHEN COR_ORDER_NAME = 'COVID Discharge Monitoring' AND COR_PATIENT_TYPE = 'Employee' THEN 'Positive' WHEN COR_ORDER_NAME IN ('COVID-19 Rapid Qualitative RNA') AND LOWER(COR_RESULT_TEXT) like 'positive%' THEN 'Positive' WHEN COR_ORDER_NAME IN ('COVID-19 Rapid Qualitative RNA') AND LOWER(COR_RESULT_TEXT) like 'negative%' THEN 'Negative' WHEN COR_ORDER_NAME IN ('COVID-19 Rapid Qualitative RNA') AND (LOWER(COR_RESULT_TEXT) like 'inconclusive%' OR LOWER(COR_RESULT_TEXT) like '%invalid%' OR LOWER(COR_RESULT_TEXT) like 'presumptive%') THEN 'Pending' WHEN COR_ORDER_NAME IN ('Notice of Non-MSK Positive COVID-19 Test', 'MSK Engage Recovery Tracker') THEN 'Positive' WHEN LOWER(COR_RESULT_TEXT) like 'not detected%' THEN 'Negative' WHEN (COR_ABNORMALITY_CODE IS NULL OR LOWER(COR_RESULT_TEXT) like 'inconclusive%' OR LOWER(COR_RESULT_TEXT) like 'indeterminant%' OR LOWER(COR_RESULT_TEXT) like 'invalid%') THEN 'Pending' ELSE COR_RESULT_TEXT END RESULT , PT_LAST_NAME , PT_FIRST_NAME , R.COR_SIGNIFICANT_DT , R.COR_RESULT_ARRIVAL_DT FROM IDB.COVID19_ORDER_AND_RESULT R JOIN (SELECT CPE_MRN AS "MRN", CPE_ENC_DTE AS "Appt Date" FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp', 'Sch') AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 = 'RDO' ) B ON R.COR_MRN = B."MRN" AND "Appt Date" BETWEEN DATE(COR_SIGNIFICANT_DT) - 14 DAYS AND DATE(COR_SIGNIFICANT_DT) + 14 DAYS LEFT JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON R.COR_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE 1=1 AND STRIP(COR_MRN) NOT IN ('11111111', '22222222') AND COR_ORDER_STATUS_CODE NOT IN ('CANP', 'CANC', 'HOLD', 'AUC3', 'DISC') AND COR_ORDER_NAME IN ('COVID-19 Qualitative RNA', 'COVID-19 Rapid Qualitative RNA') AND ((DATE(COR_SIGNIFICANT_DT) = CURRENT date AND HOUR(TIMESTAMP(COR_SIGNIFICANT_DT)) BETWEEN 0 AND 7) OR (DATE(COR_SIGNIFICANT_DT) = CURRENT date - 1 DAY AND HOUR(TIMESTAMP(COR_SIGNIFICANT_DT)) BETWEEN 17 AND 23)) ) A WHERE RESULT = 'Pending' ORDER BY COR_SIGNIFICANT_DT ; SELECT * FROM (SELECT DISTINCT R.COR_MRN , CASE WHEN LOWER(COR_RESULT_TEXT) like 'detected%' THEN 'Positive' WHEN COR_ORDER_NAME = 'COVID Discharge Monitoring' AND COR_PATIENT_TYPE = 'Employee' THEN 'Positive' WHEN COR_ORDER_NAME IN ('COVID-19 Rapid Qualitative RNA') AND LOWER(COR_RESULT_TEXT) like 'positive%' THEN 'Positive' WHEN COR_ORDER_NAME IN ('COVID-19 Rapid Qualitative RNA') AND LOWER(COR_RESULT_TEXT) like 'negative%' THEN 'Negative' WHEN COR_ORDER_NAME IN ('COVID-19 Rapid Qualitative RNA') AND (LOWER(COR_RESULT_TEXT) like 'inconclusive%' OR LOWER(COR_RESULT_TEXT) like '%invalid%' OR LOWER(COR_RESULT_TEXT) like 'presumptive%') THEN 'Pending' WHEN COR_ORDER_NAME IN ('Notice of Non-MSK Positive COVID-19 Test', 'MSK Engage Recovery Tracker') THEN 'Positive' WHEN LOWER(COR_RESULT_TEXT) like 'not detected%' THEN 'Negative' WHEN (COR_ABNORMALITY_CODE IS NULL OR LOWER(COR_RESULT_TEXT) like 'inconclusive%' OR LOWER(COR_RESULT_TEXT) like 'indeterminant%' OR LOWER(COR_RESULT_TEXT) like 'invalid%') THEN 'Pending' ELSE COR_RESULT_TEXT END RESULT , PT_LAST_NAME , PT_FIRST_NAME , R.COR_SIGNIFICANT_DT , R.COR_RESULT_ARRIVAL_DT FROM IDB.COVID19_ORDER_AND_RESULT R JOIN (SELECT CPE_MRN AS "MRN", CPE_ENC_DTE AS "Appt Date" FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp', 'Sch') AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 = 'RDO' ) B ON R.COR_MRN = B."MRN" AND "Appt Date" BETWEEN DATE(COR_SIGNIFICANT_DT) - 14 DAYS AND DATE(COR_SIGNIFICANT_DT) + 14 DAYS LEFT JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON R.COR_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE 1=1 AND STRIP(COR_MRN) NOT IN ('11111111', '22222222') AND COR_ORDER_STATUS_CODE NOT IN ('CANP', 'CANC', 'HOLD', 'AUC3', 'DISC') AND COR_ORDER_NAME IN ('COVID-19 Qualitative RNA', 'COVID-19 Rapid Qualitative RNA') AND ((DATE(COR_RESULT_ARRIVAL_DT) = CURRENT date AND HOUR(TIMESTAMP(COR_RESULT_ARRIVAL_DT)) BETWEEN 0 AND 7) OR (DATE(COR_RESULT_ARRIVAL_DT) = CURRENT date - 1 DAY AND HOUR(TIMESTAMP(COR_RESULT_ARRIVAL_DT)) BETWEEN 17 AND 23)) ) A WHERE RESULT <> 'Pending' ORDER BY COR_RESULT_ARRIVAL_DT ; SELECT DISTINCT EF_MRN , PT_LAST_NAME , PT_FIRST_NAME , EF_SUBMISSION_DT , EF_FORM_NAME , EFI_ITEM_TEXT , EFI_VALUE FROM IDB.EF_FORM JOIN IDB.EF_FORM_ITEM ON EF_FORM_ID = EFI_FORM_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON EF_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN (SELECT CPE_MRN AS "MRN", CPE_ENC_DTE AS "Appt Date" FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp', 'Sch') AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 = 'RDO' ) A ON EF_MRN = "MRN" AND "Appt Date" BETWEEN DATE(EF_SUBMISSION_DT) - 14 DAYS AND DATE(EF_SUBMISSION_DT) + 14 DAYS WHERE 1=1 AND EF_FORM_NAME IN ('Novel Coronavirus (COVID-19) Screening Questionnaire') AND EFI_ITEM_ALIAS IN ('Covid_contact') AND LOWER(EFI_VALUE) like '%yes%' AND DATE(EF_SUBMISSION_DT) = CURRENT date - 1 DAY ORDER BY EF_SUBMISSION_DT ; SELECT DISTINCT EF_MRN , PT_LAST_NAME , PT_FIRST_NAME , EF_SUBMISSION_DT , EF_FORM_NAME , EFI_ITEM_TEXT , EFI_VALUE FROM IDB.EF_FORM JOIN IDB.EF_FORM_ITEM ON EF_FORM_ID = EFI_FORM_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON EF_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN (SELECT CPE_MRN AS "MRN", CPE_ENC_DTE AS "Appt Date" FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp', 'Sch') AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 = 'RDO' ) A ON EF_MRN = "MRN" AND "Appt Date" BETWEEN DATE(EF_SUBMISSION_DT) - 14 DAYS AND DATE(EF_SUBMISSION_DT) + 14 DAYS WHERE 1=1 AND EF_FORM_NAME IN ('Novel Coronavirus (COVID-19) Screening Questionnaire') AND EFI_ITEM_ALIAS IN ('covid_symptoms') AND LOWER(EFI_VALUE) like '%yes%' AND DATE(EF_SUBMISSION_DT) = CURRENT date - 1 DAY ORDER BY EF_SUBMISSION_DT ; SELECT * FROM (SELECT DISTINCT R.COR_MRN , CASE WHEN LOWER(COR_RESULT_TEXT) like 'positive%' THEN 'Positive' WHEN LOWER(COR_RESULT_TEXT) like 'negative%' THEN 'Negative' WHEN COR_RESULT_TEXT = '' THEN 'Pending' ELSE COR_RESULT_TEXT END AS RESULT , PT_LAST_NAME , PT_FIRST_NAME , R.COR_SIGNIFICANT_DT , R.COR_RESULT_ARRIVAL_DT FROM IDB.COVID19_ORDER_AND_RESULT R JOIN (SELECT CPE_MRN AS "MRN", CPE_ENC_DTE AS "Appt Date" FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp', 'Sch') AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 = 'RDO' ) B ON R.COR_MRN = B."MRN" AND "Appt Date" BETWEEN DATE(COR_SIGNIFICANT_DT) - 14 DAYS AND DATE(COR_SIGNIFICANT_DT) + 14 DAYS LEFT JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON R.COR_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE 1=1 AND STRIP(COR_MRN) NOT IN ('11111111', '22222222') AND COR_ORDER_STATUS_CODE NOT IN ('CANP', 'CANC', 'HOLD', 'AUC3', 'DISC') AND COR_ORDER_NAME IN ('COVID-19 antiBODY Qualitative IgG') AND (DATE(COR_SIGNIFICANT_DT) = CURRENT date AND HOUR(TIMESTAMP(COR_SIGNIFICANT_DT)) BETWEEN 0 AND 7 OR DATE(COR_SIGNIFICANT_DT) = CURRENT date - 1 DAY AND HOUR(TIMESTAMP(COR_SIGNIFICANT_DT)) BETWEEN 8 AND 23) ) A WHERE RESULT <> 'Pending' ORDER BY COR_SIGNIFICANT_DT ;

prompt: Provide a report to investigate genomic determinants of response to radiotherapy in pancreatic cancer patients.
completion: SELECT DISTINCT PDRX_DMP_PATIENT_ID, PT_MRN AS MRN, GENE, RESULT FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_STRUCTURED_RESULTS_V SR JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML XM ON PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PDRX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID WHERE 1=1 AND METHOD = 'IMPACT' AND PDRX_DMP_PATIENT_ID IN ( SELECT DISTINCT PDRX_DMP_PATIENT_ID, PD.PT_MRN AS MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_BIRTH_DTE, PT_DEATH_DTE FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_STRUCTURED_RESULTS_V SR JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML XM ON PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PDRX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS PD ON PDRX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PD.PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID WHERE 1=1 AND METHOD = 'IMPACT' AND PDRX_DMP_PATIENT_ID IN ( SELECT DISTINCT RTC_TX_MRN, RTC_TX_PLAN_NAME, RTC_PRIMARY_REF_POINT, RTC_TX_COURSE_ID, RTC_TX_START_DTE, RTC_TX_STOP_DTE, RTC_TX_ELAPSED_DAYS, RTC_TX_PLANNED_FRACTIONS, RTC_TX_DELIVERED_FRACTIONS, RTC_TX_PLANNED_DOSE, RTC_TX_DELIVERED_DOSE, RTC_DOSE_CORRECTION FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_STRUCTURED_RESULTS_V SR JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML XM ON PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PDRX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS PD ON PDRX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PD.PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID JOIN IDB.RADONC_TREATMENT_COURSE ON PD.PT_MRN = RTC_TX_MRN WHERE 1=1 AND METHOD = 'IMPACT' AND PDRX_DMP_PATIENT_ID IN ( SELECT DISTINCT AC_MRN, AC_IRB_NO, AC_CONS_DTE FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_STRUCTURED_RESULTS_V SR JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML XM ON PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PDRX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS PD ON PDRX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PD.PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID JOIN IDB.ACCRUALS ON PD.PT_MRN = AC_MRN WHERE 1=1 AND METHOD = 'IMPACT' AND PDRX_DMP_PATIENT_ID IN (

prompt: Consented patients that were treated with checkpoint inhibitor (CI) on protocol, which were not treated within a clinical trial, and those who received CI both on and off protocols.
completion: WITH CHEMO AS (SELECT APR_MRN, APR_START_DTE, APR_GENERIC_NAME, CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME AS GENERIC_NAME FROM IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX JOIN IDB.CHEMO_DRUG_GENERIC ON APR_GENERIC_NAME = CDG_GENERIC_NAME WHERE CDG_BIOLOGIC_IMMUNO_FLAG = 'Y' AND CDG_INVESTIGATIVE_FLAG = 'Y' AND APR_START_DTE BETWEEN '2006-01-01' AND '2018-12-31' ), PROTOCOL AS (SELECT ACD_MRN, ACD_REG_ENTRY_DTE AS REG_DTE, ACD_CONS_DTE AS CONSENT_DTE FROM IDB.ACCRUALS_DATES WHERE ACD_IRB_NO = '17-518' ) SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN AS MRN, PT_LAST_NAME "Patient Last Name", PT_FIRST_NAME "Patient First Name", APR_GENERIC_NAME "Trial Drug Name", GENERIC_NAME "Drug Common Name", CONSENT_DTE "Consent Date", REG_DTE "Registration Date", APR_START_DTE "CI Drug Admin Date" FROM IDB.PATIENT JOIN PROTOCOL ON PT_MRN = ACD_MRN LEFT JOIN CHEMO ON PT_MRN = APR_MRN ORDER BY PT_MRN

prompt: Please provide a list of all patients under the age of 21 with a diagnosis of ganglioneuroma from 2019 to present.
completion: WITH P1 AS (SELECT DISTINCT "t1"."PT_MRN" AS "MRN", "t1"."PT_BIRTH_DTE" AS "Birth Date", YEAR(CURRENT date - PT_BIRTH_DTE) AS "Cur Age", "t1"."PT_DEATH_DTE" AS "Death Date", "t1"."PT_VITAL_STATUS" AS "Vital Status", "t2"."PRPT_ACCESSION_NO" AS "Pathology Report", "t3"."DT_DTE" AS "Pathology Report Date", "t4"."DT_DTE" AS DX_DATE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY "t1"."PT_MRN" ORDER BY "t4"."DT_DTE") AS RN, "t5"."PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_DESC" AS "Pathology Report Type", CASE WHEN LOCATE('GANGLIONEUROMA', UPPER("t2"."PRPT_REPORT")) > 0 THEN 'GANGLIONEUROMA' END AS DX FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V" "t1" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED" "t6" ON "t1"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t6"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V" "t2" ON "t6"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t2"."PRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" "t3" ON "t2"."PRPT_REPORT_DATE_ID" = "t3"."DT_DATE_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" "t4" ON "t2"."PRPT_PROCEDURE_DATE_ID" = "t4"."DT_DATE_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATH_RPRT_TYPE_LOOKUP" "t5" ON "t2"."PRPT_REPORT_TYPE" = "t5"."PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_CD" WHERE ((CONTAINS("t2"."PRPT_REPORT", '("ganglioneuroma")') = 1 AND "t4"."DT_DTE" BETWEEN '2015-1-1' AND '2022-01-31') AND "t2"."PRPT_REPORT" IS NOT NULL) AND YEAR(CURRENT date - PT_BIRTH_DTE) < 21 ) , P2 AS (SELECT * FROM P1 WHERE RN = 1) , CDB AS (SELECT DISTINCT TM_MRN AS MRN, TM_DX_DTE AS DX_DATE, STRIP(TM_HIST_CD) || ' - ' || STRIP(H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK) || ' | ' || STRIP(TM_SITE_CD) || ' - ' || STRIP(S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK) AS DX, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH AS "Birth Date", YEAR(CURRENT date - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) AS "Cur Age", PT_DATE_OF_DEATH AS "Death Date", CASE WHEN PT_DEATH_IND IN ('', 'A') THEN 'Alive' ELSE 'Deceased' END AS "Vital Status" FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM H ON TM_HIST_CD = H.CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON TM_SITE_CD = S.CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PT_MRN=TM_MRN WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND TM_HIST_CD = 'M9490/0' AND TM_DX_DTE BETWEEN '2015-1-1' AND '2022-01-31' AND YEAR(CURRENT date - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) < 21 ) , X AS (SELECT MRN, "Birth Date", "Cur Age", "Vital Status", "Death Date", DX, DX_DATE FROM P2 UNION SELECT MRN, "Birth Date", "Cur Age", "Vital Status", "Death Date", DX, DX_DATE FROM CDB) , SRG AS (SELECT SSE_MRN, SSE_SURG_DTE, SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD, SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC FROM IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE ON SSE_LOG_ID = SSP_LOG_ID WHERE SSE_SURG_DTE BETWEEN '2015-1-1' AND '2022-01-31' ) SELECT MRN, "Birth Date", "Cur Age", "Vital Status", "Death Date", DX, DX_DATE, SSE_SURG_DTE AS "Surg Date", SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD AS "CPT4 Code", SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC AS "CPT4 Description" FROM X LEFT JOIN SRG ON SSE_MRN=MRN AND SSE_SURG_DTE >=DX_DATE ORDER BY 7

prompt: Provide a list of patients who had gastric pull-up surgery from 1990 to 2016
completion: WITH SRG AS (SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN AS MRN, PT_SEX AS GENDER, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH AS DOB, PT_DATE_OF_DEATH AS DOD, COALESCE(MAX(PLA_LST_APPT_DTE, PLA_LST_DSCH_DTE), PLA_LST_APPT_DTE, PLA_LST_DSCH_DTE) AS LAST_FU_DATE, SSE_SURG_DTE, SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD, SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC, DATE(SAE_TOX_OCCR_DT) AS COMP_DATE, SAE_TOXICITY_NAME AS COMP_NAME, SAE_TOX_GRADE AS COMP_GRADE, SAE_TOX_GRADE_NAME AS COMP_CRITERIA FROM IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE ON SSE_LOG_ID = SSP_LOG_ID JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON SSE_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY ON PT_MRN = PLA_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.SRG_ADVERSE_EVENT ON SSE_LOG_ID = SAE_SURG_LOG_ID AND SAE_PROC_SEQ_NO = SSP_PROC_SEQ_NO AND SAE_TOX_GRADE > '0' WHERE 1=1 AND SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD IN ('43112', '43107', '43286', '31390', '31395') AND SSE_SURG_DTE BETWEEN '1990-01-01' AND '2016-12-31' ) , DX AS (SELECT DISTINCT TM_MRN, TM_DX_DTE AS DX_DATE, TM_HIST_CD AS HIST_CODE, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS HIST_DESC, TM_SITE_CD AS SITE_CODE, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_DESC, CASE WHEN TM_AJCC_7 NOT IN ('', '888', '999') THEN AJCC7.AV_DESC WHEN TM_AJCC NOT IN ('', '88', '99') THEN AJCC.AV_DESC WHEN TM_GENERAL_STG NOT IN ('', '9') THEN GS.AV_DESC WHEN TM_PATH_STG_GRP NOT IN ('', '88', '9', '99') THEN TM_PATH_STG_GRP ELSE CLIN.AV_DESC END AS STAGE, TM_CLIN_TNM_T, TM_CLIN_TNM_N, TM_CLIN_TNM_M, TM_PATH_TNM_T, TM_PATH_TNM_N, TM_PATH_TNM_M FROM SRG JOIN IDB.CDB_TUMOR ON TM_MRN = MRN JOIN IDB.CLM H ON TM_HIST_CD = H.CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON TM_SITE_CD = S.CLM_CLSF_CD LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS AJCC7 ON AJCC7.AV_ELEMENT = 'AJCC_7' AND AJCC7.AV_CODE = TM_AJCC_7 LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS AJCC ON AJCC.AV_ELEMENT = 'AJCC' AND AJCC.AV_CODE = TM_AJCC LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS GS ON GS.AV_ELEMENT = 'GENERAL_STG' AND GS.AV_CODE = TM_GENERAL_STG LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS CLIN ON CLIN.AV_ELEMENT = 'CLIN_STG_DSCR' AND CLIN.AV_CODE = TM_CLIN_STG_DSCR WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') ) , CHEMO AS (SELECT DISTINCT APR_MRN, SSE_SURG_DTE, CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME, APR_START_DTE, APR_END_DTE, APR_ORD_RX_TYPE, CASE WHEN APR_START_DTE < SSE_SURG_DTE THEN 'Neoadjuvant' WHEN APR_START_DTE >= SSE_SURG_DTE THEN 'Adjuvant' END AS CHEMO_TYPE FROM SRG JOIN IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX_V ON APR_MRN = MRN WHERE 1=1 AND CDG_CHEMO_FLAG = 'Y' ) , RT AS (SELECT DISTINCT RTC_TX_MRN, SSE_SURG_DTE, RTC_TX_PLAN_NAME, RTC_PRIMARY_REF_POINT, RTC_TX_START_DTE, RTC_TX_STOP_DTE, RTC_TX_ELAPSED_DAYS, RTC_TX_PLANNED_FRACTIONS, RTC_TX_DELIVERED_FRACTIONS, RTC_TX_PLANNED_DOSE, RTC_TX_DELIVERED_DOSE, RTC_DOSE_CORRECTION, CASE WHEN RTC_TX_START_DTE < SSE_SURG_DTE THEN 'Neoadjuvant' WHEN RTC_TX_START_DTE >= SSE_SURG_DTE THEN 'Adjuvant' END AS CHEMO_TYPE FROM SRG JOIN IDB.RADONC_TREATMENT_COURSE ON RTC_TX_MRN = MRN) SELECT DISTINCT "t1"."PT_MRN" AS "MRN", SSE_SURG_DTE, "t2"."PRPT_ACCESSION_NO" AS "Pathology Report", "t3"."PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_DESC" AS "Pathology Report Type", "t4"."DT_DTE" AS "Pathology Procedure Date", "t5"."DT_DTE" AS "Pathology Report Date", UPPER(CASE WHEN LENGTH(PRPT_REPORT) <= 15000 THEN RTRIM(CAST(SUBSTR(PRPT_REPORT, 1, 15000) AS VARCHAR(15000))) ELSE CAST(SUBSTR(PRPT_REPORT, 1, 15000) AS VARCHAR(15000)) END) AS TXT FROM SRG LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V" "t1" ON "t1"."PT_MRN" = MRN LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED" "t6" ON "t1"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t6"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V" "t2" ON "t6"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t2"."PRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATH_RPRT_TYPE_LOOKUP" "t3" ON "t2"."PRPT_REPORT_TYPE" = "t3"."PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_CD" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" "t4" ON "t2"."PRPT_PROCEDURE_DATE_ID" = "t4"."DT_DATE_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" "t5" ON "t2"."PRPT_REPORT_DATE_ID" = "t5"."DT_DATE_ID" WHERE 1=1 AND "t2"."PRPT_REPORT" IS NOT NULL

prompt: Inpatient admission data including hospital days
completion: SELECT DISTINCT IIPD_MRN, IIPD_IP_STS, IIPD_ADM_ID, IIPD_ADM_DTE, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, (YEAR(IIPD_ADM_DTE) - YEAR(PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH)) AS AGE_AT_ADM, CASE WHEN ICU_ICU_ADM_DTE IS NULL THEN 'NO' ELSE 'YES' END ADM_INTO_ICU, SUM(DISTINCT ICU_ICU_DAYS_STAY) ICU_DAYS, IIPA_DISCH_SVC_CD, IIPD_DISCH_DTE, IIPA_DISCH_DISP, IIPD_TOT_LOS FROM IDB.ID_IP_DAYS JOIN IDB.ID_IP_ADMISSIONS ON IIPD_ADM_ID = IIPA_ADM_ID JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PT_MRN = IIPD_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.ICU_CENSUS ON ICU_MRN = IIPD_MRN AND ICU_VISIT_NO = IIPD_VISIT_ID WHERE 1 = 1 AND ((IIPD_ADM_DTE BETWEEN '2008-01-01' AND CURRENT DATE) AND IIPD_DISCH_DTE IS NOT NULL) AND IIPD_IP_STS LIKE '%Inpatient%' GROUP BY IIPD_MRN, IIPD_IP_STS, IIPD_ADM_ID, ICU_VISIT_NO, IIPD_VISIT_ID, IIPD_ADM_DTE, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, (YEAR(IIPD_ADM_DTE) - YEAR(PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH)), CASE WHEN ICU_ICU_ADM_DTE IS NULL THEN 'NO' ELSE 'YES' END, IIPA_DISCH_SVC_CD, IIPD_DISCH_DTE, IIPA_DISCH_DISP, IIPD_TOT_LOS ORDER BY IIPD_ADM_ID

prompt: Number of women ages 11-50yrs old admitted without pregnancy test OR pregnancy test exemption order in 2018.
completion: SELECT UC_HOSP_SVC "Admitting Service", COUNT(*) "Without Pregnancy Test" FROM IDB.VISIT JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PT_MRN = VIS_MRN JOIN IDB.UNIFIED_CENSUS ON VIS_VISIT_ID = UC_VISIT_ID AND UC_CNG_TYPE = 'A' LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_ORDER ON OO_MRN = VIS_MRN AND OO_ENTER_DTE BETWEEN VIS_ADM_DTE - 15 DAYS AND VIS_DSCH_DTE AND UPPER(OO_ORD_NAME) LIKE '%PREGNANCY%' WHERE VIS_ADM_DTE BETWEEN '2018-01-01' AND '2018-12-31' AND VIS_IP_OP_ADJUSTED_IND = 'I' AND VIS_VISIT_STATUS IN ('2', '3') AND YEAR(VIS_ADM_DTE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) BETWEEN 11 AND 50 AND PT_SEX = 'F' AND OO_MRN IS NULL GROUP BY UC_HOSP_SVC ORDER BY 1 ; SELECT UC_HOSP_SVC "Admitting Service", COUNT(*) "All Admissions" FROM IDB.VISIT JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PT_MRN = VIS_MRN JOIN IDB.UNIFIED_CENSUS ON VIS_VISIT_ID = UC_VISIT_ID AND UC_CNG_TYPE = 'A' WHERE VIS_ADM_DTE BETWEEN '2018-01-01' AND '2018-12-31' AND VIS_IP_OP_ADJUSTED_IND = 'I' AND VIS_VISIT_STATUS IN ('2', '3') AND YEAR(VIS_ADM_DTE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) BETWEEN 11 AND 50 AND PT_SEX = 'F' GROUP BY UC_HOSP_SVC ORDER BY 1

prompt: Please provide a one-time list of mycosis fungoides and sezary syndrome T-cell patients diagnosed between 1/1/2000 and 1/1/2020.
completion: WITH CTE_DIAGNOSIS AS (SELECT MRN, DIAGNOSIS, MIN(DIAGNOSIS_DATE) DIAGNOSIS_DATE FROM (SELECT DISTINCT CC_MRN MRN, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK DIAGNOSIS, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) DIAGNOSIS_DATE FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND (CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) AND CC_CLSF_CD IN ('202.1', '202.10', '202.13', '202.17', '202.18', '202.2', '202.20', '202.21', '202.22', '202.23', '202.24', '202.25', '202.26', '202.27', '202.28', 'C84.1', 'C84.10', 'C84.11', 'C84.12', 'C84.13', 'C84.14', 'C84.15', 'C84.16', 'C84.17', 'C84.18', 'C84.19' ) GROUP BY CC_MRN, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK UNION ALL SELECT DISTINCT TM_MRN MRN, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK DIAGNOSIS, TM_DX_DTE DIAGNOSIS_DATE FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS ON AV_ELEMENT = 'CASE_STS' AND AV_CODE = TM_CASE_STS AND TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') WHERE 1=1 AND TM_HIST_CD IN ('M9700/3', 'M9700/6', 'M9701/3', 'M9701/6') ) GROUP BY MRN, DIAGNOSIS ) , CTE_PATIENT AS (SELECT PT_MRN MRN, PT_LAST_NAME LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME FIRST_NAME, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH DOB, PT_DEATH_IND_DESC VITAL_STATUS, PT_DATE_OF_DEATH DATE_OF_DEATH, PT_SEX_DESC GENDER, PT_RACE_DESC RACE, PT_PT_ETHNICITY_DESC ETHNICITY, PT_ZIP_CD ZIP_CODE, CASE WHEN (INSURANCE.FSC_NAME IS NULL OR INSURANCE.FSC_NAME = '') THEN 'UNINSURED' WHEN (UPPER(INSURANCE.FSC_NAME) LIKE '%MEDICARE%') THEN 'MEDICARE' WHEN (UPPER(INSURANCE.FSC_NAME) LIKE '%MEDICAID%') THEN 'MEDICAID' ELSE 'PRIVATE' END AS INSURANCE_STATUS, INSURANCE.FSC_NAME INSURANCE_TYPE, DIAGNOSIS.DIAGNOSIS_DATE, DIAGNOSIS.DIAGNOSIS FROM IDB.PATIENT_V PT JOIN CTE_DIAGNOSIS DIAGNOSIS ON DIAGNOSIS.MRN = PT.PT_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.PATIENT_INSURANCE_V INSURANCE ON INSURANCE.MRN = PT_MRN ), CTE_INITIAL_VISIT AS (SELECT PATIENT.MRN, MIN(CPE2.CPE_ENC_DTE) INT_INITIAL_VISIT FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER CPE2 JOIN CTE_PATIENT PATIENT ON PATIENT.MRN = CPE2.CPE_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT DEPT ON DEPT.CLD_DEPT_ID = CPE2.CPE_DEPT_ID AND DEPT.CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 IN ('DERM', 'LYM') JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID AND UPPER(CRE_RES_TYP) IN (UPPER('Physician')) JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE2.CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID AND (CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR LIKE '%NV%' OR CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR LIKE '%IR%') WHERE CPE2.CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CPE2.CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN '2000-01-01' AND '2020-01-01' GROUP BY MRN ) SELECT PATIENT.MRN, LAST_NAME, FIRST_NAME, DOB, VITAL_STATUS, GENDER, DATE_OF_DEATH, RACE, ETHNICITY, ZIP_CODE, INSURANCE_STATUS, INSURANCE_TYPE, DIAGNOSIS_DATE, DIAGNOSIS, INIT.INT_INITIAL_VISIT INITIAL_VISIT_DATE, MAX(CPE1.CPE_ENC_DTE) RECENT_VISIT_DATE FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER CPE1 JOIN CTE_PATIENT PATIENT ON PATIENT.MRN = CPE1.CPE_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT DEPT ON DEPT.CLD_DEPT_ID = CPE1.CPE_DEPT_ID AND DEPT.CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 IN ('DERM', 'LYM') JOIN CTE_INITIAL_VISIT INIT ON PATIENT.MRN = INIT.MRN JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID AND UPPER(CRE_RES_TYP) IN (UPPER('Physician')) WHERE CPE1.CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') GROUP BY PATIENT.MRN, LAST_NAME, FIRST_NAME, DOB, VITAL_STATUS, GENDER, DATE_OF_DEATH, RACE, ETHNICITY, ZIP_CODE, INSURANCE_TYPE, INSURANCE_STATUS, DIAGNOSIS_DATE, DIAGNOSIS, INT_INITIAL_VISIT ORDER BY PATIENT.MRN WITH UR

prompt: Provide a list of patients, whose preferred language is other than English and whose insurance is Medicaid. List to encompass one month
completion: WITH DEMOGRAPHICS AS (SELECT CPE_MRN, CPE_ENC_DTE AS APPT_DATE, CPE_APPT_DT AS APPT_TIME, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 AS DEPARTMENT, CPE_CPE_APPT_STS AS APPT_STATUS, CRE_RES_NAME AS PROVIDER_NAME, PT_PRIMARY_LANG, AV_DESC AS PRIMARY_LANG FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON CPE_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS ON AV_CODE = PT_PRIMARY_LANG AND AV_ELEMENT = 'PRIMARY_LANG' WHERE 1 = 1 AND CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT date - 30 DAYS AND CURRENT DATE AND PT_PRIMARY_LANG != 'ENG'), INS_INFO AS (SELECT MRN AS INS_MRN, FSC_PRIORITY, FSC_REP_CAT_CODE, FSC_REP_CAT_NAME AS INSURANCE, INS_CODE, INS_COMP_NAME AS INSURANCE_COMPANY_NAME, INS_EFF_DATE, INS_EXP_DATE FROM IDB.PATIENT_INSURANCE_V WHERE 1 = 1 AND FSC_REP_CAT_CODE = 'MAA') SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN, APPT_DATE, APPT_STATUS, PT_PRIMARY_LANG, PRIMARY_LANG, INSURANCE, INS_CODE FROM DEMOGRAPHICS JOIN INS_INFO ON CPE_MRN = INS_MRN

prompt: Provide a list of all hematologic malignancy patients who underwent a vitreous fluid biopsy at memorial sloan kettering
completion: WITH PATH AS (SELECT PRPT_MRN , PRPT_ACCESSION_NO, PRPT_REPORT_DTE, PRPT_PROCEDURE_DTE, PRPT_REPORT_TYPE_DESC , TRIM(DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)(?<=(^|[\.]))[^\.]*(vitreous)[^\.]*', PRPT_REPORT)) AS TARGET_EXTRACT , DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)diag[\w\W]*(?=I ATTEST)', PRPT_REPORT) AS DIAGNOSIS_TEXT , VARCHAR(PRPT_REPORT, 32000) AS "Report Text (first 32000 characters)" FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V WHERE 1=1 AND CONTAINS(PRPT_REPORT, '"vitreous"') = 1 AND (PRPT_REPORT_DTE <= '2023-12-31' OR PRPT_PROCEDURE_DTE <= '2023-12-31') AND PRPT_REPORT IS NOT NULL ) , RAD AS (SELECT RRPT_MRN , RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE , RRPT_ORDER_GROUP , RRPT_ACCESSION_NO , RRPT_PROCEDURE_NAME , TRIM(DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)(?<=(^|[\.]))[^\.]*(vitreous)[^\.]*', RRPT_REPORT_TXT)) TARGET_EXTRACT , DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)IMPRESSION[:]*[\w\W]*(?=DICTATED BY:)', RRPT_REPORT_TXT) AS "Impression" , VARCHAR(RRPT_REPORT_TXT, 32000) AS "Report Text 32000 chars" FROM DV.RADIOLOGY_REPORT_V WHERE 1=1 AND CONTAINS(RRPT_REPORT_TXT, '"vitreous"') = 1 AND (RRPT_REPORT_DTE <= '2023-12-31' OR RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE <= '2023-12-31' ) ) , ANTINEO_OCULAR AS (SELECT DISTINCT APR_MRN , APR_START_DTE, APR_END_DTE, APR_ORD_CREATE_DTE , CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME , APR_DRUG_NAME , APR_ORD_RX_TYPE , APR_ROUTE , APR_QTY, APR_FREQ, APR_DURATION, APR_DIAGNOSIS_DESC, APR_PROVIDER_NAME, APR_PROVIDER_ROLE, APR_TOTAL_GIVEN_DOSE, APR_SET_NAME, APR_SET_FORM_NAME , APR_INVESTIGATIVE_FLAG, APR_PLACEBO_FLAG, APR_TOPICAL_FLAG, CDG_CLASSIC_CHEMO_FLAG, CDG_BIOLOGIC_IMMUNO_FLAG, CDG_TARGETED_FLAG, CDG_HORMONE_FLAG, CDG_BONE_AGENTS_FLAG, CDG_THERAPEUTIC_CATEGORY FROM IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX_V APR WHERE 1=1 AND (LOWER(APR_ROUTE) like '%periocular%' OR LOWER(APR_ROUTE) like '%intraocu%' OR LOWER(APR_ROUTE) like '%intravitreal%' OR LOWER(APR_ROUTE) like '%ocula%' ) ) , PHI (PHI) AS ( VALUES ('Y')) , ICD9DXCODES AS (SELECT DXA_ATTRIBUTE_ID FROM DV.DIAGNOSIS_ATTRIBUTE WHERE DXA_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND DXA_CIC_CDER_INIT = 'YES') , DX AS (SELECT D1.MRN FROM (SELECT APR_MRN AS MRN FROM ANTINEO_OCULAR UNION SELECT PRPT_MRN FROM PATH UNION SELECT RRPT_MRN FROM RAD) D1) , DT AS (SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN AS MRN , PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID FROM DX JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON PT_MRN = MRN) , RT_FROM_PA_PRE AS (SELECT MRN, SVC_DTE, RAD_TYPE, SOURCE_IND, SVC_CD, SVC_DESC, DPT_CD, DPT_DESC, IP_OP_IND, SUM(AMT) AS SVC_AMT, SUM(QTY) AS SVC_QTY, RMS_VISIT_ID, RMS_ADM_NUM, SMS_ACCT_NO FROM (SELECT DTL_MRN AS MRN, DTL_SVC_DTE AS SVC_DTE, RAD_TYPE, 'SMS' AS SOURCE_IND, DTL_SVC_CD AS SVC_CD, CDM_SVC_DESC AS SVC_DESC, CDM_DPT_CD AS DPT_CD, AV_DESC AS DPT_DESC, DTL_IP_OP_IND AS IP_OP_IND, DTL_SVC_AMT AS AMT, DTL_SVC_QTY AS QTY, 0 AS RMS_VISIT_ID, DTL_ACCT_NO AS RMS_ADM_NUM, DTL_ACCT_NO AS SMS_ACCT_NO FROM DT DT JOIN IDB.PA_DETAIL ON MRN = DTL_MRN JOIN IDB.CDM ON CDM_SVC_CD = DTL_SVC_CD JOIN IDB.RADIATION_TYPES ON RAD_SVC_CD = DTL_SVC_CD AND RAD_SOURCE = 'SMS' LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS ON CDM_DPT_CD = AV_CODE AND AV_ELEMENT = 'DPT_CD' WHERE DTL_DTL_TYPE = 'C' AND DTL_SVC_DTE <= '2018-12-31' UNION ALL SELECT RVCD_MRN AS MRN, RVCD_SVC_DTE AS SVC_DTE, RAD_TYPE, 'RMS' AS SOURCE_IND, RCDD_CHARGE_CD AS SVC_CD, RCDD_CHARGE_DESCRIPTION AS SVC_DESC, RDPD_DEPARTMENT_MNEMONIC AS DPT_CD, RDPD_DEPARTMENT_NAME AS DPT_DESC, VIS_IP_OP_ADJUSTED_IND AS IP_OP_IND, RVCD_AMT AS AMT, RVCD_UNITS AS QTY, VIS_VISIT_ID AS RMS_VISIT_ID, VIS_ADM_NUM AS RMS_ADM_NUM, ' ' AS SMS_ACCT_NO FROM DT DT JOIN IDB.RMS_VISIT_CHARGE_DTL ON MRN = RVCD_MRN JOIN IDB.VISIT ON RVCD_VISIT_ID = VIS_VISIT_ID JOIN IDB.RMS_CHARGE_CODE_DICT_DN1240 ON RVCD_CHARGE_CODE_REC_NO = RCDD_RECORD_NUMBER JOIN IDB.RMS_DEPARTMENT_DICT_DN1301 ON RVCD_CHARGE_DEPT_REC_NO = RDPD_RECORD_NUMBER JOIN IDB.RADIATION_TYPES ON RAD_SVC_CD = RCDD_CHARGE_CD AND RAD_SOURCE = 'RMS' WHERE RVCD_SVC_DTE >= '2017-11-01' ) A GROUP BY MRN, SVC_DTE, A.RAD_TYPE, SOURCE_IND, SVC_CD, SVC_DESC, DPT_CD, DPT_DESC, IP_OP_IND, RMS_VISIT_ID, RMS_ADM_NUM, SMS_ACCT_NO HAVING SUM(QTY) > 0) , RT_FROM_PA AS (SELECT MRN, MIN(SVC_DTE) AS MIN_DTE, MAX(SVC_DTE) AS MAX_DTE, RAD_TYPE, SVC_DESC FROM RT_FROM_PA_PRE GROUP BY MRN, RAD_TYPE, SVC_DESC) , RT_FROM_PA_LISTAGG AS (SELECT MRN AS RT_FROM_PA_MRN, LISTAGG(COALESCE(MIN_DTE, '') || ' | ' || COALESCE(MAX_DTE, '') || ' | ' || COALESCE(TRIM(CAST(RAD_TYPE AS VARCHAR(3900))), '') || ' | ' || COALESCE(TRIM(SVC_DESC), ''), CHR(13) || CHR(10)) WITHIN GROUP( ORDER BY MRN, MIN_DTE) AS "RT Info from Patient Accounts" FROM RT_FROM_PA GROUP BY MRN) , RADONC AS (SELECT DISTINCT MRN, RTC_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID AS RT_ID, RTC_TX_DELIVERED_DOSE AS "Delivered Dose" , CASE WHEN PHI.PHI = 'Y' THEN CAST(START_D.DT_DTE AS VARCHAR(1000)) ELSE CAST(YEAR(START_D.DT_DTE) AS VARCHAR(1000)) END AS "Start Date" , CASE WHEN PHI.PHI = 'Y' THEN CAST(STOP_D.DT_DTE AS VARCHAR(1000)) ELSE CAST(YEAR(STOP_D.DT_DTE) AS VARCHAR(1000)) END AS "Stop Date" , RTC_TX_ELAPSED_DAYS AS "Elapsed Days" , REF_CAT.RFC_REFERENCE_POINT AS "Reference Point/Site" , RTC_TX_PLAN_NAME, RTC_TX_PLANNED_FRACTIONS, RTC_TX_DELIVERED_FRACTIONS, RTC_TX_PLANNED_DOSE, RTC_DOSE_CORRECTION FROM DV.RADONC_TREATMENT_COURSE JOIN DT ON PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = RTC_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID LEFT JOIN DV.DATE_V START_D ON RTC_TX_START_DATE_ID = START_D.DT_DATE_ID LEFT JOIN DV.DATE_V STOP_D ON RTC_TX_STOP_DATE_ID = STOP_D.DT_DATE_ID LEFT JOIN DV.REFERENCE_POINT_CATALOG REF_CAT ON REF_CAT.RFC_BEAM_THERAPY_ID = RTC_REFERENCE_POINT_ID , PHI) , RADONC_LISTAGG AS (SELECT RT_ID, LISTAGG(COALESCE("Start Date", '') || ' | ' || COALESCE("Stop Date", '') || ' | ' || COALESCE(TRIM(CAST("Reference Point/Site" AS VARCHAR(32000))), '') || ' | ' || COALESCE(TRIM("Delivered Dose"), '') , CHR(13) || CHR(10)) WITHIN GROUP( ORDER BY RT_ID, "Start Date", "Reference Point/Site") AS "Radiation Therapy" FROM RADONC GROUP BY RT_ID) , ANTINEO_DETAIL AS (SELECT DISTINCT APR_MRN , APR_START_DTE, APR_END_DTE, APR_ORD_CREATE_DTE , CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME , APR_DRUG_NAME , APR_ORD_RX_TYPE , APR_ROUTE , APR_QTY, APR_FREQ, APR_DURATION, APR_DIAGNOSIS_DESC, APR_PROVIDER_NAME, APR_PROVIDER_ROLE, APR_TOTAL_GIVEN_DOSE, APR_SET_NAME, APR_SET_FORM_NAME , APR_INVESTIGATIVE_FLAG, APR_PLACEBO_FLAG, APR_TOPICAL_FLAG, CDG_CLASSIC_CHEMO_FLAG, CDG_BIOLOGIC_IMMUNO_FLAG, CDG_TARGETED_FLAG, CDG_HORMONE_FLAG, CDG_BONE_AGENTS_FLAG, CDG_THERAPEUTIC_CATEGORY FROM IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX_V APR JOIN DT DT ON MRN = APR_MRN) , MAIN AS (SELECT DISTINCT "t1"."PT_MRN" AS "MRN", "t1"."PT_LAST_NAME" AS "Last Name", "t1"."PT_FIRST_NAME" AS "First Name", "t1"."PT_BIRTH_DTE" AS "Date of Birth", "t1"."PT_DEATH_DTE" AS "Deceased Date", CASE WHEN "t1"."PT_DEATH_DTE" IS NULL THEN YEAR(CURRENT date - "t1"."PT_BIRTH_DTE") END AS "Cur Age", "t1"."PT_VITAL_STATUS" AS "Vital Status", "t1"."PT_SEX_DESC" AS "Gender", "t1"."PT_RACE_DESC" AS "Race", "t2"."CORE_ETHNICITY_DESC" AS "Ethnicity", "t3"."PLA_LAST_DRVST_DTE" AS "Last Dr Visit Date" , CASE WHEN APR_MRN IS NOT NULL THEN 'Y' END AS MED_QUALIFY_IND , CASE WHEN PRPT_MRN IS NOT NULL THEN 'Y' END AS PATHOLOGY_QUALIFY_IND , CASE WHEN RRPT_MRN IS NOT NULL THEN 'Y' END AS RADIOLOGY_QUALIFY_IND , CASE WHEN APR_MRN IS NOT NULL AND PRPT_MRN IS NOT NULL AND RRPT_MRN IS NOT NULL THEN 'Y' END AS "Qualifies Across All" , "RT Info from Patient Accounts" , "Radiation Therapy" FROM DT DT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS" "t1" ON "t1"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = DT.PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_CORE_DEMOGRAPHICS" "t2" ON "t1"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t2"."CORE_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_LATEST_ACTIVITY" "t3" ON "t1"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t3"."PLA_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN RADONC_LISTAGG ON RT_ID = DT.PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID LEFT JOIN RT_FROM_PA_LISTAGG ON RT_FROM_PA_MRN = DT.MRN LEFT JOIN PATH ON PRPT_MRN = DT.MRN LEFT JOIN RAD ON RRPT_MRN = DT.MRN LEFT JOIN ANTINEO_OCULAR ON APR_MRN = DT.MRN WHERE 1=1 ) SELECT * FROM MAIN ORDER BY MRN

prompt: What is the quarterly number of non-regional lung biopsy cases in optime.
completion: SELECT DISTINCT SSE_MRN, SSE_SURG_DTE, QUARTER(SSE_SURG_DTE) QTR, YEAR(SSE_SURG_DTE) YR, SSP_SURG_SVC_CD SVC, SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD CPT, SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC CPT_DESC, SSP_PROC_NAME PROC_NAME, SSE_SURG_LOC , CASE WHEN SSE_SURG_LOC like 'IR%' THEN 'IR' ELSE 'KOCH' END LOCATION_GRP, SSE_LOG_STS, CASE WHEN SSP_PROC_NAME IN('NBB NEEDLE BIOPSY BODY LUNG/PLEURA CT', 'NBB NEEDLE BIOPSY BODY LUNG/PLEURA FLUORO', 'NBB NEEDLE BIOPSY BODY LUNG/PLEURA PET') THEN 'LUNG AND PLEURA BIOPSY' WHEN SSP_PROC_NAME IN('KYPHOPLASTY FOUR LEVELS', 'KYPHOPLASTY IR', 'KYPHOPLASTY THREE LEVELS', 'KYPHOPLASTY TWO LEVELS') THEN 'KYHOPLASTY' WHEN SSP_PROC_NAME IN ('GU PLACE NEPHROSTOMY', 'GU PLACE NEPHROURETEROSTOMY') THEN 'NEPHROSTOMY NEPHROUTERESTOMY' WHEN SSP_PROC_NAME = 'EMBOLIZATION, ARTERIAL TUMOR HEPATIC' THEN SSP_PROC_NAME WHEN SSP_PROC_NAME LIKE '%ABLATION%' THEN 'ABLATION' WHEN SSP_PROC_NAME LIKE 'VA PLACE MEDIPORT%' OR SSP_PROC_NAME LIKE 'VA PLACE HICKMAN%' OR SSP_PROC_NAME LIKE 'VA PLACE TLC%' THEN 'VA PLACE' WHEN SSP_PROC_NAME LIKE 'SIRSPHERE TREATMENT%' THEN 'SIRT' END PROCEDURE_TYPE FROM IDB.SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE LEFT JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT ON SSP_LOG_ID = SSE_LOG_ID AND SSP_SOURCE_TYPE = SSE_SOURCE_TYPE AND SSE_SURG_DTE BETWEEN '2019-04-01' AND '2020-03-31' WHERE (SSE_SURG_LOC like 'IR%' OR SSE_SURG_LOC like 'KOCH%') AND (SSP_PROC_NAME IN('NBB NEEDLE BIOPSY BODY LUNG/PLEURA CT', 'NBB NEEDLE BIOPSY BODY LUNG/PLEURA FLUORO', 'NBB NEEDLE BIOPSY BODY LUNG/PLEURA PET', 'EMBOLIZATION, ARTERIAL TUMOR HEPATIC', 'KYPHOPLASTY FOUR LEVELS', 'KYPHOPLASTY IR', 'KYPHOPLASTY THREE LEVELS', 'KYPHOPLASTY TWO LEVELS', 'GU PLACE NEPHROSTOMY', 'GU PLACE NEPHROURETEROSTOMY') OR SSP_PROC_NAME LIKE '%ABLATION%' OR SSP_PROC_NAME LIKE 'VA PLACE MEDIPORT%' OR SSP_PROC_NAME LIKE 'SIRSPHERE TREATMENT%' OR SSP_PROC_NAME LIKE 'VA PLACE HICKMAN%' OR SSP_PROC_NAME LIKE 'VA PLACE TLC%') ;

prompt: Create an on-demand report that captures patient and chemotherapy data for specified chemotherapy/immunotherapy regimes.
completion: WITH CTE AS (SELECT DISTINCT APR_MRN, APR_START_DTE, CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME, APR_PROVIDER_NAME, APR_DOC_SVC FROM IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX JOIN IDB.CHEMO_DRUG_GENERIC ON APR_GENERIC_NAME = CDG_GENERIC_NAME WHERE 1=1 #PROMPT('StartDate', '', ' ', ' and date(APR_START_DTE) >= ', '', '') #PROMPT('EndDate', '', ' ', ' and date(APR_START_DTE) <= ', '', '') #PROMPTMANY('Agent', 'String', ' ', ' and CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME in (', '', ')')# #PROMPTMANY('Service', 'String', ' ', ' and APR_DOC_SVC in (', '', ')')# #PROMPTMANY('Provider', 'String', ' ', ' and APR_PROVIDER_NAME in (', '', ')')# ) , CTE2 AS (SELECT APR_MRN, CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY APR_MRN) AS RN FROM (SELECT DISTINCT APR_MRN, CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME FROM CTE) A) , CHEMO AS (SELECT ALL_CHEMO_MRN, SUBSTR(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(CAST(XMLSERIALIZE(CONTENT XMLAGG(XMLELEMENT(NAME "C", '| '||DATE(APR_START_DTE) || ' | ' || DATE(APR_END_DTE) || ' | ' || TRIM(CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME) ||' |'|| CHR(13) || CHR(10)) ORDER BY DATE(APR_START_DTE)) AS CLOB(32000)) AS VARCHAR(32000)), '<C>', ','), '</C>', ''), '', ''), '<C/>', ''), ',', ''), 1) AS CHEMO_TX FROM (SELECT DISTINCT B.APR_MRN AS ALL_CHEMO_MRN, B.APR_START_DTE, B.APR_END_DTE, C.CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME FROM IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX B JOIN IDB.CHEMO_DRUG_GENERIC C ON B.APR_GENERIC_NAME = C.CDG_GENERIC_NAME JOIN CTE A ON A.APR_MRN = B.APR_MRN WHERE 1=1 #PROMPT('StartDate', '', ' ', ' and date(b.APR_START_DTE) >= ', '', '') #PROMPT('EndDate', '', ' ', ' and date(b.APR_START_DTE) <= ', '', '') ) A GROUP BY ALL_CHEMO_MRN) SELECT A.APR_MRN , TRIM(P.PT_LAST_NAME) PT_LAST_NAME , TRIM(P.PT_FIRST_NAME) PT_FIRST_NAME , TRIM(A.CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME) APR_GENERIC_NAME , A.APR_START_DTE , TRIM(A.APR_DOC_SVC) APR_DOC_SVC , TRIM(A.APR_PROVIDER_NAME) APR_PROVIDER_NAME , CHEMO_TX FROM CTE A JOIN CTE2 B ON A.APR_MRN = B.APR_MRN JOIN IDB.PATIENT P ON A.APR_MRN = P.PT_MRN LEFT JOIN CHEMO C ON A.APR_MRN = C.ALL_CHEMO_MRN GROUP BY A.APR_MRN , TRIM(P.PT_LAST_NAME) , TRIM(P.PT_FIRST_NAME) , TRIM(A.CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME) , A.APR_START_DTE , TRIM(A.APR_DOC_SVC) , TRIM(A.APR_PROVIDER_NAME) , CHEMO_TX HAVING MAX(RN) = #PROMPT('rn', 'string')# ORDER BY A.APR_MRN, A.APR_START_DTE

prompt: Provide a list of patients heights' at their first visit with me at Koch (2/10-2/27) and their last visit with me at 64th St.
completion: WITH ETO AS (SELECT CL_MRN MRN, STRIP(CL_LAST_NAME)||', '||STRIP(CL_FIRST_NAME) PT_NAME, CL_SEX SEX, CL_DATE_OF_BIRTH DOB, CPE_ENC_DTE CURR_VISIT_DATE, CPE_APPT_DT CURR_VISIT_DT, CRE_RES_NAME MD_NAME, CLD_DEPT_NAME VISIT_DEPARTMENT FROM IDB.CL_PATIENT INNER JOIN IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER ON CL_MRN = CPE_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID WHERE CPE_VST_RES_ID ='011569' AND CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN('Comp') AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN '2020-02-10' AND '2020-02-27' ) , PASTVST AS (SELECT CPE_MRN, PAST_VISIT_DATE, PAST_VISIT_DT, PAST_VISIT_DEPARTMENT FROM (SELECT CPE_MRN , CPE_ENC_DTE PAST_VISIT_DATE, CPE_APPT_DT PAST_VISIT_DT, CRE_RES_NAME MD_NAME, CLD_DEPT_NAME PAST_VISIT_DEPARTMENT, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY MRN ORDER BY CPE_APPT_DT DESC) RN FROM ETO JOIN IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER ON MRN = CPE_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID WHERE CPE_VST_RES_ID ='011569' AND CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN('Comp') AND CPE_ENC_DTE <'2020-02-10' ) AS A WHERE RN = 1 ) , CURR_MEASURES AS (SELECT CDD_DOC_GUID, MRN, PT_NAME, DOB, SEX, VISIT_DEPARTMENT, CURR_VISIT_DT, MD_NAME, CDD_DOC_NAME DOCNAME, OP_DISPLAY_NAME, CDO_ITEM_NAME, CDO_VALUE_TEXT CURR_HEIGHT_CM, OCV_CURR_LOC, OCV_PVDR_NAME FROM ETO JOIN IDB.CD_DOCUMENT ON MRN = CDD_MRN AND CURR_VISIT_DATE = CDD_SERVICE_DTE JOIN IDB.OMS_CLIENT_VISIT ON CDD_VISIT_GUID = OCV_VISIT_GUID AND OCV_PVDR_NAME = 'Kalin, Marcia' JOIN IDB.OMS_PROVIDER ON CDD_AUTH_PROV_GUID = OP_PVDR_GUID JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION ON CDD_DOC_GUID = CDO_DOC_GUID WHERE CDD_CANCEL_IND = '0' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND = '0' AND CDD_DOC_NAME = '01_Vital Signs' AND CDO_ITEM_NAME = 'Height (centimeters)' ) , PAST_MEASURES AS (SELECT CPE_MRN, PAST_VISIT_DEPARTMENT, PAST_VISIT_DT, CDD_SERVICE_DT , CDO_ITEM_NAME, PAST_HEIGHT_CM FROM (SELECT CDD_DOC_GUID, CPE_MRN, PAST_VISIT_DEPARTMENT, PAST_VISIT_DT, CDD_SERVICE_DT, CDD_DOC_NAME DOCNAME, CDO_ITEM_NAME, CDO_VALUE_TEXT PAST_HEIGHT_CM, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CPE_MRN ORDER BY CDD_SERVICE_DT DESC) RN FROM PASTVST JOIN IDB.CD_DOCUMENT ON CPE_MRN = CDD_MRN AND CDD_SERVICE_DTE <= PAST_VISIT_DATE JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION ON CDD_DOC_GUID = CDO_DOC_GUID WHERE CDD_CANCEL_IND = '0' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND = '0' AND CDD_DOC_NAME = '01_Vital Signs' AND CDO_ITEM_NAME IN('Height (centimeters)', 'Last recorded Height Height (Previous)') ) AS A WHERE RN = 1 ) SELECT DISTINCT MRN, PT_NAME, DOB, SEX, VISIT_DEPARTMENT, CURR_VISIT_DT, MD_NAME , PAST_VISIT_DEPARTMENT, PAST_VISIT_DT, CDD_SERVICE_DT PAST_RECORDED_DT , SUBSTR(PAST_HEIGHT_CM, 1, 10) PAST_HEIGHT_CM, SUBSTR(CURR_HEIGHT_CM, 1, 10) CURR_HEIGHT_CM FROM CURR_MEASURES LEFT JOIN PAST_MEASURES ON CPE_MRN = MRN ;

prompt: pull the  ESIG Nursing Intervention/Procedure ESIG Note  -  past 12 months
completion: SELECT DOC_SVC, DOC_NAME, EMD_DOCTYPE, EMD_EMR_DESC, EMD_ESIG_XWALK, COUNT(DISTINCT EPD_EMR_DOCID) FROM IDB.EMR_PT_DOCUMENT JOIN IDB.EMR_PT_DOCTYPE ON EMD_DOCTYPE = EPD_DOCTYPE JOIN IDB.DOC ON DOC_DR_NO = EPD_DOCTOR_NUM WHERE EPD_DOC_DTE >= CURRENT_DATE - 12 MONTHS AND EMD_DOCTYPE = '' GROUP BY DOC_SVC, DOC_NAME, EMD_DOCTYPE, EMD_EMR_DESC, EMD_ESIG_XWALK SELECT * FROM IDB.EMR_PT_DOCTYPE WHERE UPPER(EMD_EMR_DESC) like '%NURSING%INTERVENTION%' OR UPPER(EMD_ESIG_DESC) like '%NURSING%INTERVENTION%'

prompt: Provide a list of patients who have received MEC (mitoxantrone, etoposide, and cytarabine), FLAG (fludarabine, cytarabine), FLAG-Ida (Fludarabine, Cytarabine, and Idarubicin), and High Dose Cytarabine Reinduction (HidAC) since 1/1/2014.
completion: WITH AML AS (SELECT CC_MRN AS MRN, CLM_CLSF_CD AS DX_CODE, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS DX_DESC, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS DX_DATE FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND ((CC_PT_TYPE = 'I') OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) AND CC_CLSF_CD IN ('205.0', '205.00', '205.01', '205.02', 'C92.0', 'C92.00', 'C92.01', 'C92.02') GROUP BY CC_MRN, CLM_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK UNION SELECT TM_MRN AS MRN, H.CLM_CLSF_CD AS DX_CODE, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS DX_DESC, TM_DX_DTE AS DX_DATE FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM H ON TM_HIST_CD = H.CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON TM_SITE_CD = S.CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND TM_HIST_CD IN ('M9840/3', 'M9861/3', 'M9865/3', 'M9866/3', 'M9867/3', 'M9869/3', 'M9871/3', 'M9872/3', 'M9873/3', 'M9874/3', 'M9895/3', 'M9896/3', 'M9897/3', 'M9898/3', 'M9910/3', 'M9911/3', 'M9920/3') ) , CTE AS (SELECT MRN AS DX_MRN, DX_DATE, STRIP(DX_CODE) || '-' || STRIP(DX_DESC) AS DX_CODE FROM AML) , CTE2 AS (SELECT * FROM CTE ORDER BY DX_MRN, DX_DATE, DX_CODE) , T1 AS (SELECT DX_MRN, DX_DATE, DX_CODE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY DX_MRN ORDER BY DX_DATE) AS RN FROM CTE2 ORDER BY DX_MRN, DX_DATE) , T2 (MRN, DX, RN1) AS (SELECT DX_MRN, CAST(DX_DATE AS VARCHAR(6000))||' | '||CAST(DX_CODE AS VARCHAR(100)), RN FROM T1 WHERE T1.RN = 1 UNION ALL SELECT DX_MRN, RTRIM(CAST(DX AS VARCHAR(4000))) || ', ' || CHR(13) || CHR(10) || CAST(DX_DATE AS VARCHAR(100))||' | '||RTRIM(CAST(DX_CODE AS VARCHAR(100))) , RN1 + 1 FROM T1, T2 WHERE DX_MRN = MRN AND RN = RN1+1 ) , T3 AS (SELECT MRN, MAX(RN1) RN FROM T2 GROUP BY MRN) , T4 AS (SELECT T2.MRN, RN, DX FROM T2 JOIN T3 ON T2.MRN = T3.MRN AND T2.RN1 = T3.RN) SELECT DISTINCT APR_MRN, PT_SEX AS GENDER, APR_START_DTE, APR_END_DTE, APR_DRUG_NAME, APR_GENERIC_NAME, APR_TOTAL_GIVEN_DOSE, APR_PRESCRIBED_DOSE, APR_DOSE_UOM, APR_SET_NAME, APR_PROVIDER_NAME, APR_PROVIDER_ROLE, APR_DIAGNOSIS_DESC, DX FROM IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX_V JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON APR_MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN T4 ON MRN = APR_MRN WHERE CDG_CHEMO_FLAG = 'Y' AND(UPPER(APR_DRUG_NAME) LIKE '%MITOXANTRONE%' OR UPPER(APR_DRUG_NAME) LIKE '%ETOPOSIDE' OR UPPER(APR_DRUG_NAME) LIKE '%CYTARABINE%' OR UPPER(APR_DRUG_NAME) LIKE '%FLUDARABINE%' OR UPPER(APR_DRUG_NAME) LIKE '%IDARUBICIN%' OR UPPER(APR_GENERIC_NAME) LIKE '%MITOXANTRONE%' OR UPPER(APR_GENERIC_NAME) LIKE '%ETOPOSIDE' OR UPPER(APR_GENERIC_NAME) LIKE '%CYTARABINE%' OR UPPER(APR_GENERIC_NAME) LIKE '%FLUDARABINE%' OR UPPER(APR_GENERIC_NAME) LIKE '%IDARUBICIN%') AND APR_START_DTE >= '2014-01-01' AND APR_SET_NAME LIKE 'LKA%' AND UPPER(APR_SET_NAME) NOT LIKE '%HIDAC%CONSOL%' AND UPPER(APR_SET_NAME) NOT LIKE '%12-266%' AND APR_SET_NAME NOT IN ('LKA_HyperCVAD_B_<60', 'LKA_HyperCVAD_B_>=60', 'LKA_HyperCVAD_B_Day_2,3_cytarabine', 'LKA_IT_Cytarabine', 'LKA_IT_Methotrexate', 'LKA_IT_Methotrexate_Flat_Dose', 'LKA_L-20_Consolidation_A', 'LKA_Nelarabine')

prompt: Provide a list of pathology reports that have the terms JAK2, MPL, or CALR mutations and acute myeloid leukemia from 2012 to present.
completion: SELECT PT_MRN AS "MRN", PT_LAST_NAME AS "Last Name", PT_FIRST_NAME AS "First Name", PT_BIRTH_DTE AS "DOB", PRPT_ACCESSION_NO AS "Path Accession Number", PRPT_REPORT AS "Path Report" FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT JOIN DV.DATE R ON R.DT_DATE_ID = PRPT_REPORT_DATE_ID JOIN DV.PATH_RPRT_TYPE_LOOKUP ON PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_CD = PRPT_REPORT_TYPE JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON PRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID WHERE (CONTAINS("PRPT_REPORT", '("JAK2")') = 1 OR CONTAINS("PRPT_REPORT", '("MPL")') = 1 OR CONTAINS("PRPT_REPORT", '("CALR")') = 1) AND CONTAINS("PRPT_REPORT", '("acute myeloid leukemia")') = 1 AND R.DT_DTE >= '2012-01-01' AND PRPT_REPORT IS NOT NULL AND (PRPT_ACCESSION_NO like 'H%' OR PRPT_ACCESSION_NO like 'S%') ; SELECT PT_MRN AS "MRN", PT_LAST_NAME AS "Last Name", PT_FIRST_NAME AS "First Name", PT_BIRTH_DTE AS "DOB", PRPT_ACCESSION_NO AS "Path Accession Number", PRPT_REPORT AS "Path Report" FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT JOIN DV.DATE R ON R.DT_DATE_ID = PRPT_REPORT_DATE_ID JOIN DV.PATH_RPRT_TYPE_LOOKUP ON PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_CD = PRPT_REPORT_TYPE JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON PRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID WHERE (CONTAINS("PRPT_REPORT", '("JAK2 mutation")') = 1 OR CONTAINS("PRPT_REPORT", '("MPL mutation")') = 1 OR CONTAINS("PRPT_REPORT", '("CALR mutation")') = 1) AND CONTAINS("PRPT_REPORT", '("acute myeloid leukemia")') = 1 AND R.DT_DTE >= '2012-01-01' AND PRPT_REPORT IS NOT NULL AND (PRPT_ACCESSION_NO like 'H%' OR PRPT_ACCESSION_NO like 'S%')

prompt: Provide list of orders for advanced imaging exams (CT, MRI, PET, Nuc Med) from 1/1/2018 - 5/31/2020 for patients identified as being on a research protocol and whether exams were Research Non-billable (RNB) or standard of care.
completion: SELECT * FROM (SELECT DISTINCT OOC_ITEM_NAME "Order Item Name", OO_SET_NAME "Order Set Name", DOC_NAME "Requested by", MAX(CASE WHEN OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'RIS_Order - Current' THEN OUD_USER_DI_VALUE ELSE '' END) AS "Current Order Name", MAX(CASE WHEN OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'RIS_ANC/Interface Code' THEN OUD_USER_DI_VALUE ELSE '' END) AS "RIS- ANC Code", MAX(CASE WHEN OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'RIS_Order - Modified' THEN OUD_USER_DI_VALUE ELSE '' END) AS "Modified Order Name", MAX(CASE WHEN OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'RIS_ANC Code - Modify' THEN OUD_USER_DI_VALUE ELSE '' END) AS "RIS- Modified ANC Code", OO_ORD_ID "Order ID", OO_ANCIL_REF_CD "Order Ancillary Code", OO_MRN "MRN", MAX(CASE WHEN OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'RIS_Primary Dx' THEN OUD_USER_DI_VALUE ELSE '' END) AS "Primary Diagnosis", MAX(CASE WHEN OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'RIS_PET-DiagnosisOth' THEN OUD_USER_DI_VALUE ELSE '' END) AS "Other Diagnosis", MAX(CASE WHEN OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'RIS_Pert/Signs/Symptoms' THEN OUD_USER_DI_VALUE ELSE '' END) AS "Pertinent Signs and Symptoms", MAX(CASE WHEN OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'RIS_NM-Reason For Study' THEN OUD_USER_DI_VALUE ELSE '' END) AS "Reason for Study", MAX(CASE WHEN OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'RIS_Info Desired From Study' THEN OUD_USER_DI_VALUE ELSE '' END) AS "Info Desired", MAX(CASE WHEN OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'Requested For' THEN OUD_USER_DI_VALUE ELSE '' END) AS "Requested for Date", MAX(CASE WHEN OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'RIS_Protocol Patient Y/N' THEN OUD_USER_DI_VALUE ELSE '' END) AS "Protocol Y/N", MAX(CASE WHEN OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'RIS_Protocol #' THEN OUD_USER_DI_VALUE ELSE '' END) AS "Protocol Number", MAX(CASE WHEN OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'RIS_Research Billing' THEN OUD_USER_DI_VALUE ELSE '' END) AS "Research Billing", OSTS_STS_DESC "Status Desc" FROM IDB.OMS_ORDER JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_CATALOG ON OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID = OOC_MSTR_ITEM_GUID JOIN IDB.DOC ON OO_REQ_DR_NO = DOC_DR_NO JOIN IDB.OMS_STATUS ON OO_ORD_STS_CD = OSTS_ORD_STS_CD LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_USER_DATA ON OUD_ORD_GUID = OO_ORD_GUID WHERE OOC_ITEM_NAME IN ('CT', 'MR', 'PET', 'PET CT for Cancer', 'PET CT for Cardiac viability or perfusion', 'PET MR', 'NM') AND OSTS_ORD_STS_CD IN ('RESF') AND OO_ENTER_DTE BETWEEN '2018-01-01' AND '2020-11-15' GROUP BY OOC_ITEM_NAME, DOC_NAME, OO_ORD_ID, OO_ANCIL_REF_CD, OO_MRN, OSTS_ORD_STS_CD, OSTS_STS_DESC, OO_ORD_GUID, OO_SET_NAME) A WHERE "Protocol Y/N" = 'Yes' ;

prompt: CIS Ordersets with Troponin.

prompt: We would like to request the same items from the previous project for IRB 18-528
completion: WITH ORDERS_INFO AS (SELECT DISTINCT OO_MRN AS MRN, AC_CONS_DTE, AC_PVDR_OF_RECORD_NAME, AC_CONS_STAFF_NAME, AC_CR_DTE, OO_ENTER_DT AS "Enter DT", OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE AS "Significant Date", STRIP(OO_ORD_NAME) AS "Order Name", OO_SET_NAME AS "Set Name", OO_ORD_STS_CD AS "Order Status", OO_ORD_PRIO AS "Priority", OO_ORD_TYPE_CD, OUO_ORG_NAME, OUO_REV_CAT_DEPT, OO_SUMMARY_LINE AS "Summary Line", OUO_ATN_PVDR_NAME AS "Attending Name", OUO_PVDR_NAME AS "Provider Name", OUO_PVDR_ROLE_TYPE AS "Provider Role", OUO_USER_NAME AS "User Name", OUO_USER_ROLE_TYPE AS "User Role", OCV_CURR_LOC AS "Current Location", OO_ORD_ID AS "Order ID", OO_ORD_GUID AS "Order GUID" FROM IDB.OMS_ORDER OO JOIN IDB.ACCRUALS ON AC_MRN = OO_MRN AND AC_IRB_NO = '18-528' JOIN IDB.OMS_PROVIDER ON OO.OO_PVDR_GUID = OP_PVDR_GUID JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON OO_MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_USER_ORDERS OUO ON OO_ORD_GUID = OUO_ORD_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_CLIENT_VISIT ON OO_VISIT_GUID = OCV_VISIT_GUID WHERE OO_ORD_STS_CD NOT IN ('CANC', 'CANP', 'AUC3') AND OO.OO_ENTER_DTE >= '2/20/2019' ) SELECT * FROM ORDERS_INFO ORDER BY 1, 2, 3, 4 ; WITH CLINDOC_INFO AS (SELECT CDD_MRN AS MRN, CDD_SERVICE_DTE, CDD_SIGNED_DTE, CDD_DOC_NAME, OP_DISPLAY_NAME AS AUTHOR, CDD_DOC_GUID , AC_CONS_DTE, AC_PVDR_OF_RECORD_NAME, AC_CONS_STAFF_NAME, AC_CR_DTE FROM IDB.CD_DOCUMENT JOIN IDB.ACCRUALS ON AC_MRN = CDD_MRN AND AC_IRB_NO = '18-528' JOIN IDB.OMS_PROVIDER ON CDD_AUTH_PROV_GUID = OP_PVDR_GUID WHERE 1=1 AND CDD_CANCEL_IND <> '1' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND <> '1' AND CDD_SIGNED_DTE >= '2/20/2019' ) SELECT * FROM CLINDOC_INFO ORDER BY 1, 3, 2, 4 ; WITH ORDERS_INFO AS (SELECT DISTINCT OO_MRN AS MRN, AC_CONS_DTE, AC_PVDR_OF_RECORD_NAME, AC_CONS_STAFF_NAME, AC_CR_DTE, OO_ENTER_DT AS "Enter DT", OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE AS "Significant Date", STRIP(OO_ORD_NAME) AS "Order Name", OO_SET_NAME AS "Set Name", OO_ORD_STS_CD AS "Order Status", OO_ORD_PRIO AS "Priority", OO_ORD_TYPE_CD, OUO_ORG_NAME, OUO_REV_CAT_DEPT, OO_SUMMARY_LINE AS "Summary Line", OUO_ATN_PVDR_NAME AS "Attending Name", OUO_PVDR_NAME AS "Provider Name", OUO_PVDR_ROLE_TYPE AS "Provider Role", OUO_USER_NAME AS "User Name", OUO_USER_ROLE_TYPE AS "User Role", OCV_CURR_LOC AS "Current Location", OO_ORD_ID AS "Order ID", OO_ORD_GUID AS "Order GUID" FROM IDB.OMS_ORDER OO JOIN IDB.ACCRUALS ON AC_MRN = OO_MRN AND AC_IRB_NO = '19-408' JOIN IDB.OMS_PROVIDER ON OO.OO_PVDR_GUID = OP_PVDR_GUID JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON OO_MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_USER_ORDERS OUO ON OO_ORD_GUID = OUO_ORD_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_CLIENT_VISIT ON OO_VISIT_GUID = OCV_VISIT_GUID WHERE OO_ORD_STS_CD NOT IN ('CANC', 'CANP', 'AUC3') AND OO.OO_ENTER_DTE >= '12/11/2019' ) SELECT * FROM ORDERS_INFO ORDER BY 1, 2, 3, 4 ; prompt: Provide a list of patients with the following ICD-10 diagnosis codes: C69.20, 669.21, C69.22, H43.89, C85 who have had an appointment with Dr. Christian Grommes.
completion: WITH APPTS AS (SELECT CPE_MRN AS "MRN", CPE_ENC_DTE AS "Appt Date", CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 AS "Department", CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 AS "Service", CRE_RES_NAME AS "Provider Name", ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CPE_MRN ORDER BY CPE_ENC_DTE ASC) ENC_ASC, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CPE_MRN ORDER BY CPE_ENC_DTE DESC) ENC_DESC FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE 1 = 1 AND CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND UPPER(CRE_RES_NAME) LIKE '%GROMMES%' AND UPPER(CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6) LIKE '%NEU%' ORDER BY CPE_MRN, CPE_ENC_DTE DESC ), NEU_VISIT AS (SELECT CPE_MRN AS "MRN", CPE_ENC_DTE AS "Appt Date", CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 AS "Department", CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 AS "Service", CRE_RES_NAME AS "Provider Name", ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CPE_MRN ORDER BY CPE_ENC_DTE ASC) NEU_ENC_ASC FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE 1 = 1 AND CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND (UPPER(CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8) LIKE '%NEU%') ), DX AS (SELECT CC_MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS DX_DTE, CC_CLSF_CD AS ICD_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS ICD_DESC FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE 1 = 1 AND (CC_CLSF_CD IN ('C69.20', 'C69.21', 'C69.22', 'H43.89', 'C85.90') OR UPPER(CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK) LIKE '%VITREAL%RETIN%LYMPH%' OR UPPER(CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK) LIKE '%VITREO%RETIN%LYMPH%' OR UPPER(CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK) LIKE '%INTRAOC%LYMPH%') AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND (CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) GROUP BY CC_MRN, CC_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK ), OTHER_DX AS (SELECT TM_MRN, AV_DESC AS CASE_STS, TM_DX_DTE, TM_HIST_CD, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS HIST_DESC, TM_SITE_CD, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_DESC, TM_BEST_AJCC_STG FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS ON AV_ELEMENT = 'CASE_STS' AND AV_CODE = TM_CASE_STS WHERE 1 = 1 AND TM_MRN IN (SELECT DISTINCT "MRN" FROM APPTS) AND TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') ORDER BY TM_MRN ) SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN , PT_LAST_NAME , PT_FIRST_NAME , PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH , PT_SEX , DX_DTE , ICD_CD , ICD_DESC , CASE WHEN PT_MRN IN (SELECT DISTINCT TM_MRN FROM OTHER_DX) THEN 'YES' ELSE 'NO' END OTHER_CANCER_DX , FIRST_APPT."Appt Date" FIRST_APPT , LAST_APPT."Appt Date" LAST_APPT , PLA_LST_CON_DTE LAST_CONTACT_DT , CASE WHEN PT_DEATH_IND IN ('', 'A') THEN 'ALIVE' ELSE 'DECEASED' END AS VITAL_STS , NEU_VISIT."Appt Date" FIRST_NEU_APPT FROM DX JOIN APPTS FIRST_APPT ON CC_MRN = FIRST_APPT."MRN" AND FIRST_APPT.ENC_ASC = 1 JOIN APPTS LAST_APPT ON CC_MRN = LAST_APPT."MRN" AND LAST_APPT.ENC_DESC = 1 LEFT JOIN NEU_VISIT ON CC_MRN = NEU_VISIT."MRN" AND NEU_ENC_ASC = 1 JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON CC_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY ON PT_MRN = PLA_MRN JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS ON AV_ELEMENT = 'DEATH_IND' AND AV_CODE = PT_DEATH_IND LEFT JOIN OTHER_DX ON PT_MRN = TM_MRN ; WITH APPTS AS (SELECT CPE_MRN AS "MRN", CPE_ENC_DTE AS "Appt Date", CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 AS "Department", CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 AS "Service", CRE_RES_NAME AS "Provider Name", ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CPE_MRN ORDER BY CPE_ENC_DTE ASC) ENC_ASC, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CPE_MRN ORDER BY CPE_ENC_DTE DESC) ENC_DESC FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE 1 = 1 AND CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND UPPER(CRE_RES_NAME) LIKE '%GROMMES%' AND UPPER(CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6) LIKE '%NEU%' ORDER BY CPE_MRN, CPE_ENC_DTE DESC ), DX AS (SELECT CC_MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS DX_DTE, CC_CLSF_CD AS ICD_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS ICD_DESC FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE 1 = 1 AND (CC_CLSF_CD IN ('C69.20', 'C69.21', 'C69.22', 'H43.89', 'C85.90') OR UPPER(CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK) LIKE '%VITREAL%RETIN%LYMPH%' OR UPPER(CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK) LIKE '%VITREO%RETIN%LYMPH%' OR UPPER(CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK) LIKE '%INTRAOC%LYMPH%') AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND (CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) GROUP BY CC_MRN, CC_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK ) SELECT TM_MRN, TM_DX_DTE, TM_HIST_CD, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS HIST_DESC, TM_SITE_CD, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_DESC FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS ON AV_ELEMENT = 'CASE_STS' AND AV_CODE = TM_CASE_STS WHERE 1 = 1 AND TM_MRN IN (SELECT DISTINCT "MRN" FROM APPTS) AND TM_MRN IN (SELECT DISTINCT CC_MRN FROM DX) AND TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') ORDER BY TM_MRN

completion: WITH SRG AS (SELECT DISTINCT OC_MRN , OC_SURG_DTE AS SURG_DATE, OC_SCH_DT , OC_CASE_ID, CPX_PROC_NAME AS PROCEDURE_NAME, OC_OR_CASE_STS AS STATUS, A.CRE_RES_NAME AS SURGEON, P.OCAS_SURG_ROLE, A.CRE_RES_ID AS MD_ID, C.CRE_RES_NAME AS CO_SURGEON, C.CRE_RES_ID AS COMD_ID, P.OCAS_SURG_SVC AS SERVICE, OC_SURG_SVC_CD , OC_SURG_SVC , B.CRE_RES_NAME AS ROOM, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, ACD_IRB_NO AS IRB_NO FROM IDB.OR_CASE JOIN IDB.OR_CASE_ALL_PROC ON OCAP_CASE_ID = OC_CASE_ID JOIN IDB.OR_CASE_ALL_SURG P ON P.OCAS_CASE_ID = OCAP_CASE_ID AND P.OCAS_PNL_NO = OCAP_PNL_NO AND P.OCAS_SURG_ROLE = 'Primary' JOIN IDB.OR_CL_PROC ON OCAP_OR_PROC_ID = OCP_OR_PROC_ID JOIN IDB.CL_PROC ON OCP_PROC_ID = CPX_PROC_ID JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE A ON A.CRE_RES_ID = P.OCAS_RES_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.OR_CASE_ALL_SURG CS ON CS.OCAS_CASE_ID = OCAP_CASE_ID AND CS.OCAS_PNL_NO = OCAP_PNL_NO AND CS.OCAS_SURG_ROLE = 'Co-Surgeon' LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE C ON C.CRE_RES_ID = CS.OCAS_RES_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE B ON B.CRE_RES_ID = OC_ROOM_RES_ID JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON OC_MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.ACCRUALS_DATES ON ACD_MRN = OC_MRN AND ACD_IRB_NO = '06-107' AND ACD_OFF_STUDY_DTE IS NULL WHERE 1=1 AND OC_SURG_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT DATE AND CURRENT DATE + 42 DAY AND OC_OR_CASE_STS IN ('Sch', 'Not Sch') AND CPX_PROC_CD = '19364' ) SELECT DISTINCT OC_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, SURGEON, CO_SURGEON, SURG_DATE, CPE_ENC_DTE AS APPT_DTE, CRE_RES_NAME AS PROVIDER, CLD_DEPT_NAME AS DEPT , CLD_CLD_CENTER AS SITE, IRB_NO FROM SRG LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT * FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT A ON CPE_DEPT_ID = A.CLD_DEPT_ID AND A.CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 = 'SRG' AND A.CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 = 'PLA' JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE B ON B.CRE_RES_ID = CPE_VST_RES_ID AND CRE_RES_TYP = 'Physician' JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE 1=1 AND CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Sch') AND CPE_ENC_DTE >= CURRENT date ) AS X ON CPE_MRN = OC_MRN

prompt: List of patients with plasmablastic lymphoma

prompt: Schedule a daily report of CT and PET radiology reports that contain any of the specified search terms.
completion: SELECT DISTINCT "t1"."PT_MRN" AS "MRN", STRIP(PT_LAST_NAME) || ', ' || STRIP(PT_FIRST_NAME) AS "Name", "t2"."RRPT_ACCESSION_NO" AS "Radiology Accession Number", "t2"."RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE" AS "Radiology Performed Date", "t2"."RRPT_REPORT_DTE" AS "Radiology Report Date", "t2"."RRPT_ORDER_GROUP" AS "Radiology Order Group", "t2"."RRPT_PROCEDURE_NAME" AS "Radiology Procedure Name", UPPER(CASE WHEN LENGTH(RRPT_REPORT_TXT) <= 15000 THEN RTRIM(CAST(SUBSTR(RRPT_REPORT_TXT, 1, 15000) AS VARCHAR(15000))) ELSE CAST(SUBSTR(RRPT_REPORT_TXT, 1, 15000) AS VARCHAR(15000)) END) AS "PRPT_REPORT", UPPER(DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)IMPRESSION:[\w\W]*(?=DICTATED BY:)', RRPT_REPORT_TXT)) AS IMPRESSION FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V" "t1" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED" "t3" ON "t1"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t3"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."RADIOLOGY_REPORT_V" "t2" ON "t3"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t2"."RRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_IDENTIFICATION_MRN_V" "t4" ON "t1"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t4"."PI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" WHERE 1=1 AND "t2"."RRPT_ORDER_GROUP" LIKE '%CT%' AND UPPER("t2"."RRPT_PROCEDURE_NAME") like '%CH%' AND(LOCATE('STENOSIS', UPPER(RRPT_REPORT_TXT)) > 0 OR LOCATE('ENDOBRONCHIAL', UPPER(RRPT_REPORT_TXT)) > 0 OR LOCATE('FISTULA', UPPER(RRPT_REPORT_TXT)) > 0 OR LOCATE('ENDOTRACHEAL', UPPER(RRPT_REPORT_TXT)) > 0 OR LOCATE('POSTOBSTRUCTIVE', UPPER(RRPT_REPORT_TXT)) > 0 OR LOCATE('COLLAPSE', UPPER(RRPT_REPORT_TXT)) > 0 OR LOCATE('NARROWING', UPPER(RRPT_REPORT_TXT)) > 0) AND "t2"."RRPT_REPORT_DTE" >= CURRENT date - 1 DAYS UNION SELECT DISTINCT "t1"."PT_MRN" AS "MRN", STRIP(PT_LAST_NAME) || ', ' || STRIP(PT_FIRST_NAME) AS "Name", "t2"."RRPT_ACCESSION_NO" AS "Radiology Accession Number", "t2"."RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE" AS "Radiology Performed Date", "t2"."RRPT_REPORT_DTE" AS "Radiology Report Date", "t2"."RRPT_ORDER_GROUP" AS "Radiology Order Group", "t2"."RRPT_PROCEDURE_NAME" AS "Radiology Procedure Name", UPPER(CASE WHEN LENGTH(RRPT_REPORT_TXT) <= 15000 THEN RTRIM(CAST(SUBSTR(RRPT_REPORT_TXT, 1, 15000) AS VARCHAR(15000))) ELSE CAST(SUBSTR(RRPT_REPORT_TXT, 1, 15000) AS VARCHAR(15000)) END) AS "PRPT_REPORT", UPPER(DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)IMPRESSION:[\w\W]*(?=DICTATED BY:)', RRPT_REPORT_TXT)) AS IMPRESSION FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V" "t1" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED" "t3" ON "t1"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t3"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."RADIOLOGY_REPORT_V" "t2" ON "t3"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t2"."RRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_IDENTIFICATION_MRN_V" "t4" ON "t1"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t4"."PI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" WHERE 1=1 AND "t2"."RRPT_ORDER_GROUP" LIKE '%PET%' AND(LOCATE('STENOSIS', UPPER(RRPT_REPORT_TXT)) > 0 OR LOCATE('ENDOBRONCHIAL', UPPER(RRPT_REPORT_TXT)) > 0 OR LOCATE('FISTULA', UPPER(RRPT_REPORT_TXT)) > 0 OR LOCATE('ENDOTRACHEAL', UPPER(RRPT_REPORT_TXT)) > 0 OR LOCATE('POSTOBSTRUCTIVE', UPPER(RRPT_REPORT_TXT)) > 0 OR LOCATE('COLLAPSE', UPPER(RRPT_REPORT_TXT)) > 0 OR LOCATE('NARROWING', UPPER(RRPT_REPORT_TXT)) > 0) AND "t2"."RRPT_REPORT_DTE" >= CURRENT date -
