completion: SELECT EVI_EMPLOYEE_ID, CVP_NAME, VACCINE_STATUS, CEVE_CATEGORY, CVP_STATUS, CVP_SHORT_TERM_DIS_FLAG ON_LEAVE, CASE WHEN DOSE_ADDL_APPT_STATUS = 'PRE' THEN DATE(DOSE_ADDL_APPT_DT) ELSE NULL END AS ADDL_DOSE_APPT_DTE, FIRST_BOOSTER_ELIGIBLE_DTE, SUPV_NAME FROM IDB.COVID19_EMPLOYEE_VACCINE_INFO LEFT JOIN IDB.COVID19_EMPLOYEE_VACCINE_EXEMPT_V ON EVI_EMPLOYEE_ID = EXEMPT_EMPLOYEE_ID JOIN IDB.COVID19_VACCINE_PERSON ON EVI_EMPLOYEE_ID = CVP_EMPLOYEE_ID LEFT JOIN (SELECT CVP_EMPLOYEE_ID SUPV_ID, CVP_NAME SUPV_NAME FROM IDB.COVID19_VACCINE_PERSON) ON CVP_SUPERVISOR_ID = SUPV_ID WHERE CVP_STATUS = 'Active' AND CEVE_CATEGORY = 'Employees' AND COALESCE(CVP_SHORT_TERM_DIS_FLAG, '') <> 'Y' AND COALESCE(MEDICAL_EXEMPT, '') <> 'Y' AND COALESCE(REMOTE_EXEMPT, '') <> 'Y' AND FIRST_BOOSTER_COMPLIANT <> 'Y' AND FIRST_BOOSTER_ELIGIBLE_DTE <= CURRENT_DATE ; SELECT EVI_EMPLOYEE_ID, CVP_NAME, VACCINE_STATUS, CEVE_CATEGORY, CVP_STATUS, CVP_SHORT_TERM_DIS_FLAG ON_LEAVE, CASE WHEN DOSE_ADDL_APPT_STATUS = 'PRE' THEN DATE(DOSE_ADDL_APPT_DT) ELSE NULL END AS ADDL_DOSE_APPT_DTE, FIRST_BOOSTER_ELIGIBLE_DTE, SUPV_NAME FROM IDB.COVID19_EMPLOYEE_VACCINE_INFO LEFT JOIN IDB.COVID19_EMPLOYEE_VACCINE_EXEMPT_V ON EVI_EMPLOYEE_ID = EXEMPT_EMPLOYEE_ID JOIN IDB.COVID19_VACCINE_PERSON ON EVI_EMPLOYEE_ID = CVP_EMPLOYEE_ID LEFT JOIN (SELECT CVP_EMPLOYEE_ID SUPV_ID, CVP_NAME SUPV_NAME FROM IDB.COVID19_VACCINE_PERSON) ON CVP_SUPERVISOR_ID = SUPV_ID WHERE CVP_STATUS = 'Active' AND CEVE_CATEGORY = 'Employees' AND COALESCE(CVP_SHORT_TERM_DIS_FLAG, '') <> 'Y' AND COALESCE(MEDICAL_EXEMPT, '') <> 'Y' AND COALESCE(REMOTE_EXEMPT, '') <> 'Y' AND FIRST_BOOSTER_COMPLIANT <> 'Y' AND FIRST_BOOSTER_ELIGIBLE_DTE > CURRENT_DATE ;

prompt: Provide 2 daily reports for multiple antiemetic drug orders to be performed today or tomorrow.  First report is combination of Aprepitant and Forsaprepitant, second report is a combination of Granisetron, Ondasetron and Palonosetron and/or two day consecutive Palonosetron orders
completion: WITH ORD AS (SELECT OO_MRN, OO_ENTER_DTE, OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE, OO_ORD_GUID, OO_ORD_ID , OO_ORD_STS_CD, OO_ORD_NAME, OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID , OO_SUMMARY_LINE, OO_ORD_TYPE_CD, OO_ORD_FREQ, OO_SET_NAME, OO_REQ_TME_PRIO , CASE WHEN LOCATE(' ', STRIP(OO_ORD_NAME)) > 0 THEN SUBSTR(STRIP(OO_ORD_NAME), 1, LOCATE(' ', STRIP(OO_ORD_NAME))) ELSE STRIP(OO_ORD_NAME) END KEYWORD, OCV_CURR_LOC ORDER_LOCATION, STRIP(OS_SVC_GRP_CD)||'-'||OS_SVC_DESC ORDER_SERVICE FROM IDB.OMS_ORDER JOIN IDB.OMS_CLIENT_VISIT ON OO_VISIT_GUID = OCV_VISIT_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_SERVICE ON OCV_SVC_GUID = OS_SVC_GUID WHERE OO_ORD_TYPE_CD = 'Medication' AND OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID IN ('3000003901073029', '9000005387300730', '9000013783100730', '9000013407100730', '9000006390100730', '9000009888300730', '9000007796100730') AND OO_ORD_STS_CD IN ('AUA2', 'HOLD', 'COMP', 'COMPT', 'AUC1') AND CASE WHEN OO_ORD_STS_CD = 'HOLD' AND OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE < CURRENT DATE THEN 'N' WHEN OO_ORD_STS_CD IN ('COMP', 'COMPT', 'AUC1') AND OO_ORD_FREQ = 'once' THEN 'N' ELSE 'Y' END = 'Y' AND OO_ENTER_DTE >= CURRENT DATE - 6 MONTH ) , CNT AS (SELECT OO_MRN CNT_MRN, OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE START_DATE , CASE WHEN MAX(CASE WHEN KEYWORD = 'Aprepitant' THEN 'Y' ELSE '' END) = 'Y' AND OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE = CURRENT DATE + 1 DAY THEN 'Y' END APREPITANT_TOMORROW , CASE WHEN MAX(CASE WHEN KEYWORD = 'Aprepitant' THEN 'Y' ELSE '' END) = 'Y' AND OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE = CURRENT DATE THEN 'Y' END APREPITANT_TODAY , CASE WHEN MAX(CASE WHEN KEYWORD = 'FOSaprepitant' THEN 'Y' ELSE '' END) = 'Y' AND OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE = CURRENT DATE THEN 'Y' END FOSAPREPITANT_TODAY , CASE WHEN MAX(CASE WHEN KEYWORD = 'FOSaprepitant' THEN 'Y' ELSE '' END) = 'Y' AND OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE = CURRENT DATE + 1 DAY THEN 'Y' END FOSAPREPITANT_TOMORROW FROM ORD GROUP BY OO_MRN, OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE) , EMAR AS (SELECT OOTO_MRN, OO_ORD_GUID OOTO_ORD_GUID, OOTO_SIGNIFIC_DTE, OOTO_STATUS_CD , MAX(CASE WHEN KEYWORD = 'Aprepitant' AND OOTO_SIGNIFIC_DTE = CURRENT DATE THEN 'Y' END) APREPITANT_TODAY , MAX(CASE WHEN KEYWORD = 'Aprepitant' AND OOTO_SIGNIFIC_DTE = CURRENT DATE + 1 DAY THEN 'Y' END) APREPITANT_TOMORROW , MAX(CASE WHEN KEYWORD = 'FOSaprepitant' AND OOTO_SIGNIFIC_DTE = CURRENT DATE THEN 'Y' END) FOSAPREPITANT_TODAY , MAX(CASE WHEN KEYWORD = 'FOSaprepitant' AND OOTO_SIGNIFIC_DTE = CURRENT DATE + 1 DAY THEN 'Y' END) FOSAPREPITANT_TOMORROW FROM ORD JOIN IDB.OAS_ORD_TASK_OCCR ON OO_ORD_GUID = OOTO_ORD_GUID JOIN IDB.OAS_CTLG_ITEM_TASK ON OOTO_CAT_ITEM_GUID = OCIT_GUID AND OCIT_LEVEL_NO = 0 WHERE OOTO_SIGNIFIC_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT DATE AND CURRENT DATE + 1 DAY AND OOTO_STATUS_CD = 'Pending' AND KEYWORD IN ('Aprepitant', 'FOSaprepitant') GROUP BY OOTO_MRN, OO_ORD_GUID, OOTO_SIGNIFIC_DTE, OOTO_STATUS_CD) , EMAR_SUM AS (SELECT OOTO_MRN EMAR_MRN , MAX(APREPITANT_TODAY) APREPITANT_EMAR_TODAY , MAX(APREPITANT_TOMORROW) APREPITANT_EMAR_TOMORROW , MAX(FOSAPREPITANT_TODAY) FOSAPREPITANT_EMAR_TODAY , MAX(FOSAPREPITANT_TOMORROW) FOSAPREPITANT_EMAR_TOMORROW FROM EMAR GROUP BY OOTO_MRN) , EMAR_FNL AS (SELECT OOTO_MRN, OOTO_ORD_GUID, FOSAPREPITANT_EMAR_TODAY, FOSAPREPITANT_EMAR_TOMORROW, APREPITANT_EMAR_TODAY , APREPITANT_EMAR_TOMORROW FROM EMAR JOIN EMAR_SUM ON OOTO_MRN = EMAR_MRN), FINAL AS (SELECT OO_MRN, OO_ENTER_DTE, OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE, ORDER_LOCATION, ORDER_SERVICE, OO_ORD_GUID, OO_ORD_ID, OO_ORD_STS_CD, OO_ORD_NAME, OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID, OO_SUMMARY_LINE, OO_ORD_FREQ, OO_SET_NAME, OO_REQ_TME_PRIO , CASE WHEN COALESCE(FOSAPREPITANT_TODAY, FOSAPREPITANT_EMAR_TODAY, '') = 'Y' AND COALESCE(APREPITANT_TODAY, APREPITANT_EMAR_TODAY, '') = 'Y' THEN 'FOSaprepitant, Aprepitant combo TODAY' WHEN COALESCE(FOSAPREPITANT_TOMORROW, FOSAPREPITANT_EMAR_TOMORROW, '') = 'Y' AND COALESCE(APREPITANT_TOMORROW, APREPITANT_EMAR_TOMORROW, '') = 'Y' THEN 'FOSaprepitant,Aprepitant combo TOMORROW' ELSE '' END COMBO_INDICATOR FROM ORD LEFT JOIN CNT ON OO_MRN = CNT_MRN AND OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE = START_DATE LEFT JOIN EMAR_FNL ON OO_MRN = OOTO_MRN AND OO_ORD_GUID = OOTO_ORD_GUID WHERE OOTO_ORD_GUID IS NOT NULL OR (CNT_MRN IS NOT NULL AND OO_ORD_STS_CD IN ('HOLD', 'AUA2')) ) SELECT OO_MRN MRN, STRIP(PT_LAST_NAME)||', '||PT_FIRST_NAME PT_NAME, YEAR(OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE) - YEAR(PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) CURRENT_AGE, OO_ENTER_DTE ORDER_ENTER_DATE, OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE SIGNIFICANT_DATE, ORDER_LOCATION, ORDER_SERVICE, OO_ORD_ID ORDER_ID, OO_ORD_STS_CD ORDER_STATUS, OO_ORD_NAME ORDER_NAME , OO_SUMMARY_LINE SUMMARY_LINE, OO_ORD_FREQ FREQ, OO_SET_NAME SET_NAME, OO_REQ_TME_PRIO REQ_TIME_PRIO, COMBO_INDICATOR ALERT_INDICATOR FROM FINAL JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON OO_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE COMBO_INDICATOR > ''

prompt: Provide a list of  patients diagnosed with mantle cell lymphoma (MCL) with central nervous system (CNS) involvement.
completion: SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN AS MRN, TRIM(PT_LAST_NAME) ||', ' || TRIM(PT_FIRST_NAME) AS PATIENT_NAME, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH DATE_OF_BIRTH, PT_SEX AS GENDER, PLA_LST_KNOWN_ALIVE_DTE AS LAST_KNOWN_ALIVE, TM_DX_DTE , HIST_DESC AS HISTOLOGY , SITE_DESC AS SITE , MIN_ICD9_EFF_DTE AS EFFECTIVE_DATE , ICD9_CD , ICD9_DESC FROM IDB.PATIENT JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY ON PLA_MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN (SELECT TM_MRN, AV_DESC AS CASE_STS, TM_DX_DTE, TM_ICD10_CD, TM_HIST_CD, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS HIST_DESC, TM_SITE_CD, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_DESC FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS ON AV_ELEMENT = 'CASE_STS' AND AV_CODE = TM_CASE_STS AND TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND TM_ICD10_CD IN ('G98.198', 'C79.49', 'G96.9', 'C72.9', 'C85.89', 'C79.49', 'C85.89', 'C85.99', 'D49.7') AND TM_DX_DTE >= '2013-01-01') AS CDB ON TM_MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN (SELECT CC_MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS MIN_ICD9_EFF_DTE, CC_CLSF_CD AS ICD9_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS ICD9_DESC FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE CC_CLSF_CD IN ('G98.198', 'C79.49', 'G96.9', 'C72.9', 'C85.89', 'C79.49', 'C85.89', 'C85.99', 'D49.7') AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND (CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) GROUP BY CC_MRN, CC_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK HAVING MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) >= '2013-01-01') AS ICD9 ON CC_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE COALESCE(TM_MRN, CC_MRN) IS NOT NULL; WITH DX AS (SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN, COALESCE(TM_DX_DTE, MIN_ICD9_EFF_DTE) AS DX_DATE FROM IDB.PATIENT LEFT JOIN (SELECT TM_MRN, AV_DESC AS CASE_STS, TM_DX_DTE, TM_ICD10_CD, TM_HIST_CD, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS HIST_DESC, TM_SITE_CD, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_DESC FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS ON AV_ELEMENT = 'CASE_STS' AND AV_CODE = TM_CASE_STS AND TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND TM_ICD10_CD IN ('G98.198', 'C79.49', 'G96.9', 'C72.9', 'C85.89', 'C79.49', 'C85.89', 'C85.99', 'D49.7') AND TM_DX_DTE >= '2013-01-01') AS CDB ON TM_MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN (SELECT CC_MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS MIN_ICD9_EFF_DTE, CC_CLSF_CD AS ICD9_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS ICD9_DESC FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE CC_CLSF_CD IN ('G98.198', 'C79.49', 'G96.9', 'C72.9', 'C85.89', 'C79.49', 'C85.89', 'C85.99', 'D49.7') AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND (CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) GROUP BY CC_MRN, CC_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK HAVING MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) >= '2013-01-01') AS ICD9 ON CC_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE COALESCE(TM_MRN, CC_MRN) IS NOT NULL ) SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN AS MRN, CPE_ENC_DTE AS APPOINTMENT_DATE, DEPT AS DEPARTMENT, SERVICE FROM (SELECT CPE_MRN, CPE_ENC_DTE , CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 AS DEPT, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 AS SERVICE, ROW_NUMBER () OVER (PARTITION BY CPE_MRN, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 ORDER BY CPE_ENC_DTE ASC) RN FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID JOIN DX ON PT_MRN = CPE_MRN WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND (CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR LIKE '%NEW%' OR CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR LIKE '%NV%') AND CRE_RES_TYP = 'Physician' AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 = 'LYM' AND CPE_ENC_DTE >= DX_DATE ) WHERE RN =1 ; SELECT LR_MRN, LR_PERFORMED_DTE, LR_TEST_NAME, LR_SUBTEST_NAME, LR_RESULT_VALUE, LTL_TEXT_RESULT, LR_ABNORMALITY_CD FROM IDB.LAB_RESULTS LEFT JOIN IDB.LAB_TEXT_LINE ON LTL_RESULT_GUID = LR_RESULT_GUID AND LTL_LINE_NO = 1 WHERE 1=1 AND LR_TEST_NAME = 'Body Fluid Cell Count and Differential CSF' AND LR_PERFORMED_DTE >= '2013-01-01' ; SELECT DISTINCT APR_MRN, APR_START_DTE, CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME, APR_PRESCRIBED_DOSE, CDG_CHEMO_FLAG, APR_ROUTE FROM IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX JOIN IDB.CHEMO_DRUG_GENERIC ON APR_GENERIC_NAME = CDG_GENERIC_NAME WHERE APR_START_DTE >= '2013-01-01' AND (LOWER(APR_GENERIC_NAME) IN ('methotrexate' , 'cytarabine') AND APR_ROUTE = 'intrathecal' OR LOWER(APR_GENERIC_NAME) IN ('methotrexate') AND APR_ROUTE LIKE 'IV%') ; SELECT DISTINCT OL_MRN, OL_SURG_DTE, OLAP_LOG_ID, OP_PROC_NAME, CPX_PROC_CD FROM IDB.OR_LOG JOIN IDB.OR_LOG_ALL_PROC ON OL_LOG_ID = OLAP_LOG_ID JOIN IDB.OR_PROC ON OLAP_OR_PROC_ID = OP_OR_PROC_ID JOIN IDB.OR_CL_PROC ON OP_OR_PROC_ID = OCP_OR_PROC_ID JOIN IDB.CL_PROC ON OCP_PROC_ID = CPX_PROC_ID WHERE 1=1 AND (LOWER (OP_PROC_NAME) like '%lumbar%puncture%' OR LOWER(OP_PROC_NAME) LIKE '%ommaya%') AND OL_SURG_DTE >= '2013-01-01' ; SELECT PRPT_MRN AS MRN, PRPT_PROCEDURE_DTE AS "Procedure date", PRPT_REPORT_DTE AS "Report date", PRPT_REPORT_TYPE_DESC AS "Report type", PRPT_ACCESSION_NO AS "Accession number", PRPT_REPORT AS "Report text" FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V WHERE PRPT_REPORT_TYPE_DESC IN ('Flow Cytometry Report', 'Cytology-Non GYN') AND (LOCATE('cerebrospinal fluid', PRPT_REPORT) >= 1 OR LOCATE('lumbar puncture', PRPT_REPORT) >= 1) AND PRPT_REPORT_DTE >= '2013-01-01' ; SELECT DISTINCT RRPT_MRN, RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE, RRPT_ACCESSION_NO, RRPT_PROCEDURE_NAME FROM DV.RADIOLOGY_REPORT_V WHERE 1=1 AND (LOWER(RRPT_PROCEDURE_NAME) LIKE '%lumbar%puncture%' OR LOCATE('lumbar puncture', RRPT_REPORT_TXT) >= 1) AND RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE >= '2013-01-01' ;

prompt: Need data for patienttst between Januayr 1st 2018 and December 31 2023, who had received oxaliplatin and had a tryptase order
completion: WITH OXA AS (SELECT DISTINCT APR_MRN, CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME, APR_START_DTE, APR_END_DTE FROM IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX_V WHERE CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME = 'OXALIPLATIN' AND YEAR(APR_START_DTE) BETWEEN '2018' AND '2023' ) SELECT DISTINCT APR_MRN, CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME, APR_START_DTE, APR_END_DTE, OOC_ITEM_NAME, OOC_ITEM_DESC, OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE, OSTS_STS_DESC FROM OXA JOIN IDB.OMS_ORDER ON APR_MRN = OO_MRN JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_CATALOG ON OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID = OOC_MSTR_ITEM_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_STATUS ON OO_ORD_STS_CD = OSTS_ORD_STS_CD WHERE LOWER(OOC_ITEM_NAME) LIKE ('%tryptase%') AND OO_ORD_STS_CD NOT IN ('CANP', 'CANC', 'AUC3')

prompt: Provide a list of patients HSV positive by the viral culture at MSKCC January 2010 and December 2020.
completion: SELECT LR_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_SEX, YEAR(CURRENT date - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) AGE, LR_PERFORMED_DTE, LR_TEST_NAME, LR_SUBTEST_NAME, LR_ABNORMALITY_CD, LTL_TEXT_RESULT FROM IDB.LAB_RESULTS LEFT JOIN IDB.LAB_TEXT_LINE ON LR_RESULT_GUID = LTL_RESULT_GUID AND LTL_LINE_NO = 1 JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON LR_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE LR_PERFORMED_DTE BETWEEN '2010-01-01' AND '2020-07-01' AND LR_TEST_NAME IN ('HSV 1/2 Qual PCR (Lower Resp)', 'HSV 1/2, VZV Qual PCR (Dermal)') AND LR_ABNORMALITY_CD <> 'U' WITH UR

prompt: Requesting all rectal MRIs that contain the word "polypectomy" in the report text
completion: WITH RADIOLOGY_0 AS (SELECT "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AS PT_DEID, "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_MRN" AS PT_MRN, CAST(TRIM("DV"."RADIOLOGY_REPORT_V"."RRPT_RPT_ID") AS VARCHAR) || CAST(TRIM("DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_MRN") AS VARCHAR) AS SUBJECT_ID, "DV"."RADIOLOGY_REPORT_V"."RRPT_ORDER_GROUP" AS RRPT_ORDER_GROUP, CAST("DV"."RADIOLOGY_REPORT_V"."RRPT_REPORT_TXT" AS VARCHAR(32500)) AS RRPT_REPORT_TXT FROM "DV"."RADIOLOGY_REPORT_V" JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS" ON "DV"."RADIOLOGY_REPORT_V"."RRPT_MRN" = "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_MRN" WHERE "DV"."RADIOLOGY_REPORT_V"."RRPT_ORDER_GROUP" IN ('MR', 'Submitted Films') AND SYSIBM.REGEXP_LIKE("DV"."RADIOLOGY_REPORT_V"."RRPT_REPORT_TXT", 'Polypectomy', 'i')), DIAGNOSIS_1 AS (SELECT "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AS PT_DEID, BASE_QUERY.PT_MRN AS PT_MRN, CAST(TRIM(BASE_QUERY.PT_MRN) AS VARCHAR) || CAST(TRIM(BASE_QUERY.DIAGNOSIS_DATE) AS VARCHAR) || CAST(TRIM(BASE_QUERY.ICD_CODES_ICD_CODE) AS VARCHAR) AS SUBJECT_ID, BASE_QUERY.DIAGNOSIS_DATE AS DIAGNOSIS_DATE, TRIM(BASE_QUERY.ICD_CODES_ICD_CODE) || '-' || TRIM("IDB"."CLM"."CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK") AS ICD_CODES_ICD_CODE_DESC FROM (SELECT "IDB"."CTC_CLSF"."CC_MRN" AS PT_MRN, "IDB"."CTC_CLSF"."CC_CLSF_CD" AS ICD_CODES_ICD_CODE, MIN("IDB"."CTC_CLSF"."CC_EFF_DTE") AS DIAGNOSIS_DATE FROM "IDB"."CTC_CLSF" WHERE "IDB"."CTC_CLSF"."CC_CLSF_TYPE" LIKE 'DF%' AND ("IDB"."CTC_CLSF"."CC_PT_TYPE" = 'I' OR ("IDB"."CTC_CLSF"."CC_PT_TYPE" = 'O' AND "IDB"."CTC_CLSF"."CC_FINALIZED_IND" = 'Y')) GROUP BY "IDB"."CTC_CLSF"."CC_MRN", "IDB"."CTC_CLSF"."CC_CLSF_CD") AS BASE_QUERY JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS" ON BASE_QUERY.PT_MRN = "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_MRN" JOIN "IDB"."CLM" ON BASE_QUERY.ICD_CODES_ICD_CODE = "IDB"."CLM"."CLM_CLSF_CD" WHERE BASE_QUERY.DIAGNOSIS_DATE BETWEEN '1990-01-01' AND '2023-05-01' AND BASE_QUERY.ICD_CODES_ICD_CODE IN ('154.1', '154.8', 'C20')), COHORT AS (SELECT PT_DEID AS PT_DEID FROM (SELECT RADIOLOGY_0.PT_DEID AS PT_DEID FROM RADIOLOGY_0 INTERSECT SELECT DIAGNOSIS_1.PT_DEID AS PT_DEID FROM DIAGNOSIS_1)), COHORT_RADIOLOGY AS (SELECT SUBJECT_ID AS SUBJECT_ID, PT_DEID AS PT_DEID FROM (SELECT RADIOLOGY_0.SUBJECT_ID AS SUBJECT_ID, RADIOLOGY_0.PT_DEID AS PT_DEID FROM RADIOLOGY_0)), COHORT_DIAGNOSIS AS (SELECT SUBJECT_ID AS SUBJECT_ID, PT_DEID AS PT_DEID FROM (SELECT DIAGNOSIS_1.SUBJECT_ID AS SUBJECT_ID, DIAGNOSIS_1.PT_DEID AS PT_DEID FROM DIAGNOSIS_1)), KEYS AS (SELECT COHORT.PT_DEID AS COHORT_PT_DEID, COHORT_RADIOLOGY.SUBJECT_ID AS COHORT_RADIOLOGY_SUBJECT_ID, COHORT_RADIOLOGY.PT_DEID AS COHORT_RADIOLOGY_PT_DEID, COHORT_DIAGNOSIS.SUBJECT_ID AS COHORT_DIAGNOSIS_SUBJECT_ID, COHORT_DIAGNOSIS.PT_DEID AS COHORT_DIAGNOSIS_PT_DEID FROM COHORT LEFT OUTER JOIN COHORT_RADIOLOGY ON COHORT_RADIOLOGY.PT_DEID = COHORT.PT_DEID LEFT OUTER JOIN COHORT_DIAGNOSIS ON COHORT_DIAGNOSIS.PT_DEID = COHORT.PT_DEID), DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS AS (SELECT DISTINCT "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AS PT_DEID, IDB_PATIENT."PT_MRN" AS PT_MRN, "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AS SUBJECT_ID, TRIM(IDB_PATIENT."PT_LAST_NAME") || ', ' || TRIM(IDB_PATIENT."PT_FIRST_NAME") AS PT_NAME FROM "IDB"."PATIENT" AS IDB_PATIENT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS" ON IDB_PATIENT."PT_MRN" = "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_MRN") SELECT DISTINCT DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS.PT_MRN AS MRN, DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS.PT_NAME AS PT_NAME FROM KEYS LEFT OUTER JOIN DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS ON DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS.PT_DEID = KEYS.COHORT_PT_DEID; WITH RADIOLOGY_0 AS (SELECT "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AS PT_DEID, "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_MRN" AS PT_MRN, CAST(TRIM("DV"."RADIOLOGY_REPORT_V"."RRPT_RPT_ID") AS VARCHAR) || CAST(TRIM("DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_MRN") AS VARCHAR) AS SUBJECT_ID, "DV"."RADIOLOGY_REPORT_V"."RRPT_ORDER_GROUP" AS RRPT_ORDER_GROUP, CAST("DV"."RADIOLOGY_REPORT_V"."RRPT_REPORT_TXT" AS VARCHAR(32500)) AS RRPT_REPORT_TXT FROM "DV"."RADIOLOGY_REPORT_V" JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS" ON "DV"."RADIOLOGY_REPORT_V"."RRPT_MRN" = "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_MRN" WHERE "DV"."RADIOLOGY_REPORT_V"."RRPT_ORDER_GROUP" IN ('MR', 'Submitted Films') AND SYSIBM.REGEXP_LIKE("DV"."RADIOLOGY_REPORT_V"."RRPT_REPORT_TXT", 'Polypectomy', 'i')), DIAGNOSIS_1 AS (SELECT "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AS PT_DEID, BASE_QUERY.PT_MRN AS PT_MRN, CAST(TRIM(BASE_QUERY.PT_MRN) AS VARCHAR) || CAST(TRIM(BASE_QUERY.DIAGNOSIS_DATE) AS VARCHAR) || CAST(TRIM(BASE_QUERY.ICD_CODES_ICD_CODE) AS VARCHAR) AS SUBJECT_ID, BASE_QUERY.DIAGNOSIS_DATE AS DIAGNOSIS_DATE, TRIM(BASE_QUERY.ICD_CODES_ICD_CODE) || '-' || TRIM("IDB"."CLM"."CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK") AS ICD_CODES_ICD_CODE_DESC FROM (SELECT "IDB"."CTC_CLSF"."CC_MRN" AS PT_MRN, "IDB"."CTC_CLSF"."CC_CLSF_CD" AS ICD_CODES_ICD_CODE, MIN("IDB"."CTC_CLSF"."CC_EFF_DTE") AS DIAGNOSIS_DATE FROM "IDB"."CTC_CLSF" WHERE "IDB"."CTC_CLSF"."CC_CLSF_TYPE" LIKE 'DF%' AND ("IDB"."CTC_CLSF"."CC_PT_TYPE" = 'I' OR ("IDB"."CTC_CLSF"."CC_PT_TYPE" = 'O' AND "IDB"."CTC_CLSF"."CC_FINALIZED_IND" = 'Y')) GROUP BY "IDB"."CTC_CLSF"."CC_MRN", "IDB"."CTC_CLSF"."CC_CLSF_CD") AS BASE_QUERY JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS" ON BASE_QUERY.PT_MRN = "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_MRN" JOIN "IDB"."CLM" ON BASE_QUERY.ICD_CODES_ICD_CODE = "IDB"."CLM"."CLM_CLSF_CD" WHERE BASE_QUERY.DIAGNOSIS_DATE BETWEEN '1990-01-01' AND '2023-05-01' AND BASE_QUERY.ICD_CODES_ICD_CODE IN ('154.1', '154.8', 'C20')), COHORT AS (SELECT PT_DEID AS PT_DEID FROM (SELECT RADIOLOGY_0.PT_DEID AS PT_DEID FROM RADIOLOGY_0 INTERSECT SELECT DIAGNOSIS_1.PT_DEID AS PT_DEID FROM DIAGNOSIS_1)), COHORT_RADIOLOGY AS (SELECT SUBJECT_ID AS SUBJECT_ID, PT_DEID AS PT_DEID FROM (SELECT RADIOLOGY_0.SUBJECT_ID AS SUBJECT_ID, RADIOLOGY_0.PT_DEID AS PT_DEID FROM RADIOLOGY_0)), COHORT_DIAGNOSIS AS (SELECT SUBJECT_ID AS SUBJECT_ID, PT_DEID AS PT_DEID FROM (SELECT DIAGNOSIS_1.SUBJECT_ID AS SUBJECT_ID, DIAGNOSIS_1.PT_DEID AS PT_DEID FROM DIAGNOSIS_1)), KEYS AS (SELECT COHORT.PT_DEID AS COHORT_PT_DEID, COHORT_RADIOLOGY.SUBJECT_ID AS COHORT_RADIOLOGY_SUBJECT_ID, COHORT_RADIOLOGY.PT_DEID AS COHORT_RADIOLOGY_PT_DEID, COHORT_DIAGNOSIS.SUBJECT_ID AS COHORT_DIAGNOSIS_SUBJECT_ID, COHORT_DIAGNOSIS.PT_DEID AS COHORT_DIAGNOSIS_PT_DEID FROM COHORT LEFT OUTER JOIN COHORT_RADIOLOGY ON COHORT_RADIOLOGY.PT_DEID = COHORT.PT_DEID LEFT OUTER JOIN COHORT_DIAGNOSIS ON COHORT_DIAGNOSIS.PT_DEID = COHORT.PT_DEID), RADIOLOGY_COLUMNS AS (SELECT DISTINCT "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AS PT_DEID, "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_MRN" AS PT_MRN, CAST(TRIM("DV"."RADIOLOGY_REPORT_V"."RRPT_RPT_ID") AS VARCHAR) || CAST(TRIM("DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_MRN") AS VARCHAR) AS SUBJECT_ID, "DV"."RADIOLOGY_REPORT_V"."RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE" AS RRPT_PERFORMED_DATE, "DV"."RADIOLOGY_REPORT_V"."RRPT_ORDER_GROUP" AS RRPT_ORDER_GROUP, "DV"."RADIOLOGY_REPORT_V"."RRPT_PROCEDURE_NAME" AS RRPT_PROC_NAME, CAST("DV"."RADIOLOGY_REPORT_V"."RRPT_REPORT_TXT" AS VARCHAR(32500)) AS RRPT_REPORT_TXT, "DV"."RADIOLOGY_REPORT_V"."RRPT_ACCESSION_NO" AS RRPT_ACCESSION_NO FROM "DV"."RADIOLOGY_REPORT_V" JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS" ON "DV"."RADIOLOGY_REPORT_V"."RRPT_MRN" = "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_MRN"), DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS AS (SELECT DISTINCT "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AS PT_DEID, IDB_PATIENT."PT_MRN" AS PT_MRN, "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AS SUBJECT_ID FROM "IDB"."PATIENT" AS IDB_PATIENT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS" ON IDB_PATIENT."PT_MRN" = "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_MRN") SELECT DISTINCT DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS.PT_MRN AS MRN, RADIOLOGY_COLUMNS.RRPT_PERFORMED_DATE AS RRPT_PERFORMED_DATE, RADIOLOGY_COLUMNS.RRPT_ORDER_GROUP AS RRPT_ORDER_GROUP, RADIOLOGY_COLUMNS.RRPT_PROC_NAME AS RRPT_PROC_NAME, RADIOLOGY_COLUMNS.RRPT_REPORT_TXT AS RRPT_REPORT_TXT, RADIOLOGY_COLUMNS.RRPT_ACCESSION_NO AS RRPT_ACCESSION_NO FROM KEYS LEFT OUTER JOIN RADIOLOGY_COLUMNS ON RADIOLOGY_COLUMNS.SUBJECT_ID = KEYS.COHORT_RADIOLOGY_SUBJECT_ID LEFT OUTER JOIN DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS ON DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS.PT_DEID = KEYS.COHORT_PT_DEID;

prompt: Obtain spreadsheet on all CEM performed at MSKCC with BI-RADS 0,3,4 or 5 assessment, MRN, accession, date of study, pathology result
completion: SELECT CEM.RRPT_MRN CEM_MRN , CEM.RRPT_ACCESSION_NO CEM_ACCESSION_NO , CEM.RRPT_RPT_ID CEM_RPT_ID , CEM.RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE CEM_PERFORMED_DTE , CEM.RRPT_REPORT_DTE CEM_REPORT_DTE , CEM.RRPT_ORDER_GROUP CEM_ORDER_GROUP , CEM.RRPT_PROCEDURE_NAME CEM_PROCEDURE_NAME , CEM.RRPT_REPORT_TXT CEM_REPORT_TXT , REGEXP_EXTRACT(CEM.RRPT_REPORT_TXT, '((BI-RADS|BI RADS|BIRADS|BI-RADS:|BI RADS:|BIRADS:)( | ){0,1}(0|1|one|One|2|3|4|5).*\.)|((BI-RADS|BI RADS|BIRADS|BI-RADS:|BI RADS:|BIRADS:)( | ){0,1}(0|1|one|One|2|3|4|5).*)') AS CEM_BI_RADS , CASE WHEN (CEM.RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE = BMR.RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE OR (60 >= BMR.RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE - CEM.RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE)) THEN 'YES' ELSE 'NO' END BMR_WITHIN_2M , BMR.RRPT_ACCESSION_NO BMR_ACCESSION_NO , BMR.RRPT_RPT_ID BMR_RPT_ID , BMR.RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE BMR_PERFORMED_DTE , BMR.RRPT_REPORT_DTE BMR_REPORT_DTE , BMR.RRPT_ORDER_GROUP BMR_ORDER_GROUP , BMR.RRPT_PROCEDURE_NAME BMR_PROCEDURE_NAME , BMR.RRPT_REPORT_TXT BMR_REPORT_TXT , REGEXP_EXTRACT(BMR.RRPT_REPORT_TXT, '((BI-RADS|BI RADS|BIRADS|BI-RADS:|BI RADS:|BIRADS:)( | ){0,1}(0|1|one|One|2|3|4|5).*\.)|((BI-RADS|BI RADS|BIRADS|BI-RADS:|BI RADS:|BIRADS:)( | ){0,1}(0|1|one|One|2|3|4|5).*)') AS BMR_BI_RADS , TM_DX_DTE DX_DTE , CASE WHEN TM_DX_DTE > CEM.RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE THEN 'YES' ELSE 'NO' END DX_AFTER_CEM , TM_HIST_CD DX_CD , H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS DX_HIST_DESC , TM_SITE_CD DX_SITE_CD , S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS DX_SITE_DESC FROM DV.RADIOLOGY_REPORT_V CEM LEFT JOIN DV.RADIOLOGY_REPORT_V BMR ON CEM.RRPT_MRN = BMR.RRPT_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.CDB_TUMOR ON CEM.RRPT_MRN = TM_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD LEFT JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS ON AV_ELEMENT = 'CASE_STS' AND AV_CODE = TM_CASE_STS WHERE 1 = 1 AND (UPPER(CEM.RRPT_PROCEDURE_NAME) LIKE '%MAMMO%' OR UPPER(CEM.RRPT_PROCEDURE_NAME) LIKE 'CESM%' OR CONTAINS(CEM."RRPT_REPORT_TXT", '("mammo")') > 0) AND CONTAINS(CEM."RRPT_REPORT_TXT", '("contrast enhanced" OR "contrast-enhanced")') > 0 AND (UPPER(BMR.RRPT_ORDER_GROUP) LIKE 'MR%' OR BMR.RRPT_ORDER_GROUP LIKE ' %') AND (UPPER(BMR.RRPT_PROCEDURE_NAME) LIKE '%BRST%' OR UPPER(BMR.RRPT_PROCEDURE_NAME) LIKE '%BREAST%' OR BMR.RRPT_PROCEDURE_NAME LIKE ' %')

prompt: Design a report on the annual number of visits to the CTC service and the number of DLBCL patients with visits to the CTC and LYM service.
completion: WITH CTC AS (SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN AS MRN, CPE_PRK, CPE_ENC_CSN_ID, CPE_ENC_DTE, CRE_RES_NAME, CRE_RES_TYP, CLD_DEPT_NAME, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8, CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME, CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR, CASE WHEN CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR LIKE '%NV%' OR CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR LIKE '%IR%' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS "NV" FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CRE_RES_TYP IN ('Physician', 'Nurse Practitioner') AND(CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR LIKE '%NV%' OR CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR LIKE '%IR%') AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN '2017-01-01' AND CURRENT DATE AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 = 'CTC' ) SELECT YEAR(CPE_ENC_DTE) AS YY, MONTH(CPE_ENC_DTE) AS MM, COUNT(DISTINCT CPE_ENC_CSN_ID) AS TOTAL_VISIT_COUNT, COUNT(DISTINCT MRN) AS UNIQUE_PTS FROM CTC GROUP BY YEAR(CPE_ENC_DTE), MONTH(CPE_ENC_DTE) WITH DLBCL AS (SELECT DISTINCT TM_MRN AS MRN, TM_DX_DTE AS DX_DATE, TM_HIST_CD AS DX_CODE, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS DX_DESC FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.SEERGROUPING ON RECODE = IDB.SEERF_ICDO(TM_SITE_CD, TM_HIST_CD) AND CATEGORY1 = 'Lymphoma' JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD WHERE 1=1 AND TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND TM_HIST_CD IN ('M9679/3', 'M9680/3', 'M9681/3', 'M9688/3', 'M9714/3', 'M9738/3') UNION SELECT CC_MRN AS MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS DX_DATE, CLM_CLSF_CD AS DX_CODE, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS DX_DESC FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND ((CC_PT_TYPE = 'I') OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) AND CC_CLSF_CD IN ('C83.30', 'C83.31', 'C83.32', 'C83.33', 'C83.34', 'C83.35', 'C83.36', 'C83.37', 'C83.38', 'C83.39') GROUP BY CC_MRN, CLM_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK ) , X AS (SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN AS MRN, CPE_PRK, CPE_ENC_CSN_ID, CPE_ENC_DTE, CRE_RES_NAME, CRE_RES_TYP, CLD_DEPT_NAME, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8, CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME FROM DLBCL JOIN IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER ON CPE_MRN = MRN JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CRE_RES_TYP IN ('Physician', 'Nurse Practitioner') AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN '2017-01-01' AND CURRENT DATE AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 = 'CTC' ) SELECT YEAR(CPE_ENC_DTE) AS YY, MONTH(CPE_ENC_DTE) AS MM, COUNT(DISTINCT CPE_ENC_CSN_ID) AS TOTAL_VISIT_COUNT, COUNT(DISTINCT MRN) AS UNIQUE_PTS FROM X GROUP BY YEAR(CPE_ENC_DTE), MONTH(CPE_ENC_DTE)

prompt: Identify patients who had an Elecromyography (EMG) test from the provided list of Taxol treated patients.
completion: SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PBD_SVC_DTE FROM IDB.PATIENT P INNER JOIN IDB.PBD_DETAIL PD ON PD.PBD_MRN = P.PT_MRN INNER JOIN IDB.PBD_CODE PC ON PC.PBC_PBD_CD = PD.PBD_PBD_CD WHERE PBD_SVC_DTE BETWEEN '2006-01-01' AND '2008-11-25' AND IDB.PBD_CODE.PBC_CPT_CD IN ('95900', '95903', '95904') ORDER BY PT_LAST_NAME;

prompt: Provide a one time list of all patients who recieved their first dose of pembroluzimab in the previous 12 months
completion: WITH CTE1 AS (SELECT APR_MRN, MIN(APR_START_DTE) AS MIN_START_DATE, CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME FROM IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX_V WHERE UPPER(CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME)= 'PEMBROLIZUMAB' GROUP BY APR_MRN, CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME HAVING MIN(APR_START_DTE) BETWEEN CURRENT DATE - 12 MONTH AND CURRENT DATE) , CTE2 AS (SELECT DISTINCT A.APR_MRN AS MRN, A.CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME AS "Drug Name", A.MIN_START_DATE AS "Drug Min Start Date", B.APR_DIAGNOSIS_DESC FROM CTE1 A JOIN IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX_V B ON A.APR_MRN=B.APR_MRN AND A.CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME=B.CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME AND B.APR_START_DTE=A.MIN_START_DATE) SELECT * FROM CTE2 ORDER BY 3, 1

prompt: Can I please request a report with MSK engage data from 2018- present for protocol 15-022, then I would like to have this report monthly
completion: WITH CHRT AS (SELECT PRO_IRB_NO, AC_MRN FROM IDB.PROTOCOL JOIN IDB.ACCRUALS ON PRO_IRB_NO = AC_IRB_NO WHERE PRO_IRB_NO = '15-022' AND AC_MRN <> 'ZZZZZZZZ' ), ENG AS (SELECT EF_SUBMISSION_DT, EF_FORM_ID, EF_MRN, EF_FORM_NAME, EFI_ITEM_TEXT, EFI_ITEM_ALIAS, EFI_VALUE FROM IDB.EF_FORM LEFT JOIN IDB.EF_FORM_ITEM ON EF_FORM_ID = EFI_FORM_ID WHERE EF_SUBMISSION_DT BETWEEN CURRENT DATE - 1 MONTH AND CURRENT DATE ) SELECT DISTINCT AC_MRN AS MRN, EF_SUBMISSION_DT AS "FORM SUBMISSION DATE", EF_FORM_ID "FORM ID", EF_FORM_NAME "FORM NAME", EFI_ITEM_TEXT "ITEM TEXT", EFI_ITEM_ALIAS "ITEM ALIAS", EFI_VALUE "VALUE" FROM CHRT JOIN ENG ON AC_MRN = EF_MRN ORDER BY AC_MRN, EF_SUBMISSION_DT, EF_FORM_ID, EF_FORM_NAME, EFI_ITEM_TEXT

prompt: Provide Darwin cohort notifications for patients eligible for 22-426, lung cancer patients with KRAS G12C mutations
completion: WITH PTS AS (SELECT PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID PID FROM DV.PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED) , DT_1 AS (SELECT PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID AS P_ID FROM DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS REC LEFT JOIN DV.PATIENT_CORE_DEMOGRAPHICS ON PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = CORE_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID WHERE 1=1 AND PT_VITAL_STATUS IN ('ALIVE') ) , DT_2 AS (SELECT INC.PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID P_ID FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_STRUCTURED_RESULTS_V INC JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML DT ON INC.PRPT_PATH_RPT_ID = DT.PDRX_PATH_RPT_ID CROSS JOIN XMLTABLE('$c/root/meta-data' PASSING DT.PDRX_XML_VALUE AS "c" COLUMNS PRIMARY_SITE VARCHAR(264) PATH 'primary_site', TUMOR_TYPE_NAME VARCHAR(264) PATH 'tumor_type_name' , TUMOR_TYPE_CODE VARCHAR(264) PATH 'tumor_type_code', IS_METASTASIS VARCHAR(3) PATH 'is_metastasis' , METASTASIS_SITE VARCHAR(264) PATH 'metastasis_site' , MSI_COMMENT VARCHAR(264) PATH 'msi-comment' , MSI_SCORE VARCHAR(264) PATH 'msi-score' , MSI_TYPE VARCHAR(264) PATH 'msi-type' , TMB_SCORE VARCHAR(25) PATH 'tmb_score' , TMB_COUNT VARCHAR(25) PATH 'tmb-count', COSMIC_ID VARCHAR(5000) PATH 'cosmic_id') T JOIN (SELECT T.TUMOR_TYPE_CODE TTC FROM TABLE(DV.STRING_SPLIT('LUNG', ',')) S CROSS JOIN TABLE(DV.ONCOTREE_CHILDREN(COLUMN_VALUES)) T) X ON T.TUMOR_TYPE_CODE = TRIM(X.TTC) WHERE 1=1 AND (INC.GENE IN ('KRAS') OR INC.GENE2 IN ('KRAS')) AND INC.AA_CHANGE = 'G12C' ) , DT_3_1 AS (SELECT PRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID P_ID, PRPT_ACCESSION_NO FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V WHERE PRPT_REPORT IS NOT NULL AND CONTAINS("PRPT_REPORT", '("Idylla")') = 1 ) , DT_3 AS (SELECT V.PRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID P_ID, V.PRPT_ACCESSION_NO, V.PRPT_REPORT FROM DT_3_1 X JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V V ON X.PRPT_ACCESSION_NO = V.PRPT_ACCESSION_NO WHERE (CONTAINS("PRPT_REPORT", '("KRAS G12C")') = 1 OR CONTAINS("PRPT_REPORT", '("KRAS Exon 2 p.G12C")') = 1) ) , DEID AS (SELECT DISTINCT P_ID FROM (SELECT P_ID FROM DT_1 INTERSECT (SELECT P_ID FROM DT_2 UNION SELECT P_ID FROM DT_3 )))

prompt: Provide a Darwin cohort of patients for the given criteria along with access to the patients in the Darwin Digital Platform.
completion: WITH PTS AS (SELECT PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID PID FROM DV.PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED) , DT_1 AS (SELECT PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID AS P_ID FROM DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS REC LEFT JOIN DV.PATIENT_CORE_DEMOGRAPHICS ON PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = CORE_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID WHERE 1=1 ) , DT_2 AS (SELECT PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID AS P_ID FROM DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS REC LEFT JOIN DV.PATIENT_CORE_DEMOGRAPHICS ON PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = CORE_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID WHERE 1=1 AND PT_VITAL_STATUS IN ('ALIVE') ) , DT_3 AS (SELECT INC.PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID P_ID FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_STRUCTURED_RESULTS_V INC JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML DT ON INC.PRPT_PATH_RPT_ID = DT.PDRX_PATH_RPT_ID CROSS JOIN XMLTABLE('$c/root/meta-data' PASSING DT.PDRX_XML_VALUE AS "c" COLUMNS PRIMARY_SITE VARCHAR(264) PATH 'primary_site', TUMOR_TYPE_NAME VARCHAR(264) PATH 'tumor_type_name' , TUMOR_TYPE_CODE VARCHAR(264) PATH 'tumor_type_code', IS_METASTASIS VARCHAR(3) PATH 'is_metastasis' , METASTASIS_SITE VARCHAR(264) PATH 'metastasis_site' , MSI_COMMENT VARCHAR(264) PATH 'msi-comment' , MSI_SCORE VARCHAR(264) PATH 'msi-score' , MSI_TYPE VARCHAR(264) PATH 'msi-type' , TMB_SCORE VARCHAR(25) PATH 'tmb_score' , TMB_COUNT VARCHAR(25) PATH 'tmb-count', COSMIC_ID VARCHAR(5000) PATH 'cosmic_id') T JOIN (SELECT T.TUMOR_TYPE_CODE TTC FROM TABLE(DV.STRING_SPLIT('HCC,PDAC,BTC,ESCC,TNBC,HNSCC ', ',')) S CROSS JOIN TABLE(DV.ONCOTREE_CHILDREN(COLUMN_VALUES)) T) X ON T.TUMOR_TYPE_CODE = TRIM(X.TTC) WHERE 1=1 AND (INC.GENE IN ('MET') OR INC.GENE2 IN ('MET')) AND CASE WHEN LOCATE('heme', LOWER(INC.METHOD)) > 0 OR LOCATE('liquid', LOWER(INC.METHOD)) > 0 OR LOCATE('RDTB', INC.METHOD) >0 THEN 'liquid' ELSE 'solid' END IN ('solid') AND (INC.ABERRATIONTYPE IN ('amplification', 'copy number gain') OR CASE WHEN 'fusion' IN ('amplification', 'copy number gain') AND (UPPER(SEARCH_HIT2) like '%FUSION%' OR UPPER(SEARCH_HIT2) like '%TRANSLOCATION%' OR UPPER(SEARCH_HIT2) like '%REARRAN%' OR UPPER(SEARCH_HIT2) like '%INVERSION%') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END = 1) ) , DEID AS (SELECT DISTINCT P_ID FROM (SELECT P_ID FROM DT_1 INTERSECT SELECT P_ID FROM DT_2 INTERSECT SELECT P_ID FROM DT_3 ))

prompt: Understand outcomes of kidney cancer patients with infectious complications.
completion: WITH DX AS (SELECT CC_MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS DX_DTE FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE SUBSTR(CC_CLSF_CD, 1, 3) IN ('189', 'C64') AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND (CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) GROUP BY CC_MRN HAVING MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) BETWEEN '2000-01-01' AND '2018-09-23') , CHEMO AS (SELECT APR_MRN, DX_DTE, CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME, MIN(APR_START_DTE) FIRST_START, MAX(APR_START_DTE) LAST_START FROM IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX JOIN IDB.CHEMO_DRUG_GENERIC ON APR_GENERIC_NAME = CDG_GENERIC_NAME JOIN DX ON APR_MRN = CC_MRN WHERE APR_START_DTE BETWEEN '2000-01-01' AND '2018-09-23' AND CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME IN ('IPILIMUMAB', 'NIVOLUMAB', 'PEMBROLIZUMAB', 'ATEZOLIZUMAB', 'AVELUMAB', 'DURVALUMAB', 'TREMELIMUMAB') GROUP BY APR_MRN, DX_DTE, CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME) , COVID AS (SELECT DISTINCT MRN, DATE(MIN_IDENTIFIED_DT) MIN_IDENTIFIED_DT FROM IDB.PATIENT_COVID_INFO_V JOIN CHEMO ON MRN = APR_MRN WHERE RESULT = 'Positive' ) SELECT DISTINCT APR_MRN "MRN", PT_LAST_NAME "Last Name", PT_FIRST_NAME "First Name", PT_SEX "Gender", PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH "Date of Birth", PT_PT_ETHNICITY_DESC "Ethnicity", DX_DTE "Diagnosis Date", CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME "Chemo", FIRST_START "First Start Date", LAST_START "Last Start Date", CASE WHEN MRN IS NOT NULL THEN 'Y' ELSE '' END AS "COVID+ Flag", MIN_IDENTIFIED_DT "COVID Identified Date" FROM CHEMO JOIN IDB.PATIENT_V ON APR_MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN COVID ON APR_MRN = MRN ORDER BY APR_MRN, FIRST_START

prompt: Provide a bi-weekly report of results for the Home Blood Pressure Monitoring Survey.
completion: WITH SURVEY AS (SELECT DISTINCT PT.EPI_MRN AS MRN , TRIM(EPI_LAST_NAME) || ', ' || TRIM(EPI_FIRST_NAME) AS PATIENT_NAME , 'Quality of Life Symptom Survey' AS SURVEY_NAME , ASS.EA_SUBM_DT AS SUBMISSION_DATE , DATE(ASS.EA_ASSIGN_DT) AS ASSIGNMENT_DATE , EQ_SHORT_NAME AS QUESTION , Q.EQ_ALIAS AS QUESTION_ALIAS , A.EA_SHORT_NAME AS ANSWER , A.EA_ALIAS AS ANSWER_ALIAS , TR.ETBR_TEXT AS TEXTBLOCKRESPONSE , NR.ENR_NO AS NUMBERRESPONSE FROM IDB.EF_ASSESSMENT AS ASS JOIN IDB.EF_ASSESSMENT_DTL AS AD ON AD.EAD_ASSESS_DTL_ID = ASS.EA_ASSESS_DTL_ID JOIN IDB.EF_PATIENT_INFO PT ON ASS.EA_PT_INFO_ID = PT.EPI_PT_INFO_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.EF_RESPONSE R ON R.ERESP_ASSESS_ID = ASS.EA_ASSESS_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.EF_ANSWER A ON A.EA_ANSWER_ID = R.ERESP_ANSWER_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.EF_QUESTION Q ON Q.EQ_QUESTION_ID = A.EA_QUESTION_ID JOIN IDB.EF_SURVEY_ELEMENT SE ON A.EA_QUESTION_ID = SE.ESE_IDENTITY_ID LEFT OUTER JOIN IDB.EF_TEXT_BOX_RESPONSE TR ON TR.ETBR_ID =R.ERESP_ID LEFT OUTER JOIN IDB.EF_NUMERIC_RESPONSE NR ON NR.ENR_ID =R.ERESP_ID WHERE ASS.EA_SURV_ID ='106' AND ASS.EA_STS_ID = 3 AND DATE(ASS.EA_SUBM_DT) BETWEEN CURRENT DATE - 16 DAYS AND CURRENT DATE AND EPI_MRN IN ('38141148', '35282509', '38086130', '38083843', '35423469', '38118166', '35503074', '38058728', '38194399', '38202587', '38205488', '38206105', '38085198', '38205986', '35570873', '35565667', '38215797', '38204149', '38085198', '38218445') ) , ACR AS (SELECT AC_MRN, AC_CONS_DTE, AC_IRB_NO FROM IDB.ACCRUALS JOIN SURVEY ON AC_MRN = MRN AND AC_IRB_NO = '21-135') SELECT S.MRN, PATIENT_NAME, ASSIGNMENT_DATE, SUBMISSION_DATE, MAX(CASE WHEN QUESTION_ALIAS = 'constipatedq' THEN ANSWER END) AS "?onstipation", MAX(CASE WHEN QUESTION_ALIAS = 'deprq' THEN ANSWER END) AS "Depression", MAX(CASE WHEN QUESTION_ALIAS = 'diarrheaq' THEN ANSWER END) AS "Diarrhea", MAX(CASE WHEN QUESTION_ALIAS = 'diffcltconcntrq' THEN ANSWER END) AS "Difficulty in concentrating", MAX(CASE WHEN QUESTION_ALIAS = 'diffremq' THEN ANSWER END) AS "Difficulty with remembering", MAX(CASE WHEN QUESTION_ALIAS = 'finq' THEN ANSWER END) AS "Financial difficulties", MAX(CASE WHEN QUESTION_ALIAS = 'painintq' THEN ANSWER END) AS "Interference of pain with daily activities", MAX(CASE WHEN QUESTION_ALIAS = 'interf_famlfq' THEN ANSWER END) AS "Interference with family life", MAX(CASE WHEN QUESTION_ALIAS = 'interf_socactq' THEN ANSWER END) AS "Interference with social activities", MAX(CASE WHEN QUESTION_ALIAS = 'irritq' THEN ANSWER END) AS "Irritation", MAX(CASE WHEN QUESTION_ALIAS = 'lckdappq' THEN ANSWER END) AS "Lack of appetite", MAX(CASE WHEN QUESTION_ALIAS = 'lmtdindwq' THEN ANSWER END) AS "Limitation in doing work", MAX(CASE WHEN QUESTION_ALIAS = 'lmtdinphq' THEN ANSWER END) AS "Limitation in pursuing hobbies", MAX(CASE WHEN QUESTION_ALIAS = 'fltnstdq' THEN ANSWER END) AS "Nausea", MAX(CASE WHEN QUESTION_ALIAS = 'needrestq' THEN ANSWER END) AS "Need for rest", MAX(CASE WHEN QUESTION_ALIAS = 'needhelpq' THEN ANSWER END) AS "Need help with eating, dressing, washing or using the toilet", MAX(CASE WHEN QUESTION_ALIAS = 'staybedq' THEN ANSWER END) AS "Need to stay in bed or chair", MAX(CASE WHEN QUESTION_ALIAS = 'healthlvlq' THEN ANSWER END) AS "Overall health rate (during the past week)", MAX(CASE WHEN QUESTION_ALIAS = 'qltlfq' THEN ANSWER END) AS "Overall quality of life (during the past week)", MAX(CASE WHEN QUESTION_ALIAS = 'hadpainq' THEN ANSWER END) AS "Pain", MAX(CASE WHEN QUESTION_ALIAS = 'shortbq' THEN ANSWER END) AS "Shortness of breath", MAX(CASE WHEN QUESTION_ALIAS = 'strenuousq' THEN ANSWER END) AS "Strenuous activities", MAX(CASE WHEN QUESTION_ALIAS = 'feeltnsq' THEN ANSWER END) AS "Tenseness", MAX(CASE WHEN QUESTION_ALIAS = 'tired1q' THEN ANSWER END) AS "Tiredness", MAX(CASE WHEN QUESTION_ALIAS = 'longwalkq' THEN ANSWER END) AS "Trouble taking a long walk", MAX(CASE WHEN QUESTION_ALIAS = 'shortwalkq' THEN ANSWER END) AS "Trouble taking a short walk", MAX(CASE WHEN QUESTION_ALIAS = 'trblslq' THEN ANSWER END) AS "Troubles with sleeping", MAX(CASE WHEN QUESTION_ALIAS = 'vomitedq' THEN ANSWER END) AS "Vomiting", MAX(CASE WHEN QUESTION_ALIAS = 'fltwkq' THEN ANSWER END) AS "Weakness", MAX(CASE WHEN QUESTION_ALIAS = 'worryq' THEN ANSWER END) AS "Worry", MAX(CASE WHEN QUESTION_ALIAS = 'healthq' THEN ANSWER END) AS "healthq", MAX(CASE WHEN QUESTION_ALIAS = 'acknowledgement' THEN ANSWER END) AS "acknowledgement", MAX(CASE WHEN QUESTION_ALIAS = 'qualityq' THEN ANSWER END) AS "qualityq" FROM SURVEY S LEFT JOIN ACR ON AC_MRN = S.MRN GROUP BY S.MRN, S.PATIENT_NAME, ASSIGNMENT_DATE, SUBMISSION_DATE

prompt: list of protocol patients who are alive as of their last visit at MSK
completion: SELECT PLA_LST_APPT_DTE AS LAST_VISIT, PT_DATE_OF_DEATH, COUNT(ACD_MRN) AS PATIENT_COUNT FROM IDB.ACCRUALS_DATES JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON ACD_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY ON ACD_MRN = PLA_MRN WHERE 1 =1 AND ACD_IRB_NO = '94-018' GROUP BY PT_DATE_OF_DEATH, PLA_LST_APPT_DTE ; SELECT ACD_MRN AS MRN, TRIM(PT_LAST_NAME) || ', ' || TRIM(PT_FIRST_NAME) PATIENT_NAME, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, PT_DATE_OF_DEATH, PLA_LST_APPT_DTE AS LAST_APPT_DTE, ACD_TX_ST_DTE AS TX_START_DTE, ACD_TX_END_DTE AS TX_END_DTE, ACD_CONS_DTE AS CONSENT_DTE FROM IDB.ACCRUALS_DATES JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON ACD_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY ON ACD_MRN = PLA_MRN WHERE ACD_IRB_NO = '03-077'; SELECT ACD_MRN AS MRN, TRIM(PT_LAST_NAME) || ', ' || TRIM(PT_FIRST_NAME) PATIENT_NAME, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, PT_DATE_OF_DEATH, PLA_LST_APPT_DTE AS LAST_APPT_DTE, ACD_TX_ST_DTE AS TX_START_DTE, ACD_TX_END_DTE AS TX_END_DTE, ACD_CONS_DTE AS CONSENT_DTE FROM IDB.ACCRUALS_DATES JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON ACD_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY ON ACD_MRN = PLA_MRN WHERE ACD_IRB_NO = '12-230'; SELECT ACD_MRN AS MRN, TRIM(PT_LAST_NAME) || ', ' || TRIM(PT_FIRST_NAME) PATIENT_NAME, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, PT_DATE_OF_DEATH, PLA_LST_APPT_DTE AS LAST_APPT_DTE, ACD_TX_ST_DTE AS TX_START_DTE, ACD_TX_END_DTE AS TX_END_DTE, ACD_CONS_DTE AS CONSENT_DTE FROM IDB.ACCRUALS_DATES JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON ACD_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY ON ACD_MRN = PLA_MRN WHERE ACD_IRB_NO = '16-1643'; SELECT ACD_MRN AS MRN, TRIM(PT_LAST_NAME) || ', ' || TRIM(PT_FIRST_NAME) PATIENT_NAME, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, PT_DATE_OF_DEATH, PLA_LST_APPT_DTE AS LAST_APPT_DTE, ACD_TX_ST_DTE AS TX_START_DTE, ACD_TX_END_DTE AS TX_END_DTE, ACD_CONS_DTE AS CONSENT_DTE FROM IDB.ACCRUALS_DATES JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON ACD_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY ON ACD_MRN = PLA_MRN WHERE ACD_IRB_NO = '13-260';

prompt: Requesting 1 time retroactive list for olaparib pts.- all pts. who started in 2022
completion: WITH PATIENTS AS (SELECT PT_MRN, (TRIM(PT_LAST_NAME) || ', ' || TRIM(PT_FIRST_NAME)) AS PT_NAME, CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME, MIN(APR_START_DTE) AS FIRST_START_DATE FROM IDB.PATIENT JOIN IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX_V AS A ON PT_MRN = APR_MRN WHERE TRIM(PT_MRN) <> '' AND CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME LIKE '%OLAPARIB%' AND APR_DRUG_PROCESS_STAGE <> 'H' AND TRIM(PT_DEATH_IND) IN ('A', '') GROUP BY PT_MRN, (TRIM(PT_LAST_NAME) || ', ' || TRIM(PT_FIRST_NAME)), CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME HAVING MIN(APR_START_DTE) >= '1/1/2022'), LAST_APPOINTMENT AS (SELECT CPE_MRN, CPE_ENC_DTE AS LAST_APPT_DATE, CRE_RES_ID, CRE_RES_TYP, CRE_RES_NAME AS PROVIDER, CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME AS VST_NAME, CVT_EXT_NAME AS VST_TYPE, DOC_SVC, DOC_ACDMC_SVC, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CPE_MRN ORDER BY CPE_ENC_DTE DESC) RN FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN PATIENTS ON CPE_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CRE_RES_ID = CPE_VST_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.DOC ON DOC_DR_NO = CPE_VST_RES_ID AND TRIM(DOC_SVC) <> '' JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID = CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID WHERE CPE_ENC_DTE >= FIRST_START_DATE - 30 DAY AND CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Comp', 'Arrived') AND CRE_RES_TYP IN ('Physician', 'Dentist', 'Psychologist', 'PhD', 'Nurse Practitioner', 'Physician Assistant', 'Advanced Practice Nurse') AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 IN ('MED', 'NEU', 'RDO', 'PED') ), LAST_APPOINTMENT_2 AS (SELECT * FROM LAST_APPOINTMENT WHERE RN = 1), IRB_PROTOCOLS AS (SELECT AC_IRB_NO AS IRB_NUMBER, AC_MRN, AC_CONS_DTE AS CONSENT_DATE FROM IDB.ACCRUALS WHERE AC_IRB_NO IN ('12-245', '06-107')) SELECT PT_MRN, PT_NAME, LAST_APPT_DATE, CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME, PROVIDER, DOC_SVC, DOC_ACDMC_SVC, IRB_NUMBER, CONSENT_DATE VST_NAME, VST_TYPE FROM PATIENTS AS P JOIN LAST_APPOINTMENT_2 ON PT_MRN = CPE_MRN LEFT JOIN IRB_PROTOCOLS ON PT_MRN = AC_MRN ORDER BY PT_MRN

prompt: Provide a list of MRN and MRI brain reports for all patients with pathological diagnosis of thyroid cancer between 2000 to 2023 in order to identify patients with thyroid cancer brain metastasis.
completion: WITH DX AS (SELECT DISTINCT TM_MRN AS MRN, TM_DX_DTE AS DX_DATE, TM_SITE_CD AS DX_CODE, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS DX_DESC FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.SEERGROUPING ON RECODE = DV.SEERF_ICDO(TM_SITE_CD, TM_HIST_CD) JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD WHERE 1=1 AND TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND TM_DX_DTE BETWEEN '2000-01-01' AND '2023-06-01' AND CATEGORY2 = 'Thyroid' UNION SELECT CC_MRN AS MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS DX_DATE, CLM_CLSF_CD AS DX_CODE, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS DX_DESC FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD AND(CLM_CLSF_CD like '193%' OR CLM_CLSF_CD like 'C73%') WHERE CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND CASE WHEN CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y' THEN 'Y' WHEN CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' AND YEAR(CC_EFF_DTE) < 2004 THEN 'Y' WHEN CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND YEAR(CC_EFF_DTE) < 2001 THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END = 'Y' AND CC_PT_TYPE <> 'E' GROUP BY CC_MRN, CLM_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK HAVING MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) BETWEEN '2000-01-01' AND '2023-06-01') SELECT DISTINCT "t1"."PT_MRN" AS "MRN", "t2"."RRPT_ACCESSION_NO" AS "Radiology Accession Number", "t2"."RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE" AS "Radiology Performed Date", "t2"."RRPT_REPORT_DTE" AS "Radiology Report Date", "t2"."RRPT_ORDER_GROUP" AS "Radiology Order Group", "t2"."RRPT_PROCEDURE_NAME" AS "Radiology Procedure Name", UPPER(DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)IMPRESSION:[\w\W]*(?=DICTATED BY:)', RRPT_REPORT_TXT)) AS IMPRESSION, UPPER(CASE WHEN LENGTH(RRPT_REPORT_TXT) <= 15000 THEN RTRIM(CAST(SUBSTR(RRPT_REPORT_TXT, 1, 15000) AS VARCHAR(15000))) ELSE CAST(SUBSTR(RRPT_REPORT_TXT, 1, 15000) AS VARCHAR(15000)) END) AS "PRPT_REPORT" FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V" "t1" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED" "t3" ON "t1"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t3"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."RADIOLOGY_REPORT_V" "t2" ON "t3"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t2"."RRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_IDENTIFICATION_MRN_V" "t4" ON "t1"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t4"."PI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" WHERE "t4"."PI_SOURCE_SYSTEM_PT_ID" IN (SELECT MRN FROM DX) AND "t2"."RRPT_ORDER_GROUP" = 'MR' AND(UPPER("t2"."RRPT_PROCEDURE_NAME") like '%BRAIN%' OR UPPER("t2"."RRPT_PROCEDURE_NAME") like '%BRN%' OR UPPER("t2"."RRPT_PROCEDURE_NAME") like '%HEAD%' OR UPPER("t2"."RRPT_PROCEDURE_NAME") like '%SELLA%')

prompt: Provide a list of patients from 2011-present on nivolumab and/or pembrolizumab and have visited the dental service.
completion: WITH APPTS AS (SELECT CPE_MRN AS "MRN" , MIN(CPE_ENC_DTE) AS "Min Appt Date" , MAX(CPE_ENC_DTE) AS "Max Appt Date" FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE 1=1 AND CPE_ENC_DTE >= '1/1/2011' AND CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CPE_DEPT_ID IN ('564' ,'952' ,'5675' ,'5683' ,'5899' ,'5929') GROUP BY CPE_MRN) , MEDS_PRE AS (SELECT APR_MRN, APR_GENERIC_NAME, MIN(APR_START_DTE) AS MIN_START, MAX(APR_START_DTE) AS MAX_START , "Min Appt Date", "Max Appt Date" , SUM(COALESCE(APR_DISPENSE_CNT, 1)) AS DISPENSE_SUM FROM IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX JOIN APPTS ON MRN = APR_MRN WHERE 1=1 AND APR_GENERIC_NAME IN ('NIVOLUMAB', 'PEMBROLIZUMAB') AND APR_START_DTE >= '2011-01-01' GROUP BY APR_MRN, APR_GENERIC_NAME , "Min Appt Date", "Max Appt Date" ) , MEDS AS (SELECT APR_MRN , MAX(CASE WHEN APR_GENERIC_NAME = 'NIVOLUMAB' THEN DISPENSE_SUM ELSE 0 END) NIVO_SUM , MAX(CASE WHEN APR_GENERIC_NAME = 'NIVOLUMAB' THEN MIN_START END) NIVO_MIN_START , MAX(CASE WHEN APR_GENERIC_NAME = 'NIVOLUMAB' THEN MAX_START END) NIVO_MAX_START , MAX(CASE WHEN APR_GENERIC_NAME = 'PEMBROLIZUMAB' THEN DISPENSE_SUM ELSE 0 END) PEMB_SUM , MAX(CASE WHEN APR_GENERIC_NAME = 'PEMBROLIZUMAB' THEN MIN_START END) PEMB_MIN_START , MAX(CASE WHEN APR_GENERIC_NAME = 'PEMBROLIZUMAB' THEN MAX_START END) PEMB_MAX_START , "Min Appt Date", "Max Appt Date" FROM MEDS_PRE GROUP BY APR_MRN , "Min Appt Date", "Max Appt Date" ) , CDB_PRE AS (SELECT TM_MRN , TM_DX_DTE , VARCHAR_FORMAT(TM_DX_DTE, 'yyyy-mm-dd') AS DX_FORMAT_DATE , TRIM(TM_SITE_CD) AS SITE_CODE, TRIM(S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK) AS SITE_DESC , TRIM(TM_HIST_CD) AS HIST_CODE, TRIM(H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK) AS HIST_DESC , CASE WHEN TM_AJCC_7 NOT IN ('', '888', '999') THEN AJCC7.AV_DESC WHEN TM_AJCC NOT IN ('', '88', '99') THEN AJCC.AV_DESC WHEN TM_GENERAL_STG NOT IN ('', '9') THEN GS.AV_DESC WHEN TM_PATH_STG_GRP NOT IN ('', '88', '9', '99') THEN TM_PATH_STG_GRP ELSE CLIN.AV_DESC END AS "Best Stage" FROM MEDS JOIN IDB.CDB_TUMOR ON APR_MRN = TM_MRN AND TM_CASE_STS IN ('3', '6', '7', '8') LEFT JOIN IDB.CLM H ON TM_HIST_CD = H.CLM_CLSF_CD LEFT JOIN IDB.CLM S ON TM_SITE_CD = S.CLM_CLSF_CD LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS AJCC7 ON AJCC7.AV_ELEMENT = 'AJCC_7' AND AJCC7.AV_CODE = TM_AJCC_7 LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS AJCC ON AJCC.AV_ELEMENT = 'AJCC' AND AJCC.AV_CODE = TM_AJCC LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS GS ON GS.AV_ELEMENT = 'GENERAL_STG' AND GS.AV_CODE = TM_GENERAL_STG LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS CLIN ON CLIN.AV_ELEMENT = 'CLIN_STG_DSCR' AND CLIN.AV_CODE = TM_CLIN_STG_DSCR) , CDB_LISTAGG AS (SELECT TM_MRN, LISTAGG(COALESCE(DX_FORMAT_DATE, '') || ' | ' || COALESCE(TRIM(CAST(SITE_CODE || ' - ' || SITE_DESC AS VARCHAR(12000))), '') || ' | ' || COALESCE(TRIM(HIST_CODE || ' - ' || HIST_DESC), '') || ' | ' || COALESCE(TRIM("Best Stage"), '') , CHR(13) || CHR(10)) WITHIN GROUP( ORDER BY DX_FORMAT_DATE) AS "Cancer Database" FROM CDB_PRE GROUP BY TM_MRN) SELECT DISTINCT APR_MRN AS MRN , PT_LAST_NAME AS "Last Name" , PT_FIRST_NAME AS "First Name" , PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH AS "Date of Birth" , PT_DATE_OF_DEATH AS "Date of Death" , CASE WHEN PT_DATE_OF_DEATH IS NULL THEN YEAR(CURRENT date - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) END AS "Current Age" , CASE WHEN PT_DATE_OF_DEATH IS NULL THEN 'Alive' ELSE 'Deceased' END AS "Vital Status" , PT_SEX AS "Gender" , R.AV_DESC AS "Race" , E.AV_DESC AS "Ethnicity" , NIVO_SUM , NIVO_MIN_START , NIVO_MAX_START , PEMB_SUM , PEMB_MIN_START , PEMB_MAX_START , "Min Appt Date" , "Max Appt Date" , PLA_LST_DRVST_DTE AS "Last Dr Visit Date" , "Cancer Database" FROM MEDS JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PT_MRN = APR_MRN LEFT JOIN CDB_LISTAGG ON TM_MRN = APR_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY ON PLA_MRN = APR_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS R ON R.AV_ELEMENT = 'RACE' AND R.AV_CODE = PT_RACE LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS E ON E.AV_ELEMENT = 'PT_ETHNICITY' AND E.AV_CODE = PT_PT_ETHNICITY ; WHERE 1=1 ) SELECT * FROM MAIN ORDER

prompt: Body Fluid Bacterial Culture lab tests between 2001 and 2003 or 2017 and 2019 with results for Subtest Names Specimen and Culture Result.
completion: WITH SPECIMEN AS (SELECT DISTINCT LR_MRN AS SP_MRN, LR_PERFORMED_DTE AS SP_PERFORMED_DTE, LR_ACCESSION_NO AS SP_ACCESSION_NO, LR_CTLG_ITEM_GUID AS SP_CTLG_ITEM_GUID, LR_TEST_NAME AS SP_TEST_NAME, LR_SUBTEST_NAME AS SP_SUBTEST_NAME, LR_RESULT_VALUE AS SP_RESULT_VALUE, LTL_TEXT_RESULT AS SP_LTL_TEXT_RESULT FROM IDB.LAB_RESULTS JOIN IDB.LAB_TEXT_LINE ON LTL_RESULT_GUID = LR_RESULT_GUID WHERE (LR_PERFORMED_DTE BETWEEN '2017-01-01' AND '2019-12-31' OR LR_PERFORMED_DTE BETWEEN '2001-01-01' AND '2003-12-31') AND LOWER(LR_TEST_NAME) like '%body%' AND LOWER(LR_TEST_NAME) not like '%antibody%' AND LOWER(LR_SUBTEST_NAME) like '%specimen%' AND (LOWER(LTL_TEXT_RESULT) like '%peritoneal%' OR LOWER(LTL_TEXT_RESULT) like '%pleural%') ), CULTURERESULT AS (SELECT DISTINCT LR_MRN AS CR_MRN, LR_PERFORMED_DTE AS CR_PERFORMED_DTE, LR_ACCESSION_NO AS CR_ACCESSION_NO, LR_CTLG_ITEM_GUID AS CR_CTLG_ITEM_GUID, LR_TEST_NAME AS CR_TEST_NAME, LR_SUBTEST_NAME AS CR_SUBTEST_NAME, LR_RESULT_VALUE AS CR_RESULT_VALUE, LTL_TEXT_RESULT AS CR_LTL_TEXT_RESULT FROM IDB.LAB_RESULTS JOIN IDB.LAB_TEXT_LINE ON LTL_RESULT_GUID = LR_RESULT_GUID WHERE (LR_PERFORMED_DTE BETWEEN '2017-01-01' AND '2019-12-31' OR LR_PERFORMED_DTE BETWEEN '2001-01-01' AND '2003-12-31') AND LOWER(LR_TEST_NAME) like '%body%' AND LOWER(LR_SUBTEST_NAME) like '%culture%' ) SELECT CR_MRN AS MRN, PT_LAST_NAME AS "Patient First Name", PT_FIRST_NAME AS "Patient Last Name", CR_PERFORMED_DTE AS "Lab Performed Date", CR_ACCESSION_NO AS "Lab Accession Number", CR_CTLG_ITEM_GUID AS "Lab Catalog Item Guid", CR_TEST_NAME AS "Lab Test Name", CR_SUBTEST_NAME AS "Culture Sub Test Name", CR_LTL_TEXT_RESULT AS "Culture Text Result", SP_SUBTEST_NAME AS "Specimen Subtest Name", SP_LTL_TEXT_RESULT AS "Specimen Text Result" FROM SPECIMEN JOIN CULTURERESULT ON SP_MRN = CR_MRN AND SP_ACCESSION_NO = CR_ACCESSION_NO JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON CR_MRN = PT_MRN

prompt: Provide data on patients diagnosed with thymomas at MSKCC from January 2000-Dec 2013.
completion: SELECT DISTINCT "t1"."PT_MRN" AS "MRN", "t1"."PT_LAST_NAME" AS "Last Name", "t1"."PT_FIRST_NAME" AS "First Name", "t1"."PT_BIRTH_DTE" AS "Date of Birth", "t2"."DXCC_ICD_CODE" AS "ICD-O Histology Code", "t2"."DXCC_ICD_MSK_DESC" AS "ICD-O Histology Description", "t3"."DT_DTE" AS "Tumor Diagnosis Date", "t4"."DT_DTE" AS "Pathology Procedure Date", "t5"."DT_DTE" AS "Pathology Report Date", "t6"."PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_DESC" AS "Pathology Report Type", "t7"."PRPT_ACCESSION_NO" AS "Pathology Report" FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V" "t1" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED" "t8" ON "t1"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t8"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."CDB_TUMOR_V" "t9" ON "t8"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t9"."CDTM_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DIAGNOSIS_CODE_CAT_ICDO_V" "t2" ON "t9"."CDTM_DX_CATALOG_ID" = "t2"."DXCC_DX_CATALOG_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" "t3" ON "t9"."CDTM_DX_DATE_ID" = "t3"."DT_DATE_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."ICDO_SITE_CATALOG_V" "t10" ON "t9"."CDTM_SITE_CATALOG_ID" = "t10"."ICSC_SITE_CATALOG_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V" "t7" ON "t8"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t7"."PRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" "t4" ON "t7"."PRPT_PROCEDURE_DATE_ID" = "t4"."DT_DATE_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" "t5" ON "t7"."PRPT_REPORT_DATE_ID" = "t5"."DT_DATE_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATH_RPRT_TYPE_LOOKUP" "t6" ON "t7"."PRPT_REPORT_TYPE" = "t6"."PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_CD" WHERE (((("t2"."DXCC_ICD_CODE" IN ('M8580/3', 'M8581/3', 'M8582/3', 'M8583/3', 'M8584/3') AND "t10"."ICSC_SITE_CD" IN ('C379')) AND "t3"."DT_YEAR" >= 2000) AND CONTAINS("t7"."PRPT_REPORT", '"thymoma"') = 1) AND "t7"."PRPT_REPORT" IS NOT NULL)

prompt: Report should capture new visits to Clinical Genetics patients who were first registered as patients at MSK with a CGS visit.  Also capture all completed appts based on after initial CGS visit.
completion: SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN AS "MRN", PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH AS "DOB", YEAR(CURRENT date - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) AS "Age", CPE_ENC_DTE AS "First Appt Date", CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 AS "Department", CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 AS "Service", CLD_DEPT_NAME AS "Department Name", CRE_RES_NAME AS "Provider Name", CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR, CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID, CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME AS "Visit Type", CLD_CLD_CENTER AS "Center" FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER B JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON CPE_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE B.CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 = 'GNT' AND CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR like '%NV%' AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN '2015-01-01' AND CURRENT date AND B.CPE_ENC_DTE = (SELECT MIN(C.CPE_ENC_DTE) FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER C WHERE C.CPE_MRN = B.CPE_MRN AND C.CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp')) ; WITH INIT AS (SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN AS "MRN", PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH AS "DOB", YEAR(CURRENT date - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) AS "Age", CPE_ENC_DTE AS "First Appt Date", CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 AS "Department", CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 AS "Service", CLD_DEPT_NAME AS "Department Name", CRE_RES_NAME AS "Provider Name", CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR, CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID, CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME AS "Visit Type", CLD_CLD_CENTER AS "Center" FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER B JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON CPE_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE B.CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 = 'GNT' AND CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR like '%NV%' AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN '2015-01-01' AND CURRENT date AND (CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR LIKE '%NV%' OR CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR LIKE '%IR%') AND B.CPE_ENC_DTE = (SELECT MIN(C.CPE_ENC_DTE) FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER C WHERE C.CPE_MRN = B.CPE_MRN AND C.CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp')) ) SELECT DISTINCT "MRN", PT.PT_LAST_NAME AS "LAST NAME", PT.PT_FIRST_NAME AS "FIRST NAME", "DOB", "Age", "First Appt Date", E.CPE_ENC_DTE AS "APPT DATE", CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 AS "DEPARTMENT", CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 AS "SERVICE", D.CLD_DEPT_NAME AS "DEPARTMENT NAME", R.CRE_RES_NAME AS "PROVIDER NAME", V.CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR, V.CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID, V.CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME AS "VISIT TYPE", D.CLD_CLD_CENTER AS "CENTER" FROM INIT JOIN IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER E ON "MRN" = E.CPE_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE R ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = R.CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT D ON CPE_DEPT_ID = D.CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE V ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = V.CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID JOIN IDB.PATIENT PT ON "MRN" = PT_MRN WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CPE_ENC_DTE > "First Appt Date" ; WITH INIT AS (SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN AS "MRN", PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH AS "DOB", YEAR(CURRENT date - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) AS "Age", CPE_ENC_DTE AS "First Appt Date", CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 AS "Department", CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 AS "Service", CLD_DEPT_NAME AS "Department Name", CRE_RES_NAME AS "Provider Name", CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR, CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID, CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME AS "Visit Type", CLD_CLD_CENTER AS "Center" FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER B JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON CPE_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE B.CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 = 'GNT' AND CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR like '%NV%' AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN '2015-01-01' AND CURRENT date AND (CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR LIKE '%NV%' OR CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR LIKE '%IR%') AND B.CPE_ENC_DTE = (SELECT MIN(C.CPE_ENC_DTE) FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER C WHERE C.CPE_MRN = B.CPE_MRN AND C.CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp')) ) , SRG AS (SELECT DISTINCT "MRN", PT.PT_LAST_NAME AS "LAST NAME", PT.PT_FIRST_NAME AS "FIRST NAME", "DOB", "Age", "First Appt Date", SSE_SURG_DTE AS "SURGERY DATE", SSP_SURG_SVC_CD AS "SERVICE", SSE_SURG_LOC AS "LOCATION", STRIP(SSP_SURG_LAST_NM) || ', ' || STRIP(SSP_SURG_FIRST_NM) AS "SURGEON NAME", SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD AS CPT_CODE, SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC AS PROCEDURE_DESC FROM INIT JOIN IDB.PATIENT PT ON "MRN" = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT ON SSE_MRN = "MRN" JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE ON SSE_LOG_ID = SSP_LOG_ID WHERE 1=1 AND SSE_SURG_DTE > "First Appt Date" AND SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD NOT LIKE '9999%' ) SELECT * FROM SRG

prompt: Provide ClinDoc note and demographic data for patients who have had specific Rad Onc notes
completion: SELECT DISTINCT CDD_MRN AS MRN , PT_LAST_NAME AS "Last Name" , PT_FIRST_NAME AS "First Name" , PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH AS "Date of Birth" , PT_DATE_OF_DEATH AS "Date of Death" , CASE WHEN PT_DATE_OF_DEATH IS NULL THEN YEAR(CURRENT date - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) END AS "Current Age" , CASE WHEN PT_DATE_OF_DEATH IS NULL THEN 'Alive' ELSE 'Deceased' END AS "Vital Status" , PT_SEX AS "Gender" , CDD_DOC_NAME, CDD_SERVICE_DTE , YEAR(CDD_SERVICE_DTE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) AS "Age Then" , OCV_CURR_LOC AS "Location" , CDO_ITEM_NAME, CDO_MSTR_ITEM_NM , CDO_VALUE_TEXT , OU_DISPLAY_NAME, OU_ORD_ROLE_TYPE FROM IDB.CD_DOCUMENT JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION ON CDO_DOC_GUID = CDD_DOC_GUID AND CDO_AUTHORED_DTE = CDD_AUTHORED_DTE JOIN IDB.OMS_CLIENT_VISIT ON CDD_VISIT_GUID = OCV_VISIT_GUID LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_USER ON OU_USER_GUID = CDD_AUTH_PROV_GUID JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PT_MRN = CDD_MRN WHERE 1=1 AND CDD_SERVICE_DTE >= CURRENT date - 365 DAYS AND CDD_CANCEL_IND = '0' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND = '0' AND CDD_DOC_NAME IN ('Initial Consult/Initial Visit, AMB - Rad Onc' , 'Initial Consult/Initial Visit, IP - Rad Onc' , 'Subsequent Visit, AMB - Rad Onc' , 'Subsequent Visit, IP - Rad Onc' ) AND (CDO_ITEM_NAME = 'Active Protocols' OR CDO_ITEM_NAME like 'IRB%') AND CDO_ITEM_NAME <> 'IRB Disease' AND CDO_VALUE_TEXT > '' ORDER BY CDD_MRN, CDD_DOC_NAME, CDO_ITEM_NAME ;

prompt: Provide a one-time list of all patients diagnosed/treated with Leptomeningeal Metastasis from January 2002 until January 2022
completion: WITH POS_SUS_CSF AS (SELECT DISTINCT "t1"."PT_MRN" AS "MRN", "t2"."PRPT_ACCESSION_NO" AS "REPORT_ACCESSION_NO", CAST("t2"."PRPT_REPORT" AS VARCHAR) AS "REPORT_FULL_TEXT", CASE WHEN LOCATE('POSITIVE', UPPER("t2"."PRPT_REPORT")) > 0 THEN 'Y' END AS CSF_CYT_POSITIVE, CASE WHEN LOCATE('SUSPICIOUS', UPPER("t2"."PRPT_REPORT")) > 0 THEN 'Y' END AS CSF_CYT_SUSPICIOUS FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V" "t1" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED" "t3" ON "t1"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t3"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V" "t2" ON "t3"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t2"."PRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" WHERE (CONTAINS("t2"."PRPT_REPORT", '(("CSF" OR "cerebrospinal fluid") AND ("cytology"))') = 1 AND "t2"."PRPT_REPORT" IS NOT NULL) ), TUM_CELL3PLUS AS (SELECT LR_MRN, LR_TEST_NAME, LR_SUBTEST_NAME, LR_RESULT_VALUE TUMOR_CELL_CT FROM IDB.LAB_RESULTS WHERE UPPER(LR_TEST_NAME) LIKE '%CIRCULATING%TUMOR%' AND UPPER(LR_SUBTEST_NAME) LIKE '%CIRCULATING%TUMOR%' AND LR_RESULT_VALUE >= '3' ORDER BY LR_MRN, LR_TEST_NAME ), ICD_CODES AS (SELECT CC_MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS MIN_ICD9_EFF_DTE, CC_CLSF_CD AS ICD_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS ICD9_DESC FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE CC_CLSF_CD IN ('C70', 'C70.0', 'C70.1', 'C70.9', '192.1', '192.3') AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND (CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) GROUP BY CC_MRN, CC_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK ), TBD25912 AS (SELECT PT_MRN, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, REPORT_ACCESSION_NO, CSF_CYT_POSITIVE, CSF_CYT_SUSPICIOUS, TUMOR_CELL_CT, ICD_CD, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY PT_MRN) RN FROM IDB.PATIENT JOIN IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER ON PT_MRN = CPE_MRN LEFT JOIN POS_SUS_CSF ON PT_MRN = MRN LEFT JOIN TUM_CELL3PLUS ON PT_MRN = LR_MRN LEFT JOIN ICD_CODES ON PT_MRN = CC_MRN WHERE 1 = 1 AND CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND YEAR(CPE_ENC_DTE) BETWEEN '2002' AND '2022' AND ((CSF_CYT_POSITIVE = 'Y' OR CSF_CYT_SUSPICIOUS = 'Y') OR (TUMOR_CELL_CT IS NOT NULL) OR (ICD_CD IS NOT NULL)) ORDER BY PT_MRN, CPE_ENC_DTE DESC) SELECT * FROM TBD25912 WHERE RN = 1

prompt: Provide a monthly list of multiple myeloma patients meeting the criteria listed below
completion: WITH DIAG AS (SELECT CC_MRN, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, YEAR(CURRENT_DATE- PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) AGE, PFA_FST_APPT_DTE, PLA_LST_DRVST_DTE LAST_DOC_VIS, CC_EFF_DTE, CC_CLSF_CD AS ICD_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS ICD_DESC FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON CC_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.PT_FIRST_ACTIVITY ON CC_MRN = PFA_MRN JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY ON CC_MRN = PLA_MRN WHERE SUBSTR(CC_CLSF_CD, 1, 6) IN ('C90.00') AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND (CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) ) , ORDER AS (SELECT DISTINCT OO_MRN, MIN(OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE) ORDER_START_DATE, MAX(OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE) ORDER_STOP_DATE, OO_ORD_NAME, OO_ORD_TYPE_CD FROM DIAG JOIN IDB.OMS_ORDER ON CC_MRN = OO_MRN WHERE (LOWER(OO_ORD_NAME) LIKE '%tixagevimab%' OR LOWER(OO_ORD_NAME) LIKE '%cilgavimab%' OR LOWER(OO_ORD_NAME) LIKE '%casairivimab%' OR LOWER(OO_ORD_NAME) LIKE '%imdevimab%' OR LOWER(OO_ORD_NAME) LIKE '%bamlanivimab%' OR LOWER(OO_ORD_NAME) LIKE '%etesevimab%' OR LOWER(OO_ORD_NAME) LIKE '%sotrovimab%' OR LOWER(OO_ORD_NAME) LIKE '%paxlovid%' OR LOWER(OO_ORD_NAME) LIKE '%molnupiravir%' OR LOWER(OO_ORD_NAME) LIKE '%remdesivir%') AND OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE BETWEEN '2019-01-01' AND CURRENT_DATE GROUP BY OO_MRN, OO_ORD_NAME, OO_ORD_TYPE_CD ) , ACCURAL AS (SELECT ACD_MRN, ACD_CONS_DTE, ACD_OFF_STUDY_DTE FROM DIAG JOIN IDB.ACCRUALS_DATES ON CC_MRN = ACD_MRN WHERE ACD_IRB_NO IN ('06-107', '09-141', '12-245') ) , COVID AS (SELECT DISTINCT CP_MRN, DOSE_1_BRAND, DOSE_3_BRAND, DOSE_2_BRAND, DATE(DOSE_1_EMAR_ADMIN_DT) AS DOSE_1_EMAR_ADMIN_DTE, DATE(DOSE_2_EMAR_ADMIN_DT) AS DOSE_2_EMAR_ADMIN_DTE, DATE(DOSE_3_EMAR_ADMIN_DT) AS DOSE_3_EMAR_ADMIN_DTE FROM DIAG JOIN IDB.COVID19_PATIENT_CP_VACCINE_INFO ON CC_MRN=CP_MRN) SELECT DISTINCT V.CC_MRN, V.PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, V.AGE, V.PFA_FST_APPT_DTE INITIAL_VIS_DATE, V.LAST_DOC_VIS LAST_DR_VIS_DATE, CC_EFF_DTE DIAGNOSIS_DATE, V. ICD_CD, V.ICD_DESC, ACD_CONS_DTE CONSENT_DATE, ACD_OFF_STUDY_DTE, ORDER_START_DATE, ORDER_STOP_DATE, OO_ORD_NAME, DOSE_1_BRAND, DOSE_1_EMAR_ADMIN_DTE DOSE1_DATE, DOSE_2_BRAND, DOSE_2_EMAR_ADMIN_DTE DOSE1_DATE, DOSE_3_BRAND, DOSE_3_EMAR_ADMIN_DTE DOSE1_DATE FROM DIAG V JOIN COVID ON V.CC_MRN = CP_MRN LEFT JOIN ORDER ON V.CC_MRN = OO_MRN JOIN ACCURAL ON V.CC_MRN = ACD_MRN; WITH DIAG AS (SELECT CC_MRN, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, YEAR(CURRENT_DATE- PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) AGE, PFA_FST_APPT_DTE, PLA_LST_DRVST_DTE LAST_DOC_VIS, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS MIN_ICD_EFF_DTE, MAX(CC_EFF_DTE) AS MAX_ICD_EFF_DTE, CC_CLSF_CD AS ICD_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS ICD_DESC FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON CC_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.PT_FIRST_ACTIVITY ON CC_MRN = PFA_MRN JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY ON CC_MRN = PLA_MRN WHERE SUBSTR(CC_CLSF_CD, 1, 6) IN ('C90.00') AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND (CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) GROUP BY CC_MRN, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, YEAR(CURRENT_DATE- PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH), PFA_FST_APPT_DTE, PLA_LST_DRVST_DTE, CC_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK) , ORDER AS (SELECT DISTINCT OO_MRN, MIN(OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE) ORDER_START_DATE, MAX(OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE) ORDER_STOP_DATE, OO_ORD_NAME, OO_ORD_TYPE_CD FROM DIAG JOIN IDB.OMS_ORDER ON CC_MRN = OO_MRN WHERE (LOWER(OO_ORD_NAME) LIKE '%tixagevimab%' OR LOWER(OO_ORD_NAME) LIKE '%cilgavimab%' OR LOWER(OO_ORD_NAME) LIKE '%casairivimab%' OR LOWER(OO_ORD_NAME) LIKE '%imdevimab%' OR LOWER(OO_ORD_NAME) LIKE '%bamlanivimab%' OR LOWER(OO_ORD_NAME) LIKE '%etesevimab%' OR LOWER(OO_ORD_NAME) LIKE '%sotrovimab%' OR LOWER(OO_ORD_NAME) LIKE '%paxlovid%' OR LOWER(OO_ORD_NAME) LIKE '%molnupiravir%' OR LOWER(OO_ORD_NAME) LIKE '%remdesivir%') AND OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE BETWEEN '2019-01-01' AND CURRENT_DATE GROUP BY OO_MRN, OO_ORD_NAME, OO_ORD_TYPE_CD ) , ACCURAL AS (SELECT ACD_MRN, ACD_CONS_DTE, ACD_OFF_STUDY_DTE FROM DIAG JOIN IDB.ACCRUALS_DATES ON CC_MRN = ACD_MRN WHERE ACD_IRB_NO IN ('06-107', '09-141', '12-245') ), LAB AS (SELECT DISTINCT DIAG.*, LR_PERFORMED_DTE, LR_TEST_NAME, LR_SUBTEST_NAME, LR_RESULT_VALUE, LTL_TEXT_RESULT, LTL_LINE_NO FROM DIAG JOIN IDB.LAB_RESULTS ON CC_MRN =LR_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.LAB_TEXT_LINE ON LTL_RESULT_GUID = LR_RESULT_GUID WHERE LR_TEST_NAME IN ('COVID-19 Spike Protein AntiBODY IgG', 'COVID-19 antiBODY Qualitative IgG', 'COVID-19 Qualitative RNA', 'Lymphocyte Subsets') AND LR_PERFORMED_DTE BETWEEN '2019-01-01' AND CURRENT_DATE ) SELECT DISTINCT V.CC_MRN, LR_PERFORMED_DTE TEST_DATE, LR_TEST_NAME, LR_SUBTEST_NAME, LR_RESULT_VALUE, LTL_TEXT_RESULT, LTL_LINE_NO FROM DIAG V LEFT JOIN ORDER ON V.CC_MRN = OO_MRN JOIN ACCURAL ON V.CC_MRN = ACD_MRN LEFT JOIN LAB L ON V.CC_MRN = L.CC_MRN WHERE LTL_TEXT_RESULT IS NOT NULL ORDER BY V.CC_MRN, LR_PERFORMED_DTE, LR_TEST_NAME, LR_SUBTEST_NAME, LR_RESULT_VALUE, LTL_TEXT_RESULT, LTL_LINE_NO;

prompt: Provide all responses from MSKEngage survey titled "GYN Clinical Care" as well as diagnosis data
completion: WITH DX AS (SELECT CC_MRN, MAX(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(CC_CLSF_CD, 1, 3) IN ('C53') THEN 'Y' ELSE '' END) AS CERVICAL, MAX(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(CC_CLSF_CD, 1, 3) IN ('C52', 'C54', 'C55') THEN 'Y' ELSE '' END) AS ENDOMETRIAL, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) DX_DTE FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE SUBSTR(CC_CLSF_CD, 1, 3) IN ('C52', 'C53', 'C54', 'C55') AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND (CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) GROUP BY CC_MRN ) , PTS AS (SELECT DISTINCT EF_MRN, DX_DTE, CERVICAL, ENDOMETRIAL, DATE(EF_SUBMISSION_DT) SURVEY_DATE, EF_FORM_ID, EF_FORM_EXTERNAL_ID, EFI_ITEM_TEXT, EFI_VALUE_ALIAS, EFI_VALUE FROM IDB.EF_FORM JOIN IDB.EF_FORM_ITEM ON EF_FORM_ID = EFI_FORM_ID JOIN DX ON EF_MRN = CC_MRN WHERE EF_FORM_NAME = 'Gynecologic Clinical Care' AND DATE(EF_SUBMISSION_DT) BETWEEN '2016-01-01' AND '2020-03-18' ) , PT AS (SELECT DISTINCT SSE_MRN, PT_RACE_DESC, PT_PT_ETHNICITY_DESC, PT_MARITAL_STS_DESC, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, DX_DTE, CERVICAL, ENDOMETRIAL, SSE_SURG_DTE, MAX(CASE WHEN UPPER(SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC) LIKE 'LAPS%' OR UPPER(SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC) LIKE '%LAPAROSCOPY%' THEN 'Y' ELSE '' END) LAPAROSCOPY, MAX(CASE WHEN UPPER(SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC) LIKE '%LAPAROTOMY%' THEN 'Y' ELSE '' END) LAPAROTOMY, SURVEY_DATE, EF_FORM_ID, EF_FORM_EXTERNAL_ID, EFI_ITEM_TEXT, EFI_VALUE_ALIAS, EFI_VALUE FROM IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE ON SSE_LOG_ID = SSP_LOG_ID AND SSE_ENC_CSN_ID = SSP_ENC_CSN_ID JOIN PTS ON SSE_MRN = EF_MRN AND SURVEY_DATE >= SSE_SURG_DTE JOIN IDB.PATIENT_V ON SSE_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE (SSE_SURG_LOC not like '%IR%' AND SSE_SURG_LOC not like '%ENDO%' AND SSE_SOURCE_TYPE <> 'E') AND SSP_SURG_SVC_CD = 'GYN' AND SSE_SURG_DTE BETWEEN '2016-01-01' AND '2020-03-18' GROUP BY SSE_MRN, PT_RACE_DESC, PT_PT_ETHNICITY_DESC, PT_MARITAL_STS_DESC, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, DX_DTE, CERVICAL, ENDOMETRIAL, SSE_SURG_DTE, SURVEY_DATE, EF_FORM_ID, EF_FORM_EXTERNAL_ID, EFI_ITEM_TEXT, EFI_VALUE_ALIAS, EFI_VALUE) SELECT PT.*, CPE_ENC_DTE AS "Appt Date", CLD_DEPT_NAME AS "Department Name", CRE_RES_NAME AS "Provider Name", CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME AS "Visit Type" FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID JOIN PT ON SSE_MRN = CPE_MRN WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 = 'SRG' AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 = 'GYN'

prompt: Provide a list of patients who have painful or displaced fracture of the femur and had undergone treatments in accordance to the procedure codes provided by requester.
completion: WITH DATA AS (SELECT DISTINCT CC_MRN "MRN", PT_FIRST_NAME "First", PT_LAST_NAME "Last", PT_SEX "Sex", R.AV_DESC "Race" , E.AV_DESC "Ethnicity", PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH "DOB", CC_CLSF_CD "ICD Code", CLM_CLSF_DESC "ICD Desc", MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) "Dx Date", SSE_SURG_DTE "Procedure Date", OP_PROC_NAME "Proc Name", CPX_PROC_CD "Proc Code", SSP_SURG_LAST_NM "Surgeon" FROM IDB.PATIENT JOIN IDB.CTC_CLSF ON PT_MRN = CC_MRN JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.OR_LOG_ALL_PROC ON OLAP_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE ON SSP_LOG_ID = OLAP_LOG_ID JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT ON SSE_LOG_ID = SSP_LOG_ID JOIN IDB.OR_PROC ON OLAP_OR_PROC_ID = OP_OR_PROC_ID JOIN IDB.OR_CL_PROC ON OP_OR_PROC_ID = OCP_OR_PROC_ID JOIN IDB.CL_PROC ON OCP_PROC_ID = CPX_PROC_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS R ON R.AV_ELEMENT = 'RACE' AND R.AV_CODE = PT_RACE LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS E ON E.AV_ELEMENT = 'PT_ETHNICITY' AND E.AV_CODE = PT_PT_ETHNICITY WHERE CC_CLSF_CD IN ('C50.919', '174.9', '198.5', 'C79.51', 'C79.9', '198.89', 'M84.559A', '733.14', '733.15') AND CPX_PROC_CD IN ('27248', '27245', '27125', '27507') AND PT_MRN NOT IN (SELECT CC_MRN FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE UPPER(CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK) like '%LYMPHOMA%' UNION ALL SELECT TM_MRN FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR WHERE TM_HIST_CD IN ('M8561/0', 'M9590/3', 'M9591/3', 'M9591/3', 'M9591/3', 'M9591/3', 'M9591/3', 'M9591/3', 'M9591/3', 'M9591/3', 'M9591/3', 'M9591/3', 'M9596/3', 'M9596/3', 'M9597/3', 'M9650/3', 'M9651/3', 'M9652/3', 'M9653/3', 'M9654/3', 'M9655/3', 'M9659/3', 'M9663/3', prompt: Provide unplanned admissions and transfers to main campus from K8 PACU.
completion: SELECT DISTINCT OO_MRN "MRN", PT_LAST_NAME "PT Last Name", PT_FIRST_NAME "PT First Name", OOC_ITEM_NAME "Order Name", VIS_ADM_DTE "Admit Date", UC_NURS_STA "Floor" FROM IDB.OMS_ORDER JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_CATALOG ON OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID = OOC_MSTR_ITEM_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_STATUS ON OO_ORD_STS_CD = OSTS_ORD_STS_CD JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON OO_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.OMS_CLIENT_VISIT ON OO_VISIT_GUID = OCV_VISIT_GUID JOIN IDB.VISIT_V ON OCV_ADM_NUM = VIS_ADM_NUM JOIN IDB.UNIFIED_CENSUS ON VIS_ADM_NUM = UC_ADM_NUM AND UC_SEQ_NO = 1 WHERE OOC_ITEM_NAME IN ('Koch to Main Transfer Request', 'Outpatient to Inpatient Admission Request') AND OO_ORD_STS_CD NOT IN ('CANP', 'CANC', 'AUC3') AND OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE >= '2020-06-01' AND UC_NURS_STA = 'K08' ;

prompt: Provide a daily list of new inpatient admissions and death notifications for patients with notes authored by Lauren Saban.
completion: WITH PTS AS (SELECT DISTINCT CDD_MRN AS MRN, PT_LAST_NAME LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME FIRST_NAME, PT_SEX GENDER, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH AS DOB, PT_DATE_OF_DEATH DOD , OP_DISPLAY_NAME AS "Authored by" FROM IDB.CD_DOCUMENT JOIN IDB.OMS_PROVIDER ON CDD_AUTH_PROV_GUID = OP_PVDR_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_CLIENT_VISIT ON CDD_VISIT_GUID = OCV_VISIT_GUID JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON CDD_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE CDD_CANCEL_IND <> '1' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND <> '1' AND OP_PVDR_GUID IN (9001109654001190) ) SELECT P.*, 'Admitted' TYPE, VIS_BED "Bed" FROM PTS P JOIN IDB.VISIT_V ON MRN = VIS_MRN WHERE VIS_VISIT_STATUS IN ('2') AND VIS_IP_OP_ADJUSTED_IND = 'I' AND VIS_ADM_DTE >= CURRENT DATE - 1 DAYS UNION SELECT P.*, 'Deceased' TYPE, '' "Bed" FROM PTS P JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON MRN = PT_MRN WHERE (COALESCE(DATE(PT_DATE_OF_DEATH_UPD_DT), PT_DATE_OF_DEATH)) >= CURRENT DATE - 1 DAYS

prompt: Weekly list of transfers from Koch to Main.
