prompt: Provide a list of patients with Hodgkin's Lymphoma and CNS involvement from 2004-2018
Daily vaccine admin count report for DOH.
completion: WITH Q AS (SELECT DATE(CEVE_ADMIN_DT) AS date, CEVE_MFG_NAME BRAND, CEVE_LOCATION_DESC LOCATION, CEVE_DOSE_NUM DOSE, SUM(CASE WHEN CEVE_COHORT like '%Patient%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS PATIENT_COUNT, SUM(CASE WHEN CEVE_COHORT like '%Empl%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS EMPLOYEE_COUNT, COUNT(*) TOTAL_COUNT FROM (SELECT CEVE_MRN, 'Employee' CEVE_COHORT, CEVE_ORDER_GUID, CEVE_PT_TYPE, CEVE_ADMIN_DT, CEVE_TASK_STATUS_CD, CEVE_ORDER_NAME, COALESCE(CEVE_DOSE_NUM, 'Unknown') AS CEVE_DOSE_NUM, CEVE_MFG_NAME, CEVE_LOT, CEVE_LOT_EXP_DTE, CEVE_LOCATION_DESC FROM IDB.COVID19_EMPLOYEE_VACCINE_EMAR WHERE CEVE_PT_TYPE = 'Employee' UNION SELECT CPVE_MRN CEVE_MRN, 'Patient' CEVE_COHORT, CPVE_ORDER_GUID CEVE_ORDER_GUID, CPVE_PT_TYPE CEVE_PT_TYPE, CPVE_ADMIN_DT CEVE_ADMIN_DT, CPVE_TASK_STATUS_CD CEVE_TASK_STATUS_CD, CPVE_ORDER_NAME CEVE_ORDER_NAME, COALESCE(CPVE_DOSE_NUM, 'Unknown') CEVE_DOSE_NUM, CPVE_MFG_NAME CEVE_MFG_NAME, CPVE_LOT CEVE_LOT, CPVE_LOT_EXP_DTE CEVE_LOT_EXP_DTE, CPVE_LOCATION_DESC CEVE_LOCATION_DESC FROM IDB.COVID19_PATIENT_CP_VACCINE_EMAR) WHERE DATE(CEVE_ADMIN_DT) = CURRENT date AND CEVE_TASK_STATUS_CD = 'Performed' GROUP BY DATE(CEVE_ADMIN_DT), CEVE_LOCATION_DESC, CEVE_MFG_NAME, CEVE_DOSE_NUM) , C AS (SELECT CEVE_MFG_NAME BRAND, CEVE_LOCATION_DESC LOCATION, CEVE_DOSE_NUM DOSE, SUM(CASE WHEN CEVE_COHORT like '%Patient%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS PATIENT_COUNT, SUM(CASE WHEN CEVE_COHORT like '%Empl%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS EMPLOYEE_COUNT, COUNT(*) TOTAL_COUNT FROM (SELECT CEVE_MRN, 'Employee' CEVE_COHORT, CEVE_ORDER_GUID, CEVE_PT_TYPE, CEVE_ADMIN_DT, CEVE_TASK_STATUS_CD, CEVE_ORDER_NAME, COALESCE(CEVE_DOSE_NUM, 'Unknown') CEVE_DOSE_NUM, CEVE_MFG_NAME, CEVE_LOT, CEVE_LOT_EXP_DTE, CASE WHEN CEVE_LOCATION_DESC like 'M %' THEN 'Inpatient' ELSE CEVE_LOCATION_DESC END AS CEVE_LOCATION_DESC FROM IDB.COVID19_EMPLOYEE_VACCINE_EMAR WHERE CEVE_PT_TYPE = 'Employee' UNION SELECT CPVE_MRN CEVE_MRN, 'Patient' CEVE_COHORT, CPVE_ORDER_GUID CEVE_ORDER_GUID, CPVE_PT_TYPE CEVE_PT_TYPE, CPVE_ADMIN_DT CEVE_ADMIN_DT, CPVE_TASK_STATUS_CD CEVE_TASK_STATUS_CD, CPVE_ORDER_NAME CEVE_ORDER_NAME, COALESCE(CPVE_DOSE_NUM, 'Unknown') CEVE_DOSE_NUM, CPVE_MFG_NAME CEVE_MFG_NAME, CPVE_LOT CEVE_LOT, CPVE_LOT_EXP_DTE CEVE_LOT_EXP_DTE, CASE WHEN CPVE_LOCATION_DESC like 'M %' THEN 'Inpatient' ELSE CPVE_LOCATION_DESC END AS CEVE_LOCATION_DESC FROM IDB.COVID19_PATIENT_CP_VACCINE_EMAR) WHERE DATE(CEVE_ADMIN_DT) <= CURRENT date AND CEVE_TASK_STATUS_CD = 'Performed' GROUP BY CEVE_LOCATION_DESC, CEVE_MFG_NAME, CEVE_DOSE_NUM) SELECT C.BRAND, RIGHT(C.DOSE, 1) DOSE, C.LOCATION, CAST(C.PATIENT_COUNT AS int) PATIENT_COUNT, C.EMPLOYEE_COUNT, C.TOTAL_COUNT, Q.DATE, Q.PATIENT_COUNT DATE_PATIENT_COUNT, Q.EMPLOYEE_COUNT DATE_EMPLOYEE_COUNT, Q.TOTAL_COUNT DATE_TOTAL_COUNT FROM C LEFT JOIN Q ON C.BRAND = Q.BRAND AND C.DOSE = Q.DOSE AND C.LOCATION = Q.LOCATION ORDER BY C.BRAND DESC

prompt: Provide deidentified patient IDs for a list of MRNs.
I need the 2023 visit data for all EDD service visits - including total visits per quarter broken down by type, location and MD.
completion: SELECT CPE_MRN MRN, CPE_ENC_DTE VST_DATE, CPE_ENC_CSN_ID CSN , QUARTER (CPE_ENC_DTE) VST_QTR , CPE_CL_PT_ID PT_ID, CPE_ENC_DTE_SEQ DTE_SEQ, CPE_RM_NO RM_NO , VD.CLD_DEPT_ID DEPT_ID, VD.CLD_DEPT_NAME DEPT_NAME , VD.CLD_CLD_CENTER CLD_CENTER , VD.CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_20 CLINIC, VD.CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 GRP6 , CPE_APPT_DT APPT_DT, CPE_CHK_IN_DT CHK_IN_DT , CPE_CHK_OUT_DT CHK_OUT_DT, CPE_WALK_IN_IND WALK_IN , VT.CRE_RES_NAME VST_MD, REF.CRE_RES_NAME REF_MD , CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR VST_ABBR, CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME VST_NAME , CVT_EXT_NAME VST_TYPE, CPE_RM_IN_DT RM_IN, CPE_RM_OUT_DT RM_OUT , SD.CLD_DEPT_NAME SEC_DEPT_NAME, REF.CRE_RES_ID , SR.CRE_RES_NAME SEC_RES, SR.CRE_RES_TYP SEC_RES_TYPE FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID = CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT VD ON CPE_DEPT_ID = VD.CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE VT ON VT.CRE_RES_ID = CPE_VST_RES_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE REF ON REF.CRE_RES_ID = CPE_REF_RES_ID AND REF.CRE_RES_TYP IN ('Physician', 'Dentist', 'Psychologist', 'PhD', 'Nurse Practitioner', 'Physician Assistant', 'Advanced Practice Nurse') LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_PT_APPT ON CPE_CL_PT_ID = CPA_CL_PT_ID AND CPE_ENC_DTE_SEQ = CPA_ENC_DTE_SEQ AND CPA_LINE_NO = 2 LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT SD ON CPA_DEPT_ID = SD.CLD_DEPT_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE SR ON SR.CRE_RES_ID = CPE_VST_RES_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_PATIENT ON CPE_PRK = CL_PRK WHERE CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN '2023-01-01' AND '2023-12-31' AND CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Comp', 'Arrived') AND CPE_ENC_TYP_CD = 50 AND VD.CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 = 'EDD'

prompt: I would like to have a query run of GU - Prostate patients who have DNA-Repair mutations on IMPACT
completion: WITH CLINTRAC AS (SELECT PT_MRN AS CC_MRN FROM DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS JOIN DV.PATIENT_DIAGNOSIS_FINAL_ALL_V ON PDX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID JOIN DV.DIAGNOSIS_CATALOG ON PDX_DX_CATALOG_ID = DXCC_DX_CATALOG_ID WHERE (DXCC_ICD_CODE LIKE 'C61%' OR DXCC_ICD_CODE LIKE '185%') ) , TUMOR AS (SELECT PT_MRN AS TM_MRN FROM DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS JOIN DV.CDB_TUMOR_V ON CDTM_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID JOIN DV.DIAGNOSIS_CODE_CAT_ICDO_V ON CDTM_DX_CATALOG_ID = DXCC_DX_CATALOG_ID JOIN DV.ICDO_SITE_CATALOG_V ON CDTM_SITE_CATALOG_ID = ICSC_SITE_CATALOG_ID WHERE ICSC_SITE_CD LIKE 'C61%' ) , IMPACT AS (SELECT DISTINCT I.PT_MRN AS I_MRN, TRIM(P.PT_LAST_NAME) || ', ' || TRIM(P.PT_FIRST_NAME) AS PT_NAME, P.PT_BIRTH_DTE AS DOB, I.GENE FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_STRUCTURED_RESULTS_V I JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS P ON I.PT_MRN = P.PT_MRN LEFT JOIN TUMOR ON I.PT_MRN = TM_MRN LEFT JOIN CLINTRAC ON I.PT_MRN = CC_MRN WHERE COALESCE(TM_MRN, CC_MRN) IS NOT NULL AND I.METHOD = 'IMPACT' AND I.GENE IN ('ATM', 'BRCA1', 'BRCA2', 'BRIP1', 'CHEK2', 'FANCA', 'PALB2') ) SELECT CPE_MRN AS "MRN", PT_NAME AS "Patient Name", DOB AS "Date of Birth", LISTAGG(TRIM(GENE), ' | ') WITHIN GROUP( ORDER BY GENE) AS "Gene", CPE_ENC_DTE AS "Appt Date", CLD_DEPT_NAME AS "Department Name", CRE_RES_NAME AS "Treating Physician" FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IMPACT ON CPE_MRN = I_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID AND CRE_RES_TYP = 'Physician' JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 = 'MED' AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 = 'GU' JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS = 'Sch' AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT date AND CURRENT date + 14 DAY GROUP BY CPE_MRN, PT_NAME, DOB, CPE_ENC_DTE, CLD_DEPT_NAME, CRE_RES_NAME ORDER BY CPE_ENC_DTE, CRE_RES_NAME

prompt: Provide a bimonthly list of 06-107 consents in GYN Surgery from patients who have a language preference other than English.
completion: WITH CONSENT AS (SELECT TRIM(CRDB.PT_MRN) MRN, DATE(CRDB.CRNT_CONSENT_DATE) AS PART_A_CONSENT_DATE, PHYSICIAN_OF_RECORD AS PART_A_TREATING_MD, CONSENT_PRFSNL AS CONSENTING_PROFESSIONAL FROM NN.CRDB_DASH_PT_REG CRDB JOIN NN.CRDB_DASH_PT PT ON CRDB.PRT_ID = PT.PRT_ID AND CRDB.PT_MRN = PT.PT_MRN WHERE CRDB.PRT_ID = '06-107' AND REG_ID = '100' AND CRNT_ELGBL_STATUS_DSCRP NOT IN ('Ineligible', 'Cancel') AND TRUNC(CONSENT_DATE) BETWEEN '2022-01-01' AND CURRENT DATE AND PHYSICIAN_OF_RECORD IN ('ABU-RUSTUM, NADEEM R', 'AVIKI, EMELINE', 'BROACH, VANCE ANDREW', 'BROWN, CAROL L', 'CHI, DENNIS S', 'GARDNER, GINGER J', 'JEWELL, ELIZABETH', 'LEITAO, MARIO M', 'LONG ROCHE, KARA', 'MUELLER, JENNIFER', 'SONODA, YUKIO', 'ZIVANOVIC, OLIVER') ) SELECT DISTINCT MRN, PT_LAST_NAME AS LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME AS FIRST_NAME, AV_DESC AS PT_LANGUAGE, PART_A_CONSENT_DATE, PART_A_TREATING_MD, CONSENTING_PROFESSIONAL FROM CONSENT JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PT_MRN = MRN AND PT_PRIMARY_LANG<> 'ENG' LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS ON AV_ELEMENT = 'PRIMARY_LANG' AND AV_CODE = PT_PRIMARY_LANG ORDER BY MRN;

prompt: I am looking to find a population of patients with a prostatectomy or prostate biopsy for prostate cancer with neuroendocrine prostate cancer on their pathology.
completion: WITH INIT AS (SELECT SSE_MRN, SSE_SURG_DTE, SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD, SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC, SSP_SURG_LAST_NM, SSP_SURG_FIRST_NM, SSP_SURG_SVC_CD FROM IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE ON SSE_LOG_ID = SSP_LOG_ID AND SSE_ENC_CSN_ID = SSP_ENC_CSN_ID WHERE (SSE_SURG_LOC not like '%IR%' AND SSE_SURG_LOC not like '%ENDO%' AND SSE_SOURCE_TYPE <> 'E') AND SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD IN ('55899', '38570', '49321', '55845', '55866', '55700', '52354', '55821', '55705', '52204', '55706') ) SELECT DISTINCT PRPT_MRN, SSE_SURG_DTE, SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD, SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC, PRPT_PROCEDURE_DTE, PRPT_REPORT_DTE, PRPT_REPORT_TYPE_DESC, PRPT_ACCESSION_NO, CAST(PRPT_REPORT AS VARCHAR(32000)) AS REPORT_TX FROM INIT LEFT JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V ON SSE_MRN = PRPT_MRN WHERE PRPT_REPORT IS NOT NULL AND CONTAINS("PRPT_REPORT", '("Neuroendocrine" OR "small cell" OR "small cell" OR "large cell" OR "carcinoid" OR "Paneth cell")') = 1

prompt: List of patients seen by Dr. Guyer for Chemotherapy HSR, Acute Urticaria, and Chronic Spontaneous Urticaria and any corresponding testing performed after the initial visit and any corresponding follow-up visits after the initial visit.
completion: WITH CDOC AS (SELECT DISTINCT CDD_MRN, CDD_DOC_GUID, CDD_SERVICE_DTE, CDD_DOC_NAME, OP_DISPLAY_NAME, CDO_SECTION, CDO_ITEM_NAME, CDO_VALUE_TEXT FROM IDB.CD_DOCUMENT LEFT JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION ON CDD_DOC_GUID = CDO_DOC_GUID AND CDD_AUTHORED_DTE = CDO_AUTHORED_DTE JOIN IDB.OMS_PROVIDER ON CDD_AUTH_PROV_GUID = OP_PVDR_GUID WHERE CDD_CANCEL_IND <> '1' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND <> '1' AND OP_PVDR_NO= '029496' AND CDD_SERVICE_DTE BETWEEN '2022-11-01' AND '2023-05-31' AND (LOCATE('T45.1X5A', UPPER (CDO_VALUE_TEXT)) >= 1 OR LOCATE('L50.8', UPPER (CDO_VALUE_TEXT)) >= 1 OR LOCATE('L50.1', UPPER (CDO_VALUE_TEXT)) >= 1 ) ) , CDOCINITIAL AS (SELECT * FROM (SELECT DISTINCT CDD_MRN, CDD_DOC_GUID, CDD_SERVICE_DTE AS INITIAL_VISIT_DATE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CDD_MRN ORDER BY CDD_SERVICE_DTE ASC) AS RN, CDD_DOC_NAME, OP_DISPLAY_NAME, CDO_SECTION, CDO_ITEM_NAME, CDO_VALUE_TEXT FROM CDOC) WHERE RN = 1 ) , CDOCFOLLOW AS (SELECT * FROM (SELECT DISTINCT D.CDD_MRN, D.CDD_DOC_GUID, D.CDD_SERVICE_DTE AS FOLLOWUP_VISIT_DATE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY D.CDD_MRN ORDER BY D.CDD_SERVICE_DTE ASC) AS RNF, D.CDD_DOC_NAME, D.CDO_ITEM_NAME, D.CDO_VALUE_TEXT FROM CDOC D JOIN CDOCINITIAL CI ON D.CDD_MRN = CI.CDD_MRN AND D.CDD_SERVICE_DTE> INITIAL_VISIT_DATE WHERE D.CDD_DOC_NAME = 'Follow Up - DOM-Allergy/Immunology' ) WHERE RNF = 1 ) , SURG AS (SELECT DISTINCT SSE_MRN, SSE_SURG_DTE, INITIAL_VISIT_DATE, SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD AS SURG_CODE, SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC AS SURG_DESC, TRIM(SSP_SURG_LAST_NM) || ', ' || SSP_SURG_FIRST_NM AS SURGEON_NAME FROM IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE ON SSE_LOG_ID = SSP_LOG_ID AND SSE_ENC_CSN_ID = SSP_ENC_CSN_ID JOIN CDOCINITIAL ON CDD_MRN = SSE_MRN AND SSE_SURG_DTE> INITIAL_VISIT_DATE WHERE (SSE_SURG_LOC not like '%IR%' AND SSE_SURG_LOC not like '%ENDO%' AND SSE_SOURCE_TYPE <> 'E') ) , SURGERIES AS (SELECT DISTINCT SSE_MRN, LISTAGG(COALESCE(STRIP(SSE_SURG_DTE), '')||' : '|| COALESCE(STRIP(SURG_CODE), '')||' - '|| COALESCE(STRIP(SURG_DESC), '')||' | ', CHR(13) || CHR(10)) WITHIN GROUP ( ORDER BY SURG_CODE) AS PROCEDURES FROM SURG GROUP BY SSE_MRN, SSE_SURG_DTE) , DIAGNOSIS AS (SELECT DISTINCT PBD_MRN, DX_CLSF_CD AS DIAGNOSIS_CODE, CLM_CD_TYPE, CLM_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS DIAGNOSIS_DESC FROM IDB.PBD_DTL JOIN IDB.PBD_DX ON PBD_MRN = DX_MRN AND PBD_INV_NO = DX_INV_NO JOIN IDB.CLM ON DX_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN CDOCINITIAL CIL ON PBD_MRN = CIL.CDD_MRN WHERE 1=1 AND DX_CLSF_CD IN ('T45.1X5A', 'L50.8', 'L50.1') ) SELECT DISTINCT CDI.CDD_MRN AS MRN, CDI.CDD_DOC_GUID AS DOCUMENT_GUID, INITIAL_VISIT_DATE, CDI.CDO_VALUE_TEXT AS INITIAL_DOCUMENT_TEXT, FOLLOWUP_VISIT_DATE, CFO.CDO_VALUE_TEXT AS FOLLOWUP_DOCUMENT_TEXT, CDI.OP_DISPLAY_NAME AS PHYSICIAN_NAME, DIAGNOSIS_CODE, DIAGNOSIS_DESC, PROCEDURES FROM CDOCINITIAL CDI LEFT JOIN CDOCFOLLOW CFO ON CDI.CDD_MRN = CFO.CDD_MRN LEFT JOIN DIAGNOSIS ON CDI.CDD_MRN = PBD_MRN LEFT JOIN SURGERIES SRG ON SSE_MRN = CDI.CDD_MRN ORDER BY CDI.CDD_MRN;

prompt: Provide a list of patients treated with radiation therapy who had one of the specified drugs listed in Prescription Writer or Medication Profile before radiation.
completion: WITH RT AS (SELECT DISTINCT RTC_TX_MRN, RTC_TX_PLAN_NAME, RTC_PRIMARY_REF_POINT, RTC_TX_START_DTE, RTC_TX_STOP_DTE, RTC_TX_ELAPSED_DAYS, RTC_TX_PLANNED_FRACTIONS, RTC_TX_DELIVERED_FRACTIONS, RTC_TX_PLANNED_DOSE, RTC_TX_DELIVERED_DOSE, RTC_DOSE_CORRECTION FROM IDB.RADONC_TREATMENT_COURSE WHERE RTC_TX_START_DTE BETWEEN '2010-01-01' AND '2019-06-04' ) , HML AS (SELECT HCPR_MRN, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, RTC_TX_PLAN_NAME, RTC_TX_START_DTE, RTC_TX_STOP_DTE , HCPR_CREATED_DTE RX_CREATE_DATE , HGN_GENERIC_NAME AS GENERIC_NAME , HCPR_PRESCRIPTION_TYPE_DESC AS RX_TYPE FROM RT JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PT_MRN = RTC_TX_MRN JOIN IDB.HML_CLIENT_PRESCRIPTION ON RTC_TX_MRN = HCPR_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_CLIENT_VISIT ON OCV_VISIT_GUID = HCPR_VISIT_GUID LEFT JOIN IDB.HML_GENERIC_NAME ON HGN_GENERIC_NAME_ID = HCPR_GENERIC_NAME_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_USER USR ON USR.OU_USER_GUID = HCPR_USER_GUID LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_USER REQ ON REQ.OU_USER_GUID = HCPR_CARE_PROV_GUID LEFT JOIN IDB.HML_RX_UNIT_OF_MEASURE UOM ON UOM.HRUM_RXUOM_ID = HCPR_DOSE_UOM_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.HML_RX_UNIT_OF_MEASURE PKG ON PKG.HRUM_RXUOM_ID = HCPR_INNER_PACKAGE_SIZE_UOM_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.HML_SCRIPT_FREQUENCY ON HSF_SCRIPT_FREQ_ID = HCPR_SCRIPT_FREQ_ID WHERE HCPR_STATUS_TYPE NOT IN (4, 5, 8) AND HCPR_CREATED_DTE IS NOT NULL AND((HCPR_PRESCRIPTION_TYPE = 1 AND HCPR_TRANSMISSION_STATUS IN (1, 2, 5) ) OR HCPR_PRESCRIPTION_TYPE = 3) AND(UPPER(HCPR_DRUG_NAME) LIKE '%ADALIMUMAB%' OR UPPER(HCPR_DRUG_NAME) LIKE '%HUMIRA%' OR UPPER(HCPR_DRUG_NAME) LIKE '%CERTOLIZUMAB%' OR UPPER(HCPR_DRUG_NAME) LIKE '%CIMZIA%' OR UPPER(HCPR_DRUG_NAME) LIKE '%ETANERCEPT%' OR UPPER(HCPR_DRUG_NAME) LIKE '%ENBREL%' OR UPPER(HCPR_DRUG_NAME) LIKE '%INFLIXIMAB%' OR UPPER(HCPR_DRUG_NAME) LIKE '%AVSOLA%' OR UPPER(HCPR_DRUG_NAME) LIKE '%INFLECTRA%' OR UPPER(HCPR_DRUG_NAME) LIKE '%REMICADE%' OR UPPER(HCPR_DRUG_NAME) LIKE '%RENFLEXIS%' OR UPPER(HCPR_DRUG_NAME) LIKE '%GOLIMUMAB%' OR UPPER(HCPR_DRUG_NAME) LIKE '%SIMPONSI%' OR UPPER(HGN_GENERIC_NAME) LIKE '%ADALIMUMAB%' OR UPPER(HGN_GENERIC_NAME) LIKE '%HUMIRA%' OR UPPER(HGN_GENERIC_NAME) LIKE '%CERTOLIZUMAB%' OR UPPER(HGN_GENERIC_NAME) LIKE '%CIMZIA%' OR UPPER(HGN_GENERIC_NAME) LIKE '%ETANERCEPT%' OR UPPER(HGN_GENERIC_NAME) LIKE '%ENBREL%' OR UPPER(HGN_GENERIC_NAME) LIKE '%INFLIXIMAB%' OR UPPER(HGN_GENERIC_NAME) LIKE '%AVSOLA%' OR UPPER(HGN_GENERIC_NAME) LIKE '%INFLECTRA%' OR UPPER(HGN_GENERIC_NAME) LIKE '%REMICADE%' OR UPPER(HGN_GENERIC_NAME) LIKE '%RENFLEXIS%' OR UPPER(HGN_GENERIC_NAME) LIKE '%GOLIMUMAB%' OR UPPER(HGN_GENERIC_NAME) LIKE '%SIMPONSI%') AND HCPR_CREATED_DTE <= RTC_TX_START_DTE ) , CIS AS (SELECT DISTINCT OO_MRN, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, RTC_TX_PLAN_NAME, RTC_TX_START_DTE, RTC_TX_STOP_DTE , OO_ORD_NAME, OOTO_SIGNIFIC_DTE FROM RT JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PT_MRN = RTC_TX_MRN JOIN IDB.OMS_ORDER ON RTC_TX_MRN = OO_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_MED_DETAIL ON OO_ORD_GUID = OMD_ORD_GUID JOIN IDB.OAS_ORD_TASK_OCCR ON OOTO_ORD_GUID = OO_ORD_GUID AND OOTO_STATUS_CD = 'Performed' JOIN IDB.OAS_CTLG_ITEM_TASK ON OOTO_CAT_ITEM_GUID = OCIT_GUID AND OCIT_LEVEL_NO = 0 WHERE OO_ORD_STS_CD NOT IN ('CANC', 'CANP', 'AUC3') AND(UPPER(OO_ORD_NAME) LIKE '%ADALIMUMAB%' OR UPPER(OO_ORD_NAME) LIKE '%HUMIRA%' OR UPPER(OO_ORD_NAME) LIKE '%CERTOLIZUMAB%' OR UPPER(OO_ORD_NAME) LIKE '%CIMZIA%' OR UPPER(OO_ORD_NAME) LIKE '%ETANERCEPT%' OR UPPER(OO_ORD_NAME) LIKE '%ENBREL%' OR UPPER(OO_ORD_NAME) LIKE '%INFLIXIMAB%' OR UPPER(OO_ORD_NAME) LIKE '%AVSOLA%' OR UPPER(OO_ORD_NAME) LIKE '%INFLECTRA%' OR UPPER(OO_ORD_NAME) LIKE '%REMICADE%' OR UPPER(OO_ORD_NAME) LIKE '%RENFLEXIS%' OR UPPER(OO_ORD_NAME) LIKE '%GOLIMUMAB%' OR UPPER(OO_ORD_NAME) LIKE '%SIMPONSI%') AND OOTO_SIGNIFIC_DTE <= RTC_TX_START_DTE ) SELECT RT.RTC_TX_MRN, PT.PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, RT.RTC_TX_PLAN_NAME, RT.RTC_TX_START_DTE, RT.RTC_TX_STOP_DTE, MAX(CASE WHEN HCPR_MRN IS NOT NULL THEN 'Y' END) AS "HML", MAX(CASE WHEN OO_MRN IS NOT NULL THEN 'Y' END) AS "eMAR" FROM RT JOIN IDB.PATIENT PT ON PT_MRN = RT.RTC_TX_MRN LEFT JOIN HML ON HCPR_MRN = RT.RTC_TX_MRN LEFT JOIN CIS ON OO_MRN = RT.RTC_TX_MRN WHERE HCPR_MRN IS NOT NULL OR OO_MRN IS NOT NULL GROUP BY RT.RTC_TX_MRN, PT.PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, RT.RTC_TX_PLAN_NAME, RT.RTC_TX_START_DTE, RT.RTC_TX_STOP_DTE

prompt: A list of H-/S-cases of specimen type "skin" with "follicular lymphoma" or "follicle center" or "germinal center" or "marginal zone lymphoma" or "low grade B cell lymphoma" or "pseudolymphoma" in the diagnosis section from 01/01/2000 to present.
completion: SELECT DISTINCT DMP.PRPT_MRN AS MRN , PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_BIRTH_DTE, PT_VITAL_STATUS, PT_DEATH_DTE , CASE WHEN PT_DEATH_DTE IS NULL THEN YEAR(CURRENT date - PT_BIRTH_DTE) END AS "Current Age" , DMP.PRPT_ACCESSION_NO AS "Accession No" , DMP.PRPT_REPORT_DTE AS "Report Date" , DMP.PRPT_PROCEDURE_DTE AS "Procedure Date" , SRG.PRPT_ACCESSION_NO AS RELATED_ACC_NO , SRG_DATE.DT_DTE AS RELATED_PROC_DTE , DMP.PRPT_REPORT_TYPE_DESC AS "Report Type" , DMP.PRPT_REPORT_TYPE , DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)diag[\w\W]*(?=I ATTEST)', DMP.PRPT_REPORT) AS DIAGNOSIS_TEXT , VARCHAR(DMP.PRPT_REPORT, 32000) AS "Report Text (first 32000 characters)" , (SELECT VARCHAR(PRPT_REPORT, 32000) AS REFERENCEDPATHTEXTFROM FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT WHERE PRPT_ACCESSION_NO = SRG.PRPT_ACCESSION_NO) AS REFERENCEDPATHTEXT FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V DMP LEFT JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_REFERENCES ON PRPTR_CHILD_PATH_RPT_ID = DMP.PRPT_PATH_RPT_ID LEFT JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT SRG ON SRG.PRPT_PATH_RPT_ID = PRPTR_PATH_RPT_ID LEFT JOIN DV.DATE_V SRG_DATE ON SRG_DATE.DT_DATE_ID = SRG.PRPT_PROCEDURE_DATE_ID JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = DMP.PRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID WHERE 1=1 AND SUBSTR(DMP.PRPT_ACCESSION_NO, 1, 1) IN ('H', 'S') AND (DMP.PRPT_REPORT_DTE >= '01/01/2000' OR DMP.PRPT_PROCEDURE_DTE >= '01/01/2000' ) AND CONTAINS(DMP.PRPT_REPORT, '("skin" AND ("follicular lymphoma" OR "follicle center" OR "germinal center" OR "marginal zone lymphoma" OR "low grade B cell lymphoma" OR "pseudolymphoma"))') = 1 AND DMP.PRPT_REPORT IS NOT NULL ORDER BY 1, 9, 8 ;

prompt: Identify the number of unilateral, bilateral, and prophylactic bilateral mastectomies by year for 2010 and 2011.
completion: WITH CTE AS (SELECT PBD_MRN, PBD_SVC_DTE, PBD_MODIFIER1, PBD_MODIFIER2, PBD_MODIFIER3, CASE WHEN PBD_MODIFIER1 IN ('50', '15') OR PBD_MODIFIER2 IN ('50', '15') OR PBD_MODIFIER2 IN ('50', '15') THEN 'B' ELSE 'U' END AS LAT FROM IDB.PBD_DTL JOIN IDB.PBD_CODE ON PBD_PBD_CD = PBC_PBD_CD WHERE PBD_SVC_DTE BETWEEN '2010-01-01' AND '2011-12-31' AND PBC_CPT_CD IN ('19301', '19302', '19303', '19304', '19305', '19307') ), LEFT AS (SELECT PBD_MRN, PBD_SVC_DTE FROM CTE WHERE (PBD_MODIFIER1 = 'LT' OR PBD_MODIFIER2 = 'LT' OR PBD_MODIFIER3 = 'LT') ), RIGHT AS (SELECT PBD_MRN, PBD_SVC_DTE FROM CTE WHERE (PBD_MODIFIER1 = 'RT' OR PBD_MODIFIER2 = 'RT' OR PBD_MODIFIER3 = 'RT') ), DETAIL AS (SELECT CTE.PBD_MRN, CTE.PBD_SVC_DTE, MIN(CASE WHEN LAT = 'B' OR (L.PBD_MRN IS NOT NULL AND R.PBD_MRN IS NOT NULL) THEN 'B' ELSE 'U' END) AS LATERALITY FROM CTE LEFT JOIN LEFT L ON CTE.PBD_MRN = L.PBD_MRN AND CTE.PBD_SVC_DTE = L.PBD_SVC_DTE LEFT JOIN RIGHT R ON CTE.PBD_MRN = R.PBD_MRN AND CTE.PBD_SVC_DTE = R.PBD_SVC_DTE GROUP BY CTE.PBD_MRN, CTE.PBD_SVC_DTE) SELECT YEAR(PBD_SVC_DTE) AS YR, COUNT(*) AS COUNT FROM DETAIL GROUP BY YEAR(PBD_SVC_DTE) WITH CTE AS (SELECT PBD_MRN, PBD_SVC_DTE, PBD_MODIFIER1, PBD_MODIFIER2, PBD_MODIFIER3, CASE WHEN PBD_MODIFIER1 IN ('50', '15') OR PBD_MODIFIER2 IN ('50', '15') OR PBD_MODIFIER2 IN ('50', '15') THEN 'B' ELSE 'U' END AS LAT FROM IDB.PBD_DTL JOIN IDB.PBD_CODE ON PBD_PBD_CD = PBC_PBD_CD JOIN IDB.PBD_DX ON DX_MRN = PBD_MRN AND DX_INV_NO = PBD_INV_NO AND DX_CLSF_CD IN ('V16.3', 'V84.01') WHERE PBD_SVC_DTE BETWEEN '2010-01-01' AND '2011-12-31' AND PBC_CPT_CD IN ('19301', '19302', '19303', '19304', '19305', '19307') ), LEFT AS (SELECT PBD_MRN, PBD_SVC_DTE FROM CTE WHERE (PBD_MODIFIER1 = 'LT' OR PBD_MODIFIER2 = 'LT' OR PBD_MODIFIER3 = 'LT') ), RIGHT AS (SELECT PBD_MRN, PBD_SVC_DTE FROM CTE WHERE (PBD_MODIFIER1 = 'RT' OR PBD_MODIFIER2 = 'RT' OR PBD_MODIFIER3 = 'RT') ), DETAIL AS (SELECT CTE.PBD_MRN, CTE.PBD_SVC_DTE, MIN(CASE WHEN LAT = 'B' OR (L.PBD_MRN IS NOT NULL AND R.PBD_MRN IS NOT NULL) THEN 'B' ELSE 'U' END) AS LATERALITY FROM CTE LEFT JOIN LEFT L ON CTE.PBD_MRN = L.PBD_MRN AND CTE.PBD_SVC_DTE = L.PBD_SVC_DTE LEFT JOIN RIGHT R ON CTE.PBD_MRN = R.PBD_MRN AND CTE.PBD_SVC_DTE = R.PBD_SVC_DTE GROUP BY CTE.PBD_MRN, CTE.PBD_SVC_DTE) SELECT YEAR(PBD_SVC_DTE) AS YR, COUNT(*) AS COUNT FROM DETAIL WHERE LATERALITY = 'B' GROUP BY YEAR(PBD_SVC_DTE)

prompt: Provide a list of RLC BRE provider pts since Jan 1, 2020
completion: WITH PTS AS (SELECT CPE_MRN AS MRN, PT_LAST_NAME LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME FIRST_NAME, PLA_LST_CHEMO_DTE LAST_CHEMO_DATE, PLA_LST_RT_DTE LAST_RT_DATE, PLA_LST_SURG_DTE LAST_SURG_DATE, CPE_ENC_DTE AS APPT_DATE, CLD_DEPT_NAME AS DEPT, CRE_RES_NAME AS PROVIDER_NAME, CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME AS VISIT_TYPE_NAME FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON CPE_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY ON CPE_MRN = PLA_MRN WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CPE_ENC_DTE >= '2020-01-01' AND CLD_CLD_CENTER = '1919' AND CRE_RES_NAME IN ('GODFREY, HENRY G.', 'KILLORAN, KATHLEEN A.', 'NOUVINI, ROSA') ) , DX AS (SELECT TM_MRN, TM_DX_DTE, CATEGORY1, CATEGORY2, CATEGORY3, MAX(CASE WHEN (TRIM(TM_PATH_STG_GRP) NOT IN ('', '88', '9', '99') AND TRIM(TM_PATH_STG_DSCR) NOT IN ('4', '6')) THEN TRIM(PATH_STG.AV_DESC) WHEN TRIM(TM_CLIN_STG_GRP) NOT IN ('', '88', '9', '99') THEN TRIM(CLIN_STG.AV_DESC) ELSE 'NO VALUE ENTERED' END) MAX_STAGE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY TM_MRN ORDER BY TM_DX_DTE) RN FROM (SELECT DISTINCT MRN FROM PTS) JOIN IDB.CDB_TUMOR ON MRN = TM_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS PATH_STG ON PATH_STG.AV_ELEMENT = 'PATH_STG_GRP' AND TM_PATH_STG_GRP = PATH_STG.AV_CODE LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS CLIN_STG ON CLIN_STG.AV_ELEMENT = 'CLIN_STG_GRP' AND TM_CLIN_STG_GRP = CLIN_STG.AV_CODE JOIN IDB.SEERGROUPING ON IDB.SEERF_ICDO(TM_SITE_CD, TM_HIST_CD) = RECODE WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND CATEGORY1 <> 'Miscellaneous' GROUP BY TM_MRN, TM_DX_DTE, CATEGORY1, CATEGORY2, CATEGORY3 ) SELECT P.*, YEAR(APPT_DATE - TM_DX_DTE) YRS_SINCE_DX, TM_DX_DTE, MAX_STAGE, CATEGORY1, CATEGORY2, CATEGORY3 FROM PTS P LEFT JOIN DX ON MRN = TM_MRN AND RN = 1

prompt: Identify patients who had a lymph node dissection with one of a list of specified providers and did not have a prostatectomy the same day.
completion: SELECT PBD_MRN AS MRN, PBD_SVC_DTE AS SVC_DTE, DOC_NAME FROM IDB.PBD_DTL JOIN IDB.PBD_CODE ON PBD_PBD_CD = PBC_PBD_CD JOIN IDB.PBD_INVOICE ON PBD_INV_NO = PBI_INV_NO JOIN IDB.DOC ON PBI_PERFORM_DR_NO = DOC_DR_NO LEFT JOIN (SELECT PBD_MRN AS MRN, PBD_SVC_DTE AS SVC_DTE FROM IDB.PBD_DTL JOIN IDB.PBD_CODE ON PBD_PBD_CD = PBC_PBD_CD WHERE PBC_CPT_CD IN ('55840', '55845', '55866', '55899') ) AS A ON MRN = PBD_MRN AND SVC_DTE = PBD_SVC_DTE WHERE PBC_CPT_CD IN ('38571', '38572') AND DOC_NAME IN ('GUILLONNEAU BERTRAND', 'LAUDONE VINCENT P', 'TOUIJER KARIM A') AND MRN IS NULL

prompt: Need volumes of Pulmonary function tests performed at MSK.
completion: SELECT PT_MRN AS MRN, MRPT_PERFORMED_DTE AS "Performed Date", MP_FULL_NM AS "Ordering Provider", OS_SVC_DESC AS "Ordering Service" , MRPT_CURRENT_LOCATION AS "Test Location", OCV_IP_OP_IND AS "IP/OP indicator" FROM DV.MEDICAL_REPORTS JOIN DV.RESULT_CATALOG_ITEM ON MPRT_RESULT_CATALOG_ITEM_ID = RCI_RESULT_CATALOG_ITEM_ID JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON MRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID LEFT JOIN DV.MEDPRO_V ON MRPT_ORDERING_PROVIDER_ID=MP_MEDPRO_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_CLIENT_VISIT ON OCV_VISIT_GUID = MRPT_CLIENT_VISIT_GUID LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_SERVICE ON OS_SVC_GUID = OCV_SVC_GUID WHERE 1=1 AND MRPT_REPORT_TYPE like '%PFT%' AND PT_LAST_NAME <> 'TEST' ORDER BY 1, 2

prompt: Please provide a list of lung microwave ablation performed at our institution
completion: WITH DEMOGRAPHICS AS (SELECT RRPT_MRN, RRPT_RPT_ID, PT_BIRTH_DTE, PT_DEATH_DTE, PT_DEATH_IND_DESC, RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE, RRPT_REPORT_TXT FROM DV.RADIOLOGY_REPORT_V JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON PT_MRN=RRPT_MRN WHERE RRPT_PROCEDURE_NAME = 'IR ABLATION LUNG/CHEST' AND RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE >= '2010-01-01' ), INDICATOR_NW AS (SELECT DISTINCT RRPT_RPT_ID NW_IND_ID, 'Y' NW_VAL FROM DV.RADIOLOGY_REPORT_V JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON PT_MRN=RRPT_MRN WHERE RRPT_PROCEDURE_NAME = 'IR ABLATION LUNG/CHEST' AND RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE >= '2010-01-01' AND (CONTAINS(RRPT_REPORT_TXT, '"neuwave"') <> 0) ), INDICATOR_M AS (SELECT DISTINCT RRPT_RPT_ID M_IND_ID, 'Y' M_VAL FROM DV.RADIOLOGY_REPORT_V JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON PT_MRN=RRPT_MRN WHERE RRPT_PROCEDURE_NAME = 'IR ABLATION LUNG/CHEST' AND RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE >= '2010-01-01' AND (CONTAINS(RRPT_REPORT_TXT, '"microsulis"') <> 0) ), INDICATOR_A AS (SELECT DISTINCT RRPT_RPT_ID A_IND_ID, 'Y' A_VAL FROM DV.RADIOLOGY_REPORT_V JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON PT_MRN=RRPT_MRN WHERE RRPT_PROCEDURE_NAME = 'IR ABLATION LUNG/CHEST' AND RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE >= '2010-01-01' AND (CONTAINS(RRPT_REPORT_TXT, '"amica"') <> 0) ), INDICATOR_MW AS (SELECT DISTINCT RRPT_RPT_ID MW_IND_ID, 'Y' MW_VAL FROM DV.RADIOLOGY_REPORT_V JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON PT_MRN=RRPT_MRN WHERE RRPT_PROCEDURE_NAME = 'IR ABLATION LUNG/CHEST' AND RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE >= '2010-01-01' AND (CONTAINS(RRPT_REPORT_TXT, '"medwave"') <> 0) ), INDICATOR_C AS (SELECT DISTINCT RRPT_RPT_ID C_IND_ID, 'Y' C_VAL FROM DV.RADIOLOGY_REPORT_V JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON PT_MRN=RRPT_MRN WHERE RRPT_PROCEDURE_NAME = 'IR ABLATION LUNG/CHEST' AND RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE >= '2010-01-01' AND (CONTAINS(RRPT_REPORT_TXT, '"covidien"') <> 0) ) SELECT RRPT_MRN MRN, RRPT_RPT_ID, PT_BIRTH_DTE, PT_DEATH_DTE, PT_DEATH_IND_DESC, RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE, NW_VAL AS "Neuwave Indicator", M_VAL AS "Microsulis Indicator", A_VAL AS "Amica Indicator", MW_VAL AS "Medwave Indicator", C_VAL AS "Covidien Emprint Indicator", RRPT_REPORT_TXT FROM DEMOGRAPHICS LEFT JOIN INDICATOR_NW ON NW_IND_ID = RRPT_RPT_ID LEFT JOIN INDICATOR_M ON M_IND_ID = RRPT_RPT_ID LEFT JOIN INDICATOR_A ON A_IND_ID = RRPT_RPT_ID LEFT JOIN INDICATOR_MW ON MW_IND_ID = RRPT_RPT_ID LEFT JOIN INDICATOR_C ON C_IND_ID = RRPT_RPT_ID ; WITH MRNS AS (SELECT DISTINCT RRPT_MRN FROM DV.RADIOLOGY_REPORT_V JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON PT_MRN=RRPT_MRN WHERE RRPT_PROCEDURE_NAME = 'IR ABLATION LUNG/CHEST' AND RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE >= '2010-01-01' ) SELECT PT_MRN, DT_DTE AS "Tumor Diagnosis Date", DXCC_ICD_CODE AS "ICD-O Histology Code", DXCC_ICD_MSK_DESC AS "ICD-O Histology Description", ICSC_SITE_CD AS "ICD-O Site Code", ICSC_ICDO_SITE_MSK_DESC AS "ICD-O Site Description", TCA_CASE_STS_DESC AS "Case Status" FROM DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS JOIN DV.CDB_TUMOR_V ON CDTM_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID JOIN DV.DATE_V ON CDTM_DX_DATE_ID = DT_DATE_ID JOIN DV.DIAGNOSIS_CODE_CAT_ICDO_V ON CDTM_DX_CATALOG_ID = DXCC_DX_CATALOG_ID JOIN DV.ICDO_SITE_CATALOG_V ON CDTM_SITE_CATALOG_ID = ICSC_SITE_CATALOG_ID JOIN DV.TUMOR_CASE_ATTRIBUTES_V ON CDTM_CASE_ATTR_ID = TUMOR_CASE_ATTR_ID WHERE PT_MRN IN (SELECT RRPT_MRN FROM MRNS) ORDER BY 1, 2 ;

prompt: Provide a list of pre surgical testing patients scheduled pre surgical testing appointment, scheduled date of surgery, if cases are coordinated with provider visit with a manhattan location
completion: WITH APPTS AS (SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME , A.CLD_DEPT_NAME , A.CLD_CLD_CENTER, B.CRE_RES_NAME, B.CRE_RES_ID , CPE_ENC_DTE , CPE_APPT_MADE_DTE AS APPT_MADE_DATE, CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR, CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME, CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID, D.CRE_RES_NAME AS REF_MD, C.CLD_DEPT_NAME AS REF_DEPT, D.CRE_RES_ID AS REF_RES_ID, C.CLD_CLD_CENTER AS REF_SITE, CPE_ENC_CSN_ID FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT A ON CPE_DEPT_ID = A.CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE B ON B.CRE_RES_ID = CPE_VST_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON CPE_MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT C ON C.CLD_DEPT_ID = CPE_REF_DEP_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE D ON D.CRE_RES_ID = CPE_REF_RES_ID WHERE 1=1 AND CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Comp', 'Arrived') AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN '2019-01-01' AND '2021-12-10' AND A.CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 = 'PST' ) , SRG AS (SELECT DISTINCT SSE_MRN, SSE_SURG_DTE, SSP_ENC_CSN_ID, SSP_RES_ID, SSP_SURG_LAST_NM, SSP_SURG_FIRST_NM, SSP_PROC_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY SSE_MRN, CPE_ENC_DTE, SSE_SURG_DTE ORDER BY SSE_MRN, CPE_ENC_DTE, SSE_SURG_DTE DESC) AS PROC FROM APPTS A JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT ON CPE_MRN = SSE_MRN AND SSE_SURG_DTE >= CPE_ENC_DTE AND SSE_SOURCE_TYPE = 'O' JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE ON SSE_LOG_ID = SSP_LOG_ID WHERE 1=1 AND SSP_RES_ID = REF_RES_ID ORDER BY 1, 2, 7) , COORAPPT AS (SELECT DISTINCT Y.CPE_MRN AS CO_MRN, A.CLD_DEPT_NAME AS CO_DEPT, A.CLD_CLD_CENTER AS CO_SITE, B.CRE_RES_NAME AS CO_NAME, B.CRE_RES_ID AS CO_RESID, Y.CPE_ENC_DTE AS CO_APPT_DTE, E.CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME AS CO_VT, Y.CPE_ENC_CSN_ID FROM APPTS X JOIN IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER Y ON X.CPE_MRN = Y.CPE_MRN AND REF_RES_ID = Y.CPE_VST_RES_ID AND CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Comp', 'Arrived') AND X.CPE_ENC_DTE = Y.CPE_ENC_DTE JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT A ON CPE_DEPT_ID = A.CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE B ON B.CRE_RES_ID = CPE_VST_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE E ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = E.CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE 1=1 ) SELECT * FROM (SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN AS MRN, CLD_DEPT_NAME AS PST_DEPT, CLD_CLD_CENTER AS PST_SITE, A.CPE_ENC_DTE AS APPT_DTE, APPT_MADE_DATE, REF_MD, REF_DEPT, REF_SITE, CO_NAME, CO_DEPT, CO_SITE, CO_VT, SSE_SURG_DTE, SSP_RES_ID, SSP_SURG_LAST_NM, SSP_SURG_FIRST_NM, SSP_PROC_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CPE_MRN, A.CPE_ENC_DTE ORDER BY CPE_MRN, A.CPE_ENC_DTE, SSE_SURG_DTE ASC) AS SRG FROM APPTS A LEFT JOIN COORAPPT ON CO_MRN = CPE_MRN AND CO_APPT_DTE = A.CPE_ENC_DTE AND CO_RESID = REF_RES_ID LEFT JOIN SRG B ON CPE_MRN = SSE_MRN AND SSE_SURG_DTE >= A.CPE_ENC_DTE AND SSP_RES_ID = REF_RES_ID WHERE 1=1 ) AS X WHERE SRG = 1

prompt: Provide a list of blastic plasmacytoid dendritic cell neoplasm patients in one search and a list of chronic myelomonocytic leukemia patients in another search
completion: WITH X AS (SELECT DISTINCT "t1"."PT_MRN" AS "MRN", PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_BIRTH_DTE AS DOB, "t2"."PRPT_ACCESSION_NO" AS "Pathology Report", PRPT_REPORT_TYPE, "t3"."PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_DESC" AS "Pathology Report Type", "t4"."DT_DTE" AS "Pathology Procedure Date", UPPER(CASE WHEN LENGTH(PRPT_REPORT) <= 15000 THEN RTRIM(CAST(SUBSTR(PRPT_REPORT, 1, 15000) AS VARCHAR(15000))) ELSE CAST(SUBSTR(PRPT_REPORT, 1, 15000) AS VARCHAR(15000)) END) AS TEXT, CASE WHEN UPPER(DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)SPECIMENS SUBMITTED[\w\W]*(?=DIAGNOSIS:)', PRPT_REPORT)) = '' THEN UPPER(DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)SPECIMENSSUBMITTED[\w\W]*(?=DIAGNOSIS:)', PRPT_REPORT)) ELSE UPPER(DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)SPECIMENS SUBMITTED[\w\W]*(?=DIAGNOSIS:)', PRPT_REPORT)) END AS "SPECIMENS SUBMITTED" FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V" "t1" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED" "t6" ON "t1"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t6"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V" "t2" ON "t6"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t2"."PRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATH_RPRT_TYPE_LOOKUP" "t3" ON "t2"."PRPT_REPORT_TYPE" = "t3"."PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_CD" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" "t4" ON "t2"."PRPT_PROCEDURE_DATE_ID" = "t4"."DT_DATE_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" "t5" ON "t2"."PRPT_REPORT_DATE_ID" = "t5"."DT_DATE_ID" WHERE 1=1 AND "t2"."PRPT_REPORT" IS NOT NULL AND("t2"."PRPT_ACCESSION_NO" LIKE 'H%' OR "t2"."PRPT_ACCESSION_NO" LIKE 'S%') AND CONTAINS("t2"."PRPT_REPORT", '("CMML" OR "chronic myelomonocytic leukemia")') = 1 AND "t4"."DT_DTE" >= '2021-06-01' ) , IMPACT AS (SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN, PDWS_NAME FROM DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML DT ON PDRX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML_SETTINGS ON PDRX_PATH_DMP_RESULTS_XML_ID = PDRXS_PATH_DMP_RESULTS_XML_ID JOIN DVDMC.PATHOLOGY_DMP_WEBSVC_SETTINGS ON PDRXS_SETTING_ID = PDWS_SETTING_ID WHERE 1=1 AND PDWS_NAME like '%IMPACT%' AND PT_MRN IN (SELECT MRN FROM X) ) , FLOW AS (SELECT DISTINCT "t1"."PT_MRN" AS "MRN", PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_BIRTH_DTE AS DOB, "t2"."PRPT_ACCESSION_NO" AS "Pathology Report", PRPT_REPORT_TYPE, "t3"."PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_DESC" AS "Pathology Report Type", "t4"."DT_DTE" AS "Pathology Procedure Date" FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V" "t1" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED" "t6" ON "t1"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t6"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V" "t2" ON "t6"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t2"."PRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATH_RPRT_TYPE_LOOKUP" "t3" ON "t2"."PRPT_REPORT_TYPE" = "t3"."PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_CD" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" "t4" ON "t2"."PRPT_PROCEDURE_DATE_ID" = "t4"."DT_DATE_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" "t5" ON "t2"."PRPT_REPORT_DATE_ID" = "t5"."DT_DATE_ID" WHERE 1=1 AND "t2"."PRPT_REPORT" IS NOT NULL AND "t4"."DT_DTE" >= '2021-06-01' AND "t2"."PRPT_ACCESSION_NO" LIKE 'F%' AND "t1"."PT_MRN" IN (SELECT MRN FROM X) ) SELECT DISTINCT X.* FROM X WHERE MRN IN (SELECT PT_MRN FROM IMPACT) AND MRN IN (SELECT MRN FROM FLOW)

prompt: Survivorship patients seen that move back to the physician practices
completion: WITH APPT AS (SELECT CPE_MRN, CPE_ENC_CSN_ID, CPE_ENC_DTE, CLD_DEPT_NAME, CRE_RES_TYP, CRE_RES_NAME, CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR, CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME, CLD_CLD_CENTER, CASE WHEN CLD_DEPT_NAME like 'COL%' THEN 'COL' WHEN CLD_DEPT_NAME like 'URO%' THEN 'URO' WHEN CLD_DEPT_NAME like 'THR%' THEN 'THR' WHEN CLD_DEPT_NAME like 'GYN%' THEN 'GYN' WHEN CLD_DEPT_NAME like 'LYM%' THEN 'LYM' WHEN CLD_DEPT_NAME like 'BRE%' THEN 'BRE' WHEN (CLD_DEPT_NAME like 'HN%' OR CLD_DEPT_NAME like 'HEAD AND NECK%') THEN 'HNS' WHEN CLD_DEPT_NAME like 'RO 1275%' THEN 'Prostate RT' END AS SERVICE, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_1 FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN '2017-01-01' AND '2018-12-31' AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_1 NOT IN ('REG', 'Reg') AND (CLD_DEPT_NAME LIKE '%SVR%' OR CLD_DEPT_NAME LIKE '%SURVIVOR%' OR CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME LIKE '%SNP %' OR CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR like 'SAPP %') AND CRE_RES_NAME NOT IN ('SUPAN, CHRISTIANNE CANDA', 'KENNY, SHEILA A') ) SELECT A.CPE_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, A.CPE_ENC_CSN_ID, A.CPE_ENC_DTE, A.CLD_DEPT_NAME, A.CRE_RES_TYP, A.CRE_RES_NAME, A.CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR, A.CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME, A.CLD_CLD_CENTER, E.CPE_ENC_DTE, R.CRE_RES_NAME FROM APPT A JOIN IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER E ON A.CPE_MRN = E.CPE_MRN AND E.CPE_ENC_DTE >= A.CPE_ENC_DTE AND A.SERVICE = CASE WHEN D.CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 like 'COL%' THEN 'COL' WHEN D.CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 like 'URO%' THEN 'URO' WHEN D.CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 like 'THR%' THEN 'THR' WHEN D.CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 like 'GYN%' THEN 'GYN' WHEN D.CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 like 'LYM%' THEN 'LYM' WHEN D.CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 like 'BRE%' THEN 'BRE' WHEN (D.CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 like 'HN%' OR D.CLD_DEPT_NAME like 'HEAD AND NECK%') THEN 'HNS' WHEN D.CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 like 'RDO%' THEN 'Prostate RT' END JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE R ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT D ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE VT ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON A.CPE_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE E.CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND E.CPE_ENC_DTE >= '2017-01-01' AND R.CRE_RES_TYP IN ('Physician')

prompt: Please alter syntax of IS21403
completion: SELECT DISTINCT RPD_NUMERIC_CODE RMS_NUMBER, RPD_NAME RMS_NAME, COALESCE(COALESCE(SVC2.RSVD_MSK_ADT_SYNONYM, SVC1.RSVD_MSK_ADT_SYNONYM), 'Missing from D37/D48002!') MISSING_RMS_SVC, D.CLD_DEPT_ABBR CAD_DEPT, D.CLD_DEPT_NAME CAD_NAME, MAX_APPT_DTE FROM IDB.CL_RES_DEPT RD INNER JOIN IDB.RMS_PHYSICIAN_DICT_DN3 DN3 ON (RD.CPD_RES_ID=DN3.RPD_NUMERIC_CODE AND RPD_INACTIVE_FLAG<>'Y' AND RPD_DELETION_FLAG<>'Y') INNER JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT D ON (RD.CPD_DEPT_ID=D.CLD_DEPT_ID AND ISNULL(CLD_REC_STS, '')='') LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM IDB.RMS_MSK_ADT_SERVICE_CROSSWALK_DICT_DN48002 WHERE RMASC_INACTIVE_FLAG='N' AND RMASC_DELETION_FLAG='N' ) X ON D.CLD_DEPT_ABBR=X.RMASC_ADT_SERVICE LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM IDB.RMS_SERVICE_DICT_DN37 WHERE RSVD_INACTIVE_FLAG='N' ) SVC1 ON SVC1.RSVD_MSK_ADT_SYNONYM = D.CLD_DEPT_ABBR LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM IDB.RMS_SERVICE_DICT_DN37 WHERE RSVD_INACTIVE_FLAG='N' ) SVC2 ON SVC2.RSVD_RECORD_NUMBER = X.RMASC_GE_SERVICE_REC_NO LEFT JOIN (SELECT RPD_RECORD_NUMBER DN3ID, RPD_HIS_PRIMARY_SVC_REC_NO DN37ID FROM IDB.RMS_PHYSICIAN_DICT_DN3 DN3 UNION SELECT RAS_RECORD_NUMBER DN3ID, RAS_HIS_ALLOWABLE_SERV_REC_NO DN37ID FROM IDB.RMS_ALLOWABLE_SERVICES_DICT_DN3E DN3E) DN3E ON (DN3.RPD_RECORD_NUMBER=DN3E.DN3ID AND COALESCE(SVC2.RSVD_RECORD_NUMBER, SVC1.RSVD_RECORD_NUMBER) = DN3E.DN37ID) LEFT JOIN (SELECT RES_ID, DEPT_ID, MAX(APPT_DTE) MAX_APPT_DTE, MAX(CPE_CPE_IP_IND) CPE_CPE_IP_IND FROM (SELECT CPE_VST_RES_ID RES_ID, CPE_DEPT_ID DEPT_ID, CPE_ENC_DTE APPT_DTE, CPE_ENC_TYP_CD, CPE_CPE_APPT_STS, CPE_CPE_IP_IND FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER UNION SELECT CPE_REF_RES_ID RES_ID, CPE_REF_DEP_ID DEPT_ID, CPE_ENC_DTE APPT_DTE, CPE_ENC_TYP_CD, CPE_CPE_APPT_STS, CPE_CPE_IP_IND FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER LEFT JOIN IDB.RMS_PHYSICIAN_DICT_DN3 ON CPE_VST_RES_ID=RPD_NUMERIC_CODE WHERE COALESCE(CPE_REF_RES_ID, '') <>'' AND CPE_REF_DEP_ID IS NOT NULL AND RPD_NUMERIC_CODE IS NULL ) A WHERE CPE_ENC_TYP_CD = '50' AND CPE_CPE_APPT_STS NOT IN ('Can', 'No Show') GROUP BY RES_ID, DEPT_ID) APPT ON RPD_NUMERIC_CODE=RES_ID AND D.CLD_DEPT_ID=DEPT_ID WHERE COALESCE(CPD_CAD_DEPT_INACTIVE_IND, 'N')<>'Y' AND CPE_CPE_IP_IND<>'INPATIENT' AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_10 NOT LIKE '%R_ACI%' AND DN3E.DN3ID IS NULL ORDER BY 2, 3

prompt: Provide a twice-weekly report of patients scheduled for an appointment with Dr. Reidy-Lagunes the next day (Wed and Fri), where the appointment is a new visit or the patient has a neuroendocrine tumor diagnosis.
completion: SELECT CPP_MRN, CPP_PT_NAME, CPP_SEX, CPE_ENC_DTE, TIME(CPE_APPT_DT) APPT_TIME, CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME, MIN_ICD9_DTE FROM IDB.CL_PAS_PATIENT JOIN IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER ON CPE_CL_PT_ID = CPP_CL_PT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID LEFT JOIN (SELECT CC_MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS MIN_ICD9_DTE FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY ON CC_MRN = PLA_MRN WHERE CC_CLSF_CD LIKE '209%' AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND (CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) GROUP BY CC_MRN) AS A ON CC_MRN = CPE_MRN WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS = 'Sch' AND CRE_RES_ID = '014035' AND CPE_ENC_DTE = CURRENT DATE + 1 DAY AND (CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR LIKE '%NV%' OR CC_MRN IS NOT NULL)

prompt: Create a Tableau dashboard for a list of COVID Positive Employees Not Cleared To Return to Work.
completion: SELECT TRIM(EMPLOYEE_ID) EMPLOYEE_ID, TRIM(MRN) MRN, CVP_FIRST_NAME FIRST_NAME, CVP_LAST_NAME LAST_NAME, CVP_BIRTH_DTE DATE_OF_BIRTH, RESULT, CASE WHEN DATE(MIN_IDENTIFIED_DT) < '2020-03-01' THEN DATE('2020-03-01') ELSE DATE(MIN_IDENTIFIED_DT) END AS MIN_IDENTIFIED_DT, DATE(MAX_IDENTIFIED_DT) MAX_IDENTIFIED_DT, POSITIVE_SOURCES, CVP_JOB_TITLE JOB_TITLE, CVP_JOB_FAMILY JOB_FAMILY, CVP_JOB_FAMILY_GROUP JOB_FAMILY_GROUP, CVP_WORK_LOCATION WORK_LOCATION, TRIM(CVP_DEPT_ID) || ' - ' || TRIM(CVP_DEPT_DESC) COST_CENTER, CASE WHEN CVP_SHORT_TERM_DIS_FLAG = 'Y' THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS ON_LEAVE FROM IDB.COVID19_EMPLOYEE_INFO A JOIN IDB.COVID19_VACCINE_PERSON B ON EMPLOYEE_ID = CVP_EMPLOYEE_ID WHERE RESULT = 'Positive' AND DATE_OF_DEATH IS NULL AND CVP_STATUS = 'Active' ORDER BY DATE(MIN_IDENTIFIED_DT) DESC

prompt: this dataline report is extremely helpful! Is it possible to please add a way to include a tab that indicates how many individual (n) patients completed the survey. It seems there are duplicates at this time, with some patents completing 2 or 3 times. It would be great to include the number of patients who completed the survey
completion: WITH SRV AS (SELECT DISTINCT EF_MRN, TO_CHAR(CURRENT date - 15 DAYS , 'YYYY-MM-DD') || ' To ' || TO_CHAR (CURRENT DATE , 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS REPORT_RANGE, date (EF_SUBMISSION_DT) AS SUBMISSION_DATE FROM IDB.EF_FORM JOIN IDB.EF_PATIENT_INFO ON EPI_MRN = EF_MRN WHERE EF_FORM_ALIAS = 'YoungWomen_with_BreastCancer' AND DATE(EF_SUBMISSION_DT) >= CURRENT date - 15 DAYS ) SELECT REPORT_RANGE, COUNT(DISTINCT EF_MRN) DISTINCT_PATIENT_COUNT, COUNT(EF_MRN) AS TOTAL_SUBMISSIONS_COUNT FROM SRV GROUP BY REPORT_RANGE ; SELECT EAS_ASSESS_STS AS SURVEY_STATUS, COUNT(EA_PT_INFO_ID) NO_OF_SURVEYS FROM IDB.EF_ASSESSMENT JOIN IDB.EF_ASSESSMENT_STS ON EA_STS_ID = EAS_ASSESS_STS_ID WHERE EA_SURV_ID = 171 AND EAS_ASSESS_STS NOT IN ('Cancelled') AND date (EA_ASSIGN_DT) BETWEEN CURRENT date - 15 DAYS AND CURRENT date GROUP BY EAS_ASSESS_STS ;

prompt: How to query the patient's financial disposition field from the "financial assistance referral" order
completion: SELECT OO_MRN, OO_ENTER_DTE, OO_ORD_GUID, OO_ORD_ID, OO_ORD_NAME, OUO_USER_NAME, OUO_USER_ROLE_TYPE, OUO_PVDR_NAME, OUO_PVDR_ROLE_TYPE, OO_SUMMARY_LINE, OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE, OUO_ATN_PVDR_NAME , OUO_CURR_LOC, OUO_IP_OP_IND, LGR_LOC_GRP, OUO_ORD_STS_CD, OUO_STS_DESC, OUD_USER_DI_VALUE FROM IDB.OMS_ORDER JOIN IDB.OMS_USER_ORDERS ON OO_ORD_GUID = OUO_ORD_GUID LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_CLIENT_VISIT ON OO_VISIT_GUID = OCV_VISIT_GUID LEFT JOIN IDB.LOCATION_GROUPS_REFERENCE ON OCV_CURR_LOC = LGR_LOC_NAME LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_USER_DATA ON OO_ORD_GUID = OUD_ORD_GUID AND OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'Consult_Fin Asst_Dispo' WHERE OO_ORD_NAME IN ('Financial Assistance Outpatient Referral', 'Financial Assistance Referral') AND OO_ORD_STS_CD NOT IN ('CANC', 'CANP', 'AUC3', 'DISC')

prompt: Quarterly report of GIM NV 3008 and TELEHEALTH NV 13035 completed appointments and all orders and appointments for these patients.
completion: SELECT CPE_MRN AS "MRN", PT_LAST_NAME "Last Name", PT_FIRST_NAME "First Name", CPE_ENC_DTE AS "Appt Date", CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 AS "Department", CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 AS "Service", CLD_DEPT_NAME AS "Department Name", CRE_RES_NAME AS "Provider Name", CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME "Visit Type", CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON CPE_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND DATE(CPE_ENC_DTE) >= (DATE('0001-01-01') + YEAR(CURRENT date) YEARS - 1 YEAR + MONTH(CURRENT date) MONTHS - 4 MONTHS) AND DATE(CPE_ENC_DTE) < (DATE('0001-01-01') + YEAR(CURRENT date) YEARS - 1 YEAR + MONTH(CURRENT date) MONTHS - 1 MONTHS) AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 = 'MED' AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 = 'GIM' AND CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME IN ('GIM NV', 'TELEHEALTH NV') AND CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID IN ('3008', '13035') ; WITH PTS AS (SELECT CPE_MRN AS "MRN", CPE_ENC_DTE AS "Appt Date", CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 AS "Department", CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 AS "Service", CLD_DEPT_NAME AS "Department Name", CRE_RES_NAME AS "Provider Name", CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME "Visit Type", CPE_ENC_CSN_ID, CPE_APPT_DT FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND DATE(CPE_ENC_DTE) >= (DATE('0001-01-01') + YEAR(CURRENT date) YEARS - 1 YEAR + MONTH(CURRENT date) MONTHS - 4 MONTHS) AND DATE(CPE_ENC_DTE) < (DATE('0001-01-01') + YEAR(CURRENT date) YEARS - 1 YEAR + MONTH(CURRENT date) MONTHS - 1 MONTHS) AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 = 'MED' AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 = 'GIM' AND CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME IN ('GIM NV', 'TELEHEALTH NV') AND CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID IN ('3008', '13035') ) SELECT CPE_MRN AS "MRN", CPE_ENC_DTE AS "Appt Date", CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 AS "Department", CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 AS "Service", CLD_DEPT_NAME AS "Department Name", CRE_RES_NAME AS "Provider Name", CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME "Visit Type" FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER A JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID JOIN PTS B ON A.CPE_MRN = "MRN" AND A.CPE_APPT_DT >= B.CPE_APPT_DT AND A.CPE_ENC_CSN_ID <> B.CPE_ENC_CSN_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') ; WITH PTS AS (SELECT CPE_MRN AS "MRN", CPE_ENC_DTE AS "Appt Date", CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 AS "Department", CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 AS "Service", CLD_DEPT_NAME AS "Department Name", CRE_RES_NAME AS "Provider Name", CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME "Visit Type", CPE_ENC_CSN_ID, CPE_APPT_DT FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND DATE(CPE_ENC_DTE) >= (DATE('0001-01-01') + YEAR(CURRENT date) YEARS - 1 YEAR + MONTH(CURRENT date) MONTHS - 4 MONTHS) AND DATE(CPE_ENC_DTE) < (DATE('0001-01-01') + YEAR(CURRENT date) YEARS - 1 YEAR + MONTH(CURRENT date) MONTHS - 1 MONTHS) AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 = 'MED' AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 = 'GIM' AND CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME IN ('GIM NV', 'TELEHEALTH NV') AND CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID IN ('3008', '13035') ) SELECT OO_MRN "MRN", OOC_ITEM_NAME "Order Name", OOC_ITEM_DESC "Order Description", OO_ENTER_DT "Enter Date", OSTS_STS_DESC "Order Status", OP_DISPLAY_NAME "Requesting Provider Name" FROM IDB.OMS_ORDER JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_CATALOG ON OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID = OOC_MSTR_ITEM_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_STATUS ON OO_ORD_STS_CD = OSTS_ORD_STS_CD LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_PROVIDER ON OO_PVDR_GUID = OP_PVDR_GUID JOIN PTS ON OO_MRN = "MRN" AND OO_ENTER_DT > CPE_APPT_DT WHERE 1=1 AND OO_ORD_STS_CD NOT IN ('CANP', 'CANC', 'AUC3')

prompt: Design a report on patients who have had more than one spine surgery since 2013.
completion: WITH SRG AS (SELECT DISTINCT SSE_MRN, SSE_LOG_ID, SSE_SURG_DTE, SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD, SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC, SSP_SURG_SVC_CD, STRIP(SSP_SURG_LAST_NM) || ', ' || STRIP(SSP_SURG_FIRST_NM) AS SURGEON FROM IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE ON SSE_LOG_ID = SSP_LOG_ID WHERE 1=1 AND SSE_SURG_DTE >= '2013-01-01' AND(STRIP(SSP_SURG_LAST_NM) || ', ' || STRIP(SSP_SURG_FIRST_NM) like '%BILSKY%' OR STRIP(SSP_SURG_LAST_NM) || ', ' || STRIP(SSP_SURG_FIRST_NM) like '%LAUFER%' OR STRIP(SSP_SURG_LAST_NM) || ', ' || STRIP(SSP_SURG_FIRST_NM) like '%BARZILAI%' OR STRIP(SSP_SURG_LAST_NM) || ', ' || STRIP(SSP_SURG_FIRST_NM) like '%NEWMAN%') ) , TMP AS (SELECT SSE_MRN FROM SRG GROUP BY SSE_MRN HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT SSE_LOG_ID) > 1) , X AS (SELECT DISTINCT SRG.* FROM SRG JOIN TMP ON SRG.SSE_MRN = TMP.SSE_MRN) SELECT SSE_MRN, SSE_LOG_ID, SURGEON, SSE_SURG_DTE, LISTAGG(COALESCE(STRIP(SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD), '') || ' | ' || COALESCE(STRIP(CAST(SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC AS VARCHAR(1000))), '') , CHR(13) || CHR(10)) WITHIN GROUP( ORDER BY SSE_MRN, SSE_SURG_DTE, SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD, SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC) AS SURGERIES FROM X GROUP BY SSE_MRN, SSE_LOG_ID, SURGEON, SSE_SURG_DTE

prompt: Provide an updated list of bladder cancer patients with prior gemcitabine-cisplatin chemotherapy
completion: WITH TM AS (SELECT TM_MRN, PT_SEX, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, PT_DATE_OF_DEATH, TM_DX_DTE, TM_SITE_CD AS SITE_CODE, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_DESC, TM_HIST_CD AS HIST_CODE, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS HIST_DESC FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM H ON TM_HIST_CD = H.CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON TM_SITE_CD = S.CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON TM_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND TM_HIST_CD IN ('M8120/0', 'M8120/2', 'M8120/3', 'M8120/6', 'M8121/1', 'M8122/3', 'M8122/6', 'M8130/2', 'M8130/3', 'M8130/6', 'M8131/3') ) , A1 AS (SELECT DISTINCT APR_MRN, CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME, APR_START_DTE, APR_END_DTE, APR_ORD_RX_TYPE, APR_DISPENSE_CNT, APR_TOTAL_GIVEN_DOSE, APR_PRESCRIBED_DOSE, APR_DOSE_UOM FROM TM JOIN IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX_V ON TM_MRN = APR_MRN WHERE CDG_CHEMO_FLAG = 'Y' AND(UPPER(CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME) LIKE '%GEMCITABINE%' OR UPPER(CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME) LIKE '%CISPLATIN%' OR UPPER(APR_GENERIC_NAME) LIKE '%GEMCITABINE%' OR UPPER(APR_GENERIC_NAME) LIKE '%CISPLATIN%' OR UPPER(APR_DRUG_NAME) LIKE '%GEMCITABINE%' OR UPPER(APR_DRUG_NAME) LIKE '%CISPLATIN%') ) , A2 AS (SELECT APR_MRN, MIN(CASE WHEN UPPER(CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME) LIKE '%GEMCITABINE%' THEN APR_START_DTE END) AS "GEMCITABINE Start Date", MIN(CASE WHEN UPPER(CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME) LIKE '%CISPLATIN%' THEN APR_START_DTE END) AS "CISPLATIN Start Date" FROM A1 GROUP BY APR_MRN) , A3 AS (SELECT DISTINCT * FROM A2 WHERE "GEMCITABINE Start Date" BETWEEN '2010-11-01' AND '2020-06-01' AND "CISPLATIN Start Date" BETWEEN '2010-11-01' AND '2020-06-01' ) , CHEMO AS (SELECT DISTINCT A1.*, "GEMCITABINE Start Date", "CISPLATIN Start Date" FROM A1 JOIN A3 ON A1.APR_MRN = A3.APR_MRN) , SRG1 AS (SELECT DISTINCT SSE_MRN, SSE_SURG_DTE, SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD, SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC FROM CHEMO JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT ON SSE_MRN = APR_MRN JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE ON SSE_LOG_ID = SSP_LOG_ID WHERE 1=1 AND SSE_SURG_DTE >= "GEMCITABINE Start Date" AND SSE_SURG_DTE >= "CISPLATIN Start Date" AND SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD IN ('51570', '51575', '51580', '51585', '51590', '51595', '51596', '55155') ) , SRG2 AS (SELECT SSE_MRN, LISTAGG(COALESCE(STRIP(CAST(SSE_SURG_DTE AS VARCHAR(12000))), '') || ': ' || COALESCE(STRIP(CAST(SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD AS VARCHAR(12000))), '') || ' | ' || COALESCE(STRIP(CAST(SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC AS VARCHAR(12000))), '') , CHR(13) || CHR(10)) WITHIN GROUP( ORDER BY SSE_MRN, SSE_SURG_DTE, SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD) AS SURG FROM SRG1 GROUP BY SSE_MRN) , MAIN AS (SELECT DISTINCT TM_MRN, PT_SEX, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, PT_DATE_OF_DEATH, TM_DX_DTE, SITE_CODE, SITE_DESC, HIST_CODE, HIST_DESC, "GEMCITABINE Start Date", "CISPLATIN Start Date", SURG FROM TM JOIN CHEMO ON TM_MRN = APR_MRN JOIN SRG2 ON TM_MRN = SSE_MRN) SELECT CHEMO.*, SURG FROM CHEMO JOIN SRG2 ON APR_MRN = SSE_MRN WHERE 1=1
