prompt: Provide a weekly list of T3-4, N0-3 patients scheduled with breast surgery.
completion: WITH CDB AS (SELECT DISTINCT TM_MRN AS MRN, TM_DX_DTE AS DX_DATE, TM_HIST_CD AS HIST_CODE, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS HIST_DESC, TM_SITE_CD AS SITE_CODE, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_DESC, TM_CLIN_TNM_T AS T_STAGE, TM_CLIN_TNM_N N_STAGE FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM H ON TM_HIST_CD = H.CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON TM_SITE_CD = S.CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.SEERGROUPING ON RECODE = DV.SEERF_ICDO(TM_SITE_CD, TM_HIST_CD) AND CATEGORY1 = 'Breast' WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND (UPPER(TM_CLIN_TNM_T) like '%T%3%' OR UPPER(TM_CLIN_TNM_T) like '%T%4%') ) , CD AS (SELECT * FROM (SELECT CDD_MRN AS MRN, CDD_SERVICE_DTE, MAX(CASE WHEN CDO_ITEM_NAME IN ('T', 'T:') THEN TRIM(SUBSTR(CDO_VALUE_TEXT, 1, 200)) END) AS T_STAGE, MAX(CASE WHEN CDO_ITEM_NAME IN ('N', 'N:') THEN TRIM(SUBSTR(CDO_VALUE_TEXT, 1, 200)) END) AS N_STAGE, MAX(CASE WHEN CDO_ITEM_NAME IN ('M', 'M:') THEN TRIM(SUBSTR(CDO_VALUE_TEXT, 1, 200)) END) AS "M Stage", MAX(CASE WHEN CDO_ITEM_NAME IN ('Staging') THEN TRIM(SUBSTR(CDO_VALUE_TEXT, 1, 200)) END) AS "Stage" FROM IDB.CD_DOCUMENT JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION ON CDD_DOC_GUID = CDO_DOC_GUID AND CDD_AUTHORED_DTE = CDO_AUTHORED_DTE WHERE 1=1 AND CDD_DOC_NAME like '%Breast%' AND CDO_ITEM_NAME IN ('T', 'T:', 'N', 'N:', 'M', 'M:', 'Staging') AND CDD_CANCEL_IND <> '1' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND <> '1' GROUP BY CDD_MRN, CDD_SERVICE_DTE) C WHERE (UPPER(T_STAGE) like '%T%4%' OR UPPER(T_STAGE) like '%T%3%') ) , T AS (SELECT MRN, T_STAGE, N_STAGE FROM CDB UNION ALL SELECT MRN, T_STAGE, N_STAGE FROM CD) , CHEMO_ORDERS AS (SELECT APR_MRN, MIN(APR_START_DTE) MIN_START_DATE, MAX(APR_END_DTE) MAX_END_DATE, T_STAGE, N_STAGE FROM (SELECT DISTINCT APR_MRN, APR_GENERIC_NAME, APR_DRUG_NAME, APR_START_DTE, APR_END_DTE, T_STAGE, N_STAGE FROM T JOIN IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX ON MRN = APR_MRN WHERE(UPPER(APR_GENERIC_NAME) like '%CYCLOPHOSPHAMIDE%' OR UPPER(APR_GENERIC_NAME) like '%FLUOROURACIL%' OR UPPER(APR_GENERIC_NAME) like '%METHOTREXATE%' OR UPPER(APR_GENERIC_NAME) like '%PACLITAXEL%' OR UPPER(APR_GENERIC_NAME) like '%TRASTUZUMAB%' OR UPPER(APR_GENERIC_NAME) like '%PERTUZUMAB%' OR UPPER(APR_GENERIC_NAME) like '%DOXORUBICIN%' OR UPPER(APR_GENERIC_NAME) like '%CARBOPLATIN%') AND APR_CHEMO_FLAG = 'Y') A GROUP BY APR_MRN, T_STAGE, N_STAGE) , SURG AS (SELECT DISTINCT SSE_MRN, SSE_SURG_DTE, SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD, SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC, SSP_SURG_SVC_CD FROM IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE ON SSE_LOG_ID = SSP_LOG_ID WHERE SSP_SURG_SVC_CD = 'BRE' ) , APPTS AS (SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN AS "MRN", CPE_ENC_DTE AS "Appt Date", TIME(CPE_APPT_DT) AS "Time", CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 AS "Department", CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 AS "Service", CLD_DEPT_NAME AS "Department Name", CRE_RES_NAME AS "Provider Name", CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME AS "Visit Type" FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN CHEMO_ORDERS ON APR_MRN = CPE_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Sch') AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 = 'SRG' AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 = 'BRE' AND CRE_RES_TYP IN ('Physician') AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT date AND CURRENT date + 14 DAYS ) SELECT DISTINCT S.APR_MRN "MRN", MIN_START_DATE CHEMO_START_DATE, MAX_END_DATE CHEMO_END_DATE, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_LAST_NAME, T_STAGE, N_STAGE, "Appt Date", "Provider Name" FROM CHEMO_ORDERS S JOIN APPTS ON S.APR_MRN = "MRN" LEFT JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON S.APR_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE S.APR_MRN NOT IN (SELECT SSE_MRN FROM SURG)

prompt: Provide tumor, chemotherapy and IMPACT mutation information for patients on 12-245
completion: WITH PTS AS (SELECT DISTINCT PRO_IRB_NO, PT_MRN, PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_BIRTH_DTE, PT_DEATH_DTE, PT_SEX, PT_RACE_DESC, CORE_ETHNICITY_DESC, PDRX_DMP_PATIENT_ID FROM DV.ACCRUALS JOIN DV.PROTOCOL ON AC_PROTOCOL_ID = PRO_PROTOCOL_ID JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON AC_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID LEFT JOIN DV.PATIENT_CORE_DEMOGRAPHICS ON PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = CORE_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML ON PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PDRX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML_SETTINGS ON PDRX_PATH_DMP_RESULTS_XML_ID = PDRXS_PATH_DMP_RESULTS_XML_ID JOIN DVDMC.PATHOLOGY_DMP_WEBSVC_SETTINGS ON PDRXS_SETTING_ID = PDWS_SETTING_ID JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V ON PDRX_ACCESSION_NO = PRPT_ACCESSION_NO JOIN DV.DATE ON PRPT_REPORT_DATE_ID = DT_DATE_ID WHERE PDWS_NAME IN ('IMPACT', 'IMPACT GERMLINE SECONDARY') AND PRO_IRB_NO = '12-245' AND PT_MRN IN ('35319315', '38064923', '38064416', '35589495') ), ANTINEOPLSTICS AS (SELECT APR_MRN, CDG_THERAPEUTIC_CATEGORY, CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME, CDG_CHEMO_IND, CDG_BIOLOGIC_IMMUNO_FLAG, APR_ORAL_FLAG, MIN(APR_START_DTE) APR_START_DTE, MAX(APR_END_DTE) APR_END_DTE FROM PTS JOIN IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX ON PT_MRN = APR_MRN JOIN IDB.CHEMO_DRUG_GENERIC ON APR_GENERIC_NAME = CDG_GENERIC_NAME GROUP BY APR_MRN, CDG_CHEMO_IND, CDG_BIOLOGIC_IMMUNO_FLAG, APR_ORAL_FLAG, CDG_THERAPEUTIC_CATEGORY, CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME) , CVR_ELEMENTS AS (SELECT PDWS_NAME, PDRX_PATH_DMP_RESULTS_XML_ID, PDRX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID, PTS.PT_MRN, PDRX_PATH_RPT_ID, PDRX_ACCESSION_NO, PTS.PDRX_DMP_PATIENT_ID, PDRX_DMP_SAMPLE_ID, T.*, 'Element' AS NODETYPE FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML INNER JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V PD ON PDRX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID INNER JOIN PTS ON PTS.PT_MRN = PD.PT_MRN INNER JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML_SETTINGS ON PDRX_PATH_DMP_RESULTS_XML_ID = PDRXS_PATH_DMP_RESULTS_XML_ID INNER JOIN DVDMC.PATHOLOGY_DMP_WEBSVC_SETTINGS ON PDRXS_SETTING_ID = PDWS_SETTING_ID , XMLTABLE('$x/root//*' PASSING PDRX_XML_VALUE AS "x" COLUMNS NODEXML XML PATH '.', NODENAME VARCHAR(255) PATH 'local-name(.)', NODEVAL VARCHAR(4000) PATH '.', SEQNO FOR ORDINALITY, PARENTNODE VARCHAR(255) PATH '../local-name(.)') T WHERE 1=1 AND PDWS_NAME IN ('IMPACT', 'IMPACT GERMLINE SECONDARY') AND (NODENAME IN ('msi-score', 'tmb_cohort_percentile', 'tmb_tt_cohort', 'tmb_score', 'tmb_tt_percentile', 'tmb_cohort')) AND NODEVAL <> 'NA' ) , CVR AS (SELECT PT_MRN CVR_MRN, PDRX_ACCESSION_NO, MAX(CASE WHEN PDWS_NAME = 'IMPACT' AND NODENAME = 'tmb_cohort_percentile' THEN NODEVAL END) "IMPACT tmb_cohort_percentile", MAX(CASE WHEN PDWS_NAME = 'IMPACT' AND NODENAME = 'tmb_tt_cohort' THEN NODEVAL END) "IMPACT tmb_tt_cohort", MAX(CASE WHEN PDWS_NAME = 'IMPACT' AND NODENAME = 'tmb_score' THEN NODEVAL END) "IMPACT tmb_score", MAX(CASE WHEN PDWS_NAME = 'IMPACT' AND NODENAME = 'tmb_tt_percentile' THEN NODEVAL END) "IMPACT tmb_tt_percentile", MAX(CASE WHEN PDWS_NAME = 'IMPACT' AND NODENAME = 'tmb_cohort' THEN NODEVAL END) "IMPACT tmb_cohort", MAX(CASE WHEN PDWS_NAME = 'IMPACT' AND NODENAME = 'msi-score' THEN NODEVAL END) "IMPACT MSI Score", MAX(CASE WHEN PDWS_NAME = 'IMPACT GERMLINE SECONDARY' AND NODENAME = 'tmb_cohort_percentile' THEN NODEVAL END) "IMPACT GERMLINE SECONDARY tmb_cohort_percentile", MAX(CASE WHEN PDWS_NAME = 'IMPACT GERMLINE SECONDARY' AND NODENAME = 'tmb_tt_cohort' THEN NODEVAL END) "IMPACT GERMLINE SECONDARY tmb_tt_cohort", MAX(CASE WHEN PDWS_NAME = 'IMPACT GERMLINE SECONDARY' AND NODENAME = 'tmb_score' THEN NODEVAL END) "IMPACT GERMLINE SECONDARY tmb_score", MAX(CASE WHEN PDWS_NAME = 'IMPACT GERMLINE SECONDARY' AND NODENAME = 'tmb_tt_percentile' THEN NODEVAL END) "IMPACT GERMLINE SECONDARY tmb_tt_percentile", MAX(CASE WHEN PDWS_NAME = 'IMPACT GERMLINE SECONDARY' AND NODENAME = 'tmb_cohort' THEN NODEVAL END) "IMPACT GERMLINE SECONDARY tmb_cohort", MAX(CASE WHEN PDWS_NAME = 'IMPACT GERMLINE SECONDARY' AND NODENAME = 'msi-score' THEN NODEVAL END) "IMPACT GERMLINE SECONDARY MSI Score" FROM CVR_ELEMENTS WHERE PDWS_NAME IN ('IMPACT', 'IMPACT GERMLINE SECONDARY') GROUP BY PT_MRN, PDRX_ACCESSION_NO) , IRB06107 AS (SELECT PT_MRN IRB_MRN, AC_CONS_DTE FROM PTS JOIN DV.ACCRUALS A ON PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = AC_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID JOIN DV.PROTOCOL P ON AC_PROTOCOL_ID = PRO_PROTOCOL_ID WHERE P.PRO_IRB_NO = '06-107' ) SELECT DISTINCT TM_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_BIRTH_DTE, PT_DEATH_DTE, PT_SEX, PT_RACE_DESC, CORE_ETHNICITY_DESC, PDRX_DMP_PATIENT_ID, CASE WHEN IRB_MRN IS NOT NULL THEN 'Y' ELSE 'n' END "06-107 Consent", TM_DX_DTE, YEAR(TM_DX_DTE-PT_BIRTH_DTE) "Age at DX", TM_SITE_CD AS SITE_CODE, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_DESC, TM_HIST_CD AS HIST_CODE, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS HIST_DESC, TM_CASE_STS, CS.AV_DESC AS CASE_STS_DESC, TM_CA_SURG_DTE, RNS.CDB_AV_DESC AS TM_REASON_NO_SURG, TM_FIRST_TX_DTE, RES.CDB_AV_DESC AS TM_RESID_TUMOR_CD, PTH.CDB_AV_DESC AS TM_PATH_STG_GRP, CLN.CDB_AV_DESC AS TM_CLIN_STG_GRP, TM_CA_SURG_03, TM_AJCC, TM_AJCC_7, TM_VERSION_CUR, CDG_THERAPEUTIC_CATEGORY, CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME, CDG_CHEMO_IND, CDG_BIOLOGIC_IMMUNO_FLAG, APR_ORAL_FLAG, APR_START_DTE, APR_END_DTE, "IMPACT tmb_cohort_percentile", "IMPACT tmb_tt_cohort", "IMPACT tmb_score", "IMPACT tmb_tt_percentile", "IMPACT tmb_cohort", "IMPACT MSI Score", "IMPACT GERMLINE SECONDARY tmb_cohort_percentile", "IMPACT GERMLINE SECONDARY tmb_tt_cohort", "IMPACT GERMLINE SECONDARY tmb_score", "IMPACT GERMLINE SECONDARY tmb_tt_percentile", "IMPACT GERMLINE SECONDARY tmb_cohort", "IMPACT GERMLINE SECONDARY MSI Score" FROM PTS JOIN IDB.CDB_TUMOR ON PTS.PT_MRN = TM_MRN JOIN IDB.CLM H ON TM_HIST_CD = H.CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON TM_SITE_CD = S.CLM_CLSF_CD LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS CS ON CS.AV_ELEMENT = 'CASE_STS' AND CS.AV_CODE = TM_CASE_STS LEFT JOIN IDB.CDB_ALLOWVALS RNS ON RNS.CDB_AV_ELEMENT = 'REASON_NO_SURG' AND RNS.CDB_AV_CODE = TM_REASON_NO_SURG AND RNS.CDB_AV_CD_STS = 'A' LEFT JOIN IDB.CDB_ALLOWVALS RES ON RES.CDB_AV_ELEMENT = 'RESID_TUMOR_CD' AND RES.CDB_AV_CODE = TM_RESID_TUMOR_CD AND RES.CDB_AV_CD_STS = 'A' LEFT JOIN IDB.CDB_ALLOWVALS PTH ON PTH.CDB_AV_ELEMENT = 'PATH_STG_GRP' AND PTH.CDB_AV_CODE = TM_PATH_STG_GRP AND PTH.CDB_AV_CD_STS = 'A' LEFT JOIN IDB.CDB_ALLOWVALS CLN ON CLN.CDB_AV_ELEMENT = 'CLIN_STG_GRP' AND CLN.CDB_AV_CODE = TM_CLIN_STG_GRP AND CLN.CDB_AV_CD_STS = 'A' LEFT JOIN ANTINEOPLSTICS ON PT_MRN = APR_MRN LEFT JOIN CVR ON PT_MRN = CVR_MRN LEFT JOIN IRB06107 ON PT_MRN = IRB_MRN WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7') ; , IMPACT_RES AS (SELECT P.PT_MRN, PRPT_ACCESSION_NO, TEST_ID, PATH_PROCEDURE_DATE, GENE, RESULT, LOCUS, AA_CHANGE, NUCLEOTIDE, SEARCH_HIT1, SEARCH_HIT2, METHOD, ABERRATIONTYPE, FOLD_CHANGE FROM PTS P JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_STRUCTURED_RESULTS_V S ON P.PT_MRN = S.PT_MRN) ; SELECT PRPT_MRN, PRPT_PROCEDURE_DTE, PRPT_REPORT_DTE, PRPT_ACCESSION_NO, PRPT_REPORT FROM PTS JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V ON PT_MRN = PRPT_MRN JOIN DV.PATH_RPRT_TYPE_LOOKUP ON PRPT_REPORT_TYPE = PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_CD WHERE CONTAINS("PRPT_REPORT", '("Ki67")') = 1;

prompt: Provide a daily list of newly admitted patients diagnosed with COVID-19
completion: WITH PTS AS (SELECT CCV_MRN, CASE WHEN EMP.MRN IS NOT NULL THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END EMPLOYEE_FLAG, CCV_PATIENT_NAME, YEAR(DATE(CCV_ADMIT_DT) - COVID.DATE_OF_BIRTH) AGE_AT_ADMISSION, CCV_PROVIDER_NAME, CCV_VISIT_TYPE, COALESCE(CCV_CURRENT_LOCATION, COVID.IN_HOSP_BED) IN_HOSP_BED, CCV_ADMIT_DT, DAYS(CURRENT date) - DAYS(CCV_ADMIT_DT) LOS, COVID.RESULT, COVID.MIN_IDENTIFIED_DT FIRST_COVID_IDENTIFIED_DT, COVID.MAX_IDENTIFIED_DT LAST_COVID_IDENTIFIED_DT, DAYS(COVID.MIN_IDENTIFIED_DT) - DAYS(DATE(CCV_ADMIT_DT)) DAYS_ADMIT_TO_IDENTIFIED, COVID.MIN_RESOLVED_PROBLEM_DT FIRST_COVID_RESOLVED_DT, MAX(OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE) MOST_RECENT_DNR_DATE FROM IDB.COVID19_CLIENT_VISIT AS CCV JOIN IDB.PATIENT_COVID_INFO_V AS COVID ON CCV.CCV_MRN = COVID.MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.COVID19_EMPLOYEE_INFO EMP ON CCV.CCV_MRN = EMP.MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_ORDER ON CCV_MRN = OO_MRN AND OO_ORD_STS_CD NOT IN ('CANP', 'CANC', 'AUC3') AND OO_ORD_NAME = 'Do Not Resuscitate' WHERE CCV_CARE_LEVEL_CODE <> 'Inpt Schedule' AND CCV_VISIT_STATUS IN ('ADM', 'DSC') AND CCV_VISIT_TYPE IN ('Inpatient', 'Outpatient') AND (COVID.RESULT = 'Positive' OR (COVID.RESULT = 'Resolved' AND COVID.MIN_RESOLVED_PROBLEM_DT > CCV_ADMIT_DT)) AND DATE(CCV_ADMIT_DT) >= '2020-03-01' AND DATE(CCV_ADMIT_DT) >= CURRENT date - 1 DAY AND CCV_DISCHARGE_DT IS NULL GROUP BY CCV_MRN, CASE WHEN EMP.MRN IS NOT NULL THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END, CCV_PATIENT_NAME, YEAR(DATE(CCV_ADMIT_DT) - COVID.DATE_OF_BIRTH), CCV_PROVIDER_NAME, COVID.IN_HOSP_BED, CCV_ADMIT_DT, DAYS(CURRENT date) - DAYS(CCV_ADMIT_DT), COVID.RESULT, COVID.MIN_IDENTIFIED_DT, COVID.MAX_IDENTIFIED_DT, DAYS(COVID.MIN_IDENTIFIED_DT) - DAYS(DATE(CCV_ADMIT_DT)), COVID.MIN_RESOLVED_PROBLEM_DT, CCV_VISIT_TYPE, CCV_CURRENT_LOCATION ) , CDB AS (SELECT TM_MRN, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK SITE_CODE, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK HISTOLOGY_CODE, CASE WHEN TM_BEST_AJCC_STG like '0%' THEN '0' WHEN TM_BEST_AJCC_STG like '1%' THEN '1' WHEN TM_BEST_AJCC_STG like '2%' THEN '2' WHEN TM_BEST_AJCC_STG like '3%' THEN '3' WHEN TM_BEST_AJCC_STG like '4%' THEN '4' WHEN TM_BEST_AJCC_STG IN ('', '88', '99') THEN 'No Stage' END STAGE FROM (SELECT DISTINCT CCV_MRN FROM PTS) P JOIN IDB.CDB_TUMOR ON CCV_MRN = TM_MRN JOIN IDB.CLM H ON TM_HIST_CD = H.CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON TM_SITE_CD = S.CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') ) , MA AS (SELECT OO_MRN, OO_ORD_NAME MONOCLONAL_ANTIBODY, MIN(OO_ENTER_DTE) FIRST_MONOCLONAL_ANTIBODY_DATE FROM (SELECT DISTINCT CCV_MRN FROM PTS) P JOIN IDB.OMS_ORDER ON CCV_MRN = OO_MRN WHERE OO_ORD_STS_CD NOT IN ('CANP', 'CANC', 'AUC3') AND (LOWER(OO_ORD_NAME) like '%bamlanivimab%' OR LOWER(OO_ORD_NAME) like '%etesevimab%' OR LOWER(OO_ORD_NAME) like '%casirivimab%' OR LOWER(OO_ORD_NAME) like '%imdevimab%') GROUP BY OO_MRN, OO_ORD_NAME ) SELECT CCV_MRN MRN, CCV_PATIENT_NAME PATIENT_NAME, EMPLOYEE_FLAG, AGE_AT_ADMISSION, CCV_PROVIDER_NAME PROVIDER_NAME, CCV_VISIT_TYPE, P.IN_HOSP_BED HOSP_BED, CCV_ADMIT_DT ADMIT_DT, LOS, P.RESULT, FIRST_COVID_IDENTIFIED_DT, LAST_COVID_IDENTIFIED_DT, DAYS_ADMIT_TO_IDENTIFIED, FIRST_COVID_RESOLVED_DT, MOST_RECENT_DNR_DATE, LISTAGG(TRIM(SITE_CODE) || ' ' || TRIM(HISTOLOGY_CODE) || ' STAGE ' || STAGE, CHR(13)||CHR(10)) TUMOR, MONOCLONAL_ANTIBODY, FIRST_MONOCLONAL_ANTIBODY_DATE FROM PTS P LEFT JOIN CDB C ON CCV_MRN = TM_MRN LEFT JOIN MA ON CCV_MRN = OO_MRN GROUP BY CCV_MRN, CCV_PATIENT_NAME, EMPLOYEE_FLAG, AGE_AT_ADMISSION, CCV_PROVIDER_NAME, P.IN_HOSP_BED, CCV_ADMIT_DT, LOS, P.RESULT, FIRST_COVID_IDENTIFIED_DT, LAST_COVID_IDENTIFIED_DT, DAYS_ADMIT_TO_IDENTIFIED, FIRST_COVID_RESOLVED_DT, MOST_RECENT_DNR_DATE, CCV_VISIT_TYPE, MONOCLONAL_ANTIBODY, FIRST_MONOCLONAL_ANTIBODY_DATE

prompt: Dept of Surg, list of providers and locations, calculate number of clinic days held in 2023.
completion: SELECT CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 SERVICE , CRE_RES_NAME RESOURCE , CLD_CLD_CENTER LOCATION , COUNT(DISTINCT CPE_ENC_DTE) CLINIC_DAYS FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND YEAR(CPE_ENC_DTE) = 2023 AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 = 'SRG' AND CRE_RES_TYP = 'Physician' GROUP BY CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 , CRE_RES_NAME , CLD_CLD_CENTER

prompt: Counts of open and laproscopic procedures by diagnosis for the 10 year period 2001-2010.
completion: WITH D AS (SELECT DISTINCT "t1"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AS "PTID", MIN(PDX_DX_DATE_ID) AS MIN_DATE FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED" "t1" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DIAGNOSIS_FINAL_ALL_V" "t4" ON "t1"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t4"."PDX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DIAGNOSIS_CODE_CAT_ICD9_V" "t2" ON "t4"."PDX_DX_CATALOG_ID" = "t2"."DXCC_DX_CATALOG_ID" INNER JOIN "DV"."DATE" D ON "t4".PDX_DX_DATE_ID = D.DT_DATE_ID WHERE "t2"."DXCC_ICD_CODE" BETWEEN '153.00' AND '154.9' AND D.DT_YEAR <= 2010 GROUP BY "t1"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID") , D2 AS (SELECT "PTID", MIN(DXCC_ICD_CODE) DXCC_ICD_CODE, MIN_DATE FROM D INNER JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DIAGNOSIS_FINAL_ALL_V" "t4" ON D."PTID" = "t4"."PDX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AND PDX_DX_DATE_ID = MIN_DATE LEFT JOIN "DV"."DIAGNOSIS_CODE_CAT_ICD9_V" "t2" ON "t4"."PDX_DX_CATALOG_ID" = "t2"."DXCC_DX_CATALOG_ID" WHERE "t2"."DXCC_ICD_CODE" BETWEEN '153.00' AND '154.9' GROUP BY "PTID", MIN_DATE) , DT AS (SELECT DISTINCT D2."PTID" , CASE WHEN "t2"."DXCC_ICD_CODE" IN ('154.3', '154.2') THEN '154.2/3' WHEN "t2"."DXCC_ICD_CODE" IN ('154.8', '154.1', '154') THEN '154.1/8' WHEN "t2"."DXCC_ICD_CODE" IN ('153.5') THEN '153.5' WHEN "t2"."DXCC_ICD_CODE" IN ('154.0') THEN '153.x & 154.0' WHEN "t2"."DXCC_ICD_CODE" LIKE ('153.%') THEN '153.x & 154.0' ELSE "t2".DXCC_ICD_CODE END AS DIAGNOSIS_CODE_ROLL_UP, CASE WHEN "t2"."DXCC_ICD_CODE" IN ('154.3', '154.2') THEN 'ANAL CA' WHEN "t2"."DXCC_ICD_CODE" IN ('154.8', '154.1', '154') THEN 'RECTAL CA' WHEN "t2"."DXCC_ICD_CODE" IN ('153.5') THEN "t2".DXCC_ICD_MSK_DESC WHEN "t2"."DXCC_ICD_CODE" IN ('154.0') THEN 'COLON CA' WHEN "t2"."DXCC_ICD_CODE" LIKE ('153.%') THEN 'COLON CA' ELSE "t2".DXCC_ICD_MSK_DESC END AS DIAGNOSIS_DESC_ROLL_UP FROM D2 INNER JOIN "DV"."DIAGNOSIS_CODE_CAT_ICD9_V" "t2" ON D2.DXCC_ICD_CODE = "t2"."DXCC_ICD_CODE") , CPT AS (SELECT "t1"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AS "PT_ID", "t3"."PCC_CODE" AS "CPT Procedure Code - PBD", "t3"."PCC_DESC" AS "CPT Procedure Desc - PBD" , CASE WHEN "t3".PCC_CODE IN ('44140', '44145', '44150', '44155', '44158', '44160', '44145', '44146', '45110', '45111', '45112', '45119') THEN 'open cpt codes' WHEN "t3".PCC_CODE IN ('44204', '44205', '44206', '44204', '44207', '44208', '44210', '44212') THEN 'lsc cpt codes' END AS PROCEDURE_TYPE , D.DT_YEAR AS "Procedure Year", D.DT_DTE , "t2".MP_SERVICE_CD || '-' || "t2".MP_SERVICE_DESC AS "Service" FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED" "t1" INNER JOIN DT DT ON DT."PTID" = "t1"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."CPT_OR_PATIENT_PROCEDURE" "t3" ON "t1"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t3"."PTX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."MEDPRO_V" "t2" ON "t3"."PTX_MEDPRO_ID" = "t2"."MP_MEDPRO_ID" INNER JOIN "DV"."DATE" D ON "t3".PTX_PROC_DATE_ID = D.DT_DATE_ID WHERE "t3"."PCC_CODE" IN ('44140', '44145', '44150', '44155', '44158', '44160', '44204', '44205', '44206' , '44145', '44146', '45110', '45111', '45112', '45119', '44204', '44207', '44208', '44210', '44212') AND D.DT_YEAR BETWEEN 2001 AND 2010 ) SELECT COUNT(*), PROCEDURE_TYPE, DIAGNOSIS_CODE_ROLL_UP FROM CPT CPT INNER JOIN DT DT ON DT."PTID" = CPT."PT_ID" GROUP BY PROCEDURE_TYPE, DIAGNOSIS_CODE_ROLL_UP

prompt: Provide demographic information for patient derived xenograft (PDX) models collected on an ongoing basis in the Kung Lab. 17-387 is the protocol under which the PDXs are generated.
completion: WITH PTS AS (SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN , PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID DEID FROM DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS WHERE PT_MRN IN ('00030611', '38040916', '38041178', '38041865', '38041968', '38043053', '38043154', '38043858', '38044022', '38044924', '38046575', '38078998', '38090770', '38088825', '38092564', '38123969', '35111734', '38127418', '38135432', '38112747', '38132626', '38072155', '35598565', '38138369', '38145608') ) , DMP_ID AS (SELECT DISTINCT PDRX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID DMP_PID, PDRX_DMP_PATIENT_ID DMP_ID FROM PTS JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML ON DEID = PDRX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID) , CTMS AS (SELECT R.PT_MRN, PRT_ID, REG_ID, CONSENT_DATE FROM NN.CRDB_DASH_PT_REG R JOIN PTS P ON R.PT_MRN = P.PT_MRN WHERE 1=1 ) , PFA AS (SELECT PTS.PT_MRN, DEID, DT_DTE, ENDP_DEPT_NAME, TRIM(ENR_RES_NAME) ENR_RES_NAME, ENVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY PTS.PT_MRN ORDER BY DT_DTE) RN FROM PTS JOIN DV.PATIENT_ENCOUNTER ON DEID = PENC_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PENC_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID JOIN DV.DATE ON PENC_ENC_DATE_ID = DT_DATE_ID JOIN DV.ENCOUNTER_DEPARTMENT ON PENC_DEPT_ID = ENDP_ENC_DEPT_ID JOIN DV.ENCOUNTER_SCHD_RESOURCES ON PENC_PT_ENC_ID = ENSR_PT_ENC_ID AND ENSR_PRIMARY_RES_IND = 'Y' JOIN DV.ENCOUNTER_RESOURCE ON ENSR_RES_ID = ENR_ENC_RES_ID JOIN DV.ENCOUNTER_VISIT_TYPE ON PENC_VISIT_TYPE_ID = ENVT_ENC_VISIT_TYPE_ID WHERE PENC_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND ENR_RES_TYP = 'Physician' ) SELECT TRIM(P.PT_MRN) "MRN", TRIM(PT_LAST_NAME) "Last Name", TRIM(PT_FIRST_NAME) "First Name", PT_SEX "Gender", TRIM(PT_VITAL_STATUS) "Vital Status", PT_BIRTH_DTE "DOB", PT_DEATH_DTE "DOD", TRIM(PT_RACE_DESC) AS "Race", TRIM(CORE_ETHNICITY_DESC) AS "Ethnicity", PFA.DT_DTE "First Appt Date", ENR_RES_NAME "First Appt Resource", PLA_LAST_APPT_DTE "Last Appt Date", PLA_LAST_CONTACT_DTE "Last Contact Date", CASE WHEN PRT_ID = '12-245' AND REG_ID = '100' THEN '12-245 Part A' WHEN PRT_ID = '12-245' AND REG_ID = '300' THEN '12-245 Part C' ELSE PRT_ID END AS "IRB Number", DATE(CONSENT_DATE) "Consent Date", CASE WHEN PRT_ID = '12-245' THEN DMP_ID END "DMP ID", TCLSA_CLIN_STG_GRP AS "Clinical Group", TCLSA_CLIN_TNM_T AS "Clinical Tumor", TCLSA_CLIN_TNM_N AS "Clinical Nodes", TCLSA_CLIN_TNM_M AS "Clinical Metastases", DX.DT_DTE AS "Tumor Diagnosis Date", YEAR(DX.DT_DTE - DOB.DT_DTE) AS "Age at Tumor Diagnosis Date", ICSC_SITE_CD AS "ICD-O Site Code", TRIM(ICSC_ICDO_SITE_MSK_DESC) AS "ICD-O Site Description", DXCC_ICD_CODE AS "ICD-O Histology Code", TRIM(DXCC_ICD_MSK_DESC) AS "ICD-O Histology Description", CDTM_CDB_SEQ_NO AS "Tumor Sequence", CDTM_CA_SURG_DTE AS "Tumor Surgery Date", DV.TBS_AVAIL(PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID) AS "Tissue Bank Sample Available" FROM PTS P JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V PD ON P.PT_MRN = PD.PT_MRN JOIN DV.PATIENT_LATEST_ACTIVITY ON PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PLA_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID LEFT JOIN PFA ON PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PFA.DEID AND RN = 1 LEFT JOIN DV.PATIENT_CORE_DEMOGRAPHICS ON PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = CORE_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID LEFT JOIN DV.CDB_TUMOR ON PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = CDTM_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID LEFT JOIN DV.TUMOR_CLINICAL_STAGE_ATTRIBUTES_V ON CDTM_CLINICAL_STAGE_ATTR_ID = TCLSA_TM_CLIN_STAGE_ATTR_ID LEFT JOIN DV.DATE_V DX ON CDTM_DX_DATE_ID = DX.DT_DATE_ID LEFT JOIN DV.ICDO_SITE_CATALOG_V ON CDTM_SITE_CATALOG_ID = ICSC_SITE_CATALOG_ID LEFT JOIN DV.DIAGNOSIS_CODE_CAT_ICDO_V ON CDTM_DX_CATALOG_ID = DXCC_DX_CATALOG_ID LEFT JOIN CTMS C ON C.PT_MRN = P.PT_MRN LEFT JOIN DV.DATE_V DOB ON PT_BIRTH_DTE = DOB.DT_DTE LEFT JOIN DMP_ID ON PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = DMP_PID WHERE 1=1

prompt: List surgical adverse events for brachytherapy procedures from 2017-01-01 to 2020-07-31
completion: WITH SURGERY AS (SELECT DISTINCT SSE_MRN, SSE_SURG_DTE, SSP_SURG_LAST_NM, SSP_SURG_FIRST_NM, SSP_SURG_SVC_CD, SSE_SURG_LOC, SSE_LOG_ID, SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD, SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC FROM IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE ON SSE_LOG_ID = SSP_LOG_ID AND SSE_ENC_CSN_ID = SSP_ENC_CSN_ID WHERE (SSE_SURG_LOC not like '%IR%' AND SSE_SURG_LOC not like '%ENDO%' AND SSE_SOURCE_TYPE <> 'E') AND SSE_SURG_DTE BETWEEN '2017-01-01' AND '2020-07-31' AND SSP_SURG_SVC_CD = 'RAD ONC' AND SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD IN (77761, 77762, 77763, 77778, 77770, 77771, 77772, 77767, 77768) ) , ADVERSE AS (SELECT DISTINCT A.SAE_MRN, A.SAE_TOXICITY_NAME, A.SAE_TOX_CAT_NAME, A.SAE_TOX_GRADE, A.SAE_TOX_GRADE_NAME, A.SAE_TOX_OCCR_DT, A.SAE_SURG_LOG_ID FROM IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE ON SSE_LOG_ID = SSP_LOG_ID AND SSE_ENC_CSN_ID = SSP_ENC_CSN_ID JOIN IDB.SRG_ADVERSE_EVENT A ON SSE_LOG_ID = SAE_SURG_LOG_ID AND SAE_PROC_SEQ_NO = SSP_PROC_SEQ_NO AND SAE_TOX_GRADE > '0') SELECT DENSE_RANK() OVER ( ORDER BY SSE_MRN) "Patient count", SSE_MRN AS MRN, PT_LAST_NAME AS "Patient last name", PT_FIRST_NAME AS "Patient first name", SSE_SURG_DTE AS "Surgery date", SSP_SURG_LAST_NM AS "Surgeon last name", SSP_SURG_FIRST_NM AS "Surgeon first name", SSP_SURG_SVC_CD AS "Surgeon service", SSE_SURG_LOC AS "Surgery location", SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD AS "Procedure code", SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC AS "Procedure code desc", SAE_TOX_CAT_NAME AS "Adverse category", SAE_TOXICITY_NAME AS "Adverse name", SAE_TOX_GRADE AS "Adverse grade", SAE_TOX_GRADE_NAME "Adverse grade name" FROM SURGERY JOIN ADVERSE ON SAE_SURG_LOG_ID = SSE_LOG_ID JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON SSE_MRN = PT_MRN

prompt: Provide a weekly list of patients with Li Fraumeni Syndrome.
completion: WITH X AS (SELECT DISTINCT STRIP("t1"."PT_MRN") AS "MRN", PT_BIRTH_DTE AS DOB, STRIP(PT_LAST_NAME) || ', ' || STRIP(PT_FIRST_NAME) AS "Name", "t2"."PRPT_ACCESSION_NO" AS "Pathology Report", "t3"."DT_DTE" AS "Pathology Procedure Date", "t4"."DT_DTE" AS "Pathology Report Date", "t5"."PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_DESC" AS "Pathology Report Type", UPPER(CASE WHEN LENGTH(PRPT_REPORT) <= 15000 THEN RTRIM(CAST(SUBSTR(PRPT_REPORT, 1, 15000) AS VARCHAR(15000))) ELSE CAST(SUBSTR(PRPT_REPORT, 1, 15000) AS VARCHAR(15000)) END) AS TXT FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V" "t1" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED" "t6" ON "t1"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t6"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V" "t2" ON "t6"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t2"."PRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" "t3" ON "t2"."PRPT_PROCEDURE_DATE_ID" = "t3"."DT_DATE_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" "t4" ON "t2"."PRPT_REPORT_DATE_ID" = "t4"."DT_DATE_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATH_RPRT_TYPE_LOOKUP" "t5" ON "t2"."PRPT_REPORT_TYPE" = "t5"."PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_CD" WHERE 1=1 AND (CONTAINS("t2"."PRPT_REPORT", '("Li-Fraumeni" OR "Li Fraumeni")') = 1 AND "t2"."PRPT_REPORT" IS NOT NULL ) AND "t4"."DT_DTE" BETWEEN CURRENT date - 7 DAYS AND CURRENT date ) , AC AS (SELECT AC_MRN, MAX(CASE WHEN AC_IRB_NO = '06-107' THEN 'Y' END) AS "06-107", MAX(CASE WHEN AC_IRB_NO = '12-245' THEN 'Y' END) AS "12-245" FROM X JOIN IDB.ACCRUALS ON "MRN" = AC_MRN AND AC_IRB_NO IN ('06-107', '12-245') GROUP BY AC_MRN) , Y AS (SELECT DISTINCT X.*, CASE WHEN ("06-107") IS NULL OR "06-107" = '' THEN 'N' ELSE "06-107" END AS "06-107", CASE WHEN ("12-245") IS NULL OR "12-245" = '' THEN 'N' ELSE "12-245" END AS "12-245" FROM X LEFT JOIN AC ON MRN = AC_MRN) , PT_COUNT1 AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS PT_COUNT FROM Y) , PT_COUNT2 AS (SELECT PT_COUNT, CASE WHEN PT_COUNT = 0 THEN CAST('X' AS REAL) ELSE CAST(1 AS REAL) END AS "RUN/FAIL" FROM PT_COUNT1) SELECT Y.*, "RUN/FAIL" FROM Y, PT_COUNT2

prompt: Provide a list of lung cancer patients who received Pembrolizumab Q6 weeks.
completion: SELECT DISTINCT TRIM(PT_MRN) PT_MRN, PDI_DMP_PATIENT_ID AS DMP_ID, TRIM(PT_LAST_NAME) || ', ' || TRIM(PT_FIRST_NAME) PATIENTS_NAME, APR_DRUG_NAME, APR_SET_NAME, CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME, APR_START_DTE, APR_END_DTE, CC_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK FROM DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS JOIN IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX_V ON APR_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_DMP_IDENTIFIERS ON PDI_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.CTC_CLSF ON PT_MRN = CC_MRN JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE 1 = 1 AND CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME = 'PEMBROLIZUMAB' AND APR_SET_NAME = 'THR_PEMBROlizumab_Q6weeks' AND CC_CLSF_CD IN ('C34.90', '162.9') AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND (CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) ORDER BY PT_MRN

prompt: Provide a list of patients with MRI of the spine or CT Myelogram with either spine surgery or spine RT.
completion: WITH MR AS (SELECT DISTINCT "t1"."PT_MRN" AS "MRN", "t2"."RRPT_ACCESSION_NO" AS "Radiology Accession Number", "t2"."RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE" AS "Radiology Performed Date", "t2"."RRPT_REPORT_DTE" AS "Radiology Report Date", "t2"."RRPT_ORDER_GROUP" AS "Radiology Order Group", "t2"."RRPT_PROCEDURE_NAME" AS "Radiology Procedure Name", UPPER(DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)IMPRESSION:[\w\W]*(?=DICTATED BY:)', RRPT_REPORT_TXT)) AS IMPRESSION, UPPER(CASE WHEN LENGTH(RRPT_REPORT_TXT) <= 15000 THEN RTRIM(CAST(SUBSTR(RRPT_REPORT_TXT, 1, 15000) AS VARCHAR(15000))) ELSE CAST(SUBSTR(RRPT_REPORT_TXT, 1, 15000) AS VARCHAR(15000)) END) AS FULL_TEXT FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V" "t1" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED" "t3" ON "t1"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t3"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."RADIOLOGY_REPORT_V" "t2" ON "t3"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t2"."RRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_IDENTIFICATION_MRN_V" "t4" ON "t1"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t4"."PI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" WHERE 1=1 AND "t2"."RRPT_ORDER_GROUP" LIKE '%MR%' AND UPPER("t2"."RRPT_PROCEDURE_NAME") like '%SPIN%' AND "t2"."RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE" BETWEEN '2010-07-01' AND '2020-07-01' ) , CT AS (SELECT DISTINCT "t1"."PT_MRN" AS "MRN", "t2"."RRPT_ACCESSION_NO" AS "Radiology Accession Number", "t2"."RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE" AS "Radiology Performed Date", "t2"."RRPT_REPORT_DTE" AS "Radiology Report Date", "t2"."RRPT_ORDER_GROUP" AS "Radiology Order Group", "t2"."RRPT_PROCEDURE_NAME" AS "Radiology Procedure Name", UPPER(DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)IMPRESSION:[\w\W]*(?=DICTATED BY:)', RRPT_REPORT_TXT)) AS IMPRESSION, UPPER(CASE WHEN LENGTH(RRPT_REPORT_TXT) <= 15000 THEN RTRIM(CAST(SUBSTR(RRPT_REPORT_TXT, 1, 15000) AS VARCHAR(15000))) ELSE CAST(SUBSTR(RRPT_REPORT_TXT, 1, 15000) AS VARCHAR(15000)) END) AS FULL_TEXT FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V" "t1" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED" "t3" ON "t1"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t3"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."RADIOLOGY_REPORT_V" "t2" ON "t3"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t2"."RRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_IDENTIFICATION_MRN_V" "t4" ON "t1"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t4"."PI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" WHERE 1=1 AND "t2"."RRPT_ORDER_GROUP" LIKE '%CT%' AND UPPER("t2"."RRPT_PROCEDURE_NAME") like '%MYELO%' AND "t2"."RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE" BETWEEN '2010-07-01' AND '2020-07-01' ) , RT AS (SELECT DISTINCT RTC_TX_MRN AS MRN, RTC_TX_PLAN_NAME, RTC_PRIMARY_REF_POINT, RTC_TX_START_DTE, RTC_TX_STOP_DTE, RTC_TX_ELAPSED_DAYS, RTC_TX_PLANNED_FRACTIONS, RTC_TX_DELIVERED_FRACTIONS, RTC_TX_PLANNED_DOSE, RTC_TX_DELIVERED_DOSE, RTC_DOSE_CORRECTION FROM IDB.RADONC_TREATMENT_COURSE WHERE RTC_TX_START_DTE BETWEEN '2010-07-01' AND '2020-07-01' AND(RTC_TX_PLAN_NAME LIKE '%SP%' OR RTC_TX_PLAN_NAME LIKE 'C%' OR RTC_TX_PLAN_NAME LIKE 'L%' OR RTC_TX_PLAN_NAME LIKE 'T%' OR RTC_PRIMARY_REF_POINT LIKE '%SP%' OR RTC_PRIMARY_REF_POINT LIKE 'C%' OR RTC_PRIMARY_REF_POINT LIKE 'L%' OR RTC_PRIMARY_REF_POINT LIKE 'T%') ) , SRG AS (SELECT DISTINCT SSE_MRN AS MRN, SSE_SURG_DTE, SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD, SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC, SUBSTR(STRIP(SSP_SURG_LAST_NM)||', '||SSP_SURG_FIRST_NM, 1, 35) AS SURGEON FROM IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE ON SSE_LOG_ID = SSP_LOG_ID WHERE 1=1 AND SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC LIKE '%SPIN%' AND SSE_SURG_DTE BETWEEN '2010-07-01' AND '2020-07-01' AND SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD NOT LIKE '5%' ) , FINAL AS (SELECT PT_MRN AS MRN, STRIP(PT_LAST_NAME) || ', ' || STRIP(PT_FIRST_NAME) AS "Name", PT_SEX AS GENDER, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH AS DOB, PT_DATE_OF_DEATH AS DOD, COALESCE(MAX(PLA_LST_APPT_DTE, PLA_LST_DSCH_DTE), PLA_LST_APPT_DTE, PLA_LST_DSCH_DTE) AS LAST_FU_DATE, MAX(CASE WHEN MR.MRN IS NOT NULL THEN 'Y' END) AS "MRI Spine", MAX(CASE WHEN CT.MRN IS NOT NULL THEN 'Y' END) AS "CT Myelo", MAX(CASE WHEN RT.MRN IS NOT NULL THEN 'Y' END) AS "RT Spine", MAX(CASE WHEN SRG.MRN IS NOT NULL THEN 'Y' END) AS "Surgery Spine" FROM IDB.PATIENT JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY ON PT_MRN = PLA_MRN LEFT JOIN MR ON MR.MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN CT ON CT.MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN RT ON RT.MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN SRG ON SRG.MRN = PT_MRN WHERE(MR.MRN IS NOT NULL OR CT.MRN IS NOT NULL) AND(RT.MRN IS NOT NULL OR SRG.MRN IS NOT NULL) GROUP BY PT_MRN, STRIP(PT_LAST_NAME) || ', ' || STRIP(PT_FIRST_NAME), PT_SEX, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, PT_DATE_OF_DEATH, COALESCE(MAX(PLA_LST_APPT_DTE, PLA_LST_DSCH_DTE), PLA_LST_APPT_DTE, PLA_LST_DSCH_DTE)) SELECT * FROM FINAL

prompt: Provide a list of breast patients with any of the following somatic mutations: SMARCA2, SMARCA4, SMARCB1, SMARCC1
completion: WITH DX AS (SELECT PT_MRN, TUMOR_REG_DATA, ICD_DATA FROM IDB.PATIENT LEFT JOIN (SELECT TM_MRN, LISTAGG(TM_DX_DTE || ' | ' || TRIM(SITE_DESC) || ' | ' || TRIM(HIST_DESC), CHR(13) || CHR(10)) WITHIN GROUP( ORDER BY TM_DX_DTE) AS TUMOR_REG_DATA FROM (SELECT DISTINCT TM_MRN, AV_DESC AS CASE_STS, TM_DX_DTE, TM_HIST_CD, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS HIST_DESC, TM_SITE_CD, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_DESC FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS ON AV_ELEMENT = 'CASE_STS' AND AV_CODE = TM_CASE_STS AND TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND TM_SITE_CD LIKE 'C50%' ) A GROUP BY TM_MRN) AS CDB ON TM_MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN (SELECT CC_MRN, LISTAGG(MIN_ICD_EFF_DTE || ' | ' || TRIM(ICD_CD) || ' | ' || TRIM(ICD_DESC), CHR(13) || CHR(10)) WITHIN GROUP( ORDER BY MIN_ICD_EFF_DTE) AS ICD_DATA FROM (SELECT DISTINCT CC_MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS MIN_ICD_EFF_DTE, CC_CLSF_CD AS ICD_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS ICD_DESC FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE 1=1 AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND SUBSTR(CC_CLSF_CD, 1, 3) IN ('C50', '174', '175') GROUP BY CC_MRN, CC_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK ) A GROUP BY CC_MRN) AS ICD ON CC_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE COALESCE(TM_MRN, CC_MRN) IS NOT NULL ) , DX_FINAL AS (SELECT PT_MRN DX_MRN, TUMOR_REG_DATA, ICD_DATA FROM DX) , GENES AS (SELECT PT_MRN GENE_MRN, LISTAGG(TRIM(COALESCE(PRPT_ACCESSION_NO, '')) || ' | ' || TRIM(COALESCE(PRPT_PATH_RPT_ID, '')) || ' | ' || TRIM(COALESCE(GENE, '')) || ' | ' || TRIM(COALESCE(GENE2, '')), CHR(13) || CHR(10)) AS GENE FROM (SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN, PRPT_ACCESSION_NO, PRPT_PATH_RPT_ID, GENE, GENE2 FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_STRUCTURED_RESULTS_V JOIN DX_FINAL ON DX_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE GENE IN ('SMARCA2', 'SMARCA4', 'SMARCB1', 'SMARCC1') OR GENE2 IN ('SMARCA2', 'SMARCA4', 'SMARCB1', 'SMARCC1') )A GROUP BY PT_MRN) , CHEMO AS (SELECT APR_MRN, LISTAGG(DATE(APR_START_DTE) || ' | ' || DATE(APR_END_DTE) || ' | ' || TRIM(CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME) || ' | ' || TRIM(APR_PRESCRIBED_DOSE), CHR(13) || CHR(10)) WITHIN GROUP( ORDER BY DATE(APR_START_DTE)) AS CHEMO_TX FROM (SELECT DISTINCT APR_MRN, APR_START_DTE, APR_END_DTE, CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME, APR_PRESCRIBED_DOSE FROM IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX JOIN IDB.CHEMO_DRUG_GENERIC ON APR_GENERIC_NAME = CDG_GENERIC_NAME JOIN DX_FINAL ON DX_MRN = APR_MRN WHERE 1=1 AND APR_START_DTE = CURRENT DATE - 1 ) A GROUP BY APR_MRN) , RADONC AS (SELECT DISTINCT RTC_TX_MRN FROM IDB.RADONC_TREATMENT_COURSE JOIN DX_FINAL ON DX_MRN = RTC_TX_MRN WHERE 1=1 ) SELECT DISTINCT DX_MRN "MRN", PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH "DOB", PT_DATE_OF_DEATH "Date of Death", GENE "Accession No | Report ID | Gene1 | Gene2", CHEMO_TX "Chemo Tx", CASE WHEN RTC_TX_MRN IS NOT NULL THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS "Radonc Tx" FROM DX_FINAL JOIN GENES ON DX_MRN = GENE_MRN LEFT JOIN CHEMO ON DX_MRN = APR_MRN LEFT JOIN RADONC ON RTC_TX_MRN = RTC_TX_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON DX_MRN = PT_MRN

prompt: Provide Smoking History and Immunotherapy doses for a list of Patients

completion: WITH CLIN AS (SELECT * FROM (SELECT CDD_MRN , CDD_DOC_GUID AS DOC_GUID, CDD_SERVICE_DTE , CASE WHEN OCV_IP_OP_IND = 'O' THEN 'Out-patient' WHEN OCV_IP_OP_IND = 'I' THEN 'In-patient' ELSE OCV_IP_OP_IND END AS IP_OP_FLAG, CDD_DOC_NAME , ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CDD_MRN, CDD_SERVICE_DTE, CDD_DOC_NAME, OP_DISCIPLINE, CDO_ITEM_NAME ORDER BY CDD_SERVICE_DT DESC) RN , OCV_CURR_LOC AS LOCATION, OP_DISPLAY_NAME AS PROVIDER, OP_DISCIPLINE AS SERVICE, CDO_SECTION , CDO_ITEM_NAME, TRIM(CDO_VALUE_TEXT) AS VALUE_TEXT FROM IDB.CD_DOCUMENT LEFT JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION ON CDD_DOC_GUID = CDO_DOC_GUID AND CDD_AUTHORED_DTE = CDO_AUTHORED_DTE JOIN IDB.OMS_PROVIDER ON CDD_AUTH_PROV_GUID = OP_PVDR_GUID AND OP_DISCIPLINE IN ('Physical Therapy', 'Occupational Therapy') LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_CLIENT_VISIT ON OCV_VISIT_GUID = CDD_VISIT_GUID WHERE CDD_CANCEL_IND <> '1' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND <> '1' AND CDD_SERVICE_DTE >= '2015-01-01' AND CDD_DOC_NAME IN ('Initial/ReEval/Completion Summary, OT - Rehabilitation', 'Initial/ReEval/Completion Summary, PT - Rehabilitation', 'Initial/ReEval/ReAssess, Lymphedema Therapy - Rehabilitation') AND (CDO_ITEM_NAME IN ('In-Person Visit', 'LTO_Visit Type ls obs', 'Visit Type:', 'PTO_Visit IRD type res obs', 'LTO_Visit Discipline ls obs', 'LTO_Visit Type ls obs', 'OTO_Visit Initial Re eval res obs', 'Referral Date:', 'Date Start:', 'Start of care:', 'Start of Care Date:', 'Referring MD/NP:', 'Visit #:', 'Other Untimed Treatment Minutes:', 'Other Untimed Treatment Minutes', 'Date Start:', 'Therapy Plan of Care Date:', 'Date End:', 'Onset date:', 'Start of care:', 'Timed treatment minutes: min', 'Total Minutes', 'Insurance:', 'Consent', 'Pre-Cert Required', 'Insurance:', 'License Number:', 'Consent', 'Preferred Language') OR LOWER(CDO_ITEM_NAME) LIKE '%in%person%visit%' ) ) WHERE RN =1 ) SELECT C.CDD_MRN AS MRN, C.CDD_SERVICE_DTE AS SERVICE_DATE, C.CDD_DOC_NAME DOC_NAME, MAX(C.IP_OP_FLAG) OP_IP_FLAG, MAX(C.PROVIDER) AS PROVIDER, MAX(C.SERVICE) SERVICE, MAX(C.LOCATION) AS LOCATION, MAX(T.VALUE_TEXT) AS VISIT_TYPE, MAX(COALESCE(P.VALUE_TEXT, 'No-')) AS "In Person Visit", MAX(R.VALUE_TEXT) AS REFERRAL_DATE, MAX(D.VALUE_TEXT) AS START_DATE, MAX(E.VALUE_TEXT) AS END_DATE, MAX(S.VALUE_TEXT) AS "Start of Care", MAX(N.VALUE_TEXT) AS "Referring MD/NP", MAX(V.VALUE_TEXT) AS "Visit Number", MAX(A12.VALUE_TEXT) AS "Specialty", MAX(A13.VALUE_TEXT) AS PREHAB, MAX(A1.VALUE_TEXT) AS "Other Untimed Treatment Minutes", MAX(A2.VALUE_TEXT) AS "Therapy Plan of Care Date", MAX(A3.VALUE_TEXT) AS "Onset date:", MAX(A4.VALUE_TEXT) AS "Timed Treatment Minutes", MAX(A11.VALUE_TEXT) AS "IE/RE Untimed Treatment Minutes", MAX(A5.VALUE_TEXT) AS "Total Minutes", MAX(A6.VALUE_TEXT) AS "Insurance", MAX(A7.VALUE_TEXT) AS "Consent", MAX(A8.VALUE_TEXT) AS "Pre-Cert Required", MAX(A9.VALUE_TEXT) AS "License Number", MAX(A10.VALUE_TEXT) AS "Preferred Language" FROM CLIN C LEFT JOIN CLIN T ON C.DOC_GUID = T.DOC_GUID AND T.CDO_ITEM_NAME IN ('LTO_Visit Type ls obs', 'Visit Type:' , 'PTO_Visit IRD type res obs', 'LTO_Visit Discipline ls obs', 'LTO_Visit Type ls obs', 'OTO_Visit Initial Re eval res obs') LEFT JOIN CLIN P ON C.DOC_GUID = P.DOC_GUID AND LOWER(P.CDO_ITEM_NAME) LIKE '%in%person%visit%' LEFT JOIN CLIN R ON C.DOC_GUID = R.DOC_GUID AND R.CDO_ITEM_NAME = 'Referral Date:' LEFT JOIN CLIN D ON C.DOC_GUID = D.DOC_GUID AND D.CDO_ITEM_NAME = 'Date Start:' LEFT JOIN CLIN E ON C.DOC_GUID = D.DOC_GUID AND D.CDO_ITEM_NAME = 'Date End:' LEFT JOIN CLIN S ON C.DOC_GUID = S.DOC_GUID AND S.CDO_ITEM_NAME IN ('Start of care:', 'Start of Care Date:') LEFT JOIN CLIN N ON C.DOC_GUID = N.DOC_GUID AND N.CDO_ITEM_NAME = 'Referring MD/NP:' LEFT JOIN CLIN V ON C.DOC_GUID = V.DOC_GUID AND V.CDO_ITEM_NAME = 'Visit #:' LEFT JOIN CLIN A1 ON C.DOC_GUID = A1.DOC_GUID AND A1.CDO_ITEM_NAME IN ('Other Untimed Treatment Minutes:', 'Other Untimed Treatment Minutes') LEFT JOIN CLIN A2 ON C.DOC_GUID = A2.DOC_GUID AND A2.CDO_ITEM_NAME IN ('Therapy Plan of Care Date:') LEFT JOIN CLIN A3 ON C.DOC_GUID = A3.DOC_GUID AND A3.CDO_ITEM_NAME = 'Onset date:' LEFT JOIN CLIN A4 ON C.DOC_GUID = A4.DOC_GUID AND A4.CDO_ITEM_NAME IN ('Timed treatment minutes: min', 'Timed Treatment Minutes') LEFT JOIN CLIN A5 ON C.DOC_GUID = A5.DOC_GUID AND A5.CDO_ITEM_NAME IN ('Total Minutes', 'Total Minutes: min') LEFT JOIN CLIN A6 ON C.DOC_GUID = A6.DOC_GUID AND A6.CDO_ITEM_NAME = 'Insurance:' LEFT JOIN CLIN A7 ON C.DOC_GUID = A7.DOC_GUID AND A7.CDO_ITEM_NAME LIKE '%Consent%' LEFT JOIN CLIN A8 ON C.DOC_GUID = A8.DOC_GUID AND A8.CDO_ITEM_NAME = 'Pre-Cert Required' LEFT JOIN CLIN A9 ON C.DOC_GUID = A9.DOC_GUID AND A9.CDO_ITEM_NAME = 'License Number:' LEFT JOIN CLIN A10 ON C.DOC_GUID = A10.DOC_GUID AND A10.CDO_ITEM_NAME = 'Preferred Language' LEFT JOIN CLIN A11 ON C.DOC_GUID = A11.DOC_GUID AND A11.CDO_ITEM_NAME = 'IE/RE Untimed Treatment Minutes:' LEFT JOIN CLIN A12 ON C.DOC_GUID = A12.DOC_GUID AND A12.CDO_ITEM_NAME = 'Specialty:' LEFT JOIN CLIN A13 ON C.DOC_GUID = A13.DOC_GUID AND A13.CDO_ITEM_NAME = 'PREHAB' GROUP BY C.CDD_MRN, C.CDD_SERVICE_DTE, C.CDD_DOC_NAME ;

prompt:
Provide a list of all billed shared visits for NP Nana Keteku for 2019, 2020, and 2021 

Provide list of all billed independent visits for NP Nana Keteku for 2019, 2020, and 2021
completion: WITH BASE AS (SELECT PBD_MRN AS MRN, PBD_SVC_DTE AS SVC_DTE, PBC_CPT_CD AS CPT, PBC_PBD_DESC AS CPT_DESC, PBC_PBD_CD AS PBD_CD, PBI_PERFORM_DR_NO AS VST_PROVIDER_NO, A.DOC_NAME AS VST_PROVIDER_NAME, A.DOC_SVC VST_PROVIDER_SVC, PBD_SVC_QTY AS SVC_QTY, CAST(AV_DESC AS CHAR(50)) BILLING_AREA, PBI_NP_NO VST_NP_NO, B.DOC_NAME AS VST_CO_PROVIDER_NAME, B.DOC_SVC AS VST_CO_PROVIDER_SVC FROM IDB.PBD_DTL_CHARGES JOIN IDB.PBD_INVOICE ON PBD_INV_NO = PBI_INV_NO AND PBD_ACCT_NO= PBI_ACCT_NO AND PBD_MRN=PBI_MRN AND PBI_INV_STS = '' JOIN IDB.PBD_CODE ON PBC_PBD_CD=PBD_PBD_CD JOIN IDB.DOC A ON PBI_PERFORM_DR_NO = A.DOC_DR_NO LEFT JOIN IDB.DOC B ON PBI_NP_NO = B.DOC_DR_NO AND PBI_NP_NO <> '' JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS ON AV_ELEMENT = 'BILLING_AREA' AND AV_CODE = PBI_BILLING_AREA WHERE PBD_SVC_DTE >= '1/1/2017' AND PBD_SVC_DTE <= '6/30/2021' AND(PBI_PERFORM_DR_NO IN ('081984', '181984', '881984') OR PBI_NP_NO IN ('081984', '181984', '881984')) ) SELECT * FROM BASE WHERE VST_CO_PROVIDER_NAME IS NOT NULL ; WITH BASE AS (SELECT PBD_MRN AS MRN, PBD_SVC_DTE AS SVC_DTE, PBC_CPT_CD AS CPT, PBC_PBD_DESC AS CPT_DESC, PBC_PBD_CD AS PBD_CD, PBI_PERFORM_DR_NO AS VST_PROVIDER_NO, A.DOC_NAME AS VST_PROVIDER_NAME, A.DOC_SVC VST_PROVIDER_SVC, PBD_SVC_QTY AS SVC_QTY, CAST(AV_DESC AS CHAR(50)) BILLING_AREA, PBI_NP_NO VST_NP_NO, B.DOC_NAME AS VST_CO_PROVIDER_NAME, B.DOC_SVC AS VST_CO_PROVIDER_SVC FROM IDB.PBD_DTL_CHARGES JOIN IDB.PBD_INVOICE ON PBD_INV_NO = PBI_INV_NO AND PBD_ACCT_NO= PBI_ACCT_NO AND PBD_MRN=PBI_MRN AND PBI_INV_STS = '' JOIN IDB.PBD_CODE ON PBC_PBD_CD=PBD_PBD_CD JOIN IDB.DOC A ON PBI_PERFORM_DR_NO = A.DOC_DR_NO LEFT JOIN IDB.DOC B ON PBI_NP_NO = B.DOC_DR_NO AND PBI_NP_NO <> '' JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS ON AV_ELEMENT = 'BILLING_AREA' AND AV_CODE = PBI_BILLING_AREA WHERE PBD_SVC_DTE >= '1/1/2017' AND PBD_SVC_DTE <= '6/30/2021' AND(PBI_PERFORM_DR_NO IN ('081984', '181984', '881984') OR PBI_NP_NO IN ('081984', '181984', '881984')) ) SELECT * FROM BASE WHERE VST_CO_PROVIDER_NAME IS NULL

prompt: Provide a list of patients who had procedures done in Anesthesia Pain in 2018 and 2019
Provide a semi-weekly report for the 'Pulmonary Outpatient Referral' Order for orders that have not been "completed"
completion: SELECT OO_MRN AS MRN , TRIM(PT_LAST_NAME) || ', ' || TRIM(PT_FIRST_NAME) AS "Patient Name" , TRIM(OO_ORD_NAME) AS "Order Name" , OUO_REQ_FOR_DTE AS "Requested For Date" , DATE(OO_ENTER_DT) AS "Enter Date" , TRIM(OO_REQ_TME_PRIO) AS "Time Priority" , TRIM(OUO_STS_DESC) AS "Status Description" , OO_ORD_STS_CD AS "Status Code" , TRIM(OUD_USER_DI_VALUE) AS "Dr Preference" , CASE WHEN PT_DATE_OF_DEATH IS NOT NULL THEN 'Deceased' ELSE 'Alive' END AS "Vital Status" FROM IDB.OMS_ORDER JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_CATALOG ON OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID = OOC_MSTR_ITEM_GUID JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PT_MRN = OO_MRN JOIN IDB.OMS_USER_ORDERS ON OO_ORD_GUID = OUO_ORD_GUID LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_USER_DATA OUD ON OUD_ORD_GUID = OO_ORD_GUID AND OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'Consult_Pulm OP Attending' WHERE 1=1 AND OO_ENTER_DTE >= CURRENT date - 7 DAYS AND OOC_ITEM_NAME = 'Pulmonary Outpatient Referral' AND OUD_USER_DI_VALUE = '.No Preference' AND OUO_STS_DESC IN ('Active', 'Hold') ORDER BY OO_ENTER_DTE, OO_MRN ;

prompt: Provide a lit of ECP post transplant on Pediatrics and Adult Transplant/Cellular Therapy services
completion: WITH RAW AS (SELECT CDD_MRN, CDD_DOC_GUID, CDD_DOC_NAME, CDD_SERVICE_DTE, CDO_ITEM_NAME, CDO_VALUE_TEXT, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CDD_MRN ORDER BY CDD_SERVICE_DTE) RN FROM IDB.CD_DOCUMENT JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION ON CDD_DOC_GUID = CDO_DOC_GUID WHERE CDD_DOC_NAME = 'Procedure Note - Lab Medicine' AND CDD_SERVICE_DTE >= '2020-01-01' AND CDO_ITEM_NAME = 'Lab Med_Donor Room_Procedure Performed_RES' AND CDO_VALUE_TEXT = 'EXTRACORPOREAL PHOTOPHERESIS (ECP)' AND CDD_CANCEL_IND <> '1' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND <> '1' ) , CRDB AS (SELECT CDD_MRN CRDB_MRN, MAX(CASE WHEN CBP_MRN IS NOT NULL THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END) PEDS_CRDB, MAX(CASE WHEN CBM_MRN IS NOT NULL THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END) MED_CRDB FROM RAW LEFT JOIN IDB.CRDB_BMT_PEDIATRICS ON CDD_MRN = CBP_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.CRDB_BMT_MEDICINE ON CDD_MRN = CBM_MRN WHERE RN = 1 GROUP BY CDD_MRN ) SELECT PT_MRN MRN, PT_LAST_NAME LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME FIRST_NAME, RAW.CDD_SERVICE_DTE ECP_DATE, TRIM(O.CDO_VALUE_TEXT) REFERRING_MD, PEDS_CRDB, MED_CRDB FROM RAW LEFT JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION O ON CDD_DOC_GUID = O.CDO_DOC_GUID AND O.CDO_ITEM_NAME = 'Lab Med Donor Room - Referring Physician' JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON CDD_MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN CRDB ON CDD_MRN = CRDB_MRN WHERE RN = 1

prompt: We are requesting the MSK Engage data for esophagectomy patients who completed their surveys. It is titled Esophagectomy Patient Report.
