prompt: Provide a report of all PSMA scans, including the text under the heading "HEAD/FACE".
completion: WITH PET AS (SELECT DISTINCT "t1"."PT_MRN" AS "MRN", STRIP(PT_LAST_NAME) || ', ' || STRIP(PT_FIRST_NAME) AS "Name", PT_BIRTH_DTE AS DOB, "t2"."RRPT_ACCESSION_NO" AS "Radiology Accession Number", "t2"."RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE" AS "Radiology Performed Date", "t2"."RRPT_ORDER_GROUP" AS "Radiology Order Group", "t2"."RRPT_PROCEDURE_NAME" AS "Radiology Procedure Name", UPPER(DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)HEAD/FACE:[\w\W]*(?=NECK:)', RRPT_REPORT_TXT)) AS "HEAD/FACE:" FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V" "t1" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED" "t3" ON "t1"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t3"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."RADIOLOGY_REPORT_V" "t2" ON "t3"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t2"."RRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_IDENTIFICATION_MRN_V" "t4" ON "t1"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t4"."PI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" WHERE 1=1 AND "t2"."RRPT_PROCEDURE_NAME" like '%PSMA%' ) , PSA AS (SELECT DISTINCT LR_MRN, "Radiology Performed Date", LR_PERFORMED_DTE AS PERFORMED_DTE, LR_PERFORMED_DTE AS PERFORMED_DT, LR_TEST_NAME AS TEST_NAME, LR_SUBTEST_NAME AS SUBTEST_NAME, LR_RESULT_VALUE AS RESULT_VALUE, LR_UNIT_MEASURE AS UNIT_MEASURE, LTL_TEXT_RESULT AS TEXT_RESULT, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY LR_MRN, "Radiology Performed Date" ORDER BY LR_PERFORMED_DTE DESC) AS RN FROM PET JOIN IDB.LAB_RESULTS ON LR_MRN = MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.LAB_TEXT_LINE ON LTL_RESULT_GUID = LR_RESULT_GUID WHERE(UPPER(LR_SUBTEST_NAME) LIKE '%PROSTATE%' OR LR_SUBTEST_NAME LIKE '%PSA%') AND LR_SUBTEST_NAME <> 'PSA Ratio: (Free/Total)' AND LR_PERFORMED_DTE <= "Radiology Performed Date") SELECT * FROM PSA WHERE RN = 1 SELECT DISTINCT SSE_MRN, SSE_SURG_DTE, SSP_SURG_SVC_CD, SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD, SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC FROM PET JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT ON SSE_MRN = MRN JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE ON SSE_LOG_ID = SSP_LOG_ID WHERE 1=1 AND SSP_SURG_SVC_CD IN ('NEURO', 'HNS')

prompt: Provide a report on the outpatient gastrointestinal procedures at Endoscopy Suite for the specified time periods.
completion: WITH X AS (SELECT PT_MRN AS MRN, PT_SEX AS SEX, YEAR(CURRENT date - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) AS AGE FROM IDB.PATIENT WHERE PT_MRN IN () ) , Y AS (SELECT DISTINCT MRN, SEX, AGE, CPP_LANG, CPP_PP_LST_LGN_DTE, CPP_REMINDER_PREFERENCES, CPP_MESSAGE_DELIVERY , CASE WHEN ((OPIN.CCP_COMMUNICATION_CONCEPT_ID = 28505 AND YESTEXT.CCPA_APRV_MEDIA = 'TEXT MESSAGE' AND NOTEXT.CCPA_APRV_MEDIA IS NULL) OR ((OPIN.CCP_COMMUNICATION_CONCEPT_ID = 28505 AND YESTEXT.CCPA_APRV_MEDIA = 'TEXT MESSAGE') AND (OPOUT.CCP_COMMUNICATION_CONCEPT_ID = 28104 AND NOTEXT.CCPA_APRV_MEDIA ='TEXT MESSAGE'))) THEN 'Text Opt In' WHEN (OPOUT.CCP_COMMUNICATION_CONCEPT_ID = 28104 AND NOTEXT.CCPA_APRV_MEDIA = 'TEXT MESSAGE' AND YESTEXT.CCPA_APRV_MEDIA IS NULL) THEN 'Text Opt Out' END AS "Text Preference" FROM X LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_PAS_PATIENT PAT ON CPP_MRN = MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_COMMUNICATION_PREFERENCES OPIN ON PAT.CPP_PREFERENCES_ID = OPIN.CCP_PREFERENCES_ID AND OPIN.CCP_COMMUNICATION_CONCEPT_ID = 28505 LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_COMMUNICATION_PREFERENCES OPOUT ON PAT.CPP_PREFERENCES_ID = OPOUT.CCP_PREFERENCES_ID AND OPOUT.CCP_COMMUNICATION_CONCEPT_ID = 28104 LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_COMM_PREFERENCES_APRV YESTEXT ON PAT.CPP_PREFERENCES_ID = YESTEXT.CCPA_PREFERENCES_ID AND YESTEXT.CCPA_APRV_MEDIA = 'TEXT MESSAGE' AND OPIN.CCP_LINE_NO = YESTEXT.CCPA_GROUP_LINE_NO LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_COMM_PREFERENCES_APRV NOTEXT ON PAT.CPP_PREFERENCES_ID = NOTEXT.CCPA_PREFERENCES_ID AND NOTEXT.CCPA_APRV_MEDIA = 'TEXT MESSAGE' AND OPOUT.CCP_LINE_NO = NOTEXT.CCPA_GROUP_LINE_NO ) , SRG1 AS (SELECT DISTINCT SSE_MRN AS MRN, SSE_SURG_DTE, SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD, SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC FROM IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE ON SSE_LOG_ID = SSP_LOG_ID WHERE 1=1 AND SSE_MRN IN (SELECT MRN FROM X) ) , SRG2 AS (SELECT MRN AS SSE_MRN, LISTAGG(COALESCE(STRIP(SSE_SURG_DTE), '') || ' | ' || COALESCE(STRIP(CAST(SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD AS VARCHAR(12000))), '') || ' - ' || COALESCE(STRIP(CAST(SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC AS VARCHAR(12000))), '') , CHR(13) || CHR(10)) WITHIN GROUP( ORDER BY MRN, SSE_SURG_DTE, SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD, SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC) AS SRG FROM SRG1 GROUP BY MRN) SELECT DISTINCT Y.*, SRG FROM Y LEFT JOIN SRG2 ON MRN = SSE_MRN

prompt: Provide a list of patients who were transplanted with Unrelated Donors in 2020 and 2021.
completion: SELECT DISTINCT STRIP(OO_MRN) AS MRN, STRIP(PT_LAST_NAME) || ', ' || STRIP(PT_FIRST_NAME) AS "Name", STRIP(OO_ORD_NAME) AS "Order Name", OO_ORD_STS_CD, OSTS_STS_DESC, STRIP(X3.OUD_USER_DI_VALUE) AS "Relationship to Patient", STRIP(X2.OUD_USER_DI_VALUE) AS "If unrelated NMDP#", DATE(STRIP(X1.OUD_USER_DI_VALUE)) AS "Proposed Start Date" FROM IDB.OMS_ORDER JOIN IDB.OMS_STATUS ON OO_ORD_STS_CD = OSTS_ORD_STS_CD JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PT_MRN = OO_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_USER_DATA X1 ON OO_ORD_GUID = X1.OUD_ORD_GUID AND X1.OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'Requested For' LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_USER_DATA X2 ON OO_ORD_GUID = X2.OUD_ORD_GUID AND X2.OUD_USER_DI_CD IN ('Stem Cell NMDP#') LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_USER_DATA X3 ON OO_ORD_GUID = X3.OUD_ORD_GUID AND X3.OUD_USER_DI_CD IN ('Stem Cell Relationship') WHERE 1=1 AND OO_ORD_NAME IN ('ALLO - HPC-A Thaw Infusion Order', 'ALLO - HPC-M Thaw Infusion Order') AND DATE(STRIP(X1.OUD_USER_DI_VALUE)) BETWEEN '2020-01-01' AND '2021-12-31' AND OO_MRN <> '11111111' AND OO_ORD_STS_CD NOT IN ('CANC', 'CANP', 'AUC3', 'DISC')

prompt: Provide a lit of pediatric outpatients having labs drawn, to time of result, to Clearance to Treat (CTT) order released to become more operationally efficient and review benefit of CTT order
completion: WITH PACC AS (SELECT CPE_MRN AS "MRN", CPE_ENC_DTE AS "Appt Date", TIME(CPE_APPT_DT) "Appt Time", TIME(CPE_RM_IN_DT) "Room in Time", TIME(CPE_RM_OUT_DT) "Room out Time", D.CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 AS "Department", D.CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 AS "Service", D.CLD_DEPT_NAME AS "Dept Name", CRE_RES_NAME AS "Provider Name", CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME AS "Visit Type", REF.CLD_DEPT_NAME AS "Ref Dept Name" FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT D ON CPE_DEPT_ID = D.CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT REF ON CPE_REF_DEP_ID = REF.CLD_DEPT_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN '2021-01-01' AND CURRENT date AND D.CLD_DEPT_NAME IN ('PACC BED 1275') ) , LAB AS (SELECT LR_MRN, LR_TEST_NAME, LR_RESULT_STS_CD, LR_PERFORMED_DTE , MIN(CASE WHEN OSH_FUNCTION_CD='12' AND OSH_ORD_STS_CD = 'SPRV' THEN OSH_CREATE_DT END) SPECIMEN_RECEIVED , MIN(CASE WHEN OSH_ORD_STS_CD IN ('RESF', 'RESC') THEN OSH_CREATE_DT END) RESULTS_RECEIVED FROM PACC JOIN IDB.LAB_RESULTS ON "MRN" = LR_MRN AND "Appt Date" = LR_PERFORMED_DTE LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_ORDER ON LR_ORD_GUID = OO_ORD_GUID LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_STS_HX ON OO_ORD_GUID = OSH_ORD_GUID WHERE LR_TEST_NAME IN ('Complete Blood Count (CBC), Standard', 'Complete Blood Count (CBC), with ANC only', 'Complete Blood Count (CBC), WITH Differential', 'Comp. Metabolic Panel & Direct Bilirubin', 'Comprehensive Metabolic Panel') AND LR_RESULT_STS_CD IN ('F', 'C') GROUP BY LR_MRN, LR_TEST_NAME, LR_RESULT_STS_CD, LR_PERFORMED_DTE ) , ORD AS (SELECT OO_MRN, OO_ORD_NAME, OO_ENTER_DTE, OO_ENTER_DT FROM PACC JOIN IDB.OMS_ORDER ON "MRN" = OO_MRN AND "Appt Date" = OO_ENTER_DTE WHERE OO_ORD_NAME IN ('Pediatric Clearance for Chemo Tx') AND OO_ORD_STS_CD NOT IN ('CANP', 'CANC', 'AUC3') ) SELECT "MRN", "Appt Date", "Appt Time", "Room in Time", "Room out Time", "Department", "Service", "Dept Name", "Provider Name", "Visit Type", "Ref Dept Name", LR_TEST_NAME, TIME(SPECIMEN_RECEIVED) SPECIMEN_RECEIVED, TIME(RESULTS_RECEIVED) RESULTS_RECEIVED, OO_ORD_NAME ORDER_NAME, TIME(OO_ENTER_DT) ORDER_ENTERED_DT FROM PACC LEFT JOIN LAB ON "MRN" = LR_MRN AND "Appt Date" = LR_PERFORMED_DTE LEFT JOIN ORD ON "MRN" = OO_MRN AND "Appt Date" = OO_ENTER_DTE

prompt:
I need the following data for MSKCC’s current catchment area:

--number and percentage of active patients at MSKCC living below the federal poverty line

--number and percentage of active patients at MSKCC that are uninsured
completion: WITH X AS (SELECT DISTINCT MRN, "Name", "Order ID", "Hospital Admission Date", DAYS("Admin Date") - DAYS("Hospital Admission Date") AS "LOS when naloxone administered", "Admin Date", "Admin Time", "Admin DateTime", "Admin Day of Week", "Order Name", "Order Set Name", OOTO_TASK_DOSE AS "Dose", OOTO_TASK_UOM AS "Unit", "Route", "Route (grouped)", "Location", "Requester Name", "Service", "ICU Admission Date", "ICU Discharge Date", "Date of Death" FROM (SELECT DISTINCT OO_MRN AS MRN, STRIP(PT_LAST_NAME)||', '||STRIP(PT_FIRST_NAME) AS "Name", PT_DATE_OF_DEATH AS "Date of Death", OO_ORD_ID AS "Order ID", OO_ORD_GUID AS "Order GUID", OO_ADM_NUM AS ADM_NUM, '' AS "Log ID", CASE WHEN DAYOFWEEK(OOTO_SIGNIFIC_DTE) = 1 THEN 'Sunday' WHEN DAYOFWEEK(OOTO_SIGNIFIC_DTE) = 2 THEN 'Monday' WHEN DAYOFWEEK(OOTO_SIGNIFIC_DTE) = 3 THEN 'Tuesday' WHEN DAYOFWEEK(OOTO_SIGNIFIC_DTE) = 4 THEN 'Wednesday' WHEN DAYOFWEEK(OOTO_SIGNIFIC_DTE) = 5 THEN 'Thursday' WHEN DAYOFWEEK(OOTO_SIGNIFIC_DTE) = 6 THEN 'Friday' WHEN DAYOFWEEK(OOTO_SIGNIFIC_DTE) = 7 THEN 'Saturday' ELSE '' END AS "Admin Day of Week", OOTO_SIGNIFIC_DTE AS "Admin Date", OOTO_SIGNIFIC_DT AS "Admin DateTime", TIME(OOTO_SIGNIFIC_DT) AS "Admin Time", OO_SET_NAME AS "Order Set Name", OO_ORD_NAME AS "Order Name", CASE WHEN UPPER(OO_ORD_NAME) LIKE '%FENTANYL%' THEN 'FENTANYL' WHEN UPPER(OO_ORD_NAME) LIKE '%HYDROMORPHONE%' THEN 'HYDROMORPHONE' WHEN UPPER(OO_ORD_NAME) LIKE '%MORPHINE%' THEN 'MORPHINE' WHEN UPPER(OO_ORD_NAME) LIKE '%NALOXONE%' THEN 'NALOXONE' WHEN UPPER(OO_ORD_NAME) LIKE '%METHADONE%' THEN 'METHADONE' WHEN UPPER(OO_ORD_NAME) LIKE '%KETOROLAC%' THEN 'KETOROLAC' WHEN UPPER(OO_ORD_NAME) LIKE '%KETAMINE%' THEN 'KETAMINE' WHEN UPPER(OO_ORD_NAME) LIKE '%OLICERIDINE%' THEN 'OLICERIDINE' WHEN UPPER(OO_ORD_NAME) LIKE '%ACETAMINOPHEN%' THEN UPPER(OO_ORD_NAME) WHEN UPPER(OO_ORD_NAME) LIKE '%OFIRMEV%' THEN 'ACETAMINOPHEN' END AS "Drug Name", OMD_DOSE_LOW, SUBSTR(OO_SUMMARY_LINE, 1, 255) AS "Summary Line", OOTO_TASK_DOSE, OOTO_TASK_UOM, CASE WHEN LEFT(OMD_DOSE_LOW, 1) BETWEEN '0' AND '9' THEN CAST(STRIP(OMD_DOSE_LOW) AS DECIMAL(18, 4)) END AS "Low Dose", OMD_DOSE_HIGH AS "High Dose", OMD_DOSE_UNIT AS "Unit", OMD_ORD_ROUTE AS "Route", CASE WHEN UPPER(OMD_ORD_ROUTE) IN ('IV BOLUS.', 'IV PUSH', 'IM', 'IVPB', 'INJECTION', 'SUBCUTANEOUS') THEN 'INJ' WHEN OMD_ORD_ROUTE = 'PCA Epidural' THEN 'PCA EPIDURAL' WHEN OMD_ORD_ROUTE = 'PCA IV' THEN 'PCA IV' WHEN OMD_ORD_ROUTE = 'IVCI' THEN 'IVCI' WHEN OO_ORD_NAME LIKE '%IV PCA%' THEN 'PCA IV' ELSE 'OTHER' END AS "Route (grouped)", DATE(OCV_ADM_DT) AS "Hospital Admission Date", OS_SVC_GRP_CD, STRIP(OS_SVC_DESC) AS "Service", UPPER(OUO_PVDR_NAME) AS "Requester Name", OUO_PVDR_ROLE_TYPE AS "Requester Role", OUO_ATN_PVDR_NAME AS "Visit Attending", OCV_CURR_LOC AS "Location", ICU_ICU_ADM_DTE AS "ICU Admission Date", ICU_ICU_DSCH_DTE AS "ICU Discharge Date" FROM IDB.OMS_ORDER JOIN IDB.OAS_ORD_TASK_OCCR ON OOTO_ORD_GUID = OO_ORD_GUID AND OOTO_STATUS_CD = 'Performed' JOIN IDB.OAS_CTLG_ITEM_TASK ON OOTO_CAT_ITEM_GUID = OCIT_GUID AND OCIT_LEVEL_NO = 0 JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PT_MRN = OO_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_MED_DETAIL OMD ON OMD_ORD_GUID = OO_ORD_GUID LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_USER_ORDERS ON OUO_ORD_GUID = OO_ORD_GUID LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_CLIENT_VISIT ON OO_VISIT_GUID = OCV_VISIT_GUID LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_SERVICE ON OCV_SVC_GUID = OS_SVC_GUID LEFT JOIN IDB.ICU_CENSUS ON ICU_MRN = OO_MRN AND ICU_ICU_ADM_DTE BETWEEN OOTO_SIGNIFIC_DTE AND OOTO_SIGNIFIC_DTE + 2 DAYS WHERE OO_ORD_STS_CD NOT IN ('CANC', 'CANP', 'AUC3') AND UPPER(OO_ORD_NAME) LIKE '%NALOXONE%' AND UPPER(OO_ORD_NAME) NOT LIKE '%QUICK CHARGE%' AND OO_ORD_NAME <> 'Acetaminophen' AND OOTO_SIGNIFIC_DTE BETWEEN '2016-01-01' AND CURRENT DATE - 1 DAY AND OMD_ORD_ROUTE NOT IN ('oral', 'buccal', 'transdermal', 'PCA IV CAB', 'PCA Epidural CAB') AND OO_ORD_NAME NOT LIKE '%CAB%' ) N WHERE "Route (grouped)" IN ('PCA IV', 'INJ') AND "Admin Date" >= CURRENT date - 30 DAY ) , RRT_CIS AS (SELECT DISTINCT OO_MRN, "Admin Date", OO_ENTER_DTE AS "RRT Order Enter Date", OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE AS "RRT Significant Date", OO_ORD_NAME AS "RRT Order Name" FROM X JOIN IDB.OMS_ORDER ON MRN = OO_MRN AND OO_ORD_STS_CD NOT IN ('CANC', 'CANP', 'AUC3') AND OO_ORD_NAME like '%RRT%' AND("Admin Date" = OO_ENTER_DTE OR "Admin Date" = OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE)) , RRT_CD AS (SELECT CDD_MRN, "Admin Date", CDD_SERVICE_DTE, CDD_DOC_NAME FROM X JOIN IDB.CD_DOCUMENT ON MRN = CDD_MRN WHERE CDD_CANCEL_IND = '0' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND = '0' AND UPPER(CDD_DOC_NAME) LIKE '%RRT%' AND UPPER(CDD_DOC_NAME) LIKE '%CRRT%' AND CDD_SERVICE_DTE BETWEEN "Admin Date" AND "Admin Date" + 1 DAY ) SELECT DISTINCT X.*, CASE WHEN RRT_CIS.OO_MRN IS NOT NULL THEN 'Y' END AS "RRT order", CASE WHEN RRT_CD.CDD_MRN IS NOT NULL THEN 'Y' END AS "RRT note" FROM X LEFT JOIN RRT_CIS ON MRN = OO_MRN LEFT JOIN RRT_CD ON MRN = CDD_MRN

prompt: We need a list of rectal cancer patients coming into Dr. Garcia Aguilar or Dr. Weiser’s clinics that are currently getting either radiation and/or chemotherapy treatment. The report should also include all previous biopsy dates and if they are on any research protocols (06-107 and 12-245).
completion: WITH APPTS AS (SELECT CPE_MRN, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_LAST_NAME, CPE_ENC_DTE AS PT_APPT_DT, CRE_RES_NAME AS PROVIDER FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PT_MRN = CPE_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Sch') AND CRE_RES_TYP IN ('Physician') AND (CRE_RES_NAME LIKE '%GARCIA%AGUILAR%' OR CRE_RES_NAME LIKE '%WEISER%MARTIN%') AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT date AND CURRENT date + 2 MONTHS ) , PROC AS (SELECT SSE_MRN, SSE_SURG_DTE, SSE_SURG_STRT_DT FROM IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE ON SSE_LOG_ID = SSP_LOG_ID AND SSE_ENC_CSN_ID = SSP_ENC_CSN_ID JOIN APPTS ON CPE_MRN = SSE_MRN WHERE (SSE_SURG_LOC not like '%IR%' AND SSE_SURG_LOC not like '%ENDO%' AND SSE_SOURCE_TYPE <> 'E') AND SSP_PROC_NAME NOT IN ('RESECTION, RECTUM, LOW ANTERIOR, OPEN, WITH LOOP ILEOSTOMY CREATION', 'RESECTION, RECTUM, LOW ANTERIOR, ROBOT-ASSISTED, WITH LOOP ILEOSTOMY CREATION', 'RESECTION, RECTUM, LOW ANTERIOR, ROBOT-ASSISTED, WITH COLOANAL ANASTOMOSIS AND LOOP ILEOSTOMY CREATION', 'RESECTION, RECTUM, LOW ANTERIOR, OPEN, WITH COLOANAL ANASTOMOSIS AND LOOP ILEOSTOMY CREATION', 'RESECTION, RECTUM, LOW ANTERIOR, LAPAROSCOPIC, WITH COLOANAL ANASTOMOSIS', 'RESECTION, RECTUM, LOW ANTERIOR', 'RESECTION, RECTUM, LOW ANTERIOR, ROBOT-ASSISTED')) , RAD_CHEMO AS (SELECT P.CPE_MRN AS MRN, PT_APPT_DT, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_LAST_NAME, SSE_SURG_STRT_DT, PROVIDER, D.CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 AS DEPARTMENT, D.CLD_DEPT_NAME AS "Department Name" FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER P JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT D ON P.CPE_DEPT_ID = D.CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN APPTS A ON A.CPE_MRN = P.CPE_MRN JOIN PROC ON SSE_MRN = P.CPE_MRN AND P.CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Sch') AND D.CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 IN ('CHM', 'RAD') AND P.CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT date AND CURRENT date + 60 DAYS) , REP1 AS (SELECT AC_MRN, AC_IRB_NO AS IRB1, CASE WHEN AC_CONS_DTE IS NULL AND AC_IRB_NO = '06-107' THEN 'N' WHEN AC_CONS_DTE IS NOT NULL AND AC_IRB_NO = '06-107' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'NA' END AS CONSENT_06_107 FROM IDB.ACCRUALS JOIN RAD_CHEMO ON AC_MRN = MRN WHERE AC_IRB_NO='06-107' ), REP2 AS (SELECT AC_MRN, AC_IRB_NO AS IRB2, CASE WHEN AC_CONS_DTE IS NULL AND AC_IRB_NO = '12-245' THEN 'N' WHEN AC_CONS_DTE IS NOT NULL AND AC_IRB_NO = '12-245' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'NA' END AS CONSENT_12_245 FROM IDB.ACCRUALS JOIN RAD_CHEMO ON AC_MRN = MRN WHERE AC_IRB_NO='12-245' ) SELECT DISTINCT MRN, PT_FIRST_NAME AS FIRST_NAME, PT_LAST_NAME AS LAST_NAME, PT_APPT_DT AS APPOINTMENT_WITH_DR, DATE(SSE_SURG_STRT_DT) AS SURGERY_DATE, PROVIDER, DEPARTMENT AS TREATMENT FROM RAD_CHEMO C LEFT JOIN REP1 ON REP1.AC_MRN=C.MRN LEFT JOIN REP2 ON REP2.AC_MRN=C.MRN ; WITH APPTS AS (SELECT CPE_MRN, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_LAST_NAME FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PT_MRN = CPE_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Sch') AND CRE_RES_TYP IN ('Physician') AND (CRE_RES_NAME LIKE '%GARCIA%AGUILAR%' OR CRE_RES_NAME LIKE '%WEISER%MARTIN%') AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT date AND CURRENT date + 2 MONTHS) , PROC AS (SELECT SSE_MRN, SSE_SURG_DTE, SSE_SURG_STRT_DT FROM IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE ON SSE_LOG_ID = SSP_LOG_ID AND SSE_ENC_CSN_ID = SSP_ENC_CSN_ID JOIN APPTS ON CPE_MRN = SSE_MRN WHERE (SSE_SURG_LOC not like '%IR%' AND SSE_SURG_LOC not like '%ENDO%' AND SSE_SOURCE_TYPE <> 'E') AND SSP_PROC_NAME NOT IN ('RESECTION, RECTUM, LOW ANTERIOR, OPEN, WITH LOOP ILEOSTOMY CREATION', 'RESECTION, RECTUM, LOW ANTERIOR, ROBOT-ASSISTED, WITH LOOP ILEOSTOMY CREATION', 'RESECTION, RECTUM, LOW ANTERIOR, ROBOT-ASSISTED, WITH COLOANAL ANASTOMOSIS AND LOOP ILEOSTOMY CREATION', 'RESECTION, RECTUM, LOW ANTERIOR, OPEN, WITH COLOANAL ANASTOMOSIS AND LOOP ILEOSTOMY CREATION', 'RESECTION, RECTUM, LOW ANTERIOR, LAPAROSCOPIC, WITH COLOANAL ANASTOMOSIS', 'RESECTION, RECTUM, LOW ANTERIOR', 'RESECTION, RECTUM, LOW ANTERIOR, ROBOT-ASSISTED') ) , RAD_CHEMO AS (SELECT P.CPE_MRN AS MRN, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_LAST_NAME, SSE_SURG_STRT_DT, D.CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 AS DEPARTMENT, D.CLD_DEPT_NAME AS "Department Name" FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER P JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT D ON P.CPE_DEPT_ID = D.CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN APPTS A ON A.CPE_MRN = P.CPE_MRN JOIN PROC ON SSE_MRN = P.CPE_MRN AND P.CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Sch') AND D.CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 IN ('CHM', 'RAD') AND P.CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT date AND CURRENT date + 60 DAYS) , REP1 AS (SELECT AC_MRN, AC_IRB_NO AS IRB1, CASE WHEN AC_CONS_DTE IS NULL AND AC_IRB_NO = '06-107' THEN 'N' WHEN AC_CONS_DTE IS NOT NULL AND AC_IRB_NO = '06-107' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'NA' END AS CONSENT_06_107 FROM IDB.ACCRUALS JOIN RAD_CHEMO ON AC_MRN = MRN WHERE AC_IRB_NO='06-107' ), REP2 AS (SELECT AC_MRN, AC_IRB_NO AS IRB2, CASE WHEN AC_CONS_DTE IS NULL AND AC_IRB_NO = '12-245' THEN 'N' WHEN AC_CONS_DTE IS NOT NULL AND AC_IRB_NO = '12-245' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'NA' END AS CONSENT_12_245 FROM IDB.ACCRUALS JOIN RAD_CHEMO ON AC_MRN = MRN WHERE AC_IRB_NO='12-245' ) SELECT DISTINCT MRN, PT_FIRST_NAME AS FIRST_NAME, PT_LAST_NAME AS LAST_NAME, IRB1 AS "CONSENT_06_107", IRB2 AS "CONSENT_12_245" FROM RAD_CHEMO C LEFT JOIN REP1 ON REP1.AC_MRN=C.MRN LEFT JOIN REP2 ON REP2.AC_MRN=C.MRN

prompt: Provide a list of patients diagnosed with malignant tumor of bone between 1971 and 2018.
completion: SELECT MRN, STRIP(PT_LAST_NAME)||', '||PT_FIRST_NAME AS PT_NAME, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH DOB, PT_DATE_OF_DEATH DOD, PT_SEX_DESC AS SEX, PT_RACE_DESC AS RACE, PT_PT_ETHNICITY_DESC AS ETHNICITY, PT_ZIP_CD, PT_STATE, PT_COUNTRY, DX_DTE, DX_CD, DX_DESC, HIST_CD, HIST_DESC , PFA_FST_DRVST_DTE , PFA_FST_CHEMO_MSK_DTE, PFA_FST_RT_MSK_DTE , CA_SURG_DTE, PRIM_SURGEON_NAME, DOC_SERVICE, PLA_LST_CON_DTE LAST_CONTACT_DTE, PLA_LST_KNOWN_ALIVE_DTE LST_KNOWN_ALIVE_DTE FROM (SELECT DISTINCT TM_MRN MRN, TM_DX_DTE DX_DTE, TM_SITE_CD DX_CD, ST.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS DX_DESC, TM_HIST_CD HIST_CD, HS.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS HIST_DESC, TM_CA_SURG_DTE CA_SURG_DTE, DOC_NAME PRIM_SURGEON_NAME, DOC_ACDMC_SVC DOC_SERVICE FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM ST ON TM_SITE_CD = ST.CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.CLM HS ON TM_HIST_CD = HS.CLM_CLSF_CD LEFT JOIN IDB.DOC ON TM_PRIM_SURGEON = DOC_DR_NO WHERE TM_CASE_STS = '3' AND TM_SITE_CD IN ('C400', 'C401', 'C402', 'C403', 'C408', 'C409', 'C414', 'C418', 'C419') AND TM_HIST_CD IN ('M9180/3', 'M9220/3', 'M9231/3', 'M9240/3', 'M9242/3', 'M9243/3', 'M9260/3', 'M8800/3', 'M8801/3', 'M8802/3', 'M8803/3', 'M8804/3', 'M8805/3', 'M8810/3', 'M8811/3', 'M8812/3', 'M8850/3', 'M8852/3', 'M8854/3', 'M8890/3', 'M8900/3', 'M8910/3', 'M9040/3', 'M9041/3', 'M9043/3', 'M9120/3', 'M9181/3', 'M9182/3', 'M9183/3', 'M9184/3', 'M9185/3', 'M9186/3', 'M9187/3', 'M9190/3', 'M9192/3', 'M9194/3', 'M9221/3', 'M9540/3', 'M9593/3', 'M9756/3', 'M9930/3', 'M9261/3', 'M9133/3', 'M9370/3', 'M9261/6', 'M9125/0', 'M9133/1', 'M9133/3', 'M9370/6', 'M9371/3', 'M9372/3', 'M9373/0') AND TM_DX_DTE BETWEEN '1/1/1971' AND '12/31/2018' ) AS A JOIN IDB.PATIENT_V ON MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.PT_FIRST_ACTIVITY ON PT_MRN = PFA_MRN JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY ON PT_MRN = PLA_MRN

prompt: Provide an on demand report of BMT patient vitals (weight, height, temperature, blood pressure)
completion: SELECT CDD_MRN MRN , TRIM(PT_LAST_NAME) || ', ' || TRIM(PT_FIRST_NAME) AS PATIENT_NAME , CDD_SERVICE_DTE , CAST(MAX(CASE WHEN CDO_OBS_CTLG_MSTR_ITEM_GUID = '9000002617502890' THEN SUBSTR(CDO_VALUE_TEXT, 1, 6) END) AS INT) BP_SYSTOLIC , CAST(MAX(CASE WHEN CDO_OBS_CTLG_MSTR_ITEM_GUID = '9000002617302890' THEN SUBSTR(CDO_VALUE_TEXT, 1, 6) END) AS INT) BP_DIASTOLIC , CAST(MAX(CASE WHEN CDO_OBS_CTLG_MSTR_ITEM_GUID = '9000002618702890' THEN SUBSTR(CDO_VALUE_TEXT, 1, 6) END) AS INT) HEART_RATE , CAST(MAX(CASE WHEN CDO_OBS_CTLG_MSTR_ITEM_GUID = '9000002626102890' THEN SUBSTR(CDO_VALUE_TEXT, 1, 6) END) AS INT) RESP_RATE , CAST(MAX(CASE WHEN CDO_OBS_CTLG_MSTR_ITEM_GUID = '9000002626302890' THEN SUBSTR(CDO_VALUE_TEXT, 1, 6) END) AS INT) PULSE_OX , CAST(MAX(CASE WHEN CDO_OBS_CTLG_MSTR_ITEM_GUID = '9000002620502890' THEN SUBSTR(CDO_VALUE_TEXT, 1, 6) END) AS DECIMAL(7, 2)) TEMP_C , CAST(MAX(CASE WHEN CDO_OBS_CTLG_MSTR_ITEM_GUID = '9000002629302890' THEN SUBSTR(CDO_VALUE_TEXT, 1, 6) END) AS DECIMAL(7, 2)) TEMP_F , CAST(MAX(CASE WHEN CDO_MSTR_ITEM_NM LIKE 'Weight%' THEN SUBSTR(CDO_VALUE_TEXT, 1, 6) END) AS DECIMAL(7, 3)) PT_WT_KG , CAST(MAX(CASE WHEN CDO_MSTR_ITEM_NM LIKE 'Height%' THEN SUBSTR(CDO_VALUE_TEXT, 1, 6) END) AS DECIMAL(7, 3)) PT_HT_CM , CAST(MAX(CASE WHEN CDO_MSTR_ITEM_NM LIKE 'BSA%' THEN SUBSTR(CDO_VALUE_TEXT, 1, 6) END) AS DECIMAL(7, 3)) PT_BSA , CAST(MAX(CASE WHEN CDO_MSTR_ITEM_NM LIKE 'BMI%' THEN SUBSTR(CDO_VALUE_TEXT, 1, 6) END) AS DECIMAL(7, 3)) PT_BMI FROM (SELECT CDD_DOC_GUID, CDD_MRN, CDD_AUTHORED_DTE AS AUTH_DTE , CDD_SERVICE_DTE , CDD_DOC_NAME, CDD_AUTHORED_DT, CDD_VISIT_GUID FROM IDB.CD_DOCUMENT WHERE CDD_CANCEL_IND = '0' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND = '0' AND CDD_MRN = '38276158' AND CDD_AUTHORED_DTE BETWEEN '1/1/2010' AND CURRENT DATE AND(CDD_DOC_NAME LIKE '%Vital Signs%' OR CDD_DOC_NAME = 'Nursing Assessment - JRSC' OR CDD_DOC_NAME = 'Nursing Perioperative Flowsheet' OR CDD_DOC_NAME LIKE '%Triage%') ) A JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION ON CDD_DOC_GUID = CDO_DOC_GUID AND CDO_AUTHORED_DTE = AUTH_DTE JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PT_MRN = CDD_MRN WHERE CDO_OBS_CTLG_MSTR_ITEM_GUID IN ('9000001189502890', '9000105100002890', '9000105098802890', '9000105099002890', '9000001188702890', '9000001187902890', '9000006166102890', '9000002626102890', '9000002626302890', '9000002620502890', '9000002617502890', '9000002617302890', '9000002618702890', '9000002626102890', '9000002626302890', '9000002620502890', '9000011478902890', '9000109369002890', '9000002629302890', '9000002627902890', '9000002626702890', '9000002626902890') AND(CDO_VALUE_TEXT > '0' OR(CDO_OBS_CTLG_MSTR_ITEM_GUID IN ('9000011478902890', '9000109369002890', '9000002627902890') AND CDO_VALUE_TEXT > '')) AND CDO_ITEM_NAME NOT LIKE '%Comment%' GROUP BY CDD_MRN, TRIM(PT_LAST_NAME) || ', ' || TRIM(PT_FIRST_NAME), CDD_SERVICE_DTE

prompt: Provide count of unique patients and  average total dose per year of bleomycin recipients since 2006.
completion: SELECT PO_MRN MRN, STRIP(PT_LAST_NAME)||', '||PT_FIRST_NAME AS PT_NAME , UCASE(PIN_GENERIC_NAME) AS DRUG_NAME , SUM(POI_DOSE) AS TOTAL_DOSE, POI_DOSE_UNIT AS DOSE_UNIT , COUNT(*) AS DISPENSES , YEAR(MIN(POD_STRT_DTE)) AS TX_START_YEAR , MIN(POD_STRT_DTE) AS TX_START_DATE , MAX(POD_STRT_DTE) AS TX_LAST_DATE FROM IDB.PHM_ORDER JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PT_MRN = PO_MRN JOIN IDB.PHM_ORD_DTL ON PO_ORD_SEQ = POD_ORD_SEQ JOIN IDB.PHM_ORD_INV ON POD_ORD_SEQ = POI_ORD_SEQ AND POD_ITEM_NO = POI_ITEM_NO JOIN IDB.PHM_INVENTORY ON POI_INV_SEQ = PIN_INV_SEQ AND PIN_GENERIC_SEQ = 151 JOIN IDB.PHM_AUD_ADMIN ON PAA_ORD_SEQ = POI_ORD_SEQ AND PAA_ITEM_NO = POI_ITEM_NO AND PAA_ORD_INV_SEQ = POI_ORD_INV_SEQ WHERE PO_ORD_STS <>'X' GROUP BY PO_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, PIN_GENERIC_NAME, POI_DOSE_UNIT HAVING MIN(POD_STRT_DTE) BETWEEN '2006-01-01' AND CURRENT DATE;

prompt: Female patients of childbearing age with brain tumors between 2014-2018
completion: SELECT PT_MRN MRN, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH "Date of Birth", TM_DX_DTE "Dx Date", TM_SITE_CD "ICD-O Site Code", S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK "ICD-O Site Description", TM_HIST_CD "ICD-O Histology Code", H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK "ICD-O Histology Description", AV_DESC AS "Grade", PLA_LST_APPT_DTE "Last Appt Date", PT_DATE_OF_DEATH "Date of Death", TM_CA_SURG_DTE "First Cancer Surgery", TM_RAD_STRT_DTE "RT Start Date", TM_RAD_END_DTE "RT End Date", TM_SYST_STRT_DTE "Chemo Start Date" FROM IDB.PATIENT B JOIN IDB.CDB_TUMOR A ON A.TM_MRN = B.PT_MRN JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY ON PT_MRN = PLA_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS ON AV_ELEMENT = 'HIST_CD_GRADE' AND AV_CODE = TM_HIST_CD_GRADE JOIN IDB.CLM H ON TM_HIST_CD = H.CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON TM_SITE_CD = S.CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE PT_SEX = 'F' AND A.TM_SITE_CD like 'C71%' AND TM_HIST_CD IN ('M9440/3', 'M9400/3', 'M9380/3', 'M9401/3', 'M9450/3', 'M9421/3', 'M9382/3', 'M9451/3', 'M9505/1', 'M9413/0', 'M9492/0', 'M9490/0') AND YEAR(TM_DX_DTE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) BETWEEN 18 AND 45 AND TM_DX_DTE >= '2014-01-01'

prompt: Provide list of Thyroseq patients among those who had thyroid operations.
completion: WITH X AS (SELECT SSE_MRN, SSE_SURG_DTE, SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD, SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC, SSP_PROC_NAME, SSP_SURG_LAST_NM, SSP_SURG_FIRST_NM, SSP_SURG_SVC_CD FROM IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE ON SSE_LOG_ID = SSP_LOG_ID AND SSE_ENC_CSN_ID = SSP_ENC_CSN_ID WHERE (SSE_SURG_LOC not like '%IR%' AND SSE_SURG_LOC not like '%ENDO%' AND SSE_SOURCE_TYPE <> 'E') AND SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD IN ('60200', '60210', '60212', '60220', '60225', '60240', '60245', '60246', '60252', '60254', '60260', '60261', '60270', '60271', '95927') AND SSE_SURG_DTE BETWEEN '2018-01-01' AND '2023-11-01' ) , CLINDOC AS (SELECT DISTINCT CDD_MRN AS "MRN" FROM X LEFT JOIN IDB.CD_DOCUMENT ON SSE_MRN = CDD_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION ON CDD_DOC_GUID = CDO_DOC_GUID AND CDD_AUTHORED_DTE = CDO_AUTHORED_DTE AND CDO_VALUE_TEXT <> '' JOIN IDB.OMS_PROVIDER ON CDD_AUTH_PROV_GUID = OP_PVDR_GUID WHERE CDD_CANCEL_IND <> '1' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND <> '1' AND (LOWER(CDO_VALUE_TEXT) like '%thyroseq%' OR LOWER(CDO_VALUE_TEXT) like '%molecular testing%') UNION ALL SELECT DISTINCT PRPT_MRN FROM X LEFT JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V ON SSE_MRN = PRPT_MRN WHERE PRPT_REPORT IS NOT NULL AND CONTAINS("PRPT_REPORT", '("thyroseq" OR "molecular testing")') = 1 ) , PATH AS (SELECT DISTINCT CDD_MRN, CDD_SERVICE_DTE AS "Service Date", CDD_DOC_NAME AS "Document Name", OP_DISPLAY_NAME AS "Provider", CDD_DOC_GUID AS "Document Guid", CDO_SECTION AS "Section", CDO_ITEM_NAME AS "Item", CDO_VALUE_TEXT AS "Value" FROM X LEFT JOIN IDB.CD_DOCUMENT ON SSE_MRN = CDD_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION ON CDD_DOC_GUID = CDO_DOC_GUID AND CDD_AUTHORED_DTE = CDO_AUTHORED_DTE AND CDO_VALUE_TEXT <> '' JOIN IDB.OMS_PROVIDER ON CDD_AUTH_PROV_GUID = OP_PVDR_GUID WHERE CDD_CANCEL_IND <> '1' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND <> '1' AND (LOWER(CDD_DOC_NAME) like '%outside%pathology%' OR LOWER(CDD_DOC_NAME) like '%outside%corresp%') ) SELECT DISTINCT SSE_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, PT_SEX, SSE_SURG_DTE, SSP_SURG_LAST_NM, SSP_SURG_FIRST_NM, SSP_SURG_SVC_CD, SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD, CASE WHEN SSE_MRN IN (SELECT DISTINCT CDD_MRN FROM PATH) THEN 'YES' ELSE 'NO' END AS OUTSIDE_PATHOLOGY_DOC_IND FROM X JOIN CLINDOC ON SSE_MRN = "MRN" LEFT JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON SSE_MRN = PT_MRN

prompt: Provide the total # of Psychiatry visits for patients diagnosed with neurologic cancers seen by Psychiatry between 1/1/10 and 12/31/10.
completion: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CPE_ENC_CSN_ID) FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 = 'PSY' JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN (SELECT CC_MRN AS MRN, CC_CLSF_CD AS ICD9 FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF WHERE CC_CLSF_CD BETWEEN '191.0' AND '192.9' AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND (CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) ) AS X ON CPE_MRN = X.MRN WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN '2010-01-01' AND '2010-12-31'

prompt: Patients with chemo agents ordered by BSK Medical Oncologist from December 1 thru 31 2009
completion: SELECT DISTINCT PO_MRN AS MRN, POD_STRT_DTE AS TX_DATE, PO_DR_NAME AS PHYSICIAN, UCASE(PIN_GENERIC_NAME) AS DRUG_NAME, UCASE(PIN_TRADE_NAME) AS TRADE_NAME FROM IDB.PHM_ORDER JOIN IDB.PHM_ORD_DTL ON PO_ORD_SEQ = POD_ORD_SEQ JOIN IDB.PHM_ORD_INV ON POD_ORD_SEQ = POI_ORD_SEQ AND POD_ITEM_NO = POI_ITEM_NO AND POD_ATT_FLAG LIKE '%CHEMO%' JOIN IDB.PHM_INVENTORY ON POI_INV_SEQ = PIN_INV_SEQ JOIN IDB.DOC ON PO_DR_NO = DOC_DR_NO AND DOC_SVC = 'BSK' WHERE PO_ORD_STS <> 'X' AND POD_STRT_DTE BETWEEN '2009-12-01' AND '2009-12-31' ORDER BY PO_DR_NAME

prompt: Dataline was previously requested and needs 1 update.
completion: WITH CTE AS (SELECT ACD_IRB_NO IRB_NO, ACD_MRN, O.AC_LAST_NAME LAST_NAME, O.AC_FIRST_NAME FIRST_NAME, O.AC_DOB DOB, O.AC_RACE RACE, O.AC_SEX SEX , ACD_CONS_DTE CONSENT_DATE, ACD_OFF_STUDY_DTE OFF_STUDY_DATE FROM IDB.ACCRUALS_DATES JOIN IDB.ACCRUALS O ON ACD_IRB_NO = O.AC_IRB_NO AND ACD_MRN = O.AC_MRN WHERE ACD_IRB_NO = '15-178' AND ACD_MRN <> 'ZZZZZZZZZZZZ' ) , CHEMO AS (SELECT APR_MRN CHEMO_MRN , MIN(APR_START_DTE) CHEMO_START , MAX(APR_END_DTE) CHEMO_END FROM CTE JOIN IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX_V ON ACD_MRN = APR_MRN WHERE CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME IN('DOXORUBICIN', 'CYCLOPHOSPHAMIDE', 'PACLITAXEL', 'DOCETAXEL', 'ABRAXANE', 'METHOTREXATE', 'FLUOROURACIL', 'CARBOPLATIN', 'GEMCITABINE', 'VINORELBINE') GROUP BY APR_MRN) SELECT DISTINCT IRB_NO, LR_MRN MRN, LAST_NAME, FIRST_NAME, DOB, RACE, SEX , CONSENT_DATE, OFF_STUDY_DATE, CHEMO_START, CHEMO_END, LR_ACCESSION_NO ACCESSION_NO, LR_PERFORMED_DTE COLLECTION_DTE , LR_TEST_NAME PANEL_NAME, LR_SUBTEST_NAME TEST_NAME, LR_RESULT_VALUE RESULT_VALUE, LR_UNIT_MEASURE UNIT_MEASURE, LR_TEST_UP_LIMIT UP_LIMIT, LR_TEST_LOW_LIMIT LOW_LIMIT, CASE LR_ABNORMALITY_CD WHEN 'U' THEN '' WHEN 'L' THEN 'Low' WHEN 'H' THEN 'High' END ABNORMALITY_FLAG , LTL_TEXT_RESULT AS COMMENTS FROM CHEMO JOIN CTE ON CHEMO_MRN = ACD_MRN JOIN IDB.LAB_RESULTS ON CHEMO_MRN = LR_MRN AND LR_PERFORMED_DTE BETWEEN CHEMO_START - 1 MONTH AND CHEMO_END + 1 MONTH LEFT JOIN IDB.LAB_TEXT_LINE ON LR_MRN = LTL_MRN AND LR_RESULT_GUID = LTL_RESULT_GUID AND LTL_LINE_NO = 1 WHERE LR_TEST_NAME IN ('Complete Blood Count', 'Complete Blood Count (CBC), Standard', 'Complete Blood Count (CBC), with ANC only' , 'Complete Blood Count (CBC), With Differential', 'Complete Blood Count (CBC), WITH Differential', 'Comprehensive Metabolic Panel', 'Comprehensive Metabolic Panel, Plasma') AND LR_RESULT_VALUE > '' AND LR_SUBTEST_NAME NOT IN ('Differential Comment', 'Differential Type', 'Review Blood Smear', 'Review Smear.', 'Type');

prompt: Patient Lab results for HLA chimerism test post transplant results  for a select group of Pediatric MRNs  for a retrospective research project.
Please provide a list of patients on this protocol that have had multiple PSMA PET scans
completion: WITH PROTOCOL AS (SELECT ACD_MRN, ACD_REG_DTE, ACD_TX_ST_DTE, ACD_TX_END_DTE, ACD_OFF_STUDY_DTE, ACD_CONS_DTE FROM IDB.ACCRUALS_DATES WHERE ACD_IRB_NO = '16-306' ) , PSMA AS (SELECT RRPT_MRN, MAX(RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE) MAX_PSMA_DTE, RRPT_PROCEDURE_NAME FROM DV.RADIOLOGY_REPORT_V WHERE RRPT_ANC_CODE = 'PETPSMA' GROUP BY RRPT_MRN, RRPT_PROCEDURE_NAME) SELECT ACD_MRN MRN, ACD_REG_DTE REG_DTE, ACD_OFF_STUDY_DTE OFF_STUDY_DTE, MAX_PSMA_DTE, RRPT_PROCEDURE_NAME PROCEDURE_NAME FROM PROTOCOL LEFT JOIN PSMA ON ACD_MRN = RRPT_MRN

prompt: Provide a list of patients with marginal zone lymphoma (MZL) or mucosa-associated lymphoid tissue lymphoma (MALT) to see incidences, prognosis, and treatments.
completion: WITH LYM AS (SELECT DISTINCT TM_MRN AS MRN, TM_DX_DTE AS DX_DATE, TM_SITE_CD AS SITE_CODE, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_DESC, TM_HIST_CD AS DX_CODE, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS DX_DESC FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD WHERE 1=1 AND TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND TM_DX_DTE >= '2000-01-01' AND TM_HIST_CD IN ('M9689/3', 'M9699/3', 'M9710/3', 'M9711/3', 'M9715/3') UNION SELECT CC_MRN AS MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS DX_DATE, '' AS SITE_CODE, '' AS SITE_DESC, CLM_CLSF_CD AS DX_CODE, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS DX_DESC FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND ((CC_PT_TYPE = 'I') OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) AND CC_CLSF_CD IN ('200.30', '200.31', '200.32', '200.33', '200.34', '200.35', '200.36', '200.37', '200.38', 'C88.4') GROUP BY CC_MRN, '', '', CLM_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK HAVING MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) >= '2000-01-01') , CTE AS (SELECT MRN AS DX_MRN, DX_DATE, STRIP(DX_CODE) || '-' || STRIP(DX_DESC) || ' | ' || STRIP(SITE_CODE) || '-' || STRIP(SITE_DESC) AS DX_CODE FROM LYM) , CTE2 AS (SELECT * FROM CTE ORDER BY DX_MRN, DX_DATE, DX_CODE) , T1 AS (SELECT DX_MRN, DX_DATE, DX_CODE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY DX_MRN ORDER BY DX_DATE) AS RN FROM CTE2 ORDER BY DX_MRN, DX_DATE) , T2 (MRN, DX, RN1) AS (SELECT DX_MRN, CAST(DX_DATE AS VARCHAR(6000))||' | '||CAST(DX_CODE AS VARCHAR(100)), RN FROM T1 WHERE T1.RN = 1 UNION ALL SELECT DX_MRN, RTRIM(CAST(DX AS VARCHAR(4000))) || ', ' || CHR(13) || CHR(10) || CAST(DX_DATE AS VARCHAR(100))||' | '||RTRIM(CAST(DX_CODE AS VARCHAR(100))) , RN1 + 1 FROM T1, T2 WHERE DX_MRN = MRN AND RN = RN1+1 ) , T3 AS (SELECT MRN, MAX(RN1) RN FROM T2 GROUP BY MRN) , T4 AS (SELECT T2.MRN, RN, DX FROM T2 JOIN T3 ON T2.MRN = T3.MRN AND T2.RN1 = T3.RN) , T5 AS (SELECT DISTINCT MRN, STRIP(PT_LAST_NAME) || ', ' || STRIP(PT_FIRST_NAME) AS NAME, PT_SEX AS GENDER, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH AS DOB, PT_DATE_OF_DEATH AS DOD, DX FROM T4 JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON MRN = PT_MRN) , APR AS (SELECT APR_MRN, APR_GENERIC_NAME, MIN(APR_START_DTE) AS APR_START_DTE, MAX(APR_END_DTE) AS APR_END_DTE FROM T5 JOIN IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX_V ON MRN = APR_MRN WHERE 1=1 GROUP BY APR_MRN, APR_GENERIC_NAME )

prompt: AACR GENIE is looking for patient numbers (no PHI) to see whether a sponsored research study involving MSK patient data is feasible. Specifically looking for the number of MSK patients (total) all cancer with NSCLC that nave been treated with Tepotinib.
completion: WITH TEPOTINIB AS (SELECT DISTINCT APR_MRN FROM IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX JOIN IDB.CHEMO_DRUG_GENERIC ON APR_GENERIC_NAME = CDG_GENERIC_NAME WHERE CDG_GENERIC_NAME IN ('TEPOTINIB') ) SELECT CASE WHEN PT_DEATH_IND IN ('C', 'D', 'X') THEN 'Deceased' ELSE 'Alive' END VITAL_STATUS, COUNT(DISTINCT PT_MRN) PT_CNT FROM TEPOTINIB JOIN IDB.CDB_TUMOR ON APR_MRN = TM_MRN JOIN IDB.CLM H ON TM_HIST_CD = H.CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON TM_SITE_CD = S.CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON TM_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3') AND TM_SITE_CD like 'C34%' AND TM_HIST_CD IN ('M8013/3', 'M8014/3', 'M8022/3', 'M8030/3', 'M8031/3', 'M8032/3', 'M8033/3', 'M8046/3', 'M8052/2', 'M8052/3', 'M8070/2', 'M8070/3', 'M8071/2', 'M8071/3', 'M8072/3', 'M8073/3', 'M8074/2', 'M8074/3', 'M8083/3', 'M8140/2', 'M8140/3', 'M8250/2', 'M8250/3', 'M8251/3', 'M8252/3', 'M8253/3', 'M8254/3', 'M8255/3', 'M8260/2', 'M8260/3', 'M8310/3', 'M8333/3', 'M8480/2', 'M8480/3', 'M8481/3', 'M8490/2', 'M8490/3', 'M8560/2', 'M8560/3', 'M8572/3', 'M8574/3', 'M8972/3', 'M8973/3', 'M8980/3') GROUP BY CASE WHEN PT_DEATH_IND IN ('C', 'D', 'X') THEN 'Deceased' ELSE 'Alive' END

prompt: Recovery Tracker has expanded to Thoracic Surgery Inpatient Population.  We would like a report that tracks survey behavior as well as patient compliance and triggered PSM Alerts
completion: WITH INS AS (SELECT * FROM (SELECT MRN INS_MRN , INS_EFF_DATE , CASE WHEN UPPER(FSC_NAME) LIKE '%MEDICARE%' OR UPPER(INS_COMP_NAME) LIKE '%MEDICARE%' THEN 'MEDICARE' WHEN UPPER(FSC_NAME) LIKE '%MEDICAID%' OR UPPER(INS_COMP_NAME) LIKE '%MEDICAID%' THEN 'MEDICAID' WHEN B.MRN IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE 'PRIVATE' END AS INSURANCE_TYPE , ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY MRN ORDER BY FSC_PRIORITY ASC) AS RN FROM IDB.PATIENT_INSURANCE_V B) A WHERE RN = 1 ) , EMP AS (SELECT EF_MRN EMP_MRN , MIN(DATE(EF_SUBMISSION_DT)) MIN_EF_SUBMIT_DTE , MIN(CASE WHEN EFI_ITEM_ALIAS = 'ptcare_currentemployment' THEN EFI_VALUE END) EMPLOY_STS_DESC , MIN(CASE WHEN EFI_ITEM_ALIAS = 'ptcare_current_employed' THEN EFI_VALUE END) EMPLOY_STS FROM (SELECT EF_MRN , EFI_ITEM_ALIAS , EFI_VALUE , EF_SUBMISSION_DT , RANK() OVER(PARTITION BY EF_MRN ORDER BY EF_SUBMISSION_DT DESC) AS RN FROM IDB.EF_FORM JOIN IDB.EF_ASSESSMENT ON EA_ASSESS_ID = EF_FORM_EXTERNAL_ID AND EA_SURV_ID = 5 LEFT JOIN IDB.EF_FORM_ITEM ON EF_FORM_ID = EFI_FORM_ID WHERE EFI_ITEM_ALIAS IN ('ptcare_currentemployment', 'ptcare_current_employed') ) A WHERE RN = 1 GROUP BY EF_MRN ) , DEMO AS (SELECT PT_MRN, PT_SEX, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, L.AV_DESC AS PRIM_LANG, CASE WHEN COALESCE(R.AV_DESC, CR.AV_DESC) IN ('WHITE', 'WHITE HISPANIC') THEN 'White' WHEN COALESCE(R.AV_DESC, CR.AV_DESC) IN ('BLACK OR AFRICAN AMERICAN', 'BLACK', 'BLACK HISPANIC') THEN 'Black' WHEN COALESCE(R.AV_DESC, CR.AV_DESC) IN ('ASIAN-FAR EAST/INDIAN SUBCONT', 'KAMPUCHEAN', 'LAOTIAN', 'VIETNAMESE', 'HMONG', 'CHINESE', 'ASIAN INDIAN PAKISTANI', 'JAPANESE', 'KOREAN', 'OTHER ASIAN', 'THAI') THEN 'Asian' WHEN COALESCE(R.AV_DESC, CR.AV_DESC) IN ('NATIVE AMERICAN-AM IND/ALASKA', 'AMER IND ALEUT ESKIMO') THEN 'Native American or Alaska Native' WHEN COALESCE(R.AV_DESC, CR.AV_DESC) IN ('NATIVE HAWAIIAN OR PACIFIC ISL', 'HAWAIIAN', 'MELANESIAN', 'MICRONESIAN', 'FIJI ISLANDER', 'FILIPINO', 'GUAMANIAN', 'PACIFIC ISLANDER') THEN 'Native Hawaiian or Other Pacific Islander' ELSE 'Unspecified' END AS PT_RACE, COALESCE(CE.AV_DESC, E.AV_DESC) AS PT_ETHNICITY, INSURANCE_TYPE, EMPLOY_STS_DESC, EMPLOY_STS FROM IDB.PATIENT LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS R ON R.AV_ELEMENT = 'RACE' AND R.AV_CODE = PT_RACE LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS E ON E.AV_ELEMENT = 'PT_ETHNICITY' AND E.AV_CODE = PT_PT_ETHNICITY LEFT JOIN IDB.CDB_PATIENT ON PT_MRN = CP_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS CR ON CR.AV_ELEMENT = 'CDB_RACE' AND CR.AV_CODE = CP_CDB_RACE LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS CE ON CE.AV_ELEMENT = 'ETHNICITY' AND CE.AV_CODE = CP_ETHNICITY LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS L ON L.AV_ELEMENT = 'PRIMARY_LANG' AND L.AV_CODE = PT_PRIMARY_LANG LEFT JOIN INS ON INS_MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN EMP ON EMP_MRN = PT_MRN) , Q AS (SELECT DISTINCT EA_ASSESS_ID, EA_ASSIGN_DT, EF_SUBMISSION_DT, EA_SOURCE_ID, EA_SURV_ID, EF_FORM_NAME, EF_FORM_ID, EF_MRN, EC_COHORT_ID, EC_COHORT_DESC, CASE WHEN EC_COHORT_ID IN (80, 149) THEN 'Inpatient' WHEN EC_COHORT_ID IN (87, 147) THEN 'Inpatient' ELSE NULL END AS INP_AMB, DEMO.PT_SEX, DEMO.PT_LAST_NAME, DEMO.PT_FIRST_NAME, DEMO.PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, DEMO.PRIM_LANG, DEMO.PT_RACE, DEMO.PT_ETHNICITY, DEMO.INSURANCE_TYPE, DEMO.EMPLOY_STS_DESC, DEMO.EMPLOY_STS FROM IDB.EF_ASSESSMENT LEFT JOIN IDB.EF_FORM ON EF_FORM_EXTERNAL_ID = EA_ASSESS_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.EF_FORM_ITEM ON EF_FORM_ID = EFI_FORM_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.EF_SCHEDULING_RULE ON EA_SCHED_RULE_ID = ESR_SCHED_RULE_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.EF_COHORT ON ESR_COHORT_ID = EC_COHORT_ID LEFT JOIN DEMO ON PT_MRN = EF_MRN WHERE EC_COHORT_ID IN (80, 149) AND EF_MRN IS NOT NULL ) SELECT * FROM Q ; WITH O AS (SELECT * FROM (SELECT OL_MRN , OL_LOG_ID AS LOGID , OL_SURG_DTE , CRE.CRE_RES_NAME AS SURGEON , OLAS_SURG_SVC AS SURGSVC , TRIM(DOC_ACDMC_DPT) AS EVENT_RESOURCE_ACADEMIC_DEPT , TRIM(DOC_ACDMC_SVC) AS EVENT_RESOURCE_ACADEMIC_SERVICE , TRIM(DOC_SVC) AS EVENT_RESOURCE_SERVICE_CODE , TRIM(AV_DESC) AS EVENT_RESOURCE_SERVICE_DESC , TRIM(CE_ENCODER_DRG) CMI , OL_POSTOP_DEST , ROOM.CRE_RES_NAME AS SURG_ROOM_DESC , CL_PROC_1.CPX_PROC_NAME AS PROCEDURES , CL_PROC_1.CPX_PROC_CD AS PROCEDURE_CODES , VIS_ADM_DT , VIS_DSCH_DT , DATE(VIS_DSCH_DT) AS VIS_DSCH_DTE , VIS_DAYS_STAY , OL_PT_TYPE FROM IDB.OR_LOG JOIN IDB.OR_LOG_ALL_SURG ON OL_LOG_ID = OLAS_LOG_ID JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE CRE ON OLAS_RES_ID = CRE.CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.OR_LNLG_DX ON OLAS_LOG_ID = OLLD_LOG_ID AND OLAS_PNL_NO = OLLD_DX_PROC_PNL LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_PROC AS CL_PROC_2 ON OLLD_DX_CPT2_ID = CL_PROC_2.CPX_PROC_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_PROC AS CL_PROC_3 ON OLLD_DX_CPT3_ID = CL_PROC_3.CPX_PROC_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.OR_PROC ON OLLD_DX_OR_PROC = OP_OR_PROC_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.OR_CL_PROC ON OP_OR_PROC_ID = OCP_OR_PROC_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_PROC AS CL_PROC_1 ON OCP_PROC_ID = CL_PROC_1.CPX_PROC_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.DOC ON OLAS_RES_ID = DOC_DR_NO LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS ON AV_ELEMENT = 'SVC' AND DOC_SVC = AV_CODE AND AV_CD_STS = 'A' LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE AS ROOM ON ROOM.CRE_RES_ID = OL_ROOM_RES_ID JOIN IDB.VISIT ON VIS_MRN = OL_MRN AND VIS_ADM_DTE <= OL_SURG_DTE AND VIS_VISIT_STATUS IN ('2', '3') AND VIS_IP_OP_ADJUSTED_IND = 'I' AND (VIS_DSCH_DTE >= OL_SURG_DTE OR VIS_DSCH_DTE IS NULL) LEFT JOIN IDB.CTC_ENCODER ON VIS_ADM_NUM = SUBSTR(CE_ENCODER_CTC_VISIT_NO, 2, 8) AND VIS_MRN = CE_ENCODER_MRN AND CE_ENCODER_GRPR_CD = '0' WHERE OL_LOG_STS IN SELECT SUBSTR(VARCHAR_FORMAT(EA_SUBM_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD'), 1, 7) MON_YEAR, COUNT(EPI_MRN) SURVEYS_COMPLETED, COUNT(DISTINCT EPI_MRN) AS DISTINCT_PATIENTS FROM IDB.EF_ASSESSMENT JOIN IDB.EF_ASSESSMENT_STS ON EA_STS_ID = EAS_ASSESS_STS_ID JOIN IDB.EF_PATIENT_INFO ON EA_PT_INFO_ID = EPI_PT_INFO_ID WHERE EA_SURV_ID = 171 AND EAS_ASSESS_STS IN ('Completed') AND DATE(EA_SUBM_DT) BETWEEN CURRENT date - 1 MONTH AND CURRENT date GROUP BY SUBSTR(VARCHAR_FORMAT(EA_SUBM_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD'), 1, 7) ; ACCT.CS_MRN AND ACCT.CS_PT_STS = 'OA' WHERE ENC.CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN '2014-11-10' AND '2014-12-10' AND ENC.CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Sch', 'Comp', 'Arrived') AND (ENCDEPT.CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 = 'RDO' OR (ENCDEPT.CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 = 'NUR' AND ENCDEPT.CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 = 'RDO')) ) , PROVIDERS AS (SELECT DISTINCT CPA_CL_PT_ID , CPA_ENC_DTE_SEQ , CPA_LINE_NO , CPA_ENC_CSN_ID, CPA_MRN , CPA_ENC_DTE, CRE_RES_NAME FROM APPTS JOIN IDB.CL_PT_APPT ON CPE_CL_PT_ID = CPA_CL_PT_ID AND CPA_ENC_DTE_SEQ = CPE_ENC_DTE_SEQ JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPA_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID WHERE CPA_LINE_NO > 1 ) , ROPCP AS (SELECT DISTINCT PP_CL_PT_ID, CRE_RES_ID, CRE_RES_NAME, CRE_INT_EXT_TYP, DOC_NPI, PP_CUR_PCP_TYPE FROM APPTS JOIN IDB.PAS_PCP ON CPE_CL_PT_ID = PP_CL_PT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON PP_CUR_PCP_PROV_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.DOC ON PP_CUR_PCP_PROV_ID = DOC_DR_NO AND PP_CUR_PCP_TYPE IN ('REF TO RO', 'RO MD')) , NOTES AS (SELECT DISTINCT CPAN_CL_PT_ID , CPAN_ENC_DTE_SEQ , CPAN_LINE_NO , CPAN_MRN , CPAN_ENC_DTE , CPAN_NOTE FROM APPTS JOIN IDB.CL_PT_APPT_NOTES ON CPAN_CL_PT_ID = CPE_CL_PT_ID AND CPAN_ENC_DTE_SEQ = CPE_ENC_DTE_SEQ AND CPAN_LINE_NO BETWEEN 1 AND 4) SELECT DISTINCT MRN , APPT_DATE_TIME , CPE_ENC_CSN_ID , DURATION , IP_INDICATOR , DEPT_ID, CENTER , FULL_VT_NAME , VISIT_ABBREV, USER_ID , CPE_CL_PT_ID , CPE_ENC_DTE_SEQ, PROV1, PROV1_ID, P2.CRE_RES_NAME AS PROV2, P3.CRE_RES_NAME AS PROV3, P4.CRE_RES_NAME AS PROV4, N1.CPAN_NOTE AS NOTE1, N2.CPAN_NOTE AS NOTE2, N3.CPAN_NOTE AS NOTE3, N4.CPAN_NOTE AS NOTE4, LAST_NAME, FIRST_NAME, DOB, SEX, ADDRESS_1, ADDRESS_2, CITY, STATE, ZIP_CODE, COUNTRY, VITAL_STATUS, ACCOUNT_NO, APPT_STATUS, ROMD.CRE_RES_ID AS ROATTENDINGMD_RES_ID, ROMD.CRE_RES_NAME AS ROATTENDINGMD_NAME , ROMD.CRE_INT_EXT_TYP AS ROATTENDINGMD_INT_EXT_TYPE, ROMD.DOC_NPI AS ROATTENDINGMD_NPI, ROMD.PP_CUR_PCP_TYPE AS ROATTENDINGMD_PCP_TYPE, REFMD.CRE_RES_ID AS ROREFMD_ID, REFMD.CRE_RES_NAME AS ROREFMD_NAME, REFMD.CRE_INT_EXT_TYP AS ROREFMD_INT_EXT_TYPE, REFMD.DOC_NPI AS ROREFMD_NPI, REFMD.PP_CUR_PCP_TYPE AS ROREFMD_PCP_TYPE, CHECK_IN_DT FROM APPTS LEFT JOIN PROVIDERS P2 ON P2.CPA_CL_PT_ID = CPE_CL_PT_ID AND P2.CPA_ENC_DTE_SEQ = CPE_ENC_DTE_SEQ AND P2.CPA_LINE_NO = 2 LEFT JOIN PROVIDERS P3 ON P3.CPA_CL_PT_ID = CPE_CL_PT_ID AND P3.CPA_ENC_DTE_SEQ = CPE_ENC_DTE_SEQ AND P3.CPA_LINE_NO = 3 LEFT JOIN PROVIDERS P4 ON P4.CPA_CL_PT_ID = CPE_CL_PT_ID AND P4.CPA_ENC_DTE_SEQ = CPE_ENC_DTE_SEQ AND P4.CPA_LINE_NO = 4 LEFT JOIN NOTES N1 ON N1.CPAN_CL_PT_ID = CPE_CL_PT_ID AND N1.CPAN_ENC_DTE_SEQ = CPE_ENC_DTE_SEQ AND N1.CPAN_LINE_NO = 1 LEFT JOIN NOTES N2 ON N2.CPAN_CL_PT_ID = CPE_CL_PT_ID AND N2.CPAN_ENC_DTE_SEQ = CPE_ENC_DTE_SEQ AND N2.CPAN_LINE_NO = 2 LEFT JOIN NOTES N3 ON N3.CPAN_CL_PT_ID = CPE_CL_PT_ID AND N3.CPAN_ENC_DTE_SEQ = CPE_ENC_DTE_SEQ AND N3.CPAN_LINE_NO = 3 LEFT JOIN NOTES N4 ON N4.CPAN_CL_PT_ID = CPE_CL_PT_ID AND N4.CPAN_ENC_DTE_SEQ = CPE_ENC_DTE_SEQ AND N4.CPAN_LINE_NO = 4 LEFT JOIN ROPCP ROMD ON CPE_CL_PT_ID = ROMD.PP_CL_PT_ID AND ROMD.PP_CUR_PCP_TYPE = 'RO MD' LEFT JOIN ROPCP REFMD ON REFMD.PP_CL_PT_ID = CPE_CL_PT_ID AND REFMD.PP_CUR_PCP_TYPE = 'REF TO RO'

prompt: Create a report in DAVInCI by physician of any medication or chemotherapy orders that have a start date of today or greater
completion: SELECT DTL.* FROM (SELECT OO_MRN AS MRN, OO_ENTER_DTE ENTER_DATE , STRIP(PT_LAST_NAME)||', '||STRIP(PT_FIRST_NAME) AS PT_NAME , CASE WHEN OO_REQ_TME_PRIO IN ('Outside Order', 'Fill at MSK') OR(OO_IS_FOR_DSCH = 'Y' AND OO_REQ_TME_PRIO = 'Routine') THEN 'Retail Order' WHEN OCV_IP_OP_IND = 'I' THEN 'IP Order' ELSE 'OP Order' END ORDER_TYPE, OO_IS_FOR_DSCH FOR_DSCH , STRIP(OO_ORD_NAME)||' '||OO_ORD_MODIFIER AS ORDER_NAME , STRIP(OO_ORD_STS_CD)||' - '|| OSTS_STS_DESC AS STATUS , OOC_REV_CAT_DEPT REV_CAT_DEPT, OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE AS START_DATE , OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE + CASE WHEN OSD_STOP_AFTER_OPT IN (1, 4) THEN OSD_STOP_AFTER_VALUE - 1 ELSE 0 END DAY AS STOP_DATE , OMD_DOSE_LOW DOSE, OMD_DOSE_UNIT UNIT , OO_ORD_FREQ FREQ, OMD_MED_FORM MED_FORM , OO_IS_PRN PRN_FLAG, OMD_ORD_ROUTE ORD_ROUTE , OU_DISPLAY_NAME AS REQUESTER, OU_ORD_ROLE_TYPE REQUESTER_TYPE , CASE WHEN OU_ORD_ROLE_TYPE <> 'Attending' AND OU_DISPLAY_NAME <> OCV_PVDR_NAME THEN OCV_PVDR_NAME END AS VISIT_ATT_NAME , OO_REQ_DR_NO REQ_DR_NO, DOC_SVC SVC, OCV_CURR_LOC AS LOCATION , OO_REQ_TME_PRIO AS TIME_PRIO, OO_SUMMARY_LINE AS SUMMARYLINE , OCCT_VALUE DRUG_CATEGORY, OTPX_TRS_POL_NAME TRS_POLICY , OOC_THERAPEUTIC_CAT THERAPEUTIC_CAT , CASE WHEN OU_ORD_ROLE_TYPE <> 'Attending' AND OU_DISPLAY_NAME <> OCV_PVDR_NAME THEN OCV_PVDR_NAME ELSE OU_DISPLAY_NAME END AS PROVIDER FROM IDB.OMS_ORDER JOIN IDB.OMS_CLIENT_VISIT ON OO_VISIT_GUID = OCV_VISIT_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_CATALOG ON OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID = OOC_MSTR_ITEM_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_MED_DETAIL ON OMD_ORD_GUID = OO_ORD_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_SYS_DATA ON OO_ORD_GUID = OSD_ORD_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_USER ON OO_PVDR_GUID = OU_USER_GUID JOIN IDB.DOC ON OO_REQ_DR_NO = DOC_DR_NO AND DOC_SOURCE_DESC = 'SMS' JOIN IDB.OMS_STATUS ON OO_ORD_STS_CD = OSTS_ORD_STS_CD JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PT_MRN = OO_MRN AND PT_DATE_OF_DEATH IS NULL JOIN IDB.OMS_TRANS_POL_XREF ON OTPX_MST_ITEM_GUID = OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID AND OTPX_SESSION_TYPE = 'Standard' LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_CTLG_CLASS_TYP ON OCCT_MST_ITEM_GUID = OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID AND OCCT_CLASS_TYPE_CD = 'HVC-OrderCategory' WHERE OO_ORD_STS_CD NOT IN ('DISC', 'CANC', 'CANP', 'DISCD', 'AUC3', 'COMP', 'AUC1') AND OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE = '2011-12-19' AND OO_ORD_TYPE_CD = 'Medication' AND OOC_REV_CAT_DEPT <> 'Nursing' AND OO_REQ_DR_NO IN (#PROMPTMANY('Provider')#) ) DTL WHERE 1= 1 #PROMPTMANY('Order Type', '', ' ', 'AND ORDER_TYPE IN (', '', ')') WITH UR

prompt: Count of patients 65 and older:  seen at MSK, received chemo, had surgery and new visit appointments
completion: SELECT 'SEEN', COUNT(DISTINCT CPE_MRN) FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID AND CRE_RES_TYP IN ('Dentist', 'Physician', 'Psychologist', 'PhD') JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PT_MRN = CPE_MRN WHERE 1=1 AND YEAR(CPE_ENC_DTE) - YEAR(PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) >= 65 AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN '2021-01-01' AND '2021-12-31' AND CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Comp', 'Arrived') UNION SELECT 'NV', COUNT(DISTINCT CPE_MRN) FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID AND CRE_RES_TYP IN ('Dentist', 'Physician', 'Psychologist', 'PhD') JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID AND CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR LIKE '%NV%' JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PT_MRN = CPE_MRN WHERE 1=1 AND YEAR(CPE_ENC_DTE) - YEAR(PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) >= 65 AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN '2021-01-01' AND '2021-12-31' AND CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Comp', 'Arrived') UNION SELECT 'SURGERY', COUNT(DISTINCT SSE_MRN) FROM IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PT_MRN = SSE_MRN WHERE 1=1 AND YEAR(SSE_SURG_DTE) - YEAR(PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) >= 65 AND SSE_SURG_DTE BETWEEN '2021-01-01' AND '2021-12-31' AND (SSE_SURG_LOC not like '%IR%' AND SSE_SURG_LOC not like '%ENDO%' AND SSE_SOURCE_TYPE <> 'E') UNION SELECT 'CHEMO', COUNT(DISTINCT APR_MRN) FROM IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX_V JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PT_MRN = APR_MRN WHERE APR_START_DTE BETWEEN '2021-01-01' AND '2021-12-31' AND CDG_CHEMO_FLAG = 'Y' AND YEAR(APR_START_DTE) - YEAR(PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) >= 65

prompt: Provide radiology and demographic data for reports with radio-pharmaceutical search terms.
completion: SELECT DISTINCT "t1"."PT_MRN" AS "MRN", "t2"."RRPT_ACCESSION_NO" AS "Radiology Accession Number", "t2"."RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE" AS "Radiology Performed Date", "t2"."RRPT_REPORT_DTE" AS "Radiology Report Date", "t2"."RRPT_ORDER_GROUP" AS "Radiology Order Group", "t2"."RRPT_PROCEDURE_NAME" AS "Radiology Procedure Name", "t2"."RRPT_ANC_CODE" AS "Radiology Ancillary Code", YEAR("t2"."RRPT_REPORT_DTE") AS "Radiology Report Year", "t3"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AS "Deident PT #" FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V" "t1" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED" "t3" ON "t1"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t3"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."RADIOLOGY_REPORT_V" "t2" ON "t3"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t2"."RRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" WHERE 1=1 AND (RRPT_ORDER_GROUP like 'PET%' OR RRPT_ORDER_GROUP like 'CT%' OR RRPT_ORDER_GROUP like 'NM%') AND CONTAINS("t2"."RRPT_REPORT_TXT", '("Radium-223" | "Thorium-227" | "Actinium-225" | "Bismouth-213")') = 1 AND "t2"."RRPT_REPORT_TXT" IS NOT NULL ORDER BY MRN, RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE, RRPT_ACCESSION_NO

prompt: Provide a list of data points the specified follicular lymphoma patients.
completion: WITH X AS (SELECT PT_MRN, R.AV_DESC AS "Race", E.AV_DESC AS "Ethnicity", PT_DATE_OF_DEATH, COALESCE(MAX(PLA_LST_APPT_DTE, PLA_LST_DSCH_DTE), PLA_LST_APPT_DTE, PLA_LST_DSCH_DTE) AS LAST_FU_DATE FROM IDB.PATIENT JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY ON PT_MRN = PLA_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS R ON PT_RACE = R.AV_CODE AND R.AV_ELEMENT = 'RACE' LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS E ON PT_PT_ETHNICITY = E.AV_CODE AND E.AV_ELEMENT = 'PT_ETHNICITY' WHERE PT_MRN IN () ) , APR AS (SELECT DISTINCT APR_MRN, APR_GENERIC_NAME, APR_DRUG_NAME, APR_START_DTE, APR_END_DTE, APR_ORD_RX_TYPE FROM X JOIN IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX_V ON APR_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE CDG_CHEMO_FLAG = 'Y' AND APR_ORD_RX_TYPE <> 'HML' ) , CTE AS (SELECT APR_MRN, APR_START_DTE, APR_END_DTE, APR_GENERIC_NAME FROM APR) , CTE2 AS (SELECT * FROM CTE ORDER BY APR_MRN, APR_START_DTE, APR_END_DTE, APR_GENERIC_NAME) , CTE3 AS (SELECT APR_MRN, MAX(APR_START_DTE) AS APR_START_DTE_MAX FROM CTE2 GROUP BY APR_MRN) , CTE4 AS (SELECT CTE2.* FROM CTE2 JOIN CTE3 ON CTE2.APR_MRN = CTE3.APR_MRN AND CTE2.APR_START_DTE = CTE3.APR_START_DTE_MAX) , T1 AS (SELECT DISTINCT APR_MRN, APR_START_DTE, APR_END_DTE, RTRIM(CAST(APR_START_DTE AS VARCHAR(100))) || ' - ' || RTRIM(CAST(APR_END_DTE AS VARCHAR(100))) || ' | ' || STRIP(APR_GENERIC_NAME) AS APR_GENERIC_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY APR_MRN ORDER BY APR_GENERIC_NAME) AS RN FROM CTE4 ORDER BY APR_MRN, APR_START_DTE, APR_END_DTE, APR_GENERIC_NAME) , T2 (MRN, CHEMO, RN1) AS (SELECT APR_MRN, CAST(APR_GENERIC_NAME AS VARCHAR(4000)), RN FROM T1 WHERE T1.RN = 1 UNION ALL SELECT APR_MRN, RTRIM(CAST(CHEMO AS VARCHAR(4000))) || ', ' || CHR(13) || CHR(10) || CAST(APR_GENERIC_NAME AS VARCHAR(100)) , RN1 + 1 FROM T1, T2 WHERE APR_MRN = MRN AND RN = RN1+1 ) , T3 AS (SELECT MRN, MAX(RN1) RN FROM T2 GROUP BY MRN) , T4 AS (SELECT T2.MRN, RN, CHEMO FROM T2 JOIN T3 ON T2.MRN = T3.MRN AND T2.RN1 = T3.RN) SELECT X.*, CHEMO FROM X LEFT JOIN T4 ON PT_MRN = MRN

prompt: Provide numbe of hormonal orders /e prescriptions for 2019
completion: SELECT APR_MRN, APR_GENERIC_NAME , APR_DRUG_NAME, APR_START_DTE , APR_PRESCRIBED_DOSE, APR_DOSE_UOM , APR_DISPENSE_CNT , APR_ROUTE, APR_FREQ, APR_DURATION, APR_ORAL_FLAG, APR_QTY , APR_ORD_RX_TYPE FROM IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX JOIN IDB.CHEMO_DRUG_GENERIC ON APR_GENERIC_NAME = CDG_GENERIC_NAME WHERE CDG_HORMONE_FLAG = 'Y' AND YEAR(APR_START_DTE) = 2019

prompt: Small Cell Lung Cancer patients treated with platinum and etoposide at MSK.
completion: WITH DX AS (SELECT DISTINCT TM_MRN, TM_DX_DTE, TM_HIST_CD, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS HIST_DESC, TM_SITE_CD, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_DESC, TM_BEST_AJCC_STG FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND TM_SITE_CD LIKE 'C34%' AND TM_DX_DTE BETWEEN '2010-01-01' AND '2019-10-31' AND TM_HIST_CD IN ('M8041/2', 'M8041/3', 'M8042/3', 'M8043/3', 'M8045/3') ) , PLATINUM AS (SELECT DISTINCT APR_MRN AS PLAT_MRN, APR_START_DTE AS PLAT_START_DTE, CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME AS PLAT_NAME FROM IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX JOIN IDB.CHEMO_DRUG_GENERIC ON APR_GENERIC_NAME = CDG_GENERIC_NAME JOIN DX ON APR_MRN = TM_MRN WHERE APR_START_DTE BETWEEN '2010-01-01' AND '2019-10-31' AND CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME IN ('CISPLATIN', 'CARBOPLATIN') ) , CHEMO AS (SELECT DISTINCT APR_MRN, PLAT_START_DTE, PLAT_NAME, APR_START_DTE, CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME FROM IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX JOIN IDB.CHEMO_DRUG_GENERIC ON APR_GENERIC_NAME = CDG_GENERIC_NAME JOIN PLATINUM ON APR_MRN = PLAT_MRN AND APR_START_DTE BETWEEN PLAT_START_DTE - 7 DAYS AND PLAT_START_DTE + 7 DAYS WHERE CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME IN ('ETOPOSIDE') ) , PT AS (SELECT APR_MRN, PLAT_NAME, MIN(PLAT_START_DTE) FIRST_PLATINUM_DATE, MAX(PLAT_START_DTE) LAST_PLATINUM_DATE, MIN(APR_START_DTE) FIRST_ETOPOSIDE_DATE, MAX(APR_START_DTE) LAST_ETOPOSIDE_DATE FROM CHEMO GROUP BY APR_MRN, PLAT_NAME) , CONSENT AS (SELECT PT_MRN AC_MRN, MAX(CASE WHEN PRO_IRB_NO = '06-107' THEN AC_CONS_DTE END) "06-107 Consent", MAX(CASE WHEN PRO_IRB_NO = '12-245' THEN AC_CONS_DTE END) "12-245 Consent", MAX(CASE WHEN PRO_IRB_NO = '14-192' THEN AC_CONS_DTE END) "14-192 Consent" FROM DV.ACCRUALS JOIN DV.PROTOCOL ON AC_PROTOCOL_ID = PRO_PROTOCOL_ID JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON AC_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID JOIN PT ON APR_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE PRO_IRB_NO IN ('06-107', '12-245', '14-192') GROUP BY PT_MRN) , IMPACT AS (SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN GENE_MRN FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_STRUCTURED_RESULTS_V JOIN PT ON APR_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE METHOD = 'IMPACT' ) SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN "MRN", PT_LAST_NAME "Last Name", PT_FIRST_NAME "First Name", PT_SEX "Gender", PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH "Date of Birth", PT_DATE_OF_DEATH "Date of Death", PLA_LST_APPT_DTE "Last Appointment", PLA_LST_CON_DTE "Last Contact", TM_DX_DTE "Dx Date", TM_HIST_CD "Histology Code", HIST_DESC "Histology Description", TM_SITE_CD "Site Code", SITE_DESC "Site Description", TM_BEST_AJCC_STG "Stage", PLAT_NAME "Platinum Name", FIRST_PLATINUM_DATE "First Plat Date", FIRST_ETOPOSIDE_DATE "First Etop Date", LAST_PLATINUM_DATE "Last Plat Date", LAST_ETOPOSIDE_DATE "Last Etop Date", "06-107 Consent", "12-245 Consent", "14-192 Consent", CASE WHEN GENE_MRN IS NOT NULL THEN 'Y' ELSE '' END "IMPACT" FROM PT JOIN DX ON TM_MRN = APR_MRN JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON APR_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY ON APR_MRN = PLA_MRN LEFT JOIN CONSENT ON APR_MRN = AC_MRN LEFT JOIN IMPACT ON APR_MRN = GENE_MRN ORDER BY PT_MRN, FIRST_PLATINUM_DATE

prompt: Provide a Tableau dashboard to reconcile regional protocol order and visit data
completion: WITH GUID AS (SELECT OO_ORD_GUID, DV.TODATE(DV.REGEXSTR('[0-9]*[\-|\.|\/][0-9]*[\-|\.|\/][0-9]*', D.OUD_USER_DI_VALUE), NULL, NULL) AS REQUESTED_FOR_DATE FROM IDB.OMS_ORDER JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_CATALOG ON OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID = OOC_MSTR_ITEM_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_STATUS ON OO_ORD_STS_CD = OSTS_ORD_STS_CD JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_USER_DATA D ON OO_ORD_GUID = D.OUD_ORD_GUID AND D.OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'Requested For' WHERE 1=1 AND ((OO_SET_NAME = 'REG_Protocol' AND OSTS_STS_DESC IN ('Hold', 'Completed', 'Completed/Expired')) OR (OOC_REV_CAT_DEPT IN ('Cardiology', 'Radiology') AND OSTS_STS_DESC IN ('Hold', 'Scheduled'))) AND DV.TODATE(DV.REGEXSTR('[0-9]*[\-|\.|\/][0-9]*[\-|\.|\/][0-9]*', D.OUD_USER_DI_VALUE), NULL, NULL) >= CURRENT date AND DV.TODATE(DV.REGEXSTR('[0-9]*[\-|\.|\/][0-9]*[\-|\.|\/][0-9]*', D.OUD_USER_DI_VALUE), NULL, NULL) <= CURRENT date + 6 MONTHS ) , ORD AS (SELECT OO_MRN, G.OO_ORD_GUID, OOC_ITEM_NAME, OSTS_STS_DESC, DATE(OO_ENTER_DT) ORDER_ENTER_DATE, REQUESTED_FOR_DATE, CASE WHEN OOC_REV_CAT_DEPT = 'Radiology' THEN 'Radiology' WHEN OOC_REV_CAT_DEPT = 'Cardiology' THEN 'Cardiology' WHEN OOC_ITEM_NAME = 'Regional Research RN Visit' THEN 'RN' WHEN OOC_ITEM_NAME = 'Research Lab Visit' THEN 'Lab' WHEN T.OUD_USER_DI_VALUE = 'TX Only' THEN 'Chemo' WHEN T.OUD_USER_DI_VALUE = 'MDTX' THEN 'Combo' WHEN T.OUD_USER_DI_VALUE not like '%TX%' THEN 'MD' WHEN OOC_ITEM_NAME = 'Regional DTU Visit' THEN 'DTU' ELSE 'Other' END AS ORD_TYPE, T.OUD_USER_DI_VALUE VISIT_TYPES, LGR_LOC_GRP "Order Client Visit Location" FROM GUID G JOIN IDB.OMS_ORDER O ON G.OO_ORD_GUID = O.OO_ORD_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_CATALOG ON OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID = OOC_MSTR_ITEM_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_STATUS ON OO_ORD_STS_CD = OSTS_ORD_STS_CD LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_USER_DATA T ON G.OO_ORD_GUID = T.OUD_ORD_GUID AND T.OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'REG_Research Types' JOIN IDB.OMS_CLIENT_VISIT ON OO_VISIT_GUID= OCV_VISIT_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_LOCATION ON OCV_CURR_LOC_GUID = OL_LOC_GUID JOIN IDB.LOCATION_GROUPS_REFERENCE ON OL_LOC_GUID = LGR_LOC_GUID) , APPTS AS (SELECT PT_MRN CPE_MRN, DT_DTE CPE_ENC_DTE, PENC_ENC_CSN_ID, PENC_APPT_STS CPE_CPE_APPT_STS, ENR_RES_NAME CRE_RES_NAME, ENR_RES_TYP CRE_RES_TYP, ENDP_DEPT_NAME CLD_DEPT_NAME, ENDP_CENTER_ABBR CLD_CLD_CENTER, ENVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR, CASE WHEN ENDP_SERVICE_DEPT_GRP_6 = 'RAD' THEN 'Radiology' WHEN ENDP_SERVICE_SPECIALTY_GRP_8 = 'CAR' THEN 'Cardiology' WHEN ENR_RES_TYP = 'Nurse' AND ENR_RES_NAME like '%RSCH%' THEN 'RN' WHEN ENVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR = 'LabRes' THEN 'Lab' WHEN ENVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR like '%DTU%' THEN 'DTU' WHEN ENDP_SERVICE_DEPT_GRP_6 = 'CHM' THEN 'Chemo' WHEN ENR_RES_TYP = 'Physician' THEN 'MD' ELSE 'Other' END AS APPT_TYPE FROM (SELECT DISTINCT OO_MRN FROM ORD WHERE ORD_TYPE <> 'Combo') O JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V ON OO_MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN DV.PATIENT_ENCOUNTER ON PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PENC_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID JOIN DV.DATE ON PENC_ENC_DATE_ID = DT_DATE_ID LEFT JOIN DV.ENCOUNTER_DESC_CATALOG STS ON PENC_APPT_STS = STS.EDC_DEPT_ABBREV AND STS.EDC_GROUP_ID = 'STS' JOIN DV.ENCOUNTER_DEPARTMENT ON PENC_DEPT_ID = ENDP_ENC_DEPT_ID JOIN DV.ENCOUNTER_SCHD_RESOURCES ON PENC_PT_ENC_ID = ENSR_PT_ENC_ID AND ENSR_PRIMARY_RES_IND = 'Y' JOIN DV.ENCOUNTER_RESOURCE ON ENSR_RES_ID = ENR_ENC_RES_ID JOIN DV.ENCOUNTER_VISIT_TYPE ON PENC_VISIT_TYPE_ID = ENVT_ENC_VISIT_TYPE_ID WHERE PENC_APPT_STS NOT IN ('Can') AND DT_DTE >= CURRENT date UNION SELECT PT_MRN CPE_MRN, DT_DTE CPE_ENC_DTE, PENC_ENC_CSN_ID, PENC_APPT_STS CPE_CPE_APPT_STS, ENR_RES_NAME CRE_RES_NAME, ENR_RES_TYP CRE_RES_TYP, ENDP_DEPT_NAME CLD_DEPT_NAME, ENDP_CENTER_ABBR CLD_CLD_CENTER, ENVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR prompt:
Provide a one time list in the breast service who have been seen for management of intracranial metastases.

A) Carry an ICD code for brain metastasis (ICD-10 C79.31, or ICD-9 198.3)

B)  have had a visit with neurosurgery (particular providers include Moss, Brennan, Tabar, Holland.

C) have had a consult visit with any neurologist

D) have had radiation oncology visit with following providers: Kathryn Beal, Timothy Chan, Jonathan Yang, John Cuaron, Amy Xu, Yoshiya Yamada

completion: WITH APPTS AS (SELECT CPE_MRN, MAX(CASE WHEN CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 = 'BRE' THEN '1' ELSE '' END) AS BREAST_APPT, MAX(CASE WHEN CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 = 'NEU' THEN '1' ELSE '' END) AS NEURO_APPT FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CRE_RES_TYP IN ('Physician', 'PhD', 'Dentist', 'Psychologist') AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN '2010-01-01' AND CURRENT date AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 IN ('BRE', 'NEU') GROUP BY CPE_MRN) , DX AS (SELECT DISTINCT CC_MRN AS DX_MRN, '1' AS BRAIN_METS FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE CC_CLSF_CD IN ('198.3', 'C79.31') AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND (CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) GROUP BY CC_MRN, CC_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK ) , RADONC AS (SELECT CPE_MRN AS MRN_RADONC, CPE_ENC_DTE, CRE_RES_NAME FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CRE_RES_TYP IN ('Physician', 'PhD', 'Dentist', 'Psychologist') AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN '2010-01-01' AND CURRENT date AND CRE_RES_NAME IN ('BEAL, KATHRYN', 'CHAN, TIMOTHY', 'YANG, JONATHAN', 'CUARON, JOHN J', 'XU, AMY JIA', 'YAMADA, YOSHIYA') ) , PROTOCOL AS (SELECT DISTINCT AC_MRN, MAX(CASE WHEN AC_IRB_NO = '06-107' THEN '1' ELSE NULL END) AS "06-107", MAX(CASE WHEN AC_IRB_NO = '12-245' THEN '1' ELSE NULL END) AS "12-245" FROM IDB.ACCRUALS WHERE AC_IRB_NO IN ('06-107', '12-245') GROUP BY AC_MRN) SELECT AC_MRN, "06-107", "12-245", BREAST_APPT, NEURO_APPT, BRAIN_METS, RADONC.CPE_ENC_DTE AS RADONC_APPT, RADONC.CRE_RES_NAME AS RADONC_PROVIDER FROM PROTOCOL JOIN APPTS ON AC_MRN = CPE_MRN LEFT JOIN DX ON AC_MRN = DX_MRN LEFT JOIN RADONC ON AC_MRN = MRN_RADONC WHERE BREAST_APPT = '1' AND (BRAIN_METS = '1' OR NEURO_APPT = '1') AND RADONC.CPE_ENC_DTE IS NOT NULL ; WITH APPTS AS (SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN FROM DV.PATIENT_ENCOUNTER JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PENC_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID JOIN DV.DATE ON PENC_ENC_DATE_ID = DT_DATE_ID LEFT JOIN DV.ENCOUNTER_DESC_CATALOG STS ON PENC_APPT_STS = STS.EDC_DEPT_ABBREV AND STS.EDC_GROUP_ID = 'STS' JOIN DV.ENCOUNTER_DEPARTMENT ON PENC_DEPT_ID = ENDP_ENC_DEPT_ID JOIN DV.ENCOUNTER_SCHD_RESOURCES ON PENC_PT_ENC_ID = ENSR_PT_ENC_ID AND ENSR_PRIMARY_RES_IND = 'Y' JOIN DV.ENCOUNTER_RESOURCE ON ENSR_RES_ID = ENR_ENC_RES_ID JOIN DV.ENCOUNTER_VISIT_TYPE ON PENC_VISIT_TYPE_ID = ENVT_ENC_VISIT_TYPE_ID LEFT JOIN DV.ENCOUNTER_DESC_CATALOG DEPT ON ENDP_SERVICE_DEPT_GRP_6 = DEPT.EDC_DEPT_ABBREV AND DEPT.EDC_GROUP_ID = '6' LEFT JOIN DV.ENCOUNTER_DESC_CATALOG SVC ON ENDP_SERVICE_SPECIALTY_GRP_8 = SVC.EDC_DEPT_ABBREV AND SVC.EDC_GROUP_ID = '8' WHERE PENC_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND DT_DTE BETWEEN '2010-01-01' AND CURRENT date AND SVC.EDC_DEPT_DESC = 'Breast' ) SELECT RRPT_MRN, RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE, RRPT_PROCEDURE_NAME, RRPT_REPORT_TXT, DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)IMPRESSION:[\w\W]*(?=DICTATED BY:)', RRPT_REPORT_TXT) AS RRPT_IMPRESSION, DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)FINDINGS:[\w\W]*(?=DICTATED BY:)', RRPT_REPORT_TXT) AS RRPT_FINDINGS, REPLACE(DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)Electronically\W*Signed\W*By\W*:? ?[^\r\n\(]*', RRPT_REPORT_TXT), DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)Electronically\W*Signed\W*By\W*:? ?', RRPT_REPORT_TXT), '') AS RRPT_SIGNED_BY FROM DV.RADIOLOGY_REPORT_V R JOIN APPTS ON PT_MRN = RRPT_MRN WHERE DV.REGEX('(?i)(?<!not? )(INCREAS|ENLARG|WORSE|NEW|ADDITIONAL)', RRPT_REPORT_TXT, 'start') <> 0 AND RRPT_ORDER_GROUP = 'MR' AND prompt: Provide a list of patients diagnosed with Merkel cell carcinoma from 1990-present.
completion: WITH DX AS (SELECT TM_MRN AS MRN, TM_DX_DTE AS DX_DATE, TM_SITE_CD AS SITE_CODE, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_DESC, TM_HIST_CD AS HIST_CODE, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS HIST_DESC, TM_BEST_AJCC_STG AS STAGE FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM H ON TM_HIST_CD = H.CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON TM_SITE_CD = S.CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND TM_HIST_CD = 'M8247/3' AND TM_DX_DTE >= '1990-01-01' UNION SELECT CC_MRN AS MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS DX_DATE, CLM_CLSF_CD AS SITE_CODE, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_DESC, '' AS HIST_CODE, '' AS HIST_DESC, '' AS STAGE FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND ((CC_PT_TYPE = 'I') OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) AND CC_CLSF_CD IN ('209.31', '209.32', '209.33', '209.34', '209.35', '209.36', 'C4A.0', 'C4A.10', 'C4A.11', 'C4A.12', 'C4A.20', 'C4A.21', 'C4A.22', 'C4A.30', 'C4A.31', 'C4A.39', 'C4A.4', 'C4A.60', 'C4A.61', 'C4A.62', 'C4A.70', 'C4A.71', 'C4A.72', 'C4A.51', 'C4A.52', 'C4A.59', 'C4A.8', 'C4A.9') GROUP BY CC_MRN, CLM_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK, '', '' HAVING MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) >= '1990-01-01') , CTE AS (SELECT MRN AS DX_MRN, DX_DATE, REPLACE(STRIP(HIST_CODE) || '-' || STRIP(HIST_DESC) || '|' || STRIP(SITE_CODE) || '-' || STRIP(SITE_DESC), '-|', '') AS DX_CODE FROM DX) , CTE2 AS (SELECT * FROM CTE ORDER BY DX_MRN, DX_DATE, DX_CODE) , T1 AS (SELECT DX_MRN, DX_DATE, DX_CODE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY DX_MRN ORDER BY DX_DATE) AS RN FROM CTE2 ORDER BY DX_MRN, DX_DATE) , T2 (MRN, DX, RN1) AS (SELECT DX_MRN, CAST(DX_DATE AS VARCHAR(6000))||' | '||CAST(DX_CODE AS VARCHAR(300)), RN FROM T1 WHERE T1.RN = 1 UNION ALL SELECT DX_MRN, RTRIM(CAST(DX AS VARCHAR(4000))) || ', ' || CHR(13) || CHR(10) || CAST(DX_DATE AS VARCHAR(300))||' | '||RTRIM(CAST(DX_CODE AS VARCHAR(300))) , RN1 + 1 FROM T1, T2 WHERE DX_MRN = MRN AND RN = RN1+1 ) , T3 AS (SELECT MRN, MAX(RN1) RN FROM T2 GROUP BY MRN) , T4 AS (SELECT T2.MRN, RN, DX FROM T2 JOIN T3 ON T2.MRN = T3.MRN AND T2.RN1 = T3.RN) , X AS (SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN AS MRN, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH AS DOB, PT_SEX AS GENDER, DX FROM T4 JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON MRN = PT_MRN ) , APPT AS (SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN AS MRN, CPE_ENC_DTE AS APPT_DATE, CRE_RES_NAME AS ATTENDING, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 AS GRP6, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 AS GRP8, CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR AS VISIT_TYPE_ABBR, 'CPE' AS SRC FROM X JOIN IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER ON CPE_MRN = MRN JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CRE_RES_TYP IN ('Physician') AND CPE_ENC_DTE >= '2000-01-01' AND(CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR LIKE '%NV%' OR CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR LIKE '%IR%') UNION SELECT APPT_MRN AS MRN, APPT_SCH_DTE AS APPT_DATE, APPT_RES_CD AS ATTENDING, APPT_SVC_DPT AS GRP6, APPT_RES_SVC AS GRP8, APPT_VISIT_TYPE AS VISIT_TYPE_ABBR, 'APP' AS SRC FROM X JOIN IDB.APPOINTMENT ON APPT_MRN = MRN JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PT_MRN = APPT_MRN JOIN IDB.APPT_RESOURCE ON APPT_RES_CD = APPR_RES_CD AND APPR_RES_TYPE = 'DR' WHERE APPT_SCH_DTE BETWEEN '1990-01-01' AND '1999-12-31' AND APPT_APPT_STS_CD IN ('50', '55') ) , NV AS (SELECT APPT.* FROM APPT WHERE VISIT_TYPE_ABBR LIKE '%NV%' OR VISIT_TYPE_ABBR LIKE '%IR%' ) , ALL_APPTS AS (SELECT APPT.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY MRN ORDER BY APPT_DATE DESC) AS RN FROM APPT) SELECT DISTINCT X.*, AA.APPT_DATE, AA.ATTENDING FROM X JOIN NV ON X.MRN = NV.MRN LEFT JOIN ALL_APPTS AA ON X.MRN = AA.MRN AND RN = 1
