prompt: Create a report of patients who received the VATS lobectomy  procedure on the Thoracic service.
completion: SELECT DISTINCT PBD_MRN AS MRN, PBD_SVC_DTE AS SURG_DATE, STRIP(PBC_CPT_CD)||'-'||PBC_PBD_DESC AS SURG_DESC, TIMESTAMP(CS_ADM_DATE, CS_ADM_TIME) AS ADMIT_DT, TIMESTAMP(CS_DSCH_DATE, CS_DSCH_TIME) AS DISCH_DT, DOC_NAME AS SURGEON, SUBSTR(CHAR(PBD_SVC_DTE), 1, 5)|| CASE WHEN MONTH(PBD_SVC_DTE) BETWEEN 1 AND 3 THEN 'Q1' WHEN MONTH(PBD_SVC_DTE) BETWEEN 4 AND 6 THEN 'Q2' WHEN MONTH(PBD_SVC_DTE) BETWEEN 7 AND 9 THEN 'Q3' ELSE 'Q4' END AS SURG_YEAR, CASE WHEN CS_DSCH_DATE IS NOT NULL THEN INT(CS_DAYS_STAY) ELSE DAYS(CURRENT DATE) - DAYS(PBD_SVC_DTE) END LOS, CASE WHEN CS_DSCH_DATE IS NOT NULL THEN INT(CS_DAYS_STAY) ELSE DAYS(CURRENT DATE) - DAYS(PBD_SVC_DTE) END LOS FROM IDB.PBD_DTL JOIN IDB.PBD_CODE ON PBC_PBD_CD = PBD_PBD_CD JOIN IDB.CLM ON CLM_CLSF_CD = PBC_CPT_CD JOIN IDB.PBD_INVOICE ON PBI_MRN = PBD_MRN AND PBI_ACCT_NO = PBD_ACCT_NO AND PBI_INV_NO = PBD_INV_NO JOIN IDB.DOC ON PBI_PERFORM_DR_NO = DOC_DR_NO JOIN IDB.CASE ON CS_MRN = PBD_MRN AND PBD_ACCT_NO = CS_ACCT_NO AND CS_ACCT_NO LIKE '84%' AND CS_PT_STS <> 'IP' WHERE PBD_SVC_DTE >= CASE WHEN MONTH(CURRENT DATE) = 1 THEN DATE(STRIP(CHAR(YEAR(CURRENT_DATE) - 1))||'-01-01') ELSE DATE(STRIP(CHAR(YEAR(CURRENT_DATE)))||'-01-01') END AND PBD_SVC_DTE <= DATE(CURRENT_DATE - DAY(CURRENT_DATE) DAY) AND PBC_CPT_CD = '32663' AND PBC_PBD_DESC LIKE 'THOR%'

prompt: Provide a list of patients seen in Westchester Survivorship and by Dr. Dang.
completion: WITH PTNEW AS (SELECT CPE_MRN AS MRN, PT_LAST_NAME LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME FIRST_NAME, CPE_ENC_DTE AS APPT_DATE, CPE_CPE_APPT_STS AS APPT_STATUS, CLD_DEPT_NAME AS DEPARTMENT, CLD_CLD_CENTER AS DEPT_CENTER, CRE_RES_NAME AS PROVIDER_NAME, CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME AS VISIT_TYPE_NAME FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON CPE_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY ON CPE_MRN = PLA_MRN WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Sch', 'Arrived', 'Comp') AND CLD_DEPT_NAME = 'BREAST DMT WES SVR' AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN '2021-10-01' AND '2022-12-31' ) , DANG_APPT AS (SELECT P.MRN, P.LAST_NAME, P.FIRST_NAME, P.APPT_DATE SVP_APPT_DATE, P.DEPARTMENT SVP_DEPT_NAME, P.PROVIDER_NAME SVP_PROVIDER_NAME, P.VISIT_TYPE_NAME SVP_VISIT_TYPE, E.CPE_ENC_DTE AS DR_APPT_DATE, E.CPE_CPE_APPT_STS AS DR_APPT_STATUS, CLD_DEPT_NAME AS DR_DEPARTMENT, CRE_RES_NAME AS DOCTOR_NAME, CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME AS DR_VISIT_TYPE_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY P.MRN ORDER BY E.CPE_ENC_DTE DESC) RECENT_APPT_DT FROM PTNEW P JOIN IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER E ON P.MRN = E.CPE_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON CPE_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY ON CPE_MRN = PLA_MRN WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CRE_RES_NAME = 'DANG, CHAU' AND CPE_ENC_DTE <= APPT_DATE ) SELECT MRN, FIRST_NAME, LAST_NAME, SVP_APPT_DATE, SVP_DEPT_NAME, SVP_PROVIDER_NAME, SVP_VISIT_TYPE, DR_APPT_DATE, DR_DEPARTMENT, DOCTOR_NAME, DR_VISIT_TYPE_NAME FROM DANG_APPT WHERE RECENT_APPT_DT =1

prompt: Diagnosis and pregnancy data for patients with metastatic cancer within one year of breast cancer diagnosis. Limited to protocol date range.
completion: WITH BC_DIAGNOSIS AS (SELECT CC_MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS MIN_ICD9_EFF_DTE, CC_CLSF_CD AS ICD9_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS ICD9_DESC FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE LEFT(CC_CLSF_CD, 3) = '174' OR LEFT(CC_CLSF_CD, 3) ='C50' OR CC_CLSF_CD = '233.0' AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND (CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) GROUP BY CC_MRN, CC_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK HAVING MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) BETWEEN '1992-01-01' AND '2020-07-13'), META AS (SELECT CC_MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS MIN_ICD9_EFF_DTE, CC_CLSF_CD AS ICD9_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS ICD9_DESC FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE CC_CLSF_CD IN ('196.0', '196.1', '196.2', '196.5', '196.6', '197.0', '197.1', '197.3', '197.4', '197.5', '197.7', '197.8', '198.1', '198.2', '198.3', '198.4', '198.5', '198.7', 'C77.0', 'C77.1', 'C77.2', 'C77.4', 'C77.5', 'C78.0', 'C78.1', 'C78.39', 'C78.4', 'C78.5', 'C78.7', 'C78.7', 'C79.11', 'C79.19', 'C79.2', 'C79.31', 'C79.32', 'C79.49', 'C79.51', 'C79.52', 'C79.7') AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND (CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) GROUP BY CC_MRN, CC_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK HAVING MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) BETWEEN '1992-01-01' AND '2020-07-13') SELECT BC.CC_MRN AS "MRN", PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH AS "Date of birth", YEAR(DATE(BC.MIN_ICD9_EFF_DTE)-PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) AS "Age at breast diagnosis", R.AV_DESC AS "Race", BC.MIN_ICD9_EFF_DTE AS "Breast diagnosis date", BC.ICD9_CD AS "Breast ICD code", BC.ICD9_DESC AS "Brest ICD description", M.MIN_ICD9_EFF_DTE AS "Mets diagnosis date", DAYS(M.MIN_ICD9_EFF_DTE) - DAYS(BC.MIN_ICD9_EFF_DTE) AS "Days from breast diagnosis", M.ICD9_CD AS "Mets ICD code", M.ICD9_DESC AS "Mets ICD description", BP_PREG_DX_CD AS "IDB.BR_PRIMARY pregnancy indicator" FROM BC_DIAGNOSIS BC LEFT JOIN META M ON BC.CC_MRN = META.CC_MRN JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON BC.CC_MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS R ON R.AV_ELEMENT = 'RACE' AND R.AV_CODE = PT_RACE LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT BP_MRN, BP_PREG_DX_CD FROM IDB.BR_PRIMARY WHERE BP_PREG_DX_CD = '1' ) P ON BC.CC_MRN = P.BP_MRN WHERE DAYS(M.MIN_ICD9_EFF_DTE) - DAYS(BC.MIN_ICD9_EFF_DTE) BETWEEN 0 AND 365 AND YEAR(DATE(BC.MIN_ICD9_EFF_DTE)-PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) BETWEEN 20 AND 45

prompt: For clinical trial enrollment, all patients alive, seen in last three months, with mutations in either ATM, ARID1A, ATRX, or DAXX
completion: SELECT H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS HIST_DESC, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK SITE_DESC, COUNT(*) FROM DV.PATIENT_ENCOUNTER JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS A ON PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PENC_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_STRUCTURED_RESULTS_V B ON B.PT_MRN = A.PT_MRN AND GENE IN ('ARID1A', 'ATRX', 'DAXX', 'ATM') JOIN IDB.CDB_TUMOR ON A.PT_MRN = TM_MRN AND TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD WHERE PENC_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND DATE(PENC_ENC_DT) BETWEEN CURRENT date - 90 DAYS AND CURRENT date AND PT_DEATH_DTE IS NULL GROUP BY H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK ;

prompt: Requesting a cohort of patients with T1-T4a N0 (lymph node negative) bladder cancer that underwent radiation therapy 55gy in 20 fractions who had at least 3 months followup
completion: WITH TUMOR AS (SELECT TM_MRN, TM_DX_DTE, TM_SITE_CD, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_DESC, CASE WHEN TM_BEST_AJCC_STG NOT IN ('', '99', '88') THEN TM_BEST_AJCC_STG ELSE COALESCE(TM_PATH_TNM_T, TM_CLIN_TNM_T) END AS TSTAGE FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND TM_SITE_CD LIKE 'C67%' AND TM_CLIN_TNM_N NOT IN ('N1', 'N2', 'N3') AND TM_PATH_TNM_N NOT IN ('N1', 'N2', 'N3') AND RIGHT(TRIM(UPPER(TM_CLIN_TNM_T)), 2) <> '4B' AND RIGHT(TRIM(UPPER(TM_PATH_TNM_T)), 2) <> '4B' AND RIGHT(TRIM(UPPER(TM_BEST_AJCC_STG)), 2) <> '4B' ) , APPT AS (SELECT CPE_MRN, CPE_ENC_DTE FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID JOIN TUMOR ON CPE_MRN = TM_MRN WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME = 'RO POST-TX VISIT' ) SELECT RTC_TX_MRN AS MRN, LISTAGG(TRIM(TSTAGE), ',') WITHIN GROUP( ORDER BY TSTAGE) AS TSTAGE, RTC_TX_START_DTE AS RT_START, RTC_TX_STOP_DTE AS RT_STOP, "CHEMO Y/N", PLA_LST_APPT_DTE AS LAST_APPT_DATE FROM (SELECT DISTINCT RTC_TX_MRN, TSTAGE, RTC_TX_START_DTE, RTC_TX_STOP_DTE, CASE WHEN APR_MRN IS NULL THEN '' ELSE 'Y' END AS "CHEMO Y/N", PLA_LST_APPT_DTE FROM IDB.RADONC_TREATMENT_COURSE JOIN TUMOR ON RTC_TX_MRN = TM_MRN JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY ON RTC_TX_MRN = PLA_MRN JOIN APPT ON CPE_MRN = RTC_TX_MRN AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN RTC_TX_STOP_DTE AND RTC_TX_STOP_DTE + 90 DAYS LEFT JOIN IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX_V ON RTC_TX_MRN = APR_MRN AND CDG_CHEMO_FLAG = 'Y' AND APR_START_DTE <= RTC_TX_STOP_DTE WHERE RTC_TX_DELIVERED_FRACTIONS >= 20 AND RTC_TX_DELIVERED_DOSE >= 5500 ) GROUP BY RTC_TX_MRN, RTC_TX_START_DTE, RTC_TX_STOP_DTE, "CHEMO Y/N", PLA_LST_APPT_DTE

prompt: Provide a list of patients who were transplanted with Unrelated Donors between 01-01-2022 and 02-23-2023.
completion: SELECT DISTINCT STRIP(OO_MRN) AS MRN, STRIP(PT_LAST_NAME) || ', ' || STRIP(PT_FIRST_NAME) AS "Name", STRIP(OO_ORD_NAME) AS "Order Name", OO_ORD_STS_CD, OSTS_STS_DESC, STRIP(X3.OUD_USER_DI_VALUE) AS "Relationship to Patient", STRIP(X2.OUD_USER_DI_VALUE) AS "If unrelated NMDP#", DATE(STRIP(X1.OUD_USER_DI_VALUE)) AS "Proposed Start Date" FROM IDB.OMS_ORDER JOIN IDB.OMS_STATUS ON OO_ORD_STS_CD = OSTS_ORD_STS_CD JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PT_MRN = OO_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_USER_DATA X1 ON OO_ORD_GUID = X1.OUD_ORD_GUID AND X1.OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'Requested For' LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_USER_DATA X2 ON OO_ORD_GUID = X2.OUD_ORD_GUID AND X2.OUD_USER_DI_CD IN ('Stem Cell NMDP#') LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_USER_DATA X3 ON OO_ORD_GUID = X3.OUD_ORD_GUID AND X3.OUD_USER_DI_CD IN ('Stem Cell Relationship') WHERE 1=1 AND OO_ORD_NAME IN ('ALLO - HPC-A Thaw Infusion Order', 'ALLO - HPC-M Thaw Infusion Order') AND DATE(STRIP(X1.OUD_USER_DI_VALUE)) BETWEEN '2022-01-01' AND '2023-02-23' AND OO_MRN <> '11111111' AND OO_ORD_STS_CD NOT IN ('CANC', 'CANP', 'AUC3', 'DISC')

prompt: identifying patients with lynch syndrome treated at MSKCC and identify when they developed endometrial cancer
completion: WITH CLINDOC_0 AS (SELECT "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AS PT_DEID, "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_MRN" AS PT_MRN, "IDB"."CD_DOCUMENT"."CDD_DOC_GUID" AS SUBJECT_ID, "IDB"."CD_OBSERVATION"."CDO_ITEM_NAME" AS CD_ITEM FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS" JOIN "IDB"."CD_DOCUMENT" ON "IDB"."CD_DOCUMENT"."CDD_MRN" = "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_MRN" JOIN "IDB"."CD_OBSERVATION" ON "IDB"."CD_DOCUMENT"."CDD_DOC_GUID" = "IDB"."CD_OBSERVATION"."CDO_DOC_GUID" AND "IDB"."CD_DOCUMENT"."CDD_AUTHORED_DTE" = "IDB"."CD_OBSERVATION"."CDO_AUTHORED_DTE" AND "IDB"."CD_OBSERVATION"."CDO_VALUE_TEXT" != '' WHERE "IDB"."CD_DOCUMENT"."CDD_CANCEL_IND" != '1' AND "IDB"."CD_DOCUMENT"."CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND" != '1' AND "IDB"."CD_OBSERVATION"."CDO_ITEM_NAME" IN ('In a recent large trial, Lynch syndrome patients who took a high dosage of aspirin', 'Information about Lynch Syndrome:', 'International Lynch syndrome Awareness Day is March 22nd each year', 'Lynch GYN', 'Men and women who have Lynch syndrome should undergo colonoscopy', 'Small Bowel: For individuals who have Lynch syndrome', 'Women who have Lynch syndrome are at risk for gynecologic cancers')), DEMOGRAPHICS_1 AS (SELECT DISTINCT "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AS PT_DEID, IDB_PATIENT."PT_MRN" AS PT_MRN, "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AS SUBJECT_ID, ALLOWVALS_SEX."AV_DESC" AS SEX FROM "IDB"."PATIENT" AS IDB_PATIENT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS" ON IDB_PATIENT."PT_MRN" = "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_MRN" LEFT OUTER JOIN "IDB"."ALLOWVALS" AS ALLOWVALS_SEX ON IDB_PATIENT."PT_SEX" = ALLOWVALS_SEX."AV_CODE" AND ALLOWVALS_SEX."AV_ELEMENT" = 'SEX' WHERE ALLOWVALS_SEX."AV_DESC" IN ('FEMALE')), COHORT AS (SELECT PT_DEID AS PT_DEID FROM (SELECT CLINDOC_0.PT_DEID AS PT_DEID FROM CLINDOC_0 INTERSECT SELECT DEMOGRAPHICS_1.PT_DEID AS PT_DEID FROM DEMOGRAPHICS_1)), COHORT_CLINDOC AS (SELECT SUBJECT_ID AS SUBJECT_ID, PT_DEID AS PT_DEID FROM (SELECT CLINDOC_0.SUBJECT_ID AS SUBJECT_ID, CLINDOC_0.PT_DEID AS PT_DEID FROM CLINDOC_0)), KEYS AS (SELECT COHORT.PT_DEID AS COHORT_PT_DEID, COHORT_CLINDOC.SUBJECT_ID AS COHORT_CLINDOC_SUBJECT_ID, COHORT_CLINDOC.PT_DEID AS COHORT_CLINDOC_PT_DEID FROM COHORT LEFT OUTER JOIN COHORT_CLINDOC ON COHORT_CLINDOC.PT_DEID = COHORT.PT_DEID), DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS AS (SELECT DISTINCT "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AS PT_DEID, IDB_PATIENT."PT_MRN" AS PT_MRN, "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AS SUBJECT_ID, DMP_ID_TBL."PDRX_DMP_PATIENT_ID" AS DMP_ID, TRIM(IDB_PATIENT."PT_LAST_NAME") || ', ' || TRIM(IDB_PATIENT."PT_FIRST_NAME") AS PT_NAME, ALLOWVALS_SEX."AV_DESC" AS SEX, CASE WHEN (IDB_PATIENT."PT_DATE_OF_DEATH" IS NULL) THEN 'Alive' ELSE 'Deceased' END AS VITAL_STATS, IDB_PATIENT."PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH" AS DATE_OF_BIRTH, IDB_PATIENT."PT_DATE_OF_DEATH" AS DATE_OF_DEATH, ALLOWVALS_RACE."AV_DESC" AS RACE, ALLOWVALS_ETHNICITY."AV_DESC" AS ETHNICITY, ALLOWVALS_LANGUAGE."AV_DESC" AS PRIMARY_LANGUAGE, LAST_ACTIVITY_DATE."PLA_LST_ACTV_DTE" AS LAST_ACTIVITY_DATE, LAST_CONTACT_DATE."PLA_LST_CON_DTE" AS LAST_CONTACT_DATE FROM "IDB"."PATIENT" AS IDB_PATIENT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS" ON IDB_PATIENT."PT_MRN" = "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_MRN" LEFT OUTER JOIN "DV"."PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML" AS DMP_ID_TBL ON DMP_ID_TBL."PDRX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT OUTER JOIN "IDB"."ALLOWVALS" AS ALLOWVALS_SEX ON IDB_PATIENT."PT_SEX" = ALLOWVALS_SEX."AV_CODE" AND ALLOWVALS_SEX."AV_ELEMENT" = 'SEX' LEFT OUTER JOIN "IDB"."ALLOWVALS" AS ALLOWVALS_RACE ON IDB_PATIENT."PT_RACE" = ALLOWVALS_RACE."AV_CODE" AND ALLOWVALS_RACE."AV_ELEMENT" = 'RACE' LEFT OUTER JOIN "IDB"."ALLOWVALS" AS ALLOWVALS_ETHNICITY ON IDB_PATIENT."PT_PT_ETHNICITY" = ALLOWVALS_ETHNICITY."AV_CODE" AND ALLOWVALS_ETHNICITY."AV_ELEMENT" = 'PT_ETHNICITY' LEFT OUTER JOIN "IDB"."ALLOWVALS" AS ALLOWVALS_LANGUAGE ON IDB_PATIENT."PT_PRIMARY_LANG" = ALLOWVALS_LANGUAGE."AV_CODE" AND ALLOWVALS_LANGUAGE."AV_ELEMENT" = 'PRIMARY_LANG' LEFT OUTER JOIN "IDB".PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY AS LAST_ACTIVITY_DATE ON IDB_PATIENT."PT_MRN" = LAST_ACTIVITY_DATE."PLA_MRN" LEFT OUTER JOIN "IDB".PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY AS LAST_CONTACT_DATE ON IDB_PATIENT."PT_MRN" = LAST_CONTACT_DATE."PLA_MRN") SELECT DISTINCT DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS.PT_MRN AS MRN, DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS.DMP_ID AS DMP_ID, DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS.PT_NAME AS PT_NAME, DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS.SEX AS SEX, DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS.VITAL_STATS AS VITAL_STATUS, DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS.DATE_OF_BIRTH AS DATE_OF_BIRTH, DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS.DATE_OF_DEATH AS DATE_OF_DEATH, DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS.RACE AS RACE, DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS.ETHNICITY AS ETHNICITY, DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS.PRIMARY_LANGUAGE AS PRIMARY_LANGUAGE, DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS.LAST_ACTIVITY_DATE AS LAST_ACTIVITY_DATE, DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS.LAST_CONTACT_DATE AS LAST_CONTACT_DATE FROM KEYS LEFT OUTER JOIN DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS ON DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS.PT_DEID = KEYS.COHORT_PT_DEID;

prompt: update sleep medicine referrals data
completion: WITH CTE AS (SELECT OO_ORD_GUID ORDGUID, OO_ENTER_DTE ORD_ENTER_DATE, (YEAR(OO_ENTER_DTE)) ENTER_YR, (QUARTER(OO_ENTER_DTE)) ENTER_QTR, STRIP(CHAR(YEAR(OO_ENTER_DTE)))||'-0'||CHAR(QUARTER(OO_ENTER_DTE)) YR_QTR, MONTH(OO_ENTER_DTE) ENTER_MONTH, CASE MONTH(OO_ENTER_DTE) WHEN 1 THEN 'JAN' WHEN 2 THEN 'FEB' WHEN 3 THEN 'MAR' WHEN 4 THEN 'APR' WHEN 5 THEN 'MAY' WHEN 6 THEN 'JUN' WHEN 7 THEN 'JUL' WHEN 8 THEN 'AUG' WHEN 9 THEN 'SEP' WHEN 10 THEN 'OCT' WHEN 11 THEN 'NOV' WHEN 12 THEN 'DEC' END ENTER_MONTHNAME , OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE PERFORMED_DATE, OO_MRN MRN, STRIP(PT_LAST_NAME)||', '||PT_FIRST_NAME PT_NAME, OO_ORD_ID ORDID, OO_ORD_NAME ORDNAME, STRIP(OO_ORD_STS_CD)||'-'||OSTS_STS_DESC ORDSTATUS , MAX(CASE WHEN OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'Consult_Pulm Reason for' THEN SUBSTR(OUD_USER_DI_VALUE, 1, 100) END) "Reason For Consult", MAX(CASE WHEN OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'Instructions_Spl' THEN SUBSTR(OUD_USER_DI_VALUE, 1, 100) END) "Instructions", MAX(CASE WHEN OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'Consult_Pulm Cancer Dx' THEN SUBSTR(OUD_USER_DI_VALUE, 1, 50) END) "Primary diagnosis", MAX(CASE WHEN OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'Consult_Pulm OP Attending' THEN SUBSTR(OUD_USER_DI_VALUE, 1, 50) END) "Requested MD", MAX(CASE WHEN OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'Consult_Pulm OP Sleep Study' THEN SUBSTR(OUD_USER_DI_VALUE, 1, 5) END) "Sleep Medicine referral", MAX(CASE WHEN OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'Consult_Pulm OP Sleep Study Prior' THEN SUBSTR(OUD_USER_DI_VALUE, 1, 5) END) "Prior Sleep Study" FROM IDB.OMS_ORDER JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON OO_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_USER_DATA ON OUD_ORD_GUID = OO_ORD_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_STATUS ON OO_ORD_STS_CD = OSTS_ORD_STS_CD WHERE OO_ORD_NAME = 'Pulmonary Outpatient Referral' AND OO_ENTER_DTE >= '1/1/2019' GROUP BY OO_ORD_GUID, OO_ENTER_DTE, YEAR(OO_ENTER_DTE) , QUARTER(OO_ENTER_DTE) , MONTH(OO_ENTER_DTE) , OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE, OO_MRN, STRIP(PT_LAST_NAME)||', '||PT_FIRST_NAME , OO_ORD_ID, OO_ORD_NAME, OO_ORD_STS_CD, OSTS_STS_DESC ORDER BY YEAR(OO_ENTER_DTE) , QUARTER(OO_ENTER_DTE) , MONTH(OO_ENTER_DTE) , STRIP(OO_ORD_STS_CD)||'-'||OSTS_STS_DESC, OO_ENTER_DTE, OO_MRN) SELECT ORDGUID, ORD_ENTER_DATE, ENTER_YR, ENTER_QTR, YR_QTR, ENTER_MONTH, ENTER_MONTHNAME, PERFORMED_DATE, MRN PT_NAME, ORDID, ORDNAME, ORDSTATUS , "Reason For Consult", "Instructions", "Primary diagnosis", "Requested MD", "Sleep Medicine referral", "Prior Sleep Study" FROM CTE WHERE LOWER("Reason For Consult") LIKE '%sleep%' OR LOWER("Reason For Consult") LIKE '%apnea%' OR ("Reason For Consult") LIKE '%OSA%' OR LOWER("Reason For Consult") LIKE '%fatigue%' OR LOWER("Reason For Consult") LIKE '%insomnia%' OR LOWER("Reason For Consult") LIKE '%polycythemia%' OR LOWER("Reason For Consult") LIKE '%snoring%' OR LOWER("Reason For Consult") LIKE '%snore%' OR LOWER("Reason For Consult") LIKE '%sleepiness%' OR LOWER("Reason For Consult") LIKE '%erythrocytosis%' OR LOWER("Reason For Consult") LIKE '%somnolence%' OR LOWER("Reason For Consult") LIKE '%migraine%' OR LOWER("Reason For Consult") LIKE '%restless%' OR ("Reason For Consult") LIKE '%CPAP %' OR ("Reason For Consult") LIKE '%PAP%' OR ("Reason For Consult") LIKE '%BiPAP%' OR LOWER("Reason For Consult") LIKE '%circadian%' OR LOWER("Reason For Consult") LIKE '%hypercapnia%' OR LOWER("Reason For Consult") LIKE '%hypercapneic%' OR ("Reason For Consult") LIKE '%HSAT%' OR ("Reason For Consult") LIKE '%HCT%' OR ("Reason For Consult") LIKE '%HGB%' OR LOWER("Reason For Consult") LIKE '%parasomnia%' OR LOWER("Reason For Consult") LIKE '%obesity%' OR LOWER("Instructions") LIKE '%sleep%' OR LOWER("Instructions") LIKE '%apnea%' OR ("Instructions") LIKE '%OSA%' OR LOWER("Instructions") LIKE '%fatigue%' OR LOWER("Instructions") LIKE '%insomnia%' OR LOWER("Instructions") LIKE '%polycythemia%' OR LOWER("Instructions") LIKE '%snoring%' OR LOWER("Instructions") LIKE '%snore%' OR LOWER("Instructions") LIKE '%sleepiness%' OR LOWER("Instructions") LIKE '%erythrocytosis%' OR LOWER("Instructions") LIKE '%somnolence%' OR LOWER("Instructions") LIKE '%migraine%' OR LOWER("Instructions") LIKE '%restless%' OR ("Instructions") LIKE '%CPAP %' OR ("Instructions") LIKE '%PAP%' OR ("Instructions") LIKE '%BiPAP%' OR LOWER("Instructions") LIKE '%circadian%' OR LOWER("Instructions") LIKE '%hypercapnia%' OR LOWER("Instructions") LIKE '%hypercapneic%' OR ("Instructions") LIKE '%HSAT%' OR ("Instructions") LIKE '%HCT%' OR ("Instructions") LIKE '%HGB%' OR LOWER("Instructions") LIKE '%parasomnia%' OR LOWER("Instructions") LIKE '%obesity%' OR "Sleep Medicine referral" = 'Yes';

prompt: All positive cultures with Mycobacterium as the genus and Non-tuberculous Mycobacteria since 1/1/2011.
completion: WITH CTE AS (SELECT DISTINCT LR_MRN AS MRN, LR_ACCESSION_NO AS ACCESSION_NO, LR_PERFORMED_DTE AS PERFORMED_DTE FROM IDB.LAB_RESULTS LEFT JOIN IDB.LAB_TEXT_LINE ON LTL_RESULT_GUID = LR_RESULT_GUID WHERE 1=1 AND LR_TEST_NAME = 'Mycobacterial (AFB) Culture' AND UPPER(LR_SUBTEST_NAME) LIKE '%CULTURE%' AND UPPER(LTL_TEXT_RESULT) NOT LIKE '%CULTURE NEGATIVE%' AND LR_PERFORMED_DTE BETWEEN '2011-01-01' AND '2021-08-06' ) SELECT LR_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, LR_PERFORMED_DTE, LR_ACCESSION_NO, LR_TEST_NAME, LR_SUBTEST_NAME, LR_RESULT_VALUE, LTL_TEXT_RESULT, LTL_LINE_NO, LR_ABNORMALITY_CD, LR_CL_VISIT_GUID FROM IDB.LAB_RESULTS JOIN CTE ON LR_ACCESSION_NO = ACCESSION_NO AND LR_MRN = MRN JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON LR_MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.LAB_TEXT_LINE ON LTL_RESULT_GUID = LR_RESULT_GUID WHERE LR_TEST_NAME = 'Mycobacterial (AFB) Culture'

prompt: Generate usage metrics for ePath orderset in CIS that was created last spring, and compared to individual biopsy orders over a similar period of 2 years.
completion: SELECT DISTINCT OO_MRN, OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE, OO_ENTER_DTE, OO_ORD_NAME, OO_SET_NAME, OO_SET_TYPE, OO_REQUESTED_DTE FROM IDB.OMS_ORDER JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_USER_DATA ON OO_MRN = OUD_MRN AND OO_ORD_GUID = OUD_ORD_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_FORM_FIELD ON OUD_USER_DI_CD = OFF_DI_CD AND OO_ENTRY_FRM_GUID = OFF_ENTRY_FRM_GUID WHERE OO_ORD_NAME IN ('Surgical Pathology Order') AND LOWER(OO_SET_NAME) like '%epath%' AND OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE >= '2022-01-01' ORDER BY OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE DESC ; SELECT DISTINCT OO_MRN, OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE, OO_ENTER_DTE, OO_ORD_NAME, OO_SET_NAME, OO_SET_TYPE, OO_REQUESTED_DTE FROM IDB.OMS_ORDER JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_USER_DATA ON OO_MRN = OUD_MRN AND OO_ORD_GUID = OUD_ORD_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_FORM_FIELD ON OUD_USER_DI_CD = OFF_DI_CD AND OO_ENTRY_FRM_GUID = OFF_ENTRY_FRM_GUID WHERE OO_ORD_NAME IN ('Surgical Pathology Order') AND LOWER(OO_SET_NAME) NOT like '%epath%' AND OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE >= '2022-01-01' ORDER BY OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE DESC ; SELECT DISTINCT OO_MRN, OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE, OO_ENTER_DTE, OO_ORD_NAME, OO_SET_NAME, OO_SET_TYPE, OO_REQUESTED_DTE FROM IDB.OMS_ORDER JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_USER_DATA ON OO_MRN = OUD_MRN AND OO_ORD_GUID = OUD_ORD_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_FORM_FIELD ON OUD_USER_DI_CD = OFF_DI_CD AND OO_ENTRY_FRM_GUID = OFF_ENTRY_FRM_GUID WHERE UPPER(OO_ORD_NAME) LIKE ('CYTOLOGY%NON%') AND LOWER(OO_SET_NAME) like '%epath%' AND OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE >= '2022-01-01' ; SELECT DISTINCT OO_MRN, OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE, OO_ENTER_DTE, OO_ORD_NAME, OO_SET_NAME, OO_SET_TYPE, OO_REQUESTED_DTE FROM IDB.OMS_ORDER JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_USER_DATA ON OO_MRN = OUD_MRN AND OO_ORD_GUID = OUD_ORD_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_FORM_FIELD ON OUD_USER_DI_CD = OFF_DI_CD AND OO_ENTRY_FRM_GUID = OFF_ENTRY_FRM_GUID WHERE UPPER(OO_ORD_NAME) LIKE ('CYTOLOGY%NON%') AND LOWER(OO_SET_NAME) not like '%epath%' AND OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE >= '2022-01-01'

prompt: List of patients who are enrolled in 15-147 who are also on the "Do Not Contact" list.
completion: SELECT AC_MRN, PT_EMAIL_ADDRESS, AC_LAST_NAME, AC_FIRST_NAME FROM IDB.PROTOCOL JOIN IDB.ACCRUALS ON PRO_IRB_NO = AC_IRB_NO JOIN IDB.ACCRUALS_DATES ON AC_IRB_NO = ACD_IRB_NO AND AC_SUBJ_ID_NO = ACD_SUBJ_ID_NO AND AC_SUBJ_SEQ_NO = ACD_SUBJ_SEQ_NO JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTV_DTL ON AC_MRN = LAD_MRN JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY ON AC_MRN = PLA_MRN JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON AC_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE PRO_IRB_NO = '15-147' AND LAD_DONOT_CON_IND <> 'Y' AND PLA_DONOT_MAIL_IND <> 'Y'

prompt: Provide clinical and demographic characteristics of patients previously identified with small cell lung cancer who have undergone path review/IHC for molecular subtyping.
SEER categories for neoplasm ICD-10 diagnosis codes
completion: SELECT CLM_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK, S.* FROM IDB.CLM JOIN IDB.SEERGROUPING S ON CLM_CLSF_RECODE = RECODE WHERE CLM_CLSF_TYPE = 'I0' AND CATEGORY1 NOT IN ('Invalid', 'Non-Cancer') ORDER BY 1

prompt: Provide a weekly notification of biliary tract cancer patients with specific mutations from IMPACT and are receiving platinum therapy.
completion: WITH STRUCTURED AS (SELECT DISTINCT A.PT_MRN, PRPT_PATH_RPT_ID AS R_ID, A.PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID AS P_ID FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_STRUCTURED_RESULTS_V A JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS B ON A.PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = B.PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID WHERE 1=1 AND ((GENE IN ('ATM', 'ATR', 'CHEK2', 'BRCA1', 'BRCA2', 'RAD51', 'BRIP1', 'PALB2', 'PTEN', 'FANC', 'NBN', 'EMSY', 'MRE11', 'ARID1A') OR GENE2 IN ('ATM', 'ATR', 'CHEK2', 'BRCA1', 'BRCA2', 'RAD51', 'BRIP1', 'PALB2', 'PTEN', 'FANC', 'NBN', 'EMSY', 'MRE11', 'ARID1A'))) AND PT_VITAL_STATUS = 'ALIVE' AND METHOD like 'IMPACT%' AND METHOD NOT like 'IMPACT-HEM%' ) , MED_INFO AS (SELECT * FROM IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX_V MED JOIN STRUCTURED ON PT_MRN = APR_MRN WHERE CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME IN ('OXALIPLATIN', 'CISPLATIN') AND APR_START_DTE >= CURRENT date - 30 DAYS ) , DMP_ATTRIBUTES AS (SELECT DISTINCT PDRX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID , PDRX_DMP_PATIENT_ID, PDRX_DMP_SAMPLE_ID , R_ID , T.* FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML DT CROSS JOIN XMLTABLE('$c/root/*' PASSING DT.PDRX_XML_VALUE AS "c" COLUMNS PRIMARY_SITE VARCHAR(264) PATH '../meta-data/primary_site', TUMOR_TYPE_NAME VARCHAR(264) PATH '../meta-data/tumor_type_name' , METASTASIS_SITE VARCHAR(264) PATH '../meta-data/metastasis_site' , M_ACCESSION_NUM VARCHAR(264) PATH '../meta-data/m_accession_num' , GENE_PANEL VARCHAR(264) PATH '../meta-data/gene-panel' , PART_DESCRIPTION VARCHAR(264) PATH '../meta-data/part_description' , TUMOR_TYPE_CODE VARCHAR(264) PATH 'tumor_type_code') T JOIN (SELECT T.TUMOR_TYPE_CODE TTC FROM TABLE(DV.STRING_SPLIT('BILIARY_TRACT', ',')) S CROSS JOIN TABLE(DV.ONCOTREE_CHILDREN(COLUMN_VALUES)) T) X ON T.TUMOR_TYPE_CODE = X.TTC JOIN MED_INFO ON R_ID = PDRX_PATH_RPT_ID ) SELECT * FROM DMP_ATTRIBUTES ORDER BY R_ID, PDRX_DMP_SAMPLE_ID ;

prompt: Provide additional revision procedures with implant breast reconstruction patients for a fat grafting study.
completion: SELECT DISTINCT PBD_MRN AS MRN, CLM_CLSF_CD AS CPT_CODE, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS CPT_DESC, PBC_PBD_DESC AS PBD_DESC, PBD_SVC_DTE AS SVC_DATE FROM IDB.PBD_DTL JOIN IDB.PBD_CODE ON PBD_PBD_CD = PBC_PBD_CD JOIN IDB.CLM ON PBC_CPT_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE PBC_CPT_CD IN ('15769', '15771', '15772', '15773', '15774', '15877', '20926') AND PBD_MRN IN ()

prompt: Provide a list of orthopedic surgery patients who had an encounter at the 53rd St. Clinic and the Main Hospital Clinic with Dr. Maksim Vaynrub and Dr. Meredith Bartelstein between October 1, 2022, and January 6, 2023.
completion: SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN , CL_LAST_NAME, CL_FIRST_NAME, CPE_ENC_DTE , CPE_CPE_IP_IND, CL_DATE_OF_BIRTH, CL_DEATH_IND, A.CLD_CLD_CENTER AS SITE, A.CLD_DEPT_NAME, B.CRE_RES_NAME, CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME, CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR , CPE_ENC_CSN_ID FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT A ON CPE_DEPT_ID = A.CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE B ON B.CRE_RES_ID = CPE_VST_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID JOIN IDB.CL_PATIENT ON CPE_PRK = CL_PRK WHERE 1=1 AND CPE_VST_RES_ID IN ('023192', '025932') AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN '2022-10-22' AND '2023-01-06' AND CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Comp', 'Arrived') AND A.CLD_CLD_CENTER IN ('MAIN', '53RD')

prompt: List of NV/IR appointments scheduled under Hepatobiliary, STGI and Rad Onc Services of patients diagnosed with pancreatic cancer
completion: WITH APPTS AS (SELECT CPE_MRN AS "MRN", CPE_ENC_DTE AS "Appt Date", CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 AS "Department", CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 AS "Service", CLD_DEPT_NAME AS "Department Name", CRE_RES_NAME AS "Provider Name", CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME AS "Visit Type", CPE_CL_PT_ID, CPE_ENC_DTE_SEQ, CPE_PRK FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE (CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Sch') AND (CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR LIKE '%NV%' OR CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR LIKE '%IR%') AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT date AND CURRENT date + 7 DAYS AND ((CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 = 'MED' AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 = 'GI') OR (CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 = 'RDO' AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 = 'RDO') OR (CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 = 'SRG' AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 = 'HEP')) ) ) , DX AS (SELECT CC_MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS MIN_ICD_EFF_DTE, CC_CLSF_CD AS ICD_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS ICD_DESC FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE SUBSTR(CC_CLSF_CD, 1, 3) IN ('157', 'C25') AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' GROUP BY CC_MRN, CC_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK ) , NOTES AS (SELECT CPAN_CL_PT_ID, CPAN_ENC_DTE_SEQ, CPAN_PRK, CPAN_MRN, MAX(CPAN_ENC_DTE) AS NOTES_DTE, CPAN_NOTE FROM APPTS JOIN IDB.CL_PT_APPT_NOTES ON CPAN_CL_PT_ID = CPE_CL_PT_ID AND CPAN_ENC_DTE_SEQ = CPE_ENC_DTE_SEQ AND (LOWER(CPAN_NOTE) LIKE '%pancreatic ca%' OR LOWER(CPAN_NOTE) LIKE '%pancreas ca%' OR LOWER(CPAN_NOTE) LIKE '%pancreas%' OR LOWER(CPAN_NOTE) LIKE '%pancreatic%') GROUP BY CPAN_CL_PT_ID, CPAN_ENC_DTE_SEQ, CPAN_PRK, CPAN_MRN, CPAN_NOTE) SELECT DISTINCT "MRN" , CPE_PRK , PT_LAST_NAME "PT Last Name" , PT_FIRST_NAME "PT First Name" , "Appt Date" , "Visit Type" , "Service" , "Provider Name" , MIN_ICD_EFF_DTE "Dx Date" , ICD_CD "ICD Dx Code" , ICD_DESC "ICD Dx Desc" , CPAN_NOTE "Appt Note" FROM APPTS JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON "MRN" = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN DX ON "MRN" = CC_MRN LEFT JOIN NOTES ON CPE_PRK = CPAN_PRK

prompt: Provide a list of patients diagnosed with DLBCL who were consented to IRB protocols 06-107, 09-141 or 12-245, and were initially treated with RCHOP or REPOCH since 2009.
completion: WITH LYM AS (SELECT DISTINCT TM_MRN AS MRN, TM_DX_DTE AS DX_DATE, TM_HIST_CD AS DX_CODE, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS DX_DESC FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.SEERGROUPING ON RECODE = IDB.SEERF_ICDO(TM_SITE_CD, TM_HIST_CD) AND CATEGORY1 = 'Lymphoma' JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD WHERE 1=1 AND TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND TM_HIST_CD IN ('M9679/3', 'M9680/3', 'M9681/3', 'M9688/3', 'M9714/3', 'M9738/3') UNION SELECT CC_MRN AS MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS DX_DATE, CLM_CLSF_CD AS DX_CODE, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS DX_DESC FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND ((CC_PT_TYPE = 'I') OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) AND CC_CLSF_CD IN ('C83.30', 'C83.31', 'C83.32', 'C83.33', 'C83.34', 'C83.35', 'C83.36', 'C83.37', 'C83.38', 'C83.39') GROUP BY CC_MRN, CLM_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK ) , CTE AS (SELECT MRN AS DX_MRN, DX_DATE, STRIP(DX_CODE) || '-' || STRIP(DX_DESC) AS DX_CODE FROM LYM) , CTE2 AS (SELECT * FROM CTE ORDER BY DX_MRN, DX_DATE, DX_CODE) , T1 AS (SELECT DX_MRN, DX_DATE, DX_CODE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY DX_MRN ORDER BY DX_DATE) AS RN FROM CTE2 ORDER BY DX_MRN, DX_DATE) , T2 (MRN, DX, RN1) AS (SELECT DX_MRN, CAST(DX_DATE AS VARCHAR(6000))||' | '||CAST(DX_CODE AS VARCHAR(100)), RN FROM T1 WHERE T1.RN = 1 UNION ALL SELECT DX_MRN, RTRIM(CAST(DX AS VARCHAR(4000))) || ', ' || CHR(13) || CHR(10) || CAST(DX_DATE AS VARCHAR(100))||' | '||RTRIM(CAST(DX_CODE AS VARCHAR(100))) , RN1 + 1 FROM T1, T2 WHERE DX_MRN = MRN AND RN = RN1+1 ) , T3 AS (SELECT MRN, MAX(RN1) RN FROM T2 GROUP BY MRN) , T4 AS (SELECT T2.MRN, RN, DX FROM T2 JOIN T3 ON T2.MRN = T3.MRN AND T2.RN1 = T3.RN) , APR AS (SELECT APR_MRN, APR_SET_NAME, MIN(APR_START_DTE) AS APR_START_DTE, MAX(APR_END_DTE) AS APR_END_DTE, APR_DIAGNOSIS_DESC FROM (SELECT APR_MRN, APR_SET_NAME, APR_GENERIC_NAME, APR_DRUG_NAME, APR_START_DTE, APR_END_DTE, APR_DIAGNOSIS_DESC FROM T4 JOIN IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX_V ON MRN = APR_MRN WHERE(UPPER(APR_SET_NAME) LIKE '%EPOCH%' OR UPPER(APR_SET_NAME) LIKE '%EPOCH%' OR UPPER(APR_SET_NAME) LIKE '%CHOP%' OR UPPER(APR_SET_NAME) LIKE '%CHOP%') AND APR_START_DTE BETWEEN '2009-01-01' AND CURRENT DATE UNION SELECT APR_MRN, APR_SET_NAME, APR_GENERIC_NAME, APR_DRUG_NAME, APR_START_DTE, APR_END_DTE, APR_DIAGNOSIS_DESC FROM IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX_V WHERE(UPPER(APR_SET_NAME) LIKE '%EPOCH%' OR UPPER(APR_SET_NAME) LIKE '%EPOCH%' OR UPPER(APR_SET_NAME) LIKE '%CHOP%' OR UPPER(APR_SET_NAME) LIKE '%CHOP%') AND APR_START_DTE BETWEEN '2009-01-01' AND CURRENT DATE AND(UPPER(APR_DIAGNOSIS_DESC) LIKE '%DIFFUSE%' OR UPPER(APR_DIAGNOSIS_DESC) LIKE '%DLBCL%' OR UPPER(APR_DIAGNOSIS_DESC) LIKE '%LARGE%B%CELL%')) CH GROUP BY APR_MRN, APR_SET_NAME, APR_DIAGNOSIS_DESC) , PRO AS (SELECT AC_MRN, MAX(CASE WHEN AC_IRB_NO = '06-107' THEN AC_CONS_DTE END) AS "06-107", MAX(CASE WHEN AC_IRB_NO = '09-141' THEN AC_CONS_DTE END) AS "09-141", MAX(CASE WHEN AC_IRB_NO = '12-245' THEN AC_CONS_DTE END) AS "12-245" FROM IDB.ACCRUALS WHERE AC_IRB_NO IN ('06-107', '09-141', '12-245') AND AC_MRN IN (SELECT APR_MRN FROM APR) GROUP BY AC_MRN ) SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN AS MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, DX, APR_SET_NAME, APR_START_DTE, APR_END_DTE, APR_DIAGNOSIS_DESC, "06-107", "09-141", "12-245" FROM IDB.PATIENT JOIN APR ON PT_MRN = APR_MRN LEFT JOIN T4 ON MRN = PT_MRN JOIN PRO ON PT_MRN = AC_MRN

completion: WITH PTS AS (SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN AS "MRN", PCC_CODE AS "CPT Code", PCC_DESC AS "CPT Desc", DT_DTE AS "Procedure Date" FROM DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V JOIN DV.CPT_PBD_PATIENT_PROCEDURE ON PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PTX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID JOIN DV.DATE ON PTX_PROC_DATE_ID = DT_DATE_ID WHERE PCC_CODE IN ('51596', '51590', '51595', '51575', '51570', '38770', '50220', '50230', '50236', '50240', '50543', '50545', '50548', '50650', '50780', '51565', '51590', '51595', '51596', '52000') ), CHEMO0 AS (SELECT DISTINCT APR_MRN, "Procedure Date" CHEMO_PROC_DTE, CHAR(APR_START_DTE) || ' - ' || TRIM(APR_GENERIC_NAME) CHEMO_NAME_DTE FROM PTS JOIN IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX ON MRN=APR_MRN WHERE APR_START_DTE BETWEEN "Procedure Date" - 180 DAYS AND "Procedure Date" ) , CHEMO AS (SELECT APR_MRN, CHEMO_PROC_DTE, LISTAGG(CHEMO_NAME_DTE, ' | ') WITHIN GROUP( ORDER BY CHEMO_NAME_DTE) CHEMO_NAMES FROM CHEMO0 GROUP BY APR_MRN, CHEMO_PROC_DTE) SELECT PRPT_MRN, "CPT Code", "CPT Desc", "Procedure Date", CHEMO_NAMES, PRPT_PROCEDURE_DTE "Path Procedure Date", PRPT_REPORT_TYPE_DESC "Path Report Type", PRPT_ACCESSION_NO "Path Accession Number", PRPT_ORD_DR_SVC "Path Ordering Doctor Service", PRPT_ORD_DR_SVC_DESC "Path Ordering Doctor Service Desc", PRPT_REPORT "Path Report", PRPT_DV_PROCESS_DTE "Path Modified Date" FROM PTS JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V ON MRN = PRPT_MRN AND PRPT_PROCEDURE_DTE BETWEEN "Procedure Date" - 1 MONTH AND "Procedure Date" + 1 MONTH LEFT JOIN CHEMO ON APR_MRN = MRN AND CHEMO_PROC_DTE = "Procedure Date" WHERE PRPT_REPORT IS NOT NULL AND PRPT_DV_PROCESS_DTE >= CURRENT date - 2 DAY ORDER BY 1, 4, 5 ;

prompt: List of all the total gastrectomy patient at MSK and their admissions and lengths of stay from 2019-2023 (PRESENT).
completion: WITH ADMISSION AS (SELECT SSE_MRN AS ADMISSION_MRN, SSE_SURG_DTE AS ADM_SURG_DTE, LISTAGG(COALESCE(STRIP(CAST(SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD AS VARCHAR(12000))), '')||' - '|| COALESCE(STRIP(CAST(SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC AS VARCHAR(12000))), '')|| ' | ', CHR(13) || CHR(10)) WITHIN GROUP ( ORDER BY SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD) AS ADM_SURG_DESC, VIS_ADM_DTE AS ADM_DTE, VIS_DSCH_DTE AS DSCH_DTE, VIS_DAYS_STAY AS DAYS_STAY FROM IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE ON SSE_LOG_ID = SSP_LOG_ID AND SSE_ENC_CSN_ID = SSP_ENC_CSN_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.VISIT_V ON VIS_MRN = SSE_MRN AND VIS_VISIT_STATUS IN ('2', '3') AND VIS_IP_OP_ADJUSTED_IND = 'I' AND VIS_ADM_DTE <= SSE_SURG_DTE AND COALESCE(VIS_DSCH_DTE, '2999-12-31') >= SSE_SURG_DTE WHERE (SSE_SURG_LOC not like '%IR%' AND SSE_SURG_LOC not like '%ENDO%' AND SSE_SOURCE_TYPE <> 'E') AND SSE_SURG_DTE >= '2019-01-01' AND SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD IN ('43620', '43621', '43622') GROUP BY SSE_MRN, SSE_SURG_DTE, VIS_ADM_DTE, VIS_DSCH_DTE, VIS_DAYS_STAY) , READMISSION AS (SELECT DISTINCT SSE_MRN AS READMISSION_MRN, SSE_SURG_DTE AS READM_SURG_DTE, COUNT(DISTINCT VIS_ADM_DTE) AS READMISSION_COUNT FROM IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE ON SSE_LOG_ID = SSP_LOG_ID AND SSE_ENC_CSN_ID = SSP_ENC_CSN_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.VISIT_V ON VIS_MRN = SSE_MRN AND VIS_VISIT_STATUS IN ('2', '3') AND VIS_ADM_DTE BETWEEN SSE_SURG_DTE + 1 DAY AND SSE_SURG_DTE + 1 YEAR WHERE (SSE_SURG_LOC NOT LIKE '%IR%' AND SSE_SURG_LOC NOT LIKE '%ENDO%' AND SSE_SOURCE_TYPE <> 'E') AND SSE_SURG_DTE >= '2019-01-01' AND SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD IN ('43620', '43621', '43622') GROUP BY SSE_MRN, SSE_SURG_DTE) SELECT DISTINCT ADMISSION_MRN AS MRN, ADM_SURG_DTE AS SURGERY_DTE, ADM_SURG_DESC AS SURGERY_DESC, ADM_DTE AS ADMISSION_DTE, DSCH_DTE AS DISCHARGE_DTE, DAYS_STAY, READMISSION_COUNT FROM ADMISSION LEFT JOIN READMISSION ON ADMISSION_MRN = READMISSION_MRN AND READM_SURG_DTE = ADM_SURG_DTE ORDER BY ADMISSION_MRN; WITH ADMISSION AS (SELECT SSE_MRN AS ADMISSION_MRN, SSE_SURG_DTE AS ADM_SURG_DTE, LISTAGG(COALESCE(STRIP(CAST(SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD AS VARCHAR(12000))), '')||' - '|| COALESCE(STRIP(CAST(SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC AS VARCHAR(12000))), '')|| ' | ', CHR(13) || CHR(10)) WITHIN GROUP ( ORDER BY SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD) AS ADM_SURG_DESC, VIS_ADM_DTE AS ADM_DTE, VIS_DSCH_DTE AS DSCH_DTE, VIS_DAYS_STAY AS DAYS_STAY FROM IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE ON SSE_LOG_ID = SSP_LOG_ID AND SSE_ENC_CSN_ID = SSP_ENC_CSN_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.VISIT_V ON VIS_MRN = SSE_MRN AND VIS_VISIT_STATUS IN ('2', '3') AND VIS_IP_OP_ADJUSTED_IND = 'I' AND VIS_ADM_DTE <= SSE_SURG_DTE AND COALESCE(VIS_DSCH_DTE, '2999-12-31') >= SSE_SURG_DTE WHERE (SSE_SURG_LOC not like '%IR%' AND SSE_SURG_LOC not like '%ENDO%' AND SSE_SOURCE_TYPE <> 'E') AND SSE_SURG_DTE >= '2019-01-01' AND SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD IN ('43620', '43621', '43622') GROUP BY SSE_MRN, SSE_SURG_DTE, VIS_ADM_DTE, VIS_DSCH_DTE, VIS_DAYS_STAY) , READMISSION AS (SELECT DISTINCT SSE_MRN AS READMISSION_MRN, SSE_SURG_DTE AS READM_SURG_DTE, VIS_ADM_DTE AS READMISSION_DATE FROM IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE ON SSE_LOG_ID = SSP_LOG_ID AND SSE_ENC_CSN_ID = SSP_ENC_CSN_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.VISIT_V ON VIS_MRN = SSE_MRN AND VIS_VISIT_STATUS IN ('2', '3') AND VIS_ADM_DTE BETWEEN SSE_SURG_DTE + 1 DAY AND SSE_SURG_DTE + 1 YEAR WHERE (SSE_SURG_LOC NOT LIKE '%IR%' AND SSE_SURG_LOC NOT LIKE '%ENDO%' AND SSE_SOURCE_TYPE <> 'E') AND SSE_SURG_DTE >= '2019-01-01' AND SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD IN ('43620', '43621', '43622') ) SELECT DISTINCT ADMISSION_MRN AS MRN, ADM_SURG_DTE AS SURGERY_DTE, ADM_DTE AS ADMISSION_DTE, READMISSION_DATE FROM ADMISSION LEFT JOIN READMISSION ON ADMISSION_MRN = READMISSION_MRN AND READM_SURG_DTE = ADM_SURG_DTE ORDER BY ADMISSION_MRN;

completion: WITH PTS AS (SELECT DISTINCT OO_MRN "MRN", OOC_ITEM_NAME "Exam", OO_PERFORMED_DTE "Date", OP_DISPLAY_NAME "Provider", LISTAGG(TRIM(OUD_USER_DI_CD) || ': ' || TRIM(OUD_USER_DI_VALUE), CHR(13) || CHR(10)) WITHIN GROUP( ORDER BY DATE(OO_PERFORMED_DTE)) AS FULL_TEXT FROM IDB.OMS_ORDER JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_CATALOG ON OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID = OOC_MSTR_ITEM_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_STATUS ON OO_ORD_STS_CD = OSTS_ORD_STS_CD LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_USER_DATA ON OUD_ORD_GUID = OO_ORD_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_PROVIDER ON OO_PVDR_GUID = OP_PVDR_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_USER_ORDERS ON OO_ORD_GUID = OUO_ORD_GUID JOIN IDB.LOCATION_GROUPS_REFERENCE ON OUO_CURR_LOC = LGR_LOC_NAME WHERE LGR_LOC_GRP = '1919 Madison' AND OOC_ITEM_NAME = 'BI' AND OO_ORD_STS_CD NOT IN ('CANP', 'CANC', 'AUC3', 'HOLD', 'SCHD') AND OO_PERFORMED_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT date - 15 DAYS AND CURRENT date - 2 DAYS GROUP BY OO_MRN, OOC_ITEM_NAME, OO_PERFORMED_DTE, OP_DISPLAY_NAME UNION ALL SELECT A.CDD_MRN "MRN", A.CDD_DOC_NAME "Exam", A.CDD_SERVICE_DTE "Date", OP_DISPLAY_NAME "Provider", CDD_DOCUMENT_FULL_TEXT AS FULL_TEXT FROM IDB.CD_DOCUMENT A JOIN DV.CLINDOC_FULL_TEXT_V B ON A.CDD_DOC_GUID = B.CDD_DOC_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_PROVIDER ON A.CDD_AUTH_PROV_GUID = OP_PVDR_GUID WHERE A.CDD_DOC_NAME IN ('History & Physical, Breast - RLC', 'History & Physical, Pelvic - RLC', 'Miscellaneous/Discussion Note, Amb-Breast Examination Center') AND A.CDD_CANCEL_IND <> '1' AND A.CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND <> '1' AND A.CDD_SERVICE_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT date - 15 DAYS AND CURRENT date - 2 DAYS ) SELECT "MRN", CASE WHEN "Exam" = 'BI' THEN 'Mammo' WHEN "Exam" = 'History & Physical, Pelvic - RLC' THEN 'Pap' WHEN "Exam" = 'History & Physical, Breast - RLC' THEN 'Clinical Exam' WHEN "Exam" = 'Miscellaneous/Discussion Note, Amb-Breast Examination Center' THEN 'Consultation' END AS "Appt Type", "Date", "Provider", FULL_TEXT "Results" FROM PTS ; WITH PTS AS (SELECT OO_MRN "MRN", OOC_ITEM_NAME "Exam", OO_PERFORMED_DTE "Date", OP_DISPLAY_NAME FROM IDB.OMS_ORDER JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_CATALOG ON OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID = OOC_MSTR_ITEM_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_STATUS ON OO_ORD_STS_CD = OSTS_ORD_STS_CD JOIN IDB.OMS_PROVIDER ON OO_PVDR_GUID = OP_PVDR_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_USER_ORDERS ON OO_ORD_GUID = OUO_ORD_GUID JOIN IDB.LOCATION_GROUPS_REFERENCE ON OUO_CURR_LOC = LGR_LOC_NAME WHERE LGR_LOC_GRP = '1919 Madison' AND OOC_ITEM_NAME = 'BI' AND OO_ORD_STS_CD NOT IN ('CANP', 'CANC', 'AUC3', 'HOLD', 'SCHD') AND OO_PERFORMED_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT date - 15 DAYS AND CURRENT date - 2 DAYS UNION ALL SELECT CDD_MRN "MRN", CDD_DOC_NAME "Exam", CDD_SERVICE_DTE "Date", OP_DISPLAY_NAME FROM IDB.CD_DOCUMENT JOIN IDB.OMS_PROVIDER ON CDD_AUTH_PROV_GUID = OP_PVDR_GUID WHERE CDD_DOC_NAME IN ('History & Physical, Breast - RLC', 'History & Physical, Pelvic - RLC', 'Miscellaneous/Discussion Note, Amb-Breast Examination Center') AND CDD_CANCEL_IND <> '1' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND <> '1' AND CDD_SERVICE_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT date - 15 DAYS AND CURRENT date - 2 DAYS ) SELECT MONTHNAME(CURRENT DATE - DAY(CURRENT DATE) DAYS + 1 DAY - 1 MONTH) "Month", OP_DISPLAY_NAME AS "Provider", COUNT(CASE WHEN "Exam" = 'BI' THEN 1 ELSE NULL END) AS "Mammo", COUNT(CASE WHEN "Exam" = 'History & Physical, Pelvic - RLC' THEN 1 ELSE NULL END) AS "Pap", COUNT(CASE WHEN "Exam" = 'History & Physical, Breast - RLC' THEN 1 ELSE NULL END) AS "Clinical Exam", COUNT(CASE WHEN "Exam" = 'Miscellaneous/Discussion Note, Amb-Breast Examination Center' THEN 1 ELSE NULL END) AS "Consultation" FROM PTS GROUP BY OP_DISPLAY_NAME UNION ALL SELECT MONTHNAME(CURRENT DATE - DAY(CURRENT DATE) DAYS + 1 DAY - 1 MONTH) "Month", 'Total' AS "Provider", COUNT(CASE WHEN "Exam" = 'BI' THEN 1 ELSE NULL END) AS "Mammo", COUNT(CASE WHEN "Exam" = 'History & Physical, Pelvic - RLC' THEN 1 ELSE NULL END) AS "Pap", COUNT(CASE WHEN "Exam" = 'History & Physical, Breast - RLC' THEN 1 ELSE NULL END) AS "Clinical Exam", COUNT(CASE WHEN "Exam" = 'Miscellaneous/Discussion Note, Amb-Breast Examination Center' THEN 1 ELSE NULL END) AS "Consultation" FROM PTS ; SELECT CRE_RES_NAME "Provider Name", CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME "Visit Type", COUNT(*) "Count" FROM IDB.PATIENT JOIN IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER ON PT_MRN = CPE_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CLD_CLD_CENTER = '1919' AND CRE_RES_TYP = 'Nurse Practitioner' AND CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT date - 15 DAYS AND CURRENT date - 2 DAYS GROUP BY CRE_RES_NAME, CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME ;

completion: SELECT APR_LOCATION AS LOCATION, ANP_YEAR, COUNT(1) AS COUNTS FROM (SELECT APR_MRN, APR_START_DTE, APR_DRUG_NAME, APR_GENERIC_NAME, APR_LOCATION, APR_DOC_SVC, APR_ROUTE, YEAR(APR_START_DTE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) AS AGE , YEAR(APR_START_DTE) AS ANP_YEAR , APR_VISIT_GUID , APR_ORDER_SOURCE, APR_ORDER_SOURCE_ID, APR_DRUG_PROCESS_STAGE, APR_SET_GUID FROM IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON APR_MRN = PT_MRN AND YEAR(APR_START_DTE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) >=18 WHERE 1=1 AND APR_LOCATION IN ('M4', 'M5', 'M7', 'M8', 'M10', 'M11', 'M12', 'M14', 'M15', 'M16', 'M17', 'M18', 'M19' , 'Koch Inpatient 5', 'UCC Clinical Decision Unit', 'UCC Observation.', 'UCC 1275', 'UCC Ambulatory', 'M2 IR Waiting Room', 'M2A', 'M2C', 'M2D', 'M2E' ) AND APR_START_DTE >= '2022-01-01' AND NOT UPPER(APR_DRUG_NAME) LIKE '%INVEST%' AND APR_ROUTE IN ('IM', 'injection', 'IV push', 'IVCI', 'IVPB', 'IVPB', 'Subcutaneous', 'HAI', 'intraperitoneal') ) GROUP BY APR_LOCATION, ANP_YEAR

prompt: Number of NV/IR Patients in  GMT, HNS, MEL service where the referring provider is part of DER service
completion: WITH DERM AS (SELECT DISTINCT CRE_RES_ID RES_ID, CRE_RES_NAME REF_PROVIDER_NAME, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 REF_PROVIDER_SERVICE FROM IDB.CL_DEPT JOIN IDB.CL_RES_DEPT ON CPD_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPD_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID WHERE CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 = 'DER' AND CRE_RES_TYP IN ('Physician') ) SELECT CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 AS "Service", COUNT(DISTINCT CPE_MRN) NUMBER_OF_PT FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID JOIN IDB.CL_PAS_PATIENT ON CPE_CL_PT_ID = CPP_CL_PT_ID JOIN DERM ON CPE_REF_RES_ID = RES_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 IN ('GMT', 'HNS', 'MEL') AND (CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR LIKE '%NV%' OR CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR LIKE '%IR%') AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN '2023-01-01' AND '2023-09-30' GROUP BY CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 ; WITH DERM AS (SELECT DISTINCT CRE_RES_ID RES_ID, CRE_RES_NAME REF_PROVIDER_NAME, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 REF_PROVIDER_SERVICE FROM IDB.CL_DEPT JOIN IDB.CL_RES_DEPT ON CPD_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPD_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID WHERE CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 = 'DER' AND CRE_RES_TYP IN ('Physician') ) SELECT CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 AS "Service", COUNT(DISTINCT CPE_MRN) NUMBER_OF_PT FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID JOIN IDB.CL_PAS_PATIENT ON CPE_CL_PT_ID = CPP_CL_PT_ID JOIN DERM ON CPE_REF_RES_ID = RES_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 IN ('GMT', 'HNS', 'MEL') AND (CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR LIKE '%NV%' OR CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR LIKE '%IR%') AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN '2023-01-01' AND '2023-10-31' GROUP BY CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 ;

prompt: Provide a daily list of patients who have completed a primary surgery for breast cancer in the last 6 months and are beginning adjuvant chemotherapy
completion: WITH X AS (SELECT DISTINCT OC_MRN, OC_SURG_LOC_ID, LOC_LOC_NAME, OC_SURG_DTE, SUBSTR(MD.CRE_RES_NAME, 1, 35) SURGEON, OP_PROC_NAME OR_PROC_NAME, CPX_PROC_CD CPT, CPX_PROC_NAME CPT_DESC FROM IDB.OR_CASE JOIN IDB.OR_CASE_ALL_PROC ON OC_CASE_ID = OCAP_CASE_ID JOIN IDB.OR_CASE_ALL_SURG ON OCAP_CASE_ID = OCAS_CASE_ID AND OCAS_PNL_NO = OCAP_PNL_NO AND OCAS_SURG_ROLE = 'Primary' JOIN IDB.OR_PROC ON OCAP_OR_PROC_ID = OP_OR_PROC_ID JOIN IDB.OR_CL_PROC ON OP_OR_PROC_ID = OCP_OR_PROC_ID JOIN IDB.CL_PROC ON OCP_PROC_ID = CPX_PROC_ID JOIN IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER ON OC_MRN = CPE_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE MD ON OCAS_RES_ID = MD.CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE V ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = V.CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_LOCATION ON OC_SURG_LOC_ID = LOC_LOC_ID WHERE OC_OR_CASE_STS = 'Comp' AND OC_SURG_SVC = 'BRE' AND OC_SURG_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT_DATE- 6 MONTHS AND CURRENT_DATE ), DRUG AS (SELECT DISTINCT CAO_MRN, OC_SURG_DTE SURGERY_DATE, CAO_START_DTE DRUG_START_DATE, CAO_ORD_NAME, CAO_DRUG_NAME, CAO_ORD_STS, CAO_STS_DESC FROM X LEFT JOIN IDB.CHEMO_ALL_ORDERS V ON OC_MRN = CAO_MRN WHERE CAO_START_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT date AND CURRENT date + 7 DAYS AND CAO_ORD_STS NOT IN ('DISC', 'AUA2', 'CANC', 'CANP') AND CAO_CHEMO_IND = 'Y' AND CAO_GENERIC_NAME IN ('CARBOPLATIN', 'CYCLOPHOSPHAMIDE', 'DOXORUBICIN', 'DOXORUBICIN LIPOSOMAL', 'PACLITAXEL', 'METHOTREXATE', 'FLUOROURACIL', 'LETROZOLE', 'ANASTROZOLE', 'EXEMESTANE', 'LEUPROLIDE', 'ABEMACICLIB', 'TAMOXIFEN') ), EXCLUSION AS (SELECT DISTINCT CAO_MRN FROM IDB.CHEMO_ALL_ORDERS WHERE CAO_START_DTE <= CURRENT_DATE AND CAO_GENERIC_NAME IN ('CARBOPLATIN', 'CYCLOPHOSPHAMIDE', 'DOXORUBICIN', 'DOXORUBICIN LIPOSOMAL', 'PACLITAXEL', 'METHOTREXATE', 'FLUOROURACIL', 'LETROZOLE', 'ANASTROZOLE', 'EXEMESTANE', 'LEUPROLIDE', 'ABEMACICLIB', 'TAMOXIFEN') ) , APPT AS (SELECT CPE_MRN AS "NA_MRN", MIN(CPE_ENC_DTE) AS "Next LAB Appt Date" FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Sch') AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 = 'LAB' GROUP BY CPE_MRN) SELECT DISTINCT CAO_MRN MRN, SURGERY_DATE, DRUG_START_DATE, CAO_ORD_NAME, CAO_DRUG_NAME, CAO_ORD_STS, CAO_STS_DESC , "Next LAB Appt Date" FROM DRUG LEFT JOIN APPT ON CAO_MRN ="NA_MRN" WHERE CAO_MRN NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT CAO_MRN FROM EXCLUSION)

prompt: Provide data on patients with neoadjuvant chemotherapy for pancreatic carcinoma.
completion: WITH "cte1" AS (SELECT * FROM DV.ENCOUNTER_SCHD_RESOURCES WHERE ENSR_PRIMARY_RES_IND = 'Y' ), "cte2" AS (SELECT EDC_DEPT_DESC, EDC_DEPT_ABBREV FROM DV.ENCOUNTER_DESC_CATALOG WHERE EDC_GROUP_ID = '8' ), "cte3" AS (SELECT EDC_DEPT_ABBREV, EDC_DEPT_DESC FROM DV.ENCOUNTER_DESC_CATALOG WHERE EDC_GROUP_ID = 'STS' ) SELECT DISTINCT "t1"."PT_MRN" AS "MRN", "t2"."ICSC_SITE_CD" AS "ICD-O Site Code", "t2"."ICSC_ICDO_SITE_MSK_DESC" AS "ICD-O Site Description", "t3"."TCLSA_CLIN_TNM_T" AS "Clinical Tumor", "t3"."TCLSA_CLIN_TNM_M" AS "Clinical Metastases", "t4"."PINC_GENERIC_NAME" AS "Generic Drug Name", "t4"."PINC_CHEMO_IND" AS "Chemo Indicator", "t5"."ENDP_SERVICE_SPECIALTY_GRP_8" AS "Clinical Service (Group 8)", "t6"."EDC_DEPT_DESC" AS "Clinical Service Desc (Group 8)", CASE WHEN "t7"."EDC_DEPT_DESC"IN ('Arrived', 'Completed') THEN 'Completed' WHEN "t7"."EDC_DEPT_DESC" IN ('Scheduled') THEN 'Scheduled' ELSE 'Non-Completed/Scheduled' END AS "Completed/Scheduled Indicator" FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V" "t1" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED" "t8" ON "t1"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t8"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."CDB_TUMOR_V" "t9" ON "t8"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t9"."CDTM_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."ICDO_SITE_CATALOG_V" "t2" ON "t9"."CDTM_SITE_CATALOG_ID" = "t2"."ICSC_SITE_CATALOG_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."TUMOR_CLINICAL_STAGE_ATTRIBUTES_V" "t3" ON "t9"."CDTM_CLINICAL_STAGE_ATTR_ID" = "t3"."TCLSA_TM_CLIN_STAGE_ATTR_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PHM_PT_MEDS_MQT" "t10" ON "t8"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t10"."POD_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PHM_ORDER_DTL" "t11" ON "t10"."POD_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t11"."POD_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AND "t10"."POD_PHARMA_INVENTORY_CTLG_ID" = "t11"."POD_PHARMA_INVENTORY_CTLG_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PHM_INVENTORY_CATALOG" "t4" ON "t11"."POD_PHARMA_INVENTORY_CTLG_ID" = "t4"."PINC_INVENTORY_CTLG_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_ENCOUNTER" "t12" ON "t8"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t12"."PENC_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."ENCOUNTER_DEPARTMENT" "t5" ON "t12"."PENC_DEPT_ID" = "t5"."ENDP_ENC_DEPT_ID" LEFT JOIN "cte1" "t13" ON "t12"."PENC_PT_ENC_ID" = "t13"."ENSR_PT_ENC_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."ENCOUNTER_DEPARTMENT" "t14" ON "t13"."ENSR_DEPT_ID" = "t14"."ENDP_ENC_DEPT_ID" LEFT JOIN "cte2" "t6" ON "t14"."ENDP_SERVICE_SPECIALTY_GRP_8" = "t6"."EDC_DEPT_ABBREV" LEFT JOIN "cte3" "t7" ON "t12"."PENC_APPT_STS" = "t7"."EDC_DEPT_ABBREV" WHERE ("t2"."ICSC_SITE_CD" IN ('C250', 'C251', 'C252', 'C253', 'C254', 'C257', 'C258', 'C259') AND ("t3"."TCLSA_CLIN_TNM_T" IN ('T4', 'T4A', 'T4B', 'T4C', 'T4D') AND ("t3"."TCLSA_CLIN_TNM_M" NOT IN ('M1', 'M1A', 'M1B', 'M1C') AND ("t4"."PINC_CHEMO_IND" = 'Y' AND ("t5"."ENDP_SERVICE_SPECIALTY_GRP_8" = 'HEP' AND (CASE WHEN "t7"."EDC_DEPT_DESC"IN ('Arrived', 'Completed') THEN 'Completed' WHEN "t7"."EDC_DEPT_DESC" IN ('Scheduled') THEN 'Scheduled' ELSE 'Non-Completed/Scheduled' END = 'Completed' AND UPPER("t4"."PINC_GENERIC_NAME") IN ('IRINOTECAN HCL', 'IRINOTECAN')))))))

prompt: Provide all details on the Toxicity Grading ClinDoc for all Adverse Events for patients enrolled in IRB #15-178.
completion: WITH ETO AS (SELECT AC_IRB_NO IRB_NO, ACD_MRN MRN, STRIP(AC_LAST_NAME)||', '||AC_FIRST_NAME PT_NAME, AC_DOB, AC_RACE, AC_SEX, ACD_CONS_DTE, ACD_OFF_STUDY_DTE FROM IDB.ACCRUALS_DATES JOIN IDB.ACCRUALS ON AC_IRB_NO = ACD_IRB_NO AND AC_MRN = ACD_MRN AND AC_MRN > '' WHERE ACD_IRB_NO IN('15-178', '15-093') ) SELECT IRB_NO, MRN, PT_NAME, CDD_DOC_GUID, CDD_DOC_NAME DOCUMENT_NAME, CDD_SERVICE_DTE SERVICE_DTE, CDO_ITEM_NAME ITEM_NAME, SUBSTR(CDO_VALUE_TEXT, 1, 100) VALUE_TXT FROM IDB.CD_DOCUMENT JOIN ETO ON MRN = CDD_MRN JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION ON CDD_DOC_GUID = CDO_DOC_GUID WHERE CDD_DOC_NAME IN ('Toxicity Grading', 'Toxicity Grading - Rad Onc', 'Toxicity Summary-Breast Medicine') AND CDD_CANCEL_IND = 0 AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND = 0 AND CDO_ITEM_NAME NOT IN ('Your role:', 'ATTESTATION_Document is ready to be finalized.', 'ATTESTATION Document is ready to be finalized.', 'Protocol Section: Please select CTCAE Version') ORDER BY CDD_MRN, CDD_DOC_GUID, CDO_ITEM_SEQ

prompt: Provide number of "00-032 Gastric, G/E Junction" research blood orders that were entered from the Order Set "GMT_Dispo_Research_Labs" over the last 6 months
completion: SELECT SET_NAME, ORD_NAME, MON, WK, COUNT(OO_ORD_GUID) CNT FROM (SELECT DISTINCT OO_MRN , OO_ENTER_DTE , CASE WHEN MONTH(OO_ENTER_DTE) = 1 THEN 'JAN' WHEN MONTH(OO_ENTER_DTE) = 2 THEN 'FEB' WHEN MONTH(OO_ENTER_DTE) = 3 THEN 'MAR' WHEN MONTH(OO_ENTER_DTE) = 4 THEN 'APR' WHEN MONTH(OO_ENTER_DTE) = 5 THEN 'MAY' WHEN MONTH(OO_ENTER_DTE) = 6 THEN 'JUN' WHEN MONTH(OO_ENTER_DTE) = 7 THEN 'JUL' WHEN MONTH(OO_ENTER_DTE) = 8 THEN 'AUG' WHEN MONTH(OO_ENTER_DTE) = 9 THEN 'SEP' WHEN MONTH(OO_ENTER_DTE) = 10 THEN 'OCT' WHEN MONTH(OO_ENTER_DTE) = 11 THEN 'NOV' WHEN MONTH(OO_ENTER_DTE) = 12 THEN 'DEC' END MON, WEEK(OO_ENTER_DTE) WK, OO_ORD_GUID, OO_ORD_NAME ORD_NAME, OO_ORD_ID, OO_SET_NAME SET_NAME, OO_SET_GUID, OO_ORD_STS_CD , OO_SUMMARY_LINE FROM IDB.OMS_ORDER WHERE OO_SET_NAME = 'GMT_Dispo_Research_Labs' AND OO_ENTER_DTE >= '2012-01-01' AND (OO_ORD_STS_CD NOT LIKE 'CA%' AND OO_ORD_STS_CD NOT IN ('PEND', 'HOLD')) ) A GROUP BY SET_NAME, ORD_NAME, MON, WK

prompt: A list of H-case numbers with "TET2" AND "ZRSR2" AND ("myeloid neoplasms" OR "MDS" OR "MPN" OR "MDS/MPN" OR "CMML" OR "AML") mentioned in report text from 01/01/2013 to present.
completion: SELECT DISTINCT DMP.PRPT_MRN AS MRN , PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_BIRTH_DTE, PT_VITAL_STATUS, PT_DEATH_DTE , CASE WHEN PT_DEATH_DTE IS NULL THEN YEAR(CURRENT date - PT_BIRTH_DTE) END AS "Current Age" , DMP.PRPT_ACCESSION_NO AS "Accession No" , DMP.PRPT_REPORT_DTE AS "Report Date" , DMP.PRPT_PROCEDURE_DTE AS "Procedure Date" , SRG.PRPT_ACCESSION_NO AS RELATED_ACC_NO , SRG_DATE.DT_DTE AS RELATED_PROC_DTE , DMP.PRPT_REPORT_TYPE_DESC AS "Report Type" , DMP.PRPT_REPORT_TYPE , DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)diag[\w\W]*(?=I ATTEST)', DMP.PRPT_REPORT) AS DIAGNOSIS_TEXT , VARCHAR(DMP.PRPT_REPORT, 32000) AS "Report Text (first 32000 characters)" , (SELECT VARCHAR(PRPT_REPORT, 32000) AS REFERENCEDPATHTEXTFROM FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT WHERE PRPT_ACCESSION_NO = SRG.PRPT_ACCESSION_NO) AS REFERENCEDPATHTEXT FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V DMP LEFT JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_REFERENCES ON PRPTR_CHILD_PATH_RPT_ID = DMP.PRPT_PATH_RPT_ID LEFT JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT SRG ON SRG.PRPT_PATH_RPT_ID = PRPTR_PATH_RPT_ID LEFT JOIN DV.DATE_V SRG_DATE ON SRG_DATE.DT_DATE_ID = SRG.PRPT_PROCEDURE_DATE_ID JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = DMP.PRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID WHERE 1=1 AND DMP.PRPT_ACCESSION_NO like 'H%' AND (DMP.PRPT_REPORT_DTE >= '01/01/2013' OR DMP.PRPT_PROCEDURE_DTE >= '01/01/2013' ) AND CONTAINS(DMP.PRPT_REPORT, '("TET2" AND "ZRSR2" AND ("myeloid neoplasms" OR "MDS" OR "MPN" OR "MDS/MPN" OR "CMML" OR "AML"))') = 1 AND DMP.PRPT_REPORT IS NOT NULL ORDER BY 1, 9, 8 ;

prompt: Provide demographic and treatment details for patients of interest from prior cohort of bladder cancer brain metastasis patients
completion: WITH X AS (SELECT PT_MRN AS MRN, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH AS DOB, PT_DATE_OF_DEATH AS DOD, PT_SEX AS GENDER, R.AV_DESC AS "Race", E.AV_DESC AS "Ethnicity", CATEGORY2, SITE_CODE, SITE_DESC, HIST_CODE, HIST_DESC, DX_DATE FROM IDB.PATIENT LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS R ON PT_RACE = R.AV_CODE AND R.AV_ELEMENT = 'RACE' LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS E ON PT_PT_ETHNICITY = E.AV_CODE AND E.AV_ELEMENT = 'PT_ETHNICITY' LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT TM_MRN, TM_DX_DTE AS DX_DATE, CATEGORY2, TM_HIST_CD AS HIST_CODE, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS HIST_DESC, TM_SITE_CD AS SITE_CODE, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_DESC FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.SEERGROUPING ON RECODE = DV.SEERF_ICDO(TM_SITE_CD, TM_HIST_CD) JOIN IDB.CLM H ON TM_HIST_CD = H.CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON TM_SITE_CD = S.CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') ) CDB ON PT_MRN = TM_MRN WHERE PT_MRN IN () ) , APR AS (SELECT DISTINCT APR_MRN, CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME, APR_START_DTE, APR_END_DTE, APR_ORD_RX_TYPE FROM IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX_V JOIN X ON APR_MRN = MRN WHERE CDG_CHEMO_FLAG = 'Y' ) , RT AS (SELECT DISTINCT RTC_TX_MRN, RTC_TX_PLAN_NAME, RTC_PRIMARY_REF_POINT, RTC_TX_START_DTE, RTC_TX_STOP_DTE, RTC_TX_ELAPSED_DAYS, RTC_TX_PLANNED_FRACTIONS, RTC_TX_DELIVERED_FRACTIONS, RTC_TX_PLANNED_DOSE, RTC_TX_DELIVERED_DOSE, RTC_DOSE_CORRECTION FROM IDB.RADONC_TREATMENT_COURSE JOIN X ON RTC_TX_MRN = MRN) , SRG AS (SELECT DISTINCT SSE_MRN, SSE_SURG_DTE, SSP_SURG_SVC_CD, SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD, SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC FROM IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE ON SSE_LOG_ID = SSP_LOG_ID JOIN X ON SSE_MRN = MRN WHERE 1=1 ) , CPE AS (SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN AS MRN, CPE_ENC_DTE, CRE_RES_NAME, CRE_RES_TYP, CLD_DEPT_NAME, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8, CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN X ON CPE_MRN = MRN JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CRE_RES_TYP IN ('Physician') AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 = 'NRS' ) SELECT * FROM CPE

prompt: Determine the number of patients who initially came in with a diagnosis of cancer of unknown primary last year.
completion: SELECT COUNT(PLA_MRN) FROM IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY WHERE PLA_INITIAL_DX_DTE BETWEEN '2009-01-01' AND '2009-12-31' AND PLA_INITIAL_DX_CAT = 'Unknown Sites'

prompt: Patient initially diagnosed with stage IV colon and rectal cancer seen between 01.01.2008 to 12.31.2017.
completion: WITH DIAG AS (SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN MRN, PT_LAST_NAME "Last Name", PT_FIRST_NAME "First Name", PLA_LST_APPT_DTE "Last Appt Date", PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH "Date of Birth", PT_DATE_OF_DEATH "Date of Death", TM_DX_DTE "Tumor Dx Date", TM_BEST_AJCC_STG "Stage", TM_SITE_CD AS "Tumor Site Code", S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS "Tumor Site Desc", TM_HIST_CD AS "Tumor Histology Code", H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS "Tumor Histology Desc", TM_CASE_STS "Tumor Case Status Code", CS.AV_DESC AS "Tumor Case Status Desc" FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM H ON TM_HIST_CD = H.CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON TM_SITE_CD = S.CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON TM_MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS CS ON CS.AV_ELEMENT = 'CASE_STS' AND CS.AV_CODE = TM_CASE_STS JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY ON PLA_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND TM_DX_DTE BETWEEN '2008-01-01' AND '2017-12-31' AND TM_SITE_CD BETWEEN 'C180' AND 'C219' AND LEFT(TM_BEST_AJCC_STG, 1) = '4' ), RAD AS (SELECT DISTINCT RTC_TX_MRN, 'Y' RAD_TX FROM DIAG JOIN IDB.RADONC_TREATMENT_COURSE ON MRN = RTC_TX_MRN), CHEMO AS (SELECT DISTINCT CPO_MRN, 'Y' CHEMO_TX FROM IDB.CHEMO_PERFORMED_ORDERS) SELECT DIAG.*, RAD_TX, CHEMO_TX FROM DIAG LEFT JOIN RAD ON RTC_TX_MRN=MRN LEFT JOIN CHEMO ON CPO_MRN=MRN ; WITH MRNS AS (SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN MRN FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM H ON TM_HIST_CD = H.CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON TM_SITE_CD = S.CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON TM_MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS CS ON CS.AV_ELEMENT = 'CASE_STS' AND CS.AV_CODE = TM_CASE_STS WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND TM_DX_DTE BETWEEN '2008-01-01' AND '2017-12-31' AND TM_SITE_CD BETWEEN 'C180' AND 'C219' AND LEFT(TM_BEST_AJCC_STG, 1) = '4' ) SELECT MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, PT_DATE_OF_DEATH, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, SSE_LOG_ID, SSE_SURG_DTE, SSP_PROC_NAME, SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD, SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC, SSE_PT_IN_DT, SSE_PT_OUT_DT, SSP_SURG_LAST_NM, SSP_SURG_FIRST_NM FROM MRNS JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT ON MRN = SSE_MRN AND SSE_SOURCE_TYPE = 'O' JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE ON SSE_LOG_ID = SSP_LOG_ID AND SSP_SURG_SVC_CD = 'CRS' ; WITH MRNS AS (SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN MRN FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM H ON TM_HIST_CD = H.CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON TM_SITE_CD = S.CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON TM_MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS CS ON CS.AV_ELEMENT = 'CASE_STS' AND CS.AV_CODE = TM_CASE_STS WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND TM_DX_DTE BETWEEN '2008-01-01' AND '2017-12-31' AND TM_SITE_CD BETWEEN 'C180' AND 'C219' AND LEFT(TM_BEST_AJCC_STG, 1) = '4' ), SRG AS (SELECT DISTINCT MRN, SSE_LOG_ID LOG_ID FROM MRNS JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT ON MRN = SSE_MRN AND SSE_SOURCE_TYPE = 'O' JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE ON SSE_LOG_ID = SSP_LOG_ID AND SSP_SURG_SVC_CD = 'CRS'), TOTALS AS (SELECT MRN, LOG_ID, COALESCE(AIFM_MEAS_VALUE, 0) EBL, AIFGD_UNITS EBL_UNITS FROM SRG LEFT JOIN IDB.AN_RECORD_SUMMARY ON LOG_ID = ARS_AN_CASELOG_ID AND ARS_AN_START_DT IS NOT NULL LEFT JOIN IDB.AN_IP_DATA_STORE ON ARS_AN_52_ENC_CSN_ID = AIDS_ENC_CSN_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.AN_HSB_LINKED_DOC_CSN ON ARS_AN_EPISODE_ID = AHLDC_SUMMARY_BLOCK_ID AND AHLDC_LINKED_DOC_CSN = AIDS_ENC_CSN_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.AN_IP_FLOWSHEET_REC ON AIFRC_INPATIENT_DATA_ID = AIDS_INPATIENT_DATA_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.AN_IP_FLOWSHEET_MEAS ON AIFRC_FSD_ID = AIFM_FSD_ID AND AHLDC_LINKED_DOC_CSN = AIDS_ENC_CSN_ID AND AIFM_FLO_MEAS_ID = '400620' AND AIFM_MEAS_VALUE > '0' LEFT JOIN IDB.AN_IP_FLOWSHEET_GP_DATA ON AIFM_FLO_MEAS_ID = AIFGD_FLO_MEAS_ID) SELECT MRN, LOG_ID, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, PT_DATE_OF_DEATH, SUM(EBL) EBL, MAX(EBL_UNITS) EBL_UNITS FROM TOTALS JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PT_MRN=MRN GROUP BY MRN, LOG_ID, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, PT_DATE_OF_DEATH ;

prompt: Provide a list of patients with BRCA (BRCA1 or BRCA2) mutation diagnosed with breast cancer
completion: WITH CTE AS (SELECT PT_MRN BR_MRN, MIN(DT_DTE) DX_DTE FROM DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS JOIN DV.CDB_TUMOR_V ON CDTM_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID JOIN DV.DATE_V ON CDTM_DX_DATE_ID = DT_DATE_ID JOIN DV.DIAGNOSIS_CODE_CAT_ICDO_V ON CDTM_DX_CATALOG_ID = DXCC_DX_CATALOG_ID JOIN DV.ICDO_SITE_CATALOG_V ON CDTM_SITE_CATALOG_ID = ICSC_SITE_CATALOG_ID JOIN DV.TUMOR_CASE_ATTRIBUTES_V ON CDTM_CASE_ATTR_ID = TUMOR_CASE_ATTR_ID WHERE 1=1 AND ICSC_SITE_CD IN ('C501', 'C502', 'C503', 'C504', 'C505', 'C506', 'C508', 'C509') AND DXCC_ICD_CODE NOT BETWEEN 'M9590/0' AND 'M9729/6' AND DXCC_ICD_CODE NOT BETWEEN 'M9140/0' AND 'M9140/6' GROUP BY PT_MRN ) , GENE AS (SELECT GENE_MRN, MIN(DX_DTE) DX_DTE FROM (SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN GENE_MRN, DX_DTE FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_STRUCTURED_RESULTS_V JOIN CTE ON BR_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE GENE IN ('BRCA1', 'BRCA2') AND RESULT = 'POSITIVE' UNION ALL SELECT DISTINCT PDG_MRN GENE_MRN, MIN(BPE_DX_DT) DX_DTE FROM IDB.PT_DMT_GENETICS JOIN IDB.BR_PRIMARY ON BP_MRN = PDG_MRN JOIN IDB.BR_PT_EVENT ON BP_DX_ID = BPE_DX_ID WHERE PDG_GENE_DESC IN ('BRCA1', 'BRCA2') AND PDG_MUTATION_DESC <> 'No Mutation Detected' GROUP BY PDG_MRN ) GROUP BY GENE_MRN) SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN MRN, PT_LAST_NAME "Last Name", PT_FIRST_NAME "First Name", PT_SEX "Gender", PT_BIRTH_DTE "Date of Birth", DX_DTE "Dx Date", DT_DTE "Report Date", PRPT_ACCESSION_NO "Accession No", PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_DESC "Report Type" FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON PRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID JOIN DV.DATE_V ON PRPT_REPORT_DATE_ID = DT_DATE_ID JOIN DV.PATH_RPRT_TYPE_LOOKUP ON PRPT_REPORT_TYPE = PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_CD JOIN GENE ON GENE_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_DESC IN ('Surgical Pathology', 'Surgical Pathology Breast', 'Surgical Pathology Consult', 'Surgical Pathology Molecular Genetics', 'Surgical Submitted Slides' ) ORDER BY 1, 6

prompt: For Diagnostic Molecular Genetics (DMG) reports since 2007, provide the MRN, DMG Accession Number, and Document Date.
completion: SELECT EPD_MRN, EPD_COMMENT_INFO, EPD_DOC_DTE FROM IDB.EMR_PT_DOCUMENT WHERE EPD_DOCTYPE = 'T83' AND EPD_DOC_STATUS IN (16, 17, 18, 19, 20, 100) AND EPD_DOC_DTE >= '2007-01-01'

prompt: Perform a search of patients who have undergone MSK-IMPACT testing with a diagnosis of pancreatic cancer/pancreatic adenocarcinoma and with brain metastases.
completion: SELECT DISTINCT A.PT_MRN, PDRX_ACCESSION_NO, T.* FROM DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS A JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML DT ON PDRX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID CROSS JOIN XMLTABLE('$c/root/*' PASSING DT.PDRX_XML_VALUE AS "c" COLUMNS DT_PROCEDURE VARCHAR(40) PATH '../meta-data/dt_procedure', SAMPLEID VARCHAR(100) PATH '../meta-data/dmp_sample_id', PATIENTID VARCHAR(100) PATH '../meta-data/dmp_patient_id', PRIMARY_SITE VARCHAR(255) PATH '../meta-data/primary_site', TUMOR_TYPE_CODE VARCHAR(100) PATH '../meta-data/tumor_type_code', TUMOR_TYPE_NAME VARCHAR(255) PATH '../meta-data/tumor_type_name', PART_DESCRIPTION VARCHAR(2000) PATH '../meta-data/part_description', METASTASIS_SITE VARCHAR(255) PATH '../meta-data/metastasis_site') T WHERE 1=1 AND(UPPER(PRIMARY_SITE) like '%PANCREAS%' OR UPPER(TUMOR_TYPE_NAME) like '%PANCR%') AND METASTASIS_SITE IN ('Brain', 'Cerebellum')

prompt: data on the number of breast cancer patients we've treated  April1, 2019 to  present with the breakdown of who is on active treatment and who is on surveillance
completion: WITH TUMOR AS (SELECT TM_MRN, TM_DX_DTE, TM_BEST_AJCC_STG AS STAGE, CASE WHEN TM_SSF1 = '000' THEN 'Test not done (test not ordered and not performed)' WHEN TM_SSF1 = '010' THEN 'Positive/elevated' WHEN TM_SSF1 = '020' THEN 'Negative/normal; within normal limits' WHEN TM_SSF1 = '030' THEN 'Borderline; undetermined whether positive or negative' WHEN TM_SSF1 = '080' THEN 'Ordered, but results not in chart' WHEN TM_SSF1 = '988' THEN 'Not applicable: Information not collected for this case' WHEN TM_SSF1 = '996' THEN 'Test ordered, results not interpretable' WHEN TM_SSF1 = '997' THEN 'Test ordered, results not in chart' WHEN TM_SSF1 = '998' THEN 'Test not done (test not ordered and not performed)' WHEN TM_SSF1 = '999' THEN 'Unknown or no information; not documented in patient record' ELSE '' END AS ER_CDB, CASE WHEN TM_SSF2 = '000' THEN 'Test not done (test not ordered and not performed)' WHEN TM_SSF2 = '010' THEN 'Positive/elevated' WHEN TM_SSF2 = '020' THEN 'Negative/normal; within normal limits' WHEN TM_SSF2 = '030' THEN 'Borderline; undetermined whether positive or negative' WHEN TM_SSF2 = '080' THEN 'Ordered, but results not in chart' WHEN TM_SSF2 = '988' THEN 'Not applicable: Information not collected for this case' WHEN TM_SSF2 = '996' THEN 'Test ordered, results not interpretable' WHEN TM_SSF2 = '997' THEN 'Test ordered, results not in chart' WHEN TM_SSF2 = '998' THEN 'Test not done (test not ordered and not performed)' WHEN TM_SSF2 = '999' THEN 'Unknown or no information; not documented in patient record' ELSE '' END AS PR_CDB, CASE WHEN TM_SSF15 = '010' THEN 'Positive/elevated; amplified' WHEN TM_SSF15 = '020' THEN 'Negative/normal; within normal limits; not amplified' WHEN TM_SSF15 = '030' THEN 'Borderline; equivocal; indeterminate; undetermined whether positive or negative' WHEN TM_SSF15 = '988' THEN 'Not applicable: Information not collected for this case' WHEN TM_SSF15 = '997' THEN 'Test ordered, results not in chart' WHEN TM_SSF15 = '998' THEN 'Test not done (test not ordered and not performed)' WHEN TM_SSF15 = '999' THEN 'Unknown or no information; not documented in patient record' ELSE '' END AS HER2_CDB FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND TM_SITE_CD LIKE 'C50%' ) , CLINTRAC AS (SELECT CC_MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS MIN_EFF_ICD_DTE FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE SUBSTR(CC_CLSF_CD, 1, 3) IN ('C50', '174', '175') AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND (CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) GROUP BY CC_MRN ) , TX AS (SELECT APR_MRN , MIN(CASE WHEN CDG_CHEMO_FLAG = 'Y' THEN APR_START_DTE END) AS FIRST_CHEMO_DTE , MAX(CASE WHEN CDG_CHEMO_FLAG = 'Y' THEN APR_START_DTE END) AS LAST_CHEMO_DTE , MIN(CASE WHEN APR_ORAL_FLAG = 'Y' THEN APR_START_DTE END) AS FIRST_ORAL_DTE , MAX(CASE WHEN APR_ORAL_FLAG = 'Y' THEN APR_START_DTE END) AS LAST_ORAL_DTE , MIN(CASE WHEN CDG_BIOLOGIC_IMMUNO_FLAG = 'Y' THEN APR_START_DTE END) AS FIRST_IMMUNO_DTE , MAX(CASE WHEN CDG_BIOLOGIC_IMMUNO_FLAG = 'Y' THEN APR_START_DTE END) AS LAST_IMMUNO_DTE , MIN(CASE WHEN CDG_HORMONE_FLAG = 'Y' THEN APR_START_DTE END) AS FIRST_HORM_DTE , MAX(CASE WHEN CDG_HORMONE_FLAG = 'Y' THEN APR_START_DTE END) AS LAST_HORM_DTE , MIN(CASE WHEN CDG_TARGETED_FLAG = 'Y' THEN APR_START_DTE END) AS FIRST_TARGET_DTE , MAX(CASE WHEN CDG_TARGETED_FLAG = 'Y' THEN APR_START_DTE END) AS LAST_TARGET_DTE FROM IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX_V LEFT JOIN TUMOR ON APR_MRN = TM_MRN LEFT JOIN CLINTRAC ON APR_MRN = CC_MRN WHERE APR_LOCATION IN ('Food Nutrition 1919', 'Laboratory 1919', 'Medical Oncology 1919', 'Chemo 1919', 'ST GU 1919', 'Breast 1919') AND COALESCE(TM_MRN, CC_MRN) IS NOT NULL AND APR_START_DTE >= '2019-04-01' GROUP BY APR_MRN ) , EPH AS (SELECT CDD_MRN, CDD_SERVICE_DTE, CDO_ITEM_NAME, CDO_VALUE_TEXT FROM IDB.CD_DOCUMENT JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION ON CDD_DOC_GUID = CDO_DOC_GUID AND CDD_AUTHORED_DTE = CDO_AUTHORED_DTE JOIN TX ON CDD_MRN = APR_MRN WHERE 1=1 AND CDD_CANCEL_IND <> '1' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND <> '1' AND CDD_DOC_NAME IN ('Follow Up Note - Breast Surgery', 'Follow Up, NP - Breast Surgery', 'Follow Up - Breast Surgery', 'Follow Up - Surgery-Breast', 'Follow Up, NP/PA - Breast Surgery') AND CDO_ITEM_NAME IN ('HER2:', 'ER:', 'PR:') ) , PATIENT AS (SELECT PT_MRN , PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH , PT_SEX , PT_PRIMARY_LANG , CASE WHEN COALESCE(R.AV_DESC, CR.AV_DESC) IN ('WHITE', 'WHITE HISPANIC') THEN 'White' WHEN COALESCE(R.AV_DESC, CR.AV_DESC) IN ('BLACK OR AFRICAN AMERICAN', 'BLACK', 'BLACK HISPANIC') THEN 'Black' WHEN COALESCE(R.AV_DESC, CR.AV_DESC) IN ('ASIAN-FAR EAST/INDIAN SUBCONT', 'KAMPUCHEAN', 'LAOTIAN', 'VIETNAMESE', 'HMONG', 'CHINESE', 'ASIAN INDIAN PAKISTANI', 'JAPANESE', 'KOREAN', 'OTHER ASIAN', 'THAI') THEN 'Asian' WHEN COALESCE(R.AV_DESC, CR.AV_DESC) IN ('NATIVE AMERICAN-AM IND/ALASKA', 'AMER IND ALEUT ESKIMO') THEN 'Native American or Alaska Native' WHEN COALESCE(R.AV_DESC, CR.AV_DESC) IN ('NATIVE HAWAIIAN OR PACIFIC ISL', 'HAWAIIAN', 'MELANESIAN', 'MICRONESIAN', 'FIJI ISLANDER', 'FILIPINO', 'GUAMANIAN', 'PACIFIC ISLANDER') THEN 'Native Hawaiian or Other Pacific Islander' ELSE 'Unspecified' END AS PT_RACE , CASE WHEN COALESCE(CE.AV_DESC, E.AV_DESC) IN ('SPANISH NOS; HISPANIC NOS, LATINO NOS', 'HISPANIC OR LATINO', 'PUERTO RICAN', 'SOUTH/CENTRAL AMERICA (EXCEPT BRAZIL)', 'DOMINICAN REPUBLIC', 'OTHER SPANISH/HISPANIC(INCL EUROPEAN; EXCL DOM REP)', 'CUBAN', 'MEXICAN (INCLUDES CHICANO)') OR COALESCE(R.AV_DESC, CR.AV_DESC) IN ('WHITE HISPANIC', 'BLACK HISPANIC') THEN 'Hispanic' WHEN COALESCE(CE.AV_DESC, E.AV_DESC) IN ('NOT HISPANIC', 'SPANISH SURNAME ONLY', 'NON-SPANISH; NON-HISPANIC') THEN 'Non-Hispanic' ELSE 'Unspecified' END AS PT_HISPANIC FROM IDB.PATIENT JOIN TX ON PT_MRN = APR_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS R ON R.AV_ELEMENT = 'RACE' AND R.AV_CODE = PT_RACE LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS E ON E.AV_ELEMENT = 'PT_ETHNICITY' AND E.AV_CODE = PT_PT_ETHNICITY LEFT JOIN IDB.CDB_PATIENT ON PT_MRN = CP_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS CR ON CR.AV_ELEMENT = 'CDB_RACE' AND CR.AV_CODE = CP_CDB_RACE LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS CE ON CE.AV_ELEMENT = 'ETHNICITY' AND CE.AV_CODE = CP_ETHNICITY) SELECT APR_MRN AS MRN , PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH AS DOB , PT_SEX AS SEX , PT_RACE AS RACE , PT_HISPANIC AS ETHNICITY , AV_DESC AS PRIMARY_LANG , COALESCE(TM_DX_DTE, MIN_EFF_ICD_DTE) AS CANCER_DX_DTE , ER_CDB , PR_CDB , HER2_CDB , CDO_ITEM_NAME , CDO_VALUE_TEXT , FIRST_CHEMO_DTE , LAST_CHEMO_DTE , FIRST_ORAL_DTE , LAST_ORAL_DTE , FIRST_IMMUNO_DTE , LAST_IMMUNO_DTE , FIRST_HORM_DTE , LAST_HORM_DTE , FIRST_TARGET_DTE , LAST_TARGET_DTE FROM TX JOIN PATIENT ON APR_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS ON AV_ELEMENT = 'PRIMARY_LANG' AND AV_CODE = PT_PRIMARY_LANG LEFT JOIN TUMOR ON APR_MRN = TM_MRN LEFT JOIN CLINTRAC ON APR_MRN = CC_MRN LEFT JOIN EPH ON APR_MRN = CDD_MRN

prompt: Please provide dashboard of neurosurgery visits since 1/1/2019.
completion: SELECT CPE_MRN MRN, TRIM(PT_LAST_NAME)||', '||PT_FIRST_NAME PT_NAME , PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH , CPE_ENC_DTE , CPE_CPE_APPT_STS , CLD_DEPT_NAME , CRE_RES_NAME , CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME , CVT_EXT_NAME FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID = CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CRE_RES_ID = CPE_VST_RES_ID JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON CPE_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE CPE_ENC_DTE >= '2019-01-01' AND CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Comp', 'Arrived') AND (CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_4 = 'NRS' OR CLD_DEPT_ID IN (575, 576)) AND CRE_RES_TYP IN ('Physician', 'Nurse Practitioner', 'Physician Assistant', 'Advanced Practice Nurse') ORDER BY 1, 4

prompt: Provide a list of patient MRNs for patients in an existing Darwin query.
completion: SELECT DISTINCT "t1"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AS "Deident PT #", "t2"."PRO_IRB_NO" AS "IRB Number", "t3"."PRPT_PATH_RPT_ID" AS "DE-ID Pathology Report", "t4"."DT_YEAR" AS "Pathology Procedure Year", "t5"."DT_YEAR" AS "CPT Procedure Year (OR)", "t6"."PCC_CODE" AS "CPT Procedure Code (OR)", "t6"."PCC_DESC" AS "CPT Procedure Desc (OR)" FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED" "t1" LEFT JOIN "DV"."ACCRUALS" "t7" ON "t1"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t7"."AC_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PROTOCOL" "t2" ON "t7"."AC_PROTOCOL_ID" = "t2"."PRO_PROTOCOL_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V" "t3" ON "t1"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t3"."PRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" "t4" ON "t3"."PRPT_PROCEDURE_DATE_ID" = "t4"."DT_DATE_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."CPT_OR_PATIENT_PROCEDURE" "t6" ON "t1"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t6"."PTX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" "t5" ON "t6"."PTX_PROC_DATE_ID" = "t5"."DT_DATE_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PHM_PT_MEDS_MQT" "t8" ON "t1"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t8"."POD_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PHM_ORDER_DTL" "t9" ON "t8"."POD_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t9"."POD_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AND "t8"."POD_PHARMA_INVENTORY_CTLG_ID" = "t9"."POD_PHARMA_INVENTORY_CTLG_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PHM_INVENTORY_CATALOG" "t10" ON "t9"."POD_PHARMA_INVENTORY_CTLG_ID" = "t10"."PINC_INVENTORY_CTLG_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" "t11" ON "t9"."POD_START_DATE_ID" = "t11"."DT_DATE_ID" WHERE ("t2"."PRO_IRB_NO" = '12-245' AND ("t6"."PCC_CODE" IN ('19300', '19301', '19302', '19303', '19304', '19305', '19306', '19307', '19309', '19120', '19125', '19126', '19112', '19140', '19160', '19162', '19180', '19182') AND ("t10"."PINC_CHEMO_IND" = 'Y' AND ((("t11"."DT_YEAR" IS NOT NULL AND "t5"."DT_YEAR" IS NOT NULL) AND "t11"."DT_DTE" BETWEEN "t5"."DT_DTE" - 1 YEARS AND "t5"."DT_DTE") AND (("t4"."DT_YEAR" IS NOT NULL AND "t5"."DT_YEAR" IS NOT NULL) AND "t4"."DT_DTE" BETWEEN "t5"."DT_DTE" AND "t5"."DT_DTE")))) ) SELECT DISTINCT "t1"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AS "Deident PT #", "t2"."PT_MRN" AS "MRN" FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED" "t1" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V" "t2" ON "t1"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t2"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."ACCRUALS" "t3" ON "t1"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t3"."AC_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PROTOCOL" "t4" ON "t3"."AC_PROTOCOL_ID" = "t4"."PRO_PROTOCOL_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."CPT_OR_PATIENT_PROCEDURE" "t5" ON "t1"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t5"."PTX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" "t6" ON "t5"."PTX_PROC_DATE_ID" = "t6"."DT_DATE_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PHM_PT_MEDS_MQT" "t7" ON "t1"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t7"."POD_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PHM_ORDER_DTL" "t8" ON "t7"."POD_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t8"."POD_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AND "t7"."POD_PHARMA_INVENTORY_CTLG_ID" = "t8"."POD_PHARMA_INVENTORY_CTLG_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PHM_INVENTORY_CATALOG" "t9" ON "t8"."POD_PHARMA_INVENTORY_CTLG_ID" = "t9"."PINC_INVENTORY_CTLG_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" "t10" ON "t8"."POD_START_DATE_ID" = "t10"."DT_DATE_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V" "t11" ON "t1"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t11"."PRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" "t12" ON "t11"."PRPT_PROCEDURE_DATE_ID" = "t12"."DT_DATE_ID" WHERE ("t4"."PRO_IRB_NO" = '12-245' AND ("t5"."PCC_CODE" IN ('19300', '19301', '19302', '19303', '19304', '19305', '19306', '19307', '19309', '19120', '19125', '19126', '19112', '19140', '19160', '19162', '19180', '19182') AND ("t9"."PINC_CHEMO_IND" = 'Y' AND ((("t10"."DT_YEAR" IS NOT NULL AND "t6"."DT_YEAR" IS NOT NULL) AND "t10"."DT_DTE" BETWEEN "t6"."DT_DTE" - 1 YEARS AND "t6"."DT_DTE") AND (("t12"."DT_YEAR" IS NOT NULL AND "t6"."DT_YEAR" IS NOT NULL) AND "t12"."DT_DTE" BETWEEN "t6"."DT_DTE" AND "t6"."DT_DTE")))))

prompt: We want to write about the real world experience for patients with primary CNS lymphoma treated at MSKCC with a medication called ibrutinib between 2014-2022

prompt: Patient with histone mutations (K27M mut, K28M, K27I, K28I)
