prompt: Updating Data to include appointment types TEL NV
completion: SELECT CPE_MRN AS "MRN", PT_LAST_NAME "Last Name", PT_FIRST_NAME "First Name", CPE_ENC_DTE AS "Appt Date", CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 AS "Department", CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 AS "Service", CLD_DEPT_NAME AS "Department Name", CRE_RES_NAME AS "Provider Name", CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME "Visit Type", CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON CPE_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND DATE(CPE_ENC_DTE) >= (DATE('0001-01-01') + YEAR(CURRENT date) YEARS - 1 YEAR + MONTH(CURRENT date) MONTHS - 4 MONTHS) AND DATE(CPE_ENC_DTE) < (DATE('0001-01-01') + YEAR(CURRENT date) YEARS - 1 YEAR + MONTH(CURRENT date) MONTHS - 1 MONTHS) AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 = 'MED' AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 = 'GIM' AND CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME IN ('GIM NV', 'TELEHEALTH NV') AND CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID IN ('3008', '13035') ; WITH PTS AS (SELECT CPE_MRN AS "MRN", CPE_ENC_DTE AS "Appt Date", CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 AS "Department", CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 AS "Service", CLD_DEPT_NAME AS "Department Name", CRE_RES_NAME AS "Provider Name", CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME "Visit Type", CPE_ENC_CSN_ID, CPE_APPT_DT FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND DATE(CPE_ENC_DTE) >= (DATE('0001-01-01') + YEAR(CURRENT date) YEARS - 1 YEAR + MONTH(CURRENT date) MONTHS - 4 MONTHS) AND DATE(CPE_ENC_DTE) < (DATE('0001-01-01') + YEAR(CURRENT date) YEARS - 1 YEAR + MONTH(CURRENT date) MONTHS - 1 MONTHS) AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 = 'MED' AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 = 'GIM' AND CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME IN ('GIM NV', 'TELEHEALTH NV') AND CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID IN ('3008', '13035') ) SELECT CPE_MRN AS "MRN", CPE_ENC_DTE AS "Appt Date", CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 AS "Department", CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 AS "Service", CLD_DEPT_NAME AS "Department Name", CRE_RES_NAME AS "Provider Name", CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME "Visit Type" FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER A JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID JOIN PTS B ON A.CPE_MRN = "MRN" AND A.CPE_APPT_DT >= B.CPE_APPT_DT AND A.CPE_ENC_CSN_ID <> B.CPE_ENC_CSN_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') ; WITH PTS AS (SELECT CPE_MRN AS "MRN", CPE_ENC_DTE AS "Appt Date", CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 AS "Department", CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 AS "Service", CLD_DEPT_NAME AS "Department Name", CRE_RES_NAME AS "Provider Name", CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME "Visit Type", CPE_ENC_CSN_ID, CPE_APPT_DT FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND DATE(CPE_ENC_DTE) >= (DATE('0001-01-01') + YEAR(CURRENT date) YEARS - 1 YEAR + MONTH(CURRENT date) MONTHS - 4 MONTHS) AND DATE(CPE_ENC_DTE) < (DATE('0001-01-01') + YEAR(CURRENT date) YEARS - 1 YEAR + MONTH(CURRENT date) MONTHS - 1 MONTHS) AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 = 'MED' AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 = 'GIM' AND CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME IN ('GIM NV', 'TELEHEALTH NV') AND CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID IN ('3008', '13035') ) SELECT OO_MRN "MRN", OOC_ITEM_NAME "Order Name", OOC_ITEM_DESC "Order Description", OO_ENTER_DT "Enter Date", OSTS_STS_DESC "Order Status", OP_DISPLAY_NAME "Requesting Provider Name" FROM IDB.OMS_ORDER JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_CATALOG ON OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID = OOC_MSTR_ITEM_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_STATUS ON OO_ORD_STS_CD = OSTS_ORD_STS_CD LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_PROVIDER ON OO_PVDR_GUID = OP_PVDR_GUID JOIN PTS ON OO_MRN = "MRN" AND OO_ENTER_DT > CPE_APPT_DT WHERE 1=1 AND OO_ORD_STS_CD NOT IN ('CANP', 'CANC', 'AUC3')

prompt: Search pathology reports from 1/1/2000 to present for specific diagnostic terms
completion: SELECT PRPT_MRN "MRN", PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH "Date of birth", RTRIM(PT_FIRST_NAME) || ', ' || PT_LAST_NAME AS "Patient name", PRPT_PROCEDURE_DTE "Procedure date", PRPT_REPORT_DTE "Report date", PRPT_REPORT_TYPE_DESC "Report type", PRPT_ACCESSION_NO "Accession no", PRPT_REPORT "Path report" FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PRPT_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE PRPT_REPORT IS NOT NULL AND LEFT(PRPT_ACCESSION_NO, 1) = 'M' AND PRPT_REPORT_DTE >= '2000-01-01' AND CONTAINS(PRPT_REPORT, '( "hist1h1e" & ("diffuse large b-cell lymphoma" | "diffuse large b cell lymphoma") )') = 1 ; SELECT PRPT_MRN "MRN", PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH "Date of birth", RTRIM(PT_FIRST_NAME) || ', ' || PT_LAST_NAME AS "Patient name", PRPT_PROCEDURE_DTE "Procedure date", PRPT_REPORT_DTE "Report date", PRPT_REPORT_TYPE_DESC "Report type", PRPT_ACCESSION_NO "Accession no", PRPT_REPORT "Path report" FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PRPT_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE PRPT_REPORT IS NOT NULL AND LEFT(PRPT_ACCESSION_NO, 1) = 'M' AND PRPT_REPORT_DTE >= '2000-01-01' AND CONTAINS(PRPT_REPORT, '( "hist1h1c" & ("diffuse large b-cell lymphoma" | "diffuse large b cell lymphoma") )') = 1 ;

prompt: All endometrial cancer including carcinosarcomas that received  bevacizumab from 1993 to 2017
completion: WITH ETO AS (SELECT MRN, PT_NAME, DOB, DOD , DX_DTE, SITE_CD, SITE_DESC, TM_HIST_CD, HIST_DESC, PT_VITAL_STS_LAST_UPD_DTE, LST_CONTACT_DTE, PMH_WT_KG, PMH_BSA, PMH_HT_CM, PMH_BMI, PMH_MEASURE_DTE FROM (SELECT TM_MRN MRN, STRIP(PT_LAST_NAME)||', '||STRIP(PT_FIRST_NAME) PT_NAME, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH DOB, PT_DATE_OF_DEATH DOD , TM_DX_DTE DX_DTE, TM_SITE_CD SITE_CD, ST.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK SITE_DESC, TM_HIST_CD, HS.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK HIST_DESC, PT_VITAL_STS_LAST_UPD_DTE, PLA_LST_CON_DTE LST_CONTACT_DTE, PMH_WT_KG, PMH_BSA, PMH_HT_CM, PMH_BMI, PMH_MEASURE_DTE, ROW_NUMBER () OVER (PARTITION BY PMH_MRN ORDER BY PMH_MEASURE_DTE DESC) RN FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON TM_MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.PT_MEASURES_HX ON TM_MRN = PMH_MRN JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY ON PT_MRN = PLA_MRN JOIN IDB.CLM ST ON TM_SITE_CD = ST.CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.CLM HS ON TM_HIST_CD = HS.CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE TM_SITE_CD = 'C541' AND TM_CASE_STS = '3' AND TM_DX_DTE BETWEEN '1993-01-01' AND '2017-12-31' ) A WHERE RN = 1 ) , CHEMO AS (SELECT MRN, DRUG_NAME, MIN(START_DATE) AS START_DATE, MAX(STOP_DATE) AS STOP_DATE, SUM(DOSE) AS TTL_DOSE, DOSE_UNIT, SUM(DISPENSES) AS TTL_DISPENSES FROM (SELECT MRN, CM_SVM_DESC AS DRUG_NAME , CM_ORD_STRT_DTE AS START_DATE , COALESCE(CM_ORD_DISCONT_DTE, CM_ORD_STOP_DTE) AS STOP_DATE , SUM(CM_DOSE_NO) AS DOSE , CM_DOSE_UNIT AS DOSE_UNIT , COUNT(*) DISPENSES FROM ETO JOIN IDB.CHEMO ON MRN = CM_MRN WHERE CM_ORD_SUBDPT IN ('300') AND CM_ORD_STRT_DTE BETWEEN '1993-01-01' AND '2003-09-30' GROUP BY MRN, CM_SVM_DESC, CM_ORD_STRT_DTE, CM_OCC_STRT_DTE, CM_DOSE_UNIT, CM_ORD_STOP_DTE, CM_ORD_DISCONT_DTE UNION SELECT MRN, UCASE(PIN_GENERIC_NAME) AS DRUG_NAME , POD_STRT_DTE AS START_DATE , POD_STOP_DTE AS STOP_DATE , POI_DOSE*SUM(INT(PAA_DOSES)) AS DOSE , POI_DOSE_UNIT AS DOSE_UNIT , SUM(INT(PAA_DOSES)) DISPENSES FROM IDB.PHM_ORDER JOIN ETO ON MRN = PO_MRN JOIN IDB.PHM_ORD_DTL ON PO_ORD_SEQ = POD_ORD_SEQ JOIN IDB.PHM_ORD_INV ON POD_ORD_SEQ = POI_ORD_SEQ AND POD_ITEM_NO = POI_ITEM_NO JOIN IDB.PHM_INVENTORY ON POI_INV_SEQ = PIN_INV_SEQ AND PIN_ATT_FLAG LIKE '%CHEMO%' JOIN IDB.PHM_AUD_ADMIN ON PAA_ORD_SEQ = POI_ORD_SEQ AND PAA_ITEM_NO = POI_ITEM_NO AND PAA_ORD_INV_SEQ = POI_ORD_INV_SEQ WHERE POD_STRT_DTE <= CURRENT DATE AND PO_ORD_STS NOT IN ('X', 'P') GROUP BY MRN, PIN_GENERIC_NAME, POD_STRT_DTE , POD_STOP_DTE, POI_DOSE, POI_DOSE_UNIT HAVING SUM(INT(PAA_DOSES)) > 0 UNION SELECT PHM.MRN, PHM.DRUG_NAME , PHM.START_DATE , PHM.STOP_DATE, PHM.DOSE, PHM.DOSE_UOM DOSE_UNIT, PHM.DISPENSE_CNT DISPENSES FROM IDB.SRX_PHARMACY_SUM PHM JOIN ETO ON PHM.MRN = ETO.MRN AND PHM.CHEMO_IND = 'Y') CHEMO GROUP BY MRN, DRUG_NAME, DOSE_UNIT) SELECT A.MRN, PT_NAME, DOB, DOD , DX_DTE, SITE_CD, SITE_DESC, TM_HIST_CD, HIST_DESC, PT_VITAL_STS_LAST_UPD_DTE, LST_CONTACT_DTE, PMH_WT_KG, PMH_BSA, PMH_HT_CM, PMH_BMI, PMH_MEASURE_DTE, DRUG_NAME, START_DATE, STOP_DATE, TTL_DOSE, DOSE_UNIT, TTL_DISPENSES FROM CHEMO A JOIN ETO X ON A.MRN = X.MRN WHERE A.MRN IN (SELECT MRN FROM CHEMO WHERE UPPER(DRUG_NAME) LIKE '%BEVACIZU%')

prompt: Provide a list of patients with spinal metastases between 2010 and 2016 who had pre radiation therapy MRI scan of the spine and post radiation therapy MRI scan at MSK.
completion: WITH SEC_DX AS (SELECT CC_MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS MIN_ICD9_EFF_DTE FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE CC_CLSF_CD IN ('198.3', 'C79.31') AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND (CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) GROUP BY CC_MRN HAVING MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) BETWEEN '2010-01-01' AND '2016-12-31') , RT AS (SELECT RTC_TX_MRN, RTC_TX_PLAN_NAME, RTC_TX_DELIVERED_DOSE, RTC_TX_START_DTE, RTC_TX_STOP_DTE FROM IDB.RADONC_TREATMENT_COURSE JOIN SEC_DX ON RTC_TX_MRN = CC_MRN ) , MRI_PRE AS (SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN AS PRE_MRI_MRN, CPE_ENC_DTE AS PRE_MRI_DTE, CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME AS PRE_MRI_NAME FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID JOIN RT ON CPE_MRN = RTC_TX_MRN AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN RTC_TX_START_DTE - 56 DAYS AND RTC_TX_START_DTE - 28 DAYS WHERE (CPE_CPE_APPT_STS ='Comp' OR CPE_CPE_APPT_STS ='Arrived') AND CRE_RES_NAME LIKE '%MRI %' AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 = 'RAD' AND CRE_RES_NAME NOT LIKE '%MRI 1275-OR%' AND CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME like '%SPIN%' ) , MRI_POST AS (SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN AS POST_MRI_MRN, CPE_ENC_DTE AS POST_MRI_DTE, CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME AS POST_MRI_NAME FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID JOIN RT ON CPE_MRN = RTC_TX_MRN AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN RTC_TX_STOP_DTE AND RTC_TX_STOP_DTE + 91 DAYS WHERE (CPE_CPE_APPT_STS ='Comp' OR CPE_CPE_APPT_STS ='Arrived') AND CRE_RES_NAME LIKE '%MRI %' AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 = 'RAD' AND CRE_RES_NAME NOT LIKE '%MRI 1275-OR%' AND CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME like '%SPIN%' ) SELECT PT_MRN , PT_SEX AS SEX , PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH AS DOB , PT_DATE_OF_DEATH , CASE WHEN COALESCE(R.AV_DESC, CR.AV_DESC) IN ('WHITE', 'WHITE HISPANIC') THEN 'White' WHEN COALESCE(R.AV_DESC, CR.AV_DESC) IN ('BLACK OR AFRICAN AMERICAN', 'BLACK', 'BLACK HISPANIC') THEN 'Black' WHEN COALESCE(R.AV_DESC, CR.AV_DESC) IN ('ASIAN-FAR EAST/INDIAN SUBCONT', 'KAMPUCHEAN', 'LAOTIAN', 'VIETNAMESE', 'HMONG', 'CHINESE', 'ASIAN INDIAN PAKISTANI', 'JAPANESE', 'KOREAN', 'OTHER ASIAN', 'THAI') THEN 'Asian' WHEN COALESCE(R.AV_DESC, CR.AV_DESC) IN ('NATIVE AMERICAN-AM IND/ALASKA', 'AMER IND ALEUT ESKIMO') THEN 'Native American or Alaska Native' WHEN COALESCE(R.AV_DESC, CR.AV_DESC) IN ('NATIVE HAWAIIAN OR PACIFIC ISL', 'HAWAIIAN', 'MELANESIAN', 'MICRONESIAN', 'FIJI ISLANDER', 'FILIPINO', 'GUAMANIAN', 'PACIFIC ISLANDER') THEN 'Native Hawaiian or Other Pacific Islander' END AS RACE , CASE WHEN COALESCE(CE.AV_DESC, E.AV_DESC) IN ('SPANISH NOS; HISPANIC NOS, LATINO NOS', 'HISPANIC OR LATINO', 'PUERTO RICAN', 'SOUTH/CENTRAL AMERICA (EXCEPT BRAZIL)', 'DOMINICAN REPUBLIC', 'OTHER SPANISH/HISPANIC(INCL EUROPEAN; EXCL DOM REP)', 'CUBAN', 'MEXICAN (INCLUDES CHICANO)') OR COALESCE(R.AV_DESC, CR.AV_DESC) IN ('WHITE HISPANIC', 'BLACK HISPANIC') THEN 'Hispanic' WHEN COALESCE(CE.AV_DESC, E.AV_DESC) IN ('NOT HISPANIC', 'SPANISH SURNAME ONLY', 'NON-SPANISH; NON-HISPANIC') THEN 'Non-Hispanic' ELSE 'Unspecified' END AS ETHNICITY , RTC_TX_PLAN_NAME AS RT_LOCATION , RTC_TX_DELIVERED_DOSE AS DELIVERED_DOSE , RTC_TX_START_DTE AS RT_START_DTE , RTC_TX_STOP_DTE AS RT_STOP_DTE , PRE_MRI_DTE , PRE_MRI_NAME , POST_MRI_DTE , POST_MRI_NAME FROM IDB.PATIENT JOIN RT ON PT_MRN = RTC_TX_MRN JOIN MRI_PRE ON PT_MRN = PRE_MRI_MRN JOIN MRI_POST ON PT_MRN = POST_MRI_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS R ON R.AV_ELEMENT = 'RACE' AND R.AV_CODE = PT_RACE LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS E ON E.AV_ELEMENT = 'PT_ETHNICITY' AND E.AV_CODE = PT_PT_ETHNICITY LEFT JOIN IDB.CDB_PATIENT ON PT_MRN = CP_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS CR ON CR.AV_ELEMENT = 'CDB_RACE' AND CR.AV_CODE = CP_CDB_RACE LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS CE ON CE.AV_ELEMENT = 'ETHNICITY' AND CE.AV_CODE = CP_ETHNICITY ; WITH DX AS (SELECT PT_MRN AS MRN, DT_DTE AS DX_DATE, DXCC_ICD_MSK_DESC AS PRIMARY_CA_DX, ICSC_ICDO_SITE_MSK_DESC AS PRIMARY_CA_SITE FROM DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS JOIN DV.CDB_TUMOR_V ON CDTM_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID JOIN DV.DATE_V ON CDTM_DX_DATE_ID = DT_DATE_ID JOIN DV.DIAGNOSIS_CODE_CAT_ICDO_V ON CDTM_DX_CATALOG_ID = DXCC_DX_CATALOG_ID JOIN DV.ICDO_SITE_CATALOG_V ON CDTM_SITE_CATALOG_ID = ICSC_SITE_CATALOG_ID WHERE PT_MRN IN ({}) ) , IMPACT AS (SELECT PT_MRN, GENE, GENE2, RESULT, LOCUS, AA_CHANGE, NUCLEOTIDE, SEARCH_HIT1, SEARCH_HIT2, METHOD, ABERRATIONTYPE, FOLD_CHANGE FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_STRUCTURED_RESULTS_V JOIN DX ON PT_MRN = MRN WHERE GENE IN ('IDH1', 'TP53', 'IDH2', 'EGFR', 'MGMT') OR GENE2 IN ('IDH1', 'TP53', 'IDH2', 'EGFR', 'MGMT') ) SELECT TRIM(MRN) AS MRN, DX_DATE, PRIMARY_CA_DX, PRIMARY_CA_SITE, GENE, GENE2, RESULT, LOCUS, AA_CHANGE, NUCLEOTIDE, SEARCH_HIT1, SEARCH_HIT2, METHOD, ABERRATIONTYPE, FOLD_CHANGE FROM DX LEFT JOIN IMPACT ON MRN = PT_MRN

Requesting the number of orders for the last 7 days.

Data Access: Samantha Shanker Dr. Robert Sidlow
completion: WITH ORDERS_0 AS (SELECT "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AS PT_DEID, "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_MRN" AS PT_MRN, "IDB"."OMS_ORDER"."OO_ORD_GUID" AS SUBJECT_ID, "IDB"."OMS_ORDER"."OO_MRN" WHERE "IDB"."OMS_ORDER"."OO_ORD_STS_CD" NOT IN ('CANP', 'CANC', 'AUC3') AND "IDB"."OMS_ORDER"."OO_ENTER_DTE" BETWEEN CURRENT_DATE - 1 MONTH AND CURRENT_DATE AND "IDB"."OMS_ORDER"."OO_ORD_NAME" IN ('General Internal Medicine Outpatient Consult')), COHORT AS (SELECT PT_DEID AS PT_DEID FROM (SELECT ORDERS_0.PT_DEID AS PT_DEID FROM ORDERS_0)), COHORT_ORDERS AS (SELECT SUBJECT_ID AS SUBJECT_ID, PT_DEID AS PT_DEID FROM (SELECT ORDERS_0.SUBJECT_ID AS SUBJECT_ID, ORDERS_0.PT_DEID AS PT_DEID FROM ORDERS_0)), KEYS AS (SELECT COHORT.PT_DEID AS COHORT_PT_DEID, COHORT_ORDERS.SUBJECT_ID AS COHORT_ORDERS_SUBJECT_ID, COHORT_ORDERS.PT_DEID AS COHORT_ORDERS_PT_DEID FROM COHORT LEFT OUTER JOIN COHORT_ORDERS ON COHORT_ORDERS.PT_DEID = COHORT.PT_DEID), ADMISSIONS_COLUMNS AS (SELECT DISTINCT "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AS PT_DEID, "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_MRN" AS PT_MRN, "IDB"."VISIT_V"."VIS_VISIT_ID" AS SUBJECT_ID, "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AS SUBJECT_ID FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS") SELECT DISTINCT DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS.PT_MRN AS MRN, ADMISSIONS_COLUMNS.ADMIT_IN_OUT_PATIENT AS SUBJECT_ID, "IDB"."OMS_ORDER"."OO_ENTER_DTE" AS ORDER_ENTER_DATE, "IDB"."OMS_ORDER"."OO_ORD_NAME" AS ORDER_NAME FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS" JOIN "IDB"."OMS_ORDER" ON "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_MRN" = "IDB"."OMS_ORDER"."OO_MRN" WHERE "IDB"."OMS_ORDER"."OO_ORD_STS_CD" NOT IN ('CANP', 'CANC', 'AUC3') AND "IDB"."OMS_ORDER"."OO_ENTER_DTE" BETWEEN CURRENT_DATE - 1 MONTH AND CURRENT_DATE AND "IDB"."OMS_ORDER"."OO_ORD_NAME" IN ('General Internal Medicine Outpatient Consult')), COHORT AS (SELECT PT_DEID AS PT_DEID FROM (SELECT ORDERS_0.PT_DEID AS PT_DEID FROM ORDERS_0)), COHORT_ORDERS AS (SELECT SUBJECT_ID AS SUBJECT_ID, PT_DEID AS PT_DEID FROM (SELECT ORDERS_0.SUBJECT_ID AS SUBJECT_ID, ORDERS_0.PT_DEID AS PT_DEID FROM ORDERS_0)), KEYS AS (SELECT COHORT.PT_DEID AS COHORT_PT_DEID, COHORT_ORDERS.SUBJECT_ID AS COHORT_ORDERS_SUBJECT_ID, COHORT_ORDERS.PT_DEID AS COHORT_ORDERS_PT_DEID FROM COHORT LEFT OUTER JOIN COHORT_ORDERS ON COHORT_ORDERS.PT_DEID = COHORT.PT_DEID), ORDERS_COLUMNS AS (SELECT DISTINCT "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AS PT_DEID, "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_MRN" AS PT_MRN, "IDB"."OMS_ORDER"."OO_ORD_GUID" AS SUBJECT_ID, "IDB"."OMS_ORDER"."OO_ENTER_DTE" AS ORDER_ENTER_DATE, "IDB"."OMS_ORDER"."OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE" AS ORDER_SIGNIF_DATE, "IDB"."OMS_STATUS"."OSTS_STS_DESC" AS ORDER_STATUS, "IDB"."OMS_ORDER"."OO_ORD_NAME" AS ORDER_NAME, "IDB"."OMS_ORD_CATALOG"."OOC_ITEM_NAME" AS ORDER_ITEM_NAME, "IDB"."OMS_ORD_CATALOG"."OOC_ITEM_DESC" AS ORDER_ITEM_DESCRIPTION, "IDB"."OMS_ORDER"."OO_SET_NAME" AS ORDER_SET_NAME, "IDB"."OMS_PROVIDER"."OP_DISPLAY_NAME" AS ORDER_PROVIDER, "IDB"."OMS_PROVIDER"."OP_PROV_TYPE" AS ORDER_PROVIDER_TYPE FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS" JOIN "IDB"."OMS_ORDER" ON "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_MRN" = "IDB"."OMS_ORDER"."OO_MRN" JOIN "IDB"."OMS_STATUS" ON "IDB"."OMS_ORDER"."OO_ORD_STS_CD" = "IDB"."OMS_STATUS"."OSTS_ORD_STS_CD" JOIN "IDB"."OMS_ORD_CATALOG" ON "IDB"."OMS_ORDER"."OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID" = "IDB"."OMS_ORD_CATALOG"."OOC_MSTR_ITEM_GUID" LEFT OUTER JOIN "IDB"."OMS_PROVIDER" ON "IDB"."OMS_ORDER"."OO_PVDR_GUID" = "IDB"."OMS_PROVIDER"."OP_PVDR_GUID"), DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS AS (SELECT DISTINCT "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AS PT_DEID, "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_MRN" AS PT_MRN, "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AS SUBJECT_ID FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS") SELECT DISTINCT DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS.PT_MRN AS MRN, ORDERS_COLUMNS.ORDER_ENTER_DATE AS ORDER_ENTER_DATE, ORDERS_COLUMNS.ORDER_SIGNIF_DATE AS ORDER_SIGNIF_DATE, ORDERS_COLUMNS.ORDER_STATUS AS ORDER_STATUS, ORDERS_COLUMNS.ORDER_NAME AS ORDER_NAME, ORDERS_COLUMNS.ORDER_ITEM_NAME AS ORDER_ITEM_NAME, ORDERS_COLUMNS.ORDER_ITEM_DESCRIPTION AS ORDER_ITEM_DESCRIPTION, ORDERS_COLUMNS.ORDER_SET_NAME AS ORDER_SET_NAME, ORDERS_COLUMNS.ORDER_PROVIDER AS ORDER_PROVIDER, ORDERS_COLUMNS.ORDER_PROVIDER_TYPE AS ORDER_PROVIDER_TYPE FROM KEYS LEFT OUTER JOIN ORDERS_COLUMNS ON ORDERS_COLUMNS.SUBJECT_ID = KEYS.COHORT_ORDERS_SUBJECT_ID LEFT OUTER JOIN DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS ON DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS.PT_DEID = KEYS.COHORT_PT_DEID;

prompt: Provide a list of scheduled lab appointments at Koch to text for appointment changes.
completion: WITH PTS AS (SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN, CPE_CL_PT_ID FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Sch') AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN '2021-12-13' AND '2022-03-31' AND CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME = 'LAB KOCH' ) , TEXT_OPT AS (SELECT DISTINCT PAT.CPP_PT_NAME AS PATIENT_NAME, PAT.CPP_MRN AS OPT_MRN, PAT.CPP_CL_PT_ID OPT_PT_ID, CASE WHEN ((OPIN.CCP_COMMUNICATION_CONCEPT_ID = 28505 AND YESTEXT.CCPA_APRV_MEDIA = 'TEXT MESSAGE' AND NOTEXT.CCPA_APRV_MEDIA IS NULL) OR ((OPIN.CCP_COMMUNICATION_CONCEPT_ID = 28505 AND YESTEXT.CCPA_APRV_MEDIA = 'TEXT MESSAGE') AND (OPOUT.CCP_COMMUNICATION_CONCEPT_ID = 28104 AND NOTEXT.CCPA_APRV_MEDIA ='TEXT MESSAGE'))) THEN 'OPT IN' WHEN (OPOUT.CCP_COMMUNICATION_CONCEPT_ID = 28104 AND NOTEXT.CCPA_APRV_MEDIA = 'TEXT MESSAGE' AND YESTEXT.CCPA_APRV_MEDIA IS NULL) THEN 'OPT OUT' END AS COMMUNICATION_PREFERENCES FROM PTS JOIN IDB.CL_PAS_PATIENT PAT ON CPE_MRN = CPP_MRN LEFT OUTER JOIN IDB.CL_COMMUNICATION_PREFERENCES OPIN ON PAT.CPP_PREFERENCES_ID = OPIN.CCP_PREFERENCES_ID AND OPIN.CCP_COMMUNICATION_CONCEPT_ID = 28505 LEFT OUTER JOIN IDB.CL_COMMUNICATION_PREFERENCES OPOUT ON PAT.CPP_PREFERENCES_ID = OPOUT.CCP_PREFERENCES_ID AND OPOUT.CCP_COMMUNICATION_CONCEPT_ID = 28104 LEFT OUTER JOIN IDB.CL_COMM_PREFERENCES_APRV YESTEXT ON PAT.CPP_PREFERENCES_ID = YESTEXT.CCPA_PREFERENCES_ID AND YESTEXT.CCPA_APRV_MEDIA = 'TEXT MESSAGE' AND OPIN.CCP_LINE_NO = YESTEXT.CCPA_GROUP_LINE_NO LEFT OUTER JOIN IDB.CL_COMM_PREFERENCES_APRV NOTEXT ON PAT.CPP_PREFERENCES_ID = NOTEXT.CCPA_PREFERENCES_ID AND NOTEXT.CCPA_APRV_MEDIA = 'TEXT MESSAGE' AND OPOUT.CCP_LINE_NO = NOTEXT.CCPA_GROUP_LINE_NO WHERE PAT.CPP_MRN<> '' ) SELECT CPE_MRN, CPP_MOBILE_PHONE MOBILE_PHONE, COMMUNICATION_PREFERENCES, CPP_PP_LST_LGN_DTE PORTAL_LAST_LOGIN_DATE FROM PTS JOIN IDB.CL_PAS_PATIENT ON CPE_CL_PT_ID = CPP_CL_PT_ID LEFT JOIN TEXT_OPT ON CPE_CL_PT_ID = OPT_PT_ID WHERE CPP_MOBILE_PHONE NOT IN ('', '999-999-9999')

prompt: Provide a daily list of upcoming appointments of colorectal cancer patients with pulmonary metastases on radiographic imaging.
completion: WITH SCHEDVISITS AS (SELECT PT_MRN AS "MRN", TRIM(PT_LAST_NAME) AS "Last Name", TRIM(PT_FIRST_NAME) AS "First Name", CPE_ENC_DTE AS "Upcoming Appointment date", TIME(CPE_APPT_DT) AS "Appointment Time", CLD_DEPT_NAME AS "Department Name", CRE_RES_NAME AS "Provider Name", CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME AS "Visit Type" FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID AND CRE_RES_ID IN ('013789', '020727', '000117', '005751', '014431', '022335', '021238', '018440', '021030', '010744', '024166', '002642', '010124', '015487', '022855', '017178', '022277', '018218', '004283', '015016', '003509', '003699', '017202', '006635', '021568', '014035', '002766', '014365', '018226', '016360', '015677') JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON CPE_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS = 'Sch' AND CPE_MRN <> '' AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT date + 1 DAYS AND CURRENT date + 2 DAYS ), COLORECTAL_DX AS (SELECT TM_MRN, CT.TM_DX_DTE AS "Tumor Diagnosis Date", H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS "Histology Description", CT.TM_HIST_CD "Histology Code", S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS "Site Description", CT.TM_BEST_AJCC_STG AS "Clinical Stage" FROM (SELECT DISTINCT MRN FROM SCHEDVISITS) AS SCHEDVISITSMRN JOIN IDB.CDB_TUMOR CT ON MRN = CT.TM_MRN JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = CT.TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = CT.TM_SITE_CD WHERE CT.TM_SITE_CD IN ('C180', 'C182', 'C183', 'C184', 'C185', 'C186', 'C187', 'C188', 'C189', 'C199', 'C209', 'C218' ) AND CT.TM_HIST_CD IN ('M8140/3', 'M8480/3', 'M8255/3', 'M8574/3', 'M8144/3', 'M8323/3') ), RAD_REPORTS AS (SELECT "t1"."PT_MRN" AS "MRN", "t2"."RRPT_ORDER_GROUP" AS "Type of Last Radiology Report", "t2"."RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE" AS "Last Radiology Report Date" FROM (SELECT DISTINCT MRN FROM SCHEDVISITS) AS SCHEDVISITSMRN JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V" "t1" ON "t1"."PT_MRN" = MRN LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED" "t3" ON "t1"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t3"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."RADIOLOGY_REPORT_V" "t2" ON "t3"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t2"."RRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" WHERE "t2"."RRPT_ORDER_GROUP" IN ('CT', 'MR', 'PET CT for Cancer') AND CONTAINS("t2"."RRPT_REPORT_TXT", '("pulmonary metastasis" OR "pulmonary metastases" OR "lung nodule" OR "possibly metastatic" OR "suspicious for metastasis")') = 1 AND "t2"."RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE" >= '2019-1-1' AND "t2"."RRPT_REPORT_TXT" IS NOT NULL AND "t2"."RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE" = (SELECT MAX("t21"."RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE") FROM "DV"."RADIOLOGY_REPORT_V" "t21" WHERE "t21"."RRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID"="t2"."RRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AND "t21"."RRPT_ORDER_GROUP" IN ('CT', 'MR', 'PET CT for Cancer') AND CONTAINS("t21"."RRPT_REPORT_TXT", '("pulmonary metastasis" OR "pulmonary metastases" OR "lung nodule" OR "possibly metastatic" OR "suspicious for metastasis")') = 1 AND "t21"."RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE" >= '2019-1-1' AND "t21"."RRPT_REPORT_TXT" IS NOT NULL) ), SURGPATH_REPORTS AS (SELECT "t1"."PT_MRN" AS "MRN", MAX("t2"."DT_DTE") AS "Last Surgical Path Report Date" FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V" "t1" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED" "t4" ON "t1"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t4"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V" "t5" ON "t4"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t5"."PRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" "t2" ON "t5"."PRPT_REPORT_DATE_ID" = "t2"."DT_DATE_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATH_RPRT_TYPE_LOOKUP" "t3" ON "t5"."PRPT_REPORT_TYPE" = "t3"."PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_CD" WHERE "t3"."PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_DESC" IN ('Surgical Pathology', 'Surgical Pathology Breast', 'Surgical Pathology Consult', 'Surgical Pathology Molecular Genetics') GROUP BY "PT_MRN") SELECT V.*, R."Type of Last Radiology Report", "Last Radiology Report Date", S."Last Surgical Path Report Date", C."Tumor Diagnosis Date", C."Histology Description", C."Site Description", C."Clinical Stage" FROM SCHEDVISITS V JOIN COLORECTAL_DX C ON V.MRN=C.TM_MRN LEFT JOIN RAD_REPORTS R ON V.MRN=R.MRN LEFT JOIN SURGPATH_REPORTS S ON S.MRN=V.MRN

prompt: Provide a list of H or S class cases from 07/2012 to 07/2022 that are CD30+.
completion: WITH X AS (SELECT DISTINCT "t1"."PT_MRN" AS "MRN", PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_BIRTH_DTE AS DOB, "t2"."PRPT_ACCESSION_NO" AS "Pathology Report", PRPT_REPORT_TYPE, "t3"."PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_DESC" AS "Pathology Report Type", YEAR("t4"."DT_DTE") AS YR, "t4"."DT_DTE" AS "Pathology Procedure Date", "t5"."DT_DTE" AS "Pathology Report Date", UPPER(CASE WHEN LENGTH(PRPT_REPORT) <= 15000 THEN RTRIM(CAST(SUBSTR(PRPT_REPORT, 1, 15000) AS VARCHAR(15000))) ELSE CAST(SUBSTR(PRPT_REPORT, 1, 15000) AS VARCHAR(15000)) END) AS TXT, CASE WHEN UPPER(DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)DIAGNOSIS:[\w\W]*(?=NOTE:)', PRPT_REPORT)) <> '' THEN UPPER(DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)DIAGNOSIS:[\w\W]*(?=NOTE:)', PRPT_REPORT)) WHEN UPPER(DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)DIAGNOSIS:[\w\W]*(?=I ATTEST)', PRPT_REPORT)) <> '' THEN UPPER(DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)DIAGNOSIS:[\w\W]*(?=I ATTEST)', PRPT_REPORT)) WHEN UPPER(DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)DIAGNOSIS:[\w\W]*(?=REPORT ELECTRONICALLY SIGNED OUT )', PRPT_REPORT)) <> '' THEN UPPER(DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)DIAGNOSIS:[\w\W]*(?=REPORT ELECTRONICALLY SIGNED OUT )', PRPT_REPORT)) END AS DIAGNOSIS, CASE WHEN UPPER(DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)SPECIMENS SUBMITTED[\w\W]*(?=DIAGNOSIS:)', PRPT_REPORT)) <> '' THEN UPPER(DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)SPECIMENS SUBMITTED[\w\W]*(?=DIAGNOSIS:)', PRPT_REPORT)) WHEN UPPER(DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)SPECIMENSSUBMITTED[\w\W]*(?=DIAGNOSIS:)', PRPT_REPORT)) <> '' THEN UPPER(DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)SPECIMENSSUBMITTED[\w\W]*(?=DIAGNOSIS:)', PRPT_REPORT)) END AS "SPECIMENS SUBMITTED" FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V" "t1" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED" "t6" ON "t1"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t6"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V" "t2" ON "t6"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t2"."PRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATH_RPRT_TYPE_LOOKUP" "t3" ON "t2"."PRPT_REPORT_TYPE" = "t3"."PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_CD" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" "t4" ON "t2"."PRPT_PROCEDURE_DATE_ID" = "t4"."DT_DATE_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" "t5" ON "t2"."PRPT_REPORT_DATE_ID" = "t5"."DT_DATE_ID" WHERE 1=1 AND CONTAINS("t2"."PRPT_REPORT", '("CD30 POS" OR "CD30+" OR "CD30 +")') = 1 AND "t2"."PRPT_REPORT" IS NOT NULL AND("t2"."PRPT_ACCESSION_NO" LIKE 'H%' OR "t2"."PRPT_ACCESSION_NO" LIKE 'S%') AND PRPT_REPORT_TYPE not like '%SSL%' AND "t4"."DT_DTE" BETWEEN '2012-07-01' AND '2022-07-31' ) SELECT * FROM X

prompt: Identify bladder cancer patients who receive radiotherapy
completion: WITH TUMOR AS (SELECT TM_MRN, TM_DX_DTE FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS ON AV_ELEMENT = 'CASE_STS' AND AV_CODE = TM_CASE_STS WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND SUBSTR(TM_SITE_CD, 1, 3) = 'C67' AND RIGHT(TRIM(TM_HIST_CD), 1) = '3' AND TM_DX_DTE BETWEEN '2000-01-01' AND '2017-12-13' ) , PTS AS (SELECT PT_MRN , TM_DX_DTE AS CANCER_DX_DTE , PT_DATE_OF_DEATH , PLA_LST_CON_DTE , PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH FROM IDB.PATIENT JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY ON PT_MRN = PLA_MRN JOIN TUMOR ON PT_MRN = TM_MRN ) , CHEMO AS (SELECT APR_MRN, MIN(APR_START_DTE) AS CHEMO_START_DTE, MAX(APR_START_DTE) AS CHEMO_STOP_DTE, CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME AS CHEMO_NAME FROM IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX_V JOIN PTS ON APR_MRN = PT_MRN AND APR_START_DTE >= CANCER_DX_DTE WHERE CDG_CHEMO_FLAG = 'Y' AND APR_START_DTE BETWEEN '2000-01-01' AND '2017-12-13' GROUP BY APR_MRN, CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME ) , CTE AS (SELECT DISTINCT RTC_TX_MRN AS MRN, CANCER_DX_DTE, RTC_TX_COURSE_ID AS RT_COURSE_ID, RTC_TX_START_DTE AS RT_START, RTC_TX_STOP_DTE AS RT_STOP, RTC_TX_PLAN_NAME AS RT_PLAN_NAME, RTC_PRIMARY_REF_POINT AS PRIMARY_REF_POINT, RTC_TX_PLANNED_DOSE AS RT_PLANNED_DOSE, RTC_TX_DELIVERED_DOSE AS DELIVERED_DOSE, RTC_TX_PLANNED_FRACTIONS AS RT_PLANNED_FRACTIONS, RTC_TX_DELIVERED_FRACTIONS AS RT_DELIVERED_FRACTIONS, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH DATE_OF_BIRTH, PT_DATE_OF_DEATH DATE_OF_DEATH, PLA_LST_CON_DTE AS LAST_ENC_DTE, CASE WHEN APR_MRN IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE 'Y' END AS CHEMO_IND, CASE WHEN AC_IRB_NO IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE 'Y' END AS "12-245 IND" FROM IDB.RADONC_TREATMENT_COURSE JOIN PTS ON RTC_TX_MRN = PT_MRN AND RTC_TX_START_DTE >= CANCER_DX_DTE LEFT JOIN CHEMO ON RTC_TX_MRN = APR_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.ACCRUALS ON RTC_TX_MRN = AC_MRN AND AC_IRB_NO = '12-245' WHERE RTC_TX_STOP_DTE BETWEEN '2000-01-01' AND '2017-12-13' ) , LABS AS (SELECT LR_MRN, LR_PERFORMED_DTE, LR_RESULT_VALUE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY LR_MRN ORDER BY LR_PERFORMED_DTE DESC) AS RN FROM IDB.LAB_RESULTS JOIN CTE ON LR_MRN = MRN AND LR_PERFORMED_DTE <= RT_START WHERE LR_SUBTEST_NAME IN ('Creatinine', 'Creatinine.') ) SELECT MRN, CANCER_DX_DTE, LR_PERFORMED_DTE AS CREATININE_DRAW_DTE, LR_RESULT_VALUE "Creatinine mg/dL", RT_COURSE_ID, RT_START, RT_STOP, RT_PLAN_NAME, PRIMARY_REF_POINT, RT_PLANNED_DOSE, DELIVERED_DOSE, RT_PLANNED_FRACTIONS, RT_DELIVERED_FRACTIONS, DATE_OF_BIRTH, DATE_OF_DEATH, LAST_ENC_DTE, CHEMO_IND, "12-245 IND" FROM CTE LEFT JOIN LABS ON MRN = LR_MRN AND RN=1 ; WITH TUMOR AS (SELECT TM_MRN, TM_DX_DTE FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS ON AV_ELEMENT = 'CASE_STS' AND AV_CODE = TM_CASE_STS WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND SUBSTR(TM_SITE_CD, 1, 3) = 'C67' AND RIGHT(TRIM(TM_HIST_CD), 1) = '3' AND TM_DX_DTE BETWEEN '2000-01-01' AND '2017-12-13' ) , PTS AS (SELECT PT_MRN , TM_DX_DTE AS CANCER_DX_DTE , PT_DATE_OF_DEATH , PLA_LST_CON_DTE , PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH FROM IDB.PATIENT JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY ON PT_MRN = PLA_MRN JOIN TUMOR ON PT_MRN = TM_MRN ) , CHEMO AS (SELECT APR_MRN, MIN(APR_START_DTE) AS CHEMO_START_DTE, MAX(APR_START_DTE) AS CHEMO_STOP_DTE, CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME AS CHEMO_NAME FROM IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX_V JOIN PTS ON APR_MRN = PT_MRN AND APR_START_DTE >= CANCER_DX_DTE WHERE CDG_CHEMO_FLAG = 'Y' AND APR_START_DTE BETWEEN '2000-01-01' AND '2017-12-13' GROUP BY APR_MRN, CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME ) SELECT DISTINCT RTC_TX_MRN AS MRN, CANCER_DX_DTE, CHEMO_START_DTE, CHEMO_STOP_DTE, CHEMO_NAME FROM IDB.RADONC_TREATMENT_COURSE JOIN PTS ON RTC_TX_MRN = PT_MRN AND RTC_TX_START_DTE >= CANCER_DX_DTE JOIN CHEMO ON RTC_TX_MRN = APR_MRN WHERE RTC_TX_STOP_DTE BETWEEN '2000-01-01' AND '2017-12-13' ; WITH TUMOR AS (SELECT TM_MRN, TM_DX_DTE FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS ON AV_ELEMENT = 'CASE_STS' AND AV_CODE = TM_CASE_STS WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND SUBSTR(TM_SITE_CD, 1, 3) = 'C67' AND RIGHT(TRIM(TM_HIST_CD), 1) = '3' AND TM_DX_DTE BETWEEN '2000-01-01' AND '2017-12-13' ) , PTS AS (SELECT PT_MRN , TM_DX_DTE AS CANCER_DX_DTE , PT_DATE_OF_DEATH , PLA_LST_CON_DTE , PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH FROM IDB.PATIENT JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY ON PT_MRN = PLA_MRN JOIN TUMOR ON PT_MRN = TM_MRN ) , CHEMO AS (SELECT APR_MRN, MIN(APR_START_DTE) AS CHEMO_START_DTE, MAX(APR_START_DTE) AS CHEMO_STOP_DTE, CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME AS CHEMO_NAME FROM IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX_V JOIN PTS ON APR_MRN = PT_MRN AND APR_START_DTE >= CANCER_DX_DTE WHERE CDG_CHEMO_FLAG = 'Y' AND APR_START_DTE BETWEEN '2000-01-01' AND '2017-12-13' GROUP BY APR_MRN, CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME ) , CTE AS (SELECT DISTINCT RTC_TX_MRN AS MRN FROM IDB.RADONC_TREATMENT_COURSE JOIN PTS ON RTC_TX_MRN = PT_MRN AND RTC_TX_START_DTE >= CANCER_DX_DTE LEFT JOIN CHEMO ON RTC_TX_MRN = APR_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.ACCRUALS ON RTC_TX_MRN = AC_MRN AND AC_IRB_NO = '12-245' WHERE RTC_TX_STOP_DTE BETWEEN '2000-01-01' AND '2017-12-13' ) SELECT CDD_DOC_NAME AS "Document Name", CDD_SERVICE_DTE AS "Service Date", CDD_MRN AS "MRN", CDD_DOC_GUID AS "Document Guid", CDO_SECTION AS "Section", CDO_ITEM_NAME AS "Item", CDO_VALUE_TEXT AS "Value" FROM IDB.CD_DOCUMENT JOIN CTE ON CDD_MRN = MRN JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION ON CDD_DOC_GUID = CDO_DOC_GUID AND CDD_AUTHORED_DTE = CDO_AUTHORED_DTE AND CDO_VALUE_TEXT <> '' AND (UPPER(CDO_SECTION) like '%MED%HIST%' OR UPPER(CDO_SECTION) like '%SUR%HIST%') WHERE CDD_CANCEL_IND <> '1' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND <> '1' AND CDD_SERVICE_DTE BETWEEN '2000-01-01' AND '2017-12-13'

prompt: There us critical shortage of cisplatin, we need patient data to order drug weekly.
completion: WITH MAIN AS (SELECT DISTINCT APR_MRN "MRN", TRIM(PT_LAST_NAME)||', '||TRIM(PT_FIRST_NAME) AS "PATIENT NAME", APR_START_DTE "START DATE", CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME "COMMON GENERIC NAME", APR_PRESCRIBED_DOSE "DOSE", APR_DOSE_UOM "UOM", APR_DURATION "DURATION", OO_SET_NAME "ORDER SET NAME", OSTS_STS_DESC "ORDER STATUS DESC", OO_ENTER_ROLE "ORDER ENTER ROLE", OO_CREATE_BY "ORDER CREATED BY" FROM IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX_V JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON APR_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.OMS_ORDER ON APR_MRN = OO_MRN JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_CATALOG ON OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID = OOC_MSTR_ITEM_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_STATUS ON OO_ORD_STS_CD = OSTS_ORD_STS_CD WHERE CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME IN ('CISPLATIN') AND OO_ORD_STS_CD NOT IN ('CANP', 'CANC', 'AUC3') AND OSTS_STS_DESC IN ('Active', 'Hold', 'Pending Attending''s Approval', 'Pending Chemo RN Verification', 'Pending Chemo RPh Verification') AND APR_START_DTE BETWEEN '2023-03-01' AND '2023-11-03' ) SELECT DISTINCT MRN , "PATIENT NAME" , "START DATE" , "COMMON GENERIC NAME" , "DOSE" , "UOM" , "DURATION" , "ORDER SET NAME" , "ORDER STATUS DESC" , "ORDER ENTER ROLE" , "ORDER CREATED BY" FROM MAIN WHERE "START DATE" BETWEEN CURRENT DATE - 7 DAY AND CURRENT DATE

prompt: We are requesting a list of patients and their email addresses who've had penile implant surgery with Dr. Mulhall to send satisfaction surveys via RedCap as part of X22-034.
completion: SELECT DISTINCT SSE_MRN AS MRN, PT_EMAIL_ADDRESS AS "Email Address", SSE_SURG_DTE AS "Surgery Date", SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD AS "CPT Code", SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC AS "CPT Description", TRIM(SSP_SURG_LAST_NM) || ', ' || TRIM(SSP_SURG_FIRST_NM) AS "Surgeon's Name" FROM IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE ON SSE_LOG_ID = SSP_LOG_ID JOIN IDB.PATIENT P ON PT_MRN=SSE_MRN WHERE SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD = '54405' AND TRIM(SSP_SURG_LAST_NM) || ', ' || TRIM(SSP_SURG_FIRST_NM) = 'MULHALL, JOHN P' ORDER BY 3

prompt: Provide an extract of pathology reports for all patients with an accession number like 'S10%' and who have exclusively case status '0' records in IDB.CDB_Tumor.
completion: WITH ACC AS (SELECT DISTINCT "t1"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AS "Deident PT #", "t2"."COHORT_ID" AS "Cohort ID", "t3"."PRPT_ACCESSION_NO" AS "Pathology Report" FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED" "t1" LEFT JOIN "EUBANKM"."COHORT_ACTIVE_REPORTING_V" "t2" ON "t1"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t2"."PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V" "t3" ON "t1"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t3"."PRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" WHERE ("t2"."COHORT_ID" = 85 AND ("t3"."PRPT_ACCESSION_NO" like 'S10%')) ) SELECT DISTINCT "t1"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AS "Deident PT #", "t2"."PRPT_ACCESSION_NO" AS "Pathology Report", YEAR("t3"."DT_DTE") AS "Pathology Report Year", "t3"."DT_DTE" AS "Pathology Report Date", "t4"."PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_DESC" AS "Pathology Report Type", CASE WHEN LENGTH("t2"."PRPT_REPORT") <= 15000 THEN RTRIM(CAST(SUBSTR(REPLACE("t2"."PRPT_REPORT", CHR(26), '-'), 1, 15000) AS VARCHAR(15000))) ELSE CAST(SUBSTR("t2"."PRPT_REPORT", 1, 10000) AS VARCHAR(15000)) END "path_prpt_p1", CASE WHEN LENGTH("t2"."PRPT_REPORT") > 15000 THEN RTRIM(CAST(SUBSTR(REPLACE("t2"."PRPT_REPORT", CHR(26), '-'), 15001, 15000) AS VARCHAR(15000))) ELSE '' END "path_prpt_p2", "t5"."PT_MRN" AS "MRN", "t5".PT_LAST_NAME || ', ' || "t5".PT_FIRST_NAME AS "Patient Name" FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED" "t1" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V" "t2" ON "t1"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t2"."PRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" INNER JOIN ACC A ON "t2".PRPT_ACCESSION_NO = A."Pathology Report" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE" "t3" ON "t2"."PRPT_REPORT_DATE_ID" = "t3"."DT_DATE_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATH_RPRT_TYPE_LOOKUP" "t4" ON "t2"."PRPT_REPORT_TYPE" = "t4"."PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_CD" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V" "t5" ON "t1"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t5"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" WHERE LEFT("t5".PT_LAST_NAME, 1) IN (#PROMPTMANY('FirstLetterOfLastName')#) ORDER BY "t5"."PT_MRN"

prompt: Patients who have been prescribed oral minoxidil by dermatology for alopecia.
completion: WITH MED AS (SELECT HCPR_MRN , OP_DISPLAY_NAME , HCPR_CREATED_DTE , HCPR_PRESCRIPTION_TYPE , DATE(HCPR_DISCONTINUE_DT) HCPR_DISCONTINUE_DTE FROM IDB.HML_CLIENT_PRESCRIPTION JOIN IDB.HML_GENERIC_NAME ON HCPR_GENERIC_NAME_ID = HGN_GENERIC_NAME_ID AND HGN_GENERIC_NAME_ID = '134' JOIN IDB.OMS_PROVIDER ON HCPR_CARE_PROV_GUID = OP_PVDR_GUID JOIN IDB.HML_RX_UNIT_OF_MEASURE ON HCPR_DOSE_UOM_ID = HRUM_RXUOM_ID WHERE HCPR_ROUTE LIKE 'oral%' AND (HCPR_CREATED_DTE <> DATE(HCPR_DISCONTINUE_DT) OR HCPR_DISCONTINUE_DT IS NULL) AND HCPR_CREATED_DTE BETWEEN '2019-10-01' AND '2020-02-19' AND HCPR_PRESCRIPTION_TYPE_DESC = 'eRx' ) , APPT AS (SELECT CPE_MRN, CPE_ENC_DTE, CRE_RES_NAME FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID JOIN MED ON CPE_MRN = HCPR_MRN AND HCPR_CREATED_DTE BETWEEN CPE_ENC_DTE AND CPE_ENC_DTE + 1 DAY WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 = 'MED' AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 = 'DER' ) , PTS AS (SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, PT_SEX, CASE WHEN COALESCE(R.AV_DESC, CR.AV_DESC) IN ('WHITE', 'WHITE HISPANIC') THEN 'White' WHEN COALESCE(R.AV_DESC, CR.AV_DESC) IN ('BLACK OR AFRICAN AMERICAN', 'BLACK', 'BLACK HISPANIC') THEN 'Black' WHEN COALESCE(R.AV_DESC, CR.AV_DESC) IN ('ASIAN-FAR EAST/INDIAN SUBCONT', 'KAMPUCHEAN', 'LAOTIAN', 'VIETNAMESE', 'HMONG', 'CHINESE', 'ASIAN INDIAN PAKISTANI', 'JAPANESE', 'KOREAN', 'OTHER ASIAN', 'THAI') THEN 'Asian' WHEN COALESCE(R.AV_DESC, CR.AV_DESC) IN ('NATIVE AMERICAN-AM IND/ALASKA', 'AMER IND ALEUT ESKIMO') THEN 'Native American or Alaska Native' WHEN COALESCE(R.AV_DESC, CR.AV_DESC) IN ('NATIVE HAWAIIAN OR PACIFIC ISL', 'HAWAIIAN', 'MELANESIAN', 'MICRONESIAN', 'FIJI ISLANDER', 'FILIPINO', 'GUAMANIAN', 'PACIFIC ISLANDER') THEN 'Native Hawaiian or Other Pacific Islander' ELSE 'Unspecified' END AS PT_RACE, CASE WHEN COALESCE(CE.AV_DESC, E.AV_DESC) IN ('SPANISH NOS; HISPANIC NOS, LATINO NOS', 'HISPANIC OR LATINO', 'PUERTO RICAN', 'SOUTH/CENTRAL AMERICA (EXCEPT BRAZIL)', 'DOMINICAN REPUBLIC', 'OTHER SPANISH/HISPANIC(INCL EUROPEAN; EXCL DOM REP)', 'CUBAN', 'MEXICAN (INCLUDES CHICANO)') OR COALESCE(R.AV_DESC, CR.AV_DESC) IN ('WHITE HISPANIC', 'BLACK HISPANIC') THEN 'Hispanic' WHEN COALESCE(CE.AV_DESC, E.AV_DESC) IN ('NOT HISPANIC', 'SPANISH SURNAME ONLY', 'NON-SPANISH; NON-HISPANIC') THEN 'Non-Hispanic' ELSE 'Unspecified' END AS PT_ETHNICITY FROM IDB.PATIENT JOIN MED ON PT_MRN = HCPR_MRN JOIN APPT ON PT_MRN = CPE_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS R ON R.AV_ELEMENT = 'RACE' AND R.AV_CODE = PT_RACE LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS E ON E.AV_ELEMENT = 'PT_ETHNICITY' AND E.AV_CODE = PT_PT_ETHNICITY LEFT JOIN IDB.CDB_PATIENT ON PT_MRN = CP_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS CR ON CR.AV_ELEMENT = 'CDB_RACE' AND CR.AV_CODE = CP_CDB_RACE LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS CE ON CE.AV_ELEMENT = 'ETHNICITY' AND CE.AV_CODE = CP_ETHNICITY) , TUMOR AS (SELECT TM_MRN, TM_DX_DTE, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS HIST_DESC, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_DESC, ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY TM_MRN ORDER BY TM_DX_DTE DESC) AS T_RN FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN MED ON TM_MRN = HCPR_MRN AND TM_DX_DTE <= HCPR_CREATED_DTE JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND RIGHT(TRIM(TM_HIST_CD), 1) = '3' ) , ICD_CA AS (SELECT CC_MRN , MIN_ICD_EFF_DTE , ICD_SEER_GROUP2 , ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY CC_MRN ORDER BY MIN_ICD_EFF_DTE DESC) AS C_RN FROM (SELECT CC_MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS MIN_ICD_EFF_DTE, CATEGORY2 AS ICD_SEER_GROUP2 FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.SEERGROUPING ON CLM_CLSF_RECODE = RECODE AND CLM_CLSF_TYPE IN ('I9', 'I0') AND CLM_CD_TYPE = 'D' JOIN MED ON CC_MRN = HCPR_MRN WHERE SUBSTR(CC_CLSF_CD, 1, 3) BETWEEN 'C00' AND 'D48' AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND (CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) AND CATEGORY1 NOT IN ('Non-Cancer', 'Miscellaneous') GROUP BY CC_MRN, CATEGORY1, CATEGORY2, HCPR_CREATED_DTE HAVING MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) <= HCPR_CREATED_DTE)) SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN AS MRN , PT_LAST_NAME , PT_FIRST_NAME , PT_SEX , PT_RACE , PT_ETHNICITY , YEAR(HCPR_CREATED_DTE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) AS AGE_AT_MINOX , OP_DISPLAY_NAME AS DERM_PROVIDER , HCPR_CREATED_DTE AS MINOX_RX_DTE , HCPR_DISCONTINUE_DTE AS MINOX_DISCONTINUE_DTE , COALESCE(TM_DX_DTE, MIN_ICD_EFF_DTE) AS CANCER_DX_DTE , HIST_DESC AS CANCER_HIST , COALESCE(SITE_DESC, ICD_SEER_GROUP2) AS CANCER_SITE FROM PTS JOIN MED ON PT_MRN = HCPR_MRN LEFT JOIN TUMOR ON PT_MRN = TM_MRN AND T_RN = 1 LEFT JOIN ICD_CA ON PT_MRN = CC_MRN AND C_RN = 1 ^ WITH MED AS (SELECT HCPR_MRN , OP_DISPLAY_NAME , HCPR_CREATED_DTE , HCPR_PRESCRIPTION_TYPE , DATE(HCPR_DISCONTINUE_DT) HCPR_DISCONTINUE_DTE FROM IDB.HML_CLIENT_PRESCRIPTION JOIN IDB.HML_GENERIC_NAME ON HCPR_GENERIC_NAME_ID = HGN_GENERIC_NAME_ID AND HGN_GENERIC_NAME_ID = '134' JOIN IDB.OMS_PROVIDER ON HCPR_CARE_PROV_GUID = OP_PVDR_GUID JOIN IDB.HML_RX_UNIT_OF_MEASURE ON HCPR_DOSE_UOM_ID = HRUM_RXUOM_ID WHERE HCPR_ROUTE LIKE 'oral%' AND (HCPR_CREATED_DTE <> DATE(HCPR_DISCONTINUE_DT) OR HCPR_DISCONTINUE_DT IS NULL) AND HCPR_CREATED_DTE BETWEEN '2019-10-01' AND '2020-02-19' AND HCPR_PRESCRIPTION_TYPE_DESC = 'eRx' ) , APPT AS (SELECT CPE_MRN, CPE_ENC_DTE, CRE_RES_NAME FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID JOIN MED ON CPE_MRN = HCPR_MRN AND HCPR_CREATED_DTE BETWEEN CPE_ENC_DTE AND CPE_ENC_DTE + 1 DAY WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 = 'MED' AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 = 'DER' ) SELECT DISTINCT RTC_TX_MRN AS MRN, RTC_TX_PLAN_NAME AS RT_SITE, RTC_TX_DELIVERED_FRACTIONS AS DELIVERED_FRACTIONS, RTC_TX_DELIVERED_DOSE AS DELIVERED_DOSE, RTC_TX_START_DTE AS RT_START_DTE, RTC_TX_STOP_DTE AS RT_STOP_DTE FROM IDB.RADONC_TREATMENT_COURSE JOIN MED ON RTC_TX_MRN = HCPR_MRN JOIN APPT ON RTC_TX_MRN = CPE_MRN ^ WITH MED AS (SELECT HCPR_MRN , OP_DISPLAY_NAME , HCPR_CREATED_DTE , HCPR_PRESCRIPTION_TYPE , DATE(HCPR_DISCONTINUE_DT) HCPR_DISCONTINUE_DTE FROM IDB.HML_CLIENT_PRESCRIPTION JOIN IDB.HML_GENERIC_NAME ON HCPR_GENERIC_NAME_ID = HGN_GENERIC_NAME_ID AND HGN_GENERIC_NAME_ID = '134' JOIN IDB.OMS_PROVIDER ON HCPR_CARE_PROV_GUID = OP_PVDR_GUID JOIN IDB.HML_RX_UNIT_OF_MEASURE ON HCPR_DOSE_UOM_ID = HRUM_RXUOM_ID WHERE HCPR_ROUTE LIKE 'oral%' AND (HCPR_CREATED_DTE <> DATE(HCPR_DISCONTINUE_DT) OR HCPR_DISCONTINUE_DT IS NULL) AND HCPR_CREATED_DTE BETWEEN '2019-10-01' AND '2020-02-19' AND HCPR_PRESCRIPTION_TYPE_DESC = 'eRx' ) , APPT AS (SELECT CPE_MRN, CPE_ENC_DTE, CRE_RES_NAME FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID JOIN MED ON CPE_MRN = HCPR_MRN AND HCPR_CREATED_DTE BETWEEN CPE_ENC_DTE AND CPE_ENC_DTE + 1 DAY WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 = 'MED' AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 = 'DER' ) SELECT DISTINCT APR_MRN AS MRN, APR_START_DTE AS ANP_START_DTE, CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME AS ANP_NAME, APR_TOTAL_GIVEN_DOSE AS TOTAL_GIVEN_DOSE, APR_DOSE_UOM AS DOSE_UNIT, APR_ROUTE AS ROUTE, CDG_CHEMO_FLAG AS CHEMO_FLAG, CDG_BIOLOGIC_IMMUNO_FLAG AS IMMUNOTHERA_FLAG, CDG_TARGETED_FLAG AS TARGETED_FLAG, CDG_HORMONE_FLAG AS HORMONE_FLAG, CDG_BONE_AGENTS_FLAG AS BONE_AGENTS_FLAG FROM IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX_V JOIN MED ON APR_MRN = HCPR_MRN JOIN APPT ON APR_MRN = CPE_MRN WHERE TRIM(APR_PLACEBO_FLAG) = ''

prompt: Provide a daily report of all patients diagnosed with non-small cell lung cancer, small cell lung cancer, prostate cancer, and urothelial carcinoma who had their first dose of an immune checkpoint inhibitor and a Complete Metabolic Panel completed the previous day
completion: WITH CMP AS (SELECT DISTINCT LR_MRN , LR_TEST_NAME , LR_PERFORMED_DTE FROM IDB.LAB_RESULTS WHERE LR_PERFORMED_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT DATE - 2 DAY AND CURRENT DATE AND (LR_TEST_NAME = 'Comprehensive Metabolic Panel' OR LR_TEST_NAME IN ('Comp. Metabolic Panel & Conj Bilirubin', 'Comp. Metabolic Panel & Conj Bilirubin, Plasma', 'Comp. Metabolic Panel & Direct Bilirubin', 'Comp. Metabolic Panel & Direct Bilirubin, Plasma')) ) ,APR AS (SELECT DISTINCT APR_MRN , CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME AS DRUG_NAME , APR_DIAGNOSIS_DESC , MIN(APR_START_DTE) AS IMM_START_DTE , MAX(APR_START_DTE) AS IMM_END_DTE FROM IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX_V JOIN CMP ON APR_MRN = LR_MRN WHERE (UPPER(CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME) LIKE '%IPILIMUMAB%' OR UPPER(CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME) LIKE '%NIVOLUMAB%' OR UPPER(CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME) LIKE '%PEMBROLIZUMAB%' OR UPPER(CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME) LIKE '%DURVALUMAB%' OR UPPER(CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME) LIKE '%TREMELIMUMAB%' OR UPPER(CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME) LIKE '%AVELUMAB%' OR UPPER(CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME) LIKE '%ATEZOLIZUMAB%' OR UPPER(CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME) LIKE '%CEMIPLIMAB%' ) AND (UPPER(APR_DIAGNOSIS_DESC) LIKE ('%SCLC%') OR UPPER(APR_DIAGNOSIS_DESC) LIKE ('%NSCLC%') OR UPPER(APR_DIAGNOSIS_DESC) LIKE ('%PROSTATE%') OR UPPER(APR_DIAGNOSIS_DESC) LIKE ('%UROTHELIAL%') OR UPPER(APR_DIAGNOSIS_DESC) LIKE ('%LUNG%')) GROUP BY APR_MRN , CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME, APR_DIAGNOSIS_DESC HAVING MIN(APR_START_DTE) BETWEEN CURRENT DATE - 1 DAY AND CURRENT DATE) SELECT DISTINCT LR_MRN , LR_TEST_NAME , LR_PERFORMED_DTE , DRUG_NAME , IMM_START_DTE , IMM_END_DTE , APR_DIAGNOSIS_DESC FROM CMP JOIN APR ON LR_MRN = APR_MRN

prompt: Provide a list of all TNBC breast cancer patients diagnosed since 1/1/2022 who had neoadjuvant chemotherapy and ended up having residual disease.
completion: WITH DX1 AS (SELECT DISTINCT TM_MRN AS DX_MRN, TM_DX_DTE AS DX_DATE, TM_SITE_CD AS SITE_CODE, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_DESC, TM_HIST_CD AS HIST_CODE, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS HIST_DESC FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.SEERGROUPING ON RECODE = IDB.SEERF_ICDO(TM_SITE_CD, TM_HIST_CD) AND CATEGORY1 = 'Breast' JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD WHERE 1=1 AND TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND TM_DX_DTE >= '2022-01-01' UNION SELECT CC_MRN AS DX_MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS DX_DATE, CLM_CLSF_CD AS SITE_CODE, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_DESC, '' AS HIST_CODE, '' AS HIST_DESC FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND ((CC_PT_TYPE = 'I') OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) AND CLM_CLSF_CD like 'C50%' AND CC_MRN NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT TM_MRN FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.SEERGROUPING ON RECODE = IDB.SEERF_ICDO(TM_SITE_CD, TM_HIST_CD) AND CATEGORY1 = 'Breast' JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD WHERE 1=1 AND TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND TM_DX_DTE >= '2022-01-01') GROUP BY CC_MRN, CLM_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK, '', '' HAVING MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) >= '2022-01-01') , DX2 AS (SELECT DX_MRN, MIN(DX_DATE) AS DX_DATE FROM DX1 GROUP BY DX_MRN) , APR AS (SELECT APR_MRN, CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME, MIN(APR_START_DTE) AS START_DATE FROM DX2 JOIN IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX_V ON APR_MRN = DX_MRN WHERE CDG_CHEMO_FLAG = 'Y' GROUP BY APR_MRN, CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME ) , CHEMO AS (SELECT APR_MRN, LISTAGG(COALESCE(STRIP(CAST(START_DATE AS VARCHAR(12000))), '') || ' | ' || COALESCE(STRIP(CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME), '') , CHR(13) || CHR(10)) WITHIN GROUP( ORDER BY APR_MRN, START_DATE, CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME) AS "Chemo (Start Date | Name)" FROM APR GROUP BY APR_MRN) , X AS (SELECT DISTINCT APR_MRN AS MRN FROM CHEMO) , ER_PR_HER AS (SELECT CDD_MRN, CDD_DOC_GUID, CDD_DOC_NAME, CDD_SERVICE_DTE, CDO_ITEM_NAME, CDO_VALUE_TEXT FROM X JOIN IDB.CD_DOCUMENT ON CDD_MRN = MRN JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION ON CDD_DOC_GUID = CDO_DOC_GUID AND CDD_AUTHORED_DTE = CDO_AUTHORED_DTE WHERE 1=1 AND CDD_CANCEL_IND <> '1' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND <> '1' AND UPPER(CDD_DOC_NAME) like '%BREAST%' AND CDO_ITEM_NAME IN ('HER2:', 'ER:', 'PR:', 'T', 'T:', 'N', 'N:', 'M', 'M:', 'Staging') AND CDD_SERVICE_DTE >= '2022-01-01' ) , ER AS (SELECT CDD_MRN ER_MRN, CDD_SERVICE_DTE, CDO_VALUE_TEXT ER FROM (SELECT CDD_MRN, CDD_SERVICE_DTE, CDO_VALUE_TEXT, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CDD_MRN ORDER BY CDD_SERVICE_DTE DESC) RN FROM ER_PR_HER WHERE CDO_ITEM_NAME = 'ER:' ) WHERE RN = 1 ) , PR AS (SELECT CDD_MRN PR_MRN, CDD_SERVICE_DTE, CDO_VALUE_TEXT PR FROM (SELECT CDD_MRN, CDD_SERVICE_DTE, CDO_VALUE_TEXT, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CDD_MRN ORDER BY CDD_SERVICE_DTE DESC) RN FROM ER_PR_HER WHERE CDO_ITEM_NAME = 'PR:' ) WHERE RN = 1 ) , HER2 AS (SELECT CDD_MRN HER2_MRN, CDD_SERVICE_DTE, CDO_VALUE_TEXT HER2 FROM (SELECT CDD_MRN, CDD_SERVICE_DTE, CDO_VALUE_TEXT, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CDD_MRN ORDER BY CDD_SERVICE_DTE DESC) RN FROM ER_PR_HER WHERE CDO_ITEM_NAME = 'HER2:' ) WHERE RN = 1 ) , T AS (SELECT CDD_MRN T_MRN, CDD_SERVICE_DTE, CDO_VALUE_TEXT "T Stage" FROM (SELECT CDD_MRN, CDD_SERVICE_DTE, CDO_VALUE_TEXT, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CDD_MRN ORDER BY CDD_SERVICE_DTE DESC) RN FROM ER_PR_HER WHERE CDO_ITEM_NAME IN ('T', 'T:') ) WHERE RN = 1 ) , N AS (SELECT CDD_MRN N_MRN, CDD_SERVICE_DTE, CDO_VALUE_TEXT "N Stage" FROM (SELECT CDD_MRN, CDD_SERVICE_DTE, CDO_VALUE_TEXT, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CDD_MRN ORDER BY CDD_SERVICE_DTE DESC) RN FROM ER_PR_HER WHERE CDO_ITEM_NAME IN ('N', 'N:') ) WHERE RN = 1 ) , M AS (SELECT CDD_MRN M_MRN, CDD_SERVICE_DTE, CDO_VALUE_TEXT "M Stage" FROM (SELECT CDD_MRN, CDD_SERVICE_DTE, CDO_VALUE_TEXT, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CDD_MRN ORDER BY CDD_SERVICE_DTE DESC) RN FROM ER_PR_HER WHERE CDO_ITEM_NAME IN ('M', 'M:') ) WHERE RN = 1 ) , STAGING AS (SELECT CDD_MRN S_MRN, CDD_SERVICE_DTE, CDO_VALUE_TEXT "Stage" FROM (SELECT CDD_MRN, CDD_SERVICE_DTE, CDO_VALUE_TEXT, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CDD_MRN ORDER BY CDD_SERVICE_DTE DESC) RN FROM ER_PR_HER WHERE CDO_ITEM_NAME IN ('Staging') ) WHERE RN = 1 ) , Y AS (SELECT DISTINCT MRN, ER AS "ER", PR AS "PR", HER2 AS "HER2", "Stage", "T Stage", "N Stage", "M Stage" FROM X LEFT JOIN ER ON MRN = ER_MRN LEFT JOIN PR ON MRN = PR_MRN LEFT JOIN HER2 ON MRN = HER2_MRN LEFT JOIN T ON MRN = T_MRN LEFT JOIN N ON MRN = N_MRN LEFT JOIN M ON MRN = M_MRN LEFT JOIN STAGING ON MRN = S_MRN WHERE ER = 'Negative' AND PR = 'Negative' AND HER2 = 'Negative' AND("Stage" not like '%IV%' OR "Stage" IS NULL) ) SELECT DISTINCT Y.MRN, DX_DATE, ER AS "ER", PR AS "PR", HER2 AS "HER2", "Stage", "T Stage", "N Stage", "M Stage", "Chemo (Start Date | Name)" FROM Y JOIN DX2 ON MRN = DX_MRN JOIN CHEMO ON MRN = APR_MRN

prompt: Please provide a list of patients with breast cancer who had liver biopsy starting 2011
completion: WITH PTS AS (SELECT DISTINCT RRPT_MRN, LISTAGG(RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE, '|') WITHIN GROUP( ORDER BY RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE) AS BIOPSY_DATES FROM DV.RADIOLOGY_REPORT_V WHERE RRPT_PROCEDURE_NAME = 'IR NEEDLE BIOPSY BODY LIVER' AND RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE BETWEEN '2011-01-01' AND '2018-12-31' GROUP BY RRPT_MRN) SELECT DISTINCT TM_MRN, BIOPSY_DATES, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, PT_SEX, CASE_STS.AV_DESC AS CASE_STS, TM_DX_DTE, TM_HIST_CD, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS HIST_DESC, TM_SITE_CD, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_DESC, TM_HIST_CD_GRADE, HIST_CD_GRADE.AV_DESC AS HIST_GRADE, TM_TSTAGE, TSTAGES.AV_DESC AS TSTAGE, TM_NSTAGE, NSTAGES.AV_DESC AS NSTAGE, TM_MSTAGE, MSTAGES.AV_DESC AS MSTAGE, MSK_STAGES.AV_DESC AS STAGE, TM_MSK_STG STG_PRESENTED_AT_MSK, CDB_AV_DESC STG_PRESENTED_AT_MSK_DESC, TM_CSSIZE FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN PTS ON RRPT_MRN=TM_MRN JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS CASE_STS ON CASE_STS.AV_ELEMENT = 'CASE_STS' AND CASE_STS.AV_CODE = TM_CASE_STS AND TM_CASE_STS IN ('3', '6', '7', '8') JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS HIST_CD_GRADE ON TM_HIST_CD_GRADE = HIST_CD_GRADE.AV_CODE AND HIST_CD_GRADE.AV_ELEMENT='HIST_CD_GRADE' JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PT_MRN=TM_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS TSTAGES ON TSTAGES.AV_ELEMENT='TSTAGE' AND TSTAGES.AV_CODE=TM_TSTAGE LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS NSTAGES ON NSTAGES.AV_ELEMENT='NSTAGE' AND NSTAGES.AV_CODE=TM_NSTAGE LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS MSTAGES ON MSTAGES.AV_ELEMENT='MSTAGE' AND MSTAGES.AV_CODE=TM_MSTAGE LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS MSK_STAGES ON MSK_STAGES.AV_ELEMENT='MSK_STAGE' AND MSK_STAGES.AV_CODE=TM_MSK_STG LEFT JOIN IDB.CDB_ALLOWVALS ON CDB_AV_ELEMENT = 'GENERAL_STG' AND CDB_AV_CD_STS = 'A' AND TM_MSK_STG = CDB_AV_CODE WHERE S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK LIKE '%BREAST%' ; WITH PTS0 AS (SELECT DISTINCT RRPT_MRN, LISTAGG(RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE, '|') WITHIN GROUP( ORDER BY RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE) AS BIOPSY_DATES FROM DV.RADIOLOGY_REPORT_V WHERE RRPT_PROCEDURE_NAME = 'IR NEEDLE BIOPSY BODY LIVER' AND RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE BETWEEN '2011-01-01' AND '2018-12-31' GROUP BY RRPT_MRN), PTS AS (SELECT PTS0.* FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN PTS0 ON RRPT_MRN=TM_MRN JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS CASE_STS ON CASE_STS.AV_ELEMENT = 'CASE_STS' AND CASE_STS.AV_CODE = TM_CASE_STS AND TM_CASE_STS IN ('3', '6', '7', '8') JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS HIST_CD_GRADE ON TM_HIST_CD_GRADE = HIST_CD_GRADE.AV_CODE AND HIST_CD_GRADE.AV_ELEMENT='HIST_CD_GRADE' JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PT_MRN=TM_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS TSTAGES ON TSTAGES.AV_ELEMENT='TSTAGE' AND TSTAGES.AV_CODE=TM_TSTAGE LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS NSTAGES ON NSTAGES.AV_ELEMENT='NSTAGE' AND NSTAGES.AV_CODE=TM_NSTAGE LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS MSTAGES ON MSTAGES.AV_ELEMENT='MSTAGE' AND MSTAGES.AV_CODE=TM_MSTAGE LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS MSK_STAGES ON MSK_STAGES.AV_ELEMENT='MSK_STAGE' AND MSK_STAGES.AV_CODE=TM_MSK_STG LEFT JOIN IDB.CDB_ALLOWVALS ON CDB_AV_ELEMENT = 'GENERAL_STG' AND CDB_AV_CD_STS = 'A' AND TM_MSK_STG = CDB_AV_CODE WHERE S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK LIKE '%BREAST%' ), DXCODES AS (SELECT DXCC_ICD_CODE, DXCC_ICD_MSK_DESC, DXCC_DX_CATALOG_ID FROM DV.DIAGNOSIS_CATALOG WHERE (DXCC_ICD_CODE >= '196' AND DXCC_ICD_CODE <= '198.99') OR (DXCC_ICD_CODE >= 'C77' AND DXCC_ICD_CODE <= 'C79.9') ) SELECT PT_MRN, BIOPSY_DATES, DXCC_ICD_CODE, DXCC_ICD_MSK_DESC, MIN(DT_DTE) DXCC_DTE FROM PTS JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON RRPT_MRN=PT_MRN JOIN DV.PATIENT_DIAGNOSIS_FINAL_ALL_V ON PDX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID JOIN DV.DATE_V ON PDX_DX_DATE_ID = DT_DATE_ID JOIN DXCODES ON PDX_DX_CATALOG_ID = DXCC_DX_CATALOG_ID GROUP BY PT_MRN, BIOPSY_DATES, DXCC_ICD_CODE, DXCC_ICD_MSK_DESC ; WITH PTS0 AS (SELECT DISTINCT RRPT_MRN, RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE FROM DV.RADIOLOGY_REPORT_V WHERE RRPT_PROCEDURE_NAME = 'IR NEEDLE BIOPSY BODY LIVER' AND RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE BETWEEN '2011-01-01' AND '2018-12-31' AND CONTAINS("RRPT_REPORT_TXT", '"breast"') = 1 AND RRPT_REPORT_TXT IS NOT NULL ), PTS AS (SELECT DISTINCT PTS0.* FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN PTS0 ON RRPT_MRN=TM_MRN JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS CASE_STS ON CASE_STS.AV_ELEMENT = 'CASE_STS' AND CASE_STS.AV_CODE = TM_CASE_STS AND TM_CASE_STS IN ('3', '6', '7', '8') JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS HIST_CD_GRADE ON TM_HIST_CD_GRADE = HIST_CD_GRADE.AV_CODE AND HIST_CD_GRADE.AV_ELEMENT='HIST_CD_GRADE' JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PT_MRN=TM_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS TSTAGES ON TSTAGES.AV_ELEMENT='TSTAGE' AND TSTAGES.AV_CODE=TM_TSTAGE LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS NSTAGES ON NSTAGES.AV_ELEMENT='NSTAGE' AND NSTAGES.AV_CODE=TM_NSTAGE LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS MSTAGES ON MSTAGES.AV_ELEMENT='MSTAGE' AND MSTAGES.AV_CODE=TM_MSTAGE LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS MSK_STAGES ON MSK_STAGES.AV_ELEMENT='MSK_STAGE' AND MSK_STAGES.AV_CODE=TM_MSK_STG LEFT JOIN IDB.CDB_ALLOWVALS ON CDB_AV_ELEMENT = 'GENERAL_STG' AND CDB_AV_CD_STS = 'A' AND TM_MSK_STG = CDB_AV_CODE WHERE S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK LIKE '%BREAST%' ) SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN, RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE "LIVER BIOPSY DATE", PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, PLR_PERFORMED_DT "LAB DATE", SUBTEST.LTC_SUBTEST_NAME, PLR_RESULT_VALUE "LAB VALUE" FROM PTS JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V ON PT_MRN=RRPT_MRN JOIN DV.PATIENT_LAB_RESULT ON PLR_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID=PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID JOIN DV.LAB_TEST_CATALOG_V AS SUBTEST ON PLR_LAB_SUBTEST_CATALOG_ID = SUBTEST.LTC_LAB_TEST_CATALOG_ID AND SUBTEST.LTC_SUBTEST_NAME IN ('Albumin', 'AST', 'ALT', 'Platelets', 'Alkaline Phosphatase', 'Alkaline Phosphatase (ALK)', 'Bilirubin Direct', 'Bilirubin, Total') WHERE DATE(PLR_PERFORMED_DT) BETWEEN RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE - 7 DAYS AND RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE + 7 DAYS ;

prompt: Please send a list of patients who had breast cancer (ICD code) and their clinical stages (CDB) from 2000 to 2022.
completion: SELECT DISTINCT TM_MRN, TM_SITE_CD, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_DESC, TM_CLIN_TNM_T, TM_CLIN_TNM_M, TM_CLIN_TNM_N FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS ON AV_ELEMENT = 'CASE_STS' AND AV_CODE = TM_CASE_STS WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND TM_SITE_CD IN ('C500', 'C501', 'C502', 'C503', 'C504', 'C505', 'C506', 'C507', 'C508', 'C509') AND TM_DX_DTE BETWEEN '2000-01-01' AND '2022-02-14'

prompt: Provide a list of patients diagnosed with prostate cancer who have either a BRCA2 or BRCA1 mutation.
completion: WITH DX1 AS (SELECT DISTINCT TM_MRN AS MRN, TM_SITE_CD AS SITE_CODE, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_DESC, TM_HIST_CD AS HIST_CODE, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS HIST_DESC FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.SEERGROUPING ON RECODE = IDB.SEERF_ICDO(TM_SITE_CD, TM_HIST_CD) AND CATEGORY2 = 'Prostate' JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD WHERE 1=1 AND TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') UNION SELECT CC_MRN AS MRN, CLM_CLSF_CD AS SITE_CODE, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_DESC, '' AS HIST_CODE, '' AS HIST_DESC FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD AND CLM_CLSF_CD IN ('185', 'C61') WHERE CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND CASE WHEN CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y' THEN 'Y' WHEN CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' AND YEAR(CC_EFF_DTE) < 2004 THEN 'Y' WHEN CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND YEAR(CC_EFF_DTE) < 2001 THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END = 'Y' AND CC_PT_TYPE <> 'E' GROUP BY CC_MRN, CLM_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK UNION SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN AS MRN, '' AS SITE_CODE, PRIMARY_SITE AS SITE_DESC, TUMOR_TYPE_CODE AS HIST_CODE, TUMOR_TYPE_NAME AS HIST_DESC FROM DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML DT ON PDRX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID CROSS JOIN XMLTABLE('$c/root/*' PASSING DT.PDRX_XML_VALUE AS "c" COLUMNS TUMOR_TYPE_CODE VARCHAR(100) PATH '../meta-data/tumor_type_code', TUMOR_TYPE_NAME VARCHAR(255) PATH '../meta-data/tumor_type_name', PRIMARY_SITE VARCHAR(255) PATH '../meta-data/primary_site') T WHERE 1=1 AND (UPPER(PRIMARY_SITE) LIKE '%PROS%' OR UPPER(TUMOR_TYPE_NAME) LIKE '%PROS%') ) , DX2 AS (SELECT MRN, REPLACE(LISTAGG(COALESCE(STRIP(CAST(SITE_CODE AS VARCHAR(12000))), '') || ' | ' || COALESCE(STRIP(CAST(SITE_DESC AS VARCHAR(12000))), '') || ' | ' || COALESCE(STRIP(CAST(HIST_CODE AS VARCHAR(12000))), '') || ' | ' || COALESCE(STRIP(CAST(HIST_DESC AS VARCHAR(12000))), '') , CHR(13) || CHR(10)) WITHIN GROUP( ORDER BY MRN) , ' | |', '') AS DX FROM DX1 GROUP BY MRN) , B1 AS (SELECT DISTINCT MRN, GENE, GENE2 FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_STRUCTURED_RESULTS_V JOIN DX2 ON MRN = PT_MRN WHERE 1=1 AND(GENE like '%BRCA%' OR GENE2 like '%BRCA%') ) , B2 AS (SELECT MRN, MAX(CASE WHEN GENE like '%BRCA1%' OR GENE2 like '%BRCA1%' THEN 'Y' END) AS BRCA1, MAX(CASE WHEN GENE like '%BRCA2%' OR GENE2 like '%BRCA2%' THEN 'Y' END) AS BRCA2 FROM B1 GROUP BY MRN) , AC AS (SELECT AC_MRN, MAX(CASE WHEN AC_IRB_NO = '06-107' THEN AC_CONS_DTE END) AS "06-107 Consent Date", MAX(CASE WHEN AC_IRB_NO = '12-245' THEN AC_CONS_DTE END) AS "12-245 Consent Date" FROM IDB.ACCRUALS WHERE AC_IRB_NO IN ('06-107', '12-245') AND AC_MRN IN (SELECT DISTINCT MRN FROM B2) GROUP BY AC_MRN ) SELECT DISTINCT DX2.*, BRCA1, BRCA2, "06-107 Consent Date", "12-245 Consent Date" FROM DX2 JOIN B2 ON DX2.MRN = B2.MRN LEFT JOIN AC ON DX2.MRN = AC_MRN

prompt: Provide report of the following CIS orders: Wound Vac, Initiate Therapy and Wound Vac, Discontinue Therapy between August 2010-August 2011.
completion: SELECT DISTINCT A.*, OL_SURG_DTE, ORC_ABBR, ORC_CODE, ORC_NAME FROM (SELECT OO_MRN MRN, OO_ACCT_NO, CS_ACCT_NO, CS_ADM_DATE, CS_DSCH_DATE , OO_ORD_GUID, OO_ENTER_DTE, OO_ORD_ID, OO_ORD_NAME, OO_SUMMARY_LINE , OO_ORD_STS_CD FROM IDB.OMS_ORDER JOIN IDB.CASE ON CS_ACCT_NO = OO_ACCT_NO WHERE OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID IN ('1000003782073029', '2000003782073029') AND OO_ENTER_DTE BETWEEN '2010-08-01' AND '2011-08-31' AND OO_ORD_STS_CD NOT LIKE 'CAN%' AND OO_ORD_STS_CD <> 'DISC' ) A LEFT JOIN IDB.OR_LOG ON MRN = OL_MRN AND OL_SURG_DTE BETWEEN CS_ADM_DATE AND OO_ENTER_DTE LEFT JOIN IDB.OR_LOG_ALL_SURG ON OLAS_LOG_ID = OL_LOG_ID AND OLAS_SURG_ROLE = 'Primary' LEFT JOIN IDB.OR_CATEGORY ON OL_LOG_SVC = ORC_ABBR AND ORC_CATEGORY = 'ZC_OR_SERVICE'

prompt: Adding modification to the HER2 mutations
completion: WITH MUT AS (SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN "MRN", ABERRATIONTYPE FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_STRUCTURED_RESULTS_V WHERE GENE = 'ERBB2' AND ABERRATIONTYPE IN ('copy number loss', 'deletion', 'duplication', 'fusion', 'inversion', 'mutation', 'point_mutation', 'splicing variant', 'translocation') ) , GENES AS (SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN "MRN", ABERRATIONTYPE FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_STRUCTURED_RESULTS_V WHERE GENE = 'ERBB2' AND ABERRATIONTYPE IN ('amplification', 'copy number gain') AND PT_MRN NOT IN (SELECT "MRN" FROM MUT) ) , DX AS (SELECT TM_MRN, AV_DESC AS CASE_STS, TM_DX_DTE, TM_HIST_CD, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS HIST_DESC, TM_SITE_CD, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_DESC, TM_CLIN_STG_GRP FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS ON AV_ELEMENT = 'CASE_STS' AND AV_CODE = TM_CASE_STS WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND TM_SITE_CD LIKE 'C34%' AND TM_HIST_CD IN ('M8013/3', 'M8014/3', 'M8022/3', 'M8030/3', 'M8031/3', 'M8032/3', 'M8033/3', 'M8046/3', 'M8140/2', 'M8140/3', 'M8250/2', 'M8250/3', 'M8251/3', 'M8252/3', 'M8253/3', 'M8254/3', 'M8255/3', 'M8260/2', 'M8260/3', 'M8310/3', 'M8333/3', 'M8480/2', 'M8480/3', 'M8481/3', 'M8490/2', 'M8490/3', 'M8572/3', 'M8574/3', 'M8972/3', 'M8973/3', 'M8980/3') ) , TDM1 AS (SELECT DISTINCT APR_MRN FROM IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX JOIN GENES ON APR_MRN = "MRN" JOIN DX ON APR_MRN = TM_MRN WHERE APR_GENERIC_NAME IN ('ADO-TRASTUZUMAB EMTANSINE', 'TRASTUZUMAB', 'TRASTUZUMAB-MCC-DM1') ) , RAD AS (SELECT RRPT_MRN, RRPT_ANC_CODE, RRPT_ORDER_GROUP, RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY RRPT_MRN ORDER BY RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE DESC) AS RANK, DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)IMPRESSION:[\w\W]*(?=DICTATED BY:)', RRPT_REPORT_TXT) AS RRPT_IMPRESSION FROM DV.RADIOLOGY_REPORT_V JOIN DX ON RRPT_MRN = TM_MRN JOIN GENES ON "MRN" = RRPT_MRN WHERE RRPT_ANC_CODE IN ('CTCAC', 'CTCANC', 'CTCAPC', 'CTCAPNC', 'CTCH', 'CTCH1', 'CTCHN1', 'CTCHSLD', 'CTPE', 'CTPEWAP', 'PETHCAP', 'PETNCAP') ) , Q AS (SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, SITE_DESC, HIST_DESC, ABERRATIONTYPE, CASE WHEN APR_MRN IS NOT NULL THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS "Prior Therapy", RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE, RRPT_ANC_CODE AS "Scan Type", RRPT_IMPRESSION FROM GENES JOIN DX ON TM_MRN = "MRN" JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON TM_MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX ON APR_MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN RAD ON RRPT_MRN = PT_MRN AND RANK = 1 WHERE PT_DATE_OF_DEATH IS NULL AND PT_MRN NOT IN (SELECT APR_MRN FROM TDM1) ) SELECT * FROM Q ; WITH MUT AS (SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN "MRN", ABERRATIONTYPE FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_STRUCTURED_RESULTS_V WHERE GENE = 'ERBB2' AND ABERRATIONTYPE IN ('copy number loss', 'deletion', 'duplication', 'fusion', 'inversion', 'mutation', 'point_mutation', 'splicing variant', 'translocation') ) , GENES AS (SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN "MRN", ABERRATIONTYPE FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_STRUCTURED_RESULTS_V WHERE GENE = 'ERBB2' AND ABERRATIONTYPE IN ('amplification', 'copy number gain') AND PT_MRN NOT IN (SELECT "MRN" FROM MUT) ) , DX AS (SELECT TM_MRN, AV_DESC AS CASE_STS, TM_DX_DTE, TM_HIST_CD, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS HIST_DESC, TM_SITE_CD, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_DESC, TM_CLIN_STG_GRP FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS ON AV_ELEMENT = 'CASE_STS' AND AV_CODE = TM_CASE_STS WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND TM_SITE_CD LIKE 'C34%' AND TM_HIST_CD IN ('M8013/3', 'M8014/3', 'M8022/3', 'M8030/3', 'M8031/3', 'M8032/3', 'M8033/3', 'M8046/3', 'M8140/2', 'M8140/3', 'M8250/2', 'M8250/3', 'M8251/3', 'M8252/3', 'M8253/3', 'M8254/3', 'M8255/3', 'M8260/2', 'M8260/3', 'M8310/3', 'M8333/3', 'M8480/2', 'M8480/3', 'M8481/3', 'M8490/2', 'M8490/3', 'M8572/3', 'M8574/3', 'M8972/3', 'M8973/3', 'M8980/3') ) , TDM1 AS (SELECT DISTINCT APR_MRN FROM IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX JOIN GENES ON APR_MRN = "MRN" JOIN DX ON APR_MRN = TM_MRN WHERE APR_GENERIC_NAME IN ('ADO-TRASTUZUMAB EMTANSINE', 'TRASTUZUMAB', 'TRASTUZUMAB-MCC-DM1') ) , RAD AS (SELECT RRPT_MRN, RRPT_ANC_CODE, RRPT_ORDER_GROUP, RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY RRPT_MRN ORDER BY RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE DESC) AS RANK, DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)IMPRESSION:[\w\W]*(?=DICTATED BY:)', RRPT_REPORT_TXT) AS RRPT_IMPRESSION FROM DV.RADIOLOGY_REPORT_V JOIN DX ON RRPT_MRN = TM_MRN JOIN GENES ON "MRN" = RRPT_MRN WHERE RRPT_ANC_CODE IN ('CTCAC', 'CTCANC', 'CTCAPC', 'CTCAPNC', 'CTCH', 'CTCH1', 'CTCHN1', 'CTCHSLD', 'CTPE', 'CTPEWAP', 'PETHCAP', 'PETNCAP') ) , Q AS (SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, SITE_DESC, HIST_DESC, ABERRATIONTYPE, CASE WHEN APR_MRN IS NOT NULL THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS "Prior Therapy", RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE, RRPT_ANC_CODE AS "Scan Type", RRPT_IMPRESSION FROM GENES JOIN DX ON TM_MRN = "MRN" JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON TM_MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX ON APR_MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN RAD ON RRPT_MRN = PT_MRN AND RANK = 1 WHERE PT_DATE_OF_DEATH IS NULL AND PT_MRN NOT IN (SELECT APR_MRN FROM TDM1) ) SELECT PT_MRN, PATH_PROCEDURE_DATE, GENE, RESULT, LOCUS, AA_CHANGE, NUCLEOTIDE, SEARCH_HIT1, SEARCH_HIT2, METHOD, ABERRATIONTYPE, FOLD_CHANGE, GENE2 FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_STRUCTURED_RESULTS_V JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT MRN FROM Q) ON PT_MRN = MRN WHERE GENE = 'ERBB2'

prompt: List of patients with ganglioneuroma and neuroblastoma
completion: SELECT DISTINCT PRPT_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME "Last Name", PT_FIRST_NAME "First Name", PT_BIRTH_DTE "Date of Birth", PRPT_REPORT_DTE "Path Report Date", PRPT_REPORT_TYPE_DESC "Path Report Type", PRPT_ORD_DR_NAME, PRPT_ORD_DR_SVC_DESC FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON PRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID WHERE PRPT_REPORT IS NOT NULL AND PRPT_REPORT_DTE BETWEEN '2001-01-01' AND '2020-09-15' AND CONTAINS("PRPT_REPORT", '("ganglioneuroma")') = 1 AND PRPT_REPORT_TYPE_DESC IN ('Surgical Pathology', 'Surgical Pathology Consult', 'Surgical Submitted Slides') AND PRPT_ORD_DR_NAME IN ('BASU MD PHD,ELLEN M', 'BILSKY MD,MARK H.', 'CHEUNG MD,NAI-KONG V', 'GERSTLE MD,JUSTIN T', 'GREENFIELD MD,JEFFREY P', 'HEALEY MD,JOHN', 'HEATON MD,TODD E', 'KAYTON MD,MARK L', 'KRAMER MD,KIM', 'KUSHNER MD,BRIAN HARRIS', 'LAQUAGLIA MD,MICHAEL', 'MEYERS MD,PAUL A', 'MODAK MBBS,SHAKEEL', 'O''REILLY MD,RICHARD J', 'ROBERTS MD,STEPHEN S', 'SHLASKO MD,EDWARD', 'SHUKLA MD,NEERAV N', 'SOUWEIDANE MD,MARK M', 'WEXLER MD,LEONARD H.', 'YURASOV MD,SERGEY V') ORDER BY PRPT_MRN, PRPT_REPORT_DTE ; WITH DX AS (SELECT PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID PID, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_BIRTH_DTE, MIN(DT_DTE) AS DX_DTE FROM DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS JOIN DV.PATIENT_DIAGNOSIS_FINAL_ALL_V ON PDX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID JOIN DV.DATE_V ON PDX_DX_DATE_ID = DT_DATE_ID JOIN DV.DIAGNOSIS_CATALOG ON PDX_DX_CATALOG_ID = DXCC_DX_CATALOG_ID WHERE SUBSTR(DXCC_ICD_CODE, 1, 3) IN ('194', 'C74') GROUP BY PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_BIRTH_DTE ) SELECT DISTINCT PRPT_MRN "MRN", PT_LAST_NAME "Last Name", PT_FIRST_NAME "First Name", PT_BIRTH_DTE "Date of Birth", DX_DTE "Diagnosis Date", PRPT_REPORT_DTE "Path Report Date", PRPT_REPORT_TYPE_DESC "Path Report Type" FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V JOIN DX ON PRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PID WHERE PRPT_REPORT IS NOT NULL AND PRPT_REPORT_DTE BETWEEN '2001-01-01' AND '2020-09-15' AND PRPT_REPORT_TYPE_DESC IN ('Hematopathology Departmental Consult', 'Hematopathology Report', 'Surgical Pathology', 'Surgical Submitted Slides') AND CONTAINS("PRPT_REPORT", '("bone marrow" & ("ganglioneuroma" | "ganglioneuromatous" | "ganglion cells"))') = 1 ORDER BY PRPT_MRN, PRPT_REPORT_DTE

prompt: Provide a demographics report of all patients enrolled on the 20-180 study.
completion: WITH CTE AS (SELECT ACD_MRN MRN, ACD_IRB_NO IRB_NO, ACD_CONS_DTE CONSENT_DATE, STRIP(PT_LAST_NAME)||', '||PT_FIRST_NAME PT_NAME, PT_SEX_DESC SEX, PT_DATE_OF_DEATH DATE_OF_DEATH, YEAR(MIN(CPO_START_DTE)) - YEAR(PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) AGE_AT_FIRST_DRUG_ADMIN , MIN(CPO_START_DTE) START_DATE, MAX(CPO_STOP_DTE) END_DATE , SUM(CPO_DOSE) TOTAL_GIVEN_DOSE , CPO_SET_NAME SETNAME, CPO_SET_GUID FROM IDB.ACCRUALS_DATES JOIN IDB.CHEMO_PERFORMED_ORDERS ON ACD_MRN = CPO_MRN JOIN IDB.PATIENT_V ON PT_MRN = ACD_MRN WHERE ACD_IRB_NO = '20-180' AND (CPO_SET_NAME like '%BEAM%' OR CPO_SET_NAME like '%CBV%' OR LOWER(CPO_SET_NAME) like '%thiotepa%' OR LOWER (CPO_DRUG_NAME) like '%thiotepa%' OR LOWER (CPO_DRUG_NAME) like '%melphalan%' OR LOWER(CPO_SET_NAME) like '%carmustin%') GROUP BY ACD_MRN, ACD_IRB_NO, ACD_CONS_DTE, STRIP(PT_LAST_NAME)||', '||PT_FIRST_NAME , PT_SEX_DESC, PT_DATE_OF_DEATH, YEAR(PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) , CPO_SET_NAME, CPO_SET_GUID) SELECT MRN, PT_NAME, SEX, AGE_AT_FIRST_DRUG_ADMIN, DATE_OF_DEATH, IRB_NO, CONSENT_DATE, START_DATE, END_DATE, SETNAME, CPO_SET_GUID , OUD_USER_DI_VALUE "Cancer Diagnosis" FROM CTE JOIN IDB.OMS_ORDER ON MRN = OO_MRN AND CPO_SET_GUID = OO_SET_GUID AND OO_ORD_NAME = 'Chemo Tx' LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_USER_DATA ON OO_ORD_GUID = OUD_ORD_GUID AND OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'Cancer Diagnosis' ;

prompt: Provide NPP acknowledgement rate
completion: SELECT CAV_TITLE DEPARTMENT, YEAR(CPE_ENC_DTE) YR, MONTH(TIMESTAMP(CAST(CPE_ENC_DTE AS CHAR(10)) || ' 00:00:00')) MO, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN PLA_NPP_IND = 'Y' THEN PLA_MRN END) AS YES_NPP, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN PLA_NPP_IND <> 'Y' THEN PLA_MRN END) AS NO_NPP, COUNT(DISTINCT PLA_MRN) AS TOTAL, DECIMAL(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN PLA_NPP_IND <> 'Y' THEN PLA_MRN END))/COUNT(DISTINCT PLA_MRN) AS PERCENT_NO_NPP FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID AND CRE_STAFF_RSRC = 'Person' JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 NOT IN ('IM', 'DNR') AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 <> 'EHS' JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID AND CVT_CVT_RPT_GRP_3 <> 'Rpt Exclusion' JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY ON CPE_MRN = PLA_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_CATEGORY ON CAV_CATEGORY = 'CLD_RPT_GRP_6' AND CAV_ABBR = CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 WHERE YEAR(CPE_ENC_DTE) >= 2018 AND CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') GROUP BY CAV_TITLE , YEAR(CPE_ENC_DTE) , MONTH(TIMESTAMP(CAST(CPE_ENC_DTE AS CHAR(10)) || ' 00:00:00')) ORDER BY 2, 3, 1 ; SELECT CAV_TITLE DEPARTMENT, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN PLA_NPP_IND = 'Y' THEN PLA_MRN END) AS YES_NPP, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN PLA_NPP_IND <> 'Y' THEN PLA_MRN END) AS NO_NPP, COUNT(DISTINCT PLA_MRN) AS TOTAL, DECIMAL(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN PLA_NPP_IND <> 'Y' THEN PLA_MRN END))/COUNT(DISTINCT PLA_MRN) AS PERCENT_NO_NPP FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID AND CRE_STAFF_RSRC = 'Person' JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 NOT IN ('IM', 'DNR') AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 <> 'EHS' JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID AND CVT_CVT_RPT_GRP_3 <> 'Rpt Exclusion' JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY ON CPE_MRN = PLA_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_CATEGORY ON CAV_CATEGORY = 'CLD_RPT_GRP_6' AND CAV_ABBR = CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 WHERE YEAR(CPE_ENC_DTE) >= 2018 AND CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') GROUP BY CAV_TITLE ORDER BY 2, 3, 1
