prompt: A list of H-/S- cases with Part Description "bone marrow lymphoma" OR "BM lymphoma" AND Diagnosis and comment section with "hodgkin lymphoma" or "HL" from 01/01/2005 to present.
completion: WITH PD AS (SELECT DISTINCT PD_MRN , H_S_CASE_NUMBER , DATE_OF_SPECIMEN , H_S_REPORT_TEXT , RELATED_CASE_NUMBER , RELATED_REPORT_TEXT , DIAGNOSIS_TEXT , CAST(TRIM(SUBSTR(H_S_REPORT_TEXT, L1, (CASE WHEN L2 > L1 THEN L2 WHEN L3 > L1 THEN L3 WHEN L4 > L1 THEN L4 ELSE L5 END)-L1)) AS VARCHAR(1500)) AS PART_DESCRIPTION , PATHOLOGY_REPORT_DATE FROM (SELECT DISTINCT DMP.PRPT_MRN AS PD_MRN , DMP.PRPT_ACCESSION_NO AS H_S_CASE_NUMBER , DMP.PRPT_PROCEDURE_DTE AS DATE_OF_SPECIMEN , CAST(UPPER(SUBSTR(DMP.PRPT_REPORT, 1, 20000)) AS VARCHAR(20000)) AS H_S_REPORT_TEXT , SRG.PRPT_ACCESSION_NO AS RELATED_CASE_NUMBER , (SELECT VARCHAR(PRPT_REPORT, 32000) FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT WHERE PRPT_ACCESSION_NO = SRG.PRPT_ACCESSION_NO) AS RELATED_REPORT_TEXT , DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)diag[\w\W]*(?=I ATTEST)', DMP.PRPT_REPORT) AS DIAGNOSIS_TEXT , CASE WHEN LOCATE('SPECIMENS SUBMITTED:', CAST(UPPER(SUBSTR(DMP.PRPT_REPORT, 1, 32000)) AS VARCHAR(32000))) > 1 THEN LOCATE('SPECIMENS SUBMITTED:', CAST(UPPER(SUBSTR(DMP.PRPT_REPORT, 1, 32000)) AS VARCHAR(32000))) WHEN LOCATE('SPECIMENSSUBMITTED:', CAST(UPPER(SUBSTR(DMP.PRPT_REPORT, 1, 32000)) AS VARCHAR(32000))) > 1 THEN LOCATE('SPECIMENSSUBMITTED:', CAST(UPPER(SUBSTR(DMP.PRPT_REPORT, 1, 32000)) AS VARCHAR(32000))) END L1 , INSTR(CAST(UPPER(SUBSTR(DMP.PRPT_REPORT, 1, 12000)) AS VARCHAR(12000)), 'DIAGNOSIS:', 9, 4, OCTETS) L2 , INSTR(CAST(UPPER(SUBSTR(DMP.PRPT_REPORT, 1, 12000)) AS VARCHAR(12000)), 'DIAGNOSIS:', 9, 3, OCTETS) L3 , INSTR(CAST(UPPER(SUBSTR(DMP.PRPT_REPORT, 1, 12000)) AS VARCHAR(12000)), 'DIAGNOSIS:', 9, 2, OCTETS) L4 , INSTR(CAST(UPPER(SUBSTR(DMP.PRPT_REPORT, 1, 12000)) AS VARCHAR(12000)), 'DIAGNOSIS:', 9, 1, OCTETS) L5 , DMP.PRPT_REPORT_DTE AS PATHOLOGY_REPORT_DATE FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V DMP LEFT JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_REFERENCES ON PRPTR_CHILD_PATH_RPT_ID = DMP.PRPT_PATH_RPT_ID LEFT JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT SRG ON SRG.PRPT_PATH_RPT_ID = PRPTR_PATH_RPT_ID AND (SRG.PRPT_ACCESSION_NO LIKE 'F%' OR SRG.PRPT_ACCESSION_NO LIKE 'CG%' OR SRG.PRPT_ACCESSION_NO LIKE 'M%') WHERE 1=1 AND LEFT(DMP.PRPT_ACCESSION_NO, 1) IN ('H', 'S') AND DMP.PRPT_REPORT_DTE >= '01/01/2005' AND CAST(UPPER(SUBSTR(DMP.PRPT_REPORT, 1, 20000)) AS VARCHAR(20000)) IS NOT NULL AND CONTAINS(DMP.PRPT_REPORT, '("hodgkin lymphoma" OR "HL")') = 1 )) , RESULT AS (SELECT PT_MRN AS MRN , PT_LAST_NAME AS LAST_NAME , PT_FIRST_NAME AS FIRST_NAME , PT_BIRTH_DTE AS DATE_OF_BIRTH , PT_SEX_DESC AS SEX , PART_DESCRIPTION , DATE_OF_SPECIMEN , H_S_CASE_NUMBER , H_S_REPORT_TEXT , RELATED_CASE_NUMBER , RELATED_REPORT_TEXT , DIAGNOSIS_TEXT , PDRX_DMP_PATIENT_ID AS DMP_ID , PATHOLOGY_REPORT_DATE FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML INNER JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML_SETTINGS ON PDRX_PATH_DMP_RESULTS_XML_ID = PDRXS_PATH_DMP_RESULTS_XML_ID INNER JOIN DVDMC.PATHOLOGY_DMP_WEBSVC_SETTINGS ON PDRXS_SETTING_ID = PDWS_SETTING_ID INNER JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON PDRX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID LEFT JOIN PD ON PT_MRN = PD_MRN WHERE 1=1 AND (LOCATE('bone marrow lymphoma', LOWER(PART_DESCRIPTION)) >=1 OR LOCATE('bm lymphoma', LOWER(PART_DESCRIPTION))>= 1) AND (LOCATE('hodgkin lymphoma', LOWER (DIAGNOSIS_TEXT)) >=1 OR LOCATE('hl', LOWER (DIAGNOSIS_TEXT)) >=1) ) SELECT DISTINCT A.MRN , A.LAST_NAME , A.FIRST_NAME , A.DATE_OF_BIRTH , A.SEX , A.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_DATE , A.DATE_OF_SPECIMEN , A.DMP_ID , A.H_S_CASE_NUMBER , A.H_S_REPORT_TEXT , A.DIAGNOSIS_TEXT , A.PART_DESCRIPTION , B.RELATED_CASE_NUMBER AS F_CASE_NUMBER , B.RELATED_REPORT_TEXT AS RELATED_F_REPORT_TEXT , C.RELATED_CASE_NUMBER AS CG_CASE_NUMBER , C.RELATED_REPORT_TEXT AS RELATED_CG_REPORT_TEXT , D.RELATED_CASE_NUMBER AS M_CASE_NUMBER , D.RELATED_REPORT_TEXT AS RELATED_M_REPORT_TEXT FROM RESULT A LEFT JOIN RESULT B ON A.MRN = B.MRN AND B.RELATED_CASE_NUMBER LIKE 'F%' LEFT JOIN RESULT C ON A.MRN = C.MRN AND C.RELATED_CASE_NUMBER LIKE 'CG%' LEFT JOIN RESULT D ON A.MRN = D.MRN AND D.RELATED_CASE_NUMBER LIKE 'M%'

prompt: Provide the number of patients between the ages of 4 and 14 and who had an MRI scan within the last 5 years, grouped by race, ethnicity and gender.
completion: SELECT PT_SEX, R.AV_DESC AS RACE, E.AV_DESC AS ETHNICITY, COUNT(DISTINCT PBD_MRN) AS PTS FROM IDB.PBD_DTL JOIN IDB.PBD_CODE ON PBD_PBD_CD = PBC_PBD_CD JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PBD_MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS R ON R.AV_ELEMENT = 'RACE' AND R.AV_CODE = PT_RACE LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS E ON E.AV_ELEMENT = 'PT_ETHNICITY' AND E.AV_CODE = PT_PT_ETHNICITY WHERE YEAR(PBD_SVC_DTE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) BETWEEN 4 AND 14 AND PBD_SVC_DTE BETWEEN '2006-01-01' AND '2010-12-31' AND PBC_CPT_CD IN ('01922', '61751', '70540', '70542', '70543', '70544', '70546', '70547', '70549', '70551', '70552', '70553', '70554', '70559', '71550', '71552', '72141', '72142', '72146', '72147', '72148', '72149', '72156', '72157', '72158', '72195', '72196', '72197', '73218', '73220', '73221', '73223', '73718', '73720', '73721', '73722', '73723', '74181', '74182', '74183', '75553', '75561') GROUP BY PT_SEX, R.AV_DESC, E.AV_DESC

prompt: Counts of specific lab tests for pediatric patients <10 kg for past 3 month, September - November 2018.
completion: WITH PTS AS (SELECT DISTINCT PMH_MRN, LR_TEST_NAME, LR_ENTER_DT, LR_PERFORMED_DTE , MONTH(LR_PERFORMED_DT) AS "Month", YEAR(LR_PERFORMED_DT) AS "Year" FROM IDB.PT_MEASURES_HX JOIN IDB.LAB_RESULTS ON PMH_MRN = LR_MRN WHERE PMH_WT_KG < 10 AND PMH_MEASURE_DTE BETWEEN '2018-09-01' AND '2018-11-30' AND LR_PERFORMED_DTE BETWEEN '2018-09-01' AND '2018-11-30' ) SELECT DISTINCT LR_TEST_NAME, "Year", "Month", COUNT(*) "Count" FROM PTS GROUP BY LR_TEST_NAME, "Year", "Month" ORDER BY 3, 4 DESC

prompt: Determine the number of new melanoma patients seen over the last five years at MSKCC, grouped by age, race, and year.
completion: SELECT PT_MRN AS MRN, AV_DESC AS RACE, PT_SEX AS SEX, ICDO_HIST_CODE, ICDO_HIST_DESC, ICDO_SITE_CODE, ICDO_SITE_DESC, YEAR(TM_FIRST_MSK_DTE) AS ICDO_YR, YEAR(TM_FIRST_MSK_DTE-PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) AS ICDO_AGE, ICD9_CODE, ICD9_DESC, YEAR(MIN_ICD9_DX_DATE) AS ICD9_YR, YEAR(MIN_ICD9_DX_DATE-PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) AS ICD9_AGE FROM (SELECT * FROM (SELECT TM_MRN, TM_HIST_CD AS ICDO_HIST_CODE, CLM1.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS ICDO_HIST_DESC, TM_SITE_CD AS ICDO_SITE_CODE, CLM2.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS ICDO_SITE_DESC, TM_FIRST_MSK_DTE FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM CLM1 ON TM_HIST_CD = CLM1.CLM_CLSF_CD AND CLM1.CLM_CLSF_TYPE = 'TM' JOIN IDB.CLM CLM2 ON TM_SITE_CD = CLM2.CLM_CLSF_CD AND CLM2.CLM_CLSF_TYPE = 'TT' WHERE TM_HIST_CD IN ('M8720/2' ,'M8720/3' ,'M8721/3' ,'M8722/2' ,'M8722/3' ,'M8723/2' ,'M8723/3' ,'M8728/3' ,'M8730/3' ,'M8740/3' ,'M8741/2' ,'M8741/3' ,'M8742/2' ,'M8742/3' ,'M8743/2' ,'M8743/3' ,'M8744/2' ,'M8744/3' ,'M8745/3' ,'M8746/3' ,'M8761/3' ,'M8770/3' ,'M8771/3' ,'M8772/2' ,'M8772/3' ,'M8773/3' ,'M8774/3' ,'M8775/3' ,'M8780/3') AND TM_FIRST_MSK_DTE BETWEEN '2004-01-01' AND '2008-12-31' AND TM_CASE_STS IN ('3', '7')) AS A FULL JOIN (SELECT CC_MRN, CC_CLSF_CD AS ICD9_CODE, CLM3.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS ICD9_DESC, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS MIN_ICD9_DX_DATE FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM CLM3 ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM3.CLM_CLSF_CD AND CLM3.CLM_CLSF_TYPE = 'I9' WHERE CC_CLSF_CD IN ('172' ,'172.0' ,'172.1' ,'172.2' ,'172.3' ,'172.4' ,'172.5' ,'172.6' ,'172.7' ,'172.8' ,'172.9') AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND (CC_CIC_CDR_INITLS <> '' OR SUBSTR(CC_ACCT_NO, 1, 2) IN ('00', '84')) GROUP BY CC_MRN, CC_CLSF_CD, CLM3.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK HAVING MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) BETWEEN '2004-01-01' AND '2008-12-31') AS B ON TM_MRN = CC_MRN) AS X JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PT_MRN = COALESCE(TM_MRN, CC_MRN) JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS ON AV_CODE = PT_RACE AND AV_ELEMENT = 'RACE'

prompt: Provide a list of of the IMPACT test results for specific list of pancreatic cancer MRNs of patients on the TOPCOAT initiative (patients consented to 06-107/12-245, analysis through 15-149).
completion: SELECT DISTINCT A.PT_MRN, PDRX_ACCESSION_NO, PDRX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID, DV.TODATE(DT_PROCEDURE) AS "Procedure Date", T.*, PRPT_ACCESSION_NO, PATH_PROCEDURE_DATE, GENE, ABERRATIONTYPE, LOCUS, AA_CHANGE, NUCLEOTIDE, FOLD_CHANGE, GENE2, SEARCH_HIT1, SEARCH_HIT2, METHOD, PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_DESC FROM DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS A JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML DT ON PDRX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID LEFT JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_STRUCTURED_RESULTS_V B ON PRPT_PATH_RPT_ID = PDRX_PATH_RPT_ID CROSS JOIN XMLTABLE('$c/root/*' PASSING DT.PDRX_XML_VALUE AS "c" COLUMNS DT_PROCEDURE VARCHAR(40) PATH '../meta-data/dt_procedure', SAMPLEID VARCHAR(100) PATH '../meta-data/dmp_sample_id', PATIENTID VARCHAR(100) PATH '../meta-data/dmp_patient_id', PRIMARY_SITE VARCHAR(255) PATH '../meta-data/primary_site', TUMOR_TYPE_CODE VARCHAR(100) PATH '../meta-data/tumor_type_code', TUMOR_TYPE_NAME VARCHAR(255) PATH '../meta-data/tumor_type_name', PART_DESCRIPTION VARCHAR(2000) PATH '../meta-data/part_description', METASTASIS_SITE VARCHAR(255) PATH '../meta-data/metastasis_site') T WHERE A.PT_MRN IN ()

prompt: Provide counts of patients with ovarian, peritoneal, fallopian tube, endometrial, and cervical cancer meeting various criteria.
completion: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT TM_MRN) FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON TM_MRN = PT_MRN AND PT_SEX = 'F' AND YEAR(TM_DX_DTE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) >= 18 JOIN IDB.CL_PAS_PATIENT ON TM_MRN = CPP_MRN AND (CPP_LANG IS NULL OR CPP_LANG IN ('', 'ENG')) WHERE TM_CASE_STS = '3' AND TM_CLASS_OF_CASE IN ('1', '2') AND TM_DX_DTE BETWEEN '2008-01-01' AND '2009-12-31' AND (TM_SYST_STRT_DTE IS NOT NULL OR TM_RAD_STRT_DTE IS NOT NULL OR TM_CA_SURG_DTE BETWEEN TM_DX_DTE AND (TM_DX_DTE + 6 MONTHS)) AND ((TM_SITE_CD = 'C569' AND TM_HIST_CD NOT LIKE '%/0' AND TM_HIST_CD NOT LIKE '%/1') OR TM_SITE_CD IN ('C481', 'C482') OR TM_SITE_CD = 'C570') SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT TM_MRN) FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON TM_MRN = PT_MRN AND PT_SEX = 'F' AND YEAR(TM_DX_DTE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) >= 18 JOIN IDB.CL_PAS_PATIENT ON TM_MRN = CPP_MRN AND (CPP_LANG IS NULL OR CPP_LANG IN ('', 'ENG')) JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS ON AV_ELEMENT = 'AJCC' AND AV_CODE = TM_AJCC WHERE TM_CASE_STS = '3' AND TM_CLASS_OF_CASE IN ('1', '2') AND TM_DX_DTE BETWEEN '2008-01-01' AND '2009-12-31' AND (TM_SYST_STRT_DTE IS NOT NULL OR TM_RAD_STRT_DTE IS NOT NULL OR TM_CA_SURG_DTE BETWEEN TM_DX_DTE AND (TM_DX_DTE + 6 MONTHS)) AND TM_SITE_CD IN ('C540', 'C541', 'C542', 'C543', 'C548', 'C549', 'C559') AND (AV_DESC LIKE 'III%' OR AV_DESC LIKE 'IV%') SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT TM_MRN) FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON TM_MRN = PT_MRN AND PT_SEX = 'F' AND YEAR(TM_DX_DTE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) >= 18 JOIN IDB.CL_PAS_PATIENT ON TM_MRN = CPP_MRN AND (CPP_LANG IS NULL OR CPP_LANG IN ('', 'ENG')) JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS ON AV_ELEMENT = 'AJCC' AND AV_CODE = TM_AJCC WHERE TM_CASE_STS = '3' AND TM_CLASS_OF_CASE IN ('1', '2') AND TM_DX_DTE BETWEEN '2008-01-01' AND '2009-12-31' AND TM_SITE_CD IN ('C530', 'C531', 'C538', 'C539') AND (AV_DESC LIKE 'II%' OR AV_DESC LIKE 'III%' OR AV_DESC LIKE 'IV%')

prompt: Provide a one-time list of Cardiology patients with Doxorubicin exposure.
completion: WITH DOXO AS (SELECT PT_MRN AS MRN, PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID AS DEID, PINC_GENERIC_NAME AS "Generic Drug Name", CAT.PINC_CHEMO_IND AS "Chemo Indicator", DT_DTE AS "Order Start Date", POD_DOSE, POD_DOSE_UNIT, POD_CALC_BSA, POD_CALC_WT_KG, POD_CALS_HT_CM, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY PT_MRN ORDER BY DT_DTE) AS RN, CASE WHEN POD_CALC_BSA IS NOT NULL THEN RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY PT_MRN ORDER BY DT_DTE DESC) ELSE NULL END AS FV FROM DV.PHM_ORDER_DTL DTL JOIN DV.PHM_INVENTORY_CATALOG CAT ON DTL.POD_PHARMA_INVENTORY_CTLG_ID = PINC_INVENTORY_CTLG_ID JOIN DV.DATE_V ON DTL.POD_START_DATE_ID = DT_DATE_ID JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = POD_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID WHERE 1=1 AND PINC_GENERIC_NAME IN ('DOXOrubicin') ) , MIN_BSA AS (SELECT MRN, POD_CALC_BSA, "Order Start Date", ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY MRN ORDER BY "Order Start Date") RN FROM DOXO WHERE POD_CALC_BSA IS NOT NULL ) , PRELIM_DOSE_QUERY AS (SELECT Q1.MRN, Q1."Generic Drug Name", Q1."Order Start Date", COALESCE(COALESCE(Q1.POD_CALC_BSA, Q2.POD_CALC_BSA), Q3.POD_CALC_BSA) AS BSA, Q1.POD_DOSE / COALESCE(COALESCE(Q1.POD_CALC_BSA, Q2.POD_CALC_BSA), Q3.POD_CALC_BSA) AS "mg/m2", Q1.POD_DOSE, Q1.POD_DOSE_UNIT, SUM(Q1.POD_DOSE / COALESCE(COALESCE(Q1.POD_CALC_BSA, Q2.POD_CALC_BSA), Q3.POD_CALC_BSA)) OVER (PARTITION BY Q1.MRN ORDER BY Q1."Order Start Date") AS "Running mg/m2", SUM(Q1.POD_DOSE) OVER (PARTITION BY Q1.MRN ORDER BY Q1."Order Start Date") AS "Running Dose", ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY Q1.MRN ORDER BY Q1."Order Start Date") AS RN FROM DOXO AS Q1 LEFT JOIN DOXO AS Q2 ON Q1.MRN = Q2.MRN AND Q1.RN - 1 = Q2.RN LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM MIN_BSA WHERE RN = 1) AS Q3 ON Q1.MRN = Q3.MRN) SELECT MRN, "Generic Drug Name", "Order Start Date", BSA, "mg/m2", POD_DOSE AS "Dose", POD_DOSE_UNIT AS "Dose Unit", "Running mg/m2", "Running Dose", RN AS "Row Number" FROM PRELIM_DOSE_QUERY ; WITH DOXO AS (SELECT PT_MRN AS MRN, PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID AS DEID, PINC_GENERIC_NAME AS "Generic Drug Name", CAT.PINC_CHEMO_IND AS "Chemo Indicator", DT_DTE AS "Order Start Date", POD_DOSE, POD_DOSE_UNIT, POD_CALC_BSA, POD_CALC_WT_KG, POD_CALS_HT_CM, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY PT_MRN ORDER BY DT_DTE) AS RN, CASE WHEN POD_CALC_BSA IS NOT NULL THEN RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY PT_MRN ORDER BY DT_DTE DESC) ELSE NULL END AS FV FROM DV.PHM_ORDER_DTL DTL JOIN DV.PHM_INVENTORY_CATALOG CAT ON DTL.POD_PHARMA_INVENTORY_CTLG_ID = PINC_INVENTORY_CTLG_ID JOIN DV.DATE_V ON DTL.POD_START_DATE_ID = DT_DATE_ID JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = POD_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID WHERE 1=1 AND PINC_GENERIC_NAME IN ('DOXOrubicin') ) SELECT CDD_MRN AS "MRN", CDD_SERVICE_DTE AS "Service Date", CDD_DOC_NAME AS "Document", CDD_AUTH_PROV_NAME AS "Provider", CDD_DOCUMENT_FULL_TEXT AS "Document Text", CASE WHEN LENGTH(DV.REGEXSTR('.*mg\/m.*', CDD_DOCUMENT_FULL_TEXT)) > 1 AND LENGTH(DV.REGEXSTR('.*doxo.*', CDD_DOCUMENT_FULL_TEXT)) > 1 THEN COALESCE(DV.REGEXSTR('.*mg\/m.*', CDD_DOCUMENT_FULL_TEXT), DV.REGEXSTR('.*doxo.*', CDD_DOCUMENT_FULL_TEXT)) ELSE DV.REGEXSTR('.*mg\/m.*', CDD_DOCUMENT_FULL_TEXT) END AS "mg/m string" FROM DV.CLINDOC_FULL_TEXT_V WHERE CDD_CANCEL_IND <> '1' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND <> '1' AND CDD_DOC_NAME IN ('Initial Consultation, IP - Cardiology', 'Initial Consultation, Amb - Cardiology') AND CDD_MRN IN (SELECT MRN FROM DOXO) AND CDD_SERVICE_DTE BETWEEN '2019-01-01' AND '2019-12-31' ; WITH DOXO AS (SELECT PT_MRN AS MRN, PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID AS DEID, PINC_GENERIC_NAME AS "Generic Drug Name", CAT.PINC_CHEMO_IND AS "Chemo Indicator", DT_DTE AS "Order Start Date", POD_DOSE, POD_DOSE_UNIT, POD_CALC_BSA, POD_CALC_WT_KG, POD_CALS_HT_CM, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY PT_MRN ORDER BY DT_DTE) AS RN, CASE WHEN POD_CALC_BSA IS NOT NULL THEN RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY PT_MRN ORDER BY DT_DTE DESC) ELSE NULL END AS FV FROM DV.PHM_ORDER_DTL DTL JOIN DV.PHM_INVENTORY_CATALOG CAT ON DTL.POD_PHARMA_INVENTORY_CTLG_ID = PINC_INVENTORY_CTLG_ID JOIN DV.DATE_V ON DTL.POD_START_DATE_ID = DT_DATE_ID JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = POD_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID WHERE 1=1 AND PINC_GENERIC_NAME IN ('DOXOrubicin') ) , CLINDOC AS (SELECT CDD_MRN, CDD_DOC_NAME, CDD_SERVICE_DTE, CDD_DOCUMENT_FULL_TEXT, CDD_AUTH_PROV_NAME, CASE WHEN LENGTH(DV.REGEXSTR('.*mg\/m.*', CDD_DOCUMENT_FULL_TEXT)) > 1 AND LENGTH(DV.REGEXSTR('.*doxo.*', CDD_DOCUMENT_FULL_TEXT)) > 1 THEN COALESCE(DV.REGEXSTR('.*mg\/m.*', CDD_DOCUMENT_FULL_TEXT), DV.REGEXSTR('.*doxo.*', CDD_DOCUMENT_FULL_TEXT)) ELSE DV.REGEXSTR('.*mg\/m.*', CDD_DOCUMENT_FULL_TEXT) END AS "mg/m string" FROM DV.CLINDOC_FULL_TEXT_V WHERE CDD_CANCEL_IND <> '1' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND <> '1' AND CDD_DOC_NAME IN ('Initial Consultation, IP - Cardiology', 'Initial Consultation, Amb - Cardiology') AND CDD_MRN IN (SELECT MRN FROM DOXO) AND CDD_SERVICE_DTE BETWEEN '2019-01-01' AND '2019-12-31' ) , MIN_BSA AS (SELECT MRN, POD_CALC_BSA, "Order Start Date", ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY MRN ORDER BY "Order Start Date") RN FROM DOXO WHERE POD_CALC_BSA IS NOT NULL ) , PRELIM_DOSE_QUERY AS (SELECT Q1.MRN, Q1."Generic Drug Name", Q1."Order Start Date", COALESCE(COALESCE(Q1.POD_CALC_BSA, Q2.POD_CALC_BSA), Q3.POD_CALC_BSA) AS BSA, Q1.POD_DOSE / COALESCE(COALESCE(Q1.POD_CALC_BSA, Q2.POD_CALC_BSA), Q3.POD_CALC_BSA) AS "mg/m2", Q1.POD_DOSE, Q1.POD_DOSE_UNIT, SUM(Q1.POD_DOSE / COALESCE(COALESCE(Q1.POD_CALC_BSA, Q2.POD_CALC_BSA), Q3.POD_CALC_BSA)) OVER (PARTITION BY Q1.MRN ORDER BY Q1."Order Start Date") AS "Running mg/m2", SUM(Q1.POD_DOSE) OVER (PARTITION BY Q1.MRN ORDER BY Q1."Order Start Date") AS "Running Dose", ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY MRN ORDER BY "Order Start Date") AS RN FROM DOXO AS Q1 LEFT JOIN DOXO AS Q2 ON Q1.MRN = Q2.MRN AND Q1.RN - 1 = Q2.RN LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM MIN_BSA WHERE RN = 1) AS Q3 ON Q1.MRN = Q3.MRN) , U AS (SELECT MRN AS MRN, '' AS "Generic Drug Name", CAST('2019-01-01' AS DATE) AS "Order Start Date", 0.0 AS "BSA", 0.0 AS "mg/m2", 0.0 AS "Dose", '' AS "Dose Unit", 0.0 AS "Running mg/m2", 0.0 AS "Running Dose" FROM DOXO UNION SELECT MRN, "Generic Drug Name", "Order Start Date", BSA, "mg/m2", POD_DOSE, POD_DOSE_UNIT, "Running mg/m2", "Running Dose" FROM PRELIM_DOSE_QUERY UNION SELECT MRN AS MRN, '' AS "Generic Drug Name", CAST('2019-12-31' AS DATE) AS "Order Start Date", 0.0 AS "BSA", 0.0 AS "mg/m2", 0.0 AS "Dose", '' AS "Dose Unit", 0.0 AS "Running mg/m2", 0.0 AS "Running Dose" FROM DOXO) , DOSE_QUERY AS (SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY MRN ORDER BY "Order Start Date") AS RN FROM U) SELECT DQ1.MRN, DQ1."Dose", DQ1."Running Dose", DQ1."Dose Unit", DQ1."Running mg/m2", DQ1.RN, DQ1."Order Start Date" AS "Drug Order Date", CLINDOC.CDD_SERVICE_DTE AS "Clindoc note date", CLINDOC."mg/m string", CLINDOC.CDD_DOC_NAME, CLINDOC.CDD_AUTH_PROV_NAME, CLINDOC.CDD_DOCUMENT_FULL_TEXT FROM (SELECT * FROM DOSE_QUERY WHERE "Order Start Date" BETWEEN '2019-01-01' AND '2019-12-31') DQ1 LEFT JOIN (SELECT MRN, "Order Start Date", RN FROM DOSE_QUERY) DQ2 ON DQ1.MRN = DQ2.MRN AND DQ1.RN = DQ2.RN + 1 LEFT JOIN CLINDOC ON DQ1.MRN = CDD_MRN AND CDD_SERVICE_DTE BETWEEN DQ2."Order Start Date" AND DQ1."Order Start Date" WHERE DQ1.MRN IN (SELECT DISTINCT MRN FROM DOSE_QUERY JOIN CLINDOC ON MRN = CDD_MRN) ORDER BY DQ1.MRN AND DQ1.RN

prompt: Cohort notification of Dr. Lynn Brody's patients with primary IR operator and performed procedures of: Hepatic tumor embolization, ablation or placement of a biliary drain or stent. Notification when patients have CT/MRI/PET scans.
completion: WITH CTE AS (SELECT DISTINCT OL_MRN AS MRN, PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID AS DEID, OL_SURG_DTE AS SURGDATE, CRE_RES_NAME AS RESNAME, OLAS_SURG_SVC AS SURGSVC, OP_PROC_NAME AS PROCNAME, OLAS_SURG_ROLE_CD, OL_LOG_ID FROM IDB.OR_LOG JOIN IDB.OR_LOG_ALL_SURG ON OL_LOG_ID = OLAS_LOG_ID JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON OLAS_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.OR_LNLG_DX ON OLAS_LOG_ID = OLLD_LOG_ID AND OLAS_PNL_NO = OLLD_DX_PROC_PNL LEFT JOIN IDB.OR_PROC ON OLLD_DX_OR_PROC = OP_OR_PROC_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.OR_CL_PROC ON OP_OR_PROC_ID = OCP_OR_PROC_ID JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON OL_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE OL_LOG_STS IN ('Posted', 'Unposted') AND OLAS_SURG_ROLE_CD = '1' AND OCP_OR_PROC_ID IN ('11100076', '11100079', '11100299', '11100043', '11100181', '11100317', '11100319', '11100318', '11100177', '11100327', '11100328', '11100075', '11100080', '11100007', '11100008', '11100212', '11100009', '11100316', '11100082') AND CRE_RES_ID = '009019' ) , DEID AS (SELECT DISTINCT DEID FROM CTE) SELECT MRN, SURGDATE AS "Latest IR Date", PROCNAME AS "Latest IR Procedure", RRPT_ORDER_GROUP AS "Report Type", RRPT_PROCEDURE_NAME AS "Procedure", RRPT_RPT_ID AS "Report ID", RRPT_REPORT_DTE AS "Report Date", RRPT_REPORT_TXT AS "Report" FROM (SELECT MRN, SURGDATE, PROCNAME, SURGSVC, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY MRN ORDER BY SURGDATE DESC) AS LAST_IR FROM CTE) A JOIN DV.RADIOLOGY_REPORT_V ON A.MRN = RRPT_MRN WHERE (RRPT_ORDER_GROUP IN ('CT', 'MR', 'MR RO') AND (LOWER(RRPT_PROCEDURE_NAME) NOT like '%brain%' OR LOWER(RRPT_PROCEDURE_NAME) NOT like '%spine%')) OR (RRPT_ORDER_GROUP IN ('PET', 'PET for Cancer', 'PET for Cardiac viability or perfusion')) AND LAST_IR = 1 ;

prompt: Provide a list of breast cancer patients scheduled for IR biopsies, CT scans or PET scans.
completion: WITH TM AS (SELECT DISTINCT TM_MRN AS MRN, TM_DX_DTE AS DX_DATE, TM_SITE_CD AS DX_CODE, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS DX_DESC FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.SEERGROUPING ON RECODE = DV.SEERF_ICDO(TM_SITE_CD, TM_HIST_CD) AND CATEGORY1 = 'Breast' JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD WHERE 1=1 AND TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') ) , CC AS (SELECT CC_MRN AS MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS DX_DATE, CLM_CLSF_CD AS DX_CODE, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS DX_DESC FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD AND(CLM_CLSF_CD LIKE 'C50%' OR CLM_CLSF_CD LIKE 'C174%' OR CLM_CLSF_CD LIKE 'C175%') WHERE CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND ((CC_PT_TYPE = 'I') OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) AND CC_MRN NOT IN (SELECT MRN FROM TM) GROUP BY CC_MRN, CLM_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK ) , X AS (SELECT TM.* FROM TM UNION SELECT CC.* FROM CC) , CPE AS (SELECT DISTINCT STRIP(CPE_MRN) AS MRN, STRIP(PT_LAST_NAME) || ', ' || STRIP(PT_FIRST_NAME) AS "Name", CPE_ENC_DTE AS "Appt Date", CRE_RES_TYP, STRIP(CLD_DEPT_NAME) AS "Department", CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8, STRIP(CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME) AS "Visit Type" FROM IDB.PATIENT JOIN IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER ON PT_MRN = CPE_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Sch') AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT DATE AND CURRENT DATE + 7 DAYS AND CPE_MRN IN (SELECT MRN FROM X) AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 IN ('NUC', 'RAD') AND(CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME LIKE 'CT%CH%' OR CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME LIKE 'CT%AB%' OR CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME LIKE 'CT%PE%' OR CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME LIKE '%PET%' OR CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME LIKE 'BI%' OR CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME LIKE '%BONE%') AND CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME NOT LIKE '%BONE%DENS%' AND CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME NOT LIKE '%MAMMO%' AND CRE_RES_NAME NOT LIKE '%MAMMO%' AND CRE_RES_NAME NOT LIKE 'US%' AND CRE_RES_NAME NOT LIKE 'MRI%' ) , AC AS (SELECT AC_MRN, MAX(CASE WHEN AC_IRB_NO = '06-107' THEN AC_CONS_DTE END) AS "06-107 Consent Date", MAX(CASE WHEN AC_IRB_NO = '12-245' THEN AC_CONS_DTE END) AS "12-245 Consent Date" FROM IDB.ACCRUALS WHERE AC_IRB_NO IN ('06-107', '12-245') AND AC_MRN IN (SELECT DISTINCT MRN FROM CPE) GROUP BY AC_MRN ) , NEXT_APPT AS (SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN, CPE_ENC_DTE, CRE_RES_NAME, CRE_RES_TYP, CLD_DEPT_NAME, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8, CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CPE_MRN ORDER BY CPE_ENC_DTE) AS RN_CPE FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Sch') AND CRE_RES_TYP IN ('Physician') AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 = 'BRE' AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 = 'MED' AND CPE_MRN IN (SELECT DISTINCT MRN FROM CPE) ) SELECT DISTINCT CPE.*, CPE_ENC_DTE AS "Next BRE MED Appt Date", STRIP(CRE_RES_NAME) AS "Physician", STRIP(CLD_DEPT_NAME) AS "Department", STRIP(CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME) AS "Visit Type", "06-107 Consent Date", "12-245 Consent Date" FROM CPE JOIN X ON CPE.MRN = X.MRN LEFT JOIN NEXT_APPT ON CPE.MRN = CPE_MRN AND RN_CPE = 1 LEFT JOIN AC ON CPE.MRN = AC_MRN

prompt: Provide RMS charge for reconciliation project.
completion: SELECT DISTINCT RV_MRN, RV_ADM_NUM, A.RVCD_SVC_DTE, A.RVCD_POST_DTE, RCDD_CHARGE_CD, RCDD_CHARGE_DESCRIPTION, A.RVCD_DESC_OVERRIDE, B.RVCD_UNITS, B.RVCD_AMT, RICOD_IC_ONE_CD, RICOD_IC_ONE_DESCRIPTION, PERF_SITE_NAME, CASE WHEN RCDD_CHARGE_CD IN ('SDHS00330', 'SDHS00331') AND RICOD_IC_ONE_CD = '278' THEN 'NON STANDARD IMPLANT' WHEN LEFT(RCDD_CHARGE_CD, 4) = 'SDHS' AND RICOD_IC_ONE_CD = '278' THEN 'STANDARD IMPLANT' WHEN RCDD_CHARGE_CD IN ('SDHS00330', 'SDHS00331') AND RICOD_IC_ONE_CD = '272' THEN 'NON STANDARD SUPPLY' WHEN LEFT(RCDD_CHARGE_CD, 4) = 'SDHS' AND RICOD_IC_ONE_CD = '272' THEN 'STANDARD SUPPLY' END TYP FROM IDB.RMS_VISIT_CHARGE_DTL A JOIN IDB.RMS_VISIT ON RV_VISIT_ID = A.RVCD_VISIT_ID JOIN IDB.RMS_CHARGE_CODE_DICT_DN1240 ON A.RVCD_CHARGE_CODE_REC_NO = RCDD_RECORD_NUMBER JOIN IDB.RMS_INSURANCE_CLASSIFICATION_ONE_DICT_DN1209 ON A.RVCD_IC_CODE_REC_NO = RICOD_RECORD_NUMBER JOIN IDB.RMS_VISIT_CHARGE_DTL_V B ON A.RVCD_VISIT_ID = B.RVCD_VISIT_ID AND RCDD_CHARGE_CD = CHARGE_CD WHERE LEFT(RCDD_CHARGE_CD, 4) = 'SDHS' AND RICOD_IC_ONE_CD IN ('272', '278') AND A.RVCD_SVC_DTE BETWEEN '2020-01-01' AND '2020-06-29' ;

prompt: Annual Request to Identify patients for Annual Convocation Ceremony
completion: WITH D01 AS (SELECT CRE_RES_ID AS RESID , CPE_MRN AS MRN , CPE_ENC_DTE AS APPTDATE , PT_LAST_NAME AS LASTNAME, PT_FIRST_NAME AS FIRSTNAME , PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH AS DOB , PT_ADDR1 AS ADDR1, PT_ADDR2 AS ADDR2 , PT_CITY AS CITY, PT_STATE AS STATE, PT_ZIP_CD AS ZIP , PT_PHONE AS PHONE, CL_MOBILE_PHONE AS MOBILE_PHONE, CPP_EMAIL_ADDR AS EMAIL_ADDR FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID AND CLD_DEPT_ID IN ('1174', '156', '161', '1658', '17', '247', '248', '249', '278', '281', '366', '460', '462', '463', '465', '466', '467', '468', '550', '622') JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CRE_RES_ID = CPE_VST_RES_ID AND CRE_RES_TYP IN ('Physician', 'PhD', 'Nurse Practitioner', 'Advanced Practice Nurse', 'Physician Assistant') JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PT_MRN = CPE_MRN AND PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH BETWEEN DATE('1/1/'||YEAR(CURRENT date - 19 YEARS)) AND DATE('12/31/'||YEAR(CURRENT date - 17 YEARS)) AND PT_DEATH_IND NOT IN ('C', 'D', 'X') JOIN IDB.CL_PAS_PATIENT ON PT_MRN = CPP_MRN AND CPP_MRN <> '' JOIN IDB.CL_PATIENT ON PT_MRN = CL_MRN WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Comp', 'Arrived') AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN '2004-01-01' AND '2023-02-02' ) , D02 AS (SELECT A.MRN, DOC_NAME, RESID, DOC_ACDMC_SVC AS SVC, DOC_ACDMC_DPT AS DPT , COUNT(APPTDATE) AS MDCT , LASTNAME, FIRSTNAME, CITY, STATE, PHONE, DOB , ADDR1, ADDR2, ZIP, MOBILE_PHONE, EMAIL_ADDR FROM D01 A JOIN (SELECT MRN, COUNT(APPTDATE) AS COUNT FROM D01 GROUP BY MRN HAVING COUNT(APPTDATE) > 9) AS X ON X.MRN = A.MRN JOIN IDB.DOC ON RESID = DOC_DR_NO GROUP BY A.MRN, DOC_NAME, RESID, DOC_ACDMC_SVC, DOC_ACDMC_DPT , LASTNAME, FIRSTNAME, CITY, STATE, PHONE, DOB , ADDR1, ADDR2, ZIP, MOBILE_PHONE, EMAIL_ADDR) SELECT A.MRN, DOC_NAME, RESID, SVC, DPT, MDCT , LASTNAME, FIRSTNAME, DOB, ADDR1, ADDR2 , CITY, STATE, ZIP, PHONE, PLA_DONOT_MAIL_IND , MOBILE_PHONE, EMAIL_ADDR FROM D02 A JOIN (SELECT MRN, MAX(MDCT) AS MAXCOUNT FROM D02 GROUP BY MRN) AS X ON X.MRN = A.MRN AND MAXCOUNT = MDCT JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY ON A.MRN = PLA_MRN AND PLA_DONOT_MAIL_IND <> 'Y' GROUP BY A.MRN, DOC_NAME, RESID, SVC, DPT, MDCT , LASTNAME, FIRSTNAME, DOB, ADDR1, ADDR2 , CITY, STATE, ZIP, PHONE, PLA_DONOT_MAIL_IND , MOBILE_PHONE, EMAIL_ADDR

prompt: Provide a report of all BMT patients referred/seen by the geriatric service from 1/1/2019 to 12/31/2020.
completion: WITH X AS (SELECT DISTINCT OO_MRN, STRIP(PT_LAST_NAME) || ', ' ||STRIP(PT_FIRST_NAME) AS NAME, OO_ENTER_DTE, YEAR(OO_ENTER_DTE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) AS AGE, OO_ORD_NAME, OUD_USER_DI_VALUE AS "Consult GER Refer Svc", '' AS OUO_PVDR_NAME FROM IDB.OMS_ORDER JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON OO_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_USER_DATA ON OO_ORD_GUID = OUD_ORD_GUID AND OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'Consult_Geriatric OP Refer Service All' AND OUD_USER_DI_VALUE IN ('Bone Marrow Transplant', 'BMT') WHERE OO_ORD_STS_CD NOT IN ('CANC', 'CANP', 'AUC3') AND OO_ENTER_DTE BETWEEN '2019-01-01' AND '2020-12-31' AND OO_ORD_NAME IN ('Geriatric Outpatient Consult') UNION SELECT DISTINCT OO_MRN, STRIP(PT_LAST_NAME) || ', ' ||STRIP(PT_FIRST_NAME) AS NAME, OO_ENTER_DTE, YEAR(OO_ENTER_DTE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) AS AGE, OO_ORD_NAME, '' AS "Consult GER Refer Svc", STRIP(OUO_PVDR_NAME) AS OUO_PVDR_NAME FROM IDB.OMS_ORDER JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON OO_MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_USER_ORDERS ON OO_ORD_GUID = OUO_ORD_GUID WHERE OO_ORD_STS_CD NOT IN ('CANC', 'CANP', 'AUC3') AND OO_ENTER_DTE BETWEEN '2019-01-01' AND '2020-12-31' AND OO_ORD_NAME IN ('Geriatric Inpatient Consult') ) , Y AS (SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN, STRIP(PT_LAST_NAME) || ', ' || STRIP(PT_FIRST_NAME) AS NAME, CPE_ENC_DTE, YEAR(CPE_ENC_DTE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) AS AGE, R2.CRE_RES_NAME AS "Referring Physician", CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR AS "Visit Type" FROM IDB.PATIENT JOIN IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER ON CPE_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE R1 ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = R1.CRE_RES_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE R2 ON CPE_REF_RES_ID = R2.CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND R1.CRE_RES_TYP IN ('Physician') AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN '2019-01-01' AND '2020-12-31' AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 = 'GER' AND R2.CRE_RES_ID IN ('012286', '022731', '014639', '018176', '025791', '015404', '018770', '017194', '010801', '002352', '022764', '017426', '013748', '025601', '025098', '002972', '021527', '009894', '023184', '015560', '015255', '022806', '018846', '022012', '020685', '018184', '010389', '002212') ) SELECT DISTINCT X.*, CPE_ENC_DTE AS VISIT_DATE, "Referring Physician", "Visit Type" FROM X LEFT JOIN Y ON X.OO_MRN = Y.CPE_MRN

prompt: Provide a daily report of newly scheduled MRI appointments at BAIC and include most recent BI-RADS score if available.
completion: WITH APPT AS (SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN AS "MRN", CPE_ENC_DTE, CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Sch') AND CPE_ENC_DTE >= CURRENT date AND CRE_RES_ID IN ('200804', '200805', '200806') AND CPE_APPT_MADE_DTE = CURRENT date - 1 DAY AND CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME IN ('MR BREAST BILATERAL W/O CONTR', 'MR BREAST BILATERAL W/WO CON', 'MR BREAST UNI LEFT W/WO CON', 'MR BREAST UNILAT W/O CONTR,L', 'MR BREAST UNILAT W/O CONTR,R') ) , X AS (SELECT RRPT_MRN, RRPT_RPT_ID, RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY RRPT_MRN ORDER BY RRPT_PERFORMED_DT DESC) AS RANK, DV.REGEX('BI-RADS', RRPT_REPORT_TXT, 'matchCount') AS BI_RAD_MENTIONED, LTRIM(RTRIM(REPLACE(DV.REGEXSTR('\WBI-RADS(\s|\s\s)([0-6]|zero)', RRPT_REPORT_TXT), 'BI-RADS', ''))) AS BI_RAD_SCORE_STR FROM DV.RADIOLOGY_REPORT_V WHERE CONTAINS(RRPT_REPORT_TXT, '"bi-rads"') = 1 AND RRPT_MRN IN (SELECT "MRN" FROM APPT) ) , Y AS (SELECT RRPT_RPT_ID, RRPT_MRN, RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE, CASE WHEN BI_RAD_MENTIONED > 1 THEN 88 WHEN BI_RAD_SCORE_STR LIKE '%zero%' OR BI_RAD_SCORE_STR = '0' THEN 0 WHEN BI_RAD_SCORE_STR LIKE '%1%' THEN 1 WHEN BI_RAD_SCORE_STR LIKE '%2%' THEN 2 WHEN BI_RAD_SCORE_STR LIKE '%3%' THEN 3 WHEN BI_RAD_SCORE_STR LIKE '%4%' THEN 4 WHEN BI_RAD_SCORE_STR LIKE '%5%' THEN 5 WHEN BI_RAD_SCORE_STR LIKE '%6%' THEN 6 ELSE 99 END AS BI_RAD_SCORE FROM X WHERE RANK = 1 ) SELECT DISTINCT CPE_ENC_DTE "MRI Appointment Date", "MRN", PT_FIRST_NAME "First", PT_LAST_NAME "Last", BI_RAD_SCORE "BI-RADS Score", RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE "BI-RADS Score Date" FROM APPT LEFT JOIN Y ON "MRN" = RRPT_MRN JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V ON "MRN" = PT_MRN WHERE YEAR(CPE_ENC_DTE - PT_BIRTH_DTE) >= 18 ORDER BY CPE_ENC_DTE;

prompt: Provide list of physical therapy, occupational therapy and lymphedema therapy orders for past 3 years.
completion: WITH ORDERS AS (SELECT DISTINCT OO_MRN, VIS_ADM_NUM, OO_ORD_GUID, VIS_ADM_DT "Date of Admission", VIS_DSCH_DT "Date of Discharge", OO_ENTER_DT "Order Entered Date", OO_REQUESTED_DT "Order Requested Date", OO_SIGNIFICANT_DT "Order Significant Date", DOC_NAME "Requested by", OS_SVC_GRP_CD "Service", OOC_ITEM_NAME "Order Name", OSTS_STS_DESC "Order Status", CASE WHEN OOC_MSTR_ITEM_GUID IN ('8000003652073029' , '6000003652073029' , '1000003879073029' , '2000003826073029' , '9000005518100730' , '9000005342100730' , '9000004945100730' , '9000006897100730' , '9000005720300730' , '8000001033073001' , '2000004779073029' , '9000005666100730' , '9000005480100730' , '1000004756073029') THEN 'PT' WHEN OOC_MSTR_ITEM_GUID IN ('1000004274073029' , '9000004902100730') THEN 'Lymph' WHEN OOC_MSTR_ITEM_GUID IN ('7000003652073029' , '1000003826073029' , '9000005518200730') THEN 'OT' END AS "Order Group" FROM IDB.OMS_ORDER JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_CATALOG ON OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID = OOC_MSTR_ITEM_GUID JOIN IDB.DOC ON OO_REQ_DR_NO = DOC_DR_NO JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON OO_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.OMS_STATUS ON OO_ORD_STS_CD = OSTS_ORD_STS_CD JOIN IDB.OMS_CLIENT_VISIT ON OO_VISIT_GUID = OCV_VISIT_GUID LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_SERVICE ON OCV_SVC_GUID = OS_SVC_GUID LEFT JOIN IDB.VISIT_V ON OO_ADM_NUM = VIS_ADM_NUM WHERE (OOC_MSTR_ITEM_GUID IN ('9000004902100730' , '1000004274073029' , '8000003652073029' , '2000004779073029' , '9000005720300730' , '6000003652073029' , '9000005518200730' , '8000001033073001' , '1000004756073029' , '1000003826073029' , '9000005666100730' , '7000003652073029' , '9000004945100730' , '9000006897100730' , '1000003879073029' , '9000005342100730' , '9000005480100730' , '9000005518100730' , '2000003826073029') OR LOWER(OOC_ITEM_NAME) like '%physical%' OR LOWER(OOC_ITEM_NAME) like '%occupational%') AND OO_ENTER_DTE >= '2016-01-01' AND VIS_ADM_DTE >= '2016-01-01' ) , FIRST_ORDER AS (SELECT OO_MRN F_OO_MRN , VIS_ADM_NUM F_VIS_ADM_NUM , OO_ORD_GUID F_OO_ORD_GUID , "Requested by" "First Requested By" , "Service" "First Service" , "Order Name" "First Order Name" , "Order Entered Date" "First Order Entered Date" , "Order Requested Date" "First Order Requested Date" , "Order Significant Date" "First Order Significant Date" , "Order Group" "First Order Group" , "Order Status" "First Order Status" , ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY VIS_ADM_NUM, "Order Group" ORDER BY "Order Requested Date" ASC) AS FIRST_ORDER_RANK FROM ORDERS) , LAST_ORDER AS (SELECT OO_MRN F_OO_MRN , VIS_ADM_NUM L_VIS_ADM_NUM , OO_ORD_GUID L_OO_ORD_GUID , "Requested by" "Last Requested By" , "Service" "Last Service" , "Order Name" "Last Order Name" , "Order Entered Date" "Last Order Entered Date" , "Order Requested Date" "Last Order Requested Date" , "Order Significant Date" "Last Order Significant Date" , "Order Group" "Last Order Group" , "Order Status" "Last Order Status" , ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY VIS_ADM_NUM, "Order Group" ORDER BY "Order Requested Date" DESC) AS LAST_ORDER_RANK FROM ORDERS) , FIRST_NOTE AS (SELECT CDD_DOC_NAME, VIS_ADM_NUM, OP_DISPLAY_NAME, CDD_SERVICE_DT, CDD_ENTER_DT, CDD_AUTHORED_DT, CDD_MRN, CDD_ADM_NUM, CDD_DOC_GUID, ORDER_GROUP, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CDD_ADM_NUM, ORDER_GROUP ORDER BY CDD_ENTER_DT ASC) AS FIRST_RANK FROM (SELECT DISTINCT CDD_DOC_NAME, VIS_ADM_NUM, OP_DISPLAY_NAME, CDD_SERVICE_DT, CDD_ENTER_DT, CDD_AUTHORED_DT, CDD_MRN, CDD_ADM_NUM, CDD_DOC_GUID, CASE WHEN LOWER(CDD_DOC_NAME) like '%physical therapy%' THEN 'PT' WHEN LOWER(CDD_DOC_NAME) like '%occupational therapy%' THEN 'OT' WHEN LOWER(CDD_DOC_NAME) like '%lymphedema therapy%' THEN 'Lymph' END AS ORDER_GROUP FROM IDB.CD_DOCUMENT JOIN IDB.OMS_PROVIDER ON CDD_AUTH_PROV_GUID = OP_PVDR_GUID JOIN ORDERS ON CDD_ADM_NUM = VIS_ADM_NUM WHERE CDD_CANCEL_IND <> '1' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND <> '1' AND (LOWER(CDD_DOC_NAME) like '%physical therapy%' OR LOWER(CDD_DOC_NAME) like '%occupational therapy%' OR LOWER(CDD_DOC_NAME) like '%lymphedema therapy%') AND CDD_SERVICE_DTE >= '2016-01-01' ) A) , LAST_NOTE AS (SELECT CDD_DOC_NAME, VIS_ADM_NUM, OP_DISPLAY_NAME, CDD_SERVICE_DT, CDD_ENTER_DT, CDD_AUTHORED_DT, CDD_MRN, CDD_ADM_NUM, CDD_DOC_GUID, ORDER_GROUP, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CDD_ADM_NUM, ORDER_GROUP ORDER BY CDD_ENTER_DT DESC) AS LAST_RANK FROM (SELECT DISTINCT CDD_DOC_NAME, VIS_ADM_NUM, OP_DISPLAY_NAME, CDD_SERVICE_DT, CDD_ENTER_DT, CDD_AUTHORED_DT, CDD_MRN, CDD_ADM_NUM, CDD_DOC_GUID, CASE WHEN LOWER(CDD_DOC_NAME) like '%physical therapy%' THEN 'PT' WHEN LOWER(CDD_DOC_NAME) like '%occupational therapy%' THEN 'OT' WHEN LOWER(CDD_DOC_NAME) like '%lymphedema therapy%' THEN 'Lymph' END AS ORDER_GROUP FROM IDB.CD_DOCUMENT JOIN IDB.OMS_PROVIDER ON CDD_AUTH_PROV_GUID = OP_PVDR_GUID JOIN ORDERS ON CDD_ADM_NUM = VIS_ADM_NUM WHERE CDD_CANCEL_IND <> '1' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND <> '1' AND (LOWER(CDD_DOC_NAME) like '%physical therapy%' OR LOWER(CDD_DOC_NAME) like '%occupational therapy%' OR LOWER(CDD_DOC_NAME) like '%lymphedema therapy%') AND CDD_SERVICE_DTE >= '2016-01-01' ) A) SELECT DISTINCT A.VIS_ADM_NUM, "Date of Admission", "Date of Discharge", "Order Group", "First Order Entered Date", "First Order Requested Date", "First Service", "First Order Name", "First Order Status", "Last Order Entered Date", "Last Order Requested Date", "Last Service", "Last Order Name", "Last Order Status", B.CDD_DOC_GUID "First Note GUID", B.CDD_DOC_NAME "First Note", B.CDD_ENTER_DT "First Note Enter Date", B.CDD_SERVICE_DT "First Note Service Date", C.CDD_DOC_GUID "Last Note GUID", C.CDD_DOC_NAME "Last Note", C.CDD_ENTER_DT "Last Note Enter Date", C.CDD_SERVICE_DT "Last Note Service Date" FROM ORDERS A JOIN FIRST_ORDER D ON A.VIS_ADM_NUM = D.F_VIS_ADM_NUM AND A."Order Group" = D."First Order Group" AND FIRST_ORDER_RANK = 1 JOIN LAST_ORDER E ON A.VIS_ADM_NUM = E.L_VIS_ADM_NUM AND A."Order Group" = E."Last Order Group" AND LAST_ORDER_RANK = 1 LEFT JOIN FIRST_NOTE B ON A.VIS_ADM_NUM = B.CDD_ADM_NUM AND A."Order Group" = B.ORDER_GROUP AND FIRST_RANK = 1 LEFT JOIN LAST_NOTE C ON A.VIS_ADM_NUM = C.CDD_ADM_NUM AND A."Order Group" = C.ORDER_GROUP AND LAST_RANK = 1 WHERE 1=1 ;

prompt: Provide a list of patients diagnosed with colorectal cancer in MSK system between 1/1/2000 - 12/31/2012.
completion: SELECT DISTINCT TM_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, PT_DATE_OF_DEATH, PT_SEX, PLA_LST_ACTV_DTE, CS.CDB_AV_DESC AS CASE_STATUS, TM_HIST_CD, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS HISTOLOGY_DESC, TM_SITE_CD, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_DESC, TM_ICD9_CD, CASE WHEN TM_AJCC_7 NOT IN ('', '888', '999') THEN AJCC7.AV_DESC WHEN TM_AJCC NOT IN ('', '88', '99') THEN AJCC.AV_DESC ELSE '' END AS AJCC_STAGE, TM_SURG_DEF_DTE , TM_CA_SURG_DTE, AVSITE_DESC AS SURGERY_INFORMATION, RNS.CDB_AV_DESC AS REASON_NO_SURG, CASE WHEN TM_PATH_STG_GRP NOT IN ('', '88', '9', '99') THEN TM_PATH_STG_GRP ELSE '' END AS PATH_STAGE FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR INNER JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON TM_MRN = PT_MRN INNER JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD INNER JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD INNER JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY ON TM_MRN = PLA_MRN INNER JOIN IDB.CDB_ALLOWVALS CS ON TM_CASE_STS = CS.CDB_AV_CODE AND CS.CDB_AV_ELEMENT = 'CASE_STS' INNER JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS AJCC7 ON AJCC7.AV_ELEMENT = 'AJCC_7' AND AJCC7.AV_CODE = TM_AJCC_7 LEFT OUTER JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS AJCC ON AJCC.AV_ELEMENT = 'AJCC' AND AJCC.AV_CODE = TM_AJCC INNER JOIN IDB.CDB_ALLOWVALS RNS ON RNS.CDB_AV_ELEMENT = 'REASON_NO_SURG' AND RNS.CDB_AV_CD_STS = 'A' AND TM_REASON_NO_SURG = RNS.CDB_AV_CODE INNER JOIN IDB.CDB_ALLOWVALS_SITE ON AVSITE_ELEMENT = 'CA_SURG_SUM_03' AND AVSITE_CODE = TM_CA_SURG_03 AND TM_SITE_CD BETWEEN AVSITE_LOW_SITE AND AVSITE_HIGH_SITE WHERE TM_SITE_CD IN ('C180', 'C182', 'C183', 'C184', 'C185', 'C186', 'C187', 'C188', 'C189', 'C199', 'C209', 'C218') AND TM_DX_DTE >= '1/1/2000' AND TM_DX_DTE <= '12/31/2012' AND TM_CASE_STS IN ('3', '6', '7', '8')

prompt: Daily report for patients who completed Engage survey with alerts and which procedure they have so clinicians can intervene.
completion: WITH IRNV AS (SELECT EF_MRN MRN, DATE(EF_SUBMISSION_DT) SUBMISSION_DATE, DATE(EA_ASSIGN_DT) SURVEY_ASSIGN_DATE , EF_FORM_ALIAS FORM_ALIAS, EA_SOURCE_ID SOURCE_ID , MAX(CASE WHEN TRIM(EFI_ITEM_ALIAS) = 'heartstent_6mo' THEN SUBSTR(EFI_VALUE, 1, 3) END) AS HEART_STENT_6MO , MAX(CASE WHEN TRIM(EFI_ITEM_ALIAS) = 'heartattack_6mo' THEN SUBSTR(EFI_VALUE, 1, 3) END) AS HEART_ATTACK_6MO , MAX(CASE WHEN TRIM(EFI_ITEM_ALIAS) = 'faint_6mo' THEN SUBSTR(EFI_VALUE, 1, 3) END) AS FAINT_6MO , MAX(CASE WHEN TRIM(EFI_ITEM_ALIAS) = 'TIA_6mo' THEN SUBSTR(EFI_VALUE, 1, 3) END) AS TIA_6MO , MAX(CASE WHEN TRIM(EFI_ITEM_ALIAS) = 'stroke_6mo' THEN SUBSTR(EFI_VALUE, 1, 3) END) AS STROKE_6MO , MAX(CASE WHEN TRIM(EFI_ITEM_ALIAS) = 'difficultopenmouth_y_n' THEN SUBSTR(EFI_VALUE, 1, 3) END) AS DIFFICULT_OPEN_MOUTH_Y_N , MAX(CASE WHEN TRIM(EFI_ITEM_ALIAS) = 'headneck_surgery' THEN SUBSTR(EFI_VALUE, 1, 3) END) AS HEAD_NECK_SURGERY , MAX(CASE WHEN TRIM(EFI_ITEM_ALIAS) = 'SOB_lyingflat' THEN SUBSTR(EFI_VALUE, 1, 3) END) AS SOB_LYING_FLAT FROM IDB.EF_FORM JOIN IDB.EF_FORM_ITEM ON EF_FORM_ID = EFI_FORM_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.EF_ASSESSMENT ON EF_FORM_EXTERNAL_ID = EA_ASSESS_ID WHERE EF_FORM_ALIAS = 'IR_NVq' AND DATE(EF_SUBMISSION_DT) >= '8/1/2021' AND EFI_ITEM_ALIAS IN ('heartstent_6mo', 'heartattack_6mo', 'faint_6mo', 'TIA_6mo', 'stroke_6mo', 'difficultopenmouth_y_n', 'headneck_surgery', 'SOB_lyingflat') GROUP BY EF_MRN, DATE(EF_SUBMISSION_DT), DATE(EA_ASSIGN_DT) , EF_FORM_ALIAS, EA_SOURCE_ID, EF_SUBMISSION_DT, EA_TRIGGERD_BY, EA_SUBM_DT) , FNL AS (SELECT MRN, SUBMISSION_DATE, SURVEY_ASSIGN_DATE, HEART_STENT_6MO, HEART_ATTACK_6MO , FAINT_6MO, TIA_6MO, STROKE_6MO, DIFFICULT_OPEN_MOUTH_Y_N, HEAD_NECK_SURGERY, SOB_LYING_FLAT , CASE_SURGERY_DTE, CASE_STATUS, REPLACE(LOG_COMPLETION_FLAG, 'Unexisting Record', 'Uncompleted Case') COMPLETION_FLAG , CASE_LOCATION, CASE_PRIMARY_SERVICE, CASE_PRIMARY_SURGEON , ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY MRN, SUBMISSION_DATE ORDER BY CASE_STATUS DESC) RN FROM IRNV LEFT JOIN IDB.PERIOP_CASE_EVENT_V ON MRN = PATIENT_MRN AND CASE_SURGERY_DTE BETWEEN SUBMISSION_DATE AND CURRENT DATE + 21 DAY AND CASE_PRIMARY_SERVICE = 'Interventional Radiology' WHERE UPPER(COALESCE(HEART_STENT_6MO, HEART_ATTACK_6MO, FAINT_6MO, TIA_6MO, STROKE_6MO, DIFFICULT_OPEN_MOUTH_Y_N, HEAD_NECK_SURGERY, SOB_LYING_FLAT, 'NO')) = 'YES' ) SELECT MRN, SUBMISSION_DATE, SURVEY_ASSIGN_DATE, HEART_STENT_6MO, HEART_ATTACK_6MO , FAINT_6MO, TIA_6MO, STROKE_6MO, DIFFICULT_OPEN_MOUTH_Y_N, HEAD_NECK_SURGERY, SOB_LYING_FLAT , CASE_SURGERY_DTE, CASE_STATUS, COMPLETION_FLAG, CASE_LOCATION, CASE_PRIMARY_SERVICE, CASE_PRIMARY_SURGEON FROM FNL WHERE RN=1 ORDER BY SUBMISSION_DATE, MRN, CASE_SURGERY_DTE, CASE_STATUS

prompt: Post-translplant lymphoproliferative disease (PTLD) Cases
completion: SELECT CC_MRN MRN, PT_LAST_NAME "Last Name", PT_FIRST_NAME "First Name", PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH "Date of Birth", AV_DESC "Race", MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) "First Dx Date" FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON CC_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS ON PT_RACE = AV_CODE AND AV_ELEMENT = 'RACE' WHERE CC_CLSF_CD IN ('D47.Z1', '238.77') AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND (CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) GROUP BY CC_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, AV_DESC ORDER BY 1 DESC

prompt: We would like to have a list of patients with MY Hydro procedure done
completion: WITH RADIOLOGY_0 AS (SELECT "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AS PT_DEID, "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_MRN" AS PT_MRN, CAST(TRIM("DV"."RADIOLOGY_REPORT_V"."RRPT_RPT_ID") AS VARCHAR) || CAST(TRIM("DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_MRN") AS VARCHAR) AS SUBJECT_ID, "DV"."RADIOLOGY_REPORT_V"."RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE" AS RRPT_PERFORMED_DATE, "DV"."RADIOLOGY_REPORT_V"."RRPT_PROCEDURE_NAME" AS RRPT_PROC_NAME FROM "DV"."RADIOLOGY_REPORT_V" JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS" ON "DV"."RADIOLOGY_REPORT_V"."RRPT_MRN" = "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_MRN" WHERE "DV"."RADIOLOGY_REPORT_V"."RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE" BETWEEN '2010-01-01' AND '2023-03-28' AND "DV"."RADIOLOGY_REPORT_V"."RRPT_PROCEDURE_NAME" IN ('MR HYDRO W/O CONTRAST')), COHORT AS (SELECT PT_DEID AS PT_DEID FROM (SELECT RADIOLOGY_0.PT_DEID AS PT_DEID FROM RADIOLOGY_0)), COHORT_RADIOLOGY AS (SELECT SUBJECT_ID AS SUBJECT_ID, PT_DEID AS PT_DEID FROM (SELECT RADIOLOGY_0.SUBJECT_ID AS SUBJECT_ID, RADIOLOGY_0.PT_DEID AS PT_DEID FROM RADIOLOGY_0)), KEYS AS (SELECT COHORT.PT_DEID AS COHORT_PT_DEID, COHORT_RADIOLOGY.SUBJECT_ID AS COHORT_RADIOLOGY_SUBJECT_ID, XMLAGG(XMLELEMENT(NAME "c", RTRIM(LTRIM(CHM.CCH_CHEMO_NAME)))) AS CLOB(255)) AS VARCHAR(255)), '<c>', ','), '</c>', ''), 2) AS CHEMO_NAME FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_PATIENT PAT ON CPE_MRN = PAT.CL_MRN JOIN IDB.RMS_PATIENT_FSC ON PAT.CL_MRN = RPF_MRN JOIN IDB.RMS_PATIENT_FSC_PRIORITY ON RPFP_PATIENT_ID = RPF_PATIENT_ID AND RPFP_FSC_REC_NO = RPF_FSC_REC_NO AND RPFP_LINE_NO = RPFP_LINE_NO AND RPFP_LINE_NO = 1 JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID = CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT VD ON CPE_DEPT_ID = VD.CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE VT ON VT.CRE_RES_ID = CPE_VST_RES_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE REF ON REF.CRE_RES_ID = CPE_REF_RES_ID AND REF.CRE_RES_TYP IN ('Physician', 'Dentist', 'Psychologist', 'PhD', 'Nurse Practitioner', 'Physician Assistant', 'Advanced Practice Nurse') LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_PT_APPT ON CPE_CL_PT_ID = CPA_CL_PT_ID AND CPE_ENC_DTE_SEQ = CPA_ENC_DTE_SEQ AND CPA_LINE_NO = 2 LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT SD ON CPA_DEPT_ID = SD.CLD_DEPT_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE SR ON SR.CRE_RES_ID = CPE_VST_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_PT_CHEMO PTCHM ON CPE_CL_PT_ID = PTCHM.CPC_CL_PT_ID AND CPE_ENC_DTE_SEQ = PTCHM.CPC_ENC_DTE_SEQ JOIN IDB.CL_CHEMO CHM ON PTCHM.CPC_CHEMO_ID = CHM.CCH_CHEMO_ID JOIN IDACS.HIGH_COST_CHEMO HCCHM ON PTCHM.CPC_CHEMO_ID = HCCHM.CHC_CHEMO_ID WHERE CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT DATE AND CURRENT DATE + 7 DAY AND CPE_CPE_APPT_STS = 'Sch' AND CPE_ENC_TYP_CD = 50 AND CPE_CPE_IP_IND <> 'INPATIENT' AND NOT (VT.CRE_RES_ABBR = 'TX PREP') AND NOT (CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR = 'EV') AND VT.CRE_RES_TYP = 'Chemotherapy Unit' AND CVT_CVT_RPT_GRP_3 = '' GROUP BY CPE_MRN, CPE_ENC_DTE, VD.CLD_DEPT_ID, VD.CLD_DEPT_NAME, VD.CLD_CLD_CENTER , VD.CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_20, VD.CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 , CPE_APPT_DT, CPE_APPT_MADE_DT, VD.CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_1 , VT.CRE_RES_NAME, REF.CRE_RES_NAME , CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR, CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME , CVT_EXT_NAME, SD.CLD_DEPT_NAME, REF.CRE_RES_ID, SR.CRE_RES_NAME, SR.CRE_RES_TYP, RPF_INS_GROUP, RPF_PLAN, PRI_VST_RESOURCE, REF.CRE_RES_NAME PRI_REF_MD, CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR PRI_VST_ABBR, CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME PRI_VST_NAME , CVT_EXT_NAME PRI_VST_TYPE , VD.CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_1 AS PRI_GRP_01 , CASE WHEN VD.CLD_CLD_CENTER IN ('MON', 'BER', 'BSK') THEN 'NJ' ELSE 'NY' END PRI_STATE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CPE_MRN ORDER BY CPE_APPT_DT DESC) RN FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN ETO ON MRN = CPE_MRN AND SCH_VST_DATE > CPE_ENC_DTE JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID = CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT VD ON CPE_DEPT_ID = VD.CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE VT ON VT.CRE_RES_ID = CPE_VST_RES_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE REF ON REF.CRE_RES_ID = CPE_REF_RES_ID AND REF.CRE_RES_TYP IN ('Physician', 'Dentist', 'Psychologist', 'PhD', 'Nurse Practitioner', 'Physician Assistant', PRI_VST_ABBR, PRI_VST_NAME , PRI_VST_TYPE , RPF_INS_GROUP, RPF_INS_COMP_NAME, RPF_LINE_NO, RPF_EFF_DTE, CHEMO_NAME, CURRENT DATE RPT_START_DATE, CURRENT DATE + 7 DAY RPT_END_DATE FROM ETO JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN PRIO ON MRN = PRI_MRN WHERE COALESCE(PRI_STATE, '') <> SCH_STATE AND PRI_VST_DATE IS NOT NULL

prompt: Provide a list of patients diagnosed with prostate cancer 2001 to present who were diagnosed with brain mets and had radiation therapy delivered to the brain.
