"DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AS SUBJECT_ID, DMP_ID_TBL."PDRX_DMP_PATIENT_ID" AS DMP_ID, TRIM(IDB_PATIENT."PT_LAST_NAME") || ', ' || TRIM(IDB_PATIENT."PT_FIRST_NAME") AS PT_NAME, ALLOWVALS_SEX."AV_DESC" AS SEX, CASE WHEN (IDB_PATIENT."PT_DATE_OF_DEATH" IS NULL) THEN 'Alive' ELSE 'Deceased' END AS VITAL_STATS, IDB_PATIENT."PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH" AS DATE_OF_BIRTH, IDB_PATIENT."PT_DATE_OF_DEATH" AS DATE_OF_DEATH, ALLOWVALS_RACE."AV_DESC" AS RACE, ALLOWVALS_ETHNICITY."AV_DESC" AS ETHNICITY, ALLOWVALS_LANGUAGE."AV_DESC" AS PRIMARY_LANGUAGE, LAST_ACTIVITY_DATE."PLA_LST_ACTV_DTE" AS LAST_ACTIVITY_DATE, LAST_CONTACT_DATE."PLA_LST_CON_DTE" AS LAST_CONTACT_DATE FROM "IDB"."PATIENT" AS IDB_PATIENT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS" ON IDB_PATIENT."PT_MRN" = "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_MRN" LEFT OUTER JOIN "DV"."PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML" AS DMP_ID_TBL ON DMP_ID_TBL."PDRX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT OUTER JOIN "IDB"."ALLOWVALS" AS ALLOWVALS_SEX ON IDB_PATIENT."PT_SEX" = ALLOWVALS_SEX."AV_CODE" AND ALLOWVALS_SEX."AV_ELEMENT" = 'SEX' LEFT OUTER JOIN "IDB"."ALLOWVALS" AS ALLOWVALS_RACE ON IDB_PATIENT."PT_RACE" = ALLOWVALS_RACE."AV_CODE" AND ALLOWVALS_RACE."AV_ELEMENT" = 'RACE' LEFT OUTER JOIN "IDB"."ALLOWVALS" AS ALLOWVALS_ETHNICITY ON IDB_PATIENT."PT_PT_ETHNICITY" = ALLOWVALS_ETHNICITY."AV_CODE" AND ALLOWVALS_ETHNICITY."AV_ELEMENT" = 'PT_ETHNICITY' LEFT OUTER JOIN "IDB"."ALLOWVALS" AS ALLOWVALS_LANGUAGE ON IDB_PATIENT."PT_PRIMARY_LANG" = ALLOWVALS_LANGUAGE."AV_CODE" AND ALLOWVALS_LANGUAGE."AV_ELEMENT" = 'PRIMARY_LANG' LEFT OUTER JOIN "IDB".PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY AS LAST_ACTIVITY_DATE ON IDB_PATIENT."PT_MRN" = LAST_ACTIVITY_DATE."PLA_MRN" LEFT OUTER JOIN "IDB".PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY AS LAST_CONTACT_DATE ON IDB_PATIENT."PT_MRN" = LAST_CONTACT_DATE."PLA_MRN") SELECT DISTINCT DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS.PT_MRN AS MRN, DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS.DMP_ID AS DMP_ID, DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS.PT_NAME AS PT_NAME, DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS.SEX AS SEX, DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS.VITAL_STATS AS VITAL_STATUS, DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS.DATE_OF_BIRTH AS DATE_OF_BIRTH, DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS.DATE_OF_DEATH AS DATE_OF_DEATH, DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS.RACE AS RACE, DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS.ETHNICITY AS ETHNICITY, DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS.PRIMARY_LANGUAGE AS PRIMARY_LANGUAGE, DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS.LAST_ACTIVITY_DATE AS LAST_ACTIVITY_DATE, DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS.LAST_CONTACT_DATE AS LAST_CONTACT_DATE FROM KEYS LEFT OUTER JOIN DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS ON DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS.PT_DEID = KEYS.COHORT_PT_DEID; WITH DIAGNOSIS_0 AS (SELECT "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AS PT_DEID, BASE_QUERY.PT_MRN AS PT_MRN, CAST(TRIM(BASE_QUERY.PT_MRN) AS VARCHAR) || CAST(TRIM(BASE_QUERY.DIAGNOSIS_DATE) AS VARCHAR) || CAST(TRIM(BASE_QUERY.ICD_CODES_ICD_CODE) AS VARCHAR) AS SUBJECT_ID, BASE_QUERY.DIAGNOSIS_DATE AS DIAGNOSIS_DATE, TRIM(BASE_QUERY.ICD_CODES_ICD_CODE) || '-' || TRIM("IDB"."CLM"."CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK") AS ICD_CODES_ICD_CODE_DESC, YEAR(BASE_QUERY.DIAGNOSIS_DATE - "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_BIRTH_DTE") AS AGE_AT_ICD_CODE_DATE FROM (SELECT "IDB"."CTC_CLSF"."CC_MRN" AS PT_MRN, "IDB"."CTC_CLSF"."CC_CLSF_CD" AS ICD_CODES_ICD_CODE, MIN("IDB"."CTC_CLSF"."CC_EFF_DTE") AS DIAGNOSIS_DATE FROM "IDB"."CTC_CLSF" WHERE "IDB"."CTC_CLSF"."CC_CLSF_TYPE" LIKE 'DF%' AND ("IDB"."CTC_CLSF"."CC_PT_TYPE" = 'I' OR ("IDB"."CTC_CLSF"."CC_PT_TYPE" = 'O' AND "IDB"."CTC_CLSF"."CC_FINALIZED_IND" = 'Y')) GROUP BY "IDB"."CTC_CLSF"."CC_MRN", "IDB"."CTC_CLSF"."CC_CLSF_CD") AS BASE_QUERY JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS" ON BASE_QUERY.PT_MRN = "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_MRN" JOIN "IDB"."CLM" ON BASE_QUERY.ICD_CODES_ICD_CODE = "IDB"."CLM"."CLM_CLSF_CD" WHERE BASE_QUERY.DIAGNOSIS_DATE BETWEEN '1990-01-01' AND '2022-01-31' AND BASE_QUERY.ICD_CODES_ICD_CODE IN ('009.0', '558.9', 'A09', 'K52.89', 'K52.9') AND YEAR(BASE_QUERY.DIAGNOSIS_DATE - "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_BIRTH_DTE") BETWEEN 1 AND 21), COHORT AS (SELECT PT_DEID AS PT_DEID FROM (SELECT DIAGNOSIS_0.PT_DEID AS PT_DEID FROM DIAGNOSIS_0)), COHORT_DIAGNOSIS AS (SELECT SUBJECT_ID AS SUBJECT_ID, PT_DEID AS PT_DEID FROM (SELECT DIAGNOSIS_0.SUBJECT_ID AS SUBJECT_ID, DIAGNOSIS_0.PT_DEID AS PT_DEID FROM DIAGNOSIS_0)), KEYS AS (SELECT COHORT.PT_DEID AS COHORT_PT_DEID, COHORT_DIAGNOSIS.SUBJECT_ID AS COHORT_DIAGNOSIS_SUBJECT_ID, COHORT_DIAGNOSIS.PT_DEID AS COHORT_DIAGNOSIS_PT_DEID FROM COHORT LEFT OUTER JOIN COHORT_DIAGNOSIS ON COHORT_DIAGNOSIS.PT_DEID = COHORT.PT_DEID), DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS AS (SELECT DISTINCT "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AS PT_DEID, IDB_PATIENT."PT_MRN" AS PT_MRN, "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AS SUBJECT_ID FROM "IDB"."PATIENT" AS IDB_PATIENT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS" ON IDB_PATIENT."PT_MRN" = "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_MRN"), DIAGNOSIS_COLUMNS AS (SELECT DISTINCT "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AS PT_DEID, BASE_QUERY.PT_MRN AS PT_MRN, CAST(TRIM(BASE_QUERY.PT_MRN) AS VARCHAR) || CAST(TRIM(BASE_QUERY.DIAGNOSIS_DATE) AS VARCHAR) || CAST(TRIM(BASE_QUERY.ICD_CODES_ICD_CODE) AS VARCHAR) AS SUBJECT_ID, BASE_QUERY.DIAGNOSIS_DATE AS DIAGNOSIS_DATE, BASE_QUERY.ICD_CODES_ICD_CODE AS ICD_CODES_ICD_CODE, TRIM(BASE_QUERY.ICD_CODES_ICD_CODE) || '-' || TRIM("IDB"."CLM"."CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK") AS ICD_CODES_ICD_CODE_DESC, YEAR(BASE_QUERY.DIAGNOSIS_DATE - "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_BIRTH_DTE") AS AGE_AT_ICD_CODE_DATE FROM (SELECT "IDB"."CTC_CLSF"."CC_MRN" AS PT_MRN, "IDB"."CTC_CLSF"."CC_CLSF_CD" AS ICD_CODES_ICD_CODE, MIN("IDB"."CTC_CLSF"."CC_EFF_DTE") AS DIAGNOSIS_DATE FROM "IDB"."CTC_CLSF" WHERE "IDB"."CTC_CLSF"."CC_CLSF_TYPE" LIKE 'DF%' AND ("IDB"."CTC_CLSF"."CC_PT_TYPE" = 'I' OR ("IDB"."CTC_CLSF"."CC_PT_TYPE" = 'O' AND "IDB"."CTC_CLSF"."CC_FINALIZED_IND" = 'Y')) GROUP BY "IDB"."CTC_CLSF"."CC_MRN", "IDB"."CTC_CLSF"."CC_CLSF_CD") AS BASE_QUERY JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS" ON BASE_QUERY.PT_MRN = "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_MRN" JOIN "IDB"."CLM" ON BASE_QUERY.ICD_CODES_ICD_CODE = "IDB"."CLM"."CLM_CLSF_CD") SELECT DISTINCT DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS.PT_MRN AS MRN, DIAGNOSIS_COLUMNS.DIAGNOSIS_DATE AS DIAGNOSIS_DATE, DIAGNOSIS_COLUMNS.ICD_CODES_ICD_CODE AS ICD_CODE, DIAGNOSIS_COLUMNS.ICD_CODES_ICD_CODE_DESC AS ICD_CODE_DESCRIPTION, DIAGNOSIS_COLUMNS.AGE_AT_ICD_CODE_DATE AS AGE_AT_ICD_CODE_DATE FROM KEYS LEFT OUTER JOIN DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS ON DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS.PT_DEID = KEYS.COHORT_PT_DEID LEFT OUTER JOIN DIAGNOSIS_COLUMNS ON DIAGNOSIS_COLUMNS.SUBJECT_ID = KEYS.COHORT_DIAGNOSIS_SUBJECT_ID;

prompt: Used by HIM to correct visits
completion: SELECT EAD_MRN, MIN(RPT_PAT_NAME) AS RPT_PAT_NAME, EAD_DOCUMENT_DTE, EAD_DOCTYPE, MAX(CU_USER) AS CODER_ID, MAX(CU_LAST_NAME) AS CODER_LAST_NAME, MAX(CU_FIRST_NAME) AS CODER_FIRST_NAME, MAX(CV_CTC_VISIT_TYPE) AS CV_CTC_VISIT_TYPE, MAX(CASE WHEN CC_CLSF_CD = '38240' THEN '38240 ' ELSE '' END || CASE WHEN CC_CLSF_CD = '38241' THEN '38241 ' ELSE '' END || CASE WHEN CC_CLSF_CD = '38242' THEN '38242 ' ELSE '' END || CASE WHEN CC_CLSF_CD = '38243' THEN '38243 ' ELSE '' END) AS CODED, MIN(SUBSTR(CASE WHEN CDO_OBS_CTLG_MSTR_ITEM_GUID IN ('9000044392702890', '9000114135702890') THEN CDO_VALUE_TEXT END, 1, 50)) AS CELL_INFUSION_TYPE, MIN(SUBSTR(CASE WHEN CDO_OBS_CTLG_MSTR_ITEM_GUID IN ('9000044366902890', '9000044381902890') THEN CDO_VALUE_TEXT END, 1, 50)) AS CELL_SOURCE, DATE('2018-01-01') AS BEGDTE, CURRENT_DATE - 1 DAY AS ENDDTE, CURRENT_DATE AS RUNDTE , CDD_DOC_GUID FROM IDB.EMR_AA_DOCUMENT LEFT OUTER JOIN IDB.CTC_CLSF ON CC_MRN = EAD_MRN AND CC_EFF_DTE = EAD_DOCUMENT_DTE AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y' AND CC_CLSF_CD IN ('38240', '38241', '38242', '38243') LEFT OUTER JOIN IDB.CTC_VISIT ON CV_MRN = EAD_MRN AND CV_CTC_VISIT_TYPE = 'O' AND CV_ADM_DTE >= '2016-01-01' AND EAD_DOCUMENT_DTE BETWEEN CV_ADM_DTE AND VALUE(CV_DSCH_DTE, CURRENT_DATE) LEFT OUTER JOIN IDB.RMS_PATIENT ON EAD_MRN = RPT_MRN LEFT OUTER JOIN IDB.CTC_REC_HX ON CRH_VISIT_ID = CC_VISIT_ID LEFT OUTER JOIN IDB.CTC_USERS ON CRH_CTC_CNG_USER = CU_USER LEFT OUTER JOIN IDB.CD_DOCUMENT ON EAD_MRN = CDD_MRN AND EAD_DOCUMENT_DTE = CDD_SERVICE_DTE AND CDD_DOC_NAME LIKE 'Cell Infusion - BMT%' AND CDD_CANCEL_IND = '0' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND = '0' LEFT OUTER JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION ON CDD_DOC_GUID = CDO_DOC_GUID AND CDO_OBS_CTLG_MSTR_ITEM_GUID IN ('9000044392702890', '9000044366902890', '9000044381902890', '9000114135702890') AND CDO_VALUE_TEXT > '' WHERE EAD_DOCTYPE = 'KS1' AND EAD_DOCUMENT_DTE >= '2018-01-01' AND (CDD_MRN IS NOT NULL OR EAD_BATCH_ID > 0) AND EAD_RIGHT_ID = 167 GROUP BY EAD_MRN, EAD_DOCUMENT_DTE, EAD_DOCTYPE, CDD_DOC_GUID HAVING MAX(CV_CTC_VISIT_TYPE) IS NULL ORDER BY EAD_DOCUMENT_DTE, EAD_MRN

prompt: Provide results of food frequency questionnaires from the MSK Engage Portal
completion: SELECT DISTINCT PT.EPI_MRN AS MRN , 'food_activity' AS SURVEY_ALIAS , ASS.EA_SUBM_DT AS SUBMISSION_DATE , Q.EQ_ALIAS AS QUESTION_ALIAS , A.EA_ALIAS AS ANSWER_ALIAS , A.EA_SHORT_NAME AS ANSWER , TR.ETBR_TEXT AS TEXTBLOCKRESPONSE , NR.ENR_NO AS NUMBERRESPONSE FROM IDB.EF_ASSESSMENT AS ASS JOIN IDB.EF_ASSESSMENT_DTL AS AD ON AD.EAD_ASSESS_DTL_ID = ASS.EA_ASSESS_DTL_ID JOIN IDB.EF_PATIENT_INFO PT ON ASS.EA_PT_INFO_ID = PT.EPI_PT_INFO_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.EF_RESPONSE R ON R.ERESP_ASSESS_ID = ASS.EA_ASSESS_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.EF_ANSWER A ON A.EA_ANSWER_ID = R.ERESP_ANSWER_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.EF_QUESTION Q ON Q.EQ_QUESTION_ID = A.EA_QUESTION_ID JOIN IDB.EF_SURVEY_ELEMENT SE ON A.EA_QUESTION_ID = SE.ESE_IDENTITY_ID LEFT OUTER JOIN IDB.EF_TEXT_BOX_RESPONSE TR ON TR.ETBR_ID =R.ERESP_ID LEFT OUTER JOIN IDB.EF_NUMERIC_RESPONSE NR ON NR.ENR_ID =R.ERESP_ID WHERE EPI_MRN IN ('38141148', '35282509', '38086130', '38083843', '35423469', '38118166', '35503074', '38058728', '38194399', '38202587', '38205488', '38206105', '38085198', '38205986' ) AND ASS.EA_STS_ID = 3 AND ASS.EA_SURV_ID IN (SELECT ES_SURV_ID FROM IDB.EF_SURVEY WHERE ES_SURV_ALIAS = 'food_activity' ) ; WITH SURVEY AS (SELECT DISTINCT PT.EPI_MRN AS MRN , YEAR(CURRENT date - PT.EPI_BIRTH_DTE) AS CURRENT_AGE, 'food_activity' AS SURVEY_ALIAS , ASS.EA_SUBM_DT AS SUBMISSION_DATE , Q.EQ_ALIAS AS QUESTION_ALIAS , A.EA_ALIAS AS ANSWER_ALIAS , A.EA_SHORT_NAME AS ANSWER , TR.ETBR_TEXT AS TEXTBLOCKRESPONSE , NR.ENR_NO AS NUMBERRESPONSE FROM IDB.EF_ASSESSMENT AS ASS JOIN IDB.EF_ASSESSMENT_DTL AS AD ON AD.EAD_ASSESS_DTL_ID = ASS.EA_ASSESS_DTL_ID JOIN IDB.EF_PATIENT_INFO PT ON ASS.EA_PT_INFO_ID = PT.EPI_PT_INFO_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.EF_RESPONSE R ON R.ERESP_ASSESS_ID = ASS.EA_ASSESS_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.EF_ANSWER A ON A.EA_ANSWER_ID = R.ERESP_ANSWER_ID JOIN IDB.EF_QUESTION Q ON Q.EQ_QUESTION_ID = A.EA_QUESTION_ID LEFT OUTER JOIN IDB.EF_TEXT_BOX_RESPONSE TR ON TR.ETBR_ID =R.ERESP_ID LEFT OUTER JOIN IDB.EF_NUMERIC_RESPONSE NR ON NR.ENR_ID =R.ERESP_ID WHERE EPI_MRN IN ('38141148', '35282509', '38086130', '38083843', '35423469', '38118166', '35503074', '38058728', '38194399', '38202587', '38205488', '38206105', '38085198', '38205986' ) AND ASS.EA_STS_ID = 3 AND ASS.EA_SURV_ID IN (SELECT ES_SURV_ID FROM IDB.EF_SURVEY WHERE ES_SURV_ALIAS = 'food_activity' ) ) SELECT DISTINCT MRN, CURRENT_AGE, SUBMISSION_DATE FROM SURVEY ;

prompt: Amend INF5679 by providing last visit date, date of death, and specified vaccine dates.
completion: WITH VACCINES AS (SELECT "t1"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AS DEIDENT, MRN, "t4"."PINC_GENERIC_NAME" AS "Generic Drug Name", BMT_DTE, MIN("t5"."DT_DTE") AS "Vaccine Date" FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED" "t1" JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_IDENTIFICATION_MRN_V" "t8" ON "t1"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t8"."PI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" JOIN WILLSJ.INF5679 ON MRN = "t8"."PI_SOURCE_SYSTEM_PT_ID" JOIN "DV"."PHM_PT_MEDS_MQT" "t6" ON "t1"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t6"."POD_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" JOIN "DV"."PHM_INVENTORY_CATALOG" "t4" ON "t6"."POD_PHARMA_INVENTORY_CTLG_ID" = "t4"."PINC_INVENTORY_CTLG_ID" JOIN "DV"."PHM_ORDER_DTL" "t7" ON "t6"."POD_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t7"."POD_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AND "t6"."POD_PHARMA_INVENTORY_CTLG_ID" = "t7"."POD_PHARMA_INVENTORY_CTLG_ID" JOIN "DV"."DATE" "t5" ON "t7"."POD_START_DATE_ID" = "t5"."DT_DATE_ID" AND DT_DTE >= BMT_DTE WHERE "t4"."PINC_GENERIC_NAME" IN ('MEASLES,MUMPS&RUBELLA VACCINE', 'Measles Virus Vaccine ', 'Measles/Mumps/Rubella Vaccine ', 'Varicella Virus Vaccine ') GROUP BY "t1"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID", MRN, "t4"."PINC_GENERIC_NAME", BMT_DTE ) SELECT A.MRN AS "MRN", A.BMT_DTE AS "BMT Date", MAX(COALESCE("t2"."PLA_LAST_ADM_DTE", "t2"."PLA_LAST_APPT_DTE"), COALESCE("t2"."PLA_LAST_DSCH_DTE", "t2"."PLA_LAST_APPT_DTE"), "t2"."PLA_LAST_APPT_DTE") AS "Last Visit or Admit/Discharge Date", "t3"."PT_DEATH_DTE" AS "Deceased Date", MIN(MMR."Vaccine Date") AS "MMR Date", MEASLES."Vaccine Date" AS "Measles Date", VARICELLA."Vaccine Date" AS "Varicella Date" FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED" "t1" JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_IDENTIFICATION_MRN_V" "t8" ON "t1"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t8"."PI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" JOIN WILLSJ.INF5679 A ON A.MRN = "t8"."PI_SOURCE_SYSTEM_PT_ID" JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_LATEST_ACTIVITY" "t2" ON "t1"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t2"."PLA_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V" "t3" ON "t1"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t3"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN VACCINES MMR ON "t1"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = MMR.DEIDENT AND MMR."Generic Drug Name" IN ('Measles/Mumps/Rubella Vaccine', 'MEASLES,MUMPS&RUBELLA VACCINE') LEFT JOIN VACCINES MEASLES ON "t1"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = MEASLES.DEIDENT AND MEASLES."Generic Drug Name" = 'Measles Virus Vaccine' LEFT JOIN VACCINES VARICELLA ON "t1"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = VARICELLA.DEIDENT AND VARICELLA."Generic Drug Name" = 'Varicella Virus Vaccine' GROUP BY A.MRN, A.BMT_DTE, "t2"."PLA_LAST_ADM_DTE", "t2"."PLA_LAST_DSCH_DTE", "t2"."PLA_LAST_APPT_DTE", "t3"."PT_DEATH_DTE", MEASLES."Vaccine Date", VARICELLA."Vaccine Date"

prompt: Provide a list of S-/H- cases with "CD40" mentioned in the IMMUNOHISTOCHEMISTRY section of pathology report.
completion: SELECT FIRST_NAME, LAST_NAME, "MRN", "DOB", PT_GENDER, "H/S NUMBER", VARCHAR(PRPT_REPORT, 32000) AS "H-/S- CASE PATHOLOGY TEXT" FROM (SELECT PT_FIRST_NAME FIRST_NAME, PT_LAST_NAME LAST_NAME, PT_MRN "MRN", PT_BIRTH_DTE "DOB", PT_GENDER, STRIP(PRPT_ACCESSION_NO) "H/S NUMBER", PRPT_REPORT, DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)IMMUNOHISTOCHEMISTRY:[\w\W]*(?=)', PRV.PRPT_REPORT) IMMUNOHISTO_CHEMISTRY, DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)IMMUNOHISTOCHEMISTRY[\w\W]*(?=Immunophenotype:)', PRV.PRPT_REPORT) IMMUNOHISTO_CHEMISTRY1 FROM DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS PD JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V PRV ON PT_MRN = PRPT_MRN WHERE PRPT_REPORT IS NOT NULL AND SUBSTR(PRPT_ACCESSION_NO, 1, 1) IN ('H', 'S') AND (CONTAINS("PRPT_REPORT", '("IMMUNOHISTOCHEMISTRY:" )') = 1 OR CONTAINS("PRPT_REPORT", '("immunohistochemistry:" )') = 1 OR CONTAINS("PRPT_REPORT", '("immunohistochemistry" )') = 1 OR CONTAINS("PRPT_REPORT", '("IMMUNOHISTOCHEMISTRY" )') = 1) AND PRPT_PROCEDURE_DTE BETWEEN '2022-01-01' AND CURRENT DATE ) WHERE LOCATE('CD40', PRPT_REPORT) >=1 OR LOCATE('CD40', IMMUNOHISTO_CHEMISTRY1)>=1 OR LOCATE('CD40', IMMUNOHISTO_CHEMISTRY)>=1 OR LOCATE('CD4', PRPT_REPORT) >=1 OR LOCATE('CD4', IMMUNOHISTO_CHEMISTRY1)>=1 OR LOCATE('CD4', IMMUNOHISTO_CHEMISTRY)>=1

prompt: Provide data on patients with a nephroureterectomy at MSK.
completion: SELECT PBD_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, CS_ADM_DATE, CS_DSCH_DATE, PBD_SVC_DTE, PBC_CPT_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK, DOC_NAME FROM IDB.PBD_DTL JOIN IDB.PBD_INVOICE ON PBD_INV_NO = PBI_INV_NO JOIN IDB.PBD_CODE ON PBD_PBD_CD = PBC_PBD_CD JOIN IDB.DOC ON PBI_PERFORM_DR_NO = DOC_DR_NO JOIN IDB.CLM ON PBC_CPT_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PBD_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.CASE ON PBD_MRN = CS_MRN AND PBD_ACCT_NO = CS_ACCT_NO WHERE PBC_CPT_CD IN ('50234', '50548') ORDER BY PBD_MRN, PBD_SVC_DTE, PBC_CPT_CD WITH CTE AS (SELECT DISTINCT PBD_MRN FROM IDB.PBD_DTL JOIN IDB.PBD_INVOICE ON PBD_INV_NO = PBI_INV_NO JOIN IDB.PBD_CODE ON PBD_PBD_CD = PBC_PBD_CD JOIN IDB.DOC ON PBI_PERFORM_DR_NO = DOC_DR_NO JOIN IDB.CLM ON PBC_CPT_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PBD_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.CASE ON PBD_MRN = CS_MRN AND PBD_ACCT_NO = CS_ACCT_NO WHERE PBC_CPT_CD IN ('50234', '50548') ) SELECT HXD_MRN AS MRN, HXD_SVC_DTE AS SVC_DTE, CDM_SVC_CD, CDM_SVC_DESC FROM CTE JOIN IDB.HX_PA_DETAIL ON HXD_MRN = PBD_MRN JOIN IDB.CDM ON CDM_SVC_CD = HXD_SVC_CD WHERE HXD_DTL_TYPE = 'C' AND CDM_DPT_CD LIKE '54%' AND CDM_SVC_CD IN ('54002001', '54010202', '54010301', '54010400', '54010509', '54010608', '54011002', '54011010', '54011028', '67364307', '68364306', '77364305', '89008601') GROUP BY HXD_MRN, HXD_SVC_DTE, CDM_SVC_CD, CDM_SVC_DESC HAVING SUM(HXD_SVC_QTY) > 0 UNION ALL SELECT DTL_MRN AS MRN, DTL_SVC_DTE AS SVC_DTE, CDM_SVC_CD, CDM_SVC_DESC FROM CTE JOIN IDB.PA_DETAIL ON DTL_MRN = PBD_MRN JOIN IDB.CDM ON CDM_SVC_CD = DTL_SVC_CD WHERE DTL_DTL_TYPE = 'C' AND CDM_DPT_CD LIKE '54%' AND CDM_SVC_CD IN ('54002001', '54010202', '54010301', '54010400', '54010509', '54010608', '54011002', '54011010', '54011028', '67364307', '68364306', '77364305', '89008601') GROUP BY DTL_MRN, DTL_SVC_DTE, CDM_SVC_CD, CDM_SVC_DESC HAVING SUM(DTL_SVC_QTY) > 0 WITH CTE AS (SELECT DISTINCT PBD_MRN FROM IDB.PBD_DTL JOIN IDB.PBD_INVOICE ON PBD_INV_NO = PBI_INV_NO JOIN IDB.PBD_CODE ON PBD_PBD_CD = PBC_PBD_CD JOIN IDB.DOC ON PBI_PERFORM_DR_NO = DOC_DR_NO JOIN IDB.CLM ON PBC_CPT_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PBD_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.CASE ON PBD_MRN = CS_MRN AND PBD_ACCT_NO = CS_ACCT_NO WHERE PBC_CPT_CD IN ('50234', '50548') ) SELECT CM_MRN AS MRN, CM_SVM_DESC AS GENERIC_NAME, CM_DOSE_NO AS DOSE, CM_DOSE_UNIT AS DOSE_UNIT, CM_OCC_STRT_DTE AS START_DATE, CM_OCC_STRT_DTE AS STOP_DATE FROM CTE JOIN IDB.CHEMO ON PBD_MRN = CM_MRN WHERE CM_ORD_SUBDPT IN ('300', '400') UNION ALL SELECT PO_MRN AS MRN, PIN_GENERIC_NAME AS GENERIC_NAME, POI_NET_PT_DOSE AS DOSE, POI_DOSE_UNIT, POD_STRT_DTE AS START_DATE, POD_STOP_DTE AS STOP_DATE FROM CTE JOIN IDB.PHM_ORDER ON PBD_MRN = PO_MRN JOIN IDB.PHM_ORD_DTL ON PO_ORD_SEQ = POD_ORD_SEQ JOIN IDB.PHM_ORD_INV ON POD_ORD_SEQ = POI_ORD_SEQ AND POD_ITEM_NO = POI_ITEM_NO JOIN IDB.PHM_INVENTORY ON POI_INV_SEQ = PIN_INV_SEQ WHERE PO_ORD_STS NOT IN ('X', 'P') AND UCASE(PIN_ATT_FLAG) LIKE '%CHEMO%'

prompt: Requesting report to confirm patients seen by Dr. Vahdat from 2017-1/24/2019 have pathology confirmed at MSKCC.
completion: WITH VISITS AS (SELECT CPE_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME , CPE_ENC_DTE, CPE_CPE_APPT_STS, CLD_DEPT_NAME, CRE_RES_NAME, CRE_RES_ID , CPE_ENC_CSN_ID FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CRE_RES_ID = CPE_VST_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON CPE_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE 1=1 AND CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Comp', 'Arrived', 'Sch') AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN '2017-01-01' AND '2020-12-31' AND CRE_RES_ID = '023226' ) , LASTVIS AS (SELECT A.CPE_MRN, A.PT_LAST_NAME, A.PT_FIRST_NAME , MAX(B.CPE_ENC_DTE) AS LAST_DTE, COUNT(DISTINCT B.CPE_ENC_CSN_ID) AS VIS_CNT, MIN(C.CPE_ENC_DTE) AS NEXT_DTE FROM VISITS A LEFT JOIN VISITS B ON A.CPE_MRN = B.CPE_MRN AND B.CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Comp', 'Arrived') LEFT JOIN VISITS C ON A.CPE_MRN = C.CPE_MRN AND C.CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Sch') AND C.CPE_ENC_DTE >= CURRENT DATE GROUP BY A.CPE_MRN, A.PT_LAST_NAME, A.PT_FIRST_NAME) , PATH AS (SELECT CPE_MRN, A.PT_LAST_NAME, A.PT_FIRST_NAME, LAST_DTE, NEXT_DTE, VIS_CNT, PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_DESC AS PATH_RPT_TYPE, MIN(P.DT_DTE) AS PATH_PROC_DTE, MIN(R.DT_DTE) AS PATH_RPT_DTE FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT JOIN DV.DATE P ON P.DT_DATE_ID = PRPT_PROCEDURE_DATE_ID JOIN DV.DATE R ON R.DT_DATE_ID = PRPT_REPORT_DATE_ID JOIN DV.PATH_RPRT_TYPE_LOOKUP ON PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_CD = PRPT_REPORT_TYPE JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON PRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID JOIN LASTVIS A ON PT_MRN = CPE_MRN JOIN DV.MEDPRO ON PRPT_ORDERING_MEDPRO_ID = MP_MEDPRO_ID WHERE 1=1 AND PRPT_REPORT IS NOT NULL GROUP BY CPE_MRN, A.PT_LAST_NAME, A.PT_FIRST_NAME, LAST_DTE, NEXT_DTE, VIS_CNT, PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_DESC) SELECT DISTINCT X.CPE_MRN, X.PT_LAST_NAME, X.PT_FIRST_NAME, X.LAST_DTE, X.NEXT_DTE, X.VIS_CNT, B.PATH_PROC_DTE AS CYTOLOGY_GYN, C.PATH_PROC_DTE AS CYTOLOGY_NON_GYN, D.PATH_PROC_DTE AS CYTOLOGY_SUBMITTED_SLIDES, E.PATH_PROC_DTE AS CYTOLOLOGY_PRIVATE_GYN, F.PATH_PROC_DTE AS DIAGNOSTIC_MOLECULAR_GENETICS, G.PATH_PROC_DTE AS DIAGNOSTIC_MOLECULAR_PATHOLOGY, H.PATH_PROC_DTE AS FLOW_CYTOMETRY_REPORT, I.PATH_PROC_DTE AS HEMATOPATHOLOGY_DEPARTMENTAL_CONSULT, J.PATH_PROC_DTE AS HEMATOPATHOLOGY_REPORT, K.PATH_PROC_DTE AS OFFSITE_SSL_CASES , L.PATH_PROC_DTE AS SURGICAL_PATHOLOGY, M.PATH_PROC_DTE AS SURGICAL_PATHOLOGY_BREAST, N.PATH_PROC_DTE AS SURGICAL_PATHOLOGY_CONSULT, O.PATH_PROC_DTE AS SURGICAL_SUBMITTED_SLIDES FROM LASTVIS X LEFT JOIN PATH A ON X.CPE_MRN = A.CPE_MRN LEFT JOIN PATH B ON A.CPE_MRN = B.CPE_MRN AND B.PATH_RPT_TYPE = 'Cytology-GYN' LEFT JOIN PATH C ON A.CPE_MRN = C.CPE_MRN AND C.PATH_RPT_TYPE = 'Cytology-Non GYN' LEFT JOIN PATH D ON A.CPE_MRN = D.CPE_MRN AND D.PATH_RPT_TYPE = 'Cytology-Submitted Slides' LEFT JOIN PATH E ON A.CPE_MRN = E.CPE_MRN AND E.PATH_RPT_TYPE = 'Cytolology-Private-GYN' LEFT JOIN PATH F ON A.CPE_MRN = F.CPE_MRN AND F.PATH_RPT_TYPE = 'Diagnostic Molecular Genetics' LEFT JOIN PATH G ON A.CPE_MRN = G.CPE_MRN AND G.PATH_RPT_TYPE = 'Diagnostic Molecular Pathology' LEFT JOIN PATH H ON A.CPE_MRN = H.CPE_MRN AND H.PATH_RPT_TYPE = 'Flow Cytometry Report' LEFT JOIN PATH I ON A.CPE_MRN = I.CPE_MRN AND I.PATH_RPT_TYPE = 'Hematopathology Departmental Consult' LEFT JOIN PATH J ON A.CPE_MRN = J.CPE_MRN AND J.PATH_RPT_TYPE = 'Hematopathology Report' LEFT JOIN PATH K ON A.CPE_MRN = K.CPE_MRN AND K.PATH_RPT_TYPE = 'Off-Site SSL Cases (64th St.)' LEFT JOIN PATH L ON A.CPE_MRN = L.CPE_MRN AND L.PATH_RPT_TYPE = 'Surgical Pathology' LEFT JOIN PATH M ON A.CPE_MRN = M.CPE_MRN AND M.PATH_RPT_TYPE = 'Surgical Pathology Breast' LEFT JOIN PATH N ON A.CPE_MRN = N.CPE_MRN AND N.PATH_RPT_TYPE = 'Surgical Pathology Consult' LEFT JOIN PATH O ON A.CPE_MRN = O.CPE_MRN AND O.PATH_RPT_TYPE = 'Surgical Submitted Slides'

prompt: Provide data on patients with breast MRI biopsy in 2010-11.
completion: WITH "cte1" AS (SELECT "PRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID", "DT_DTE" AS "Pathology Report Date", "PRPT_ACCESSION_NO" AS "Pathology Report", CASE WHEN CONTAINS("PRPT_REPORT", '"DCIS"') <> 0 THEN 'Y' ELSE '' END AS "DCIS", CASE WHEN CONTAINS("PRPT_REPORT", '"DUCTAL CARCINOMA IN SITU"') <> 0 THEN 'Y' ELSE '' END AS "DUCTAL CARCINOMA IN SITU", CASE WHEN CONTAINS("PRPT_REPORT", '"IDC"') <> 0 THEN 'Y' ELSE '' END AS "IDC", CASE WHEN CONTAINS("PRPT_REPORT", '"INVASIVE DUCTAL CARCINOMA"') <> 0 THEN 'Y' ELSE '' END AS "INVASIVE DUCTAL CARCINOMA", CASE WHEN CONTAINS("PRPT_REPORT", '"ILC"') <> 0 THEN 'Y' ELSE '' END AS "ILC", CASE WHEN CONTAINS("PRPT_REPORT", '"INVASIVE LOBULAR CARCINOMA"') <> 0 THEN 'Y' ELSE '' END AS "INVASIVE LOBULAR CARCINOMA", CASE WHEN CONTAINS("PRPT_REPORT", '"IMC"') <> 0 THEN 'Y' ELSE '' END AS "IMC", CASE WHEN CONTAINS("PRPT_REPORT", '"INVASIVE MAMMARY CARCINOMA"') <> 0 THEN 'Y' ELSE '' END AS "INVASIVE MAMMARY CARCINOMA", CASE WHEN CONTAINS("PRPT_REPORT", '"LCIS"') <> 0 THEN 'Y' ELSE '' END AS "LCIS", CASE WHEN CONTAINS("PRPT_REPORT", '"LOBULAR CARCINOMA IN SITU"') <> 0 THEN 'Y' ELSE '' END AS "LOBULAR CARCINOMA IN SITU", CASE WHEN CONTAINS("PRPT_REPORT", '"ADH"') <> 0 THEN 'Y' ELSE '' END AS "ADH", CASE WHEN CONTAINS("PRPT_REPORT", '"ATYPICAL DUCTAL HYPERPLASIA"') <> 0 THEN 'Y' ELSE '' END AS "ATYPICAL DUCTAL HYPERPLASIA", CASE WHEN CONTAINS("PRPT_REPORT", '"ALH"') <> 0 THEN 'Y' ELSE '' END AS "ALH", CASE WHEN CONTAINS("PRPT_REPORT", '"ATYPICAL LOBULAR HYPERPLASIA"') <> 0 THEN 'Y' ELSE '' END AS "ATYPICAL LOBULAR HYPERPLASIA", CASE WHEN CONTAINS("PRPT_REPORT", '"RADIAL SCAR"') <> 0 THEN 'Y' ELSE '' END AS "RADIAL SCAR", CASE WHEN CONTAINS("PRPT_REPORT", '"RADIAL SCLEROSING LESION"') <> 0 THEN 'Y' ELSE '' END AS "RADIAL SCLEROSING LESION", CASE WHEN CONTAINS("PRPT_REPORT", '"FIBROEPITHELIAL LESION"') <> 0 THEN 'Y' ELSE '' END AS "FIBROEPITHELIAL LESION", CASE WHEN CONTAINS("PRPT_REPORT", '"FIBROSIS"') <> 0 THEN 'Y' ELSE '' END AS "FIBROSIS" FROM "DV"."PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V" TEXTTABLE JOIN "DV"."DATE" ON "PRPT_REPORT_DATE_ID" = "DT_DATE_ID" WHERE CONTAINS("PRPT_REPORT", '"DCIS" | "DUCTAL CARCINOMA IN SITU" | "IDC" | "INVASIVE DUCTAL CARCINOMA" | "ILC" | "INVASIVE LOBULAR CARCINOMA" | "IMC" | "INVASIVE MAMMARY CARCINOMA" | "LCIS" | "LOBULAR CARCINOMA IN SITU" | "ADH" | "ATYPICAL DUCTAL HYPERPLASIA" | "ALH" | "ATYPICAL LOBULAR HYPERPLASIA" | "RADIAL SCAR" | "RADIAL SCLEROSING LESION" | "FIBROEPITHELIAL LESION" | "FIBROSIS"') <> 0 ) SELECT "t2"."PT_MRN" AS "MRN", "t2"."PT_LAST_NAME" AS "Last Name", "t2"."PT_FIRST_NAME" AS "First Name", "t2"."PT_SEX" AS "Gender", "t4"."DT_DTE" AS "CPT Procedure Date - PBD", "Pathology Report Date", "Pathology Report", "DCIS", "DUCTAL CARCINOMA IN SITU", "IDC", "INVASIVE DUCTAL CARCINOMA", "ILC", "INVASIVE LOBULAR CARCINOMA", "IMC", "INVASIVE MAMMARY CARCINOMA", "LCIS", "LOBULAR CARCINOMA IN SITU", "ADH", "ATYPICAL DUCTAL HYPERPLASIA", "ALH", "ATYPICAL LOBULAR HYPERPLASIA", "RADIAL SCAR", "RADIAL SCLEROSING LESION", "FIBROEPITHELIAL LESION", "FIBROSIS" FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED" "t1" JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V" "t2" ON "t1"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t2"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" JOIN "DV"."CPT_PBD_PATIENT_PROCEDURE" "t3" ON "t1"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t3"."PTX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" JOIN "DV"."DATE" "t4" ON "t3"."PTX_PROC_DATE_ID" = "t4"."DT_DATE_ID" LEFT JOIN "cte1" ON "t1"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "PRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AND "Pathology Report Date" BETWEEN "t4"."DT_DTE" AND "t4"."DT_DTE" + 14 DAYS WHERE "t2"."PT_SEX" IN ('F') AND "t3"."PROC_ID" IN (54227) AND "t4"."DT_DTE" BETWEEN '2010-1-1' AND '2011-12-31'

prompt: 2018 new visit appointments in Pediatric Surgery with Dr. Heaton, Dr. Laquaglia, and Dr. Gerstle
completion: SELECT CPE_MRN AS "MRN", PT_LAST_NAME "Last Name", PT_FIRST_NAME "First Name", PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH "DOB", CPE_ENC_DTE AS "Appt Date", CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 AS "Department", CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 AS "Service", CLD_DEPT_NAME AS "Department Name", RES.CRE_RES_NAME AS "Provider Name", CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME AS "Visit Type", RES.CRE_RES_NAME AS "Referring Provider Name", FSC_NAME "Insurance", FSC_PRIORITY "Insurance Priority" FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE RES ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = RES.CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE REF ON CPE_REF_RES_ID = REF.CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.PATIENT_INSURANCE_V ON CPE_MRN = MRN JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON CPE_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN '2018-01-01' AND '2018-12-31' AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 = 'SRG' AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 = 'PDS' AND RES.CRE_RES_NAME IN ('HEATON, TODD E', 'LAQUAGLIA, MICHAEL', 'GERSTLE, JUSTIN THEODORE') AND (CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME like '%NV%' OR CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME like '%IR%') ;

prompt: Identify patients with small cell carcinoma of the lung and radiation therapy at MSK.
completion: SELECT "t4"."PT_MRN" AS "MRN", "t4"."PT_LAST_NAME" AS "Last Name", "t4"."PT_FIRST_NAME" AS "First Name", "t4"."PT_SEX" AS "Gender", "t4"."PT_BIRTH_DTE" AS "Date of Birth", "t4"."PT_DEATH_DTE" AS "Date of Death", "t3"."DXCC_ICD_CODE" AS "ICD-O Histology Code", "t3"."DXCC_ICD_MSK_DESC" AS "ICD-O Histology Desc", "t2"."ICSC_SITE_CD" AS "ICD-O Site Code", "t2"."ICSC_ICDO_SITE_MSK_DESC" AS "ICD-O Site Desc", "t8"."TCA_CASE_STS_DESC" AS "Case Status", "t5"."DT_DTE" AS "CDB Tumor Diagnosis Date", CDTM_RAD_STRT_DTE AS "Tumor Radiation Therapy Start Date", "t6"."PLA_LAST_RT_DTE" AS "Last MSK Radiation Therapy Date" FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED" "t1" JOIN "DV"."CDB_TUMOR_V" "t7" ON "t1"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t7"."CDTM_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" JOIN "DV"."ICDO_SITE_CATALOG_V" "t2" ON "t7"."CDTM_SITE_CATALOG_ID" = "t2"."ICSC_SITE_CATALOG_ID" JOIN "DV"."DIAGNOSIS_CODE_CAT_ICDO_V" "t3" ON "t7"."CDTM_DX_CATALOG_ID" = "t3"."DXCC_DX_CATALOG_ID" JOIN "DV"."DATE" "t5" ON "t7"."CDTM_DX_DATE_ID" = "t5"."DT_DATE_ID" JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V" "t4" ON "t1"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t4"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_LATEST_ACTIVITY" "t6" ON "t1"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t6"."PLA_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" JOIN "DV"."TUMOR_CASE_ATTRIBUTES" "t8" ON "t7"."CDTM_CASE_ATTR_ID" = "t8"."TUMOR_CASE_ATTR_ID" WHERE "t3"."DXCC_ICD_CODE" IN ('M8002/3', 'M8041/3', 'M8043/3', 'M8045/3', 'M8073/3') AND "t2"."ICSC_SITE_CD" IN ('C339', 'C340', 'C341', 'C342', 'C343', 'C348', 'C349') AND "t6"."PLA_LAST_RT_DTE" >= "t5"."DT_DTE"

prompt: Please provide a list of patients who have had brain imaging completed at MSK, then diagnosed with a brain a met.
completion: WITH FIRST_BRAIN_IMAGING AS (SELECT RRPT_MRN AS MRN, MIN(RRPT_REPORT_DTE) AS BRAIN_IMAGE_DTE FROM DV.RADIOLOGY_REPORT_V WHERE RRPT_PROCEDURE_NAME LIKE '%BRAIN%' AND RRPT_REPORT_DTE >= '2005-01-01' GROUP BY RRPT_MRN), BRAIN_METS AS (SELECT CC_MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS METS_DATE FROM FIRST_BRAIN_IMAGING JOIN IDB.CTC_CLSF ON MRN=CC_MRN AND CC_EFF_DTE > BRAIN_IMAGE_DTE JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE (CLM_CLSF_CD) IN ('198.3', 'C79.31') GROUP BY CC_MRN), PTS AS (SELECT DISTINCT MRN FROM FIRST_BRAIN_IMAGING) SELECT DISTINCT TM_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, PT_SEX, CASE_STS.AV_DESC AS CASE_STS, TM_DX_DTE, TM_HIST_CD, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS HIST_DESC, TM_SITE_CD, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_DESC, TM_HIST_CD_GRADE, HIST_CD_GRADE.AV_DESC AS HIST_GRADE, TM_TSTAGE, TSTAGES.AV_DESC AS TSTAGE, TM_NSTAGE, NSTAGES.AV_DESC AS NSTAGE, TM_MSTAGE, MSTAGES.AV_DESC AS MSTAGE, MSK_STAGES.AV_DESC AS STAGE, TM_MSK_STG STG_PRESENTED_AT_MSK, CDB_AV_DESC STG_PRESENTED_AT_MSK_DESC, TM_CSSIZE FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN PTS ON MRN=TM_MRN JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS CASE_STS ON CASE_STS.AV_ELEMENT = 'CASE_STS' AND CASE_STS.AV_CODE = TM_CASE_STS AND TM_CASE_STS IN ('3', '6', '7', '8') JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS HIST_CD_GRADE ON TM_HIST_CD_GRADE = HIST_CD_GRADE.AV_CODE AND HIST_CD_GRADE.AV_ELEMENT='HIST_CD_GRADE' JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PT_MRN=TM_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS TSTAGES ON TSTAGES.AV_ELEMENT='TSTAGE' AND TSTAGES.AV_CODE=TM_TSTAGE LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS NSTAGES ON NSTAGES.AV_ELEMENT='NSTAGE' AND NSTAGES.AV_CODE=TM_NSTAGE LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS MSTAGES ON MSTAGES.AV_ELEMENT='MSTAGE' AND MSTAGES.AV_CODE=TM_MSTAGE LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS MSK_STAGES ON MSK_STAGES.AV_ELEMENT='MSK_STAGE' AND MSK_STAGES.AV_CODE=TM_MSK_STG LEFT JOIN IDB.CDB_ALLOWVALS ON CDB_AV_ELEMENT = 'GENERAL_STG' AND CDB_AV_CD_STS = 'A' AND TM_MSK_STG = CDB_AV_CODE ; WITH FIRST_BRAIN_IMAGING AS (SELECT RRPT_MRN AS MRN, MIN(RRPT_REPORT_DTE) AS FIRST_BRAIN_IMAGE_DTE FROM DV.RADIOLOGY_REPORT_V WHERE RRPT_PROCEDURE_NAME LIKE '%BRAIN%' AND RRPT_REPORT_DTE >= '2005-01-01' GROUP BY RRPT_MRN) SELECT MRN, FIRST_BRAIN_IMAGE_DTE, RRPT_PROCEDURE_NAME, RRPT_REPORT_DTE FROM FIRST_BRAIN_IMAGING JOIN DV.RADIOLOGY_REPORT_V ON MRN=RRPT_MRN AND FIRST_BRAIN_IMAGE_DTE < RRPT_REPORT_DTE WHERE RRPT_PROCEDURE_NAME LIKE '%BRAIN%' AND RRPT_REPORT_DTE >= '2005-01-01' ORDER BY 1 ; WITH BRAIN_IMAGING AS (SELECT DISTINCT RRPT_MRN AS CC_MRN FROM DV.RADIOLOGY_REPORT_V WHERE RRPT_PROCEDURE_NAME LIKE '%BRAIN%' AND RRPT_REPORT_DTE >= '2005-01-01' GROUP BY RRPT_MRN), APPTS AS (SELECT CPE_MRN AS "MRN", CPE_ENC_DTE "Appointment Date", CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 AS "Department", CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 AS "Service", CLD_DEPT_NAME AS "Department Name", CRE_RES_NAME AS "GIM Provider Name", CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME AS "Visit Type", ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CPE_MRN ORDER BY CPE_ENC_DTE) AS RN FROM BRAIN_IMAGING JOIN IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER ON CC_MRN=CPE_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CRE_RES_TYP='Physician' AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8='NRS' UNION SELECT CPE_MRN AS "MRN", CPE_ENC_DTE "Appointment Date", CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 AS "Department", CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 AS "Service", CLD_DEPT_NAME AS "Department Name", CRE_RES_NAME AS "GIM Provider Name", CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME AS "Visit Type", ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CPE_MRN ORDER BY CPE_ENC_DTE) AS RN FROM BRAIN_IMAGING JOIN IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER ON CC_MRN=CPE_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CRE_RES_TYP='Physician' AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8='NEU' ) SELECT CC_MRN MRN, "Appointment Date", "Department", "Service", "Department Name", "GIM Provider Name", "Visit Type" FROM BRAIN_IMAGING JOIN APPTS ON MRN=CC_MRN AND RN = 1 ORDER BY 1, 2, 3 ; WITH BRAIN_IMAGING AS (SELECT DISTINCT RRPT_MRN AS MRN FROM DV.RADIOLOGY_REPORT_V WHERE RRPT_PROCEDURE_NAME LIKE '%BRAIN%' AND RRPT_REPORT_DTE >= '2005-01-01' GROUP BY RRPT_MRN) SELECT CC_MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS MIN_ICD9_EFF_DTE, CC_CLSF_CD AS ICD9_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS ICD9_DESC FROM BRAIN_IMAGING JOIN IDB.CTC_CLSF ON CC_MRN=MRN JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE CLM_CLSF_CD IN ('198.3', 'C79.31') AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND (CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) GROUP BY CC_MRN, CC_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK HAVING MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) >= '2005-01-01' ORDER BY 1, 2

prompt:
addition of 1 year of data (8/1/2020- 7/31/2021) to previous request LAB22952 

Retrospective data analysis to determine incidence rates of respiratory pathogens from before and after march 2020.
completion: SELECT LR_MRN AS MRN, PT_LAST_NAME , PT_FIRST_NAME , YEAR(CURRENT date - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) AS AGE, PT_SEX AS GENDER, AV_DESC AS RACE, PT_ZIP_CD AS ZIP, LR_PERFORMED_DTE AS LAB_DTE, LR_PERFORMED_DT AS LAB_DT, LR_RESULT_GUID AS RESULT_GUID, LR_ACCESSION_NO AS ACCESSION_NO, LR_TEST_NAME AS TEST_NAME, LR_SUBTEST_NAME AS ASSAY, RTRIM(LTL_TEXT_RESULT) AS LAB_RESULTS FROM IDB.LAB_RESULTS LEFT JOIN IDB.LAB_TEXT_LINE ON LTL_RESULT_GUID = LR_RESULT_GUID JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON LR_MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS ON AV_ELEMENT = 'RACE' AND AV_CODE = PT_RACE WHERE 1=1 AND LR_PERFORMED_DTE BETWEEN '2020-08-01' AND '2021-07-31' AND (LR_TEST_NAME IN ('COVID-19/Flu A B/RSV Qual RNA Panel', 'Influenza A and B PCR', 'Influenza Virus Types A and B/Respiratory Syncytial Virus Qualitative RNA Naso', 'Respiratory NAT Panel', 'Respiratory Syncytial Virus DFA', 'Respiratory PCR Panel', 'Respiratory NAT Panel with SARS-CoV-2', 'Viral Culture') OR LR_SUBTEST_NAME IN ('COVID-19/Flu A B/RSV Qual RNA Panel', 'Influenza A and B PCR', 'Influenza Virus Types A and B/Respiratory Syncytial Virus Qualitative RNA Naso', 'Respiratory NAT Panel', 'Respiratory Syncytial Virus DFA', 'Respiratory PCR Panel', 'Respiratory NAT Panel with SARS-CoV-2', 'Viral Culture'))

prompt: Please identify all patients with breast cancer treated at MSK from June 2022 until now with sacituzumab govitecan for any breast-cancer related indication, and please report additional clinical characteristics outlined below
completion: WITH HNS_PTS AS (SELECT CPE_MRN AS "MRN", CPE_ENC_DTE AS "Appt Date", CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 AS "Department", CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 AS "Service", CLD_DEPT_NAME AS "Department Name", CRE_RES_NAME AS "Provider Name", CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME AS "Visit Type", CVT_EXT_NAME AS "Visit Type External" FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 = 'HNS' AND UPPER(CRE_RES_NAME) IN ('SHERMAN, ERIC J' , 'PFISTER, DAVID' , 'HO, ALAN' , 'DUNN, LARA ANN' , 'WONG, WINSTON' , 'KRIPLANI, ANUJA' , 'FETTEN, JAMES VINCENT' , 'MICHEL, LOREN SCOTT' , 'BAXI, SHRUJAL') ) SELECT TM_MRN, AV_DESC AS CASE_STS, TM_DX_DTE, TM_HIST_CD, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS HIST_DESC, TM_SITE_CD, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_DESC, TM_BEST_AJCC_STG FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S prompt: Provide a list of all inpatients, 75 years of age and under, who died since January 1, 2011, excluding patients with specified diagnoses, and make this a monthly report.
completion: SELECT MRN, LASTNAME, FIRSTNAME, AGE, DOD, ADMDTE, TOD, SVC FROM (SELECT PT_MRN AS MRN, PT_LAST_NAME AS LASTNAME, PT_FIRST_NAME AS FIRSTNAME , YEAR(PT_DATE_OF_DEATH - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) AS AGE , PT_DATE_OF_DEATH AS DOD, CS_ADM_DATE AS ADMDTE , CS_DSCH_TIME AS TOD , CS_HOSP_SVC AS SVC FROM IDB.CASE JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PT_MRN = CS_MRN WHERE CS_DSCH_DATE BETWEEN '2011-01-01' AND '2011-12-31' AND ((CS_DSCH_DISP LIKE 'C%' OR CS_DSCH_DISP LIKE 'D%') OR (CS_DSCH_DATE = PT_DATE_OF_DEATH AND PT_DEATH_IND IN ('D', 'C'))) UNION SELECT PT_MRN AS MRN, PT_LAST_NAME AS LASTNAME, PT_FIRST_NAME AS FIRSTNAME , YEAR(PT_DATE_OF_DEATH - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) AS AGE , PT_DATE_OF_DEATH AS DOD, PT_DATE_OF_DEATH AS ADMDTE , '00:00:00' AS TOD, 'UCC' AS SVC FROM IDB.PATIENT WHERE PT_DEATH_IND IN ('D', 'C') AND PT_DATE_OF_DEATH BETWEEN '2011-01-01' AND '2011-12-31' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM IDB.CASE WHERE CS_MRN = PT_MRN AND((CS_DSCH_DISP LIKE 'C%' OR CS_DSCH_DISP LIKE 'D%') OR CS_DSCH_DATE = PT_DATE_OF_DEATH)) ) AS Y WHERE AGE < 76 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF WHERE CC_MRN = Y.MRN AND CC_EFF_DTE BETWEEN ADMDTE AND DOD AND (CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND (CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) AND (CC_CLSF_CD IN ('042', 'V08', '46.1', '54.5', '795.71') OR CC_CLSF_CD BETWEEN '010.00' AND '018.96' OR CC_CLSF_CD BETWEEN '066.40' AND '066.49' OR CC_CLSF_CD BETWEEN '070.2' AND '071' OR CC_CLSF_CD BETWEEN '079.50' AND '079.59' OR CC_CLSF_CD BETWEEN '140.0' AND '190.9' OR CC_CLSF_CD BETWEEN '192.2' AND '208.91' OR CC_CLSF_CD BETWEEN '230.0' AND '239.9' OR CC_CLSF_CD BETWEEN '284.0' AND '284.9' OR CC_CLSF_CD BETWEEN '286.0' AND '286.4' OR CC_CLSF_CD BETWEEN '321.0' AND '321.8' OR CC_CLSF_CD BETWEEN '323.0' AND '323.4' OR CC_CLSF_CD BETWEEN '551.00' AND '551.9' OR CC_CLSF_CD BETWEEN '765.00' AND '765.19' OR CC_CLSF_CD BETWEEN 'V10.00' AND 'V10.9')))

prompt: Will need a monthly report outlining the number of Pap exams, clinical exams, and mammograms completed at the Breast Examination Center of Harlem.
completion: WITH PTS AS (SELECT OO_MRN "MRN", OOC_ITEM_NAME "Exam", OO_PERFORMED_DTE "Date", OP_DISPLAY_NAME "Provider" FROM IDB.OMS_ORDER JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_CATALOG ON OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID = OOC_MSTR_ITEM_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_STATUS ON OO_ORD_STS_CD = OSTS_ORD_STS_CD JOIN IDB.OMS_PROVIDER ON OO_PVDR_GUID = OP_PVDR_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_USER_ORDERS ON OO_ORD_GUID = OUO_ORD_GUID JOIN IDB.LOCATION_GROUPS_REFERENCE ON OUO_CURR_LOC = LGR_LOC_NAME WHERE LGR_LOC_GRP = 'BECH' AND OOC_ITEM_NAME = 'BI' AND OO_ORD_STS_CD NOT IN ('CANP', 'CANC', 'AUC3', 'HOLD', 'SCHD') AND OO_PERFORMED_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT DATE - DAY(CURRENT DATE) DAYS + 1 DAY - 1 MONTH AND CURRENT DATE - DAY(CURRENT DATE) DAYS UNION ALL SELECT CDD_MRN "MRN", CDD_DOC_NAME "Exam", CDD_SERVICE_DTE "Date", OP_DISPLAY_NAME "Provider" FROM IDB.CD_DOCUMENT JOIN IDB.OMS_PROVIDER ON CDD_AUTH_PROV_GUID = OP_PVDR_GUID WHERE CDD_DOC_NAME IN ('History & Physical, Breast - BECH', 'History & Physical, Pelvic - BECH', 'Miscellaneous/Discussion Note, Amb-Breast Examination Center') AND CDD_CANCEL_IND <> '1' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND <> '1' AND CDD_SERVICE_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT DATE - DAY(CURRENT DATE) DAYS + 1 DAY - 1 MONTH AND CURRENT DATE - DAY(CURRENT DATE) DAYS ) SELECT "MRN", CASE WHEN "Exam" = 'BI' THEN 'Mammo' WHEN "Exam" = 'History & Physical, Pelvic - BECH' THEN 'Pap' WHEN "Exam" = 'History & Physical, Breast - BECH' THEN 'Clinical Exam' WHEN "Exam" = 'Miscellaneous/Discussion Note, Amb-Breast Examination Center' THEN 'Consultation' END AS "Appt Type", "Date", "Provider" FROM PTS ; WITH PTS AS (SELECT OO_MRN "MRN", OOC_ITEM_NAME "Exam", OO_PERFORMED_DTE "Date", OP_DISPLAY_NAME FROM IDB.OMS_ORDER JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_CATALOG ON OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID = OOC_MSTR_ITEM_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_STATUS ON OO_ORD_STS_CD = OSTS_ORD_STS_CD JOIN IDB.OMS_PROVIDER ON OO_PVDR_GUID = OP_PVDR_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_USER_ORDERS ON OO_ORD_GUID = OUO_ORD_GUID JOIN IDB.LOCATION_GROUPS_REFERENCE ON OUO_CURR_LOC = LGR_LOC_NAME WHERE LGR_LOC_GRP = 'BECH' AND OOC_ITEM_NAME = 'BI' AND OO_ORD_STS_CD NOT IN ('CANP', 'CANC', 'AUC3', 'HOLD', 'SCHD') AND OO_PERFORMED_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT DATE - DAY(CURRENT DATE) DAYS + 1 DAY - 1 MONTH AND CURRENT DATE - DAY(CURRENT DATE) DAYS UNION ALL SELECT CDD_MRN "MRN", CDD_DOC_NAME "Exam", CDD_SERVICE_DTE "Date", OP_DISPLAY_NAME FROM IDB.CD_DOCUMENT JOIN IDB.OMS_PROVIDER ON CDD_AUTH_PROV_GUID = OP_PVDR_GUID WHERE CDD_DOC_NAME IN ('History & Physical, Breast - BECH', 'History & Physical, Pelvic - BECH', 'Miscellaneous/Discussion Note, Amb-Breast Examination Center') AND CDD_CANCEL_IND <> '1' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND <> '1' AND CDD_SERVICE_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT DATE - DAY(CURRENT DATE) DAYS + 1 DAY - 1 MONTH AND CURRENT DATE - DAY(CURRENT DATE) DAYS ) SELECT MONTHNAME(CURRENT DATE - DAY(CURRENT DATE) DAYS + 1 DAY - 1 MONTH) "Month", OP_DISPLAY_NAME AS "Provider", COUNT(CASE WHEN "Exam" = 'BI' THEN 1 ELSE NULL END) AS "Mammo", COUNT(CASE WHEN "Exam" = 'History & Physical, Pelvic - BECH' THEN 1 ELSE NULL END) AS "Pap", COUNT(CASE WHEN "Exam" = 'History & Physical, Breast - BECH' THEN 1 ELSE NULL END) AS "Clinical Exam", COUNT(CASE WHEN "Exam" = 'Miscellaneous/Discussion Note, Amb-Breast Examination Center' THEN 1 ELSE NULL END) AS "Consultation" FROM PTS GROUP BY OP_DISPLAY_NAME UNION ALL SELECT MONTHNAME(CURRENT DATE - DAY(CURRENT DATE) DAYS + 1 DAY - 1 MONTH) "Month", 'Total' AS "Provider", COUNT(CASE WHEN "Exam" = 'BI' THEN 1 ELSE NULL END) AS "Mammo", COUNT(CASE WHEN "Exam" = 'History & Physical, Pelvic - BECH' THEN 1 ELSE NULL END) AS "Pap", COUNT(CASE WHEN "Exam" = 'History & Physical, Breast - BECH' THEN 1 ELSE NULL END) AS "Clinical Exam", COUNT(CASE WHEN "Exam" = 'Miscellaneous/Discussion Note, Amb-Breast Examination Center' THEN 1 ELSE NULL END) AS "Consultation" FROM PTS ; SELECT CRE_RES_NAME, CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME, COUNT(*) FROM IDB.PATIENT JOIN IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER ON PT_MRN = CPE_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CLD_CLD_CENTER = 'BECH' AND CRE_RES_TYP = 'Nurse Practitioner' AND CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT DATE - DAY(CURRENT DATE) DAYS + 1 DAY - 1 MONTH AND CURRENT DATE - DAY(CURRENT DATE) DAYS GROUP BY CRE_RES_NAME, CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME

prompt: Provide a list of patients with esophagogastric adenocarcinoma with high PDL1 expression
completion: WITH PTS AS (SELECT PT_MRN TM_MRN, PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_BIRTH_DTE, PT_DEATH_DTE, DT_DTE TM_DX_DTE, ICSC_SITE_CD, ICSC_ICDO_SITE_MSK_DESC, DXCC_ICD_CODE, DXCC_ICD_MSK_DESC, TCSA_TM_AJCC_DESC, TCA_CASE_STS_DESC FROM DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS JOIN DV.CDB_TUMOR_V ON CDTM_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID JOIN DV.DATE_V ON CDTM_DX_DATE_ID = DT_DATE_ID JOIN DV.DIAGNOSIS_CODE_CAT_ICDO_V ON CDTM_DX_CATALOG_ID = DXCC_DX_CATALOG_ID JOIN DV.ICDO_SITE_CATALOG_V ON CDTM_SITE_CATALOG_ID = ICSC_SITE_CATALOG_ID JOIN DV.TUMOR_CASE_ATTRIBUTES_V ON CDTM_CASE_ATTR_ID = TUMOR_CASE_ATTR_ID JOIN DV.TUMOR_COLLAB_STAGE_ATTRIBUTES_V ON CDTM_COLLAB_STAGE_ATTR_ID = TCSA_TM_COLLAB_STAGE_ATTR_ID WHERE (ICSC_SITE_CD like 'C15%' OR ICSC_SITE_CD like 'C16%') AND DXCC_ICD_CODE = 'M8140/3' AND DT_DTE >= '2013-01-01' AND TCA_CASE_STS_DESC IN ('Completed', 'Consult only', 'Non-Index tumor', 'Pathology only') ) , CPS AS (SELECT PRPT_MRN, PRPT_PROCEDURE_DTE, PRPT_REPORT_DTE, PRPT_ACCESSION_NO, PRPT_REPORT FROM PTS JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V ON TM_MRN = PRPT_MRN JOIN DV.PATH_RPRT_TYPE_LOOKUP ON PRPT_REPORT_TYPE = PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_CD WHERE CONTAINS("PRPT_REPORT", '("Combined Positive Score (CPS)")') = 1 ) , EBER AS (SELECT PRPT_MRN, PRPT_PROCEDURE_DTE, PRPT_REPORT_DTE, PRPT_ACCESSION_NO, PRPT_REPORT FROM PTS JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V ON TM_MRN = PRPT_MRN JOIN DV.PATH_RPRT_TYPE_LOOKUP ON PRPT_REPORT_TYPE = PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_CD WHERE CONTAINS("PRPT_REPORT", '("EBER" | "EBV")') = 1 ) , HER2 AS (SELECT CDD_MRN, CDO_VALUE_TEXT, CDO_LARGE_VALUE_TEXT_IND FROM PTS JOIN IDB.CD_DOCUMENT ON TM_MRN = CDD_MRN JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION ON CDO_DOC_GUID = CDD_DOC_GUID AND CDO_AUTHORED_DTE = CDD_AUTHORED_DTE WHERE CDD_CANCEL_IND <> '1' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND <> '1' AND(UPPER(CDO_ITEM_NAME) LIKE '%HER2%' OR UPPER(CDO_VALUE_TEXT) LIKE '%HER2%') ) , IRB AS (SELECT TM_MRN IRB_MRN, MAX(CASE WHEN P.PRO_IRB_NO = '12-245' THEN AC_CONS_DTE END) "12-245", MAX(CASE WHEN P.PRO_IRB_NO = '06-107' THEN AC_CONS_DTE END) "06-107" FROM PTS JOIN DV.ACCRUALS A ON PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = AC_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID JOIN DV.PROTOCOL P ON AC_PROTOCOL_ID = PRO_PROTOCOL_ID WHERE P.PRO_IRB_NO IN ('12-245', '06-107') GROUP BY TM_MRN ) , MMR AS (SELECT PRPT_MRN, PRPT_PROCEDURE_DTE, PRPT_REPORT_DTE, PRPT_ACCESSION_NO, PRPT_REPORT FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V JOIN DV.PATH_RPRT_TYPE_LOOKUP ON PRPT_REPORT_TYPE = PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_CD WHERE CONTAINS("PRPT_REPORT", '("MLH1" | "MSH2" | "MSH6" | "PMS2")') = 1 AND PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_DESC = 'Surgical Pathology' ) , CVR_ELEMENTS AS (SELECT PDWS_NAME, PDRX_PATH_DMP_RESULTS_XML_ID, PDRX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID, PT_MRN, PDRX_PATH_RPT_ID, PDRX_ACCESSION_NO, PDRX_DMP_PATIENT_ID, PDRX_DMP_SAMPLE_ID, T.*, 'Element' AS NODETYPE FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML INNER JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V ON PDRX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID INNER JOIN PTS ON TM_MRN = PT_MRN INNER JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML_SETTINGS ON PDRX_PATH_DMP_RESULTS_XML_ID = PDRXS_PATH_DMP_RESULTS_XML_ID INNER JOIN DVDMC.PATHOLOGY_DMP_WEBSVC_SETTINGS ON PDRXS_SETTING_ID = PDWS_SETTING_ID , XMLTABLE('$x/root//*' PASSING PDRX_XML_VALUE AS "x" COLUMNS NODEXML XML PATH '.', NODENAME VARCHAR(255) PATH 'local-name(.)', NODEVAL VARCHAR(4000) PATH '.', SEQNO FOR ORDINALITY, PARENTNODE VARCHAR(255) PATH '../local-name(.)') T WHERE 1=1 AND PDWS_NAME IN ('IMPACT') AND (NODENAME IN ('tumor_type_name', 'msi-score', 'tmb_cohort_percentile', 'tmb_tt_cohort', 'tmb_score', 'tmb_tt_percentile', 'tmb_cohort', 'tumor_purity')) AND NODEVAL <> 'NA' ) , CVR AS (SELECT PT_MRN CVR_MRN, PDRX_ACCESSION_NO, MAX(CASE WHEN PDWS_NAME = 'IMPACT' AND NODENAME = 'tumor_type_name' THEN NODEVAL END) "IMPACT tumor_type_name", MAX(CASE WHEN PDWS_NAME = 'IMPACT' AND NODENAME = 'tmb_cohort_percentile' THEN NODEVAL END) "IMPACT tmb_cohort_percentile", MAX(CASE WHEN PDWS_NAME = 'IMPACT' AND NODENAME = 'tmb_tt_cohort' THEN NODEVAL END) "IMPACT tmb_tt_cohort", MAX(CASE WHEN PDWS_NAME = 'IMPACT' AND NODENAME = 'tmb_score' THEN NODEVAL END) "IMPACT tmb_score", MAX(CASE WHEN PDWS_NAME = 'IMPACT' AND NODENAME = 'tmb_tt_percentile' THEN NODEVAL END) "IMPACT tmb_tt_percentile", MAX(CASE WHEN PDWS_NAME = 'IMPACT' AND NODENAME = 'tmb_cohort' THEN NODEVAL END) "IMPACT tmb_cohort", MAX(CASE WHEN PDWS_NAME = 'IMPACT' AND NODENAME = 'msi-score' THEN NODEVAL END) "IMPACT MSI Score", MAX(CASE WHEN PDWS_NAME = 'IMPACT' AND NODENAME = 'tumor_purity' THEN NODEVAL END) "IMPACT Tumor Purity" FROM CVR_ELEMENTS WHERE PDWS_NAME IN ('IMPACT') GROUP BY PT_MRN, PDRX_ACCESSION_NO) SELECT * FROM PTS LEFT JOIN CPS CPS ON TM_MRN = CPS.PRPT_MRN LEFT JOIN EBER E ON TM_MRN = E.PRPT_MRN LEFT JOIN HER2 H ON TM_MRN = H.CDD_MRN LEFT JOIN IRB I ON TM_MRN = I.IRB_MRN LEFT JOIN MMR M ON TM_MRN = M.PRPT_MRN LEFT JOIN CVR CVR ON TM_MRN = CVR.CVR_MRN ; SELECT TM_MRN, CDG_THERAPEUTIC_CATEGORY, CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME, APR_START_DTE, APR_END_DTE, APR_PRESCRIBED_DOSE, APR_DOSE_UOM, APR_TOTAL_GIVEN_DOSE, APR_ROUTE, APR_ORAL_FLAG, APR_QTY, APR_FREQ, APR_DURATION, APR_INSTRUCTIONS, APR_SET_NAME FROM PTS JOIN IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX ON TM_MRN = APR_MRN JOIN IDB.CHEMO_DRUG_GENERIC ON APR_GENERIC_NAME = CDG_GENERIC_NAME ; SELECT TM_MRN, RTC_TX_PLAN_NAME, RTC_TX_PLANNED_FRACTIONS, RTC_TX_DELIVERED_FRACTIONS, RTC_TX_PLANNED_DOSE, RTC_TX_DELIVERED_DOSE, RTC_TX_START_DTE, RTC_TX_STOP_DTE, RTC_TX_ELAPSED_DAYS, RTC_PRIMARY_REF_POINT, RTC_DOSE_CORRECTION FROM PTS JOIN IDB.RADONC_TREATMENT_COURSE ON TM_MRN = RTX_MRN SELECT SSP_LOG_ID, SSP_PROC_SEQ_NO, SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD, SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC , SSP_RES_ID, SSP_SURG_LAST_NM, SSP_SURG_FIRST_NM, SSP_SURG_SVC_CD, SSE_MRN, SSE_SURG_DTE, SSE_SURG_LOC FROM PTS JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE ON TM_MRN = SSE_MRN JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT ON SSE_LOG_ID = SSP_LOG_ID ; ; , IMPACT_RES AS (SELECT P.PT_MRN, PRPT_ACCESSION_NO, TEST_ID, PATH_PROCEDURE_DATE, GENE, RESULT, LOCUS, AA_CHANGE, NUCLEOTIDE, SEARCH_HIT1, SEARCH_HIT2, METHOD, ABERRATIONTYPE, FOLD_CHANGE FROM PTS P JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_STRUCTURED_RESULTS_V S ON P.PT_MRN = S.PT_MRN WHERE METHOD = 'IMPACT' )

RELEASED_DATE , MAX(CASE WHEN FLD_LABEL = 'Component Needed' THEN DI_VALUE END) COMPONENT_NEEDED , MAX(CASE WHEN DI_CD = 'Requested For' THEN DI_VALUE END) REQUESTED_FOR , MAX(CASE WHEN FLD_LABEL = 'Patient Blood Type' THEN DI_VALUE END) PT_BLOOD_TYPE , MAX(CASE WHEN FLD_LABEL = 'Donor Blood Type' THEN DI_VALUE END) DONOR_BLOOD_TYPE , MAX(CASE WHEN FLD_LABEL = 'Relationship to Patient' THEN DI_VALUE END) RELATIONSHIP , MAX(CASE WHEN DI_CD = 'Type of HSCT' THEN DI_VALUE END) HSCT_TYPE , MAX(CASE WHEN DI_CD LIKE 'CD 34%' THEN DI_VALUE END) TARGETED_CD34 , MAX(CASE WHEN DI_CD LIKE 'Positive I%D%Markers%' THEN DI_VALUE END) SEROLOG_RESULTS , MAX(CASE WHEN DI_CD LIKE 'Pre Transplant ID%' THEN DI_VALUE END) TDT_WN_30DAYS , MAX(CASE WHEN FLD_LABEL = 'Hep B Core' AND DI_VALUE = '1' THEN 'X' END) TDT_RESULTS1 , MAX(CASE WHEN FLD_LABEL = 'Hep B Surface Antigen' AND DI_VALUE = '1' THEN 'X' END) TDT_RESULTS2 , MAX(CASE WHEN FLD_LABEL = 'Hep C Antibody' AND DI_VALUE = '1' THEN 'X' END) TDT_RESULTS3 , MAX(CASE WHEN FLD_LABEL = 'Hep C PCR' AND DI_VALUE = '1' THEN 'X' END) TDT_RESULTS4 , MAX(CASE WHEN FLD_LABEL = 'HIV 1/2 Antibody' AND DI_VALUE = '1' THEN 'X' END) TDT_RESULTS5 , MAX(CASE WHEN FLD_LABEL = 'HIV 1 PCR' AND DI_VALUE = '1' THEN 'X' END) TDT_RESULTS6 , MAX(CASE WHEN FLD_LABEL = 'HTLV 1/2' AND DI_VALUE = '1' THEN 'X' END) TDT_RESULTS7 , MAX(CASE WHEN FLD_LABEL = 'Chagas' AND DI_VALUE = '1' THEN 'X' END) TDT_RESULTS8 , MAX(CASE WHEN FLD_LABEL = 'RPR' AND DI_VALUE = '1' THEN 'X' END) TDT_RESULTS9 , MAX(CASE WHEN FLD_LABEL = 'West Nile Virus' AND DI_VALUE = '1' THEN 'X' END) TDT_RESULTS10 , MAX(CASE WHEN DI_CD = 'Cancer Diagnosis' THEN DI_VALUE END) CA_DX , MAX(CASE WHEN FLD_LABEL LIKE '%Spec%Instr%' THEN DI_VALUE END) SPEC_INSTR , MAX(CASE WHEN FLD_LABEL LIKE 'RNB%' AND DI_VALUE = '1' THEN 'X' END) RNB , MAX(CASE WHEN FLD_LABEL LIKE '%Comments%' THEN DI_VALUE END) COMMENTS , SUMMARYLINE, OO_ORD_GUID, 'NRS' GRP FROM (SELECT OO_MRN AS MRN, OO_ENTER_DTE ENTER_DATE , PT_LAST_NAME LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME FIRST_NAME , YEAR(COALESCE(PT_DATE_OF_DEATH, OO_ENTER_DTE) - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) AGE , CASE WHEN OO_REQ_TME_PRIO IN ('Outside Order', 'Fill at MSK') OR(OO_IS_FOR_DSCH = 'Y' AND OO_REQ_TME_PRIO = 'Routine') THEN 'Retail Order' WHEN OCV_IP_OP_IND = 'I' THEN 'IP Order' ELSE 'OP Order' END ORDER_TYPE , OOC_ITEM_NAME AS ORDER_NAME , STRIP(OO_ORD_STS_CD)||' - '|| OSTS_STS_DESC AS STATUS , USR.OU_DISPLAY_NAME AS ORD_USER, OO_ENTER_ROLE USER_ROLE , REQ.OU_DISPLAY_NAME AS REQUESTER, REQ.OU_ORD_ROLE_TYPE REQUESTER_ROLE , OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE AS START_DATE, OSH_CREATE_DTE RELEASED_DATE , CASE WHEN REQ.OU_ORD_ROLE_TYPE <> 'Attending' AND REQ.OU_DISPLAY_NAME <> OCV_PVDR_NAME THEN OCV_PVDR_NAME END AS VISIT_ATT_NAME , DOC_SVC SVC, OCV_CURR_LOC AS LOCATION , OO_REQ_TME_PRIO AS TIME_PRIO, OO_SUMMARY_LINE AS SUMMARYLINE , OO_ORD_GUID, OFF_FLD_GUID, REPLACE(OFF_FLD_LABEL, ':', '') FLD_LABEL , OFF_DI_CD DI_CD, SUBSTR(STRIP(OUD_USER_DI_VALUE), 1, 255) DI_VALUE FROM IDB.OMS_ORDER JOIN IDB.OMS_CLIENT_VISIT ON OO_VISIT_GUID = OCV_VISIT_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_CATALOG ON OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID = OOC_MSTR_ITEM_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_USER USR ON OO_USER_GUID = USR.OU_USER_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_USER REQ ON OO_PVDR_GUID = REQ.OU_USER_GUID JOIN IDB.DOC ON OO_REQ_DR_NO = DOC_DR_NO AND DOC_SOURCE_DESC = 'SMS' JOIN IDB.OMS_STATUS ON OO_ORD_STS_CD = OSTS_ORD_STS_CD JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PT_MRN = OO_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_STS_HX ON OSH_ORD_GUID = OO_ORD_GUID AND OSH_FUNCTION_CD = '105' JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_FORM_FIELD ON OO_ENTRY_FRM_GUID = OFF_ENTRY_FRM_GUID LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_USER_DATA ON OUD_ORD_GUID = OO_ORD_GUID AND OFF_DI_CD = OUD_USER_DI_CD WHERE OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE BETWEEN LAST_DAY(CURRENT DATE - 2 MONTH) + 1 DAY AND LAST_DAY(CURRENT DATE - 1 MONTH) AND OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID IN ('1000003876073029', '1000004618073029', '3000001162073001', '9000005597100730', '9000006841100730') ) X GROUP BY MRN, LAST_NAME, FIRST_NAME, AGE, ENTER_DATE, ORDER_TYPE, ORDER_NAME, STATUS , ORD_USER, USER_ROLE, REQUESTER, REQUESTER_ROLE, VISIT_ATT_NAME, SVC , LOCATION, TIME_PRIO, START_DATE, RELEASED_DATE, SUMMARYLINE, OO_ORD_GUID

prompt: Please provide a list of open clinical trials between the years 2000 and 2020 for patients aged 15-39.
completion: WITH X AS (SELECT DISTINCT AC_MRN, AC_CONS_DTE, YEAR(AC_CONS_DTE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) AS CONSENT_AGE, CASE WHEN YEAR(AC_CONS_DTE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) < 15 THEN '<15' WHEN YEAR(AC_CONS_DTE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) BETWEEN 15 AND 39 THEN '15-39' WHEN YEAR(AC_CONS_DTE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) >= 40 THEN '40+' END AS AGE_BUCKET, PRO_IRB_NO, PRO_IRB_TITLE, PRO_OPEN_DTE, PRO_CLOSE_ACCR_DTE FROM IDB.PROTOCOL P JOIN IDB.ACCRUALS ON PRO_IRB_NO = AC_IRB_NO JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON AC_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE YEAR(AC_CONS_DTE) BETWEEN 2000 AND 2020 ) SELECT PRO_IRB_NO, PRO_IRB_TITLE, PRO_OPEN_DTE, PRO_CLOSE_ACCR_DTE, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN AGE_BUCKET = '<15' THEN AC_MRN END) AS "<15", COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN AGE_BUCKET = '15-39' THEN AC_MRN END) AS "15-39", COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN AGE_BUCKET = '40+' THEN AC_MRN END) AS "40+" FROM X GROUP BY PRO_IRB_NO, PRO_IRB_TITLE, PRO_OPEN_DTE, PRO_CLOSE_ACCR_DTE

prompt: Provide a list of Thoracic and BMT patients that have been seen by a Survivorship APP within the last 12 months.
completion: SELECT DISTINCT TRIM(PT_MRN) PT_MRN, TRIM(PT_LAST_NAME) || ', ' || TRIM(PT_FIRST_NAME) PATIENTS_NAME, SSE_SURG_DTE SURGERY_DATE, CLD_DEPT_NAME DEPARTMENT, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 FROM IDB.PATIENT JOIN IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER ON PT_MRN = CPE_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT ON PT_MRN = SSE_MRN JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE ON SSE_LOG_ID = SSP_LOG_ID WHERE 1 = 1 AND CLD_DEPT_NAME IN ('BMTMED 1275 SURVIVORSP', 'BMTMED 205 E64-LC SVR', 'BMTMED KOCH-12 SVR' ) AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 IN ('BMT', 'THR') AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 IN ('SRG', 'MED') AND SSE_SURG_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT_DATE - 1 YEAR AND CURRENT_DATE

prompt:
List of pathology reports for: 

- Hodgkin lymphoma excisional biopsy cases

- "effusion" and "lymphoma" cases

- plasma cell neoplasm or multiple myeloma cases with CD38/CD138 immunostains 

- CD34 immunostains
completion: SELECT PT_MRN AS "MRN", PT_LAST_NAME AS "Last Name", PT_FIRST_NAME AS "First Name", PT_BIRTH_DTE AS "DOB", PRPT_ACCESSION_NO AS "Path Accession Number", PRPT_REPORT AS "Path Report" FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT JOIN DV.DATE R ON R.DT_DATE_ID = PRPT_REPORT_DATE_ID JOIN DV.PATH_RPRT_TYPE_LOOKUP ON PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_CD = PRPT_REPORT_TYPE JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON PRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID WHERE CONTAINS("PRPT_REPORT", '("hodgkin lymphoma")') = 1 AND CONTAINS("PRPT_REPORT", '("lymph node")') = 1 AND R.DT_DTE >= '2017-01-01' AND PRPT_REPORT IS NOT NULL AND (PRPT_ACCESSION_NO like 'H%' OR PRPT_ACCESSION_NO like 'S%') AND (PRPT_REPORT_TYPE like '%_R' OR PRPT_REPORT_TYPE like '%_HR') ; SELECT PT_MRN AS "MRN", PT_LAST_NAME AS "Last Name", PT_FIRST_NAME AS "First Name", PT_BIRTH_DTE AS "DOB", PRPT_ACCESSION_NO AS "Path Accession Number", PRPT_REPORT AS "Path Report" FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT JOIN DV.DATE R ON R.DT_DATE_ID = PRPT_REPORT_DATE_ID JOIN DV.PATH_RPRT_TYPE_LOOKUP ON PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_CD = PRPT_REPORT_TYPE JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON PRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID WHERE CONTAINS("PRPT_REPORT", '("effusion")') = 1 AND CONTAINS("PRPT_REPORT", '("lymphoma")') = 1 AND R.DT_DTE >= '2009-01-01' AND PRPT_REPORT IS NOT NULL AND (PRPT_ACCESSION_NO like 'H%' OR PRPT_ACCESSION_NO like 'S%' OR PRPT_ACCESSION_NO like 'C%') ; SELECT PT_MRN AS "MRN", PT_LAST_NAME AS "Last Name", PT_FIRST_NAME AS "First Name", PT_BIRTH_DTE AS "DOB", PRPT_ACCESSION_NO AS "Path Accession Number", PRPT_REPORT AS "Path Report" FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT JOIN DV.DATE R ON R.DT_DATE_ID = PRPT_REPORT_DATE_ID JOIN DV.PATH_RPRT_TYPE_LOOKUP ON PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_CD = PRPT_REPORT_TYPE JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON PRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID WHERE (CONTAINS("PRPT_REPORT", '("plasma cell neoplasm")') = 1 OR CONTAINS("PRPT_REPORT", '("multiple myeloma")') = 1) AND (CONTAINS("PRPT_REPORT", '("CD38")') = 1 OR CONTAINS("PRPT_REPORT", '("CD138")') = 1) AND CONTAINS("PRPT_REPORT", '("core")') = 1 AND CONTAINS("PRPT_REPORT", '("CD34")') = 1 AND R.DT_DTE >= '2010-01-01' AND PRPT_REPORT IS NOT NULL AND (PRPT_ACCESSION_NO like 'H%' OR PRPT_ACCESSION_NO like 'S%') AND (PRPT_REPORT_TYPE like '%_R' OR PRPT_REPORT_TYPE like '%_HR') ; SELECT PT_MRN AS "MRN", PT_LAST_NAME AS "Last Name", PT_FIRST_NAME AS "First Name", PT_BIRTH_DTE AS "DOB", PRPT_ACCESSION_NO AS "Path Accession Number", PRPT_REPORT AS "Path Report" FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT JOIN DV.DATE R ON R.DT_DATE_ID = PRPT_REPORT_DATE_ID JOIN DV.PATH_RPRT_TYPE_LOOKUP ON PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_CD = PRPT_REPORT_TYPE JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON PRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID WHERE (CONTAINS("PRPT_REPORT", '("CD34")') = 1) AND CONTAINS("PRPT_REPORT", '("core")') = 1 AND CONTAINS("PRPT_REPORT", '("CD138")') = 1 AND R.DT_DTE >= '2010-01-01' AND PRPT_REPORT IS NOT NULL AND (PRPT_ACCESSION_NO like 'H%' OR PRPT_ACCESSION_NO like 'S%') AND (PRPT_REPORT_TYPE like '%_R' OR PRPT_REPORT_TYPE like '%_HR') ;

prompt: Provide a detailed list of all orders placed from 5/1/16 to 5/31/19 for these CIS orders: "Unrelated Donor Search- Preliminary" and "Unrelated Donor Search- Formal".
completion: SELECT DISTINCT OO_MRN "MRN", PT_LAST_NAME "Last Name", PT_FIRST_NAME "First Name", PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH "DOB", MAX(CASE WHEN OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'Height' THEN OUD_USER_DI_VALUE ELSE '' END) AS "Height", MAX(CASE WHEN OUD_USER_DI_CD IN('Weight', 'BMT_Weight') THEN OUD_USER_DI_VALUE ELSE '' END) AS "Weight", DOC_NAME "Requested by", OUO_ATN_PVDR_NAME "Attending MD", OUO_CURR_LOC "Location", MAX(CASE WHEN OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'BMT_Dx' THEN OUD_USER_DI_VALUE ELSE '' END) AS "Diagnosis", MAX(CASE WHEN OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'BMT_Disease_Status' THEN OUD_USER_DI_VALUE ELSE '' END) AS "Disease Status", MAX(CASE WHEN OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'BMT_Weight_Message' THEN OUD_USER_DI_VALUE ELSE '' END) AS "Weight Note", MAX(CASE WHEN OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'BMT_HLA_Typing' THEN OUD_USER_DI_VALUE ELSE '' END) AS "Patient High Resolution HLA Typing", MAX(CASE WHEN OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'BMT_Transplant' THEN OUD_USER_DI_VALUE ELSE '' END) AS "Transplant Urgency", MAX(CASE WHEN OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'BMT_CMV_Status' THEN OUD_USER_DI_VALUE ELSE '' END) AS "CMV Status", MAX(CASE WHEN OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'BMT_ABO/RH' THEN OUD_USER_DI_VALUE ELSE '' END) AS "ABO/RH", MAX(CASE WHEN OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'BMT_Sibling_Typing' THEN OUD_USER_DI_VALUE ELSE '' END) AS "Sibling HLA Typing Complete", MAX(CASE WHEN OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'BMT_Transplant_History' THEN OUD_USER_DI_VALUE ELSE '' END) AS "History of Previous Transplant", MAX(CASE WHEN OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'BMT_Search_Request_Aware' THEN OUD_USER_DI_VALUE ELSE '' END) AS "Aware of Formal Search Request", MAX(CASE WHEN OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'BMT_Cord_Transplant_Candidate' THEN OUD_USER_DI_VALUE ELSE '' END) AS "Candidate for Cord Transplant", MAX(CASE WHEN OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'BMT_URD_Mismatch' THEN OUD_USER_DI_VALUE ELSE '' END) AS "Candidate for 7/8 URD", MAX(CASE WHEN OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'BMT_Candidate_Haplo' THEN OUD_USER_DI_VALUE ELSE '' END) AS "Candidate for Haplo", MAX(CASE WHEN OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'BMT_Candidate_Auto' THEN OUD_USER_DI_VALUE ELSE '' END) AS "Candidate for Auto", MAX(CASE WHEN OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'BMT_Priority_HSC_Source' THEN OUD_USER_DI_VALUE ELSE '' END) AS "Priority HSC Source if No 8/8 URD", MAX(CASE WHEN OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'BMT_Donor_Priority' THEN OUD_USER_DI_VALUE ELSE '' END) AS "Time/Priority", MAX(CASE WHEN OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'Requested For' THEN OUD_USER_DI_VALUE ELSE '' END) AS "Requested For", OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE "Order Significant Date", OSTS_STS_DESC "Status Desc" FROM IDB.OMS_ORDER JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON OO_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_CATALOG ON OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID = OOC_MSTR_ITEM_GUID JOIN IDB.DOC ON OO_REQ_DR_NO = DOC_DR_NO JOIN IDB.OMS_STATUS ON OO_ORD_STS_CD = OSTS_ORD_STS_CD LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_USER_ORDERS ON OUO_ORD_GUID = OO_ORD_GUID LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_USER_DATA ON OUD_ORD_GUID = OO_ORD_GUID LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_PROVIDER ON OUO_PVDR_NO = OP_PVDR_NO WHERE OOC_ITEM_NAME IN ('Unrelated Donor Search- Formal') AND OSTS_ORD_STS_CD NOT IN ('CANC', 'CANP') AND OO_ENTER_DTE BETWEEN '2016-05-01' AND '2019-05-31' GROUP BY OO_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, DOC_NAME, OUO_ATN_PVDR_NAME, OUO_CURR_LOC, OSTS_STS_DESC, OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE ; SELECT DISTINCT OO_MRN "MRN", PT_LAST_NAME "Last Name", PT_FIRST_NAME "First Name", PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH "DOB", MAX(CASE WHEN OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'Height' THEN OUD_USER_DI_VALUE ELSE '' END) AS "Height", MAX(CASE WHEN OUD_USER_DI_CD IN('Weight', 'BMT_Weight') THEN OUD_USER_DI_VALUE ELSE '' END) AS "Weight", DOC_NAME "Requested by", OUO_ATN_PVDR_NAME "Attending MD", OUO_CURR_LOC "Location", MAX(CASE WHEN OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'BMT_Dx' THEN OUD_USER_DI_VALUE ELSE '' END) AS "Diagnosis", MAX(CASE WHEN OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'BMT_DateofDiagnosis' THEN OUD_USER_DI_VALUE ELSE '' END) AS "Date of Diagnosis", MAX(CASE WHEN OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'BMT_Disease_Status' THEN OUD_USER_DI_VALUE ELSE '' END) AS "Disease Status", MAX(CASE WHEN OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'BMT_Weight_Message' THEN OUD_USER_DI_VALUE ELSE '' END) AS "Weight Note", MAX(CASE WHEN OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'BMT_HLA_Typing' THEN OUD_USER_DI_VALUE ELSE '' END) AS "Patient High Resolution HLA Typing", MAX(CASE WHEN OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'BMT_Transplant' THEN OUD_USER_DI_VALUE ELSE '' END) AS "Transplant Urgency", MAX(CASE WHEN OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'BMT_Protocol_Consent' THEN OUD_USER_DI_VALUE ELSE '' END) AS "Consented IRB_16-024 (BMT/Leukemia Reg)", MAX(CASE WHEN OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'BMT_Donor_Race' THEN OUD_USER_DI_VALUE ELSE '' END) AS "Ancestry (Broad Race Category)", MAX(CASE WHEN OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'BMT_Donor_Priority' THEN OUD_USER_DI_VALUE ELSE '' END) AS "Time/Priority", MAX(CASE WHEN OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'Requested For' THEN OUD_USER_DI_VALUE ELSE '' END) AS "Requested For", OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE "Order Significant Date", OSTS_STS_DESC "Status Desc" FROM IDB.OMS_ORDER JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON OO_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_CATALOG ON OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID = OOC_MSTR_ITEM_GUID JOIN IDB.DOC ON OO_REQ_DR_NO = DOC_DR_NO JOIN IDB.OMS_STATUS ON OO_ORD_STS_CD = OSTS_ORD_STS_CD LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_USER_ORDERS ON OUO_ORD_GUID = OO_ORD_GUID LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_USER_DATA ON OUD_ORD_GUID = OO_ORD_GUID LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_PROVIDER ON OUO_PVDR_NO = OP_PVDR_NO WHERE OOC_ITEM_NAME IN ('Unrelated Donor Search- Preliminary') AND OSTS_ORD_STS_CD NOT IN ('CANC', 'CANP') AND OO_ENTER_DTE BETWEEN '2016-05-01' AND '2019-05-31' GROUP BY OO_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, DOC_NAME, OUO_ATN_PVDR_NAME, OUO_CURR_LOC, OSTS_STS_DESC, OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE

prompt: I want to find out how many emergency medicaid patients that MSK has treated, along with type of cancer
completion: WITH DX AS (SELECT TM_MRN, TM_DX_DTE, TM_HIST_CD, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS HIST_DESC, TM_SITE_CD, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_DESC, TM_BEST_AJCC_STG FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') ), COHORT AS (SELECT PT_MRN, TRIM(PT_LAST_NAME) CONCAT ',' CONCAT TRIM(PT_FIRST_NAME) PT_NAME, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, YEAR(CURRENT DATE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) AGE, CASE WHEN PT_DEATH_IND IN ('', 'A') THEN 'ALIVE' ELSE 'DECEASED' END AS PT_VITAL_STS, PT_DATE_OF_DEATH, AV_DESC PRIM_LANG, PT_STATE, PT_ZIP_CD, PT_ADDR1, PT_ADDR2, FSC_NAME, FSC_REP_CAT_NAME, INS_COMP_NAME, TM_DX_DTE, TM_HIST_CD CANCER_DX, HIST_DESC DX_DESC, TM_BEST_AJCC_STG, CASE WHEN MRN IN (SELECT TM_MRN FROM DX) THEN 'YES' ELSE 'NO' END DIAGNOSED_CANCER, CASE WHEN MRN IN (SELECT PDI_MRN FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_DMP_IDENTIFIERS WHERE PDI_CANCER_STUDY_ID LIKE '%IMPACT%') THEN 'YES' ELSE 'NO' END MSK_IMPACT FROM IDB.PATIENT JOIN DX ON PT_MRN = TM_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS ON PT_PRIMARY_LANG = AV_CODE AND AV_ELEMENT = 'PRIMARY_LANG' JOIN IDB.PATIENT_INSURANCE_V ON PT_MRN = MRN AND FSC_PRIORITY = 1 WHERE 1 = 1 AND UPPER(FSC_NAME) LIKE '%MEDICAID EMERGENCY%' ) SELECT FSC_NAME, FSC_REP_CAT_NAME, PT_VITAL_STS, PRIM_LANG, DIAGNOSED_CANCER, MSK_IMPACT, COUNT(*) VOLUME FROM COHORT GROUP BY FSC_NAME, FSC_REP_CAT_NAME, PT_VITAL_STS, PRIM_LANG, DIAGNOSED_CANCER, MSK_IMPACT

prompt: For the following years 2018 - 2023 Provide a list of the average number of patients heavier than 300 lbs. admitted each week to each inpatient unit and the average length of stay on the unit for these patients.
completion: WITH CTE AS (SELECT PMH_MRN, PMH_MEASURE_DTE, PMH_WT_KG, PMH_HT_CM, PMH_BSA, PMH_BMI, PMH_MEASURE_SYS FROM IDB.PT_MEASURES_HX WHERE PMH_WT_KG >= 136.5 AND PMH_MEASURE_DTE >= '2018-01-01' ), DTL AS (SELECT VIS_MRN, VIS_ADM_NUM, WEEK(VIS_ADM_DTE) ADM_WEEK, YEAR(VIS_ADM_DTE) ADM_YEAR, VIS_ADM_DTE, VIS_DSCH_DTE, VIS_NURS_STA NURS_STA, VIS_HOSP_SVC HOSP_SVC, VIS_DAYS_STAY DAYS_STAY, MIN(PMH_MEASURE_DTE) FIRST_MEASURE_DTE , MIN(PMH_WT_KG) WT_KG, MAX(PMH_HT_CM) HT_CM , MAX(PMH_BSA) BSA, MAX(PMH_BMI) BMI FROM IDB.VISIT JOIN CTE ON PMH_MRN = VIS_MRN AND PMH_MEASURE_DTE BETWEEN VIS_ADM_DTE AND VIS_DSCH_DTE WHERE VIS_ADM_DTE >= '2018-01-01' AND VIS_IP_OP_ADJUSTED_IND = 'I' GROUP BY VIS_VISIT_ID, VIS_MRN, VIS_ADM_NUM , VIS_ADM_DTE, VIS_DSCH_DTE, VIS_NURS_STA, VIS_HOSP_SVC, VIS_DAYS_STAY) SELECT ADM_YEAR, ADM_WEEK, NURS_STA, HOSP_SVC, AVG(DAYS_STAY) AVG_DAYS_STAY, COUNT(*) ADM_CNT, AVG(WT_KG) AVG_WT_KG FROM DTL GROUP BY ADM_YEAR, ADM_WEEK, NURS_STA, HOSP_SVC ORDER BY 1, 2, 3

prompt: Identify germ cell testicular cancer survivors meeting specified criteria.
completion: WITH CTE AS (SELECT DISTINCT TM_MRN FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.PT_FIRST_ACTV_DTL ON TM_MRN = FAD_MRN JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY ON TM_MRN = PLA_MRN JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON TM_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE TM_HIST_CD IN ('M9060/3', 'M9061/3', 'M9062/3', 'M9063/3', 'M9064/2', 'M9064/3', 'M9065/3', 'M9070/3', 'M9071/3', 'M9080/0', 'M9080/1', 'M9080/3', 'M9082/3', 'M9083/3', 'M9084/3', 'M9085/3', 'M9100/3', 'M9101/3', 'M9102/3') AND TM_CASE_STS = '3' AND MIN(COALESCE(FAD_OLD_PHM_CH_DTE, FAD_FST_PHM_CH_DTE, FAD_OLD_CHVST_DTE, FAD_FST_CHVST_DTE), COALESCE(FAD_FST_PHM_CH_DTE, FAD_OLD_CHVST_DTE, FAD_FST_CHVST_DTE, FAD_OLD_PHM_CH_DTE), COALESCE(FAD_OLD_CHVST_DTE, FAD_FST_CHVST_DTE, FAD_OLD_PHM_CH_DTE, FAD_FST_PHM_CH_DTE), COALESCE(FAD_FST_CHVST_DTE, FAD_OLD_PHM_CH_DTE, FAD_FST_PHM_CH_DTE, FAD_OLD_CHVST_DTE)) <= CURRENT DATE - 2 YEARS AND PLA_LST_CHEMO_DTE <= CURRENT DATE - 2 YEAR AND PT_DATE_OF_DEATH IS NULL ) SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT TM_MRN) FROM CTE JOIN IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER ON TM_MRN = CPE_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID WHERE CRE_RES_NAME IN ('BAJORIN, DEAN', 'BOSL, GEORGE', 'MOTZER, ROBERT', 'FELDMAN, DARREN RICHARD', 'SCHOEN, MARY') AND CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CPE_ENC_DTE >= CURRENT DATE - 18 MONTHS

completion: WITH X AS (SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN AS MRN, CPE_ENC_DTE AS "Appt Date", CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 AS "Department", CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 AS "Service", CLD_DEPT_NAME AS "Department Name", CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR, CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME AS "Visit Type", C.CRE_RES_NAME AS "Provider Name", C.CRE_RES_TYP AS "Provider Type", D.CRE_RES_NAME AS "Referring Provider Name", D.CRE_RES_TYP AS "Referring Provider Type" FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE C ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = C.CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE D ON CPE_REF_RES_ID = D.CRE_REF_SRCE_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.PAS_REFERRAL ON CPE_MRN = PRF_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE C.CRE_RES_TYP IN ('Nurse Practitioner') AND D.CRE_RES_TYP IN ('Physician') AND (CLD_DEPT_NAME LIKE '%SVP%' OR CLD_DEPT_NAME LIKE '%SURVIVORSHIP%') AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 = 'URO' AND D. CRE_REF_SRCE_ID IN ('009472', '005165', '013185', '022681', '014498', '002311', '016949', '016964', '012047', '009480') AND YEAR(CPE_ENC_DTE) IN ('2021', '2022', '2023') ) SELECT * FROM X ; WITH X AS (SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN AS MRN, CPE_ENC_DTE AS "Appt Date", CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 AS "Department", CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 AS "Service", CLD_DEPT_NAME AS "Department Name", CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR, CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME AS "Visit Type", C.CRE_RES_NAME AS "Provider Name", C.CRE_RES_TYP AS "Provider Type", D.CRE_RES_NAME AS "Referring Provider Name", D.CRE_RES_TYP AS "Referring Provider Type" FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE C ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = C.CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE D ON CPE_REF_RES_ID = D.CRE_REF_SRCE_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.PAS_REFERRAL ON CPE_MRN = PRF_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE C.CRE_RES_TYP IN ('Nurse Practitioner') AND D.CRE_RES_TYP IN ('Physician') AND (CLD_DEPT_NAME LIKE '%SVP%' OR CLD_DEPT_NAME LIKE '%SURVIVORSHIP%') AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 = 'URO' AND D. CRE_REF_SRCE_ID IN ('009472', '005165', '013185', '022681', '014498', '002311', '016949', '016964', '012047', '009480') AND YEAR(CPE_ENC_DTE) IN ('2021', '2022', '2023') ), VOLUME AS (SELECT DISTINCT "Referring Provider Name", COUNT(MRN) VOLUME_PER_MD FROM (SELECT DISTINCT MRN, "Referring Provider Name" FROM X) GROUP BY "Referring Provider Name") SELECT * FROM VOLUME ; WITH X AS (SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN AS MRN, CPE_ENC_DTE AS "Appt Date", CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 AS "Department", CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 AS "Service", CLD_DEPT_NAME AS "Department Name", CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR, CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME AS "Visit Type", C.CRE_RES_NAME AS "Provider Name", C.CRE_RES_TYP AS "Provider Type", D.CRE_RES_NAME AS "Referring Provider Name", D.CRE_RES_TYP AS "Referring Provider Type" FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE C ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = C.CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE D ON CPE_REF_RES_ID = D.CRE_REF_SRCE_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.PAS_REFERRAL ON CPE_MRN = PRF_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE C.CRE_RES_TYP IN ('Nurse Practitioner') AND D.CRE_RES_TYP IN ('Physician') AND (CLD_DEPT_NAME LIKE '%SVP%' OR CLD_DEPT_NAME LIKE '%SURVIVORSHIP%') AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 = 'URO' AND D. CRE_REF_SRCE_ID IN ('009472', '005165', '013185', '022681', '014498', '002311', '016949', '016964', '012047', '009480') AND YEAR(CPE_ENC_DTE) IN ('2021', '2022', '2023') ), VOLUME AS (SELECT DISTINCT "Referring Provider Name", COUNT(MRN) VOLUME_PER_MD FROM (SELECT DISTINCT MRN, "Referring Provider Name" FROM X) GROUP BY "Referring Provider Name") SELECT DISTINCT MRN, COUNT("Appt Date") YEARWISE_COUNT FROM (SELECT DISTINCT MRN, "Appt Date", "Provider Name" FROM X) GROUP BY MRN

prompt: Provide a list of patients with a history of HSCT and underwent a bronchoscopy
completion: WITH PTS AS (SELECT CBP_MRN MRN, CBP_TRANSPLANT_DTE HSCT_DATE FROM IDB.CRDB_BMT_PEDIATRICS WHERE CBP_TRANSPLANT_TYPE = 'ALLO' UNION SELECT DISTINCT CDD_MRN MRN, CDD_SERVICE_DTE HSCT_DATE FROM IDB.CD_DOCUMENT JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION ON CDD_MRN = CDO_MRN AND CDD_DOC_GUID = CDO_DOC_GUID WHERE CDD_DOC_NAME IN ('Cell Infusion - BMT', 'Cell Infusion - BMT/CTS') AND CDD_CANCEL_IND <> '1' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND <> '1' AND CDO_ITEM_NAME= 'Product Information: Cell Infusion Type' AND LOCATE('allo', LOWER(CDO_VALUE_TEXT)) >= 1 ) , HSCT AS (SELECT MRN, LISTAGG(DISTINCT CHAR(HSCT_DATE), '; ') HSCT_DATE FROM PTS GROUP BY MRN) , BRONCH_R AS (SELECT DISTINCT CASE_NUMBER, PATIENT_MRN, PATIENT_NAME, PATIENT_AGE , CASE_SURGERY_DTE , CASE_PRIMARY_SERVICE , CPX_PROC_NAME, CPX_PROC_TYP, CPX_PROC_CD, OCAP_PNL_NO PNL_NO, CRE_RES_NAME SURGEON FROM (SELECT DISTINCT MRN FROM PTS) JOIN IDB.PERIOP_CASE_EVENT_V ON MRN = PATIENT_MRN JOIN IDB.PATIENT_V ON PT_MRN = PATIENT_MRN JOIN IDB.OR_CASE ON OC_CASE_ID = CASE_NUMBER JOIN IDB.OR_CASE_ALL_PROC ON OC_CASE_ID = OCAP_CASE_ID JOIN IDB.OR_CASE_ALL_SURG ON OCAP_CASE_ID = OCAS_CASE_ID AND OCAS_PNL_NO = OCAP_PNL_NO AND OCAS_SURG_ROLE = 'Primary' JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CRE_RES_ID = OCAS_RES_ID JOIN IDB.OR_CL_PROC ON (OCAP_OR_PROC_ID=OCP_OR_PROC_ID) JOIN IDB.CL_PROC ON (OCP_PROC_ID=CPX_PROC_ID) WHERE CASE_SURGERY_DTE BETWEEN '2002-01-01' AND '2017-12-31' AND CASE_STATUS IN ('Completed') AND CASE_LOCATION <> 'ENDO' AND (CPX_PROC_NAME like '%BRONCHOSCOPY%' OR CPX_PROC_NAME like '%BRNCHSC%') AND YEAR(CASE_SURGERY_DTE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) < 21 ) , BRONCH AS (SELECT PATIENT_MRN, LISTAGG(DISTINCT CHAR(CASE_SURGERY_DTE), '; ') BRONCHOSCOPY_DATE FROM BRONCH_R GROUP BY PATIENT_MRN) SELECT MRN, PT_LAST_NAME LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME FIRST_NAME, HSCT_DATE, BRONCHOSCOPY_DATE FROM HSCT JOIN BRONCH ON MRN = PATIENT_MRN JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON MRN = PT_MRN

prompt: Provide specific pathology and genetic information on patients who have had ALK IHC testing.
completion: WITH PATH_INFO AS (SELECT DISTINCT "t1"."PT_MRN" AS MRN, PRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID AS PID, "t2"."DT_DTE" AS "Report Date", "t3"."PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_DESC" AS "Report Type", "t4"."DT_DTE" AS "Procedure Date", "t5"."PRPT_ACCESSION_NO" AS "Accession No" , VARCHAR(PRPT_REPORT, 32000) AS "Report Text (first 32,000 characters)" , DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)(?<=)(ALK( )*\(clone)[^\.]*', VARCHAR(PRPT_REPORT, 32000)) AS TARGET_EXTRACT , XMLCAST(XMLQUERY('fn:substring-before(fn:substring-after($x,''DIAGNOSIS:''), ''I ATTEST'')' PASSING REPLACE(VARCHAR(PRPT_REPORT, 32000), CHR(26), '') AS "x") AS VARCHAR(32000)) AS "Diagnosis Section" , XMLCAST(XMLQUERY('fn:substring-before(fn:substring-after($x,''SPECIMENS SUBMITTED:''), ''DIAGNOSIS'')' PASSING REPLACE(UPPER(VARCHAR(PRPT_REPORT, 32000)), CHR(26), '') AS "x") AS VARCHAR(32000)) AS "Specimens Submitted Section" , DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)diag[\w\W]*(?=I ATTEST)', VARCHAR(PRPT_REPORT, 32000)) AS "Diagnosis & History" FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V" "t1" LEFT JOIN DV.PATIENT_LATEST_ACTIVITY ON PLA_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = "t1"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED" "t6" ON "t1"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t6"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V" "t5" ON "t6"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t5"."PRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" "t2" ON "t5"."PRPT_REPORT_DATE_ID" = "t2"."DT_DATE_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATH_RPRT_TYPE_LOOKUP" "t3" ON "t5"."PRPT_REPORT_TYPE" = "t3"."PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_CD" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" "t4" ON "t5"."PRPT_PROCEDURE_DATE_ID" = "t4"."DT_DATE_ID" WHERE 1=1 AND CONTAINS("t5"."PRPT_REPORT", '"ALK (clone"') = 1 AND ("t2"."DT_DTE" BETWEEN '1/1/2000' AND '3/10/2021' OR "t4"."DT_DTE" BETWEEN '1/1/2000' AND '3/10/2021' ) AND "t5"."PRPT_REPORT" IS NOT NULL ) , GENE_PRE AS (SELECT DISTINCT PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID, METHOD FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_STRUCTURED_RESULTS_V JOIN PATH_INFO ON PID = PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID WHERE GENE like '%ALK%' ) , ALK_INDICATORS AS (SELECT PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID AS ALK_PID , LISTAGG(COALESCE(METHOD, '') , ', ') WITHIN GROUP ( ORDER BY METHOD) AS "ALK Panels" FROM GENE_PRE GROUP BY PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID) SELECT MRN, "Report Date", "Report Type", "Procedure Date", "Accession No" , TARGET_EXTRACT AS "Target Extract" , "Report Text (first 32,000 characters)" , "Diagnosis Section" , "Specimens Submitted Section" , "Diagnosis & History", "ALK Panels", "t1"."PT_LAST_NAME" AS "Last Name", "t1"."PT_FIRST_NAME" AS "First Name", "t1"."PT_BIRTH_DTE" AS "Date of Birth", "t1"."PT_DEATH_DTE" AS "Deceased Date", "t1"."PT_VITAL_STATUS" AS "Vital Status", "t1"."PT_SEX_DESC" AS "Gender", "t1"."PT_RACE_DESC" AS "Race" FROM PATH_INFO LEFT JOIN ALK_INDICATORS ON ALK_PID = PID JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V" "t1" ON PID = PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID ORDER BY MRN, "Report Date" ;
