prompt: Provide a breakdown of lung, Hodgkin’s lymphoma, and bladder cancer MSK patients by race/ethnicity
completion: WITH DX AS (SELECT CC_MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS ICD_EFF_DTE, CC_CLSF_CD AS ICD_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS ICD_DESC FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.CL_PAS_PATIENT ON CC_MRN = CPP_MRN WHERE SUBSTR(CC_CLSF_CD, 1, 3) IN ('162', 'C34') AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND DATE(CPP_REC_CR_DT) >= '2016-10-24' GROUP BY CC_MRN, CC_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK ) SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT PT_MRN) AS COUNT , E.AV_DESC "Ethnicity" , R.AV_DESC "Race" FROM IDB.PATIENT JOIN DX ON PT_MRN = CC_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS E ON E.AV_ELEMENT = 'PT_ETHNICITY' AND E.AV_CODE = PT_PT_ETHNICITY LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS R ON R.AV_ELEMENT = 'RACE' AND R.AV_CODE = PT_RACE GROUP BY E.AV_DESC , R.AV_DESC ORDER BY E.AV_DESC, R.AV_DESC ; WITH DX AS (SELECT CC_MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS ICD_EFF_DTE, CC_CLSF_CD AS ICD_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS ICD_DESC FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.CL_PAS_PATIENT ON CC_MRN = CPP_MRN WHERE SUBSTR(CC_CLSF_CD, 1, 3) IN ('188', 'C67') AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND DATE(CPP_REC_CR_DT) >= '2017-02-02' GROUP BY CC_MRN, CC_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK ) SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT PT_MRN) AS COUNT , E.AV_DESC "Ethnicity" , R.AV_DESC "Race" FROM IDB.PATIENT JOIN DX ON PT_MRN = CC_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS E ON E.AV_ELEMENT = 'PT_ETHNICITY' AND E.AV_CODE = PT_PT_ETHNICITY LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS R ON R.AV_ELEMENT = 'RACE' AND R.AV_CODE = PT_RACE GROUP BY E.AV_DESC , R.AV_DESC ORDER BY E.AV_DESC, R.AV_DESC ; WITH DX AS (SELECT CC_MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS ICD_EFF_DTE, CC_CLSF_CD AS ICD_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS ICD_DESC FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.CL_PAS_PATIENT ON CC_MRN = CPP_MRN WHERE SUBSTR(CC_CLSF_CD, 1, 3) IN ('201', 'C81') AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND DATE(CPP_REC_CR_DT) >= '2016-05-17' GROUP BY CC_MRN, CC_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK ) SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT PT_MRN) AS COUNT , E.AV_DESC "Ethnicity" , R.AV_DESC "Race" FROM IDB.PATIENT JOIN DX ON PT_MRN = CC_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS E ON E.AV_ELEMENT = 'PT_ETHNICITY' AND E.AV_CODE = PT_PT_ETHNICITY LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS R ON R.AV_ELEMENT = 'RACE' AND R.AV_CODE = PT_RACE GROUP BY E.AV_DESC , R.AV_DESC ORDER BY E.AV_DESC, R.AV_DESC ; WITH DX AS (SELECT CC_MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS ICD_EFF_DTE, CC_CLSF_CD AS ICD_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS ICD_DESC FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.CL_PAS_PATIENT ON CC_MRN = CPP_MRN WHERE SUBSTR(CC_CLSF_CD, 1, 3) IN ('185', 'C61') AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND DATE(CPP_REC_CR_DT) >= '2017-05-01' GROUP BY CC_MRN, CC_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK ) SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT PT_MRN) AS COUNT , E.AV_DESC "Ethnicity" , R.AV_DESC "Race" FROM IDB.PATIENT JOIN DX ON PT_MRN = CC_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS E ON E.AV_ELEMENT = 'PT_ETHNICITY' AND E.AV_CODE = PT_PT_ETHNICITY LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS R ON R.AV_ELEMENT = 'RACE' AND R.AV_CODE = PT_RACE GROUP BY E.AV_DESC , R.AV_DESC ORDER BY E.AV_DESC, R.AV_DESC ;

prompt: Please provide a weekly list of all newly diagnosed MCL patients
completion: WITH PTS AS (SELECT CC_MRN MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) DX_DTE FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE SUBSTR(CC_CLSF_CD, 1, 5) IN ('200.4', 'C83.1') AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND (CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) GROUP BY CC_MRN HAVING MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) >= CURRENT DATE - 7 DAYS UNION SELECT TM_MRN MRN, MIN(TM_DX_DTE) DX_DTE FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM H ON TM_HIST_CD = H.CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON TM_SITE_CD = S.CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND TM_HIST_CD = 'M9673/3' GROUP BY TM_MRN HAVING MIN(TM_DX_DTE) >= CURRENT DATE - 7 DAYS) , APPT AS (SELECT CPE_MRN, CRE_RES_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CPE_MRN ORDER BY APPT_CNT DESC) RN FROM (SELECT CPE_MRN, CRE_RES_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT CPE_ENC_CSN_ID) APPT_CNT FROM PTS JOIN IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER ON MRN = CPE_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CRE_RES_TYP = 'Physician' AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 = 'MED' AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 = 'LYM' GROUP BY CPE_MRN, CRE_RES_NAME )) SELECT MRN, PT_LAST_NAME LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME FIRST_NAME, DX_DTE, CRE_RES_NAME TREATING_MD FROM PTS JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN APPT ON MRN = CPE_MRN AND RN = 1

prompt: Provide MSK patients who were diagnosed positive for a dimorphic fungus from 1990-2015. For those patients provide demographic, clinical and lab results for the specified lab tests.
completion:
SELECT DISTINCT "t1"."PT_MRN" AS "MRN", "t1"."PT_LAST_NAME" AS "Last Name", "t1"."PT_FIRST_NAME" AS "First Name", "t1"."PT_BIRTH_DTE" AS "Date of Birth", "t1"."PT_SEX_DESC" AS "Gender", "t1"."PT_RACE_DESC" AS "Race", "t2"."CORE_ETHNICITY_DESC" AS "Ethnicity", "t1"."PT_VITAL_STATUS" AS "Vital Status", "t3"."PRPT_ACCESSION_NO" AS "Pathology Report", "t4"."DT_DTE" AS "Pathology Report Date", "t5"."PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_DESC" AS "Pathology Report Type", "t6"."DT_DTE" AS "Pathology Procedure Date" , CAST(SUBSTR("t3"."PRPT_REPORT", 1, 25000) AS VARCHAR(25000)) AS PATH_RPT, REPLACE(REPLACE(LTRIM(RTRIM(CAST(SUBSTR("t3"."PRPT_REPORT", 1, 25000) AS VARCHAR(25000)))), CHR(13), '
'), CHR(10), '') AS PATH_PRPT_P1 FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V" "t1" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_CORE_DEMOGRAPHICS" "t2" ON "t1"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t2"."CORE_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED" "t7" ON "t1"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t7"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V" "t3" ON "t7"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t3"."PRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" "t4" ON "t3"."PRPT_REPORT_DATE_ID" = "t4"."DT_DATE_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATH_RPRT_TYPE_LOOKUP" "t5" ON "t3"."PRPT_REPORT_TYPE" = "t5"."PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_CD" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" "t6" ON "t3"."PRPT_PROCEDURE_DATE_ID" = "t6"."DT_DATE_ID" WHERE (CONTAINS("t3"."PRPT_REPORT", '("GMS stain" | "HE stain" | "PAS stain")') = 1 AND "t3"."PRPT_REPORT" IS NOT NULL)

prompt: I would like data from the patient intake surveys (title: "Enhanced Telemedicine Patient Intake") for the MATCH-IO project in aggregate (excel) so I can conduct preliminary data analysis on the survey findings.
completion: SELECT DISTINCT EF_MRN AS MRN, EF_FORM_ID AS FORM_ID, DATE(EF_SUBMISSION_DT) AS SUBMISSION_DATE, EF_FORM_NAME AS FORM_NAME, EFI_ITEM_TEXT AS QUESTION, EFI_VALUE AS ANSWERVALUE FROM IDB.EF_FORM LEFT JOIN IDB.EF_FORM_ITEM ON EF_FORM_ID = EFI_FORM_ID WHERE EF_FORM_NAME = 'Enhanced Telemedicine Patient Intake Form' ORDER BY 3, 1, 2, 5

prompt: Smoking Cessation orders from 1/1/2015 to current date
completion: SELECT OUO_MRN AS MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, OUO_ENTER_DTE AS ORDER_DATE, OUO_ORD_NAME AS ORDER_NAME, OUO_ORD_GUID AS ORDER_GUID, OUO_STS_DESC AS ORDER_STATUS, OSH_FUNCTION_CD AS FUNCTION_CODE, AV_DESC AS FUNCTION_DESC, OSH_ORD_STS_CD AS STATUS_HX, OSH_CREATE_DTE AS FUNCTION_DATE, OSH_CREATE_DT AS FUNCTION_DT FROM IDB.OMS_USER_ORDERS JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_STS_HX ON OUO_ORD_GUID = OSH_ORD_GUID AND OUO_MRN = OSH_MRN JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON OUO_MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS ON AV_CODE = OSH_FUNCTION_CD AND AV_ELEMENT = 'FUNCTION_CD' WHERE 1=1 AND LOWER(OUO_ORD_NAME) LIKE '%smoking cessation%' AND OUO_ENTER_DTE BETWEEN '2018-01-01' AND '2021-12-31' ORDER BY OUO_ENTER_DTE, OUO_ORD_GUID, OSH_CREATE_DT

prompt: Design a Darwin on-demand report to enter a list of MRNs on protocol 16-656 and get their demographic, chemotherapy, radiation therapy and cancer dx data.
completion: SELECT DISTINCT STRIP(PT_MRN) AS MRN, STRIP(PT_LAST_NAME) || ', ' || STRIP(PT_FIRST_NAME) AS NAME, STRIP(PT_SEX) AS GENDER, STRIP(R.AV_DESC) AS "Race", STRIP(E.AV_DESC) AS "Ethnicity", PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH AS DOB, PT_DATE_OF_DEATH AS DOD, COALESCE(MAX(PLA_LST_APPT_DTE, PLA_LST_DSCH_DTE), PLA_LST_APPT_DTE, PLA_LST_DSCH_DTE) AS LAST_FU_DATE FROM IDB.PATIENT JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY ON PT_MRN = PLA_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS R ON PT_RACE = R.AV_CODE AND R.AV_ELEMENT = 'RACE' LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS E ON PT_PT_ETHNICITY = E.AV_CODE AND E.AV_ELEMENT = 'PT_ETHNICITY' WHERE 1=1 AND PT_MRN IN (#PROMPTMANY('MRN', 'STRING')#) SELECT DISTINCT STRIP(TM_MRN) AS MRN, TM_DX_DTE AS DX_DATE, TM_HIST_CD AS HIST_CODE, STRIP(H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK) AS HIST_DESC, TM_SITE_CD AS SITE_CODE, STRIP(S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK) AS SITE_DESC, STRIP(CASE WHEN TM_AJCC_7 NOT IN ('', '888', '999') THEN AJCC7.AV_DESC WHEN TM_AJCC NOT IN ('', '88', '99') THEN AJCC.AV_DESC WHEN TM_GENERAL_STG NOT IN ('', '9') THEN GS.AV_DESC WHEN TM_PATH_STG_GRP NOT IN ('', '88', '9', '99') THEN TM_PATH_STG_GRP ELSE CLIN.AV_DESC END) AS STAGE, TM_CLIN_TNM_T, TM_CLIN_TNM_N, TM_CLIN_TNM_M, TM_PATH_TNM_T, TM_PATH_TNM_N, TM_PATH_TNM_M, TM_TUMOR_SIZE FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM H ON TM_HIST_CD = H.CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON TM_SITE_CD = S.CLM_CLSF_CD LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS AJCC7 ON AJCC7.AV_ELEMENT = 'AJCC_7' AND AJCC7.AV_CODE = TM_AJCC_7 LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS AJCC ON AJCC.AV_ELEMENT = 'AJCC' AND AJCC.AV_CODE = TM_AJCC LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS GS ON GS.AV_ELEMENT = 'GENERAL_STG' AND GS.AV_CODE = TM_GENERAL_STG LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS CLIN ON CLIN.AV_ELEMENT = 'CLIN_STG_DSCR' AND CLIN.AV_CODE = TM_CLIN_STG_DSCR WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND TM_MRN IN (#PROMPTMANY('MRN', 'STRING')#) SELECT DISTINCT STRIP(RTC_TX_MRN) AS RTC_TX_MRN, RTC_TX_PLAN_NAME, RTC_PRIMARY_REF_POINT, RTC_TX_START_DTE, RTC_TX_STOP_DTE, RTC_TX_ELAPSED_DAYS, RTC_TX_PLANNED_FRACTIONS, RTC_TX_DELIVERED_FRACTIONS, RTC_TX_PLANNED_DOSE, RTC_TX_DELIVERED_DOSE, RTC_DOSE_CORRECTION FROM IDB.RADONC_TREATMENT_COURSE WHERE RTC_TX_MRN IN (#PROMPTMANY('MRN', 'STRING')#) SELECT DISTINCT STRIP(APR_MRN) AS APR_MRN, APR_GENERIC_NAME, APR_START_DTE, APR_END_DTE, APR_ROUTE, APR_ORD_RX_TYPE, APR_ORDER_SOURCE, APR_ORDER_SOURCE_ID FROM IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX_V WHERE CDG_CHEMO_FLAG = 'Y' AND APR_MRN IN (#PROMPTMANY('MRN', 'STRING')#)

prompt: Provide a weekly list of patients with Pancreatic Adenocarcinoma in the following clinics each week: Dr. Eileen O'Reilly, Dr. Anna Varghese and Dr. Wungki Park.

'2008-01-01' AND '2022-07-31' AND CBP_TRANSPLANT_TYPE = 'ALLO' ) , HCT AS (SELECT MRN, LISTAGG(COALESCE(STRIP(CAST(BMT_DATE AS VARCHAR(12000))), '') , CHR(13) || CHR(10)) WITHIN GROUP( ORDER BY MRN, BMT_DATE) AS ALLO_DATE FROM HCT1 GROUP BY MRN) , X AS (SELECT DISTINCT HCT.*, "12-245" FROM HCT LEFT JOIN (SELECT AC_MRN, MAX(CASE WHEN AC_IRB_NO = '12-245' THEN 'Y' END) AS "12-245" FROM IDB.ACCRUALS WHERE AC_IRB_NO IN ('12-245') GROUP BY AC_MRN ) AC ON HCT.MRN = AC_MRN) , AML1 AS (SELECT TM_MRN AS MRN, TM_DX_DTE AS DX_DATE, TM_HIST_CD AS DX_CODE, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS DX_DESC FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM H ON TM_HIST_CD = H.CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON TM_SITE_CD = S.CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND TM_HIST_CD IN ('M9840/3', 'M9861/3', 'M9865/3', 'M9866/3',
