AND ((CC_PT_TYPE = 'I') OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) AND CC_CLSF_CD IN ('205', '205.0', '205.00', '205.01', '205.02', '207', '207.0', '207.00', '207.01', '207.02', '207.2', '207.20', '207.21', '207.22', 'C92.0', 'C92.00', 'C92.01', 'C92.02', 'C92.4', 'C92.40', 'C92.41', 'C92.42', 'C92.5', 'C92.50', 'C92.51', 'C92.52', 'C94.0', 'C94.00', 'C94.01', 'C94.02', 'C94.2', 'C94.20', 'C94.21', 'C94.22', '206', '206.0', '206.00', '206.01', '206.02', 'C93.0', 'C93.00', 'C93.01', 'C93.02') AND CC_MRN IN (SELECT DISTINCT MRN FROM X) GROUP BY CC_MRN, CLM_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK ) , AML2 AS (SELECT MRN, LISTAGG(COALESCE(STRIP(CAST(DX_DATE AS VARCHAR(12000))), '') || ' | ' || COALESCE(STRIP(CAST(DX_CODE AS VARCHAR(12000))), '') || ' | ' || COALESCE(STRIP(CAST(DX_DESC AS VARCHAR(12000))), '') , CHR(13) || CHR(10)) WITHIN GROUP( ORDER BY MRN, DX_DATE) AS AML FROM AML1 GROUP BY MRN) , MDS1 AS (SELECT TM_MRN AS MRN, TM_DX_DTE AS DX_DATE, TM_HIST_CD AS DX_CODE, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS DX_DESC FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM H ON TM_HIST_CD = H.CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON TM_SITE_CD = S.CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND TM_HIST_CD IN ('M9989/1', 'M9989/3', 'M9975/3') AND TM_MRN IN (SELECT DISTINCT MRN FROM X) UNION SELECT CC_MRN AS MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS DX_DATE, CLM_CLSF_CD AS DX_CODE, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS DX_DESC FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND ((CC_PT_TYPE = 'I') OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) AND CC_CLSF_CD IN ('238.7', '238.72', '238.73', '238.74', '238.75', 'D46', 'D46.0', 'D46.1', 'D46.2', 'D46.20', 'D46.21', 'D46.22', 'D46.4', 'D46.9', 'D46.A', 'D46.B', 'D46.C', 'D46.Z') AND CC_MRN IN (SELECT DISTINCT MRN FROM X) GROUP BY CC_MRN, CLM_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK ) , MDS2 AS (SELECT MRN, LISTAGG(COALESCE(STRIP(CAST(DX_DATE AS VARCHAR(12000))), '') || ' | ' || COALESCE(STRIP(CAST(DX_CODE AS VARCHAR(12000))), '') || ' | ' || COALESCE(STRIP(CAST(DX_DESC AS VARCHAR(12000))), '') , CHR(13) || CHR(10)) WITHIN GROUP( ORDER BY MRN, DX_DATE) AS MDS FROM MDS1 GROUP BY MRN) , Y AS (SELECT DISTINCT X.*, AML, MDS FROM X LEFT JOIN AML2 ON X.MRN = AML2.MRN LEFT JOIN MDS2 ON X.MRN = MDS2.MRN) , IMP AS (SELECT DISTINCT Y.PT_MRN, PATIENTID, SAMPLEID, TUMOR_TYPE_NAME, TUMOR_TYPE_CODE, GENE, RESULT, LOCUS, METHOD, AA_CHANGE, NUCLEOTIDE, SEARCH_HIT1, SEARCH_HIT2, ABERRATIONTYPE, FOLD_CHANGE, GENE2 FROM DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS X JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_STRUCTURED_RESULTS_V Y ON X.PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = Y.PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID AND Y.GENE like '%TP53%' JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML DT ON PRPT_PATH_RPT_ID = PDRX_PATH_RPT_ID CROSS JOIN XMLTABLE('$c/root/*' PASSING DT.PDRX_XML_VALUE AS "c" COLUMNS SAMPLEID VARCHAR(100) PATH '../meta-data/dmp_sample_id', PATIENTID VARCHAR(100) PATH '../meta-data/dmp_patient_id', TUMOR_TYPE_CODE VARCHAR(100) PATH '../meta-data/tumor_type_code', TUMOR_TYPE_NAME VARCHAR(255) PATH '../meta-data/tumor_type_name') T WHERE Y.PT_MRN IN (SELECT DISTINCT MRN FROM Y) ) SELECT DISTINCT Y.*, PATIENTID, SAMPLEID, TUMOR_TYPE_NAME, TUMOR_TYPE_CODE, GENE, RESULT, LOCUS, METHOD, AA_CHANGE, NUCLEOTIDE, SEARCH_HIT1, SEARCH_HIT2, ABERRATIONTYPE, FOLD_CHANGE, GENE2 FROM Y JOIN IMP ON PT_MRN = MRN WHERE MDS <> '' OR AML <> ''

prompt: Provide the time from IR referral to consult to biopsy for patients with telemedicine visits and in person visits.
completion: WITH BX AS (SELECT OC_CASE_ID, OC_MRN AS MRN, OC_SURG_DTE AS BX_SCHD_DATE, OP_PROC_NAME , OP_PROC_DESC AS PROC_NAME, MD.CRE_RES_NAME AS SURGEON , OC_REC_CR_DTE CASE_CREATE_DTE, RF.CRE_RES_NAME REF_MD , OC_CASE_ID CASE_ID, OC_OR_CASE_STS CASE_STS, OC_OR_CASE_STS_CD , RTRIM(PT_LAST_NAME)||', '||RTRIM(PT_FIRST_NAME) AS PT_NAME , RM.CRE_RES_NAME AS LOCATION FROM IDB.OR_CASE ORC JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON OC_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.OR_CASE_ALL_PROC ON OC_CASE_ID = OCAP_CASE_ID JOIN IDB.OR_CASE_ALL_SURG ON OCAP_CASE_ID = OCAS_CASE_ID AND OCAS_SURG_ROLE = 'Primary' JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE MD ON OCAS_RES_ID = MD.CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.OR_PROC ON OCAP_OR_PROC_ID = OP_OR_PROC_ID JOIN IDB.OR_CL_PROC ON OP_OR_PROC_ID = OCP_OR_PROC_ID JOIN IDB.CL_PROC ON OCP_PROC_ID = CPX_PROC_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE RF ON OC_REF_RES_ID = RF.CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.OR_CASE_DX_CODES ON OCD_CASE_ID = OC_CASE_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE RM ON OC_ROOM_RES_ID = RM.CRE_RES_ID WHERE 1=1 AND OCAS_SURG_SVC = 'IR' AND OC_SURG_DTE >= '2018-01-01' AND OC_OR_CASE_STS_CD NOT IN ('2', '5') AND(UCASE(OP_PROC_NAME) LIKE '%BIOPSY%' OR UCASE(OP_PROC_NAME) LIKE '%BX%') ) , CONSULT AS (SELECT CPE_MRN AS "MRN", CPE_ENC_DTE AS "Appt Date", BX_SCHD_DATE, PROC_NAME, DAYS (BX_SCHD_DATE) - DAYS(CPE_ENC_DTE) "DAYS from consult to BX", CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 AS "Department", CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 AS "Service", CLD_DEPT_NAME AS "Department Name", CRE_RES_TYP "Provider Type", CRE_RES_NAME AS "Provider Name", CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME AS "Visit Type", CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR, CASE WHEN CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR LIKE 'TEL%' THEN 'TeleHealth' ELSE 'In Person' END "TeleHealth vs In-Person", CASE WHEN CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR LIKE 'TEL%' THEN CASE WHEN CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_1 IN ('REG', 'Reg') THEN CLD_CLD_CENTER WHEN CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_1 IN ('') THEN 'Home' END ELSE 'In Person' END "TeleHealth Location", ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY "MRN", BX_SCHD_DATE ORDER BY DAYS (BX_SCHD_DATE) - DAYS(CPE_ENC_DTE) DESC) RN FROM BX JOIN IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER ON MRN = CPE_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 = 'IR' AND (CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR like '%IR%' OR CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR like '%NV%') AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN BX_SCHD_DATE - 42 DAYS AND BX_SCHD_DATE ) , IR_REF AS (SELECT OO_MRN, OO_ORD_GUID, BX_SCHD_DATE, OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE, OO_ORD_NAME, DAYS (BX_SCHD_DATE) - DAYS(OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE) "DAYS from IR referral to biopsy", DAYS ("Appt Date") - DAYS(OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE) "DAYS from IR referral to consult", ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY OO_MRN, BX_SCHD_DATE ORDER BY DAYS ("Appt Date") - DAYS(OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE) DESC) RN FROM CONSULT JOIN IDB.OMS_ORDER ON "MRN" = OO_MRN AND RN = 1 WHERE OO_ORD_NAME IN ('IR - Referral', 'IR - Referral Protocol Biopsy') AND OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE BETWEEN "Appt Date" - 42 DAYS AND "Appt Date" AND OO_ORD_STS_CD NOT IN ('CANP', 'CANC', 'AUC3') ) , FINAL AS (SELECT B.MRN, B.BX_SCHD_DATE, B.PROC_NAME, "Appt Date", "Visit Type", "DAYS from IR referral to biopsy", "DAYS from consult to BX", "TeleHealth vs In-Person", OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE, OO_ORD_NAME, "DAYS from IR referral to consult" FROM BX B JOIN CONSULT C ON B.MRN = C."MRN" AND B.BX_SCHD_DATE = C.BX_SCHD_DATE AND C.RN = 1 JOIN IR_REF I ON C."MRN" = OO_MRN AND C.BX_SCHD_DATE = I.BX_SCHD_DATE AND I.RN = 1) SELECT * FROM FINAL; SELECT "TeleHealth vs In-Person", AVG("DAYS from IR referral to biopsy") "Avg DAYS from IR referral to biopsy", MEDIAN("DAYS from IR referral to biopsy") "Median DAYS from IR referral to biopsy", AVG("DAYS from IR referral to consult") "Avg DAYS from IR referral to consult", MEDIAN("DAYS from IR referral to consult") "Median DAYS from IR referral to consult", AVG("DAYS from consult to BX") "Avg DAYS from consult to BX", MEDIAN("DAYS from consult to BX")"Median DAYS from consult to BX" FROM FINAL GROUP BY "TeleHealth vs In-Person"

prompt: The optimal extent of resection for patients with inflammatory bowel disease (IBD) diagnosed with colorectal cancer remains uncertain. We plan to review the MSK database for patients with a diagnosis of IBD (either Crohn?s disease or ulcerative colitis) who undergo colectomy and characterize the extent of the resection and outcomes.
completion: WITH CDD1 AS (SELECT CDD_MRN, CDD_SERVICE_DTE, CDD_DOC_GUID , CDD_DOC_NAME, CDO_LARGE_VALUE_TEXT_IND , CDO_SECTION, CDO_CTLG_DISPL_NM, CDO_MSTR_ITEM_NM, CDO_ITEM_NAME , LOCATE('COLITIS', UPPER(CDO_VALUE_TEXT)) AS COLITIS , LOCATE('CROHN', UPPER(CDO_VALUE_TEXT)) AS CROHN FROM IDB.CD_DOCUMENT JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION ON CDD_MRN = CDO_MRN AND CDD_DOC_GUID = CDO_DOC_GUID AND CDO_AUTHORED_DTE = CDD_AUTHORED_DTE WHERE 1=1 AND CDD_CANCEL_IND <> '1' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND <> '1' AND(LOCATE('COLITIS', UPPER(CAST(CDO_VALUE_TEXT AS VARCHAR(32000)))) > 0 OR LOCATE('CROHN', UPPER(CAST(CDO_VALUE_TEXT AS VARCHAR(32000)))) > 0) ORDER BY CDD_DOC_NAME, CDO_LARGE_VALUE_TEXT_IND) , CDD2 AS (SELECT CDD_MRN, CASE WHEN COLITIS > 0 THEN 'Y' END AS COLITIS, CASE WHEN CROHN > 0 THEN 'Y' END AS CROHN, MIN(CDD_SERVICE_DTE) AS INIT_CDD_SERVICE_DTE FROM CDD1 GROUP BY CDD_MRN, CASE WHEN COLITIS > 0 THEN 'Y' END, CASE WHEN CROHN > 0 THEN 'Y' END) , PROCS AS (SELECT DISTINCT SSE_MRN, SSE_SURG_DTE, SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD, SSP_SURG_LAST_NM, SSP_SURG_FIRST_NM, SSP_SURG_SVC_CD, SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC, PMH_BMI FROM IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE ON SSE_LOG_ID = SSP_LOG_ID AND SSE_ENC_CSN_ID = SSP_ENC_CSN_ID JOIN CDD2 ON SSE_MRN = CDD_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.PT_MEASURES_HX ON PMH_MRN = SSE_MRN AND PMH_MEASURE_DTE = SSE_SURG_DTE WHERE SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD IN ('44157', '44158', '44204', '44205', '44206', '44207', '44208', '44210', '44211', '44212', '44211', '45113', '45123', '44158', '44239', '45110', '45111', '45112', '45114', '45116', '45119', '45120', '45121', '45395', '45397', '45499', '45500', '45505', '45550', '45562', '45563', '45999', '57250', '57300', '57305', '0184T', '45108', '45160', '45170', '45180', '45181', '45190', '45990', '49646', '44140', '44141', '44143', '44144', '44145', '44146', '44147', '44150', '44151', '44152', '44153', '44155', '44156', '44160') ) , COLORECTAL AS (SELECT TM_MRN, TM_SITE_CD, CASE WHEN TM_AJCC_7 NOT IN ('', '888', '999') THEN AJCC7.AV_DESC WHEN TM_AJCC NOT IN ('', '88', '99') THEN AJCC.AV_DESC WHEN TM_GENERAL_STG NOT IN ('', '9') THEN GS.AV_DESC WHEN TM_PATH_STG_GRP NOT IN ('', '88', '9', '99') THEN TM_PATH_STG_GRP ELSE CLIN.AV_DESC END AS BEST_STAGE, S.AV_DESC AS "SMOKING_HX", TM_FIRST_RECUR_DTE FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS S ON S.AV_ELEMENT = 'SMOKING_HX' AND S.AV_CODE = TM_SMOKING_HX JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS AJCC7 ON AJCC7.AV_ELEMENT = 'AJCC_7' AND AJCC7.AV_CODE = TM_AJCC_7 LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS AJCC ON AJCC.AV_ELEMENT = 'AJCC' AND AJCC.AV_CODE = TM_AJCC LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS GS ON GS.AV_ELEMENT = 'GENERAL_STG' AND GS.AV_CODE = TM_GENERAL_STG LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS CLIN ON CLIN.AV_ELEMENT = 'CLIN_STG_DSCR' AND CLIN.AV_CODE = TM_CLIN_STG_DSCR WHERE SUBSTR(TM_SITE_CD, 1, 3) IN ('C18', 'C19', 'C20') AND TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND TM_MRN IN (SELECT SSE_MRN FROM PROCS) ) , DYSPLASIA AS (SELECT CC_MRN, CC_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE (SUBSTR(CC_CLSF_CD, 1, 3) IN ('D12') OR CC_CLSF_CD IN ('K63.5', '211.3', '211.4')) AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND CC_MRN IN (SELECT SSE_MRN FROM PROCS) ) , CHOLANGITIS AS (SELECT CC_MRN, CC_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE CC_CLSF_CD IN ('K83.01', '576.1') AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' ) SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN "MRN", PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH "DOB", PT_SEX "SEX", R.AV_DESC AS "Race (Reg)", E.AV_DESC AS "Ethnicity (Reg)", PT_DATE_OF_DEATH "Date of Death", CASE WHEN TM_MRN IS NOT NULL THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS "Diagnosed with Colorectal Cancer", CASE WHEN D.CC_MRN IS NOT NULL THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS "Diagnosed with Dysplasia", INIT_CDD_SERVICE_DTE, COLITIS, CROHN, CASE WHEN CH.CC_CLSF_CD IS NOT NULL THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS "PSC?", "SMOKING_HX", BEST_STAGE, P.PMH_BMI "BMI", P.SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD "CPT Code", P.SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC "Procedure", P.SSE_SURG_DTE "Surg Date", TM_FIRST_RECUR_DTE "Recurrence Date" FROM IDB.PATIENT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS R ON R.AV_ELEMENT = 'RACE' AND R.AV_CODE = PT_RACE LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS E ON E.AV_ELEMENT = 'PT_ETHNICITY' AND E.AV_CODE = PT_PT_ETHNICITY JOIN CDD2 ON PT_MRN = CDD_MRN LEFT JOIN CHOLANGITIS CH ON CH.CC_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN PROCS P ON SSE_MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN COLORECTAL ON PT_MRN = TM_MRN LEFT JOIN DYSPLASIA D ON D.CC_MRN = PT_MRN

prompt:
Pathology reports of the following cases:

CLL cases

Mantle Cell Lymphoma

Marginal Zone Lymphoma 

Lymphoplasmacytic Lymphoma

B-ALL cases

Burkitt Lymphoma
completion: SELECT PT_MRN AS "MRN", PT_LAST_NAME AS "Last Name", PT_FIRST_NAME AS "First Name", PT_BIRTH_DTE AS "DOB", PRPT_ACCESSION_NO AS "Path Accession Number", PRPT_REPORT AS "Path Report" FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT JOIN DV.DATE R ON R.DT_DATE_ID = PRPT_REPORT_DATE_ID JOIN DV.PATH_RPRT_TYPE_LOOKUP ON PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_CD = PRPT_REPORT_TYPE JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON PRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID WHERE (CONTAINS("PRPT_REPORT", '("CLL")') = 1 OR CONTAINS("PRPT_REPORT", '("SLL")') = 1) AND R.DT_DTE >= '2015-01-01' AND PRPT_REPORT IS NOT NULL AND (PRPT_ACCESSION_NO like 'H%' OR PRPT_ACCESSION_NO like 'S%') AND (PRPT_REPORT_TYPE like '%_R' OR PRPT_REPORT_TYPE like '%_HR') ; SELECT PT_MRN AS "MRN", PT_LAST_NAME AS "Last Name", PT_FIRST_NAME AS "First Name", PT_BIRTH_DTE AS "DOB", PRPT_ACCESSION_NO AS "Path Accession Number", PRPT_REPORT AS "Path Report" FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT JOIN DV.DATE R ON R.DT_DATE_ID = PRPT_REPORT_DATE_ID JOIN DV.PATH_RPRT_TYPE_LOOKUP ON PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_CD = PRPT_REPORT_TYPE JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON PRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID WHERE (CONTAINS("PRPT_REPORT", '("mantle cell lymphoma")') = 1) AND R.DT_DTE >= '2015-01-01' AND PRPT_REPORT IS NOT NULL AND (PRPT_ACCESSION_NO like 'H%' OR PRPT_ACCESSION_NO like 'S%') AND (PRPT_REPORT_TYPE like '%_R' OR PRPT_REPORT_TYPE like '%_HR') ; SELECT PT_MRN AS "MRN", PT_LAST_NAME AS "Last Name", PT_FIRST_NAME AS "First Name", PT_BIRTH_DTE AS "DOB", PRPT_ACCESSION_NO AS "Path Accession Number", PRPT_REPORT AS "Path Report" FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT JOIN DV.DATE R ON R.DT_DATE_ID = PRPT_REPORT_DATE_ID JOIN DV.PATH_RPRT_TYPE_LOOKUP ON PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_CD = PRPT_REPORT_TYPE JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON PRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID WHERE (CONTAINS("PRPT_REPORT", '("marginal zone lymphoma")') = 1) AND R.DT_DTE >= '2015-01-01' AND PRPT_REPORT IS NOT NULL AND (PRPT_ACCESSION_NO like 'H%' OR PRPT_ACCESSION_NO like 'S%') AND (PRPT_REPORT_TYPE like '%_R' OR PRPT_REPORT_TYPE like '%_HR') ; SELECT PT_MRN AS "MRN", PT_LAST_NAME AS "Last Name", PT_FIRST_NAME AS "First Name", PT_BIRTH_DTE AS "DOB", PRPT_ACCESSION_NO AS "Path Accession Number", PRPT_REPORT AS "Path Report" FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT JOIN DV.DATE R ON R.DT_DATE_ID = PRPT_REPORT_DATE_ID JOIN DV.PATH_RPRT_TYPE_LOOKUP ON PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_CD = PRPT_REPORT_TYPE JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON PRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID WHERE (CONTAINS("PRPT_REPORT", '("lymphoplasmacytic lymphoma")') = 1) AND R.DT_DTE >= '2015-01-01' AND PRPT_REPORT IS NOT NULL AND (PRPT_ACCESSION_NO like 'H%' OR PRPT_ACCESSION_NO like 'S%') AND (PRPT_REPORT_TYPE like '%_R' OR PRPT_REPORT_TYPE like '%_HR') ; SELECT PT_MRN AS "MRN", PT_LAST_NAME AS "Last Name", PT_FIRST_NAME AS "First Name", PT_BIRTH_DTE AS "DOB", PRPT_ACCESSION_NO AS "Path Accession Number", PRPT_REPORT AS "Path Report" FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT JOIN DV.DATE R ON R.DT_DATE_ID = PRPT_REPORT_DATE_ID JOIN DV.PATH_RPRT_TYPE_LOOKUP ON PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_CD = PRPT_REPORT_TYPE JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON PRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID WHERE (CONTAINS("PRPT_REPORT", '("B-ALL")') = 1) AND R.DT_DTE >= '2015-01-01' AND PRPT_REPORT IS NOT NULL AND (PRPT_ACCESSION_NO like 'H%' OR PRPT_ACCESSION_NO like 'S%') AND (PRPT_REPORT_TYPE like '%_R' OR PRPT_REPORT_TYPE like '%_HR') ; SELECT PT_MRN AS "MRN", PT_LAST_NAME AS "Last Name", PT_FIRST_NAME AS "First Name", PT_BIRTH_DTE AS "DOB", PRPT_ACCESSION_NO AS "Path Accession Number", PRPT_REPORT AS "Path Report" FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT JOIN DV.DATE R ON R.DT_DATE_ID = PRPT_REPORT_DATE_ID JOIN DV.PATH_RPRT_TYPE_LOOKUP ON PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_CD = PRPT_REPORT_TYPE JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON PRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID WHERE (CONTAINS("PRPT_REPORT", '("Burkitt lymphoma")') = 1) AND R.DT_DTE >= '2015-01-01' AND PRPT_REPORT IS NOT NULL AND (PRPT_ACCESSION_NO like 'H%' OR PRPT_ACCESSION_NO like 'S%') AND (PRPT_REPORT_TYPE like '%_R' OR PRPT_REPORT_TYPE like '%_HR') ;

prompt: I am requesting an on demand report for  free text MRI data so we can parse relevant data for projects in prostate cancer (16-165/17-629)
completion: WITH RPTS AS (SELECT RRPT_MRN , RRPT_ORDER_GROUP, RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE, RRPT_ACCESSION_NO, RRPT_PROCEDURE_NAME , REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(VARCHAR(RRPT_REPORT_TXT, 32000), CHR(13)||CHR(10)||CHR(13)||CHR(10), '~`'), CHR(13)||CHR(10), ' '), '~`', CHR(13)||CHR(10)||CHR(13)||CHR(10)) AS RRPT_REPORT_TXT , VARCHAR(RRPT_REPORT_TXT, 32000) AS RRPT_REPORT_TXT_ORIG FROM DV.RADIOLOGY_REPORT_V WHERE 1=1 AND RRPT_MRN IN (#PROMPTMANY('ACC_NO')#) ) SELECT RRPT_MRN AS MRN , RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE AS "Performed Date" , RRPT_ORDER_GROUP AS "Modality" , RRPT_ACCESSION_NO AS "Accession No" , RRPT_PROCEDURE_NAME AS "Procedure Name" , DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)EXTRACAPSULAR EXTENSION[:]*[\w\W]*(?=SEMINAL)', RRPT_REPORT_TXT) EXTRACAP_STMT1 , DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)EXTRACAPSULAR EXTENSION[:]*[\w\W]*(?=SEMINAL)', VARCHAR(RRPT_REPORT_TXT_ORIG, 32000)) EXTRACAP_STMT2 , CASE WHEN LOCATE('PI-RADS', RRPT_REPORT_TXT) > 0 THEN SUBSTR(RRPT_REPORT_TXT, LOCATE('PI-RADS', RRPT_REPORT_TXT), 30) END TXT , DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)PI[\- ]?RADS[ ,]*(v)?2[.1]*[ ,]*(Category|score)[:=]?[ ,]{0,3}[\[]?([\d]|Not[ ]*applicable)', RRPT_REPORT_TXT) AS SEARCH_TEXT , DV.REGEXSTR('[\d]$', DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)PI[\- ]?RADS[ ,]*(v)?2[.1]*[ ,]*(Category|score)[:]?[ ,]{0,3}([\d]|Not[ ]*applicable)', RRPT_REPORT_TXT)) AS SEARCH_INT , DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)(?<=(P)*I)( )*(-)*(RAD)(S)*( )*(:)*( )*.*', RRPT_REPORT_TXT) AS PARSED_PI_RADS , DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)IMPRESSION[:]*[\w\W]*(?=DICTATED[ ]*BY:)', VARCHAR(RRPT_REPORT_TXT_ORIG, 32000)) AS "Impression" , RRPT_REPORT_TXT_ORIG AS "Report Text 32000 chars" FROM RPTS WHERE 1=1 ORDER BY RRPT_MRN, RRPT_ACCESSION_NO

prompt: Provide the MRNs of patients with pancreatic cancer (C25) that had surgical resection/removal, and/or any percutaneous sample of liver metastasis/metastases.
completion: SELECT DISTINCT CC_MRN PRIMARY_MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS PRI_MIN_ICD9_EFF_DTE, CC_CLSF_CD AS PRI_ICD9_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS PRI_ICD9_DESC FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE SUBSTR(CC_CLSF_CD, 1, 3) IN ('C25') AND CASE WHEN CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y' AND CC_PT_TYPE <> 'E' THEN 'Y' WHEN CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' AND YEAR(CC_EFF_DTE) < 2004 THEN 'Y' WHEN CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND YEAR(CC_EFF_DTE) < 2001 THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END = 'Y' GROUP BY CC_MRN, CC_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK

prompt: Provide a list of what beds patients are placed in within the PACU.
completion: SELECT DISTINCT OL_MRN AS MRN, CASE WHEN PT_DATE_OF_DEATH IS NULL THEN YEAR(CURRENT DATE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) END AS "Current Age", YEAR(OL_SURG_DTE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) AS "AGE AT SURGERY", OL_LOG_ID AS "LOG ID", OL_SURG_DTE AS "SURGERY DATE" , OL_PT_TYPE AS "Patient Type" , CPX_PROC_CD AS "CPT Code", OP_PROC_NAME AS "CPT Description" , CRE_RES_NAME AS "Surgeon Name", OLAS_SURG_SVC AS "Surgery Service Code" , LOC_LOC_NAME AS LOCATION , OL_PREOP_BED_LABEL , OL_PACU_BED_LABEL , OL_POSTOP_DEST , OL_PACU_LOC , PACU_IN_TIME_ACTUAL AS PACU_ADMIT_DATE_TIME , PACU_OUT_TIME_ACTUAL AS PACU_DISCH_DATE_TIME FROM IDB.OR_LOG JOIN IDB.OR_CASE ON OL_LOG_ID = OC_CASE_ID JOIN IDB.PERIOP_CASE_EVENT_V ON OL_LOG_ID = LOG_NUMBER JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON OL_MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_LOCATION ON OL_SURG_LOC_ID = LOC_LOC_ID JOIN IDB.OR_LOG_ALL_PROC ON OL_LOG_ID = OLAP_LOG_ID JOIN IDB.OR_LOG_ALL_SURG ON OL_LOG_ID = OLAS_LOG_ID AND OLAP_PNL_NO = OLAS_PNL_NO AND OLAS_SURG_ROLE = 'Primary' JOIN IDB.OR_PROC ON OLAP_OR_PROC_ID = OP_OR_PROC_ID JOIN IDB.OR_CL_PROC ON OP_OR_PROC_ID = OCP_OR_PROC_ID JOIN IDB.CL_PROC ON OCP_PROC_ID = CPX_PROC_ID JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON OLAS_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID WHERE 1=1 AND OL_SURG_DTE BETWEEN '2023-01-01' AND '2023-12-31' AND OL_LOG_STS_CD NOT IN ('4', '6') AND OL_PACU_BED_LABEL <> '' AND UPPER(OL_PACU_LOC) LIKE '%PACU%' AND UPPER(OL_PACU_LOC) NOT LIKE '%JR%' AND UPPER(OL_PACU_LOC) NOT LIKE '%KOCH%' AND UPPER(OL_PACU_LOC) NOT LIKE '%MONM%' ORDER BY OL_MRN ; SELECT DISTINCT OL_MRN AS MRN, CASE WHEN PT_DATE_OF_DEATH IS NULL THEN YEAR(CURRENT DATE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) END AS "Current Age", YEAR(OL_SURG_DTE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) AS "AGE AT SURGERY", OL_LOG_ID AS "LOG ID", OL_SURG_DTE AS "SURGERY DATE" , OL_PT_TYPE AS "Patient Type" , CPX_PROC_CD AS "CPT Code", OP_PROC_NAME AS "CPT Description" , CRE_RES_NAME AS "Surgeon Name", OLAS_SURG_SVC AS "Surgery Service Code" , LOC_LOC_NAME AS LOCATION , OL_PREOP_BED_LABEL , OL_PACU_BED_LABEL , OL_POSTOP_DEST , OL_PACU_LOC , PACU_IN_TIME_ACTUAL AS PACU_ADMIT_DATE_TIME , PACU_OUT_TIME_ACTUAL AS PACU_DISCH_DATE_TIME FROM IDB.OR_LOG JOIN IDB.OR_CASE ON OL_LOG_ID = OC_CASE_ID JOIN IDB.PERIOP_CASE_EVENT_V ON OL_LOG_ID = LOG_NUMBER JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON OL_MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_LOCATION ON OL_SURG_LOC_ID = LOC_LOC_ID JOIN IDB.OR_LOG_ALL_PROC ON OL_LOG_ID = OLAP_LOG_ID JOIN IDB.OR_LOG_ALL_SURG ON OL_LOG_ID = OLAS_LOG_ID AND OLAP_PNL_NO = OLAS_PNL_NO AND OLAS_SURG_ROLE = 'Primary' JOIN IDB.OR_PROC ON OLAP_OR_PROC_ID = OP_OR_PROC_ID JOIN IDB.OR_CL_PROC ON OP_OR_PROC_ID = OCP_OR_PROC_ID JOIN IDB.CL_PROC ON OCP_PROC_ID = CPX_PROC_ID JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON OLAS_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID WHERE 1=1 AND YEAR(OL_SURG_DTE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) BETWEEN 0 AND 17 AND OL_SURG_DTE BETWEEN '2023-01-01' AND '2023-12-31' AND OL_LOG_STS_CD NOT IN ('4', '6') AND OL_PACU_BED_LABEL <> '' AND UPPER(OL_PACU_LOC) LIKE '%PACU%' AND UPPER(OL_PACU_LOC) NOT LIKE '%JR%' AND UPPER(OL_PACU_LOC) NOT LIKE '%KOCH%' AND UPPER(OL_PACU_LOC) NOT LIKE '%MONM%' ORDER BY OL_MRN ;

prompt: Provide a list of former and current tobacco users with any appointment 6/1/18-6/1/21
completion: WITH SMOKING AS (SELECT DISTINCT TM_MRN, SM.AV_DESC SMOKING_HX, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY TM_MRN ORDER BY TM_DX_DTE DESC) RN FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.SEERGROUPING ON IDB.SEERF_ICDO(TM_SITE_CD, TM_HIST_CD) = RECODE LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS SM ON SM.AV_ELEMENT = 'SMOKING_HX' AND SM.AV_CODE = TM_SMOKING_HX AND AV_CD_STS = 'A' WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') ) , PTS AS (SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN AS "MRN", SMOKING_HX, PT_LAST_NAME LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME FIRST_NAME, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH DOB, CPP_EMAIL_ADDR EMAIL, CAV_NAME LANGUAGE, PLA_LST_APPT_DTE, CPE_ENC_DTE, CPE_CPE_APPT_STS FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN SMOKING ON TM_MRN = CPE_MRN AND RN = 1 JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON CPE_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY ON CPE_MRN = PLA_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_PAS_PATIENT ON CPE_MRN = CPP_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_CATEGORY ON CAV_CATEGORY = 'LANG' AND CPP_LANG = CAV_ABBR WHERE 1=1 AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN '2018-06-01' AND '2021-06-01' AND CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp', 'Sch') AND PT_DEATH_IND IN ('', 'A') AND PLA_DONOT_MAIL_IND <> 'Y' AND CPP_EMAIL_ADDR <> '' AND SMOKING_HX IN ('Cigarette smoker current', 'Cigar/pipe smoker current', 'Snuff/chew/smokeless current', 'Combination use current', 'Previous use') ) , NEXT_A AS (SELECT "MRN", CPE_ENC_DTE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY "MRN" ORDER BY CPE_ENC_DTE) RN FROM PTS WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS = 'Sch' ) , FINAL AS (SELECT DISTINCT P."MRN", LAST_NAME, FIRST_NAME, EMAIL, LANGUAGE, SMOKING_HX FROM PTS P LEFT JOIN NEXT_A N ON P."MRN" = N."MRN" AND RN = 1) SELECT * FROM FINAL

prompt: Provide a report of pathology cases with a diagnosis "Follicular Lymphoma" and the concurrent flow report, cytogenetics, and molecular reports.
completion: WITH X AS (SELECT DISTINCT "t1"."PT_MRN" AS "MRN", PT_LAST_NAME AS LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME AS FIRST_NAME, PT_BIRTH_DTE AS DOB, PT_SEX_DESC AS GENDER, "t2"."PRPT_ACCESSION_NO" AS "Pathology Report", "t3"."PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_DESC" AS "Pathology Report Type", PRPT_REPORT_TYPE AS REPORT_TYPE, "t4"."DT_DTE" AS "Pathology Procedure Date", "t5"."DT_DTE" AS "Pathology Report Date", UPPER(CASE WHEN LENGTH(PRPT_REPORT) <= 15000 THEN RTRIM(CAST(SUBSTR(PRPT_REPORT, 1, 15000) AS VARCHAR(15000))) ELSE CAST(SUBSTR(PRPT_REPORT, 1, 15000) AS VARCHAR(15000)) END) AS TXT, UPPER(DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)SPECIMENS SUBMITTED[\w\W]*(?=DIAGNOSIS:)', PRPT_REPORT)) AS "SPECIMENS SUBMITTED", UPPER(DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)DIAGNOSIS:[\w\W]*(?=COMMENT)', PRPT_REPORT)) AS "DIAGNOSIS" FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V" "t1" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED" "t6" ON "t1"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t6"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V" "t2" ON "t6"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t2"."PRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATH_RPRT_TYPE_LOOKUP" "t3" ON "t2"."PRPT_REPORT_TYPE" = "t3"."PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_CD" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" "t4" ON "t2"."PRPT_PROCEDURE_DATE_ID" = "t4"."DT_DATE_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" "t5" ON "t2"."PRPT_REPORT_DATE_ID" = "t5"."DT_DATE_ID" WHERE 1=1 AND CONTAINS("t2"."PRPT_REPORT", '("Follicular Lymphoma")') = 1 AND "t2"."PRPT_REPORT" IS NOT NULL AND "t4"."DT_DTE" >= '2014-01-01' AND("t2"."PRPT_ACCESSION_NO" LIKE 'H%' OR "t2"."PRPT_ACCESSION_NO" LIKE 'S%') ) , Y AS (SELECT DISTINCT "t1"."PT_MRN" AS "MRN", PT_LAST_NAME AS LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME AS FIRST_NAME, PT_BIRTH_DTE AS DOB, PT_SEX_DESC AS GENDER, "t2"."PRPT_ACCESSION_NO" AS "Pathology Report", "t3"."PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_DESC" AS "Pathology Report Type", PRPT_REPORT_TYPE AS REPORT_TYPE, "t4"."DT_DTE" AS "Pathology Procedure Date", "t5"."DT_DTE" AS "Pathology Report Date", UPPER(CASE WHEN LENGTH(PRPT_REPORT) <= 15000 THEN RTRIM(CAST(SUBSTR(PRPT_REPORT, 1, 15000) AS VARCHAR(15000))) ELSE CAST(SUBSTR(PRPT_REPORT, 1, 15000) AS VARCHAR(15000)) END) AS TXT, UPPER(DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)SPECIMENS SUBMITTED[\w\W]*(?=DIAGNOSIS:)', PRPT_REPORT)) AS "SPECIMENS SUBMITTED", UPPER(DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)DIAGNOSIS:[\w\W]*(?=COMMENT)', PRPT_REPORT)) AS "DIAGNOSIS" FROM X LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V" "t1" ON "t1"."PT_MRN" = MRN LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED" "t6" ON "t1"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t6"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V" "t2" ON "t6"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t2"."PRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATH_RPRT_TYPE_LOOKUP" "t3" ON "t2"."PRPT_REPORT_TYPE" = "t3"."PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_CD" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" "t4" ON "t2"."PRPT_PROCEDURE_DATE_ID" = "t4"."DT_DATE_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" "t5" ON "t2"."PRPT_REPORT_DATE_ID" = "t5"."DT_DATE_ID" WHERE 1=1 AND "t2"."PRPT_REPORT" IS NOT NULL AND "t4"."DT_DTE" >= '2014-01-01' AND((("t2"."PRPT_ACCESSION_NO" LIKE 'F%' AND "t4"."DT_DTE" BETWEEN "Pathology Procedure Date" - 3 DAYS AND "Pathology Procedure Date" + 3 DAYS) OR (("t2"."PRPT_ACCESSION_NO" LIKE 'M%' OR "t2"."PRPT_ACCESSION_NO" LIKE 'CG%') AND "t4"."DT_DTE" BETWEEN "Pathology Procedure Date" - 14 DAYS AND "Pathology Procedure Date" + 14 DAYS))) ) , Z AS (SELECT * FROM X UNION SELECT * FROM Y) SELECT Z.* FROM Z JOIN IDB.ACCRUALS ON MRN = AC_MRN AND AC_IRB_NO IN ('13-037', '06-107', '12-245', '09-141')

prompt: Requesting Clear cell Sarcoma from pathology report from the last 5 years.
completion: WITH PATHOLOGY_RESULTS AS (SELECT PRPT_MRN , PRPT_ACCESSION_NO , PRPT_REPORT_DTE , PRPT_PROCEDURE_DTE , PRPT_REPORT_TYPE_DESC , TRIM(DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)(?<=(^|[\.]))[^\.]*(clear cell sarcoma)[^\.]*', PRPT_REPORT)) AS TARGET_EXTRACT , VARCHAR(PRPT_REPORT, 32000) AS REPORT_TEXT FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V WHERE 1 = 1 AND CONTAINS(PRPT_REPORT, '"clear cell sarcoma"') = 1 AND PRPT_REPORT IS NOT NULL), ENCOUNTER_DATA AS (SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN, CPE_ENC_DTE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CPE_MRN ORDER BY CPE_ENC_DTE) AS ROW_NUMBER FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 = 'MED' AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 = 'SAR' AND CRE_RES_TYP = 'Physician' AND CPE_ENC_DTE >= CURRENT date - 5 YEARS ORDER BY 1, 2), RESULTS AS (SELECT PRPT_MRN , PRPT_ACCESSION_NO , PRPT_PROCEDURE_DTE , ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY PRPT_MRN ORDER BY PRPT_PROCEDURE_DTE DESC) AS ROW_NUMBERS , PRPT_REPORT_TYPE_DESC , REPORT_TEXT , CPE_ENC_DTE FROM PATHOLOGY_RESULTS JOIN ENCOUNTER_DATA ON PRPT_MRN = CPE_MRN WHERE ROW_NUMBER = 1) SELECT PRPT_MRN, PRPT_ACCESSION_NO, PRPT_PROCEDURE_DTE, PRPT_REPORT_TYPE_DESC, REPORT_TEXT, CPE_ENC_DTE FROM RESULTS WHERE ROW_NUMBERS = 1 ;

prompt: Weekly List  of Patient Info for the following week's visits with specific providers and NPs
completion: SELECT CPE_MRN AS "MRN", TRIM(PT_LAST_NAME) || ', ' || TRIM(PT_FIRST_NAME) AS "Patient Name", CPE_ENC_DTE AS "Appt Date", CPE_APPT_DT AS "Appt Time", CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 AS "Department", CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 AS "Service", CLD_DEPT_NAME AS "Department Name", CRE_RES_NAME AS "Provider Name", CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME AS "Visit Type", CVT_EXT_NAME AS "Visit Type External" FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PT_MRN = CPE_MRN WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Sch') AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT date + 3 DAYS AND CURRENT date + 10 DAYS AND (CRE_RES_NAME LIKE '%POSTOW%NURSE%' OR CRE_RES_NAME LIKE '%LEZCAN%NURSE%' OR CRE_RES_NAME LIKE '%SHOUSHTARI%NURSE%' OR CRE_RES_NAME LIKE '%SMITHY%NURSE%' OR CRE_RES_NAME LIKE '%MOMTAZ%NURSE%' OR CRE_RES_NAME LIKE '%ARIYAN%NURSE%' OR CRE_RES_NAME LIKE '%BELLO%NURSE%' OR CRE_RES_NAME LIKE '%BRADY%NURSE%' OR CRE_RES_NAME LIKE '%COIT%NURSE%' OR CRE_RES_NAME LIKE '%BARKERNURSE%NURSE%' OR CRE_RES_NAME LIKE '%ZHAN%NURSE%' OR CRE_RES_NAME LIKE '%CHENYANG%NURSE%' OR CRE_RES_NAME LIKE '%HALPERN%NURSE%' OR CRE_RES_NAME LIKE '%ROTEMBERG%NURSE%' OR CRE_RES_NAME LIKE '%BUSAM%NURSE%' OR CRE_RES_NAME LIKE '%LEZCANO%NURSE%' OR CRE_RES_NAME LIKE '%MOY%ANDREA%NURSE%' OR CRE_RES_NAME LIKE '%KLEBANOFF%NURSE%' OR CRE_RES_NAME LIKE '%BARTLETT%NURSE%' OR CRE_RES_NAME LIKE '%KLEBANOFF%NURSE%' OR CRE_RES_NAME LIKE '%BARKER%NURSE%' OR CRE_RES_ID IN ('018150' , '020453', '030080', '020420', '014514' , '024430', '024448' , '51287' , '001404', '016584' , '028936', '006734', '024547' , '009506', '022673', '025122' , '022103') ) ; WITH APPT AS (SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN AS PT_MRN FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID WHERE 1=1 AND CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Sch') AND CRE_RES_TYP IN ('Nurse', 'Provider', 'Nurse Practitioner') AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT date + 3 DAYS AND CURRENT date + 10 DAYS AND (CRE_RES_NAME LIKE '%POSTOW%NURSE%' OR CRE_RES_NAME LIKE '%LEZCAN%NURSE%' OR CRE_RES_NAME LIKE '%SHOUSHTARI%NURSE%' OR CRE_RES_NAME LIKE '%SMITHY%NURSE%' OR CRE_RES_NAME LIKE '%MOMTAZ%NURSE%' OR CRE_RES_NAME LIKE '%ARIYAN%NURSE%' OR CRE_RES_NAME LIKE '%BELLO%NURSE%' OR CRE_RES_NAME LIKE '%BRADY%NURSE%' OR CRE_RES_NAME LIKE '%COIT%NURSE%' OR CRE_RES_NAME LIKE '%BARKERNURSE%NURSE%' OR CRE_RES_NAME LIKE '%ZHAN%NURSE%' OR CRE_RES_NAME LIKE '%CHENYANG%NURSE%' OR CRE_RES_NAME LIKE '%HALPERN%NURSE%' OR CRE_RES_NAME LIKE '%ROTEMBERG%NURSE%' OR CRE_RES_NAME LIKE '%BUSAM%NURSE%' OR CRE_RES_NAME LIKE '%LEZCANO%NURSE%' OR CRE_RES_NAME LIKE '%MOY%ANDREA%NURSE%' OR CRE_RES_NAME LIKE '%KLEBANOFF%NURSE%' OR CRE_RES_NAME LIKE '%BARTLETT%NURSE%' OR CRE_RES_NAME LIKE '%KLEBANOFF%NURSE%' OR CRE_RES_NAME LIKE '%BARKER%NURSE%' OR CRE_RES_ID IN ('018150' , '020453', '030080', '020420', '014514' , '024430', '024448' , '51287' , '001404', '016584' , '028936', '006734', '024547' , '009506', '022673', '025122' , '022103') ) ) SELECT PT_MRN, TM_DX_DTE AS CDB_DX_DATE, TM_HIST_CD AS HISTOLOGY_CODE, HIST_DESC AS HISTOLOGY_DESC, TM_SITE_CD AS SITE_CODE, SITE_DESC, MIN_ICD9_EFF_DTE AS MIN_ICD_DATE, ICD9_CD, ICD9_DESC FROM APPT LEFT JOIN (SELECT TM_MRN, AV_DESC AS CASE_STS, TM_DX_DTE, TM_HIST_CD, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS HIST_DESC, TM_SITE_CD, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_DESC FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS ON AV_ELEMENT = 'CASE_STS' AND AV_CODE = TM_CASE_STS JOIN IDB.SEERGROUPING ON IDB.SEERF_ICDO(TM_SITE_CD, TM_HIST_CD) = RECODE AND CATEGORY2 ='Melanoma of the Skin' WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') ) AS CDB ON TM_MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN (SELECT CC_MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS MIN_ICD9_EFF_DTE, CC_CLSF_CD AS ICD9_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS ICD9_DESC FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE (SUBSTR(CC_CLSF_CD, 1, 3) BETWEEN 'C00' AND 'D49' OR SUBSTR(CC_CLSF_CD, 1, 3) BETWEEN '140' AND '239') AND (CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK LIKE '%MELANOMA%' OR CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK LIKE '%SKIN%') AND CASE WHEN CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y' AND CC_PT_TYPE <> 'E' THEN 'Y' WHEN CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' AND YEAR(CC_EFF_DTE) < 2004 THEN 'Y' WHEN CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND YEAR(CC_EFF_DTE) < 2001 THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END = 'Y' GROUP BY CC_MRN, CC_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK ) AS ICD9 ON CC_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE COALESCE(TM_MRN, CC_MRN) IS NOT NULL ;

prompt: List of all HNSCC patients, 18 years of age or older, scheduled to see NYC HNS MDs who have completed RT
completion: WITH APPT AS (SELECT CPE_MRN, TRIM(PT_LAST_NAME) || ', ' || TRIM(PT_FIRST_NAME) AS PT_NAME, CPE_ENC_DTE, YEAR(CPE_ENC_DTE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) AS AGE, CPE_APPT_DT, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8, CLD_DEPT_NAME, CRE_RES_NAME, CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PT_MRN = CPE_MRN WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS ='Sch' AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 = 'HNS' AND CRE_RES_TYP IN ('Physician', 'PhD', 'Physician Assistant') AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_1 NOT IN ('REG', 'Reg') AND YEAR(CPE_ENC_DTE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) >= 18 AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT DATE + 1 DAY AND CURRENT DATE + 3 DAYS ) , APT_DT AS (SELECT MIN (CPE_ENC_DTE) AS NEXT_APPT FROM APPT WHERE CPE_ENC_DTE > CURRENT DATE ) , REP AS (SELECT A.* FROM APPT A JOIN APT_DT ON NEXT_APPT = CPE_ENC_DTE) , DX AS (SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN AS DX_MRN FROM REP LEFT JOIN (SELECT TM_MRN, TM_SITE_CD FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND TM_SITE_CD IN ('C020', 'C021', 'C022', 'C023', 'C024', 'C028', 'C029', 'C030', 'C031', 'C039', 'C040', 'C041', 'C048', 'C049', 'C050', 'C059', 'C060', 'C061', 'C062', 'C068', 'C069', 'C079', 'C080', 'C081', 'C088', 'C089' ) ) ON TM_MRN = CPE_MRN LEFT JOIN (SELECT CC_MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS MIN_ICD9_EFF_DTE, CC_CLSF_CD AS ICD9_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS ICD9_DESC FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE 1=1 AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND (CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) AND CC_CLSF_CD IN ('C01.9', 'C02.4', 'C05.1', 'C05.2', 'C09.0', 'C09.1', 'C09.8', 'C09.9', 'C10.0', 'C10.2', 'C10.3', 'C10.8', 'C10.9', 'C11.1', '142', '142', '142.1', '142.2', '142.8', '142.9', '210.2', 'C02.0', 'C02.1', 'C02.2', 'C02.3', 'C02.8', 'C02.9', 'C03.0', 'C03.1', 'C03.9', 'C04.0', 'C04.1', 'C04.8', 'C04.9', 'C06.0', 'C06.1', 'C05.0', 'C05.8', 'C05.9', 'C06.2', 'C06.80', 'C06.89', 'C06.9') GROUP BY CC_MRN, CC_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK ) ON CC_MRN = CPE_MRN WHERE COALESCE(TM_MRN, CC_MRN) IS NOT NULL ) , RAD AS (SELECT RTC_TX_MRN, RTC_TX_START_DTE, RTC_TX_STOP_DTE, RTC_TX_PLAN_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY RTC_TX_MRN ORDER BY RTC_TX_START_DTE DESC) AS RAD_1, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY RTC_TX_MRN ORDER BY RTC_TX_STOP_DTE DESC) AS RAD_2 FROM IDB.RADONC_TREATMENT_COURSE JOIN REP ON CPE_MRN = RTC_TX_MRN AND RTC_TX_STOP_DTE < CPE_ENC_DTE) SELECT CPE_MRN AS MRN, PT_NAME AS "Patient Name", CPE_APPT_DT AS "Appt Time", AGE AS "Age as of Appt Date", CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 AS "Department", CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 AS "Service", CLD_DEPT_NAME AS "Department Name", CRE_RES_NAME AS "Provider Name", CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME AS "Visit Type", CASE WHEN DX_MRN IS NOT NULL THEN 'Y' END AS "Diagnosis Flag", CASE WHEN RTC_TX_MRN IS NOT NULL THEN 'Y' END AS "Radiation Flag" FROM REP LEFT JOIN DX ON DX_MRN = CPE_MRN LEFT JOIN RAD ON RTC_TX_MRN = CPE_MRN AND RAD_2 = 1 ; WITH APPT AS (SELECT CPE_MRN, TRIM(PT_LAST_NAME) || ', ' || TRIM(PT_FIRST_NAME) AS PT_NAME, CPE_ENC_DTE FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PT_MRN = CPE_MRN WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS ='Sch' AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 = 'HNS' AND CRE_RES_TYP IN ('Physician', 'PhD', 'Physician Assistant') AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_1 NOT IN ('REG', 'Reg') AND YEAR(CPE_ENC_DTE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) >= 18 AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT DATE + 1 DAY AND CURRENT DATE + 3 DAYS ) , APT_DT AS (SELECT MIN (CPE_ENC_DTE) AS NEXT_APPT FROM APPT WHERE CPE_ENC_DTE > CURRENT DATE ) SELECT CPE_MRN AS MRN, CPE_ENC_DTE AS APPOINTMENT_DATE, RTC_TX_START_DTE AS RADIATON_START_DATE, RTC_TX_STOP_DTE AS RADIATION_STOP_DATE, RTC_TX_PLAN_NAME AS RADIATION_SITE FROM APPT JOIN APT_DT ON NEXT_APPT = CPE_ENC_DTE JOIN IDB.RADONC_TREATMENT_COURSE R ON CPE_MRN = RTC_TX_MRN AND RTC_TX_STOP_DTE < NEXT_APPT ;

prompt: Provide a weekly report of patients with colorectal cancer with ERBB2 amplification and RAS wildtype.
completion: SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN MRN, PT_BIRTH_DTE DOB, PT_FIRST_NAME FIRST, PT_LAST_NAME LAST, PRIMARY_SITE, TUMOR_TYPE_NAME, PDWS_NAME TEST_NAME FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML INNER JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT ON PDRX_PATH_RPT_ID = PRPT_PATH_RPT_ID LEFT JOIN DV.DATE DTRPT ON PRPT_REPORT_DATE_ID = DTRPT.DT_DATE_ID LEFT JOIN DV.DATE DTPROCPATHRPT ON PRPT_PROCEDURE_DATE_ID = DTPROCPATHRPT.DT_DATE_ID INNER JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML_SETTINGS ON PDRX_PATH_DMP_RESULTS_XML_ID = PDRXS_PATH_DMP_RESULTS_XML_ID INNER JOIN DVDMC.PATHOLOGY_DMP_WEBSVC_SETTINGS ON PDRXS_SETTING_ID = PDWS_SETTING_ID INNER JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON PDRX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID, XMLTABLE('$c/root/*' PASSING PDRX_XML_VALUE AS "c" COLUMNS TOTAL_NUMBER_VARIANTS int PATH 'count(../*[not(name()=''meta-data'')])', VARIANT_CLASS VARCHAR(100) PATH 'variant_class', GENE_ID VARCHAR(100) PATH 'gene_id', GENE_FOLD_CHANGE VARCHAR(100) PATH 'gene_fold_change', VARIANT_TYPE VARCHAR(100) PATH './local-name(.)', TUMOR_TYPE_CODE VARCHAR(100) PATH '../meta-data/tumor_type_code', TUMOR_TYPE_NAME VARCHAR(255) PATH '../meta-data/tumor_type_name', PRIMARY_SITE VARCHAR(255) PATH '../meta-data/primary_site') T JOIN (SELECT T.TUMOR_TYPE_CODE TTC FROM TABLE(DV.ONCOTREE_CHILDREN('BOWEL')) T) X ON T.TUMOR_TYPE_CODE = X.TTC WHERE GENE_ID = 'ERBB2' AND GENE_FOLD_CHANGE > 0 AND VARIANT_TYPE <> 'meta-data' AND PT_MRN NOT IN (SELECT A.PT_MRN FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_STRUCTURED_RESULTS_V A JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS B ON A.PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = B.PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID WHERE GENE IN ('KRAS', 'NRAS') OR GENE2 IN ('KRAS', 'NRAS') )

prompt: Request a list of patient names, date of birth, and MRN of pediatric patients enrolled in IRB protocols 12-245 and 19-133 for the past 5 years
completion: WITH PATIENT AS (SELECT PT_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH FROM IDB.PATIENT), ENCOUNTER AS (SELECT CPE_MRN, CPE_ENC_DTE, CPE_ENC_TYP_TTL, CPE_DEPT_ID FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER CPE WHERE CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN '2017-01-01' AND '2022-08-01' ), DEBT AS (SELECT CLD_DEPT_NAME, CLD_DEPT_ID, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 FROM IDB.CL_DEPT WHERE CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 = 'PED' ), ACCRUALS AS (SELECT AC_MRN, AC_IRB_NO, AC_CONS_DTE FROM IDB.ACCRUALS WHERE AC_IRB_NO IN ('12-245', '19-133') AND AC_CONS_DTE IS NOT NULL ) SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN AS "Patient MRN", PT_LAST_NAME AS "Last Name", PT_FIRST_NAME AS "First Name", PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH AS "Patient Date of Birth", YEAR (Date (CPE_ENC_DTE) - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) AS "Age", AC_IRB_NO AS "IRB Protocol Number ", CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 AS "Department", AC_CONS_DTE AS "Consent Date" FROM ENCOUNTER AS E JOIN PATIENT AS P ON E.CPE_MRN = P.PT_MRN JOIN ACCRUALS AS C ON E.CPE_MRN = C.AC_MRN JOIN DEBT AS D ON E.CPE_DEPT_ID = D.CLD_DEPT_ID WHERE YEAR (Date (CPE_ENC_DTE) - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) BETWEEN '0' AND '21'

prompt: Time from NV date to OR date for all the attendings in the Head and Neck service from 2010 to 2014
completion: WITH "cte1" AS (SELECT * FROM DV.ENCOUNTER_SCHD_RESOURCES WHERE ENSR_PRIMARY_RES_IND = 'Y' ), "cte2" AS (SELECT EDC_DEPT_ABBREV, EDC_DEPT_DESC FROM DV.ENCOUNTER_DESC_CATALOG WHERE EDC_GROUP_ID = 'STS' ), "cte3" AS (SELECT UPPER(MP_FULL_NM) MP_FULL_NM_UPPER, M.* FROM DV.MEDPRO_V M), "cte4" AS (SELECT DXCC_DX_CATALOG_ID, LTRIM(RTRIM(DXCC_ICD_CODE)) DXCC_ICD_CODE, LTRIM(RTRIM(DXCC_ICD_MSK_DESC)) DXCC_ICD_MSK_DESC, LTRIM(RTRIM(DXCC_ICD_CODE)) || ' - ' || LTRIM(RTRIM(DXCC_ICD_MSK_DESC)) AS DXCC_CODE_AND_MSK_DESC, LTRIM(RTRIM(DXCC_ICD_NATIONAL_DESC)) DXCC_ICD_NATIONAL_DESC, DXCC_DESC_LONG, CASE WHEN DXCC_ICD_CODE BETWEEN '196' AND '196.99' OR DXCC_ICD_CODE BETWEEN '197' AND '197.99' OR DXCC_ICD_CODE BETWEEN '198' AND '198.99' THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS DXCC_METS_INDICATOR, DXCC_CREATED_DT, DXCC_CREATED_BY, DXCC_MODIFIED_DT FROM DV.DIAGNOSIS_CATALOG WHERE DXCC_DX_TYPE = 'ICD9' ) SELECT DISTINCT "t1"."PT_MRN" AS "MRN", "t2"."DT_DTE" AS "Encounter Date", "t3"."ENVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR" AS "Visit Type Abbrev", "t4"."ENR_RES_NAME" AS "Primary Resource Name", "t5"."ENDP_DEPT_NAME" AS "Department Name", CASE WHEN "t3"."ENVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR" like '%NV%' THEN 'New Visit' WHEN "t3"."ENVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR" like '%IR%' THEN 'Internal Referral' ELSE 'Non-New Visit/Interal Referral' END AS "New Visit/Internal Referral Indicator", "t2"."DT_YEAR" AS "Encounter Year", "t6"."PCC_CODE" AS "CPT Procedure Code (OR)", "t6"."PCC_DESC" AS "CPT Procedure Desc (OR)", "t7"."MP_FULL_NM_UPPER" AS "CPT Procedure Physician (OR)", "t7"."MP_SERVICE_DESC" AS "CPT Physician Service (OR)", "t8"."DT_DTE" AS "CPT Procedure Date (OR)", "t8"."DT_YEAR" AS "CPT Procedure Year (OR)", "t9"."DXCC_ICD_CODE" AS "ICD-9 Final Dx Code", "t9"."DXCC_ICD_MSK_DESC" AS "ICD-9 Final Dx Description" FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V" "t1" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED" "t10" ON "t1"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t10"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_ENCOUNTER" "t11" ON "t10"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t11"."PENC_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" "t2" ON "t11"."PENC_ENC_DATE_ID" = "t2"."DT_DATE_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."ENCOUNTER_VISIT_TYPE" "t3" ON "t11"."PENC_VISIT_TYPE_ID" = "t3"."ENVT_ENC_VISIT_TYPE_ID" LEFT JOIN "cte1" "t12" ON "t11"."PENC_PT_ENC_ID" = "t12"."ENSR_PT_ENC_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."ENCOUNTER_RESOURCE" "t4" ON "t12"."ENSR_RES_ID" = "t4"."ENR_ENC_RES_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."ENCOUNTER_DEPARTMENT" "t5" ON "t11"."PENC_DEPT_ID" = "t5"."ENDP_ENC_DEPT_ID" LEFT JOIN "cte2" "t13" ON "t11"."PENC_APPT_STS" = "t13"."EDC_DEPT_ABBREV" LEFT JOIN "DV"."CPT_OR_PATIENT_PROCEDURE" "t6" ON "t10"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t6"."PTX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "cte3" "t7" ON "t6"."PTX_MEDPRO_ID" = "t7"."MP_MEDPRO_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" "t8" ON "t6"."PTX_PROC_DATE_ID" = "t8"."DT_DATE_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DIAGNOSIS_FINAL_ALL_V" "t14" ON "t10"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t14"."PDX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "cte4" "t9" ON "t14"."PDX_DX_CATALOG_ID" = "t9"."DXCC_DX_CATALOG_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" "t15" ON "t14"."PDX_DX_DATE_ID" = "t15"."DT_DATE_ID" WHERE (CASE WHEN "t3"."ENVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR" like '%NV%' THEN 'New Visit' WHEN "t3"."ENVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR" like '%IR%' THEN 'Internal Referral' ELSE 'Non-New Visit/Interal Referral' END IN ('Internal Referral', 'New Visit') AND ("t4"."ENR_RES_TYP" IN ('PhD', 'Physician') AND ("t5"."ENDP_SERVICE_SPECIALTY_GRP_8" = 'HNS' AND ("t5"."ENDP_SERVICE_DEPT_GRP_6" = 'SRG' AND ("t2"."DT_YEAR" BETWEEN 2010 AND 2014 AND (CASE WHEN "t13"."EDC_DEPT_DESC"IN ('Arrived', 'Completed') THEN 'Completed' WHEN "t13"."EDC_DEPT_DESC" IN ('Scheduled') THEN 'Scheduled' ELSE 'Non-Completed/Scheduled' END = 'Completed' AND ("t7"."MP_SERVICE_DESC" IN ('HEAD & NECK', 'HEAD & NECK - CLINIC') AND ("t14"."DXA_CIC_CDER_INIT" = 'YES' AND (((("t8"."DT_DTE" BETWEEN '2010-1-1' AND '2014-3-31' AND "t2"."DT_DTE" BETWEEN '2010-1-1' AND '2014-3-31') AND "t8"."DT_DTE" >= "t2"."DT_DTE" + 1 DAYS) AND "t15"."DT_DTE" BETWEEN '2010-1-1' AND '2014-3-31') AND ABS(TIMESTAMPDIFF(16, CHAR(TIMESTAMP(CASE WHEN (TIMESTAMP("t8"."DT_DTE", '00:00:00') <= TIMESTAMP("t2"."DT_DTE", '00:00:00')) THEN "t8"."DT_DTE" ELSE "t2"."DT_DTE" END + (ABS(TIMESTAMPDIFF(16, CHAR(TIMESTAMP("t8"."DT_DTE", '00:00:00') - TIMESTAMP("t2"."DT_DTE", '00:00:00'))))/2) DAYS, '00:00:00') - TIMESTAMP("t15"."DT_DTE", '00:00:00')))) <= 0)))))))))

prompt: Identify patients with breast cancer and CML.
completion: WITH "cte1" AS (SELECT PRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID AS PATH_DEID, "t5"."DT_DTE" AS "Pathology Report Date", "t2"."PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_DESC" AS "Pathology Report Type", "t4"."PRPT_ACCESSION_NO" AS "Pathology Report" FROM "DV"."PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V" "t4" JOIN "DV"."PATH_RPRT_TYPE_LOOKUP" "t2" ON "t4"."PRPT_REPORT_TYPE" = "t2"."PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_CD" JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" "t5" ON "t4"."PRPT_REPORT_DATE_ID" = "t5"."DT_DATE_ID" WHERE CONTAINS("PRPT_DEID_REPORT", '("t(16%" | "t (16%" | (("inv(16%" | ' || '"inv (16%") & NOT "did not reveal an inv(16)" & NOT "did not detect an inv(16)" & NOT "did not detect an inversion 16") | ' || '"t(8;21)%" | "t (8;21)%")') <> 0 ), CKIT AS (SELECT DISTINCT PRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID AS CKIT_DEID FROM "DV"."PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V" JOIN "DV"."MOLECULAR_DX_PATH_REPORT_ANNOTATIONS_V" "t6" ON "PRPT_PATH_RPT_ID" = "MDPRA_PRPT_PATH_RPT_ID" WHERE "t6"."MDPRA_GENE" IN ('AML1-ETO', 'KIT') AND "t6"."MDPRA_RESULT" = 'POSITIVE' ), "cte2" AS (SELECT DXCC_DX_CATALOG_ID, LTRIM(RTRIM(DXCC_ICD_CODE)) DXCC_ICD_CODE, LTRIM(RTRIM(DXCC_ICD_MSK_DESC)) DXCC_ICD_MSK_DESC, LTRIM(RTRIM(DXCC_ICD_CODE)) || ' - ' || LTRIM(RTRIM(DXCC_ICD_MSK_DESC)) AS DXCC_CODE_AND_MSK_DESC, LTRIM(RTRIM(DXCC_ICD_NATIONAL_DESC)) DXCC_ICD_NATIONAL_DESC, DXCC_DESC_LONG, CASE WHEN DXCC_ICD_CODE BETWEEN '196' AND '196.99' OR DXCC_ICD_CODE BETWEEN '197' AND '197.99' OR DXCC_ICD_CODE BETWEEN '198' AND '198.99' THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS DXCC_METS_INDICATOR, DXCC_CREATED_DT, DXCC_CREATED_BY, DXCC_MODIFIED_DT FROM DV.DIAGNOSIS_CATALOG WHERE DXCC_DX_TYPE = 'ICD9' ) SELECT DISTINCT "t3"."PT_MRN" AS "MRN", "t3"."PT_LAST_NAME" AS "Last Name", "t3"."PT_FIRST_NAME" AS "First Name", "t3"."PT_BIRTH_DTE" AS "Date of Birth", "t3"."PT_DEATH_DTE" AS "Deceased Date", "t3"."PT_SEX_DESC" AS "Gender", "Pathology Report Date", "Pathology Report Type", "Pathology Report", CASE WHEN CKIT_DEID IS NOT NULL THEN 'Y' ELSE '' END AS "AML1-ETO or KIT Positive" FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED" "t1" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V" "t3" ON "t1"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t3"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."CDB_TUMOR_V" "t7" ON "t1"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t7"."CDTM_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DIAGNOSIS_CODE_CAT_ICDO_V" "t8" ON "t7"."CDTM_DX_CATALOG_ID" = "t8"."DXCC_DX_CATALOG_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DIAGNOSIS_FINAL_ALL_V" "t9" ON "t1"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t9"."PDX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "cte2" "t10" ON "t9"."PDX_DX_CATALOG_ID" = "t10"."DXCC_DX_CATALOG_ID" LEFT JOIN "cte1" "t4" ON "t1"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = PATH_DEID LEFT JOIN CKIT ON CKIT_DEID = "t1"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" WHERE ("t8"."DXCC_ICD_CODE" IN ('M9840/3', 'M9861/3', 'M9866/3', 'M9867/3', 'M9871/3', 'M9872/3', 'M9873/3', 'M9874/3', 'M9895/3', 'M9896/3', 'M9897/3', 'M9910/3', 'M9920/3') OR ("t10"."DXCC_ICD_CODE" IN ('205.0', '205.00', '205.01', '205.02', '207.2', '207.20', '207.21', '207.22', '238.72', '238.73', '238.74', '238.75') AND "t9"."DXA_CIC_CDER_INIT" = 'YES')) AND COALESCE(PATH_DEID, CKIT_DEID) IS NOT NULL

prompt: We would like to retrieve all medullary thyroid carcinomas, completely encapsulated, without capsular invasion, no angioinvasion (vascular invasion), no extrathyroidal extension, and negative lymph nodes.
completion: WITH DX AS (SELECT TM_MRN, AV_DESC AS CASE_STS, TM_DX_DTE, TM_HIST_CD, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS HIST_DESC, TM_SITE_CD, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_DESC, TM_BEST_AJCC_STG FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS ON AV_ELEMENT = 'CASE_STS' AND AV_CODE = TM_CASE_STS WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND TM_SITE_CD LIKE 'C739%' AND H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK LIKE '%MEDULLARY%' AND TM_DX_DTE >= '1999-03-21' ) , SYN AS (SELECT TM_MRN, PSRP_ACC_NO, MAX(CASE WHEN PSRP_CATEGORY='Lymph Nodes' THEN TRIM(REPLACE(REPLACE(PSRP_VALUE, 'Lymph Nodes', ''), '-', '')) END) "Lymph Nodes", MAX(CASE WHEN PSRP_CATEGORY='Tumor Encapsulation' THEN TRIM(REPLACE(REPLACE(PSRP_VALUE, 'Tumor Encapsulation', ''), '-', '')) END) "Tumor Encapsulation", MAX(CASE WHEN PSRP_CATEGORY='Capsular Invasion' THEN TRIM(REPLACE(REPLACE(PSRP_VALUE, 'Capsular Invasion', ''), '-', '')) END) "Capsular Invasion", MAX(CASE WHEN PSRP_CATEGORY='Blood Vessel Invasion' THEN TRIM(REPLACE(REPLACE(PSRP_VALUE, 'Blood Vessel Invasion', ''), '-', '')) END) "Blood Vessel Invasion", MAX(CASE WHEN PSRP_CATEGORY='Extrathyroid Extension' THEN TRIM(REPLACE(REPLACE(PSRP_VALUE, 'Extrathyroid Extension', ''), '-', '')) END) "Extrathyroid Extension" FROM DX JOIN IDB.PATH_SYNOPTIC_RPT ON TM_MRN = PSRP_MRN JOIN IDB.PATH_WK_SHEET_DICT ON PSRP_WK_SHEET_KEY = PWD_WK_SHEET_KEY WHERE 1 = 1 AND DATE(PSRP_PROC_DT) >= '1999-03-21' GROUP BY TM_MRN, PSRP_ACC_NO) SELECT * FROM SYN;

prompt: Patients diagnosed with parastomal hernia
completion: WITH PT AS (SELECT CC_MRN AS MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS ICD_DX_DTE, CC_CLSF_CD AS ICD_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS ICD_DESC FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND (CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) AND CC_CLSF_CD IN ('K43.3', 'K43.4', 'K43.5') GROUP BY CC_MRN, CC_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK HAVING MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) BETWEEN '2020-01-01' AND CURRENT DATE) , OSTOMY AS (SELECT SSE_MRN AS OSTOMY_MRN, MIN(SSE_SURG_DTE) OSTOMY_TAKEDOWN FROM IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE ON SSE_LOG_ID = SSP_LOG_ID AND SSE_ENC_CSN_ID = SSP_ENC_CSN_ID JOIN PT ON SSE_MRN = MRN WHERE (SSE_SURG_LOC not like '%IR%' AND SSE_SURG_LOC not like '%ENDO%' AND SSE_SOURCE_TYPE <> 'E') AND SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD IN ('44625', '44620', '44626') GROUP BY SSE_MRN) , PARASTOMAL AS (SELECT PBD_MRN AS PARASTOMAL_MRN, MIN(PBD_SVC_DTE) PARASTOMAL_HERNIA_RPR FROM IDB.PBD_DTL JOIN IDB.PBD_CODE ON PBD_PBD_CD = PBC_PBD_CD JOIN IDB.CLM ON PBC_CPT_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN PT ON PBD_MRN = MRN WHERE PBC_CPT_CD IN ('49621', '49622') GROUP BY PBD_MRN) , DIABETES AS (SELECT CC_MRN AS DIABETES_MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS DIABETES_DX FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN PT ON CC_MRN = MRN WHERE CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND (CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) AND SUBSTR(CC_CLSF_CD, 1, 3) IN ('E10', 'E11') GROUP BY CC_MRN ) , DX AS (SELECT TM_MRN, TM_DX_DTE, TM_HIST_CD, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS HIST_DESC, TM_SITE_CD, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_DESC, TM_BEST_AJCC_STG, AV_DESC AS SMOKING_HX FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS ON AV_ELEMENT = 'SMOKING_HX' AND AV_CODE = TM_SMOKING_HX JOIN PT ON TM_MRN = MRN WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') ) SELECT DISTINCT MRN, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, PT_DATE_OF_DEATH, ICD_DX_DTE, YEAR(ICD_DX_DTE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) AGE_AT_DX, ICD_CD, ICD_DESC, OSTOMY_TAKEDOWN, PARASTOMAL_HERNIA_RPR, DIABETES_DX, TM_DX_DTE, TM_HIST_CD, HIST_DESC, TM_SITE_CD, SITE_DESC, TM_BEST_AJCC_STG, SMOKING_HX FROM PT JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN OSTOMY ON MRN = OSTOMY_MRN LEFT JOIN PARASTOMAL ON MRN = PARASTOMAL_MRN LEFT JOIN DIABETES ON MRN = DIABETES_MRN LEFT JOIN DX ON MRN = TM_MRN ORDER BY MRN, ICD_DX_DTE, TM_DX_DTE, TM_SITE_CD, TM_HIST_CD ; WITH PT AS (SELECT CC_MRN AS MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS ICD_DX_DTE, CC_CLSF_CD AS ICD_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS ICD_DESC FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND (CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) AND CC_CLSF_CD IN ('K43.3', 'K43.4', 'K43.5') GROUP BY CC_MRN, CC_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK HAVING MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) BETWEEN '2020-01-01' AND CURRENT DATE) SELECT DISTINCT SSE_MRN, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, PT_DATE_OF_DEATH, ICD_DX_DTE, ICD_CD, ICD_DESC, YEAR(ICD_DX_DTE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) AGE_AT_DX, ICD_DX_DTE, SSE_SURG_DTE, YEAR(SSE_SURG_DTE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) AGE_AT_SRG, SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD, SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC, TRIM(SSP_SURG_LAST_NM) || ', ' || TRIM(SSP_SURG_FIRST_NM) AS SURGEON, SSP_SURG_SVC_CD, SAE_TOX_GRADE, SAE_TOXICITY_NAME, SAE_TOX_CAT_NAME, SAE_TOX_GRADE_NAME FROM IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE ON SSE_LOG_ID = SSP_LOG_ID AND SSE_ENC_CSN_ID = SSP_ENC_CSN_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.SRG_ADVERSE_EVENT A ON SSE_LOG_ID = SAE_SURG_LOG_ID AND SAE_PROC_SEQ_NO = SSP_PROC_SEQ_NO AND SAE_TOX_GRADE > '0' JOIN PT ON SSE_MRN = MRN JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON MRN = PT_MRN WHERE (SSE_SURG_LOC not like '%IR%' AND SSE_SURG_LOC not like '%ENDO%' AND SSE_SOURCE_TYPE <> 'E') AND SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD IN ('44141', '44142', '44143', '44144', '44146', '44150', '44151', '44155', '44155', '44156', '44158', '44160', '44187', '44205', '44206', '44208', '44209', '44210', '44211', '44212', '44310', '44312', '44314', '44320', '44340', '44345', '44346', '45110', '45113', '45119', '45397', '49000') ORDER BY SSE_MRN, ICD_DX_DTE, SSE_SURG_DTE, SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD, SAE_TOX_GRADE ; SELECT DISTINCT SSE_MRN, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, PT_DATE_OF_DEATH, SSE_SURG_DTE, YEAR(SSE_SURG_DTE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) AGE_AT_SRG, SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD, SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC, TRIM(SSP_SURG_LAST_NM) || ', ' || TRIM(SSP_SURG_FIRST_NM) AS SURGEON, SSP_SURG_SVC_CD, SAE_TOX_GRADE, SAE_TOXICITY_NAME, SAE_TOX_CAT_NAME, SAE_TOX_GRADE_NAME FROM IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE ON SSE_LOG_ID = SSP_LOG_ID AND SSE_ENC_CSN_ID = SSP_ENC_CSN_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.SRG_ADVERSE_EVENT A ON SSE_LOG_ID = SAE_SURG_LOG_ID AND SAE_PROC_SEQ_NO = SSP_PROC_SEQ_NO AND SAE_TOX_GRADE > '0' JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON SSE_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE (SSE_SURG_LOC not like '%IR%' AND SSE_SURG_LOC not like '%ENDO%' AND SSE_SOURCE_TYPE <> 'E') AND SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD IN ('44141', '44142', '44143', '44144', '44146', '44150', '44151', '44155', '44155', '44156', '44158', '44160', '44187', '44205', '44206', '44208', '44209', '44210', '44211', '44212', '44310', '44312', '44314', '44320', '44340', '44345', '44346', '45110', '45113', '45119', '45397', '49000') AND SSE_SURG_DTE BETWEEN '2020-01-01' AND CURRENT DATE ORDER BY SSE_MRN, SSE_SURG_DTE, SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD, SAE_TOX_GRADE

prompt: Provide a weekly notification of pancreatic cancer patients with specific mutations from IMPACT and are receiving platinum therapy.
completion: WITH STRUCTURED AS (SELECT DISTINCT A.PT_MRN, PRPT_PATH_RPT_ID AS R_ID, A.PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID AS P_ID FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_STRUCTURED_RESULTS_V A JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS B ON A.PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = B.PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID WHERE 1=1 AND ((GENE IN ('BRCA1', 'BRCA2', 'PALB2', 'ATM', 'BAP1', 'BARD1', 'BLM', 'BRIP1', 'CHEK2', 'FAM175A', 'FANCA', 'FANCC', 'NBN', 'RAD50', 'RAD51', 'RAD51C', 'RTEL1') OR GENE2 IN ('BRCA1', 'BRCA2', 'PALB2', 'ATM', 'BAP1', 'BARD1', 'BLM', 'BRIP1', 'CHEK2', 'FAM175A', 'FANCA', 'FANCC', 'NBN', 'RAD50', 'RAD51', 'RAD51C', 'RTEL1'))) AND PT_VITAL_STATUS = 'ALIVE' AND METHOD like 'IMPACT%' AND METHOD NOT like 'IMPACT-HEM%' ) , MED_INFO AS (SELECT * FROM IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX_V MED JOIN STRUCTURED ON PT_MRN = APR_MRN WHERE CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME IN ('OXALIPLATIN', 'CISPLATIN') AND APR_START_DTE >= CURRENT date - 30 DAYS ) , DMP_ATTRIBUTES AS (SELECT DISTINCT PDRX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID , PDRX_DMP_PATIENT_ID, PDRX_DMP_SAMPLE_ID , R_ID , T.* FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML DT CROSS JOIN XMLTABLE('$c/root/*' PASSING DT.PDRX_XML_VALUE AS "c" COLUMNS PRIMARY_SITE VARCHAR(264) PATH '../meta-data/primary_site', TUMOR_TYPE_NAME VARCHAR(264) PATH '../meta-data/tumor_type_name' , METASTASIS_SITE VARCHAR(264) PATH '../meta-data/metastasis_site' , M_ACCESSION_NUM VARCHAR(264) PATH '../meta-data/m_accession_num' , GENE_PANEL VARCHAR(264) PATH '../meta-data/gene-panel' , PART_DESCRIPTION VARCHAR(264) PATH '../meta-data/part_description') T JOIN MED_INFO ON R_ID = PDRX_PATH_RPT_ID WHERE PRIMARY_SITE = 'Pancreas' ) SELECT * FROM DMP_ATTRIBUTES ORDER BY R_ID, PDRX_DMP_SAMPLE_ID ;

prompt: One-time run of the MED12587 – Monthly Bacterial Fungal Positive Cultures that is from January 2021 through September 2021 and then resume next month with October cultures
completion: SELECT DISTINCT LPC_MRN MRN, STRIP(PT_LAST_NAME)||', '||STRIP(PT_FIRST_NAME) PT_NAME, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH DOB, PT_SEX SEX, DOC_SVC AS SVC, LPC_ACCESSION_NO, LPC_PERFORMED_DT , LPC_ORGANISM_OBSERVATION, LPC_PERFORMED_DT COLLECTION_DT , OO_PERFORMED_DT COLLECTION_DT , LPC_FINAL_DT, LPC_SPECIMEN_LOC_ABBR, LPC_SPECIMEN_DESC, LPC_BATTERY_CD FROM IDB.LAB_POSITIVE_CULTURES JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON LPC_MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_ORDER ON LPC_MRN = OO_MRN AND LPC_ACCESSION_NO = OO_ANCIL_REF_CD LEFT JOIN IDB.DOC ON OO_REQ_DR_NO = DOC_DR_NO WHERE LPC_PERFORMED_DTE BETWEEN LAST_DAY(CURRENT DATE - 10 MONTH) + 1 DAY AND LAST_DAY(CURRENT DATE - 1 MONTH) AND (UPPER(LPC_ORGANISM_OBSERVATION) LIKE '%RHIZOP%' OR UPPER(LPC_ORGANISM_OBSERVATION) LIKE '%MUCOR%' OR UPPER(LPC_ORGANISM_OBSERVATION) LIKE '%CUNNINGHAME%' OR UPPER(LPC_ORGANISM_OBSERVATION) LIKE '%BERTHOLLETI%' OR UPPER(LPC_ORGANISM_OBSERVATION) LIKE '%APOPHYSOMY%' OR UPPER(LPC_ORGANISM_OBSERVATION) LIKE '%LICHTHEI%') ;

prompt: Monthly report of all active and inactive MSKCC physicians, physician assistants and nurse practitioners.
completion: SELECT DOC_NAME "Physician Name", DOC_DR_NO "Doc #", DOC_NPI "NPI", DOC_LICENSE "License", DOC_ACDMC_DPT "Academic Department", DOC_ACDMC_SVC "Academic Service", DOC_SVC "Service" FROM IDB.DOC WHERE DOC_SVC <> ' ' AND DOC_DR_STS = 'A' ORDER BY 1 ; SELECT DOC_NAME "Physician Name", 'INACTIVE' "Doc #", DOC_NPI "NPI", DOC_LICENSE "License", DOC_ACDMC_DPT "Academic Department", DOC_ACDMC_SVC "Academic Service", DOC_SVC "Service" FROM IDB.DOC WHERE DOC_DR_STS = 'I' OR DOC_SVC <> ' ' ORDER BY 1 ;

prompt: Provide genetic, RT, antineoplastic, surgery, and demographic data for patients who have had NGS tests which indicated 'adenoid cystic carcinoma' type histologies.
Provide a list of patients that received Denosumab/Zoledronic acid/ pamidronate prior to dental extraction
completion: WITH PATIENTS AS (SELECT TRIM(PT_MRN) AS PT_MRN, TRIM(PT_LAST_NAME) || ', ' || TRIM(PT_FIRST_NAME) AS PATIENTS_NAME, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH FROM IDB.PATIENT), TUMORS AS (SELECT CC_MRN, CLM_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK, CC_EFF_DTE, TM_SITE_TXT, RTC_TX_MRN, TRIM(RTC_TX_PLAN_NAME) AS SITE_DESCRIPTION, TRIM(RTC_PRIMARY_REF_POINT) AS PRIMARY_REF_POINT, RTC_TX_START_DTE AS RADIATION_START_DATE, RTC_TX_STOP_DTE AS RADIATION_END_DATE, RTC_TX_DELIVERED_DOSE AS DELIVERED_DOSE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY RTC_TX_MRN ORDER BY RTC_TX_START_DTE DESC) RN_RADIATION FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CDB_TUMOR ON CC_MRN = TM_MRN JOIN IDB.RADONC_TREATMENT_COURSE ON CC_MRN = RTC_TX_MRN JOIN IDB.CLM ON CLM_CLSF_CD = CC_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS ON AV_CODE = CC_CLSF_TYPE WHERE AV_ELEMENT = 'CLSF_TYPE' AND CC_EFF_DTE BETWEEN '01-01-2020' AND '09-30-2020' AND RTC_TX_START_DTE BETWEEN '01-01-2020' AND '09-30-2020' AND RTC_TX_STOP_DTE BETWEEN '01-01-2020' AND '09-30-2020' ORDER BY RTC_TX_MRN, RTC_TX_START_DTE DESC), DENTAL_EXTRACTION AS (SELECT CC_MRN AS DENTAL_MRN, CLM_CLSF_CD AS DENTAL_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC AS DENTAL_DESCRIPTION, CC_EFF_DTE AS EXTRACTION_DATE, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS DENTAL FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CLM_CLSF_CD = CC_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS ON AV_CODE = CC_CLSF_TYPE WHERE AV_ELEMENT = 'CLSF_TYPE' AND CLM_CLSF_CD IN ('D7140', 'D7210', 'D7220', 'D7230') AND CC_EFF_DTE BETWEEN '01-01-2020' AND '09-30-2020'), DRUG AS (SELECT APR_MRN, APR_DRUG_NAME FROM IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX_V WHERE UPPER(APR_DRUG_NAME) LIKE ('%DENOSUMAB%') OR UPPER(APR_DRUG_NAME) LIKE ('%ZOLEDRONIC%') OR UPPER(APR_DRUG_NAME) LIKE ('%PAMIDRONATE%') ) SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN, PATIENTS_NAME, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK, CC_EFF_DTE, TM_SITE_TXT, SITE_DESCRIPTION, PRIMARY_REF_POINT, RADIATION_START_DATE, RADIATION_END_DATE, DELIVERED_DOSE, DENTAL_CD, DENTAL_DESCRIPTION, EXTRACTION_DATE, APR_DRUG_NAME FROM PATIENTS JOIN TUMORS ON PT_MRN = CC_MRN JOIN DENTAL_EXTRACTION ON PT_MRN = DENTAL_MRN JOIN DRUG ON PT_MRN = APR_MRN

prompt: Please copy report number BAIC17590 with the following department/provider info:  Dept: BER CHEMO, Provider: BER CHEMO
completion: WITH SCH_VST AS (SELECT CPE_MRN MRN, STRIP(PT_LAST_NAME)||', '||STRIP(PT_FIRST_NAME) PT_NAME, PT_SEX_DESC SEX, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH DOB, CPE_APPT_MADE_DTE APPT_MADE_DTE, CPE_ENC_DTE SCH_VST_DATE, VD.CLD_DEPT_ID DEPT_ID, VD.CLD_DEPT_NAME DEPT_NAME, VD.CLD_CLD_CENTER CLD_CENTER , CPE_APPT_DT APPT_DT, VT.CRE_RES_NAME VST_MD, REF.CRE_RES_NAME REF_MD, CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME VST_NAME , CVT_EXT_NAME VST_TYPE , CLN1.CCH_CHEMO_NAME TREATMENT1, CLN1.CCH_DURATION_MIN DURATION1, CLN2.CCH_CHEMO_NAME TREATMENT2, CLN2.CCH_DURATION_MIN DURATION2 FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.PATIENT_V ON CPE_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID = CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT VD ON CPE_DEPT_ID = VD.CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE VT ON VT.CRE_RES_ID = CPE_VST_RES_ID AND VT.CRE_RES_ID = 300443 LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_PT_APPT LN1 ON LN1.CPA_CL_PT_ID = CPE_CL_PT_ID AND LN1.CPA_ENC_DTE_SEQ = CPE_ENC_DTE_SEQ LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_PT_CHEMO PCLN1 ON PCLN1.CPC_CL_PT_ID = LN1.CPA_CL_PT_ID AND PCLN1.CPC_ENC_DTE_SEQ = LN1.CPA_ENC_DTE_SEQ AND PCLN1.CPC_LINE_NO = 1 LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_CHEMO CLN1 ON CLN1.CCH_CHEMO_ID = PCLN1.CPC_CHEMO_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_PT_APPT LN2 ON CPE_CL_PT_ID = LN2.CPA_CL_PT_ID AND CPE_ENC_DTE_SEQ = LN2.CPA_ENC_DTE_SEQ JOIN IDB.CL_PT_CHEMO PCLN2 ON PCLN2.CPC_CL_PT_ID = LN2.CPA_CL_PT_ID AND PCLN2.CPC_ENC_DTE_SEQ = LN2.CPA_ENC_DTE_SEQ AND PCLN2.CPC_LINE_NO = 2 LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_CHEMO CLN2 ON CLN2.CCH_CHEMO_ID = PCLN2.CPC_CHEMO_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE REF ON REF.CRE_RES_ID = CPE_REF_RES_ID AND REF.CRE_RES_TYP IN ('Physician', 'Dentist', 'Psychologist', 'PhD', 'Nurse Practitioner', 'Physician Assistant', 'Advanced Practice Nurse') LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE SR ON SR.CRE_RES_ID = CPE_VST_RES_ID WHERE CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN (CASE WHEN DAYOFWEEK(CURRENT DATE) = 2 THEN CURRENT DATE - 3 DAY ELSE CURRENT DATE END) AND CURRENT DATE + 20 DAY AND CPE_CPE_APPT_STS = 'Sch' AND CPE_ENC_TYP_CD = 50 ) , COOL_ENROLLMENT AS (SELECT MRN AS ENROLL_MRN, OUO_ORD_NAME ORDNAME, OUO_ORD_ID ORDERID, OUO_ENTER_DTE ORD_ENTERDTE, OUO_STS_DESC ORDSTATUS, OUO_ATN_PVDR_NAME PROVIDER, OUD_USER_DI_VALUE AS "PAXMAN THERAPY START", ROW_NUMBER () OVER (PARTITION BY MRN ORDER BY OUO_ENTER_DTE DESC) RN FROM SCH_VST JOIN IDB.OMS_USER_ORDERS ON OUO_MRN = MRN AND OUO_ENTER_DTE < CURRENT DATE LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_USER_DATA ON OUO_ORD_GUID = OUD_ORD_GUID AND OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'Paxman_Therapy_Start' WHERE OUO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID = '9000011661100730' AND OUO_ORD_STS_CD NOT LIKE 'CA%' ) , PRI_COOLING AS (SELECT CDD_MRN , DOCGUID , DOCNAME , SERVICE_DTE, PT_COOLING, COOLING_LOCATION, ROW_NUMBER () OVER (PARTITION BY CDD_MRN ORDER BY SERVICE_DTE DESC) RNC FROM (SELECT CDD_MRN , CDO_DOC_GUID DOCGUID, CDD_DOC_NAME DOCNAME, CDD_SERVICE_DTE SERVICE_DTE, MAX(CASE WHEN CDO_ITEM_NAME = 'Patient is cooling' THEN SUBSTR(CDO_VALUE_TEXT, 1, 50) ELSE '' END) PT_COOLING, MAX(CASE WHEN CDO_ITEM_NAME = 'Cooling Treatment location' THEN SUBSTR(CDO_VALUE_TEXT, 1, 50) ELSE '' END) COOLING_LOCATION FROM SCH_VST JOIN IDB.CD_DOCUMENT ON MRN = CDD_MRN JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION ON CDD_DOC_GUID = CDO_DOC_GUID WHERE CDD_CANCEL_IND = '0' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND = '0' AND CDD_SERVICE_DTE < CURRENT DATE AND CDO_CTLG_DISPL_NM = 'Cooling Treatment' AND CDO_ITEM_NAME IN ('Patient is cooling', 'Cooling Treatment location') GROUP BY CDD_MRN , CDO_DOC_GUID , CDD_DOC_NAME , CDD_SERVICE_DTE) AS A WHERE UPPER(COOLING_LOCATION) LIKE '%SCALP%' OR UPPER(COOLING_LOCATION) = '' ) , PRI_CHEMO AS (SELECT MRN AS CHEMO_MRN, PRI_CHEMO_DTE, PRI_DEPT_NAME, PRI_VST_MD, PRI_REF_MD, PRI_VST_NAME, PRI_VST_TYPE , CHM_TREATMENT1, CHM_DURATION1, CHM_TREATMENT2, CHM_DURATION2 FROM (SELECT MRN, PT_NAME, CPE_ENC_DTE PRI_CHEMO_DTE, VD.CLD_DEPT_NAME PRI_DEPT_NAME, VT.CRE_RES_NAME PRI_VST_MD, REF.CRE_RES_NAME PRI_REF_MD, CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME PRI_VST_NAME , CVT_EXT_NAME PRI_VST_TYPE , CLN1.CCH_CHEMO_NAME CHM_TREATMENT1, CLN1.CCH_DURATION_MIN CHM_DURATION1, CLN2.CCH_CHEMO_NAME CHM_TREATMENT2, CLN2.CCH_DURATION_MIN CHM_DURATION2 , ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY MRN ORDER BY CPE_ENC_DTE DESC) RN FROM SCH_VST JOIN IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER ON CPE_MRN = MRN AND CPE_ENC_DTE < CURRENT date JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID = CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT VD ON CPE_DEPT_ID = VD.CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE VT ON VT.CRE_RES_ID = CPE_VST_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_PT_APPT LN1 ON LN1.CPA_CL_PT_ID = CPE_CL_PT_ID AND LN1.CPA_ENC_DTE_SEQ = CPE_ENC_DTE_SEQ JOIN IDB.CL_PT_CHEMO PCLN1 ON PCLN1.CPC_CL_PT_ID = LN1.CPA_CL_PT_ID AND PCLN1.CPC_ENC_DTE_SEQ = LN1.CPA_ENC_DTE_SEQ AND PCLN1.CPC_LINE_NO = 1 JOIN IDB.CL_CHEMO CLN1 ON CLN1.CCH_CHEMO_ID = PCLN1.CPC_CHEMO_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE REF ON REF.CRE_RES_ID = CPE_REF_RES_ID AND REF.CRE_RES_TYP IN ('Physician', 'Dentist', 'Psychologist', 'PhD', 'Nurse Practitioner', 'Physician Assistant', 'Advanced Practice Nurse') LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_PT_APPT LN2 ON CPE_CL_PT_ID = LN2.CPA_CL_PT_ID AND CPE_ENC_DTE_SEQ = LN2.CPA_ENC_DTE_SEQ JOIN IDB.CL_PT_CHEMO PCLN2 ON PCLN2.CPC_CL_PT_ID = LN2.CPA_CL_PT_ID AND PCLN2.CPC_ENC_DTE_SEQ = LN2.CPA_ENC_DTE_SEQ AND PCLN2.CPC_LINE_NO = 2 LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_CHEMO CLN2 ON CLN2.CCH_CHEMO_ID = PCLN2.CPC_CHEMO_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE SR ON SR.CRE_RES_ID = CPE_VST_RES_ID WHERE CPE_ENC_DTE < CURRENT DATE AND CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CPE_ENC_TYP_CD = 50 ) AS A WHERE RN = 1 ) SELECT MRN, PT_NAME, SEX, DOB, APPT_MADE_DTE, SCH_VST_DATE, DEPT_NAME, APPT_DT, VST_MD, REF_MD, VST_NAME, VST_TYPE, TREATMENT1, DURATION1, TREATMENT2, DURATION2, ORDNAME, ORD_ENTERDTE, ORDERID, ORDSTATUS, PROVIDER, "PAXMAN THERAPY START", SERVICE_DTE AS PRIOR_COOLING_DTE, PT_COOLING, COOLING_LOCATION, PRI_CHEMO_DTE, PRI_DEPT_NAME, PRI_VST_MD, PRI_REF_MD, PRI_VST_NAME, PRI_VST_TYPE , CHM_TREATMENT1, CHM_DURATION1, CHM_TREATMENT2, CHM_DURATION2 FROM SCH_VST LEFT JOIN COOL_ENROLLMENT ON MRN = ENROLL_MRN AND RN = 1 LEFT JOIN PRI_CHEMO ON MRN = CHEMO_MRN LEFT JOIN PRI_COOLING ON MRN = CDD_MRN AND RNC = 1 WHERE ((TREATMENT1 LIKE 'SCALP COOLING%' OR TREATMENT2 LIKE 'SCALP COOLING%')) OR (NOT (TREATMENT1 LIKE 'SCALP COOLING%' OR TREATMENT2 LIKE 'SCALP COOLING%') AND ENROLL_MRN IS NOT NULL)

prompt: The goal is to determine how many of the GMT patients we are reviewing radiology scans with over the phone by an NP (ethel law) as opposed to coming in for an outpatient visit with Sam Singer or Ethel Law.
completion: WITH RAD AS (SELECT DISTINCT RRPT_MRN, RRPT_REQUESTER, RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE FROM DV.RADIOLOGY_REPORT_V WHERE RRPT_REQUESTER IN ('Law, Ethel', 'LAW NP,ETHEL BEELING P', 'Singer, Samuel', 'SINGER MD,SAMUEL') AND RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE BETWEEN '2018-01-01' AND '2018-11-01' ORDER BY RRPT_MRN, RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE) , APPTS AS (SELECT DISTINCT RRPT_MRN "amrn", CPE_ENC_DTE, RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE "a date", CRE_RES_NAME AS "Provider Name" FROM RAD JOIN IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER ON CPE_MRN = RRPT_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE + 1 DAY AND RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE + 21 DAYS AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 = 'GMT' ) , PHONE AS (SELECT DISTINCT CDD_DOC_NAME, RRPT_MRN "pmrn", RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE "p date", OP_DISPLAY_NAME, CDD_DOC_GUID, CDD_AUTHORED_DTE, CDD_SERVICE_DTE FROM IDB.CD_DOCUMENT JOIN IDB.OMS_PROVIDER ON CDD_AUTH_PROV_GUID = OP_PVDR_GUID JOIN RAD ON CDD_MRN = RRPT_MRN AND CDD_SERVICE_DTE BETWEEN RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE + 1 DAY AND RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE + 21 DAYS WHERE CDD_CANCEL_IND <> '1' AND OP_DISPLAY_NAME = 'Law, Ethel' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND <> '1' AND CDD_DOC_NAME = 'Telephone/Electronic Communication, Nursing-Care Coordinate' ) , PHONE2 AS (SELECT DISTINCT CDD_DOC_GUID, CDO_VALUE_TEXT "Reason for Call" FROM PHONE LEFT JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION ON CDD_DOC_GUID = CDO_DOC_GUID AND CDD_AUTHORED_DTE = CDO_AUTHORED_DTE WHERE CDO_SECTION = 'Reason for Call' AND CDO_ITEM_NAME = 'Comments' ) SELECT DISTINCT RRPT_MRN, RRPT_REQUESTER, RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE, LISTAGG(CHAR(CDD_SERVICE_DTE)||': '||"Reason for Call", CHR(13) || CHR(10)) "comments", CASE WHEN "amrn" IS NOT NULL THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS "Had Visit", CASE WHEN "pmrn" IS NOT NULL THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS "Had Phone Call" FROM RAD LEFT JOIN APPTS ON RRPT_MRN = "amrn" AND RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE = "a date" LEFT JOIN PHONE ON RRPT_MRN = "pmrn" AND RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE = "p date" LEFT JOIN PHONE2 ON PHONE.CDD_DOC_GUID = PHONE2.CDD_DOC_GUID GROUP BY RRPT_MRN, RRPT_REQUESTER, RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE, "amrn", "pmrn" ;

prompt: Provide an on-demand report to show DMP Patient and Sample IDs for one or more MRNs
completion: SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN AS MRN , PDRX_DMP_PATIENT_ID AS "DMP Patient ID", PDRX_DMP_SAMPLE_ID AS "DMP Sample ID" , T.* FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML DT CROSS JOIN XMLTABLE('$c/root/*' PASSING DT.PDRX_XML_VALUE AS "c" COLUMNS PRIMARY_SITE VARCHAR(264) PATH '../meta-data/primary_site', TUMOR_TYPE_NAME VARCHAR(264) PATH '../meta-data/tumor_type_name' , TUMOR_TYPE_CODE VARCHAR(264) PATH '../meta-data/tumor_type_code' , METASTASIS_SITE VARCHAR(264) PATH '../meta-data/metastasis_site' , GENE_PANEL VARCHAR(264) PATH '../meta-data/gene-panel' , PART_DESCRIPTION VARCHAR(264) PATH '../meta-data/part_description' , DT_PROCEDURE VARCHAR(100) PATH '../meta-data/dt_procedure') T JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PDRX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID WHERE 1=1 AND PT_MRN IN ('35395126', '35416163', '35357934', '35381683', '35392762', '35412918', '35392510')

prompt:
We wanted to run a quick report of any pt seen in GYN Surv (so Rose Ali or Erin Diament) between Jan 1, 2019-present day.

And then see who is within a 20 mile radius of the Westchester location (I’m not sure what we’ve done in the past radius wise, so if you have suggestions for a larger or smaller radius let us know, otherwise let’s start with 20 miles).
completion: WITH PTS AS (SELECT CPE_MRN MRN , TRIM(PT_LAST_NAME) || ', ' || TRIM(PT_FIRST_NAME) PT_NAME , CPE_ENC_DTE APPT_DTE , CRE_RES_NAME AS PROVIDER , CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID AND CRE_RES_ID IN ('081927', '080945') JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON CPE_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CPE_ENC_DTE >= '2019-01-01' ) , PT_LOCATION AS (SELECT PT_MRN LOC_MRN, ZC_ZIP, ZC_LATITUDE AS LAT, ZC_LONGITUDE AS LON FROM IDB.PATIENT JOIN IDB.ZIPCODE ON ZC_ZIP=PT_ZIP_CD JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT MRN FROM PTS) A ON PT_MRN = MRN) , LOCS (LAT2, LON2, LOC) AS (SELECT 41.027895, -73.733488, 'Westchester' FROM SYSIBM.SYSDUMMY1) , DIST AS (SELECT PT_LOCATION.*, ROUND(DEGREES(ACOS(SIN(RADIANS(LAT)) *SIN(RADIANS(LAT2)) +COS(RADIANS(LAT)) *COS(RADIANS(LAT2)) *COS(RADIANS(LON-LON2))) * 69.09)) AS "Distance from Westchester" FROM PT_LOCATION, LOCS) SELECT MRN , PT_NAME , APPT_DTE , PROVIDER , CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME VISIT_TYPE , "Distance from Westchester" FROM PTS LEFT JOIN DIST ON MRN = LOC_MRN
