'JRSC' WHEN OC_SURG_LOC_ID=1000600 THEN 'Monmouth OR' ELSE 'Other' END AS LOCATION , LISTAGG('| ' || TRIM(CPX_PROC_CD) || ' - ' || TRIM(CPX_PROC_NAME) || ' |', CHR(13) || CHR(10)) WITHIN GROUP( ORDER BY CPX_PROC_CD) AS PROCEDURE FROM IDB.OR_CASE JOIN IDB.OR_CASE_ALL_PROC ON OC_CASE_ID = OCAP_CASE_ID JOIN IDB.OR_CASE_ALL_SURG ON OCAP_CASE_ID = OCAS_CASE_ID AND OCAS_PNL_NO = OCAP_PNL_NO AND OCAS_SURG_ROLE = 'Primary' JOIN IDB.OR_PROC ON OCAP_OR_PROC_ID = OP_OR_PROC_ID JOIN IDB.OR_CL_PROC ON OP_OR_PROC_ID = OCP_OR_PROC_ID JOIN IDB.CL_PROC ON OCP_PROC_ID = CPX_PROC_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE REF ON REF.CRE_RES_ID = OC_REF_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_LOCATION ON OC_SURG_LOC_ID = LOC_LOC_ID JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON OC_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE OC_MRN <> '' AND OC_SURG_DTE BETWEEN '2016-01-01' AND CURRENT date AND OC_SURG_SVC IN ('CRS', 'GYN', 'THO', 'HNS', 'NEURO', 'URO', 'HEP', 'PEDS', 'PLA') AND OC_SURG_LOC_ID = 1000010 GROUP BY OC_MRN , OC_CASE_ID , OC_OR_CASE_STS , OC_SURG_SVC , OC_REC_CR_DTE , OC_SCH_DT , OC_SURG_DTE , PT_LAST_NAME , PT_FIRST_NAME , CASE WHEN OC_SURG_LOC_ID=1000010 THEN 'Main OR' WHEN OC_SURG_LOC_ID=1000020 THEN 'SDH' WHEN OC_SURG_LOC_ID=1000030 THEN 'Endoscopy' WHEN OC_SURG_LOC_ID=1000080 THEN 'IR Room' WHEN OC_SURG_LOC_ID=1000300 THEN 'JRSC' WHEN OC_SURG_LOC_ID=1000600 THEN 'Monmouth OR' ELSE 'Other' END) , NOTES AS (SELECT DISTINCT CDD_MRN, CDD_SERVICE_DTE, CDD_DOC_NAME, MAX(CASE WHEN CDO_SECTION = 'Pre-procedure Checklist' AND CDO_ITEM_NAME = 'NUR_ERAS Did the patient drink Clearfast RES' THEN TRIM(CDO_VALUE_TEXT) END) AS "Clearfast", MAX(CASE WHEN CDO_SECTION = 'Pre-procedure Checklist' AND CDO_ITEM_NAME = 'NUR_ERAS Patient was provided with Clearfast drink and education RES' THEN TRIM(CDO_VALUE_TEXT) END) AS "Clearfast Drink and Education", MAX(CASE WHEN CDO_SECTION = 'Pre-procedure Checklist' AND CDO_ITEM_NAME = 'NUR_ERAS Time patient drank Clearfast RES' THEN TRIM(CDO_VALUE_TEXT) END) AS "Clearfast Time", MAX(CASE WHEN CDO_SECTION = 'PMSFH' AND CDO_ITEM_NAME = 'Diabetes Mellitus Type' THEN TRIM(CDO_VALUE_TEXT) END) AS "Diabetes Mellitus Type" FROM IDB.CD_DOCUMENT LEFT JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION ON CDD_DOC_GUID = CDO_DOC_GUID AND CDD_AUTHORED_DTE = CDO_AUTHORED_DTE AND CDO_VALUE_TEXT <> '' JOIN IDB.OMS_PROVIDER ON CDD_AUTH_PROV_GUID = OP_PVDR_GUID JOIN PROCS ON CDD_MRN = OC_MRN WHERE CDD_CANCEL_IND <> '1' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND <> '1' AND CDD_DOC_NAME = 'Nursing Assessment - Pre-Operative/Procedure' AND CDO_SECTION IN ('PMSFH', 'Pre-procedure Checklist') AND CDO_ITEM_NAME IN ('NUR_ERAS Time patient drank Clearfast RES', 'NUR_ERAS Did the patient drink Clearfast RES', 'NUR_ERAS Patient was provided with Clearfast drink and education RES', 'Diabetes Mellitus Type') AND CDD_SERVICE_DTE = OC_SURG_DTE GROUP BY CDD_MRN , CDD_SERVICE_DTE , CDD_DOC_NAME) , GLUCOSE AS (SELECT LR_MRN, LR_PERFORMED_DT, LR_PERFORMED_DTE, LR_TEST_NAME, LR_SUBTEST_NAME, LR_RESULT_VALUE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY LR_MRN ORDER BY LR_PERFORMED_DT ASC) GLUCOSE_RANK FROM IDB.LAB_RESULTS LEFT JOIN IDB.LAB_TEXT_LINE ON LTL_RESULT_GUID = LR_RESULT_GUID JOIN PROCS ON OC_MRN = LR_MRN AND LR_PERFORMED_DTE = OC_SURG_DTE WHERE LR_TEST_NAME = 'Glucose, Bedside' ) , DIABETES AS (SELECT CC_MRN FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF WHERE 1=1 AND CC_CLSF_CD IN ('250', '250.0', '250.00', '250.01', '250.02', '250.03', '250.1', '250.10', '250.11', '250.12', '250.13', '250.2', '250.20', '250.21', '250.22', '250.23', '250.3', '250.30', '250.31', '250.32', '250.33', '250.4', '250.40', '250.41', '250.42', '250.43', '250.5', '250.50', '250.51', '250.52', '250.53', '250.6', '250.60', '250.61', '250.62', '250.63', '250.7', '250.70', '250.71', '250.72', '250.73', '250.8', '250.80', '250.81', '250.82', '250.83', '250.9', '250.90', '250.91', '250.92', '250.93' ,'E10.10' ,'E10.11' ,'E10.21' ,'E10.29' ,'E10.311' ,'E10.319' ,'E10.36' ,'E10.37X1' ,'E10.37X2' ,'E10.37X3' ,'E10.37X9' ,'E10.39' ,'E10.40' ,'E10.51' ,'E10.618' ,'E10.620' ,'E10.621' ,'E10.622' ,'E10.628' ,'E10.630' ,'E10.638' ,'E10.641' ,'E10.649' ,'E10.65' ,'E10.69' ,'E10.8' ,'E10.9' ,'E11.00' ,'E11.01' ,'E11.10' ,'E11.11' ,'E11.21' ,'E11.29' ,'E11.311' ,'E11.319' ,'E11.36' ,'E11.39' ,'E11.40' ,'E11.51' ,'E11.618' ,'E11.620' ,'E11.621' ,'E11.622' ,'E11.628' ,'E11.630' ,'E11.638' ,'E11.641' ,'E11.649' ,'E11.65' ,'E11.69' ,'E11.8' ,'E11.9' ,'E13.10') AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND (CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) ) SELECT DISTINCT OC_MRN "MRN" , OC_CASE_ID "Case ID" , OC_OR_CASE_STS "Case Status" , OC_SURG_SVC "Service" , OC_REC_CR_DTE "Record Create Date" , OC_SCH_DT "Scheduled Date" , OC_SURG_DTE "Surgery Date" , PT_LAST_NAME "PT Last Name" , PT_FIRST_NAME "PT First Name" , LOCATION "Location" , PROCEDURE "Procedure" , "Clearfast" , "Clearfast Drink and Education" , "Clearfast Time" , "Diabetes Mellitus Type" , LR_RESULT_VALUE "Glucose Bedside Test Value" , CASE WHEN CC_MRN IS NOT NULL THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS "Diabetes Y/N" FROM PROCS JOIN NOTES ON OC_MRN = CDD_MRN AND OC_SURG_DTE = CDD_SERVICE_DTE LEFT JOIN GLUCOSE ON OC_MRN = LR_MRN AND OC_SURG_DTE = LR_PERFORMED_DTE AND GLUCOSE_RANK = 1 LEFT JOIN DIABETES ON OC_MRN = CC_MRN ;

prompt: Provide a list of Transfusion reaction workup in 2023
completion: WITH X AS (SELECT OO_MRN MRN, OO_ORD_GUID, OO_ENTER_DTE ENTERED_DATE, TIME(OO_ENTER_DT) ENTERED_TIME, OO_ORD_NAME ORDER_NAME, OO_SET_NAME SET_NAME , OP_DISPLAY_NAME REQUESTER_NAME, OP_PROV_TYPE REQUESTER_ROLE, OCV_CURR_LOC LOCATION , OU_DISPLAY_NAME ENTERED_BY_NAME, OU_ORD_ROLE_TYPE ENTERED_BY_ROLE , OO_ORD_SOURCE ORDER_SOURCE FROM IDB.OMS_ORDER JOIN IDB.OMS_USER ON OU_USER_GUID = OO_USER_GUID LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_PROVIDER ON OP_PVDR_GUID = OO_PVDR_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_CLIENT_VISIT ON OCV_VISIT_GUID = OO_VISIT_GUID WHERE 1=1 AND OO_SET_NAME = 'Transfusion Reaction Work-Up' AND OO_ENTER_DTE BETWEEN '2023-01-01' AND '2023-12-31' AND OO_ORD_STS_CD NOT IN ('CANP', 'CANC', 'AUC3') ) , MEDS AS (SELECT OO_MRN, OO_ENTER_DTE, LISTAGG(DISTINCT STRIP(OO_ORD_NAME), CHR(13)||CHR(10)) MEDICATIONS FROM X JOIN IDB.OMS_ORDER ON X.MRN = OO_MRN AND X.ENTERED_DATE = OO_ENTER_DTE WHERE 1=1 AND OO_ORD_TYPE_CD = 'Medication' AND OO_ORD_STS_CD NOT IN ('CANP', 'CANC', 'AUC3') GROUP BY OO_MRN, OO_ENTER_DTE ) SELECT X.*, MEDICATIONS FROM X LEFT JOIN MEDS M ON X.MRN = M.OO_MRN AND X.ENTERED_DATE = M.OO_ENTER_DTE

prompt: Provide a list of Endo procedures from 12/1/2021 to 5/2/2022.
completion: SELECT OL_MRN, OL_LOG_ID, OL_SURG_DTE, OLAS_SURG_SVC, OLAP_OR_PROC_ID, OP_PROC_NAME, LOC_LOC_NAME, OL_LOG_STS, CPX_PROC_CD, CPX_PROC_NAME FROM IDB.OR_LOG JOIN IDB.OR_LOG_ALL_PROC ON OL_LOG_ID = OLAP_LOG_ID JOIN IDB.OR_PROC ON OLAP_OR_PROC_ID = OP_OR_PROC_ID JOIN IDB.OR_CL_PROC ON OP_OR_PROC_ID = OCP_OR_PROC_ID JOIN IDB.CL_PROC ON OCP_PROC_ID = CPX_PROC_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_LOCATION ON OL_SURG_LOC_ID = LOC_LOC_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.OR_LOG_ALL_SURG ON OLAP_LOG_ID = OLAS_LOG_ID AND OLAP_PNL_NO = OLAS_PNL_NO AND OLAS_SURG_ROLE = 'Primary' LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CRE_RES_ID = OLAS_RES_ID WHERE OL_LOG_STS NOT IN ('Can') AND OL_SURG_DTE BETWEEN '2021-12-01' AND '2022-05-02' AND LOC_LOC_NAME like '%ENDO%'

prompt: Provide a weekly list of patients who are receiving carboplatin (or are scheduled to receive carboplatin) in the next 2 weeks in Gynecology and Genitourinary services in the department of Medicine.
completion: WITH VST AS (SELECT CPE_MRN AS "MRN", PT_LAST_NAME "Last Name", PT_FIRST_NAME "First Name", CPE_APPT_DT AS "Carboplatin Infusion DateTime", CLD_DEPT_NAME AS "Department", CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 AS "Service", S.CAV_TITLE AS "Service Desc", CVT_EXT_NAME AS "Visit Type", CCH_CHEMO_NAME AS "Chemo Name", VT.CRE_RES_NAME CHEMO_RES, REF.CRE_RES_NAME REF_MD, REF.CRE_RES_TYP REF_TYPE FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PT_MRN = CPE_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE VT ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = VT.CRE_RES_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE REF ON REF.CRE_RES_ID = CPE_REF_RES_ID AND REF.CRE_RES_TYP IN ('Physician', 'Dentist', 'Psychologist', 'PhD', 'Nurse Practitioner', 'Physician Assistant', 'Advanced Practice Nurse') JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_CATEGORY D ON D.CAV_CATEGORY = 'CLD_RPT_GRP_6' AND D.CAV_ABBR = CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_CATEGORY S ON S.CAV_CATEGORY = 'CLD_RPT_GRP_8' AND S.CAV_ABBR = CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_PT_CHEMO ON CPC_CL_PT_ID = CPE_CL_PT_ID AND CPC_ENC_DTE_SEQ = CPE_ENC_DTE_SEQ LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_CHEMO ON CPC_CHEMO_ID = CCH_CHEMO_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Sch') AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT DATE AND CURRENT date + 7 DAY AND S.CAV_TITLE IN ('GYNECOLOGY', 'GERIATRICS', 'GENITOURINARY', 'GMO') AND CCH_CHEMO_NAME like '%CARBO%' AND CVT_EXT_NAME = 'Treatment' ) , MEDONC AS (SELECT "MRN" , "Last Name" , "First Name", "Carboplatin Infusion DateTime", CPE_APPT_DT VST_DT, VD.CLD_DEPT_NAME DEPT_NAME , VD.CLD_CLD_CENTER CLD_CENTER , CPE_APPT_DT APPT_DT , VT.CRE_RES_NAME VST_MD, VT.CRE_RES_TYP , CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR VST_ABBR, CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME VST_NAME , CVT_EXT_NAME VST_TYPE, ROW_NUMBER () OVER (PARTITION BY "MRN" ORDER BY CPE_APPT_DT) RN FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN VST ON "MRN" = CPE_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID = CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT VD ON CPE_DEPT_ID = VD.CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE VT ON VT.CRE_RES_ID = CPE_VST_RES_ID AND VT.CRE_RES_TYP IN ('Physician', 'PhD') LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_CATEGORY S ON S.CAV_CATEGORY = 'CLD_RPT_GRP_8' AND S.CAV_ABBR = VD.CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Sch') AND CPE_ENC_TYP_CD = 50 AND VD.CLD_CLD_CENTER IN ('68TH', '53RD') ) SELECT A."MRN", A."Last Name", A."First Name", A."Carboplatin Infusion DateTime", A."Department", A."Service", A."Service Desc", A."Visit Type", A."Chemo Name", DEPT_NAME "MedOnc Dept", APPT_DT "MedOnc Visit Dt", VST_MD "MedOnc Name", VST_TYPE "Visit Type" FROM VST A LEFT JOIN MEDONC B ON A."MRN" = B."MRN" AND RN = 1 ;

prompt: Schedule a daily and monthly report of all Adverse Drug Reactions (ADRs) in Clindoc.
completion: WITH CTE AS (SELECT DISTINCT CDD_MRN AS MRN, STRIP(PT_LAST_NAME)||', '||STRIP(PT_FIRST_NAME) AS PT_NAME, OCV_CURR_LOC AS "LOCATION", CDD_DOC_GUID AS DOC_GUID, CDD_AUTHORED_DTE AS AUTHORED_DTE, CDD_SERVICE_DTE AS SERVICE_DTE, CDD_DOC_NAME AS DOC_NAME, CDO_SECTION AS "SECTION", CDO_CTLG_DISPL_NM AS CTLG_DISPL_NM, CDO_ITEM_NAME AS ITEM_NAME, STRIP(CDO_VALUE_TEXT) AS VALUE_TEXT, CDO_MSTR_ITEM_NM AS MSTR_ITEM_NM FROM IDB.CD_DOCUMENT JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION ON CDO_DOC_GUID = CDD_DOC_GUID AND CDO_AUTHORED_DTE = CDD_AUTHORED_DTE JOIN IDB.OMS_CLIENT_VISIT ON CDD_VISIT_GUID = OCV_VISIT_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_SERVICE ON OCV_SVC_GUID = OS_SVC_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_PROVIDER ON CDD_AUTH_PROV_GUID = OP_PVDR_GUID JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON CDD_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE CDD_CANCEL_IND = '0' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND = '0' AND CDD_SERVICE_DTE = CURRENT DATE - 1 DAY AND CDO_MSTR_ITEM_NM IN ('NUR_ADR_Date DTM', 'NUR_ADR_Drug Name 1 RES', 'NUR_ADR_Drug Name (Other) FT', 'NUR_ADR_Systems RES', 'NUR_ADR_Systems Other FT', 'NUR_ADR_Intervention RES', 'NUR_ADR_Intervention 2 SUG', 'NUR_ADR_Case Details FT', 'NUR_ADR_Paient Sent to RES', 'NUR_ADR_Cardiovascular RES', 'NUR_ADR_General RES', 'NUR_ADR_GI RES', 'NUR_ADR_Musculoskeletal RES', 'NUR_ADR_Neurology RES', 'NUR_ADR_Psych RES', 'NUR_ADR_Respiratory RES', 'NUR_ADR_Skin RES' ) ) , EVENT_DATE AS (SELECT DOC_GUID, MAX(CASE WHEN MSTR_ITEM_NM = 'NUR_ADR_Date DTM' THEN VALUE_TEXT END) AS EVENT_DATE FROM CTE GROUP BY DOC_GUID) , CASE_DETAILS AS (SELECT DOC_GUID, MAX(CASE WHEN MSTR_ITEM_NM = 'NUR_ADR_Case Details FT' THEN VALUE_TEXT END) AS CASE_DETAILS FROM CTE GROUP BY DOC_GUID) , DRUG_NAME AS (SELECT DOC_GUID, MAX(CASE WHEN MSTR_ITEM_NM = 'NUR_ADR_Drug Name 1 RES' THEN VALUE_TEXT END) AS DRUG_NAME FROM CTE GROUP BY DOC_GUID) , DRUG_NAME_OTHER AS (SELECT DOC_GUID, MAX(CASE WHEN MSTR_ITEM_NM = 'NUR_ADR_Drug Name (Other) FT' THEN VALUE_TEXT END) AS DRUG_NAME_OTHER FROM CTE GROUP BY DOC_GUID) , SYSTEMS AS (SELECT DOC_GUID, MAX(CASE WHEN MSTR_ITEM_NM = 'NUR_ADR_Systems RES' THEN VALUE_TEXT END) AS SYSTEMS FROM CTE GROUP BY DOC_GUID) , SYSTEMS_OTHER AS (SELECT DOC_GUID, MAX(CASE WHEN MSTR_ITEM_NM = 'NUR_ADR_Systems Other FT' THEN VALUE_TEXT END) AS SYSTEMS_OTHER FROM CTE GROUP BY DOC_GUID) , INTERVENTION AS (SELECT DOC_GUID, MAX(CASE WHEN MSTR_ITEM_NM = 'NUR_ADR_Intervention RES' THEN VALUE_TEXT END) AS INTERVENTION FROM CTE GROUP BY DOC_GUID) , INTERVENTION_OTHER AS (SELECT DOC_GUID, MAX(CASE WHEN MSTR_ITEM_NM = 'NUR_ADR_Intervention 2 SUG' THEN VALUE_TEXT END) AS INTERVENTION_OTHER FROM CTE GROUP BY DOC_GUID) , CARDIOVASCULAR AS (SELECT DOC_GUID, MAX(CASE WHEN MSTR_ITEM_NM = 'NUR_ADR_Cardiovascular RES' THEN VALUE_TEXT END) AS CARDIOVASCULAR FROM CTE GROUP BY DOC_GUID) , GENERAL AS (SELECT DOC_GUID, MAX(CASE WHEN MSTR_ITEM_NM = 'NUR_ADR_General RESS' THEN VALUE_TEXT END) AS GENERAL FROM CTE GROUP BY DOC_GUID) , GI AS (SELECT DOC_GUID, MAX(CASE WHEN MSTR_ITEM_NM = 'NUR_ADR_GI RES' THEN VALUE_TEXT END) AS GI FROM CTE GROUP BY DOC_GUID) , MUSCULOSKELETAL AS (SELECT DOC_GUID, MAX(CASE WHEN MSTR_ITEM_NM = 'NUR_ADR_Musculoskeletal RES' THEN VALUE_TEXT END) AS MUSCULOSKELETAL FROM CTE GROUP BY DOC_GUID) , NEUROLOGY AS (SELECT DOC_GUID, MAX(CASE WHEN MSTR_ITEM_NM = 'NUR_ADR_Neurology RES' THEN VALUE_TEXT END) AS NEUROLOGY FROM CTE GROUP BY DOC_GUID) , PSYCH AS (SELECT DOC_GUID, MAX(CASE WHEN MSTR_ITEM_NM = 'NUR_ADR_Psych RES' THEN VALUE_TEXT END) AS PSYCH FROM CTE GROUP BY DOC_GUID) , RESPIRATORY AS (SELECT DOC_GUID, MAX(CASE WHEN MSTR_ITEM_NM = 'NUR_ADR_Respiratory RES' THEN VALUE_TEXT END) AS RESPIRATORY FROM CTE GROUP BY DOC_GUID) , SKIN AS (SELECT DOC_GUID, MAX(CASE WHEN MSTR_ITEM_NM = 'NUR_ADR_Skin RES' THEN VALUE_TEXT END) AS SKIN FROM CTE GROUP BY DOC_GUID) , PATIENT_SENT_TO AS (SELECT DOC_GUID, MAX(CASE WHEN MSTR_ITEM_NM = 'NUR_ADR_Paient Sent to RES' THEN VALUE_TEXT END) AS PATIENT_SENT_TO FROM CTE GROUP BY DOC_GUID) SELECT CTE.MRN, CTE.PT_NAME, CTE."LOCATION", CTE.DOC_GUID, CTE.AUTHORED_DTE, CTE.SERVICE_DTE, CTE.DOC_NAME, CTE."SECTION", EVENT_DATE, CASE_DETAILS, DRUG_NAME, DRUG_NAME_OTHER, SYSTEMS, SYSTEMS_OTHER, INTERVENTION, INTERVENTION_OTHER, CARDIOVASCULAR, GENERAL, GI, MUSCULOSKELETAL, NEUROLOGY, PSYCH, RESPIRATORY, SKIN, PATIENT_SENT_TO FROM CTE LEFT JOIN EVENT_DATE ON CTE.DOC_GUID = EVENT_DATE.DOC_GUID LEFT JOIN CASE_DETAILS ON CTE.DOC_GUID = CASE_DETAILS.DOC_GUID LEFT JOIN DRUG_NAME ON CTE.DOC_GUID = DRUG_NAME.DOC_GUID LEFT JOIN DRUG_NAME_OTHER ON CTE.DOC_GUID = DRUG_NAME_OTHER.DOC_GUID LEFT JOIN SYSTEMS ON CTE.DOC_GUID = SYSTEMS.DOC_GUID LEFT JOIN SYSTEMS_OTHER ON CTE.DOC_GUID = SYSTEMS_OTHER.DOC_GUID LEFT JOIN INTERVENTION ON CTE.DOC_GUID = INTERVENTION.DOC_GUID LEFT JOIN INTERVENTION_OTHER ON CTE.DOC_GUID = INTERVENTION_OTHER.DOC_GUID LEFT JOIN CARDIOVASCULAR ON CTE.DOC_GUID = CARDIOVASCULAR.DOC_GUID LEFT JOIN GENERAL ON CTE.DOC_GUID = GENERAL.DOC_GUID LEFT JOIN GI ON CTE.DOC_GUID = GI.DOC_GUID LEFT JOIN MUSCULOSKELETAL ON CTE.DOC_GUID = MUSCULOSKELETAL.DOC_GUID LEFT JOIN NEUROLOGY ON CTE.DOC_GUID = NEUROLOGY.DOC_GUID LEFT JOIN PSYCH ON CTE.DOC_GUID = PSYCH.DOC_GUID LEFT JOIN RESPIRATORY ON CTE.DOC_GUID = RESPIRATORY.DOC_GUID LEFT JOIN SKIN ON CTE.DOC_GUID = SKIN.DOC_GUID LEFT JOIN PATIENT_SENT_TO ON CTE.DOC_GUID = PATIENT_SENT_TO.DOC_GUID

prompt: Invitation to livestream Comedy vs Cancer, a standup comedy show benefiting blood cancer research at MSK.
completion: SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME "Last Name", PT_FIRST_NAME "First Name", CPP_EMAIL_ADDR AS "Email Address" FROM IDB.PATIENT JOIN IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER ON PT_MRN = CPE_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY ON CPE_MRN = PLA_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_PAS_PATIENT ON CPE_MRN = CPP_MRN WHERE PT_STATE IN ('NY', 'NJ', 'CT', 'PA') AND PT_DEATH_IND IN ('', 'A') AND YEAR(CURRENT DATE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) BETWEEN 18 AND 90 AND CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND YEAR(CPE_ENC_DTE) = '2022' AND (CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 <> 'NUR') AND (CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 IN ('BMT', 'LEU', 'LYM', 'MYL')) AND CRE_RES_TYP = 'Physician' AND (PLA_DONOT_MAIL_IND <> 'Y') AND (CPP_EMAIL_ADDR <> '') AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 IN ('BMT', 'LEU', 'LYM', 'MYL') ;

prompt: Provide a weekly list of patients with a financial clearance order for single agent pembrolizumab (either 3 week or 6 week dosing schedule)
completion: WITH DRUG AS (SELECT DISTINCT OO_MRN, OOC_ITEM_NAME, OOC_ITEM_DESC, OO_ENTER_DTE, OO_SCHEDULED_DT AS SCH_DTE, OP_DISPLAY_NAME, OSTS_STS_DESC, DRUG.OUD_USER_DI_VALUE AS DRUG_NAME FROM IDB.OMS_ORDER JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_CATALOG ON OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID = OOC_MSTR_ITEM_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_STATUS ON OO_ORD_STS_CD = OSTS_ORD_STS_CD JOIN IDB.OMS_PROVIDER ON OO_PVDR_GUID = OP_PVDR_GUID LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_USER_DATA DRUG ON DRUG.OUD_ORD_GUID = OO_ORD_GUID WHERE DRUG.OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'PreAuthChemo_Drug Names' AND UPPER(DRUG.OUD_USER_DI_VALUE) LIKE '%PEMBROLIZUMAB%' AND OO_ENTER_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT DATE - 7 DAY AND CURRENT DATE - 1 DAY ), CYCLE_INT AS (SELECT DISTINCT OO_MRN AS CYCLE_MRN, OO_SCHEDULED_DT CYC_SCH_DTE, DRUG.OUD_USER_DI_VALUE AS CYCLE_INTERVAL FROM IDB.OMS_ORDER JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_CATALOG ON OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID = OOC_MSTR_ITEM_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_STATUS ON OO_ORD_STS_CD = OSTS_ORD_STS_CD LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_USER_DATA DRUG ON DRUG.OUD_ORD_GUID = OO_ORD_GUID WHERE DRUG.OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'PreAuthChemo_Interval1' ) SELECT DISTINCT OO_MRN AS MRN, PT_LAST_NAME AS "Patient Last Name", YEAR(CURRENT_DATE- PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) AS "Age", G.AV_DESC AS GENDER, OO_ENTER_DTE AS "Order Enter Date", OSTS_STS_DESC AS "Order Status Description", OOC_ITEM_NAME AS "Order Item Name", OP_DISPLAY_NAME AS "Provider Namee", DRUG_NAME AS "Drug Name", CYCLE_INTERVAL AS "Cycle Interval" FROM DRUG JOIN CYCLE_INT ON OO_MRN = CYCLE_MRN JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON OO_MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS G ON G.AV_ELEMENT = 'SEX' AND G.AV_CODE = PT_SEX WHERE CYCLE_INTERVAL IN ('3 weeks', '6 weeks')

prompt: Provide identified data for Darwin query related to breast cancer metastases.
completion: SELECT DISTINCT "t1"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AS "Deident PT #", "t2"."PT_MRN" AS "MRN", "t2"."PT_BIRTH_DTE" AS "Date of Birth", "t3"."ICSC_SITE_CD" AS "ICD-O Site Code", "t3"."ICSC_ICDO_SITE_MSK_DESC" AS "ICD-O Site Description", "t4"."DT_DTE" AS "Tumor Diagnosis Date", "t5"."PRPT_ACCESSION_NO" AS "Pathology Report", "t6"."DT_DTE" AS "Pathology Report Date" FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED" "t1" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V" "t2" ON "t1"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t2"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."CDB_TUMOR_V" "t7" ON "t1"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t7"."CDTM_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."ICDO_SITE_CATALOG_V" "t3" ON "t7"."CDTM_SITE_CATALOG_ID" = "t3"."ICSC_SITE_CATALOG_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" "t4" ON "t7"."CDTM_DX_DATE_ID" = "t4"."DT_DATE_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V" "t5" ON "t1"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t5"."PRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" "t6" ON "t5"."PRPT_REPORT_DATE_ID" = "t6"."DT_DATE_ID" WHERE (("t6"."DT_YEAR" BETWEEN 2009 AND 2013 AND (1 = 1 AND (1 = 1 AND (1 = 1 AND CONTAINS("t5"."PRPT_REPORT", '((((("metastasis" | "metastases") & "brain") & (("lung" | "liver" | "bone" | "lymph node") & ("metastasis" | "metastases"))) & ((("primary" | ("invasive" | "in situ" | "in-situ") | ("ductal" | "lobular" | "mammary")) & "carcinoma") & "breast")) & NOT "adenocarcinoma" & NOT "melanoma")') = 1)))) AND "t5"."PRPT_REPORT" IS NOT NULL)

prompt: : Requesting Patients who have had an Outpatient Enteral Order put in. Will have Data Line add home address and portal status afterwards, as those couldn't be added here.

"IDB"."OMS_ORDER"."OO_ENTER_DTE" AS ORDER_ENTER_DATE, "IDB"."OMS_ORDER"."OO_ORD_NAME" AS ORDER_NAME , HOMECARE.OUD_USER_DI_VALUE AS "Home Care" FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS" JOIN "IDB"."OMS_ORDER" ON "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_MRN" = "IDB"."OMS_ORDER"."OO_MRN" LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_USER_DATA HOMECARE ON OO_ORD_GUID = HOMECARE.OUD_ORD_GUID AND HOMECARE.OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'Diet_OP_Ent_Feed_Home_Care' WHERE "IDB"."OMS_ORDER"."OO_ENTER_DTE" BETWEEN '2020-01-01' AND '2023-01-13' AND "IDB"."OMS_ORDER"."OO_ORD_NAME" IN ('Outpatient Enteral Feed')) , DEMOGRAPHICS_1 AS (SELECT DISTINCT "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AS PT_DEID, "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_MRN" AS PT_MRN, "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_LAST_NAME" AS PT_LAST_NAME, "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_FIRST_NAME" AS PT_FIRST_NAME, "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_ADDR1" AS PT_ADDR1, "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_ADDR2" AS PT_ADDR2, "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_CITY" AS PT_CITY, "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_STATE" AS PT_STATE, "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_ZIP_CD" AS PT_ZIP_CD, "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AS SUBJECT_ID, "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_VITAL_STATUS" AS VITAL_STATS FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS" WHERE "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_VITAL_STATUS" IN ('ALIVE')) , PRIMARY_ONCOLOGIST_PRE AS (SELECT PD.PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID PID, PT_MRN AS MRN, COALESCE(LOWER(CPA_ATTRIBUTE_VALUE), '') AS PRIM_ONCO_EMAIL FROM DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS PD LEFT JOIN DVCMS.COHORT_PATIENT_ATTRIBUTES ON CPA_COHORT_ID = 4368 AND PD.PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = CPA_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID WHERE 1 = 1) , PRIMARY_ONCOLOGIST AS (SELECT PID , MRN , PRIM_ONCO_EMAIL , CASE WHEN PRIM_ONCO_EMAIL = '' THEN '' ELSE DV.LDAPQUERY(PRIM_ONCO_EMAIL, 'mail', 'sn') END PRIM_ONCO_LAST_NAME , CASE WHEN PRIM_ONCO_EMAIL = '' THEN '' ELSE DV.LDAPQUERY(PRIM_ONCO_EMAIL, 'mail', 'givenName') END PRIM_ONCO_FIRST_NAME FROM PRIMARY_ONCOLOGIST_PRE) SELECT * FROM ORDERS_0 AS O JOIN DEMOGRAPHICS_1 AS D ON O.PT_MRN = D.PT_MRN LEFT JOIN PRIMARY_ONCOLOGIST AS P ON O.PT_MRN = P.MRN ORDER BY O.PT_MRN

completion: SELECT DISTINCT PRPT_MRN "MRN" , PT_BIRTH_DTE "DATE OF BIRTH" , PT_DEATH_DTE "DATE OF DEATH" , PT_RACE_DESC "RACE" , CORE_ETHNICITY_DESC "ETHNICITY" , PRPT_PROCEDURE_DTE "PROCEDURE DATE" , PRPT_ACCESSION_NO "ACCESSION NUMBER" , PRPT_REPORT_TYPE_DESC "REPORT TYPE DESC" , CAST(PRPT_REPORT AS VARCHAR(24000)) AS "REPORT TEXT" FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V ON PRPT_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN DV.PATIENT_CORE_DEMOGRAPHICS ON CORE_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID WHERE CONTAINS("PRPT_REPORT", '("TAILGUT")') = 1 AND (PRPT_PROCEDURE_DTE) BETWEEN '2004-01-01' AND '2021-05-31' ; WITH MAIN AS (SELECT DISTINCT CC_MRN, CLM_CLSF_CD AS DX_CODE, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS DX_DESC, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS DX_DATE FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND ((CC_PT_TYPE = 'I') OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) AND CLM_CLSF_CD IN ('Q85.9', 'Q85.89', 'Q85.83', 'Q85.82', 'Q85.81', 'Q85.8', 'Q85.1', 'Q85.09', 'Q85.03', 'Q85.02', 'Q85.01', 'Q85.00', 'Q85.0', 'Q85', 'C41.4', 'K62.89', '569.42', '569.49', '170.6', '237.70', '237.71', '237.72', '237.70', '237.73', '237.79', '759.5', '759.6') GROUP BY CC_MRN, CLM_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK HAVING (MIN(CC_EFF_DTE)) BETWEEN '2004-01-01' AND '2021-05-31') SELECT DISTINCT CC_MRN "MRN" , PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH "DATE OF BIRTH" , PT_DATE_OF_DEATH "DATE OF DEATH" , TRIM(R.AV_DESC) "RACE" , TRIM(E.AV_DESC) "ETHNICITY" , DX_DATE "DIAGNOSIS DATE" , DX_CODE "DIAGNOSIS CODE" , DX_DESC "DIAGNOSIS DESC" FROM MAIN JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON CC_MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS R ON R.AV_CODE = PT_RACE AND R.AV_ELEMENT = 'RACE' LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS E ON E.AV_CODE = PT_PT_ETHNICITY AND E.AV_ELEMENT = 'PT_ETHNICITY' ;

completion: SELECT DISTINCT PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID AS PT_DEID, OOTO_SIGNIFIC_DTE AS ADMIN_DATE, SUBSTR(CHAR(OOTO_SIGNIFIC_DTE), 1, 7) RPT_MONTH, OOC_ITEM_NAME AS DRUG_NAME, OOTO_TASK_DOSE DOSE, OOTO_TASK_UOM DOSE_UOM, OOTO_TASK_ROUTE_CD ROUTE, OOC_REV_CAT_DEPT AS REVIEW_CATEGORY, OP_DISPLAY_NAME REQUESTER, OU_ORD_ROLE_TYPE REQUESTER_ROLE, OCV_IP_OP_IND IP_OP_IND, LGR_LOC_NAME LOCATION, LGR_AMB_LOCATION CENTER FROM IDB.OAS_ORD_TASK_OCCR JOIN IDB.OAS_CTLG_ITEM_TASK ON OOTO_CAT_ITEM_GUID = OCIT_GUID AND OCIT_LEVEL_NO = 0 AND OOTO_STATUS_CD = 'Performed' JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_CATALOG ON OCIT_MST_ITEM_GUID = OOC_MSTR_ITEM_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_ORDER ON OO_ORD_GUID = OOTO_ORD_GUID JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V ON OO_MRN=PT_MRN JOIN IDB.OMS_PROVIDER ON OO_PVDR_GUID = OP_PVDR_GUID LEFT JOIN IDB.DOC ON OP_PVDR_NO = DOC_DR_NO JOIN IDB.OMS_USER ON OP_PVDR_GUID = OU_USER_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_CLIENT_VISIT ON OO_VISIT_GUID = OCV_VISIT_GUID LEFT JOIN IDB.LOCATION_GROUPS_REFERENCE ON LGR_LOC_GUID = OCV_CURR_LOC_GUID WHERE OO_ORD_STS_CD NOT IN ('CANP', 'CANC', 'AUC3') AND OOTO_SIGNIFIC_DTE >= '1/1/2015' AND (DOC_ACDMC_SVC LIKE '%DERMATOLOGY%' OR OP_PVDR_GUID IN ('9000340277301190', '3000005639119029', '6000004675119029')) AND (LOWER(OOC_ITEM_NAME) LIKE '%omalizumab%' OR LOWER(OOC_ITEM_NAME) LIKE '%dupilumab%' OR LOWER(OOC_ITEM_NAME) LIKE '%infliximab%' OR LOWER(OOC_ITEM_NAME) LIKE '%ustekinumab%' OR LOWER(OOC_ITEM_NAME) LIKE '%etanercept%' OR LOWER(OOC_ITEM_NAME) LIKE '%risankizumab%' OR LOWER(OOC_ITEM_NAME) LIKE '%immune%globulin%iv%' OR LOWER(OOC_ITEM_NAME) LIKE '%rituximab%' OR LOWER(OOC_ITEM_NAME) LIKE '%guselkumab%') ORDER BY 2

prompt: Create a report of patients with New Visit to the Leukemia Service from 1/1/2009 to 3/31/2019.
completion: WITH LEU AS (SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN AS MRN, STRIP(PT_LAST_NAME) AS LAST_NAME, STRIP(PT_FIRST_NAME) AS FIRST_NAME, STRIP(PT_SEX) AS GENDER, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH AS DOB, CPE_ENC_DTE, STRIP(CRE_RES_NAME) AS CRE_RES_NAME, STRIP(CLD_DEPT_NAME) AS CLD_DEPT_NAME, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8, STRIP(CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR) AS CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR, CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON CPE_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CRE_RES_TYP IN ('Physician') AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN '2009-01-01' AND '2019-03-31' AND(CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 = 'LEU' OR CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME LIKE '%LEU%') AND(CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR LIKE '%NV%' OR CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR LIKE '%IR%') ) , X AS (SELECT TM_MRN AS DX_MRN, TM_DX_DTE AS DX_DATE, TM_SITE_CD AS SITE_CODE, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_DESC, TM_HIST_CD AS HIST_CODE, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS HIST_DESC FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM H ON TM_HIST_CD = H.CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON TM_SITE_CD = S.CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('3', '6', '7', '8') AND TM_MRN IN (SELECT MRN FROM LEU) UNION SELECT CC_MRN AS DX_MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS DX_DATE, CLM_CLSF_CD AS SITE_CODE, CLM_CLSF_DESC AS SITE_DESC, '' AS HIST_CODE, '' AS HIST_DESC FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND ((CC_PT_TYPE = 'I') OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) AND(CLM_CLSF_CD BETWEEN 'C00' AND 'D49.9' OR CLM_CLSF_CD BETWEEN '140' AND '239.9') AND CC_MRN IN (SELECT MRN FROM LEU) GROUP BY CC_MRN, CLM_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC ) , CTE AS (SELECT DX_MRN, DX_DATE, REPLACE((STRIP(SITE_CODE) || '-' || STRIP(SITE_DESC) || '|' || STRIP(HIST_CODE) || '-' || STRIP(HIST_DESC)),'|-', '') AS DX_CODE FROM X) , CTE2 AS (SELECT * FROM CTE ORDER BY DX_MRN, DX_DATE, DX_CODE) , T1 AS (SELECT DX_MRN, DX_DATE, DX_CODE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY DX_MRN ORDER BY DX_DATE) AS RN FROM CTE2 ORDER BY DX_MRN, DX_DATE) , T2 (MRN, DX, RN1) AS (SELECT DX_MRN, CAST(DX_DATE AS VARCHAR(12000))||' | '||CAST(DX_CODE AS VARCHAR(300)), RN FROM T1 WHERE T1.RN = 1 UNION ALL SELECT DX_MRN, RTRIM(CAST(DX AS VARCHAR(6000))) || ', ' || CHR(13) || CHR(10) || CAST(DX_DATE AS VARCHAR(300))||' | '||RTRIM(CAST(DX_CODE AS VARCHAR(300))) , RN1 + 1 FROM T1, T2 WHERE DX_MRN = MRN AND RN = RN1+1 ) , T3 AS (SELECT MRN, MAX(RN1) RN FROM T2 GROUP BY MRN) , T4 AS (SELECT T2.MRN, RN, DX FROM T2 JOIN T3 ON T2.MRN = T3.MRN AND T2.RN1 = T3.RN) SELECT LEU.*, DX FROM LEU LEFT JOIN T4 ON LEU.MRN = T4.MRN

prompt: Provide a report of completed hydration procedures ordered in RO Clinic 2.
completion: SELECT RPT_MONTH, COUNT(DISTINCT MRN) PTS , COUNT(*) AS TTL_HYDRATION_VTS , COUNT(*) - COALESCE(SUM(ADDON_IND), 0) AS REG_HYDR_VTS , SUM(MAGNESIUM_IND) AS MAGNESIUM_ADDON , SUM(POTASSIUM_IND) AS POTASSIUM_ADDON , SUM(ADDON_IND) AS TTL_ADDON_VTS , SUM(EMAR_TASK_CNT) EMAR_TASKS , SUM(ADDON_IND)*100.0/COUNT(*) AS PCT_ADDON , (COUNT(*) - COALESCE(SUM(ADDON_IND), 0))*100.0/COUNT(*) AS PCT_REGULAR FROM (SELECT CPE_MRN MRN, CPE_ENC_DTE VST_DTE , DATE(SUBSTR(CHAR(CPE_ENC_DTE), 1, 8)||'01') RPT_MONTH , SUBSTR(CHAR(CPE_ENC_DTE), 1, 5)|| CASE WHEN MONTH(CPE_ENC_DTE) BETWEEN 1 AND 3 THEN 'Q1' WHEN MONTH(CPE_ENC_DTE) BETWEEN 4 AND 6 THEN 'Q2' WHEN MONTH(CPE_ENC_DTE) BETWEEN 7 AND 9 THEN 'Q3' ELSE 'Q4' END AS RPT_QTR , SUBSTR(OO_ORD_NAME, 1, 13) ORDER_NAME , MAX(CASE WHEN MAG.OOA_ADD_NAME IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END) MAGNESIUM_IND , MAX(CASE WHEN POT.OOA_ADD_NAME IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END) POTASSIUM_IND , MAX(CASE WHEN COALESCE(MAG.OOA_ADD_NAME, POT.OOA_ADD_NAME) IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END) ADDON_IND , COUNT(DISTINCT OOTO_PERF_FROM_DT) EMAR_TASK_CNT , CASE WHEN MAX(COALESCE(MAG.OOA_ADD_NAME, POT.OOA_ADD_NAME)) IS NOT NULL THEN 'Hydration Add-on' ELSE 'Regular Hydration' END ORD_TYPE , DAYOFWEEK_ISO(CPE_ENC_DTE) DOW , CASE WHEN DAYOFWEEK_ISO(CPE_ENC_DTE) = 1 THEN 'Mon' WHEN DAYOFWEEK_ISO(CPE_ENC_DTE) = 2 THEN 'Tue' WHEN DAYOFWEEK_ISO(CPE_ENC_DTE) = 3 THEN 'Wed' WHEN DAYOFWEEK_ISO(CPE_ENC_DTE) = 4 THEN 'Thu' WHEN DAYOFWEEK_ISO(CPE_ENC_DTE) = 5 THEN 'Fri' WHEN DAYOFWEEK_ISO(CPE_ENC_DTE) = 6 THEN 'Sat' ELSE 'Sun' END AS DOWX FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CRE_RES_ID = CPE_VST_RES_ID AND CRE_RES_TYP = 'Nurse' JOIN IDB.OMS_ORDER ON CPE_MRN = OO_MRN AND CPE_ENC_DTE = OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_CATALOG ON OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID = OOC_MSTR_ITEM_GUID LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_ADDITIVE MAG ON OO_ORD_GUID = MAG.OOA_ORD_GUID AND MAG.OOA_ADD_NAME LIKE 'Magnesium Sulf%' LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_ADDITIVE POT ON OO_ORD_GUID = POT.OOA_ORD_GUID AND POT.OOA_ADD_NAME LIKE 'Potassium Chloride%' JOIN IDB.OAS_ORD_TASK_OCCR ON OOTO_ORD_GUID = OO_ORD_GUID AND OOTO_STATUS_CD = 'Performed' AND OOTO_SIGNIFIC_DTE = OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE JOIN IDB.OAS_CTLG_ITEM_TASK CAT ON OOTO_CAT_ITEM_GUID = OCIT_GUID AND OCIT_LEVEL_NO = 0 WHERE CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN CASE WHEN MONTH(CURRENT DATE) < 3 THEN = 'IV Fluids' GROUP BY CPE_MRN, CPE_ENC_DTE, CPE_ENC_DTE, SUBSTR(OO_ORD_NAME, 1, 13)) HYDR GROUP BY RPT_MONTH

prompt: I'm requesting a list of patients who have received ketamine infusion during hu3F8 treatment while admitted inpatient between 2016-2020.
completion: WITH HU3F8 AS (SELECT VISIT_GUID, MRN , ORD_NAME , MIN(START_DATE) START_DATE, MAX(STOP_DATE) STOP_DATE FROM (SELECT CIS_VISIT_NO, VISIT_GUID, ORD_STS, MRN, PT_NAME , PT_AGE, CURR_LOC, IP_OP_IND, CIS_SERVICE , ORD_NAME, DRUG_NAME, DOSE, DOSE_UOM , INFUSION_RATE, ORDERING_PVDR_NO, ORDERING_PVDR_NAME , TIME_PRIORITY, START_DATE, STOP_DATE, ROUTE, ORD_FREQ , OCV_ADM_DT, OCV_DSCH_DT, OCV_IP_OP_IND, SET_NAME FROM IDB.SRX_PHARMACY_SUM JOIN IDB.OMS_CLIENT_VISIT ON VISIT_GUID = OCV_VISIT_GUID JOIN IDB.VISIT_V ON OCV_ADM_NUM = VIS_ADM_NUM WHERE ORD_NAME like '%Hu3F8%' ) AS A GROUP BY VISIT_GUID, MRN , ORD_NAME) SELECT SRX.MRN, SRX.PT_NAME , SRX.PT_AGE, SRX.CURR_LOC, SRX.IP_OP_IND, SRX.CIS_SERVICE , SRX.ORD_NAME , SRX.DRUG_NAME , SUM(SRX.DOSE) TOTAL_DOSE, SRX.DOSE_UOM , MIN(SRX.START_DATE) START_DATE, MAX(SRX.STOP_DATE) STOP_DATE, SRX.ROUTE, SRX.ORD_FREQ , ADM.DATE_OF_DEATH, ADM.DATE_OF_BIRTH, ADM.AGE_AT_ADMIT, ADM.ADM_TYPE_DESC, ADM.ADMIT_DT, ADM.DISCHARGE_DT, ADM.LOS, ADM.ADMITTING_DIAGNOSIS, ADM.ADM_DIAG_DESC, ADM.FINAL_DIAGNOSIS, ADM.FINAL_DIAG_DESC FROM HU3F8 X JOIN IDB.SRX_PHARMACY_SUM SRX ON X.MRN = SRX.MRN JOIN IDB.OMS_CLIENT_VISIT ON SRX.VISIT_GUID = OCV_VISIT_GUID JOIN IDB.VISIT_V ON OCV_ADM_NUM = VIS_ADM_NUM JOIN IDB.INPATIENT_ADMISSIONS_V ADM ON ADMIT_ID = VIS_ADM_NUM WHERE (UPPER(DRUG_NAME) LIKE '%KETAMIN%') GROUP BY SRX.MRN, SRX.PT_NAME , SRX.PT_AGE, SRX.CURR_LOC, SRX.IP_OP_IND, SRX.CIS_SERVICE , SRX.ORD_NAME , SRX.DRUG_NAME, SRX.DOSE_UOM , SRX.ROUTE, SRX.ORD_FREQ , ADM.DATE_OF_DEATH, ADM.DATE_OF_BIRTH, ADM.AGE_AT_ADMIT, ADM.ADM_TYPE_DESC, ADM.ADMIT_DT, ADM.DISCHARGE_DT, ADM.LOS, ADM.ADMITTING_DIAGNOSIS, ADM.ADM_DIAG_DESC, ADM.FINAL_DIAGNOSIS, ADM.FINAL_DIAG_DESC ;

prompt: Requesting the number of young onset GI patient visits (diagnosed <50 years old) in the past year per month.
completion: WITH APPTCOL AS (SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN, CPE_ENC_DTE, YEAR(CPE_ENC_DTE) || ' - ' || MONTH(CPE_ENC_DTE) AS MONTH_YR, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 AS APPT_SERVICE, CPE_DEPT_ID, CLD_DEPT_NAME AS DEPT_NAME, CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID, CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME, CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND UPPER(CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8) = 'COL' AND CPE_DEPT_ID IN ('60', '61', '1084', '1116', '1383', '1410', '1653') AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN '2022-06-01' AND '2023-05-31' ) , CDBCOL AS (SELECT DISTINCT TM_MRN, TM_DX_DTE, CONCAT(CONCAT(RTRIM(TM_SITE_CD), '-'), S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK) AS CDB_SITE, CONCAT(CONCAT(RTRIM(TM_HIST_CD), '-'), H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK) AS CDB_HIST FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS ON AV_ELEMENT = 'CASE_STS' AND AV_CODE = TM_CASE_STS JOIN APPTCOL ON CPE_MRN = TM_MRN WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND (TM_SITE_CD LIKE 'C18%' OR TM_SITE_CD LIKE 'C19%' OR TM_SITE_CD LIKE 'C20%') ) , IDBCOL AS (SELECT DISTINCT CC_MRN, CC_CLSF_CD AS IDB_CODE, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS IDB_DESC, MIN (CC_EFF_DTE) AS MIN_DX_DTE FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN APPTCOL ON CC_MRN = CPE_MRN WHERE 1=1 AND (CC_CLSF_CD LIKE 'C18%' OR CC_CLSF_CD LIKE 'C19%' OR CC_CLSF_CD LIKE 'C20%') GROUP BY CC_MRN, CC_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK ) , DXCOL AS (SELECT DISTINCT DX_MRN, DX_CODE, DX_DESC, MIN (DX_DTE) AS DX_DTE FROM (SELECT TM_MRN AS DX_MRN, TM_DX_DTE AS DX_DTE, CDB_SITE AS DX_CODE, CDB_HIST AS DX_DESC FROM CDBCOL UNION SELECT CC_MRN AS DX_MRN, MIN_DX_DTE AS DX_DTE, IDB_CODE AS DX_CODE, IDB_DESC AS DX_DESC FROM IDBCOL) GROUP BY DX_MRN, DX_CODE, DX_DESC) , FINALRPT AS (SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN, CPE_ENC_DTE, DX_DTE, CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR FROM APPTCOL JOIN DXCOL ON CPE_MRN = DX_MRN JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PT_MRN = CPE_MRN WHERE YEAR(DX_DTE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) < 50 ORDER BY CPE_MRN) SELECT YEAR (CPE_ENC_DTE) AS APPT_YEAR, MONTH (CPE_ENC_DTE) AS APPT_MONTH, COUNT (CPE_MRN) AS APPT_COUNT FROM FINALRPT GROUP BY YEAR (CPE_ENC_DTE) , MONTH (CPE_ENC_DTE) ; WITH APPTGI AS (SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN, CPE_ENC_DTE, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 AS APPT_SERVICE, CPE_DEPT_ID, CLD_DEPT_NAME AS DEPT_NAME, CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID, CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME, CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN '2022-06-01' AND '2023-05-31' AND UPPER(CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8) = 'GI' AND CPE_DEPT_ID IN ('213', '260', '338', '409', '546', '733', '851', '1171', '1210', '1222', '1228', '1301', '1473', '1579', '1654', '1725', '1923') ) , CDBGI AS (SELECT DISTINCT TM_MRN, TM_DX_DTE, CONCAT(CONCAT(RTRIM(TM_SITE_CD), '-'), S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK) AS CDB_SITE, CONCAT(CONCAT(RTRIM(TM_HIST_CD), '-'), H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK) AS CDB_HIST FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS ON AV_ELEMENT = 'CASE_STS' AND AV_CODE = TM_CASE_STS JOIN APPTGI ON CPE_MRN = TM_MRN JOIN DV.SEERGROUPING ON DV.SEERF_ICDO(TM_SITE_CD, TM_HIST_CD) = RECODE AND CATEGORY1 IN ('Digestive System') WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') ) , IDBGI AS (SELECT DISTINCT CC_MRN, CC_CLSF_CD AS IDB_CODE, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS IDB_DESC, MIN (CC_EFF_DTE) AS MIN_DX_DTE FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN APPTGI ON CC_MRN = CPE_MRN WHERE 1=1 AND (CC_CLSF_CD LIKE 'C15%' OR CC_CLSF_CD LIKE 'C16%' OR CC_CLSF_CD LIKE 'C17%' OR CC_CLSF_CD LIKE 'C18%' OR CC_CLSF_CD LIKE 'C19%' OR CC_CLSF_CD LIKE 'C20%' OR CC_CLSF_CD LIKE 'C21%' OR CC_CLSF_CD LIKE 'C22%' OR CC_CLSF_CD LIKE 'C23%' OR CC_CLSF_CD LIKE 'C24%' OR CC_CLSF_CD LIKE 'C25%' OR CC_CLSF_CD LIKE 'C26%' OR CC_CLSF_CD LIKE 'C48%' OR CC_CLSF_CD LIKE 'C7A%') AND CC_CLSF_CD NOT IN ('C2639', 'C1751', 'C1788', 'C2639') GROUP BY CC_MRN, CC_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK) , DXGI AS (SELECT DISTINCT DX_MRN, DX_CODE, DX_DESC, MIN (DX_DTE) AS DX_DTE FROM (SELECT TM_MRN AS DX_MRN, TM_DX_DTE AS DX_DTE, CDB_SITE AS DX_CODE, CDB_HIST AS DX_DESC FROM CDBGI UNION SELECT CC_MRN AS DX_MRN, MIN_DX_DTE AS DX_DTE, IDB_CODE AS DX_CODE, IDB_DESC AS DX_DESC FROM IDBGI) GROUP BY DX_MRN, DX_CODE, DX_DESC) , FINALRPT AS (SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN, CPE_ENC_DTE, DX_DTE, CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR FROM APPTGI JOIN DXGI ON CPE_MRN = DX_MRN JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PT_MRN = CPE_MRN WHERE YEAR(DX_DTE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) < 50 ORDER BY CPE_MRN) SELECT YEAR (CPE_ENC_DTE) AS APPT_YEAR, MONTH (CPE_ENC_DTE) AS APPT_MONTH, COUNT (CPE_MRN) AS APPT_COUNT FROM FINALRPT GROUP BY YEAR (CPE_ENC_DTE) , MONTH (CPE_ENC_DTE);

Code", "t2"."DXCC_ICD_MSK_DESC" AS "ICD-O Histology Description", MIN("t7"."DT_DTE") AS "Min Brain Mets ICD-9 Date", UPPER("PINC_GENERIC_NAME") AS "Generic Drug Name", MIN("Order Start Date") AS "Min Drug Order Start Date" FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED" "t1" JOIN "DV"."CDB_TUMOR_V" "t9" ON "t1"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t9"."CDTM_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" JOIN "DV"."DIAGNOSIS_CODE_CAT_ICDO_V" "t2" ON "t9"."CDTM_DX_CATALOG_ID" = "t2"."DXCC_DX_CATALOG_ID" JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" "t6" ON "t9"."CDTM_DX_DATE_ID" = "t6"."DT_DATE_ID" JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DIAGNOSIS_FINAL_ALL_V" "t10" ON "t1"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t10"."PDX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" JOIN "DV"."DIAGNOSIS_CATALOG" "t3" ON "t10"."PDX_DX_CATALOG_ID" = "t3"."DXCC_DX_CATALOG_ID" JOIN "DV"."ICDO_SITE_CATALOG_V" "site" ON "t9"."CDTM_SITE_CATALOG_ID" = "site"."ICSC_SITE_CATALOG_ID" JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DIAGNOSIS_FINAL_DATES_V" "t11" ON ON "t12"."POD_PHARMA_INVENTORY_CTLG_ID" = "t4"."PINC_INVENTORY_CTLG_ID" AND UPPER("t4"."PINC_GENERIC_NAME") IN ('SUNITINIB (SU011248)', 'SUNITINIB (SU011248) OR PLACEBO', 'SUNITINIB MALATE', 'AXITINIB', 'AXITINIB (AG-013736)', 'GW786034 (PAZOPANIB)', 'PAZOPANIB', 'PAZOPANIB OR PLACEBO', 'BAY 43-9006 (SORAFENIB) OR PLACEBO', 'SORAFENIB', 'SORAFENIB (BAY 43-9006)', 'EVEROLIMUS', 'EVEROLIMUS (RAD001)', 'EVEROLIMUS (RAD001) OR PLACEBO', 'RAD001 (EVEROLIMUS) OR PLACEBO', 'BEVACIZUMAB', 'BEVACIZUMAB OR PLACEBO', 'BEVACIZUMAB', 'BEVACIZUMAB OR PLACEBO', 'SU011248', 'TEMsirolimus', "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V" "t5" ON "t1"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t5"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" WHERE "ICSC_SITE_CD" = 'C649' AND "t3"."DXCC_ICD_CODE" = '198.3' GROUP BY "t5"."PT_MRN", "t5"."PT_LAST_NAME", "t5"."PT_FIRST_NAME", "t6"."DT_DTE", "t2"."DXCC_ICD_CODE", "t2"."DXCC_ICD_MSK_DESC", UPPER("PINC_GENERIC_NAME")

('06.2', '06.31', '06.39', '06.4', '06.50', '06.51', '06.52', '06.6', '06.91', '06.92', '06.93', '06.94', '06.98', '0GTG0ZZ', '0GTG4ZZ', '0GTH0ZZ', '0GTH4ZZ', '0G5K0ZZ', '0G5K3ZZ', '0G5K4ZZ', '0GBG0ZZ', '0GBG3ZZ', '0GBG4ZZ', '0GBH0ZZ', '0GBH3ZZ', '0GBH4ZZ', '0GBJ0ZZ', '0GBJ3ZZ', '0GBJ4ZZ', '0GTJ0ZZ', '0GTJ4ZZ', '0GTK0ZZ', '0GTK4ZZ', '0CB70ZZ', '0G8J0ZZ', '0G8J3ZZ', '0G8J4ZZ') AND CC_CLSF_TYPE = 'PC' AND CC_EFF_DTE >= '2021-01-01'), PBD_ICD AS (SELECT MRN, CPT_CODE, CPT_DESC, SVC_DATE, DOC_NAME, 'pbd' AS SOURCE FROM CPT UNION ALL SELECT MRN, CPT_CODE, CPT_DESC, SVC_DATE, DOC_NAME, 'dia' AS SOURCE FROM ICD910) SELECT MRN, PT_SEX, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, (YEAR(SVC_DATE) - YEAR(PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH)) AS AGE, DOC_NAME, SVC_DATE, CPT_DESC, CPT_CODE FROM PBD_ICD LEFT JOIN IDB.PATIENT prompt: Exception Report - Patients Not Marked Deceased from SSDI or ObituaryData.com due to exceptions or with DOD over 30 days different
completion: SELECT PT_MRN AS "MRN", TM_MRN AS "CDB MRN", CHAR(DX_DTE) AS "Min Tumor Dx Date", STRIP(PT_LAST_NAME) || ', ' || STRIP(PT_FIRST_NAME) AS "IDB Name", STRIP(NDM_LAST_NAME) || ', ' || STRIP(NDM_FIRST_NAME) || ' ' || STRIP(NDM_MIDDLE_NAME) AS "SSDI Name (Matched on SSN)", STRIP(OB_LAST_NAME) || ', ' || STRIP(OB_FIRST_NAME) || ' ' || STRIP(OB_MIDDLE_INIT) AS "OB Name", CASE WHEN PT_DEATH_IND IN ('', 'A') THEN 'Alive' ELSE 'Deceased' END AS "IDB Vital Status", CHAR(PT_DATE_OF_DEATH) AS "IDB Date of Death", CHAR(NDM_DEATH_DTE) AS "SSDI Date of Death", CHAR(OB_DEATH_DTE) AS "OB Date of Death", DAYS(NDM_DEATH_DTE) - DAYS(PT_DATE_OF_DEATH) AS "Death Date Days Diff SSDI", DAYS(OB_DEATH_DTE) - DAYS(PT_DATE_OF_DEATH) AS "Death Date Days Diff OB", CASE WHEN PLA_LST_APPT_DTE > NDM_DEATH_DTE OR PLA_LST_APPT_DTE > OB_DEATH_DTE THEN 'Y' END AS "Appt After Death Date", CHAR(PLA_LST_APPT_DTE) AS "Last Appt Date", CASE WHEN MAX_APPT_DTE IS NOT NULL THEN 'Y' END AS "Future Appt", CHAR(MAX_APPT_DTE) AS "Max Future Appt Date", CASE WHEN PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH <> NDM_BIRTH_DTE OR PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH <> OB_BIRTH_DTE THEN 'Y' END AS "Date of Birth Mismatch", CHAR(PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) AS "IDB Date of Birth", CHAR(NDM_BIRTH_DTE) AS "SSDI Date of Birth", CHAR(OB_BIRTH_DTE) AS "OB Date of Birth", YEAR(NDM_DEATH_DTE - NDM_BIRTH_DTE) AS "SSDI Age at Death", OB_AGE AS "OB Age at Death", CASE WHEN AV_DESC IN ('NEW YORK (MANHATTAN)', 'BRONX', 'KINGS (BROOKLYN)', 'QUEENS', 'RICHMOND (STATEN ISLAND)') AND OB_BIRTH_DTE IS NULL AND OB_AGE <> '' THEN 'Y' ELSE '' END AS "5 Boroughs and No Obit DOB" FROM IDB.PATIENT JOIN IDBSEC.PATIENT_SSN ON PTSS_MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN IDBSEC.NTIS_DEATH_MASTER ON NDM_SSA_NO = PTSS_SSA_NO JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY ON PLA_MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN (SELECT CPE_MRN, MAX(CPE_ENC_DTE) AS MAX_APPT_DTE FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS = 'Sch' AND CPE_ENC_DTE >= CURRENT DATE GROUP BY CPE_MRN) AS A ON PT_MRN = CPE_MRN LEFT JOIN (SELECT TM_MRN, MIN(TM_DX_DTE) AS DX_DTE FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR WHERE TM_DX_DTE IS NOT NULL GROUP BY TM_MRN) CDB ON PT_MRN = CDB.TM_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS ON AV_ELEMENT = 'DISTRICT_CD' AND AV_CODE = PT_DISTRICT_CD LEFT JOIN IDB.OBITUARY ON UPPER(REPLACE(OB_LAST_NAME, ' (Brief)', '')) = PT_LAST_NAME AND UPPER(OB_FIRST_NAME) = CASE WHEN LOCATE(' ', TRIM(PT_FIRST_NAME)) > 0 THEN SUBSTR(PT_FIRST_NAME, 1, LOCATE(' ', TRIM(PT_FIRST_NAME))-1) ELSE PT_FIRST_NAME END AND UPPER(OB_MIDDLE_INIT) = CASE WHEN OB_MIDDLE_INIT = '' THEN '' WHEN LOCATE(' ', TRIM(PT_FIRST_NAME)) > 0 THEN SUBSTR(PT_FIRST_NAME, LOCATE(' ', TRIM(PT_FIRST_NAME))+1, 1) ELSE OB_MIDDLE_INIT END AND COALESCE(OB_BIRTH_DTE, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) = PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH AND OB_AGE <> '' AND YEAR(OB_DEATH_DTE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) = OB_AGE AND UPPER(OB_CITY) = PT_CITY AND UPPER(OB_STATE) = PT_STATE WHERE (PT_DEATH_IND IN ('', 'A') OR ABS(DAYS(NDM_DEATH_DTE) - DAYS(PT_DATE_OF_DEATH)) > 30 OR ABS(DAYS(OB_DEATH_DTE) - DAYS(PT_DATE_OF_DEATH)) > 30) AND (DATE(NDM_UPD_DT) BETWEEN CURRENT date - 22 DAYS AND CURRENT date - 16 DAY OR DATE(OB_IDB_UPD_DT) BETWEEN CURRENT date - 22 DAYS AND CURRENT date - 16 DAY) ORDER BY 1

prompt: Provide a quarterly report on the number of pre-procedure part one notes submitted by the following RN's: Cathy Birn, Michelle Baker, Felicia Foster and Mary Anne Regan.
completion: SELECT OP_DISPLAY_NAME AS "RN Name", COUNT(DISTINCT CDD_DOC_GUID) AS "Pre-Procedure/Surgery, Part 1 - Nursing Notes" FROM (SELECT DISTINCT CDD_MRN, CDD_DOC_GUID, CDD_SERVICE_DTE, CDD_DOC_NAME, OP_DISPLAY_NAME FROM IDB.CD_DOCUMENT JOIN IDB.OMS_PROVIDER ON OP_PVDR_GUID = CDD_AUTH_PROV_GUID WHERE CDD_CANCEL_IND = '0' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND = '0' AND CDD_DOC_NAME = 'Pre-Procedure/Surgery, Part 1 - Nursing' AND CDD_SERVICE_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT DATE - (DAY(CURRENT DATE) - 1) DAYS - 3 MONTH AND CURRENT DATE - (DAY(CURRENT DATE)) DAYS AND OP_PVDR_GUID IN ('9000007982201190', '4000002007119001', '9000008839101190', '7000002226119001') ) X GROUP BY OP_DISPLAY_NAME

prompt: Provide a list of all patients diagnosed with sarcoma (ICD 171.x) and who were treated with sunitinib or SU11248 since 2000
completion: WITH "cte1" AS (SELECT TEXTTABLE.*, CONTAINS("PRPT_REPORT", '"GASTROINTESTINAL STROMAL" | ' || '"GIST"') AS "HitCol1" FROM "DV"."PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V" TEXTTABLE) , PATH AS (SELECT DISTINCT "t1"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" , MIN("t4"."DT_DTE") AS "First GIST Path Report Date" FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED" "t1" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PHM_PT_MEDS_MQT" "t5" ON "t1"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t5"."POD_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PHM_INVENTORY_CATALOG" "t2" ON "t5"."POD_PHARMA_INVENTORY_CTLG_ID" = "t2"."PINC_INVENTORY_CTLG_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PHM_ORDER_DTL" "t6" ON "t5"."POD_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t6"."POD_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AND "t5"."POD_PHARMA_INVENTORY_CTLG_ID" = "t6"."POD_PHARMA_INVENTORY_CTLG_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PHM_ORDER_DISPENSE_OCCR" "t7" ON "t6"."POD_PHARMA_ORDER_DETAIL_ID" = "t7"."PDO_PHARMA_ORDER_DETAIL_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE" "t8" ON "t7"."PDO_DISPNS_DATE_ID" = "t8"."DT_DATE_ID" LEFT JOIN "cte1" "t3" ON "t1"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t3"."PRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE" "t4" ON "t3"."PRPT_REPORT_DATE_ID" = "t4"."DT_DATE_ID" WHERE ("t2"."PINC_GENERIC_NAME" IN ('SU011248', 'SUNITinib (SU011248)', 'SUNITinib Malate') AND ("t8"."DT_DTE" >= '2000-1-1' AND "t3"."HitCol1" <> 0)) GROUP BY "t1"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID") , PATH_W_DATE AS (SELECT P.PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID, P."First GIST Path Report Date" , R.PRPT_ACCESSION_NO AS "Accession Number" FROM PATH P INNER JOIN "cte1" R ON P.PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = R.PRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID AND R."HitCol1" <> 0 INNER JOIN "DV"."DATE" "t4" ON R."PRPT_REPORT_DATE_ID" = "t4"."DT_DATE_ID" AND "t4"."DT_DTE" = P."First GIST Path Report Date") , ICD9 AS (SELECT DISTINCT "t1"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID", "t2"."DXCC_ICD_CODE" AS "ICD-9 Code", "t2"."DXCC_ICD_MSK_DESC" AS "ICD-9 MSK code description", MIN("t4"."DT_DTE") AS "ICD-9 Diagnosis Date", "t5"."DT_DTE" AS "ICD-9 First Dx Date" FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED" "t1" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DIAGNOSIS_FINAL_ALL_V" "t6" ON "t1"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t6"."PDX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DIAGNOSIS_CODE_CAT_ICD9_V" "t2" ON "t6"."PDX_DX_CATALOG_ID" = "t2"."DXCC_DX_CATALOG_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE" "t4" ON "t6"."PDX_DX_DATE_ID" = "t4"."DT_DATE_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DIAGNOSIS_FINAL_DATES_V" "t7" ON "t6"."PDX_DX_CATALOG_ID" = "t7"."PDX_DX_CATALOG_ID" AND "t6"."PDX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t7"."PDX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE" "t5" ON "t7"."FIRST_DIAGNOSIS_DATE_ID" = "t5"."DT_DATE_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PHM_PT_MEDS_MQT" "t8" ON "t1"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t8"."POD_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PHM_INVENTORY_CATALOG" "t3" ON "t8"."POD_PHARMA_INVENTORY_CTLG_ID" = "t3"."PINC_INVENTORY_CTLG_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PHM_ORDER_DTL" "t9" ON "t8"."POD_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t9"."POD_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AND "t8"."POD_PHARMA_INVENTORY_CTLG_ID" = "t9"."POD_PHARMA_INVENTORY_CTLG_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PHM_ORDER_DISPENSE_OCCR" "t10" ON "t9"."POD_PHARMA_ORDER_DETAIL_ID" = "t10"."PDO_PHARMA_ORDER_DETAIL_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE" "t11" ON "t10"."PDO_DISPNS_DATE_ID" = "t11"."DT_DATE_ID" WHERE ("t6"."PDX_DX_CATALOG_ID" IN (5711, 5768, 5712, 5769, 5713, 5770, 5714, 5771, 5715) AND ("t3"."PINC_GENERIC_NAME" IN ('SU011248', 'SUNITinib (SU011248)', 'SUNITinib Malate') AND "t11"."DT_DTE" >= '2000-1-1')) GROUP BY "t1"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID", "t2"."DXCC_ICD_CODE", "t2"."DXCC_ICD_MSK_DESC", "t5"."DT_DTE") , CDB AS (SELECT DISTINCT "t1"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID", "t3"."DXCC_ICD_CODE" AS "ICD-O Histology Code", "t3"."DXCC_ICD_MSK_DESC" AS "ICD-O Histology Desc", "t4"."DT_DTE" AS "CDB Tumor Diagnosis Date" FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED" "t1" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PHM_PT_MEDS_MQT" "t5" ON "t1"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t5"."POD_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PHM_INVENTORY_CATALOG" "t2" ON "t5"."POD_PHARMA_INVENTORY_CTLG_ID" = "t2"."PINC_INVENTORY_CTLG_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PHM_ORDER_DTL" "t6" ON "t5"."POD_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t6"."POD_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AND "t5"."POD_PHARMA_INVENTORY_CTLG_ID" = "t6"."POD_PHARMA_INVENTORY_CTLG_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PHM_ORDER_DISPENSE_OCCR" "t7" ON "t6"."POD_PHARMA_ORDER_DETAIL_ID" = "t7"."PDO_PHARMA_ORDER_DETAIL_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE" "t8" ON "t7"."PDO_DISPNS_DATE_ID" = "t8"."DT_DATE_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."CDB_TUMOR_V" "t9" ON "t1"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t9"."CDTM_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DIAGNOSIS_CODE_CAT_ICDO_V" "t3" ON "t9"."CDTM_DX_CATALOG_ID" = "t3"."DXCC_DX_CATALOG_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE" "t4" ON "t9"."CDTM_DX_DATE_ID" = "t4"."DT_DATE_ID" WHERE ("t2"."PINC_GENERIC_NAME" IN ('SU011248', 'SUNITinib (SU011248)', 'SUNITinib Malate') AND ("t8"."DT_DTE" >= '2000-1-1' AND "t3"."DXCC_ICD_CODE" IN ('M8936/3'))) ) SELECT DISTINCT "t1"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AS "Deident PT #", "t2"."PT_MRN" AS "MRN", "t2"."PT_BIRTH_DTE" AS "Date of Birth", C."ICD-O Histology Code", C."ICD-O Histology Desc", C."CDB Tumor Diagnosis Date", I."ICD-9 Code", I."ICD-9 MSK code description", I."ICD-9 Diagnosis Date", I."ICD-9 First Dx Date", P."First GIST Path Report Date" , P."Accession Number" FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED" "t1" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V" "t2" ON "t1"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t2"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN PATH_W_DATE P ON "t1".PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = P.PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID LEFT JOIN ICD9 I ON "t1".PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = I.PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID LEFT JOIN CDB C ON "t1".PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = C.PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID WHERE P.PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID IS NOT NULL OR I.PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID IS NOT NULL OR C.PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID IS NOT NULL
