prompt: Provide a weekly list of endometrial, ovarian, cervical, vaginal, and other gynecologic malignances with ARID1A mutations.
completion: WITH GENE AS (SELECT DISTINCT PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID PID FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_STRUCTURED_RESULTS_V G WHERE GENE IN ('ARID1A') ) , DEID AS (SELECT PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID P_ID FROM GENE G JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS P ON G.PT_MRN = P.PT_MRN JOIN DV.CDB_TUMOR_V ON CDTM_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID JOIN DV.DATE_V ON CDTM_DX_DATE_ID = DT_DATE_ID JOIN DV.DIAGNOSIS_CODE_CAT_ICDO_V ON CDTM_DX_CATALOG_ID = DXCC_DX_CATALOG_ID JOIN DV.ICDO_SITE_CATALOG_V ON CDTM_SITE_CATALOG_ID = ICSC_SITE_CATALOG_ID JOIN DV.TUMOR_CASE_ATTRIBUTES_V ON CDTM_CASE_ATTR_ID = TUMOR_CASE_ATTR_ID JOIN DV.SEERGROUPING ON DV.SEERF_ICDO(ICSC_SITE_CD, DXCC_ICD_CODE) = RECODE WHERE TCA_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7') AND CATEGORY1 = 'Female Genital System' ) SELECT * FROM DEID

prompt: Provide opioid data for patients who have received specific opioids.
completion: WITH GENDRUG AS (SELECT DISTINCT HGN_GENERIC_NAME, OCDX_DRUG_KEY CAT_DRUG_KEY, CASE WHEN (C2.ODC_CATEGORY_NAME = ' ' OR C2.ODC_CATEGORY_NAME IS NULL) THEN C1.ODC_CATEGORY_NAME WHEN (C3.ODC_CATEGORY_NAME = ' ' OR C3.ODC_CATEGORY_NAME IS NULL) THEN C2.ODC_CATEGORY_NAME CONCAT ' | ' CONCAT C1.ODC_CATEGORY_NAME ELSE C3.ODC_CATEGORY_NAME CONCAT ' | ' CONCAT C2.ODC_CATEGORY_NAME END AS CATEGORY_NAME FROM IDB.HML_GENERIC_NAME JOIN IDB.OMS_CATEGORY_DRUG_XREF ON HGN_DRUG_CATALOG_KEY = OCDX_DRUG_KEY JOIN IDB.OMS_DRUG_CATEGORIES C1 ON C1.ODC_MULTUM_CATEGORY_ID = OCDX_MULTUM_CATEGORY_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_CATEGORY_SUB_XREF L2 ON C1.ODC_MULTUM_CATEGORY_ID = L2.OCSX_SUB_CATEGORY_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_DRUG_CATEGORIES C2 ON C2.ODC_MULTUM_CATEGORY_ID = L2.OCSX_MULTUM_CATEGORY_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_CATEGORY_SUB_XREF L3 ON L2.OCSX_MULTUM_CATEGORY_ID = L3.OCSX_SUB_CATEGORY_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_DRUG_CATEGORIES C3 ON C3.ODC_MULTUM_CATEGORY_ID = L3.OCSX_MULTUM_CATEGORY_ID) , DRUGRN AS (SELECT DISTINCT CAT_DRUG_KEY, HGN_GENERIC_NAME, CATEGORY_NAME , ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CAT_DRUG_KEY ORDER BY CATEGORY_NAME) RN FROM GENDRUG) , DRUGCAT AS (SELECT CAT_DRUG_KEY, HGN_GENERIC_NAME GENERIC_NAME , MAX(CASE WHEN RN = 1 THEN CATEGORY_NAME END)|| MAX(CASE WHEN RN = 2 THEN '; '||STRIP(CATEGORY_NAME) ELSE '' END)|| MAX(CASE WHEN RN = 3 THEN '; '||STRIP(CATEGORY_NAME) ELSE '' END)|| MAX(CASE WHEN RN = 4 THEN '; '||STRIP(CATEGORY_NAME) ELSE '' END) THERAP_CATEGORY FROM DRUGRN GROUP BY CAT_DRUG_KEY, HGN_GENERIC_NAME) SELECT HCPR_MRN AS MRN , CHAR(HCPR_PRESCRIPTION_ID) "Rx ID" , HCPR_STATUS_TYPE_DESC AS "Rx Status" , HCPR_PRESCRIPTION_TYPE_DESC AS "Rx Type" , HCPR_CREATED_DTE AS "Rx Create Date" , DATE(HCPR_START_DT) AS "Rx Start Date" , DATE(HCPR_END_DT) AS "Rx End Date" , HCPR_DRUG_NAME AS "Drug Name" , HGN_GENERIC_NAME AS "Generic Name" , THERAP_CATEGORY , HCPR_DOSE_AMT AS "Dose" , UOM.HRUM_NAME AS "UoM" , HCPR_ROUTE AS "Route" , CHAR(INT(HCPR_QTY_AMT)) AS QTY, HSF_ABBREVIATIION AS "Freq" , CHAR(INT(HCPR_DURATION_AMT)) AS "Duration" , CHAR(INT(HCPR_REFILLS)) AS "Refills" , HCPR_INSTRUCTIONS AS "Instructions" , OS_SVC_DESC AS "Client Visit SVC" , OS_SVC_GRP_CD AS "Client Visit SVC Code" , OCV_CURR_LOC , CASE WHEN OCV_CURR_LOC LIKE '%JR%' THEN 'Y' END AS "JRSC" FROM IDB.HML_CLIENT_PRESCRIPTION JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON HCPR_MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_CLIENT_VISIT ON OCV_VISIT_GUID = HCPR_VISIT_GUID LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_SERVICE ON OCV_SVC_GUID = OS_SVC_GUID LEFT JOIN IDB.HML_GENERIC_NAME ON HGN_GENERIC_NAME_ID = HCPR_GENERIC_NAME_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_USER USR ON USR.OU_USER_GUID = HCPR_USER_GUID LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_USER REQ ON REQ.OU_USER_GUID = HCPR_CARE_PROV_GUID LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_PROVIDER REQ2 ON REQ2.OP_PVDR_GUID = HCPR_CARE_PROV_GUID LEFT JOIN IDB.DOC D1 ON REQ2.OP_PVDR_NO = DOC_DR_NO LEFT JOIN IDB.HML_RX_UNIT_OF_MEASURE UOM ON UOM.HRUM_RXUOM_ID = HCPR_DOSE_UOM_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.HML_RX_UNIT_OF_MEASURE PKG ON PKG.HRUM_RXUOM_ID = HCPR_INNER_PACKAGE_SIZE_UOM_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.HML_SCRIPT_FREQUENCY ON HSF_SCRIPT_FREQ_ID = HCPR_SCRIPT_FREQ_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.RXW_PHARMACY ON HCPR_PHARMACY_ID = RPH_PHARMACY_ID LEFT JOIN DRUGCAT ON CAT_DRUG_KEY = HGN_DRUG_CATALOG_KEY WHERE HCPR_STATUS_TYPE NOT IN (4, 5, 8) AND((HCPR_PRESCRIPTION_TYPE = 1 AND HCPR_TRANSMISSION_STATUS IN (1, 2, 5) ) OR HCPR_PRESCRIPTION_TYPE = 3) AND DATE(HCPR_START_DT) BETWEEN '2020-09-01' AND '2022-12-31' AND (UPPER(HGN_GENERIC_NAME) LIKE '%BUPRENORPHINE%' OR UPPER(HGN_GENERIC_NAME) LIKE '%FENTANYL%' OR UPPER(HGN_GENERIC_NAME) LIKE '%HYDROMORPHONE%' OR UPPER(HGN_GENERIC_NAME) LIKE '%METHADONE%' OR UPPER(HGN_GENERIC_NAME) LIKE '%MORPHINE%' OR UPPER(HGN_GENERIC_NAME) LIKE '%OXYCODONE%' OR UPPER(HGN_GENERIC_NAME) LIKE '%OXYMORPHONE%' OR UPPER(HGN_GENERIC_NAME) LIKE '%TAPENTADOL%' OR UPPER(HGN_GENERIC_NAME) LIKE '%TRAMADOL%' OR UPPER(HCPR_DRUG_NAME) LIKE '%BUPRENORPHINE%' OR UPPER(HCPR_DRUG_NAME) LIKE '%FENTANYL%' OR UPPER(HCPR_DRUG_NAME) LIKE '%HYDROMORPHONE%' OR UPPER(HCPR_DRUG_NAME) LIKE '%METHADONE%' OR UPPER(HCPR_DRUG_NAME) LIKE '%MORPHINE%' OR UPPER(HCPR_DRUG_NAME) LIKE '%OXYCODONE%' OR UPPER(HCPR_DRUG_NAME) LIKE '%OXYMORPHONE%' OR UPPER(HCPR_DRUG_NAME) LIKE '%TAPENTADOL%' OR UPPER(HCPR_DRUG_NAME) LIKE '%TRAMADOL%') ;

prompt: Provide a list of AML patients on IVOSIDENIB, ENASIDENIB, VORASIDENIB, AG-881, MIDOSTAURIN, GILTERITINIB, CRENOLANIB, QUIZARTINIB (AC220) with a bone marrow biopsy
completion: WITH PTS AS (SELECT APR_MRN MRN, PT_LAST_NAME "Last Name", PT_FIRST_NAME "First Name", PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH DOB, PT_SEX GENDER, CASE WHEN PT_DEATH_IND IN ('X', 'C', 'D') THEN 'Deceased' ELSE 'Alive' END "Vital Status", APR_START_DTE START_DATE, APR_END_DTE END_DATE, APR_GENERIC_NAME GENERIC_NAME, APR_INVESTIGATIVE_FLAG INVESTIGATIVE_FLAG, APR_DRUG_NAME DRUG_NAME, APR_SET_NAME SET_NAME, (APR_PRESCRIBED_DOSE) DOSE, APR_ROUTE ROUTE, APR_DURATION, APR_FREQ FROM IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX JOIN IDB.CHEMO_DRUG_GENERIC ON APR_GENERIC_NAME = CDG_GENERIC_NAME JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON APR_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE APR_START_DTE >= '2011-01-01' AND CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME IN ('IVOSIDENIB', 'ENASIDENIB', 'VORASIDENIB', 'AG-881', 'MIDOSTAURIN', 'GILTERITINIB', 'CRENOLANIB', 'QUIZARTINIB (AC220)') AND YEAR(APR_START_DTE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) >= 18 UNION SELECT HCPR_MRN MRN, PT_LAST_NAME "Last Name", PT_FIRST_NAME "First Name", PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH DOB, PT_SEX GENDER, CASE WHEN PT_DEATH_IND IN ('X', 'C', 'D') THEN 'Deceased' ELSE 'Alive' END "Vital Status", DATE(COALESCE(HCPR_START_DT, HCPR_CREATED_DT)) START_DTE, DATE(HCPR_END_DT) HCPR_END_DTE, HCPR_DRUG_NAME GENERIC_NAME, '' INVESTIGATIVE_FLAG, HCPR_DRUG_NAME DRUG_NAME, '' SET_NAME, HCPR_DOSE_AMT DOSE, HCPR_ROUTE ROUTE, VARCHAR(HCPR_DURATION_AMT) DURATION, '' APR_FREQ FROM IDB.HML_CLIENT_PRESCRIPTION JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON HCPR_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE (UPPER(HCPR_DRUG_NAME) like 'IVOSIDENIB%' OR UPPER(HCPR_DRUG_NAME) like 'ENASIDENIB%' OR UPPER(HCPR_DRUG_NAME) like 'AG%221%' OR UPPER(HCPR_DRUG_NAME) like 'AG%881%' OR UPPER(HCPR_DRUG_NAME) like 'MIDOSTAURIN%' OR UPPER(HCPR_DRUG_NAME) like 'GILTERITINIB%' OR UPPER(HCPR_DRUG_NAME) like 'CRENOLANIB%' OR UPPER(HCPR_DRUG_NAME) like 'QUIZARTINIB%') AND COALESCE(DATE(HCPR_START_DT), DATE(HCPR_CREATED_DT)) >= '2011-01-01' AND YEAR(COALESCE(DATE(HCPR_START_DT), DATE(HCPR_CREATED_DT)) - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) >= 18 ) , CDB AS (SELECT DISTINCT TM_MRN MRN, "Last Name", "First Name", TM_DX_DTE, TM_SITE_CD AS SITE_CODE, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_DESC, TM_HIST_CD AS HIST_CODE, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS HIST_DESC, CATEGORY1, CATEGORY2, CATEGORY3 FROM (SELECT DISTINCT MRN, "Last Name", "First Name" FROM PTS) A JOIN IDB.CDB_TUMOR ON MRN = TM_MRN JOIN IDB.CLM H ON TM_HIST_CD = H.CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON TM_SITE_CD = S.CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.SEERGROUPING ON DV.SEERF_ICDO(TM_SITE_CD, TM_HIST_CD) = RECODE WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7') AND CATEGORY3='Acute Myeloid Leukemia' ) , PATH AS (SELECT * FROM (SELECT MRN, PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID, TM_DX_DTE, PRPT_PROCEDURE_DTE, PRPT_REPORT_DTE, PRPT_ACCESSION_NO, PRPT_REPORT_TYPE_DESC, PRPT_REPORT, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY MRN, PRPT_REPORT_TYPE_DESC ORDER BY DAYS(PRPT_PROCEDURE_DTE) - DAYS(TM_DX_DTE)) RN FROM CDB JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON MRN = PT_MRN JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V ON MRN = PRPT_MRN AND PRPT_PROCEDURE_DTE BETWEEN TM_DX_DTE - 1.5 MONTHS AND TM_DX_DTE AND (CONTAINS(PRPT_REPORT, '("bone marrow biopsy" | "BM BX" | "bm biopsy" | "bone marrow bx" | "bone marrow" | "bm aspirate")') = 1)) WHERE RN = 1 ) , PATH_MAPPING AS (SELECT PT_MRN, SPD.DT_DTE BIOPSY_DATE, SP.PRPT_PATH_RPT_ID BIOPSY_RPT_ID, SP.PRPT_ACCESSION_NO BIOPSY_ACCESSION_NO, SP.PRPT_REPORT BIOPSY_REPORT, MDD.DT_DTE CHILD_DATE, MD.PRPT_PATH_RPT_ID CHILD_RPT_ID, MD.PRPT_ACCESSION_NO CHILD_ACCESSION_NO, MD.PRPT_REPORT CHILD_REPORT FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V MD JOIN DV.DATE_V MDD ON MDD.DT_DATE_ID = MD.PRPT_PROCEDURE_DATE_ID JOIN DV.PATH_RPRT_TYPE_LOOKUP ON MD.PRPT_REPORT_TYPE = PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_CD JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_REFERENCES ON MD.PRPT_PATH_RPT_ID = PRPTR_CHILD_PATH_RPT_ID JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V SP ON SP.PRPT_PATH_RPT_ID = PRPTR_PATH_RPT_ID JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V ON SP.PRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID JOIN DV.DATE_V SPD ON SPD.DT_DATE_ID = SP.PRPT_PROCEDURE_DATE_ID JOIN PATH PATH ON PATH.PRPT_ACCESSION_NO = SP.PRPT_ACCESSION_NO) , PATH_STRUCTURED AS (SELECT MRN, TM_DX_DTE, PATH_PROCEDURE_DATE, PATH_RPT_DATE, PRPT_ACCESSION_NO, GENE, METHOD, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY MRN ORDER BY DAYS(PATH_PROCEDURE_DATE) - DAYS(TM_DX_DTE)) RN FROM CDB JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_STRUCTURED_RESULTS_V ON MRN = PT_MRN WHERE PATH_PROCEDURE_DATE BETWEEN TM_DX_DTE - 1.5 MONTHS AND TM_DX_DTE ) , LABS AS (SELECT PT_MRN AS MRN, T.LTC_SUBTEST_NAME AS "Lab-Test Name", S.LTC_SUBTEST_NAME AS "Lab-Subtest Name", DT_DTE AS "Lab-Performed Date", PLR_RESULT_VALUE AS "Lab-Test Result Value", PLR_UNIT_MEASURE AS "Lab-Unit Measure", ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY PT_MRN, S.LTC_SUBTEST_NAME ORDER BY CASE WHEN DAYS(DT_DTE) - DAYS(START_DATE) = 0 THEN -2 ELSE DAYS(DT_DTE) - DAYS(START_DATE) END) RN FROM PTS JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON MRN = PT_MRN JOIN DV.PATIENT_LAB_RESULT ON PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PLR_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID JOIN DV.LAB_TEST_CATALOG_V T ON PLR_LAB_TEST_CATALOG_ID = T.LTC_LAB_TEST_CATALOG_ID JOIN DV.LAB_TEST_CATALOG_V S ON PLR_LAB_SUBTEST_CATALOG_ID = S.LTC_LAB_TEST_CATALOG_ID JOIN DV.DATE_V ON PLR_PERFORMED_DATE_ID = DT_DATE_ID WHERE T.LTC_SUBTEST_NAME IN ('Complete Blood Count') AND S.LTC_SUBTEST_NAME IN ('WBC', 'HGB', 'Platelets.', 'Abs Neut') AND DT_DTE BETWEEN START_DATE - 1 DAY AND START_DATE + 1 DAY AND RN = 1 ) , LABS_PIVOT AS (SELECT MRN, MAX(CASE WHEN "Lab-Subtest Name" = 'WBC' THEN "Lab-Performed Date" END) "WBC Performed Date", MAX(CASE WHEN "Lab-Subtest Name" = 'WBC' THEN TRIM("Lab-Test Result Value") || "Lab-Unit Measure" END) "WBC Result", MAX(CASE WHEN "Lab-Subtest Name" = 'HGB' THEN "Lab-Performed Date" END) "HGB Performed Date", MAX(CASE WHEN "Lab-Subtest Name" = 'HGB' THEN TRIM("Lab-Test Result Value") || "Lab-Unit Measure" END) "HGB Result", MAX(CASE WHEN "Lab-Subtest Name" = 'Platelets.' THEN "Lab-Performed Date" END) "Platelets. Performed Date", MAX(CASE WHEN "Lab-Subtest Name" = 'Platelets.' THEN TRIM("Lab-Test Result Value") || "Lab-Unit Measure" END) "Platelets. Result", MAX(CASE WHEN "Lab-Subtest Name" = 'Abs Neut' THEN "Lab-Performed Date" END) "Abs Neut Performed Date", MAX(CASE WHEN "Lab-Subtest Name" = 'Abs Neut' THEN TRIM("Lab-Test Result Value") || "Lab-Unit Measure" END) "Abs Neut Result" FROM LABS WHERE RN = 1 GROUP BY MRN ) SELECT P.MRN, P."Last Name", P."First Name", DOB, GENDER, "Vital Status", START_DATE, END_DATE, GENERIC_NAME, INVESTIGATIVE_FLAG, DRUG_NAME, SET_NAME, DOSE, ROUTE, C.TM_DX_DTE, SITE_CODE, SITE_DESC, HIST_CODE, HIST_DESC, BIOPSY_DATE, BIOPSY_ACCESSION_NO, BIOPSY_REPORT, CHILD_DATE, CHILD_ACCESSION_NO, CHILD_REPORT, "WBC Performed Date", "WBC Result", "HGB Performed Date", "HGB Result", "Platelets. Performed Date", "Platelets. Result", "Abs Neut Performed Date", "Abs Neut Result" FROM PTS P JOIN CDB C ON P.MRN = C.MRN LEFT JOIN LABS_PIVOT L ON P.MRN = L.MRN LEFT JOIN PATH_MAPPING ON C.MRN = PT_MRN

prompt: Requesting a lisr of patients with Intravascular large B cell lymphoma for a retrospective cohort study.
completion: WITH X AS (SELECT CC_MRN AS MRN, CLM_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS DX_DATE FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND CASE WHEN CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y' THEN 'Y' WHEN CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' AND YEAR(CC_EFF_DTE) < 2004 THEN 'Y' WHEN CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND YEAR(CC_EFF_DTE) < 2001 THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END = 'Y' AND CC_PT_TYPE <> 'E' AND CC_CLSF_CD BETWEEN 'C83.30' AND 'C83.39' GROUP BY CC_MRN, CLM_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK HAVING MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) BETWEEN '2023-01-01' AND '2023-12-31') , I AS (SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN, PDWS_NAME FROM DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML DT ON PDRX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML_SETTINGS ON PDRX_PATH_DMP_RESULTS_XML_ID = PDRXS_PATH_DMP_RESULTS_XML_ID JOIN DVDMC.PATHOLOGY_DMP_WEBSVC_SETTINGS ON PDRXS_SETTING_ID = PDWS_SETTING_ID WHERE 1=1 AND PDWS_NAME like '%IMPACT%' AND PT_MRN IN (SELECT DISTINCT MRN FROM X) ) , Y AS (SELECT DISTINCT MRN, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH AS DOB, PT_SEX AS GENDER, R.AV_DESC AS "Race", E.AV_DESC AS "Ethnicity", CASE WHEN I.PT_MRN IS NOT NULL THEN 'Y' END AS IMPACT FROM X JOIN IDB.PATIENT P ON P.PT_MRN = MRN JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY ON PT_MRN = PLA_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS R ON PT_RACE = R.AV_CODE AND R.AV_ELEMENT = 'RACE' LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS E ON PT_PT_ETHNICITY = E.AV_CODE AND E.AV_ELEMENT = 'PT_ETHNICITY' LEFT JOIN I ON I.PT_MRN = MRN), AC AS (SELECT AC_IRB_NO, AC_MRN FROM Y JOIN IDB.ACCRUALS ON AC_MRN = MRN AND AC_IRB_NO = '16-245') , PATH AS (SELECT DISTINCT "t1"."PT_MRN" AS PT_MRN, "t2"."PRPT_ACCESSION_NO" AS "Pathology Report", "t3"."PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_DESC" AS "Pathology Report Type", "t4"."DT_DTE" AS "Pathology Procedure Date", UPPER(CASE WHEN LENGTH(PRPT_REPORT) <= 15000 THEN RTRIM(CAST(SUBSTR(PRPT_REPORT, 1, 15000) AS VARCHAR(15000))) ELSE CAST(SUBSTR(PRPT_REPORT, 1, 15000) AS VARCHAR(15000)) END) AS TXT FROM Y JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V" "t1" ON PT_MRN = MRN LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED" "t6" ON "t1"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t6"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V" "t2" ON "t6"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t2"."PRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATH_RPRT_TYPE_LOOKUP" "t3" ON "t2"."PRPT_REPORT_TYPE" = "t3"."PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_CD" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" "t4" ON "t2"."PRPT_PROCEDURE_DATE_ID" = "t4"."DT_DATE_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" "t5" ON "t2"."PRPT_REPORT_DATE_ID" = "t5"."DT_DATE_ID" WHERE 1=1 AND CONTAINS("t2"."PRPT_REPORT", '("Ki-67" OR "Ki67")') = 1 AND "t2"."PRPT_REPORT" IS NOT NULL AND UPPER("t3"."PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_DESC") LIKE '%SURGICAL PATHOLOGY%' ), CLINIAL AS (SELECT DISTINCT CDO_MRN, CDO_ITEM_NAME, CDO_MSTR_ITEM_NM, CDO_SET_NM FROM IDB.CD_DOCUMENT JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION ON CDO_DOC_GUID = CDD_DOC_GUID JOIN Y ON CDO_MRN = MRN WHERE CDD_CANCEL_IND = '0' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND = '0' AND(UPPER(CDO_ITEM_NAME) LIKE '%ECOG%') AND CDO_VALUE_TEXT <> '' AND CDO_VALUE_TEXT LIKE ('%ECOG%:') ), LDH AS (SELECT DISTINCT LR_MRN, DX_DATE, LR_PERFORMED_DTE AS PERFORMED_DTE, LR_TEST_NAME AS TEST_NAME, LR_SUBTEST_NAME AS SUBTEST_NAME, LR_RESULT_VALUE AS RESULT_VALUE, LR_UNIT_MEASURE AS UNIT_MEASURE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY LR_MRN, DX_DATE ORDER BY ABS(DAYS(DX_DATE) - DAYS(LR_PERFORMED_DTE))) AS RN FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.LAB_RESULTS ON LR_MRN = TM_MRN JOIN Y ON LR_MRN = MRN JOIN X X2 ON LR_MRN = X2.MRN WHERE 1=1 AND LR_SUBTEST_NAME LIKE 'LDH%' AND LR_RESULT_VALUE <> '' ) SELECT DISTINCT Y.*, PATH.*, X2.*, AC_IRB_NO, CDO_ITEM_NAME, CDO_MSTR_ITEM_NM, CDO_SET_NM, PERFORMED_DTE, TEST_NAME, SUBTEST_NAME, RESULT_VALUE, UNIT_MEASURE, CASE WHEN IMPACT = 'Y' THEN '1' WHEN AC_MRN IS NOT NULL AND PT_MRN IS NOT NULL THEN '2' WHEN AC_MRN IS NULL AND PT_MRN IS NOT NULL THEN '3' WHEN PT_MRN IS NULL THEN '4' END AS GRP FROM Y JOIN X X2 ON Y.MRN = X2.MRNV LEFT JOIN AC ON Y.MRN = AC_MRN LEFT JOIN PATH ON Y.MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN CLINIAL ON Y.MRN = CDO_MRN LEFT JOIN LDH ON Y.MRN = LR_MRN AND LDH.RN = 1

prompt: Replace AMB5658 with a monthly report of all the patients that checked in to 53rd St and had blood drawn or vitals scanned the same day.
completion: SELECT MRN, STRIP(CL_LAST_NAME)||', '||STRIP(CL_FIRST_NAME) PT_NAME , VST_DTE, CLD_DEPT_NAME DEPT_NAME, CLD_CLD_PHY_LOC LOCATION , CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME VISIT_NAME, CVT_EXT_NAME VISIT_TYPE , CRE_EXT_RES_NAME VISIT_RES_NAME, CRE_RES_TYP RES_TYP , FST_CHECK_IN, VITALS_SCAN_DT , DATE(FST_CHECK_IN) CHECK_IN_DATE , TIME(FST_CHECK_IN) CHECK_IN_TIME , DATE(VITALS_SCAN_DT) VITALS_SCAN_DATE , TIME(VITALS_SCAN_DT) VITALS_SCAN_TIME , BLOOD_DRAWN_DT, BLOOD_DRAWN_DATE , BLOOD_DRAWN_TIME , SUBSTR(CHAR(VST_DTE), 1, 5)|| CASE WHEN MONTH(VST_DTE) BETWEEN 1 AND 3 THEN 'Q1' WHEN MONTH(VST_DTE) BETWEEN 4 AND 6 THEN 'Q2' WHEN MONTH(VST_DTE) BETWEEN 7 AND 9 THEN 'Q3' ELSE 'Q4' END AS RPT_QTR FROM (SELECT A.CPE_MRN MRN, A.CPE_ENC_DTE VST_DTE , A.CPE_CHK_IN_DT FST_CHECK_IN , MIN(CPE_RM_IN_DT) FST_RM_IN_DT , MIN(CDD_AUTHORED_DT) VITALS_SCAN_DT FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER A JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON A.CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID AND CLD_CLD_CENTER = '53RD' AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 <> 'PFS' LEFT JOIN IDB.CD_DOCUMENT ON A.CPE_MRN = CDD_MRN AND CDD_AUTHORED_DTE = A.CPE_ENC_DTE AND CDD_ACCT_NO NOT LIKE '84%' AND CDD_DOC_NAME = 'Vital Signs - Outpatient' AND CDD_CANCEL_IND = '0' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND = '0' WHERE A.CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN LAST_DAY(CURRENT DATE - 2 MONTH) + 1 DAY AND LAST_DAY(CURRENT DATE - 1 MONTH) AND UCASE(A.CPE_CPE_APPT_STS) IN ('COMP', 'ARRIVED') AND A.CPE_ENC_TYP_CD = 50 AND A.CPE_CHK_IN_DT = (SELECT MIN(B.CPE_CHK_IN_DT) FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER B WHERE A.CPE_ENC_DTE = B.CPE_ENC_DTE AND A.CPE_MRN = B.CPE_MRN AND A.CPE_ENC_TYP_CD = B.CPE_ENC_TYP_CD AND A.CPE_CPE_APPT_STS = B.CPE_CPE_APPT_STS) GROUP BY A.CPE_MRN, A.CPE_ENC_DTE, A.CPE_CHK_IN_DT) ENC JOIN IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER ON CPE_MRN = MRN AND CPE_ENC_DTE = VST_DTE AND CPE_CHK_IN_DT = FST_CHECK_IN AND(CPE_RM_IN_DT = FST_RM_IN_DT OR FST_RM_IN_DT IS NULL) AND UCASE(CPE_CPE_APPT_STS) IN ('COMP', 'ARRIVED') JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID AND CLD_CLD_CENTER = '53RD' AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 <> 'PFS' JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CRE_RES_ID = CPE_VST_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID = CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID LEFT JOIN (SELECT OO_MRN, OO_PERFORMED_DTE BLOOD_DRAWN_DATE , TIME(MIN(OO_PERFORMED_DT)) BLOOD_DRAWN_TIME , MIN(OO_PERFORMED_DT) BLOOD_DRAWN_DT FROM IDB.OMS_ORDER JOIN IDB.OMS_ANCILLARY_NAME ON OAN_MSTR_ITEM_GUID = OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_CATALOG ON OAN_MSTR_ITEM_GUID = OOC_MSTR_ITEM_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_ENTRY_FORM ON OO_ENTRY_FRM_GUID = OEF_ENTRY_FRM_GUID AND OEF_CURRENT_IND = 'Y' AND OAN_CODING_STD = 'MSKLab' AND OOC_EXP_DT IS NULL AND(UCASE(OOC_ITEM_NAME) NOT LIKE '%URIN%' OR OAN_ANC_NAME = 'TPMT') AND UCASE(OOC_ITEM_NAME) NOT LIKE '%STOOL%' AND UCASE(OOC_ITEM_NAME) NOT LIKE '%SALIVA%' AND UCASE(OOC_ITEM_NAME) NOT LIKE '%CSF%' AND UCASE(OOC_ITEM_NAME) NOT LIKE '%BILL%' AND UCASE(OOC_ITEM_NAME) NOT LIKE '%FLUID%' AND UCASE(OOC_ITEM_NAME) NOT LIKE '%NOTE%' AND UCASE(OOC_ITEM_NAME) NOT LIKE '%FECAL%' AND UCASE(OOC_ITEM_NAME) NOT LIKE '%GASTRIC%' AND UCASE(OOC_ITEM_NAME) NOT LIKE '%(NO)%' AND UCASE(OOC_ITEM_NAME) NOT LIKE '%MARROW%' AND UCASE(OOC_ITEM_NAME) NOT LIKE '%CATHETER%' AND UCASE(OOC_ITEM_NAME) NOT LIKE '%WOUND%' AND OAN_ANC_NAME <> 'MARROW' AND OOC_REV_CAT_DEPT <> 'Miscellaneous' AND UCASE(OOC_ITEM_DESC) NOT LIKE '%QUEST%' AND UCASE(OOC_ITEM_DESC) NOT LIKE '%NO%' AND UCASE(OOC_ITEM_DESC) NOT LIKE '%NO%ORD%' AND UCASE(OOC_ITEM_DESC) NOT LIKE '%EXP%' AND UCASE(OOC_ITEM_DESC) NOT LIKE '%BILL%' AND UCASE(OOC_ITEM_DESC) NOT LIKE '%DECTIVATED%' AND UCASE(OOC_ITEM_DESC) NOT LIKE 'BM%' AND OEF_FORM_TITLE NOT IN ('Chemistry-Urines', 'Sperm Banking') AND OAN_MSTR_ITEM_GUID NOT IN ('7000001435073001', '5000002972073001', '1000004498073029', '7000001524073001', '5000003254073029', '7000003254073029', '7000001405073001', '6000001438073001', '7000001196073001', '7000001317073001', '9000001499073001', '1000001513073001', '9000006287100730', '4000001512073001', '1007073001') WHERE OO_ORD_STS_CD NOT IN ('CANC', 'CANP', 'DISC', 'AUC1') AND OO_PERFORMED_DTE BETWEEN LAST_DAY(CURRENT DATE - 2 MONTH) + 1 DAY AND LAST_DAY(CURRENT DATE - 1 MONTH) GROUP BY OO_MRN, OO_PERFORMED_DTE) CIS ON MRN = OO_MRN AND VST_DTE = BLOOD_DRAWN_DATE JOIN IDB.CL_PATIENT ON CL_MRN = MRN WHERE COALESCE(VITALS_SCAN_DT, BLOOD_DRAWN_DT) IS NOT NULL

prompt: Identify MRNs for the de-identified ID's created by DAVInCI query.
completion: SELECT "Deident PT #", "MRN", "Last Name", "First Name", "CPT Procedure Date - OR", "ICD-9 First Dx Date", CASE WHEN "ICD-9 CIC-Coded Indicator" = 1 THEN 'YES' ELSE '' END AS "ICD-9 CIC-Coded Indicator", "ICD-O Histology Code", "ICD-O Histology Desc", "ICD-O Site Code", "ICD-O Site Desc", "RT Indicator" FROM (SELECT "Deident PT #", "MRN", "Last Name", "First Name", "CPT Procedure Date - OR", "ICD-9 First Dx Date", MAX("ICD-9 CIC-Coded Indicator") AS "ICD-9 CIC-Coded Indicator", "ICD-O Histology Code", "ICD-O Histology Desc", "ICD-O Site Code", "ICD-O Site Desc", "RT Indicator" FROM (SELECT DISTINCT "t1"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AS "Deident PT #", "t2"."PT_MRN" AS "MRN", "t2"."PT_LAST_NAME" AS "Last Name", "t2"."PT_FIRST_NAME" AS "First Name", "t3"."DT_DTE" AS "CPT Procedure Date - OR", "t6"."DT_DTE" AS "ICD-9 First Dx Date", CASE WHEN "t5"."DXA_CIC_CDER_INIT" = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS "ICD-9 CIC-Coded Indicator", "t4"."DXCC_ICD_CODE" AS "ICD-O Histology Code", "t4"."DXCC_ICD_MSK_DESC" AS "ICD-O Histology Desc", "t4"."ICSC_SITE_CD" AS "ICD-O Site Code", "t4"."ICSC_ICDO_SITE_MSK_DESC" AS "ICD-O Site Desc", CASE WHEN "t4"."PLA_LAST_RT_DTE" IS NOT NULL THEN 'Y' ELSE '' END AS "RT Indicator" FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED" "t1" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS" "t2" ON "t1"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t2"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."CPT_OR_PATIENT_PROCEDURE" "t7" ON "t1"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t7"."PTX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE" "t3" ON "t7"."PTX_PROC_DATE_ID" = "t3"."DT_DATE_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_ICDO_DIAGNOSIS_V" "t4" ON "t1"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t4"."PDX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DIAGNOSIS_FINAL_ALL_V" "t5" ON "t1"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t5"."PDX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AND "t5"."PDX_DX_CATALOG_ID" IN (5860) LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DIAGNOSIS_FINAL_DATES_V" "t8" ON "t5"."PDX_DX_CATALOG_ID" = "t8"."PDX_DX_CATALOG_ID" AND "t5"."PDX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t8"."PDX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE" "t6" ON "t8"."FIRST_DIAGNOSIS_DATE_ID" = "t6"."DT_DATE_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_LATEST_ACTIVITY" "t4" ON "t1"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t4"."PLA_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AND "t4"."PLA_LAST_RT_DTE" >= '1901-1-1' WHERE "t7"."PROC_ID" IN (8853) ) AS A GROUP BY "Deident PT #", "MRN", "Last Name", "First Name", "CPT Procedure Date - OR", "ICD-9 First Dx Date", "ICD-O Histology Code", "ICD-O Histology Desc", "ICD-O Site Code", "ICD-O Site Desc", "RT Indicator") AS B

prompt: Would like CEA/CA19-9 and CA125 data for all patient MRNS on project for ICARuS clinical trial. We will provide all MRNs to dataline.
Identify all salivary gland patients from 1985-2009.
completion: WITH CTE AS (SELECT TM_MRN AS MRN, MIN(TM_DX_DTE) AS MIN_DTE FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR WHERE TM_SITE_CD BETWEEN 'C079' AND 'C089' AND TM_DX_DTE BETWEEN '1985-01-01' AND '2009-12-31' AND TM_CASE_STS IN ('3', '6', '7', '8') GROUP BY TM_MRN UNION ALL SELECT CC_MRN AS MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS MIN_DTE FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF WHERE CC_CLSF_CD IN ('142', '142.0', '142.1', '142.2', '142.8', '142.9', '210.2') AND CC_EFF_DTE BETWEEN '1985-01-01' AND '2009-12-31' AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' GROUP BY CC_MRN UNION ALL SELECT CC_MRN AS MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS MIN_DTE FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF WHERE CC_CLSF_CD IN ('26.0', '26.11', '26.12', '26.99') AND CC_EFF_DTE BETWEEN '1985-01-01' AND '2009-12-31' GROUP BY CC_MRN UNION ALL SELECT PBD_MRN AS MRN, MIN(PBD_SVC_DTE) AS MIN_DTE FROM IDB.PBD_DTL JOIN IDB.PBD_INVOICE ON PBD_INV_NO = PBI_INV_NO JOIN IDB.PBD_CODE ON PBD_PBD_CD = PBC_PBD_CD WHERE PBC_CPT_CD IN ('42330', '42400', '42405', '42408', '42410', '42415', '42420', '42425', '42426', '42440', '42450') AND PBD_SVC_DTE BETWEEN '1985-01-01' AND '2009-12-31' GROUP BY PBD_MRN ) SELECT MRN, MIN(MIN_DTE) AS MIN_DTE FROM CTE GROUP BY MRN

prompt: The CME office requires a list of names and emails of current and past patients with a pancreas cancer diagnosis in order to send an email invitation for an event to a select group of patients. The event takes place November 18, 2022, and we would like to send the email on or around November 1
completion: WITH PATIENTS AS (SELECT TRIM(PT_MRN) AS PT_MRN, TRIM(PT_LAST_NAME) || ', ' || TRIM(PT_FIRST_NAME) AS PATIENTS_NAME, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, TRIM(PT_EMAIL_ADDRESS) AS EMAIL_ADDRESS, CPE_ENC_DTE, CPE_CPE_APPT_STS, PT_DEATH_IND, AV_DESC AS DEATH_IND_DESC, PT_STATE, PT_CITY, PT_ZIP_CD FROM IDB.PATIENT JOIN IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER ON PT_MRN = CPE_MRN JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTV_DTL ON PT_MRN = LAD_MRN JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS ON AV_ELEMENT = 'DEATH_IND' AND AV_CODE = PT_DEATH_IND WHERE 1=1 AND CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Sch', 'Arrived', 'Comp') AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN '2016-01-01'AND '2022-12-31' AND UPPER(AV_DESC) IN 'ALIVE' AND PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH >= '1922-01-01' AND LAD_DONOT_CON_IND <> 'Y' AND LEFT(PT_ZIP_CD, 2) IN ('10', '11', '06', '07') AND TRIM(PT_EMAIL_ADDRESS) <> '' ), DIAGNOSIS AS (SELECT CC_MRN, CLM_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK, CC_EFF_DTE FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CLM_CLSF_CD = CC_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS ON AV_CODE = CC_CLSF_TYPE WHERE AV_ELEMENT = 'CLSF_TYPE' AND CLM_CLSF_CD IN ('157.4', 'C25.9', '157.9', 'C25.8', 'C25.7', 'C25.4') AND CC_EFF_DTE BETWEEN '2016-01-01'AND '2022-12-31' ) SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN, PATIENTS_NAME, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, EMAIL_ADDRESS, CPE_ENC_DTE, CPE_CPE_APPT_STS, DEATH_IND_DESC, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK, PT_STATE, PT_CITY FROM PATIENTS JOIN DIAGNOSIS ON PT_MRN = CC_MRN

prompt: Provide patient and pathology data based on Darwin query "LCAZ STUDY (Brogi/Norton) 12-17-13".
completion: SELECT DISTINCT "t1"."PT_MRN" AS "MRN", "t2"."ICSC_SITE_CD" AS "ICD-O Site Code", "t2"."ICSC_ICDO_SITE_MSK_DESC" AS "ICD-O Site Description", "t3"."PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_DESC" AS "Pathology Report Type", "t4"."PRPT_ACCESSION_NO" AS "Pathology Report", "t5"."DT_DTE" AS "Pathology Report Date", "t6"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AS "Deident PT #" FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED" "t6" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V" "t1" ON "t6"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t1"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."CDB_TUMOR_V" "t7" ON "t6"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t7"."CDTM_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."ICDO_SITE_CATALOG_V" "t2" ON "t7"."CDTM_SITE_CATALOG_ID" = "t2"."ICSC_SITE_CATALOG_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V" "t4" ON "t6"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t4"."PRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATH_RPRT_TYPE_LOOKUP" "t3" ON "t4"."PRPT_REPORT_TYPE" = "t3"."PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_CD" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" "t5" ON "t4"."PRPT_REPORT_DATE_ID" = "t5"."DT_DATE_ID" WHERE (("t5"."DT_YEAR" BETWEEN 2005 AND 2013 AND ("t3"."PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_DESC" IN ('Special Procedure, Surgical', 'Surgical Pathology', 'Surgical Pathology Breast') AND ("t2"."ICSC_SITE_CD" IN ('C500', 'C501', 'C502', 'C503', 'C504', 'C505', 'C506', 'C509') AND (CONTAINS("t4"."PRPT_REPORT", '("large central acellular zone" | "large central acellular zone of necrosis" | "central fibrosis" | "central necrosis" | "carcinoma with myxofibroid stromal changes" | "ductal carcinoma with central fibrosis" | "invasive ductal carcinoma with a large central acellular zone" | "invasive ductal carcinoma with large central acellular zone" | "IDC with centri-zonal necrosis" | "IDC with central necrosis" | "invasive carcinoma with a central acellular zone" | "poorly differentiated IDC with a large central necrotic zone" | "poorly differentiated IDC with a large central acellular zone" | "poorly differentiated invasive ductal carcinoma with a large central necrotic zone" | "poorly differentiated invasive ductal carcinoma with a large central acellular zone" | "poorly differentiated invasive ductal carcinoma with large central necrotic zone" | "poorly differentiated invasive ductal carcinoma with large central acellular zone")') = 1 AND (CONTAINS("t4"."PRPT_REPORT", '("excision" | "lumpectomy" | "excisional biopsy" | "surgical biopsy" | "mastectomy")') = 1 AND NOT(CONTAINS("t4"."PRPT_REPORT", '("biopsy" | "core biopsy" | "needle loc biopsy" | "FNA" | "fine needle aspirate")') = 1)))))) AND ("t4"."PRPT_REPORT" IS NOT NULL AND ("t4"."PRPT_REPORT" IS NOT NULL AND "t4"."PRPT_REPORT" IS NOT NULL)))

prompt: Schedule a bi-weekly report of patients diagnosed with Small Cell Lung Cancer (SCLC) currently receiving atezolizumab or lurbinectedin.
completion: WITH CTE1 AS (SELECT STRIP(APR_MRN) AS MRN, STRIP(PT_LAST_NAME) || ', ' || STRIP(PT_FIRST_NAME) AS "PT Name", STRIP(PT_SEX) AS "Gender", PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH AS DOB, STRIP(CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME) AS "Chemo Name", MAX(APR_START_DTE) AS "Latest Chemo Date", STRIP(APR_DIAGNOSIS_DESC) AS DX_DESC FROM IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX_V JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON APR_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE CDG_CHEMO_FLAG = 'Y' AND PT_DATE_OF_DEATH IS NULL AND(UPPER(APR_GENERIC_NAME) LIKE '%ATEZOLIZUMAB%' OR UPPER(APR_GENERIC_NAME) LIKE '%LURBINECTEDIN%' OR UPPER(APR_DRUG_NAME) LIKE '%ATEZOLIZUMAB%' OR UPPER(APR_DRUG_NAME) LIKE '%LURBINECTEDIN%') AND((UPPER(APR_DIAGNOSIS_DESC) like '%SMALL%CELL%' AND UPPER(APR_DIAGNOSIS_DESC) like '%LUNG%') OR APR_DIAGNOSIS_DESC like '%SCLC%') AND UPPER(APR_DIAGNOSIS_DESC) not like '%NON%' AND UPPER(APR_DIAGNOSIS_DESC) not like '%NSCLC%' GROUP BY STRIP(APR_MRN), STRIP(PT_LAST_NAME) || ', ' || STRIP(PT_FIRST_NAME), STRIP(PT_SEX), PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, STRIP(CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME), STRIP(APR_DIAGNOSIS_DESC) ) , CTE2 AS (SELECT MRN, "PT Name", "Gender", DOB, "Chemo Name", "Latest Chemo Date", DX_DESC, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY MRN ORDER BY "Latest Chemo Date" DESC, "Chemo Name" DESC) AS RN_CHEMO FROM CTE1) , X AS (SELECT * FROM CTE2 WHERE RN_CHEMO = 1 ) , CPE AS (SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN, CPE_ENC_DTE, CRE_RES_NAME, CRE_RES_TYP, CLD_DEPT_NAME, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8, CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CPE_MRN ORDER BY CPE_ENC_DTE DESC) AS RN FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN X ON MRN = CPE_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Comp', 'Arrived') AND CRE_RES_TYP = 'Physician' AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT date - 30 DAYS AND CURRENT date ) , X1 AS (SELECT DISTINCT X.* FROM X JOIN CPE ON CPE_MRN = MRN) , THR AS (SELECT CPE_MRN, CPE_ENC_DTE AS "Next THR Appt Date", STRIP(CRE_RES_NAME) AS "Next THR Physician", ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CPE_MRN ORDER BY CPE_ENC_DTE, CPE_APPT_DT) AS RN_THR FROM (SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN, CPE_ENC_DTE, CPE_APPT_DT, CRE_RES_NAME, CRE_RES_TYP, CLD_DEPT_NAME, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8, CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN X1 ON CPE_MRN = MRN JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Sch') AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 = 'THR') C) , CT_PET_NEXT AS (SELECT CPE_MRN, CPE_ENC_DTE AS "Next CT-PET Date", STRIP(CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME) AS "Next CT-PET", ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CPE_MRN ORDER BY CPE_ENC_DTE, CPE_APPT_DT) AS RN_CT_PET FROM (SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN, CPE_ENC_DTE, CPE_APPT_DT, CRE_RES_NAME, CRE_RES_TYP, CLD_DEPT_NAME, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8, CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME, CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN X1 ON CPE_MRN = MRN JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Sch') AND(CRE_RES_NAME like 'CT %' OR CRE_RES_NAME like 'PET %') )) , RAD1 AS (SELECT DISTINCT "t1"."PT_MRN" AS "MRN", "t2"."RRPT_ACCESSION_NO" AS "Radiology Accession Number", "t2"."RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE" AS "Last CT-PET Date", "t2"."RRPT_REPORT_DTE" AS "Radiology Report Date", "t2"."RRPT_ORDER_GROUP" AS "Radiology Order Group", "t2"."RRPT_PROCEDURE_NAME" AS "Last CT-PET", UPPER(DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)IMPRESSION:[\w\W]*(?=DICTATED BY:)', RRPT_REPORT_TXT)) AS IMPRESSION, UPPER(CASE WHEN LENGTH(RRPT_REPORT_TXT) <= 15000 THEN RTRIM(CAST(SUBSTR(RRPT_REPORT_TXT, 1, 15000) AS VARCHAR(15000))) ELSE CAST(SUBSTR(RRPT_REPORT_TXT, 1, 15000) AS VARCHAR(15000)) END) AS "PRPT_REPORT", ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY "t1"."PT_MRN" ORDER BY "t2"."RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE" DESC) AS RN_RAD FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V" "t1" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED" "t3" ON "t1"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t3"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."RADIOLOGY_REPORT_V" "t2" ON "t3"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t2"."RRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_IDENTIFICATION_MRN_V" "t4" ON "t1"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t4"."PI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" WHERE "t4"."PI_SOURCE_SYSTEM_PT_ID" IN (SELECT MRN FROM X1) AND(UPPER("t2"."RRPT_ORDER_GROUP") like '%CT%' OR UPPER("t2"."RRPT_ORDER_GROUP") like '%PET%') ) , AC1 AS (SELECT DISTINCT AC_MRN AS MRN, AC_IRB_NO FROM IDB.ACCRUALS JOIN X1 ON AC_MRN = MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.ACCRUALS_DATES ON AC_MRN = ACD_MRN AND AC_IRB_NO = ACD_IRB_NO WHERE ACD_OFF_STUDY_DTE IS NULL ) , AC2 AS (SELECT MRN, LISTAGG(COALESCE(STRIP(CAST(AC_IRB_NO AS VARCHAR(2000))), '') , CHR(13) || CHR(10)) WITHIN GROUP( ORDER BY MRN) AS IRB FROM (SELECT DISTINCT MRN, AC_IRB_NO FROM AC1) A GROUP BY MRN) , TM AS (SELECT DISTINCT TM_MRN, TM_DX_DTE, TM_HIST_CD AS HIST_CODE, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS HIST_DESC, TM_SITE_CD AS SITE_CODE, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_DESC FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN X1 ON TM_MRN = MRN JOIN IDB.CLM H ON TM_HIST_CD = H.CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON TM_SITE_CD = S.CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') ) , TM2 AS (SELECT TM_MRN, LISTAGG(COALESCE(STRIP(CAST(TM_DX_DTE AS VARCHAR(12000))), '') || ' | ' || COALESCE(STRIP(CAST(HIST_CODE AS VARCHAR(12000))), '') || ' | ' || COALESCE(STRIP(CAST(HIST_DESC AS VARCHAR(12000))), '') || ' | ' || COALESCE(STRIP(CAST(SITE_CODE AS VARCHAR(12000))), '') || ' | ' || COALESCE(STRIP(CAST(SITE_DESC AS VARCHAR(12000))), '') , CHR(13) || CHR(10)) WITHIN GROUP( ORDER BY TM_MRN, TM_DX_DTE) AS DX FROM TM GROUP BY TM_MRN) SELECT DISTINCT X1.*, "Next THR Appt Date", "Next THR Physician", "Next CT-PET Date", "Next CT-PET", "Last CT-PET Date", "Last CT-PET", REPLACE(IMPRESSION, 'FINAL REPORT', '') AS IMPRESSION, DX, IRB FROM X1 LEFT JOIN THR ON X1.MRN = THR.CPE_MRN AND RN_THR = 1 LEFT JOIN CT_PET_NEXT ON X1.MRN = CT_PET_NEXT.CPE_MRN AND RN_CT_PET = 1 LEFT JOIN RAD1 ON X1.MRN = RAD1.MRN AND RN_RAD = 1 LEFT JOIN AC2 ON X1.MRN = AC2.MRN LEFT JOIN TM2 ON X1.MRN = TM_MRN

prompt: Create a report listing lab specimens and MRNs that were released from various locations. The report should be for the 2nd quarter and separated by the week and day.
completion: SELECT LOCATION, MONTH, WEEK_NO, CASE WHEN DAY = 1 THEN 'Mon' WHEN DAY = 2 THEN 'Tue' WHEN DAY = 3 THEN 'Wed' WHEN DAY = 4 THEN 'Thu' WHEN DAY = 5 THEN 'Fri' WHEN DAY = 6 THEN 'Sat' ELSE 'Sun' END AS WEEKDAY, COUNT(DISTINCT OO_MRN) AS PTS, COUNT(*) AS ORDS FROM (SELECT OO_MRN, OO_ENTER_DTE, OO_ORD_NAME, CASE WHEN MONTH(OO_ENTER_DTE) = 4 THEN 'April' WHEN MONTH(OO_ENTER_DTE) = 5 THEN 'May' ELSE 'June' END AS MONTH, WEEK_ISO(OO_ENTER_DTE) AS WEEK_NO, DAYOFWEEK_ISO(OO_ENTER_DTE) AS DAY, OCV_CURR_LOC AS LOCATION FROM IDB.OMS_ORDER JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_CATALOG ON OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID = OOC_MSTR_ITEM_GUID AND UCASE(OOC_REV_CAT_DEPT) = 'LABORATORY' JOIN IDB.OMS_CLIENT_VISIT ON OCV_VISIT_GUID = OO_VISIT_GUID AND OCV_CURR_LOC LIKE '%64%' WHERE OO_ENTER_DTE BETWEEN '2009-04-01' AND '2009-06-30' AND OO_ORD_STS_CD LIKE 'RES%' AND OO_PERFORMED_DT IS NOT NULL AND OO_ORD_TYPE_CD = 'Diagnostic' AND UCASE(OO_CREATE_BY) NOT LIKE '%INTERFACES%' ) DTL GROUP BY LOCATION, MONTH, WEEK_NO, DAY

prompt: Please remove procedure codes for thyroidectomy (CPX_PROC_CD in the report is 60240).
completion: WITH PREP AS (SELECT OTR_RELEASE_NAME, OTR_RELEASE_DATE, OTTT_CODE, OTTT_NAME, OTTT_MAINTYPENAME, OTTT_TISSUE FROM (SELECT OTR_RELEASE_NAME, OTR_RELEASE_DATE, OTTT_CODE, OTTT_NAME, OTTT_MAINTYPENAME, OTTT_TISSUE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY OTTT_CODE ORDER BY CASE WHEN OTR_RELEASE_NAME = 'oncotree_latest_stable' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END DESC, OTR_RELEASE_DATE DESC) RN FROM DSGTOOLS.ONCOTREE_TUMORTYPE_V WHERE OTR_RELEASE_NAME NOT IN ('oncotree_development', 'oncotree_candidate_release') ) WHERE RN = 1 ), DIAGNOSIS AS (SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN, PDRX_ACCESSION_NO, PDRX_DMP_PATIENT_ID, PDRX_DMP_SAMPLE_ID, TUMOR_TYPE_CODE, TUMOR_TYPE_NAME, OTTT_MAINTYPENAME, OTTT_TISSUE, OTR_RELEASE_NAME, IS_METASTASIS, PRIMARY_SITE, METASTASIS_SITE, PART_DESCRIPTION FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML INNER JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML_SETTINGS ON PDRX_PATH_DMP_RESULTS_XML_ID = PDRXS_PATH_DMP_RESULTS_XML_ID INNER JOIN DVDMC.PATHOLOGY_DMP_WEBSVC_SETTINGS ON PDRXS_SETTING_ID = PDWS_SETTING_ID INNER JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON PDRX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID, XMLTABLE('$c/root/meta-data' PASSING PDRX_XML_VALUE AS "c" COLUMNS TUMOR_TYPE_CODE VARCHAR(100) PATH 'tumor_type_code', TUMOR_TYPE_NAME VARCHAR(255) PATH 'tumor_type_name', IS_METASTASIS VARCHAR(10) PATH 'is_metastasis', PRIMARY_SITE VARCHAR(255) PATH 'primary_site', METASTASIS_SITE VARCHAR(255) PATH 'metastasis_site', PART_DESCRIPTION VARCHAR(2000) PATH 'part_description') T INNER JOIN PREP ON TUMOR_TYPE_CODE = OTTT_CODE WHERE OTTT_MAINTYPENAME = 'Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer' ) SELECT OC_CASE_ID , OC_MRN , TRIM(PT_LAST_NAME) CONCAT ', ' CONCAT TRIM(PT_FIRST_NAME) PT_NAME , CASE WHEN OCAS_SURG_ROLE = 'Primary' THEN CRE_RES_NAME END PRIMARY_SURGEON , CASE WHEN OCAS_SURG_ROLE = 'Assissting' THEN CRE_RES_NAME END CO_SURGEON , OC_SURG_DTE , CPX_PROC_CD , CPX_PROC_NAME , OTTT_MAINTYPENAME , TUMOR_TYPE_CODE , TUMOR_TYPE_NAME FROM IDB.OR_CASE JOIN IDB.OR_CASE_ALL_PROC ON OC_CASE_ID = OCAP_CASE_ID JOIN IDB.OR_CASE_ALL_SURG ON OCAP_CASE_ID = OCAS_CASE_ID AND OCAS_PNL_NO = OCAP_PNL_NO JOIN IDB.OR_PROC ON OCAP_OR_PROC_ID = OP_OR_PROC_ID JOIN IDB.OR_CL_PROC ON OP_OR_PROC_ID = OCP_OR_PROC_ID JOIN IDB.CL_PROC ON OCP_PROC_ID = CPX_PROC_ID JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CRE_RES_ID = OCAS_RES_ID JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON OC_MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN DIAGNOSIS ON OC_MRN = DIAGNOSIS.PT_MRN WHERE 1 = 1 AND (OC_SURG_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT date AND CURRENT date + 21) AND OC_OR_CASE_STS_CD NOT IN ('2', '5') AND ((CPX_PROC_CD BETWEEN '32440' AND '32549' AND CPX_PROC_CD <> '32491') OR (CPX_PROC_CD IN ('32663', '32657', '32669', '32670', '7502999', '532480', '7532482', '7532483', '7532484', '7532486', '7532489', '7532500', '7532501', '7532502', '7532506', '7532507', '7532515', '7532657', '7532667'))) GROUP BY OC_CASE_ID , OC_MRN , TRIM(PT_LAST_NAME) CONCAT ', ' CONCAT TRIM(PT_FIRST_NAME) , OCAS_SURG_ROLE , CRE_RES_NAME , CASE WHEN OCAS_SURG_ROLE = 'Primary' THEN CRE_RES_NAME END , CASE WHEN OCAS_SURG_ROLE = 'Co-Surgeon' THEN CRE_RES_NAME END , OC_SURG_DTE , CPX_PROC_CD , CPX_PROC_NAME , OTTT_MAINTYPENAME , TUMOR_TYPE_CODE , TUMOR_TYPE_NAME ORDER BY OC_CASE_ID, OC_SURG_DTE ASC

prompt: Provide diagnosis and demographic data for a list of MRNs.
completion: WITH "cte1" AS (SELECT * FROM DV.ENCOUNTER_SCHD_RESOURCES WHERE ENSR_PRIMARY_RES_IND = 'Y' ), "cte2" AS (SELECT EDC_DEPT_DESC, EDC_DEPT_ABBREV FROM DV.ENCOUNTER_DESC_CATALOG WHERE EDC_GROUP_ID = '8' ), "cte3" AS (SELECT EDC_DEPT_ABBREV, EDC_DEPT_DESC FROM DV.ENCOUNTER_DESC_CATALOG WHERE EDC_GROUP_ID = 'STS' ), "cte4" AS (SELECT DXCC_DX_CATALOG_ID, LTRIM(RTRIM(DXCC_ICD_CODE)) DXCC_ICD_CODE, LTRIM(RTRIM(DXCC_ICD_MSK_DESC)) DXCC_ICD_MSK_DESC, LTRIM(RTRIM(DXCC_ICD_CODE)) || ' - ' || LTRIM(RTRIM(DXCC_ICD_MSK_DESC)) AS DXCC_CODE_AND_MSK_DESC, LTRIM(RTRIM(DXCC_ICD_NATIONAL_DESC)) DXCC_ICD_NATIONAL_DESC, DXCC_DESC_LONG, CASE WHEN DXCC_ICD_CODE BETWEEN '196' AND '196.99' OR DXCC_ICD_CODE BETWEEN '197' AND '197.99' OR DXCC_ICD_CODE BETWEEN '198' AND '198.99' THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS DXCC_METS_INDICATOR, DXCC_CREATED_DT, DXCC_CREATED_BY, DXCC_MODIFIED_DT FROM DV.DIAGNOSIS_CATALOG WHERE DXCC_DX_TYPE = 'ICD9' ) SELECT DISTINCT "t1"."PT_MRN" AS "MRN", "t1"."PT_LAST_NAME" AS "Last Name", "t1"."PT_FIRST_NAME" AS "First Name", "t2"."ENDP_SERVICE_SPECIALTY_GRP_8" AS "Clinical Service (Group 8)", "t3"."EDC_DEPT_DESC" AS "Clinical Service Desc (Group 8)", "t4"."ENR_RES_NAME" AS "Primary Resource Name", CASE WHEN "t5"."EDC_DEPT_DESC"IN ('Arrived', 'Completed') THEN 'Completed' WHEN "t5"."EDC_DEPT_DESC" IN ('Scheduled') THEN 'Scheduled' ELSE 'Non-Completed/Scheduled' END AS "Completed/Scheduled Indicator", "t6"."DT_DTE" AS "Encounter Date" FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V" "t1" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED" "t7" ON "t1"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t7"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_ENCOUNTER" "t8" ON "t7"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t8"."PENC_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."ENCOUNTER_DEPARTMENT" "t2" ON "t8"."PENC_DEPT_ID" = "t2"."ENDP_ENC_DEPT_ID" LEFT JOIN "cte1" "t9" ON "t8"."PENC_PT_ENC_ID" = "t9"."ENSR_PT_ENC_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."ENCOUNTER_DEPARTMENT" "t10" ON "t9"."ENSR_DEPT_ID" = "t10"."ENDP_ENC_DEPT_ID" LEFT JOIN "cte2" "t3" ON "t10"."ENDP_SERVICE_SPECIALTY_GRP_8" = "t3"."EDC_DEPT_ABBREV" LEFT JOIN "DV"."ENCOUNTER_RESOURCE" "t4" ON "t9"."ENSR_RES_ID" = "t4"."ENR_ENC_RES_ID" LEFT JOIN "cte3" "t5" ON "t8"."PENC_APPT_STS" = "t5"."EDC_DEPT_ABBREV" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" "t6" ON "t8"."PENC_ENC_DATE_ID" = "t6"."DT_DATE_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."CDB_TUMOR_V" "t11" ON "t7"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t11"."CDTM_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."ICDO_SITE_CATALOG_V" "t12" ON "t11"."CDTM_SITE_CATALOG_ID" = "t12"."ICSC_SITE_CATALOG_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DIAGNOSIS_FINAL_ALL_V" "t13" ON "t7"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t13"."PDX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "cte4" "t14" ON "t13"."PDX_DX_CATALOG_ID" = "t14"."DXCC_DX_CATALOG_ID" WHERE (("t12"."ICSC_SITE_CD" IN ('C250', 'C251', 'C252', 'C253', 'C254', 'C257', 'C258', 'C259') OR "t14"."DXCC_ICD_CODE" IN ('157', '157.0', '157.1', '157.2', '157.3', '157.4', '157.8', '157.9')) AND ("t2"."ENDP_SERVICE_SPECIALTY_GRP_8" = 'GNT' AND (CASE WHEN "t5"."EDC_DEPT_DESC"IN ('Arrived', 'Completed') THEN 'Completed' WHEN "t5"."EDC_DEPT_DESC" IN ('Scheduled') THEN 'Scheduled' ELSE 'Non-Completed/Scheduled' END = 'Completed' AND "t6"."DT_DTE" BETWEEN '2014-1-1' AND '2014-7-31')))

prompt: Provide a quarterly report on Psychiatry's GAD-7 and PHQ-9 scale data.
completion: WITH CTE AS (SELECT OP_DISPLAY_NAME AS PROVIDER, SUM(CASE WHEN CDO_MSTR_ITEM_NM = 'Psy_Initial_MSE_GAD 7 ob' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS GAD, SUM(CASE WHEN CDO_MSTR_ITEM_NM = 'Psy_Initial_MSE_PHQ 9 ob' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS PHQ FROM IDB.CD_DOCUMENT JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION ON CDD_DOC_GUID = CDO_DOC_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_PROVIDER ON CDD_AUTH_PROV_GUID = OP_PVDR_GUID WHERE CDD_DOC_NAME IN ('Follow Up Note - Psychiatry', 'Initial Evaluation - Psychiatry') AND CDD_CANCEL_IND <> '1' AND CDD_AUTHORED_DTE >= '2011-05-01' AND CDO_MSTR_ITEM_NM IN ('Psy_Initial_MSE_GAD 7 ob', 'Psy_Initial_MSE_PHQ 9 ob') AND CDO_VALUE_TEXT <> '' GROUP BY OP_DISPLAY_NAME), CTE2 AS (SELECT OP_DISPLAY_NAME AS PROVIDER, COUNT(DISTINCT CDD_DOC_GUID) AS DOCS FROM IDB.CD_DOCUMENT JOIN IDB.OMS_PROVIDER ON CDD_AUTH_PROV_GUID = OP_PVDR_GUID WHERE CDD_DOC_NAME IN ('Follow Up Note - Psychiatry', 'Initial Evaluation - Psychiatry') AND CDD_CANCEL_IND <> '1' AND CDD_AUTHORED_DTE >= '2011-05-01' GROUP BY OP_DISPLAY_NAME) SELECT CTE2.PROVIDER, DECIMAL(GAD, 10, 5)/DECIMAL(DOCS, 10, 5) AS GAD_PERCENT, DECIMAL(PHQ, 10, 5)/DECIMAL(DOCS, 10, 5) AS PHQ_PERCENT, DOCS FROM CTE2 LEFT JOIN CTE ON CTE.PROVIDER = CTE2.PROVIDER

prompt: I would like total volume of patients seen by Peds Psych, in 2012 and 2013, by I/P and O/P.  Also, I would like unique counts of patients seen by Peds Psych, in 2012 and 2013, by I/P (unique number) and O/P (new visit).
completion: WITH OPVISITS AS (SELECT DOC_NAME AS OPMD, CPE_ENC_CSN_ID AS CSN, CPE_MRN AS OPMRN , YEAR(CPE_ENC_DTE) AS OPYEAR, CPE_ENC_DTE AS OPDATE, CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR AS VT FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.DOC ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = DOC_DR_NO AND DOC_DR_NO IN ('011775', '011619', '013854', '018507') JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN '2012-01-01' AND '2013-12-31' AND CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Comp', 'Arrived') ) , OPSUM AS (SELECT OPMD, OPYEAR, COUNT(CSN) AS OPVIS FROM OPVISITS GROUP BY OPMD, OPYEAR) , OPNVPTS AS (SELECT OPMD, OPYEAR, COUNT(DISTINCT OPMRN) AS OPNV FROM OPVISITS WHERE VT LIKE '%NV%' GROUP BY OPMD, OPYEAR) , IP AS (SELECT IPMD, IPYEAR, COUNT(IPMRN) AS IPVISITS, COUNT(DISTINCT IPMRN) AS IPPTS FROM (SELECT DISTINCT DOC_NAME AS IPMD, YEAR(PBD_SVC_DTE) AS IPYEAR, PBD_SVC_DTE AS IPDATE , PBD_MRN AS IPMRN FROM IDB.PBD_DTL JOIN IDB.PBD_INVOICE ON PBI_MRN = PBD_MRN AND PBI_ACCT_NO = PBD_ACCT_NO AND PBI_INV_NO = PBD_INV_NO AND PBI_PERFORM_DR_NO IN ('011775', '011619', '013854', '018507') JOIN IDB.DOC ON PBI_PERFORM_DR_NO = DOC_DR_NO WHERE PBD_SVC_DTE BETWEEN '2012-01-01' AND '2013-12-31' AND PBD_ACCT_NO LIKE '84%' ) AS X GROUP BY IPMD, IPYEAR) SELECT A.OPMD, A.OPYEAR, OPVIS, OPNV, IPVISITS, IPPTS FROM OPSUM A LEFT JOIN OPNVPTS B ON A.OPMD = B.OPMD AND A.OPYEAR = B.OPYEAR LEFT JOIN IP ON IPMD = A.OPMD AND A.OPYEAR = IPYEAR

prompt: Provide a push report that is triggered when patients on Airborne-MTB or Airborne-Rule Out MTB precautions are scheduled for outpatient appointments.

prompt: Provide the foreign and forfile MRI brain exams from January 2000 to December 2021 who brain metastasis for Dr. Stember.
completion: WITH RAD AS (SELECT DISTINCT "t1"."PT_MRN" AS "MRN", "t2"."RRPT_ACCESSION_NO" AS "Radiology Accession Number", "t2"."RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE" AS "Radiology Performed Date", "t2"."RRPT_REPORT_DTE" AS "Radiology Report Date", "t2"."RRPT_ORDER_GROUP" AS "Radiology Order Group", RRPT_ANC_CODE, "t2"."RRPT_PROCEDURE_NAME" AS "Radiology Procedure Name", UPPER(CASE WHEN LENGTH(RRPT_REPORT_TXT) <= 15000 THEN RTRIM(CAST(SUBSTR(RRPT_REPORT_TXT, 1, 15000) AS VARCHAR(15000))) ELSE CAST(SUBSTR(RRPT_REPORT_TXT, 1, 15000) AS VARCHAR(15000)) END) AS "PRPT_REPORT", DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)IMPRESSION[\w\W]*(?=DICTATED BY:)', RRPT_REPORT_TXT) AS RRPT_IMPRESSION , DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)IMPRESSION[\w\W]*(?=DICTATEDBY:)', RRPT_REPORT_TXT) AS RRPT_IMPRESSION2, DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)CLINICAL STATEMENT:[\w\W]*(?=TECHNIQUE:)', RRPT_REPORT_TXT) AS CLINICAL_STATEMENT, DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)CLINICAL[\w\W]*(?=TECHNIQUE:)', RRPT_REPORT_TXT) AS CLINICAL_STATEMENT1, DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)CLINICAL[\w\W]*(?=TECHNIQUES:)', RRPT_REPORT_TXT) AS CLINICAL_STATEMENT2, DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)CLINICAL[\w\W]*(?=TECHNIQUES)', RRPT_REPORT_TXT) AS CLINICAL_STATEMENT3 FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V" "t1" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED" "t3" ON "t1"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t3"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."RADIOLOGY_REPORT_V" "t2" ON "t3"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t2"."RRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_IDENTIFICATION_MRN_V" "t4" ON "t1"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t4"."PI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" WHERE 1=1 AND "t2"."RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE" BETWEEN '2000-01-01' AND '2021-12-31' AND RRPT_ANC_CODE IN ('FCDMRHD', 'FFCDMRHD') ) , TUMOR AS (SELECT TM_MRN, V.AV_DESC AS CASE_STS, TM_DX_DTE, TM_HIST_CD, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS HIST_DESC, TM_SITE_CD, G.AV_DESC AS GRADE, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_DESC, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, CASE WHEN CLINICAL_STATEMENT <> '' THEN CLINICAL_STATEMENT ELSE CASE WHEN CLINICAL_STATEMENT1 <> '' THEN CLINICAL_STATEMENT1 ELSE CASE WHEN CLINICAL_STATEMENT2 <> '' THEN CLINICAL_STATEMENT2 ELSE CASE WHEN CLINICAL_STATEMENT3 <> '' THEN CLINICAL_STATEMENT3 END END END END AS CLINICAL_STATEMENT FROM RAD JOIN IDB.CDB_TUMOR ON MRN= TM_MRN JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS V ON V.AV_ELEMENT = 'CASE_STS' AND V.AV_CODE = TM_CASE_STS LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS G ON G.AV_ELEMENT = 'HIST_CD_GRADE' AND G.AV_CODE = TM_HIST_CD_GRADE LEFT JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON MRN = PT_MRN WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') ) SELECT DISTINCT "MRN", PT_LAST_NAME, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH "Radiology Accession Number", "Radiology Performed Date", "Radiology Report Date", "Radiology Order Group", YEAR("Radiology Performed Date"- PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) AGE_AT_MRI, RRPT_ANC_CODE EXAM_CD, "Radiology Procedure Name", TM_DX_DTE DIAGNOSIS_DATE, TM_HIST_CD HISTOLOGY_CD, HIST_DESC HISTOLOGY_DESC, GRADE, "PRPT_REPORT", CASE WHEN RRPT_IMPRESSION <> '' THEN RRPT_IMPRESSION ELSE CASE WHEN RRPT_IMPRESSION2 <> '' THEN RRPT_IMPRESSION2 END END AS IMPRESSION, SUBSTR(T.CLINICAL_STATEMENT, 1, 150) CLINICAL_ST FROM RAD LEFT JOIN TUMOR T ON MRN = TM_MRN

PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) AGE_20061231, YEAR('2020-12-31' - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) AGE_20201231 FROM (SELECT TM_MRN MRN FROM CDB UNION SELECT PRPT_MRN MRN FROM PATH) JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON MRN = PT_MRN WHERE (YEAR('2020-12-31' - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) BETWEEN 15 AND 39 OR YEAR('2006-12-31' - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) BETWEEN 15 AND 39) ) , ORD AS (SELECT DISTINCT MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, OO_SET_GUID, OO_ENTER_DTE, OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE, OO_ORD_NAME, OO_SET_NAME, YEAR(OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) AGE_20061231, YEAR('2020-12-31' - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) AGE_20201231 FROM (SELECT TM_MRN MRN FROM CDB UNION SELECT PRPT_MRN MRN FROM PATH) JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON MRN = PT_MRN WHERE (YEAR('2020-12-31' -
