completion: SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN AS "MRN", PT_LAST_NAME "Last Name", PT_FIRST_NAME "First Name", PT_DATE_OF_DEATH "DOD", TM_DX_DTE "Dx Date", YEAR(TM_DX_DTE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) "Age at Dx", TM_SITE_CD AS "Site Code", S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS "Site Desc", TM_HIST_CD AS "Histology Code", H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS "Histology Desc" FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID JOIN IDB.CDB_TUMOR ON CPE_MRN = TM_MRN JOIN IDB.CLM H ON TM_HIST_CD = H.CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON TM_SITE_CD = S.CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON CPE_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 = 'SAR' AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN '2019-06-01' AND '2020-05-14' AND TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7') AND TM_HIST_CD IN ('M8850/3', 'M8850/6', 'M8851/3', 'M8852/3', 'M8852/6', 'M8853/3', 'M8853/6', 'M8854/3', 'M8855/3', 'M8857/3', 'M8860/3', 'M8860/6')

prompt: VP/ECC  - - Cluster 4 Cadence charges modification
completion: SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN, CPE_ENC_DTE, CPE_ENC_CSN_ID, CRE_RES_ID, CLD_DEPT_ABBR, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_4, CLD_CLD_CENTER, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_9, CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME, CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR, CVT_CVT_RPT_GRP_3, CV_CTC_VISIT_TYPE AS WITHIN_ADMIT, CASE WHEN OL_MRN IS NOT NULL THEN 'S' END AS OPTIME, CASE WHEN OO.MRN IS NOT NULL OR HX.MRN IS NOT NULL THEN 'M' END AS MOA, CHAR(CASE WHEN CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 = 'UCC' THEN 'UCC' WHEN CLD_DEPT_ABBR = 'PEDUCC' THEN 'UCP' WHEN CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 = 'PED' THEN 'PED' WHEN CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 = 'RDO' OR CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 = 'RDO' THEN 'RDO' WHEN CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR = 'LAB70' THEN 'GNT' WHEN CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 > ' ' THEN CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 WHEN CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 > ' ' THEN CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 ELSE 'AMB' END) AS SVC, CASE WHEN CLD_CLD_CENTER IN ('MAIN', 'UCC') THEN ' ' ELSE 'PO' END AS MOD3, CASE WHEN UPPER(CCH_CHEMO_NAME) = 'SCALP COOLING MACHINE SHORT' THEN '67543249' WHEN UPPER(CCH_CHEMO_NAME) = 'SCALP COOLING MACHINE MEDIUM' THEN '67543256' WHEN UPPER(CCH_CHEMO_NAME) = 'SCALP COOLING MACHINE LONG' THEN '67543264' WHEN (CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR = 'Cooling' AND CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME LIKE '%MACHINE%') OR CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR = 'COOLING' THEN '67543231' WHEN CPE_ENC_DTE < '2018-10-01' AND (CCH_CHEMO_ID BETWEEN 300 AND 1118 OR CCH_CHEMO_ID BETWEEN 1280 AND 1633 OR CCH_CHEMO_ID BETWEEN 1699 AND 1710 OR CCH_CHEMO_ID BETWEEN 1948 AND 1958) AND CCH_CHEMO_NAME NOT LIKE '%W/O ANESTH%' AND (CCH_CHEMO_NAME LIKE 'PACC%' OR CCH_CHEMO_NAME LIKE 'PDH%') THEN '77200004' WHEN CPE_ENC_DTE >= '2018-10-01' AND CCH_CHEMO_ID BETWEEN 2149 AND 2150 THEN '77200004' WHEN CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR = 'LAB70' THEN '51364156' END AS FMS_CDM, CASE WHEN CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR IN('TOTPH', '3DPH', 'TBI') THEN '96904' WHEN CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR = 'PDT' THEN '96567' WHEN CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR = 'FNA' AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 = 'CYT' THEN '10021' WHEN CCH_CHEMO_NAME LIKE 'PACC FNA%' OR CCH_CHEMO_NAME LIKE 'PDH FNA%' THEN '10021' WHEN CCH_CHEMO_NAME LIKE 'P%BMA%SPINAL TAP%' THEN '38220' WHEN CCH_CHEMO_NAME LIKE 'P%4 BMA%2 BIOP%' THEN '3822238220' WHEN CCH_CHEMO_NAME LIKE 'P%BMA%BIOPSY%' THEN '38222' WHEN CCH_CHEMO_NAME LIKE 'P%CORE%BIOPSY%' THEN '38505' WHEN CCH_CHEMO_NAME LIKE '%THORACENTESIS%' THEN '32554' WHEN CCH_CHEMO_NAME LIKE '%PARACENTESIS%' THEN '49082' WHEN CCH_CHEMO_NAME LIKE 'PACC OMMAYA%' OR CCH_CHEMO_NAME LIKE 'PDH OMMAYA%' THEN '61020' WHEN CPE_ENC_DTE <= '2018-12-31' AND (CCH_CHEMO_NAME LIKE 'PACC G-TUBE%' OR CCH_CHEMO_NAME LIKE 'PDH G-TUBE%') THEN '43760' WHEN CCH_CHEMO_NAME LIKE 'PACC G-TUBE%' OR CCH_CHEMO_NAME LIKE 'PDH G-TUBE%' THEN '43762' WHEN CCH_CHEMO_NAME LIKE 'PACC INCISION/DRAINAGE%' THEN '10060' WHEN CCH_CHEMO_NAME LIKE 'PACC SUPPRELIN%' OR CCH_CHEMO_NAME LIKE 'PDH SUPPRELIN%' THEN '11983' WHEN CCH_CHEMO_NAME LIKE 'PACC%FOLEY%' OR CCH_CHEMO_NAME LIKE 'PDH%FOLEY%' THEN '51702' WHEN CCH_CHEMO_NAME LIKE 'PACC%SKIN%BX%' OR CCH_CHEMO_NAME LIKE 'PDH%SKIN%BX%' THEN '11100' WHEN CCH_CHEMO_NAME LIKE 'P%PROCHYMAL/ME%' THEN '38242' WHEN CCH_CHEMO_NAME LIKE 'P%INS%CVC%< 5%' THEN '36555' WHEN CCH_CHEMO_NAME LIKE 'P%INS%CVC%> 5%' THEN '36556' WHEN CCH_CHEMO_NAME LIKE 'P%REPAIR%CVC%' THEN '36575' WHEN CCH_CHEMO_NAME LIKE 'P%REPL %CVC%' THEN '36580' WHEN CCH_CHEMO_NAME LIKE 'P%BROVIAC REM%' THEN '36589' WHEN CCH_CHEMO_NAME LIKE 'P%MEDIPORT REM%' THEN '36590' WHEN CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME LIKE 'P%ECHO%2DM%' OR CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME LIKE 'P%ECHO%COLOR%' THEN '93307' WHEN CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME LIKE 'P%ECHO%LIMITED%' THEN '93308' WHEN CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME LIKE 'P%ECHO%COMPLETE%' THEN '93306' WHEN CPE_ENC_DTE < '2020-01-01' AND CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME LIKE 'P%ECHO%CMPLT%3D%STRN%' THEN '93306763770399T' WHEN CPE_ENC_DTE >= '2020-01-01' AND CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME LIKE 'P%ECHO%CMPLT%3D%STRN%' THEN '933067637793356' WHEN CPE_ENC_DTE < '2020-01-01' AND CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME LIKE 'P%ECHO%CMPLT%STRN%' AND CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME NOT LIKE 'P%ECHO%CMPLT%3D%STRN%' THEN '933060399T' WHEN CPE_ENC_DTE >= '2020-01-01' AND CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME LIKE 'P%ECHO%CMPLT%STRN%' AND CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME NOT LIKE 'P%ECHO%CMPLT%3D%STRN%' THEN '9330693356' WHEN CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME LIKE 'P%ECHO%CMPLT%3D%' AND CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME NOT LIKE 'P%ECHO%CMPLT%3D%STRN%' THEN '9330676377' WHEN CCH_CHEMO_ID IN (297, 1269, 1270, 1667, 1668, 1669, 2115) OR (CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME LIKE 'TRANS%' AND CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR LIKE 'TR%') OR UPPER(CVT_EXT_NAME) LIKE '%TRANSFUSION%' OR CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME LIKE '%TRANSFUSION%' OR ((CCH_CHEMO_NAME LIKE '%TRANS %' OR CCH_CHEMO_NAME LIKE '%TRANSFUSION%' OR CCH_CHEMO_NAME LIKE '%PLATELETS%' OR CCH_CHEMO_NAME LIKE '% PLT %' OR CCH_CHEMO_NAME LIKE '%RBC%' OR CCH_CHEMO_NAME LIKE '%FFP%') AND CCH_CHEMO_NAME NOT LIKE '%CHEMO OR TRANS%') THEN '36430' END AS HCPCS123, CASE WHEN CCH_CHEMO_NAME LIKE 'P%4 BMA%2 BIOP%' THEN '505950' WHEN CCH_CHEMO_NAME LIKE 'P%2 BMA%2 BIOP%' THEN '50 ' WHEN CCH_CHEMO_NAME LIKE 'P%4 BMA%4 BIOP%' THEN '5059 ' WHEN CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR = '3DPH' THEN 'RS ' END AS BMA_BX_MOD12 FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CLD_DEPT_ID = CPE_DEPT_ID AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_9 = ' ' LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID = CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CRE_RES_ID = CPE_VST_RES_ID AND (CRE_RES_TYP IN ('Physician', 'Physician Assistant', 'Nurse Practitioner', 'Advanced Practice Nurse') OR CRE_RES_NAME = 'CARDIOLOGY 53 MD' OR CLD_DEPT_NAME LIKE '%WOC%') LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_PT_CHEMO ON CPC_CL_PT_ID = CPE_CL_PT_ID AND CPC_ENC_DTE_SEQ = CPE_ENC_DTE_SEQ LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_CHEMO ON CCH_CHEMO_ID = CPC_CHEMO_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.CTC_VISIT ON CV_MRN = CPE_MRN AND CV_CTC_VISIT_TYPE = 'I' AND CV_ADM_DTE < CPE_ENC_DTE AND VALUE(CV_DSCH_DTE, CURRENT DATE) > CPE_ENC_DTE LEFT JOIN IDB.OR_LOG ON OL_MRN = CPE_MRN AND OL_SURG_DTE = CPE_ENC_DTE AND OL_LOG_STS_CD NOT IN ('4', '6') AND OL_ROOM_RES_ID <> '1002060' AND OL_SURG_LOC_ID <> 1000090 AND OL_LOG_SVC NOT IN ('IR', 'ANES') LEFT JOIN IDCIC.HIMECC_AGED_D_PY ON CPE_MRN = AGED_MRN AND CPE_ENC_DTE = AGED_DOS LEFT JOIN IDCIC.HIMECC_HX_D_PY HX ON CPE_MRN = HX.MRN AND CPE_ENC_DTE = HX.DOS AND HX.RMS_SVCCD LIKE '%MOA%' AND HX.HCPCS <> '36430' LEFT JOIN IDCIC.HIMECC_MOA_D_PY OO ON CPE_MRN = OO.MRN AND CPE_ENC_DTE = OO.DOS AND OO.HCPCS <> '36430' WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Comp', 'Arrived') AND CPE_ENC_DTE >= '2018-02-17' AND CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR IN('TOTPH', '3DPH', 'TBI') AND CPE_MRN > ' ' AND CPE_ENC_TYP_CD = 50 AND CLD_CLD_CENTER <> 'HAU' AND CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID NOT IN ('12845', '3733')

prompt: Provide admitting and final diagnoses for patients admitted to and discharged from the Gastrointestinal Oncology Service and General Medicine Service since 2009.
completion: SELECT CASE WHEN CC_CLSF_TYPE = 'DA' THEN 'Admitting' ELSE 'Final' END AS TYPE, CASE WHEN CH_HOSP_SVC = 'GEN' THEN 'GEN' ELSE 'GI' END AS SVC, CC_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK, COUNT(DISTINCT CS_ACCT_NO) AS ADMISSIONS FROM IDB.CASE JOIN IDB.CENSUS ON CS_MRN = CH_MRN AND CS_ACCT_NO = CH_ACCT_NO AND CH_CNG_TYPE = 'A' JOIN IDB.CTC_CLSF ON CS_MRN = CC_MRN AND CS_ACCT_NO = CC_ACCT_NO JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE ((CH_HOSP_SVC = 'GEN' AND CS_HOSP_SVC = 'GEN') OR (CH_HOSP_SVC IN ('GIA', 'GIB') AND CS_HOSP_SVC IN ('GEN', 'GIA', 'GIB'))) AND CS_DSCH_DATE >= '2009-01-01' AND (CC_CLSF_TYPE = 'DA' OR (CC_CLSF_TYPE like 'DF%' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y' AND CC_PT_TYPE = 'I')) GROUP BY CASE WHEN CC_CLSF_TYPE = 'DA' THEN 'Admitting' ELSE 'Final' END, CASE WHEN CH_HOSP_SVC = 'GEN' THEN 'GEN' ELSE 'GI' END, CC_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK

prompt: Provide weekly report on cfDNA lab draws for protocol 16-1138 patients.
completion: SELECT DISTINCT OO_MRN MRN, PT_LAST_NAME LAST, PT_FIRST_NAME FIRST, OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE LAB_DATE, OO_ORD_STS_CD FROM IDB.OMS_ORDER JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_CATALOG ON OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID = OOC_MSTR_ITEM_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_STATUS ON OO_ORD_STS_CD = OSTS_ORD_STS_CD JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PT_MRN = OO_MRN WHERE OOC_ITEM_NAME IN ('cfDNA', 'MSK-ACCESS cfDNA (for pts with Solid Tumor)') AND OO_ORD_STS_CD NOT IN ('CANP', 'CANC', 'AUC3') AND OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT date - 7 DAYS AND CURRENT date AND OO_SUMMARY_LINE like '%16-1138%' ORDER BY OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE DESC

prompt: Provide a list of all patients from 2003-2019 with colorectal liver metastases who had pump placement surgery.
completion: WITH MAIN AS (SELECT CC_MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS MIN_ICD9_EFF_DTE, CC_CLSF_CD AS ICD9_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS ICD9_DESC FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE SUBSTR(CC_CLSF_CD, 1, 3) IN ('C18', '153', 'C19', '154', 'C20') AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' GROUP BY CC_MRN, CC_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK HAVING MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) BETWEEN '2003-01-01' AND '2019-12-31') , METS AS (SELECT CC_MRN METS_MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS METS_DTE, CC_CLSF_CD AS METS_ICD_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS METS_ICD_DESC FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE CC_CLSF_CD IN ('C78.7', '197.7') AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' GROUP BY CC_MRN, CC_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK HAVING MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) BETWEEN '2003-01-01' AND '2019-12-31') , SURG AS (SELECT SSE_MRN, SSE_SURG_DTE, SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD, SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC, SSP_SURG_LAST_NM, SSP_SURG_FIRST_NM, SSP_SURG_SVC_CD FROM IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE ON SSE_LOG_ID = SSP_LOG_ID AND SSE_ENC_CSN_ID = SSP_ENC_CSN_ID WHERE 1=1 AND SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD IN ('36260', '36261', '36530', '62362') AND SSE_SURG_DTE BETWEEN '2003-01-01' AND '2019-12-31' ) , CHEMO AS (SELECT APR_MRN, APR_START_DTE, CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME, APR_GENERIC_NAME, APR_PRESCRIBED_DOSE, APR_ROUTE FROM IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX JOIN IDB.CHEMO_DRUG_GENERIC ON APR_GENERIC_NAME = CDG_GENERIC_NAME JOIN SURG ON SSE_MRN = APR_MRN WHERE APR_START_DTE < SSE_SURG_DTE ) SELECT DISTINCT CC_MRN "MRN" , SSE_SURG_DTE "Pump Placement Surgery Date" , SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD "Surgery CPT Code" , CASE WHEN APR_MRN IS NOT NULL THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS "Chemo Pre Surgery" FROM MAIN JOIN METS ON CC_MRN = METS_MRN AND METS_DTE >= MIN_ICD9_EFF_DTE JOIN SURG ON CC_MRN = SSE_MRN LEFT JOIN CHEMO ON CC_MRN = APR_MRN

prompt: A list of F-cases with "TCRbeta1" mentioned in the report, from 01/01/2020 to present.
completion: SELECT DISTINCT "t1"."PT_MRN" AS "MRN", PT_LAST_NAME AS "Last Name", PT_FIRST_NAME AS "First Name", "t1"."PT_BIRTH_DTE" AS "Date of Birth", "t1"."PT_DEATH_DTE" AS "Deceased Date", "t1"."PT_VITAL_STATUS" AS "Vital Status", "t2"."DT_DTE" AS "Pathology Report Date", "t3"."PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_DESC" AS "Pathology Report Type", "t4"."DT_DTE" AS "Pathology Procedure Date", "t5"."PRPT_ACCESSION_NO" AS "Pathology Report" , VARCHAR(PRPT_REPORT, 32000) AS "Report Text (first 32,000 characters)" , XMLCAST(XMLQUERY('fn:substring-before(fn:substring-after($x,''DIAGNOSIS:''), ''I ATTEST'')' PASSING REPLACE(VARCHAR(PRPT_REPORT, 32000), CHR(26), '') AS "x") AS VARCHAR(32000)) AS "Diagnosis Section" , XMLCAST(XMLQUERY('fn:substring-before(fn:substring-after($x,''SPECIMENS SUBMITTED:''), ''DIAGNOSIS'')' PASSING REPLACE(UPPER(VARCHAR(PRPT_REPORT, 32000)), CHR(26), '') AS "x") AS VARCHAR(32000)) AS "Specimens Submitted Section" , DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)diag[\w\W]*(?=I ATTEST)', VARCHAR(PRPT_REPORT, 32000)) AS "Diagnosis & History" FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V" "t1" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED" "t6" ON "t1"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t6"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V" "t5" ON "t6"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t5"."PRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" "t2" ON "t5"."PRPT_REPORT_DATE_ID" = "t2"."DT_DATE_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATH_RPRT_TYPE_LOOKUP" "t3" ON "t5"."PRPT_REPORT_TYPE" = "t3"."PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_CD" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" "t4" ON "t5"."PRPT_PROCEDURE_DATE_ID" = "t4"."DT_DATE_ID" WHERE 1=1 AND PRPT_ACCESSION_NO like 'F%' AND (LOCATE('TCRCBETA1', UPPER(VARCHAR(PRPT_REPORT, 32000))) > 0 OR LOCATE('TCRC BETA1', UPPER(VARCHAR(PRPT_REPORT, 32000))) > 0 OR LOCATE('TRBC1', UPPER(VARCHAR(PRPT_REPORT, 32000))) > 0 ) AND "t5"."PRPT_REPORT" IS NOT NULL AND ("t2"."DT_DTE" >= '2020-01-01' OR "t4"."DT_DTE" >= '2020-01-01' )

prompt: Provide annual companion report s in HA4573 for 2016, 2017, 2018, and 2019 YTD
completion: SELECT YEAR(OO_ENTER_DTE) ENTER_YT, MONTH(OO_ENTER_DTE) ENTER_MONTH, OO_MRN MRN, STRIP(PT_LAST_NAME)||', '||STRIP(PT_FIRST_NAME) PT_NAME , OUO_ORD_ID ORD_ID , OO_ORD_NAME ORD_NAME, OO_ENTER_DT ENTER_DT, OO_REQUESTED_DT AS RELEASE_DT , OO_STOP_DT AS DISCONT_DT , A.OUD_USER_DI_VALUE AS FREQUENCY , OUO_PVDR_NAME REQUESTED_BY, OUO_ATN_PVDR_NAME ATN_DR_NAME , OUO_CURR_LOC LOCATION, OO_SUMMARY_LINE REASON , OUO_STS_DESC STATUS , RTRIM(OS_SVC_GRP_CD)||' - '|| RTRIM(OS_SVC_DESC) AS SERVICE FROM IDB.OMS_USER_ORDERS AS X JOIN IDB.OMS_ORDER ON OUO_ORD_GUID = OO_ORD_GUID AND OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID = '6000003646073029' JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON OO_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.OMS_CLIENT_VISIT ON OO_VISIT_GUID = OCV_VISIT_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_SERVICE ON OCV_SVC_GUID = OS_SVC_GUID LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_USER_DATA A ON OUO_ORD_GUID = A.OUD_ORD_GUID AND A.OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'Nsg_Companion_Frequency' WHERE OO_ENTER_DTE >= DATE('2016-01-01') AND OO_ENTER_DTE <= LAST_DAY(CURRENT DATE - 1 MONTHS) AND OUO_ORD_STS_CD NOT LIKE 'CAN%'

prompt: Provide a list of patients diagnosed with a bone tumor of the humerus or scapula since 1980.
completion: WITH X AS (SELECT DISTINCT TM_MRN AS MRN, PT_SEX, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, PT_DATE_OF_DEATH, COALESCE(MAX(PLA_LST_APPT_DTE, PLA_LST_DSCH_DTE), PLA_LST_APPT_DTE, PLA_LST_DSCH_DTE) AS LAST_FU_DATE, TM_DX_DTE, TM_SITE_CD AS SITE_CODE, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_DESC, TM_HIST_CD AS HIST_CODE, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS HIST_DESC, CASE WHEN TM_AJCC_7 NOT IN ('', '888', '999') THEN AJCC7.AV_DESC WHEN TM_AJCC NOT IN ('', '88', '99') THEN AJCC.AV_DESC WHEN TM_GENERAL_STG NOT IN ('', '9') THEN GS.AV_DESC WHEN TM_PATH_STG_GRP NOT IN ('', '88', '9', '99') THEN TM_PATH_STG_GRP ELSE CLIN.AV_DESC END AS STAGE, GR.AV_DESC AS GRADE, TM_TUMOR_SIZE FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON TM_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY ON PT_MRN = PLA_MRN JOIN IDB.SEERGROUPING ON RECODE = IDB.SEERF_ICDO(TM_SITE_CD, TM_HIST_CD) JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS AJCC7 ON AJCC7.AV_ELEMENT = 'AJCC_7' AND AJCC7.AV_CODE = TM_AJCC_7 LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS AJCC ON AJCC.AV_ELEMENT = 'AJCC' AND AJCC.AV_CODE = TM_AJCC LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS GS ON GS.AV_ELEMENT = 'GENERAL_STG' AND GS.AV_CODE = TM_GENERAL_STG LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS CLIN ON CLIN.AV_ELEMENT = 'CLIN_STG_DSCR' AND CLIN.AV_CODE = TM_CLIN_STG_DSCR LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS GR ON GR.AV_ELEMENT = 'HIST_CD_GRADE' AND GR.AV_CODE = TM_HIST_CD_GRADE WHERE CATEGORY1 = 'Bones and Joints' AND TM_SITE_CD IN ('C400') AND TM_CASE_STS IN ('3', '6', '7', '8') AND TM_DX_DTE >= '1980-01-01' ) SELECT DISTINCT APR_MRN, APR_DRUG_NAME, APR_START_DTE, APR_END_DTE, APR_ORD_RX_TYPE, APR_ORDER_SOURCE FROM IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX JOIN IDB.CHEMO_DRUG_GENERIC ON APR_GENERIC_NAME = CDG_GENERIC_NAME WHERE APR_MRN IN (SELECT MRN FROM X) AND CDG_CHEMO_FLAG = 'Y' SELECT DISTINCT RTC_TX_MRN, RTC_TX_PLAN_NAME, RTC_PRIMARY_REF_POINT, RTC_TX_START_DTE, RTC_TX_STOP_DTE, RTC_TX_ELAPSED_DAYS, RTC_TX_PLANNED_FRACTIONS, RTC_TX_DELIVERED_FRACTIONS, RTC_TX_PLANNED_DOSE, RTC_TX_DELIVERED_DOSE, RTC_DOSE_CORRECTION FROM IDB.RADONC_TREATMENT_COURSE WHERE RTC_TX_MRN IN (SELECT MRN FROM X) SELECT DISTINCT SSE_MRN, SSE_SURG_DTE, SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD, SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC, DATE(SAE_TOX_OCCR_DT) AS COMP_DATE, SAE_TOXICITY_NAME AS COMP_NAME, SAE_TOX_GRADE AS COMP_GRADE, SAE_TOX_GRADE_NAME AS COMP_CRITERIA FROM IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE ON SSE_LOG_ID = SSP_LOG_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.SRG_ADVERSE_EVENT ON SSE_LOG_ID = SAE_SURG_LOG_ID AND SAE_PROC_SEQ_NO = SSP_PROC_SEQ_NO AND SAE_TOX_GRADE > '0' WHERE SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD NOT LIKE '9999%' AND SSP_SOURCE_TYPE = 'O' AND SSE_MRN IN (SELECT MRN FROM X) SELECT CC_MRN, CLM_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND ((CC_PT_TYPE = 'I') OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) AND (CC_CLSF_CD BETWEEN '196' AND '198.99' OR CC_CLSF_CD BETWEEN 'C77' AND 'C79.99') AND CC_MRN IN (SELECT MRN FROM X) GROUP BY CC_MRN, CLM_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK

prompt: Provide a structured report for patient answers to biospecimen protocol consent questionnaires.
completion: WITH ARM AS (SELECT DISTINCT PROTOCOL_NO, STEP_CODE, ARM_DESCRIPTION FROM NN.SV_SUB_TREATMENT WHERE PROTOCOL_NO IN ('06-107', '12-245', '09-141') ) , RAW AS (SELECT CA_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, CA_IRB_NO, CA_REG_ID, STEP_CODE, ARM_DESCRIPTION, CA_CONSENT_DTE, ACD_OFF_STUDY_DTE, CA_QUESTION_ID, CQD_QUESTION_DESC, CA_ANSWER_DESC, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY CA_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, CA_IRB_NO, CA_REG_ID ORDER BY CA_REG_ENTRY_START_DT DESC) RNK FROM IDB.CONSENT_ANSWERS CA JOIN IDB.CONSENT_QUESTION_DEFINITION ON CA_IRB_NO = CQD_IRB_NO AND CA_REG_ID = CQD_REG_ID AND CA_QUESTION_ID = CQD_QUESTION_ID JOIN ARM ON CA_IRB_NO = PROTOCOL_NO AND CQD_REG_ID = STEP_CODE JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON CA_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.ACCRUALS_DATES ON CA.CA_MRN = ACD_MRN AND CA_IRB_NO = ACD_IRB_NO) SELECT CA_MRN "MRN", PT_LAST_NAME "Last Name", PT_FIRST_NAME "First Name", PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH "DOB", CA_IRB_NO "Protocol", CA_REG_ID "Registration ID", ARM_DESCRIPTION "Arm", CA_CONSENT_DTE "Consent Date", ACD_OFF_STUDY_DTE "Off Study Date", MAX(CASE WHEN CA_QUESTION_ID = 1 THEN CQD_QUESTION_DESC END) "Question 1", MAX(CASE WHEN CA_QUESTION_ID = 1 THEN CA_ANSWER_DESC END) "Question 1 Answer", MAX(CASE WHEN CA_QUESTION_ID = 2 THEN CQD_QUESTION_DESC END) "Question 2", MAX(CASE WHEN CA_QUESTION_ID = 2 THEN CA_ANSWER_DESC END) "Question 2 Answer", MAX(CASE WHEN CA_QUESTION_ID = 3 THEN CQD_QUESTION_DESC END) "Question 3", MAX(CASE WHEN CA_QUESTION_ID = 3 THEN CA_ANSWER_DESC END) "Question 3 Answer", MAX(CASE WHEN CA_QUESTION_ID = 4 THEN CQD_QUESTION_DESC END) "Question 4", MAX(CASE WHEN CA_QUESTION_ID = 4 THEN CA_ANSWER_DESC END) "Question 4 Answer", MAX(CASE WHEN CA_QUESTION_ID = 5 THEN CQD_QUESTION_DESC END) "Question 5", MAX(CASE WHEN CA_QUESTION_ID = 5 THEN CA_ANSWER_DESC END) "Question 5 Answer", MAX(CASE WHEN CA_QUESTION_ID = 6 THEN CQD_QUESTION_DESC END) "Question 6", MAX(CASE WHEN CA_QUESTION_ID = 6 THEN CA_ANSWER_DESC END) "Question 6 Answer", MAX(CASE WHEN CA_QUESTION_ID = 7 THEN CQD_QUESTION_DESC END) "Question 7", MAX(CASE WHEN CA_QUESTION_ID = 7 THEN CA_ANSWER_DESC END) "Question 7 Answer" FROM RAW GROUP BY CA_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, CA_IRB_NO, CA_REG_ID, STEP_CODE, ARM_DESCRIPTION, CA_CONSENT_DTE, ACD_OFF_STUDY_DTE

prompt: EGFR mutant lung cancer patients who also have confirmed gene fusions confirmed on IMPACT
completion: WITH DXLIST AS (SELECT TM_MRN, TM_DX_DTE, TM_HIST_CD, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS HIST_DESC, TM_SITE_CD, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_DESC FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND TM_SITE_CD LIKE 'C34%' ) , DX AS (SELECT TM_MRN DX_MRN, LISTAGG(COALESCE(CAST(TM_DX_DTE AS VARCHAR(20)), '') || ' | ' || COALESCE(TRIM(TM_HIST_CD), '') || ' - ' || COALESCE(TRIM(HIST_DESC), '') || ' | ' || COALESCE(TRIM(TM_SITE_CD), '') || ' - ' || COALESCE(TRIM(SITE_DESC), '') , CHR(13) || CHR(10)) WITHIN GROUP( ORDER BY TM_DX_DTE DESC) AS DX_INFO FROM DXLIST GROUP BY TM_MRN) , PRO06107 AS (SELECT DISTINCT AC_MRN PRO06107_MRN, AC_CONS_DTE PRO06107_CONS_DTE FROM IDB.ACCRUALS JOIN DXLIST ON AC_MRN = TM_MRN WHERE AC_IRB_NO = '06-107' ) , PRO12245 AS (SELECT DISTINCT AC_MRN PRO12245_MRN, AC_CONS_DTE PRO12245_CONS_DTE FROM IDB.ACCRUALS JOIN DXLIST ON AC_MRN = TM_MRN WHERE AC_IRB_NO = '12-245' ) SELECT A.PT_MRN "MRN", PT_LAST_NAME "Last Name", PT_FIRST_NAME "First Name", PT_BIRTH_DTE "Date of Birth", PRO06107_CONS_DTE "06-107 Consent", PRO12245_CONS_DTE "12-245 Consent", DX_INFO "Dx Date | Histology | Site", A.PATH_PROCEDURE_DATE "Report Procedure Date", A.PATH_RPT_DATE "Report Date", A.PRPT_ACCESSION_NO "Accession No", A.PRPT_REPORT "Report Text", A.GENE, A.LOCUS, A.AA_CHANGE, A.NUCLEOTIDE, A.METHOD, A.ABERRATIONTYPE, A.FOLD_CHANGE FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_STRUCTURED_RESULTS_V A JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS B ON A.PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = B.PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID JOIN DX ON A.PT_MRN = DX_MRN LEFT JOIN PRO06107 ON A.PT_MRN = PRO06107_MRN LEFT JOIN PRO12245 ON A.PT_MRN = PRO12245_MRN WHERE GENE = 'EGFR' AND PATH_RPT_DATE BETWEEN '2012-01-01' AND '2020-08-03' ORDER BY 1 DESC ; WITH DXLIST AS (SELECT TM_MRN, TM_DX_DTE, TM_HIST_CD, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS HIST_DESC, TM_SITE_CD, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_DESC FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND TM_SITE_CD LIKE 'C34%' ) , DX AS (SELECT TM_MRN DX_MRN, LISTAGG(COALESCE(CAST(TM_DX_DTE AS VARCHAR(20)), '') || ' | ' || COALESCE(TRIM(TM_HIST_CD), '') || ' - ' || COALESCE(TRIM(HIST_DESC), '') || ' | ' || COALESCE(TRIM(TM_SITE_CD), '') || ' - ' || COALESCE(TRIM(SITE_DESC), '') , CHR(13) || CHR(10)) WITHIN GROUP( ORDER BY TM_DX_DTE DESC) AS DX_INFO FROM DXLIST GROUP BY TM_MRN) , PRO06107 AS (SELECT DISTINCT AC_MRN PRO06107_MRN, AC_CONS_DTE PRO06107_CONS_DTE FROM IDB.ACCRUALS JOIN DXLIST ON AC_MRN = TM_MRN WHERE AC_IRB_NO = '06-107' ) , PRO12245 AS (SELECT DISTINCT AC_MRN PRO12245_MRN, AC_CONS_DTE PRO12245_CONS_DTE FROM IDB.ACCRUALS JOIN DXLIST ON AC_MRN = TM_MRN WHERE AC_IRB_NO = '12-245' ) , GENE AS (SELECT DISTINCT PRPT_ACCESSION_NO FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_STRUCTURED_RESULTS_V JOIN DX ON PT_MRN = DX_MRN WHERE GENE = 'EGFR' AND CONTAINS("PRPT_REPORT", '("fusion" | "rearrangement" | "translocation" | "inversion" | "intragenic deletion")') = 1 AND PATH_RPT_DATE BETWEEN '2012-01-01' AND '2020-08-03' ) SELECT A.PT_MRN "MRN", PT_LAST_NAME "Last Name", PT_FIRST_NAME "First Name", PT_BIRTH_DTE "Date of Birth", PRO06107_CONS_DTE "06-107 Consent", PRO12245_CONS_DTE "12-245 Consent", DX_INFO "Dx Date | Histology | Site", A.PATH_PROCEDURE_DATE "Report Procedure Date", A.PATH_RPT_DATE "Report Date", A.PRPT_ACCESSION_NO "Accession No", PDRX_DMP_SAMPLE_ID "DMP Sample ID", A.PRPT_REPORT "Report Text", A.GENE, A.LOCUS, A.AA_CHANGE, A.NUCLEOTIDE, A.SEARCH_HIT2, A.METHOD, A.ABERRATIONTYPE, A.FOLD_CHANGE FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_STRUCTURED_RESULTS_V A JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML ON PRPT_PATH_RPT_ID = PDRX_PATH_RPT_ID JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS B ON A.PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = B.PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID JOIN DX ON A.PT_MRN = DX_MRN JOIN GENE C ON A.PRPT_ACCESSION_NO = C.PRPT_ACCESSION_NO LEFT JOIN PRO06107 ON A.PT_MRN = PRO06107_MRN LEFT JOIN PRO12245 ON A.PT_MRN = PRO12245_MRN ORDER BY 1 DESC

prompt: Provide a daily report of direct admits or observed patients with fever in the BMT service
completion: WITH PTS AS (SELECT OO_MRN MRN , OO_ORD_GUID ORD_GUID , OO_VISIT_GUID VISIT_GUID , OCV_VISIT_DTE VISIT_DTE , PT_FIRST_NAME , PT_LAST_NAME , OO_ENTER_DTE ORD_ENTER_DTE , OOC_ITEM_NAME ORD_NAME , OCV_PVDR_NAME PRIMARY_ATTENDING , OS_SVC_DESC SVC , MIN(CASE WHEN DX.OUD_USER_DI_CD IN ('UCC Primary Dx', 'UCC Primary Diagnoses2') THEN DX.OUD_USER_DI_VALUE END) AS PRIMARY_DX , MIN(CASE WHEN DX.OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'UCC Primary Dx#2' THEN DX.OUD_USER_DI_VALUE END) AS PRIMARY_DX2 , CASE WHEN (UPPER(DX.OUD_USER_DI_VALUE) LIKE '%FEVER%' OR UPPER(DX.OUD_USER_DI_VALUE) LIKE '%NEUT%') THEN 'Y' END AS FEVER_NEUT_YN FROM IDB.OMS_ORDER JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_CATALOG ON OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID = OOC_MSTR_ITEM_GUID AND OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID IN ('1000004272073029', '9000013014100730') JOIN IDB.OMS_CLIENT_VISIT ON OO_VISIT_GUID = OCV_VISIT_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_SERVICE ON OCV_SVC_GUID = OS_SVC_GUID AND OS_SVC_GRP_CD IN ('TRB', 'TRW', 'TRG', 'TRK') JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON OO_MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_USER_DATA DX ON OO_ORD_GUID = DX.OUD_ORD_GUID AND DX.OUD_USER_DI_CD IN ('UCC Primary Dx#2', 'UCC Primary Dx', 'UCC Primary Diagnoses2') WHERE YEAR(OO_ENTER_DTE) = 2021 AND OO_ORD_STS_CD NOT IN ('CANP', 'CANC', 'AUC3') GROUP BY OO_MRN , OO_ORD_GUID , OO_VISIT_GUID , OCV_VISIT_DTE , PT_FIRST_NAME , PT_LAST_NAME , OO_ENTER_DTE , OOC_ITEM_NAME , OCV_PVDR_NAME , OS_SVC_DESC , CASE WHEN (UPPER(DX.OUD_USER_DI_VALUE) LIKE '%FEVER%' OR UPPER(DX.OUD_USER_DI_VALUE) LIKE '%NEUT%') THEN 'Y' END ) , OBS AS (SELECT OO_MRN OBS_MRN , OO_VISIT_GUID OBS_VISIT_GUID , OO_ORD_GUID OBS_ORD_GUID , OO_SIGNIFICANT_DT AS OBS_PLACE_DT , OUD_USER_DI_VALUE AS OBS_ORD_NAME FROM PTS JOIN IDB.OMS_ORDER ON MRN = OO_MRN AND ORD_GUID = OO_ORD_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_USER_DATA ON OO_ORD_GUID = OUD_ORD_GUID AND OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'UCC Disposition' AND OUD_USER_DI_VALUE = 'Place in Observation') , DISP AS (SELECT OO_MRN DISP_MRN , OO_VISIT_GUID DISP_VISIT_GUID , OO_ORD_GUID DISP_ORD_GUID , OUD_USER_DI_VALUE OBS_DISPO , OO_SIGNIFICANT_DT AS OBS_DISPO_DT FROM PTS JOIN IDB.OMS_ORDER ON MRN = OO_MRN AND ORD_GUID = OO_ORD_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_USER_DATA ON OO_ORD_GUID = OUD_ORD_GUID AND OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'UCC Disposition' AND OUD_USER_DI_VALUE <> 'Place in Observation' JOIN OBS ON OO_VISIT_GUID = OBS_VISIT_GUID WHERE OO_SIGNIFICANT_DT > OBS_PLACE_DT ) SELECT MRN , VISIT_GUID , VISIT_DTE , PT_FIRST_NAME , PT_LAST_NAME , MIN(ORD_ENTER_DTE) FIRST_ORD_ENTER_DTE , ORD_NAME , PRIMARY_ATTENDING , MIN(PRIMARY_DX) PRIMARY_DX , MIN(PRIMARY_DX2) PRIMARY_DX2 , MIN(FEVER_NEUT_YN) FEVER_NEUT_YN , SVC , OBS_ORD_NAME , OBS_PLACE_DT , OBS_DISPO , OBS_DISPO_DT , HOUR(OBS_DISPO_DT - OBS_PLACE_DT) HOURS_IN_OBS FROM PTS JOIN OBS ON MRN = OBS_MRN AND VISIT_GUID = OBS_VISIT_GUID LEFT JOIN DISP ON OBS_MRN = DISP_MRN AND OBS_VISIT_GUID = DISP_VISIT_GUID GROUP BY MRN , VISIT_GUID , VISIT_DTE , PT_FIRST_NAME , PT_LAST_NAME , ORD_NAME , PRIMARY_ATTENDING , SVC , OBS_ORD_NAME , OBS_PLACE_DT , OBS_DISPO , OBS_DISPO_DT , HOUR(OBS_DISPO_DT - OBS_PLACE_DT) ; SELECT OO_MRN MRN , OO_ORD_GUID ORD_GUID , OO_VISIT_GUID VISIT_GUID , OCV_VISIT_DTE VISIT_DTE , PT_FIRST_NAME , PT_LAST_NAME , OO_ENTER_DTE ORD_ENTER_DTE , OOC_ITEM_NAME ORD_NAME , OCV_PVDR_NAME PRIMARY_ATTENDING , OS_SVC_DESC SVC , MIN(CASE WHEN OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'UCC Primary Dx' THEN OUD_USER_DI_VALUE END) AS PRIMARY_DX , MIN(CASE WHEN OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'BMT_Teams' THEN OUD_USER_DI_VALUE END) AS BMT_TEAM , MIN(CASE WHEN OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'BMT_Reason_for_Admission' THEN OUD_USER_DI_VALUE END) AS RSN_FOR_ADMIT , MIN(CASE WHEN (OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'UCC Primary Dx' AND UPPER(OUD_USER_DI_VALUE) LIKE '%FEVER%') OR (OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'UCC Primary Dx' AND UPPER(OUD_USER_DI_VALUE) LIKE '%NEUT%') THEN 'Y' END) AS FEVER_NEUT_DX_YN , MIN(CASE WHEN (OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'BMT_Reason_for_Admission' AND UPPER(OUD_USER_DI_VALUE) LIKE '%FEVER%') OR (OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'BMT_Reason_for_Admission' AND UPPER(OUD_USER_DI_VALUE) LIKE '%NEUT%') THEN 'Y' END) AS FEVER_NEUT_RSN_YN FROM IDB.OMS_ORDER JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_CATALOG ON OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID = OOC_MSTR_ITEM_GUID AND OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID = '9000006305100730' JOIN IDB.OMS_CLIENT_VISIT ON OO_VISIT_GUID = OCV_VISIT_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_SERVICE ON OCV_SVC_GUID = OS_SVC_GUID JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON OO_MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_USER_DATA ON OO_ORD_GUID = OUD_ORD_GUID AND OUD_USER_DI_CD IN ('BMT_Reason_for_Admission', 'UCC Primary Dx', 'BMT_Teams') WHERE YEAR(OO_ENTER_DTE) = 2021 AND OO_ORD_STS_CD NOT IN ('CANP', 'CANC', 'AUC3') GROUP BY OO_MRN , OO_ORD_GUID , OO_VISIT_GUID , OCV_VISIT_DTE , PT_FIRST_NAME , PT_LAST_NAME , OO_ENTER_DTE , OOC_ITEM_NAME , OCV_PVDR_NAME , OS_SVC_DESC ; WITH PTS AS (SELECT OO_MRN MRN , OO_ORD_GUID ORD_GUID , OO_VISIT_GUID VISIT_GUID , OCV_ADM_NUM , OCV_VISIT_DTE VISIT_DTE , PT_FIRST_NAME , PT_LAST_NAME , OO_ENTER_DTE ORD_ENTER_DTE , OOC_ITEM_NAME ORD_NAME , OCV_PVDR_NAME PRIMARY_ATTENDING , OS_SVC_DESC SVC , MIN(CASE WHEN DX.OUD_USER_DI_CD IN ('UCC Primary Dx', 'UCC Primary Diagnoses2') THEN DX.OUD_USER_DI_VALUE END) AS PRIMARY_DX , MIN(CASE WHEN DX.OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'UCC Primary Dx#2' THEN DX.OUD_USER_DI_VALUE END) AS PRIMARY_DX2 , CASE WHEN (UPPER(DX.OUD_USER_DI_VALUE) LIKE '%FEVER%' OR UPPER(DX.OUD_USER_DI_VALUE) LIKE '%NEUT%') THEN 'Y' END AS FEVER_NEUT_YN FROM IDB.OMS_ORDER JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_CATALOG ON OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID = OOC_MSTR_ITEM_GUID AND OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID IN ('1000004272073029', '9000013014100730') JOIN IDB.OMS_CLIENT_VISIT ON OO_VISIT_GUID = OCV_VISIT_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_SERVICE ON OCV_SVC_GUID = OS_SVC_GUID AND OS_SVC_GRP_CD IN ('TRB', 'TRW', 'TRG', 'TRK') JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON OO_MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_USER_DATA DX ON OO_ORD_GUID = DX.OUD_ORD_GUID AND DX.OUD_USER_DI_CD IN ('UCC Primary Dx#2', 'UCC Primary Dx', 'UCC Primary Diagnoses2') WHERE YEAR(OO_ENTER_DTE) = 2021 AND OO_ORD_STS_CD NOT IN ('CANP', 'CANC', 'AUC3') AND (CASE WHEN (UPPER(DX.OUD_USER_DI_VALUE) LIKE '%FEVER%' OR UPPER(DX.OUD_USER_DI_VALUE) LIKE '%NEUT%') THEN 'Y' END) = 'Y' GROUP BY OO_MRN , OO_ORD_GUID , OO_VISIT_GUID , OCV_ADM_NUM , OCV_VISIT_DTE , PT_FIRST_NAME , PT_LAST_NAME , OO_ENTER_DTE , OOC_ITEM_NAME , OCV_PVDR_NAME , OS_SVC_DESC , CASE WHEN (UPPER(DX.OUD_USER_DI_VALUE) LIKE '%FEVER%' OR UPPER(DX.OUD_USER_DI_VALUE) LIKE '%NEUT%') THEN 'Y' END ) , OBS AS (SELECT OO_MRN OBS_MRN , OO_VISIT_GUID OBS_VISIT_GUID , OO_ORD_GUID OBS_ORD_GUID , OO_SIGNIFICANT_DT AS OBS_PLACE_DT , OUD_USER_DI_VALUE AS OBS_ORD_NAME FROM PTS JOIN IDB.OMS_ORDER ON MRN = OO_MRN AND ORD_GUID = OO_ORD_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_USER_DATA ON OO_ORD_GUID = OUD_ORD_GUID AND OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'UCC Disposition' AND OUD_USER_DI_VALUE = 'Admit to IP') SELECT A.MRN , VISIT_GUID , VISIT_DTE , PT_FIRST_NAME , PT_LAST_NAME , MIN(ORD_ENTER_DTE) FIRST_ORD_ENTER_DTE , ORD_NAME , PRIMARY_ATTENDING , MIN(PRIMARY_DX) PRIMARY_DX , MIN(PRIMARY_DX2) PRIMARY_DX2 , MIN(FEVER_NEUT_YN) FEVER_NEUT_YN , SVC , ADMIT_DT FROM PTS A JOIN OBS ON A.MRN = OBS_MRN AND VISIT_GUID = OBS_VISIT_GUID LEFT JOIN IDB.INPATIENT_ADMISSIONS_V B ON OCV_ADM_NUM = ADMIT_ID GROUP BY A.MRN , VISIT_GUID , VISIT_DTE , PT_FIRST_NAME , PT_LAST_NAME , ORD_NAME , PRIMARY_ATTENDING , SVC , ADMIT_DT

prompt: Provide an on demand report of all patients with cfdna Plasma Prep with Dr. Pedram Razavi indicated as the PI.
completion: WITH ORD_R AS (SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN MRN, PT_LAST_NAME LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME FIRST_NAME, OO_ORD_GUID, OO_ANCIL_REF_CD, OO_ORD_NAME ORDER_NAME, OSTS_STS_DESC ORDER_STATUS FROM IDB.OMS_ORDER JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON OO_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.OMS_STATUS ON OO_ORD_STS_CD = OSTS_ORD_STS_CD LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_USER_DATA ON OO_MRN = OUD_MRN AND OO_ORD_GUID = OUD_ORD_GUID WHERE ((OO_ORD_NAME IN ('cfDNA', 'cfDNA Plasma Prep', 'MSK-ACCESS cfDNA (for pts with Solid Tumor)') AND (OUD_USER_DI_CD IN ('LBRZ_CFPI', 'PPATH_Access_Investigator/Service') AND LOWER(OUD_USER_DI_VALUE) like '%razavi%')) OR OO_ORD_NAME = 'Guardant Send Out') ) , ORD AS (SELECT MRN, LAST_NAME, FIRST_NAME, OO_ORD_GUID, OO_ANCIL_REF_CD, ORDER_NAME, ORDER_STATUS, OUD_USER_DI_VALUE ORDER_REQUESTED_FOR_DATE FROM ORD_R LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_USER_DATA ON MRN = OUD_MRN AND OO_ORD_GUID = OUD_ORD_GUID AND OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'Requested For') , X AS (SELECT MRN, LAST_NAME, FIRST_NAME, ORDER_REQUESTED_FOR_DATE, ORDER_NAME, OO_ANCIL_REF_CD ANCILLARY_ID, ORDER_STATUS FROM ORD UNION SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN MRN, PT_LAST_NAME LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME FIRST_NAME, OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE ORDER_REQUESTED_FOR_DATE, OO_ORD_NAME ORDER_NAME, OO_ANCIL_REF_CD ANCILLARY_ID, OSTS_STS_DESC ORDER_STATUS FROM IDB.OMS_ORDER JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON OO_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.OMS_STATUS ON OO_ORD_STS_CD = OSTS_ORD_STS_CD WHERE OO_SET_HEADING = 'ctDNA - GRAIL' ) SELECT * FROM X ORDER BY ORDER_REQUESTED_FOR_DATE, ORDER_STATUS

prompt: All prostate cancer patients that have received SBRT since June 2018
completion: WITH TUMOR AS (SELECT TM_MRN FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND TM_SITE_CD LIKE 'C61%' ) , CLINTRAC AS (SELECT CC_MRN FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE SUBSTR(CC_CLSF_CD, 1, 3) IN ('185', 'C61') AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND (CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) ) , RTC AS (SELECT MRN , SVC_DTE , SVC_DESC FROM IDB.RADIATION_CHARGES_V WHERE SVC_DTE >= '2018-06-01' ) , RT AS (SELECT RTC_TX_MRN, RTC_TX_START_DTE, RTC_TX_STOP_DTE, SVC_DESC FROM IDB.RADONC_TREATMENT_COURSE JOIN RTC ON RTC_TX_MRN = MRN AND RTC_TX_START_DTE = SVC_DTE WHERE UPPER(RTC_TX_PLAN_NAME) LIKE 'PROS%' OR UPPER(RTC_TX_PLAN_NAME) LIKE 'PRST%' ) SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN AS MRN , PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH AS DOB , RTC_TX_START_DTE AS START_DTE , RTC_TX_STOP_DTE AS END_DTE FROM IDB.PATIENT JOIN RT ON PT_MRN = RTC_TX_MRN LEFT JOIN TUMOR ON PT_MRN = TM_MRN LEFT JOIN CLINTRAC ON PT_MRN = CC_MRN WHERE COALESCE(TM_MRN, CC_MRN) IS NOT NULL GROUP BY PT_MRN , PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH , RTC_TX_START_DTE , RTC_TX_STOP_DTE HAVING MIN(CASE WHEN SVC_DESC LIKE 'SBRT%' THEN 'Y' END) = 'Y' AND MIN(CASE WHEN SVC_DESC LIKE 'IMRT%' THEN 'Y' END) IS NULL

prompt: Provide a weekly list of appointments for patients with IBD diagnosis
completion: WITH ICD AS (SELECT CC_MRN MRN, PT_LAST_NAME LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME FIRST_NAME, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH DOB, CCS_ICD_CODE ICD_CODE, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK ICD_DESC, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS FIRST_EFF_DTE FROM IDB.CCS_HIER LEFT JOIN IDB.CLM ON CCS_ICD_CODE = CLM_CLSF_CD AND CLM_CD_TYPE = 'D' INNER JOIN IDB.CTC_CLSF ON CLM_CLSF_CD = CC_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON CC_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE 1=1 AND CCS_ICD_CODE IN ('555', '555.1', '555.2', '555.9', '556', '556', '556.1', '556.2', '556.3', '556.4', '556.5', '556.6', '556.8', '556.9', 'K50.00', 'K50.012', 'K50.013', 'K50.018', 'K50.10', 'K50.111', 'K50.112', 'K50.113', 'K50.118', 'K50.80', 'K50.811', 'K50.812', 'K50.813', 'K50.814', 'K50.818', 'K50.819', 'K50.90', 'K50.911', 'K50.912', 'K50.913', 'K50.918', 'K50.919', 'K51.00', 'K51.011', 'K51.013', 'K51.018', 'K51.20', 'K51.211', 'K51.212', 'K51.214', 'K51.218', 'K51.30', 'K51.311', 'K51.314', 'K51.318', 'K51.50', 'K51.511', 'K51.514', 'K51.518', 'K51.80', 'K51.811', 'K51.812', 'K51.813', 'K51.814', 'K51.818', 'K51.90', 'K51.911', 'K51.912', 'K51.913', 'K51.914', 'K51.918', 'K51.919') AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND (CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) GROUP BY CC_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, CCS_ICD_CODE, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK) , APPTS AS (SELECT CPE_MRN, YEAR(CPE_ENC_DTE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) AGE_AT_APPT, ICD_CODE, ICD_DESC, FIRST_EFF_DTE, CPE_ENC_DTE APPT_DATE, TIME(CPE_APPT_DT) APPT_TIME, CRE_RES_NAME APPT_MD, CLD_CLD_CENTER APPT_LOCATION, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CPE_MRN ORDER BY CPE_APPT_DT) RN FROM ICD JOIN IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER ON MRN = CPE_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON MRN = PT_MRN WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Sch') AND CRE_RES_TYP = 'Physician' AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT date AND CURRENT date + 14 DAYS ) , CANCER_DX AS (SELECT SEER_MRN, SEER_CAT, LISTAGG(SEER_SUBCAT, '; ') SEER_SUBCAT FROM (SELECT DISTINCT TM_MRN SEER_MRN, CATEGORY1 SEER_CAT, CATEGORY2 SEER_SUBCAT, CATEGORY3, CATEGORY4 FROM ICD JOIN IDB.CDB_TUMOR ON MRN = TM_MRN JOIN IDB.SEERGROUPING ON IDB.SEERF_ICDO(TM_SITE_CD, TM_HIST_CD) = RECODE WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7') AND CATEGORY1 = 'Digestive System' ) GROUP BY SEER_MRN, SEER_CAT) SELECT I.*, APPT_DATE, APPT_TIME, AGE_AT_APPT, APPT_MD, APPT_LOCATION, SEER_CAT, SEER_SUBCAT FROM ICD I JOIN APPTS ON I.MRN = CPE_MRN AND RN = 1 JOIN CANCER_DX ON I.MRN = SEER_MRN

prompt: Provide a count of how many patients had a stent placement subsequently admitted for fever, urinary tract infection, or pyelonephritis and whether they had a subsequent stent exchange.
completion: WITH SRG AS (SELECT DISTINCT SSE_MRN, SSE_LOG_ID, SSE_SURG_DTE, SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD, SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC FROM IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE ON SSE_LOG_ID = SSP_LOG_ID WHERE 1=1 AND SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD = '52332' ) , IP AS (SELECT VIS_MRN, VIS_ADM_NUM, SSE_LOG_ID, SSE_SURG_DTE, VIS_ADM_DTE, VIS_DSCH_DTE FROM IDB.VISIT_V V JOIN SRG ON VIS_MRN = SSE_MRN AND VIS_ADM_DTE > SSE_SURG_DTE WHERE VIS_IP_OP_ADJUSTED_IND = 'I' AND VIS_VISIT_STATUS IN ('2', '3') ) , X AS (SELECT CC_MRN AS MRN, SSE_LOG_ID AS LOG_ID1, SSE_SURG_DTE AS SRG1, VIS_ADM_NUM, VIS_ADM_DTE, YEAR(VIS_ADM_DTE) AS ADM_YEAR, CC_EFF_DTE AS DX_DATE, CLM_CLSF_CD AS DX_CODE, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS DX_DESC FROM IP JOIN IDB.CTC_CLSF ON CC_MRN = VIS_MRN AND CC_ADM_NUM = VIS_ADM_NUM JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DA%' AND CC_EFF_DTE > SSE_SURG_DTE AND ((CC_PT_TYPE = 'I') OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) AND CC_CLSF_CD IN ('590', '590.0', '590.00', '590.01', '590.1', '590.10', '590.11', '590.2', '590.3', '590.8', '590.80', '590.81', '590.9', 'N10', 'N10.', '599.0', 'N39.0', '780.60', 'R50', 'R50.9') ) , Y AS (SELECT DISTINCT SSE_MRN AS MRN, LOG_ID1, SSE_LOG_ID, SSE_SURG_DTE, SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD, SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC, VIS_ADM_NUM, VIS_ADM_DTE, ADM_YEAR FROM X JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT ON SSE_MRN = MRN AND SSE_SURG_DTE >= VIS_ADM_DTE JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE ON SSE_LOG_ID = SSP_LOG_ID WHERE 1=1 AND SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD = '52310' ) SELECT ADM_YEAR, COUNT(DISTINCT LOG_ID1) AS SUBSEQUENT_SRG_COUNT, COUNT(DISTINCT VIS_ADM_NUM) AS VISITS_W_SUBSEQ_SRG_COUNT, COUNT(DISTINCT SSE_LOG_ID) AS TOTAL_SRG_COUNT, COUNT(DISTINCT MRN) AS UNIQUE_PT_COUNT FROM Y GROUP BY ADM_YEAR

prompt: Provide MRN, date of procedure, surgical service, and surgeon, for all patients with CPT code 27057, 27600, and/or ICD code 729.7 in the last 5 years.
completion: SELECT MRN, DXDTE, DXCD, DXDESC, SRGDTE, CPTCD, CPTDESC, MDLASTNAME, MDFIRSTNAME, CC_CLSF_CD OTHERDXCD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK OTHERDXDESC, PT_SEX SEX, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH DOB, PT_WT_KG WT, PT_HT_CM HT FROM (SELECT DISTINCT CC_MRN AS MRN, CC_EFF_DTE DXDTE, CLM_CLSF_CD DXCD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK DXDESC, SSE_SURG_DTE SRGDTE, SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD CPTCD, SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC CPTDESC, SSP_SURG_LAST_NM MDLASTNAME, SSP_SURG_FIRST_NM MDFIRSTNAME FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD LEFT JOIN (SELECT SSE_MRN, SSE_SURG_DTE, SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD, SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC , SSP_SURG_LAST_NM, SSP_SURG_FIRST_NM FROM IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE ON SSP_LOG_ID = SSE_LOG_ID WHERE SSE_SURG_DTE BETWEEN '2008-01-01' AND '2012-12-31' AND (SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC LIKE '%FASCIOTOMY%' OR SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD = '27057') )AS X ON SSE_MRN = CC_MRN WHERE CC_EFF_DTE BETWEEN '2008-01-01' AND '2012-12-31' AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND CC_CLSF_CD like '729.7%' AND (CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) UNION SELECT DISTINCT SSE_MRN AS MRN, CC_EFF_DTE DXDTE, CLM_CLSF_CD DXCD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK DXDESC, SSE_SURG_DTE SRGDTE, SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD CPTCD, SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC CPTDESC, SSP_SURG_LAST_NM MDLASTNAME, SSP_SURG_FIRST_NM MDFIRSTNAME FROM IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE ON SSP_LOG_ID = SSE_LOG_ID AND SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC LIKE '%FASCIOTOMY%' OR SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD = '27057' LEFT JOIN IDB.CTC_CLSF ON SSE_MRN = CC_MRN AND CC_EFF_DTE BETWEEN '2008-01-01' AND '2012-12-31' AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND CC_CLSF_CD like '729.7%' AND (CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) LEFT JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE SSE_SURG_DTE BETWEEN '2008-01-01' AND '2012-12-31' ) AS Y JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.CTC_CLSF ON Y.MRN = CC_MRN AND CC_EFF_DTE = Y.DXDTE AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND CC_CLSF_CD not like '729.7%' AND (CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) LEFT JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD

prompt: DataTerrain Report
completion: WITH LKUP_TYPE AS (SELECT 'displayName' AS TYPE, 'zzPDL_TDI_DataLine_Consultants' SEARCH_VAL FROM SYSIBM.SYSDUMMY1) , USRS AS (SELECT 1 COHORT_ID , DV.LDAPQUERY(SEARCH_VAL, TYPE, 'member') MEM , DV.LDAPQUERY(SEARCH_VAL, TYPE, 'displayName') DISPLAYNAME , DV.LDAPQUERY(SEARCH_VAL, TYPE, 'managedBy') OWNER FROM LKUP_TYPE) , MEM AS (SELECT DISPLAYNAME, OWNER, COLUMN_VALUES MEM FROM USRS CROSS JOIN TABLE(DVCMS.DRF_SPLIT(MEM, '|')) T) , DL_EMP_PRE AS (SELECT LOWER(SUBSTR(MEM, 4, LOCATE(',', MEM) - 4)) USERNAME, DISPLAYNAME FROM MEM WHERE UPPER(MEM) not like 'CN=ZZPDL%' ) , DL_EMP AS (SELECT DISTINCT USERNAME, DISPLAYNAME FROM DL_EMP_PRE WHERE CASE WHEN USERNAME IN ('chattea2', 'poonc') THEN 0 WHEN USERNAME IN ('chuc') AND DISPLAYNAME IN ('zzPDL_TDI_DataLine_Consultants') THEN 0 ELSE 1 END = 1 ) , DT AS (SELECT USERNAME, MEI_FIRST_NAME FIRST_NAME FROM IDB.MSKCC_EMPLOYEE_INFO JOIN DL_EMP ON LOWER(MEI_USER_ID) = USERNAME) SELECT "Project Code", "Developer Primary", FIRST_NAME "First Name", "Project Request Date", "Project Delivery Date", "Project Completion Status" FROM DSG.PROJECTS JOIN DT ON UPPER("Developer Primary") = UPPER(USERNAME) WHERE COALESCE("Project Completion Status", '') NOT IN ('On hold', 'Cancelled') ORDER BY "Project Request Date" DESC

prompt: Aggregated patient demographics for the patients of  BECH for 2017 and 2018.
completion: WITH CTE AS (SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN, R.AV_DESC AS "Race" , E.AV_DESC AS "Ethnicity" FROM IDB.PATIENT JOIN IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER ON PT_MRN = CPE_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS R ON R.AV_ELEMENT = 'RACE' AND R.AV_CODE = PT_RACE LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS E ON E.AV_ELEMENT = 'PT_ETHNICITY' AND E.AV_CODE = PT_PT_ETHNICITY WHERE CLD_CLD_CENTER = 'BECH' AND CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN '2017-01-01' AND '2018-12-31' ) SELECT "Race", "Ethnicity", COUNT(*) FROM CTE GROUP BY "Race", "Ethnicity" UNION ALL SELECT 'TOTAL' AS "Race", 'TOTAL' AS "Ethnicity", COUNT(*) FROM CTE

prompt: A SQL code to pull isolation data for each inpatient day where a patient has an infection control precaution indicator. Each isolation indicator in place for that day will be put in a separate column.
completion: WITH OHI AS (SELECT OHI_MRN , VIS_VISIT_ID AS VISIT_ID , VIS_NURS_STA AS NURS_STA , VIS_ADM_DTE , VIS_DSCH_DTE , OHI_STS_CD , DATE(OHI_CREATE_DT) OHI_CREATE_DTE , CASE WHEN OHI_RESOLVED_DTE IS NULL THEN CURRENT DATE - 1 DAY ELSE OHI_RESOLVED_DTE END AS OHI_RESOLVED_DTE , OHI_CODE , MIN(DATE(OHI_CREATE_DT)) OVER(PARTITION BY VIS_VISIT_ID) AS VIS_MIN_CREATE_DTE , MAX(OHI_RESOLVED_DTE) OVER(PARTITION BY VIS_VISIT_ID) AS VIS_MAX_RESOLVE_DTE , ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY VIS_VISIT_ID ORDER BY OHI_CREATE_DT) AS RN FROM IDB.OMS_HEALTH_ISSUE JOIN IDB.OMS_CLIENT_VISIT ON OHI_VISIT_GUID = OCV_VISIT_GUID AND OHI_MRN = OCV_MRN JOIN IDB.VISIT_V ON OCV_ADM_NUM = VIS_ADM_NUM AND VIS_IP_OP_ADJUSTED_IND = 'I' WHERE OHI_TYPE_CD='Inf Control' AND OHI_STS_CD NOT IN ('Entered in Error', 'Cancelled/Entered in Error') AND DATE(OHI_CREATE_DT) >= '2015-01-01' ) SELECT DISTINCT P.VISIT_ID || CHAR(DAYS(DT_DTE)) PT_DAY_ID , DATE(DAYS(DT_DTE) - (DAYOFWEEK(DT_DTE)-1)) WEEK_OF , DATE(TRIM(CHAR(YEAR(DT_DTE))) || '-' || TRIM(CHAR(MONTH(DT_DTE))) || '-' || '1') MONTH_OF , DT_DTE AS DATE , P.OHI_MRN AS MRN , P.VISIT_ID , P.NURS_STA , P.VIS_ADM_DTE AS ADM_DTE , P.VIS_DSCH_DTE AS DSCH_DTE , P1.OHI_CODE AS PRECAUTION1 , P2.OHI_CODE AS PRECAUTION2 , P3.OHI_CODE AS PRECAUTION3 , P4.OHI_CODE AS PRECAUTION4 , P5.OHI_CODE AS PRECAUTION5 , P6.OHI_CODE AS PRECAUTION6 , P7.OHI_CODE AS PRECAUTION7 , P8.OHI_CODE AS PRECAUTION8 FROM (SELECT DISTINCT VIS_ADM_DTE AS DT_DTE FROM IDB.VISIT_V) JOIN OHI P ON DT_DTE BETWEEN P1.VIS_MIN_CREATE_DTE AND P1.VIS_MAX_RESOLVE_DTE JOIN OHI P1 ON DT_DTE BETWEEN P1.OHI_CREATE_DTE AND P1.OHI_RESOLVED_DTE AND P.VISIT_ID = P1.VISIT_ID AND P1.RN=1 LEFT JOIN OHI P2 ON DT_DTE BETWEEN P2.OHI_CREATE_DTE AND P2.OHI_RESOLVED_DTE AND P.VISIT_ID = P2.VISIT_ID AND P2.RN=2 LEFT JOIN OHI P3 ON DT_DTE BETWEEN P3.OHI_CREATE_DTE AND P3.OHI_RESOLVED_DTE AND P.VISIT_ID = P3.VISIT_ID AND P3.RN=3 LEFT JOIN OHI P4 ON DT_DTE BETWEEN P4.OHI_CREATE_DTE AND P4.OHI_RESOLVED_DTE AND P.VISIT_ID = P4.VISIT_ID AND P4.RN=4 LEFT JOIN OHI P5 ON DT_DTE BETWEEN P5.OHI_CREATE_DTE AND P5.OHI_RESOLVED_DTE AND P.VISIT_ID = P5.VISIT_ID AND P5.RN=5 LEFT JOIN OHI P6 ON DT_DTE BETWEEN P6.OHI_CREATE_DTE AND P6.OHI_RESOLVED_DTE AND P.VISIT_ID = P6.VISIT_ID AND P6.RN=6 LEFT JOIN OHI P7 ON DT_DTE BETWEEN P7.OHI_CREATE_DTE AND P7.OHI_RESOLVED_DTE AND P.VISIT_ID = P7.VISIT_ID AND P7.RN=7 LEFT JOIN OHI P8 ON DT_DTE BETWEEN P8.OHI_CREATE_DTE AND P8.OHI_RESOLVED_DTE AND P.VISIT_ID = P8.VISIT_ID AND P8.RN=8

prompt: Provide data for breast cancer patients treated with neoadjuvant chemotherapy
completion: WITH DX AS (SELECT TM_MRN, AV_DESC AS CASE_STS, TM_DX_DTE, TM_HIST_CD, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS HIST_DESC, TM_SITE_CD, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_DESC, TM_CA_SURG_DTE, TM_CHEMO_STRT_DTE, TM_CHEM_SUM_MSK, TM_CLIN_TNM_T, TM_CLIN_TNM_N, TM_POST_RX_T, TM_POST_RX_N FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS ON AV_ELEMENT = 'CASE_STS' AND AV_CODE = TM_CASE_STS WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND TM_SITE_CD LIKE 'C50%' AND TM_CHEMO_STRT_DTE BETWEEN TM_CA_SURG_DTE - 1 YEAR AND TM_CA_SURG_DTE ) , CHEMO AS (SELECT APR_MRN, SUBSTR(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(CAST(XMLSERIALIZE(CONTENT XMLAGG(XMLELEMENT(NAME "C", '| '||DATE(APR_START_DTE) || ' | ' || DATE(APR_END_DTE) || ' | ' || TRIM(CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME) || ' | ' || TRIM(APR_PRESCRIBED_DOSE)||' |'|| CHR(13) || CHR(10)) ORDER BY DATE(APR_START_DTE)) AS CLOB(32000)) AS VARCHAR(32000)), '<C>', ','), '</C>', ''), '', ''), '<C/>', ''), ',', ''), 1) AS CHEMO_TX FROM (SELECT DISTINCT APR_MRN, APR_START_DTE, APR_END_DTE, CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME, APR_PRESCRIBED_DOSE FROM IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX JOIN IDB.CHEMO_DRUG_GENERIC ON APR_GENERIC_NAME = CDG_GENERIC_NAME JOIN DX ON TM_MRN = APR_MRN WHERE 1=1 ) A GROUP BY APR_MRN) SELECT DISTINCT TM_MRN "MRN", PT_LAST_NAME "PT Last Name", PT_FIRST_NAME "PT First Name", PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH "DOB", PT_DATE_OF_DEATH "DOD", TM_DX_DTE "Dx Date", SITE_DESC "Site", HIST_DESC "Histology", TM_CLIN_TNM_T "Clinical T Stage", TM_CLIN_TNM_N "Clinical N Stage", TM_POST_RX_T "Post Tx T Stage", TM_POST_RX_N "Post Tx N Stage", CHEMO_TX "All Chemo Tx", MAX(COALESCE(PLA_LST_APPT_DTE, PLA_LST_DSCH_DTE), COALESCE(PLA_LST_DSCH_DTE, PLA_LST_APPT_DTE)) "Last Follow Up Date" FROM DX JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON TM_MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY ON TM_MRN = PLA_MRN LEFT JOIN CHEMO ON TM_MRN = APR_MRN

prompt: A line list of inpatient COVID test orders by date since 3/1/2020 and a summary of the number of tests ordered by date.
completion: SELECT OO_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, OOC_ITEM_NAME, OO_ENTER_DTE, OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE, OL_LOC_NAME, OP_DISPLAY_NAME, OSTS_STS_DESC, LTL_TEXT_RESULT FROM IDB.OMS_ORDER O JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_CATALOG ON OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID = OOC_MSTR_ITEM_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_PROVIDER ON OO_PVDR_GUID = OP_PVDR_GUID JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON OO_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.OMS_VISIT_LOCATION A ON OVL_VISIT_GUID = OO_VISIT_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_LOCATION ON OVL_LOC_GUID = OL_LOC_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_STATUS ON OO_ORD_STS_CD = OSTS_ORD_STS_CD LEFT JOIN IDB.LAB_RESULTS ON LR_ORD_GUID = OO_ORD_GUID AND LR_SUBTEST_NAME IN ('COVID-19 RNA Result', 'COVID-19 Rapid Qualitative RNA Result') LEFT JOIN IDB.LAB_TEXT_LINE ON LTL_RESULT_GUID = LR_RESULT_GUID WHERE A.OVL_VISIT_LOC_GUID = (SELECT MAX(B.OVL_VISIT_LOC_GUID) FROM IDB.OMS_VISIT_LOCATION B WHERE A.OVL_VISIT_GUID = B.OVL_VISIT_GUID AND B.OVL_EFF_DT <= O.OO_ENTER_DT) AND OO_ORD_STS_CD NOT IN ('CANC', 'CANP', 'HOLD', 'AUC3') AND OOC_ITEM_NAME IN ('COVID-19 Qualitative RNA', 'COVID-19 Rapid Qualitative RNA') AND OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE >= '2020-03-01' AND OL_LOC_NAME like 'M 16%'

prompt: Provide a monthly  list of all patients treated at MSK who have a note in the chart under "Service: Gastrointestinal Oncology" AND have an surgical pathology report  in the last month.
completion: WITH DX1 AS (SELECT DISTINCT PRPT_MRN , PRPT_REPORT_DTE, PRPT_ACCESSION_NO, CASE WHEN INSTR(LOWER(CAST (PRPT_REPORT AS VARCHAR(12000))), 'neuroendocrine carcinoma') >0 THEN 'Neuroendocrine Carcinoma' WHEN INSTR(LOWER(CAST (PRPT_REPORT AS VARCHAR(12000))), 'well differentiated neuroendocrine tumor') >0 OR INSTR(LOWER(CAST (PRPT_REPORT AS VARCHAR(12000))), 'well-differentiated neuroendocrine tumor') >0 THEN 'Well Differentiated Neuroendocrine Tumor' END AS SEARCH_STRING, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY PRPT_MRN ORDER BY PRPT_REPORT_DTE DESC) PATH_RN FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V WHERE PRPT_REPORT IS NOT NULL AND PRPT_REPORT_DTE BETWEEN FIRST_DAY(CURRENT DATE -1 MONTH) AND LAST_DAY(CURRENT DATE -1 MONTH) AND (INSTR(LOWER(CAST (PRPT_REPORT AS VARCHAR(12000))), 'neuroendocrine carcinoma') >0 OR INSTR(LOWER(CAST (PRPT_REPORT AS VARCHAR(12000))), 'well differentiated neuroendocrine tumor') >0 OR INSTR(LOWER(CAST (PRPT_REPORT AS VARCHAR(12000))), 'well-differentiated neuroendocrine tumor') >0) ) , EMR AS (SELECT EAD_MRN, EAD_DOCUMENT_DTE FROM IDB.EMR_AA_DOCUMENT D JOIN IDB.EMR_AA_DOCTYPE ON EAD_DOCTYPE = EADT_DOCTYPE JOIN DX1 ON PRPT_MRN = EAD_MRN WHERE VALUE(EAD_RIGHT_ID, EADT_RIGHT_ID) = 167 AND EAD_DOCTYPE = 'M18' AND EAD_DOCUMENT_DTE BETWEEN FIRST_DAY(CURRENT DATE -1 MONTH) AND LAST_DAY(CURRENT DATE -1 MONTH) AND EADT_EMR_DESC LIKE '%DOM%' AND EADT_CATEGORY ='Assessments' ) , DX2 AS (SELECT DISTINCT CDD_MRN, OP_DISCIPLINE, CDD_SERVICE_DTE, CDD_DOC_GUID, CDD_DOC_NAME, CDO_SECTION, CDO_ITEM_NAME, CDO_VALUE_TEXT FROM IDB.CD_DOCUMENT LEFT JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION ON CDD_DOC_GUID = CDO_DOC_GUID AND CDD_AUTHORED_DTE = CDO_AUTHORED_DTE AND CDO_VALUE_TEXT <> '' JOIN EMR ON EAD_MRN = CDD_MRN AND CDD_SERVICE_DTE = EAD_DOCUMENT_DTE JOIN IDB.OMS_PROVIDER ON CDD_AUTH_PROV_GUID = OP_PVDR_GUID WHERE CDD_CANCEL_IND <> '1' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND <> '1' AND CDD_DOC_NAME like '%DOM-Gastrointestinal Oncology%' AND UPPER(CDO_ITEM_NAME) ='SERVICE' AND CDO_VALUE_TEXT = 'Gastrointestinal Oncology' AND OP_DISCIPLINE IN ('Medicine', 'xHematology') AND CDD_SERVICE_DTE BETWEEN FIRST_DAY(CURRENT DATE -1 MONTH) AND LAST_DAY(CURRENT DATE -1 MONTH) ) SELECT DISTINCT CDD_MRN AS MRN , PRPT_REPORT_DTE AS PATH_REPORT_DATE, SEARCH_STRING, PRPT_ACCESSION_NO AS ACCESSION_NO FROM DX1 JOIN DX2 ON CDD_MRN = PRPT_MRN AND PATH_RN =1 ; WITH DX1 AS (SELECT DISTINCT PRPT_MRN , PRPT_REPORT_DTE, PRPT_ACCESSION_NO, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY PRPT_MRN ORDER BY PRPT_REPORT_DTE DESC) PATH_RN FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V WHERE PRPT_REPORT IS NOT NULL AND PRPT_REPORT_DTE BETWEEN FIRST_DAY(CURRENT DATE -1 MONTH) AND LAST_DAY(CURRENT DATE -1 MONTH) AND INSTR(LOWER(CAST (PRPT_REPORT AS VARCHAR(12000))), 'sez6') >0 ) , EMR AS (SELECT EAD_MRN, EAD_DOCUMENT_DTE FROM IDB.EMR_AA_DOCUMENT D JOIN IDB.EMR_AA_DOCTYPE ON EAD_DOCTYPE = EADT_DOCTYPE JOIN DX1 ON PRPT_MRN = EAD_MRN WHERE VALUE(EAD_RIGHT_ID, EADT_RIGHT_ID) = 167 AND EAD_DOCTYPE = 'M18' AND EAD_DOCUMENT_DTE BETWEEN FIRST_DAY(CURRENT DATE -1 MONTH) AND LAST_DAY(CURRENT DATE -1 MONTH) AND EADT_EMR_DESC LIKE '%DOM%' AND EADT_CATEGORY ='Assessments' ) , DX2 AS (SELECT DISTINCT CDD_MRN, OP_DISCIPLINE, CDD_SERVICE_DTE, CDD_DOC_GUID, CDD_DOC_NAME, CDO_SECTION, CDO_ITEM_NAME, CDO_VALUE_TEXT FROM IDB.CD_DOCUMENT LEFT JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION ON CDD_DOC_GUID = CDO_DOC_GUID AND CDD_AUTHORED_DTE = CDO_AUTHORED_DTE AND CDO_VALUE_TEXT <> '' JOIN EMR ON EAD_MRN = CDD_MRN AND CDD_SERVICE_DTE = EAD_DOCUMENT_DTE JOIN IDB.OMS_PROVIDER ON CDD_AUTH_PROV_GUID = OP_PVDR_GUID WHERE CDD_CANCEL_IND <> '1' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND <> '1' AND CDD_DOC_NAME like '%DOM-Gastrointestinal Oncology%' AND UPPER(CDO_ITEM_NAME) ='SERVICE' AND CDO_VALUE_TEXT = 'Gastrointestinal Oncology' AND OP_DISCIPLINE IN ('Medicine', 'Hematology') AND CDD_SERVICE_DTE BETWEEN FIRST_DAY(CURRENT DATE -1 MONTH) AND LAST_DAY(CURRENT DATE -1 MONTH) ) SELECT DISTINCT CDD_MRN AS MRN , PRPT_REPORT_DTE AS PATH_REPORT_DATE , PRPT_ACCESSION_NO AS ACCESSION_NO FROM DX1 JOIN DX2 ON CDD_MRN = PRPT_MRN AND PATH_RN =1 ;

prompt: Provide data on patients diagnosed with pancreatic cancer between 2006 and 2013.
completion: SELECT DISTINCT "t1"."PT_MRN" AS "MRN", "t2"."ICSC_SITE_CD" AS "ICD-O Site Code", "t2"."ICSC_ICDO_SITE_MSK_DESC" AS "ICD-O Site Description", "t3"."DT_YEAR" AS "Tumor Diagnosis Year", "t4"."TCSA_TM_AJCC_DESC" AS "Collaborative Group (AJCC stage)", "t5"."TCA_CASE_STS_DESC" AS "Case Status", "t6"."CDTM_CA_SURG_DTE" AS "Tumor Surgery Date", "t6"."CDTM_CDB_SEQ_NO" AS "Tumor Sequence", "t1"."PT_SEX_DESC" AS "Gender", "t1"."PT_LAST_NAME" AS "Last Name", "t1"."PT_FIRST_NAME" AS "First Name", "t1"."PT_BIRTH_DTE" AS "Date of Birth", "t1"."PT_DEATH_DTE" AS "Deceased Date", "t7"."DXCC_ICD_CODE" AS "ICD-O Histology Code", "t7"."DXCC_ICD_MSK_DESC" AS "ICD-O Histology Description" FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V" "t1" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED" "t8" ON "t1"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t8"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."CDB_TUMOR_V" "t6" ON "t8"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t6"."CDTM_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."ICDO_SITE_CATALOG_V" "t2" ON "t6"."CDTM_SITE_CATALOG_ID" = "t2"."ICSC_SITE_CATALOG_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" "t3" ON "t6"."CDTM_DX_DATE_ID" = "t3"."DT_DATE_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."TUMOR_COLLAB_STAGE_ATTRIBUTES_V" "t4" ON "t6"."CDTM_COLLAB_STAGE_ATTR_ID" = "t4"."TCSA_TM_COLLAB_STAGE_ATTR_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."TUMOR_CASE_ATTRIBUTES_V" "t5" ON "t6"."CDTM_CASE_ATTR_ID" = "t5"."TUMOR_CASE_ATTR_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DIAGNOSIS_CODE_CAT_ICDO_V" "t7" ON "t6"."CDTM_DX_CATALOG_ID" = "t7"."DXCC_DX_CATALOG_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_IDENTIFICATION_MRN_V" "t9" ON "t1"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t9"."PI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" WHERE ("t2"."ICSC_SITE_CD" IN ('C250', 'C251', 'C252', 'C253', 'C254', 'C257', 'C258', 'C259') AND ("t3"."DT_YEAR" BETWEEN 2006 AND 2013 AND ("t5"."TCA_CASE_STS_DESC" = 'Completed' AND ("t4"."TCSA_TM_AJCC_DESC" IN ('IIA', 'IIB', 'IIEA', 'IIEB', 'IIESB', 'III', 'IIIEA', 'IIIEB', 'IIIESA', 'IINOS') AND "t9"."PI_SOURCE_SYSTEM_PT_ID" = '0'))))

prompt: Request data to evaluate how much IV magnesium sulfate was prescribed to individual patients who receive an EGFR inhibitor (cetuximab, panitumumab, nimotuzumab, and necitumumab)from 1/2015 - 12/2020
completion: WITH CTE AS (SELECT APR_MRN , MIN(APR_START_DT) "EGFR inhibitor START_DT" , MAX(APR_END_DT) "EGFR inhibitor END_DT" FROM IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX_V WHERE (LOWER(CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME) IN ('cetuximab', 'panitumumab', 'nimotuzumab', 'necitumumab') OR LOWER(APR_DRUG_NAME)IN ('cetuximab', 'panitumumab', 'nimotuzumab', 'necitumumab')) AND APR_START_DTE BETWEEN '2015-01-01' AND '2020-12-31' AND APR_DRUG_PROCESS_STAGE <> 'H' AND APR_ORD_RX_TYPE IN ('OP', 'IP') GROUP BY APR_MRN) SELECT OOTO_MRN, "EGFR inhibitor START_DT", "EGFR inhibitor END_DT" , OO_ORD_NAME ORDNAME, MIN(OOTO_SIGNIFIC_DT) "Magnesium Start DT", MAX(OOTO_SIGNIFIC_DT) "Magnesium End DT", SUM(OMD_DOSE_LOW) TOTAL_DOSE, OMD_DOSE_UNIT UOM, OMD_ORD_ROUTE ROUTE FROM CTE JOIN IDB.OMS_ORDER ON APR_MRN = OO_MRN AND OO_SIGNIFICANT_DT BETWEEN "EGFR inhibitor START_DT" AND "EGFR inhibitor END_DT" JOIN IDB.OMS_MED_DETAIL ON OO_ORD_GUID = OMD_ORD_GUID JOIN IDB.OAS_ORD_TASK_OCCR ON OO_ORD_GUID = OOTO_ORD_GUID JOIN IDB.OAS_CTLG_ITEM_TASK ON OOTO_CAT_ITEM_GUID = OCIT_GUID AND OCIT_LEVEL_NO = 0 AND OMD_ORD_ROUTE like 'IV%' AND LOWER(OO_ORD_NAME) like '%magnesium%sulfat%' AND OOTO_STATUS_CD= 'Performed' GROUP BY OOTO_MRN, "EGFR inhibitor START_DT", "EGFR inhibitor END_DT" , OO_ORD_NAME, OMD_DOSE_UNIT, OMD_ORD_ROUTE ;

prompt: Provide a list of patients who have appointments scheduled from 05/01/2023 - 05/19/2023. The patients are scheduled under the appointment department: UROLOGY 68-C and UROLOGY 68-C APP.
completion: SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN AS "MRN", CPE_ENC_DTE AS "Appt Date", CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 AS "Department", CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 AS "Service", CLD_DEPT_NAME AS "Department Name", CRE_RES_NAME AS "Provider Name", CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME AS "Visit Type" FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Sch') AND CLD_DEPT_NAME IN ('UROLOGY 68-C', 'UROLOGY 68-C APP') AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN '2023-05-01' AND '2023-05-19' ;

prompt: We are trying to identify how many sarcoma patients within past 1 year have been treated with anti-PD-1 and/or anti-CTLA4 therapy (i.e. immunotherapy).
completion: WITH MAIN AS (SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN AS P_MRN , TRIM(PT_LAST_NAME)||' '||TRIM(PT_FIRST_NAME) "NAME" , H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK "CLM CLASSICIATION DESCRIPTION" , CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 "SERVICE" , CDG_THERAPEUTIC_CATEGORY "IMMUNOTHERAPY TREATMENT" , MIN(APR_START_DTE) OVER (PARTITION BY PT_MRN, CDG_THERAPEUTIC_CATEGORY) "DATE OF IMMUNO STARTED" , MAX(APR_END_DTE) OVER (PARTITION BY PT_MRN, CDG_THERAPEUTIC_CATEGORY) "DATE OF IMMUNO STOPPED" FROM IDB.PATIENT JOIN IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER ON PT_MRN = CPE_MRN AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN '2020-01-01' AND '2020-12-31' JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 = 'SAR' LEFT JOIN IDB.CDB_TUMOR ON TM_MRN = CPE_MRN AND TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') JOIN IDB.CLM H ON TM_HIST_CD = H.CLM_CLSF_CD AND H.CLM_CLSF_CD NOT IN ('C4A', 'C4A.0', 'C4A.1', 'C4A.10', 'C4A.11', 'C4A.111', 'C4A.112', 'C4A.12', 'C4A.121', 'C4A.122', 'C4A.2', 'C4A.20', 'C4A.21', 'C4A.22', 'C4A.3', 'C4A.30', 'C4A.31', 'C4A.39', 'C4A.4', 'C4A.5', 'C4A.51', 'C4A.52', 'C4A.59', 'C4A.6', 'C4A.60', 'C4A.61', 'C4A.62', 'C4A.7', 'C4A.70', 'C4A.71', 'C4A.72', 'C4A.8', 'C4A.9', 'C7B.1', 'M8247/3', 'Z85.821', '0058U', '0059U', '209.31', '209.32', '209.33', '209.34', '209.35', '209.36', '209.75', '8247/3', '0000000', '') JOIN IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX_V ON CPE_MRN = APR_MRN AND CDG_IMMUNOTHERAPY_FLAG = 'Y' ) ,PROTOCOLS AS (SELECT AC_MRN, LISTAGG(TRIM(AC_IRB_NO), ', ') "Protocols" FROM IDB.ACCRUALS JOIN IDB.PROTOCOL ON PRO_IRB_NO = AC_IRB_NO WHERE 1=1 AND AC_MRN IN (SELECT P_MRN FROM MAIN) GROUP BY AC_MRN) ,IMPACT AS (SELECT PT_MRN AS I_MRN, PRPT_REPORT_DTE, PDWS_NAME, PDRX_DMP_PATIENT_ID, PDRX_DMP_SAMPLE_ID AS I_PDRX_DMP_SAMPLE_ID, T.* , DV.TODATE(DT_PROCEDURE) AS "Procedure Date" FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V ON PRPT_PATH_RPT_ID = PDRX_PATH_RPT_ID INNER JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML_SETTINGS ON PDRX_PATH_DMP_RESULTS_XML_ID = PDRXS_PATH_DMP_RESULTS_XML_ID INNER JOIN DVDMC.PATHOLOGY_DMP_WEBSVC_SETTINGS ON PDRXS_SETTING_ID = PDWS_SETTING_ID INNER JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON PDRX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID JOIN MAIN ON P_MRN = PT_MRN , XMLTABLE('$x/root/meta-data' PASSING PDRX_XML_VALUE AS "x" COLUMNS TMBSCORE VARCHAR(25) PATH 'tmb_score', MSI_SCORE VARCHAR(25) PATH 'msi-score', MSI_TYPE VARCHAR(25) PATH 'msi-type', GENE_PANEL VARCHAR(100) PATH '../meta-data/gene-panel', M_ACCESSION_NUM VARCHAR(100) PATH '../meta-data/m_accession_num', PRIMARY_SITE VARCHAR(100) PATH '../meta-data/primary_site', TUMOR_TYPE_NAME VARCHAR(100) PATH '../meta-data/tumor_type_name', METASTASIS_SITE VARCHAR(100) PATH '../meta-data/metastasis_site', PART_DESCRIPTION VARCHAR(170) PATH '../meta-data/part_description', DT_PROCEDURE VARCHAR(100) PATH '../meta-data/dt_procedure') T WHERE 1=1 AND PDWS_NAME like 'IMPACT%' ) ,ARCHER AS (SELECT PT_MRN AS A_MRN, PDRX_DMP_SAMPLE_ID AS A_PDRX_DMP_SAMPLE_ID, T.* , DV.TODATE(DT_PROCEDURE) AS "Procedure Date" FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V ON PRPT_PATH_RPT_ID = PDRX_PATH_RPT_ID INNER JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML_SETTINGS ON PDRX_PATH_DMP_RESULTS_XML_ID = PDRXS_PATH_DMP_RESULTS_XML_ID INNER JOIN DVDMC.PATHOLOGY_DMP_WEBSVC_SETTINGS ON PDRXS_SETTING_ID = PDWS_SETTING_ID INNER JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON PDRX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID JOIN MAIN ON P_MRN = PT_MRN , XMLTABLE('$x/root/meta-data' PASSING PDRX_XML_VALUE AS "x" COLUMNS TMBSCORE VARCHAR(25) PATH 'tmb_score', MSI_SCORE VARCHAR(25) PATH 'msi-score', MSI_TYPE VARCHAR(25) PATH 'msi-type', GENE_PANEL VARCHAR(100) PATH '../meta-data/gene-panel', M_ACCESSION_NUM VARCHAR(100) PATH '../meta-data/m_accession_num', PRIMARY_SITE VARCHAR(100) PATH '../meta-data/primary_site', TUMOR_TYPE_NAME VARCHAR(100) PATH '../meta-data/tumor_type_name', METASTASIS_SITE VARCHAR(100) PATH '../meta-data/metastasis_site', PART_DESCRIPTION VARCHAR(170) PATH '../meta-data/part_description', DT_PROCEDURE VARCHAR(100) PATH '../meta-data/dt_procedure') T WHERE 1=1 AND PDWS_NAME like 'ARCHER%' ) SELECT DISTINCT MAIN.*, "Protocols", CASE WHEN COUNT(I_PDRX_DMP_SAMPLE_ID) OVER (PARTITION BY I_MRN) >=1 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS "Had MSK IMPACT done (Yes/No)", CASE WHEN COUNT(A_PDRX_DMP_SAMPLE_ID) OVER (PARTITION BY A_MRN) >=1 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS "Had ARCHER done (Yes/No)" FROM MAIN LEFT JOIN PROTOCOLS ON AC_MRN = P_MRN LEFT JOIN IMPACT ON P_MRN = I_MRN LEFT JOIN ARCHER ON P_MRN = A_MRN ;

prompt: Requesting list of all patients for whom a clindoc MERT note was completed between May 1st 2020 to January 31st 2021. In addition, would like to know if these were a coordinated visit with a provider, lab / radiology visit. In addition, would like to know how many went home versus transferred to another hospital (MSK, outside hospital), and 3 months mortality of these patients.
completion: WITH CLINDOC AS (SELECT CDD_MRN AS MRN, CDD_SERVICE_DTE, CDD_DOC_NAME, OP_DISPLAY_NAME AS PROVIDER, CDD_DOC_GUID, CDO_SECTION, CDO_ITEM_NAME, CDO_VALUE_TEXT FROM IDB.CD_DOCUMENT LEFT JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION ON CDD_DOC_GUID = CDO_DOC_GUID AND CDD_AUTHORED_DTE = CDO_AUTHORED_DTE AND CDO_VALUE_TEXT <> '' JOIN IDB.OMS_PROVIDER ON CDD_AUTH_PROV_GUID = OP_PVDR_GUID WHERE CDD_CANCEL_IND <> '1' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND <> '1' AND CDO_SECTION = 'MERT' AND CDD_SERVICE_DTE BETWEEN '2020-05-01' AND '2021-01-30' ) , CHEMO AS (SELECT APR_MRN, APR_START_DTE START_DTE FROM IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX_V JOIN CLINDOC ON MRN = APR_MRN WHERE CDG_CHEMO_FLAG = 'Y' ) SELECT TRIM(PT_LAST_NAME) || ', ' || TRIM(PT_FIRST_NAME) NAME, YEAR(CD.CDD_SERVICE_DTE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) AGE, PT_SEX SEX, CD.MRN, CD.CDD_SERVICE_DTE NOTE_DATE, PT_DATE_OF_DEATH DEATH_DATE, DAYS(PT_DATE_OF_DEATH) - DAYS(CD.CDD_SERVICE_DTE) DAYS_AFTER_NOTE, MAX(CASE WHEN CHEMO.START_DTE >= CD.CDD_SERVICE_DTE - 30 DAY THEN 'Y' ELSE '' END) AS ACTIVE_CHEMO FROM CLINDOC CD LEFT JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON CD.MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN CHEMO ON CD.MRN = CHEMO.APR_MRN AND START_DTE BETWEEN CD.CDD_SERVICE_DTE - 30 DAY AND CD.CDD_SERVICE_DTE GROUP BY TRIM(PT_LAST_NAME) || ', ' || TRIM(PT_FIRST_NAME), YEAR(CD.CDD_SERVICE_DTE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH), PT_SEX, CD.MRN, CD.CDD_SERVICE_DTE, PT_DATE_OF_DEATH, DAYS(PT_DATE_OF_DEATH) - DAYS(CD.CDD_SERVICE_DTE)

prompt: Provide a weekly count of orders of specified flu medications.
completion: SELECT PIN_MNEMONIC, PO_MRN, PO_CR_DTE, POD_STRT_DTE, PO_DISP_LOC_NAME, POD_ITEM_DESC, PO_DR_NAME, CASE WHEN PO_ACCT_NO LIKE '84%' THEN 'Inpatient' ELSE 'Retail' END AS RX_TYPE FROM IDB.PHM_ORDER JOIN IDB.PHM_ORD_DTL ON PO_ORD_SEQ = POD_ORD_SEQ JOIN IDB.PHM_ORD_INV ON POD_ITEM_NO = POI_ITEM_NO AND POD_ORD_SEQ = POI_ORD_SEQ JOIN IDB.PHM_INVENTORY ON POI_INV_SEQ = PIN_INV_SEQ WHERE POD_CR_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT DATE - 7 DAYS AND CURRENT DATE - 1 DAYS AND PO_ORD_STS NOT IN ('X', 'P') AND POD_ATT_FLAG NOT LIKE '%IVVEH%' AND PIN_MNEMONIC IN ('OSE75C', 'OSE300P25', 'ZAN100D') AND UCASE(POI_INV_LOC_NAME) NOT LIKE '%OUTPATIENT CLINIC%'

prompt: Identify all patients who have skin microbiome collection performed by searching 'skin microbiome collection' in clinic notes as a string term between 2017 and 2019
completion: SELECT DISTINCT CDD_MRN AS "MRN", TRIM(PT_LAST_NAME)||',' ||TRIM(PT_FIRST_NAME) AS "Patient Name", CDD_SERVICE_DTE AS "Service Date", CDD_DOC_NAME AS "Document Name", OP_DISPLAY_NAME AS "Provider", CDO_SECTION AS "Section Name", CDO_ITEM_NAME AS "Item Name", CDO_VALUE_TEXT AS "Value Text" FROM IDB.CD_DOCUMENT JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PT_MRN = CDD_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION ON CDD_DOC_GUID = CDO_DOC_GUID AND CDD_AUTHORED_DTE = CDO_AUTHORED_DTE AND CDO_VALUE_TEXT <> '' JOIN IDB.OMS_PROVIDER ON CDD_AUTH_PROV_GUID = OP_PVDR_GUID WHERE CDD_CANCEL_IND <> '1' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND <> '1' AND UPPER(CDO_VALUE_TEXT) LIKE '%SKIN MICROBIOME COLLECTION%' OR UPPER(CDD_DOC_NAME) LIKE '%MICROBIOME%' AND CDD_SERVICE_DTE BETWEEN '2017-01-01' AND '2019-12-31' ORDER BY CDD_MRN

prompt: Design a structured report of patients who had surgery performed in the Breast service in the specified date range.
completion: SELECT DISTINCT STRIP(SSE_MRN) AS MRN, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH AS DOB, SSE_SURG_DTE AS "Surgery Date", STRIP(SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD) AS "CPT Code", STRIP(SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC) AS "Surgery Description", STRIP(SSP_LATERALITY) AS "Laterality" FROM IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE ON SSE_LOG_ID = SSP_LOG_ID JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PT_MRN = SSE_MRN WHERE 1=1 AND SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD IN ('19301', '19302', '19303', '19304', '19307', '38500', '38525', '38530', '38740', '38745')

prompt: EEGs performed inpatient and outpatient for patients <= 21 from 2014 - present.
completion: SELECT OO_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, YEAR(OO_ENTER_DTE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) "Age at EEG", OO_ENTER_DTE, OO_ORD_STS_CD, OO_ORD_NAME, MAX(CASE WHEN OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'EEG_Type' THEN OUD_USER_DI_VALUE END) "EEG Type", MAX(CASE WHEN OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'EEG_Neuro_Diag' THEN OUD_USER_DI_VALUE END) "Diagnosis" FROM IDB.OMS_ORDER LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_USER_DATA ON OO_ORD_GUID = OUD_ORD_GUID JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PT_MRN = OO_MRN WHERE OO_ORD_NAME ='Electroencephalogram' AND OO_ENTER_DTE>='2014-01-01' AND YEAR(OO_ENTER_DTE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) < 22 AND OUD_USER_DI_CD IN ('EEG_Type', 'EEG_Neuro_Diag') AND OO_ORD_STS_CD NOT IN ('CANP', 'CANC', 'AUC3') GROUP BY OO_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, YEAR(OO_ENTER_DTE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH), OO_ENTER_DTE, OO_ORD_STS_CD, OO_ORD_NAME ; SELECT CDD_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, YEAR(CDD_SERVICE_DTE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) "Age at EEG", CDD_SERVICE_DTE, CDD_DOC_NAME, MAX(CASE WHEN CDO_ITEM_NAME ='Diagnosis' THEN CDO_VALUE_TEXT END) "Diagnosis", MAX(CASE WHEN CDO_ITEM_NAME ='Study Location' THEN CDO_VALUE_TEXT END) "Study Location", MAX(CASE WHEN CDO_ITEM_NAME ='Reason for study' THEN CDO_VALUE_TEXT END) "Reason for study", MAX(CASE WHEN CDO_ITEM_NAME ='Type of EEG' THEN CDO_VALUE_TEXT END) "Type of EEG", MAX(CASE WHEN CDO_ITEM_NAME ='Start Date/Time' THEN CDO_VALUE_TEXT END) "Start Date/Time" FROM IDB.CD_DOCUMENT JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION ON CDD_DOC_GUID = CDO_DOC_GUID JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON CDD_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE CDD_DOC_NAME='Electroencephalography Report - Neurology' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND <> '1' AND CDD_CANCEL_IND <> '1' AND CDD_SERVICE_DTE >= '2014-01-01' AND YEAR(CDD_SERVICE_DTE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) < 22 AND CDO_ITEM_NAME IN ('Diagnosis', 'Study Location', 'Reason for study', 'Type of EEG', 'Start Date/Time') GROUP BY CDD_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, YEAR(CDD_SERVICE_DTE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH), CDD_SERVICE_DTE, CDD_DOC_NAME ; SELECT ED_MRN, D.PT_LAST_NAME, D.PT_FIRST_NAME, D.PT_BIRTH_DTE, YEAR(ED_SERVICEDATE-D.PT_BIRTH_DTE) "Age at EEG", CND_EMAR_DESC, ED_SERVICEDATE FROM DV.ESIG_DOCUMENTS JOIN DV.CLINICAL_NOTES_EMR_DOCUMENTS ON CNED_DERIVED_DOCUMENT_NO = ED_DOCNUMBER AND CNED_DERIVED_REFERENCE_NO = ED_REFERENCE JOIN DV.CLINICAL_NOTES_DOCTYPES ON CND_MEDICAL_DOCTYPE_ID = CNED_DOCTYPE_ID LEFT JOIN DV.MEDPRO ON MP_SOURCE_PROVIDER_NO = ED_PHYSICIANNUM AND MP_SOURCE_PROVIDER_NO <> '' JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V D ON ED_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE VALUE(CNED_RIGHT_CD, CND_RIGHT_CD) = '167' AND CND_EMAR_DESC like 'Electroencephalography%' AND ED_SERVICEDATE >= '2014-01-01' AND YEAR(ED_SERVICEDATE - D.PT_BIRTH_DTE) < 22

prompt: list of MRN/DOS that have remote care observation field (pt location = ny/nj). It appears these were new fields added recently.
completion: SELECT CDD_MRN AS "MRN", PT_STATE AS "Patient Location", CDD_SERVICE_DTE AS "Service Date", CDD_DOC_NAME AS "Document Name", CDO_ITEM_NAME AS "Item Name", CDO_VALUE_TEXT AS "Value Text" FROM IDB.CD_DOCUMENT LEFT JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION ON CDD_DOC_GUID = CDO_DOC_GUID AND CDD_AUTHORED_DTE = CDO_AUTHORED_DTE AND CDO_VALUE_TEXT <> '' JOIN IDB.OMS_PROVIDER ON CDD_AUTH_PROV_GUID = OP_PVDR_GUID JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PT_MRN = CDD_MRN WHERE CDD_CANCEL_IND <> '1' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND <> '1' AND LOWER(CDO_VALUE_TEXT) like 'remote care option%' AND PT_STATE IN ('NJ', 'NY')

prompt: Pull pathology reports with the lymph node as the site of biopsy for the MRNs of the MED27506 request
completion: WITH X AS (SELECT DISTINCT "t1"."PT_MRN" AS "MRN", "t2"."PRPT_ACCESSION_NO" AS "Pathology Report", "t3"."PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_DESC" AS "Pathology Report Type", "t4"."DT_DTE" AS "Pathology Procedure Date", "t5"."DT_DTE" AS "Pathology Report Date", UPPER(CASE WHEN LENGTH(PRPT_REPORT) <= 15000 THEN RTRIM(CAST(SUBSTR(PRPT_REPORT, 1, 15000) AS VARCHAR(15000))) ELSE CAST(SUBSTR(PRPT_REPORT, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK ) , DX2 AS (SELECT MRN, LISTAGG(COALESCE(STRIP(CAST(DX_DATE AS VARCHAR(12000))), '') || ' | ' || COALESCE(STRIP(CAST(DX_CODE AS VARCHAR(12000))), '') || ' | ' || COALESCE(STRIP(CAST(DX_DESC AS VARCHAR(12000))), '') , CHR(13) || CHR(10)) WITHIN GROUP( ORDER BY MRN, DX_DATE, DX_CODE, DX_DESC) AS DX FROM DX1 GROUP BY MRN) , CRDB AS (SELECT CBM_MRN AS MRN, DX, CBM_TRANSPLANT_TYPE AS BMT_TYPE, CBM_TRANSPLANT_DTE AS BMT_DATE FROM DX2 JOIN IDB.CRDB_BMT_MEDICINE ON CBM_MRN = MRN WHERE 1=1 AND CBM_TRANSPLANT_TYPE like '%AUTO%' UNION SELECT CBP_MRN AS MRN, DX, CDD_MRN, DX, CDD_DOC_GUID, CDD_DOC_NAME, DATE(CASE WHEN CDO_ITEM_NAME = 'HSCT Date' AND LENGTH(STRIP(SUBSTR(CDO_VALUE_TEXT, 1, 10))) = 10 THEN SUBSTR(CDO_VALUE_TEXT, 1, 10) WHEN CDO_ITEM_NAME = 'HSCT 1, 2) || '/' || SUBSTR(CDO_VALUE_TEXT, 4, 2) || '/' || '20' || SUBSTR(CDO_VALUE_TEXT, 7, 2) END) AS HSCT_DATE, CASE WHEN CDO_ITEM_NAME = 'HSCT Summary_Donor Type' THEN STRIP(SUBSTR(CDO_VALUE_TEXT, 1, 20)) END AS HSCT_TYPE FROM DX2 JOIN IDB.CD_DOCUMENT ON CDD_MRN = MRN JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION ON CDO_DOC_GUID = CDD_DOC_GUID AND CDO_AUTHORED_DTE = CDD_AUTHORED_DTE WHERE CDD_CANCEL_IND = '0' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND = '0' AND CDD_DOC_NAME IN ('Admission Note - BMT', 'Progress Note - BMT', 'Follow Up - BMT') AND CDO_ITEM_NAME IN ('HSCT Summary_Donor Type') AND CDO_VALUE_TEXT = 'Autologous' ) , X AS (SELECT CDD_MRN AS MRN, DX, MAX(HSCT_TYPE) AS BMT_TYPE, MAX(HSCT_DATE) AS BMT_DATE FROM CD1 WHERE CDD_DOC_GUID IN (SELECT CDD_DOC_GUID FROM CD2) AND CDD_MRN NOT IN (SELECT MRN FROM CRDB) GROUP BY CDD_MRN, DX UNION SELECT * FROM CRDB) SELECT DISTINCT MRN, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH AS DOB, PT_DATE_OF_DEATH AS DOD, PFA_FST_APPT_DTE, PLA_LST_APPT_DTE, DX, BMT_TYPE, BMT_DATE FROM X JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON OSTS_ORD_STS_CD JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PT_MRN = OO_MRN JOIN IDB.OMS_PROVIDER ON OO_PVDR_GUID = OP_PVDR_GUID WHERE OOC_ITEM_NAME = 'HRCSM Identification Order' ) , USR AS (SELECT U.OO_MRN, U.PATIENT_NAME, U.ORDER_NAME, U.REQUESTED_DATE, U.ORDER_DATE, U.ORDER_STATUS, U.PROVIDER, OUD_USER_DI_CD, OUD_USER_DI_VALUE , U.OO_ORD_GUID FROM ORD U JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_USER_DATA ON U.OO_ORD_GUID = OUD_ORD_GUID AND OUD_MRN = U.OO_MRN) SELECT DISTINCT U.OO_MRN, U.PATIENT_NAME, U.ORDER_NAME, U.REQUESTED_DATE, U.ORDER_DATE, U.ORDER_STATUS, U.PROVIDER, TRIM(U1.OUD_USER_DI_VALUE) AS "HRCSM_Mutation", TRIM(U2.OUD_USER_DI_VALUE) AS "HRCSM_Personal Mutation", TRIM(U3.OUD_USER_DI_VALUE) AS "HRCSM_Prior_Cancer", TRIM(U4.OUD_USER_DI_VALUE) AS "HRCSM_Pre-malignancy", TRIM(U5.OUD_USER_DI_VALUE) AS "HRCSM_Personal history", TRIM(U6.OUD_USER_DI_VALUE) AS "HRCSM_Family history Y/N", TRIM(U7.OUD_USER_DI_VALUE) AS "HRCSM_Family history", TRIM(U8.OUD_USER_DI_VALUE) AS "HRCSM_Survivorship", TRIM(U9.OUD_USER_DI_VALUE) AS "Comment" FROM USR U LEFT JOIN USR U1 ON U1.OO_ORD_GUID = U.OO_ORD_GUID AND U1.OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'HRCSM_Mutation' LEFT JOIN USR U2 ON U2.OO_ORD_GUID = U.OO_ORD_GUID AND U2.OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'HRCSM_Personal Mutation' LEFT JOIN USR U3 ON U3.OO_ORD_GUID = U.OO_ORD_GUID AND U3.OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'HRCSM_Prior_Cancer' LEFT JOIN USR U4 ON U4.OO_ORD_GUID = U.OO_ORD_GUID AND U4.OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'HRCSM_Pre-malignancy' LEFT JOIN USR U5 ON U5.OO_ORD_GUID = U.OO_ORD_GUID AND U5.OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'HRCSM_Personal history' LEFT JOIN USR U6 ON U6.OO_ORD_GUID = U.OO_ORD_GUID AND U6.OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'HRCSM_Family history Y/N' LEFT JOIN USR U7 ON U7.OO_ORD_GUID = U.OO_ORD_GUID AND U7.OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'HRCSM_Family history' LEFT JOIN USR U8 ON U8.OO_ORD_GUID = U.OO_ORD_GUID AND
