prompt:
Creating a daily dataline report for HCT patients with positive C-diff PCR.

We already have structured reports for the BMT population for other infections such as Med 15258 and note that Cynthia is familiar with similar ID reports
completion: WITH PTS AS (SELECT PT_MRN AS LR_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME "Last Name", PT_FIRST_NAME "First Name", LR_TEST_NAME AS "Lab-Test Name", LR_SUBTEST_NAME AS "Lab-Subtest Name", LR_PERFORMED_DTE "Lab Performed Date", CAST(LTL_TEXT_RESULT AS VARCHAR(3000)) AS "Lab-Test Result Notes", LR_RESULT_VALUE AS "Lab-Test Result Value" FROM IDB.LAB_RESULTS LEFT JOIN IDB.LAB_TEXT_LINE ON LTL_MRN = LR_MRN AND LTL_RESULT_GUID = LR_RESULT_GUID JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON LR_MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.ACCRUALS_DATES ON ACD_MRN = LR_MRN WHERE LR_TEST_NAME = 'C. Difficile PCR' AND ACD_IRB_NO='21-319' AND LTL_TEXT_RESULT not like 'Not Detected%' ) , X AS (SELECT CDD_MRN, CDD_SERVICE_DTE "Cell Infusion Date", DATE(CDD_SIGNED_DT) CDD_SIGNED_DT, CDD_AUTH_PROV_GUID, CDD_VISIT_GUID, CDD_DOC_GUID, MAX(CASE WHEN CDO_MSTR_ITEM_NM IN ('BMT_Cell INF_PI_Cell Infusion Type RES', 'Product Information: Cell Infusion Type') THEN CAST(TRIM(CDO_VALUE_TEXT) AS VARCHAR(500)) END) AS "Cell Infusion Type", MAX(CASE WHEN CDO_MSTR_ITEM_NM IN ('BMT_Cell_INF_Dx RES', 'BMT_Cell INF_Dx Other FT') THEN CAST(TRIM(CDO_VALUE_TEXT) AS VARCHAR(500)) END) AS "Diagnosis", MAX(CASE WHEN CDO_MSTR_ITEM_NM IN ('BMT_Cell INF_Protocol RES', 'BMT_Cell INF_Transplant Regimen Protocol Other FT') THEN CAST(TRIM(CDO_VALUE_TEXT) AS VARCHAR(500)) END) AS "Protocol" FROM PTS JOIN IDB.CD_DOCUMENT ON LR_MRN = CDD_MRN JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION CI ON CDD_DOC_GUID = CI.CDO_DOC_GUID AND CDD_AUTHORED_DTE = CI.CDO_AUTHORED_DTE WHERE CDD_DOC_NAME = 'Cell Infusion - BMT' AND CDD_CANCEL_IND <> '1' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND <> '1' AND CDO_VALUE_TEXT <> '' AND CDO_MSTR_ITEM_NM IN ('BMT_Cell INF_PI_Cell Infusion Type RES', 'BMT_Cell_INF_Dx RES', 'BMT_Cell INF_Dx Other FT', 'BMT_Cell INF_Protocol RES', 'BMT_Cell INF_Transplant Regimen Protocol Other FT', 'Product Information: Cell Infusion Type') GROUP BY CDD_MRN, CDD_SERVICE_DTE, CDD_SIGNED_DT, CDD_AUTH_PROV_GUID, CDD_VISIT_GUID, CDD_DOC_GUID ) , Y AS (SELECT DISTINCT X.*, P.OU_DISPLAY_NAME AS "Note User", OU_OCCUPATION AS "User Role" FROM X JOIN IDB.OMS_USER P ON CDD_AUTH_PROV_GUID = P.OU_USER_GUID UNION SELECT DISTINCT X.*, U.OU_DISPLAY_NAME AS "Note User", OU_OCCUPATION AS "User Role" FROM X JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION ON CDD_DOC_GUID = CDO_DOC_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_USER U ON CDO_USER_GUID = U.OU_USER_GUID) , Z AS (SELECT CDD_DOC_GUID, "Note User", "User Role", ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CDD_DOC_GUID ORDER BY "Note User") AS RN FROM Y ORDER BY CDD_DOC_GUID, "Note User") , Z1 AS (SELECT CDD_DOC_GUID, MAX(CASE WHEN RN = 1 THEN "Note User" END) AS "Co-signer #1", MAX(CASE WHEN RN = 1 THEN "User Role" END) AS "Co-signer #1 Role", MAX(CASE WHEN RN = 2 THEN "Note User" END) AS "Co-signer #2", MAX(CASE WHEN RN = 2 THEN "User Role" END) AS "Co-signer #2 Role" FROM Z GROUP BY CDD_DOC_GUID) , CD AS (SELECT CDD_MRN AS MRN, STRIP(PT_LAST_NAME)||', '||STRIP(PT_FIRST_NAME) AS "Patient Name", "Co-signer #1", "Co-signer #1 Role", "Co-signer #2", "Co-signer #2 Role", OCV_CURR_LOC AS "Visit Location", "Cell Infusion Type", "Cell Infusion Date" FROM Y JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON CDD_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN Z1 ON Y.CDD_DOC_GUID = Z1.CDD_DOC_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_CLIENT_VISIT ON CDD_VISIT_GUID = OCV_VISIT_GUID) SELECT DISTINCT LR_MRN "MRN", "Last Name", "First Name", "Lab-Test Name", "Lab-Subtest Name", "Lab Performed Date", "Lab-Test Result Notes", "Lab-Test Result Value", "Cell Infusion Date", "Cell Infusion Type", "Co-signer #1", "Co-signer #1 Role", "Co-signer #2", "Co-signer #2 Role", "Visit Location", CURRENT date "Report Date" FROM PTS LEFT JOIN CD ON LR_MRN = MRN ORDER BY LR_MRN

prompt: Provide a list of patients diagnosed with prostate cancer and rectal cancer and were treated with either external beam radiotherapy or brachytherapy.
completion: WITH DX1 AS (SELECT MRN1, NAME, DX_DATE1, SITE_CODE1, SITE_DESC1, HIST_CODE1, HIST_DESC1 FROM (SELECT DISTINCT TM_MRN AS MRN1, STRIP(PT_LAST_NAME) || ', ' || STRIP(PT_FIRST_NAME) AS NAME, TM_DX_DTE AS DX_DATE1, TM_SITE_CD AS SITE_CODE1, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_DESC1, TM_HIST_CD AS HIST_CODE1, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS HIST_DESC1, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY TM_MRN ORDER BY TM_DX_DTE) AS RN FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.SEERGROUPING ON RECODE = IDB.SEERF_ICDO(TM_SITE_CD, TM_HIST_CD) JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON TM_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE 1=1 AND TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND CATEGORY2 IN ('Prostate') ) C1 WHERE RN = 1 ) , DX2A AS (SELECT DISTINCT TM_MRN AS MRN2, NAME, DX_DATE1, SITE_CODE1, SITE_DESC1, DX_DATE2, SITE_CODE2, SITE_DESC2 FROM (SELECT DISTINCT TM_MRN, NAME, DX_DATE1, SITE_CODE1, SITE_DESC1, TM_DX_DTE AS DX_DATE2, TM_SITE_CD AS SITE_CODE2, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_DESC2, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY TM_MRN ORDER BY TM_DX_DTE) AS RN FROM DX1 JOIN IDB.CDB_TUMOR ON TM_MRN = MRN1 AND TM_DX_DTE > DX_DATE1 JOIN IDB.SEERGROUPING ON RECODE = IDB.SEERF_ICDO(TM_SITE_CD, TM_HIST_CD) JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD WHERE 1=1 AND TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND CATEGORY3 IN ('Rectum and Rectosigmoid Junction') ) D1 WHERE RN = 1 ) , DX2 AS (SELECT DX2A.* FROM DX2A ) , RT1 AS (SELECT DISTINCT RTC_TX_MRN, NAME, DX_DATE1, SITE_CODE1, SITE_DESC1, DX_DATE2, SITE_CODE2, SITE_DESC2, RTC_TX_PLAN_NAME, RTC_PRIMARY_REF_POINT, RTC_TX_START_DTE, RTC_TX_STOP_DTE, RTC_TX_ELAPSED_DAYS, RTC_TX_PLANNED_FRACTIONS, RTC_TX_DELIVERED_FRACTIONS, RTC_TX_PLANNED_DOSE, RTC_TX_DELIVERED_DOSE, RTC_DOSE_CORRECTION FROM IDB.RADONC_TREATMENT_COURSE JOIN DX2 ON RTC_TX_MRN = MRN2 AND RTC_TX_START_DTE BETWEEN DX_DATE1 AND CURRENT DATE) , RT2 AS (SELECT HCV.MRN, NAME, DX_DATE1, SITE_CODE1, SITE_DESC1, DX_DATE2, SITE_CODE2, SITE_DESC2, SVC_DTE AS RT_DATE, RAD_TYPE AS RT_TYPE, RAD_SVC_DESC AS RT_DESC FROM DX2 JOIN IDB.HOSPITAL_CHARGES_V HCV ON DX2.MRN2 = HCV.MRN JOIN IDB.RADIATION_TYPES ON SVC_CD = RAD_SVC_CD WHERE 1=1 AND SVC_DTE BETWEEN DX_DATE1 AND CURRENT DATE AND(UPPER(RAD_TYPE) LIKE '%BRACHY%' OR UPPER(RAD_SVC_DESC) LIKE '%BRACHY%' OR UPPER(SVC_DESC) LIKE '%BRACHY%' OR UPPER(DPT_DESC) LIKE '%BRACHY%' OR UPPER(RAD_TYPE) LIKE '%HDR%' OR UPPER(RAD_SVC_DESC) LIKE '%HDR%' OR UPPER(SVC_DESC) LIKE '%HDR%' OR UPPER(DPT_DESC) LIKE '%HDR%' OR UPPER(RAD_TYPE) LIKE '%LDR%' OR UPPER(RAD_SVC_DESC) LIKE '%LDR%' OR UPPER(SVC_DESC) LIKE '%LDR%' OR UPPER(DPT_DESC) LIKE '%LDR%') ) , X AS (SELECT COALESCE(RTC_TX_MRN, MRN) AS MRN, RT_DATE, RT_TYPE, RT_DESC, RTC_TX_PLAN_NAME, RTC_PRIMARY_REF_POINT, RTC_TX_START_DTE, RTC_TX_STOP_DTE, RTC_TX_ELAPSED_DAYS, RTC_TX_PLANNED_FRACTIONS, RTC_TX_DELIVERED_FRACTIONS, RTC_TX_PLANNED_DOSE, RTC_TX_DELIVERED_DOSE, RTC_DOSE_CORRECTION FROM RT2 FULL JOIN RT1 ON RT2.MRN = RT1.RTC_TX_MRN) SELECT DISTINCT X.MRN, NAME, DX_DATE1, SITE_CODE1, SITE_DESC1, DX_DATE2, SITE_CODE2, SITE_DESC2, RT_DATE, RT_TYPE, RT_DESC, RTC_TX_PLAN_NAME, RTC_PRIMARY_REF_POINT, RTC_TX_START_DTE, RTC_TX_STOP_DTE, RTC_TX_ELAPSED_DAYS, RTC_TX_PLANNED_FRACTIONS, RTC_TX_DELIVERED_FRACTIONS, RTC_TX_PLANNED_DOSE, RTC_TX_DELIVERED_DOSE, RTC_DOSE_CORRECTION FROM X JOIN DX2 ON X.MRN = DX2.MRN2

prompt: Provide a report of abdominal MRIs, including demographic, visit data..
completion: SELECT CPE_MRN AS "MRN", PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH AS "Date of Birth", PT_DATE_OF_DEATH AS "Date of Death", PLA_LST_CON_DTE AS "Last Contact Date", PLA_LST_ACTV_DTE AS "Last Activity Date", CPE_ENC_DTE AS "Date of Abdominal or Liver MRI", CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME AS "MRI Visit Type Name", CLD_DEPT_NAME AS "MRI Department Name", CRE_RES_NAME AS "MRI Resource Name" FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON CPE_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY ON CPE_MRN = PLA_MRN AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN '2020-01-01'AND '2020-02-01' AND (YEAR(CPE_ENC_DTE)-YEAR(PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH))<21 AND CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CVT_EXT_NAME LIKE '%MRI%' AND (CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME LIKE '%ABDOMEN%' OR CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME LIKE'%LIVER%' OR CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME LIKE '%PELVIS%')

prompt: Provide a report on Parotid head and neck patients.
completion: WITH X AS (SELECT DISTINCT SSE_MRN AS MRN, PT_SEX, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, PT_DATE_OF_DEATH, COALESCE(MAX(PLA_LST_APPT_DTE, PLA_LST_DSCH_DTE), PLA_LST_APPT_DTE, PLA_LST_DSCH_DTE) AS LAST_FU_DATE, SSP_LOG_ID, SSE_SURG_DTE, SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD, SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC, SSP_SURG_LAST_NM, SSP_SURG_FIRST_NM, SSP_SURG_SVC_CD, DATE(SAE_TOX_OCCR_DT) AS COMP_DATE, SAE_TOXICITY_NAME AS COMP_NAME, SAE_TOX_GRADE AS COMP_GRADE, SAE_TOX_GRADE_NAME AS COMP_CRITERIA FROM IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE ON SSE_LOG_ID = SSP_LOG_ID JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON SSE_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY ON PT_MRN = PLA_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.SRG_ADVERSE_EVENT ON SSE_LOG_ID = SAE_SURG_LOG_ID AND SAE_PROC_SEQ_NO = SSP_PROC_SEQ_NO AND SAE_TOX_GRADE > '0' WHERE SSP_LOG_ID IN (SELECT SSE_LOG_ID FROM IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE ON SSE_LOG_ID = SSP_LOG_ID WHERE SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD IN ('42410', '42415', '42420', '42425', '42426') AND SSE_SURG_DTE BETWEEN '2010-01-01' AND '2019-07-01') ) , TM AS (SELECT DISTINCT TM_MRN, TM_DX_DTE AS DX_DATE, TM_HIST_CD AS HIST_CODE, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS HIST_DESC, TM_SITE_CD AS SITE_CODE, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_DESC, CASE WHEN TM_AJCC_7 NOT IN ('', '888', '999') THEN AJCC7.AV_DESC WHEN TM_AJCC NOT IN ('', '88', '99') THEN AJCC.AV_DESC WHEN TM_GENERAL_STG NOT IN ('', '9') THEN GS.AV_DESC WHEN TM_PATH_STG_GRP NOT IN ('', '88', '9', '99') THEN TM_PATH_STG_GRP ELSE CLIN.AV_DESC END AS STAGE, TM_CLIN_TNM_T, TM_CLIN_TNM_N, TM_CLIN_TNM_M, TM_PATH_TNM_T, TM_PATH_TNM_N, TM_PATH_TNM_M FROM X JOIN IDB.CDB_TUMOR ON TM_MRN = MRN JOIN IDB.CLM H ON TM_HIST_CD = H.CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON TM_SITE_CD = S.CLM_CLSF_CD LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS AJCC7 ON AJCC7.AV_ELEMENT = 'AJCC_7' AND AJCC7.AV_CODE = TM_AJCC_7 LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS AJCC ON AJCC.AV_ELEMENT = 'AJCC' AND AJCC.AV_CODE = TM_AJCC LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS GS ON GS.AV_ELEMENT = 'GENERAL_STG' AND GS.AV_CODE = TM_GENERAL_STG LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS CLIN ON CLIN.AV_ELEMENT = 'CLIN_STG_DSCR' AND CLIN.AV_CODE = TM_CLIN_STG_DSCR WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('3', '6', '7', '8') ) , CHEMO AS (SELECT DISTINCT APR_MRN, APR_DRUG_NAME, APR_START_DTE, APR_END_DTE, APR_ORD_RX_TYPE, APR_ORDER_SOURCE, APR_ORDER_SOURCE_ID FROM X JOIN IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX ON APR_MRN = MRN AND APR_START_DTE >= SSE_SURG_DTE JOIN IDB.CHEMO_DRUG_GENERIC ON APR_GENERIC_NAME = CDG_GENERIC_NAME WHERE CDG_CHEMO_FLAG = 'Y' ) , RT AS (SELECT DISTINCT RTC_TX_MRN, RTC_TX_PLAN_NAME, RTC_PRIMARY_REF_POINT, RTC_TX_START_DTE, RTC_TX_STOP_DTE, RTC_TX_ELAPSED_DAYS, RTC_TX_PLANNED_FRACTIONS, RTC_TX_DELIVERED_FRACTIONS, RTC_TX_PLANNED_DOSE, RTC_TX_DELIVERED_DOSE, RTC_DOSE_CORRECTION FROM X JOIN IDB.RADONC_TREATMENT_COURSE ON RTC_TX_MRN = MRN AND RTC_TX_START_DTE >= SSE_SURG_DTE)

prompt: Number of new DLBCL patients seen at MSK (main hospital and regionals) in a year. No PHI
completion: WITH DX AS (SELECT CC_MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS MIN_ICD9_EFF_DTE FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE SUBSTR(CC_CLSF_CD, 1, 5) IN ('C83.3') AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND (CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) GROUP BY CC_MRN HAVING MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) BETWEEN '2018-01-01' AND '2019-01-01') SELECT CASE WHEN CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_1 = '' THEN 'Manhattan' ELSE CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_1 END "Reg vs Man", CLD_CLD_CENTER "Center", COUNT(DISTINCT CPE_MRN) "Patient Count" FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID JOIN DX ON CPE_MRN = CC_MRN WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN '2018-01-01' AND '2019-01-01' AND (CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR LIKE '%NV%' OR CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR LIKE '%IR%') GROUP BY ROLLUP (CASE WHEN CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_1 = '' THEN 'Manhattan' ELSE CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_1 END, CLD_CLD_CENTER) ; WITH DX AS (SELECT CC_MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS MIN_ICD9_EFF_DTE FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE SUBSTR(CC_CLSF_CD, 1, 5) IN ('C83.3') AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND (CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) GROUP BY CC_MRN HAVING MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) BETWEEN '2018-01-01' AND '2019-01-01') SELECT PT_SEX "Gender", COUNT(DISTINCT CPE_MRN) "Patient Count" FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID JOIN DX ON CPE_MRN = CC_MRN JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON CPE_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN '2018-01-01' AND '2019-01-01' AND (CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR LIKE '%NV%' OR CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR LIKE '%IR%') GROUP BY ROLLUP (PT_SEX) ; WITH DX AS (SELECT CC_MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS MIN_ICD9_EFF_DTE FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE SUBSTR(CC_CLSF_CD, 1, 5) IN ('C83.3') AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND (CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) GROUP BY CC_MRN HAVING MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) BETWEEN '2018-01-01' AND '2019-01-01') SELECT RACE.AV_DESC "Race", COUNT(DISTINCT CPE_MRN) "Patient Count" FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID JOIN DX ON CPE_MRN = CC_MRN JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON CPE_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS RACE ON PT_RACE = RACE.AV_CODE AND RACE.AV_ELEMENT = 'RACE' WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN '2018-01-01' AND '2019-01-01' AND (CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR LIKE '%NV%' OR CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR LIKE '%IR%') GROUP BY ROLLUP (RACE.AV_DESC) ; WITH DX AS (SELECT CC_MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS MIN_ICD9_EFF_DTE FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE SUBSTR(CC_CLSF_CD, 1, 5) IN ('C83.3') AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND (CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) GROUP BY CC_MRN HAVING MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) BETWEEN '2018-01-01' AND '2019-01-01') SELECT ETHNICITY.AV_DESC "Ethnicity", COUNT(DISTINCT CPE_MRN) "Patient Count" FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID JOIN DX ON CPE_MRN = CC_MRN JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON CPE_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS ETHNICITY ON PT_PT_ETHNICITY = ETHNICITY.AV_CODE AND ETHNICITY.AV_ELEMENT = 'PT_ETHNICITY' WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN '2018-01-01' AND '2019-01-01' AND (CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR LIKE '%NV%' OR CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR LIKE '%IR%') GROUP BY ROLLUP (ETHNICITY.AV_DESC)

prompt: Pancreas patients who had a new visit  from 1/1/15 - present  with any HPB or GI medicine physician but did not have chemotherapy or surgery.
completion: WITH "cte1" AS (SELECT * FROM DV.ENCOUNTER_SCHD_RESOURCES WHERE ENSR_PRIMARY_RES_IND = 'Y' ) , "cte2" AS (SELECT EDC_DEPT_DESC, EDC_DEPT_ABBREV FROM DV.ENCOUNTER_DESC_CATALOG WHERE EDC_GROUP_ID = '8' ) , "cte3" AS (SELECT EDC_DEPT_ABBREV, EDC_DEPT_DESC FROM DV.ENCOUNTER_DESC_CATALOG WHERE EDC_GROUP_ID = 'STS' ) , "cte4" AS (SELECT DXCC_DX_CATALOG_ID, LTRIM(RTRIM(DXCC_ICD_CODE)) DXCC_ICD_CODE, LTRIM(RTRIM(DXCC_ICD_MSK_DESC)) DXCC_ICD_MSK_DESC, LTRIM(RTRIM(DXCC_ICD_CODE)) || ' - ' || LTRIM(RTRIM(DXCC_ICD_MSK_DESC)) AS DXCC_CODE_AND_MSK_DESC, LTRIM(RTRIM(DXCC_ICD_NATIONAL_DESC)) DXCC_ICD_NATIONAL_DESC, DXCC_DESC_LONG, CASE WHEN (DXCC_DX_TYPE = 'ICD9' AND DXCC_ICD_CODE BETWEEN '196' AND '198.99') OR (DXCC_DX_TYPE = 'ICD10' AND DXCC_ICD_CODE BETWEEN 'C77' AND 'C79.9') THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS DXCC_METS_INDICATOR, DXCC_CREATED_DT, DXCC_CREATED_BY, DXCC_MODIFIED_DT FROM DV.DIAGNOSIS_CATALOG WHERE DXCC_DX_TYPE IN ('ICD9', 'ICD10') ) SELECT DISTINCT "t1"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AS "Deident PT #", "t2"."ENR_RES_NAME" AS "Primary Resource Name", "t3"."PT_LAST_NAME" AS "Last Name", "t3"."PT_MRN" AS "MRN", "t4"."EDC_DEPT_DESC" AS "Clinical Service Desc (Group 8)", CASE WHEN "t5"."ENVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR" like '%NV%' THEN 'New Visit' WHEN "t5"."ENVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR" like '%IR%' THEN 'Internal Referral' ELSE 'Non-New Visit/Interal Referral' END AS "New Visit/Internal Referral Indicator", "t6"."PLA_LAST_SURG_DTE" AS "Last MSK Surgery Date", "t6"."PLA_LAST_CHEMO_DTE" AS "Last MSK Chemo Date", "t7"."DT_DTE" AS "Encounter Date", "t8"."ENDP_SERVICE_SPECIALTY_GRP_8" AS "Clinical Service (Group 8)", "t3"."PT_FIRST_NAME" AS "First Name", ENSR_ENC_CSN_ID AS CSN FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED" "t1" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_ENCOUNTER" "t11" ON "t1"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t11"."PENC_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "cte1" "t12" ON "t11"."PENC_PT_ENC_ID" = "t12"."ENSR_PT_ENC_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."ENCOUNTER_RESOURCE" "t2" ON "t12"."ENSR_RES_ID" = "t2"."ENR_ENC_RES_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."ENCOUNTER_DEPARTMENT" "t13" ON "t12"."ENSR_DEPT_ID" = "t13"."ENDP_ENC_DEPT_ID" LEFT JOIN "cte2" "t4" ON "t13"."ENDP_SERVICE_SPECIALTY_GRP_8" = "t4"."EDC_DEPT_ABBREV" LEFT JOIN "DV"."ENCOUNTER_VISIT_TYPE" "t5" ON "t11"."PENC_VISIT_TYPE_ID" = "t5"."ENVT_ENC_VISIT_TYPE_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" "t7" ON "t11"."PENC_ENC_DATE_ID" = "t7"."DT_DATE_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."ENCOUNTER_DEPARTMENT" "t8" ON "t11"."PENC_DEPT_ID" = "t8"."ENDP_ENC_DEPT_ID" LEFT JOIN "cte3" "t14" ON "t11"."PENC_APPT_STS" = "t14"."EDC_DEPT_ABBREV" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V" "t3" ON "t1"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t3"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_LATEST_ACTIVITY" "t6" ON "t3"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t6"."PLA_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DIAGNOSIS_FINAL_ALL_V" "t15" ON "t1"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t15"."PDX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DIAGNOSIS_FINAL_DATES_V" "t16" ON "t15"."PDX_DX_CATALOG_ID" = "t16"."PDX_DX_CATALOG_ID" AND "t15"."PDX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t16"."PDX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" "t9" ON "t16"."FIRST_DIAGNOSIS_DATE_ID" = "t9"."DT_DATE_ID" LEFT JOIN "cte4" "t10" ON "t15"."PDX_DX_CATALOG_ID" = "t10"."DXCC_DX_CATALOG_ID" WHERE ("t8"."ENDP_SERVICE_DEPT_GRP_6" IN ('MED', 'SRG') AND ("t8"."ENDP_SERVICE_SPECIALTY_GRP_8" IN ('GI', 'HEP') AND (CASE WHEN "t14"."EDC_DEPT_DESC"IN ('Arrived', 'Completed') THEN 'Completed' WHEN "t14"."EDC_DEPT_DESC" IN ('Scheduled') THEN 'Scheduled' ELSE 'Non-Completed/Scheduled' END = 'Completed' AND ("t2"."ENR_RES_TYP" IN ('PhD', 'Physician') AND ("t7"."DT_DTE" BETWEEN (DATE(CURRENT DATE) - DAY(DATE(CURRENT DATE)) DAYS + 1 DAY) - (MONTH(CURRENT DATE) - (((QUARTER(CURRENT DATE)-2)*3)+1)) MONTHS AND (((DATE(CURRENT DATE) - DAY(DATE(CURRENT DATE)) DAYS + 1 DAY) - (MONTH(CURRENT DATE) - (((QUARTER(CURRENT DATE)-2)*3)+1)) MONTHS) + 3 MONTHS) - 1 DAY AND (CASE WHEN "t5"."ENVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR" like '%NV%' THEN 'New Visit' WHEN "t5"."ENVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR" like '%IR%' THEN 'Internal Referral' ELSE 'Non-New Visit/Interal Referral' END IN ('Internal Referral', 'New Visit') AND ("t10"."DXCC_ICD_CODE" IN ('157', '157.0', '157.1', '157.2', '157.3', '157.4', '157.8', '157.9', 'C25.0', 'C25.1', 'C25.2', 'C25.3', 'C25.4', 'C25.7', 'C25.8', 'C25.9') AND "t15"."DXA_CIC_CDER_INIT" = 'YES')))))))

prompt: A list of patients scheduled for chemo at 53rd street the next day.

prompt:
List of pathology reports for:

DLBCL excisional biopsy cases from 2014 onward

FL excisional biopsy cases from 2014 onward
completion: SELECT PT_MRN AS "MRN", PT_LAST_NAME AS "Last Name", PT_FIRST_NAME AS "First Name", PT_BIRTH_DTE AS "DOB", PRPT_ACCESSION_NO AS "Path Accession Number", PRPT_REPORT AS "Path Report" FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT JOIN DV.DATE R ON R.DT_DATE_ID = PRPT_REPORT_DATE_ID JOIN DV.PATH_RPRT_TYPE_LOOKUP ON PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_CD = PRPT_REPORT_TYPE JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON PRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID WHERE (CONTAINS("PRPT_REPORT", '("DLBCL")') = 1 OR CONTAINS("PRPT_REPORT", '("Diffuse large b cell lymphoma")') = 1) AND CONTAINS("PRPT_REPORT", '("excision")') = 1 AND R.DT_DTE >= '2014-01-01' AND PRPT_REPORT IS NOT NULL AND (PRPT_ACCESSION_NO like 'H%' OR PRPT_ACCESSION_NO like 'S%') AND (PRPT_REPORT_TYPE like '%_R' OR PRPT_REPORT_TYPE like '%_HR') ; SELECT PT_MRN AS "MRN", PT_LAST_NAME AS "Last Name", PT_FIRST_NAME AS "First Name", PT_BIRTH_DTE AS "DOB", PRPT_ACCESSION_NO AS "Path Accession Number", PRPT_REPORT AS "Path Report" FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT JOIN DV.DATE R ON R.DT_DATE_ID = PRPT_REPORT_DATE_ID JOIN DV.PATH_RPRT_TYPE_LOOKUP ON PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_CD = PRPT_REPORT_TYPE JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON PRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID WHERE (CONTAINS("PRPT_REPORT", '("FL")') = 1 OR CONTAINS("PRPT_REPORT", '("follicular lymphoma")') = 1) AND CONTAINS("PRPT_REPORT", '("excision")') = 1 AND R.DT_DTE >= '2014-01-01' AND PRPT_REPORT IS NOT NULL AND (PRPT_ACCESSION_NO like 'H%' OR PRPT_ACCESSION_NO like 'S%') AND (PRPT_REPORT_TYPE like '%_R' OR PRPT_REPORT_TYPE like '%_HR') ;

prompt: Weekly report for upcoming SARCOMA 53-5 patients with current and prior GMT 53-5 appt
completion: WITH SARCOMA AS (SELECT CPE_MRN AS "MRN", CPE_ENC_DTE AS "Appt Date", CLD_DEPT_NAME AS "Department Name", CRE_RES_NAME AS "Provider Name", CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME AS "Visit Type" FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Sch') AND CPE_ENC_DTE = CURRENT date + 1 DAY AND CLD_DEPT_ID IN ('778') ) , GMT AS (SELECT CPE_MRN AS "MRN", CPE_ENC_DTE AS "Prior GMT Appt Date", CRE_RES_NAME AS "Prior GMT Provider Name", ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY CPE_MRN ORDER BY CPE_ENC_DTE DESC) RANK FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CLD_DEPT_ID IN ('1008') ) , GMT2 AS (SELECT CPE_MRN, CPE_ENC_DTE, CRE_RES_NAME, CLD_DEPT_NAME FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Sch') AND CPE_ENC_DTE = CURRENT date + 1 DAY AND CLD_DEPT_ID IN ('1008') ) SELECT A.*, C.CPE_ENC_DTE "Sched GMT Appt Date", C.CRE_RES_NAME "Sched GMT Appt Provider", C.CLD_DEPT_NAME "Sched GMT Dept", B."Prior GMT Appt Date", B."Prior GMT Provider Name" FROM SARCOMA A LEFT JOIN GMT B ON A."MRN" = B."MRN" AND B.RANK = 1 LEFT JOIN GMT2 C ON A."MRN" = C.CPE_MRN AND A."Appt Date" = C.CPE_ENC_DTE ;

prompt: Provide diagnosis and survival information for patients who provided tissue samples
completion: WITH PTS AS (SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_DEATH_IND FROM IDB.PATIENT LEFT JOIN IDB.ACCRUALS_DATES ON PT_MRN = ACD_MRN WHERE PT_MRN IN ('03529926', '35276261', '35305435', '35370547', '35405969', '35464547', '35465513', '35466338', '35512147', '35578311', '35363061', '35375296', '35577128', '35009999', '35206917', '38016493', '35590129', '38044022', '35249926', '38039472') AND ACD_IRB_NO IN ('02-060', '97-094', '06-107', '09-141') AND ACD_CONS_DTE IS NOT NULL ) SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN MRN, PT_LAST_NAME LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME FIRST_NAME, CASE WHEN PT_DEATH_IND IN ('X', 'C', 'D') THEN 'Deceased' ELSE 'Alive' END VITAL_STATUS, COALESCE(CHAR(TM_DX_DTE), 'Needs chart review') TM_DX_DTE, COALESCE(TM_SITE_CD, 'Needs chart review') AS SITE_CODE, COALESCE(S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK, 'Needs chart review') AS SITE_DESC, COALESCE(TM_HIST_CD, 'Needs chart review') AS HIST_CODE, COALESCE(H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK, 'Needs chart review') AS HIST_DESC, CASE WHEN PLA_LST_CHEMO_DTE IS NOT NULL THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'Needs chart review' END CHEMO, PLA_LST_CON_DTE LAST_CONTACT_DATE FROM PTS LEFT JOIN IDB.CDB_TUMOR ON PT_MRN = TM_MRN AND TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7') AND TM_HIST_CD NOT IN ('M8340/3') LEFT JOIN IDB.CLM H ON TM_HIST_CD = H.CLM_CLSF_CD LEFT JOIN IDB.CLM S ON TM_SITE_CD = S.CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY ON PT_MRN = PLA_MRN

CPX_PROC_ID JOIN IDB.OR_LOG_ALL_SURG ON OLAS_LOG_ID = OLAP_LOG_ID AND OLAS_PNL_NO = OLAP_PNL_NO AND OLAS_SURG_SVC = OL_LOG_SVC JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY PTACT ON PTACT.PLA_MRN = OL_MRN AND PTACT.PLA_DECEASED_IND <> 'Y' JOIN IDB.VISIT ON VIS_MRN = OL_MRN AND VIS_ADM_DTE <= OL_SURG_DTE AND VIS_VISIT_STATUS IN ('2', '3') AND VIS_IP_OP_ADJUSTED_IND = 'I' AND (VIS_DSCH_DTE >= OL_SURG_DTE OR VIS_DSCH_DTE IS NULL) LEFT JOIN IDB.CTC_ENCODER ON VIS_ADM_NUM = SUBSTR(CE_ENCODER_CTC_VISIT_NO, 2, 8) AND VIS_MRN = CE_ENCODER_MRN AND CE_ENCODER_GRPR_CD = '0' LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE AS RESOURCE ON OLAS_RES_ID = RESOURCE.CRE_RES_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE AS ROOM ON ROOM.CRE_RES_ID = OL_ROOM_RES_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.DOC ON OLAS_RES_ID = DOC_DR_NO LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS A ON A.AV_ELEMENT = 'SVC' AND DOC_SVC = A.AV_CODE AND A.AV_CD_STS = 'A' WHERE OL_LOG_STS IN ('Complete', 'Posted', 'Unposted', 'Missing Info') AND OL_POSTOP_DEST = 'IP Unit' AND OL_SURG_LOC_ID=1000010 AND OL_LOG_SVC IN ('THO', 'HEP', 'HNS', 'GMT', 'BRE', 'PLA', 'GYN', 'URO') AND OLAS_SURG_ROLE_CD = '1' AND OL_SURG_DTE >= '2020-01-01' ) A WHERE RN = 1 ) , ICD AS (SELECT OCD_CASE_ID , MIN(CASE WHEN OCD_LINE_NO = 1 THEN CDX_ICD10 END) PRIMARY_ICD10 , MIN(CASE WHEN OCD_LINE_NO = 2 THEN CDX_ICD10 END) SECONDARY_ICD10_1 , MIN(CASE WHEN OCD_LINE_NO = 3 THEN CDX_ICD10 END) SECONDARY_ICD10_2 FROM (SELECT DISTINCT OCD_CASE_ID, OCD_LINE_NO, CDX_ICD10, CDX_DX_NAME FROM SURG JOIN IDB.OR_CASE_DX_CODES ON OCD_CASE_ID = EVENT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DX ON CDX_DX_ID = OCD_DX_ID) A GROUP BY OCD_CASE_ID) , BED AS (SELECT UC_MRN , UC_TRANSFER_DT , UC_BED , LOG_ID FROM (SELECT UC_MRN , TIMESTAMP(UC_TRANSFER_DTE, UC_TRANSFER_TME) UC_TRANSFER_DT , UC_BED , EVENT_ID AS LOG_ID , ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY UC_MRN ORDER BY UC_SEQ_NO DESC) AS RN FROM IDB.VISIT JOIN SURG ON VIS_MRN = MRN JOIN IDB.UNIFIED_CENSUS ON VIS_VISIT_ID = UC_VISIT_ID WHERE VIS_VISIT_STATUS IN ('2', '3') AND VIS_IP_OP_ADJUSTED_IND = 'I' AND VIS_ADM_DTE <= EVENT_DATE AND (VIS_DSCH_DTE >= EVENT_DATE OR VIS_DSCH_DTE IS NULL) ) A WHERE RN = 1 ) , PERIOP AS (SELECT CASE_NUMBER , TOES_OUT_TIME_ACTUAL , PERIOP_DEST FROM (SELECT CASE_NUMBER , TOES_OUT_TIME_ACTUAL , UC_BED AS PERIOP_DEST , ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY CASE_NUMBER ORDER BY UC_SEQ_NO ASC) AS RN FROM IDB.PERIOP_CASE_EVENT_V JOIN SURG ON CASE_NUMBER = EVENT_ID JOIN IDB.VISIT ON VIS_MRN = MRN AND VIS_IP_OP_ADJUSTED_IND = 'I' AND VIS_ADM_DTE <= EVENT_DATE AND (VIS_DSCH_DTE >= EVENT_DATE OR VIS_DSCH_DTE IS NULL) JOIN IDB.UNIFIED_CENSUS ON VIS_VISIT_ID = UC_VISIT_ID AND TIMESTAMP(UC_TRANSFER_DTE, UC_TRANSFER_TME) >= TOES_OUT_TIME_ACTUAL) A WHERE RN =1 ) , PATIENT AS (SELECT PT_MRN, PT_SEX, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, L.AV_DESC AS PRIM_LANG, CASE WHEN COALESCE(R.AV_DESC, CR.AV_DESC) IN ('WHITE', 'WHITE HISPANIC') THEN 'White' WHEN COALESCE(R.AV_DESC, CR.AV_DESC) IN ('BLACK OR AFRICAN AMERICAN', 'BLACK', 'BLACK HISPANIC') THEN 'Black' WHEN COALESCE(R.AV_DESC, CR.AV_DESC) IN ('ASIAN-FAR EAST/INDIAN SUBCONT', 'KAMPUCHEAN', 'LAOTIAN', 'VIETNAMESE', 'HMONG', 'CHINESE', 'ASIAN INDIAN PAKISTANI', 'JAPANESE', 'KOREAN', 'OTHER ASIAN', 'THAI') THEN 'Asian' WHEN COALESCE(R.AV_DESC, CR.AV_DESC) IN ('NATIVE AMERICAN-AM IND/ALASKA', 'AMER IND ALEUT ESKIMO') THEN 'Native American or Alaska Native' WHEN COALESCE(R.AV_DESC, CR.AV_DESC) IN ('NATIVE HAWAIIAN OR PACIFIC ISL', 'HAWAIIAN', 'MELANESIAN', 'MICRONESIAN', 'FIJI ISLANDER', 'FILIPINO', 'GUAMANIAN', 'PACIFIC ISLANDER') THEN 'Native Hawaiian or Other Pacific Islander' ELSE 'Unspecified' END AS PT_RACE, CASE WHEN COALESCE(CE.AV_DESC, E.AV_DESC) IN ('SPANISH NOS; HISPANIC NOS, LATINO NOS', 'HISPANIC OR LATINO', 'PUERTO RICAN', 'SOUTH/CENTRAL AMERICA (EXCEPT BRAZIL)', 'DOMINICAN REPUBLIC', 'OTHER SPANISH/HISPANIC(INCL EUROPEAN; EXCL DOM REP)', 'CUBAN', 'MEXICAN (INCLUDES CHICANO)') OR COALESCE(R.AV_DESC, CR.AV_DESC) IN ('WHITE HISPANIC', 'BLACK HISPANIC') THEN 'Hispanic' WHEN COALESCE(CE.AV_DESC, E.AV_DESC) IN ('NOT HISPANIC', 'SPANISH SURNAME ONLY', 'NON-SPANISH; NON-HISPANIC') THEN 'Non-Hispanic' ELSE 'Unspecified' END AS PT_ETHNICITY FROM IDB.PATIENT LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS R ON R.AV_ELEMENT = 'RACE' AND R.AV_CODE = PT_RACE LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS E ON E.AV_ELEMENT = 'PT_ETHNICITY' AND E.AV_CODE = PT_PT_ETHNICITY LEFT JOIN IDB.CDB_PATIENT ON PT_MRN = CP_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS CR ON CR.AV_ELEMENT = 'CDB_RACE' AND CR.AV_CODE = CP_CDB_RACE LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS CE ON CE.AV_ELEMENT = 'ETHNICITY' AND CE.AV_CODE = CP_ETHNICITY LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS L ON L.AV_ELEMENT = 'PRIMARY_LANG' AND L.AV_CODE = PT_PRIMARY_LANG) SELECT TRIM(EVENT_RESOURCE_ACADEMIC_SERVICE) "Service" , TRIM(EVENT_RESOURCE_ACADEMIC_DEPT) "Department" , EVENT_SURGICAL_SERVICE , TRIM(EVENT_ID) EVENT_ID , EVENT_DATE "Event_Date" , TRIM(MRN) MRN , TRIM(PT_LAST_NAME) || ', ' || TRIM(PT_FIRST_NAME) AS "Name" , TRIM(PT_SEX) "Sex" , TRIM(PT_RACE) "Race" , TRIM(PT_ETHNICITY) "Ethnicity" , TRIM(PRIM_LANG) AS "Primary Language" , PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH AS DOB , YEAR(EVENT_DATE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) AS "Age" , CMI , CASE WHEN EPI_PORTAL_USER_IND = 0 THEN NULL WHEN EPI_PORTAL_USER_IND = 1 AND EPI_PORTAL_STS_CHG_DT IS NULL THEN DATE('1900-01-01') WHEN EPI_PORTAL_USER_IND = 1 AND EPI_PORTAL_STS_CHG_DT > VIS_DSCH_DT THEN NULL WHEN (EPI_PORTAL_USER_IND = 1 AND EPI_PORTAL_STS_CHG_DT <= VIS_DSCH_DT) OR (EPI_PORTAL_USER_IND = 1 AND VIS_DSCH_DT IS NULL) THEN DATE(EPI_PORTAL_STS_CHG_DT) ELSE DATE('1900-01-01') END "Portal reg" , TRIM(UC_BED) AS "Bed POD1" , TRIM(EVENT_RESOURCE_NAME) AS "Surgeon" , PANEL_N , CPX_PROC_CD CPT , TRIM(CPE_CPE_APPT_STS) AS "Encounter" , TRIM(SURG_ROOM_DESC) "OR Location" , TOES_OUT_TIME_ACTUAL "OR Out Time" , TRIM(PERIOP_DEST) "Destination" , VIS_ADM_DT "Admission" , VIS_DSCH_DT "Discharge" , PRIMARY_ICD10 , SECONDARY_ICD10_1 , SECONDARY_ICD10_2 FROM SURG JOIN PATIENT ON MRN = PT_MRN JOIN PERIOP ON EVENT_ID = CASE_NUMBER LEFT JOIN BED ON EVENT_ID = LOG_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.EF_PATIENT_INFO ON MRN = EPI_MRN LEFT JOIN ICD ON EVENT_ID = OCD_CASE_ID

prompt: Provide a list of patients diagnosed with AML or APL who received intrathecal (IT) chemotherapy with Cytarabine, Methotrexate or Thiotepa.
completion: WITH AML AS (SELECT CC_MRN AS MRN FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND ((CC_PT_TYPE = 'I') OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) AND CC_CLSF_CD IN ('205.0', '205.00', '205.01', '205.02', 'C92.0', 'C92.00', 'C92.01', 'C92.02', 'C92.4', 'C92.40', 'C92.41', 'C92.42') UNION SELECT TM_MRN AS MRN FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM H ON TM_HIST_CD = H.CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON TM_SITE_CD = S.CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('3', '6', '7', '8') AND TM_HIST_CD IN ('M9840/3', 'M9861/3', 'M9865/3', 'M9866/3', 'M9867/3', 'M9869/3', 'M9871/3', 'M9872/3', 'M9873/3', 'M9874/3', 'M9895/3', 'M9896/3', 'M9897/3', 'M9910/3', 'M9911/3', 'M9920/3') ) SELECT DISTINCT APR_MRN, APR_DRUG_NAME, APR_GENERIC_NAME, APR_ROUTE, APR_START_DTE, APR_END_DTE, APR_ORD_RX_TYPE, APR_ORDER_SOURCE, APR_ORDER_SOURCE_ID FROM IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX JOIN IDB.CHEMO_DRUG_GENERIC ON APR_GENERIC_NAME = CDG_GENERIC_NAME WHERE APR_MRN IN (SELECT MRN FROM AML) AND(UPPER(APR_DRUG_NAME) LIKE '%CYTARABINE%' OR UPPER(APR_DRUG_NAME) LIKE '%METHOTREXATE%' OR UPPER(APR_DRUG_NAME) LIKE '%THIOTEPA%' OR UPPER(APR_GENERIC_NAME) LIKE '%CYTARABINE%' OR UPPER(APR_GENERIC_NAME) LIKE '%METHOTREXATE%' OR UPPER(APR_GENERIC_NAME) LIKE '%THIOTEPA%') AND APR_ROUTE IN ('intraommaya', 'intrathecal', 'IO', 'IT')

prompt: Review patients in the last year, who both had thyroid surgery and saw the Endocrinology Department.
completion: WITH SRG AS (SELECT SSE_MRN, SSE_SURG_DTE, SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD, SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC, SSP_SURG_LAST_NM, SSP_SURG_FIRST_NM, SSP_SURG_SVC_CD FROM IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE ON SSE_LOG_ID = SSP_LOG_ID AND SSE_ENC_CSN_ID = SSP_ENC_CSN_ID WHERE SSE_SURG_DTE BETWEEN '2019-10-01' AND '2020-10-01' AND SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD IN ('60210', '60220', '60225', '60240', '60252', '60254', '60260', '60271') ) , ORDERS AS (SELECT DISTINCT OO_MRN, SSE_SURG_DTE, SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD, SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC, SSP_SURG_LAST_NM, SSP_SURG_FIRST_NM, SSP_SURG_SVC_CD, OOC_ITEM_NAME, MIN(OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE) OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE FROM IDB.OMS_ORDER JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_CATALOG ON OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID = OOC_MSTR_ITEM_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_STATUS ON OO_ORD_STS_CD = OSTS_ORD_STS_CD JOIN SRG ON SSE_MRN = OO_MRN AND OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE >= SSE_SURG_DTE WHERE OOC_ITEM_NAME IN ('Endocrine Outpatient Consult', 'Endocrine Outpatient Follow Up Visit') AND OO_ORD_STS_CD NOT IN ('CANP', 'CANC', 'AUC3') GROUP BY OO_MRN, SSE_SURG_DTE, SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD, SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC, SSP_SURG_LAST_NM, SSP_SURG_FIRST_NM, SSP_SURG_SVC_CD, OOC_ITEM_NAME) SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN "MRN", SSE_SURG_DTE "Surgery Date", SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD "CPT Code", SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC "CPT Description", TRIM(SSP_SURG_LAST_NM) || ', ' || TRIM(SSP_SURG_FIRST_NM) "Surgeon", SSP_SURG_SVC_CD "Service", OOC_ITEM_NAME "Order Name", OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE "Order Date", CPE_ENC_DTE "Appt Date", CLD_DEPT_NAME "Department Name", CRE_RES_NAME "Provider Name", CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME "Visit Type" FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID JOIN ORDERS ON OO_MRN = CPE_MRN AND CPE_ENC_DTE >= SSE_SURG_DTE WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME IN ('ENDO IR', 'TELEHEALTH IR', 'PHONE IR') ORDER BY 1 ; WITH SRG AS (SELECT SSE_MRN, SSE_SURG_DTE, SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD, SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC, SSP_SURG_LAST_NM, SSP_SURG_FIRST_NM, SSP_SURG_SVC_CD FROM IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE ON SSE_LOG_ID = SSP_LOG_ID AND SSE_ENC_CSN_ID = SSP_ENC_CSN_ID WHERE SSE_SURG_DTE BETWEEN '2019-10-01' AND '2020-10-01' AND SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD IN ('60210', '60220', '60225', '60240', '60252', '60254', '60260', '60271') ) SELECT DISTINCT OO_MRN "MRN", SSE_SURG_DTE "Surgery Date", SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD "CPT Code", SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC "CPT Description", TRIM(SSP_SURG_LAST_NM) || ', ' || TRIM(SSP_SURG_FIRST_NM) "Surgeon", SSP_SURG_SVC_CD "Service", OOC_ITEM_NAME "Order Name", MAX(OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE) "Order Date" FROM IDB.OMS_ORDER JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_CATALOG ON OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID = OOC_MSTR_ITEM_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_STATUS ON OO_ORD_STS_CD = OSTS_ORD_STS_CD JOIN SRG ON SSE_MRN = OO_MRN AND OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE <= SSE_SURG_DTE WHERE OOC_ITEM_NAME IN ('Endocrine Outpatient Consult', 'Endocrine Outpatient Follow Up Visit') AND OO_ORD_STS_CD NOT IN ('CANP', 'CANC', 'AUC3') GROUP BY OO_MRN, SSE_SURG_DTE, SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD, SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC, TRIM(SSP_SURG_LAST_NM) || ', ' || TRIM(SSP_SURG_FIRST_NM), SSP_SURG_SVC_CD, OOC_ITEM_NAME ORDER BY 1

prompt: Create a report identifying all inpatients who have expired during the past year with either astrocytoma grade one brain tumors or benign brain tumors, neoplasms of cerebral meninges or neoplasms of cranial nerves.
completion: SELECT PT_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_DATE_OF_DEATH, CLM_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF INNER JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD INNER JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PT_MRN = CC_MRN INNER JOIN IDB.CASE ON CS_MRN = PT_MRN AND PT_DEATH_IND IN ('C', 'D') WHERE (CLM_CLSF_CD BETWEEN '191.0' AND '191.9' OR CLM_CLSF_CD IN ('225.0', '225.2', '225.1')) AND (PT_DATE_OF_DEATH BETWEEN CS_ADM_DATE AND CS_DSCH_DATE) AND (PT_DATE_OF_DEATH > CURRENT_DATE - 1 YEAR) AND ((CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y' AND CC_PT_TYPE = 'O') OR CC_PT_TYPE = 'I') AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'D%' GROUP BY PT_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_DATE_OF_DEATH, CLM_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK

prompt: Daily list of follow-up appointment dates for patients with pathology orders placed in CIS in the last 7 days
completion: WITH ETO AS (SELECT OO_MRN MRN, STRIP(PT_LAST_NAME)||', '||PT_FIRST_NAME PT_NAME, OO_ORD_GUID, OO_ORD_ID ORDID, OO_ENTER_DTE ORDER_ENTER_DATE, OO_ORD_STS_CD ORDSTATUS, OO_ORD_NAME ORDER_NAME , OO_ANCIL_REF_CD ACCESSION_NO, OO_REQ_TME_PRIO "Time Priority" , MAX(CASE WHEN OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'iPath_Location#_1' AND OUD_USER_DI_VALUE <> 'Location (Free Text)' THEN OUD_USER_DI_VALUE ELSE (CASE WHEN OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'iPath_Location_FreeText_1' THEN OUD_USER_DI_VALUE END) END) LOCATION, COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'iPath_Attending' THEN OUD_USER_DI_VALUE END), MAX(CASE WHEN OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'Approved By, Hematologist' THEN OUD_USER_DI_VALUE END)) ATTENDING, MAX(CASE WHEN OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'iPath_Procedure_1' THEN OUD_USER_DI_VALUE END) PROCEDURE_1, MAX(CASE WHEN OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'Requested For' THEN OUD_USER_DI_VALUE END) COLLECTION_DATE, MAX(CASE WHEN OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'RequestedTime' THEN OUD_USER_DI_VALUE END) TIME_PRIORITY, MAX(CASE WHEN OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'Specimen#2' THEN OUD_USER_DI_VALUE END) SPECIMEN, MAX(CASE WHEN OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'Site#1/Laterality' THEN OUD_USER_DI_VALUE END) SITE FROM IDB.OMS_ORDER JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PT_MRN = OO_MRN JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_USER_DATA ON OO_ORD_GUID = OUD_ORD_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_CATALOG ON OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID = OOC_MSTR_ITEM_GUID WHERE OO_ORD_TYPE_CD = 'Diagnostic' AND OO_ENTER_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT date - 7 DAY AND CURRENT date AND OOC_REV_CAT_DEPT = 'Pathology' AND OO_ORD_NAME IN ('Surgical Pathology' , 'Surgical Pathology Order') AND OO_ORD_STS_CD NOT IN ('CANC', 'CANP', 'AUC3', 'DISC') GROUP BY OO_MRN , STRIP(PT_LAST_NAME)||', '||PT_FIRST_NAME , OO_ORD_GUID, OO_ORD_ID , OO_ENTER_DTE , OO_ORD_STS_CD, OO_ORD_NAME , OO_REQ_TME_PRIO, OO_ANCIL_REF_CD) SELECT DISTINCT MRN, PT_NAME, ORDID, ORDER_ENTER_DATE, ORDER_NAME, ACCESSION_NO, LOCATION, ATTENDING, PROCEDURE_1, COLLECTION_DATE, TIME_PRIORITY, SPECIMEN, SITE, CPE_ENC_DTE "Follow Up Visit Date" , CLD_DEPT_NAME "Visit Department" , CRE_RES_NAME "Visit MD Name", CRE_RES_TYP "Occupation" , CVT_EXT_NAME "Visit Type" FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN ETO ON MRN = CPE_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID AND CRE_RES_TYP IN ('Physician', 'Dentist', 'Psychologist', 'PhD', 'Nurse Practitioner', 'Physician Assistant', 'Advanced Practice Nurse') JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Sch') AND (UPPER(CVT_EXT_NAME) like 'FOLLOW%UP%') OR CVT_EXT_NAME IN ('Joint Follow Up', 'Follow Up Consult') ;

prompt: Need a list of all MSK Sarcoma patients seen from 1/1/21-12/31/23 that we can sort by MD and catchment area
completion: WITH PTS AS (SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN MRN, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, TRIM(PT_ADDR1) || ', ' || TRIM(PT_ADDR2)|| ' ' || TRIM(PT_CITY)|| ' , ' || TRIM(PT_STATE) PT_ADDRESS, IIC_CATCHMENT, CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME, CRE_RES_NAME, CLD_DEPT_NAME, CLD_CLD_CENTER, CPE_ENC_DTE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CPE_MRN ORDER BY CPE_CHK_IN_DT DESC) RN FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON CPE_MRN=PT_MRN JOIN IDB.ZIPCODE ON LEFT(PT_ZIP_CD, 5) = ZC_ZIP LEFT JOIN IDB.ID_IP_IWT_CATCHMENT ON ZC_ZIP = IIC_ZIP_CD WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND PT_DATE_OF_DEATH IS NULL AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN '2021-01-01' AND '2023-12-31' AND CRE_RES_ID IN ('016071', '016642', '492008', '025346', '027862', '029868', '030023', '015818', '011957', '016550', '022715', '026617', '025023', '030445', '026625', '016378') ORDER BY 1, 5) , CHEMO AS (SELECT CHEMO_MRN, MAX_CHEMO_TX , CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME, APR_ROUTE, APR_SET_NAME, APR_ORD_RX_TYPE, CPO_LOC_GUID, COALESCE(CPO_LOC_NAME, CP_VISIT_LOC) AS LAST_TX_LOCATION , ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY APR_MRN ORDER BY UPPER(APR_ROUTE), CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME) CRN FROM (SELECT APR_MRN AS CHEMO_MRN, MAX(APR_START_DT) AS MAX_CHEMO_TX FROM IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX_V JOIN PTS ON MRN =APR_MRN AND RN=1 WHERE CDG_CHEMO_FLAG ='Y' AND CDG_DRUG_TYPE ='Antineoplastics' AND APR_DRUG_PROCESS_STAGE <> 'H' GROUP BY APR_MRN) CH JOIN IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX_V ON APR_MRN=CHEMO_MRN AND APR_START_DT = MAX_CHEMO_TX AND CDG_CHEMO_FLAG ='Y' AND CDG_DRUG_TYPE ='Antineoplastics' AND APR_DRUG_PROCESS_STAGE <> 'H' LEFT JOIN IDB.CHEMO_PERFORMED_ORDERS ON CPO_MRN=APR_MRN AND APR_ORDER_SOURCE ='CPO' AND APR_ORDER_SOURCE_ID = CPO_PERFORMED_ORDERS_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.CHEMO_PRESCRIPTIONS ON CP_MRN=APR_MRN AND APR_ORDER_SOURCE ='CRX' AND APR_ORDER_SOURCE_ID = CP_RX_ID) SELECT MRN, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, PT_ADDRESS, IIC_CATCHMENT AS CATCHMENT, CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME AS VISIT_NAME, CPE_ENC_DTE AS VISIT_DATE, CRE_RES_NAME AS PROVIDER, CLD_DEPT_NAME AS DEPT_NAME, MAX_CHEMO_TX AS LAST_CHEMO_TX, LAST_TX_LOCATION AS LAST_CHEMO_TX_LOCATION, CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME AS LAST_CHEMO_NAME, APR_ROUTE AS CHEMO_ROUTE, APR_SET_NAME AS CHEMO_SET_NAME FROM PTS LEFT JOIN CHEMO ON MRN=CHEMO_MRN AND CRN=1 WHERE RN=1

prompt:
Please provide a report that reflects the total number of inpatient physical therapy referrals generated. Seperate them by referring service, and then by the order title description (physical therapy, chest physical therapy, post op pulmonary program, lymphedema therapy). 

2. Please provide the same quarterly report for occupational therapy. 

I would like seperate reports starting with the last quarter of 2006, including an annual total also. Then, 2007 divided into quarters (1/1/07--3/31/07, 4/1/07--6/30/07). Please include an annual total column and a comparison to the 2006 quarterly and annual totals.
completion: SELECT COALESCE(PY_TYPE, CY_TYPE) AS SVC_TYPE , COALESCE(PY_SERVICE, CY_SERVICE) AS REFERRING_SERVICE , COALESCE(PY_ORDER_TITLE, CY_ORDER_TITLE) AS ORDER_TITLE , CASE WHEN PY_YEAR IS NOT NULL THEN PY_YEAR ELSE CY_YEAR - 1 END AS PY_YEAR , PY_Q1, PY_Q2, PY_H1, PY_Q3, PY_Q4, PY_H2, PY_AN , CASE WHEN CY_YEAR IS NOT NULL THEN CY_YEAR ELSE PY_YEAR + 1 END AS CY_YEAR , CY_Q1, CY_Q2, CY_H1, CY_Q3, CY_Q4, CY_H2, CY_AN , CASE WHEN PY_Q1>0 THEN ROUND(100*(COALESCE(CY_Q1, 0)-PY_Q1)/PY_Q1, 2) END Q1_CNG , CASE WHEN PY_Q2>0 THEN ROUND(100*(COALESCE(CY_Q2, 0)-PY_Q2)/PY_Q2, 2) END Q2_CNG , CASE WHEN PY_H1>0 THEN ROUND(100*(COALESCE(CY_H1, 0)-PY_H1)/PY_H1, 2) END H1_CNG , CASE WHEN PY_Q3>0 THEN ROUND(100*(COALESCE(CY_Q3, 0)-PY_Q3)/PY_Q3, 2) END Q3_CNG , CASE WHEN PY_Q4>0 THEN ROUND(100*(COALESCE(CY_Q4, 0)-PY_Q4)/PY_Q4, 2) END Q4_CNG , CASE WHEN PY_H2>0 THEN ROUND(100*(COALESCE(CY_H2, 0)-PY_H2)/PY_H2, 2) END H2_CNG , CASE WHEN PY_AN>0 THEN ROUND(100*(COALESCE(CY_AN, 0)-PY_AN)/PY_AN, 2) END AN_CNG FROM (SELECT PY_TYPE, PY_SERVICE, PY_ORDER_TITLE, PY_YEAR , SUM(CASE WHEN RPT_QTR = 'Q1' THEN 1 END) AS PY_Q1 , SUM(CASE WHEN RPT_QTR = 'Q2' AND MTH >= 6 THEN 1 END) AS PY_Q2 , SUM(CASE WHEN RPT_QTR = 'Q3' AND MTH >= 9 THEN 1 END) AS PY_Q3 , SUM(CASE WHEN RPT_QTR = 'Q4' AND MTH = 12 THEN 1 END) AS PY_Q4 , SUM(CASE WHEN RPT_HY = 'H1' AND MTH >= 6 THEN 1 END) AS PY_H1 , SUM(CASE WHEN RPT_HY = 'H2' AND MTH = 12 THEN 1 END) AS PY_H2 , SUM(CASE WHEN MTH = 12 THEN 1 END) AS PY_AN FROM (SELECT OO_ENTER_DTE, OO_MRN, OS_SVC_DESC AS PY_SERVICE , CASE WHEN UCASE(OO_ORD_NAME) LIKE '%PRESCRIPTION%' THEN 'P&O' WHEN UCASE(OO_ORD_NAME) LIKE '%OCCUPATIONAL%OUTPATIENT%' OR UCASE(OO_ORD_NAME) LIKE '%OUTPATIENT%OCCUPATIONAL%' THEN 'Outpatient OT' WHEN UCASE(OO_ORD_NAME) LIKE '%OCCUPATIONAL%' THEN 'OT' WHEN UCASE(OO_ORD_NAME) LIKE '%OUTPATIENT%' THEN 'Outpatient PT' ELSE 'PT' END AS PY_TYPE , OO_ORD_NAME AS PY_ORDER_TITLE , YEAR(OO_ENTER_DTE) AS PY_YEAR , MONTH(DATE(CURRENT_DATE-12 MONTHS - DAY(CURRENT_DATE) DAYS)) MTH , CASE WHEN MONTH(OO_ENTER_DTE) BETWEEN 1 AND 3 THEN 'Q1' WHEN MONTH(OO_ENTER_DTE) BETWEEN 4 AND 6 THEN 'Q2' WHEN MONTH(OO_ENTER_DTE) BETWEEN 7 AND 9 THEN 'Q3' ELSE 'Q4' END AS RPT_QTR , CASE WHEN MONTH(OO_ENTER_DTE) BETWEEN 1 AND 6 THEN 'H1' ELSE 'H2' END AS RPT_HY FROM IDB.OMS_ORDER JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_CATALOG ON OOC_MSTR_ITEM_GUID = OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_USER ON OO_PVDR_GUID = OU_USER_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_CLIENT_VISIT ON OCV_VISIT_GUID = OO_VISIT_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_SERVICE ON OCV_SVC_GUID = OS_SVC_GUID WHERE OO_ORD_STS_CD NOT IN ('AUC3', 'CANC', 'CANP', 'REJCT') AND UCASE(OOC_REV_CAT_DEPT) = 'REHABILITATION' AND OO_ENTER_DTE BETWEEN DATE(SUBSTR(CHAR(CURRENT_DATE), 1, 5)||'01-01')-12 MONTHS AND DATE(CURRENT_DATE-12 MONTHS - DAY(CURRENT_DATE) DAYS) ) AS ORDS GROUP BY PY_TYPE, PY_SERVICE, PY_ORDER_TITLE, PY_YEAR) AS PY FULL OUTER JOIN (SELECT CY_TYPE, CY_SERVICE, CY_ORDER_TITLE, CY_YEAR , SUM(CASE WHEN RPT_QTR = 'Q1' THEN 1 END) AS CY_Q1 , SUM(CASE WHEN RPT_QTR = 'Q2' AND MTH >= 6 THEN 1 END) AS CY_Q2 , SUM(CASE WHEN RPT_QTR = 'Q3' AND MTH >= 9 THEN 1 END) AS CY_Q3 , SUM(CASE WHEN RPT_QTR = 'Q4' AND MTH = 12 THEN 1 END) AS CY_Q4 , SUM(CASE WHEN RPT_HY = 'H1' AND MTH >= 6 THEN 1 END) AS CY_H1 , SUM(CASE WHEN RPT_HY = 'H2' AND MTH = 12 THEN 1 END) AS CY_H2 , SUM(CASE WHEN MTH = 12 THEN 1 END) AS CY_AN FROM (SELECT OO_ENTER_DTE, OO_MRN, OS_SVC_DESC AS CY_SERVICE , CASE WHEN UCASE(OO_ORD_NAME) LIKE '%PRESCRIPTION%' THEN 'P&O' WHEN UCASE(OO_ORD_NAME) LIKE '%OCCUPATIONAL%OUTPATIENT%' OR UCASE(OO_ORD_NAME) LIKE '%OUTPATIENT%OCCUPATIONAL%' THEN 'Outpatient OT' WHEN UCASE(OO_ORD_NAME) LIKE '%OCCUPATIONAL%' THEN 'OT' WHEN UCASE(OO_ORD_NAME) LIKE '%OUTPATIENT%' THEN 'Outpatient PT' ELSE 'PT' END AS CY_TYPE , OO_ORD_NAME AS CY_ORDER_TITLE , YEAR(OO_ENTER_DTE) AS CY_YEAR , MONTH(DATE(CURRENT_DATE - DAY(CURRENT_DATE) DAYS)) MTH , CASE WHEN MONTH(OO_ENTER_DTE) BETWEEN 1 AND 3 THEN 'Q1' WHEN MONTH(OO_ENTER_DTE) BETWEEN 4 AND 6 THEN 'Q2' WHEN MONTH(OO_ENTER_DTE) BETWEEN 7 AND 9 THEN 'Q3' ELSE 'Q4' END AS RPT_QTR , CASE WHEN MONTH(OO_ENTER_DTE) BETWEEN 1 AND 6 THEN 'H1' ELSE 'H2' END AS RPT_HY FROM IDB.OMS_ORDER JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_CATALOG ON OOC_MSTR_ITEM_GUID = OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_USER ON OO_PVDR_GUID = OU_USER_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_CLIENT_VISIT ON OCV_VISIT_GUID = OO_VISIT_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_SERVICE ON OCV_SVC_GUID = OS_SVC_GUID WHERE OO_ORD_STS_CD NOT IN ('AUC3', 'CANC', 'CANP', 'REJCT') AND UCASE(OOC_REV_CAT_DEPT) = 'REHABILITATION' AND OO_ENTER_DTE BETWEEN DATE(SUBSTR(CHAR(CURRENT_DATE), 1, 5)||'01-01') AND DATE(CURRENT_DATE - DAY(CURRENT_DATE) DAYS) ) AS ORDS GROUP BY CY_TYPE, CY_SERVICE, CY_ORDER_TITLE, CY_YEAR) AS CY ON CY_TYPE = PY_TYPE AND CY_SERVICE = PY_SERVICE AND CY_ORDER_TITLE = PY_ORDER_TITLE WHERE PY_Q1 IS NOT NULL OR PY_Q2 IS NOT NULL OR PY_Q3 IS NOT NULL OR PY_Q4 IS NOT NULL OR CY_Q1 IS NOT NULL OR CY_Q2 IS NOT NULL OR CY_Q3 IS NOT NULL OR CY_Q4 IS NOT NULL

prompt: Provide a monthly report of all AEs entered into the Clinical Trial Toxicity Log clindoc in xxxResearch folder in EMR under an Exercise Oncology Service IRB-approved protocol.
completion: SELECT "PROTOCOL#", "MRN", "NAME", "TOXICITY", "START DATE", "STOP DATE", "GRADE", "INTERVENTION", "ATTRIBUTION", "ENTERED BY", "ENTERED DATE", "COMMENTS" FROM (SELECT DISTINCT CRAE_IRB_NO "PROTOCOL#", PT_MRN "MRN", TRIM(PT_LAST_NAME)||', '||TRIM(PT_FIRST_NAME) "NAME", TRIM(CRTX_TOXICITY) "TOXICITY", CRAE_START_DTE "START DATE", CRAE_STOP_DTE "STOP DATE", CRAE_GRADE "GRADE", CRAE_INTERVENTION "INTERVENTION", CRAA_ATTRIBUTION "ATTRIBUTION", CRAE_ACTION_BY "ENTERED BY", (CRAE_CREATE_DT) "ENTERED DATE", CRAE_COMMENTS "COMMENTS", ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CRTX_TOXICITY, CRAE_IRB_NO, PT_MRN, CRAE_START_DTE ORDER BY CRAE_CREATE_DT DESC) RN FROM IDB.PATIENT P JOIN IDB.CLNR_ADVERSE_EVENT ON CRAE_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.CLNR_TOXICITY34 ON CRAE_VERSION = CRTX_VERSION AND CRAE_CTC_AE_IX = CRTX_CTC_AE_IX AND CRAE_GRADE = CRTX_GRADE JOIN IDB.CLNR_ADVERSE_ATTRIBUTION ON CRAA_MRN = CRAE_MRN AND CRAA_IRB_NO = CRAE_IRB_NO AND CRAA_ADVERSE_EVENT_NO = CRAE_ADVERSE_EVENT_NO AND CRAA_ADVERSE_EVENT_SEQ_NO = CRAE_ADVERSE_EVENT_SEQ_NO WHERE CRAE_IRB_NO IN ('18-534', '19-113', '19-126', '19-486', '20-130', '20-378, 21-101') AND CRAE_START_DTE BETWEEN FIRST_DAY (CURRENT date - 1 MONTH) AND LAST_DAY(CURRENT date - 1 MONTH) ORDER BY PT_MRN, CRAE_START_DTE, CRAE_STOP_DTE) A WHERE A.RN = 1

prompt: Provide a list of patients treated with immune-checkpoint inhibitors who developed pneumonitis and underwent sampling for pathology
completion: WITH ICI AS (SELECT DISTINCT APR_MRN, CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME, APR_GENERIC_NAME, APR_DRUG_NAME, APR_START_DTE, APR_END_DTE, APR_ORD_RX_TYPE FROM IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX_V WHERE CDG_IMMUNOTHERAPY_FLAG = 'Y' AND APR_START_DTE BETWEEN '2015-01-01' AND CURRENT DATE ) , ICI2 AS (SELECT APR_MRN, CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME, MIN(APR_START_DTE) AS APR_START_DTE, MAX(APR_END_DTE) AS APR_END_DTE FROM ICI GROUP BY APR_MRN, CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME) , ICI3 AS (SELECT APR_MRN AS MRN, LISTAGG(COALESCE(STRIP(CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME), '') || ' | ' || COALESCE(STRIP(CAST(APR_START_DTE AS VARCHAR(12000))), '') || ' | ' || COALESCE(STRIP(CAST(APR_END_DTE AS VARCHAR(12000))), '') , CHR(13) || CHR(10)) WITHIN GROUP( ORDER BY APR_MRN, APR_START_DTE, APR_END_DTE, CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME) AS IO FROM ICI2 GROUP BY APR_MRN) , ICI_MIN AS (SELECT APR_MRN, MIN(APR_START_DTE) AS START_DATE_INIT FROM ICI2 GROUP BY APR_MRN) , X AS (SELECT ICI3.*, START_DATE_INIT FROM ICI3 JOIN ICI_MIN ON ICI3.MRN = ICI_MIN.APR_MRN ) , PATH AS (SELECT DISTINCT X.*, "t2"."PRPT_ACCESSION_NO" AS "Pathology Report", "t3"."DT_DTE" AS "Pathology Procedure Date", "t4"."DT_DTE" AS "Pathology Report Date", "t5"."PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_DESC" AS "Pathology Report Type", UPPER(CASE WHEN LENGTH(PRPT_REPORT) <= 15000 THEN RTRIM(CAST(SUBSTR(PRPT_REPORT, 1, 15000) AS VARCHAR(15000))) ELSE CAST(SUBSTR(PRPT_REPORT, 1, 15000) AS VARCHAR(15000)) END) AS TXT FROM X LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V" "t1" ON "t1"."PT_MRN" = MRN LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED" "t6" ON "t1"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t6"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V" "t2" ON "t6"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t2"."PRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" "t3" ON "t2"."PRPT_PROCEDURE_DATE_ID" = "t3"."DT_DATE_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" "t4" ON "t2"."PRPT_REPORT_DATE_ID" = "t4"."DT_DATE_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATH_RPRT_TYPE_LOOKUP" "t5" ON "t2"."PRPT_REPORT_TYPE" = "t5"."PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_CD" WHERE 1=1 AND CONTAINS("t2"."PRPT_REPORT", '"lung"') = 1 AND "t2"."PRPT_REPORT" IS NOT NULL AND "t3"."DT_DTE" >= '2015-01-01' AND "t3"."DT_DTE" > START_DATE_INIT AND "t5"."PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_DESC" = 'Surgical Pathology' ) , P1 AS (SELECT P.*, DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)SPECIMENS SUBMITTED:[\w\W]*(?=DIAGNOSIS:)', TXT) AS SPECIMENS_SUBMITTED, POSITION('SPECIMENS SUBMITTED:', TXT, CODEUNITS32) AS POS_SPECIMENS_SUBMITTED, POSITION('DIAGNOSIS:', TXT, CODEUNITS32) AS POS_DIAGNOSIS FROM PATH P WHERE POSITION('DIAGNOSIS:', TXT, CODEUNITS32) > POSITION('SPECIMENS SUBMITTED:', TXT, CODEUNITS32) ) , P2 AS (SELECT P1.*, SUBSTR(SPECIMENS_SUBMITTED, 1, POS_DIAGNOSIS-POS_SPECIMENS_SUBMITTED) AS SPECIMENS_SUBMITTED2 FROM P1) , P3 AS (SELECT MRN, IO, START_DATE_INIT, "Pathology Report", "Pathology Procedure Date", "Pathology Report Date", "Pathology Report Type", SPECIMENS_SUBMITTED2 FROM P2 WHERE UPPER(SPECIMENS_SUBMITTED2) LIKE '%LUNG%' ) , P4 AS (SELECT P3.*, CDD_SERVICE_DTE, CDD_DOC_GUID, CDD_DOC_NAME, OU_OCCUPATION, OU_ORD_ROLE_TYPE, CDO_SECTION, CDO_CTLG_DISPL_NM, CDO_MSTR_ITEM_NM, CDO_ITEM_NAME, CDO_VALUE_TEXT, LOCATE('PNEUMONITIS', UPPER(CDO_VALUE_TEXT)) AS text, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CDD_MRN ORDER BY CDD_SERVICE_DTE) AS RN FROM P3 JOIN IDB.CD_DOCUMENT ON CDD_MRN = MRN AND CDD_SERVICE_DTE > START_DATE_INIT JOIN IDB.OMS_USER ON CDD_AUTH_PROV_GUID = OU_USER_GUID AND(OU_OCCUPATION IN ('PA', 'NP', 'NP/APN', 'RN, APN') OR OU_ORD_ROLE_TYPE IN ('Attending', 'Fellow', 'Housestaff', 'PhD')) JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION ON CDO_DOC_GUID = CDD_DOC_GUID AND CDO_AUTHORED_DTE = CDD_AUTHORED_DTE WHERE 1=1 AND CDD_CANCEL_IND = '0' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND = '0' AND UPPER(CDO_SECTION) = 'MEDICAL DECISION MAKING' AND LOCATE('PNEUMONITIS', UPPER(CDO_VALUE_TEXT)) > 0 ) SELECT * FROM P4 WHERE RN = 1

prompt: 22-042 Candidates - Patients with Simulation Order - Rad Onc ClinDoc notes and their upcoming appointments
completion: WITH PTS AS (SELECT DISTINCT CDD_MRN, CDD_SERVICE_DTE FROM IDB.CD_DOCUMENT JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION ON CDD_MRN = CDO_MRN AND CDD_DOC_GUID = CDO_DOC_GUID WHERE CDD_CANCEL_IND <> '1' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND <> '1' AND CDD_DOC_NAME = 'Simulation Order - Rad Onc' AND LOCATE('Isocenter 2', CDO_VALUE_TEXT) >= 1 AND CDD_SERVICE_DTE = CURRENT date - 1 DAYS ) SELECT CDD_MRN MRN, PT_LAST_NAME "Last Name", PT_FIRST_NAME "First Name", CDD_SERVICE_DTE "Simulation Order Service Date", CPE_ENC_DTE "Appt Date", CLD_DEPT_NAME "Department", CRE_RES_TYP "Resource Type", CRE_RES_NAME "Resource Name", CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME "Visit Type" FROM PTS JOIN IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER ON CDD_MRN = CPE_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON CDD_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Sch') AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 = 'RDO'

prompt: Provide a weekly list of patients scheduled for a cystectomy in the next 21 days.
completion: WITH SRG AS (SELECT OC_CASE_ID, STRIP(OC_MRN) AS MRN, STRIP(PT_LAST_NAME) || ', ' || STRIP(PT_FIRST_NAME) AS "PT Name", OC_SURG_DTE AS "Cystectomy Date", STRIP(CRE_RES_NAME) AS "Surgeon", STRIP(CPX_PROC_CD) AS "CPT Code", STRIP(CPX_PROC_NAME) AS "Procedure Name" FROM IDB.OR_CASE JOIN IDB.OR_CASE_ALL_PROC ON OC_CASE_ID = OCAP_CASE_ID JOIN IDB.OR_CASE_ALL_SURG ON OCAP_CASE_ID = OCAS_CASE_ID AND OCAS_PNL_NO = OCAP_PNL_NO AND OCAS_SURG_ROLE = 'Primary' JOIN IDB.OR_PROC ON OCAP_OR_PROC_ID = OP_OR_PROC_ID JOIN IDB.OR_CL_PROC ON OP_OR_PROC_ID = OCP_OR_PROC_ID JOIN IDB.CL_PROC ON OCP_PROC_ID = CPX_PROC_ID JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CRE_RES_ID = OCAS_RES_ID JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON OC_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE OC_SURG_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT date AND CURRENT date + 28 DAYS AND OC_OR_CASE_STS_CD NOT IN ('2', '5') AND CPX_PROC_CD IN ('51520', '51525', '51530', '51570', '51575', '51580', '51585', '51590', '51595', '51596') ) , CPE AS (SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN, CPE_ENC_DTE, CRE_RES_NAME, CRE_RES_TYP, CLD_DEPT_NAME, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8, CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CPE_MRN ORDER BY CPE_ENC_DTE) AS RN FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN SRG ON CPE_MRN = MRN JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Sch') AND CRE_RES_TYP IN ('Physician') AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 = 'SRG' AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 = 'URO' ) , CPE2 AS (SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN, CPE_ENC_DTE, CRE_RES_NAME, CRE_RES_TYP, CLD_DEPT_NAME, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8, CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID, CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN SRG ON CPE_MRN = MRN JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE 1=1 AND CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Sch') AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT date AND CURRENT date + 28 DAYS AND CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID = 3245 ) SELECT DISTINCT SRG.*, CPE.CPE_ENC_DTE AS "Next URO SRG Appt Date", STRIP(CPE.CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME) AS "Next URO SRG Visit Type", CPE2.CPE_ENC_DTE AS "Next WOC SRG Appt Date", STRIP(CPE2.CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME) AS "Next WOC SRG Visit Type" FROM SRG LEFT JOIN CPE ON CPE.CPE_MRN = MRN LEFT JOIN CPE2 ON CPE2.CPE_MRN = MRN

prompt: We are requesting a list of outstanding orders written by Dr. Nikoletta Lendvai that were not completed (still on hold or pending) in CIS as of 3/29/2019 (Dr. Lendvai's last day at MSKCC). We are trying to assess the volume of pending CIS orders after the MD left MSKCC. We expect all orders to be completed by this time but would like to review orders on hold/pending as of 3/29/2019 or after.
completion: WITH ORD AS (SELECT OO_MRN MRN, PT_LAST_NAME LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME FIRST_NAME, PT_DATE_OF_DEATH DOD, OO_ENTER_DTE , OO_ORD_GUID , OO_VISIT_GUID, OO_ORD_ID ORDERID, OO_ORD_NAME ORDERNAME, OO_ORD_TYPE_CD ORD_TYPE, OO_SUMMARY_LINE , STRIP(OO_ORD_STS_CD)||' - '||STRIP(OSTS_STS_DESC) ORDSTATUS, OP_DISPLAY_NAME ORD_PROVIDER, OU_DISPLAY_NAME ENTERED_BY, OO_ENTER_ROLE ENTEREDBY_ROLE, OCV_VISIT_DTE, OCV_ENC_CSN_ID, OCV_APPT_ID_SEQ_NO, OCV_APPT_ID, OCV_VISIT_STS, OCV_CURR_LOC LOCATION, OCV_PVDR_NAME FROM IDB.OMS_ORDER JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON OO_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.OMS_CLIENT_VISIT ON OO_VISIT_GUID = OCV_VISIT_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_PROVIDER ON OO_PVDR_GUID = OP_PVDR_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_USER ON OO_USER_GUID = OU_USER_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_STATUS ON OO_ORD_STS_CD = OSTS_ORD_STS_CD WHERE OO_ENTER_DTE >= '2019-03-01' AND OO_PVDR_GUID = '2000007597119029' AND OO_ORD_STS_CD IN ('HOLD', 'PDVR4', 'PEND', 'AUA2') ) , PAST_VST AS (SELECT CPE_MRN, MAX(CPE_ENC_DTE) VST_DTE, CPE_CPE_APPT_STS APPT_STS , CLD_DEPT_NAME DEPT_NAME, CLD_CLD_CENTER CENTER , CVT_EXT_NAME VISIT_TYPE FROM ORD JOIN IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER ON MRN = CPE_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID AND CLD_CLD_CENTER IN ('MON', '205 E64') JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((CPE_MRN, CLD_CLD_CENTER, CLD_DEPT_NAME, CVT_EXT_NAME, CPE_CPE_APPT_STS) , (CPE_MRN))) , PAST_VST2 AS (SELECT T1.CPE_MRN P_MRN, T1.VST_DTE LAST_VST_DATE, T1.APPT_STS , T1.CENTER LAST_VISIT_CENTER, T1.VISIT_TYPE LAST_VST_TYPE FROM PAST_VST T1 JOIN PAST_VST T2 ON T1.VST_DTE = T2.VST_DTE AND T1.CPE_MRN = T2.CPE_MRN WHERE T2.DEPT_NAME IS NULL AND T1.DEPT_NAME IS NOT NULL ) , NEXT_VST AS (SELECT CPE_MRN N_MRN, CPE_APPT_DT NEXT_SCHEDULED_VST_DT, RESOURCE_NAME, RESOURCE_TYPE, DEPT_NAME NEXT_DEPT_NAME, CENTER NEXT_CENTER, VISIT_TYPE NEXT_VISIT_TYPE FROM (SELECT CPE_MRN, CPE_ENC_DTE VST_DTE, CPE_DEPT_ID DEPTID, CPE_CPE_APPT_STS APPT_STS, CPE_APPT_DT , CRE_RES_NAME RESOURCE_NAME, CRE_RES_TYP RESOURCE_TYPE, CLD_DEPT_NAME DEPT_NAME, CLD_CLD_CENTER CENTER, CLD_CLD_PHY_LOC LOCATION, CVT_EXT_NAME VISIT_TYPE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY CPE_MRN ORDER BY CPE_APPT_DT ASC) VRN FROM ORD JOIN IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER ON MRN = CPE_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID AND CLD_CLD_CENTER IN ('MON', '205 E64') JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Sch') ) AS A WHERE VRN = 1 ) SELECT DISTINCT MRN, LAST_NAME, FIRST_NAME, DOD, OO_ENTER_DTE ORD_ENTER_DTE , ORDERID, ORDERNAME, ORD_TYPE, OO_SUMMARY_LINE , ORDSTATUS, ORD_PROVIDER, ENTERED_BY, ENTEREDBY_ROLE, LOCATION ORD_LOCATION, LAST_VST_DATE, LAST_VISIT_CENTER , NEXT_SCHEDULED_VST_DT, RESOURCE_NAME, NEXT_DEPT_NAME, NEXT_CENTER FROM ORD LEFT JOIN PAST_VST2 ON MRN = P_MRN LEFT JOIN NEXT_VST ON MRN = N_MRN

prompt: I am trying to get rolling information on when attendings are absent from clinic. This could be done by querying their appointments and noting it is <5, for instance, or by using EPIC/cadence to pull out attendings on service or vacation.
completion: SELECT 'HEADER' ATN_NAME, 'HEADER' DEPTS, CHAR(CURRENT date + 1 DAYS) "1 Day Forward", CHAR(CURRENT date + 2 DAYS) "2 Days Forward", CHAR(CURRENT date + 3 DAYS) "3 Days Forward", CHAR(CURRENT date + 4 DAYS) "4 Days Forward", CHAR(CURRENT date + 5 DAYS) "5 Days Forward", CHAR(CURRENT date + 6 DAYS) "6 Days Forward", CHAR(CURRENT date + 7 DAYS) "1 Days Forward" FROM SYSIBM.SYSDUMMY1 ; WITH ATN_LAST_30_DAYS AS (SELECT DISTINCT CRE_RES_NAME ATN_NAME, CLD_DEPT_NAME DEPT_NAME FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT date - 30 DAY AND CURRENT date AND (CLD_DEPT_NAME like '%LEU%' OR CLD_DEPT_NAME like '%BMT%' OR CLD_DEPT_NAME like 'HEM%' OR CLD_DEPT_NAME like '%LYM%' OR CLD_DEPT_NAME like 'ST G%' OR CLD_DEPT_NAME like '%BRE%' OR CLD_DEPT_NAME like 'ST T%' OR CLD_DEPT_NAME like '%SAR%' OR CLD_DEPT_NAME like '%MEL%' OR CLD_DEPT_NAME like '%EDD%' OR CLD_DEPT_NAME like '%ITC%') ), NEXT_WEEK_APPTS AS (SELECT CPE_ENC_DTE AS "Appt Date", CRE_RES_NAME AS "Provider Name", COUNT(CPE_MRN) "Appt Count" FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Sch') AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT date AND CURRENT date + 7 DAY AND (CLD_DEPT_NAME like '%LEU%' OR CLD_DEPT_NAME like '%BMT%' OR CLD_DEPT_NAME like 'HEM%' OR CLD_DEPT_NAME like '%LYM%' OR CLD_DEPT_NAME like 'ST G%' OR CLD_DEPT_NAME like '%BRE%' OR CLD_DEPT_NAME like 'ST T%' OR CLD_DEPT_NAME like '%SAR%' OR CLD_DEPT_NAME like '%MEL%' OR CLD_DEPT_NAME like '%EDD%' OR CLD_DEPT_NAME like '%ITC%') GROUP BY CPE_ENC_DTE, CRE_RES_NAME) SELECT ATN_NAME, LISTAGG(DISTINCT TRIM(DEPT_NAME), '|') DEPTS, G."Appt Count" "1 Day Forward", F."Appt Count" "2 Days Forward", E."Appt Count" "3 Days Forward", D."Appt Count" "4 Days Forward", C."Appt Count" "5 Days Forward", B."Appt Count" "6 Days Forward", A."Appt Count" "7 Days Forward" FROM ATN_LAST_30_DAYS LEFT JOIN NEXT_WEEK_APPTS A ON ATN_NAME = A."Provider Name" AND A."Appt Date" = CURRENT date + 7 DAYS LEFT JOIN NEXT_WEEK_APPTS B ON ATN_NAME = B."Provider Name" AND B."Appt Date" = CURRENT date + 6 DAYS LEFT JOIN NEXT_WEEK_APPTS C ON ATN_NAME = C."Provider Name" AND C."Appt Date" = CURRENT date + 5 DAYS LEFT JOIN NEXT_WEEK_APPTS D ON ATN_NAME = D."Provider Name" AND D."Appt Date" = CURRENT date + 4 DAYS LEFT JOIN NEXT_WEEK_APPTS E ON ATN_NAME = E."Provider Name" AND E."Appt Date" = CURRENT date + 3 DAYS LEFT JOIN NEXT_WEEK_APPTS F ON ATN_NAME = F."Provider Name" AND F."Appt Date" = CURRENT date + 2 DAYS LEFT JOIN NEXT_WEEK_APPTS G ON ATN_NAME = G."Provider Name" AND G."Appt Date" = CURRENT date + 1 DAYS GROUP BY ATN_NAME, A."Appt Count", B."Appt Count", C."Appt Count", D."Appt Count", E."Appt Count", F."Appt Count", G."Appt Count" ORDER BY 1 ;

prompt: Provide a list of patients with a completed visit in department INTEG MED 74 [116] since 10/1/2019.
completion: WITH PTS AS (SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN AS MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_ADDR1, PT_ADDR2, PT_CITY, PT_STATE , PT_ZIP_CD, PT_COUNTRY, PT_PHONE, PT_EMAIL_ADDRESS, YEAR (CURRENT DATE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) AS AGE, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH AS DOB, CLD_DEPT_NAME AS DEPT, CRE_RES_NAME AS PROVIDER, CPE_ENC_DTE AS APPT_DTE, CASE WHEN CPE_CPE_APPT_STS = 'Arrived' THEN 'Comp' ELSE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS END AS STATUS, CPE_APPT_DT AS APPT_DT, CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME AS VT_NAME, CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID AS VT_ID, CPP_PP_LST_LGN_DTE AS LAST_PORTAL_LOG_IN_DTE FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CRE_RES_ID = CPE_VST_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID AND NOT (UPPER(CVT_EXT_NAME) LIKE '%TELEMEDICINE%' OR UPPER(CVT_EXT_NAME) LIKE '%PHONE%') JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON CPE_MRN = PT_MRN AND PT_DEATH_IND NOT IN ('C', 'D', 'X') JOIN IDB.CL_PAS_PATIENT ON CPE_CL_PT_ID = CPP_CL_PT_ID WHERE 1=1 AND CPE_DEPT_ID = '116' AND ((CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Comp', 'Arrived') AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN '2019-10-01' AND CURRENT DATE - 1 DAY) OR (CPE_CPE_APPT_STS = 'Sch' AND CPE_ENC_DTE >= CURRENT DATE))) , LAST_APPT AS (SELECT MRN, APPT_DTE AS LAST_APPT_DTE, VT_NAME AS LAST_VT, DEPT AS LAST_DEPT, PROVIDER AS LAST_PROVIDER FROM PTS JOIN (SELECT MRN AS MRN_L, MAX(APPT_DT) AS LAST_APPT_DT FROM PTS WHERE STATUS = 'Comp' GROUP BY MRN) AS X ON MRN = MRN_L AND APPT_DT = LAST_APPT_DT) , NEXT_APPT AS (SELECT MRN, APPT_DTE AS NEXT_APPT_DTE, VT_NAME AS NEXT_VT, DEPT AS NEXT_DEPT, PROVIDER AS NEXT_PROVIDER FROM PTS JOIN (SELECT MRN AS MRN_N, MIN(APPT_DT) AS NEXT_APPT_DT FROM PTS WHERE STATUS = 'Sch' GROUP BY MRN) AS X ON MRN = MRN_N AND APPT_DT = NEXT_APPT_DT) SELECT DISTINCT A.MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, AGE, DOB, PT_ADDR1, PT_ADDR2, PT_CITY, PT_STATE , PT_ZIP_CD, PT_COUNTRY, PT_PHONE, PT_EMAIL_ADDRESS, LAST_APPT_DTE, LAST_VT, LAST_DEPT, LAST_PROVIDER, NEXT_APPT_DTE, NEXT_VT, NEXT_DEPT, NEXT_PROVIDER , LAST_PORTAL_LOG_IN_DTE FROM PTS A LEFT JOIN LAST_APPT B ON A.MRN = B.MRN LEFT JOIN NEXT_APPT C ON A.MRN = C.MRN WHERE 1=1

prompt: Provide a quarterly search for small cell carcinoma cases.
completion: SELECT PRPT_MRN "MRN" , PT_LAST_NAME "PT Last Name" , PT_FIRST_NAME "PT First Name" , PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH "DOB" , CASE WHEN A.AC_MRN IS NOT NULL THEN 'Y' END AS "12-245 Consent" , CASE WHEN B.AC_MRN IS NOT NULL THEN 'Y' END AS "06-107 Consent" , PRPT_PROCEDURE_DTE "Procedure Date" , PRPT_ACCESSION_NO "Accession Number" , PRPT_REPORT "Pathology Report" FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PRPT_MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.ACCRUALS A ON PRPT_MRN = A.AC_MRN AND A.AC_IRB_NO = '12-245' LEFT JOIN IDB.ACCRUALS B ON PRPT_MRN = B.AC_MRN AND B.AC_IRB_NO = '06-107' WHERE PRPT_REPORT IS NOT NULL AND CONTAINS("PRPT_REPORT", '("small cell carcinoma" AND NOT "non-small cell carcinoma" AND NOT "non small cell carcinoma")') = 1 AND PRPT_REPORT_TYPE IN ('S_R', 'S_R_Order') AND (DATE(PRPT_PROCEDURE_DTE) >= (DATE('0001-01-01') + YEAR(CURRENT date) YEARS - 1 YEAR + MONTH(CURRENT date) MONTHS - 4 MONTHS) AND DATE(PRPT_PROCEDURE_DTE) < (DATE('0001-01-01') + YEAR(CURRENT date) YEARS - 1 YEAR + MONTH(CURRENT date) MONTHS - 1 MONTHS))
