prompt: Provide a report of all H/S pathology reports since 1/1/2018 containing any of the specified search terms.
completion: WITH X AS (SELECT DISTINCT "t1"."PT_MRN" AS "MRN", PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_BIRTH_DTE AS DOB, "t2"."PRPT_ACCESSION_NO" AS "Pathology Report", PRPT_REPORT_TYPE, "t3"."PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_DESC" AS "Pathology Report Type", YEAR("t4"."DT_DTE") AS YR, "t4"."DT_DTE" AS "Pathology Procedure Date", "t5"."DT_DTE" AS "Pathology Report Date", UPPER(CASE WHEN LENGTH(PRPT_REPORT) <= 15000 THEN RTRIM(CAST(SUBSTR(PRPT_REPORT, 1, 15000) AS VARCHAR(15000))) ELSE CAST(SUBSTR(PRPT_REPORT, 1, 15000) AS VARCHAR(15000)) END) AS TXT, CASE WHEN UPPER(DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)DIAGNOSIS:[\w\W]*(?=NOTE:)', PRPT_REPORT)) <> '' THEN UPPER(DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)DIAGNOSIS:[\w\W]*(?=NOTE:)', PRPT_REPORT)) WHEN UPPER(DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)DIAGNOSIS:[\w\W]*(?=I ATTEST)', PRPT_REPORT)) <> '' THEN UPPER(DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)DIAGNOSIS:[\w\W]*(?=I ATTEST)', PRPT_REPORT)) WHEN UPPER(DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)DIAGNOSIS:[\w\W]*(?=REPORT ELECTRONICALLY SIGNED OUT )', PRPT_REPORT)) <> '' THEN UPPER(DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)DIAGNOSIS:[\w\W]*(?=REPORT ELECTRONICALLY SIGNED OUT )', PRPT_REPORT)) END AS DIAGNOSIS, CASE WHEN UPPER(DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)SPECIMENS SUBMITTED[\w\W]*(?=DIAGNOSIS:)', PRPT_REPORT)) <> '' THEN UPPER(DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)SPECIMENS SUBMITTED[\w\W]*(?=DIAGNOSIS:)', PRPT_REPORT)) WHEN UPPER(DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)SPECIMENSSUBMITTED[\w\W]*(?=DIAGNOSIS:)', PRPT_REPORT)) <> '' THEN UPPER(DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)SPECIMENSSUBMITTED[\w\W]*(?=DIAGNOSIS:)', PRPT_REPORT)) END AS SPECIMENS_SUBMITTED FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V" "t1" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED" "t6" ON "t1"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t6"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V" "t2" ON "t6"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t2"."PRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATH_RPRT_TYPE_LOOKUP" "t3" ON "t2"."PRPT_REPORT_TYPE" = "t3"."PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_CD" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" "t4" ON "t2"."PRPT_PROCEDURE_DATE_ID" = "t4"."DT_DATE_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" "t5" ON "t2"."PRPT_REPORT_DATE_ID" = "t5"."DT_DATE_ID" WHERE 1=1 AND CONTAINS("t2"."PRPT_REPORT", '("follicular lymphoma" OR "fl" OR "low grade B cell lymphoma" OR "LGBCL" OR "B cell lymphoma" OR "atypical B cell" OR "face" OR "mucosa" OR "cheek" OR "scalp" OR "gum" OR "gingiva" OR "tongue" OR "lip" OR "eye" OR "eyelid" OR "forehead" OR "temporal" OR "temporal mass" OR "buccal" OR "chin" OR "Thyroid" OR "nasal" OR "submental" OR "sublingual" OR "parotid" OR "salivary gland" OR "salivary" OR "periparotid" OR "occipital" OR "auricular" OR "bone")') = 1 AND "t2"."PRPT_REPORT" IS NOT NULL AND("t2"."PRPT_ACCESSION_NO" LIKE 'H%' OR "t2"."PRPT_ACCESSION_NO" LIKE 'S%') AND PRPT_REPORT_TYPE not like '%SSL%' AND "t4"."DT_DTE" BETWEEN '2018-01-01' AND CURRENT date ) , DX AS (SELECT * FROM X WHERE(DIAGNOSIS LIKE '%FOLLICULAR LYMPHOMA%' OR DIAGNOSIS LIKE '%LOW GRADE B CELL LYMPHOMA%' OR DIAGNOSIS LIKE '%LGBCL%' OR DIAGNOSIS LIKE '%B CELL LYMPHOMA%' OR DIAGNOSIS LIKE '%ATYPICAL B CELL%')) , SS AS (SELECT * FROM X WHERE SPECIMENS_SUBMITTED LIKE '%FACE%' OR SPECIMENS_SUBMITTED LIKE '%MUCOSA%' OR SPECIMENS_SUBMITTED LIKE '%CHEEK%' OR SPECIMENS_SUBMITTED LIKE '%SCALP%' OR SPECIMENS_SUBMITTED LIKE '%GUM%' OR SPECIMENS_SUBMITTED LIKE '%GINGIVA%' OR SPECIMENS_SUBMITTED LIKE '%TONGUE%' OR SPECIMENS_SUBMITTED LIKE '%LIP%' OR SPECIMENS_SUBMITTED LIKE '%EYE%' OR SPECIMENS_SUBMITTED LIKE '%EYELID%' OR SPECIMENS_SUBMITTED LIKE '%FOREHEAD%' OR SPECIMENS_SUBMITTED LIKE '%TEMPORAL%' OR SPECIMENS_SUBMITTED LIKE '%TEMPORAL MASS%' OR SPECIMENS_SUBMITTED LIKE '%BUCCAL%' OR SPECIMENS_SUBMITTED LIKE '%CHIN%' OR SPECIMENS_SUBMITTED LIKE '%THYROID%' OR SPECIMENS_SUBMITTED LIKE '%NASAL%' OR SPECIMENS_SUBMITTED LIKE '%SUBMENTAL%' OR SPECIMENS_SUBMITTED LIKE '%SUBLINGUAL%' OR SPECIMENS_SUBMITTED LIKE '%PAROTID%' OR SPECIMENS_SUBMITTED LIKE '%SALIVARY GLAND%' OR SPECIMENS_SUBMITTED LIKE '%SALIVARY%' OR SPECIMENS_SUBMITTED LIKE '%PERIPAROTID%' OR SPECIMENS_SUBMITTED LIKE '%OCCIPITAL%' OR SPECIMENS_SUBMITTED LIKE '%AURICULAR%' OR SPECIMENS_SUBMITTED LIKE '%BONE%' ) , HS AS (SELECT * FROM X WHERE X."Pathology Report" IN (SELECT "Pathology Report" FROM DX) AND X."Pathology Report" IN (SELECT "Pathology Report" FROM SS) ) , M AS (SELECT DISTINCT A.PRPT_ACCESSION_NO AS ACC_NO, B.PRPT_ACCESSION_NO AS CHILD_ACC_NO FROM DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_REFERENCES ON PRPTR_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PRPTR_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID LEFT JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V A ON PRPTR_PATH_RPT_ID = A.PRPT_PATH_RPT_ID LEFT JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V B ON PRPTR_CHILD_PATH_RPT_ID = B.PRPT_PATH_RPT_ID WHERE A.PRPT_ACCESSION_NO IN (SELECT "Pathology Report" FROM HS) ) SELECT DISTINCT "t1"."PT_MRN" AS "MRN", PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_BIRTH_DTE AS DOB, "t2"."PRPT_ACCESSION_NO" AS "Pathology Report", PRPT_REPORT_TYPE, "t3"."PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_DESC" AS "Pathology Report Type", YEAR("t4"."DT_DTE") AS YR, "t4"."DT_DTE" AS "Pathology Procedure Date", "t5"."DT_DTE" AS "Pathology Report Date", UPPER(CASE WHEN LENGTH(PRPT_REPORT) <= 15000 THEN RTRIM(CAST(SUBSTR(PRPT_REPORT, 1, 15000) AS VARCHAR(15000))) ELSE CAST(SUBSTR(PRPT_REPORT, 1, 15000) AS VARCHAR(15000)) END) AS TXT, CASE WHEN UPPER(DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)DIAGNOSIS:[\w\W]*(?=NOTE:)', PRPT_REPORT)) <> '' THEN UPPER(DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)DIAGNOSIS:[\w\W]*(?=NOTE:)', PRPT_REPORT)) WHEN UPPER(DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)DIAGNOSIS:[\w\W]*(?=I ATTEST)', PRPT_REPORT)) <> '' THEN UPPER(DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)DIAGNOSIS:[\w\W]*(?=I ATTEST)', PRPT_REPORT)) WHEN UPPER(DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)DIAGNOSIS:[\w\W]*(?=REPORT ELECTRONICALLY SIGNED OUT )', PRPT_REPORT)) <> '' THEN UPPER(DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)DIAGNOSIS:[\w\W]*(?=REPORT ELECTRONICALLY SIGNED OUT )', PRPT_REPORT)) END AS DIAGNOSIS, CASE WHEN UPPER(DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)SPECIMENS SUBMITTED[\w\W]*(?=DIAGNOSIS:)', PRPT_REPORT)) <> '' THEN UPPER(DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)SPECIMENS SUBMITTED[\w\W]*(?=DIAGNOSIS:)', PRPT_REPORT)) WHEN UPPER(DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)SPECIMENSSUBMITTED[\w\W]*(?=DIAGNOSIS:)', PRPT_REPORT)) <> '' THEN UPPER(DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)SPECIMENSSUBMITTED[\w\W]*(?=DIAGNOSIS:)', PRPT_REPORT)) END AS SPECIMENS_SUBMITTED FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V" "t1" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED" "t6" ON "t1"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t6"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V" "t2" ON "t6"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t2"."PRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATH_RPRT_TYPE_LOOKUP" "t3" ON "t2"."PRPT_REPORT_TYPE" = "t3"."PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_CD" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" "t4" ON "t2"."PRPT_PROCEDURE_DATE_ID" = "t4"."DT_DATE_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" "t5" ON "t2"."PRPT_REPORT_DATE_ID" = "t5"."DT_DATE_ID" WHERE "t2"."PRPT_ACCESSION_NO" IN (SELECT CHILD_ACC_NO FROM M)

prompt: Identify all patients admitted to the leukemia service who have received lasix within the past 24 hours and the dose.
completion: SELECT DISTINCT CAC_MRN MRN, RTRIM(PT_LAST_NAME)||', '||PT_FIRST_NAME PT_NAME, CAC_HOSP_SVC_CD HOSPITAL_SVC, POD_ITEM_DESC DRUG_NAME, DATE(POD_ORD_STRT_DT) START_DATE, DATE(PDO_DSPNS_DT) DISPENSE_DATE, POD_DOSE DOSE, POD_DOSE_UNIT DOSE_UNIT, POSA_SCH_CD SCHEDULE, POSA_ORD_DUR_TXT DURATION FROM DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS JOIN DV.HOSPITAL_STAY ON HS_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID JOIN DV.HOSPITAL_SERVICE ON HSVC_HOSP_SVC_ID = HS_SVC_ID JOIN DV.COMBINED_ADMISSION_CENSUS_V ON CAC_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = HS_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID AND HS_ACCT_NO = CAC_ACCT_NO AND(CAC_HOSP_SVC_CD = 'LKA' OR HSVC_HOSP_SVC_CD = 'LKA') AND CAC_EFFECTIVE_DTE >= CURRENT_DATE - 6 MONTH JOIN DV.PHM_ORDER_DTL ON POD_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = CAC_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID AND POD_IVVH_ORD_IND = 'N' JOIN DV.PATIENT_ACCOUNT ON PA_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = CAC_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID AND CAC_ACCT_NO = PA_ACCT_NO AND PA_PT_ACCT_ID = POD_PT_ACCT_ID JOIN DV.PHM_INVENTORY_CATALOG ON PINC_INVENTORY_CTLG_ID = POD_PHARMA_INVENTORY_CTLG_ID AND PINC_GENERIC_NAME = 'Furosemide' JOIN DV.PHM_ORDER_SCHED_ATTR ON POSA_PHARMA_ORD_SCH_ATTR_ID = POD_PHARMA_ORD_SCH_ATTR_ID JOIN DV.PHM_ORDER_DISPENSE_OCCR ON PDO_PHARMA_ORDER_DETAIL_ID = POD_PHARMA_ORDER_DETAIL_ID JOIN DV.DATE ON DT_DATE_ID = PDO_DISPNS_DATE_ID AND DT_DTE = CURRENT_DATE - 1 DAY

prompt: List of pediatric patient who died from January 2018 to June 2021
completion: WITH PED_PTS AS (SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN MRN, INTEGER((DAYS(PT_DATE_OF_DEATH) - DAYS(PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH)) / 365) AGE_OF_DEATH FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON CPE_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE 1=1 AND CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CRE_RES_TYP IN ('Physician') AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 = 'PED' AND PT_DATE_OF_DEATH BETWEEN '2018-01-01' AND '2021-06-30' ) , APPTS AS (SELECT CPE_MRN , COUNT , "Service" , AV_DESC , ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CPE_MRN ORDER BY COUNT DESC) RANK FROM (SELECT CPE_MRN , COUNT(DISTINCT CPE_ENC_CSN_ID) AS COUNT , CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 AS "Service" , AV_DESC FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS ON CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 = AV_CODE AND AV_ELEMENT = 'HOSP_SVC' JOIN PED_PTS ON CPE_MRN = MRN WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CRE_RES_TYP IN ('Physician') GROUP BY CPE_MRN, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8, AV_DESC) A GROUP BY CPE_MRN , COUNT , "Service" , AV_DESC) SELECT DISTINCT PT.PT_MRN, PT.PT_FIRST_NAME, PT.PT_LAST_NAME, PT.PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, PT.PT_DATE_OF_DEATH, AGE_OF_DEATH, PT.PT_ADDR1, PT.PT_ADDR2, PT.PT_EMAIL_ADDRESS, PT.PT_PHONE, CL_MOBILE_PHONE, "Service" , A.AV_DESC AS LANGUAGE FROM PED_PTS JOIN IDB.PATIENT PT ON PED_PTS.MRN = PT.PT_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_PATIENT ON PT.PT_MRN = CL_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS A ON AV_CODE = CL_PRIMARY_LANG AND AV_ELEMENT = 'PRIMARY_LANG' LEFT JOIN APPTS ON PED_PTS.MRN = CPE_MRN AND RANK = 1 WHERE AGE_OF_DEATH <= 25 ORDER BY PT.PT_MRN

prompt: Follow-up request to DataLine project MED21823. Smoking status of list of MRNs. I can provide the list of MRNs of interest in an excel sheet.
Provide a weekly report of CIS IMPACT sample collection orders
completion: SELECT TRIM(OO_MRN) AS "MRN", PT_LAST_NAME "Last Name", PT_FIRST_NAME "First Name", ACD_CONS_DTE "12-245 Consent Date", DATE(OO_ENTER_DT) AS "Order Enter Date", OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE AS "Order Date", OSTS_STS_DESC "Order Status", OSH_CREATE_DTE AS "Order Release Date", OO_SET_NAME AS "Set Name", OO_ORD_NAME AS "Order Name", DOC_SVC AS "SVC", AV_DESC AS "Service", MAX(CASE WHEN OO_ORD_NAME='Diag Molecular Path (Heme Onc) Order' AND M1.OFF_FLD_LABEL = 'Molecular Assay Requested #1:' THEN OUD_USER_DI_VALUE END) "Molecular Assay Requested #1", MAX(CASE WHEN OO_ORD_NAME='Diag Molecular Path (Heme Onc) Order' AND M1.OFF_FLD_LABEL = 'Molecular Assay Requested #2:' THEN OUD_USER_DI_VALUE END) "Molecular Assay Requested #2", MAX(CASE WHEN OO_ORD_NAME='Diag Molecular Path (Heme Onc) Order' AND M1.OFF_FLD_LABEL = 'Molecular Assay Requested #3:' THEN OUD_USER_DI_VALUE END) "Molecular Assay Requested #3", MAX(CASE WHEN OO_ORD_NAME='Diag Molecular Path (Heme Onc) Order' AND M1.OFF_FLD_LABEL = 'Molecular Assay Requested #4:' THEN OUD_USER_DI_VALUE END) "Molecular Assay Requested #4", MAX(CASE WHEN OO_ORD_NAME='Diag Molecular Path (Heme Onc) Order' AND M1.OFF_FLD_LABEL = 'Molecular Assay Requested #5:' THEN OUD_USER_DI_VALUE END) "Molecular Assay Requested #5" FROM IDB.OMS_ORDER JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON OO_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.ACCRUALS_DATES ON OO_MRN = ACD_MRN AND ACD_IRB_NO = '12-245' LEFT JOIN IDB.DOC ON OO_REQ_DR_NO = DOC_DR_NO LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS ON AV_CODE = DOC_SVC AND AV_ELEMENT = 'SVC' LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_STS_HX ON OO_ORD_GUID = OSH_ORD_GUID AND OSH_FUNCTION_CD = '105' JOIN IDB.OMS_STATUS ON OO_ORD_STS_CD = OSTS_ORD_STS_CD LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_USER_DATA ON OO_MRN = OUD_MRN AND OO_ORD_GUID = OUD_ORD_GUID LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_FORM_FIELD M1 ON OUD_USER_DI_CD = M1.OFF_DI_CD AND OO_ENTRY_FRM_GUID = M1.OFF_ENTRY_FRM_GUID AND M1.OFF_FLD_LABEL like 'Molecular Assay Requested%' WHERE OO_ORD_STS_CD NOT IN ('CANC', 'CANP', 'AUC3') AND (OO_ORD_NAME IN ('Diag Molecular Path Saliva as Normal Control for MSK-IMPACT', 'Diag Molecular Path Saliva or Nails as Normal Control for MSK-IMPACT', 'Diag Molecular Path (Heme Onc) Order') OR OO_SET_NAME IN ('IMPACT_Heme_Order_Set')) AND OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE >= '2018-01-01' GROUP BY TRIM(OO_MRN), PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, ACD_CONS_DTE, DATE(OO_ENTER_DT), OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE, OSTS_STS_DESC, OSH_CREATE_DTE, OO_SET_NAME, OO_ORD_NAME, DOC_SVC, AV_DESC ORDER BY 1, 2

prompt: Provide a monthly  list of all patients treated at MSK who have a note in the chart under "Service: Gastrointestinal Oncology" AND have an surgical pathology report  in the last month.
completion: WITH DX1 AS (SELECT DISTINCT PRPT_MRN , PRPT_REPORT_DTE, PRPT_ACCESSION_NO, CASE WHEN INSTR(LOWER(CAST (PRPT_REPORT AS VARCHAR(12000))), 'neuroendocrine carcinoma') >0 THEN 'Neuroendocrine Carcinoma' WHEN INSTR(LOWER(CAST (PRPT_REPORT AS VARCHAR(12000))), 'well differentiated neuroendocrine tumor') >0 OR INSTR(LOWER(CAST (PRPT_REPORT AS VARCHAR(12000))), 'well-differentiated neuroendocrine tumor') >0 THEN 'Well Differentiated Neuroendocrine Tumor' END AS SEARCH_STRING, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY PRPT_MRN ORDER BY PRPT_REPORT_DTE DESC) PATH_RN FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V WHERE PRPT_REPORT IS NOT NULL AND PRPT_REPORT_DTE BETWEEN '2010-01-01' AND '2017-12-31' AND (INSTR(LOWER(CAST (PRPT_REPORT AS VARCHAR(12000))), 'neuroendocrine carcinoma') >0 OR INSTR(LOWER(CAST (PRPT_REPORT AS VARCHAR(12000))), 'well differentiated neuroendocrine tumor') >0 OR INSTR(LOWER(CAST (PRPT_REPORT AS VARCHAR(12000))), 'well-differentiated neuroendocrine tumor') >0) ) , EMR AS (SELECT EAD_MRN, EAD_DOCUMENT_DTE FROM IDB.EMR_AA_DOCUMENT D JOIN IDB.EMR_AA_DOCTYPE ON EAD_DOCTYPE = EADT_DOCTYPE JOIN DX1 ON PRPT_MRN = EAD_MRN WHERE VALUE(EAD_RIGHT_ID, EADT_RIGHT_ID) = 167 AND EAD_DOCTYPE = 'M18' AND EAD_DOCUMENT_DTE BETWEEN '2010-01-01' AND '2017-12-31' AND EADT_EMR_DESC LIKE '%DOM%' AND EADT_CATEGORY ='Assessments' ) , DX2 AS (SELECT DISTINCT CDD_MRN, OP_DISCIPLINE, CDD_SERVICE_DTE, CDD_DOC_GUID, CDD_DOC_NAME, CDO_SECTION, CDO_ITEM_NAME, CDO_VALUE_TEXT FROM IDB.CD_DOCUMENT LEFT JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION ON CDD_DOC_GUID = CDO_DOC_GUID AND CDD_AUTHORED_DTE = CDO_AUTHORED_DTE AND CDO_VALUE_TEXT <> '' JOIN EMR ON EAD_MRN = CDD_MRN AND CDD_SERVICE_DTE = EAD_DOCUMENT_DTE JOIN IDB.OMS_PROVIDER ON CDD_AUTH_PROV_GUID = OP_PVDR_GUID WHERE CDD_CANCEL_IND <> '1' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND <> '1' AND CDD_DOC_NAME like '%DOM-Gastrointestinal Oncology%' AND UPPER(CDO_ITEM_NAME) ='SERVICE' AND CDO_VALUE_TEXT = 'Gastrointestinal Oncology' AND OP_DISCIPLINE IN ('Medicine', 'xHematology') AND CDD_SERVICE_DTE BETWEEN '2010-01-01' AND '2017-12-31' ) SELECT DISTINCT CDD_MRN AS MRN , PRPT_REPORT_DTE AS PATH_REPORT_DATE, SEARCH_STRING, PRPT_ACCESSION_NO AS ACCESSION_NO FROM DX1 JOIN DX2 ON CDD_MRN = PRPT_MRN AND PATH_RN =1 ; WITH DX1 AS (SELECT DISTINCT PRPT_MRN , PRPT_REPORT_DTE, PRPT_ACCESSION_NO, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY PRPT_MRN ORDER BY PRPT_REPORT_DTE DESC) PATH_RN FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V WHERE PRPT_REPORT IS NOT NULL AND PRPT_REPORT_DTE BETWEEN '2010-01-01' AND '2017-12-31' AND INSTR(LOWER(CAST (PRPT_REPORT AS VARCHAR(12000))), 'sez6') >0 ) , EMR AS (SELECT EAD_MRN, EAD_DOCUMENT_DTE FROM IDB.EMR_AA_DOCUMENT D JOIN IDB.EMR_AA_DOCTYPE ON EAD_DOCTYPE = EADT_DOCTYPE JOIN DX1 ON PRPT_MRN = EAD_MRN WHERE VALUE(EAD_RIGHT_ID, EADT_RIGHT_ID) = 167 AND EAD_DOCTYPE = 'M18' AND EAD_DOCUMENT_DTE BETWEEN '2010-01-01' AND '2017-12-31' AND EADT_EMR_DESC LIKE '%DOM%' AND EADT_CATEGORY ='Assessments' ) , DX2 AS (SELECT DISTINCT CDD_MRN, OP_DISCIPLINE, CDD_SERVICE_DTE, CDD_DOC_GUID, CDD_DOC_NAME, CDO_SECTION, CDO_ITEM_NAME, CDO_VALUE_TEXT FROM IDB.CD_DOCUMENT LEFT JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION ON CDD_DOC_GUID = CDO_DOC_GUID AND CDD_AUTHORED_DTE = CDO_AUTHORED_DTE AND CDO_VALUE_TEXT <> '' JOIN EMR ON EAD_MRN = CDD_MRN AND CDD_SERVICE_DTE = EAD_DOCUMENT_DTE JOIN IDB.OMS_PROVIDER ON CDD_AUTH_PROV_GUID = OP_PVDR_GUID WHERE CDD_CANCEL_IND <> '1' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND <> '1' AND CDD_DOC_NAME like '%DOM-Gastrointestinal Oncology%' AND UPPER(CDO_ITEM_NAME) ='SERVICE' AND CDO_VALUE_TEXT = 'Gastrointestinal Oncology' AND OP_DISCIPLINE IN ('Medicine', 'Hematology') AND CDD_SERVICE_DTE BETWEEN '2010-01-01' AND '2017-12-31' ) SELECT DISTINCT CDD_MRN AS MRN , PRPT_REPORT_DTE AS PATH_REPORT_DATE , PRPT_ACCESSION_NO AS ACCESSION_NO FROM DX1 JOIN DX2 ON CDD_MRN = PRPT_MRN AND PATH_RN =1 ;

prompt: Provide a list of patients with "lacrimal carcinoma" with some basic disease, treatment and demographic data included.
completion: WITH PATH AS (SELECT DISTINCT "t1"."PT_MRN" AS "MRN", "t2"."PRPT_ACCESSION_NO" AS "Pathology Report", "t3"."DT_DTE" AS "Pathology Procedure Date", "t4"."DT_DTE" AS "Pathology Report Date", "t5"."PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_DESC" AS "Pathology Report Type", PRPT_ORD_DR_NAME, UPPER(CASE WHEN LENGTH(PRPT_REPORT) <= 15000 THEN RTRIM(CAST(SUBSTR(PRPT_REPORT, 1, 15000) AS VARCHAR(15000))) ELSE CAST(SUBSTR(PRPT_REPORT, 1, 15000) AS VARCHAR(15000)) END) AS TXT, CASE WHEN LOCATE('ORBIT', UPPER(PRPT_REPORT)) > 0 THEN 'Y' END AS ORBIT, CASE WHEN LOCATE('LACRIMAL', UPPER(PRPT_REPORT)) > 0 THEN 'Y' END AS LACRIMAL FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V" "t1" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED" "t6" ON "t1"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t6"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V" "t2" ON "t6"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t2"."PRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" "t3" ON "t2"."PRPT_PROCEDURE_DATE_ID" = "t3"."DT_DATE_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" "t4" ON "t2"."PRPT_REPORT_DATE_ID" = "t4"."DT_DATE_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATH_RPRT_TYPE_LOOKUP" "t5" ON "t2"."PRPT_REPORT_TYPE" = "t5"."PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_CD" WHERE 1=1 AND CONTAINS("t2"."PRPT_REPORT", '("orbit" OR "lacrimal")') = 1 AND CONTAINS("t2"."PRPT_REPORT", '("carcinoma")') = 1 AND "t2"."PRPT_REPORT" IS NOT NULL ) , X AS (SELECT MRN, STRIP(PT_LAST_NAME) || ', ' || STRIP(PT_FIRST_NAME) AS "Name", PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH AS DOB, PT_SEX, R.AV_DESC AS "Race", E.AV_DESC AS "Ethnicity", PT_DATE_OF_DEATH AS DOD, COALESCE(MAX(PLA_LST_APPT_DTE, PLA_LST_DSCH_DTE), PLA_LST_APPT_DTE, PLA_LST_DSCH_DTE) AS LAST_FU_DATE, "Pathology Report", "Pathology Procedure Date", "Pathology Report Date", "Pathology Report Type", PRPT_ORD_DR_NAME, TXT, ORBIT, LACRIMAL FROM PATH JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY ON MRN = PLA_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS R ON PT_RACE = R.AV_CODE AND R.AV_ELEMENT = 'RACE' LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS E ON PT_PT_ETHNICITY = E.AV_CODE AND E.AV_ELEMENT = 'PT_ETHNICITY') , RT AS (SELECT DISTINCT RTC_TX_MRN, RTC_TX_PLAN_NAME, RTC_PRIMARY_REF_POINT, RTC_TX_START_DTE, RTC_TX_STOP_DTE, RTC_TX_ELAPSED_DAYS, RTC_TX_PLANNED_FRACTIONS, RTC_TX_DELIVERED_FRACTIONS, RTC_TX_PLANNED_DOSE, RTC_TX_DELIVERED_DOSE, RTC_DOSE_CORRECTION FROM IDB.RADONC_TREATMENT_COURSE JOIN X ON RTC_TX_MRN = MRN WHERE 1=1 ) , APR AS (SELECT APR_MRN, CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME, APR_DRUG_NAME, MIN(APR_START_DTE) AS START_DATE, MAX(APR_END_DTE) AS END_DATE, APR_ORD_RX_TYPE FROM IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX_V JOIN X ON APR_MRN = MRN WHERE CDG_CHEMO_FLAG = 'Y' GROUP BY APR_MRN, CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME, APR_DRUG_NAME, APR_ORD_RX_TYPE ) , SRG AS (SELECT DISTINCT SSE_MRN, SSE_SURG_DTE, SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD, SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC FROM X JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT ON SSE_MRN = MRN JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE ON SSE_LOG_ID = SSP_LOG_ID WHERE 1=1 ) SELECT * FROM SRG

prompt: Provide weekly list of inpatient consults and assignments for Infectious Diseases service.
completion: WITH MAIN AS (SELECT DISTINCT OO_MRN AS "MRN", OO_VISIT_GUID, TRIM(PT_LAST_NAME)||', '||TRIM(PT_FIRST_NAME) AS "PATIENT NAME", OO_REQUESTED_DTE AS "ORDER REQUESTED DATE", OO_ENTER_DTE AS "ORDER ENTER DATE", OS_SVC_DESC AS "REFERRING SERVICE", OCV.OCV_PVDR_NAME AS "REFERRING PROVIDER", MAX(CASE WHEN OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'Consult_Infec Dx IP Reason' THEN SUBSTR(OUD_USER_DI_VALUE, 1, 100) END) "REASON FOR CONSULT", MAX(CASE WHEN OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'Consult_Infec Dx IP Primary' THEN SUBSTR(OUD_USER_DI_VALUE, 1, 50) END) "PRIMARY DIAGNOSIS" FROM IDB.OMS_ORDER JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON OO_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.OMS_STATUS ON OO_ORD_STS_CD = OSTS_ORD_STS_CD JOIN IDB.OMS_CLIENT_VISIT OCV ON OO_VISIT_GUID = OCV_VISIT_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_SERVICE ON OCV_SVC_GUID = OS_SVC_GUID LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_USER_DATA ON OUD_ORD_GUID = OO_ORD_GUID WHERE OO_ORD_NAME = 'Infectious Disease Inpatient Consult' AND OO_ENTER_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT date -7 DAY AND CURRENT date - 2 DAY AND OO_ORD_STS_CD NOT IN ('CANC', 'CANP', 'AUC3') GROUP BY OO_MRN, OO_VISIT_GUID, TRIM(PT_LAST_NAME)||', '||TRIM(PT_FIRST_NAME), OO_REQUESTED_DTE, OO_ENTER_DTE, OS_SVC_DESC, OO_SUMMARY_LINE, OCV.OCV_PVDR_NAME), CD AS (SELECT DISTINCT CDD_MRN, CDD_DOC_GUID, CDD_SERVICE_DTE, CDD_DOC_NAME, CDD_VISIT_GUID, MAX(U1.OU_DISPLAY_NAME) "ID FELLOW/APP", MAX(U2.OU_DISPLAY_NAME) "ID MD ATTENDING", ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CDD_MRN ORDER BY ABS(DAYS("ORDER ENTER DATE") - DAYS(CDD_SERVICE_DTE)) ASC) RN FROM MAIN JOIN IDB.CD_DOCUMENT ON "MRN" = CDD_MRN JOIN IDB.OMS_USER U1 ON CDD_AUTH_PROV_GUID = U1.OU_USER_GUID LEFT JOIN IDB.CD_DOCUMENT_HISTORY ON CDD_DOC_GUID = CDH_CLIENT_DOC_GUID AND CDD_CLIENT_GUID = CDH_CLIENT_GUID LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_USER U2 ON CDH_USER_GUID = U2.OU_USER_GUID WHERE CDD_CANCEL_IND = '0' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND = '0' AND UPPER(CDD_DOC_NAME) LIKE ('%DOM%INFECTIOUS%') AND CDD_SERVICE_DTE >= "ORDER ENTER DATE" GROUP BY CDD_MRN, CDD_DOC_GUID, CDD_SERVICE_DTE, CDD_DOC_NAME, CDD_VISIT_GUID, "ORDER ENTER DATE") SELECT DISTINCT "MRN" , "PATIENT NAME" , "ORDER ENTER DATE" , "ORDER REQUESTED DATE" , "REFERRING SERVICE" , "REFERRING PROVIDER" , "REASON FOR CONSULT" , "PRIMARY DIAGNOSIS" , CDD_SERVICE_DTE "DOCUMENT SERVICE DT" , CDD_DOC_NAME "DOCUMENT NAME" , "ID FELLOW/APP" , "ID MD ATTENDING" FROM MAIN LEFT JOIN CD ON "MRN" = CDD_MRN AND RN = 1

prompt: I need to pull vital signs that are entered into the flowsheets in CIS for specific patients from 2015 - 2020
completion: SELECT CDD_MRN MRN, PT_LAST_NAME AS "Last Name", PT_FIRST_NAME AS "First Name", CDD_DOC_NAME AS "Document Name", AUTH_DTE AS "Date Vitals Authored", CDD_SERVICE_DTE AS "Date Vitals Taken", CAST(MAX(CASE WHEN CDO_MSTR_ITEM_NM LIKE 'Weight%' THEN SUBSTR(CDO_VALUE_TEXT, 1, 6) END) AS DECIMAL(7, 3)) AS "Weight (kg)", CAST(MAX(CASE WHEN CDO_MSTR_ITEM_NM LIKE 'BSA%' THEN SUBSTR(CDO_VALUE_TEXT, 1, 6) END) AS DECIMAL(7, 3)) AS "BSA", CAST(MAX(CASE WHEN CDO_OBS_CTLG_MSTR_ITEM_GUID = '9000002617502890' THEN SUBSTR(CDO_VALUE_TEXT, 1, 6) END) AS INT) AS "BP Systolic", CAST(MAX(CASE WHEN CDO_OBS_CTLG_MSTR_ITEM_GUID = '9000002617302890' THEN SUBSTR(CDO_VALUE_TEXT, 1, 6) END) AS INT) AS "BP Diastolic" FROM (SELECT CDD_DOC_GUID, CDD_MRN, CDD_SERVICE_DTE, CDD_AUTHORED_DTE AUTH_DTE, CDD_DOC_NAME, CDD_AUTHORED_DT, CDD_VISIT_GUID FROM IDB.CD_DOCUMENT WHERE CDD_CANCEL_IND = '0' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND = '0' AND CDD_SERVICE_DTE BETWEEN '1/1/2015' AND '12/31/2020' AND(CDD_DOC_NAME LIKE '%Vital Signs%' OR CDD_DOC_NAME = 'Nursing Assessment - JRSC' OR CDD_DOC_NAME = 'Nursing Perioperative Flowsheet' OR CDD_DOC_NAME LIKE '%Triage%')) A JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION ON CDD_DOC_GUID = CDO_DOC_GUID AND CDO_AUTHORED_DTE = AUTH_DTE LEFT JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON CDD_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE CDO_OBS_CTLG_MSTR_ITEM_GUID IN ('9000001189502890', '9000105100002890', '9000105098802890', '9000105099002890', '9000001188702890', '9000001187902890', '9000006166102890', '9000002626102890', '9000002626302890', '9000002620502890', '9000002617502890', '9000002617302890', '9000002618702890', '9000002626102890', '9000002626302890', '9000002620502890', '9000011478902890', '9000109369002890', '9000002629302890', '9000002627902890', '9000002626702890', '9000002626902890') AND(TRIM(CDO_VALUE_TEXT) > '0' AND RIGHT(TRIM(CDO_VALUE_TEXT), 1) BETWEEN '0' AND '9' OR(CDO_OBS_CTLG_MSTR_ITEM_GUID IN ('9000011478902890', '9000109369002890', '9000002627902890') AND CDO_VALUE_TEXT > '')) AND CDO_ITEM_NAME NOT LIKE '%Comment%' GROUP BY CDD_MRN, CDD_SERVICE_DTE, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, AUTH_DTE, CDD_AUTHORED_DT, CDD_DOC_GUID , CDD_DOC_NAME

prompt: Identify lymphoma patients meeting specified criteria.
completion: WITH LYMPHOMA AS (SELECT PDX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID AS LYMPHOMA_DEID, MIN(DT_DTE) AS MIN_LYMPHOMA_DTE FROM DV.PATIENT_DIAGNOSIS_FINAL_ALL_V JOIN DV.DIAGNOSIS_CODE_CAT_ICD9_V ON PDX_DX_CATALOG_ID = DXCC_DX_CATALOG_ID JOIN DV.DATE ON PDX_DX_DATE_ID = DT_DATE_ID WHERE DXCC_ICD_CODE BETWEEN '200.00' AND '202.99' AND DXA_CIC_CDER_INIT = 'YES' GROUP BY PDX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID HAVING MIN(DT_DTE) BETWEEN '2000-01-01' AND '2010-12-31'), CNS AS (SELECT PDX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID AS CNS_DEID, MIN(DT_DTE) AS MIN_CNS_DTE FROM LYMPHOMA JOIN DV.PATIENT_DIAGNOSIS_FINAL_ALL_V ON LYMPHOMA_DEID = PDX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID JOIN DV.DIAGNOSIS_CODE_CAT_ICD9_V ON PDX_DX_CATALOG_ID = DXCC_DX_CATALOG_ID JOIN DV.DATE ON PDX_DX_DATE_ID = DT_DATE_ID WHERE DXCC_ICD_CODE IN ('198.3', '198.4', '200.5', '200.50', '200.51', '200.52', '200.53', '200.54', '200.55', '200.56', '200.57', '200.58') AND DXA_CIC_CDER_INIT = 'YES' GROUP BY PDX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID), PATH AS (SELECT PRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID AS PATH_DEID, MIN(DT_DTE) AS MIN_PATH_DTE FROM LYMPHOMA JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V ON LYMPHOMA_DEID = PRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID JOIN DV.DATE ON PRPT_REPORT_DATE_ID = DT_DATE_ID WHERE CONTAINS(PRPT_DEID_REPORT, '(NOT "NEGATIVE FOR MALIGNANT CELLS" & "cerebrospinal fluid")') <> 0 GROUP BY PRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID), CPT AS (SELECT PTX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID AS CPT_DEID, MIN(DT_DTE) AS MIN_CPT_DTE FROM LYMPHOMA JOIN DV.CPT_PBD_PATIENT_PROCEDURE ON LYMPHOMA_DEID = PTX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID JOIN DV.DATE ON PTX_PROC_DATE_ID = DT_DATE_ID WHERE PCC_CODE IN ('G0267', '38205', '38206', '38209', '38215', '38230', '38231') GROUP BY PTX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID) SELECT PT_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, MIN_LYMPHOMA_DTE, MIN_CNS_DTE, MIN_PATH_DTE, MIN_CPT_DTE FROM LYMPHOMA JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V ON LYMPHOMA_DEID = PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID LEFT JOIN CNS ON LYMPHOMA_DEID = CNS_DEID LEFT JOIN PATH ON LYMPHOMA_DEID = PATH_DEID LEFT JOIN CPT ON LYMPHOMA_DEID = CPT_DEID WHERE COALESCE(CNS_DEID, PATH_DEID, CPT_DEID) IS NOT NULL

prompt: Please take out any repeat patients on the dataline for this protocol
completion: SELECT DISTINCT OC_MRN , YEAR(OC_SURG_DTE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) AS AGE, TRIM(PT_LAST_NAME) || ', ' || TRIM(PT_FIRST_NAME) AS PATIENT_NAME, PT_EMAIL_ADDRESS AS EMAIL FROM IDB.OR_CASE JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PT_MRN = OC_MRN WHERE OC_SURG_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT date + 7 DAYS AND CURRENT date + 13 DAYS AND OC_OR_CASE_STS_CD NOT IN ('2', '5') AND PT_DEATH_IND IN ('', 'A') AND YEAR(OC_SURG_DTE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) >= 65 ORDER BY 1; WITH APPT AS (SELECT OC_MRN, OC_SURG_DTE AS SURGERY_DATE, YEAR(OC_SURG_DTE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) AS AGE, TRIM(PT_LAST_NAME) || ', ' || TRIM(PT_FIRST_NAME) AS PATIENT_NAME, PT_EMAIL_ADDRESS AS EMAIL, OC_PT_CLASS AS PATIENT_CLASS, AV_DESC AS PATIENT_CLASS_DESC, CPX_PROC_CD AS CPT_CODE, TRIM(CPX_PROC_NAME) AS CPT_DESC, CRE_RES_NAME AS SURGEON, OC_SURG_SVC AS SERVICE, OC_DAYS_STAY FROM IDB.OR_CASE JOIN IDB.OR_CASE_ALL_PROC ON OC_CASE_ID = OCAP_CASE_ID JOIN IDB.OR_CASE_ALL_SURG ON OCAP_CASE_ID = OCAS_CASE_ID AND OCAS_PNL_NO = OCAP_PNL_NO AND OCAS_SURG_ROLE = 'Primary' JOIN IDB.OR_PROC ON OCAP_OR_PROC_ID = OP_OR_PROC_ID JOIN IDB.OR_CL_PROC ON OP_OR_PROC_ID = OCP_OR_PROC_ID JOIN IDB.CL_PROC ON OCP_PROC_ID = CPX_PROC_ID JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CRE_RES_ID = OCAS_RES_ID JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PT_MRN = OC_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS ON AV_CODE = OC_PT_CLASS AND AV_ELEMENT = 'PT_CLASS' WHERE OC_SURG_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT date + 7 DAYS AND CURRENT date + 13 DAYS AND OC_OR_CASE_STS_CD NOT IN ('2', '5') AND PT_DEATH_IND IN ('', 'A') AND YEAR(OC_SURG_DTE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) >= 65 ) , DX AS (SELECT CC_MRN, MAX(CASE WHEN CC_CLSF_CD BETWEEN 'E08' AND 'E13.99' OR CC_CLSF_CD BETWEEN '250' AND '250.99' THEN 'Y' END) AS DIABETES_FLAG FROM APPT JOIN IDB.CTC_CLSF ON OC_MRN = CC_MRN JOIN IDB.CLM A ON A.CLM_CLSF_CD = CC_CLSF_CD AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND ((CC_PT_TYPE = 'I') OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) AND (CC_CLSF_CD BETWEEN 'E08' AND 'E13.99' OR CC_CLSF_CD BETWEEN '250' AND '250.99') GROUP BY CC_MRN) , HOME_MED AS (SELECT MRN, LISTAGG(DRUG, ', ') DRUG_LIST FROM (SELECT DISTINCT HCPR_MRN MRN, HCPR_DRUG_NAME, CASE WHEN LOWER(HCPR_DRUG_NAME) LIKE '%metformin%' THEN 'metformin' WHEN LOWER(HCPR_DRUG_NAME) LIKE '%glipizide%' THEN 'glipizide' WHEN LOWER(HCPR_DRUG_NAME) LIKE '%glyburide%' THEN 'glyburide' WHEN LOWER(HCPR_DRUG_NAME) LIKE '%glimepiride%' THEN 'glimepiride' WHEN LOWER(HCPR_DRUG_NAME) LIKE '%insulin%' THEN 'insulin' ELSE '' END AS DRUG FROM APPT LEFT JOIN IDB.HML_CLIENT_PRESCRIPTION HCPR ON HCPR_MRN= OC_MRN WHERE HCPR_GENERIC_NAME_ID != -100 AND (HCPR_PRESCRIPTION_TYPE = 1 AND HCPR_TRANSMISSION_STATUS IN (1, 2, 5) OR HCPR_PRESCRIPTION_TYPE = 3) AND HCPR_STATUS_TYPE_DESC = 'Active' AND (LOWER(HCPR_DRUG_NAME) LIKE '%metformin%' OR LOWER(HCPR_DRUG_NAME) LIKE '%glipizide%' OR LOWER(HCPR_DRUG_NAME) LIKE '%glyburide%' OR LOWER(HCPR_DRUG_NAME) LIKE '%glimepiride%' OR LOWER(HCPR_DRUG_NAME) LIKE '%insulin%' ) ) GROUP BY MRN) , SMO_HX AS (SELECT CDD_MRN , CDD_SERVICE_DTE, CDO_SECTION, TRIM(CDO_ITEM_NAME) ITEM_NAME, TRIM(CDO_VALUE_TEXT) SMOKING_HX, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CDD_MRN, CDO_ITEM_NAME ORDER BY CDD_SERVICE_DTE DESC) AS SMO_RN FROM IDB.CD_DOCUMENT LEFT JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION ON CDD_DOC_GUID = CDO_DOC_GUID AND CDD_AUTHORED_DTE = CDO_AUTHORED_DTE AND CDO_VALUE_TEXT <> '' JOIN APPT ON OC_MRN = CDD_MRN WHERE CDD_CANCEL_IND <> '1' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND <> '1' AND UPPER(CDO_SECTION) ='SOCIAL HISTORY' AND UPPER(CDO_ITEM_NAME) ='SMOKING STATUS' ) , ASH AS (SELECT ASH_MRN, ASH_ENC_DTE, ASH_TOBACCO_USED_YEARS PACK_YRS, ASH_TOBACCO_COMMENT COMMENTS, ASH_SMOKING_QUIT_DTE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ASH_MRN ORDER BY ASH_ENC_DTE DESC) RN FROM IDB.AN_SOCIAL_HX JOIN APPT ON ASH_MRN = OC_MRN) , ACC AS (SELECT AC_MRN, LISTAGG(AC_IRB_NO, ',') PROTOCOLS FROM IDB.ACCRUALS JOIN APPT ON OC_MRN = AC_MRN GROUP BY AC_MRN) , ORD AS (SELECT OO_MRN, TRIM(OO_ORD_NAME) AS ORDER_NAME, OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE AS ORDER_DATE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY OO_MRN, OO_ORD_STS_CD ORDER BY OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE DESC) ORD_RN, OSTS_STS_DESC AS ORDER_STATUS FROM IDB.OMS_ORDER JOIN IDB.OMS_STATUS ON OO_ORD_STS_CD = OSTS_ORD_STS_CD JOIN APPT ON OO_MRN = OC_MRN WHERE OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID IN ('9000015486300730', '2000001302073001' ) AND OO_ORD_STS_CD NOT IN ('CANP', 'CANC', 'AUC3') ) SELECT DISTINCT OC_MRN AS MRN, AGE AS "Age as of surgery", SURGERY_DATE , OC_DAYS_STAY AS "Length of Stay", CPT_CODE, CPT_DESC, SURGEON, SERVICE AS "Surgery Service", ORDER_DATE AS "DNR Order Date", ORDER_STATUS AS "DNR Order Status", DRUG_LIST, DIABETES_FLAG, SMOKING_HX , PROTOCOLS AS "Protocols (Accrued)", PACK_YRS || '-' || TRIM(COMMENTS) AS TOBACCO_USE FROM APPT A LEFT JOIN DX ON OC_MRN = CC_MRN LEFT JOIN HOME_MED ON OC_MRN = MRN LEFT JOIN ACC ON AC_MRN = OC_MRN LEFT JOIN SMO_HX ON CDD_MRN = OC_MRN AND SMO_RN =1 LEFT JOIN ASH ON ASH_MRN = OC_MRN AND RN=1 LEFT JOIN ORD ON OO_MRN = OC_MRN AND ORD_RN =1 WHERE NOT (SMOKING_HX LIKE '%Never%' AND DIABETES_FLAG ='N') ;

prompt: Provide a list of patients diagnosed with rare kidney cancer diagnosed between 2000-2019.
completion: WITH IMPACT AS (SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN GENE_MRN, PDRX_DMP_PATIENT_ID FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_STRUCTURED_RESULTS_V JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML ON PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PDRX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID WHERE METHOD = 'IMPACT' ) SELECT PRPT_MRN "MRN", PT_BIRTH_DTE "Date of Birth", PT_SEX_DESC "Gender", PT_RACE_DESC "Race", PT_DEATH_DTE "Date of Death", PLA_LAST_APPT_DTE "Last Appt Date", PRPT_PROCEDURE_DTE "Report Procedure Date", PRPT_REPORT_DTE "Report Date", PRPT_REPORT_TYPE_DESC "Report Type", PRPT_DEID_REPORT "De-Identified Report Text", CASE WHEN LOWER(PRPT_REPORT) LIKE '%kidney%' OR LOWER(PRPT_REPORT) LIKE '%renal%' THEN 'Y' ELSE '' END "Kidney/Renal", CASE WHEN LOWER(PRPT_REPORT) LIKE '%epithelioid%' THEN 'Y' ELSE '' END "Epithelioid", CASE WHEN GENE_MRN IS NOT NULL THEN 'Y' ELSE '' END "Has IMPACT", PDRX_DMP_PATIENT_ID "DMP Patient ID" FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON PRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID JOIN DV.PATIENT_LATEST_ACTIVITY ON PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PLA_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID LEFT JOIN IMPACT ON PRPT_MRN = GENE_MRN WHERE PRPT_REPORT IS NOT NULL AND CONTAINS("PRPT_REPORT", '("angiomyolipoma")') = 1 AND PRPT_REPORT_DTE >= '2000-01-01' ORDER BY 1

prompt: Provide the number of patients with prostate cancer who received ADT between 2020-2022. In addition, provide the number of patients with prostate cancer with received ADT between 2020-2022 who were referred to rehabilitation medicine.
completion: WITH PROSTATE_CANCER_PATIENTS AS (SELECT DISTINCT CC_MRN, CC_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_TYPE, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS DESCRIPTIONS FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE CC_CLSF_CD LIKE 'C61%' AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND (CC_PT_TYPE <> 'I' OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) ), PATIENT_IN_DRUG_LIST AS (SELECT DISTINCT TRIM(V.PT_MRN) AS PATIENTS_MRN, TRIM(PT_LAST_NAME) || ', ' || TRIM(PT_FIRST_NAME) AS PATIENTS_NAME, TRIM(APR_GENERIC_NAME) AS GENERIC_NAME, TRIM(CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME) AS COMMON_GENERIC_NAME, TRIM(APR_DRUG_NAME) AS DRUG_NAME, CASE WHEN APR_DRUG_PROCESS_STAGE = 'A' THEN 'ADMIN' WHEN APR_DRUG_PROCESS_STAGE = 'P' THEN 'PRESCRIPTION' WHEN APR_DRUG_PROCESS_STAGE = 'D' THEN 'DISPENSE' WHEN APR_DRUG_PROCESS_STAGE = 'H' THEN 'HOME MEDS' WHEN APR_DRUG_PROCESS_STAGE = 'S' THEN 'ASSUMED ADMIN' END AS DRUG_PROCESS_STAGE, TRIM(CDG_HORMONE_FLAG) AS HORMONE_FLAG, TRIM(CDG_DRUG_TYPE) AS DRUG_TYPE, APR_START_DTE AS ORDER_START_DATE, TRIM(APR_FREQ) AS FREQUENCY, TRIM(APR_DURATION) AS DURATION, TRIM(APR_SET_NAME) AS SET_NAME, TRIM(APR_DIAGNOSIS_DESC) AS DX_DESCRIPTION, TRIM(APR_DOC_SVC) AS PROVIDER_SERVICE FROM PROSTATE_CANCER_PATIENTS JOIN IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX_V ON CC_MRN = APR_MRN JOIN IDB.PATIENT V ON APR_MRN = V.PT_MRN WHERE UPPER(CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME) IN ('LEUPROLIDE', 'DEGARELIX ', 'RELUGOLIX ', 'BICALUTAMIDE', 'NILUTAMIDE', 'ABIRATERONE', 'ENZALUTAMIDE', 'APALUTAMIDE', 'DAROLUTAMIDE', 'PREDNISONE', 'DOCETAXEL', 'CABAZITAXEL', 'CARBOPLATIN', 'RADIUM RA-223 CHLORIDE', 'SIPULEUCEL-T', 'ZOLEDRONIC ACID', 'DENOSUMAB') AND APR_START_DTE BETWEEN '2020-01-01' AND '2022-08-31'), REHAB_PATIENTS AS (SELECT DISTINCT CR_MRN, CR_RFL_TYPE AS REFERRAL_TYPE, CR_ENTRY_DTE AS REFERRAL_DATE, CR_REFERRING_PROV_ID, DOC_ACDMC_DPT, DOC_ACDMC_SVC, DOC_NAME FROM PROSTATE_CANCER_PATIENTS JOIN IDB.CL_REFERRAL ON CC_MRN = CR_MRN JOIN IDB.DOC ON CR_REFERRING_PROV_ID = DOC_DR_NO WHERE TRIM(UPPER(CR_RFL_TYPE)) LIKE '%REHAB%' AND CR_ENTRY_DTE BETWEEN '2020-01-01' AND '2022-08-31' AND TRIM(CR_REFERRING_PROV_ID) <> '') SELECT PATIENTS_MRN, PATIENTS_NAME, REFERRAL_DATE, REFERRAL_TYPE, CR_REFERRING_PROV_ID, DOC_NAME, DOC_ACDMC_DPT, DOC_ACDMC_SVC, COMMON_GENERIC_NAME, ORDER_START_DATE, DRUG_PROCESS_STAGE, DESCRIPTIONS, FREQUENCY FROM PROSTATE_CANCER_PATIENTS JOIN PATIENT_IN_DRUG_LIST ON CC_MRN = PATIENTS_MRN LEFT JOIN REHAB_PATIENTS ON CC_MRN = CR_MRN ORDER BY PATIENTS_MRN, REFERRAL_DATE, REFERRAL_DATE

prompt: Update previously run request with new date range and two additional fields, identifying advanced imaging orders for patients on research protocols and who entered those orders.
completion: SELECT * FROM (SELECT DISTINCT OOC_ITEM_NAME "Order Item Name", OO_SET_NAME "Order Set Name", DOC_NAME "Requested by", OU_DISPLAY_NAME "Entered by", OU_ORD_ROLE_TYPE "Entered by Role", MAX(CASE WHEN OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'RIS_Order - Current' THEN OUD_USER_DI_VALUE ELSE '' END) AS "Current Order Name", MAX(CASE WHEN OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'RIS_ANC/Interface Code' THEN OUD_USER_DI_VALUE ELSE '' END) AS "RIS- ANC Code", MAX(CASE WHEN OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'RIS_Order - Modified' THEN OUD_USER_DI_VALUE ELSE '' END) AS "Modified Order Name", MAX(CASE WHEN OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'RIS_ANC Code - Modify' THEN OUD_USER_DI_VALUE ELSE '' END) AS "RIS- Modified ANC Code", OO_ORD_ID "Order ID", OO_ANCIL_REF_CD "Order Ancillary Code", OO_MRN "MRN", MAX(CASE WHEN OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'RIS_Primary Dx' THEN OUD_USER_DI_VALUE ELSE '' END) AS "Primary Diagnosis", MAX(CASE WHEN OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'RIS_PET-DiagnosisOth' THEN OUD_USER_DI_VALUE ELSE '' END) AS "Other Diagnosis", MAX(CASE WHEN OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'RIS_Pert/Signs/Symptoms' THEN OUD_USER_DI_VALUE ELSE '' END) AS "Pertinent Signs and Symptoms", MAX(CASE WHEN OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'RIS_NM-Reason For Study' THEN OUD_USER_DI_VALUE ELSE '' END) AS "Reason for Study", MAX(CASE WHEN OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'RIS_Info Desired From Study' THEN OUD_USER_DI_VALUE ELSE '' END) AS "Info Desired", MAX(CASE WHEN OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'Requested For' THEN OUD_USER_DI_VALUE ELSE '' END) AS "Requested for Date", MAX(CASE WHEN OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'RIS_Protocol Patient Y/N' THEN OUD_USER_DI_VALUE ELSE '' END) AS "Protocol Y/N", MAX(CASE WHEN OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'RIS_Protocol #' THEN OUD_USER_DI_VALUE ELSE '' END) AS "Protocol Number", MAX(CASE WHEN OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'RIS_Research Billing' THEN OUD_USER_DI_VALUE ELSE '' END) AS "Research Billing", OSTS_STS_DESC "Status Desc" FROM IDB.OMS_ORDER JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_CATALOG ON OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID = OOC_MSTR_ITEM_GUID JOIN IDB.DOC ON OO_REQ_DR_NO = DOC_DR_NO JOIN IDB.OMS_STATUS ON OO_ORD_STS_CD = OSTS_ORD_STS_CD LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_USER_DATA ON OUD_ORD_GUID = OO_ORD_GUID LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_USER ON OO_USER_GUID = OU_USER_GUID WHERE OOC_ITEM_NAME IN ('CT', 'MR', 'PET', 'PET CT for Cancer', 'PET CT for Cardiac viability or perfusion', 'PET MR', 'NM') AND OSTS_ORD_STS_CD IN ('RESF') AND OO_ENTER_DTE BETWEEN '2018-01-01' AND '2021-01-31' GROUP BY OOC_ITEM_NAME, DOC_NAME, OO_ORD_ID, OO_ANCIL_REF_CD, OO_MRN, OSTS_ORD_STS_CD, OSTS_STS_DESC, OO_ORD_GUID, OO_SET_NAME, OU_DISPLAY_NAME, OU_ORD_ROLE_TYPE) A WHERE "Protocol Y/N" = 'Yes' ;

prompt: We are evaluating patients who have had neoadjuvant chemotherapy/immunotherapy here at MSKCC with head and neck squamous cancer. We will be evaluating tissue that is available from their surgery.
completion: WITH APR AS (SELECT DISTINCT APR_MRN, CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME, APR_START_DTE, APR_END_DTE FROM IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX_V WHERE (UPPER(CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME) LIKE ('%CISPLATIN%') OR UPPER(CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME) LIKE ('%CARBOPLATIN%') OR UPPER(CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME) LIKE ('%DOCETAXEL%') OR UPPER(CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME) LIKE ('%PACLITAXEL%') OR UPPER(CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME) LIKE ('%CETUXIMAB%') OR UPPER(CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME) LIKE ('%CEMIPLIMAB%')) AND APR_START_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT DATE - 10 YEAR AND CURRENT DATE ), DX_ALL AS (SELECT TM_MRN AS DX_MRN, TM_HIST_CD AS DX_CODE, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS DX_DESC FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN APR ON APR_MRN = TM_MRN JOIN IDB.CLM H ON TM_HIST_CD = H.CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON TM_SITE_CD = S.CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND TM_HIST_CD IN ('M8070/3', 'M8071/3', 'M8072/3', 'M8073/3') UNION SELECT CC_MRN AS DX_MRN, CLM_CLSF_CD AS DX_CODE, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS DX_DESC FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN APR ON CC_MRN = APR_MRN JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND ((CC_PT_TYPE = 'I') OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) AND (CC_CLSF_CD LIKE ('C44%') OR CC_CLSF_CD LIKE ('173%') OR CC_CLSF_CD LIKE ('C04%') OR CC_CLSF_CD LIKE ('144%') OR CC_CLSF_CD LIKE ('C31%') OR CC_CLSF_CD LIKE ('160%') OR CC_CLSF_CD LIKE ('C14%') OR CC_CLSF_CD LIKE ('149%') OR CC_CLSF_CD LIKE ('C76%') OR CC_CLSF_CD = '195.0') ) , FINAL AS (SELECT DISTINCT APR_MRN, CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME, APR_START_DTE, APR_END_DTE FROM APR JOIN DX_ALL ON APR_MRN = DX_MRN) ,OP AS (SELECT DISTINCT CDD_MRN, CDD_DOC_NAME, CDD_SERVICE_DTE FROM IDB.CD_DOCUMENT JOIN FINAL ON CDD_MRN = APR_MRN WHERE (CDD_DOC_NAME = 'Operative Report - Head and Neck' OR CDD_DOC_NAME = 'Operative Report - Surgery-Head and Neck') AND CDD_SERVICE_DTE > APR_START_DTE AND CDD_CANCEL_IND <> '1' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND <> '1' ) SELECT DISTINCT APR_MRN, CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME, APR_START_DTE, APR_END_DTE, CDD_DOC_NAME, CDD_SERVICE_DTE FROM FINAL JOIN OP ON APR_MRN = CDD_MRN ; WITH APR AS (SELECT DISTINCT APR_MRN, CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME, APR_START_DTE, APR_END_DTE FROM IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX_V WHERE (UPPER(CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME) LIKE ('%CISPLATIN%') OR UPPER(CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME) LIKE ('%CARBOPLATIN%') OR UPPER(CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME) LIKE ('%DOCETAXEL%') OR UPPER(CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME) LIKE ('%PACLITAXEL%') OR UPPER(CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME) LIKE ('%CETUXIMAB%') OR UPPER(CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME) LIKE ('%CEMIPLIMAB%')) AND APR_START_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT DATE - 5 YEAR AND CURRENT DATE ), DX_ALL AS (SELECT TM_MRN AS DX_MRN, TM_HIST_CD AS DX_CODE, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS DX_DESC FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN APR ON APR_MRN = TM_MRN JOIN IDB.CLM H ON TM_HIST_CD = H.CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON TM_SITE_CD = S.CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND TM_HIST_CD IN ('M8070/3', 'M8071/3', 'M8072/3', 'M8073/3') UNION SELECT CC_MRN AS DX_MRN, CLM_CLSF_CD AS DX_CODE, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS DX_DESC FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN APR ON CC_MRN = APR_MRN JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND ((CC_PT_TYPE = 'I') OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) AND (CC_CLSF_CD LIKE ('C44%') OR CC_CLSF_CD LIKE ('173%') OR CC_CLSF_CD LIKE ('C04%') OR CC_CLSF_CD LIKE ('144%') OR CC_CLSF_CD LIKE ('C31%') OR CC_CLSF_CD LIKE ('160%') OR CC_CLSF_CD LIKE ('C14%') OR CC_CLSF_CD LIKE ('149%') OR CC_CLSF_CD LIKE ('C76%') OR CC_CLSF_CD = '195.0') ) , FINAL AS (SELECT DISTINCT APR_MRN, CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME, APR_START_DTE, APR_END_DTE FROM APR JOIN DX_ALL ON APR_MRN = DX_MRN) ,OP AS (SELECT DISTINCT CDD_MRN, CDD_DOC_NAME, CDD_SERVICE_DTE FROM IDB.CD_DOCUMENT JOIN FINAL ON CDD_MRN = APR_MRN WHERE (CDD_DOC_NAME = 'Operative Report - Head and Neck' OR CDD_DOC_NAME = 'Operative Report - Surgery-Head and Neck') AND CDD_SERVICE_DTE > APR_START_DTE AND CDD_CANCEL_IND <> '1' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND <> '1' ) SELECT DISTINCT APR_MRN, CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME, APR_START_DTE, APR_END_DTE, CDD_DOC_NAME, CDD_SERVICE_DTE FROM FINAL JOIN OP ON APR_MRN = CDD_MRN ; WITH APR AS (SELECT DISTINCT APR_MRN, CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME, APR_START_DTE, APR_END_DTE FROM IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX_V WHERE (UPPER(CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME) LIKE ('%CISPLATIN%') OR UPPER(CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME) LIKE ('%CARBOPLATIN%') OR UPPER(CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME) LIKE ('%DOCETAXEL%') OR UPPER(CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME) LIKE ('%PACLITAXEL%') OR UPPER(CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME) LIKE ('%CETUXIMAB%') OR UPPER(CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME) LIKE ('%CEMIPLIMAB%')) AND APR_START_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT DATE - prompt: Provide demographic, contact, LOS and insurance information on Pediatric inpatients from 1/1/2012
completion: SELECT DISTINCT CS_MRN MRN, STRIP(CS_LAST_NAME)||', '||STRIP(CS_FIRST_NAME) AS PT_NAME, CS_SEX SEX, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH DOB, YEAR(CS_ADM_DATE) - YEAR(PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) AGE_AT_ADM, CS_ADM_DATE ADM_DTE, CS_DSCH_DATE DSCH_DTE, DAYS(COALESCE(CS_DSCH_DATE, CURRENT DATE)) - DAYS(CS_ADM_DATE) LOS_AS_CURRENT, CH_HOSP_SVC ADM_HOSP_SVC, CH_NURS_STA ADM_NRS_STA , CS_HOSP_SVC HOSP_SVC, PT_ADDR1 ADDR1, PT_ADDR2 ADDR2, PT_CITY CITY, PT_STATE STATE, PT_ZIP_CD ZIP_CD, PT_COUNTRY COUNTRY , DOC_NAME, DOC_SVC, INS1.INS_PLAN_PRIO INS1_PRIO, INS1.INS_PLAN_CD INS1_CD, INS1.INS_PLAN_DESC INS1_DESC, INS2.INS_PLAN_PRIO INS2_PRIO, INS2.INS_PLAN_CD INS2_CD, INS2.INS_PLAN_DESC INS2_DESC, INS3.INS_PLAN_PRIO INS3_PRIO, INS3.INS_PLAN_CD INS3_CD, INS3.INS_PLAN_DESC INS3_DESC, CON_NAME PT_GUARANTOR, SUBSTR(AV_DESC, 1, 15) AS GNTR_RELATION FROM IDB.CASE JOIN IDB.CENSUS ON CS_ACCT_NO = CH_ACCT_NO AND CH_MRN = CS_MRN AND (YEAR(CS_ADM_DATE) - YEAR(PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) < 21 OR CH_HOSP_SVC IN ('PDB', 'PDC', 'PDG', 'PDP', 'PDU', 'PED') ) JOIN IDB.DOC ON CS_ADM_DR_NO = DOC_DR_NO JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PT_MRN = CS_MRN AND (YEAR(CS_ADM_DATE) - YEAR(PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) < 21 OR CS_HOSP_SVC IN ('PDB', 'PDC', 'PDG', 'PDP', 'PDU', 'PED')) LEFT JOIN IDB.INSURANCE INS1 ON INS1.INS_MRN = CS_MRN AND INS1.INS_PLAN_PRIO = '1' AND INS1.INS_VERIFY_IND = 'Y' LEFT JOIN IDB.INSURANCE INS2 ON INS2.INS_MRN = CS_MRN AND INS2.INS_PLAN_PRIO = '2' AND INS2.INS_VERIFY_IND = 'Y' LEFT JOIN IDB.INSURANCE INS3 ON INS3.INS_MRN = CS_MRN AND INS3.INS_PLAN_PRIO = '3' AND INS3.INS_VERIFY_IND = 'Y' LEFT JOIN IDB.CONTACT ON CS_MRN = CON_MRN AND CON_REL_CD IN ('PTGAR') LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS ON AV_CODE = CON_REL_IND AND AV_ELEMENT = 'REL_IND' WHERE COALESCE(CS_DSCH_DATE, CURRENT DATE) >= '2012-01-01' AND CS_PT_STS LIKE 'I%' AND CS_PT_STS <> 'IP' AND SUBSTR(CH_ACCT_NO, 1, 2) = '84' AND CH_CNG_TYPE = 'A'

prompt: Pull the subset of patients with a diagnosis of "anaplastic carcinoma" or "carcinoma, anaplastic" of the "ovary" "fallopian tube" "peritoneum" "pelvis"   mucinous” AND “sarcomatoid” “mucinous” AND “mural nodule” in pathology free text.
completion: WITH INIT AS (SELECT PRPT_MRN, PRPT_PROCEDURE_DTE, PRPT_REPORT_DTE, PRPT_REPORT_TYPE_DESC, PRPT_ACCESSION_NO, CAST(PRPT_REPORT AS VARCHAR(32000)) AS TEXT, PRPT_ORD_DR_NAME, PRPT_ORD_DR_SVC_DESC FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V WHERE PRPT_REPORT IS NOT NULL AND (CONTAINS("PRPT_REPORT", '("anaplastic carcinoma" and "ovary")') = 1 OR CONTAINS("PRPT_REPORT", '("anaplastic carcinoma" and "pelvis")') = 1 OR CONTAINS("PRPT_REPORT", '("anaplastic carcinoma" and "fallopian tube" )') = 1 OR CONTAINS("PRPT_REPORT", '("anaplastic carcinoma" and "peritoneum" )') = 1 OR CONTAINS("PRPT_REPORT", '("carcinoma, anaplastic" and "ovary")') = 1 OR CONTAINS("PRPT_REPORT", '("carcinoma, anaplastic" and "pelvis")') = 1 OR CONTAINS("PRPT_REPORT", '("carcinoma, anaplastic" and "fallopian tube" )') = 1 OR CONTAINS("PRPT_REPORT", '("carcinoma, anaplastic" and "peritoneum" )') = 1 OR (CONTAINS("PRPT_REPORT", '("mucinous" and "sarcomatoid")') = 1 OR CONTAINS("PRPT_REPORT", '("mucinous" and "mural nodule")') = 1)) ) SELECT DISTINCT A.*, PT_SEX FROM INIT A JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PRPT_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE PT_SEX = 'F'

prompt: Provide diagnosis and RT treatment data on patients with ATM mutations and an ongoing weekly report of newly identified patients.
completion: WITH CTE AS (SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN, PT_BIRTH_DTE, PT_DEATH_DTE, TUMOR_TYPE_CODE, TUMOR_TYPE_NAME, PRIMARY_SITE, GENE_ID, SITE1_GENE, SITE2_GENE, PDWS_NAME, DTPROCPATHRPT.DT_DTE PROCEDURE_DATE, REPORTDATE.DT_DTE, SUBMITTING_PHYSICIAN FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML INNER JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT ON PDRX_PATH_RPT_ID = PRPT_PATH_RPT_ID JOIN DV.DATE DTPROCPATHRPT ON PRPT_PROCEDURE_DATE_ID = DTPROCPATHRPT.DT_DATE_ID JOIN DV.DATE REPORTDATE ON PRPT_REPORT_DATE_ID = REPORTDATE.DT_DATE_ID AND REPORTDATE.DT_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT date - 7 DAYS AND CURRENT date INNER JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML_SETTINGS ON PDRX_PATH_DMP_RESULTS_XML_ID = PDRXS_PATH_DMP_RESULTS_XML_ID INNER JOIN DVDMC.PATHOLOGY_DMP_WEBSVC_SETTINGS ON PDRXS_SETTING_ID = PDWS_SETTING_ID INNER JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON PDRX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID, XMLTABLE('$c/root/*' PASSING PDRX_XML_VALUE AS "c" COLUMNS VARIANT_TYPE VARCHAR(100) PATH './local-name(.)', SITE1_GENE VARCHAR(100) PATH 'site1_gene', SITE2_GENE VARCHAR(100) PATH 'site2_gene', GENE_ID VARCHAR(100) PATH 'gene_id', TUMOR_TYPE_CODE VARCHAR(100) PATH '../meta-data/tumor_type_code', TUMOR_TYPE_NAME VARCHAR(255) PATH '../meta-data/tumor_type_name', PRIMARY_SITE VARCHAR(255) PATH '../meta-data/primary_site', DT_PROCEDURE VARCHAR(40) PATH '../meta-data/dt_procedure', SUBMITTING_PHYSICIAN VARCHAR(100) PATH '../meta-data/submitting_physician') T WHERE GENE_ID = 'ATM' OR SITE1_GENE = 'ATM' OR SITE2_GENE = 'ATM' AND VARIANT_TYPE <> 'meta-data' ) , CTE2 AS (SELECT CPE_MRN, MIN(CPE_ENC_DTE) "Next Appointment Date" FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID WHERE CPE_MRN IN (SELECT PT_MRN FROM CTE) AND CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Sch') AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 = 'MED' AND CRE_RES_TYP IN ('Physician') AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 IN ('BMT', 'BRE', 'EDD', 'GI', 'GMO', 'GU', 'HEM', 'HNS', 'ITC', 'LEU', 'LYM', 'MEDONC', 'MEL', 'MSO', 'MYL', 'REN', 'SAR', 'THR') AND CPE_ENC_DTE > CURRENT date GROUP BY CPE_MRN) SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN MRN, PT_BIRTH_DTE DOB, PT_DEATH_DTE DATE_OF_DEATH, TUMOR_TYPE_CODE, TUMOR_TYPE_NAME, PRIMARY_SITE, GENE_ID, SITE1_GENE, SITE2_GENE, PDWS_NAME TEST_NAME, PROCEDURE_DATE, SUBMITTING_PHYSICIAN, RTC_TX_START_DTE RT_START, RTC_TX_STOP_DTE RT_STOP, RTC_TX_PLAN_NAME RT_PLAN, RTC_TX_DELIVERED_DOSE RT_DOSE, "Next Appointment Date" FROM CTE LEFT JOIN CTE2 ON CPE_MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.RADONC_TREATMENT_COURSE ON RTC_TX_MRN = PT_MRN ;

prompt: Please provide all the data from Intake, Tobacco Treatment - Psychiatry for July 1, 2019 to December 31, 2019. Also, please provide all the data from Follow Up, Tobacco Treatment - Psychiatry for July 1, 2019 to December 31, 2019.
completion: SELECT CDD_MRN AS MRN, CDD_DOC_NAME, OP_DISPLAY_NAME AS PROVIDER, CDD_SERVICE_DTE, CDD_DOC_GUID, CDO_SECTION, CDO_ITEM_NAME, CDO_VALUE_TEXT FROM IDB.CD_DOCUMENT JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION ON CDD_DOC_GUID = CDO_DOC_GUID AND CDD_AUTHORED_DTE = CDO_AUTHORED_DTE AND CDO_VALUE_TEXT <> '' JOIN IDB.OMS_PROVIDER ON CDD_AUTH_PROV_GUID = OP_PVDR_GUID WHERE CDD_CANCEL_IND <> '1' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND <> '1' AND CDD_DOC_NAME IN ('Intake, Tobacco Treatment - Psychiatry', 'Follow Up, Tobacco Treatment - Psychiatry') AND CDD_SERVICE_DTE BETWEEN '2018-01-01' AND '2019-12-31'

prompt: Provide a list of patients with prostate cancer who receive 1-5 fractions of radiation and had a PSMA PET scan before and after
completion: WITH DX AS (SELECT DISTINCT CC_MRN AS MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS MIN_ICD9_EFF_DTE, CC_CLSF_CD AS ICD9_CODE, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS ICD9_DESC FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE SUBSTR(CC_CLSF_CD, 1, 3) IN ('185', 'C61') AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND (CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) GROUP BY CC_MRN, CC_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK HAVING MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) BETWEEN '2015-01-01' AND '2022-07-31'), RAD_MSK AS (SELECT DISTINCT RTC_TX_MRN , CASE WHEN RTC_TX_START_DTE >= '2020-01-01' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS RAD_2020_FLAG FROM IDB.RADONC_TREATMENT_COURSE JOIN DX ON RTC_TX_MRN = MRN WHERE 1=1 ) SELECT D.*, CASE WHEN RTC_TX_MRN IS NOT NULL THEN 'Y' END AS "Rad Tx at MSK ", CASE WHEN RAD_2020_FLAG = 1 THEN 'Y' END AS "Rad Tx at MSK(after 2020)" FROM DX D LEFT JOIN RAD_MSK ON RTC_TX_MRN = MRN ; WITH DX AS (SELECT DISTINCT CC_MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS MIN_ICD9_EFF_DTE, CC_CLSF_CD AS ICD9_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS ICD9_DESC FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE SUBSTR(CC_CLSF_CD, 1, 3) IN ('185', 'C61') AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND (CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) GROUP BY CC_MRN, CC_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK HAVING MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) BETWEEN '2015-01-01' AND '2022-07-31') , RAD_TX AS (SELECT DISTINCT RTC_TX_MRN, RTC_TX_PLAN_NAME, CASE WHEN UPPER(RTC_TX_PLAN_NAME) LIKE '%PROS%' THEN 'Y' END AS PROSTATE_FLAG, RTC_TX_START_DTE RAD_START, RTC_TX_STOP_DTE AS RAD_STOP FROM IDB.RADONC_TREATMENT_COURSE JOIN DX ON RTC_TX_MRN = CC_MRN WHERE 1=1 AND RTC_TX_START_DTE BETWEEN '2020-01-01' AND '2022-07-31' ) , RAD AS (SELECT RTC_TX_MRN AS RAD_MRN, PROSTATE_FLAG, MIN(RAD_START) AS FIRST_RAD_TX, MAX(RAD_STOP) AS LAST_RAD_TX FROM RAD_TX JOIN DX ON RTC_TX_MRN = CC_MRN GROUP BY RTC_TX_MRN, PROSTATE_FLAG) , PET AS (SELECT DISTINCT RRPT_MRN, FIRST_PET, LAST_PET, CASE WHEN FIRST_PET <= FIRST_RAD_TX THEN 'Y' END AS "PET PSMA Before Rad", CASE WHEN LAST_PET >= LAST_RAD_TX THEN 'Y' END AS "PET PSMA After Rad" FROM RAD JOIN (SELECT RRPT_MRN, MIN(RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE) FIRST_PET, MAX(RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE) LAST_PET FROM DV.RADIOLOGY_REPORT_V JOIN DX ON RRPT_MRN = CC_MRN WHERE RRPT_ORDER_GROUP LIKE '%PET%' AND RRPT_PROCEDURE_NAME LIKE '%PSMA%' GROUP BY RRPT_MRN) ON RAD_MRN = RRPT_MRN) , PET_PROST_RAD AS (SELECT DISTINCT RRPT_MRN AS PROST_MRN , FIRST_PET, LAST_PET, CASE WHEN FIRST_PET <= FIRST_RAD_TX THEN 'Y' END AS "PET PSMA Before Rad Tx(Prostate)", CASE WHEN LAST_PET >= LAST_RAD_TX THEN 'Y' END AS "PET PSMA After Rad Tx(Prostate)" FROM RAD JOIN (SELECT RRPT_MRN, MIN(RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE) FIRST_PET, MAX(RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE) LAST_PET FROM DV.RADIOLOGY_REPORT_V JOIN DX ON RRPT_MRN = CC_MRN WHERE RRPT_ORDER_GROUP LIKE '%PET%' AND RRPT_PROCEDURE_NAME LIKE '%PSMA%' GROUP BY RRPT_MRN) ON RAD_MRN = RRPT_MRN AND PROSTATE_FLAG = 'Y' ) SELECT DISTINCT CC_MRN AS MRN , "PET PSMA Before Rad Tx(Prostate)", "PET PSMA After Rad Tx(Prostate)", "PET PSMA Before Rad", "PET PSMA After Rad" FROM DX D JOIN PET ON RRPT_MRN = CC_MRN LEFT JOIN PET_PROST_RAD ON PROST_MRN = CC_MRN ; WITH DX AS (SELECT DISTINCT CC_MRN , MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS MIN_ICD9_EFF_DTE, CC_CLSF_CD AS ICD9_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS ICD9_DESC FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE SUBSTR(CC_CLSF_CD, 1, 3) IN ('185', 'C61') AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND (CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) GROUP BY CC_MRN, CC_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK HAVING MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) BETWEEN '2015-01-01' AND '2022-07-31'), RAD_TX AS (SELECT RTC_TX_MRN AS MRN , RTC_TX_COURSE_ID COURSE_ID, UPPER(RTC_TX_PLAN_NAME) AS SITE , RTC_TX_DELIVERED_FRACTIONS AS DELIVERED_FRACTIONS , RTC_TX_DELIVERED_DOSE AS DELIVERED_DOSE, RTC_TX_START_DTE AS RADIATION_START, RTC_TX_STOP_DTE AS RADIATION_STOP FROM IDB.RADONC_TREATMENT_COURSE JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT CC_MRN FROM DX) ON RTC_TX_MRN = CC_MRN WHERE 1=1 AND RTC_TX_STOP_DTE BETWEEN '2020-01-01' AND '2022-07-31' ) SELECT * FROM RAD_TX ;

prompt: Identify Hodgkin's Lymphoma patients diagnosed between 1994 and 2008 who were at least 60 years old at diagnosis and were treated at MSKCC.
completion: WITH CDB AS (SELECT TM_MRN, TM_DX_DTE AS "Tumor Diagnosis Date", YEAR(TM_DX_DTE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) AS "Age at Tumor Diagnosis Date", C.AV_DESC AS "Case Status", CC.AV_DESC AS "Class of Case", TM_HIST_CD AS "ICD-O Histology Code", H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS "ICD-O Histology Description", TM_SITE_CD AS "ICD-O Site Code", S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS "ICD-O Site Description" FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON TM_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY ON PLA_MRN = TM_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS C ON C.AV_ELEMENT = 'CASE_STS' AND C.AV_CODE = TM_CASE_STS LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS CC ON CC.AV_ELEMENT = 'CLASS_OF_CASE' AND CC.AV_CODE = TM_CLASS_OF_CASE LEFT JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD LEFT JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('3', '6', '7', '8') AND TM_HIST_CD IN ('M9596/3', 'M9650/3', 'M9651/3', 'M9652/3', 'M9653/3', 'M9654/3', 'M9655/3', 'M9656/3', 'M9657/3', 'M9658/3', 'M9659/3', 'M9660/3', 'M9661/3', 'M9662/3', 'M9663/3', 'M9664/3', 'M9665/3', 'M9666/3', 'M9667/3') AND TM_DX_DTE BETWEEN '1994-01-01' AND '2008-12-31' AND YEAR(TM_DX_DTE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) >= 60 AND PLA_LST_TX_DTE >= '1994-01-01' ), ICD9 AS (SELECT CC_MRN, MIN_DX_DTE AS "Min ICD-9 Dx Date", YEAR(MIN_DX_DTE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) AS "Age at Min ICD-9 Dx Date" FROM (SELECT CC_MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS MIN_DX_DTE FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY ON PLA_MRN = CC_MRN JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND (CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) AND CC_CLSF_CD LIKE '201%' AND PLA_LST_TX_DTE >= '1994-01-01' GROUP BY CC_MRN ) AS A JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PT_MRN = CC_MRN WHERE MIN_DX_DTE BETWEEN '1994-01-01' AND '2008-12-31' AND YEAR(MIN_DX_DTE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) >= 60 ) SELECT PT_MRN AS "MRN", PT_LAST_NAME AS "Last Name", PT_FIRST_NAME AS "First Name", PT_SEX AS "Sex", PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH AS "Date of Birth", CASE WHEN PT_DATE_OF_DEATH IS NULL THEN 'ALIVE' ELSE 'DECEASED' END AS "Vital Status", PT_DATE_OF_DEATH AS "Date of Death", PLA_LST_CON_DTE AS "Last Contact Date", "Tumor Diagnosis Date", "Age at Tumor Diagnosis Date", "Case Status", "Class of Case", "ICD-O Histology Code", "ICD-O Histology Description", "ICD-O Site Code", "ICD-O Site Description", "Min ICD-9 Dx Date", "Age at Min ICD-9 Dx Date" FROM IDB.PATIENT JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY ON PT_MRN = PLA_MRN LEFT JOIN CDB ON PT_MRN = TM_MRN LEFT JOIN ICD9 ON PT_MRN = CC_MRN WHERE COALESCE(TM_MRN, CC_MRN) IS NOT NULL

completion: WITH STUDY AS (SELECT PRO_IRB_NO, PRO_IRB_TITLE, PRO_IRB_STS, PRO_PROTOCOL_TYPE, AC_MRN, AC_NON_MSK_INST, AC_LAST_NAME, AC_FIRST_NAME, AC_PVDR_OF_RECORD_NAME, ACD_REG_DTE, ACD_TX_ST_DTE, ACD_TX_END_DTE, ACD_OFF_STUDY_DTE, ACD_CONS_DTE FROM IDB.PROTOCOL JOIN IDB.ACCRUALS ON PRO_IRB_NO = AC_IRB_NO JOIN IDB.ACCRUALS_DATES ON AC_IRB_NO = ACD_IRB_NO AND AC_SUBJ_ID_NO = ACD_SUBJ_ID_NO AND AC_SUBJ_SEQ_NO = ACD_SUBJ_SEQ_NO WHERE PRO_IRB_NO = '06-107' AND ACD_OFF_STUDY_DTE IS NULL ) SELECT PRPT_MRN, PRPT_PROCEDURE_DTE, PRPT_REPORT_DTE, PRPT_REPORT_TYPE_DESC, PRPT_ACCESSION_NO, LEFT(PRPT_REPORT, 20000) PRPT_REPORT, PRPT_ORD_DR_NAME, PRPT_ORD_DR_SVC_DESC FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V JOIN STUDY ON PRPT_MRN = AC_MRN WHERE PRPT_REPORT IS NOT NULL AND (PRPT_REPORT like '%Pylori%' OR PRPT_REPORT like '%pylori%') AND PRPT_REPORT like '%positive%'

prompt: Provide a weekly list of Breast, Head and Neck or Urology service patients scheduled for upcoming surgeries at JRSC or Monmouth OR in the next 60 days and are identified as active smokers (last 30 days) from the Tobacco Screening section of their Pre-Visit EPACS or Initial Visit clinic notes.
completion: WITH CAD AS (SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN AS "MRN", CPE_ENC_DTE AS "Appt Date", CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 AS "Department", CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 AS "Service", CLD_DEPT_NAME AS "Department Name", CRE_RES_NAME AS "Provider Name", CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME AS "Visit Type" FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Sch') AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 IN ('SRG') AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 IN ('BRE', 'HNS', 'URO') AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT DATE AND CURRENT DATE + 60 DAYS ), LOC AS (SELECT OL_MRN, CASE WHEN OL_SURG_LOC_ID=1000010 THEN 'Main OR' WHEN OL_SURG_LOC_ID=1000020 THEN 'SDH' WHEN OL_SURG_LOC_ID=1000030 THEN 'Endoscopy' WHEN OL_SURG_LOC_ID=1000080 THEN 'IR Room' WHEN OL_SURG_LOC_ID=1000300 THEN 'JRSC' WHEN OL_SURG_LOC_ID=1000600 THEN 'Monmouth OR' ELSE 'Other' END AS LOCATION FROM CAD JOIN IDB.OR_LOG ON "MRN" = OL_MRN ) , SURG_LOC AS (SELECT DISTINCT OL_MRN, LOCATION FROM LOC WHERE LOCATION IN ('JRSC', 'Monmouth OR') ) , CLINDOC AS (SELECT CDD_MRN, CDD_SERVICE_DTE AS "Service Date", CDD_DOC_NAME AS "Document Name", OP_DISPLAY_NAME AS "Provider", CDD_DOC_GUID AS "Document Guid", CDO_SECTION AS "Section", CDO_ITEM_NAME AS "Item", CDO_VALUE_TEXT AS "Value" FROM SURG_LOC JOIN IDB.CD_DOCUMENT ON OL_MRN = CDD_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION ON CDD_DOC_GUID = CDO_DOC_GUID AND CDD_AUTHORED_DTE = CDO_AUTHORED_DTE AND CDO_VALUE_TEXT <> '' JOIN IDB.OMS_PROVIDER ON CDD_AUTH_PROV_GUID = OP_PVDR_GUID WHERE CDD_CANCEL_IND <> '1' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND <> '1' AND CDO_ITEM_NAME IN ('Smoking 100packs Lifetime Y/N', 'smoked in the past 30 days? Y/N', 'started smoking at age', 'Avg packs per day', 'Some days, Every day', 'Smoking Status') AND CDO_ITEM_NAME NOT IN ('Quit smoking at age') AND CDO_VALUE_TEXT NOT IN ('Never Smoker', 'No') AND (CDD_DOC_NAME LIKE '%Pre-Visit EPACS%' OR CDD_DOC_NAME LIKE 'Initial Visit%') ) SELECT DISTINCT "MRN", "Appt Date", "Department", "Service", "Department Name", "Provider Name", "Visit Type", LOCATION, "Document Name", "Provider", "Section", "Item", "Value" FROM CAD JOIN SURG_LOC ON "MRN" = OL_MRN JOIN CLINDOC ON "MRN" = CDD_MRN WHERE LOWER("Value") NOT IN ('former smoker', 'smoker current status unknown', 'unknown if ever smoked') AND (LOWER("Item") <> ('smoked in the past 30 days? Y/N') AND LOWER("Value") <> 'no') ;

prompt: We have a list of about 14,000 patients  that we will need the diagnosis date, primary disease, histology, and any other diagnosis variables available in Dataline.

prompt: Please provide a list of patients who underwent hepatic resection after hepatic artery pump insertion in the last 10 years at our institution
completion: WITH PTS_DTE AS (SELECT DISTINCT SSE_MRN MRN, SSE_SURG_DTE DTE, SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD CPT_CD, SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC DESC FROM IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE ON SSE_LOG_ID = SSP_LOG_ID AND SSE_ENC_CSN_ID = SSP_ENC_CSN_ID WHERE SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD IN ('36260') ) SELECT MRN, CPT_CD, DESC, DTE, SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD, SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC, SSE_SURG_DTE FROM PTS_DTE JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT ON SSE_MRN = MRN AND SSE_SURG_DTE > DTE JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE ON SSE_LOG_ID = SSP_LOG_ID AND SSE_ENC_CSN_ID = SSP_ENC_CSN_ID WHERE SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD IN ('47120', '47122', '47125', '47130', '47100') AND SSE_SURG_DTE BETWEEN '2009-06-01' AND '2019-06-01' ORDER BY 1, 3, 5 ;

prompt: We will be sending a secure email to patients asking them to participate in an interview about their experience at MSK. We would like to ensure we remove anyone who has asked us to not contact them and we'd like to check vital status.
completion: WITH MAX_IAP_DATE AS (SELECT CADENCE_PT_ID AS PT_ID, MAX(IAP_CONVERSION_DATE) AS 'IapDate' FROM DBO.ACCESSMSK_MASTER AM GROUP BY CADENCE_PT_ID) , IAP_DATE_NULL AS (SELECT * FROM MAX_IAP_DATE WHERE IAPDATE IS NULL), JULY_VISITS AS (SELECT DISTINCT CADENCE_PT_ID, MRN, MAX(VISIT_DATE) AS 'MostRecentVisitDateInJuly' FROM DBO.ACCESSMSK_MASTER AM WHERE VISIT_DATE BETWEEN '2022-08-01' AND '2022-10-31' AND NEWVISIT_GRP2 = 'External New Visit' AND NEWVISIT_GRP1 = 'New Visit' AND COMP_STS = '5. Comp' GROUP BY CADENCE_PT_ID, MRN), NOT_CONVERTED AS (SELECT IAP_DATE_NULL.*, JULY_VISITS.MRN, JULY_VISITS.MOSTRECENTVISITDATEINJULY FROM IAP_DATE_NULL INNER JOIN JULY_VISITS ON IAP_DATE_NULL.PT_ID = JULY_VISITS.CADENCE_PT_ID) , NO_PRE_EXISITING_TREATMENT_DATE AS (SELECT NC.* FROM NOT_CONVERTED NC LEFT JOIN DBO.MIDB_IAP MI ON NC.MRN = MI.MRN WHERE MI.MIN_TX_DTE IS NULL), ORAL_TREATMENT AS (SELECT ND.* FROM NO_PRE_EXISITING_TREATMENT_DATE ND ) , MAX_APPT_DT AS (SELECT OT.PT_ID, OT.MRN, MAX(CPE_APPT_DT) AS 'MaxApptDt', CPE_CPE_APPT_STS, OT.MOSTRECENTVISITDATEINJULY FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER CPE INNER JOIN ORAL_TREATMENT OT ON CPE.CPE_CL_PT_ID = OT.PT_ID LEFT JOIN DBO.ACCESSMSK_VISIT_TYPE CVT ON CPE.CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT.VISIT_TYPE_ID GROUP BY OT.PT_ID, OT.MRN, CPE_CPE_APPT_STS, OT.MOSTRECENTVISITDATEINJULY), MAX_APPT_STS AS ( (SELECT * FROM (SELECT PT_ID, MRN, MAXAPPTDT, CPE_CPE_APPT_STS, MOSTRECENTVISITDATEINJULY, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY PT_ID ORDER BY MAXAPPTDT DESC) AS RN FROM MAX_APPT_DT) T WHERE T.RN = 1)) SELECT MS.*, P.PT_NAME, P.SEX, P.CURRENT_AGE, P.HOME_PHONE, P.MOBILE_PHONE, P.[LANGUAGE] FROM MAX_APPT_STS MS LEFT JOIN ACCESSMSK_PATIENT P ON MS.PT_ID = P.CADENCE_PT_ID

prompt: break down of documents types in EMR using "Transcribed Orders Email" (doctype AJD) and "Dispo Sheet" from 2/22/21 - current date.
completion: SELECT CDD_MRN AS "MRN", CDD_SERVICE_DTE AS "Service Date", CDD_DOC_NAME AS "Document Name", OP_DISPLAY_NAME AS "Provider", CDO_SECTION AS "Section", CDO_ITEM_NAME AS "Item", OP_DISCIPLINE, OU_DISPLAY_NAME FROM IDB.CD_DOCUMENT LEFT JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION ON CDD_DOC_GUID = CDO_DOC_GUID AND CDD_AUTHORED_DTE = CDO_AUTHORED_DTE AND CDO_VALUE_TEXT <> '' JOIN IDB.OMS_PROVIDER ON CDD_AUTH_PROV_GUID = OP_PVDR_GUID LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_USER ON CDD_USER_GUID = OU_USER_GUID WHERE CDD_CANCEL_IND <> '1' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND <> '1' AND (CDD_DOC_NAME = 'Transcribed Orders Email') AND CDD_SERVICE_DTE >= '2021-02-22' ; SELECT EAD_MRN, EAD_DOCTOR_NUM, EADT_EMR_DESC, EAD_DOCUMENT_DTE FROM IDB.EMR_AA_DOCUMENT LEFT JOIN IDB.EMR_AA_DOCTYPE ON EAD_DOCTYPE = EADT_DOCTYPE WHERE VALUE(EAD_RIGHT_ID, EADT_RIGHT_ID) = 167 AND EADT_EMR_DESC like 'Dispo Sheet%' AND EAD_DOCUMENT_DTE >= '2021-02-22' ;

prompt: Non-GYN thyroid nodule fine needle aspiration biopsies done in 2018 that were suspicious (Bethesda V) or definite (Bethesda VI) papillary thyroid cancer
completion: WITH THYROID AS (SELECT "t1"."PT_MRN" AS "MRN", "t2"."PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_DESC" AS "Pathology Report Type", "t3"."PRPT_ACCESSION_NO" AS "Pathology Report", "t4"."DT_DTE" AS "Pathology Procedure Date", "t3"."PRPT_REPORT" AS "Pathology Report Text" FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V" "t1" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED" "t6" ON "t1"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t6"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V" "t3" ON "t6"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t3"."PRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATH_RPRT_TYPE_LOOKUP" "t2" ON "t3"."PRPT_REPORT_TYPE" = "t2"."PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_CD" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" "t4" ON "t3"."PRPT_PROCEDURE_DATE_ID" = "t4"."DT_DATE_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" "t5" ON "t3"."PRPT_REPORT_DATE_ID" = "t5"."DT_DATE_ID" WHERE "t2"."PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_DESC" IN ('Cytology-Non GYN', 'Cytology-Private Non-GYN') AND CONTAINS("t3"."PRPT_REPORT", '"papillary"') = 1 AND CONTAINS("t3"."PRPT_REPORT", '"Bethesda"') = 1 AND "t3"."PRPT_REPORT" IS NOT NULL AND "t4"."DT_DTE" BETWEEN '2018-01-01' AND '2018-12-31' ) , US AS (SELECT "MRN", PT_LAST_NAME "Last Name", PT_FIRST_NAME "First Name", "Pathology Report Type", "Pathology Report", "Pathology Procedure Date", "Pathology Report Text", RRPT_ACCESSION_NO "US Accession No", RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE "US Performed Date", RRPT_ORDER_GROUP "US Report Group", RRPT_ANC_CODE "Ancillary Code", RRPT_PROCEDURE_NAME "Procedure Name", RRPT_REPORT_TXT "Report Text", ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY "MRN" ORDER BY ABS(DAYS(RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE) - DAYS("Pathology Procedure Date"))) RN FROM THYROID JOIN DV.RADIOLOGY_REPORT_V ON "MRN" = RRPT_MRN JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON "MRN" = PT_MRN WHERE RRPT_ORDER_GROUP = 'US' AND RRPT_ANC_CODE IN ('USTH', 'USBXTHY', 'USBXTHY', 'USBXTHYB', 'USTH') ) SELECT * FROM US WHERE RN = 1 ; WITH THYROID AS (SELECT "t1"."PT_MRN" AS "MRN", "t2"."PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_DESC" AS "Pathology Report Type", "t3"."PRPT_ACCESSION_NO" AS "Pathology Report", "t4"."DT_DTE" AS "Pathology Procedure Date", "t3"."PRPT_REPORT" AS "Pathology Report Text" FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V" "t1" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED" "t6" ON "t1"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t6"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V" "t3" ON "t6"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t3"."PRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATH_RPRT_TYPE_LOOKUP" "t2" ON "t3"."PRPT_REPORT_TYPE" = "t2"."PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_CD" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" "t4" ON "t3"."PRPT_PROCEDURE_DATE_ID" = "t4"."DT_DATE_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" "t5" ON "t3"."PRPT_REPORT_DATE_ID" = "t5"."DT_DATE_ID" WHERE "t2"."PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_DESC" IN ('Cytology-Non GYN', 'Cytology-Private Non-GYN') AND CONTAINS("t3"."PRPT_REPORT", '"papillary"') = 1 AND CONTAINS("t3"."PRPT_REPORT", '"Bethesda"') = 1 AND "t3"."PRPT_REPORT" IS NOT NULL AND "t4"."DT_DTE" BETWEEN '2018-01-01' AND '2018-12-31' ) SELECT "MRN", PT_LAST_NAME "Last Name", PT_FIRST_NAME "First Name", PRPT_ACCESSION_NO "Accession No", PRPT_PROCEDURE_DTE "Procedure Date", PRPT_REPORT_TYPE_DESC "Report Type", PRPT_REPORT "Report Text" FROM (SELECT DISTINCT "MRN" FROM THYROID) JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V P ON "MRN" = PRPT_MRN JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON "MRN" = PT_MRN WHERE CONTAINS(PRPT_REPORT, '"thyroid"') = 1 AND PRPT_REPORT_TYPE like 'S_%'
