prompt: 65+ patient being that live in Nassau and Suffolk County
completion: WITH BRE_DX AS (SELECT PT_MRN AS MRN, COALESCE(TM_DX_DTE, MIN_ICD9_EFF_DTE) AS FIRST_DX_DATE, CURRENT_AGE, YEAR (COALESCE(TM_DX_DTE, MIN_ICD9_EFF_DTE) - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) AS AGE_AT_DX, STAGE FROM (SELECT PT_MRN, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, TRIM(PT_LAST_NAME) AS LAST_NAME, TRIM(PT_FIRST_NAME) AS FIRST_NAME, YEAR (CURRENT DATE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) CURRENT_AGE, TM_DX_DTE, STAGE, MIN_ICD9_EFF_DTE FROM IDB.PATIENT LEFT JOIN (SELECT TM_MRN, TM_DX_DTE, TM_BEST_AJCC_STG AS STAGE FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS ON AV_ELEMENT = 'CASE_STS' AND AV_CODE = TM_CASE_STS AND TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND TM_SITE_CD IN ('C500', 'C501', 'C502', 'C503', 'C504', 'C505', 'C506', 'C508', 'C509')) AS CDB ON TM_MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN (SELECT CC_MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS MIN_ICD9_EFF_DTE FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE SUBSTR(CC_CLSF_CD, 1, 3) IN ('174', 'C50' ) AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND (CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) GROUP BY CC_MRN ) AS ICD9 ON CC_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE COALESCE(TM_MRN, CC_MRN) IS NOT NULL )), BRE_MRN AS (SELECT DISTINCT MRN FROM BRE_DX) , PTS AS (SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN, ZC_COUNTY FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PT_MRN =CPE_MRN JOIN BRE_MRN ON PT_MRN=MRN JOIN IDB.ZIPCODE ON ZC_ZIP = SUBSTR(PT_ZIP_CD, 1, 5) WHERE ZC_STATE = 'NY' AND ZC_COUNTY IN ('Suffolk', 'Nassau') AND YEAR (CURRENT DATE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) >=70 AND PT_DATE_OF_DEATH IS NULL) , PRIO_CHEMO AS (SELECT APR_MRN, MAX(CASE WHEN APR_ORD_RX_TYPE = 'Rx' THEN APR_START_DTE ELSE APR_END_DTE END) LAST_CHEMO_DATE, ZC_COUNTY FROM IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX_V JOIN PTS ON APR_MRN=PT_MRN WHERE APR_DRUG_PROCESS_STAGE <> 'H' AND CDG_CHEMO_FLAG = 'Y' AND CDG_DRUG_TYPE = 'Antineoplastics' GROUP BY APR_MRN, ZC_COUNTY) , PRIOR_CHEMO AS (SELECT * FROM PRIO_CHEMO WHERE LAST_CHEMO_DATE BETWEEN CURRENT DATE-6 MONTH AND CURRENT DATE) , UPCOMING_APPT AS (SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN, CPE_ENC_DTE FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN PTS ON CPE_MRN=PT_MRN WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS ='Sch' AND CPE_ENC_DTE > CURRENT DATE ) SELECT DISTINCT APR_MRN AS MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME , PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, YEAR (CURRENT DATE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) AS AGE, PT_STATE, ZC_COUNTY AS COUNTY, PT_CITY, LISTAGG(CPE_ENC_DTE, ' | ') WITHIN GROUP ( ORDER BY CPE_ENC_DTE) AS "Upcoming Appt" FROM PRIOR_CHEMO JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON APR_MRN =PT_MRN LEFT JOIN UPCOMING_APPT ON APR_MRN=CPE_MRN GROUP BY APR_MRN , PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, YEAR (CURRENT DATE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) , PT_STATE, ZC_COUNTY, PT_CITY

prompt: Provide a report of clinical data for a list of patients who received mosunetuzumab.
completion: WITH X AS (SELECT DISTINCT APR_MRN AS MRN, CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME, APR_DRUG_NAME, APR_START_DTE, APR_DIAGNOSIS_DESC FROM IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX_V WHERE CDG_CHEMO_FLAG = 'Y' AND(UPPER(APR_GENERIC_NAME) LIKE '%MOSUNETUZUMAB%' OR UPPER(APR_DRUG_NAME) LIKE '%MOSUNETUZUMAB%') ) , PATH AS (SELECT DISTINCT "t1"."PT_MRN" AS "MRN", "t2"."PRPT_ACCESSION_NO" AS "Pathology Report", "t3"."PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_DESC" AS "Pathology Report Type", "t4"."DT_DTE" AS "Pathology Procedure Date", UPPER(CASE WHEN LENGTH(PRPT_REPORT) <= 15000 THEN RTRIM(CAST(SUBSTR(PRPT_REPORT, 1, 15000) AS VARCHAR(15000))) ELSE CAST(SUBSTR(PRPT_REPORT, 1, 15000) AS VARCHAR(15000)) END) AS TXT FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V" "t1" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED" "t6" ON "t1"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t6"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V" "t2" ON "t6"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t2"."PRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATH_RPRT_TYPE_LOOKUP" "t3" ON "t2"."PRPT_REPORT_TYPE" = "t3"."PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_CD" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" "t4" ON "t2"."PRPT_PROCEDURE_DATE_ID" = "t4"."DT_DATE_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" "t5" ON "t2"."PRPT_REPORT_DATE_ID" = "t5"."DT_DATE_ID" WHERE 1=1 AND "t2"."PRPT_REPORT" IS NOT NULL AND "t1"."PT_MRN" IN (SELECT MRN FROM X) ) , SCANS AS (SELECT DISTINCT "t1"."PT_MRN" AS "MRN", "t2"."RRPT_ACCESSION_NO" AS "Radiology Accession Number", "t2"."RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE" AS "Radiology Performed Date", "t2"."RRPT_ORDER_GROUP" AS "Radiology Order Group", "t2"."RRPT_PROCEDURE_NAME" AS "Radiology Procedure Name", UPPER(DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)IMPRESSION:[\w\W]*(?=DICTATED BY:)', RRPT_REPORT_TXT)) AS IMPRESSION, UPPER(CASE WHEN LENGTH(RRPT_REPORT_TXT) <= 15000 THEN RTRIM(CAST(SUBSTR(RRPT_REPORT_TXT, 1, 15000) AS VARCHAR(15000))) ELSE CAST(SUBSTR(RRPT_REPORT_TXT, 1, 15000) AS VARCHAR(15000)) END) AS "PRPT_REPORT" FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V" "t1" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED" "t3" ON "t1"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t3"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."RADIOLOGY_REPORT_V" "t2" ON "t3"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t2"."RRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_IDENTIFICATION_MRN_V" "t4" ON "t1"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t4"."PI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" WHERE "t4"."PI_SOURCE_SYSTEM_PT_ID" IN (SELECT MRN FROM X) AND(UPPER("t2"."RRPT_ORDER_GROUP") like '%CT%' OR UPPER("t2"."RRPT_ORDER_GROUP") like '%PET%') ) , Z1 AS (SELECT DISTINCT LR_MRN AS MRN, LR_PERFORMED_DTE AS PERFORMED_DTE, LR_TEST_NAME AS TEST_NAME, LR_SUBTEST_NAME AS SUBTEST_NAME, LR_RESULT_VALUE AS RESULT_VALUE, LR_UNIT_MEASURE AS UNIT_MEASURE, LTL_LINE_NO AS LINE_NO, LTL_TEXT_RESULT AS TEXT_RESULT FROM X JOIN IDB.LAB_RESULTS ON LR_MRN = MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.LAB_TEXT_LINE ON LTL_RESULT_GUID = LR_RESULT_GUID AND LTL_LINE_NO = 1 WHERE 1=1 AND(UPPER(LR_SUBTEST_NAME) LIKE '%ABS LYMPH%' OR UPPER(LR_SUBTEST_NAME) LIKE '%ABS NEUT%' OR UPPER(LR_SUBTEST_NAME) LIKE 'CD3%' OR UPPER(LR_SUBTEST_NAME) LIKE 'CD4%' OR UPPER(LR_SUBTEST_NAME) LIKE 'CD%16%' OR UPPER(LR_SUBTEST_NAME) LIKE 'CD%19%' OR UPPER(LR_SUBTEST_NAME) LIKE 'CD%56%' OR UPPER(LR_TEST_NAME) LIKE '%CYTOKINE%PANEL%' OR UPPER(LR_TEST_NAME) LIKE '%CREACTIVE%PROTEIN%' OR UPPER(LR_SUBTEST_NAME) LIKE '%CREACTIVE%PROTEIN%' OR UPPER(LR_SUBTEST_NAME) LIKE 'IGG%' OR UPPER(LR_SUBTEST_NAME) LIKE 'IGM%' OR UPPER(LR_SUBTEST_NAME) LIKE 'IGA%' OR UPPER(LR_SUBTEST_NAME) LIKE 'IMMUNOGLOBULIN G%' OR UPPER(LR_SUBTEST_NAME) LIKE 'IMMUNOGLOBULIN M%' OR UPPER(LR_SUBTEST_NAME) LIKE 'IMMUNOGLOBULIN A%' OR LR_SUBTEST_NAME = 'Interferon-gamma (IFN-y) Serum' OR UPPER(LR_SUBTEST_NAME) LIKE '%PNEUMOCOCCAL%' OR UPPER(LR_SUBTEST_NAME) LIKE '%HEMOPHILUS%' OR UPPER(LR_SUBTEST_NAME) LIKE '%INFLUENZAE%' OR UPPER(LR_SUBTEST_NAME) LIKE '%TETANUS%' OR UPPER(LR_SUBTEST_NAME) LIKE '%POLIO%' OR UPPER(LR_SUBTEST_NAME) LIKE '%PERTUSSIS%' OR UPPER(LR_SUBTEST_NAME) LIKE 'HEP%B%' OR UPPER(LR_SUBTEST_NAME) LIKE 'HEP%C%' OR UPPER(LR_SUBTEST_NAME) LIKE '%HIV%' OR UPPER(LR_SUBTEST_NAME) LIKE '%HTLV%') AND UPPER(LR_SUBTEST_NAME) NOT LIKE 'CD30%' AND UPPER(LR_SUBTEST_NAME) NOT LIKE 'CD34%' AND UPPER(LR_SUBTEST_NAME) NOT LIKE 'CD38%' AND UPPER(LR_SUBTEST_NAME) NOT LIKE 'CD45%' ) SELECT * FROM Z1

prompt: Please create a metrics report of percentage (format: number per totals MRNs, % complete) of parameters completed in the Breast Follow Up ClinDoc. Please create a metrics report of each Breast Follow Up form as there have been a few versions over the years.
completion: SELECT * FROM (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CDD_MRN) AS MRN_COUNT FROM (SELECT CDD_MRN, CDD_ENTER_DTE, CDD_DOC_NAME, CDD_DOC_GUID, CDO_SECTION, CDO_ITEM_NAME FROM IDB.CD_DOCUMENT LEFT JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION ON CDD_DOC_GUID = CDO_DOC_GUID AND CDD_AUTHORED_DTE = CDO_AUTHORED_DTE AND CDO_VALUE_TEXT <> '')) AS COUNTER; SELECT * FROM (SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER () OVER (PARTITION BY CDD_MRN ORDER BY CDD_ENTER_DTE DESC) AS RN FROM (SELECT CDD_MRN, CDD_ENTER_DTE, CDD_DOC_NAME, CDD_DOC_GUID, CDO_SECTION, CDO_ITEM_NAME FROM IDB.CD_DOCUMENT LEFT JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION ON CDD_DOC_GUID = CDO_DOC_GUID AND CDD_AUTHORED_DTE = CDO_AUTHORED_DTE AND CDO_VALUE_TEXT <> '')) WHERE RN IN (1, 2);

prompt: Provide a list of patients from 2004-2018 that were seen by the dental service at MSKCC that received radiation therapy, resulting in osteoradionecrosis, reduced salivary function, and trismus.
completion: WITH PTS AS (SELECT DISTINCT RTC_TX_MRN MRN FROM IDB.RADONC_TREATMENT_COURSE JOIN IDB.CTC_CLSF ON CC_MRN = RTC_TX_MRN JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD AND (CC_CLSF_CD LIKE 'C0%' OR CC_CLSF_CD LIKE 'C1%') WHERE CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND (CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y') ) AND CC_EFF_DTE BETWEEN '2004-01-01' AND '2018-12-31' ) SELECT PT_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, PT_SEX, PT_DEATH_IND_DESC, PT_DATE_OF_DEATH FROM PTS JOIN IDB.PATIENT_V ON PT_MRN = MRN ; WITH PTS AS (SELECT DISTINCT RTC_TX_MRN MRN FROM IDB.RADONC_TREATMENT_COURSE JOIN IDB.CTC_CLSF ON CC_MRN = RTC_TX_MRN JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD AND (CC_CLSF_CD LIKE 'C0%' OR CC_CLSF_CD LIKE 'C1%') WHERE CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND (CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y') ) AND CC_EFF_DTE BETWEEN '2004-01-01' AND '2018-12-31' ) SELECT CC_MRN, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS MIN_ICD_EFF_DTE, YEAR(CC_EFF_DTE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) AGE_AT_DX, CC_CLSF_CD AS ICD_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS ICD_DESC FROM PTS JOIN IDB.CTC_CLSF ON CC_MRN = MRN JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PT_MRN = MRN WHERE CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND (CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y') ) AND (CC_CLSF_CD LIKE 'C0%' OR CC_CLSF_CD LIKE 'C1%') GROUP BY CC_MRN, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, YEAR(CC_EFF_DTE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH), CC_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK ; WITH PTS AS (SELECT DISTINCT RTC_TX_MRN MRN FROM IDB.RADONC_TREATMENT_COURSE JOIN IDB.CTC_CLSF ON CC_MRN = RTC_TX_MRN JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD AND (CC_CLSF_CD LIKE 'C0%' OR CC_CLSF_CD LIKE 'C1%') WHERE CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND (CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y') ) AND CC_EFF_DTE BETWEEN '2004-01-01' AND '2018-12-31' ) SELECT DISTINCT TM_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, CASE_STS.AV_DESC AS CASE_STS, TM_DX_DTE, TM_HIST_CD, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS HIST_DESC, TM_SITE_CD, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_DESC, TM_HIST_CD_GRADE, HIST_CD_GRADE.AV_DESC AS HIST_GRADE, TM_TSTAGE, TSTAGES.AV_DESC AS TSTAGE, TM_NSTAGE, NSTAGES.AV_DESC AS NSTAGE, TM_MSTAGE, MSTAGES.AV_DESC AS MSTAGE, MSK_STAGES.AV_DESC AS STAGE, TM_MSK_STG STG_PRESENTED_AT_MSK, CDB_AV_DESC STG_PRESENTED_AT_MSK_DESC, TM_CSSIZE FROM PTS JOIN IDB.CDB_TUMOR ON MRN = TM_MRN JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS CASE_STS ON CASE_STS.AV_ELEMENT = 'CASE_STS' AND CASE_STS.AV_CODE = TM_CASE_STS AND TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS HIST_CD_GRADE ON TM_HIST_CD_GRADE = HIST_CD_GRADE.AV_CODE AND HIST_CD_GRADE.AV_ELEMENT='HIST_CD_GRADE' JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PT_MRN=TM_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS TSTAGES ON TSTAGES.AV_ELEMENT='TSTAGE' AND TSTAGES.AV_CODE=TM_TSTAGE LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS NSTAGES ON NSTAGES.AV_ELEMENT='NSTAGE' AND NSTAGES.AV_CODE=TM_NSTAGE LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS MSTAGES ON MSTAGES.AV_ELEMENT='MSTAGE' AND MSTAGES.AV_CODE=TM_MSTAGE LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS MSK_STAGES ON MSK_STAGES.AV_ELEMENT='MSK_STAGE' AND MSK_STAGES.AV_CODE=TM_MSK_STG LEFT JOIN IDB.CDB_ALLOWVALS ON CDB_AV_ELEMENT = 'GENERAL_STG' AND CDB_AV_CD_STS = 'A' AND TM_MSK_STG = CDB_AV_CODE ; WITH PTS AS (SELECT DISTINCT RTC_TX_MRN MRN FROM IDB.RADONC_TREATMENT_COURSE JOIN IDB.CTC_CLSF ON CC_MRN = RTC_TX_MRN JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD AND (CC_CLSF_CD LIKE 'C0%' OR CC_CLSF_CD LIKE 'C1%') WHERE CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND (CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y') ) AND CC_EFF_DTE BETWEEN '2004-01-01' AND '2018-12-31' ) SELECT RTC_TX_MRN, RTC_TX_COURSE_NO, RTC_TX_PLANSETUP_NO, RTC_TX_COURSE_ID, RTC_TX_PLAN_NAME, RTC_TX_PLANNED_FRACTIONS, RTC_TX_DELIVERED_FRACTIONS, RTC_TX_PLANNED_DOSE, RTC_TX_DELIVERED_DOSE, RTC_TX_START_DTE, RTC_TX_STOP_DTE, RTC_TX_ELAPSED_DAYS, RTC_PRIMARY_REF_POINT, RTC_DOSE_CORRECTION FROM PTS JOIN IDB.RADONC_TREATMENT_COURSE ON RTC_TX_MRN = MRN ; WITH PTS AS (SELECT DISTINCT RTC_TX_MRN MRN FROM IDB.RADONC_TREATMENT_COURSE JOIN IDB.CTC_CLSF ON CC_MRN = RTC_TX_MRN JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD AND (CC_CLSF_CD LIKE 'C0%' OR CC_CLSF_CD LIKE 'C1%') WHERE CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND (CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y') ) AND CC_EFF_DTE BETWEEN '2004-01-01' AND '2018-12-31' ) SELECT APR_MRN, APR_START_DTE, APR_GENERIC_NAME, APR_PRESCRIBED_DOSE, APR_ROUTE FROM PTS JOIN IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX ON MRN= APR_MRN ; WITH PTS AS (SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN MRN, DXCC_ICD_CODE FROM DV.RADONC_TREATMENT_COURSE JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON RTC_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID JOIN DV.PATIENT_DIAGNOSIS_FINAL_ALL_V ON PDX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID JOIN DV.DATE_V ON PDX_DX_DATE_ID = DT_DATE_ID JOIN DV.DIAGNOSIS_CATALOG ON PDX_DX_CATALOG_ID = DXCC_DX_CATALOG_ID WHERE (DXCC_ICD_CODE LIKE 'C0%' OR DXCC_ICD_CODE LIKE 'C1%') AND DT_DTE BETWEEN '2004-01-01' AND '2018-12-31' ) SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN AS "MRN", PT_LAST_NAME "LAST NAME", PT_FIRST_NAME "FIRST NAME", PCC_CODE AS "CPT CODE", PCC_DESC AS "CPT DESC", DT_DTE AS "PROCEDURE DATE" FROM PTS JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON MRN = PT_MRN JOIN DV.CPT_PBD_PATIENT_PROCEDURE ON PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PTX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID JOIN DV.DATE ON PTX_PROC_DATE_ID = DT_DATE_ID WHERE PCC_CODE IN ('70355') ; WITH PTS AS (SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN MRN, DXCC_ICD_CODE FROM DV.RADONC_TREATMENT_COURSE JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON RTC_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID JOIN DV.PATIENT_DIAGNOSIS_FINAL_ALL_V ON PDX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID JOIN DV.DATE_V ON PDX_DX_DATE_ID = DT_DATE_ID JOIN DV.DIAGNOSIS_CATALOG ON PDX_DX_CATALOG_ID = DXCC_DX_CATALOG_ID WHERE (DXCC_ICD_CODE LIKE 'C0%' OR DXCC_ICD_CODE LIKE 'C1%') AND DT_DTE BETWEEN '2004-01-01' AND '2018-12-31' ) SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN AS "MRN", PT_LAST_NAME "LAST NAME", PT_FIRST_NAME "FIRST NAME", PCC_CODE AS "CPT CODE", PCC_DESC AS "CPT DESC", DT_DTE AS "PROCEDURE DATE" FROM PTS JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON MRN = PT_MRN JOIN DV.CPT_PBD_PATIENT_PROCEDURE ON PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PTX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID JOIN DV.DATE ON PTX_PROC_DATE_ID = DT_DATE_ID WHERE PCC_CODE IN ('99201', '99202', '99203', '99204', '99205') ; WITH PTS AS (SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN MRN, DXCC_ICD_CODE FROM DV.RADONC_TREATMENT_COURSE JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON RTC_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID JOIN DV.PATIENT_DIAGNOSIS_FINAL_ALL_V ON PDX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID JOIN DV.DATE_V ON PDX_DX_DATE_ID = DT_DATE_ID JOIN DV.DIAGNOSIS_CATALOG ON PDX_DX_CATALOG_ID = DXCC_DX_CATALOG_ID WHERE (DXCC_ICD_CODE LIKE 'C0%' OR DXCC_ICD_CODE LIKE 'C1%') AND DT_DTE BETWEEN '2004-01-01' AND '2018-12-31' ) SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN AS "MRN", PT_LAST_NAME "LAST NAME", PT_FIRST_NAME "FIRST NAME", PCC_CODE AS "CPT CODE", PCC_DESC AS "CPT DESC", DT_DTE AS "PROCEDURE DATE" FROM PTS JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON MRN = PT_MRN JOIN DV.CPT_PBD_PATIENT_PROCEDURE ON PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PTX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID JOIN DV.DATE ON PTX_PROC_DATE_ID = DT_DATE_ID WHERE PCC_CODE IN ('99212', '99213', '99214', '99215') ; WITH PTS AS (SELECT DISTINCT RTC_TX_MRN MRN FROM IDB.RADONC_TREATMENT_COURSE JOIN IDB.CTC_CLSF ON CC_MRN = RTC_TX_MRN JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD AND (CC_CLSF_CD LIKE 'C0%' OR CC_CLSF_CD LIKE 'C1%') WHERE CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND (CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y') ) AND CC_EFF_DTE BETWEEN '2004-01-01' AND '2018-12-31' ) SELECT CC_MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS MIN_ICD_EFF_DTE, CC_CLSF_CD AS ICD_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS ICD_DESC FROM PTS JOIN IDB.CTC_CLSF ON CC_MRN = MRN JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND (CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y') ) AND SUBSTR(CC_CLSF_CD, 1, 3) IN ('250', 'E11') GROUP BY CC_MRN, CC_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK ;

prompt: provide monthly count for the number of Foreign Breast Submissions received at Bergen Breast Radiology. The attendings that would be submitting these requests are Dr. Montagna and Dr. Mamtani
completion: WITH BREAST_SUBMISSIONS AS (SELECT DISTINCT "t1"."PT_MRN" AS MRN, "t2"."RRPT_ACCESSION_NO" AS RADIOLOGY_ACCESSION_NUMBER, "t2"."RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE" AS RADIOLOGY_PERFORMED_DATE, "t2"."RRPT_REPORT_DTE" AS RADIOLOGY_REPORT_DATE, "t2"."RRPT_ORDER_GROUP" AS RADIOLOGY_ORDER_GROUP, "t2"."RRPT_PROCEDURE_NAME" AS RADIOLOGY_PROCEDURE_NAME, UPPER(DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)IMPRESSION:[\w\W]*(?=DICTATED BY:)', RRPT_REPORT_TXT)) AS IMPRESSION, UPPER(CASE WHEN LENGTH(RRPT_REPORT_TXT) <= 15000 THEN RTRIM(CAST(SUBSTR(RRPT_REPORT_TXT, 1, 15000) AS VARCHAR(15000))) ELSE CAST(SUBSTR(RRPT_REPORT_TXT, 1, 15000) AS VARCHAR(15000)) END) AS PRPT_REPORT FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V" "t1" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED" "t3" ON "t1"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t3"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."RADIOLOGY_REPORT_V" "t2" ON "t3"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t2"."RRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_IDENTIFICATION_MRN_V" "t4" ON "t1"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t4"."PI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" WHERE 1 = 1 AND UPPER("t2"."RRPT_PROCEDURE_NAME") like '%FOREIGN%' AND UPPER("t2"."RRPT_PROCEDURE_NAME") like '%BREAST%' ), PROVIDERS AS (SELECT CPE_MRN, CRE_RES_NAME AS PROVIDER_NAME, CLD_CLD_CENTER AS CENTER, CLD_DEPT_NAME, OVL_MRN, OL_LOC_CD, OL_LOC_NAME, OL_LOC_HL7_CD FROM IDB.CL_RESOURCE JOIN IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.OMS_VISIT_LOCATION ON CPE_MRN = OVL_MRN JOIN IDB.OMS_LOCATION ON OL_LOC_GUID = OVL_LOC_GUID WHERE CRE_RES_NAME IN ('MONTAGNA, GIACOMO', 'MAMTANI, ANITA') AND UPPER(OL_LOC_NAME) LIKE ('%BERGEN%') AND OL_IS_LOC_GRP = 'Y' ) SELECT DISTINCT MRN, RADIOLOGY_ACCESSION_NUMBER, RADIOLOGY_PERFORMED_DATE, RADIOLOGY_ORDER_GROUP, RADIOLOGY_PROCEDURE_NAME, IMPRESSION, PRPT_REPORT, PROVIDER_NAME, CENTER, CLD_DEPT_NAME, OL_LOC_CD, OL_LOC_NAME, OL_LOC_HL7_CD FROM BREAST_SUBMISSIONS JOIN PROVIDERS ON MRN = CPE_MRN

prompt: Provide monthly report of all Microbiology tests for C. difficile  taken from inpatient locations or from Urgent Care.
completion: WITH INF AS (SELECT OO_VISIT_GUID VISIT_GUID, OO_ORD_GUID ORD_GUID, OO_ACCT_NO, OO_MRN MRN, STRIP(PT_LAST_NAME)||', '||STRIP(PT_FIRST_NAME) PT_NAME, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH DOB, PT_SEX SEX , OCV_ADM_DT ADM_DT, OCV_DSCH_DT DSCH_DT, OCV_IP_OP_IND IP_OP, OCV_CURR_LOC AS CURR_LOC, OO_ORD_ID ORD_ID, OO_ORD_NAME ORD_NAME, OO_ENTER_DTE, OP_TASK_ROLE_TYPE PVDR_ROLE, OP_DISPLAY_NAME ORD_PVDR, RSLT.LR_ACCESSION_NO ACCESS_NO, RSLT.LR_TEST_NAME TEST_NAME, RSLT.LR_SUBTEST_NAME CULTURE, CULTR.LTL_TEXT_RESULT CULT_RESULT, SPES.LR_SUBTEST_NAME SPECIMEN, SPESR.LTL_TEXT_RESULT SPECIMEN_DESC, RSLT.LR_PERFORMED_DT LAB_COLLECTION_DT, OO_PERFORMED_DT COLLECTION_DT, OO_ENTER_DT ORD_ENTER_DT, OO_ORD_STS_CD FROM IDB.OMS_ORDER JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON OO_MRN = PT_MRN AND OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID = '9000006287100730' JOIN IDB.OMS_PROVIDER ON OO_PVDR_GUID = OP_PVDR_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_CLIENT_VISIT ON OO_VISIT_GUID = OCV_VISIT_GUID JOIN IDB.LAB_RESULTS RSLT ON OO_ORD_GUID = RSLT.LR_ORD_GUID AND RSLT.LR_TEST_NAME = 'C. Difficile PCR' AND RSLT.LR_SUBTEST_NAME = 'Result' JOIN IDB.LAB_TEXT_LINE CULTR ON RSLT.LR_RESULT_GUID = CULTR.LTL_RESULT_GUID AND CULTR.LTL_LINE_NO = 1 JOIN IDB.LAB_RESULTS SPES ON OO_ORD_GUID = SPES.LR_ORD_GUID AND SPES.LR_TEST_NAME = 'C. Difficile PCR' AND SPES.LR_SUBTEST_NAME = 'Specimen Description' JOIN IDB.LAB_TEXT_LINE SPESR ON SPES.LR_RESULT_GUID = SPESR.LTL_RESULT_GUID AND SPESR.LTL_LINE_NO = 1 WHERE OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE >= CURRENT DATE - 2 MONTH - DAY(CURRENT DATE - 2 MONTHS)DAYS + 1 DAYS AND OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE <= LAST_DAY(CURRENT DATE - 2 MONTHS) AND CULTR.LTL_TEXT_RESULT NOT LIKE 'NEGATIVE %' ) , ORD_LOC AS (SELECT DISTINCT INF.VISIT_GUID, INF.ORD_GUID, INF.MRN, INF.ORD_ENTER_DT, TVL.OVL_CREATE_DT ORD_CR_DTE, TVL.OVL_EFF_DT ORD_EFF_DTE, TVL.OVL_CHNG_DT ORD_CHG_DT, TLOC.OL_LOC_NAME ORD_LOCATION FROM INF JOIN IDB.OMS_VISIT_LOCATION TVL ON VISIT_GUID = TVL.OVL_VISIT_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_LOCATION TLOC ON TVL.OVL_LOC_GUID = TLOC.OL_LOC_GUID AND TVL.OVL_EFF_DT = (SELECT MAX(OVL_EFF_DT) FROM IDB.OMS_VISIT_LOCATION WHERE OVL_VISIT_GUID = TVL.OVL_VISIT_GUID AND INF.ORD_ENTER_DT >= OVL_EFF_DT )) , PAST_ADM AS (SELECT MRN, MAX(CS_DSCH_DATE) PRIOR_DSCH FROM INF JOIN IDB.CASE ON MRN = CS_MRN AND SUBSTR(CS_ACCT_NO, 1, 2) = '84' AND CS_ACCT_NO <> OO_ACCT_NO AND CS_PT_STS LIKE 'I%' AND CS_PT_TYPE <> 'IP' AND CS_DSCH_DATE BETWEEN COALESCE(DATE(DSCH_DT), OO_ENTER_DTE) - 3 MONTH AND COALESCE(DATE(DSCH_DT), OO_ENTER_DTE) GROUP BY MRN) SELECT DISTINCT INF.VISIT_GUID, INF.ORD_GUID, INF.OO_ACCT_NO, INF.MRN, INF.PT_NAME, INF.DOB, INF.SEX, INF.ADM_DT, INF.DSCH_DT, INF.IP_OP, INF.ORD_ID, INF.ORD_NAME, INF.ORD_PVDR , INF.ACCESS_NO, INF.TEST_NAME, INF.CULTURE, INF.CULT_RESULT, INF.SPECIMEN, INF.SPECIMEN_DESC, INF.LAB_COLLECTION_DT, INF.COLLECTION_DT, INF.ORD_ENTER_DT, ORD_LOC.ORD_EFF_DTE, CASE WHEN ORD_LOC.ORD_LOCATION IS NULL THEN CURR_LOC ELSE ORD_LOC.ORD_LOCATION END ORD_LOCATION, PRIOR_DSCH FROM INF JOIN ORD_LOC ORD_LOC ON INF.MRN = ORD_LOC.MRN AND INF.VISIT_GUID = ORD_LOC.VISIT_GUID AND INF.ORD_GUID = ORD_LOC.ORD_GUID AND (INF.IP_OP = 'I' OR (CASE WHEN ORD_LOC.ORD_LOCATION IS NULL THEN CURR_LOC ELSE ORD_LOC.ORD_LOCATION END) LIKE 'UCC%') LEFT JOIN PAST_ADM ADM ON INF.MRN = ADM.MRN

prompt: Provide the number of Lymphoma outpatient visits and patients that were diagnosed with large cell lymphoma or Hodgkins disease.
completion: SELECT COUNT(CPE_ENC_CSN_ID) AS VISITS , COUNT(DISTINCT CPE_MRN) AS PATIENTS FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CRE_RES_ID = CPE_VST_RES_ID AND CRE_RES_TYP IN ('Physician', 'PhD', 'Psychologist') JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 = 'MED' AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 = 'LYM' JOIN IDB.CTC_CLSF ON CPE_MRN = CC_MRN AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND CC_EFF_DTE BETWEEN '2009-01-01' AND '2009-12-31' AND (CC_CLSF_CD BETWEEN '200.7' AND '200.78' OR CC_CLSF_CD IN ('201.50', '201.51')) AND (CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) WHERE CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN '2009-01-01' AND '2009-12-31' AND CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CPE_CPE_IP_IND <> 'INPATIENT'

prompt: A list of clinical data associated with a list of MRNs that have been consented to 12-245 Part A and C.
completion: WITH DEMOGRAPHICS_0 AS (SELECT DISTINCT "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AS PT_DEID, IDB_PATIENT."PT_MRN" AS PT_MRN, "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AS SUBJECT_ID FROM "IDB"."PATIENT" AS IDB_PATIENT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS" ON IDB_PATIENT."PT_MRN" = "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_MRN" WHERE IDB_PATIENT."PT_MRN" IN ('35454305', '35446068', '35085766', '00219527', '35168431', '35459308', '35496025', '35497360', '35498943', '00900840', '35494690', '38241237', '38244733')), PROTOCOL_1 AS (SELECT "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AS PT_DEID, "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_MRN" AS PT_MRN, CAST(TRIM("IDB"."ACCRUALS"."AC_CONS_DTE") AS VARCHAR) || CAST(TRIM("IDB"."ACCRUALS"."AC_MRN") AS VARCHAR) || CAST(TRIM("IDB"."ACCRUALS"."AC_IRB_NO") AS VARCHAR) AS SUBJECT_ID, "IDB"."ACCRUALS"."AC_IRB_NO" AS AC_IRB_NO FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS" JOIN "IDB"."ACCRUALS" ON "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_MRN" = "IDB"."ACCRUALS"."AC_MRN" WHERE "IDB"."ACCRUALS"."AC_NON_MSK_INST" = '' AND "IDB"."ACCRUALS"."AC_IRB_NO" IN ('12-245')), COHORT AS (SELECT PT_DEID AS PT_DEID FROM (SELECT DEMOGRAPHICS_0.PT_DEID AS PT_DEID FROM DEMOGRAPHICS_0 INTERSECT SELECT PROTOCOL_1.PT_DEID AS PT_DEID FROM PROTOCOL_1)), COHORT_PROTOCOL AS (SELECT SUBJECT_ID AS SUBJECT_ID, PT_DEID AS PT_DEID FROM (SELECT PROTOCOL_1.SUBJECT_ID AS SUBJECT_ID, PROTOCOL_1.PT_DEID AS PT_DEID FROM PROTOCOL_1)), KEYS AS (SELECT COHORT.PT_DEID AS COHORT_PT_DEID, COHORT_PROTOCOL.SUBJECT_ID AS COHORT_PROTOCOL_SUBJECT_ID, COHORT_PROTOCOL.PT_DEID AS COHORT_PROTOCOL_PT_DEID FROM COHORT LEFT OUTER JOIN COHORT_PROTOCOL ON COHORT_PROTOCOL.PT_DEID = COHORT.PT_DEID), DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS AS (SELECT DISTINCT "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AS PT_DEID, IDB_PATIENT."PT_MRN" AS PT_MRN, "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AS SUBJECT_ID FROM "IDB"."PATIENT" AS IDB_PATIENT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS" ON IDB_PATIENT."PT_MRN" = "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_MRN"), PROTOCOL_COLUMNS AS (SELECT DISTINCT "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AS PT_DEID, "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_MRN" AS PT_MRN, CAST(TRIM("IDB"."ACCRUALS"."AC_CONS_DTE") AS VARCHAR) || CAST(TRIM("IDB"."ACCRUALS"."AC_MRN") AS VARCHAR) || CAST(TRIM("IDB"."ACCRUALS"."AC_IRB_NO") AS VARCHAR) AS SUBJECT_ID, "IDB"."ACCRUALS"."AC_CONS_DTE" AS AC_CONS_DTE, "IDB"."ACCRUALS"."AC_IRB_NO" AS AC_IRB_NO, "IDB"."PROTOCOL"."PRO_IRB_TITLE" AS PRO_IRB_TITLE FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS" JOIN "IDB"."ACCRUALS" ON "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_MRN" = "IDB"."ACCRUALS"."AC_MRN" JOIN "IDB"."PROTOCOL" ON "IDB"."ACCRUALS"."AC_IRB_NO" = "IDB"."PROTOCOL"."PRO_IRB_NO") SELECT DISTINCT DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS.PT_MRN AS MRN, PROTOCOL_COLUMNS.AC_CONS_DTE AS AC_CONS_DTE, PROTOCOL_COLUMNS.AC_IRB_NO AS AC_IRB_NO, PROTOCOL_COLUMNS.PRO_IRB_TITLE AS PRO_IRB_TITLE FROM KEYS LEFT OUTER JOIN DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS ON DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS.PT_DEID = KEYS.COHORT_PT_DEID LEFT OUTER JOIN PROTOCOL_COLUMNS ON PROTOCOL_COLUMNS.SUBJECT_ID = KEYS.COHORT_PROTOCOL_SUBJECT_ID;

prompt: We are submitting a request to complete a secondary analysis of this prospective randomized study (we have existing data-tables), to analyze cause of death and cost-effectiveness.
completion: WITH PT_INFO AS (SELECT PT_MRN, AC_IRB_NO, AC_CONS_DTE, PLA_LST_ACTV_DTE, PT_DATE_OF_DEATH, CAST(PT_DEATH_INFO_SOURCE_CD AS VARCHAR (100)), ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY PT_MRN ORDER BY PLA_LST_ACTV_DTE DESC) RN FROM IDB.PATIENT JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY ON PT_MRN = PLA_MRN JOIN IDB.ACCRUALS ON PT_MRN = AC_MRN AND AC_IRB_NO = '18-196' ), NOTE AS (SELECT CDD_MRN AS MRN, CDD_SERVICE_DTE AS NOTE_DATE, CDD_DOC_GUID AS DOCUMENT_GUID, CDD_DOC_NAME AS DOCUMENT_NAME, CAST(CDO_VALUE_TEXT AS VARCHAR (1155)) AS NOTE FROM IDB.CD_DOCUMENT JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION ON CDD_DOC_GUID = CDO_DOC_GUID WHERE 1 = 1 AND CDD_DOC_NAME IN 'Discharge Note/Summary' AND TRIM(CDO_VALUE_TEXT) > '' ) SELECT PT_MRN, AC_IRB_NO, AC_CONS_DTE, PLA_LST_ACTV_DTE, PT_DATE_OF_DEATH, MRN, NOTE_DATE, DOCUMENT_GUID, DOCUMENT_NAME, NOTE FROM PT_INFO LEFT JOIN NOTE ON PT_MRN = MRN AND PT_DATE_OF_DEATH = NOTE_DATE ; WITH PT_INFO AS (SELECT PT_MRN, AC_IRB_NO, AC_CONS_DTE, PLA_LST_ACTV_DTE, PT_DATE_OF_DEATH, CAST(PT_DEATH_INFO_SOURCE_CD AS VARCHAR (100)), ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY PT_MRN ORDER BY PLA_LST_ACTV_DTE DESC) RN FROM IDB.PATIENT JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY ON PT_MRN = PLA_MRN JOIN IDB.ACCRUALS ON PT_MRN = AC_MRN AND AC_IRB_NO = '18-196' AND PT_MRN NOT IN 'ZZZZZZZZ'), NOTE AS (SELECT CDD_MRN AS MRN, CDD_SERVICE_DTE AS NOTE_DATE, CDD_DOC_GUID AS DOCUMENT_GUID, CDD_DOC_NAME AS DOCUMENT_NAME, MAX(CASE WHEN CDO_OBS_CTLG_MSTR_ITEM_GUID = '9000116962502890' THEN SUBSTR(TRIM(CDO_VALUE_TEXT), 1, 155) END) IMMEDIATE_CAUSE_OF_DEATH, MAX(CASE WHEN CDO_OBS_CTLG_MSTR_ITEM_GUID = '9000006422302890' THEN SUBSTR(TRIM(CDO_VALUE_TEXT), 1, 55) END) TIME_OF_DEATH, MAX(CASE WHEN CDO_OBS_CTLG_MSTR_ITEM_GUID = '9000006416502890' THEN SUBSTR(TRIM(CDO_VALUE_TEXT), 1, 255) END) PHYSICAL_EXAM_NOTABLE FROM IDB.CD_DOCUMENT JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION ON CDD_DOC_GUID = CDO_DOC_GUID WHERE CDD_DOC_NAME = 'Death Note' AND TRIM(CDO_VALUE_TEXT) > '' GROUP BY CDD_MRN, CDD_SERVICE_DTE, CDD_DOC_GUID, CDD_DOC_NAME ORDER BY 2) SELECT PT_MRN, AC_IRB_NO, AC_CONS_DTE, PLA_LST_ACTV_DTE, PT_DATE_OF_DEATH, MRN, NOTE_DATE, DOCUMENT_GUID, DOCUMENT_NAME, IMMEDIATE_CAUSE_OF_DEATH, TIME_OF_DEATH, PHYSICAL_EXAM_NOTABLE FROM PT_INFO LEFT JOIN NOTE ON PT_MRN = MRN ; WITH PT_INFO AS (SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN, AC_IRB_NO, AC_CONS_DTE, PLA_LST_ACTV_DTE, PT_DATE_OF_DEATH, CAST(PT_DEATH_INFO_SOURCE_CD AS VARCHAR (100)), ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY PT_MRN ORDER BY PLA_LST_ACTV_DTE DESC) RN, SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD, SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC, SSE_SURG_DTE FROM IDB.PATIENT JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY ON PT_MRN = PLA_MRN JOIN IDB.ACCRUALS ON PT_MRN = AC_MRN AND AC_IRB_NO = '18-196' AND PT_MRN NOT IN 'ZZZZZZZZ' JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT ON PT_MRN = SSE_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE ON SSE_LOG_ID = SSP_LOG_ID WHERE 1 = 1 AND AC_CONS_DTE <= SSE_SURG_DTE ), NOTE AS (SELECT CDD_MRN AS MRN, CDD_SERVICE_DTE AS NOTE_DATE, CDD_DOC_GUID AS DOCUMENT_GUID, CDD_DOC_NAME AS DOCUMENT_NAME, CAST(CDO_VALUE_TEXT AS VARCHAR (1155)) AS NOTE FROM IDB.CD_DOCUMENT JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION ON CDD_DOC_GUID = CDO_DOC_GUID WHERE 1 = 1 AND CDD_DOC_NAME IN 'Discharge Note/Summary' AND TRIM(CDO_VALUE_TEXT) > '' ) SELECT PT_MRN, AC_IRB_NO, AC_CONS_DTE, PLA_LST_ACTV_DTE, PT_DATE_OF_DEATH, MRN, NOTE_DATE, DOCUMENT_GUID, DOCUMENT_NAME, NOTE, SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD, SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC, SSE_SURG_DTE FROM PT_INFO LEFT JOIN NOTE ON PT_MRN = MRN AND PT_DATE_OF_DEATH = NOTE_DATE ;

prompt: Provide a list of dosing information for MSK patients who received enfortumab vedotin
completion: SELECT MRN, PT_NAME, PT_AGE, CURR_LOC, IP_OP_IND, ORD_NAME, ORD_STS , DRUG_NAME, DOSE, DOSE_UOM, INFUSION_RATE, TOT_VOL_NO , TOT_VOL_UOM, START_DATE, STOP_DATE, PT_WT , PT_HT, PT_BSA, ROUTE, ORD_FREQ, SET_NAME FROM IDB.SRX_PHARMACY_SUM WHERE ORD_NAME IN('enFORtumab vedotin (ASG-22CE) INVEST', 'enFORtumab vedotin-ejfv INJ', 'enFORtumab vedotin-ejfv INJ (Pt Free Supply)') ORDER BY MRN, START_DATE ;

prompt: A report of H14551 for all of 2017
completion: SELECT DISTINCT RTRIM(PT_MRN) "MRN", RTRIM(PT_LAST_NAME) "Patient Last Name", RTRIM(PT_FIRST_NAME) "Patient First Name", RTRIM(DOC_NAME) "Doctor Name", OOS_CREATE_DT "Order Set Date and Time" FROM IDB.OMS_ORDER_SET JOIN IDB.OMS_ORDER ON OOS_SET_GUID = OO_SET_GUID JOIN IDB.DOC ON OO_REQ_DR_NO = DOC_DR_NO JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PT_MRN = OO_MRN WHERE OOS_SET_NAME = 'IP_Compartment Syndrome' AND OO_ENTER_DTE BETWEEN '2017-01-01' AND '2017-12-31' ORDER BY 5

prompt: Provide a weekday report of all female patients ages 11-55 who are scheduled for an MR, CT, or X-ray the next day (or next three days on Friday) who do not have a Pregnancy Exemption Order ordered.
completion: SELECT PT_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, CRE_RES_NAME, CPE_ENC_DTE, TIME(CPE_APPT_DT) AS ENC_TIME, CASE WHEN SUBSTR(CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME, 1, 2) = 'CT' THEN 'CT' WHEN SUBSTR(CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME, 1, 2) = 'MR' THEN 'MRI' WHEN SUBSTR(CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME, 1, 2) = 'XR' THEN 'XRAY' END AS MODALITY, CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME, MAX(CASE WHEN OO_MRN IS NOT NULL THEN 'Y' ELSE '' END) AS PREG_HOLD FROM IDB.PATIENT JOIN IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER ON PT_MRN = CPE_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_ORDER ON OO_MRN = PT_MRN AND OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID = '9000006089100730' AND OO_ORD_STS_CD = 'HOLD' WHERE PT_SEX = 'F' AND YEAR(CPE_ENC_DTE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) BETWEEN 11 AND 55 AND CPE_CPE_APPT_STS = 'Sch' AND (CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME LIKE 'CT%' OR CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME LIKE 'MR%' AND CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME <> 'MRN REQUEST' OR CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME LIKE 'XR%') AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT DATE + 1 DAY AND CASE WHEN DAYOFWEEK(CURRENT DATE) = 6 THEN CURRENT DATE + 3 DAYS ELSE CURRENT DATE + 1 DAY END AND CPE_ENC_DTE >= CURRENT DATE + 1 DAY AND PT_MRN NOT IN (SELECT OO_MRN FROM IDB.OMS_ORDER WHERE OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID = '9000006089100730' AND OO_ORD_STS_CD = 'AUA2') GROUP BY PT_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, CRE_RES_NAME, CPE_ENC_DTE, TIME(CPE_APPT_DT), CASE WHEN SUBSTR(CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME, 1, 2) = 'CT' THEN 'CT' WHEN SUBSTR(CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME, 1, 2) = 'MR' THEN 'MRI' WHEN SUBSTR(CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME, 1, 2) = 'XR' THEN 'XRAY' END, CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME

prompt: New visit patients seen by thoracic medical oncology with NSCLC

CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME VISIT_TYPE, CLM_CLSF_CD ICD10_CODE, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK CODE_DSC FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CRE_RES_ID = CPE_VST_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID JOIN IDB.CL_PATIENT ON CPE_PRK = CL_PRK JOIN IDB.PBD_DTL ON CPE_MRN = PBD_MRN AND CPE_ENC_DTE = PBD_SVC_DTE JOIN IDB.PBD_INVOICE ON PBI_MRN = PBD_MRN AND PBI_INV_NO = PBD_INV_NO AND PBI_PERFORM_DR_NO = CPE_VST_RES_ID JOIN IDB.PBD_DX ON DX_MRN = PBI_MRN AND DX_INV_NO = PBI_INV_NO AND DX_CLSF_CD LIKE 'C34%' JOIN IDB.CLM ON DX_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE 1=1 AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN '2022-07-01' AND '2022-07-30' AND (CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR like '%NV%' OR CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR LIKE '%IR%') AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 = 'MED' AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 = 'THR' AND CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Comp', 'Arrived') AND CRE_RES_TYP IN ('Physician', 'Advanced Practice Nurse', 'Dentist', 'PhD', 'Psychologist', 'Physician Assistant', 'Nurse Practitioner') ) , HIST AS (SELECT DISTINCT TM_MRN , TM_DX_DTE AS HIST_DX_DTE, TM_HIST_CD AS HIST_CD, TM_BEST_AJCC_STG AS STAGE FROM APPTS JOIN IDB.CDB_TUMOR ON MRN = TM_MRN JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS C ON C.AV_ELEMENT = 'CASE_STS' AND C.AV_CODE = TM_CASE_STS WHERE 1=1 AND TM_CASE_STS IN ('3', '6', '7', '8') AND TM_SITE_CD LIKE 'C34%' AND TM_HIST_CD IN ('M8013/3', 'M8014/3', 'M8022/3', 'M8030/3', 'M8031/3', 'M8032/3', 'M8033/3', 'M8046/3', 'M8052/2', 'M8052/3', 'M8070/2', 'M8070/3', 'M8071/2', 'M8071/3', 'M8072/3', 'M8073/3', 'M8074/2', 'M8074/3', 'M8083/3', 'M8140/2', 'M8140/3', 'M8250/2', 'M8250/3', 'M8251/3', 'M8252/3', 'M8253/3', 'M8254/3', 'M8255/3', 'M8260/2', 'M8260/3', 'M8310/3', 'M8333/3', 'M8480/2', 'M8480/3', 'M8481/3', 'M8490/2', 'M8490/3', 'M8560/2', 'M8560/3', 'M8572/3', 'M8574/3', 'M8972/3', 'M8973/3', 'M8980/3') ) SELECT DISTINCT MRN LAST_NAME, FIRST_NAME, DOB, APPT_DTE, DEPT, PROVIDER, VISIT_TYPE, ICD10_CODE, CODE_DSC, HIST_DX_DTE, HIST_CD, STAGE FROM APPTS LEFT JOIN HIST ON MRN = TM_MRN

prompt: Please provide a list of all patients diagnosed with monomorphic epitheliotropic intestinal T-cell lymphoma, enteropathy-associated T-cell lymphoma, or hepatosplenic gamma delta T-cell lymphoma from 1/1/2000 - 9/1/2020.
completion: WITH PTS AS (SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN AS MRN FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT JOIN DV.DATE P ON P.DT_DATE_ID = PRPT_PROCEDURE_DATE_ID JOIN DV.DATE R ON R.DT_DATE_ID = PRPT_REPORT_DATE_ID JOIN DV.PATH_RPRT_TYPE_LOOKUP ON PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_CD = PRPT_REPORT_TYPE JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON PRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID JOIN DV.MEDPRO ON PRPT_ORDERING_MEDPRO_ID = MP_MEDPRO_ID WHERE 1=1 AND CONTAINS("PRPT_REPORT", '("monomorphic epitheliotropic intestinal T-cell lymphoma" | "Enteropathy associated T-cell lymphoma" | "Hepatosplenic gamma-delta T-cell lymphoma")') = 1 AND PRPT_REPORT IS NOT NULL AND P.DT_DTE BETWEEN '2000-01-01' AND '2020-09-01' ) , APPTS AS (SELECT CPE_MRN AS "MRN", CPE_ENC_DTE AS "Appt Date", CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 AS "Department", CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 AS "Service", CLD_DEPT_NAME AS "Department Name", CRE_RES_NAME AS "Provider Name", CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME AS "Visit Type", ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CPE_MRN ORDER BY CPE_APPT_DT DESC) RN FROM PTS JOIN IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER ON MRN = CPE_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 = 'LYM' AND CRE_RES_TYP = 'Physician' AND (CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR LIKE '%NV%' OR CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR LIKE '%IR%') ) , CDB AS (SELECT DISTINCT TM_MRN, TM_DX_DTE, TM_SITE_CD AS SITE_CODE, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_DESC, TM_HIST_CD AS HIST_CODE, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS HIST_DESC FROM PTS JOIN IDB.CDB_TUMOR ON MRN = TM_MRN JOIN IDB.CLM H ON TM_HIST_CD = H.CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON TM_SITE_CD = S.CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7') ) SELECT PT_MRN MRN, PT_LAST_NAME LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME FIRST_NAME, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH DOB, PT_DATE_OF_DEATH DOD, PT_SEX GENDER, PLA_LST_ACTV_DTE LAST_ACTIVE_DATE, "Appt Date", "Visit Type", "Provider Name", LISTAGG(TM_DX_DTE || ': ' || TRIM(SITE_CODE) || ' ' || TRIM(SITE_DESC) || ' ' || TRIM(HIST_CODE) || ' ' || TRIM(HIST_DESC), CHR(13)||CHR(10)) TUMOR, LISTAGG(TRIM(CBM_TRANSPLANT_TYPE) || ' ' || CBM_TRANSPLANT_DTE, CHR(13)||CHR(10)) BMT_TRANSPLANT FROM PTS P JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON P.MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY ON P.MRN = PLA_MRN LEFT JOIN APPTS A ON P.MRN = A."MRN" AND RN = 1 LEFT JOIN CDB ON P.MRN = TM_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.CRDB_BMT_MEDICINE ON P.MRN = CBM_MRN GROUP BY PT_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, PT_DATE_OF_DEATH, PT_SEX, PLA_LST_ACTV_DTE , "Appt Date", "Visit Type", "Provider Name" ; WITH PTS AS (SELECT PT_MRN AS MRN, MIN(P.DT_DTE) PROCEDURE_DATE FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT JOIN DV.DATE P ON P.DT_DATE_ID = PRPT_PROCEDURE_DATE_ID JOIN DV.DATE R ON R.DT_DATE_ID = PRPT_REPORT_DATE_ID JOIN DV.PATH_RPRT_TYPE_LOOKUP ON PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_CD = PRPT_REPORT_TYPE JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON PRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID JOIN DV.MEDPRO ON PRPT_ORDERING_MEDPRO_ID = MP_MEDPRO_ID WHERE 1=1 AND CONTAINS("PRPT_REPORT", '("monomorphic epitheliotropic intestinal T-cell lymphoma" | "Enteropathy associated T-cell lymphoma" | "Hepatosplenic gamma-delta T-cell lymphoma")') = 1 AND PRPT_REPORT IS NOT NULL AND P.DT_DTE BETWEEN '2000-01-01' AND '2020-09-01' GROUP BY PT_MRN ) SELECT MRN, PROCEDURE_DATE, APR_START_DTE, APR_END_DTE, CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME FROM PTS P JOIN IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX_V ON P.MRN = APR_MRN WHERE APR_START_DTE >= PROCEDURE_DATE

prompt: List of all Glioma patients with IMPACT Part C Testing
completion: WITH PARTC AS (SELECT DISTINCT PDRX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID PARTC_DEID, PT_MRN PARTC_MRN FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML_SETTINGS ON PDRX_PATH_DMP_RESULTS_XML_ID = PDRXS_PATH_DMP_RESULTS_XML_ID JOIN DVDMC.PATHOLOGY_DMP_WEBSVC_SETTINGS ON PDRXS_SETTING_ID = PDWS_SETTING_ID JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON PDRX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID WHERE PDWS_NAME = 'IMPACT GERMLINE SECONDARY' ) , CHEMO AS (SELECT APR_MRN, COALESCE(MIN(APR_START_DTE), MIN(APR_ORD_CREATE_DTE)) TEMOZOLOMIDE FROM IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX JOIN IDB.CHEMO_DRUG_GENERIC ON APR_GENERIC_NAME = CDG_GENERIC_NAME JOIN PARTC ON APR_MRN = PARTC_MRN WHERE CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME = 'TEMOZOLOMIDE' GROUP BY APR_MRN ) , RAD AS (SELECT DISTINCT RTC_TX_MRN FROM IDB.RADONC_TREATMENT_COURSE JOIN PARTC ON RTC_TX_MRN = PARTC_MRN) SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN MRN, PT_LAST_NAME "Last Name", PT_FIRST_NAME "First Name", PT_BIRTH_DTE "Date of Birth", PT_SEX_DESC "Gender", DTPROCPATHRPT.DT_DTE "Procedure Date", TUMOR_TYPE_NAME "Tumor Type", PRIMARY_SITE "Primary Site", TEMOZOLOMIDE, CASE WHEN RTC_TX_MRN IS NOT NULL THEN 'Y' ELSE '' END "Radiation?" FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT ON PDRX_PATH_RPT_ID = PRPT_PATH_RPT_ID LEFT JOIN DV.DATE DTPROCPATHRPT ON PRPT_PROCEDURE_DATE_ID = DTPROCPATHRPT.DT_DATE_ID JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML_SETTINGS ON PDRX_PATH_DMP_RESULTS_XML_ID = PDRXS_PATH_DMP_RESULTS_XML_ID JOIN DVDMC.PATHOLOGY_DMP_WEBSVC_SETTINGS ON PDRXS_SETTING_ID = PDWS_SETTING_ID JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON PDRX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID JOIN PARTC ON PDRX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PARTC_DEID LEFT JOIN CHEMO ON PT_MRN = APR_MRN LEFT JOIN RAD ON PT_MRN = RTC_TX_MRN, XMLTABLE('$c/root/*' PASSING PDRX_XML_VALUE AS "c" COLUMNS TUMOR_TYPE_NAME VARCHAR(255) PATH '../meta-data/tumor_type_name', PRIMARY_SITE VARCHAR(255) PATH '../meta-data/primary_site') T WHERE PDWS_NAME = 'IMPACT' AND (UPPER(PRIMARY_SITE) LIKE '%BRAIN%' OR UPPER(PRIMARY_SITE) LIKE '%CEREBELLUM%') ORDER BY 1 DESC ; WITH PARTC AS (SELECT DISTINCT PDRX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID PARTC_DEID, PT_MRN PARTC_MRN FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML_SETTINGS ON PDRX_PATH_DMP_RESULTS_XML_ID = PDRXS_PATH_DMP_RESULTS_XML_ID JOIN DVDMC.PATHOLOGY_DMP_WEBSVC_SETTINGS ON PDRXS_SETTING_ID = PDWS_SETTING_ID JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON PDRX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID WHERE PDWS_NAME = 'IMPACT GERMLINE SECONDARY' ) , PT AS (SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT ON PDRX_PATH_RPT_ID = PRPT_PATH_RPT_ID JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML_SETTINGS ON PDRX_PATH_DMP_RESULTS_XML_ID = PDRXS_PATH_DMP_RESULTS_XML_ID JOIN DVDMC.PATHOLOGY_DMP_WEBSVC_SETTINGS ON PDRXS_SETTING_ID = PDWS_SETTING_ID JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON PDRX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID JOIN PARTC ON PDRX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PARTC_DEID, XMLTABLE('$c/root/*' PASSING PDRX_XML_VALUE AS "c" COLUMNS TUMOR_TYPE_NAME VARCHAR(255) PATH '../meta-data/tumor_type_name', PRIMARY_SITE VARCHAR(255) PATH '../meta-data/primary_site') T WHERE PDWS_NAME = 'IMPACT' AND (UPPER(PRIMARY_SITE) LIKE '%BRAIN%' OR UPPER(PRIMARY_SITE) LIKE '%CEREBELLUM%') ) SELECT DISTINCT RTC_TX_MRN MRN, PT_LAST_NAME "Last Name", PT_FIRST_NAME "First Name", RTC_TX_PLAN_NAME, RTC_TX_PLANNED_FRACTIONS, RTC_TX_DELIVERED_FRACTIONS, RTC_TX_PLANNED_DOSE, RTC_TX_DELIVERED_DOSE, RTC_TX_START_DTE, RTC_TX_STOP_DTE FROM IDB.RADONC_TREATMENT_COURSE JOIN PT ON RTC_TX_MRN = PT_MRN ORDER BY 1 DESC, 9 ; WITH PARTC AS (SELECT DISTINCT PDRX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID PARTC_DEID, PT_MRN PARTC_MRN FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML_SETTINGS ON PDRX_PATH_DMP_RESULTS_XML_ID = PDRXS_PATH_DMP_RESULTS_XML_ID JOIN DVDMC.PATHOLOGY_DMP_WEBSVC_SETTINGS ON PDRXS_SETTING_ID = PDWS_SETTING_ID JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON PDRX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID WHERE PDWS_NAME = 'IMPACT GERMLINE SECONDARY' ) SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN MRN, PT_LAST_NAME "Last Name", PT_FIRST_NAME "First Name", GENE_ID "GENE ID", SITE1_GENE "SITE1 GENE", SITE2_GENE "SITE2 GENE" FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT ON PDRX_PATH_RPT_ID = PRPT_PATH_RPT_ID JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML_SETTINGS ON PDRX_PATH_DMP_RESULTS_XML_ID = PDRXS_PATH_DMP_RESULTS_XML_ID JOIN DVDMC.PATHOLOGY_DMP_WEBSVC_SETTINGS ON PDRXS_SETTING_ID = PDWS_SETTING_ID JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON PDRX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID JOIN PARTC ON PDRX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PARTC_DEID, XMLTABLE('$c/root/*' PASSING PDRX_XML_VALUE AS "c" COLUMNS TOTAL_NUMBER_VARIANTS int PATH 'count(../*[not(name()=''meta-data'')])', VARIANT_TYPE VARCHAR(100) PATH './local-name(.)', TUMOR_TYPE_NAME VARCHAR(255) PATH '../meta-data/tumor_type_name', PRIMARY_SITE VARCHAR(255) PATH '../meta-data/primary_site', GENE_ID VARCHAR(100) PATH 'gene_id', SITE1_GENE VARCHAR(100) PATH 'site1_gene', SITE2_GENE VARCHAR(100) PATH 'site2_gene') T WHERE PDWS_NAME = 'IMPACT' AND (UPPER(PRIMARY_SITE) LIKE '%BRAIN%' OR UPPER(PRIMARY_SITE) LIKE '%CEREBELLUM%') AND (TOTAL_NUMBER_VARIANTS =0 OR VARIANT_TYPE <> 'meta-data')

prompt: Create a report of unique 2011 breast center breast cancer patients grouped by gender
completion: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CPE_MRN), CASE WHEN CC_CLSF_CD BETWEEN '174' AND '174.9' THEN 'F' WHEN CC_CLSF_CD BETWEEN '175' AND '175.9' THEN 'M' ELSE NULL END AS GENDER FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CTC_CLSF ON CPE_MRN = CC_MRN AND CPE_ENC_DTE >= CC_EFF_DTE JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CC_CLSF_CD BETWEEN '174' AND '175.9' AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND ((CC_PT_TYPE = 'I') OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) AND CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CLD_CLD_CENTER = '300 E66' AND YEAR(CPE_ENC_DTE) = 2011 GROUP BY CASE WHEN CC_CLSF_CD BETWEEN '174' AND '174.9' THEN 'F' WHEN CC_CLSF_CD BETWEEN '175' AND '175.9' THEN 'M' ELSE NULL END SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CPE_MRN), CASE WHEN CC_CLSF_CD BETWEEN '174' AND '174.9' THEN 'F' WHEN CC_CLSF_CD BETWEEN '175' AND '175.9' THEN 'M' ELSE NULL END AS GENDER FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CTC_CLSF ON CPE_MRN = CC_MRN AND CPE_ENC_DTE >= CC_EFF_DTE JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CC_CLSF_CD BETWEEN '174' AND '175.9' AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND ((CC_PT_TYPE = 'I') OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) AND CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CLD_CLD_CENTER = '300 E66' AND YEAR(CPE_ENC_DTE) = 2011 AND CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR IN ('NV1', 'NV3', 'IR1') GROUP BY CASE WHEN CC_CLSF_CD BETWEEN '174' AND '174.9' THEN 'F' WHEN CC_CLSF_CD BETWEEN '175' AND '175.9' THEN 'M' ELSE NULL END

prompt: Provide a list of patients treated with immune checkpoint inhibitor (ICI) between 1/1/2000 - 12/31/2020 and had a diagnosis of microscopic colitis BEFORE first dose of ICI.
completion: WITH DX AS (SELECT CC_MRN AS MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS DX_DATE FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND ((CC_PT_TYPE = 'I') OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) AND CC_CLSF_CD LIKE 'K52.83%' AND CC_EFF_DTE BETWEEN '2000-01-01' AND '2020-12-31' GROUP BY CC_MRN, CLM_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK UNION SELECT "t1"."PT_MRN" AS MRN, MIN("t3"."DT_DTE") AS DX_DATE FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V" "t1" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED" "t6" ON "t1"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t6"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V" "t2" ON "t6"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t2"."PRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" "t3" ON "t2"."PRPT_PROCEDURE_DATE_ID" = "t3"."DT_DATE_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" "t4" ON "t2"."PRPT_REPORT_DATE_ID" = "t4"."DT_DATE_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATH_RPRT_TYPE_LOOKUP" "t5" ON "t2"."PRPT_REPORT_TYPE" = "t5"."PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_CD" WHERE (CONTAINS("t2"."PRPT_REPORT", '("Microscopic colitis" | "Lymphocytic colitis" | "Collagenous colitis")') = 1 AND "t2"."PRPT_REPORT" IS NOT NULL) AND "t3"."DT_DTE" BETWEEN '2000-01-01' AND '2020-12-31' GROUP BY "t1"."PT_MRN" UNION SELECT CDD_MRN, MIN(CDD_SERVICE_DTE) AS DX_DATE FROM IDB.CD_DOCUMENT JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION ON CDD_MRN = CDO_MRN AND CDD_DOC_GUID = CDO_DOC_GUID AND CDO_AUTHORED_DTE = CDD_AUTHORED_DTE LEFT JOIN IDB.CD_EXTENDED_VALUE_TEXT ON CDEVT_DOC_GUID = CDO_DOC_GUID AND CDEVT_IDENTITY = CDO_IDENTITY WHERE 1=1 AND CDD_CANCEL_IND <> '1' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND <> '1' AND(LOCATE('MICROSCOPIC COLITIS', UPPER(CAST(CDEVT_VALUE_TEXT AS VARCHAR(32000)))) > 0 OR LOCATE('LYMPHOCYTIC COLITIS', UPPER(CAST(CDEVT_VALUE_TEXT AS VARCHAR(32000)))) > 0 OR LOCATE('COLLAGENOUS COLITIS', UPPER(CAST(CDEVT_VALUE_TEXT AS VARCHAR(32000)))) > 0) AND CDD_SERVICE_DTE BETWEEN '2000-01-01' AND '2020-12-31' GROUP BY CDD_MRN ) , DX2 AS (SELECT MRN, MIN(DX_DATE) AS DX_DATE FROM DX GROUP BY MRN) , ICI AS (SELECT APR_MRN, CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME, MIN(APR_START_DTE) AS START_DATE, MAX(APR_END_DTE) AS END_DATE FROM DX2 JOIN IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX_V ON APR_MRN = MRN WHERE CDG_IMMUNOTHERAPY_FLAG = 'Y' OR CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME = 'TREMELIMUMAB' GROUP BY APR_MRN, CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME ) , ICI_MIN AS (SELECT APR_MRN, MIN(START_DATE) AS INIT_ICI_START_DATE FROM ICI GROUP BY APR_MRN) , ICI2 AS (SELECT ICI.*, INIT_ICI_START_DATE FROM ICI JOIN ICI_MIN ON ICI.APR_MRN = ICI_MIN.APR_MRN) SELECT DISTINCT MRN, DX_DATE, CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME, START_DATE, END_DATE, INIT_ICI_START_DATE FROM ICI2 JOIN DX2 ON MRN = APR_MRN AND DX_DATE < INIT_ICI_START_DATE

completion: WITH APPOINTMENT AS (SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN, CPE_ENC_DTE, CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Sch') AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT DATE AND CURRENT DATE + 7 DAYS ) , ICD AS (SELECT DISTINCT CC_MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS MIN_DX_DTE, CC_CLSF_CD AS ICD_CODE, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS ICD_DESC FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN APPOINTMENT ON CPE_MRN = CC_MRN WHERE CC_CLSF_CD IN ('C91.10', 'C91.12', 'C91.11', 'C83.00') AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND (CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) GROUP BY CC_MRN, CC_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK ) , DRUGINCLUDE AS (SELECT DISTINCT APR_MRN AS IN_APR_MRN, CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME AS IN_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME, APR_START_DTE AS IN_APR_START_DTE, APR_END_DTE AS IN_APR_END_DTE FROM IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX JOIN IDB.CHEMO_DRUG_GENERIC ON APR_GENERIC_NAME = CDG_GENERIC_NAME JOIN APPOINTMENT ON APR_MRN = CPE_MRN AND APR_START_DTE < CPE_ENC_DTE WHERE CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME IN ('IBRUTINIB', 'ACALABRUTINIB', 'ZANUBRUTINIB', 'TIRABRUTINIB', 'ORELABRUTINIB') ) , DRUGEXCLUDE AS (SELECT DISTINCT APR_MRN AS EX_APR_MRN, CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME AS EX_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME, APR_START_DTE AS EX_APR_START_DTE, APR_END_DTE AS EX_APR_END_DTE FROM IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX JOIN IDB.CHEMO_DRUG_GENERIC ON APR_GENERIC_NAME = CDG_GENERIC_NAME JOIN APPOINTMENT ON APR_MRN = CPE_MRN AND APR_START_DTE < CPE_ENC_DTE WHERE CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME IN ('G3139 (OBLIMERSEN SODIUM)', 'NAVITOCLAX (ABT-263)', 'OBATOCLAX MESYLATE (GX15-070MS)', 'OBLIMERSEN', 'NAVITOCLAX', 'VENETOCLAX', 'OBATOCLAX', 'AT-101') ) , INEX AS (SELECT DISTINCT IN_APR_MRN, IN_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME, IN_APR_START_DTE, IN_APR_END_DTE FROM DRUGINCLUDE WHERE IN_APR_MRN NOT IN (SELECT EX_APR_MRN FROM DRUGEXCLUDE) ) SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN, IN_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME FROM APPOINTMENT JOIN ICD ON CC_MRN = CPE_MRN JOIN INEX ON IN_APR_MRN= CPE_MRN

prompt: Identify all patients who were diagnosed with the ICD-9 code 205.30 since 1986, CIC-coded.
completion: WITH DT AS (SELECT DISTINCT C.CLSF_MRN MRN, P.PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, MIN(C.CLSF_EFF_DATE) FIRST_DX_DATE, PLA_LST_RT_DTE FROM IDB.CLSF C INNER JOIN IDB.PATIENT P ON C.CLSF_MRN = P.PT_MRN INNER JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY A ON C.CLSF_MRN = A.PLA_MRN WHERE CLSF_CLSF_CD = '205.30' AND(CLSF_CIC_CDER_INIT <> '' OR CLSF_ACCT_NO LIKE '84%' OR CLSF_ACCT_NO LIKE '00%') GROUP BY C.CLSF_MRN, P.PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, PLA_LST_RT_DTE) SELECT MRN, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, FIRST_DX_DATE, YEAR(FIRST_DX_DATE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) AGE_AT_DX, PLA_LST_RT_DTE FROM DT

prompt: Provide a list of pediatric patients that had an appointment 2 months ago and had neutrophil over 0.5 and a blood culture ordered
completion: WITH APPTS AS (SELECT CPE_MRN AS "MRN", PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, YEAR(CPE_ENC_DTE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) AGE_AT_APPT, CPE_ENC_DTE AS "Appt Date", CLD_DEPT_NAME AS "Department Name", CRE_RES_NAME AS "Provider Name", CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME AS "Visit Type" FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON CPE_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT date - 7 DAYS AND CURRENT date AND DAYS(CPE_ENC_DTE) - DAYS(PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) > 61 AND (CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 = ('PED') OR CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_4 = ('PED') OR CLD_DEPT_NAME = 'ORTHOPEDICS 1275-9') AND CPE_CPE_IP_IND <> 'INPATIENT' ) , LABS AS (SELECT "MRN", PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, AGE_AT_APPT, "Appt Date", "Department Name", "Provider Name", "Visit Type", LR_PERFORMED_DTE, LR_TEST_NAME, LR_SUBTEST_NAME, LR_RESULT_VALUE, LR_UNIT_MEASURE FROM APPTS JOIN IDB.LAB_RESULTS ON MRN = LR_MRN AND "Appt Date" BETWEEN LR_PERFORMED_DTE AND LR_PERFORMED_DTE + 1 DAY LEFT JOIN IDB.LAB_TEXT_LINE ON LR_RESULT_GUID = LTL_RESULT_GUID WHERE LR_SUBTEST_NAME IN ('Abs Neut' , 'Abs Neut 3Diff' , 'Absolute Neutrophil Count, Quest' , 'Amended Report. prompt: Provide post-immunotherapy complete blood counts, complete metabolic panels, and basic metabolic panels for cohort of IMPACT-tested patients who received immunotherapy at MSK
completion: WITH PT AS (SELECT '{mrn}' MRN , DATE('{dte}') START_DTE FROM SYSIBM.SYSDUMMY1) , CMP AS (SELECT LR_MRN , LR_PERFORMED_DT , MAX(CASE WHEN LR_SUBTEST_NAME = 'Albumin' THEN LR_RESULT_VALUE END) ALBUMIN , MAX(CASE WHEN LR_SUBTEST_NAME = 'Protein, Total' THEN LR_RESULT_VALUE END) PROTEIN_TOTAL FROM IDB.LAB_RESULTS JOIN PT ON LR_MRN = MRN WHERE LR_TEST_NAME = 'Comprehensive Metabolic Panel' AND LR_SUBTEST_NAME IN ('Albumin', 'Protein, Total') AND LR_PERFORMED_DTE BETWEEN START_DTE AND START_DTE + 4 MONTH GROUP BY LR_MRN , LR_PERFORMED_DT ) , BMP AS (SELECT LR_MRN , LR_PERFORMED_DT , LR_RESULT_VALUE CALCIUM FROM IDB.LAB_RESULTS JOIN PT ON LR_MRN = MRN WHERE LR_TEST_NAME = 'Basic Metabolic Panel' AND LR_SUBTEST_NAME = 'Calcium' AND LR_PERFORMED_DTE BETWEEN START_DTE AND START_DTE + 4 MONTH ) , CBC AS (SELECT LR_MRN , LR_PERFORMED_DT , MAX(CASE WHEN LR_SUBTEST_NAME = 'Abs Neut' THEN LR_RESULT_VALUE END) ABS_NEUT , MAX(CASE WHEN LR_SUBTEST_NAME = 'Abs Mono' THEN LR_RESULT_VALUE END) ABS_MONO , MAX(CASE WHEN LR_SUBTEST_NAME = 'Abs Lymph' THEN LR_RESULT_VALUE END) ABS_LYMPH , MAX(CASE WHEN LR_SUBTEST_NAME = 'Abs Eos' THEN LR_RESULT_VALUE END) ABS_EOS , MAX(CASE WHEN LR_SUBTEST_NAME = 'Abs Baso' THEN LR_RESULT_VALUE END) ABS_BASO , MAX(CASE WHEN LR_SUBTEST_NAME = 'WBC' THEN LR_RESULT_VALUE END) WBC , MAX(CASE WHEN LR_SUBTEST_NAME = 'Platelets.' THEN LR_RESULT_VALUE END) PLATELETS , MAX(CASE WHEN LR_SUBTEST_NAME = 'HGB' THEN LR_RESULT_VALUE END) HGB FROM IDB.LAB_RESULTS JOIN PT ON LR_MRN = MRN WHERE LR_TEST_NAME IN ('Complete Blood Count', 'Complete Blood Count (CBC), WITH Differential', 'Complete Blood Count (CBC), Standard') AND LR_SUBTEST_NAME IN ('Abs Neut', 'Abs Mono', 'Abs Lymph', 'Abs Eos', 'Abs Baso', 'WBC', 'Platelets.', 'HGB') AND LR_PERFORMED_DTE BETWEEN START_DTE AND START_DTE + 4 MONTH GROUP BY LR_MRN , LR_PERFORMED_DT ) SELECT PT.* , CBC.LR_PERFORMED_DT CBC_DT , ABS_NEUT , ABS_MONO , ABS_LYMPH , ABS_EOS , ABS_BASO , WBC , PLATELETS , HGB , CMP.LR_PERFORMED_DT CMP_DT , ALBUMIN , PROTEIN_TOTAL , BMP.LR_PERFORMED_DT BMP_DT , CALCIUM FROM PT LEFT JOIN CMP ON MRN = CMP.LR_MRN LEFT JOIN BMP ON MRN = BMP.LR_MRN LEFT JOIN CBC ON MRN = CBC.LR_MRN

completion: WITH PLEU AS (SELECT CPE_ENC_CSN_ID, CPE_CL_PT_ID, CPE_MRN AS MRN, CPE_ENC_DTE_SEQ , RTRIM(CL_LAST_NAME)||', '||RTRIM(CL_FIRST_NAME) AS PT_NAME , CPE_ENC_DTE AS VISIT_DTE , CLD_DEPT_NAME AS VISIT_DEPT , CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR AS VST_TYPE, CVT_EXT_NAME VST_TYPE_NAME , A.CPAN_NOTE UCC_NOTE, MIN(CC_CLSF_CD) AS PLEURAL_EFF FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_PATIENT ON CPE_MRN = CL_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_PT_APPT_NOTES A ON CPE_CL_PT_ID = A.CPAN_CL_PT_ID AND CPE_ENC_DTE_SEQ = A.CPAN_ENC_DTE_SEQ AND UPPER(CPAN_NOTE) like '%PLEURAL EFF%' JOIN IDB.CTC_CLSF ON CC_MRN = CPE_MRN AND CC_EFF_DTE = CPE_ENC_DTE AND CC_CLSF_CD LIKE '511.%' AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'D%' AND (CC_FINALIZED_IND= 'Y' OR CC_PT_TYPE = 'I') WHERE CPE_DEPT_ID = 230 AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN '2012-01-01' AND CURRENT DATE - 5 DAYS AND CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') GROUP BY CPE_ENC_CSN_ID, CPE_MRN , CPE_CL_PT_ID, CPE_ENC_DTE_SEQ , CL_LAST_NAME, CL_FIRST_NAME , CPE_ENC_DTE , CLD_DEPT_NAME , CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR , CVT_EXT_NAME , A.CPAN_NOTE) , ADM AS (SELECT CPE_ENC_CSN_ID, CPE_CL_PT_ID, CPE_ENC_DTE_SEQ, MRN, PT_NAME, VISIT_DTE, VISIT_DEPT, VST_TYPE, VST_TYPE_NAME, UCC_NOTE, PLEURAL_EFF , COALESCE(A.CPAN_NOTE, B.CPAN_NOTE, ' ') AS ADMIT_NOTES , C.CPAN_NOTE AS MD_NAME , CH_EFF_DATE AS ADMIT_DTE FROM PLEU LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_PT_APPT_NOTES A ON CPE_CL_PT_ID = A.CPAN_CL_PT_ID AND CPE_ENC_DTE_SEQ = A.CPAN_ENC_DTE_SEQ AND A.CPAN_LINE_NO = 1 AND UPPER(A.CPAN_NOTE) LIKE '%ADMIT%' LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_PT_APPT_NOTES B ON CPE_CL_PT_ID = B.CPAN_CL_PT_ID AND CPE_ENC_DTE_SEQ = B.CPAN_ENC_DTE_SEQ AND B.CPAN_LINE_NO = 2 AND UPPER(B.CPAN_NOTE) LIKE '%ADMIT%' LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_PT_APPT_NOTES C ON CPE_CL_PT_ID = C.CPAN_CL_PT_ID AND CPE_ENC_DTE_SEQ = C.CPAN_ENC_DTE_SEQ AND C.CPAN_LINE_NO = 3 JOIN IDB.CENSUS ON CH_MRN = MRN AND CH_CNG_TYPE = 'A' AND CH_EFF_DATE BETWEEN VISIT_DTE AND VISIT_DTE + 1 DAYS) , SURG AS ( SELECT MRN, PT_NAME, VISIT_DTE, VISIT_DEPT, VST_TYPE, VST_TYPE_NAME, UCC_NOTE, PLEURAL_EFF, SSE_SURG_DTE SURG_DTE, SSE_SURG_LOC SURG_LOC, SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD PROC_CD, SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC PROC_DESC, SSP_SURG_LAST_NM SRG_LAST_NME, SSP_SURG_FIRST_NM SRG_FIRST_NME FROM PLEU JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT ON MRN = SSE_MRN AND SSE_SURG_DTE BETWEEN VISIT_DTE AND VISIT_DTE + 14 DAYS JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE ON SSP_LOG_ID = SSE_LOG_ID WHERE SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD IN ('32421', '32422', '32550', '32551', '32560', '32601', '32561', '32562', '32095')

prompt: Provide a list of bladder cancer patients receiving immune checkpoint inhibitors
completion: WITH PTS AS (SELECT DISTINCT TM_MRN FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.SEERGROUPING ON IDB.SEERF_ICDO(TM_SITE_CD, TM_HIST_CD) = RECODE JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON TM_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND CATEGORY2 IN ('Urinary Bladder') ) , IRB AS (SELECT AC_MRN, AC_IRB_NO, PRO_CLOSE_ACCR_DTE FROM PTS JOIN IDB.ACCRUALS ON TM_MRN = AC_MRN JOIN IDB.PROTOCOL ON AC_IRB_NO = PRO_IRB_NO WHERE PRO_PROTOCOL_TYPE IN ('Therapeutic', 'Therapeutic/QOL') ) , IMMUNO AS (SELECT TM_MRN MRN, CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME, APR_START_DTE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY TM_MRN, CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME ORDER BY APR_START_DTE) RN FROM PTS JOIN IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX_V ON TM_MRN = APR_MRN WHERE CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME IN ('PEMBROLIZUMAB', 'NIVOLUMAB', 'ATEZOLIZUMAB', 'AVELUMAB', 'DURVALUMAB') ) SELECT MRN, MAX(CASE WHEN RN = 1 AND CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME = 'PEMBROLIZUMAB' THEN CHAR(APR_START_DTE) ELSE '' END) FIRST_PEMBROLIZUMAB_DATE, MAX(CASE WHEN RN = 1 AND CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME = 'PEMBROLIZUMAB' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END) PEMBROLIZUMAB, MAX(CASE WHEN RN = 1 AND CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME = 'NIVOLUMAB' THEN CHAR(APR_START_DTE) ELSE '' END) FIRST_NIVOLUMAB_DATE, MAX(CASE WHEN RN = 1 AND CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME = 'NIVOLUMAB' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END) NIVOLUMAB, MAX(CASE WHEN RN = 1 AND CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME = 'ATEZOLIZUMAB' THEN CHAR(APR_START_DTE) ELSE '' END) FIRST_ATEZOLIZUMAB_DATE, MAX(CASE WHEN RN = 1 AND CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME = 'ATEZOLIZUMAB' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END) ATEZOLIZUMAB, MAX(CASE WHEN RN = 1 AND CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME = 'AVELUMAB' THEN CHAR(APR_START_DTE) ELSE '' END) FIRST_AVELUMAB_DATE, MAX(CASE WHEN RN = 1 AND CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME = 'AVELUMAB' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END) AVELUMAB, MAX(CASE WHEN RN = 1 AND CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME = 'DURVALUMAB' THEN CHAR(APR_START_DTE) ELSE '' END) FIRST_DURVALUMAB_DATE, MAX(CASE WHEN RN = 1 AND CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME = 'DURVALUMAB' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END) DURVALUMAB, MAX(CASE WHEN AC_MRN IS NOT NULL THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END) CLINICAL_TRIAL FROM IMMUNO LEFT JOIN IRB ON MRN = AC_MRN GROUP BY MRN

prompt: Provide a list of patients who were diagnosed with Retinoblastoma in the first 2 months of life.
completion: WITH DX AS (SELECT DISTINCT STRIP(TM_MRN) AS MRN, STRIP(PT_LAST_NAME) AS LAST_NAME, STRIP(PT_FIRST_NAME) AS FIRST_NAME, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH AS DOB, PT_SEX AS GENDER, PT_DATE_OF_DEATH AS DOD, PLA_LST_TX_DTE, TM_DX_DTE AS DX_DATE, MONTHS_BETWEEN (TM_DX_DTE, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) AS DX_AGE_IN_MONTHS, STRIP(TM_HIST_CD) AS HIST_CODE, STRIP(H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK) AS HIST_DESC, STRIP(TM_SITE_CD) AS SITE_CODE, STRIP(S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK) AS SITE_DESC, STRIP(LAT.AV_DESC) AS LATERALITY FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM H ON TM_HIST_CD = H.CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON TM_SITE_CD = S.CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON TM_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY ON PT_MRN = PLA_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS LAT ON LAT.AV_CODE = TM_LATERALITY_CD AND LAT.AV_ELEMENT = 'LATERALITY_CD' WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND TM_HIST_CD IN ('M9510/3', 'M9511/3', 'M9512/3', 'M9513/3') AND MONTHS_BETWEEN(TM_DX_DTE, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) BETWEEN 0 AND 2 AND TM_DX_DTE BETWEEN '2003-01-01' AND '2020-08-19' ) , CPE AS (SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN AS MRN, CPE_ENC_DTE, CRE_RES_NAME, CRE_RES_TYP, CLD_DEPT_NAME, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8, CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CPE_MRN ORDER BY CPE_ENC_DTE DESC) AS RN FROM DX JOIN IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER ON CPE_MRN = MRN JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CRE_RES_TYP IN ('Physician') AND CLD_DEPT_NAME = 'OPHTHALMIC ONC 1275' AND(CRE_RES_ID = '011593' OR CRE_RES_ID = '016840') ) , CHEMO AS (SELECT DISTINCT APR_MRN, APR_GENERIC_NAME, APR_START_DTE, APR_END_DTE, APR_ORD_RX_TYPE FROM DX JOIN IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX_V ON APR_MRN = MRN WHERE CDG_CHEMO_FLAG = 'Y' ) , SRG AS (SELECT DISTINCT SSE_MRN, SSE_SURG_DTE, SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD, SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC FROM DX JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT ON SSE_MRN = MRN JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE ON SSE_LOG_ID = SSP_LOG_ID WHERE 1=1 AND SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD IN ('65103', '65105', '67208', '67210', '67218', '67412', '92226') ) , METS AS (SELECT CC_MRN, CLM_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS METS_DATE_INIT FROM DX JOIN IDB.CTC_CLSF ON CC_MRN = MRN JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND ((CC_PT_TYPE = 'I') OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) AND (CC_CLSF_CD BETWEEN '196' AND '198.99' OR CC_CLSF_CD BETWEEN 'C77' AND 'C79.99') GROUP BY CC_MRN, CLM_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK ) SELECT * FROM METS

prompt: Provide list of patients identified with CIC-DUX4 or BCOR-CCNB3 gene fusions.
completion: WITH GENE AS (SELECT PT_MRN GENE_MRN, PATH_PROCEDURE_DATE, GENE, GENE2 FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_STRUCTURED_RESULTS_V WHERE 1=1 AND ((GENE IN ('CIC') AND GENE2 IN ('DUX4')) OR (GENE IN ('BCOR') AND GENE2 IN ('CCNB3'))) ) , DX AS (SELECT PT_MRN, TUMOR_REG_DATA, ICD_DATA FROM IDB.PATIENT LEFT JOIN (SELECT TM_MRN, LISTAGG(TM_DX_DTE || ' | ' || TRIM(SITE_DESC) || ' | ' || TRIM(HIST_DESC), CHR(13) || CHR(10)) WITHIN GROUP( ORDER BY TM_DX_DTE) AS TUMOR_REG_DATA FROM (SELECT DISTINCT TM_MRN, AV_DESC AS CASE_STS, TM_DX_DTE, TM_HIST_CD, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS HIST_DESC, TM_SITE_CD, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_DESC FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS ON AV_ELEMENT = 'CASE_STS' AND AV_CODE = TM_CASE_STS AND TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') ) A GROUP BY TM_MRN) AS CDB ON TM_MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN (SELECT CC_MRN, LISTAGG(MIN_ICD9_EFF_DTE || ' | ' || TRIM(ICD9_CD) || ' | ' || TRIM(ICD9_DESC), CHR(13) || CHR(10)) WITHIN GROUP( ORDER BY MIN_ICD9_EFF_DTE) AS ICD_DATA FROM (SELECT DISTINCT CC_MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS MIN_ICD9_EFF_DTE, CC_CLSF_CD AS ICD9_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS ICD9_DESC FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE 1=1 AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND ((CC_CLSF_CD BETWEEN '140' AND '239.99') OR (CC_CLSF_CD BETWEEN 'C00' AND 'D49')) GROUP BY CC_MRN, CC_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK ) A GROUP BY CC_MRN) AS ICD9 ON CC_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE COALESCE(TM_MRN, CC_MRN) IS NOT NULL ) , DX_FINAL AS (SELECT PT_MRN DX_MRN, TUMOR_REG_DATA, ICD_DATA FROM DX JOIN GENE ON GENE_MRN = PT_MRN) SELECT DISTINCT GENE_MRN "MRN", TUMOR_REG_DATA "Tumor Registry Dx", ICD_DATA "ICD Dx", PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH "DOB", YEAR(CURRENT date - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) AS "Current Age", PT_SEX "Gender", GENE "Gene1", GENE2 "Gene2" FROM GENE LEFT JOIN DX_FINAL ON GENE_MRN = DX_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON GENE_MRN = PT_MRN

prompt: Provide a list of patients who were diagnosed with brain metastases at MSKCC prior to 2012, but who were never diagnosed with melanoma, colon, lung, breast, prostate or kidney cancer.
completion: SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, PT_DATE_OF_DEATH FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF INNER JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD INNER JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON CC_MRN = PT_MRN INNER JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY ON PT_MRN = PLA_MRN WHERE CC_CLSF_CD IN ('198.3') AND CC_EFF_DTE <= '2011-12-31' AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND ((CC_PT_TYPE = 'I') OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT CC_MRN FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF WHERE CC_CLSF_CD IN ('153', '153.0', '153.1', '153.2', '153.3', '153.4', '153.5', '153.6', '153.7', '153.8', '153.9', '154.0', '154.1', '162', '162.0', '162.2', '162.3', '162.4', '162.5', '162.8', '162.9', '172', '172.0', '172.1', '172.2', '172.3', '172.4', '172.5', '172.6', '172.7', '172.8', '172.9', '174', '174.0', '174.1', '174.2', '174.3', '174.4', '174.5', '174.6', '174.8', '174.9', '185', '189.0') AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND ((CC_PT_TYPE = 'I') OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) AND PT_MRN = CC_MRN)

prompt: Provide data on patients with CT and MRI prior to nephrectomy.
completion: SELECT PT_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, PT_DATE_OF_DEATH, TM_DX_DTE, TM_HIST_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS HIST_DESC, MAX(C.PBD_SVC_DTE) AS CT_DTE, MAX(A.PBD_SVC_DTE) AS MRI_DTE, E.PBD_SVC_DTE AS NEPHRECTOMY_DTE FROM IDB.PATIENT JOIN IDB.CDB_TUMOR ON PT_MRN = TM_MRN AND TM_SITE_CD = 'C649' AND TM_CASE_STS IN ('3', '6', '7', '8') LEFT JOIN IDB.CLM ON TM_HIST_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.PBD_DTL A ON TM_MRN = A.PBD_MRN JOIN IDB.PBD_CODE B ON A.PBD_PBD_CD = B.PBC_PBD_CD AND B.PBC_CPT_CD IN ('72195', '72196', '72197', '74181', '74182', '74183') JOIN IDB.PBD_DTL C ON TM_MRN = C.PBD_MRN JOIN IDB.PBD_CODE D ON C.PBD_PBD_CD = D.PBC_PBD_CD AND D.PBC_CPT_CD IN ('72192', '72193', '72194', '74150', '74160', '74170') JOIN IDB.PBD_DTL E ON TM_MRN = E.PBD_MRN JOIN IDB.PBD_CODE F ON E.PBD_PBD_CD = F.PBC_PBD_CD AND F.PBC_CPT_CD IN ('50543', '50545', '50546') WHERE A.PBD_SVC_DTE <= E.PBD_SVC_DTE AND C.PBD_SVC_DTE <= E.PBD_SVC_DTE AND ABS(DAYS(A.PBD_SVC_DTE) - DAYS(C.PBD_SVC_DTE)) <= 28 GROUP BY PT_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, PT_DATE_OF_DEATH, TM_DX_DTE, TM_HIST_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK, E.PBD_SVC_DTE

completion: WITH X AS (SELECT STRIP(PT_MRN) AS MRN, STRIP(PT_LAST_NAME) || ', ' || STRIP(PT_FIRST_NAME) AS NAME, CDD_ADM_NUM, OCV_CURR_LOC, OP_DISPLAY_NAME, CDD_DOC_GUID, CDD_SERVICE_DTE, CDD_DOC_NAME, CDO_SECTION, CDO_CTLG_DISPL_NM, CDO_MSTR_ITEM_NM, CDO_ITEM_NAME, STRIP(SUBSTR(CDO_VALUE_TEXT, 1, 500)) AS VALUE_TEXT FROM IDB.CD_DOCUMENT JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION ON CDO_DOC_GUID = CDD_DOC_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_CLIENT_VISIT ON OCV_VISIT_GUID = CDD_VISIT_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_PROVIDER ON OP_PVDR_GUID = CDD_AUTH_PROV_GUID JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PT_MRN = CDD_MRN WHERE CDD_CANCEL_IND = '0' AND
