AND CDD_SERVICE_DTE BETWEEN '2022-01-01' AND CURRENT date ) , Y AS (SELECT X.MRN, X.CDD_DOC_GUID, MAX(X1.VALUE_TEXT) AS "Discipline", MAX(X2.VALUE_TEXT) AS "Visit Type", MAX(X3.VALUE_TEXT) AS "Complexity", MAX(X4.VALUE_TEXT) AS "Onset Date", MAX(X5.VALUE_TEXT) AS "Referral Date", MAX(X6.VALUE_TEXT) AS "Start of Care Date", MAX(X7.VALUE_TEXT) AS "Therapy Plan of Care Date", MAX(X8.VALUE_TEXT) AS "Referring Provider", MAX(X9.VALUE_TEXT) AS "Initial/Re-Evaluation minutes", MAX(X10.VALUE_TEXT) AS "Timed Treatment minutes", MAX(X11.VALUE_TEXT) AS "Untimed Treatment minutes", MAX(X11A.VALUE_TEXT) AS "Other Untimed Treatment minutes", MAX(X12.VALUE_TEXT) AS "Total minutes", MAX(X13.VALUE_TEXT) AS "Diagnosis", MAX(X14.VALUE_TEXT) AS "PT/OT/ST Tx Dx:" FROM X LEFT JOIN X X1 ON X1.CDD_DOC_GUID = X.CDD_DOC_GUID AND X1.CDO_MSTR_ITEM_NM IN ('PT_Discipline RES', 'INOT_Discipline RES', 'INLT_VisitDiscipline_RES') LEFT JOIN X X2 ON X2.CDD_DOC_GUID = X.CDD_DOC_GUID AND X2.CDO_MSTR_ITEM_NM IN ('INPT_Visit Status ls obs', 'INOT_Visit Status obs', 'INLT_VisitStatus_RES') LEFT JOIN X X3 ON X3.CDD_DOC_GUID = X.CDD_DOC_GUID AND X3.CDO_MSTR_ITEM_NM IN ('OTE_Evaluation Complex RES', 'OTE_Evaluation Complex-2 RES', 'OTE_Evaluation Complex-1 RES') LEFT JOIN X X4 ON X4.CDD_DOC_GUID = X.CDD_DOC_GUID AND X4.CDO_MSTR_ITEM_NM IN ('INPT_Onset Date', 'INOT_Onset Date', 'INOT_Onset Date') LEFT JOIN X X5 ON X5.CDD_DOC_GUID = X.CDD_DOC_GUID AND X5.CDO_MSTR_ITEM_NM IN ('INPT_Referral Date', 'INOT_Referral Date', 'INOT_Referral Date') LEFT JOIN X X6 ON X6.CDD_DOC_GUID = X.CDD_DOC_GUID AND X6.CDO_MSTR_ITEM_NM IN ('PTO_StartOfCareDate_DTM', 'INOT_Start of Care Date DT', 'INLT_Start of care Date obs') LEFT JOIN X X7 ON X7.CDD_DOC_GUID = X.CDD_DOC_GUID AND X7.CDO_MSTR_ITEM_NM IN ('PT_Therapy Plan of Care Date DT', 'INOT_Therapy Plan of Care Date DT', 'PT_Therapy Plan of Care Date DT') LEFT JOIN X X8 ON X8.CDD_DOC_GUID = X.CDD_DOC_GUID AND X8.CDO_MSTR_ITEM_NM IN ('PT_Referring Provider FT', 'INOT_Referring Provider FT', 'PT_Referring Provider FT') LEFT JOIN X X9 ON X9.CDD_DOC_GUID = X.CDD_DOC_GUID AND X9.CDO_MSTR_ITEM_NM IN ('INPT_EvaluationMinutes_NUM', 'INLT_EvaluationMinutes_NUM') LEFT JOIN X X10 ON X10.CDD_DOC_GUID = X.CDD_DOC_GUID AND X10.CDO_MSTR_ITEM_NM IN ('INPT_TimedTreatmentMin_NUM', 'INOT_Timed codes minutes num obs', 'INLT_TimedTreatmentMin_NUM') LEFT JOIN X X11 ON X11.CDD_DOC_GUID = X.CDD_DOC_GUID AND X11.CDO_MSTR_ITEM_NM IN ('INPT_UntimedTreatmentMin_NUM', 'INOT_Untimed Treatment Minutes num obs', 'INLT_UntimedTreatmentMin_NUM') LEFT JOIN X X11A ON X11A.CDD_DOC_GUID = X.CDD_DOC_GUID AND X11A.CDO_MSTR_ITEM_NM IN ('INOT_Other Untimed Treatment Minutes num obs') LEFT JOIN X X12 ON X12.CDD_DOC_GUID = X.CDD_DOC_GUID AND X12.CDO_MSTR_ITEM_NM IN ('INPT_TotalTreatmentMin_CAL', 'INOT_Total Treatment Minutes CAL', 'INLT_TotalTreatmentMin_CAL') LEFT JOIN X X13 ON X13.CDD_DOC_GUID = X.CDD_DOC_GUID AND X13.CDO_MSTR_ITEM_NM IN ('INPT_Diagnosis (Initial Eval) obs') LEFT JOIN X X14 ON X14.CDD_DOC_GUID = X.CDD_DOC_GUID AND X14.CDO_MSTR_ITEM_NM IN ('REH_DiagnosisPrimary_FT') GROUP BY X.MRN, X.CDD_DOC_GUID) SELECT DISTINCT X.MRN, NAME, CDD_ADM_NUM AS "Visit #", STRIP(OCV_CURR_LOC) AS "Current Location", STRIP(OP_DISPLAY_NAME) AS "Author", X.CDD_DOC_GUID, CDD_SERVICE_DTE, CDD_DOC_NAME, "Discipline", "Visit Type", "Complexity", "Onset Date", "Referral Date", "Start of Care Date", CASE WHEN "Referral Date" IS NOT NULL AND "Start of Care Date" IS NOT NULL AND "Referral Date" <> '' AND "Start of Care Date" <> '' THEN DAYS("Start of Care Date") - DAYS("Referral Date") END AS "No of days to eval", "Therapy Plan of Care Date", "Referring Provider", "Initial/Re-Evaluation minutes", "Timed Treatment minutes", "Untimed Treatment minutes", "Other Untimed Treatment minutes", "Total minutes", "Diagnosis", "PT/OT/ST Tx Dx:" FROM X LEFT JOIN Y ON X.CDD_DOC_GUID = Y.CDD_DOC_GUID

prompt: Amend Workday Report for Employee Vaccine Status
completion: WITH DUPS AS (SELECT EVI_EMPLOYEE_ID AS EID, COUNT(DISTINCT EVI_MRN) AS CT FROM IDB.COVID19_EMPLOYEE_VACCINE_INFO WHERE CEVE_CATEGORY IN ('Employees', 'Contingents', 'Pre-hires') AND ELIGIBLE_DTE IS NOT NULL GROUP BY EVI_EMPLOYEE_ID HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT EVI_MRN) > 1) , EMP AS (SELECT EVI_EMPLOYEE_ID, CEVE_CATEGORY, DOSE_1_BRAND, DOSE_1_ADMIN_DTE, DOSE_2_BRAND, DOSE_2_ADMIN_DTE, VACCINE_EXEMPTION_REASON, VACCINE_EXEMPTION_DTE, VACCINE_EXEMPTION_EXP_DTE, DOSE_1_APPT_DT, DOSE_1_APPT_STATUS, DOSE_2_APPT_DT, DOSE_2_APPT_STATUS FROM IDB.COVID19_EMPLOYEE_VACCINE_INFO WHERE CEVE_CATEGORY IN ('Employees', 'Contingents', 'Pre-hires') AND ELIGIBLE_DTE IS NOT NULL AND EVI_EMPLOYEE_ID NOT IN (SELECT EID FROM DUPS) UNION ALL SELECT EVI_EMPLOYEE_ID, CEVE_CATEGORY, MAX(DOSE_1_BRAND) DOSE_1_BRAND, MAX(DOSE_1_ADMIN_DTE) DOSE_1_ADMIN_DTE, MAX(DOSE_2_BRAND) DOSE_2_BRAND, MAX(DOSE_2_ADMIN_DTE) DOSE_2_ADMIN_DTE, MAX(VACCINE_EXEMPTION_REASON) VACCINE_EXEMPTION_REASON, MAX(VACCINE_EXEMPTION_DTE) VACCINE_EXEMPTION_DTE, MAX(VACCINE_EXEMPTION_EXP_DTE) VACCINE_EXEMPTION_EXP_DTE, MAX(DOSE_1_APPT_DT) DOSE_1_APPT_DT, MAX(DOSE_1_APPT_STATUS) DOSE_1_APPT_STATUS, MAX(DOSE_2_APPT_DT) DOSE_2_APPT_DT, MAX(DOSE_2_APPT_STATUS) DOSE_2_APPT_STATUS FROM IDB.COVID19_EMPLOYEE_VACCINE_INFO JOIN DUPS ON EVI_EMPLOYEE_ID = EID WHERE CEVE_CATEGORY IN ('Employees', 'Contingents', 'Pre-hires') AND ELIGIBLE_DTE IS NOT NULL GROUP BY EVI_EMPLOYEE_ID, CEVE_CATEGORY) , FIN AS (SELECT A.*, TRIM(CVP_NAME) CVP_NAME, CASE WHEN (DOSE_1_BRAND LIKE 'Janssen%' AND DOSE_1_ADMIN_DTE IS NOT NULL) OR (DOSE_2_ADMIN_DTE IS NOT NULL) THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS VACCINE_SERIES_COMPLETE, CASE WHEN VACCINE_EXEMPTION_DTE <= CURRENT DATE AND (VACCINE_EXEMPTION_EXP_DTE IS NULL OR VACCINE_EXEMPTION_EXP_DTE >= CURRENT DATE) THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS "Exemption Flag", CASE WHEN DOSE_1_ADMIN_DTE IS NOT NULL THEN 'Completed' WHEN DOSE_1_ADMIN_DTE IS NULL AND DOSE_1_APPT_STATUS = 'PRE' THEN 'MSK Scheduled' ELSE 'No Record' END AS DOSE_1, CASE WHEN DOSE_2_ADMIN_DTE IS NOT NULL THEN 'Completed' WHEN DOSE_2_ADMIN_DTE IS NULL AND DOSE_2_APPT_STATUS = 'PRE' THEN 'MSK Scheduled' ELSE 'No Record' END AS DOSE_2, CASE WHEN CVP_VACC_REMT_EXMP_IND = 'Y' THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS REMOTE_FLAG, CVP_VACC_REMT_EXMP_EFF_DTE AS REMOTE_EFFECTIVE_DATE FROM EMP A JOIN IDB.COVID19_VACCINE_PERSON ON EVI_EMPLOYEE_ID = CVP_EMPLOYEE_ID) SELECT DISTINCT TRIM(EVI_EMPLOYEE_ID) "Employee ID", TRIM(CVP_NAME) "Employee Name", VACCINE_SERIES_COMPLETE "Vaccine Series Complete", "Exemption Flag", DOSE_1, DOSE_2, REMOTE_FLAG "Remote Worker Flag", REMOTE_EFFECTIVE_DATE "Date Effective" FROM FIN

prompt: Request to create a weekly report of patients who have been referred for sleep studies, based on the "Sleep Study" order in CIS.
completion: WITH ETO AS (SELECT OUO_ORD_GUID, OO_MRN MRN, STRIP(PT_LAST_NAME)||', '||STRIP(PT_FIRST_NAME) PT_NAME, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH DOB, PT_SEX SEX, YEAR(CURRENT DATE) - YEAR(PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) CURRENT_AGE, OO_ENTER_DTE ENTER_DATE , OUO_REQ_FOR_DTE REQ_FOR_DTE, OO_ORD_NAME ORD_NAME, STRIP(OO_ORD_STS_CD)|| ' - '||OUO_STS_DESC ORD_STS, OUO_IP_OP_IND IP_OP_IND, OO_REQ_TME_PRIO TIME_PRIORITY, OUO_USER_NAME USER_NAME, OO_ENTER_ROLE USER_ROLE, OUO_PVDR_NAME REQUESTED_BY, OUO_PVDR_ROLE_TYPE REQUESTER_ROLE, RQ.DOC_SVC SVC, AV_DESC AS SVC_DESC, OUO_CURR_LOC ORD_LOCATION , OSH_CREATE_DTE RELEASED_DTE , DAYS(CURRENT DATE) - DAYS(OO_ENTER_DTE) DAYS_SINCE_ENTERED , OO_SUMMARY_LINE ORD_SUMMARY FROM IDB.OMS_USER_ORDERS JOIN IDB.OMS_ORDER ON OO_ORD_GUID = OUO_ORD_GUID JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PT_MRN = OO_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.DOC RQ ON RQ.DOC_DR_NO = OO_REQ_DR_NO LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS ON RQ.DOC_SVC = AV_CODE AND AV_ELEMENT = 'SVC' LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_STS_HX ON OSH_ORD_GUID = OO_ORD_GUID AND OSH_FUNCTION_CD = '105' WHERE OO_ENTER_DTE >= '2019-01-01' AND OO_REQ_TME_PRIO NOT IN ('Outside Order', 'Medicaid') AND OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID = '9000012913100730' ) , DX AS (SELECT OUD_ORD_GUID, OUD_MRN , MAX(CASE WHEN OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'Sleep Dx' THEN OUD_USER_DI_VALUE ELSE '' END) "Sleep Dx", MAX(CASE WHEN OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'Cancer Dx' THEN OUD_USER_DI_VALUE ELSE '' END) "Cancer Dx" FROM ETO JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_USER_DATA ON OUO_ORD_GUID = OUD_ORD_GUID GROUP BY OUD_ORD_GUID, OUD_MRN), BMI AS (SELECT PMH_MRN, PMH_MEASURE_DTE, PMH_BMI, PMH_MEASURE_SYS FROM ETO JOIN IDB.PT_MEASURES_HX ON MRN = PMH_MRN WHERE PMH_MEASURE_SYS = 'CDD' AND PMH_MEASURE_DTE = (SELECT MAX(PMH_MEASURE_DTE) AS MDTE FROM IDB.PT_MEASURES_HX WHERE PMH_MRN = MRN) ) SELECT PT_NAME, MRN, DOB, CURRENT_AGE AGE , PMH_BMI AS BMI, "Cancer Dx", ENTER_DATE, ORD_STS "Order Status", REQ_FOR_DTE, "Sleep Dx", IP_OP_IND "INPT/OUTPT", REQUESTED_BY, SVC_DESC SERVICE, ORD_SUMMARY, RELEASED_DTE, DAYS_SINCE_ENTERED FROM ETO LEFT JOIN DX ON OUD_ORD_GUID = OUO_ORD_GUID LEFT JOIN BMI ON MRN = PMH_MRN

prompt: Please provide a list of all patients (de-identified) who have received a checkpoint inhibitor (list provided below) and who also meet one of following other criteria: (1) Neutropenia, (2) Anemia, (3) Thrombocytopenia, or (4) Positive result in coombs test
completion: WITH CPI_PTS AS (SELECT PT_MRN AS MRN, PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID AS DEID, PIC.PINC_GENERIC_NAME AS "Generic Drug Name", MIN(D1.DT_DTE) AS "Order Start Date", MAX(D2.DT_DTE) AS "Order Stop Date" FROM DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS LEFT JOIN DV.PHM_PT_MEDS_MQT PPMM ON PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PPMM.POD_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID LEFT JOIN DV.PHM_ORDER_DTL POD ON PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = POD.POD_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID AND PPMM.POD_PHARMA_INVENTORY_CTLG_ID = POD.POD_PHARMA_INVENTORY_CTLG_ID LEFT JOIN DV.PHM_INVENTORY_CATALOG PIC ON POD.POD_PHARMA_INVENTORY_CTLG_ID = PIC.PINC_INVENTORY_CTLG_ID AND PIC.PINC_CHEMO_IND = 'Y' LEFT JOIN DV.DATE_V D1 ON POD.POD_START_DATE_ID = D1.DT_DATE_ID LEFT JOIN DV.DATE_V D2 ON POD.POD_STOP_DATE_ID = D2.DT_DATE_ID LEFT JOIN DV.PHM_ORDER_ATTR POA ON POD.POD_PHARMA_ORD_ATTR_ID = POA.POA_PHARMA_ORDER_ATTR_ID WHERE LOWER(PIC.PINC_GENERIC_NAME) IN ('ipilimumab', 'nivolumab', 'pembrolizumab', 'atezolizumab', 'avelumab', 'durvalumab') GROUP BY PT_MRN, PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID, PIC.PINC_GENERIC_NAME) , PTS AS (SELECT MRN, DEID, LR_TEST_NAME, LR_SUBTEST_NAME, LR_RESULT_VALUE, LR_TEST_UP_LIMIT, LR_TEST_LOW_LIMIT, LR_PERFORMED_DTE, LR_UNIT_MEASURE FROM CPI_PTS JOIN IDB.LAB_RESULTS ON LR_MRN = MRN WHERE LR_SUBTEST_NAME IN ('Abs Neut', 'Absolute Neutrophil Count, Quest', 'Neutrophils Absolute, Quest', 'Neutrophils, Absolute, Quest', 'Quest Neutrophils, Absolute') ) SELECT * FROM PTS ;

prompt: Daily report on patients scheduled for appointments that day at Koch Center who have an open Nursing Ambulatory Referral Chaplaincy order.
completion: WITH ETO AS (SELECT ORDSTATUS, ENTER_DTE, ORDID, ORDNAME, OO_MRN, "Requested For", "Chaplaincy Religion", ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY OO_MRN ORDER BY ENTER_DTE DESC) REQ FROM (SELECT STRIP(OO_ORD_STS_CD)||'-'||STRIP(OSTS_STS_DESC) ORDSTATUS, OO_ENTER_DTE ENTER_DTE, OO_ORD_ID ORDID, OO_ORD_NAME ORDNAME, OO_MRN, MAX(CASE WHEN OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'Requested For' THEN OUD_USER_DI_VALUE ELSE '' END) "Requested For", MAX(CASE WHEN OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'Chaplaincy Religion' THEN OUD_USER_DI_VALUE ELSE '' END) "Chaplaincy Religion" FROM IDB.OMS_ORDER JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_USER_DATA ON OO_ORD_GUID = OUD_ORD_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_STATUS ON OO_ORD_STS_CD = OSTS_ORD_STS_CD WHERE OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID = '9000005587400730' AND OO_ORD_STS_CD = 'AUA2' GROUP BY OO_ORD_STS_CD, OSTS_STS_DESC, OO_ENTER_DTE , OO_ORD_ID, OO_ORD_NAME , OO_MRN) AS A) , VST AS (SELECT CPE_ENC_CSN_ID, CPE_MRN MRN, STRIP(PT_LAST_NAME)||', '||STRIP(PT_FIRST_NAME) PT_NAME, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH DOB, CLD_DEPT_NAME DEPT_NAME, CRE_RES_NAME VISIT_PROVIDER, CRE_RES_TYP RES_TYP, CPE_ENC_DTE VISIT_DATE, TIME(CPE_APPT_DT) AS VISIT_TIME, CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME VISIT_TYPE, CPE_APPT_DT, ORDSTATUS, ENTER_DTE, ORDID, ORDNAME, OO_MRN, "Requested For", "Chaplaincy Religion", ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CPE_MRN, CPE_ENC_DTE ORDER BY CPE_ENC_CSN_ID DESC) RN FROM ETO JOIN IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER ON OO_MRN = CPE_MRN AND REQ = 1 JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PT_MRN = CPE_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CRE_RES_ID = CPE_VST_RES_ID AND CRE_RES_TYP IN ('Physician', 'Nurse Practitioner', 'Physician Assistant', 'Nurse', 'PhD', 'Therapist') JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID = CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CLD_DEPT_ID = CPE_DEPT_ID AND CLD_CLD_CENTER = 'KOCH' WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS = 'Sch' AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT date AND CURRENT DATE + 2 DAY AND CPE_CPE_IP_IND <> 'Inpatient' ) SELECT MRN, PT_NAME, DOB, DEPT_NAME, VISIT_PROVIDER, RES_TYP, VISIT_DATE, VISIT_TIME, VISIT_TYPE, ORDID, ORDNAME, ORDSTATUS, "Requested For", "Chaplaincy Religion" FROM VST WHERE RN = 1 ;

prompt: Provide a list of patients diagnosed with brain metastases who have been treated with osimertinib (tagrisso).
completion: WITH A1 AS (SELECT DISTINCT APR_MRN, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH AS DOB, CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME, APR_GENERIC_NAME, APR_DRUG_NAME, APR_START_DTE, APR_END_DTE, APR_ORD_RX_TYPE FROM IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX_V JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON APR_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE 1=1 AND CDG_CHEMO_FLAG = 'Y' AND(UPPER(APR_GENERIC_NAME) LIKE '%OSIMERTINIB%' OR UPPER(APR_GENERIC_NAME) LIKE '%TAGRISSO%' OR UPPER(CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME) LIKE '%OSIMERTINIB%' OR UPPER(CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME) LIKE '%TAGRISSO%' OR UPPER(APR_DRUG_NAME) LIKE '%OSIMERTINIB%' OR UPPER(APR_DRUG_NAME) LIKE '%TAGRISSO%') ) , A2 AS (SELECT APR_MRN, DOB, CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME, MIN(APR_START_DTE) AS START_DATE, MAX(APR_END_DTE) AS END_DATE FROM A1 GROUP BY APR_MRN, DOB, CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME) , M1 AS (SELECT ZZ.*, CASE WHEN INIT_METS_DATE < START_DATE THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS "Brain Mets prior to Start Date" FROM (SELECT DISTINCT CC_MRN, START_DATE, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS INIT_METS_DATE, CLM_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN A2 ON CC_MRN = APR_MRN WHERE CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND ((CC_PT_TYPE = 'I') OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) AND CC_CLSF_CD IN ('C79.3', 'C79.31', '198.3') GROUP BY CC_MRN, START_DATE, CLM_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK ) ZZ) , M2 AS (SELECT CC_MRN, MAX("Brain Mets prior to Start Date") AS "Brain Mets prior to Start Date", LISTAGG(COALESCE(STRIP(CAST(INIT_METS_DATE AS VARCHAR(12000))), '') || ' | ' || COALESCE(STRIP(CLM_CLSF_CD), '') || ' | ' || COALESCE(STRIP(CAST(CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS VARCHAR(12000))), '') , CHR(13) || CHR(10)) WITHIN GROUP( ORDER BY CC_MRN, INIT_METS_DATE, CLM_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK) AS METS FROM M1 GROUP BY CC_MRN) , X AS (SELECT TM_MRN, TM_DX_DTE, TM_SITE_CD AS SITE_CODE, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_DESC, TM_HIST_CD AS HIST_CODE, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS HIST_DESC FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM H ON TM_HIST_CD = H.CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON TM_SITE_CD = S.CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND TM_MRN IN (SELECT APR_MRN FROM A2) ) , CTE AS (SELECT TM_MRN AS DX_MRN, TM_DX_DTE AS DX_DATE, STRIP(SITE_CODE) || '-' || STRIP(SITE_DESC) || '|' || STRIP(HIST_CODE) || '-' || STRIP(HIST_DESC) AS DX_CODE FROM X) , CTE2 AS (SELECT * FROM CTE ORDER BY DX_MRN, DX_DATE, DX_CODE) , T1 AS (SELECT DX_MRN, DX_DATE, DX_CODE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY DX_MRN ORDER BY DX_DATE) AS RN FROM CTE2 ORDER BY DX_MRN, DX_DATE) , T2 (MRN, DX, RN1) AS (SELECT DX_MRN, CAST(DX_DATE AS VARCHAR(6000))||' | '||CAST(DX_CODE AS VARCHAR(100)), RN FROM T1 WHERE T1.RN = 1 UNION ALL SELECT DX_MRN, RTRIM(CAST(DX AS VARCHAR(4000))) || ', ' || CHR(13) || CHR(10) || CAST(DX_DATE AS VARCHAR(100))||' | '||RTRIM(CAST(DX_CODE AS VARCHAR(100))) , RN1 + 1 FROM T1, T2 WHERE DX_MRN = MRN AND RN = RN1+1 ) , T3 AS (SELECT MRN, MAX(RN1) RN FROM T2 GROUP BY MRN) , T4 AS (SELECT T2.MRN AS TM_MRN, RN, DX FROM T2 JOIN T3 ON T2.MRN = T3.MRN AND T2.RN1 = T3.RN) , Y AS (SELECT A2.*, "Brain Mets prior to Start Date", METS, DX FROM A2 LEFT JOIN M2 ON APR_MRN = CC_MRN LEFT JOIN T4 ON APR_MRN = TM_MRN) , MR AS (SELECT DISTINCT "t1"."PT_MRN" AS "MRN", START_DATE, "t2"."RRPT_ACCESSION_NO" AS "Radiology Accession Number", "t2"."RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE" AS "Radiology Performed Date", "t2"."RRPT_REPORT_DTE" AS "Radiology Report Date", "t2"."RRPT_ORDER_GROUP" AS "Radiology Order Group", "t2"."RRPT_PROCEDURE_NAME" AS "Radiology Procedure Name", UPPER(DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)IMPRESSION:[\w\W]*(?=DICTATED BY:)', RRPT_REPORT_TXT)) AS IMPRESSION, UPPER(CASE WHEN LENGTH(RRPT_REPORT_TXT) <= 15000 THEN RTRIM(CAST(SUBSTR(RRPT_REPORT_TXT, 1, 15000) AS VARCHAR(15000))) ELSE CAST(SUBSTR(RRPT_REPORT_TXT, 1, 15000) AS VARCHAR(15000)) END) AS "Full Report", ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY "t1"."PT_MRN", START_DATE ORDER BY "t2"."RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE" DESC) AS RN FROM Y LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V" "t1" ON APR_MRN = "t1"."PT_MRN" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED" "t3" ON "t1"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t3"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."RADIOLOGY_REPORT_V" "t2" ON "t3"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t2"."RRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_IDENTIFICATION_MRN_V" "t4" ON "t1"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t4"."PI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" WHERE 1=1 AND METS <> '' AND "t2"."RRPT_ORDER_GROUP" = 'MR' AND "t2"."RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE" <= START_DATE AND(UPPER("t2"."RRPT_PROCEDURE_NAME") LIKE '%BRAIN%' OR UPPER("t2"."RRPT_PROCEDURE_NAME") LIKE '%SELLA%') ) SELECT DISTINCT "t1"."PT_MRN" AS "MRN", "t2"."PRPT_ACCESSION_NO" AS "Pathology Report", "t3"."DT_DTE" AS "Pathology Procedure Date", "t4"."DT_DTE" AS "Pathology Report Date", PRPT_REPORT_TYPE_DESC, UPPER(CASE WHEN LENGTH(PRPT_REPORT) <= 15000 THEN RTRIM(CAST(SUBSTR(PRPT_REPORT, 1, 15000) AS VARCHAR(15000))) ELSE CAST(SUBSTR(PRPT_REPORT, 1, 15000) AS VARCHAR(15000)) END) AS TXT, CASE WHEN LOCATE('CSF', UPPER("t2"."PRPT_REPORT")) > 0 THEN 'Y' END AS CSF, CASE WHEN LOCATE('CEREBROSPINAL FLUID', UPPER("t2"."PRPT_REPORT")) > 0 THEN 'Y' END AS "CEREBROSPINAL FLUID", CASE WHEN LOCATE('LUMBAR PUNCTURE', UPPER("t2"."PRPT_REPORT")) > 0 THEN 'Y' END AS "LUMBAR PUNCTURE" FROM Y JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V" "t1" ON APR_MRN = "t1"."PT_MRN" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED" "t5" ON "t1"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t5"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V" "t2" ON "t5"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t2"."PRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" "t3" ON "t2"."PRPT_PROCEDURE_DATE_ID" = "t3"."DT_DATE_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" "t4" ON "t2"."PRPT_REPORT_DATE_ID" = "t4"."DT_DATE_ID" WHERE 1=1 AND METS <> '' AND CONTAINS("t2"."PRPT_REPORT", '("CSF" | "CEREBROSPINAL FLUID" | "LUMBAR PUNCTURE")') = 1 AND "t2"."PRPT_REPORT" IS NOT NULL AND(PRPT_REPORT_TYPE_DESC = 'Flow Cytometry Report' OR PRPT_REPORT_TYPE_DESC LIKE '%Cytology%')

prompt: Upcoming appointments with Dr. Gopakumar Iyer, Dr. Dean Bajorin, Dr. Samuel Funt, Dr. Min Yuen Teo, and Dr. Jonathan Rosenberg and the patient's 12-245 Part A and Part C status
completion: WITH APPTS AS (SELECT PT_MRN AS "MRN", PT_LAST_NAME "Last Name", PT_FIRST_NAME "First Name", PT_BIRTH_DTE, PT_RACE_DESC, CORE_ETHNICITY_DESC, CPP_LANG, PENC_ENC_DT, DT_DTE AS "Encounter Date", TIME(PENC_ENC_DT) "Encounter Time", ENR_RES_NAME AS "Primary Resource Name", ENVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME AS "Visit Type Name", ENDP_CENTER_ABBR "Location" FROM DV.PATIENT_ENCOUNTER JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PENC_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID JOIN DV.PATIENT_CORE_DEMOGRAPHICS ON PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = CORE_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID JOIN IDB.CL_PAS_PATIENT ON PT_MRN = CPP_MRN JOIN DV.DATE ON PENC_ENC_DATE_ID = DT_DATE_ID LEFT JOIN DV.ENCOUNTER_DESC_CATALOG STS ON PENC_APPT_STS = STS.EDC_DEPT_ABBREV AND STS.EDC_GROUP_ID = 'STS' JOIN DV.ENCOUNTER_DEPARTMENT ON PENC_DEPT_ID = ENDP_ENC_DEPT_ID JOIN DV.ENCOUNTER_SCHD_RESOURCES ON PENC_PT_ENC_ID = ENSR_PT_ENC_ID AND ENSR_PRIMARY_RES_IND = 'Y' JOIN DV.ENCOUNTER_RESOURCE ON ENSR_RES_ID = ENR_ENC_RES_ID JOIN DV.ENCOUNTER_VISIT_TYPE ON PENC_VISIT_TYPE_ID = ENVT_ENC_VISIT_TYPE_ID WHERE PENC_APPT_STS IN ('Sch') AND ENR_RES_NAME IN ('IYER, GOPAKUMAR V', 'BAJORIN, DEAN', 'FUNT, SAMUEL A', 'TEO, MIN YUEN', 'ROSENBERG, JONATHAN E') AND DT_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT date AND CURRENT date + 7 DAY ) , IRB AS (SELECT MRN IRB_MRN, MAX(CASE WHEN REG_ID = '100' THEN CRDB.CRNT_CONSENT_DATE END) "Part A Consent Date", MAX(CASE WHEN REG_ID = '100' THEN DATE(CRDB.REGISTRATION_DATETIME) END) "Part A Registration Date", MAX(CASE WHEN REG_ID = '300' THEN CRDB.CRNT_CONSENT_DATE END) "Part C Consent Date", MAX(CASE WHEN REG_ID = '300' THEN DATE(CRDB.REGISTRATION_DATETIME) END) "Part C Registration Date" FROM (SELECT DISTINCT MRN FROM APPTS) A JOIN NN.CRDB_DASH_PT_REG CRDB ON MRN = PT_MRN JOIN NN.CRDB_DASH_PT PT ON CRDB.PRT_ID = PT.PRT_ID AND CRDB.PT_MRN = PT.PT_MRN WHERE CRDB.PRT_ID = '12-245' AND REG_ID IN ('100', '300') AND CRNT_ELGBL_STATUS_DSCRP NOT IN ('Ineligible', 'Cancel') GROUP BY MRN ) , NEXT_APPT AS (SELECT A.MRN, A.PENC_ENC_DT, DT_DTE "Next Encounter Date", TIME(E.PENC_ENC_DT) "Next Encounter Time", ENR_RES_NAME AS "Next Primary Resource Name", ENVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME AS "Next Visit Type Name", ENDP_CENTER_ABBR "Next Location", ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY A.MRN, A.PENC_ENC_DT ORDER BY E.PENC_ENC_DT) RN FROM (SELECT MRN, PENC_ENC_DT FROM APPTS) A JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON MRN = PT_MRN JOIN DV.PATIENT_ENCOUNTER E ON PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PENC_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID AND A.PENC_ENC_DT < E.PENC_ENC_DT JOIN DV.DATE ON PENC_ENC_DATE_ID = DT_DATE_ID LEFT JOIN DV.ENCOUNTER_DESC_CATALOG STS ON PENC_APPT_STS = STS.EDC_DEPT_ABBREV AND STS.EDC_GROUP_ID = 'STS' JOIN DV.ENCOUNTER_DEPARTMENT ON PENC_DEPT_ID = ENDP_ENC_DEPT_ID JOIN DV.ENCOUNTER_SCHD_RESOURCES ON PENC_PT_ENC_ID = ENSR_PT_ENC_ID AND ENSR_PRIMARY_RES_IND = 'Y' JOIN DV.ENCOUNTER_RESOURCE ON ENSR_RES_ID = ENR_ENC_RES_ID JOIN DV.ENCOUNTER_VISIT_TYPE ON PENC_VISIT_TYPE_ID = ENVT_ENC_VISIT_TYPE_ID WHERE PENC_APPT_STS IN ('Sch') ) SELECT A."MRN", "Last Name", "First Name", PT_BIRTH_DTE "DOB", PT_RACE_DESC "Race", CORE_ETHNICITY_DESC "Ethnicity", CPP_LANG "Primary Language", "Encounter Date", "Encounter Time", "Primary Resource Name", "Visit Type Name", "Location", "Part A Consent Date", "Part A Registration Date", "Part C Consent Date", "Part C Registration Date", "Next Encounter Date", "Next Encounter Time", "Next Primary Resource Name", "Next Visit Type Name", "Next Location" FROM APPTS A LEFT JOIN IRB ON A."MRN" = IRB_MRN LEFT JOIN NEXT_APPT NA ON A."MRN" = NA.MRN AND A.PENC_ENC_DT = NA.PENC_ENC_DT AND RN = 1

prompt: Provide a Darwin report to provide catchment areas
completion: SELECT PT_MRN MRN, PT_LAST_NAME LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME FIRST_NAME, IIC_ZIP_CD ZIP_CODE, IIC_CITY CITY, IIC_COUNTY COUNTY, IIC_STATE STATE, IIC_CATCHMENT CATCHMENT FROM IDB.PATIENT JOIN IDB.ZIPCODE ON LEFT(PT_ZIP_CD, 5) = ZC_ZIP JOIN IDB.ID_IP_IWT_CATCHMENT ON ZC_ZIP = IIC_ZIP_CD WHERE 1=1

prompt: Identify female patients who had a breast biopsy from 1998-2010 at age 25 or younger.
completion: WITH STEREO1 AS (SELECT PBD_MRN AS MRN, PBD_SVC_DTE AS SVC_DTE FROM IDB.PATIENT JOIN IDB.PBD_DTL ON PBD_MRN = PT_MRN AND YEAR(PBD_SVC_DTE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) <= 25 AND PBD_SVC_DTE >= '1998-01-01' JOIN IDB.PBD_CODE ON PBD_PBD_CD = PBC_PBD_CD WHERE PT_SEX = 'F' AND PBC_CPT_CD = '77031'), STEREO2 AS (SELECT PBD_MRN AS MRN, PBD_SVC_DTE AS SVC_DTE FROM IDB.PATIENT JOIN STEREO1 ON PBD_MRN = MRN AND PBD_SVC_DTE = SVC_DTE JOIN IDB.PBD_DTL ON PBD_MRN = PT_MRN AND YEAR(PBD_SVC_DTE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) <= 25 AND PBD_SVC_DTE >= '1998-01-01' JOIN IDB.PBD_CODE ON PBD_PBD_CD = PBC_PBD_CD WHERE PT_SEX = 'F' AND PBC_CPT_CD = '19103'), MR1 AS (SELECT PBD_MRN AS MRN, PBD_SVC_DTE AS SVC_DTE FROM IDB.PATIENT JOIN IDB.PBD_DTL ON PBD_MRN = PT_MRN AND YEAR(PBD_SVC_DTE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) <= 25 AND PBD_SVC_DTE >= '1998-01-01' JOIN IDB.PBD_CODE ON PBD_PBD_CD = PBC_PBD_CD WHERE PT_SEX = 'F' AND PBC_CPT_CD = '77021'), MR2 AS (SELECT PBD_MRN AS MRN, PBD_SVC_DTE AS SVC_DTE FROM IDB.PATIENT JOIN MR1 ON PBD_MRN = MRN AND PBD_SVC_DTE = SVC_DTE JOIN IDB.PBD_DTL ON PBD_MRN = PT_MRN AND YEAR(PBD_SVC_DTE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) <= 25 AND PBD_SVC_DTE >= '1998-01-01' JOIN IDB.PBD_CODE ON PBD_PBD_CD = PBC_PBD_CD WHERE PT_SEX = 'F' AND PBC_CPT_CD = '19103'), US1 AS (SELECT PBD_MRN AS MRN, PBD_SVC_DTE AS SVC_DTE FROM IDB.PATIENT JOIN IDB.PBD_DTL ON PBD_MRN = PT_MRN AND YEAR(PBD_SVC_DTE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) <= 25 AND PBD_SVC_DTE >= '1998-01-01' JOIN IDB.PBD_CODE ON PBD_PBD_CD = PBC_PBD_CD WHERE PT_SEX = 'F' AND PBC_CPT_CD = '76942'), US2 AS (SELECT PBD_MRN AS MRN, PBD_SVC_DTE AS SVC_DTE FROM IDB.PATIENT JOIN US1 ON PBD_MRN = MRN AND PBD_SVC_DTE = SVC_DTE JOIN IDB.PBD_DTL ON PBD_MRN = PT_MRN AND YEAR(PBD_SVC_DTE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) <= 25 AND PBD_SVC_DTE >= '1998-01-01' JOIN IDB.PBD_CODE ON PBD_PBD_CD = PBC_PBD_CD WHERE PT_SEX = 'F' AND PBC_CPT_CD IN ('10022', '19102', '19103')), PA AS (SELECT DTL_MRN AS MRN, DTL_SVC_DTE AS SVC_DTE FROM IDB.PATIENT JOIN IDB.PA_DETAIL ON DTL_MRN = PT_MRN AND YEAR(DTL_SVC_DTE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) <= 25 WHERE PT_SEX = 'F' AND DTL_SVC_CD IN ('4100228', '4100343', '4190120', '4191029', '4191128', '4191045', '4191037', '4191052', '4193009', '4193025', '4760989', '4769428', '50770213', '4742060', '4769410', '4760948', '4761128', '4188017', '4188033')) SELECT PT_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, SVC_DTE AS BIOPSY_DTE, YEAR(SVC_DTE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) AS AGE_AT_BIOPSY FROM (SELECT * FROM STEREO2 UNION SELECT * FROM MR2 UNION SELECT * FROM US2 UNION SELECT * FROM PA) AS A JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PT_MRN = MRN

prompt: Please provide a one time list of all lung cancer patients with EGFR mutations who also have PIK3CA mutations H1047R, H1047L, E545K, E542K.
completion: WITH CDB AS (SELECT DISTINCT TM_MRN, AV_DESC AS CASE_STS, TM_DX_DTE, TM_HIST_CD, CONCAT(CONCAT(RTRIM(TM_SITE_CD), '-'), S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK) AS IDB_SITE, CONCAT(CONCAT(RTRIM(TM_HIST_CD), '-'), H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK) AS IDB_HIST FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS ON AV_ELEMENT = 'CASE_STS' AND AV_CODE = TM_CASE_STS WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND TM_SITE_CD LIKE 'C34%' ) , IDB AS (SELECT DISTINCT CC_MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS MIN_DX_DTE, CC_CLSF_CD AS ICD9_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS ICD9_DESC FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE SUBSTR(CC_CLSF_CD, 1, 3) IN ('162', 'C34') AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND (CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) GROUP BY CC_MRN, CC_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK ) , DIAG AS (SELECT DISTINCT DX_MRN, LISTAGG(COALESCE(STRIP(CAST(DX_DTE AS VARCHAR(12000))), '')||' :'|| COALESCE(STRIP(CAST(DX_CODE AS VARCHAR(12000))), '')||' - '|| COALESCE(STRIP(CAST(DX_DESC AS VARCHAR(12000))), '')|| ' | ', CHR(13) || CHR(10)) WITHIN GROUP ( ORDER BY DX_CODE) AS DIAGNOSIS FROM (SELECT TM_MRN AS DX_MRN, TM_DX_DTE AS DX_DTE, IDB_SITE AS DX_CODE, IDB_HIST AS DX_DESC FROM CDB UNION SELECT CC_MRN AS DX_MRN, MIN_DX_DTE AS DX_DTE, ICD9_CD AS DX_CODE, ICD9_DESC AS DX_DESC FROM IDB) GROUP BY DX_MRN) , EGFR AS (SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN AS EGFR_MRN, DIAGNOSIS AS EGFR_DIAGNOSIS, GENE AS EGFR_GENE, AA_CHANGE AS EGFR_MUTATION FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_STRUCTURED_RESULTS_V JOIN DIAG ON DX_MRN = PT_MRN AND GENE = 'EGFR' AND AA_CHANGE IN ('L858R', 'L861Q', 'S768I', 'T790M', 'E746_A750del', 'E746_A750delinsAP', 'E746_A750delinsIP', 'E746_A750delinsNP', 'E746_A750delinsRP', 'E746_L747delinsIP', 'E746_L750delinsP', 'E746_P753delinsIS', 'E746_P753delinsLS', 'E746_P753delinsVS', 'E746_S752delinsA', 'E746_S752delinsI', 'E746_S752delinsIPVA', 'E746_S752delinsN', 'E746_S752delinsV', 'E746_T751delinsA', 'E746_T751delinsAPS', 'E746_T751delinsI', 'E746_T751delinsIP', 'E746_T751delinsL', 'E746_T751delinsVA', 'E746_T751delinsVP', 'E746_T751delinsVS') ) , PIK3CA AS (SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN AS PIK_MRN, DIAGNOSIS AS PIK_DIAGNOSIS, GENE AS PIK_GENE, AA_CHANGE AS PIK3CA_MUTATION FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_STRUCTURED_RESULTS_V JOIN DIAG ON DX_MRN = PT_MRN AND GENE = 'PIK3CA' AND AA_CHANGE IN ('H1047R', 'H1047L', 'E545K', 'E542K')) SELECT EGFR_MUTATION, COUNT(EGFR_MRN) AS EGFR_PATIENTS_COUNT FROM EGFR JOIN PIK3CA ON PIK_MRN = EGFR_MRN GROUP BY EGFR_MUTATION; WITH CDB AS (SELECT DISTINCT TM_MRN, AV_DESC AS CASE_STS, TM_DX_DTE, TM_HIST_CD, CONCAT(CONCAT(RTRIM(TM_SITE_CD), '-'), S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK) AS IDB_SITE, CONCAT(CONCAT(RTRIM(TM_HIST_CD), '-'), H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK) AS IDB_HIST FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS ON AV_ELEMENT = 'CASE_STS' AND AV_CODE = TM_CASE_STS WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND TM_SITE_CD LIKE 'C34%' ) , IDB AS (SELECT DISTINCT CC_MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS MIN_DX_DTE, CC_CLSF_CD AS ICD9_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS ICD9_DESC FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE SUBSTR(CC_CLSF_CD, 1, 3) IN ('162', 'C34') AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND (CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) GROUP BY CC_MRN, CC_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK ) , DIAG AS (SELECT DISTINCT DX_MRN, LISTAGG(COALESCE(STRIP(CAST(DX_DTE AS VARCHAR(12000))), '')||' :'|| COALESCE(STRIP(CAST(DX_CODE AS VARCHAR(12000))), '')||' - '|| COALESCE(STRIP(CAST(DX_DESC AS VARCHAR(12000))), '')|| ' | ', CHR(13) || CHR(10)) WITHIN GROUP ( ORDER BY DX_CODE) AS DIAGNOSIS FROM (SELECT TM_MRN AS DX_MRN, TM_DX_DTE AS DX_DTE, IDB_SITE AS DX_CODE, IDB_HIST AS DX_DESC FROM CDB UNION SELECT CC_MRN AS DX_MRN, MIN_DX_DTE AS DX_DTE, ICD9_CD AS DX_CODE, ICD9_DESC AS DX_DESC FROM IDB) GROUP BY DX_MRN) , EGFR AS (SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN AS EGFR_MRN, DIAGNOSIS AS EGFR_DIAGNOSIS, GENE AS EGFR_GENE, AA_CHANGE AS EGFR_MUTATION FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_STRUCTURED_RESULTS_V JOIN DIAG ON DX_MRN = PT_MRN AND GENE = 'EGFR' AND AA_CHANGE IN ('L858R', 'L861Q', 'S768I', 'T790M', 'E746_A750del', 'E746_A750delinsAP', 'E746_A750delinsIP', 'E746_A750delinsNP', 'E746_A750delinsRP', 'E746_L747delinsIP', 'E746_L750delinsP', 'E746_P753delinsIS', 'E746_P753delinsLS', 'E746_P753delinsVS', 'E746_S752delinsA', 'E746_S752delinsI', 'E746_S752delinsIPVA', 'E746_S752delinsN', 'E746_S752delinsV', 'E746_T751delinsA', 'E746_T751delinsAPS', 'E746_T751delinsI', 'E746_T751delinsIP', 'E746_T751delinsL', 'E746_T751delinsVA', 'E746_T751delinsVP', 'E746_T751delinsVS') ) , PIK3CA AS (SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN AS PIK_MRN, DIAGNOSIS AS PIK_DIAGNOSIS, GENE AS PIK_GENE, AA_CHANGE AS PIK3CA_MUTATION FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_STRUCTURED_RESULTS_V JOIN DIAG ON DX_MRN = PT_MRN AND GENE = 'PIK3CA' AND AA_CHANGE IN ('H1047R', 'H1047L', 'E545K', 'E542K')) SELECT PIK3CA_MUTATION, COUNT(PIK_MRN) AS PIK3CA_PATIENTS_COUNT FROM EGFR JOIN PIK3CA ON PIK_MRN = EGFR_MRN GROUP BY PIK3CA_MUTATION;

prompt: Provide diagnostic data of patients treated at MSKCC for oropharyngeal cancers.
completion: WITH ICD0 AS (SELECT TM_MRN AS MRN , MIN(TM_DX_DTE) AS FIRSTICD0_DX FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR TM WHERE TM.TM_SITE_CD IN ('C019' , 'C028' , 'C029' , 'C050' , 'C051' , 'C052' , 'C058' , 'C059' , 'C068' , 'C069' , 'C090' , 'C091' , 'C099' , 'C100' , 'C101' , 'C102' , 'C103' , 'C108' , 'C109') AND TM_DX_DTE >= '1985-01-01' AND TM_DX_DTE <= '2012-12-31' GROUP BY TM_MRN), ICD9 AS (SELECT CC_MRN AS MRN , MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS FIRSTICD9_DX FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF LEFT JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE CC_CLSF_CD IN ('141.0' , '141.5' , '141.8' , '141.9' , '145.3' , '145.4' , '145.5' , '145.8' , '145.9' , '146' , '146.0' , '146.1' , '146.2' , '146.3' , '146.4' , '146.5' , '146.6' , '146.7' , '146.8' , '146.9' , '149' , '149.8') AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND (CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) AND CC_EFF_DTE >= '1985-01-01' AND CC_EFF_DTE <= '2012-12-31' GROUP BY CC_MRN) SELECT ICD0.MRN , CAST(ICD0.FIRSTICD0_DX AS CHAR(15)) AS FIRSTICD0_DX , CAST(ICD9.FIRSTICD9_DX AS CHAR(15)) AS FIRSTICD9_DX , CASE WHEN ICD0.FIRSTICD0_DX > ICD9.FIRSTICD9_DX THEN CAST(ICD9.FIRSTICD9_DX AS CHAR(15)) ELSE CAST(ICD0.FIRSTICD0_DX AS CHAR(15)) END AS FIRSTDX FROM ICD0 INNER JOIN ICD9 ON ICD0.MRN = ICD9.MRN UNION ALL SELECT ICD0.MRN , CAST(ICD0.FIRSTICD0_DX AS CHAR(15)) AS FIRSTICD0_DX , 'Unknown' AS FIRSTICD9_DX , CAST(ICD0.FIRSTICD0_DX AS CHAR(15)) AS FIRSTDX FROM ICD0 LEFT OUTER JOIN ICD9 ON ICD0.MRN = ICD9.MRN WHERE ICD9.MRN IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT ICD9.MRN , 'Unknown' AS FIRSTICD0_DX , CAST(ICD9.FIRSTICD9_DX AS CHAR(15)) AS FIRSTICD9_DX , CAST(ICD9.FIRSTICD9_DX AS CHAR(15)) AS FIRSTDX FROM ICD9 LEFT OUTER JOIN ICD0 ON ICD9.MRN = ICD0.MRN WHERE ICD0.MRN IS NULL

prompt: Provide a report of contrast extravasation documentation to ensure compliance and improve documentation fields.
completion: WITH X AS (SELECT DISTINCT CDD_MRN, CDD_DOC_GUID, CDD_AUTHORED_DTE, CDD_SERVICE_DTE, CDD_DOC_NAME, X0.CDO_SECTION, X0.CDO_CTLG_DISPL_NM, X0.CDO_ITEM_NAME, X0.CDO_MSTR_ITEM_NM, STRIP(SUBSTR(X0.CDO_VALUE_TEXT, 1, 2000)) AS VALUE_TEXT FROM IDB.CD_DOCUMENT JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION X0 ON X0.CDO_DOC_GUID = CDD_DOC_GUID AND X0.CDO_AUTHORED_DTE = CDD_AUTHORED_DTE WHERE CDD_CANCEL_IND = '0' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND = '0' AND CDD_SERVICE_DTE BETWEEN '2019-01-01' AND CURRENT date AND CDD_DOC_NAME IN ('Nursing Event Note - Inpatient-Contrast Extravasation', 'Nursing Event Note - Outpatient-Contrast Extravasation', 'Nursing Event Note - Periop-Contrast Extravasation', 'zContrast Extravasation - Radiology') AND X0.CDO_CTLG_DISPL_NM LIKE '%Contrast%Extravasation%' AND CDO_VALUE_TEXT <> '' ) SELECT DISTINCT STRIP(X.CDD_MRN) AS MRN, X.CDD_DOC_GUID AS DOC_GUID, X.CDD_AUTHORED_DTE AS AUTHORED_DTE, X.CDD_SERVICE_DTE AS SERVICE_DTE, X.CDD_DOC_NAME AS DOC_NAME, X.CDO_SECTION AS "SECTION", X.CDO_CTLG_DISPL_NM AS CTLG_DISPL_NM, STRIP(SUBSTR(Y1.VALUE_TEXT, 1, 1000)) AS "MR-CT Contrast:", STRIP(SUBSTR(Y1A.VALUE_TEXT, 1, 1000)) AS "MR Contrast", STRIP(SUBSTR(Y1B.VALUE_TEXT, 1, 1000)) AS "CT Contrast:", STRIP(SUBSTR(Y1C.VALUE_TEXT, 1, 1000)) AS "CT Contrast", STRIP(SUBSTR(Y2.VALUE_TEXT, 1, 1000)) AS "Estimated Amount:", STRIP(SUBSTR(Y3.VALUE_TEXT, 1, 1000)) AS "Venous access", STRIP(SUBSTR(Y3A.VALUE_TEXT, 1, 1000)) AS "Laterality", STRIP(SUBSTR(Y3B.VALUE_TEXT, 1, 1000)) AS "Location", STRIP(SUBSTR(Y3C.VALUE_TEXT, 1, 1000)) AS "Location Other:", STRIP(SUBSTR(Y4.VALUE_TEXT, 1, 1000)) AS "Injection Method", STRIP(SUBSTR(Y4A.VALUE_TEXT, 1, 1000)) AS "Power Injection:", STRIP(SUBSTR(Y5.VALUE_TEXT, 1, 1000)) AS "Contrast Describe Area:", STRIP(SUBSTR(Y6.VALUE_TEXT, 1, 1000)) AS "Infiltration Area:", STRIP(SUBSTR(Y7.VALUE_TEXT, 1, 1000)) AS "Infiltration Area 2:", STRIP(SUBSTR(Y8.VALUE_TEXT, 1, 1000)) AS "Infiltration Skin", STRIP(SUBSTR(Y9.VALUE_TEXT, 1, 1000)) AS "Skin is", STRIP(SUBSTR(Y10.VALUE_TEXT, 1, 1000)) AS "Location of pulses assessed:", STRIP(SUBSTR(Y11.VALUE_TEXT, 1, 1000)) AS "Pulses on extremity", STRIP(SUBSTR(Y12.VALUE_TEXT, 1, 1000)) AS "Capillary nail", STRIP(SUBSTR(Y13.VALUE_TEXT, 1, 1000)) AS "Subjective Report", STRIP(SUBSTR(Y14.VALUE_TEXT, 1, 1000)) AS "Motion of Fingers:", STRIP(SUBSTR(Y15.VALUE_TEXT, 1, 1000)) AS "Imaging study", STRIP(SUBSTR(Y16.VALUE_TEXT, 1, 1000)) AS "Imaging study:", STRIP(SUBSTR(Y17.VALUE_TEXT, 1, 1000)) AS "Interventions", STRIP(SUBSTR(Y18.VALUE_TEXT, 1, 1000)) AS "Compress Applied", STRIP(SUBSTR(Y19.VALUE_TEXT, 1, 1000)) AS "Affected extremity", STRIP(SUBSTR(Y20.VALUE_TEXT, 1, 1000)) AS "Discharge Disposition:", STRIP(SUBSTR(Y21.VALUE_TEXT, 1, 1000)) AS "Discharge - Other:", STRIP(SUBSTR(Y22.VALUE_TEXT, 1, 1000)) AS "Attending/Radiologist Name:", STRIP(SUBSTR(Y23.VALUE_TEXT, 1, 1000)) AS "Attending Notified:", STRIP(SUBSTR(Y23A.VALUE_TEXT, 1, 1000)) AS "Discussed with Attending/Radiologist:", STRIP(SUBSTR(Y24.VALUE_TEXT, 1, 1000)) AS "Patient Education", STRIP(SUBSTR(Y25.VALUE_TEXT, 1, 2000)) AS "Comments:" FROM X LEFT JOIN X Y1 ON Y1.CDD_DOC_GUID = X.CDD_DOC_GUID AND Y1.CDO_ITEM_NAME = 'MR-CT Contrast:' LEFT JOIN X Y1A ON Y1A.CDD_DOC_GUID = X.CDD_DOC_GUID AND Y1A.CDO_ITEM_NAME = 'MR Contrast' LEFT JOIN X Y1B ON Y1B.CDD_DOC_GUID = X.CDD_DOC_GUID AND Y1B.CDO_ITEM_NAME = 'CT Contrast:' LEFT JOIN X Y1C ON Y1C.CDD_DOC_GUID = X.CDD_DOC_GUID AND Y1C.CDO_ITEM_NAME = 'CT Contrast' LEFT JOIN X Y2 ON Y2.CDD_DOC_GUID = X.CDD_DOC_GUID AND Y2.CDO_ITEM_NAME = 'Estimated Amount:' LEFT JOIN X Y3 ON Y3.CDD_DOC_GUID = X.CDD_DOC_GUID AND Y3.CDO_ITEM_NAME = 'Venous access' LEFT JOIN X Y3A ON Y3A.CDD_DOC_GUID = X.CDD_DOC_GUID AND Y3A.CDO_ITEM_NAME = 'Laterality' LEFT JOIN X Y3B ON Y3B.CDD_DOC_GUID = X.CDD_DOC_GUID AND Y3B.CDO_ITEM_NAME = 'Location' LEFT JOIN X Y3C ON Y3C.CDD_DOC_GUID = X.CDD_DOC_GUID AND Y3C.CDO_ITEM_NAME = 'Location Other:' LEFT JOIN X Y4 ON Y4.CDD_DOC_GUID = X.CDD_DOC_GUID AND Y4.CDO_ITEM_NAME = 'Injection Method' LEFT JOIN X Y4A ON Y4A.CDD_DOC_GUID = X.CDD_DOC_GUID AND Y4A.CDO_ITEM_NAME = 'Power Injection:' LEFT JOIN X Y5 ON Y5.CDD_DOC_GUID = X.CDD_DOC_GUID AND Y5.CDO_ITEM_NAME = 'Contrast Describe Area:' LEFT JOIN X Y6 ON Y6.CDD_DOC_GUID = X.CDD_DOC_GUID AND Y6.CDO_ITEM_NAME = 'Infiltration Area:' LEFT JOIN X Y7 ON Y7.CDD_DOC_GUID = X.CDD_DOC_GUID AND Y7.CDO_ITEM_NAME = 'Infiltration Area 2:' LEFT JOIN X Y8 ON Y8.CDD_DOC_GUID = prompt: Provide darwin cohort and notifications for upcoming research appointments in the following week.
completion: WITH BASE AS (SELECT PT_MRN MRN , TRIM(ENDP_SERVICE_DEPT_GRP_6) DEPT_GRP_6 , TRIM(ENDP_SVC_CLINIC_SUB_DEPT_GRP_7) DIV_GRP_7 , TRIM(ENDP_SERVICE_SPECIALTY_GRP_8) RPT_GRP_8 , TRIM(T2.EDC_DEPT_DESC) APPT_STATUS_DESC , CASE WHEN ENVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR like '%NV%' THEN 'New Visit' WHEN ENVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR like '%IR%' THEN 'Internal Referral' ELSE 'Non-New Visit/Interal Referral' END AS IRNV_IND , PENC_ENC_DT, PENC_MODIFIED_DT , ENR_RES_NAME FROM DV.PATIENT_ENCOUNTER T6 INNER JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PENC_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID INNER JOIN DV.ENCOUNTER_SCHD_RESOURCES SR ON T6.PENC_PT_ENC_ID = SR.ENSR_PT_ENC_ID INNER JOIN DV.ENCOUNTER_RESOURCE ER ON SR.ENSR_RES_ID = ER.ENR_ENC_RES_ID INNER JOIN DV.ENCOUNTER_VISIT_TYPE EVT ON T6.PENC_VISIT_TYPE_ID = EVT.ENVT_ENC_VISIT_TYPE_ID INNER JOIN DV.ENCOUNTER_DESC_CATALOG T2 ON EDC_GROUP_ID = 'STS' AND T6.PENC_APPT_STS = T2.EDC_DEPT_ABBREV INNER JOIN DV.ENCOUNTER_DEPARTMENT T3 ON T6.PENC_DEPT_ID = T3.ENDP_ENC_DEPT_ID INNER JOIN DV.DATE_V REC ON T6.PENC_ENC_DATE_ID = REC.DT_DATE_ID WHERE 1=1 AND T2.EDC_DEPT_DESC IN ('Scheduled') AND DT_DTE <= (CURRENT date + 7 DAYS) + (7-(DAYOFWEEK_ISO((CURRENT date + 7 DAYS)))) DAYS AND DT_DTE >= (CURRENT date + 7 DAYS) - (DAYOFWEEK_ISO(CURRENT date + 7 DAYS) - 1) DAYS AND ER.ENR_RES_NAME IN ('ST GU GCT RESEARCH RN', 'ST GU REN RESEARCH RN', 'ST GU 68 BLADDER RESEARCH RN') ) SELECT * FROM BASE

prompt: Provide a monthly list of pancreatic adenocarcinoma patients with germline BRCA1 or BRCA2 mutation.
completion: WITH IMPACT_1 AS (SELECT DISTINCT Y.PT_MRN, PDRX_ACCESSION_NO, GENE, RESULT, METHOD, PATH_PROCEDURE_DATE, PATH_RPT_DATE, PRPT_CREATED_DT, PDMR_CREATED_DT, PRPT_ACCESSION_NO, PRPT_PATH_RPT_ID, LOCUS, AA_CHANGE, NUCLEOTIDE, SEARCH_HIT1, SEARCH_HIT2, ABERRATIONTYPE, FOLD_CHANGE, GENE2, PDRX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID, PDRX_DMP_PATIENT_ID, T.* FROM DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS X JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_STRUCTURED_RESULTS_V Y ON X.PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = Y.PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID AND GENE like '%BRCA%' JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML DT ON PRPT_PATH_RPT_ID = PDRX_PATH_RPT_ID CROSS JOIN XMLTABLE('$c/root/*' PASSING DT.PDRX_XML_VALUE AS "c" COLUMNS GENE_PANEL VARCHAR(100) PATH '../meta-data/gene-panel', PART_DESCRIPTION VARCHAR(2000) PATH '../meta-data/part_description', PROJECT VARCHAR(100) PATH '../meta-data/dmp_alys_task_name', SAMPLEID VARCHAR(100) PATH '../meta-data/dmp_sample_id', PATIENTID VARCHAR(100) PATH '../meta-data/dmp_patient_id', TUMOR_TYPE_CODE VARCHAR(100) PATH '../meta-data/tumor_type_code', TUMOR_TYPE_NAME VARCHAR(255) PATH '../meta-data/tumor_type_name', IS_METASTASIS VARCHAR(10) PATH '../meta-data/is_metastasis', PRIMARY_SITE VARCHAR(255) PATH '../meta-data/primary_site', DATE_TUMOR_SEQUENCING VARCHAR(255) PATH '../meta-data/date_tumor_sequencing', METASTASIS_SITE VARCHAR(255) PATH '../meta-data/metastasis_site', DT_PROCEDURE VARCHAR(40) PATH '../meta-data/dt_procedure', DT_SIGNOUT VARCHAR(40) PATH '../meta-data/dt_signout', DT_ACCESSIONED VARCHAR(40) PATH '../meta-data/dt_accessioned', DT_ALYS_END_TIME VARCHAR(40) PATH '../meta-data/dt_alys_end_time', DT_DMS_START_TIME VARCHAR(40) PATH '../meta-data/dt_dms_start_time') T WHERE 1=1 AND(UPPER(PRIMARY_SITE) like '%PANCREAS%' OR UPPER(TUMOR_TYPE_NAME) like '%PANCR%') AND PATH_RPT_DATE BETWEEN CURRENT DATE - (DAY(CURRENT DATE) - 1) DAYS - 1 MONTH AND CURRENT DATE - (DAY(CURRENT DATE)) DAYS ) , IMPACT AS (SELECT IMPACT_1.*, CASE WHEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM IMPACT_1) = 0 THEN CAST('X' AS REAL) ELSE CAST( (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM IMPACT_1) AS REAL) END AS "Run/Fail" FROM IMPACT_1) , GI AS (SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN, CPE_ENC_DTE, STRIP(CRE_RES_NAME) AS CRE_RES_NAME, CRE_RES_TYP, STRIP(CLD_DEPT_NAME) AS CLD_DEPT_NAME, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8, CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CPE_MRN ORDER BY CPE_ENC_DTE DESC) AS RN FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CRE_RES_TYP IN ('Physician') AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 = 'GI' AND CPE_MRN IN (SELECT PT_MRN FROM IMPACT) ) SELECT IMPACT.*, CPE_ENC_DTE, CRE_RES_NAME, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8, CLD_DEPT_NAME, RN FROM IMPACT LEFT JOIN GI ON IMPACT.PT_MRN = GI.CPE_MRN AND RN = 1

prompt: Create a report which will provide a count by service of visit and name of NP associated with a ClinDoc form named “Telephone/Electronic Communication, MD, NP, PA” in first quarter 2012.
completion: SELECT OS_SVC_DESC, OU_DISPLAY_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT CDD_DOC_GUID) FROM IDB.CD_DOCUMENT INNER JOIN IDB.OMS_USER ON CDD_USER_GUID = OU_USER_GUID INNER JOIN IDB.OMS_CLIENT_VISIT ON OCV_VISIT_GUID = CDD_VISIT_GUID INNER JOIN IDB.OMS_SERVICE ON OS_SVC_GUID = OCV_SVC_GUID WHERE CDD_SIGNED_DTE BETWEEN '01/01/2012' AND '03/31/2012' AND CDD_AUTHORED_DTE BETWEEN '01/11/2012' AND '03/31/2012' AND CDD_CANCEL_IND = '0' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND = '0' AND CDD_DOC_NAME = 'Telephone/Electronic Communication, MD, NP, PA' AND OU_OCCUPATION = 'NP' GROUP BY OS_SVC_DESC, OU_DISPLAY_NAME

prompt: Create a report on patients diagnosed with prostate cancer and a brain metastasis.
completion: WITH PROSTATE AS (SELECT TM_MRN AS MRN, TM_DX_DTE AS DX_DATE, TM_SITE_CD AS DX_CODE, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS DX_DESC, TM_HIST_CD AS HIST_CODE, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS HIST_DESC FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM H ON TM_HIST_CD = H.CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON TM_SITE_CD = S.CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('3', '6', '7', '8') AND TM_SITE_CD = 'C619' UNION SELECT CC_MRN AS MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS DX_DATE, CLM_CLSF_CD AS DX_CODE, CLM_CLSF_DESC AS DX_DESC, '' AS HIST_CODE, '' AS HIST_DESC FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND ((CC_PT_TYPE = 'I') OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) AND CC_CLSF_CD IN ('185', 'C61') AND CC_MRN NOT IN (SELECT TM_MRN AS MRN FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM H ON TM_HIST_CD = H.CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON TM_SITE_CD = S.CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('3', '6', '7', '8') AND TM_SITE_CD = 'C619' ) GROUP BY CC_MRN, CLM_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC ) , METS AS (SELECT CC_MRN AS MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS METS_DATE FROM PROSTATE JOIN IDB.CTC_CLSF ON MRN = CC_MRN JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND ((CC_PT_TYPE = 'I') OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) AND CC_CLSF_CD IN ('C79.3', 'C79.31', '198.3', '198.4') GROUP BY CC_MRN ) , X AS (SELECT DISTINCT PROSTATE.* FROM PROSTATE JOIN METS ON PROSTATE.MRN = METS.MRN WHERE METS_DATE >= DX_DATE ) , OTHER_PRIMARY AS (SELECT TM_MRN AS MRN, TM_DX_DTE AS DX_DATE, TM_SITE_CD AS DX_CODE, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS DX_DESC FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM H ON TM_HIST_CD = H.CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON TM_SITE_CD = S.CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('3', '6', '7', '8') AND TM_SITE_CD <> 'C619' AND TM_MRN IN (SELECT MRN FROM X) ) , DX AS (SELECT DISTINCT X.*, YEAR(DX_DATE) AS YYYY FROM X WHERE MRN NOT IN (SELECT MRN FROM OTHER_PRIMARY) ) SELECT APR_MRN, APR_GENERIC_NAME, APR_DRUG_NAME, APR_ORD_RX_TYPE, MIN(APR_START_DTE) AS APR_START_DTE, MAX(APR_END_DTE) AS APR_END_DTE FROM DX JOIN IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX ON MRN = APR_MRN JOIN IDB.CHEMO_DRUG_GENERIC ON APR_GENERIC_NAME = CDG_GENERIC_NAME WHERE(UPPER(APR_GENERIC_NAME) LIKE '%ENZALUTAMIDE%' OR UPPER(APR_GENERIC_NAME) LIKE '%XTANDI%' OR UPPER(APR_GENERIC_NAME) LIKE '%APALUTAMIDE%' OR UPPER(APR_GENERIC_NAME) LIKE '%ERLEADA %' OR UPPER(APR_GENERIC_NAME) LIKE '%ABIRATERONE%' OR UPPER(APR_GENERIC_NAME) LIKE '%ZYTIGA%' OR UPPER(APR_GENERIC_NAME) LIKE '%DEGARELIX%' OR UPPER(APR_GENERIC_NAME) LIKE '%FIRMAGON%' OR UPPER(APR_GENERIC_NAME) LIKE '%BICALUTAMIDE%' OR UPPER(APR_GENERIC_NAME) LIKE '%CASODEX%' OR UPPER(APR_GENERIC_NAME) LIKE '%LUPRON%' OR UPPER(APR_GENERIC_NAME) LIKE '%LEUPROLIDE%' OR UPPER(APR_DRUG_NAME) LIKE '%ENZALUTAMIDE%' OR UPPER(APR_DRUG_NAME) LIKE '%XTANDI%' OR UPPER(APR_DRUG_NAME) LIKE '%APALUTAMIDE%' OR UPPER(APR_DRUG_NAME) LIKE '%ERLEADA %' OR UPPER(APR_DRUG_NAME) LIKE '%ABIRATERONE%' OR UPPER(APR_DRUG_NAME) LIKE '%ZYTIGA%' OR UPPER(APR_DRUG_NAME) LIKE '%DEGARELIX%' OR UPPER(APR_DRUG_NAME) LIKE '%FIRMAGON%' OR UPPER(APR_DRUG_NAME) LIKE '%BICALUTAMIDE%' OR UPPER(APR_DRUG_NAME) LIKE '%CASODEX%' OR UPPER(APR_DRUG_NAME) LIKE '%LUPRON%' OR UPPER(APR_DRUG_NAME) LIKE '%LEUPROLIDE%') GROUP BY APR_MRN, APR_GENERIC_NAME, APR_DRUG_NAME, APR_ORD_RX_TYPE

prompt: Provide Tableau dashboard on patients who receive Extracorporeal Photopheresis (ECP) treatment for their GVHD post hematopoietic stem cell transplant from an allogeneic donor
completion: WITH PTS AS (SELECT CDD_MRN, CDD_SERVICE_DTE ECP_SERVICE_DATE FROM IDB.CD_DOCUMENT LEFT JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION ON CDD_MRN = CDO_MRN AND CDD_DOC_GUID = CDO_DOC_GUID AND CDD_AUTHORED_DTE = CDO_AUTHORED_DTE WHERE CDD_DOC_NAME = 'Procedure Note - Lab Medicine' AND CDD_CANCEL_IND <> '1' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND <> '1' AND CDO_ITEM_NAME = 'Lab Med_Donor Room_Procedure Performed_RES' AND CDO_VALUE_TEXT = 'EXTRACORPOREAL PHOTOPHERESIS (ECP)' ) , PRIM_MD AS (SELECT C.CDD_MRN, C.CDD_SERVICE_DTE, CDO_ITEM_NAME, CDO_VALUE_TEXT PRIMARY_MD FROM PTS P JOIN IDB.CD_DOCUMENT C ON P.CDD_MRN = C.CDD_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION ON C.CDD_MRN = CDO_MRN AND CDD_DOC_GUID = CDO_DOC_GUID AND CDD_AUTHORED_DTE = CDO_AUTHORED_DTE WHERE CDD_DOC_NAME = 'PreBMT/IEC Therapy Patient Eval Checklist - PED BMT' AND CDD_CANCEL_IND <> '1' AND CDO_ITEM_NAME = 'Primary Physician' ) , GVHD AS (SELECT DISTINCT P.CDD_MRN, CDD_DOC_GUID, CDD_AUTHORED_DTE, C.CDD_SERVICE_DTE, CDD_DOC_NAME, CASE WHEN CDD_DOC_NAME IN ('GvHD Grading, Acute, MD/NP - BMT', 'GvHD Grading, Acute, MD/NP/PA - BMT', 'GvHD Assessment, Acute, MD/NP/PA - BMT') THEN 'Acute' WHEN CDD_DOC_NAME IN ('GvHD Diagnosis, Chronic - BMT', 'GvHD Assessment, Chronic - BMT', 'GvHD Grading, Chronic - BMT') THEN 'Chronic' WHEN CDD_DOC_NAME IN ('GvHD Assessment, Chronic and Late Acute - BMT') THEN 'Chronic Late Acute' END GVHD, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY P.CDD_MRN, CASE WHEN CDD_DOC_NAME IN ('GvHD Grading, Acute, MD/NP - BMT', 'GvHD Grading, Acute, MD/NP/PA - BMT', 'GvHD Assessment, Acute, MD/NP/PA - BMT') THEN 'Acute' WHEN CDD_DOC_NAME IN ('GvHD Diagnosis, Chronic - BMT', 'GvHD Assessment, Chronic - BMT', 'GvHD Grading, Chronic - BMT') THEN 'Chronic' WHEN CDD_DOC_NAME IN ('GvHD Assessment, Chronic and Late Acute - BMT') THEN 'Chronic Late Acute' END ORDER BY C.CDD_SERVICE_DTE DESC) RN FROM (SELECT DISTINCT CDD_MRN FROM PTS) P JOIN IDB.CD_DOCUMENT C ON P.CDD_MRN = C.CDD_MRN WHERE CDD_DOC_NAME IN ('GvHD Grading, Acute, MD/NP - BMT', 'GvHD Grading, Acute, MD/NP/PA - BMT', 'GvHD Assessment, Acute, MD/NP/PA - BMT', 'GvHD Diagnosis, Chronic - BMT', 'GvHD Assessment, Chronic - BMT', 'GvHD Grading, Chronic - BMT', 'GvHD Assessment, Chronic and Late Acute - BMT') AND CDD_CANCEL_IND <> '1' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND <> '1' ) , GVHD_F AS (SELECT CDD_MRN, MAX(CASE WHEN GVHD = 'Acute' AND CDO_ITEM_NAME IN ('Overall Grade', 'Overall Acute/Chronic grade') THEN STRIP(CDO_VALUE_TEXT) END) AS "Acute Overall Grade", MAX(CASE WHEN GVHD = 'Acute' AND CDO_ITEM_NAME IN ('Highest Overall Grade', 'Overall highest grade') THEN STRIP(CDO_VALUE_TEXT) END) AS "Acute Highest Overall Grade", MAX(CASE WHEN GVHD = 'Acute' AND CDO_ITEM_NAME = 'Acute GvHD Onset Date' THEN STRIP(CDO_VALUE_TEXT) END) AS "Acute GvHD Onset Date", MAX(CASE WHEN GVHD = 'Chronic' AND CDO_ITEM_NAME = 'Date of Onset' THEN STRIP(CDO_VALUE_TEXT) END) AS "Chronic Date of Chronic Onset", MAX(CASE WHEN GVHD = 'Chronic' AND CDO_ITEM_NAME = 'Overall Severity' THEN STRIP(CDO_VALUE_TEXT) END) AS "Chronic Overall Chronic Severity", MAX(CASE WHEN GVHD = 'Chronic Late Acute' AND CDO_ITEM_NAME IN ('BMT_GVHD_Assessment_Overall highest grade RES', 'Overall highest grade') THEN STRIP(CDO_VALUE_TEXT) END) AS "Chronic Late Acute Highest Overall Grade", MAX(CASE WHEN GVHD = 'Chronic Late Acute' AND CDO_ITEM_NAME = 'Date of Chronic GVHD Diagnosis' THEN STRIP(CDO_VALUE_TEXT) END) AS "Chronic Late Acute Date of Chronic Diagnosis", MAX(CASE WHEN GVHD = 'Chronic Late Acute' AND CDO_ITEM_NAME = 'Overall Chronic GVHD Severity' THEN STRIP(CDO_VALUE_TEXT) END) AS "Chronic Late Acute Chronic GVHD Overall Severity" FROM GVHD LEFT JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION ON CDD_MRN = CDO_MRN AND CDD_DOC_GUID = CDO_DOC_GUID AND CDD_AUTHORED_DTE = CDO_AUTHORED_DTE WHERE RN = 1 AND CDO_ITEM_NAME IN ('Overall Grade', 'Overall Acute/Chronic grade', 'Highest Overall Grade', 'Overall highest grade', 'Acute GvHD Onset Date', 'Date of Onset', 'Overall Severity', 'BMT_GVHD_Assessment_Overall highest grade RES', 'Overall highest grade', 'Date of Chronic GVHD Diagnosis') GROUP BY CDD_MRN ) SELECT PTS.CDD_MRN MRN, ECP_SERVICE_DATE, PRIMARY_MD, "Acute Overall Grade", "Acute Highest Overall Grade", "Acute GvHD Onset Date", "Chronic Date of Chronic Onset", "Chronic Overall Chronic Severity", "Chronic Late Acute Highest Overall Grade", "Chronic Late Acute Date of Chronic Diagnosis", "Chronic Late Acute Chronic GVHD Overall Severity" FROM PTS PTS LEFT JOIN PRIM_MD PM ON PTS.CDD_MRN = PM.CDD_MRN LEFT JOIN GVHD_F GVHD ON PTS.CDD_MRN = GVHD.CDD_MRN

prompt: Patients with locally advanced gastric cancer treated with pre-operative chemotherapy followed by surgery
completion: SELECT DISTINCT TM_MRN MRN, PT_LAST_NAME "Last Name", PT_FIRST_NAME "First Name", PT_SEX "Gender", RACE.AV_DESC "Race", PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH "Date of Birth", PT_DATE_OF_DEATH "Date of Death", PLA_LST_APPT_DTE "Last Appointment Date", YEAR(TM_DX_DTE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) "Age at Dx", ST.AV_DESC "Case Status", TM_DX_DTE "Dx Date", TM_HIST_CD "Histology", H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK "Histology Description", TM_SITE_CD "Site Code", S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK "Site Description", TM_SYST_STRT_DTE "Chemo Start Date", TM_CA_SURG_DTE "Surgery Date", TM_CLIN_STG_GRP "Clinical Stage", TM_PATH_STG_GRP "Path Stage" FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS ST ON ST.AV_ELEMENT = 'CASE_STS' AND ST.AV_CODE = TM_CASE_STS JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON TM_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY ON TM_MRN = PLA_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS RACE ON PT_RACE = RACE.AV_CODE AND RACE.AV_ELEMENT = 'RACE' WHERE 1=1 AND (TM_SITE_CD LIKE 'C15%' OR TM_SITE_CD LIKE 'C16%') AND YEAR(TM_DX_DTE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) > 18 AND TM_DX_DTE BETWEEN '2006-05-01' AND '2020-08-11' ORDER BY TM_MRN DESC

prompt: Patients diagnosed with kidney cancer between 2005-2020, who also have diagnosis of concurrent meningioma
completion: WITH DX AS (SELECT DISTINCT TM_MRN, TM_DX_DTE, TM_HIST_CD, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS HIST_DESC, TM_SITE_CD, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_DESC FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND TM_SITE_CD LIKE 'C64%' AND TM_DX_DTE BETWEEN '2005-01-01' AND '2018-09-23' ) SELECT DISTINCT RRPT_MRN "MRN", PT_LAST_NAME "Last Name", PT_FIRST_NAME "First Name", PT_BIRTH_DTE "Date of Birth", PT_DEATH_DTE "Date of Death", PLA_LAST_APPT_DTE "Last Appt Date", TM_DX_DTE "Tumor Dx Date", TM_HIST_CD "Histology Code", HIST_DESC "Histology Description", TM_SITE_CD "Site Code", SITE_DESC "Site Description" FROM DV.RADIOLOGY_REPORT_V JOIN DX ON RRPT_MRN = TM_MRN JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON RRPT_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN DV.PATIENT_LATEST_ACTIVITY ON PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PLA_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID WHERE RRPT_ORDER_GROUP IN ('MR', 'CT') AND RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE BETWEEN '2005-01-01' AND '2018-09-23' AND CONTAINS("RRPT_REPORT_TXT", '("meningioma")') = 1 ORDER BY RRPT_MRN, TM_DX_DTE ; WITH DX AS (SELECT DISTINCT TM_MRN, TM_DX_DTE, TM_HIST_CD, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS HIST_DESC, TM_SITE_CD, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_DESC FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND TM_SITE_CD LIKE 'C64%' AND TM_DX_DTE BETWEEN '2005-01-01' AND '2018-09-23' ) SELECT RRPT_MRN "MRN", PT_LAST_NAME "Last Name", PT_FIRST_NAME "First Name", PT_BIRTH_DTE "Date of Birth", PT_DEATH_DTE "Date of Death", PLA_LAST_APPT_DTE "Last Appt Date", TM_DX_DTE "Tumor Dx Date", TM_HIST_CD "Histology Code", HIST_DESC "Histology Description", TM_SITE_CD "Site Code", SITE_DESC "Site Description", RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE "Radiology Performed Date", RRPT_ORDER_GROUP "Order Group", RRPT_PROCEDURE_NAME "Procedure Name", RRPT_REPORT_TXT "Report Text" FROM DV.RADIOLOGY_REPORT_V JOIN DX ON RRPT_MRN = TM_MRN JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON RRPT_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN DV.PATIENT_LATEST_ACTIVITY ON PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PLA_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID WHERE RRPT_ORDER_GROUP IN ('MR', 'CT') AND RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE BETWEEN '2005-01-01' AND '2018-09-23' AND CONTAINS("RRPT_REPORT_TXT", '("meningioma")') = 1 ORDER BY RRPT_MRN, TM_DX_DTE, RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE

prompt: Provide all CLin docs entered for a specific document "Busulfan Pharmacokinetic Note" since May 2011.
completion: SELECT A.*, RTRIM(CDO_VALUE_TEXT) AS COMMENTS FROM (SELECT CDD_MRN MRN, STRIP(PT_LAST_NAME)||', '||PT_FIRST_NAME NAME , YEAR(CDD_AUTHORED_DTE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) AGE_AT_TX , PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH DOB, PT_SEX GENDER, CDD_DOC_GUID , CDD_AUTHORED_DTE AUTHORED_DTE, CDD_DOC_NAME CLINDOC_NAME , OU_DISPLAY_NAME RPH_NAME, OU_ORD_ROLE_TYPE ROLE_TYPE , CAST(RTRIM(MAX(CASE WHEN CDO_ITEM_NAME = 'Primary Diagnosis' THEN SUBSTR(STRIP(CDO_VALUE_TEXT), 1, 255) END))AS VARCHAR(255)) AS PRIM_DX , CAST(RTRIM(MAX(CASE WHEN CDO_ITEM_NAME = 'Reason for BMT:' THEN SUBSTR(STRIP(CDO_VALUE_TEXT), 1, 255) END))AS VARCHAR(255)) AS BMT_REASON , CAST(RTRIM(MAX(CASE WHEN CDO_ITEM_NAME = 'On Protocol: IRB#:' THEN SUBSTR(STRIP(CDO_VALUE_TEXT), 1, 255) END))AS VARCHAR(255)) AS IRB_NO , CAST(RTRIM(MAX(CASE WHEN CDO_ITEM_NAME = 'Total number of Busulfan Doses planned:' THEN SUBSTR(STRIP(CDO_VALUE_TEXT), 1, 255) END))AS VARCHAR(255)) AS TTL_DOSES_PLANNED , CAST(RTRIM(MAX(CASE WHEN CDO_ITEM_NAME = 'Preparative Regimen:' THEN SUBSTR(STRIP(CDO_VALUE_TEXT), 1, 255) END))AS VARCHAR(255)) AS REGIMEN , CAST(RTRIM(MAX(CASE WHEN CDO_ITEM_NAME = 'Start Date of Busulfan' THEN SUBSTR(STRIP(CDO_VALUE_TEXT), 1, 255) END))AS VARCHAR(255)) AS START_DATE , CAST(RTRIM(MAX(CASE WHEN CDO_ITEM_NAME = 'Initial Dose of Busulfan kg' THEN SUBSTR(STRIP(CDO_VALUE_TEXT), 1, 255) END))AS VARCHAR(255)) AS INIT_DOSE_KG , CAST(RTRIM(MAX(CASE WHEN CDO_ITEM_NAME = 'Target AUC:' THEN SUBSTR(STRIP(CDO_VALUE_TEXT), 1, 255) END))AS VARCHAR(255)) AS TARGET_AUC , CAST(RTRIM(MAX(CASE WHEN CDO_ITEM_NAME = 'Inital Dose of Busulfan mg' THEN SUBSTR(STRIP(CDO_VALUE_TEXT), 1, 255) END))AS VARCHAR(255)) AS INIT_DOSE_MG , CAST(RTRIM(MAX(CASE WHEN CDO_ITEM_NAME = 'Actual Dose given X Target AUC' THEN SUBSTR(STRIP(CDO_VALUE_TEXT), 1, 255) END))AS VARCHAR(255)) AS ACTUAL_DOSE , CAST(RTRIM(MAX(CASE WHEN CDO_ITEM_NAME = 'AUC Measured' THEN SUBSTR(STRIP(CDO_VALUE_TEXT), 1, 255) END))AS VARCHAR(255)) AS AUC_MEASURED , CAST(RTRIM(MAX(CASE WHEN CDO_ITEM_NAME = '# of doses patient recieved' THEN SUBSTR(STRIP(CDO_VALUE_TEXT), 1, 255) END))AS VARCHAR(255)) AS TTL_ACTUAL_DOSES , CAST(RTRIM(MAX(CASE WHEN CDO_ITEM_NAME = 'Calculation Recommendation fit/does not fit model' THEN SUBSTR(STRIP(CDO_VALUE_TEXT), 1, 255) END))AS VARCHAR(255)) AS CALC_RECOMMENDATION , CAST(RTRIM(MAX(CASE WHEN CDO_ITEM_NAME = 'AUC' THEN SUBSTR(STRIP(CDO_VALUE_TEXT), 1, 255) END))AS VARCHAR(255)) AS AUC , CAST(RTRIM(MAX(CASE WHEN CDO_ITEM_NAME = 'Adjusted Dose ' THEN SUBSTR(STRIP(CDO_VALUE_TEXT), 1, 255) END))AS VARCHAR(255)) AS ADJUSTED_DOSE , CAST(RTRIM(MAX(CASE WHEN CDO_ITEM_NAME = 'New Busulfan dose' THEN SUBSTR(STRIP(CDO_VALUE_TEXT), 1, 255) END))AS VARCHAR(255)) AS NEW_DOSE , CAST(RTRIM(MAX(CASE WHEN CDO_ITEM_NAME = '# of doses pt to receive' THEN SUBSTR(STRIP(CDO_VALUE_TEXT), 1, 255) END))AS VARCHAR(255)) AS DOSES_LEFT , CAST(RTRIM(MAX(CASE WHEN CDO_ITEM_NAME = 'Name of Dr' THEN SUBSTR(STRIP(CDO_VALUE_TEXT), 1, 255) END))AS VARCHAR(255)) AS DR_NAME , CAST(RTRIM(MAX(CASE WHEN CDO_ITEM_NAME = 'Pharmacist Pager Number' THEN SUBSTR(STRIP(CDO_VALUE_TEXT), 1, 255) END))AS VARCHAR(255)) AS RPH_PAGER , CAST(RTRIM(MAX(CASE WHEN CDO_ITEM_NAME = 'Calculation of Busulfan dose double checked' THEN SUBSTR(STRIP(CDO_VALUE_TEXT), 1, 255) END))AS VARCHAR(255)) AS VERIFIED_BY FROM IDB.CD_DOCUMENT JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION ON CDD_DOC_GUID = CDO_DOC_GUID LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_USER ON CDD_AUTH_PROV_GUID = OU_USER_GUID JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PT_MRN = CDD_MRN WHERE CDD_AUTHORED_DTE BETWEEN LAST_DAY(CURRENT DATE - 7 MONTH) + 1 DAY AND LAST_DAY(CURRENT DATE - 1 MONTH) AND CDD_DOC_NAME = 'Consultation Note, Busulfan - Pharmacy' AND CDD_ACCT_NO LIKE '84%' AND CDO_SECTION <> 'Blood Drawn/Concentrations' GROUP BY CDD_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, CDD_AUTHORED_DTE , PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, PT_SEX, CDD_DOC_NAME , OU_DISPLAY_NAME, OU_ORD_ROLE_TYPE, CDD_DOC_GUID) A JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION ON CDD_DOC_GUID = CDO_DOC_GUID AND CDO_SECTION = 'Pharmacist Calculation/Recommendation' AND CDO_ITEM_NAME = 'Comments'

prompt: Provide the total missed appointments for patients 15 - 39 years old seen in 2019
completion: WITH PTS AS (SELECT CPE_MRN AS "MRN", CPE_ENC_CSN_ID, PT_LAST_NAME "Last Name", PT_FIRST_NAME "First Name", PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH "DOB", PT_STATE "State", CPE_ENC_DTE AS "Appt Date", YEAR(CPE_ENC_DTE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) "Age at Appt", CPE_CPE_APPT_STS, CASE WHEN CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_1 IN ('REG', 'Reg') THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS "Regional", CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 AS "Department", CAV_NAME AS "Service", CLD_CLD_CENTER "Location", CLD_DEPT_NAME AS "Department Name", CRE_RES_TYP "Provider Type", CRE_RES_NAME AS "Provider Name", CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR AS "Visit Type Abbr", CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME AS "Visit Type", ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CPE_MRN ORDER BY CPE_ENC_DTE) RN FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON CPE_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_CATEGORY ON CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 = CAV_ABBR AND CAV_CATEGORY = 'CLD_RPT_GRP_8' WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp', 'No Show') AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN '2019-01-01' AND '2019-12-31' AND YEAR(CPE_ENC_DTE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) BETWEEN 15 AND 39 ) , NO_SHOW AS (SELECT MRN, COUNT(DISTINCT CPE_ENC_CSN_ID) "Number of No Show appts" FROM PTS WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('No Show') GROUP BY MRN ) SELECT P.MRN, "Last Name", "First Name", "DOB", "Department", "Service", "Number of No Show appts" FROM PTS P JOIN NO_SHOW NS ON P."MRN" = NS.MRN WHERE RN = 1;

prompt: Patients with an APP visit at BSK between Aug - Nov 2018 that had a survivorship referral order to BSK
completion: WITH APPTS AS (SELECT CPE_MRN, CPE_ENC_CSN_ID, CPE_ENC_DTE, CLD_DEPT_NAME, CRE_RES_NAME, CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR, CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME, CLD_CLD_CENTER, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_1 FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME like '%APP%' AND CLD_CLD_CENTER = 'BSK' AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN '2018-08-01' AND CURRENT date - 1 DAY ) , ORD AS (SELECT PT_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, OO_ENTER_DTE, OO_ORD_NAME, DOC_NAME, DOC_SVC, OSTS_ORD_STS_CD, OSTS_STS_DESC FROM IDB.OMS_ORDER JOIN IDB.OMS_STATUS ON OO_ORD_STS_CD = OSTS_ORD_STS_CD JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON OO_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.DOC ON OO_REQ_DR_NO = DOC_DR_NO WHERE OO_ORD_NAME = 'Survivorship NP/PA Referral' AND DOC_SVC = 'BSK' AND OO_ORD_STS_CD NOT IN ('CANP', 'CANC', 'AUC3') ) SELECT PT_MRN MRN, PT_LAST_NAME "Last Name", PT_FIRST_NAME "First Name", CPE_ENC_DTE "Appt Date", CLD_DEPT_NAME "Dept Name", CRE_RES_NAME "Resource Name", CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR "Visit Type Abbr", CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME "Visit Type Name", CLD_CLD_CENTER "Center", OO_ENTER_DTE "Order Enter Date", OO_ORD_NAME "Order Name", DOC_NAME "Ordering Physician", DOC_SVC "Ordering Service", OSTS_STS_DESC "Order Status" FROM APPTS JOIN ORD ON CPE_MRN = PT_MRN

prompt: Provide a one time list of pediatric patients diagnosed with pancreatoblastoma who have been cared for at Memorial Sloan Kettering Cancer Center.
completion: WITH INIT AS (SELECT DISTINCT CC_MRN INIT_MRN FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE SUBSTR(CC_CLSF_CD, 1, 3) IN ('C25') AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND (CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) AND CC_EFF_DTE BETWEEN '1967-01-01' AND CURRENT DATE UNION ALL SELECT PRPT_MRN FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V WHERE PRPT_REPORT IS NOT NULL AND PRPT_REPORT_DTE BETWEEN '1967-01-01' AND CURRENT DATE AND CONTAINS("PRPT_REPORT", '("pancreatoblastoma")') = 1 ), TUMOR AS (SELECT DISTINCT CC_MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) MIN_ICD9_EFF_DTE, CC_CLSF_CD AS ICD9_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS ICD9_DESC FROM INIT LEFT JOIN IDB.CTC_CLSF ON INIT_MRN = CC_MRN JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE SUBSTR(CC_CLSF_CD, 1, 3) IN ('C25') AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND (CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) AND CC_EFF_DTE BETWEEN '1967-01-01' AND CURRENT DATE GROUP BY CC_MRN, CC_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK) , ALLPATH AS (SELECT PRPT_MRN, PRPT_PROCEDURE_DTE, PRPT_REPORT_DTE, PRPT_REPORT_TYPE_DESC, PRPT_ACCESSION_NO, CAST(PRPT_REPORT AS VARCHAR(32000)) PRPT_REPORT_TEXT, PRPT_ORD_DR_NAME, PRPT_ORD_DR_SVC_DESC FROM INIT LEFT JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V ON INIT_MRN = PRPT_MRN WHERE PRPT_REPORT IS NOT NULL AND CONTAINS("PRPT_REPORT", '("pancreatoblastoma")') = 1 ) , SURG AS (SELECT SSE_MRN, SSE_SURG_DTE||'= ' ||SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD AS SURG_DATA FROM INIT JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT ON INIT_MRN = SSE_MRN JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE ON SSE_LOG_ID = SSP_LOG_ID AND SSE_ENC_CSN_ID = SSP_ENC_CSN_ID WHERE (SSE_SURG_LOC not like '%IR%' AND SSE_SURG_LOC not like '%ENDO%' AND SSE_SOURCE_TYPE <> 'E') AND SSE_SURG_DTE BETWEEN '1967-01-01' AND CURRENT DATE ), LISTS AS (SELECT DISTINCT SSE_MRN AS SURG_MRN, LISTAGG(SURG_DATA, CHR(10)) WITHIN GROUP ( ORDER BY SURG_DATA) AS SURG_DATAS FROM (SELECT DISTINCT SSE_MRN, SURG_DATA FROM SURG) GROUP BY SSE_MRN) SELECT DISTINCT INIT_MRN, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, PT_SEX, R.AV_DESC AS "Race", MIN_ICD9_EFF_DTE, ICD9_CD, ICD9_DESC, SURG_DATAS AS SURG_DATE_AND_CPT, COALESCE(MAX(PLA_LST_APPT_DTE, PLA_LST_DSCH_DTE), PLA_LST_APPT_DTE, PLA_LST_DSCH_DTE) AS LAST_FU_DATE, PRPT_REPORT_TEXT, PRPT_PROCEDURE_DTE, PRPT_REPORT_DTE, PRPT_REPORT_TYPE_DESC FROM INIT LEFT JOIN TUMOR ON INIT_MRN = CC_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON INIT_MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS R ON PT_RACE = R.AV_CODE AND R.AV_ELEMENT = 'RACE' LEFT JOIN LISTS ON INIT_MRN = SURG_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY ON INIT_MRN = PLA_MRN LEFT JOIN ALLPATH ON INIT_MRN = PRPT_MRN ; WITH TUMOR AS (SELECT DISTINCT CC_MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) MIN_ICD9_EFF_DTE, CC_CLSF_CD AS ICD9_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS ICD9_DESC FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE SUBSTR(CC_CLSF_CD, 1, 3) IN ('C25') AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND (CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) AND CC_EFF_DTE BETWEEN '1967-01-01' AND CURRENT DATE GROUP BY CC_MRN, CC_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK), PATH AS (SELECT TUMOR.*, PRPT_MRN, CAST(PRPT_REPORT AS VARCHAR(32000)) PATH_TEXT, PRPT_PROCEDURE_DTE, PRPT_REPORT_DTE, PRPT_REPORT_TYPE_DESC FROM TUMOR LEFT JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V ON CC_MRN = PRPT_MRN WHERE PRPT_REPORT IS NOT NULL AND CONTAINS("PRPT_REPORT", '("pancreatoblastoma")') = 1 ) , SURG AS (SELECT SSE_MRN, SSE_SURG_DTE||'= ' ||SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD AS SURG_DATA FROM PATH JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT ON CC_MRN = SSE_MRN JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE ON SSE_LOG_ID = SSP_LOG_ID AND SSE_ENC_CSN_ID = SSP_ENC_CSN_ID WHERE (SSE_SURG_LOC not like '%IR%' AND SSE_SURG_LOC not like '%ENDO%' AND SSE_SOURCE_TYPE <> 'E') ), LISTS AS (SELECT DISTINCT SSE_MRN AS SURG_MRN, LISTAGG(SURG_DATA, CHR(10)) WITHIN GROUP ( ORDER BY SURG_DATA) AS SURG_DATAS FROM (SELECT DISTINCT SSE_MRN, SURG_DATA FROM SURG) GROUP BY SSE_MRN) SELECT DISTINCT CC_MRN, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, PT_SEX, R.AV_DESC AS "Race", MIN_ICD9_EFF_DTE, ICD9_CD, ICD9_DESC, SURG_DATAS AS SURG_DATE_AND_CPT, COALESCE(MAX(PLA_LST_APPT_DTE, PLA_LST_DSCH_DTE), PLA_LST_APPT_DTE, PLA_LST_DSCH_DTE) AS LAST_FU_DATE, PATH_TEXT, PRPT_PROCEDURE_DTE, PRPT_REPORT_DTE, PRPT_REPORT_TYPE_DESC FROM PATH LEFT JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON CC_MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS R ON PT_RACE = R.AV_CODE AND R.AV_ELEMENT = 'RACE' LEFT JOIN LISTS ON CC_MRN = SURG_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY ON CC_MRN = PLA_MRN ; SELECT DISTINCT PRPT_MRN, CAST(PRPT_REPORT AS VARCHAR(32000)) PATH_TEXT, PRPT_PROCEDURE_DTE, PRPT_REPORT_DTE, PRPT_REPORT_TYPE_DESC FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V WHERE PRPT_REPORT IS NOT NULL AND PRPT_REPORT_DTE BETWEEN '1967-01-01' AND CURRENT DATE AND CONTAINS("PRPT_REPORT", '("pancreatoblastoma")') = 1

prompt: Provide list of patients and variables with axillary lymph node dissection from 2005 to present.
completion: WITH X AS (SELECT DISTINCT PBD_MRN AS MRN, CLM_CLSF_CD AS CPT_CODE, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS CPT_DESC, PBC_PBD_DESC AS PBD_DESC, PBD_SVC_DTE AS ALND_DATE, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, YEAR(PBD_SVC_DTE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) AS AGE FROM IDB.PBD_DTL JOIN IDB.PBD_CODE ON PBD_PBD_CD = PBC_PBD_CD JOIN IDB.CLM ON PBC_CPT_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PT_MRN = PBD_MRN WHERE PBD_SVC_DTE BETWEEN '2005-01-01' AND '2017-12-31' AND PBC_CPT_CD IN ('38745', '38500', '38525') ) , CDB AS (SELECT DISTINCT TM_MRN, TM_DX_DTE AS DX_DATE, TM_HIST_CD AS HIST_CODE, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS HIST_DESC, TM_SITE_CD AS SITE_CODE, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_DESC, TM_BEST_AJCC_STG, CASE WHEN TM_AJCC_7 NOT IN ('', '888', '999') THEN AJCC7.AV_DESC WHEN TM_AJCC NOT IN ('', '88', '99') THEN AJCC.AV_DESC WHEN TM_GENERAL_STG NOT IN ('', '9') THEN GS.AV_DESC WHEN TM_PATH_STG_GRP NOT IN ('', '88', '9', '99') THEN TM_PATH_STG_GRP ELSE CLIN.AV_DESC END AS STAGE, TM_TUMOR_SIZE FROM X JOIN IDB.CDB_TUMOR ON TM_MRN = MRN JOIN IDB.CLM H ON TM_HIST_CD = H.CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON TM_SITE_CD = S.CLM_CLSF_CD LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS AJCC7 ON AJCC7.AV_ELEMENT = 'AJCC_7' AND AJCC7.AV_CODE = TM_AJCC_7 LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS AJCC ON AJCC.AV_ELEMENT = 'AJCC' AND AJCC.AV_CODE = TM_AJCC LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS GS ON GS.AV_ELEMENT = 'GENERAL_STG' AND GS.AV_CODE = TM_GENERAL_STG LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS CLIN ON CLIN.AV_ELEMENT = 'CLIN_STG_DSCR' AND CLIN.AV_CODE = TM_CLIN_STG_DSCR WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') ) , CHEMO AS (SELECT APR_MRN, APR_GENERIC_NAME, MIN(APR_START_DTE) AS START_DATE, MAX(APR_END_DTE) AS END_DATE FROM X JOIN IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX_V ON APR_MRN = MRN WHERE CDG_CHEMO_FLAG = 'Y' GROUP BY APR_MRN, APR_GENERIC_NAME ) , RT AS (SELECT DISTINCT RTC_TX_MRN, RTC_TX_PLAN_NAME, RTC_PRIMARY_REF_POINT, RTC_TX_START_DTE, RTC_TX_STOP_DTE, RTC_TX_ELAPSED_DAYS, RTC_TX_PLANNED_FRACTIONS, RTC_TX_DELIVERED_FRACTIONS, RTC_TX_PLANNED_DOSE, RTC_TX_DELIVERED_DOSE, RTC_DOSE_CORRECTION FROM X JOIN IDB.RADONC_TREATMENT_COURSE ON RTC_TX_MRN = MRN) , B1 AS (SELECT MRN, ALND_DATE, PMH_MEASURE_DTE, PMH_WT_KG, PMH_HT_CM, PMH_BMI, ABS(DAYS(PMH_MEASURE_DTE) - DAYS(ALND_DATE)) AS ABS_DAYS_DIFF FROM X JOIN IDB.PT_MEASURES_HX ON MRN = PMH_MRN) , B2 AS (SELECT MRN, ALND_DATE, MIN(ABS_DAYS_DIFF) AS ABS_DAYS_DIFF_MIN FROM B1 GROUP BY MRN, ALND_DATE) , B3 AS (SELECT DISTINCT B1.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY B1.MRN, B1.ALND_DATE ORDER BY PMH_MEASURE_DTE) AS RN FROM B1 JOIN B2 ON B1.MRN = B2.MRN AND B1.ALND_DATE = B2.ALND_DATE AND B1.ABS_DAYS_DIFF = B2.ABS_DAYS_DIFF_MIN) , MAST AS (SELECT DISTINCT SSE_MRN, ALND_DATE, SSE_SURG_DTE AS MAST_DATE, SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD AS MAST_CPT_CODE, SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC AS MAST_DESC FROM X JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT ON MRN = SSE_MRN AND SSE_SURG_DTE >= ALND_DATE JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE ON SSE_LOG_ID = SSP_LOG_ID WHERE 1=1 AND SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD IN ('19301', '19302', '19303', '19304', '19305', '19306', '19307', '19309') ) , LYMPHEDEMA AS (SELECT CC_MRN, ALND_DATE, CLM_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK, CC_EFF_DTE FROM X JOIN IDB.CTC_CLSF ON MRN = CC_MRN AND CC_EFF_DTE >= ALND_DATE JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND ((CC_PT_TYPE = 'I') OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) AND CC_CLSF_CD IN ('457.0', 'I97.2', '457.1', 'I89.0') ) , C1 AS (SELECT CC_MRN AS MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS DX_DATE, CLM_CLSF_CD AS DX_CODE, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS DX_DESC FROM X JOIN IDB.CTC_CLSF ON MRN = CC_MRN JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND ((CC_PT_TYPE = 'I') OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) AND CLM_CLSF_CD IN (SELECT DISTINCT CLM_CLSF_CD FROM IDB.CLM WHERE CLM_CLSF_CD like '250.%' OR CLM_CLSF_CD like 'E10.%' OR CLM_CLSF_CD like 'E11.%' OR CLM_CLSF_CD like 'E13.%' OR CLM_CLSF_CD like '401%' OR CLM_CLSF_CD BETWEEN 'I10' AND 'I16.99' OR CLM_CLSF_CD like '272.2%' OR CLM_CLSF_CD like '272.4%' OR CLM_CLSF_CD like 'E78.2%' OR CLM_CLSF_CD like 'E78.4%' OR CLM_CLSF_CD like 'E78.49%' OR CLM_CLSF_CD like 'E78.5%' ) GROUP BY CC_MRN, CLM_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK ) , C2 AS (SELECT MRN, MAX(CASE WHEN DX_CODE like '250.%' OR DX_CODE like 'E10.%' OR DX_CODE like 'E11.%' OR DX_CODE like 'E13.%' THEN 'Y' END) AS "DM", MAX(CASE WHEN DX_CODE like '401%' OR DX_CODE BETWEEN 'I10' AND 'I16.99' THEN 'Y' END) AS "HTN", MAX(CASE WHEN DX_CODE like '272.2%' OR DX_CODE like '272.4%' OR DX_CODE like 'E78.2%' OR DX_CODE like 'E78.4%' OR DX_CODE like 'E78.49%' OR DX_CODE like 'E78.5%' THEN 'Y' END) AS "HLD" FROM C1 GROUP BY MRN) SELECT DISTINCT X.*, PMH_WT_KG, PMH_HT_CM, PMH_BMI, PMH_MEASURE_DTE, ABS_DAYS_DIFF, CASE WHEN MAST.SSE_MRN IS NOT NULL THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS "Mastectomy", CASE WHEN CC_MRN IS NOT NULL THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS "Lymphedema", "DM", "HTN", "HLD" FROM X LEFT JOIN B3 ON X.MRN = B3.MRN AND X.ALND_DATE = B3.ALND_DATE AND RN = 1 LEFT JOIN MAST ON X.MRN = MAST.SSE_MRN AND X.ALND_DATE = MAST.ALND_DATE LEFT JOIN LYMPHEDEMA ON X.MRN = LYMPHEDEMA.CC_MRN AND X.ALND_DATE = LYMPHEDEMA.ALND_DATE LEFT JOIN C2 ON X.MRN = C2.MRN

prompt: Number of visits seen within designated CTC clinic time and number of visits seen outside of clinic time.
completion: SELECT YEAR(CPE_ENC_DTE) "Year", CASE WHEN DAYOFWEEK(CPE_ENC_DTE) = 2 AND TIME(CPE_APPT_DT) BETWEEN TIME('13:00:00') AND TIME('18:00:00') THEN 'During CTC Clinic time' WHEN DAYOFWEEK(CPE_ENC_DTE) = 3 AND TIME(CPE_APPT_DT) BETWEEN TIME('07:30:00') AND TIME('18:00:00') THEN 'During CTC Clinic time' WHEN DAYOFWEEK(CPE_ENC_DTE) = 4 AND TIME(CPE_APPT_DT) BETWEEN TIME('07:30:00') AND TIME('12:30:00') THEN 'During CTC Clinic time' ELSE 'Outside CTC Clinic Time' END "CTC Clinic Time", CRE_RES_NAME "Provider", COUNT(*) "Appointments" FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CLD_DEPT_NAME IN ('CTC KOCH-14', 'CTC KOCH-14 APP') AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN '2020-01-01' AND CURRENT DATE GROUP BY YEAR(CPE_ENC_DTE), CASE WHEN DAYOFWEEK(CPE_ENC_DTE) = 2 AND TIME(CPE_APPT_DT) BETWEEN TIME('13:00:00') AND TIME('18:00:00') THEN 'During CTC Clinic time' WHEN DAYOFWEEK(CPE_ENC_DTE) = 3 AND TIME(CPE_APPT_DT) BETWEEN TIME('07:30:00') AND TIME('18:00:00') THEN 'During CTC Clinic time' WHEN DAYOFWEEK(CPE_ENC_DTE) = 4 AND TIME(CPE_APPT_DT) BETWEEN TIME('07:30:00') AND TIME('12:30:00') THEN 'During CTC Clinic time' ELSE 'Outside CTC Clinic Time' END, CRE_RES_NAME ORDER BY 1, 2, 3

prompt: All MRIs ordered for post-operative Neurosurgery patients in 2018
completion: WITH SRG AS (SELECT DISTINCT SSE_MRN, SSE_LOG_ID, SSE_ENC_CSN_ID, SSE_SURG_DTE , SSE_SURG_STRT_DT, SSE_SURG_END_DT, SSE_PT_OUT_DT OR_END_DT, SSE_PT_IN_DT OR_STRT_DT, SSE_SURG_LOC , SSP_SURG_LAST_NM, SSP_SURG_FIRST_NM, SSP_SURG_SVC_CD FROM IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE ON SSE_LOG_ID = SSP_LOG_ID WHERE SSE_SURG_DTE BETWEEN '2018-01-01' AND '2018-12-31' AND SSP_SURG_SVC_CD = 'NEURO' ) , INP_ADM AS (SELECT ADM.UC_MRN, ADM.UC_VISIT_ID VISIT_ID, ADM.UC_ADM_NUM ADM_NUM, TIMESTAMP(ADM.UC_TRANSFER_DTE, ADM.UC_TRANSFER_TME) ADM_DT, TIMESTAMP(DSCH.UC_TRANSFER_DTE, DSCH.UC_TRANSFER_TME) DSCH_DT, DSCH.UC_SEQ_NO, SSE_SURG_STRT_DT, SSE_SURG_END_DT, OR_STRT_DT, OR_END_DT FROM SRG JOIN IDB.UNIFIED_CENSUS ADM ON SSE_MRN = ADM.UC_MRN AND ADM.UC_CNG_TYPE = 'A' JOIN IDB.UNIFIED_CENSUS DSCH ON SSE_MRN = DSCH.UC_MRN AND DSCH.UC_CNG_TYPE <> 'A' AND DSCH.UC_VISIT_ID = ADM.UC_VISIT_ID WHERE SSE_SURG_DTE BETWEEN ADM.UC_TRANSFER_DTE AND DSCH.UC_TRANSFER_DTE AND DSCH.UC_SEQ_NO = (SELECT MAX(X.UC_SEQ_NO) FROM IDB.UNIFIED_CENSUS X WHERE ADM.UC_MRN = X.UC_MRN AND X.UC_CNG_TYPE <> 'A' AND ADM.UC_VISIT_ID = X.UC_VISIT_ID) ) , READM AS (SELECT T1.UC_MRN MRN, T1.ADM_DT FIRST_ADM, T2.ADM_DT READM_DT, DAYS(T2.ADM_DT) - DAYS(T1.ADM_DT) READM_DAYS FROM INP_ADM T1 JOIN INP_ADM T2 ON T1.UC_MRN = T2.UC_MRN AND T1.ADM_DT < T2.ADM_DT AND DAYS(T2.ADM_DT) - DAYS(T1.ADM_DT) <= 30) SELECT OO_MRN MRN, ADM_DT, DSCH_DT, (DAYS(DSCH_DT)*24*60 + HOUR(DSCH_DT)*60 + MINUTE(DSCH_DT))/60 - (DAYS(ADM_DT)*24*60 + HOUR(ADM_DT)*60 + MINUTE(ADM_DT))/60 LOS_HRS, OR_STRT_DT, SSE_SURG_STRT_DT SURG_STRT_DT, SSE_SURG_END_DT SURG_END_DT, OR_END_DT, STRIP(OO_ORD_NAME)||' - '||STRIP(OO_ORD_MODIFIER) MRI_NAME, RRPT_PERFORMED_DT MRI_PERFORMED_DT, (DAYS(RRPT_PERFORMED_DT)*24*60 + HOUR(RRPT_PERFORMED_DT)*60 + MINUTE(RRPT_PERFORMED_DT))/60 - (DAYS(OR_END_DT)*24*60 + HOUR(OR_END_DT)*60 + MINUTE(OR_END_DT))/60 HRS_BTW_OR_MRI, RRPT_ORDER_LOCATION MRI_ORD_LOCATION, READM_DT, READM_DAYS FROM INP_ADM LEFT JOIN READM ON MRN = UC_MRN AND FIRST_ADM = ADM_DT JOIN IDB.OMS_ORDER ON OO_MRN = UC_MRN AND OO_ENTER_DT BETWEEN ADM_DT AND DSCH_DT JOIN DV.RADIOLOGY_REPORT_V ON OO_ORD_GUID = RRPT_ORDER_GUID AND RRPT_PERFORMED_DT > OR_END_DT WHERE OO_ORD_STS_CD NOT LIKE 'CA%' AND OO_ORD_NAME = 'MR' ORDER BY DATE(ADM_DT), OO_MRN

prompt: Provide a daily emailed Excel report with Khorana score for patients scheduled with future chemo visits.
completion: SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN, CPE_ENC_DTE, IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE.* FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID AND CPE_CPE_IP_IND <> 'INPATIENT' AND CRE_RES_TYP = 'Chemotherapy Unit' JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID AND CVT_CVT_RPT_GRP_3 = '' JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 = 'CHM' AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT date -1 DAY AND CURRENT date + 14 DAYS WHERE CPE_MRN IN ('35581047', '35569634', '35569349', '35461734', '35204802', '35556654', '35576649', '35477123', '35222702', '38001078', '38052061', '38068631', '38047957', '35507572', '35480894', '00553528', '35454308', '00392264', '38067223', '38066887') ; SELECT * FROM IDB.OMS_ORDER WHERE OO_ORD_NAME like 'Chemo%' AND OO_MRN IN ('35581047', '35569634', '35569349', '35461734', '35204802', '35556654', '35576649', '35477123', '35222702', '38001078', '38052061', '38068631', '38047957', '35507572', '35480894', '00553528', '35454308', '00392264', '38067223', '38066887') AND OO_ENTER_DTE > CURRENT date - 30 DAY

prompt: Provide a daily report: Monmouth MRI, PET and CT W/WO Contrast Appointments of Patients with a Diabetes Diagnosis
completion: WITH PTS AS (SELECT DISTINCT CPE_ENC_DTE AS APPT_DATE, TIME(CPE_APPT_DT) AS APPT_TIME, CPE_MRN AS MRN, CL_LAST_NAME AS LAST_NAME, CL_FIRST_NAME AS FIRST_NAME, YEAR (CPE_ENC_DTE - CL_DATE_OF_BIRTH) AS AGE, CLD_DEPT_NAME AS DEPT, A.CRE_RES_NAME AS PROVIDER, CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME AS VT_NAME, CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID, CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR, B.CRE_RES_NAME AS REFERRING_MD FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID AND CLD_CLD_CENTER = 'MON' AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 IN ('RAD', 'NUC') JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE A ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = A.CRE_RES_ID AND NOT A.CRE_RES_NAME LIKE 'US%' JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID AND CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME LIKE '%CON%' JOIN IDB.CL_PATIENT ON CPE_PRK = CL_PRK LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE B ON CPE_REF_RES_ID = B.CRE_RES_ID WHERE 1={?CRAP} AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT date AND CURRENT date + 7 DAY AND CPE_CPE_APPT_STS = 'Sch' ) , DX AS (SELECT DX_MRN, DX_CODE, DX_DESC, MAX(SVC_DTE) AS LAST_DXDATE FROM (SELECT PBD_MRN AS DX_MRN, PBD_SVC_DTE AS SVC_DTE, CLM_CLSF_CD AS DX_CODE, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS DX_DESC FROM PTS JOIN IDB.PBD_DTL ON MRN = PBD_MRN AND PBD_SVC_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT DATE - 720 DAY AND CURRENT DATE JOIN IDB.PBD_DX ON PBD_MRN = DX_MRN AND PBD_ACCT_NO = DX_ACCT_NO AND PBD_INV_NO = DX_INV_NO JOIN IDB.CLM ON DX_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD AND CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK LIKE '%DIAB%' AND NOT CLM_CLSF_CD IN ('V12.21', 'V18.0', 'V77.1', 'Z13.1', 'Z83.3', 'Z86.31', 'Z86.32') UNION SELECT CC_MRN AS DX_MRN, CC_EFF_DTE AS SVC_DTE, CLM_CLSF_CD AS DX_CODE, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS DX_DESC FROM PTS JOIN IDB.CTC_CLSF ON MRN = CC_MRN AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND (CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) AND CC_EFF_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT DATE - 1825 DAY AND CURRENT DATE JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD AND CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK LIKE '%DIAB%' AND NOT CLM_CLSF_CD IN ('V12.21', 'V18.0', 'V77.1', 'Z13.1', 'Z83.3', 'Z86.31', 'Z86.32')) AS X GROUP BY DX_MRN, DX_CODE, DX_DESC) SELECT MRN, APPT_DATE, APPT_TIME, MRN, LAST_NAME, FIRST_NAME, AGE, DEPT, PROVIDER, VT_NAME , REFERRING_MD, DX_CODE, DX_DESC, LAST_DXDATE FROM PTS JOIN DX ON DX_MRN = MRN UNION SELECT MRN, APPT_DATE, APPT_TIME, MRN, LAST_NAME, FIRST_NAME, AGE, DEPT, PROVIDER, VT_NAME , REFERRING_MD, DX_CODE, DX_DESC, LAST_DXDATE FROM PTS LEFT JOIN DX ON DX_MRN = MRN WHERE AGE >= 70

prompt: Provide a list of breast medicine patients with ER+ breast cancer that had a screening order submitted for between 10/1/2021-12/31/21.
completion: WITH BRST_CANCER AS (SELECT CDD_MRN, CDD_DOC_NAME, TRIM(PT_LAST_NAME)||', ' || TRIM(PT_FIRST_NAME) AS PATIENT_NAME, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, 'ER+' AS "Breast Cancer Type" FROM IDB.CD_DOCUMENT JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION ON CDD_DOC_GUID = CDO_DOC_GUID AND CDD_AUTHORED_DTE = CDO_AUTHORED_DTE JOIN IDB.PATIENT P ON CDD_MRN = PT_MRN AND CDD_CANCEL_IND <> '1' AND CDD_DOC_NAME IN ('Follow Up Note - Breast Surgery', 'Follow Up, NP - Breast Surgery', 'Follow Up - Breast Surgery', 'Follow Up - Surgery-Breast', 'Follow Up, NP/PA - Breast Surgery', 'Follow Up - DOM-Breast Medicine' , 'Initial Consult/Initial Visit, AMB - DOM-Breast Medicine') AND CDO_ITEM_NAME = 'ER:' AND CDO_VALUE_TEXT = 'Positive') SELECT DISTINCT CDD_MRN AS MRN, PATIENT_NAME, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH AS DATE_OF_BIRTH, CDD_DOC_NAME, OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE AS "Date of Screening order" FROM BRST_CANCER JOIN IDB.OMS_ORDER ON OO_MRN = CDD_MRN AND OO_ORD_NAME LIKE 'Breast Medicine Research Screening%' AND OO_ORD_STS_CD NOT IN ('CANP', 'CANC', 'AUC3') AND OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE BETWEEN '2021-10-01' AND '2021-12-31'

prompt:
To provide a daily list of inpatients that had hypoglycemia (a glucose level of <70 mg/dL) in the previous 24 hours.



I currently receive reports for glucose levels >140 mg/dL & >400 mg/dL
