completion: SELECT LR_MRN , PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_SEX, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH , LR_PERFORMED_DT, LR_ACCESSION_NO, LR_ENTER_DT , LR_SUBTEST_NAME, LR_RESULT_VALUE , DEC(TRANSLATE(LTRIM(RTRIM(TRANSLATE(CHAR(CASE WHEN RTRIM(LTRIM(LR_RESULT_VALUE)) IN ('') THEN NULL WHEN RTRIM(LTRIM(TRANSLATE(RTRIM(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(LR_RESULT_VALUE, '%', ''), '+', ''), '-', ''), '>', ''), '<', '')), '*', ' 1234567890'))) IN ('', '.') THEN DEC(RTRIM(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE (REPLACE (LR_RESULT_VALUE, '%', ''),'+', ''), '-', ''), '>', ''), '<', '')), 20, 5) ELSE NULL END), ' ', '0'))), '0', ' ')|| '0', 12, 5) AS RES_VALUE , LR_ORD_ID, LR_ORD_GUID , LR_ORD_MSTR_ITEM_GUID , LR_ORD_PVDR_GUID, OCV_CURR_LOC , OCV_SVC_GUID, OS_SVC_GRP_CD, OS_SVC_DESC FROM IDB.LAB_RESULTS JOIN IDB.OMS_CLIENT_VISIT ON LR_CL_VISIT_GUID = OCV_VISIT_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_SERVICE ON OCV_SVC_GUID = OS_SVC_GUID JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON LR_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE UPPER(LR_SUBTEST_NAME) LIKE '%GLUCO%' AND UPPER(LR_SUBTEST_NAME) NOT LIKE '%URIN%' AND (LR_SUBTEST_NAME) <> 'Glucose, CSF' AND DATE(LR_ENTER_DT) >= CURRENT date - 1 DAY AND LR_PERFORMED_DTE >= CURRENT DATE - 10 DAY AND OCV_IP_OP_IND = 'I'

prompt: Update PFS24722 to include patients admitted in prior months or discharged in later months.
completion: WITH MTH AS (SELECT DISTINCT '2021-12-01' AS START_DATE, '2021-12-31' AS END_DATE FROM IDB.ALLOWVALS) SELECT DISTINCT STRIP(COVID.MRN) AS MRN, STRIP(PT_LAST_NAME) || ', ' || STRIP(PT_FIRST_NAME) AS NAME, STRIP(RESULT) AS RESULT, START_DATE, END_DATE, ADMIT_DATE, DISCHARGE_DATE, COALESCE(MIN(DISCHARGE_DATE, END_DATE), END_DATE) AS DISCHARGE_DATE_FOR_LOS, LOS AS LOS_OLD, CASE WHEN DAYS(COALESCE(MIN(DISCHARGE_DATE, END_DATE), END_DATE)) - DAYS(MAX(ADMIT_DATE, START_DATE)) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE DAYS(COALESCE(MIN(DISCHARGE_DATE, END_DATE), END_DATE)) - DAYS(MAX(ADMIT_DATE, START_DATE)) END AS LOS, FLOOR_ADMIT, FLOOR_DISCHARGE, COVID.IN_HOSP_NS FROM IDB.COVID19_PATIENT_INFO COVID, MTH JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON COVID.MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.INPATIENT_ADMISSIONS_V IP ON COVID.MRN = IP.MRN AND MIN_IDENTIFIED_DT <= DISCHARGE_DT_FOR_CALCS AND (RESULT = 'Positive' OR (RESULT = 'Resolved' AND MIN_RESOLVED_PROBLEM_DT > ADMIT_DT)) WHERE 1=1 AND(ADMIT_DATE BETWEEN START_DATE AND END_DATE OR DISCHARGE_DATE BETWEEN START_DATE AND END_DATE OR(ADMIT_DATE < START_DATE AND DISCHARGE_DATE > END_DATE) OR(ADMIT_DATE < START_DATE AND DISCHARGE_DATE IS NULL))

prompt: Patients with their first appointment with MR RECTUM visit type at KOCH
completion:
WITH APPTS AS (SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN AS MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH AS DOB, A.CLD_DEPT_NAME AS DEPT , B.CRE_RES_NAME AS PROVIDER , CPE_ENC_DTE AS APPT_DTE, CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME AS VT_NAME, D.CRE_RES_NAME AS REF_MD, CPE_ENC_CSN_ID AS CSN FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT A ON CPE_DEPT_ID = A.CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE B ON B.CRE_RES_ID = CPE_VST_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON CPE_MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT C ON C.CLD_DEPT_ID = CPE_REF_DEP_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE D ON D.CRE_RES_ID = CPE_REF_RES_ID WHERE 1=1 AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT DATE AND CURRENT DATE + 30 DAY AND CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME like 'MR RECTUM%' AND A.CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 = 'RAD' AND A.CLD_CLD_CENTER = 'KOCH' AND CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Sch') ) , MINDATE AS (SELECT CPE_MRN AS MIN_MRN, MIN(CPE_ENC_DTE) AS MIN_DTE FROM APPTS X JOIN IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER Z ON Z.CPE_MRN = X.MRN JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT A ON CPE_DEPT_ID = A.CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE B ON B.CRE_RES_ID = CPE_VST_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE 1=1 AND CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME like 'MR RECTUM%' AND A.CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 = 'RAD' AND A.CLD_CLD_CENTER = 'KOCH' AND CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Sch', 'Comp') GROUP BY CPE_MRN) , PTS AS (SELECT MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, DOB, DEPT, PROVIDER, APPT_DTE, VT_NAME, REF_MD FROM APPTS JOIN MINDATE ON MIN_MRN = MRN AND APPT_DTE = MIN_DTE) SELECT PTS.* , PRPT_ACCESSION_NO AS ACCESSION_NO, RPT.PRPT_CREATED_DT AS REPORT_CREATE_DT , DV.REGEXSTR ('(?i)(Diagnosis:|DIAGNOSTIC INTERPRETATION:)[^]*[
]*[\w\W]*?(?=
I ATTEST|
[ ]*?\*\*\*:|TEST AND METHOD)', PRPT_REPORT) DIAGNOSIS , PRPT_REPORT FROM PTS JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT RPT ON PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID LEFT JOIN DV.PATH_RPRT_TYPE_LOOKUP T2 ON RPT.PRPT_REPORT_TYPE = T2.PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_CD ORDER BY APPT_DTE, RPT.PRPT_CREATED_DT DESC

prompt: Provide a list of patients diagnosed with T1N0M0 breast cancer from 2000 onwards.
completion: WITH PTS AS (SELECT DISTINCT TM_MRN, C.AV_DESC AS CASE_STS, TM_DX_DTE, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS HIST_DESC, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_DESC, TM_PATH_TNM_T, TM_PATH_TNM_N, TM_PATH_TNM_M, G.AV_DESC AS HIST_GRADE, TM_TUMOR_SIZE, TM_CA_SURG_98, TM_CA_SURG_03, TM_CA_SURG_DTE, COALESCE(TM_SURG_DEF_DTE, TM_CA_SURG_DTE) TM_SURG_DEF_DTE, AVSITE_DESC, BP_ESTRG_RCR_DESC, BP_PRGSTR_RCP_DESC, BP_HER2_DESC FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS C ON C.AV_ELEMENT = 'CASE_STS' AND C.AV_CODE = TM_CASE_STS LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS G ON G.AV_ELEMENT = 'HIST_CD_GRADE' AND G.AV_CODE = TM_HIST_CD_GRADE LEFT JOIN IDB.CDB_ALLOWVALS_SITE ON AVSITE_ELEMENT = 'CA_SURG_SUM_03' AND AVSITE_CODE = TM_CA_SURG_03 AND AVSITE_LOW_SITE <= TM_SITE_CD AND AVSITE_HIGH_SITE >= TM_SITE_CD AND AVSITE_INACTIV_DTE = '9999-01-01' LEFT JOIN IDB.BR_PRIMARY ON TM_MRN = BP_MRN WHERE 1=1 AND TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND TM_SITE_CD LIKE 'C50%' AND TM_PATH_TNM_T like '%1%' AND TM_DX_DTE >= '2000-01-01' ) , ERHERPR AS (SELECT DISTINCT CDD_MRN, MAX(CASE WHEN CDO_ITEM_NAME = 'HER2:' THEN TRIM(CDO_VALUE_TEXT) END) AS HER2, MAX(CASE WHEN CDO_ITEM_NAME = 'ER:' THEN TRIM(CDO_VALUE_TEXT) END) AS ER, MAX(CASE WHEN CDO_ITEM_NAME = 'PR:' THEN TRIM(CDO_VALUE_TEXT) END) AS PR FROM IDB.CD_DOCUMENT JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION ON CDD_DOC_GUID = CDO_DOC_GUID AND CDD_AUTHORED_DTE = CDO_AUTHORED_DTE JOIN PTS ON TM_MRN = CDD_MRN WHERE 1=1 AND CDD_CANCEL_IND <> '1' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND <> '1' AND CDD_DOC_NAME like '%Breast%' AND CDO_ITEM_NAME IN ('HER2:', 'ER:', 'PR:') AND CDO_LARGE_VALUE_TEXT_IND <> 'Y' AND CDD_AUTHORED_DTE >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY CDD_MRN) , CHEMO AS (SELECT APR_MRN, LISTAGG(APR_START_DTE || ' | ' || APR_GENERIC_NAME, CHR(13) || CHR(10)) WITHIN GROUP( ORDER BY APR_START_DTE) AS CHEMO_TX FROM (SELECT DISTINCT APR_MRN, APR_START_DTE, APR_GENERIC_NAME FROM IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX JOIN ERHERPR ON APR_MRN = CDD_MRN JOIN PTS ON APR_MRN = TM_MRN WHERE APR_START_DTE BETWEEN TM_DX_DTE AND TM_DX_DTE + 1 YEAR) A GROUP BY APR_MRN) , RADONC AS (SELECT RTC_TX_MRN, LISTAGG(RTC_TX_START_DTE || ' | ' || RTC_TX_PLAN_NAME, CHR(13) || CHR(10)) WITHIN GROUP( ORDER BY RTC_TX_START_DTE) AS RADONC_TX FROM (SELECT DISTINCT RTC_TX_MRN, RTC_TX_START_DTE, RTC_TX_PLAN_NAME FROM IDB.RADONC_TREATMENT_COURSE JOIN ERHERPR ON RTC_TX_MRN = CDD_MRN JOIN PTS ON RTC_TX_MRN = TM_MRN WHERE RTC_TX_START_DTE BETWEEN TM_DX_DTE AND TM_DX_DTE + 1 YEAR) A GROUP BY RTC_TX_MRN) , REOCCUR AS (SELECT DISTINCT APR_MRN AS REOCCUR_MRN FROM IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX JOIN ERHERPR ON APR_MRN = CDD_MRN JOIN PTS ON APR_MRN = TM_MRN WHERE APR_START_DTE >= TM_DX_DTE + 1 YEAR UNION SELECT DISTINCT RTC_TX_MRN AS REOCCUR_MRN FROM IDB.RADONC_TREATMENT_COURSE JOIN ERHERPR ON RTC_TX_MRN = CDD_MRN JOIN PTS ON RTC_TX_MRN = TM_MRN WHERE RTC_TX_START_DTE >= TM_DX_DTE + 1 YEAR ) SELECT TM_MRN "MRN", PT_LAST_NAME "PT Last Name", PT_FIRST_NAME "PT First Name", PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH "DOB", TM_DX_DTE "DX Date", HIST_DESC "Histology", SITE_DESC "Site", TM_PATH_TNM_T "T Stage", TM_PATH_TNM_N "N Stage", TM_PATH_TNM_M "M Stage", TM_TUMOR_SIZE "Tumor Size", TM_SURG_DEF_DTE "Surgery Date", AVSITE_DESC "Surgery Description", COALESCE(BP_HER2_DESC, HER2) "HER2", COALESCE(BP_ESTRG_RCR_DESC, ER) "ER", COALESCE(BP_PRGSTR_RCP_DESC, PR) "PR", CHEMO_TX "Chemo Tx", RADONC_TX "Radonc Tx", CASE WHEN REOCCUR_MRN IS NOT NULL THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS "Reoccurrence", PLA_LST_APPT_DTE "Last Appt Date", LAD_PT_DEATH_DTE "PT Death Date", CASE WHEN LAD_PT_DEATH_DTE IS NOT NULL THEN LAD_PT_DEATH_DTE ELSE CASE WHEN MAX(COALESCE(LAD_LST_KNOWN_ALIVE_DTE, '1800-01-01'), COALESCE(PLA_LST_DSCH_DTE, '1800-01-01'), COALESCE(PLA_LST_TX_DTE, '1800-01-01'), COALESCE(PLA_LST_APPT_DTE, '1800-01-01'), COALESCE(CASE WHEN LAD_CP_LFU_DTE >= '2011-01-01' THEN LAD_CP_LFU_DTE END, '1800-01-01')) <> '1800-01-01' THEN MAX(COALESCE(LAD_LST_KNOWN_ALIVE_DTE, '1800-01-01'), COALESCE(PLA_LST_DSCH_DTE, '1800-01-01'), COALESCE(PLA_LST_TX_DTE, '1800-01-01'), COALESCE(PLA_LST_APPT_DTE, '1800-01-01'), COALESCE(CASE WHEN LAD_CP_LFU_DTE >= '2011-01-01' THEN LAD_CP_LFU_DTE END, '1800-01-01')) ELSE NULL END END AS "Last Known Alive Date" FROM PTS LEFT JOIN ERHERPR ON TM_MRN = CDD_MRN LEFT JOIN CHEMO ON TM_MRN = APR_MRN LEFT JOIN RADONC ON TM_MRN = RTC_TX_MRN LEFT JOIN REOCCUR ON TM_MRN = REOCCUR_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTV_DTL ON TM_MRN = LAD_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY ON PLA_MRN = LAD_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON TM_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE YEAR(TM_DX_DTE- PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) >= 65

prompt: Provide a Darwin report for pediatric specimens banked in HOTB.
completion: WITH PTS AS (SELECT PT_MRN PEDS_MRN, PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID DEID FROM DVCMS.COHORT_PATIENT JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V ON CHP_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID WHERE CHP_COHORT_ID = 6819 UNION SELECT PT_MRN PEDS_MRN, PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID DEID FROM DVCMS.COHORT_PATIENT JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V ON CHP_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID WHERE CHP_COHORT_ID = 230 ) SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN AS "MRN", PT_LAST_NAME "Last Name", PT_FIRST_NAME "First Name", DEID, DT_DTE AS "Collection Date", HS_OWNER "Owner", HSDC_SOURCE_DETAIL_CODE_DESC AS "Source Detail", HCTC_CELL_TYPE_CODE_DESC AS "Cell Type", HS_SPECIMENT_CELL_COUNT AS "Total Number of Cells (x10^6)", HS_VAIL_CELLS_COUNT "Vial Cell Count", DECIMAL(HS_SPECIMENT_CELL_COUNT/HS_VAIL_CELLS_COUNT, 17, 2) "Number of Vials", HSC_STATUS_CODE_DESC AS "Disease Status", HTC_TREATMENT_CODE_DESC AS "Treatment" FROM PTS JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON PEDS_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN DV.HOTB_SPECIMEN ON PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = HS_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID JOIN DV.DATE ON HS_COLLECTION_DATE_ID = DT_DATE_ID JOIN DV.HOTB_SOURCE_DETAIL_CODES ON HS_SOURCE_DETAIL_CODE_ID = HSDC_SOURCE_DETAIL_CODE_ID JOIN DV.HOTB_CELL_TYPE_CODES ON HS_CELL_TYPE_CODE_ID = HCTC_CELL_TYPE_CODE_ID JOIN DV.HOTB_STATUS_CODES ON HS_STATUS_CODE_ID = HSC_STATUS_CODE_ID JOIN DV.HOTB_TREATMENT_CODES ON HS_TREATMENT_CODE_ID = HTC_TREATMENT_CODE_ID

prompt: MRN's of all patients who have had outpatient PT, OT, or Lymphedema therapy from July 1, 2001 until Dec. 31, 2009.
completion: SELECT MRN, SVC_DTE, ACCT, AMT, SVC_CD, PROC_CD, DESC FROM (SELECT DISTINCT DTL_MRN AS MRN, DTL_ACCT_NO AS ACCT , DTL_SVC_DTE AS SVC_DTE, SUM (DTL_SVC_AMT) AS AMT, DTL_UNIT_CLOSE_DTE AS CLOSE_DTE, DTL_POST_DTE AS POST_DTE, DTL_SVC_CD AS SVC_CD, PROC_PROC_CD AS PROC_CD, PROC_3RD_PRTY_IND AS THIRD_PARTY, PROC_IDB_UPD_IND AS UPD_IND, PROC_TYPE_IND AS TYPE_IND, CDM_SVC_DESC AS DESC, DTL_IP_OP_IND FROM IDB.PA_DETAIL JOIN IDB.PROCEDURE ON PROC_SVC_CD = DTL_SVC_CD AND PROC_IDB_UPD_IND = 'A' AND PROC_3RD_PRTY_IND = 'H' AND PROC_TYPE_IND = 'P' JOIN IDB.CDM ON CDM_SVC_CD = DTL_SVC_CD WHERE DTL_SVC_DTE BETWEEN '2009-10-09' AND '2009-10-09' AND DTL_SVC_CD IN ('59000208', '59000216', '59000224', '59000232', '59000240' , '59000257', '58201104', '58201112', '58201120', '58201138', '58201146', '58201203' , '58090903', '58190901', '58200007', '58290909', '59100008') AND DTL_DTL_TYPE ='C' AND DTL_IP_OP_IND = 'O' GROUP BY DTL_MRN, DTL_ACCT_NO, DTL_SVC_DTE, DTL_UNIT_CLOSE_DTE, DTL_POST_DTE , DTL_SVC_CD, PROC_PROC_CD, PROC_3RD_PRTY_IND, PROC_IDB_UPD_IND , PROC_TYPE_IND, CDM_SVC_DESC, DTL_IP_OP_IND) AS X WHERE AMT > 0

prompt: Please provide data on mitogen sample results for every patient.
completion: SELECT DISTINCT LR_MRN AS MRN, LR_PERFORMED_DTE AS TEST_DATE, LR_TEST_NAME AS TEST_NAME, LR_SUBTEST_NAME AS SUBTEST_NAME, LR_RESULT_VALUE AS RESULT_VALUE, AC_IRB_NO AS IRB_NO FROM (SELECT DISTINCT LR_MRN, LR_PERFORMED_DTE, LR_TEST_NAME, LR_SUBTEST_NAME, LR_RESULT_VALUE, AC_IRB_NO FROM IDB.LAB_RESULTS LEFT JOIN IDB.LAB_TEXT_LINE ON LTL_RESULT_GUID = LR_RESULT_GUID JOIN IDB.ACCRUALS ON AC_MRN = LR_MRN AND AC_IRB_NO = '21-206' WHERE LR_TEST_NAME IN ('Mitogen (PHA) with physician interpretation', 'Mitogens', 'Mitogens Panel', 'Mitogen Proliferation', 'Mitogen Package.', 'Mitogen Proliferation Panel', 'Mitogen (PHA only)', 'Unstimulated Mitogen', 'Mitogen (PHA)') AND LR_RESULT_VALUE <> '' AND LR_PERFORMED_DTE >= '2021-06-15' ) ORDER BY LR_MRN;

prompt: Provide a list of patients with T-cell lymphoma and a diagnosis of acute myeloid leukemia or MDS
completion: WITH DX1 AS (SELECT TM_MRN AS MRN, TM_DX_DTE AS DX_DATE, TM_HIST_CD AS DX_CODE, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS DX_DESC FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM H ON TM_HIST_CD = H.CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON TM_SITE_CD = S.CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND TM_HIST_CD IN ('M9413/3', 'M9702/3', 'M9705/3', 'M9706/3', 'M9707/3') UNION SELECT CC_MRN AS MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS DX_DATE, CLM_CLSF_CD AS DX_CODE, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS DX_DESC FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND ((CC_PT_TYPE = 'I') OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) AND CC_CLSF_CD IN ('202.70', '202.71', '202.72', '202.73', '202.74', '202.75', '202.76', '202.77', '202.78', 'C84.40', 'C84.41', 'C84.42', 'C84.43', 'C84.44', 'C84.45', 'C84.46', 'C84.47', 'C84.48', 'C84.49', 'C84.90', 'C84.91', 'C84.92', 'C84.93', 'C84.94', 'C84.95', 'C84.96', 'C84.97', 'C84.98', 'C84.99', 'C84.Z0', 'C84.Z1', 'C84.Z2', 'C84.Z3', 'C84.Z4', 'C84.Z5', 'C84.Z6', 'C84.Z7', 'C84.Z8', 'C84.Z9', 'C86.5') GROUP BY CC_MRN, CLM_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK ) , DX2 AS (SELECT MRN, LISTAGG(COALESCE(STRIP(CAST(DX_DATE AS VARCHAR(12000))), '') || ' | ' || COALESCE(STRIP(CAST(DX_CODE AS VARCHAR(12000))), '') || ' | ' || COALESCE(STRIP(CAST(DX_DESC AS VARCHAR(12000))), '') , CHR(13) || CHR(10)) WITHIN GROUP( ORDER BY MRN, DX_DATE, DX_CODE, DX_DESC) AS DX_T_CELL FROM DX1 GROUP BY MRN) , AML_MDS AS (SELECT TM_MRN AS MRN, TM_DX_DTE AS DX_DATE, TM_HIST_CD AS DX_CODE, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS DX_DESC FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM H ON TM_HIST_CD = H.CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON TM_SITE_CD = S.CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND(TM_HIST_CD IN ('M9962/3', 'M9950/1', 'M9950/3', 'M9989/1', 'M9989/3', 'M9975/3', 'M9932/3', 'M9840/3', 'M9861/3', 'M9865/3', 'M9866/3', 'M9867/3', 'M9869/3', 'M9871/3', 'M9872/3', 'M9873/3', 'M9874/3', 'M9895/3', 'M9896/3', 'M9897/3', 'M9898/3', 'M9910/3', 'M9911/3', 'M9920/3', 'M9891/3') OR TM_HIST_CD like 'M99%') AND TM_MRN IN (SELECT DISTINCT MRN FROM DX2) UNION SELECT CC_MRN AS MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS DX_DATE, CLM_CLSF_CD AS DX_CODE, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS DX_DESC FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND ((CC_PT_TYPE = 'I') OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) AND(CC_CLSF_CD IN ('238.4', '238.71', '238.74', '238.75', '289.83', 'D46', 'D46.0', 'D46.1', 'D46.2', 'D46.20', 'D46.21', 'D46.22', 'D46.4', 'D46.9', 'D46.A', 'D46.B', 'D46.C', 'D46.Z', 'D75.81', '205', '205.0', '205.00', '205.01', '205.02', '207', '207.0', '207.00', '207.01', '207.02', '207.2', '207.20', '207.21', '207.22', 'C92.0', 'C92.00', 'C92.01', 'C92.02', 'C92.4', 'C92.40', 'C92.41', 'C92.42', 'C92.5', 'C92.50', 'C92.51', 'C92.52', 'C94.0', 'C94.00', 'C94.01', 'C94.02', 'C94.2', 'C94.20', 'C94.21', 'C94.22', '206', '206.0', '206.00', '206.01', '206.02', 'C93.0', 'C93.00', 'C93.01', 'C93.02') OR CC_CLSF_CD like '238%' OR CC_CLSF_CD like 'D45%' OR CC_CLSF_CD like 'D46%' OR CC_CLSF_CD like 'D47%') AND CC_MRN IN (SELECT DISTINCT MRN FROM DX2) GROUP BY CC_MRN, CLM_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK ) , AML_MDS2 AS (SELECT MRN, LISTAGG(COALESCE(STRIP(CAST(DX_DATE AS VARCHAR(12000))), '') || ' | ' || COALESCE(STRIP(CAST(DX_CODE AS VARCHAR(12000))), '') || ' | ' || COALESCE(STRIP(CAST(DX_DESC AS VARCHAR(12000))), '') , CHR(13) || CHR(10)) WITHIN GROUP( ORDER BY MRN, DX_DATE, DX_CODE, DX_DESC) AS DX_AML_MDS FROM AML_MDS GROUP BY MRN) SELECT DX2.*, DX_AML_MDS FROM DX2 JOIN AML_MDS2 AM2 ON DX2.MRN = AM2.MRN

prompt: A list of H- or S- cases with "blastic plasmacytoid dendritic cell neoplasm" OR "BPDCN" mentioned in the report from 01/01/2019 to present.
completion: SELECT DISTINCT PRPT_MRN AS MRN , PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_BIRTH_DTE, PT_VITAL_STATUS, PT_DEATH_DTE , PRPT_ACCESSION_NO AS "Accession No" , PRPT_REPORT_DTE AS "Report Date" , PRPT_PROCEDURE_DTE AS "Procedure Date" , PRPT_REPORT_TYPE_DESC AS "Report Type" , DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)diag[\w\W]*(?=I ATTEST)', PRPT_REPORT) AS DIAGNOSIS_TEXT , VARCHAR(PRPT_REPORT, 32000) AS "Report Text (first 32000 characters)" FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID WHERE 1=1 AND SUBSTR(PRPT_ACCESSION_NO, 1, 1) IN ('H', 'S') AND (PRPT_REPORT_DTE >= '01/01/2019' OR PRPT_PROCEDURE_DTE >= '01/01/2019') AND CONTAINS(PRPT_REPORT, '("blastic plasmacytoid dendritic cell neoplasm" OR "BPDCN")') = 1 AND PRPT_REPORT IS NOT NULL ORDER BY PRPT_MRN, PRPT_REPORT_DTE, PRPT_PROCEDURE_DTE

prompt: Soon to be opening MED22-016 clinical trial which will enroll patients with NSCLC and mesothelioma with MTAP deletions on a targeted therapy clinical trial.
completion: WITH PTS AS (SELECT PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID PID FROM DV.PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED) , DT_1 AS (SELECT PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID AS P_ID FROM DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS REC LEFT JOIN DV.PATIENT_CORE_DEMOGRAPHICS ON PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = CORE_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID WHERE 1=1 ) , DT_2 AS (SELECT PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID AS P_ID FROM DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS REC LEFT JOIN DV.PATIENT_CORE_DEMOGRAPHICS ON PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = CORE_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID WHERE 1=1 AND PT_VITAL_STATUS IN ('ALIVE') ) , DT_3_1 AS (SELECT INC.PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID P_ID FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_STRUCTURED_RESULTS_V INC JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML DT ON INC.PRPT_PATH_RPT_ID = DT.PDRX_PATH_RPT_ID CROSS JOIN XMLTABLE('$c/root/meta-data' PASSING DT.PDRX_XML_VALUE AS "c" COLUMNS PRIMARY_SITE VARCHAR(264) PATH 'primary_site', TUMOR_TYPE_NAME VARCHAR(264) PATH 'tumor_type_name' , TUMOR_TYPE_CODE VARCHAR(264) PATH 'tumor_type_code', IS_METASTASIS VARCHAR(3) PATH 'is_metastasis' , METASTASIS_SITE VARCHAR(264) PATH 'metastasis_site' , MSI_COMMENT VARCHAR(264) PATH 'msi-comment' , MSI_SCORE VARCHAR(264) PATH 'msi-score' , MSI_TYPE VARCHAR(264) PATH 'msi-type' , TMB_SCORE VARCHAR(25) PATH 'tmb_score' , TMB_COUNT VARCHAR(25) PATH 'tmb-count', COSMIC_ID VARCHAR(5000) PATH 'cosmic_id') T JOIN (SELECT T.TUMOR_TYPE_CODE TTC FROM TABLE(DV.STRING_SPLIT('LUNG', ',')) S CROSS JOIN TABLE(DV.ONCOTREE_CHILDREN(COLUMN_VALUES)) T) X ON T.TUMOR_TYPE_CODE = TRIM(X.TTC) WHERE 1=1 AND (INC.GENE IN ('MTAP') OR INC.GENE2 IN ('MTAP')) AND INC.FOLD_CHANGE <= -2 ) , DT_3_2 AS (SELECT INC.PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID P_ID FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_STRUCTURED_RESULTS_V INC JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML DT ON INC.PRPT_PATH_RPT_ID = DT.PDRX_PATH_RPT_ID CROSS JOIN XMLTABLE('$c/root/meta-data' PASSING DT.PDRX_XML_VALUE AS "c" COLUMNS PRIMARY_SITE VARCHAR(264) PATH 'primary_site', TUMOR_TYPE_NAME VARCHAR(264) PATH 'tumor_type_name' , TUMOR_TYPE_CODE VARCHAR(264) PATH 'tumor_type_code', IS_METASTASIS VARCHAR(3) PATH 'is_metastasis' , METASTASIS_SITE VARCHAR(264) PATH 'metastasis_site' , MSI_COMMENT VARCHAR(264) PATH 'msi-comment' , MSI_SCORE VARCHAR(264) PATH 'msi-score' , MSI_TYPE VARCHAR(264) PATH 'msi-type' , TMB_SCORE VARCHAR(25) PATH 'tmb_score' , TMB_COUNT VARCHAR(25) PATH 'tmb-count', COSMIC_ID VARCHAR(5000) PATH 'cosmic_id') T WHERE 1=1 AND LOWER(TUMOR_TYPE_NAME) like '%' || LOWER('mesothelioma') || '%' AND (INC.GENE IN ('MTAP') OR INC.GENE2 IN ('MTAP')) AND INC.FOLD_CHANGE <= -2 ) , DEID AS (SELECT DISTINCT P_ID FROM (SELECT P_ID FROM DT_1 INTERSECT SELECT P_ID FROM DT_2 INTERSECT (SELECT P_ID FROM DT_3_1 UNION ALL SELECT P_ID FROM DT_3_2 )))

prompt: Time sensitive request. Need for Magnet document submission
completion: WITH DX AS (SELECT CC_MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS MIN_ICD9_EFF_DTE FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE CC_CLSF_CD IN ('Z95.0', 'V45.01') AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND (CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) GROUP BY CC_MRN ) , EMR AS (SELECT DISTINCT EAD_MRN FROM IDB.EMR_AA_DOCUMENT JOIN IDB.EMR_AA_DOCTYPE ON EAD_DOCTYPE = EADT_DOCTYPE WHERE VALUE(EAD_RIGHT_ID, EADT_RIGHT_ID) = 167 AND EAD_DOCTYPE = 'RS9' ) SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN AS "MRN", CPE_ENC_DTE AS "Appt Date", CASE WHEN EAD_MRN IS NOT NULL THEN 'Y' ELSE '' END "99-00756 Form", CASE WHEN CC_MRN IS NOT NULL THEN 'Y' ELSE '' END "ICD Code in ClinTrac" FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID LEFT JOIN DX ON CPE_MRN = CC_MRN LEFT JOIN EMR ON CPE_MRN = EAD_MRN WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CRE_RES_NAME LIKE '%MRI %' AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 = 'RAD' AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN '2016-10-01' AND '2019-03-31' AND CLD_CLD_CENTER = 'MAIN' AND COALESCE(EAD_MRN, CC_MRN) IS NOT NULL ORDER BY 1 DESC

prompt: Schedule a bimonthly report of cholangiocarcinoma patients with an upcoming appointment in Westchester.
completion: WITH X AS (SELECT TM_MRN AS MRN, TM_DX_DTE AS DX_DATE, TM_HIST_CD AS DX_CODE, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS DX_DESC FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM H ON TM_HIST_CD = H.CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON TM_SITE_CD = S.CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('3', '6', '7', '8') AND TM_HIST_CD = 'M8160/3' UNION SELECT CC_MRN AS MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS DX_DATE, CLM_CLSF_CD AS DX_CODE, CLM_CLSF_DESC AS DX_DESC FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND ((CC_PT_TYPE = 'I') OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) AND CC_CLSF_CD IN ('C22.1', 'C24.0', '155.1', '156.1') GROUP BY CC_MRN, CLM_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC ) SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN AS MRN, PT_LAST_NAME AS "Last Name", PT_FIRST_NAME "First Name", CPE_ENC_DTE AS "Appointment Date", CRE_RES_NAME AS "Provider Name", CRE_RES_TYP AS "Provider Type", CLD_DEPT_NAME AS "Dept Name", CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME AS "Visit Type" FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON CPE_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE 1=1 AND CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Sch') AND(CLD_DEPT_NAME LIKE '%WES%' OR CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME LIKE '%WES%') AND CPE_MRN IN (SELECT MRN FROM X) AND CPE_ENC_DTE >= CURRENT DATE AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 = 'GI' AND CRE_RES_TYP IN ('Physician', 'Nurse Practitioner')

prompt: Cohort of Myeloid patients consented to biobanking protocols - to be accessed in Darwin Digital Platform
completion: WITH DT_1 AS (SELECT DISTINCT PDRX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID P_ID FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML DT CROSS JOIN XMLTABLE('$c/root/meta-data' PASSING DT.PDRX_XML_VALUE AS "c" COLUMNS PRIMARY_SITE VARCHAR(264) PATH 'primary_site' , TUMOR_TYPE_NAME VARCHAR(264) PATH 'tumor_type_name' , TUMOR_TYPE_CODE VARCHAR(264) PATH 'tumor_type_code' , IS_METASTASIS VARCHAR(3) PATH 'is_metastasis' , METASTASIS_SITE VARCHAR(264) PATH 'metastasis_site') T JOIN (SELECT T.TUMOR_TYPE_CODE TTC FROM TABLE(DV.STRING_SPLIT('MNM', ',')) S CROSS JOIN TABLE(DV.ONCOTREE_CHILDREN(COLUMN_VALUES)) T) X ON T.TUMOR_TYPE_CODE = X.TTC WHERE 1=1 ) , DT_2 AS (SELECT DISTINCT PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID AS P_ID FROM IDB.ACCRUALS JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON AC_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE 1=1 AND AC_IRB_NO IN ('12-245', '06-107', '09-141') ) , DEID AS (SELECT DISTINCT A.P_ID FROM DT_1 A JOIN DT_2 B ON A.P_ID = B.P_ID)

prompt: Provide a list of patients who received intravenous recombinant tissue plasminogen activator (rTPA) for stroke.
completion: SELECT PT_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_SEX, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, GENERIC_NAME, MIN(START_DATE) AS START_DATE, MAX(STOP_DATE) AS STOP_DATE FROM IDB.PATIENT JOIN (SELECT ORD_MRN AS MRN, SVM_SVM_DESC AS GENERIC_NAME, MIN(ORD_STRT_DTE) AS START_DATE, MAX(COALESCE(ORD_STOP_DTE, ORD_DISCONT_DTE)) AS STOP_DATE FROM IDB.ORDERS JOIN IDB.RX_MEDSOL ON RMS_ORD_NO = ORD_ORD_NO AND ORD_MRN = RMS_MRN AND ORD_ACCT_NO = RMS_ACCT_NO JOIN IDB.SVM ON RMS_SVM_DPT = SVM_SVM_DPT AND RMS_SVM_CD = SVM_SVM_CD WHERE ORD_STRT_DTE >= '1996-01-01' AND ORD_ORD_STS_CD IN ('20', '85') AND SVM_SVM_DESC LIKE 'ALTEPLASE%' AND RMS_ROUTE_OF_ADMIN LIKE 'IV%' GROUP BY ORD_MRN, SVM_SVM_DESC UNION ALL SELECT PO_MRN AS MRN, UCASE(PIN_GENERIC_NAME) AS GENERIC_NAME, MIN(POD_STRT_DTE) AS START_DATE, MAX(POD_STOP_DTE) AS STOP_DATE FROM IDB.PHM_ORDER JOIN IDB.PHM_ORD_DTL ON PO_ORD_SEQ = POD_ORD_SEQ JOIN IDB.PHM_ORD_INV ON POD_ORD_SEQ = POI_ORD_SEQ AND POD_ITEM_NO = POI_ITEM_NO JOIN IDB.PHM_INVENTORY ON POI_INV_SEQ = PIN_INV_SEQ WHERE PO_ORD_STS NOT IN ('X', 'P') AND UCASE(PIN_GENERIC_NAME) LIKE 'ALTEPLASE%' AND PO_ROUTE_DESC LIKE 'IV%' GROUP BY PO_MRN, PIN_GENERIC_NAME) RX ON MRN = PT_MRN GROUP BY PT_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_SEX, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, GENERIC_NAME

prompt: List of all surgical procedures performed by Dr. Smita Sihag as primary surgeon between 12/1/2017 and 11/28/2018.
completion: SELECT SSE_MRN "MRN", PT_LAST_NAME "Last Name", PT_FIRST_NAME "First Name", PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH "DOB", SSE_SURG_DTE "Surgery Date", SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD "Surgery CPT Code", SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC "Surgery Description" FROM IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE ON SSE_LOG_ID = SSP_LOG_ID JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PT_MRN = SSE_MRN WHERE SSP_RES_ID = '022335' AND SSE_SURG_DTE BETWEEN '2017-12-01' AND '2018-11-28'

prompt: List of patients coming to Rad Onc for MR for the next 7 days along with the MSK Engage form submission details
completion: WITH APPTS AS (SELECT DISTINCT ENC.CPE_ENC_CSN_ID , ENC.CPE_PRK , ENC.CPE_MRN , PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_LAST_NAME , ENC.CPE_ENC_DTE , CLD_CLD_CENTER , DEPT.CLD_DEPT_NAME FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER AS ENC JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE AS RESOURCE ON ENC.CPE_REF_RES_ID = RESOURCE.CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT AS DEPT ON ENC.CPE_DEPT_ID = DEPT.CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE AS VISIT_TYP ON ENC.CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = VISIT_TYP.CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON CPE_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY ON PLA_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE CPE_MRN > '' AND PLA_DECEASED_IND <> 'Y' AND UCASE(CPE_CPE_APPT_STS) IN('SCH', 'ARRIVED', 'COMP') AND ENC.CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT_DATE AND CURRENT_DATE + 7 DAY AND ((CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 = 'RAD' AND ENC.CPE_VST_RES_ID IN (SELECT CRE_RES_ID FROM IDB.CL_RESOURCE WHERE CRE_RES_NAME LIKE '%MRI 1275%' OR CRE_RES_NAME LIKE '%MRI 53%' OR CRE_RES_NAME LIKE '%MRI 300 E66%' OR CRE_RES_NAME LIKE '%MRI KOCH%' OR CRE_RES_NAME LIKE '%MRI BSK%' OR CRE_RES_NAME LIKE '%MRI CMK%' OR CRE_RES_NAME LIKE 'MRI BER%' OR CRE_RES_NAME LIKE '%MRI MON%' OR CRE_RES_NAME LIKE '%MRI NAS%' OR CRE_RES_NAME LIKE 'MR WES%' )) OR CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID IN (9691, 9692, 9765, 9766, 13187, 13188, 13272) OR (CPE_DEPT_ID = 1558 AND ENC.CPE_VST_RES_ID = 202262 AND CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID IN (11459, 6653, 11463, 6650, 6660, 13195, 3772, 3776)) ) ) , FORM AS (SELECT EPI_MRN , EA_STS_ID , EAS_ASSESS_STS, EA_SUBM_DT, EA_SOURCE_ID , EA_ASSIGN_DT FROM IDB.EF_ASSESSMENT JOIN IDB.EF_PATIENT_INFO ON EA_PT_INFO_ID = EPI_PT_INFO_ID JOIN APPTS ON CHAR(EA_SOURCE_ID) = CHAR(CPE_ENC_CSN_ID) JOIN IDB.EF_SURVEY ON EA_SURV_ID = ES_SURV_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.EF_ASSESSMENT_STS ON EA_STS_ID = EAS_ASSESS_STS_ID WHERE ES_SURV_ALIAS = 'screeningmri' AND EA_STS_ID IN(1, 2) ) SELECT CPE_MRN AS MRN, TRIM(PT_LAST_NAME) || ', ' || TRIM(PT_FIRST_NAME) AS PATIENT_NAME, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH AS DATE_OF_BIRTH, CLD_DEPT_NAME AS DEPARTMENT, CPE_ENC_DTE AS APPOINTMENT_DATE, COALESCE (EAS_ASSESS_STS, 'Not-Assigned') AS SURVEY_STATUS, EA_ASSIGN_DT AS ASSIGNED_DATE FROM APPTS LEFT JOIN FORM ON EPI_MRN = CPE_MRN WHERE CLD_DEPT_NAME NOT LIKE '%KOCH%'

prompt: Provide data on patients who had a stereotactic radiosurgery procedure between 6/1/2010 and 8/1/2010.
completion: WITH "cte1" AS (SELECT BT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID, BT_COURSE_NO COURSE_NO, BT_COURSE_IDENTIFIER COURSE_IDENTIFIER FROM DV.RADONC_BEAM_THERAPY UNION SELECT FD_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID, FD_COURSE_NO COURSE_NO, FD_COURSE_IDENTIFIER COURSE_IDENTIFIER FROM DV.RADONC_FIELD_DETAIL) SELECT DISTINCT "t7"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AS "Deident PT #", "t8"."PT_MRN" AS "MRN", "t9"."COURSE_IDENTIFIER" AS "Course ID", "t10"."DT_DTE" AS "Treatment Start Date", "t11"."DT_DTE" AS "Treatment Stop Date", MP_FULL_NM, "t12"."RFC_REFERENCE_POINT" AS "Reference Point/Site", "t13"."BT_DELIVERED_DOSE" AS "Delivered Dose", "t13"."BT_TOTAL_FRACTIONS" AS "Total Fractions" FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED" "t7" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V" "t8" ON "t7"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t8"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "cte1" "t9" ON "t7"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t9"."PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."RADONC_BEAM_THERAPY" "t13" ON "t9"."PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t13"."BT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AND "t9"."COURSE_NO" = "t13"."BT_COURSE_NO" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE" "t10" ON "t13"."BT_TX_START_DATE_ID" = "t10"."DT_DATE_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE" "t11" ON "t13"."BT_TX_STOP_DATE_ID" = "t11"."DT_DATE_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."REFERENCE_POINT_CATALOG" "t12" ON "t13"."BT_REFERENCE_POINT_ID" = "t12"."RFC_BEAM_THERAPY_ID" LEFT JOIN DV.MEDPRO ON MP_MEDPRO_ID = BT_ATTENDING_MEDPRO_ID WHERE ("t7"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" IN (SELECT "Deident PT #" FROM (SELECT DISTINCT "t1"."PT_MRN" AS "MRN", "t1"."PT_LAST_NAME" AS "Last Name", "t1"."PT_FIRST_NAME" AS "First Name", "t2"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AS "Deident PT #", "t3"."DT_DTE" AS "CPT Procedure Date - PBD", "t4"."PCC_CODE" AS "CPT Procedure Code - PBD", "t4"."PCC_DESC" AS "CPT Procedure Desc - PBD", "t5"."MP_FULL_NM" AS "CPT Procedure Physician - PBD", "t5"."MP_SERVICE_DESC" AS "CPT Physician Service Desc" FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED" "t2" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V" "t1" ON "t2"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t1"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."CPT_PBD_PATIENT_PROCEDURE" "t4" ON "t2"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t4"."PTX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE" "t3" ON "t4"."PTX_PROC_DATE_ID" = "t3"."DT_DATE_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."MEDPRO_V" "t5" ON "t4"."PTX_MEDPRO_ID" = "t5"."MP_MEDPRO_ID" WHERE ("t4"."PROC_ID" IN (58087, 58088, 58093, 58094) AND "t3"."DT_DTE" BETWEEN '2010-6-1' AND '2010-8-1') ) AS "t6") AND "t10"."DT_DTE" BETWEEN '2010-6-1' AND '2010-8-1')

prompt: Provide QA of  backloaded new columns LR_ORD_MSTR_ITEM_GUID  and  LR_ORD_PVDR_GUID in IDB.LAB_RESULTS table  and LRH_ORD_MSTR_ITEM_GUID and LRH_ORD_PVDR_GUID in  IDB.LAB_RESULTS_HX table.
completion: SELECT LR_ORD_GUID , LR_ORD_MSTR_ITEM_GUID , CASE WHEN LR_ORD_MSTR_ITEM_GUID <> COALESCE(OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID, '') THEN 'Y' ELSE ' ' END ORD_GUID , LR_ORD_PVDR_GUID , CASE WHEN LR_ORD_PVDR_GUID <> COALESCE(OO_PVDR_GUID, '') THEN 'Y' ELSE ' ' END PRVD_GUID FROM IDB.LAB_RESULTS LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_ORDER ON OO_ORD_GUID = LR_ORD_GUID WHERE OO_ENTER_DTE BETWEEN '2008-01-01' AND '2008-03-31' AND ((CASE WHEN LR_ORD_MSTR_ITEM_GUID <> COALESCE(OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID, '') THEN 'Y' ELSE ' ' END) = 'Y' OR (CASE WHEN LR_ORD_PVDR_GUID <> COALESCE(OO_PVDR_GUID, '') THEN 'Y' ELSE ' ' END) = 'Y') SELECT LRH_ORD_GUID , LRH_ORD_MSTR_ITEM_GUID , CASE WHEN LRH_ORD_MSTR_ITEM_GUID <> COALESCE(OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID, '') THEN 'Y' ELSE ' ' END ORD_GUID , LRH_ORD_PVDR_GUID , CASE WHEN LRH_ORD_PVDR_GUID <> COALESCE(OO_PVDR_GUID, '') THEN 'Y' ELSE ' ' END PRVD_GUID FROM IDB.LAB_RESULTS_HX LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_ORDER ON OO_ORD_GUID = LRH_ORD_GUID WHERE OO_ENTER_DTE BETWEEN '2005-01-01' AND '2005-03-31' AND ((CASE WHEN LRH_ORD_MSTR_ITEM_GUID <> COALESCE(OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID, '') THEN 'Y' ELSE ' ' END) = 'Y' OR (CASE WHEN LRH_ORD_PVDR_GUID <> COALESCE(OO_PVDR_GUID, '') THEN 'Y' ELSE ' ' END) = 'Y')

prompt: Provide a report of patients diagnosed with lymphoma of the lung or bronchus who have been treated with radiation.
completion: WITH TM AS (SELECT DISTINCT TM_MRN AS MRN, TM_DX_DTE AS DX_DATE, TM_SITE_CD AS SITE_CODE, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_DESC, TM_HIST_CD AS HIST_CODE, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS HIST_DESC, CASE WHEN TM_AJCC_7 NOT IN ('', '888', '999') THEN AJCC7.AV_DESC WHEN TM_AJCC NOT IN ('', '88', '99') THEN AJCC.AV_DESC WHEN TM_GENERAL_STG NOT IN ('', '9') THEN GS.AV_DESC WHEN TM_PATH_STG_GRP NOT IN ('', '88', '9', '99') THEN TM_PATH_STG_GRP ELSE CLIN.AV_DESC END AS STAGE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY TM_MRN ORDER BY TM_DX_DTE) AS RN FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS AJCC7 ON AJCC7.AV_ELEMENT = 'AJCC_7' AND AJCC7.AV_CODE = TM_AJCC_7 LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS AJCC ON AJCC.AV_ELEMENT = 'AJCC' AND AJCC.AV_CODE = TM_AJCC LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS GS ON GS.AV_ELEMENT = 'GENERAL_STG' AND GS.AV_CODE = TM_GENERAL_STG LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS CLIN ON CLIN.AV_ELEMENT = 'CLIN_STG_DSCR' AND CLIN.AV_CODE = TM_CLIN_STG_DSCR WHERE 1=1 AND TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND TM_DX_DTE BETWEEN '2000-01-01' AND '2021-01-20' AND TM_SITE_CD IN ('C340', 'C341', 'C342', 'C343', 'C348', 'C349') AND TM_HIST_CD IN ('M9699/3', 'M9823/3', 'M9590/3', 'M9591/3', 'M9596/3', 'M9650/3', 'M9651/3', 'M9652/3', 'M9653/3', 'M9654/3', 'M9655/3', 'M9659/3', 'M9661/3', 'M9662/3', 'M9663/3', 'M9664/3', 'M9665/3', 'M9667/3', 'M9670/3', 'M9671/3', 'M9673/3', 'M9675/3', 'M9680/3', 'M9684/3', 'M9687/3', 'M9688/3', 'M9690/3', 'M9691/3', 'M9695/3', 'M9698/3', 'M9701/3', 'M9702/3', 'M9705/3', 'M9712/3', 'M9714/3', 'M9719/3', 'M9724/3', 'M9727/3', 'M9728/3', 'M9729/3', 'M9731/3', 'M9734/3', 'M9735/3', 'M9737/3', 'M9738/3', 'M9740/3', 'M9741/3', 'M9750/3', 'M9751/3', 'M9754/3', 'M9755/3', 'M9756/3', 'M9757/3', 'M9758/3', 'M9759/3', 'M9811/3', 'M9812/3', 'M9813/3', 'M9814/3', 'M9815/3', 'M9816/3', 'M9817/3', 'M9818/3', 'M9831/3', 'M9837/3', 'M9965/3', 'M9967/3', 'M9971/3', 'M9975/3', 'M9678/3', 'M9679/3', 'M9689/3', 'M9700/3', 'M9708/3', 'M9709/3', 'M9718/3', 'M9733/3', 'M9742/3', 'M9760/3', 'M9761/3', 'M9762/3', 'M9800/3', 'M9801/3', 'M9805/3', 'M9806/3', 'M9807/3', 'M9808/3', 'M9809/3', 'M9820/3', 'M9826/3', 'M9827/3', 'M9828/3', 'M9832/3', 'M9833/3', 'M9834/3', 'M9835/3', 'M9836/3', 'M9840/3', 'M9860/3', 'M9861/3', 'M9863/3', 'M9865/3', 'M9866/3', 'M9867/3', 'M9869/3', 'M9870/3', 'M9871/3', 'M9872/3', 'M9873/3', 'M9874/3', 'M9875/3', 'M9876/3', 'M9891/3', 'M9895/3', 'M9896/3', 'M9897/3', 'M9898/3', 'M9910/3', 'M9911/3', 'M9920/3', 'M9930/3', 'M9931/3', 'M9940/3', 'M9945/3', 'M9946/3', 'M9948/3', 'M9960/3', 'M9961/3', 'M9962/3', 'M9963/3', 'M9964/3', 'M9966/3') ) , PATH AS (SELECT "t1"."PT_MRN" AS "MRN", "t3"."DT_DTE" AS DX_DATE, '' AS SITE_CODE, '' AS SITE_DESC, '' AS HIST_CODE, '' AS HIST_DESC, '' AS STAGE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY "t1"."PT_MRN" ORDER BY "t3"."DT_DTE") AS RN FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V" "t1" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED" "t4" ON "t1"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t4"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V" "t2" ON "t4"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t2"."PRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" "t3" ON "t2"."PRPT_PROCEDURE_DATE_ID" = "t3"."DT_DATE_ID" WHERE (CONTAINS("t2"."PRPT_REPORT", '("Plasmacytoma" | "lymphoma") & ("lung" | "bronchus")') = 1 AND "t2"."PRPT_REPORT" IS NOT NULL) ) , DX AS (SELECT DISTINCT MRN, DX_DATE, SITE_CODE, SITE_DESC, HIST_CODE, HIST_DESC, STAGE FROM TM WHERE RN = 1 UNION SELECT DISTINCT MRN, DX_DATE, SITE_CODE, SITE_DESC, HIST_CODE, HIST_DESC, STAGE FROM PATH WHERE MRN NOT IN (SELECT MRN FROM TM) AND RN = 1 ) , X AS (SELECT * FROM DX WHERE DX_DATE BETWEEN '2000-01-01' AND '2021-01-20' ) , PT AS (SELECT DISTINCT MRN, STRIP(PT_LAST_NAME) || ', ' || STRIP(PT_FIRST_NAME) AS NAME, DX_DATE, SITE_CODE, SITE_DESC, HIST_CODE, HIST_DESC, STAGE, R.AV_DESC AS "Race", E.AV_DESC AS "Ethnicity", PT_SEX, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, PT_DATE_OF_DEATH, COALESCE(MAX(PLA_LST_APPT_DTE, PLA_LST_DSCH_DTE), PLA_LST_APPT_DTE, PLA_LST_DSCH_DTE) AS LAST_FU_DATE FROM X JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS R ON PT_RACE = R.AV_CODE AND R.AV_ELEMENT = 'RACE' LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS E ON PT_PT_ETHNICITY = E.AV_CODE AND E.AV_ELEMENT = 'PT_ETHNICITY' JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY ON PT_MRN = PLA_MRN) , RT AS (SELECT DISTINCT RTC_TX_MRN, RTC_TX_PLAN_NAME, RTC_PRIMARY_REF_POINT, RTC_TX_START_DTE, RTC_TX_STOP_DTE, RTC_TX_ELAPSED_DAYS, RTC_TX_PLANNED_FRACTIONS, RTC_TX_DELIVERED_FRACTIONS, RTC_TX_PLANNED_DOSE, RTC_TX_DELIVERED_DOSE, RTC_DOSE_CORRECTION FROM X JOIN IDB.RADONC_TREATMENT_COURSE ON MRN = RTC_TX_MRN) , RT_LUNG AS (SELECT DISTINCT RTC_TX_MRN, RTC_TX_PLAN_NAME, RTC_PRIMARY_REF_POINT, RTC_TX_START_DTE, RTC_TX_STOP_DTE, RTC_TX_ELAPSED_DAYS, RTC_TX_PLANNED_FRACTIONS, RTC_TX_DELIVERED_FRACTIONS, RTC_TX_PLANNED_DOSE, RTC_TX_DELIVERED_DOSE, RTC_DOSE_CORRECTION, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY RTC_TX_MRN ORDER BY RTC_TX_START_DTE DESC) AS RN FROM X JOIN IDB.RADONC_TREATMENT_COURSE ON MRN = RTC_TX_MRN WHERE RTC_TX_PLAN_NAME LIKE '%LUNG%' OR RTC_TX_PLAN_NAME LIKE '%LOBE%' ) SELECT DISTINCT PT.*, RTL.RTC_TX_PLAN_NAME, RTL.RTC_PRIMARY_REF_POINT, RTL.RTC_TX_START_DTE, RTL.RTC_TX_STOP_DTE, RTL.RTC_TX_ELAPSED_DAYS, RTL.RTC_TX_PLANNED_FRACTIONS, RTL.RTC_TX_DELIVERED_FRACTIONS, RTL.RTC_TX_PLANNED_DOSE, RTL.RTC_TX_DELIVERED_DOSE, RTL.RTC_DOSE_CORRECTION FROM PT JOIN RT ON PT.MRN = RT.RTC_TX_MRN LEFT JOIN RT_LUNG RTL ON PT.MRN = RTL.RTC_TX_MRN AND RN = 1

prompt: Provide a list of Classical Hodgkin Lymphoma cases from 07/2012 to 07/2022
completion: WITH X AS (SELECT DISTINCT "t1"."PT_MRN" AS "MRN", PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_BIRTH_DTE AS DOB, "t2"."PRPT_ACCESSION_NO" AS "Pathology Report", PRPT_REPORT_TYPE, "t3"."PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_DESC" AS "Pathology Report Type", YEAR("t4"."DT_DTE") AS YR, "t4"."DT_DTE" AS "Pathology Procedure Date", "t5"."DT_DTE" AS "Pathology Report Date", UPPER(CASE WHEN LENGTH(PRPT_REPORT) <= 15000 THEN RTRIM(CAST(SUBSTR(PRPT_REPORT, 1, 15000) AS VARCHAR(15000))) ELSE CAST(SUBSTR(PRPT_REPORT, 1, 15000) AS VARCHAR(15000)) END) AS TXT, CASE WHEN UPPER(DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)DIAGNOSIS:[\w\W]*(?=NOTE:)', PRPT_REPORT)) <> '' THEN UPPER(DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)DIAGNOSIS:[\w\W]*(?=NOTE:)', PRPT_REPORT)) WHEN UPPER(DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)DIAGNOSIS:[\w\W]*(?=I ATTEST)', PRPT_REPORT)) <> '' THEN UPPER(DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)DIAGNOSIS:[\w\W]*(?=I ATTEST)', PRPT_REPORT)) WHEN UPPER(DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)DIAGNOSIS:[\w\W]*(?=REPORT ELECTRONICALLY SIGNED OUT )', PRPT_REPORT)) <> '' THEN UPPER(DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)DIAGNOSIS:[\w\W]*(?=REPORT ELECTRONICALLY SIGNED OUT )', PRPT_REPORT)) END AS DIAGNOSIS, CASE WHEN UPPER(DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)SPECIMENS SUBMITTED[\w\W]*(?=DIAGNOSIS:)', PRPT_REPORT)) <> '' THEN UPPER(DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)SPECIMENS SUBMITTED[\w\W]*(?=DIAGNOSIS:)', PRPT_REPORT)) WHEN UPPER(DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)SPECIMENSSUBMITTED[\w\W]*(?=DIAGNOSIS:)', PRPT_REPORT)) <> '' THEN UPPER(DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)SPECIMENSSUBMITTED[\w\W]*(?=DIAGNOSIS:)', PRPT_REPORT)) END AS "SPECIMENS SUBMITTED" FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V" "t1" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED" "t6" ON "t1"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t6"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V" "t2" ON "t6"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t2"."PRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATH_RPRT_TYPE_LOOKUP" "t3" ON "t2"."PRPT_REPORT_TYPE" = "t3"."PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_CD" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" "t4" ON "t2"."PRPT_PROCEDURE_DATE_ID" = "t4"."DT_DATE_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" "t5" ON "t2"."PRPT_REPORT_DATE_ID" = "t5"."DT_DATE_ID" WHERE 1=1 AND CONTAINS("t2"."PRPT_REPORT", '("Classic Hodgkin Lymphoma" OR "Classical Hodgkin Lymphoma" OR "Classic Hodgkins Lymphoma" OR "Classical Hodgkins Lymphoma" OR "Classic HL" OR "Classical HL")') = 1 AND "t2"."PRPT_REPORT" IS NOT NULL AND("t2"."PRPT_ACCESSION_NO" LIKE 'H%' OR "t2"."PRPT_ACCESSION_NO" LIKE 'S%') AND PRPT_REPORT_TYPE not like '%SSL%' AND "t4"."DT_DTE" BETWEEN '2012-07-01' AND '2022-07-31' ) SELECT * FROM X WHERE(UPPER(DIAGNOSIS) like '%CLASSIC%HODGKIN%LYMPHOMA%' OR UPPER(DIAGNOSIS) like '%CLASSIC%HODGKIN%LYMPHOMA%' OR UPPER(DIAGNOSIS) like '%CLASSIC%HL%') AND UPPER(DIAGNOSIS) not like '%NO EVIDENCE OF CLASSIC%HODGKIN%LYMPHOMA%' AND UPPER(DIAGNOSIS) not like '%NO EVIDENCE OF CLASSIC%HL%'

prompt: Provide a weekly recurring list of new visits and internal referrals to the lymphoma service the prior week and include the specified lab results.
completion: WITH LYM AS (SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN AS MRN, STRIP(PT_LAST_NAME) AS LAST_NAME, STRIP(PT_FIRST_NAME) AS FIRST_NAME, STRIP(PT_SEX) AS GENDER, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH AS DOB, CPE_ENC_DTE, STRIP(CRE_RES_NAME) AS CRE_RES_NAME, STRIP(CLD_DEPT_NAME) AS CLD_DEPT_NAME, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8, STRIP(CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR) AS CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON CPE_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CRE_RES_TYP IN ('Physician') AND CPE_ENC_DTE >= '2018-10-15' AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 = 'LYM' AND(CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR LIKE '%NV%' OR CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR LIKE '%IR%') ) , L1 AS (SELECT DISTINCT LR_MRN AS MRN, CPE_ENC_DTE, LR_PERFORMED_DTE AS PERFORMED_DTE, LR_PERFORMED_DT AS PERFORMED_DT, CASE WHEN UPPER(LR_SUBTEST_NAME) LIKE '%ABS LYMPH%' THEN 'Abs Lymph' WHEN UPPER(LR_SUBTEST_NAME) LIKE 'ALBUMIN%' THEN 'Albumin' WHEN LR_SUBTEST_NAME = 'Erythrocyte Sedimentation Rate' THEN 'Erythrocyte Sedimentation Rate' WHEN LR_SUBTEST_NAME = 'Hepatitis B Surface Antigen' THEN 'Hepatitis B Surface Antigen' WHEN LR_SUBTEST_NAME = 'Hepatitis B Virus Core AntiBODY, Total' THEN 'Hepatitis B Virus Core AntiBODY, Total' WHEN LR_SUBTEST_NAME = 'Hepatitis B Virus Surface AntiBODY' THEN 'Hepatitis B Virus Surface AntiBODY' WHEN LR_SUBTEST_NAME = 'Hepatitis C Virus AntiBODY' THEN 'Hepatitis C Virus AntiBODY' WHEN LR_SUBTEST_NAME = 'HGB' THEN 'Hemoglobin' WHEN LR_SUBTEST_NAME = 'HIV-1/2 Ab/Ag Immunoassay' THEN 'HIV-1/2 Ab/Ag Immunoassay' WHEN LR_SUBTEST_NAME = 'HTLV-I/II Antibodies' THEN 'HTLV-I/II Antibodies' WHEN UPPER(LR_SUBTEST_NAME) LIKE 'LACTATE DEHYDROGENASE (LD)%' THEN 'LDH' WHEN UPPER(LR_SUBTEST_NAME) LIKE 'LYMPH%' THEN 'Lymphocyte %' WHEN UPPER(LR_SUBTEST_NAME) LIKE 'PLATELETS%' THEN 'Platelets' WHEN UPPER(LR_SUBTEST_NAME) LIKE 'WBC%' THEN 'WBC' END AS LAB_NAME, LR_TEST_NAME AS TEST_NAME, LR_SUBTEST_NAME AS SUBTEST_NAME, LR_RESULT_VALUE AS RESULT_VALUE, LR_UNIT_MEASURE AS UNIT_MEASURE, LTL_TEXT_RESULT AS TEXT_RESULT, LR_TEST_LOW_LIMIT AS TEST_LOW_LIMIT, LR_TEST_UP_LIMIT AS TEST_UP_LIMIT FROM LYM JOIN IDB.LAB_RESULTS ON LR_MRN = MRN AND LR_PERFORMED_DTE >= CPE_ENC_DTE LEFT JOIN IDB.LAB_TEXT_LINE ON LTL_RESULT_GUID = LR_RESULT_GUID WHERE(UPPER(LR_SUBTEST_NAME) LIKE '%WBC%' OR UPPER(LR_SUBTEST_NAME) LIKE '%ABS LYMPH%' OR UPPER(LR_SUBTEST_NAME) LIKE '%PLATELET%' OR UPPER(LR_SUBTEST_NAME) LIKE 'LYMPH%%' OR UPPER(LR_SUBTEST_NAME) LIKE '%HGB%' OR UPPER(LR_SUBTEST_NAME) LIKE 'ALBUMIN%' OR UPPER(LR_SUBTEST_NAME) LIKE '%LACTATE DEHYDROGENASE%' OR UPPER(LR_SUBTEST_NAME) LIKE '%ERYTHROCYTE SEDIMENTATION RATE%' OR LR_SUBTEST_NAME IN ('Hepatitis B Surface Antigen', 'Hepatitis B Virus Core AntiBODY, Total', 'Hepatitis B Virus Surface AntiBODY', 'Hepatitis C Virus AntiBODY', 'HIV-1/2 Ab/Ag Immunoassay', 'HTLV-I/II Antibodies')) AND UPPER(LR_SUBTEST_NAME) NOT LIKE '%URINE%' AND UPPER(LR_SUBTEST_NAME) NOT LIKE '%CSF%' ) , L2 AS (SELECT MRN, CPE_ENC_DTE, LAB_NAME, MIN(PERFORMED_DT) AS PERFORMED_DT_MIN FROM L1 WHERE NOT (RESULT_VALUE IS NULL AND TEXT_RESULT = '') GROUP BY MRN, CPE_ENC_DTE, LAB_NAME ) , L3 AS (SELECT DISTINCT L1.* FROM L1 JOIN L2 ON L1.MRN = L2.MRN AND L1.CPE_ENC_DTE = L2.CPE_ENC_DTE AND L1.LAB_NAME = L2.LAB_NAME AND L1.PERFORMED_DT = L2.PERFORMED_DT_MIN) , L4 AS (SELECT MRN, CPE_ENC_DTE, MAX(CASE WHEN UPPER(SUBTEST_NAME) LIKE '%ABS LYMPH%' THEN RESULT_VALUE END) AS "Abs Lymph", MAX(CASE WHEN UPPER(SUBTEST_NAME) LIKE 'ALBUMIN%' THEN RESULT_VALUE END) AS "Albumin", MAX(CASE WHEN SUBTEST_NAME = 'Erythrocyte Sedimentation Rate' THEN RESULT_VALUE END) AS "Erythrocyte Sedimentation Rate", MAX(CASE WHEN SUBTEST_NAME = 'Hepatitis B Surface Antigen' THEN TEXT_RESULT END) AS "Hepatitis B Surface Antigen", MAX(CASE WHEN SUBTEST_NAME = 'Hepatitis B Virus Core AntiBODY, Total' THEN TEXT_RESULT END) AS "Hepatitis B Virus Core AntiBODY, Total", MAX(CASE WHEN SUBTEST_NAME = 'Hepatitis B Virus Surface AntiBODY' THEN TEXT_RESULT END) AS "Hepatitis B Virus Surface AntiBODY", MAX(CASE WHEN SUBTEST_NAME = 'Hepatitis C Virus AntiBODY' THEN TEXT_RESULT END) AS "Hepatitis C Virus AntiBODY", MAX(CASE WHEN SUBTEST_NAME = 'HGB' THEN RESULT_VALUE END) AS "Hemoglobin", MAX(CASE WHEN SUBTEST_NAME = 'HIV-1/2 Ab/Ag Immunoassay' THEN TEXT_RESULT END) AS "HIV-1/2 Ab/Ag Immunoassay", MAX(CASE WHEN SUBTEST_NAME = 'HTLV-I/II Antibodies' THEN RESULT_VALUE END) AS "HTLV-I/II Antibodies", MAX(CASE WHEN UPPER(SUBTEST_NAME) LIKE 'LACTATE DEHYDROGENASE (LD)%' THEN RESULT_VALUE END) AS "LDH", MAX(CASE WHEN UPPER(SUBTEST_NAME) LIKE 'LACTATE DEHYDROGENASE (LD)%' THEN TEST_LOW_LIMIT END) AS "LDH Lower Limit", MAX(CASE WHEN UPPER(SUBTEST_NAME) LIKE 'LACTATE DEHYDROGENASE (LD)%' THEN TEST_UP_LIMIT END) AS "LDH Upper Limit", MAX(CASE WHEN UPPER(SUBTEST_NAME) LIKE 'LYMPH%' THEN RESULT_VALUE END) AS "Lymphocyte %", MAX(CASE WHEN UPPER(SUBTEST_NAME) LIKE 'PLATELETS%' THEN RESULT_VALUE END) AS "Platelets", MAX(CASE WHEN UPPER(SUBTEST_NAME) LIKE 'WBC%' THEN RESULT_VALUE END) AS "WBC" FROM L3 GROUP BY MRN, CPE_ENC_DTE ) SELECT DISTINCT LYM.*, STRIP("Abs Lymph") AS "Abs Lymph", STRIP("Albumin") AS "Albumin", STRIP("Erythrocyte Sedimentation Rate") AS "Erythrocyte Sedimentation Rate", STRIP("Hepatitis B Surface Antigen") AS "Hepatitis B Surface Antigen", STRIP("Hepatitis B Virus Core AntiBODY, Total") AS "Hepatitis B Virus Core AntiBODY, Total", STRIP("Hepatitis B Virus Surface AntiBODY") AS "Hepatitis B Virus Surface AntiBODY", STRIP("Hepatitis C Virus AntiBODY") AS "Hepatitis C Virus AntiBODY", STRIP("Hemoglobin") AS "Hemoglobin", STRIP("HIV-1/2 Ab/Ag Immunoassay") AS "HIV-1/2 Ab/Ag Immunoassay", STRIP("HTLV-I/II Antibodies") AS "HTLV-I/II Antibodies", STRIP("LDH") AS "LDH", STRIP("LDH Lower Limit") AS "LDH Lower Limit", STRIP("LDH Upper Limit") AS "LDH Upper Limit", STRIP("Lymphocyte %") AS "Lymphocyte %", STRIP("Platelets") AS "Platelets", STRIP("WBC") AS "WBC" FROM LYM LEFT JOIN L4 ON LYM.MRN = L4.MRN AND LYM.CPE_ENC_DTE = L4.CPE_ENC_DTE

prompt: Provide a list of patients who have had "C1, C2 or occipital condyle fractures" listed on their radiology reports.
completion: WITH X AS (SELECT DISTINCT "t1"."PT_MRN" AS "MRN", "t2"."RRPT_ACCESSION_NO" AS "Radiology Accession Number", "t2"."RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE" AS "Radiology Performed Date", "t2"."RRPT_REPORT_DTE" AS "Radiology Report Date", "t2"."RRPT_ORDER_GROUP" AS "Radiology Order Group", "t2"."RRPT_PROCEDURE_NAME" AS "Radiology Procedure Name", UPPER(CASE WHEN LENGTH(RRPT_REPORT_TXT) <= 15000 THEN RTRIM(CAST(SUBSTR(RRPT_REPORT_TXT, 1, 15000) AS VARCHAR(15000))) ELSE CAST(SUBSTR(RRPT_REPORT_TXT, 1, 15000) AS VARCHAR(15000)) END) AS "PRPT_REPORT" FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V" "t1" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED" "t3" ON "t1"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t3"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."RADIOLOGY_REPORT_V" "t2" ON "t3"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t2"."RRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_IDENTIFICATION_MRN_V" "t4" ON "t1"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t4"."PI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" WHERE 1=1 AND("t2"."RRPT_ORDER_GROUP" like '%MR%' OR "t2"."RRPT_ORDER_GROUP" like '%CT%') AND(UPPER(RRPT_REPORT_TXT) like '%C1%' OR UPPER(RRPT_REPORT_TXT) like '%C2%' OR UPPER(RRPT_REPORT_TXT) like '%CONDYLE%') AND(UPPER(RRPT_REPORT_TXT) like '%FRACTURE%') AND "t2"."RRPT_PROCEDURE_NAME" IN ('Cervical & Thoracic Spine w & w/o Con', 'Cervical & Thoracic Spine w/ Con', 'Cervical & Thoracic Spine w/o Con', 'Cervical Spine w/ Con', 'Cervical Spine w/&w/o Con', 'Cervical Spine w/&w/o Con + Perfusion', 'Cervical Spine w/o Con', 'CT CERVICAL SPINE W/ CON', 'CT CERVICAL SPINE W/O CON', 'CT CSPINE', 'CT CSPINE & TSPINE W CON', 'CT CSPINE & TSPINE W/O CON', 'CT CSPINE & TSPINE W/WO CON', 'CT CSPINE W/WO CON', 'CT POST MYELO CERVICAL SPINE', 'CT POST MYELO OF TOTAL SPINE', 'CT POST MYELO THORACIC SPINE', 'CT TOTAL SPINE W/ CON', 'CT TOTAL SPINE W/O CON', 'CT TOTAL SPINE W/WO CON', 'Focal Cervical Spine w/&w/o Con', 'Focal Cervical Spine w/&w/o Con + Perfusion', 'Focal Cervical Spine w/o Con', 'Focal Spine w/&w/o Con', 'Focal Spine w/&w/o Con + Perfusion', 'Focal Spine w/o Con', 'MR CERVICAL SPINE W/O CON', 'MR CERVICAL SPINE W/WO CON', 'MR CORD COMPRESSION WO GAD', 'MR C-SPINE W/WO CON + PERFUSION', 'MR FOCAL SPINE W/O CONTRAST', 'MR FOCAL SPINE W/WO + PERFUSION', 'MR FOCAL SPINE W/WO CONTRAST', 'MR NECK W/O CON', 'MR NECK W/WO CON', 'MR TOTAL SPINE SURVERY W/O CON', 'MR TOTAL SPINE SURVERY W/WO', 'MR TOTAL SPINE SURVEY W/ CON', 'MR TOTAL SPINE SURVEY W/O CON', 'MR TOTAL SPINE SURVEY W/WO', 'MR TOTAL SPINE W/ + PERFUSION', 'MR TOTAL SPINE W/WO + PERFUSION', 'Total Spine Survey w/ Con', 'Total Spine Survey w/&w/o Con', 'Total Spine Survey w/o Con', 'Total Spine w & w/o Con', 'Total Spine w/ Con', 'Total Spine w/o Con', 'Total Spine w/wo Con + Perfusion', 'Post Myelogram Cervical Spine') AND "t2"."RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE" BETWEEN '1998-01-01' AND '2021-12-31' ) , CPE AS (SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN, CPE_ENC_DTE, CRE_RES_NAME, CRE_RES_TYP, CLD_DEPT_NAME, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8, CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CPE_MRN ORDER BY CPE_ENC_DTE DESC) AS RN FROM X JOIN IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER ON CPE_MRN = MRN JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CRE_RES_TYP IN ('Physician') AND CRE_RES_NAME IN ('BARZILAI, ORI', 'BILSKY, MARK', 'LAUFER, ILYA') ) , Y AS (SELECT "MRN", PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH AS DOB, PT_DATE_OF_DEATH AS DOD, PLA_LST_KNOWN_ALIVE_DTE, PT_SEX AS GENDER, "Radiology Performed Date", "Radiology Report Date", "Radiology Order Group", "Radiology Procedure Name" FROM X JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY ON MRN = PLA_MRN WHERE MRN IN (SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN FROM CPE) ) SELECT * FROM Y SELECT DISTINCT SSE_MRN, SSE_LOG_ID, SSE_SURG_DTE, SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD, SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC, STRIP(SSP_SURG_LAST_NM) || ', ' || STRIP(SSP_SURG_FIRST_NM) AS SURGEON, DATE(SAE_TOX_OCCR_DT) AS COMP_DATE, SAE_TOXICITY_NAME AS COMP_NAME, SAE_TOX_GRADE AS COMP_GRADE, SAE_TOX_GRADE_NAME AS COMP_CRITERIA FROM IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE ON SSE_LOG_ID = SSP_LOG_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.SRG_ADVERSE_EVENT ON SSE_LOG_ID = SAE_SURG_LOG_ID AND SAE_PROC_SEQ_NO = SSP_PROC_SEQ_NO AND SAE_TOX_GRADE > '0' WHERE SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD <> '999999' AND SSP_SOURCE_TYPE = 'O' AND(STRIP(SSP_SURG_LAST_NM) || ', ' || STRIP(SSP_SURG_FIRST_NM) like '%LAUFER, ILYA%' OR STRIP(SSP_SURG_LAST_NM) || ', ' || STRIP(SSP_SURG_FIRST_NM) like '%BILSKY, MARK%' OR STRIP(SSP_SURG_LAST_NM) || ', ' || STRIP(SSP_SURG_FIRST_NM) like '%BARZILAI, ORI%') AND SSE_MRN IN (SELECT DISTINCT MRN FROM Y) AND SSE_SURG_DTE BETWEEN '1998-01-01' AND '2021-12-31'

prompt: Provide counts of discharge disposition data by service and floor for the past 3 years.
completion: SELECT AV_DESC AS "Disposition", VIS_HOSP_SVC "Service", HOSP_SVC_DESC "Service Desc", VIS_NURS_STA "Floor", NURS_STA_DESC, YEAR(VIS_DSCH_DTE) AS "Year", MONTH(VIS_DSCH_DTE) AS "Month", COUNT(*) AS "Count" FROM IDB.VISIT_V JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS ON AV_ELEMENT = 'DSCH_DISP' AND AV_CODE = VIS_DSCH_DISP WHERE VIS_VISIT_STATUS = '3' AND VIS_DSCH_DTE BETWEEN '2016-04-01' AND '2019-04-30' AND VIS_IP_OP_ADJUSTED_IND = 'I' GROUP BY AV_DESC, VIS_HOSP_SVC, HOSP_SVC_DESC, VIS_NURS_STA, NURS_STA_DESC, YEAR(VIS_DSCH_DTE), MONTH(VIS_DSCH_DTE) ORDER BY AV_DESC, VIS_HOSP_SVC, VIS_NURS_STA, YEAR(VIS_DSCH_DTE), MONTH(VIS_DSCH_DTE)

prompt: Create a report listing orders entered into CIS using the non-formulary form for 1 month by MRN, entered by name and title and location. Include any administration instructions entered.
completion: SELECT OO_MRN AS MRN, OO_ENTER_DTE ENTER_DATE , OEF_FORM_NAME AS FORM_NAME, OO_ORD_NAME ORD_NAME , OO_SUMMARY_LINE AS SUMMARY_LINE, OCV_CURR_LOC AS LOCATION , OO_ORD_STS_CD AS ORD_STATUS, OU_DISPLAY_NAME AS ENTERED_BY , OU_OCCUPATION AS TITLE, OU_ORD_ROLE_TYPE AS ENTERED_ROLE FROM IDB.OMS_ORDER JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_CATALOG ON OOC_MSTR_ITEM_GUID = OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID AND OOC_REV_CAT_DEPT = 'Pharmacy' AND OOC_ITEM_NAME = 'Non-Formulary Medication' JOIN IDB.OMS_CLIENT_VISIT ON OCV_VISIT_GUID = OO_VISIT_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_USER ON OU_USER_GUID = OO_USER_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_ENTRY_FORM ON OEF_ENTRY_FRM_GUID = OO_ENTRY_FRM_GUID AND OEF_FORM_NAME LIKE 'RX-NONFORMULARY%' WHERE OO_ORD_STS_CD NOT IN ('CANC', 'CANP') AND OO_ORD_TYPE_CD = 'Medication' AND OO_ENTER_DTE BETWEEN '2009-09-01' AND '2009-09-30'

prompt: Initial query, potential project.  Deidentified data is fine.  Looking to characterize bronchoscopy procedures performed on patients taking immune checkpoint inhibitors (pembrolizumab, nivolumab, ipilimumab, durvalumab, atezolizumab).
completion: WITH CI AS (SELECT APR_MRN, APR_GENERIC_NAME, MIN(APR_START_DTE) FIRST_START_DTE, MAX(APR_START_DTE) LAST_START_DTE FROM IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX JOIN IDB.CHEMO_DRUG_GENERIC ON APR_GENERIC_NAME = CDG_GENERIC_NAME WHERE CDG_BIOLOGIC_IMMUNO_FLAG = 'Y' GROUP BY APR_MRN, APR_GENERIC_NAME) SELECT DISTINCT PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID, YEAR(FIRST_START_DTE) FIRST_START_DTE, YEAR(LAST_START_DTE) LAST_START_DTE, APR_GENERIC_NAME, YEAR(SSE_SURG_DTE) SSE_SURG_DTE, SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD, SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC, SSP_SURG_SVC_CD FROM CI JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT ON SSE_MRN = APR_MRN AND SSE_SURG_DTE > FIRST_START_DTE JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE ON SSE_LOG_ID = SSP_LOG_ID AND SSE_ENC_CSN_ID = SSP_ENC_CSN_ID JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON PT_MRN = SSE_MRN WHERE SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC like '%BRONCHOSCOPY%' ; WITH CI AS (SELECT APR_MRN, APR_GENERIC_NAME, MIN(APR_START_DTE) FIRST_START_DTE, MAX(APR_START_DTE) LAST_START_DTE FROM IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX JOIN IDB.CHEMO_DRUG_GENERIC ON APR_GENERIC_NAME = CDG_GENERIC_NAME WHERE CDG_BIOLOGIC_IMMUNO_FLAG = 'Y' GROUP BY APR_MRN, APR_GENERIC_NAME), PTS AS (SELECT DISTINCT SSE_MRN MRN FROM CI JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT ON SSE_MRN = APR_MRN AND SSE_SURG_DTE > FIRST_START_DTE JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE ON SSE_LOG_ID = SSP_LOG_ID AND SSE_ENC_CSN_ID = SSP_ENC_CSN_ID WHERE SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC like '%BRONCHOSCOPY%' ) SELECT PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID, AV_DESC AS CASE_STS, YEAR(TM_DX_DTE) TM_DX_DTE, TM_HIST_CD, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS HIST_DESC, TM_SITE_CD, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_DESC FROM PTS JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON PT_MRN = MRN JOIN IDB.CDB_TUMOR ON MRN = TM_MRN JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS ON AV_ELEMENT = 'CASE_STS' AND AV_CODE = TM_CASE_STS AND TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') ; WITH CI AS (SELECT APR_MRN, APR_GENERIC_NAME, MIN(APR_START_DTE) FIRST_START_DTE, MAX(APR_START_DTE) LAST_START_DTE FROM IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX JOIN IDB.CHEMO_DRUG_GENERIC ON APR_GENERIC_NAME = CDG_GENERIC_NAME WHERE CDG_BIOLOGIC_IMMUNO_FLAG = 'Y' GROUP BY APR_MRN, APR_GENERIC_NAME), PTS AS (SELECT DISTINCT SSE_MRN MRN FROM CI JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT ON SSE_MRN = APR_MRN AND SSE_SURG_DTE > FIRST_START_DTE JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE ON SSE_LOG_ID = SSP_LOG_ID AND SSE_ENC_CSN_ID = SSP_ENC_CSN_ID WHERE SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC like '%BRONCHOSCOPY%' ) SELECT PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID , YEAR(APR_START_DTE) APR_START_DTE, APR_GENERIC_NAME, APR_PRESCRIBED_DOSE, APR_ROUTE FROM PTS JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON PT_MRN = MRN JOIN IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX ON MRN= APR_MRN ; WITH CI AS (SELECT APR_MRN, APR_GENERIC_NAME, MIN(APR_START_DTE) FIRST_START_DTE, MAX(APR_START_DTE) LAST_START_DTE FROM IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX JOIN IDB.CHEMO_DRUG_GENERIC ON APR_GENERIC_NAME = CDG_GENERIC_NAME WHERE CDG_BIOLOGIC_IMMUNO_FLAG = 'Y' GROUP BY APR_MRN, APR_GENERIC_NAME), PTS AS (SELECT DISTINCT SSE_MRN MRN FROM CI JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT ON SSE_MRN = APR_MRN AND SSE_SURG_DTE > FIRST_START_DTE JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE ON SSE_LOG_ID = SSP_LOG_ID AND SSE_ENC_CSN_ID = SSP_ENC_CSN_ID WHERE SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC like '%BRONCHOSCOPY%' ) SELECT PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID , RTC_TX_PLAN_NAME, RTC_TX_PLANNED_FRACTIONS, RTC_TX_DELIVERED_FRACTIONS, RTC_TX_PLANNED_DOSE, RTC_TX_DELIVERED_DOSE, YEAR(RTC_TX_START_DTE) RTC_TX_START_DTE, YEAR(RTC_TX_STOP_DTE) RTC_TX_STOP_DTE, RTC_TX_ELAPSED_DAYS, RTC_PRIMARY_REF_POINT, RTC_DOSE_CORRECTION FROM PTS JOIN IDB.RADONC_TREATMENT_COURSE ON RTC_TX_MRN = MRN JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON PT_MRN = MRN ;

prompt: List of pre-surgical testing and GIM appointments in 2018.
completion: WITH PST AS (SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN, CPE_ENC_DTE, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8, CLD_DEPT_NAME, CRE_RES_NAME, CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 = 'PST' AND CLD_DEPT_NAME IN ('BER PST-2', 'MON PST-C', 'BSK PST', 'CMK PST', 'PST WES', 'MON PST-LC') AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN '2018-01-01' AND '2018-12-31' ) , CV AS (SELECT DISTINCT A.CPE_MRN, P.CPE_ENC_DTE DTE, A.CPE_ENC_DTE, C.CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6, C.CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8, C.CLD_DEPT_NAME, B.CRE_RES_NAME, D.CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER A JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE B ON A.CPE_VST_RES_ID = B.CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT C ON A.CPE_DEPT_ID = C.CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE D ON A.CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = D.CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID JOIN PST P ON P.CPE_MRN = A.CPE_MRN WHERE A.CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND C.CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 = 'MED' AND C.CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 = 'GIM' AND P.CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN A.CPE_ENC_DTE - 6 MONTHS AND A.CPE_ENC_DTE + 6 MONTHS AND A.CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN '2017-01-01' AND '2019-12-31' ) , MV AS (SELECT CPE_MRN, CPE_ENC_DTE, SUBSTR(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(CAST(XMLSERIALIZE(CONTENT XMLAGG(XMLELEMENT(NAME "c", CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME || CHR(13) || CHR(10)) ORDER BY CPE_MRN, CPE_ENC_DTE) AS CLOB(32000)) AS VARCHAR(32000)), '<c>', ','), '</c>', ''), '', ''), '', ''), '<c/>', ''), ',', ''), 1) AS AGG_VISIT_TYPE, COUNT(*) AS COUNT FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') GROUP BY CPE_MRN, CPE_ENC_DTE) SELECT A.CPE_MRN "MRN", A.CPE_ENC_DTE "PST Dte", A.CLD_DEPT_NAME "PST Dept", B.CPE_ENC_DTE "Cardiology Dte", B.CLD_DEPT_NAME "Cardiology Dept", B.CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME "Cardiology Visit Type", COUNT "Visits on Cardiology Visit Dte", AGG_VISIT_TYPE "Visit Types" FROM PST A JOIN CV B ON A.CPE_MRN = B.CPE_MRN JOIN MV C ON B.CPE_MRN = C.CPE_MRN AND B.CPE_ENC_DTE = C.CPE_ENC_DTE ORDER BY A.CPE_ENC_DTE, A.CPE_MRN, B.CPE_ENC_DTE ;

prompt: Provide breast physicians with Surgical Pathology Submitted Slides Order and Cytology-Submitted Slides Order.
completion: SELECT DISTINCT OO_MRN MRN, STRIP(PT_LAST_NAME)||', '||PT_FIRST_NAME PT_NAME, OO_ENTER_DTE ENTER_DATE, OO_ORD_ID ORDER_ID, OO_ORD_NAME ORD_NAME, OO_ORD_STS_CD ORD_STATUS, DOC_SVC, SVC SERVICE, DOC_ACDMC_SVC ACDMC_SERVICE, T2.OU_DISPLAY_NAME PROVIDER, T2.OU_ORD_ROLE_TYPE ROLE_TYPE, OP_DISCIPLINE DISCIPLINE, OCV_CURR_LOC ORDER_LOCATION FROM IDB.OMS_ORDER JOIN IDB.OMS_CLIENT_VISIT ON OO_VISIT_GUID = OCV_VISIT_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_SERVICE ON OCV_SVC_GUID = OS_SVC_GUID JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON OO_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.OMS_PROVIDER T1 ON OO_PVDR_GUID = OP_PVDR_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_USER T2 ON OO_PVDR_GUID = T2.OU_USER_GUID LEFT JOIN IDB.DOC ON T1.OP_PVDR_NO = DOC_DR_NO LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_STS_HX ON OO_ORD_GUID = OSH_ORD_GUID AND OSH_FUNCTION_CD = '100' LEFT JOIN (SELECT CPD_RES_ID RES_ID, CLD_DEPT_NAME DEPT_NAME , CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_4 SVC, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_20 CLINIC , ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CPD_RES_ID ORDER BY CPD_CAD_DEPT_INACTIVE_IND, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_15 DESC , CLD_DEPT_ID DESC, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_4) RN FROM IDB.CL_RES_DEPT JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPD_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_4 <> 'MOC') A ON RES_ID = T1.OP_PVDR_NO AND RN = 1 WHERE OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID IN ('3000003594073029', '6000003594073029') AND OO_ORD_STS_CD NOT IN('CANC', 'CANP', 'AUC1', 'AUC3', 'DISC', 'COMP') AND OO_ENTER_DTE BETWEEN (CASE WHEN DAYOFWEEK(CURRENT DATE) = 2 THEN CURRENT DATE - 3 DAY ELSE CURRENT DATE - 1 DAY END) AND CURRENT DATE AND OSH_ORD_GUID IS NULL AND (DOC_SVC IN ('BRE', 'BRM', 'BMS') OR COALESCE(SVC, '') IN ('BRE', 'BRM', 'BMS') ) ;

prompt: Pupillometer was implemented in the NACU and ICU to monitor patients at high risk for neurologically decline and provide early interventions. Since imp
completion: WITH CDD AS (SELECT DISTINCT CD_MRN, CD_SERVICE_DATE, DOC_NAME, DOC_GUID, SECTION_NAME, ITEM_NAME, VALUE_TEXT FROM (SELECT DISTINCT CDD_MRN AS CD_MRN, CDD_SERVICE_DT AS CD_SERVICE_DATE, CDD_DOC_NAME AS DOC_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CDD_MRN, CDD_DOC_GUID ORDER BY CDD_SERVICE_DT ASC) AS ROWNUM, CDD_DOC_GUID AS DOC_GUID, CDO_SECTION AS SECTION_NAME, CDO_ITEM_NAME AS ITEM_NAME, VARCHAR(CDO_VALUE_TEXT, 32000) AS VALUE_TEXT FROM IDB.CD_DOCUMENT LEFT JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION ON CDD_DOC_GUID = CDO_DOC_GUID AND CDD_AUTHORED_DTE = CDO_AUTHORED_DTE AND CDO_VALUE_TEXT <> '' JOIN IDB.OMS_PROVIDER ON CDD_AUTH_PROV_GUID = OP_PVDR_GUID WHERE CDD_CANCEL_IND <> '1' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND <> '1' AND CDD_DOC_NAME = 'Nursing Focused Assessment' AND CDO_SECTION = 'Neurological Check' AND CDD_SERVICE_DTE BETWEEN '2023-10-01' AND CURRENT date -1 DAY AND CDO_VALUE_TEXT <> 'Manual' AND CDO_ITEM_NAME IN ('Pupil Assessment Assessment Method', 'Pupil Assessment Left Pupillometer Neurological Pupil Index (NPi)', 'Pupil Assessment Right Pupillometer Neurological Pupil Index (NPi)', 'Pupil Assessment NPi Difference', 'Pupil Assessment Left Pupil Size (mm)', 'Pupils Assessment Left Pupil Size (mm)', 'Pupils Assessment Right Pupil Size (mm)', 'Pupil Assessment Right Pupil Size (mm)') ) A WHERE ROWNUM = 6 ) SELECT DISTINCT CDD_MRN AS "MRN", CDD_SERVICE_DT AS "Service Date", CDD_DOC_NAME AS "Document Name", OP_DISPLAY_NAME AS "Provider", CDD_DOC_GUID AS "Document Guid", CDO_SECTION AS "Section", CDO_ITEM_NAME AS "Item Name", VARCHAR(CDO_VALUE_TEXT, 32000) AS "Value Text" FROM CDD JOIN IDB.CD_DOCUMENT ON CD_MRN = CDD_MRN AND CDD_SERVICE_DT = CD_SERVICE_DATE AND DOC_GUID = CDD_DOC_GUID LEFT JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION ON CDD_DOC_GUID = CDO_DOC_GUID AND CDD_AUTHORED_DTE = CDO_AUTHORED_DTE AND CDO_VALUE_TEXT <> '' JOIN IDB.OMS_PROVIDER ON CDD_AUTH_PROV_GUID = OP_PVDR_GUID WHERE CDD_CANCEL_IND <> '1' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND <> '1' AND CDO_SECTION = 'Neurological Check' AND CDO_VALUE_TEXT <> 'Manual' AND CDO_ITEM_NAME IN ('Pupil Assessment Assessment Method', 'Pupil Assessment Left Pupillometer Neurological Pupil Index (NPi)', 'Pupil Assessment Right Pupillometer Neurological Pupil Index (NPi)', 'Pupil Assessment NPi Difference', 'Pupil Assessment Left Pupil Size (mm)', 'Pupils Assessment Left Pupil Size (mm)', 'Pupils Assessment Right Pupil Size (mm)', 'Pupil Assessment Right Pupil Size (mm)') ORDER BY CDD_MRN, CDD_SERVICE_DT

prompt: Provide a list of patients consented to specific trials and some information that will help with tracking correlatives.

OMD_ORD_ROUTE ROUTE , OO_ORD_GUID ORD_GUID, OO_REQ_TME_PRIO TIME_PRIORITY , CAST(STRIP(OO_SUMMARY_LINE) AS VARCHAR(500)) SUMMARYLINE , MIN(CASE WHEN OCIT_LEVEL_NO = 0 THEN OOTO_PERF_FROM_DT END) INFUSION_START, OCV_IP_OP_IND IP_OP_IND , CASE WHEN LOWER(OMD_LEN_TIME_CURR_RATE_UOM) LIKE 'h%r%' THEN 60 WHEN LOWER(OMD_LEN_TIME_CURR_RATE_UOM) LIKE 'min%' THEN 1 END * CASE WHEN RTRIM(OMD_LEN_TIME_CURR_RATE) BETWEEN '1' AND '999' THEN INTEGER(RTRIM(OMD_LEN_TIME_CURR_RATE)) ELSE 1 END INF_RATE , MAX(CASE WHEN OCIT_LEVEL_NO = 1 THEN OOTO_PERF_FROM_DT ELSE OOTO_PERF_TO_DT END) OO_ORD_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_USER REQ ON OO_PVDR_GUID = REQ.OU_USER_GUID LEFT JOIN IDB.DOC ON OO_REQ_DR_NO = DOC_DR_NO LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_CATALOG ON OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID = OOC_MSTR_ITEM_GUID LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_ENTRY_FORM ON OO_ENTRY_FRM_GUID = OEF_ENTRY_FRM_GUID JOIN IDB.OAS_ORD_TASK_OCCR ON OOTO_ORD_GUID = OO_ORD_GUID AND OOTO_STATUS_CD = 'Performed' JOIN IDB.OAS_CTLG_ITEM_TASK ON '9000016188200730') AND OO_ORD_TYPE_CD = 'Medication' GROUP BY OO_MRN, OO_ENTER_DTE, OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE, OO_ORD_NAME , OMD_DOSE_UNIT, OCV_CURR_LOC, OCV_IP_OP_IND, OO_ORD_STS_CD , REQ.OU_DISPLAY_NAME, OHI_ONSET_DTE, OHI_RESOLVED_DTE, OHI_SHORT_NAME, OHI_CODE , ABS(DAYS(OHI_ONSET_DTE) - DAYS(START_DATE)) DAYS_TO_MAB , ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY OHI_MRN ORDER BY ABS(DAYS(OHI_ONSET_DTE) - DAYS(START_DATE)), OHI_STS_CD, OHI_CODE) RN1 , ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY OHI_MRN ORDER BY OHI_ONSET_DTE DESC, OHI_STS_CD, OHI_CODE) RN2 FROM IDB.OMS_HEALTH_ISSUE JOIN ORD ON OO_MRN = OHI_MRN WHERE OHI_ONSET_DTE >= START_DATE - 30 DAY AND OHI_TYPE_CD = 'Inf Control' AND OHI_STS_CD IN ('Inactive', 'Active') AND OHI_CODE IN ('ACNCOV', 'DROPQUAR') ) SELECT OO_MRN MRN, STRIP(PT_LAST_NAME)||', '||PT_FIRST_NAME AS PT_NAME, YEAR(START_DATE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) AGE , PT_SEX GENDER, PT_DATE_OF_DEATH AS DECEASED_DATE, PLA_LST_DRVST_DTE LAST_MD_VST_DATE , PLA_LST_KNOWN_ALIVE_DTE LST_KNOWN_ALIVE_DATE, ENTER_DTE, START_DATE, DRUG_NAME, EMAR_DOSE, UOM, ROUTE , ORDID, CURR_LOC, CIS_STATUS, REQUESTER, REQST_ROLE, SETNAME, TIME_PRIORITY, IP_OP_IND, ORD_GUID , VARCHAR_FORMAT(INFUSION_START, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') INFUSION_START , VARCHAR_FORMAT(CASE WHEN INFUSION_END IS NOT NULL AND INFUSION_START <> INFUSION_END THEN INFUSION_END ELSE INFUSION_START + MAX(INF_RATE, 1) MINUTE END, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') INFUSION_END , CASE WHEN INFUSION_END IS NOT NULL AND INFUSION_START <> INFUSION_END THEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(4, CHAR(INFUSION_END - INFUSION_START)) VARCHAR_FORMAT(MAX_RESOLVED_PROBLEM_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') MAX_RESOLVED_PROBLEM_DT , A.OHI_ONSET_DTE MIN_HI_ONSET_DTE, A.OHI_STS_CD MIN_HI_STATUS, A.OHI_SHORT_NAME MIN_HI_SHORT_NAME , LIKE 'D%' THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS HOSP_DEATH_FLAG FROM IDB.VISIT_V JOIN IDB.PATIENT_V ON VIS_MRN=PT_MRN WHERE VIS_ADM_DTE BETWEEN '2023-06-01' AND '2023-12-31' AND VIS_IP_OP_ADJUSTED_IND ='I' AND YEAR(VIS_ADM_DTE-PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) >= 18 AND VIS_VISIT_STATUS IN ('2', '3') ) , ADM_ORDER AS (SELECT OUO_MRN, VIS_ADM_NUM AS OUO_ADM_NUM, OUO_ORD_NAME, OUO_PVDR_NAME, OUO_PVDR_ROLE_TYPE , OUO_ENTER_DT, OUO_ORD_STS_CD, OO_SIGNIFICANT_DT, OUO_CURR_LOC, OUO_VISIT_GUID AS VISIT_GUID, ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY OUO_MRN, VIS_ADM_NUM ORDER BY OUO_ENTER_DT) ORN FROM IDB.OMS_USER_ORDERS JOIN IDB.OMS_ORDER ON OO_ORD_GUID = OUO_ORD_GUID JOIN ADM ON VIS_MRN=OUO_MRN WHERE OUO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID IN ('1000004094073029', '9000004904100730') AND OUO_ENTER_DTE BETWEEN VIS_ADM_DTE-1 DAY AND VIS_DSCH_DTE AND OUO_ORD_STS_CD NOT IN ('CANC', 'CANP', 'AUC3', 'DISC') ) , ORD_LOC AS (SELECT VISIT_GUID LOC_GUID, OUO_ADM_NUM LOC_ADM_NUM , OUO_ENTER_DT LOC_ADMIN , COALESCE(LGR_LOC_NAME, = OL_LOC_GRP_GUID WHERE A.OVL_VISIT_LOC_GUID = (SELECT MAX(B.OVL_VISIT_LOC_GUID) FROM IDB.OMS_VISIT_LOCATION B WHERE A.OVL_VISIT_GUID = B.OVL_VISIT_GUID AND B.OVL_EFF_DT <= ADM_ORDER.OUO_ENTER_DT) AND NULL THEN 'Y' END DNR_FLAG FROM ADM JOIN IDB.EMR_PT_DOC_AUTHV ON VIS_MRN = EPDA_MRN AND EPDA_DOC_DTE BETWEEN VIS_ADM_DTE AND VIS_DSCH_DTE AND EPDA_CATEGORY = 'ADVANCE DIRECTIV' AND EPDA_EMR_DESC LIKE
