CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Sch') AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT DATE AND CURRENT DATE + 28 DAYS AND(CRE_RES_ID IN ('022061', '009480', '014498', '008045', '013011', '022681', '012047', '016949', '018036', '082156', '084806') OR CRE_RES_NAME LIKE '%LAB%BER%' OR CRE_RES_NAME LIKE '%LAB%BSK%' OR CRE_RES_NAME LIKE '%LAB%CMK%' OR CRE_RES_NAME LIKE '%LAB%COMMACK%' OR CRE_RES_NAME LIKE '%LAB%KIMMEL%' OR CRE_RES_NAME LIKE '%LAB%MON%' OR CRE_RES_NAME LIKE '%LAB%NAS%' OR CRE_RES_NAME LIKE '%LAB%WES%') ) , DX AS (SELECT TM_MRN AS MRN, TM_DX_DTE AS DX_DATE, TM_SITE_CD AS DX_CODE, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS DX_DESC FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM H ON TM_HIST_CD = H.CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON TM_SITE_CD = S.CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('3', '6', '7', '8') AND TM_SITE_CD = 'C619' AND TM_MRN IN (SELECT MRN FROM CPE) UNION SELECT CC_MRN AS MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS DX_DATE, CLM_CLSF_CD AS DX_CODE, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS DX_DESC FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND ((CC_PT_TYPE = 'I') OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) AND CC_CLSF_CD IN ('C61', '185') AND CC_MRN IN (SELECT MRN FROM CPE) GROUP BY CC_MRN, CLM_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK ) , X AS (SELECT DISTINCT CPE.* FROM CPE JOIN DX ON CPE.MRN = DX.MRN) , CD AS (SELECT DISTINCT CDD_MRN, CDD_DOC_GUID, CDD_SERVICE_DTE, CDD_DOC_NAME FROM X JOIN IDB.CD_DOCUMENT ON MRN = CDD_MRN AND CDD_CANCEL_IND = '0' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND = '0' AND UPPER(CDD_DOC_NAME) LIKE '%ACTIVE SURVEILLANCE%') SELECT DISTINCT X.*, CASE WHEN CDD_MRN IS NOT NULL THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS "Active Surveillance Note (Y/N)" FROM X LEFT JOIN CD ON MRN = CDD_MRN

prompt: Schedule a daily report of patients eligible for 20-021.
completion: WITH X AS (SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN AS MRN, CPE_CL_PT_ID, CPE_ENC_CSN_ID, STRIP(PT_LAST_NAME) "Last Name", STRIP(PT_FIRST_NAME) AS "First Name", PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH AS DOB, CPE_ENC_DTE AS "Appt Date", TIME(CPE_APPT_DT) AS "Appt Time", STRIP(CRE_RES_NAME) AS "Appt MD", CRE_RES_TYP, CLD_DEPT_NAME "Appt Location", CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8, STRIP(CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR) AS "Appt Type Abbr", STRIP(CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME) AS "Appt Type", CPAN_LINE_NO AS "Appt Note Line No", CPAN_NOTE AS "Appt Note" FROM IDB.PATIENT JOIN IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER ON CPE_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_PT_APPT_NOTES ON CPE_CL_PT_ID = CPAN_CL_PT_ID AND CPE_ENC_DTE_SEQ = CPAN_ENC_DTE_SEQ WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Sch') AND CRE_RES_TYP IN ('Physician') AND CPE_ENC_DTE = CASE WHEN DAYOFWEEK(CURRENT date) = 6 THEN CURRENT date + 3 DAYS ELSE CURRENT date + 1 DAYS END AND YEAR(CPE_ENC_DTE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) BETWEEN 18 AND 75 AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 = 'SRG' AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 IN ('BRE', 'PLA') AND(CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR LIKE '%NV1%' OR CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR LIKE '%NV2%' OR CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR LIKE '%NV3%' OR CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR LIKE '%NV%RISE%' OR CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR LIKE '%CO%' OR CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR LIKE '%FX%' OR CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR LIKE '%FX%RISE%' OR CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR LIKE '%IR1%' OR CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR LIKE '%IR2%' OR CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR LIKE '%IR%RISE%') ) , N AS (SELECT MRN, CPE_CL_PT_ID, CPE_ENC_CSN_ID, LISTAGG(COALESCE("Appt Note Line No", '') || ') ' || COALESCE(TRIM(CAST("Appt Note" AS VARCHAR(12000))), '') , CHR(13) || CHR(10)) WITHIN GROUP( ORDER BY "Appt Note Line No") AS NOTE FROM X GROUP BY MRN, CPE_CL_PT_ID, CPE_ENC_CSN_ID) , Y AS (SELECT X.MRN, X.CPE_CL_PT_ID, X.CPE_ENC_CSN_ID, "Last Name", "First Name", DOB, "Appt Date", "Appt Time", "Appt MD", CRE_RES_TYP, "Appt Location", CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8, "Appt Type Abbr", "Appt Type", NOTE FROM X LEFT JOIN N ON X.MRN = N.MRN AND X.CPE_CL_PT_ID = N.CPE_CL_PT_ID AND X.CPE_ENC_CSN_ID = N.CPE_ENC_CSN_ID) , PBD AS (SELECT DISTINCT PBD_MRN, CLM_CLSF_CD AS CPT_CODE, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS CPT_DESC, PBC_PBD_DESC AS PBD_DESC, PBD_SVC_DTE AS SVC_DATE FROM IDB.PBD_DTL JOIN IDB.PBD_CODE ON PBD_PBD_CD = PBC_PBD_CD JOIN IDB.CLM ON PBC_CPT_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE CLM_CLSF_CD IN ('19307', '38745') ) , Z AS (SELECT DISTINCT Y.* FROM Y WHERE MRN NOT IN (SELECT PBD_MRN FROM PBD) ) SELECT * FROM Z , SCANS AS (SELECT DISTINCT "t1"."PT_MRN" AS "MRN", "t2"."RRPT_ACCESSION_NO" AS "Radiology Accession Number", "t2"."RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE" AS "Radiology Performed Date", "t2"."RRPT_REPORT_DTE" AS "Radiology Report Date", "t2"."RRPT_ORDER_GROUP" AS "Radiology Order Group", "t2"."RRPT_PROCEDURE_NAME" AS "Radiology Procedure Name", UPPER(CASE WHEN LENGTH(RRPT_REPORT_TXT) <= 15000 THEN RTRIM(CAST(SUBSTR(RRPT_REPORT_TXT, 1, 15000) AS VARCHAR(15000))) ELSE CAST(SUBSTR(RRPT_REPORT_TXT, 1, 15000) AS VARCHAR(15000)) END) AS "PRPT_REPORT", REPLACE(UPPER(DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)IMPRESSION:[\w\W]*(?=DICTATED BY:)', RRPT_REPORT_TXT)), 'IMPRESSION:', '') AS IMPRESSION, REPLACE(UPPER(DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)FINDINGS:[\w\W]*(?=IMPRESSION:)', RRPT_REPORT_TXT)), 'FINDINGS:', '') AS FINDINGS, REPLACE(UPPER(DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)OTHER:[\w\W]*(?=IMPRESSION:)', RRPT_REPORT_TXT)), 'OTHER:', '') AS OTHER FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V" "t1" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED" "t3" ON "t1"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t3"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."RADIOLOGY_REPORT_V" "t2" ON "t3"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t2"."RRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_IDENTIFICATION_MRN_V" "t4" ON "t1"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t4"."PI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" WHERE "t4"."PI_SOURCE_SYSTEM_PT_ID" IN (SELECT MRN FROM Z) AND(LOCATE('LYMPH NODE', UPPER(RRPT_REPORT_TXT)) > 0 OR LOCATE('LYMPHADENOPATHY', UPPER(RRPT_REPORT_TXT)) > 0 OR LOCATE('AXILLA', UPPER(RRPT_REPORT_TXT)) > 0) )

prompt: Weekly list of patients aged 40 and over scheduled for an RO SET UP without ECG
completion: WITH ECG AS (SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN ECG_MRN FROM DV.MEDICAL_REPORTS JOIN DV.RESULT_CATALOG_ITEM ON MPRT_RESULT_CATALOG_ITEM_ID = RCI_RESULT_CATALOG_ITEM_ID JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON MRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID WHERE RCI_MASTER_CATEGORY = 'Cardiology' AND RCI_CATEGORY1 = 'ECG' ) SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN AS "MRN", PT_LAST_NAME "Last Name", PT_FIRST_NAME "First Name", YEAR(CPE_ENC_DTE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) "Age at Appt", CPE_ENC_DTE AS "Appt Date", CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 AS "Department", CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 AS "Service", CLD_DEPT_NAME AS "Department Name", CRE_RES_NAME AS "Provider Name", CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME AS "Visit Type" FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON CPE_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Sch') AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT DATE AND CURRENT DATE + 14 DAYS AND YEAR(CPE_ENC_DTE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) >= 40 AND CPE_MRN NOT IN (SELECT * FROM ECG) AND CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME IN ('RO BOOST SETUP-15', 'RO BOOST SETUP-30', 'RO BOOST SETUP-45', 'RO BOOST SETUP-60', 'RO BOOST SETUP-75', 'RO CONE DOWN SETUP-15', 'RO CONE DOWN SETUP-30', 'RO CONE DOWN SETUP-45', 'RO CONE DOWN SETUP-60', 'RO CONE DOWN SETUP-75', 'RO SBRT (1 FX) SETUP&TX-120', 'RO SBRT (1 FX) SETUP&TX-60', 'RO SBRT (1 FX) SETUP&TX-75', 'RO SBRT (1 FX) SETUP&TX-90', 'RO SBRT (<=5 FX) SETUP&TX-120', 'RO SBRT (<=5 FX) SETUP&TX-45', 'RO SBRT (<=5 FX) SETUP&TX-60', 'RO SBRT (<=5 FX) SETUP&TX-75', 'RO SBRT (<=5 FX) SETUP&TX-90', 'RO SETUP BEAM TREAT EXT RT-105', 'RO SETUP BEAM TREAT EXT RT-120', 'RO SETUP BEAM TREAT EXT RT-30', 'RO SETUP BEAM TREAT EXT RT-45', 'RO SETUP BEAM TREAT EXT RT-60', 'RO SETUP BEAM TREAT EXT RT-75', 'RO SETUP BEAM TREAT EXT RT-90', 'RO SETUP FILMS EXT RT-105', 'RO SETUP FILMS EXT RT-120', 'RO SETUP FILMS EXT RT-30', 'RO SETUP FILMS EXT RT-45', 'RO SETUP FILMS EXT RT-60', 'RO SETUP FILMS EXT RT-75', 'RO SETUP FILMS EXT RT-90', 'RO SRS BRAIN(1FX) SETUP&TX-120', 'RO SRS BRAIN(1FX) SETUP&TX-150', 'RO SRS BRAIN(1FX) SETUP&TX-60', 'RO SRS BRAIN(1FX) SETUP&TX-90') ORDER BY 1

prompt: Provide admission data for adult patients admitted for fever/neutropenia.
completion: WITH VISIT_DATA AS (SELECT DISTINCT VIS_ADM_NUM , PT_MRN, VIS_ADM_DT, VIS_ADM_DTE, VIS_DSCH_DTE, PT_LAST_NAME , PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH , ADMITPHYS.DOC_NAME AS ADMIT_DOC_NAME, ATTENDPHYS.DOC_NAME AS ATTEND_DOC_NAME, VIS_VISIT_ID, VIS_DAYS_STAY, VIS_MINUTES_STAY , VIS_HOSP_SVC, UC_HOSP_SVC, RDXD_DX_CD AS DX_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC FROM IDB.RMS_VISIT JOIN IDB.VISIT_V ON RV_VISIT_ID = VIS_VISIT_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.UNIFIED_CENSUS ON VIS_ADM_NUM = UC_ADM_NUM AND UC_SEQ_NO = '1' LEFT JOIN IDB.RMS_ADM_DX ON VIS_VISIT_ID = RAD_VISIT_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.RMS_DX_DICT_DN36 ON RDXD_RECORD_NUMBER = RAD_DX_REC_NO LEFT JOIN IDB.CLM ON RDXD_DX_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON RV_MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.RMS_PATIENT ON RV_PATIENT_ID = RPT_PATIENT_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.DOC ADMITPHYS ON ADMITPHYS.DOC_DR_NO = VIS_ADM_DR_NO LEFT JOIN IDB.DOC ATTENDPHYS ON ATTENDPHYS.DOC_DR_NO = VIS_ATN_DR_NO WHERE 1=1 AND VIS_VISIT_STATUS = '3' AND VIS_IP_OP_ADJUSTED_IND = 'I' AND VIS_ADM_DTE BETWEEN '2019-01-01' AND '2019-12-31' AND VIS_MINUTES_STAY < 2880 AND YEAR(VIS_ADM_DTE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) >= 18 ) , ADMIT_REASON AS (SELECT OO_MRN, OO_ADM_NUM, "Admit Reason" FROM (SELECT DISTINCT OO_MRN, OO_ADM_NUM, STRIP(OUD_USER_DI_VALUE) AS "Admit Reason" , DX_CD FROM VISIT_DATA JOIN IDB.OMS_ORDER ON OO_ADM_NUM = VIS_ADM_NUM JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_USER_DATA ON OO_ORD_GUID = OUD_ORD_GUID WHERE OO_ORD_STS_CD NOT IN ('CANC', 'CANP', 'AUC3') AND OO_ORD_NAME = 'Admit Order' AND OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'Nsg Reason Admission' ) D WHERE 1=1 AND ((LOWER("Admit Reason") like '%fever%' OR LOWER("Admit Reason") like '%neutropenia%' OR LOWER("Admit Reason") like '%neutropenic%') OR DX_CD IN ('D70.9', 'R50.9')) ) , CHEMO AS (SELECT APR_MRN, APR_START_DTE FROM IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX JOIN VISIT_DATA ON PT_MRN = APR_MRN WHERE 1=1 AND APR_START_DTE BETWEEN VIS_ADM_DTE - 21 DAYS AND VIS_ADM_DTE ) SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN "MRN", TIME(VIS_ADM_DT) AS "Admit Time", VIS_ADM_DTE "Admit Date", VIS_DSCH_DTE "Discharge Date", PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH "DOB", VIS_DAYS_STAY "Days Stayed", VIS_MINUTES_STAY "Minutes Stayed", UC_HOSP_SVC "Admitting Service", VIS_HOSP_SVC "Discharge Service", "Admit Reason", DX_CD "Admitting ICD Dx", CLM_CLSF_DESC "Admitting ICD Dx Desc", MAX(APR_START_DTE) AS "Last Chemo Date Prior to Admission" FROM VISIT_DATA JOIN ADMIT_REASON ON OO_ADM_NUM = VIS_ADM_NUM JOIN CHEMO ON PT_MRN = APR_MRN GROUP BY PT_MRN, TIME(VIS_ADM_DT), VIS_ADM_DTE, VIS_DSCH_DTE, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH , VIS_DAYS_STAY, VIS_MINUTES_STAY , VIS_HOSP_SVC, UC_HOSP_SVC, "Admit Reason", DX_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC

prompt: Provide a list of the international patients Dr. Murray Brennan has seen since 2007, sorted by country.
completion: SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, PT_COUNTRY, PT_FC, AV_DESC AS FINANCIAL_CLASS_DESC FROM IDB.PATIENT INNER JOIN IDB.PBD_DTL ON PT_MRN = PBD_MRN INNER JOIN IDB.PBD_INVOICE ON PBD_INV_NO = PBI_INV_NO INNER JOIN IDB.DOC ON PBI_PERFORM_DR_NO = DOC_DR_NO INNER JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS ON AV_ELEMENT = 'FC' AND AV_CODE = PT_FC WHERE DOC_NAME IN ('BRENNAN MURRAY F ') AND PT_COUNTRY <> '' AND PBD_SVC_DTE >= '01/01/2007' ORDER BY PT_COUNTRY, PT_LAST_NAME

prompt: 2017, 2018, 2019, 2020, 2021 dermatology visit data
completion: SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN, CLD_CLD_CENTER, CAV_NAME AS SITE, CLD_DEPT_NAME , CRE_RES_NAME, CRE_RES_ID, CRE_RES_STS, CPE_ENC_DTE , CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR, CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME, CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID, CPE_ENC_CSN_ID , CPE_CPE_APPT_STS FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CRE_RES_ID = CPE_VST_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID JOIN IDB.CL_CATEGORY ON CAV_ABBR = CLD_CLD_CENTER AND CAV_CATEGORY = 'CLD_CENTER' LEFT JOIN IDB.DOC ON CPE_REF_RES_ID = DOC_DR_NO LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_PT_APPT_NOTES ON CPAN_CL_PT_ID = CPE_CL_PT_ID AND CPAN_ENC_DTE_SEQ = CPE_ENC_DTE_SEQ WHERE 1=1 AND CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Comp', 'Arrived') AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN '2017-01-01' AND '2021-12-31' AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 = 'MED' AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 = 'DER'

prompt: Requesting a list all inpatient chemo orders verified by pharmacy between 22:00 and 23:00 in the past year
completion: SELECT CV_ORD_GUID ORDGUID, CV_START_DTE START_DATE, CV_MRN MRN, STRIP(PT_LAST_NAME)||', '||STRIP(PT_FIRST_NAME) PT_NAME, CAO_ORDID ORDID, CV_ORD_NAME ORD_NAME , CAO_DRUG_NAME DRUG_NAME, CAO_DOSE DOSE, CAO_DOSE_UNIT DOSE_UNIT, CAO_MED_FORM MED_FORM, CAO_ROUTE ROUTE, CAO_CHEMO_IND CHEMO_IND, CV_RPH_USER_NAME RPH_NAME, CV_RPH_USER_ROLE RPH_ROLE, CV_SUMMARY_LINE, CV_IP_OP_IND IP_OP, CV_ORD_STS ORDER_STATUS, CV_LOC_NAME LOCATION, DATE(CV_RPH_VERIFIED_DT) RPH_VERIFIED_DATE, TIME(CV_RPH_VERIFIED_DT) RPH_VERIFIED_TIME FROM IDB.CHEMO_VERIFICATIONS JOIN IDB.CHEMO_ALL_ORDERS ON CAO_ORD_GUID = CV_ORD_GUID JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON CV_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE DATE(CV_RPH_VERIFIED_DT) BETWEEN '12/27/2018' AND '12/27/2019' AND TIME(CV_RPH_VERIFIED_DT) BETWEEN '22:00:00' AND '23:00:00' AND CAO_CHEMO_IND = 'Y' AND CV_IP_OP_IND = 'I' ORDER BY CV_LOC_NAME, CV_RPH_VERIFIED_DT, CV_MRN

prompt: Provide a list of MSK patients who have EDER, SCOTT [22209] listed as an external provider.  Provider dates of when faxes were sent to external provider Dr. Scott Eder for above  patients and if possible fax number used.
completion: SELECT DISTINCT CDD_MRN MRN, PT_LAST_NAME LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME FIRST_NAME, CDD_SERVICE_DTE SERVICE_DATE, CDD_DOC_NAME DOC_NAME, CDO_CTLG_DISPL_NM SECTION, CDO_ITEM_NAME ITEM, CDO_VALUE_TEXT VALUE FROM IDB.CD_DOCUMENT JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION ON CDO_DOC_GUID = CDD_DOC_GUID AND CDO_AUTHORED_DTE = CDD_AUTHORED_DTE JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON CDD_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE CDD_CANCEL_IND = '0' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND = '0' AND CDO_CTLG_DISPL_NM = 'Fax to External MDs' AND CDO_VALUE_TEXT <> '' AND CDO_VALUE_TEXT <> 'External provider info is not available' AND CDO_VALUE_TEXT like '%EDER, SCOTT%'

prompt: List of patients referred to Dr. Guyer via Allergy and Immunology Outpatient Consult Request CIS order with oxaliplatin, platinum, or platin in other reason field of CIS order.
completion: WITH X AS (SELECT DISTINCT OO_MRN MRN, OO_ENTER_DTE, OO_ORD_ID, OO_ORD_GUID, OO_ORD_NAME, OFF_FLD_LABEL AS FLD_LABEL1, OO_ENTRY_FRM_GUID, D1.OUD_USER_DI_CD AS DI_CD1, D1.OUD_USER_DI_VALUE AS DI_VALUE1 FROM IDB.OMS_ORDER JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_FORM_FIELD ON OFF_ENTRY_FRM_GUID = OO_ENTRY_FRM_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_USER_DATA D1 ON OO_ORD_GUID = D1.OUD_ORD_GUID AND OFF_DI_CD = D1.OUD_USER_DI_CD WHERE OO_ORD_STS_CD NOT IN ('CANC', 'CANP', 'AUC3') AND UPPER(OO_ORD_NAME) LIKE '%ALLERGY%AND%IMMUNOLOGY%REQUEST%' ), ORD AS (SELECT DISTINCT OO_MRN, OUD_USER_DI_CD, OUD_USER_DI_VALUE FROM X LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_ORDER T ON MRN = OO_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_USER_DATA ON OUD_ORD_GUID = T.OO_ORD_GUID WHERE T.OO_ORD_STS_CD NOT IN ('CANC', 'CANP', 'AUC3') AND UPPER(T.OO_ORD_NAME) LIKE '%ALLERGY%AND%IMMUNOLOGY%REQUEST%' AND (LOWER(OUD_USER_DI_VALUE) LIKE '%oxaliplatin%' OR LOWER(OUD_USER_DI_VALUE) LIKE '%platin%' OR LOWER(OUD_USER_DI_VALUE) LIKE '%platinum%') ) SELECT DISTINCT X.*, TRIM(PT_LAST_NAME)||', '||TRIM(PT_FIRST_NAME) AS "PATIENT NAME", PFA_FST_ACTV_DTE FIRST_ACTIVITY_DATE, PFA_FST_APPT_DTE FIRST_APPT_DATE FROM X JOIN ORD ON MRN = OO_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.PT_FIRST_ACTIVITY ON MRN = PFA_MRN

prompt: Request of patients seen/treated in the Leukemia Service with BR/R B-Cell ALL over the last 12 months
completion: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CC_MRN) FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER ON CC_MRN = CPE_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE SUBSTR(CC_CLSF_CD, 1, 5) IN ('204.0', 'C91.0') AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CPE_ENC_DTE >= CURRENT date - 1 YEAR AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 = 'LEU'

prompt: Request data to provide clinical director with CT patient volume for Rad Onc MD for licensing purposes.
completion: WITH APPOINTMENTS_0 AS (SELECT "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AS PT_DEID, CL_PT_ENCOUNTER."CPE_ENC_CSN_ID" AS SUBJECT_ID, CL_PT_ENCOUNTER."CPE_ENC_DTE" AS APPT_DATE, CL_PT_ENCOUNTER."CPE_CPE_APPT_STS" AS APPT_STATUS, CL_VISIT_TYPE_AT."CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME" AS APPT_TYPE_NAME FROM "IDB"."CL_PT_ENCOUNTER" AS CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS" ON CL_PT_ENCOUNTER."CPE_MRN" = "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_MRN" AND "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_MRN" != '' AND "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_MRN" IS NOT NULL JOIN "IDB"."CL_VISIT_TYPE" AS CL_VISIT_TYPE_AT ON CL_PT_ENCOUNTER."CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID" = CL_VISIT_TYPE_AT."CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID" WHERE CL_PT_ENCOUNTER."CPE_ENC_DTE" BETWEEN CURRENT_DATE - 1 YEARS AND CURRENT_DATE AND CL_PT_ENCOUNTER."CPE_CPE_APPT_STS" IN ('Comp', 'Arrived') AND CL_VISIT_TYPE_AT."CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME" IN ('RO POST-TX VISIT', 'RO POST-TX VISIT-PHONE', 'RO POST-TX VISIT-VIDEO') ), COHORT AS (SELECT PT_DEID AS PT_DEID FROM (SELECT APPOINTMENTS_0.PT_DEID AS PT_DEID FROM APPOINTMENTS_0)), COHORT_APPOINTMENTS AS (SELECT SUBJECT_ID AS SUBJECT_ID, PT_DEID AS PT_DEID FROM (SELECT APPOINTMENTS_0.SUBJECT_ID AS SUBJECT_ID, APPOINTMENTS_0.PT_DEID AS PT_DEID FROM APPOINTMENTS_0)), KEYS AS (SELECT COHORT.PT_DEID AS COHORT_PT_DEID, COHORT_APPOINTMENTS.SUBJECT_ID AS COHORT_APPOINTMENTS_SUBJECT_ID, COHORT_APPOINTMENTS.PT_DEID AS COHORT_APPOINTMENTS_PT_DEID FROM COHORT LEFT OUTER JOIN COHORT_APPOINTMENTS ON COHORT_APPOINTMENTS.PT_DEID = COHORT.PT_DEID), APPOINTMENTS_COLUMNS AS (SELECT DISTINCT "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AS PT_DEID, CL_PT_ENCOUNTER."CPE_ENC_CSN_ID" AS SUBJECT_ID, CL_RESOURCE_PROV."CRE_RES_NAME" AS PROVIDER, CL_PT_ENCOUNTER."CPE_ENC_DTE" AS APPT_DATE, CL_DEPT_DEPT_NAME."CLD_DEPT_NAME" AS DEPT_NAME, CL_CATEGORY_DPT_CAT."CAV_NAME" AS DEPARTMENT, CL_VISIT_TYPE_AT."CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME" AS APPT_TYPE_NAME FROM "IDB"."CL_PT_ENCOUNTER" AS CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS" ON CL_PT_ENCOUNTER."CPE_MRN" = "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_MRN" AND "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_MRN" != '' AND "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_MRN" IS NOT NULL JOIN "IDB"."CL_RESOURCE" AS CL_RESOURCE_PROV ON CL_PT_ENCOUNTER."CPE_VST_RES_ID" = CL_RESOURCE_PROV."CRE_RES_ID" JOIN "IDB"."CL_DEPT" AS CL_DEPT_DEPT_NAME ON CL_PT_ENCOUNTER."CPE_DEPT_ID" = CL_DEPT_DEPT_NAME."CLD_DEPT_ID" JOIN "IDB"."CL_DEPT" AS CL_DEPT_DEPT ON CL_PT_ENCOUNTER."CPE_DEPT_ID" = CL_DEPT_DEPT."CLD_DEPT_ID" LEFT OUTER JOIN "IDB"."CL_CATEGORY" AS CL_CATEGORY_DPT_CAT ON CL_DEPT_DEPT."CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6" = CL_CATEGORY_DPT_CAT."CAV_ABBR" AND CL_CATEGORY_DPT_CAT."CAV_CATEGORY" = 'CLD_RPT_GRP_6' JOIN "IDB"."CL_VISIT_TYPE" AS CL_VISIT_TYPE_AT ON CL_PT_ENCOUNTER."CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID" = CL_VISIT_TYPE_AT."CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID"), DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS AS (SELECT DISTINCT "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AS PT_DEID, IDB_PATIENT."PT_MRN" AS PT_MRN, "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AS SUBJECT_ID FROM "IDB"."PATIENT" AS IDB_PATIENT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS" ON IDB_PATIENT."PT_MRN" = "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_MRN") SELECT DISTINCT DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS.PT_DEID AS PT_DEID, APPOINTMENTS_COLUMNS.PROVIDER AS APPT_PROVIDER, APPOINTMENTS_COLUMNS.APPT_DATE AS APPT_DATE, APPOINTMENTS_COLUMNS.DEPT_NAME AS APPT_DEPARTMENT, APPOINTMENTS_COLUMNS.DEPARTMENT AS APPT_DEPARTMENT_GRP6, APPOINTMENTS_COLUMNS.APPT_TYPE_NAME AS APPT_TYPE FROM KEYS LEFT OUTER JOIN APPOINTMENTS_COLUMNS ON APPOINTMENTS_COLUMNS.SUBJECT_ID = KEYS.COHORT_APPOINTMENTS_SUBJECT_ID LEFT OUTER JOIN DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS ON DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS.PT_DEID = KEYS.COHORT_PT_DEID; WITH APPOINTMENTS_0 AS (SELECT "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AS PT_DEID, CL_PT_ENCOUNTER."CPE_ENC_CSN_ID" AS SUBJECT_ID, CL_PT_ENCOUNTER."CPE_ENC_DTE" AS APPT_DATE, CL_PT_ENCOUNTER."CPE_CPE_APPT_STS" AS APPT_STATUS, CL_VISIT_TYPE_AT."CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME" AS APPT_TYPE_NAME FROM "IDB"."CL_PT_ENCOUNTER" AS CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS" ON CL_PT_ENCOUNTER."CPE_MRN" = "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_MRN" AND "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_MRN" != '' AND "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_MRN" IS NOT NULL JOIN "IDB"."CL_VISIT_TYPE" AS CL_VISIT_TYPE_AT ON CL_PT_ENCOUNTER."CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID" = CL_VISIT_TYPE_AT."CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID" WHERE CL_PT_ENCOUNTER."CPE_ENC_DTE" BETWEEN CURRENT_DATE - 1 YEARS AND CURRENT_DATE AND CL_PT_ENCOUNTER."CPE_CPE_APPT_STS" IN ('Comp', 'Arrived') AND CL_VISIT_TYPE_AT."CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME" IN ('RO POST-TX VISIT', 'RO POST-TX VISIT-PHONE', 'RO POST-TX VISIT-VIDEO') ), COHORT AS (SELECT PT_DEID AS PT_DEID FROM (SELECT APPOINTMENTS_0.PT_DEID AS PT_DEID FROM APPOINTMENTS_0)), COHORT_APPOINTMENTS AS (SELECT SUBJECT_ID AS SUBJECT_ID, PT_DEID AS PT_DEID FROM (SELECT APPOINTMENTS_0.SUBJECT_ID AS SUBJECT_ID, APPOINTMENTS_0.PT_DEID AS PT_DEID FROM APPOINTMENTS_0)), KEYS AS (SELECT COHORT.PT_DEID AS COHORT_PT_DEID, COHORT_APPOINTMENTS.SUBJECT_ID AS COHORT_APPOINTMENTS_SUBJECT_ID, COHORT_APPOINTMENTS.PT_DEID AS COHORT_APPOINTMENTS_PT_DEID FROM COHORT LEFT OUTER JOIN COHORT_APPOINTMENTS ON COHORT_APPOINTMENTS.PT_DEID = COHORT.PT_DEID), DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS AS (SELECT DISTINCT "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AS PT_DEID, IDB_PATIENT."PT_MRN" AS PT_MRN, "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AS SUBJECT_ID, "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_STATE" AS PT_STATE, DMP_ID_TBL."PDRX_DMP_PATIENT_ID" AS DMP_ID FROM "IDB"."PATIENT" AS IDB_PATIENT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS" ON IDB_PATIENT."PT_MRN" = "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_MRN" LEFT OUTER JOIN "DV"."PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML" AS DMP_ID_TBL ON DMP_ID_TBL."PDRX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID") SELECT DISTINCT DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS.PT_DEID AS PT_DEID, DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS.PT_STATE AS PT_STATE FROM KEYS LEFT OUTER JOIN DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS ON DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS.PT_DEID = KEYS.COHORT_PT_DEID;

prompt: cfDNA draws for patients enrolled on protocol 18-002 and 12-245.
completion: WITH USER_DATA AS (SELECT OUD_ORD_GUID, MAX(TRIM(CASE WHEN OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'Lab_Specimen Collected' THEN OUD_USER_DI_VALUE END)) "Specimen Collected", MAX(TRIM(CASE WHEN OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'Lab_Specimen Collected On' THEN OUD_USER_DI_VALUE END)) "Collected On", MAX(TRIM(CASE WHEN OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'Lab_Specimen Drawn By' THEN OUD_USER_DI_VALUE END)) "Drawn By", MAX(TRIM(CASE WHEN OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'LBC_INST' THEN OUD_USER_DI_VALUE END)) "LBC INST", MAX(TRIM(CASE WHEN OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'LBRZ_cfTUBID' THEN OUD_USER_DI_VALUE END)) "cfTUBID", MAX(TRIM(CASE WHEN OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'Requested For' THEN OUD_USER_DI_VALUE END)) "Requested For" FROM IDB.OMS_ORD_USER_DATA JOIN IDB.OMS_ORDER ON OO_ORD_GUID = OUD_ORD_GUID WHERE OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID = '9000010830200730' AND OO_ORD_STS_CD NOT IN ('CANP', 'CANC', 'AUC3') GROUP BY OUD_ORD_GUID ) SELECT DISTINCT OOC_ITEM_NAME "Order Item", OO_MRN "MRN", PT_LAST_NAME "Last Name", PT_FIRST_NAME "First Name", OO_ENTER_DTE "Order Enter Date", OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE "Requested For", "Collected On", OSTS_STS_DESC "Status", OU_DISPLAY_NAME "Entered By", OP_DISPLAY_NAME "Provider", "Specimen Collected", "Drawn By", "LBC INST" FROM IDB.OMS_ORDER JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_CATALOG ON OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID = OOC_MSTR_ITEM_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_STATUS ON OO_ORD_STS_CD = OSTS_ORD_STS_CD JOIN IDB.OMS_USER ON OO_USER_GUID = OU_USER_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_PROVIDER ON OO_PVDR_GUID = OP_PVDR_GUID JOIN USER_DATA ON OO_ORD_GUID = OUD_ORD_GUID JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON OO_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID = '9000010830200730' AND OO_ORD_STS_CD NOT IN ('CANP', 'CANC', 'AUC3') AND OO_MRN IN ('38001927', '35589409', '38022991', '35501991', '00032834', '38027037', '38037096', '38101243', '38071684', '38087059') ORDER BY OO_MRN, OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE

prompt: Provide pathology and demographic data for 'heme' reports matching specific search terms.
completion: SELECT DISTINCT DMP.PRPT_MRN AS MRN , PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_BIRTH_DTE, PT_VITAL_STATUS, PT_DEATH_DTE , CASE WHEN PT_DEATH_DTE IS NULL THEN YEAR(CURRENT date - PT_BIRTH_DTE) END AS "Current Age" , DMP.PRPT_ACCESSION_NO AS "Accession No" , DMP.PRPT_REPORT_DTE AS "Report Date" , DMP.PRPT_PROCEDURE_DTE AS "Procedure Date" , SRG.PRPT_ACCESSION_NO AS RELATED_ACC_NO , SRG.PRPT_PROCEDURE_DTE AS RELATED_PROC_DTE , DMP.PRPT_REPORT_TYPE_DESC AS "Report Type" , DMP.PRPT_REPORT_TYPE , DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)diag[\w\W]*(?=I ATTEST)', DMP.PRPT_REPORT) AS DIAGNOSIS_TEXT , VARCHAR(DMP.PRPT_REPORT, 32000) AS "Report Text (first 32000 characters)" , (SELECT VARCHAR(PRPT_REPORT, 32000) AS REFERENCEDPATHTEXTFROM FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V WHERE PRPT_ACCESSION_NO = SRG.PRPT_ACCESSION_NO) AS REFERENCEDPATHTEXT FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V DMP LEFT JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_REFERENCES ON PRPTR_CHILD_PATH_RPT_ID = DMP.PRPT_PATH_RPT_ID LEFT JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V SRG ON SRG.PRPT_PATH_RPT_ID = PRPTR_PATH_RPT_ID JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = DMP.PRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID WHERE 1=1 AND SUBSTR(DMP.PRPT_ACCESSION_NO, 1, 1) = 'H' AND (DMP.PRPT_REPORT_DTE >= '11/01/2020' OR DMP.PRPT_PROCEDURE_DTE >= '11/01/2020' ) AND CONTAINS(DMP.PRPT_REPORT, '("myelodysplastic syndrome" OR "MDS")') = 1 AND DMP.PRPT_REPORT IS NOT NULL ORDER BY 1, 9, 8 ;

prompt: We would like to receive a list of patients (full name) ever seen by someone in the Dermatology Service (across locations/sites).
completion: WITH INIT AS (SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN AS "MRN", CPE_ENC_DTE AS "Appt Date", CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 AS "Department", CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 AS "Service", CLD_DEPT_NAME AS "Department Name", CRE_RES_NAME AS "Provider Name", ROWNUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY CPE_MRN ORDER BY CPE_ENC_DTE DESC) RN FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND (CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 = 'DER' OR CLD_DEPT_NAME LIKE '%DERM%' OR CLD_DEPT_NAME LIKE '%HAU NURSING%') ) SELECT DISTINCT "MRN", PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_LAST_NAME, R.AV_DESC AS "Race", E.AV_DESC AS "Ethnicity" , CR.AV_DESC AS "Race (CDB)" , CE.AV_DESC AS "Ethnicity (CDB)", "Appt Date" AS LAST_APP_DATE, "Department", "Service", "Department Name", "Provider Name" SEEN_PROVIDER_NAME FROM INIT LEFT JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON "MRN" = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS R ON PT_RACE = R.AV_CODE AND R.AV_ELEMENT = 'RACE' LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS E ON PT_PT_ETHNICITY = E.AV_CODE AND E.AV_ELEMENT = 'PT_ETHNICITY' LEFT JOIN IDB.CDB_PATIENT ON PT_MRN = CP_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS CR ON CR.AV_ELEMENT = 'CDB_RACE' AND CR.AV_CODE = CP_CDB_RACE LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS CE ON CE.AV_ELEMENT = 'ETHNICITY' AND CE.AV_CODE = CP_ETHNICITY WHERE RN=1

prompt: Provide a list of pediatric patients with leptomeningeal cancer seen at MSK from 1/1/2010-12/31/2019
completion: WITH DX AS (SELECT CC_MRN, CC_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) MIN_EFF_DTE FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE (CC_CLSF_CD IN ('C70.1', '192.3', '198.4', 'C79.32', 'C79.40', 'C79.49')) AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND (CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) GROUP BY CC_MRN, CC_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK HAVING MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) BETWEEN '2010-01-01' AND '2019-12-31') SELECT CC_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, YEAR(MIN_EFF_DTE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) "Age at Dx", CC_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK, MIN_EFF_DTE FROM DX JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON CC_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE YEAR(MIN_EFF_DTE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) <= 21

prompt: Provide the count of inpatient blood glucose test results between 0 and 60 performed in 2008.
completion: SELECT LR_RESULT_VALUE, COUNT(*) AS RESULT_COUNT FROM IDB.LAB_RESULTS WHERE ((LR_TEST_NAME = 'Glucose (BEDSIDE)' AND LR_SUBTEST_NAME = 'Glucose (BEDSIDE)') OR (LR_TEST_NAME = 'Glucose, Whole Blood' AND LR_SUBTEST_NAME = 'Glucose, Whole Blood') OR (LR_TEST_NAME = 'Basic Metabolic Panel, Whole Blood' AND LR_SUBTEST_NAME = 'Glucose, Whole Blood') OR (LR_TEST_NAME = 'Basic Metabolic Panel' AND LR_SUBTEST_NAME = 'Glucose') OR (LR_TEST_NAME = 'Comprehensive Metabolic Panel' AND LR_SUBTEST_NAME = 'Glucose') OR (LR_TEST_NAME = 'Comp. Metabolic Panel & Conj Bilirubin' AND LR_SUBTEST_NAME = 'Glucose') OR (LR_TEST_NAME = 'Glucose' AND LR_SUBTEST_NAME = 'Glucose') OR (LR_TEST_NAME = 'Glucose, Fasting' AND LR_SUBTEST_NAME = 'Glucose, Fasting') OR (LR_TEST_NAME = 'Glucose 2 Hour' AND LR_SUBTEST_NAME = 'Glucose 2 Hour')) AND LR_PERFORMED_DTE BETWEEN '2008-01-01' AND '2008-12-31' AND (LR_ACCT_NO like '00%' OR LR_ACCT_NO like '84%') GROUP BY LR_RESULT_VALUE

prompt: Patients seen in the Ambulatory Infusion Setting who had a Medical Emergency Response called after 5pm. De-identified data is great.
completion: SELECT DISTINCT CDD_SERVICE_DT AS "Service Date", CDD_DOC_NAME AS "Document Name", CDO_ITEM_NAME AS "Item", CDO_VALUE_TEXT AS "Value Text" FROM IDB.CD_DOCUMENT LEFT JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION ON CDD_DOC_GUID = CDO_DOC_GUID AND CDD_AUTHORED_DTE = CDO_AUTHORED_DTE AND CDO_VALUE_TEXT <> '' WHERE CDD_CANCEL_IND <> '1' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND <> '1' AND CDD_DOC_NAME = 'Assessment, Medical Emergency Response Team' AND CDD_SERVICE_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT DATE -6 MONTH AND CURRENT DATE -1 DAY AND TIME(CDD_SERVICE_DT) BETWEEN '17:00' AND '23:59' AND UPPER(CDO_VALUE_TEXT) LIKE '%INFUSION%'

prompt: Design a bi-monthly report of all IR patients, at main campus and Koch, showing if they had a Pre-Procedure and Post-Procedure Assessment in the Nursing Perioperative Flowsheet document.
completion: WITH IR AS (SELECT VIS_MRN, VIS_ADM_NUM, VIS_DTE, VIS_PATIENT_TYPE, VIS_HOSP_SVC, VIS_NURS_STA, NURS_STA_DESC FROM IDB.VISIT_V WHERE 1=1 AND VIS_ADM_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT date - 14 DAYS AND CURRENT date - 1 DAY AND VIS_HOSP_SVC = 'IR' AND(VIS_NURS_STA IN ('AUCH', 'K08', 'KOCH', 'MAIN', 'OUCC', 'UCCO', 'UCDU') OR VIS_NURS_STA like 'M%' OR VIS_NURS_STA like 'NS%') AND VIS_NURS_STA not like '%MON%' AND VIS_NURS_STA not like '%NAS%' AND VIS_NURS_STA not like '%BSK%' AND VIS_NURS_STA not like '%CMK%' AND VIS_NURS_STA not like '%WES%' AND VIS_PATIENT_TYPE <> 'OP' ) , CD AS (SELECT CDD_MRN, CDD_SERVICE_DTE, MAX(CASE WHEN CDO_VALUE_TEXT = 'IR - Immediate Pre-Procedure Assessment' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END) AS "Pre-Procedure Assessment", MAX(CASE WHEN CDO_VALUE_TEXT = 'IR - Immediate Post-Procedure Assessment' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END) AS "Post-Procedure Assessment" FROM (SELECT CDD_MRN, CDD_DOC_GUID, CDD_SERVICE_DTE, TIME(CDD_SERVICE_DT) AS CDD_SERVICE_TIME, CDD_DOC_NAME, CDO_SECTION, CDO_CTLG_DISPL_NM, CDO_MSTR_ITEM_NM, CDO_ITEM_NAME, CDO_VALUE_TEXT FROM IDB.CD_DOCUMENT JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION ON CDO_DOC_GUID = CDD_DOC_GUID AND CDO_AUTHORED_DTE = CDD_AUTHORED_DTE WHERE CDD_CANCEL_IND = '0' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND = '0' AND CDD_DOC_NAME LIKE '%Nursing Perioperative Flowsheet%' AND CDO_MSTR_ITEM_NM = 'PSC_NUR Type of Assessment RES' AND CDO_VALUE_TEXT IN ('IR - Immediate Pre-Procedure Assessment', 'IR - Immediate Post-Procedure Assessment') AND CDD_SERVICE_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT date - 14 DAYS AND CURRENT date - 1 DAY ) N GROUP BY CDD_MRN, CDD_SERVICE_DTE) SELECT STRIP(VIS_MRN) AS VIS_MRN, VIS_ADM_NUM, VIS_DTE, STRIP(VIS_PATIENT_TYPE) AS VIS_PATIENT_TYPE, STRIP(VIS_HOSP_SVC) AS VIS_HOSP_SVC, STRIP(VIS_NURS_STA) AS VIS_NURS_STA, STRIP(NURS_STA_DESC) AS NURS_STA_DESC, MAX(CASE WHEN "Pre-Procedure Assessment" IS NULL THEN 'N' ELSE "Pre-Procedure Assessment" END) AS "Pre-Procedure Assessment", MAX(CASE WHEN "Post-Procedure Assessment" IS NULL THEN 'N' ELSE "Post-Procedure Assessment" END) AS "Post-Procedure Assessment" FROM IR LEFT JOIN CD ON VIS_MRN = CDD_MRN AND VIS_DTE = CDD_SERVICE_DTE GROUP BY VIS_MRN, VIS_ADM_NUM, VIS_DTE, VIS_PATIENT_TYPE, VIS_HOSP_SVC, VIS_NURS_STA, NURS_STA_DESC

prompt: Requesting daily report of IR Referral Orders for Needle Biopsy - Liver Procedure and OPTIME scheduled procedures similar to RAD14542
completion: SELECT DISTINCT MRN , DATE(CURRENT DATE -5 DAYS) AS START_DATE, CURRENT date AS END_DATE FROM (SELECT DISTINCT MRN FROM (SELECT OO_MRN MRN, OO_ORD_GUID GUID, STRIP(PT_LAST_NAME)||', '||STRIP(PT_FIRST_NAME) AS PT_NAME, MAX(CASE WHEN OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'RIS_IR-Procedure' THEN OUD_USER_DI_VALUE END) AS PROC_NAME, MAX(CASE WHEN OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'RIS_IR-Biopsy Location' THEN OUD_USER_DI_VALUE END) AS BIOPSY_LOCATION FROM IDB.OMS_ORDER JOIN IDB.OMS_USER ON OU_USER_GUID = OO_USER_GUID JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON OO_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_USER_DATA A ON OO_ORD_GUID = OUD_ORD_GUID AND OO_ORD_NAME = 'IR - Referral' AND UPPER(OO_SUMMARY_LINE) LIKE '%BIOPSY%' WHERE OO_ENTER_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT DATE -5 DAYS AND CURRENT date AND OO_ORD_STS_CD NOT IN ('CANP', 'CANC') GROUP BY OO_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, OO_ORD_GUID) AS IRREF WHERE UPPER(BIOPSY_LOCATION) LIKE '%LIVER%' UNION ALL SELECT DISTINCT OC_MRN AS MRN FROM IDB.OR_CASE JOIN IDB.OR_CASE_ALL_PROC ON OC_CASE_ID= OCAP_CASE_ID JOIN IDB.CL_PATIENT PAT ON OC_MRN=CL_MRN JOIN IDB.OR_PROC ON OCAP_OR_PROC_ID= OP_OR_PROC_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ROOM ON OC_ROOM_RES_ID=ROOM.CRE_RES_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE REF ON OC_REF_RES_ID=REF.CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.OR_CASE_ALL_SURG ON OCAS_CASE_ID= OCAP_CASE_ID AND OCAS_PNL_NO = OCAP_PNL_NO LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE PERF ON OCAS_RES_ID=PERF.CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.OR_CL_PROC ON OP_OR_PROC_ID= OCP_OR_PROC_ID JOIN IDB.CL_PROC ON OCP_PROC_ID=CPX_PROC_ID JOIN IDB.CL_LOCATION ON OC_SURG_LOC_ID = LOC_LOC_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE USR ON OC_REQST_USER_ID=USR.CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_USER ON CLE_USER_ID = OC_CR_USER_ID WHERE OC_SURG_SVC = 'IR' AND OC_REC_CR_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT DATE - 5 DAY AND CURRENT DATE AND (UPPER(OP_PROC_DESC) IN('LIVER BIOPSY')) AND OC_OR_CASE_STS NOT IN ('5', '2') ) AS A

prompt: A one time report listing patients who have more than one  room in encounter on the same day in the Chemo department.
completion: WITH RES AS (SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN AS "MRN", CPE_ENC_DTE AS "Appt Date", CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 AS "Department", CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 AS "Service", CLD_DEPT_NAME AS "Department Name", CRE_RES_NAME AS "Provider Name", CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME AS "Visit Type", DATE(AEIEI_EVENT_DT) AS EVENT_DATE, AEIEI_EVENT_DISPLAY_NAME, AEIEI_EVENT_COMMENTS, AEIEI_EVENT_USER_ID FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID JOIN IDB.AN_ED_IEV_PAT_INFO ON AEIPI_ENC_CSN_ID = CPE_ENC_CSN_ID JOIN IDB.AN_ED_IEV_EVENT_INFO ON AEIEI_EVENT_ID = AEIPI_EVENT_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND UPPER(AEIEI_EVENT_DISPLAY_NAME) LIKE '%ROOM IN%' AND CLD_DEPT_NAME = 'CMK CHEMO' ORDER BY CPE_ENC_DTE), RES1 AS (SELECT "MRN", "Appt Date", "Department", "Service", "Department Name", "Provider Name", "Visit Type", AEIEI_EVENT_USER_ID, EVENT_DATE, AEIEI_EVENT_DISPLAY_NAME, AEIEI_EVENT_COMMENTS, COUNT("Appt Date") OVER (PARTITION BY "MRN", "Appt Date") AS CNT FROM RES) SELECT "MRN", "Appt Date", "Department", "Service", "Department Name", "Provider Name", "Visit Type", AEIEI_EVENT_USER_ID AS "AEIEI Event User ID", EVENT_DATE AS "AEIEI Event Date", AEIEI_EVENT_DISPLAY_NAME AS "AEIEI Event Display Name", AEIEI_EVENT_COMMENTS AS "AEIEI Event Comments" FROM RES1 WHERE CNT > 1

prompt: List of patients with Burkitt's lymphoma diagnosed from year 2000 to present.
completion: WITH CLINTRAC AS (SELECT CC_MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS MIN_ICD9_EFF_DTE FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE SUBSTR(CC_CLSF_CD, 1, 5) IN ('C83.7', '200.2') AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND (CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) AND CC_EFF_DTE >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY CC_MRN ) , TUMOR AS (SELECT DISTINCT TM_MRN, TM_DX_DTE, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK, TM_BEST_AJCC_STG AS STAGE FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS ON AV_ELEMENT = 'CASE_STS' AND AV_CODE = TM_CASE_STS AND TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND TM_HIST_CD = 'M9687/3' WHERE TM_DX_DTE >= '2000-01-01' ) , PATH AS (SELECT PRPT_MRN, PRPT_PROCEDURE_DTE, PRPT_REPORT_DTE, PRPT_REPORT_TYPE_DESC, PRPT_ACCESSION_NO, PRPT_REPORT, PRPT_ORD_DR_NAME, PRPT_ORD_DR_SVC_DESC, DV.REGEXSTR('(?<=1\) )([^:]+)|(?<=1.2\) )([^:]+)|(?<=1.3\) )([^:]+)|(?<=1\. )([^:]+)', PRPT_REPORT) "Biopsy Location" FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V WHERE CONTAINS("PRPT_REPORT", '("BURKITT" | "burkitt" | "Burkitt" | "BURKIT" | "burkit" | "Burkit")') = 1 AND PRPT_REPORT_TYPE_DESC = 'Surgical Pathology' AND PRPT_REPORT IS NOT NULL ) , RADONC AS (SELECT RTC_TX_MRN, RTC_TX_COURSE_NO, RTC_TX_PLANSETUP_NO, RTC_TX_COURSE_ID, RTC_TX_PLAN_NAME, RTC_TX_PLANNED_FRACTIONS, RTC_TX_DELIVERED_FRACTIONS, RTC_TX_PLANNED_DOSE, RTC_TX_DELIVERED_DOSE, RTC_TX_START_DTE, RTC_TX_STOP_DTE, RTC_TX_ELAPSED_DAYS, RTC_PRIMARY_REF_POINT, RTC_DOSE_CORRECTION FROM IDB.RADONC_TREATMENT_COURSE) , IMPACT AS (SELECT PT_MRN AS I_MRN, PRPT_ACCESSION_NO AS I_ACCESSION, PATH_PROCEDURE_DATE, GENE, ABERRATIONTYPE, GENE2 FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_STRUCTURED_RESULTS_V) SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN AS MRN, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH AS DOB, (DAYS(CURRENT_DATE) - DAYS(PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH))/365 "Current Age", PT_SEX AS "Sex", AV_DESC "Race", CASE WHEN PT_PT_ETHNICITY = 'HIS' THEN 'Hispanic' WHEN PT_PT_ETHNICITY = 'NON' THEN 'Non-Hispanic' ELSE PT_PT_ETHNICITY END "Ethnicity", CASE WHEN PT_DATE_OF_DEATH IS NOT NULL THEN 'DECEASED' ELSE 'ALIVE' END "Vital Status", COALESCE(TM_DX_DTE, MIN_ICD9_EFF_DTE) "Diagnosis Date", RTC_TX_PLAN_NAME "RT Site", RTC_TX_START_DTE "RT Start", RTC_TX_STOP_DTE "RT End", RTC_TX_PLANNED_FRACTIONS "Planned Fractions", RTC_TX_DELIVERED_FRACTIONS "Delivered Fractions", RTC_TX_PLANNED_DOSE "Planned Dose", RTC_TX_DELIVERED_DOSE "Delivered Dose", PRPT_PROCEDURE_DTE "Pathology Date", "Biopsy Location", PATH_PROCEDURE_DATE "IMPACT Test Date", GENE "Gene", ABERRATIONTYPE "Aberration Type", GENE2 "Gene2" FROM IDB.PATIENT JOIN RADONC ON PT_MRN = RTC_TX_MRN JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS ON AV_ELEMENT = 'RACE' AND AV_CODE = PT_RACE LEFT JOIN TUMOR ON PT_MRN = TM_MRN LEFT JOIN CLINTRAC ON PT_MRN = CC_MRN LEFT JOIN PATH ON PT_MRN = PRPT_MRN LEFT JOIN IMPACT ON PT_MRN = I_MRN WHERE COALESCE(TM_MRN, CC_MRN) IS NOT NULL ORDER BY PT_MRN

prompt: Prostate cancer patients with first-time radiation between August 1, 2019 and December 31, 2019
completion: WITH DX AS (SELECT DISTINCT TM_MRN FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND TM_SITE_CD LIKE 'C61%' UNION SELECT DISTINCT CC_MRN TM_MRN FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE SUBSTR(CC_CLSF_CD, 1, 3) IN ('C61', '185') AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND (CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) ) , RAD AS (SELECT DISTINCT RTC_TX_MRN FROM IDB.RADONC_TREATMENT_COURSE WHERE RTC_TX_START_DTE < '2019-08-01' ) SELECT DISTINCT RTC_TX_MRN AS "MRN", RTC_TX_PLAN_NAME AS "Site", RTC_TX_DELIVERED_FRACTIONS AS "Delivered Fractions", RTC_TX_DELIVERED_DOSE AS "Delivered Dose", RTC_TX_START_DTE AS "Start Date", RTC_TX_STOP_DTE AS "Stop Date" FROM IDB.RADONC_TREATMENT_COURSE JOIN DX ON RTC_TX_MRN = TM_MRN WHERE RTC_TX_START_DTE BETWEEN '2019-08-01' AND '2019-12-31' AND RTC_TX_MRN NOT IN (SELECT * FROM RAD)

prompt: Provide a list of patients who underwent surgery for squamous cell carcinoma in the parotid gland from 1992 to present
completion: WITH BASE AS (SELECT PBD_MRN , PBD_SVC_DTE , PBC_CPT_CD , CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK FROM IDB.PBD_DTL JOIN IDB.PBD_CODE ON PBD_PBD_CD = PBC_PBD_CD JOIN IDB.CLM ON PBC_CPT_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.PBD_INVOICE ON PBD_INV_NO = PBI_INV_NO WHERE PBD_SVC_DTE BETWEEN '1992-01-01' AND '2020-02-05' AND PBC_CPT_CD IN ('42425', '42415', '42420', '42426', '42410') ) , PTH AS (SELECT PRPT_MRN , COALESCE(PRPT_PROCEDURE_DTE, DATE(RIGHT(DV.REGEXSTR('(?<=Date of Collection\/Procedure\/Outside Report: ).*', PRPT_REPORT), 4) || '-' || LEFT(DV.REGEXSTR('(?<=Date of Collection\/Procedure\/Outside Report: ).*', PRPT_REPORT), 2) || '-' || SUBSTR(DV.REGEXSTR('(?<=Date of Collection\/Procedure\/Outside Report: ).*', PRPT_REPORT), 4, 2))) PRPT_PROCEDURE_DTE FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V JOIN BASE ON PRPT_MRN = PBD_MRN WHERE PRPT_REPORT IS NOT NULL AND CONTAINS("PRPT_REPORT", '("squamous cell carcinoma" | "squamous carcinoma" | "SCC")') = 1 AND PRPT_REPORT_DTE BETWEEN '1992-01-01' AND '2020-02-05' ) , PTS AS (SELECT PBD_MRN MRN , TRIM(PT_LAST_NAME) || ', ' || TRIM(PT_FIRST_NAME) PATIENT_NAME , PT_BIRTH_DTE DOB , PBD_SVC_DTE SURGERY_DTE , PBC_CPT_CD SURGERY_CPT_CD , CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK SURGERY_DESC FROM BASE JOIN PTH ON PBD_MRN = PRPT_MRN JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON PBD_MRN = PT_MRN AND PBD_SVC_DTE = PRPT_PROCEDURE_DTE) , TM AS (SELECT PT_MRN TM_MRN , DT_DTE DX_DTE , DXCC_ICD_CODE HIST_CD , DXCC_ICD_MSK_DESC HIST_DESC , ICSC_SITE_CD SITE_CD , ICSC_ICDO_SITE_MSK_DESC SITE_DESC FROM DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS JOIN DV.CDB_TUMOR_V ON CDTM_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID JOIN DV.DATE_V ON CDTM_DX_DATE_ID = DT_DATE_ID JOIN DV.DIAGNOSIS_CODE_CAT_ICDO_V ON CDTM_DX_CATALOG_ID = DXCC_DX_CATALOG_ID JOIN DV.ICDO_SITE_CATALOG_V ON CDTM_SITE_CATALOG_ID = ICSC_SITE_CATALOG_ID JOIN DV.TUMOR_CASE_ATTRIBUTES_V ON CDTM_CASE_ATTR_ID = TUMOR_CASE_ATTR_ID JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT MRN FROM PTS) A ON PT_MRN = MRN WHERE (SUBSTR(DXCC_ICD_CODE, 1, 5) = 'M8070' OR DXCC_ICD_CODE IN ('M8070/2', 'M8070/3', 'M8070/6', 'M8071/3', 'M8072/3', 'M8073/3', 'M8074/3', 'M8075/3', 'M8076/2', 'M8076/3', 'M8083/3', 'M8084/3')) AND DT_DTE BETWEEN '1992-01-01' AND '2020-02-05' ) SELECT DISTINCT MRN , PATIENT_NAME , DOB , SURGERY_DTE , SURGERY_CPT_CD , SURGERY_DESC , DX_DTE , HIST_CD , HIST_DESC , SITE_CD , SITE_DESC FROM PTS LEFT JOIN TM ON MRN = TM_MRN ; WITH PTH AS (SELECT PRPT_MRN , COALESCE(PRPT_PROCEDURE_DTE, DATE(RIGHT(DV.REGEXSTR('(?<=Date of Collection\/Procedure\/Outside Report: ).*', PRPT_REPORT), 4) || '-' || LEFT(DV.REGEXSTR('(?<=Date of Collection\/Procedure\/Outside Report: ).*', PRPT_REPORT), 2) || '-' || SUBSTR(DV.REGEXSTR('(?<=Date of Collection\/Procedure\/Outside Report: ).*', PRPT_REPORT), 4, 2))) PRPT_PROCEDURE_DTE FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V WHERE PRPT_REPORT IS NOT NULL AND CONTAINS("PRPT_REPORT", '("parotid" | "parotidectomy")') = 1 AND PRPT_REPORT_DTE BETWEEN '1992-01-01' AND '2020-02-05' ) , PBD AS (SELECT PBD_MRN , PBD_SVC_DTE , PBC_CPT_CD , CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK FROM IDB.PBD_DTL JOIN IDB.PBD_CODE ON PBD_PBD_CD = PBC_PBD_CD JOIN IDB.CLM ON PBC_CPT_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.PBD_INVOICE ON PBD_INV_NO = PBI_INV_NO JOIN PTH ON PBD_MRN = PRPT_MRN AND PBD_SVC_DTE = PRPT_PROCEDURE_DTE WHERE PBD_SVC_DTE BETWEEN '1992-01-01' AND '2020-02-05' AND PBC_CPT_CD IN ('42425', '42415', '42420', '42426', '42410') ) , TM AS (SELECT PT_MRN TM_MRN , DT_DTE DX_DTE , DXCC_ICD_CODE HIST_CD , DXCC_ICD_MSK_DESC HIST_DESC , ICSC_SITE_CD SITE_CD , ICSC_ICDO_SITE_MSK_DESC SITE_DESC FROM DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS JOIN DV.CDB_TUMOR_V ON CDTM_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID JOIN DV.DATE_V ON CDTM_DX_DATE_ID = DT_DATE_ID JOIN DV.DIAGNOSIS_CODE_CAT_ICDO_V ON CDTM_DX_CATALOG_ID = DXCC_DX_CATALOG_ID JOIN DV.ICDO_SITE_CATALOG_V ON CDTM_SITE_CATALOG_ID = ICSC_SITE_CATALOG_ID JOIN DV.TUMOR_CASE_ATTRIBUTES_V ON CDTM_CASE_ATTR_ID = TUMOR_CASE_ATTR_ID JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT PRPT_MRN FROM PTH) A ON PT_MRN = PRPT_MRN WHERE (SUBSTR(DXCC_ICD_CODE, 1, 5) = 'M8070' OR DXCC_ICD_CODE IN ('M8070/2', 'M8070/3', 'M8070/6', 'M8071/3', 'M8072/3', 'M8073/3', 'M8074/3', 'M8075/3', 'M8076/2', 'M8076/3', 'M8083/3', 'M8084/3')) AND DT_DTE BETWEEN '1992-01-01' AND '2020-02-05' ) SELECT DISTINCT PRPT_MRN MRN , TRIM(PT_LAST_NAME) || ', ' || TRIM(PT_FIRST_NAME) PATIENT_NAME , PT_BIRTH_DTE DOB , PBD_SVC_DTE SURGERY_DTE , PBC_CPT_CD SURGERY_CPT_CD , CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK SURGERY_DESC , DX_DTE , HIST_CD , HIST_DESC , SITE_CD , SITE_DESC FROM PTH JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON PRPT_MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN PBD ON PRPT_MRN = PBD_MRN LEFT JOIN TM ON PRPT_MRN = TM_MRN

prompt: Create a report that identifies cases of multiple MSK patients using the same SSN.
completion: SELECT PTSS_SSA_NO, PT_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_AKA, PT_SEX, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, PT_ZIP_CD, PT_MRN_CREATE_DATE, PT_DATE_OF_DEATH, PLA_LST_DRVST_DTE, PLA_LST_ACTV_DTE, NDM_LAST_NAME, NDM_FIRST_NAME, NDM_MIDDLE_NAME, NDM_BIRTH_DTE, NDM_RSDNCE_ZIP_CD FROM IDB.PATIENT_SSN JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PT_MRN = PTSS_MRN JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY ON PT_MRN = PLA_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.NTIS_DEATH_MASTER ON PTSS_SSA_NO = NDM_SSA_NO WHERE PTSS_SSA_NO IN (SELECT PTSS_SSA_NO FROM IDB.PATIENT_SSN WHERE PTSS_SSA_NO <> '' GROUP BY PTSS_SSA_NO HAVING COUNT(*) > 1)

prompt: Patients with abnormal Eos results that have received immunotherapies or seen in Dermatology
completion: WITH IMMUNO AS (SELECT DISTINCT APR_MRN FROM IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX JOIN IDB.CHEMO_DRUG_GENERIC ON APR_GENERIC_NAME = CDG_GENERIC_NAME WHERE CDG_GENERIC_NAME IN ('IPILIMUMAB', 'NIVOLUMAB', 'ATEZOLIZUMAB', 'AVELUMAB', 'PEMBROLIZUMAB', 'CEMIPLIMAB') ) , PTS AS (SELECT LR_MRN, LR_PERFORMED_DTE, LR_TEST_NAME, LR_SUBTEST_NAME, LR_RESULT_VALUE, LR_ABNORMALITY_CD, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY LR_MRN ORDER BY LR_PERFORMED_DTE) RN FROM IMMUNO JOIN IDB.LAB_RESULTS ON APR_MRN = LR_MRN WHERE (LR_SUBTEST_NAME like 'Eosinophil%' OR LR_SUBTEST_NAME like 'Eos%') AND LR_ABNORMALITY_CD <> 'U' ) SELECT DISTINCT TM_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, PT_SEX, LR_PERFORMED_DTE "Most recent Eos Performed Date", LR_TEST_NAME "Most recent Eos Test Name", LR_SUBTEST_NAME "Most recent Eos Subtest Name", LR_RESULT_VALUE "Most recent Eos Result Value", LR_ABNORMALITY_CD "Most recent Eos Abnormality Code", TM_DX_DTE, TM_SITE_CD AS SITE_CODE, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_DESC, TM_HIST_CD AS HIST_CODE, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS HIST_DESC, TM_CASE_STS, CS.AV_DESC AS CASE_STS_DESC FROM PTS JOIN IDB.CDB_TUMOR ON LR_MRN = TM_MRN JOIN IDB.CLM H ON TM_HIST_CD = H.CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON TM_SITE_CD = S.CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON TM_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY ON PT_MRN = PLA_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS CS ON CS.AV_ELEMENT = 'CASE_STS' AND CS.AV_CODE = TM_CASE_STS WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND RN = 1 ; WITH PTS AS (SELECT LR_MRN, LR_PERFORMED_DTE, LR_TEST_NAME, LR_SUBTEST_NAME, LR_RESULT_VALUE, LR_ABNORMALITY_CD, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY LR_MRN ORDER BY LR_PERFORMED_DTE) RN FROM IDB.LAB_RESULTS JOIN IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER ON LR_MRN = CPE_MRN AND ABS(DAYS(LR_PERFORMED_DTE) - DAYS(CPE_ENC_DTE)) <= 30 JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID WHERE (LR_SUBTEST_NAME like 'Eosinophil%' OR LR_SUBTEST_NAME like 'Eos%') AND LR_ABNORMALITY_CD <> 'U' AND LR_PERFORMED_DTE >= '2015-01-01' AND CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CRE_RES_TYP = 'Physician' AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 = 'MED' AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 = 'DER' ) SELECT DISTINCT TM_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, PT_SEX, LR_PERFORMED_DTE "Most recent Eos Performed Date", LR_TEST_NAME "Most recent Eos Test Name", LR_SUBTEST_NAME "Most recent Eos Subtest Name", LR_RESULT_VALUE "Most recent Eos Result Value", LR_ABNORMALITY_CD "Most recent Eos Abnormality Code", TM_DX_DTE, TM_SITE_CD AS SITE_CODE, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_DESC, TM_HIST_CD AS HIST_CODE, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS HIST_DESC, TM_CASE_STS, CS.AV_DESC AS CASE_STS_DESC FROM PTS JOIN IDB.CDB_TUMOR ON LR_MRN = TM_MRN JOIN IDB.CLM H ON TM_HIST_CD = H.CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON TM_SITE_CD = S.CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON TM_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY ON PT_MRN = PLA_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS CS ON CS.AV_ELEMENT = 'CASE_STS' AND CS.AV_CODE = TM_CASE_STS WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND RN = 1 ;

prompt: Provide a list of NSCLC patients with ALK positive and PD-L1 results in pathology reports.
I am requesting surgery and pathology information on a list of patients who received 2HG spectroscopy scans. The specific list of patients have been compiled on an excel file.
completion: WITH PTS AS (SELECT DISTINCT D.PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID, PRPT_PATH_RPT_ID, PDRX_DMP_PATIENT_ID FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS D LEFT JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML X ON D.PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PDRX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID AND PRPT_PATH_RPT_ID = PDRX_PATH_RPT_ID JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V V ON D.PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = V.PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID WHERE GENE IN ('IDH2', 'NRAS') AND RESULT = 'POSITIVE' ) , ACCRUALS AS (SELECT AC_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID, MAX(CASE WHEN PRO_IRB_NO = '06-107' THEN AC_CONS_DTE END) "06-107 Consent Date", MAX(CASE WHEN PRO_IRB_NO = '06-107' THEN AC_OFF_STUDY_DTE END) "06-107 Off-Study Date", MAX(CASE WHEN PRO_IRB_NO = '09-141' THEN AC_CONS_DTE END) "09-141 Consent Date", MAX(CASE WHEN PRO_IRB_NO = '09-141' THEN AC_OFF_STUDY_DTE END) "09-141 Off-Study Date", MAX(CASE WHEN PRO_IRB_NO = '12-245' THEN AC_CONS_DTE END) "12-245 Consent Date" FROM PTS JOIN DV.ACCRUALS ON PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = AC_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID JOIN DV.PROTOCOL ON AC_PROTOCOL_ID = PRO_PROTOCOL_ID WHERE PRO_IRB_NO IN ('06-107', '09-141', '12-245') GROUP BY AC_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID ) , ENCOUNTER AS (SELECT PENC_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID, PENC_ENC_CSN_ID, DATE(PENC_ENC_DT) "Next Sch Appt Date", ENDP_SERVICE_SPECIALTY_GRP_8, ENR_RES_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY PENC_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID ORDER BY PENC_ENC_DT) RN FROM PTS JOIN DV.PATIENT_ENCOUNTER ON PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PENC_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID JOIN DV.ENCOUNTER_DEPARTMENT ON PENC_DEPT_ID = ENDP_ENC_DEPT_ID JOIN DV.ENCOUNTER_SCHD_RESOURCES ON PENC_PT_ENC_ID = ENSR_PT_ENC_ID AND ENSR_PRIMARY_RES_IND = 'Y' JOIN DV.ENCOUNTER_RESOURCE ON ENSR_RES_ID = ENR_ENC_RES_ID WHERE ENR_RES_TYP = 'Physician' AND PENC_APPT_STS = 'Sch' ) , VFREQ AS (SELECT PT_MRN, PDRX_ACCESSION_NO, T.* FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML INNER JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML_SETTINGS ON PDRX_PATH_DMP_RESULTS_XML_ID = PDRXS_PATH_DMP_RESULTS_XML_ID INNER JOIN DVDMC.PATHOLOGY_DMP_WEBSVC_SETTINGS ON PDRXS_SETTING_ID = PDWS_SETTING_ID INNER JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON PDRX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID, XMLTABLE('$c/root/*' PASSING PDRX_XML_VALUE AS "c" COLUMNS VARIANT_CLASS VARCHAR(100) PATH 'variant_class', SITE1_GENE VARCHAR(100) PATH 'site1_gene', SITE2_GENE VARCHAR(100) PATH 'site2_gene', GENE_ID VARCHAR(100) PATH 'gene_id', EXON_NUM VARCHAR(100) PATH 'exon_num', AA_CHANGE VARCHAR(100) PATH 'aa_change', CDNA_CHANGE VARCHAR(100) PATH 'cDNA_change', GENE_FOLD_CHANGE VARCHAR(100) PATH 'gene_fold_change', TUMOR_VFREQ VARCHAR(100) PATH 'tumor_vfreq', VARIANT_TYPE VARCHAR(100) PATH './local-name(.)', PROJECT VARCHAR(100) PATH '../meta-data/dmp_alys_task_name', SAMPLEID VARCHAR(100) PATH '../meta-data/dmp_sample_id', PATIENTID VARCHAR(100) PATH '../meta-data/dmp_patient_id', TUMOR_TYPE_CODE VARCHAR(100) PATH '../meta-data/tumor_type_code', TUMOR_TYPE_NAME VARCHAR(255) PATH '../meta-data/tumor_type_name', IS_METASTASIS VARCHAR(10) PATH '../meta-data/is_metastasis', PRIMARY_SITE VARCHAR(255) PATH '../meta-data/primary_site', METASTASIS_SITE VARCHAR(255) PATH '../meta-data/metastasis_site') T WHERE PDWS_NAME = 'RAINDANCE THUNDERBOLTS' AND GENE_ID IN ('JAK2') AND VARIANT_TYPE <> 'meta-data' ) SELECT PD.PT_MRN, PD.PT_LAST_NAME, PD.PT_FIRST_NAME, PDRX_DMP_PATIENT_ID, PRPT_ACCESSION_NO, DT_DTE REPORT_DATE, D.GENE, D.RESULT, D.LOCUS, D.AA_CHANGE, D.NUCLEOTIDE, D.METHOD, D.ABERRATIONTYPE, D.FOLD_CHANGE, TUMOR_VFREQ, "06-107 Consent Date", "06-107 Off-Study Date", "09-141 Consent Date", "09-141 Off-Study Date", "12-245 Consent Date", "Next Sch Appt Date", ENDP_SERVICE_SPECIALTY_GRP_8, ENR_RES_NAME FROM PTS P JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS D ON P.PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = D.PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID AND P.PRPT_PATH_RPT_ID = D.PRPT_PATH_RPT_ID JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V X ON P.PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = X.PRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID AND P.PRPT_PATH_RPT_ID = X.PRPT_PATH_RPT_ID JOIN DV.DATE ON PRPT_REPORT_DATE_ID = DT_DATE_ID JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V PD ON P.PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PD.PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID LEFT JOIN VFREQ V ON PD.PT_MRN = V.PT_MRN AND PRPT_ACCESSION_NO = V.PDRX_ACCESSION_NO LEFT JOIN ACCRUALS ON P.PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = AC_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID LEFT JOIN ENCOUNTER ON P.PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PENC_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID AND RN = 1

prompt: Provide a list of all patients who underwent specified procedures at MSKCC.
completion: SELECT PBD_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, PBD_SVC_DTE, PBC_CPT_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK, DOC_NAME FROM IDB.PBD_DTL JOIN IDB.PBD_INVOICE ON PBD_INV_NO = PBI_INV_NO JOIN IDB.PBD_CODE ON PBD_PBD_CD = PBC_PBD_CD JOIN IDB.DOC ON PBI_PERFORM_DR_NO = DOC_DR_NO JOIN IDB.CLM ON PBC_CPT_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PBD_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE PBC_CPT_CD IN ('61595', '61596', '61597', '61605', '61615', '61616', '69501', '69502', '69505', '69511', '69530', '69535', '69601', '69602', '69603', '69604', '69605', '69631', '69632', '69633', '69635', '69636', '69637', '69641', '69642', '69643', '69644', '69645', '69646') ORDER BY PBD_MRN, PBD_SVC_DTE, PBC_CPT_CD

prompt: Generate a list of pediatric patients treated with radiation therapy
completion: WITH APPT AS (SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN, MIN(CPE_ENC_DTE) AS APPT_DATE, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 AS "Department", CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 AS "Service", CLD_DEPT_NAME AS "Department Name" FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 = 'RDO' GROUP BY CPE_MRN, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8, CLD_DEPT_NAME HAVING MIN(CPE_ENC_DTE) BETWEEN '2000-01-01' AND '2023-12-01') SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN, CASE WHEN PT_DATE_OF_DEATH IS NULL THEN YEAR(CURRENT date - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) END AS AGE, YEAR(APPT_DATE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) AS "Age at Appointment", PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH AS "Date of Birth", PT_DATE_OF_DEATH AS "Date of Death", CASE WHEN PT_DATE_OF_DEATH IS NULL THEN 'Alive' ELSE 'Deceased' END AS "Vital Status", R.AV_DESC AS RACE, E.AV_DESC AS ETHNICITY, COALESCE(MAX(PLA_LST_APPT_DTE, PLA_LST_DSCH_DTE), PLA_LST_APPT_DTE, PLA_LST_DSCH_DTE) AS "DATE OF LAST FOLLOW UP", APPT_DATE, "Department", "Service", "Department Name" FROM APPT JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON CPE_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY ON PT_MRN = PLA_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS R ON R.AV_ELEMENT = 'RACE' AND R.AV_CODE = PT_RACE LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS G ON G.AV_ELEMENT = 'SEX' AND G.AV_CODE = PT_SEX LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS E ON E.AV_ELEMENT = 'PT_ETHNICITY' AND E.AV_CODE = PT_PT_ETHNICITY WHERE YEAR(APPT_DATE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) BETWEEN 0 AND 21 ORDER BY PT_MRN ; WITH APPT AS (SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN, MIN(CPE_ENC_DTE) AS APPT_DATE, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 AS "Department", CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 AS "Service", CLD_DEPT_NAME AS "Department Name" FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 = 'RDO' GROUP BY CPE_MRN, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8, CLD_DEPT_NAME HAVING MIN(CPE_ENC_DTE) BETWEEN '2000-01-01' AND '2023-12-01') , PT AS (SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN, CASE WHEN PT_DATE_OF_DEATH IS NULL THEN YEAR(CURRENT date - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) END AS AGE, YEAR(APPT_DATE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) AS "Age at Appointment", PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH AS "Date of Birth", PT_DATE_OF_DEATH AS "Date of Death", CASE WHEN PT_DATE_OF_DEATH IS NULL THEN 'Alive' ELSE 'Deceased' END AS "Vital Status", R.AV_DESC AS RACE, E.AV_DESC AS ETHNICITY, COALESCE(MAX(PLA_LST_APPT_DTE, PLA_LST_DSCH_DTE), PLA_LST_APPT_DTE, PLA_LST_DSCH_DTE) AS "DATE OF LAST FOLLOW UP", APPT_DATE, "Department", "Service", "Department Name" FROM APPT JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON CPE_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY ON PT_MRN = PLA_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS R ON R.AV_ELEMENT = 'RACE' AND R.AV_CODE = PT_RACE LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS G ON G.AV_ELEMENT = 'SEX' AND G.AV_CODE = PT_SEX LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS E ON E.AV_ELEMENT = 'PT_ETHNICITY' AND E.AV_CODE = PT_PT_ETHNICITY WHERE YEAR(APPT_DATE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) BETWEEN 0 AND 21 ), ICD AS (SELECT DISTINCT CC_MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS MIN_ICD9_EFF_DTE, CC_CLSF_CD AS ICD9_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS ICD9_DESC FROM PT JOIN IDB.CTC_CLSF ON PT_MRN = CC_MRN JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE CC_CLSF_CD IN ('V84.01', 'V84.02', 'V84.03', 'V84.04', 'V84.09', 'Z15.01', 'Z15.02', 'Z15.03', 'Z15.04', 'Z15.09') AND CASE WHEN CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y' AND CC_PT_TYPE <> 'E' THEN 'Y' WHEN CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' AND YEAR(CC_EFF_DTE) < 2004 THEN 'Y' WHEN CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND YEAR(CC_EFF_DTE) < 2001 THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END = 'Y' GROUP BY CC_MRN, CC_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK HAVING MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) BETWEEN '1980-01-01' AND '2023-12-01') SELECT DISTINCT CC_MRN MRN, AGE, "Date of Birth", "Date of Death", "Vital Status", RACE, ETHNICITY, "DATE OF LAST FOLLOW UP", MIN_ICD9_EFF_DTE AS "ICD Date", ICD9_CD AS "ICD Code", ICD9_DESC AS "ICD Description" FROM PT JOIN ICD ON PT_MRN = CC_MRN ORDER BY CC_MRN ; WITH APPT AS (SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN, MIN(CPE_ENC_DTE) AS APPT_DATE, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 AS "Department", CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 AS "Service", CLD_DEPT_NAME AS "Department Name" FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 = 'RDO' GROUP BY CPE_MRN, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8, CLD_DEPT_NAME HAVING MIN(CPE_ENC_DTE) BETWEEN '2000-01-01' AND '2023-12-01') , PT AS (SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN, CASE WHEN PT_DATE_OF_DEATH IS NULL THEN YEAR(CURRENT date - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) END AS AGE, YEAR(APPT_DATE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) AS "Age at Appointment", PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH AS "Date of Birth", PT_DATE_OF_DEATH AS "Date of Death", CASE WHEN PT_DATE_OF_DEATH IS NULL THEN 'Alive' ELSE 'Deceased' END AS "Vital Status", R.AV_DESC AS RACE, E.AV_DESC AS ETHNICITY, COALESCE(MAX(PLA_LST_APPT_DTE, PLA_LST_DSCH_DTE), PLA_LST_APPT_DTE, PLA_LST_DSCH_DTE) AS "DATE OF LAST FOLLOW UP", APPT_DATE, "Department", "Service", "Department Name" FROM APPT JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON CPE_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY ON PT_MRN = PLA_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS R ON R.AV_ELEMENT = 'RACE' AND R.AV_CODE = PT_RACE LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS G ON G.AV_ELEMENT = 'SEX' AND G.AV_CODE = PT_SEX LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS E ON E.AV_ELEMENT = 'PT_ETHNICITY' AND E.AV_CODE = PT_PT_ETHNICITY WHERE YEAR(APPT_DATE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) BETWEEN 0 AND 21 ) SELECT DISTINCT CDD_MRN AS MRN, AGE, "Date of Birth", "Date of Death", "Vital Status", RACE, ETHNICITY, "DATE OF LAST FOLLOW UP", CDD_SERVICE_DTE AS "Service Date", CDD_DOC_NAME AS "Document Name", VARCHAR(CDD_DOCUMENT_FULL_TEXT, 32000) AS "Report Text" FROM PT JOIN DV.CLINDOC_FULL_TEXT_V ON PT_MRN = CDD_MRN WHERE CDD_CANCEL_IND <> '1' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND <> '1' AND UPPER(VARCHAR(CDD_DOCUMENT_FULL_TEXT, 32000)) LIKE '%LI-FRAUMENI%SYNDROME%' AND CDD_SERVICE_DTE BETWEEN '1980-01-01' AND '2023-12-01' ORDER BY CDD_MRN ;

prompt: Sepsis alert volume from Koch 5 inpatient from 2020-present
completion: WITH ALERT AS (SELECT OCI_CLIENT_ID_CD MRN, OALR_PATIENT_LOCATION PATIENT_LOCATION, OALR_DESCRIPTION ALERT_DESC, DATE(OALR_ENTERED_DT) PLACEMENT_DATE, OALR_ENTERED_DT PLACEMENT_DT , OALR_TRIGGERING_INFO TRIGGERING_INFO, OALR_PRIORITY_CODE PRIORITY, OALR_EVENT_TYPE EVENT_TYPE, OALR_MLM_NAME ALERT_NAME, TRIM(OALR_ALERT_COMMENTS) ALERT_COMMENTS , TRIM(OALR_ACK_USER_NAME) ACK_USER_NAME, OALR_ACK_DT ACK_DT, OP_DISPLAY_NAME AS PRIMARY_PVDR , ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY OCI_CLIENT_ID_CD, DATE(OALR_ENTERED_DT) ORDER BY OALR_ENTERED_DT) RN1 , ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY OCI_CLIENT_ID_CD, DATE(OALR_ENTERED_DT) ORDER BY COALESCE(OALR_ACK_DT, CURRENT TIMESTAMP), OALR_ENTERED_DT) RN2 , ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY OCI_CLIENT_ID_CD, DATE(OALR_ENTERED_DT) ORDER BY CASE WHEN OALR_ALERT_COMMENTS > '' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END, OALR_ENTERED_DT) RN3 FROM IDB.OMS_ALERT_REPOSITORY JOIN IDB.OMS_CLIENT_ID ON OALR_CLIENT_GUID = OCI_CLIENT_GUID AND OCI_TYPE_CD = 'MRN' JOIN IDB.OMS_PROVIDER ON OALR_PRIMARY_PVDR_GUID = OP_PVDR_GUID WHERE 1=1 AND DATE(OALR_ENTERED_DT) >= '1/1/2020' AND UPPER(OALR_MLM_NAME) LIKE '%SEPSIS%' AND UPPER(OALR_PATIENT_LOCATION) LIKE '%KOCH%' AND OALR_PRIORITY_CODE = 'HIGH' ) , ALERTFNL AS (SELECT A.MRN, A.PATIENT_LOCATION, A.PRIMARY_PVDR, A.ALERT_DESC, A.PLACEMENT_DATE, A.PLACEMENT_DT, A.TRIGGERING_INFO, A.PRIORITY, A.EVENT_TYPE, A.ALERT_NAME , B.ACK_USER_NAME, B.ACK_DT, C.ALERT_COMMENTS FROM ALERT A LEFT JOIN ALERT B ON A.MRN = B.MRN AND A.PLACEMENT_DT = B.PLACEMENT_DT AND B.RN2 = 1 LEFT JOIN ALERT C ON A.MRN = C.MRN AND A.PLACEMENT_DT = C.PLACEMENT_DT AND C.RN3 = 1 WHERE A.RN1 = 1 ) SELECT DISTINCT A.* , OUO_ORD_ID ORD_ID, OUO_ORD_NAME ORD_NAME, OUO_ENTER_DT ORD_ENTER_DT, OUO_REQ_TME_PRIO REQ_TME_PRIO, OUO_ORD_STS_CD ORD_STS , OUO_SET_NAME SETNAME, OUO_OO_SIGNIFICANT_DT SIGNIFICANT_DT, OUO_USER_NAME USER_NAME, OUO_USER_ROLE_TYPE USER_ROLE FROM ALERTFNL A LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_USER_ORDERS ON OUO_MRN = MRN AND OUO_ENTER_DT BETWEEN PLACEMENT_DT AND PLACEMENT_DT + 3 HOUR AND UPPER(OUO_SET_NAME) LIKE '%SEPSIS%' AND OUO_ORD_STS_CD NOT IN ('CANC', 'AUC3', 'DISC') AND UPPER(OUO_ORD_NAME) LIKE '%SEPSIS%' ORDER BY MRN, PLACEMENT_DT

prompt: Provide a weekly list of newly diagnosed breast cancer patient who are scheduled for a breast MRI and CEM. Include the planned NAT appointment date if available
completion: SELECT RRPT_MRN, RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE, RRPT_PROCEDURE_NAME , RRPT_REPORT_TXT FROM DV.RADIOLOGY_REPORT_V JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PT_MRN = RRPT_MRN AND YEAR (RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) >=18 AND PT_SEX = 'F' WHERE RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE >= CURRENT date - 4 DAYS AND INSTR(RRPT_REPORT_TXT, 'BI-RADS 6') > 0 AND RRPT_ORDER_GROUP = 'MR' ;

prompt: Provide a list of Patients who received ocular angiography imaging.
completion: SELECT PBD_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, PBD_SVC_DTE, PBC_CPT_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK, DOC_NAME ORDERING_PYSICIAN FROM IDB.PBD_DTL JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PBD_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.PBD_CODE ON PBD_PBD_CD = PBC_PBD_CD JOIN IDB.CLM ON PBC_CPT_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.PBD_INVOICE ON PBD_INV_NO = PBI_INV_NO JOIN IDB.DOC ON PBI_ORDER_DR_NO = DOC_DR_NO WHERE PBC_CPT_CD IN ('92235', '92242', '92240')
