prompt: Update the Darwin structured report MED15624 - Staff-Patient Interaction by Staff Name and Date with additional columns.
completion: WITH CTE AS (SELECT DISTINCT OU_DISPLAY_NAME, CDD_DOC_GUID, CDD_AUTHORED_DT, CDD_SERVICE_DTE, CDD_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, CDD_DOC_NAME, CDD_VISIT_GUID FROM IDB.CD_DOCUMENT JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION ON CDD_DOC_GUID = CDO_DOC_GUID AND CDD_AUTHORED_DTE = CDO_AUTHORED_DTE JOIN IDB.OMS_USER ON CDO_USER_GUID = OU_USER_GUID JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PT_MRN = CDD_MRN WHERE 1=1 AND OU_DISPLAY_NAME = (#PROMPT('Staff Name')#) AND CDD_SERVICE_DTE BETWEEN DATE(#PROMPT('Start Date', 'STRING', '1900-01-01')#) AND DATE(#PROMPT ('End Date', 'STRING', '2999-12-31')#) ) , LOC AS (SELECT CDD_DOC_GUID, OL_LOC_NAME FROM CTE JOIN IDB.OMS_VISIT_LOCATION ON OVL_VISIT_GUID = CDD_VISIT_GUID AND OVL_EFF_DT = (SELECT MAX(OVL_EFF_DT) AS MAX_OVL_EFF_DT FROM IDB.OMS_VISIT_LOCATION WHERE OVL_EFF_DT <= CDD_AUTHORED_DT AND OVL_VISIT_GUID = CDD_VISIT_GUID) JOIN IDB.OMS_LOCATION ON OVL_LOC_GUID = OL_LOC_GUID) , CTE2 AS (SELECT TRIM(OU_DISPLAY_NAME) AS "Staff Name", OOTO_PERF_FROM_DT AS "Performed Date and Time", DATE(OOTO_PERF_FROM_DT) AS "Service Date", TRIM(OOTO_MRN) AS "MRN", TRIM(PT_LAST_NAME) || ', ' || TRIM(PT_FIRST_NAME) AS "Patient Name", OO_VISIT_GUID FROM IDB.OAS_ORD_TASK_OCCR JOIN IDB.OAS_CTLG_ITEM_TASK ON OOTO_CAT_ITEM_GUID = OCIT_GUID AND OCIT_LEVEL_NO = 0 JOIN IDB.OMS_USER ON OU_USER_GUID = OOTO_PER_PVDR_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_ORDER ON OOTO_ORD_GUID = OO_ORD_GUID JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PT_MRN = OOTO_MRN WHERE OOTO_STATUS_CD = 'Performed' AND OU_DISPLAY_NAME = (#PROMPT('Staff Name')#) AND OOTO_PERF_FROM_DTE BETWEEN DATE(#PROMPT('Start Date', 'STRING', '1900-01-01')#) AND DATE(#PROMPT ('End Date', 'STRING', '2999-12-31')#) ) , LOC2 AS (SELECT OO_VISIT_GUID, "Performed Date and Time", OL_LOC_NAME FROM CTE2 JOIN IDB.OMS_VISIT_LOCATION ON OVL_VISIT_GUID = OO_VISIT_GUID AND OVL_EFF_DT = (SELECT MAX(OVL_EFF_DT) AS MAX_OVL_EFF_DT FROM IDB.OMS_VISIT_LOCATION WHERE OVL_EFF_DT <= "Performed Date and Time" AND OVL_VISIT_GUID = OO_VISIT_GUID) JOIN IDB.OMS_LOCATION ON OVL_LOC_GUID = OL_LOC_GUID) , X AS (SELECT TRIM(OU_DISPLAY_NAME) AS "Staff Name", TRIM(CDD_MRN) AS "MRN", TRIM(PT_LAST_NAME) || ', ' || TRIM(PT_FIRST_NAME) AS "Patient Name", A.CDD_AUTHORED_DT AS "Date and Time", A.CDD_SERVICE_DTE AS "Service Date", TRIM(CDD_DOC_NAME) AS "Document Name", TRIM(OL_LOC_NAME) AS "Location", 'ClinDoc' AS "Type" FROM CTE A LEFT JOIN LOC B ON A.CDD_DOC_GUID = B.CDD_DOC_GUID UNION ALL SELECT "Staff Name", "MRN", "Patient Name", A."Performed Date and Time" AS "Date and Time", A."Service Date", '' AS "Document Name", TRIM(OL_LOC_NAME) AS "Location", 'EMAR' AS "Type" FROM CTE2 A LEFT JOIN LOC2 B ON A.OO_VISIT_GUID = B.OO_VISIT_GUID AND A."Performed Date and Time" = B."Performed Date and Time") , V1 AS (SELECT DISTINCT MRN, VIS_ADM_NUM, VIS_ADM_DT, VIS_ADM_DTE, VIS_DSCH_DTE, VIS_PATIENT_TYPE, VIS_HOSP_SVC, HOSP_SVC_DESC, VIS_NURS_STA, VIS_ROOM_NUM, VIS_IP_OP_ADJUSTED_IND, VIS_VISIT_STATUS, VISIT_STATUS_DESC FROM X LEFT JOIN IDB.VISIT_V ON MRN = VIS_MRN WHERE 1=1 AND VIS_IP_OP_ADJUSTED_IND = 'I' AND VIS_VISIT_STATUS IN ('2', '3') ) , V2 AS (SELECT V1.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY MRN ORDER BY VIS_ADM_DT DESC) AS RN FROM V1) , V3 AS (SELECT MRN, VISIT_STATUS_DESC, VIS_ADM_DTE, VIS_DSCH_DTE, VIS_ROOM_NUM, HOSP_SVC_DESC, CASE WHEN VISIT_STATUS_DESC ='ADMITTED' THEN 'Y' END AS "Currently Admitted" FROM V2 WHERE RN = 1 ) SELECT DISTINCT X.*, "Currently Admitted", VIS_ROOM_NUM AS "Room", VIS_DSCH_DTE AS "Last Discharge Date", STRIP(HOSP_SVC_DESC) AS "Service" FROM X LEFT JOIN V3 ON X.MRN = V3.MRN

prompt: Provide a list of appointments scheduled with Dyana Sumner between Jul-Oct 2021.
completion: SELECT CPE_MRN AS "MRN", PT_LAST_NAME "Last Name", PT_FIRST_NAME "First Name", CPE_ENC_DTE AS "Appt Date", CLD_DEPT_NAME AS "Department Name", CRE_RES_NAME AS "Provider Name", CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME AS "Visit Type" FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON CPE_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Sch') AND CRE_RES_NAME = 'SUMNER, DYANA KATHERINE' AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN '2021-07-01' AND '2021-10-31'

prompt: Provide a list of completed and scheduled appts with Drs. David Jones, Prasad Adusumilli, Bernard Park, Manjit Bains, Robert Downey, Valerie Rusch, Gaetano Rocco, Matthew Bott, James Huang, Daniela Molena, Smita Sihag, and James Isbell at 53rd Street location from the last 2 years.
completion: WITH LAST_VISIT AS (SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN, CPE_ENC_DTE, CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME, CLD_CLD_CENTER, CRE_RES_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CPE_MRN ORDER BY CPE_APPT_DT DESC) AS LAST_VIS FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CPE_ENC_DTE >= CURRENT date - 2 YEARS AND CRE_RES_ID IN ('018440', '013789', '000117', '020727', '005751', '014431', '021238', '018440', '021030', '010744', '024166', '002642', '022335') AND CLD_CLD_CENTER = '53RD' ) , NEXT_VISIT AS (SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN, CPE_ENC_DTE, CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME, CRE_RES_NAME, CLD_CLD_CENTER, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CPE_MRN, CRE_RES_NAME ORDER BY CPE_ENC_DTE ASC) AS NEXT_VIS FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Sch') AND CPE_ENC_DTE >= CURRENT date AND CRE_RES_ID IN ('018440', '013789', '000117', '020727', '005751', '014431', '021238', '018440', '021030', '010744', '024166', '002642', '022335') AND CLD_CLD_CENTER = '53RD' ) SELECT DISTINCT A.PT_MRN "MRN", A.PT_LAST_NAME "Last Name", A.PT_FIRST_NAME "First Name", A.PT_ADDR1 "Address 1", A.PT_ADDR2 "Address 2", A.PT_CITY "City", A.PT_STATE "State", A.PT_ZIP_CD "Zip Code", B.CRE_RES_NAME "Provider Name", B.CPE_ENC_DTE "Last Visit Date", B.CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME "Last Visit Type", C.CPE_ENC_DTE "Next Scheduled Visit Date", C.CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME "Next Scheduled Visit Type", LAD_DONOT_CON_IND "Do Not Contact Indicator", PLA_DONOT_MAIL_IND "Do Not Mail Indicator", CAV_NAME "Preferred Language", CPP_PP_LST_LGN_DTE "Portal Last Login Date" FROM IDB.PATIENT A JOIN LAST_VISIT B ON PT_MRN = B.CPE_MRN AND B.LAST_VIS = 1 LEFT JOIN NEXT_VISIT C ON B.CPE_MRN = C.CPE_MRN AND C.NEXT_VIS = 1 AND B.CRE_RES_NAME = C.CRE_RES_NAME JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTV_DTL ON PT_MRN = LAD_MRN JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY ON PT_MRN = PLA_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_CATEGORY ON PT_PRIMARY_LANG = CAV_ABBR AND CAV_CATEGORY = 'LANG' LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_PAS_PATIENT ON PT_MRN = CPP_MRN WHERE 1=1 AND PT_DEATH_IND IN ('A', '') ORDER BY B.CPE_ENC_DTE DESC ;

prompt: List of Mast Cell Sarcoma cases from 2010-2019.
completion: WITH TUMOR AS (SELECT DISTINCT T_MRN, LISTAGG(TRIM(HIST_DESC) || ' - SITE: ' || TRIM(SITE_DESC), ' / ') WITHIN GROUP( ORDER BY HIST_DESC) "Histology/Site" FROM (SELECT DISTINCT TM_MRN AS T_MRN, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS HIST_DESC, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_DESC FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS ON AV_ELEMENT = 'CASE_STS' AND AV_CODE = TM_CASE_STS AND TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8')) GROUP BY T_MRN) SELECT PRPT_MRN AS MRN, PT_LAST_NAME "Patient Last Name", PT_FIRST_NAME "Patient First Name", PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH AS DOB, LISTAGG(TRIM(PRPT_ACCESSION_NO), ' / ') WITHIN GROUP( ORDER BY PRPT_ACCESSION_NO) "Accession No.", "Histology/Site" FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PRPT_MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN TUMOR ON PRPT_MRN = T_MRN WHERE SUBSTR(PRPT_ACCESSION_NO, 1, 1) IN ('H', 'S') AND CONTAINS("PRPT_REPORT", '("mast cell sarcoma" | "mast cell" | "mastocytosis")') = 1 AND CONTAINS("PRPT_REPORT", '("BONE MARROW" | "SKIN")') = 0 AND PRPT_REPORT IS NOT NULL AND PRPT_PROCEDURE_DTE BETWEEN '2000-01-01' AND '2009-12-31' GROUP BY PRPT_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, "Histology/Site"

prompt: Provide cancer diagnosis and treatment data on female patients below age 50 with rectal or anal cancer.
completion: SELECT DISTINCT TM_MRN AS MRN, PT_LAST_NAME AS LAST, PT_FIRST_NAME AS FIRST, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH AS DOB, PT_DATE_OF_DEATH AS DATE_OF_DEATH, YEAR(CURRENT date - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) AS CURRENT_AGE, PT_SEX AS SEX, R.AV_DESC AS RACE , E.AV_DESC AS ETHNICITY, PLA_LST_APPT_DTE AS LAST_APPOINTMENT_DATE, TM_HIST_CD AS HISTOLOGY_CODE, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS HIST_DESC, TM_SITE_CD AS SITE_CODE, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_DESC, C.AV_DESC AS CASE_STS, TM_TUMOR_SIZE, TM_MSK_STG, TM_BEST_SUMM_STG, TM_BEST_AJCC_STG AS AJCC_STAGE, TM_PATH_STG_GRP AS PATH_STAGE, TM_PATH_TNM_T AS PATH_T, TM_PATH_TNM_N AS PATH_N, TM_PATH_TNM_M AS PATH_M, TM_CLIN_STG_GRP AS CLIN_STAGE, TM_CLIN_TNM_T AS CLIN_T, TM_CLIN_TNM_N AS CLIN_N, TM_CLIN_TNM_M AS CLIN_M FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS C ON C.AV_ELEMENT = 'CASE_STS' AND C.AV_CODE = TM_CASE_STS JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON TM_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.RADONC_TREATMENT_COURSE ON RTC_TX_MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS R ON R.AV_ELEMENT = 'RACE' AND R.AV_CODE = PT_RACE LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS E ON E.AV_ELEMENT = 'PT_ETHNICITY' AND E.AV_CODE = PT_PT_ETHNICITY LEFT JOIN IDB.CDB_PATIENT ON PT_MRN = CP_MRN JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY ON PLA_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND TM_SITE_CD BETWEEN 'C20' AND 'C21' AND PT_SEX = 'F' AND TM_DX_DTE BETWEEN '1995-01-01' AND '2019-08-01' AND YEAR(TM_DX_DTE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) < 50 ; WITH PTS AS (SELECT DISTINCT TM_MRN FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS ON AV_ELEMENT = 'CASE_STS' AND AV_CODE = TM_CASE_STS JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON TM_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.RADONC_TREATMENT_COURSE ON RTC_TX_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND TM_SITE_CD BETWEEN 'C20' AND 'C21' AND PT_SEX = 'F' AND TM_DX_DTE BETWEEN '1995-01-01' AND '2019-08-01' AND YEAR(TM_DX_DTE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) < 50 ) SELECT DISTINCT CC_MRN, CC_CLSF_CD AS ICD_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS ICD_DESC FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE (CC_CLSF_CD BETWEEN 'C00' AND 'C99' OR CC_CLSF_CD BETWEEN '140' AND '209') AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND CC_MRN IN (SELECT TM_MRN FROM PTS) GROUP BY CC_MRN, CC_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK ; SELECT DISTINCT TM_MRN, APR_DRUG_NAME, MIN(APR_START_DTE) "Min Start Date", MAX(APR_END_DTE)"Max End Date", APR_PRESCRIBED_DOSE FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS ON AV_ELEMENT = 'CASE_STS' AND AV_CODE = TM_CASE_STS JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON TM_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.RADONC_TREATMENT_COURSE ON RTC_TX_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX_V ON APR_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND TM_SITE_CD BETWEEN 'C20' AND 'C21' AND PT_SEX = 'F' AND TM_DX_DTE BETWEEN '1995-01-01' AND '2019-08-01' AND YEAR(TM_DX_DTE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) < 50 GROUP BY TM_MRN, APR_DRUG_NAME, APR_PRESCRIBED_DOSE ; SELECT DISTINCT TM_MRN, YEAR(RTC_TX_START_DTE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) "Age at RT", RTC_TX_START_DTE, RTC_TX_STOP_DTE, RTC_TX_DELIVERED_DOSE, RTC_TX_DELIVERED_FRACTIONS, RAD_TYPE FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS ON AV_ELEMENT = 'CASE_STS' AND AV_CODE = TM_CASE_STS JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON TM_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.RADONC_TREATMENT_COURSE ON RTC_TX_MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.RADIATION_CHARGES_V ON MRN = TM_MRN AND SVC_DTE = RTC_TX_START_DTE WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND TM_SITE_CD BETWEEN 'C20' AND 'C21' AND PT_SEX = 'F' AND TM_DX_DTE BETWEEN '1995-01-01' AND '2019-08-01' AND YEAR(TM_DX_DTE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) < 50 ; SELECT DISTINCT TM_MRN, SSE_SURG_DTE, SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD, SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS ON AV_ELEMENT = 'CASE_STS' AND AV_CODE = TM_CASE_STS JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON TM_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.RADONC_TREATMENT_COURSE ON RTC_TX_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT ON SSE_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE ON SSE_LOG_ID = SSP_LOG_ID AND SSE_ENC_CSN_ID = SSP_ENC_CSN_ID WHERE (SSE_SURG_LOC not like '%IR%' AND SSE_SURG_LOC not like '%ENDO%' AND SSE_SOURCE_TYPE <> 'E') AND TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND TM_SITE_CD BETWEEN 'C20' AND 'C21' AND PT_SEX = 'F' AND TM_DX_DTE BETWEEN '1995-01-01' AND '2019-08-01' AND YEAR(TM_DX_DTE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) < 50 AND SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD <> '58825'

prompt: Upcoming appointments of patients with Ground-glass Opacification on CT Scan
completion: WITH CTE AS (SELECT DISTINCT RRPT_MRN, RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE FROM DV.RADIOLOGY_REPORT_V WHERE RRPT_REPORT_TXT IS NOT NULL AND RRPT_ORDER_GROUP = 'CT' AND CONTAINS(RRPT_REPORT_TXT, '("ggo" OR "ground glass" OR "nodular opacity" OR "nodular opacities")') = 1 AND RRPT_REPORT_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT DATE - 730 DAY AND CURRENT DATE ) , NSLC AS (SELECT DISTINCT TM_MRN FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND TM_SITE_CD LIKE 'C34%' AND TM_BEST_AJCC_STG IN ('2A', '2B', '3A', '3B', '3C', '4', '4A', '4B') AND TM_HIST_CD IN ('M8013/3', 'M8014/3', 'M8022/3', 'M8030/3', 'M8031/3', 'M8032/3', 'M8033/3', 'M8046/3', 'M8052/2', 'M8052/3', 'M8070/2', 'M8070/3', 'M8071/2', 'M8071/3', 'M8072/3', 'M8073/3', 'M8074/2', 'M8074/3', 'M8083/3', 'M8140/2', 'M8140/3', 'M8250/2', 'M8250/3', 'M8251/3', 'M8252/3', 'M8253/3', 'M8254/3', 'M8255/3', 'M8260/2', 'M8260/3', 'M8310/3', 'M8333/3', 'M8480/2', 'M8480/3', 'M8481/3', 'M8490/2', 'M8490/3', 'M8560/2', 'M8560/3', 'M8572/3', 'M8574/3', 'M8972/3', 'M8973/3', 'M8980/3') ) , APPT AS (SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME AS "Last Name", PT_FIRST_NAME AS "First Name", CPE_ENC_DTE AS "Appt Date", CHAR(TIME(CPE_APPT_DT), USA) "Appt Time", CLD_DEPT_NAME AS "Department Name", CRE_RES_NAME AS "Provider Name", CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME AS "Visit Type", MAX(RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE) "Latest CT" FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID JOIN CTE ON CPE_MRN = RRPT_MRN JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON CPE_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Sch') AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT DATE AND CURRENT DATE + 2 DAYS AND CPE_MRN NOT IN (SELECT TM_MRN FROM NSLC) AND CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME NOT IN ('AD HOC CONSENT ONLY', 'AD HOC POST OP', 'THR CONSENT ONLY', 'THR POST OP', 'THR PROCEDURE') AND CRE_RES_NAME IN ('BAINS, MANJIT', 'RUSCH, VALERIE', 'DOWNEY, ROBERT', 'PARK, BERNARD J.', 'ADUSUMILLI, PRASAD S', 'HUANG, JAMES', 'JONES, DAVID R', 'BOTT, MATTHEW J', 'MOLENA, DANIELA', 'ISBELL, JAMES MICHAEL', 'SIHAG, SMITA', 'ROCCO, GAETANO', 'SUMNER, DYANA KATHERINE', 'BERKOWITZ-HERGIANTO, ALISON', 'DEVIGNE, AMY ROSE', 'BEATTIE, JASON ANTHONY', 'CHAWLA, MOHIT', 'FEINSTEIN, MARC', 'GEYER, ALEXANDER IOSIF', 'HUSTA, BRYAN CHRISTOPHER', 'KALCHIEM-DEKEL, OR', 'KHUSAINOVA, ELVINA', 'LEE, ROBERT', 'STOVER, DIANE', 'TAN, MIRANDA', 'VANDER ELS, NICHOLAS', 'VAN ELDEN, LEONTINE JULIE ROSE') GROUP BY CPE_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, CPE_ENC_DTE, CHAR(TIME(CPE_APPT_DT), USA), CLD_DEPT_NAME, CRE_RES_NAME, CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME) , DX AS (SELECT TM_MRN, TM_DX_DTE, TM_HIST_CD, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS HIST_DESC, TM_SITE_CD, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_DESC, TM_BEST_AJCC_STG FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD JOIN APPT ON TM_MRN = CPE_MRN WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND TM_DX_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT DATE - 1825 DAYS AND CURRENT DATE ) , PATH AS (SELECT PRPT_MRN, MAX(PRPT_REPORT_DTE) LAST_PATH_RPT FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V JOIN APPT ON PRPT_MRN = CPE_MRN WHERE PRPT_REPORT IS NOT NULL AND PRPT_REPORT_TYPE_DESC IN ('Surgical Pathology', 'Surgical Pathology Breast', 'Surgical Pathology Consult') GROUP BY PRPT_MRN) SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN "MRN", "Last Name", "First Name", "Appt Date", "Appt Time", "Department Name", "Provider Name", "Visit Type", "Latest CT", TM_DX_DTE, TM_HIST_CD, HIST_DESC, TM_SITE_CD, SITE_DESC, TM_BEST_AJCC_STG, LAST_PATH_RPT FROM APPT LEFT JOIN DX ON CPE_MRN = TM_MRN LEFT JOIN PATH ON CPE_MRN = PRPT_MRN ORDER BY CPE_MRN, "Appt Date", TM_DX_DTE

prompt: Provide a list of pediatric patients tested for COVID and associated order data and the test results
completion: WITH PEDS_R AS (SELECT CPE_MRN PEDS_MRN, CPE_ENC_DTE APPT_DATE, CPE_CPE_APPT_STS STATUS FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE 1=1 AND (CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 = ('PED') OR CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_4 = ('PED') OR CLD_DEPT_NAME = 'ORTHOPEDICS 1275-9') AND CPE_CPE_IP_IND <> 'INPATIENT' UNION SELECT VIS_MRN PEDS_MRN, VIS_ADM_DTE APPT_DATE, 'Inpatient' STATUS FROM IDB.VISIT WHERE VIS_HOSP_SVC IN ('PDB', 'PDG', 'PDP', 'PDR', 'PDU', 'PED', 'PDS') AND VIS_IP_OP_ADJUSTED_IND = 'I' AND VIS_VISIT_STATUS IN ('2', '3') ) , PEDS AS (SELECT PEDS_MRN, STATUS FROM (SELECT PEDS_MRN, STATUS, APPT_DATE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY PEDS_MRN ORDER BY APPT_DATE DESC) RN FROM PEDS_R) WHERE RN = 1 ) , ORD AS (SELECT PEDS_MRN, STATUS, OO_ORD_NAME, OO_ORD_ID, OO_ORD_GUID, OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE, OUD_USER_DI_CD, OUD_USER_DI_VALUE, OSTS_STS_DESC, OCV_CURR_LOC LOCATION FROM PEDS JOIN IDB.OMS_ORDER ON PEDS_MRN = OO_MRN JOIN IDB.OMS_STATUS ON OO_ORD_STS_CD = OSTS_ORD_STS_CD JOIN IDB.OMS_CLIENT_VISIT ON OO_VISIT_GUID = OCV_VISIT_GUID LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_USER_DATA ON OO_ORD_GUID = OUD_ORD_GUID AND OUD_USER_DI_CD IN ('Micro-COVID Questions', 'Micro-COVID Screening', 'LBRZ_COVID_PatientType', 'LBRZ_CMICRO_COVID', 'LBRZ_COVID_Indicator', 'Lab_Specimen Collected On', 'Micro-COVID Surveillance', 'LBRZ_SREQ', 'LBRZ_COVID_Caregiver FN', 'LBRZ_COVID_Caregiver LN', 'LBRZ_COVID_Caregiver MRN') WHERE OO_ORD_STS_CD NOT IN ('CANP', 'CANC', 'AUC3') AND OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE = CURRENT date - 1 DAY AND OO_ORD_NAME IN ('COVID-19 antiBODY Qualitative IgG', 'COVID-19 Blood Collection', 'COVID-19 Other Patient Type', 'COVID-19 Patient Type', 'COVID-19 Qualitative RNA', 'COVID-19 Rapid Qualitative RNA', 'COVID-19 Rapid Qualitative RNA Result', 'COVID-19 Rapid Qualitative RNA Specimen Type', 'COVID-19 RNA Result', 'COVID-19 Screening (NO)', 'COVID-19 Specimen Type') ) , ORD_PIVOT AS (SELECT PEDS_MRN, STATUS, OO_ORD_NAME, OO_ORD_ID, OO_ORD_GUID, OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE, OSTS_STS_DESC, LOCATION, MAX(CASE WHEN OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'Micro-COVID Questions' AND LOWER(OUD_USER_DI_VALUE) like '%within the last 14 days patient has been in close contact with a person confirmed to have novel coronavirus%' THEN 'Y' END) "14 days close contact", MAX(CASE WHEN OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'Micro-COVID Questions' AND LOWER(OUD_USER_DI_VALUE) like '%currently patient has fever, cough, sob, body aches and/or chills%' THEN 'Y' END) "Current Fever/Cough/SOB/Body Aches/Chills", MAX(CASE WHEN OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'Micro-COVID Screening' THEN OUD_USER_DI_VALUE END) "Pre-screening", MAX(CASE WHEN OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'LBRZ_COVID_PatientType' THEN OUD_USER_DI_VALUE END) "Patient Type", MAX(CASE WHEN OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'LBRZ_COVID_Caregiver FN' THEN OUD_USER_DI_VALUE END) "Ped Patient First Name", MAX(CASE WHEN OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'LBRZ_COVID_Caregiver LN' THEN OUD_USER_DI_VALUE END) "Ped Patient Last Name", MAX(CASE WHEN OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'LBRZ_COVID_Caregiver MRN' THEN OUD_USER_DI_VALUE END) "Ped Patient MRN", MAX(CASE WHEN OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'LBRZ_CMICRO_COVID' THEN OUD_USER_DI_VALUE END) "Specimen Desc", MAX(CASE WHEN OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'LBRZ_COVID_Indicator' THEN OUD_USER_DI_VALUE END) "Isolation Indicator", MAX(CASE WHEN OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'Lab_Specimen Collected On' THEN OUD_USER_DI_VALUE END) "Specimen collected on date", MAX(CASE WHEN OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'Micro-COVID Surveillance' THEN OUD_USER_DI_VALUE END) "Surveillance Type", MAX(CASE WHEN OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'LBRZ_SREQ' THEN OUD_USER_DI_VALUE END) "Special Requests" FROM ORD GROUP BY PEDS_MRN, STATUS, OO_ORD_NAME, OO_ORD_ID, OO_ORD_GUID, OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE, OSTS_STS_DESC, LOCATION) , CDB AS (SELECT TM_MRN, LISTAGG(CHAR(TM_DX_DTE) || ': ' || TRIM(TM_SITE_CD) || ' ' || TRIM(S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK) || ' ' || TRIM(TM_HIST_CD) || ' ' || TRIM(H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK), CHR(13)||CHR(10)) TUMOR FROM (SELECT DISTINCT PEDS_MRN FROM ORD_PIVOT) JOIN IDB.CDB_TUMOR ON PEDS_MRN = TM_MRN JOIN IDB.CLM H ON TM_HIST_CD = H.CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON TM_SITE_CD = S.CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') GROUP BY TM_MRN ) , LAST_APPT AS (SELECT CPE_MRN, CPE_ENC_DTE, CRE_RES_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CPE_MRN ORDER BY CPE_APPT_DT DESC) RN FROM (SELECT DISTINCT PEDS_MRN FROM ORD_PIVOT) JOIN IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER ON PEDS_MRN = CPE_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE H ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CRE_RES_TYP = 'Physician' ) , MD AS (SELECT PEDS_MRN MD_MRN, PRIMARY_RESOURCE_NAME, CNT, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY PEDS_MRN ORDER BY CNT DESC) RN FROM (SELECT D.PEDS_MRN, CRE_RES_NAME PRIMARY_RESOURCE_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT CPE_ENC_CSN_ID) CNT FROM (SELECT DISTINCT PEDS_MRN FROM ORD_PIVOT) D JOIN IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER A ON D.PEDS_MRN = A.CPE_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID WHERE CRE_RES_TYP = 'Physician' AND CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') GROUP BY D.PEDS_MRN, CRE_RES_NAME )) SELECT OO_ORD_NAME ORDER_NAME, OSTS_STS_DESC ORDER_STATUS, TRIM(PT_LAST_NAME) ||', ' || TRIM(PT_FIRST_NAME) NAME, PEDS_MRN MRN, VARCHAR_FORMAT(PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, 'MM/DD/YYYY') DOB, PRIMARY_RESOURCE_NAME, LOCATION, "Patient Type", "Ped Patient First Name", "Ped Patient Last Name", "Ped Patient MRN", "Isolation Indicator", "Surveillance Type", "Special Requests", "Specimen collected on date", L.COR_RESULT_TEXT "Result" FROM ORD_PIVOT OP JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PEDS_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.COVID19_ORDER_AND_RESULT L ON PEDS_MRN = COR_MRN AND OO_ORD_GUID = COR_ORDER_GUID LEFT JOIN CDB ON PEDS_MRN = TM_MRN LEFT JOIN LAST_APPT LA ON PEDS_MRN = CPE_MRN AND LA.RN = 1 LEFT JOIN MD MD ON PEDS_MRN = MD_MRN AND MD.RN = 1 WHERE COALESCE(COR_PATIENT_TYPE, '') <> 'Employee' ORDER BY 1, 7

prompt: Single and Multi-Panel OR Cases for Gyn, Breast & Plastics
completion: WITH MULTIPANEL AS (SELECT DISTINCT SSP_LOG_ID MULTIPANEL_LOG_ID FROM IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE ON SSE_LOG_ID = SSP_LOG_ID AND SSE_ENC_CSN_ID = SSP_ENC_CSN_ID WHERE (SSE_SURG_LOC not like '%IR%' AND SSE_SURG_LOC not like '%ENDO%' AND SSE_SOURCE_TYPE <> 'E') AND YEAR(SSE_SURG_DTE) >= 2018 AND SSP_SURG_SVC_CD IN ('BRE', 'PLA', 'GYN') AND SSP_PNL_NO > 1 ) , PANEL_TIME AS (SELECT OLPT_LOG_ID, OLPT_PNL_NO, MAX(CASE WHEN OLPT_PNL_EVNT_CD = '200' THEN TIME(OLPT_EVNT_IN_DT) END) PANEL_START, MAX(CASE WHEN OLPT_PNL_EVNT_CD = '300' THEN TIME(OLPT_EVNT_IN_DT) END) PANEL_END FROM IDB.OR_LOG_PANEL_TIMES GROUP BY OLPT_LOG_ID, OLPT_PNL_NO) SELECT DISTINCT SSP_LOG_ID "Log ID", SSP_PNL_NO "Panel No", SSE_SURG_DTE "Surgery Date", PANEL_START "Panel Start", PANEL_END "Panel End", TIME(SSE_PT_IN_DT) "Patient In Time", TIME(SSE_PT_OUT_DT) "Patient Out Time", SSE_MRN MRN, SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD "CPT Code", SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC "CPT Description", SSP_LATERALITY "Laterality", TRIM(SSP_SURG_LAST_NM) || ', ' || TRIM(SSP_SURG_FIRST_NM) "Surgeon", SSP_SURG_SVC_CD "Service", SSE_SURG_LOC "Location" FROM IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE ON SSE_LOG_ID = SSP_LOG_ID AND SSE_ENC_CSN_ID = SSP_ENC_CSN_ID JOIN PANEL_TIME ON SSP_LOG_ID = OLPT_LOG_ID AND SSP_PNL_NO = OLPT_PNL_NO WHERE (SSE_SURG_LOC not like '%IR%' AND SSE_SURG_LOC not like '%ENDO%' AND SSE_SOURCE_TYPE <> 'E') AND YEAR(SSE_SURG_DTE) >= 2018 AND SSP_SURG_SVC_CD IN ('BRE', 'PLA', 'GYN') AND SSP_LOG_ID NOT IN (SELECT * FROM MULTIPANEL) ORDER BY 1, 2, 9 ; WITH MULTIPANEL AS (SELECT DISTINCT SSP_LOG_ID MULTIPANEL_LOG_ID FROM IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE ON SSE_LOG_ID = SSP_LOG_ID AND SSE_ENC_CSN_ID = SSP_ENC_CSN_ID WHERE (SSE_SURG_LOC not like '%IR%' AND SSE_SURG_LOC not like '%ENDO%' AND SSE_SOURCE_TYPE <> 'E') AND YEAR(SSE_SURG_DTE) >= 2018 AND SSP_SURG_SVC_CD IN ('BRE', 'PLA', 'GYN') AND SSP_PNL_NO > 1 ) , OTHERCASES AS (SELECT DISTINCT SSP_LOG_ID OTHERCASES_LOG_ID FROM IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE ON SSE_LOG_ID = SSP_LOG_ID AND SSE_ENC_CSN_ID = SSP_ENC_CSN_ID WHERE (SSE_SURG_LOC not like '%IR%' AND SSE_SURG_LOC not like '%ENDO%' AND SSE_SOURCE_TYPE <> 'E') AND YEAR(SSE_SURG_DTE) >= 2018 AND SSP_SURG_SVC_CD NOT IN ('BRE', 'PLA', 'GYN') ) , PANEL_TIME AS (SELECT OLPT_LOG_ID, OLPT_PNL_NO, MAX(CASE WHEN OLPT_PNL_EVNT_CD = '200' THEN TIME(OLPT_EVNT_IN_DT) END) PANEL_START, MAX(CASE WHEN OLPT_PNL_EVNT_CD = '300' THEN TIME(OLPT_EVNT_IN_DT) END) PANEL_END FROM IDB.OR_LOG_PANEL_TIMES GROUP BY OLPT_LOG_ID, OLPT_PNL_NO) SELECT DISTINCT SSP_LOG_ID "Log ID", SSP_PNL_NO "Panel No", SSE_SURG_DTE "Surgery Date", PANEL_START "Panel Start", PANEL_END "Panel End", TIME(SSE_PT_IN_DT) "Patient In Time", TIME(SSE_PT_OUT_DT) "Patient Out Time", SSE_MRN MRN, SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD "CPT Code", SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC "CPT Description", SSP_LATERALITY "Laterality", TRIM(SSP_SURG_LAST_NM) || ', ' || TRIM(SSP_SURG_FIRST_NM) "Surgeon", SSP_SURG_SVC_CD "Service", SSE_SURG_LOC "Location" FROM IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE ON SSE_LOG_ID = SSP_LOG_ID AND SSE_ENC_CSN_ID = SSP_ENC_CSN_ID JOIN MULTIPANEL ON SSP_LOG_ID = MULTIPANEL_LOG_ID JOIN PANEL_TIME ON SSP_LOG_ID = OLPT_LOG_ID AND SSP_PNL_NO = OLPT_PNL_NO WHERE (SSE_SURG_LOC not like '%IR%' AND SSE_SURG_LOC not like '%ENDO%' AND SSE_SOURCE_TYPE <> 'E') AND YEAR(SSE_SURG_DTE) >= 2018 AND SSP_SURG_SVC_CD IN ('BRE', 'PLA', 'GYN') AND SSP_LOG_ID NOT IN (SELECT * FROM OTHERCASES) ORDER BY 1, 2, 9

prompt: Design a weekly report of OR cases scheduled in the next 7 days with an ambulatory nerve catheter.
completion: WITH X AS (SELECT DISTINCT OC_CASE_ID AS CASE_NO, STRIP(OC_MRN) AS MRN, STRIP(PT_LAST_NAME) || ', ' || STRIP(PT_FIRST_NAME) AS "Patient Name", PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH AS DOB, YEAR(OC_SURG_DTE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) AS "Patient Age", PT_SEX AS "Gender", VIS_ADM_DTE, VIS_DSCH_DTE, CASE WHEN CURRENT date BETWEEN VIS_ADM_DTE AND COALESCE(VIS_DSCH_DTE, CURRENT date) THEN 'IP' ELSE 'OP' END AS PT_STATUS, STRIP(OC_OR_CASE_STS) AS SURGSTATUS, OC_SURG_DTE AS "Scheduled Date", OC_SCH_DT AS SURGDATETIME, TIME(OC_SCH_DT) AS "Scheduled Time", OC_SURG_LOC_ID, LOC_LOC_NAME, LOC_LOC_ABBR, CASE WHEN OC_SURG_LOC_ID=1000010 THEN 'Main OR' WHEN OC_SURG_LOC_ID=1000020 THEN 'SDH' WHEN OC_SURG_LOC_ID=1000030 THEN 'Endoscopy' WHEN OC_SURG_LOC_ID=1000300 THEN 'JRSC' WHEN OC_SURG_LOC_ID=1000080 THEN 'IR Room' WHEN OC_SURG_LOC_ID=1000060 THEN 'CMK IR' WHEN OC_SURG_LOC_ID=1000070 THEN 'WES IR' WHEN OC_SURG_LOC_ID=1000500 THEN 'KOCH IR' WHEN OC_SURG_LOC_ID=1000600 THEN 'MON OR' WHEN OC_SURG_LOC_ID=1000700 THEN 'MON IR' ELSE 'Other' END AS "Location Name", CASE WHEN OC_SURG_LOC_ID=1000010 THEN 'M6' WHEN OC_SURG_LOC_ID=1000020 THEN 'M2' WHEN OC_SURG_LOC_ID=1000030 THEN 'ENDO' WHEN OC_SURG_LOC_ID=1000300 THEN 'JRSC' WHEN OC_SURG_LOC_ID=1000080 THEN 'IR' WHEN OC_SURG_LOC_ID=1000060 THEN 'CMK IR' WHEN OC_SURG_LOC_ID=1000070 THEN 'WES IR' WHEN OC_SURG_LOC_ID=1000500 THEN 'KOCH IR' WHEN OC_SURG_LOC_ID=1000600 THEN 'MON OR' WHEN OC_SURG_LOC_ID=1000700 THEN 'MON IR' ELSE 'Other' END AS "Location", STRIP(ROOM.CRE_RES_NAME) AS "OR Room", OC_PAIN_MGMT AS "Pain Mgmt", RES.CRE_RES_NAME AS SURGEON, CPX_PROC_CD, CPX_PROC_NAME, OP_OR_PROC_ID, OP_PROC_NAME, OCP_OR_PROC_ID, OCAS_PNL_NO, OCP_LINE_NO, OCP_PROC_ID FROM IDB.OR_CASE JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON OC_MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.VISIT_V ON VIS_MRN = PT_MRN AND VIS_IP_OP_ADJUSTED_IND = 'I' AND VIS_VISIT_STATUS IN ('2', '3') AND CURRENT date BETWEEN VIS_ADM_DTE AND COALESCE(VIS_DSCH_DTE, CURRENT date) JOIN IDB.OR_CASE_ALL_PROC ON OC_CASE_ID = OCAP_CASE_ID JOIN IDB.OR_CASE_ALL_SURG ON OCAP_CASE_ID = OCAS_CASE_ID AND OCAS_PNL_NO = OCAP_PNL_NO JOIN IDB.OR_PROC ON OCAP_OR_PROC_ID = OP_OR_PROC_ID JOIN IDB.OR_CL_PROC ON OP_OR_PROC_ID = OCP_OR_PROC_ID JOIN IDB.CL_PROC ON OCP_PROC_ID = CPX_PROC_ID JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE RES ON OCAS_RES_ID = RES.CRE_RES_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ROOM ON OC_ROOM_RES_ID = ROOM.CRE_RES_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_LOCATION ON OC_SURG_LOC_ID = LOC_LOC_ID WHERE 1=1 AND OC_SURG_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT date + 3 DAY AND CURRENT date + 7 DAYS AND OC_OR_CASE_STS_CD NOT IN ('2', '5') AND OC_PAIN_MGMT = 'Amb NRV Cath' ) , Y1 AS (SELECT DISTINCT CASE_NO, OP_PROC_NAME, SURGEON FROM X) , Y2 AS (SELECT CASE_NO, OP_PROC_NAME, SURGEON, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CASE_NO ORDER BY OP_PROC_NAME, SURGEON) AS RN FROM Y1) , Y AS (SELECT CASE_NO, LISTAGG(COALESCE(STRIP(CAST(RN AS VARCHAR(1000))), '') || ' ' || COALESCE(STRIP(CAST(OP_PROC_NAME AS VARCHAR(1000))), '') || ' | ' || COALESCE(STRIP(CAST(SURGEON AS VARCHAR(1000))), '') , CHR(13) || CHR(10)) WITHIN GROUP( ORDER BY CASE_NO, OP_PROC_NAME, SURGEON) AS "Procedure | Surgeon" FROM Y2 GROUP BY CASE_NO) SELECT DISTINCT X.CASE_NO, MRN, "Patient Name", DOB, "Patient Age", "Gender", "Scheduled Date", "Scheduled Time", "Location Name", "OR Room", "Pain Mgmt", "Procedure | Surgeon" FROM X LEFT JOIN Y ON X.CASE_NO = Y.CASE_NO

prompt: Provide de-identified information on patients diagnosed with Hepatocellular Carcinoma and are receiving Metformin.
completion: SELECT DISTINCT "t1"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AS "Deident PT #", "t2"."DT_YEAR" AS "Tumor Diagnosis Year", "t3"."DXCC_ICD_CODE" AS "ICD-O Histology Code", "t3"."DXCC_ICD_MSK_DESC" AS "ICD-O Histology Description", "t4"."ICSC_SITE_CD" AS "ICD-O Site Code", "t4"."ICSC_ICDO_SITE_MSK_DESC" AS "ICD-O Site Description", "t5"."DT_YEAR" AS "First Order Start Year", "t6"."PINC_GENERIC_NAME" AS "Generic Drug Name" FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V" "t7" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED" "t1" ON "t7"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t1"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."CDB_TUMOR_V" "t8" ON "t1"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t8"."CDTM_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" "t2" ON "t8"."CDTM_DX_DATE_ID" = "t2"."DT_DATE_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DIAGNOSIS_CODE_CAT_ICDO_V" "t3" ON "t8"."CDTM_DX_CATALOG_ID" = "t3"."DXCC_DX_CATALOG_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."ICDO_SITE_CATALOG_V" "t4" ON "t8"."CDTM_SITE_CATALOG_ID" = "t4"."ICSC_SITE_CATALOG_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PHM_PT_MEDS_MQT" "t9" ON "t1"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t9"."POD_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" "t5" ON "t9"."FIST_START_DATE_ID" = "t5"."DT_DATE_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PHM_ORDER_DTL" "t10" ON "t9"."POD_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t10"."POD_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AND "t9"."POD_PHARMA_INVENTORY_CTLG_ID" = "t10"."POD_PHARMA_INVENTORY_CTLG_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PHM_INVENTORY_CATALOG" "t6" ON "t10"."POD_PHARMA_INVENTORY_CTLG_ID" = "t6"."PINC_INVENTORY_CTLG_ID" WHERE ("t3"."DXCC_ICD_CODE" IN ('M8170/3', 'M8171/3', 'M8172/3', 'M8173/3', 'M8174/3', 'M8175/3', 'M8180/3') AND UPPER("t6"."PINC_GENERIC_NAME") IN ('GLYBURIDE-METFORMIN', 'GLYBURIDE/METFORMIN HCL', 'METFORMIN-PIOGLITAZONE', 'METFORMIN', 'METFORMIN HCL', 'METFORMIN HCL', 'NF-METFORMIN XR'))

prompt: Provide baseline Body Mass Index (BMI) for a cohort of patients treated with chemotherapy at the time of treatment initiation
completion: SELECT PT_MRN, MRPT_PERFORMED_DTE, MRPT_ACCESSION_NO, RCI_CATEGORY1, RCI_CATEGORY2, RCI_ITEM_NAME, MRPT_MED_REPORT_TXT FROM DV.MEDICAL_REPORTS JOIN DV.RESULT_CATALOG_ITEM ON MPRT_RESULT_CATALOG_ITEM_ID = RCI_RESULT_CATALOG_ITEM_ID JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON MRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID WHERE RCI_CATEGORY1 IN ('MRI', 'CT Scan') AND PT_MRN IN {} SELECT PT_MRN, PT_SEX, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, PT_DATE_OF_DEATH, TRIM(R.AV_DESC) AS PT_RACE, TRIM(E.AV_DESC) AS PT_ETHNICITY, LAD_LST_APPT_DTE FROM IDB.PATIENT LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS R ON R.AV_ELEMENT = 'RACE' AND R.AV_CODE = PT_RACE LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS E ON E.AV_ELEMENT = 'PT_ETHNICITY' AND E.AV_CODE = PT_PT_ETHNICITY LEFT JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTV_DTL ON PT_MRN = LAD_MRN WHERE PT_MRN IN {} SELECT TM_MRN, AV_DESC AS CASE_STS, TM_DX_DTE, TM_HIST_CD, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS HIST_DESC, TM_SITE_CD, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_DESC FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS ON AV_ELEMENT = 'CASE_STS' AND AV_CODE = TM_CASE_STS WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND TM_HIST_CD IN ('M8120/0', 'M8120/2', 'M8120/3', 'M8120/6', 'M8121/1', 'M8122/3', 'M8122/6', 'M8130/2', 'M8130/3', 'M8130/6', 'M8131/3') AND TM_DX_DTE BETWEEN '2000-01-01' AND CURRENT date AND TM_MRN IN {} SELECT LR_MRN, LR_PERFORMED_DTE, LR_ORD_GUID, LR_TEST_NAME, LR_SUBTEST_NAME, LR_RESULT_VALUE, LTL_TEXT_RESULT, LR_ABNORMALITY_CD FROM IDB.LAB_RESULTS LEFT JOIN IDB.LAB_TEXT_LINE ON LTL_RESULT_GUID = LR_RESULT_GUID WHERE TRIM(LR_TEST_NAME) IN ('Comprehensive Metabolic Panel', 'Complete Blood Count (CBC), WITH Differential') AND LR_MRN IN {} SELECT PMH_MRN, PMH_MEASURE_DTE, PMH_WT_KG, PMH_HT_CM, PMH_BSA, PMH_BMI, PMH_MEASURE_SYS FROM IDB.PT_MEASURES_HX WHERE PMH_MRN IN {} SELECT APR_MRN, APR_START_DTE, APR_END_DTE, CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME, APR_GENERIC_NAME, APR_PRESCRIBED_DOSE, APR_ROUTE FROM IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX JOIN IDB.CHEMO_DRUG_GENERIC ON APR_GENERIC_NAME = CDG_GENERIC_NAME WHERE APR_MRN IN {}

prompt: Identify all patients who had an MRI prior to prostatectomy at MSKCC from 1/1/2001 to present.
completion: WITH PROSTATECTOMY AS (SELECT PBD_MRN AS MRN, PBD_SVC_DTE AS DTE FROM IDB.PBD_DTL JOIN IDB.PBD_CODE ON PBD_PBD_CD = PBC_PBD_CD JOIN IDB.CLM ON PBC_CPT_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE PBC_CPT_CD IN ('52650', '55701', '55801', '55810', '55812', '55815', '55821', '55831', '55840', '55842', '55845', '55862', '55865', '55866') ) SELECT PT_MRN AS "MRN", PT_LAST_NAME AS "Last Name", PT_FIRST_NAME AS "First Name", PT_SEX AS "Sex", PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH AS "Date of Birth", PT_DATE_OF_DEATH AS "Date of Death", MAX(PBD_SVC_DTE) AS "Date of MRI", DTE AS "Date of Prostatectomy" FROM IDB.PATIENT JOIN PROSTATECTOMY ON PT_MRN = MRN JOIN IDB.PBD_DTL ON PBD_MRN = MRN AND PBD_SVC_DTE <= DTE AND PBD_SVC_DTE >= '2001-01-01' JOIN IDB.PBD_CODE ON PBD_PBD_CD = PBC_PBD_CD WHERE PBC_CPT_CD IN ('72195', '72196', '72197', '74181', '74182', '74183') GROUP BY PT_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_SEX, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, PT_DATE_OF_DEATH, DTE

prompt: Provide a list of all Covid-19 tests results that have been ordered by a pediatrics provider
completion: SELECT COR_MRN "MRN" , CASE WHEN LOWER(COR_RESULT_TEXT) like 'detected%' THEN 'Positive' WHEN COR_ORDER_NAME IN ('COVID-19 Rapid Qualitative RNA') AND LOWER(COR_RESULT_TEXT) like 'positive%' THEN 'Positive' WHEN COR_ORDER_NAME IN ('COVID-19 Rapid Qualitative RNA') AND LOWER(COR_RESULT_TEXT) like 'negative%' THEN 'Negative' WHEN COR_ORDER_NAME IN ('COVID-19 Rapid Qualitative RNA') AND (LOWER(COR_RESULT_TEXT) like 'inconclusive%' OR LOWER(COR_RESULT_TEXT) like '%invalid%' OR LOWER(COR_RESULT_TEXT) like 'presumptive%') THEN 'Pending' WHEN COR_ORDER_NAME IN ('Notice of Non-MSK Positive COVID-19 Test', 'MSK Engage Recovery Tracker') THEN 'Positive' WHEN LOWER(COR_RESULT_TEXT) like 'not detected%' THEN 'Negative' WHEN (COR_ABNORMALITY_CODE IS NULL OR LOWER(COR_RESULT_TEXT) like 'inconclusive%' OR LOWER(COR_RESULT_TEXT) like 'indeterminant%' OR LOWER(COR_RESULT_TEXT) like 'invalid%') THEN 'Pending' END "Result" , COR_PATIENT_TYPE "Patient Type" , COR_ORDER_NAME "Order Name" , COR_SIGNIFICANT_DT "Order Date" , COR_RESULT_ARRIVAL_DT "Result Date" , CCV_PROVIDER_NAME "Provider on visit" , OL_LOC_NAME "Current Location" FROM IDB.COVID19_ORDER_AND_RESULT R JOIN IDB.COVID19_CLIENT_VISIT ON COR_VISIT_GUID = CCV_CLIENT_VISIT_GUID LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_LOCATION ON CCV_CURRENT_LOCATION_GUID = OL_LOC_GUID WHERE STRIP(COR_MRN) NOT IN ('11111111', '22222222') AND COR_ORDER_STATUS_CODE NOT IN ('CANP', 'CANC', 'HOLD', 'AUC3') AND COR_PATIENT_TYPE like 'Patient%' AND CCV_SERVICE_GROUP_CODE IN ('PACC', 'PDR', 'PDS', 'PED', 'PEDS', 'PDB', 'PDG', 'PDU') ORDER BY COR_SIGNIFICANT_DT DESC ;

prompt: Provide a list of all patients at MSKCC with dermatopathology illustrating IgA vasculitis.
completion: WITH X AS (SELECT DISTINCT "t1"."PT_MRN" AS "MRN", "t2"."PRPT_ACCESSION_NO" AS "Pathology Report", "t3"."PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_DESC" AS "Pathology Report Type", "t4"."DT_DTE" AS "Pathology Procedure Date", "t5"."DT_DTE" AS "Pathology Report Date", UPPER(CASE WHEN LENGTH(PRPT_REPORT) <= 15000 THEN RTRIM(CAST(SUBSTR(PRPT_REPORT, 1, 15000) AS VARCHAR(15000))) ELSE CAST(SUBSTR(PRPT_REPORT, 1, 15000) AS VARCHAR(15000)) END) AS TXT FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V" "t1" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED" "t6" ON "t1"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t6"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V" "t2" ON "t6"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t2"."PRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATH_RPRT_TYPE_LOOKUP" "t3" ON "t2"."PRPT_REPORT_TYPE" = "t3"."PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_CD" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" "t4" ON "t2"."PRPT_PROCEDURE_DATE_ID" = "t4"."DT_DATE_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" "t5" ON "t2"."PRPT_REPORT_DATE_ID" = "t5"."DT_DATE_ID" WHERE (CONTAINS("t2"."PRPT_REPORT", '(("IgA vasculitis" | "immunoglobulin A" | "vasculitis") & ("direct immunofluorescence" | " dif "))') = 1 AND "t2"."PRPT_REPORT" IS NOT NULL) AND YEAR("t5"."DT_DTE" - PT_BIRTH_DTE) >= 18 AND "t4"."DT_DTE" BETWEEN '1966-04-01' AND '2020-09-01' ) SELECT PT_MRN AS MRN, STRIP(PT_LAST_NAME) || ', ' || STRIP(PT_FIRST_NAME) AS NAME, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH AS DOB, PT_SEX AS GENDER, PT_DATE_OF_DEATH, R.AV_DESC AS "Race", E.AV_DESC AS "Ethnicity", CPE_ENC_DTE, CRE_RES_NAME, CLD_DEPT_NAME, "Pathology Procedure Date", "Pathology Report Date", "Pathology Report", TXT FROM X JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PT_MRN = MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS R ON PT_RACE = R.AV_CODE AND R.AV_ELEMENT = 'RACE' LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS E ON PT_PT_ETHNICITY = E.AV_CODE AND E.AV_ELEMENT = 'PT_ETHNICITY' JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN, CPE_ENC_DTE, CRE_RES_NAME, CRE_RES_TYP, CLD_DEPT_NAME, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8, CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CPE_MRN ORDER BY CPE_ENC_DTE DESC) AS RN FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CRE_RES_TYP IN ('Physician') AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 = 'DER' AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN '1966-04-01' AND '2020-09-01' ) DER ON CPE_MRN = PT_MRN AND RN = 1

prompt:
Grant IDB ID FIDBAPPS SELECT permission to the following IDB objects.



IDB.PBD_DTL_CHARGES

IDB.PBD_INVOICE

IDB.PBD_CODE
completion: SELECT DR_NO, DOC_NAME, DOC_SVC, RPT_MONTH, COUNT(*) IP_CONSULTS FROM (SELECT DOC_DR_NO DR_NO, DOC_NAME, DOC_SVC , PBD_MRN, PBD_ACCT_NO, PBD_SVC_DTE SVC_DTE , STRIP(PBC_CPT_CD)||' - '||PBC_PBD_DESC CPT_DESC , SUBSTR(CHAR(PBD_SVC_DTE), 1, 7) AS RPT_MONTH FROM IDB.PBD_DTL_CHARGES JOIN IDB.PBD_INVOICE ON PBI_MRN = PBD_MRN AND PBI_ACCT_NO = PBD_ACCT_NO AND PBI_INV_NO = PBD_INV_NO AND PBI_INV_STS = ' ' JOIN IDB.PBD_CODE ON PBD_PBD_CD = PBC_PBD_CD JOIN IDB.DOC ON DOC_DR_NO = PBI_PERFORM_DR_NO AND DOC_SVC IN ('BRE', 'GMT', 'GYN', 'HEP', 'HNS', 'NRS', 'OPH', 'ORT', 'REC', 'THR', 'URO', 'PLA') WHERE PBD_SVC_DTE BETWEEN '2014-01-01' AND CURRENT DATE AND PBC_CPT_CD LIKE '992%' AND PBC_PBD_DESC LIKE '%INP%CONS%' ) PBD GROUP BY DR_NO, DOC_NAME, DOC_SVC, RPT_MONTH

prompt: Provide a list of patients who underwent bronchoscopy with foreign body removal (CPT 31635) from 2008-2019
completion: WITH PROCEDURES AS (SELECT SSE_MRN, SSE_SURG_DTE, SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD, SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC, SSP_SURG_LAST_NM, SSP_SURG_FIRST_NM, SSP_SURG_SVC_CD FROM IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE ON SSE_LOG_ID = SSP_LOG_ID AND SSE_ENC_CSN_ID = SSP_ENC_CSN_ID WHERE 1=1 AND SSE_SURG_DTE BETWEEN '2008-01-01' AND CURRENT date AND SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD = '31635' ) , DX AS (SELECT TM_MRN, C.AV_DESC AS CASE_STS, TM_DX_DTE, TM_HIST_CD, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS HIST_DESC, TM_SITE_CD, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_DESC, SM.AV_DESC AS SMOKING_HX FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS C ON C.AV_ELEMENT = 'CASE_STS' AND C.AV_CODE = TM_CASE_STS LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS SM ON SM.AV_ELEMENT = 'SMOKING_HX' AND SM.AV_CODE = TM_SMOKING_HX JOIN PROCEDURES ON SSE_MRN = TM_MRN WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND TM_DX_DTE >= '2000-01-01' ) SELECT DISTINCT SSE_MRN "MRN", PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH "DOB", PT_DATE_OF_DEATH "DOD", SSE_SURG_DTE "Surgery Date", YEAR(SSE_SURG_DTE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) "Age at Surgery", SSP_SURG_LAST_NM "Surgeon Last Name", SSP_SURG_FIRST_NM "Surgeon First Name", SSP_SURG_SVC_CD "Service", SITE_DESC "Dx Site", HIST_DESC "Dx Histology", SMOKING_HX "Smoking History" FROM PROCEDURES JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON SSE_MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN DX ON SSE_MRN = TM_MRN ORDER BY SSE_MRN, SSE_SURG_DTE, SITE_DESC

prompt: Need number of Pediatric solid tumor patients on ERAS protocol.
completion: WITH ORDERS_0 AS (SELECT "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AS PT_DEID, "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_MRN" AS PT_MRN, "IDB"."OMS_ORDER"."OO_ORD_GUID" AS SUBJECT_ID, "IDB"."OMS_ORDER"."OO_ORD_NAME" AS ORDER_NAME FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS" JOIN "IDB"."OMS_ORDER" ON "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_MRN" = "IDB"."OMS_ORDER"."OO_MRN" WHERE "IDB"."OMS_ORDER"."OO_ORD_STS_CD" NOT IN ('CANP', 'CANC', 'AUC3') AND "IDB"."OMS_ORDER"."OO_ORD_NAME" IN ('Place on PEDIATRIC Thoracotomy ERAS Pathway') ), COHORT AS (SELECT PT_DEID AS PT_DEID FROM (SELECT ORDERS_0.PT_DEID AS PT_DEID FROM ORDERS_0)), COHORT_ORDERS AS (SELECT SUBJECT_ID AS SUBJECT_ID, PT_DEID AS PT_DEID FROM (SELECT ORDERS_0.SUBJECT_ID AS SUBJECT_ID, ORDERS_0.PT_DEID AS PT_DEID FROM ORDERS_0)), KEYS AS (SELECT COHORT.PT_DEID AS COHORT_PT_DEID, COHORT_ORDERS.SUBJECT_ID AS COHORT_ORDERS_SUBJECT_ID, COHORT_ORDERS.PT_DEID AS COHORT_ORDERS_PT_DEID FROM COHORT LEFT OUTER JOIN COHORT_ORDERS ON COHORT_ORDERS.PT_DEID = COHORT.PT_DEID), DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS AS (SELECT DISTINCT "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AS PT_DEID, IDB_PATIENT."PT_MRN" AS PT_MRN, "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AS SUBJECT_ID FROM "IDB"."PATIENT" AS IDB_PATIENT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS" ON IDB_PATIENT."PT_MRN" = "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_MRN"), DIAGNOSIS_TR_COLUMNS AS (SELECT DISTINCT "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AS PT_DEID, "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_MRN" AS PT_MRN, CAST(TRIM("IDB"."CDB_TUMOR"."TM_MRN") AS VARCHAR) || CAST(TRIM("IDB"."CDB_TUMOR"."TM_TUMOR_SEQ") AS VARCHAR) || CAST(TRIM("IDB"."CDB_TUMOR"."TM_DX_DTE") AS VARCHAR) AS SUBJECT_ID, "IDB"."ALLOWVALS"."AV_DESC" AS DX_TR_CASE_STATUS, "IDB"."CDB_TUMOR"."TM_BEST_AJCC_STG" AS DX_TR_STAGE, TRIM("IDB"."CDB_TUMOR"."TM_SITE_CD") || ' - ' || TRIM(CLM_SITE."CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK") AS DX_TR_SITE, TRIM("IDB"."CDB_TUMOR"."TM_HIST_CD") || ' - ' || TRIM(CLM_HIST."CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK") AS DX_TR_HISTOLOGY, "IDB"."CDB_TUMOR"."TM_DX_DTE" AS DX_TR_DX_DATE, YEAR("IDB"."CDB_TUMOR"."TM_DX_DTE" - DEMO_AGE."PT_BIRTH_DTE") AS AGE_AT_CANCER_DIAGNOSIS_DATE FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS" JOIN "IDB"."CDB_TUMOR" ON "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_MRN" = "IDB"."CDB_TUMOR"."TM_MRN" JOIN "IDB"."ALLOWVALS" ON "IDB"."ALLOWVALS"."AV_CODE" = "IDB"."CDB_TUMOR"."TM_CASE_STS" AND "IDB"."ALLOWVALS"."AV_ELEMENT" = 'CASE_STS' JOIN "IDB"."CLM" AS CLM_SITE ON CLM_SITE."CLM_CLSF_CD" = "IDB"."CDB_TUMOR"."TM_SITE_CD" JOIN "IDB"."CLM" AS CLM_HIST ON CLM_HIST."CLM_CLSF_CD" = "IDB"."CDB_TUMOR"."TM_HIST_CD" JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS" AS DEMO_AGE ON "IDB"."CDB_TUMOR"."TM_MRN" = DEMO_AGE."PT_MRN") SELECT DISTINCT DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS.PT_DEID AS PT_DEID, DIAGNOSIS_TR_COLUMNS.DX_TR_CASE_STATUS AS DX_TR_CASE_STATUS, DIAGNOSIS_TR_COLUMNS.DX_TR_STAGE AS DX_TR_STAGE, DIAGNOSIS_TR_COLUMNS.DX_TR_SITE AS DX_TR_SITE, DIAGNOSIS_TR_COLUMNS.DX_TR_HISTOLOGY AS DX_TR_HISTOLOGY, DIAGNOSIS_TR_COLUMNS.DX_TR_DX_DATE AS DX_TR_DX_DATE, DIAGNOSIS_TR_COLUMNS.AGE_AT_CANCER_DIAGNOSIS_DATE AS AGE_AT_CANCER_DIAGNOSIS_DATE FROM KEYS LEFT OUTER JOIN DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS ON DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS.PT_DEID = KEYS.COHORT_PT_DEID LEFT OUTER JOIN DIAGNOSIS_TR_COLUMNS ON DIAGNOSIS_TR_COLUMNS.PT_DEID = KEYS.COHORT_PT_DEID;

prompt: Provide a biweekly list of upcoming Interventional Radiology surgery cases for patients with NSCLC or suspected NSCLC
completion: WITH LUNG_CDB AS (SELECT TM_MRN, TM_DX_DTE, TM_SITE_CD, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_DESC, TM_HIST_CD, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS HIST_DESC, TM_BEST_AJCC_STG, ROW_NUMBER()OVER(PARTITION BY TM_MRN ORDER BY TM_DX_DTE, TM_CDB_SEQ_NO, TM_TUMOR_SEQ) RN FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM H ON TM_HIST_CD = H.CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON TM_SITE_CD = S.CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND TM_SITE_CD like 'C34%' AND TM_HIST_CD IN ('M8013/3', 'M8014/3', 'M8022/3', 'M8030/3', 'M8031/3', 'M8032/3', 'M8033/3', 'M8046/3', 'M8052/2', 'M8052/3', 'M8070/2', 'M8070/3', 'M8071/2', 'M8071/3', 'M8072/3', 'M8073/3', 'M8074/2', 'M8074/3', 'M8083/3', 'M8140/2', 'M8140/3', 'M8250/2', 'M8250/3', 'M8251/3', 'M8252/3', 'M8253/3', 'M8254/3', 'M8255/3', 'M8260/2', 'M8260/3', 'M8310/3', 'M8333/3', 'M8480/2', 'M8480/3', 'M8481/3', 'M8490/2', 'M8490/3', 'M8560/2', 'M8560/3', 'M8572/3', 'M8574/3', 'M8972/3', 'M8973/3', 'M8980/3') ) SELECT OC_SURG_DTE DOS, OC_MRN MRN, OC_CASE_ID CASE_ID, PATIENT_NAME, PATIENT_AGE, PATIENT_SEX , OC_NO_OF_PNLS TTL_PNLS, OC_POSTOP_DEST POSTOP_DEST , OCAS_SURG_SVC SVC, OCAP_ANES_TYPE ANES_TYPE , CASE WHEN OC_PT_CLASS IN ('IP', 'PSC', 'SDA', 'PDH', 'EI', 'FSI') THEN 'IP' ELSE 'OP' END AS PT_IND, OC_PT_CLASS PT_CLASS , LOC_LOC_NAME LOC_NAME, RM.CRE_RES_NAME OR_ROOM , SUBSTR(MD.CRE_RES_NAME, 1, 35) SURGEON, OCAP_PNL_NO PNL_NO , OCAP_LINE_NO PROC_SEQ_NO, OCAP_LAT LAT , OP_OR_PROC_ID OR_PROC_ID , OP_PROC_NAME OR_PROC_NAME, OCP_LINE_NO CPT_SEQ_NO , CPX_PROC_CD CPT, CPX_PROC_NAME CPT_DESC , RTRIM(DX1.CDX_ICD10)||' - '|| DX1.CDX_DX_NAME PREOP_DX1 , RTRIM(DX2.CDX_ICD10)||' - '|| DX2.CDX_DX_NAME PREOP_DX2 , TM_DX_DTE, TM_SITE_CD, SITE_DESC, TM_HIST_CD, HIST_DESC , RF.CRE_RES_NAME REF_MD , CASE WHEN AC_MRN IS NOT NULL THEN 'Y' END IRB_12_245 FROM IDB.OR_CASE JOIN IDB.PERIOP_CASE_EVENT_V ON OC_CASE_ID = CASE_NUMBER JOIN IDB.OR_CASE_ALL_PROC ON OC_CASE_ID = OCAP_CASE_ID JOIN IDB.OR_CASE_ALL_SURG ON OCAP_CASE_ID = OCAS_CASE_ID AND OCAS_SURG_ROLE = 'Primary' AND OCAS_PNL_NO = OCAP_PNL_NO JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE MD ON OCAS_RES_ID = MD.CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_LOCATION ON OC_SURG_LOC_ID = LOC_LOC_ID JOIN IDB.OR_PROC ON OCAP_OR_PROC_ID = OP_OR_PROC_ID JOIN IDB.OR_CL_PROC ON OP_OR_PROC_ID = OCP_OR_PROC_ID AND(OCP_LINE_NO = 1 OR OCAS_SURG_SVC <> 'PLA') JOIN IDB.CL_PROC ON OCP_PROC_ID = CPX_PROC_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE RF ON OC_REF_RES_ID = RF.CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.OR_CASE_DX_CODES D1 ON D1.OCD_CASE_ID = OC_CASE_ID AND D1.OCD_LINE_NO = 1 LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_DX DX1 ON DX1.CDX_DX_ID = D1.OCD_DX_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.OR_CASE_DX_CODES D2 ON D2.OCD_CASE_ID = OC_CASE_ID AND D2.OCD_LINE_NO = 2 LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_DX DX2 ON DX2.CDX_DX_ID = D2.OCD_DX_ID JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE LOC ON LOC.CRE_RES_ID = OC_ROOM_RES_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE RM ON RM.CRE_RES_ID = OC_ROOM_RES_ID LEFT JOIN LUNG_CDB ON OC_MRN= TM_MRN AND RN = 1 LEFT JOIN IDB.ACCRUALS ON AC_MRN = OC_MRN AND AC_IRB_NO = '12-245' WHERE OC_SURG_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT DATE AND CURRENT DATE + 14 DAY AND OC_OR_CASE_STS_CD NOT IN ('2', '5') AND OCAS_SURG_SVC = 'IR' AND (TM_MRN IS NOT NULL OR DX1.CDX_ICD10 LIKE 'C34%' OR DX2.CDX_ICD10 LIKE 'C34%' OR UPPER(DX1.CDX_DX_NAME) LIKE '%LUNG%' OR UPPER(DX2.CDX_DX_NAME) LIKE '%LUNG%') ORDER BY OC_SURG_DTE, OC_CASE_ID, OCAP_LINE_NO

prompt: Identify all patients who have an RN visit in Cadence for Mulhall RN visits between January 1, 2008 and September 30, 2010.  Data
completion: SELECT CPE_MRN AS MRN, CPE_ENC_DTE AS APPT_DATE, CLD_DEPT_NAME, CRE_RES_NAME, CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR , PT_LAST_NAME AS LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME AS FIRST_NAME, CLD_CLD_CENTER, CLD_CLD_PHY_LOC, CPE_RM_NO FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CRE_RES_ID = CPE_VST_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PT_MRN = CPE_MRN WHERE CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN '2008-01-01' AND '2010-09-30' AND CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Sch') AND CPE_VST_RES_ID = '8808'

prompt: Frequently updated list of patients scheduled in outpatient sites that have tested positive for COVID-19.
completion: WITH PROBLEM_LIST AS (SELECT DISTINCT CPL_MRN, CPL_PROBLEM_DESC FROM IDB.COVID19_PROBLEM_LIST WHERE CPL_PROBLEM_STATUS = 'Active' ) SELECT CPA_ENC_CSN_ID "Encounter ID", TRIM(CPA_MRN) AS "MRN", TRIM(PT_LAST_NAME) || ', ' || TRIM(PT_FIRST_NAME) AS "Patient Name", PT_SEX AS "Gender", PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH AS "Date of Birth", PT_DATE_OF_DEATH AS "Date of Death", PT_PHONE AS "Patient Phone", CASE WHEN CPL_MRN IS NOT NULL THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS "Infection Control Isolation", CPL_PROBLEM_DESC "Problem List", CPA_ENC_DTE AS "Appt Date", CPE_APPT_DT AS "Appt Datetime", CHAR(TIME(CPE_APPT_DT), USA) AS "Appt Time", TRIM(CLD_CLD_CENTER) AS "Center", TRIM(CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6) AS "Department", TRIM(D.CAV_TITLE) AS "Department Description", TRIM(CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_7) AS "Division", TRIM(CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8) AS "Service", TRIM(S.CAV_TITLE) AS "Service Description", TRIM(CLD_DEPT_NAME) AS "Department Name", TRIM(CRE_RES_NAME) AS "Provider Name", TRIM(CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME) AS "Visit Type", CASE WHEN ((CVT_CVT_RPT_GRP_17 = 'TELEHEALTH' OR UPPER(CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME) LIKE '%PHONE%') OR (CLD_DEPT_ID IN (1382, 1354)) OR UPPER(CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME) IN ('IC BUNDLED SERVICES', 'IC INTEG MED REVIEW', 'IC MEDICAL RECORDS REVIEW', 'IC MSK IMPACT', 'IC RADIOLOGY REVIEW', 'IC VIDEO CONSULT')) THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS "Telehealth Flag", LISTAGG (COALESCE(TRIM(CPAN_NOTE), '') , CHR(13) || CHR(10)) WITHIN GROUP( ORDER BY CPA_ENC_CSN_ID, CPAN_LINE_NO) AS "Appt Notes", CPE_CPE_APPT_STS "Appt Status", MIN_IDENTIFIED_DT "Identified Date", DATE(MIN_RESULT_DT) "Result Date", DATE(MAX_RESULT_DT) "Last Result Date", RESULT "Result" FROM IDB.CL_PT_APPT JOIN IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER ON CPA_ENC_CSN_ID = CPE_ENC_CSN_ID JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPA_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPA_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_PT_APPT_NOTES ON CPA_CL_PT_ID = CPAN_CL_PT_ID AND CPA_ENC_DTE_SEQ = CPAN_ENC_DTE_SEQ JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON CPA_MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_CATEGORY D ON D.CAV_CATEGORY = 'CLD_RPT_GRP_7' AND D.CAV_ABBR = CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_7 LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_CATEGORY S ON S.CAV_CATEGORY = 'CLD_RPT_GRP_8' AND S.CAV_ABBR = CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 LEFT JOIN IDB.PATIENT_COVID_INFO_V ON CPA_MRN = MRN AND RESULT IN ('Positive', 'Resolved') LEFT JOIN PROBLEM_LIST ON CPA_MRN = CPL_MRN WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp', 'Sch') AND CPA_ENC_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT DATE - 365 DAYS AND CURRENT DATE + 180 DAYS AND (MRN IS NOT NULL OR CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME = 'COVID POS/SYM VISIT PREP' OR CPL_PROBLEM_DESC = 'Airborne-Contact-Rule Out COVID-19') AND CPA_MRN <> '' GROUP BY CPA_ENC_CSN_ID, TRIM(CPA_MRN), TRIM(PT_LAST_NAME) || ', ' || TRIM(PT_FIRST_NAME), PT_SEX, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, PT_DATE_OF_DEATH, PT_PHONE, CASE WHEN CPL_MRN IS NOT NULL THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END, CPL_PROBLEM_DESC, CPA_ENC_DTE, CPE_APPT_DT, CHAR(TIME(CPE_APPT_DT), USA), TRIM(CLD_CLD_CENTER), TRIM(CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6), TRIM(D.CAV_TITLE), TRIM(CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_7), TRIM(CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8), TRIM(S.CAV_TITLE), TRIM(CLD_DEPT_NAME), TRIM(CRE_RES_NAME), TRIM(CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME), CASE WHEN ((CVT_CVT_RPT_GRP_17 = 'TELEHEALTH' OR UPPER(CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME) LIKE '%PHONE%') OR (CLD_DEPT_ID IN (1382, 1354)) OR UPPER(CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME) IN ('IC BUNDLED SERVICES', 'IC INTEG MED REVIEW', 'IC MEDICAL RECORDS REVIEW', 'IC MSK IMPACT', 'IC RADIOLOGY REVIEW', 'IC VIDEO CONSULT')) THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END, CPE_CPE_APPT_STS, MIN_IDENTIFIED_DT, DATE(MIN_RESULT_DT), DATE(MAX_RESULT_DT), RESULT

prompt: Total number of Total Body Photos from 2014-2022
completion: SELECT YEAR(CPE_ENC_DTE) AS "Year", CLD_DEPT_NAME AS "Department Name", CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME AS "Visit Type", COUNT(*) AS "Total Count" FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND (UPPER(CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME) LIKE '%DERM%TOTAL%BODY%' OR UPPER(CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME) LIKE '%DERM%3D%PHOTO%' OR UPPER(CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME) LIKE '%DERM%TBI%FR%' OR UPPER(CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME) LIKE '%DERM%TBI%SIMPLE%' OR UPPER(CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME) LIKE '%DERM205%E64%TOTAL%BODY%') AND (UPPER(CLD_DEPT_NAME) LIKE '%DERM%KOCH%-%18%NURSING%' OR UPPER(CLD_DEPT_NAME) LIKE '%DERM%16%E60-3%NURSING%') AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN '2014-01-01' AND (CURRENT date - 1 DAY) GROUP BY YEAR(CPE_ENC_DTE), CLD_DEPT_NAME, CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME ORDER BY YEAR(CPE_ENC_DTE), COUNT(*) DESC

prompt: All reported instances of the organism "Staphylococcus lugdunensis" from Jan. 2001 to Dec. 2017 (This includes Sunquest and Harvest data before Cerner go-live).
completion: WITH ETO AS (SELECT LPC_MRN, LPC_ACCESSION_NO, LPC_PERFORMED_DT , LPC_ORGANISM_OBSERVATION , LPC_DRUG_CD, LPC_PERFORMED_DTE, LPC_FINAL_DTE , LPC_SPECIMEN_LOC_ABBR , LPC_ORGANISM_CD, LPC_DRUG_NAME , LPC_RESULT_NUMERIC, LPC_RESULT_TEXT, LPC_RESULT_TYPE , LPC_SPECIMEN_DESC FROM IDB.LAB_POSITIVE_CULTURES WHERE (LPC_ORGANISM_CD = 'STLU' OR UPPER(LPC_ORGANISM_OBSERVATION) like '%STAPHYLO%LUGDUNE%') AND LPC_PERFORMED_DTE BETWEEN '2001-01-01' AND '2017-12-31' ) SELECT DISTINCT RST.LR_MRN MRN, STRIP(PT_LAST_NAME)||', '||STRIP(PT_FIRST_NAME) PT_NAME , RST.LR_ORD_ID ORDID, YEAR(LPC_PERFORMED_DTE) COLLECTED_YEAR, MONTH(LPC_PERFORMED_DTE) COLLECTED_MONTH, RL.OSH_CREATE_DT COLLECTION_DT, SR.OSH_CREATE_DT SPECIMEN_RECEIVED_DT, OO_ARRIVAL_DT FINAL_RESULT_DT, RST.LR_ACCESSION_NO ACCESSION_NO, RST.LR_TEST_NAME TEST_NAME, LPC_SPECIMEN_LOC_ABBR COLLECT_LOCATION, LPC_ORGANISM_OBSERVATION CULTURE_RESULT, LPC_DRUG_NAME DRUG_NAME, LPC_RESULT_TEXT SENSITIVITY_RESULT , LPC_SPECIMEN_DESC SPECIMEN_DESC FROM ETO JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON LPC_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.LAB_RESULTS RST ON LPC_MRN = LR_MRN AND LPC_ACCESSION_NO = LR_ACCESSION_NO AND LR_PERFORMED_DTE = LPC_PERFORMED_DTE JOIN IDB.OMS_ORDER ON RST.LR_ORD_GUID = OO_ORD_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_STS_HX RL ON RL.OSH_ORD_GUID = OO_ORD_GUID AND RL.OSH_FUNCTION_CD = '105' LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_STS_HX SR ON SR.OSH_ORD_GUID = OO_ORD_GUID AND SR.OSH_FUNCTION_CD = '12' UNION SELECT OUO_MRN MRN , STRIP(PT_LAST_NAME)||', '||STRIP(PT_FIRST_NAME) PT_NAME , OO_ORD_ID ORDID, YEAR(OO_SIGNIFICANT_DT) COLLECTED_YEAR, MONTH(OO_SIGNIFICANT_DT) COLLECTED_MONTH , RL.OSH_CREATE_DT COLLECTION_DT, SR.OSH_CREATE_DT SPECIMEN_RECEIVED_DT, OO_ARRIVAL_DT FINAL_RESULT_DT, SPES.LR_ACCESSION_NO ACCESSION_NO, OO_ORD_NAME AS TEST_NAME , CASE WHEN OCV_IP_OP_IND = 'O' THEN OCV_CURR_LOC ELSE COALESCE(OL_LOC_NAME, OCV_CURR_LOC) END AS COLLECT_LOCATION, CULTR.LTL_TEXT_RESULT CULTURE_RESULT , SENS.LR_SUBTEST_NAME DRUG_NAME , SENSR.LTL_TEXT_RESULT SENSITIVITY_RESULT, SPESR.LTL_TEXT_RESULT SPECIMEN_DESC FROM IDB.OMS_USER_ORDERS JOIN IDB.OMS_ORDER ON OO_ORD_GUID = OUO_ORD_GUID JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PT_MRN = OO_MRN JOIN IDB.OMS_CLIENT_VISIT ON OCV_VISIT_GUID = OO_VISIT_GUID LEFT JOIN IDB.CASE ON CS_MRN = OO_MRN AND CS_ACCT_NO = OO_ACCT_NO AND CS_PT_STS <> 'IP' AND CS_ACCT_NO LIKE '84%' JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_STS_HX RL ON RL.OSH_ORD_GUID = OO_ORD_GUID AND RL.OSH_FUNCTION_CD = '105' LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_STS_HX SR ON SR.OSH_ORD_GUID = OO_ORD_GUID AND SR.OSH_FUNCTION_CD = '12' LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_VISIT_LOCATION LOCX ON OVL_VISIT_GUID = OCV_VISIT_GUID AND RL.OSH_CREATE_DT BETWEEN OVL_EFF_DT AND COALESCE(OVL_CHNG_DT, TIMESTAMP(CURRENT DATE, CURRENT TIME)) AND OVL_LOC_GUID <> '6000001118061001' AND OCV_IP_OP_IND = 'I' LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_LOCATION LOC ON OVL_LOC_GUID = OL_LOC_GUID JOIN IDB.LAB_RESULTS SPES ON OO_ORD_GUID = SPES.LR_ORD_GUID AND OO_MRN = SPES.LR_MRN AND OO_ACCT_NO = SPES.LR_ACCT_NO AND SPES.LR_PERFORMED_DTE = DATE(OO_PERFORMED_DT) AND SPES.LR_ACCESSION_NO = OUO_ANCIL_REF_CD AND SPES.LR_SUBTEST_NAME = 'Specimen Description' LEFT JOIN IDB.LAB_TEXT_LINE SPESR ON SPES.LR_RESULT_GUID = SPESR.LTL_RESULT_GUID AND SPESR.LTL_LINE_NO = 1 JOIN IDB.LAB_RESULTS CULT ON OO_ORD_GUID = CULT.LR_ORD_GUID AND OO_MRN = CULT.LR_MRN AND OO_ACCT_NO = CULT.LR_ACCT_NO AND CULT.LR_PERFORMED_DTE = DATE(OO_PERFORMED_DT) AND CULT.LR_ACCESSION_NO = OUO_ANCIL_REF_CD AND CULT.LR_SUBTEST_NAME IN('Culture', 'Culture Result.', 'Culture Result') LEFT JOIN IDB.LAB_TEXT_LINE CULTR ON CULT.LR_RESULT_GUID = CULTR.LTL_RESULT_GUID AND CULTR.LTL_LINE_NO = 1 JOIN IDB.LAB_RESULTS ORG ON OO_ORD_GUID = ORG.LR_ORD_GUID AND OO_MRN = ORG.LR_MRN AND OO_ACCT_NO = ORG.LR_ACCT_NO AND ORG.LR_PERFORMED_DTE = DATE(OO_PERFORMED_DT) AND ORG.LR_ACCESSION_NO = OUO_ANCIL_REF_CD AND ORG.LR_SUBTEST_NAME = 'Organism' JOIN IDB.LAB_TEXT_LINE ORGR ON ORG.LR_RESULT_GUID = prompt: list of protocol patients who are alive as of their last visit at MSK
completion: SELECT ACD_MRN AS MRN, TRIM(PT_LAST_NAME) || ', ' || TRIM(PT_FIRST_NAME) PATIENT_NAME, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, PT_DATE_OF_DEATH, PLA_LST_APPT_DTE AS LAST_APPT_DTE, ACD_TX_ST_DTE AS TX_START_DTE, ACD_TX_END_DTE AS TX_END_DTE, ACD_CONS_DTE AS CONSENT_DTE FROM IDB.ACCRUALS_DATES JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON ACD_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY ON ACD_MRN = PLA_MRN WHERE ACD_IRB_NO = '94-018'; SELECT ACD_MRN AS MRN, TRIM(PT_LAST_NAME) || ', ' || TRIM(PT_FIRST_NAME) PATIENT_NAME, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, PT_DATE_OF_DEATH, PLA_LST_APPT_DTE AS LAST_APPT_DTE, ACD_TX_ST_DTE AS TX_START_DTE, ACD_TX_END_DTE AS TX_END_DTE, ACD_CONS_DTE AS CONSENT_DTE FROM IDB.ACCRUALS_DATES JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON ACD_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY ON ACD_MRN = PLA_MRN WHERE ACD_IRB_NO = '03-077'; SELECT ACD_MRN AS MRN, TRIM(PT_LAST_NAME) || ', ' || TRIM(PT_FIRST_NAME) PATIENT_NAME, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, PT_DATE_OF_DEATH, PLA_LST_APPT_DTE AS LAST_APPT_DTE, ACD_TX_ST_DTE AS TX_START_DTE, ACD_TX_END_DTE AS TX_END_DTE, ACD_CONS_DTE AS CONSENT_DTE FROM IDB.ACCRUALS_DATES JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON ACD_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY ON ACD_MRN = PLA_MRN WHERE ACD_IRB_NO = '12-230'; SELECT ACD_MRN AS MRN, TRIM(PT_LAST_NAME) || ', ' || TRIM(PT_FIRST_NAME) PATIENT_NAME, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, PT_DATE_OF_DEATH, PLA_LST_APPT_DTE AS LAST_APPT_DTE, ACD_TX_ST_DTE AS TX_START_DTE, ACD_TX_END_DTE AS TX_END_DTE, ACD_CONS_DTE AS CONSENT_DTE FROM IDB.ACCRUALS_DATES JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON ACD_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY ON ACD_MRN = PLA_MRN WHERE ACD_IRB_NO = '16-1643'; SELECT ACD_MRN AS MRN, TRIM(PT_LAST_NAME) || ', ' || TRIM(PT_FIRST_NAME) PATIENT_NAME, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, PT_DATE_OF_DEATH, PLA_LST_APPT_DTE AS LAST_APPT_DTE, ACD_TX_ST_DTE AS TX_START_DTE, ACD_TX_END_DTE AS TX_END_DTE, ACD_CONS_DTE AS CONSENT_DTE FROM IDB.ACCRUALS_DATES JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON ACD_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY ON ACD_MRN = PLA_MRN WHERE ACD_IRB_NO = '13-260';

prompt: Update the crosswalk for MED6691 to remove duplicates

prompt: Provide an annual list of bone surgery patients who have had IMPACT testing as MSK.
completion: WITH X AS (SELECT DISTINCT "t1"."PT_MRN" AS "MRN", PRPT_ORD_DR_SVC, PRPT_ORD_DR_SVC_DESC, "t2"."PRPT_ACCESSION_NO" AS "Pathology Report", "t3"."PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_DESC" AS "Pathology Report Type", "t4"."DT_DTE" AS "Pathology Procedure Date", UPPER(CASE WHEN LENGTH(PRPT_REPORT) <= 15000 THEN RTRIM(CAST(SUBSTR(PRPT_REPORT, 1, 15000) AS VARCHAR(15000))) ELSE CAST(SUBSTR(PRPT_REPORT, 1, 15000) AS VARCHAR(15000)) END) AS TXT, CASE WHEN UPPER(DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)DIAGNOSIS:[\w\W]*(?=I ATTEST)', PRPT_REPORT)) <> '' THEN UPPER(DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)DIAGNOSIS:[\w\W]*(?=I ATTEST)', PRPT_REPORT)) WHEN UPPER(DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)DIAGNOSIS:[\w\W]*(?=NOTE:)', PRPT_REPORT)) <> '' THEN UPPER(DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)DIAGNOSIS:[\w\W]*(?=NOTE:)', PRPT_REPORT)) WHEN UPPER(DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)DIAGNOSIS:[\w\W]*(?=REPORT ELECTRONICALLY SIGNED OUT )', PRPT_REPORT)) <> '' THEN UPPER(DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)DIAGNOSIS:[\w\W]*(?=REPORT ELECTRONICALLY SIGNED OUT )', PRPT_REPORT)) END AS DIAGNOSIS FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V" "t1" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED" "t6" ON "t1"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t6"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V" "t2" ON "t6"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t2"."PRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATH_RPRT_TYPE_LOOKUP" "t3" ON "t2"."PRPT_REPORT_TYPE" = "t3"."PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_CD" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" "t4" ON "t2"."PRPT_PROCEDURE_DATE_ID" = "t4"."DT_DATE_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" "t5" ON "t2"."PRPT_REPORT_DATE_ID" = "t5"."DT_DATE_ID" WHERE 1=1 AND CONTAINS("t2"."PRPT_REPORT", '("acetabulum" OR "clavicle" OR "Femur" OR "Fibula" OR "humerus" OR "iliac" OR "ilium" OR "pelvic" OR "pelvis" OR "pubic" OR "pubic ramus" OR "radius" OR "scapula" OR "tibia" OR "tibial" OR "trochanter" OR "ulna")') = 1 AND "t2"."PRPT_REPORT" IS NOT NULL AND UPPER("t3"."PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_DESC") LIKE '%SURGICAL PATHOLOGY%' AND PRPT_ORD_DR_SVC_DESC = 'ORTHOPEDICS' AND "t4"."DT_DTE" BETWEEN '2019-01-01' AND '2022-12-31' ) , IMPACT AS (SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN AS IMP_MRN, "Pathology Report", PDRX_ACCESSION_NO, "Pathology Procedure Date", PDRX_DMP_PATIENT_ID, PDRX_DMP_SAMPLE_ID, T.* FROM X JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON PT_MRN = MRN JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML DT ON PDRX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML_SETTINGS ON PDRX_PATH_DMP_RESULTS_XML_ID = PDRXS_PATH_DMP_RESULTS_XML_ID JOIN DVDMC.PATHOLOGY_DMP_WEBSVC_SETTINGS ON PDRXS_SETTING_ID = PDWS_SETTING_ID CROSS JOIN XMLTABLE('$c/root/*' PASSING DT.PDRX_XML_VALUE AS "c" COLUMNS DT_PROCEDURE VARCHAR(40) PATH '../meta-data/dt_procedure', TUMOR_TYPE_NAME VARCHAR(264) PATH '../meta-data/tumor_type_name', TUMOR_TYPE_CODE VARCHAR(100) PATH '../meta-data/tumor_type_code', PRIMARY_SITE VARCHAR(100) PATH '../meta-data/primary_site', IS_METASTASIS VARCHAR(10) PATH '../meta-data/is_metastasis', METASTASIS_SITE VARCHAR(100) PATH '../meta-data/metastasis_site', PART_DESCRIPTION VARCHAR(2000) PATH '../meta-data/part_description') T WHERE 1=1 AND PDWS_NAME like '%IMPACT%' ) , Y AS (SELECT DISTINCT STRIP(PT_MRN) AS MRN, STRIP(PT_LAST_NAME) || ', ' || STRIP(PT_FIRST_NAME) AS "Name", PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH AS DOB, STRIP(PT_SEX) AS "Gender", STRIP(R.AV_DESC) AS "Race", STRIP(E.AV_DESC) AS "Ethnicity", PT_DATE_OF_DEATH AS DOD, IMPACT.* FROM IDB.PATIENT JOIN IMPACT ON PT_MRN = IMP_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS R ON PT_RACE = R.AV_CODE AND R.AV_ELEMENT = 'RACE' LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS E ON PT_PT_ETHNICITY = E.AV_CODE AND E.AV_ELEMENT = 'PT_ETHNICITY') SELECT DISTINCT STRIP(SSE_MRN) AS SSE_MRN, SSE_SURG_DTE, SSP_SURG_SVC_CD, STRIP(SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD) AS "CPT Code", STRIP(SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC) AS "Procedure Description", STRIP(SSP_SURG_LAST_NM) || ', ' || STRIP(SSP_SURG_FIRST_NM) AS "Surgeon" FROM Y JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT ON SSE_MRN = MRN JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE ON SSE_LOG_ID = SSP_LOG_ID WHERE SSP_SURG_SVC_CD <> 'ORTHO'

prompt: Daily report of patients scheduled for chemo at BAIC who have no record of a completed ECHO in the prior two months.
completion: WITH PTS AS (SELECT CPE_MRN AS MRN, CPE_ENC_DTE "CHEMO BRE Visit Date", LISTAGG(TRIM(CCH_CHEMO_NAME), ' , ') AS "Chemo Type" FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_PT_CHEMO ON CPC_CL_PT_ID = CPE_CL_PT_ID AND CPC_ENC_DTE_SEQ = CPE_ENC_DTE_SEQ LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_CHEMO ON CPC_CHEMO_ID = CCH_CHEMO_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Sch') AND CRE_RES_ID = '300338' AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN (SELECT DISTINCT CASE WHEN DAYOFWEEK(CURRENT date) = 6 THEN CURRENT date + 3 DAYS ELSE CURRENT date + 1 DAY END FROM DV.DATE) AND (SELECT DISTINCT CASE WHEN DAYOFWEEK(CURRENT date) = 6 THEN CURRENT date + 4 DAYS ELSE CURRENT date + 2 DAY END FROM DV.DATE) AND (UPPER(CCH_CHEMO_NAME) like '%TRASTU%' OR UPPER(CCH_CHEMO_NAME) like '%PERTUZ%' OR UPPER(CCH_CHEMO_NAME) like '%DOXO%' OR UPPER(CCH_CHEMO_NAME) like '%EPIR%' OR UPPER(CCH_CHEMO_NAME) like '%IDARU%' OR UPPER(CCH_CHEMO_NAME) like '%DAUNO%' OR UPPER(CCH_CHEMO_NAME) like '%MITOX%') GROUP BY CPE_MRN, CPE_ENC_DTE, CPE_APPT_DT) , OMIT AS (SELECT DISTINCT ES_MRN, DATE(ER_STUDY_START_DT) AS ECHO_DATE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ES_MRN ORDER BY DATE(ER_STUDY_START_DT) DESC) AS RANK FROM IDB.ECHO_STUDY JOIN IDB.ECHO_REPORT ON ER_STUDY_ID = ES_STUDY_ID JOIN IDB.ECHO_AVAILABILITY ON EA_STUDY_ID = ES_STUDY_ID WHERE ES_MRN IN (SELECT MRN FROM PTS) AND EA_REPORT_STATUS = 'Final' AND DATE(ER_STUDY_START_DT) BETWEEN CURRENT date - 60 DAYS AND CURRENT date ) , LASTECHO AS (SELECT DISTINCT ES_MRN, DATE(ER_STUDY_START_DT) AS ECHO_DATE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ES_MRN ORDER BY DATE(ER_STUDY_START_DT) DESC) AS RANK FROM IDB.ECHO_STUDY JOIN IDB.ECHO_REPORT ON ER_STUDY_ID = ES_STUDY_ID JOIN IDB.ECHO_AVAILABILITY ON EA_STUDY_ID = ES_STUDY_ID WHERE ES_MRN IN (SELECT MRN FROM PTS) AND EA_REPORT_STATUS = 'Final' AND DATE(ER_STUDY_START_DT) < CURRENT date - 60 DAYS ) , NEXTECHO AS (SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN, CPE_ENC_DTE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CPE_MRN ORDER BY CPE_ENC_DTE) AS RANK FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Sch') AND CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME IN ('REST ECHO1275 IP', 'PACCECHO CMPLT + STRN IP', 'STRESS ECHO1275 OP', 'STRESS ECHO53', 'REST ECHO1275 OP PORTABLE', 'REST ECHO53', 'REST ECHO1275 OP', 'STRESS ECHO1275 IP', 'EXRC REST ECHO68', 'PACCECHO CMPLT + STRN OP', 'REST ECHO1275 IP PORTABLE', 'EXRC STRESS ECHO68') AND CPE_ENC_DTE > CURRENT date AND CPE_MRN IN (SELECT MRN FROM PTS) ) , OUTSIDE AS (SELECT OO_MRN, OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE FROM IDB.OMS_ORDER JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_CATALOG ON OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID = OOC_MSTR_ITEM_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_STATUS ON OO_ORD_STS_CD = OSTS_ORD_STS_CD WHERE OOC_ITEM_NAME IN ('ECHO:2-D & M-Mode/Doppler', 'ECHO:Stress Echo with EKG', 'ECHO:TEE', 'Stress Echo with EKG (NI)', 'Pediatric Echo', 'Stress Echo-EKG', 'ECHO:Dobutamine Echo Stress Test (DEST)', 'Dobutamine Echo Stress Test (DEST) (NI)') AND OO_ORD_STS_CD NOT IN ('CANP', 'CANC', 'AUC3') AND OO_REQ_TME_PRIO = 'Outside Order' AND OO_MRN IN (SELECT MRN FROM PTS) AND OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT date - 60 DAYS AND CURRENT date ) SELECT DISTINCT MRN, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_LAST_NAME, "CHEMO BRE Visit Date", ECHO_DATE "Last MSK ECHO", B.CPE_ENC_DTE "Next ECHO Appt", CASE WHEN C.OO_MRN IS NOT NULL THEN 'YES' ELSE 'NO' END AS "Outside ECHO ordered past 2 months?", "Chemo Type" FROM PTS JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PT_MRN = MRN LEFT JOIN LASTECHO A ON ES_MRN = MRN AND ECHO_DATE < CURRENT date - 60 DAYS AND A.RANK = 1 LEFT JOIN NEXTECHO B ON CPE_MRN = MRN AND B.RANK = 1 LEFT JOIN OUTSIDE C ON C.OO_MRN = MRN WHERE MRN NOT IN (SELECT ES_MRN FROM OMIT)

prompt: For a given list of patients (MRNs will be provided in an excel sheet), provide a list of patients which have had a diagnosis of GI, GU, or GYN cancers (ICD code list will be provided).
completion: WITH DX AS (SELECT PT_MRN CC_MRN, SUBSTR(DXCC_ICD_CODE, 1, 3) AS ICD_GROUP, MIN(DT_DTE) DX_DTE FROM DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS JOIN DV.PATIENT_DIAGNOSIS_FINAL_ALL_V ON PDX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID JOIN DV.DATE_V ON PDX_DX_DATE_ID = DT_DATE_ID JOIN DV.DIAGNOSIS_CATALOG ON PDX_DX_CATALOG_ID = DXCC_DX_CATALOG_ID WHERE SUBSTR(DXCC_ICD_CODE, 1, 3) IN ('C61', 'C62', 'C64', 'C65', 'C66', 'C67', '185', '186', '188', '189') AND DT_DTE BETWEEN '2000-01-01' AND '2019-03-15' GROUP BY PT_MRN, SUBSTR(DXCC_ICD_CODE, 1, 3) ) , RAD AS (SELECT DISTINCT RRPT_MRN, DX_DTE, ICD_GROUP FROM DV.RADIOLOGY_REPORT_V JOIN DX ON RRPT_MRN = CC_MRN WHERE RRPT_REPORT_TXT IS NOT NULL AND (CONTAINS("RRPT_REPORT_TXT", '("inguinal adenopathy" | "inguinal node" | "inguinal lymph node" | "inguinal node metastasis" | "inguinal nodal metastasis" | "groin (node)")') = 1 OR CONTAINS("RRPT_REPORT_TXT", '("inguinal" & "metastasis")') = 1) AND RRPT_ORDER_GROUP IN ('CT', 'MR', 'PET', 'PET CT for Cancer', 'PET for Cancer', 'Submitted Films', 'US') ) , PATH AS (SELECT DISTINCT PRPT_MRN, DX_DTE, ICD_GROUP FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V JOIN RAD ON RRPT_MRN = PRPT_MRN WHERE PRPT_REPORT IS NOT NULL AND CONTAINS("PRPT_REPORT", '("inguinal")') = 1 AND PRPT_REPORT_TYPE_DESC IN ('Surgical Pathology', 'Surgical Pathology Consult', 'Surgical Submitted Slides', 'Special Procedure, Surgical', 'Off-Site FNA Cases (64th St.)') ) SELECT RRPT_MRN "MRN", DX_DTE "Diagnosis Date", ICD_GROUP "ICD Group", RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE "Rad Performed Date", RRPT_ACCESSION_NO "Accession No", RRPT_ORDER_GROUP "Order Group", RRPT_PROCEDURE_NAME "Procedure Name", RRPT_REPORT_TXT "Report Text" FROM DV.RADIOLOGY_REPORT_V JOIN PATH ON RRPT_MRN = PRPT_MRN WHERE RRPT_REPORT_TXT IS NOT NULL AND (CONTAINS("RRPT_REPORT_TXT", '("inguinal adenopathy" | "inguinal node" | "inguinal lymph node" | "inguinal node metastasis" | "inguinal nodal metastasis" | "groin (node)")') = 1 OR CONTAINS("RRPT_REPORT_TXT", '("inguinal" & "metastasis")') = 1) AND RRPT_ORDER_GROUP IN ('CT', 'MR', 'PET', 'PET CT for Cancer', 'PET for Cancer', 'Submitted Films', 'US') ; WITH DX AS (SELECT PT_MRN CC_MRN, SUBSTR(DXCC_ICD_CODE, 1, 3) AS ICD_GROUP, MIN(DT_DTE) DX_DTE FROM DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS JOIN DV.PATIENT_DIAGNOSIS_FINAL_ALL_V ON PDX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID JOIN DV.DATE_V ON PDX_DX_DATE_ID = DT_DATE_ID JOIN DV.DIAGNOSIS_CATALOG ON PDX_DX_CATALOG_ID = DXCC_DX_CATALOG_ID WHERE SUBSTR(DXCC_ICD_CODE, 1, 3) IN ('C61', 'C62', 'C64', 'C65', 'C66', 'C67', '185', '186', '188', '189') AND DT_DTE BETWEEN '2000-01-01' AND '2019-03-15' GROUP BY PT_MRN, SUBSTR(DXCC_ICD_CODE, 1, 3) ) , RAD AS (SELECT DISTINCT RRPT_MRN, DX_DTE, ICD_GROUP FROM DV.RADIOLOGY_REPORT_V JOIN DX ON RRPT_MRN = CC_MRN WHERE RRPT_REPORT_TXT IS NOT NULL AND (CONTAINS("RRPT_REPORT_TXT", '("inguinal adenopathy" | "inguinal node" | "inguinal lymph node" | "inguinal node metastasis" | "inguinal nodal metastasis" | "groin (node)")') = 1 OR CONTAINS("RRPT_REPORT_TXT", '("inguinal" & "metastasis")') = 1) AND RRPT_ORDER_GROUP IN ('CT', 'MR', 'PET', 'PET CT for Cancer', 'PET for Cancer', 'Submitted Films', 'US') ) SELECT RRPT_MRN "MRN", DX_DTE "Diagnosis Date", ICD_GROUP "ICD Group", PRPT_REPORT_DTE "Path Report Date", PRPT_ACCESSION_NO "Accession No", PRPT_REPORT_TYPE_DESC "Path Report Type", PRPT_REPORT "Path Report Text" FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V JOIN RAD ON RRPT_MRN = PRPT_MRN WHERE PRPT_REPORT IS NOT NULL AND CONTAINS("PRPT_REPORT", '("inguinal")') = 1 AND PRPT_REPORT_TYPE_DESC IN ('Surgical Pathology', 'Surgical Pathology Consult', 'Surgical Submitted Slides', 'Special Procedure, Surgical', 'Off-Site FNA Cases (64th St.)') ; WITH DX AS (SELECT PT_MRN CC_MRN, SUBSTR(DXCC_ICD_CODE, 1, 3) AS ICD_GROUP, MIN(DT_DTE) DX_DTE FROM DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS JOIN DV.PATIENT_DIAGNOSIS_FINAL_ALL_V ON PDX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID JOIN DV.DATE_V ON PDX_DX_DATE_ID = DT_DATE_ID JOIN DV.DIAGNOSIS_CATALOG ON PDX_DX_CATALOG_ID = DXCC_DX_CATALOG_ID WHERE SUBSTR(DXCC_ICD_CODE, 1, 3) IN ('C61', 'C62', 'C64', 'C65', 'C66', 'C67', '185', '186', '188', '189') AND DT_DTE BETWEEN '2000-01-01' AND '2019-03-15' GROUP BY PT_MRN, SUBSTR(DXCC_ICD_CODE, 1, 3) ) SELECT RRPT_MRN "MRN", DX_DTE "Diagnosis Date", ICD_GROUP "ICD Group", RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE "Rad Performed Date", RRPT_ACCESSION_NO "Accession No", RRPT_ORDER_GROUP "Order Group", RRPT_PROCEDURE_NAME "Procedure Name", RRPT_REPORT_TXT "Report Text" FROM DV.RADIOLOGY_REPORT_V JOIN DX ON RRPT_MRN = CC_MRN WHERE RRPT_REPORT_TXT IS NOT NULL AND (CONTAINS("RRPT_REPORT_TXT", '("inguinal adenopathy" | "inguinal node" | "inguinal lymph node" | "inguinal node metastasis" | "inguinal nodal metastasis" | "groin (node)")') = 1 OR CONTAINS("RRPT_REPORT_TXT", '("inguinal" & "metastasis")') = 1) AND RRPT_ORDER_GROUP IN ('CT', 'MR', 'PET', 'PET CT for Cancer', 'PET for Cancer', 'Submitted Films', 'US') ; SELECT PT_MRN MRN, MIN(DT_DTE) FIRST_DX_DTE, SUBSTR(DXCC_ICD_CODE, 1, 3) AS ICD_GROUP, DXCC_ICD_CODE, DXCC_ICD_MSK_DESC FROM DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS JOIN DV.PATIENT_DIAGNOSIS_FINAL_ALL_V ON PDX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID JOIN DV.DATE_V ON PDX_DX_DATE_ID = DT_DATE_ID JOIN DV.DIAGNOSIS_CATALOG ON PDX_DX_CATALOG_ID = DXCC_DX_CATALOG_ID WHERE SUBSTR(DXCC_ICD_CODE, 1, 3) IN ('C61', 'C62', 'C64', 'C65', 'C66', 'C67', '185', '186', '188', '189') AND DT_DTE BETWEEN '2000-01-01' AND '2019-03-15' GROUP BY PT_MRN, SUBSTR(DXCC_ICD_CODE, 1, 3), DXCC_ICD_CODE, DXCC_ICD_MSK_DESC

prompt: Please provide a list of patients diagnosed with Multiple Myeloma and were treated with radiation at MSK
completion: WITH DX AS (SELECT TM_MRN AS MRN, TM_DX_DTE AS DX_DATE, TM_HIST_CD AS DX_CODE, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS DX_DESC, TM_SITE_CD AS SITE_CODE, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_DESC FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM H ON TM_HIST_CD = H.CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON TM_SITE_CD = S.CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND TM_HIST_CD = 'M9732/3' AND TM_DX_DTE BETWEEN '2000-01-01' AND '2017-11-01' UNION SELECT CC_MRN AS MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS DX_DATE, CLM_CLSF_CD AS DX_CODE, CLM_CLSF_DESC AS DX_DESC, '', '' FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND ((CC_PT_TYPE = 'I') OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) AND CC_CLSF_CD IN ('203', '203.0', '203.00', '203.01', '203.02', 'C90.0', 'C90.00', 'C90.01', 'C90.02') GROUP BY CC_MRN, CLM_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC, '', '' HAVING MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) BETWEEN '2000-01-01' AND '2017-11-01') , CTE AS (SELECT MRN AS DX_MRN, DX_DATE, STRIP(DX_CODE) || '-' || STRIP(DX_DESC) AS DX_CODE FROM DX) , CTE2 AS (SELECT * FROM CTE ORDER BY DX_MRN, DX_DATE, DX_CODE) , T1 AS (SELECT DX_MRN, DX_DATE, DX_CODE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY DX_MRN ORDER BY DX_DATE) AS RN FROM CTE2 ORDER BY DX_MRN, DX_DATE) , T2 (MRN, DX, RN1) AS (SELECT DX_MRN, CAST(DX_DATE AS VARCHAR(6000))||' | '||CAST(DX_CODE AS VARCHAR(100)), RN FROM T1 WHERE T1.RN = 1 UNION ALL SELECT DX_MRN, RTRIM(CAST(DX AS VARCHAR(4000))) || ', ' || CHR(13) || CHR(10) || CAST(DX_DATE AS VARCHAR(100))||' | '||RTRIM(CAST(DX_CODE AS VARCHAR(100))) , RN1 + 1 FROM T1, T2 WHERE DX_MRN = MRN AND RN = RN1+1 ) , T3 AS (SELECT MRN, MAX(RN1) RN FROM T2 GROUP BY MRN) , T4 AS (SELECT T2.MRN, RN, DX FROM T2 JOIN T3 ON T2.MRN = T3.MRN AND T2.RN1 = T3.RN) , RT AS (SELECT DISTINCT RTC_TX_MRN, STRIP(PT_LAST_NAME) || prompt: All patients with Sarcoma diagnosis who had a New Visit or Internal Referral appt completed with any of the MDs in the MSO Service Oct 2010 until present time (Dept: MEL SAR ONC 53-4 or MEL SAR ONC 53-5).  Data elements required include: MRN, Name, DOB, Appt Type (NV/IR),Date of Visit, Diagnosis.
completion: SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN AS MRN , CL_DEATH_IND AS DEATH_IND , CL_LAST_NAME AS LAST_NAME, CL_FIRST_NAME AS FIRST_NAME , CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR AS VISIT_TYPE , CL_DATE_OF_BIRTH AS DOB , YEAR(CPE_ENC_DTE - CL_DATE_OF_BIRTH) AS VISIT_AGE , CRE_RES_NAME AS ATTENDING, CLD_DEPT_NAME AS DEPT , CPE_ENC_DTE AS APPT_DATE , CLM_CLSF_CD AS ICD9, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS DESCRIPTION FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER A JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID AND CLD_DEPT_NAME IN ('MEL SAR ONC 53-3', 'MEL SAR ONC 53-4', 'MEL SAR ONC 53-5') JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CRE_RES_ID = CPE_VST_RES_ID AND CRE_RES_TYP IN ('Physician', 'PhD') JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID AND (CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR LIKE '%NV%' OR CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR LIKE '%IR%') JOIN IDB.CTC_CLSF ON CPE_MRN = CC_MRN AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND (CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) AND CC_CLSF_CD BETWEEN '176' AND '176.9' JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.CL_PATIENT ON CL_MRN = CPE_MRN WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Comp', 'Arrived') AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN '2010-10-01' AND '2011-11-21'

prompt: Provide a list of lung cancer patients who have received platinum, etoposide, and atezolizumab since August 1st, 2018.
completion: WITH CHEMO AS (SELECT OO_MRN, OOC_ITEM_NAME, OOC_ITEM_DESC, OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE, OSTS_STS_DESC, OO_SET_NAME FROM IDB.OMS_ORDER JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_CATALOG ON OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID = OOC_MSTR_ITEM_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_STATUS ON OO_ORD_STS_CD = OSTS_ORD_STS_CD WHERE 1=1 AND UPPER(OO_SET_NAME) like 'THR_%' AND (UPPER(OO_SET_NAME) like '%ATEZOLIZUMAB%') AND OO_ORD_STS_CD NOT IN ('CANP', 'CANC', 'AUC3') AND OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE >= '2018-01-01' ) , IMPACT AS (SELECT DISTINCT PDWS_NAME, PT_MRN GENE_MRN, PDRX_ACCESSION_NO, SAMPLEID, PATIENTID, TUMOR_TYPE_NAME, IS_METASTASIS, PRIMARY_SITE, METASTASIS_SITE FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML_SETTINGS ON PDRX_PATH_DMP_RESULTS_XML_ID = PDRXS_PATH_DMP_RESULTS_XML_ID JOIN DVDMC.PATHOLOGY_DMP_WEBSVC_SETTINGS ON PDRXS_SETTING_ID = PDWS_SETTING_ID JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON PDRX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID JOIN CHEMO ON PT_MRN = OO_MRN, XMLTABLE('$c/root/*' PASSING PDRX_XML_VALUE AS "c" COLUMNS TOTAL_NUMBER_VARIANTS int PATH 'count(../*[not(name()=''meta-data'')])', VARIANT_TYPE VARCHAR(100) PATH './local-name(.)', SAMPLEID VARCHAR(100) PATH '../meta-data/dmp_sample_id', PATIENTID VARCHAR(100) PATH '../meta-data/dmp_patient_id', TUMOR_TYPE_CODE VARCHAR(100) PATH '../meta-data/tumor_type_code', TUMOR_TYPE_NAME VARCHAR(255) PATH '../meta-data/tumor_type_name', IS_METASTASIS VARCHAR(10) PATH '../meta-data/is_metastasis', PRIMARY_SITE VARCHAR(255) PATH '../meta-data/primary_site', METASTASIS_SITE VARCHAR(255) PATH '../meta-data/metastasis_site') T WHERE PDWS_NAME = 'IMPACT' AND (TOTAL_NUMBER_VARIANTS =0 OR VARIANT_TYPE <> 'meta-data') ) SELECT DISTINCT TM_MRN MRN, PT_LAST_NAME "Last Name", PT_FIRST_NAME "First Name", PT_SEX "Gender", PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH "Date of Birth", PT_DATE_OF_DEATH "Date of Death", TM_DX_DTE "Dx Date", TM_HIST_CD "Histology Code", H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK "Histology Description" , OO_SET_NAME , OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE , PDRX_ACCESSION_NO "IMPACT Accession No" , SAMPLEID "IMPACT Sample ID" FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS ON AV_ELEMENT = 'CASE_STS' AND AV_CODE = TM_CASE_STS JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON TM_MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS STAGE ON TM_AJCC = STAGE.AV_CODE AND STAGE.AV_ELEMENT = 'AJCC' JOIN CHEMO ON TM_MRN = OO_MRN LEFT JOIN IMPACT ON TM_MRN = GENE_MRN WHERE 1=1 AND TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND TM_HIST_CD IN ('M8246/3', 'M8041/2', 'M8041/3', 'M8042/3', 'M8043/3', 'M8045/3') ;

prompt: Provide daily report of patient who developed fever after blood transfusion (same data as in LAB18414).
completion: WITH ETO AS (SELECT DISTINCT BBP_MRN MRN, BBP_ORD_ID , PT_LAST_NAME LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME FIRST_NAME, PT_SEX_DESC SEX, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH DOB, OUO_CURR_LOC PT_LOCATION, BBP_RESULT_ORD_GUID ORDDGUID, BBP_ACCESSION_NO ACCESSION_NO, BBP_PRODUCT_CODE, BBP_PRODUCT_ABRV, BBP_PRODUCT_DESC , BBP_TRANSACTION_DESC, BBP_TRANSACTION_DT BLD_PRODUCT_ISSUED_DT, BBP_TRANSACTION_DTE, BBP_UNIT_NO, BBP_UNIT_VOLUME, BBP_BLOOD_TYPE FROM IDB.BLB_BLOOD_PRODUCTS_ISSUED JOIN IDB.OMS_USER_ORDERS ON OUO_ORD_GUID = BBP_RESULT_ORD_GUID JOIN IDB.PATIENT_V ON BBP_MRN = PT_MRN AND BBP_TRANSACTION_DESC = 'Issued order' AND BBP_PRODUCT_ABRV IN ('RBC', 'Platelets', 'WB', 'FFP') WHERE BBP_TRANSACTION_DTE BETWEEN CASE WHEN DAYOFWEEK(CURRENT DATE) = 2 THEN CURRENT DATE -
