4 DAY ELSE CURRENT DATE - 3 DAY END AND CURRENT DATE ) , TEMPT AS (SELECT MRN AS MRN_T, BBP_ORD_ID , LAST_NAME, FIRST_NAME, SEX, DOB, PT_LOCATION, ORDDGUID, ACCESSION_NO, BBP_PRODUCT_CODE PRODUCT_CODE , BBP_PRODUCT_ABRV PRODUCT_ABRV, BBP_PRODUCT_DESC PRODUCT_DESC, BBP_TRANSACTION_DESC TRANSACTION_DESC, BLD_PRODUCT_ISSUED_DT, CDD_SERVICE_DT T_DATE, BBP_TRANSACTION_DTE, BBP_UNIT_NO, BBP_UNIT_VOLUME, BBP_BLOOD_TYPE, SUBSTR(C.CDO_VALUE_TEXT, 1, 10) AS C_TEMP_TXT, (CASE WHEN COALESCE(SUBSTR(C.CDO_VALUE_TEXT, 1, 10), ' ') > ' ' THEN CAST(STRIP(REPLACE(SUBSTR(C.CDO_VALUE_TEXT, 1, 10), 'N/A', '')) AS DECIMAL(5, 1)) ELSE NULL END) C_TEMP_NUMERIC FROM ETO JOIN IDB.CD_DOCUMENT ON MRN = CDD_MRN AND CDD_SERVICE_DT BETWEEN BLD_PRODUCT_ISSUED_DT AND BLD_PRODUCT_ISSUED_DT + 30 HOUR JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION C ON CDD_DOC_GUID = C.CDO_DOC_GUID AND C.CDO_ITEM_NAME IN ('Temperature Temp C') WHERE CDD_CANCEL_IND = '0' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND = '0' AND CDD_SERVICE_DTE BETWEEN DATE(BBP_TRANSACTION_DTE) AND DATE(BBP_TRANSACTION_DTE) + 2 DAY ) SELECT MRN_T, LAST_NAME, FIRST_NAME , DOB , VARCHAR_FORMAT(DATE(BLD_PRODUCT_ISSUED_DT), 'MM-DD-YYYY') BLD_PROD_ISSUED_DATE , TIME(BLD_PRODUCT_ISSUED_DT) BLD_PROD_ISSUED_TIME , PT_LOCATION, ACCESSION_NO, PRODUCT_DESC, C_TEMP_TXT, C_TEMP_NUMERIC , T_DATE , VARCHAR_FORMAT(DATE(T_DATE), 'MM-DD-YYYY') T_DATE , TIME(T_DATE) T_TIME, (DAYS(T_DATE)*24*60 + HOUR(T_DATE)*60 + MINUTE(T_DATE)) - (DAYS(BLD_PRODUCT_ISSUED_DT)*24*60 + HOUR(BLD_PRODUCT_ISSUED_DT)*60 + MINUTE(BLD_PRODUCT_ISSUED_DT)) DIFF_IN_MIN, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY MRN_T ORDER BY (DAYS(T_DATE)*24*60 + HOUR(T_DATE)*60 + MINUTE(T_DATE)) - (DAYS(BLD_PRODUCT_ISSUED_DT)*24*60 + HOUR(BLD_PRODUCT_ISSUED_DT)*60 + MINUTE(BLD_PRODUCT_ISSUED_DT))) TR FROM (SELECT MRN_T, LAST_NAME, FIRST_NAME , DOB, BLD_PRODUCT_ISSUED_DT, PT_LOCATION, ACCESSION_NO, PRODUCT_DESC, C_TEMP_TXT, C_TEMP_NUMERIC, T_DATE , ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY MRN_T, BLD_PRODUCT_ISSUED_DT ORDER BY COALESCE(C_TEMP_NUMERIC, 0) DESC) RN FROM TEMPT ) AS A WHERE RN = 1 AND C_TEMP_NUMERIC >= 38

prompt: Provide a list of breast cancer patients who have been prescribed PARP inhibitor in the past: talaazoparib, olaprib.
completion: WITH BREAST AS (SELECT PT_MRN MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME FROM IDB.PATIENT JOIN IDB.CDB_TUMOR ON PT_MRN = TM_MRN JOIN IDB.SEERGROUPING ON IDB.SEERF_ICDO(TM_SITE_CD, TM_HIST_CD) = RECODE WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7') AND CATEGORY1 = 'Breast' ) SELECT MRN, PT_LAST_NAME LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME FIRST_NAME, MAX(COALESCE(HCPR_START_DT, HCPR_END_DT)) LAST_PRESCRIPTION_DATE FROM BREAST JOIN IDB.HML_CLIENT_PRESCRIPTION ON MRN = HCPR_MRN WHERE (LOWER(HCPR_DRUG_NAME) like '%talazoparib%' OR LOWER(HCPR_DRUG_NAME) like '%olaparib%') GROUP BY MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME

prompt: Daily report of pathology result email notifications sent out to referring providers from new C&L system ("Results Routing" initiative).
completion: WITH PATH AS (SELECT PRPT_MRN , TRIM(PT_LAST_NAME) || ', ' || TRIM(PT_FIRST_NAME) AS PT_NAME , PRPT_ACCESSION_NO , PRPT_PROCEDURE_DTE , PRPT_REPORT_DTE , DATE(PRPT_CONTENT_CREATED_DT) PRPT_CONTENT_CREATED_DT , PRPT_REPORT_TYPE_DESC FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON PRPT_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE 1=1 AND DATE(PRPT_CONTENT_CREATED_DT) = CURRENT date - 1 DAY ) , CTE_1 AS (SELECT DISTINCT PRPT_MRN , PT_NAME , PRPT_ACCESSION_NO , PRPT_PROCEDURE_DTE , PRPT_REPORT_DTE , PRPT_CONTENT_CREATED_DT , COALESCE(PRPT_REPORT_TYPE_DESC, OOC_ITEM_NAME) AS PRPT_REPORT_TYPE_DESC , OOC_ITEM_NAME , OUD_USER_DI_VALUE , B.PDF_FILE_URL FROM PATH JOIN IDB.OMS_ORDER ON PRPT_MRN = OO_MRN AND PRPT_ACCESSION_NO = OO_ANCIL_REF_CD JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_CATALOG ON OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID = OOC_MSTR_ITEM_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_USER_DATA ON OUD_ORD_GUID = OO_ORD_GUID JOIN COPATH.C_SPECIMEN A ON PRPT_ACCESSION_NO = SPECNUM_FORMATTED JOIN COPATH.Y_MSK_SPEC_PDF_URL B ON A.SPECIMEN_ID = B.SPECIMEN_ID AND OO_ORD_ID = ORDER_ENTRY_NUM WHERE 1=1 AND OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'PPATH_Send Extra Copy To:' ) , CTE_2 (PRPT_MRN, PRPT_ACCESSION_NO, REST, PRODUCT, LEV) AS (SELECT PRPT_MRN , PRPT_ACCESSION_NO , OUD_USER_DI_VALUE || ';' AS REST , '' AS PRODUCT , 0 AS LEV FROM CTE_1 UNION ALL SELECT PRPT_MRN , PRPT_ACCESSION_NO , SUBSTRING(REST, INSTR(REST, ';') + 1) , LEFT(REST, INSTR(REST, ';') - 1) , LEV + 1 FROM CTE_2 WHERE REST <> '' ) , CTE_3 AS (SELECT PRPT_MRN , PRPT_ACCESSION_NO , TRIM(PRODUCT) PRODUCT FROM CTE_2 WHERE LEV > 0 ) , CTE_4 AS (SELECT A.PRPT_MRN , A.PT_NAME , A.PRPT_ACCESSION_NO , A.PRPT_PROCEDURE_DTE , A.PRPT_REPORT_DTE , A.PRPT_CONTENT_CREATED_DT , A.PRPT_REPORT_TYPE_DESC , A.OUD_USER_DI_VALUE , REPLACE((REGEXP_SUBSTR(B.PRODUCT, '/(\w+)')) , '/', '') AS REF_PROV_NO , PDF_FILE_URL FROM CTE_1 A JOIN CTE_3 B ON A.PRPT_MRN = B.PRPT_MRN AND A.PRPT_ACCESSION_NO = B.PRPT_ACCESSION_NO) , FINAL_CTE AS (SELECT PRPT_MRN , PT_NAME , PRPT_ACCESSION_NO , PRPT_PROCEDURE_DTE , PRPT_REPORT_DTE , PRPT_CONTENT_CREATED_DT , PRPT_REPORT_TYPE_DESC , PDF_FILE_URL , OUD_USER_DI_VALUE , REF_PROV_NO , OU_DISPLAY_NAME , OU_EMAIL_ADDR FROM CTE_4 LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_PROVIDER ON REF_PROV_NO = OP_PVDR_NO LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_USER ON OP_PVDR_GUID = OU_USER_GUID) SELECT * FROM FINAL_CTE ! WITH PATH AS (SELECT PRPT_MRN , TRIM(PT_LAST_NAME) || ', ' || TRIM(PT_FIRST_NAME) AS PT_NAME , PRPT_ACCESSION_NO , PRPT_PROCEDURE_DTE , PRPT_REPORT_DTE , DATE(PRPT_CONTENT_CREATED_DT) PRPT_CONTENT_CREATED_DT , PRPT_REPORT_TYPE_DESC FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON PRPT_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE 1=1 AND DATE(PRPT_CONTENT_CREATED_DT) = CURRENT date - 1 DAY ) , CTE_1 AS (SELECT DISTINCT PRPT_MRN , PT_NAME , PRPT_ACCESSION_NO , PRPT_PROCEDURE_DTE , PRPT_REPORT_DTE , PRPT_CONTENT_CREATED_DT , COALESCE(PRPT_REPORT_TYPE_DESC, OOC_ITEM_NAME) AS PRPT_REPORT_TYPE_DESC , OOC_ITEM_NAME , OUD_USER_DI_VALUE , B.PDF_FILE_URL FROM PATH JOIN IDB.OMS_ORDER ON PRPT_MRN = OO_MRN AND PRPT_ACCESSION_NO = OO_ANCIL_REF_CD JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_CATALOG ON OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID = OOC_MSTR_ITEM_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_USER_DATA ON OUD_ORD_GUID = OO_ORD_GUID JOIN COPATH.C_SPECIMEN A ON PRPT_ACCESSION_NO = SPECNUM_FORMATTED JOIN COPATH.Y_MSK_SPEC_PDF_URL B ON A.SPECIMEN_ID = B.SPECIMEN_ID AND OO_ORD_ID = ORDER_ENTRY_NUM WHERE 1=1 AND OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'PPATH_Send Extra Copy To:' ) , CTE_2 (PRPT_MRN, PRPT_ACCESSION_NO, REST, PRODUCT, LEV) AS (SELECT PRPT_MRN , PRPT_ACCESSION_NO , OUD_USER_DI_VALUE || ';' AS REST , '' AS PRODUCT , 0 AS LEV FROM CTE_1 UNION ALL SELECT PRPT_MRN , PRPT_ACCESSION_NO , SUBSTRING(REST, INSTR(REST, ';') + 1) , LEFT(REST, INSTR(REST, ';') - 1) , LEV + 1 FROM CTE_2 WHERE REST <> '' ) , CTE_3 AS (SELECT PRPT_MRN , PRPT_ACCESSION_NO , TRIM(PRODUCT) PRODUCT FROM CTE_2 WHERE LEV > 0 ) , CTE_4 AS (SELECT A.PRPT_MRN , A.PT_NAME , A.PRPT_ACCESSION_NO , A.PRPT_PROCEDURE_DTE , A.PRPT_REPORT_DTE , A.PRPT_CONTENT_CREATED_DT , A.PRPT_REPORT_TYPE_DESC , A.OUD_USER_DI_VALUE , REPLACE((REGEXP_SUBSTR(B.PRODUCT, '/(\w+)')) , '/', '') AS REF_PROV_NO , PDF_FILE_URL FROM CTE_1 A JOIN CTE_3 B ON A.PRPT_MRN = B.PRPT_MRN AND A.PRPT_ACCESSION_NO = B.PRPT_ACCESSION_NO) , FINAL_CTE AS (SELECT PRPT_MRN , PT_NAME , PRPT_ACCESSION_NO , PRPT_PROCEDURE_DTE , PRPT_REPORT_DTE , PRPT_CONTENT_CREATED_DT , PRPT_REPORT_TYPE_DESC , PDF_FILE_URL , OUD_USER_DI_VALUE , REF_PROV_NO , OU_DISPLAY_NAME , OU_EMAIL_ADDR FROM CTE_4 LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_PROVIDER ON REF_PROV_NO = OP_PVDR_NO LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_USER ON OP_PVDR_GUID = OU_USER_GUID) SELECT REF_PROV_NO , OU_DISPLAY_NAME , OU_EMAIL_ADDR , COUNT(DISTINCT OU_EMAIL_ADDR) AS "Number of emails" , COUNT(DISTINCT PRPT_ACCESSION_NO) AS "Reports in email count" FROM FINAL_CTE GROUP BY REF_PROV_NO , OU_DISPLAY_NAME , OU_EMAIL_ADDR

prompt: Provide the genomic data for patients consented to IMPACT from a pre-defined list of kidney cancer patients. From: 1/1/2000 To: 6/19/2020.
completion: WITH PREP AS (SELECT OTR_RELEASE_NAME, OTR_RELEASE_DATE, OTTT_CODE, OTTT_NAME, OTTT_MAINTYPENAME, OTTT_TISSUE FROM (SELECT OTR_RELEASE_NAME, OTR_RELEASE_DATE, OTTT_CODE, OTTT_NAME, OTTT_MAINTYPENAME, OTTT_TISSUE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY OTTT_CODE ORDER BY CASE WHEN OTR_RELEASE_NAME = 'oncotree_latest_stable' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END DESC, OTR_RELEASE_DATE DESC) RN FROM DSGTOOLS.ONCOTREE_TUMORTYPE_V WHERE OTR_RELEASE_NAME NOT IN ('oncotree_development', 'oncotree_candidate_release') ) WHERE RN = 1 ) , ONCOTREE AS (SELECT PDWS_NAME, PDRX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID AS DEID, PT_MRN AS MRN, PDRX_ACCESSION_NO, PDRX_DMP_PATIENT_ID, PDRX_DMP_SAMPLE_ID, TUMOR_TYPE_CODE, TUMOR_TYPE_NAME, OTTT_MAINTYPENAME, OTTT_TISSUE, OTR_RELEASE_NAME, IS_METASTASIS, PRIMARY_SITE, METASTASIS_SITE, PART_DESCRIPTION FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML INNER JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML_SETTINGS ON PDRX_PATH_DMP_RESULTS_XML_ID = PDRXS_PATH_DMP_RESULTS_XML_ID INNER JOIN DVDMC.PATHOLOGY_DMP_WEBSVC_SETTINGS ON PDRXS_SETTING_ID = PDWS_SETTING_ID INNER JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON PDRX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID, XMLTABLE('$c/root/meta-data' PASSING PDRX_XML_VALUE AS "c" COLUMNS TUMOR_TYPE_CODE VARCHAR(100) PATH 'tumor_type_code', TUMOR_TYPE_NAME VARCHAR(255) PATH 'tumor_type_name', IS_METASTASIS VARCHAR(10) PATH 'is_metastasis', PRIMARY_SITE VARCHAR(255) PATH 'primary_site', METASTASIS_SITE VARCHAR(255) PATH 'metastasis_site', PART_DESCRIPTION VARCHAR(2000) PATH 'part_description') T INNER JOIN PREP ON TUMOR_TYPE_CODE = OTTT_CODE WHERE OTTT_MAINTYPENAME = 'Renal Cell Carcinoma' ) , PATH AS (SELECT PT_MRN, PRPT_ACCESSION_NO, PRPT_REPORT_TYPE, PATH_RPT_DATE, PATH_PROCEDURE_DATE, GENE, RESULT, LOCUS, AA_CHANGE, NUCLEOTIDE, METHOD, ABERRATIONTYPE, PRPT_REPORT, SEARCH_HIT2 FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_STRUCTURED_RESULTS_V WHERE METHOD = 'IMPACT' AND (GENE like '%SDH%' OR GENE like 'FH%') ) SELECT P.PT_MRN AS "MRN", P.PATH_RPT_DATE AS "Path Rpt Date", P.PATH_PROCEDURE_DATE AS "Path Proc Date", P.GENE AS "Gene", P.RESULT AS "Result", P.AA_CHANGE AS "AA_Change", P.PRPT_REPORT AS "Report", O.OTTT_MAINTYPENAME AS "Type Category", O.TUMOR_TYPE_CODE AS "Type Code", O.TUMOR_TYPE_NAME AS "Type Name", O.METASTASIS_SITE AS "Metastasis Site" FROM PATH P JOIN ONCOTREE O ON P.PT_MRN = O.MRN ;

prompt: Provide total number of UGI Series ordered by each GMO MD for all of 2009.
completion: SELECT OO_MRN MRN, OO_ACCT_NO ACCT_NO, OO_ENTER_DTE ENTER_DATE , OO_ORD_ID ORDID, OO_ORD_GUID ORDGIUD, RB.OP_DISPLAY_NAME REQUESTER , REQ.DOC_SVC REQ_SVC, OCV_PVDR_NAME ATT_NAME, ATTN.DOC_SVC ATT_SVC , OO_ORD_NAME, SUBSTR(STRIP(CASE WHEN OO_ORD_NAME = 'Outside Radiology Order' THEN CASE WHEN RO.OUD_USER_DI_VALUE = 'Other' AND RI.OUD_USER_DI_VALUE IS NOT NULL THEN RI.OUD_USER_DI_VALUE ELSE COALESCE(RO.OUD_USER_DI_VALUE, OO_ORD_NAME) END WHEN COALESCE(MD.OUD_USER_DI_VALUE, CR.OUD_USER_DI_VALUE) IS NOT NULL THEN CASE WHEN COALESCE(MD.OUD_USER_DI_VALUE, CR.OUD_USER_DI_VALUE) LIKE '%:%' THEN COALESCE(MD.OUD_USER_DI_VALUE, CR.OUD_USER_DI_VALUE) ELSE STRIP(OO_ORD_NAME)||': '|| COALESCE(MD.OUD_USER_DI_VALUE, CR.OUD_USER_DI_VALUE) END ELSE OO_ORD_NAME END), 1, 155) AS ITEM_NAME , STRIP(OO_ORD_STS_CD)||'-'||STRIP(OSTS_STS_DESC) STATUS , OO_REQ_TME_PRIO AS TIME_PRIORITY, OO_SUMMARY_LINE AS ORD_SUMMARY FROM IDB.OMS_ORDER JOIN IDB.OMS_PROVIDER RB ON OO_PVDR_GUID = RB.OP_PVDR_GUID LEFT JOIN IDB.DOC REQ ON REQ.DOC_DR_NO = RB.OP_PVDR_NO JOIN IDB.OMS_STATUS ON OO_ORD_STS_CD = OSTS_ORD_STS_CD JOIN IDB.OMS_CLIENT_VISIT ON OCV_VISIT_GUID = OO_VISIT_GUID AND OCV_IP_OP_IND = 'O' LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_PROVIDER ATT ON OCV_PVDR_NAME = ATT.OP_DISPLAY_NAME LEFT JOIN IDB.DOC ATTN ON ATTN.DOC_DR_NO = ATT.OP_PVDR_NO LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_USER_DATA CR ON CR.OUD_ORD_GUID = OO_ORD_GUID AND CR.OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'RIS_Order - Current' AND UCASE(CR.OUD_USER_DI_VALUE) LIKE '%UPPER%GI%' LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_USER_DATA MD ON MD.OUD_ORD_GUID = OO_ORD_GUID AND MD.OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'RIS_Order - Modified' AND UCASE(MD.OUD_USER_DI_VALUE) LIKE '%UPPER%GI%' LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_USER_DATA RO ON RO.OUD_ORD_GUID = OO_ORD_GUID AND RO.OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'Rad_Outside_Test' AND UCASE(RO.OUD_USER_DI_VALUE) LIKE '%UPPER%GI%' LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_USER_DATA RI ON RI.OUD_ORD_GUID = OO_ORD_GUID AND RI.OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'RDR_Info' AND UCASE(RI.OUD_USER_DI_VALUE) LIKE '%UPPER%GI%' WHERE OO_ENTER_DTE BETWEEN '2009-01-01' AND '2009-12-31' AND OO_ORD_STS_CD NOT IN ('CANC', 'CANP', 'HOLD', 'SCHED', 'PEND', 'AUC3') AND OO_ACCT_NO NOT LIKE '84%' AND(UCASE(OO_ORD_NAME) LIKE 'XR%UPPER GI%' OR(OO_ORD_NAME IN ('XR', 'Outside Radiology Order') AND OO_SUMMARY_LINE LIKE '%UPPER GI%')) AND COALESCE(REQ.DOC_SVC, ATTN.DOC_SVC) = 'GMO'

prompt: Provide a list of patients diagnosed with NET [neuroendocrine tumors] and functional/non-functional endocrine tumors [adrenal] or pseudopapillary neoplasm that received radiation to either liver or adrenal gland.
completion: WITH DX AS (SELECT TM_MRN AS MRN, TM_DX_DTE AS DX_DATE, TM_HIST_CD AS HIST_CODE, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS HIST_DESC, TM_SITE_CD AS SITE_CODE, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_DESC, TM_HIST_CD_GRADE, AV_DESC AS GRADE FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM H ON TM_HIST_CD = H.CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON TM_SITE_CD = S.CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS ON AV_ELEMENT = 'HIST_CD_GRADE' AND TM_HIST_CD_GRADE = AV_CODE WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND TM_HIST_CD IN ('M8013/3', 'M8246/3', 'M8574/3', 'M8240/3') AND TM_DX_DTE >= '2000-01-01' ) , RT AS (SELECT DISTINCT RTC_TX_MRN, RTC_TX_PLAN_NAME, RTC_PRIMARY_REF_POINT, RTC_TX_START_DTE, RTC_TX_STOP_DTE, RTC_TX_ELAPSED_DAYS, RTC_TX_PLANNED_FRACTIONS, RTC_TX_DELIVERED_FRACTIONS, RTC_TX_PLANNED_DOSE, RTC_TX_DELIVERED_DOSE, RTC_DOSE_CORRECTION FROM IDB.RADONC_TREATMENT_COURSE JOIN DX ON RTC_TX_MRN = MRN WHERE UPPER(RTC_TX_PLAN_NAME) like '%ADR%' OR UPPER(RTC_TX_PLAN_NAME) like '%LIV%' OR UPPER(RTC_TX_PLAN_NAME) like '%ABD%' OR UPPER(RTC_PRIMARY_REF_POINT) like '%ADR%' OR UPPER(RTC_PRIMARY_REF_POINT) like '%LIV%' OR UPPER(RTC_PRIMARY_REF_POINT) like '%ABD%' ) , X AS (SELECT DISTINCT DX.* FROM DX JOIN RT ON RTC_TX_MRN = MRN) , CTE AS (SELECT DISTINCT MRN AS DX_MRN, DX_DATE, STRIP(HIST_CODE) || ' - ' || STRIP(HIST_DESC) || ' | ' || STRIP(SITE_CODE) || ' - ' || STRIP(SITE_DESC) || ' | ' || STRIP(GRADE) AS DX_CODE FROM X) , CTE2 AS (SELECT * FROM CTE ORDER BY DX_MRN, DX_DATE, DX_CODE) , T1 AS (SELECT DX_MRN, DX_DATE, DX_CODE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY DX_MRN ORDER BY DX_DATE) AS RN FROM CTE2 ORDER BY DX_MRN, DX_DATE) , T2 (MRN, DX, RN1) AS (SELECT DX_MRN, CAST(DX_DATE AS VARCHAR(8000))||' | '||CAST(DX_CODE AS VARCHAR(200)), RN FROM T1 WHERE T1.RN = 1 UNION ALL SELECT DX_MRN, RTRIM(CAST(DX AS VARCHAR(4000))) || ', ' || CHR(13) || CHR(10) || CAST(DX_DATE AS VARCHAR(200))||' | '||RTRIM(CAST(DX_CODE AS VARCHAR(200))) , RN1 + 1 FROM T1, T2 WHERE DX_MRN = MRN AND RN = RN1+1 ) , T3 AS (SELECT MRN, MAX(RN1) RN FROM T2 GROUP BY MRN) , T4 AS (SELECT T2.MRN, RN, DX FROM T2 JOIN T3 ON T2.MRN = T3.MRN AND T2.RN1 = T3.RN) , Y AS (SELECT PT_MRN AS MRN, STRIP(PT_LAST_NAME) || ', ' || STRIP(PT_FIRST_NAME) AS NAME, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH AS DOB, PT_SEX AS GENDER, R.AV_DESC AS "Race", E.AV_DESC AS "Ethnicity", PT_DATE_OF_DEATH AS DOD, DX FROM T4 JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PT_MRN = MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS R ON PT_RACE = R.AV_CODE AND R.AV_ELEMENT = 'RACE' LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS E ON PT_PT_ETHNICITY = E.AV_CODE AND E.AV_ELEMENT = 'PT_ETHNICITY') , CHEMO AS (SELECT DISTINCT APR_MRN, CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME, APR_START_DTE, APR_END_DTE, APR_ORD_RX_TYPE FROM IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX_V JOIN Y ON APR_MRN = MRN WHERE CDG_CHEMO_FLAG = 'Y' ) SELECT DISTINCT SSE_MRN, SSE_SURG_DTE, SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD, SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC FROM Y JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT ON SSE_MRN = MRN JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE ON SSE_LOG_ID = SSP_LOG_ID WHERE 1=1 AND SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC like '%EMBOL%'

prompt: Requesting MSK-ACCESS and ResBio results for all patients with non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC) with ROS1 fusions
completion: WITH GEN AS (SELECT PT_MRN MRN, PDRX_ACCESSION_NO, DTRPT.DT_DTE AS REPORTDATE, DTPROCPATHRPT.DT_DTE AS PROCEDUREDATE, TOTAL_NUMBER_VARIANTS, SITE1_GENE, SITE2_GENE, GENE_ID, EXON_NUM, AA_CHANGE, CDNA_CHANGE FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML INNER JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT ON PDRX_PATH_RPT_ID = PRPT_PATH_RPT_ID LEFT JOIN DV.DATE DTRPT ON PRPT_REPORT_DATE_ID = DTRPT.DT_DATE_ID LEFT JOIN DV.DATE DTPROCPATHRPT ON PRPT_PROCEDURE_DATE_ID = DTPROCPATHRPT.DT_DATE_ID INNER JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML_SETTINGS ON PDRX_PATH_DMP_RESULTS_XML_ID = PDRXS_PATH_DMP_RESULTS_XML_ID INNER JOIN DVDMC.PATHOLOGY_DMP_WEBSVC_SETTINGS ON PDRXS_SETTING_ID = PDWS_SETTING_ID INNER JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON PDRX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID, XMLTABLE('$c/root/*' PASSING PDRX_XML_VALUE AS "c" COLUMNS TOTAL_NUMBER_VARIANTS int PATH 'count(../*[not(name()=''meta-data'')])', VARIANT_CLASS VARCHAR(100) PATH 'variant_class', SITE1_GENE VARCHAR(100) PATH 'site1_gene', SITE2_GENE VARCHAR(100) PATH 'site2_gene', GENE_ID VARCHAR(100) PATH 'gene_id', EXON_NUM VARCHAR(100) PATH 'exon_num', AA_CHANGE VARCHAR(100) PATH 'aa_change', CDNA_CHANGE VARCHAR(100) PATH 'cDNA_change', GENE_FOLD_CHANGE VARCHAR(100) PATH 'gene_fold_change', VARIANT_TYPE VARCHAR(100) PATH './local-name(.)') T WHERE 1=1 AND PDWS_NAME = 'ACCESS' AND (GENE_ID = 'ROS1' OR SITE1_GENE= 'ROS1' OR SITE2_GENE= 'ROS1') AND (TOTAL_NUMBER_VARIANTS =0 OR VARIANT_TYPE <> 'meta-data') ) , BASE AS (SELECT PT_MRN MRN , PDRX_ACCESSION_NO , PT_LAST_NAME , PT_FIRST_NAME , PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH DOB , PT_SEX SEX , CASE WHEN COALESCE(R.AV_DESC, CR.AV_DESC) IN ('WHITE', 'WHITE HISPANIC') THEN 'White' WHEN COALESCE(R.AV_DESC, CR.AV_DESC) IN ('BLACK OR AFRICAN AMERICAN', 'BLACK', 'BLACK HISPANIC') THEN 'Black' WHEN COALESCE(R.AV_DESC, CR.AV_DESC) IN ('ASIAN-FAR EAST/INDIAN SUBCONT', 'KAMPUCHEAN', 'LAOTIAN', 'VIETNAMESE', 'HMONG', 'CHINESE', 'ASIAN INDIAN PAKISTANI', 'JAPANESE', 'KOREAN', 'OTHER ASIAN', 'THAI') THEN 'Asian' WHEN COALESCE(R.AV_DESC, CR.AV_DESC) IN ('NATIVE AMERICAN-AM IND/ALASKA', 'AMER IND ALEUT ESKIMO') THEN 'Native American or Alaska Native' WHEN COALESCE(R.AV_DESC, CR.AV_DESC) IN ('NATIVE HAWAIIAN OR PACIFIC ISL', 'HAWAIIAN', 'MELANESIAN', 'MICRONESIAN', 'FIJI ISLANDER', 'FILIPINO', 'GUAMANIAN', 'PACIFIC ISLANDER') THEN 'Native Hawaiian or Other Pacific Islander' ELSE 'Unspecified' END AS RACE , REPORTDATE , PROCEDUREDATE , TOTAL_NUMBER_VARIANTS , MAX(SITE1_GENE) SITE1_GENE , MAX(SITE2_GENE) SITE2_GENE , MAX(GENE_ID) GENE_ID , MAX(EXON_NUM) EXON_NUM , MAX(AA_CHANGE) AA_CHANGE , MAX(CDNA_CHANGE) CDNA_CHANGE FROM IDB.PATIENT JOIN GEN ON PT_MRN = MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS R ON R.AV_ELEMENT = 'RACE' AND R.AV_CODE = PT_RACE LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS E ON E.AV_ELEMENT = 'PT_ETHNICITY' AND E.AV_CODE = PT_PT_ETHNICITY LEFT JOIN IDB.CDB_PATIENT ON PT_MRN = CP_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS CR ON CR.AV_ELEMENT = 'CDB_RACE' AND CR.AV_CODE = CP_CDB_RACE LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS CE ON CE.AV_ELEMENT = 'ETHNICITY' AND CE.AV_CODE = CP_ETHNICITY GROUP BY PT_MRN , PDRX_ACCESSION_NO , PT_LAST_NAME , PT_FIRST_NAME , PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH , PT_SEX , CASE WHEN COALESCE(R.AV_DESC, CR.AV_DESC) IN ('WHITE', 'WHITE HISPANIC') THEN 'White' WHEN COALESCE(R.AV_DESC, CR.AV_DESC) IN ('BLACK OR AFRICAN AMERICAN', 'BLACK', 'BLACK HISPANIC') THEN 'Black' WHEN COALESCE(R.AV_DESC, CR.AV_DESC) IN ('ASIAN-FAR EAST/INDIAN SUBCONT', 'KAMPUCHEAN', 'LAOTIAN', 'VIETNAMESE', 'HMONG', 'CHINESE', 'ASIAN INDIAN PAKISTANI', 'JAPANESE', 'KOREAN', 'OTHER ASIAN', 'THAI') THEN 'Asian' WHEN COALESCE(R.AV_DESC, CR.AV_DESC) IN ('NATIVE AMERICAN-AM IND/ALASKA', 'AMER IND ALEUT ESKIMO') THEN 'Native American or Alaska Native' WHEN COALESCE(R.AV_DESC, CR.AV_DESC) IN ('NATIVE HAWAIIAN OR PACIFIC ISL', 'HAWAIIAN', 'MELANESIAN', 'MICRONESIAN', 'FIJI ISLANDER', 'FILIPINO', 'GUAMANIAN', 'PACIFIC ISLANDER') THEN 'Native Hawaiian or Other Pacific Islander' ELSE 'Unspecified' END , REPORTDATE , PROCEDUREDATE , TOTAL_NUMBER_VARIANTS) SELECT MRN , PT_LAST_NAME , PT_FIRST_NAME , DOB , SEX , RACE , REPORTDATE , PROCEDUREDATE , TOTAL_NUMBER_VARIANTS , SITE1_GENE , SITE2_GENE , GENE_ID , EXON_NUM , AA_CHANGE , CDNA_CHANGE , PRPT_REPORT FROM BASE JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V ON PDRX_ACCESSION_NO = PRPT_ACCESSION_NO

prompt: Design a structured report to pull chimerism data from Cytogenetics and Diagnostic Molecular reports for specified MRNs.
completion: SELECT DISTINCT "t1"."PT_MRN" AS "MRN", TRIM(PT_LAST_NAME) AS "Last Name", TRIM(PT_FIRST_NAME) AS "First Name", TRIM(PRPT_ACCESSION_NO) AS "Pathology Accession Number", TRIM(PRPT_REPORT_TYPE_DESC) AS "Pathology Report Type", "t4"."DT_DTE" AS "Pathology Procedure Date", "t5"."DT_DTE" AS "Pathology Report Date", CASE WHEN LENGTH(PRPT_REPORT) <= 15000 THEN RTRIM(CAST(SUBSTR(PRPT_REPORT, 1, 15000) AS VARCHAR(15000))) ELSE CAST(SUBSTR(PRPT_REPORT, 1, 15000) AS VARCHAR(15000)) END "path_prpt_p1", CASE WHEN LENGTH(PRPT_REPORT) > 15000 THEN RTRIM(CAST(SUBSTR(PRPT_REPORT, 15001, 15000) AS VARCHAR(15000))) ELSE '' END "path_prpt_p2", CASE WHEN SUBSTR(UPPER(DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)SPECIMENS SUBMITTED:[\w\W]*(?=)', PRPT_REPORT)), 1, 100) <>'' THEN SUBSTR(UPPER(DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)SPECIMENS SUBMITTED:[\w\W]*(?=)', PRPT_REPORT)), 1, 100) WHEN SUBSTR(UPPER(DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)SPECIMENSSUBMITTED:[\w\W]*(?=)', PRPT_REPORT)), 1, 100) <>'' THEN SUBSTR(UPPER(DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)SPECIMENSSUBMITTED:[\w\W]*(?=)', PRPT_REPORT)), 1, 100) END AS "Specimens Submitted", CASE WHEN SUBSTR(UPPER(DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)TEST PERFORMED:[\w\W]*(?=)', PRPT_REPORT)), 1, 100) <>'' THEN SUBSTR(UPPER(DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)TEST PERFORMED:[\w\W]*(?=)', PRPT_REPORT)), 1, 100) WHEN SUBSTR(UPPER(DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)TESTPERFORMED:[\w\W]*(?=)', PRPT_REPORT)), 1, 100) <>'' THEN SUBSTR(UPPER(DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)TESTPERFORMED:[\w\W]*(?=)', PRPT_REPORT)), 1, 100) WHEN SUBSTR(UPPER(DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)TEST AND METHODOLOGY:[\w\W]*(?=)', PRPT_REPORT)), 1, 100) <>'' THEN SUBSTR(UPPER(DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)TEST AND METHODOLOGY:[\w\W]*(?=)', PRPT_REPORT)), 1, 100) END AS "Test Performed", CASE WHEN SUBSTR(UPPER(DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)DIAGNOSTIC INTERPRETATION:[\w\W]*(?=)', PRPT_REPORT)), 1, 100) <>'' THEN SUBSTR(UPPER(DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)DIAGNOSTIC INTERPRETATION:[\w\W]*(?=)', PRPT_REPORT)), 1, 100) WHEN SUBSTR(UPPER(DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)DIAGNOSTICINTERPRETATION:[\w\W]*(?=)', PRPT_REPORT)), 1, 100) <>'' THEN SUBSTR(UPPER(DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)DIAGNOSTICINTERPRETATION:[\w\W]*(?=)', PRPT_REPORT)), 1, 100) END AS "Diagnostic Interpretation", CASE WHEN SUBSTR(UPPER(DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)ENGRAFTMENT STATUS:[\w\W]*(?=)', PRPT_REPORT)), 1, 100) <>'' THEN SUBSTR(UPPER(DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)ENGRAFTMENT STATUS:[\w\W]*(?=)', PRPT_REPORT)), 1, 100) WHEN SUBSTR(UPPER(DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)ENGRAFTMENTSTATUS:[\w\W]*(?=)', PRPT_REPORT)), 1, 100) <>'' THEN SUBSTR(UPPER(DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)ENGRAFTMENTSTATUS:[\w\W]*(?=)', PRPT_REPORT)), 1, 100) END AS "Engraftment Status", CASE WHEN SUBSTR(UPPER(DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)HOST:[\w\W]*(?=DONOR:)', PRPT_REPORT)), 1, 100) <>'' THEN SUBSTR(UPPER(DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)HOST:[\w\W]*(?=DONOR:)', PRPT_REPORT)), 1, 100) WHEN SUBSTR(UPPER(DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)HOST:[\w\W]*(?=)', PRPT_REPORT)), 1, 100) <>'' THEN SUBSTR(UPPER(DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)HOST:[\w\W]*(?=)', PRPT_REPORT)), 1, 100) END AS "Host:", CASE WHEN SUBSTR(UPPER(DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)DONOR:[\w\W]*(?=TEST AND METHODOLOGY:)', PRPT_REPORT)), 1, 100) <>'' THEN SUBSTR(UPPER(DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)DONOR:[\w\W]*(?=TEST AND METHODOLOGY:)', PRPT_REPORT)), 1, 100) WHEN SUBSTR(UPPER(DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)DONOR:[\w\W]*(?=)', PRPT_REPORT)), 1, 100) <>'' THEN SUBSTR(UPPER(DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)DONOR:[\w\W]*(?=)', PRPT_REPORT)), 1, 100) END AS "Donor:" FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V" "t1" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED" "t6" ON "t1"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t6"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V" "t2" ON "t6"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t2"."PRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATH_RPRT_TYPE_LOOKUP" "t3" ON "t2"."PRPT_REPORT_TYPE" = "t3"."PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_CD" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" "t4" ON "t2"."PRPT_PROCEDURE_DATE_ID" = "t4"."DT_DATE_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" "t5" ON "t2"."PRPT_REPORT_DATE_ID" = "t5"."DT_DATE_ID" WHERE 1=1 AND "t4"."DT_DTE" BETWEEN '2023-01-01' AND CURRENT date AND CONTAINS("t2"."PRPT_REPORT", '("ENGRAFTMENT" OR "CHIMERISM" OR "CHIMERIC" OR "POLYMORPHISM")') = 1 AND "t2"."PRPT_REPORT" IS NOT NULL AND "t3"."PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_DESC" IN ('Cytogenetics', 'Diagnostic Molecular Pathology') AND PRPT_MRN IN (#PROMPTMANY('MRN')#) #PROMPTMANY('Pathology Report Type', 'String', ' ', ' and PRPT_REPORT_TYPE_DESC in (', '', ')')# #PROMPT('Procedure Date Start', 'String', ' ', ' and PRPT_PROCEDURE_DTE >=')# #PROMPT('Procedure Date End', 'String', ' ', ' and PRPT_PROCEDURE_DTE <=')#

prompt: Provide a list of the scheduled operating room cases done by Dr. Husta and co PIs Dr. Mohit Chawla, Dr. Robert Lee, Dr. Or Kalchiem-Dekel, Dr. Elizabeth Yogiaveetil, and Nicholas Vander Els
completion: WITH PROC AS (SELECT DISTINCT OC_MRN, OC_SURG_DTE, OC_SURG_LOC_ID, CRE_RES_NAME, CRE_RES_TYP, CRE_RES_ABBR, CPX_PROC_CD, CPX_PROC_NAME FROM IDB.OR_CASE JOIN IDB.OR_CASE_ALL_PROC ON OC_CASE_ID = OCAP_CASE_ID JOIN IDB.OR_CASE_ALL_SURG ON OCAP_CASE_ID = OCAS_CASE_ID AND OCAS_PNL_NO = OCAP_PNL_NO AND OCAS_SURG_ROLE = 'Primary' JOIN IDB.OR_PROC ON OCAP_OR_PROC_ID = OP_OR_PROC_ID JOIN IDB.OR_CL_PROC ON OP_OR_PROC_ID = OCP_OR_PROC_ID JOIN IDB.CL_PROC ON OCP_PROC_ID = CPX_PROC_ID JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CRE_RES_ID = OCAS_RES_ID WHERE OC_SURG_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT date AND CURRENT DATE+ 7 DAYS AND OC_OR_CASE_STS_CD NOT IN ('2', '5') AND CRE_RES_NAME IN ('HUSTA, BRYAN CHRISTOPHER', 'CHAWLA, MOHIT', 'LEE, ROBERT', 'KALCHIEM-DEKEL, OR', 'YOGIAVEETIL, ELIZABETH CHACKO', 'VANDER ELS, NICHOLAS') ), DIAG AS (SELECT PT_MRN, CASE_STS, TRIM(TM_DX_DTE)|| '= '|| TRIM(TM_SITE_CD) ||'- ' || TRIM(SITE_DESC) AS ICDO_DETAILS, TRIM(MIN_ICD9_EFF_DTE)|| '= '|| TRIM(ICD9_CD)||'- '|| TRIM(ICD9_DESC) AS ICD9_DETAILS FROM IDB.PATIENT LEFT JOIN (SELECT TM_MRN, AV_DESC AS CASE_STS, TM_DX_DTE, TM_HIST_CD, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS HIST_DESC, TM_SITE_CD, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_DESC FROM PROC LEFT JOIN IDB.CDB_TUMOR ON OC_MRN =TM_MRN JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS ON AV_ELEMENT = 'CASE_STS' AND AV_CODE = TM_CASE_STS AND TM_CASE_STS IN ('3', '6', '7', '8') ) AS CDB ON TM_MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN (SELECT CC_MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS MIN_ICD9_EFF_DTE, CC_CLSF_CD AS ICD9_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS ICD9_DESC FROM PROC LEFT JOIN IDB.CTC_CLSF ON OC_MRN = CC_MRN JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE CASE WHEN CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y' AND CC_PT_TYPE <> 'E' THEN 'Y' WHEN CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' AND YEAR(CC_EFF_DTE) < 2004 THEN 'Y' WHEN CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND YEAR(CC_EFF_DTE) < 2001 THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END = 'Y' GROUP BY CC_MRN, CC_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK ) AS ICD9 ON CC_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE COALESCE(TM_MRN, CC_MRN) IS NOT NULL ) , ICDO AS (SELECT PT_MRN AS ICDO_MRN, LISTAGG(COALESCE(STRIP(CAST(ICDO_DETAILS AS VARCHAR(32000))), '') , CHR(13) || CHR(10)) WITHIN GROUP( ORDER BY PT_MRN, ICDO_DETAILS) AS ICDO_DATA FROM (SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN, ICDO_DETAILS FROM DIAG) GROUP BY PT_MRN) , ICD9 AS (SELECT PT_MRN AS ICD9_MRN, LISTAGG(COALESCE(STRIP(CAST(ICD9_DETAILS AS VARCHAR(32000))), '') , CHR(13) || CHR(10)) WITHIN GROUP( ORDER BY PT_MRN, ICD9_DETAILS) AS ICD9_DATA FROM (SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN, ICD9_DETAILS FROM DIAG) GROUP BY PT_MRN) SELECT P.*, ICDO_DATA, ICD9_DATA FROM PROC P LEFT JOIN ICDO ON OC_MRN = ICDO_MRN LEFT JOIN ICD9 ON OC_MRN = ICD9_MRN

prompt: Procedure tallies for the 4 2021-2022 MSK Breast surgical fellows (Linda M. Pak, Emily N. Palmquist, Marissa K. Srour, and Austin D. Williams) from 1/1/21 to 7/1/22
completion: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT LOGID) AS COUNT , SURGEON FROM (SELECT DISTINCT OL_LOG_ID AS LOGID, OL_SURG_DTE AS SURGDATE, CRE_RES_NAME AS SURGEON, OP_PROC_NAME AS CIRCRN_ORPNAME, CL_PROC_1.CPX_PROC_NAME AS CIRCRN_CPTNAME, CL_PROC_1.CPX_PROC_CD AS CIRCRN_CPT, CL_PROC_2.CPX_PROC_CD AS PBD_IDX FROM IDB.OR_LOG JOIN IDB.OR_LOG_ALL_SURG ON OL_LOG_ID = OLAS_LOG_ID JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON OLAS_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.OR_LNLG_DX ON OLAS_LOG_ID = OLLD_LOG_ID AND OLAS_PNL_NO = OLLD_DX_PROC_PNL LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_PROC AS CL_PROC_2 ON OLLD_DX_CPT2_ID = CL_PROC_2.CPX_PROC_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_PROC AS CL_PROC_3 ON OLLD_DX_CPT3_ID = CL_PROC_3.CPX_PROC_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.OR_PROC ON OLLD_DX_OR_PROC = OP_OR_PROC_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.OR_CL_PROC ON OP_OR_PROC_ID = OCP_OR_PROC_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_PROC AS CL_PROC_1 ON OCP_PROC_ID = CL_PROC_1.CPX_PROC_ID WHERE OL_LOG_STS IN ('Posted', 'Unposted') AND CRE_RES_ID IN ('2237373', '2237417', '2237381', '2237380') AND OL_SURG_DTE BETWEEN '2021-01-01' AND '2022-07-01' ) A WHERE 1=1 GROUP BY SURGEON ; SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT LOGID) AS COUNT , SURGEON , CIRCRN_ORPNAME , CIRCRN_CPT FROM (SELECT DISTINCT OL_LOG_ID AS LOGID, OL_SURG_DTE AS SURGDATE, CRE_RES_NAME AS SURGEON, OP_PROC_NAME AS CIRCRN_ORPNAME, CL_PROC_1.CPX_PROC_NAME AS CIRCRN_CPTNAME, CL_PROC_1.CPX_PROC_CD AS CIRCRN_CPT, CL_PROC_2.CPX_PROC_CD AS PBD_IDX FROM IDB.OR_LOG JOIN IDB.OR_LOG_ALL_SURG ON OL_LOG_ID = OLAS_LOG_ID JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON OLAS_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.OR_LNLG_DX ON OLAS_LOG_ID = OLLD_LOG_ID AND OLAS_PNL_NO = OLLD_DX_PROC_PNL LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_PROC AS CL_PROC_2 ON OLLD_DX_CPT2_ID = CL_PROC_2.CPX_PROC_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_PROC AS CL_PROC_3 ON OLLD_DX_CPT3_ID = CL_PROC_3.CPX_PROC_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.OR_PROC ON OLLD_DX_OR_PROC = OP_OR_PROC_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.OR_CL_PROC ON OP_OR_PROC_ID = OCP_OR_PROC_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_PROC AS CL_PROC_1 ON OCP_PROC_ID = CL_PROC_1.CPX_PROC_ID WHERE OL_LOG_STS IN ('Posted', 'Unposted') AND CRE_RES_ID IN ('2237373', '2237417', '2237381', '2237380') AND OL_SURG_DTE BETWEEN '2021-01-01' AND '2022-07-01' ) A WHERE 1=1 GROUP BY SURGEON , CIRCRN_CPT , CIRCRN_ORPNAME ORDER BY SURGEON, CIRCRN_CPT, CIRCRN_ORPNAME ;

prompt: Provide a yearly count, since 2019, of how many new patients were seen by the colorectal department and how many of those patients have been consented to 06-107.
completion: WITH CR19 AS (SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN AS MRN, CPE_ENC_DTE, CRE_RES_NAME, CRE_RES_TYP, CLD_DEPT_NAME, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8, CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR, CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CPE_MRN ORDER BY CPE_ENC_DTE DESC) AS RN FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CRE_RES_TYP IN ('Physician') AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN '2019-01-01' AND '2020-12-31' AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 = 'COL' AND(CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR LIKE '%NV%' OR CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR LIKE '%IR%') ) , X AS (SELECT MRN, YEAR(CPE_ENC_DTE) AS YR, MAX(CASE WHEN AC_IRB_NO = '06-107' THEN 'Y' END) AS "06-107", MAX(CASE WHEN AC_IRB_NO = '12-245' THEN 'Y' END) AS "12-245" FROM CR19 LEFT JOIN IDB.ACCRUALS ON MRN = AC_MRN GROUP BY MRN, YEAR(CPE_ENC_DTE)) SELECT YR, COUNT(DISTINCT MRN) AS NV_COUNT, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "06-107" = 'Y' THEN MRN END) AS "06-107 Count", COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "12-245" = 'Y' THEN MRN END) AS "12-245 Count" FROM X GROUP BY YR

prompt: Schedule a bi-monthly report of pancreatic patients with BRCA1, BRCA2 or PALB2 mutations who have had a recent MSK appointment.
completion: WITH IMPACT_1 AS (SELECT DISTINCT Y.PT_MRN, PDRX_ACCESSION_NO, GENE, RESULT, METHOD, PATH_PROCEDURE_DATE, PATH_RPT_DATE, PRPT_CREATED_DT, PDMR_CREATED_DT, T.* FROM DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS X JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_STRUCTURED_RESULTS_V Y ON X.PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = Y.PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID AND(GENE like '%BRCA%' OR GENE like '%PALB2%') JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML DT ON PRPT_PATH_RPT_ID = PDRX_PATH_RPT_ID CROSS JOIN XMLTABLE('$c/root/*' PASSING DT.PDRX_XML_VALUE AS "c" COLUMNS GENE_PANEL VARCHAR(100) PATH '../meta-data/gene-panel', PART_DESCRIPTION VARCHAR(2000) PATH '../meta-data/part_description', PROJECT VARCHAR(100) PATH '../meta-data/dmp_alys_task_name', SAMPLEID VARCHAR(100) PATH '../meta-data/dmp_sample_id', PATIENTID VARCHAR(100) PATH '../meta-data/dmp_patient_id', TUMOR_TYPE_CODE VARCHAR(100) PATH '../meta-data/tumor_type_code', TUMOR_TYPE_NAME VARCHAR(255) PATH '../meta-data/tumor_type_name', IS_METASTASIS VARCHAR(10) PATH '../meta-data/is_metastasis', PRIMARY_SITE VARCHAR(255) PATH '../meta-data/primary_site', DATE_TUMOR_SEQUENCING VARCHAR(255) PATH '../meta-data/date_tumor_sequencing', METASTASIS_SITE VARCHAR(255) PATH '../meta-data/metastasis_site', DT_PROCEDURE VARCHAR(40) PATH '../meta-data/dt_procedure', DT_SIGNOUT VARCHAR(40) PATH '../meta-data/dt_signout', DT_ACCESSIONED VARCHAR(40) PATH '../meta-data/dt_accessioned', DT_ALYS_END_TIME VARCHAR(40) PATH '../meta-data/dt_alys_end_time', DT_DMS_START_TIME VARCHAR(40) PATH '../meta-data/dt_dms_start_time') T WHERE 1=1 AND(UPPER(PRIMARY_SITE) like '%PANCREAS%' OR UPPER(TUMOR_TYPE_NAME) like '%PANCR%') AND PATH_RPT_DATE >= CURRENT DATE - 9 MONTHS AND PT_VITAL_STATUS = 'ALIVE' ) , IMPACT AS (SELECT IMPACT_1.*, CASE WHEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM IMPACT_1) = 0 THEN CAST('X' AS REAL) ELSE CAST( (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM IMPACT_1) AS REAL) END AS "Run/Fail" FROM IMPACT_1) , GI AS (SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN, CPE_ENC_DTE, STRIP(CRE_RES_NAME) AS CRE_RES_NAME, CRE_RES_TYP, STRIP(CLD_DEPT_NAME) AS CLD_DEPT_NAME, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8, CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CPE_MRN ORDER BY CPE_ENC_DTE DESC) AS RN FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CRE_RES_TYP IN ('Physician') AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 IN ('GI', 'GAS') AND CPE_ENC_DTE >= CURRENT DATE - 9 MONTHS AND CPE_MRN IN (SELECT PT_MRN FROM IMPACT) ) SELECT IMPACT.*, STRIP(PT_LAST_NAME) || ', ' || STRIP(PT_FIRST_NAME) AS NAME, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH AS DOB, STRIP(PT_SEX) AS GENDER, STRIP(R.AV_DESC) AS "Race", STRIP(E.AV_DESC) AS "Ethnicity", CPE_ENC_DTE, STRIP(CRE_RES_NAME) AS CRE_RES_NAME, STRIP(CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8) AS CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8, STRIP(CLD_DEPT_NAME) AS CLD_DEPT_NAME, RN FROM IMPACT JOIN IDB.PATIENT P ON IMPACT.PT_MRN = P.PT_MRN LEFT JOIN GI ON IMPACT.PT_MRN = GI.CPE_MRN AND RN = 1 LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS R ON PT_RACE = R.AV_CODE AND R.AV_ELEMENT = 'RACE' LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS E ON PT_PT_ETHNICITY = E.AV_CODE AND E.AV_ELEMENT = 'PT_ETHNICITY'

prompt: Provide a one-time list of non-English speaking patients in breast and lung cancer clinics.
completion: WITH PTS AS (SELECT CDD_MRN MRN, STRIP(PT_LAST_NAME)||', '||PT_FIRST_NAME PT_NAME, PT_SEX_DESC SEX, PT_RACE_DESC RACE, PT_PT_ETHNICITY_DESC ETHNICITY, PT_MARITAL_STS_DESC MARITAL_STS, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH DOB, YEAR(CDD_SERVICE_DTE) - YEAR(PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) CURRENT_AGE, MIN (CDD_SERVICE_DTE) FIRST_VISIT_DTE, MAX (CDD_SERVICE_DTE) LAST_VISIT_DTE, MAX(CASE WHEN CDO_ITEM_NAME = 'Preferred Language' THEN SUBSTR(CDO_VALUE_TEXT, 1, 50) END) PREFERRED_LANG FROM IDB.CD_DOCUMENT JOIN IDB.PATIENT_V ON CDD_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION ON CDD_DOC_GUID = CDO_DOC_GUID WHERE CDD_CANCEL_IND = '0' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND = '0' AND PT_DATE_OF_DEATH IS NULL AND (CDD_DOC_NAME LIKE '%Breast%' OR CDD_DOC_NAME LIKE'%Thoracic%') GROUP BY CDD_MRN, STRIP(PT_LAST_NAME)||', '||PT_FIRST_NAME , PT_SEX_DESC , PT_RACE_DESC , PT_PT_ETHNICITY_DESC , PT_MARITAL_STS_DESC , PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH , YEAR(CDD_SERVICE_DTE) - YEAR(PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) HAVING MAX(CASE WHEN CDO_ITEM_NAME = 'Preferred Language' THEN SUBSTR(CDO_VALUE_TEXT, 1, 50) END)<> 'English' ) , DX AS (SELECT CC_MRN, CC_CLSF_CD DX_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK DX_DESC , CC_EFF_DTE FIRST_DX_DTE , DOC_NAME, DOC_SVC, DOC_ACDMC_DPT , ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CC_MRN ORDER BY CC_EFF_DTE) RN FROM PTS JOIN IDB.CTC_CLSF ON MRN = CC_MRN JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.DOC ON CC_RESP_PARTY = DOC_DR_NO WHERE (CC_CLSF_CD LIKE 'C50.%' OR CC_CLSF_CD LIKE 'C34.%') AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND (CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR(CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) ) SELECT MRN, PT_NAME, SEX, RACE, ETHNICITY, MARITAL_STS, DOB, CURRENT_AGE, FIRST_VISIT_DTE, LAST_VISIT_DTE, PREFERRED_LANG, DX_CD, DX_DESC, FIRST_DX_DTE, DOC_NAME, DOC_SVC, DOC_ACDMC_DPT FROM PTS JOIN DX ON MRN = CC_MRN AND RN = 1 ;

prompt: Living pediatrics patients born in either 2000. 2001, 2002, 2003 and have had ten or more pediatric appointments.
completion: WITH PED17410D01 AS (SELECT CRE_RES_ID AS RESID , CPE_MRN AS MRN , CPE_ENC_DTE AS APPTDATE , PT_LAST_NAME AS LASTNAME, PT_FIRST_NAME AS FIRSTNAME , PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH AS DOB , PT_ADDR1 AS ADDR1, PT_ADDR2 AS ADDR2 , PT_CITY AS CITY, PT_STATE AS STATE, PT_ZIP_CD AS ZIP , PT_PHONE AS PHONE, CL_MOBILE_PHONE AS MOBILE_PHONE, CPP_EMAIL_ADDR AS EMAIL_ADDR FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID AND (CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 = 'PED' OR (CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 = 'SRG' AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 = 'PDS')) AND CLD_DEPT_NAME not like 'PDH%' JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CRE_RES_ID = CPE_VST_RES_ID AND CRE_RES_TYP IN ('Physician', 'PhD', 'Nurse Practitioner', 'Advanced Practice Nurse', 'Physician Assistant') JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PT_MRN = CPE_MRN AND PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH BETWEEN '2000-01-01' AND '2003-12-31' AND PT_DEATH_IND NOT IN ('C', 'D', 'X') JOIN IDB.CL_PAS_PATIENT ON PT_MRN = CPP_MRN AND CPP_MRN <> '' JOIN IDB.CL_PATIENT ON PT_MRN = CL_MRN WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Comp', 'Arrived') AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN '2000-01-01' AND '2019-01-31' ) , PED17410D02 AS (SELECT A.MRN, DOC_NAME, RESID, DOC_ACDMC_SVC AS SVC, DOC_ACDMC_DPT AS DPT , COUNT(APPTDATE) AS MDCT , LASTNAME, FIRSTNAME, CITY, STATE, PHONE, DOB , ADDR1, ADDR2, ZIP, MOBILE_PHONE, EMAIL_ADDR FROM PED17410D01 A JOIN (SELECT MRN, COUNT(APPTDATE) AS COUNT FROM PED17410D01 GROUP BY MRN HAVING COUNT(APPTDATE) > 9) AS X ON X.MRN = A.MRN JOIN IDB.DOC ON RESID = DOC_DR_NO GROUP BY A.MRN, DOC_NAME, RESID, DOC_ACDMC_SVC, DOC_ACDMC_DPT , LASTNAME, FIRSTNAME, CITY, STATE, PHONE, DOB , ADDR1, ADDR2, ZIP, MOBILE_PHONE, EMAIL_ADDR) SELECT A.MRN, DOC_NAME, RESID, SVC, DPT, MDCT , LASTNAME, FIRSTNAME, DOB, ADDR1, ADDR2 , CITY, STATE, ZIP, PHONE, PLA_DONOT_MAIL_IND , MOBILE_PHONE, EMAIL_ADDR FROM PED17410D02 A JOIN (SELECT MRN, MAX(MDCT) AS MAXCOUNT FROM PED17410D02 GROUP BY MRN) AS X ON X.MRN = A.MRN AND MAXCOUNT = MDCT JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY ON A.MRN = PLA_MRN GROUP BY A.MRN, DOC_NAME, RESID, SVC, DPT, MDCT , LASTNAME, FIRSTNAME, DOB, ADDR1, ADDR2 , CITY, STATE, ZIP, PHONE, PLA_DONOT_MAIL_IND , MOBILE_PHONE, EMAIL_ADDR

prompt: Operational dashboard to see Patient COVID Vaccine Appointments (INCLUDING CANCELLED)
completion: WITH EMAR AS (SELECT CASE WHEN CPVE_DOSE_NUM LIKE '%1%' THEN 1 WHEN CPVE_DOSE_NUM LIKE '%2%' THEN 2 ELSE NULL END AS EMAR_DOSE_NUMBER, CPVE_ORDER_GUID, CPVE_MRN, CPVE_ADMIN_DT, CPVE_MFG_NAME, CPVE_LOT, CPVE_LOT_EXP_DTE, CPVE_BODY_SITE, CPVE_DOSE, CPVE_ROUTE_CD FROM IDB.COVID19_PATIENT_CP_VACCINE_EMAR E WHERE CPVE_TASK_STATUS_CD = 'Performed' ) SELECT DISTINCT CPVV_MRN, CPVV_PATIENT_NAME, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, PT_PHONE, PT_EMAIL_ADDRESS, CPVV_VISIT_DT, CPVV_VISIT_STATUS, CPVV_CREATED_WHEN_DT, CPVV_MSK_VISIT_TYPE, EM1.CPVE_ADMIN_DT DOSE_1_EMAR_ADMIN_DT, EM2.CPVE_ADMIN_DT DOSE_2_EMAR_ADMIN_DT FROM IDB.COVID19_PATIENT_CP_VACCINE_VISIT LEFT JOIN EMAR EM1 ON EM1.CPVE_MRN = CPVV_MRN AND EM1.EMAR_DOSE_NUMBER = 1 LEFT JOIN EMAR EM2 ON EM2.CPVE_MRN = CPVV_MRN AND EM2.EMAR_DOSE_NUMBER = 2 LEFT JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON CPVV_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE DATE(CPVV_VISIT_DT) >= '2021-02-18'

prompt: Provide list of patients with the term 'thrombotic microangiopathy' in surgical pathology reports between 2000 and 2023
completion: SELECT PRPT_MRN, PRPT_PROCEDURE_DTE, PRPT_REPORT_TYPE_DESC, PRPT_ACCESSION_NO, PRPT_REPORT FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V WHERE PRPT_REPORT IS NOT NULL AND PRPT_REPORT_DTE BETWEEN '2000-01-01' AND CURRENT date AND CONTAINS("PRPT_REPORT", '("thrombotic microangiopathy")') = 1 AND PRPT_ACCESSION_NO like 'S%'

prompt: Provide data on patients admitted to GI oncology service with the diagnosis of small bowel obstruction
completion: WITH X0 AS (SELECT DISTINCT VIS_MRN AS MRN, VIS_ADM_NUM AS ADM_NUM, VIS_HOSP_SVC AS HOSP_SVC, VIS_ADM_DTE AS ADM_DTE, VIS_DSCH_DTE AS DSCH_DTE, VIS_DAYS_STAY AS LOS, CC_EFF_DTE, CLM_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK FROM IDB.VISIT_V JOIN IDB.CTC_CLSF ON CC_ADM_NUM = VIS_ADM_NUM AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'D%' AND ((CC_PT_TYPE = 'I') OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) AND CC_CLSF_CD LIKE 'K56%' JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE VIS_IP_OP_ADJUSTED_IND = 'I' AND VIS_VISIT_STATUS IN ('2', '3') AND VIS_HOSP_SVC like 'GI%' AND VIS_ADM_DTE >= '2019-01-01' ) , ICD AS (SELECT MRN, ADM_NUM, LISTAGG(COALESCE(STRIP(CAST(CC_EFF_DTE AS VARCHAR(12000))), '') || ' | ' || COALESCE(STRIP(CAST(CLM_CLSF_CD AS VARCHAR(12000))), '') || ' - ' || COALESCE(STRIP(CAST(CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS VARCHAR(12000))), '') , CHR(13) || CHR(10)) WITHIN GROUP( ORDER BY MRN, ADM_NUM, CC_EFF_DTE, CLM_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK) AS ICD_10 FROM X0 GROUP BY MRN, ADM_NUM) , X AS (SELECT DISTINCT X0.MRN, X0.ADM_NUM, HOSP_SVC, ADM_DTE, DSCH_DTE, LOS, ICD_10 FROM X0 LEFT JOIN ICD ON X0.MRN = ICD.MRN AND X0.ADM_NUM = ICD.ADM_NUM) , READMIT1 AS (SELECT DISTINCT VIS_MRN, ADM_NUM, VIS_PATIENT_TYPE, VIS_ADM_NUM, VIS_HOSP_SVC, VIS_ADM_DTE, VIS_DSCH_DTE, VIS_DAYS_STAY FROM X JOIN IDB.VISIT_V ON VIS_MRN = MRN AND VIS_ADM_DTE BETWEEN DSCH_DTE AND DSCH_DTE + 14 DAYS WHERE VIS_IP_OP_ADJUSTED_IND = 'I' AND VIS_VISIT_STATUS IN ('2', '3') AND VIS_HOSP_SVC like 'GI%' ) , READMIT2 AS (SELECT VIS_MRN, ADM_NUM, LISTAGG(COALESCE(STRIP(CAST(VIS_ADM_DTE AS VARCHAR(12000))), '') , CHR(13) || CHR(10)) WITHIN GROUP( ORDER BY VIS_MRN, ADM_NUM, VIS_ADM_DTE) AS READMITS FROM READMIT1 GROUP BY VIS_MRN, ADM_NUM) , X1 AS (SELECT DISTINCT X.*, READMITS FROM X LEFT JOIN READMIT2 ON X.MRN = READMIT2.VIS_MRN AND X.ADM_NUM = READMIT2.ADM_NUM) , SRG AS (SELECT DISTINCT SSE_MRN, SSE_SURG_DTE, SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD, SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC FROM X1 JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT ON SSE_MRN = MRN AND SSE_SURG_DTE BETWEEN ADM_DTE AND DSCH_DTE JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE ON SSE_LOG_ID = SSP_LOG_ID WHERE SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD IN ('43246', '43830', '49440') OR SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC = 'GI GASTROSTOMY PLACE' ) , CTE AS (SELECT SSE_MRN AS SRG_MRN, SSE_SURG_DTE AS SRG_DATE, STRIP(SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD) || ' - ' || STRIP(SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC) AS SRG_CPT FROM SRG) , CTE2 AS (SELECT * FROM CTE ORDER BY SRG_MRN, SRG_DATE, SRG_CPT) , T1 AS (SELECT SRG_MRN, SRG_DATE, SRG_CPT, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY SRG_MRN ORDER BY SRG_DATE) AS RN FROM CTE2 ORDER BY SRG_MRN, SRG_DATE) , T2 (MRN, SRG, RN1) AS (SELECT SRG_MRN, CAST(SRG_DATE AS VARCHAR(6000))||' | '||CAST(SRG_CPT AS VARCHAR(100)), RN FROM T1 WHERE T1.RN = 1 UNION ALL SELECT SRG_MRN, RTRIM(CAST(SRG AS VARCHAR(4000))) || ', ' || CHR(13) || CHR(10) || CAST(SRG_DATE AS VARCHAR(100))||' | '||RTRIM(CAST(SRG_CPT AS VARCHAR(100))) , RN1 + 1 FROM T1, T2 WHERE SRG_MRN = MRN AND RN = RN1+1 ) , T3 AS (SELECT MRN, MAX(RN1) RN FROM T2 GROUP BY MRN) , T4 AS (SELECT T2.MRN, RN, SRG FROM T2 JOIN T3 ON T2.MRN = T3.MRN AND T2.RN1 = T3.RN) , SRG2 AS (SELECT DISTINCT SSE_MRN, SSE_SURG_DTE, SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD, SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC FROM X1 JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT ON SSE_MRN = MRN AND SSE_SURG_DTE BETWEEN ADM_DTE AND DSCH_DTE JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE ON SSE_LOG_ID = SSP_LOG_ID WHERE SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD IN ('44120', '44180') ) , CTE3 AS (SELECT SSE_MRN AS SRG_MRN, SSE_SURG_DTE AS SRG_DATE, STRIP(SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD) || ' - ' || STRIP(SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC) AS SRG_CPT FROM SRG2) , CTE4 AS (SELECT * FROM CTE3 ORDER BY SRG_MRN, SRG_DATE, SRG_CPT) , T11 AS (SELECT SRG_MRN, SRG_DATE, SRG_CPT, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY SRG_MRN ORDER BY SRG_DATE) AS RN FROM CTE4 ORDER BY SRG_MRN, SRG_DATE) , T22 (MRN, SRG, RN1) AS (SELECT SRG_MRN, CAST(SRG_DATE AS VARCHAR(6000))||' | '||CAST(SRG_CPT AS VARCHAR(100)), RN FROM T11 WHERE T11.RN = 1 UNION ALL SELECT SRG_MRN, RTRIM(CAST(SRG AS VARCHAR(4000))) || ', ' || CHR(13) || CHR(10) || CAST(SRG_DATE AS VARCHAR(100))||' | '||RTRIM(CAST(SRG_CPT AS VARCHAR(100))) , RN1 + 1 FROM T11, T22 WHERE SRG_MRN = MRN AND RN = RN1+1 ) , T33 AS (SELECT MRN, MAX(RN1) RN FROM T22 GROUP BY MRN) , T44 AS (SELECT T22.MRN, RN, SRG AS SRG2 FROM T22 JOIN T33 ON T22.MRN = T33.MRN AND T22.RN1 = T33.RN) , X2 AS (SELECT X1.*, SRG, SRG2 FROM X1 LEFT JOIN T4 ON X1.MRN = T4.MRN LEFT JOIN T44 ON X1.MRN = T44.MRN) , CIS AS (SELECT OO_MRN, ADM_NUM , MAX(CASE WHEN UPPER(OO_ORD_NAME) LIKE '%OCTREOTIDE%' THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END) AS OCTREOTIDE , MAX(CASE WHEN UPPER(OO_ORD_NAME) LIKE '%DEXAMETHASONE%' THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END) AS DEXAMETHASONE , MAX(CASE WHEN UPPER(OO_ORD_NAME) LIKE '%OLANZAP%' THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END) AS OLANZAP FROM X2 JOIN IDB.OMS_ORDER ON MRN = OO_MRN AND ADM_NUM = OO_ADM_NUM LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_MED_DETAIL ON OO_ORD_GUID = OMD_ORD_GUID JOIN IDB.OAS_ORD_TASK_OCCR ON OOTO_ORD_GUID = OO_ORD_GUID AND OOTO_STATUS_CD = 'Performed' JOIN IDB.OAS_CTLG_ITEM_TASK ON OOTO_CAT_ITEM_GUID = OCIT_GUID AND OCIT_LEVEL_NO = 0 WHERE OO_ORD_STS_CD NOT IN ('CANC', 'CANP', 'AUC3') AND(UPPER(OO_ORD_NAME) LIKE '%OCTREOTIDE%' OR UPPER(OO_ORD_NAME) LIKE '%DEXAMETHASONE%' OR UPPER(OO_ORD_NAME) LIKE '%OLANZAP%') AND OOTO_SIGNIFIC_DTE BETWEEN ADM_DTE AND DSCH_DTE GROUP BY OO_MRN, ADM_NUM ) , TPN AS (SELECT DISTINCT OO_MRN, ADM_NUM, OO_ORD_NAME FROM X2 JOIN IDB.OMS_ORDER ON OO_MRN = MRN AND ADM_NUM = OO_ADM_NUM AND OO_ENTER_DTE BETWEEN ADM_DTE AND DSCH_DTE AND OO_ORD_STS_CD NOT IN ('CANC', 'CANP', 'AUC3') AND OO_ORD_NAME IN ('Discharged on TPN', 'TPN Consult (Inpatient)', 'TPN Order (Adult)')) , TMP AS (SELECT DISTINCT X2.MRN, X2.ADM_NUM, OCTREOTIDE, DEXAMETHASONE, OLANZAP, CASE WHEN TPN.OO_MRN IS NOT NULL THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS TPN FROM X2 LEFT JOIN CIS ON X2.MRN = CIS.OO_MRN AND X2.ADM_NUM = CIS.ADM_NUM LEFT JOIN TPN ON X2.MRN = TPN.OO_MRN AND X2.ADM_NUM = TPN.ADM_NUM) SELECT X2.*, CASE WHEN OCTREOTIDE IS NULL THEN 'No' ELSE OCTREOTIDE END AS OCTREOTIDE, CASE WHEN DEXAMETHASONE IS NULL THEN 'No' ELSE DEXAMETHASONE END AS DEXAMETHASONE, CASE WHEN OLANZAP IS NULL THEN 'No' ELSE OLANZAP END AS OLANZAP, CASE WHEN TPN IS NULL THEN 'No' ELSE TPN END AS TPN FROM X2 LEFT JOIN TMP ON X2.MRN = TMP.MRN AND X2.ADM_NUM = TMP.ADM_NUM

prompt: Identify all patients who underwent neck dissections for metastatic squamous cell carcinoma from a head and neck primary site, 2000-2010.
completion: SELECT PT_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, PBD_SVC_DTE, PBC_CPT_CD, C.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK, DOC_NAME, TM_DX_DTE, TM_HIST_CD, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS ICDO_HIST_DESC, TM_SITE_CD, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS ICDO_SITE_DESC, TM_PATH_TNM_N FROM IDB.PATIENT JOIN IDB.CDB_TUMOR ON PT_MRN = TM_MRN JOIN IDB.PBD_DTL ON TM_MRN = PBD_MRN JOIN IDB.PBD_INVOICE ON PBD_INV_NO = PBI_INV_NO JOIN IDB.PBD_CODE ON PBD_PBD_CD = PBC_PBD_CD JOIN IDB.DOC ON PBI_PERFORM_DR_NO = DOC_DR_NO JOIN IDB.CLM C ON PBC_CPT_CD = C.CLM_CLSF_CD LEFT JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD LEFT JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD WHERE PBC_CPT_CD IN ('21555', '21556', '21557', '38724') AND PBD_SVC_DTE >= '2000-01-01' AND TM_CASE_STS = '3' AND TM_DX_DTE <= PBD_SVC_DTE AND TM_PATH_TNM_N NOT IN ('N88', 'N', 'N0', 'NX') AND TM_HIST_CD IN ('M8051/3', 'M8052/3', 'M8070/3', 'M8071/3', 'M8072/3', 'M8073/3', 'M8074/3', 'M8075/3', 'M8076/3', 'M8078/3', 'M8082/3', 'M8083/3', 'M8084/3') AND TM_SITE_CD IN ('C001', 'C003', 'C004', 'C006', 'C009', 'C019', 'C020', 'C021', 'C022', 'C023', 'C028', 'C029', 'C030', 'C031', 'C039', 'C040', 'C041', 'C048', 'C049', 'C050', 'C051', 'C052', 'C059', 'C060', 'C062', 'C068', 'C069', 'C079', 'C080', 'C090', 'C091', 'C098', 'C099', 'C101', 'C103', 'C109', 'C119', 'C129', 'C130', 'C131', 'C132', 'C139', 'C140', 'C148', 'C300', 'C310', 'C311', 'C320', 'C321', 'C322', 'C323', 'C329', 'C441', 'C442', 'C443', 'C444', 'C695', 'C760', 'C809')

prompt: Provide a report identifying all living patients with a positive RNF43 or RSPO diagnostic molecular test result and metastatic colon or rectal cancer.
completion: WITH PTS AS (SELECT PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID PID FROM DV.PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED) , DT_1 AS (SELECT PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID AS P_ID FROM DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS REC WHERE 1=1 AND PT_VITAL_STATUS IN ('ALIVE') ) , DT_2_1 AS (SELECT INC.PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID P_ID FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_STRUCTURED_RESULTS_V INC JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML DT ON INC.PRPT_PATH_RPT_ID = DT.PDRX_PATH_RPT_ID CROSS JOIN XMLTABLE('$c/root/meta-data' PASSING DT.PDRX_XML_VALUE AS "c" COLUMNS PRIMARY_SITE VARCHAR(264) PATH 'primary_site', TUMOR_TYPE_NAME VARCHAR(264) PATH 'tumor_type_name' , TUMOR_TYPE_CODE VARCHAR(264) PATH 'tumor_type_code', IS_METASTASIS VARCHAR(3) PATH 'is_metastasis' , METASTASIS_SITE VARCHAR(264) PATH 'metastasis_site') T WHERE 1=1 AND CASE WHEN LOWER(METASTASIS_SITE) IN ('null', 'not available', 'not applicable') THEN 0 ELSE 1 END = 1 AND (INC.GENE IN ('RSPO2', 'RSPO3') OR INC.GENE2 IN ('RSPO2', 'RSPO3')) AND LOWER(INC.METHOD) IN LOWER('Archer') ) , DT_2_2 AS (SELECT INC.PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID P_ID FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_STRUCTURED_RESULTS_V INC LEFT JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_STRUCTURED_RESULTS_V EX ON INC.PRPT_PATH_RPT_ID = EX.PRPT_PATH_RPT_ID AND EX.GENE IN ('APC', 'CTNNB1') JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML DT ON INC.PRPT_PATH_RPT_ID = DT.PDRX_PATH_RPT_ID CROSS JOIN XMLTABLE('$c/root/meta-data' PASSING DT.PDRX_XML_VALUE AS "c" COLUMNS PRIMARY_SITE VARCHAR(264) PATH 'primary_site', TUMOR_TYPE_NAME VARCHAR(264) PATH 'tumor_type_name' , TUMOR_TYPE_CODE VARCHAR(264) PATH 'tumor_type_code', IS_METASTASIS VARCHAR(3) PATH 'is_metastasis' , METASTASIS_SITE VARCHAR(264) PATH 'metastasis_site') T WHERE 1=1 AND CASE WHEN LOWER(METASTASIS_SITE) IN ('null', 'not available', 'not applicable') THEN 0 ELSE 1 END = 1 AND (INC.GENE IN ('RNF43') OR INC.GENE2 IN ('RNF43')) AND LOWER(INC.METHOD) IN LOWER('IMPACT') AND EX.PRPT_PATH_RPT_ID IS NULL ) SELECT DISTINCT P_ID FROM (SELECT P_ID FROM DT_1 INTERSECT (SELECT P_ID FROM DT_2_1 UNION ALL SELECT P_ID FROM DT_2_2 ))

prompt: To outline the causes and patterns of death related to germ cell tumor diagnosis.
completion: WITH CNS_METS AS (SELECT CC_MRN, 'Y' AS CNS_METS FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE CC_CLSF_CD IN ('198.3', '198.4', 'C79.31', 'C79.32') AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' ) SELECT DISTINCT TM_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, PT_DATE_OF_DEATH, E.AV_DESC AS ETHNICITY, R.AV_DESC AS RACE, TM_DX_DTE "TUMOR DX", TM_CA_SURG_DTE "CANCER SURGERY", TM_SURG_DEF_DTE "MOST INVASIVE SURGERY TO THE PRIMARY SITE DATE", TM_SYST_STRT_DTE "FIRST SYSTEMIC TREATMENT", TM_RAD_STRT_DTE "FIRST RADIATION THERAPY", TM_SITE_CD "PRIMARY SITE", S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK "SITE DESC", TM_HIST_CD "HISTOLOGY CODE", H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK "HISTOLOGY SITE", TM_CLIN_TNM_T, TM_CLIN_TNM_N, TM_CLIN_TNM_M, TM_CLIN_STG_GRP, TM_PATH_TNM_T, TM_PATH_TNM_N, TM_PATH_TNM_M, TM_PATH_STG_GRP, CNS_METS FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PT_MRN = TM_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS E ON E.AV_ELEMENT = 'PT_ETHNICITY' AND E.AV_CODE = PT_PT_ETHNICITY LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS R ON R.AV_ELEMENT = 'RACE' AND R.AV_CODE = PT_RACE LEFT JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD LEFT JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD LEFT JOIN CNS_METS ON TM_MRN = CC_MRN WHERE PT_SEX = 'M' AND PT_DATE_OF_DEATH IS NOT NULL AND TM_DX_DTE BETWEEN '1997-01-01' AND '2017-12-31' AND YEAR(TM_DX_DTE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) >= 18 AND TM_CASE_STS IN ('3' ,'6' ,'7') AND TM_HIST_CD IN ('M9085/3' ,'M9061/3' ,'M9070/3' ,'M9065/3' ,'M9080/3' ,'M9100/3' ,'M9101/3' ,'M9063/3' ,'M9062/3' ,'M9071/3') ; WITH PTS AS (SELECT TM_MRN FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PT_MRN = TM_MRN WHERE PT_SEX = 'M' AND PT_DATE_OF_DEATH IS NOT NULL AND TM_DX_DTE BETWEEN '1997-01-01' AND '2017-12-31' AND YEAR(TM_DX_DTE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) >= 18 AND TM_CASE_STS IN ('3' ,'6' ,'7') AND TM_HIST_CD IN ('M9085/3' ,'M9061/3' ,'M9070/3' ,'M9065/3' ,'M9080/3' ,'M9100/3' ,'M9101/3' ,'M9063/3' ,'M9062/3' ,'M9071/3') ) SELECT DISTINCT T1.PT_MRN AS CIS_MRN, T2.PINC_GENERIC_NAME AS "Generic Drug Name", MIN(T3.DT_DTE) AS "Min Start Date", MAX(T10.DT_DTE) AS "Max Stop Date" FROM PTS JOIN DV.PATIENT_IDENTIFICATION_MRN_V ON PI_SOURCE_SYSTEM_PT_ID = TM_MRN INNER JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V T1 ON T1.PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID LEFT JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED T4 ON T1.PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = T4.PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID LEFT JOIN DV.PHM_PT_MEDS_MQT T5 ON T4.PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = T5.POD_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID LEFT JOIN DV.PHM_ORDER_DTL T6 ON T5.POD_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = T6.POD_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID AND T5.POD_PHARMA_INVENTORY_CTLG_ID = T6.POD_PHARMA_INVENTORY_CTLG_ID LEFT JOIN DV.PHM_INVENTORY_CATALOG T2 ON T6.POD_PHARMA_INVENTORY_CTLG_ID = T2.PINC_INVENTORY_CTLG_ID LEFT JOIN DV.DATE_V T3 ON T6.POD_START_DATE_ID = T3.DT_DATE_ID LEFT JOIN DV.DATE_V T10 ON T6.POD_STOP_DATE_ID = T10.DT_DATE_ID WHERE 1=1 AND T2.PINC_CHEMO_IND = 'Y' GROUP BY PT_MRN, T2.PINC_GENERIC_NAME ;

prompt: Procedure tallies for breast surgical fellows (Sarah Shubeck, Jennifer Zhang, Francys Verdial Argueta, Mary Mrdutt, and Giacomo Montagna) from  1/1/20 to 7/1/21.
completion: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT LOGID) AS COUNT , SURGEON FROM (SELECT DISTINCT OL_LOG_ID AS LOGID, OL_SURG_DTE AS SURGDATE, CRE_RES_NAME AS SURGEON, OP_PROC_NAME AS CIRCRN_ORPNAME, CL_PROC_1.CPX_PROC_NAME AS CIRCRN_CPTNAME, CL_PROC_1.CPX_PROC_CD AS CIRCRN_CPT, CL_PROC_2.CPX_PROC_CD AS PBD_IDX FROM IDB.OR_LOG JOIN IDB.OR_LOG_ALL_SURG ON OL_LOG_ID = OLAS_LOG_ID JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON OLAS_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.OR_LNLG_DX ON OLAS_LOG_ID = OLLD_LOG_ID AND OLAS_PNL_NO = OLLD_DX_PROC_PNL LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_PROC AS CL_PROC_2 ON OLLD_DX_CPT2_ID = CL_PROC_2.CPX_PROC_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_PROC AS CL_PROC_3 ON OLLD_DX_CPT3_ID = CL_PROC_3.CPX_PROC_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.OR_PROC ON OLLD_DX_OR_PROC = OP_OR_PROC_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.OR_CL_PROC ON OP_OR_PROC_ID = OCP_OR_PROC_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_PROC AS CL_PROC_1 ON OCP_PROC_ID = CL_PROC_1.CPX_PROC_ID WHERE OL_LOG_STS IN ('Posted', 'Unposted') AND CRE_RES_ID IN ('2236613', '2236610', '2236612', '2236605', '2236604') AND OL_SURG_DTE BETWEEN '2020-01-01' AND '2021-07-01' ) A WHERE 1=1 GROUP BY SURGEON ; SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT LOGID) AS COUNT , SURGEON , CIRCRN_ORPNAME , CIRCRN_CPT FROM (SELECT DISTINCT OL_LOG_ID AS LOGID, OL_SURG_DTE AS SURGDATE, CRE_RES_NAME AS SURGEON, OP_PROC_NAME AS CIRCRN_ORPNAME, CL_PROC_1.CPX_PROC_NAME AS CIRCRN_CPTNAME, CL_PROC_1.CPX_PROC_CD AS CIRCRN_CPT, CL_PROC_2.CPX_PROC_CD AS PBD_IDX FROM IDB.OR_LOG JOIN IDB.OR_LOG_ALL_SURG ON OL_LOG_ID = OLAS_LOG_ID JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON OLAS_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.OR_LNLG_DX ON OLAS_LOG_ID = OLLD_LOG_ID AND OLAS_PNL_NO = OLLD_DX_PROC_PNL LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_PROC AS CL_PROC_2 ON OLLD_DX_CPT2_ID = CL_PROC_2.CPX_PROC_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_PROC AS CL_PROC_3 ON OLLD_DX_CPT3_ID = CL_PROC_3.CPX_PROC_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.OR_PROC ON OLLD_DX_OR_PROC = OP_OR_PROC_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.OR_CL_PROC ON OP_OR_PROC_ID = OCP_OR_PROC_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_PROC AS CL_PROC_1 ON OCP_PROC_ID = CL_PROC_1.CPX_PROC_ID WHERE OL_LOG_STS IN ('Posted', 'Unposted') AND CRE_RES_ID IN ('2236613', '2236610', '2236612', '2236605', '2236604') AND OL_SURG_DTE BETWEEN '2020-01-01' AND '2021-07-01' ) A WHERE 1=1 GROUP BY SURGEON , CIRCRN_CPT , CIRCRN_ORPNAME ORDER BY SURGEON, CIRCRN_CPT, CIRCRN_ORPNAME ;

prompt: Identify patients within the STGU/bladder cancer group who have been treated with enfortumab vedotin, and dates of all surgical pathology reports for those patients
completion: WITH FIRSTEV AS (SELECT DISTINCT APR_MRN AS FIRSTEV_MRN, ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY APR_MRN ORDER BY APR_START_DTE ASC) AS RNFIRST, APR_START_DTE AS FIRST_DRUG_START_DATE, APR_END_DTE AS FIRST_DRUG_END_DATE, CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME AS DRUG_NAME_EV FROM IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX_V WHERE CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME = 'ENFORTUMAB VEDOTIN' GROUP BY APR_MRN, APR_START_DTE, APR_END_DTE, CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME), LASTEV AS (SELECT DISTINCT APR_MRN AS LASTEV_MRN, ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY APR_MRN ORDER BY APR_START_DTE DESC) AS RNLAST, APR_START_DTE AS LAST_DRUG_START_DATE, APR_END_DTE AS LAST_DRUG_END_DATE, CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME AS DRUG_NAME_EV_LAST FROM IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX_V WHERE CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME = 'ENFORTUMAB VEDOTIN' GROUP BY APR_MRN, APR_START_DTE, APR_END_DTE, CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME) SELECT PT_MRN AS MRN, TRIM(PT_LAST_NAME)||','|| TRIM(PT_FIRST_NAME) AS "Patient Name", PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH AS "Date of Birth", PT_DATE_OF_DEATH AS "Date of Death", FIRST_DRUG_START_DATE AS "First Drug Start Date", FIRST_DRUG_END_DATE AS "First Drug End Date", LAST_DRUG_START_DATE AS "Last Drug Start Date", LAST_DRUG_END_DATE AS "Last Drug Start Date", DRUG_NAME_EV AS "Drug Name" FROM FIRSTEV JOIN LASTEV ON FIRSTEV_MRN = LASTEV_MRN JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON FIRSTEV_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE RNFIRST = 1 AND RNLAST = 1 ; WITH FIRSTEV AS (SELECT DISTINCT APR_MRN AS FIRSTEV_MRN, ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY APR_MRN ORDER BY APR_START_DTE ASC) AS RNFIRST, APR_START_DTE AS FIRST_DRUG_START_DATE, APR_END_DTE AS FIRST_DRUG_END_DATE, CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME AS DRUG_NAME_EV FROM IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX_V WHERE CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME = 'ENFORTUMAB VEDOTIN' GROUP BY APR_MRN, APR_START_DTE, APR_END_DTE, CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME), PATHOLOGY AS (SELECT DISTINCT PRPT_MRN, PRPT_REPORT_DTE, PRPT_REPORT_TYPE_DESC, PRPT_ACCESSION_NO, VARCHAR(PRPT_REPORT, 32000) AS REPORT_TXT FROM FIRSTEV JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V ON FIRSTEV_MRN = PRPT_MRN WHERE PRPT_REPORT IS NOT NULL AND (UPPER(PRPT_REPORT_TYPE_DESC) LIKE 'SURGICAL PATHOLOGY%' OR UPPER(PRPT_REPORT_TYPE_DESC) LIKE '%CYTOLOGY%') ) SELECT PT_MRN AS MRN, TRIM(PT_LAST_NAME)||','|| TRIM(PT_FIRST_NAME) AS "Patient Name", PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH AS "Date of Birth", PT_DATE_OF_DEATH AS "Date of Death", FIRST_DRUG_START_DATE AS "First Drug Start Date", PRPT_REPORT_DTE AS "Report Date", PRPT_REPORT_TYPE_DESC AS "Report Type Description", PRPT_ACCESSION_NO AS "Accession Number", REPORT_TXT AS "Report Text" FROM FIRSTEV JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON FIRSTEV_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN PATHOLOGY ON FIRSTEV_MRN = PRPT_MRN WHERE RNFIRST = 1 ;

prompt: Count of Patients seen at 53rd St Sarcoma Service from 2014. [No PHI]
completion: WITH APPTS AS (SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN, MIN(CPE_ENC_DTE) FIRST_NV_DTE, CLD_DEPT_NAME, CRE_RES_NAME FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND (CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR LIKE '%NV%' OR CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR LIKE '%IR%') AND YEAR(CPE_ENC_DTE) >= 2014 AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 = 'SAR' AND CLD_CLD_CENTER = '53RD' GROUP BY CPE_MRN, CLD_DEPT_NAME, CRE_RES_NAME ) , DX AS (SELECT DISTINCT TM_MRN, TM_DX_DTE, TM_HIST_CD, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS HIST_DESC, TM_SITE_CD, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_DESC FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS ON AV_ELEMENT = 'CASE_STS' JOIN APPTS ON TM_MRN = CPE_MRN AND AV_CODE = TM_CASE_STS WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') ) SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN MRN, PT_LAST_NAME "Last Name", PT_FIRST_NAME "First Name", PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH "Date of Birth", FIRST_NV_DTE "First New Visit", CLD_DEPT_NAME "Department", CRE_RES_NAME "Provider", TM_DX_DTE "Dx Date", TM_HIST_CD "Histology Code", HIST_DESC "Histology Description", TM_SITE_CD "Site Code", SITE_DESC "Site Description" FROM APPTS JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON CPE_MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN DX ON CPE_MRN = TM_MRN

prompt: Provide the number of surgical patients that has latex allergy from January 1, 2012 to this date.
completion: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT SSE_MRN) LATEX_ALGY_PTS FROM IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE ON SSE_LOG_ID = SSP_LOG_ID JOIN IDB.OMS_PT_ALLERGY ON OPA_MRN = SSE_MRN WHERE OPA_ALGY_STS = 'Active' AND SSE_SURG_DTE >='2012-01-01' AND(OPA_ALRGN_TYPE = 'Latex' OR UPPER(OPA_ALGY_TEXT) = 'LATEX')

prompt: Provide a list of patients seen and scheduled to be seen by Dr Julia Brockway-Marchello at 300 E66.
completion: WITH APPTS AS (SELECT CPE_MRN, CPE_ENC_DTE, CPE_APPT_DT, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8, CLD_DEPT_NAME, CRE_RES_NAME, CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CPE_MRN ORDER BY (CPE_ENC_DTE) DESC) AS LAST_RN, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CPE_MRN ORDER BY (CPE_ENC_DTE) ASC) AS FIRST_RN FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CLD_DEPT_NAME = 'BRE MED 300 E66' AND CRE_RES_ID = '025338' GROUP BY CPE_MRN, CPE_ENC_DTE, CPE_APPT_DT, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8, CLD_DEPT_NAME, CRE_RES_NAME, CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME) , FIRST_APPT AS (SELECT CPE_MRN FIRSTAPPT_MRN, CPE_ENC_DTE FIRSTAPPT_DTE, CPE_APPT_DT FIRSTAPPT_DT, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 FIRSTAPPT_DEPT, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 FIRSTAPPT_SVC, CLD_DEPT_NAME FIRSTAPPT_DEPTNAME, CRE_RES_NAME FIRSTAPPT_PROVIDER, CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME FIRSTAPPT_VISITTYPE, LAST_RN, FIRST_RN FROM APPTS WHERE LAST_RN = 1 OR FIRST_RN = 1 ) , PRE_APPT AS (SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN PREAPPT_MRN, CPE_ENC_DTE PREAPPT_DTE, CPE_APPT_DT PREAPPT_DT, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 PREAPPT_DEPT, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 PREAPPT_SVC, CLD_DEPT_NAME PREAPPT_DEPTNAME, CRE_RES_NAME PREAPPT_PROVIDER, CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME PREAPPT_VISITTYPE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CPE_MRN ORDER BY (CPE_ENC_DTE) DESC) AS PREAPPT_RN FROM FIRST_APPT JOIN IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER ON FIRSTAPPT_MRN = CPE_MRN AND FIRST_RN = 1 AND CPE_APPT_DT < FIRSTAPPT_DT JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE 1=1 AND CRE_RES_TYP IN ('Physician') AND CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CLD_DEPT_NAME = 'BRE MED 300 E66' ) , SCH_APPTS AS (SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN SCH_MRN, CPE_ENC_DTE SCH_DTE, CPE_APPT_DT SCH_DT, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 SCH_DEPT, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 SCH_SVC, CLD_DEPT_NAME SCH_DEPTNAME, CRE_RES_NAME SCH_PROVIDER, CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME SCH_VISITTYPE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CPE_MRN ORDER BY (CPE_ENC_DTE) ASC) AS SCH_RN FROM FIRST_APPT JOIN IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER ON FIRSTAPPT_MRN = CPE_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE 1=1 AND CRE_RES_TYP IN ('Physician') AND CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Sch') AND CLD_DEPT_NAME = 'BRE MED 300 E66' ) SELECT DISTINCT FIRSTAPPT_MRN "MRN", PT_LAST_NAME "Last Name", PT_FIRST_NAME "First Name", PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH "DOB", PT_DATE_OF_DEATH "DOD", PT_ADDR1 "Address 1", PT_ADDR2 "Address 2", PT_CITY "City", PT_STATE "State", PT_ZIP_CD "Zip Code", PT_COUNTRY "Country", PT_PHONE "Phone", LAD_DONOT_CON_IND "Do Not Contact Ind", FIRSTAPPT_DT "Last Appt Date", FIRSTAPPT_PROVIDER "Last Appt Provider", FIRSTAPPT_VISITTYPE "Last Appt Type", PREAPPT_DT "Last Appt Pre-Dr. B", PREAPPT_PROVIDER "Last Provider pre-Dr. B", PREAPPT_VISITTYPE "Last Appt Type pre-Dr. B", SCH_DT "Sch Appt Date", SCH_PROVIDER "Sch Appt Provider", SCH_VISITTYPE "Sch Appt Type" FROM FIRST_APPT LEFT JOIN PRE_APPT ON FIRSTAPPT_MRN = PREAPPT_MRN AND PREAPPT_RN = 1 LEFT JOIN SCH_APPTS ON FIRSTAPPT_MRN = SCH_MRN AND SCH_RN = 1 LEFT JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON FIRSTAPPT_MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTV_DTL ON FIRSTAPPT_MRN = LAD_MRN WHERE LAST_RN = 1 ; WITH APPTS AS (SELECT CPE_MRN, CPE_ENC_DTE, CPE_APPT_DT, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8, CLD_DEPT_NAME, CRE_RES_NAME, CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CPE_MRN ORDER BY (CPE_ENC_DTE) ASC) AS FIRST_RN FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN EXCLUDE_MRN FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CRE_RES_ID = '025338' ) A ON CPE_MRN = EXCLUDE_MRN WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Sch') AND CLD_DEPT_NAME = 'BRE MED 300 E66' AND CRE_RES_ID = '025338' AND EXCLUDE_MRN IS NULL GROUP BY CPE_MRN, CPE_ENC_DTE, CPE_APPT_DT, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8, CLD_DEPT_NAME, CRE_RES_NAME, CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME) , FIRST_APPT AS (SELECT CPE_MRN FIRSTAPPT_MRN, CPE_ENC_DTE FIRSTAPPT_DTE, CPE_APPT_DT FIRSTAPPT_DT, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 FIRSTAPPT_DEPT, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 FIRSTAPPT_SVC, CLD_DEPT_NAME FIRSTAPPT_DEPTNAME, CRE_RES_NAME FIRSTAPPT_PROVIDER, CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME FIRSTAPPT_VISITTYPE, FIRST_RN FROM APPTS WHERE FIRST_RN = 1 ) , PRE_APPT AS (SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN PREAPPT_MRN, CPE_ENC_DTE PREAPPT_DTE, CPE_APPT_DT PREAPPT_DT, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 PREAPPT_DEPT, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 PREAPPT_SVC, CLD_DEPT_NAME PREAPPT_DEPTNAME, CRE_RES_NAME PREAPPT_PROVIDER, CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME PREAPPT_VISITTYPE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CPE_MRN ORDER BY (CPE_ENC_DTE) DESC) AS PREAPPT_RN FROM FIRST_APPT JOIN IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER ON FIRSTAPPT_MRN = CPE_MRN AND FIRST_RN = 1 AND CPE_APPT_DT < FIRSTAPPT_DT JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE 1=1 AND CRE_RES_TYP IN ('Physician') AND CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CLD_DEPT_NAME = 'BRE MED 300 E66' ) SELECT DISTINCT FIRSTAPPT_MRN "MRN", PT_LAST_NAME "Last Name", PT_FIRST_NAME "First Name", PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH "DOB", PT_DATE_OF_DEATH "DOD", PT_ADDR1 "Address 1", PT_ADDR2 "Address 2", PT_CITY "City", PT_STATE "State", PT_ZIP_CD "Zip Code", PT_COUNTRY "Country", PT_PHONE "Phone", LAD_DONOT_CON_IND "Do Not Contact Ind", FIRSTAPPT_DT "Sch Appt Date", FIRSTAPPT_PROVIDER "Sch Appt Provider", FIRSTAPPT_VISITTYPE "Sch Appt Type", PREAPPT_DT "Last Appt Pre-Dr. B", PREAPPT_PROVIDER "Last Provider pre-Dr. B", PREAPPT_VISITTYPE "Last Appt Type pre-Dr. B" FROM FIRST_APPT LEFT JOIN PRE_APPT ON FIRSTAPPT_MRN = PREAPPT_MRN AND PREAPPT_RN = 1 LEFT JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON FIRSTAPPT_MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTV_DTL ON FIRSTAPPT_MRN = LAD_MRN ;

prompt: To look at pts meeting simplified criteria on the medicine side for potential survivorship targeting in the future, per Dr. Diaz.
completion: WITH APPT AS (SELECT CPE_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, CPE_ENC_CSN_ID CSNID, CPE_ENC_DTE "APPT_DATE", CLD_DEPT_NAME, CRE_RES_NAME, CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME, CLD_CLD_CENTER, CASE WHEN CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 = 'URO' THEN 'UROLOGY' WHEN CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 = 'GMO' THEN 'GYNECOLOGY' WHEN CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 = 'THR' THEN 'THORACIC' WHEN CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 = 'HNS' THEN 'HEAD & NECK' WHEN CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 = 'COL' THEN 'COLORECTAL' ELSE 'NOT_LISTED' END AS "CLD_GRP8_CATEG" , ROW_NUMBER () OVER (PARTITION BY CPE_MRN, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 ORDER BY CPE_ENC_DTE DESC) RN FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON CPE_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Sch') AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN '2022-01-01' AND '2022-06-30' AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 = 'MED' AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_1 NOT IN ('REG', 'Reg') AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 IN ('URO', 'GMO', 'THR', 'HNS', 'COL') ) , DIAG AS (SELECT A.*, TM_DX_DTE AS "DIAGNOSIS_DATE", YEAR (APPT_DATE - TM_DX_DTE) AS "YEARS_SINCE_DX", CASE WHEN TM_AJCC_7 NOT IN ('', '888', '999') THEN AJCC7.AV_DESC WHEN TM_AJCC NOT IN ('', '88', '99') THEN AJCC.AV_DESC WHEN TM_GENERAL_STG NOT IN ('', '9') THEN GS.AV_DESC WHEN TM_PATH_STG_GRP NOT IN ('', '88', '9', '99') THEN TM_PATH_STG_GRP ELSE CLIN.AV_DESC END AS STAGE, CASE WHEN CATEGORY2 IN ('Lung and Bronchus', 'Esophagus') THEN 'THORACIC' WHEN CATEGORY1 = 'Urinary System' THEN 'UROLOGY' WHEN CATEGORY2 IN ('Prostate', 'Testis') THEN 'UROLOGY' WHEN CATEGORY1 = 'Female Genital System' THEN 'GYNECOLOGY' WHEN CATEGORY2 IN ('Colon and Rectum', 'Anus, Anal Canal and Anorectum') THEN 'COLORECTAL' WHEN CATEGORY1 = 'Oral Cavity and Pharynx' THEN 'HEAD & NECK' WHEN CATEGORY2 = 'Larynx' THEN 'HEAD & NECK' ELSE 'NOT__LISTED' END AS "DISEASE_GROUP", ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY A.CPE_MRN, A.CLD_GRP8_CATEG ORDER BY TM_DX_DTE ASC) DG FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR T JOIN APPT A ON TM_MRN = A.CPE_MRN AND RN = 1 JOIN IDB.SEERGROUPING SG ON IDB.SEERF_ICDO(TM_SITE_CD, TM_HIST_CD) = RECODE AND SG.CATEGORY1 IN ('Urinary System', 'Digestive System', 'Female Genital System', 'Male Genital System', 'Respiratory System', 'Oral Cavity and Pharynx') AND CATEGORY2 NOT IN ('Nose, Nasal Cavity and Middle Ear', 'Pleura', 'Trachea, Mediastinum and Other Respiratory Organs') JOIN IDB.CLM H ON TM_HIST_CD = H.CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON TM_SITE_CD = S.CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.CL_PAS_PATIENT ON TM_MRN = CPP_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS CS ON CS.AV_ELEMENT = 'CASE_STS' AND CS.AV_CODE = TM_CASE_STS LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS AJCC7 ON AJCC7.AV_ELEMENT = 'AJCC_7' AND AJCC7.AV_CODE = TM_AJCC_7 LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS AJCC ON AJCC.AV_ELEMENT = 'AJCC' AND AJCC.AV_CODE = TM_AJCC LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS GS ON GS.AV_ELEMENT = 'GENERAL_STG' AND GS.AV_CODE = TM_GENERAL_STG LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS CLIN ON CLIN.AV_ELEMENT = 'CLIN_STG_DSCR' AND CLIN.AV_CODE = TM_CLIN_STG_DSCR WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3') ) SELECT CPE_MRN AS "MRN", PT_LAST_NAME AS "LAST_NAME", PT_FIRST_NAME AS "FIRST_NAME", APPT_DATE AS "LATEST_APPOINTMENT_DATE", CLD_DEPT_NAME AS "DEPARTMENT", CRE_RES_NAME AS "PROVIDER", CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME AS "VISIT_TYPE", CLD_CLD_CENTER AS "LOCATION", YEARS_SINCE_DX AS "YEARS_SINCE_DIAGNOSIS", DISEASE_GROUP, STAGE FROM DIAG D WHERE 1=1 AND YEARS_SINCE_DX >=5 AND DG = 1 AND CLD_GRP8_CATEG = DISEASE_GROUP AND ((DISEASE_GROUP = 'THORACIC' AND (STAGE like '1%' OR STAGE like '2%' OR STAGE like 'I%') AND STAGE NOT like 'III%' AND STAGE NOT like 'IV%' AND STAGE <> 'IN SITU') OR (DISEASE_GROUP IN ('UROLOGY', 'GYNECOLOGY', 'COLORECTAL', 'HEAD & NECK') AND (STAGE like '1%' OR STAGE like '2%' OR STAGE like '3%' OR STAGE like 'I%') AND STAGE NOT like 'IV%' AND STAGE <> 'IN SITU'))

prompt: Provide 3 weekly reports for Survivorship Colorectal clinic as per provided specifications.
completion: WITH PTS AS (SELECT MRN, LAST_NAME, FIRST_NAME, PHONE, STATE , SCH_APPT_DTE , MAX(CPE_APPT_DT) AS LAST_APPT_DT FROM (SELECT CPE_MRN MRN , PT_LAST_NAME LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME FIRST_NAME , PT_PHONE PHONE, PT_STATE STATE , CPE_ENC_DTE AS SCH_APPT_DTE FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON CPE_MRN = PT_MRN AND CPE_VST_RES_ID IN ('003939', '004572', '010835', '010108', '001818', '014688') AND CPE_CPE_APPT_STS = 'Sch' AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT date + 21 DAYS AND CURRENT date + 25 DAYS AND PT_DATE_OF_DEATH IS NULL) VST JOIN IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER ON MRN = CPE_MRN AND CPE_VST_RES_ID IN ('003939', '004572', '010835', '010108', '001818', '014688') AND CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CPE_ENC_DTE < SCH_APPT_DTE GROUP BY MRN, LAST_NAME, FIRST_NAME, PHONE, STATE, SCH_APPT_DTE) , PTS_MD AS (SELECT MRN, LAST_NAME, FIRST_NAME, PHONE, STATE , SCH_APPT_DTE, LAST_APPT_DT , CRE_RES_NAME AS MD_NAME , DAYS(SCH_APPT_DTE) - DAYS(LAST_APPT_DT) DAYS_DIFF FROM PTS JOIN IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER ON MRN = CPE_MRN AND CPE_APPT_DT = LAST_APPT_DT AND CPE_VST_RES_ID IN ('003939', '004572', '010835', '010108', '001818', '014688') AND CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID) , SURG AS (SELECT PBD_MRN, LAST_SURG_DTE, PBC_CPT_CD AS CPT_CD, PBC_PBD_DESC AS SURG_DESC FROM (SELECT PBD_MRN MRN , MAX(PBD_SVC_DTE) AS LAST_SURG_DTE FROM PTS_MD JOIN IDB.PBD_DTL ON MRN = PBD_MRN JOIN IDB.PBD_INVOICE ON PBD_MRN = PBI_MRN AND PBD_ACCT_NO = PBI_ACCT_NO AND PBD_INV_NO = PBI_INV_NO JOIN IDB.PBD_CODE ON PBD_PBD_CD = PBC_PBD_CD WHERE PBI_PERFORM_DR_NO IN ('003939', '004572', '010835', '010108', '001818', '014688') AND PBC_CPT_CD IN ('45110', '45111', '45112', '45113', '45114', '45116', '45119', '45121', '45123', '45397') GROUP BY PBD_MRN) AS SRG JOIN IDB.PBD_DTL ON MRN = PBD_MRN AND PBD_SVC_DTE = LAST_SURG_DTE JOIN IDB.PBD_INVOICE ON PBD_MRN = PBI_MRN AND PBD_ACCT_NO = PBI_ACCT_NO AND PBD_INV_NO = PBI_INV_NO JOIN IDB.PBD_CODE ON PBD_PBD_CD = PBC_PBD_CD WHERE PBI_PERFORM_DR_NO IN ('003939', '004572', '010835', '010108', '001818', '014688') AND PBC_CPT_CD IN ('45110', '45111', '45112', '45113', '45114', '45116', '45119', '45121', '45123', '45397') ) , CHEMO AS (SELECT PLA_MRN , PLA_LST_RT_DTE LAST_RT, PLA_LST_CHEMO_DTE LAST_CHEMO , YEAR(SCH_APPT_DTE) - YEAR(PLA_LST_RT_DTE) RT_YR_DIFF , YEAR(SCH_APPT_DTE) - YEAR(PLA_LST_CHEMO_DTE) CH_YR_DIFF FROM PTS_MD X JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY ON MRN = PLA_MRN AND ((PLA_LST_CHEMO_DTE <= DATE(LAST_APPT_DT) - 1 YEAR AND PLA_LST_RT_DTE IS NULL) OR (PLA_LST_RT_DTE <= DATE(LAST_APPT_DT) - 1 YEAR AND PLA_LST_CHEMO_DTE IS NULL) OR (PLA_LST_CHEMO_DTE <= DATE(LAST_APPT_DT) - 1 YEAR AND PLA_LST_RT_DTE <= DATE(LAST_APPT_DT) - 1 YEAR))) SELECT X.MRN, X.LAST_NAME, X.FIRST_NAME, X.PHONE, X.STATE , X.SCH_APPT_DTE, X.LAST_APPT_DT , X.MD_NAME , X.DAYS_DIFF , LAST_SURG_DTE, CPT_CD, SURG_DESC , LAST_RT, RT_YR_DIFF, LAST_CHEMO, CH_YR_DIFF , YEAR(X.LAST_APPT_DT) - YEAR(LAST_SURG_DTE) SRG_YR_DIFF , TM_DX_DTE, TM_SITE_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_DESC , CASE WHEN TM_AJCC <> ' ' THEN AV_DESC ELSE CASE WHEN TM_AJCC <> ' ' THEN TM_AJCC ELSE CASE WHEN TM_PATH_STG_DSCR = '4' THEN TM_CLIN_STG_GRP ELSE CASE WHEN TM_PATH_STG_GRP = '99' THEN TM_CLIN_STG_GRP ELSE TM_PATH_STG_GRP END END END END AS STAGE_DESC FROM PTS_MD X LEFT JOIN SURG ON MRN = PBD_MRN LEFT JOIN CHEMO ON MRN = PLA_MRN JOIN IDB.TM_TUMOR ON PBD_MRN = TM_MRN AND (TM_SITE_CD IN('C199', 'C209', 'C210', 'C211', 'C218')) JOIN IDB.CLM ON TM_SITE_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS ON AV_CODE = TM_AJCC AND AV_ELEMENT = 'AJCC'

prompt: Count of patients that have visited an oncologist in specific services in the last year. Estimate for R01 grant recruitment.
completion: SELECT DISTINCT DENSE_RANK() OVER ( ORDER BY CPE_CL_PT_ID) AS PATIENT_NO, CASE WHEN PT_DATE_OF_DEATH IS NOT NULL THEN YEAR(DATE(PT_DATE_OF_DEATH)-PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) ELSE YEAR(DATE(CURRENT DATE)-PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) END AS AGE, CASE WHEN PT_DATE_OF_DEATH IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE NULL END AS DECEASED, PT_SEX AS GENDER, "Ethnicity (Reg)" AS "ETHNICITY", "Race (Reg)" AS "RACE", PT_PRIMARY_LANG AS "LANGUAGE", S.CAV_TITLE AS "SERVICE", CRE_RES_NAME AS "RESOURCE" FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN (SELECT PT_MRN , PT_LAST_NAME , PT_FIRST_NAME , PT_SEX , PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH , PT_DATE_OF_DEATH , R.AV_DESC AS "Race (Reg)" , E.AV_DESC AS "Ethnicity (Reg)" , PT_PRIMARY_LANG FROM IDB.PATIENT LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS R ON R.AV_ELEMENT = 'RACE' AND R.AV_CODE = PT_RACE LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS E ON E.AV_ELEMENT = 'PT_ETHNICITY' AND E.AV_CODE = PT_PT_ETHNICITY) ON CPE_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_CATEGORY S ON S.CAV_CATEGORY = 'CLD_RPT_GRP_8' AND S.CAV_ABBR = CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CRE_RES_TYP IN ('Physician') AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN '2020-04-01' AND '2020-04-30' AND YEAR(DATE(CURRENT DATE)-PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) >= 21 AND S.CAV_TITLE IN ('GASTROENTEROLOGY', 'GENITOURINARY', 'GYNECOLOGY', 'LYMPHOMA', 'PULMONARY', 'LEUKEMIA', 'LEUKEMIA LYMPHOMA') ;

prompt: Provide a de-identified report of all patients who had tumors resected at MSK from 1/1/2017 through 12/31/2017.
completion: WITH X AS (SELECT DISTINCT "t1"."PT_MRN" AS "MRN", YEAR("t1"."PT_BIRTH_DTE") AS "Year of Birth" FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V" "t1" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED" "t6" ON "t1"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t6"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V" "t5" ON "t6"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t5"."PRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATH_RPRT_TYPE_LOOKUP" "t2" ON "t5"."PRPT_REPORT_TYPE" = "t2"."PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_CD" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" "t3" ON "t5"."PRPT_PROCEDURE_DATE_ID" = "t3"."DT_DATE_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" "t4" ON "t5"."PRPT_REPORT_DATE_ID" = "t4"."DT_DATE_ID" WHERE ((CONTAINS("t5"."PRPT_REPORT", '("negative surgical margins" | "surgical margins negative" | "R0" | "resected")') = 1 AND ("t2"."PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_DESC" IN ('Surgical Pathology', 'Surgical Pathology Breast', 'Surgical Pathology Consult', 'Surgical Pathology Molecular Genetics') AND "t3"."DT_YEAR" = 2017)) AND "t5"."PRPT_REPORT" IS NOT NULL) ) , CDB AS (SELECT DISTINCT TM_MRN, TM_DX_DTE, TM_HIST_CD AS HIST_CODE, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS HIST_DESC, TM_SITE_CD AS SITE_CODE, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_DESC, CASE WHEN TM_AJCC_7 NOT IN ('', '888', '999') THEN AJCC7.AV_DESC WHEN TM_AJCC NOT IN ('', '88', '99') THEN AJCC.AV_DESC WHEN TM_GENERAL_STG NOT IN ('', '9') THEN GS.AV_DESC WHEN TM_PATH_STG_GRP NOT IN ('', '88', '9', '99') THEN TM_PATH_STG_GRP ELSE CLIN.AV_DESC END AS STAGE FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM H ON TM_HIST_CD = H.CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON TM_SITE_CD = S.CLM_CLSF_CD LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS AJCC7 ON AJCC7.AV_ELEMENT = 'AJCC_7' AND AJCC7.AV_CODE = TM_AJCC_7 LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS AJCC ON AJCC.AV_ELEMENT = 'AJCC' AND AJCC.AV_CODE = TM_AJCC LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS GS ON GS.AV_ELEMENT = 'GENERAL_STG' AND GS.AV_CODE = TM_GENERAL_STG LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS CLIN ON CLIN.AV_ELEMENT = 'CLIN_STG_DSCR' AND CLIN.AV_CODE = TM_CLIN_STG_DSCR WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('3', '6', '7', '8') AND TM_MRN IN (SELECT MRN FROM X) ) , CTE AS (SELECT TM_MRN AS DX_MRN, YEAR(TM_DX_DTE) AS DX_DATE, STRIP(SITE_CODE) || '-' || STRIP(SITE_DESC) || '|' || STRIP(HIST_CODE) || '-' || STRIP(HIST_DESC) || '|' || STRIP(STAGE) AS DX_CODE FROM CDB) , CTE2 AS (SELECT * FROM CTE ORDER BY DX_MRN, DX_DATE, DX_CODE) , T1 AS (SELECT DX_MRN, DX_DATE, DX_CODE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY DX_MRN ORDER BY DX_DATE) AS RN FROM CTE2 ORDER BY DX_MRN, DX_DATE) , T2 (MRN, DX, RN1) AS (SELECT DX_MRN, CAST(DX_DATE AS VARCHAR(6000))||' | '||CAST(DX_CODE AS VARCHAR(150)), RN FROM T1 WHERE T1.RN = 1 UNION ALL SELECT DX_MRN, RTRIM(CAST(DX AS VARCHAR(4000))) || ', ' || CHR(13) || CHR(10) || CAST(DX_DATE AS VARCHAR(150))||' | '||RTRIM(CAST(DX_CODE AS VARCHAR(100))) , RN1 + 1 FROM T1, T2 WHERE DX_MRN = MRN AND RN = RN1+1 ) , T3 AS (SELECT MRN, MAX(RN1) RN FROM T2 GROUP BY MRN) , T4 AS (SELECT T2.MRN, RN, DX FROM T2 JOIN T3 ON T2.MRN = T3.MRN AND T2.RN1 = T3.RN) SELECT X.*, DX FROM X LEFT JOIN T4 ON X.MRN = T4.MRN

prompt: Provide the inpatient consults and follow-ups for Pediatric Surgery, PACT, and GI services
completion: SELECT CDD_MRN MRN, PT_LAST_NAME LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME FIRST_NAME, CDD_SERVICE_DTE SERVICE_DATE, CDD_DOC_NAME DOC_NAME, U1.OU_DISPLAY_NAME AS "Author", U1.OU_ORD_ROLE_TYPE AS "Author Role", U2.OU_DISPLAY_NAME AS "Signer", U2.OU_ORD_ROLE_TYPE AS "Signer Role", MAX(CASE WHEN CDO_ITEM_NAME = 'Service' THEN CDO_VALUE_TEXT END) "Service", MAX(CASE WHEN CDO_ITEM_NAME = 'Referring Service:' THEN CDO_VALUE_TEXT END) "Referring Service" FROM IDB.CD_DOCUMENT JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON CDD_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.VISIT_V ON CDD_MRN = VIS_MRN AND CDD_SERVICE_DTE BETWEEN VIS_ADM_DTE AND COALESCE(VIS_DSCH_DTE, CURRENT date) LEFT JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION ON CDD_MRN = CDO_MRN AND CDD_DOC_GUID = CDO_DOC_GUID AND CDD_AUTHORED_DTE = CDO_AUTHORED_DTE AND CDO_ITEM_NAME IN ('Referring Service:', 'Service') JOIN IDB.OMS_USER U1 ON CDD_AUTH_PROV_GUID = U1.OU_USER_GUID LEFT JOIN IDB.CD_DOCUMENT_HISTORY ON CDD_DOC_GUID = CDH_CLIENT_DOC_GUID AND CDD_CLIENT_GUID = CDH_CLIENT_GUID LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_USER U2 ON CDH_USER_GUID = U2.OU_USER_GUID WHERE 1=1 AND CDD_CANCEL_IND <> '1' AND CDD_SERVICE_DTE BETWEEN '2022-01-01' AND CURRENT date AND ((CDD_DOC_NAME IN ('Progress Note - Pediatric Surgery/Oncology', 'Progress Note - Pediatric Surgery', 'Procedure Note - PED PACT', 'Pre-Procedure Note - PED PACT', 'Post-Procedure Note - PED PACT', 'Initial Consultation - PED-PACT (Pain & Palliative Care)', 'Initial Consultation - Pediatric Surgery', 'Initial Consultation - PACC-PACT (Pain & Palliative Care)', 'Informed Con for MSK Impact Test', 'Follow Up Consultation - PED-PACT (Pain & Palliative Care)', 'Follow Up Consultation -
