Pediatric Surgery', 'Follow Up Consultation - PACC-PACT (Pain & Palliative Care)', 'Epidural Note - PED PACT', 'Discharge Note/Summary - Pediatric Surgery/Oncology', 'Discharge Note/Summary - Pediatric Surgery', 'Day of Discharge Note, NP - Pediatric Surgery/Oncology', 'Admission Note - Pediatric Surgery/Oncology', 'Admission Note - Pediatric Surgery', 'Miscellaneous Note - Pediatrics-pediatric surgery', 'Miscellaneous Note - Pediatrics-Pediatric surgery', 'Miscellaneous Note - Pediatrics-Pediatric Surgery', 'Miscellaneous Note - Pediatrics-peds surgery', 'Miscellaneous Note - Pediatrics-Peds Surgery', 'Miscellaneous Note - Pediatrics-surgery', 'Miscellaneous Note - Pediatrics-Surgery')) OR (CDD_DOC_NAME IN ('Initial Consultation - PACC-Gastroenterology', 'Follow Up Consultation - PACC-Gastroenterology') AND U1.OU_DISPLAY_NAME ='Queliza, Karen')) GROUP BY CDD_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, CDD_SERVICE_DTE, CDD_DOC_NAME, U1.OU_DISPLAY_NAME, U1.OU_ORD_ROLE_TYPE, U2.OU_DISPLAY_NAME, U2.OU_ORD_ROLE_TYPE

prompt: We would like to add Dr. Dmitriy Zamarin to this Dataline as well.
completion: WITH BASE AS (SELECT MRN , PT_LAST_NAME , PT_FIRST_NAME , DOB , AGE_AT_ENCOUNTER , CRE_RES_NAME , CPE_ENC_DTE , CPE_APPT_DT , CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME , LISTAGG(TRIM(CPAN_NOTE), '; ') WITHIN GROUP( ORDER BY CPAN_LINE_NO ASC) VISIT_NOTE FROM (SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN MRN , PT_LAST_NAME , PT_FIRST_NAME , PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH DOB , YEAR(CPE_ENC_DTE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) AS AGE_AT_ENCOUNTER , CRE_RES_NAME , CPE_ENC_DTE , CPE_APPT_DT , CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME , CPAN_NOTE , CPAN_LINE_NO FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON CPE_MRN = PT_MRN AND PT_PRIMARY_LANG = 'ENG' JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID AND CRE_RES_ID IN ('016261', '021550', '017202', '012625', '019224', '020446') JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_PT_APPT_NOTES ON CPE_PRK = CPAN_PRK AND CPE_ENC_DTE = CPAN_ENC_DTE WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS = 'Sch' AND CPE_ENC_DTE <= CURRENT date + 28 DAY AND YEAR(CPE_ENC_DTE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) >= 18 ) A GROUP BY MRN , PT_LAST_NAME , PT_FIRST_NAME , DOB , AGE_AT_ENCOUNTER , CRE_RES_NAME , CPE_ENC_DTE , CPE_APPT_DT , CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME) , CANCER AS (SELECT CC_MRN DX_MRN , MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS MIN_ICD_EFF_DTE , CATEGORY1 , CATEGORY2 , CATEGORY3 , CATEGORY4 FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN BASE ON CC_MRN = MRN JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.SEERGROUPING ON CLM_CLSF_RECODE = RECODE WHERE (SUBSTR(CC_CLSF_CD, 1, 3) BETWEEN 'C00' AND 'C76' OR SUBSTR(CC_CLSF_CD, 1, 3) BETWEEN 'C80' AND 'C96') AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND (CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) AND CATEGORY1 IN ('Myeloma', 'Leukemia', 'Lymphoma', 'Digestive System', 'Male Genital System', 'Urinary System', 'Female Genital System', 'Lung and Bronchus') GROUP BY CC_MRN , CATEGORY1 , CATEGORY2 , CATEGORY3 , CATEGORY4 ) , METS AS (SELECT CC_MRN , MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS METS_ICD_EFF_DTE FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN CANCER ON CC_MRN = DX_MRN AND CATEGORY1 IN ('Digestive System', 'Male Genital System', 'Urinary System', 'Female Genital System', 'Lung and Bronchus') JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE SUBSTR(CC_CLSF_CD, 1, 3) BETWEEN 'C77' AND 'C79' AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND (CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) GROUP BY CC_MRN ) SELECT DISTINCT MRN , PT_LAST_NAME , PT_FIRST_NAME , DOB , AGE_AT_ENCOUNTER , CRE_RES_NAME PROVIDER , CPE_ENC_DTE ENCOUNTER_DATE , CPE_APPT_DT SCHEDULED_APPT_DT , CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME VISIT_TYPE , VISIT_NOTE FROM BASE JOIN CANCER ON MRN = DX_MRN LEFT JOIN METS ON MRN = CC_MRN WHERE CATEGORY1 IN ('Myeloma', 'Leukemia', 'Lymphoma') OR (CATEGORY1 IN ('Digestive System', 'Male Genital System', 'Urinary System', 'Female Genital System', 'Lung and Bronchus') AND CC_MRN IS NOT NULL) ;

prompt: Pediatric admissions occurring in 2018 and Q1 2019 for patients enrolled on an IRB protocol.
completion: SELECT PRO_IRB_NO "IRB", PRO_INDUST_CNTR "Industry Sponsored", ACD_MRN "MRN", ACD_REG_DTE "Registration Date", ACD_TX_ST_DTE "Tx Start Date", ACD_TX_END_DTE "Tx End Date", ACD_OFF_STUDY_DTE "Off Study Date", VIS_ADM_DTE "Admission Date", CASE WHEN DAYOFWEEK(VIS_ADM_DTE) = 1 THEN 'Sunday' WHEN DAYOFWEEK(VIS_ADM_DTE) = 2 THEN 'Monday' WHEN DAYOFWEEK(VIS_ADM_DTE) = 3 THEN 'Tuesday' WHEN DAYOFWEEK(VIS_ADM_DTE) = 4 THEN 'Wednesday' WHEN DAYOFWEEK(VIS_ADM_DTE) = 5 THEN 'Thursday' WHEN DAYOFWEEK(VIS_ADM_DTE) = 6 THEN 'Friday' WHEN DAYOFWEEK(VIS_ADM_DTE) = 7 THEN 'Saturday' END "Admission Day Of Week", TREATMENT_PLAN_DESC "Treatment Plan", ADM_SOURCE_DESC "Admission Source" FROM IDB.PROTOCOL JOIN IDB.ACCRUALS ON PRO_IRB_NO = AC_IRB_NO JOIN IDB.ACCRUALS_DATES ON AC_IRB_NO = ACD_IRB_NO AND AC_SUBJ_ID_NO = ACD_SUBJ_ID_NO AND AC_SUBJ_SEQ_NO = ACD_SUBJ_SEQ_NO JOIN IDB.VISIT_V ON VIS_MRN = AC_MRN AND VIS_ADM_DTE BETWEEN '2018-01-01' AND '2019-03-31' AND VIS_IP_OP_ADJUSTED_IND = 'I' AND VIS_VISIT_STATUS IN ('2', '3') WHERE PRO_SPON_DPT_NAME like 'Pediatrics%' AND PRO_PROTOCOL_TYPE IN ('Therapeutic', 'Therapeutic/QOL') AND VIS_ADM_DTE BETWEEN ACD_REG_DTE AND COALESCE(ACD_OFF_STUDY_DTE, PRO_CLOSE_PROT_DTE, CURRENT date) ORDER BY 1, 2

prompt: Provide count of notes completed by team for AYA patients (15-39 years old and 'aged out' year of 40 yo)
completion: WITH PTS AS (SELECT DISTINCT CDD_MRN, CDD_DOC_GUID , CDD_DOC_NAME , OP_DISPLAY_NAME, CDD_SERVICE_DTE , PT_SEX , PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH AS DOB , COALESCE(YEAR(PT_DATE_OF_DEATH), YEAR(CURRENT DATE)) - YEAR(PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) AS CURRENT_AGE, YEAR(CDD_SERVICE_DTE)- YEAR(PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) AS NOTE_AGE, SVC.CDO_ITEM_NAME AS ITEM_NAME, SVC.CDO_VALUE_TEXT AS SERVICE FROM IDB.CD_DOCUMENT JOIN IDB.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V ON CDD_MRN = PT_MRN AND YEAR(CDD_SERVICE_DTE)- YEAR(PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) BETWEEN 15 AND 39 INNER JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION A ON A.CDO_DOC_GUID = CDD_DOC_GUID LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_USER ON A.CDO_USER_GUID = OU_USER_GUID LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_PROVIDER ON OP_USER_GUID = OU_USER_GUID LEFT JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION SVC ON SVC.CDO_DOC_GUID = A.CDO_DOC_GUID AND UPPER(SVC.CDO_ITEM_NAME) = 'SERVICE' WHERE 1=1 AND CDD_CANCEL_IND = '0' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND = '0' AND ((OP_DISPLAY_NAME = 'Sarro, Emily' AND CDD_SERVICE_DTE BETWEEN '2023-01-01' AND '2023-12-15' AND CDD_DOC_NAME IN ('Evaluation Consultation, Adolescent and Young Adult', 'Evaluation Consultation, Adolescent and Young Adult-InPerson', 'Evaluation Consultation, Adolescent and Young Adult-Phone', 'Evaluation Consultation, Adolescent and Young Adult-Telemed', 'Follow Up - DOM-Sarcoma', 'Follow Up - PACC Sarcoma', 'Follow Up - PACC Sarcoma-Urgent', 'Follow Up Consultation, Adolescent and Young Adult', 'Follow Up Consultation, Adolescent and Young Adult v2-Follow', 'Initial Consultation, Adolescent and Young Adult', 'Miscellaneous Note - Pediatrics', 'Miscellaneous Note - Pediatrics-AYA', 'Miscellaneous/Discussion Note, Amb-DOM', 'Miscellaneous/Discussion Note, Amb-DOM Lymphoma', 'Miscellaneous/Discussion Note, Amb-DOM Sarcoma', 'Miscellaneous/Discussion Note, Amb-DOM Sarcoma - AYA', 'Miscellaneous/Discussion Note, Amb-MSK Koch', 'Miscellaneous/Discussion Note, Amb-Outpatient', 'Telephone/Electronic Communication, MD, PhD, APP')) OR (OP_DISPLAY_NAME = 'Hightower, Heather' AND CDD_SERVICE_DTE BETWEEN '2023-01-01' AND '2023-12-15' AND CDD_DOC_NAME IN ('Nursing Event Note - Inpatient-Psychosocial', 'Nursing Event Note - Outpatient-Other', 'Nursing Event Note - Outpatient-Psychosocial', 'Telephone/Electronic Communication, Nursing-Care Coordinate', 'Telephone/Electronic Communication, Nursing-Symptom Mgt', 'Telephone/Electronic Communication, Nursing-Treatment Care')) OR (OP_DISPLAY_NAME = 'Russo, Alexandra' AND CDD_SERVICE_DTE BETWEEN '2023-01-01' AND '2023-12-15' AND CDD_DOC_NAME = 'Psychosocial - Social Work' AND A.CDO_ITEM_NAME = 'Others:' AND LOWER(A.CDO_VALUE_TEXT) like 'adolescent and young adult%')) ) , PRIM_MD AS (SELECT CPE_MRN, PRIMARY_MD, PRIMARY_DEPT, PRIMARY_SERVICE, APPT_COUNT, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CPE_MRN ORDER BY APPT_COUNT DESC) RN FROM (SELECT CPE_MRN, CRE_RES_NAME PRIMARY_MD, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 PRIMARY_DEPT, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 PRIMARY_SERVICE, COUNT(CPE_ENC_CSN_ID) APPT_COUNT FROM (SELECT DISTINCT CDD_MRN FROM PTS) JOIN IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER ON CDD_MRN = CPE_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CRE_RES_TYP IN ('Physician') AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 IN ('MED', 'PED') GROUP BY CPE_MRN, CRE_RES_NAME, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 )) SELECT PTS.*, PRIMARY_DEPT, PRIMARY_SERVICE FROM PTS LEFT JOIN PRIM_MD ON CDD_MRN = CPE_MRN AND RN = 1 ORDER BY OP_DISPLAY_NAME, CDD_SERVICE_DTE, CDD_MRN

prompt: Provide a list of all patients with a diagnosis of lung neuroendocrine tumors (NET)who were treated with temozolomide at MSKCC from January 1, 2008- December 31, 2020
completion: WITH DIAG AS (SELECT CC_MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS MIN_ICD9_EFF_DTE, CC_CLSF_CD AS ICD9_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS ICD9_DESC FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE CC_CLSF_CD IN ('209.21', 'C7A.090') AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND (CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) GROUP BY CC_MRN, CC_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK HAVING MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) BETWEEN '2008-01-01' AND '2020-12-31') , ANP AS (SELECT DISTINCT APR_MRN , APR_START_DTE FROM IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX JOIN DIAG ON APR_MRN = CC_MRN JOIN IDB.CHEMO_DRUG_GENERIC ON APR_GENERIC_NAME = CDG_GENERIC_NAME WHERE APR_START_DTE BETWEEN '2008-01-01' AND CURRENT date AND CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME = 'TEMOZOLOMIDE' ) SELECT CC_MRN AS MRN, PT_LAST_NAME AS "Last Name", PT_FIRST_NAME AS "First Name", PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH AS "Date of Birth", PT_DATE_OF_DEATH AS "Date of Death", PLA_LST_APPT_DTE AS "Last OP Appt Date at MSK", D.AV_DESC AS "Survival Status", APR_START_DTE AS "TEMOZOLOMIDE - Adm. Date" FROM DIAG LEFT JOIN ANP ON APR_MRN = CC_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY ON PLA_MRN = APR_MRN JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PT_MRN = APR_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS D ON D.AV_ELEMENT = 'DEATH_IND' AND PT_DEATH_IND = D.AV_CODE

prompt: Identify patients with metastatic colorectal cancer who have been treated with anti-EGFR therapy (Cetuximab or Panitumumab).
completion: SELECT DISTINCT "t1"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AS "Deident PT #", "t2"."PT_MRN" AS "MRN", "t2"."PT_LAST_NAME" AS "Last Name", "t2"."PT_FIRST_NAME" AS "First Name", "t3"."DXCC_ICD_CODE" AS "ICD-O Histology Code", "t3"."DXCC_ICD_MSK_DESC" AS "ICD-O Histology Desc", "t4"."ICSC_SITE_CD" AS "ICD-O Site Code", "t4"."ICSC_ICDO_SITE_MSK_DESC" AS "ICD-O Site Desc", "t5"."DT_DTE" AS "CDB Tumor Diagnosis Date", "t6"."PINC_GENERIC_NAME" AS "Generic Drug Name", "t7"."DT_DTE" AS "First Order Start Date" FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED" "t1" INNER JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS" "t2" ON "t1"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t2"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."CDB_TUMOR" "t8" ON "t1"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t8"."CDTM_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DIAGNOSIS_CODE_CAT_ICDO_V" "t3" ON "t8"."CDTM_DX_CATALOG_ID" = "t3"."DXCC_DX_CATALOG_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."ICDO_SITE_CATALOG_V" "t4" ON "t8"."CDTM_SITE_CATALOG_ID" = "t4"."ICSC_SITE_CATALOG_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE" "t5" ON "t8"."CDTM_DX_DATE_ID" = "t5"."DT_DATE_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PHM_PT_MEDS_MQT" "t9" ON "t1"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t9"."POD_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PHM_INVENTORY_CATALOG" "t6" ON "t9"."POD_PHARMA_INVENTORY_CTLG_ID" = "t6"."PINC_INVENTORY_CTLG_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE" "t7" ON "t9"."FIST_START_DATE_ID" = "t7"."DT_DATE_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PHM_ORDER_DTL" "t10" ON "t9"."POD_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t10"."POD_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AND "t9"."POD_PHARMA_INVENTORY_CTLG_ID" = "t10"."POD_PHARMA_INVENTORY_CTLG_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE" "t11" ON "t10"."POD_START_DATE_ID" = "t11"."DT_DATE_ID" WHERE ("t6"."PINC_GENERIC_NAME" IN ('CETUXimab', 'PANITUMumab') AND ("t4"."ICSC_SITE_CD" IN ('C182', 'C183', 'C184', 'C185', 'C186', 'C187', 'C188', 'C189', 'C199', 'C209', 'C218', 'C180', 'C181') AND (DV.TBS_AVAIL("t1"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID") IN ('YES') AND "t11"."DT_DTE" BETWEEN '1999-1-1' AND '2009-1-31')))

prompt: Investigate current inpatient workflow for ordering Aerobika valve device.
completion: WITH NOTE_DEVICE AS (SELECT DISTINCT CDD_MRN DEV_MRN, CDD_SERVICE_DTE DEV_SERVICE_DTE, CDD_SERVICE_DT DEV_SERVICE_DT FROM IDB.CD_DOCUMENT LEFT JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION ON CDD_DOC_GUID = CDO_DOC_GUID AND CDD_AUTHORED_DTE = CDO_AUTHORED_DTE AND CDO_VALUE_TEXT <> '' JOIN IDB.OMS_PROVIDER ON CDD_AUTH_PROV_GUID = OP_PVDR_GUID WHERE CDD_CANCEL_IND <> '1' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND <> '1' AND CDD_DOC_NAME = 'Assessment/Treatment Note - Respiratory Therapy-Bronchial Hy' AND CDO_ITEM_NAME = 'Bronchial HygieneTherapy Provided' AND CDO_VALUE_TEXT = 'Oscillating Positive Expiratory Pressure (OPEP) Device' ) , NOTE_CHARGES AS (SELECT DISTINCT CDD_MRN CHR_MRN, CDD_SERVICE_DTE CHR_SERVICE_DTE, CDD_SERVICE_DT CHR_SERVICE_DT FROM IDB.CD_DOCUMENT LEFT JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION ON CDD_DOC_GUID = CDO_DOC_GUID AND CDD_AUTHORED_DTE = CDO_AUTHORED_DTE AND CDO_VALUE_TEXT <> '' JOIN IDB.OMS_PROVIDER ON CDD_AUTH_PROV_GUID = OP_PVDR_GUID WHERE CDD_CANCEL_IND <> '1' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND <> '1' AND CDD_DOC_NAME = 'Assessment/Treatment Note - Respiratory Therapy-Bronchial Hy' AND CDO_ITEM_NAME = 'Charges' AND CDO_VALUE_TEXT = 'OPEP INIT - 56000045' ) , DX AS (SELECT PBD_MRN, MAX(CASE WHEN DX_CLSF_CD LIKE 'J18%' THEN PBD_SVC_DTE ELSE NULL END) AS PNEU_DX_DTE, MAX(CASE WHEN DX_CLSF_CD LIKE 'J44%' THEN PBD_SVC_DTE ELSE NULL END) AS COPD_DX_DTE, MAX(CASE WHEN DX_CLSF_CD LIKE 'J47%' THEN PBD_SVC_DTE ELSE NULL END) AS BRONCH_DX_DTE FROM IDB.PBD_DTL JOIN IDB.PBD_DX ON PBD_MRN = DX_MRN AND PBD_INV_NO = DX_INV_NO JOIN IDB.CLM ON DX_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE (DX_CLSF_CD LIKE 'J18%' OR DX_CLSF_CD LIKE 'J44%' OR DX_CLSF_CD LIKE 'J47%' ) AND PBD_SVC_DTE >= CURRENT_DATE - 365 DAYS GROUP BY PBD_MRN ) , BILLING AS (SELECT DISTINCT RVCD_MRN, VIS_ADM_NUM BVIS_ADM_NUM, RVCD_VISIT_ID, RVCD_SVC_DTE, DEPARTMENT_NAME, CHARGE_CD, CHARGE_DESCRIPTION FROM IDB.RMS_VISIT_CHARGE_DTL_V WHERE RVCD_SVC_DTE BETWEEN '2020-09-10' AND '2021-09-10' AND CHARGE_CD = 'RESS00011' ) , CTE AS (SELECT OO_MRN, OOC_ITEM_NAME, OOC_ITEM_DESC, OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE, OO_SIGNIFICANT_DT, OSTS_STS_DESC, OO_ORD_STS_CD, 1 AS CT, CASE WHEN HOUR(OO_SIGNIFICANT_DT) BETWEEN 7 AND 18 THEN 1 ELSE NULL END AS "7AM_7PM", CASE WHEN HOUR(OO_SIGNIFICANT_DT) BETWEEN 19 AND 24 THEN 1 ELSE NULL END AS "7PM_7AM", CASE WHEN VIS_MRN IS NOT NULL THEN 'Inpatient' ELSE NULL END AS INPATIENT_FLAG, COALESCE(DEV_SERVICE_DT, CHR_SERVICE_DT) NOTE_DT, RVCD_SVC_DTE BILLING_DTE, COALESCE(CAST(COALESCE(DEV_SERVICE_DT, CHR_SERVICE_DT) AS date), RVCD_SVC_DTE) NOTE_BILLING_DATE, TIMESTAMPDIFF(4, CHAR(COALESCE(DEV_SERVICE_DT, CHR_SERVICE_DT) - OO_SIGNIFICANT_DT)) / 60.0 NOTE_HOURS_AFTER_ORDER, VIS_ADM_DT, VIS_DSCH_DT, TIMESTAMPDIFF(4, CHAR(VIS_DSCH_DT - VIS_ADM_DT)) / 60.0 HOURS_TO_DISCHARGE, PNEU_DX_DTE, COPD_DX_DTE, BRONCH_DX_DTE FROM IDB.OMS_ORDER JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_CATALOG ON OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID = OOC_MSTR_ITEM_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_STATUS ON OO_ORD_STS_CD = OSTS_ORD_STS_CD LEFT JOIN IDB.VISIT_V ON OO_MRN = VIS_MRN AND OO_SIGNIFICANT_DT BETWEEN VIS_ADM_DT AND COALESCE(VIS_DSCH_DT, CAST(CURRENT_DATE AS timestamp)) LEFT JOIN NOTE_DEVICE ON OO_MRN = DEV_MRN AND DEV_SERVICE_DTE BETWEEN VIS_ADM_DTE AND COALESCE(CAST(VIS_DSCH_DT AS date), (CURRENT_DATE)) LEFT JOIN NOTE_CHARGES ON OO_MRN = CHR_MRN AND CHR_SERVICE_DTE BETWEEN VIS_ADM_DTE AND COALESCE(CAST(VIS_DSCH_DT AS date), (CURRENT_DATE)) LEFT JOIN DX ON PBD_MRN = OO_MRN LEFT JOIN BILLING ON OO_MRN = RVCD_MRN AND VIS_ADM_NUM = BVIS_ADM_NUM WHERE OOC_ITEM_NAME = 'Flutter Valve' AND OO_ORD_STS_CD NOT IN ('CANP', 'CANC', 'AUC3') AND OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE BETWEEN '2020-09-10' AND '2021-09-10' ) SELECT DISTINCT * FROM CTE WHERE INPATIENT_FLAG = 'Inpatient' ;

prompt: Provide vital status for a provided list of patients.
Provide the identified data for two Darwin searches on patients with modafinil in primary brain tumors and methylphenidate in primary brain tumors.
completion: SELECT "t1"."PT_MRN" AS "MRN", "t1"."PT_LAST_NAME" AS "Last Name", "t1"."PT_FIRST_NAME" AS "First Name", "t1"."PT_BIRTH_DTE" AS "Date of Birth", "t1"."PT_DEATH_DTE" AS "Deceased Date", "t1"."PT_SEX_DESC" AS "Gender", "t3"."DT_DTE" AS "Tumor Diagnosis Date", "t2"."ICSC_SITE_CD" AS "ICD-O Site Code", "t2"."ICSC_ICDO_SITE_MSK_DESC" AS "ICD-O Site Description", "t5"."DXCC_ICD_CODE" AS "ICD-O Histology Code", "t5"."DXCC_ICD_MSK_DESC" AS "ICD-O Histology Description", MIN("t7"."DT_DTE") AS "First Order Start Date", MAX("t7"."DT_DTE") AS "Last Order Start Date" FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V" "t1" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED" "t8" ON "t1"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t8"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."CDB_TUMOR_V" "t9" ON "t8"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t9"."CDTM_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."ICDO_SITE_CATALOG_V" "t2" ON "t9"."CDTM_SITE_CATALOG_ID" = "t2"."ICSC_SITE_CATALOG_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" "t3" ON "t9"."CDTM_DX_DATE_ID" = "t3"."DT_DATE_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DIAGNOSIS_CODE_CAT_ICDO_V" "t5" ON "t9"."CDTM_DX_CATALOG_ID" = "t5"."DXCC_DX_CATALOG_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PHM_ORDER_DTL" "t10" ON "t8"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t10"."POD_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PHM_INVENTORY_CATALOG" "t6" ON "t10"."POD_PHARMA_INVENTORY_CTLG_ID" = "t6"."PINC_INVENTORY_CTLG_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" "t7" ON "t10"."POD_START_DATE_ID" = "t7"."DT_DATE_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" "t4" ON "t1"."PT_BIRTH_DTE" = "t4"."DT_DTE" WHERE ("t2"."ICSC_SITE_CD" IN ('C710', 'C711', 'C712', 'C713', 'C714', 'C715', 'C716', 'C717', 'C718', 'C719') AND ("t3"."DT_DTE" >= '1990-1-1' AND (YEAR("t3"."DT_DTE" - "t4"."DT_DTE") >= 18 AND UPPER("t6"."PINC_GENERIC_NAME") IN ('*METHYLPHENIDATE (C-II)', '*METHYLPHENIDATE OR PLACEBO', 'methylPHENIDATE', 'methylPHENIDATE HCl', 'methylPHENIDATE or Placebo', 'METHYLPHENIDATE (INV)', 'METHYLPHENIDATE OR PLACEBO', 'METHYLPHENIDATE VS PLACEBO', 'NF-*METHYLPHENIDATE ER')))) GROUP BY "t1"."PT_MRN", "t1"."PT_LAST_NAME", "t1"."PT_FIRST_NAME", "t1"."PT_BIRTH_DTE", "t1"."PT_DEATH_DTE", "t1"."PT_SEX_DESC", "t3"."DT_DTE", "t2"."ICSC_SITE_CD", "t2"."ICSC_ICDO_SITE_MSK_DESC", "t5"."DXCC_ICD_CODE", "t5"."DXCC_ICD_MSK_DESC"

prompt: Provide a report on NSCLC patients.
completion: WITH X AS (SELECT DISTINCT TM_MRN AS DX_MRN, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, PT_DATE_OF_DEATH, PT_SEX, R.AV_DESC AS "Race", E.AV_DESC AS "Ethnicity", TM_DX_DTE, TM_SITE_CD AS DX_CODE, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS DX_DESC, TM_HIST_CD AS HIST_CODE, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS HIST_DESC, CASE WHEN TM_AJCC_7 NOT IN ('', '888', '999') THEN AJCC7.AV_DESC WHEN TM_AJCC NOT IN ('', '88', '99') THEN AJCC.AV_DESC WHEN TM_GENERAL_STG NOT IN ('', '9') THEN GS.AV_DESC WHEN TM_PATH_STG_GRP NOT IN ('', '88', '9', '99') THEN TM_PATH_STG_GRP ELSE CLIN.AV_DESC END AS STAGE FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON TM_MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS R ON PT_RACE = R.AV_CODE AND R.AV_ELEMENT = 'RACE' LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS E ON PT_PT_ETHNICITY = E.AV_CODE AND E.AV_ELEMENT = 'PT_ETHNICITY' JOIN IDB.CLM H ON TM_HIST_CD = H.CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON TM_SITE_CD = S.CLM_CLSF_CD LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS AJCC7 ON AJCC7.AV_ELEMENT = 'AJCC_7' AND AJCC7.AV_CODE = TM_AJCC_7 LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS AJCC ON AJCC.AV_ELEMENT = 'AJCC' AND AJCC.AV_CODE = TM_AJCC LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS GS ON GS.AV_ELEMENT = 'GENERAL_STG' AND GS.AV_CODE = TM_GENERAL_STG LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS CLIN ON CLIN.AV_ELEMENT = 'CLIN_STG_DSCR' AND CLIN.AV_CODE = TM_CLIN_STG_DSCR WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('3', '6', '7', '8') AND TM_SITE_CD IN ('C340', 'C341', 'C342', 'C343', 'C348', 'C349') AND TM_HIST_CD NOT IN ('M8002/3', 'M8041/3', 'M8043/3', 'M8044/3', 'M8045/3', 'M8073/3', 'M8803/3', 'M9691/3', 'M9695/3') ) SELECT DISTINCT SSE_MRN, SSE_SURG_DTE, SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD, SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC FROM X JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT ON SSE_MRN = DX_MRN JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE ON SSE_LOG_ID = SSP_LOG_ID WHERE 1=1 AND SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD NOT LIKE '9999%' AND SSE_SURG_LOC not like '%IR%' AND SSE_SURG_LOC not like '%ENDO%' AND SSE_SOURCE_TYPE <> 'E'

prompt: Provide a daily update modelled off of "SKI15201 - Made and Canceled Appt of Patients on Various Protocols", but only for protocols 18-014 and 21-216.
completion: WITH PRO AS (SELECT DISTINCT PRO_IRB_NO FROM IDB.PROTOCOL WHERE PRO_IRB_NO IN ('18-014', '21-216') ) , PTS AS (SELECT DISTINCT A.PRO_IRB_NO AS IRB_NO, B.ACD_MRN AS MRN, B.ACD_CONS_DTE AS CONSENT_DTE FROM PRO A JOIN IDB.ACCRUALS_DATES B ON B.ACD_IRB_NO = A.PRO_IRB_NO AND B.ACD_TX_ST_DTE IS NOT NULL AND B.ACD_TX_END_DTE IS NULL) SELECT DISTINCT MRN , CL_LAST_NAME AS LAST_NAME, CL_FIRST_NAME AS FIRST_NAME , IRB_NO, CPE_ENC_DTE AS APPT_DTE, TIME(CPE_APPT_DT) AS APPT_TIME , CLD_DEPT_NAME AS DEPT, CRE_RES_NAME AS RESOURCE, CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR AS VT_ABBR , CPE_CPE_APPT_STS AS STATUS, CPE_APPT_MADE_DTE AS MADE_DATE, CPE_CANCEL_DTE AS CANCEL_DATE FROM PTS JOIN IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER ON MRN = CPE_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID JOIN IDB.CL_PATIENT ON CPE_MRN = CL_MRN WHERE CONSENT_DTE <= CPE_ENC_DTE AND(CPE_APPT_MADE_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT date - 3 DAY AND CURRENT date - 1 DAY OR CPE_CANCEL_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT date - 3 DAY AND CURRENT date - 1 DAY) ORDER BY IRB_NO, MRN, CPE_CPE_APPT_STS, CPE_ENC_DTE, CRE_RES_NAME

prompt: Provide an updated list of patients with parotidectomy
completion: WITH BASE AS (SELECT DISTINCT PBD_MRN MRN, PBD_SVC_DTE SVC_DTE, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK PROCEDURE, DOC_NAME SURGEON FROM IDB.PBD_DTL JOIN IDB.PBD_CODE ON PBD_PBD_CD = PBC_PBD_CD JOIN IDB.CLM ON PBC_CPT_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.PBD_INVOICE ON PBD_INV_NO = PBI_INV_NO JOIN IDB.DOC ON PBI_PERFORM_DR_NO = DOC_DR_NO WHERE PBC_CPT_CD IN('61595', '69145', '69150', '69155', '69440', '69450', '69501', '69502', '69505', '69511', '69535', '69601', '69602', '69603', '69604', '69605', '69635', '69636', '69637', '69641', '69642', '69643', '69644', '69645', '69646', '69910') ) , CANCER AS (SELECT DISTINCT TM_MRN FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN BASE ON TM_MRN = MRN JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND TM_HIST_CD IN ('M8070/3', 'M8070/2', 'M8070/3', 'M80706/3', 'M8071/3', 'M8072/3', 'M8073/3', 'M8074/3', 'M8075/3', 'M8076/2', 'M8076/3', 'M8083/3', 'M8084/3') ) SELECT MRN , TRIM(PT_LAST_NAME) || ', ' || TRIM(PT_FIRST_NAME) PT_NAME , SVC_DTE , PROCEDURE , SURGEON , CASE WHEN TM_MRN IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE 'Y' END AS SCC_YN FROM BASE JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PT_MRN = MRN LEFT JOIN CANCER ON MRN = TM_MRN

prompt: Provide a list of all anaplastic large cell lymphoma with an appointment with lymphoma and plastic surgery
completion: WITH ANAPLAST AS (SELECT CC_MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS MIN_ICD9_EFF_DTE, CC_CLSF_CD AS ICD9_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS ICD9_DESC FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE CLM_CLSF_CD IN ('C84.7', 'C84.70', 'C84.72', 'C84.78', 'C84.79', '200.6', '200.60', '200.63', '200.64', '200.65', '200.67') AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' GROUP BY CC_MRN, CC_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK), VISIT AS (SELECT CPE_MRN AS "MRN", CPE_ENC_DTE AS "Appt Date", CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 AS "Department", CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 AS "Service", CLD_DEPT_NAME AS "Department Name", CRE_RES_NAME AS "Provider Name", CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME AS "Visit Type" FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID JOIN ANAPLAST ON CPE_MRN=CC_MRN WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CRE_RES_TYP IN ('Physician') AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6='SRG' AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8='PLA' AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN '2000-01-01' AND '2022-10-01'), LASTVST AS (SELECT DISTINCT MRN, "Appt Date" , ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY MRN ORDER BY "Appt Date" DESC) RN FROM VISIT) SELECT DISTINCT MRN, "Appt Date" FROM LASTVST WHERE RN = 1 ORDER BY 1

prompt: Provide a list of CLL patients with a SF3B1 mutation.
completion: WITH GENE_PRE AS (SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN, PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID, PRPT_ACCESSION_NO, PRPT_PATH_RPT_ID AS GEN_R_ID, METHOD FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_STRUCTURED_RESULTS_V WHERE 1=1 AND (GENE='SF3B1' OR GENE2='SF3B1' ) ) , DMP_DX_PRE AS (SELECT DISTINCT PDRX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID P_ID, T.*, DT.PDRX_PATH_RPT_ID AS R_ID FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML DT CROSS JOIN XMLTABLE('$c/root/*' PASSING DT.PDRX_XML_VALUE AS "c" COLUMNS DMP_PATIENT_ID VARCHAR(264) PATH '../meta-data/dmp_patient_id', DMP_SAMPLE_ID VARCHAR(264) PATH '../meta-data/dmp_sample_id', PRIMARY_SITE VARCHAR(264) PATH '../meta-data/primary_site', TUMOR_TYPE_NAME VARCHAR(264) PATH '../meta-data/tumor_type_name' , METASTASIS_SITE VARCHAR(264) PATH '../meta-data/metastasis_site' , M_ACCESSION_NUM VARCHAR(264) PATH '../meta-data/m_accession_num' , GENE_PANEL VARCHAR(264) PATH '../meta-data/gene-panel' , PART_DESCRIPTION VARCHAR(264) PATH '../meta-data/part_description') T JOIN GENE_PRE ON GEN_R_ID = PDRX_PATH_RPT_ID WHERE 1=1 AND TUMOR_TYPE_NAME IN ('Chronic Lymphocytic Leukemia', 'Chronic Lymphocytic Leukemia/Small Lymphocytic Lymphoma') ) , DT AS (SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN AS MRN , P_ID PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID FROM DMP_DX_PRE JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = P_ID) , COUNTS AS (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT P_ID) AS UNIQUE_PTS, TUMOR_TYPE_NAME FROM DMP_DX_PRE GROUP BY TUMOR_TYPE_NAME ORDER BY TUMOR_TYPE_NAME) SELECT DISTINCT "t1"."PT_MRN" AS "MRN", "t1"."PT_LAST_NAME" AS "Last Name", "t1"."PT_FIRST_NAME" AS "First Name", "t1"."PT_BIRTH_DTE" AS "Date of Birth", "t1"."PT_DEATH_DTE" AS "Deceased Date", CASE WHEN "t1"."PT_DEATH_DTE" IS NULL THEN YEAR(CURRENT date - "t1"."PT_BIRTH_DTE") END AS "Cur Age", "t1"."PT_VITAL_STATUS" AS "Vital Status", "t1"."PT_SEX_DESC" AS "Gender", "t1"."PT_RACE_DESC" AS "Race", "t2"."CORE_ETHNICITY_DESC" AS "Ethnicity", "t3"."PLA_LAST_DRVST_DTE" AS "Last Dr Visit Date" , DMP_PATIENT_ID , DMP_SAMPLE_ID , PRIMARY_SITE , TUMOR_TYPE_NAME , METASTASIS_SITE , M_ACCESSION_NUM , GENE_PANEL , PART_DESCRIPTION FROM DT DT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS" "t1" ON "t1"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = DT.PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_CORE_DEMOGRAPHICS" "t2" ON "t1"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t2"."CORE_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_LATEST_ACTIVITY" "t3" ON "t1"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t3"."PLA_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" JOIN DMP_DX_PRE ON P_ID = DT.PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID WHERE 1=1 ORDER BY "t1"."PT_MRN"

prompt: Report of patient responses to Press Gany questions and select demographics.
completion: WITH MAIN AS (SELECT DISTINCT PSD_MRN, K.PSD_SURVEY_RECEIVED_DTE, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH AS "DATE OF BIRTH", PT_SEX AS "SEX ASSIGNED AT BIRTH", TRIM(G.AV_DESC) AS GENDER, TRIM(R.AV_DESC) AS RACE, TRIM(E.AV_DESC) AS ETHNICITY, PT_PRIMARY_LANG AS "Primary Language", MAX(CASE WHEN ((PQD_SURVEY_QUESTION_CD = 'SEX' AND PSD_SURVEY_TYPE IN ('UC', 'OR', 'ON', 'IN', 'AS')) OR (PQD_SURVEY_QUESTION_CD = 'ITSEX' AND PSD_SURVEY_TYPE IN ('IN', 'UC', 'AS', 'OR', 'ON'))) THEN PSR_SURVEY_RESPONSE_TEXT END) AS "Patient Sex From Engage", MAX(CASE WHEN ((PQD_SURVEY_QUESTION_CD ='O2' AND PSD_SURVEY_TYPE = 'IN') OR (PQD_SURVEY_QUESTION_CD ='F155' AND PSD_SURVEY_TYPE = 'UC') OR (PQD_SURVEY_QUESTION_CD ='O1' AND PSD_SURVEY_TYPE IN ('ON', 'OR'))) THEN PSR_SURVEY_RESPONSE_TEXT END) AS "How well the staff worked together to care for you", MAX(CASE WHEN ((PQD_SURVEY_QUESTION_CD ='O4' AND PSD_SURVEY_TYPE = 'IN') OR (PQD_SURVEY_QUESTION_CD ='O2' AND PSD_SURVEY_TYPE = 'ON') OR (PQD_SURVEY_QUESTION_CD ='F120' AND PSD_SURVEY_TYPE = 'UC') OR (PQD_SURVEY_QUESTION_CD ='O3' AND PSD_SURVEY_TYPE = 'OR')) THEN PSR_SURVEY_RESPONSE_TEXT END) AS "Overall rating of care received during your visit", MAX(CASE WHEN ((PQD_SURVEY_QUESTION_CD ='O3' AND PSD_SURVEY_TYPE IN ('IN', 'ON')) OR (PQD_SURVEY_QUESTION_CD ='F4' AND PSD_SURVEY_TYPE = 'UC') OR (PQD_SURVEY_QUESTION_CD ='O4' AND PSD_SURVEY_TYPE = 'OR')) THEN PSR_SURVEY_RESPONSE_TEXT END) AS "Likelihood of your recommending this center to others" FROM IDB.PG_SURVEY_DETAIL K JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PSD_MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS G ON G.AV_CODE = PT_SEX AND G.AV_ELEMENT = 'SEX' LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS R ON R.AV_CODE = PT_RACE AND R.AV_ELEMENT = 'RACE' LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS E ON E.AV_CODE = PT_PT_ETHNICITY AND E.AV_ELEMENT = 'PT_ETHNICITY' JOIN IDB.PG_SURVEY_RESPONSE R ON K.PSD_SURVEY_ID = R.PSR_SURVEY_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.PG_QUESTION_DETAIL Q ON R.PSR_SURVEY_QUESTION_CD = Q.PQD_SURVEY_QUESTION_CD AND K.PSD_SURVEY_TYPE = Q.PQD_SURVEY_TYPE WHERE K.PSD_SURVEY_RECEIVED_DTE >= '2018-01-01' AND PT_DEATH_IND IN ('', 'A') AND PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH > '1923-02-02' AND PQD_QUESTION_CATEGORY IN ('Analysis', 'Demographics') AND (((PQD_SURVEY_QUESTION_CD ='O2' AND PSD_SURVEY_TYPE = 'IN') OR (PQD_SURVEY_QUESTION_CD ='F155' AND PSD_SURVEY_TYPE = 'UC') OR (PQD_SURVEY_QUESTION_CD ='O1' AND PSD_SURVEY_TYPE IN ('ON', 'OR'))) OR ((PQD_SURVEY_QUESTION_CD ='O4' AND PSD_SURVEY_TYPE = 'IN') OR (PQD_SURVEY_QUESTION_CD ='O2' AND PSD_SURVEY_TYPE = 'ON') OR (PQD_SURVEY_QUESTION_CD ='F120' AND PSD_SURVEY_TYPE = 'UC') OR (PQD_SURVEY_QUESTION_CD ='O3' AND PSD_SURVEY_TYPE = 'OR')) OR ((PQD_SURVEY_QUESTION_CD ='O3' AND PSD_SURVEY_TYPE IN ('IN', 'ON')) OR (PQD_SURVEY_QUESTION_CD ='F4' AND PSD_SURVEY_TYPE = 'UC') OR (PQD_SURVEY_QUESTION_CD ='O4' AND PSD_SURVEY_TYPE = 'OR')) OR ((PQD_SURVEY_QUESTION_CD = 'SEX' AND PSD_SURVEY_TYPE IN ('UC', 'OR', 'ON', 'IN', 'AS')) OR (PQD_SURVEY_QUESTION_CD = 'ITSEX' AND PSD_SURVEY_TYPE IN ('IN', 'UC', 'AS', 'OR', 'ON'))) ) GROUP BY PSD_MRN, K.PSD_SURVEY_RECEIVED_DTE, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, PT_SEX, TRIM(G.AV_DESC), TRIM(R.AV_DESC), TRIM(E.AV_DESC), PT_PRIMARY_LANG ORDER BY 1), CDB AS (SELECT TM_MRN AS DX_MRN, TM_DX_DTE AS DX_DATE, TM_HIST_CD AS DX_CODE, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS DX_DESC FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN MAIN ON PSD_MRN = TM_MRN JOIN IDB.CLM H ON TM_HIST_CD = H.CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON TM_SITE_CD = S.CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') UNION SELECT CC_MRN AS DX_MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS DX_DATE, CLM_CLSF_CD AS DX_CODE, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS DX_DESC FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN MAIN ON PSD_MRN = CC_MRN JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND ((CC_PT_TYPE = 'I') OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) GROUP BY CC_MRN, CLM_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK), DX_ALL AS (SELECT DX_MRN, LISTAGG(COALESCE(STRIP(CAST(DX_DATE AS VARCHAR(12000))), '') || ' | ' || COALESCE(STRIP(DX_CODE), '') || ' | ' || COALESCE(STRIP(DX_DESC), '') , CHR(13) || CHR(10)) WITHIN GROUP( ORDER BY DX_MRN, DX_DATE, DX_CODE, DX_DESC) AS CANCER_DX FROM CDB GROUP BY DX_MRN) SELECT MN.*, D.CANCER_DX FROM MAIN MN JOIN DX_ALL D ON MN.PSD_MRN = D.DX_MRN

prompt: Provide a list of future visits for Kathleen Keenan, NP.
completion: SELECT CPE_MRN AS "MRN", CL_FIRST_NAME AS "Patient First Name", CL_LAST_NAME AS "Patient Last Name", (CL_ADDR1|| ' ' || CL_ADDR2 || ' '|| CL_CITY || ' ' || CL_STATE) AS "Full Address", CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME AS "Visit Type", CVT_EXT_NAME AS "Visit Type Meaning", CPE_ENC_DTE AS "Date of Next visit", CLD_DEPT_NAME AS "Department Name", CRE_RES_NAME AS "Provider Name", PLA_DONOT_MAIL_IND AS "Do not contact Indicator" FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID JOIN IDB.CL_PATIENT ON CPE_PRK = CL_PRK JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY ON CPE_MRN = PLA_MRN WHERE CRE_RES_NAME = 'KEENAN, KATHLEEN' AND CPE_ENC_DTE > CURRENT Date AND CPE_CPE_APPT_STS = 'Sch'

prompt: Patients with a future appointment in Survivorship Colorectal clinic - lookout period 7 days ahead.
completion: WITH BASE AS (SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN AS MRN , TRIM(CLD_DEPT_NAME) AS DEPARTMENTNAME , CPE_ENC_DTE AS EVENT_DATE , CPE_APPT_DT AS EVENT_DT , 'Appointment' AS EVENT_TYPE , 'DV.PATIENT_ENCOUNTER' AS EVENT_SOURCE , CPE_ENC_CSN_ID AS EVENT_ID , TRIM(CRE_RES_NAME) EVENT_RESOURCE_NAME , TRIM(CRE_RES_ID) EVENT_RESOURCE_ID , TRIM(MP_EMAIL_ADDR) EVENT_RESOURCE_EMAIL , 1 EVENT_RESOURCE_PRIMARY_IND , TRIM(MP_SERVICE_DESC) EVENT_RESOURCE_SERVICE_DESC, TRIM(MP_SERVICE_CD) EVENT_RESOURCE_SERVICE_CODE , TRIM(MP_ACADEMIC_SVC_DESC) EVENT_RESOURCE_ACADEMIC_SERVICE, TRIM(MP_ACADEMIC_DEPT_DESC) EVENT_RESOURCE_ACADEMIC_DEPT FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID = CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CLD_DEPT_ID = CPE_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON CPE_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN DV.MEDPRO ON MP_SOURCE_PROVIDER_NO = CPE_VST_RES_ID WHERE 1=1 AND CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('ApptReassgn', 'Arrived', 'Comp', 'Sch') AND CLD_DEPT_ID = 536 AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT date - 7 DAYS AND CURRENT date +7 DAYS ) , ADDITIONAL_DETAILS_PRE AS (SELECT MRN, EVENT_ID, EVENT_DATE, EVENT_DT , 'DepartmentName' AS NAME, DEPARTMENTNAME AS VALUE FROM BASE) , ADDITIONAL_DETAILS_VALIDATION AS (SELECT DISTINCT MRN, EVENT_ID, EVENT_DATE, EVENT_DT, NAME, VALUE FROM ADDITIONAL_DETAILS_PRE) , RESOURCES_VALIDATION AS (SELECT DISTINCT MRN, EVENT_ID, EVENT_DATE, EVENT_DT, EVENT_RESOURCE_ID, EVENT_RESOURCE_NAME, EVENT_RESOURCE_EMAIL, EVENT_RESOURCE_SERVICE_CODE, EVENT_RESOURCE_SERVICE_DESC, EVENT_RESOURCE_ACADEMIC_DEPT, EVENT_RESOURCE_ACADEMIC_SERVICE, EVENT_RESOURCE_PRIMARY_IND FROM BASE) , EVENTS_VALIDATION AS (SELECT DISTINCT MRN, EVENT_ID, EVENT_DATE, EVENT_DT, EVENT_TYPE, EVENT_SOURCE FROM BASE) , ADDITIONAL_DETAILS_XML AS (SELECT MRN, EVENT_ID, EVENT_DATE, EVENT_DT, XMLELEMENT(NAME "row", XMLCONCAT(XMLELEMENT(NAME NAME, NAME), XMLELEMENT(NAME VALUE, VALUE))) ADDITIONAL_DETAILS FROM ADDITIONAL_DETAILS_VALIDATION WHERE NAME <> '' ) , RESOURCES_XML AS (SELECT MRN, EVENT_ID, EVENT_DATE, EVENT_DT, XMLROW(EVENT_RESOURCE_ID, EVENT_RESOURCE_NAME, EVENT_RESOURCE_EMAIL, EVENT_RESOURCE_SERVICE_CODE, EVENT_RESOURCE_SERVICE_DESC, EVENT_RESOURCE_ACADEMIC_DEPT, EVENT_RESOURCE_ACADEMIC_SERVICE, EVENT_RESOURCE_PRIMARY_IND) EVENT_RESOURCES FROM RESOURCES_VALIDATION) , PRE_XML AS (SELECT TRIM(E.MRN) AS MRN , E.EVENT_TYPE , E.EVENT_SOURCE , E.EVENT_ID , E.EVENT_DATE , E.EVENT_DT , R.EVENT_RESOURCES , A.ADDITIONAL_DETAILS , VARCHAR_FORMAT(E.EVENT_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD-HH24-MI') ORDER_BY FROM EVENTS_VALIDATION E JOIN RESOURCES_XML R ON E.MRN = R.MRN AND E.EVENT_ID = R.EVENT_ID AND E.EVENT_DATE = R.EVENT_DATE AND E.EVENT_DT = R.EVENT_DT LEFT JOIN ADDITIONAL_DETAILS_XML A ON E.MRN = A.MRN AND E.EVENT_ID = A.EVENT_ID AND E.EVENT_DATE = A.EVENT_DATE AND E.EVENT_DT = A.EVENT_DT) , DEID AS ( SELECT PI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID P_ID , XMLDOCUMENT(XMLELEMENT(NAME COHORT_INCLUSION_EVENTS, XMLAGG(XMLROW(EVENT_TYPE, EVENT_SOURCE, EVENT_ID, EVENT_DATE, EVENT_DT, ORDER_BY, EVENT_RESOURCES, ADDITIONAL_DETAILS)))) $xmldata$ from dv.PATIENT_IDENTIFICATION join pre_xml on PI_SOURCE_SYSTEM_PT_ID = mrn and PI_PT_IDENTIFICATION_TYPE = 'MRN' GROUP BY pi_pt_deidentification_id )--select p_id, $xmldata$ FROM DEID

prompt: Provide a list of patients who have had a PSMA PET scan. Additionally, provide a PDF with all reports.
completion: WITH RAD AS (SELECT DISTINCT "t4"."PI_SOURCE_SYSTEM_PT_ID", "t1"."PT_MRN" AS "MRN", "t2"."RRPT_ACCESSION_NO" AS "Radiology Accession Number", "t2"."RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE" AS "Radiology Performed Date", "t2"."RRPT_REPORT_DTE" AS "Radiology Report Date", "t2"."RRPT_ORDER_GROUP" AS "Radiology Order Group", "t2"."RRPT_PROCEDURE_NAME" AS "Radiology Procedure Name", DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)IMPRESSION:[\w\W]*(?=DICTATED( BY:|BY:))', RRPT_REPORT_TXT) AS "Impression Of Scan", DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)FINDINGS:[\w\W]*(?=IMPRESSION:)', RRPT_REPORT_TXT) AS "FINDINGS", UPPER(CASE WHEN LENGTH(RRPT_REPORT_TXT) <= 15000 THEN RTRIM(CAST(SUBSTR(RRPT_REPORT_TXT, 1, 15000) AS VARCHAR(15000))) ELSE CAST(SUBSTR(RRPT_REPORT_TXT, 1, 15000) AS VARCHAR(15000)) END) AS "REPORT" FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V" "t1" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED" "t3" ON "t1"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t3"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."RADIOLOGY_REPORT_V" "t2" ON "t3"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t2"."RRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_IDENTIFICATION_MRN_V" "t4" ON "t1"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t4"."PI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" WHERE 1=1 AND "t2"."RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE" BETWEEN '2000-01-01' AND '2022-12-31' AND (UPPER("t2"."RRPT_PROCEDURE_NAME") LIKE '%PSMA%' OR UPPER("t2"."RRPT_PROCEDURE_NAME") LIKE '%PYLARIFY%') ), DX AS (SELECT TM_MRN AS TM_MRN, TM_DX_DTE AS DX_DATE FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM H ON TM_HIST_CD = H.CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN RAD ON TM_MRN = "MRN" JOIN IDB.CLM S ON TM_SITE_CD = S.CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('11', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND TM_SITE_CD = 'C619' UNION SELECT CC_MRN AS TM_MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS DX_DATE FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN RAD ON CC_MRN = "MRN" WHERE CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND ((CC_PT_TYPE = 'I') OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) AND CC_CLSF_CD IN ('C61', '185') AND CC_MRN NOT IN (SELECT TM_MRN FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM H ON TM_HIST_CD = H.CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON TM_SITE_CD = S.CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND TM_SITE_CD = 'C619') GROUP BY CC_MRN, CLM_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK ) SELECT DISTINCT "MRN" , DX_DATE "Date Of Prostate Cancer" , "Radiology Accession Number" , "Radiology Performed Date" , "Radiology Order Group" , "Radiology Procedure Name" , "Impression Of Scan" , "FINDINGS" , "REPORT" FROM RAD LEFT JOIN DX ON TM_MRN = "MRN"

prompt: Provide a count of patients, 18-39, who have been treated with adjuvant or neoadjuvant taxanes, but not anthracyclines, every year since 2015.
completion: WITH X AS (SELECT DISTINCT APR_MRN AS MRN, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME, APR_DRUG_NAME, APR_START_DTE, APR_END_DTE, APR_ORD_RX_TYPE FROM IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX_V JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON APR_MRN = PT_MRN AND YEAR(APR_START_DTE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) BETWEEN 18 AND 39 AND PT_DATE_OF_DEATH IS NULL WHERE 1=1 AND APR_START_DTE >= '2015-01-01' AND(UPPER(APR_GENERIC_NAME) LIKE '%DOCETAXEL%' OR UPPER(APR_GENERIC_NAME) LIKE '%PACLITAXEL%' OR UPPER(APR_GENERIC_NAME) LIKE '%TAXOL%' OR UPPER(APR_GENERIC_NAME) LIKE '%TAXOTERE%' OR UPPER(CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME) LIKE '%DOCETAXEL%' OR UPPER(CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME) LIKE '%PACLITAXEL%' OR UPPER(CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME) LIKE '%TAXOL%' OR UPPER(CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME) LIKE '%TAXOTERE%' OR UPPER(APR_DRUG_NAME) LIKE '%DOCETAXEL%' OR UPPER(APR_DRUG_NAME) LIKE '%PACLITAXEL%' OR UPPER(APR_DRUG_NAME) LIKE '%TAXOL%' OR UPPER(APR_DRUG_NAME) LIKE '%TAXOTERE%') ) , Y AS (SELECT DISTINCT A.APR_MRN, A.CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME, A.APR_DRUG_NAME, A.APR_START_DTE, A.APR_END_DTE, A.APR_ORD_RX_TYPE FROM IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX_V A JOIN X ON APR_MRN = MRN WHERE 1=1 AND(UPPER(A.APR_GENERIC_NAME) LIKE '%DOXORUBICIN%' OR UPPER(A.APR_GENERIC_NAME) LIKE '%EPIRUBICIN%' OR UPPER(A.CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME) LIKE '%DOXORUBICIN%' OR UPPER(A.CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME) LIKE '%EPIRUBICIN%' OR UPPER(A.APR_DRUG_NAME) LIKE '%DOXORUBICIN%' OR UPPER(A.APR_DRUG_NAME) LIKE '%EPIRUBICIN%') ) , Z AS (SELECT X.* FROM X WHERE MRN NOT IN (SELECT APR_MRN FROM Y) ) SELECT YEAR(APR_START_DTE) AS YR, COUNT(DISTINCT MRN) FROM Z GROUP BY YEAR(APR_START_DTE)

VARCHAR) || CAST(TRIM("IDB"."CDB_TUMOR"."TM_TUMOR_SEQ") AS VARCHAR) || CAST(TRIM("IDB"."CDB_TUMOR"."TM_DX_DTE") AS VARCHAR) AS SUBJECT_ID, "IDB"."ALLOWVALS"."AV_DESC" AS DX_TR_CASE_STATUS, TRIM("IDB"."CDB_TUMOR"."TM_SITE_CD") || ' - ' || TRIM(CLM_SITE."CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK") AS DX_TR_SITE FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS" JOIN "IDB"."CDB_TUMOR" ON "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_MRN" = CAST(TRIM("IDB"."ACCRUALS"."AC_MRN") AS VARCHAR) || CAST(TRIM("IDB"."ACCRUALS"."AC_IRB_NO") AS VARCHAR) AS SUBJECT_ID, "IDB"."ACCRUALS"."AC_IRB_NO" AS AC_IRB_NO FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS" JOIN SUBJECT_ID, PT_DEID AS PT_DEID FROM (SELECT DIAGNOSIS_TR_0.SUBJECT_ID AS SUBJECT_ID, DIAGNOSIS_TR_0.PT_DEID AS PT_DEID FROM DIAGNOSIS_TR_0)), COHORT_PROTOCOL AS (SELECT SUBJECT_ID AS SUBJECT_ID, AS COHORT_DIAGNOSIS_TR_SUBJECT_ID, COHORT_DIAGNOSIS_TR.PT_DEID AS COHORT_DIAGNOSIS_TR_PT_DEID, COHORT_PROTOCOL.SUBJECT_ID AS COHORT_PROTOCOL_SUBJECT_ID, COHORT_PROTOCOL.PT_DEID AS VARCHAR) || CAST(TRIM("IDB"."CDB_TUMOR"."TM_TUMOR_SEQ") AS VARCHAR) || CAST(TRIM("IDB"."CDB_TUMOR"."TM_DX_DTE") AS VARCHAR) AS SUBJECT_ID, TRIM("IDB"."CDB_TUMOR"."TM_SITE_CD") || ' - ' || TRIM(CLM_SITE."CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK") AS DX_TR_SITE, TRIM("IDB"."CDB_TUMOR"."TM_HIST_CD") || ' - ' || TRIM(CLM_HIST."CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK") AS DX_TR_HISTOLOGY FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS" JOIN "IDB"."CDB_TUMOR" ON "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_MRN" = "IDB"."CDB_TUMOR"."TM_MRN" JOIN "IDB"."CLM" AS CLM_SITE ON CLM_SITE."CLM_CLSF_CD" = "IDB"."CDB_TUMOR"."TM_SITE_CD" JOIN "IDB"."CLM" AS CLM_HIST ON CLM_HIST."CLM_CLSF_CD" = "IDB"."CDB_TUMOR"."TM_HIST_CD"), DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS AS (SELECT DISTINCT "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AS PT_DEID, IDB_PATIENT."PT_MRN" PT_MRN, CAST(TRIM("IDB"."ACCRUALS"."AC_CONS_DTE") AS VARCHAR) || CAST(TRIM("IDB"."ACCRUALS"."AC_MRN") AS VARCHAR) || CAST(TRIM("IDB"."ACCRUALS"."AC_IRB_NO") AS VARCHAR) AS SUBJECT_ID, "IDB"."ACCRUALS"."AC_NON_MSK_INST" = '' AND "IDB"."ACCRUALS"."AC_IRB_NO" IN ('06-107')), COHORT AS (SELECT PT_DEID AS PT_DEID FROM (SELECT DIAGNOSIS_TR_0.PT_DEID AS PT_DEID FROM DIAGNOSIS_TR_0 INTERSECT SELECT PROTOCOL_1.PT_DEID AS PT_DEID FROM PROTOCOL_1)), COHORT_DIAGNOSIS_TR AS (SELECT SUBJECT_ID AS SUBJECT_ID, PT_DEID AS PT_DEID FROM (SELECT DIAGNOSIS_TR_0.SUBJECT_ID AS SUBJECT_ID, prompt: list of completed orders entered in 2022 with 'per policy' in order source
completion: SELECT DISTINCT OO_MRN, OO_ENTER_DTE, OUO_CURR_LOC AS LOCATION, OO_ORD_NAME AS ORDER_NAME, RTRIM(OO_ORD_STS_CD)||' - '||OUO_STS_DESC AS CURR_STS, OUO_USER_NAME AS ENTER_USER, OUO_PVDR_NAME AS REQUESTER, OU_DISPLAY_NAME AS DISC_USER, OSH_ORD_SOURCE AS ORD_SOURCE, OUO_ORD_SOURCE, OUO_REV_CAT_DEPT , OSH_REASON_TXT AS REASON_TXT FROM IDB.OMS_ORDER JOIN IDB.OMS_USER_ORDERS ON OO_ORD_GUID = OUO_ORD_GUID JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON OO_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.OMS_MED_DETAIL ON OO_ORD_GUID = OMD_ORD_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_SYS_DATA ON OSD_ORD_GUID = OO_ORD_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_STS_HX ON OSH_ORD_GUID = OO_ORD_GUID LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_USER ON OSH_USER_GUID = OU_USER_GUID WHERE OO_ORD_STS_CD NOT IN ('CANC', 'CANCD', 'AUC3') AND (UPPER(OSH_ORD_SOURCE) like '%PER%POLICY%' OR UPPER(OUO_ORD_SOURCE) LIKE '%PER%POLICY%') AND YEAR(OO_ENTER_DTE) = '2022' AND OO_ORD_STS_CD = 'COMP'
