completion: SELECT RPT_MRN, RPT_PAT_NAME, RVSD_VITAL_STATUS_MNEMONIC AS "Vital Status", RPT_DECEASED_IND AS "Deceased Indicator", CASE WHEN RPT_DATE_OF_DEATH IS NOT NULL THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS "Date of Death Valued" FROM IDB.RMS_PATIENT JOIN IDB.RMS_VITAL_STATUS_DICT_DN48006 ON RPT_U_VITAL_STATUS_REC_NO = RVSD_RECORD_NUMBER WHERE RVSD_VITAL_STATUS_MNEMONIC IN ('A', '') AND (RPT_DECEASED_IND = 'Y' OR RPT_DATE_OF_DEATH IS NOT NULL) AND LENGTH(TRIM(RPT_MRN)) = 8 ORDER BY 2

prompt: A list of stage II and III colorectal cancer patients over 65 years of age with at least 4 months since their first chemo date or up to 3 months since their last chemo date.  Patients must also have had their first visit no earlier than 12 months ago.
completion: SELECT DISTINCT DATA1.*, APPT.NEXT_APPT_DATE, CLD_CLD_CENTER AS APPT_LOCATION FROM (SELECT P.PT_MRN, P.PT_FIRST_NAME, P.PT_LAST_NAME, P.PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, P1.CL_MOBILE_PHONE, P1.CL_PHONE, PAS.CPP_HOME_PHONE, PAS.CPP_WORK_PHONE, PAS.CPP_EMAIL_ADDR, MIN(CE.CS_ADM_DATE) AS FIRST_ADM_DATE, MIN(D.POD_STRT_DTE) FIRST_ORDER_START, MAX(D.POD_STOP_DTE) LAST_ORDER_STOP FROM IDB.PATIENT P LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_PATIENT P1 ON P.PT_MRN = P1.CL_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_PAS_PATIENT PAS ON P.PT_MRN = PAS.CPP_MRN INNER JOIN (SELECT TM_MRN AS MRN FROM IDB.TM_TUMOR WHERE TM_SITE_CD IN ('C182', 'C183', 'C184', 'C185', 'C186', 'C187', 'C188', 'C189', 'C199', 'C209', 'C218') AND (TM_AJCC BETWEEN '30' AND '69' OR TM_CLIN_STG_GRP BETWEEN '2' AND '3X' OR TM_PATH_STG_GRP BETWEEN '2' AND '3X') UNION SELECT CLSF_MRN AS MRN FROM IDB.CLSF WHERE CLSF_CLSF_CD IN ('153', '153.0', '153.1', '153.2', '153.3', '153.4', '153.6', '153.7', '153.8', '153.9', '230.3', '154', '154.1', '154.8') AND (CLSF_ACCT_NO like '00%' OR CLSF_ACCT_NO like '84%' OR CLSF_CIC_CDER_INIT <> '') ) MRNS ON P.PT_MRN = MRNS.MRN INNER JOIN IDB.CASE CE ON P.PT_MRN = CE.CS_MRN INNER JOIN IDB.PHM_ORDER O ON P.PT_MRN = O.PO_MRN AND UPPER(O.PO_ORD_STS) <> 'X' JOIN IDB.PHM_ORD_DTL D ON O.PO_ORD_SEQ = D.POD_ORD_SEQ AND D.POD_ATT_FLAG LIKE '%CHEMO%' JOIN IDB.PHM_ORD_INV I ON POD_ITEM_NO = POI_ITEM_NO AND POD_ORD_SEQ = POI_ORD_SEQ JOIN IDB.PHM_INVENTORY INV ON POI_INV_SEQ = PIN_INV_SEQ WHERE YEAR(CURRENT date - P.PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) >= 65 GROUP BY P.PT_MRN, P.PT_FIRST_NAME, P.PT_LAST_NAME, P.PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, P1.CL_MOBILE_PHONE, P1.CL_PHONE, PAS.CPP_HOME_PHONE, PAS.CPP_WORK_PHONE, PAS.CPP_EMAIL_ADDR HAVING MIN(CE.CS_ADM_DATE) >= (CURRENT date - 1 YEAR) AND (MIN(D.POD_STRT_DTE) <= (CURRENT date - 120 DAYS) OR MAX(D.POD_STOP_DTE) >= (CURRENT date - 210 DAYS))) DATA1 LEFT JOIN (SELECT NEXT_APPT.CPE_MRN, NEXT_APPT.NEXT_APPT_DATE, APPTS.CLD_CLD_CENTER FROM (SELECT CPE_MRN, MIN(CPE_APPT_DT) AS NEXT_APPT_DATE FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER WHERE CPE_ENC_DTE >= CURRENT date AND CPE_CPE_APPT_STS = 'Sch' GROUP BY CPE_MRN) NEXT_APPT INNER JOIN (SELECT CPE_MRN, CLD_CLD_CENTER, CPE_APPT_DT FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER INNER JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID WHERE CPE_ENC_DTE >= CURRENT date AND CPE_CPE_APPT_STS = 'Sch' ) APPTS ON NEXT_APPT.CPE_MRN = APPTS.CPE_MRN AND NEXT_APPT.NEXT_APPT_DATE = APPTS.CPE_APPT_DT) APPT ON CPE_MRN = PT_MRN

prompt: Provide a weekly screening report for protocol 20-224.
completion: WITH CPE AS (SELECT DISTINCT STRIP(CPE_MRN) AS MRN, STRIP(PT_LAST_NAME) AS "Last Name", STRIP(PT_FIRST_NAME) AS "First Name", VARCHAR(CPE_ENC_DTE) AS "Appt Date", TIME(CPE_APPT_DT) AS "Appt Time", STRIP(CRE_RES_NAME) AS CRE_RES_NAME, STRIP(CRE_RES_TYP) AS CRE_RES_TYP, STRIP(CLD_DEPT_NAME) AS CLD_DEPT_NAME, STRIP(CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME) AS CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PT_MRN = CPE_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Sch') AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT DATE AND CURRENT DATE + 14 DAYS AND CRE_RES_ID IN ('013185', '016964', '002311') ) , DX AS (SELECT DISTINCT TM_MRN AS MRN, TM_DX_DTE AS DX_DATE, TM_HIST_CD AS HIST_CODE, STRIP(H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK) AS HIST_DESC, TM_SITE_CD AS SITE_CODE, STRIP(S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK) AS SITE_DESC, TM_TUMOR_SIZE, STRIP(CASE WHEN TM_AJCC_7 NOT IN ('', '888', '999') THEN AJCC7.AV_DESC WHEN TM_AJCC NOT IN ('', '88', '99') THEN AJCC.AV_DESC WHEN TM_GENERAL_STG NOT IN ('', '9') THEN GS.AV_DESC WHEN TM_PATH_STG_GRP NOT IN ('', '88', '9', '99') THEN TM_PATH_STG_GRP ELSE CLIN.AV_DESC END) AS STAGE FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM H ON TM_HIST_CD = H.CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON TM_SITE_CD = S.CLM_CLSF_CD LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS AJCC7 ON AJCC7.AV_ELEMENT = 'AJCC_7' AND AJCC7.AV_CODE = TM_AJCC_7 LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS AJCC ON AJCC.AV_ELEMENT = 'AJCC' AND AJCC.AV_CODE = TM_AJCC LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS GS ON GS.AV_ELEMENT = 'GENERAL_STG' AND GS.AV_CODE = TM_GENERAL_STG LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS CLIN ON CLIN.AV_ELEMENT = 'CLIN_STG_DSCR' AND CLIN.AV_CODE = TM_CLIN_STG_DSCR WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND TM_MRN IN (SELECT MRN FROM CPE) AND TM_HIST_CD IN ('M8312/3') ) , CT AS (SELECT DISTINCT "t1"."PT_MRN" AS "MRN", "t2"."RRPT_ACCESSION_NO" AS "Radiology Accession Number", "t2"."RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE" AS "Radiology Performed Date", "t2"."RRPT_REPORT_DTE" AS "Radiology Report Date", "t2"."RRPT_ORDER_GROUP" AS "Radiology Order Group", "t2"."RRPT_PROCEDURE_NAME" AS "Radiology Procedure Name", UPPER(CASE WHEN LENGTH(RRPT_REPORT_TXT) <= 15000 THEN RTRIM(CAST(SUBSTR(RRPT_REPORT_TXT, 1, 15000) AS VARCHAR(15000))) ELSE CAST(SUBSTR(RRPT_REPORT_TXT, 1, 15000) AS VARCHAR(15000)) END) AS "PRPT_REPORT", ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY "t1"."PT_MRN" ORDER BY "t2"."RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE" DESC) AS CT_RN FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V" "t1" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED" "t3" ON "t1"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t3"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."RADIOLOGY_REPORT_V" "t2" ON "t3"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t2"."RRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_IDENTIFICATION_MRN_V" "t4" ON "t1"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t4"."PI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" WHERE "t4"."PI_SOURCE_SYSTEM_PT_ID" IN (SELECT MRN FROM CPE) AND "t2"."RRPT_ORDER_GROUP" = 'CT' ) , NEPH AS (SELECT DISTINCT PBD_MRN, CLM_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK, PBC_PBD_DESC, PBD_SVC_DTE FROM IDB.PBD_DTL JOIN IDB.PBD_CODE ON PBD_PBD_CD = PBC_PBD_CD JOIN IDB.CLM ON PBC_CPT_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE PBD_MRN IN (SELECT MRN FROM DX) AND(CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK like '%NEPHRECTOMY%' OR PBC_PBD_DESC like '%NEPHRECTOMY%') ) SELECT CPE.*, HIST_CODE, HIST_DESC, SITE_CODE, SITE_DESC, TM_TUMOR_SIZE, "Radiology Performed Date", "Radiology Order Group", "Radiology Procedure Name", CASE WHEN NEPH.PBD_MRN IS NOT NULL THEN 'Y' END AS "Nephrectomy" FROM CPE JOIN DX ON CPE.MRN = DX.MRN LEFT JOIN CT ON CPE.MRN = CT.MRN AND CT_RN = 1 LEFT JOIN NEPH ON CPE.MRN = PBD_MRN ORDER BY "Appt Date", "Appt Time"

prompt: HR+, HER2- breast cancer
completion: WITH PTS AS (SELECT PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID PID FROM DV.PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED) , DT_1 AS (SELECT PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID AS P_ID FROM DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS REC LEFT JOIN DV.PATIENT_CORE_DEMOGRAPHICS ON PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = CORE_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID WHERE 1=1 ) , DT_2 AS (SELECT PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID AS P_ID FROM DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS REC LEFT JOIN DV.PATIENT_CORE_DEMOGRAPHICS ON PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = CORE_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID WHERE 1=1 AND PT_VITAL_STATUS IN ('ALIVE') ) , DT_3 AS (SELECT INC.PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID P_ID FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_STRUCTURED_RESULTS_V INC WHERE 1=1 AND (INC.GENE IN ('PIK3CA') OR INC.GENE2 IN ('PIK3CA')) AND INC.AA_CHANGE IN ('R88Q', 'R93X', 'G118D', 'N345K', 'C420R', 'E453X', 'E542K', 'E545X', 'Q546X', 'E726K', 'M1043I', 'H1047X', 'G1049R') ) , DT_4 AS (SELECT INC.PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID P_ID FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_STRUCTURED_RESULTS_V INC JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML DT ON INC.PRPT_PATH_RPT_ID = DT.PDRX_PATH_RPT_ID CROSS JOIN XMLTABLE('$c/root/meta-data' PASSING DT.PDRX_XML_VALUE AS "c" COLUMNS PRIMARY_SITE VARCHAR(264) PATH 'primary_site', TUMOR_TYPE_NAME VARCHAR(264) PATH 'tumor_type_name' , TUMOR_TYPE_CODE VARCHAR(264) PATH 'tumor_type_code', IS_METASTASIS VARCHAR(3) PATH 'is_metastasis' , METASTASIS_SITE VARCHAR(264) PATH 'metastasis_site' , MSI_COMMENT VARCHAR(264) PATH 'msi-comment' , MSI_SCORE VARCHAR(264) PATH 'msi-score' , MSI_TYPE VARCHAR(264) PATH 'msi-type' , TMB_SCORE VARCHAR(25) PATH 'tmb_score' , TMB_COUNT VARCHAR(25) PATH 'tmb-count', COSMIC_ID VARCHAR(5000) PATH 'cosmic_id') T JOIN (SELECT T.TUMOR_TYPE_CODE TTC FROM TABLE(DV.STRING_SPLIT('BOWEL', ',')) S CROSS JOIN TABLE(DV.ONCOTREE_CHILDREN(COLUMN_VALUES)) T) X ON T.TUMOR_TYPE_CODE = TRIM(X.TTC) WHERE 1=1 ) , DEID AS (SELECT DISTINCT P_ID FROM (SELECT P_ID FROM DT_1 INTERSECT SELECT P_ID FROM DT_2 INTERSECT SELECT P_ID FROM DT_3 EXCEPT SELECT P_ID FROM DT_4 ))

prompt: Provide the number of distinct patients that received an autologous transplant since 2016 by state
completion: SELECT PT_STATE, COUNT(DISTINCT CDD_MRN) CNT FROM IDB.CD_DOCUMENT JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION ON CDD_MRN = CDO_MRN AND CDD_DOC_GUID = CDO_DOC_GUID AND CDD_AUTHORED_DTE = CDO_AUTHORED_DTE JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON CDD_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE CDD_DOC_NAME IN ('Cell Infusion - BMT') AND CDD_CANCEL_IND <> '1' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND <> '1' AND CDO_ITEM_NAME = 'Product Information: Cell Infusion Type' AND CDO_VALUE_TEXT like 'Autologous%' AND CDD_SERVICE_DTE BETWEEN '2016-01-01' AND CURRENT date GROUP BY PT_STATE

prompt: Please provide a list of all new breast medicine and breast surgery visits per week.
completion: SELECT DISTINCT TRIM(PT_MRN) AS PT_MRN, TRIM(PT_LAST_NAME) || ', ' || TRIM(PT_FIRST_NAME) AS PATIENTS_NAME, PT_PRIMARY_LANG, YEAR(DATE(CPE_ENC_DTE) - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) AS AGE, CPE_ENC_DTE APPT_DATE, CRE_RES_NAME MD_NAME, CLD_DEPT_NAME, CAV_TITLE AS DEPARTMENT, IIC_STATE, IIC_DISTANCE, IIC_CATCHMENT FROM IDB.PATIENT JOIN IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER ON PT_MRN = CPE_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_CATEGORY D ON D.CAV_CATEGORY = 'CLD_RPT_GRP_6' AND D.CAV_ABBR = CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID JOIN IDB.ID_IP_IWT_CATCHMENT ON SUBSTR(PT_ZIP_CD, 1, 5) = IIC_ZIP_CD WHERE 1 =1 AND CPE_CPE_APPT_STS = 'Sch' AND (UPPER(CLD_DEPT_NAME) LIKE '%BRE%MED%' OR UPPER(CLD_DEPT_NAME) LIKE '%BREAST%') AND PT_PRIMARY_LANG IN ('ENG') AND YEAR(DATE(CPE_ENC_DTE) - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) <= 75 AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT_DATE + 7 AND CURRENT date + 14 DAY AND IIC_CATCHMENT IN ('NYC', 'North Jersey', 'Lower Hudson Valley', 'Nassau', 'Central Jersey', 'Jersey Shore', 'Suffolk')

prompt:
Please provide list of MRNs from 1/1/2000 to 5/31/2021 who had "retrorectal cyst” or “retrorectal cystic hamartoma” or "Tailgut cyst".

Please do text search in Pathology report for  "retrorectal cyst” or “retrorectal cystic hamartoma” or "Tailgut cyst".
completion: SELECT PRPT_MRN "MRN", PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH "DATE OF BIRTH", PT_DATE_OF_DEATH "DATE OF DEATH", TRIM(R.AV_DESC) AS RACE, TRIM(E.AV_DESC) AS ETHNICITY, PRPT_PROCEDURE_DTE, PRPT_REPORT_TYPE_DESC, PRPT_ACCESSION_NO, PRPT_REPORT FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PRPT_MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS R ON R.AV_CODE = PT_RACE AND R.AV_ELEMENT = 'RACE' LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS E ON E.AV_CODE = PT_PT_ETHNICITY AND E.AV_ELEMENT = 'PT_ETHNICITY' WHERE PRPT_REPORT IS NOT NULL AND PRPT_PROCEDURE_DTE BETWEEN '2000-01-01' AND '2021-05-31' AND CONTAINS("PRPT_REPORT", '("retrorectal cyst" OR "retrorectal cystic hamartoma" OR "Tailgut cyst")') = 1 ; SELECT CDD_MRN "MRN", PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH "DATE OF BIRTH", PT_DATE_OF_DEATH "DATE OF DEATH", TRIM(R.AV_DESC) AS RACE, TRIM(E.AV_DESC) AS ETHNICITY, CDD_SERVICE_DTE "DOCUMENT SERVICE DATE", CDD_DOCUMENT_FULL_TEXT "CLINDOC REPORT" FROM DV.CLINDOC_FULL_TEXT_V JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON CDD_MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS R ON R.AV_CODE = PT_RACE AND R.AV_ELEMENT = 'RACE' LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS E ON E.AV_CODE = PT_PT_ETHNICITY AND E.AV_ELEMENT = 'PT_ETHNICITY' WHERE CDD_CANCEL_IND <> '1' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND <> '1' AND (CDD_DOC_NAME LIKE 'Initial%' OR CDD_DOC_NAME LIKE 'Follow%') AND CONTAINS("CDD_DOCUMENT_FULL_TEXT", '("retrorectal cyst" OR "retrorectal cystic hamartoma" OR "Tailgut cyst")') = 1 AND CDD_SERVICE_DTE BETWEEN '2000-01-01' AND '2021-05-31' ;

prompt: Patients with small cell lung cancer who received platinum+etoposide therapy.
completion: WITH CHEMO1 AS (SELECT CPO_MRN, CPO_START_DTE, 'ETOPOSIDE' AS CHEMO FROM IDB.CHEMO_PERFORMED_ORDERS WHERE UPPER(TRIM(CPO_ORD_NAME)) LIKE '%ETOPOSIDE%' UNION ALL SELECT CP_MRN CPO_MRN, DATE(CP_START_DT) CPO_START_DTE, 'ETOPOSIDE' AS CHEMO FROM IDB.CHEMO_PRESCRIPTIONS WHERE UPPER(TRIM(CP_GENERIC_NAME)) LIKE '%ETOPOSIDE%' ) , CHEMO2 AS (SELECT CPO_MRN, MIN(CPO_START_DTE) FIRST_ST_DTE, MAX(CPO_START_DTE) LAST_ST_DTE, CHEMO FROM CHEMO1 GROUP BY CPO_MRN, CHEMO) , CHEMO3 AS (SELECT CPO_MRN, CPO_START_DTE, 'CARBOPLATIN' AS CHEMO FROM IDB.CHEMO_PERFORMED_ORDERS WHERE UPPER(TRIM(CPO_ORD_NAME)) LIKE '%CARBOPLATIN%' UNION ALL SELECT CP_MRN CPO_MRN, DATE(CP_START_DT) CPO_START_DTE, 'CARBOPLATIN' AS CHEMO FROM IDB.CHEMO_PRESCRIPTIONS WHERE UPPER(TRIM(CP_GENERIC_NAME)) LIKE '%CARBOPLATIN%' UNION ALL SELECT CPO_MRN, CPO_START_DTE, 'CISPLATIN' AS CHEMO FROM IDB.CHEMO_PERFORMED_ORDERS WHERE UPPER(TRIM(CPO_ORD_NAME)) LIKE '%CISPLATIN%' UNION ALL SELECT CP_MRN CPO_MRN, DATE(CP_START_DT) CPO_START_DTE, 'CISPLATIN' AS CHEMO FROM IDB.CHEMO_PRESCRIPTIONS WHERE UPPER(TRIM(CP_GENERIC_NAME)) LIKE '%CISPLATIN%' ) , CHEMO4 AS (SELECT CPO_MRN, MIN(CPO_START_DTE) FIRST_ST_DTE, MAX(CPO_START_DTE) LAST_ST_DTE, CHEMO FROM CHEMO3 GROUP BY CPO_MRN, CHEMO) , CHEMO AS (SELECT DISTINCT A.CPO_MRN CHEMO_MRN, A.CHEMO PLATINUM, A.FIRST_ST_DTE PLATINUM_FIRST_ST_DTE, A.LAST_ST_DTE PLATINUM_LAST_ST_DTE, B.CHEMO CHEMO2, B.FIRST_ST_DTE, B.LAST_ST_DTE FROM CHEMO4 A JOIN CHEMO2 B ON A.CPO_MRN = B.CPO_MRN AND B.FIRST_ST_DTE BETWEEN A.FIRST_ST_DTE - 7 DAYS AND A.FIRST_ST_DTE + 7 DAYS) , CONSENT AS (SELECT ACD_MRN, MAX(CASE WHEN ACD_IRB_NO = '06-107' THEN ACD_CONS_DTE END) "06-107 Consent", MAX(CASE WHEN ACD_IRB_NO = '12-245' THEN ACD_CONS_DTE END) "12-245 Consent", MAX(CASE WHEN ACD_IRB_NO = '14-192' THEN ACD_CONS_DTE END) "14-192 Consent" FROM IDB.ACCRUALS_DATES JOIN CHEMO ON CHEMO_MRN = ACD_MRN WHERE ACD_IRB_NO IN ('06-107', '12-245', '14-192') GROUP BY ACD_MRN) , IMPACT AS (SELECT DISTINCT PDWS_NAME, PT_MRN GENE_MRN, PDRX_ACCESSION_NO, SAMPLEID, PATIENTID, TUMOR_TYPE_NAME, IS_METASTASIS, PRIMARY_SITE, METASTASIS_SITE FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML_SETTINGS ON PDRX_PATH_DMP_RESULTS_XML_ID = PDRXS_PATH_DMP_RESULTS_XML_ID JOIN DVDMC.PATHOLOGY_DMP_WEBSVC_SETTINGS ON PDRXS_SETTING_ID = PDWS_SETTING_ID JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON PDRX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID JOIN CHEMO ON PT_MRN = CHEMO_MRN, XMLTABLE('$c/root/*' PASSING PDRX_XML_VALUE AS "c" COLUMNS TOTAL_NUMBER_VARIANTS int PATH 'count(../*[not(name()=''meta-data'')])', VARIANT_TYPE VARCHAR(100) PATH './local-name(.)', SAMPLEID VARCHAR(100) PATH '../meta-data/dmp_sample_id', PATIENTID VARCHAR(100) PATH '../meta-data/dmp_patient_id', TUMOR_TYPE_CODE VARCHAR(100) PATH '../meta-data/tumor_type_code', TUMOR_TYPE_NAME VARCHAR(255) PATH '../meta-data/tumor_type_name', IS_METASTASIS VARCHAR(10) PATH '../meta-data/is_metastasis', PRIMARY_SITE VARCHAR(255) PATH '../meta-data/primary_site', METASTASIS_SITE VARCHAR(255) PATH '../meta-data/metastasis_site') T WHERE PDWS_NAME = 'IMPACT' AND (TOTAL_NUMBER_VARIANTS =0 OR VARIANT_TYPE <> 'meta-data') ) SELECT TM_MRN MRN, PT_LAST_NAME "Last Name", PT_FIRST_NAME "First Name", PT_SEX "Gender", PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH "Date of Birth", PT_DATE_OF_DEATH "Date of Death", PLA_LST_APPT_DTE "Last Appointment", PLA_LST_CON_DTE "Last Contact", TM_DX_DTE "Dx Date", TM_HIST_CD "Histology Code", H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK "Histology Description", STAGE.AV_DESC "Stage", PLATINUM, PLATINUM_FIRST_ST_DTE, PLATINUM_LAST_ST_DTE, FIRST_ST_DTE ETOPOSIDE_FIRST_ST_DTE, LAST_ST_DTE ETOPOSIDE_LAST_ST_DTE, CASE WHEN GENE_MRN IS NOT NULL THEN 'Y' END IMPACT_RESULT, "06-107 Consent", "12-245 Consent", "14-192 Consent" FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS ON AV_ELEMENT = 'CASE_STS' AND AV_CODE = TM_CASE_STS JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON TM_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY ON PT_MRN = PLA_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS STAGE ON TM_AJCC = STAGE.AV_CODE AND STAGE.AV_ELEMENT = 'AJCC' JOIN CHEMO ON TM_MRN = CHEMO_MRN LEFT JOIN IMPACT ON TM_MRN = GENE_MRN LEFT JOIN CONSENT ON TM_MRN = ACD_MRN WHERE TM_SITE_CD LIKE 'C34%' AND TM_HIST_CD IN ('M8041/2', 'M8041/3', 'M8042/3', 'M8043/3', 'M8045/3')

prompt: Please provide the conversion rates for Gynecology service in Department of Surgery.
completion: WITH SURG AS (SELECT * FROM (SELECT DISTINCT SSE_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, MIN_SURG_DTE, SSP_SURG_LAST_NM, SSP_SURG_FIRST_NM, SSP_RES_ID, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY SSE_MRN ORDER BY MIN_SURG_DTE ASC) AS ROW FROM (SELECT * FROM (SELECT DISTINCT SSE_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, MIN(SSE_SURG_DTE) AS MIN_SURG_DTE, SSP_SURG_LAST_NM, SSP_SURG_FIRST_NM, SSP_RES_ID FROM IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE ON SSE_LOG_ID = SSP_LOG_ID JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON SSE_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE 1=1 AND SSP_SURG_SVC_CD = 'GYN' GROUP BY SSE_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, SSP_SURG_LAST_NM, SSP_SURG_FIRST_NM, SSP_RES_ID) AS Z WHERE MIN_SURG_DTE >= '2020-01-01' ) AS X ORDER BY ROW ASC) AS Y WHERE ROW = 1 ) , APPTS AS (SELECT DISTINCT SSE_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, MIN_SURG_DTE, SSP_SURG_LAST_NM, SSP_SURG_FIRST_NM, SSP_RES_ID, CPE_MRN, CPE_ENC_DTE, TIME(CPE_APPT_DT) AS APPT_TIME, CLD_DEPT_NAME, CRE_RES_NAME, CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR, DAYS(MIN_SURG_DTE) - DAYS(CPE_ENC_DTE) AS DAYSDIFF, VIS_ADM_DTE, VIS_ADM_TIME, VIS_DSCH_DTE, VIS_IP_OP_ADJUSTED_IND FROM SURG LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER ON SSE_MRN = CPE_MRN AND SSP_RES_ID = CPE_VST_RES_ID AND CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Comp', 'Arrived') AND CPE_ENC_DTE <= MIN_SURG_DTE LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CRE_RES_ID = CPE_VST_RES_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.VISIT_V ON CPE_MRN = VIS_MRN AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN VIS_ADM_DTE AND VIS_DSCH_DTE AND VIS_IP_OP_ADJUSTED_IND = 'I') , NVAPPTS AS (SELECT DISTINCT A.CPE_MRN, CPE_ENC_DTE, APPT_TIME, CLD_DEPT_NAME, CRE_RES_NAME, CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR, DAYSDIFF, VIS_ADM_DTE, VIS_ADM_TIME, VIS_DSCH_DTE, VIS_IP_OP_ADJUSTED_IND FROM APPTS A JOIN (SELECT B.CPE_MRN AS MAXMRN, MAX(CPE_ENC_DTE) AS MAXNV FROM APPTS B WHERE CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR like '%IR%' OR CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR LIKE '%NV%' GROUP BY B.CPE_MRN) AS X ON A.CPE_MRN = MAXMRN AND A.CPE_ENC_DTE = MAXNV) , APPTCOUNT AS (SELECT SSE_MRN, COUNT(A.CPE_ENC_DTE) AS APPT_COUNT FROM APPTS A JOIN NVAPPTS B ON B.CPE_MRN = SSE_MRN WHERE 1=1 AND A.CPE_ENC_DTE >= B.CPE_ENC_DTE GROUP BY SSE_MRN) SELECT DISTINCT A.SSE_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, SSP_SURG_LAST_NM, SSP_SURG_FIRST_NM, SSP_RES_ID, MIN_SURG_DTE AS SURG_DTE, C.CPE_ENC_DTE AS FIRST_APPT_DTE, C.DAYSDIFF, C.CLD_DEPT_NAME, C.CRE_RES_NAME, C.CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR, APPT_COUNT, C.VIS_IP_OP_ADJUSTED_IND FROM APPTS A LEFT JOIN APPTCOUNT B ON A.SSE_MRN = B.SSE_MRN LEFT JOIN NVAPPTS C ON A.SSE_MRN = C.CPE_MRN

prompt: generate a list of both inpatients and outpatients (only BMT patients) with a listed penicillin allergy
completion: WITH PTS AS (SELECT DISTINCT VIS_MRN MRN, VIS_IP_OP_ADJUSTED_IND IP_OP FROM IDB.VISIT_V WHERE VIS_VISIT_STATUS = 2 AND (VIS_HOSP_SVC IN ('BMT', 'TRB', 'TRBB', 'TRG', 'TRW') AND VIS_IP_OP_ADJUSTED_IND = 'O') OR (VIS_IP_OP_ADJUSTED_IND = 'I') ), ALLERGIES AS (SELECT MRN, IP_OP, OPA_ALRGN_CD ALLERGEN, OPA_ALGY_TYP_DESC ALLERGEN_TYPE, OPA_CREATE_DT ALLERGEN_CREATE_DT, OPA_ALGY_SEVERITY ALLERGEN_SEVERITY, OPA_ALGY_REACT ALLERGEN_REACTION, OPA_ALRGN_TYPE ALLERGEN_FORM, OPA_ALGY_STS ALLERGEN_STATUS FROM PTS JOIN IDB.OMS_PT_ALLERGY ON MRN=OPA_MRN AND OPA_ALGY_STS = 'Active' WHERE OPA_ALRGN_CD = 'Penicillin' ) SELECT * FROM ALLERGIES

prompt: Provide a list of patients with lung mesothelioma treated with SBRT.
completion: WITH DX AS (SELECT DISTINCT TM_MRN AS DX_MRN , TM_DX_DTE AS DX_DT , TM_SITE_CD AS "SITE CODE" , TM_HIST_CD AS "HIST CODE" FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR WHERE TM_DX_DTE <= '2022-03-15' AND TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND TM_HIST_CD IN ('M9050/0', 'M9050/3', 'M9050/6', 'M9051/0', 'M9051/3', 'M9051/6', 'M9052/0', 'M9052/3', 'M9052/6', 'M9053/0', 'M9053/3', 'M9053/6', 'M9054/0', 'M9055/1') UNION SELECT DISTINCT CC_MRN AS DX_MRN , MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS DX_DT , CC_CLSF_CD AS "SITE CODE" , '' AS "HIST CODE" FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND ((CC_PT_TYPE = 'I') OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) AND CC_CLSF_CD IN ('C45.0', 'C45.1', 'C45.2', 'C45.7', 'C45.9') GROUP BY CC_MRN, CC_CLSF_CD, '' HAVING MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) <= '2022-03-15') SELECT DISTINCT Y.DX_MRN , PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH AS "DATE OF BIRTH" , TRIM(B.AV_DESC) AS "RACE" , TRIM(A.AV_DESC) AS "SEX" , PT_DATE_OF_DEATH AS "DATE OF DEATH" , "SITE CODE" AS "PRIMARY CANCER SITE" , "HIST CODE" AS "TUMOR HISTOLOGY" , RTC_TX_COURSE_ID "COURSE ID" , RTC_TX_PLAN_NAME "PLAN NAME" , RTC_TX_PLANNED_FRACTIONS "PLANNED FRACTION" , RTC_TX_DELIVERED_FRACTIONS "DELIVERED FRACTION" , RTC_TX_PLANNED_DOSE "PLANNED DOSE" , RTC_TX_DELIVERED_DOSE "DELIVERED DOSE" , MIN (X.SVC_DTE) AS "START DATE" , MAX(X.SVC_DTE) AS "STOP DATE" FROM IDB.RADIATION_CHARGES_V X JOIN DX Y ON Y.DX_MRN = X.MRN AND (X.SVC_DESC LIKE ('SBRT%') OR RAD_TYPE = 'STEREOTACTIC') JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON X.MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.RADONC_TREATMENT_COURSE ON RTC_TX_MRN = X.MRN AND X.SVC_DTE BETWEEN RTC_TX_START_DTE AND RTC_TX_STOP_DTE AND (RTC_TX_PLANNED_FRACTIONS BETWEEN 1 AND 5 OR RTC_TX_DELIVERED_FRACTIONS BETWEEN 1 AND 5) AND (RTC_TX_PLANNED_DOSE BETWEEN 3000 AND 7000 OR RTC_TX_DELIVERED_DOSE BETWEEN 3000 AND 7000) LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS A ON A.AV_CODE = PT_SEX AND A.AV_ELEMENT = 'SEX' LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS B ON B.AV_CODE = PT_RACE AND B.AV_ELEMENT = 'RACE' WHERE RTC_TX_PLAN_NAME LIKE '%LUNG%' GROUP BY DX_MRN , PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH , TRIM(B.AV_DESC) , TRIM(A.AV_DESC) , "SITE CODE" , "HIST CODE" , PT_DATE_OF_DEATH , RTC_TX_COURSE_ID , RTC_TX_PLAN_NAME , RTC_TX_PLANNED_FRACTIONS , RTC_TX_DELIVERED_FRACTIONS , RTC_TX_PLANNED_DOSE , RTC_TX_DELIVERED_DOSE

prompt: Provide a list of prostate cancer patients consented to 12-245, who have received IMPACT testing, and have been treated with any of the specified drugs.
completion: WITH DX_1 AS (SELECT TM_MRN AS MRN, TM_DX_DTE AS DX_DATE, TM_SITE_CD AS DX_CODE, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS DX_DESC, TM_HIST_CD AS HIST_CODE, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS HIST_DESC FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM H ON TM_HIST_CD = H.CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON TM_SITE_CD = S.CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.ACCRUALS ON TM_MRN = AC_MRN AND AC_IRB_NO = '12-245' WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND TM_SITE_CD = 'C619' UNION SELECT CC_MRN AS MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS DX_DATE, CLM_CLSF_CD AS DX_CODE, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS DX_DESC, '' AS HIST_CODE, '' AS HIST_DESC FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.ACCRUALS ON CC_MRN = AC_MRN AND AC_IRB_NO = '12-245' WHERE CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND ((CC_PT_TYPE = 'I') OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) AND CC_CLSF_CD IN ('C61', '185') GROUP BY CC_MRN, CLM_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK ) , DX AS (SELECT MRN, LISTAGG(COALESCE(STRIP(CAST(DX_DATE AS VARCHAR(12000))), '') || ' | ' || COALESCE(STRIP(DX_CODE), '') || ' - ' || COALESCE(STRIP(CAST(DX_DESC AS VARCHAR(12000))), '') || ' | ' || COALESCE(STRIP(HIST_CODE), '') || ' - ' || COALESCE(STRIP(CAST(HIST_DESC AS VARCHAR(12000))), '') , CHR(13) || CHR(10)) WITHIN GROUP( ORDER BY MRN, DX_DATE, DX_CODE) AS DX_CODE FROM DX_1 GROUP BY MRN) , IO_1 AS (SELECT APR_MRN, APR_GENERIC_NAME, APR_DRUG_NAME, MIN(APR_START_DTE) AS START_DATE, MAX(APR_END_DTE) AS END_DATE FROM IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX_V V1 JOIN IDB.CHEMO_DRUG_GENERIC V2 ON APR_GENERIC_NAME = CDG_GENERIC_NAME WHERE APR_MRN IN (SELECT MRN FROM DX) AND(CDG_IMMUNOTHERAPY_FLAG = 'Y' OR(UPPER(APR_GENERIC_NAME) LIKE '%TREMELIMUMAB%' OR UPPER(APR_DRUG_NAME) LIKE '%TREMELIMUMAB%' OR UPPER(APR_GENERIC_NAME) LIKE '%EMACTUZUMAB%' OR UPPER(APR_DRUG_NAME) LIKE '%EMACTUZUMAB%' OR UPPER(APR_GENERIC_NAME) LIKE '%TALAZOPARIB%' OR UPPER(APR_DRUG_NAME) LIKE '%TALAZOPARIB%' OR UPPER(APR_GENERIC_NAME) LIKE '%TALZENNA%' OR UPPER(APR_DRUG_NAME) LIKE '%TALZENNA' OR UPPER(APR_GENERIC_NAME) LIKE '%VEMURAFENIB%' OR UPPER(APR_DRUG_NAME) LIKE '%VEMURAFENIB%' OR UPPER(APR_GENERIC_NAME) LIKE '%ZELBORAF%' OR UPPER(APR_DRUG_NAME) LIKE '%ZELBORAF%' OR UPPER(APR_GENERIC_NAME) LIKE '%MK%4166%' OR UPPER(APR_DRUG_NAME) LIKE '%MK%4166%' OR UPPER(APR_GENERIC_NAME) LIKE '%LY3321367%' OR UPPER(APR_DRUG_NAME) LIKE '%LY3321367%' OR UPPER(APR_GENERIC_NAME) LIKE '%BMS%986249%' OR UPPER(APR_DRUG_NAME) LIKE '%BMS%986249%' OR UPPER(APR_GENERIC_NAME) LIKE '%CX%072%' OR UPPER(APR_DRUG_NAME) LIKE '%CX%072%' OR UPPER(APR_GENERIC_NAME) LIKE '%TTX%030%' OR UPPER(APR_DRUG_NAME) LIKE '%TTX%030%' OR UPPER(APR_GENERIC_NAME) LIKE '%AM0010%' OR UPPER(APR_DRUG_NAME) LIKE '%AM0010%')) GROUP BY APR_MRN, APR_GENERIC_NAME, APR_DRUG_NAME ) , IO AS (SELECT APR_MRN, LISTAGG(COALESCE(STRIP(APR_GENERIC_NAME), '') || ' | ' || COALESCE(STRIP(CAST(START_DATE AS VARCHAR(12000))), '') || ' | ' || COALESCE(STRIP(CAST(END_DATE AS VARCHAR(12000))), '') , CHR(13) || CHR(10)) WITHIN GROUP( ORDER BY APR_MRN, START_DATE, END_DATE, APR_GENERIC_NAME) AS IMMUNOTHERAPY FROM IO_1 GROUP BY APR_MRN) , IMPACT_1 AS (SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN, PDRX_DMP_PATIENT_ID, PDWS_NAME, PDWS_DESCRIPTION, T.* FROM DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML DT ON PDRX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML_SETTINGS ON PDRX_PATH_DMP_RESULTS_XML_ID = PDRXS_PATH_DMP_RESULTS_XML_ID JOIN DVDMC.PATHOLOGY_DMP_WEBSVC_SETTINGS ON PDRXS_SETTING_ID = PDWS_SETTING_ID CROSS JOIN XMLTABLE('$c/root/*' PASSING DT.PDRX_XML_VALUE AS "c" COLUMNS TUMOR_TYPE_NAME VARCHAR(264) PATH '../meta-data/tumor_type_name', PRIMARY_SITE VARCHAR(100) PATH '../meta-data/primary_site') T WHERE 1=1 AND PDWS_NAME like '%IMPACT%' AND PT_MRN IN () ) , IMPACT AS (SELECT PT_MRN AS IMPACT_MRN, PDRX_DMP_PATIENT_ID AS DMP_ID, LISTAGG(STRIP(TUMOR_TYPE_NAME) || ' | ' || STRIP(PRIMARY_SITE) , CHR(13) || CHR(10)) WITHIN GROUP( ORDER BY PT_MRN, TUMOR_TYPE_NAME, PRIMARY_SITE) AS TUMOR_TYPE_IMPACT FROM IMPACT_1 GROUP BY PT_MRN, PDRX_DMP_PATIENT_ID) SELECT DISTINCT DX.MRN, STRIP(PT_LAST_NAME) || ', ' || STRIP(PT_FIRST_NAME) AS NAME, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH AS DOB, DX_CODE, DMP_ID, TUMOR_TYPE_IMPACT, IMMUNOTHERAPY FROM DX JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IO ON MRN = APR_MRN JOIN IMPACT ON MRN = IMPACT_MRN

prompt: Provide data on patients diagnosed with ICD9 189 or 189.0 who have been treated with Nivolumab or Ipilimumab.
completion: WITH "cte1" AS (SELECT DXCC_DX_CATALOG_ID, LTRIM(RTRIM(DXCC_ICD_CODE)) DXCC_ICD_CODE, LTRIM(RTRIM(DXCC_ICD_MSK_DESC)) DXCC_ICD_MSK_DESC, LTRIM(RTRIM(DXCC_ICD_CODE)) || ' - ' || LTRIM(RTRIM(DXCC_ICD_MSK_DESC)) AS DXCC_CODE_AND_MSK_DESC, LTRIM(RTRIM(DXCC_ICD_NATIONAL_DESC)) DXCC_ICD_NATIONAL_DESC, DXCC_DESC_LONG, CASE WHEN DXCC_ICD_CODE BETWEEN '196' AND '196.99' OR DXCC_ICD_CODE BETWEEN '197' AND '197.99' OR DXCC_ICD_CODE BETWEEN '198' AND '198.99' THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS DXCC_METS_INDICATOR, DXCC_CREATED_DT, DXCC_CREATED_BY, DXCC_MODIFIED_DT FROM DV.DIAGNOSIS_CATALOG WHERE DXCC_DX_TYPE = 'ICD9' ) SELECT DISTINCT "t1"."PT_MRN" AS "MRN", "t2"."DXCC_ICD_CODE" AS "ICD-9 Final Dx Code", "t2"."DXCC_ICD_MSK_DESC" AS "ICD-9 Final Dx Description", "t3"."PINC_ITEM_NAME" AS "Drug Name", "t1"."PT_BIRTH_DTE" AS "Date of Birth", "t1"."PT_DEATH_DTE" AS "Deceased Date", "t4"."DILK_DEATH_IND_DESC" AS "Death Info Source", "t1"."PT_VITAL_STATUS" AS "Vital Status", "t5"."DT_DTE" AS "Dispense Date" FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V" "t1" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED" "t6" ON "t1"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t6"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DIAGNOSIS_FINAL_ALL_V" "t7" ON "t6"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t7"."PDX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "cte1" "t2" ON "t7"."PDX_DX_CATALOG_ID" = "t2"."DXCC_DX_CATALOG_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PHM_PT_MEDS_MQT" "t8" ON "t6"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t8"."POD_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PHM_ORDER_DTL" "t9" ON "t8"."POD_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t9"."POD_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AND "t8"."POD_PHARMA_INVENTORY_CTLG_ID" = "t9"."POD_PHARMA_INVENTORY_CTLG_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PHM_INVENTORY_CATALOG" "t3" ON "t9"."POD_PHARMA_INVENTORY_CTLG_ID" = "t3"."PINC_INVENTORY_CTLG_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PHM_ORDER_DISPENSE_OCCR" "t10" ON "t9"."POD_PHARMA_ORDER_DETAIL_ID" = "t10"."PDO_PHARMA_ORDER_DETAIL_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" "t5" ON "t10"."PDO_DISPNS_DATE_ID" = "t5"."DT_DATE_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DEATH_INDICATOR_LOOKUP_V" "t4" ON "t1"."PT_DEATH_IND" = "t4"."DILK_DEATH_IND_CD" WHERE ("t2"."DXCC_ICD_CODE" IN ('189', '189.0') AND (UPPER("t3"."PINC_ITEM_NAME") IN ('BMS-936558 (NIVOLUMAB) INV, 100 MG', 'NIVOLUMAB (BMS-936558) OR PLACEBO INV, 100 MG', 'NIVOLUMAB (BMS-936558) OR PLACEBO INV, BLIND DOSE') OR (UPPER("t3"."PINC_ITEM_NAME") IN ('BMS-936558 (MDX-1106) BLIND DOSE INV') OR (UPPER("t3"."PINC_ITEM_NAME") IN ('IPILIMUMAB', 'IPILIMUMAB (BMS-734016) BLIND DOSE INV, 1 DOSE', 'IPILIMUMAB (BMS-734016) INV, 200 MG', 'IPILIMUMAB (BMS-734016) INV, 50 MG', 'IPILIMUMAB (BMS-734016) OR PLACEBO INV, 200 MG', 'IPILIMUMAB (BMS-734016) OR PLACEBO INV, 50 MG', 'MDX-010 (IPILIMUMAB) INV, 200 MG', 'MDX-010 (IPILIMUMAB) INV, 25 MG', 'MDX-010 (IPILIMUMAB) INV, 50 MG', 'MDX-010 (IPILIMUMAB) INV, BLIND DOSE', 'MDX-010 (IPILIMUMAB) PROCESS B INV, 200 MG', 'MDX-010 (IPILIMUMAB) PROCESS C INV, 200 MG') OR UPPER("t3"."PINC_ITEM_NAME") IN ('MDX-010 OR PLACEBO INV, 25 MG')))))

prompt: Determine the number of pediatric patients with cancer diagnoses during a given time period, the number pediatric patients meeting given criteria, and the number of OR visits by those patients.
completion: SELECT SUM(T.LUK) AS LUK_SUM, SUM(T.BC) AS BC_SUM, 0 AS ST_SUM, DX_YEAR FROM (SELECT DISTINCT CLSF.CLSF_MRN PT_MRN, SSE_LOG_ID, YEAR(SSE_SURG_DTE) DX_YEAR, CASE WHEN LOCATE(LTRIM(RTRIM(CLSF.CLSF_CLSF_CD)), '204,204.0,204.00,204.01') > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END LUK, CASE WHEN LOCATE(LTRIM(RTRIM(CLSF.CLSF_CLSF_CD)), '191,191.0,191.1,191.2,191.3,191.4,191.5,191.6,191.7,191.8,191.9,192.1,198.3,225.0,225.2') > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END BC, CASE WHEN LOCATE(LTRIM(RTRIM(CLSF.CLSF_CLSF_CD)), '204,204.0,204.00,204.01') = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ST FROM IDB.CLSF CLSF INNER JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT ON CLSF_MRN = SSE_MRN WHERE (CLSF_ACCT_NO like '00%' OR CLSF_ACCT_NO like '84%' OR CLSF_CIC_CDER_INIT <> '') AND CLSF_CLSF_TYPE like 'DF%' AND (CLSF.CLSF_CLSF_CD IN ('204', '204.0', '204.00', '204.01') OR CLSF.CLSF_CLSF_CD IN ('191', '191.0', '191.1', '191.2', '191.3', '191.4', '191.5', '191.6', '191.7', '191.8', '191.9', '192.1', '198.3', '225.0', '225.2') OR CLSF.CLSF_CLSF_CD BETWEEN '140' AND '199.999' OR CLSF.CLSF_CLSF_CD BETWEEN '210' AND '227.999' OR CLSF.CLSF_CLSF_CD BETWEEN '229' AND '229.999') AND YEAR(CLSF_EFF_DATE) BETWEEN 2007 AND 2008 AND YEAR(SSE_SURG_DTE) BETWEEN 2007 AND 2008 ) T INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT P.PT_MRN AS MRN FROM IDB.PATIENT P INNER JOIN IDB.CASE C ON P.PT_MRN = C.CS_MRN WHERE CS_HOSP_SVC IN ('PED', 'PDP', 'PDC') GROUP BY P.PT_MRN, P.PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH HAVING YEAR(MIN(C.CS_ADM_DATE) - P.PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) < 21 UNION SELECT DISTINCT A.PA_MRN AS MRN FROM IDB.ACCOUNT A WHERE PA_RESP_BL_CD IN ('C', 'S', 'V') UNION SELECT DISTINCT DTL_MRN AS MRN FROM IDB.PA_DTL WHERE DTL_SVC_CD like '77%' UNION SELECT DISTINCT PBI_MRN AS MRN FROM IDB.PBD_INVOICE WHERE PBI_BILLING_AREA IN ('505735', '517714') UNION SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN AS MRN FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER INNER JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID WHERE CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 IN ('PED', 'PDH', 'BMTPED') AND CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') ) X ON PT_MRN = MRN GROUP BY DX_YEAR SELECT SUM(TOTAL) AS TOTAL, DX_YEAR FROM (SELECT DISTINCT CLSF.CLSF_MRN PT_MRN, YEAR(CLSF_EFF_DATE) DX_YEAR , 1 TOTAL FROM IDB.CLSF CLSF WHERE (CLSF_ACCT_NO like '00%' OR CLSF_ACCT_NO like '84%' OR CLSF_CIC_CDER_INIT <> '') AND CLSF_CLSF_TYPE like 'DF%' AND CLSF.CLSF_CLSF_CD BETWEEN '140' AND '239.99' AND YEAR(CLSF_EFF_DATE) BETWEEN 2007 AND 2008 ) T INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT P.PT_MRN AS MRN FROM IDB.PATIENT P INNER JOIN IDB.CASE C ON P.PT_MRN = C.CS_MRN WHERE CS_HOSP_SVC IN ('PED', 'PDP', 'PDC') GROUP BY P.PT_MRN, P.PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH HAVING YEAR(MIN(C.CS_ADM_DATE) - P.PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) < 21 UNION SELECT DISTINCT A.PA_MRN AS MRN FROM IDB.ACCOUNT A WHERE PA_RESP_BL_CD IN ('C', 'S', 'V') UNION SELECT DISTINCT DTL_MRN AS MRN FROM IDB.PA_DTL WHERE DTL_SVC_CD like '77%' UNION SELECT DISTINCT PBI_MRN AS MRN FROM IDB.PBD_INVOICE WHERE PBI_BILLING_AREA IN ('505735', '517714') UNION SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN AS MRN FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER INNER JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID WHERE CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 IN ('PED', 'PDH', 'BMTPED') AND CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') ) X ON PT_MRN = MRN GROUP BY DX_YEAR

prompt: AMB15059 - PA CHARGES FOR 67, 68 DEPT CURR MON THIS YR VS prior MON THIS YR is run for a group of us in Am Care, PA and HIM on a monthly basis.  We often need to look at information at the patient level, so we thought it might be helpful to have this information in a tableau dashboard as opposed in addition to the static report.
completion: SELECT TRIM(A.RVCD_MRN) AS "MRN", TRIM(A.DEPARTMENT_MNEMONIC) AS "Department", TRIM(A.DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS "Department Name", TRIM(A.PERF_SITE_MNEMONIC) AS "Performing Site Mnemonic", TRIM(A.PERF_SITE_NAME) AS "Performing Site Name", TRIM(A.PROV_PHYSICIAN_NAME) AS "Physician", A.RVCD_PROV_PHYSICIAN_REC_NO "Physician No", A.RVCD_SVC_DTE AS "DOS", A.RVCD_FILE_DTE AS "File Date", A.RVCD_POST_DTE AS "Post Date", TRIM(A.RCDD_SMS_LEGACY_CD) "SMS Legacy Code", TRIM(CHARGE_CD) AS "Service Code", TRIM(CHARGE_DESCRIPTION) AS "Service Code Description", TRIM(HCPCS_CODE) AS "HCPCS Code", A.RVCD_AMT AS "AMT", A.RVCD_UNITS AS "QTY" FROM IDB.RMS_VISIT_CHARGE_DTL_V A JOIN IDB.RMS_VISIT_CHARGE_DTL B ON A.RVCD_VISIT_ID = B.RVCD_VISIT_ID AND A.RVCD_BATCH_NUMBER = B.RVCD_BATCH_NUMBER AND A.RVCD_LINE_NO = B.RVCD_LINE_NO LEFT JOIN IDB.VISIT ON B.RVCD_VISIT_ID = VIS_VISIT_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.RMS_VISIT ON B.RVCD_VISIT_ID = RV_VISIT_ID WHERE 1=1 AND A.RVCD_SVC_DTE >= '2018-03-01' AND A.RVCD_SVC_DTE < (DATE('0001-01-01') + YEAR(CURRENT date) YEARS - 1 YEAR + MONTH(CURRENT date) MONTHS - 2 MONTHS)

prompt: Update NRS22908 to a daily report of PET procedure patients who present with a blood glucose of >=200 or <70 the previous week, the previous month and for upcoming appointments.
completion: WITH X_TMP AS (SELECT DISTINCT STRIP(CPE_MRN) AS MRN, CPE_ENC_CSN_ID, CPE_RIS_EXTERNAL_ORD_ID, CPE_CPE_IP_IND, CPE_ENC_DTE AS "Appt Date", TIME(CPE_APPT_DT) AS "Appt Time", STRIP(CPE_CPE_APPT_STS) AS "Appt Status", STRIP(CPE_CPE_CANCEL_RSN) AS "Cancel Reason", STRIP(CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME) AS "Visit Type", STRIP(CRE_RES_NAME) AS CRE_RES_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CPE_MRN, CPE_ENC_DTE ORDER BY CPE_CPE_APPT_STS DESC) AS APPT_RN FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE 1=1 AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN '2020-10-01' AND '2021-03-31' AND CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME like '%FDG%' AND CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Can', 'Comp') ) , X AS (SELECT X_TMP.* FROM X_TMP LEFT JOIN IDB.VISIT_V ON MRN = VIS_MRN AND "Appt Date" BETWEEN VIS_ADM_DTE AND COALESCE(VIS_DSCH_DTE, CURRENT date) AND VIS_IP_OP_ADJUSTED_IND = 'I' WHERE VIS_MRN IS NULL ) , GL AS (SELECT DISTINCT STRIP(LR_MRN) AS MRN, CPE_ENC_CSN_ID, LR_PERFORMED_DTE AS PERFORMED_DTE, TIME(LR_PERFORMED_DT) AS PERFORMED_TIME, STRIP(LR_TEST_NAME) AS TEST_NAME, STRIP(LR_SUBTEST_NAME) AS SUBTEST_NAME, STRIP(LR_RESULT_VALUE) AS RESULT_VALUE, STRIP(LR_UNIT_MEASURE) AS UNIT_MEASURE FROM X JOIN IDB.LAB_RESULTS ON LR_MRN = MRN AND LR_PERFORMED_DTE = "Appt Date" LEFT JOIN IDB.LAB_TEXT_LINE ON LTL_RESULT_GUID = LR_RESULT_GUID WHERE UPPER(LR_SUBTEST_NAME) LIKE '%GLUCOSE%BEDSIDE%' AND UPPER(LR_SUBTEST_NAME) NOT LIKE '%URINE%' AND LR_RESULT_VALUE <> '' AND LR_RESULT_VALUE NOT IN ('Normal', 'Indeterminate') AND LR_RESULT_VALUE NOT LIKE '%<%' AND LR_RESULT_VALUE NOT LIKE '%>%' UNION SELECT DISTINCT STRIP(LR_MRN) AS MRN, CPE_ENC_CSN_ID, LR_PERFORMED_DTE AS PERFORMED_DTE, TIME(LR_PERFORMED_DT) AS PERFORMED_TIME, STRIP(LR_TEST_NAME) AS TEST_NAME, STRIP(LR_SUBTEST_NAME) AS SUBTEST_NAME, STRIP(LR_RESULT_VALUE) AS RESULT_VALUE, STRIP(LR_UNIT_MEASURE) AS UNIT_MEASURE FROM X JOIN IDB.LAB_RESULTS ON LR_MRN = MRN AND LR_PERFORMED_DTE = "Appt Date" LEFT JOIN IDB.LAB_TEXT_LINE ON LTL_RESULT_GUID = LR_RESULT_GUID WHERE UPPER(LR_SUBTEST_NAME) LIKE '%GLUCOSE%BEDSIDE%' AND UPPER(LR_SUBTEST_NAME) NOT LIKE '%URINE%' AND(LR_RESULT_VALUE LIKE '%<%' OR LR_RESULT_VALUE LIKE '%>%') ) , Y_TMP AS (SELECT X.*, PERFORMED_DTE, PERFORMED_TIME, TEST_NAME, SUBTEST_NAME, RESULT_VALUE, UNIT_MEASURE FROM X JOIN GL ON X.MRN = GL.MRN AND X.CPE_ENC_CSN_ID = GL.CPE_ENC_CSN_ID AND PERFORMED_DTE = "Appt Date" WHERE 1=1 AND(RESULT_VALUE like '%<%' OR RESULT_VALUE like '%>%') UNION SELECT X.*, PERFORMED_DTE, PERFORMED_TIME, TEST_NAME, SUBTEST_NAME, RESULT_VALUE, UNIT_MEASURE FROM X JOIN GL ON X.MRN = GL.MRN AND X.CPE_ENC_CSN_ID = GL.CPE_ENC_CSN_ID AND PERFORMED_DTE = "Appt Date" WHERE 1=1 AND NOT(RESULT_VALUE like '%<%' OR RESULT_VALUE like '%>%') AND NOT RESULT_VALUE BETWEEN 70 AND 200 ) , Y AS (SELECT Y_TMP.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CPE_ENC_CSN_ID ORDER BY PERFORMED_DTE, PERFORMED_TIME) AS RN FROM Y_TMP) , Z1 AS (SELECT MRN, CPE_ENC_CSN_ID, PERFORMED_TIME, TEST_NAME, SUBTEST_NAME, RESULT_VALUE, UNIT_MEASURE FROM Y WHERE RN = 1 ) , Z2 AS (SELECT MRN, CPE_ENC_CSN_ID, PERFORMED_TIME, TEST_NAME, SUBTEST_NAME, RESULT_VALUE, UNIT_MEASURE FROM Y WHERE RN = 2 ) , Z3 AS (SELECT MRN, CPE_ENC_CSN_ID, LISTAGG(COALESCE(STRIP(PERFORMED_TIME), '') || ' | ' || COALESCE(STRIP(CAST(RESULT_VALUE AS VARCHAR(12000))), '') || ' | ' || COALESCE(STRIP(CAST(UNIT_MEASURE AS VARCHAR(12000))), '') , CHR(13) || CHR(10)) WITHIN GROUP( ORDER BY MRN, CPE_ENC_CSN_ID, PERFORMED_TIME) AS GLUCOSE_VALUES_OTHER FROM Y WHERE RN >= 3 GROUP BY MRN, CPE_ENC_CSN_ID) SELECT DISTINCT Y.MRN, Y.CPE_ENC_CSN_ID, CPE_RIS_EXTERNAL_ORD_ID, CPE_CPE_IP_IND, "Appt Date", "Appt Time", "Appt Status", "Cancel Reason", "Visit Type", CRE_RES_NAME, Z1.PERFORMED_TIME AS FIRST_GLUCOSE_TIME, Z1.RESULT_VALUE AS FIRST_GLUCOSE_VALUE, Z1.UNIT_MEASURE AS FIRST_GLUCOSE_UNIT, Z2.PERFORMED_TIME AS SECOND_GLUCOSE_TIME, Z2.RESULT_VALUE AS SECOND_GLUCOSE_VALUE, Z2.UNIT_MEASURE AS SECOND_GLUCOSE_UNIT, GLUCOSE_VALUES_OTHER FROM Y LEFT JOIN Z1 ON Y.CPE_ENC_CSN_ID = Z1.CPE_ENC_CSN_ID LEFT JOIN Z2 ON Y.CPE_ENC_CSN_ID = Z2.CPE_ENC_CSN_ID LEFT JOIN Z3 ON Y.CPE_ENC_CSN_ID = Z3.CPE_ENC_CSN_ID WHERE APPT_RN = 1

prompt: Provide a daily list of adolescent and young adult patients (AYA), aged 15-39 years old, seen on the hematologic services at MSK.
completion: SELECT CPE_MRN AS "MRN", CL_LAST_NAME "Last Name", CL_FIRST_NAME "First Name", YEAR(DATE(CURRENT date)-CL_DATE_OF_BIRTH) AS AGE, CPE_ENC_DTE AS "Appt Date", CAST(CPE_APPT_DT AS TIME) AS "Appt Time", CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 AS "Department", D.CAV_TITLE AS "Department Desc", CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 AS "Service", S.CAV_TITLE AS "Service Desc", CLD_DEPT_NAME AS "Department Name", CRE_RES_NAME AS "Provider Name", CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR, CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME AS "Visit Type", CLE_NAME "Appt Entered By", DX.TM_DX_DTE AS "Diagnosis Date", DX.TM_SITE_CD AS "Diagnosis Site Code", DX.SITE_DESC AS "Diagnosis Site Desc", DX.TM_BEST_AJCC_STG AS "Diagnosis Stage" FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_PATIENT ON CL_PRK = CPE_PRK JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_USER ON CPE_ENTER_USER_ID = CLE_USER_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_CATEGORY D ON D.CAV_CATEGORY = 'CLD_RPT_GRP_6' AND D.CAV_ABBR = CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_CATEGORY S ON S.CAV_CATEGORY = 'CLD_RPT_GRP_8' AND S.CAV_ABBR = CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 LEFT JOIN (SELECT TM_MRN, TM_DX_DTE, TM_SITE_CD, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_DESC, TM_BEST_AJCC_STG FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS ON AV_ELEMENT = 'CASE_STS' AND AV_CODE = TM_CASE_STS WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8')) DX ON TM_MRN = CPE_MRN WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Sch', 'Arrived', 'Comp') AND CPE_ENC_DTE >= CURRENT date - 14 DAY AND YEAR(DATE(CURRENT date)-CL_DATE_OF_BIRTH) BETWEEN 15 AND 39 AND S.CAV_TITLE IN ('LYMPHOMA', 'HEMATOLOGY', 'LEUKEMIA', 'MYELOMA', 'BONE MARROW TRANSPLANT') ;

prompt: Provide order information, requesting MD name,  and  indication of EMR document 'Chemotherapy procedure note and admin record'  for chemotherapy orders with route of intrathecal or intrapleural  from January to March 2012.
completion: SELECT OO_MRN, OO_ACCT_NO, OO_ENTER_DTE, OCV_CURR_LOC, OCV_PVDR_NAME PVDR_NAME, OO_ORD_NAME, OO_ORD_ID, OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE, OU_DISPLAY_NAME AS REQ_BY , EPD_DOCTYPE, EMD_EMR_DESC DOC_NAME, EPD_DOC_DTE FROM IDB.OMS_ORDER JOIN IDB.OMS_CLIENT_VISIT ON OO_VISIT_GUID = OCV_VISIT_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_USER ON OO_PVDR_GUID = OU_USER_GUID LEFT JOIN IDB.EMR_PT_DOCUMENT ON EPD_MRN = OO_MRN AND EPD_DOCTYPE = 'F70' AND EPD_DOC_DTE = OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE LEFT JOIN IDB.EMR_PT_DOCTYPE ON EMD_DOCTYPE = EPD_DOCTYPE WHERE OO_ORD_TYPE_CD = 'Medication' AND OO_ORD_STS_CD NOT LIKE 'CA%' AND OO_ENTER_DTE BETWEEN '2012-01-01' AND '2012-03-31' AND (UPPER(OO_SUMMARY_LINE) like '%INTRATHECAL%' OR UPPER(OO_SUMMARY_LINE) likE '%INTRAPLEURAL%')

prompt: Create a report listing patients who have received at least 24 doses of Pamidronate and/or Zoledronic Acid.
completion: SELECT MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, SUM(DOSE_COUNT) AS DOSE_COUNT, MIN(START_DATE) AS MIN_START_DATE, MAX(STOP_DATE) AS MAX_STOP_DATE FROM (SELECT CM_MRN AS MRN, COUNT(*) AS DOSE_COUNT, MIN(CM_OCC_STRT_DTE) AS START_DATE, MAX(CM_OCC_STRT_DTE) AS STOP_DATE FROM IDB.CHEMO WHERE CM_SVM_DESC IN ('PAMIDRONATE', 'ZOLEDRONATE', 'ZOLEDRONIC ACID') GROUP BY CM_MRN UNION ALL SELECT PO_MRN AS MRN, POI_NET_PT_DOSE AS DOSE_COUNT, POD_STRT_DTE AS START_DATE, POD_STOP_DTE AS STOP_DATE FROM IDB.PHM_ORDER JOIN IDB.PHM_ORD_DTL ON PO_ORD_SEQ = POD_ORD_SEQ JOIN IDB.PHM_ORD_INV ON POD_ORD_SEQ = POI_ORD_SEQ AND POD_ITEM_NO = POI_ITEM_NO JOIN IDB.PHM_INVENTORY ON POI_INV_SEQ = PIN_INV_SEQ WHERE PO_ORD_STS NOT IN ('X', 'P') AND PIN_GENERIC_NAME IN ('Pamidronate Disodium', 'Zoledronic Acid') ) AS RX JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON MRN = PT_MRN GROUP BY MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME HAVING SUM(DOSE_COUNT) >= 24

prompt: Provide a list of all orders and frequency entered for patients with active visits with Dr Sergio Giralt.
completion: SELECT OO_MRN, STRIP(PT_LAST_NAME)||', '||STRIP(PT_FIRST_NAME) AS PT_NAME , OO_ENTER_DTE , OO_ORD_NAME, OO_SET_NAME , OO_ORD_MODIFIER, OO_ORD_TYPE_CD , OOC_REV_CAT_DEPT , OP_DISPLAY_NAME AS REQUESTED_BY FROM IDB.OMS_ORDER JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_CATALOG ON OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID = OOC_MSTR_ITEM_GUID JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON OO_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.OMS_PROVIDER ON OO_PVDR_GUID = OP_PVDR_GUID WHERE OO_PVDR_GUID = '9000014312201190' AND OO_ENTER_DTE >= '2011-01-01' AND OO_ORD_STS_CD NOT LIKE 'CA%'

prompt: Patients seen at KOCH scheduled with visit type ID 3550
completion: SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN AS MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH AS DOB, A.CLD_DEPT_NAME AS DEPARTMENT, A.CLD_CLD_CENTER AS SITE, B.CRE_RES_NAME AS PROVIDER, B.CRE_RES_ID AS PROVIDER_ID, CPE_ENC_DTE AS APPT_DATE, TIME(CPE_APPT_DT) AS APPT_TIME, CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME AS VT_NAME, CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID AS VT_ID, D.CRE_RES_NAME AS REF_MD, C.CLD_DEPT_NAME AS REF_DEPT, CLE_NAME AS SCHEDULER, CPAN_NOTE AS NOTES, CPAN_LINE_NO AS LINE_NO, CPE_ENC_CSN_ID AS CSN FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT A ON CPE_DEPT_ID = A.CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE B ON B.CRE_RES_ID = CPE_VST_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON CPE_MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT C ON C.CLD_DEPT_ID = CPE_REF_DEP_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE D ON D.CRE_RES_ID = CPE_REF_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_USER ON CPE_ENTER_USER_ID = CLE_USER_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_PT_APPT_NOTES ON CPAN_CL_PT_ID = CPE_CL_PT_ID AND CPAN_ENC_DTE_SEQ = CPE_ENC_DTE_SEQ WHERE 1=1 AND CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Sch') AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT date AND CURRENT date + 7 DAYS AND CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = 3550 AND A.CLD_CLD_CENTER = 'KOCH'

prompt: List  of  completed outpatient visits on a weekly basis for the  given list of 20 providers.
completion: SELECT CPE_MRN AS "MRN", TRIM(PT_LAST_NAME) || ', ' || TRIM (PT_FIRST_NAME) AS "Patient Name", CPE_APPT_DT AS "Appt Date/Time", CPE_ENC_CSN_ID AS "CSN ID", CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 AS "Department", CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 AS "Service", CLD_DEPT_NAME AS "Department Name", TRIM(CRE_RES_NAME) AS "Provider Name", TRIM(CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME) AS "Visit Type", TRIM(CVT_EXT_NAME) AS "Visit Type External" FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PT_MRN = CPE_MRN WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CRE_RES_TYP IN ('Nurse Practitioner', 'Physician' ) AND CPE_ENC_DTE <= '2024-04-18' AND (CRE_RES_NAME LIKE '%TRAINA%TIFFANY%' OR CRE_RES_NAME LIKE '%TRAINA%TIFFANY%' OR CRE_RES_NAME LIKE '%WILLIAMS%ODESSA%' OR CRE_RES_NAME LIKE '%RAJ%NITYA%' OR CRE_RES_NAME LIKE '%ROSENBERG%JONATHAN%' OR CRE_RES_NAME LIKE '%SHAH%NEIL%' OR CRE_RES_NAME LIKE '%ZELENETZ%ANDREW%' OR CRE_RES_NAME LIKE '%HAMLIN%PAUL%' OR CRE_RES_NAME LIKE '%AVILA%ED%' OR CRE_RES_NAME LIKE '%STONE%JACQUELINE%' OR CRE_RES_NAME LIKE '%SANTOMASSO%BIANCA%' OR CRE_RES_NAME LIKE '%ERRANTE%MIMMA%' OR CRE_RES_NAME LIKE '%GOMEZ%DANIEL%' OR CRE_RES_NAME LIKE '%ROMESSER%PAUL%' OR CRE_RES_NAME LIKE '%BEEGLE%COLLEEN%' OR CRE_RES_NAME LIKE '%ROMAN%BEN%' OR CRE_RES_NAME LIKE '%CRAMER%JENNIFER%' OR CRE_RES_NAME LIKE '%CRACCHIOLO%JENNIFER%' OR CRE_RES_NAME LIKE '%IYENGAR%NEIL%' OR CRE_RES_NAME LIKE '%STEIN%EYTAN%' OR CRE_RES_NAME LIKE '%COHEN%MARC%' ) AND (CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR LIKE '%NV%' OR CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR LIKE '%IR%' OR CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR LIKE '%FX%' OR CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR LIKE '%FU%')

prompt: Cervical Cancer Screening among the African American Community completed by Claudia Ortiz or Maria Sales 2019 - 2022YTD.
completion: SELECT YEAR(OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE) ENCOUNTER_YEAR, COUNT(DISTINCT OO_ORD_GUID) SCREENINGS_COUNT FROM IDB.OMS_ORDER JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_CATALOG ON OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID = OOC_MSTR_ITEM_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_CLIENT_VISIT ON OO_VISIT_GUID = OCV_VISIT_GUID JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PT_MRN = OO_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS R ON R.AV_ELEMENT = 'RACE' AND R.AV_CODE = PT_RACE WHERE OO_ORD_STS_CD NOT IN ('CANP', 'CANC', 'AUC3', 'PEND') AND OOC_ITEM_NAME IN ('Cytology-GYN', 'Cytology-GYN Order') AND YEAR(OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE) BETWEEN 2019 AND 2022 AND OCV_PVDR_NAME IN ('Ortiz, Claudia', 'Sales, Marta') AND R.AV_DESC IN ('BLACK HISPANIC', 'BLACK OR AFRICAN AMERICAN') GROUP BY YEAR(OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE) ORDER BY YEAR(OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE) DESC

prompt: Provide detailed Survivorship Engage survey responses
completion: SELECT DISTINCT EF_MRN FROM IDB.EF_FORM WHERE EF_FORM_NAME like 'Survivorship Patient Self Assessment - %' ; SELECT EF_MRN, EF_FORM_NAME, EF_SUBMISSION_DT, EFI_ITEM_ALIAS, EFI_ITEM_TEXT, EFI_VALUE_ALIAS , EFI_VALUE FROM IDB.EF_FORM LEFT JOIN IDB.EF_FORM_ITEM ON EF_FORM_ID = EFI_FORM_ID WHERE EF_FORM_NAME like 'Survivorship Patient Self Assessment - %' ; WITH PTS AS (SELECT DISTINCT EF_MRN FROM IDB.EF_FORM WHERE EF_FORM_NAME like 'Survivorship Patient Self Assessment - %' ) SELECT SSE_MRN, SSE_SURG_DTE, SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD, SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC, SSP_SURG_LAST_NM, SSP_SURG_FIRST_NM, SSP_SURG_SVC_CD FROM PTS JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT ON EF_MRN = SSE_MRN JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE ON SSE_LOG_ID = SSP_LOG_ID AND SSE_ENC_CSN_ID = SSP_ENC_CSN_ID WHERE (SSE_SURG_LOC not like '%IR%' AND SSE_SURG_LOC not like '%ENDO%' AND SSE_SOURCE_TYPE <> 'E') ; WITH PTS AS (SELECT DISTINCT EF_MRN FROM IDB.EF_FORM WHERE EF_FORM_NAME like 'Survivorship Patient Self Assessment - %' ) SELECT APR_MRN, APR_START_DTE, APR_END_DTE, CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME FROM PTS JOIN IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX_V ON EF_MRN = APR_MRN WHERE CDG_CHEMO_FLAG = 'Y' ; WITH PTS AS (SELECT DISTINCT EF_MRN FROM IDB.EF_FORM WHERE EF_FORM_NAME like 'Survivorship Patient Self Assessment - %' ) SELECT APR_MRN, APR_START_DTE, APR_END_DTE, CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME FROM PTS JOIN IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX_V ON EF_MRN = APR_MRN WHERE CDG_HORMONE_FLAG = 'Y' ; WITH PTS AS (SELECT DISTINCT EF_MRN FROM IDB.EF_FORM WHERE EF_FORM_NAME like 'Survivorship Patient Self Assessment - %' ) SELECT RTC_TX_MRN, RTC_TX_START_DTE, RTC_TX_STOP_DTE, RTC_TX_PLAN_NAME, RTC_TX_DELIVERED_FRACTIONS, RTC_TX_DELIVERED_DOSE FROM PTS JOIN IDB.RADONC_TREATMENT_COURSE ON EF_MRN = RTC_TX_MRN ; WITH PTS AS (SELECT EF_MRN, EF_FORM_NAME, DATE(EF_SUBMISSION_DT) EF_SUBMISSION_DTE FROM IDB.EF_FORM WHERE EF_FORM_NAME like 'Survivorship Patient Self Assessment - %' ) SELECT EF_MRN, EF_FORM_NAME, EF_SUBMISSION_DTE, CPE_ENC_DTE AS "Appt Date", CLD_DEPT_NAME AS "Department Name", CRE_RES_NAME AS "Provider Name", CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME AS "Visit Type" FROM PTS JOIN IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER ON EF_MRN = CPE_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 = 'SVR' AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN EF_SUBMISSION_DTE AND EF_SUBMISSION_DTE + 30 DAYS

prompt: List of patients with stage IA grade 1 endometrioid endometrial cancer with a diagnosis between 1997 and 2008.
completion: WITH "cte1" AS (SELECT TEXTTABLE.*, CONTAINS("PRPT_REPORT", '"FIGO grade 1"') AS "HitCol1" FROM "DV"."PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V" TEXTTABLE) SELECT DISTINCT "t2"."PT_MRN" AS "MRN", "t2"."PT_FIRST_NAME" AS "First Name", "t2"."PT_LAST_NAME" AS "Last Name", "t3"."ICSC_SITE_CD" AS "ICD-O Site Code", "t3"."ICSC_SITE_CD" AS "ICD-O Site Code2", "t3"."ICSC_ICDO_SITE_MSK_DESC" AS "ICD-O Site Desc", "t4"."DXCC_ICD_CODE" AS "ICD-O Histology Code", "t4"."DXCC_ICD_MSK_DESC" AS "ICD-O Histology Desc", "t5"."TCA_CASE_STS_DESC" AS "Case Status", "t5"."TCA_CLASS_OF_CASE" AS "Class of Case", "t6"."TOSA_SEER_SUM_STAGE_DESC" AS "Summary Stage", "t6"."TOSA_MSK_STG_DESC" AS "MSK Stage", "t7"."TCLSA_CLIN_STG_GRP_DESC" AS "Clinical Group", "t8"."TPSA_PATH_STG_GRP_DESC" AS "Path Group", "t9"."TCSA_TM_AJCC_DESC" AS "Collaborative Group", "t10"."CDTM_CDB_SEQ_NO" AS "Tumor Sequence", "t11"."DT_DTE" AS "CDB Tumor Diagnosis Date", "t10"."CDTM_CA_SURG_DTE" AS "CDB Cancer Surgery Date", "t12"."PLA_LAST_RT_DTE" AS "Last MSK Radiation Therapy Dat", "t12"."PLA_LAST_SURG_DTE" AS "Last MSK Surgery Date", "t13"."PRPT_ACCESSION_NO" AS "Path contains FIGO grade 1" FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED" "t1" INNER JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V" "t2" ON "t1"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t2"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."CDB_TUMOR_V" "t10" ON "t1"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t10"."CDTM_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."ICDO_SITE_CATALOG_V" "t3" ON "t10"."CDTM_SITE_CATALOG_ID" = "t3"."ICSC_SITE_CATALOG_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DIAGNOSIS_CODE_CAT_ICDO_V" "t4" ON "t10"."CDTM_DX_CATALOG_ID" = "t4"."DXCC_DX_CATALOG_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."TUMOR_CASE_ATTRIBUTES_V" "t5" ON "t10"."CDTM_CASE_ATTR_ID" = "t5"."TUMOR_CASE_ATTR_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."TUMOR_OTHER_STAGE_ATTRIBUTES_V" "t6" ON "t10"."CDTM_TM_OTHER_STAGE_ATTR_ID" = "t6"."TOSA_TM_OTHER_STAGE_ATTR_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."TUMOR_CLINICAL_STAGE_ATTRIBUTES_V" "t7" ON "t10"."CDTM_CLINICAL_STAGE_ATTR_ID" = "t7"."TCLSA_TM_CLIN_STAGE_ATTR_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."TUMOR_PATH_STAGE_ATTRIBUTES_V" "t8" ON "t10"."CDTM_PATH_STAGE_ATTR_ID" = "t8"."TPSA_TM_PATH_STAGE_ATTR_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."TUMOR_COLLAB_STAGE_ATTRIBUTES_V" "t9" ON "t10"."CDTM_COLLAB_STAGE_ATTR_ID" = "t9"."TCSA_TM_COLLAB_STAGE_ATTR_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" "t11" ON "t10"."CDTM_DX_DATE_ID" = "t11"."DT_DATE_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_LATEST_ACTIVITY" "t12" ON "t1"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t12"."PLA_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT OUTER JOIN "cte1" "t13" ON "t1"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t13"."PRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AND "t13"."HitCol1" <> 0 WHERE ("t3"."ICSC_SITE_CD" IN ('C549', 'C559', 'C541') AND ("t4"."DXCC_ICD_CODE" IN ('M8380/3', prompt: Provide weekly report of appointment data for patients enrolled to protocol 19-198.
completion: WITH SCHED AS (SELECT AC_MRN, CPE_ENC_DTE, CRE_RES_NAME, CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CPE_MRN ORDER BY CPE_ENC_DTE) AS RANK FROM IDB.ACCRUALS JOIN IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER ON CPE_MRN = AC_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE AC_IRB_NO IN ('19-198') AND CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Sch') AND CRE_RES_TYP = 'Physician' ) , NXTMD AS (SELECT CPE_MRN, CPE_ENC_DTE, CRE_RES_NAME, CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CPE_MRN ORDER BY CPE_ENC_DTE) AS RANK FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Sch') AND CRE_RES_TYP = 'Physician' AND CPE_MRN IN (SELECT AC_MRN FROM SCHED) ) , SCAN AS (SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN, CPE_ENC_DTE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CPE_MRN ORDER BY CPE_ENC_DTE) AS RANK FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Sch') AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 IN ('RAD', 'NUC') AND (CRE_RES_NAME like '%MRI %' OR CRE_RES_NAME like '%CT %' OR CRE_RES_NAME like '%PET %') AND CPE_MRN IN (SELECT AC_MRN FROM SCHED) ) SELECT DISTINCT AC_MRN MRN, PT_LAST_NAME FIRST, PT_FIRST_NAME LAST, CHAR(PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) DOB, CHAR(A.CPE_ENC_DTE) NEXT_THR_APPT, CHAR(B.CPE_ENC_DTE) NEXT_MSK_MD_APPT, CHAR(C.CPE_ENC_DTE) NEXT_SCAN_APPT FROM SCHED A JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON AC_MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN NXTMD B ON AC_MRN = B.CPE_MRN AND B.RANK = 1 LEFT JOIN SCAN C ON AC_MRN = C.CPE_MRN AND C.RANK = 1 WHERE A.RANK = 1 UNION SELECT '' MRN, '' FIRST, '' LAST, '' DOB, '' NEXT_THR_APPT, '' NEXT_MSK_MD_APPT, '' NEXT_SCAN_APPT FROM SYSIBM.SYSDUMMY1

prompt: Please provide outpatient clinic metrics for the Kimmel Center visits for the last year.
completion: SELECT CPE_ENC_DTE AS "Appt Date", CPE_APPT_DT "Appt Date/Time", CPE_CPE_APPT_STS "Appt Sts", CPE_CHK_IN_DT "Check In", CPE_CHK_OUT_DT "Check Out", CPE_RM_IN_DT "Room In", CPE_RM_OUT_DT "Room Out", P.CRE_RES_NAME AS "Resource Name", CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 "Dept", CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 "Service", CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME AS "Visit Type" FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE P ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = P.CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE 1=1 AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN '2019-01-01' AND '2019-12-31' AND CLD_CLD_CENTER = '68TH' AND CLD_CLD_PHY_LOC = 'Concourse';

prompt: Patients who received chemotherapy or radiation and have at least 2 Surgical Path Report at MSK for ovarian, liver and pancreatic cancer
completion: WITH PROTOCOL AS (SELECT DISTINCT AC_MRN FROM IDB.ACCRUALS WHERE AC_IRB_NO IN ('12-245', '06-107') AND AC_MRN NOT IN ('ZZZZZZZZ') ) , PATH AS (SELECT PRPT_MRN, COUNT(DISTINCT PRPT_PATH_RPT_ID) CT FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V JOIN PROTOCOL ON PRPT_MRN = AC_MRN WHERE PRPT_REPORT IS NOT NULL AND PRPT_REPORT_DTE BETWEEN '2022-01-01' AND CURRENT DATE AND PRPT_REPORT_TYPE_DESC = 'Surgical Pathology' GROUP BY PRPT_MRN HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT PRPT_PATH_RPT_ID) > 1) , DX AS (SELECT CC_MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS ICD_MIN_DTE, CC_CLSF_CD AS ICD_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS ICD_DESC FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN PATH ON CC_MRN = PRPT_MRN WHERE SUBSTR(CC_CLSF_CD, 1, 3) IN ('C25', 'C56', 'C22') AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND (CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) GROUP BY CC_MRN, CC_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK HAVING MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) BETWEEN '2022-01-01' AND CURRENT DATE) SELECT CC_MRN, PT_SEX, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, PT_DATE_OF_DEATH, ICD_MIN_DTE, CASE WHEN ICD_CD LIKE 'C22%' THEN 'Liver' WHEN ICD_CD LIKE 'C25%' THEN 'Pancreas' WHEN ICD_CD LIKE 'C56%' THEN 'Ovary' END AS SITE, ICD_CD, ICD_DESC, CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME, MIN(APR_START_DTE) MIN_APR_START_DTE, MAX(APR_START_DTE) MAX_APR_START_DTE FROM IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX_V JOIN DX ON APR_MRN = CC_MRN JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON CC_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE APR_START_DTE BETWEEN '2022-01-01' AND CURRENT DATE AND CDG_CHEMO_FLAG = 'Y' AND CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME IN ('NIRAPARIB', 'OLAPARIB', 'YTTRIUM Y-90 MICROSPHERES', 'YTTRIUM Y-90 THERASPHERES', 'CARBOPLATIN', 'CISPLATIN', 'OXALIPLATIN', 'CYCLOPHOSPHAMIDE') GROUP BY CC_MRN, PT_SEX, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, PT_DATE_OF_DEATH, ICD_MIN_DTE, CASE WHEN ICD_CD LIKE 'C22%' THEN 'Liver' WHEN ICD_CD LIKE 'C25%' THEN 'Pancreas' WHEN ICD_CD LIKE 'C56%' THEN 'Ovary' END, ICD_CD, ICD_DESC, CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME ORDER BY CC_MRN, ICD_MIN_DTE, ICD_CD, CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME ; WITH PROTOCOL AS (SELECT DISTINCT AC_MRN FROM IDB.ACCRUALS WHERE AC_IRB_NO IN ('12-245', '06-107') AND AC_MRN NOT IN ('ZZZZZZZZ') ) , PATH AS (SELECT PRPT_MRN, COUNT(DISTINCT PRPT_PATH_RPT_ID) CT FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V JOIN PROTOCOL ON PRPT_MRN = AC_MRN WHERE PRPT_REPORT IS NOT NULL AND PRPT_REPORT_DTE BETWEEN '2022-01-01' AND CURRENT DATE AND PRPT_REPORT_TYPE_DESC = 'Surgical Pathology' GROUP BY PRPT_MRN HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT PRPT_PATH_RPT_ID) > 1) , DX AS (SELECT CC_MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS ICD_MIN_DTE, CC_CLSF_CD AS ICD_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS ICD_DESC FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN PATH ON CC_MRN = PRPT_MRN WHERE SUBSTR(CC_CLSF_CD, 1, 3) IN ('C25', 'C56', 'C22') AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND (CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) GROUP BY CC_MRN, CC_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK HAVING MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) BETWEEN '2022-01-01' AND CURRENT DATE) SELECT DISTINCT CC_MRN, PT_SEX, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, PT_DATE_OF_DEATH, ICD_MIN_DTE, CASE WHEN ICD_CD LIKE 'C22%' THEN 'Liver' WHEN ICD_CD LIKE 'C25%' THEN 'Pancreas' WHEN ICD_CD LIKE 'C56%' THEN 'Ovary' END AS SITE, ICD_CD, ICD_DESC, RTC_TX_START_DTE, RTC_TX_STOP_DTE, RTC_TX_PLAN_NAME, RTC_TX_DELIVERED_FRACTIONS, RTC_TX_DELIVERED_DOSE FROM IDB.RADONC_TREATMENT_COURSE JOIN DX ON RTC_TX_MRN = CC_MRN JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON CC_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE RTC_TX_START_DTE BETWEEN '2022-01-01' AND CURRENT DATE ORDER BY CC_MRN, ICD_MIN_DTE, ICD_CD, RTC_TX_START_DTE ;

prompt: Provide list of patients with rectal cancer and underwent TNT (total neoajuvant chemotherapy) since 2013
completion: WITH DX AS (SELECT DISTINCT TM_MRN, C.AV_DESC AS CASE_STS, TM_DX_DTE, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS HIST_DESC, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_DESC, TM_PATH_TNM_T, TM_PATH_TNM_N, TM_PATH_TNM_M, TM_CLIN_TNM_T, TM_CLIN_TNM_N, TM_CLIN_TNM_M, TM_CLIN_STG_GRP, G.AV_DESC AS HIST_GRADE, TM_TUMOR_SIZE, TM_CA_SURG_98, TM_CA_SURG_03, TM_RAD_STRT_DTE, TM_CHEMO_STRT_DTE, TM_CA_SURG_DTE, COALESCE(TM_SURG_DEF_DTE, TM_CA_SURG_DTE) TM_SURG_DEF_DTE, AVSITE_DESC FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS C ON C.AV_ELEMENT = 'CASE_STS' AND C.AV_CODE = TM_CASE_STS LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS G ON G.AV_ELEMENT = 'HIST_CD_GRADE' AND G.AV_CODE = TM_HIST_CD_GRADE LEFT JOIN IDB.CDB_ALLOWVALS_SITE ON AVSITE_ELEMENT = 'CA_SURG_SUM_03' AND AVSITE_CODE = TM_CA_SURG_03 AND AVSITE_LOW_SITE <= TM_SITE_CD AND AVSITE_HIGH_SITE >= TM_SITE_CD AND AVSITE_INACTIV_DTE = '9999-01-01' WHERE 1=1 AND TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND TM_SITE_CD LIKE 'C20%' AND TM_DX_DTE >= '2012-01-01' ) , RADONC AS (SELECT RTC_TX_MRN, LISTAGG(DATE(RTC_TX_START_DTE) || ' | ' || DATE(RTC_TX_STOP_DTE) || ' | ' || TRIM(RTC_TX_PLAN_NAME) || ' | ' || TRIM(RTC_TX_PLANNED_FRACTIONS) || ' | ' || TRIM(RTC_TX_DELIVERED_FRACTIONS) || ' | ' || TRIM(RTC_TX_PLANNED_DOSE) || ' | ' || TRIM(RTC_TX_DELIVERED_DOSE), CHR(13) || CHR(10)) WITHIN GROUP( ORDER BY DATE(RTC_TX_START_DTE)) AS RADONC_TX FROM (SELECT DISTINCT RTC_TX_MRN, RTC_TX_COURSE_NO, RTC_TX_PLANSETUP_NO, RTC_TX_COURSE_ID, RTC_TX_PLAN_NAME, RTC_TX_PLANNED_FRACTIONS, RTC_TX_DELIVERED_FRACTIONS, RTC_TX_PLANNED_DOSE, RTC_TX_DELIVERED_DOSE, RTC_TX_START_DTE, RTC_TX_STOP_DTE, RTC_TX_ELAPSED_DAYS, RTC_PRIMARY_REF_POINT, RTC_DOSE_CORRECTION FROM IDB.RADONC_TREATMENT_COURSE JOIN DX ON TM_MRN = RTC_TX_MRN AND RTC_TX_START_DTE >= TM_DX_DTE) A GROUP BY RTC_TX_MRN) , CHEMO AS (SELECT APR_MRN, SUBSTR(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(CAST(XMLSERIALIZE(CONTENT XMLAGG(XMLELEMENT(NAME "c", '| '||DATE(APR_START_DTE) || ' | ' || DATE(APR_END_DTE) || ' | ' || TRIM(CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME) || ' | ' || TRIM(APR_PRESCRIBED_DOSE)||' |'|| CHR(13) || CHR(10)) ORDER BY DATE(APR_START_DTE)) AS CLOB(32000)) AS VARCHAR(32000)), '<c>', ','), '</c>', ''), '', ''), '<c/>', ''), ',', ''), 1) AS CHEMO_TX FROM (SELECT DISTINCT APR_MRN, APR_START_DTE, APR_END_DTE, CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME, APR_PRESCRIBED_DOSE FROM IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX JOIN IDB.CHEMO_DRUG_GENERIC ON APR_GENERIC_NAME = CDG_GENERIC_NAME JOIN DX ON TM_MRN = APR_MRN AND APR_START_DTE <= TM_SURG_DEF_DTE ) A GROUP BY APR_MRN) , SURG AS (SELECT SSE_MRN, SUBSTR(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(CAST(XMLSERIALIZE(CONTENT XMLAGG(XMLELEMENT(NAME "c", '| '||DATE(SSE_SURG_DTE) || ' | ' || TRIM(SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD) ||' |'|| CHR(13) || CHR(10)) ORDER BY DATE(SSE_SURG_DTE)) AS CLOB(32000)) AS VARCHAR(32000)), '<c>', ','), '</c>', ''), '', ''), '<c/>', ''), ',', ''), 1) AS SURGERIES FROM (SELECT DISTINCT SSE_MRN, SSE_SURG_DTE, SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD, SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC FROM IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE ON SSE_LOG_ID = SSP_LOG_ID AND SSE_ENC_CSN_ID = SSP_ENC_CSN_ID JOIN DX ON TM_MRN = SSE_MRN WHERE (SSE_SURG_LOC not like '%IR%' AND SSE_SURG_LOC not like '%ENDO%' AND SSE_SOURCE_TYPE <> 'E') ) A GROUP BY SSE_MRN) , CLINDOC AS (SELECT CDD_DOC_GUID, CDD_MRN, CDD_DOC_NAME, CDD_SERVICE_DTE, CDD_DOCUMENT_FULL_TEXT, CDD_AUTH_PROV_NAME FROM DV.CLINDOC_FULL_TEXT_V JOIN DX ON TM_MRN = CDD_MRN WHERE CDD_CANCEL_IND <> '1' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND <> '1' AND CONTAINS(CDD_DOCUMENT_FULL_TEXT, '("anal verge")') = 1 ) SELECT DISTINCT TM_MRN "MRN" , TM_DX_DTE "Dx Date", HIST_DESC "Histology", SITE_DESC "Site", PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH "DOB", YEAR(TM_DX_DTE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) "Age at Dx", PT_SEX "Gender" , TM_RAD_STRT_DTE "First Radiation Date", TM_CHEMO_STRT_DTE "First Chemo Date", TM_CA_SURG_DTE "Surgery Date" , PT_DATE_OF_DEATH "Date of Death", TM_PATH_TNM_T "Clinical T Stage", TM_PATH_TNM_N "Clinical N Stage", TM_PATH_TNM_M "Clinical M Stage", TM_CLIN_STG_GRP, TM_CLIN_TNM_T "Pathological T Stage", TM_CLIN_TNM_N "Pathological N Stage", TM_CLIN_TNM_M "Pathological M Stage", RADONC_TX "Radonc Tx Details", CHEMO_TX "Chemo Details", SURGERIES "Surgery Details", CASE WHEN CDD_MRN IS NOT NULL THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS "Anal Verge Indicator" FROM DX LEFT JOIN RADONC ON TM_MRN = RTC_TX_MRN LEFT JOIN CHEMO ON TM_MRN = APR_MRN LEFT JOIN CLINDOC ON TM_MRN = CDD_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON TM_MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN SURG ON TM_MRN = SSE_MRN

prompt: Provide a list of patients who received a PSMA PET in the past 7 days
completion: WITH PTS AS (SELECT CHP_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID P_ID FROM DVCMS.COHORT_PATIENT JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = CHP_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID WHERE CHP_COHORT_ID = 11128 ) SELECT PT_MRN MRN, PT_LAST_NAME LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME FIRST_NAME, CURRENT date REPORT_DATE FROM PTS JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V ON P_ID = PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID

prompt: Provide a weekly list of UTUC patients undergoing a procedure.
completion: WITH SURGERIES AS (SELECT DISTINCT OC_CASE_ID, OC_MRN, OC_SURG_DTE, CRE_RES_NAME, CONCAT(CONCAT(RTRIM(CPX_PROC_CD), '-'), CPX_PROC_NAME) AS CPT_CD_DESC FROM IDB.OR_CASE JOIN IDB.OR_CASE_ALL_PROC ON OC_CASE_ID = OCAP_CASE_ID JOIN IDB.OR_CASE_ALL_SURG ON OCAP_CASE_ID = OCAS_CASE_ID AND OCAS_PNL_NO = OCAP_PNL_NO AND OCAS_SURG_ROLE = 'Primary' JOIN IDB.OR_PROC ON OCAP_OR_PROC_ID = OP_OR_PROC_ID JOIN IDB.OR_CL_PROC ON OP_OR_PROC_ID = OCP_OR_PROC_ID JOIN IDB.CL_PROC ON OCP_PROC_ID = CPX_PROC_ID JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CRE_RES_ID = OCAS_RES_ID WHERE 1=1 AND OC_SURG_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT DATE + 1 DAY AND CURRENT DATE + 21 DAYS AND OC_OR_CASE_STS_CD NOT IN ('2', '5') AND CPX_PROC_CD IN ('50548', '52355', '52352') ) , SURG AS (SELECT DISTINCT OC_MRN, OC_SURG_DTE, CRE_RES_NAME, LISTAGG(COALESCE(STRIP(CAST(CPT_CD_DESC AS VARCHAR(12000))), '')|| ' | ', CHR(13) || CHR(10))AS SURGERY_CODE_DESC FROM SURGERIES GROUP BY OC_MRN, OC_SURG_DTE, CRE_RES_NAME) , DIAGNOSIS AS (SELECT * FROM (SELECT CC_MRN, CC_EFF_DTE, CC_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK, ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY CC_MRN, CC_CLSF_CD ORDER BY CC_EFF_DTE DESC) AS RN FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN SURG ON CC_MRN = OC_MRN WHERE CC_CLSF_CD IN ('C66.9', 'C68.0') AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND (CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) ) WHERE RN = 1 ) , PROTOCOL AS (SELECT AC_MRN, AC_CONS_DTE, AC_IRB_NO FROM IDB.ACCRUALS JOIN SURG ON OC_MRN = AC_MRN WHERE AC_IRB_NO IN ('12-245', '06-107') ) SELECT DISTINCT OC_MRN AS MRN, CC_EFF_DTE AS DIAGNOSIS_DATE, CC_CLSF_CD AS DIAGNOSIS_CODE, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS DIAGNOSIS_DESC, CRE_RES_NAME AS SURGEON_NAME, OC_SURG_DTE AS SURGERY_DATE, SURGERY_CODE_DESC, AC_IRB_NO FROM SURG LEFT JOIN DIAGNOSIS ON CC_MRN = OC_MRN LEFT JOIN PROTOCOL ON AC_MRN = OC_MRN ORDER BY OC_MRN;

prompt: Daily list of patients who have/have not completed assigned questionnaire and responses to survey questions.
completion: WITH SRV_ALL AS (SELECT EF_MRN AS MRN, DATE(EF_SUBMISSION_DT) AS SUBMISSION_DATE, DATE(EA_ASSIGN_DT) AS SURVEY_ASSIGN_DATE, EF_FORM_ALIAS , EA_SUBM_DT, EA_SOURCE_ID AS SOURCE_ID, MAX(CASE WHEN TRIM(EFI_ITEM_ALIAS) = 'heartstent_6mo' THEN SUBSTR(TRIM(EFI_VALUE), 1, 3) ELSE '' END) AS HEARTSTENT_6MO, MAX(CASE WHEN TRIM(EFI_ITEM_ALIAS) = 'faint_6mo' THEN SUBSTR(TRIM(EFI_VALUE), 1, 3) ELSE '' END) AS FAINT_6MO, MAX(CASE WHEN TRIM(EFI_ITEM_ALIAS) = 'stroke_6mo' THEN SUBSTR(TRIM(EFI_VALUE), 1, 3) ELSE '' END) AS STROKE_6MO, MAX(CASE WHEN TRIM(EFI_ITEM_ALIAS) = 'difficultopenmouth_y_n' THEN SUBSTR(TRIM(EFI_VALUE), 1, 3) ELSE '' END) AS DIFFICULTOPENMOUTH_Y_N, MAX(CASE WHEN TRIM(EFI_ITEM_ALIAS) = 'headneck_surgeryans' THEN SUBSTR(TRIM(EFI_VALUE), 1, 3) ELSE '' END) AS HEADNECK_SURGERYANS, MAX(CASE WHEN TRIM(EFI_ITEM_ALIAS) = 'SOB_lyingflat' THEN SUBSTR(TRIM(EFI_VALUE), 1, 3) ELSE '' END) AS SOB_LYINGFLAT, MAX(CASE WHEN TRIM(EFI_ITEM_ALIAS) = 'heart_device' THEN SUBSTR(TRIM(EFI_VALUE), 1, 3) ELSE '' END) AS HEART_DEVICE, MAX(CASE WHEN TRIM(EFI_ITEM_ALIAS) = 'hemodialysis_ans' THEN SUBSTR(TRIM(EFI_VALUE), 1, 3) ELSE '' END) AS HEMODIALYSIS_ANS, MAX(CASE WHEN TRIM(EFI_ITEM_ALIAS) = 'insulin_device' THEN SUBSTR(TRIM(EFI_VALUE), 1, 3) ELSE '' END) AS INSULIN_DEVICE, LISTAGG((CASE WHEN TRIM(EFI_ITEM_ALIAS) = 'anes_meds' THEN TRIM(SUBSTR(EFI_VALUE, 1, 200)) END) , '~') AS ANES_MEDS FROM IDB.EF_FORM JOIN IDB.EF_FORM_ITEM ON EF_FORM_ID = EFI_FORM_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.EF_ASSESSMENT ON EF_FORM_EXTERNAL_ID = EA_ASSESS_ID WHERE EF_FORM_ALIAS = 'pre_anesthesia' AND DATE(EF_SUBMISSION_DT) BETWEEN CURRENT date - 90 DAYS AND CURRENT date AND EFI_ITEM_ALIAS IN ('heartstent_6mo', 'faint_6mo', 'stroke_6mo', 'difficultopenmouth_y_n', 'headneck_surgeryans', 'SOB_lyingflat', 'anes_meds', 'heart_device', 'hemodialysis_ans', 'insulin_device') GROUP BY EF_MRN, DATE(EF_SUBMISSION_DT), DATE(EA_ASSIGN_DT), EF_FORM_ALIAS, EA_SOURCE_ID, EF_SUBMISSION_DT, EA_SUBM_DT ) , SRV AS (SELECT TRIM(PT_LAST_NAME) || ', ' || TRIM(PT_FIRST_NAME) AS PATIENT_NAME, S.* FROM SRV_ALL S JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PT_MRN = MRN WHERE (UPPER(HEARTSTENT_6MO) = 'YES' OR UPPER(FAINT_6MO) = 'YES' OR UPPER(STROKE_6MO) = 'YES' OR UPPER(DIFFICULTOPENMOUTH_Y_N) = 'YES' OR UPPER(HEADNECK_SURGERYANS) = 'YES' OR UPPER(SOB_LYINGFLAT) = 'YES' OR UPPER(HEART_DEVICE) = 'YES' OR UPPER(HEMODIALYSIS_ANS) = 'YES' OR UPPER(INSULIN_DEVICE) = 'YES') OR (LOWER(ANES_MEDS) like '%buprenorphine%' OR LOWER(ANES_MEDS) like '%methadone%') ) , COMP_SRG AS (SELECT SSE_MRN , '2COMP_SRV' AS COHORT, SSE_LOG_STS LOG_STATUS, SSE_LOG_ID, TRIM(SSP_SURG_LAST_NM) || ', ' || TRIM(SSP_SURG_FIRST_NM) AS SURGEON_NAME, SSE_SURG_DTE AS SURGERY_DATE, SSE_SURG_LOC AS LOCATION, LISTAGG(CAST (TRIM(SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC) AS VARCHAR(255)), ', ') AS PROCEDURE_NAMES, LISTAGG(CAST (TRIM(SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD) AS VARCHAR(15)), ', ') AS PROCEDURE_CODES FROM SRV JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT ON CHAR(SOURCE_ID) = SSE_LOG_ID JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE ON SSE_LOG_ID = SSP_LOG_ID AND SSE_ENC_CSN_ID = SSP_ENC_CSN_ID GROUP BY SSE_MRN, SSE_LOG_ID, SSE_LOG_STS, TRIM(SSP_SURG_LAST_NM) || ', ' || TRIM(SSP_SURG_FIRST_NM), SSE_SURG_DTE, SSE_SURG_LOC ) , SCH_SRG AS (SELECT OC_MRN AS MRN, '1_sch' AS COHORT, OC_OR_CASE_STS AS CASE_STATUS, OC_CASE_ID, OC_SURG_DTE SURGERY_DATE, CRE_RES_NAME SURGEON_NAME, LOC_LOC_NAME LOCATION, LISTAGG(TRIM(CPX_PROC_CD), ', ') AS PROCEDURE_CODES, LISTAGG(TRIM(CPX_PROC_NAME), ', ') AS PROCEDURE_NAMES FROM IDB.OR_CASE JOIN IDB.OR_CASE_ALL_PROC ON OC_CASE_ID = OCAP_CASE_ID JOIN IDB.OR_CASE_ALL_SURG ON OCAP_CASE_ID = OCAS_CASE_ID AND OCAS_PNL_NO = OCAP_PNL_NO AND OCAS_SURG_ROLE = 'Primary' JOIN IDB.OR_PROC ON OCAP_OR_PROC_ID = OP_OR_PROC_ID JOIN IDB.OR_CL_PROC ON OP_OR_PROC_ID = OCP_OR_PROC_ID JOIN IDB.CL_PROC ON OCP_PROC_ID = CPX_PROC_ID JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CRE_RES_ID = OCAS_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_LOCATION ON OC_SURG_LOC_ID = LOC_LOC_ID JOIN SRV ON OC_CASE_ID = CHAR(SOURCE_ID) WHERE OC_CASE_ID NOT IN (SELECT SSE_LOG_ID FROM COMP_SRG ) GROUP BY OC_MRN, OC_CASE_ID, OC_SURG_DTE, OC_OR_CASE_STS, CRE_RES_NAME, LOC_LOC_NAME) , SURG AS (SELECT MRN, COHORT, CASE_STATUS, OC_CASE_ID AS LOG_ID, SURGERY_DATE, SURGEON_NAME, LOCATION, PROCEDURE_CODES, PROCEDURE_NAMES FROM SCH_SRG UNION SELECT SSE_MRN, COHORT, LOG_STATUS, SSE_LOG_ID, SURGERY_DATE, SURGEON_NAME, LOCATION, PROCEDURE_CODES, PROCEDURE_NAMES FROM COMP_SRG) SELECT V.PATIENT_NAME, V.MRN, V.SURVEY_ASSIGN_DATE, V.SUBMISSION_DATE, SURGERY_DATE, LOCATION, SURGEON_NAME, PROCEDURE_NAMES, HEARTSTENT_6MO AS "heartstent_6mo", FAINT_6MO AS "faint_6mo", STROKE_6MO AS "stroke_6mo", DIFFICULTOPENMOUTH_Y_N AS "difficultopenmouth_y_n", HEADNECK_SURGERYANS AS "headneck_surgeryans", SOB_LYINGFLAT AS "SOB_lyingflat", HEART_DEVICE AS "heart_device", HEMODIALYSIS_ANS AS "hemodialysis_ans", INSULIN_DEVICE AS "insulin_device", ANES_MEDS AS "anes_meds" , CASE_STATUS FROM SRV V JOIN SURG R ON CHAR(SOURCE_ID) = LOG_ID ORDER BY SUBMISSION_DATE DESC

prompt: List of patients from 3 protocols with stored tissue blocks and/or IMPACT testing
completion: WITH AC AS (SELECT DISTINCT AC_IRB_NO, AC_MRN AS MRN, STRIP(PT_LAST_NAME)||', '||STRIP(PT_FIRST_NAME) AS NAME FROM IDB.PATIENT JOIN IDB.ACCRUALS AC ON PT_MRN = AC_MRN WHERE AC_IRB_NO IN ('18-431', '18-486') UNION SELECT DISTINCT AC_IRB_NO, AC_MRN AS MRN, STRIP(PT_LAST_NAME)||', '||STRIP(PT_FIRST_NAME) AS NAME FROM IDB.PATIENT JOIN IDB.ACCRUALS AC ON PT_MRN = AC_MRN WHERE AC_IRB_NO IN ('12-245') #PROMPTMANY('MRN', 'String', ' ', ' and AC_MRN in (', '', ')') ) , IMPACT AS (SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN, NAME, AC_IRB_NO, PDWS_DESCRIPTION, PDRX_ACCESSION_NO, T.* FROM AC JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON PT_MRN = MRN JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML DT ON PDRX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML_SETTINGS ON PDRX_PATH_DMP_RESULTS_XML_ID = PDRXS_PATH_DMP_RESULTS_XML_ID JOIN DVDMC.PATHOLOGY_DMP_WEBSVC_SETTINGS ON PDRXS_SETTING_ID = PDWS_SETTING_ID CROSS JOIN XMLTABLE('$c/root/*' PASSING DT.PDRX_XML_VALUE AS "c" COLUMNS DT_PROCEDURE VARCHAR(40) PATH '../meta-data/dt_procedure', DT_SIGNOUT VARCHAR(40) PATH '../meta-data/dt_signout', DT_ACCESSIONED VARCHAR(40) PATH '../meta-data/dt_accessioned') T WHERE 1=1 AND PDWS_NAME like '%IMPACT%' AND PT_MRN IN (SELECT MRN FROM AC) ) SELECT DISTINCT STRIP(B.PT_MRN) AS "MRN", NAME, AC_IRB_NO, TBA_PROCUREMENT_DTE "Procurement Date", TBA_ACCESSION_NUM "Accession Number", TBA_PART_NUM "Part Number", TBA_SUB_PART_NUM "Sub Part Number", TBD_BANK_NUM "Bank Number", TBA_TISSUE_TYPE_DESC "Tissue Type", TBA_DISEASE_DESC "Disease", TBA_SITE_DESC "Site", TBD_CATEGORY_DESC "Specimen Category", TBD_UNIT_DESC "Specimen Unit", TBD_QUALITY_DESC "Specimen Quality", TBD_SPECIMEN_TYPE_DESC "Specimen Type" FROM AC JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V ON PT_MRN = MRN JOIN DV.TISSUE_BANK_ACCESSION A ON TBA_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS B ON TBA_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = B.PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID JOIN DV.TISSUE_BANK_DETAIL ON TBA_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = TBD_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID AND TBA_ACCESSION_NUM = TBD_ACCESSION_NUM AND TBA_PART_NUM = TBD_PART_NUM AND TBA_SUB_PART_NUM = TBD_SUB_PART_NUM WHERE (TBD_RESERVED_REQUEST_ID IS NULL OR TBD_RESERVED_REQUEST_ID = '' ) AND TBD_DISTRIBUTION_DT IS NULL AND TBD_BANK_NUM IS NOT NULL AND SUBSTR(TBD_ACCESSION_NUM, 1, 1) IN ('A', 'H', 'S') AND TBD_QUALITY_DESC = 'Frozen Specimen' AND TBD_SPECIMEN_TYPE_DESC = 'Tissue'

prompt: Lung metastases treated with SBRT from 2008 - 20018.
completion: SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, RTC_TX_COURSE_ID, RTC_TX_PLAN_NAME, RTC_PRIMARY_REF_POINT, RTC_TX_DELIVERED_FRACTIONS, RTC_TX_DELIVERED_DOSE, RTC_TX_START_DTE, RTC_TX_STOP_DTE , S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_DESC FROM IDB.RADONC_TREATMENT_COURSE JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PT_MRN = RTC_TX_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.CDB_TUMOR ON TM_MRN = RTC_TX_MRN AND TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') LEFT JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD WHERE RTC_TX_START_DTE BETWEEN '2008-01-01' AND '2018-12-31' AND (UPPER(RTC_TX_PLAN_NAME) LIKE '%LUNG%' OR UPPER(RTC_TX_COURSE_ID) LIKE '%LUNG%' OR UPPER(RTC_PRIMARY_REF_POINT) LIKE '%LUNG%')

prompt: Provide a list of patients diagnosed with LMS, LPS, or UPS that have metastatic disease and have been seen in the Sarcoma clinic within the last 2 years.
completion: WITH LMS_LPS_UPS AS (SELECT DISTINCT TM_MRN LMS_MRN FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND TM_HIST_CD IN ('M8890/0', 'M8890/1', 'M8890/3', 'M8890/6', 'M8850/3', 'M8851/3', 'M8852/3', 'M8853/3', 'M8854/3', 'M8855/3', 'M8857/3', 'M8858/3', 'M8860/3', 'M8830/3') ), SEEN_AT_SARCOMA AS (SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN SAR_MRN, CRE_RES_NAME ATN_NAME, CPE_ENC_DTE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CPE_MRN ORDER BY CPE_ENC_DTE DESC) RN FROM LMS_LPS_UPS JOIN IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER ON LMS_MRN = CPE_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 IN ('MED', 'PED') AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 IN ('SAR') AND CPE_ENC_DTE >= CURRENT date - 2 YEARS ) , HAS_METS AS (SELECT DISTINCT CC_MRN METS_MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) METS_DX_DTE FROM SEEN_AT_SARCOMA JOIN IDB.CTC_CLSF ON SAR_MRN = CC_MRN JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE (CC_CLSF_CD BETWEEN '196' AND '198.999' OR CC_CLSF_CD BETWEEN 'C77' AND 'C79.999') AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND (CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) GROUP BY CC_MRN) , NO_TX AS (SELECT METS_MRN NO_TX_MRN, METS_DX_DTE FROM HAS_METS WHERE METS_MRN NOT IN (SELECT SSE_MRN FROM IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE ON SSE_LOG_ID = SSP_LOG_ID AND SSE_ENC_CSN_ID = SSP_ENC_CSN_ID WHERE (SSE_SURG_LOC not like '%IR%' AND SSE_SURG_LOC not like '%ENDO%' AND SSE_SOURCE_TYPE <> 'E') ) AND METS_MRN NOT IN (SELECT APR_MRN FROM IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX) AND METS_MRN NOT IN (SELECT RTC_TX_MRN FROM IDB.RADONC_TREATMENT_COURSE) ) SELECT TM_MRN, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, PT_SEX, AV_DESC AS CASE_STS, TM_DX_DTE, TM_HIST_CD, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS HIST_DESC, TM_SITE_CD, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_DESC, METS_DX_DTE, SAR1.CPE_ENC_DTE SAR_DTE_1, SAR1.ATN_NAME SAR_ATN_1, SAR2.CPE_ENC_DTE SAR_DTE_2, SAR2.ATN_NAME SAR_ATN_2, SAR3.CPE_ENC_DTE SAR_DTE_3, SAR3.ATN_NAME SAR_ATN_3 FROM NO_TX JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PT_MRN = NO_TX_MRN LEFT JOIN SEEN_AT_SARCOMA SAR1 ON SAR1.SAR_MRN = NO_TX_MRN AND SAR1.RN = 1 LEFT JOIN SEEN_AT_SARCOMA SAR2 ON SAR2.SAR_MRN = NO_TX_MRN AND SAR2.RN = 2 LEFT JOIN SEEN_AT_SARCOMA SAR3 ON SAR3.SAR_MRN = NO_TX_MRN AND SAR3.RN = 3 JOIN IDB.CDB_TUMOR ON TM_MRN = NO_TX_MRN JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS ON AV_ELEMENT = 'CASE_STS' AND AV_CODE = TM_CASE_STS AND TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') ;

prompt: Provide a daily report of patient names and MRNs who have a Surgical Pathology Submitted Slide or Cytology Submitted Slide Order signed off on my clinician
completion: SELECT PT_MRN MRN, STRIP(PT_LAST_NAME)||', '||PT_FIRST_NAME PT_NAME, OO_ENTER_DTE ORDER_ENTER_DATE, OO_ORD_ID ORDID, OO_ORD_NAME ORDNAME, OSH_ORD_STS_CD ORDSTATUS, OU_DISPLAY_NAME SINGEDBY, OU_OCCUPATION OCCUPATION, OSH_CREATE_DTE SIGNED_DATE, OSH_REASON_TXT REASON_TEXT, OO_ORD_STS_CD FROM IDB.OMS_ORDER JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON OO_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_STS_HX ON OSH_ORD_GUID = OO_ORD_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_USER ON OSH_USER_GUID = OU_USER_GUID WHERE (OO_ORD_NAME) IN('Surgical Pathology Submitted Slides Order', 'Cytology-Submitted Slides Order') AND OO_ORD_STS_CD NOT LIKE 'RE%' AND OSH_CREATE_DTE >= CURRENT date - 3 DAY AND OSH_FUNCTION_CD = '100'

prompt: Darwin Cohort notification of metastatic colorectal and appendiceal cancer patients with KRAS G12c mutation
completion: WITH PTS AS (SELECT * FROM (SELECT PDWS_NAME, PDRX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID, PT_MRN, GENE_ID, EXON_NUM, AA_CHANGE, CDNA_CHANGE, MSI_TYPE, MSI_SCORE, TUMOR_TYPE_CODE, TUMOR_TYPE_NAME, PRIMARY_SITE, DT_PROCEDURE, VARIANT_TYPE, REF_ALLELE, ALT_ALLELE, START_POSITION, TUMOR_DP, TUMOR_AD, VARIANT_CLASS, TOTAL_NUMBER_VARIANTS FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML INNER JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT ON PDRX_PATH_RPT_ID = PRPT_PATH_RPT_ID INNER JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML_SETTINGS ON PDRX_PATH_DMP_RESULTS_XML_ID = PDRXS_PATH_DMP_RESULTS_XML_ID INNER JOIN DVDMC.PATHOLOGY_DMP_WEBSVC_SETTINGS ON PDRXS_SETTING_ID = PDWS_SETTING_ID INNER JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON PDRX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID, XMLTABLE('$c/root/*' PASSING PDRX_XML_VALUE AS "c" COLUMNS TOTAL_NUMBER_VARIANTS int PATH 'count(../*[not(name()=''meta-data'')])', VARIANT_CLASS VARCHAR(100) PATH 'variant_class', GENE_ID VARCHAR(100) PATH 'gene_id', EXON_NUM VARCHAR(100) PATH 'exon_num', AA_CHANGE VARCHAR(100) PATH 'aa_change', CDNA_CHANGE VARCHAR(100) PATH 'cDNA_change', TUMOR_TYPE_CODE VARCHAR(100) PATH '../meta-data/tumor_type_code', TUMOR_TYPE_NAME VARCHAR(255) PATH '../meta-data/tumor_type_name', PRIMARY_SITE VARCHAR(255) PATH '../meta-data/primary_site', DT_PROCEDURE VARCHAR(40) PATH '../meta-data/dt_procedure', MSI_TYPE VARCHAR(40) PATH '../meta-data/msi-type', MSI_SCORE VARCHAR(40) PATH '../meta-data/msi-score', VARIANT_TYPE VARCHAR(100) PATH './local-name(.)', ALT_ALLELE VARCHAR(255) PATH 'alt_allele', REF_ALLELE VARCHAR(255) PATH 'ref_allele', START_POSITION int PATH 'start_position', TUMOR_DP VARCHAR(100) PATH 'tumor_dp', TUMOR_AD VARCHAR(100) PATH 'tumor_ad') T CROSS JOIN TABLE(DV.DMP_XML_MAF(VARIANT_TYPE, REF_ALLELE, ALT_ALLELE, START_POSITION, TUMOR_DP, TUMOR_AD, VARIANT_CLASS)) WHERE 1=1 AND PDWS_NAME = 'IMPACT' AND PDRX_MODIFIED_DT >= CURRENT timestamp -
