1000 HOUR AND (TOTAL_NUMBER_VARIANTS =0 OR VARIANT_TYPE <> 'meta-data') ) A WHERE 1=1 AND (LOWER(PRIMARY_SITE) like '%colo%' OR LOWER(PRIMARY_SITE) like '%append%') AND GENE_ID = 'KRAS' ) , DT AS (SELECT PDRX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID, GENE_ID, EXON_NUM, AA_CHANGE, CDNA_CHANGE, MSI_TYPE, MSI_SCORE, TUMOR_TYPE_NAME, PRIMARY_SITE FROM PTS JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON PDRX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID WHERE PT_VITAL_STATUS = 'ALIVE' AND AA_CHANGE like '%G12C%' ) , DEID AS (SELECT DISTINCT PDRX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID FROM DT) ) ;

prompt: Provide a report of surgical patients discharged within 1 day of surgery who were prescribed oxycodone that day, in 2022.
completion: WITH SRG AS (SELECT DISTINCT OL_MRN, VIS_ADM_DTE, OL_SURG_DTE, VIS_DSCH_DTE, OL_LOG_ID, OLAP_PNL_NO, OLAS_SURG_SVC, OLAP_LINE_NO, OLAP_OR_PROC_ID, OP_IMO_CD, OP_PROC_NAME, OCP_LINE_NO, CPX_PROC_CD, CPX_PROC_NAME FROM IDB.OR_LOG JOIN IDB.OR_LOG_ALL_PROC ON OL_LOG_ID = OLAP_LOG_ID JOIN IDB.OR_PROC ON OLAP_OR_PROC_ID = OP_OR_PROC_ID JOIN IDB.OR_CL_PROC ON OP_OR_PROC_ID = OCP_OR_PROC_ID JOIN IDB.CL_PROC ON OCP_PROC_ID = CPX_PROC_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.OR_LOG_ALL_SURG ON OLAP_LOG_ID = OLAS_LOG_ID AND OLAP_PNL_NO = OLAS_PNL_NO AND OLAS_SURG_ROLE = 'Primary' LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CRE_RES_ID = OLAS_RES_ID JOIN IDB.VISIT ON OL_MRN = VIS_MRN AND OL_SURG_DTE BETWEEN VIS_ADM_DTE AND COALESCE(VIS_DSCH_DTE, CURRENT date) WHERE OL_LOG_STS NOT IN ('Canceled', 'Voided') AND OL_SURG_DTE BETWEEN '2021-12-31' AND '2022-12-31' AND VIS_DSCH_DTE BETWEEN '2022-01-01' AND '2022-12-31' AND VIS_DSCH_DTE BETWEEN OL_SURG_DTE AND OL_SURG_DTE + 1 DAY ) , X AS (SELECT DISTINCT OL_MRN, OL_SURG_DTE, VIS_DSCH_DTE, CPX_PROC_CD, CPX_PROC_NAME, OP_PROC_NAME FROM SRG) , ERX AS (SELECT OL_MRN , CPX_PROC_CD, CPX_PROC_NAME, OP_PROC_NAME , HCPR_DRUG_NAME AS DRUG_NAME , HGN_GENERIC_NAME AS GENERIC_NAME FROM X JOIN IDB.HML_CLIENT_PRESCRIPTION ON HCPR_MRN = OL_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_CLIENT_VISIT ON OCV_VISIT_GUID = HCPR_VISIT_GUID LEFT JOIN IDB.HML_GENERIC_NAME ON HGN_GENERIC_NAME_ID = HCPR_GENERIC_NAME_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_USER USR ON USR.OU_USER_GUID = HCPR_USER_GUID LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_USER REQ ON REQ.OU_USER_GUID = HCPR_CARE_PROV_GUID LEFT JOIN IDB.HML_RX_UNIT_OF_MEASURE UOM ON UOM.HRUM_RXUOM_ID = HCPR_DOSE_UOM_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.HML_RX_UNIT_OF_MEASURE PKG ON PKG.HRUM_RXUOM_ID = HCPR_INNER_PACKAGE_SIZE_UOM_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.HML_SCRIPT_FREQUENCY ON HSF_SCRIPT_FREQ_ID = HCPR_SCRIPT_FREQ_ID WHERE HCPR_STATUS_TYPE NOT IN (4, 5, 8) AND HCPR_CREATED_DTE IS NOT NULL AND(HCPR_PRESCRIPTION_TYPE = 1 AND HCPR_TRANSMISSION_STATUS IN (1, 2, 5)) AND (UPPER(HCPR_DRUG_NAME) LIKE '%OXYCODONE%' OR UPPER(HGN_GENERIC_NAME) LIKE '%OXYCODONE%') AND(DATE(HCPR_START_DT) = VIS_DSCH_DTE OR HCPR_CREATED_DTE = VIS_DSCH_DTE) ) SELECT * FROM ERX , EMAR AS (SELECT DISTINCT OL_MRN , CPX_PROC_CD, CPX_PROC_NAME, OP_PROC_NAME , OO_ORD_NAME , OMD_DOSE_LOW AS "Dose", OMD_DOSE_UNIT AS "Unit" FROM X JOIN IDB.OMS_ORDER ON OO_MRN = OL_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_MED_DETAIL ON OO_ORD_GUID = OMD_ORD_GUID JOIN IDB.OAS_ORD_TASK_OCCR ON OOTO_ORD_GUID = OO_ORD_GUID AND OOTO_STATUS_CD = 'Performed' JOIN IDB.OAS_CTLG_ITEM_TASK ON OOTO_CAT_ITEM_GUID = OCIT_GUID AND OCIT_LEVEL_NO = 0 WHERE OO_ORD_STS_CD NOT IN ('CANC', 'CANP', 'AUC3') AND UPPER(OO_ORD_NAME) LIKE '%OXYCODONE%' AND OOTO_SIGNIFIC_DTE = VIS_DSCH_DTE )

prompt: Provide list of adults diagnosed with medulloblastoma from 1/1/2000 through 7/31/2022
completion: WITH DIAG AS (SELECT CC_MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS MIN_ICD9_EFF_DTE, CC_CLSF_CD AS ICD9_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS ICD9_DESC FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE SUBSTR(CC_CLSF_CD, 1, 5) IN ('C71.6', '191.6') AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND (CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) AND CC_EFF_DTE BETWEEN '2000-01-01' AND '2021-07-01' GROUP BY CC_MRN, CC_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK ), APPT AS (SELECT CPE_MRN AS "MRN", PT_LAST_NAME "Last Name", PT_FIRST_NAME "First Name", PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH DOB, PT_DATE_OF_DEATH, PT_SEX, YEAR(CPE_ENC_DTE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) "Age at Appt", CPE_ENC_DTE AS "Appt Date", CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 AS "Department", CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 AS "Service", CLD_DEPT_NAME AS "Department Name", CRE_RES_NAME AS "Provider Name", CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR AS "Visit Type ABBR", CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME AS "Visit Type", ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CPE_MRN ORDER BY CPE_ENC_DTE) RN FROM DIAG LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER ON CC_MRN = CPE_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON CPE_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CRE_RES_TYP IN ('Physician') AND (CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME LIKE '%NV%' OR CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME LIKE '%IR%') AND ((CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 = 'PED' AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 = 'NOC') OR (CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 = 'NEU')) AND YEAR(CPE_ENC_DTE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) >= 18 ) SELECT DISTINCT MRN, "Last Name", "First Name", DOB, PT_DATE_OF_DEATH, PT_SEX, PRPT_PROCEDURE_DTE, PRPT_REPORT_DTE, PRPT_REPORT_TYPE_DESC FROM APPT LEFT JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V ON MRN = PRPT_MRN WHERE PRPT_REPORT_TYPE_DESC = 'Surgical Pathology'

prompt: Provide a weekly list of patients with HSV infections.
completion: WITH HSV AS (SELECT LR_MRN, LR_TEST_NAME, LR_SUBTEST_NAME, LR_PERFORMED_DTE, LR_IDB_PRCS_DTE FROM IDB.LAB_RESULTS WHERE LR_TEST_NAME IN ('HSV 1/2, VZV Qual PCR (Dermal)', 'HSV 1/2, VZV Qual PCR, Dermal', 'HSV Antiviral Acyclovir Susceptibility', 'HSV Antiviral Foscarnet Susceptibility', 'HSV 1/2 Quant PCR (Plasma)') AND LR_IDB_PRCS_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT DATE - 7 DAYS AND CURRENT DATE - 1 DAY ), STEMCELL AS ( (SELECT LR_MRN AS "BMTMRN", CBM_TRANSPLANT_TYPE AS "TRANSPLANT TYPE", CBM_TRANSPLANT_DTE AS "TRANSPLANT DATE" FROM (SELECT DISTINCT LR_MRN FROM HSV) AS "HSVMRN" JOIN IDB.CRDB_BMT_MEDICINE ON LR_MRN = CBM_MRN UNION SELECT LR_MRN AS "BMTMRN", CBP_TRANSPLANT_TYPE AS "TRANSPLANT TYPE", CBP_TRANSPLANT_DTE AS "TRANSPLANT DATE" FROM (SELECT DISTINCT LR_MRN FROM HSV) AS "HSVMRN" JOIN IDB.CRDB_BMT_PEDIATRICS ON LR_MRN = CBP_MRN)), MALAGNANCIES AS (SELECT CC_MRN, CC_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK, CLM_CLSF_TYPE, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS "First Effective Date" FROM (SELECT DISTINCT LR_MRN FROM HSV) AS "HSVMRN" JOIN IDB.CTC_CLSF ON LR_MRN = CC_MRN JOIN IDB.CLM ON CLM_CLSF_CD = CC_CLSF_CD WHERE (CC_CLSF_CD BETWEEN '140' AND '239.99' OR CC_CLSF_CD BETWEEN 'C00' AND 'D49.99') AND (CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) GROUP BY CC_MRN, CC_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK, CLM_CLSF_TYPE), PT AS (SELECT PT_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME AS "Last Name", PT_FIRST_NAME AS "First Name", PT_SEX AS "Gender", PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH AS "Date of Birth" FROM (SELECT DISTINCT LR_MRN FROM HSV) AS "HSVMRN" JOIN IDB.PATIENT P ON LR_MRN = PT_MRN) SELECT PT_MRN AS "MRN", "Last Name", "First Name", "Gender", "Date of Birth", LR_TEST_NAME AS "Lab Test Name", LR_SUBTEST_NAME AS "Lab Subtest Name", LR_PERFORMED_DTE AS "Lab Performed Date", LR_IDB_PRCS_DTE AS "Lab Available Date", "TRANSPLANT TYPE", "TRANSPLANT DATE", CC_CLSF_CD AS "ICD Code", CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS "ICD Description", CASE CLM_CLSF_TYPE WHEN 'I9' THEN 'ICD-9' WHEN 'I0' THEN 'ICD-10' ELSE 'Unknown' END AS "ICD Version", "First Effective Date", CURRENT date - 6 DAYS AS "Lab Results Available Start Date", CURRENT date AS "Lab Results Available End Date" FROM PT JOIN HSV ON LR_MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN STEMCELL ON "BMTMRN" = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN MALAGNANCIES ON CC_MRN = PT_MRN

prompt: Create a report showing how many outpatients aged 60 and over who had a CT with contrast in the past 90 days had had a creatinine result within 12 weeks prior, grouped by age range and week range.
completion: SELECT * FROM IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE WHERE CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME like '%MR%' AND (CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME like '%W/ CON%' OR CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME like '%W/CON%' OR CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME like '%W/W%' OR CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME like '%W/W/O%' OR CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME like '%W CON%' OR CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME like '%W/ W/O%' OR CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME like '%W/ & W/O%' OR CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME like '%W & W/O%') OUTPATIENT EVERYTHING ELSE

prompt: Breast Radiology patients requiring follow-up based on BIRAD Score
completion: WITH CTE AS (SELECT RRPT_MRN, RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE, RRPT_ORDER_LOCATION, RRPT_ACCESSION_NO, RRPT_ORDER_GROUP, RRPT_PROCEDURE_NAME, RRPT_REQUESTER, RRPT_ANC_CODE, RRPT_REPORT_TXT, DV.REGEX('BI-RADS', RRPT_REPORT_TXT, 'matchCount') AS BI_RAD_MENTIONED, REPLACE(DV.REGEXSTR('\WBI-RADS[:]*[\s]*([0-6]|zero)', RRPT_REPORT_TXT), 'BI-RADS', '') AS BI_RAD_SCORE_STR FROM DV.RADIOLOGY_REPORT_V WHERE CONTAINS(RRPT_REPORT_TXT, '("birads" | "bi-rads")') = 1 AND RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE >= CURRENT date - 365 DAYS ) , BIRADS AS (SELECT RRPT_MRN, RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE, RRPT_ACCESSION_NO, RRPT_ORDER_LOCATION, RRPT_ORDER_GROUP, RRPT_PROCEDURE_NAME, RRPT_REQUESTER, RRPT_REPORT_TXT, CASE WHEN BI_RAD_MENTIONED > 1 THEN 88 WHEN BI_RAD_SCORE_STR LIKE '%zero%' OR BI_RAD_SCORE_STR LIKE '%0%' THEN 0 WHEN BI_RAD_SCORE_STR LIKE '%1%' THEN 1 WHEN BI_RAD_SCORE_STR LIKE '%2%' THEN 2 WHEN BI_RAD_SCORE_STR LIKE '%3%' THEN 3 WHEN BI_RAD_SCORE_STR LIKE '%4%' THEN 4 WHEN BI_RAD_SCORE_STR LIKE '%5%' THEN 5 WHEN BI_RAD_SCORE_STR LIKE '%6%' THEN 6 ELSE 99 END AS BI_RAD_SCORE FROM CTE) , BIRADS_FILTERED AS (SELECT RRPT_MRN, RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE, RRPT_ORDER_LOCATION, RRPT_ACCESSION_NO, RRPT_REQUESTER, RRPT_ORDER_GROUP, RRPT_PROCEDURE_NAME, RRPT_REPORT_TXT, BI_RAD_SCORE, CASE WHEN BI_RAD_SCORE = 0 THEN 'Incomplete' WHEN BI_RAD_SCORE = 1 THEN 'Negative' WHEN BI_RAD_SCORE = 2 THEN 'Benign finding(s)' WHEN BI_RAD_SCORE = 3 THEN 'Probably benign' WHEN BI_RAD_SCORE = 4 THEN 'Suspicious abnormality' WHEN BI_RAD_SCORE = 5 THEN 'Highly suggestive of malignancy' WHEN BI_RAD_SCORE = 6 THEN 'Known biopsy – proven malignancy' WHEN BI_RAD_SCORE = 99 THEN 'Unknown' WHEN BI_RAD_SCORE = 88 THEN 'Multiple mentions of BI-RADS. Multiple scans or previous scans. Manually review' END AS BI_RAD_DESC FROM BIRADS WHERE BI_RAD_SCORE IN (0, 99, 88) ) , BIRADS_EXCLUDE AS (SELECT RRPT_MRN FROM BIRADS WHERE BI_RAD_SCORE NOT IN (0, 99, 88) ) , PT AS (SELECT RRPT_MRN, MIN(RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE) FIRST_PERFORMED_DATE FROM BIRADS_FILTERED GROUP BY RRPT_MRN) , SCH_APPTS AS (SELECT RRPT_MRN, FIRST_PERFORMED_DATE, DT_DTE, PENC_APPT_STS, ENDP_DEPT_NAME, ENDP_SERVICE_DEPT_GRP_6, ENVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR, ENVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME FROM DV.PATIENT_ENCOUNTER JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PENC_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID JOIN PT ON PT_MRN = RRPT_MRN JOIN DV.DATE ON PENC_ENC_DATE_ID = DT_DATE_ID JOIN DV.ENCOUNTER_DESC_CATALOG STS ON PENC_APPT_STS = STS.EDC_DEPT_ABBREV AND STS.EDC_GROUP_ID = 'STS' JOIN DV.ENCOUNTER_DEPARTMENT ON PENC_DEPT_ID = ENDP_ENC_DEPT_ID JOIN DV.ENCOUNTER_VISIT_TYPE ON PENC_VISIT_TYPE_ID = ENVT_ENC_VISIT_TYPE_ID WHERE PENC_APPT_STS IN ('Sch') AND ENDP_SERVICE_DEPT_GRP_6 = 'RAD' ) SELECT RRPT_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_BIRTH_DTE, RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE, RRPT_ORDER_LOCATION, RRPT_ACCESSION_NO, RRPT_ORDER_GROUP, RRPT_REQUESTER, RRPT_PROCEDURE_NAME, RRPT_REPORT_TXT, BI_RAD_SCORE, BI_RAD_DESC FROM BIRADS_FILTERED JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON RRPT_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE RRPT_MRN NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT RRPT_MRN FROM SCH_APPTS) AND RRPT_MRN NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT RRPT_MRN FROM BIRADS_EXCLUDE)

prompt: Patient Data SAE and AEs data for patients enrolled in 21-047.
completion: WITH STUDY AS (SELECT SUBJECT_MRN, SUBJECT_STATUS, ON_STUDYDATE FROM NN.SV_SUB_ONSTUDY WHERE PROTOCOL_NO = '21-047' AND SUBJECT_MRN IN ('35112680', '35166933', '35372463', '35421209', '35518768', '35587528', '38011344', '38015873', '38051811', '38073252', '38074972', '38090256', '38090526', '38093274', '38096233', '38096322', '38109123', '38116105', '38122328', '38129629', '38129834', '38131588', '38134286', '38134934', '38135745', '38136055', '38139733', '38142285', '38144425', '38145773', '38151625', '38154246', '38160392', '38170134', '38178456', '38178747', '38183247', '38188950', '38207135', '38210163', '38217304', '38240057', '00039574', '00843727', '35036836', '35543981') ), ACCR AS (SELECT AC_MRN, AC_LAST_NAME, AC_FIRST_NAME, AC_DOB, AC_SEX, AC_CONS_DTE, CASE WHEN AC_CONS_DTE IS NOT NULL THEN 'Y' END AS CONSENT_FLAG, ACD_OFF_STUDY_DTE, ACD_TX_ST_DTE, ACD_TX_END_DTE FROM IDB.ACCRUALS JOIN IDB.ACCRUALS_DATES ON AC_IRB_NO = ACD_IRB_NO AND AC_SUBJ_ID_NO = ACD_SUBJ_ID_NO AND AC_SUBJ_SEQ_NO = ACD_SUBJ_SEQ_NO AND AC_IRB_NO = '21-047') SELECT SUBJECT_MRN, A.* FROM STUDY S LEFT JOIN ACCR A ON AC_MRN = SUBJECT_MRN AND ACD_OFF_STUDY_DTE IS NULL ; WITH STUDY AS (SELECT SUBJECT_MRN, SUBJECT_STATUS, ON_STUDYDATE FROM NN.SV_SUB_ONSTUDY WHERE PROTOCOL_NO = '21-047' AND SUBJECT_MRN IN ('35112680', '35166933', '35372463', '35421209', '35518768', '35587528', '38011344', '38015873', '38051811', '38073252', '38074972', '38090256', '38090526', '38093274', '38096233', '38096322', '38109123', '38116105', '38122328', '38129629', '38129834', '38131588', '38134286', '38134934', '38135745', '38136055', '38139733', '38142285', '38144425', '38145773', '38151625', '38154246', '38160392', '38170134', '38178456', '38178747', '38183247', '38188950', '38207135', '38210163', '38217304', '38240057', '00039574', '00843727', '35036836', '35543981') ) , SAE AS (SELECT DISTINCT A.SAE_MRN, SAE_TOX_OCCR_DT, SAE_TOX_GRADE, SAE_TOX_GRADE_NAME, SAE_TOXICITY_NAME, SAE_TOX_CLASS FROM IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE ON SSE_LOG_ID = SSP_LOG_ID AND SSE_ENC_CSN_ID = SSP_ENC_CSN_ID JOIN IDB.SRG_ADVERSE_EVENT A ON SSE_LOG_ID = SAE_SURG_LOG_ID AND SAE_PROC_SEQ_NO = SSP_PROC_SEQ_NO AND SAE_TOX_GRADE > '0' JOIN STUDY ON SUBJECT_MRN = SSE_MRN) SELECT SUBJECT_MRN, S.* FROM STUDY LEFT JOIN SAE S ON SAE_MRN = SUBJECT_MRN ; WITH STUDY AS (SELECT SUBJECT_MRN, SUBJECT_STATUS, DATE(ON_STUDYDATE) ON_STUDY_DATE FROM NN.SV_SUB_ONSTUDY WHERE PROTOCOL_NO = '21-047' AND SUBJECT_MRN IN ('35112680', '35166933', '35372463', '35421209', '35518768', '35587528', '38011344', '38015873', '38051811', '38073252', '38074972', '38090256', '38090526', '38093274', '38096233', '38096322', '38109123', '38116105', '38122328', '38129629', '38129834', '38131588', '38134286', '38134934', '38135745', '38136055', '38139733', '38142285', '38144425', '38145773', '38151625', '38154246', '38160392', '38170134', '38178456', '38178747', '38183247', '38188950', '38207135', '38210163', '38217304', '38240057', '00039574', '00843727', '35036836', '35543981') ) SELECT DISTINCT CRAE_MRN MRN, CRAE_IRB_NO IRB_NO, ON_STUDY_DATE, CRAE_BASELINE, CRAE_GRADE, CRAA_TREATMENT, CRAE_INTERVENTION, CRAE_OTHER_INTERVENTION, TRIM(CRTX_TOXICITY) TOXICITY, CRAE_ONGOING_IND, CRAE_VERIFIED_IND, CRAE_EXPECTED_TOXICITY, CRAA_ATTRIBUTION, CRAE_START_DTE, CRAE_STOP_DTE, CRTX_SYSTEM FROM STUDY LEFT JOIN IDB.CLNR_ADVERSE_EVENT C ON SUBJECT_MRN = CRAE_MRN AND CRAE_IRB_NO ='21-047' JOIN IDB.CLNR_TOXICITY34 ON CRAE_VERSION = CRTX_VERSION AND CRAE_CTC_AE_IX = CRTX_CTC_AE_IX AND CRAE_GRADE = CRTX_GRADE JOIN IDB.CLNR_ADVERSE_ATTRIBUTION ON CRAA_MRN = CRAE_MRN AND CRAA_IRB_NO = CRAE_IRB_NO AND CRAA_ADVERSE_EVENT_NO = CRAE_ADVERSE_EVENT_NO AND CRAA_ADVERSE_EVENT_SEQ_NO = CRAE_ADVERSE_EVENT_SEQ_NO WHERE CRAE_IRB_NO = '21-047' ;

prompt: Provide count of patients by race/ethnicity for all of MSK and patients diagnosed with breast cancer seen since 3/1/19.
completion: WITH DX AS (SELECT CC_MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS ICD_EFF_DTE, CC_CLSF_CD AS ICD_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS ICD_DESC FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY ON CC_MRN = PLA_MRN WHERE SUBSTR(CC_CLSF_CD, 1, 3) IN ('174', '175', 'C50') AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND PLA_LST_APPT_DTE >= '2019-03-01' GROUP BY CC_MRN, CC_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK ) SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT PT_MRN) AS COUNT , E.AV_DESC "Ethnicity" , R.AV_DESC "Race" FROM IDB.PATIENT JOIN DX ON PT_MRN = CC_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS E ON E.AV_ELEMENT = 'PT_ETHNICITY' AND E.AV_CODE = PT_PT_ETHNICITY LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS R ON R.AV_ELEMENT = 'RACE' AND R.AV_CODE = PT_RACE GROUP BY E.AV_DESC , R.AV_DESC ORDER BY E.AV_DESC, R.AV_DESC ; WITH DX AS (SELECT CC_MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS ICD_EFF_DTE, CC_CLSF_CD AS ICD_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS ICD_DESC FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY ON CC_MRN = PLA_MRN AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND PLA_LST_APPT_DTE >= '2019-03-01' GROUP BY CC_MRN, CC_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK) SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT PT_MRN) AS COUNT , E.AV_DESC "Ethnicity" , R.AV_DESC "Race" , CASE WHEN CC_MRN IS NOT NULL THEN 'Breast' ELSE 'Other' END AS "Dx" FROM IDB.PATIENT JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY ON PT_MRN = PLA_MRN AND PLA_LST_APPT_DTE >= '2019-03-01' LEFT JOIN DX ON PT_MRN = CC_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS E ON E.AV_ELEMENT = 'PT_ETHNICITY' AND E.AV_CODE = PT_PT_ETHNICITY LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS R ON R.AV_ELEMENT = 'RACE' AND R.AV_CODE = PT_RACE GROUP BY E.AV_DESC , R.AV_DESC , CASE WHEN CC_MRN IS NOT NULL THEN 'Breast' ELSE 'Other' END ORDER BY E.AV_DESC, R.AV_DESC, CASE WHEN CC_MRN IS NOT NULL THEN 'Breast' ELSE 'Other' END ;

prompt: Design a weekly report of patients with the specified diagnoses who are scheduled for a neurosurgery visit in the next 7 seven days.
completion: WITH CPE AS (SELECT DISTINCT STRIP(CPE_MRN) AS CPE_MRN, CPE_ENC_DTE, STRIP(CRE_RES_NAME) AS CRE_RES_NAME, CRE_RES_TYP, STRIP(CLD_DEPT_NAME) AS CLD_DEPT_NAME, STRIP(CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME) AS CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Sch') AND CRE_RES_TYP IN ('Physician') AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 = 'NRS' AND CLD_DEPT_NAME not like '%PED%' AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT DATE AND CURRENT DATE + 7 DAYS ) , DX AS (SELECT DISTINCT TM_MRN AS MRN, CATEGORY2 FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN CPE ON CPE_MRN = TM_MRN JOIN IDB.SEERGROUPING ON RECODE = IDB.SEERF_ICDO(TM_SITE_CD, TM_HIST_CD) AND CATEGORY2 IN ('Esophagus', 'Stomach', 'Breast', 'Lung and Bronchus', 'Colon and Rectum') JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD WHERE 1=1 AND TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') UNION SELECT CC_MRN AS MRN, CATEGORY2 FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN CPE ON CPE_MRN = CC_MRN JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.SEERGROUPING ON RECODE = MIN(IDB.SEERF_ICD9(CLM_CLSF_CD), IDB.SEERF_ICD10(CLM_CLSF_CD)) AND CATEGORY2 IN ('Esophagus', 'Stomach', 'Breast', 'Lung and Bronchus', 'Colon and Rectum') WHERE CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND CASE WHEN CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y' THEN 'Y' WHEN CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' AND YEAR(CC_EFF_DTE) < 2004 THEN 'Y' WHEN CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND YEAR(CC_EFF_DTE) < 2001 THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END = 'Y' AND CC_PT_TYPE <> 'E' GROUP BY CC_MRN, CATEGORY2 ) SELECT DISTINCT CPE.*, STRIP(CATEGORY2) AS DX FROM CPE JOIN DX ON MRN = CPE_MRN

prompt: Evaluate the potential for creating  a PET/CT radiogenomic data set for NSCLC lung cancer
completion: WITH NSCLC AS (SELECT TM_MRN, TM_DX_DTE, CASE WHEN TM_RAD_STRT_DTE <= COALESCE(TM_SYST_STRT_DTE, '2100-01-01') AND TM_RAD_STRT_DTE <= COALESCE(TM_OTH_STRT_DTE, '2100-01-01') AND TM_RAD_STRT_DTE <= COALESCE(TM_CHEMO_STRT_DTE, '2100-01-01') AND TM_RAD_STRT_DTE <= COALESCE(TM_HORM_STRT_DTE, '2100-01-01') AND TM_RAD_STRT_DTE <= COALESCE(TM_IMMUN_STRT_DTE, '2100-01-01') THEN TM_RAD_STRT_DTE WHEN TM_OTH_STRT_DTE <= COALESCE(TM_SYST_STRT_DTE, '2100-01-01') AND TM_OTH_STRT_DTE <= COALESCE(TM_RAD_STRT_DTE, '2100-01-01') AND TM_OTH_STRT_DTE <= COALESCE(TM_CHEMO_STRT_DTE, '2100-01-01') AND TM_OTH_STRT_DTE <= COALESCE(TM_HORM_STRT_DTE, '2100-01-01') AND TM_OTH_STRT_DTE <= COALESCE(TM_IMMUN_STRT_DTE, '2100-01-01') THEN TM_OTH_STRT_DTE WHEN TM_CHEMO_STRT_DTE <= COALESCE(TM_SYST_STRT_DTE, '2100-01-01') AND TM_CHEMO_STRT_DTE <= COALESCE(TM_RAD_STRT_DTE, '2100-01-01') AND TM_CHEMO_STRT_DTE <= COALESCE(TM_OTH_STRT_DTE, '2100-01-01') AND TM_CHEMO_STRT_DTE <= COALESCE(TM_HORM_STRT_DTE, '2100-01-01') AND TM_CHEMO_STRT_DTE <= COALESCE(TM_IMMUN_STRT_DTE, '2100-01-01') THEN TM_CHEMO_STRT_DTE WHEN TM_HORM_STRT_DTE <= COALESCE(TM_SYST_STRT_DTE, '2100-01-01') AND TM_HORM_STRT_DTE <= COALESCE(TM_RAD_STRT_DTE, '2100-01-01') AND TM_HORM_STRT_DTE <= COALESCE(TM_OTH_STRT_DTE, '2100-01-01') AND TM_HORM_STRT_DTE <= COALESCE(TM_CHEMO_STRT_DTE, '2100-01-01') AND TM_HORM_STRT_DTE <= COALESCE(TM_IMMUN_STRT_DTE, '2100-01-01') THEN TM_HORM_STRT_DTE WHEN TM_SYST_STRT_DTE <= COALESCE(TM_HORM_STRT_DTE, '2100-01-01') AND TM_SYST_STRT_DTE <= COALESCE(TM_RAD_STRT_DTE, '2100-01-01') AND TM_SYST_STRT_DTE <= COALESCE(TM_OTH_STRT_DTE, '2100-01-01') AND TM_SYST_STRT_DTE <= COALESCE(TM_CHEMO_STRT_DTE, '2100-01-01') AND TM_SYST_STRT_DTE <= COALESCE(TM_IMMUN_STRT_DTE, '2100-01-01') THEN TM_SYST_STRT_DTE WHEN TM_IMMUN_STRT_DTE <= COALESCE(TM_HORM_STRT_DTE, '2100-01-01') AND TM_IMMUN_STRT_DTE <= COALESCE(TM_RAD_STRT_DTE, '2100-01-01') AND TM_IMMUN_STRT_DTE <= COALESCE(TM_OTH_STRT_DTE, '2100-01-01') AND TM_IMMUN_STRT_DTE <= COALESCE(TM_CHEMO_STRT_DTE, '2100-01-01') AND TM_IMMUN_STRT_DTE <= COALESCE(TM_SYST_STRT_DTE, '2100-01-01') THEN TM_IMMUN_STRT_DTE END AS FIRST_THERAPY_DATE FROM (SELECT DISTINCT TM_MRN , TM_RAD_STRT_DTE , TM_RAD_END_DTE , TM_SYST_STRT_DTE , TM_OTH_STRT_DTE , TM_CHEMO_STRT_DTE , TM_HORM_STRT_DTE , TM_IMMUN_STRT_DTE , AV_DESC AS CASE_STS , TM_DX_DTE , TM_HIST_CD , H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS HIST_DESC , TM_SITE_CD , S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_DESC FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS ON AV_ELEMENT = 'CASE_STS' AND AV_CODE = TM_CASE_STS WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND TM_SITE_CD LIKE 'C34%' AND TM_DX_DTE >= '2015-01-01' AND TM_HIST_CD IN ('M8013/3', 'M8014/3', 'M8022/3', 'M8030/3', 'M8031/3', 'M8032/3', 'M8033/3', 'M8046/3', 'M8052/2', 'M8052/3', 'M8070/2', 'M8070/3', 'M8071/2', 'M8071/3', 'M8072/3', 'M8073/3', 'M8074/2', 'M8074/3', 'M8083/3', 'M8140/2', 'M8140/3', 'M8250/2', 'M8250/3', 'M8251/3', 'M8252/3', 'M8253/3', 'M8254/3', 'M8255/3', 'M8260/2', 'M8260/3', 'M8310/3', 'M8333/3', 'M8480/2', 'M8480/3', 'M8481/3', 'M8490/2', 'M8490/3', 'M8560/2', 'M8560/3', 'M8572/3', 'M8574/3', 'M8972/3', 'M8973/3', 'M8980/3') AND (TM_RAD_STRT_DTE IS NOT NULL OR TM_SYST_STRT_DTE IS NOT NULL OR TM_OTH_STRT_DTE IS NOT NULL OR TM_CHEMO_STRT_DTE IS NOT NULL OR TM_HORM_STRT_DTE IS NOT NULL OR TM_IMMUN_STRT_DTE IS NOT NULL) ) A ) , SCANS AS (SELECT DISTINCT RRPT_MRN FROM DV.RADIOLOGY_REPORT_V JOIN NSCLC ON TM_MRN = RRPT_MRN AND RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE >= TM_DX_DTE AND RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE <= FIRST_THERAPY_DATE WHERE 1=1 AND RRPT_ORDER_GROUP IN ('PET', 'PET CT for Cancer', 'PET CT for Cardiac viability or perfusion', 'PET for Cancer', 'PET for Cardiac viability or perfusion', 'PET MR', 'CT') AND RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE BETWEEN '2016-08-01' AND '2019-08-01' ) , MSKIMPACT AS (SELECT DISTINCT PRPT_MRN FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V JOIN NSCLC ON TM_MRN = PRPT_MRN WHERE 1=1 AND PRPT_PROCEDURE_DTE BETWEEN '2016-08-01' AND '2019-08-01' AND CONTAINS("PRPT_REPORT", '("MSK-IMPACT")') = 1 ) SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT TM_MRN) AS COUNT FROM NSCLC JOIN SCANS ON TM_MRN = RRPT_MRN JOIN MSKIMPACT ON TM_MRN = PRPT_MRN

prompt: Create a report which will identify all patients who diagnosed of rectal cancer from January 2007 to August 2011.
completion: SELECT DISTINCT "t4"."PT_MRN" AS "MRN", "t4"."PT_LAST_NAME" AS "Last Name", "t4"."PT_FIRST_NAME" AS "First Name", 'CDB Tumor/ICD-O' AS "Diagnosis Code Type", "t2"."ICSC_SITE_CD" AS "Code", "t2"."ICSC_ICDO_SITE_MSK_DESC" AS "Code description", "t3"."DT_DTE" AS "Dx Date", "t5"."CDTM_CA_SURG_DTE" AS "CDB Cancer Surgery Date" FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED" "t1" LEFT JOIN "DV"."CDB_TUMOR_V" "t5" ON "t1"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t5"."CDTM_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."ICDO_SITE_CATALOG_V" "t2" ON "t5"."CDTM_SITE_CATALOG_ID" = "t2"."ICSC_SITE_CATALOG_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE" "t3" ON "t5"."CDTM_DX_DATE_ID" = "t3"."DT_DATE_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V" "t4" ON "t1"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t4"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" WHERE ("t2"."ICSC_SITE_CD" IN ('C209', 'C218') AND "t3"."DT_YEAR" >= 2007) UNION SELECT DISTINCT "t5"."PT_MRN" AS "MRN", "t5"."PT_LAST_NAME" AS "Last Name", "t5"."PT_FIRST_NAME" AS "First Name", 'ICD-9' AS "Diagnosis Code Type", "t2"."DXCC_ICD_CODE" AS "Code", "t2"."DXCC_ICD_MSK_DESC" AS "Code description", "t4"."DT_DTE" AS "Dx Date", NULL AS "CDB Cancer Surgery Date" FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED" "t1" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DIAGNOSIS_FINAL_ALL_V" "t3" ON "t1"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t3"."PDX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DIAGNOSIS_CODE_CAT_ICD9_V" "t2" ON "t3"."PDX_DX_CATALOG_ID" = "t2"."DXCC_DX_CATALOG_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DIAGNOSIS_FINAL_DATES_V" "t6" ON "t3"."PDX_DX_CATALOG_ID" = "t6"."PDX_DX_CATALOG_ID" AND "t3"."PDX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t6"."PDX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE" "t4" ON "t6"."FIRST_DIAGNOSIS_DATE_ID" = "t4"."DT_DATE_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V" "t5" ON "t1"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t5"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" WHERE ("t3"."PDX_DX_CATALOG_ID" IN (5669, 5614) AND ("t3"."DXA_CIC_CDER_INIT" IN ('YES') AND YEAR("t4"."DT_DTE") >= 2007))

prompt: Assess nursing documents filed by user to measure compliance with department policy
completion: WITH APPTS AS (SELECT CPE_MRN AS "MRN", CPE_ENC_DTE AS "Appt Date", CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 AS "Department", CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 AS "Service", CLD_DEPT_NAME AS "Department Name", CRE_RES_NAME AS "Provider Name", CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME AS "Visit Type" FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CRE_RES_TYP IN ('Physician', 'PhD', 'Dentist', 'Psychologist') AND CPE_ENC_DTE >= '2019-11-01' AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 IN ('GAS', 'PUL') AND CRE_RES_NAME IN ('FALECK, DAVID M', 'GAMBARIN-GELWAN, MAYA', 'GERDES, HANS', 'LUDWIG, EMMY', 'MARKOWITZ, ARNOLD', 'MENDELSOHN, ROBIN B', 'NISHIMURA, MAKOTO', 'SCHATTNER, MARK A', 'SHIKE, MOSHE', 'NEWFIELD, JACLYN', 'KURTZ, ROBERT', 'HUSTA, BRYAN CHRISTOPHER', 'CHAWLA, MOHIT', 'VANDER ELS, NICHOLAS') ) SELECT CDD_DOC_NAME AS "DOCUMENT NAME", OP_DISPLAY_NAME AS "PROVIDER", OP_PROV_TYPE AS "PROVIDER TYPE", CDD_SERVICE_DTE AS "SERVICE DATE", CDD_MRN AS "MRN", CDD_DOC_GUID AS "DOCUMENT GUID", CDO_SECTION AS "SECTION", CDO_ITEM_NAME AS "ITEM", CDO_VALUE_TEXT AS "VALUE", CDO_CTLG_DISPL_NM FROM IDB.CD_DOCUMENT LEFT JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION ON CDD_DOC_GUID = CDO_DOC_GUID AND CDD_AUTHORED_DTE = CDO_AUTHORED_DTE AND CDO_VALUE_TEXT <> '' JOIN IDB.OMS_PROVIDER ON CDD_AUTH_PROV_GUID = OP_PVDR_GUID JOIN APPTS ON MRN = CDD_MRN WHERE CDD_CANCEL_IND <> '1' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND <> '1' AND CDD_SERVICE_DTE >= '2019-11-01' AND CDD_DOC_NAME IN ('Adult Health Screening, Ambulatory - Nursing', 'Nursing Encounter, Outpatient - Surgery-Assessment', 'Nursing Encounter, Outpatient - Surgery-Medication Administr', 'Nursing Encounter, Outpatient - Surgery-Nursing Intervention', 'Nursing Encounter, Outpatient - Surgery-Other', 'Nursing Encounter, Outpatient - Surgery-Patient Education', 'Nursing Health Assessment-Outpatient', 'Pre-Procedure/Surgery, Part 1 - Nursing', 'Telephone/Electronic Communication, Nursing', 'Telephone/Electronic Communication, Nursing-Care Coordinate', 'Telephone/Electronic Communication, Nursing-Homecare', 'Telephone/Electronic Communication, Nursing-Insur Verif', 'Telephone/Electronic Communication, Nursing-Lab', 'Telephone/Electronic Communication, Nursing-Patient Edu', 'Telephone/Electronic Communication, Nursing-Pre New Visit', 'Telephone/Electronic Communication, Nursing-Prescription', 'Telephone/Electronic Communication, Nursing-Reassessment', 'Telephone/Electronic Communication, Nursing-Symptom Mgt', 'Telephone/Electronic Communication, Nursing-Treatment Care')

prompt: Provide a weekly list of patients who have been assigned the Values Facing Cancer Worksheet and Values Worksheet Data Collection Survey on MSK engage, with each patient's completion status.
completion: SELECT EA_ASSESS_ID SURVEY_ID, ES_SURV_NAME SURVEY_NAME, EPI_MRN MRN, EPI_LAST_NAME LAST_NAME, EPI_FIRST_NAME FIRST_NAME, EA_ASSIGN_DT ASSIGNED_DT, MAX(CASE WHEN EA_SUBM_DT IS NOT NULL THEN EA_SUBM_DT END) SUBMITTION_DT, EA_EXPIRY_DT EXPIRY_DT, EAS_ASSESS_STS ASSESSMENT_STATUS FROM IDB.EF_SURVEY JOIN IDB.EF_ASSESSMENT ON EA_SURV_ID = ES_SURV_ID JOIN IDB.EF_PATIENT_INFO ON EPI_PT_INFO_ID = EA_PT_INFO_ID AND EA_SURV_ID IN (122, 123) AND DATE(EA_ASSIGN_DT) < CURRENT DATE LEFT JOIN IDB.EF_SURVEY_ELEMENT ON ES_SURV_ID = ESE_SURV_ID JOIN IDB.EF_ASSESSMENT_STS ON EAS_ASSESS_STS_ID = EA_STS_ID WHERE ES_SURV_ALIAS IN ('values_worksheet', 'valuesworksheet_datacollection') GROUP BY EA_ASSESS_ID, ES_SURV_NAME, EPI_MRN, EPI_LAST_NAME, EPI_FIRST_NAME, EPI_GENDER, EPI_BIRTH_DTE, EPI_EMAIL, EPI_RACE, EPI_ETHNICITY , EA_EXPIRY_DT, EA_ASSIGN_DT, EAS_ASSESS_STS ORDER BY EA_ASSESS_ID ; WITH CTE AS (SELECT EA_ASSESS_ID SRV_ID, ES_SURV_NAME SURVEY_NAME, EPI_MRN MRN, EPI_LAST_NAME LAST_NAME, EPI_FIRST_NAME FIRST_NAME, EA_ASSIGN_DT ASSIGNED_DT, MAX(CASE WHEN EA_SUBM_DT IS NOT NULL THEN EA_SUBM_DT END) SUBMITTION_DT, EA_EXPIRY_DT EXPIRY_DT, EAS_ASSESS_STS ASSESSMENT_STATUS FROM IDB.EF_SURVEY JOIN IDB.EF_ASSESSMENT ON EA_SURV_ID = ES_SURV_ID JOIN IDB.EF_PATIENT_INFO ON EPI_PT_INFO_ID = EA_PT_INFO_ID AND EA_SURV_ID IN (122, 123) AND DATE(EA_ASSIGN_DT) < CURRENT DATE LEFT JOIN IDB.EF_SURVEY_ELEMENT ON ES_SURV_ID = ESE_SURV_ID JOIN IDB.EF_ASSESSMENT_STS ON EAS_ASSESS_STS_ID = EA_STS_ID WHERE ES_SURV_ALIAS IN ('values_worksheet', 'valuesworksheet_datacollection') GROUP BY EA_ASSESS_ID, ES_SURV_NAME, EPI_MRN, EPI_LAST_NAME, EPI_FIRST_NAME, EPI_GENDER, EPI_BIRTH_DTE, EPI_EMAIL, EPI_RACE, EPI_ETHNICITY , EA_EXPIRY_DT, EA_ASSIGN_DT, EAS_ASSESS_STS) , SURVEYS AS (SELECT ERESP_ASSESS_ID , LT.ELT_TRANSLATION AS QUESTION , R.ERESP_ID AS RESPONSEID, ETBR_ID, NR.ENR_NO, COALESCE(ALT.ELT_TRANSLATION, TR.ETBR_TEXT) AS "Answer" , CHAR(INT(NR.ENR_NO))AS NUMBERRESPONSE FROM CTE JOIN IDB.EF_RESPONSE R ON CTE.SRV_ID = R.ERESP_ASSESS_ID INNER JOIN IDB.EF_ANSWER A ON A.EA_ANSWER_ID = R.ERESP_ANSWER_ID LEFT OUTER JOIN IDB.EF_OPT_ANSWER O ON A.EA_ANSWER_ID= O.EOA_ID INNER JOIN IDB.EF_QUESTION Q ON Q.EQ_QUESTION_ID = A.EA_QUESTION_ID INNER JOIN IDB.EF_RESOURCE RES ON Q.EQ_RESOURCE_ID = RES.ER_RES_ID INNER JOIN IDB.EF_LOCALIZATION L ON L.EL_RESOURCE_ID = RES.ER_RES_ID INNER JOIN IDB.EF_LOCALIZATION_TEXT LT ON L.EL_LOC_TXT_ID = LT.ELT_LOC_TXT_ID LEFT OUTER JOIN IDB.EF_TEXT_BOX_RESPONSE TR ON TR.ETBR_ID =R.ERESP_ID LEFT OUTER JOIN IDB.EF_NUMERIC_RESPONSE NR ON NR.ENR_ID =R.ERESP_ID LEFT OUTER JOIN IDB.EF_DYNAMIC_OPT_RESP DR ON DR.EDOR_ID =R.ERESP_ID LEFT OUTER JOIN IDB.EF_DATA_SRC_OPT_RESP DSR ON DSR.EDSOR_ID =R.ERESP_ID LEFT OUTER JOIN IDB.EF_OPT_DATA_SRC ODS ON ODS.EODS_ID =DSR.EDSOR_ID LEFT OUTER JOIN IDB.EF_OPT_DATA_SRC_VAL DSV ON DSR.EDSOR_VALUE_ID= DSV.EODSV_ID LEFT OUTER JOIN IDB.EF_COLUMN_RESP CR ON CR.ECR_ID = R.ERESP_ID LEFT OUTER JOIN IDB.EF_DATE_RESPONSE DRS ON DRS.EDR_ID= R.ERESP_ID LEFT OUTER JOIN IDB.EF_LOCALIZATION AL ON O.EOA_TXT_RES_ID= AL.EL_RESOURCE_ID LEFT OUTER JOIN IDB.EF_LOCALIZATION_TEXT ALT ON ALT.ELT_LOC_TXT_ID= AL.EL_LOC_TXT_ID) SELECT ERESP_ASSESS_ID SURVEY_ID, SURVEY_NAME, MRN, LAST_NAME, FIRST_NAME, ASSIGNED_DT, SUBMITTION_DT, EXPIRY_DT, ASSESSMENT_STATUS, QUESTION, COALESCE("Answer", NUMBERRESPONSE) "Answer" FROM CTE LEFT JOIN SURVEYS R ON CTE.SRV_ID = R.ERESP_ASSESS_ID ORDER BY MRN, SURVEY_NAME, RESPONSEID ;

prompt: Patients diagnosed with low grade serous ovarian cancer who received treatment with MEK inhibitor (ie trametinib, binimetinib)
completion: WITH TMR AS (SELECT TM_MRN, MIN(TM_DX_DTE) DX_DTE , TM_SITE_CD SITE_CD, ST.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK SITE_DESC, TM_HIST_CD HIST_CD, HS.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK HIST_DESC , MAX(CASE WHEN TM_BEST_AJCC_STG <> '' THEN TM_BEST_AJCC_STG ELSE CASE WHEN TM_AJCC <> ' ' THEN AJCC.AV_DESC ELSE CASE WHEN TM_PATH_STG_DSCR = '4' THEN TM_CLIN_STG_GRP ELSE CASE WHEN TM_PATH_STG_GRP = '99' THEN TM_CLIN_STG_GRP ELSE TM_PATH_STG_GRP END END END END) AS STAGE , G.AV_DESC AS GRADE FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR LEFT JOIN IDB.CLM ST ON ST.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD LEFT JOIN IDB.CLM HS ON HS.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS AJCC ON AJCC.AV_ELEMENT = 'AJCC' AND AJCC.AV_CODE = TM_AJCC LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS G ON G.AV_ELEMENT = 'HIST_CD_GRADE' AND G.AV_CODE = TM_HIST_CD_GRADE WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('3', '1', '6', '7') AND TM_HIST_CD IN ('M8260/3', 'M8441/3', 'M8450/3', 'M8460/3', 'M8461/3') AND TM_SITE_CD = 'C569' GROUP BY TM_MRN, TM_SITE_CD , ST.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK, TM_HIST_CD, HS.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK, G.AV_DESC) SELECT TM_MRN, RPT_PAT_NAME, DX_DTE, SITE_CD, SITE_DESC, HIST_CD, HIST_DESC, STAGE, GRADE , MIN(CPO_START_DTE) START_DTE, MAX(CPO_START_DTE) LAST_DTE, CPO_GENERIC_NAME DRUG_GENERIC_NAME FROM TMR JOIN IDB.CHEMO_PERFORMED_ORDERS ON TM_MRN = CPO_MRN JOIN IDB.RMS_PATIENT ON CPO_MRN = RPT_MRN WHERE CPO_CHEMO_IND = 'Y' AND UPPER(CPO_GENERIC_NAME) IN('AZD6244', 'BINIMETINIB', 'COBIMETINIB', 'GDC-0973', 'GSK1120212', 'MEK162', 'SELUMETINIB', 'TRAMETINIB') GROUP BY TM_MRN, RPT_PAT_NAME, DX_DTE, SITE_CD, SITE_DESC, HIST_CD, HIST_DESC, STAGE, GRADE , CPO_GENERIC_NAME

prompt:
Provide a search of the following terms in pathology reports from the past 3 years:



-Suture granuloma

-Langerhans cell hyperplasia

-Sinus histiocytosis
completion: WITH D AS (SELECT DISTINCT "t1"."PT_MRN" AS "MRN", "t1"."PT_LAST_NAME" AS "Last Name", "t1"."PT_FIRST_NAME" AS "First Name", "t1"."PT_BIRTH_DTE" AS "Date of Birth", "t1"."PT_SEX_DESC" AS "Gender", "t1"."PT_RACE_DESC" AS "Race", "t2"."CORE_ETHNICITY_DESC" AS "Ethnicity", "t1"."PT_VITAL_STATUS" AS "Vital Status", "t3"."PRPT_ACCESSION_NO" AS "Pathology Report", "t4"."DT_DTE" AS "Pathology Report Date", "t5"."PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_DESC" AS "Pathology Report Type", "t6"."DT_DTE" AS "Pathology Procedure Date" , CAST(SUBSTR("t3"."PRPT_REPORT", 1, 25000) AS VARCHAR(25000)) AS PATH_RPT FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V" "t1" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_CORE_DEMOGRAPHICS" "t2" ON "t1"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t2"."CORE_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED" "t7" ON "t1"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t7"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V" "t3" ON "t7"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t3"."PRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" "t4" ON "t3"."PRPT_REPORT_DATE_ID" = "t4"."DT_DATE_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATH_RPRT_TYPE_LOOKUP" "t5" ON "t3"."PRPT_REPORT_TYPE" = "t5"."PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_CD" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" "t6" ON "t3"."PRPT_PROCEDURE_DATE_ID" = "t6"."DT_DATE_ID" WHERE "t4"."DT_DTE" BETWEEN DATE('2018-01-01') AND DATE('2021-12-31') AND ("t3"."PRPT_REPORT" IS NOT NULL) ) SELECT * , ACD_IRB_NO, ACD_CONS_DTE , CASE WHEN LOCATE('suture granuloma', LOWER(D.PATH_RPT)) > 0 THEN SUBSTR(D.PATH_RPT, LOCATE('suture granuloma', LOWER(D.PATH_RPT)), 35) END "Suture Granuloma" , CASE WHEN LOCATE('langerhans cell hyperplasia', LOWER(D.PATH_RPT)) > 0 THEN SUBSTR(D.PATH_RPT, LOCATE('langerhans cell hyperplasia', LOWER(D.PATH_RPT)), 55) END "Langerhans cell hyperplasia" , CASE WHEN LOCATE('sinus histiocytosis', LOWER(D.PATH_RPT)) > 0 THEN SUBSTR(D.PATH_RPT, LOCATE('sinus histiocytosis', LOWER(D.PATH_RPT)), 55) END "Sinus histiocytosis" FROM D JOIN IDB.ACCRUALS_DATES ON ACD_MRN = "MRN" AND ACD_IRB_NO IN('06-107', '12-245', '17-516', '15-021') WHERE LOCATE('suture granuloma', LOWER(D.PATH_RPT)) > 0 OR LOCATE('langerhans cell hyperplasia', LOWER(D.PATH_RPT)) > 0 OR LOCATE('sinus histiocytosis', LOWER(D.PATH_RPT)) > 0

prompt: Provide a daily list of patients who are  65 years or older ,seen in Surgery with either diabetes requiring medication or insulin or smoking history, including protocols currently on.
completion: SELECT DISTINCT OC_MRN , YEAR(OC_SURG_DTE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) AS AGE, TRIM(PT_LAST_NAME) || ', ' || TRIM(PT_FIRST_NAME) AS PATIENT_NAME, PT_EMAIL_ADDRESS AS EMAIL FROM IDB.OR_CASE JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PT_MRN = OC_MRN WHERE OC_SURG_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT date + 7 DAYS AND CURRENT date + 13 DAYS AND OC_OR_CASE_STS_CD NOT IN ('2', '5') AND PT_DEATH_IND IN ('', 'A') AND YEAR(OC_SURG_DTE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) >= 65 ORDER BY 1; WITH APPT AS (SELECT OC_MRN, OC_SURG_DTE AS SURGERY_DATE, CASE_LOCATION, YEAR(OC_SURG_DTE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) AS AGE, TRIM(PT_LAST_NAME) || ', ' || TRIM(PT_FIRST_NAME) AS PATIENT_NAME, PT_EMAIL_ADDRESS AS EMAIL, OC_PT_CLASS AS PATIENT_CLASS, AV_DESC AS PATIENT_CLASS_DESC, CPX_PROC_CD AS CPT_CODE, TRIM(CPX_PROC_NAME) AS CPT_DESC, CRE_RES_NAME AS SURGEON, OC_SURG_SVC AS SERVICE, OC_DAYS_STAY FROM IDB.OR_CASE JOIN IDB.OR_CASE_ALL_PROC ON OC_CASE_ID = OCAP_CASE_ID JOIN IDB.OR_CASE_ALL_SURG ON OCAP_CASE_ID = OCAS_CASE_ID AND OCAS_PNL_NO = OCAP_PNL_NO AND OCAS_SURG_ROLE = 'Primary' JOIN IDB.OR_PROC ON OCAP_OR_PROC_ID = OP_OR_PROC_ID JOIN IDB.OR_CL_PROC ON OP_OR_PROC_ID = OCP_OR_PROC_ID JOIN IDB.CL_PROC ON OCP_PROC_ID = CPX_PROC_ID JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CRE_RES_ID = OCAS_RES_ID JOIN IDB.PERIOP_CASE_EVENT_V ON OC_CASE_ID = CASE_NUMBER JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PT_MRN = OC_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS ON AV_CODE = OC_PT_CLASS AND AV_ELEMENT = 'PT_CLASS' WHERE OC_SURG_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT date + 7 DAYS AND CURRENT date + 13 DAYS AND OC_OR_CASE_STS_CD NOT IN ('2', '5') AND PT_DEATH_IND IN ('', 'A') AND YEAR(OC_SURG_DTE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) >= 65 ) , DX AS (SELECT CC_MRN, MAX(CASE WHEN CC_CLSF_CD BETWEEN 'E08' AND 'E13.99' OR CC_CLSF_CD BETWEEN '250' AND '250.99' THEN 'Y' END) AS DIABETES_FLAG FROM APPT JOIN IDB.CTC_CLSF ON OC_MRN = CC_MRN JOIN IDB.CLM A ON A.CLM_CLSF_CD = CC_CLSF_CD AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND ((CC_PT_TYPE = 'I') OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) AND (CC_CLSF_CD BETWEEN 'E08' AND 'E13.99' OR CC_CLSF_CD BETWEEN '250' AND '250.99') GROUP BY CC_MRN) , HOME_MED AS (SELECT MRN, LISTAGG(DRUG, ', ') DRUG_LIST FROM (SELECT DISTINCT HCPR_MRN MRN, HCPR_DRUG_NAME, CASE WHEN LOWER(HCPR_DRUG_NAME) LIKE '%metformin%' THEN 'metformin' WHEN LOWER(HCPR_DRUG_NAME) LIKE '%glipizide%' THEN 'glipizide' WHEN LOWER(HCPR_DRUG_NAME) LIKE '%glyburide%' THEN 'glyburide' WHEN LOWER(HCPR_DRUG_NAME) LIKE '%glimepiride%' THEN 'glimepiride' WHEN LOWER(HCPR_DRUG_NAME) LIKE '%insulin%' THEN 'insulin' ELSE '' END AS DRUG FROM APPT LEFT JOIN IDB.HML_CLIENT_PRESCRIPTION HCPR ON HCPR_MRN= OC_MRN WHERE HCPR_GENERIC_NAME_ID != -100 AND (HCPR_PRESCRIPTION_TYPE = 1 AND HCPR_TRANSMISSION_STATUS IN (1, 2, 5) OR HCPR_PRESCRIPTION_TYPE = 3) AND HCPR_STATUS_TYPE_DESC = 'Active' AND (LOWER(HCPR_DRUG_NAME) LIKE '%metformin%' OR LOWER(HCPR_DRUG_NAME) LIKE '%glipizide%' OR LOWER(HCPR_DRUG_NAME) LIKE '%glyburide%' OR LOWER(HCPR_DRUG_NAME) LIKE '%glimepiride%' OR LOWER(HCPR_DRUG_NAME) LIKE '%insulin%' ) ) GROUP BY MRN) , SMO_HX AS (SELECT CDD_MRN , CDD_SERVICE_DTE, CDO_SECTION, TRIM(CDO_ITEM_NAME) ITEM_NAME, TRIM(CDO_VALUE_TEXT) SMOKING_HX, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CDD_MRN, CDO_ITEM_NAME ORDER BY CDD_SERVICE_DTE DESC) AS SMO_RN FROM IDB.CD_DOCUMENT LEFT JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION ON CDD_DOC_GUID = CDO_DOC_GUID AND CDD_AUTHORED_DTE = CDO_AUTHORED_DTE AND CDO_VALUE_TEXT <> '' JOIN APPT ON OC_MRN = CDD_MRN WHERE CDD_CANCEL_IND <> '1' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND <> '1' AND UPPER(CDO_SECTION) ='SOCIAL HISTORY' AND UPPER(CDO_ITEM_NAME) ='SMOKING STATUS' ) , ASH AS (SELECT ASH_MRN, ASH_ENC_DTE, ASH_TOBACCO_USED_YEARS PACK_YRS, ASH_TOBACCO_COMMENT COMMENTS, ASH_SMOKING_QUIT_DTE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ASH_MRN ORDER BY ASH_ENC_DTE DESC) RN FROM IDB.AN_SOCIAL_HX JOIN APPT ON ASH_MRN = OC_MRN) , ACC AS (SELECT AC_MRN, LISTAGG(AC_IRB_NO, ',') PROTOCOLS FROM IDB.ACCRUALS JOIN APPT ON OC_MRN = AC_MRN GROUP BY AC_MRN) , ORD AS (SELECT OO_MRN, TRIM(OO_ORD_NAME) AS ORDER_NAME, OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE AS ORDER_DATE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY OO_MRN, OO_ORD_STS_CD ORDER BY OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE DESC) ORD_RN, OSTS_STS_DESC AS ORDER_STATUS FROM IDB.OMS_ORDER JOIN IDB.OMS_STATUS ON OO_ORD_STS_CD = OSTS_ORD_STS_CD JOIN APPT ON OO_MRN = OC_MRN WHERE OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID IN ('9000015486300730', '2000001302073001' ) AND OO_ORD_STS_CD NOT IN ('CANP', 'CANC', 'AUC3') ) SELECT DISTINCT OC_MRN AS MRN, AGE AS "Age as of surgery", SURGERY_DATE , CASE_LOCATION, OC_DAYS_STAY AS "Length of Stay", CPT_CODE, CPT_DESC, SURGEON, SERVICE AS "Surgery Service", ORDER_DATE AS "DNR Order Date", ORDER_STATUS AS "DNR Order Status", DRUG_LIST, DIABETES_FLAG, SMOKING_HX , PROTOCOLS AS "Protocols (Accrued)", PACK_YRS || '-' || TRIM(COMMENTS) AS TOBACCO_USE FROM APPT A LEFT JOIN DX ON OC_MRN = CC_MRN LEFT JOIN HOME_MED ON OC_MRN = MRN LEFT JOIN ACC ON AC_MRN = OC_MRN LEFT JOIN SMO_HX ON CDD_MRN = OC_MRN AND SMO_RN =1 LEFT JOIN ASH ON ASH_MRN = OC_MRN AND RN=1 LEFT JOIN ORD ON OO_MRN = OC_MRN AND ORD_RN =1 WHERE NOT (SMOKING_HX LIKE '%Never%' AND DIABETES_FLAG ='N') ;

prompt: Provide list of all patients who recieved synagis (palivuzimab) from 9-12-10 to 12-12-11 based on medication administration records.
completion: SELECT OO_MRN MRN , STRIP(PT_LAST_NAME)||', '||STRIP(PT_FIRST_NAME) AS PT_NAME , OO_ORD_NAME AS ORDER_NAME, OO_ORD_FREQ FREQ , OU_DISPLAY_NAME AS REQUESTER, OU_ORD_ROLE_TYPE REQUESTER_TYPE , DOC_SVC SVC, OCV_CURR_LOC AS LOCATION , OOTO_SIGNIFIC_DTE ADMIN_DATE , OOTO_TASK_DOSE DOSE, OOTO_TASK_UOM UOM, OCV_IP_OP_IND IP_OP_IND FROM IDB.OMS_ORDER JOIN IDB.OMS_CLIENT_VISIT ON OO_VISIT_GUID = OCV_VISIT_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_CATALOG ON OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID = OOC_MSTR_ITEM_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_USER ON OO_PVDR_GUID = OU_USER_GUID JOIN IDB.DOC ON OO_REQ_DR_NO = DOC_DR_NO JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PT_MRN = OO_MRN JOIN IDB.OMS_CTLG_CLASS_TYP OC ON OC.OCCT_MST_ITEM_GUID = OOC_MSTR_ITEM_GUID AND OC.OCCT_CLASS_TYPE_CD = 'HVC-OrderCategory' AND OC.OCCT_VALUE = 'Anti-Infectives' JOIN IDB.OAS_ORD_TASK_OCCR ON OOTO_ORD_GUID = OO_ORD_GUID AND OOTO_STATUS_CD = 'Performed' AND OOTO_SIGNIFIC_DTE = OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE JOIN IDB.OAS_CTLG_ITEM_TASK ON OOTO_CAT_ITEM_GUID = OCIT_GUID AND OCIT_LEVEL_NO = 0 WHERE OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE BETWEEN '2010-09-12' AND '2011-12-12' AND OO_ORD_STS_CD NOT IN ('CANC', 'CANP') AND OO_ORD_TYPE_CD = 'Medication' AND OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID = '2000004193073029'

prompt: Marketing and communications need list of Employee ID and Email Addresses
completion: WITH DEMO AS (SELECT CVP_EMPLOYEE_ID, CVP_EMAIL_ADDR, CEVE_CATEGORY FROM IDB.COVID19_VACCINE_PERSON JOIN IDB.COVID19_EMPLOYEE_VACCINE_ELIGIBLE_V ON CVP_EMPLOYEE_ID = CEVE_EMPLOYEE_ID WHERE YEAR(CURRENT_DATE - CVP_BIRTH_DTE) >= 50 AND ON_LEAVE <> 'Y' AND CEVE_CATEGORY = 'Employees' ) SELECT EVI_EMPLOYEE_ID, CVP_EMAIL_ADDR, DOSE_ADDL_ADMIN_DTE, DOSE_ADDL_ADMIN_DTE + 116 DAYS ADMIN_DTE_PLUS_116_DAYS FROM IDB.COVID19_EMPLOYEE_VACCINE_INFO I JOIN DEMO D ON EVI_EMPLOYEE_ID = CVP_EMPLOYEE_ID WHERE DOSE_ADDL_ADMIN_DTE IS NOT NULL ORDER BY DOSE_ADDL_ADMIN_DTE DESC

prompt: Provide list of patients in Breast service  who are added in Clin Doc transition to community data ( Rerun of  MED25305 , w/ new timeframe from June 20, 2022-report run date )
completion: WITH APPTS AS (SELECT CPE_MRN, TRIM(PT_LAST_NAME) || ', ' || TRIM(PT_FIRST_NAME) AS PATIENT_NAME, TRIM(CRE_RES_NAME) AS PROVIDER_NAME, TRIM(CLD_DEPT_NAME) AS DEPARTMENT, TRIM(CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME) AS VISIT_TYPE, CPE_ENC_DTE AS APPOINTMENT_DATE FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.PATIENT P ON P.PT_MRN = CPE_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN '2022-06-20' AND CURRENT date AND CLD_DEPT_NAME IN ('BAIC 300 E66', 'CMK SURVIVORSHIP', 'NAS SURVIVORSHIP-2', 'BSK SURVIVORSHIP-4', 'MON BRE DMT-2 SVR', 'MON BRE DMT-C SVR', 'MON BRE DMT-LC SVR', 'BREAST DMT WES SVR', 'BRE MED 300 E66 SVRSHP', 'BREAST 300 E66 SVRSHP', 'BREAST DMT 300 E66 SVR') AND CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR NOT IN ('FX', 'INJ', 'TEL APP IR', 'TEL APP AFR' ) ) , EAD AS (SELECT EAD_MRN, EADT_EMR_DESC, A.CPE_MRN AS MRN FROM APPTS A JOIN (SELECT EAD_MRN, EADT_EMR_DESC FROM IDB.EMR_AA_DOCUMENT JOIN IDB.EMR_AA_DOCTYPE ON EAD_DOCTYPE = EADT_DOCTYPE AND VALUE(EAD_RIGHT_ID, EADT_RIGHT_ID) = 167 AND EAD_DOCTYPE = 'WB5') E ON E.EAD_MRN = A.CPE_MRN) , Q1 AS (SELECT DISTINCT CDD_MRN Q1_MRN, TRIM(CDO_ITEM_NAME) AS Q1, TRIM(CDO_VALUE_TEXT) AS Q1_VALUE FROM APPTS JOIN IDB.CD_DOCUMENT ON CDD_MRN = CPE_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION ON CDD_DOC_GUID = CDO_DOC_GUID AND CDD_AUTHORED_DTE = CDO_AUTHORED_DTE WHERE CDD_CANCEL_IND <> '1' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND <> '1' AND CDD_DOC_NAME like 'Follow Up, APP, AMB - Survivorship%' AND CDD_SERVICE_DTE >= '2022-06-20' AND CDO_SECTION IN ('MEDICAL DECISION MAKING' , 'OBJECTIVE/ASSESSMENT & PLAN' ) AND CDO_ITEM_NAME ='Is patient eligible (per Breast Survivorship Guidelines) for transition of care to local PCP/Provider?' ) , Q2 AS (SELECT DISTINCT CDD_MRN Q2_MRN, TRIM(CDO_ITEM_NAME) AS Q2, TRIM(CDO_VALUE_TEXT) AS Q2_VALUE FROM APPTS JOIN IDB.CD_DOCUMENT ON CDD_MRN = CPE_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION ON CDD_DOC_GUID = CDO_DOC_GUID AND CDD_AUTHORED_DTE = CDO_AUTHORED_DTE WHERE CDD_CANCEL_IND <> '1' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND <> '1' AND CDD_DOC_NAME like 'Follow Up, APP, AMB - Survivorship%' AND CDD_SERVICE_DTE >= '2022-06-20' AND CDO_SECTION IN ('MEDICAL DECISION MAKING' , 'OBJECTIVE/ASSESSMENT & PLAN') AND CDO_ITEM_NAME = 'Did patient accept?' ) , Q3 AS (SELECT DISTINCT CDD_MRN Q3_MRN, TRIM(CDO_ITEM_NAME) AS Q3, TRIM(CDO_VALUE_TEXT) AS Q3_VALUE FROM APPTS JOIN IDB.CD_DOCUMENT ON CDD_MRN = CPE_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION ON CDD_DOC_GUID = CDO_DOC_GUID AND CDD_AUTHORED_DTE = CDO_AUTHORED_DTE WHERE CDD_CANCEL_IND <> '1' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND <> '1' AND CDD_DOC_NAME like 'Follow Up, APP, AMB - Survivorship%' AND CDD_SERVICE_DTE >= '2022-06-20' AND CDO_SECTION IN ('MEDICAL DECISION MAKING' , 'OBJECTIVE/ASSESSMENT & PLAN') AND CDO_ITEM_NAME = 'Reason declines' ) SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN AS MRN, PATIENT_NAME AS "Patient Name", PROVIDER_NAME AS "Provider Name" , DEPARTMENT, VISIT_TYPE AS "Visit Type", APPOINTMENT_DATE AS "Appointment Date" , CASE WHEN EAD_MRN IS NOT NULL THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS "Transition to community?", Q1_VALUE AS "Is patient eligible (per Breast Survivorship Guidelines) for transition of care to local PCP/Provider?" , Q2_VALUE AS "Did patient accept?", Q3_VALUE AS "Reason declines" FROM APPTS A LEFT JOIN EAD E ON EAD_MRN = A.CPE_MRN LEFT JOIN Q1 ON Q1_MRN = CPE_MRN LEFT JOIN Q2 ON Q2_MRN = CPE_MRN LEFT JOIN Q3 ON Q3_MRN = CPE_MRN

prompt: Provide an updated list of MM patients receiving RT from 1/2023 through 12/2023.
completion: WITH X AS (SELECT DISTINCT CC_MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS MIN_ICD9_EFF_DTE, CC_CLSF_CD AS ICD9_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS ICD9_DESC FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE (CC_CLSF_CD) IN ('203', '203.0', '203.00', '203.01', '203.02', 'C90', 'C90.00', 'C90.01', 'C90.02', 'C90.10', 'C90.11', 'C90.12', 'C90.20', 'C90.21', 'C90.22', 'C90.30', 'C90.31', 'C90.32') AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND (CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) GROUP BY CC_MRN, CC_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK ), RAD AS (SELECT DISTINCT RTC_TX_MRN, RTC_TX_COURSE_NO, RTC_TX_PLANSETUP_NO, RTC_TX_COURSE_ID, RTC_TX_PLAN_NAME, RTC_TX_PLANNED_FRACTIONS, RTC_TX_DELIVERED_FRACTIONS, RTC_TX_PLANNED_DOSE, RTC_TX_DELIVERED_DOSE, RTC_TX_START_DTE, RTC_TX_STOP_DTE, RTC_TX_ELAPSED_DAYS, RTC_PRIMARY_REF_POINT, RTC_DOSE_CORRECTION FROM X JOIN IDB.RADONC_TREATMENT_COURSE ON X.CC_MRN = RTC_TX_MRN WHERE RTC_TX_START_DTE BETWEEN '2023-01-01' AND '2023-12-31' ) , BMT AS (SELECT DISTINCT CDD_MRN BMT_MRN, CDD_SERVICE_DTE AS BMT_DATE, CDD_DOC_NAME AS "Document Name", OP_DISPLAY_NAME AS "Provider", CDO_SECTION AS "Section", CDO_ITEM_NAME AS "Item", CDO_VALUE_TEXT AS "Value" FROM RAD JOIN IDB.CD_DOCUMENT ON RTC_TX_MRN= CDD_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION ON CDD_DOC_GUID = CDO_DOC_GUID AND CDD_AUTHORED_DTE = CDO_AUTHORED_DTE AND CDO_VALUE_TEXT <> '' JOIN IDB.OMS_PROVIDER ON CDD_AUTH_PROV_GUID = OP_PVDR_GUID WHERE CDD_CANCEL_IND <> '1' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND <> '1' AND ((CDD_DOC_NAME) IN 'Cell Infusion - BMT') AND CDD_SERVICE_DTE <=RTC_TX_START_DTE ) , CHEMO AS (SELECT DISTINCT * FROM (SELECT APR_MRN CHEMO_MRN, APR_START_DTE CHEMO_DATE, APR_END_DTE, CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME CHEMO_GENERIC_NAME, APR_GENERIC_NAME, CDG_CHEMO_FLAG, APR_PRESCRIBED_DOSE, APR_ROUTE, ROWNUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY APR_MRN ORDER BY APR_START_DTE DESC) RN FROM RAD JOIN IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX_V ON RTC_TX_MRN= APR_MRN WHERE APR_START_DTE <=RTC_TX_START_DTE AND CDG_CHEMO_FLAG = 'Y' ) WHERE RN=1 ) , IMMUNO AS (SELECT DISTINCT * FROM (SELECT DISTINCT APR_MRN IMMUNO_MRN , APR_START_DTE IMMUNO_DATE, APR_END_DTE, CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME IMMUNO_GENERIC_NAME, APR_GENERIC_NAME, APR_PRESCRIBED_DOSE, CDG_BIOLOGIC_IMMUNO_FLAG, APR_ROUTE, ROWNUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY APR_MRN ORDER BY APR_START_DTE DESC) RN FROM RAD JOIN IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX ON RTC_TX_MRN =APR_MRN JOIN IDB.CHEMO_DRUG_GENERIC ON APR_GENERIC_NAME = CDG_GENERIC_NAME WHERE CDG_BIOLOGIC_IMMUNO_FLAG = 'Y' AND CDG_THERAPEUTIC_CATEGORY like '%anti-%' ) WHERE RN=1 ) , NOTE AS (SELECT DISTINCT CDD_MRN, MD_NOTE_DATE FROM (SELECT DISTINCT CDD_MRN, CDD_SERVICE_DTE AS MD_NOTE_DATE, CDD_DOC_NAME AS "Document Name", OP_DISPLAY_NAME AS "Provider", CDD_DOC_GUID AS "Document Guid", CDO_SECTION AS "Section", CDO_ITEM_NAME AS "Item", CDO_VALUE_TEXT AS "Value", ROWNUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY CDD_MRN ORDER BY CDD_SERVICE_DTE DESC) RNK FROM RAD JOIN IDB.CD_DOCUMENT ON RTC_TX_MRN= CDD_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION ON CDD_DOC_GUID = CDO_DOC_GUID AND CDD_AUTHORED_DTE = CDO_AUTHORED_DTE AND CDO_VALUE_TEXT <> '' JOIN IDB.OMS_PROVIDER ON CDD_AUTH_PROV_GUID = OP_PVDR_GUID WHERE CDD_CANCEL_IND <> '1' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND <> '1' AND (UPPER(CDD_DOC_NAME) like 'FOLLOW%UP%' OR UPPER(CDD_DOC_NAME) like 'PROGRESS%NOTE%BMT%') ) WHERE RNK=1 ) SELECT DISTINCT RTC_TX_MRN MRN, PT_LAST_NAME AS "Last Name", PT_FIRST_NAME AS "First Name", PT_GENDER AS "Gender", PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH AS "Date of Birth", PT_DATE_OF_DEATH AS "Date of Death", CASE WHEN PT_DATE_OF_DEATH IS NULL THEN 'Alive' ELSE 'Deceased' END AS "Vital Status", R.AV_DESC AS "Race", E.AV_DESC AS "Ethnicity", RTC_TX_START_DTE AS "Treatment Start Date", RTC_TX_STOP_DTE AS "Treatment End Date", RTC_TX_COURSE_ID AS "Treatment Course ID", RTC_TX_PLAN_NAME AS "Treatment Plan Name", RTC_TX_PLANNED_FRACTIONS AS "Treatment Planned Fractions", RTC_TX_DELIVERED_FRACTIONS AS "Treatment Delivered Fractions", RTC_TX_PLANNED_DOSE AS "Treatment Planned Dose", RTC_TX_DELIVERED_DOSE AS "Treatment Delivered Dose", RTC_TX_ELAPSED_DAYS AS "Treatment Elapsed Days", RTC_PRIMARY_REF_POINT AS "Primary Ref Point", RTC_DOSE_CORRECTION AS "Treatment Dose Correction", CHEMO_DATE AS "Last Chemo Date", CHEMO_GENERIC_NAME AS "Last Chemo Generic Name", IMMUNO_DATE AS "Last Immuno Date", IMMUNO_GENERIC_NAME AS "Last Immuno Generic Name", BMT_DATE AS "Last BMT Date", MD_NOTE_DATE FROM RAD LEFT JOIN BMT ON RTC_TX_MRN = BMT_MRN LEFT JOIN CHEMO ON RTC_TX_MRN = CHEMO_MRN LEFT JOIN IMMUNO ON RTC_TX_MRN = IMMUNO_MRN LEFT JOIN NOTE ON RTC_TX_MRN = CDD_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON RTC_TX_MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS R ON R.AV_ELEMENT = 'RACE' AND R.AV_CODE = PT_RACE LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS E ON E.AV_ELEMENT = 'PT_ETHNICITY' AND E.AV_CODE = PT_PT_ETHNICITY ORDER BY RTC_TX_MRN

prompt: Weekly report of incomplete Nursing Procedure Lab Medicine Note
completion: SELECT MAX(CASE WHEN CDO_MSTR_ITEM_NM = 'DON_NUR Patient Status Location RES' THEN TRIM(SUBSTR(CDO_VALUE_TEXT, 1, 200)) END) AS "Patient Status Location", CDD_MRN AS "MRN", CDD_SERVICE_DTE AS "Service Date" FROM IDB.CD_DOCUMENT LEFT JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION ON CDD_DOC_GUID = CDO_DOC_GUID AND CDD_AUTHORED_DTE = CDO_AUTHORED_DTE AND CDO_VALUE_TEXT <> '' JOIN IDB.OMS_PROVIDER ON CDD_AUTH_PROV_GUID = OP_PVDR_GUID WHERE CDD_CANCEL_IND <> '1' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND = '1' AND CDD_DOC_NAME = 'Nursing Procedure - Lab Medicine' AND CDD_SERVICE_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT DATE - 7 DAYS AND CURRENT DATE GROUP BY CDD_MRN, CDD_SERVICE_DTE ORDER BY 1, 3 DESC

prompt: Provide a list of splenectomies done at MSK in 2010.
completion: SELECT PT_MRN AS "MRN", PT_LAST_NAME AS "Last Name", PT_FIRST_NAME AS "First Name", PBC_CPT_CD AS "CPT Code", CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS "CPT Description", PBD_SVC_DTE AS "CPT Procedure Date" FROM IDB.PATIENT JOIN IDB.PBD_DTL ON PT_MRN = PBD_MRN JOIN IDB.PBD_CODE ON PBD_PBD_CD = PBC_PBD_CD JOIN IDB.CLM ON PBC_CPT_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE PBC_CPT_CD IN ('38100', '38101', '38120', '38129', '49220') AND PBD_SVC_DTE BETWEEN '2010-01-01' AND '2010-12-31'

prompt: Provide data on patients who started pemetrexed in 2008.
completion: WITH PEM AS (SELECT POD_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID AS PEM_DEID, LAST_STOP_DTE AS LAST_PEM_DTE FROM DV.PHM_PT_MEDS_MQT JOIN DV.PHM_INVENTORY_CATALOG ON POD_PHARMA_INVENTORY_CTLG_ID = PINC_INVENTORY_CTLG_ID WHERE PINC_GENERIC_NAME = 'Pemetrexed' AND FIST_START_DTE BETWEEN '2008-1-1' AND '2008-12-31') SELECT PT_MRN AS "MRN", PINC_GENERIC_NAME AS "Generic Drug Name", FIST_START_DTE AS "First Order Start Date", LAST_STOP_DTE AS "Last Order Stop Date", SUM(POD_NET_ACCUM_DOSE) AS "Dose Count", SUM(POD_DOSE*POD_NET_ACCUM_DOSE) AS "Total Dose (Dose Count x Dose)", POD_DOSE_UNIT AS "Dose Units" FROM DV.PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V ON PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID JOIN DV.PHM_PT_MEDS_MQT MQT ON PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = MQT.POD_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID JOIN DV.PHM_INVENTORY_CATALOG CAT ON MQT.POD_PHARMA_INVENTORY_CTLG_ID = PINC_INVENTORY_CTLG_ID JOIN DV.PHM_ORDER_DTL DTL ON MQT.POD_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = DTL.POD_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID AND MQT.POD_PHARMA_INVENTORY_CTLG_ID = DTL.POD_PHARMA_INVENTORY_CTLG_ID JOIN PEM ON PEM_DEID = MQT.POD_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID AND LAST_STOP_DTE <= LAST_PEM_DTE WHERE CAT.PINC_CHEMO_IND = 'Y' GROUP BY PT_MRN, PINC_GENERIC_NAME, FIST_START_DTE, LAST_STOP_DTE, POD_DOSE_UNIT WITH PEM AS (SELECT POD_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID AS PEM_DEID, LAST_STOP_DTE AS LAST_PEM_DTE FROM DV.PHM_PT_MEDS_MQT JOIN DV.PHM_INVENTORY_CATALOG ON POD_PHARMA_INVENTORY_CTLG_ID = PINC_INVENTORY_CTLG_ID WHERE PINC_GENERIC_NAME = 'Pemetrexed' AND FIST_START_DTE BETWEEN '2008-1-1' AND '2008-12-31') SELECT PT_MRN AS "MRN", PINC_GENERIC_NAME AS "Generic Drug Name", FIST_START_DTE AS "First Order Start Date", START.DT_DTE AS "Start Date", STOP.DT_DTE AS "Stop Date", POD_NET_ACCUM_DOSE AS "Dose Count", POD_DOSE AS "Dose", POD_DOSE*POD_NET_ACCUM_DOSE AS "Total Dose (Dose Count x Dose)", POD_DOSE_UNIT AS "Dose Units" FROM DV.PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V ON PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID JOIN DV.PHM_PT_MEDS_MQT MQT ON PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = MQT.POD_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID JOIN DV.PHM_INVENTORY_CATALOG CAT ON MQT.POD_PHARMA_INVENTORY_CTLG_ID = PINC_INVENTORY_CTLG_ID JOIN DV.PHM_ORDER_DTL DTL ON MQT.POD_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = DTL.POD_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID AND MQT.POD_PHARMA_INVENTORY_CTLG_ID = DTL.POD_PHARMA_INVENTORY_CTLG_ID JOIN PEM ON PEM_DEID = MQT.POD_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID AND LAST_STOP_DTE <= LAST_PEM_DTE JOIN DV.DATE START ON POD_START_DATE_ID = START.DT_DATE_ID JOIN DV.DATE STOP ON POD_STOP_DATE_ID = STOP.DT_DATE_ID WHERE CAT.PINC_CHEMO_IND = 'Y' WITH PEM AS (SELECT DISTINCT MQT.POD_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID AS PEM_DEID, DT_DTE AS PEM_DTE FROM DV.PHM_PT_MEDS_MQT MQT JOIN DV.PHM_INVENTORY_CATALOG CAT ON POD_PHARMA_INVENTORY_CTLG_ID = PINC_INVENTORY_CTLG_ID JOIN DV.PHM_ORDER_DTL DTL ON MQT.POD_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = DTL.POD_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID AND MQT.POD_PHARMA_INVENTORY_CTLG_ID = DTL.POD_PHARMA_INVENTORY_CTLG_ID JOIN DV.DATE ON POD_START_DATE_ID = DT_DATE_ID WHERE CAT.PINC_GENERIC_NAME = 'Pemetrexed' AND FIST_START_DTE BETWEEN '2008-1-1' AND '2008-12-31') SELECT PT_MRN AS "MRN", DT_DTE AS "Lab Performed Date", PLR_RESULT_VALUE AS "Lab Result Value", PEM_DTE AS "Pemetrexed Order Start Date" FROM DV.PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED JOIN PEM ON PEM_DEID = PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V ON PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID JOIN DV.PATIENT_LAB_RESULT ON PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PLR_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID JOIN DV.LAB_TEST_CATALOG ON PLR_LAB_SUBTEST_CATALOG_ID = LTC_LAB_TEST_CATALOG_ID JOIN DV.DATE ON PLR_PERFORMED_DATE_ID = DT_DATE_ID WHERE LTC_SUBTEST_NAME = 'Creatinine' AND DT_DTE BETWEEN PEM_DTE - 7 DAYS AND PEM_DTE WITH PEM AS (SELECT DISTINCT MQT.POD_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID AS PEM_DEID, FIST_START_DTE AS FIRST_START_DTE FROM DV.PHM_PT_MEDS_MQT MQT JOIN DV.PHM_INVENTORY_CATALOG CAT ON POD_PHARMA_INVENTORY_CTLG_ID = PINC_INVENTORY_CTLG_ID JOIN DV.PHM_ORDER_DTL DTL ON MQT.POD_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = DTL.POD_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID AND MQT.POD_PHARMA_INVENTORY_CTLG_ID = DTL.POD_PHARMA_INVENTORY_CTLG_ID JOIN DV.DATE ON POD_START_DATE_ID = DT_DATE_ID WHERE CAT.PINC_GENERIC_NAME = 'Pemetrexed' AND FIST_START_DTE BETWEEN '2008-1-1' AND '2008-12-31') SELECT PT_MRN AS "MRN", DXCC_ICD_CODE AS "ICD-O Histology Code", DXCC_ICD_MSK_DESC AS "ICD-O Histology Desc", ICSC_SITE_CD AS "ICD-O Site Code", ICSC_ICDO_SITE_MSK_DESC AS "ICD-O Site Desc", DT_DTE AS "CDB Tumor Diagnosis Date", FIRST_START_DTE AS "Min Pemetrexed Start Date" FROM DV.CDB_TUMOR_V JOIN PEM ON PEM_DEID = CDTM_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V ON CDTM_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID JOIN DV.TUMOR_CASE_ATTRIBUTES ON CDTM_CASE_ATTR_ID = TUMOR_CASE_ATTR_ID JOIN DV.DIAGNOSIS_CODE_CAT_ICDO_V ON CDTM_DX_CATALOG_ID = DXCC_DX_CATALOG_ID JOIN DV.ICDO_SITE_CATALOG_V ON CDTM_SITE_CATALOG_ID = ICSC_SITE_CATALOG_ID JOIN DV.DATE ON CDTM_DX_DATE_ID = DT_DATE_ID WHERE TCA_CASE_STS_DESC = 'Completed'

prompt: The study wants to determine and get a clinical assessment on the diagnostic accuracy of the  new MRI method called "High resolution Diffusion-Weighted MR imaging" when compared to conventional MRI imaging.
completion: WITH APPT AS (SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN AS "MRN", CPE_ENC_DTE, TIME(CPE_APPT_DT) APPT_TIME, CPE_APPT_MADE_DTE, CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Sch') AND CPE_ENC_DTE >= CURRENT date + 7 DAYS AND CRE_RES_ID IN ('200804', '200805', '200806') AND CPE_APPT_MADE_DTE =CURRENT date - 1 DAY AND CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME IN ('MR BREAST BILATERAL W/O CONTR', 'MR BREAST BILATERAL W/WO CON', 'MR BREAST UNI LEFT W/WO CON', 'MR BREAST UNILAT W/O CONTR,L', 'MR BREAST UNILAT W/O CONTR,R') ) , X AS (SELECT RRPT_MRN, RRPT_RPT_ID, RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY RRPT_MRN ORDER BY RRPT_PERFORMED_DT DESC) AS RANK, DV.REGEX('BI-RADS', RRPT_REPORT_TXT, 'matchCount') AS BI_RAD_MENTIONED, LTRIM(RTRIM(REPLACE(DV.REGEXSTR('\WBI-RADS(\s|\s\s)([0-6]|zero)', RRPT_REPORT_TXT), 'BI-RADS', ''))) AS BI_RAD_SCORE_STR FROM DV.RADIOLOGY_REPORT_V WHERE CONTAINS(RRPT_REPORT_TXT, '"bi-rads"') = 1 AND RRPT_MRN IN (SELECT "MRN" FROM APPT) ) , Y AS (SELECT RRPT_RPT_ID, RRPT_MRN, RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE, CASE WHEN BI_RAD_MENTIONED > 1 THEN 88 WHEN BI_RAD_SCORE_STR LIKE '%zero%' OR BI_RAD_SCORE_STR = '0' THEN 0 WHEN BI_RAD_SCORE_STR LIKE '%1%' THEN 1 WHEN BI_RAD_SCORE_STR LIKE '%2%' THEN 2 WHEN BI_RAD_SCORE_STR LIKE '%3%' THEN 3 WHEN BI_RAD_SCORE_STR LIKE '%4%' THEN 4 WHEN BI_RAD_SCORE_STR LIKE '%5%' THEN 5 WHEN BI_RAD_SCORE_STR LIKE '%6%' THEN 6 ELSE 99 END AS BI_RAD_SCORE FROM X WHERE RANK = 1 ) SELECT DISTINCT CPE_ENC_DTE "MRI Appointment Date", APPT_TIME, "MRN", PT_FIRST_NAME "First", PT_LAST_NAME "Last", PT_PHONE, CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME, BI_RAD_SCORE "BI-RADS Score", RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE "BI-RADS Score Date" FROM APPT LEFT JOIN Y ON "MRN" = RRPT_MRN JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V ON "MRN" = PT_MRN WHERE YEAR(CPE_ENC_DTE - PT_BIRTH_DTE) >= 18 ORDER BY CPE_ENC_DTE;

prompt: List of new patients/consultations seen in the pediatric oncology department between 07/01/2020-09/30/2021
completion: SELECT CPE_MRN AS "MRN", CPE_ENC_DTE AS "Date of Initial consultation visit", CRE_RES_NAME AS "Provider Name", CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME AS "visit type", CVT_EXT_NAME AS "Visit Type Meaning", CLD_DEPT_NAME AS "Department Name", CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8, PT_DATE_OF_DEATH AS "Date Of Death" FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON CPE_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 IN ('PED') AND CLD_DEPT_NAME IN (UCASE('Peds Leu Lym 1275'), UCASE('Peds Neuroblast 1275'), UCASE('Peds Sarcoma 1275'), UCASE('Peds Neuro Onc 1275')) AND (CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR LIKE '%NV%' OR CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR LIKE '%IR%') AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN '2020-07-01' AND '2021-09-30' AND CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Comp', 'Arrived')

prompt:
For 2022: 

All NV/IRs with diagnosis: brain mets



Within 6 mos after visit, did these patients have: 

•	Lumbar puncture (if yes, include details – date of procedure)

•	Oral or IV chemo (if yes, include first treatment date, chemo)

•	Enrollment in a clinical trial (if yes, include date, trial #)
completion: WITH DX AS (SELECT DISTINCT CC_MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS MIN_ICD9_EFF_DTE, CC_CLSF_CD AS ICD9_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS ICD9_DESC FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE CC_CLSF_CD IN ('C79.31') AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND (CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) GROUP BY CC_MRN, CC_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK ), APPO AS (SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN AS "MRN", PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, ICD9_CD AS ICD_CD, ICD9_DESC AS ICD_DESC, CPE_ENC_DTE AS "Appt Date", CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 AS "Department", CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 AS "Service", CLD_DEPT_NAME AS "Department Name", CRE_RES_NAME AS "Provider Name", CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME AS "Visit Type" FROM DX JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON CC_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER ON CC_MRN = CPE_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN '01-01-2022' AND '12-31-2022' AND (CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR LIKE '%NV%' OR CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR LIKE '%IR%') AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 = 'NEU' ) , PATH AS (SELECT PRPT_MRN, PRPT_PROCEDURE_DTE AS "Procedure date", PRPT_REPORT_DTE AS "Report date", PRPT_REPORT_TYPE_DESC AS "Report type", PRPT_ACCESSION_NO AS "Accession number" , PRPT_REPORT AS "Report text" FROM APPO JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V ON "MRN" = PRPT_MRN WHERE LOCATE('lumbar puncture', PRPT_REPORT) >= 1 AND PRPT_REPORT_DTE BETWEEN "Appt Date" AND "Appt Date" + 6 MONTHS ) , CHEMO AS (SELECT APR_MRN, APR_START_DTE, APR_END_DTE, CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME, APR_GENERIC_NAME, APR_PRESCRIBED_DOSE, APR_ROUTE FROM APPO JOIN IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX_V ON "MRN" = APR_MRN WHERE CDG_CHEMO_FLAG = 'Y' AND APR_ROUTE IN ('IV', 'ORAL', 'Oral', 'oral', 'intravenous') AND APR_START_DTE BETWEEN "Appt Date" AND "Appt Date" + 6 MONTHS ) , TRAIL AS (SELECT DISTINCT AC_MRN, AC_IRB_NO, AC_CONS_DTE FROM APPO JOIN IDB.ACCRUALS ON "MRN" = AC_MRN WHERE AC_CONS_DTE BETWEEN "Appt Date" AND "Appt Date" + 6 MONTHS ) SELECT DISTINCT "MRN", PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, ICD_CD, ICD_DESC, "Appt Date", "Department", "Service", "Department Name", "Provider Name", "Visit Type", "Procedure date", "Report date", "Report type", "Accession number", VARCHAR("Report text", 32000) AS RRPT_REPORT_TEXT, MIN(APR_START_DTE) OVER(PARTITION BY "MRN") AS START_DATE, MAX(APR_END_DTE) OVER(PARTITION BY "MRN") AS END_DATE, CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME, APR_GENERIC_NAME, APR_PRESCRIBED_DOSE, APR_ROUTE, AC_IRB_NO, AC_CONS_DTE FROM APPO LEFT JOIN CHEMO ON "MRN" = APR_MRN LEFT JOIN PATH ON "MRN" = PRPT_MRN LEFT JOIN TRAIL ON "MRN" = AC_MRN ;

prompt: Provide a one time report on the occurrence of vascular infusion procedures at  the main campus and the Koch center during 2020.
completion: WITH X AS (SELECT OL_MRN, OL_SURG_DTE, OL_LOG_ID, OLAP_PNL_NO, OLAS_SURG_SVC, OLAP_LINE_NO, OLAP_OR_PROC_ID, OP_IMO_CD, OP_PROC_NAME, OCP_LINE_NO, CPX_PROC_CD, CPX_PROC_NAME, OL_ROOM_RES_ID, ROOM.CRE_RES_NAME AS ROOM, RES.CRE_RES_NAME AS RES, L1.LOC_LOC_NAME, L1.LOC_LOC_ABBR, OL_SURG_LOC_ID FROM IDB.OR_LOG JOIN IDB.OR_LOG_ALL_PROC ON OL_LOG_ID = OLAP_LOG_ID JOIN IDB.OR_PROC ON OLAP_OR_PROC_ID = OP_OR_PROC_ID JOIN IDB.OR_CL_PROC ON OP_OR_PROC_ID = OCP_OR_PROC_ID JOIN IDB.CL_PROC ON OCP_PROC_ID = CPX_PROC_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.OR_LOG_ALL_SURG ON OLAP_LOG_ID = OLAS_LOG_ID AND OLAP_PNL_NO = OLAS_PNL_NO AND OLAS_SURG_ROLE = 'Primary' LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE RES ON RES.CRE_RES_ID = OLAS_RES_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_LOCATION L1 ON OL_SURG_LOC_ID = L1.LOC_LOC_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ROOM ON OL_ROOM_RES_ID = ROOM.CRE_RES_ID WHERE OL_LOG_STS NOT IN ('Canceled', 'Voided') AND OL_SURG_DTE BETWEEN '2020-01-01' AND CURRENT date AND(UPPER(OP_PROC_NAME) like '%VASCULAR%INFUSION%' OR UPPER(CPX_PROC_NAME) like '%VASCULAR%INFUSION%') ) SELECT OP_PROC_NAME, LOC_LOC_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT OL_LOG_ID) FROM X GROUP BY OP_PROC_NAME, LOC_LOC_NAME WITH X AS (SELECT OC_CASE_ID, OC_MRN, OC_SURG_DTE, L1.LOC_LOC_NAME, ROOM.CRE_RES_NAME AS ROOM, RES.CRE_RES_NAME, CPX_PROC_CD, CPX_PROC_NAME, OP_OR_PROC_ID, OP_PROC_NAME, OCP_OR_PROC_ID, OCP_LINE_NO, OCP_PROC_ID, OC_OR_CASE_STS_CD, OC_OR_CASE_STS FROM IDB.OR_CASE JOIN IDB.OR_CASE_ALL_PROC ON OC_CASE_ID = OCAP_CASE_ID JOIN IDB.OR_CASE_ALL_SURG ON OCAP_CASE_ID = OCAS_CASE_ID AND OCAS_PNL_NO = OCAP_PNL_NO AND OCAS_SURG_ROLE = 'Primary' JOIN IDB.OR_PROC ON OCAP_OR_PROC_ID = OP_OR_PROC_ID JOIN IDB.OR_CL_PROC ON OP_OR_PROC_ID = OCP_OR_PROC_ID JOIN IDB.CL_PROC ON OCP_PROC_ID = CPX_PROC_ID JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE RES ON RES.CRE_RES_ID = OCAS_RES_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_LOCATION L1 ON OC_SURG_LOC_ID = L1.LOC_LOC_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ROOM ON OC_ROOM_RES_ID = ROOM.CRE_RES_ID WHERE OC_OR_CASE_STS_CD NOT IN ('2', '5') AND OC_SURG_DTE BETWEEN '2020-01-01' AND '2020-12-31' AND(UPPER(OP_PROC_NAME) like '%VASCULAR%INFUSION%' OR UPPER(CPX_PROC_NAME) like '%VASCULAR%INFUSION%') ) SELECT OP_PROC_NAME, LOC_LOC_NAME, MONTH(OC_SURG_DTE) AS MTH, COUNT(DISTINCT OC_CASE_ID) FROM X GROUP BY OP_PROC_NAME, LOC_LOC_NAME, MONTH(OC_SURG_DTE)

prompt: Provide weekly  list of patients  who are screened for protocol 20-091 and/or brain cancer/glioma along with histology diagnosis, treatment and Methylation status
completion: WITH DX AS (SELECT DISTINCT CC_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, YEAR(CURRENT DATE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) AS CURRENT_AGE, MIN_ICD9_EFF_DTE, ICD9_CD, ICD9_DESC FROM (SELECT CC_MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS MIN_ICD9_EFF_DTE, CC_CLSF_CD AS ICD9_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS ICD9_DESC FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE 1=1 AND CC_CLSF_CD BETWEEN 'C71.1' AND 'C71.9' AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND (CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) GROUP BY CC_MRN, CC_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK HAVING MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) >='2014-01-01') C JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON CC_MRN = PT_MRN ) , CDD AS (SELECT DISTINCT CDD_MRN, CDO_ITEM_NAME, IDH_FLAG, CDO_VALUE_TEXT FROM (SELECT CDD_MRN , CDD_SERVICE_DTE , CDO_SECTION, CDO_ITEM_NAME , CASE WHEN INSTR(CDO_VALUE_TEXT, 'GTR') >0 OR INSTR(CDO_VALUE_TEXT, 'IDH') > 0 OR INSTR(CDO_VALUE_TEXT, 'MGMT') >0 THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS IDH_FLAG, CDO_VALUE_TEXT, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CDD_MRN, UPPER(CDO_SECTION), CDO_ITEM_NAME ORDER BY CDD_SERVICE_DTE DESC) RN FROM IDB.CD_DOCUMENT LEFT JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION ON CDD_DOC_GUID = CDO_DOC_GUID AND CDD_AUTHORED_DTE = CDO_AUTHORED_DTE AND CDO_VALUE_TEXT <> '' JOIN DX ON CC_MRN = CDD_MRN WHERE CDD_CANCEL_IND <> '1' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND <> '1' AND CDD_SERVICE_DTE >= MIN_ICD9_EFF_DTE AND ((UPPER(CDO_SECTION) = 'ONCOLOGY HISTORY' AND CDO_ITEM_NAME = 'ONCOLOGY HISTORY') OR (UPPER(CDO_SECTION) = 'BRAIN TUMOR' AND CDO_ITEM_NAME = 'Brain Tumor Description') ) ) WHERE IDH_FLAG = 'Y' AND RN=1 ) , VISIT AS (SELECT CPE_MRN, CPE_ENC_DTE , CLD_DEPT_NAME AS DEPARTMENT_NAME , ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CPE_MRN ORDER BY CPE_ENC_DTE ASC) FIRST_APPT FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID JOIN DX ON CC_MRN = CPE_MRN WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Sch') AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 = 'NEU' AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 = 'NEU' AND CRE_RES_TYP = 'Physician' AND CPE_ENC_DTE >= CURRENT DATE ) SELECT DISTINCT CC_MRN AS MRN, PT_LAST_NAME AS LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME AS FIRST_NAME, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH AS DATE_OF_BIRTH, CURRENT_AGE, MIN_ICD9_EFF_DTE AS DIAGNOSIS_DATE, ICD9_CD AS ICD_CODE, ICD9_DESC AS ICD_DESCRIPTION, IDH_FLAG, CDO_VALUE_TEXT AS CLINDOC_DIAGNOSIS, CPE_ENC_DTE AS APPOINTMENT_DATE FROM DX D LEFT JOIN CDD ON CDD_MRN = D.CC_MRN LEFT JOIN VISIT ON CPE_MRN = D.CC_MRN AND FIRST_APPT = 1 WHERE CURRENT_AGE >= 18 ; WITH DX AS (SELECT CC_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME FIRST_NAME, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, YEAR(CURRENT DATE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) AS CURRENT_AGE, MIN_ICD9_EFF_DTE, ICD9_CD, ICD9_DESC FROM (SELECT CC_MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS MIN_ICD9_EFF_DTE, CC_CLSF_CD AS ICD9_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS ICD9_DESC FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE 1=1 AND CC_CLSF_CD BETWEEN 'C71.1' AND 'C71.9' AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND (CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) GROUP BY CC_MRN, CC_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK HAVING MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) >='2014-01-01') C JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON CC_MRN = PT_MRN ) SELECT RTC_TX_MRN, LAST_NAME, FIRST_NAME, MIN(RTC_TX_START_DTE) RAD_TX_START_DATE, MAX(RTC_TX_STOP_DTE) RAD_TX_STOP_DATE FROM IDB.RADONC_TREATMENT_COURSE JOIN DX ON CC_MRN = RTC_TX_MRN AND RTC_TX_START_DTE >= MIN_ICD9_EFF_DTE GROUP BY RTC_TX_MRN, LAST_NAME, FIRST_NAME ; WITH DX AS (SELECT CC_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME FIRST_NAME, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, YEAR(CURRENT DATE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) AS CURRENT_AGE, MIN_ICD9_EFF_DTE, ICD9_CD, ICD9_DESC FROM (SELECT CC_MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS MIN_ICD9_EFF_DTE, CC_CLSF_CD AS ICD9_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS ICD9_DESC FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE 1=1 AND CC_CLSF_CD BETWEEN 'C71.1' AND 'C71.9' AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND (CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) GROUP BY CC_MRN, CC_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK HAVING MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) >='2014-01-01') C JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON CC_MRN = PT_MRN) SELECT APR_MRN, LAST_NAME, FIRST_NAME, MIN(APR_START_DTE) IMMUNO_TX_START_DATE, MAX(APR_END_DTE) IMMUNO_TX_STOP_DATE FROM IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX JOIN IDB.CHEMO_DRUG_GENERIC ON APR_GENERIC_NAME = CDG_GENERIC_NAME JOIN DX ON CC_MRN = APR_MRN AND APR_START_DTE >= MIN_ICD9_EFF_DTE WHERE CDG_BIOLOGIC_IMMUNO_FLAG = 'Y' AND CDG_THERAPEUTIC_CATEGORY like '%anti-%' GROUP BY APR_MRN, LAST_NAME, FIRST_NAME ; WITH DX AS (SELECT CC_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME FIRST_NAME, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, YEAR(CURRENT DATE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) AS CURRENT_AGE, MIN_ICD9_EFF_DTE, ICD9_CD, ICD9_DESC FROM (SELECT CC_MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS MIN_ICD9_EFF_DTE, CC_CLSF_CD AS ICD9_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS ICD9_DESC FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE 1=1 AND CC_CLSF_CD BETWEEN 'C71.1' AND 'C71.9' AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND (CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) GROUP BY CC_MRN, CC_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK HAVING MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) >='2014-01-01') C JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON CC_MRN = PT_MRN ) SELECT APR_MRN, LAST_NAME, FIRST_NAME, MIN(APR_START_DTE) CHEMO_START_DATE, MAX(APR_END_DTE) CHEMO_STOP_DATE FROM IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX JOIN IDB.CHEMO_DRUG_GENERIC ON APR_GENERIC_NAME = CDG_GENERIC_NAME JOIN DX ON CC_MRN = APR_MRN AND APR_START_DTE >= MIN_ICD9_EFF_DTE JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PT_MRN = APR_MRN WHERE CDG_CHEMO_FLAG = 'Y' GROUP BY APR_MRN, LAST_NAME, FIRST_NAME ;

prompt: Create a report of patients who have encountered five specific pediatric surgeons in the last 5 years.
completion: WITH CPE1 AS (SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN AS MRN, STRIP(PT_LAST_NAME) || ', ' || STRIP(PT_FIRST_NAME) AS NAME, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH AS DOB, PT_SEX AS GENDER, R.AV_DESC AS "Race", E.AV_DESC AS "Ethnicity", PT_DATE_OF_DEATH AS DOD, COALESCE(MAX(PLA_LST_APPT_DTE, PLA_LST_DSCH_DTE), PLA_LST_APPT_DTE, PLA_LST_DSCH_DTE) AS LAST_FU_DATE, CPE_ENC_DTE, CRE_RES_ID, CRE_RES_NAME, CLD_DEPT_NAME, CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CPE_MRN ORDER BY CPE_ENC_DTE) AS RN FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON CPE_MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS R ON PT_RACE = R.AV_CODE AND R.AV_ELEMENT = 'RACE' LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS E ON PT_PT_ETHNICITY = E.AV_CODE AND E.AV_ELEMENT = 'PT_ETHNICITY' JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY ON CPE_MRN = PLA_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CRE_RES_TYP IN ('Physician') AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN '1/1/2019' AND '1/1/2024' AND CRE_RES_ID IN ('018457', '028324', '023960', '029645', '002196', '007054') ) , X AS (SELECT * FROM CPE1 WHERE RN = 1 ) , HW1 AS (SELECT DISTINCT MRN, CPE_ENC_DTE, PMH_MEASURE_DTE, PMH_WT_KG, PMH_HT_CM, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY MRN, CPE_ENC_DTE ORDER BY PMH_MEASURE_DTE DESC) AS RN_1 FROM X JOIN IDB.PT_MEASURES_HX ON MRN = PMH_MRN AND PMH_MEASURE_DTE <= CPE_ENC_DTE) , SRG AS (SELECT DISTINCT SSE_MRN AS MRN, SSE_LOG_ID, SSE_SURG_DTE, SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD, SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC, STRIP(SSP_SURG_LAST_NM) || ', ' || STRIP(SSP_SURG_FIRST_NM) AS SURGEON, SSP_SURG_SVC_CD FROM IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE ON SSE_LOG_ID = SSP_LOG_ID JOIN X ON SSE_MRN = MRN WHERE 1=1 AND SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD NOT LIKE '9999%' AND SSE_SURG_LOC not like '%IR%' AND SSE_SURG_LOC not like '%ENDO%' AND SSE_SOURCE_TYPE <> 'E' ) , HW2 AS (SELECT S.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY MRN, SSE_LOG_ID, SSE_SURG_DTE ORDER BY PMH_MEASURE_DTE DESC) AS RN_2 FROM (SELECT DISTINCT MRN, SSE_LOG_ID, SSE_SURG_DTE, PMH_MEASURE_DTE, PMH_WT_KG, PMH_HT_CM FROM SRG JOIN IDB.PT_MEASURES_HX ON MRN = PMH_MRN AND PMH_MEASURE_DTE <= SSE_SURG_DTE) S) , SRG2 AS (SELECT DISTINCT SRG.*, HW2.SSE_SURG_DTE AS MEAS_DATE_PRE_SRG_DATE, HW2.PMH_WT_KG AS WT_PRE_SRG_DATE, HW2.PMH_HT_CM AS HT_PRE_SRG_DATE FROM SRG LEFT JOIN HW2 ON SRG.SSE_LOG_ID = HW2.SSE_LOG_ID AND RN_2 = 1) , Y AS (SELECT DISTINCT X.*, HW1.CPE_ENC_DTE AS MEAS_PRE_INIT_VISIT_DATE, HW1.PMH_WT_KG AS WT_PRE_INIT_VISIT_DATE, HW1.PMH_HT_CM AS HT_PRE_INIT_VISIT_DATE FROM X LEFT JOIN HW1 ON X.MRN = HW1.MRN AND RN_1 = 1) SELECT * FROM Y , APR AS (SELECT APR_MRN, CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME, APR_DRUG_NAME, MIN(APR_START_DTE) AS START_DATE, MAX(APR_END_DTE) AS END_DATE, APR_ORD_RX_TYPE FROM IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX_V JOIN X ON APR_MRN = MRN WHERE CDG_CHEMO_FLAG = 'Y' GROUP BY APR_MRN, CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME, APR_DRUG_NAME, APR_ORD_RX_TYPE ) , RT AS (SELECT DISTINCT RTC_TX_MRN, RTC_TX_PLAN_NAME, RTC_PRIMARY_REF_POINT, RTC_TX_START_DTE, RTC_TX_STOP_DTE, RTC_TX_ELAPSED_DAYS, RTC_TX_PLANNED_FRACTIONS, RTC_TX_DELIVERED_FRACTIONS, RTC_TX_PLANNED_DOSE, RTC_TX_DELIVERED_DOSE, RTC_DOSE_CORRECTION FROM IDB.RADONC_TREATMENT_COURSE JOIN X ON RTC_TX_MRN = MRN) , OHI AS (SELECT DISTINCT MRN, OHI_STS_CD AS "Status", OHI_ONSET_DTE AS "Onset Date", OHI_RESOLVED_DTE AS "Resolved Date", OHI_TYPE_CD AS "Problem Type", OHI_SHORT_NAME AS "Problem", OHI_HI_TEXT AS "Description", OHI_ICD10_CD FROM X JOIN IDB.OMS_HEALTH_ISSUE ON OHI_MRN = MRN WHERE 1=1 AND OHI_STS_CD = 'Active' AND OHI_TYPE_CD = 'Cancer Dx' AND(OHI_ICD10_CD IN ('C74.90', 'D36.10', 'C74.90', 'C64.1', 'C64.2', 'C64.9', 'C64.1', 'C64.9', 'D30.00', 'D13.4', 'C22.2', 'C22.0', 'C22.0', 'C22.4', 'D18.00', 'C22.0', 'C49.9', 'C41.9', 'C41.9', 'C49.9', 'C49.9', 'D21.9', 'C73', 'C34.90', 'C74.90', 'C7A.09X', 'D48.6', 'C18.9', 'C49.A0', 'C57.9', 'C62.90', 'C43.9', 'C7A.8', 'C25.9',
