prompt: Design a weekly report of all orders released for CIS order 'Heme Germline MSK-IMPACT'
completion: WITH X AS (SELECT DISTINCT OO_MRN AS MRN, STRIP(PT_LAST_NAME)||', '||STRIP(PT_FIRST_NAME) AS "Name", PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH AS DOB, PT_SEX AS "Gender", PT_HT_CM AS "Height", PT_WT_KG AS "Weight", OO_ACCT_NO AS "Acct No", OCV_VISIT_ID_CD AS "Visit ID", OO_ORD_ID AS "Order ID", OO_ORD_GUID AS "Order GUID", OO_ENTER_DT AS "Enter DT", OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE AS "Order Date", CHAR(OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE) AS "Order Date (Char)", OSH_CREATE_DTE AS "Release Date", CHAR(OSH_CREATE_DTE) AS "Release Date (Char)", OO_SET_NAME AS "Set Name", STRIP(OO_ORD_NAME) AS "Order Name", DM.OUD_USER_DI_CD AS DI_CD1, STRIP(DM.OUD_USER_DI_VALUE) AS "Platform", DX.OUD_USER_DI_CD AS DI_CD2, STRIP(DX.OUD_USER_DI_VALUE) AS "Primary Dx", DX2.OUD_USER_DI_CD AS DI_CD3, STRIP(DX2.OUD_USER_DI_VALUE) AS "Secondary Dx", CONTACT.OUD_USER_DI_CD AS DI_CD4, STRIP(CONTACT.OUD_USER_DI_VALUE) AS "Contact Name/Beeper #", CONSENT1.OUD_USER_DI_CD AS DI_CD5, STRIP(CONSENT1.OUD_USER_DI_VALUE) AS "Informed Consent Obtained?", CONSENT2.OUD_USER_DI_CD AS DI_CD6, STRIP(CONSENT2.OUD_USER_DI_VALUE) AS "Blood sent to DMP w/ Part A", COH.OUD_USER_DI_CD AS DI_CD18, STRIP(COH.OUD_USER_DI_VALUE) AS "DMG Impact Patient Cohort", DI5.OUD_USER_DI_CD AS DI_CD21, STRIP(DI5.OUD_USER_DI_VALUE) AS "DMG Info 5", HEM.OUD_USER_DI_CD AS DI_CD7, STRIP(HEM.OUD_USER_DI_VALUE) AS "Hem Malignancy?", HEM2.OUD_USER_DI_CD AS DI_CD11, STRIP(HEM2.OUD_USER_DI_VALUE) AS "Hem Malignancy Specify", TRN.OUD_USER_DI_CD AS DI_CD12, STRIP(TRN.OUD_USER_DI_VALUE) AS "Transplant?", PTR.OUD_USER_DI_CD AS DI_CD13, STRIP(PTR.OUD_USER_DI_VALUE) AS "Post Transplant", TRD.OUD_USER_DI_CD AS DI_CD14, STRIP(TRD.OUD_USER_DI_VALUE) AS "Transplant Date", TRT.OUD_USER_DI_CD AS DI_CD15, STRIP(TRT.OUD_USER_DI_VALUE) AS "Transplant Type", HIS.OUD_USER_DI_CD AS DI_CD16, STRIP(HIS.OUD_USER_DI_VALUE) AS "Previous History", COP.OUD_USER_DI_CD AS DI_CD17, STRIP(COP.OUD_USER_DI_VALUE) AS "Send Extra Copy To:", PRO.OUD_USER_DI_CD AS DI_CD8, STRIP(PRO.OUD_USER_DI_VALUE) AS "Protocol # (if applicable)", REQ.OUD_USER_DI_CD AS DI_CD9, STRIP(REQ.OUD_USER_DI_VALUE) AS "Date", RNB.OUD_USER_DI_CD AS DI_CD10, STRIP(RNB.OUD_USER_DI_VALUE) AS "RNB Research Do Not Bill", CC.OUD_USER_DI_CD AS DI_CD19, STRIP(CC.OUD_USER_DI_VALUE) AS "CC", FND.OUD_USER_DI_CD AS DI_CD20, STRIP(FND.OUD_USER_DI_VALUE) AS "FND", OO_SUMMARY_LINE AS "Summary Line", OUO_ATN_PVDR_NAME AS "Attending Name", OUO_PVDR_NAME AS "Provider Name", OUO_PVDR_ROLE_TYPE AS "Provider Role", OUO_USER_NAME AS "User Name", OUO_USER_ROLE_TYPE AS "User Role", DOC_SVC AS "SVC", AV_DESC AS "Service", OCV_CURR_LOC AS "Current Location", OCV_CURR_LOC_GUID AS "Current Location GUID", OO_VISIT_GUID AS "Visit GUID" FROM IDB.OMS_ORDER JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON OO_MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_USER_ORDERS ON OO_ORD_GUID = OUO_ORD_GUID LEFT JOIN IDB.DOC ON OO_REQ_DR_NO = DOC_DR_NO LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS ON AV_CODE = DOC_SVC AND AV_ELEMENT = 'SVC' LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_USER_DATA DM ON OO_ORD_GUID = DM.OUD_ORD_GUID AND DM.OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'PPATH_HEME_IMPACT_SampleType' LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_USER_DATA DX ON OO_ORD_GUID = DX.OUD_ORD_GUID AND DX.OUD_USER_DI_CD IN ('DMG DX') LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_USER_DATA CONTACT ON OO_ORD_GUID = CONTACT.OUD_ORD_GUID AND CONTACT.OUD_USER_DI_CD IN ('Contact Name') LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_USER_DATA CONSENT1 ON OO_ORD_GUID = CONSENT1.OUD_ORD_GUID AND CONSENT1.OUD_USER_DI_CD IN ('DMG Consent?') LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_USER_DATA CONSENT2 ON OO_ORD_GUID = CONSENT2.OUD_ORD_GUID AND CONSENT2.OUD_USER_DI_CD IN ('DiagMoleST-ConsentForImpact-HemeGerm') LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_USER_DATA COH ON OO_ORD_GUID = COH.OUD_ORD_GUID AND COH.OUD_USER_DI_CD IN ('DMG Impact Patient Cohort') LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_USER_DATA DI5 ON OO_ORD_GUID = DI5.OUD_ORD_GUID AND DI5.OUD_USER_DI_CD IN ('DMG Info 5') LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_USER_DATA HEM ON OO_ORD_GUID = HEM.OUD_ORD_GUID AND HEM.OUD_USER_DI_CD IN ('DMG Impact Hem Malignancy') LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_USER_DATA HEM2 ON OO_ORD_GUID = HEM2.OUD_ORD_GUID AND HEM2.OUD_USER_DI_CD IN ('DMG_Impact Hem Malignancy Specify') LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_USER_DATA TRN ON OO_ORD_GUID = TRN.OUD_ORD_GUID AND TRN.OUD_USER_DI_CD IN ('Transplant?') LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_USER_DATA PTR ON OO_ORD_GUID = PTR.OUD_ORD_GUID AND PTR.OUD_USER_DI_CD IN ('Post Transplant') LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_USER_DATA TRD ON OO_ORD_GUID = TRD.OUD_ORD_GUID AND TRD.OUD_USER_DI_CD IN ('Transplant Date') LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_USER_DATA TRT ON OO_ORD_GUID = TRT.OUD_ORD_GUID AND TRT.OUD_USER_DI_CD IN ('Transplant Type') LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_USER_DATA HIS ON OO_ORD_GUID = HIS.OUD_ORD_GUID AND HIS.OUD_USER_DI_CD IN ('DMG Previous History') LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_USER_DATA COP ON OO_ORD_GUID = COP.OUD_ORD_GUID AND COP.OUD_USER_DI_CD IN ('Send Extra Copy To:') LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_USER_DATA PRO ON OO_ORD_GUID = PRO.OUD_ORD_GUID AND PRO.OUD_USER_DI_CD IN ('Protocol # (if applicable)') LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_USER_DATA REQ ON OO_ORD_GUID = REQ.OUD_ORD_GUID AND REQ.OUD_USER_DI_CD IN ('Requested For') LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_USER_DATA RNB ON OO_ORD_GUID = RNB.OUD_ORD_GUID AND RNB.OUD_USER_DI_CD IN ('Research Billing') LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_USER_DATA CC ON OO_ORD_GUID = CC.OUD_ORD_GUID AND CC.OUD_USER_DI_CD IN ('DMG_GERM_CC') LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_USER_DATA FND ON OO_ORD_GUID = FND.OUD_ORD_GUID AND FND.OUD_USER_DI_CD IN ('DMG_GERM_Fund') LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_USER_DATA DX2 ON OO_ORD_GUID = DX2.OUD_ORD_GUID AND DX2.OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'DMG DX 2' JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_STS_HX ON OO_ORD_GUID = OSH_ORD_GUID AND OSH_FUNCTION_CD = '105' JOIN IDB.OMS_CLIENT_VISIT ON OO_VISIT_GUID = OCV_VISIT_GUID WHERE OO_ORD_STS_CD NOT IN ('CANC', 'CANP', 'AUC3') AND OO_ORD_NAME = 'Heme Germline MSK-IMPACT' AND OSH_CREATE_DTE >= CURRENT DATE - 7 DAYS ) , ORD_LOC AS (SELECT DISTINCT X."Visit GUID", X."Order GUID", X.MRN, X."Enter DT", OL_LOC_NAME AS ORD_LOCATION, OL_LOC_GUID FROM X JOIN IDB.OMS_VISIT_LOCATION A ON OVL_VISIT_GUID = X."Visit GUID" JOIN IDB.OMS_LOCATION ON OVL_LOC_GUID = OL_LOC_GUID WHERE A.OVL_VISIT_LOC_GUID = (SELECT MAX(B.OVL_VISIT_LOC_GUID) FROM IDB.OMS_VISIT_LOCATION B WHERE A.OVL_VISIT_GUID = B.OVL_VISIT_GUID AND B.OVL_EFF_DT <= X."Enter DT") ) , Y AS (SELECT DISTINCT X."MRN", X."Name", X.DOB, X."Gender", X."Height", X."Weight", X."Acct No", X."Visit ID", X."Order ID", X."Order GUID", X."Enter DT", X."Order Date", X."Order Date (Char)", X."Release Date", X."Release Date (Char)", X."Set Name", X."Order Name", X."Platform", X."Primary Dx", X."Secondary Dx", X."Contact Name/Beeper #", X."Informed Consent Obtained?", X."Blood sent to DMP w/ Part A", X."DMG Impact Patient Cohort", X."DMG Info 5", X."Hem Malignancy?", X."Hem Malignancy Specify", X."Transplant?", X."Post Transplant", X."Transplant Date", X."Transplant Type", X."Previous History", X."Send Extra Copy To:", X."Protocol # (if applicable)", X."Date", X."RNB Research Do Not Bill", X."CC", X."FND", X."Summary Line", X."Attending Name", X."Provider Name", X."Provider Role", X."User Name", X."User Role", X."SVC", STRIP(X."Service") AS "Service", X."Current Location", X."Visit GUID", STRIP(COALESCE(ORD_LOC.ORD_LOCATION, "Current Location")) AS "Location", LGR_LOC_GRP AS "Location Group" FROM X LEFT JOIN ORD_LOC ORD_LOC ON X.MRN = ORD_LOC.MRN AND X."Visit GUID" = ORD_LOC."Visit GUID" AND X."Order GUID" = ORD_LOC."Order GUID" LEFT JOIN IDB.LOCATION_GROUPS_REFERENCE ON LGR_LOC_GUID = COALESCE(OL_LOC_GUID, "Current Location GUID")) , Z AS (SELECT DISTINCT Y."MRN", Y."Name", Y.DOB, Y."Gender", Y."Height", Y."Weight", Y."Acct No", Y."Visit ID", Y."Order ID", Y."Order GUID", Y."Enter DT", Y."Order Date", Y."Order Date (Char)", Y."Release Date", Y."Release Date (Char)", Y."Set Name", Y."Order Name", Y."Platform", Y."Primary Dx", Y."Secondary Dx", Y."Contact Name/Beeper #", Y."Informed Consent Obtained?", Y."Blood sent to DMP w/ Part A", Y."DMG Impact Patient Cohort", Y."DMG Info 5", Y."Hem Malignancy?", Y."Hem Malignancy Specify", Y."Transplant?", Y."Post Transplant", Y."Transplant Date", Y."Transplant Type", Y."Previous History", Y."Send Extra Copy To:", Y."Protocol # (if applicable)", Y."Date", Y."RNB Research Do Not Bill", Y."CC", Y."FND", Y."Summary Line", Y."Attending Name", Y."Provider Name", Y."Provider Role", Y."User Name", Y."User Role", Y."SVC", Y."Service", Y."Current Location", Y."Visit GUID", Y."Location", Y."Location Group" FROM Y ) , PMH1 AS (SELECT PMH_MRN, PMH_MEASURE_DTE, PMH_WT_KG, PMH_HT_CM FROM IDB.PT_MEASURES_HX WHERE PMH_MRN IN (SELECT DISTINCT "MRN" FROM Z) ) , PMH2 AS (SELECT PMH_MRN, MAX(PMH_MEASURE_DTE) AS PMH_MEASURE_DTE_MAX FROM PMH1 GROUP BY PMH_MRN) , PMH3 AS (SELECT PMH1.* FROM PMH1 JOIN PMH2 ON PMH1.PMH_MRN = PMH2.PMH_MRN AND PMH1.PMH_MEASURE_DTE = PMH2.PMH_MEASURE_DTE_MAX) SELECT DISTINCT Z.*, PMH_WT_KG, PMH_HT_CM FROM Z LEFT JOIN PMH3 ON Z."MRN" = PMH_MRN

prompt: To determine findings on transthoracic echocardiogram in patient presenting with embolic stroke/CVA.
completion: WITH EMBOLIC_STROKE AS (SELECT CC_MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS MIN_ICD9_EFF_DTE, CC_CLSF_CD AS ICD9_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS ICD9_DESC FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE CC_CLSF_CD IN ('I63.9', '434.91', 'I74.9', '444.9') AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND (CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) GROUP BY CC_MRN, CC_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK ) SELECT PBD_MRN MRN, PT_LAST_NAME "Patient Last Name", PT_FIRST_NAME "Patient First Name", PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH "DoB", ICD9_CD "ICD Code", ICD9_DESC "ICD Description", MIN_ICD9_EFF_DTE "ICD Diagnosis Date", PBD_SVC_DTE "Echo Date", PBC_CPT_CD "Echo Code", PBC_PBD_DESC "Echo Description" FROM EMBOLIC_STROKE JOIN IDB.PBD_DTL ON PBD_MRN = CC_MRN JOIN IDB.PBD_CODE ON PBD_PBD_CD = PBC_PBD_CD JOIN IDB.CLM ON PBC_CPT_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PT_MRN = CC_MRN WHERE PBC_PBD_CD IN ('5193306', '9593306', '5193307') ORDER BY MRN, PBD_SVC_DTE

prompt: Patients treated with TIP chemotherapy regimen (paclitaxel, ifosfamide, cisplatin)
completion: WITH TIP AS (SELECT DISTINCT I.APR_MRN IVAC_MRN FROM IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX_V I JOIN IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX_V E ON I.APR_MRN = E.APR_MRN AND E.CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME = 'CISPLATIN' AND E.APR_START_DTE BETWEEN I.APR_START_DTE AND I.APR_START_DTE + 10 DAYS JOIN IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX_V C ON I.APR_MRN = C.APR_MRN AND C.CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME = 'IFOSFAMIDE' AND C.APR_START_DTE BETWEEN I.APR_START_DTE AND I.APR_START_DTE + 10 DAYS WHERE I.CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME = 'PACLITAXEL' AND YEAR(I.APR_START_DTE) >= 2004 ) , PT AS (SELECT DISTINCT APR_MRN FROM IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX_V JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON APR_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN TIP ON APR_MRN = IVAC_MRN WHERE CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME IN ('CISPLATIN', 'IFOSFAMIDE', 'PACLITAXEL') AND APR_START_DTE BETWEEN '2004-09-01' AND '2019-09-13' AND YEAR(APR_START_DTE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) >= 18 ) , DX AS (SELECT DISTINCT TM_MRN, TM_DX_DTE, TM_HIST_CD, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS HIST_DESC, TM_SITE_CD, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_DESC FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD JOIN PT ON TM_MRN = APR_MRN WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') ) SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN "MRN", PT_LAST_NAME "Last Name", PT_FIRST_NAME "First Name", PT_SEX "Gender", PT_RACE_DESC "Race", PT_PT_ETHNICITY_DESC "Ethnicity", PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH "Date of Birth", PT_DATE_OF_DEATH "Date of Death", TM_DX_DTE "Tumor Dx Date", TM_HIST_CD "Histology Code", HIST_DESC "Histology Description", TM_SITE_CD "Site Code", SITE_DESC "Site Description" FROM PT JOIN IDB.PATIENT_V ON APR_MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN DX ON APR_MRN = TM_MRN ORDER BY 1, 9 ; WITH TIP AS (SELECT DISTINCT I.APR_MRN IVAC_MRN FROM IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX_V I JOIN IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX_V E ON I.APR_MRN = E.APR_MRN AND E.CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME = 'CISPLATIN' AND E.APR_START_DTE BETWEEN I.APR_START_DTE AND I.APR_START_DTE + 10 DAYS JOIN IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX_V C ON I.APR_MRN = C.APR_MRN AND C.CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME = 'IFOSFAMIDE' AND C.APR_START_DTE BETWEEN I.APR_START_DTE AND I.APR_START_DTE + 10 DAYS WHERE I.CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME = 'PACLITAXEL' AND YEAR(I.APR_START_DTE) >= 2004 ) SELECT DISTINCT APR_MRN "MRN", PT_LAST_NAME "Last Name", PT_FIRST_NAME "First Name", PT_SEX "Gender", PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH "Date of Birth", YEAR(APR_START_DTE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) "Age", CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME "Chemo Name", APR_START_DTE "Start Date", APR_END_DTE "End Date", APR_TOTAL_GIVEN_DOSE "Total Give Dose" FROM IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX_V JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON APR_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN TIP ON APR_MRN = IVAC_MRN WHERE CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME IN ('CISPLATIN', 'IFOSFAMIDE', 'PACLITAXEL') AND APR_START_DTE BETWEEN '2004-09-01' AND '2019-09-13' AND YEAR(APR_START_DTE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) >= 18 ORDER BY 1, 8, 9 ; WITH TIP AS (SELECT DISTINCT I.APR_MRN IVAC_MRN FROM IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX_V I JOIN IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX_V E ON I.APR_MRN = E.APR_MRN AND E.CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME = 'CISPLATIN' AND E.APR_START_DTE BETWEEN I.APR_START_DTE AND I.APR_START_DTE + 10 DAYS JOIN IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX_V C ON I.APR_MRN = C.APR_MRN AND C.CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME = 'IFOSFAMIDE' AND C.APR_START_DTE BETWEEN I.APR_START_DTE AND I.APR_START_DTE + 10 DAYS WHERE I.CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME = 'PACLITAXEL' AND YEAR(I.APR_START_DTE) >= 2004 ) , PT AS (SELECT DISTINCT APR_MRN FROM IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX_V JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON APR_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN TIP ON APR_MRN = IVAC_MRN WHERE CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME IN ('CISPLATIN', 'IFOSFAMIDE', 'PACLITAXEL') AND APR_START_DTE BETWEEN '2004-09-01' AND '2019-09-13' AND YEAR(APR_START_DTE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) >= 18 ) SELECT PRPT_MRN "MRN", PT_LAST_NAME "Last Name", PT_FIRST_NAME "First Name", PT_SEX "Gender", PT_BIRTH_DTE "Date of Birth", PRPT_REPORT_DTE "Path Report Date", PRPT_REPORT_TYPE_DESC "Path Report Type", PRPT_ACCESSION_NO "Accession No", PRPT_REPORT "Path Report Text" FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V JOIN PT ON PRPT_MRN = APR_MRN JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON PRPT_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE PRPT_REPORT IS NOT NULL ORDER BY 1, 6

prompt: Provide a weekly list of patients diagnosed with CTCL (Mycosis Fungoides).
completion: SELECT DISTINCT * FROM (SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, MAX_ICD9_EFF_DTE AS DIAGNOSIS_DATE , ICD9_CD, ICD9_DESC FROM IDB.PATIENT LEFT JOIN (SELECT CC_MRN, MAX(CC_EFF_DTE) AS MAX_ICD9_EFF_DTE, CC_CLSF_CD AS ICD9_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS ICD9_DESC FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE CC_CLSF_CD IN ('C84.09', 'C84.A9', 'C84.19', 'C84.00') AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND (CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) GROUP BY CC_MRN, CC_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK ) AS ICD9 ON CC_MRN = PT_MRN) WHERE (DIAGNOSIS_DATE) BETWEEN CURRENT DATE - 7 DAYS AND CURRENT DATE UNION SELECT DISTINCT PBD_MRN, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH , PBD_SVC_DTE, DX_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK FROM IDB.PBD_DTL JOIN IDB.PBD_DX ON DX_INV_NO = PBD_INV_NO AND DX_MRN = PBD_MRN JOIN IDB.CLM ON CLM_CLSF_CD = DX_CLSF_CD AND CLM_CD_TYPE = 'D' JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PBD_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE 1=1 AND PBD_SVC_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT DATE - 7 DAYS AND CURRENT DATE AND DX_CLSF_CD IN ('C84.09', 'C84.A9', 'C84.19', 'C84.00')

prompt: Schedule a monthly list of stage 0, 1, 2, and 3 breast cancer survivors above the age of 18.
completion: SELECT TM_MRN AS MRN , CATEGORY1 AS "SEER Category1" , CATEGORY2 AS "SEER Category2" , CASE WHEN CPP_COUNTRY = '' THEN 'Y' END AS USA_INCLUDE , CASE WHEN ZC_COUNTY = 'New York' THEN 'Y' END AS MANHATTAN_INCLUDE , CASE WHEN PT_STATE = 'NY' THEN 'Y' END AS NY_STATE_INCLUDE , CASE WHEN ZC_COUNTY IN ('New York', 'Kings', 'Queens', 'Bronx', 'Richmond') THEN 'Y' END AS NYC_INCLUDE , TRIM(PT_LAST_NAME) AS "Last Name" , TRIM(PT_FIRST_NAME) AS "First Name" , TRIM(PT_SEX) AS "Gender" , PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH AS "Date of Birth" , CASE WHEN PT_DATE_OF_DEATH IS NULL THEN YEAR(CURRENT date - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) END AS "Age" , PT_ADDR1 AS "Address 1" , PT_ADDR2 AS "Address 2" , PT_CITY AS "City" , PT_STATE AS "State" , CASE WHEN LENGTH(STRIP(PT_ZIP_CD)) = 5 THEN PT_ZIP_CD WHEN LENGTH(STRIP(PT_ZIP_CD)) = 9 THEN SUBSTR(PT_ZIP_CD, 1, 5) || '-' || SUBSTR(PT_ZIP_CD, 6, 4) ELSE 'ERROR' END AS "Zip Code" , TRIM(CPP_LANG) AS "Language" , TRIM(CC.AV_DESC) AS "Class of Case" , TM_DX_DTE AS "Tumor Diagnosis Date" , TM_HIST_CD AS "Hist Code" , H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS "Hist Description" , TM_SITE_CD AS "Site Code" , S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS "Site Description" , TRIM(CASE WHEN TM_AJCC_7 NOT IN ('', '888', '999') THEN AJCC7.AV_DESC WHEN TM_AJCC NOT IN ('', '88', '99') THEN AJCC.AV_DESC WHEN TM_GENERAL_STG NOT IN ('', '9') THEN GS.AV_DESC WHEN TM_PATH_STG_GRP NOT IN ('', '88', '9', '99') THEN TM_PATH_STG_GRP ELSE CLIN.AV_DESC END) AS "Stage" , PLA_LST_TX_DTE "Last Tx Date" , ZC_COUNTY , CPP_COUNTRY FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.SEERGROUPING ON RECODE = IDB.SEERF_ICDO(TM_SITE_CD, TM_HIST_CD) AND(CATEGORY1 IN ('Female Genital System') OR CATEGORY2 IN ('Colon and Rectum', 'Prostate')) LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_PAS_PATIENT ON CPP_MRN = TM_MRN JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PT_MRN = TM_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.ZIPCODE Z ON ZC_ZIP = SUBSTR(PT_ZIP_CD, 1, 5) JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY ON PLA_MRN = TM_MRN AND PLA_LST_TX_DTE < CURRENT date - 3 MONTH JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTV_DTL ON LAD_MRN = TM_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS CC ON CC.AV_CODE = TM_CLASS_OF_CASE AND CC.AV_ELEMENT = 'CLASS_OF_CASE' JOIN IDB.CLM H ON TM_HIST_CD = H.CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON TM_SITE_CD = S.CLM_CLSF_CD LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS AJCC7 ON AJCC7.AV_ELEMENT = 'AJCC_7' AND AJCC7.AV_CODE = TM_AJCC_7 LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS AJCC ON AJCC.AV_ELEMENT = 'AJCC' AND AJCC.AV_CODE = TM_AJCC LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS GS ON GS.AV_ELEMENT = 'GENERAL_STG' AND GS.AV_CODE = TM_GENERAL_STG LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS CLIN ON CLIN.AV_ELEMENT = 'CLIN_STG_DSCR' AND CLIN.AV_CODE = TM_CLIN_STG_DSCR JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS CS ON CS.AV_ELEMENT = 'CASE_STS' AND CS.AV_CODE = TM_CASE_STS WHERE 1=1 AND PT_DATE_OF_DEATH IS NULL AND YEAR(CURRENT date - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) >= 18 AND TM_DX_DTE >= CURRENT date - 10 YEARS AND TM_CASE_STS = '3' AND CPP_LANG IN ('ENG', ' ') AND CASE WHEN ZC_COUNTY IN ('New York', 'Kings', 'Queens', 'Bronx', 'Richmond') THEN 'Y' END = 'Y' AND LAD_DONOT_CON_IND <> 'Y' AND(TRIM(CASE WHEN TM_AJCC_7 NOT IN ('', '888', '999') THEN AJCC7.AV_DESC WHEN TM_AJCC NOT IN ('', '88', '99') THEN AJCC.AV_DESC WHEN TM_GENERAL_STG NOT IN ('', '9') THEN GS.AV_DESC WHEN TM_PATH_STG_GRP NOT IN ('', '88', '9', '99') THEN TM_PATH_STG_GRP ELSE CLIN.AV_DESC END) not like '%4%' AND TRIM(CASE WHEN TM_AJCC_7 NOT IN ('', '888', '999') THEN AJCC7.AV_DESC WHEN TM_AJCC NOT IN ('', '88', '99') THEN AJCC.AV_DESC WHEN TM_GENERAL_STG NOT IN ('', '9') THEN GS.AV_DESC WHEN TM_PATH_STG_GRP NOT IN ('', '88', '9', '99') THEN TM_PATH_STG_GRP ELSE CLIN.AV_DESC END) not like '%IV%' AND TRIM(CASE WHEN TM_AJCC_7 NOT IN ('', '888', '999') THEN AJCC7.AV_DESC WHEN TM_AJCC NOT IN ('', '88', '99') THEN AJCC.AV_DESC WHEN TM_GENERAL_STG NOT IN ('', '9') THEN GS.AV_DESC WHEN TM_PATH_STG_GRP NOT IN ('', '88', '9', '99') THEN TM_PATH_STG_GRP ELSE CLIN.AV_DESC END) not like '%DISTANT METASTASES/SYSTEMIC DISEASE%')

prompt: Patients with Thymic tumors treated with Radiation and/or Chemo since 2000
completion: WITH CTE AS (SELECT CC_MRN TM_MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS DX_DTE FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE CC_CLSF_CD IN ('C37', '164.0') AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND (CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) AND CC_MRN NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT SSE_MRN FROM IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT WHERE (SSE_SURG_LOC not like '%IR%' AND SSE_SURG_LOC not like '%ENDO%' AND SSE_SOURCE_TYPE <> 'E') ) GROUP BY CC_MRN UNION ALL SELECT DISTINCT TM_MRN, MIN(TM_DX_DTE) DX_DTE FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND TM_SITE_CD LIKE 'C37%' AND TM_MRN NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT SSE_MRN FROM IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT WHERE (SSE_SURG_LOC not like '%IR%' AND SSE_SURG_LOC not like '%ENDO%' AND SSE_SOURCE_TYPE <> 'E') ) AND TM_CA_SURG_DTE IS NULL GROUP BY TM_MRN ) , DX AS (SELECT TM_MRN, MIN(DX_DTE) DX_DTE FROM CTE WHERE DX_DTE >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY TM_MRN) , CHEMOLIST AS (SELECT APR_MRN, CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME, MIN(APR_START_DTE) FIRST_START_DTE, MAX(APR_START_DTE) LAST_START_DTE, COUNT(*) COUNT FROM IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX JOIN IDB.CHEMO_DRUG_GENERIC ON APR_GENERIC_NAME = CDG_GENERIC_NAME JOIN DX ON APR_MRN = TM_MRN WHERE CDG_CHEMO_FLAG = 'Y' AND YEAR(APR_START_DTE) >= 2000 GROUP BY APR_MRN, CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME ) , CHEMO AS (SELECT APR_MRN, LISTAGG(COALESCE(TRIM(CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME), '') || ' | ' || COALESCE(CAST(FIRST_START_DTE AS VARCHAR(20)), '') || ' | ' || COALESCE(CAST(LAST_START_DTE AS VARCHAR(20)), '') || (A.COR_SIGNIFICANT_DT) ASC) AS POS_RN FROM (SELECT COR_MRN, COR_SIGNIFICANT_DT, COR_RESULT_ARRIVAL_DT, COR_ORDER_ID, CASE WHEN LOWER(COR_RESULT_TEXT) like 'detected%' THEN 'Positive' WHEN COR_RESULT_ARRIVAL_DT, COR_ORDER_ID, CASE WHEN LOWER(COR_RESULT_TEXT) like 'detected%' THEN 'Positive' WHEN COR_ORDER_NAME IN ('COVID-19 Rapid Qualitative RNA') AND LOWER(COR_RESULT_TEXT) like prompt: Provide a list of pancreatic patients with BRCA1, BRCA2, and PALB2 mutations
completion: WITH PTS AS (SELECT PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID PID FROM DV.PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED) , DT_1 AS (SELECT PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID AS P_ID FROM DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS REC LEFT JOIN DV.PATIENT_CORE_DEMOGRAPHICS ON PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = CORE_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID WHERE 1=1 AND PT_VITAL_STATUS= 'ALIVE' ) , DT_2 AS (SELECT INC.PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID P_ID , METASTASIS_SITE FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_STRUCTURED_RESULTS_V INC JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML DT ON INC.PRPT_PATH_RPT_ID = DT.PDRX_PATH_RPT_ID CROSS JOIN XMLTABLE('$c/root/meta-data' PASSING DT.PDRX_XML_VALUE AS "c" COLUMNS PRIMARY_SITE VARCHAR(264) PATH 'primary_site', TUMOR_TYPE_NAME VARCHAR(264) PATH 'tumor_type_name' , TUMOR_TYPE_CODE VARCHAR(264) PATH 'tumor_type_code', IS_METASTASIS VARCHAR(3) PATH 'is_metastasis' , METASTASIS_SITE VARCHAR(264) PATH 'metastasis_site' , MSI_COMMENT VARCHAR(264) PATH 'msi-comment' , MSI_SCORE VARCHAR(264) PATH 'msi-score' , MSI_TYPE VARCHAR(264) PATH 'msi-type' , TMB_SCORE VARCHAR(25) PATH 'tmb_score' , TMB_COUNT VARCHAR(25) PATH 'tmb-count', COSMIC_ID VARCHAR(5000) PATH 'cosmic_id') T JOIN (SELECT T.TUMOR_TYPE_CODE TTC FROM TABLE(DV.STRING_SPLIT('PAAD,PAAC,PAASC', ',')) S CROSS JOIN TABLE(DV.ONCOTREE_CHILDREN(COLUMN_VALUES)) T) X ON T.TUMOR_TYPE_CODE = TRIM(X.TTC) WHERE 1=1 AND CASE WHEN LOWER(METASTASIS_SITE) IN ('null', 'not available', 'not applicable', '') THEN 'No' ELSE 'Yes' END = 'Yes' AND (INC.GENE IN ('BRCA1', 'BRCA2', 'PALB2', 'ATM') OR INC.GENE2 IN ('BRCA1', 'BRCA2', 'PALB2', 'ATM')) AND METASTASIS_SITE = 'Liver' ) , DEID AS (SELECT DISTINCT P_ID FROM (SELECT P_ID FROM DT_1 INTERSECT SELECT P_ID FROM DT_2 ))

Rehabilitation', 'Follow Up, PT/OT - Rehabilitation', 'Follow Up, PT - Rehabilitation') AND CDD_CANCEL_IND <> '1' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND <> '1' ) , ORD AS (SELECT DISTINCT OO_MRN, OO_ORD_NAME, OO_ENTER_DTE FROM PTS P JOIN IDB.OMS_ORDER ON MRN = OO_MRN WHERE OO_ORD_STS_CD NOT IN ('CANP', 'CANC', 'AUC3') AND OO_ORD_NAME IN ('Physical Therapy Inpatient Consult', 'Physical Therapy Pre/Post-Op Evaluation') ) , CD AS (SELECT DISTINCT CDD_MRN, CDD_DOC_NAME, CDD_SERVICE_DTE FROM PTS JOIN IDB.CD_DOCUMENT ON MRN = CDD_MRN WHERE CDD_DOC_NAME IN ('Initial/ReEval/Completion Summary, PT - Rehabilitation', 'Follow Up, PT/OT - Rehabilitation', 'Follow Up, PT - Rehabilitation') AND CDD_CANCEL_IND <> '1' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND <> '1' ), ADM_TO_ORD AS (SELECT MRN, OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE, OCV_CURR_LOC, MIN(CASE WHEN OO_ORD_NAME = 'Physical Therapy Inpatient Consult' AND OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE <= OO_ENTER_DTE THEN OO_ENTER_DTE END) "Date of Physical Therapy Inpatient Consult order", MIN(CASE WHEN OO_ORD_NAME = 'Physical Therapy Pre/Post-Op Evaluation' AND OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE <= OO_ENTER_DTE THEN OO_ENTER_DTE END) "Date of Physical Therapy Pre/Post-Op Evaluation order" FROM PTS JOIN ORD ON MRN = OO_MRN GROUP BY MRN, OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE, OCV_CURR_LOC) SELECT P.MRN, PT_LAST_NAME "Last Name", PT_FIRST_NAME "First Name", P.OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE "Order Significant Date", P.OCV_CURR_LOC "Location", "Date of Physical Therapy Inpatient Consult order", "Date of Physical Therapy Pre/Post-Op Evaluation order", MIN(CASE WHEN CDD_DOC_NAME = 'Initial/ReEval/Completion Summary, PT - Rehabilitation' AND COALESCE("Date of Physical Therapy Inpatient Consult order", "Date of Physical Therapy Pre/Post-Op Evaluation order") <= CDD_SERVICE_DTE THEN CDD_SERVICE_DTE END) "Date of Initial/ReEval/Completion Summary, PT- Rehabilitation note", MIN(CASE WHEN CDD_DOC_NAME = 'Follow Up, PT/OT - Rehabilitation' AND COALESCE("Date of Physical Therapy Inpatient Consult order", "Date of Physical Therapy Pre/Post-Op Evaluation order") <= CDD_SERVICE_DTE THEN CDD_SERVICE_DTE END) "Date of Follow Up, PT/OT - Rehabilitation note", MIN(CASE WHEN CDD_DOC_NAME = 'Follow Up, PT - Rehabilitation' AND COALESCE("Date of Physical Therapy Inpatient Consult order", "Date of Physical Therapy Pre/Post-Op Evaluation order") <= CDD_SERVICE_DTE THEN CDD_SERVICE_DTE END) "Date of Follow Up, PT - Rehabilitation note" FROM PTS P JOIN ADM_TO_ORD AO ON P.MRN = AO.MRN AND P.OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE = AO.OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE JOIN CD ON P.MRN = CDD_MRN JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON P.MRN = PT_MRN GROUP BY P.MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, P.OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE, P.OCV_CURR_LOC, "Date of Physical Therapy Inpatient Consult order", "Date of Physical Therapy Pre/Post-Op Evaluation order" ORDER BY P.MRN, OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE

SSE_SURG_DTE, SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD, SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC, SURGEON_NAME FROM (SELECT DISTINCT SSE_MRN, CHEMO_START_DTE, CHEMO_END_DTE, SSE_SURG_DTE, SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD, SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC, SURGEON_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY SSE_MRN, SSE_SURG_DTE ORDER BY CHEMO_START_DTE ASC) AS RN_FIRST FROM SURG WHERE CHEMO_START_DTE BETWEEN SSE_SURG_DTE - 3 YEARS AND SSE_SURG_DTE ) WHERE RN_FIRST =1 ) , CHEMO_LAST AS (SELECT DISTINCT SSE_MRN AS CHEMO_LAST_MRN, CHEMO_START_DTE AS CHEMO_LAST_START_DATE, CHEMO_END_DTE AS CHEMO_FIRST_END_DATE, SSE_SURG_DTE, RN_LAST FROM (SELECT DISTINCT SSE_MRN, CHEMO_START_DTE, CHEMO_END_DTE, SSE_SURG_DTE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY SSE_MRN ORDER BY CHEMO_END_DTE DESC) AS RN_LAST FROM SURG) WHERE RN_LAST =1 ) , SURGERY_AFTER_DRUG AS (SELECT DISTINCT CHEMO_FIRST_MRN AS SURG_MRN, CHEMO_FIRST_START_DATE AS SURG_START_DATE, CHEMO_FIRST_END_DATE AS SURG_END_DATE, SSE_SURG_DTE AS SURG_DATE, SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD, SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC, SURGEON_NAME FROM CHEMO_FIRST WHERE SSE_SURG_DTE > CHEMO_FIRST_START_DATE ) , DIAGNOSIS AS (SELECT DISTINCT PBD_MRN, LISTAGG(COALESCE(STRIP(CAST(MIN_DTE AS VARCHAR(12000))), '')||' : '|| COALESCE(STRIP(CAST(ICD9_CD AS VARCHAR(12000))), '')||' - '|| COALESCE(STRIP(CAST(ICD9_DESC AS VARCHAR(12000))), '')|| ' | ', CHR(13) || CHR(10)) WITHIN GROUP ( ORDER BY ICD9_CD) AS BILLING_DIAGNOSIS FROM (SELECT DISTINCT PBD_MRN, MIN(PBD_SVC_DTE) AS MIN_DTE, DX_CLSF_CD AS ICD9_CD, A.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS ICD9_DESC, 'PBD' AS SOURCE FROM IDB.PBD_DTL JOIN IDB.PBD_DX ON PBD_MRN = DX_MRN AND PBD_INV_NO = DX_INV_NO JOIN IDB.CLM A ON DX_CLSF_CD = A.CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.PBD_CODE ON PBD_PBD_CD = PBC_PBD_CD JOIN IDB.CLM B ON PBC_CPT_CD = B.CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.PBD_INVOICE ON PBD_INV_NO = PBI_INV_NO JOIN IDB.DOC ON PBI_PERFORM_DR_NO = DOC_DR_NO JOIN SURGERY_AFTER_DRUG ON SURG_MRN = PBD_MRN WHERE 1=1 GROUP BY PBD_MRN, DX_CLSF_CD, A.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK ) GROUP BY PBD_MRN) SELECT DISTINCT SURG_MRN AS MRN, SURG_START_DATE AS CHEMO_FIRST_DATE, SURG_END_DATE AS CHEMO_END_DATE, SURG_DATE, SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD AS SURG_CODE, SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC AS SURG_DESC, SURGEON_NAME, BILLING_DIAGNOSIS FROM SURGERY_AFTER_DRUG LEFT JOIN DIAGNOSIS ON PBD_MRN = SURG_MRN ORDER BY SURG_MRN; WITH CHEMO AS (SELECT DISTINCT APR_MRN AS CHEMO_MRN, APR_START_DTE AS CHEMO_START_DTE, APR_END_DTE AS CHEMO_END_DTE FROM IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX JOIN IDB.CHEMO_DRUG_GENERIC ON APR_GENERIC_NAME = CDG_GENERIC_NAME WHERE 1=1 AND CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME = 'BEVACIZUMAB' ) , SURG AS (SELECT DISTINCT SSE_MRN, SSE_SURG_DTE, CHEMO_START_DTE, CHEMO_END_DTE, SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD, SSP_SURG_SVC_CD, SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC, TRIM(SSP_SURG_LAST_NM) || ', ' || SSP_SURG_FIRST_NM AS SURGEON_NAME FROM IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE ON SSE_LOG_ID= SSP_LOG_ID AND SSE_ENC_CSN_ID = SSP_ENC_CSN_ID JOIN CHEMO ON SSE_MRN = CHEMO_MRN WHERE (SSE_SURG_LOC NOT LIKE '%IR%' AND SSE_SURG_LOC NOT LIKE '%ENDO%' AND SSE_SOURCE_TYPE <> 'E') AND SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD BETWEEN '61304' AND '61576' AND SSE_SURG_DTE <= '2023-09-01' ) , CHEMO_FIRST AS (SELECT DISTINCT SSE_MRN AS CHEMO_FIRST_MRN, CHEMO_START_DTE AS CHEMO_FIRST_START_DATE, CHEMO_END_DTE AS CHEMO_FIRST_END_DATE, SSE_SURG_DTE, SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD, SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC, SURGEON_NAME FROM (SELECT DISTINCT SSE_MRN, CHEMO_START_DTE, CHEMO_END_DTE, SSE_SURG_DTE, SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD, SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC, SURGEON_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY SSE_MRN, SSE_SURG_DTE ORDER BY CHEMO_START_DTE ASC) AS RN_FIRST FROM SURG WHERE CHEMO_START_DTE BETWEEN SSE_SURG_DTE - 3 YEARS AND SSE_SURG_DTE ) WHERE RN_FIRST =1 ) , CHEMO_LAST AS (SELECT DISTINCT SSE_MRN AS CHEMO_LAST_MRN, CHEMO_START_DTE AS CHEMO_LAST_START_DATE, CHEMO_END_DTE AS CHEMO_FIRST_END_DATE, SSE_SURG_DTE, RN_LAST FROM (SELECT DISTINCT SSE_MRN, CHEMO_START_DTE, CHEMO_END_DTE, SSE_SURG_DTE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY SSE_MRN ORDER BY CHEMO_END_DTE DESC) AS RN_LAST FROM SURG) WHERE RN_LAST =1 ) , SURGERY_AFTER_DRUG AS (SELECT DISTINCT CHEMO_FIRST_MRN AS SURG_MRN, CHEMO_FIRST_START_DATE AS SURG_START_DATE, CHEMO_FIRST_END_DATE AS SURG_END_DATE, SSE_SURG_DTE AS SURG_DATE, SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD, SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC, SURGEON_NAME FROM CHEMO_FIRST WHERE SSE_SURG_DTE > CHEMO_FIRST_START_DATE ) , PATH AS (SELECT DISTINCT PRPT_MRN, PRPT_REPORT_DTE AS PATH_REPORT_DATE, PRPT_ACCESSION_NO AS PATH_ACCESSION_NO, VARCHAR(PRPT_REPORT, 32000) AS PATH_REPORT, DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)diag[\w\W]*(?=I ATTEST)', PRPT_REPORT) AS PATH_DIAGNOSIS FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V INNER JOIN SURGERY_AFTER_DRUG ON SURG_MRN = PRPT_MRN AND PRPT_PROCEDURE_DTE = SURG_DATE AND PRPT_REPORT_DTE >= SURG_DATE AND PRPT_REPORT_DTE <= '2023-09-01' WHERE PRPT_REPORT IS NOT NULL ) SELECT DISTINCT SURG_MRN AS MRN, PATH_REPORT_DATE, PATH_ACCESSION_NO, PATH_REPORT, PATH_DIAGNOSIS FROM SURGERY_AFTER_DRUG INNER JOIN PATH ON SURG_MRN = PRPT_MRN ORDER BY SURG_MRN;

prompt: Provide a weekly list of patients with non small cell lung cancer (NSCLC) that have had IMPACT or ACCESS testing completed and include whether they have consented to 12-245 and/or 06-107 (flag)
completion: WITH DT AS (SELECT DT.PDRX_DMP_PATIENT_ID, DT.PDRX_DMP_SAMPLE_ID, PDRX_PATH_RPT_ID, PDRX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID P_ID , METHOD, DT_DTE AS REPORT_DATE, TUMOR_TYPE_CODE, TUMOR_TYPE_NAME FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML DT JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT ON DT.PDRX_PATH_RPT_ID = PRPT_PATH_RPT_ID JOIN DV.DATE ON DT_DATE_ID = PRPT_REPORT_DATE_ID CROSS JOIN XMLTABLE('$c/root/meta-data' PASSING DT.PDRX_XML_VALUE AS "c" COLUMNS PRIMARY_SITE VARCHAR(264) PATH 'primary_site', TUMOR_TYPE_NAME VARCHAR(264) PATH 'tumor_type_name' , TUMOR_TYPE_CODE VARCHAR(264) PATH 'tumor_type_code', IS_METASTASIS VARCHAR(3) PATH 'is_metastasis' , METASTASIS_SITE VARCHAR(264) PATH 'metastasis_site' , MSI_COMMENT VARCHAR(264) PATH 'msi-comment' , MSI_SCORE VARCHAR(264) PATH 'msi-score' , MSI_TYPE VARCHAR(264) PATH 'msi-type' , TMB_SCORE VARCHAR(25) PATH 'tmb_score' , TMB_COUNT VARCHAR(25) PATH 'tmb-count', COSMIC_ID VARCHAR(5000) PATH 'cosmic_id' , METHOD VARCHAR(256) PATH 'dmp_alys_task_name') T JOIN (SELECT T.TUMOR_TYPE_CODE TTC FROM TABLE(DV.ONCOTREE_CHILDREN('LUNG')) T) X ON T.TUMOR_TYPE_CODE = TRIM(X.TTC) ) , DT_1 AS (SELECT PT_MRN, PDRX_DMP_PATIENT_ID, DT.PDRX_DMP_SAMPLE_ID , METHOD, REPORT_DATE, TUMOR_TYPE_CODE, TUMOR_TYPE_NAME , A1.AC_CONS_DTE CONSENT_06107 , A1.AC_OFF_STUDY_DTE OFF_STUDY_06107 , A2.AC_CONS_DTE CONSENT_12245 , A2.AC_OFF_STUDY_DTE OFF_STUDY_12245 FROM DT JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = P_ID LEFT JOIN DV.ACCRUALS A1 ON A1.AC_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = P_ID AND A1.AC_PROTOCOL_ID = (SELECT PRO_PROTOCOL_ID FROM DV.PROTOCOL WHERE PRO_IRB_NO IN ('06-107')) LEFT JOIN DV.ACCRUALS A2 ON A2.AC_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = P_ID AND A2.AC_PROTOCOL_ID = (SELECT PRO_PROTOCOL_ID FROM DV.PROTOCOL WHERE PRO_IRB_NO IN ('12-245'))) SELECT * FROM DT_1 WHERE REPORT_DATE >= CURRENT date - 30 DAYS ORDER BY REPORT_DATE DESC ;

prompt: Provide a list of neurosurgical spine patients whose pathology report confirmed colorectal, rectal, or colon as the diagnosis.
completion: WITH PATH_DX AS (SELECT PRPT_MRN, PRPT_PROCEDURE_DTE, PRPT_REPORT_DTE, PRPT_REPORT_TYPE_DESC, PRPT_ACCESSION_NO, PRPT_REPORT, PRPT_ORD_DR_NAME, PRPT_ORD_DR_SVC_DESC FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V WHERE PRPT_REPORT IS NOT NULL AND (CONTAINS("PRPT_REPORT", '("metastatic adenocarcinoma" & ("colon" | "colorectal" | "colonic" | "rectal"))') = 1) AND DATE(PRPT_REPORT_DTE) BETWEEN '1998-01-01' AND '2020-05-31' ) , SURG AS (SELECT DISTINCT SSE_MRN, SSE_SURG_DTE FROM IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE ON SSE_LOG_ID = SSP_LOG_ID AND SSE_ENC_CSN_ID = SSP_ENC_CSN_ID JOIN PATH_DX ON SSE_MRN = PRPT_MRN WHERE 1=1 AND SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD IN ('63275', '63276', '63277', '63055', '22842') ) SELECT PRPT_MRN MRN , PT_SEX , PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH , PT_DATE_OF_DEATH , PLA_LST_KNOWN_ALIVE_DTE , SSE_SURG_DTE , PRPT_REPORT_DTE , PRPT_REPORT FROM PATH_DX JOIN SURG ON PRPT_MRN = SSE_MRN JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PRPT_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY ON PRPT_MRN = PLA_MRN WHERE 1=1 ; WITH PATH_DX AS (SELECT PRPT_MRN, PRPT_PROCEDURE_DTE, PRPT_REPORT_DTE, PRPT_REPORT_TYPE_DESC, PRPT_ACCESSION_NO, PRPT_REPORT, PRPT_ORD_DR_NAME, PRPT_ORD_DR_SVC_DESC FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V WHERE PRPT_REPORT IS NOT NULL AND (CONTAINS("PRPT_REPORT", '("metastatic adenocarcinoma" & ("colon" | "colorectal" | "colonic" | "rectal"))') = 1) AND DATE(PRPT_REPORT_DTE) BETWEEN '1998-01-01' AND '2020-05-31' ) , SURG AS (SELECT DISTINCT SSE_MRN, SSE_SURG_DTE FROM IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE ON SSE_LOG_ID = SSP_LOG_ID AND SSE_ENC_CSN_ID = SSP_ENC_CSN_ID JOIN PATH_DX ON SSE_MRN = PRPT_MRN WHERE 1=1 AND SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD IN ('63275', '63276', '63277', '63055', '22842') ) , RADONC AS (SELECT RTC_TX_MRN, RTC_TX_PLAN_NAME, RTC_PRIMARY_REF_POINT, RTC_TX_PLANNED_FRACTIONS, RTC_TX_DELIVERED_FRACTIONS, RTC_TX_PLANNED_DOSE, RTC_TX_DELIVERED_DOSE, RTC_TX_START_DTE, RTC_TX_STOP_DTE, RTC_TX_ELAPSED_DAYS, RTC_DOSE_CORRECTION FROM IDB.RADONC_TREATMENT_COURSE JOIN SURG ON SSE_MRN = RTC_TX_MRN WHERE 1=1 AND RTC_TX_START_DTE BETWEEN '1998-01-01' AND '2020-05-31' ) SELECT RTC_TX_MRN MRN, RTC_TX_PLAN_NAME, RTC_PRIMARY_REF_POINT, RTC_TX_PLANNED_FRACTIONS, RTC_TX_DELIVERED_FRACTIONS, RTC_TX_PLANNED_DOSE, RTC_TX_DELIVERED_DOSE, RTC_TX_START_DTE, RTC_TX_STOP_DTE, RTC_TX_ELAPSED_DAYS, RTC_DOSE_CORRECTION FROM PATH_DX JOIN SURG ON PRPT_MRN = SSE_MRN JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PRPT_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY ON PRPT_MRN = PLA_MRN JOIN RADONC ON PRPT_MRN = RTC_TX_MRN WHERE 1=1 ; WITH PATH_DX AS (SELECT PRPT_MRN, PRPT_PROCEDURE_DTE, PRPT_REPORT_DTE, PRPT_REPORT_TYPE_DESC, PRPT_ACCESSION_NO, PRPT_REPORT, PRPT_ORD_DR_NAME, PRPT_ORD_DR_SVC_DESC FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V WHERE PRPT_REPORT IS NOT NULL AND (CONTAINS("PRPT_REPORT", '("adenocarcinoma" & ("lung" | "non-small cell" | "non small cell"))') = 1) AND DATE(PRPT_REPORT_DTE) BETWEEN '1998-01-01' AND '2020-05-31' ) , SURG AS (SELECT DISTINCT SSE_MRN, SSE_SURG_DTE FROM IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE ON SSE_LOG_ID = SSP_LOG_ID AND SSE_ENC_CSN_ID = SSP_ENC_CSN_ID JOIN PATH_DX ON SSE_MRN = PRPT_MRN WHERE 1=1 AND SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD IN ('63275', '63276', '63277', '63055', '22842') ) SELECT PRPT_MRN MRN , PT_SEX , PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH , PT_DATE_OF_DEATH , PLA_LST_KNOWN_ALIVE_DTE , SSE_SURG_DTE , PRPT_REPORT_DTE , PRPT_REPORT FROM PATH_DX JOIN SURG ON PRPT_MRN = SSE_MRN JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PRPT_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY ON PRPT_MRN = PLA_MRN WHERE 1=1 ; WITH PATH_DX AS (SELECT PRPT_MRN, PRPT_PROCEDURE_DTE, PRPT_REPORT_DTE, PRPT_REPORT_TYPE_DESC, PRPT_ACCESSION_NO, PRPT_REPORT, PRPT_ORD_DR_NAME, PRPT_ORD_DR_SVC_DESC FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V WHERE PRPT_REPORT IS NOT NULL AND (CONTAINS("PRPT_REPORT", '("adenocarcinoma" & ("lung" | "non-small cell" | "non small cell"))') = 1) AND DATE(PRPT_REPORT_DTE) BETWEEN '1998-01-01' AND '2020-05-31' ) , SURG AS (SELECT DISTINCT SSE_MRN, SSE_SURG_DTE FROM IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE ON SSE_LOG_ID = SSP_LOG_ID AND SSE_ENC_CSN_ID = SSP_ENC_CSN_ID JOIN PATH_DX ON SSE_MRN = PRPT_MRN WHERE 1=1 AND SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD IN ('63275', '63276', '63277', '63055', '22842') ) , RADONC AS (SELECT RTC_TX_MRN, RTC_TX_PLAN_NAME, RTC_PRIMARY_REF_POINT, RTC_TX_PLANNED_FRACTIONS, RTC_TX_DELIVERED_FRACTIONS, RTC_TX_PLANNED_DOSE, RTC_TX_DELIVERED_DOSE, RTC_TX_START_DTE, RTC_TX_STOP_DTE, RTC_TX_ELAPSED_DAYS, RTC_DOSE_CORRECTION FROM IDB.RADONC_TREATMENT_COURSE JOIN SURG ON SSE_MRN = RTC_TX_MRN WHERE 1=1 AND RTC_TX_START_DTE BETWEEN '1998-01-01' AND '2020-05-31' ) SELECT RTC_TX_MRN MRN, RTC_TX_PLAN_NAME, RTC_PRIMARY_REF_POINT, RTC_TX_PLANNED_FRACTIONS, RTC_TX_DELIVERED_FRACTIONS, RTC_TX_PLANNED_DOSE, RTC_TX_DELIVERED_DOSE, RTC_TX_START_DTE, RTC_TX_STOP_DTE, RTC_TX_ELAPSED_DAYS, RTC_DOSE_CORRECTION FROM PATH_DX JOIN SURG ON PRPT_MRN = SSE_MRN JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PRPT_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY ON PRPT_MRN = PLA_MRN JOIN RADONC ON PRPT_MRN = RTC_TX_MRN WHERE 1=1 ;

prompt: Provide a list of low-grade fibromyxoid sarcoma and sclerosing epitheliod fibrosarcoma patients with localized or metastatic disease .
completion: WITH PATH AS (SELECT DISTINCT "t1"."PT_MRN" AS "MRN", "t2"."PRPT_ACCESSION_NO" AS "Pathology Report", "t3"."PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_DESC" AS "Pathology Report Type", "t4"."DT_DTE" AS "Pathology Procedure Date", UPPER(CASE WHEN LENGTH(PRPT_REPORT) <= 15000 THEN RTRIM(CAST(SUBSTR(PRPT_REPORT, 1, 15000) AS VARCHAR(15000))) ELSE CAST(SUBSTR(PRPT_REPORT, 1, 15000) AS VARCHAR(15000)) END) AS TXT FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V" "t1" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED" "t6" ON "t1"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t6"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V" "t2" ON "t6"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t2"."PRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATH_RPRT_TYPE_LOOKUP" "t3" ON "t2"."PRPT_REPORT_TYPE" = "t3"."PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_CD" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" "t4" ON "t2"."PRPT_PROCEDURE_DATE_ID" = "t4"."DT_DATE_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" "t5" ON "t2"."PRPT_REPORT_DATE_ID" = "t5"."DT_DATE_ID" WHERE 1=1 AND CONTAINS("t2"."PRPT_REPORT", '("low-grade fibromyxoid" OR "low grade fibromyxoid" OR "sclerosing epitheliod fibrosarcoma")') = 1 AND "t2"."PRPT_REPORT" IS NOT NULL AND UPPER("t3"."PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_DESC") LIKE '%SURGICAL PATHOLOGY%' ) , SAR AS (SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN AS MRN, CPE_ENC_DTE, CRE_RES_NAME, CRE_RES_TYP, CLD_DEPT_NAME, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8, CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN PATH ON CPE_MRN = MRN JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CRE_RES_TYP IN ('Physician') AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 = 'SAR' ) , X AS (SELECT DISTINCT PATH.* FROM PATH JOIN SAR ON PATH.MRN = SAR.MRN) , CHEMO AS (SELECT DISTINCT APR_MRN, CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME, APR_START_DTE, APR_END_DTE, APR_ORD_RX_TYPE FROM IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX_V JOIN X ON APR_MRN = MRN WHERE CDG_CHEMO_FLAG = 'Y' AND NOT(CDG_IMMUNOTHERAPY_FLAG = 'Y') ) , CHEMO1 AS (SELECT APR_MRN, CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME, MIN(APR_START_DTE) AS START_DATE, MAX(COALESCE(APR_END_DTE, APR_START_DTE)) AS END_DATE FROM CHEMO GROUP BY APR_MRN, CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME) , CHEMO2 AS (SELECT APR_MRN, LISTAGG(COALESCE(STRIP(CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME), '') || ' | ' || COALESCE(STRIP(CAST(START_DATE AS VARCHAR(1000))), '') || ' | ' || COALESCE(STRIP(CAST(END_DATE AS VARCHAR(1000))), '') , CHR(13) || CHR(10)) WITHIN GROUP( ORDER BY APR_MRN, START_DATE, END_DATE, CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME) AS CHEMO FROM CHEMO1 GROUP BY APR_MRN) , IO AS (SELECT DISTINCT APR_MRN, CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME, APR_START_DTE, APR_END_DTE, APR_ORD_RX_TYPE FROM IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX_V JOIN X ON APR_MRN = MRN WHERE CDG_IMMUNOTHERAPY_FLAG = 'Y' ) , IO1 AS (SELECT APR_MRN, CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME, MIN(APR_START_DTE) AS START_DATE, MAX(COALESCE(APR_END_DTE, APR_START_DTE)) AS END_DATE FROM IO GROUP BY APR_MRN, CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME) , IO2 AS (SELECT APR_MRN, LISTAGG(COALESCE(STRIP(CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME), '') || ' | ' || COALESCE(STRIP(CAST(START_DATE AS VARCHAR(1000))), '') || ' | ' || COALESCE(STRIP(CAST(END_DATE AS VARCHAR(1000))), '') , CHR(13) || CHR(10)) WITHIN GROUP( ORDER BY APR_MRN, START_DATE, END_DATE, CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME) AS IO FROM IO1 GROUP BY APR_MRN) , RT AS (SELECT DISTINCT RTC_TX_MRN, RTC_TX_PLAN_NAME, RTC_PRIMARY_REF_POINT, RTC_TX_START_DTE, RTC_TX_STOP_DTE, RTC_TX_ELAPSED_DAYS, RTC_TX_PLANNED_FRACTIONS, RTC_TX_DELIVERED_FRACTIONS, RTC_TX_PLANNED_DOSE, RTC_TX_DELIVERED_DOSE, RTC_DOSE_CORRECTION FROM X JOIN IDB.RADONC_TREATMENT_COURSE ON RTC_TX_MRN = MRN) , RT1 AS (SELECT RTC_TX_MRN, RTC_TX_PLAN_NAME, MIN(RTC_TX_START_DTE) AS START_DATE, MAX(RTC_TX_STOP_DTE) AS STOP_DATE FROM RT GROUP BY RTC_TX_MRN, RTC_TX_PLAN_NAME) , RT2 AS (SELECT RTC_TX_MRN, LISTAGG(COALESCE(STRIP(RTC_TX_PLAN_NAME), '') || ' | ' || COALESCE(STRIP(CAST(START_DATE AS VARCHAR(1000))), '') || ' | ' || COALESCE(STRIP(CAST(STOP_DATE AS VARCHAR(1000))), '') , CHR(13) || CHR(10)) WITHIN GROUP( ORDER BY RTC_TX_MRN, RTC_TX_PLAN_NAME, START_DATE, STOP_DATE) AS RT FROM RT1 GROUP BY RTC_TX_MRN) SELECT DISTINCT X.*, CHEMO, IO, RT FROM X LEFT JOIN CHEMO2 ON MRN = CHEMO2.APR_MRN LEFT JOIN IO2 ON MRN = IO2.APR_MRN LEFT JOIN RT2 ON MRN = RT2.RTC_TX_MRN

prompt: Provide IMPACT, chemo, RadOnc, surgery, tumor, diagnosis, pathology, radiology, and demographic data for a cohort of IMPACT-tested patients
completion: WITH ALLOW_PTS AS (SELECT CHP_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID AS ALLOW_PID, PT_MRN MRN, PT_LAST_NAME "Last Name", PT_FIRST_NAME "First Name" , CHT_COHORT_CREATE_DTE , CHP_COHORT_ID, CHP_CREATED_DT FROM DVCMS.COHORT_PATIENT INNER JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON CHP_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID=PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID JOIN DVCMS.COHORT ON CHT_COHORT_ID= CHP_COHORT_ID WHERE CHP_COHORT_ID = 9031 ) , RADONC AS (SELECT DISTINCT MRN, START_D.DT_DTE AS "Start Date", STOP_D.DT_DTE AS "Stop Date", RTC_TX_PLAN_NAME AS "Plan Name", RTC_TX_PLANNED_DOSE AS "Planned Dose", RTC_TX_DELIVERED_DOSE AS "Delivered Dose", RTC_TX_PLANNED_FRACTIONS AS "Planned Fractions", RTC_TX_DELIVERED_FRACTIONS AS "Delivered Fractions", RTC_TX_ELAPSED_DAYS AS "Elapsed Days", REF_CAT.RFC_REFERENCE_POINT AS "Reference Point/Site" FROM DV.RADONC_TREATMENT_COURSE JOIN ALLOW_PTS ON ALLOW_PID = RTC_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID LEFT JOIN DV.DATE_V START_D ON RTC_TX_START_DATE_ID = START_D.DT_DATE_ID LEFT JOIN DV.DATE_V STOP_D ON RTC_TX_STOP_DATE_ID = STOP_D.DT_DATE_ID LEFT JOIN DV.REFERENCE_POINT_CATALOG REF_CAT ON REF_CAT.RFC_BEAM_THERAPY_ID = RTC_REFERENCE_POINT_ID) SELECT * FROM RADONC ORDER BY 1, 2, 3 ;

prompt: Female patients scheduled for RO set up at Main Campus (aged 11-50) within the next week that will need pregnancy test
completion: SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN "MRN", PT_LAST_NAME "Last Name", PT_FIRST_NAME "First Name", A.CRE_RES_NAME "Resource", B.CRE_RES_NAME "Referring Provider", CLD_CLD_CENTER "Location", CPE_ENC_DTE "Appt Date", TIME(CPE_APPT_DT) AS "Appt Time", CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME "Visit Type", OOC_ITEM_DESC "Order", OSTS_STS_DESC "Order Status" FROM IDB.PATIENT JOIN IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER ON PT_MRN = CPE_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE A ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = A.CRE_RES_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE B ON CPE_REF_RES_ID = B.CRE_RES_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_ORDER ON OO_MRN = PT_MRN AND OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID = '9000006089100730' LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_STATUS ON OO_ORD_STS_CD = OSTS_ORD_STS_CD LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_CATALOG ON OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID = OOC_MSTR_ITEM_GUID WHERE PT_SEX = 'F' AND YEAR(CPE_ENC_DTE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) BETWEEN 11 AND 50 AND CPE_CPE_APPT_STS = 'Sch' AND CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME IN ('RO BOOST SETUP-60', 'RO CONE DOWN SETUP-30', 'RO CONE DOWN SETUP-60', 'RO SBRT (<=5 FX) SETUP&TX-120', 'RO SBRT (<=5 FX) SETUP&TX-60', 'RO SBRT (<=5 FX) SETUP&TX-90', 'RO SBRT (1 FX) SETUP&TX-120', 'RO SBRT (1 FX) SETUP&TX-60', 'RO SBRT (1 FX) SETUP&TX-90', 'RO SETUP BEAM TREAT EXT RT-105', 'RO SETUP BEAM TREAT EXT RT-120', 'RO SETUP BEAM TREAT EXT RT-30', 'RO SETUP BEAM TREAT EXT RT-60', 'RO SETUP BEAM TREAT EXT RT-90', 'RO SETUP FILMS EXT RT-120', 'RO SETUP FILMS EXT RT-30', 'RO SETUP FILMS EXT RT-60', 'RO SETUP FILMS EXT RT-90', 'RO SRS BRAIN(1FX) SETUP&TX-120', 'RO SRS BRAIN(1FX) SETUP&TX-150', 'RO SRS BRAIN(1FX) SETUP&TX-60', 'RO SRS BRAIN(1FX) SETUP&TX-90', 'RO SBRT (<=5 FX) SETUP&TX-40', 'RO SETUP BEAM TREAT EXT RT-20', 'RO SETUP BEAM TREAT EXT RT-40', 'RO SETUP FILMS EXT RT-40') AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT DATE + 1 DAY AND CURRENT date + 7 DAYS AND CLD_DEPT_NAME IN ('RO 1275 CLINIC 4', 'RO 1275 TREATMENT 4', 'RO 1275 TREATMENT 3', 'RO 1275 TREATMENT 2');

prompt: Provide weekly or monthly volume (for 2020 and 2021) of Pulmonary Outpatient Referrals via CIS with either one of the two criteria indicated Reason for Consult as "Sleep Apnea" or Sleep Medicine Referral section as "yes". Both are not needed.
completion: SELECT OO_ORD_GUID ORDGUID, OO_ENTER_DTE ORD_ENTER_DATE, (YEAR(OO_ENTER_DTE)) ENTER_YR, (QUARTER(OO_ENTER_DTE)) ENTER_QTR, STRIP(CHAR(YEAR(OO_ENTER_DTE)))||'-0'||CHAR(QUARTER(OO_ENTER_DTE)) YR_QTR, MONTH(OO_ENTER_DTE) ENTER_MONTH, CASE MONTH(OO_ENTER_DTE) WHEN 1 THEN 'JAN' WHEN 2 THEN 'FEB' WHEN 3 THEN 'MAR' WHEN 4 THEN 'APR' WHEN 5 THEN 'MAY' WHEN 6 THEN 'JUN' WHEN 7 THEN 'JUL' WHEN 8 THEN 'AUG' WHEN 9 THEN 'SEP' WHEN 10 THEN 'OCT' WHEN 11 THEN 'NOV' WHEN 12 THEN 'DEC' END ENTER_MONTHNAME , OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE PERFORMED_DATE, OO_MRN MRN, STRIP(PT_LAST_NAME)||', '||PT_FIRST_NAME PT_NAME, OO_ORD_ID ORDID, OO_ORD_NAME ORDNAME, STRIP(OO_ORD_STS_CD)||'-'||OSTS_STS_DESC ORDSTATUS , MAX(CASE WHEN OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'Consult_Pulm Reason for' THEN SUBSTR(OUD_USER_DI_VALUE, 1, 100) END) "Reason For Consult", MAX(CASE WHEN OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'Consult_Pulm Cancer Dx' THEN SUBSTR(OUD_USER_DI_VALUE, 1, 50) END) "Primary diagnosis", MAX(CASE WHEN OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'Consult_Pulm OP Attending' THEN SUBSTR(OUD_USER_DI_VALUE, 1, 50) END) "Requested MD", MAX(CASE WHEN OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'Consult_Pulm OP Sleep Study' THEN SUBSTR(OUD_USER_DI_VALUE, 1, 5) END) "Sleep Medicine referral", MAX(CASE WHEN OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'Consult_Pulm OP Sleep Study Prior' THEN SUBSTR(OUD_USER_DI_VALUE, 1, 5) END) "Prior Sleep Study" FROM IDB.OMS_ORDER JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON OO_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_USER_DATA ON OUD_ORD_GUID = OO_ORD_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_STATUS ON OO_ORD_STS_CD = OSTS_ORD_STS_CD WHERE OO_ORD_NAME = 'Pulmonary Outpatient Referral' AND OO_ENTER_DTE >= '1/1/2019' GROUP BY OO_ORD_GUID, OO_ENTER_DTE, YEAR(OO_ENTER_DTE) , QUARTER(OO_ENTER_DTE) , MONTH(OO_ENTER_DTE) , OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE, OO_MRN, STRIP(PT_LAST_NAME)||', '||PT_FIRST_NAME , OO_ORD_ID, OO_ORD_NAME, OO_ORD_STS_CD, OSTS_STS_DESC HAVING LOWER(MAX(CASE WHEN OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'Consult_Pulm Reason for' THEN SUBSTR(OUD_USER_DI_VALUE, 1, 50) END)) like '%sleep%apnea%' OR MAX(CASE WHEN OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'Consult_Pulm OP Sleep Study' THEN SUBSTR(OUD_USER_DI_VALUE, 1, 5) END) = 'Yes' ORDER BY YEAR(OO_ENTER_DTE) , QUARTER(OO_ENTER_DTE) , MONTH(OO_ENTER_DTE) , STRIP(OO_ORD_STS_CD)||'-'||OSTS_STS_DESC, OO_ENTER_DTE, OO_MRN

prompt: Wish to know proportions of gender, ethnicity, and race for all MSKCC patients over last 2 year.
completion: SELECT PT_SEX, PTRACE.AV_DESC AS RACE, PTETH.AV_DESC AS ETHNICITY, COUNT(PLA_MRN) FROM IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY JOIN IDB.CDB_PATIENT ON PLA_MRN = CP_MRN JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PT_MRN = PLA_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS PTRACE ON PT_RACE = PTRACE.AV_CODE AND PTRACE.AV_ELEMENT = 'RACE' LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS PTETH ON PT_RACE = PTETH.AV_CODE AND PTETH.AV_ELEMENT = 'ETHNICITY' WHERE PLA_LST_ACTV_DTE > '2010-09-01' GROUP BY PT_SEX, PTETH.AV_DESC, PTRACE.AV_DESC

prompt: Estimate the percentage of admissions on the medicine services that received at least 1 administration of albumin
completion: SELECT VIS_MRN, VIS_ADM_NUM, VIS_ADM_DTE, VIS_DSCH_DTE, VIS_HOSP_SVC, HOSP_SVC_DESC, CASE WHEN COUNT(START_DATE) > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS ALBUMIN_DURING_ADMIT, CASE WHEN COUNT(START_DATE) > 0 THEN COUNT(START_DATE) ELSE 0 END AS ALBUMIN_ADMINS_DURING_ADMIT, LISTAGG(CAST(START_DATE AS VARCHAR(10)), '|') AS ALBUMIN_DATES FROM IDB.VISIT_V LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM IDB.SRX_PHARMACY_SUM P JOIN IDB.SRX_GENERIC_ITEM G ON P.GI_ID = G.SGI_GI_ID WHERE (LOWER(SGI_GI_NAME) like '%albumin human%') AND IP_OP_IND = 'I' AND START_DATE BETWEEN '2019-01-01' AND '2021-05-31' ) ON VIS_MRN = MRN AND START_DATE BETWEEN VIS_ADM_DTE AND VIS_DSCH_DTE WHERE VIS_IP_OP_ADJUSTED_IND = 'I' AND VIS_VISIT_STATUS IN ('2', '3') AND VIS_ADM_DTE BETWEEN '2019-01-01' AND '2021-05-31' AND VIS_HOSP_SVC IN ('BMS', 'GIA', 'GIB', 'GIC', 'GID', 'GEN', 'GUO', 'GMO', 'HMA', 'HMB', 'LUN', 'STP', 'STR') GROUP BY VIS_MRN, VIS_ADM_NUM, VIS_ADM_DTE, VIS_DSCH_DTE, VIS_HOSP_SVC, HOSP_SVC_DESC ;

prompt: Provide a list of patients with Multiple Myeloma who were seen at MSKCC between January 1, 2020 and December 31, 2020.
completion: WITH DX1 AS (SELECT TM_MRN AS MRN, TM_DX_DTE AS DX_DATE, TM_HIST_CD AS DX_CODE, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS DX_DESC FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM H ON TM_HIST_CD = H.CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON TM_SITE_CD = S.CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND TM_HIST_CD = 'M9732/3' UNION SELECT CC_MRN AS MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS DX_DATE, CLM_CLSF_CD AS DX_CODE, CLM_CLSF_DESC AS DX_DESC FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND ((CC_PT_TYPE = 'I') OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) AND CC_CLSF_CD IN ('203', '203.0', '203.00', '203.01', '203.02', 'C90.0', 'C90.00', 'C90.01', 'C90.02') GROUP BY CC_MRN, CLM_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC, '', '' ) , DX2 AS (SELECT MRN, LISTAGG(COALESCE(STRIP(CAST(DX_DATE AS VARCHAR(12000))), '')|| ' | ' || COALESCE(STRIP(DX_CODE), '') || ' | ' || COALESCE(STRIP(CAST(DX_DESC AS VARCHAR(12000))), '') , CHR(13) || CHR(10)) WITHIN GROUP( ORDER BY MRN, DX_DATE, DX_CODE, DX_DESC) AS DX FROM DX1 GROUP BY MRN) , CPE AS (SELECT * FROM (SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN, DX, CPE_ENC_DTE, CRE_RES_NAME, CRE_RES_TYP, CLD_DEPT_NAME, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8, CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CPE_MRN ORDER BY CPE_ENC_DTE) AS RN FROM DX2 JOIN IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER ON MRN = CPE_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CRE_RES_TYP IN ('Physician') AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN '2020-01-01' AND '2020-12-31' AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 = 'MYL') M WHERE RN = 1 ) , X AS (SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN AS MRN, STRIP(PT_LAST_NAME) || ', ' || STRIP(PT_FIRST_NAME) AS NAME, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH AS DOB, PT_SEX AS GENDER, R.AV_DESC AS "Race", E.AV_DESC AS "Ethnicity", PT_DATE_OF_DEATH AS DOD, DX, CPE_ENC_DTE, CRE_RES_NAME, CRE_RES_TYP, CLD_DEPT_NAME, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8, CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME FROM CPE JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON CPE_MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS R ON PT_RACE = R.AV_CODE AND R.AV_ELEMENT = 'RACE' LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS E ON PT_PT_ETHNICITY = E.AV_CODE AND E.AV_ELEMENT = 'PT_ETHNICITY') , APR AS (SELECT APR_MRN, CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME, MIN(APR_START_DTE) AS START_DATE, MAX(APR_END_DTE) AS END_DATE FROM X JOIN IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX_V ON MRN = APR_MRN WHERE 1=1 AND(UPPER(APR_GENERIC_NAME) LIKE '%BELANTAMAB%' OR UPPER(APR_DRUG_NAME) LIKE '%BELANTAMAB%') GROUP BY APR_MRN, CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME ) , Y AS (SELECT X.*, CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME, START_DATE, END_DATE FROM X LEFT JOIN APR ON APR_MRN = MRN) , L1 AS (SELECT DISTINCT LR_MRN AS MRN, LR_PERFORMED_DTE AS PERFORMED_DTE, LR_PERFORMED_DT AS PERFORMED_DT, CASE WHEN LR_SUBTEST_NAME LIKE '%Albumin%' THEN 'Albumin' WHEN LR_SUBTEST_NAME LIKE '%Beta%2%Microglobulin%' THEN 'B2M' WHEN LR_SUBTEST_NAME LIKE '%LD%' THEN 'LDH' END AS LAB_CATEGORY, LR_TEST_NAME AS TEST_NAME, LR_SUBTEST_NAME AS SUBTEST_NAME, LR_RESULT_VALUE AS RESULT_VALUE, LR_UNIT_MEASURE AS UNIT_MEASURE, LTL_TEXT_RESULT AS TEXT_RESULT FROM Y JOIN IDB.LAB_RESULTS ON MRN = LR_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.LAB_TEXT_LINE ON LTL_RESULT_GUID = LR_RESULT_GUID WHERE LR_SUBTEST_NAME IN ('Albumin', 'Albumin, Plasma', 'Beta 2 Microglobulin', 'Beta-2 Microglobulin', 'Beta-2 Microglobulin, CSF', 'Lactate Dehydrogenase (LD)', 'Lactate Dehydrogenase (LD), S', 'LDH', 'LDH, Plasma', 'Total LDH', 'Total LDH, Fluid') AND LR_RESULT_VALUE <> '' ) , L2 AS (SELECT L1.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY MRN, LAB_CATEGORY ORDER BY PERFORMED_DT) AS RN FROM L1) , L3 AS (SELECT * FROM L2 WHERE RN = 1 ) , L4 AS (SELECT MRN, MAX(CASE WHEN LAB_CATEGORY = 'Albumin' THEN RESULT_VALUE END) AS "Albumin 1st MSK Value", MAX(CASE WHEN LAB_CATEGORY = 'Albumin' THEN PERFORMED_DTE END) AS "Albumin 1st MSK Date", MAX(CASE WHEN LAB_CATEGORY = 'B2M' THEN RESULT_VALUE END) AS "B2M 1st MSK Value", MAX(CASE WHEN LAB_CATEGORY = 'B2M' THEN PERFORMED_DTE END) AS "B2M 1st MSK Date", MAX(CASE WHEN LAB_CATEGORY = 'LDH' THEN RESULT_VALUE END) AS "LDH 1st MSK Value", MAX(CASE WHEN LAB_CATEGORY = 'LDH' THEN PERFORMED_DTE END) AS "LDH 1st MSK Date" FROM L2 GROUP BY MRN) SELECT DISTINCT Y.*, "Albumin 1st MSK Value", "Albumin 1st MSK Date", "B2M 1st MSK Value", "B2M 1st MSK Date", "LDH 1st MSK Value", "LDH 1st MSK Date" FROM Y LEFT JOIN L4 ON Y.MRN = L4.MRN SELECT DISTINCT "t1"."PT_MRN" AS "MRN", "t2"."PRPT_ACCESSION_NO" AS "Pathology Report", "t3"."DT_DTE" AS "Pathology Procedure Date", "t4"."DT_DTE" AS "Pathology Report Date", "t5"."PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_DESC" AS "Pathology Report Type", UPPER(CASE WHEN LENGTH(PRPT_REPORT) <= 15000 THEN RTRIM(CAST(SUBSTR(PRPT_REPORT, 1, 15000) AS VARCHAR(15000))) ELSE CAST(SUBSTR(PRPT_REPORT, 1, 15000) AS VARCHAR(15000)) END) AS TXT FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V" "t1" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED" "t6" ON "t1"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t6"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V" "t2" ON "t6"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t2"."PRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" "t3" ON "t2"."PRPT_PROCEDURE_DATE_ID" = "t3"."DT_DATE_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" "t4" ON "t2"."PRPT_REPORT_DATE_ID" = "t4"."DT_DATE_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATH_RPRT_TYPE_LOOKUP" "t5" ON "t2"."PRPT_REPORT_TYPE" = "t5"."PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_CD" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_IDENTIFICATION_MRN_V" "t7" ON "t1"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t7"."PI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" WHERE (("t7"."PI_SOURCE_SYSTEM_PT_ID" IN () AND CONTAINS("t2"."PRPT_REPORT", '("bone marrow biopsy" OR "bm biopsy")') = 1) AND "t2"."PRPT_REPORT" IS NOT NULL) AND(UPPER("t5"."PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_DESC") LIKE '%HEMATOPATHOLOGY%' OR UPPER("t5"."PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_DESC") LIKE '%SURGICAL%PATH%')

prompt:
There was a previous request to simply get the count of MRNs for the listed criteria. The count was 215. We now need the data elements (below) for these 215 unique MRNs. All diagnosis codes remain the same as before. 



Demographics: 

MRN 

Last name 

DOB 

Sex

Race 

Ethnicity 

Current survival status (alive/dead) 

Last known appt/contact
completion: SELECT DISTINCT TM_MRN , PT_LAST_NAME , PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH , TRIM(A.AV_DESC) AS SEX , TRIM(B.AV_DESC) AS RACE , TRIM(C.AV_DESC) AS ETHNICITY , CASE WHEN PT_DEATH_IND IN ('', 'A') THEN 'ALIVE' ELSE 'DECEASED' END AS VITAL_STATUS , COALESCE(MAX(PLA_LST_APPT_DTE, PLA_LST_DSCH_DTE), PLA_LST_APPT_DTE, PLA_LST_DSCH_DTE) AS "LAST CONTACT" FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON TM_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY ON PT_MRN = PLA_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS A ON A.AV_ELEMENT = 'SEX' AND A.AV_CODE = PT_SEX LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS B ON B.AV_ELEMENT = 'RACE' AND B.AV_CODE = PT_RACE LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS C ON C.AV_ELEMENT = 'ETHNICITY' AND C.AV_CODE = PT_PT_ETHNICITY WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND TM_HIST_CD = 'M8480/3' AND TM_SITE_CD LIKE ('C25%') AND TM_DX_DTE >= '2005-01-01'

prompt: Provided a list of H- and S- cases (specimen class "HR" and "R" respectively) with "myelodysplastic syndrome" OR "MDS" in Diagnosis section from July 1st 2018 to present.
completion: WITH PATHREPORT AS (SELECT DISTINCT PRPT_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_BIRTH_DTE, PT_VITAL_STATUS, PT_DEATH_DTE , PRPT_ACCESSION_NO AS "Accession No" , PRPT_REPORT_DTE AS "Pathology Report Date" , PRPT_PROCEDURE_DTE AS "Pathology Procedure Date" , PRPT_REPORT_TYPE_DESC AS "Pathology Report Type Description", PRPT_REPORT_TYPE , DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)diag[\w\W]*(?=I ATTEST)', PRPT_REPORT) AS DIAGNOSIS_TEXT , VARCHAR(PRPT_REPORT, 32000) AS "Report Text (first 32000 characters)" FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID WHERE SUBSTR(PRPT_ACCESSION_NO, 1, 1) IN ('H', 'S') AND (PRPT_REPORT_DTE BETWEEN '07/01/2018' AND CURRENT date - 1 DAY) AND PRPT_REPORT IS NOT NULL ) SELECT DISTINCT PRPT_MRN AS MRN, PT_LAST_NAME AS "Patient Last Name", PT_FIRST_NAME AS "Patient First Name", PT_BIRTH_DTE AS "Date of Birth", PT_DEATH_DTE AS "Date of Death", PT_VITAL_STATUS AS "Vital Satatus", "Accession No", "Pathology Report Date", "Pathology Procedure Date", PRPT_REPORT_TYPE AS "Pathology Report Type", "Pathology Report Type Description", DIAGNOSIS_TEXT AS "Diagnosis Text", "Report Text (first 32000 characters)" FROM PATHREPORT WHERE (LOWER(DIAGNOSIS_TEXT) like '%myelodysplastic syndrome%' OR LOWER(DIAGNOSIS_TEXT) like '%mds%') AND NOT ((INSTR (LOWER(DIAGNOSIS_TEXT), 'no definitive morphologic or immunophenotypic evidence of residual') <> 0) OR (INSTR (LOWER(DIAGNOSIS_TEXT), 'no diagnostic morphologic evidence of myelodysplastic syndrome') <> 0) OR (INSTR (LOWER(DIAGNOSIS_TEXT), 'complete remission') <> 0) OR (INSTR (LOWER(DIAGNOSIS_TEXT), 'no morphologic evidence of mds') <> 0) OR (INSTR (LOWER(DIAGNOSIS_TEXT), 'no morphologic or immunophenotypic evidence of myelodysplastic syndrome') <> 0) OR (INSTR (LOWER(DIAGNOSIS_TEXT), 'no morphologic or immunophenotypic evidence of involvement by') <> 0) OR (INSTR (LOWER(DIAGNOSIS_TEXT), 'no diagnostic morphologic or reported immunophenotypic evidence of') <> 0) OR (INSTR (LOWER(DIAGNOSIS_TEXT), 'no diagnostic morphologic or immunophenotypic involvement') <> 0) OR (INSTR (LOWER(DIAGNOSIS_TEXT), 'no diagnostic morphologic or immunophenotypic evidence of') <> 0))

prompt: Chemotherapy volume from Jan 2019 to Feb 2022
completion: SELECT APR_MRN, APR_START_DTE, APR_DRUG_NAME, APR_GENERIC_NAME, APR_LOCATION, APR_DOC_SVC, APR_ROUTE , YEAR(APR_START_DTE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) AS AGE, APR_VISIT_GUID, APR_ORDER_SOURCE, APR_ORDER_SOURCE_ID, APR_DRUG_PROCESS_STAGE, APR_SET_GUID FROM IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON APR_MRN = PT_MRN AND YEAR(APR_START_DTE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) >=18 WHERE 1=1 AND APR_LOCATION IN ('M4', 'M5', 'M7', 'M8', 'M10', 'M11', 'M12', 'M14', 'M15', 'M16', 'M17', 'M18', 'M19') AND APR_START_DTE BETWEEN '2019-01-01' AND '2022-02-28' AND NOT UPPER(APR_DRUG_NAME) LIKE '%INVEST%' AND APR_ROUTE IN ('IM', 'injection', 'IV push', 'IVCI', 'IVPB', 'IVPB', 'Subcutaneous', 'HAI', 'intraperitoneal')

prompt: Provide a one time list of Hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC)  patients who have had IMPACT (12-245) testing.
completion: WITH HCC_PTS AS (SELECT CC_MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS ICD_EFF_DTE, CC_CLSF_CD AS ICD_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS ICD_DESC, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON CC_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE SUBSTR(CC_CLSF_CD, 1, 3) IN ('155', 'C22') AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' GROUP BY CC_MRN, CC_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME HAVING MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) >= '2013-01-01') , IMPACT AS (SELECT PDWS_NAME, PT_MRN, PDRX_ACCESSION_NO, DTRPT.DT_DTE AS REPORTDATE_PATHCLIN, DTPROCPATHRPT.DT_DTE AS PROCEDUREDATE_PATHCLIN, GENE_PANEL, SAMPLEID, PATIENTID, TUMOR_TYPE_CODE, TUMOR_TYPE_NAME, IS_METASTASIS, PRIMARY_SITE, METASTASIS_SITE FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML INNER JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT ON PDRX_PATH_RPT_ID = PRPT_PATH_RPT_ID LEFT JOIN DV.DATE DTRPT ON PRPT_REPORT_DATE_ID = DTRPT.DT_DATE_ID LEFT JOIN DV.DATE DTPROCPATHRPT ON PRPT_PROCEDURE_DATE_ID = DTPROCPATHRPT.DT_DATE_ID INNER JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML_SETTINGS ON PDRX_PATH_DMP_RESULTS_XML_ID = PDRXS_PATH_DMP_RESULTS_XML_ID INNER JOIN DVDMC.PATHOLOGY_DMP_WEBSVC_SETTINGS ON PDRXS_SETTING_ID = PDWS_SETTING_ID INNER JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON PDRX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID, XMLTABLE('$c/root/*' PASSING PDRX_XML_VALUE AS "c" COLUMNS TOTAL_NUMBER_VARIANTS int PATH 'count(../*[not(name()=''meta-data'')])', VARIANT_CLASS VARCHAR(100) PATH 'variant_class', SITE1_GENE VARCHAR(100) PATH 'site1_gene', SITE2_GENE VARCHAR(100) PATH 'site2_gene', GENE_ID VARCHAR(100) PATH 'gene_id', EXON_NUM VARCHAR(100) PATH 'exon_num', AA_CHANGE VARCHAR(100) PATH 'aa_change', CDNA_CHANGE VARCHAR(100) PATH 'cDNA_change', GENE_FOLD_CHANGE prompt:
Provide the following information from 6/1/10 through 3/31/11:

1.  Total number of  patients seen for at least one visit for outpatient physical therapy or occupational therapy, who live in the Brooklyn and Staten Island areas. 

2. Total number of patients seen for at least one visit for outpatient physical or occupation therapy, who live in the Brooklyn and Staten Island areas and are 65 years old or older.

3. Total number of patients seen for at least one visit for outpatient physical or occupational therapy, who live in the Brooklyn and Staten Island areas and have a primary diagnosis of breast cancer.
completion: SELECT COUNTY, AGE, DX, COUNT (DISTINCT MRN) FROM (SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN AS MRN, CASE WHEN YEAR(CURRENT date - CPP_DATE_OF_BIRTH) > 64 THEN '65+' ELSE 'Under 65' END AS AGE, CASE WHEN CPP_COUNTY IN ('KINGS', 'RICHMOND') THEN CPP_COUNTY ELSE 'OTHER' END AS COUNTY, CASE WHEN CC_CLSF_CD IS NOT NULL THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END DX FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 IN ('PT', 'REH') JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CRE_RES_ID = CPE_VST_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_PAS_PATIENT ON CPP_MRN = CPE_MRN LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT CC_MRN, CC_CLSF_CD FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF WHERE CC_EFF_DTE BETWEEN '2010-06-01' AND '2011-03-31' AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND (CC_CLSF_CD BETWEEN '174' AND '174.9' OR CC_CLSF_CD IN ('233.0', '175.9')) AND (CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) ) AS X ON X.CC_MRN = CPE_MRN WHERE CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN '2010-06-01' AND '2011-03-31' AND CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') ) AS Y GROUP BY COUNTY, AGE, DX

prompt: Notification email to referral oncologists regarding patient eligibility based on genomic alterations for study MED21-034
completion: WITH PTS AS (SELECT PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID PID FROM DV.PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED) , DT_1 AS (SELECT PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID AS P_ID FROM DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS REC LEFT JOIN DV.PATIENT_CORE_DEMOGRAPHICS ON PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = CORE_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID WHERE 1=1 ) , DT_2 AS (SELECT INC.PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID P_ID FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_STRUCTURED_RESULTS_V INC WHERE 1=1 AND (INC.GENE IN ('KRAS') OR INC.GENE2 IN ('KRAS')) AND INC.AA_CHANGE IN ('G12C') ) , DT_3 AS (SELECT PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID AS P_ID FROM DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS REC LEFT JOIN DV.PATIENT_CORE_DEMOGRAPHICS ON PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = CORE_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID WHERE 1=1 AND PT_VITAL_STATUS IN ('ALIVE') ) , DT_4 AS (SELECT PENC_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID AS P_ID FROM (SELECT PENC_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID , TRIM(ENDP_SERVICE_DEPT_GRP_6) DEPT_GRP_6 , TRIM(ENDP_SVC_CLINIC_SUB_DEPT_GRP_7) DIV_GRP_7 , TRIM(ENDP_SERVICE_SPECIALTY_GRP_8) RPT_GRP_8 , TRIM(ENDP_CENTER_FULL_NAME) CENTER_FULL_NAME , TRIM(ENDP_DEPT_NAME) DEPT_NAME , TRIM(T2.EDC_DEPT_DESC) APPT_STATUS_DESC , CASE WHEN ENVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR like '%NV%' THEN 'New Visit' WHEN ENVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR like '%IR%' THEN 'Internal Referral' ELSE 'Non-New Visit/Interal Referral' END AS IRNV_IND , PENC_ENC_DT, PENC_MODIFIED_DT FROM DV.PATIENT_ENCOUNTER T6 INNER JOIN DV.ENCOUNTER_SCHD_RESOURCES SR ON T6.PENC_PT_ENC_ID = SR.ENSR_PT_ENC_ID INNER JOIN DV.ENCOUNTER_RESOURCE ER ON SR.ENSR_RES_ID = ER.ENR_ENC_RES_ID INNER JOIN DV.ENCOUNTER_VISIT_TYPE EVT ON T6.PENC_VISIT_TYPE_ID = EVT.ENVT_ENC_VISIT_TYPE_ID INNER JOIN DV.ENCOUNTER_DESC_CATALOG T2 ON EDC_GROUP_ID = 'STS' AND T6.PENC_APPT_STS = T2.EDC_DEPT_ABBREV INNER JOIN DV.ENCOUNTER_DEPARTMENT T3 ON T6.PENC_DEPT_ID = T3.ENDP_ENC_DEPT_ID INNER JOIN DV.DATE_V REC ON T6.PENC_ENC_DATE_ID = REC.DT_DATE_ID WHERE 1=1 AND ((T2.EDC_DEPT_DESC IN ('Completed', 'Scheduled') AND DT_DTE <= CURRENT date + (7-(DAYOFWEEK_ISO(CURRENT date))) DAYS AND DT_DTE >= CURRENT date - (DAYOFWEEK_ISO(CURRENT date) - 1) DAYS) OR (T2.EDC_DEPT_DESC IN ('Completed') AND DT_DTE >= DATE('2021-12-15') ) ) ) T WHERE 1=1 ) , DEID AS (SELECT DISTINCT P_ID FROM (SELECT P_ID FROM DT_1 INTERSECT SELECT P_ID FROM DT_2 INTERSECT SELECT P_ID FROM DT_3 INTERSECT SELECT P_ID FROM DT_4 ))

Nurse') WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN('Sch') AND VD.CLD_DEPT_ID = 61 ), IRB AS (SELECT ACD_MRN, ACD_IRB_NO, ACD_CONS_DTE FROM ETO JOIN IDB.ACCRUALS_DATES ON CC_MRN = ACD_MRN WHERE ACD_IRB_NO IN ('06-107') AND ACD_OFF_STUDY_DTE IS NULL ) SELECT DOS, MRN, PT_NAME, FIRST_DX_DTE, DX_CDE, DX_DESC, AGE_AT_SRG , CASE_ID, SVC, PT_CLASS, SURGEON, PNL_NO, OR_PROC_NAME, CPT, CPT_DESC , APPT_DT , APPT_TIME, DEPT_NAME, VST_RESOURCE, VST_NAME, VST_TYPE, LTRIM(RTRIM(ACD_IRB_NO)) IRB FROM ETO T1 JOIN SRG T2 ON CC_MRN = T2.MRN LEFT JOIN VST T4 ON T2.MRN = T4.VST_MRN AND RN = 1 LEFT JOIN IRB T3 ON T2.MRN = T3.ACD_MRN

prompt: To update the our current report to match the updated questions from the AHS to the new care Questionnaire.
completion: WITH NOTES AS (SELECT DISTINCT CDD_DOC_GUID, CDD_MRN, CDD_AUTHORED_DTE, CDD_VISIT_GUID, CDD_AUTH_PROV_GUID FROM IDB.CD_DOCUMENT JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION ON CDD_DOC_GUID = CDO_DOC_GUID AND CDD_AUTHORED_DTE = CDO_AUTHORED_DTE JOIN IDB.OMS_CLIENT_VISIT ON CDD_VISIT_GUID = OCV_VISIT_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_SERVICE ON OCV_SVC_GUID = OS_SVC_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_PROVIDER ON CDD_AUTH_PROV_GUID = OP_PVDR_GUID JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PT_MRN = CDD_MRN WHERE CDD_DOC_NAME IN ('Nursing Health Assessment - Outpatient') AND CDD_CANCEL_IND <> '1' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND <> '1' AND CDD_AUTHORED_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT date - 30 DAYS AND CURRENT date - 2 DAYS AND CDO_MSTR_ITEM_NM = 'Smoking Status RES' AND CDO_VALUE_TEXT IN ('Current every day smoker', 'Current some day smoker') ), RN_ORDER AS (SELECT DISTINCT CDD_DOC_GUID AS RN_ORDER_DOC_GUID FROM NOTES JOIN IDB.OMS_ORDER ON OO_MRN = CDD_MRN JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_CATALOG ON OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID = OOC_MSTR_ITEM_GUID WHERE OOC_ITEM_NAME = 'Nursing Ambulatory Ref Smoking Cessation' AND OO_ENTER_DTE BETWEEN CDD_AUTHORED_DTE AND CDD_AUTHORED_DTE + 1 DAY ), OTHER_ORDERS AS (SELECT CDD_DOC_GUID AS OTHER_ORDERS_DOC_GUID, MAX(CASE WHEN OO_ORD_NAME = 'Nursing Ambulatory Ref Smoking Cessation' THEN 'Y' END) AS "RN Order Placed within 30 Days Prior", MAX(CASE WHEN OO_ORD_NAME = 'Smoking Cessation MD/NP/PA Consult' THEN 'Y' END) AS "RN Placed MD/NP/PA Order" FROM NOTES JOIN IDB.OMS_ORDER ON OO_MRN = CDD_MRN JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_CATALOG ON OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID = OOC_MSTR_ITEM_GUID WHERE ((OOC_ITEM_NAME = 'Nursing Ambulatory Ref Smoking Cessation' AND OO_ENTER_DTE BETWEEN CDD_AUTHORED_DTE - 30 DAYS AND CDD_AUTHORED_DTE - 1 DAY) OR (OOC_ITEM_NAME = 'Smoking Cessation MD/NP/PA Consult' AND OO_ENTER_DTE BETWEEN CDD_AUTHORED_DTE AND CDD_AUTHORED_DTE + 1 DAY AND OO_USER_GUID = CDD_AUTH_PROV_GUID)) AND CDD_DOC_GUID NOT IN (SELECT RN_ORDER_DOC_GUID FROM RN_ORDER) GROUP BY CDD_DOC_GUID) SELECT TRIM(OP_DISPLAY_NAME) AS "Provider", TRIM(OS_SVC_DESC) AS "Service", CDD_AUTHORED_DTE AS "Authored Date", CDD_MRN AS "MRN", TRIM(PT_LAST_NAME) AS "Last Name", TRIM(PT_FIRST_NAME) AS "First Name", "RN Placed MD/NP/PA Order", "RN Order Placed within 30 Days Prior" FROM NOTES LEFT JOIN OTHER_ORDERS ON CDD_DOC_GUID = OTHER_ORDERS_DOC_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_CLIENT_VISIT ON CDD_VISIT_GUID = OCV_VISIT_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_SERVICE ON OCV_SVC_GUID = OS_SVC_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_PROVIDER ON CDD_AUTH_PROV_GUID = OP_PVDR_GUID JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PT_MRN = CDD_MRN WHERE CDD_DOC_GUID NOT IN (SELECT RN_ORDER_DOC_GUID FROM RN_ORDER)

prompt: Pathology reports from 1/1/2018 to present containing key terms related to Classical Hodgkin Lymphoma
completion: SELECT PT_MRN AS "MRN", PT_LAST_NAME AS "Last Name", PT_FIRST_NAME AS "First Name", PT_BIRTH_DTE AS "DOB", PRPT_ACCESSION_NO AS "Path Accession Number", PRPT_REPORT AS "Path Report" FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT JOIN DV.DATE R ON R.DT_DATE_ID = PRPT_REPORT_DATE_ID JOIN DV.PATH_RPRT_TYPE_LOOKUP ON PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_CD = PRPT_REPORT_TYPE JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON PRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID WHERE CONTAINS("PRPT_REPORT", '(("Classic Hodgkin lymphoma" | "classical hodgkin lymphoma") & ("lymphocyte-rich" | "lymphocyte rich"))') = 1 AND R.DT_DTE >= '2018-01-01' AND PRPT_REPORT IS NOT NULL AND (PRPT_ACCESSION_NO like 'H%') ; SELECT PT_MRN AS "MRN", PT_LAST_NAME AS "Last Name", PT_FIRST_NAME AS "First Name", PT_BIRTH_DTE AS "DOB", PRPT_ACCESSION_NO AS "Path Accession Number", PRPT_REPORT AS "Path Report" FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT JOIN DV.DATE R ON R.DT_DATE_ID = PRPT_REPORT_DATE_ID JOIN DV.PATH_RPRT_TYPE_LOOKUP ON PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_CD = PRPT_REPORT_TYPE JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON PRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID WHERE CONTAINS("PRPT_REPORT", '(("Classic Hodgkin lymphoma" | "classical hodgkin lymphoma") & ("Lymphocyte depleted" | "lymphocyte-depleted"))') = 1 AND R.DT_DTE >= '2018-01-01' AND PRPT_REPORT IS NOT NULL AND (PRPT_ACCESSION_NO like 'H%') ; SELECT PT_MRN AS "MRN", PT_LAST_NAME AS "Last Name", PT_FIRST_NAME AS "First Name", PT_BIRTH_DTE AS "DOB", PRPT_ACCESSION_NO AS "Path Accession Number", PRPT_REPORT AS "Path Report" FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT JOIN DV.DATE R ON R.DT_DATE_ID = PRPT_REPORT_DATE_ID JOIN DV.PATH_RPRT_TYPE_LOOKUP ON PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_CD = PRPT_REPORT_TYPE JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON PRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID WHERE CONTAINS("PRPT_REPORT", '("features intermediate between dlbcl and classic hodgkin lymphoma" | "features intermediate between dlbcl and classical hodgkin lymphoma" | "features intermediate between dlbcl and chl" | "grey zone lymphoma" | "grey-zone lymphoma")') = 1 AND CONTAINS("PRPT_REPORT", '("cell lymphoma, unclassifiable" | "cell lymphoma unclassifiable")') = 1 AND R.DT_DTE >= '2018-01-01' AND PRPT_REPORT IS NOT NULL AND (PRPT_ACCESSION_NO like 'H%') ;

prompt: C. auris surveillance audits to run on Tuesdays and Thursdays
completion: SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, OO_ENTER_DTE, OO_ENTER_DT, OO_SIGNIFICANT_DT, OO_ARRIVAL_DT, OO_ORD_NAME, OO_SET_NAME, OCV_CURR_LOC, OO_PERFORMED_DT, OCV_DSCH_DISP, LR_ACCESSION_NO, LR_TEST_NAME, LR_SUBTEST_NAME, LTL_TEXT_RESULT, OS_SVC_DESC FROM IDB.OMS_ORDER LEFT JOIN IDB.LAB_RESULTS ON LR_ORD_GUID = OO_ORD_GUID LEFT JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON OO_MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.LAB_TEXT_LINE ON LR_RESULT_GUID = LTL_RESULT_GUID LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_CLIENT_VISIT ON OCV_VISIT_GUID = OO_VISIT_GUID LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_SERVICE ON OCV_SVC_GUID = OS_SVC_GUID WHERE DATE(OO_ENTER_DTE) BETWEEN CURRENT DATE - 5 DAY AND CURRENT DATE AND OO_ORD_NAME = 'C. auris Surveillance DNA Qualitative' SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, OO_ENTER_DTE, OO_ENTER_DT, OO_SIGNIFICANT_DT, OO_ARRIVAL_DT, OO_ORD_NAME, OO_SET_NAME, OCV_CURR_LOC, OO_PERFORMED_DT, OCV_DSCH_DISP, LR_ACCESSION_NO, LR_TEST_NAME, LR_SUBTEST_NAME, LTL_TEXT_RESULT, OS_SVC_DESC FROM IDB.OMS_ORDER LEFT JOIN IDB.LAB_RESULTS ON LR_ORD_GUID = OO_ORD_GUID LEFT JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON OO_MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.LAB_TEXT_LINE ON LR_RESULT_GUID = LTL_RESULT_GUID LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_CLIENT_VISIT ON OCV_VISIT_GUID = OO_VISIT_GUID LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_SERVICE ON OCV_SVC_GUID = OS_SVC_GUID WHERE DATE(OO_ENTER_DTE) BETWEEN CURRENT DATE - 3 DAY AND CURRENT DATE AND OO_ORD_NAME = 'C. auris Surveillance DNA Qualitative'
