prompt: Create a revised list of MRIs performed on the provided list of patients and specified exam dates
completion: WITH DX_ALL AS (SELECT DISTINCT TM_MRN AS DX_MRN, TM_DX_DTE AS DX_DATE, TM_HIST_CD AS DX_CODE, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS DX_DESC FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM H ON TM_HIST_CD = H.CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON TM_SITE_CD = S.CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND TM_HIST_CD IN ('M9510/3', 'M9510/6', 'M9511/3', 'M9511/6', 'M9512/3', 'M9513/3', 'M9514/1') AND TM_DX_DTE BETWEEN '2013-01-01' AND '2023-02-09' UNION SELECT DISTINCT CC_MRN AS DX_MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS DX_DATE, CLM_CLSF_CD AS DX_CODE, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS DX_DESC FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND ((CC_PT_TYPE = 'I') OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) AND CC_CLSF_CD IN ('190.5', 'C69.20' ,'C69.21' ,'C69.22') GROUP BY CC_MRN, CLM_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK HAVING MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) BETWEEN '2013-01-01' AND '2023-02-09'), DX AS (SELECT DISTINCT DX_MRN, LISTAGG(COALESCE(STRIP(DX_CODE), '') || ' - ' || COALESCE(STRIP(CAST(DX_DESC AS VARCHAR(12000))), '') , CHR(13) || CHR(10)) WITHIN GROUP( ORDER BY DX_MRN, DX_CODE, DX_DESC) AS CANCER_DX FROM DX_ALL GROUP BY DX_MRN) , ANS AS (SELECT OL_MRN , OL_SURG_DTE , ARS_AN_START_DT , ARS_AN_STOP_DT , ARS_AN_PROC_NAME , MAX(CASE WHEN PROP.ODAFA_MEDICATION_NAME IS NOT NULL THEN 'YES' END) AS HAS_PROPOFOL , MAX(CASE WHEN MIDAZ.ODAFA_MEDICATION_NAME IS NOT NULL THEN 'YES' END) AS HAS_MIDAZ , MAX(CASE WHEN DEXMED.ODAFA_MEDICATION_NAME IS NOT NULL THEN 'YES' END) AS HAS_DEXMED , MAX(CASE WHEN FENT.ODAFA_MEDICATION_NAME IS NOT NULL THEN 'YES' END) AS HAS_FENTANYL , CASE WHEN MAX(AIFM_MEAS_VALUE) != '0' THEN 'YES' END AS HAS_SEVOFLURANE FROM DX JOIN IDB.OR_LOG ON DX_MRN = OL_MRN JOIN IDB.AN_RECORD_SUMMARY ON OL_LOG_ID = ARS_AN_CASELOG_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.AN_IP_DATA_STORE ON ARS_AN_CL_PT_ID = AIDS_CL_PT_ID AND ARS_AN_52_ENC_CSN_ID = AIDS_ENC_CSN_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.AN_IP_FLOWSHEET_REC ON AIFRC_INPATIENT_DATA_ID = AIDS_INPATIENT_DATA_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.AN_IP_FLOWSHEET_MEAS ON AIFRC_FSD_ID = AIFM_FSD_ID AND AIFM_FLO_MEAS_ID='1120100015' LEFT JOIN IDB.OR_DRUG_AND_FLUIDS_ADMINS PROP ON PROP.ODAFA_LOG_ID = OL_LOG_ID AND PROP.ODAFA_MEDICATION_NAME like 'Propofol 10mg/mL' LEFT JOIN IDB.OR_DRUG_AND_FLUIDS_ADMINS MIDAZ ON MIDAZ.ODAFA_LOG_ID = OL_LOG_ID AND MIDAZ.ODAFA_MEDICATION_NAME like 'Midazolam %' LEFT JOIN IDB.OR_DRUG_AND_FLUIDS_ADMINS DEXMED ON DEXMED.ODAFA_LOG_ID = OL_LOG_ID AND DEXMED.ODAFA_MEDICATION_NAME = 'Dexmedetomidine 4mcg/mL' LEFT JOIN IDB.OR_DRUG_AND_FLUIDS_ADMINS FENT ON FENT.ODAFA_LOG_ID = OL_LOG_ID AND FENT.ODAFA_MEDICATION_NAME = 'fentaNYL 50mcg/mL' WHERE (ARS_AN_PROC_NAME like '%OPH PROCEDURE W/ANESTHESIA%' OR ARS_AN_PROC_NAME like '%OPH NV%') AND ARS_AN_START_DT IS NOT NULL AND ARS_AN_STOP_DT IS NOT NULL GROUP BY OL_MRN , OL_SURG_DTE , ARS_AN_START_DT , ARS_AN_STOP_DT , ARS_AN_PROC_NAME) , COHORT AS (SELECT DISTINCT DX_MRN , TRIM(PT_LAST_NAME) "LAST NAME" , TRIM(PT_FIRST_NAME) "FIRST NAME" , TRIM(G.AV_DESC) "GENDER" , PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH "DATE OF BIRTH" , CANCER_DX "DIAGNOSIS" , OL_SURG_DTE AS EXAM_DATE , ARS_AN_PROC_NAME "EXAM TYPE" , HAS_PROPOFOL , HAS_MIDAZ , HAS_DEXMED , HAS_FENTANYL , HAS_SEVOFLURANE , TIME(ARS_AN_START_DT) AS ANES_START_TIME , TIME(ARS_AN_STOP_DT) AS ANES_STOP_TIME FROM DX JOIN ANS ON DX_MRN = OL_MRN JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON DX_MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS G ON G.AV_CODE = PT_SEX AND G.AV_ELEMENT = 'SEX') , MED AS (SELECT DISTINCT OO_MRN , OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE, OO_ORD_NAME, OO_ORD_MODIFIER, OOTO_TASK_DOSE, OOTO_TASK_UOM FROM COHORT JOIN IDB.OMS_ORDER ON OO_MRN = DX_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_MED_DETAIL ON OO_ORD_GUID = OMD_ORD_GUID JOIN IDB.OAS_ORD_TASK_OCCR ON OOTO_ORD_GUID = OO_ORD_GUID AND OOTO_STATUS_CD = 'Performed' JOIN IDB.OAS_CTLG_ITEM_TASK ON OOTO_CAT_ITEM_GUID = OCIT_GUID AND OCIT_LEVEL_NO = 0 AND (UPPER(OO_ORD_NAME) LIKE ('%CYCLOPENTOLATE%') OR UPPER(OO_ORD_NAME) LIKE ('%TROPICAMIDE%') OR UPPER(OO_ORD_NAME) LIKE ('%PROPARACAINE%') OR UPPER(OO_ORD_NAME) LIKE ('%PHENYLEPHRINE%') OR UPPER(OO_ORD_NAME) LIKE ('%KETOROLAC%') OR UPPER(OO_ORD_NAME) LIKE ('%OPHTHALMIC%') OR UPPER(OO_ORD_NAME) LIKE ('%MYDRIACYL%') OR UPPER(OO_ORD_NAME) LIKE ('%TETRACAINE%') OR UPPER(OO_ORD_NAME) LIKE ('%CYCLOGYL%') OR UPPER(OO_ORD_NAME) LIKE ('%CYCLOPENTOLATE%'))), MED_ALL AS (SELECT DISTINCT OO_MRN, OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE , LISTAGG(COALESCE(STRIP(CAST(OO_ORD_NAME AS VARCHAR(12000))), '') || ' - ' || COALESCE(STRIP(CAST(OO_ORD_MODIFIER AS VARCHAR(12000))), '')|| ' - ' || COALESCE(STRIP(CAST(OOTO_TASK_DOSE AS VARCHAR(12000))), '')|| ' - ' || COALESCE(STRIP(CAST(OOTO_TASK_UOM AS VARCHAR(12000))), '') , CHR(13) || CHR(10)) WITHIN GROUP( ORDER BY OO_MRN, OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE) AS MEDICATION FROM MED GROUP BY OO_MRN, OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE), LAT AS (SELECT DISTINCT CDD_MRN, CDD_SERVICE_DTE AS "Service Date", CDD_DOC_NAME AS "Document Name", CDO_ITEM_NAME AS "Item", CDO_VALUE_TEXT AS "Value" FROM COHORT JOIN IDB.CD_DOCUMENT ON DX_MRN = CDD_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION ON CDD_DOC_GUID = CDO_DOC_GUID AND CDD_AUTHORED_DTE = CDO_AUTHORED_DTE AND CDO_VALUE_TEXT <> '' JOIN IDB.OMS_PROVIDER ON CDD_AUTH_PROV_GUID = OP_PVDR_GUID WHERE CDD_CANCEL_IND <> '1' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND <> '1' AND CDD_DOC_NAME = 'Assessment, Pediatric - Ophthalmic Oncology' AND CDO_SECTION = 'Ophthalmic Exam' AND CDO_ITEM_NAME = 'Laterality' AND (CDD_SERVICE_DTE) = EXAM_DATE ), VISIT AS (SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN, CPE_ENC_DTE AS "Appt Date", CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 AS "Service", CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME AS "Visit Type", CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR FROM COHORT JOIN IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER ON DX_MRN = CPE_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 = 'OPH' ), FLAG_1 AS (SELECT DISTINCT SSE_MRN, SSE_SURG_DTE FROM COHORT JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT ON DX_MRN = SSE_MRN JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE ON SSE_LOG_ID = SSP_LOG_ID AND SSE_ENC_CSN_ID = SSP_ENC_CSN_ID WHERE (SSE_SURG_LOC not like '%IR%' AND SSE_SURG_LOC not like '%ENDO%' AND SSE_SOURCE_TYPE <> 'E') AND SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD IN ('67210', '67208', '67028') AND SSE_SURG_DTE < EXAM_DATE ), FLAG_2 AS (SELECT DISTINCT SSE_MRN, SSE_SURG_DTE FROM COHORT JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT ON DX_MRN = SSE_MRN JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE ON SSE_LOG_ID = SSP_LOG_ID AND SSE_ENC_CSN_ID = SSP_ENC_CSN_ID WHERE (SSE_SURG_LOC not like '%IR%' AND SSE_SURG_LOC not like '%ENDO%' AND SSE_SOURCE_TYPE <> 'E') AND SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD IN ('67210', '67208', '67028') AND SSE_SURG_DTE = EXAM_DATE ), FLAG_2A AS (SELECT DISTINCT APR_MRN FROM COHORT JOIN IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX_V ON DX_MRN = APR_MRN AND APR_START_DTE = EXAM_DATE) , FLAG_3 AS (SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN AS F3_MRN FROM COHORT JOIN IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER ON DX_MRN = CPE_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID IN ('4517', '13174') AND CPE_ENC_DTE = EXAM_DATE ) SELECT DISTINCT CH.* , "Value" AS "LATERALITY" , MEDICATION AS "DILATION DROP/FORMULA ADMINISTERED " , CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR AS "VISIT TYPE" , CASE WHEN F1.SSE_MRN IS NULL THEN 'NO' ELSE 'YES' END AS "PREVIOUS FOCAL LASER TREATMENT" , CASE WHEN F2.SSE_MRN IS NULL AND F2A.APR_MRN IS NULL THEN 'NO' ELSE 'YES' END AS "TREATMENT ON THE DAY OF EXAM" , CASE WHEN (F3.F3_MRN IS NOT NULL OR UPPER(CH."EXAM TYPE") LIKE ('%MRI PEDIATRIC SCAN WITH ANESTHESIA%')) THEN 'YES' ELSE 'NO' END AS "MRI ON EXAM DATE (Y/N)" FROM COHORT CH LEFT JOIN MED_ALL ON CH.DX_MRN = OO_MRN AND OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE = CH.EXAM_DATE LEFT JOIN LAT ON CH.DX_MRN = CDD_MRN LEFT JOIN VISIT ON CH.DX_MRN = CPE_MRN AND "Appt Date" = EXAM_DATE LEFT JOIN FLAG_1 F1 ON CH.DX_MRN = F1.SSE_MRN LEFT JOIN FLAG_2 F2 ON CH.DX_MRN = F2.SSE_MRN LEFT JOIN FLAG_2A F2A ON CH.DX_MRN = F2A.APR_MRN LEFT JOIN FLAG_3 F3 ON CH.DX_MRN = F3.F3_MRN ;

prompt: Provide a list of patients who underwent surgery on the pancreas, ampulla, distal bile duct, and duodenum from 1/2020 to present who also had a documented case of COVID19 at any point.
completion: WITH SURG AS (SELECT DISTINCT SSE_MRN, SSE_SURG_DTE, SSP_PROC_NAME FROM IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE ON SSE_LOG_ID = SSP_LOG_ID AND SSE_ENC_CSN_ID = SSP_ENC_CSN_ID WHERE (SSE_SURG_LOC not like '%IR%' AND SSE_SURG_LOC not like '%ENDO%' AND SSE_SOURCE_TYPE <> 'E') AND SSE_SURG_DTE BETWEEN '2020-01-01' AND '2022-02-28' AND SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD IN ('48150', '48153', '48140', '48120', '48155', '44120', '49000', '48148', '47711') ) , COVID AS (SELECT S.*, MRN, RESULT, MIN_RESULT_DT AS COVID_DATE FROM SURG S JOIN IDB.COVID19_PATIENT_INFO ON S.SSE_MRN = MRN WHERE RESULT IN ('Positive', 'Resolved') ) , DIAG AS (SELECT MRN DX_MRN, TM_DX_DTE, TM_HIST_CD, HIST_DESC, ICD9_CD, ICD9_DESC FROM COVID C LEFT JOIN (SELECT TM_MRN, TM_DX_DTE, TM_HIST_CD, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS HIST_DESC FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD AND TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') ) AS CDB ON TM_MRN = C.MRN LEFT JOIN (SELECT CC_MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS MIN_ICD9_EFF_DTE, CC_CLSF_CD AS ICD9_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS ICD9_DESC FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND (CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) GROUP BY CC_MRN, CC_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK ) AS ICD9 ON CC_MRN = C.MRN WHERE COALESCE(TM_MRN, CC_MRN) IS NOT NULL ) SELECT DISTINCT SSE_MRN MRN, SSE_SURG_DTE SURGERY_DATE, SSP_PROC_NAME PROCEDURE_NAME, TM_HIST_CD HISTOLOGY_CODE, HIST_DESC HISTOLOGY_DESCRIPTION, ICD9_CD ICD9_CODE, ICD9_DESC ICD9_DESCRIPTION, RESULT AS COVID_RESULT, COVID_DATE AS COVID_RESULT_DATE FROM COVID C LEFT JOIN DIAG V ON DX_MRN = C.MRN ;

prompt: ALLO Transplant patients with GvHD diagnosis
completion: WITH HCT AS (SELECT CBM_MRN AS HCT_MRN, CBM_TRANSPLANT_DTE AS TRANSPLANT_DTE, CBM_INDICATION_DESC AS INDICATION_DESC FROM IDB.CRDB_BMT_MEDICINE WHERE CBM_TRANSPLANT_TYPE = 'ALLO' AND CBM_TRANSPLANT_DTE BETWEEN '1966-04-01' AND '2021-06-01' UNION ALL SELECT CBP_MRN AS HCT_MRN, CBP_TRANSPLANT_DTE AS TRANSPLANT_DTE, CBP_INDICATION_DESC AS INDICATION_DESC FROM IDB.CRDB_BMT_PEDIATRICS WHERE CBP_TRANSPLANT_TYPE = 'ALLO' AND CBP_TRANSPLANT_DTE BETWEEN '1966-04-01' AND '2021-06-01' ) , DX AS (SELECT CC_MRN, TRANSPLANT_DTE, INDICATION_DESC, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS DX_DTE FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN HCT ON CC_MRN = HCT_MRN WHERE CC_CLSF_CD LIKE 'D89.81%' AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND (CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) GROUP BY CC_MRN, TRANSPLANT_DTE, INDICATION_DESC HAVING MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) BETWEEN '1966-04-01' AND '2021-06-01') , CDB AS (SELECT TM_MRN, AV_DESC AS CASE_STS, TM_DX_DTE, TM_HIST_CD, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS HIST_DESC, TM_SITE_CD, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_DESC, TM_BEST_AJCC_STG FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS ON AV_ELEMENT = 'CASE_STS' AND AV_CODE = TM_CASE_STS JOIN DX ON CC_MRN = TM_MRN WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND TM_DX_DTE BETWEEN '1966-04-01' AND '2021-06-01' ) SELECT DISTINCT LR_MRN, PT_SEX_DESC, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, YEAR(LR_PERFORMED_DTE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) AGE_AT_LAB, TRANSPLANT_DTE, INDICATION_DESC, DX_DTE, LR_PERFORMED_DTE, LR_TEST_NAME, LR_SUBTEST_NAME, LR_RESULT_VALUE, LR_ABNORMALITY_CD, LTL_LINE_NO, LTL_TEXT_RESULT, TM_DX_DTE, TM_HIST_CD, HIST_DESC, TM_SITE_CD, SITE_DESC, TM_BEST_AJCC_STG FROM IDB.LAB_RESULTS JOIN IDB.PATIENT_V ON LR_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN DX ON LR_MRN = CC_MRN AND LR_PERFORMED_DTE >= TRANSPLANT_DTE LEFT JOIN IDB.LAB_TEXT_LINE ON LTL_RESULT_GUID = LR_RESULT_GUID LEFT JOIN CDB ON LR_MRN = TM_MRN WHERE (LR_TEST_NAME LIKE 'Vitamin%' OR LR_TEST_NAME LIKE 'Iron%' OR LR_TEST_NAME LIKE 'Zinc%' OR LR_TEST_NAME LIKE 'Copper%' OR LR_TEST_NAME LIKE 'Selenium%' OR LR_TEST_NAME LIKE 'Niacin%' OR LR_TEST_NAME LIKE 'Folate%' OR LR_TEST_NAME LIKE 'Folic%') AND LR_PERFORMED_DTE BETWEEN '1966-04-01' AND '2021-06-01'

prompt: Provide list of patients with an adrenocortical carcinoma diagnosis between January 1st 1997 and December 31st 2020.
completion: SELECT PBD_MRN AS MRN, DX_DTE, DX_CLSF_CD AS DX_CODE, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS DX_DESC, PT_SEX AS GENDER, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH AS DOB, PT_DATE_OF_DEATH AS DOD, PT_DEATH_IND AS DEATH_IND, YEAR(CURRENT_DATE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) AS CURRENT_AGE FROM (SELECT DISTINCT PBD_MRN , MIN(PBD_SVC_DTE) AS DX_DTE, DX_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK FROM IDB.PBD_DTL JOIN IDB.PBD_DX ON DX_INV_NO = PBD_INV_NO AND DX_MRN = PBD_MRN JOIN IDB.CLM ON CLM_CLSF_CD = DX_CLSF_CD AND CLM_CD_TYPE = 'D' WHERE 1=1 AND CLM_CLSF_CD IN ('C74.00', 'C74.01') GROUP BY PBD_MRN, DX_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK) AS X JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PBD_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE 1=1 AND YEAR(CURRENT_DATE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) >= 18 AND DX_DTE BETWEEN '2017-01-01' AND '2020-12-31'

prompt: Provide data on patients with upper lobe lung cancer and PET/CT since 2009.
completion: WITH PBD AS (SELECT "PTX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID", "t4"."DT_DTE" AS "PET/CT CPT Date", "t3"."PCC_CODE" AS "PET/CT CPT Code", "t3"."PCC_DESC" AS "PET/CT CPT Description" FROM "DV"."CPT_PBD_PATIENT_PROCEDURE" "t3" JOIN "DV"."DATE" "t4" ON "t3"."PTX_PROC_DATE_ID" = "t4"."DT_DATE_ID" WHERE "t3"."PROC_ID" IN (22971, 23306, 22972) AND "t4"."DT_DTE" >= '2009-01-01' ), CDB AS (SELECT "CDTM_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID", "DT_DTE" AS "CDB Tumor Diagnosis Date", "TCA_CASE_STS_DESC" AS "Case Status", "DXCC_ICD_CODE" AS "ICD-O Histology Code", "DXCC_ICD_MSK_DESC" AS "ICD-O Histology Desc" FROM (SELECT DISTINCT "PTX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" FROM PBD) AS A JOIN "DV"."CDB_TUMOR_V" ON "PTX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "CDTM_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" JOIN "DV"."TUMOR_CASE_ATTRIBUTES" ON "CDTM_CASE_ATTR_ID" = "TUMOR_CASE_ATTR_ID" JOIN "DV"."DATE" "t10" ON "CDTM_DX_DATE_ID" = "t10"."DT_DATE_ID" JOIN "DV"."ICDO_SITE_CATALOG_V" ON "CDTM_SITE_CATALOG_ID" = "ICSC_SITE_CATALOG_ID" JOIN "DV"."DIAGNOSIS_CODE_CAT_ICDO_V" "t9" ON "CDTM_DX_CATALOG_ID" = "DXCC_DX_CATALOG_ID" WHERE "ICSC_SITE_CD" = 'C341' ), ICD9 AS (SELECT "PDX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID", MIN("DT_DTE") AS "Min ICD-9 Dx Effective Date" FROM (SELECT DISTINCT "PTX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" FROM PBD) AS A JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DIAGNOSIS_FINAL_ALL_V" ON "PTX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "PDX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" JOIN "DV"."DATE" ON "PDX_DX_DATE_ID" = "DT_DATE_ID" WHERE "PDX_DX_CATALOG_ID" = 5694 AND "DXA_CIC_CDER_INIT" = 'YES' GROUP BY "PDX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" ) SELECT "t7"."PT_MRN" AS "MRN", "t7"."PT_LAST_NAME" AS "Last Name", "t7"."PT_FIRST_NAME" AS "First Name", "t7"."PT_SEX" AS "Gender", "t7"."PT_BIRTH_DTE" AS "Date of Birth", "t7"."PT_DEATH_DTE" AS "Deceased Date", "CDB Tumor Diagnosis Date", "Case Status", "ICD-O Histology Code", "ICD-O Histology Desc", "Min ICD-9 Dx Effective Date", "PET/CT CPT Date", "PET/CT CPT Code", "PET/CT CPT Description" FROM PBD LEFT JOIN CDB ON "PTX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "CDTM_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN ICD9 ON "PTX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "PDX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V" "t7" ON "PTX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t7"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" WHERE COALESCE("CDTM_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID", "PDX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID") IS NOT NULL

prompt: Created, cancelled and modified appointments of patients on protocol 15-129
completion: SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN AS MRN, CPE_ENC_DTE AS APPT_DATE, CL_LAST_NAME , CL_FIRST_NAME, A.CLD_DEPT_NAME AS DEPT_NAME, B.CRE_RES_NAME AS PROVIDER, B.CRE_RES_TYP AS PROVIDER_TYPE, CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME AS VISIT_TYPE, CPE_CPE_APPT_STS AS APPT_STATUS, CPE_CPE_CANCEL_RSN AS CANCEL_REASON, CPE_APPT_MADE_DTE AS APPT_MADE_DATE, CPE_CANCEL_DTE AS APPT_CANCEL_DATE, DATE(CPAN_IDB_UPD_DT) AS COMMENT_DATE, CPE_ENC_CSN_ID AS CSN_ID, SUBSTR(REPLACE(REPLACE(CAST(XMLSERIALIZE(CONTENT XMLAGG(XMLELEMENT(NAME "c", RTRIM(CPAN_NOTE))) AS CLOB(500)) AS VARCHAR(500)), '<c>', ','), '</c>', ''), 2) AS COMMENTS FROM IDB.ACCRUALS_DATES JOIN IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER ON ACD_MRN = CPE_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT A ON CPE_DEPT_ID = A.CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE B ON B.CRE_RES_ID = CPE_VST_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID JOIN IDB.CL_PATIENT ON CPE_PRK = CL_PRK LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_PT_APPT_NOTES ON CPE_CL_PT_ID = CPAN_CL_PT_ID AND CPE_ENC_DTE_SEQ = CPAN_ENC_DTE_SEQ WHERE 1=1 AND ACD_IRB_NO = '15-129' AND (ACD_OFF_STUDY_DTE IS NULL OR ACD_OFF_STUDY_DTE > CPE_ENC_DTE) AND CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Can', 'Sch', 'CxlSameDay') AND CPE_ENC_DTE >= CURRENT DATE AND (DATE(CPAN_IDB_UPD_DT) = CURRENT DATE - 1 OR CPE_APPT_MADE_DTE = CURRENT DATE - 1 OR CPE_CANCEL_DTE = CURRENT DATE - 1) GROUP BY CPE_MRN , CL_LAST_NAME , CL_FIRST_NAME, A.CLD_DEPT_NAME , B.CRE_RES_NAME , B.CRE_RES_TYP , CPE_ENC_DTE , CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME, CPE_CPE_APPT_STS , CPE_CPE_CANCEL_RSN , CPE_APPT_MADE_DTE , CPE_CANCEL_DTE , DATE(CPAN_IDB_UPD_DT) , CPE_ENC_CSN_ID

prompt: Count of cases performed in IR in 2022 and 2023 on patients greater than or equal to 200lbs.
completion: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT SSE_LOG_ID) "Count of IR Cases" FROM IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE ON SSE_LOG_ID = SSP_LOG_ID JOIN IDB.PT_MEASURES_HX ON PMH_MRN = SSE_MRN AND SSE_ENC_CSN_ID = SSP_ENC_CSN_ID WHERE SSE_SURG_LOC like '%IR%' AND SSP_SURG_SVC_CD = 'IR' AND SSE_SURG_DTE BETWEEN '2022-01-01' AND '2023-12-31' AND PMH_MEASURE_DTE BETWEEN SSE_SURG_DTE AND SSE_SURG_DTE + 90 DAYS AND PMH_WT_KG >= 90.7 AND SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD NOT LIKE '99999%' AND SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD NOT IN ('49083', '76705')

prompt: I am looking to receive the MSK Engage survey results from patients who answered a survey for IRB protocol X22-036.
completion: SELECT DISTINCT EF_SUBMISSION_DT, EF_FORM_ID, EF_MRN, EF_FORM_NAME, EFI_ITEM_TEXT, EFI_ITEM_ALIAS, EFI_VALUE FROM IDB.EF_FORM LEFT JOIN IDB.EF_FORM_ITEM ON EF_FORM_ID = EFI_FORM_ID WHERE EF_FORM_NAME = 'Long-Term Follow Up in Urology' ORDER BY EF_SUBMISSION_DT, EF_FORM_ID, EF_MRN, EFI_ITEM_TEXT

prompt: Followup MED11102 - Update number of surgery patients  by service who underwent procedures with additionally provided CPT codes within 14 days of UCC visit with pleural effusion from 6/30/2012 to 7/31/2015
completion: WITH PLEU AS (SELECT CPE_ENC_CSN_ID, CPE_CL_PT_ID, CPE_MRN AS MRN, CPE_ENC_DTE_SEQ , RTRIM(CL_LAST_NAME)||', '||RTRIM(CL_FIRST_NAME) AS PT_NAME , CPE_ENC_DTE AS VISIT_DTE , CLD_DEPT_NAME AS VISIT_DEPT , CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR AS VST_TYPE, CVT_EXT_NAME VST_TYPE_NAME , A.CPAN_NOTE UCC_NOTE, MIN(CC_CLSF_CD) AS PLEURAL_EFF FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_PATIENT ON CPE_MRN = CL_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_PT_APPT_NOTES A ON CPE_CL_PT_ID = A.CPAN_CL_PT_ID AND CPE_ENC_DTE_SEQ = A.CPAN_ENC_DTE_SEQ AND UPPER(CPAN_NOTE) like '%PLEURAL EFF%' JOIN IDB.CTC_CLSF ON CC_MRN = CPE_MRN AND CC_EFF_DTE = CPE_ENC_DTE AND CC_CLSF_CD LIKE '511.%' AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'D%' AND (CC_FINALIZED_IND= 'Y' OR CC_PT_TYPE = 'I') WHERE CPE_DEPT_ID = 230 AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN '2012-01-01' AND CURRENT DATE - 5 DAYS AND CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') GROUP BY CPE_ENC_CSN_ID, CPE_MRN , CPE_CL_PT_ID, CPE_ENC_DTE_SEQ , CL_LAST_NAME, CL_FIRST_NAME , CPE_ENC_DTE , CLD_DEPT_NAME , CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR , CVT_EXT_NAME , A.CPAN_NOTE) , ADM AS (SELECT CPE_ENC_CSN_ID, CPE_CL_PT_ID, CPE_ENC_DTE_SEQ, MRN, PT_NAME, VISIT_DTE, VISIT_DEPT, VST_TYPE, VST_TYPE_NAME, UCC_NOTE, PLEURAL_EFF , COALESCE(A.CPAN_NOTE, B.CPAN_NOTE, ' ') AS ADMIT_NOTES , C.CPAN_NOTE AS MD_NAME , CH_EFF_DATE AS ADMIT_DTE FROM PLEU LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_PT_APPT_NOTES A ON CPE_CL_PT_ID = A.CPAN_CL_PT_ID AND CPE_ENC_DTE_SEQ = A.CPAN_ENC_DTE_SEQ AND A.CPAN_LINE_NO = 1 AND UPPER(A.CPAN_NOTE) LIKE '%ADMIT%' LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_PT_APPT_NOTES B ON CPE_CL_PT_ID = B.CPAN_CL_PT_ID AND CPE_ENC_DTE_SEQ = B.CPAN_ENC_DTE_SEQ AND B.CPAN_LINE_NO = 2 AND UPPER(B.CPAN_NOTE) LIKE '%ADMIT%' LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_PT_APPT_NOTES C ON CPE_CL_PT_ID = C.CPAN_CL_PT_ID AND CPE_ENC_DTE_SEQ = C.CPAN_ENC_DTE_SEQ AND C.CPAN_LINE_NO = 3 JOIN IDB.CENSUS ON CH_MRN = MRN AND CH_CNG_TYPE = 'A' AND CH_EFF_DATE BETWEEN VISIT_DTE AND VISIT_DTE + 1 DAYS) , SURG AS ( SELECT MRN, PT_NAME, VISIT_DTE, VISIT_DEPT, VST_TYPE, VST_TYPE_NAME, UCC_NOTE, PLEURAL_EFF, SSE_SURG_DTE SURG_DTE, SSE_SURG_LOC SURG_LOC, SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD PROC_CD, SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC PROC_DESC, SSP_SURG_LAST_NM SRG_LAST_NME, SSP_SURG_FIRST_NM SRG_FIRST_NME FROM PLEU JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT ON MRN = SSE_MRN AND SSE_SURG_DTE BETWEEN VISIT_DTE AND VISIT_DTE + 14 DAYS JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE ON SSP_LOG_ID = SSE_LOG_ID WHERE SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD IN ('32421', '32422', '32550', '32551', '32560', '32601', '32561', '32562', '32095')

prompt: Identify all MALE patients diagnosed with breast cancer who also had any surgical procedure or biopsy.
completion: SELECT PT_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, TM_DX_DTE, TM_CA_SURG_DTE, TM_NON_CA_SURG_DTE, MIN_ICD9_DATE, MIN_PROC_DATE FROM (SELECT * FROM (SELECT COALESCE(TM_MRN, CC_MRN) AS MRN, TM_DX_DTE, TM_CA_SURG_DTE, TM_NON_CA_SURG_DTE, MIN_ICD9_DATE FROM (SELECT TM_MRN, TM_DX_DTE, TM_CA_SURG_DTE, TM_NON_CA_SURG_DTE FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR WHERE TM_SITE_CD IN ('C500', 'C501', 'C502', 'C503', 'C504', 'C505', 'C506', 'C508', 'C509') AND TM_DX_DTE BETWEEN '1980-01-01' AND '2009-01-09' AND TM_CASE_STS = '3' AND TM_CLASS_OF_CASE < '3')AS A FULL JOIN (SELECT CC_MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS MIN_ICD9_DATE FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF WHERE CC_CLSF_CD IN ('175', '175.0', '175.9') AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND(CC_CIC_CDR_INITLS <> '' OR SUBSTR(CC_ACCT_NO, 1, 2) IN ('00', '84')) AND CC_EFF_DTE BETWEEN '1985-07-01' AND '2009-01-09' GROUP BY CC_MRN) AS B ON TM_MRN = CC_MRN) AS X LEFT JOIN (SELECT PBD_MRN, MIN(PBD_SVC_DTE) AS MIN_PROC_DATE FROM IDB.PBD_DTL JOIN IDB.PBD_CODE ON PBD_PBD_CD = PBC_PBD_CD WHERE PBC_CPT_CD BETWEEN '10000' AND '69999' AND PBD_SVC_DTE BETWEEN '1993-10-01' AND '2009-01-09' GROUP BY PBD_MRN) AS C ON PBD_MRN = MRN) AS D JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PT_MRN = MRN AND PT_SEX = 'M'

prompt: Weekly list of patients with MSK-Access CfDNA CIS Orders
completion: WITH USER_DATA AS (SELECT OUD_ORD_GUID, MAX(TRIM(CASE WHEN OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'Cancer Dx' THEN OUD_USER_DI_VALUE END)) "Clinical Diagnosis", MAX(TRIM(CASE WHEN OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'PPATH_Access_Clin info' THEN OUD_USER_DI_VALUE END)) "Clinical Info", MAX(TRIM(CASE WHEN OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'PPATH_Access_indication' THEN OUD_USER_DI_VALUE END)) "Indication for test", MAX(TRIM(CASE WHEN OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'iPATH_Access_therapy' THEN OUD_USER_DI_VALUE END)) "Active Therapy", MAX(TRIM(CASE WHEN OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'iPATH_Access_tx response' THEN OUD_USER_DI_VALUE END)) "Responding to Tx?", MAX(TRIM(CASE WHEN OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'iPATH_Access_Consent' THEN OUD_USER_DI_VALUE END)) "MSK-Access Consent", MAX(TRIM(CASE WHEN OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'iPATH_Access_Outside testing' THEN OUD_USER_DI_VALUE END)) "Outside Testing", MAX(TRIM(CASE WHEN OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'iPATH_Access_systemic tx' THEN OUD_USER_DI_VALUE END)) "Prior targeted therapy or immunotherapy", MAX(TRIM(CASE WHEN OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'Protocol # (if applicable))' THEN OUD_USER_DI_VALUE END)) "Protocol No", MAX(TRIM(CASE WHEN OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'Research Billing' THEN OUD_USER_DI_VALUE END)) "Research Billing", MAX(TRIM(CASE WHEN OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'Special Instructions' THEN OUD_USER_DI_VALUE END)) "Special Instructions", MAX(TRIM(CASE WHEN OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'Lab_Specimen Collected On' THEN OUD_USER_DI_VALUE END)) "Collection Date" FROM IDB.OMS_ORD_USER_DATA JOIN IDB.OMS_ORDER ON OO_ORD_GUID = OUD_ORD_GUID WHERE OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID = '9000013297100730' AND OO_ORD_STS_CD NOT IN ('CANP', 'CANC', 'AUC3') AND OO_ENTER_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT DATE - 7 DAYS AND CURRENT DATE - 1 DAYS GROUP BY OUD_ORD_GUID ) SELECT DISTINCT OO_MRN MRN, PT_LAST_NAME "Last Name", PT_FIRST_NAME "First Name", OO_ENTER_DTE "Enter Date", OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE "Start Date", OO_MODIFIED_DTE "Order Modified Date", OSTS_STS_DESC "Status", OU_DISPLAY_NAME "Entered By", OP_DISPLAY_NAME "Provider", DOC_ACDMC_DPT "Academic Dept", "Clinical Diagnosis", "Clinical Info", "Indication for test", "Active Therapy", "MSK-Access Consent", "Outside Testing", "Prior targeted therapy or immunotherapy", "Protocol No", "Research Billing", "Special Instructions", "Collection Date" FROM IDB.OMS_ORDER JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_CATALOG ON OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID = OOC_MSTR_ITEM_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_STATUS ON OO_ORD_STS_CD = OSTS_ORD_STS_CD JOIN IDB.OMS_USER ON OO_USER_GUID = OU_USER_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_PROVIDER ON OO_PVDR_GUID = OP_PVDR_GUID JOIN USER_DATA ON OO_ORD_GUID = OUD_ORD_GUID JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON OO_MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.DOC ON OP_PVDR_NO = DOC_DR_NO WHERE OOC_ITEM_NAME = 'MSK-ACCESS cfDNA (for pts with Solid Tumor)' AND OO_ORD_STS_CD NOT IN ('CANP', 'CANC', 'AUC3') AND COALESCE(OO_MODIFIED_DTE, OO_ENTER_DTE) BETWEEN CURRENT DATE - 7 DAYS AND CURRENT DATE - 1 DAYS ORDER BY 4, 1

prompt: Provide MRN of patients who underwent an allogeneic transplant and received Ruxolitinib or Itacitinib for GVHD
completion: WITH HCT AS (SELECT CBM_MRN AS MRN, CBM_TRANSPLANT_TYPE AS BMT_TYPE, CBM_TRANSPLANT_DTE AS BMT_DATE FROM IDB.CRDB_BMT_MEDICINE WHERE 1=1 AND CBM_TRANSPLANT_TYPE = 'ALLO' UNION SELECT CBP_MRN AS MRN, CBP_TRANSPLANT_TYPE AS BMT_TYPE, CBP_TRANSPLANT_DTE AS BMT_DATE FROM IDB.CRDB_BMT_PEDIATRICS WHERE 1=1 AND CBP_TRANSPLANT_TYPE = 'ALLO' ) , APR AS (SELECT APR_MRN, APR_GENERIC_NAME, MIN(APR_START_DTE) AS START_DATE FROM HCT JOIN IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX_V ON APR_MRN = MRN WHERE CDG_CHEMO_FLAG = 'Y' AND APR_ORD_RX_TYPE <> 'HML' AND(UPPER(APR_GENERIC_NAME) LIKE '%RUXOLITINIB%' OR UPPER(APR_GENERIC_NAME) LIKE '%ITACITINIB%' OR UPPER(CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME) LIKE '%RUXOLITINIB%' OR UPPER(CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME) LIKE '%ITACITINIB%' OR UPPER(APR_DRUG_NAME) LIKE '%RUXOLITINIB%' OR UPPER(APR_DRUG_NAME) LIKE '%ITACITINIB%') GROUP BY APR_MRN, APR_GENERIC_NAME ) , X AS (SELECT MRN, BMT_TYPE, BMT_DATE, MAX(CASE WHEN APR_GENERIC_NAME LIKE '%RUXOLITINIB%' THEN START_DATE END) AS "RUXOLITINIB Start Date", MAX(CASE WHEN APR_GENERIC_NAME LIKE '%ITACITINIB%' THEN START_DATE END) AS "ITACITINIB Start Date" FROM HCT JOIN APR ON MRN = APR_MRN GROUP BY MRN, BMT_TYPE, BMT_DATE) , DX1 AS (SELECT DISTINCT TM_MRN AS MRN, TM_DX_DTE, CATEGORY1, TM_HIST_CD AS DX_CODE, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS DX_DESC FROM X JOIN IDB.CDB_TUMOR ON TM_MRN = MRN JOIN IDB.SEERGROUPING ON RECODE = DV.SEERF_ICDO(TM_SITE_CD, TM_HIST_CD) AND CATEGORY1 IN ('Lymphoma', 'Leukemia', 'Myeloma', 'Miscellaneous') JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD WITH APR AS (SELECT DISTINCT APR_MRN, CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME, APR_START_DTE, APR_END_DTE, APR_LOCATION AS LOCATION, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY APR_MRN ORDER BY APR_START_DTE) AS RN2 FROM IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX_V WHERE CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME = 'OXALIPLATIN' AND APR_START_DTE BETWEEN '2018-01-01' AND '2023-10-31' ) , EPI AS (SELECT DISTINCT OO_MRN, OO_ORD_NAME, OOTO_SIGNIFIC_DTE "ORDER SIGNIFICANT DATE", OMD_DOSE_LOW AS "Dose", OMD_DOSE_UNIT AS "Unit", OOTO_TASK_DOSE AS "DOSE (EMAR)", OOTO_TASK_UOM AS "Unit (EMAR)" FROM IDB.OMS_ORDER JOIN APR ON APR_MRN = OO_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_MED_DETAIL ON OO_ORD_GUID = OMD_ORD_GUID JOIN IDB.OAS_ORD_TASK_OCCR ON OOTO_ORD_GUID = OO_ORD_GUID AND OOTO_STATUS_CD = 'Performed' JOIN IDB.OAS_CTLG_ITEM_TASK ON OOTO_CAT_ITEM_GUID = OCIT_GUID AND OCIT_LEVEL_NO = 0 WHERE 1=1 AND OO_ORD_STS_CD NOT IN ('CANC', 'CANP', 'AUC3') AND UPPER(OO_ORD_NAME) LIKE ('EPINEPHRINE%') AND OOTO_SIGNIFIC_DTE BETWEEN '2018-01-01' AND '2023-10-31' ), OX_EP AS (SELECT DISTINCT APR_MRN AS OX_MRN, APR_START_DTE AS OX_START, RN2 AS OX_EP_NUM FROM APR JOIN EPI ON APR_MRN = OO_MRN AND "ORDER SIGNIFICANT DATE" = APR_START_DTE) SELECT OX_MRN, OX_START, OX_EP_NUM FROM OX_EP ; DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS ON DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS.PT_DEID = KEYS.COHORT_PT_DEID;

prompt:
Provide data of female patients between the ages of 11 to 50 with visits to the Urgent Care Center and UCC-SCC Haupt 1275 over the last 12 months. 

Provide data of female patients between the ages of 11 to 50 with visits to the Urgent Care Center and UCC-SCC Haupt 1275 requiring radiology exams (XRay, Ct scan, MRI).
completion: WITH VISIT AS (SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN AS "MRN", CPE_ENC_DTE AS "Appt Date", CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 AS "Department", CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 AS "Service", CLD_DEPT_NAME AS "Department Name", CRE_RES_NAME AS "Provider Name", CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME AS "Visit Type", CPE_CPE_APPT_STS FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 IN ('UCC') AND CRE_RES_NAME LIKE '%UCC-SCC 1275 HAUPT%' AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT DATE - 12 MONTHS AND CURRENT DATE ) SELECT DISTINCT "MRN", PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, "Appt Date", "Department", "Service", "Department Name", "Provider Name", "Visit Type", CPE_CPE_APPT_STS, PT_SEX AS "GENDER", PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, YEAR(CURRENT DATE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) AS AGE FROM VISIT JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON "MRN" = PT_MRN WHERE PT_SEX = 'F' AND YEAR(CURRENT DATE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) BETWEEN 11 AND 50 ; WITH VISIT AS (SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN AS "MRN", CPE_ENC_DTE AS "Appt Date", CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 AS "Department", CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 AS "Service", CLD_DEPT_NAME AS "Department Name", CRE_RES_NAME AS "Provider Name", CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME AS "Visit Type", CPE_CPE_APPT_STS FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 IN ('UCC') AND CRE_RES_NAME LIKE '%UCC-SCC 1275 HAUPT%' ), PAT AS (SELECT DISTINCT "MRN", PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, "Appt Date", "Department", "Service", "Department Name", "Provider Name", "Visit Type", CPE_CPE_APPT_STS, PT_SEX AS "GENDER", PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, YEAR(CURRENT DATE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) AS AGE FROM VISIT JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON "MRN" = PT_MRN WHERE PT_SEX = 'F' AND YEAR(CURRENT DATE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) BETWEEN 11 AND 50 ) SELECT DISTINCT "MRN", PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, "Appt Date", "Department", "Service", "Department Name", "Provider Name", "Visit Type", CPE_CPE_APPT_STS, "GENDER", PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, AGE, RRPT_ORDER_GROUP, RRPT_PROCEDURE_NAME, VARCHAR(RRPT_REPORT_TXT, 32000) AS "RRPT_REPORT_TXT" FROM PAT JOIN DV.RADIOLOGY_REPORT_V ON "MRN" = RRPT_MRN WHERE RRPT_ORDER_GROUP IN ('CT', 'XR', 'MR') ;

prompt: Revise NRS4165 - Non-Formulary Medication Orders within Last Month Report to each field currently displaying in the summary field to be a discrete column on the excel spreadsheet.
completion: SELECT MRN, ENTER_DATE, OO_ORD_GUID, ORDER_TYPE, FOR_DSCH , REQUESTER, REQUESTER_TYPE, VISIT_ATT_NAME, SVC, LOCATION , ORDER_NAME, STATUS, START_DATE, STOP_DATE , DOSE, UNIT, FREQ, MED_FORM, PRN_FLAG , ROUTE, NO_REFILL, TIME_PRIO, SUMMARYLINE , MAX(CASE WHEN OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'Rx - Nonformulary Med' THEN OUD_USER_DI_VALUE END) MED_NAME , MAX(CASE WHEN OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'Rx - NonForm Indication' THEN OUD_USER_DI_VALUE END) INDICATION , MAX(CASE WHEN OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'Rx - Med Strength' THEN OUD_USER_DI_VALUE END) STRENGTH , MAX(CASE WHEN OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'Rx - Quantity' THEN OUD_USER_DI_VALUE END) QUANTITY , MAX(CASE WHEN OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'Rx - Pharmacy/MAR Info2' THEN OUD_USER_DI_VALUE END) RX_INFO , MAX(CASE WHEN OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'Rx - IV Diluent Volume' THEN OUD_USER_DI_VALUE END) IV_DILUENT_VOLUME , MAX(CASE WHEN OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'Rx - IV_Volume_UOM' THEN OUD_USER_DI_VALUE END) IV_VOLUME_UOM , MAX(CASE WHEN OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'Rx - Instructions' THEN OUD_USER_DI_VALUE END) INSTRUCTIONS FROM (SELECT OO_MRN AS MRN, OO_ENTER_DTE ENTER_DATE, OO_ORD_GUID , CASE WHEN OO_REQ_TME_PRIO IN ('Outside Order', 'Fill at MSK') OR(OO_IS_FOR_DSCH = 'Y' AND OO_REQ_TME_PRIO = 'Routine') THEN 'Retail Order' WHEN OCV_IP_OP_IND = 'I' THEN 'IP Order' ELSE 'OP Order' END ORDER_TYPE, OO_IS_FOR_DSCH FOR_DSCH , SUBSTR(OO_ORD_NAME, 1, 25) ORDER_NAME , STRIP(OO_ORD_STS_CD)||' - '|| OSTS_STS_DESC AS STATUS , OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE AS START_DATE , OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE + CASE WHEN OSD_STOP_AFTER_OPT IN (1, 4) THEN OSD_STOP_AFTER_VALUE - 1 ELSE 0 END DAY AS STOP_DATE, OMD_NO_REFILL NO_REFILL , OMD_DOSE_LOW DOSE, OMD_DOSE_UNIT UNIT, OO_ORD_FREQ FREQ , OMD_MED_FORM MED_FORM, OO_IS_PRN PRN_FLAG, OMD_ORD_ROUTE ROUTE , OU_DISPLAY_NAME AS REQUESTER, OU_ORD_ROLE_TYPE REQUESTER_TYPE , OCV_PVDR_NAME AS VISIT_ATT_NAME , DOC_SVC SVC, OCV_CURR_LOC AS LOCATION , OO_REQ_TME_PRIO AS TIME_PRIO, OO_SUMMARY_LINE AS SUMMARYLINE FROM IDB.OMS_ORDER JOIN IDB.OMS_CLIENT_VISIT ON OO_VISIT_GUID = OCV_VISIT_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_MED_DETAIL ON OMD_ORD_GUID = OO_ORD_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_SYS_DATA ON OO_ORD_GUID = OSD_ORD_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_USER ON OO_PVDR_GUID = OU_USER_GUID JOIN IDB.DOC ON OO_REQ_DR_NO = DOC_DR_NO AND DOC_SOURCE_DESC = 'SMS' JOIN IDB.OMS_STATUS ON OO_ORD_STS_CD = OSTS_ORD_STS_CD WHERE OO_ORD_STS_CD NOT IN ('CANC', 'CANP') AND OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID = '3000001133073001' AND OO_ENTER_DTE BETWEEN LAST_DAY(CURRENT DATE - 2 MONTH) + 1 DAY AND LAST_DAY(CURRENT DATE - 1 MONTH) ) A JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_USER_DATA ON OO_ORD_GUID = OUD_ORD_GUID GROUP BY MRN, ENTER_DATE, OO_ORD_GUID, ORDER_TYPE, FOR_DSCH , ORDER_NAME, STATUS, START_DATE, STOP_DATE , DOSE, UNIT, FREQ, MED_FORM, PRN_FLAG, ROUTE , REQUESTER, REQUESTER_TYPE, VISIT_ATT_NAME , SVC, LOCATION, TIME_PRIO, SUMMARYLINE, NO_REFILL

prompt: Provide a weekly list of stage I or stage II non-small cell lung cancer patients scheduled to see a thoracic surgeon that week.
completion: WITH X AS (SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN AS MRN, CPE_ENC_DTE AS "Appt Date", STRIP(CRE_RES_NAME) AS "Physician", STRIP(CLD_DEPT_NAME) AS "Department", CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8, STRIP(CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME) AS "Visit Type" FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE 1=1 AND CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Sch') AND CRE_RES_TYP IN ('Physician') AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 IN ('THR') AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 IN ('SRG') AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT DATE AND CURRENT DATE + 6 DAYS AND(CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME LIKE '%NV%' OR CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME LIKE '%IR%') ) , CC AS (SELECT CC_MRN AS MRN, CLM_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS INIT_EFF_DATE FROM X JOIN IDB.CTC_CLSF ON MRN = CC_MRN JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND ((CC_PT_TYPE = 'I') OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) AND CC_CLSF_CD BETWEEN 'C00' AND 'D49.99' GROUP BY CC_MRN, CLM_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK ) , CC2 AS (SELECT MRN, LISTAGG(COALESCE(STRIP(CLM_CLSF_CD), '') || ' | ' || COALESCE(STRIP(CAST(CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS VARCHAR(12000))), '') || ' | ' || COALESCE(STRIP(CAST(INIT_EFF_DATE AS VARCHAR(12000))), '') , CHR(13) || CHR(10)) WITHIN GROUP( ORDER BY MRN, INIT_EFF_DATE, CLM_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK) AS ICD_10 FROM CC GROUP BY MRN) SELECT X.*, ICD_10 FROM X LEFT JOIN CC2 ON X.MRN = CC2.MRN

prompt: Scheduled report of all 'Outside Patient Referral' orders placed within the past week.
completion: SELECT OO_MRN "MRN", PT_LAST_NAME "Last Name", PT_FIRST_NAME "First Name", OO_ORD_ID "Order ID", OS_SVC_DESC "Service", OU_DISPLAY_NAME "Requester Name", OU_ORD_ROLE_TYPE "Requester Role", DATE(OO_ENTER_DT) "Order Entered Date", DATE(OO_REQUESTED_DT) "Order Requested by Date", OOC_ITEM_NAME "Order Name", OSTS_STS_DESC "Order Status" FROM IDB.OMS_ORDER JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_CATALOG ON OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID = OOC_MSTR_ITEM_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_STATUS ON OO_ORD_STS_CD = OSTS_ORD_STS_CD JOIN IDB.OMS_CLIENT_VISIT ON OCV_VISIT_GUID = OO_VISIT_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_SERVICE ON OS_SVC_GUID = OCV_SVC_GUID JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON OO_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.OMS_USER ON OU_USER_GUID = OO_PVDR_GUID WHERE OOC_ITEM_NAME = 'Outside Patient Referral' AND OO_ENTER_DT >= CURRENT date - 7 DAYS ORDER BY OO_MRN;

prompt: Provide a list of pathology reports that contain the phrase: "Blastic plasmacytoid dendritic cell neoplasm" since 2012.
completion: SELECT PT_MRN AS "MRN", PT_LAST_NAME AS "Last Name", PT_FIRST_NAME AS "First Name", PT_BIRTH_DTE AS "DOB", YEAR(CURRENT date - PT_BIRTH_DTE) AS "Current Age", PRPT_ACCESSION_NO AS "Path Accession Number", PRPT_REPORT_TYPE "Path Report Type", PRPT_REPORT AS "Path Report" FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT JOIN DV.DATE R ON R.DT_DATE_ID = PRPT_REPORT_DATE_ID JOIN DV.PATH_RPRT_TYPE_LOOKUP ON PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_CD = PRPT_REPORT_TYPE JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON PRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID WHERE 1=1 AND CONTAINS("PRPT_REPORT", '("blastic plasmacytoid dendritic cell neoplasm")') = 1 AND R.DT_DTE >= '2012-01-01' AND PRPT_REPORT IS NOT NULL AND (PRPT_ACCESSION_NO like 'H%' OR PRPT_ACCESSION_NO like 'S%') ;

prompt: Provide a listing of patients with neurofibromatosis for study feasibility inquiry
completion: WITH NF AS (SELECT CC_MRN NF_MRN, MAX(CASE WHEN CLM_CLSF_CD IN ('237.71', 'Q85.01') THEN 'Y' END) NF1, MAX(CASE WHEN CLM_CLSF_CD IN ('237.72', 'Q85.02') THEN 'Y' END) NF2, MAX(CASE WHEN CLM_CLSF_CD NOT IN ('237.71', 'Q85.01', '237.72', 'Q85.02') THEN 'Y' END) NF_NOT_SPECIFIED FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE CC_CLSF_CD IN ('237.7', '237.70', '237.71', '237.72', '237.79', 'Q85.0', 'Q85.00', 'Q85.01', 'Q85.02', 'Q85.09') AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND (CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) GROUP BY CC_MRN ) , FIRST_VISIT AS (SELECT CPE_MRN AS "MRN", CPE_ENC_CSN_ID, CPE_ENC_DTE AS "Appt Date", CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 AS "Department", CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 AS "Service", CLD_DEPT_NAME AS "Department Name", CRE_RES_NAME AS "Provider Name", CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME AS "Visit Type", ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CPE_MRN ORDER BY CPE_ENC_DTE) RN FROM NF JOIN IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER ON NF_MRN = CPE_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CRE_RES_TYP IN ('Physician') ) , APPT_CNT AS (SELECT "MRN", COUNT(DISTINCT CPE_ENC_CSN_ID) "Number of appts in 2020" FROM FIRST_VISIT WHERE "Appt Date" BETWEEN '2000-01-01' AND '2020-12-31' GROUP BY "MRN" ) SELECT NF_MRN MRN, PT_LAST_NAME LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME FIRST_NAME, NF1, NF2, NF_NOT_SPECIFIED, YEAR("Appt Date") YEAR_OF_FIRST_APPT, "Department", "Service", "Number of appts in 2020", CASE WHEN YEAR("Appt Date" - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) >= 1 AND YEAR("Appt Date" - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) < 7 THEN '1-7 years' WHEN YEAR("Appt Date" - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) >= 7 AND YEAR("Appt Date" - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) < 18 THEN '7-18 years' WHEN YEAR("Appt Date" - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) >= 18 THEN '>18 years' END AGE_GROUP FROM NF JOIN FIRST_VISIT FV ON NF_MRN = FV."MRN" AND RN = 1 JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON NF_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN APPT_CNT AC ON NF_MRN = AC."MRN" WHERE "Appt Date" >= '2000-01-01'

prompt: Provide data on the utilization of a regimen of high dose cytarabine plus idarbucin in the last 5 years.
completion: SELECT YEAR(OUO_ENTER_DT) AS YEARENTERED, MONTH(OUO_ENTER_DT) AS MONTHENTERED, COUNT(DISTINCT OO_SET_GUID) AS NUMORDERSETS FROM IDB.OMS_USER_ORDERS JOIN IDB.OMS_ORDER ON OO_ORD_GUID = OUO_ORD_GUID WHERE OUO_ENTER_DTE >= '2008-11-01' AND OO_SET_NAME LIKE '%LKA_AML_HIDAC/IDA_.Re-Induction%' GROUP BY YEAR(OUO_ENTER_DT), MONTH(OUO_ENTER_DT)

prompt: Provide a report comparing LOS from 9/2017-8/2018 to 9/2016-8/2017 in the HMS service for the provided hospitalist physicians vs all others.
completion: WITH X AS (SELECT DISTINCT VIS_MRN, VIS_ADM_DTE, VIS_DSCH_DTE, VIS_HOSP_SVC, VIS_DAYS_STAY AS LOS, ATN_DR_NAME, CASE WHEN ATN_DR_NAME = 'HEINEN MD,JENNIFER A' THEN 'HEINEN MD,JENNIFER A' WHEN ATN_DR_NAME = 'GEORGE MD,ANCY M' THEN 'GEORGE MD,ANCY M' ELSE 'All Others' END AS ATTENDING, CASE WHEN VIS_ADM_DTE BETWEEN '2017-09-01' AND '2018-08-31' THEN '9/2017 - 8/2018' WHEN VIS_ADM_DTE BETWEEN '2016-09-01' AND '2017-08-31' THEN '9/2016 - 8/2017' END AS HMS_ADM_PERIOD FROM IDB.VISIT_V WHERE VIS_HOSP_SVC LIKE 'HM%' AND VIS_ADM_DTE BETWEEN '2016-09-01' AND '2018-08-31' ) SELECT HMS_ADM_PERIOD, ATTENDING, LOS FROM X

prompt: Amend Workday Report for Employee Vaccine Status to add FIRST_BOOSTER_COMPLIANT, FIRST_BOOSTER_ELIGIBLE_DTE
completion: WITH DUPS AS (SELECT EVI_EMPLOYEE_ID AS EID, COUNT(DISTINCT EVI_MRN) AS CT FROM IDB.COVID19_EMPLOYEE_VACCINE_INFO WHERE CEVE_CATEGORY IN ('Employees', 'Contingents', 'Pre-hires') AND ELIGIBLE_DTE IS NOT NULL GROUP BY EVI_EMPLOYEE_ID HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT EVI_MRN) > 1) , EMP AS (SELECT EVI_EMPLOYEE_ID, CEVE_CATEGORY, DOSE_1_BRAND, DOSE_1_ADMIN_DTE, DOSE_2_BRAND, DOSE_2_ADMIN_DTE, VACCINE_EXEMPTION_REASON, VACCINE_EXEMPTION_DTE, VACCINE_EXEMPTION_EXP_DTE, DOSE_1_APPT_DT, DOSE_1_APPT_STATUS, DOSE_2_APPT_DT, DOSE_2_APPT_STATUS FROM IDB.COVID19_EMPLOYEE_VACCINE_INFO WHERE CEVE_CATEGORY IN ('Employees', 'Contingents', 'Pre-hires') AND ELIGIBLE_DTE IS NOT NULL AND EVI_EMPLOYEE_ID NOT IN (SELECT EID FROM DUPS) UNION ALL SELECT EVI_EMPLOYEE_ID, CEVE_CATEGORY, MAX(DOSE_1_BRAND) DOSE_1_BRAND, MAX(DOSE_1_ADMIN_DTE) DOSE_1_ADMIN_DTE, MAX(DOSE_2_BRAND) DOSE_2_BRAND, MAX(DOSE_2_ADMIN_DTE) DOSE_2_ADMIN_DTE, MAX(VACCINE_EXEMPTION_REASON) VACCINE_EXEMPTION_REASON, MAX(VACCINE_EXEMPTION_DTE) VACCINE_EXEMPTION_DTE, MAX(VACCINE_EXEMPTION_EXP_DTE) VACCINE_EXEMPTION_EXP_DTE, MAX(DOSE_1_APPT_DT) DOSE_1_APPT_DT, MAX(DOSE_1_APPT_STATUS) DOSE_1_APPT_STATUS, MAX(DOSE_2_APPT_DT) DOSE_2_APPT_DT, MAX(DOSE_2_APPT_STATUS) DOSE_2_APPT_STATUS FROM IDB.COVID19_EMPLOYEE_VACCINE_INFO JOIN DUPS ON EVI_EMPLOYEE_ID = EID WHERE CEVE_CATEGORY IN ('Employees', 'Contingents', 'Pre-hires') AND ELIGIBLE_DTE IS NOT NULL GROUP BY EVI_EMPLOYEE_ID, CEVE_CATEGORY) , FIN AS (SELECT A.*, TRIM(CVP_NAME) CVP_NAME, CASE WHEN (DOSE_1_BRAND LIKE 'Janssen%' AND DOSE_1_ADMIN_DTE IS NOT NULL) OR (DOSE_2_ADMIN_DTE IS NOT NULL) THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS VACCINE_SERIES_COMPLETE, CASE WHEN VACCINE_EXEMPTION_DTE <= CURRENT DATE AND (VACCINE_EXEMPTION_EXP_DTE IS NULL OR VACCINE_EXEMPTION_EXP_DTE >= CURRENT DATE) THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS "Exemption Flag", CASE WHEN DOSE_1_ADMIN_DTE IS NOT NULL THEN 'Completed' WHEN DOSE_1_ADMIN_DTE IS NULL AND DOSE_1_APPT_STATUS = 'PRE' THEN 'MSK Scheduled' ELSE 'No Record' END AS DOSE_1, CASE WHEN DOSE_2_ADMIN_DTE IS NOT NULL THEN 'Completed' WHEN DOSE_2_ADMIN_DTE IS NULL AND DOSE_2_APPT_STATUS = 'PRE' THEN 'MSK Scheduled' ELSE 'No Record' END AS DOSE_2, CASE WHEN CVP_VACC_REMT_EXMP_IND = 'Y' THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS REMOTE_FLAG, CVP_VACC_REMT_EXMP_EFF_DTE AS REMOTE_EFFECTIVE_DATE FROM EMP A JOIN IDB.COVID19_VACCINE_PERSON ON EVI_EMPLOYEE_ID = CVP_EMPLOYEE_ID) SELECT DISTINCT TRIM(EVI_EMPLOYEE_ID) "Employee ID", TRIM(CVP_NAME) "Employee Name", VACCINE_SERIES_COMPLETE "Vaccine Series Complete", "Exemption Flag", DOSE_1, DOSE_2, REMOTE_FLAG "Remote Worker Flag", REMOTE_EFFECTIVE_DATE "Date Effective" FROM FIN

prompt: Investigate Employee and Patient COVID Vaccine mismatch
completion: WITH P AS (SELECT CEVE_MRN AS MRN FROM IDB.COVID19_PATIENT_CP_VACCINE_EMAR JOIN IDB.COVID19_EMPLOYEE_VACCINE_EMAR ON CPVE_MRN = CEVE_MRN) , CTE AS (SELECT CPVE_MRN AS MRN, DATE(CPVE_ADMIN_DT) AS "DoseDate", CPVE_DOSE_NUM AS "ImmunizationCode", CPVE_MFG_NAME AS "VaccineCode", CPVE_LOT AS "VaccineLotNumber", CPVE_LOT_EXP_DTE AS "ExpirationDate", CPVE_ROUTE_CD AS "ImmunizationRouteCode", CPVE_BODY_SITE AS "InjectionSiteCode" FROM IDB.COVID19_PATIENT_CP_VACCINE_EMAR JOIN P ON CPVE_MRN = MRN WHERE CPVE_TASK_STATUS_CD = 'Performed' UNION ALL SELECT CEVE_MRN AS MRN, DATE(CEVE_ADMIN_DT) AS "DoseDate", CEVE_DOSE_NUM AS "ImmunizationCode", CEVE_MFG_NAME AS "VaccineCode", CEVE_LOT AS "VaccineLotNumber", CEVE_LOT_EXP_DTE AS "ExpirationDate", CEVE_ROUTE_CD AS "ImmunizationRouteCode", CEVE_BODY_SITE AS "InjectionSiteCode" FROM IDB.COVID19_EMPLOYEE_VACCINE_EMAR JOIN P ON CEVE_MRN = MRN WHERE CEVE_TASK_STATUS_CD = 'Performed' ) SELECT DISTINCT CMDM_EMPLOYEE_ID "EmployeeNumber", "DoseDate", "ImmunizationCode", "VaccineCode", "VaccineLotNumber", "ExpirationDate", "ImmunizationRouteCode", "InjectionSiteCode" FROM CTE JOIN IDB.COVID19_MDM_MATCH ON MRN = CMDM_MRN

prompt: Provide a list of Pediatric Service patients seen from 1/1/23 - 12/31/23 at a regional site who received any of these drugs: High dose methotrexate, cyclophosphamide, ifosfamide, or cisplatin
completion: WITH PEDS AS (SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN AS MRN, CPE_ENC_DTE AS APPT_DATE, CRE_RES_NAME, CRE_RES_TYP, CLD_CLD_CENTER AS SITE, CLD_DEPT_NAME AS DEPT_NAME, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 AS GRP_6, CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME AS VISIT_TYPE FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN '2023-01-01' AND '2023-12-31' AND(CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 = 'PED' OR CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_4 = 'PED') AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_1 = 'REG' ) , X AS (SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN AS MRN, CPE_ENC_CSN_ID, CPE_ENC_DTE AS CHEMO_DATE, YEAR(CPE_ENC_DTE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) AS AGE, R2.CRE_RES_NAME AS CHEMO_REFERRING_MD, CLD_CLD_CENTER, CCH_CHEMO_NAME AS CHEMO_NAME, CLD_DEPT_NAME AS CHEMO_DEPT_NAME FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN PEDS ON CPE_MRN = MRN JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON CPE_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE R1 ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = R1.CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE R2 ON CPE_REF_RES_ID = R2.CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID JOIN IDB.CL_PT_CHEMO ON CPC_CL_PT_ID = CPE_CL_PT_ID AND CPC_ENC_DTE_SEQ = CPE_ENC_DTE_SEQ JOIN IDB.CL_CHEMO ON CPC_CHEMO_ID = CCH_CHEMO_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 = 'CHM' AND R1.CRE_RES_TYP = 'Chemotherapy Unit' AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN '2023-01-01' AND '2023-12-31' AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_1 = 'REG' AND(UPPER(CCH_CHEMO_NAME) LIKE '%METHOTREXATE%' OR UPPER(CCH_CHEMO_NAME) LIKE '%CYCLOPHOSPHAMIDE%' OR UPPER(CCH_CHEMO_NAME) LIKE '%IFOSFAMIDE%' OR UPPER(CCH_CHEMO_NAME) LIKE '%CISPLATIN%') ) SELECT * FROM X

prompt: Provide a list of upcoming appointments with Jessica Divanno to determine if they are eligible for telemed appointments
completion: WITH APPTS AS (SELECT CPE_MRN AS "MRN", PT_LAST_NAME "Last Name", PT_FIRST_NAME "First Name", PT_STATE "State of Residence", CPE_ENC_DTE AS "Appt Date", CPE_APPT_DT, CPP_PP_LST_LGN_DTE "Last Portal Login Date" FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON CPE_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_PAS_PATIENT ON CPE_MRN = CPP_MRN WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Sch') AND CRE_RES_NAME = 'DIVANNO, JESSICA ROSE' AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN '2020-01-01' AND '2020-06-30' ) , DX AS (SELECT TM_MRN DX_MRN, TM_DX_DTE DX_DTE, TM_SITE_CD AS SITE_CODE, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_DESC, TM_HIST_CD AS HIST_CODE, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS HIST_DESC FROM (SELECT DISTINCT "MRN" FROM APPTS) A JOIN IDB.CDB_TUMOR ON "MRN" = TM_MRN JOIN IDB.CLM H ON TM_HIST_CD = H.CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON TM_SITE_CD = S.CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') ) SELECT "MRN", "Last Name", "First Name", "State of Residence", "Appt Date", DX_DTE, SITE_CODE, SITE_DESC, HIST_CODE, HIST_DESC, "Last Portal Login Date" FROM APPTS A LEFT JOIN DX ON "MRN" = DX_MRN ORDER BY CPE_APPT_DT

prompt: Identify patients who underwent certain injection procedures performed by Dr. Jonas M Sokolof between 10/1/08 and 6/30/09.
completion: SELECT DISTINCT "t1"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AS "Deident PT #", "t2"."PT_MRN" AS "MRN", "t2"."PT_LAST_NAME" AS "Last Name", "t2"."PT_FIRST_NAME" AS "First Name", "t3"."PCC_CODE" AS "CPT Procedure Code - PBD", "t3"."PCC_DESC" AS "CPT Procedure Desc - PBD", "t4"."DT_DTE" AS "CPT Procedure Date - PBD" FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED" "t1" INNER JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS" "t2" ON "t1"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t2"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."CPT_PBD_PATIENT_PROCEDURE" "t3" ON "t1"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t3"."PTX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE" "t4" ON "t3"."PTX_PROC_DATE_ID" = "t4"."DT_DATE_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."MEDPRO_V" "t5" ON "t3"."PTX_MEDPRO_ID" = "t5"."MP_MEDPRO_ID" WHERE ("t3"."PROC_ID" IN (9751, 9415, 9749, 8945, 9289, 54224, 9413, 3897) AND ("t4"."DT_DTE" BETWEEN '2008-10-1' AND '2009-6-30' AND "t5"."MP_FULL_NM" IN ('SOKOLOF JONAS M', 'Sokolof, Jonas')))

prompt: Create PDF file for pathology reports delivered in prior project NEU24395
completion: WITH D AS (SELECT DISTINCT "t1"."PT_MRN" AS "MRN", "t1"."PT_LAST_NAME" AS "Last Name", "t1"."PT_FIRST_NAME" AS "First Name", "t1"."PT_BIRTH_DTE" AS "Date of Birth", "t1"."PT_SEX_DESC" AS "Gender", "t1"."PT_RACE_DESC" AS "Race", "t2"."CORE_ETHNICITY_DESC" AS "Ethnicity", "t1"."PT_VITAL_STATUS" AS "Vital Status", "t3"."PRPT_ACCESSION_NO" AS "Pathology Report", "t4"."DT_DTE" AS "Pathology Report Date", "t5"."PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_DESC" AS "Pathology Report Type", "t6"."DT_DTE" AS "Pathology Procedure Date" , CAST(SUBSTR("t3"."PRPT_REPORT", 1, 25000) AS VARCHAR(25000)) AS PATH_RPT FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V" "t1" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_CORE_DEMOGRAPHICS" "t2" ON "t1"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t2"."CORE_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED" "t7" ON "t1"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t7"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V" "t3" ON "t7"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t3"."PRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" "t4" ON "t3"."PRPT_REPORT_DATE_ID" = "t4"."DT_DATE_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATH_RPRT_TYPE_LOOKUP" "t5" ON "t3"."PRPT_REPORT_TYPE" = "t5"."PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_CD" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" "t6" ON "t3"."PRPT_PROCEDURE_DATE_ID" = "t6"."DT_DATE_ID" WHERE "t4"."DT_DTE" BETWEEN DATE('2018-01-01') AND DATE('2021-12-31') AND ("t3"."PRPT_REPORT" IS NOT NULL) ) SELECT * , ACD_IRB_NO, ACD_CONS_DTE , CASE WHEN LOCATE('suture granuloma', LOWER(D.PATH_RPT)) > 0 THEN SUBSTR(D.PATH_RPT, LOCATE('suture granuloma', LOWER(D.PATH_RPT)), 35) END "Suture Granuloma" , CASE WHEN LOCATE('langerhans cell hyperplasia', LOWER(D.PATH_RPT)) > 0 THEN SUBSTR(D.PATH_RPT, LOCATE('langerhans cell hyperplasia', LOWER(D.PATH_RPT)), 55) END "Langerhans cell hyperplasia" , CASE WHEN LOCATE('sinus histiocytosis', LOWER(D.PATH_RPT)) > 0 THEN SUBSTR(D.PATH_RPT, LOCATE('sinus histiocytosis', LOWER(D.PATH_RPT)), 55) END "Sinus histiocytosis" FROM D JOIN IDB.ACCRUALS_DATES ON ACD_MRN = "MRN" AND ACD_IRB_NO IN('06-107', '12-245', '17-516', '15-021') WHERE LOCATE('suture granuloma', LOWER(D.PATH_RPT)) > 0 OR LOCATE('langerhans cell hyperplasia', LOWER(D.PATH_RPT)) > 0 OR LOCATE('sinus histiocytosis', LOWER(D.PATH_RPT)) > 0

prompt: Provide colorectal patients seen between Jan 2018 - Oct 2019 that have had surgery for a repair bowel opening
completion: WITH SRG AS (SELECT DISTINCT SSE_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, SSE_SURG_DTE, TRIM(SSP_SURG_LAST_NM) || ', ' || TRIM(SSP_SURG_FIRST_NM) SURGEON, SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC FROM IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE ON SSE_LOG_ID = SSP_LOG_ID JOIN IDB.CLM ON SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER ON SSE_MRN = CPE_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON SSE_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD IN ('44625', '44620', '44625', '45110', '45395', '44310') AND SSE_SURG_DTE BETWEEN '2018-01-01' AND '2019-10-31' AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 = 'MED' AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 = 'GI' AND CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') ) SELECT SSE_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, SSE_SURG_DTE, SURGEON, SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD, SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC, TM_DX_DTE, TM_SITE_CD AS SITE_CODE, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_DESC, TM_HIST_CD AS HIST_CODE, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS HIST_DESC, CATEGORY3, MAX(CASE WHEN (TRIM(TM_PATH_STG_GRP) NOT IN ('99') AND TRIM(TM_PATH_STG_DSCR) NOT IN ('4', '6')) THEN TRIM(PATH_STG.AV_DESC) ELSE TRIM(CLIN_STG.AV_DESC) END) MAX_STAGE FROM SRG JOIN IDB.CDB_TUMOR ON SSE_MRN = TM_MRN JOIN IDB.CLM H ON TM_HIST_CD = H.CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON TM_SITE_CD = S.CLM_CLSF_CD LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS PATH_STG ON PATH_STG.AV_ELEMENT = 'PATH_STG_GRP' AND TM_PATH_STG_GRP = PATH_STG.AV_CODE LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS CLIN_STG ON CLIN_STG.AV_ELEMENT = 'CLIN_STG_GRP' AND TM_CLIN_STG_GRP = CLIN_STG.AV_CODE JOIN IDB.SEERGROUPING ON IDB.SEERF_ICDO(TM_SITE_CD, TM_HIST_CD) = RECODE WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7') AND CATEGORY2 = 'Colon and Rectum' AND TM_SITE_CD like 'C20%' GROUP BY SSE_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, SSE_SURG_DTE, SURGEON, SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD, SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC, TM_DX_DTE, TM_SITE_CD, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK, TM_HIST_CD, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK, CATEGORY3

prompt: Provide MRN,Date of Birth, Name, age at diagnosis (at time of path report), gender, last completed MD visit of the patients with diagnosis of Hairy Cell Leukemia within the last 30 years.
completion: WITH "cte1" AS (SELECT DXCC_DX_CATALOG_ID, LTRIM(RTRIM(DXCC_ICD_CODE)) DXCC_ICD_CODE, LTRIM(RTRIM(DXCC_ICD_MSK_DESC)) DXCC_ICD_MSK_DESC, LTRIM(RTRIM(DXCC_ICD_CODE)) || ' - ' || LTRIM(RTRIM(DXCC_ICD_MSK_DESC)) AS DXCC_CODE_AND_MSK_DESC, LTRIM(RTRIM(DXCC_ICD_NATIONAL_DESC)) DXCC_ICD_NATIONAL_DESC, DXCC_DESC_LONG, CASE WHEN DXCC_ICD_CODE BETWEEN '196' AND '196.99' OR DXCC_ICD_CODE BETWEEN '197' AND '197.99' OR DXCC_ICD_CODE BETWEEN '198' AND '198.99' THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS DXCC_METS_INDICATOR, DXCC_CREATED_DT, DXCC_CREATED_BY, DXCC_MODIFIED_DT FROM DV.DIAGNOSIS_CATALOG WHERE DXCC_DX_TYPE = 'ICD9' ) ,ICD9 AS (SELECT DISTINCT "t1"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AS "Deident PT #", "t2"."PT_SEX_DESC" AS "Gender", "t2"."PT_LAST_NAME" AS "Last Name", "t2"."PT_MRN" AS "MRN", "t2"."PT_FIRST_NAME" AS "First Name", "t2"."PT_BIRTH_DTE" AS "Date of Birth", "t2"."PT_DEATH_DTE" AS "Deceased Date", "t3"."PLA_LAST_DRVST_DTE" AS "Last Dr Visit Date", "t4"."DT_DTE" AS "ICD-9 First Final Diagnosis Date" FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED" "t1" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V" "t2" ON "t1"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t2"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_LATEST_ACTIVITY" "t3" ON "t2"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t3"."PLA_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DIAGNOSIS_FINAL_ALL_V" "t5" ON "t1"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t5"."PDX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DIAGNOSIS_FINAL_DATES_V" "t6" ON "t5"."PDX_DX_CATALOG_ID" = "t6"."PDX_DX_CATALOG_ID" AND "t5"."PDX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t6"."PDX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" "t4" ON "t6"."FIRST_DIAGNOSIS_DATE_ID" = "t4"."DT_DATE_ID" LEFT JOIN "cte1" "t7" ON "t5"."PDX_DX_CATALOG_ID" = "t7"."DXCC_DX_CATALOG_ID" WHERE (1 = 1 AND (("t7"."DXCC_ICD_CODE" IN ('202.4', '202.40', '202.41', '202.42', '202.43', '202.44', '202.45', '202.46', '202.47', '202.48') AND "t5"."DXA_CIC_CDER_INIT" = 'YES') AND 1 = 1)) ) , CDB AS (SELECT DISTINCT "t1"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AS "Deident PT #", "t2"."PT_SEX_DESC" AS "Gender", "t2"."PT_LAST_NAME" AS "Last Name", "t2"."PT_MRN" AS "MRN", "t2"."PT_FIRST_NAME" AS "First Name", "t2"."PT_BIRTH_DTE" AS "Date of Birth", "t2"."PT_DEATH_DTE" AS "Deceased Date", "t3"."PLA_LAST_DRVST_DTE" AS "Last Dr Visit Date", "t4"."DT_DTE" AS "Tumor Diagnosis Date" FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED" "t1" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V" "t2" ON "t1"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t2"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_LATEST_ACTIVITY" "t3" ON "t2"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t3"."PLA_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."CDB_TUMOR_V" "t5" ON "t1"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t5"."CDTM_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" "t4" ON "t5"."CDTM_DX_DATE_ID" = "t4"."DT_DATE_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DIAGNOSIS_CODE_CAT_ICDO_V" "t6" ON "t5"."CDTM_DX_CATALOG_ID" = "t6"."DXCC_DX_CATALOG_ID" WHERE ("t6"."DXCC_ICD_CODE" IN ('M9940/3') AND (1 = 1 AND 1 = 1)) ), PATH AS (SELECT DISTINCT "t1"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AS "Deident PT #", "t2"."PT_SEX_DESC" AS "Gender", "t2"."PT_LAST_NAME" AS "Last Name", "t2"."PT_MRN" AS "MRN", "t2"."PT_FIRST_NAME" AS "First Name", "t2"."PT_BIRTH_DTE" AS "Date of Birth", "t2"."PT_DEATH_DTE" AS "Deceased Date", "t3"."PLA_LAST_DRVST_DTE" AS "Last Dr Visit Date", "t4"."DT_DTE" AS "Pathology Procedure Date" FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED" "t1" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V" "t2" ON "t1"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t2"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_LATEST_ACTIVITY" "t3" ON "t2"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t3"."PLA_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATHOLOGY_REPORT" "t5" ON "t1"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t5"."PRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" "t4" ON "t5"."PRPT_PROCEDURE_DATE_ID" = "t4"."DT_DATE_ID" WHERE ((1 = 1 AND (1 = 1 AND CONTAINS("t5"."PRPT_DEID_REPORT", '("HCL" | "HAIRY CELL")') = 1)) AND "t5"."PRPT_DEID_REPORT" IS NOT NULL) ) , PTS AS (SELECT DISTINCT "MRN", "Deident PT #", "First Name", "Last Name", "Date of Birth", "Deceased Date", "Last Dr Visit Date" FROM ICD9 UNION SELECT DISTINCT "MRN", "Deident PT #", "First Name", "Last Name", "Date of Birth", "Deceased Date", "Last Dr Visit Date" FROM PATH UNION SELECT DISTINCT "MRN", "Deident PT #", "First Name", "Last Name", "Date of Birth", "Deceased Date", "Last Dr Visit Date" FROM CDB), "skin" AS (SELECT TEXTTABLE.*, CONTAINS("PRPT_REPORT", '("Melanoma" | "Basal cell carcinoma" | "Squamous cell carcinoma")') AS "HitCol1" FROM PTS INNER JOIN "DV"."PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V" TEXTTABLE ON "Deident PT #" = TEXTTABLE.PRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID WHERE CONTAINS("PRPT_REPORT", '("Melanoma" | "Basal cell carcinoma" | "Squamous cell carcinoma")') <> 0 ) SELECT P.*, I9."ICD-9 First Final Diagnosis Date", PT."Pathology Procedure Date", CD."Tumor Diagnosis Date", CASE WHEN LOCATE(UPPER('Squamous cell carcinoma'), UPPER(SK."PRPT_REPORT")) <> 0 THEN 'Squamous' ELSE ' ' END AS "Squamous", CASE WHEN LOCATE(UPPER('Melanoma'), UPPER(SK."PRPT_REPORT")) <> 0 THEN 'Melanoma' ELSE ' ' END AS "Malanoma", CASE WHEN LOCATE(UPPER('Basal cell carcinoma'), UPPER(SK."PRPT_REPORT")) <> 0 THEN 'Basal' ELSE ' ' END AS "Basal" FROM PTS P LEFT JOIN PATH PT ON PT."Deident PT #"=P."Deident PT #" LEFT JOIN ICD9 I9 ON I9."Deident PT #"=P."Deident PT #" LEFT JOIN CDB CD ON CD."Deident PT #"=P."Deident PT #" LEFT JOIN "skin" SK ON SK.PRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = P."Deident PT #"

prompt: Provide a list of patients who had spine surgery between 1998 to 2018
completion: SELECT SSE_MRN "MRN", PT_LAST_NAME "Last Name", PT_FIRST_NAME "First Name", PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH "DOB", PT_DATE_OF_DEATH "DOD", PT_LAST_KNOWN_ALIVE_DTE "Last Known Alive Date", SSE_SURG_DTE "Surgery Date", SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD "CPT Code", CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK "CPT Desc", TRIM(SSP_SURG_LAST_NM) || ', ' || TRIM(SSP_SURG_FIRST_NM) "Surgeon", PRPT_REPORT_DTE "Report Date" FROM IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE ON SSE_LOG_ID = SSP_LOG_ID JOIN IDB.CLM ON SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON SSE_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V ON SSE_MRN = PRPT_MRN AND SSE_SURG_DTE = PRPT_PROCEDURE_DTE WHERE SSE_SURG_DTE BETWEEN '1998-01-01' AND '2018-12-31' AND (UPPER(CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK) like '%SPINE%' OR SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD IN ('63275', '63276', '63277', '63278', '63280', '63281', '63282', '63285', '63286', '22842', '22590', '22595', '22600', '22610', '22612', '22849', '22852', '22845', '22551', '22855', '63045', '63046', '63047', '63185', '63001', '63003', '63005', '63081', '63101', '63102', '22899', '22513', '22514', '95940', '77003', '61783', '69990', '76998', '63030', '63020', '62380', '64772', '21935', '21554', '21556', '64713', '62350', '62362', '62355', '62365', '63650', '95972', '63685', '63663', '63661', '20250', '62272', '63740', '63307', '64999', '11044', '13101', '10140', '10180'))

prompt: Provide a report of medications administered for bone metastases, to the specified list of patients.

prompt: I would like to request a report that shows the Most Frequent Volume of Subsequent New Visits (visit type [3669]) for all Radiation Oncology MDs from Q2, Q3, and Q4 of 2022 per clinic day.
completion: SELECT PHYSICIAN_NAME, WEEKDAY, QUARTER, COUNT(CPE_ENC_CSN_ID) SUBNV_COUNT FROM (SELECT CRE_RES_NAME AS PHYSICIAN_NAME, DAYNAME (CPE_ENC_DTE) AS WEEKDAY, CPE_ENC_CSN_ID, CASE WHEN MONTH(CPE_ENC_DTE) BETWEEN 10 AND 12 THEN 'Q4' WHEN MONTH(CPE_ENC_DTE) BETWEEN 4 AND 6 THEN 'Q2' WHEN MONTH(CPE_ENC_DTE) BETWEEN 7 AND 9 THEN 'Q3' END AS QUARTER FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID AND CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID = 3669 AND CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME = 'RO SUB NV' WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN '2022-04-01' AND '2022-06-30' AND CRE_RES_TYP IN ('Physician') ) GROUP BY PHYSICIAN_NAME, WEEKDAY, QUARTER ORDER BY PHYSICIAN_NAME; SELECT PHYSICIAN_NAME, WEEKDAY, QUARTER, COUNT(CPE_ENC_CSN_ID) SUBNV_COUNT FROM (SELECT CRE_RES_NAME AS PHYSICIAN_NAME, DAYNAME (CPE_ENC_DTE) AS WEEKDAY, CPE_ENC_CSN_ID, CASE WHEN MONTH(CPE_ENC_DTE) BETWEEN 10 AND 12 THEN 'Q4' WHEN MONTH(CPE_ENC_DTE) BETWEEN 4 AND 6 THEN 'Q2' WHEN MONTH(CPE_ENC_DTE) BETWEEN 7 AND 9 THEN 'Q3' END AS QUARTER FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID AND CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID = 3669 AND CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME = 'RO SUB NV' WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN '2022-07-01' AND '2022-09-30' AND CRE_RES_TYP IN ('Physician') ) GROUP BY PHYSICIAN_NAME, WEEKDAY, QUARTER ORDER BY PHYSICIAN_NAME; SELECT PHYSICIAN_NAME, WEEKDAY, QUARTER, COUNT(CPE_ENC_CSN_ID) SUBNV_COUNT FROM (SELECT CRE_RES_NAME AS PHYSICIAN_NAME, DAYNAME (CPE_ENC_DTE) AS WEEKDAY, CPE_ENC_CSN_ID, CASE WHEN MONTH(CPE_ENC_DTE) BETWEEN 10 AND 12 THEN 'Q4' WHEN MONTH(CPE_ENC_DTE) BETWEEN 4 AND 6 THEN 'Q2' WHEN MONTH(CPE_ENC_DTE) BETWEEN 7 AND 9 THEN 'Q3' END AS QUARTER FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID AND CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID = 3669 AND CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME = 'RO SUB NV' WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN '2022-10-01' AND '2022-12-31' AND CRE_RES_TYP IN ('Physician') ) GROUP BY PHYSICIAN_NAME, WEEKDAY, QUARTER ORDER BY PHYSICIAN_NAME;

prompt: Provide a monthly list of patients diagnosed with either germ cell tumor and nevi OR germ cell tumor and melanoma.
completion: SELECT PT_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, B.AV_DESC AS GERM_CELL_CASE_STS, D.AV_DESC AS MEL_NEVI_CASE_STS FROM IDB.PATIENT JOIN IDB.CDB_TUMOR A ON A.TM_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS B ON B.AV_ELEMENT = 'CASE_STS' AND B.AV_CODE = A.TM_CASE_STS JOIN IDB.CDB_TUMOR C ON C.TM_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS D ON D.AV_ELEMENT = 'CASE_STS' AND D.AV_CODE = C.TM_CASE_STS WHERE A.TM_CASE_STS IN ('3', '6', '7', '8') AND A.TM_HIST_CD BETWEEN 'M9060' AND 'M9105/3' AND C.TM_CASE_STS IN ('3', '6', '7', '8') AND C.TM_HIST_CD BETWEEN 'M8720' AND 'M8799/3'

prompt: Design a report on rectal patients discharged from M15 who have been prescribed tylenol or motrin.
completion: WITH V AS (SELECT VIS_MRN, VIS_ADM_NUM, VIS_ADM_DTE, VIS_DSCH_DTE, VIS_DSCH_TIME, VIS_PATIENT_TYPE, VIS_HOSP_SVC, VIS_NURS_STA FROM IDB.VISIT WHERE VIS_IP_OP_ADJUSTED_IND = 'I' AND VIS_VISIT_STATUS IN ('2', '3') AND VIS_DSCH_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT DATE - (DAY(CURRENT DATE) - 1) DAYS - 1 MONTH AND CURRENT DATE - (DAY(CURRENT DATE)) DAYS AND VIS_HOSP_SVC IN ('REC') AND VIS_NURS_STA = 'NS15' ) SELECT STRIP(HCPR_MRN) AS MRN , VIS_ADM_DTE AS "Admission Date", VIS_DSCH_DTE AS "Discharge Date", VIS_DSCH_TIME AS "Discharge Time" , VIS_NURS_STA AS "Nursing Station", VIS_HOSP_SVC AS "Hospital Service" , HCPR_CREATED_DTE AS "Rx Create Date" , DATE(HCPR_START_DT) AS "Start Date" , HCPR_END_DT AS "End Date" , STRIP(HCPR_STATUS_TYPE_DESC) AS "Rx Status" , DATE(HCPR_DISCONTINUE_DT) AS "Discontinue Date" , STRIP(HGN_GENERIC_NAME) AS "Generic Name" , STRIP(HCPR_DRUG_NAME) AS "Drug Name" , STRIP(HCPR_PRESCRIPTION_TYPE_DESC) AS "Rx Type" , STRIP(REQ.OU_DISPLAY_NAME) AS "Requester", STRIP(REQ.OU_ORD_ROLE_TYPE) AS "Requester Role" FROM IDB.HML_CLIENT_PRESCRIPTION JOIN V ON HCPR_MRN = VIS_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_CLIENT_VISIT ON OCV_VISIT_GUID = HCPR_VISIT_GUID LEFT JOIN IDB.HML_GENERIC_NAME ON HGN_GENERIC_NAME_ID = HCPR_GENERIC_NAME_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_USER USR ON USR.OU_USER_GUID = HCPR_USER_GUID LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_USER REQ ON REQ.OU_USER_GUID = HCPR_CARE_PROV_GUID LEFT JOIN IDB.HML_RX_UNIT_OF_MEASURE UOM ON UOM.HRUM_RXUOM_ID = HCPR_DOSE_UOM_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.HML_RX_UNIT_OF_MEASURE PKG ON PKG.HRUM_RXUOM_ID = HCPR_INNER_PACKAGE_SIZE_UOM_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.HML_SCRIPT_FREQUENCY ON HSF_SCRIPT_FREQ_ID = HCPR_SCRIPT_FREQ_ID WHERE HCPR_STATUS_TYPE NOT IN (4, 5, 8) AND HCPR_CREATED_DTE IS NOT NULL AND(HCPR_PRESCRIPTION_TYPE = 1 AND HCPR_TRANSMISSION_STATUS IN (1, 2, 5)) AND (UPPER(HCPR_DRUG_NAME) LIKE '%TYLENOL%' OR UPPER(HCPR_DRUG_NAME) LIKE '%ACETAMINOPHEN%' OR UPPER(HCPR_DRUG_NAME) LIKE '%MOTRIN%' OR UPPER(HCPR_DRUG_NAME) LIKE '%ADVIL%' OR UPPER(HCPR_DRUG_NAME) LIKE '%IBUPROFEN%' OR UPPER(HCPR_DRUG_NAME) LIKE '%MIRALAX%' OR UPPER(HCPR_DRUG_NAME) LIKE '%PSYLLIUM%' OR UPPER(HCPR_DRUG_NAME) LIKE '%DOCUSATE%' OR UPPER(HCPR_DRUG_NAME) LIKE '%COLACE%' OR UPPER(HGN_GENERIC_NAME) LIKE '%TYLENOL%' OR UPPER(HGN_GENERIC_NAME) LIKE '%ACETAMINOPHEN%' OR UPPER(HGN_GENERIC_NAME) LIKE '%MOTRIN%' OR UPPER(HGN_GENERIC_NAME) LIKE '%ADVIL%' OR UPPER(HGN_GENERIC_NAME) LIKE '%IBUPROFEN%' OR UPPER(HGN_GENERIC_NAME) LIKE '%MIRALAX%' OR UPPER(HGN_GENERIC_NAME) LIKE '%PSYLLIUM%' OR UPPER(HGN_GENERIC_NAME) LIKE '%DOCUSATE%' OR UPPER(HGN_GENERIC_NAME) LIKE '%COLACE%') AND HGN_GENERIC_NAME not like '%-%' AND HGN_GENERIC_NAME not like '%/%'

prompt: Identify the count of unique patients who were vented in the ICU in 2011 and the count who were vented in the ICU in 2012 YTD.
completion: SELECT YEAR(OO_SIGNIFICANT_DT) AS YR, COUNT(DISTINCT OO_MRN) AS PTS FROM IDB.OMS_ORDER JOIN IDB.OMS_VISIT_LOCATION ON OVL_VISIT_GUID = OO_VISIT_GUID AND OVL_EFF_DT = (SELECT MAX(OVL_EFF_DT) AS MAX_OVL_EFF_DT FROM IDB.OMS_VISIT_LOCATION WHERE OVL_EFF_DT <= OO_SIGNIFICANT_DT AND OVL_VISIT_GUID = OO_VISIT_GUID) JOIN IDB.OMS_LOCATION ON OVL_LOC_GUID = OL_LOC_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_CATALOG ON OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID = OOC_MSTR_ITEM_GUID WHERE OL_LOC_NAME LIKE 'ICU%' AND DATE(OO_SIGNIFICANT_DT) >= '2011-01-01' AND OOC_ITEM_NAME like 'Ventilator%' AND OO_ORD_STS_CD NOT IN ('CANC', 'CANP') GROUP BY YEAR(OO_SIGNIFICANT_DT)

prompt: Abnormal lab values for patients on protocol 17-070
completion: WITH PROTOCOL AS (SELECT AC_MRN, AC_CONS_DTE FROM IDB.ACCRUALS WHERE AC_IRB_NO = '17-070' ) SELECT LR_MRN, AC_CONS_DTE, LR_PERFORMED_DTE, LR_TEST_NAME, LR_SUBTEST_NAME, LR_TEST_UP_LIMIT, LR_TEST_LOW_LIMIT, LR_RESULT_VALUE, LTL_TEXT_RESULT, LR_ABNORMALITY_CD FROM IDB.LAB_RESULTS LEFT JOIN IDB.LAB_TEXT_LINE ON LTL_RESULT_GUID = LR_RESULT_GUID JOIN PROTOCOL ON LR_MRN = AC_MRN AND LR_PERFORMED_DTE >= AC_CONS_DTE - 30 DAYS WHERE LR_ABNORMALITY_CD IN ('L', 'A', 'H') ORDER BY 1, 2, 3

prompt: Cadence Depts missing from RMS' D48002 and D37 dictionaries.
completion: SELECT CLD_DEPT_ID, CLD_DEPT_ABBR DEPT_ABBREV, CLD_DEPT_NAME DEPT_NAME, CLD_CLD_CENTER DEPT_CENTER, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_4 RPT_GRP_4, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 RPT_GRP_6, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_7 RPT_GRP_7, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 RPT_GRP_8, CLD_IDB_INS_DTE FROM IDB.CL_DEPT DEP LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM IDB.RMS_MSK_ADT_SERVICE_CROSSWALK_DICT_DN48002 WHERE RMASC_INACTIVE_FLAG='N' AND RMASC_DELETION_FLAG='N' ) DN48002 ON DEP.CLD_DEPT_ABBR=DN48002.RMASC_ADT_SERVICE LEFT JOIN (SELECT RSVD_MSK_ADT_SYNONYM FROM IDB.RMS_SERVICE_DICT_DN37 WHERE RSVD_INACTIVE_FLAG='N' AND RSVD_DELETION_FLAG ='N' ) DN37 ON DEP.CLD_DEPT_ABBR=DN37.RSVD_MSK_ADT_SYNONYM LEFT JOIN (SELECT RSVD_RECORD_NUMBER, RSVD_MSK_ADT_SYNONYM FROM IDB.RMS_SERVICE_DICT_DN37 WHERE RSVD_INACTIVE_FLAG='N' AND RSVD_DELETION_FLAG ='N' ) DN37B ON DN48002.RMASC_GE_SERVICE_REC_NO=DN37B.RSVD_RECORD_NUMBER WHERE CLD_DEPT_ID<>268 AND CLD_REC_STS='' AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6<>'' AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_10 NOT LIKE '%R_ACI%' AND COALESCE(DN37.RSVD_MSK_ADT_SYNONYM, DN37B.RSVD_MSK_ADT_SYNONYM) IS NULL

prompt: Provide update to Chondrosarcoma patients with an IDH1 mutation cohort logic to use DMP.
completion: WITH DT_1 AS (SELECT PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID AS P_ID FROM DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS REC LEFT JOIN DV.PATIENT_CORE_DEMOGRAPHICS ON PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = CORE_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID WHERE 1=1 ) , DT_2 AS (SELECT INC.PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID P_ID FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_STRUCTURED_RESULTS_V INC JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML DT ON INC.PRPT_PATH_RPT_ID = DT.PDRX_PATH_RPT_ID CROSS JOIN XMLTABLE('$c/root/meta-data' PASSING DT.PDRX_XML_VALUE AS "c" COLUMNS PRIMARY_SITE VARCHAR(264) PATH 'primary_site', TUMOR_TYPE_NAME VARCHAR(264) PATH 'tumor_type_name' , TUMOR_TYPE_CODE VARCHAR(264) PATH 'tumor_type_code', IS_METASTASIS VARCHAR(3) PATH 'is_metastasis' , METASTASIS_SITE VARCHAR(264) PATH 'metastasis_site' , MSI_COMMENT VARCHAR(264) PATH 'msi-comment' , MSI_SCORE VARCHAR(264) PATH 'msi-score' , MSI_TYPE VARCHAR(264) PATH 'msi-type' , TMB_SCORE VARCHAR(25) PATH 'tmb_score' , TMB_COUNT VARCHAR(25) PATH 'tmb-count', COSMIC_ID VARCHAR(5000) PATH 'cosmic_id') T JOIN (SELECT T.TUMOR_TYPE_CODE TTC FROM TABLE(DV.STRING_SPLIT('CHS', ',')) S CROSS JOIN TABLE(DV.ONCOTREE_CHILDREN(COLUMN_VALUES)) T) X ON T.TUMOR_TYPE_CODE = TRIM(X.TTC) WHERE 1=1 AND (INC.GENE IN ('IDH1') OR INC.GENE2 IN ('IDH1')) ) , DT_3 AS (SELECT PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID AS P_ID FROM DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS REC LEFT JOIN DV.PATIENT_CORE_DEMOGRAPHICS ON PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = CORE_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID WHERE 1=1 AND PT_VITAL_STATUS IN ('ALIVE') AND YEAR(CURRENT date - PT_BIRTH_DTE) >= 18 ) , DEID AS (SELECT DISTINCT P_ID FROM (SELECT P_ID FROM DT_1 INTERSECT SELECT P_ID FROM DT_2 INTERSECT SELECT P_ID FROM DT_3 ))

prompt: A list of H-/C-/S-cases with "primary effusion lymphoma" in diagnosis section from 01/01/2016 to present.
completion: SELECT DISTINCT DMP.PRPT_MRN AS MRN , PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_BIRTH_DTE, PT_VITAL_STATUS, PT_DEATH_DTE , CASE WHEN PT_DEATH_DTE IS NULL THEN YEAR(CURRENT date - PT_BIRTH_DTE) END AS "Current Age" , DMP.PRPT_ACCESSION_NO AS "Accession No" , DMP.PRPT_REPORT_DTE AS "Report Date" , DMP.PRPT_PROCEDURE_DTE AS "Procedure Date" , SRG.PRPT_ACCESSION_NO AS RELATED_ACC_NO , SRG_DATE.DT_DTE AS RELATED_PROC_DTE , DMP.PRPT_REPORT_TYPE_DESC AS "Report Type" , DMP.PRPT_REPORT_TYPE , DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)diag[\w\W]*(?=I ATTEST)', DMP.PRPT_REPORT) AS DIAGNOSIS_TEXT , VARCHAR(DMP.PRPT_REPORT, 32000) AS "Report Text (first 32000 characters)" , (SELECT VARCHAR(PRPT_REPORT, 32000) AS REFERENCEDPATHTEXTFROM FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT WHERE PRPT_ACCESSION_NO = SRG.PRPT_ACCESSION_NO) AS REFERENCEDPATHTEXT FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V DMP LEFT JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_REFERENCES ON PRPTR_CHILD_PATH_RPT_ID = DMP.PRPT_PATH_RPT_ID LEFT JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT SRG ON SRG.PRPT_PATH_RPT_ID = PRPTR_PATH_RPT_ID LEFT JOIN DV.DATE_V SRG_DATE ON SRG_DATE.DT_DATE_ID = SRG.PRPT_PROCEDURE_DATE_ID JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = DMP.PRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID WHERE 1=1 AND SUBSTR(DMP.PRPT_ACCESSION_NO, 1, 1) IN ('H', 'S', 'C') AND CONTAINS(DMP.PRPT_REPORT, '("primary effusion lymphoma")') = 1 AND (DMP.PRPT_REPORT_DTE >= '01/01/2016' OR DMP.PRPT_PROCEDURE_DTE >= '01/01/2016' ) AND DMP.PRPT_REPORT IS NOT NULL ORDER BY 1, 9, 8

prompt: Provide January - March 2023 and May - July 2023 KBMA override numbers for Memorial 14.
completion: WITH TASKS AS (SELECT OCV_MRN MRN, OCV_CURR_LOC, OO_ORD_NAME, OTSH_REASON_TXT, OOTO_SIGNIFIC_DT, OOTO_STATUS_CD, OU_DISPLAY_NAME AS ENTERED_BY, OO_ORD_ID FROM IDB.OAS_TASK_STS_HIST H LEFT JOIN IDB.OAS_ORD_TASK_OCCR T ON OOTO_GUID = OTSH_TASK_OCC_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_USER U ON OTSH_ENT_PVDR_GUID = OU_USER_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_ORDER O ON OO_ORD_GUID = OOTO_ORD_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_CLIENT_VISIT V ON OCV_VISIT_GUID = OO_VISIT_GUID WHERE 1=1 AND (H.OTSH_PRCS_DT) BETWEEN '2023-01-01' AND '2023-03-31' AND T.OOTO_STATUS_CD = 'Performed' AND OCV_CURR_LOC LIKE ('M 14%') AND OTSH_REASON_TXT IN ('Override Drug Scan:', 'Override Drug Scan: 6808435411', 'Override Drug Scan: administered by MD', 'Override Drug Scan: Adverse Drug Reaction', 'Override Drug Scan: barcode', 'Override Drug Scan: Barcode Damage', 'Override Drug Scan: Barcode Missing', 'Override Drug Scan: Device Failure', 'Override Drug Scan: forgot to scan', 'Override Drug Scan: Given by another RN in UCC', 'Override Drug Scan: given on different shift', 'Override Drug Scan: IV Contrast', 'Override Drug Scan: No Match on Scan', 'Override Drug Scan: Product not found', 'Override Drug Scan: reset task status, now not populating', 'Override Drug Scan: scan didnt save on computer', 'Override Drug Scan: Wristband issue', 'Override Drug Scan: didn''t scan') ) SELECT OTSH_REASON_TXT "REASON CODE", COUNT(MRN) AS CNT FROM TASKS GROUP BY OTSH_REASON_TXT

prompt: One time request for Gynecology Surgery patients who underwent exploratory laparotomy (ICD.9 code 49000) from January 1, 2024 to April 30, 2024
completion: SELECT DISTINCT SSE_MRN AS MRN, TRIM(PT_LAST_NAME) || ', ' || TRIM(PT_FIRST_NAME) "Patient's Name", SSE_SURG_DTE, SSE_LOG_ID, SSE_LOG_STS, SSE_SURG_LOC, SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD, SSP_PROC_NAME, SSP_SURG_SVC_CD, TRIM(SSP_SURG_LAST_NM) || ', ' || TRIM(SSP_SURG_FIRST_NM) "Surgeon's Name" FROM IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE ON SSE_LOG_ID = SSP_LOG_ID JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON SSE_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE 1=1 AND SSP_SURG_SVC_CD = 'GYN' AND SSE_SURG_DTE BETWEEN '2024-01-01' AND '2024-04-30' AND SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD = '49000' ORDER BY 3, 1

prompt: Provide a list of Spanish speaking patients with completed or scheduled appointments in 2020.
completion: SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN AS "MRN", PT_LAST_NAME LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME FIRST_NAME, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH DOB, PT_PHONE, CPP_EMAIL_ADDR EMAIL, CAV_NAME LANGUAGE FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON CPE_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY ON CPE_MRN = PLA_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_PAS_PATIENT ON CPE_MRN = CPP_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_CATEGORY ON CAV_CATEGORY = 'LANG' AND CPP_LANG = CAV_ABBR WHERE 1=1 AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN '2020-01-01' AND '2020-12-31' AND CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp', 'Sch') AND PT_DEATH_IND IN ('', 'A') AND PLA_DONOT_MAIL_IND <> 'Y' AND CPP_EMAIL_ADDR <> '' AND CAV_NAME = 'Spanish' WITH UR

prompt: Please provide data on the number of Same Day Treatment Requests entered for blood transfusions from the Kimmel Center to Chemo 1275 in the 4th quarter of 2019.
