prompt: Provide a Database View of the 'Surgeries' table in Darwin.
completion: SELECT DISTINCT OL_MRN AS MRN, CPX_PROC_CD AS "CPT Code", CPX_PROC_NAME AS "Procedure Description", OL_SURG_DTE AS "Procedure Date", CRE_RES_NAME AS "Physician", OLAS_SURG_SVC AS "Physician Service" FROM IDB.OR_LOG JOIN IDB.OR_LOG_ALL_PROC ON OL_LOG_ID = OLAP_LOG_ID JOIN IDB.OR_PROC ON OLAP_OR_PROC_ID = OP_OR_PROC_ID JOIN IDB.OR_CL_PROC ON OP_OR_PROC_ID = OCP_OR_PROC_ID JOIN IDB.CL_PROC ON OCP_PROC_ID = CPX_PROC_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.OR_LOG_ALL_SURG ON OLAP_LOG_ID = OLAS_LOG_ID AND OLAP_PNL_NO = OLAS_PNL_NO AND OLAS_SURG_ROLE = 'Primary' LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CRE_RES_ID = OLAS_RES_ID WHERE OL_LOG_STS NOT IN ('Canceled', 'Voided') AND CPX_PROC_CD not like '99999%'

prompt: Provide ClinDoc notes enteredby Emily Sarro and Alexandra Russo for the AYA (Adolescent/Young Adult) initiative
completion: SELECT DISTINCT CDD_MRN AS MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_SEX, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH AS DOB , CDD_AUTHORED_DTE AS AUTHORED_DATE, OP_DISPLAY_NAME AS "Authored by" , CDD_DOC_NAME AS DOC_NAME, OL_LOC_NAME, CDD_DOC_GUID AS DOC_GUID FROM IDB.CD_DOCUMENT JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION ON CDD_DOC_GUID = CDO_DOC_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_PROVIDER ON CDD_AUTH_PROV_GUID = OP_PVDR_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_CLIENT_VISIT ON CDD_VISIT_GUID = OCV_VISIT_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_VISIT_LOCATION ON OCV_VISIT_GUID = OVL_VISIT_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_LOCATION ON OVL_LOC_GUID = OL_LOC_GUID JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON CDD_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE CDD_CANCEL_IND <> '1' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND <> '1' AND CDD_AUTHORED_DTE BETWEEN '2020-03-01' AND CURRENT DATE AND OP_PVDR_GUID IN (9000009140401190 , 9001019830001190) AND YEAR(CDD_SIGNED_DTE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) BETWEEN 15 AND 39 AND CASE WHEN OP_PVDR_GUID IN (9000009140401190) AND CDO_VALUE_TEXT like '%AYA%' THEN 1 WHEN OP_PVDR_GUID IN (9001019830001190) AND UPPER(CDD_DOC_NAME) NOT IN ('PACC BMT', 'HIGH RISK SCREENING FORM - CDC') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END = 1

prompt: Schedule a weekly list of biopsy orders by the lymphoma service.
completion: SELECT DISTINCT STRIP(OO_MRN) AS MRN, OO_ENTER_DTE, STRIP(DOC_SVC) AS "Service", STRIP(OUO_USER_NAME) AS USER_NAME, STRIP(OUO_ATN_PVDR_NAME) AS "Attending", STRIP(OUO_PVDR_NAME) AS "Provider", OO_ORD_ID, OO_ORD_GUID, STRIP(OO_ORD_NAME) AS "Order Name" FROM IDB.OMS_ORDER LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_USER_ORDERS ON OO_ORD_GUID = OUO_ORD_GUID LEFT JOIN IDB.DOC ON OO_REQ_DR_NO = DOC_DR_NO WHERE OO_ORD_STS_CD NOT IN ('CANC', 'CANP', 'AUC3') AND OO_ENTER_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT DATE - 7 DAYS AND CURRENT DATE - 1 DAY AND DOC_SVC = 'LYM' AND OO_ORD_NAME IN ('BMA Biopsy and Aspirate Procedure Request', 'IP_IR_Biopsy', 'IR - Protocol Biopsy Requests', 'IR - Referral Protocol Biopsy', 'US:Guided Soft Tissue Core Biopsy', 'US:Guided Soft Tissue FNA Biopsy', 'BM Aspirate', 'IR - Referral')

prompt:
MSK started vaccinating healthcare personnel (HCP) on December 16, 2020. As of February 16, 2021, over 13,000 HCP are immunized against COVID-19 for an overall vaccination rate of 70%.

During these two months, NYC experienced a second surge of COVID-19, and 461 MSK employees were diagnosed with laboratory-confirmed SARS CoV-2 infection. Within this timeframe, 9590 MSK employees underwent at least one PCR evaluation to detect SARS CoV-2  for symptomatic and surveillance testing (4.8% positivity rate). 

The existing surveillance and testing protocols at MSK provide a unique set of resources to measure mRNA vaccines' overall clinical effectiveness among HCP with symptomatic and asymptomatic SARS CoV-2 infection. The findings will be useful to boost COVID-19 vaccine acceptance among HCP at MSK.
completion: WITH BASE AS (SELECT TRIM(MEI_LAST_NAME) || ', ' || TRIM(MEI_FIRST_NAME) EMP_NAME , EVI_MRN , EVI_EMPLOYEE_ID , YEAR(DATE(DOSE_1_EMAR_ADMIN_DT) - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) AS AGE_AT_DOSE1 , MEI_JOB_FAMILY_GROUP JOB_FAMILY_GROUP , MEI_JOB_FAMILY JOB_FAMILY , MEI_JOB_TITLE JOB_TITLE , CASE WHEN DOSE_1_CIS_ORDER_NAME like 'Pfizer%' THEN 'Pfizer' WHEN DOSE_1_CIS_ORDER_NAME like 'Moderna%' THEN 'Moderna' ELSE DOSE_1_CIS_ORDER_NAME END MANUFACTURER , DOSE_1_EMAR_ADMIN_DT , DOSE_2_EMAR_ADMIN_DT FROM IDB.COVID19_EMPLOYEE_VACCINE_INFO JOIN IDB.MSKCC_EMPLOYEE_INFO ON MEI_EMPLOYEE_ID = EVI_EMPLOYEE_ID JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON EVI_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE DOSE_1_EMAR_ADMIN_DT IS NOT NULL AND EVI_EMPLOYEE_ID IS NOT NULL ) , C19_POS AS (SELECT MRN , MIN(MIN_IDENTIFIED_DT) MIN_IDENTIFIED_DT FROM IDB.COVID19_EMPLOYEE_INFO JOIN BASE ON MRN = EVI_MRN WHERE RESULT IN ('Positive', 'Resolved') GROUP BY MRN ) , IGG AS (SELECT COR_MRN IGG_MRN , MIN(COR_SIGNIFICANT_DT) IGG_FIRST_POS_DT FROM IDB.COVID19_ORDER_AND_RESULT A JOIN BASE ON COR_MRN = EVI_MRN WHERE COR_ORDER_NAME = 'COVID-19 antiBODY Qualitative IgG' AND COR_RESULT_ARRIVAL_DT IS NOT NULL AND UPPER(COR_RESULT_TEXT) LIKE '%POSITIVE%' AND DATE(COR_SIGNIFICANT_DT) < '2020-12-16' GROUP BY COR_MRN ) SELECT EMP_NAME , EVI_EMPLOYEE_ID EMPLOYEE_ID , EVI_MRN MRN , AGE_AT_DOSE1 , JOB_FAMILY_GROUP , JOB_FAMILY , JOB_TITLE , MANUFACTURER , DOSE_1_EMAR_ADMIN_DT , MIN(DOSE_2_EMAR_ADMIN_DT) DOSE_2_EMAR_ADMIN_DT , MIN_IDENTIFIED_DT C19_FIRST_PCR_POS_DT , IGG_FIRST_POS_DT FROM BASE LEFT JOIN C19_POS ON EVI_MRN = MRN LEFT JOIN IGG ON EVI_MRN = IGG_MRN GROUP BY EMP_NAME , EVI_EMPLOYEE_ID , EVI_MRN , AGE_AT_DOSE1 , JOB_FAMILY_GROUP , JOB_FAMILY , JOB_TITLE , MANUFACTURER , DOSE_1_EMAR_ADMIN_DT , MIN_IDENTIFIED_DT , IGG_FIRST_POS_DT ; WITH BASE AS (SELECT TRIM(MEI_LAST_NAME) || ', ' || TRIM(MEI_FIRST_NAME) EMP_NAME , EVI_MRN , YEAR(DATE(DOSE_1_EMAR_ADMIN_DT) - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) AS AGE_AT_DOSE1 , MEI_JOB_FAMILY_GROUP JOB_FAMILY_GROUP , MEI_JOB_FAMILY JOB_FAMILY , MEI_JOB_TITLE JOB_TITLE , CASE WHEN DOSE_1_CIS_ORDER_NAME like 'Pfizer%' THEN 'Pfizer' WHEN DOSE_1_CIS_ORDER_NAME like 'Moderna%' THEN 'Moderna' ELSE DOSE_1_CIS_ORDER_NAME END MANUFACTURER , DOSE_1_EMAR_ADMIN_DT , DOSE_2_EMAR_ADMIN_DT FROM IDB.COVID19_EMPLOYEE_VACCINE_INFO JOIN IDB.MSKCC_EMPLOYEE_INFO ON MEI_EMPLOYEE_ID = EVI_EMPLOYEE_ID JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON EVI_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE DOSE_1_EMAR_ADMIN_DT IS NOT NULL AND EVI_EMPLOYEE_ID IS NOT NULL ) SELECT COR_MRN MRN , COR_SIGNIFICANT_DT TEST_DT , CASE WHEN UPPER(COR_RESULT_TEXT) like 'DETECTED%' OR UPPER(COR_RESULT_TEXT) like 'POSITIVE%' THEN 'Positive' WHEN UPPER(COR_RESULT_TEXT) LIKE 'NEGATIVE%' OR UPPER(COR_RESULT_TEXT) LIKE 'NOT DETECTED%' THEN 'Negative' WHEN LOWER(COR_RESULT_TEXT) like 'inconclusive%' OR LOWER(COR_RESULT_TEXT) like '%invalid%' OR LOWER(COR_RESULT_TEXT) like 'presumptive%' OR COR_ABNORMALITY_CODE IS NULL THEN 'Pending' ELSE 'Pending' END AS TEST_RESULT , COR_SPECIMEN_TYPE SPECIMEN_TYPE , COALESCE(COR_EMPLOYEE_SUBTYPE, CASE WHEN COR_PATIENT_TYPE = 'Patient (Surveillance)' THEN 'Surveillance' WHEN COR_PATIENT_TYPE = 'Patient (Symptomatic)' THEN 'Symptomatic' ELSE COR_EMPLOYEE_SUBTYPE END) SYMPTOM_SURVEILL FROM IDB.COVID19_ORDER_AND_RESULT JOIN BASE ON COR_MRN = EVI_MRN AND COR_SIGNIFICANT_DT >= DOSE_1_EMAR_ADMIN_DT WHERE COR_ORDER_NAME IN ('COVID-19 Qualitative RNA', 'COVID-19 Rapid Qualitative RNA', 'COVID-19/Flu A B/RSV Qual RNA Panel', 'Respiratory NAT Panel with SARS-CoV-2') AND STRIP(COR_MRN) NOT IN ('11111111', '22222222') AND COR_ORDER_STATUS_CODE IN ('RESC', 'RESF') ; WITH BASE AS (SELECT TRIM(MEI_LAST_NAME) || ', ' || TRIM(MEI_FIRST_NAME) EMP_NAME , MEI_EMPLOYEE_ID , YEAR(DATE('2020-12-16') - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) AS AGE_AT_2020_12_16 , MEI_JOB_FAMILY_GROUP JOB_FAMILY_GROUP , MEI_JOB_FAMILY JOB_FAMILY , MEI_JOB_TITLE JOB_TITLE FROM IDB.MSKCC_EMPLOYEE_INFO JOIN IDB.COVID19_MDM_MATCH ON MEI_EMPLOYEE_ID = CMDM_EMPLOYEE_ID JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON CMDM_MRN = PT_MRN AND YEAR(DATE('2020-12-16') - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) >= 15 AND (CMDM_MRN <> '38109448') LEFT JOIN IDB.COVID19_EMPLOYEE_VACCINE_INFO ON MEI_EMPLOYEE_ID = EVI_EMPLOYEE_ID WHERE MEI_STATUS <> 'Terminated' AND DOSE_1_EMAR_ADMIN_DT IS NULL ) , C19_POS AS (SELECT EMPLOYEE_ID , MIN(MIN_IDENTIFIED_DT) MIN_IDENTIFIED_DT FROM IDB.COVID19_EMPLOYEE_INFO JOIN BASE ON EMPLOYEE_ID = MEI_EMPLOYEE_ID WHERE RESULT IN ('Positive', 'Resolved') GROUP BY EMPLOYEE_ID ) , IGG AS (SELECT COR_MRN IGG_MRN , COR_EMPLOYEE_ID IGG_EMPLOYEE_ID , MIN(COR_SIGNIFICANT_DT) IGG_FIRST_POS_DT FROM IDB.COVID19_ORDER_AND_RESULT JOIN BASE ON COR_EMPLOYEE_ID = MEI_EMPLOYEE_ID WHERE COR_ORDER_NAME = 'COVID-19 antiBODY Qualitative IgG' AND COR_RESULT_ARRIVAL_DT IS NOT NULL AND UPPER(COR_RESULT_TEXT) LIKE '%POSITIVE%' AND DATE(COR_SIGNIFICANT_DT) < '2020-12-16' GROUP BY COR_MRN, COR_EMPLOYEE_ID ) SELECT DISTINCT EMP_NAME , MEI_EMPLOYEE_ID EMPLOYEE_ID , AGE_AT_2020_12_16 , JOB_FAMILY_GROUP , JOB_FAMILY , JOB_TITLE , MIN_IDENTIFIED_DT C19_FIRST_PCR_POS_DT , IGG_FIRST_POS_DT FROM BASE LEFT JOIN C19_POS ON MEI_EMPLOYEE_ID = EMPLOYEE_ID LEFT JOIN IGG ON MEI_EMPLOYEE_ID = IGG_EMPLOYEE_ID ; WITH BASE AS (SELECT MEI_EMPLOYEE_ID FROM IDB.MSKCC_EMPLOYEE_INFO LEFT JOIN IDB.COVID19_EMPLOYEE_VACCINE_INFO ON MEI_EMPLOYEE_ID = EVI_EMPLOYEE_ID WHERE MEI_STATUS <> 'Terminated' AND DOSE_1_EMAR_ADMIN_DT IS NULL ) SELECT COR_EMPLOYEE_ID EMPLOYEE_ID , COR_SIGNIFICANT_DT TEST_DT , CASE WHEN UPPER(COR_RESULT_TEXT) like 'DETECTED%' OR UPPER(COR_RESULT_TEXT) like 'POSITIVE%' THEN 'Positive' WHEN UPPER(COR_RESULT_TEXT) LIKE 'NEGATIVE%' OR UPPER(COR_RESULT_TEXT) LIKE 'NOT DETECTED%' THEN 'Negative' WHEN LOWER(COR_RESULT_TEXT) like 'inconclusive%' OR LOWER(COR_RESULT_TEXT) like '%invalid%' OR LOWER(COR_RESULT_TEXT) like 'presumptive%' OR COR_ABNORMALITY_CODE IS NULL THEN 'Pending' ELSE 'Pending' END AS TEST_RESULT , COR_SPECIMEN_TYPE SPECIMEN_TYPE , COALESCE(COR_EMPLOYEE_SUBTYPE, CASE WHEN COR_PATIENT_TYPE = 'Patient (Surveillance)' THEN 'Surveillance' WHEN COR_PATIENT_TYPE = 'Patient (Symptomatic)' THEN 'Symptomatic' ELSE COR_EMPLOYEE_SUBTYPE END) SYMPTOM_SURVEILL FROM IDB.COVID19_ORDER_AND_RESULT JOIN BASE ON COR_EMPLOYEE_ID = MEI_EMPLOYEE_ID WHERE COR_ORDER_NAME IN ('COVID-19 Qualitative RNA', 'COVID-19 Rapid Qualitative RNA', 'COVID-19/Flu A B/RSV Qual RNA Panel', 'Respiratory NAT Panel with SARS-CoV-2') AND STRIP(COR_MRN) NOT IN ('11111111', '22222222') AND COR_ORDER_STATUS_CODE IN ('RESC', 'RESF') AND DATE(COR_SIGNIFICANT_DT) >= '2020-12-16'

prompt: AML patients referred to ABMT for transplant consultation
completion: WITH CDD AS (SELECT CDD_MRN, MIN(CDD_SERVICE_DTE) AS INITIAL_VISIT_CONSULT_DATE, CDD_DOC_NAME, ROW_NUMBER () OVER(PARTITION BY CDD_MRN) AS CDD_RN FROM IDB.CD_DOCUMENT WHERE (CDD_DOC_NAME LIKE 'Initial Consult/Initial Visit - BMT' OR CDD_DOC_NAME LIKE 'Initial Consult/Initial Visit, AMB - DOM-Bone Marrow Transpl' OR CDD_DOC_NAME LIKE 'Initial Consultation - BMT' OR CDD_DOC_NAME LIKE 'Initial Consult/Initial Visit, IP - DOM-Bone Marrow Transpla' AND CDD_SERVICE_DTE BETWEEN '2010-01-01' AND '2019-12-31') GROUP BY CDD_MRN, CDD_DOC_NAME ORDER BY CDD_MRN), AML AS (SELECT CC_MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS DX_EFFECTIVE_DATE, CC_CLSF_CD AS ICD_CD, ROW_NUMBER () OVER(PARTITION BY CC_MRN) AS CC_RN FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE CC_CLSF_CD IN ('205.00', '205.01', '205.02', 'C92.00', 'C92.01', 'C92.02') AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND (CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) GROUP BY CC_MRN, CC_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK), KPS AS (SELECT CDO_MRN KPS_MRN, CDO_AUTHORED_DTE KPS_DATE, CDO_SECTION, CDO_CTLG_DISPL_NM, CDO_ITEM_NAME KPS_ITEM_NAME, CDO_VALUE_TEXT KPS_SCORE FROM IDB.CD_OBSERVATION WHERE UPPER(CDO_ITEM_NAME) LIKE '%KPS%' AND CDO_VALUE_TEXT IS NOT NULL) SELECT DISTINCT CDD_MRN MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, (YEAR(INITIAL_VISIT_CONSULT_DATE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH)) AGE_AT_CONSULT, PT_SEX GENDER, R.AV_DESC RACE, KPS_SCORE AS KPS_AT_CONSULT, PLA_LST_CON_DTE LAST_CONTACT_DATE, CASE WHEN PT_DEATH_IND IN ('X', 'D') THEN 'DEAD' ELSE 'ALIVE' END PT_VITAL_STATUS, PT_DATE_OF_DEATH FROM CDD JOIN AML ON CDD_MRN = CC_MRN AND INITIAL_VISIT_CONSULT_DATE >= DX_EFFECTIVE_DATE JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON CDD_MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN KPS ON CDD_MRN = KPS_MRN AND INITIAL_VISIT_CONSULT_DATE = KPS_DATE LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS R ON R.AV_ELEMENT = 'RACE' AND R.AV_CODE = PT_RACE LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS E ON E.AV_ELEMENT = 'PT_ETHNICITY' AND E.AV_CODE = PT_PT_ETHNICITY JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY ON CDD_MRN = PLA_MRN WHERE (YEAR(INITIAL_VISIT_CONSULT_DATE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH)) >= 65 AND CDD_RN = 1 ORDER BY CDD_MRN

prompt: Provide a list of patient with inferior vena cava thrombosis, portal vein thrombosis, and splenic vein thrombosis in the last 2 years. Provide date of diagnosis and any radiology scans performed on the date of diagnosis and any IR procedures performed after the diagnosis date
completion: WITH THROMBOSIS AS (SELECT CC_MRN, CC_EFF_DTE AS ICD_EFF_DTE, CC_CLSF_CD AS ICD_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS ICD_DESC FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE (CC_CLSF_CD LIKE 'K55.0%' OR CC_CLSF_CD LIKE 'I82.220%' OR CC_CLSF_CD LIKE 'I82.890%' OR CC_CLSF_CD LIKE 'I81%') AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND CC_EFF_DTE >= CURRENT date - 2 YEARS ) SELECT * FROM THROMBOSIS; WITH THROMBOSIS AS (SELECT CC_MRN, CC_EFF_DTE AS ICD_EFF_DTE, CC_CLSF_CD AS ICD_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS ICD_DESC FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE (CC_CLSF_CD LIKE 'K55.0%' OR CC_CLSF_CD LIKE 'I82.220%' OR CC_CLSF_CD LIKE 'I82.890%' OR CC_CLSF_CD LIKE 'I81%') AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND CC_EFF_DTE >= CURRENT date - 2 YEARS ) SELECT TM_MRN, AV_DESC AS CASE_STS, TM_DX_DTE, TM_HIST_CD, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS HIST_DESC, TM_SITE_CD, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_DESC FROM THROMBOSIS JOIN IDB.CDB_TUMOR ON TM_MRN=CC_MRN JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS ON AV_ELEMENT = 'CASE_STS' AND AV_CODE = TM_CASE_STS AND TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') ; WITH THROMBOSIS AS (SELECT CC_MRN, CC_EFF_DTE AS ICD_EFF_DTE, CC_CLSF_CD AS ICD_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS ICD_DESC FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE (CC_CLSF_CD LIKE 'K55.0%' OR CC_CLSF_CD LIKE 'I82.220%' OR CC_CLSF_CD LIKE 'I82.890%' OR CC_CLSF_CD LIKE 'I81%') AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND CC_EFF_DTE >= CURRENT date - 2 YEARS ) SELECT RRPT_MRN, ICD_EFF_DTE DX_DTE, ICD_CD DX_ICD_CD, ICD_DESC DX_ICD_DESC, RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE, RRPT_ACCESSION_NO, RRPT_ORDER_GROUP, RRPT_PROCEDURE_NAME, RRPT_ANC_CODE, RRPT_REPORT_TXT FROM THROMBOSIS JOIN DV.RADIOLOGY_REPORT_V ON RRPT_MRN=CC_MRN WHERE (RRPT_ORDER_GROUP like '%IR%' AND RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE > ICD_EFF_DTE) OR RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE = ICD_EFF_DTE ;

completion: WITH PTS AS (SELECT DISTINCT RRPT_MRN MRN, RRPT_ACCESSION_NO FROM DV.RADIOLOGY_REPORT_V JOIN IDB.OMS_ORDER ON RRPT_MRN = OO_MRN JOIN IDB.OMS_STATUS ON OO_ORD_STS_CD = OSTS_ORD_STS_CD WHERE (UPPER(RRPT_PROCEDURE_NAME) like '%SIRSPHERE TREATMENT%' OR UPPER(RRPT_PROCEDURE_NAME) like '%THERASPHERE TREATMENT%') AND OO_SET_NAME = 'MSK-IMPACT' AND OSTS_STS_DESC NOT IN ('Cancelled', 'Expired', 'Pending') ) SELECT PT_MRN, DT_DTE AS "Tumor Diagnosis Date", DXCC_ICD_CODE AS "ICD-O Histology Code", DXCC_ICD_MSK_DESC AS "ICD-O Histology Description", ICSC_SITE_CD AS "ICD-O Site Code", ICSC_ICDO_SITE_MSK_DESC AS "ICD-O Site Description", TCA_CASE_STS_DESC AS "Case Status" FROM PTS JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON MRN = PT_MRN JOIN DV.CDB_TUMOR_V ON CDTM_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID JOIN DV.DATE_V ON CDTM_DX_DATE_ID = DT_DATE_ID JOIN DV.DIAGNOSIS_CODE_CAT_ICDO_V ON CDTM_DX_CATALOG_ID = DXCC_DX_CATALOG_ID JOIN DV.ICDO_SITE_CATALOG_V ON CDTM_SITE_CATALOG_ID = ICSC_SITE_CATALOG_ID JOIN DV.TUMOR_CASE_ATTRIBUTES_V ON CDTM_CASE_ATTR_ID = TUMOR_CASE_ATTR_ID ; WITH PTS AS (SELECT DISTINCT RRPT_MRN MRN, RRPT_ACCESSION_NO FROM DV.RADIOLOGY_REPORT_V JOIN IDB.OMS_ORDER ON RRPT_MRN = OO_MRN JOIN IDB.OMS_STATUS ON OO_ORD_STS_CD = OSTS_ORD_STS_CD WHERE (UPPER(RRPT_PROCEDURE_NAME) like '%SIRSPHERE TREATMENT%' OR UPPER(RRPT_PROCEDURE_NAME) like '%THERASPHERE TREATMENT%') AND OO_SET_NAME = 'MSK-IMPACT' AND OSTS_STS_DESC NOT IN ('Cancelled', 'Expired', 'Pending') ), RADIO AS (SELECT RRPT_MRN, PTS.RRPT_ACCESSION_NO, RRPT_PROCEDURE_NAME, RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE, RRPT_REPORT_DTE, RRPT_REPORT_TXT FROM PTS JOIN DV.RADIOLOGY_REPORT_V R ON MRN = RRPT_MRN AND PTS.RRPT_ACCESSION_NO = R.RRPT_ACCESSION_NO ), FOLLOWUP AS (SELECT MRN, PTS.RRPT_ACCESSION_NO, MAX(FOLLOWUP.RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE) PET_DTE FROM PTS JOIN DV.RADIOLOGY_REPORT_V FOLLOWUP ON MRN = FOLLOWUP.RRPT_MRN WHERE UPPER(FOLLOWUP.RRPT_PROCEDURE_NAME) like '%PET%' AND UPPER(FOLLOWUP.RRPT_PROCEDURE_NAME) not like '%PETROUS%' GROUP BY MRN, PTS.RRPT_ACCESSION_NO) SELECT RADIO.RRPT_MRN AS MRN, RADIO.RRPT_ACCESSION_NO AS "Accession Number", RADIO.RRPT_PROCEDURE_NAME "Procedure Name", RADIO.RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE "Procedure Date", RADIO.RRPT_REPORT_DTE "Report Date", RADIO.RRPT_REPORT_TXT "Report Text", CASE WHEN FOLLOWUP.PET_DTE >= RADIO.RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS "Pet Followup", CASE WHEN FOLLOWUP.PET_DTE >= RADIO.RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE THEN FOLLOWUP.PET_DTE ELSE NULL END AS "Pet Followup Date" FROM RADIO LEFT JOIN FOLLOWUP ON FOLLOWUP.RRPT_ACCESSION_NO = RADIO.RRPT_ACCESSION_NO ; WITH PTS AS (SELECT DISTINCT RRPT_MRN MRN FROM DV.RADIOLOGY_REPORT_V JOIN IDB.OMS_ORDER ON RRPT_MRN = OO_MRN JOIN IDB.OMS_STATUS ON OO_ORD_STS_CD = OSTS_ORD_STS_CD WHERE (UPPER(RRPT_PROCEDURE_NAME) like '%SIRSPHERE TREATMENT%' OR UPPER(RRPT_PROCEDURE_NAME) like '%THERASPHERE TREATMENT%') AND OO_SET_NAME = 'MSK-IMPACT' AND OSTS_STS_DESC NOT IN ('Cancelled', 'Expired', 'Pending') ) SELECT PT_MRN, PDRX_DMP_PATIENT_ID, PDRX_DMP_SAMPLE_ID, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_BIRTH_DTE, PT_DEATH_DTE, PT_VITAL_STATUS, PDRX_ACCESSION_NO, PDRX_DV_PROCESS_DTE, T.* FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML INNER JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML_SETTINGS ON PDRX_PATH_DMP_RESULTS_XML_ID = PDRXS_PATH_DMP_RESULTS_XML_ID INNER JOIN DVDMC.PATHOLOGY_DMP_WEBSVC_SETTINGS ON PDRXS_SETTING_ID = PDWS_SETTING_ID INNER JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON PDRX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID INNER JOIN PTS ON MRN = PT_MRN, XMLTABLE('$c/root/*' PASSING PDRX_XML_VALUE AS "c" COLUMNS VARIANT_CLASS VARCHAR(100) PATH 'variant_class', SITE1_GENE VARCHAR(100) PATH 'site1_gene', SITE2_GENE VARCHAR(100) PATH 'site2_gene', GENE_ID VARCHAR(100) PATH 'gene_id', EXON_NUM VARCHAR(100) PATH 'exon_num', AA_CHANGE VARCHAR(100) PATH 'aa_change', CDNA_CHANGE VARCHAR(100) PATH 'cDNA_change', GENE_FOLD_CHANGE VARCHAR(100) PATH 'gene_fold_change', VARIANT_TYPE VARCHAR(100) PATH './local-name(.)', PROJECT VARCHAR(100) PATH '../meta-data/dmp_alys_task_name', SAMPLEID VARCHAR(100) PATH '../meta-data/dmp_sample_id', PATIENTID VARCHAR(100) PATH '../meta-data/dmp_patient_id', TUMOR_TYPE_CODE VARCHAR(100) PATH '../meta-data/tumor_type_code', TUMOR_TYPE_NAME VARCHAR(255) PATH '../meta-data/tumor_type_name', IS_METASTASIS VARCHAR(10) PATH '../meta-data/is_metastasis', PRIMARY_SITE VARCHAR(255) PATH '../meta-data/primary_site', METASTASIS_SITE VARCHAR(255) PATH '../meta-data/metastasis_site') T WHERE VARIANT_TYPE <> 'meta-data'

'EIF1AX', 'MYC', 'BRCA1', 'BRCA2', 'ATM', 'PALB')) AND PT_VITAL_STATUS = 'ALIVE' ) , ADDITIONAL_DETAILS_SCH_APPT AS (SELECT DISTINCT A.CPE_MRN, B.CRE_RES_NAME, A.CPE_ENC_DTE, E.CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY A.CPE_MRN ORDER BY A.CPE_ENC_DTE ASC) AS NEXT_APPT_RANK FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER A JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE B ON A.CPE_VST_RES_ID = B.CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT D ON prompt: We need the MRNs for patients with a diagnosis of pancreas cancer who did not go to the OR for surgery, and who were seen more than once at MSKCC between January 2018 and December 2020
completion: WITH DX AS (SELECT DISTINCT CC_MRN, CC_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE CC_EFF_DTE BETWEEN '2018-01-01' AND '2020-12-31' AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND (CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) AND CC_CLSF_CD like 'C25%' ) , APPTS AS (SELECT CPE_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_SEX, TOTAL FROM (SELECT CPE_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_SEX , COUNT (CPE_ENC_CSN_ID) AS TOTAL FROM DX JOIN IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER ON CC_MRN = CPE_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID AND NOT CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 IN ('PFS', 'MSKACCESS') JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PT_MRN = CPE_MRN WHERE CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN '2018-01-01' AND '2020-12-31' AND CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') GROUP BY CPE_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_SEX) AS X WHERE TOTAL >1 ) SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_SEX, TOTAL FROM APPTS JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT ON CPE_MRN <> SSE_MRN AND SSE_SURG_DTE BETWEEN '2018-01-01' AND '2020-12-31'

prompt: Provide pathology and demographic data for patients who have specific search terms mentioned in pathology report text since 01/01/2019.
completion: SELECT DISTINCT PRPT_MRN AS MRN , PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_BIRTH_DTE, PT_VITAL_STATUS, PT_DEATH_DTE , PRPT_ACCESSION_NO AS "Accession No" , PRPT_REPORT_DTE AS "Report Date" , PRPT_PROCEDURE_DTE AS "Procedure Date" , PRPT_REPORT_TYPE_DESC AS "Report Type" , DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)diag[\w\W]*(?=I ATTEST)', PRPT_REPORT) AS DIAGNOSIS_TEXT , VARCHAR(PRPT_REPORT, 32000) AS "Report Text (first 32000 characters)" FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID WHERE 1=1 AND UPPER(PRPT_REPORT_TYPE_DESC) like '%CYT%' AND (PRPT_REPORT_DTE >= '01/01/2019' OR PRPT_PROCEDURE_DTE >= '01/01/2019') AND CONTAINS(PRPT_REPORT, '("plasmacytoid dendritic cell" OR "plasmacytoid dendritic cells")') = 1 AND PRPT_REPORT IS NOT NULL ORDER BY PRPT_MRN, PRPT_REPORT_DTE, PRPT_PROCEDURE_DTE

prompt: Please provide a list of all scheduled patients (by zip code) for MR that are scheduled and live within 30 miles of zip code 11725
completion: WITH RD AS (SELECT CPE_MRN AS "NA_MRN", CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6, CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME, MIN(CPE_ENC_DTE) AS "Next Appt Date" FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Sch') AND CRE_RES_NAME LIKE '%MRI %' AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 = 'RAD' GROUP BY CPE_MRN, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6, CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME) SELECT DISTINCT NA_MRN, CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME, "Next Appt Date", CAST(PT_ZIP_CD AS DECFLOAT), ZC_STATE, ZC_CITY, ZC_COUNTY, ZC_LONGITUDE, ZC_LATITUDE FROM RD JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON NA_MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.ZIPCODE ON PT_ZIP_CD = ZC_ZIP

prompt: Provide a one-time report of patients who have documented hypersensitivity reports in clindoc to liposomal doxorubicin from 1/1/2016 to 12/31/2018.
completion: WITH X AS (SELECT DISTINCT CDD_MRN AS MRN, STRIP(PT_LAST_NAME)||', '||STRIP(PT_FIRST_NAME) AS NAME, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH AS DOB, CDD_SERVICE_DTE AS SERVICE_DTE, CDD_SERVICE_DT AS SERVICE_DT, TIME(CDD_SERVICE_DT) AS SERVICE_TME, CDD_DOC_GUID AS DOC_GUID, STRIP(CDD_DOC_NAME) AS DOC_NAME, STRIP(OP_DISPLAY_NAME) AS AUTHOR, STRIP(CDO_SECTION) AS "SECTION", STRIP(CDO_CTLG_DISPL_NM) AS DISPL_NM, STRIP(CDO_ITEM_NAME) AS ITEM_NAME, STRIP(SUBSTR(CDO_VALUE_TEXT, 1, 2000)) AS VALUE_TEXT, STRIP(CDO_MSTR_ITEM_NM) AS MASTER_ITEM_NM FROM IDB.CD_DOCUMENT JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION ON CDO_DOC_GUID = CDD_DOC_GUID AND CDO_AUTHORED_DTE = CDD_AUTHORED_DTE JOIN IDB.OMS_PROVIDER ON CDD_AUTH_PROV_GUID = OP_PVDR_GUID JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON CDD_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE CDD_CANCEL_IND = '0' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND = '0' AND(CDD_DOC_NAME = 'Adverse Drug Reaction' OR CDD_DOC_NAME LIKE 'Nursing Event Note - Inpatient%' OR CDD_DOC_NAME LIKE 'Nursing Event Note - Outpatient%' OR CDD_DOC_NAME LIKE 'Nursing Event Note - Periop%' OR CDD_DOC_NAME LIKE 'Nursing Treatment/Assessment - Outpatient%') AND(CDO_MSTR_ITEM_NM IN ('NUR_ADR_Drug Name 1 RES', 'NUR_ADR_Drug Name (Other) FT') OR UPPER(CDO_CTLG_DISPL_NM) LIKE '%DRUG%NAME%' OR UPPER(CDO_ITEM_NAME) LIKE '%DRUG%NAME%') AND CDD_SERVICE_DTE BETWEEN '2016-01-01' AND '2018-12-31' AND(UPPER(CDO_VALUE_TEXT) LIKE '%LIPOSOMAL DOXORUBICIN%' OR UPPER(CDO_VALUE_TEXT) LIKE '%DOXORUBICIN%LIPOSOMAL%' OR UPPER(CDO_VALUE_TEXT) LIKE '%DOXIL%' OR UPPER(CDO_VALUE_TEXT) LIKE '%LIPODOX%') ) , Y AS (SELECT DISTINCT CDD_MRN AS MRN, CDD_SERVICE_DTE AS SERVICE_DTE, CDD_SERVICE_DT AS SERVICE_DT, TIME(CDD_SERVICE_DT) AS SERVICE_TME, CDD_DOC_GUID AS DOC_GUID, STRIP(CDD_DOC_NAME) AS DOC_NAME, STRIP(CDO_SECTION) AS "SECTION", STRIP(CDO_CTLG_DISPL_NM) AS DISPL_NM, STRIP(CDO_ITEM_NAME) AS ITEM_NAME, STRIP(SUBSTR(CDO_VALUE_TEXT, 1, 2000)) AS "Case Details", STRIP(CDO_MSTR_ITEM_NM) AS MASTER_ITEM_NM FROM IDB.CD_DOCUMENT JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION ON CDO_DOC_GUID = CDD_DOC_GUID AND CDO_AUTHORED_DTE = CDD_AUTHORED_DTE WHERE CDD_DOC_GUID IN (SELECT DOC_GUID FROM X) AND CDO_ITEM_NAME = 'Case Details' ) SELECT DISTINCT X.*, "Case Details" FROM X LEFT JOIN Y ON X.DOC_GUID = Y.DOC_GUID

prompt: Provide dispensed medications on demand
completion: SELECT DISTINCT T1.PT_MRN AS MRN, T1.PT_LAST_NAME AS "Last Name", T2.PINC_GENERIC_NAME AS "Generic Drug Name", T1.PT_FIRST_NAME AS "First Name", T2.PINC_ITEM_NAME AS "Drug Name", T3.DT_DTE AS "Dispense Date", T4.PDO_DSPNS_DT AS "Dispense DateTime", T4.PDO_DOSE AS DOSAGE, T4.PDO_DOSE_UNIT AS "Dose Unit" FROM DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V T1 LEFT JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED T5 ON T1.PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = T5.PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID LEFT JOIN DV.PHM_PT_MEDS_MQT T6 ON T5.PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = T6.POD_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID LEFT JOIN DV.PHM_ORDER_DTL T7 ON T6.POD_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = T7.POD_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID AND T6.POD_PHARMA_INVENTORY_CTLG_ID = T7.POD_PHARMA_INVENTORY_CTLG_ID LEFT JOIN DV.PHM_INVENTORY_CATALOG T2 ON T7.POD_PHARMA_INVENTORY_CTLG_ID = T2.PINC_INVENTORY_CTLG_ID LEFT JOIN DV.PHM_ORDER_DISPENSE_OCCR T4 ON T7.POD_PHARMA_ORDER_DETAIL_ID = T4.PDO_PHARMA_ORDER_DETAIL_ID LEFT JOIN DV.DATE_V T3 ON T4.PDO_DISPNS_DATE_ID = T3.DT_DATE_ID LEFT JOIN DV.PATIENT_IDENTIFICATION_MRN_V T8 ON T1.PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = T8.PI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID

prompt: Provide a list of 50-60 patients who were treated with chemotherapy and radiation therapy concurrently for head and neck cancer at Basking Ridge from 2/2017-2/2019  Looking for the most recent 50 who completed RT by Feb 2019
completion: WITH ICD AS (SELECT CC_MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS MIN_ICD9_EFF_DTE, CC_CLSF_CD FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER ON CC_MRN = CPE_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID AND CLD_CLD_CENTER = 'BSK' WHERE CC_CLSF_CD IN ('C01', 'C02.9', 'C06.2', 'C06.9', 'C09.9', 'C10.3', 'C11.0', 'C11.9', 'C30.0', 'C32.0', 'C32.1', 'C73', 'C76.0', 'C00.9') AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND (CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) GROUP BY CC_MRN, CC_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK HAVING MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) >= '2017-02-01' AND MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) <= '2019-02-01'), CH AS (SELECT DISTINCT APR_MRN, CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME, APR_DRUG_NAME, APR_START_DTE FROM ICD JOIN IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX_V ON ICD.CC_MRN = APR_MRN AND (UPPER(CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME) LIKE ('%CISPLATIN%') OR UPPER(CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME) LIKE ('%CARBOPLATIN%') OR UPPER(CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME) LIKE ('%TAXOL%') OR UPPER(CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME) LIKE ('%DOXORUBICIN%') OR UPPER(CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME) LIKE ('%GEMCITABINE%') OR UPPER(CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME) LIKE ('%CETUXIMAB%'))), RT AS (SELECT DISTINCT RTC_TX_MRN, RTC_TX_PLAN_NAME, RTC_TX_PLANNED_DOSE, RTC_PRIMARY_REF_POINT, RTC_TX_START_DTE, RTC_TX_STOP_DTE, RTC_TX_DELIVERED_DOSE FROM CH JOIN IDB.RADONC_TREATMENT_COURSE ON APR_MRN = RTC_TX_MRN AND CH.APR_START_DTE = RTC_TX_START_DTE), HW1 AS (SELECT PMH_MRN AS MRN, PMH_MEASURE_DTE, PMH_WT_KG, PMH_HT_CM, ABS(DAYS(PMH_MEASURE_DTE) - DAYS(APR_START_DTE)) AS ABS_DAYS_DIFF FROM CH JOIN IDB.PT_MEASURES_HX ON APR_MRN = PMH_MRN) , HW2 AS (SELECT MRN H2_MRN, MIN(ABS_DAYS_DIFF) AS ABS_DAYS_DIFF_MIN FROM HW1 GROUP BY MRN), HW AS (SELECT DISTINCT HW1.* FROM HW1 JOIN HW2 ON HW1.MRN = HW2.H2_MRN AND HW1.ABS_DAYS_DIFF = HW2.ABS_DAYS_DIFF_MIN), CD AS (SELECT DISTINCT CDD.CDD_MRN AS "MRN", CDD.CDD_SERVICE_DTE AS "Service Date", CDD.CDD_DOC_NAME AS "Document Name", CO.CDO_ITEM_NAME AS "Item", CO.CDO_VALUE_TEXT AS CLINDOC_TEXT FROM CH JOIN IDB.CD_DOCUMENT CDD ON APR_MRN = CDD_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION CO ON CDD_DOC_GUID = CDO_DOC_GUID AND CDD_AUTHORED_DTE = CDO_AUTHORED_DTE AND CDO_VALUE_TEXT <> '' JOIN IDB.OMS_PROVIDER ON CDD_AUTH_PROV_GUID = OP_PVDR_GUID WHERE CDD_CANCEL_IND <> '1' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND <> '1' AND CDO_VALUE_TEXT <> '' AND CDD_DOC_NAME IN ('Follow Up - DOM-Head and Neck Oncology', 'Initial Consult/Initial Visit, AMB - DOM-Head and Neck Oncol') AND CDD_SERVICE_DTE>= '2017-02-01' AND CDD_SERVICE_DTE <= '2019-02-01' AND (LOWER(CO.CDO_VALUE_TEXT) LIKE ('%hospital and admitted%') OR LOWER(CO.CDO_VALUE_TEXT) LIKE ('%emergency department%') OR LOWER(CO.CDO_VALUE_TEXT) LIKE ('%failure to thrive%') OR LOWER(CO.CDO_VALUE_TEXT) LIKE ('%peg placement%') OR LOWER(CO.CDO_VALUE_TEXT) LIKE ('%dehydration%') OR LOWER(CO.CDO_VALUE_TEXT) LIKE ('%fever%') OR LOWER(CO.CDO_VALUE_TEXT) LIKE ('%infection%')) ) SELECT DISTINCT CC_MRN "MRN" , TRIM(A.AV_DESC) AS GENDER , YEAR(CURRENT DATE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) AS AGE , CC_CLSF_CD "ICD CODE" , MIN_ICD9_EFF_DTE "DX DATE" , PMH_HT_CM "HEIGHT" , PMH_WT_KG "WEIGHT" , CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME "GENERIC NAME" , RTC_TX_PLANNED_DOSE "PLANNED DOSE" , RTC_PRIMARY_REF_POINT "PRIMARY REF POINT" , RTC_TX_START_DTE "TREATMENT START DATE" , RTC_TX_STOP_DTE "TREATMENT STOP DATE" FROM ICD JOIN CH ON CC_MRN = APR_MRN JOIN RT ON APR_MRN = RTC_TX_MRN JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON APR_MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS A ON PT_SEX = A.AV_CODE AND A.AV_ELEMENT = 'SEX' LEFT JOIN HW ON APR_MRN = HW.MRN ; WITH ICD AS (SELECT CC_MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS MIN_ICD9_EFF_DTE, CC_CLSF_CD FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER ON CC_MRN = CPE_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID AND CLD_CLD_CENTER = 'BSK' WHERE CC_CLSF_CD IN ('C01', 'C02.9', 'C06.2', 'C06.9', 'C09.9', 'C10.3', 'C11.0', 'C11.9', 'C30.0', 'C32.0', 'C32.1', 'C73', 'C76.0', 'C00.9') AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND (CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) GROUP BY CC_MRN, CC_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK HAVING MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) >= '2017-02-01' AND MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) <= '2019-02-01'), CH AS (SELECT DISTINCT APR_MRN, CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME, APR_DRUG_NAME, APR_START_DTE FROM ICD JOIN IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX_V ON ICD.CC_MRN = APR_MRN AND (UPPER(CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME) LIKE ('%CISPLATIN%') OR UPPER(CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME) LIKE ('%CARBOPLATIN%') OR UPPER(CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME) LIKE ('%TAXOL%') OR UPPER(CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME) LIKE ('%DOXORUBICIN%') OR UPPER(CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME) LIKE ('%GEMCITABINE%') OR UPPER(CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME) LIKE ('%CETUXIMAB%'))), RT AS (SELECT DISTINCT RTC_TX_MRN, RTC_TX_PLAN_NAME, RTC_TX_PLANNED_DOSE, RTC_PRIMARY_REF_POINT, RTC_TX_START_DTE, RTC_TX_STOP_DTE, RTC_TX_DELIVERED_DOSE FROM CH JOIN IDB.RADONC_TREATMENT_COURSE ON APR_MRN = RTC_TX_MRN AND CH.APR_START_DTE = RTC_TX_START_DTE), HW1 AS (SELECT PMH_MRN AS MRN, PMH_MEASURE_DTE, PMH_WT_KG, PMH_HT_CM, ABS(DAYS(PMH_MEASURE_DTE) - DAYS(APR_START_DTE)) AS ABS_DAYS_DIFF FROM CH JOIN IDB.PT_MEASURES_HX ON APR_MRN = PMH_MRN) , HW2 AS (SELECT MRN H2_MRN, MIN(ABS_DAYS_DIFF) AS ABS_DAYS_DIFF_MIN FROM HW1 GROUP BY MRN), HW AS (SELECT DISTINCT HW1.* FROM HW1 JOIN HW2 ON HW1.MRN = HW2.H2_MRN AND HW1.ABS_DAYS_DIFF = HW2.ABS_DAYS_DIFF_MIN), CD AS (SELECT CDD.CDD_MRN AS "MRN", CDD.CDD_SERVICE_DTE AS "Service Date", CDD.CDD_DOC_NAME AS "Document Name", CO.CDO_ITEM_NAME AS "Item", CO.CDO_VALUE_TEXT AS CLINDOC_TEXT FROM CH JOIN IDB.CD_DOCUMENT CDD ON APR_MRN = CDD_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION CO ON CDD_DOC_GUID = CDO_DOC_GUID AND CDD_AUTHORED_DTE = CDO_AUTHORED_DTE AND CDO_VALUE_TEXT <> '' JOIN IDB.OMS_PROVIDER ON CDD_AUTH_PROV_GUID = OP_PVDR_GUID WHERE CDD_CANCEL_IND <> '1' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND <> '1' AND CDO_VALUE_TEXT <> '' AND CDD_DOC_NAME IN ('Follow Up, AMB - Rad Onc', 'Initial Consult/Initial Visit, AMB - Rad Onc', 'Status Check - Rad Onc') AND CDD_SERVICE_DTE>= '2017-02-01' AND CDD_SERVICE_DTE <= '2019-02-01' AND (LOWER(CO.CDO_VALUE_TEXT) LIKE ('%hospital and admitted%') OR LOWER(CO.CDO_VALUE_TEXT) LIKE ('%emergency department%') OR LOWER(CO.CDO_VALUE_TEXT) LIKE ('%failure to thrive%') OR LOWER(CO.CDO_VALUE_TEXT) LIKE ('%peg placement%') OR LOWER(CO.CDO_VALUE_TEXT) LIKE ('%dehydration%') OR LOWER(CO.CDO_VALUE_TEXT) LIKE ('%fever%') OR LOWER(CO.CDO_VALUE_TEXT) LIKE ('%infection%')) ) SELECT DISTINCT CC_MRN "MRN" , TRIM(A.AV_DESC) AS GENDER , YEAR(CURRENT DATE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) AS AGE , CC_CLSF_CD "ICD CODE" , MIN_ICD9_EFF_DTE "DX DATE" , PMH_HT_CM "HEIGHT" , PMH_WT_KG "WEIGHT" , CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME "GENERIC NAME" , RTC_TX_PLANNED_DOSE "PLANNED DOSE" , RTC_PRIMARY_REF_POINT "PRIMARY REF POINT" , RTC_TX_START_DTE "TREATMENT START DATE" , RTC_TX_STOP_DTE "TREATMENT STOP DATE" FROM ICD JOIN CH ON CC_MRN = APR_MRN JOIN RT ON APR_MRN = RTC_TX_MRN JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON APR_MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS A ON PT_SEX = A.AV_CODE AND A.AV_ELEMENT = 'SEX' LEFT JOIN HW ON APR_MRN = HW.MRN ;

prompt: Provide the number of visits and patients that physical therapist Jeanette Zucker saw in 2009.
completion: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CPE_MRN) AS PATIENTS, COUNT(CPE_ENC_CSN_ID) AS VISITS FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER WHERE CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN '2009-01-01' AND '2009-12-31' AND CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID IN (5051, 5052) AND CPE_VST_RES_ID = '1102'

prompt: Recurrent ovarian cancer patients with surgery for malignant bowel obstruction from 2019-Present
completion: WITH INIT AS (SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, PT_SEX, TM_DX_DTE, TM_HIST_CD, HIST_DESC, TM_SITE_CD, SITE_DESC, MIN_ICD9_EFF_DTE, ICD9_CD, ICD9_DESC FROM IDB.PATIENT LEFT JOIN (SELECT TM_MRN, AV_DESC AS CASE_STS, TM_DX_DTE, TM_HIST_CD, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS HIST_DESC, TM_SITE_CD, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_DESC FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS ON AV_ELEMENT = 'CASE_STS' AND AV_CODE = TM_CASE_STS AND TM_CASE_STS IN ('3', '6', '7', '8') AND TM_SITE_CD LIKE 'C56%' ) AS CDB ON TM_MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN (SELECT CC_MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS MIN_ICD9_EFF_DTE, CC_CLSF_CD AS ICD9_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS ICD9_DESC FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE CC_CLSF_CD IN ('C56.9', 'C79.6', 'C79.60', 'C79.61', 'C79.62') AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND (CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) GROUP BY CC_MRN, CC_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK ) AS ICD9 ON CC_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE COALESCE(TM_MRN, CC_MRN) IS NOT NULL ) , SURG AS (SELECT DISTINCT SSE_MRN, SSE_LOG_ID, SSP_PROC_SEQ_NO, SSE_SURG_DTE, SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD, SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC, SSP_SURG_LAST_NM, SSP_SURG_FIRST_NM, SSP_SURG_SVC_CD, DATE(SSE_SURG_STRT_DT) AS SURG_START_DTE, DATE(SSE_SURG_END_DT) AS SURG_END_DTE, DATE(SSE_PT_IN_DT) AS SSE_PT_IN_DT, DATE(SSE_PT_OUT_DT) AS SSE_PT_OUT_DT, TIME(SSE_PT_IN_DT) AS PT_IN_TIME, TIME(SSE_PT_OUT_DT) AS PT_OUT_TIME, TIME(SSE_SURG_STRT_DT) AS SURG_START_TIME, TIME(SSE_SURG_END_DT) AS SURG_END_TIME FROM INIT JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT ON PT_MRN = SSE_MRN JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE ON SSE_LOG_ID = SSP_LOG_ID AND SSE_ENC_CSN_ID = SSP_ENC_CSN_ID WHERE (SSE_SURG_LOC not like '%IR%' AND SSE_SURG_LOC not like '%ENDO%' AND SSE_SOURCE_TYPE <> 'E') AND SSE_SURG_DTE BETWEEN '01-01-2019' AND '11-30-2022' AND SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD IN ('44005', '44110', '44111', '44120', '44121', '44125', '44130', '44139', '44140', '44141', '44143', '44144', '44145', '44146', '44150', '44160', '44180', '44187', '44207', '44227', '44310', '44312', '44320', '44340', '44345', '44602', '44604', '44605', '44620', '44625', '44626', '44640', '44700', '44950', '44955') ) , LAB AS (SELECT DISTINCT LR_MRN, SSE_SURG_DTE, LR_PERFORMED_DTE AS RECENT_LR_PERFORMED_DTE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY LR_MRN ORDER BY LR_PERFORMED_DTE DESC) AS RN, LR_TEST_NAME, LR_SUBTEST_NAME, LR_RESULT_VALUE, LTL_TEXT_RESULT, LR_ABNORMALITY_CD FROM SURG JOIN IDB.LAB_RESULTS ON SSE_MRN = LR_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.LAB_TEXT_LINE ON LTL_RESULT_GUID = LR_RESULT_GUID WHERE LR_SUBTEST_NAME IN ('Albumin') AND LR_PERFORMED_DTE < SSE_SURG_DTE ) , CHEMO AS (SELECT DISTINCT APR_MRN, SSE_SURG_DTE, APR_START_DTE AS RECENT_APR_START_DTE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY APR_MRN ORDER BY APR_START_DTE DESC) AS RN, CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME, APR_GENERIC_NAME, APR_PRESCRIBED_DOSE, APR_ROUTE FROM SURG JOIN IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX ON SSE_MRN = APR_MRN JOIN IDB.CHEMO_DRUG_GENERIC ON APR_GENERIC_NAME = CDG_GENERIC_NAME ) , COMPLICATION AS (SELECT DISTINCT SSE_MRN AS MRN, DATE(SAE_TOX_OCCR_DT) AS COMPLICATION_DATE, SAE_TOXICITY_NAME AS COMPLICATION_NAME, SAE_TOX_GRADE AS COMPLICATION_GRADE, SAE_TOX_GRADE_NAME AS TOXICITY_GRADE_NAME FROM SURG LEFT JOIN IDB.SRG_ADVERSE_EVENT ON SSE_LOG_ID = SAE_SURG_LOG_ID AND SAE_PROC_SEQ_NO = SSP_PROC_SEQ_NO AND SAE_TOX_GRADE > '0') , EBL AS (SELECT OL_MRN, OL_LOG_ID, ARS_AN_PROC_NAME, CAST(STRIP(AIFM_MEAS_VALUE) AS DECIMAL(9, 2)) AS EBL FROM SURG JOIN IDB.OR_LOG ON SSE_MRN = OL_MRN JOIN IDB.AN_RECORD_SUMMARY ON OL_LOG_ID = ARS_AN_CASELOG_ID AND OL_CL_PT_ID = ARS_AN_CL_PT_ID JOIN IDB.AN_IP_DATA_STORE ON ARS_AN_CL_PT_ID = AIDS_CL_PT_ID AND AIDS_ENC_CSN_ID = ARS_AN_52_ENC_CSN_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.AN_IP_FLOWSHEET_REC ON AIFRC_INPATIENT_DATA_ID = AIDS_INPATIENT_DATA_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.AN_IP_FLOWSHEET_MEAS ON AIFRC_FSD_ID = AIFM_FSD_ID WHERE AIFM_MEAS_VALUE > ' ' AND AIFM_FLO_MEAS_ID = '400620' ) , APPO AS (SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN AS "MRN", SSE_SURG_DTE, CPE_ENC_DTE AS "Appt Date", CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 AS "Department", CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 AS "Service", CLD_DEPT_NAME AS "Department Name", CRE_RES_NAME AS "Provider Name", CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME AS "Visit Type", CVT_STS, CVT_IN_OUT_PT FROM SURG JOIN IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER ON SSE_MRN = CPE_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') ) , ADMIT AS (SELECT DISTINCT VIS_MRN, SSE_SURG_DTE, VIS_ADM_DTE, VIS_DSCH_DTE, VIS_DAYS_STAY AS "Hospital LOS", VIS_HOSP_SVC, HOSP_SVC_DESC, VIS_NURS_STA, NURS_STA_DESC FROM SURG JOIN IDB.VISIT_V ON SSE_MRN = VIS_MRN WHERE VIS_IP_OP_ADJUSTED_IND = 'I' AND VIS_VISIT_STATUS IN ('2', '3') AND VIS_ADM_DTE BETWEEN SSE_SURG_DTE - 10 DAYS AND SSE_SURG_DTE + 10 DAYS ) , LOS AS (SELECT * FROM ADMIT WHERE VIS_ADM_DTE <= SSE_SURG_DTE ) SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, PT_SEX, TM_DX_DTE, TM_HIST_CD, HIST_DESC, TM_SITE_CD, SITE_DESC, MIN_ICD9_EFF_DTE, ICD9_CD, ICD9_DESC, SSE_PT_IN_DT, SURG_START_DTE, PT_IN_TIME, SURG_START_TIME, SURG_END_TIME, SURG_END_DTE, SSE_PT_OUT_DT, PT_OUT_TIME, SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD, SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC, SSP_SURG_LAST_NM, SSP_SURG_FIRST_NM, SSP_SURG_SVC_CD FROM INIT JOIN SURG ON PT_MRN = SSE_MRN ;

prompt: to identify what patients have an implanted mediport device that received peripheral draws
completion: WITH CHEMO AS (SELECT CL_PATIENT.CL_MRN, CL_PATIENT.CL_LAST_NAME, CL_PATIENT.CL_FIRST_NAME, CL_RESOURCE.CRE_RES_NAME, CL_DEPT.CLD_DEPT_NAME, CL_VISIT_TYPE.CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME, CL_PT_ENCOUNTER.CPE_APPT_DT, CL_PT_ENCOUNTER.CPE_CPE_APPT_STS, CL_PT_ENCOUNTER.CPE_ENC_DTE, CL_CHEMO.CCH_CHEMO_NAME, CL_PT_CHEMO.CPC_CHEMO_ID FROM (((((IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER CL_PT_ENCOUNTER INNER JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT CL_DEPT ON CL_PT_ENCOUNTER.CPE_DEPT_ID=CL_DEPT.CLD_DEPT_ID) INNER JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CL_PT_ENCOUNTER.CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID=CL_VISIT_TYPE.CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID) INNER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE CL_RESOURCE ON CL_PT_ENCOUNTER.CPE_VST_RES_ID=CL_RESOURCE.CRE_RES_ID) INNER JOIN IDB.CL_PATIENT CL_PATIENT ON CL_PT_ENCOUNTER.CPE_PRK=CL_PATIENT.CL_PRK) INNER JOIN IDB.CL_PT_CHEMO CL_PT_CHEMO ON (CL_PT_ENCOUNTER.CPE_MRN=CL_PT_CHEMO.CPC_MRN) AND (CL_PT_ENCOUNTER.CPE_ENC_DTE_SEQ=CL_PT_CHEMO.CPC_ENC_DTE_SEQ)) INNER JOIN IDB.CL_CHEMO CL_CHEMO ON CL_PT_CHEMO.CPC_CHEMO_ID=CL_CHEMO.CCH_CHEMO_ID WHERE CL_PT_ENCOUNTER.CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN '2018-04-01' AND '2018-06-30' AND (CL_PT_ENCOUNTER.CPE_CPE_APPT_STS='Arrived' OR CL_PT_ENCOUNTER.CPE_CPE_APPT_STS='Comp') AND CL_DEPT.CLD_DEPT_NAME like '%53%' ) , ETO AS (SELECT PL_LOCATION_NAME , PR_MRN, PR_ACCESSION_NO , PTC_TEST_NAME, PR_TEST_COLLECTION_TYPE , PR_COLLECTION_DT, PR_COLLECTION_DTE, PR_PT_ENCOUNTER_TYPE FROM CHEMO JOIN IDB.PHLEBOTOMY_RECORDS ON CL_MRN = PR_MRN AND CPE_ENC_DTE = PR_COLLECTION_DTE JOIN IDB.PHLEBOTOMY_LOCATIONS ON PR_LOCATION_CODE = PL_LOCATION_CODE JOIN IDB.PHLEBOTOMY_TEST_CODES ON PR_TEST_CODE = PTC_TEST_NAME WHERE PR_COLLECTION_DTE BETWEEN '2018-04-01' AND '2018-06-30' AND PR_LOCATION_CODE LIKE '%53%' ) , MEDIPORT AS (SELECT CDD_DOC_GUID, CDD_DOC_NAME, CDD_SERVICE_DT, CDD_SERVICE_DTE, CDO_MRN, CDO_ITEM_NAME, CDO_VALUE_TEXT , ROW_NUMBER () OVER (PARTITION BY CDO_MRN, PR_COLLECTION_DTE ORDER BY ABS(DAYS(PR_COLLECTION_DTE) - DAYS(CDD_SERVICE_DTE)) ASC) RN FROM ETO JOIN IDB.CD_DOCUMENT ON PR_MRN = CDD_MRN AND CDD_SERVICE_DTE BETWEEN PR_COLLECTION_DTE - 3 DAY AND PR_COLLECTION_DTE JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION ON CDD_DOC_GUID = CDO_DOC_GUID AND UPPER(CDO_ITEM_NAME) LIKE '%CVAD%PRESENT%') SELECT DISTINCT CL_MRN MRN, STRIP(CL_LAST_NAME)||', '||STRIP(CL_FIRST_NAME) PT_NAME, CRE_RES_NAME VST_RESOURCE, CLD_DEPT_NAME DEPT_NAME, CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME VISIT_TYPE, CPE_CPE_APPT_STS APPT_STS, CPE_ENC_DTE VISIT_DTE , PR_ACCESSION_NO ACCESSION_NO, PTC_TEST_NAME TEST_NAME, PR_TEST_COLLECTION_TYPE COLLECTION_TYPE , PR_COLLECTION_DTE COLLECTION_DTE, CDD_DOC_NAME DOC_NAME , CDD_SERVICE_DTE SERVICE_DTE, CDO_ITEM_NAME ITEM_NAME, CASE WHEN CDO_VALUE_TEXT IS NULL THEN 'UNKNOWN' ELSE SUBSTR(CDO_VALUE_TEXT, 1, 5) END CVAD_IND FROM CHEMO LEFT OUTER JOIN ETO ON CL_MRN = PR_MRN AND CPE_ENC_DTE = PR_COLLECTION_DTE LEFT OUTER JOIN MEDIPORT ON PR_MRN = CDO_MRN AND CDD_SERVICE_DTE = PR_COLLECTION_DTE AND RN = 1

prompt: Pathology diagnosis search
completion: WITH PTS AS (SELECT DISTINCT PRPT_MRN MRN FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V WHERE PRPT_REPORT IS NOT NULL AND CONTAINS(PRPT_REPORT, '("adenomyoepithelioma")') = 1 ) SELECT TM_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, AV_DESC AS CASE_STS, TM_DX_DTE, TM_HIST_CD, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS HIST_DESC, TM_SITE_CD, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_DESC FROM PTS JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PT_MRN = MRN JOIN IDB.CDB_TUMOR ON MRN = TM_MRN JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS ON AV_ELEMENT = 'CASE_STS' AND AV_CODE = TM_CASE_STS AND TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') ; SELECT PRPT_MRN MRN, PRPT_ACCESSION_NO, PRPT_REPORT FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V WHERE PRPT_REPORT IS NOT NULL AND CONTAINS(PRPT_REPORT, '("adenomyoepithelioma")') = 1 ;

prompt: Provide the number of KD8 docs Seeta Verron has completed April 1, 2020-present.
completion: SELECT EAD_MRN MRN, PT_LAST_NAME LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME FIRST_NAME, EAD_DOCUMENT_DTE DOCUMENT_DATE, DOC_NAME PROVIDER, EAD_DOCTYPE DOCTYPE, EADT_EMR_DESC DOCUMENT_DESC FROM IDB.EMR_AA_DOCUMENT JOIN IDB.EMR_AA_DOCTYPE ON EAD_DOCTYPE = EADT_DOCTYPE JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON EAD_MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.DOC ON EAD_DOCTOR_NUM = DOC_DR_NO WHERE VALUE(EAD_RIGHT_ID, EADT_RIGHT_ID) = 167 AND EAD_DOCTYPE = 'KD8' AND EAD_DOCUMENT_DTE BETWEEN '2020-04-01' AND CURRENT date AND DOC_NAME = 'VERRON NP,SEETA V'

prompt: Identify patients with meningioma and spectroscopy.
completion: WITH CDB AS (SELECT TM_MRN, MIN(TM_DX_DTE) MIN_CDB_DX_DTE FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('3', '6', '7', '8') AND TM_HIST_CD IN ('M9530/0', 'M9530/1', 'M9530/3', 'M9530/6', 'M9531/0', 'M9532/0', 'M9533/0', 'M9534/0', 'M9535/0', 'M9536/0', 'M9537/0', 'M9538/1', 'M9538/3', 'M9539/1', 'M9539/3', 'M9539/6') AND TM_DX_DTE BETWEEN '1997-01-01' AND '2010-12-31' GROUP BY TM_MRN), ICD9 AS (SELECT CC_MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS MIN_ICD9_DTE FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF WHERE CC_CLSF_TYPE like 'DF%' AND CC_CLSF_CD IN ('225.2', '192.1', '237.6', '349.2') AND CC_EFF_DTE BETWEEN '1997-01-01' AND '2010-12-31' GROUP BY CC_MRN), COMBINED AS (SELECT COALESCE(TM_MRN, CC_MRN) AS MRN, COALESCE(MIN(MIN_CDB_DX_DTE, MIN_ICD9_DTE), MIN_CDB_DX_DTE, MIN_ICD9_DTE) AS MIN_DX_DTE FROM CDB FULL JOIN ICD9 ON TM_MRN = CC_MRN), CPT1 AS (SELECT DISTINCT PBD_MRN AS CPT1_MRN, MIN_DX_DTE, PBD_SVC_DTE AS CPT1_DTE FROM COMBINED JOIN IDB.PBD_DTL ON MRN = PBD_MRN JOIN IDB.PBD_CODE ON PBD_PBD_CD = PBC_PBD_CD WHERE PBC_CPT_CD IN ('70552', '70553')), CPT2 AS (SELECT PBD_MRN, MIN_DX_DTE, PBD_SVC_DTE AS CPT_DTE FROM CPT1 JOIN IDB.PBD_DTL ON CPT1_MRN = PBD_MRN AND CPT1_DTE = PBD_SVC_DTE JOIN IDB.PBD_CODE ON PBD_PBD_CD = PBC_PBD_CD WHERE PBC_CPT_CD = '76390') SELECT PT_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_SEX, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, PT_DATE_OF_DEATH, PLA_LST_APPT_DTE, MIN_DX_DTE, CPT_DTE FROM CPT2 JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PBD_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY ON PBD_MRN = PLA_MRN

prompt: We need a weekly report to screen for patients that meet eligibility criteria for this study.
completion: WITH VISIT AS (SELECT CPE_MRN AS MRN, CPE_ENC_DTE "VISIT DATE", CRE_RES_NAME "PHYSICIAN", CRE_RES_TYP FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 = 'NEU' JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS = ('Sch') AND CRE_RES_TYP = ('Physician') AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT DATE AND CURRENT DATE + 14 DAYS ), DX AS (SELECT DISTINCT CC_MRN MRN , MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) OVER (PARTITION BY CC_MRN, CC_CLSF_CD) DX_DTE , CC_CLSF_CD DX_CD , PT_FIRST_NAME "FIRST NAME" , PT_LAST_NAME "LAST NAME" , YEAR(CURRENT DATE) - YEAR(PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) "AGE" FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN VISIT V ON CC_MRN = V.MRN JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PT_MRN = CC_MRN WHERE CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND (CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) ), PATH AS (SELECT DISTINCT "t1"."PT_MRN" AS "MRN", "t4"."DT_DTE" AS "Pathology Procedure Date", "t5"."DT_DTE" AS "Pathology Report Date", UPPER(CASE WHEN LENGTH(PRPT_REPORT) <= 15000 THEN RTRIM(CAST(SUBSTR(PRPT_REPORT, 1, 15000) AS VARCHAR(15000))) ELSE CAST(SUBSTR(PRPT_REPORT, 1, 15000) AS VARCHAR(15000)) END) AS TXT FROM VISIT V JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V" "t1" ON V.MRN = "t1".PT_MRN LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED" "t6" ON "t1"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t6"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V" "t2" ON "t6"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t2"."PRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATH_RPRT_TYPE_LOOKUP" "t3" ON "t2"."PRPT_REPORT_TYPE" = "t3"."PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_CD" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" "t4" ON "t2"."PRPT_PROCEDURE_DATE_ID" = "t4"."DT_DATE_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" "t5" ON "t2"."PRPT_REPORT_DATE_ID" = "t5"."DT_DATE_ID" WHERE 1=1 AND "t2"."PRPT_REPORT" IS NOT NULL AND CONTAINS("t2"."PRPT_REPORT", '(("CSF" OR "cerebrospinal fluid") AND ("positive" OR "abnormal" OR "atypical" OR "suspicious"))') = 1 AND UPPER("t3"."PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_DESC") like '%CYTOLOGY%' ) ,CT AS (SELECT DISTINCT LR_MRN, LR_RESULT_VALUE, CASE WHEN TRIM(LR_RESULT_VALUE) like '>%' THEN CAST(STRIP(REPLACE(LR_RESULT_VALUE, '>', '')) AS DECIMAL(5, 1)) WHEN TRIM(LR_RESULT_VALUE) like '<%' THEN 0 ELSE CAST(STRIP(LR_RESULT_VALUE) AS DECIMAL(5, 1)) END AS LAB_RESULT, LR_RESULT_VALUE_CODE FROM IDB.LAB_RESULTS JOIN VISIT V ON LR_MRN = V.MRN WHERE (UPPER(LR_SUBTEST_NAME) LIKE '%CIRCULATING TUMOR CELLS%' OR UPPER(LR_SUBTEST_NAME) like '%CTC%') AND LR_RESULT_VALUE NOT IN ('See Comment', 'QNS', 'Propos', 'Proneg', 'CTCMF', 'CTCFR', 'cancel', '! CTCMF', '!CTCLK', '!CTCMK', '') AND REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(TRIM(LR_RESULT_VALUE), '>=', ''), '>', ''), '<=', ''), '<', '') NOT IN ('0.00', '0', '1', '2') ) SELECT DISTINCT DX.MRN , "FIRST NAME" , "LAST NAME" , "AGE" , "VISIT DATE" , "PHYSICIAN" , CASE WHEN PATH.TXT <> '' THEN 'YES' ELSE 'NO' END AS "CSF (Y/N)" , PATH.TXT "PATHOLOGY REPORT TEXT (CSF)" , CASE WHEN CT.LAB_RESULT IS NOT NULL THEN 'YES' ELSE 'NO' END AS "CTC (Y/N)" , CT.LAB_RESULT "CTC RESULT" FROM DX JOIN VISIT V ON DX.MRN = V.MRN LEFT JOIN PATH ON V.MRN = PATH.MRN LEFT JOIN CT ON V.MRN = CT.LR_MRN

prompt: Provide a list of patients diagnosed with standard plasmacytoma treated with radiation at MSK.
completion: WITH DX AS (SELECT TM_MRN AS MRN, TM_DX_DTE AS DX_DATE, TM_HIST_CD AS DX_CODE, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS DX_DESC, TM_SITE_CD AS SITE_CODE, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_DESC FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM H ON TM_HIST_CD = H.CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON TM_SITE_CD = S.CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND TM_HIST_CD IN ('M9731/3', 'M9734/3') AND TM_DX_DTE BETWEEN '2000-01-01' AND CURRENT DATE UNION SELECT CC_MRN AS MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS DX_DATE, CLM_CLSF_CD AS DX_CODE, CLM_CLSF_DESC AS DX_DESC, '' AS SITE_CODE, '' AS SITE_DESC FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND ((CC_PT_TYPE = 'I') OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) AND CC_CLSF_CD IN ('238.6', 'C90.2', 'C90.20', 'C90.21', 'C90.22', 'C90.3', 'C90.30', 'C90.31', 'C90.32') GROUP BY CC_MRN, CLM_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC, '', '' HAVING MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) BETWEEN '2000-01-01' AND CURRENT DATE) , CTE AS (SELECT MRN AS DX_MRN, DX_DATE, STRIP(DX_CODE) || '-' || STRIP(DX_DESC) || ' | ' || STRIP(SITE_CODE) || '-' || STRIP(SITE_DESC) AS DX_CODE FROM DX) , CTE2 AS (SELECT * FROM CTE ORDER BY DX_MRN, DX_DATE, DX_CODE) , T1 AS (SELECT DX_MRN, DX_DATE, DX_CODE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY DX_MRN ORDER BY DX_DATE) AS RN FROM CTE2 ORDER BY DX_MRN, DX_DATE) , T2 (MRN, DX, RN1) AS (SELECT DX_MRN, CAST(DX_DATE AS VARCHAR(6000))||' | '||CAST(DX_CODE AS VARCHAR(100)), RN FROM T1 WHERE T1.RN = 1 UNION ALL SELECT DX_MRN, RTRIM(CAST(DX AS VARCHAR(4000))) || ', ' || CHR(13) || CHR(10) || CAST(DX_DATE AS VARCHAR(100))||' | '||RTRIM(CAST(DX_CODE AS VARCHAR(100))) , RN1 + 1 FROM T1, T2 WHERE DX_MRN = MRN AND RN = RN1+1 ) , T3 AS (SELECT MRN, MAX(RN1) RN FROM T2 GROUP BY MRN) , T4 AS (SELECT T2.MRN, RN, DX FROM T2 JOIN T3 ON T2.MRN = T3.MRN AND T2.RN1 = T3.RN) , RT AS (SELECT DISTINCT RTC_TX_MRN, RTC_TX_PLAN_NAME, RTC_PRIMARY_REF_POINT, RTC_TX_START_DTE, RTC_TX_STOP_DTE, RTC_TX_ELAPSED_DAYS, RTC_TX_PLANNED_FRACTIONS, RTC_TX_DELIVERED_FRACTIONS, RTC_TX_PLANNED_DOSE, RTC_TX_DELIVERED_DOSE, RTC_DOSE_CORRECTION FROM IDB.RADONC_TREATMENT_COURSE JOIN T4 ON MRN = RTC_TX_MRN) , PL AS (SELECT MRN, STRIP(PT_LAST_NAME) || ', ' || STRIP(PT_FIRST_NAME) AS NAME, PT_SEX AS GENDER, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH AS DOB, PT_DATE_OF_DEATH AS DOD, DX, RTC_TX_PLAN_NAME, RTC_PRIMARY_REF_POINT, RTC_TX_START_DTE, RTC_TX_STOP_DTE, RTC_TX_ELAPSED_DAYS, RTC_TX_PLANNED_FRACTIONS, RTC_TX_DELIVERED_FRACTIONS, RTC_TX_PLANNED_DOSE, RTC_TX_DELIVERED_DOSE, RTC_DOSE_CORRECTION FROM T4 JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON MRN = PT_MRN JOIN RT ON MRN = RTC_TX_MRN) , CHEMO AS (SELECT APR_MRN, CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME, MIN(APR_START_DTE) AS START_DATE, MAX(APR_END_DTE) AS END_DATE FROM IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX_V JOIN PL ON MRN = APR_MRN WHERE CDG_CHEMO_FLAG = 'Y' GROUP BY APR_MRN, CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME ) SELECT * FROM CHEMO

prompt: MRN of patients with Stage IV, metastatic and unresectable solid tumors seen by the outpatient supportive care team as a new visit in 2020,
completion: WITH NV AS (SELECT MRN FROM (SELECT CPE_MRN MRN, CPE_ENC_DTE , MONTHS_BETWEEN (CPE_ENC_DTE, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH)/12 AS "AGE_ASON_APPT" FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PT_MRN = CPE_MRN WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 IN ('SUP' ) AND CVT_IN_OUT_PT = 'Outpatient' AND CPE_MRN <> '' AND (CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME LIKE '%NV%' OR CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME LIKE '%IR%' OR CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME LIKE '%NEW%') AND YEAR(CPE_ENC_DTE) = '2020' ) WHERE AGE_ASON_APPT >= 18 ) , TUMOR AS (SELECT TM_MRN MRN, 'Stage4 -Non-Lympoma,Non-Leukemi, Non-Myeloma' AS CATEG_NAME FROM (SELECT TM_MRN, RECODE, CASE WHEN TM_AJCC_7 NOT IN ('', '888', '999') THEN AJCC7.AV_DESC WHEN TM_AJCC NOT IN ('', '88', '99') THEN AJCC.AV_DESC WHEN TM_GENERAL_STG NOT IN ('', '9') THEN GS.AV_DESC WHEN TM_PATH_STG_GRP NOT IN ('', '88', '9', '99') THEN TM_PATH_STG_GRP ELSE CLIN.AV_DESC END AS "STAGE" FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR T JOIN NV A ON TM_MRN = A.MRN JOIN IDB.SEERGROUPING SG ON IDB.SEERF_ICDO(TM_SITE_CD, TM_HIST_CD) = SG.RECODE JOIN IDB.CLM H ON TM_HIST_CD = H.CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON TM_SITE_CD = S.CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.CL_PAS_PATIENT ON TM_MRN = CPP_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS CS ON CS.AV_ELEMENT = 'CASE_STS' AND CS.AV_CODE = TM_CASE_STS LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS AJCC7 ON AJCC7.AV_ELEMENT = 'AJCC_7' AND AJCC7.AV_CODE = TM_AJCC_7 LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS AJCC ON AJCC.AV_ELEMENT = 'AJCC' AND AJCC.AV_CODE = TM_AJCC LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS GS ON GS.AV_ELEMENT = 'GENERAL_STG' AND GS.AV_CODE = TM_GENERAL_STG LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS CLIN ON CLIN.AV_ELEMENT = 'CLIN_STG_DSCR' AND CLIN.AV_CODE = TM_CLIN_STG_DSCR WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND (RECODE NOT IN ('33042', '34000', '35011') AND RECODE < '37000') ) WHERE STAGE LIKE 'IV%' OR STAGE LIKE '4%' ) , PANC AS (SELECT TM_MRN MRN, 'PANCREATIC CANCER ALL STAGES' AS CATEG_NAME FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN NV ON MRN = TM_MRN WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND TM_SITE_CD LIKE 'C259%' ) , LUNG AS (SELECT TM_MRN MRN, 'LUNG CANCER STAGES 3 AND 4' AS CATEG_NAME FROM (SELECT TM_MRN , CASE WHEN TM_AJCC_7 NOT IN ('', '888', '999') THEN AJCC7.AV_DESC WHEN TM_AJCC NOT IN ('', '88', '99') THEN AJCC.AV_DESC WHEN TM_GENERAL_STG NOT IN ('', '9') THEN GS.AV_DESC WHEN TM_PATH_STG_GRP NOT IN ('', '88', '9', '99') THEN TM_PATH_STG_GRP ELSE CLIN.AV_DESC END AS "STAGE" FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR T JOIN NV A ON TM_MRN = A.MRN JOIN IDB.SEERGROUPING SG ON IDB.SEERF_ICDO(TM_SITE_CD, TM_HIST_CD) = RECODE AND CATEGORY2 = 'Lung and Bronchus' AND CATEGORY1 = 'Respiratory System' JOIN IDB.CLM H ON TM_HIST_CD = H.CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON TM_SITE_CD = S.CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.CL_PAS_PATIENT ON TM_MRN = CPP_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS CS ON CS.AV_ELEMENT = 'CASE_STS' AND CS.AV_CODE = TM_CASE_STS LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS AJCC7 ON AJCC7.AV_ELEMENT = 'AJCC_7' AND AJCC7.AV_CODE = TM_AJCC_7 LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS AJCC ON AJCC.AV_ELEMENT = 'AJCC' AND AJCC.AV_CODE = TM_AJCC LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS GS ON GS.AV_ELEMENT = 'GENERAL_STG' AND GS.AV_CODE = TM_GENERAL_STG LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS CLIN ON CLIN.AV_ELEMENT = 'CLIN_STG_DSCR' AND CLIN.AV_CODE = TM_CLIN_STG_DSCR WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') ) WHERE STAGE LIKE 'III%' OR STAGE LIKE 'IV%' OR STAGE LIKE '3%' OR STAGE LIKE '4%' ) , BILL AS (SELECT PBD_MRN MRN, 'Billed for Metastatic Disease' AS CATEG_NAME FROM IDB.PBD_DTL JOIN IDB.PBD_CODE ON PBD_PBD_CD = PBC_PBD_CD JOIN IDB.CLM ON PBC_CPT_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN NV ON NV.MRN = PBD_MRN WHERE (CLM_CLSF_CD >= '196' AND CLM_CLSF_CD <= '199') OR (CLM_CLSF_CD >= 'C77' AND CLM_CLSF_CD <= 'C79') ) SELECT MRN, CATEG_NAME FROM TUMOR UNION SELECT MRN, CATEG_NAME FROM PANC UNION SELECT MRN, CATEG_NAME FROM LUNG UNION SELECT MRN, CATEG_NAME FROM BILL

prompt: Provide a monthly YTD report of inpatients transferred or discharged to an extended NYS skilled nursing facility, transferred to a short-term inpatient care hospital or transferred to a rehabilitation center.

'||SUBSTR(STRIP(DD.AV_DESC), 1, 63) DC_DISP , COALESCE(A.OUO_ORD_NAME, SUBSTR(STRIP(B.OUO_ORD_NAME)||': ' ||OUD_USER_DI_VALUE, 1, 125)) AS ORD_NAME , COALESCE(A.OUO_ENTER_DTE, B.OUO_ENTER_DTE) ENTER_DATE , STRIP(COALESCE(A.OUO_ORD_STS_CD, B.OUO_ORD_STS_CD)) ||'-'||STRIP(COALESCE(A.OUO_STS_DESC, B.OUO_STS_DESC)) ORD_STS , UO.OO_SUMMARY_LINE ORDSUMMARY, UO.OO_SIGNIFICANT_DT, UO.OO_REQUESTED_DT, UO.OO_STOP_DT , SUBSTR(CHAR(CS_DSCH_DATE), 1, 7) RPT_MONTH , SUBSTR(CHAR(CS_DSCH_DATE), 1, 7) RPT_MONTH , CASE WHEN OHI_HI_DESCRIPTION IS NOT NULL THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END ISOL_IND , OHI_HI_DESCRIPTION ISOL_REASON FROM IDB.CASE JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON CS_MRN = PT_MRN AND CS_MRN BETWEEN '00000000' AND '99999999' AND CS_MRN = '35241546' AND CS_DSCH_DATE >= CASE WHEN MONTH(CURRENT DATE) = 1 THEN DATE(STRIP(CHAR(YEAR(CURRENT_DATE) - prompt: All new visit see at the dermatology cutaneous lymphoma visit since 2013 and their pathology reports.
completion: WITH APPT AS (SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CRE_RES_ID IN ('000612', '007815', '016659', '019927', '024380', '427412', '029900') AND CRE_RES_TYP IN ('Physician') AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN '2013-01-01' AND '2023-01-19' ) , PTS AS (SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN AS MRN , PT_SEX AS "Sex Assigned at Birth" , PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH AS "Date of Birth" , YEAR (CURRENT DATE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) AS "Current Age" , TRIM(R.AV_DESC) AS "Race" , TRIM(E.AV_DESC) AS "Ethnicity" , INS1.INS_PLAN_DESC INS1_DESC , INS2.INS_PLAN_DESC INS2_DESC , INS3.INS_PLAN_DESC INS3_DESC , ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY PT_MRN ORDER BY INS1.INS_PLAN_DESC) RN FROM APPT JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PT_MRN = CPE_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS R ON R.AV_ELEMENT = 'RACE' AND R.AV_CODE = PT_RACE LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS E ON E.AV_ELEMENT = 'PT_ETHNICITY' AND E.AV_CODE = PT_PT_ETHNICITY LEFT JOIN IDB.INSURANCE INS1 ON INS1.INS_MRN = PT_MRN AND INS1.INS_PLAN_PRIO = '1' AND INS1.INS_VERIFY_IND = 'Y' LEFT JOIN IDB.INSURANCE INS2 ON INS2.INS_MRN = PT_MRN AND INS2.INS_PLAN_PRIO = '2' AND INS2.INS_VERIFY_IND = 'Y' LEFT JOIN IDB.INSURANCE INS3 ON INS3.INS_MRN = PT_MRN AND INS3.INS_PLAN_PRIO = '3' AND INS3.INS_VERIFY_IND = 'Y') SELECT * FROM PTS WHERE RN =1 ;

prompt: Provide a list of patients diagnosed with indolent lymphoma and received radiation therapy to the eye(s), from 1980 - 2020, to the left, right or bilateral orbit(s) using very low dose radiation (400cGY in one or two fractions).
completion: WITH LYM AS (SELECT DISTINCT "t1"."PT_MRN" AS "MRN", "t4"."DT_DTE" AS DX_DATE, '' AS SITE_CODE, '' AS SITE_DESC, '' AS DX_CODE, '' AS DX_DESC FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V" "t1" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED" "t5" ON "t1"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t5"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V" "t2" ON "t5"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t2"."PRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" "t3" ON "t2"."PRPT_REPORT_DATE_ID" = "t3"."DT_DATE_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" "t4" ON "t2"."PRPT_PROCEDURE_DATE_ID" = "t4"."DT_DATE_ID" WHERE CONTAINS("t2"."PRPT_REPORT", '("marginal zone lymphoma" | "MZL" | "Follicular lymphoma" | "indolent lymphoma")') = 1 AND "t4"."DT_DTE" BETWEEN '1980-1-1' AND '2020-12-31' AND CONTAINS("t2"."PRPT_REPORT", '("eye" | "orbit")') = 1 UNION SELECT DISTINCT TM_MRN AS MRN, TM_DX_DTE AS DX_DATE, TM_SITE_CD AS SITE_CODE, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_DESC, TM_HIST_CD AS DX_CODE, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS DX_DESC FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD WHERE 1=1 AND TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND TM_DX_DTE BETWEEN '1980-01-01' AND '2020-12-31' AND TM_HIST_CD IN ('M9689/3', 'M9699/3', 'M9710/3', 'M9711/3', 'M9715/3', 'M9595/3', 'M9597/3', 'M9690/3', 'M9691/3', 'M9695/3', 'M9698/3') AND(S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK LIKE '%EYE%' OR S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK LIKE '%ORBIT%') UNION SELECT CC_MRN AS MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS DX_DATE, '' AS SITE_CODE, '' AS SITE_DESC, CLM_CLSF_CD AS DX_CODE, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS DX_DESC FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND ((CC_PT_TYPE = 'I') OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) AND(CC_CLSF_CD IN ('200.30', '200.31', 'C88.4', '202.01', 'C82.01', 'C82.09', 'C82.11', 'C82.19', 'C82.21', 'C82.29', 'C82.31', 'C82.39', 'C82.41', 'C82.49', 'C82.51', 'C82.59', 'C82.61', 'C82.69', 'C82.81', 'C82.89', 'C82.91', 'C82.99')) GROUP BY CC_MRN, '', '', CLM_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK HAVING MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) BETWEEN '1980-01-01' AND '2020-12-31') , CTE AS (SELECT MRN AS DX_MRN, DX_DATE, STRIP(DX_CODE) || '-' || STRIP(DX_DESC) || ' | ' || STRIP(SITE_CODE) || '-' || STRIP(SITE_DESC) AS DX_CODE FROM LYM) , CTE2 AS (SELECT * FROM CTE ORDER BY DX_MRN, DX_DATE, DX_CODE) , T1 AS (SELECT DX_MRN, DX_DATE, DX_CODE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY DX_MRN ORDER BY DX_DATE) AS RN FROM CTE2 ORDER BY DX_MRN, DX_DATE) , T2 (MRN, DX, RN1) AS (SELECT DX_MRN, CAST(DX_DATE AS VARCHAR(6000))||' | '||CAST(DX_CODE AS VARCHAR(100)), RN FROM T1 WHERE T1.RN = 1 UNION ALL SELECT DX_MRN, RTRIM(CAST(DX AS VARCHAR(4000))) || ', ' || CHR(13) || CHR(10) || CAST(DX_DATE AS VARCHAR(100))||' | '||RTRIM(CAST(DX_CODE AS VARCHAR(100))) , RN1 + 1 FROM T1, T2 WHERE DX_MRN = MRN AND RN = RN1+1 ) , T3 AS (SELECT MRN, MAX(RN1) RN FROM T2 GROUP BY MRN) , T4 AS (SELECT T2.MRN, RN, DX FROM T2 JOIN T3 ON T2.MRN = T3.MRN AND T2.RN1 = T3.RN) , T5 AS (SELECT MRN, STRIP(PT_LAST_NAME) || ', ' || STRIP(PT_FIRST_NAME) AS NAME, R.AV_DESC AS "Race", E.AV_DESC AS "Ethnicity", PT_SEX AS GENDER, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH AS DOB, PT_DATE_OF_DEATH AS DOD, DX FROM T4 JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS R ON PT_RACE = R.AV_CODE AND R.AV_ELEMENT = 'RACE' LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS E ON PT_PT_ETHNICITY = E.AV_CODE AND E.AV_ELEMENT = 'PT_ETHNICITY') , RT AS (SELECT DISTINCT RTC_TX_MRN, RTC_TX_PLAN_NAME, RTC_PRIMARY_REF_POINT, RTC_TX_START_DTE, RTC_TX_STOP_DTE, RTC_TX_ELAPSED_DAYS, RTC_TX_PLANNED_FRACTIONS, RTC_TX_DELIVERED_FRACTIONS, RTC_TX_PLANNED_DOSE, RTC_TX_DELIVERED_DOSE, RTC_DOSE_CORRECTION FROM T5 JOIN IDB.RADONC_TREATMENT_COURSE ON RTC_TX_MRN = MRN WHERE(RTC_TX_PLAN_NAME LIKE '%EYE%' OR RTC_TX_PLAN_NAME LIKE '%ORBIT%' OR RTC_PRIMARY_REF_POINT LIKE '%EYE%' OR RTC_PRIMARY_REF_POINT LIKE '%ORBIT%') AND RTC_TX_START_DTE BETWEEN '1980-01-01' AND '2020-12-31') , RT1 AS (SELECT T5.*, RTC_TX_PLAN_NAME, RTC_PRIMARY_REF_POINT, RTC_TX_START_DTE, RTC_TX_STOP_DTE, RTC_TX_ELAPSED_DAYS, RTC_TX_PLANNED_FRACTIONS, RTC_TX_DELIVERED_FRACTIONS, RTC_TX_PLANNED_DOSE, RTC_TX_DELIVERED_DOSE, RTC_DOSE_CORRECTION FROM T5 JOIN RT ON RTC_TX_MRN = MRN) , RT2 AS (SELECT DISTINCT MRN FROM RT1 WHERE RTC_TX_DELIVERED_DOSE = 400 OR RTC_TX_DELIVERED_FRACTIONS IN (1, 2) ) SELECT RT1.* FROM RT1 JOIN RT2 ON RT2.MRN = RT1.MRN

prompt: Count of patients diagnosed with Primary sclerosing cholangitis (PSC)
completion: WITH Q AS (SELECT DISTINCT CDD_MRN AS "MRN", OP_DISPLAY_NAME AS "Provider", CDD_SERVICE_DTE AS "Service Date", CDD_DOC_NAME AS "Document Name", CDO_SECTION AS "Section", CDO_ITEM_NAME AS "Item", CDO_VALUE_TEXT AS "Value", CASE WHEN LOWER(CDO_VALUE_TEXT) LIKE '%primary sclerosing cholangitis%' THEN 'Primary Sclerosing Cholangitis' WHEN CDO_VALUE_TEXT LIKE '%to PSC%' THEN 'to PSC' WHEN CDO_VALUE_TEXT LIKE '%in PSC%' THEN 'in PSC' WHEN CDO_VALUE_TEXT LIKE '% PSC %' THEN 'PSC' ELSE NULL END AS "Match Type" FROM IDB.CD_DOCUMENT LEFT JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION ON CDD_DOC_GUID = CDO_DOC_GUID AND CDD_AUTHORED_DTE = CDO_AUTHORED_DTE AND CDO_VALUE_TEXT <> '' JOIN IDB.OMS_PROVIDER ON CDD_AUTH_PROV_GUID = OP_PVDR_GUID WHERE CDD_CANCEL_IND <> '1' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND <> '1' AND CDO_SECTION IN ('PAST MEDICAL HISTORY', 'ONCOLOGY HISTORY', 'History of Present Illness', 'HISTORY OF PRESENT ILLNESS', 'HPI', 'PAST MEDICAL HISTORY', 'PMSH') AND CDO_ITEM_NAME NOT IN ('Patient Location', 'Family History') AND (CDO_VALUE_TEXT LIKE '% PSC %' OR LOWER(CDO_VALUE_TEXT) LIKE '%primary sclerosing cholangitis%') ) SELECT DISTINCT DENSE_RANK() OVER ( ORDER BY "MRN") AS "Patient Count", "MRN", "Service Date", "Document Name", "Section", "Item", "Value", "Match Type", DX.CC_CLSF_CD AS "ICD Code" FROM Q FULL OUTER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT CC_MRN, CC_CLSF_CD FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE CC_CLSF_CD IN ('K83.01') AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND (CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) GROUP BY CC_MRN, CC_CLSF_CD ) DX ON Q.MRN = DX.CC_MRN WHERE "Match Type" NOT IN ('to PSC', 'in PSC') ;

prompt: Provide a list of patients who had total body photography since 4/1/2016 for all MSK sites.
completion: SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN AS "MRN", PT_LAST_NAME "First Name", PT_FIRST_NAME "Last Name", CPE_ENC_DTE AS "Appt Date", CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 AS "Department", CLD_DEPT_NAME AS "Department Name", CRE_RES_NAME AS "Provider Name", CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME AS "Visit Type", CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR , CLD_CLD_CENTER, CLD_CLD_PHY_LOC FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON CPE_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CPE_ENC_DTE >= '2016-04-01' AND CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME IN ('AD HOC TOTAL BODY', 'DERM TOTAL BODY', 'DERM53 PHOTO FR VISIT', 'DERM53 PHOTO FX VISIT') AND CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME NOT IN ('DERM 3D PHOTO', 'DERM PDT' ) ORDER BY CPE_MRN, CPE_ENC_DTE

prompt: Identify patients diagnosed with melanoma and brain or leptomeningeal metastases who received whole brain radiation therapy.
completion: WITH CTE AS (SELECT CC_MRN AS MRN FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF INNER JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND ((CC_PT_TYPE = 'I') OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) AND CC_CLSF_CD IN ('172', '172.0', '172.1', '172.2', '172.3', '172.4', '172.5', '172.6', '172.7', '172.8', '172.9') UNION SELECT TM_MRN AS MRN FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR INNER JOIN IDB.CLM H ON TM_HIST_CD = H.CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('3', '6', '7', '8') AND TM_HIST_CD IN ('M8720/2', 'M8720/3', 'M8720/6', 'M8721/3', 'M8721/6', 'M8722/2', 'M8722/3', 'M8723/2', 'M8723/3', 'M8728/3', 'M8730/3', 'M8730/6', 'M8740/3', 'M8741/3', 'M8742/3', 'M8743/2', 'M8743/3', 'M8744/2', 'M8744/3', 'M8745/3', 'M8746/3', 'M8761/3', 'M8770/3', 'M8771/3', 'M8772/2', 'M8772/3', 'M8773/3', 'M8774/3', 'M8775/3') ) SELECT CC_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF INNER JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD INNER JOIN CTE ON CC_MRN = MRN INNER JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON CC_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND ((CC_PT_TYPE = 'I') OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) AND CC_CLSF_CD IN ('198.3', '198.4') GROUP BY CC_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME

prompt: Weekly report for all deceased patients still have active orders.
completion: SELECT "Pharmacy_Order_Start_Date"."Start_Date", CURRENT DATE, "Patient_Demographics"."MRN", RTRIM("Patient_Demographics"."Last_Name") || ', ' || RTRIM("Patient_Demographics"."First_Name"), "Pharmacy_Order_Detail"."Item_Desc", "Pharmacy_Order_Detail"."Dose", "Pharmacy_Order_Detail"."Dose_Unit", "Pharmacy_Order_Attribute"."OP_Order_Location_Name", "Pharmacy_Order_MedPro"."MedPro_Name", "Pharmacy_Order_Detail"."Rx_No", "Patient_Demographics"."Deceased_Date", "Pharmacy_Order_Stop_Date"."Stop_Date" FROM (SELECT "PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" "Deident_PT__", "PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_MRN" "MRN", "PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_LAST_NAME" "Last_Name", "PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_FIRST_NAME" "First_Name", "PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_DEATH_DTE" "Deceased_Date" FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V" "PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS") "Patient_Demographics" LEFT OUTER JOIN (((((( (SELECT "PHM_INVENTORY_CATALOG"."PINC_INVENTORY_CTLG_ID" "Inventory_Id", CASE WHEN UCASE("PHM_INVENTORY_CATALOG"."PINC_ATTR_FLAG") like '%IVVEH%' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END "Base_Solution_Ind" FROM "DV"."PHM_INVENTORY_CATALOG" "PHM_INVENTORY_CATALOG") "Pharmacy_Inventory_Catalog" INNER JOIN (SELECT "PHM_PT_MEDS_MQT"."POD_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" "Deident_PT__", "PHM_PT_MEDS_MQT"."POD_PHARMA_INVENTORY_CTLG_ID" "Inventory_Id" FROM "DV"."PHM_PT_MEDS_MQT" "PHM_PT_MEDS_MQT") "Pharmacy_Drug_First_Last_Dates" ON "Pharmacy_Inventory_Catalog"."Inventory_Id" = "Pharmacy_Drug_First_Last_Dates"."Inventory_Id") INNER JOIN (SELECT "PHM_ORDER_DTL"."POD_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" "Deident_PT__", "PHM_ORDER_DTL"."POD_PHARMA_INVENTORY_CTLG_ID" "Inventory_Id", "PHM_ORDER_DTL"."POD_ORDERING_PHYSICIAN_ID" "Physician_Id", "PHM_ORDER_DTL"."POD_RX_NO" "Rx_No", "PHM_ORDER_DTL"."POD_ORD_STS" "Order_Status", "PHM_ORDER_DTL"."POD_ITEM_DESC" "Item_Desc", "PHM_ORDER_DTL"."POD_START_DATE_ID" "Start_Date_Id", "PHM_ORDER_DTL"."POD_STOP_DATE_ID" "Stop_Date_Id", "PHM_ORDER_DTL"."POD_PHARMA_ORD_ATTR_ID" "Attribute_Id", "PHM_ORDER_DTL"."POD_DOSE" "Dose", "PHM_ORDER_DTL"."POD_DOSE_UNIT" "Dose_Unit" FROM "DV"."PHM_ORDER_DTL" "PHM_ORDER_DTL") "Pharmacy_Order_Detail" ON "Pharmacy_Order_Detail"."Deident_PT__" = "Pharmacy_Drug_First_Last_Dates"."Deident_PT__" AND "Pharmacy_Order_Detail"."Inventory_Id" = "Pharmacy_Drug_First_Last_Dates"."Inventory_Id") INNER JOIN (SELECT "PHM_ORDER_ATTR"."POA_PHARMA_ORDER_ATTR_ID" "Attribute_Id", LTRIM(RTRIM("PHM_ORDER_ATTR"."POA_DISP_LOC_DTL_NAME")) "OP_Order_Location_Name" FROM "DV"."PHM_ORDER_ATTR" "PHM_ORDER_ATTR") "Pharmacy_Order_Attribute" ON "Pharmacy_Order_Attribute"."Attribute_Id" = "Pharmacy_Order_Detail"."Attribute_Id") INNER JOIN (SELECT "MEDPRO_V"."MP_MEDPRO_ID" "MedPro_ID", "MEDPRO_V"."MP_MEDPRO_IDENT_TYPE" "MedPro_Id_Type", "MEDPRO_V"."MP_SOURCE_PROVIDER_NO" "MedPro_No", "MEDPRO_V"."MP_SERVICE_CD" "MedPro_Service", "MEDPRO_V"."MP_SERVICE_DESC" "MedPro_Service_Desc", "MEDPRO_V"."MP_LICENSE_NO" "MedPro_License_No", "MEDPRO_V"."MP_FULL_NM" "MedPro_Name", "MEDPRO_V"."MP_TITLE" "MedPro_Title", "MEDPRO_V"."MP_WORK_PHONE_NO" "MedPro_Work_Phone_No", "MEDPRO_V"."MP_FAX_NO" "MedPro_Fax_No", "MEDPRO_V"."MP_UPIN_NO" "MedPro_UPIN_No", "MEDPRO_V"."MP_EMAIL_ADDR" "MedPro_Email_Address", "MEDPRO_V"."MP_HOSP_ROLE" "MedPro_Hospital_Role", "MEDPRO_V"."MP_PROVIDER_TYPE_DESC" "MedPro_Provider_Type", "MEDPRO_V"."MP_ACTIVE_STATUS_CD" "MedPro_Active_Status_Code", "MEDPRO_V"."MP_ACADEMIC_DEPT_DESC" "MedPro_Academic_Dept", "MEDPRO_V"."MP_ACADEMIC_SVC_DESC" "MedPro_Academic_Service", "MEDPRO_V"."MP_FIRST_NM" "MedPro_First_Name", "MEDPRO_V"."MP_LAST_NM" "MedPro_Last_Name", "MEDPRO_V"."MP_EXTERNAL_NM" "MedPro_External_Name", "MEDPRO_V"."MP_MEDPRO_ID_NM" "MedPro_No_and_Name" FROM "DV"."MEDPRO_V" "MEDPRO_V") "Pharmacy_Order_MedPro" ON "Pharmacy_Order_MedPro"."MedPro_ID" = "Pharmacy_Order_Detail"."Physician_Id") INNER JOIN (SELECT "DATE_"."DT_DATE_ID" "Start_Date_Id", "DATE_"."DT_DTE" "Start_Date" FROM "DV"."DATE_V" "DATE_") "Pharmacy_Order_Start_Date" ON "Pharmacy_Order_Start_Date"."Start_Date_Id" = "Pharmacy_Order_Detail"."Start_Date_Id") INNER JOIN (SELECT "DATE_"."DT_DATE_ID" "Stop_Date_Id", "DATE_"."DT_DTE" "Stop_Date" FROM "DV"."DATE_V" "DATE_") "Pharmacy_Order_Stop_Date" ON "Pharmacy_Order_Stop_Date"."Stop_Date_Id" = "Pharmacy_Order_Detail"."Stop_Date_Id") ON "Patient_Demographics"."Deident_PT__" = "Pharmacy_Drug_First_Last_Dates"."Deident_PT__" WHERE "Pharmacy_Inventory_Catalog"."Base_Solution_Ind" = 'N' AND NOT "Patient_Demographics"."Deceased_Date" IS NULL AND "Pharmacy_Order_Detail"."Order_Status" = 'A' FOR FETCH ONLY

prompt: Provide a list of patients who were diagnosed with uveal melanoma (choroidal, ciliary body, iris) or conjunctival melanoma.
completion: WITH DMP_DX_PRE AS (SELECT DISTINCT PDRX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID P_ID, T.*, DT.PDRX_PATH_RPT_ID AS R_ID FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML DT CROSS JOIN XMLTABLE('$c/root/*' PASSING DT.PDRX_XML_VALUE AS "c" COLUMNS TUMOR_TYPE_NAME VARCHAR(264) PATH '../meta-data/tumor_type_name' , TUMOR_TYPE_CODE VARCHAR(264) PATH '../meta-data/tumor_type_code') T JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT T.TUMOR_TYPE_CODE TTC FROM TABLE(DV.STRING_SPLIT('OM,HNMUCM', ',')) S CROSS JOIN TABLE(DV.ONCOTREE_CHILDREN(TRIM(COLUMN_VALUES))) T) X ON T.TUMOR_TYPE_CODE = X.TTC) , VARIANTS_TO_OMIT (CNV_TYPE_OMIT) AS ( VALUES ('snp-indel-silent-np'),('snp-indel-silent')) , VARIANT_CLASS_TO_OMIT (VARIANT_CLASS_OMIT) AS ( VALUES ('Unknown'),('UTR3'),('UTR5'),('intronic'),('synonymous_SNV')) , DMP AS (SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN AS DMP_MRN , MAINRPT.DT_DTE AS "Report Date" , PRPT_ACCESSION_NO , PDWS_NAME , MAINPATH.PRPT_ACCESSION_NO AS M_ACCESSION , DV.REGEXSTR('(S|H|C|M|F|B|DMG)[0-9]{2}[\s|-][0-9]*', XMLCAST(XMLQUERY('$x/root/meta-data/part_description' PASSING PDRX_XML_VALUE AS "x") AS VARCHAR(1000))) AS REFERENCEDACCESSION , T.* , PDRX_DMP_SAMPLE_ID AS SAMPLEID, PDRX_DMP_PATIENT_ID AS PATIENTID , DV.TODATE(DT_PROCEDURE) AS "Procedure Date" FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML JOIN DMP_DX_PRE ON R_ID = PDRX_PATH_RPT_ID INNER JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML_SETTINGS ON PDRX_PATH_DMP_RESULTS_XML_ID = PDRXS_PATH_DMP_RESULTS_XML_ID INNER JOIN DVDMC.PATHOLOGY_DMP_WEBSVC_SETTINGS ON PDRXS_SETTING_ID = PDWS_SETTING_ID INNER JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON PDRX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID LEFT JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V MAINPATH ON MAINPATH.PRPT_PATH_RPT_ID = PDRX_PATH_RPT_ID LEFT JOIN DV.DATE_V MAINRPT ON MAINRPT.DT_DATE_ID = MAINPATH.PRPT_REPORT_DATE_ID, XMLTABLE('$c/root/*' PASSING PDRX_XML_VALUE AS "c" COLUMNS TOTAL_NUMBER_VARIANTS int PATH 'count(../*[not(name()=''meta-data'')])', CNV_TYPE VARCHAR(500) PATH 'name()', VARIANT_TYPE VARCHAR(100) PATH './local-name(.)', DT_PROCEDURE VARCHAR(100) PATH '../meta-data/dt_procedure', GENE_PANEL VARCHAR(100) PATH '../meta-data/gene-panel', VARIANT_CLASS VARCHAR(100) PATH 'variant_class', GENE_ID VARCHAR(100) PATH 'gene_id', SITE1_GENE VARCHAR(100) PATH 'site1_gene', SITE2_GENE VARCHAR(100) PATH 'site2_gene', EXON_NUM VARCHAR(100) PATH 'exon_num', AA_CHANGE VARCHAR(100) PATH 'aa_change', NORMAL_VFREQ VARCHAR(100) PATH 'normal_vfreq', MAFREQ_1000G VARCHAR(100) PATH 'mafreq_1000g', CHROMOSOME VARCHAR(100) PATH 'chromosome', CDNA_CHANGE VARCHAR(100) PATH 'cDNA_change', GENE_FOLD_CHANGE VARCHAR(100) PATH 'gene_fold_change', PRIMARY_SITE VARCHAR(100) PATH '../meta-data/primary_site', TUMOR_TYPE_NAME VARCHAR(100) PATH '../meta-data/tumor_type_name', TUMOR_TYPE_CODE VARCHAR(100) PATH '../meta-data/tumor_type_code', METASTASIS_SITE VARCHAR(100) PATH '../meta-data/metastasis_site', MSI_SCORE VARCHAR(255) PATH '../meta-data/msi-score', MSI_TYPE VARCHAR(255) PATH '../meta-data/msi-type', PART_DESCRIPTION VARCHAR(170) PATH '../meta-data/part_description', NORMAL_DP VARCHAR(100) PATH 'normal_dp', TUMOR_DP VARCHAR(100) PATH 'tumor_dp', NORMAL_AD VARCHAR(100) PATH 'normal_ad', TUMOR_AD VARCHAR(100) PATH 'tumor_ad', TUMOR_VFREQ VARCHAR(100) PATH 'tumor_vfreq', START_POSITION int PATH 'start_position', ALT_ALLELE VARCHAR(255) PATH 'alt_allele', REF_ALLELE VARCHAR(255) PATH 'ref_allele') T LEFT JOIN VARIANTS_TO_OMIT ON CNV_TYPE = CNV_TYPE_OMIT LEFT JOIN VARIANT_CLASS_TO_OMIT ON VARIANT_CLASS = VARIANT_CLASS_OMIT WHERE 1=1 AND CNV_TYPE_OMIT IS NULL AND VARIANT_CLASS_OMIT IS NULL AND (TOTAL_NUMBER_VARIANTS =0 OR VARIANT_TYPE <> 'meta-data') ) SELECT * FROM DMP ORDER BY 1, 3, 13 ;

prompt: Completed Breast MRIs by ordering physician, by the entire breast service: BRE66 (surgeons), STBRE66 (medical oncologists), BREDMTSVR (survivorship) providers for 2007, 2008 2009 and 2010.
completion: SELECT V1.CLD_DEPT_NAME VST_DEPT, COUNT(CPE_ENC_CSN_ID) VST_CNT , CHAR(YEAR(CPE_ENC_DTE)) AS VST_YEAR, CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME VST_NAME , CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR VST_ABBR, CVT_EXT_NAME VST_TYPE , CRE_RES_NAME AS REF_MD, R1.CLD_DEPT_NAME AS REF_DEPT , R1.CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_4 REF_SVC FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID AND CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID IN (917, 1512, 1513, 1514, 1574, 1575, 3060, 3061, 3062, 6689, 6690, 6691, 6692, 6693, 6694, 6695, 6696, 6697, 7673, 7674) JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT V1 ON CPE_DEPT_ID = V1.CLD_DEPT_ID AND V1.CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 = 'RAD' AND V1.CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_1 <> 'REG' JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_REF_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT R1 ON CPE_REF_DEP_ID = R1.CLD_DEPT_ID WHERE CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN '2007-01-01' AND '2010-12-31' AND CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Comp', 'Arrived') AND CPE_ENC_TYP_CD = 50 GROUP BY V1.CLD_DEPT_NAME, CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME, CHAR(YEAR(CPE_ENC_DTE)) , CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR, CVT_EXT_NAME, CRE_RES_NAME, R1.CLD_DEPT_NAME , R1.CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_4

prompt: We want to look at the role of radiation oncology in ethics consultations (are patients on treatment having ethical issues/conflicts, is radiation being called as a last line of therapy for patients who are pending goals of care discussions, etc?)
completion: WITH VISIT AS (SELECT VIS_MRN , VIS_ADM_NUM , VIS_ADM_DTE , VIS_DSCH_DTE , CASE WHEN PT_DATE_OF_DEATH = VIS_DSCH_DTE THEN 'DECEASED' ELSE 'ALIVE' END AS DISCHARGE_STATUS , PT_DATE_OF_DEATH , ETHICS_CONSULTREQDATE FROM IDB.VISIT_V JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON VIS_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN (SELECT '{mrn}' MRN, DATE('{dte}') ETHICS_CONSULTREQDATE FROM SYSIBM.SYSDUMMY1) ON VIS_MRN = MRN AND ETHICS_CONSULTREQDATE BETWEEN VIS_ADM_DTE AND VIS_DSCH_DTE) , RT AS (SELECT RTC_TX_MRN, RTC_TX_COURSE_NO, RTC_TX_PLANSETUP_NO, RTC_TX_COURSE_ID, RTC_TX_PLAN_NAME, RTC_TX_PLANNED_FRACTIONS, RTC_TX_DELIVERED_FRACTIONS, RTC_TX_PLANNED_DOSE, RTC_TX_DELIVERED_DOSE, RTC_TX_START_DTE, RTC_TX_STOP_DTE, RTC_TX_ELAPSED_DAYS, RTC_PRIMARY_REF_POINT, RTC_DOSE_CORRECTION FROM IDB.RADONC_TREATMENT_COURSE JOIN VISIT ON RTC_TX_MRN = VIS_MRN WHERE RTC_TX_START_DTE BETWEEN ETHICS_CONSULTREQDATE - 30 DAYS AND ETHICS_CONSULTREQDATE + 30 DAYS OR RTC_TX_STOP_DTE BETWEEN ETHICS_CONSULTREQDATE - 30 DAYS AND ETHICS_CONSULTREQDATE + 30 DAYS ) , RDO_CONS AS (SELECT OO_MRN, OO_ORD_GUID, OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE, MAX(CASE WHEN OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'Requested For' THEN OUD_USER_DI_VALUE END) AS REQUESTED_FOR, MAX(CASE WHEN OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'Consult_Rad Onc IP Reason' THEN OUD_USER_DI_VALUE END) AS REASON_FOR_CONS FROM IDB.OMS_ORDER JOIN VISIT ON OO_MRN = VIS_MRN AND OO_ADM_NUM = VIS_ADM_NUM LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_USER_DATA ON OO_ORD_GUID = OUD_ORD_GUID AND OUD_USER_DI_CD IN ('Requested For', 'Consult_Rad Onc IP Reason') WHERE OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID = '9000008562100730' AND OO_ORD_STS_CD NOT IN ('CANP', 'CANC', 'AUC3') GROUP BY OO_MRN , OO_ORD_GUID , OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE ) , CC AS (SELECT CC_MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS MIN_ICD_EFF_DTE, CLM_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN VISIT ON CC_MRN = VIS_MRN JOIN RT ON CC_MRN = RTC_TX_MRN WHERE (SUBSTR(CC_CLSF_CD, 1, 3) BETWEEN 'C00' AND 'C97' OR SUBSTR(CC_CLSF_CD, 1, 3) BETWEEN '140' AND '209') AND CC_EFF_DTE BETWEEN RTC_TX_START_DTE AND RTC_TX_STOP_DTE AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND (CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) GROUP BY CC_MRN, CLM_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK ) SELECT TRIM(VIS_MRN) MRN , ETHICS_CONSULTREQDATE , VIS_ADM_NUM , VIS_ADM_DTE , VIS_DSCH_DTE , DISCHARGE_STATUS , PT_DATE_OF_DEATH , CLM_CLSF_CD AS ICD_CD , CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS ICD_DESC , OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE AS RADONC_IP_CONS_DTE , REQUESTED_FOR , REASON_FOR_CONS , RTC_TX_COURSE_NO , RTC_TX_PLANSETUP_NO , RTC_TX_COURSE_ID , RTC_TX_PLAN_NAME , RTC_TX_PLANNED_FRACTIONS , RTC_TX_DELIVERED_FRACTIONS , RTC_TX_PLANNED_DOSE , RTC_TX_DELIVERED_DOSE , RTC_TX_START_DTE , RTC_TX_STOP_DTE , RTC_TX_ELAPSED_DAYS , RTC_PRIMARY_REF_POINT , RTC_DOSE_CORRECTION FROM VISIT LEFT JOIN RT ON VIS_MRN = RTC_TX_MRN LEFT JOIN RDO_CONS ON VIS_MRN = OO_MRN LEFT JOIN CC ON VIS_MRN = CC_MRN

prompt: Update SQL, identifying which records are IP.
completion: SELECT EAD_MRN, MIN(RPT_PAT_NAME) AS RPT_PAT_NAME, EAD_DOCUMENT_DTE, EAD_DOCTYPE, MAX(CU_USER) AS CODER_ID, MAX(CU_LAST_NAME) AS CODER_LAST_NAME, MAX(CU_FIRST_NAME) AS CODER_FIRST_NAME, MAX(CV_CTC_VISIT_TYPE) AS CV_CTC_VISIT_TYPE, MAX(CASE WHEN CC_CLSF_CD = '38240' THEN '38240 ' ELSE '' END || CASE WHEN CC_CLSF_CD = '38241' THEN '38241 ' ELSE '' END || CASE WHEN CC_CLSF_CD = '38242' THEN '38242 ' ELSE '' END || CASE WHEN CC_CLSF_CD = '0540T' THEN '0540T' ELSE '' END || CASE WHEN CC_CLSF_CD = '38999' THEN '38999' ELSE '' END || CASE WHEN CC_CLSF_CD = '38243' THEN '38243 ' ELSE '' END) AS CODED, MIN(SUBSTR(CASE WHEN CDO_ITEM_NAME = 'Product Information: Cell Infusion Type' THEN CDO_VALUE_TEXT END, 1, 50)) AS CELL_INFUSION_TYPE, MIN(SUBSTR(CASE WHEN CDO_ITEM_NAME = 'BMT_Cell INF_PI_Cell Source RES' THEN CDO_VALUE_TEXT END, 1, 50)) AS CELL_SOURCE, CV_ADM_DTE, CV_DSCH_DTE, VIS_PATIENT_TYPE, VIS_ADM_DTE, VIS_DSCH_DTE, DATE('2018-01-01') AS BEGDTE, CURRENT_DATE -
