1 DAY AS ENDDTE, CURRENT_DATE AS RUNDTE FROM IDB.EMR_AA_DOCUMENT LEFT OUTER JOIN IDB.CTC_CLSF ON CC_MRN = EAD_MRN AND CC_EFF_DTE = EAD_DOCUMENT_DTE AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y' AND CC_CLSF_CD IN ('38240', '38241', '38242', '38243', '0540T', '38999') LEFT OUTER JOIN IDB.CTC_VISIT ON CV_MRN = EAD_MRN AND CV_CTC_VISIT_TYPE = 'O' AND CV_ADM_DTE >= '2016-01-01' AND EAD_DOCUMENT_DTE BETWEEN CV_ADM_DTE AND VALUE(CV_DSCH_DTE, CURRENT_DATE) LEFT OUTER JOIN IDB.RMS_PATIENT ON EAD_MRN = RPT_MRN LEFT OUTER JOIN IDB.CTC_REC_HX ON CRH_VISIT_ID = CC_VISIT_ID LEFT OUTER JOIN IDB.CTC_USERS ON CRH_CTC_CNG_USER = CU_USER LEFT OUTER JOIN IDB.CD_DOCUMENT ON EAD_MRN = CDD_MRN AND EAD_DOCUMENT_DTE = CDD_SERVICE_DTE AND CDD_DOC_NAME LIKE 'Cell Infusion - BMT%' AND CDD_CANCEL_IND = '0' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND = '0' LEFT OUTER JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION ON CDD_DOC_GUID = CDO_DOC_GUID AND CDO_ITEM_NAME IN ('Product Information: Cell Infusion Type', 'BMT_Cell INF_PI_Cell Source RES') LEFT OUTER JOIN IDB.VISIT ON EAD_MRN = VIS_MRN AND VIS_IP_OP_ADJUSTED_IND = 'I' AND VIS_VISIT_STATUS IN ('2', '3') AND CV_ADM_DTE BETWEEN VIS_ADM_DTE AND VIS_DSCH_DTE WHERE EAD_DOCTYPE = 'KS1' AND EAD_DOCUMENT_DTE >= '2018-01-01' AND (CDD_MRN IS NOT NULL OR EAD_BATCH_ID > 0) AND EAD_RIGHT_ID = 167 GROUP BY EAD_MRN, EAD_DOCUMENT_DTE, EAD_DOCTYPE, CV_ADM_DTE, CV_DSCH_DTE, VIS_PATIENT_TYPE, VIS_ADM_DTE, VIS_DSCH_DTE HAVING MAX(CV_CTC_VISIT_TYPE) IS NOT NULL ORDER BY EAD_DOCUMENT_DTE, EAD_MRN

prompt: Provide a list of Plastics IR and NV appointments, by MD and location (including Manhattan and regionals) from January - March 2018.
completion: WITH APPTS AS (SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN, CPE_ENC_DTE, CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME, CLD_CLD_CENTER, CRE_RES_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CPE_MRN ORDER BY CPE_ENC_DTE ASC) AS FIRST_VIS FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN '2018-01-01' AND '2018-03-31' AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 = 'PLA' AND CRE_RES_TYP = 'Physician' AND (CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR LIKE '%NV%' OR CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR LIKE '%IR%') ) , NEXT_VISIT AS (SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN, CPE_ENC_DTE, CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME, CRE_RES_NAME, CLD_CLD_CENTER, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CPE_MRN ORDER BY CPE_ENC_DTE ASC) AS NEXT_VIS FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN '2018-04-01' AND CURRENT date AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 = 'PLA' AND CRE_RES_TYP IN ('Physician', 'Nurse Practitioner', 'Physician Assistant', 'Advanced Practice Nurse') ) , INSURANCE AS (SELECT DISTINCT MRN, FSC_PRIORITY, FSC_NAME, INS_COMP_NAME FROM IDB.PATIENT_INSURANCE_V JOIN APPTS ON MRN = CPE_MRN WHERE FSC_PRIORITY = 1 ) , DX AS (SELECT PT_MRN, TUMOR_REG_DATA, ICD_DATA FROM IDB.PATIENT JOIN APPTS ON CPE_MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN (SELECT TM_MRN, LISTAGG(TM_DX_DTE || ' | ' || TRIM(SITE_DESC) || ' | ' || TRIM(HIST_DESC), CHR(13) || CHR(10)) WITHIN GROUP( ORDER BY TM_DX_DTE) AS TUMOR_REG_DATA FROM (SELECT DISTINCT TM_MRN, AV_DESC AS CASE_STS, TM_DX_DTE, TM_HIST_CD, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS HIST_DESC, TM_SITE_CD, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_DESC FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS ON AV_ELEMENT = 'CASE_STS' AND AV_CODE = TM_CASE_STS AND TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') ) A GROUP BY TM_MRN) AS CDB ON TM_MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN (SELECT CC_MRN, LISTAGG(MIN_ICD_EFF_DTE || ' | ' || TRIM(ICD_CD) || ' | ' || TRIM(ICD_DESC), CHR(13) || CHR(10)) WITHIN GROUP( ORDER BY MIN_ICD_EFF_DTE) AS ICD_DATA FROM (SELECT DISTINCT CC_MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS MIN_ICD_EFF_DTE, CC_CLSF_CD AS ICD_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS ICD_DESC FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE 1=1 AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND ((CC_CLSF_CD BETWEEN '140' AND '239.99') OR (CC_CLSF_CD BETWEEN 'C00' AND 'D49')) GROUP BY CC_MRN, CC_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK ) A GROUP BY CC_MRN) AS ICD ON CC_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE COALESCE(TM_MRN, CC_MRN) IS NOT NULL ) , DX_FINAL AS (SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN DX_MRN, TUMOR_REG_DATA, ICD_DATA FROM DX ) SELECT DISTINCT B.PT_MRN "MRN", B.PT_LAST_NAME "Last Name", B.PT_FIRST_NAME "First Name", YEAR(CURRENT date - B.PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) AS "Age", B.PT_CITY "City", B.PT_ZIP_CD "Zip Code", A.CPE_ENC_DTE "Appt Date", A.CRE_RES_NAME "Provider Name", A.CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME "Appt Type", A.CLD_CLD_CENTER "Appt Location", C.CPE_ENC_DTE "Followup Appt Date", C.CRE_RES_NAME "Followup Provider Name", C.CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME "Followup Appt Type", C.CLD_CLD_CENTER "Followup Appt Location", FSC_NAME "Primary Insurance", ICD_DATA "ICD Dx Data" FROM IDB.PATIENT B JOIN APPTS A ON B.PT_MRN = A.CPE_MRN AND A.FIRST_VIS = 1 LEFT JOIN NEXT_VISIT C ON A.CPE_MRN = C.CPE_MRN AND C.NEXT_VIS = 1 LEFT JOIN INSURANCE ON A.CPE_MRN = MRN LEFT JOIN DX_FINAL ON A.CPE_MRN = DX_MRN WHERE 1=1 ORDER BY A.CPE_ENC_DTE DESC ;

prompt: Provide a list of pediatric patients seen in 2019 in Peds NRS 1275 with a NV or PPAT visit type and a corresponding list of OR encounters with either Dr. Mark Souweidane or Dr. Jeff Greenfield.
completion: WITH APPTS AS (SELECT CPE_MRN AS "MRN", PT_LAST_NAME "Last Name", PT_FIRST_NAME "First Name", CPE_ENC_DTE AS "Appt Date", CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 AS "Department", CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 AS "Service", CLD_DEPT_NAME AS "Department Name", CRE_RES_NAME AS "Provider Name", CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME AS "Visit Type" FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON CPE_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN '2019-01-01' AND '2019-12-31' AND (CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR LIKE '%NV%' OR CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR LIKE '%IR%' OR CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME = 'PEDNRS PPAT') AND CLD_DEPT_NAME = 'PEDS NEUROSURG 1275' ) SELECT "MRN", "Last Name", "First Name", "Appt Date", "Department Name", "Provider Name", "Visit Type", LISTAGG(CHAR(SSE_SURG_DTE) || ': ' || TRIM(SSP_SURG_LAST_NM) || ', ' || TRIM(SSP_SURG_FIRST_NM) || ' - ' || TRIM(SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD) || ' ' || TRIM(SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC), CHR(13)||CHR(10)) SURGERY FROM APPTS LEFT JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT ON "MRN" = SSE_MRN AND SSE_SURG_DTE >= "Appt Date" LEFT JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE ON SSE_LOG_ID = SSP_LOG_ID AND SSE_ENC_CSN_ID = SSP_ENC_CSN_ID AND (SSE_SURG_LOC not like '%IR%' AND SSE_SURG_LOC not like '%ENDO%' AND SSE_SOURCE_TYPE <> 'E') AND SSP_SURG_LAST_NM IN ('SOUWEIDANE', 'GREENFIELD') GROUP BY "MRN", "Last Name", "First Name", "Appt Date", "Department", "Service", "Department Name", "Provider Name", "Visit Type"

prompt: Provide a list of all the patients at MSK diagnosed with Merkel cell carcinoma defined either by ICDO or ICD9 codes.
completion: WITH CDB AS (SELECT DISTINCT "t1"."PT_MRN" AS "MRN", "t1"."PT_LAST_NAME" AS "Last Name", "t1"."PT_FIRST_NAME" AS "First Name", "t1"."PT_BIRTH_DTE" AS "Date of Birth", "t2"."DXCC_ICD_CODE" AS "ICD-O Histology Code", "t2"."DXCC_ICD_MSK_DESC" AS "ICD-O Histology Description", "t3"."DT_DTE" AS "Tumor Diagnosis Date" FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V" "t1" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED" "t4" ON "t1"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t4"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."CDB_TUMOR_V" "t5" ON "t4"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t5"."CDTM_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DIAGNOSIS_CODE_CAT_ICDO_V" "t2" ON "t5"."CDTM_DX_CATALOG_ID" = "t2"."DXCC_DX_CATALOG_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" "t3" ON "t5"."CDTM_DX_DATE_ID" = "t3"."DT_DATE_ID" WHERE "t2"."DXCC_ICD_CODE" = 'M8247/3' ), "ICD9" AS (SELECT DISTINCT "t1"."PT_MRN" AS "MRN", "t1"."PT_LAST_NAME" AS "Last Name", "t1"."PT_FIRST_NAME" AS "First Name", "t1"."PT_BIRTH_DTE" AS "Date of Birth", "t2"."DXCC_ICD_CODE" AS "ICD-9 Final Dx Code", "t2"."DXCC_ICD_MSK_DESC" AS "ICD-9 Final Dx Description", "t3"."DT_DTE" AS "ICD-9 Final Diagnosis Date" FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V" "t1" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED" "t4" ON "t1"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t4"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DIAGNOSIS_FINAL_ALL_V" "t5" ON "t4"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t5"."PDX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN (SELECT DXCC_DX_CATALOG_ID, LTRIM(RTRIM(DXCC_ICD_CODE)) DXCC_ICD_CODE, LTRIM(RTRIM(DXCC_ICD_MSK_DESC)) DXCC_ICD_MSK_DESC, LTRIM(RTRIM(DXCC_ICD_CODE)) || ' - ' || LTRIM(RTRIM(DXCC_ICD_MSK_DESC)) AS DXCC_CODE_AND_MSK_DESC, LTRIM(RTRIM(DXCC_ICD_NATIONAL_DESC)) DXCC_ICD_NATIONAL_DESC, DXCC_DESC_LONG, CASE WHEN DXCC_ICD_CODE BETWEEN '196' AND '196.99' OR DXCC_ICD_CODE BETWEEN '197' AND '197.99' OR DXCC_ICD_CODE BETWEEN '198' AND '198.99' THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS DXCC_METS_INDICATOR, DXCC_CREATED_DT, DXCC_CREATED_BY, DXCC_MODIFIED_DT FROM DV.DIAGNOSIS_CATALOG WHERE DXCC_DX_TYPE = 'ICD9' ) "t2" ON "t5"."PDX_DX_CATALOG_ID" = "t2"."DXCC_DX_CATALOG_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" "t3" ON "t5"."PDX_DX_DATE_ID" = "t3"."DT_DATE_ID" WHERE "t2"."DXCC_ICD_CODE" = '209.75' AND "t5"."DXA_CIC_CDER_INIT" = 'YES'), ICD9MIN AS (SELECT "t6"."MRN" AS "MRN-LBL-2", "t6"."Last Name" AS "Last Name-LBL-2", "t6"."First Name" AS "First Name-LBL-2", "t6"."Date of Birth" AS "Date of Birth-LBL-2", "t6"."ICD-9 Final Dx Code" AS "ICD-9 Final Dx Code-LBL-2", "t6"."ICD-9 Final Dx Description" AS "ICD-9 Final Dx Description-LBL-2", MIN("t6"."ICD-9 Final Diagnosis Date") AS "MIN (ICD-9 Final Diagnosis Date)" FROM "ICD9" "t6" GROUP BY "t6"."MRN", "t6"."Last Name", "t6"."First Name", "t6"."Date of Birth", "t6"."ICD-9 Final Dx Code", "t6"."ICD-9 Final Dx Description") SELECT COALESCE(MRN, "MRN-LBL-2") AS MRN, COALESCE("Last Name", "Last Name-LBL-2") AS LAST_NAME, COALESCE("First Name", "First Name-LBL-2") AS FIRST_NAME, COALESCE("Date of Birth", "Date of Birth-LBL-2") AS DATE_OF_BIRTH, "ICD-O Histology Code", "ICD-O Histology Description", "Tumor Diagnosis Date", "ICD-9 Final Dx Code-LBL-2", "ICD-9 Final Dx Description-LBL-2", "MIN (ICD-9 Final Diagnosis Date)" FROM CDB FULL JOIN ICD9MIN ON CDB.MRN = ICD9MIN."MRN-LBL-2"

prompt: Provide clinical TNM staging for the specified resection patients.
Weekly list of patients with MSK-Access CfDNA CIS Orders
completion: WITH USER_DATA AS (SELECT OUD_ORD_GUID, MAX(TRIM(CASE WHEN OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'Cancer Dx' THEN OUD_USER_DI_VALUE END)) "Clinical Diagnosis", MAX(TRIM(CASE WHEN OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'PPATH_Access_Clin info' THEN OUD_USER_DI_VALUE END)) "Clinical Info", MAX(TRIM(CASE WHEN OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'PPATH_Access_indication' THEN OUD_USER_DI_VALUE END)) "Indication for test", MAX(TRIM(CASE WHEN OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'iPATH_Access_therapy' THEN OUD_USER_DI_VALUE END)) "Active Therapy", MAX(TRIM(CASE WHEN OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'iPATH_Access_tx response' THEN OUD_USER_DI_VALUE END)) "Responding to Tx?", MAX(TRIM(CASE WHEN OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'iPATH_Access_Consent' THEN OUD_USER_DI_VALUE END)) "MSK-Access Consent", MAX(TRIM(CASE WHEN OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'iPATH_Access_Outside testing' THEN OUD_USER_DI_VALUE END)) "Outside Testing", MAX(TRIM(CASE WHEN OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'iPATH_Access_systemic tx' THEN OUD_USER_DI_VALUE END)) "Prior targeted therapy or immunotherapy", MAX(TRIM(CASE WHEN OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'Protocol # (if applicable))' THEN OUD_USER_DI_VALUE END)) "Protocol No", MAX(TRIM(CASE WHEN OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'Research Billing' THEN OUD_USER_DI_VALUE END)) "Research Billing", MAX(TRIM(CASE WHEN OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'Special Instructions' THEN OUD_USER_DI_VALUE END)) "Special Instructions", MAX(TRIM(CASE WHEN OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'Lab_Specimen Collected On' THEN OUD_USER_DI_VALUE END)) "Collection Date" FROM IDB.OMS_ORD_USER_DATA JOIN IDB.OMS_ORDER ON OO_ORD_GUID = OUD_ORD_GUID WHERE OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID = '9000013297100730' AND OO_ORD_STS_CD NOT IN ('CANP', 'CANC', 'AUC3') AND OO_ENTER_DTE BETWEEN DATE(YEAR(CURRENT_DATE) || '-1-1') AND DATE(YEAR(CURRENT_DATE) || '-12-31') GROUP BY OUD_ORD_GUID ) SELECT DISTINCT OO_MRN MRN, PT_LAST_NAME "Last Name", PT_FIRST_NAME "First Name", OO_ENTER_DTE "Enter Date", OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE "Start Date", OO_MODIFIED_DTE "Order Modified Date", OSTS_STS_DESC "Status", OU_DISPLAY_NAME "Entered By", OP_DISPLAY_NAME "Provider", DOC_ACDMC_DPT "Academic Dept", "Clinical Diagnosis", "Clinical Info", "Indication for test", "Active Therapy", "MSK-Access Consent", "Outside Testing", "Prior targeted therapy or immunotherapy", "Protocol No", "Research Billing", "Special Instructions", "Collection Date" FROM IDB.OMS_ORDER JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_CATALOG ON OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID = OOC_MSTR_ITEM_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_STATUS ON OO_ORD_STS_CD = OSTS_ORD_STS_CD JOIN IDB.OMS_USER ON OO_USER_GUID = OU_USER_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_PROVIDER ON OO_PVDR_GUID = OP_PVDR_GUID JOIN USER_DATA ON OO_ORD_GUID = OUD_ORD_GUID JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON OO_MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.DOC ON OP_PVDR_NO = DOC_DR_NO WHERE OOC_ITEM_NAME = 'MSK-ACCESS cfDNA (for pts with Solid Tumor)' AND OO_ORD_STS_CD NOT IN ('CANP', 'CANC', 'AUC3') AND COALESCE(OO_MODIFIED_DTE, OO_ENTER_DTE) BETWEEN DATE(YEAR(CURRENT_DATE) || '-1-1') AND DATE(YEAR(CURRENT_DATE) || '-12-31') ORDER BY 4, 1

prompt: Provide a list of people ages 18 to 75 who have completed active cancer treatment at MSK between January 1, 2018 and August 1, 2021 and who live in New York State, Connecticut, New Jersey, Pennsylvania, Delaware, Massachusetts, Vermont, New Hampshire, Florida, Virginia, District of Columbia, Maryland, Rhode Island, and Maine.
completion: SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN "MRN" , PT_LAST_NAME "PT Last Name" , PT_FIRST_NAME "PT First Name" , PT_ZIP_CD "Zip Code" , PT_STATE "State" , PT_EMAIL_ADDRESS "Email address" , CPP_REC_CR_DT "MRN create date" , LAST_SVR_DTE "last svrship appt" FROM IDB.PATIENT JOIN IDB.CL_PAS_PATIENT ON PT_MRN = CPP_MRN JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTV_DTL ON PT_MRN = LAD_MRN JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN, MAX(CPE_ENC_DTE) AS LAST_SVR_DTE FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CLD_DEPT_ID = CPE_DEPT_ID WHERE 1=1 AND CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND (CLD_DEPT_ABBR like '%SVR%' OR CLD_DEPT_NAME like '%SVR%') GROUP BY CPE_MRN) A ON PT_MRN = CPE_MRN AND LAST_SVR_DTE >= DATE(CPP_REC_CR_DT) LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN IM_MRN FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID WHERE 1=1 AND CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CRE_RES_TYP IN ('Physician') AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 = 'IM' ) B ON PT_MRN = IM_MRN WHERE 1=1 AND YEAR(CURRENT date - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) >= 18 AND DATE(CPP_REC_CR_DT) >= '2019-01-01' AND PT_DATE_OF_DEATH IS NULL AND LAD_DONOT_CON_IND <> 'Y' AND (PT_EMAIL_ADDRESS IS NOT NULL AND PT_EMAIL_ADDRESS <> '') AND PT_STATE IN ('NY', 'NJ', 'PA', 'CT', 'DE', 'MA', 'VT', 'NH', 'FL', 'VA', 'DC', 'MD', 'RI', 'ME') AND IM_MRN IS NULL

prompt: Provide aggregate data of referring services from OMS Integrative Medicine Inpatient Consults
completion: SELECT HOSP_SVC, CUR_LOC , SUM(REIKI_REFLEXOLOGY_SWEDISH) AS REIKI_REFLEXOLOGY_SWEDISH , SUM(MIND_BODY) AS MIND_BODY , SUM(DANCE_MULTISENSORY_THERAPY) AS DANCE_MULTISENSORY_THERAPY , SUM(MASSAGE) AS MASSAGE , SUM(MUSIC_THERAPY) AS MUSIC_THERAPY , SUM(YOGA) AS YOGA , SUM(ACCUPUNCTURE) AS ACCUPUNCTURE FROM (SELECT ORD_GUID, ORDID, HOSP_SVC, CUR_LOC, ORD_NAME , SUM(CASE WHEN OFF_FLD_LABEL <> 'Treatment:' AND SERVICE = 'Massage (Reiki, Reflexology, Swedish)' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) REIKI_REFLEXOLOGY_SWEDISH , SUM(CASE WHEN OFF_FLD_LABEL <> 'Treatment:' AND SERVICE = 'Mind/Body (Meditation,Imagery,Hypnosis)' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) MIND_BODY , SUM(CASE WHEN (OFF_FLD_LABEL <> 'Treatment:' AND SERVICE = 'Dance/Multisensory Therapy (Peds ONLY)') OR (OFF_FLD_LABEL = 'Treatment:' AND SERVICE like '% Dance Therapy Peds Only%') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) DANCE_MULTISENSORY_THERAPY , SUM(CASE WHEN OFF_FLD_LABEL = 'Treatment:' AND SERVICE LIKE '%Massage%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) MASSAGE , SUM(CASE WHEN OFF_FLD_LABEL = 'Treatment:' AND SERVICE like '%Music Therapy%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) MUSIC_THERAPY , SUM(CASE WHEN OFF_FLD_LABEL = 'Treatment:' AND SERVICE like '%Yoga%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) YOGA , SUM(CASE WHEN OFF_FLD_LABEL = 'Treatment:' AND SERVICE like '%Accupuncture%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) ACCUPUNCTURE , SUM(CASE WHEN OFF_FLD_LABEL = 'Treatment:' AND SERVICE like '%Meditation%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) MEDITATION FROM (SELECT DISTINCT OO_MRN, OO_ACCT_NO, OO_ORD_GUID ORD_GUID, OO_ENTER_DTE, OO_ORD_ID ORDID , OO_ORD_NAME ORD_NAME, ENT.OU_DISPLAY_NAME ENT_BY, REQ.OU_DISPLAY_NAME REQ_BY , OO_ORD_STS_CD, OO_STS_LVL_NO , OCV_ADM_DT, OCV_DSCH_DT, OCV_IP_OP_IND , OCV_CURR_LOC , OS_SVC_GRP_CD, OS_SVC_DESC HOSP_SVC , OCV_PVDR_NAME PRVD_NAME, OCV_DSCH_DISP , OEF_FORM_DESC , OFF_FLD_LABEL, OUD_USER_DI_VALUE , CASE WHEN OFF_FLD_LABEL = 'Treatment:' THEN OUD_USER_DI_VALUE ELSE OFF_FLD_LABEL END SERVICE , CASE WHEN OCV_CURR_LOC LIKE 'ICU%' THEN 'ICU' WHEN OCV_CURR_LOC LIKE 'UCC%' THEN 'UCC' WHEN OCV_CURR_LOC LIKE 'Surgery Periop%' THEN 'Surgery Periop' WHEN OCV_CURR_LOC LIKE 'M %' THEN CASE WHEN SUBSTR(OCV_CURR_LOC, 3, 2) BETWEEN '10' AND '19' THEN 'M'||SUBSTR(OCV_CURR_LOC, 3, 2) ELSE 'M'||SUBSTR(OCV_CURR_LOC, 3, 1) END ELSE OCV_CURR_LOC END CUR_LOC FROM IDB.OMS_ORDER JOIN IDB.OMS_CLIENT_VISIT ON OO_VISIT_GUID = OCV_VISIT_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_USER ENT ON OO_USER_GUID = ENT.OU_USER_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_USER REQ ON OO_PVDR_GUID = REQ.OU_USER_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_SERVICE ON OCV_SVC_GUID = OS_SVC_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_CATALOG ON OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID = OOC_MSTR_ITEM_GUID INNER JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_ENTRY_FORM ON OOC_FORM_GUID = OEF_FORM_GUID INNER JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_FORM_FIELD ON OEF_ENTRY_FRM_GUID = OFF_ENTRY_FRM_GUID LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_USER_DATA ON OO_ORD_GUID = OUD_ORD_GUID AND OFF_DI_CD = OUD_USER_DI_CD WHERE OOC_MSTR_ITEM_GUID = '9000006696100730' AND OFF_DI_CD IN ('Consult_IntgMed Treatment', 'Nsg_Ref_Intg_Med_Tx') AND (OUD_USER_DI_VALUE > '' AND OUD_USER_DI_VALUE <> '0') AND OO_ORD_STS_CD NOT IN ('CANC', 'CANP', 'DISC') ) AS A GROUP BY ORD_GUID, ORDID, HOSP_SVC, CUR_LOC, ORD_NAME) AS B GROUP BY HOSP_SVC, CUR_LOC

prompt: Identify patients with head and neck cancer diagnosed prior to 2008, Clinical M0, treated with a specific induction chemotherapy regimen at MSKCC.
completion: WITH CIS AS (SELECT DISTINCT "t1"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" CIS_DEID FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED" "t1" JOIN "DV"."PHM_PT_MEDS_MQT" "t5" ON "t1"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t5"."POD_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" JOIN "DV"."PHM_INVENTORY_CATALOG" "t2" ON "t5"."POD_PHARMA_INVENTORY_CTLG_ID" = "t2"."PINC_INVENTORY_CTLG_ID" WHERE "t2"."PINC_GENERIC_NAME" IN ('CISPLATIN', 'CISPLATIN (CDDP)', 'CISplatin', 'SLIT Cisplatin') ), DOC AS (SELECT DISTINCT "t1"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" DOC_DEID FROM CIS JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED" "t1" ON CIS_DEID = "t1"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" JOIN "DV"."PHM_PT_MEDS_MQT" "t5" ON "t1"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t5"."POD_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" JOIN "DV"."PHM_INVENTORY_CATALOG" "t2" ON "t5"."POD_PHARMA_INVENTORY_CTLG_ID" = "t2"."PINC_INVENTORY_CTLG_ID" WHERE "t2"."PINC_GENERIC_NAME" IN ('DOCETAXEL', 'DOCEtaxel') ), FLUOR AS (SELECT DISTINCT "t1"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" DEID FROM DOC JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED" "t1" ON DOC_DEID = "t1"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" JOIN "DV"."PHM_PT_MEDS_MQT" "t5" ON "t1"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t5"."POD_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" JOIN "DV"."PHM_INVENTORY_CATALOG" "t2" ON "t5"."POD_PHARMA_INVENTORY_CTLG_ID" = "t2"."PINC_INVENTORY_CTLG_ID" WHERE "t2"."PINC_GENERIC_NAME" IN ('FLUOROURACIL', 'FLUOROURACIL 2%', 'FLUOROURACIL 5%', 'Fluorouracil') ) SELECT PT_MRN AS "MRN", PT_LAST_NAME AS "Last Name", PT_FIRST_NAME AS "First Name", PT_SEX AS "Gender", PT_BIRTH_DTE AS "Date of Birth", PT_DEATH_DTE AS "Date of Death", DT_DTE AS "Tumor Diagnosis Date", "t3"."DXCC_ICD_CODE" AS "ICD-O Histology Code", "t3"."DXCC_ICD_MSK_DESC" AS "ICD-O Histology Desc", "t4"."ICSC_SITE_CD" AS "ICD-O Site Code", "t4"."ICSC_ICDO_SITE_MSK_DESC" AS "ICD-O Site Desc" FROM FLUOR JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON DEID = PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID JOIN "DV"."CDB_TUMOR_V" "t6" ON DEID = "t6"."CDTM_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" JOIN "DV"."DIAGNOSIS_CODE_CAT_ICDO_V" "t3" ON "t6"."CDTM_DX_CATALOG_ID" = "t3"."DXCC_DX_CATALOG_ID" JOIN "DV"."ICDO_SITE_CATALOG_V" "t4" ON "t6"."CDTM_SITE_CATALOG_ID" = "t4"."ICSC_SITE_CATALOG_ID" LEFT JOIN DV.TUMOR_CLINICAL_STAGE_ATTRIBUTES ON "CDTM_CLINICAL_STAGE_ATTR_ID" = "TCLSA_TM_CLIN_STAGE_ATTR_ID" JOIN DV.DATE ON DT_DATE_ID = CDTM_DX_DATE_ID JOIN DV.TUMOR_CASE_ATTRIBUTES ON CDTM_CASE_ATTR_ID = TUMOR_CASE_ATTR_ID WHERE "TCA_CASE_STS_DESC" = 'Completed' AND TCLSA_CLIN_TNM_M_DESC IN ('M0', '0') AND "t4"."ICSC_SITE_CD" IN ('C009', 'C019', 'C021', 'C029', 'C030', 'C031', 'C041', 'C060', 'C062', 'C079', 'C090', 'C099', 'C108', 'C109', 'C111', 'C118', 'C119', 'C129', 'C138', 'C139', 'C300', 'C311', 'C318', 'C320', 'C321')

prompt: List of all angioimmunoblasitc T cell lymphoma, anaplastic large T cell lymphoma and peripheral T cell lymphoma who underwent bone marrow biopsy, chemotherapy, and survived at least 6 months from diagnosis
completion: WITH CLINTRAC AS (SELECT CC_MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS MIN_ICD9_EFF_DTE FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE (SUBSTR(CC_CLSF_CD, 1, 5) IN ('C84.4', 'C84.5', 'C84.6', 'C84.7', 'C86.5', '202.7', '200.6') OR CC_CLSF_CD = '200.80') AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND (CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) GROUP BY CC_MRN ) , TUMOR AS (SELECT DISTINCT TM_MRN, TM_DX_DTE, TM_BEST_AJCC_STG AS STAGE FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS ON AV_ELEMENT = 'CASE_STS' AND AV_CODE = TM_CASE_STS AND TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND TM_HIST_CD IN ('M9705/3', 'M9714/3', 'M9702/3')) , CHEMO AS (SELECT APR_MRN, APR_START_DTE AS CHEMO_DTE FROM IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX JOIN IDB.CHEMO_DRUG_GENERIC ON APR_GENERIC_NAME = CDG_GENERIC_NAME) , PATH AS (SELECT PRPT_MRN, PRPT_PROCEDURE_DTE, DV.REGEXSTR('(?<=Date of Receipt: )([^\s]+)', PRPT_REPORT) AS RECEIPT_DTE, PRPT_REPORT_DTE, PRPT_ACCESSION_NO, PRPT_REPORT, ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY PRPT_MRN ORDER BY PRPT_PROCEDURE_DTE ASC) AS RANK FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V WHERE PRPT_REPORT IS NOT NULL AND CONTAINS("PRPT_REPORT", '("LPIC" | "MARROW" | "BONE" | "BONE MARROW" | "ASPIRATE")') = 1 AND PRPT_REPORT_TYPE_DESC = 'Surgical Pathology' ) SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN AS MRN, PT_SEX "Sex", PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH AS DOB, CASE WHEN PT_PT_ETHNICITY = 'NON' THEN 'Non-Hispanic' WHEN PT_PT_ETHNICITY = 'HIS' THEN 'Hispanic' ELSE PT_PT_ETHNICITY END "Ethnicity", AV_DESC "Race", COALESCE(TM_DX_DTE, MIN_ICD9_EFF_DTE) "Diagnosis Date", MIN(CHEMO_DTE) "First Chemo Date", PRPT_PROCEDURE_DTE "First Bone Marrow Biopsy Date", RECEIPT_DTE "Report Receipt Date", CASE WHEN PT_DATE_OF_DEATH IS NOT NULL THEN 'DECEASED' ELSE 'ALIVE' END "Vital Status", PT_DATE_OF_DEATH "Date of Death", MAX(LAD_FU_COMPL_DTE, LAD_PBD_SURG_DTE, LAD_PA_ACTV_DTE) "Last Known MSK Enc" FROM IDB.PATIENT JOIN CHEMO ON PT_MRN = APR_MRN JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS ON AV_ELEMENT = 'RACE' AND AV_CODE = PT_RACE JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTV_DTL ON PT_MRN = LAD_MRN JOIN PATH P ON PT_MRN = P.PRPT_MRN AND P.RANK = 1 LEFT JOIN TUMOR ON PT_MRN = TM_MRN LEFT JOIN CLINTRAC ON PT_MRN = CC_MRN WHERE COALESCE(TM_MRN, CC_MRN) IS NOT NULL AND CHEMO_DTE >= COALESCE(TM_DX_DTE, MIN_ICD9_EFF_DTE) AND (DAYS(PT_DATE_OF_DEATH) - DAYS(COALESCE(TM_DX_DTE, MIN_ICD9_EFF_DTE)) > 182 OR PT_DATE_OF_DEATH IS NULL) GROUP BY PT_MRN, PT_SEX, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, CASE WHEN PT_PT_ETHNICITY = 'NON' THEN 'Non-Hispanic' WHEN PT_PT_ETHNICITY = 'HIS' THEN 'Hispanic' ELSE PT_PT_ETHNICITY END, AV_DESC, COALESCE(TM_DX_DTE, MIN_ICD9_EFF_DTE), PT_DATE_OF_DEATH - COALESCE(TM_DX_DTE, MIN_ICD9_EFF_DTE), PRPT_PROCEDURE_DTE, RECEIPT_DTE, PRPT_ACCESSION_NO, CASE WHEN PT_DATE_OF_DEATH IS NOT NULL THEN 'DECEASED' ELSE 'ALIVE' END, PT_DATE_OF_DEATH, LAD_FU_COMPL_DTE, LAD_PBD_SURG_DTE, LAD_PA_ACTV_DTE ORDER BY COALESCE(TM_DX_DTE, MIN_ICD9_EFF_DTE), PT_MRN

prompt: Provide darwin cohort and notifications for upcoming research appointments in the following week.
completion: WITH BASE AS (SELECT PENC_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID , PT_MRN MRN , TRIM(ENDP_SERVICE_DEPT_GRP_6) DEPT_GRP_6 , TRIM(ENDP_SVC_CLINIC_SUB_DEPT_GRP_7) DIV_GRP_7 , TRIM(ENDP_SERVICE_SPECIALTY_GRP_8) RPT_GRP_8 , TRIM(T2.EDC_DEPT_DESC) APPT_STATUS_DESC , CASE WHEN ENVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR like '%NV%' THEN 'New Visit' WHEN ENVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR like '%IR%' THEN 'Internal Referral' ELSE 'Non-New Visit/Interal Referral' END AS IRNV_IND , PENC_ENC_DT, PENC_MODIFIED_DT , ENR_RES_NAME FROM DV.PATIENT_ENCOUNTER T6 INNER JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PENC_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID INNER JOIN DV.ENCOUNTER_SCHD_RESOURCES SR ON T6.PENC_PT_ENC_ID = SR.ENSR_PT_ENC_ID INNER JOIN DV.ENCOUNTER_RESOURCE ER ON SR.ENSR_RES_ID = ER.ENR_ENC_RES_ID INNER JOIN DV.ENCOUNTER_VISIT_TYPE EVT ON T6.PENC_VISIT_TYPE_ID = EVT.ENVT_ENC_VISIT_TYPE_ID INNER JOIN DV.ENCOUNTER_DESC_CATALOG T2 ON EDC_GROUP_ID = 'STS' AND T6.PENC_APPT_STS = T2.EDC_DEPT_ABBREV INNER JOIN DV.ENCOUNTER_DEPARTMENT T3 ON T6.PENC_DEPT_ID = T3.ENDP_ENC_DEPT_ID INNER JOIN DV.DATE_V REC ON T6.PENC_ENC_DATE_ID = REC.DT_DATE_ID WHERE 1=1 AND T2.EDC_DEPT_DESC IN ('Scheduled') AND DT_DTE <= (CURRENT date + 7 DAYS) + (7-(DAYOFWEEK_ISO((CURRENT date + 7 DAYS)))) DAYS AND DT_DTE >= (CURRENT date + 7 DAYS) - (DAYOFWEEK_ISO(CURRENT date + 7 DAYS) - 1) DAYS AND ER.ENR_RES_NAME IN ('ST GU 68 PROSTATE RESEARCH RN') ) SELECT * FROM BASE

prompt: Epithelioid hemangioendothelioma NF2 solid tumors
completion: WITH PTS AS (SELECT PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID PID FROM DV.PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED) , DT_1 AS (SELECT PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID AS P_ID FROM DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS REC LEFT JOIN DV.PATIENT_CORE_DEMOGRAPHICS ON PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = CORE_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID WHERE 1=1 AND PT_VITAL_STATUS IN ('ALIVE') ) , DT_2 AS (SELECT INC.PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID P_ID FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_STRUCTURED_RESULTS_V INC WHERE 1=1 AND (INC.GENE IN ('NF2') OR INC.GENE2 IN ('NF2')) AND ABERRATIONTYPE <> 'copy number gain' AND CASE WHEN LOCATE('heme', LOWER(INC.METHOD)) > 0 OR LOCATE('liquid', LOWER(INC.METHOD)) > 0 OR LOCATE('RDTB', INC.METHOD) >0 THEN 'liquid' ELSE 'solid' END IN ('solid') ) , DT_3 AS (SELECT INC.PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID P_ID , GENE, GENE2, SEARCH_HIT2 FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_STRUCTURED_RESULTS_V INC WHERE 1=1 AND (INC.GENE IN ('YAP1') OR INC.GENE2 IN ('YAP1') OR INC.GENE IN ('WWTR1 ') OR INC.GENE2 IN ('WWTR1 ')) AND (INC.ABERRATIONTYPE IN ('fusion') OR CASE WHEN 'fusion' IN ('fusion') AND (UPPER(SEARCH_HIT2) like '%FUSION%' OR UPPER(SEARCH_HIT2) like '%TRANSLOCATION%' OR UPPER(SEARCH_HIT2) like '%REARRAN%' OR UPPER(SEARCH_HIT2) like '%INVERSION%') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END = 1) ) , DT_4 AS (SELECT PRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID AS P_ID FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V REC WHERE 1=1 AND CONTAINS(PRPT_REPORT, '"epithelioid hemangioendothelioma"') = 1 ) , DT_5 AS (SELECT PENC_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID AS P_ID FROM (SELECT PENC_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID , TRIM(ENDP_SERVICE_DEPT_GRP_6) DEPT_GRP_6 , TRIM(ENDP_SVC_CLINIC_SUB_DEPT_GRP_7) DIV_GRP_7 , TRIM(ENDP_SERVICE_SPECIALTY_GRP_8) RPT_GRP_8 , TRIM(ENDP_CENTER_FULL_NAME) CENTER_FULL_NAME , TRIM(ENDP_DEPT_NAME) DEPT_NAME , TRIM(T2.EDC_DEPT_DESC) APPT_STATUS_DESC , CASE WHEN ENVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR like '%NV%' THEN 'New Visit' WHEN ENVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR like '%IR%' THEN 'Internal Referral' ELSE 'Non-New Visit/Interal Referral' END AS IRNV_IND , PENC_ENC_DT, PENC_MODIFIED_DT FROM DV.PATIENT_ENCOUNTER T6 INNER JOIN DV.ENCOUNTER_SCHD_RESOURCES SR ON T6.PENC_PT_ENC_ID = SR.ENSR_PT_ENC_ID INNER JOIN DV.ENCOUNTER_RESOURCE ER ON SR.ENSR_RES_ID = ER.ENR_ENC_RES_ID INNER JOIN DV.ENCOUNTER_VISIT_TYPE EVT ON T6.PENC_VISIT_TYPE_ID = EVT.ENVT_ENC_VISIT_TYPE_ID INNER JOIN DV.ENCOUNTER_DESC_CATALOG T2 ON EDC_GROUP_ID = 'STS' AND T6.PENC_APPT_STS = T2.EDC_DEPT_ABBREV INNER JOIN DV.ENCOUNTER_DEPARTMENT T3 ON T6.PENC_DEPT_ID = T3.ENDP_ENC_DEPT_ID INNER JOIN DV.DATE_V REC ON T6.PENC_ENC_DATE_ID = REC.DT_DATE_ID WHERE 1=1 AND T2.EDC_DEPT_DESC IN ('Scheduled') ) T WHERE 1=1 ) , DEID AS (SELECT DISTINCT P_ID FROM (SELECT P_ID FROM DT_1 INTERSECT SELECT P_ID FROM DT_5 INTERSECT (SELECT P_ID FROM DT_2 UNION ALL SELECT P_ID FROM DT_3 UNION ALL SELECT P_ID FROM DT_4 )))

prompt: Unilateral Mastectomies without reconstruction in JRSC
completion: WITH CTE AS (SELECT SSE_MRN CTE_MRN, SSE_LOG_ID CTE_LOG_ID FROM IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE ON SSE_LOG_ID = SSP_LOG_ID AND SSE_ENC_CSN_ID = SSP_ENC_CSN_ID WHERE SSE_SURG_DTE >= CURRENT DATE - 90 DAY AND SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD IN ('19303', '19307') AND SSE_SURG_LOC LIKE 'JR%' ) SELECT SSE_MRN MRN, PT_LAST_NAME "Last Name", PT_FIRST_NAME "First Name", SSE_SURG_DTE "Surgery Date", SSE_LOG_ID "Log ID", SSP_PROC_SEQ_NO "Panel", SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD "CPT Code", SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC "CPT Description", TRIM(SSP_SURG_LAST_NM) || ', ' || TRIM(SSP_SURG_FIRST_NM) "Surgeon", SSP_SURG_SVC_CD "Service", SSE_SURG_LOC "Location" FROM IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE ON SSE_LOG_ID = SSP_LOG_ID AND SSE_ENC_CSN_ID = SSP_ENC_CSN_ID JOIN CTE ON SSE_LOG_ID = CTE_LOG_ID JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON SSE_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE SSP_SURG_SVC_CD <> 'PLA' ORDER BY SSE_LOG_ID DESC, SSP_PROC_SEQ_NO

prompt: Provide a weekly list of patients scheduled for the specified Mastectomy procedures in the next 3 weeks and a weekly list of patients completing Chemotherapy the following week.
completion: WITH X AS (SELECT OC_CASE_ID, STRIP(OC_MRN) AS MRN, STRIP(PT_LAST_NAME) "Last Name", STRIP(PT_FIRST_NAME) AS "First Name", PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH AS DOB, YEAR(OC_SURG_DTE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) AS "Age", OC_SURG_DTE, STRIP(CRE_RES_NAME) AS "Surgeon", STRIP(CPX_PROC_CD) AS "CPT Code", STRIP(CPX_PROC_NAME) AS "CPT Description", OP_OR_PROC_ID AS "Procedure ID", STRIP(OP_PROC_NAME) AS "Procedure Description", OCP_LINE_NO, OCP_PROC_ID FROM IDB.PATIENT JOIN IDB.OR_CASE ON PT_MRN = OC_MRN JOIN IDB.OR_CASE_ALL_PROC ON OC_CASE_ID = OCAP_CASE_ID JOIN IDB.OR_CASE_ALL_SURG ON OCAP_CASE_ID = OCAS_CASE_ID AND OCAS_PNL_NO = OCAP_PNL_NO AND OCAS_SURG_ROLE = 'Primary' JOIN IDB.OR_PROC ON OCAP_OR_PROC_ID = OP_OR_PROC_ID JOIN IDB.OR_CL_PROC ON OP_OR_PROC_ID = OCP_OR_PROC_ID JOIN IDB.CL_PROC ON OCP_PROC_ID = CPX_PROC_ID JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CRE_RES_ID = OCAS_RES_ID WHERE OC_SURG_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT date AND CURRENT date + 21 DAYS AND YEAR(OC_SURG_DTE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) BETWEEN 18 AND 75 AND OC_OR_CASE_STS_CD NOT IN ('2', '5') AND CPX_PROC_CD IN ('19162', '19200', '19220', '19240', '19302', '19305', '19307', '38745') ) , CPE AS (SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN, CPE_ENC_DTE, STRIP(CRE_RES_NAME) AS CRE_RES_NAME, STRIP(CRE_RES_TYP) AS CRE_RES_TYP, STRIP(CLD_DEPT_NAME) AS CLD_DEPT_NAME, STRIP(CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6) AS CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6, STRIP(CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8) AS CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8, STRIP(CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME) AS CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CPE_MRN ORDER BY CPE_ENC_DTE DESC) AS RN FROM X JOIN IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER ON CPE_MRN = MRN JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Sch') AND CRE_RES_TYP IN ('Physician') AND CRE_RES_ID IN ('019745', '014381', '005926', '015693', '009217', '004622', '021212', '025924', '022699', '014084', '018481', '017285', '010165', '002873', '023119', '005694') ) SELECT DISTINCT X.*, CPE_ENC_DTE, CRE_RES_NAME, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8, CLD_DEPT_NAME, CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME FROM X LEFT JOIN CPE ON MRN = CPE_MRN WITH X AS (SELECT DISTINCT STRIP(PT_MRN) AS MRN, STRIP(PT_LAST_NAME) "Last Name", STRIP(PT_FIRST_NAME) AS "First Name", PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH AS DOB, YEAR(CPE_ENC_DTE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) AS "Age", CPE_ENC_DTE AS CHEMO_DATE, STRIP(R1.CRE_RES_NAME) AS CHEMO_RES_NAME, STRIP(R1.CRE_RES_TYP) AS CHEMO_RES_TYPE, STRIP(R2.CRE_RES_NAME) AS CHEMO_REFERRING_MD, STRIP(CCH_CHEMO_NAME) AS CHEMO_NAME, STRIP(CLD_DEPT_NAME) AS CHEMO_DEPT_NAME, STRIP(CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6) AS CHEMO_GRP6, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 AS CHEMO_GRP8, STRIP(CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME) AS CHEMO_VISIT_TYPE, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY CPE_MRN ORDER BY CPE_ENC_DTE DESC) AS RN_CHEMO FROM IDB.PATIENT JOIN IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER ON PT_MRN = CPE_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE R1 ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = R1.CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE R2 ON CPE_REF_RES_ID = R2.CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID JOIN IDB.CL_PT_CHEMO ON CPC_CL_PT_ID = CPE_CL_PT_ID AND CPC_ENC_DTE_SEQ = CPE_ENC_DTE_SEQ JOIN IDB.CL_CHEMO ON CPC_CHEMO_ID = CCH_CHEMO_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Sch') AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 = 'CHM' AND R1.CRE_RES_TYP = 'Chemotherapy Unit' AND YEAR(CPE_ENC_DTE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) BETWEEN 18 AND 75 AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT date AND CURRENT date + 7 DAYS AND(UPPER(CCH_CHEMO_NAME) LIKE '%DOXORUBICIN%' OR UPPER(CCH_CHEMO_NAME) LIKE '%ADRIAMYCIN%' OR UPPER(CCH_CHEMO_NAME) LIKE '%CYCLOPHOSPHAMIDE%' OR UPPER(CCH_CHEMO_NAME) LIKE '%CYTOXAN%' OR UPPER(CCH_CHEMO_NAME) LIKE '%PACLITAXEL%' OR UPPER(CCH_CHEMO_NAME) LIKE '%TAXOL%' OR UPPER(CCH_CHEMO_NAME) LIKE '%ABRAXANE%') AND CPE_MRN NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT PBD_MRN FROM IDB.PBD_DTL JOIN IDB.PBD_CODE ON PBD_PBD_CD = PBC_PBD_CD JOIN IDB.CLM ON PBC_CPT_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE CLM_CLSF_CD IN ('19307', '38745') ) ) , CPE AS (SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN, CPE_ENC_DTE AS APPT_DATE, STRIP(CRE_RES_NAME) AS CRE_RES_NAME, STRIP(CRE_RES_TYP) AS CRE_RES_TYP, STRIP(CLD_DEPT_NAME) AS CLD_DEPT_NAME, STRIP(CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6) AS CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6, STRIP(CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8) AS CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8, STRIP(CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME) AS CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CPE_MRN ORDER BY CPE_ENC_DTE DESC) AS RN FROM X JOIN IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER CPE ON CPE_MRN = MRN JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Sch') AND CRE_RES_TYP IN ('Physician') AND CRE_RES_ID IN ('019745', '014381', '005926', '015693', '009217', '004622', '021212', '025924', '022699', '014084', '018481', '017285', '010165', '002873', '023119', '005694') AND(CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME like 'BRE FR%' OR CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME like 'BRE FX%') ) SELECT DISTINCT X.*, APPT_DATE, CRE_RES_NAME, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8, CLD_DEPT_NAME, CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME FROM X JOIN CPE ON MRN = CPE_MRN WHERE RN_CHEMO = 1

prompt: Identify African-American and Hispanic patients between the ages of 18 and 60 (inclusive), with a diagnosis of breast cancer stages I-III, prior to having chemotherapy, radiation therapy or endocrine therapy.
completion: SELECT DISTINCT MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, PT_PHONE, DX_DTE, CC_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF INNER JOIN (SELECT PT_MRN AS MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS DX_DTE FROM IDB.PATIENT INNER JOIN IDB.CTC_CLSF X ON PT_MRN = CC_MRN INNER JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD INNER JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY ON PT_MRN = PLA_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS ON PT_RACE = AV_CODE AND AV_ELEMENT = 'RACE' WHERE YEAR(CURRENT DATE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) BETWEEN 18 AND 60 AND CC_CLSF_CD BETWEEN '174' AND '174.9' AND ((CC_PT_TYPE = 'I') OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND (UPPER(AV_DESC) LIKE '%BLACK%' OR UPPER(PT_PT_ETHNICITY) = ('HIS')) AND CC_EFF_DTE BETWEEN (CURRENT DATE - 15 DAY) AND (CURRENT DATE - 1 DAY) AND CC_MRN NOT IN (SELECT BG_MRN FROM IDB.BR_GENERAL INNER JOIN IDB.BR_PT_EVENT ON BG_MRN = BPE_MRN INNER JOIN IDB.BR_PRIMARY ON BPE_MRN = BP_MRN AND BPE_DX_ID = BP_DX_ID AND BPE_PRIM_SEQ_NO = BP_PRIM_SEQ_NO WHERE X.CC_MRN = BG_MRN AND (BP_ESTRG_RCR_CD = '1' OR BP_PRGSTR_RCP_CD = '1') AND BG_HRT = '1' ) AND CC_MRN NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT CC_MRN FROM IDB.PATIENT INNER JOIN IDB.CTC_CLSF ON PT_MRN = CC_MRN INNER JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS ON PT_RACE = AV_CODE AND AV_ELEMENT = 'RACE' WHERE X.CC_MRN = PT_MRN AND CC_CLSF_CD BETWEEN '174' AND '174.9' AND ((CC_PT_TYPE = 'I') OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND (UPPER(AV_DESC) LIKE '%BLACK%' OR UPPER(PT_PT_ETHNICITY) = ('HIS')) AND CC_EFF_DTE < (CURRENT DATE - 15 DAY) ) AND CC_MRN NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT CC_MRN FROM IDB.PATIENT INNER JOIN IDB.CTC_CLSF ON PT_MRN = CC_MRN INNER JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS ON PT_RACE = AV_CODE AND AV_ELEMENT = 'RACE' WHERE X.CC_MRN = PT_MRN AND CC_CLSF_CD = '198.81' AND ((CC_PT_TYPE = 'I') OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND (UPPER(AV_DESC) LIKE '%BLACK%' OR UPPER(PT_PT_ETHNICITY) = ('HIS')) AND CC_EFF_DTE < (CURRENT DATE - 15 DAY) ) AND PLA_LST_CHEMO_DTE IS NULL AND PLA_LST_RT_DTE IS NULL GROUP BY PT_MRN) A ON A.MRN = CC_MRN AND A.DX_DTE = CC_EFF_DTE INNER JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD INNER JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON MRN = PT_MRN WHERE YEAR(CURRENT DATE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) BETWEEN 18 AND 60 AND CC_CLSF_CD BETWEEN '174' AND '174.9' AND ((CC_PT_TYPE = 'I') OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%'

prompt: Provide bi-weekly list of pancreatic cancer patients with resected disease who are receiving follow up care at MSK.
completion: WITH DX AS (SELECT TM_MRN, AV_DESC AS CASE_STS, TM_DX_DTE, TM_HIST_CD, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS HIST_DESC, TM_SITE_CD, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_DESC, TM_BEST_AJCC_STG, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY TM_MRN ORDER BY TM_DX_DTE) RN FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS ON AV_ELEMENT = 'CASE_STS' AND AV_CODE = TM_CASE_STS WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND TM_SITE_CD LIKE 'C25%' ) , PROC AS (SELECT SSE_MRN, SSE_SURG_DTE, SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD, SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC, TRIM(SSP_SURG_LAST_NM) || ', ' || TRIM(SSP_SURG_FIRST_NM) SURGEON_NAME, TM_HIST_CD, HIST_DESC, TM_SITE_CD, SITE_DESC FROM IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE ON SSE_LOG_ID = SSP_LOG_ID AND SSE_ENC_CSN_ID = SSP_ENC_CSN_ID JOIN DX ON SSE_MRN = TM_MRN AND RN = 1 WHERE SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD = '48150' AND SSE_SURG_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT date - 360 DAY AND CURRENT date ) , CHEMO AS (SELECT APR_MRN, MIN(APR_START_DTE) CHEMO_START_DTE FROM IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX JOIN IDB.CHEMO_DRUG_GENERIC ON APR_GENERIC_NAME = CDG_GENERIC_NAME JOIN PROC ON APR_MRN = SSE_MRN AND APR_START_DTE >= SSE_SURG_DTE GROUP BY APR_MRN) , RAD AS (SELECT RTC_TX_MRN, MIN(RTC_TX_START_DTE) RAD_START_DTE FROM IDB.RADONC_TREATMENT_COURSE JOIN PROC ON RTC_TX_MRN = SSE_MRN AND RTC_TX_START_DTE >= SSE_SURG_DTE GROUP BY RTC_TX_MRN) , GI_APPT AS (SELECT CPE_MRN, CPE_ENC_DTE, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 DEPT, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 SVC, CLD_DEPT_NAME, CRE_RES_NAME, CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CPE_MRN ORDER BY CPE_ENC_DTE) RN FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID JOIN PROC ON CPE_MRN = SSE_MRN AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN SSE_SURG_DTE AND SSE_SURG_DTE + 60 DAY WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 = 'GI' AND CRE_RES_TYP IN ('Physician', 'PhD', 'Dentist', 'Psychologist') ) SELECT P.*, C.CHEMO_START_DTE, R.RAD_START_DTE, G.CPE_ENC_DTE GI_APPT_DTE, G.CRE_RES_NAME GI_APPT_PROVIDER, G.CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME GI_APPT_VISIT_TYPE FROM PROC P LEFT JOIN CHEMO C ON APR_MRN = SSE_MRN LEFT JOIN RAD R ON RTC_TX_MRN = SSE_MRN LEFT JOIN GI_APPT G ON G.CPE_MRN = SSE_MRN AND G.RN = 1 ;

prompt: Provide a list of all patients with ICD-9 code 215.0 or 215 seen between 1998 and 2010 who saw a head and neck surgeon but did not have surgery in the head and neck department during that time period.
completion: WITH DX AS (SELECT CC_MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS MIN_DX_DTE, MAX(CASE WHEN CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y') THEN 'Y' ELSE '' END) AS EVER_CIC_CODED FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF WHERE CC_CLSF_CD IN ('215', '215.0') AND CC_CLSF_TYPE like 'DF%' AND CC_EFF_DTE BETWEEN '1998-01-01' AND '2010-12-31' GROUP BY CC_MRN), APPT AS (SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN FROM DX JOIN IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER ON CC_MRN = CPE_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CLD_DEPT_ID = CPE_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CRE_RES_ID = CPE_VST_RES_ID WHERE CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN '1998-01-01' AND '2010-12-31' AND CLD_DEPT_ABBR = 'HNS' AND CRE_RES_TYP = 'Physician' AND CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp')), SURG AS (SELECT DISTINCT SSE_MRN FROM APPT JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT ON CPE_MRN = SSE_MRN JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE ON SSE_LOG_ID = SSP_LOG_ID JOIN IDB.DOC ON SSP_RES_ID = DOC_DR_NO WHERE SSE_SURG_DTE BETWEEN '1998-01-01' AND '2010-12-31' AND DOC_SVC = 'HNS') SELECT PT_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_SEX, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, PT_DATE_OF_DEATH, MIN_DX_DTE, EVER_CIC_CODED FROM DX JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON CC_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE CC_MRN IN (SELECT CPE_MRN FROM APPT) AND CC_MRN NOT IN (SELECT SSE_MRN FROM SURG)

prompt: Identify all patients with fMRI since 2006.
completion: SELECT DTL_MRN, DTL_SVC_DTE FROM IDB.PA_DETAIL WHERE DTL_DTL_TYPE = 'C' AND DTL_SVC_CD IN ('50705540', '50705557', '50764992') AND DTL_SVC_DTE >= '2006-01-01' GROUP BY DTL_MRN, DTL_SVC_DTE, DTL_SVC_CD HAVING SUM(DTL_SVC_QTY) > 0

prompt: Provide a list of questionnaires assigned to patients on protocol 19-382.
completion: WITH AC AS (SELECT * FROM IDB.ACCRUALS WHERE AC_IRB_NO = '19-382' ) , EF AS (SELECT DISTINCT EPI_MRN AS MRN, TRIM(EPI_LAST_NAME) AS PT_LAST_NAME, TRIM(EPI_FIRST_NAME) AS PT_FIRST_NAME, AC_IRB_NO, AC_CONS_DTE, ES_SURV_NAME AS "Survey Name", EAS_ASSESS_STS AS "Assessment Status", DATE(EA_SUBM_DT) AS "Submission Date", DATE(EA_ASSIGN_DT) AS "Assignment Date", DATE(EA_EXPIRY_DT) AS "Expiry Date" FROM AC JOIN IDB.EF_PATIENT_INFO PT ON AC_MRN = EPI_MRN JOIN IDB.EF_ASSESSMENT A ON A.EA_PT_INFO_ID = PT.EPI_PT_INFO_ID JOIN IDB.EF_SURVEY S ON A.EA_SURV_ID = S.ES_SURV_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.EF_ASSESSMENT_DTL AD ON A.EA_ASSESS_DTL_ID = AD.EAD_ASSESS_DTL_ID JOIN IDB.EF_ASSESSMENT_STS AS STS ON A.EA_STS_ID = STS.EAS_ASSESS_STS_ID WHERE EAS_ASSESS_STS_ID <> 4 AND EA_TRIGGERD_BY <> 6 AND ES_SURV_NAME IN ('Technical Survey', 'Demographics', 'Quality of Life Questionnaire (FACT-G)', 'Telehealth Usability Questionnaire', 'Serious Illness Questionnaire') ) SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN AS MRN, STRIP(PT_LAST_NAME) AS PT_LAST_NAME, STRIP(PT_FIRST_NAME) AS PT_FIRST_NAME, CPE_ENC_DTE, STRIP(CRE_RES_NAME) AS CRE_RES_NAME, STRIP(CRE_RES_TYP) AS CRE_RES_TYP, STRIP(CLD_DEPT_NAME) AS CLD_DEPT_NAME, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8, CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR, STRIP(CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME) AS CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME, STRIP(CPE_CPE_APPT_STS) AS CPE_CPE_APPT_STS FROM AC JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PT_MRN = AC_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER ON CPE_MRN = AC_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp', 'Can', 'Sch') AND CRE_RES_TYP IN ('Physician', 'Nurse Practitioner') AND CRE_RES_ID IN ('021113', '025676', '082727')

prompt: Daily report of pts scheduled in the OR with COVID results
completion: SELECT DISTINCT OC_MRN "MRN" , PT_LAST_NAME "Last Name" , PT_FIRST_NAME "First Name" , LOC_LOC_NAME "Location" , OC_SURG_DTE "Surgery Date" , CRE_RES_NAME "Primary Surgeon" , A.RESULT "COVID19 Result" , A.MIN_RESULT_DT "COVID19 Result Date" , OC_OR_CASE_STS "OR Case Status" FROM IDB.PATIENT_COVID_INFO_V A RIGHT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT OC_MRN, OC_SURG_DTE, OC_OR_CASE_STS, OC_OR_CASE_STS_CD, CRE_RES_NAME, CPX_PROC_NAME, OC_CASE_ID, OCAP_OR_PROC_ID, LOC_LOC_NAME FROM IDB.OR_CASE JOIN IDB.OR_CASE_ALL_PROC ON OC_CASE_ID = OCAP_CASE_ID JOIN IDB.OR_CASE_ALL_SURG ON OCAP_CASE_ID = OCAS_CASE_ID AND OCAS_PNL_NO = OCAP_PNL_NO AND OCAS_SURG_ROLE = 'Primary' JOIN IDB.OR_PROC ON OCAP_OR_PROC_ID = OP_OR_PROC_ID JOIN IDB.OR_CL_PROC ON OP_OR_PROC_ID = OCP_OR_PROC_ID JOIN IDB.CL_PROC ON OCP_PROC_ID = CPX_PROC_ID JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CRE_RES_ID = OCAS_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_LOCATION ON OC_SURG_LOC_ID = LOC_LOC_ID WHERE OC_MRN <> '' AND OC_OR_CASE_STS_CD IN ('1', '2') AND OC_SURG_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT date AND CURRENT date + 5 DAYS ) B ON A.MRN = OC_MRN JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON OC_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE 1=1 ORDER BY OC_SURG_DTE ASC ;

prompt: Provide a list of RN transcribed and verbal orders for GU chemo and GU Nursing staff from 10/1/2012 to 9/30/2013
completion: SELECT OUO_MRN MRN, OUO_ORD_NAME ORDNAME, OUO_ORD_ID ORDID, OUO_ENTER_DT ENTERDT, OUO_REQ_TME_PRIO TIMEPRIO, OUO_STS_DESC ORDSTS, OUO_REV_CAT_DEPT CAT_DEPT, OUO_CURR_LOC CURR_LOCATION, OUO_USER_NAME ENTEREDBY , OUO_USER_ROLE_TYPE ENTERED_ROLE, OU_LOGON_ID LOGONID, OUO_ORD_SOURCE ORD_SOURCE FROM IDB.OMS_ORDER JOIN IDB.OMS_USER_ORDERS ON OO_ORD_GUID = OUO_ORD_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_USER ON OO_USER_GUID = OU_USER_GUID WHERE OO_ENTER_DTE BETWEEN '2012-10-01' AND '2013-09-30' AND OUO_ORD_SOURCE IN ('.Transcribed Order', 'Verbal Order') AND OUO_USER_ROLE_TYPE IN ('Nurse', 'Chemo Nurse', 'Nurse Practitioner') AND OUO_CURR_LOC IN('Chemo GU 68 Unit', 'DTU 68 Unit') AND OUO_REQ_TME_PRIO = 'Administer in Clinic' AND OUO_ORD_STS_CD NOT LIKE 'CAN%'

prompt: Provide count of NSCLC cases from 2016 to present
Provide demographic, treatment, and IMPACT data for about list of patients who have consented to IMPACT.
Provide a list of Pediatric patients that live in the North Jersey catchment area that have been seen since  5/1/2021
completion: WITH PTS AS (SELECT CPE_MRN PEDS_MRN FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN '2021-05-01' AND CURRENT date AND (CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 = ('PED') OR CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_4 = ('PED') OR CLD_DEPT_NAME = 'ORTHOPEDICS 1275-9') AND CPE_CPE_IP_IND <> 'INPATIENT' UNION SELECT VIS_MRN PEDS_MRN FROM IDB.VISIT WHERE VIS_HOSP_SVC IN ('PDB', 'PDG', 'PDP', 'PDR', 'PDU', 'PED', 'PDS') AND VIS_IP_OP_ADJUSTED_IND = 'I' AND VIS_VISIT_STATUS IN ('2', '3') AND VIS_ADM_DTE BETWEEN '2021-05-01' AND CURRENT date ) , FINAL AS (SELECT PT_MRN MRN, PT_LAST_NAME LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME FIRST_NAME, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH DOB, YEAR(CURRENT date - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) CURRENT_AGE, PT_ZIP_CD ZIP, PT_COUNTY COUNTY, IIC_CATCHMENT FROM PTS JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PEDS_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.ZIPCODE ON LEFT(PT_ZIP_CD, 5) = ZC_ZIP JOIN IDB.ID_IP_IWT_CATCHMENT ON ZC_ZIP = IIC_ZIP_CD WHERE YEAR(CURRENT date - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) >= 12 AND IIC_CATCHMENT = 'Lower Hudson Valley' ) , APPTS AS (SELECT CPE_MRN AS "MRN", CPE_ENC_DTE AS "Appt Date", CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 AS "Department", CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 AS "Service", CLD_CLD_CENTER "Location", CLD_DEPT_NAME AS "Department Name", CRE_RES_NAME AS "Provider Name", CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME AS "Visit Type", ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CPE_MRN ORDER BY CPE_ENC_DTE DESC) RN FROM FINAL JOIN IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER ON MRN = CPE_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_1 NOT IN ('Reg', 'REG') AND CLD_CLD_CENTER = 'MAIN' AND CRE_RES_TYP = 'Physician' ) SELECT FINAL.MRN, LAST_NAME, FIRST_NAME, DOB, CURRENT_AGE, ZIP, COUNTY, IIC_CATCHMENT, "Appt Date", "Department Name", "Location" FROM FINAL LEFT JOIN APPTS ON FINAL.MRN = APPTS."MRN" AND RN = 1

prompt: Provide patient responses for specific questions on the Engage "Colorectal Scorecard" questionnaire.
completion: SELECT DISTINCT EF_MRN AS MRN , PT_LAST_NAME AS "Last Name" , PT_FIRST_NAME AS "First Name" , PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH AS "Date of Birth" , PT_DATE_OF_DEATH AS "Date of Death" , CASE WHEN PT_DATE_OF_DEATH IS NULL THEN YEAR(CURRENT date - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) END AS "Current Age" , CASE WHEN PT_DATE_OF_DEATH IS NULL THEN 'Alive' ELSE 'Deceased' END AS "Vital Status" , PT_SEX AS "Gender" , EF_FORM_NAME , DATE(EF_SUBMISSION_DT) AS SUBMIT_DTE , EFI_ITEM_EXTERNAL_ID AS QUES_ID , EFI_ITEM_ALIAS , EFI_VALUE AS ANSWER , EFI_ITEM_TEXT AS QUESTION , EFI_VALUE_TYPE , EF_FORM_ID FROM IDB.EF_ASSESSMENT EF JOIN IDB.EF_FORM ON EF_FORM_EXTERNAL_ID = EA_ASSESS_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.EF_FORM_ITEM EFI ON EF_FORM_ID = EFI_FORM_ID JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PT_MRN = EF_MRN WHERE 1=1 AND EF_FORM_NAME ='Colorectal Scorecard' AND EFI_ITEM_ALIAS IN ('colorectal_importance', 'colorectal_priority_other', 'column_0') ORDER BY EF_MRN, EF_FORM_NAME, EF_FORM_ID, EFI_ITEM_EXTERNAL_ID DESC

prompt: Provide all "HLA Antibody Screen, Class I and Class II" CIS results from MSK Histocompatibility Lab from 5/1/2022 to 12/31/2022.
completion: WITH X AS (SELECT DISTINCT PT_FIRST_NAME FIRST_NAME, PT_LAST_NAME LAST_NAME, LR_MRN MRN, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH DATE_OF_BIRTH, LR_TEST_NAME TEST_NAME, LR_SUBTEST_NAME SUBTEST_NAME, LR_PERFORMED_DTE TEST_DATE, LR_RESULT_VALUE RESULT_VALUE, LTL_TEXT_RESULT TEXT_RESULTS, LR_RESULT_TYPE_CD RESULT_TYPE_CD, LR_RESULT_STS_CD RESULT_STATUS_CD, LR_RESULT_GUID GUID, LR_ACCESSION_NO ACCNO FROM IDB.LAB_RESULTS LEFT JOIN IDB.LAB_TEXT_LINE ON LTL_RESULT_GUID = LR_RESULT_GUID JOIN IDB.PATIENT P ON LR_MRN =PT_MRN WHERE LR_PERFORMED_DTE BETWEEN '2022-05-01' AND '2022-12-31' AND LR_TEST_NAME = ('HLA AntiBODY Screen, Class I and Class II') AND LR_SUBTEST_NAME IN ('HLA Class I AntiBODY Screen Result', 'HLA Class II AntiBODY Screen Result', 'Test Comments', 'Performed Date', 'HLA Class I Antibodies MFI 1000-4000', 'HLA Class I Antibodies MFI 4001-10000 ', 'HLA Class I Antibodies MFI >10000', 'HLA Class I Antibody Interpretation', 'HLA CLASS I Antibody ID Performed Date', 'HLA Class II Antibodies MFI 1000-4000', 'HLA Class II Antibodies MFI 4001-10000 ', 'HLA Class II Antibodies MFI >10000', 'HLA Class II Antibody Interpretation', 'HLA Class II Antibody ID Performed Date', 'Test Methodology', 'HLA Methodology Comments', 'HLA Blood Specimen Source', 'Adult or Pediatric Service', 'Recipient Diagnosis', 'ASHI Laboratory Director') ) SELECT DISTINCT X.MRN, X.ACCNO, X.TEST_NAME, X.TEST_DATE, A.SUBTEST_NAME AS HLA_CLASS_I_AB_SCREEN_RESULT, A.RESULT_VALUE AS RESULT, A.TEXT_RESULTS , A.RESULT_TYPE_CD, A.RESULT_STATUS_CD, B.SUBTEST_NAME AS HLA_CLASS_II_AB_SCREEN_RESULT, B.RESULT_VALUE AS RESULT, B.TEXT_RESULTS , B.RESULT_TYPE_CD, B.RESULT_STATUS_CD, C.SUBTEST_NAME AS TEST_COMMENTS, C.RESULT_VALUE AS RESULT, C.TEXT_RESULTS , C.RESULT_TYPE_CD, C.RESULT_STATUS_CD, D.SUBTEST_NAME AS PERFORMED_DATE, D.RESULT_VALUE AS RESULT, D.TEXT_RESULTS , D.RESULT_TYPE_CD, D.RESULT_STATUS_CD, E.SUBTEST_NAME AS HLA_CLASS_I_AB_MFI_1000_4000, E.RESULT_VALUE AS RESULT, E.TEXT_RESULTS , E.RESULT_TYPE_CD, E.RESULT_STATUS_CD, F.SUBTEST_NAME AS HLA_CLASS_I_AB_MFI_4001_10000, F.RESULT_VALUE AS RESULT, F.TEXT_RESULTS , F.RESULT_TYPE_CD, F.RESULT_STATUS_CD, G.SUBTEST_NAME AS HLA_CLASS_I_AB_MFI_10000, G.RESULT_VALUE AS RESULT, G.TEXT_RESULTS , G.RESULT_TYPE_CD, G.RESULT_STATUS_CD, H.SUBTEST_NAME AS HLA_CLASS_I_AB_INTERPRETATION, H.RESULT_VALUE AS RESULT, H.TEXT_RESULTS , H.RESULT_TYPE_CD, H.RESULT_STATUS_CD, I.SUBTEST_NAME AS HLA_CLASS_I_AB_ID_PERFORMED_DATE, I.RESULT_VALUE AS RESULT, I.TEXT_RESULTS , I.RESULT_TYPE_CD, I.RESULT_STATUS_CD, J.SUBTEST_NAME AS HLA_CLASS_II_AB_MFI_1000_4000, J.RESULT_VALUE AS RESULT, J.TEXT_RESULTS , J.RESULT_VALUE, J.RESULT_TYPE_CD, J.RESULT_STATUS_CD, K.SUBTEST_NAME AS HLA_CLASS_II_AB_MFI_4001_10000, K.RESULT_VALUE AS RESULT, K.TEXT_RESULTS , K.RESULT_TYPE_CD, K.RESULT_STATUS_CD, L.SUBTEST_NAME AS HLA_CLASS_II_AB_MFI_10000, L.RESULT_VALUE AS RESULT, L.TEXT_RESULTS , L.RESULT_TYPE_CD, L.RESULT_STATUS_CD, M.SUBTEST_NAME AS HLA_CLASS_II_AB_INTERPRETATION, M.RESULT_VALUE AS RESULT, M.TEXT_RESULTS , M.RESULT_TYPE_CD, M.RESULT_STATUS_CD, N.SUBTEST_NAME AS HLA_CLASS_II_AB_ID_PERFORMED_DATE, N.RESULT_VALUE AS RESULT, N.TEXT_RESULTS , N.RESULT_TYPE_CD, N.RESULT_STATUS_CD, O.SUBTEST_NAME AS TEST_METHODOLOGY, O.RESULT_VALUE AS RESULT, O.TEXT_RESULTS , O.RESULT_TYPE_CD, O.RESULT_STATUS_CD, P.SUBTEST_NAME AS HLA_METHODOLOGY_COMMENTS, P.RESULT_VALUE AS RESULT, P.TEXT_RESULTS , P.RESULT_TYPE_CD, P.RESULT_STATUS_CD, Q.SUBTEST_NAME AS HLA_BLOOD_SPECIMEN_SOURCE, Q.RESULT_VALUE AS RESULT, Q.TEXT_RESULTS , Q.RESULT_TYPE_CD, Q.RESULT_STATUS_CD, R.SUBTEST_NAME AS ADULT_OR_PEDIATRIC_SERVICE, R.RESULT_VALUE AS RESULT, R.TEXT_RESULTS, R.RESULT_TYPE_CD, R.RESULT_STATUS_CD, S.SUBTEST_NAME AS RECIPIENT_DIAGNOSIS, S.RESULT_VALUE AS RESULT, S.TEXT_RESULTS , S.RESULT_TYPE_CD, S.RESULT_STATUS_CD, T.SUBTEST_NAME AS ASHI_LABORATORY_DIRECTOR, T.RESULT_VALUE AS RESULT, T.TEXT_RESULTS , T.RESULT_TYPE_CD, T.RESULT_STATUS_CD FROM X LEFT OUTER JOIN X A ON A.MRN = X.MRN AND X.ACCNO= A.ACCNO AND A.SUBTEST_NAME = 'HLA Class I AntiBODY Screen Result' LEFT OUTER JOIN X B ON B.MRN = X.MRN AND X.ACCNO= B.ACCNO AND B.SUBTEST_NAME = 'HLA Class II AntiBODY Screen Result' LEFT OUTER JOIN X C ON C.MRN = X.MRN AND X.ACCNO= C.ACCNO AND C.SUBTEST_NAME = 'Test Comments' LEFT OUTER JOIN X D ON D.MRN = X.MRN AND X.ACCNO= D.ACCNO AND D.SUBTEST_NAME = 'Performed Date' LEFT OUTER JOIN X E ON E.MRN = X.MRN AND X.ACCNO= E.ACCNO AND E.SUBTEST_NAME = 'HLA Class I Antibodies MFI 1000-4000' LEFT OUTER JOIN X F ON F.MRN = X.MRN AND X.ACCNO= F.ACCNO AND F.SUBTEST_NAME = 'HLA Class I Antibodies MFI 4001-10000' LEFT OUTER JOIN X G ON G.MRN = X.MRN AND X.ACCNO= G.ACCNO AND G.SUBTEST_NAME = 'HLA Class I Antibodies MFI >10000' LEFT OUTER JOIN X H ON H.MRN = X.MRN AND X.ACCNO= H.ACCNO AND H.SUBTEST_NAME = 'HLA Class I Antibody Interpretation' LEFT OUTER JOIN X I ON I.MRN = X.MRN AND X.ACCNO= I.ACCNO AND I.SUBTEST_NAME = 'HLA CLASS I Antibody ID Performed Date' LEFT OUTER JOIN X J ON J.MRN = X.MRN AND X.ACCNO= J.ACCNO AND J.SUBTEST_NAME = 'HLA Class II Antibodies MFI 1000-4000' LEFT OUTER JOIN X K ON K.MRN = X.MRN AND X.ACCNO= K.ACCNO AND K.SUBTEST_NAME = 'HLA Class II Antibodies MFI 4001-10000' LEFT OUTER JOIN X L ON L.MRN = X.MRN AND X.ACCNO= L.ACCNO AND L.SUBTEST_NAME = 'HLA Class II Antibodies MFI >10000' LEFT OUTER JOIN X M ON M.MRN = X.MRN AND X.ACCNO= M.ACCNO AND M.SUBTEST_NAME = 'HLA Class II Antibody Interpretation' LEFT OUTER JOIN X N ON N.MRN = X.MRN AND X.ACCNO= N.ACCNO AND N.SUBTEST_NAME = 'HLA Class II Antibody ID Performed Date' LEFT OUTER JOIN X O ON O.MRN = X.MRN AND X.ACCNO= O.ACCNO AND O.SUBTEST_NAME = 'Test Methodology' LEFT OUTER JOIN X P ON P.MRN = X.MRN AND X.ACCNO= P.ACCNO AND P.SUBTEST_NAME = 'HLA Methodology Comments' LEFT OUTER JOIN X Q ON Q.MRN = X.MRN AND X.ACCNO= Q.ACCNO AND Q.SUBTEST_NAME = 'HLA Blood Specimen Source' LEFT OUTER JOIN X R ON R.MRN = X.MRN AND X.ACCNO= R.ACCNO AND R.SUBTEST_NAME = 'Adult or Pediatric Service' LEFT OUTER JOIN X S ON S.MRN = X.MRN AND X.ACCNO= S.ACCNO AND S.SUBTEST_NAME = 'Recipient Diagnosis' LEFT OUTER JOIN X T ON T.MRN = X.MRN AND X.ACCNO= T.ACCNO AND T.SUBTEST_NAME = 'ASHI Laboratory Director'

prompt: Provide information on inpatient deaths.
completion: SELECT PT_MRN, PT_DATE_OF_DEATH, YEAR(PT_DATE_OF_DEATH) AS YEAR, PT_DEATH_IND FROM IDB.PATIENT WHERE PT_DEATH_IND IN ('C', 'D') AND PT_DATE_OF_DEATH BETWEEN '2016-01-01' AND '2018-12-31'

prompt: Patients with a diagnosis of pancreatic cancer and had more than one appointment in Cadence
completion: WITH DX AS (SELECT CC_MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS DX_DTE FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE SUBSTR(CC_CLSF_CD, 1, 3) IN ('157', 'C25') AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND (CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) GROUP BY CC_MRN HAVING MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) BETWEEN '2012-01-01' AND '2019-12-31') , PT AS (SELECT CPE_MRN, DX_DTE, COUNT(*) APPTS FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID JOIN DX ON CPE_MRN = CC_MRN WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN '2012-01-01' AND '2019-12-31' GROUP BY CPE_MRN, DX_DTE HAVING COUNT(*) > 1) , CHEMO AS (SELECT APR_MRN, CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME, MIN(APR_START_DTE) FIRST_CHEMO_START, MAX(APR_START_DTE) LAST_CHEMO_START FROM IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX_V JOIN PT ON APR_MRN = CPE_MRN WHERE CDG_CHEMO_FLAG = 'Y' AND APR_START_DTE BETWEEN '2012-01-01' AND '2019-12-31' GROUP BY APR_MRN, CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME) , BMI AS (SELECT DISTINCT PMH_MRN, CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME CHEMO_NAME, FIRST_CHEMO_START CHEMO_START, PMH_MEASURE_DTE, PMH_BMI, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY PMH_MRN, CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME, FIRST_CHEMO_START ORDER BY ABS(FIRST_CHEMO_START - PMH_MEASURE_DTE) ASC) AS RN FROM IDB.PT_MEASURES_HX JOIN CHEMO ON PMH_MRN = APR_MRN) , TM AS (SELECT DISTINCT TM_MRN, TM_DX_DTE, TM_HIST_CD, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS HIST_DESC, TM_SITE_CD, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_DESC, TM_CLIN_STG_GRP, TM_PATH_STG_GRP, TM_RAD_STRT_DTE, TM_RAD_END_DTE, TM_REG_RAD_DOSE, TM_BOOST_RAD_DOSE FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD JOIN PT ON CPE_MRN = TM_MRN WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND TM_SITE_CD LIKE 'C25%' ) SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN "MRN", PT_LAST_NAME "Last Name", PT_FIRST_NAME "First Name", PT_SEX "Gender", PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH "Date of Birth", PT_DATE_OF_DEATH "Date of Death", DX_DTE "Diagnosis Date", CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME "Chemo Name", FIRST_CHEMO_START "First Chemo Start Date", LAST_CHEMO_START "Last Chemo Start Date", PMH_BMI "BMI", PMH_MEASURE_DTE "BMI Measure Date", TM_DX_DTE, TM_HIST_CD, HIST_DESC, TM_SITE_CD, SITE_DESC, TM_CLIN_STG_GRP, TM_PATH_STG_GRP, TM_RAD_STRT_DTE, TM_RAD_END_DTE, TM_REG_RAD_DOSE, TM_BOOST_RAD_DOSE FROM PT JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON CPE_MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN CHEMO ON CPE_MRN = APR_MRN LEFT JOIN BMI ON APR_MRN = PMH_MRN AND CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME = CHEMO_NAME AND FIRST_CHEMO_START = CHEMO_START AND RN = 1 LEFT JOIN TM ON CPE_MRN = TM_MRN ORDER BY CPE_MRN, FIRST_CHEMO_START ; WITH DX AS (SELECT CC_MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS DX_DTE FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE SUBSTR(CC_CLSF_CD, 1, 3) IN ('157', 'C25') AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND (CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) GROUP BY CC_MRN HAVING MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) BETWEEN '2012-01-01' AND '2019-12-31') , PT AS (SELECT CPE_MRN, DX_DTE, COUNT(*) APPTS FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID JOIN DX ON CPE_MRN = CC_MRN WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN '2012-01-01' AND '2019-12-31' GROUP BY CPE_MRN, DX_DTE HAVING COUNT(*) > 1) SELECT DISTINCT RTC_TX_MRN "MRN", PT_LAST_NAME "Last Name", PT_FIRST_NAME "First Name", RTC_TX_START_DTE "Rad Start Date", RTC_TX_STOP_DTE "Rad Stop Date", RTC_TX_PLAN_NAME "Rad Site", RTC_TX_DELIVERED_FRACTIONS "Delivered Fraction", RTC_TX_DELIVERED_DOSE "Delivered Dose" FROM IDB.RADONC_TREATMENT_COURSE JOIN PT ON RTC_TX_MRN = CPE_MRN JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON CPE_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE RTC_TX_START_DTE BETWEEN '2012-01-01' AND '2019-12-31' ORDER BY 1, 4 ; WITH DX AS (SELECT CC_MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS DX_DTE FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE SUBSTR(CC_CLSF_CD, 1, 3) IN ('157', 'C25') AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND (CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) GROUP BY CC_MRN HAVING MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) BETWEEN '2012-01-01' AND '2019-12-31') , PT AS (SELECT CPE_MRN, DX_DTE, COUNT(*) APPTS FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID JOIN DX ON CPE_MRN = CC_MRN WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN '2012-01-01' AND '2019-12-31' GROUP BY CPE_MRN, DX_DTE HAVING COUNT(*) > 1) , LABS AS (SELECT LR_MRN, LR_PERFORMED_DTE, LR_TEST_NAME, LR_SUBTEST_NAME, LR_RESULT_VALUE, LTL_TEXT_RESULT FROM IDB.LAB_RESULTS JOIN PT ON LR_MRN = CPE_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.LAB_TEXT_LINE ON LTL_RESULT_GUID = LR_RESULT_GUID WHERE LR_PERFORMED_DTE BETWEEN '2012-01-01' AND '2019-12-31' AND LR_TEST_NAME IN ('Cancer Antigen 19-9', 'CEA') ) SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN "MRN", PT_LAST_NAME "Last Name", PT_FIRST_NAME "First Name", DX_DTE "Diagnosis Date", LR_SUBTEST_NAME "Lab Test Name", LR_PERFORMED_DTE "Lab Performed Date", LR_RESULT_VALUE "Lab Result Value", LTL_TEXT_RESULT "Lab Result Text" FROM PT JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON CPE_MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN LABS ON CPE_MRN = LR_MRN ORDER BY CPE_MRN, LR_SUBTEST_NAME, LR_PERFORMED_DTE

prompt: Weekly list of patients with mammographically dense breasts and no signs of malignancy who are coming in for a routine DBT mammogram.
completion: WITH APPTS AS (SELECT CPE_ENC_DTE AS "Appt Date", TIME(CPE_APPT_DT) AS "Appt Time", CPE_MRN AS "MRN", PT_LAST_NAME "Last Name", PT_FIRST_NAME "First Name", PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH "DOB", CLD_DEPT_NAME AS "Department Name", CLD_CLD_CENTER AS "Location", CRE_RES_NAME AS "Provider Name", CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME AS "Visit Type" FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON CPE_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE 1=1 AND CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Sch') AND CRE_RES_NAME = 'MAMMO 300 E66-GDC' AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT date + 7 AND CURRENT date + 14 DAYS ORDER BY CPE_ENC_DTE, TIME(CPE_APPT_DT) ASC) , DENSE_RAD AS (SELECT RRPT_MRN , RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE , RRPT_ORDER_GROUP , RRPT_PROCEDURE_NAME FROM DV.RADIOLOGY_REPORT_V JOIN APPTS ON "MRN" = RRPT_MRN AND RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE <= "Appt Date" WHERE 1=1 AND CONTAINS("RRPT_REPORT_TXT", '("extremely dense" OR "dense tissue" OR "dense breast" OR "heterogeneously dense")') = 1 AND RRPT_PROCEDURE_NAME like '%TOMO%' ) , BREAST_DX AS (SELECT CC_MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS MIN_ICD_EFF_DTE, CC_CLSF_CD AS ICD_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS ICD_DESC FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN APPTS ON "MRN" = CC_MRN WHERE SUBSTR(CC_CLSF_CD, 1, 3) IN ('174', '175', 'C50') AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' GROUP BY CC_MRN, CC_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK ) SELECT DISTINCT "MRN" , "Last Name" , "First Name" , YEAR(CURRENT date - "DOB") AS "Age" , "Appt Date" , "Appt Time" , "Provider Name" , "Location" , "Visit Type" FROM APPTS JOIN DENSE_RAD ON "MRN" = RRPT_MRN LEFT JOIN BREAST_DX ON "MRN" = CC_MRN WHERE 1=1 AND YEAR(CURRENT date - "DOB") BETWEEN 45 AND 74 AND CC_MRN IS NULL ;

prompt: Create a report assessing the incidence of anaplastic large cell lymphoma in breast implant patients.
completion: WITH X AS (SELECT DISTINCT PBD_MRN, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH AS DOB, CLM_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK, PBC_PBD_DESC, PBD_SVC_DTE FROM IDB.PBD_DTL JOIN IDB.PBD_CODE ON PBD_PBD_CD = PBC_PBD_CD JOIN IDB.CLM ON PBC_CPT_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PBD_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE CLM_CLSF_CD IN ('19357') AND PBD_SVC_DTE BETWEEN '2016-12-01' AND '2018-12-01' ) , Y AS (SELECT PBD_MRN, DOB, CLM_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK, PBC_PBD_DESC, PBD_SVC_DTE, CDD_MRN, CDD_DOC_GUID, CDD_SERVICE_DTE, CDD_DOC_NAME, CDO_SECTION, CDO_CTLG_DISPL_NM, CDO_MSTR_ITEM_NM, CDO_ITEM_NAME, STRIP(SUBSTR(CDO_VALUE_TEXT, 1, 2000)) AS CDO_VALUE_TEXT FROM X LEFT JOIN IDB.CD_DOCUMENT ON CDD_MRN = PBD_MRN AND CDD_CANCEL_IND = '0' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND = '0' AND CDD_DOC_NAME = 'Operative Report, Tissue Expander - Plastic' AND CDD_SERVICE_DTE BETWEEN '2016-12-01' AND '2018-12-01' LEFT JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION ON CDO_DOC_GUID = CDD_DOC_GUID AND CDO_AUTHORED_DTE = CDD_AUTHORED_DTE ) , CD AS (SELECT DISTINCT CDD_MRN, CDD_DOC_GUID, CDD_SERVICE_DTE, CDD_DOC_NAME, CDO_MSTR_ITEM_NM, CDO_ITEM_NAME, CDO_VALUE_TEXT FROM Y WHERE CDD_DOC_GUID <> '' ) , CD1 AS (SELECT CDD_DOC_GUID, CDO_VALUE_TEXT AS "Procedure" FROM CD WHERE CDO_MSTR_ITEM_NM IN ('PLA_OP_IF_ProcedureDisplay1', 'PLA_OP_IF_ProcedureDisplay2') ) , CD2 AS (SELECT CDD_DOC_GUID, CDO_VALUE_TEXT AS "Indications" FROM CD WHERE CDO_MSTR_ITEM_NM IN ('OP_PLA_Indications FT') ) , CD3 AS (SELECT CDD_DOC_GUID, CDO_VALUE_TEXT AS "AlloDerm Position" FROM CD WHERE CDO_MSTR_ITEM_NM IN ('OP_PLA_TE_AlloDerm position (other) FT') ) , CD4 AS (SELECT CDD_DOC_GUID, CDO_VALUE_TEXT AS "Muscle(s) elevated" FROM CD WHERE CDO_MSTR_ITEM_NM IN ('OP_PLA_Muscle(s) elevated with Electrocautery RES') ) , CD5 AS (SELECT CDD_DOC_GUID, CDO_VALUE_TEXT AS "Other Muscles Elevated" FROM CD WHERE CDO_MSTR_ITEM_NM IN ('OP_PLA_Other Muscles Elevated FT') ) , CD6 AS (SELECT CDD_DOC_GUID, CDO_VALUE_TEXT AS "Muscle Closure" FROM CD WHERE CDO_MSTR_ITEM_NM IN ('OP_PLA_Muscle Closure (other) FT') ) , CD7 AS (SELECT CDD_DOC_GUID, CDO_VALUE_TEXT AS "Additional Details" FROM CD WHERE CDO_MSTR_ITEM_NM IN ('OP_PLA_Additional Details FT') ) , CD_FINAL AS (SELECT DISTINCT CD.CDD_MRN, CD.CDD_DOC_GUID, CD.CDD_SERVICE_DTE, CD.CDD_DOC_NAME, "Procedure", "Indications", "AlloDerm Position", "Muscle(s) elevated", "Other Muscles Elevated", "Muscle Closure", "Additional Details" FROM CD LEFT JOIN CD1 ON CD.CDD_DOC_GUID = CD1.CDD_DOC_GUID LEFT JOIN CD2 ON CD.CDD_DOC_GUID = CD2.CDD_DOC_GUID LEFT JOIN CD3 ON CD.CDD_DOC_GUID = CD3.CDD_DOC_GUID LEFT JOIN CD4 ON CD.CDD_DOC_GUID = CD4.CDD_DOC_GUID LEFT JOIN CD5 ON CD.CDD_DOC_GUID = CD5.CDD_DOC_GUID LEFT JOIN CD6 ON CD.CDD_DOC_GUID = CD6.CDD_DOC_GUID LEFT JOIN CD7 ON CD.CDD_DOC_GUID = CD7.CDD_DOC_GUID) SELECT DISTINCT Y.PBD_MRN, DOB, CLM_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK, PBC_PBD_DESC, PBD_SVC_DTE, CD_FINAL.CDD_DOC_GUID, CD_FINAL.CDD_DOC_NAME, CD_FINAL.CDD_SERVICE_DTE, DAYS(CD_FINAL.CDD_SERVICE_DTE) - DAYS(PBD_SVC_DTE) AS DAYS_DIFF, "Muscle(s) elevated", "Other Muscles Elevated", "Muscle Closure", "Procedure", "Indications", "AlloDerm Position", "Additional Details" FROM Y LEFT JOIN CD_FINAL ON CD_FINAL.CDD_MRN = Y.CDD_MRN

prompt: Provide a one-time list of all patients with adrenal cortical carcinoma (ACC) who have received pembrolizumab at MSKCC from 2015 to the present
completion: WITH DIAG AS (SELECT DISTINCT CC_MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS MIN_ICD9_EFF_DTE, CC_CLSF_CD AS ICD9_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS ICD9_DESC FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE 1=1 AND CC_CLSF_CD IN ('C74.00', 'C74.01', 'C74.02', 'C74.10', 'C74.11', 'C74.12', 'C74.90', 'C74.91', 'C74.92', '194.0') AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND (CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) GROUP BY CC_MRN, CC_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK ) SELECT DISTINCT APR_MRN AS MRN, FIRST_NAME, LAST_NAME, DRUG_START_DATE FROM (SELECT APR_MRN, PT_FIRST_NAME AS FIRST_NAME, PT_LAST_NAME AS LAST_NAME, APR_START_DTE AS DRUG_START_DATE, ICD9_DESC, ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY APR_MRN ORDER BY APR_START_DTE ASC) AS RN FROM IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX JOIN IDB.CHEMO_DRUG_GENERIC ON APR_GENERIC_NAME = CDG_GENERIC_NAME JOIN DIAG ON CC_MRN = APR_MRN JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PT_MRN = APR_MRN JOIN IDB.ACCRUALS ON AC_MRN = APR_MRN WHERE 1=1 AND CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME IN('PEMBROLIZUMAB' ) AND APR_START_DTE BETWEEN '2015-01-01' AND '2021-09-01' ) WHERE RN = 1

prompt: Requesting a list of all patients who have received belumosudil inpatient
completion: SELECT DISTINCT HCPR_MRN , OCV_IP_OP_IND AS "Patient Indicator" , CASE WHEN HCPR_START_DT IS NOT NULL AND HCPR_START_DT > HCPR_CREATED_DT THEN HCPR_START_DT ELSE HCPR_CREATED_DT END AS "Drug Start Date" , HCPR_END_DT AS "Drug End Date" , HCPR_DISCONTINUE_DT AS "Drug Discontinued Date" , HCPR_DRUG_NAME AS "Drug Name" , HCPR_DOSE_AMT AS "Dose" , UOM.HRUM_NAME AS "Unit Of Measure" , HCPR_ROUTE ROUTE , GDCY_THERAPEUTIC_CATEGORY AS "Therapy Category" , HCPR_STATUS_TYPE_DESC AS "Prescription Status" , HCPR_PRESCRIPTION_TYPE_DESC AS "RX Type" , HCPR_INSTRUCTIONS INSTRUCTIONS , HCPR_COMMENTS COMMENTS FROM IDB.HML_CLIENT_PRESCRIPTION JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON HCPR_MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_CLIENT_VISIT ON OCV_VISIT_GUID = HCPR_VISIT_GUID LEFT JOIN IDB.HML_GENERIC_NAME ON HGN_GENERIC_NAME_ID = HCPR_GENERIC_NAME_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_USER USR ON USR.OU_USER_GUID = HCPR_USER_GUID LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_USER REQ ON REQ.OU_USER_GUID = HCPR_CARE_PROV_GUID LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_PROVIDER ON HCPR_CARE_PROV_GUID = OP_PVDR_GUID LEFT JOIN IDB.DOC PR ON OP_PVDR_NO = PR.DOC_DR_NO LEFT JOIN IDB.DOC ATN ON OCV_ATT_DR_NO = ATN.DOC_DR_NO LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_SERVICE ON OCV_SVC_GUID = OS_SVC_GUID LEFT JOIN IDB.HML_RX_UNIT_OF_MEASURE UOM ON UOM.HRUM_RXUOM_ID = HCPR_DOSE_UOM_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.HML_RX_UNIT_OF_MEASURE PKG ON PKG.HRUM_RXUOM_ID = HCPR_INNER_PACKAGE_SIZE_UOM_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.HML_SCRIPT_FREQUENCY ON HSF_SCRIPT_FREQ_ID = HCPR_SCRIPT_FREQ_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.RXW_PHARMACY ON HCPR_PHARMACY_ID = RPH_PHARMACY_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.GENERIC_DRUG_CATEGORY_V ON HGN_DRUG_CATALOG_KEY = GDCY_CAT_DRUG_KEY WHERE OCV_IP_OP_IND = 'I' AND CASE WHEN HCPR_START_DT IS NOT NULL AND HCPR_START_DT > HCPR_CREATED_DT THEN HCPR_START_DT ELSE HCPR_CREATED_DT END BETWEEN '2021-01-01' AND '2023-10-31' AND (UPPER(HCPR_DRUG_NAME) LIKE '%BELUMOSUDIL%' OR UPPER(HGN_GENERIC_NAME) LIKE '%BELUMOSUDIL%' OR UPPER(HCPR_DRUG_NAME) LIKE '%REZURO%' OR UPPER(HGN_GENERIC_NAME) LIKE '%REZURO%') AND HCPR_STATUS_TYPE NOT IN (4, 8, 2, 5) AND(HCPR_PRESCRIPTION_TYPE = 1 AND HCPR_TRANSMISSION_STATUS IN (1, 5) OR HCPR_PRESCRIPTION_TYPE = 3) ORDER BY HCPR_MRN

prompt: List of Patients with mutant lung cancer with CNS metastases including leptomeningeal disease and brain metastases, who have MSK-IMPACT or sequencing done on brain  samples.
completion: WITH LUNG AS (SELECT DISTINCT PDWS_NAME, PT_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, EXON_NUM, AA_CHANGE, CDNA_CHANGE, PART_DESCRIPTION, DT_PROCEDURE, SAMPLEID, TUMOR_TYPE_NAME, PRIMARY_SITE, METASTASIS_SITE FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML INNER JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT ON PDRX_PATH_RPT_ID = PRPT_PATH_RPT_ID LEFT JOIN DV.DATE DTRPT ON PRPT_REPORT_DATE_ID = DTRPT.DT_DATE_ID LEFT JOIN DV.DATE DTPROCPATHRPT ON PRPT_PROCEDURE_DATE_ID = DTPROCPATHRPT.DT_DATE_ID INNER JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML_SETTINGS ON PDRX_PATH_DMP_RESULTS_XML_ID = PDRXS_PATH_DMP_RESULTS_XML_ID INNER JOIN DVDMC.PATHOLOGY_DMP_WEBSVC_SETTINGS ON PDRXS_SETTING_ID = PDWS_SETTING_ID INNER JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON PDRX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID, XMLTABLE('$c/root/*' PASSING PDRX_XML_VALUE AS "c" COLUMNS TOTAL_NUMBER_VARIANTS int PATH 'count(../*[not(name()=''meta-data'')])', VARIANT_CLASS VARCHAR(100) PATH 'variant_class', EXON_NUM VARCHAR(100) PATH 'exon_num', AA_CHANGE VARCHAR(100) PATH 'aa_change', CDNA_CHANGE VARCHAR(100) PATH 'cDNA_change', GENE_ID VARCHAR(100) PATH 'gene_id', NORMAL_DP VARCHAR(100) PATH 'normal_dp', TUMOR_DP VARCHAR(100) PATH 'tumor_dp', NORMAL_AD VARCHAR(100) PATH 'normal_ad', TUMOR_AD VARCHAR(100) PATH 'tumor_ad', TUMOR_VFREQ VARCHAR(100) PATH 'tumor_vfreq', START_POSITION int PATH 'start_position', ALT_ALLELE VARCHAR(255) PATH 'alt_allele', REF_ALLELE VARCHAR(255) PATH 'ref_allele', VARIANT_TYPE VARCHAR(100) PATH './local-name(.)', PART_DESCRIPTION VARCHAR(2000) PATH '../meta-data/part_description', SAMPLEID VARCHAR(100) PATH '../meta-data/dmp_sample_id', PATIENTID VARCHAR(100) PATH '../meta-data/dmp_patient_id', TUMOR_TYPE_CODE VARCHAR(100) PATH '../meta-data/tumor_type_code', TUMOR_TYPE_NAME VARCHAR(255) PATH '../meta-data/tumor_type_name', IS_METASTASIS VARCHAR(10) PATH '../meta-data/is_metastasis', PRIMARY_SITE VARCHAR(255) PATH '../meta-data/primary_site', METASTASIS_SITE VARCHAR(255) PATH '../meta-data/metastasis_site', DT_PROCEDURE VARCHAR(40) PATH '../meta-data/dt_procedure') T CROSS JOIN TABLE(DV.DMP_XML_MAF(VARIANT_TYPE, REF_ALLELE, ALT_ALLELE, START_POSITION, TUMOR_DP, TUMOR_AD, VARIANT_CLASS)) WHERE 1=1 AND PDWS_NAME = 'IMPACT' AND GENE_ID = 'EGFR' AND PRIMARY_SITE = 'Lung' AND IS_METASTASIS = '1' AND (METASTASIS_SITE like 'Brain%' OR UPPER(METASTASIS_SITE) IN ('CNS', 'CSF', 'csf')) AND (TOTAL_NUMBER_VARIANTS =0 OR VARIANT_TYPE <> 'meta-data') ) , DX AS (SELECT CC_MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS ICD_DATE, CC_CLSF_CD AS ICD_CODE, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS ICD_DESC FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN LUNG ON PT_MRN = CC_MRN AND CC_CLSF_CD IN ('C79.31', 'C79.32', '198.3', '198.4') WHERE 1=1 AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND (CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) GROUP BY CC_MRN, CC_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK HAVING MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) BETWEEN '2014-01-01' AND CURRENT date) , OTH AS (SELECT P.* FROM (SELECT PDWS_NAME, PT_MRN, PART_DESCRIPTION, DT_PROCEDURE , PRIMARY_SITE, METASTASIS_SITE FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML INNER JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT ON PDRX_PATH_RPT_ID = PRPT_PATH_RPT_ID LEFT JOIN DV.DATE DTRPT ON PRPT_REPORT_DATE_ID = DTRPT.DT_DATE_ID LEFT JOIN DV.DATE DTPROCPATHRPT ON PRPT_PROCEDURE_DATE_ID = DTPROCPATHRPT.DT_DATE_ID INNER JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML_SETTINGS ON PDRX_PATH_DMP_RESULTS_XML_ID = PDRXS_PATH_DMP_RESULTS_XML_ID INNER JOIN DVDMC.PATHOLOGY_DMP_WEBSVC_SETTINGS ON PDRXS_SETTING_ID = PDWS_SETTING_ID INNER JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON PDRX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID, XMLTABLE('$c/root/*' PASSING PDRX_XML_VALUE AS "c" COLUMNS TOTAL_NUMBER_VARIANTS int PATH 'count(../*[not(name()=''meta-data'')])', VARIANT_CLASS VARCHAR(100) PATH 'variant_class', GENE_ID VARCHAR(100) PATH 'gene_id', NORMAL_DP VARCHAR(100) PATH 'normal_dp', TUMOR_DP VARCHAR(100) PATH 'tumor_dp', NORMAL_AD VARCHAR(100) PATH 'normal_ad', TUMOR_AD VARCHAR(100) PATH 'tumor_ad', START_POSITION int PATH 'start_position', ALT_ALLELE VARCHAR(255) PATH 'alt_allele', REF_ALLELE VARCHAR(255) PATH 'ref_allele', VARIANT_TYPE VARCHAR(100) PATH './local-name(.)', PART_DESCRIPTION VARCHAR(2000) PATH '../meta-data/part_description', IS_METASTASIS VARCHAR(10) PATH '../meta-data/is_metastasis', PRIMARY_SITE VARCHAR(255) PATH '../meta-data/primary_site', METASTASIS_SITE VARCHAR(255) PATH '../meta-data/metastasis_site', DT_PROCEDURE VARCHAR(40) PATH '../meta-data/dt_procedure') T CROSS JOIN TABLE(DV.DMP_XML_MAF(VARIANT_TYPE, REF_ALLELE, ALT_ALLELE, START_POSITION, TUMOR_DP, TUMOR_AD, VARIANT_CLASS)) WHERE 1=1 AND PDWS_NAME = 'IMPACT' AND GENE_ID = 'EGFR' AND PRIMARY_SITE = 'Lung' AND IS_METASTASIS = '1' AND METASTASIS_SITE NOT like 'Brain%' AND (TOTAL_NUMBER_VARIANTS =0 OR VARIANT_TYPE <> 'meta-data') ) P JOIN LUNG L ON L.PT_MRN = P.PT_MRN) SELECT DISTINCT L.PT_MRN AS MRN, L.PT_LAST_NAME AS LAST_NAME, L.EXON_NUM, L.AA_CHANGE, L.CDNA_CHANGE, L.PART_DESCRIPTION BRAIN_SPECIMEN, L.DT_PROCEDURE AS BRAIN_SP_PROC_DATE, L.SAMPLEID AS SAMPLE_ID, L.TUMOR_TYPE_NAME , L.PRIMARY_SITE, L.METASTASIS_SITE, ICD_CODE, ICD_DESC AS ICD_DESCRIPTION, ICD_DATE, P.PART_DESCRIPTION AS OTHER_PART_DESCRIPTION, P.DT_PROCEDURE AS OTHER_PART_PROC_DATE FROM LUNG L LEFT JOIN DX ON CC_MRN = L.PT_MRN LEFT JOIN OTH P ON P.PT_MRN = L.PT_MRN

prompt: Examination of patients with extrahepatic biliary strictures undergoing surgical resection (i.e. bile duct resection)
completion: WITH DX AS (SELECT TM_MRN, TM_DX_DTE, TM_HIST_CD, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS HIST_DESC, TM_SITE_CD, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_DESC FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') ) SELECT DISTINCT PBD_MRN "MRN", PT_LAST_NAME "Last Name", PT_FIRST_NAME "First Name", PT_SEX "Gender", PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH "Date of Birth", PT_DATE_OF_DEATH "Date of Death", PBD_SVC_DTE "Surgery Date", PBC_CPT_CD "CPT Code", CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK "CPT Description", DOC_ACDMC_SVC "Service", TM_DX_DTE "Tumor Dx Date", TM_HIST_CD "Histology Code", HIST_DESC "Histology Description", TM_SITE_CD "Site Code", SITE_DESC "Site Description" FROM IDB.PBD_DTL JOIN IDB.PBD_CODE ON PBD_PBD_CD = PBC_PBD_CD JOIN IDB.CLM ON PBC_CPT_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.PBD_INVOICE ON PBD_INV_NO = PBI_INV_NO JOIN IDB.DOC ON PBI_PERFORM_DR_NO = DOC_DR_NO JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PBD_MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN DX ON PBD_MRN = TM_MRN WHERE PBC_CPT_CD IN ('47711', '47712') AND DOC_ACDMC_SVC <> 'PEDIATRIC SURGICAL' ; WITH DX AS (SELECT DISTINCT TM_MRN, TM_DX_DTE, TM_HIST_CD, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS HIST_DESC, TM_SITE_CD, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_DESC FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') ) , PATH AS (SELECT PRPT_MRN, PRPT_PROCEDURE_DTE, PRPT_REPORT_DTE, PRPT_REPORT_TYPE_DESC, PRPT_ACCESSION_NO, PRPT_REPORT FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V JOIN DX ON PRPT_MRN = TM_MRN WHERE PRPT_REPORT IS NOT NULL ) SELECT PBD_MRN "MRN", PT_LAST_NAME "Last Name", PT_FIRST_NAME "First Name", PT_SEX "Gender", PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH "Date of Birth", PT_DATE_OF_DEATH "Date of Death", PBD_SVC_DTE "Surgery Date", PBC_CPT_CD "CPT Code", CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK "CPT Description", DOC_ACDMC_SVC "Service", PRPT_PROCEDURE_DTE "Report Procedure Date", PRPT_REPORT_DTE "Report Date", PRPT_REPORT_TYPE_DESC "Report Type", PRPT_REPORT "Report Text" FROM IDB.PBD_DTL JOIN IDB.PBD_CODE ON PBD_PBD_CD = PBC_PBD_CD JOIN IDB.CLM ON PBC_CPT_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.PBD_INVOICE ON PBD_INV_NO = PBI_INV_NO JOIN IDB.DOC ON PBI_PERFORM_DR_NO = DOC_DR_NO JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PBD_MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN DX ON PBD_MRN = TM_MRN LEFT JOIN PATH ON PBD_MRN = PRPT_MRN AND PBD_SVC_DTE = PRPT_PROCEDURE_DTE WHERE PBC_CPT_CD IN ('47711', '47712') AND DOC_ACDMC_SVC <> 'PEDIATRIC SURGICAL' ; WITH DX AS (SELECT DISTINCT TM_MRN FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND TM_SITE_CD IN ('C240', 'C248', 'C249') ) SELECT PRPT_MRN "MRN", PT_LAST_NAME "Last Name", PT_FIRST_NAME "First Name", PT_SEX "Gender", PT_BIRTH_DTE "Date of Birth", PT_DEATH_DTE "Date of Death", PRPT_PROCEDURE_DTE "Report Procedure Date", PRPT_REPORT_DTE "Report Date", PRPT_REPORT_TYPE_DESC "Report Type", PRPT_REPORT "Report Text" FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V JOIN DX ON PRPT_MRN = TM_MRN JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON PRPT_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE PRPT_REPORT IS NOT NULL AND CONTAINS("PRPT_REPORT", '("benign" & "biliary")') = 1

prompt: Provide a daily list of patients who are  65 years or older ,seen in Surgery with either diabetes requiring medication or insulin or smoking history, including protocols currently on.
completion: SELECT DISTINCT OC_MRN , YEAR(OC_SURG_DTE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) AS AGE, TRIM(PT_LAST_NAME) || ', ' || TRIM(PT_FIRST_NAME) AS PATIENT_NAME, PT_EMAIL_ADDRESS AS EMAIL FROM IDB.OR_CASE JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PT_MRN = OC_MRN WHERE OC_SURG_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT date + 7 DAYS AND CURRENT date + 13 DAYS AND OC_OR_CASE_STS_CD NOT IN ('2', '5') AND PT_DEATH_IND IN ('', 'A') AND YEAR(OC_SURG_DTE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) >= 65 ORDER BY 1; WITH APPT AS (SELECT OC_MRN, OC_SURG_DTE AS SURGERY_DATE, YEAR(OC_SURG_DTE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) AS AGE, TRIM(PT_LAST_NAME) || ', ' || TRIM(PT_FIRST_NAME) AS PATIENT_NAME, PT_EMAIL_ADDRESS AS EMAIL, OC_PT_CLASS AS PATIENT_CLASS, AV_DESC AS PATIENT_CLASS_DESC, CPX_PROC_CD AS CPT_CODE, TRIM(CPX_PROC_NAME) AS CPT_DESC, CRE_RES_NAME AS SURGEON, OC_SURG_SVC AS SERVICE, OC_DAYS_STAY FROM IDB.OR_CASE JOIN IDB.OR_CASE_ALL_PROC ON OC_CASE_ID = OCAP_CASE_ID JOIN IDB.OR_CASE_ALL_SURG ON OCAP_CASE_ID = OCAS_CASE_ID AND OCAS_PNL_NO = OCAP_PNL_NO AND OCAS_SURG_ROLE = 'Primary' JOIN IDB.OR_PROC ON OCAP_OR_PROC_ID = OP_OR_PROC_ID JOIN IDB.OR_CL_PROC ON OP_OR_PROC_ID = OCP_OR_PROC_ID JOIN IDB.CL_PROC ON OCP_PROC_ID = CPX_PROC_ID JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CRE_RES_ID = OCAS_RES_ID JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PT_MRN = OC_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS ON AV_CODE = OC_PT_CLASS AND AV_ELEMENT = 'PT_CLASS' WHERE OC_SURG_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT date + 7 DAYS AND CURRENT date + 13 DAYS AND OC_OR_CASE_STS_CD NOT IN ('2', '5') AND PT_DEATH_IND IN ('', 'A') AND YEAR(OC_SURG_DTE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) >= 65 ) , DX AS (SELECT CC_MRN, MAX(CASE WHEN CC_CLSF_CD BETWEEN 'E08' AND 'E13.99' OR CC_CLSF_CD BETWEEN '250' AND '250.99' THEN 'Y' END) AS DIABETES_FLAG FROM APPT JOIN IDB.CTC_CLSF ON OC_MRN = CC_MRN JOIN IDB.CLM A ON A.CLM_CLSF_CD = CC_CLSF_CD AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND
