((CC_PT_TYPE = 'I') OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) AND (CC_CLSF_CD BETWEEN 'E08' AND 'E13.99' OR CC_CLSF_CD BETWEEN '250' AND '250.99') GROUP BY CC_MRN) , HOME_MED AS (SELECT MRN, LISTAGG(DRUG, ', ') DRUG_LIST FROM (SELECT DISTINCT HCPR_MRN MRN, HCPR_DRUG_NAME, CASE WHEN LOWER(HCPR_DRUG_NAME) LIKE '%metformin%' THEN 'metformin' WHEN LOWER(HCPR_DRUG_NAME) LIKE '%glipizide%' THEN 'glipizide' WHEN LOWER(HCPR_DRUG_NAME) LIKE '%glyburide%' THEN 'glyburide' WHEN LOWER(HCPR_DRUG_NAME) LIKE '%glimepiride%' THEN 'glimepiride' WHEN LOWER(HCPR_DRUG_NAME) LIKE '%insulin%' THEN 'insulin' ELSE '' END AS DRUG FROM APPT LEFT JOIN IDB.HML_CLIENT_PRESCRIPTION HCPR ON HCPR_MRN= OC_MRN WHERE HCPR_GENERIC_NAME_ID != -100 AND (HCPR_PRESCRIPTION_TYPE = 1 AND HCPR_TRANSMISSION_STATUS IN (1, 2, 5) OR HCPR_PRESCRIPTION_TYPE = 3) AND HCPR_STATUS_TYPE_DESC = 'Active' AND (LOWER(HCPR_DRUG_NAME) LIKE '%metformin%' OR LOWER(HCPR_DRUG_NAME) LIKE '%glipizide%' OR LOWER(HCPR_DRUG_NAME) LIKE '%glyburide%' OR LOWER(HCPR_DRUG_NAME) LIKE '%glimepiride%' OR LOWER(HCPR_DRUG_NAME) LIKE '%insulin%' ) ) GROUP BY MRN) , SMO_HX AS (SELECT CDD_MRN , CDD_SERVICE_DTE, CDO_SECTION, TRIM(CDO_ITEM_NAME) ITEM_NAME, TRIM(CDO_VALUE_TEXT) SMOKING_HX, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CDD_MRN, CDO_ITEM_NAME ORDER BY CDD_SERVICE_DTE DESC) AS SMO_RN FROM IDB.CD_DOCUMENT LEFT JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION ON CDD_DOC_GUID = CDO_DOC_GUID AND CDD_AUTHORED_DTE = CDO_AUTHORED_DTE AND CDO_VALUE_TEXT <> '' JOIN APPT ON OC_MRN = CDD_MRN WHERE CDD_CANCEL_IND <> '1' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND <> '1' AND UPPER(CDO_SECTION) ='SOCIAL HISTORY' AND UPPER(CDO_ITEM_NAME) ='SMOKING STATUS' ) , ASH AS (SELECT ASH_MRN, ASH_ENC_DTE, ASH_TOBACCO_USED_YEARS PACK_YRS, ASH_TOBACCO_COMMENT COMMENTS, ASH_SMOKING_QUIT_DTE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ASH_MRN ORDER BY ASH_ENC_DTE DESC) RN FROM IDB.AN_SOCIAL_HX JOIN APPT ON ASH_MRN = OC_MRN) , ACC AS (SELECT AC_MRN, LISTAGG(AC_IRB_NO, ',') PROTOCOLS FROM IDB.ACCRUALS JOIN APPT ON OC_MRN = AC_MRN GROUP BY AC_MRN) , ORD AS (SELECT OO_MRN, TRIM(OO_ORD_NAME) AS ORDER_NAME, OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE AS ORDER_DATE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY OO_MRN, OO_ORD_STS_CD ORDER BY OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE DESC) ORD_RN, OSTS_STS_DESC AS ORDER_STATUS FROM IDB.OMS_ORDER JOIN IDB.OMS_STATUS ON OO_ORD_STS_CD = OSTS_ORD_STS_CD JOIN APPT ON OO_MRN = OC_MRN WHERE OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID IN ('9000015486300730', '2000001302073001' ) AND OO_ORD_STS_CD NOT IN ('CANP', 'CANC', 'AUC3') ) SELECT DISTINCT OC_MRN AS MRN, AGE AS "Age as of surgery", SURGERY_DATE , OC_DAYS_STAY AS "Length of Stay", CPT_CODE, CPT_DESC, SURGEON, SERVICE AS "Surgery Service", ORDER_DATE AS "DNR Order Date", ORDER_STATUS AS "DNR Order Status", DRUG_LIST, DIABETES_FLAG, SMOKING_HX , PROTOCOLS AS "Protocols (Accrued)", PACK_YRS || '-' || TRIM(COMMENTS) AS TOBACCO_USE FROM APPT A LEFT JOIN DX ON OC_MRN = CC_MRN LEFT JOIN HOME_MED ON OC_MRN = MRN LEFT JOIN ACC ON AC_MRN = OC_MRN LEFT JOIN SMO_HX ON CDD_MRN = OC_MRN AND SMO_RN =1 LEFT JOIN ASH ON ASH_MRN = OC_MRN AND RN=1 LEFT JOIN ORD ON OO_MRN = OC_MRN AND ORD_RN =1 WHERE NOT (SMOKING_HX LIKE '%Never%' AND DIABETES_FLAG ='N') ;

prompt: Provide a daily list of patients beginning neoadjuvant treatment for early stage breast cancer.
completion: WITH X AS (SELECT DISTINCT CAO_MRN MRN, CAO_ORD_NAME ORDER_NAME, CAO_DRUG_NAME DRUG_NAME, MIN(CAO_START_DTE) DRUG_START_DATE, CAO_CURR_LOC, APR_LOCATION, CAO_GENERIC_NAME, CAO_CHEMO_IND, APR_PROVIDER_NAME PHYSICIAN_NAME FROM IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX_V JOIN IDB.CHEMO_ALL_ORDERS V ON APR_MRN = CAO_MRN WHERE CAO_START_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT date AND CURRENT date + 7 DAYS AND CAO_ORD_STS NOT IN ('DISC', 'AUA2', 'CANC', 'CANP') AND CAO_CHEMO_IND = 'Y' AND CAO_GENERIC_NAME IN ('CARBOPLATIN', 'CYCLOPHOSPHAMIDE', 'DOXORUBICIN', 'DOXORUBICIN LIPOSOMAL', 'PACLITAXEL', 'TRASTUZUMAB') GROUP BY CAO_MRN, CAO_ORD_NAME, CAO_DRUG_NAME, CAO_CURR_LOC, APR_LOCATION, CAO_GENERIC_NAME, CAO_CHEMO_IND, APR_PROVIDER_NAME), EXCLUSION AS (SELECT DISTINCT CAO_MRN FROM IDB.CHEMO_ALL_ORDERS WHERE CAO_START_DTE <= CURRENT_DATE AND CAO_GENERIC_NAME IN ('CARBOPLATIN', 'CYCLOPHOSPHAMIDE', 'DOXORUBICIN', 'DOXORUBICIN LIPOSOMAL', 'PACLITAXEL', 'TRASTUZUMAB') ) SELECT DISTINCT * FROM X WHERE MRN NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT CAO_MRN FROM EXCLUSION)

prompt: Please provide re-surgery/exploration for bleeding (CPT code 10140) within 7 days for mastectomy and axillary dissection patients  as of 2008.
completion: SELECT MRN, SURG_DATE, RPT_QTR, BRE_SURGEON, LOS, PT_TYPE, ADM_DATE, DSCH_DATE , LAT_IND, SURG_TYPE, SSE_SURG_DTE RESURG_DATE , STRIP(SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD)||' - '|| SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC RESURG_DESC , DAYS(SSE_SURG_DTE) - DAYS(SURG_DATE) DAYS_TO_RESURG, SSP_SURG_LAST_NM RESURG_MD FROM (SELECT MRN, SURG_DATE, RPT_QTR, MAX(SURGEON) BRE_SURGEON, LOS, PT_TYPE , ADM_DATE, DSCH_DATE , MAX(AXD) AXD, MAX(MAST_PART) MAST_PART, MAX(MAST_COMPL) MAST_COMPL , MIN(LAT_IND) LAT, MAX(W_EXPANDER) W_EXPANDER, MAX(W_FLAP) W_FLAP , CASE WHEN MIN(LAT_IND) = 'BL' OR COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN MAST_COMPL = 'Y' THEN CPT_CD END) = 2 THEN 'BL' WHEN MAX(MAST_COMPL) = 'Y' THEN 'UL' ELSE PT_TYPE END LAT_IND , CASE WHEN MAX(MAST_COMPL) = 'Y' AND MAX(W_FLAP) = 'Y' THEN 'Mastectomy With w Flap' WHEN MAX(MAST_COMPL) = 'Y' AND MAX(W_EXPANDER) = 'Y' THEN 'Mastectomy With Breast Reconstruction' WHEN MAX(MAST_COMPL) = 'Y' THEN 'Mastectomy' WHEN MAX(AXD) = 'Y' AND MAX(MAST_PART) = 'Y' THEN 'Axillary Dissection with Wide Exicision' WHEN MAX(AXD) = 'Y' THEN 'Axillary Dissection' ELSE 'Other' END AS SURG_TYPE FROM (SELECT DISTINCT PBD_MRN AS MRN, PBD_SVC_DTE AS SURG_DATE , PBC_CPT_CD CPT_CD, PBC_PBD_DESC AS SURG_DESC , CASE WHEN CS_ADM_DATE IS NOT NULL THEN 'IP' ELSE 'OP' END PT_TYPE , CASE WHEN DOC_SVC = 'BRE' THEN DOC_NAME END AS SURGEON , CS_ADM_DATE AS ADM_DATE, CS_DSCH_DATE AS DSCH_DATE , SUBSTR(CHAR(PBD_SVC_DTE), 1, 5)|| CASE WHEN MONTH(PBD_SVC_DTE) BETWEEN 1 AND 3 THEN 'Q1' WHEN MONTH(PBD_SVC_DTE) BETWEEN 4 AND 6 THEN 'Q2' WHEN MONTH(PBD_SVC_DTE) BETWEEN 7 AND 9 THEN 'Q3' ELSE 'Q4' END AS RPT_QTR , CASE WHEN CS_DSCH_DATE IS NOT NULL THEN INT(CS_DAYS_STAY) WHEN CS_ADM_DATE IS NOT NULL THEN DAYS(CURRENT DATE) - DAYS(PBD_SVC_DTE) END AS LOS , CASE WHEN PBC_CPT_CD IN ('38745', '19302') THEN 'Y' END AXD , CASE WHEN PBC_CPT_CD IN ('19301', '19302') THEN 'Y' END MAST_PART , CASE WHEN PBC_CPT_CD IN ('19303', '19307', '19305') THEN 'Y' END MAST_COMPL , CASE WHEN PBC_CPT_CD = '19357' THEN 'Y' END W_EXPANDER , CASE WHEN PBC_CPT_CD IN ('19361', '19364', '19367', '19368', '19369') THEN 'Y' END W_FLAP , CASE WHEN PBC_PBD_DESC LIKE '%BILAT%' THEN 'BL' ELSE 'UL' END LAT_IND FROM IDB.PBD_DTL_CHARGES JOIN IDB.PBD_CODE ON PBC_PBD_CD = PBD_PBD_CD AND(PBC_PBD_DESC LIKE 'BRST %' OR PBC_PBD_DESC LIKE 'PLAST%') JOIN IDB.PBD_INVOICE ON PBI_MRN = PBD_MRN AND PBI_ACCT_NO = PBD_ACCT_NO AND PBI_INV_NO = PBD_INV_NO AND PBI_INV_STS = ' ' JOIN IDB.DOC ON PBI_PERFORM_DR_NO = DOC_DR_NO LEFT JOIN IDB.CASE ON CS_MRN = PBD_MRN AND PBD_SVC_DTE BETWEEN CS_ADM_DATE AND CS_DSCH_DATE AND CS_ACCT_NO LIKE '84%' AND CS_PT_STS <> 'IP' WHERE PBD_SVC_DTE BETWEEN '2008-01-01' AND '2010-05-31' AND PBC_CPT_CD IN ('38745', '19302', '19303', '19307', '19305', '19301', '19361', '19364', '19367', '19368', '19369', '19357') ) SURG GROUP BY MRN, SURG_DATE, RPT_QTR, LOS, PT_TYPE, ADM_DATE, DSCH_DATE HAVING MAX(W_FLAP) IS NULL AND MAX(COALESCE(AXD, MAST_COMPL)) = 'Y') A JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT ON MRN = SSE_MRN AND SURG_DATE <= SSE_SURG_DTE JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE ON SSP_LOG_ID = SSE_LOG_ID AND SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD IN ('10060', '10001', '10140', '21501') WHERE DAYS(SSE_SURG_DTE) - DAYS(SURG_DATE) BETWEEN 0 AND 7

prompt: Living patient seen at ORT Service with a diagnosis of Osteochondroma or Multiple Hereditary Exostoses

prompt: Provide Cancer Diagnosis info for all patients consented to 15-047
completion: WITH PRO AS (SELECT DISTINCT AC_MRN FROM IDB.ACCRUALS WHERE AC_IRB_NO = '15-047' ) , BMI AS (SELECT DISTINCT PMH_MRN, PMH_MEASURE_DTE, PMH_BMI FROM IDB.PT_MEASURES_HX JOIN PRO ON PMH_MRN = AC_MRN) , DX AS (SELECT DISTINCT AC_MRN "MRN", PT_LAST_NAME "Last Name", PT_FIRST_NAME "First Name", PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH "Date of Birth", SMOKE.AV_DESC "Smoking Hx", TM_CDB_SEQ_NO "Diagnosis Sequence No", TM_HIST_CD "Histology Code", H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK "Histology Description", TM_SITE_CD "Site Code", S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK "Site Description", STAGE.AV_DESC "T Stage", PMH_BMI BMI, PMH_MEASURE_DTE "BMI Measure Date", TM_DX_DTE "Tumor Diagnosis Date", DAYS(PMH_MEASURE_DTE) - DAYS(TM_DX_DTE) "BMI Days Diff", ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY AC_MRN, TM_CDB_SEQ_NO ORDER BY ABS(DAYS(PMH_MEASURE_DTE) - DAYS(TM_DX_DTE)) ASC) AS ROWRANK FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS STATUS ON STATUS.AV_ELEMENT = 'CASE_STS' AND STATUS.AV_CODE = TM_CASE_STS JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON TM_MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS SMOKE ON SMOKE.AV_ELEMENT = 'SMOKING_HX' AND TM_SMOKING_HX = SMOKE.AV_CODE LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS STAGE ON STAGE.AV_ELEMENT = 'TSTAGE' AND TM_SMOKING_HX = STAGE.AV_CODE JOIN PRO ON TM_MRN = AC_MRN LEFT JOIN BMI ON TM_MRN = PMH_MRN WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') ) SELECT * FROM DX WHERE ROWRANK = 1 ORDER BY 1, 6 ; WITH PRO AS (SELECT DISTINCT AC_MRN FROM IDB.ACCRUALS WHERE AC_IRB_NO = '15-047' ) SELECT APR_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME "Last Name", PT_FIRST_NAME "First Name", APR_START_DTE "Start Date", APR_GENERIC_NAME "Generic Name", APR_PRESCRIBED_DOSE "Prescribed Dose", APR_ROUTE "Route" FROM IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX JOIN IDB.CHEMO_DRUG_GENERIC ON APR_GENERIC_NAME = CDG_GENERIC_NAME JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON APR_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN PRO ON APR_MRN = AC_MRN ORDER BY 1, 4

prompt: provide a list of allo-HCT patients who underwent bone health assessment
completion: WITH TRANSPLANT AS (SELECT CB.CBM_MRN AS MRN, CB.CBM_TRANSPLANT_TYPE AS TRANSPLANT_TYPE, CB.CBM_INDICATION_DESC AS INDICATION_DESC, CB.CBM_TRANSPLANT_DTE AS TRANSPLANT_DTE FROM IDB.CRDB_BMT_MEDICINE CB WHERE CB.CBM_TRANSPLANT_TYPE = 'ALLO' AND CB.CBM_TRANSPLANT_DTE BETWEEN '2017-01-01' AND '2021-12-31' UNION SELECT CP.CBP_MRN AS MRN, CP.CBP_TRANSPLANT_TYPE AS TRANSPLANT_TYPE, CP.CBP_INDICATION_DESC AS INDICATION_DESC, CP.CBP_TRANSPLANT_DTE AS TRANSPLANT_DTE FROM IDB.CRDB_BMT_PEDIATRICS CP WHERE CP.CBP_TRANSPLANT_TYPE = 'ALLO' AND CP.CBP_TRANSPLANT_DTE BETWEEN '2017-01-01' AND '2021-12-31' ), BONEDENAX_NO_REPORT AS (SELECT OO_MRN AS BONEDENAX_MRN, OO_ORD_GUID, TRANSPLANT_DTE, TRANSPLANT_TYPE, INDICATION_DESC, OUD_USER_DI_VALUE AS BONEDENAX_RIS_CODE, OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'RIS_ANC/Interface Code' AND OUD_USER_DI_VALUE = 'BONEDENAX' AND OO_ORD_STS_CD IN ('RESF', 'RESC', 'PERF') AND TRANSPLANT_DTE BETWEEN '2017-01-01' AND '2021-12-31' ), BONEDENAX AS (SELECT BONEDENAX_MRN, TRANSPLANT_DTE, TRANSPLANT_TYPE, INDICATION_DESC, BONEDENAX_RIS_CODE, BONEDENAX_PERFORMED_DATE, BONEDENAX_ORDER_NAME, RRPT_REPORT_TXT FROM BONEDENAX_NO_REPORT JOIN DV.RADIOLOGY_REPORT_V ON OO_ORD_GUID = RRPT_ORDER_GUID), ALLVITAMINDLABS AS (SELECT LR_MRN AS VITAMIND_MRN, LR_PERFORMED_DTE AS VITAMIND_PERFORMED_DATE, BONEDENAX_PERFORMED_DATE, ABS(DAYS(BONEDENAX_PERFORMED_DATE) - DAYS(LR_PERFORMED_DTE)) AS "VitaminD Days to Bonedenax", LR_CTLG_ITEM_GUID AS VITAMIND_ID, LR_TEST_NAME AS VITAMIND_TEST_NAME, LR_SUBTEST_NAME AS VITAMIND_SUBTEST_NAME, LR_RESULT_VALUE AS VITAMIND_RESULT_VALUE, LR_UNIT_MEASURE AS VITAMIND_UNIT_MEASURE FROM BONEDENAX JOIN IDB.LAB_RESULTS ON BONEDENAX_MRN = LR_MRN AND ABS(DAYS(BONEDENAX_PERFORMED_DATE) - DAYS(LR_PERFORMED_DTE)) <=30 WHERE LR_CTLG_ITEM_GUID = '5000001023101001' ) , CLOSESTVITAMINDLAB AS (SELECT * FROM ALLVITAMINDLABS A WHERE "VitaminD Days to Bonedenax" = (SELECT MIN("VitaminD Days to Bonedenax") FROM ALLVITAMINDLABS C WHERE A.VITAMIND_MRN = C.VITAMIND_MRN AND A.BONEDENAX_PERFORMED_DATE = C.BONEDENAX_PERFORMED_DATE) ) , PTHLABS AS (SELECT LR_MRN AS PTH_MRN, LR_CTLG_ITEM_GUID AS PTH_ID, LR_TEST_NAME AS PTH_TEST_NAME, LR_SUBTEST_NAME AS PTH_SUBTEST_NAME, LR_PERFORMED_DTE AS PTH_PERFORMED_DATE, LR_RESULT_VALUE AS PTH_RESULT_VALUE, LR_UNIT_MEASURE AS PTH_UNIT_MEASURE FROM (SELECT DISTINCT BONEDENAX_MRN FROM BONEDENAX) AS DISTINCT_BONEDENAX JOIN IDB.LAB_RESULTS ON BONEDENAX_MRN = LR_MRN WHERE LR_CTLG_ITEM_GUID = '3000001153101001'), PATIENTS AS (SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_LAST_NAME FROM BONEDENAX JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PT_MRN = BONEDENAX_MRN) SELECT PT_MRN AS MRN, PT_FIRST_NAME AS "First Name", PT_LAST_NAME AS "Last Name", TRANSPLANT_TYPE AS "Transplant Type", INDICATION_DESC AS "Indication Description", TRANSPLANT_DTE AS "Transplant Date", BONEDENAX_RIS_CODE AS "Bonedenax RIS Code", BONEDENAX.BONEDENAX_PERFORMED_DATE AS "Bonedenax Performed Date", BONEDENAX_ORDER_NAME AS "Bonedenax Order Name", RRPT_REPORT_TXT AS "Bone Density Report Text", CLOSESTVITAMINDLAB.VITAMIND_PERFORMED_DATE AS "Vitamin D Performed Date", CLOSESTVITAMINDLAB.VITAMIND_RESULT_VALUE AS "Vitamin D Result Value", CLOSESTVITAMINDLAB.VITAMIND_UNIT_MEASURE AS "Vitamin D Unit Measure", CLOSESTVITAMINDLAB."VitaminD Days to Bonedenax", CLOSESTVITAMINDLAB.VITAMIND_SUBTEST_NAME AS "Vitamin D Subtest Name", PTH_SUBTEST_NAME AS "PTH Subtest Name", PTH_PERFORMED_DATE AS "PTH Performed Date", PTH_RESULT_VALUE AS "PTH Result Value", PTH_UNIT_MEASURE AS "PTH Unit Measure" FROM PATIENTS LEFT JOIN BONEDENAX ON PT_MRN = BONEDENAX_MRN LEFT JOIN CLOSESTVITAMINDLAB ON prompt: Provide 1 time list of MRNs with race and ethnicity data to compare Engage values with RMS values
completion: WITH MAIN AS (SELECT EF_MRN, EF_SUBMISSION_DT, EF_FORM_NAME, MAX(CASE WHEN EFI_ITEM_ALIAS = 'raceq' THEN SUBSTR(EFI_VALUE, 1, 500) ELSE '' END) AS "EF_RACE", MAX(CASE WHEN EFI_ITEM_ALIAS = 'ethnicq' THEN SUBSTR(EFI_VALUE, 1, 500) ELSE '' END) AS "EF_ETHNICITY" FROM IDB.EF_FORM LEFT JOIN IDB.EF_FORM_ITEM ON EF_FORM_ID = EFI_FORM_ID WHERE EF_FORM_NAME = 'Sexual and Reproductive Health New Patient Questionnaire' GROUP BY EF_MRN, EF_SUBMISSION_DT, EF_FORM_NAME) SELECT DISTINCT EF_MRN , EF_SUBMISSION_DT , EF_FORM_NAME , "EF_RACE" , "EF_ETHNICITY" , TRIM(R.AV_DESC) AS "PAT_RACE" , TRIM(E.AV_DESC) AS "PAT_ETHNICITY" FROM MAIN JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PT_MRN = EF_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS R ON R.AV_ELEMENT = 'RACE' AND R.AV_CODE = PT_RACE LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS E ON E.AV_ELEMENT = 'PT_ETHNICITY' AND E.AV_CODE = PT_PT_ETHNICITY ; WITH MAIN AS (SELECT EF_MRN, EF_SUBMISSION_DT, EF_FORM_NAME, MAX(CASE WHEN EFI_ITEM_ALIAS = 'raceq' THEN SUBSTR(EFI_VALUE, 1, 500) ELSE '' END) AS "EF_RACE", MAX(CASE WHEN EFI_ITEM_ALIAS = 'ethnicq' THEN SUBSTR(EFI_VALUE, 1, 500) ELSE '' END) AS "EF_ETHNICITY" FROM IDB.EF_FORM LEFT JOIN IDB.EF_FORM_ITEM ON EF_FORM_ID = EFI_FORM_ID WHERE EF_FORM_NAME = 'Medical History' GROUP BY EF_MRN, EF_SUBMISSION_DT, EF_FORM_NAME) SELECT DISTINCT EF_MRN , EF_SUBMISSION_DT , EF_FORM_NAME , "EF_RACE" , "EF_ETHNICITY" , TRIM(R.AV_DESC) AS "PAT_RACE" , TRIM(E.AV_DESC) AS "PAT_ETHNICITY" FROM MAIN JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PT_MRN = EF_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS R ON R.AV_ELEMENT = 'RACE' AND R.AV_CODE = PT_RACE LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS E ON E.AV_ELEMENT = 'PT_ETHNICITY' AND E.AV_CODE = PT_PT_ETHNICITY ;

prompt: Provide a Darwin cohort of patients for the given criteria along with access to the patients in the Darwin Digital Platform.
completion: WITH PTS AS (SELECT PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID PID FROM DV.PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED) , DT_1 AS (SELECT PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID AS P_ID FROM DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS REC LEFT JOIN DV.PATIENT_CORE_DEMOGRAPHICS ON PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = CORE_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID WHERE 1=1 ) , DT_2 AS (SELECT PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID AS P_ID FROM DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS REC LEFT JOIN DV.PATIENT_CORE_DEMOGRAPHICS ON PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = CORE_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID WHERE 1=1 AND PT_VITAL_STATUS IN ('ALIVE') ) , DT_3 AS (SELECT INC.PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID P_ID FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_STRUCTURED_RESULTS_V INC JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML DT ON INC.PRPT_PATH_RPT_ID = DT.PDRX_PATH_RPT_ID CROSS JOIN XMLTABLE('$c/root/meta-data' PASSING DT.PDRX_XML_VALUE AS "c" COLUMNS PRIMARY_SITE VARCHAR(264) PATH 'primary_site', TUMOR_TYPE_NAME VARCHAR(264) PATH 'tumor_type_name' , TUMOR_TYPE_CODE VARCHAR(264) PATH 'tumor_type_code', IS_METASTASIS VARCHAR(3) PATH 'is_metastasis' , METASTASIS_SITE VARCHAR(264) PATH 'metastasis_site' , MSI_COMMENT VARCHAR(264) PATH 'msi-comment' , MSI_SCORE VARCHAR(264) PATH 'msi-score' , MSI_TYPE VARCHAR(264) PATH 'msi-type' , TMB_SCORE VARCHAR(25) PATH 'tmb_score' , TMB_COUNT VARCHAR(25) PATH 'tmb-count', COSMIC_ID VARCHAR(5000) PATH 'cosmic_id') T JOIN (SELECT T.TUMOR_TYPE_CODE TTC FROM TABLE(DV.STRING_SPLIT('COADREAD', ',')) S CROSS JOIN TABLE(DV.ONCOTREE_CHILDREN(COLUMN_VALUES)) T) X ON T.TUMOR_TYPE_CODE = TRIM(X.TTC) WHERE 1=1 ) , DEID AS (SELECT DISTINCT P_ID FROM (SELECT P_ID FROM DT_1 INTERSECT SELECT P_ID FROM DT_2 INTERSECT SELECT P_ID FROM DT_3 ))

prompt: Provide a list of patients diagnosed with indolent lymphoma and received radiation therapy to the eye(s).
completion: WITH LYM AS (SELECT DISTINCT TM_MRN AS MRN, TM_DX_DTE AS DX_DATE, TM_SITE_CD AS SITE_CODE, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_DESC, TM_HIST_CD AS DX_CODE, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS DX_DESC FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD WHERE 1=1 AND TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND TM_DX_DTE BETWEEN '2000-01-01' AND CURRENT DATE AND TM_HIST_CD IN ('M9689/3', 'M9699/3', 'M9710/3', 'M9711/3', 'M9715/3', 'M9595/3', 'M9597/3', 'M9690/3', 'M9691/3', 'M9695/3', 'M9698/3') AND(S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK LIKE '%EYE%' OR S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK LIKE '%ORBIT%') UNION SELECT CC_MRN AS MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS DX_DATE, '' AS SITE_CODE, '' AS SITE_DESC, CLM_CLSF_CD AS DX_CODE, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS DX_DESC FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND ((CC_PT_TYPE = 'I') OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) AND(CC_CLSF_CD IN ('200.30', '200.31', 'C88.4', '202.01', 'C82.01', 'C82.09', 'C82.11', 'C82.19', 'C82.21', 'C82.29', 'C82.31', 'C82.39', 'C82.41', 'C82.49', 'C82.51', 'C82.59', 'C82.61', 'C82.69', 'C82.81', 'C82.89', 'C82.91', 'C82.99')) GROUP BY CC_MRN, '', '', CLM_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK HAVING MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) BETWEEN '2000-01-01' AND CURRENT DATE) , CTE AS (SELECT MRN AS DX_MRN, DX_DATE, STRIP(DX_CODE) || '-' || STRIP(DX_DESC) || ' | ' || STRIP(SITE_CODE) || '-' || STRIP(SITE_DESC) AS DX_CODE FROM LYM) , CTE2 AS (SELECT * FROM CTE ORDER BY DX_MRN, DX_DATE, DX_CODE) , T1 AS (SELECT DX_MRN, DX_DATE, DX_CODE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY DX_MRN ORDER BY DX_DATE) AS RN FROM CTE2 ORDER BY DX_MRN, DX_DATE) , T2 (MRN, DX, RN1) AS (SELECT DX_MRN, CAST(DX_DATE AS VARCHAR(6000))||' | '||CAST(DX_CODE AS VARCHAR(100)), RN FROM T1 WHERE T1.RN = 1 UNION ALL SELECT DX_MRN, RTRIM(CAST(DX AS VARCHAR(4000))) || ', ' || CHR(13) || CHR(10) || CAST(DX_DATE AS VARCHAR(100))||' | '||RTRIM(CAST(DX_CODE AS VARCHAR(100))) , RN1 + 1 FROM T1, T2 WHERE DX_MRN = MRN AND RN = RN1+1 ) , T3 AS (SELECT MRN, MAX(RN1) RN FROM T2 GROUP BY MRN) , T4 AS (SELECT T2.MRN, RN, DX FROM T2 JOIN T3 ON T2.MRN = T3.MRN AND T2.RN1 = T3.RN) , T5 AS (SELECT MRN, STRIP(PT_LAST_NAME) || ', ' || STRIP(PT_FIRST_NAME) AS NAME, PT_SEX AS GENDER, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH AS DOB, PT_DATE_OF_DEATH AS DOD, DX FROM T4 JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON MRN = PT_MRN) SELECT T5.*, RTC_TX_PLAN_NAME, RTC_PRIMARY_REF_POINT, RTC_TX_START_DTE, RTC_TX_STOP_DTE, RTC_TX_ELAPSED_DAYS, RTC_TX_PLANNED_FRACTIONS, RTC_TX_DELIVERED_FRACTIONS, RTC_TX_PLANNED_DOSE, RTC_TX_DELIVERED_DOSE, RTC_DOSE_CORRECTION FROM T5 JOIN IDB.RADONC_TREATMENT_COURSE ON RTC_TX_MRN = MRN WHERE(RTC_TX_PLAN_NAME LIKE '%EYE%' OR RTC_TX_PLAN_NAME LIKE '%ORBIT%' OR RTC_PRIMARY_REF_POINT LIKE '%EYE%' OR RTC_PRIMARY_REF_POINT LIKE '%ORBIT%')

prompt: Provide a report of patients who have had SCC referral orders from September 1, 2017 to September 30, 2018, with a chief complaint of hypoglycemia, hyperglycemia or diabetes.
completion: SELECT DISTINCT OO_MRN, OO_ENTER_DTE, OO_ORD_ID, OO_ORD_GUID, OO_ORD_NAME, OO_SUMMARY_LINE, CASE WHEN UPPER(OO_SUMMARY_LINE) LIKE '%DIABET%' OR UPPER(OO_SUMMARY_LINE) LIKE '%INSULIN%' OR UPPER(OO_SUMMARY_LINE) LIKE '%GLUCOSE%' OR UPPER(OO_SUMMARY_LINE) LIKE '%SUGAR%' OR UPPER(OO_SUMMARY_LINE) LIKE '%STEROID%' OR UPPER(OO_SUMMARY_LINE) LIKE '%BG%' OR UPPER(OO_SUMMARY_LINE) LIKE '%BS%' OR UPPER(OO_SUMMARY_LINE) LIKE '%DM%' OR UPPER(OO_SUMMARY_LINE) LIKE '%WHIPPLE%' OR UPPER(OO_SUMMARY_LINE) LIKE '%PANCREATECTOMY%' OR UPPER(OO_SUMMARY_LINE) LIKE '%AIC%' OR UPPER(OO_SUMMARY_LINE) LIKE '%A1C%' OR UPPER(OO_SUMMARY_LINE) LIKE '%GLYCOSURIA%' OR UPPER(OO_SUMMARY_LINE) LIKE '%GLYCEMIC%CONTROL%' THEN 'Y' END AS "Diabetes", CASE WHEN UPPER(OO_SUMMARY_LINE) LIKE '%HYPERGLYCEMIA%' THEN 'Y' END AS "Hyperglycemia", CASE WHEN UPPER(OO_SUMMARY_LINE) LIKE '%HYPOGLYCEMIA%' THEN 'Y' END AS "Hypoglycemia" FROM IDB.OMS_ORDER WHERE OO_ORD_STS_CD NOT IN ('CANC', 'CANP', 'AUC3') AND OO_ENTER_DTE BETWEEN '2017-09-01' AND '2018-09-30' AND OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID = '9000011549100730'

prompt: Provide a list of patients diagnosed with liposarcoma since 1/1/2016.
completion: WITH CTE AS (SELECT DISTINCT "t1"."PT_MRN" AS "MRN", "t1"."PT_BIRTH_DTE" AS "Date of Birth", "t2"."DXCC_ICD_CODE" AS "ICD-O Histology Code", "t2"."DXCC_ICD_MSK_DESC" AS "ICD-O Histology Description", "t3"."ICSC_SITE_CD" AS "ICD-O Site Code", "t3"."ICSC_ICDO_SITE_MSK_DESC" AS "ICD-O Site Description", "t4"."DT_DTE" AS "Tumor Diagnosis Date" FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V" "t1" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED" "t5" ON "t1"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t5"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."CDB_TUMOR_V" "t6" ON "t5"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t6"."CDTM_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DIAGNOSIS_CODE_CAT_ICDO_V" "t2" ON "t6"."CDTM_DX_CATALOG_ID" = "t2"."DXCC_DX_CATALOG_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."ICDO_SITE_CATALOG_V" "t3" ON "t6"."CDTM_SITE_CATALOG_ID" = "t3"."ICSC_SITE_CATALOG_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" "t4" ON "t6"."CDTM_DX_DATE_ID" = "t4"."DT_DATE_ID" WHERE ("t2"."DXCC_ICD_CODE" IN ('M8850/3', 'M8851/3', 'M8852/3', 'M8853/3', 'M8854/3', 'M8855/3', 'M8857/3', 'M8858/3', 'M8860/3') AND "t4"."DT_DTE" BETWEEN '2016-01-01' AND '2018-12-31') ) SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN, GENE, RESULT FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_STRUCTURED_RESULTS_V IMP JOIN CTE ON MRN = PT_MRN WHERE METHOD = 'IMPACT'

prompt: Please provide a list of patients with solid tumors (excluding primary brain tumors) who had cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) cytology testing between April 2016 and April 2019. Thank you!
completion: WITH PTS AS (SELECT MRN, PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID DEID, PT_BIRTH_DTE, PT_SEX FROM (SELECT DISTINCT LR_MRN MRN FROM IDB.LAB_RESULTS WHERE LR_SUBTEST_NAME IN ('Circulating Tumor Cells, CSF') AND LR_PERFORMED_DTE BETWEEN '2016-04-01' AND '2019-04-30' MINUS SELECT DISTINCT CC_MRN MRN FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND (SUBSTR(CC_CLSF_CD, 1, 3) IN ('C71', '191', 'C95', 'C92', '205', '208', 'C90', '203', 'D46', '238') OR CC_CLSF_CD LIKE 'C96.6%' OR CC_CLSF_CD LIKE '277.89%' ) ) A JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON PT_MRN = MRN) , LABS AS (SELECT MRN PLR_MRN, SUBTEST.LTC_SUBTEST_NAME AS TEST, DT_DTE AS "CTC date", PLR_RESULT_VALUE AS "CTC result" FROM PTS JOIN DV.PATIENT_LAB_RESULT ON DEID = PLR_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V ON PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PLR_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID JOIN DV.LAB_TEST_CATALOG_V AS SUBTEST ON PLR_LAB_SUBTEST_CATALOG_ID = SUBTEST.LTC_LAB_TEST_CATALOG_ID JOIN DV.DATE_V ON PLR_PERFORMED_DATE_ID = DT_DATE_ID JOIN DV.PATIENT_IDENTIFICATION_MRN_V ON PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID WHERE SUBTEST.LTC_SUBTEST_NAME = 'Circulating Tumor Cells, CSF' AND PLR_RESULT_VALUE <> ' ' AND DT_DTE BETWEEN '2016-04-01' AND '2019-04-30' ), DX AS (SELECT TM_MRN, LISTAGG(DX, '|') WITHIN GROUP( ORDER BY TM_MRN) DX FROM (SELECT TM_MRN, TRIM(AV_DESC) || ' - ' || CHAR(TM_DX_DTE) || ' - ' || TRIM(H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK) || ' - ' || TRIM(S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK) AS DX FROM PTS JOIN IDB.CDB_TUMOR ON MRN = TM_MRN JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS ON AV_ELEMENT = 'CASE_STS' AND AV_CODE = TM_CASE_STS AND TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') ) A GROUP BY TM_MRN) , CYTO_ID AS (SELECT DISTINCT PRPT_ACCESSION_NO ACC_NO FROM PTS JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V ON PRPT_MRN = MRN WHERE PRPT_REPORT_TYPE_DESC = 'Cytology-Non GYN' AND CONTAINS(PRPT_REPORT, '"cytologic diagnosis:"') = 1 ), CYTO AS (SELECT PRPT_MRN, PRPT_PROCEDURE_DTE, PRPT_REPORT_TYPE, PRPT_REPORT_TYPE_DESC, PRPT_ACCESSION_NO, PRPT_ORD_DR_SVC, PRPT_ORD_DR_SVC_DESC, DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)cytologic diagnosis:[^:]*', PRPT_REPORT) CYTOLOGY, PRPT_REPORT FROM CYTO_ID JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V ON ACC_NO = PRPT_ACCESSION_NO) SELECT MRN, PT_BIRTH_DTE, PT_SEX, PRPT_PROCEDURE_DTE CYTOLOGY_DTE, CYTOLOGY, DX PRIMARY_TUMOR_DX FROM PTS JOIN LABS ON MRN = PLR_MRN LEFT JOIN DX ON TM_MRN = MRN LEFT JOIN CYTO ON MRN = PRPT_MRN ;

prompt:
Please provide a one time report from RMS production that lists patient name, visit number, and MRN for visits since RMS LIVE (2/24/18) to present that have been in any of the following beds:

location M06, room 6VIR, beds 1-9

location M02, room 2VIR, beds 1-5

location JRSO, room JRVIR, beds 1-8
completion: SELECT DISTINCT VIS_MRN MRN, VIS_ADM_NUM "Admission Number", PT_LAST_NAME "Patient Last Name", PT_FIRST_NAME "Patient First Name", VIS_ADM_DTE "Admission Date", VIS_IP_OP_ADJUSTED_IND "IP/OP", ADM_TYPE_DESC "Admission Type", NURS_STA_DESC "Nursing Station", VIS_ROOM_NUM "Room", VIS_BED "Bed", RV_ADM_ENTERED_INITS "Transaction User" FROM IDB.VISIT_V LEFT JOIN IDB.RMS_VISIT ON RV_ADM_NUM = VIS_ADM_NUM JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PT_MRN = VIS_MRN WHERE VIS_NURS_STA IN ('M06', 'M02', 'JRSO', 'CMKO', 'MONO', 'WESO') AND VIS_ROOM_NUM IN ('6VIR', '2VIR', 'JRVIR', 'CMKVIR', 'MONVIR', 'WESVIR') AND (VIS_ADM_DTE >= '2018-02-24' OR VIS_DSCH_DTE >= '2018-02-24') ORDER BY 1, 5 ;

prompt: Provide a list of all myeloma patients consented to 06-107 and 12-245 during 2021-22, demographics, and dates of subsequent MSK-IMPACT testing.
completion: WITH DIAG AS (SELECT CC_MRN, MAX(CASE WHEN AC_IRB_NO ='12-245' THEN AC_CONS_DTE END) IRB_12_245_CONS_DTE, MAX(CASE WHEN AC_IRB_NO ='06-107' THEN AC_CONS_DTE END) IRB_06_107_CONS_DTE FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.ACCRUALS ON AC_MRN = CC_MRN AND AC_IRB_NO IN ('12-245', '06-107') AND AC_CONS_DTE BETWEEN '2021-01-01' AND '2022-12-31' LEFT JOIN IDB.ACCRUALS_DATES ON ACD_MRN = AC_MRN AND ACD_IRB_NO = AC_IRB_NO WHERE CC_CLSF_CD IN ('C90.00', 'C90.01', 'C90.02', 'C90.10', 'C90.11', 'C90.12', 'C90.20', 'C90.21', 'C90.30', 'C90.31', 'C90.32', 'D47.2') AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND (CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) GROUP BY CC_MRN ) , IMPACT AS (SELECT DISTINCT PR.PRPT_MRN, VARCHAR(PR.PRPT_REPORT, 32000) AS PRPT_REPORT, PR.PRPT_PROCEDURE_DTE AS PROCEDURE_DTE, IRB_12_245_CONS_DTE, IRB_06_107_CONS_DTE FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V PR JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_STRUCTURED_RESULTS_V ST ON PR.PRPT_PATH_RPT_ID = ST.PRPT_PATH_RPT_ID AND ST.METHOD = 'IMPACTHeme' JOIN DIAG ON PR.PRPT_MRN = CC_MRN WHERE 1=1 AND (CONTAINS(PR.PRPT_REPORT, '("MSK-IMPACT Heme")') = 1 AND (LOCATE('Matched', PR.PRPT_REPORT) >= 1 OR LOCATE('Unmatched', PR.PRPT_REPORT) >= 1)) ) SELECT DISTINCT PRPT_MRN AS MRN, TRIM(PT_LAST_NAME) || ', ' || PT_FIRST_NAME AS NAME, PT.PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH AS DATE_OF_BIRTH, PT.PT_RACE_DESC AS RACE, PT.PT_PT_ETHNICITY_DESC AS ETHNICITY, IRB_12_245_CONS_DTE, IRB_06_107_CONS_DTE, PRPT_REPORT AS PATH_REPORT, PROCEDURE_DTE AS DATE_MSK_IMPACT_TESTING FROM IMPACT JOIN IDB.PATIENT_V PT ON PT.PT_MRN = PRPT_MRN

prompt: Weekly report of all breast cancer patients who initiated trastuzumab/Herceptin therapy within the past 3 months
completion: WITH PT AS (SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME AS "Last Name", PT_FIRST_NAME AS "First Name", PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH AS "Date of Birth", PT_DATE_OF_DEATH AS "Date of Death", G.AV_CODE AS GENDER, R.AV_DESC AS RACE, E.AV_DESC AS ETHNICITY, CASE WHEN PT_DATE_OF_DEATH IS NULL THEN 'Alive' ELSE 'Deceased' END AS "Vital Status", TM_DX_DTE AS "Tumor Diagnosis Date", TM_HIST_CD AS "Histology Code", HIST_DESC AS "Histology Description", TM_SITE_CD AS "Site Code", SITE_DESC AS "Site Description", BEST_STAGE AS "Best Stage", MIN_ICD9_EFF_DTE AS "ICD Date", ICD9_CD AS "ICD Code", ICD9_DESC AS "ICD Description" FROM IDB.PATIENT LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS R ON R.AV_ELEMENT = 'RACE' AND R.AV_CODE = PT_RACE LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS E ON E.AV_ELEMENT = 'PT_ETHNICITY' AND E.AV_CODE = PT_PT_ETHNICITY LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS G ON G.AV_ELEMENT = 'SEX' AND G.AV_CODE = PT_SEX LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT TM_MRN, TM_DX_DTE, TM_HIST_CD, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS HIST_DESC, TM_SITE_CD, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_DESC, CASE WHEN TM_AJCC_7 NOT IN ('', '888', '999') THEN AJCC7.AV_DESC WHEN TM_AJCC NOT IN ('', '88', '99') THEN AJCC.AV_DESC WHEN TM_GENERAL_STG NOT IN ('', '9') THEN GS.AV_DESC WHEN TM_PATH_STG_GRP NOT IN ('', '88', '9', '99') THEN TM_PATH_STG_GRP ELSE CLIN.AV_DESC END AS BEST_STAGE, CASE WHEN TM_AJCC_7 NOT IN ('', '888', '999') THEN 'AJCC_7' WHEN TM_AJCC NOT IN ('', '88', '99') THEN 'AJCC' WHEN TM_GENERAL_STG NOT IN ('', '9') THEN 'GeneralStage' WHEN TM_PATH_STG_GRP NOT IN ('', '88', '9', '99') THEN 'PathStage' ELSE 'ClinicalStage' END AS BEST_STAGE_SOURCE FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS AL ON AL.AV_ELEMENT = 'CASE_STS' AND AL.AV_CODE = TM_CASE_STS LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS AJCC7 ON AJCC7.AV_ELEMENT = 'AJCC_7' AND AJCC7.AV_CODE = TM_AJCC_7 LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS AJCC ON AJCC.AV_ELEMENT = 'AJCC' AND AJCC.AV_CODE = TM_AJCC LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS GS ON GS.AV_ELEMENT = 'GENERAL_STG' AND GS.AV_CODE = TM_GENERAL_STG LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS CLIN ON CLIN.AV_ELEMENT = 'CLIN_STG_DSCR' AND CLIN.AV_CODE = TM_CLIN_STG_DSCR WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('3', '6', '7', '8') AND TM_SITE_CD IN ('C500' , 'C501', 'C502', 'C503', 'C504', 'C505', 'C506', 'C508', 'C509' ) ) AS CDB ON TM_MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT CC_MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS MIN_ICD9_EFF_DTE, CC_CLSF_CD AS ICD9_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS ICD9_DESC FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE CC_CLSF_CD IN ('174.0', '174.1', '174.2', '174.3', '174.4', '174.5', '174.6', '174.8', '174.9', 'C50.011', 'C50.012', 'C50.019', 'C50.021', 'C50.022', 'C50.111', 'C50.112', 'C50.119', 'C50.121', 'C50.122', 'C50.211', 'C50.212', 'C50.219', 'C50.221', 'C50.222', 'C50.311', 'C50.312', 'C50.319', 'C50.321', 'C50.322', 'C50.411', 'C50.412', 'C50.419', 'C50.421', 'C50.422', 'C50.511', 'C50.512', 'C50.519', 'C50.521', 'C50.522', 'C50.611', 'C50.612', 'C50.621', 'C50.622', 'C50.811', 'C50.812', 'C50.819', 'C50.821', 'C50.822', 'C50.911', 'C50.912', 'C50.919', 'C50.921', 'C50.922', 'C50.929') AND CASE WHEN CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y' AND CC_PT_TYPE <> 'E' THEN 'Y' WHEN CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' AND YEAR(CC_EFF_DTE) < 2004 THEN 'Y' WHEN CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND YEAR(CC_EFF_DTE) < 2001 THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END = 'Y' GROUP BY CC_MRN, CC_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK ) AS ICD9 ON CC_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE COALESCE(TM_MRN, CC_MRN) IS NOT NULL ), APR AS (SELECT DISTINCT APR_MRN, MIN(APR_START_DTE) MIN_APR_DTE, MIN(APR_END_DTE) MIN_APR_END_DTE, CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME FROM PT JOIN IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX ON PT_MRN = APR_MRN JOIN IDB.CHEMO_DRUG_GENERIC ON APR_GENERIC_NAME = CDG_GENERIC_NAME WHERE CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME = 'TRASTUZUMAB' GROUP BY APR_MRN, CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME ) , APR1 AS (SELECT DISTINCT DRUG_MRN, "APR Start Date", "Generic Name", "Prescribed Dose", "Route" FROM (SELECT DISTINCT A.APR_MRN DRUG_MRN, A.CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME AS "Generic Name", ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY A.APR_MRN ORDER BY A.MIN_APR_DTE ASC) AS RN, A.MIN_APR_DTE AS "APR Start Date", B.APR_PRESCRIBED_DOSE AS "Prescribed Dose", B.APR_ROUTE AS "Route" FROM APR A JOIN IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX_V B ON A.APR_MRN = B.APR_MRN WHERE A.MIN_APR_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT DATE -90 DAY AND CURRENT DATE -1 DAY ) A WHERE RN =1 ) SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN AS "MRN", "Last Name", "First Name", "Date of Birth", GENDER, RACE, ETHNICITY, "Tumor Diagnosis Date", "Histology Code", "Histology Description", "Site Code", "Site Description", "Best Stage", "ICD Date", "ICD Code", "ICD Description", "APR Start Date", "Generic Name", "Prescribed Dose", "Route" FROM PT JOIN APR1 ON PT_MRN = DRUG_MRN ORDER BY PT_MRN

prompt: Provide a list of patients who have have 2 or more elafin values available from 1/31/2016 to 1/31/2019.
completion: WITH LABS_RAW AS (SELECT LR_MRN, LR_RESULT_GUID, LR_PERFORMED_DTE, LR_TEST_NAME, LR_SUBTEST_NAME, LR_RESULT_VALUE, LR_ABNORMALITY_CD FROM IDB.LAB_RESULTS WHERE LR_TEST_NAME = 'Elafin plasma, Viracor' AND LR_PERFORMED_DTE BETWEEN '2016-01-31' AND '2019-01-31' ) , PTS AS (SELECT LR_MRN, COUNT(DISTINCT LR_RESULT_GUID) CNT FROM LABS_RAW GROUP BY LR_MRN HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT LR_RESULT_GUID) >= 2) , BMT_DATES AS (SELECT CDD_MRN BMT_MRN, LR_PERFORMED_DTE, CDO_ITEM_NAME, CDO_VALUE_TEXT, CDD_SERVICE_DTE HSCT_DATE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY LR_MRN, LR_PERFORMED_DTE ORDER BY CDD_SERVICE_DTE DESC) RN FROM LABS_RAW JOIN IDB.CD_DOCUMENT ON LR_MRN = CDD_MRN JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION ON CDD_MRN = CDO_MRN AND CDD_DOC_GUID = CDO_DOC_GUID AND CDD_AUTHORED_DTE = CDO_AUTHORED_DTE WHERE CDD_DOC_NAME IN ('Cell Infusion - BMT') AND CDO_ITEM_NAME = 'Product Information: Cell Infusion Type' AND CDD_CANCEL_IND <> '1' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND <> '1' AND CDD_SERVICE_DTE <= LR_PERFORMED_DTE ) SELECT DISTINCT TM_MRN "MRN", PT_LAST_NAME "Last Name", PT_FIRST_NAME "First Name", PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH "DOB", PT_SEX "Sex", TM_DX_DTE "Tumor Dx Date", TM_SITE_CD AS "Tumor Site Code", S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS "Tumor Site Desc", TM_HIST_CD AS "Tumor Histology Code", H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS "Tumor Histology Desc", CDO_VALUE_TEXT, HSCT_DATE, LR.LR_PERFORMED_DTE "Lab Performed Date", LR_TEST_NAME "Lab Test Name", LR_SUBTEST_NAME "Lab Subtest Name", LR_RESULT_VALUE "Lab Result" FROM PTS P JOIN LABS_RAW LR ON P.LR_MRN = LR.LR_MRN JOIN IDB.CDB_TUMOR ON LR.LR_MRN = TM_MRN JOIN IDB.CLM H ON TM_HIST_CD = H.CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON TM_SITE_CD = S.CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON TM_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY ON PT_MRN = PLA_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS CS ON CS.AV_ELEMENT = 'CASE_STS' AND CS.AV_CODE = TM_CASE_STS LEFT JOIN BMT_DATES BD ON P.LR_MRN = BMT_MRN AND LR.LR_PERFORMED_DTE = BD.LR_PERFORMED_DTE AND RN = 1 WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8')

prompt: Pediatric patients who have undergone ovarian harvest, ovarian transposition, testicular harvest, or testicular transposition since 1995
completion: SELECT SSE_MRN MRN, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH DOB, SSE_SURG_DTE "Surgery Date", YEAR(SSE_SURG_DTE-PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) "Age at Surgery", SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD "CPT Code", SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC "CPT Desc" FROM IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE ON SSE_LOG_ID = SSP_LOG_ID JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON SSE_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE SSE_SURG_DTE >= '1990-01-01' AND YEAR(SSE_SURG_DTE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) <= 21 AND SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD IN ('58661', '58720', '58825', '58940', '54520', '54522', '54620', '54640', '54680', '0058T', '0357T', '89259', '89335', '89337') ; WITH PTS AS (SELECT DISTINCT SSE_MRN FROM IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE ON SSE_LOG_ID = SSP_LOG_ID JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON SSE_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE SSE_SURG_DTE >= '1990-01-01' AND YEAR(SSE_SURG_DTE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) <= 21 AND SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD IN ('58661', '58720', '58825', '58940', '54520', '54522', '54620', '54640', '54680', '0058T', '0357T', '89259', '89335', '89337') ) SELECT DISTINCT TM_MRN MRN, YEAR(TM_DX_DTE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) "Age at Dx", TM_DX_DTE "Tumor Dx Date", TM_SITE_CD AS "Tumor Site Code", S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS "Tumor Site Desc", TM_HIST_CD AS "Tumor Histology Code", H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS "Tumor Histology Desc" FROM PTS JOIN IDB.CDB_TUMOR ON SSE_MRN = TM_MRN JOIN IDB.CLM H ON TM_HIST_CD = H.CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON TM_SITE_CD = S.CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON TM_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY ON PT_MRN = PLA_MRN WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('3', '6', '7', '8')

prompt: Provide a list of patients treated with Axicabtagene ciloleucel and associated characteristics since October 2017.
completion: WITH PTS AS (SELECT DISTINCT APR_MRN MRN, APR_GENERIC_NAME, APR_START_DTE FROM IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX WHERE APR_GENERIC_NAME IN ('AXICABTAGENE CILOLEUCEL') ) SELECT PT_MRN, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, PT_DATE_OF_DEATH, PLA_LST_CON_DTE "Last Contact Date", APR_GENERIC_NAME, APR_START_DTE FROM PTS JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON MRN=PT_MRN JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY ON PLA_MRN=MRN ; WITH PTS AS (SELECT DISTINCT APR_MRN MRN, APR_GENERIC_NAME, APR_START_DTE FROM IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX WHERE APR_GENERIC_NAME IN ('AXICABTAGENE CILOLEUCEL') ) SELECT APR_MRN, APR.APR_GENERIC_NAME, APR.APR_ROUTE, APR.APR_START_DTE, APR.APR_END_DTE, APR.APR_PRESCRIBED_DOSE FROM PTS JOIN IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX APR ON PTS.MRN = APR.APR_MRN AND APR.APR_START_DTE BETWEEN PTS.APR_START_DTE - 30 DAYS AND PTS.APR_START_DTE + 30 DAYS WHERE APR_CHEMO_FLAG = 'Y' ORDER BY 1, 4, 2 ; WITH PTS AS (SELECT DISTINCT APR_MRN MRN, APR_GENERIC_NAME, APR_START_DTE FROM IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX WHERE APR_GENERIC_NAME IN ('AXICABTAGENE CILOLEUCEL') ) SELECT OO_MRN, OO_ENTER_DTE, OO_ORD_STS_CD, OO_ORD_NAME, MAX(CASE WHEN OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'EEG_Type' THEN OUD_USER_DI_VALUE END) "EEG Type" FROM PTS JOIN IDB.OMS_ORDER ON OO_MRN = MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_USER_DATA ON OO_ORD_GUID = OUD_ORD_GUID WHERE OO_ORD_NAME ='Electroencephalogram' AND OUD_USER_DI_CD IN ('EEG_Type') AND OO_ORD_STS_CD NOT IN ('CANP', 'CANC', 'AUC3') AND OO_ENTER_DTE BETWEEN APR_START_DTE AND APR_START_DTE + 30 DAYS GROUP BY OO_MRN, OO_ENTER_DTE, OO_ORD_STS_CD, OO_ORD_NAME ; WITH PTS AS (SELECT DISTINCT APR_MRN MRN, APR_GENERIC_NAME, APR_START_DTE FROM IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX WHERE APR_GENERIC_NAME IN ('AXICABTAGENE CILOLEUCEL') ) SELECT * FROM PTS JOIN IDB.OMS_ORDER ON OO_MRN=MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_USER_DATA ON OO_ORD_GUID = OUD_ORD_GUID WHERE UPPER(OO_SUMMARY_LINE) LIKE '%LUMBAR%PUNC%' AND OO_ORD_STS_CD NOT IN ('CANP', 'CANC', 'AUC3') AND OO_ENTER_DTE BETWEEN APR_START_DTE AND APR_START_DTE + 30 DAYS ; WITH PTS AS (SELECT DISTINCT APR_MRN MRN, APR_GENERIC_NAME, APR_START_DTE FROM IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX WHERE APR_GENERIC_NAME IN ('AXICABTAGENE CILOLEUCEL') ) SELECT DISTINCT MRN, PBD_SVC_DTE, PBC_PBD_DESC FROM PTS JOIN IDB.PBD_DTL ON PBD_MRN = MRN AND PBD_SVC_DTE BETWEEN APR_START_DTE AND APR_START_DTE + 30 DAYS JOIN IDB.PBD_CODE ON PBD_PBD_CD = PBC_PBD_CD WHERE PBC_PBD_DESC like '%MRI%BRAIN%' ; WITH PTS AS (SELECT DISTINCT APR_MRN MRN, APR_GENERIC_NAME, APR_START_DTE FROM IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX WHERE APR_GENERIC_NAME IN ('AXICABTAGENE CILOLEUCEL') ) SELECT T1.PT_MRN MRN, APR_GENERIC_NAME, APR_START_DTE, T2.PINC_GENERIC_NAME, T3.DT_DTE MED_START_DATE, T10.DT_DTE AS MED_STOP_DATE FROM PTS JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V T1 ON MRN=PT_MRN JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED T4 ON T1.PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = T4.PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID LEFT JOIN DV.PHM_PT_MEDS_MQT T5 ON T4.PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = T5.POD_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID LEFT JOIN DV.PHM_ORDER_DTL T6 ON T5.POD_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = T6.POD_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID AND T5.POD_PHARMA_INVENTORY_CTLG_ID = T6.POD_PHARMA_INVENTORY_CTLG_ID LEFT JOIN DV.PHM_INVENTORY_CATALOG T2 ON T6.POD_PHARMA_INVENTORY_CTLG_ID = T2.PINC_INVENTORY_CTLG_ID LEFT JOIN DV.DATE_V T10 ON T6.POD_STOP_DATE_ID = T10.DT_DATE_ID LEFT JOIN DV.DATE_V T3 ON T6.POD_START_DATE_ID = T3.DT_DATE_ID WHERE (APR_START_DTE BETWEEN T3.DT_DTE AND T10.DT_DTE OR APR_START_DTE+30 DAY BETWEEN T3.DT_DTE AND T10.DT_DTE OR T3.DT_DTE BETWEEN APR_START_DTE AND APR_START_DTE+30 DAY OR T10.DT_DTE BETWEEN APR_START_DTE AND APR_START_DTE+30 DAY) AND (UPPER(T2.PINC_GENERIC_NAME) LIKE '%DEXAMETHASONE%' OR UPPER(T2.PINC_GENERIC_NAME) LIKE '%METHYLPREDNISOLONE%' OR UPPER(T2.PINC_GENERIC_NAME) LIKE '%LEVETIRACETAM%' OR UPPER(T2.PINC_GENERIC_NAME) LIKE '%PHENYTOIN%' OR UPPER(T2.PINC_GENERIC_NAME) LIKE '%FOSPHENYTOIN%' OR UPPER(T2.PINC_GENERIC_NAME) LIKE '%LACOSAMIDE%' OR UPPER(T2.PINC_GENERIC_NAME) LIKE '%CEFEPIME%' OR UPPER(T2.PINC_GENERIC_NAME) LIKE '%IMIPENEM%' OR UPPER(T2.PINC_GENERIC_NAME) LIKE '%MEROPENEM%' OR UPPER(T2.PINC_GENERIC_NAME) LIKE '%TOCILIZUMAB%' OR UPPER(T2.PINC_GENERIC_NAME) LIKE '%ANAKINRA%' OR UPPER(T2.PINC_GENERIC_NAME) LIKE '%SILTUXIMAB%' OR UPPER(T2.PINC_GENERIC_NAME) LIKE '%PROPOFOL%' OR UPPER(T2.PINC_GENERIC_NAME) LIKE '%MIDAZOLAM%' OR UPPER(T2.PINC_GENERIC_NAME) LIKE '%LORAZEPAM%' OR UPPER(T2.PINC_GENERIC_NAME) LIKE '%FILGRASTIM%' OR UPPER(T2.PINC_GENERIC_NAME) LIKE '%PEGFILGRASTIM%' OR UPPER(T2.PINC_GENERIC_NAME) LIKE '%THIAMINE%') ; WITH PTS AS (SELECT DISTINCT APR_MRN MRN, APR_GENERIC_NAME, APR_START_DTE FROM IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX WHERE APR_GENERIC_NAME IN ('AXICABTAGENE CILOLEUCEL') ) SELECT LR_MRN, LR_TEST_NAME, LR_SUBTEST_NAME, LR_PERFORMED_DTE, LR_RESULT_VALUE FROM PTS JOIN IDB.LAB_RESULTS ON LR_MRN = MRN AND LR_PERFORMED_DTE BETWEEN APR_START_DTE AND APR_START_DTE + 30 DAYS WHERE LR_SUBTEST_NAME IN ('C-Reactive Protein', 'C-Reactive Protein, High Sensitivity', 'Ferritin.', 'Fibrinogen.', 'Fibrinogen', 'D-Dimer', 'Red Blood Cells CSF', 'Total Cells Counted CSF', 'Protein, CSF', 'Glucose, CSF', 'Vitamin B1 (Thiamin), Whole Blood, Mayo', 'Sodium') OR LR_TEST_NAME = 'Cytokines Panel 1' ORDER BY 1, 4, 3 ; WITH PTS AS (SELECT DISTINCT APR_MRN MRN, APR_GENERIC_NAME, APR_START_DTE FROM IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX WHERE APR_GENERIC_NAME IN ('AXICABTAGENE CILOLEUCEL') ), VISIT AS (SELECT VIS_MRN MRN, VIS_ADM_DTE, VIS_DSCH_DTE FROM PTS JOIN IDB.VISIT_V ON VIS_MRN=MRN AND APR_START_DTE BETWEEN VIS_ADM_DTE AND VIS_DSCH_DTE) SELECT CDD_MRN, VIS_ADM_DTE ADMIT, VIS_DSCH_DTE DISCHARGE, C.CDD_SERVICE_DTE TEMP_DTE, MAX(CAST(TRIM(CDO_VALUE_TEXT) AS float)) "Temperature F" FROM VISIT JOIN IDB.CD_DOCUMENT C ON CDD_MRN = MRN AND CDD_SERVICE_DTE BETWEEN VIS_ADM_DTE AND VIS_DSCH_DTE JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION ON CDD_DOC_GUID = CDO_DOC_GUID AND CDD_AUTHORED_DTE = CDO_AUTHORED_DTE WHERE UPPER(CDD_DOC_NAME) like '%VITAL SIGNS%' AND CDD_CANCEL_IND <> '1' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND <> '1' AND CDO_ITEM_NAME IN ('Temperature F') GROUP BY CDD_MRN, VIS_ADM_DTE, VIS_DSCH_DTE, C.CDD_SERVICE_DTE ORDER BY 1, 4 ; WITH PTS AS (SELECT DISTINCT APR_MRN MRN, APR_GENERIC_NAME, APR_START_DTE FROM IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX WHERE APR_GENERIC_NAME IN ('AXICABTAGENE CILOLEUCEL') ) SELECT DISTINCT CDD_MRN AS "MRN", CDD_DOC_NAME AS "Document Name", CDD_SERVICE_DTE AS "Service Date", CDD_DOC_GUID AS "Document Guid", CDO_SECTION AS "Section", CDO_ITEM_NAME AS "Item", CDO_VALUE_TEXT AS "Value" FROM PTS JOIN IDB.CD_DOCUMENT ON CDD_MRN = MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION ON CDD_DOC_GUID = CDO_DOC_GUID AND CDD_AUTHORED_DTE = CDO_AUTHORED_DTE AND CDO_VALUE_TEXT <> '' WHERE CDD_CANCEL_IND <> '1' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND <> '1' AND UPPER(CDD_DOC_NAME) like '%LUMBAR%' AND UPPER(CDO_ITEM_NAME) like '%PRESSURE%' ; WITH PTS AS (SELECT DISTINCT APR_MRN MRN, APR_GENERIC_NAME, APR_START_DTE FROM IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX WHERE APR_GENERIC_NAME IN ('AXICABTAGENE CILOLEUCEL') ) SELECT MRN, RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE, RRPT_PROCEDURE_NAME, RRPT_REPORT_TXT FROM DV.RADIOLOGY_REPORT_V JOIN PTS ON MRN=RRPT_MRN WHERE CONTAINS(RRPT_REPORT_TXT, '"opening pressure"') = 1

prompt: Provide a list of operations performed in the main OR that ended after 7:00 pm between January and April, 2010.
completion: SELECT OL_SURG_DTE SURG_DATE, LOC_LOC_ID LID, LOC_LOC_NAME LOC , CASE WHEN DAYOFWEEK(DATE(OL_SURG_DTE)) = 1 THEN 'Sun' WHEN DAYOFWEEK(DATE(OL_SURG_DTE)) = 2 THEN 'Mon' WHEN DAYOFWEEK(DATE(OL_SURG_DTE)) = 3 THEN 'Tue' WHEN DAYOFWEEK(DATE(OL_SURG_DTE)) = 4 THEN 'Wed' WHEN DAYOFWEEK(DATE(OL_SURG_DTE)) = 5 THEN 'Thu' WHEN DAYOFWEEK(DATE(OL_SURG_DTE)) = 6 THEN 'Fri' WHEN DAYOFWEEK(DATE(OL_SURG_DTE)) = 7 THEN 'Sat' END AS DOW , CRE_RES_NAME OR_ROOM, OL_CASE_CLASS CASE_CLASS, OL_MRN MRN , OL_LOG_ID LOG_ID, CASE WHEN ORC_NAME IN ('IP', 'PSC', 'SDA', 'PDH', 'EI', 'FSI') THEN 'IP' ELSE 'OP' END AS PT_TYPE , TIME(PO.OLCT_EVNT_IN_DT) PT_IN_ROOM, TIME(MIN(S.OLPT_EVNT_IN_DT)) SURG_START , TIME(MAX(E.OLPT_EVNT_IN_DT)) SURG_END, TIME(PO.OLCT_EVNT_IN_DT) PT_ROOM_OUT , SUBSTR(CASE WHEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(4, CHAR(MAX(E.OLPT_EVNT_IN_DT) - MIN(S.OLPT_EVNT_IN_DT)))/60 BETWEEN 0 AND 9 THEN '0'||STRIP(CHAR(TIMESTAMPDIFF(4, CHAR(MAX(E.OLPT_EVNT_IN_DT) - MIN(S.OLPT_EVNT_IN_DT)))/60)) ELSE STRIP(CHAR(TIMESTAMPDIFF(4, CHAR(MAX(E.OLPT_EVNT_IN_DT) - MIN(S.OLPT_EVNT_IN_DT)))/60)) END ||':'||RIGHT(DIGITS(MOD((TIMESTAMPDIFF(4, CHAR(MAX(E.OLPT_EVNT_IN_DT) - MIN(S.OLPT_EVNT_IN_DT)))),60)), 2), 1, 8) TTL_SURG_TIME , SUBSTR(CASE WHEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(4, CHAR(PO.OLCT_EVNT_IN_DT - PI.OLCT_EVNT_IN_DT))/60 BETWEEN 0 AND 9 THEN '0'||STRIP(CHAR(TIMESTAMPDIFF(4, CHAR(PO.OLCT_EVNT_IN_DT - PI.OLCT_EVNT_IN_DT))/60)) ELSE STRIP(CHAR(TIMESTAMPDIFF(4, CHAR(PO.OLCT_EVNT_IN_DT - PI.OLCT_EVNT_IN_DT))/60)) END ||':'||RIGHT(DIGITS(MOD((TIMESTAMPDIFF(4, CHAR(PO.OLCT_EVNT_IN_DT - PI.OLCT_EVNT_IN_DT))),60)), 2), 1, 8) TTL_ROOM_TIME , (CURRENT DATE - 8 DAY) AS FD, (CURRENT DATE - 2 DAY) AS TD FROM IDB.OR_LOG JOIN IDB.OR_LOG_ALL_SURG ON OLAS_LOG_ID = OL_LOG_ID AND OLAS_SURG_ROLE = 'Primary' JOIN IDB.OR_LOG_ALL_PROC ON OLAS_LOG_ID = OLAP_LOG_ID AND OLAS_PNL_NO = OLAP_PNL_NO JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON OL_ROOM_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_LOCATION ON OL_SURG_LOC_ID = LOC_LOC_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.OR_LOG_PANEL_TIMES S ON S.OLPT_LOG_ID = OL_LOG_ID AND S.OLPT_PNL_NO = OLAP_PNL_NO AND S.OLPT_OR_PROC_ID = OLAP_OR_PROC_ID AND S.OLPT_PNL_EVNT_CD = '100' LEFT JOIN IDB.OR_LOG_PANEL_TIMES E ON E.OLPT_LOG_ID = OL_LOG_ID AND E.OLPT_PNL_NO = OLAP_PNL_NO AND E.OLPT_OR_PROC_ID = OLAP_OR_PROC_ID AND E.OLPT_PNL_EVNT_CD = '300' LEFT JOIN IDB.OR_LOG_CASE_TIMES PI ON OL_LOG_ID = PI.OLCT_LOG_ID AND PI.OLCT_TRACK_EVNT_CD = '600' LEFT JOIN IDB.OR_LOG_CASE_TIMES PO ON OL_LOG_ID = PO.OLCT_LOG_ID AND PO.OLCT_TRACK_EVNT_CD = '1000' LEFT JOIN IDB.OR_CATEGORY ON ORC_CATEGORY = 'ZC.PAT.CLASS' AND ORC_CODE = OL_PT_TYPE_CD WHERE OL_SURG_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT DATE - 8 DAY AND CURRENT DATE - 2 DAY AND PI.OLCT_EVNT_IN_DT IS NOT NULL AND TIME(E.OLPT_EVNT_IN_DT) > '19:00' AND OL_LOG_STS NOT IN ('4', '6') GROUP BY OL_SURG_DTE, LOC_LOC_ID, LOC_LOC_NAME, CRE_RES_NAME , OL_CASE_CLASS, OL_MRN, OL_LOG_ID , CASE WHEN ORC_NAME IN ('IP', 'PSC', 'SDA', 'PDH', 'EI', 'FSI') THEN 'IP' ELSE 'OP' END , PI.OLCT_EVNT_IN_DT, PO.OLCT_EVNT_IN_DT
