prompt: please provide a list of patients with a pathological diagnosis of chondrosarcoma AND a CT chest within a 6 week interval of the pathology date with the phrase "metastases" in the body or impression of the report . Time period: Jan 1st  2009- Jan 1st 2019
completion: WITH DX AS (SELECT PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID DEID, DXCC_ICD_CODE AS "ICD-9/10 Dx Code", DXCC_ICD_MSK_DESC AS "ICD-9/10 Dx Description", MIN(DT_DTE) AS "ICD-9/10 Min Dx Date" FROM DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS JOIN DV.PATIENT_DIAGNOSIS_FINAL_ALL_V ON PDX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID JOIN DV.DATE_V ON PDX_DX_DATE_ID = DT_DATE_ID JOIN DV.DIAGNOSIS_CATALOG ON PDX_DX_CATALOG_ID = DXCC_DX_CATALOG_ID WHERE (DXCC_ICD_CODE LIKE 'C41.9%' OR DXCC_ICD_CODE LIKE '170.9%') GROUP BY PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID, DXCC_ICD_CODE, DXCC_ICD_MSK_DESC UNION SELECT PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID DEID, ICSC_SITE_CD AS "ICD-9/10 Dx Code", ICSC_ICDO_SITE_MSK_DESC AS "ICD-9/10 Dx Description", MIN(DT_DTE) AS "ICD-9/10 Min Dx Date" FROM DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS JOIN DV.CDB_TUMOR_V ON CDTM_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID JOIN DV.DATE_V ON CDTM_DX_DATE_ID = DT_DATE_ID JOIN DV.DIAGNOSIS_CODE_CAT_ICDO_V ON CDTM_DX_CATALOG_ID = DXCC_DX_CATALOG_ID JOIN DV.ICDO_SITE_CATALOG_V ON CDTM_SITE_CATALOG_ID = ICSC_SITE_CATALOG_ID JOIN DV.TUMOR_CASE_ATTRIBUTES_V ON CDTM_CASE_ATTR_ID = TUMOR_CASE_ATTR_ID WHERE ICSC_SITE_CD like 'C419%' GROUP BY PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID, ICSC_SITE_CD, ICSC_ICDO_SITE_MSK_DESC) SELECT DISTINCT DEID, "ICD-9/10 Dx Code", "ICD-9/10 Dx Description", YEAR("ICD-9/10 Min Dx Date") AS "ICD-9/10 Min Dx Date", RRPT_PROCEDURE_NAME, YEAR(RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE) RRPT_PERFORMED_YEAR, RRPT_ORDER_GROUP FROM DV.RADIOLOGY_REPORT_V JOIN DX ON DEID=RRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID AND RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE BETWEEN "ICD-9/10 Min Dx Date" AND "ICD-9/10 Min Dx Date" + (12*7) DAYS WHERE RRPT_ORDER_GROUP = 'CT' AND CONTAINS("RRPT_REPORT_TXT", '("metastasis" | "metastases" | "metastatic")') = 1 AND (CONTAINS("RRPT_REPORT_TXT", '"chest"') = 1 OR LOWER(RRPT_PROCEDURE_NAME) like '%chest%') ;

prompt: This is a retrospective study examining the impact of geriatric deficits, defined by eRFA and/or official geriatrics office consultation, on the outcome of lymphoma patients with and without chimeric antigen receptor therapy.
completion: WITH CLINTRAC AS (SELECT CC_MRN FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE (SUBSTR(CC_CLSF_CD, 1, 3) BETWEEN 'C81' AND 'C86' OR SUBSTR(CC_CLSF_CD, 1, 3) BETWEEN '200' AND '202' OR SUBSTR(CC_CLSF_CD, 1, 3) = 'C88' OR CC_CLSF_CD IN ('273.3', '203.81', '203.80', '238.79')) AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND (CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) ) , ERFA AS (SELECT EF_MRN, EF_SUBMISSION_DT, EFI_ITEM_TEXT, EFI_ITEM_ALIAS, EFI_VALUE, RANK() OVER(PARTITION BY EF_MRN ORDER BY EF_SUBMISSION_DT DESC) AS RANK FROM IDB.EF_FORM JOIN IDB.EF_FORM_ITEM ON EF_FORM_ID = EFI_FORM_ID WHERE EF_FORM_ALIAS = 'erfa' AND DATE (EF_SUBMISSION_DT) BETWEEN '2010-01-01' AND '2019-07-31' ) , CLINDOC AS (SELECT CDD_MRN, MIN(CDD_SERVICE_DTE) CDD_SERVICE_DTE FROM IDB.CD_DOCUMENT LEFT JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION ON CDD_DOC_GUID = CDO_DOC_GUID AND CDD_AUTHORED_DTE = CDO_AUTHORED_DTE AND CDO_VALUE_TEXT <> '' JOIN IDB.OMS_PROVIDER ON CDD_AUTH_PROV_GUID = OP_PVDR_GUID WHERE CDD_CANCEL_IND <> '1' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND <> '1' AND (CDD_DOC_NAME = 'Initial Consult/Initial Visit - Geriatric' OR CDD_DOC_NAME = 'Initial Consult/Initial Visit, AMB - DOM-Geriatrics') AND CDD_SERVICE_DTE BETWEEN '2010-01-01' AND '2019-07-31' GROUP BY CDD_MRN ) SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, PT_DATE_OF_DEATH, PT_SEX, HIST_DESC AS DX, EF_SUBMISSION_DT, CDD_SERVICE_DTE, EFI_ITEM_ALIAS, EFI_VALUE FROM IDB.PATIENT JOIN CLINTRAC ON PT_MRN = CC_MRN LEFT JOIN (SELECT TM_MRN, LISTAGG(TM_DX_DTE || ': ' || TRIM(HIST_DESC), CHR(13) || CHR(10)) AS HIST_DESC FROM (SELECT DISTINCT TM_MRN, MIN(TM_DX_DTE) AS TM_DX_DTE, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS HIST_DESC FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS C ON C.AV_ELEMENT = 'CASE_STS' AND C.AV_CODE = TM_CASE_STS AND TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') GROUP BY TM_MRN, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK) GROUP BY TM_MRN) ON PT_MRN = TM_MRN LEFT JOIN ERFA ON PT_MRN = EF_MRN AND RANK = 1 LEFT JOIN CLINDOC ON PT_MRN = CDD_MRN WHERE COALESCE(CDD_MRN, EF_MRN) IS NOT NULL ; SELECT DISTINCT EFI_ITEM_ALIAS "eRFA Alias", EFI_ITEM_TEXT "eRFA Question" FROM IDB.EF_FORM JOIN IDB.EF_FORM_ITEM ON EF_FORM_ID = EFI_FORM_ID WHERE EF_FORM_ALIAS = 'erfa' ORDER BY EFI_ITEM_ALIAS

prompt: Provide a list of pediatric patients diagnosed with Congenital Mesoblastic Nephroma, Mesoblastic Nephroma, Congenital Nephroma, Infantile Fibrosarcoma, Congenital Fibrosarcoma or Congenital Infantile Fibrosarcoma from 1/1/1990 to 2/1/2019.
completion: SELECT PT_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_SEX, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, PT_DATE_OF_DEATH, PLA_LST_CON_DTE LAST_CONTACT_DTE, CASE_STS, TM_DX_DTE, TM_HIST_CD, HIST_DESC, TM_SITE_CD, SITE_DESC, WITHIN_TWO_MONTHS_DX_STG, TM_FIRST_RECUR_DTE, MIN_ICD9_EFF_DTE ICD9_10_DX_DTE, ICD9_CD ICD_9_10_CD, ICD9_DESC ICD_9_10_DESC FROM IDB.PATIENT LEFT JOIN (SELECT TM_MRN, C.AV_DESC AS CASE_STS, TM_DX_DTE, TM_HIST_CD, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS HIST_DESC, TM_SITE_CD, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_DESC, TM_HIST_CD_GRADE, HIST_CD_GRADE.AV_DESC AS HIST_GRADE, C2.CDB_AV_DESC WITHIN_TWO_MONTHS_DX_STG, TM_FIRST_RECUR_DTE FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS C ON C.AV_ELEMENT = 'CASE_STS' AND C.AV_CODE = TM_CASE_STS AND TM_CASE_STS IN ('3', '6', '7', '8') AND (TM_HIST_CD LIKE 'M8960%' OR TM_HIST_CD LIKE '8814%') LEFT JOIN IDB.CDB_ALLOWVALS C2 ON C2.CDB_AV_ELEMENT = 'GENERAL_STG' AND C2.CDB_AV_CD_STS = 'A' AND TM_GENERAL_STG = C2.CDB_AV_CODE LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS HIST_CD_GRADE ON TM_HIST_CD_GRADE = HIST_CD_GRADE.AV_CODE AND HIST_CD_GRADE.AV_ELEMENT='HIST_CD_GRADE' WHERE TM_DX_DTE >= '1990-01-01' ) AS CDB ON TM_MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN (SELECT CC_MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS MIN_ICD9_EFF_DTE, CC_CLSF_CD AS ICD9_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS ICD9_DESC FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE CC_EFF_DTE >= '1990-01-01' AND (CC_CLSF_CD LIKE 'C64%' OR CC_CLSF_CD LIKE 'C49%' OR CC_CLSF_CD LIKE '189%' OR CC_CLSF_CD LIKE '171%') AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND (CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) GROUP BY CC_MRN, CC_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK ) AS ICD9 ON CC_MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY ON PT_MRN = PLA_MRN WHERE COALESCE(TM_MRN, CC_MRN) IS NOT NULL AND (TM_DX_DTE - 21 YEARS < PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH OR MIN_ICD9_EFF_DTE - 21 YEARS < PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) ; WITH PTS AS (SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN MRN FROM IDB.PATIENT LEFT JOIN (SELECT TM_MRN, C.AV_DESC AS CASE_STS, TM_DX_DTE, TM_HIST_CD, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS HIST_DESC, TM_SITE_CD, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_DESC, TM_HIST_CD_GRADE, HIST_CD_GRADE.AV_DESC AS HIST_GRADE, C2.CDB_AV_DESC WITHIN_TWO_MONTHS_DX_STG, TM_TSTAGE, TSTAGES.AV_DESC AS TSTAGE, TM_NSTAGE, NSTAGES.AV_DESC AS NSTAGE, TM_MSTAGE, MSTAGES.AV_DESC AS MSTAGE, MSK_STAGES.AV_DESC AS STAGE, TM_MSK_STG STG_PRESENTED_AT_MSK, C1.CDB_AV_DESC STG_PRESENTED_AT_MSK_DESC, TM_CSSIZE FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS C ON C.AV_ELEMENT = 'CASE_STS' AND C.AV_CODE = TM_CASE_STS AND TM_CASE_STS IN ('3', '6', '7', '8') AND (TM_HIST_CD LIKE 'M8960%' OR TM_HIST_CD LIKE '8814%') LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS TSTAGES ON TSTAGES.AV_ELEMENT='TSTAGE' AND TSTAGES.AV_CODE=TM_TSTAGE LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS NSTAGES ON NSTAGES.AV_ELEMENT='NSTAGE' AND NSTAGES.AV_CODE=TM_NSTAGE LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS MSTAGES ON MSTAGES.AV_ELEMENT='MSTAGE' AND MSTAGES.AV_CODE=TM_MSTAGE LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS MSK_STAGES ON MSK_STAGES.AV_ELEMENT='MSK_STAGE' AND MSK_STAGES.AV_CODE=TM_MSK_STG LEFT JOIN IDB.CDB_ALLOWVALS C1 ON C1.CDB_AV_ELEMENT = 'GENERAL_STG' AND C1.CDB_AV_CD_STS = 'A' AND TM_MSK_STG = C1.CDB_AV_CODE LEFT JOIN IDB.CDB_ALLOWVALS C2 ON C2.CDB_AV_ELEMENT = 'GENERAL_STG' AND C2.CDB_AV_CD_STS = 'A' AND TM_GENERAL_STG = C2.CDB_AV_CODE LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS HIST_CD_GRADE ON TM_HIST_CD_GRADE = HIST_CD_GRADE.AV_CODE AND HIST_CD_GRADE.AV_ELEMENT='HIST_CD_GRADE' WHERE TM_DX_DTE >= '1990-01-01' ) AS CDB ON TM_MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN (SELECT CC_MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS MIN_ICD9_EFF_DTE, CC_CLSF_CD AS ICD9_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS ICD9_DESC FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE CC_EFF_DTE >= '1990-01-01' AND (CC_CLSF_CD LIKE 'C64%' OR CC_CLSF_CD LIKE 'C49%' OR CC_CLSF_CD LIKE '189%' OR CC_CLSF_CD LIKE '171%') AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND (CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) GROUP BY CC_MRN, CC_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK) AS ICD9 ON CC_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE COALESCE(TM_MRN, CC_MRN) IS NOT NULL AND (TM_DX_DTE - 21 YEARS < PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH OR MIN_ICD9_EFF_DTE - 21 YEARS < PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) ) SELECT MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, PT_DATE_OF_DEATH, SSE_SURG_DTE, SSE_LOG_STS, SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD, SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC, SSP_SURG_LAST_NM, SSP_SURG_FIRST_NM, SSP_SURG_SVC_CD FROM PTS JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON MRN=PT_MRN JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT ON MRN = SSE_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE ON SSE_LOG_ID = SSP_LOG_ID ;

prompt: Provide a list of all suicide assessments for all inpatient Pediatric patients (age 8+) in 2022.
completion: WITH PEDS_IP AS (SELECT DISTINCT VIS_MRN FROM IDB.VISIT JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON VIS_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE VIS_HOSP_SVC IN ('PDB', 'PDG', 'PDP', 'PDR', 'PDU', 'PED', 'PDS') AND VIS_IP_OP_ADJUSTED_IND = 'I' AND VIS_VISIT_STATUS IN ('2', '3') AND YEAR(VIS_ADM_DTE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) >= 8 ) , RAW AS (SELECT CDD_MRN, CDD_DOC_GUID, CDD_SERVICE_DTE, CDO_CTLG_DISPL_NM, CDO_ITEM_NAME, CDO_VALUE_TEXT FROM PEDS_IP JOIN IDB.CD_DOCUMENT ON VIS_MRN = CDD_MRN JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION ON CDD_MRN = CDO_MRN AND CDD_DOC_GUID = CDO_DOC_GUID WHERE CDD_CANCEL_IND <> '1' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND <> '1' AND CDD_SERVICE_DTE BETWEEN '2022-01-01' AND '2022-12-31' AND LOCATE('Nursing Ongoing Assessment', CDD_DOC_NAME) >= 1 AND CDO_CTLG_DISPL_NM = 'Suicide Severity' ) SELECT CDD_MRN MRN, PT_LAST_NAME LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME FIRST_NAME, PT_SEX SEX, YEAR(CDD_SERVICE_DTE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) AGE_AT_NOTE, CDD_SERVICE_DTE SERVICE_DATE, MAX(CASE WHEN CDO_ITEM_NAME = 'Able to assess patient at this time' THEN CDO_VALUE_TEXT END) ASSESS_PT, MAX(CASE WHEN CDO_ITEM_NAME = 'Unable to assess patient' THEN CDO_VALUE_TEXT END) UNABLE_ASSESS_PT, MAX(CASE WHEN CDO_ITEM_NAME = 'Have you wished you were dead or wished you could go to sleep and not wake up, within the past month?' THEN CDO_VALUE_TEXT END) WISH_DEAD, MAX(CASE WHEN CDO_ITEM_NAME = 'Have you actually had any thoughts of killing yourself, within the past month?' THEN CDO_VALUE_TEXT END) THOUGHTS, MAX(CASE WHEN CDO_ITEM_NAME = 'Have you ever done anything, started to do anything, or prepared to do anything to end your life? Examples: Collected pills, obtained a gun, gave away valuables, wrote a will or suicide note, took out pills but didn''t swallow any, held a gun but chan' THEN CDO_VALUE_TEXT END) SUICIDE_ACTION, MAX(CASE WHEN CDO_ITEM_NAME = 'How long ago did you do any of these?' THEN CDO_VALUE_TEXT END) SUICIDE_ACTION_TIME, MAX(CASE WHEN CDO_ITEM_NAME = '"I thought about taking an overdose but I never made a specific plan as to when where or how I would actually do it...and I would never go through with it." Have you been thinking about how you might do this, within the past month?' THEN CDO_VALUE_TEXT END) OVERDOSE, MAX(CASE WHEN CDO_ITEM_NAME = 'Thoughts of killing oneself with details of plan fully or partially worked out and person has some intent to carry it out. Have you started to work out or worked out the details of how to kill yourselfActive suicidal thoughts of killing oneself and p' THEN CDO_VALUE_TEXT END) DETAILS, MAX(CASE WHEN CDO_ITEM_NAME = 'Active suicidal thoughts of killing oneself and patient reports having some intent to carry it out. Have you had these thoughts and had some intention of acting on them, within the past month?' THEN CDO_VALUE_TEXT END) OTHER_DETAILS, MAX(CASE WHEN CDO_ITEM_NAME = 'CSSRS_Instructions' THEN CDO_VALUE_TEXT END) CSSRS_INSTRUCTIONS, MAX(CASE WHEN CDO_ITEM_NAME = '© 2008 The Research Foundation for Mental Hygiene, Inc.' THEN CDO_VALUE_TEXT END) MENTAL_HYGINE, MAX(CASE WHEN CDO_ITEM_NAME = 'C-SSRS Columbia-Suicide Severity Rating Scale - Psychiatry' THEN CDO_VALUE_TEXT END) CSSRS_RATING_SCALE FROM RAW JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON CDD_MRN = PT_MRN GROUP BY CDD_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_SEX, CDD_SERVICE_DTE, YEAR(CDD_SERVICE_DTE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH)

prompt: List of patients that have taken the medication Denosumab and have been seen in the dental service for possible incidence of ONJ.
completion: WITH CLINTRAC AS (SELECT CC_MRN, LISTAGG(TRIM(DXCC_ICD_CODE) || ':' || TRIM(DXCC_ICD_MSK_DESC), CHR(13)||CHR(10)) AS DX FROM (SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN AS CC_MRN, DXCC_ICD_CODE, DXCC_ICD_MSK_DESC, MIN(DT_DTE) AS DX_DATE FROM DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS JOIN DV.PATIENT_DIAGNOSIS_FINAL_ALL_V ON PDX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID JOIN DV.DATE_V ON PDX_DX_DATE_ID = DT_DATE_ID JOIN DV.DIAGNOSIS_CATALOG ON PDX_DX_CATALOG_ID = DXCC_DX_CATALOG_ID WHERE ((DXCC_ICD_CODE BETWEEN 'C50.00' AND 'C50.919') OR (DXCC_ICD_CODE BETWEEN '174.0' AND '175.9') OR (DXCC_ICD_CODE BETWEEN 'C90.00' AND 'C90.02') OR (DXCC_ICD_CODE BETWEEN '203.00' AND '203.02') OR (DXCC_ICD_CODE IN ('185', 'C61'))) GROUP BY PT_MRN, DXCC_ICD_CODE, DXCC_ICD_MSK_DESC ) WHERE DX_DATE BETWEEN '2001-01-01' AND '2018-12-31' GROUP BY CC_MRN ) , DENT AS (SELECT PBD_MRN, MIN(CASE WHEN PBC_CPT_CD = '70355' THEN PBD_SVC_DTE END) AS "1st PanRad", MIN(CASE WHEN PBC_CPT_CD BETWEEN '99201' AND '99205' AND SUBSTR(PBC_PBD_DESC, 1, 5) = 'DENTL' THEN PBD_SVC_DTE END) AS "1st Dental Visit", "Dental FU w/PanRad" FROM IDB.PBD_DTL_CHARGES LEFT JOIN IDB.PBD_CODE ON PBD_PBD_CD = PBC_PBD_CD AND (PBC_CPT_CD = '70355' OR (PBC_CPT_CD BETWEEN '99201' AND '99205' AND SUBSTR(PBC_PBD_DESC, 1, 5) = 'DENTL')) LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT PBD_MRN AS MRN, PBD_SVC_DTE AS "Dental FU w/PanRad" FROM IDB.PBD_DTL_CHARGES JOIN IDB.PBD_CODE ON PBD_PBD_CD = PBC_PBD_CD AND PBC_CPT_CD BETWEEN '99212' AND '99215' AND SUBSTR(PBC_PBD_DESC, 1, 5) = 'DENTL') ON PBD_MRN = MRN WHERE COALESCE(PBC_PBD_CD, MRN) IS NOT NULL GROUP BY PBD_MRN, "Dental FU w/PanRad" ) SELECT PT_MRN AS MRN, PT_LAST_NAME AS "Patient Last Name", PT_FIRST_NAME AS "Patient First Name", PT_BIRTH_DTE AS DOB, PT_DEATH_DTE "Patient Death Date", PT_SEX_DESC "Patient Sex", DX "Diagnosis", DT_DTE AS "Denosumab Date", "1st PanRad", "1st Dental Visit", "Dental FU w/PanRad" FROM DV.PHM_ORDER_DTL DTL JOIN DV.PHM_INVENTORY_CATALOG CAT ON DTL.POD_PHARMA_INVENTORY_CTLG_ID = PINC_INVENTORY_CTLG_ID AND UPPER(PINC_GENERIC_NAME) = 'DENOSUMAB' JOIN DV.DATE_V ON DTL.POD_START_DATE_ID = DT_DATE_ID JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = POD_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID JOIN CLINTRAC ON PT_MRN = CC_MRN JOIN DENT ON PT_MRN = PBD_MRN WHERE 1=1 ORDER BY PT_MRN, DT_DTE, "Dental FU w/PanRad"

prompt: Provide the molecular report of patients diagnosed with small cell lung cancer and who have had POU2F IHC done
Provide a list from 2019 to date of patients seen within the Breast Medicine service
completion: WITH CPE1 AS (SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN, STRIP(PT_LAST_NAME) || ', ' || STRIP(PT_FIRST_NAME) AS NAME, CPE_ENC_DTE, CRE_RES_NAME, CLD_DEPT_NAME, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8, CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CPE_MRN ORDER BY CPE_ENC_DTE) AS RN FROM IDB.PATIENT JOIN IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER ON PT_MRN = CPE_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CRE_RES_TYP IN ('Physician') AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 = 'BRE' AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 = 'MED' AND CPE_ENC_DTE >= '2021-01-01' ) , CPE AS (SELECT CPE1.* FROM CPE1 WHERE RN = 1 ) , DX AS (SELECT DISTINCT TM_MRN AS MRN, TM_DX_DTE AS DX_DATE, TM_SITE_CD AS SITE_CODE, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_DESC, TM_HIST_CD AS HIST_CODE, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS HIST_DESC, CASE WHEN TM_SSF1 = '000' THEN 'Test not done (test not ordered and not performed)' WHEN TM_SSF1 = '010' THEN 'Positive/elevated' WHEN TM_SSF1 = '020' THEN 'Negative/normal; within normal limits' WHEN TM_SSF1 = '030' THEN 'Borderline; undetermined whether positive or negative' WHEN TM_SSF1 = '080' THEN 'Ordered, but results not in chart' WHEN TM_SSF1 = '988' THEN 'Not applicable: Information not collected for this case' WHEN TM_SSF1 = '996' THEN 'Test ordered, results not interpretable' WHEN TM_SSF1 = '997' THEN 'Test ordered, results not in chart' WHEN TM_SSF1 = '998' THEN 'Test not done (test not ordered and not performed)' WHEN TM_SSF1 = '999' THEN 'Unknown or no information; not documented in patient record' ELSE '' END AS "ER", CASE WHEN TM_SSF2 = '000' THEN 'Test not done (test not ordered and not performed)' WHEN TM_SSF2 = '010' THEN 'Positive/elevated' WHEN TM_SSF2 = '020' THEN 'Negative/normal; within normal limits' WHEN TM_SSF2 = '030' THEN 'Borderline; undetermined whether positive or negative' WHEN TM_SSF2 = '080' THEN 'Ordered, but results not in chart' WHEN TM_SSF2 = '988' THEN 'Not applicable: Information not collected for this case' WHEN TM_SSF2 = '996' THEN 'Test ordered, results not interpretable' WHEN TM_SSF2 = '997' THEN 'Test ordered, results not in chart' WHEN TM_SSF2 = '998' THEN 'Test not done (test not ordered and not performed)' WHEN TM_SSF2 = '999' THEN 'Unknown or no information; not documented in patient record' ELSE '' END AS "PR", CASE WHEN TM_SSF15 = '010' THEN 'Positive/elevated; amplified' WHEN TM_SSF15 = '020' THEN 'Negative/normal; within normal limits; not amplified' WHEN TM_SSF15 = '030' THEN 'Borderline; equivocal; indeterminate; undetermined whether positive or negative' WHEN TM_SSF15 = '988' THEN 'Not applicable: Information not collected for this case' WHEN TM_SSF15 = '997' THEN 'Test ordered, results not in chart' WHEN TM_SSF15 = '998' THEN 'Test not done (test not ordered and not performed)' WHEN TM_SSF15 = '999' THEN 'Unknown or no information; not documented in patient record' ELSE '' END AS "HER2", CASE WHEN TM_AJCC_7 NOT IN ('', '888', '999') THEN AJCC7.AV_DESC WHEN TM_AJCC NOT IN ('', '88', '99') THEN AJCC.AV_DESC WHEN TM_GENERAL_STG NOT IN ('', '9') THEN GS.AV_DESC WHEN TM_PATH_STG_GRP NOT IN ('', '88', '9', '99') THEN TM_PATH_STG_GRP ELSE CLIN.AV_DESC END AS STAGE FROM CPE JOIN IDB.CDB_TUMOR ON CPE_MRN = TM_MRN JOIN IDB.SEERGROUPING ON RECODE = IDB.SEERF_ICDO(TM_SITE_CD, TM_HIST_CD) JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS AJCC7 ON AJCC7.AV_ELEMENT = 'AJCC_7' AND AJCC7.AV_CODE = TM_AJCC_7 LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS AJCC ON AJCC.AV_ELEMENT = 'AJCC' AND AJCC.AV_CODE = TM_AJCC LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS GS ON GS.AV_ELEMENT = 'GENERAL_STG' AND GS.AV_CODE = TM_GENERAL_STG LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS CLIN ON CLIN.AV_ELEMENT = 'CLIN_STG_DSCR' AND CLIN.AV_CODE = TM_CLIN_STG_DSCR WHERE 1=1 AND CATEGORY1 = 'Breast' AND TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') ) , X AS (SELECT CPE.*, DX_DATE, SITE_CODE, SITE_DESC, HIST_CODE, HIST_DESC, "ER", "PR", "HER2", STAGE FROM CPE JOIN DX ON CPE_MRN = MRN) , SRG AS (SELECT DISTINCT SSE_MRN, SSE_SURG_DTE, SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD, SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC FROM X JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT ON CPE_MRN = SSE_MRN JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE ON SSE_LOG_ID = SSP_LOG_ID WHERE 1=1 ) , SRG1 AS (SELECT SSE_MRN AS SRG_MRN, SSE_SURG_DTE AS SRG_DATE, STRIP(SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD) || ' - ' || STRIP(SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC) AS SRG_CPT FROM SRG) , SRG2 AS (SELECT * FROM SRG1 ORDER BY SRG_MRN, SRG_DATE, SRG_CPT) , S1 AS (SELECT SRG_MRN, SRG_DATE, SRG_CPT, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY SRG_MRN ORDER BY SRG_DATE) AS RN FROM SRG2 ORDER BY SRG_MRN, SRG_DATE) , S2 (MRN, SRG, RN1) AS (SELECT SRG_MRN, CAST(SRG_DATE AS VARCHAR(6000))||' | '||CAST(SRG_CPT AS VARCHAR(100)), RN FROM S1 WHERE S1.RN = 1 UNION ALL SELECT SRG_MRN, RTRIM(CAST(SRG AS VARCHAR(4000))) || ', ' || CHR(13) || CHR(10) || CAST(SRG_DATE AS VARCHAR(100))||' | '||RTRIM(CAST(SRG_CPT AS VARCHAR(100))) , RN1 + 1 FROM S1, S2 WHERE SRG_MRN = MRN AND RN = RN1+1 ) , S3 AS (SELECT MRN, MAX(RN1) RN FROM S2 GROUP BY MRN) , S4 AS (SELECT S2.MRN, RN, SRG FROM S2 JOIN S3 ON S2.MRN = S3.MRN AND S2.RN1 = S3.RN) , APR AS (SELECT APR_MRN, CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME, MIN(APR_START_DTE) AS APR_START_DTE, MAX(APR_END_DTE) AS APR_END_DTE FROM IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX_V JOIN X ON CPE_MRN = APR_MRN WHERE CDG_CHEMO_FLAG = 'Y' GROUP BY APR_MRN, CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME ) , A1 AS (SELECT APR_MRN, LISTAGG(COALESCE(STRIP(CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME), '') || ' | ' || COALESCE(STRIP(CAST(APR_START_DTE AS VARCHAR(12000))), '') || ' | ' || COALESCE(STRIP(CAST(APR_END_DTE AS VARCHAR(12000))), '') , CHR(13) || CHR(10)) WITHIN GROUP( ORDER BY APR_MRN, APR_START_DTE, APR_END_DTE) AS CHEMO FROM APR GROUP BY APR_MRN) SELECT X.*, SRG, CHEMO FROM X LEFT JOIN S4 ON CPE_MRN = MRN LEFT JOIN A1 ON CPE_MRN = APR_MRN

prompt: Preliminary identification of patients admitted to the hospital with constipation as a major problem during the hospitalization.
completion: WITH ADMITS AS (SELECT DISTINCT IIPA_MRN, IIPA_ADM_ID, IIPA_ADM_DTE, IIPA_DISCH_DTE FROM IDB.ID_IP_ADMISSIONS WHERE IIPA_ADM_DTE BETWEEN '2019-01-01' AND '2021-12-31' ), DX AS (SELECT * FROM (SELECT DISTINCT IIPA_MRN AS DX_MRN, IIPA_ADM_ID AS DX_ADM_ID FROM ADMITS) AS ADMITS_V JOIN IDB.CTC_CLSF ON DX_ADM_ID = CC_ADM_NUM JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS A ON AV_CODE=CC_CLSF_TYPE AND AV_ELEMENT='CLSF_TYPE' WHERE CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' AND CC_CLSF_CD IN ('K59.0', 'K59.00', 'K59.01', 'K59.02', 'K59.03', 'K59.04', 'K59.05', 'K59.06', 'K59.07', 'K59.08', 'K59.09')), ADMIT_REASON AS (SELECT * FROM (SELECT DISTINCT DX_MRN AS AR_MRN, DX_ADM_ID AS AR_ADM_ID FROM DX) AS ADMITS_V JOIN IDB.OMS_ORDER ON OO_ADM_NUM = AR_ADM_ID JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_USER_DATA OOUD ON OO_ORD_GUID=OUD_ORD_GUID WHERE OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'Nsg Reason Admission' AND UPPER(OUD_USER_DI_VALUE) LIKE '%CONST%'), ALL_ADMITS AS (SELECT DISTINCT IIPA_MRN AS MRN, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_LAST_NAME, IIPA_ADM_ID AS ADMIT_ID, RV_VISIT_ID AS VISIT_ID, IIPA_ADM_DTE AS ADMIT_DATE, IIPA_DISCH_DTE AS DISCHARGE_DATE, CLM_CLSF_CD AS ICD10_CODE, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS ICD10_DESC, AV_DESC AS FINAL_DX_TYPE, COALESCE (OUD_USER_DI_VALUE, '') AS REASON_FOR_ADMISSION FROM ADMITS JOIN IDB.RMS_VISIT RV ON RV_ADM_NUM=IIPA_ADM_ID JOIN IDB.PATIENT P ON PT_MRN=RV_MRN JOIN DX ON IIPA_MRN =DX_MRN AND IIPA_ADM_ID=DX_ADM_ID LEFT JOIN ADMIT_REASON ON IIPA_MRN=AR_MRN AND IIPA_ADM_ID=AR_ADM_ID), DEID_ADMIT_CTE AS (SELECT ADMIT_ID AS DEID_ADMIT_CTE_ADMIT_ID, ROW_NUMBER()OVER() AS DEID_ADMIT_ID FROM (SELECT DISTINCT ADMIT_ID FROM ALL_ADMITS) AS DEID_DEID_ADMIT) SELECT DEID_ADMIT_ID, ADMIT_DATE, DISCHARGE_DATE, ICD10_CODE, ICD10_DESC, FINAL_DX_TYPE, REASON_FOR_ADMISSION FROM DEID_ADMIT_CTE JOIN ALL_ADMITS ON ADMIT_ID= DEID_ADMIT_CTE_ADMIT_ID ; WITH ADMITS AS (SELECT DISTINCT IIPA_MRN, IIPA_ADM_ID, RV_VISIT_ID AS VISIT_ID, IIPA_ADM_DTE, IIPA_DISCH_DTE FROM IDB.ID_IP_ADMISSIONS JOIN IDB.RMS_VISIT RV ON RV_ADM_NUM=IIPA_ADM_ID WHERE IIPA_ADM_DTE BETWEEN '2019-01-01' AND '2021-12-31' ), MNTX AS (SELECT OO_MRN, OO_ORD_GUID, IIPA_ADM_ID, VISIT_ID, OO_ORD_NAME, IIPA_ADM_DTE, IIPA_DISCH_DTE FROM ADMITS JOIN IDB.OMS_ORDER ON OO_MRN= IIPA_MRN AND OO_ADM_NUM = IIPA_ADM_ID WHERE OO_ORD_NAME = 'Methylnaltrexone INJ' ), MNTX_ADMIN AS (SELECT OOTO_MRN AS MRN, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_LAST_NAME, IIPA_ADM_ID AS ADMIT_ID, VISIT_ID, IIPA_ADM_DTE AS ADMIT_DATE, IIPA_DISCH_DTE AS DISCHARGE_DATE, OO_ORD_NAME AS ORDER_NAME, OOTO_SIGNIFIC_DTE AS ADMINISTRATION_DATE, OOTO_SIGNIFIC_TME AS ADMINISTRATION_TIME FROM MNTX JOIN IDB.OAS_ORD_TASK_OCCR ON OOTO_ORD_GUID = OO_ORD_GUID AND OOTO_MRN =OO_MRN AND OOTO_STATUS_CD = 'Performed' JOIN IDB.PATIENT P ON PT_MRN=OO_MRN ), DEID_ADMIT_CTE AS (SELECT MNTX_ADMIN_ADMIT_ID, ROW_NUMBER() OVER() AS DEID_ADMIT_ID FROM (SELECT DISTINCT ADMIT_ID AS MNTX_ADMIN_ADMIT_ID FROM MNTX_ADMIN) AS DEID_MNTX_ADMIT) SELECT DEID_ADMIT_ID, ADMIT_DATE, DISCHARGE_DATE, ORDER_NAME, ADMINISTRATION_DATE, ADMINISTRATION_TIME FROM DEID_ADMIT_CTE JOIN MNTX_ADMIN ON MNTX_ADMIN_ADMIT_ID=ADMIT_ID

prompt: Please provide a daily (M-F) list of patients who have had orders entered for "prednisone" or "methylprednisolone". Please include MRN, pt first and last name, DOB, HSCT date, ORDER name, start date, dose, Attending name, and diagnosis description. The list can be delivered as a table in the notification email. No excel spreadsheet format needed.
completion: WITH ETO AS (SELECT CBM_MRN , PT_LAST_NAME LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME FIRST_NAME, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH DOB, CBM_INDICATION_DESC HCT_DESC, CBM_TRANSPLANT_TYPE , CBM_TRANSPLANT_DTE HCT_DATE, CBM_EXTRACT_DT , ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CBM_MRN ORDER BY CBM_TRANSPLANT_DTE DESC) RN FROM IDB.CRDB_BMT_MEDICINE JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON CBM_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE CBM_TRANSPLANT_DTE BETWEEN '2018-01-01' AND CURRENT DATE AND (UPPER(CBM_INDICATION_DESC) LIKE '%ALLO%' OR UPPER(CBM_TRANSPLANT_TYPE) = 'ALLO') ) , VST AS (SELECT CV_MRN, CV_ADM_DTE, CV_ADM_TME, CV_DSCH_DTE, CV_DSCH_TME, CV_RMS_VISIT_TYPE, CV_CTC_VISIT_TYPE, CC_CLSF_CD, CC_EFF_DTE, CC_VISIT_DTE , CC_RESP_PARTY, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK , DOC_NAME, DOC_SVC, DOC_ACDMC_SVC, DOC_ACDMC_DPT FROM (SELECT CV_MRN , CV_ADM_DTE, CV_ADM_TME, CV_DSCH_DTE, CV_DSCH_TME, CV_RMS_VISIT_TYPE, CV_CTC_VISIT_TYPE, CC_CLSF_CD, CC_EFF_DTE, CC_VISIT_DTE , CC_RESP_PARTY, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK , DOC_NAME, DOC_SVC, DOC_ACDMC_SVC, DOC_ACDMC_DPT, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CV_MRN ORDER BY CC_EFF_DTE DESC) RN FROM ETO JOIN IDB.CTC_VISIT ON CBM_MRN = CV_MRN JOIN IDB.CTC_CLSF ON CV_VISIT_ID = CC_VISIT_ID AND CC_EFF_DTE BETWEEN HCT_DATE - 30 DAY AND CURRENT DATE JOIN IDB.CLM ON CLM_CLSF_CD = CC_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.DOC ON CC_RESP_PARTY = DOC_DR_NO AND DOC_ACDMC_SVC IN ('BONE MARROW TRANSPLANT', 'LEUKEMIA') WHERE (CC_CLSF_CD BETWEEN 'C00%' AND 'D49%') AND (CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' ) AS A WHERE RN= 1 ) , SRX AS (SELECT MRN , LAST_NAME, FIRST_NAME, DOB, HCT_DATE, ORD_NAME, DRUG_NAME, START_DATE, DOSE, DOSE_UOM, ROUTE, ORD_FREQ, IP_OP_IND, ORDERING_PVDR_NAME, VISIT_ATT_NAME FROM (SELECT MRN , LAST_NAME, FIRST_NAME, DOB, HCT_DATE, ORD_NAME, DRUG_NAME, START_DATE, DOSE, DOSE_UOM, ROUTE, ORD_FREQ, IP_OP_IND , ORDERING_PVDR_NAME, VISIT_ATT_NAME FROM ETO JOIN IDB.SRX_PHARMACY_SUM ON MRN = CBM_MRN AND START_DATE >= CURRENT DATE - 14 DAY LEFT JOIN VST ON CV_MRN = MRN WHERE UPPER(DRUG_NAME) LIKE '%PREDNISO%' OR UPPER(DRUG_NAME) LIKE '%METHYLPREDNI%' OR UPPER(DRUG_NAME) LIKE '%DEXAMETHAZ%' UNION SELECT HCPR_MRN MRN , LAST_NAME, FIRST_NAME, DOB, HCT_DATE, HCPR_DRUG_NAME ORD_NAME, HGN_GENERIC_NAME DRUG_NAME , COALESCE(DATE(HCPR_START_DT), RX.HCPR_CREATED_DTE) START_DATE, HCPR_DOSE_AMT DOSE, UOM.HRUM_DESCRIPTION DOSE_UOM, HCPR_ROUTE ROUTE , HSF_DESCRIPTION ORD_FREQ, OCV_IP_OP_IND AS IP_OP_IND, OCV_PVDR_NAME AS ORDERING_PVDR_NAME, VST.DOC_NAME VISIT_ATT_NAME FROM IDB.HML_CLIENT_PRESCRIPTION RX JOIN ETO ON CBM_MRN = HCPR_MRN LEFT JOIN VST ON CV_MRN = HCPR_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_CLIENT_VISIT ON OCV_VISIT_GUID = HCPR_VISIT_GUID LEFT JOIN IDB.DOC ON OCV_ATT_DR_NO = DOC_DR_NO LEFT JOIN IDB.HML_GENERIC_NAME ON HGN_GENERIC_NAME_ID = HCPR_GENERIC_NAME_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_PROVIDER REQ ON REQ.OP_PVDR_GUID = HCPR_CARE_PROV_GUID LEFT JOIN IDB.HML_RX_UNIT_OF_MEASURE UOM ON UOM.HRUM_RXUOM_ID = HCPR_DOSE_UOM_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.HML_RX_UNIT_OF_MEASURE PKG ON PKG.HRUM_RXUOM_ID = HCPR_INNER_PACKAGE_SIZE_UOM_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.HML_SCRIPT_FREQUENCY ON HSF_SCRIPT_FREQ_ID = HCPR_SCRIPT_FREQ_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.RXW_PHARMACY ON HCPR_PHARMACY_ID = RPH_PHARMACY_ID LEFT JOIN (SELECT HCPX_PRESCRIPTION_ID, DATE(MAX(HCPX_UPD_DT)) AS NO_LONGER_TAKING_DTE , MAX(HCPX_UPD_DT) AS NO_LONGER_TAKING_DT FROM IDB.HML_CLIENT_PRESCRIPTION_HX WHERE HCPX_FIELD_NAME = 'StatusType' AND HCPX_FROM_VALUE = '1' AND HCPX_MODIFICATION_REASON LIKE 'Med Review - No Longer%' GROUP BY HCPX_PRESCRIPTION_ID) X ON HCPX_PRESCRIPTION_ID = HCPR_PRESCRIPTION_ID AND HCPR_STATUS_TYPE_DESC = 'NoLongerTaking' WHERE HCPR_STATUS_TYPE NOT IN (4, 8, 5) AND HCPR_CREATED_DTE >= CURRENT DATE - 14 DAY AND COALESCE(DATE(HCPR_START_DT), RX.HCPR_CREATED_DTE) >= CURRENT DATE - 14 DAY AND(HCPR_PRESCRIPTION_TYPE = 1 AND HCPR_TRANSMISSION_STATUS IN (1, 2, 5) OR HCPR_PRESCRIPTION_TYPE = 3) AND(LOWER(HCPR_DRUG_NAME) like '%predniso%' OR LOWER(HCPR_DRUG_NAME) like '%methylpredni%' OR LOWER(HCPR_DRUG_NAME) like '%dexamethaz%') ) AS A) SELECT DISTINCT MRN , LAST_NAME, FIRST_NAME, DOB, HCT_DATE, ORD_NAME, DRUG_NAME, START_DATE, DOSE, DOSE_UOM, ROUTE, ORD_FREQ, IP_OP_IND, ORDERING_PVDR_NAME, VISIT_ATT_NAME, DX_CODE, DX_DESC FROM (SELECT MRN , LAST_NAME, FIRST_NAME, DOB, HCT_DATE, ORD_NAME, DRUG_NAME, START_DATE, DOSE, DOSE_UOM, ROUTE, ORD_FREQ, IP_OP_IND, ORDERING_PVDR_NAME, VISIT_ATT_NAME, CC_CLSF_CD DX_CODE , CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK DX_DESC FROM SRX LEFT JOIN VST ON MRN = CV_MRN WHERE START_DATE IS NOT NULL ) AS A WHERE START_DATE >= CURRENT DATE - (CASE WHEN DAYOFWEEK(CURRENT DATE) = 2 THEN 3 ELSE 1 END) DAY ;

prompt: Identifying eligible patients for mailing and email invitations from Office Physician in Chief
completion: SELECT PLA_MRN, PLA_DONOT_MAIL_IND FROM IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY WHERE PLA_MRN = '35173983'

prompt: Provide a list of patients who received a pulmonary function test (PFT) at main campus (A3) and the service which requested it at the end of every quarter.
completion: SELECT OO_MRN "MRN", OL_LOC_NAME "Location", PT_LAST_NAME "Last Name", PT_FIRST_NAME "First Name", PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH "DOB", OS_SVC_DESC "Service", OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE "PFT Date" FROM IDB.OMS_ORDER JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_CATALOG ON OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID = OOC_MSTR_ITEM_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_STATUS ON OO_ORD_STS_CD = OSTS_ORD_STS_CD JOIN IDB.OMS_CLIENT_VISIT ON OCV_VISIT_GUID = OO_VISIT_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_SERVICE ON OS_SVC_GUID = OCV_SVC_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_LOCATION ON OL_LOC_GUID = OCV_CURR_LOC_GUID JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON OO_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE OOC_ITEM_NAME = 'Pulmonary Function Test' AND OO_ORD_STS_CD IN ('AUA2', 'AUC1', 'COMP', 'COMPT') AND OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE >= (DATE('0001-01-01') + YEAR(CURRENT date) YEARS - 1 YEAR + MONTH(CURRENT date) MONTHS - 4 MONTHS) AND OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE < (DATE('0001-01-01') + YEAR(CURRENT date) YEARS - 1 YEAR + MONTH(CURRENT date) MONTHS - 1 MONTHS) AND OL_LOC_NAME like '%A3%' ORDER BY OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE, OO_MRN;

prompt: A list of Radiology Stat Creatinine orders for MSK Nassau patients.
completion: WITH APT AS (SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN, CPE_ENC_DTE, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 AS "Department", CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 AS "Service", CLD_DEPT_NAME AS "Department Name", CRE_RES_NAME AS "Provider Name", CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME AS "Visit Type", CPE_CHK_IN_DT, CLD_CLD_CENTER FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CLD_CLD_CENTER LIKE '%NAS%' AND CLD_DEPT_NAME = 'RADIOLOGY (ADV) NAS' AND CPE_ENC_DTE >= CURRENT date - 7 DAYS ) , ORDDATA AS (SELECT MRN , ORDER_NAME , OUO_ORD_GUID AS ORDER_GUID , ORDER_ENTER_DATE , ORDER_ENTER_TIME , DATE(CPE_CHK_IN_DT) AS CHECK_IN_DATE , TIME(CPE_CHK_IN_DT) AS CHECK_IN_TIME , ORDER_STATUS , STATUS_DATE , STATUS_TIME , OSH_MAINT_SUMLNE , OSH_ARRIVAL_DT FROM (SELECT DISTINCT OUO_MRN AS MRN , OUO_ORD_GUID , OUO_ORD_NAME AS ORDER_NAME , OUO_ENTER_DTE AS ORDER_ENTER_DATE , TIME(OUO_ENTER_DT) AS ORDER_ENTER_TIME , CPE_CHK_IN_DT , OSH_ARRIVAL_DT , date (OSH_ARRIVAL_DT) AS STATUS_DATE , TIME (OSH_ARRIVAL_DT) AS STATUS_TIME , OSH_ORD_GUID , OSH_ORD_STS_CD , OSTS_STS_DESC AS ORDER_STATUS , OSH_MAINT_SUMLNE , ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY OSH_ORD_GUID, OSH_ORD_STS_CD ORDER BY OSH_ARRIVAL_DT ASC) AS ROW_NUM FROM IDB.OMS_USER_ORDERS JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_STS_HX ON OUO_MRN = OSH_MRN AND OSH_ORD_GUID = OUO_ORD_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_STATUS ON OSH_ORD_STS_CD = OSTS_ORD_STS_CD JOIN APT ON CPE_MRN = OUO_MRN AND CPE_ENC_DTE = date (OSH_ARRIVAL_DT) WHERE 1=1 AND LOWER(OUO_ORD_NAME) = 'creatinine' AND OUO_ORD_STS_CD NOT IN ('CANP', 'CANC', 'AUC3') AND date (OSH_ARRIVAL_DT) >= CURRENT date - 7 DAYS ) AS X WHERE ROW_NUM = 1 ORDER BY OUO_ORD_GUID, STATUS_TIME ASC) , SPECCOLTD AS (SELECT DISTINCT MRN_COL , ORDER_GUID , DATE(OSH_ARRIVAL_TIMESTAMP) AS SPECIMEN_COLLECTED_DATE , TIME(OSH_ARRIVAL_TIMESTAMP) AS SPECIMEN_COLLECTED_TIME FROM (SELECT MRN AS MRN_COL , ORDER_GUID , MIN(HX.OSH_ARRIVAL_DT) AS OSH_ARRIVAL_TIMESTAMP FROM ORDDATA JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_STS_HX HX ON MRN = OSH_MRN AND HX.OSH_ORD_GUID= ORDER_GUID WHERE DATE (HX.OSH_ARRIVAL_DT) >= CURRENT DATE - 7 DAYS AND HX.OSH_MAINT_SUMLNE like '%Specimen Collected%' GROUP BY MRN, ORDER_GUID)) SELECT DISTINCT A.MRN , A.ORDER_NAME , A.ORDER_GUID , A.ORDER_ENTER_DATE , A.ORDER_ENTER_TIME , A.CHECK_IN_DATE , A.CHECK_IN_TIME , B.STATUS_DATE AS HOLD_DATE, B.STATUS_TIME AS HOLD_TIME , C.STATUS_DATE AS PENDING_DATE, C.STATUS_TIME AS PENDING_TIME , D.STATUS_DATE AS SPECIMEN_RECEIVED_DATE, D.STATUS_TIME AS SPECIMEN_RECEIVED_TIME , F.SPECIMEN_COLLECTED_DATE, F.SPECIMEN_COLLECTED_TIME , E.STATUS_DATE AS RESULTED_DATE, E.STATUS_TIME AS RESULTED_TIME , TIMESTAMPDIFF(4, F.SPECIMEN_COLLECTED_TIME- C.STATUS_TIME) AS PENDING_VS_COLLECTED, TIMESTAMPDIFF(4, D.STATUS_TIME - F.SPECIMEN_COLLECTED_TIME) AS COLLECTED_VS_SPECIMEN_RECD , TIMESTAMPDIFF(4, C.STATUS_TIME - A.CHECK_IN_TIME) AS CHECK_IN_VS_PENDING, TIMESTAMPDIFF(4, D.STATUS_TIME- C.STATUS_TIME) AS PENDING_VS_SPECIMEN_RECD, TIMESTAMPDIFF(4, E.STATUS_TIME- D.STATUS_TIME) AS SPECIMEN_RECD_VS_RESULTED FROM ORDDATA A LEFT JOIN ORDDATA B ON A.ORDER_GUID = B.ORDER_GUID AND B.ORDER_STATUS = 'Hold' LEFT JOIN ORDDATA C ON A.ORDER_GUID = C.ORDER_GUID AND C.ORDER_STATUS = 'Pending' LEFT JOIN ORDDATA D ON A.ORDER_GUID = D.ORDER_GUID AND D.ORDER_STATUS = 'Specimen Received' LEFT JOIN ORDDATA E ON A.ORDER_GUID = E.ORDER_GUID AND E.ORDER_STATUS = '1 or More Final Results' LEFT JOIN SPECCOLTD F ON A.ORDER_GUID = F.ORDER_GUID

prompt: Identify secondary ovarian cancer patients with imaging within a year prior to a hysterectomy/oophorectomy.
completion: WITH ICD9 AS (SELECT CC_MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS MIN_DX_DTE, MAX(CASE WHEN CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y') THEN 'Y' ELSE '' END) AS EVER_CIC_CODED FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF WHERE CC_CLSF_CD = '198.6' AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' GROUP BY CC_MRN), IMAGING AS (SELECT PBD_MRN AS IMAGING_MRN, PBC_CPT_CD AS IMAGING_CPT, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS IMAGING_CPT_DESC, PBD_SVC_DTE AS IMAGING_DTE FROM ICD9 JOIN IDB.PBD_DTL ON CC_MRN = PBD_MRN JOIN IDB.PBD_CODE ON PBD_PBD_CD = PBC_PBD_CD JOIN IDB.CLM ON PBC_CPT_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE PBC_CPT_CD IN ('74150', '74160', '74170', '74181', '74182', '74183', '76856', '76857')), HYST AS (SELECT PBD_MRN AS HYST_MRN, PBC_CPT_CD AS HYST_CPT, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS_HYST_CPT_DESC, PBD_SVC_DTE AS HYST_DTE FROM IMAGING JOIN IDB.PBD_DTL ON IMAGING_MRN = PBD_MRN AND IMAGING_DTE BETWEEN (PBD_SVC_DTE - 12 MONTHS) AND PBD_SVC_DTE JOIN IDB.PBD_CODE ON PBD_PBD_CD = PBC_PBD_CD JOIN IDB.CLM ON PBC_CPT_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE PBC_CPT_CD IN ('51925', '54926', '56308', '58150', '58152', '58180', '58200', '58205', '58210', '58260', '58265', '58275', '58280', '58285', '58550', '59560', '59561', '59580', '59581', 'S2078')), CDB AS (SELECT TM_MRN, TM_DX_DTE AS "Tumor Diagnosis Date", TM_HIST_CD AS "ICD-O Histology Code", H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS "ICD-O Histology Description", TM_SITE_CD AS "ICD-O Site Code", S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS "ICD-O Site Description", AV_DESC AS "Case Status" FROM HYST JOIN IDB.CDB_TUMOR ON HYST_MRN = TM_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD LEFT JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS ON AV_ELEMENT = 'CASE_STS' AND AV_CODE = TM_CASE_STS WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('3', '6', '7', '8')) SELECT PT_MRN AS "MRN", PT_LAST_NAME AS "Last Name", PT_FIRST_NAME AS "First Name", PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH AS "Date of Birth", PT_SEX AS "Sex", MAX(IMAGING_DTE) AS "CT Date", HYST_DTE AS "Hysterectomy Date", "Tumor Diagnosis Date", "ICD-O Histology Code", "ICD-O Histology Description", "ICD-O Site Code", "ICD-O Site Description", "Case Status", MIN_DX_DTE AS "Min ICD-9 Date", EVER_CIC_CODED FROM IDB.PATIENT JOIN ICD9 ON PT_MRN = CC_MRN JOIN HYST ON PT_MRN = HYST_MRN LEFT JOIN IMAGING ON IMAGING_MRN = HYST_MRN AND IMAGING_DTE BETWEEN (HYST_DTE - 12 MONTHS) AND HYST_DTE AND IMAGING_CPT IN ('74150', '74160', '74170') LEFT JOIN CDB ON PT_MRN = TM_MRN GROUP BY PT_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, PT_SEX, HYST_DTE, "Tumor Diagnosis Date", "ICD-O Histology Code", "ICD-O Histology Description", "ICD-O Site Code", "ICD-O Site Description", "Case Status", MIN_DX_DTE, EVER_CIC_CODED WITH ICD9 AS (SELECT CC_MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS MIN_DX_DTE, MAX(CASE WHEN CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y') THEN 'Y' ELSE '' END) AS EVER_CIC_CODED FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF WHERE CC_CLSF_CD = '198.6' AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' GROUP BY CC_MRN), HYST AS (SELECT DISTINCT PBD_MRN AS HYST_MRN, PBD_SVC_DTE AS HYST_DTE FROM ICD9 JOIN IDB.PBD_DTL ON CC_MRN = PBD_MRN JOIN IDB.PBD_CODE ON PBD_PBD_CD = PBC_PBD_CD JOIN IDB.CLM ON PBC_CPT_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE PBC_CPT_CD IN ('51925', '54926', '56308', '58150', '58152', '58180', '58200', '58205', '58210', '58260', '58265', '58275', '58280', '58285', '58550', '59560', '59561', '59580', '59581', 'S2078')) SELECT DISTINCT PBD_MRN AS IMAGING_MRN, PBC_CPT_CD AS IMAGING_CPT, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS IMAGING_CPT_DESC, PBD_SVC_DTE AS IMAGING_DTE FROM HYST JOIN IDB.PBD_DTL ON HYST_MRN = PBD_MRN AND PBD_SVC_DTE BETWEEN (HYST_DTE - 12 MONTHS) AND HYST_DTE JOIN IDB.PBD_CODE ON PBD_PBD_CD = PBC_PBD_CD JOIN IDB.CLM ON PBC_CPT_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE PBC_CPT_CD IN ('74150', '74160', '74170', '74181', '74182', '74183', '76856', '76857')

prompt: Patients with implants scheduled for PET and CT simulation appts in Radiation Oncology, Cadence Dept 375
completion: SELECT DISTINCT CPE_ENC_DTE AS "Appt Date", TRIM(CPE_MRN) AS "MRN", TRIM(PT_LAST_NAME) "Last Name", TRIM(PT_FIRST_NAME) "First Name", TRIM(CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME) AS "Visit Type", TRIM(OHI_HI_DESCRIPTION) AS "Implant Device", TRIM(OHI_SHORT_NAME) AS "Implant Device 2", TRIM(OHI_HI_TEXT) AS "Implant Description" FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID JOIN IDB.OMS_HEALTH_ISSUE ON CPE_MRN = OHI_MRN JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON CPE_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN SYSIBM.SYSDUMMY1 ON 1 = 1 WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Sch') AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT date AND CURRENT date + 7 DAYS AND CLD_DEPT_ID = '375' AND CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME like '%PET%' AND OHI_TYPE_CD = 'Implanted Dev' AND OHI_STS_CD = 'Active' ORDER BY CPE_ENC_DTE, TRIM(CPE_MRN), TRIM(CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME), TRIM(OHI_HI_DESCRIPTION) ; SELECT DISTINCT CPE_ENC_DTE AS "Appt Date", TRIM(CPE_MRN) AS "MRN", TRIM(PT_LAST_NAME) "Last Name", TRIM(PT_FIRST_NAME) "First Name", TRIM(CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME) AS "Visit Type", TRIM(OHI_HI_DESCRIPTION) AS "Implant Device", TRIM(OHI_SHORT_NAME) AS "Implant Device 2", TRIM(OHI_HI_TEXT) AS "Implant Description" FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID JOIN IDB.OMS_HEALTH_ISSUE ON CPE_MRN = OHI_MRN JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON CPE_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN SYSIBM.SYSDUMMY1 ON 1 = 1 WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Sch') AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT date AND CURRENT date + 7 DAYS AND CLD_DEPT_ID = '375' AND CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME like '%MR%' AND OHI_TYPE_CD = 'Implanted Dev' AND OHI_STS_CD = 'Active' ORDER BY CPE_ENC_DTE, TRIM(CPE_MRN), TRIM(CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME), TRIM(OHI_HI_DESCRIPTION)

prompt: Provide a dashboard demonstrating completion of the following note: Pre-Exam Review, Technologist – Radiology
completion: SELECT DISTINCT CDD_MRN AS MRN, CDD_DOC_GUID AS DOC_GUID, CDD_DOC_NAME AS "Document Name", CDD_SERVICE_DTE AS "Service Date", TIME(CDD_SERVICE_DT) AS "Service Time", HOUR(CDD_SERVICE_DT) AS "Service Hour", CDO_VALUE_TEXT AS "Modality", OU_DISPLAY_NAME AS "RT", OCV_CURR_LOC AS "Location" FROM IDB.CD_DOCUMENT LEFT JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION ON CDO_DOC_GUID = CDD_DOC_GUID AND CDO_AUTHORED_DTE = CDD_AUTHORED_DTE AND CDO_MSTR_ITEM_NM = 'NUR_Rad Modality RES' JOIN IDB.OMS_USER ON CDD_AUTH_PROV_GUID = OU_USER_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_CLIENT_VISIT ON CDD_VISIT_GUID = OCV_VISIT_GUID WHERE CDD_CANCEL_IND = '0' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND = '0' AND CDD_DOC_NAME = 'Pre-Exam Review, Technologist - Radiology' AND CDD_SERVICE_DTE >= '2021-01-01'

prompt: Provide a list of patients diagnosed with COVID-19 since March 13.
completion: WITH POS AS (SELECT MRN, LAST_NAME, FIRST_NAME, DATE_OF_BIRTH, RESULT, DATE_OF_DEATH, DATE(MIN_IDENTIFIED_DT) FIRST_POSITIVE_DTE, DATE(MAX_IDENTIFIED_DT) MOST_RECENT_POSITIVE_DTE FROM IDB.COVID19_PATIENT_INFO WHERE RESULT IN ('Positive', 'Resolved') AND DATE(MIN_IDENTIFIED_DT) >= '2020-03-13' ) , ANTIBODY AS (SELECT COR_MRN, COR_ORDER_NAME, COR_ABNORMALITY_DESC, COR_RESULT_TEXT, COR_ORDER_STATUS_CODE, COR_RESULT_ITEM_CODE, DATE(COR_SIGNIFICANT_DT) COR_SIGNIFICANT_DTE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY COR_MRN ORDER BY COR_SIGNIFICANT_DT DESC) RN FROM (SELECT DISTINCT MRN FROM POS) JOIN IDB.COVID19_ORDER_AND_RESULT ON MRN = COR_MRN WHERE COR_ORDER_NAME IN ('COVID-19 antiBODY Qualitative IgG') AND COR_ORDER_STATUS_CODE NOT IN ('CANP', 'CANC', 'AUC3') ) , CDB AS (SELECT TM_MRN, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK SITE_CODE, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK HISTOLOGY_CODE, CASE WHEN TM_BEST_AJCC_STG like '0%' THEN '0' WHEN TM_BEST_AJCC_STG like '1%' THEN '1' WHEN TM_BEST_AJCC_STG like '2%' THEN '2' WHEN TM_BEST_AJCC_STG like '3%' THEN '3' WHEN TM_BEST_AJCC_STG like '4%' THEN '4' WHEN TM_BEST_AJCC_STG IN ('', '88', '99') THEN 'No Stage' END STAGE FROM (SELECT DISTINCT MRN FROM POS) P JOIN IDB.CDB_TUMOR ON MRN = TM_MRN JOIN IDB.CLM H ON TM_HIST_CD = H.CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON TM_SITE_CD = S.CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3') ) SELECT MRN, LAST_NAME, FIRST_NAME, DATE_OF_BIRTH, DATE_OF_DEATH, LISTAGG(TRIM(SITE_CODE) || ' ' || TRIM(HISTOLOGY_CODE) || ' STAGE ' || STAGE, CHR(13)||CHR(10)) TUMOR, FIRST_POSITIVE_DTE, MOST_RECENT_POSITIVE_DTE, COR_ORDER_NAME, COR_SIGNIFICANT_DTE, COR_ORDER_STATUS_CODE, COR_RESULT_TEXT FROM POS LEFT JOIN ANTIBODY ON MRN = COR_MRN AND RN = 1 LEFT JOIN CDB ON MRN = TM_MRN GROUP BY MRN, LAST_NAME, FIRST_NAME, DATE_OF_BIRTH, DATE_OF_DEATH, FIRST_POSITIVE_DTE, MOST_RECENT_POSITIVE_DTE, COR_ORDER_NAME, COR_SIGNIFICANT_DTE, COR_ORDER_STATUS_CODE, COR_RESULT_TEXT ;

prompt: Living Pediatric patients born in either 2003, 2004 or 2005 and have had ten or more pediatric MD appointments
completion: WITH D01 AS (SELECT CRE_RES_ID AS RESID , CPE_MRN AS MRN , CPE_ENC_DTE AS APPTDATE , PT_LAST_NAME AS LASTNAME, PT_FIRST_NAME AS FIRSTNAME , PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH AS DOB , PT_ADDR1 AS ADDR1, PT_ADDR2 AS ADDR2 , PT_CITY AS CITY, PT_STATE AS STATE, PT_ZIP_CD AS ZIP , PT_PHONE AS PHONE, CL_MOBILE_PHONE AS MOBILE_PHONE, CPP_EMAIL_ADDR AS EMAIL_ADDR FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID AND CLD_DEPT_ID IN ('1174', '156', '161', '1658', '17', '247', '248', '249', '278', '281', '366', '460', '462', '463', '465', '466', '467', '468', '550', '622') JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CRE_RES_ID = CPE_VST_RES_ID AND CRE_RES_TYP IN ('Physician', 'PhD', 'Nurse Practitioner', 'Advanced Practice Nurse', 'Physician Assistant') JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PT_MRN = CPE_MRN AND PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH BETWEEN '2003-01-01' AND '2005-12-31' AND PT_DEATH_IND NOT IN ('C', 'D', 'X') JOIN IDB.CL_PAS_PATIENT ON PT_MRN = CPP_MRN AND CPP_MRN <> '' JOIN IDB.CL_PATIENT ON PT_MRN = CL_MRN WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Comp', 'Arrived') AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN '2003-01-01' AND '2022-01-31' ) , D02 AS (SELECT A.MRN, DOC_NAME, RESID, DOC_ACDMC_SVC AS SVC, DOC_ACDMC_DPT AS DPT , COUNT(APPTDATE) AS MDCT , LASTNAME, FIRSTNAME, CITY, STATE, PHONE, DOB , ADDR1, ADDR2, ZIP, MOBILE_PHONE, EMAIL_ADDR FROM D01 A JOIN (SELECT MRN, COUNT(APPTDATE) AS COUNT FROM D01 GROUP BY MRN HAVING COUNT(APPTDATE) > 9) AS X ON X.MRN = A.MRN JOIN IDB.DOC ON RESID = DOC_DR_NO GROUP BY A.MRN, DOC_NAME, RESID, DOC_ACDMC_SVC, DOC_ACDMC_DPT , LASTNAME, FIRSTNAME, CITY, STATE, PHONE, DOB , ADDR1, ADDR2, ZIP, MOBILE_PHONE, EMAIL_ADDR) SELECT A.MRN, DOC_NAME, RESID, SVC, DPT, MDCT , LASTNAME, FIRSTNAME, DOB, ADDR1, ADDR2 , CITY, STATE, ZIP, PHONE, PLA_DONOT_MAIL_IND , MOBILE_PHONE, EMAIL_ADDR FROM D02 A JOIN (SELECT MRN, MAX(MDCT) AS MAXCOUNT FROM D02 GROUP BY MRN) AS X ON X.MRN = A.MRN AND MAXCOUNT = MDCT JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY ON A.MRN = PLA_MRN GROUP BY A.MRN, DOC_NAME, RESID, SVC, DPT, MDCT , LASTNAME, FIRSTNAME, DOB, ADDR1, ADDR2 , CITY, STATE, ZIP, PHONE, PLA_DONOT_MAIL_IND , MOBILE_PHONE, EMAIL_ADDR

'D''ANDREA, GABRIELLA ', 'DANG, CHAU ', 'DICKLER, MAURAN ', 'FORNIER, MONICA ', 'FORNIER, MONICA N ', 'GILEWSKI, TERESA ', 'GILEWSKI, TERESA ANN ', 'GOLDFARB, SHARI ', 'HUDIS, CLIFF ', 'HUDIS, CLIFFORD ', 'LAKE, DIANA ', 'LAKE, DIANA E. ', 'MODI, SHANU ', 'MOYNAHAN, MARY ELLEN ', 'NORTON, LARRY ', 'ROBSON, MARK ', 'SEIDMAN, ANDREW ', 'SKLARIN, NANCY ', 'SKLARIN, NANCY_DUP ', 'THEODOULOU, MARIA ', 'THEODOULOU, MARIA_DUP ', 'THEODOULOU, MARIA_DUPB ', 'TRAINA, TIFFANY ')))

prompt: Provide a daily list of patients who are  65 years or older ,seen in Surgery with either diabetes requiring medication or insulin or smoking history, including protocols currently on.
completion: WITH APPT AS (SELECT OC_MRN, OC_SURG_DTE AS SURGERY_DATE, YEAR(OC_SURG_DTE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) AS AGE, TRIM(PT_LAST_NAME) || ', ' || TRIM(PT_FIRST_NAME) AS PATIENT_NAME, OC_PT_CLASS AS PATIENT_CLASS, AV_DESC AS PATIENT_CLASS_DESC, CPX_PROC_CD AS CPT_CODE, TRIM(CPX_PROC_NAME) AS CPT_DESC, CRE_RES_NAME AS SURGEON, OC_SURG_SVC AS SERVICE, OC_DAYS_STAY FROM IDB.OR_CASE JOIN IDB.OR_CASE_ALL_PROC ON OC_CASE_ID = OCAP_CASE_ID JOIN IDB.OR_CASE_ALL_SURG ON OCAP_CASE_ID = OCAS_CASE_ID AND OCAS_PNL_NO = OCAP_PNL_NO AND OCAS_SURG_ROLE = 'Primary' JOIN IDB.OR_PROC ON OCAP_OR_PROC_ID = OP_OR_PROC_ID JOIN IDB.OR_CL_PROC ON OP_OR_PROC_ID = OCP_OR_PROC_ID JOIN IDB.CL_PROC ON OCP_PROC_ID = CPX_PROC_ID JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CRE_RES_ID = OCAS_RES_ID JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PT_MRN = OC_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS ON AV_CODE = OC_PT_CLASS AND AV_ELEMENT = 'PT_CLASS' WHERE OC_SURG_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT date + 7 DAYS AND CURRENT date + 13 DAYS AND OC_OR_CASE_STS_CD NOT IN ('2', '5') AND PT_DEATH_IND IN ('', 'A') AND YEAR(OC_SURG_DTE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) >= 65 ) , DX AS (SELECT CC_MRN, MAX(CASE WHEN CC_CLSF_CD BETWEEN 'E08' AND 'E13.99' OR CC_CLSF_CD BETWEEN '250' AND '250.99' THEN 'Y' END) AS DIABETES_FLAG FROM APPT JOIN IDB.CTC_CLSF ON OC_MRN = CC_MRN JOIN IDB.CLM A ON A.CLM_CLSF_CD = CC_CLSF_CD AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND ((CC_PT_TYPE = 'I') OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) AND (CC_CLSF_CD BETWEEN 'E08' AND 'E13.99' OR CC_CLSF_CD BETWEEN '250' AND '250.99') GROUP BY CC_MRN) , HOME_MED AS (SELECT MRN, LISTAGG(DRUG, ', ') DRUG_LIST FROM (SELECT DISTINCT HCPR_MRN MRN, HCPR_DRUG_NAME, CASE WHEN LOWER(HCPR_DRUG_NAME) LIKE '%metformin%' THEN 'metformin' WHEN LOWER(HCPR_DRUG_NAME) LIKE '%glipizide%' THEN 'glipizide' WHEN LOWER(HCPR_DRUG_NAME) LIKE '%glyburide%' THEN 'glyburide' WHEN LOWER(HCPR_DRUG_NAME) LIKE '%glimepiride%' THEN 'glimepiride' WHEN LOWER(HCPR_DRUG_NAME) LIKE '%insulin%' THEN 'insulin' ELSE '' END AS DRUG FROM APPT LEFT JOIN IDB.HML_CLIENT_PRESCRIPTION HCPR ON HCPR_MRN= OC_MRN WHERE HCPR_GENERIC_NAME_ID != -100 AND (HCPR_PRESCRIPTION_TYPE = 1 AND HCPR_TRANSMISSION_STATUS IN (1, 2, 5) OR HCPR_PRESCRIPTION_TYPE = 3) AND HCPR_STATUS_TYPE_DESC = 'Active' AND (LOWER(HCPR_DRUG_NAME) LIKE '%metformin%' OR LOWER(HCPR_DRUG_NAME) LIKE '%glipizide%' OR LOWER(HCPR_DRUG_NAME) LIKE '%glyburide%' OR LOWER(HCPR_DRUG_NAME) LIKE '%glimepiride%' OR LOWER(HCPR_DRUG_NAME) LIKE '%insulin%' ) ) GROUP BY MRN) , SMO_HX AS (SELECT CDD_MRN , CDD_SERVICE_DTE, CDO_SECTION, TRIM(CDO_ITEM_NAME) ITEM_NAME, TRIM(CDO_VALUE_TEXT) SMOKING_HX, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CDD_MRN, CDO_ITEM_NAME ORDER BY CDD_SERVICE_DTE DESC) AS SMO_RN FROM IDB.CD_DOCUMENT LEFT JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION ON CDD_DOC_GUID = CDO_DOC_GUID AND CDD_AUTHORED_DTE = CDO_AUTHORED_DTE AND CDO_VALUE_TEXT <> '' JOIN APPT ON OC_MRN = CDD_MRN WHERE CDD_CANCEL_IND <> '1' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND <> '1' AND UPPER(CDO_SECTION) ='SOCIAL HISTORY' AND UPPER(CDO_ITEM_NAME) ='SMOKING STATUS' ) , ASH AS (SELECT ASH_MRN, ASH_ENC_DTE, ASH_TOBACCO_USED_YEARS PACK_YRS, ASH_TOBACCO_COMMENT COMMENTS, ASH_SMOKING_QUIT_DTE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ASH_MRN ORDER BY ASH_ENC_DTE DESC) RN FROM IDB.AN_SOCIAL_HX JOIN APPT ON ASH_MRN = OC_MRN) , ACC AS (SELECT AC_MRN, LISTAGG(AC_IRB_NO, ',') PROTOCOLS FROM IDB.ACCRUALS JOIN APPT ON OC_MRN = AC_MRN GROUP BY AC_MRN) , ORD AS (SELECT OO_MRN, TRIM(OO_ORD_NAME) AS ORDER_NAME, OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE AS ORDER_DATE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY OO_MRN, OO_ORD_STS_CD ORDER BY OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE DESC) ORD_RN, OSTS_STS_DESC AS ORDER_STATUS FROM IDB.OMS_ORDER JOIN IDB.OMS_STATUS ON OO_ORD_STS_CD = OSTS_ORD_STS_CD JOIN APPT ON OO_MRN = OC_MRN WHERE OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID IN ('9000015486300730', '2000001302073001' ) AND OO_ORD_STS_CD NOT IN ('CANP', 'CANC', 'AUC3') ) SELECT DISTINCT OC_MRN AS MRN, PATIENT_NAME AS "Patient Name", AGE AS "Age as of surgery", SURGERY_DATE , OC_DAYS_STAY AS "Length of Stay", CPT_CODE, CPT_DESC, SURGEON, SERVICE AS "Surgery Service", ORDER_DATE AS "DNR Order Date", ORDER_STATUS AS "DNR Order Status", DRUG_LIST, DIABETES_FLAG, SMOKING_HX , PROTOCOLS AS "Protocols (Accrued)", PACK_YRS || '-' || TRIM(COMMENTS) AS TOBACCO_USE FROM APPT A LEFT JOIN DX ON OC_MRN = CC_MRN LEFT JOIN HOME_MED ON OC_MRN = MRN LEFT JOIN ACC ON AC_MRN = OC_MRN LEFT JOIN SMO_HX ON CDD_MRN = OC_MRN AND SMO_RN =1 LEFT JOIN ASH ON ASH_MRN = OC_MRN AND RN=1 LEFT JOIN ORD ON OO_MRN = OC_MRN AND ORD_RN =1 WHERE NOT (SMOKING_HX LIKE '%Never%' AND DIABETES_FLAG ='N')

prompt: Provide a list of patients diagnosed with liposarcoma between since 2010.
completion: WITH CTE AS (SELECT DISTINCT "t1"."PT_MRN" AS "MRN", "t1"."PT_BIRTH_DTE" AS "Date of Birth", "t2"."DXCC_ICD_CODE" AS "ICD-O Histology Code", "t2"."DXCC_ICD_MSK_DESC" AS "ICD-O Histology Description", "t3"."ICSC_SITE_CD" AS "ICD-O Site Code", "t3"."ICSC_ICDO_SITE_MSK_DESC" AS "ICD-O Site Description", "t4"."DT_DTE" AS "Tumor Diagnosis Date" FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V" "t1" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED" "t5" ON "t1"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t5"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."CDB_TUMOR_V" "t6" ON "t5"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t6"."CDTM_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DIAGNOSIS_CODE_CAT_ICDO_V" "t2" ON "t6"."CDTM_DX_CATALOG_ID" = "t2"."DXCC_DX_CATALOG_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."ICDO_SITE_CATALOG_V" "t3" ON "t6"."CDTM_SITE_CATALOG_ID" = "t3"."ICSC_SITE_CATALOG_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" "t4" ON "t6"."CDTM_DX_DATE_ID" = "t4"."DT_DATE_ID" WHERE ("t2"."DXCC_ICD_CODE" IN ('M8850/3', 'M8851/3', 'M8852/3', 'M8853/3', 'M8854/3', 'M8855/3', 'M8857/3', 'M8858/3', 'M8860/3') AND "t4"."DT_DTE" BETWEEN '2010-1-1' AND CURRENT date) ) SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN, GENE, RESULT FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_STRUCTURED_RESULTS_V IMP JOIN CTE ON MRN = PT_MRN WHERE METHOD = 'IMPACT'

prompt: Provide an on-demand report showing genetic and demographic data for NGS (next-generation sequencing) testing based on a list of MRNs entered into the report.
completion: WITH VARIANTS_TO_OMIT (CNV_TYPE_OMIT) AS ( VALUES ('snp-indel-silent-np'),('snp-indel-silent')) , VARIANT_CLASS_TO_OMIT (VARIANT_CLASS_OMIT) AS ( VALUES ('Unknown'),('UTR3'),('UTR5'),('intronic'),('synonymous_SNV')) , DMP_ATTRIBUTES AS (SELECT PT_MRN, PDRX_ACCESSION_NO AS "M Acces No", PDWS_NAME AS "Panel", DTRPT.DT_DTE AS "M Report Date", DTPROCPATHRPT.DT_DTE AS "M Proc Date", DT_PROCEDURE, DV.TODATE(DT_PROCEDURE) AS "Procedure Date", TOTAL_NUMBER_VARIANTS AS "Num Variants", VARIANT_CLASS, CNV_TYPE, GENE_ID, SITE1_GENE, SITE2_GENE, EXON_NUM, AA_CHANGE, CDNA_CHANGE, GENE_FOLD_CHANGE, CASE WHEN GENE_FOLD_CHANGE IS NULL THEN 'N/A' WHEN LEFT(LTRIM(RTRIM(GENE_FOLD_CHANGE)), 1) = '-' THEN 'Deletion' ELSE 'Amplification' END AS "Amp/Del Ind", CHROMOSOME, NORMAL_DP, TUMOR_DP, NORMAL_AD, TUMOR_AD, TUMOR_VFREQ, ALT_ALLELE, REF_ALLELE, VARIANT_TYPE, GENE_PANEL, PART_DESCRIPTION, DV.REGEXSTR('(S|H|C|M|F|B|DMG)[0-9]{2}[\s|-][0-9]*', XMLCAST(XMLQUERY('$x/root/meta-data/part_description' PASSING PDRX_XML_VALUE AS "x") AS VARCHAR(2000))) AS "Refer Acces No", PROJECT, PDRX_DMP_SAMPLE_ID AS "Sample ID", PDRX_DMP_PATIENT_ID AS "Patient ID", TUMOR_TYPE_CODE, TUMOR_TYPE_NAME, IS_METASTASIS, PRIMARY_SITE, METASTASIS_SITE , PT_LAST_NAME AS "Last Name", PT_FIRST_NAME AS "First Name", PT_BIRTH_DTE AS "Date of Birth", PT_DEATH_DTE AS "Deceased Date", CASE WHEN PT_DEATH_DTE IS NULL THEN YEAR(CURRENT date - PT_BIRTH_DTE) END AS "Cur Age", PT_VITAL_STATUS AS "Vital Status", PT_SEX_DESC AS "Gender", PT_RACE_DESC AS "Race" FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML INNER JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT ON PDRX_PATH_RPT_ID = PRPT_PATH_RPT_ID LEFT JOIN DV.DATE DTRPT ON PRPT_REPORT_DATE_ID = DTRPT.DT_DATE_ID LEFT JOIN DV.DATE DTPROCPATHRPT ON PRPT_PROCEDURE_DATE_ID = DTPROCPATHRPT.DT_DATE_ID INNER JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML_SETTINGS ON PDRX_PATH_DMP_RESULTS_XML_ID = PDRXS_PATH_DMP_RESULTS_XML_ID INNER JOIN DVDMC.PATHOLOGY_DMP_WEBSVC_SETTINGS ON PDRXS_SETTING_ID = PDWS_SETTING_ID INNER JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON PDRX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID, XMLTABLE('$c/root/*' PASSING PDRX_XML_VALUE AS "c" COLUMNS TOTAL_NUMBER_VARIANTS int PATH 'count(../*[not(name()=''meta-data'')])', CNV_TYPE VARCHAR(500) PATH 'name()', VARIANT_CLASS VARCHAR(100) PATH 'variant_class', SITE1_GENE VARCHAR(100) PATH 'site1_gene', SITE2_GENE VARCHAR(100) PATH 'site2_gene', GENE_ID VARCHAR(100) PATH 'gene_id', EXON_NUM VARCHAR(100) PATH 'exon_num', AA_CHANGE VARCHAR(100) PATH 'aa_change', CDNA_CHANGE VARCHAR(100) PATH 'cDNA_change', GENE_FOLD_CHANGE VARCHAR(100) PATH 'gene_fold_change', VARIANT_ID VARCHAR(255) PATH 'snp_indel_variant_id|cnv_variant_id|sv_variant_id', CHROMOSOME VARCHAR(100) PATH 'chromosome', NORMAL_DP VARCHAR(100) PATH 'normal_dp', TUMOR_DP VARCHAR(100) PATH 'tumor_dp', NORMAL_AD VARCHAR(100) PATH 'normal_ad', TUMOR_AD VARCHAR(100) PATH 'tumor_ad', TUMOR_VFREQ VARCHAR(100) PATH 'tumor_vfreq', ALT_ALLELE VARCHAR(255) PATH 'alt_allele', REF_ALLELE VARCHAR(255) PATH 'ref_allele', VARIANT_TYPE VARCHAR(100) PATH './local-name(.)', GENE_PANEL VARCHAR(100) PATH '../meta-data/gene-panel', PART_DESCRIPTION VARCHAR(2000) PATH '../meta-data/part_description', PROJECT VARCHAR(100) PATH '../meta-data/dmp_alys_task_name', TUMOR_TYPE_CODE VARCHAR(100) PATH '../meta-data/tumor_type_code', TUMOR_TYPE_NAME VARCHAR(255) PATH '../meta-data/tumor_type_name', IS_METASTASIS VARCHAR(10) PATH '../meta-data/is_metastasis', PRIMARY_SITE VARCHAR(255) PATH '../meta-data/primary_site', METASTASIS_SITE VARCHAR(255) PATH '../meta-data/metastasis_site', DT_PROCEDURE VARCHAR(40) PATH '../meta-data/dt_procedure') T LEFT JOIN VARIANTS_TO_OMIT ON CNV_TYPE = CNV_TYPE_OMIT LEFT JOIN VARIANT_CLASS_TO_OMIT ON VARIANT_CLASS = VARIANT_CLASS_OMIT WHERE 1=1 AND PDRX_MODIFIED_DT >= CURRENT timestamp - 30 HOUR AND (TOTAL_NUMBER_VARIANTS =0 OR VARIANT_TYPE <> 'meta-data') AND CNV_TYPE_OMIT IS NULL AND VARIANT_CLASS_OMIT IS NULL ) SELECT * FROM DMP_ATTRIBUTES ORDER BY 1, 2, 3, 4 ;

prompt: Identify MRNs of patients that had a removal of groin lymph nodes and were diagnosed with either bladder or urethral cancer.
completion: SELECT DISTINCT "t1"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AS "Deident PT #", "t2"."PT_MRN" AS "MRN", "t3"."ICSC_SITE_CD" AS "ICD-O Site Code", "t3"."ICSC_ICDO_SITE_MSK_DESC" AS "ICD-O Site Desc" FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED" "t1" INNER JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS" "t2" ON "t1"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t2"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_ICDO_DIAGNOSIS_V" "t3" ON "t1"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t3"."PDX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DIAGNOSIS_FINAL_ALL_V" "t4" ON "t1"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t4"."PDX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."CPT_PBD_PATIENT_PROCEDURE" "t5" ON "t1"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t5"."PTX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" WHERE ((("t4"."PDX_DX_CATALOG_ID" IN (5758, 5815, 5759, 5816, 5760, 5817, 5761, 5818, 5762, 5819, 5763, 5822) AND "t4"."DXA_CIC_CDER_INIT" IN ('YES') ) OR "t3"."ICSC_SITE_CD" IN ('C670', 'C671', 'C672', 'C673', 'C674', 'C675', 'C678', 'C679', 'C676', 'C677') ) AND "t5"."PROC_ID" IN (6065, 6066))

prompt: List of Patients treated with commercial bispecific antibodies at MSKCC
completion: SELECT TM_MRN, TM_DX_DTE, TM_HIST_CD, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS HIST_DESC, TM_SITE_CD, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_DESC, TM_BEST_AJCC_STG FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD JOIN DV.SEERGROUPING ON DV.SEERF_ICDO(TM_SITE_CD, TM_HIST_CD) = RECODE AND CATEGORY1 IN ('Lymphoma', 'Myeloma', 'Leukemia') WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') ; WITH DX AS (SELECT DISTINCT TM_MRN FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN DV.SEERGROUPING ON DV.SEERF_ICDO(TM_SITE_CD, TM_HIST_CD) = RECODE AND CATEGORY1 IN ('Lymphoma', 'Myeloma', 'Leukemia') WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') ) , DEMOG AS (SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN AS "MRN" , PT_LAST_NAME AS "Last Name" , PT_FIRST_NAME AS "First Name" , PT_SEX AS "Sex" , PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH AS "Date of Birth" , V.AV_DESC AS "Vital Status" , PT_DATE_OF_DEATH AS "Date of Death" , TRIM(R.AV_DESC) AS "Race" , PLA_LST_APPT_DTE AS "Last O/P Appt Date" , PLA_LST_CON_DTE AS "Last Contact Date" FROM IDB.PATIENT JOIN DX ON TM_MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS R ON R.AV_ELEMENT = 'RACE' AND R.AV_CODE = PT_RACE LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS V ON V.AV_ELEMENT = 'DEATH_IND' AND V.AV_CODE = PT_DEATH_IND LEFT JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY ON PLA_MRN = PT_MRN) SELECT * FROM DEMOG ; WITH DX AS (SELECT DISTINCT TM_MRN FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN DV.SEERGROUPING ON DV.SEERF_ICDO(TM_SITE_CD, TM_HIST_CD) = RECODE AND CATEGORY1 IN ('Lymphoma', 'Myeloma', 'Leukemia') WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') ) , CHEMO AS (SELECT APR_MRN, APR_START_DTE, APR_END_DTE, APR_GENERIC_NAME AS DRUG_NAME, APR_PRESCRIBED_DOSE AS DOSAGE, APR_DOSE_UOM AS UOM, APR_ROUTE FROM IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX_V JOIN DX ON TM_MRN = APR_MRN AND (LOWER(APR_GENERIC_NAME) LIKE '%epcoritamab%' OR LOWER(APR_GENERIC_NAME) LIKE '%mosunetuzumab%' OR LOWER(APR_GENERIC_NAME) LIKE '%glofitamab%')) , PET AS (SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN , CPE_ENC_DTE AS PET_APPT_DATE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CPE_MRN ORDER BY CPE_ENC_DTE DESC) RN , CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME AS SCAN_TYPE FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID JOIN CHEMO ON APR_MRN = CPE_MRN WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CPE_ENC_DTE <= APR_START_DTE AND CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME LIKE '%PET%CT%' AND CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR NOT LIKE '%INJ%' ) SELECT C.*, PET_APPT_DATE, SCAN_TYPE FROM CHEMO C LEFT JOIN PET ON APR_MRN = CPE_MRN AND RN =1 ;

prompt: Patients with an incisional biopsy of testis using CPT code 54505 in the past 10 years.
completion: WITH "cte1" AS (SELECT UPPER(MP_FULL_NM) MP_FULL_NM_UPPER, M.* FROM DV.MEDPRO_V M) SELECT DISTINCT "t1"."PT_MRN" AS "MRN", "t2"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AS "Deident PT #", "t3"."PCC_CODE" AS "CPT Procedure Code (PBD)", "t3"."PCC_DESC" AS "CPT Procedure Desc (PBD)", "t4"."DT_YEAR" AS "CPT Procedure Year (PBD)", "t5"."MP_FULL_NM_UPPER" AS "CPT Procedure Physician (PBD)" FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED" "t2" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V" "t1" ON "t2"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t1"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."CPT_PBD_PATIENT_PROCEDURE" "t3" ON "t2"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t3"."PTX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" "t4" ON "t3"."PTX_PROC_DATE_ID" = "t4"."DT_DATE_ID" LEFT JOIN "cte1" "t5" ON "t3"."PTX_MEDPRO_ID" = "t5"."MP_MEDPRO_ID" WHERE ("t3"."PCC_CODE" IN ('54505') AND "t4"."DT_YEAR" BETWEEN 2004 AND 2014)

prompt: Create a report of patients with AML, ALL and MPAL who have MLL rearrangement leukemia (11q23).
completion: WITH X AS (SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, PT_SEX, R.AV_DESC AS "Race", E.AV_DESC AS "Ethnicity", PT_DATE_OF_DEATH, COALESCE(MAX(PLA_LST_APPT_DTE, PLA_LST_DSCH_DTE), PLA_LST_APPT_DTE, PLA_LST_DSCH_DTE) AS LAST_FU_DATE, CASE WHEN APR_MRN IS NOT NULL THEN 'Y' END AS "CYTARABINE_METHOTREXATE" FROM IDB.PATIENT JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY ON PT_MRN = PLA_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS R ON PT_RACE = R.AV_CODE AND R.AV_ELEMENT = 'RACE' LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS E ON PT_PT_ETHNICITY = E.AV_CODE AND E.AV_ELEMENT = 'PT_ETHNICITY' LEFT JOIN IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX_V ON APR_MRN = PT_MRN AND(UPPER(APR_GENERIC_NAME) LIKE '%CYTARABINE%' OR UPPER(APR_GENERIC_NAME) LIKE '%METHOTREXATE%' OR UPPER(APR_DRUG_NAME) LIKE '%CYTARABINE%' OR UPPER(APR_DRUG_NAME) LIKE '%METHOTREXATE%') WHERE PT_MRN IN () ) , PATH AS (SELECT DISTINCT "t1"."PT_MRN" AS "MRN", "t2"."PRPT_ACCESSION_NO" AS "Pathology Report", "t3"."DT_DTE" AS "Pathology Procedure Date", "t4"."DT_DTE" AS "Pathology Report Date", "t5"."PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_DESC" AS "Pathology Report Type", PRPT_ORD_DR_SVC_DESC, PRPT_ORD_DR_NAME, UPPER(CASE WHEN LENGTH(PRPT_REPORT) <= 15000 THEN RTRIM(CAST(SUBSTR(PRPT_REPORT, 1, 15000) AS VARCHAR(15000))) ELSE CAST(SUBSTR(PRPT_REPORT, 1, 15000) AS VARCHAR(15000)) END) AS TXT FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V" "t1" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED" "t6" ON "t1"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t6"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V" "t2" ON "t6"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t2"."PRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" "t3" ON "t2"."PRPT_PROCEDURE_DATE_ID" = "t3"."DT_DATE_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" "t4" ON "t2"."PRPT_REPORT_DATE_ID" = "t4"."DT_DATE_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATH_RPRT_TYPE_LOOKUP" "t5" ON "t2"."PRPT_REPORT_TYPE" = "t5"."PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_CD" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_IDENTIFICATION_MRN_V" "t7" ON "t1"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t7"."PI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" WHERE 1=1 AND "t5"."PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_DESC" IN ('Flow Cytometry Report', 'Hematopathology Report') AND "t1"."PT_MRN" IN (SELECT PT_MRN FROM X) ) WITH DX AS (SELECT DISTINCT TM_MRN AS MRN, TM_DX_DTE AS DX_DATE, TM_SITE_CD AS SITE_CODE, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_DESC, TM_HIST_CD AS HIST_CODE, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS HIST_DESC, AV_DESC AS "Laterality" FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.SEERGROUPING ON RECODE = IDB.SEERF_ICDO(TM_SITE_CD, TM_HIST_CD) JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS ON TM_LATERALITY_CD = AV_CODE AND AV_ELEMENT = 'LATERALITY_CD' WHERE 1=1 AND TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND TM_MRN IN () UNION SELECT CC_MRN AS MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS DX_DATE, CLM_CLSF_CD AS SITE_CODE, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_DESC, '' AS HIST_CODE, '' AS HIST_DESC, '' AS "Laterality" FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.SEERGROUPING ON RECODE = MIN(IDB.SEERF_ICD9(CLM_CLSF_CD), IDB.SEERF_ICD10(CLM_CLSF_CD)) WHERE CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND ((CC_PT_TYPE = 'I') OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) AND(CLM_CLSF_CD BETWEEN '140' AND '239.99' OR CLM_CLSF_CD BETWEEN 'C00' AND 'D49.99') AND CC_MRN IN () GROUP BY CC_MRN, CLM_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK, '', '', '' ) , CTE AS (SELECT MRN AS DX_MRN, DX_DATE, STRIP(SITE_CODE) || ' - ' || STRIP(SITE_DESC) || ' | ' || STRIP(HIST_CODE) || ' - ' || STRIP(HIST_DESC) || ' | ' || STRIP("Laterality") AS DX_CODE FROM DX) , CTE2 AS (SELECT * FROM CTE ORDER BY DX_MRN, DX_DATE, DX_CODE) , T1 AS (SELECT DX_MRN, DX_DATE, DX_CODE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY DX_MRN ORDER BY DX_DATE) AS RN FROM CTE2 ORDER BY DX_MRN, DX_DATE) , T2 (MRN, DX, RN1) AS (SELECT DX_MRN, CAST(DX_DATE AS VARCHAR(6000))||' | '||CAST(DX_CODE AS VARCHAR(100)), RN FROM T1 WHERE T1.RN = 1 UNION ALL SELECT DX_MRN, RTRIM(CAST(DX AS VARCHAR(4000))) || ', ' || CHR(13) || CHR(10) || CAST(DX_DATE AS VARCHAR(100))||' | '||RTRIM(CAST(DX_CODE AS VARCHAR(100))) , RN1 + 1 FROM T1, T2 WHERE DX_MRN = MRN AND RN = RN1+1 ) , T3 AS (SELECT MRN, MAX(RN1) RN FROM T2 GROUP BY MRN) SELECT T2.MRN, RN, REPLACE(DX, ' | - |', '') AS DX FROM T2 JOIN T3 ON T2.MRN = T3.MRN AND T2.RN1 = T3.RN

completion: WITH X AS (SELECT DISTINCT TM_MRN AS MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, R.AV_DESC AS "Race", E.AV_DESC AS "Ethnicity", PT_SEX, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, PT_DATE_OF_DEATH, COALESCE(MAX(PLA_LST_APPT_DTE, PLA_LST_DSCH_DTE), PLA_LST_APPT_DTE, PLA_LST_DSCH_DTE) AS LAST_FU_DATE, TM_DX_DTE AS DX_DATE, TM_HIST_CD AS HIST_CODE, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS HIST_DESC, TM_SITE_CD AS SITE_CODE, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_DESC, CS.AV_DESC AS "Case Status", CASE WHEN TM_AJCC_7 NOT IN ('', '888', '999') THEN AJCC7.AV_DESC WHEN TM_AJCC NOT IN ('', '88', '99') THEN AJCC.AV_DESC WHEN TM_GENERAL_STG NOT IN ('', '9') THEN GS.AV_DESC WHEN TM_PATH_STG_GRP NOT IN ('', '88', '9', '99') THEN TM_PATH_STG_GRP ELSE CLIN.AV_DESC END AS "Stage" FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON TM_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY ON TM_MRN = PLA_MRN JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS R ON PT_RACE = R.AV_CODE AND R.AV_ELEMENT = 'RACE' JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS E ON PT_PT_ETHNICITY = E.AV_CODE AND E.AV_ELEMENT = 'PT_ETHNICITY' JOIN IDB.SEERGROUPING ON RECODE = IDB.SEERF_ICDO(TM_SITE_CD, TM_HIST_CD) AND CATEGORY1 = 'Lymphoma' JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS AJCC7 ON AJCC7.AV_ELEMENT = 'AJCC_7' AND AJCC7.AV_CODE = TM_AJCC_7 LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS AJCC ON AJCC.AV_ELEMENT = 'AJCC' AND AJCC.AV_CODE = TM_AJCC LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS GS ON GS.AV_ELEMENT = 'GENERAL_STG' AND GS.AV_CODE = TM_GENERAL_STG LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS CLIN ON CLIN.AV_ELEMENT = 'CLIN_STG_DSCR' AND CLIN.AV_CODE = TM_CLIN_STG_DSCR LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS CS ON CS.AV_ELEMENT = 'CASE_STS' AND CS.AV_CODE = TM_CASE_STS WHERE 1=1 AND TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND TM_HIST_CD IN ('M9680/3', 'M9681/3', 'M9738/3') AND S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK LIKE '%SKIN%' ) , CHEMO AS (SELECT DISTINCT APR_MRN, APR_GENERIC_NAME, APR_START_DTE, APR_END_DTE, APR_ORD_RX_TYPE FROM IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX JOIN IDB.CHEMO_DRUG_GENERIC ON APR_GENERIC_NAME = CDG_GENERIC_NAME WHERE APR_MRN IN (SELECT MRN FROM X) AND CDG_CHEMO_FLAG = 'Y' ) , SURG AS (SELECT DISTINCT SSE_MRN, SSE_SURG_DTE, SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD, SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC FROM IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE ON SSE_LOG_ID = SSP_LOG_ID WHERE SSE_MRN IN (SELECT MRN FROM X) ) , RT AS (SELECT DISTINCT RTC_TX_MRN, RTC_TX_PLAN_NAME, RTC_PRIMARY_REF_POINT, RTC_TX_START_DTE, RTC_TX_STOP_DTE, RTC_TX_ELAPSED_DAYS, RTC_TX_PLANNED_FRACTIONS, RTC_TX_DELIVERED_FRACTIONS, RTC_TX_PLANNED_DOSE, RTC_TX_DELIVERED_DOSE, RTC_DOSE_CORRECTION FROM IDB.RADONC_TREATMENT_COURSE WHERE RTC_TX_MRN IN (SELECT MRN FROM X) ) SELECT * FROM RT
