prompt: COVID Patient Days for 2020
completion: SELECT DISTINCT CALENDAR_DATE, COVID.MRN, COVID.LAST_NAME, COVID.FIRST_NAME, COVID.DATE_OF_BIRTH, COVID.DATE_OF_DEATH, RESULT, DATE(MIN_IDENTIFIED_DT) MIN_IDENTIFIED_DT, DATE(COVID.MIN_RESOLVED_PROBLEM_DT) MIN_RESOLVED_PROBLEM_DT, IP.ADMIT_DATE, IP.DISCHARGE_DATE, LOS, SERVICE_MIDNIGHT, CASE WHEN COVID.DATE_OF_DEATH <= IP.DISCHARGE_DATE THEN 'Y' ELSE '' END AS DISCHARGED_DECEASED, CASE WHEN SERVICE_MIDNIGHT = 'Intensive Care Unit' OR SVC_MIDNIGHT = 'PDU' THEN 'Y' ELSE '' END AS ICU FROM IDB.COVID19_PATIENT_INFO COVID JOIN IDB.INPATIENT_ADMISSIONS_V IP ON COVID.MRN = IP.MRN AND (RESULT = 'Positive' OR (RESULT = 'Resolved' AND MIN_RESOLVED_PROBLEM_DT > IP.ADMIT_DT)) JOIN IDB.INPATIENT_DAYS_V IPDAYS ON IP.ADMIT_ID = IPDAYS.ADMIT_ID AND CALENDAR_DATE BETWEEN DATE(MIN_IDENTIFIED_DT) AND COALESCE(DATE(MIN_RESOLVED_PROBLEM_DT), '2999-01-01') - 1 DAY WHERE YEAR(CALENDAR_DATE) = 2020 ORDER BY CALENDAR_DATE, COVID.MRN

prompt: Provide a weekly list of orders that have expired entered under visits by GMO provider Dr. Roisin O"Cearbhaill or any of her PA's Jessica Gahres or Katy Nickolaus.
completion: WITH PAT_VISIT AS (SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN AS MRN, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_LAST_NAME, CPE_ENC_DTE AS "Date of Visit", CPE_CPE_APPT_STS, CRE_RES_NAME, CPE_ENC_DTE FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PT_MRN = CPE_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID WHERE 1=1 AND CLD_DEPT_ID IN ('72', '766') AND CRE_RES_ID IN ('070201', '070722', '015412', '085639', '087270') AND CPE_CPE_APPT_STS = 'Comp' AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT date - 14 DAY AND CURRENT date ), ORD AS (SELECT MRN, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_LAST_NAME, "Date of Visit", OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE AS "Date of Order", OO_ORD_NAME AS "Order Name", OO_ORD_STS_CD AS "Order status", OO_ORD_TYPE_CD AS "order type", OOC_EXP_DT AS "Expired Date" FROM PAT_VISIT JOIN IDB.OMS_ORDER ON MRN = OO_MRN JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_CATALOG ON OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID = OOC_MSTR_ITEM_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_STATUS ON OO_ORD_STS_CD = OSTS_ORD_STS_CD AND OO_ORD_STS_CD IN ('CANP', 'CANC', 'DISC', 'DISCD') AND (UPPER(OOC_ITEM_NAME) IN ('CT', 'MR', 'XR', 'US', 'IR', 'PET') OR UPPER(OOC_ITEM_NAME) like '%CONSULT%' OR UPPER(OOC_ITEM_NAME) like '%GMO VISIT%') AND OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT date - 14 DAY AND CURRENT date) SELECT DISTINCT A.* FROM ORD A

prompt: Provide a monthly list of patients seen in Manhattan and Regional HPB Surgery clinics as well as regional survival clinics with the Diagnosis of Pancreas Cyst.
completion: WITH DT AS (SELECT PT_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME , PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID , TRIM(ENR_RES_NAME) AS APPT_RESOURCE , TRIM(ENDP_SERVICE_DEPT_GRP_6) DEPT_GRP_6 , TRIM(ENDP_SVC_CLINIC_SUB_DEPT_GRP_7) DIV_GRP_7 , TRIM(ENDP_SERVICE_SPECIALTY_GRP_8) RPT_GRP_8 , TRIM(ENDP_CENTER_FULL_NAME) CENTER_FULL_NAME , TRIM(ENDP_DEPT_NAME) DEPT_NAME , TRIM(T2.EDC_DEPT_DESC) APPT_STATUS_DESC , CASE WHEN ENVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR like '%NV%' THEN 'New Visit' WHEN ENVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR like '%IR%' THEN 'Internal Referral' ELSE 'Non-New Visit/Interal Referral' END AS IRNV_IND , PENC_ENC_DT, PENC_MODIFIED_DT FROM DV.PATIENT_ENCOUNTER T6 JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON PENC_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID INNER JOIN DV.ENCOUNTER_SCHD_RESOURCES SR ON T6.PENC_PT_ENC_ID = SR.ENSR_PT_ENC_ID INNER JOIN DV.ENCOUNTER_RESOURCE ER ON SR.ENSR_RES_ID = ER.ENR_ENC_RES_ID INNER JOIN DV.ENCOUNTER_VISIT_TYPE EVT ON T6.PENC_VISIT_TYPE_ID = EVT.ENVT_ENC_VISIT_TYPE_ID INNER JOIN DV.ENCOUNTER_DESC_CATALOG T2 ON EDC_GROUP_ID = 'STS' AND T6.PENC_APPT_STS = T2.EDC_DEPT_ABBREV INNER JOIN DV.ENCOUNTER_DEPARTMENT T3 ON T6.PENC_DEPT_ID = T3.ENDP_ENC_DEPT_ID INNER JOIN DV.DATE_V REC ON T6.PENC_ENC_DATE_ID = REC.DT_DATE_ID WHERE 1=1 AND T2.EDC_DEPT_DESC IN ('Scheduled') AND DT_DTE <= CURRENT date + 31 DAYS AND DT_DTE >= CURRENT date AND (ENDP_SERVICE_SPECIALTY_GRP_8 IN ('HEP') OR (ER.ENR_RES_NAME IN ('PANC CYST APP') AND TRIM(ENDP_DEPT_ABBR) || ' - ' || TRIM(ENDP_DEPT_NAME) IN ('HEP533APP - HEP 53-3 APP')) OR (ER.ENR_RES_NAME IN ('LOMBARDO, CATHY ANN') AND TRIM(ENDP_DEPT_ABBR) || ' - ' || TRIM(ENDP_DEPT_NAME) IN ('SVRCMK - CMK SURVIVORSHIP')) OR (ER.ENR_RES_NAME IN ('CRISTINO, JULIE ELIZABETH') AND TRIM(ENDP_DEPT_ABBR) || ' - ' || TRIM(ENDP_DEPT_NAME) IN ('SRGAPPBSK - BSK SURG ONC APP'))) AND CASE WHEN ENVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR like '%NV%' THEN 'New Visit' WHEN ENVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR like '%IR%' THEN 'Internal Referral' ELSE 'Non-New Visit/Interal Referral' END IN ('Non-New Visit/Interal Referral') ), IRB AS (SELECT PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID P_ID, LISTAGG(DISTINCT TRIM(PRO_IRB_NO), ', ') IRB_NO FROM DT LEFT JOIN DV.ACCRUALS ON AC_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID LEFT JOIN DV.PROTOCOL ON AC_PROTOCOL_ID = PRO_PROTOCOL_ID GROUP BY PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID) SELECT PT_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, APPT_RESOURCE, DEPT_GRP_6, RPT_GRP_8, CENTER_FULL_NAME, DEPT_NAME, APPT_STATUS_DESC, IRNV_IND, PENC_ENC_DT, PENC_MODIFIED_DT, IRB_NO FROM DT LEFT JOIN IRB ON PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = P_ID ORDER BY PENC_ENC_DT ASC

prompt: Dr. Sofocleous needs a list of all patients that underwent Y90 Sirsphere SIRTEX treatment up until today.
completion: WITH SRG AS (SELECT DISTINCT SSE_MRN MRN, CHAR(SSE_SURG_DTE) "Treatment Date", CHAR(PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) DOB, CHAR(PT_DATE_OF_DEATH) "Death Date", CHAR(PLA_LST_CON_DTE) "Last Contact Date", SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC "Proc Name", SSP_SURG_LAST_NM "Surgeon Last Name", SSP_SURG_FIRST_NM "Surgeon First Name" FROM IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE ON SSE_LOG_ID = SSP_LOG_ID JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PT_MRN = SSE_MRN JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY ON PLA_MRN=PT_MRN WHERE (UPPER(SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC) like '%SIRSPHERE%' OR UPPER(SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC) like '%THERASPHERE%') ), REFER AS (SELECT CPE_MRN, CHAR("Treatment Date") TX_DTE, CRE_RES_NAME, CPE_ENC_DTE , ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY MRN, "Treatment Date" ORDER BY CPE_ENC_DTE DESC, CPE_REF_RES_ID DESC) AS RN FROM SRG JOIN IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER ON MRN = CPE_MRN AND "Treatment Date" > CPE_ENC_DTE AND CPE_CPE_APPT_STS = 'Comp' JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 = 'IR' JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE R ON CPE_REF_RES_ID = R.CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID AND (CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR like '%NV%' OR CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR like '%IR%')) , DX_AGG_0 AS (SELECT DISTINCT TM_MRN, TRIM(H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK) AS HIST_DESC, TRIM(S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK) AS SITE_DESC FROM REFER JOIN IDB.CDB_TUMOR ON TM_MRN=CPE_MRN JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS CASE_STS ON CASE_STS.AV_ELEMENT = 'CASE_STS' AND CASE_STS.AV_CODE = TM_CASE_STS AND TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') ) , DX_AGG AS (SELECT DISTINCT TM_MRN, LISTAGG(TRIM(HIST_DESC), ' | ') WITHIN GROUP( ORDER BY TM_MRN) AS HIST_DESC, LISTAGG(TRIM(SITE_DESC), ' | ') WITHIN GROUP( ORDER BY TM_MRN) AS SITE_DESC FROM DX_AGG_0 GROUP BY TM_MRN) , SEC_DX_0 AS (SELECT DISTINCT CC_MRN, CC_CLSF_CD FROM REFER JOIN IDB.CTC_CLSF ON CPE_MRN = CC_MRN JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE (SUBSTR(CC_CLSF_CD, 1, 3) BETWEEN 'C77' AND 'C79' OR SUBSTR(CC_CLSF_CD, 1, 3) BETWEEN '196' AND '198') AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND (CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) ) , SEC_DX AS (SELECT CC_MRN, LISTAGG(TRIM(CC_CLSF_CD), ' | ') WITHIN GROUP( ORDER BY CC_MRN) AS SEC_DX_ICD_CD FROM SEC_DX_0 GROUP BY CC_MRN) SELECT SRG.*, CRE_RES_NAME "Referring MD", CHAR(CPE_ENC_DTE) "Referring Date", HIST_DESC, SITE_DESC, SEC_DX_ICD_CD FROM SRG LEFT JOIN REFER ON CPE_MRN=MRN AND "Treatment Date"=TX_DTE AND RN=1 LEFT JOIN DX_AGG ON TM_MRN=MRN LEFT JOIN SEC_DX ON MRN = CC_MRN ORDER BY 1, 2

prompt: Provide a list of patients diagnosed with glioblastoma since 1/1/2005 with an ICD-O Site of C710 (Cerebrum).
completion: SELECT DISTINCT "t1"."PT_MRN" AS "MRN", "t1"."PT_BIRTH_DTE" AS "Date of Birth", "t1"."PT_DEATH_DTE" AS "Deceased Date", "t1"."PT_SEX_DESC" AS "Gender", "t2"."CORE_ETHNICITY_DESC" AS "Ethnicity", "t3"."DT_DTE" AS "Tumor Diagnosis Date", "t4"."ICSC_SITE_CD" AS "ICD-O Site Code", "t4"."ICSC_ICDO_SITE_MSK_DESC" AS "ICD-O Site Description", "t5"."DXCC_ICD_CODE" AS "ICD-O Histology Code", "t5"."DXCC_ICD_MSK_DESC" AS "ICD-O Histology Description", "t6"."CDTM_LATERALITY_DESC" AS "Tumor Laterality", "t7"."PLA_LAST_DRVST_DTE" AS "Last Dr Visit Date" FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V" "t1" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_CORE_DEMOGRAPHICS" "t2" ON "t1"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t2"."CORE_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED" "t8" ON "t1"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t8"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."CDB_TUMOR_V" "t6" ON "t8"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t6"."CDTM_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" "t3" ON "t6"."CDTM_DX_DATE_ID" = "t3"."DT_DATE_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."ICDO_SITE_CATALOG_V" "t4" ON "t6"."CDTM_SITE_CATALOG_ID" = "t4"."ICSC_SITE_CATALOG_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DIAGNOSIS_CODE_CAT_ICDO_V" "t5" ON "t6"."CDTM_DX_CATALOG_ID" = "t5"."DXCC_DX_CATALOG_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_LATEST_ACTIVITY" "t7" ON "t1"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t7"."PLA_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" WHERE ("t4"."ICSC_SITE_CD" IN ('C710') AND ("t5"."DXCC_ICD_CODE" IN ('M9440/3', 'M9441/3', 'M9442/3') AND "t3"."DT_DTE" >= '2005-1-1'))

prompt: Provide a list of living patients with non-squamous NSCLC and specified mutations.
completion: WITH MUT AS (SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN "MRN", ABERRATIONTYPE FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_STRUCTURED_RESULTS_V WHERE GENE = 'ERBB2' AND ABERRATIONTYPE IN ('copy number loss', 'deletion', 'duplication', 'fusion', 'inversion', 'mutation', 'point_mutation', 'splicing variant', 'translocation') ) , GENES AS (SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN "MRN", ABERRATIONTYPE FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_STRUCTURED_RESULTS_V WHERE GENE = 'ERBB2' AND ABERRATIONTYPE IN ('amplification', 'copy number gain') AND PT_MRN NOT IN (SELECT "MRN" FROM MUT) ) , DX AS (SELECT TM_MRN, AV_DESC AS CASE_STS, TM_DX_DTE, TM_HIST_CD, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS HIST_DESC, TM_SITE_CD, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_DESC, TM_CLIN_STG_GRP FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS ON AV_ELEMENT = 'CASE_STS' JOIN GENES ON "MRN" = TM_MRN AND AV_CODE = TM_CASE_STS WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND TM_SITE_CD LIKE 'C34%' AND TM_HIST_CD IN ('M8013/3', 'M8014/3', 'M8022/3', 'M8030/3', 'M8031/3', 'M8032/3', 'M8033/3', 'M8046/3', 'M8140/2', 'M8140/3', 'M8250/2', 'M8250/3', 'M8251/3', 'M8252/3', 'M8253/3', 'M8254/3', 'M8255/3', 'M8260/2', 'M8260/3', 'M8310/3', 'M8333/3', 'M8480/2', 'M8480/3', 'M8481/3', 'M8490/2', 'M8490/3', 'M8572/3', 'M8574/3', 'M8972/3', 'M8973/3', 'M8980/3') ) , TDM1 AS (SELECT DISTINCT APR_MRN FROM IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX JOIN GENES ON APR_MRN = "MRN" JOIN DX ON APR_MRN = TM_MRN WHERE APR_GENERIC_NAME IN ('ADO-TRASTUZUMAB EMTANSINE', 'TRASTUZUMAB', 'TRASTUZUMAB-MCC-DM1') ) , RAD AS (SELECT RRPT_MRN, RRPT_ANC_CODE, RRPT_ORDER_GROUP, RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY RRPT_MRN ORDER BY RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE DESC) AS RANK, DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)IMPRESSION:[\w\W]*(?=DICTATED BY:)', RRPT_REPORT_TXT) AS RRPT_IMPRESSION FROM DV.RADIOLOGY_REPORT_V JOIN DX ON RRPT_MRN = TM_MRN JOIN GENES ON "MRN" = RRPT_MRN WHERE RRPT_ANC_CODE IN ('CTCAC', 'CTCANC', 'CTCAPC', 'CTCAPNC', 'CTCH', 'CTCH1', 'CTCHN1', 'CTCHSLD', 'CTPE', 'CTPEWAP', 'PETHCAP', 'PETNCAP') ) , APPT AS (SELECT CPE_MRN, CPE_ENC_DTE, CRE_RES_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CPE_MRN ORDER BY CPE_ENC_DTE) AS RNK FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID JOIN DX ON TM_MRN = CPE_MRN WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Sch') AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 IN ('THR') AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 IN ('MED') AND CRE_RES_TYP = 'Physician' ) SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, CPE_ENC_DTE "Next THR Appt", CRE_RES_NAME "Appt MD", SITE_DESC, HIST_DESC, ABERRATIONTYPE, CASE WHEN APR_MRN IS NOT NULL THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS "Prior Therapy", RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE, RRPT_ANC_CODE AS "Scan Type", RRPT_IMPRESSION FROM GENES JOIN DX ON TM_MRN = "MRN" JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON TM_MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN APPT ON PT_MRN = CPE_MRN AND RNK = 1 LEFT JOIN IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX ON APR_MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN RAD ON RRPT_MRN = PT_MRN AND RANK = 1 WHERE PT_DATE_OF_DEATH IS NULL AND PT_MRN NOT IN (SELECT APR_MRN FROM TDM1) ORDER BY PT_MRN ; WITH GENES AS (SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN "MRN", LISTAGG(ABERRATIONTYPE, ', ') AS "Aberration Types" FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_STRUCTURED_RESULTS_V WHERE GENE IN ('EGFR') AND ABERRATIONTYPE NOT IN ('fusion') GROUP BY PT_MRN) , DX AS (SELECT TM_MRN, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS HIST_DESC, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_DESC FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS ON AV_ELEMENT = 'CASE_STS' JOIN GENES ON "MRN" = TM_MRN AND AV_CODE = TM_CASE_STS WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND TM_SITE_CD LIKE 'C34%' AND TM_HIST_CD IN ('M8013/3', 'M8014/3', 'M8022/3', 'M8030/3', 'M8031/3', 'M8032/3', 'M8033/3', 'M8046/3', 'M8140/2', 'M8140/3', 'M8250/2', 'M8250/3', 'M8251/3', 'M8252/3', 'M8253/3', 'M8254/3', 'M8255/3', 'M8260/2', 'M8260/3', 'M8310/3', 'M8333/3', 'M8480/2', 'M8480/3', 'M8481/3', 'M8490/2', 'M8490/3', 'M8572/3', 'M8574/3', 'M8972/3', 'M8973/3', 'M8980/3') ) , OSIM AS (SELECT DISTINCT APR_MRN FROM IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX JOIN DX ON APR_MRN = TM_MRN WHERE APR_GENERIC_NAME = 'OSIMERTINIB' ) , RAD AS (SELECT RRPT_MRN, RRPT_ANC_CODE, RRPT_ORDER_GROUP, RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY RRPT_MRN ORDER BY RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE DESC) AS RANK, DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)IMPRESSION:[\w\W]*(?=DICTATED BY:)', RRPT_REPORT_TXT) AS RRPT_IMPRESSION FROM DV.RADIOLOGY_REPORT_V JOIN DX ON RRPT_MRN = TM_MRN JOIN GENES ON "MRN" = RRPT_MRN WHERE RRPT_ANC_CODE IN ('CTCAC', 'CTCANC', 'CTCAPC', 'CTCAPNC', 'CTCH', 'CTCH1', 'CTCHN1', 'CTCHSLD', 'CTPE', 'CTPEWAP', 'PETHCAP', 'PETNCAP') ) , APPT AS (SELECT CPE_MRN, CPE_ENC_DTE, CRE_RES_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CPE_MRN ORDER BY CPE_ENC_DTE) AS RNK FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID JOIN OSIM ON APR_MRN = CPE_MRN WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Sch') AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 IN ('THR') AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 IN ('MED') AND CRE_RES_TYP = 'Physician' ) SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, CPE_ENC_DTE "Next THR Appt", CRE_RES_NAME "Appt MD", SITE_DESC, HIST_DESC, "Aberration Types", RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE, RRPT_ANC_CODE AS "Scan Type", RRPT_IMPRESSION FROM GENES JOIN DX ON TM_MRN = "MRN" JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON TM_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN OSIM ON APR_MRN = TM_MRN LEFT JOIN APPT ON PT_MRN = CPE_MRN AND RNK = 1 LEFT JOIN RAD ON RRPT_MRN = PT_MRN AND RANK = 1 WHERE PT_DATE_OF_DEATH IS NULL ORDER BY PT_MRN

prompt: A list of H/S lymphoma cases where patients also one of the following: FAS mutation, ferritin value >= 2000, "hemophagocytic lymphohistiocytosis" in ClinDoc assessment.
completion: WITH PATH_PRE AS (SELECT DISTINCT DMP.PRPT_MRN AS MRN, DMP.PRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID AS PATH_PID , PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_BIRTH_DTE, PT_VITAL_STATUS, PT_DEATH_DTE , CASE WHEN PT_DEATH_DTE IS NULL THEN YEAR(CURRENT date - PT_BIRTH_DTE) END AS "Current Age" , DMP.PRPT_ACCESSION_NO AS "Accession No" , DMP.PRPT_REPORT_DTE AS "Report Date" , DMP.PRPT_PROCEDURE_DTE AS "Procedure Date" , SRG.PRPT_ACCESSION_NO AS RELATED_ACC_NO , SRG_DATE.DT_DTE AS RELATED_PROC_DTE , DMP.PRPT_REPORT_TYPE_DESC AS "Report Type" , DMP.PRPT_REPORT_TYPE , DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)diag[\w\W]*(?=I ATTEST)', DMP.PRPT_REPORT) AS DIAGNOSIS_TEXT , VARCHAR(DMP.PRPT_REPORT, 32000) AS "Report Text (first 32000 characters)" , TRIM(DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)(?<=(^|[\.]))[^\.]*(non-Hodgkin|non Hodgkin|NK cell lymphoma|NK cell leukemia|T-cell lymphoma|T cell lymphoma|mature T-cell lymphoma|mature T cell lymphoma|atypical NK cell|atypical T-cell|atypical T cell|T-cell lymphoproliferative disorder|T cell lymphoproliferative disorder|NK cell neoplasm|T-cell neoplasm|T cell neoplasm)[^\.]*', VARCHAR(DMP.PRPT_REPORT, 32000))) AS TARGET_EXTRACT FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V DMP LEFT JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_REFERENCES ON PRPTR_CHILD_PATH_RPT_ID = DMP.PRPT_PATH_RPT_ID LEFT JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT SRG ON SRG.PRPT_PATH_RPT_ID = PRPTR_PATH_RPT_ID LEFT JOIN DV.DATE_V SRG_DATE ON SRG_DATE.DT_DATE_ID = SRG.PRPT_PROCEDURE_DATE_ID JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = DMP.PRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID WHERE 1=1 AND SUBSTR(DMP.PRPT_ACCESSION_NO, 1, 1) IN ('S', 'H') AND (DMP.PRPT_REPORT_DTE >= '01/01/2012' OR DMP.PRPT_PROCEDURE_DTE >= '01/01/2012' ) AND CONTAINS(DMP.PRPT_REPORT, '(("non-Hodgkin" OR "non Hodgkin" OR "NK cell lymphoma" OR "NK cell leukemia" OR "T-cell lymphoma" OR "T cell lymphoma" OR "mature T-cell lymphoma" OR "mature T cell lymphoma" OR "atypical NK cell" OR "atypical T-cell" OR "atypical T cell" OR "T-cell lymphoproliferative disorder" OR "T cell lymphoproliferative disorder" OR "NK cell neoplasm" OR "T-cell neoplasm" OR "T cell neoplasm" ))') = 1 AND DMP.PRPT_REPORT IS NOT NULL ) , CLINDOC_PRE AS (SELECT DISTINCT CDD_MRN, CDD_DOC_NAME, CDD_SERVICE_DTE , TRIM(DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)(?<=(^|[\.]))[^\.]*(HLH|hemophagocytic lymphohistiocytosis)[^\.]*', CDD_DOCUMENT_FULL_TEXT)) AS "Target Sentence/s" , VARCHAR(CDD_DOCUMENT_FULL_TEXT, 32000) AS "ClinDoc Full Report Text" FROM DV.CLINDOC_FULL_TEXT_V JOIN PATH_PRE ON MRN = CDD_MRN WHERE 1=1 AND CONTAINS(CDD_DOCUMENT_FULL_TEXT, '"HLH" OR "hemophagocytic lymphohistiocytosis"') = 1 AND CDD_DOC_NAME IN ('Follow Up Consultation - DOM' , 'Follow Up Consultation - DOM-Bone Marrow Transplant' , 'Initial Consult/Initial Visit – BMT' , 'Initial Consult/Initial Visit, AMB - DOM-Adult Long Term F' , 'Initial Consult/Initial Visit, AMB - DOM-Bone Marrow Trans' , 'Initial Consult/Initial Visit, AMB - DOM-Leukemia' , 'Initial Consult/Initial Visit, AMB - DOM-Lymphoma' , 'Initial Consult/Initial Visit, AMB - DOM-Myeloma' , 'Initial Consult/Initial Visit, IP - DOM' , 'Follow Up Consultation - DOM-Hematology/Anticoag' , 'Follow Up Consultation - DOM-Infectious Diseases' , 'Follow Up Consultation - DOM-Leukemia' , 'Follow Up Consultation - DOM-Lymphoma' , 'Follow Up Consultation - DOM-Palliative Medicine' , 'Follow Up Consultation, NP/PA - DOM-Lymphoma' , 'Follow Up Consultation, NP/PA - DOM-Palliative Medicine' , 'Follow Up Consultation, NP/PA - DOM-Supportive Care' , 'Prep Note, Initial Consult/Initial Visit, AMB - DOM' ) ) , CLINDOC_INFO AS (SELECT CDD_MRN, CDD_DOC_NAME, CDD_SERVICE_DTE , "Target Sentence/s" , "ClinDoc Full Report Text" , ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CDD_MRN ORDER BY CDD_SERVICE_DTE DESC) DESCRN FROM CLINDOC_PRE) , LABS_PRE AS (SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN AS LAB_MRN, LAB_PERFORMED_DATE, LAB_PERFORMED_TIME, LAB_TEST_NAME, LAB_SUBTEST_NAME, LAB_TEST_RESULT_VALUE, LAB_PARSED_NUMERIC_RESULT FROM DV.LABS_V JOIN PATH_PRE ON PATH_PID = PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID WHERE 1=1 AND LAB_PARSED_NUMERIC_RESULT >= 2000 AND LAB_SUBTEST_NAME like '%Ferritin%' AND LAB_TEST_RESULT_VALUE IS NOT NULL AND LAB_TEST_RESULT_VALUE > '' AND LAB_TEST_RESULT_VALUE <> 'canceled' AND LAB_TEST_RESULT_VALUE not like '<%' ) , LAB_INFO AS (SELECT LAB_MRN, LAB_PARSED_NUMERIC_RESULT, LAB_PERFORMED_DATE, LAB_PERFORMED_TIME, LAB_TEST_NAME, LAB_SUBTEST_NAME, LAB_TEST_RESULT_VALUE , ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY LAB_MRN ORDER BY LAB_PERFORMED_DATE DESC) DESCRN FROM LABS_PRE) , GENE_PRE AS (SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN AS GENE_MRN, PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID AS GENE_PID, PATH_RPT_DATE, PRPT_ACCESSION_NO, GENE, RESULT, LOCUS, AA_CHANGE, NUCLEOTIDE, METHOD, ABERRATIONTYPE FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_STRUCTURED_RESULTS_V JOIN PATH_PRE ON PATH_PID = PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID WHERE 1=1 AND (GENE='FAS' OR GENE2 = 'FAS') AND ABERRATIONTYPE = 'mutation' ) , GENE_INFO AS (SELECT GENE_MRN, PATH_RPT_DATE, PRPT_ACCESSION_NO, GENE, LOCUS, AA_CHANGE, NUCLEOTIDE, ABERRATIONTYPE, METHOD , ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY GENE_MRN ORDER BY PATH_RPT_DATE DESC) DESCRN FROM GENE_PRE ) , DT AS (SELECT CDD_MRN AS MRN FROM CLINDOC_INFO UNION SELECT LAB_MRN FROM LAB_INFO UNION SELECT GENE_MRN FROM GENE_PRE) , EMR AS (SELECT EAD_MRN, MAX(EAD_DOCUMENT_DTE) AS EMR_RECENT_DATE FROM IDB.EMR_AA_DOCUMENT JOIN DT DT ON DT.MRN = EAD_MRN JOIN IDB.EMR_AA_DOCTYPE ON EADT_DOCTYPE = EAD_DOCTYPE GROUP BY EAD_MRN) SELECT DT.MRN, PATH_PID , PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_BIRTH_DTE, PT_VITAL_STATUS, PT_DEATH_DTE , "Current Age" , "Accession No" , "Report Date" , "Procedure Date" , RELATED_ACC_NO , RELATED_PROC_DTE , "Report Type" , PRPT_REPORT_TYPE , DIAGNOSIS_TEXT , TARGET_EXTRACT , "Report Text (first 32000 characters)" , EMR_RECENT_DATE , CDD_DOC_NAME AS "ClinDoc Document Name", CDD_SERVICE_DTE AS "Service Date" , "Target Sentence/s" , "ClinDoc Full Report Text" , LAB_PARSED_NUMERIC_RESULT , LAB_PERFORMED_DATE , LAB_PERFORMED_TIME , LAB_TEST_NAME , LAB_SUBTEST_NAME , LAB_TEST_RESULT_VALUE , PATH_RPT_DATE AS "Recent Report Date", PRPT_ACCESSION_NO AS "Accession No", GENE, LOCUS, AA_CHANGE, NUCLEOTIDE, METHOD, ABERRATIONTYPE FROM PATH_PRE PP JOIN DT DT ON DT.MRN = PP.MRN LEFT JOIN EMR ON EAD_MRN = PP.MRN LEFT JOIN CLINDOC_INFO CD ON CDD_MRN = PP.MRN AND CD.DESCRN = 1 LEFT JOIN LAB_INFO LABS ON LAB_MRN = PP.MRN AND LABS.DESCRN = 1 LEFT JOIN GENE_INFO GENE ON GENE_MRN = PP.MRN AND GENE.DESCRN = 1 ORDER BY MRN, "Report Date", "Procedure Date"

prompt: I am requesting a list of all patients who were diagnosed with urachal carcinoma or bladder adenocarcinoma and had either a partial or radical cystectomy.
completion: SELECT DISTINCT "t1"."PT_MRN" AS "MRN", "t2"."ICSC_SITE_CD" AS "ICD-O Site Code", "t2"."ICSC_ICDO_SITE_MSK_DESC" AS "ICD-O Site Description", "t3"."DT_YEAR" AS "Tumor Diagnosis Year", "t4"."CDTM_CA_SURG_YEAR" AS "Tumor Surgery Year", "t5"."DXCC_ICD_CODE" AS "ICD-O Histology Code", "t5"."DXCC_ICD_MSK_DESC" AS "ICD-O Histology Description", PCC_CODE "CPT Code", PCC_CODE_DESC "CPT Desc", D1.DT_DTE "CPT Date" FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS" "t1" LEFT JOIN "DV"."CDB_TUMOR_V" "t4" ON "t1"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t4"."CDTM_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."ICDO_SITE_CATALOG_V" "t2" ON "t4"."CDTM_SITE_CATALOG_ID" = "t2"."ICSC_SITE_CATALOG_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" "t3" ON "t4"."CDTM_DX_DATE_ID" = "t3"."DT_DATE_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DIAGNOSIS_CODE_CAT_ICDO_V" "t5" ON "t4"."CDTM_DX_CATALOG_ID" = "t5"."DXCC_DX_CATALOG_ID" LEFT JOIN DV.CPT_PBD_PATIENT_PROCEDURE ON PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PTX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID AND PCC_CODE IN ('51550', '51555', '51565', '51570', '51575', '51590', '51595', '51596', '51565', '51590') LEFT JOIN DV.DATE_V D1 ON PTX_PROC_DATE_ID=D1.DT_DATE_ID WHERE (("t2"."ICSC_SITE_CD" IN ('C677') OR ("t2"."ICSC_SITE_CD" IN ('C670', 'C671', 'C672', 'C673', 'C674', 'C675', 'C678', 'C679') AND "t5"."DXCC_ICD_CODE" IN ('M8140/3', 'M8140/2', 'M8260/3', 'M8480/3'))) AND "t3"."DT_YEAR" BETWEEN 1995 AND 2018)

prompt: list of protocol patients who are alive as of their last visit at MSK
completion: SELECT PLA_LST_APPT_DTE AS LAST_VISIT, PT_DATE_OF_DEATH, COUNT(ACD_MRN) AS PATIENT_COUNT FROM IDB.ACCRUALS_DATES JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON ACD_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY ON ACD_MRN = PLA_MRN WHERE 1 =1 AND ACD_IRB_NO = '94-018' GROUP BY PT_DATE_OF_DEATH, PLA_LST_APPT_DTE ; SELECT ACD_MRN AS MRN, TRIM(PT_LAST_NAME) || ', ' || TRIM(PT_FIRST_NAME) PATIENT_NAME, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, PT_DATE_OF_DEATH, PLA_LST_APPT_DTE AS LAST_APPT_DTE, ACD_TX_ST_DTE AS TX_START_DTE, ACD_TX_END_DTE AS TX_END_DTE, ACD_CONS_DTE AS CONSENT_DTE FROM IDB.ACCRUALS_DATES JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON ACD_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY ON ACD_MRN = PLA_MRN WHERE ACD_IRB_NO = '03-077'; SELECT ACD_MRN AS MRN, TRIM(PT_LAST_NAME) || ', ' || TRIM(PT_FIRST_NAME) PATIENT_NAME, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, PT_DATE_OF_DEATH, PLA_LST_APPT_DTE AS LAST_APPT_DTE, ACD_TX_ST_DTE AS TX_START_DTE, ACD_TX_END_DTE AS TX_END_DTE, ACD_CONS_DTE AS CONSENT_DTE FROM IDB.ACCRUALS_DATES JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON ACD_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY ON ACD_MRN = PLA_MRN WHERE ACD_IRB_NO = '12-230'; SELECT ACD_MRN AS MRN, TRIM(PT_LAST_NAME) || ', ' || TRIM(PT_FIRST_NAME) PATIENT_NAME, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, PT_DATE_OF_DEATH, PLA_LST_APPT_DTE AS LAST_APPT_DTE, ACD_TX_ST_DTE AS TX_START_DTE, ACD_TX_END_DTE AS TX_END_DTE, ACD_CONS_DTE AS CONSENT_DTE FROM IDB.ACCRUALS_DATES JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON ACD_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY ON ACD_MRN = PLA_MRN WHERE ACD_IRB_NO = '16-1643'; SELECT ACD_MRN AS MRN, TRIM(PT_LAST_NAME) || ', ' || TRIM(PT_FIRST_NAME) PATIENT_NAME, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, PT_DATE_OF_DEATH, PLA_LST_APPT_DTE AS LAST_APPT_DTE, ACD_TX_ST_DTE AS TX_START_DTE, ACD_TX_END_DTE AS TX_END_DTE, ACD_CONS_DTE AS CONSENT_DTE FROM IDB.ACCRUALS_DATES JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON ACD_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY ON ACD_MRN = PLA_MRN WHERE ACD_IRB_NO = '13-260';

prompt: Create a report of endometrial cancer patients who had procedures in the OR with Dr. Chi in 2004.
completion: SELECT DISTINCT GS_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, GS_SURG_DTE FROM IDB.GYN_PRIMARY INNER JOIN IDB.GYN_SURGERY ON GS_MRN = GP_MRN INNER JOIN IDB.GYN_GENERAL ON GS_MRN = GG_MRN INNER JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE ON SSP_LOG_ID = GS_SURG_CASE_NO INNER JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON GP_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE GP_SITE_CD IN ('C541', 'C543', 'C549', 'C559') AND YEAR(GS_SURG_DTE) = 2004 AND GP_DX_DTE <= GS_SURG_DTE AND SSP_SURG_LAST_NM = 'CHI' AND SSP_SURG_FIRST_NM = 'DENNIS'

prompt: Surgical times for the patients treated with protocol procedure.
completion: WITH CTE AS (SELECT DISTINCT AC_MRN FROM IDB.ACCRUALS WHERE AC_IRB_NO = '17-070' ) SELECT DISTINCT SSE_MRN "MRN", SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD "CPT Code", SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC "CPT Descritpion", SSE_SURG_DTE "Surgery Date", TIME(SSE_PT_IN_DT) "Patient In Time", TIME(SSE_SURG_STRT_DT) "Surgery Start Time", TIME(SSE_SURG_END_DT) "Surgery End Time", TIME(SSE_PT_OUT_DT) "Patient Out Time" FROM IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE ON SSE_LOG_ID = SSP_LOG_ID AND SSE_ENC_CSN_ID = SSP_ENC_CSN_ID JOIN CTE ON SSE_MRN = AC_MRN WHERE SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD = '55899' ORDER BY 1, 3

prompt: Provide a list of any protocol open to pediatric patients (in pediatrics or another department) open at any time in 2019 and accrual summary to therapeutic protocols in 2019
completion: SELECT PRO_IRB_NO "IRB", PRO_AMND_NO "Amendment Number", PRO_IRB_TITLE "Title", PRO_IRB_STS_DESC "Status", PRO_IRB_STS_DTE "Status Date", PRO_PROTO_PHASE "Phase", PRO_PROTOCOL_TYPE "Type", PRO_OPEN_DTE "Open Date", PRO_CLOSE_ACCR_DTE "Closed to Accrual Date", PRO_CLOSE_PROT_DTE "Closed Date", PRO_MIN_AGE "Min Age", PRO_MAX_AGE "Max Age", PRO_CHILDREN_FLAG "Children Flag", PRO_INVST_DVCE_TST "Investigational Device", PRO_INVST_DRGS_TST "Investigational Drug", PRO_SPON_NAME "PI", PRO_SPON_DPT_NAME "Department", PRO_PTS_PLND "Patients Planned", PRO_PTS_ACCRD "Patients Accrued" FROM IDB.PROTOCOL JOIN NN.SV_PCL_MGMT_MGMTGROUP ON PRO_IRB_NO = PROTOCOL_NO WHERE 1=1 AND ((MGMT_GROUP_DESCRIPTION like 'Pediatrics%' AND PRIMARY = 'Y') OR (PRO_CHILDREN_FLAG ='Y') OR (PRO_PROTOCOL_TYPE IN ('Therapeutic', 'Therapeutic/QOL') AND PRO_MIN_AGE < 18)) AND COALESCE(PRO_CLOSE_PROT_DTE, CURRENT date) >= '2019-01-01' AND PRO_PROTOCOL_TYPE IN ('Therapeutic', 'Therapeutic/QOL') WITH PTS_R AS (SELECT PT_MRN, PT_BIRTH_DTE FROM DVCMS.COHORT_PATIENT JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON CHP_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID WHERE CHP_COHORT_ID = 230 ) , PTS AS (SELECT * FROM PTS_R WHERE PT_MRN='35549893' ) , X1 AS (SELECT DISTINCT ST.SUBJECT_MRN, ST.PROTOCOL_NO, PRO_SPON_DPT_NAME, PRO_PROTOCOL_TYPE, ARM_CODE, PT_BIRTH_DTE, VARCHAR_FORMAT(SIGNED_DATE, 'MM/DD/YYYY') SIGNED_DATE, SC.DESCRIPTION, ON_TREATMENT_DATE, OFF_TREATMENTDATE, TRIM(LAST_NAME)||', '||TRIM(FIRST_NAME) AS CONSENTING_PROFESSIONAL FROM PTS JOIN NN.SV_SUB_TREATMENT ST ON PT_MRN = ST.SUBJECT_MRN JOIN NN.SV_SUB_CONSENT SC ON ST.PROTOCOL_NO = SC.PROTOCOL_NO AND ST.SUBJECT_MRN = SC.SUBJECT_MRN LEFT JOIN NN.SV_SUB_FOLLOWUP SF ON ST.PROTOCOL_NO = SF.PROTOCOL_NO AND ST.SUBJECT_MRN = SF.SUBJECT_MRN JOIN DV.PROTOCOL ON ST.PROTOCOL_NO = PRO_IRB_NO LEFT JOIN NN.SV_SUBJ_TREATING_STAFF TSTAFF ON ST.PROTOCOL_SUBJECT_ID = TSTAFF.PROTOCOL_SUBJECT_ID AND STAFF_ROLE = 'Consenting Professional' WHERE STATUS = 'ACCEPTED' AND PRO_PROTOCOL_TYPE IN ('Therapeutic', 'Therapeutic/QOL') AND PRO_SPON_DPT_NAME not like 'Ped%' AND SIGNED_DATE >= '2019-01-01' ) SELECT * FROM X1; , X AS (SELECT SUBJECT_MRN, PROTOCOL_NO, ARM_CODE, SIGNED_DATE, DESCRIPTION, ON_TREATMENT_DATE, OFF_TREATMENTDATE, YEAR(SIGNED_DATE-PT_BIRTH_DTE) "Age at consent", CONSENTING_PROFESSIONAL, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY SUBJECT_MRN, PROTOCOL_NO, ARM_CODE ORDER BY SIGNED_DATE) RN FROM X1) , CLEANUP AS (SELECT AC_MRN, AC_IRB_NO, ACD_TX_ST_DTE, ACD_TX_END_DTE, AC_CONS_STAFF_NAME, AC_CONS_DTE, ACD_REG_DTE, ACD_OFF_STUDY_DTE, AC_PVDR_OF_RECORD_NAME FROM X LEFT JOIN IDB.ACCRUALS ON SUBJECT_MRN = AC_MRN AND PROTOCOL_NO = AC_IRB_NO LEFT JOIN IDB.ACCRUALS_DATES ON SUBJECT_MRN = ACD_MRN AND PROTOCOL_NO = ACD_IRB_NO WHERE COALESCE(AC_MRN, ACD_MRN) IS NOT NULL ) , PEDS AS (SELECT TRIM(X.SUBJECT_MRN) "MRN", TRIM(PT_LAST_NAME) "Last Name", TRIM(PT_FIRST_NAME) "First Name", TRIM(X.PROTOCOL_NO) "Protocol", PRO_PROTOCOL_TYPE "Protocol Type", TRIM(X.ARM_CODE) "Arm", CASE WHEN RN = 1 THEN COALESCE(DATE(X.SIGNED_DATE), AC_CONS_DTE) END "Consent Date", DESCRIPTION "Consent Description", TRIM(COALESCE(CONSENTING_PROFESSIONAL, AC_CONS_STAFF_NAME)) "Consenting Professional", AC_PVDR_OF_RECORD_NAME "Provider Name", ACD_REG_DTE "Registration Date", COALESCE(ON_TREATMENT_DATE, ACD_TX_ST_DTE) "On Treatment", COALESCE(OFF_TREATMENTDATE, ACD_TX_END_DTE) "Off Treatment", ACD_OFF_STUDY_DTE "Off Study Date" FROM X X JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON X.SUBJECT_MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN CLEANUP C ON X.SUBJECT_MRN = C.AC_MRN AND X.PROTOCOL_NO = C.AC_IRB_NO WHERE RN = 1 ) ; SELECT DISTINCT ST.SUBJECT_MRN, ST.PROTOCOL_NO, PRO_SPON_DPT_NAME, PRO_PROTOCOL_TYPE, ARM_CODE, VARCHAR_FORMAT(SIGNED_DATE, 'MM/DD/YYYY') SIGNED_DATE, SC.DESCRIPTION, ON_TREATMENT_DATE, OFF_TREATMENTDATE, TRIM(LAST_NAME)||', '||TRIM(FIRST_NAME) AS CONSENTING_PROFESSIONAL FROM NN.SV_SUB_TREATMENT ST JOIN NN.SV_SUB_CONSENT SC ON ST.PROTOCOL_NO = SC.PROTOCOL_NO AND ST.SUBJECT_MRN = SC.SUBJECT_MRN LEFT JOIN NN.SV_SUB_FOLLOWUP SF ON ST.PROTOCOL_NO = SF.PROTOCOL_NO AND ST.SUBJECT_MRN = SF.SUBJECT_MRN JOIN NN.SV_PCL_MGMT_MGMTGROUP M ON ST.PROTOCOL_NO = M.PROTOCOL_NO JOIN DV.PROTOCOL ON ST.PROTOCOL_NO = PRO_IRB_NO LEFT JOIN NN.SV_SUBJ_TREATING_STAFF TSTAFF ON ST.PROTOCOL_SUBJECT_ID = TSTAFF.PROTOCOL_SUBJECT_ID AND STAFF_ROLE = 'Consenting Professional' WHERE STATUS = 'ACCEPTED' AND MGMT_GROUP_DESCRIPTION like 'Ped%' AND PRIMARY = 'Y' AND SIGNED_DATE >= '2019-01-01' AND PRO_PROTOCOL_TYPE IN ('Therapeutic', 'Therapeutic/QOL') AND ST.SUBJECT_MRN='35549893'

prompt: Provide daily list of transplant/CAR patients with COVID positive results.
completion: WITH BMT AS (SELECT DISTINCT CBM_MRN AS "MRN", 'BMT' AS "Patient type" FROM IDB.CRDB_BMT_MEDICINE UNION SELECT DISTINCT CBP_MRN AS "MRN", 'BMT' AS "Patient type" FROM IDB.CRDB_BMT_PEDIATRICS) , CART AS (SELECT DISTINCT CDD_MRN MRN, 'CAR-T' AS "Patient type" FROM IDB.CD_DOCUMENT JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION ON CDD_MRN = CDO_MRN AND CDD_DOC_GUID = CDO_DOC_GUID AND CDD_AUTHORED_DTE = CDO_AUTHORED_DTE WHERE CDD_DOC_NAME IN ('Cell Infusion - BMT') AND CDD_CANCEL_IND <> '1' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND <> '1' AND CDO_ITEM_NAME = 'BMT_Cell INF_PI_Cell Source RES' AND CDO_VALUE_TEXT = 'Chimeric Antigen Receptor (CAR)' ) , MRN_LIST AS (SELECT COALESCE(BMT.MRN, CART.MRN) AS "MRN", CONCAT(IFNULL(BMT."Patient type", ''), IFNULL(CART."Patient type", '')) AS "Patient type" FROM BMT FULL OUTER JOIN CART ON BMT.MRN = CART.MRN) , VISIT AS (SELECT VIS_MRN, VIS_ADM_NUM, VIS_ADM_DTE, VIS_DSCH_DTE, VIS_PATIENT_TYPE, VIS_HOSP_SVC, VIS_NURS_STA, ATN_DR_NAME, VIS_IP_OP_ADJUSTED_IND, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY VIS_MRN ORDER BY VIS_ADM_DTE DESC) AS RN FROM IDB.VISIT_V JOIN MRN_LIST ON MRN = VIS_MRN WHERE VIS_VISIT_STATUS IN ('2', '3') AND VIS_ATN_DR_NO <> '999998' AND VIS_PATIENT_TYPE IN ('OP', 'IP') ) , COVID AS (SELECT DISTINCT TRIM(CIV.MRN) "MRN", TRIM(LAST_NAME) || ', ' || TRIM(FIRST_NAME) "Name", DATE_OF_BIRTH "Date of Birth", DATE_OF_DEATH "Date of Death", RESULT "Result", MIN_IDENTIFIED_DT "Identified Date", MIN_RESULT_DT "Result Date", TRIM(POSITIVE_SOURCES) "Positive Source", TRIM(NEGATIVE_SOURCES) "Negative Source", TRIM(PENDING_SOURCES) "Pending Source", CASE WHEN UPPER(POSITIVE_SOURCES) LIKE '%ORDER_AND_RESULT%' AND RESULT IN ('Positive', 'Resolved') THEN 'MSK Lab' WHEN UPPER(POSITIVE_SOURCES) NOT LIKE '%ORDER_AND_RESULT%' AND RESULT IN ('Positive', 'Resolved') THEN 'Non-MSK Lab' END "Lab Flag", MAX_RESOLVED_PROBLEM_DT FROM IDB.PATIENT_COVID_INFO_V CIV WHERE RESULT IN ('Positive', 'Resolved') ) , PROTOCOL AS (SELECT PRO_IRB_NO, PRO_IRB_TITLE, PRO_IRB_STS, PRO_PROTOCOL_TYPE, AC_MRN, AC_NON_MSK_INST, AC_LAST_NAME, AC_FIRST_NAME, AC_PVDR_OF_RECORD_NAME, ACD_REG_DTE, ACD_TX_ST_DTE, ACD_TX_END_DTE, ACD_OFF_STUDY_DTE, ACD_CONS_DTE FROM IDB.PROTOCOL JOIN IDB.ACCRUALS ON PRO_IRB_NO = AC_IRB_NO JOIN IDB.ACCRUALS_DATES ON AC_IRB_NO = ACD_IRB_NO AND AC_SUBJ_ID_NO = ACD_SUBJ_ID_NO AND AC_SUBJ_SEQ_NO = ACD_SUBJ_SEQ_NO WHERE ACD_OFF_STUDY_DTE IS NULL ) SELECT CIV."MRN", CIV."Name", PRO_IRB_NO "IRB Number", ACD_TX_ST_DTE "Protocol Start Date", PLA_LST_ADM_DTE "Last Admit Date", ATN_DR_NAME "Last Attending Doctor", VIS_IP_OP_ADJUSTED_IND AS "Inpatient/Outpatient", CIV."Result Date" AS "COVID-19 Result Date", CIV."Result", CIV.MAX_RESOLVED_PROBLEM_DT AS "Resolved date", CIV."Date of Birth", CIV."Date of Death", CASE WHEN UPPER(CIV."Positive Source") LIKE '%ORDER_AND_RESULT%' AND CIV."Result" IN ('Positive', 'Resolved') THEN 'MSK Lab' WHEN UPPER(CIV."Positive Source") NOT LIKE '%ORDER_AND_RESULT%' AND CIV."Result" IN ('Positive', 'Resolved') THEN 'Non-MSK Lab' END "Lab Flag", "Patient type" FROM MRN_LIST JOIN COVID CIV ON MRN_LIST.MRN = CIV.MRN LEFT JOIN PROTOCOL ON MRN_LIST.MRN = AC_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY ON MRN_LIST.MRN = PLA_MRN LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM VISIT WHERE RN = 1) ON MRN_LIST.MRN = VIS_MRN

prompt: "Providing Volume of Patients Referred to Rehab from RLC"
completion: SELECT OO_MRN MRN, PT_LAST_NAME LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME FIRST_NAME, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH DATE_OF_BIRTH, OO_ENTER_DTE REFERRED_DATE, OO_ORD_NAME TYPE_OF_THERAPY, DOC_NAME REFERRING_DOCTOR_NAME FROM IDB.OMS_ORDER JOIN IDB.DOC ON OO_REQ_DR_NO = DOC_DR_NO JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON OO_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE OO_ORD_NAME IN ('Physical Therapy Outpatient Consult', 'Occupational Therapy Outpatient Consult', 'Lymphedema Therapy Outpatient Consult') AND OO_ORD_STS_CD NOT IN ('CANP', 'CANC', 'AUC3') AND OO_ENTER_DTE BETWEEN '2020-01-01' AND '2021-12-31' AND TRIM(DOC_NAME) IN ('NOUVINI MD,ROSA', 'KILLORAN MD,KATHLEEN A', 'GODFREY MD,HENRY', 'KAMPEL MD,LEWIS J.')

prompt: Counts and percentage  with HCP on file of alive adult patients with attended visits within the past 2 years.
completion: WITH ALLPTS AS (SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN AS MRN, CASE WHEN EPDA_MRN IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END HCP FROM IDB.PATIENT JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY ON PT_MRN = PLA_MRN JOIN IDB.PT_FIRST_ACTIVITY ON PT_MRN = PFA_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.EMR_PT_DOC_AUTHV ON EPDA_MRN = PT_MRN AND EPDA_DOCTYPE = 'A20' WHERE PT_DATE_OF_DEATH IS NULL AND PLA_LST_APPT_DTE >= CURRENT date - 2 YEAR AND YEAR(PLA_LST_APPT_DTE) - YEAR(PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) >= 18 ) , PTS1 AS (SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN AS MRN1, CASE WHEN EPDA_MRN IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END HCP1 FROM IDB.PATIENT JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY ON PT_MRN = PLA_MRN JOIN IDB.PT_FIRST_ACTIVITY ON PT_MRN = PFA_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.EMR_PT_DOC_AUTHV ON EPDA_MRN = PT_MRN AND EPDA_DOCTYPE = 'A20' WHERE PT_DATE_OF_DEATH IS NULL AND PLA_LST_APPT_DTE >= CURRENT date - 2 YEAR AND PFA_FST_APPT_DTE = PLA_LST_APPT_DTE AND YEAR(PLA_LST_APPT_DTE) - YEAR(PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) >= 18 ) , PTS2 AS (SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN AS MRN2, CASE WHEN EPDA_MRN IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END HCP2 FROM IDB.PATIENT JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY ON PT_MRN = PLA_MRN JOIN IDB.PT_FIRST_ACTIVITY ON PT_MRN = PFA_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.EMR_PT_DOC_AUTHV ON EPDA_MRN = PT_MRN AND EPDA_DOCTYPE = 'A20' WHERE PT_DATE_OF_DEATH IS NULL AND PLA_LST_APPT_DTE >= CURRENT date - 2 YEAR AND PFA_FST_APPT_DTE <> PLA_LST_APPT_DTE AND YEAR(PLA_LST_APPT_DTE) - YEAR(PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) >= 18 ) SELECT T0.*, T1.*, T2.* FROM (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT MRN) "All Patients" , SUM(HCP) "All HCP Patients", SUM(HCP) *1.00/COUNT(DISTINCT MRN)*100.00 "PCT of HCP from All Patients" FROM ALLPTS) AS T0, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT MRN1) "All Patients with 1 Vst" , SUM(HCP1) "HCP Patients with 1 VST", SUM(HCP1) *1.00/COUNT(DISTINCT MRN1)*100.00 "PCT of HCP Patients with 1 VST" FROM PTS1) AS T1, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT MRN2) "All Patients with 2 or More Vst" , SUM(HCP2) "HCP Patients with 2 or More VST", SUM(HCP2) *1.00/COUNT(DISTINCT MRN2)*100.00 "PCT of HCP Patients with 2 or More VST" FROM PTS2) AS T2 ;

prompt: List of all patients given Belumosudil between 2017-2022. Inpatient or as a home medication.
completion: SELECT DISTINCT HCPR_MRN, HCPR_PRESCRIPTION_ID RX_ID , HCPR_CREATED_DTE RX_CREATE_DATE , DATE(HCPR_START_DT) START_DATE , DATE(HCPR_END_DT) AS END_DATE , DATE(HCPR_DISCONTINUE_DT) AS DISCONTINUE_DATE , HCPR_DRUG_NAME AS DRUG_NAME , HGN_GENERIC_NAME AS GENERIC_NAME , HCPR_DOSE_AMT , HCPR_DOSE_UOM_ID , HCPR_ROUTE , HCPR_STATUS_TYPE_DESC AS PRESCRIPTION_STATUS , HCPR_PRESCRIPTION_TYPE_DESC AS RX_TYPE FROM IDB.HML_CLIENT_PRESCRIPTION LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_CLIENT_VISIT ON OCV_VISIT_GUID = HCPR_VISIT_GUID LEFT JOIN IDB.HML_GENERIC_NAME ON HGN_GENERIC_NAME_ID = HCPR_GENERIC_NAME_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_USER USR ON USR.OU_USER_GUID = HCPR_USER_GUID LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_USER REQ ON REQ.OU_USER_GUID = HCPR_CARE_PROV_GUID LEFT JOIN IDB.HML_RX_UNIT_OF_MEASURE UOM ON UOM.HRUM_RXUOM_ID = HCPR_DOSE_UOM_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.HML_RX_UNIT_OF_MEASURE PKG ON PKG.HRUM_RXUOM_ID = HCPR_INNER_PACKAGE_SIZE_UOM_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.HML_SCRIPT_FREQUENCY ON HSF_SCRIPT_FREQ_ID = HCPR_SCRIPT_FREQ_ID WHERE HCPR_STATUS_TYPE NOT IN (4, 5, 8) AND HCPR_CREATED_DTE IS NOT NULL AND((HCPR_PRESCRIPTION_TYPE = 1 AND HCPR_TRANSMISSION_STATUS IN (1, 2, 5) ) OR HCPR_PRESCRIPTION_TYPE = 3) AND (UPPER(HCPR_DRUG_NAME) LIKE '%BELUMOSUDIL%' OR UPPER(HGN_GENERIC_NAME) LIKE '%BELUMOSUDIL%' OR UPPER(HCPR_DRUG_NAME) LIKE '%REZURO%' OR UPPER(HGN_GENERIC_NAME) LIKE '%REZURO%') AND HCPR_CREATED_DTE BETWEEN '2017-01-01' AND '2022-12-31' ; SELECT DISTINCT HCPR_MRN, HCPR_PRESCRIPTION_ID RX_ID , HCPR_CREATED_DTE RX_CREATE_DATE , DATE(HCPR_START_DT) START_DATE , DATE(HCPR_END_DT) AS END_DATE , DATE(HCPR_DISCONTINUE_DT) AS DISCONTINUE_DATE , HCPR_DRUG_NAME AS DRUG_NAME , HGN_GENERIC_NAME AS GENERIC_NAME , HCPR_DOSE_AMT , HCPR_DOSE_UOM_ID , HCPR_ROUTE , HCPR_STATUS_TYPE_DESC AS PRESCRIPTION_STATUS , HCPR_PRESCRIPTION_TYPE_DESC AS RX_TYPE FROM IDB.HML_CLIENT_PRESCRIPTION LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_CLIENT_VISIT ON OCV_VISIT_GUID = HCPR_VISIT_GUID LEFT JOIN IDB.HML_GENERIC_NAME ON HGN_GENERIC_NAME_ID = HCPR_GENERIC_NAME_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_USER USR ON USR.OU_USER_GUID = HCPR_USER_GUID LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_USER REQ ON REQ.OU_USER_GUID = HCPR_CARE_PROV_GUID LEFT JOIN IDB.HML_RX_UNIT_OF_MEASURE UOM ON UOM.HRUM_RXUOM_ID = HCPR_DOSE_UOM_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.HML_RX_UNIT_OF_MEASURE PKG ON PKG.HRUM_RXUOM_ID = HCPR_INNER_PACKAGE_SIZE_UOM_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.HML_SCRIPT_FREQUENCY ON HSF_SCRIPT_FREQ_ID = HCPR_SCRIPT_FREQ_ID WHERE HCPR_STATUS_TYPE NOT IN (4, 5, 8) AND HCPR_CREATED_DTE IS NOT NULL AND((HCPR_PRESCRIPTION_TYPE = 1 AND HCPR_TRANSMISSION_STATUS IN (1, 2, 5) ) OR HCPR_PRESCRIPTION_TYPE = 3) AND (UPPER(HCPR_DRUG_NAME) LIKE '%RUXOLITINIB%' AND UPPER(HCPR_DRUG_NAME) LIKE '%IBRUTINIB%' AND UPPER(HCPR_DRUG_NAME) LIKE '%PREDNISONE%' AND UPPER(HCPR_DRUG_NAME) LIKE '%PREDNISOLONE%' AND UPPER(HCPR_DRUG_NAME) LIKE '%METHYLPREDNISONE%' AND UPPER(HCPR_DRUG_NAME) LIKE '%CORTISONE%' AND UPPER(HCPR_DRUG_NAME) LIKE '%HYDROCORTISONE%' OR UPPER(HGN_GENERIC_NAME) LIKE '%RUXOLITINIB%' OR UPPER(HGN_GENERIC_NAME) LIKE '%IBRUTINIB%' OR UPPER(HGN_GENERIC_NAME) LIKE '%PREDNISONE%' OR UPPER(HGN_GENERIC_NAME) LIKE '%PREDNISOLONE%' OR UPPER(HGN_GENERIC_NAME) LIKE '%METHYLPREDNISONE%' OR UPPER(HGN_GENERIC_NAME) LIKE '%CORTISONE%' OR UPPER(HGN_GENERIC_NAME) LIKE '%HYDROCORTISONE%') AND HCPR_CREATED_DTE BETWEEN '2017-01-01' AND '2022-12-31' ;

prompt: Provide the name and MRN of every patient diagnosed with adrenocortical carcinoma from 2009-2011.
completion: WITH CDB AS (SELECT PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID AS CDB_DEID, MIN(DT_DTE) AS "Tumor Diagnosis Date" FROM DV.PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED JOIN DV.CDB_TUMOR_V ON PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = CDTM_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID JOIN DV.DATE ON CDTM_DX_DATE_ID = DT_DATE_ID JOIN DV.DIAGNOSIS_CODE_CAT_ICDO_V ON CDTM_DX_CATALOG_ID = DXCC_DX_CATALOG_ID WHERE DXCC_ICD_CODE = 'M8370/3' AND DT_YEAR >= 2009 GROUP BY PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID), PATH AS (SELECT PRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID AS PATH_DEID, MIN(DT_DTE) AS "Min Path Date (with Search Term)" FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V JOIN DV.DATE ON PRPT_REPORT_DATE_ID = DT_DATE_ID WHERE DT_YEAR >= 2009 AND CONTAINS(PRPT_DEID_REPORT, '"adrenocortical" | "adrenal cortical"') <> 0 GROUP BY PRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID) SELECT PT_MRN AS "MRN", PT_LAST_NAME AS "Last Name", PT_FIRST_NAME AS "First Name", "Tumor Diagnosis Date", "Min Path Date (with Search Term)", PLA_LAST_APPT_DTE AS "Last Appointment Date" FROM DV.PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V ON PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID JOIN DV.PATIENT_LATEST_ACTIVITY ON PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PLA_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID LEFT JOIN CDB ON CDB_DEID = PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID LEFT JOIN PATH ON PATH_DEID = PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID WHERE COALESCE(CDB_DEID, PATH_DEID) IS NOT NULL ORDER BY PT_MRN

prompt: Provide daily list of patients that had the FIRST order placed in CIS the day prior for Lu177-PSMA treatment.
completion: WITH X AS (SELECT DISTINCT STRIP(OO_MRN) AS MRN, STRIP(OO_ORD_NAME) AS "Order Name", STRIP(OO_ORD_ID) AS "Order ID", OO_ENTER_DTE AS "Order Entered Date", ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY OO_MRN ORDER BY OO_ENTER_DTE) AS RN FROM IDB.OMS_ORDER WHERE 1=1 AND OO_ORD_STS_CD NOT IN ('CANC', 'CANP', 'AUC3') AND UPPER(OO_ORD_NAME) LIKE '%LU%177%PSMA%' ) , Y AS (SELECT DISTINCT X.* FROM X WHERE RN = 1 AND "Order Entered Date" = CURRENT date - 1 DAY ) , CPE1 AS (SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN, CPE_ENC_DTE, CRE_RES_NAME, CRE_RES_TYP, CLD_DEPT_NAME, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8, CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME FROM Y JOIN IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER ON CPE_MRN = MRN JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Sch') AND CRE_RES_TYP IN ('Physician') ) , CPE2 AS (SELECT CPE1.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CPE_MRN ORDER BY CPE_ENC_DTE) AS RN_CPE FROM CPE1) SELECT DISTINCT Y.*, CPE_ENC_DTE AS "Next Appt Date", STRIP(CRE_RES_NAME) AS "Physician Name", CLD_DEPT_NAME AS "Department", 1 AS X FROM Y LEFT JOIN CPE2 ON MRN = CPE_MRN AND RN_CPE = 1

prompt: Provide inpatient admission or death notification for patients with a ClinDoc note authored by Anastasia Zankowsky
completion: WITH PTS_AZ AS (SELECT DISTINCT CDD_MRN FROM IDB.CD_DOCUMENT LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_PROVIDER P1 ON CDD_AUTH_PROV_GUID = P1.OP_PVDR_GUID LEFT JOIN IDB.CD_DOCUMENT_HISTORY CDH1 ON CDD_DOC_GUID = CDH1.CDH_CLIENT_DOC_GUID AND CDD_CLIENT_GUID = CDH1.CDH_CLIENT_GUID LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_PROVIDER P2 ON CDH_USER_GUID = P2.OP_PVDR_GUID WHERE CDD_CANCEL_IND <> '1' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND <> '1' AND (P1.OP_DISPLAY_NAME = 'Zankowsky, Anastasia' OR P2.OP_DISPLAY_NAME = 'Zankowsky, Anastasia') ) , PTS AS (SELECT CDD_MRN, VIS_BED, 'Admitted' SOURCE FROM PTS_AZ JOIN IDB.VISIT_V ON CDD_MRN = VIS_MRN WHERE VIS_IP_OP_ADJUSTED_IND = 'I' AND VIS_VISIT_STATUS IN ('2') AND VIS_ADM_DTE >= CURRENT DATE - 1 DAYS UNION SELECT CDD_MRN, '' VIS_BED, 'Deceased' SOURCE FROM PTS_AZ JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON CDD_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE COALESCE(DATE(PT_DATE_OF_DEATH_UPD_DT), PT_DATE_OF_DEATH) >= CURRENT DATE - 1 DAYS ) SELECT PT_MRN "MRN", PT_LAST_NAME "Last Name", PT_FIRST_NAME "First Name", CHAR(PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) "DOB", CHAR(PT_DATE_OF_DEATH) "DOD", YEAR(CURRENT DATE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) "Current Age", SOURCE "Admitted/Deceased", VIS_BED "Bed", CHAR(TM_DX_DTE) "Tumor Dx Date", TM_SITE_CD AS "Tumor Site Code", S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS "Tumor Site Desc", TM_HIST_CD AS "Tumor Histology Code", H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS "Tumor Histology Desc" FROM PTS LEFT JOIN IDB.CDB_TUMOR ON CDD_MRN = TM_MRN AND TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') LEFT JOIN IDB.CLM H ON TM_HIST_CD = H.CLM_CLSF_CD LEFT JOIN IDB.CLM S ON TM_SITE_CD = S.CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON CDD_MRN = PT_MRN

prompt: will help justify expansion of the program and highlight areas where access is an issue. The report will help ensure we allocate proper resources.
completion: WITH NEW_OPTIME AS (SELECT DISTINCT SSE_MRN, SSE_SURG_DTE, SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD, SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC, SSP_LOG_ID, CASE WHEN SSE_PT_TYPE IN ('IP', 'IPOP') THEN 'I' ELSE 'O' END AS OPTIME_IPOP, CASE WHEN ARS_AN_CASELOG_ID IS NOT NULL THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END HAD_ANESTHESIA, CASE WHEN SSE_SURG_LOC = 'COMMACK IR' THEN 'CMK' WHEN SSE_SURG_LOC IN ('MONMOUTH IR 01', 'MONMOUTH OR 01', 'MONMOUTH OR 02') THEN 'MON' WHEN SSE_SURG_LOC = 'WESTCHESTER IR' THEN 'WES' ELSE 'MAIN' END AS SSE_SURG_LOC FROM IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE ON SSE_LOG_ID = SSP_LOG_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.AN_RECORD_SUMMARY ON ARS_AN_CASELOG_ID = SSE_LOG_ID WHERE 1=1 AND SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD IN ('38220', '38221', '38222') AND SSE_SURG_DTE BETWEEN '2012-01-01' AND CURRENT date ) SELECT * FROM NEW_OPTIME ORDER BY 1, 2, 3 ; WITH DOCS AS (SELECT DISTINCT B.DOC_NAME DOCS_NAME, A.DOC_DR_NO DOC_NO_PRIMARY, A.DOC_LICENSE, A.DOC_NAME DOC_NAME_PRIMARY, A.DOC_NPI, B.DOC_DR_NO DOC_NO, C.CRE_RES_NAME CRE_NAME, C.CRE_RES_ID CRE_ID, COALESCE(CASE WHEN A.DOC_ACDMC_SVC = '' THEN NULL ELSE A.DOC_ACDMC_SVC END, CASE WHEN B.DOC_ACDMC_SVC = '' THEN NULL ELSE B.DOC_ACDMC_SVC END) DOC_SERVICE FROM IDB.DOC A JOIN IDB.DOC B ON A.DOC_LICENSE = B.DOC_LICENSE LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE C ON B.DOC_DR_NO = C.CRE_RES_ID) , DOC_NAME AS (SELECT DOC_NPI, MIN(DOCS_NAME) PROVIDER FROM DOCS GROUP BY DOC_NPI) , PBD AS (SELECT DISTINCT PBD_MRN, PBD_SVC_DTE, PBC_CPT_CD, PBC_PBD_DESC, PBI_SVC_LOC, MAX(CASE WHEN A.AV_DESC = 'HEM-HEMATOLOGY GROUP' THEN 'HEM' WHEN A.AV_DESC = 'HEM-LEUKEMIA GROUP' THEN 'LEU' WHEN A.AV_DESC = 'HEM-LYMPHOMA GROUP' THEN 'LYM' WHEN A.AV_DESC = 'HEM-MYELOMA' THEN 'MYL' WHEN A.AV_DESC = 'HEM-TRANSPLANT GROUP' THEN 'BMT' WHEN A.AV_DESC = 'PEDIATRIC GROUP' THEN 'PED' WHEN DOC_SERVICE IN ('LYM', 'LYMPHOMA', 'HEMATOLOGY-LYMPHOMA', 'HEM-LYMHOMA GROUP', 'LYMPHOMA/MYELOMA GRN', 'HEM-LYMPHOMA/MYELOMA/TRANSPALNT') THEN 'LYM' WHEN DOC_SERVICE IN ('HEMATOLOGIC ONCOLOGY', 'HEMATOLOGY') THEN 'HEM' WHEN DOC_SERVICE IN ('LEUKEMIA', 'SLEEPY HOLLOW LEUKEMIA', 'LEULEMIA') THEN 'LEU' WHEN DOC_SERVICE IN ('MYELOMA', 'Myeloma/BMT') THEN 'MYL' WHEN DOC_SERVICE IN ('BMT', 'BMT/SCC', 'BONE MARROW TRANSPLANT', 'Myeloma/BMT') THEN 'BMT' WHEN DOC_SERVICE IN ('PEDIATRIC BMT', 'PEDIATRIC HEMATOLOGIC MALIGNAN', 'PEDIATRIC NEUROBLASTOMA', 'PEDIATRIC NEURO-ONCOLOGY', 'PEDIATRIC SARCOMA', 'PEDIATRIC STEM CELL TRANSPLANT', 'PEDIATRIC SURGICAL', 'PEDIATRICS') THEN 'PED' WHEN DOC_SERVICE IN ('INTERVENTIONAL RADIOLOGY') THEN 'IR' ELSE 'Other' END) AS BILLING_AREA, B.AV_DESC LOC, PBI_PERFORM_DR_NO, DOC_NPI, DOC_NO_PRIMARY DOC_DR_NO, DOC_NAME_PRIMARY DOC_NAME FROM IDB.PBD_DTL JOIN IDB.PBD_CODE ON PBD_PBD_CD = PBC_PBD_CD JOIN IDB.PBD_INVOICE ON PBD_INV_NO = PBI_INV_NO JOIN IDB.CLM ON CLM_CLSF_CD = PBC_CPT_CD LEFT JOIN DOCS ON PBI_PERFORM_DR_NO = DOC_NO_PRIMARY LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS A ON A.AV_ELEMENT = 'BILLING_AREA' AND A.AV_CODE = PBI_BILLING_AREA LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS B ON B.AV_ELEMENT = 'SVC_LOC' AND B.AV_CODE = PBI_SVC_LOC WHERE 1=1 AND PBC_CPT_CD IN ('38220', '38221', '38222') AND PBD_SVC_DTE BETWEEN '2012-01-01' AND CURRENT date GROUP BY PBD_MRN, PBD_SVC_DTE, PBC_CPT_CD, PBC_PBD_DESC, PBI_SVC_LOC, B.AV_DESC, PBI_PERFORM_DR_NO, DOC_NPI, DOC_NO_PRIMARY, DOC_NAME_PRIMARY) , OPTIME AS (SELECT DISTINCT SSE_MRN, PBD_SVC_DTE OPTIME_PBD_SVC_DTE, PBC_CPT_CD OPTIME_PBC_CPT_CD, SSE_SURG_DTE, SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD, SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC, SSP_LOG_ID, CASE WHEN SSE_PT_TYPE IN ('IP', 'IPOP') THEN 'I' ELSE 'O' END AS OPTIME_IPOP, CASE WHEN ARS_AN_CASELOG_ID IS NOT NULL THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END HAD_ANESTHESIA, CASE WHEN SSE_SURG_LOC = 'COMMACK IR' THEN 'CMK' WHEN SSE_SURG_LOC IN ('MONMOUTH IR 01', 'MONMOUTH OR 01', 'MONMOUTH OR 02') THEN 'MON' WHEN SSE_SURG_LOC = 'WESTCHESTER IR' THEN 'WES' ELSE 'MAIN' END AS SSE_SURG_LOC FROM PBD JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT ON PBD_MRN = SSE_MRN AND PBD_SVC_DTE = SSE_SURG_DTE JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE ON SSE_LOG_ID = SSP_LOG_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.AN_RECORD_SUMMARY ON ARS_AN_CASELOG_ID = SSE_LOG_ID) , INPT AS (SELECT DISTINCT VIS_MRN, PBD_SVC_DTE AS IP_SVC_DTE, PBC_CPT_CD IP_PBC_CPT_CD, VIS_IP_OP_ADJUSTED_IND, VIS_HOSP_SVC, VIS_NURS_STA, 'MAIN' AS INPT_LOC FROM PBD JOIN IDB.VISIT ON PBD_MRN = VIS_MRN AND VIS_VISIT_STATUS IN ('2', '3') AND VIS_ADM_DTE <= PBD_SVC_DTE AND COALESCE(VIS_DSCH_DTE, '2999-12-31') >= PBD_SVC_DTE AND VIS_IP_OP_ADJUSTED_IND = 'I') , OP_APPTS AS (SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN, PBD_SVC_DTE AS OP_SVC_DTE, PBC_CPT_CD OP_PBC_CPT_CD, CPE_ENC_DTE, CLD_CLD_CENTER, 'O' AS APPT_IP_OP_IND, A.DOC_NAME, B.DOC_NAME_PRIMARY, A.DOC_DR_NO, B.DOC_NO_PRIMARY, CRE_ID FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN DOCS B ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID JOIN PBD A ON PBD_MRN = CPE_MRN AND PBD_SVC_DTE = CPE_ENC_DTE AND B.DOC_NO_PRIMARY = A.DOC_DR_NO WHERE 1=1 AND CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') ) SELECT * FROM OP_APPTS ORDER BY 1, 2, 3, 4 ;

prompt: Create a report of patients with DLBCL who were also either HIV antibody positive, HIV viral load positive, or have an ICD10 code for HIV.
completion: WITH LYM AS (SELECT DISTINCT TM_MRN AS MRN, TM_DX_DTE AS DX_DATE, TM_HIST_CD AS DX_CODE, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS DX_DESC FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.SEERGROUPING ON RECODE = IDB.SEERF_ICDO(TM_SITE_CD, TM_HIST_CD) AND CATEGORY1 = 'Lymphoma' JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD WHERE 1=1 AND TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND TM_HIST_CD IN ('M9679/3', 'M9680/3', 'M9681/3', 'M9688/3', 'M9714/3', 'M9738/3') UNION SELECT CC_MRN AS MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS DX_DATE, CLM_CLSF_CD AS DX_CODE, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS DX_DESC FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND ((CC_PT_TYPE = 'I') OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) AND CC_CLSF_CD IN ('C83.30', 'C83.31', 'C83.32', 'C83.33', 'C83.34', 'C83.35', 'C83.36', 'C83.37', 'C83.38', 'C83.39') GROUP BY CC_MRN, CLM_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK ) , CTE AS (SELECT MRN AS DX_MRN, DX_DATE, STRIP(DX_CODE) || ' - ' || STRIP(DX_DESC) AS DX_CODE FROM LYM) , CTE2 AS (SELECT * FROM CTE ORDER BY DX_MRN, DX_DATE, DX_CODE) , T1 AS (SELECT DX_MRN, DX_DATE, DX_CODE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY DX_MRN ORDER BY DX_DATE) AS RN FROM CTE2 ORDER BY DX_MRN, DX_DATE) , T2 (MRN, DX, RN1) AS (SELECT DX_MRN, CAST(DX_DATE AS VARCHAR(6000))||' | '||CAST(DX_CODE AS VARCHAR(100)), RN FROM T1 WHERE T1.RN = 1 UNION ALL SELECT DX_MRN, RTRIM(CAST(DX AS VARCHAR(4000))) || ', ' || CHR(13) || CHR(10) || CAST(DX_DATE AS VARCHAR(100))||' | '||RTRIM(CAST(DX_CODE AS VARCHAR(100))) , RN1 + 1 FROM T1, T2 WHERE DX_MRN = MRN AND RN = RN1+1 ) , T3 AS (SELECT MRN, MAX(RN1) RN FROM T2 GROUP BY MRN) , T4 AS (SELECT T2.MRN, RN, DX FROM T2 JOIN T3 ON T2.MRN = T3.MRN AND T2.RN1 = T3.RN) SELECT LR_MRN AS MRN, DX, LR_PERFORMED_DTE AS PERFORMED_DTE, LR_TEST_NAME AS TEST_NAME, LR_SUBTEST_NAME AS SUBTEST_NAME, LR_RESULT_VALUE, LR_UNIT_MEASURE, STRIP(LTL_TEXT_RESULT) AS TEXT_RESULT FROM T4 JOIN IDB.LAB_RESULTS ON MRN = LR_MRN JOIN IDB.LAB_TEXT_LINE ON LTL_RESULT_GUID = LR_RESULT_GUID WHERE(LR_SUBTEST_NAME LIKE '%HIV%' OR LR_TEST_NAME LIKE '%HIV%') AND((UPPER(LR_RESULT_VALUE) LIKE '%POSITIVE%' OR UPPER(LTL_TEXT_RESULT) LIKE '%POSITIVE%') OR (LR_RESULT_VALUE <> '' AND LR_RESULT_VALUE NOT IN ('TNP', 'REJECT**', 'REJECT', 'K103KN**', 'DNR'))) , CC AS (SELECT CC_MRN AS MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS HIV_DATE, CLM_CLSF_CD AS HIV_CODE, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS HIV_DESC FROM T4 JOIN IDB.CTC_CLSF ON CC_MRN = MRN JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND ((CC_PT_TYPE = 'I') OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) AND CC_CLSF_CD IN ('B20', 'B97.35', 'R75', 'Z21', '042', '042.0', '042.1', '042.2', '042.9', '043.0', '043.1', '043.2', '043.3', '043.9', '044.0', '044.9', '079.53', '279.10', '279.19', '795.71', '795.8', 'V08') GROUP BY CC_MRN, CLM_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK ) , CC2 AS (SELECT MRN, LISTAGG(COALESCE(STRIP(CAST(HIV_DATE AS VARCHAR(12000))), '') || ' | ' || COALESCE(STRIP(HIV_CODE), '') || ' - ' || COALESCE(STRIP(CAST(HIV_DESC AS VARCHAR(12000))), '') , CHR(13) || CHR(10)) WITHIN GROUP( ORDER BY MRN, HIV_DATE, HIV_CODE, HIV_DESC) AS HIV FROM CC GROUP BY MRN) SELECT T4.MRN, T4.DX, HIV FROM T4 JOIN CC2 ON T4.MRN = CC2.MRN SELECT CDD_MRN, DX, CDD_DOC_GUID, CDD_SERVICE_DTE, CDD_DOC_NAME, CDO_SECTION, CDO_CTLG_DISPL_NM, CDO_ITEM_NAME, CDO_VALUE_TEXT FROM T4 JOIN IDB.CD_DOCUMENT ON CDD_MRN = T4.MRN JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION ON CDO_DOC_GUID = CDD_DOC_GUID AND CDO_AUTHORED_DTE = CDD_AUTHORED_DTE WHERE CDD_CANCEL_IND = '0' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND = '0' AND(CDO_SECTION LIKE '%HIV%' OR CDO_CTLG_DISPL_NM LIKE '%HIV%' OR CDO_ITEM_NAME LIKE '%HIV%') AND UPPER(CDO_VALUE_TEXT) LIKE '%POSITIVE%'

prompt: Provide a monthly report of patients referred to see General Internal Medicine (GIM) for reasons/comments "Study 23-274".  We are looking for whom the patients are scheduled with in GIM (specific Providers) (Dr. Adrienne Vincenzino, Dr. Shellie Gumbs and Dr. Amsale Ketema) and appointment details.
completion: WITH PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS AS (SELECT PT_MRN, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_CITY, PT_STATE, OO_ORD_STS_CD, OO_ORD_GUID, OO_ENTER_DTE AS ORDER_PLACEMENT_DATE, OO_ORD_NAME, OS_SVC_GRP_CD, OS_SVC_DESC, LGR_AMB_LOCATION, MAX(CASE WHEN OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'Consult_Medicine OP_Telehealth' THEN SUBSTR(OUD_USER_DI_VALUE, 1, 255) END) VISIT_REQUESTED, MAX(CASE WHEN OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'Consult_Medicine OP_Telehealth Y/N' THEN SUBSTR(OUD_USER_DI_VALUE, 1, 255) END) VISIT_REQUESTED_YN, MAX(CASE WHEN OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'Instructions_Spl' THEN SUBSTR(OUD_USER_DI_VALUE, 1, 255) END) ADDITIONAL_INFORMATION, ROW_NUMBER () OVER (PARTITION BY PT_MRN ORDER BY OO_ENTER_DTE DESC, OO_ORD_STS_CD, OO_ORD_GUID) AS ROW_NUMBERS FROM IDB.PATIENT JOIN IDB.OMS_ORDER ON PT_MRN = OO_MRN JOIN IDB.OMS_CLIENT_VISIT ON OO_VISIT_GUID = OCV_VISIT_GUID LEFT JOIN IDB.LOCATION_GROUPS_REFERENCE ON OCV_CURR_LOC_GUID = LGR_LOC_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_SERVICE ON OS_SVC_GUID = OCV_SVC_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_USER_DATA ON OO_ORD_GUID = OUD_ORD_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_CATALOG ON OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID = OOC_MSTR_ITEM_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_STATUS ON OO_ORD_STS_CD = OSTS_ORD_STS_CD WHERE 1 = 1 AND OO_ENTER_DTE >= CURRENT DATE - 6 MONTH AND UPPER(OOC_ITEM_NAME) LIKE '%CONSULT%' AND OO_ORD_NAME = 'General Internal Medicine Outpatient Consult' GROUP BY PT_MRN, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_CITY, PT_STATE, OO_ORD_STS_CD, OO_ENTER_DTE, OO_ORD_NAME, OO_ORD_GUID, OS_SVC_GRP_CD, OS_SVC_DESC, LGR_AMB_LOCATION) , VISITS AS (SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_CITY, PT_STATE, OO_ORD_STS_CD, OO_ORD_GUID, OS_SVC_GRP_CD, OS_SVC_DESC, ORDER_PLACEMENT_DATE, OO_ORD_NAME, VISIT_REQUESTED, ADDITIONAL_INFORMATION, CPE_APPT_MADE_DTE AS APPT_MADE_DTE, CPE_ENC_DTE AS APPT_DATE, CPE_CPE_APPT_STS, VD.CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 AS REF_SERVICE, VD.CLD_DEPT_ID AS DEP_NAME, VD.CLD_DEPT_NAME AS DEP_NAME1, LOC.CLD_CLD_CENTER AS SITE, CPE_VST_RES_ID AS PROV_ID, VT.CRE_RES_NAME AS PROV_NAME, VT1.CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID AS VST_ID, VT1.CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME AS VT_NAME, CPE_REF_RES_ID AS INT_REF_PROV_ID, CPE_REF_DEP_ID, LGR_AMB_LOCATION, REF.CRE_RES_NAME AS INT_REF_PROV_NAME, RFD.CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 AS REF_GRP_8, RFD.CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_4 AS REF_GRP_4, CPCA_CHANGE_REASON_TEXT AS REASON_TEXT, CAST(VT1.CVT_IN_OUT_PT AS VARCHAR (254)) AS PATIENT_TYPE FROM PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS AS PATIENTS LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER ON PT_MRN = CPE_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE AS VT1 ON VT1.CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID = CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT AS VD ON CPE_DEPT_ID = VD.CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE VT ON VT.CRE_RES_ID = CPE_VST_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE REF ON REF.CRE_RES_ID = CPE_REF_RES_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_PT_CHNG_APPT ON CPE_ENC_CSN_ID = CPCA_ENC_CSN_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT SD ON SD.CLD_DEPT_ID = CPCA_OLD_DEPT_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT RFD ON RFD.CLD_DEPT_ID = CPE_REF_DEP_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT LOC ON LOC.CLD_DEPT_ID = CPE_REF_DEP_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE SR ON SR.CRE_RES_ID = CPCA_OLD_RES_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE VT2 ON VT2.CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID = CPCA_OLD_VISIT_TYP_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_USER ON CPCA_USER_ID = CLE_USER_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_PATIENT ON CPE_PRK = CL_PRK WHERE 1 = 1 AND REF.CRE_RES_TYP IN ('Physician', 'Dentist', 'Psychologist', 'PhD', 'Nurse Practitioner', 'Physician Assistant', 'Advanced Practice Nurse') AND VD.CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 = 'GIM' AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT DATE - 6 MONTHS AND CURRENT DATE + 90 DAYS AND VT.CRE_RES_ID IN ('010926', '013250', '012138', '019950', '008615') AND REF.CRE_RES_NAME IS NOT NULL AND UPPER(CPE_CPE_APPT_STS) IN ('COMP', 'ARRIVED', 'SCH') AND CPE_APPT_MADE_DTE >= ORDER_PLACEMENT_DATE AND ROW_NUMBERS = 1 ), IRB AS (SELECT AC_MRN, PRO_IRB_NO, PRO_IRB_TITLE, PRO_PROTOCOL_TYPE FROM IDB.PROTOCOL JOIN IDB.ACCRUALS ON PRO_IRB_NO = AC_IRB_NO WHERE PRO_IRB_NO = '23-274' ), SURVEY AS (SELECT EF.EF_MRN, EF.EF_FORM_ID AS SURVEYID, EF.EF_SUBMISSION_DT AS SUBMITDT, EF.EF_FORM_NAME, EF.EF_FORM_ALIAS, 'Y' AS SURVERY_COMPLETED FROM IDB.EF_FORM AS EF JOIN IDB.EF_FORM_ITEM AS EI ON EF.EF_FORM_ID = EI.EFI_FORM_ID JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN FROM VISITS) AS PATIENTS ON EF.EF_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE 1 = 1 AND EF_SUBMISSION_DT BETWEEN CURRENT date - 6 MONTHS AND CURRENT date AND EF.EF_FORM_NAME = ('Interdisciplinary Clinic Patient Satisfaction Survey') GROUP BY EF_MRN, EF_FORM_ID, EF_SUBMISSION_DT, EF_SURVEY_ID, EF_FORM_NAME, EF_FORM_ALIAS, EF_FORM_DESCRIPTION HAVING COUNT(EF.EF_MRN) > 0 ORDER BY EF_MRN, EF_SUBMISSION_DT, EF_SURVEY_ID, EF_FORM_NAME, EF_FORM_ALIAS, EF_FORM_DESCRIPTION) SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_CITY, PT_STATE, OS_SVC_DESC, ORDER_PLACEMENT_DATE, OO_ORD_NAME, VISIT_REQUESTED, ADDITIONAL_INFORMATION, APPT_MADE_DTE, APPT_DATE, CPE_CPE_APPT_STS, LGR_AMB_LOCATION, PROV_NAME, INT_REF_PROV_NAME, REASON_TEXT, PATIENT_TYPE, PRO_IRB_NO, PRO_IRB_TITLE, CASE WHEN SURVERY_COMPLETED = 'Y' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS SURVERY_COMPLETED FROM VISITS AS V LEFT JOIN SURVEY AS S ON V.PT_MRN = S.EF_MRN JOIN IRB AS I ON V.PT_MRN = I.AC_MRN

prompt: Requesting to build on-demand version of existing 'database view' query MED28166 which was developed by Dan Kelly
completion: SELECT DISTINCT "t1"."PT_MRN" AS "MRN" , "t2"."LTC_SUBTEST_NAME" AS "Lab-Test Name" , "t3"."LTC_SUBTEST_NAME" AS "Lab-Subtest Name" , "t4"."DT_DTE" AS "Lab Date" , TIME(PLR_PERFORMED_DT) AS "Lab Time" , "t5"."PLR_RESULT_VALUE" AS "Lab Value" , "t5"."PLR_TEST_LOW_LIMIT" AS "Lab-Limit Lower" , "t5"."PLR_TEST_UP_LIMIT" AS "Lab-Limit Upper" , "t5"."PLR_ABNORMALITY_CD" AS "Lab-Abnormal Flag" , CAST ("t5"."PLR_TEXT_RESULT" AS VARCHAR(3000)) AS "Lab-Test Result Notes" , PLR_PERFORMED_DT AS "Performed DateTime" FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS" "t1" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_LAB_RESULT" "t5" ON "t5"."PLR_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t1"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."LAB_TEST_CATALOG_V" "t2" ON "t5"."PLR_LAB_TEST_CATALOG_ID" = "t2"."LTC_LAB_TEST_CATALOG_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."LAB_TEST_CATALOG_V" "t3" ON "t5"."PLR_LAB_SUBTEST_CATALOG_ID" = "t3"."LTC_LAB_TEST_CATALOG_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" "t4" ON "t5"."PLR_PERFORMED_DATE_ID" = "t4"."DT_DATE_ID" WHERE 1=1 AND PT_MRN IN (#PROMPTMANY('MRN_LIST')#) AND "t2"."LTC_CTLG_ITEM_GUID" IN ('9000001459101001' ,'5000001483101001' ,'2000001228101001' ,'9000004938301010' ,'9000005512401010') AND "t4"."DT_DTE" BETWEEN CURRENT date - 365 DAYS AND CURRENT date AND "t5"."PLR_RESULT_VALUE" IS NOT NULL AND "t5"."PLR_RESULT_VALUE" <> '' ORDER BY "t1"."PT_MRN" , "t3"."LTC_SUBTEST_NAME" , "t4"."DT_DTE" , PLR_PERFORMED_DT ; SELECT RRPT_MRN AS MRN , RRPT_ORDER_GROUP AS "Modality" , RRPT_ACCESSION_NO AS "Accession No" , RRPT_PROCEDURE_NAME AS "Procedure Name" , RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE AS "Performed Date" , RRPT_REPORT_DTE AS "Report Date" , DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)IMPRESSION:[\w\W]*(?=DICTATED BY:)', RRPT_REPORT_TXT) AS "Impression" , VARCHAR(RRPT_REPORT_TXT, 32000) AS "Report Text" , DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)FINDINGS[:]*[\w\W]*(?=IMPRESSION:)', RRPT_REPORT_TXT) AS "Findings" , RRPT_SVC_CD AS "Svc Code" , RRPT_SVC_DESC AS "Svc Description" , RRPT_MODIFIED_DT, RRPT_CONTENT_MODIFIED_DT FROM DV.RADIOLOGY_REPORT_V RAD WHERE 1=1 AND RRPT_MRN IN (#PROMPTMANY('MRN_LIST')#) ; SELECT DISTINCT "t1"."PT_MRN" AS "MRN", "t1"."PT_BIRTH_DTE" AS "Date of Birth", "t1"."PT_DEATH_DTE" AS "Deceased Date", "t1"."PT_VITAL_STATUS" AS "Vital Status", PLA_LAST_DRVST_DTE AS "Last Dr Visit Date", "t2"."DT_DTE" AS "Pathology Report Date", "t3"."PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_DESC" AS "Pathology Report Type", "t4"."DT_DTE" AS "Pathology Procedure Date", "t5"."PRPT_ACCESSION_NO" AS "Pathology Report" , VARCHAR(PRPT_REPORT, 32000) AS "Report Text (32000 characters)" , XMLCAST(XMLQUERY('fn:substring-before(fn:substring-after($x,''DIAGNOSIS:''), ''I ATTEST'')' PASSING REPLACE(VARCHAR(PRPT_REPORT, 32000), CHR(26), '') AS "x") AS VARCHAR(32000)) AS "Diagnosis Section" , XMLCAST(XMLQUERY('fn:substring-before(fn:substring-after($x,''SPECIMENS SUBMITTED:''), ''DIAGNOSIS'')' PASSING REPLACE(UPPER(VARCHAR(PRPT_REPORT, 32000)), CHR(26), '') AS "x") AS VARCHAR(32000)) AS "Specimens Submitted Section" , DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)diag[\w\W]*(?=I ATTEST)', VARCHAR(PRPT_REPORT, 32000)) AS "Diagnosis & History" FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS" "t1" LEFT JOIN DV.PATIENT_LATEST_ACTIVITY ON PLA_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = "t1"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED" "t6" ON "t1"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t6"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V" "t5" ON "t6"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t5"."PRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" "t2" ON "t5"."PRPT_REPORT_DATE_ID" = "t2"."DT_DATE_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATH_RPRT_TYPE_LOOKUP" "t3" ON "t5"."PRPT_REPORT_TYPE" = "t3"."PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_CD" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" "t4" ON "t5"."PRPT_PROCEDURE_DATE_ID" = "t4"."DT_DATE_ID" WHERE 1=1 AND RRPT_MRN IN (#PROMPTMANY('MRN_LIST')#) AND "t5"."PRPT_REPORT" IS NOT NULL ; SELECT DISTINCT APR_MRN AS MRN , APR_START_DTE AS "Start Date", APR_END_DTE AS "End Date" , CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME AS "Common Generic Name" , APR_DRUG_NAME AS "Drug Name" , APR_ORD_RX_TYPE AS "Rx Type" , APR_ROUTE AS "Route" , CASE WHEN APR_DRUG_PROCESS_STAGE = 'A' THEN 'ADMIN' WHEN APR_DRUG_PROCESS_STAGE = 'P' THEN 'PRESCRIPTION' WHEN APR_DRUG_PROCESS_STAGE = 'D' THEN 'DISPENSE' WHEN APR_DRUG_PROCESS_STAGE = 'H' THEN 'HOME MEDS' WHEN APR_DRUG_PROCESS_STAGE = 'S' THEN 'ASSUMED ADMIN' END AS "Drug Process Stage" , APR_QTY AS "Qty", APR_FREQ AS "Freq", APR_DURATION AS "Duration", APR_DIAGNOSIS_DESC AS "Diagnosis Desc", APR_PROVIDER_NAME AS "Provider Name", APR_PROVIDER_ROLE AS "Provider Role" , APR_TOTAL_GIVEN_DOSE AS "Given Dose", APR_PRESCRIBED_DOSE AS "Prescribed Dose", APR_DOSE_UOM AS UOM, APR_DISPENSE_CNT AS "Dispense Count" , APR_PERFORMED_ORDERS_QTY_TEXT AS "Performed Orders QTY" , APR_SET_NAME AS "Set Name" , APR_INVESTIGATIVE_FLAG AS "Investigative Flag" , CDG_CLASSIC_CHEMO_FLAG AS "Classic Chemo", CDG_BIOLOGIC_IMMUNO_FLAG AS "Biologic" , CDG_TARGETED_FLAG AS "Targeted", CDG_HORMONE_FLAG AS "Hormone", CDG_BONE_AGENTS_FLAG AS "Bone Agents" FROM IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX_V APR WHERE 1=1 AND APR_MRN IN (#PROMPTMANY('MRN_LIST')#) ORDER BY APR_MRN, "Common Generic Name", "Start Date" ;

prompt: Weekly list of post op brain mets patients patients with ICD 10 code c79.31 for surgeons, Moss, Brennan, Tabar, Yu
completion: WITH APT AS (SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN, CPE_ENC_DTE, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 AS DEPARTMENT, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 AS SERVICE, CLD_DEPT_NAME AS DEPARTMENT_NAME, CRE_RES_ID, CRE_RES_NAME, CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME AS VISIT_TYPE, CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CPE_MRN, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 ORDER BY CPE_ENC_DTE ASC) AS RNUMBER FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID AND UPPER(CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME) IN ('AD HOC POST OP', 'NRS POST OP', 'TELEHEALTH POST OP', 'NRS53 POST OP', 'PHONE POST OP') WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS = 'Sch' AND CRE_RES_ID IN ('023978', '009910', '012062', '027953') AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6= 'NRS' AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN (CURRENT date + 7 DAYS) AND (CURRENT date + 15 DAYS) ) , DIAG AS (SELECT CC_MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS MIN_ICD9_EFF_DTE, CC_CLSF_CD AS ICD9_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS ICD9_DESC FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE CC_CLSF_CD IN ('C71.9 ', 'C79.31') AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND (CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) GROUP BY CC_MRN, CC_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK ) SELECT MRN, DATE_OF_SURGERY, PHYSICIAN, APPOINTMENT_DATE, VISIT_TYPE FROM (SELECT DISTINCT SSE_MRN AS MRN, SSE_SURG_DTE AS DATE_OF_SURGERY, CRE_RES_NAME AS PHYSICIAN, CPE_ENC_DTE AS APPOINTMENT_DATE, VISIT_TYPE, RNUMBER, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY SSE_MRN ORDER BY SSE_SURG_DTE DESC) AS RN, SSP_SURG_SVC_CD FROM IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE ON SSE_LOG_ID = SSP_LOG_ID AND SSE_ENC_CSN_ID = SSP_ENC_CSN_ID JOIN DIAG ON SSE_MRN = CC_MRN JOIN APT ON SSE_MRN = CPE_MRN AND SSP_RES_ID IN ('023978', '009910', '012062', '027953') WHERE 1=1 AND SSE_SURG_DTE>= MIN_ICD9_EFF_DTE ) AS X WHERE RN = 1 AND RNUMBER = 1

prompt: Provide ICU and hospital variables for retrospective Covid research project.
completion: WITH PTS AS (SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, YEAR (CURRENT DATE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) AS AGE, PT_GENDER, PT_SEX , AV_DESC AS RACE, PT_DATE_OF_DEATH, VIS_HOSP_SVC, HOSP_SVC_DESC , VIS_ADM_DTE FROM IDB.VISIT_V JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON VIS_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS ON PT_RACE = AV_CODE AND AV_ELEMENT = 'RACE' WHERE 1=1 AND (VIS_HOSP_SVC like 'IC%' AND NOT VIS_HOSP_SVC = 'IC') AND VIS_ADM_DTE BETWEEN '2020-03-01' AND '2021-10-31' AND YEAR (CURRENT DATE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) > 18 ) , COVID AS (SELECT COR_MRN, COR_ORDER_NAME, DATE(COR_SIGNIFICANT_DT) AS TEST_DTE, COR_RESULT_TEXT, COR_SPECIMEN_TYPE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY COR_MRN ORDER BY COR_SIGNIFICANT_DT DESC) AS ROW FROM PTS JOIN IDB.COVID19_ORDER_AND_RESULT ON COR_MRN = PT_MRN AND COR_ORDER_STATUS_CODE NOT IN ('CANP', 'CANC', 'HOLD', 'AUC3', 'DISC', 'PEND') AND COR_PATIENT_TYPE LIKE 'Patient%' AND (COR_ORDER_NAME LIKE '%RNA%' OR COR_ORDER_NAME = 'Respiratory NAT Panel with SARS-CoV-2') AND LEFT(UPPER(COR_RESULT_TEXT), 8) IN ('POSITIVE', 'DETECTED') AND DATE(COR_SIGNIFICANT_DT) BETWEEN '2020-03-01' AND '2021-10-31' ORDER BY 1) , C30 AS (SELECT DISTINCT A.COR_MRN AS C30_MRN FROM COVID A JOIN COVID B ON A.COR_MRN = B.COR_MRN AND B.ROW = A.ROW + 1 WHERE DAYS(A.TEST_DTE) - DAYS(B.TEST_DTE) >= 14 ) , BMI AS (SELECT DISTINCT A.PMH_MRN, A.PMH_BMI, A.PMH_MEASURE_DTE FROM C30 JOIN IDB.PT_MEASURES_HX A ON C30_MRN = A.PMH_MRN AND A.PMH_MEASURE_DTE BETWEEN '2020-03-01' AND '2021-10-31' JOIN (SELECT PMH_MRN, MAX(PMH_MEASURE_DTE) AS LAST_BMI FROM IDB.PT_MEASURES_HX WHERE PMH_BMI IS NOT NULL AND PMH_MEASURE_DTE BETWEEN '2020-03-01' AND '2021-10-31' GROUP BY PMH_MRN) AS X ON A.PMH_MRN = X.PMH_MRN AND A.PMH_MEASURE_DTE = LAST_BMI) SELECT PT_MRN , PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH , AGE, PT_GENDER, PT_SEX , RACE, PT_DATE_OF_DEATH, PMH_BMI FROM C30 JOIN PTS ON C30_MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN BMI ON PT_MRN = PMH_MRN

prompt: Provide e-notification alerts for patients who have been on specific anti-PD-1 therapy medications with specific prescribers within a specific timeframe.
completion: WITH CURRENT_PD1 AS (SELECT DISTINCT APR_MRN AS CUR_MRN , APR_GENERIC_NAME AS GENERIC_NAME , CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME AS COMMON_GENERIC_NAME , APR_START_DTE AS START_DTE , APR_END_DTE AS END_DTE FROM IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX_V ANTI WHERE 1=1 AND CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME IN ('NIVOLUMAB' , 'PEMBROLIZUMAB') AND APR_PROVIDER_NAME IN ('Betof Warner, Allison' , 'Callahan, Margaret' , 'Chapman, Paul' , 'Iqbal, Afsheen' , 'Momtaz, Parisa' , 'Postow, Michael' , 'Postow, Michael A' , 'Wolchok, Jedd' , 'Weinstein, Alyona') AND APR_START_DTE >= CURRENT date - 56 DAYS ) , STEP2_PD1 AS (SELECT DISTINCT APR_MRN AS STEP2_MRN , APR_GENERIC_NAME , CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME , APR_START_DTE , APR_END_DTE FROM IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX_V ANTI JOIN CURRENT_PD1 ON CUR_MRN = APR_MRN WHERE 1=1 AND CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME IN ('NIVOLUMAB' , 'PEMBROLIZUMAB') AND APR_PROVIDER_NAME IN ('Betof Warner, Allison' , 'Callahan, Margaret' , 'Chapman, Paul' , 'Iqbal, Afsheen' , 'Momtaz, Parisa' , 'Postow, Michael' , 'Postow, Michael A' , 'Wolchok, Jedd' , 'Weinstein, Alyona' ) AND APR_START_DTE <= CURRENT date - 8 MONTHS ) , PTS_TO_EXCLUDE AS (SELECT DISTINCT APR_MRN FROM IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX_V ANTI JOIN STEP2_PD1 ON STEP2_MRN = APR_MRN WHERE 1=1 AND ANTI.CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME IN ('NIVOLUMAB' , 'PEMBROLIZUMAB') AND ANTI.APR_PROVIDER_NAME IN ('Betof Warner, Allison' , 'Callahan, Margaret' , 'Chapman, Paul' , 'Iqbal, Afsheen' , 'Momtaz, Parisa' , 'Postow, Michael' , 'Postow, Michael A' , 'Wolchok, Jedd' , 'Weinstein, Alyona' ) AND ANTI.APR_START_DTE <= CURRENT date - 13 MONTHS ) , QUAL_PTS AS (SELECT DISTINCT STEP2_MRN AS QUAL_MRN FROM STEP2_PD1 WHERE STEP2_MRN NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT APR_MRN FROM PTS_TO_EXCLUDE) ) SELECT DISTINCT APR_MRN , ANTI.* , APR_GENERIC_NAME , CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME , APR_START_DTE , APR_END_DTE FROM IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX_V ANTI JOIN QUAL_PTS ON QUAL_MRN = APR_MRN WHERE 1=1 AND ANTI.CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME IN ('NIVOLUMAB' , 'PEMBROLIZUMAB') AND ANTI.APR_PROVIDER_NAME IN ('Betof Warner, Allison' , 'Callahan, Margaret' , 'Chapman, Paul' , 'Iqbal, Afsheen' , 'Momtaz, Parisa' , 'Postow, Michael' , 'Postow, Michael A' , 'Wolchok, Jedd' , 'Weinstein, Alyona') ;

prompt: I'm getting unusual results in my query and suspect that I have an incorrect join. For example, I'm getting consent/procedure dates after date of death.
completion: SELECT DISTINCT PD.PT_MRN, PT_RACE_DESC, PT_RELIGION_DESC, PT_SEX_DESC, PCD.CORE_ETHNICITY_DESC, CONS."consent_date_12245a", CONS."consent_date_12245c", PD.PT_DEATH_DTE, PLA.PLA_PED_IND AS "peds", PRV.PRPT_PROCEDURE_DTE, PRV.PRPT_REPORT_DTE, PRV.PRPT_ACCESSION_NO, PRV.PRPT_REPORT_TYPE_DESC, PDRX_DMP_PATIENT_ID DMP_ID, CAST(PRV.PRPT_REPORT AS VARCHAR(32000)) AS PATH_TEXT FROM DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V PD JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V PRV ON PD.PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PRV.PRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID LEFT JOIN (SELECT PT_MRN , MAX(CASE WHEN REG_ID = '100' THEN DATE(CRNT_CONSENT_DATE) END) "consent_date_12245a", MAX(CASE WHEN REG_ID = '300' THEN DATE(CRNT_CONSENT_DATE) END) "consent_date_12245c" FROM NN.CRDB_DASH_PT_REG WHERE PRT_ID = '12-245' AND REG_ID IN ('100', '300') AND CRNT_ELGBL_STATUS_DSCRP NOT IN ('Ineligible', 'Cancel') GROUP BY PRT_ID, PT_MRN) CONS ON PD.PT_MRN = CONS.PT_MRN LEFT JOIN DV.PATIENT_CORE_DEMOGRAPHICS PCD ON PD.PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PCD.CORE_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY PLA ON PD.PT_MRN = PLA.PLA_MRN LEFT JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML ON PDRX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PD.PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID WHERE PRPT_PROCEDURE_DTE > PT_DEATH_DTE

prompt: Create Monthly detail report of 1st cases delay reasons.
completion: SELECT CASE WHEN RM.CRE_RES_NAME LIKE 'IR CIGI MRI%' THEN 1000079 WHEN RM.CRE_RES_NAME LIKE 'IR CIGI%' THEN 1000078 ELSE LOC_LOC_ID END LID , CASE WHEN RM.CRE_RES_NAME LIKE 'IR CIGI MRI%' THEN 'IR M2 MRI' WHEN RM.CRE_RES_NAME LIKE 'IR CIGI%' THEN 'IR M2' ELSE LOC_LOC_NAME END LOC , RM.CRE_RES_NAME OR_ROOM, A.OL_LOG_ID LOGID , A.OL_SURG_DTE SURG_DTE, SUBSTR(MD.CRE_RES_NAME, 1, 35) SURGEON , OLAS_SURG_SVC SVC, SUBSTR(ANS.CRE_RES_NAME, 1, 45) ANESTH , LLD_DELAY_TYPE DELAY_TYPE , LLD_LOG_LINE_NO DELAY_LINE, LLDR_DELAY_RSN DELAY_RSN , COALESCE(STRIP(CHAR(LLD_DELAY_LEN))||' min ', '') DEL_TIME , LLDC_DELAY_COMMENT DELAY_COMMENT , CASE WHEN MONTH(CURRENT DATE) IN (1, 2) THEN DATE(CURRENT_DATE-(DAYOFYEAR(CURRENT DATE)-1)DAY)-1 YEAR ELSE DATE(CURRENT_DATE-(DAYOFYEAR(CURRENT DATE)-1)DAY) END AS FRDT , LAST_DAY(CURRENT DATE - 1 MONTH) TODT FROM IDB.OR_LOG A JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE RM ON A.OL_ROOM_RES_ID = RM.CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_LOCATION ON A.OL_SURG_LOC_ID = LOC_LOC_ID JOIN IDB.OR_LOG_CASE_TIMES PI ON A.OL_LOG_ID = PI.OLCT_LOG_ID AND PI.OLCT_TRACK_EVNT_CD = '600' JOIN IDB.OR_LOG_ALL_SURG ON OLAS_LOG_ID = A.OL_LOG_ID AND OLAS_PNL_NO = 1 AND OLAS_SURG_ROLE = 'Primary' JOIN IDB.OR_CASE ON A.OL_LOG_ID = OC_CASE_ID JOIN IDB.OR_LNLG_ANES_STAFF ON A.OL_LOG_ID = LLAS_LOG_ID AND LLAS_ANES_STAFF_CD = '20' JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE MD ON MD.CRE_RES_ID = OLAS_RES_ID JOIN IDB.OR_LNLG_DELAY ON LLD_LOG_ID = A.OL_LOG_ID AND LLD_DELAY_TYPE_CD IN ('10', '20') LEFT JOIN IDB.OR_LNLG_DELAY_RSN ON LLDR_LOG_ID = LLD_LOG_ID AND LLDR_DELAY_REC_ID = LLD_DELAY_REC_ID AND LLDR_LOG_LINE_NO = LLD_LOG_LINE_NO LEFT JOIN IDB.OR_LNLG_DELAY_COMM ON LLDC_LOG_ID = LLD_LOG_ID AND LLDC_DELAY_REC_ID = LLD_DELAY_REC_ID AND LLDC_LOG_LINE_NO = LLD_LOG_LINE_NO LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ANS ON ANS.CRE_RES_ID = LLAS_ANES_RES_ID WHERE A.OL_SURG_DTE BETWEEN CASE WHEN MONTH(CURRENT DATE) IN (1, 2) THEN DATE(CURRENT_DATE-(DAYOFYEAR(CURRENT DATE)-1)DAY)-1 YEAR ELSE DATE(CURRENT_DATE-(DAYOFYEAR(CURRENT DATE)-1)DAY) END AND LAST_DAY(CURRENT DATE - 1 MONTH) AND PI.OLCT_EVNT_IN_DT IS NOT NULL AND A.OL_LOG_STS NOT IN ('4', '6') AND OC_ADD_ON_CASE_IND <> 'Y' AND A.OL_SCH_STRT_DT = (SELECT MIN(B.OL_SCH_STRT_DT) FROM IDB.OR_LOG B WHERE A.OL_SURG_DTE = B.OL_SURG_DTE AND A.OL_ROOM_RES_ID = B.OL_ROOM_RES_ID) ORDER BY LID, OR_ROOM, DELAY_LINE

prompt: EPI8861 - Provide a report showing survival status and tumor diagnosis data for all pancreatic cancer patients consented to MSKCC IRB approved protocol #02-102.
completion: SELECT DISTINCT "t1"."PT_MRN" AS "MRN", "t1"."PT_LAST_NAME" AS "Last Name", "t1"."PT_FIRST_NAME" AS "First Name", "t1"."PT_BIRTH_DTE" AS "Date of Birth", "t1"."PT_DEATH_DTE" AS "Deceased Date", "t1"."PT_VITAL_STATUS" AS "Vital Status", "t2"."PLA_LAST_APPT_DTE" AS "Last Appointment Date", "t2"."PLA_LAST_CONTACT_DTE" AS "Last Contact Date", "t2"."PLA_LAST_ACTV_DTE" AS "Last Activity Date", "t3"."ICSC_SITE_CD" AS "ICD-O Site Code", "t3"."ICSC_ICDO_SITE_MSK_DESC" AS "ICD-O Site Description", "t4"."DT_DTE" AS "Tumor Diagnosis Date", "t5"."TCSA_TM_AJCC_DESC" AS "Collaborative Group (AJCC stage)", YEAR("t4"."DT_DTE" - "t6"."DT_DTE") AS "Age at Tumor Diagnosis Date - years" FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V" "t1" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_LATEST_ACTIVITY" "t2" ON "t1"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t2"."PLA_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED" "t7" ON "t1"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t7"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."CDB_TUMOR_V" "t8" ON "t7"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t8"."CDTM_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."ICDO_SITE_CATALOG_V" "t3" ON "t8"."CDTM_SITE_CATALOG_ID" = "t3"."ICSC_SITE_CATALOG_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" "t4" ON "t8"."CDTM_DX_DATE_ID" = "t4"."DT_DATE_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."TUMOR_COLLAB_STAGE_ATTRIBUTES_V" "t5" ON "t8"."CDTM_COLLAB_STAGE_ATTR_ID" = "t5"."TCSA_TM_COLLAB_STAGE_ATTR_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."ACCRUALS" "t9" ON "t7"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t9"."AC_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PROTOCOL" "t10" ON "t9"."AC_PROTOCOL_ID" = "t10"."PRO_PROTOCOL_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" "t6" ON "t1"."PT_BIRTH_DTE" = "t6"."DT_DTE" WHERE ("t10"."PRO_IRB_NO" = '02-102' AND "t3"."ICSC_SITE_CD" IN ('C250', 'C251', 'C252', 'C253', 'C257', 'C258', 'C259'))

prompt: Provide a ongoing weekly list of patients who have been infused with immune effector cells (IECs) via MSKCC's Cellular Therapeutics Center. Also requesting a list of patients who have been infused with IECs during the prior month (May 2021).
completion: WITH PTS AS (SELECT PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID PID FROM DV.PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED) , DT_1 AS (SELECT PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID AS P_ID FROM DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS REC LEFT JOIN DV.PATIENT_CORE_DEMOGRAPHICS ON PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = CORE_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID WHERE 1=1 ) , DT_2 AS (SELECT CFT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID AS P_ID FROM DV.CLINDOC_FULL_TEXT REC JOIN DV.DATE AS AUTH ON CFT_AUTHORED_DATE_ID = AUTH.DT_DATE_ID JOIN DV.DATE AS SERV ON CFT_SERVICE_DATE_ID = SERV.DT_DATE_ID JOIN DV.DATE AS SGN ON CFT_SIGNED_DATE_ID = SGN.DT_DATE_ID JOIN DV.DATE AS ENT ON CFT_ENTER_DATE_ID = ENT.DT_DATE_ID WHERE 1=1 AND SERV.DT_DTE >= DATE('2021-05-01') AND CFT_DOCUMENT_NAME IN ('Cell Infusion - BMT') ) , DEID AS (SELECT DISTINCT P_ID FROM (SELECT P_ID FROM DT_1 INTERSECT SELECT P_ID FROM DT_2 )) SELECT P_ID FROM DEID

prompt: Provide a list of patients with supraclavicular lymph node metastasis between 1/1/2008 - 12/31/2018. Provide a list of patients with inguinal lymph node metastasis between 1/1/2008 - 12/31/2018.
completion: WITH PATH AS (SELECT * FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V WHERE PRPT_PROCEDURE_DTE BETWEEN '2008-01-01' AND '2018-12-31' AND CONTAINS("PRPT_REPORT", '("SUPRACLAVICULAR" & "NODE" & "POSITIVE FOR MALIGNANT CELLS")') = 1 ) , EXCLUDE_DX AS (SELECT PRPT_MRN CC_MRN FROM PATH JOIN DV.PATIENT_DIAGNOSIS_FINAL_ALL_V ON PDX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID JOIN DV.DATE_V ON PDX_DX_DATE_ID = DT_DATE_ID JOIN DV.DIAGNOSIS_CATALOG ON PDX_DX_CATALOG_ID = DXCC_DX_CATALOG_ID WHERE (SUBSTR(DXCC_ICD_CODE, 1, 3) IN ('C73', '193', 'C34', '162', 'C50', '174', 'C43', '172') OR DXCC_ICD_CODE IN ('C76.0', '195.0') OR DXCC_ICD_CODE BETWEEN 'C81' AND 'C96.999' OR DXCC_ICD_CODE BETWEEN '200' AND '209.99') ) , RAD AS (SELECT * FROM PATH JOIN DV.RADIOLOGY_REPORT_V ON PRPT_MRN = RRPT_MRN AND RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE BETWEEN PRPT_PROCEDURE_DTE - 1 YEAR AND PRPT_PROCEDURE_DTE + 1 YEAR WHERE RRPT_MRN NOT IN (SELECT CC_MRN FROM EXCLUDE_DX) ) SELECT PT_MRN, PT_BIRTH_DTE, DT_DTE AS "Tumor Diagnosis Date", DXCC_ICD_CODE AS "ICD-O Histology Code", DXCC_ICD_MSK_DESC AS "ICD-O Histology Description", ICSC_SITE_CD AS "ICD-O Site Code", ICSC_ICDO_SITE_MSK_DESC AS "ICD-O Site Description", TCA_CASE_STS_DESC AS "Case Status" FROM RAD JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON RRPT_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN DV.CDB_TUMOR_V ON CDTM_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID JOIN DV.DATE_V ON CDTM_DX_DATE_ID = DT_DATE_ID JOIN DV.DIAGNOSIS_CODE_CAT_ICDO_V ON CDTM_DX_CATALOG_ID = DXCC_DX_CATALOG_ID JOIN DV.ICDO_SITE_CATALOG_V ON CDTM_SITE_CATALOG_ID = ICSC_SITE_CATALOG_ID JOIN DV.TUMOR_CASE_ATTRIBUTES_V ON CDTM_CASE_ATTR_ID = TUMOR_CASE_ATTR_ID ;
