prompt: Provide order data for orders entered by specific users from October 5th, 2020 to present.
Provide a list of patients of Dr. Sandra D'Angelo who are diagnosed with Merkel Cell Carcinoma and have been treated between 2016-2018.
completion: WITH PTS AS (SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN, CRE_RES_NAME FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON PT_MRN=CPE_MRN WHERE CRE_RES_ID = '016378' AND CPE_ENC_DTE >= '2016-01-01' ) , DX AS (SELECT TM_MRN, AV_DESC AS CASE_STS, TM_DX_DTE, TM_HIST_CD, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS HIST_DESC, TM_SITE_CD, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_DESC FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS ON AV_ELEMENT = 'CASE_STS' AND AV_CODE = TM_CASE_STS WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('3', '6', '7', '8') AND TM_HIST_CD = 'M8247/3' ) , CHEMO AS (SELECT CHEMO_MRN, SUBSTR(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(CAST(XMLSERIALIZE(CONTENT XMLAGG(XMLELEMENT(NAME "c", MIN_DTE || ' | ' || MAX_DTE|| ' | ' || MED || CHR(13) || CHR(10)) ORDER BY MIN_DTE, MED) AS CLOB(32000)) AS VARCHAR(32000)), '<c>', ','), '</c>', ''), '&#xD', ''), '<c/>', ''), ',', ''), 1) AS CHEMO FROM (SELECT CHEMO_MRN, MED, MIN(START_DTE) AS MIN_DTE, MAX(START_DTE) AS MAX_DTE FROM (SELECT CPO_MRN AS CHEMO_MRN, CPO_ORD_NAME AS MED, CPO_START_DTE AS START_DTE FROM IDB.CHEMO_PERFORMED_ORDERS UNION ALL SELECT CP_MRN AS CHEMO_MRN, CP_GENERIC_NAME AS MED, DATE(CP_START_DT) AS START_DTE FROM IDB.CHEMO_PRESCRIPTIONS) A GROUP BY CHEMO_MRN, MED) A GROUP BY CHEMO_MRN) SELECT CPE_MRN "MRN", PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH "DOB", HIST_DESC "Histology", SITE_DESC "Primary Site", CHEMO "Chemo History", A.AC_CONS_DTE AS "06-107 Consent", B.AC_CONS_DTE AS "12-245 Consent" FROM PTS JOIN DX ON CPE_MRN = TM_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON CPE_MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN CHEMO ON CHEMO_MRN = CPE_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.ACCRUALS A ON CPE_MRN = A.AC_MRN AND A.AC_IRB_NO = '06-107' LEFT JOIN IDB.ACCRUALS B ON CPE_MRN = B.AC_MRN AND B.AC_IRB_NO = '12-245'

completion: WITH PTS AS (SELECT PT_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_ZIP_CD FROM IDB.PATIENT_V WHERE 1=1 AND PT_MRN = '38321030' ) , PARTNER_HOSP AS (SELECT PT_MRN PARTNER_MRN, PARTNER_HOSP "Partner Hospital" FROM PTS JOIN IDB.CATCHMENT_PARTNER_HOSP_V ON PT_ZIP_CD = IIC_ZIP_CD WHERE PARTNER_HOSP IS NOT NULL AND PT_MRN <> '' ) , APPT AS (SELECT CPE_MRN, CPE_ENC_DTE AS "Partner Hospital Appt Date", CRE_RES_NAME AS "Partner Hospital Provider Name", ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CPE_MRN ORDER BY CPE_APPT_DT DESC) RN FROM PTS JOIN IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER ON PT_MRN = CPE_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp', 'Sch', 'Can', 'CxlSameDay', 'No Show') AND CLD_DEPT_NAME = 'PARTNER HOSP' ) , COLLAB_ONC AS (SELECT CPFF_MRN, 'Y' "Collaborative Oncology Flag" FROM PTS JOIN IDB.CL_PAS_FYI_FLAGS ON PT_MRN = CPFF_MRN WHERE CPFF_PAT_FLAG_TYPE = 'COLLABORATIVE ONCOLOGY' AND CPFF_MRN <> '' ) , NYCBS AS (SELECT CDD_MRN, CDD_SERVICE_DTE, CDO_VALUE_TEXT, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CDD_MRN ORDER BY CDD_SERVICE_DTE DESC) RN FROM PTS JOIN IDB.CD_DOCUMENT ON PT_MRN = CDD_MRN JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION ON CDD_MRN = CDO_MRN AND CDD_DOC_GUID = CDO_DOC_GUID WHERE 1=1 AND CDD_DOC_NAME like 'External Communication - Shared Care%' AND LOCATE('NYCBS', CDO_VALUE_TEXT) >= 1 ) , EMR AS (SELECT EAD_MRN, EAD_DOCUMENT_DTE, EADT_CATEGORY, EAD_DOCTYPE, EADT_EMR_DESC, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY EAD_MRN ORDER BY EAD_DOCUMENT_DTE DESC) RN FROM PTS JOIN IDB.EMR_AA_DOCUMENT ON PT_MRN = EAD_MRN JOIN IDB.EMR_AA_DOCTYPE ON EAD_DOCTYPE = EADT_DOCTYPE WHERE VALUE(EAD_RIGHT_ID, EADT_RIGHT_ID) = 167 AND EADT_CATEGORY = 'Outside Corresp' ) SELECT PT_MRN MRN, PT_LAST_NAME LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME FISRT_NAME , "Collaborative Oncology Flag" , "Partner Hospital" , "Partner Hospital Appt Date" , "Partner Hospital Provider Name" , CASE WHEN CDD_MRN IS NULL THEN 'Y' END "NYCBS in ClinDoc" , CASE WHEN EAD_MRN IS NULL THEN 'Y' END "Non-MSKCC Correspondence in EMR" FROM PTS LEFT JOIN PARTNER_HOSP ON PT_MRN = PARTNER_MRN LEFT JOIN APPT A ON PT_MRN = CPE_MRN AND A.RN = 1 LEFT JOIN COLLAB_ONC ON PT_MRN = CPFF_MRN LEFT JOIN NYCBS N ON PT_MRN = N.CDD_MRN AND N.RN = 1 LEFT JOIN EMR E ON PT_MRN = E.EAD_MRN AND E.RN = 1

prompt: Provide a list of patients diagnosed with anaplastic thyroid cancer and treated with radiation therapy.
completion: SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, TM_DX_DTE, TM_HIST_CD, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS HIST_DESC, TM_SITE_CD, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_DESC, RTC_TX_START_DTE, RTC_TX_STOP_DTE, RTC_TX_DELIVERED_DOSE, RTC_TX_DELIVERED_FRACTIONS, RTC_TX_PLAN_NAME, RTC_PRIMARY_REF_POINT FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PT_MRN = TM_MRN JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS ON AV_ELEMENT = 'CASE_STS' AND AV_CODE = TM_CASE_STS JOIN IDB.RADONC_TREATMENT_COURSE ON RTC_TX_MRN = TM_MRN WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND (TM_SITE_CD LIKE 'C193%' OR TM_SITE_CD LIKE 'C73%') AND TM_HIST_CD = 'M8021/3'

prompt: Would like list of call CATCH referrals since the CATCH referral order was created in CIS. Would like to detail how many were scheduled, how many were completed (both new patients and follow ups), broken down into month and year. CIS order is named: CATCH (hereditary Surveillance Clinic Referrral)
completion: SELECT ORDER_NAME, ORD_STATUS, MONTH_YR, COUNT(OO_MRN) AS YEAR_MONTH FROM (SELECT OO_ORD_NAME ORDER_NAME, OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE, OO_MRN, SUBSTR(TO_CHAR (OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE, 'YYYY-MM-DD'),1, 7) AS MONTH_YR, OSTS_STS_DESC ORD_STATUS FROM IDB.OMS_ORDER JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_CATALOG ON OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID = OOC_MSTR_ITEM_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_STATUS ON OO_ORD_STS_CD = OSTS_ORD_STS_CD WHERE OOC_ITEM_NAME LIKE '%CATCH%' AND OO_ORD_STS_CD NOT IN ('CANP', 'CANC', 'AUC3') AND OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE IS NOT NULL ) GROUP BY ORDER_NAME, ORD_STATUS, MONTH_YR ;

prompt: Provide the total missed appointments for patients 15 - 39 years old seen in 2019
completion: SELECT CPE_MRN AS "MRN", PT_LAST_NAME AS "Last Name", PT_FIRST_NAME AS "First Name", PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH AS "DOB", CPE_ENC_DTE AS "Appt Date", YEAR (Date (CPE_ENC_DTE) - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) AS "Age", CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 AS "Department", CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 AS "Service", COUNT(CPE_MRN) AS "Missed Appts" FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON CPE_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('No Show', 'CxlSameDay') AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN '2019-01-01' AND '2019-12-31' AND YEAR (Date (CPE_ENC_DTE) - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) BETWEEN 15 AND 39 GROUP BY CPE_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, CPE_ENC_DTE, YEAR (Date (CPE_ENC_DTE) - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH), CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 ORDER BY CPE_MRN

prompt: List of patients with mycosis fungoides who have experienced large cell transformation
completion:
WITH ETO AS (SELECT DISTINCT "t1"."PT_MRN" AS "MRN", "t2"."PINC_GENERIC_NAME" AS "Generic Drug Name", "t2"."PINC_CHEMO_IND" AS "Chemo Indicator", "t2"."PINC_ITEM_NAME" AS "Drug Name", "t2"."PINC_TRADE_NAME" AS "Trade Name", "t3"."DT_DTE" AS "Order Start Date", "t4"."DT_DTE" AS "Order Stop Date", "t5"."POA_ROUTE_DESC" AS "Route of Administration", "t6"."POD_DOSE" AS "Normalized Dose", "t6"."POD_DOSE_UNIT" AS "Normalized Dose Unit", "t7"."DT_DTE" AS "First Order Start Date", ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY "t1"."PT_MRN" ORDER BY "t7"."DT_DTE") AS RNM FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V" "t1" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED" "t8" ON "t1"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t8"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PHM_PT_MEDS_MQT" "t9" ON "t8"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t9"."POD_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PHM_ORDER_DTL" "t6" ON "t9"."POD_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t6"."POD_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AND "t9"."POD_PHARMA_INVENTORY_CTLG_ID" = "t6"."POD_PHARMA_INVENTORY_CTLG_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PHM_INVENTORY_CATALOG" "t2" ON "t6"."POD_PHARMA_INVENTORY_CTLG_ID" = "t2"."PINC_INVENTORY_CTLG_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" "t3" ON "t6"."POD_START_DATE_ID" = "t3"."DT_DATE_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" "t4" ON "t6"."POD_STOP_DATE_ID" = "t4"."DT_DATE_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PHM_ORDER_ATTR" "t5" ON "t6"."POD_PHARMA_ORD_ATTR_ID" = "t5"."POA_PHARMA_ORDER_ATTR_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" "t7" ON "t9"."FIST_START_DATE_ID" = "t7"."DT_DATE_ID" WHERE (UPPER("t2"."PINC_GENERIC_NAME") IN ('BRENTUXIMAB VEDOTIN', 'ROMIDEPSIN', 'BELINOSTAT', 'PRALATREXATE') AND "t7"."DT_DTE" BETWEEN '2009-1-1' AND '2020-10-1') ) , PATH AS (SELECT DISTINCT "t1"."PT_MRN" AS "PATH_MRN", "t1"."PT_LAST_NAME" AS "Last Name", "t1"."PT_FIRST_NAME" AS "First Name", "t1"."PT_BIRTH_DTE" AS "Date of Birth", "t1"."PT_SEX_DESC" AS "Gender", "t1"."PT_RACE_DESC" AS "Race", "t2"."CORE_ETHNICITY_DESC" AS "Ethnicity", "t1"."PT_VITAL_STATUS" AS "Vital Status", "t3"."PRPT_ACCESSION_NO" AS "Accession No", "t4"."DT_DTE" AS "Pathology Report Date", "t5"."PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_DESC" AS "Pathology Report Type", "t6"."DT_DTE" AS "Pathology Procedure Date" , CAST(SUBSTR("t3"."PRPT_REPORT", 1, 25000) AS VARCHAR(25000)) AS PATH_RPT, REPLACE(REPLACE(LTRIM(RTRIM(CAST(SUBSTR("t3"."PRPT_REPORT", 1, 25000) AS VARCHAR(25000)))), CHR(13), '
'), CHR(10), '') AS PATH_PRPT_P1 , ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY "t1"."PT_MRN" ORDER BY "t4"."DT_DTE") AS RNP FROM (SELECT DISTINCT "MRN" FROM ETO) A JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V" "t1" ON "MRN" = "t1"."PT_MRN" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_CORE_DEMOGRAPHICS" "t2" ON "t1"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t2"."CORE_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED" "t7" ON "t1"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t7"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V" "t3" ON "t7"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t3"."PRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" "t4" ON "t3"."PRPT_REPORT_DATE_ID" = "t4"."DT_DATE_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATH_RPRT_TYPE_LOOKUP" "t5" ON "t3"."PRPT_REPORT_TYPE" = "t5"."PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_CD" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" "t6" ON "t3"."PRPT_PROCEDURE_DATE_ID" = "t6"."DT_DATE_ID" WHERE ((CONTAINS("t3"."PRPT_REPORT", '("large cell transformation", "LCT" ,"large cells" ,"progression")') = 1 AND CONTAINS("t3"."PRPT_REPORT", '("mycosis fungoides", "MF" ,"cutaneous T cell lymphoma" , "CTCL")') = 1) AND "t3"."PRPT_REPORT" IS NOT NULL) ) SELECT DISTINCT "MRN", "Last Name", "First Name", "Date of Birth", "Gender", "Race", "Ethnicity", "Vital Status", "Accession No", "Pathology Report Date", "Pathology Report Type", "Generic Drug Name", "Drug Name", "Order Start Date", "Order Stop Date", "Route of Administration", "Normalized Dose", "Normalized Dose Unit", "First Order Start Date" FROM ETO JOIN PATH ON ETO."MRN" = "PATH_MRN" AND RNM = 1 AND RNP = 1

prompt: Provide data for 2010 on (OR LOS) patient in room to patient out of room for open prostatectomies, by service and by surgeon. Please provide count, average and median.
completion: SELECT DOS, MRN, LOG_ID, LOG_ID, TTL_PNLS, POSTOP_DEST, PT_IND , SVC, SURGEON, OR_LOS, MAX(PNL1_CPT1) PNL1_CPT1 , MAX(PNL1_CPT2) PNL1_CPT2, MAX(PNL1_CPT3) PNL1_CPT3, MAX(PNL1_CPT4) PNL1_CPT4 FROM (SELECT OL_SURG_DTE DOS, OL_MRN MRN, OL_LOG_ID LOG_ID , OL_NO_OF_PNLS TTL_PNLS, OL_POSTOP_DEST POSTOP_DEST , OLAS_SURG_SVC SVC, SUBSTR(CRE_RES_NAME, 1, 35) SURGEON , CASE WHEN OLAS_PNL_NO = 1 AND OLAP_LINE_NO = 1 THEN SUBSTR(STRIP(CPX_PROC_CD)||' - '||STRIP(CPX_PROC_NAME), 1, 55) ELSE '' END AS PNL1_CPT1 , CASE WHEN OLAS_PNL_NO = 1 AND OLAP_LINE_NO = 2 THEN SUBSTR(STRIP(CPX_PROC_CD)||' - '||STRIP(CPX_PROC_NAME), 1, 55) ELSE '' END AS PNL1_CPT2 , CASE WHEN OLAS_PNL_NO = 1 AND OLAP_LINE_NO = 3 THEN SUBSTR(STRIP(CPX_PROC_CD)||' - '||STRIP(CPX_PROC_NAME), 1, 55) ELSE '' END AS PNL1_CPT3 , CASE WHEN OLAS_PNL_NO = 1 AND OLAP_LINE_NO = 4 THEN SUBSTR(STRIP(CPX_PROC_CD)||' - '||STRIP(CPX_PROC_NAME), 1, 55) ELSE '' END AS PNL1_CPT4 , CASE WHEN CS_ACCT_NO IS NOT NULL THEN 'IP' ELSE 'OP' END AS PT_IND , CASE WHEN CPX_PROC_CD IN ('999997', '10140', '55866', '51800') OR CPX_PROC_CD BETWEEN '51550' AND '51596' THEN 'Y' END EXC_IND , CASE WHEN CPX_PROC_CD BETWEEN '55801' AND '55845' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END OTHER_CPT , SSE_PT_IN_DT PT_ROOM_IN, SSE_PT_OUT_DT PT_ROOM_OUT , TIMESTAMPDIFF(4, CHAR(SSE_PT_OUT_DT - SSE_PT_IN_DT)) OR_LOS FROM IDB.OR_LOG JOIN IDB.OR_LOG_ALL_PROC ON OL_LOG_ID = OLAP_LOG_ID JOIN IDB.OR_LOG_ALL_SURG ON OLAP_LOG_ID = OLAS_LOG_ID AND OLAS_PNL_NO = OLAP_PNL_NO AND OLAS_SURG_ROLE = 'Primary' AND OLAS_SURG_SVC = 'URO' LEFT JOIN IDB.CASE ON OL_MRN = CS_MRN AND CS_ACCT_NO LIKE '84%' AND OL_SURG_DTE BETWEEN CS_ADM_DATE AND CS_DSCH_DATE AND CS_PT_STS <> 'IP' JOIN IDB.OR_PROC ON OLAP_OR_PROC_ID = OP_OR_PROC_ID JOIN IDB.OR_CL_PROC ON OP_OR_PROC_ID = OCP_OR_PROC_ID JOIN IDB.CL_PROC ON OCP_PROC_ID = CPX_PROC_ID JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CRE_RES_ID = OLAS_RES_ID JOIN (SELECT SSE_LOG_ID, SSE_SURG_DTE, SSE_PT_IN_DT, SSE_PT_OUT_DT FROM IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE ON SSE_LOG_ID = SSP_LOG_ID WHERE SSE_SURG_DTE BETWEEN '2010-01-01' AND '2010-12-31' AND SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD BETWEEN '55801' AND '55845') SRG ON OL_LOG_ID = SSE_LOG_ID AND OL_SURG_DTE = SSE_SURG_DTE AND OL_NO_OF_PNLS = 1 AND OL_LOG_STS_CD NOT IN ('4', '6')) SRG GROUP BY DOS, MRN, LOG_ID, LOG_ID, SVC, TTL_PNLS, POSTOP_DEST, PT_IND, OR_LOS, SURGEON HAVING MAX(EXC_IND) IS NULL

prompt: Please run reports similar to MED6314, but for David Qualls from July 1st, 2020-Current.
completion: WITH CHMSET AS (SELECT CAO_MRN MRN, CAO_ENTER_DTE ENTER_DATE, CAO_START_DTE CHEMO_START_DATE , STRIP(CAO_ORD_STS)||' - '||STRIP(CAO_STS_DESC) STATUS , CASE WHEN CAO_SET_GUID > ' ' THEN CAO_SET_GUID ELSE CAO_ORD_GUID END SET_GUID , CASE WHEN CAO_SET_NAME > ' ' THEN CAO_SET_NAME WHEN CAO_ORD_TYPE = 'IP' AND CAO_ORAL_CHEMO_IND = 'Y' THEN 'No Set Oral Chemo for Inpatients: '||STRIP(CAO_ORD_NAME) WHEN CAO_ORD_TYPE = 'IP' THEN 'No Set Injection Chemo for Inpatients: '||STRIP(CAO_ORD_NAME) WHEN CAO_ORD_TYPE = 'OP' AND CAO_ORAL_CHEMO_IND = 'Y' THEN 'No Set Oral Chemo for Outpatients: '||STRIP(CAO_ORD_NAME) WHEN CAO_ORD_TYPE = 'OP' THEN 'No Set Injection Chemo for Outpatients: '||STRIP(CAO_ORD_NAME) ELSE 'Take Home Rx: '||STRIP(CAO_ORD_NAME) END AS SETNAME , CAO_SET_FORM_NAME SET_FORM_NAME, CAO_SUMMARY_LINE SUMMARYLINE , CAO_ORD_GUID ORD_GUID, CAO_SVC_TYPE SVC_TYPE, CAO_ORD_TYPE_CD ORD_TYPE , SUBSTR(CASE WHEN MONTH(CAO_ENTER_DTE) BETWEEN 7 AND 12 THEN STRIP(CHAR(YEAR(CAO_ENTER_DTE)))||'-'||CHAR(YEAR(CAO_ENTER_DTE)+1) ELSE STRIP(CHAR(YEAR(CAO_ENTER_DTE)-1))||'-'||CHAR(YEAR(CAO_ENTER_DTE)) END, 1, 9) ACADEMIC_YR , CASE WHEN MONTH(CAO_ENTER_DTE) BETWEEN 7 AND 9 THEN 'Q1' WHEN MONTH(CAO_ENTER_DTE) BETWEEN 10 AND 12 THEN 'Q2' WHEN MONTH(CAO_ENTER_DTE) BETWEEN 1 AND 3 THEN 'Q3' ELSE 'Q4' END ACADEMIC_QTR, 'HEM' GRP , OU_DISPLAY_NAME PROVIDER, OUO_PVDR_ROLE_TYPE PVDR_ROLE, DOC_SVC SVC, CAO_ORD_NAME DRUG_NAME, CAO_ORDID ORDID , ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CAO_MRN, CAO_ENTER_DTE, CAO_START_DTE, CAO_SET_GUID ORDER BY CAO_ORD_GUID) RN FROM IDB.CHEMO_ALL_ORDERS LEFT JOIN IDB.CHEMO_PERFORMED_ORDERS ON CAO_ORD_GUID = CPO_ORD_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_ORDER ON CAO_ORD_GUID = OO_ORD_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_USER_ORDERS ON OO_ORD_GUID = OUO_ORD_GUID AND OUO_PVDR_ROLE_TYPE = 'Fellow' JOIN IDB.OMS_USER ON OO_PVDR_GUID = OU_USER_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_ORG_UNIT ON OU_ORG_UNIT_GUID = OOU_ORG_UNIT_GUID AND OU_USER_GUID = '9001207833001190' LEFT JOIN IDB.DOC ON OO_REQ_DR_NO = DOC_DR_NO JOIN IDB.CHEMO_DRUG_GENERIC ON CAO_GENERIC_NAME = CDG_GENERIC_NAME WHERE CAO_ENTER_DTE BETWEEN DATE(SUBSTR(CHAR(CURRENT_DATE), 1, 5)||'07-01') - 3 YEAR AND LAST_DAY(CURRENT DATE - 1 MONTH) AND CAO_ORD_TYPE_CD = 'Medication' UNION ALL SELECT CP_MRN MRN, CP_RX_CREATE_DTE ENTER_DATE , COALESCE(DATE(CP_START_DT), CP_RX_CREATE_DTE) CHEMO_START_DATE , CP_PRESCRIPTION_STATUS STATUS, CHAR(CP_RX_ID) AS SET_GUID , 'Take Home Rx: '||CASE WHEN CP_GENERIC_NAME > ' ' THEN STRIP(CP_GENERIC_NAME) ELSE STRIP(CP_DRUG_NAME) END SETNAME , ' ' SET_FORM_NAME, CP_INSTRUCTIONS SUMMARYLINE , CHAR(CP_RX_ID) ORD_GUID, 'ADULT' SVC_TYPE, CP_RX_TYPE ORD_TYPE , SUBSTR(CASE WHEN MONTH(CP_RX_CREATE_DTE) BETWEEN 7 AND 12 THEN STRIP(CHAR(YEAR(CP_RX_CREATE_DTE)))||'-'||CHAR(YEAR(CP_RX_CREATE_DTE)+1) ELSE STRIP(CHAR(YEAR(CP_RX_CREATE_DTE)-1))||'-'||CHAR(YEAR(CP_RX_CREATE_DTE)) END, 1, 9) ACADEMIC_YR , CASE WHEN MONTH(CP_RX_CREATE_DTE) BETWEEN 7 AND 9 THEN 'Q1' WHEN MONTH(CP_RX_CREATE_DTE) BETWEEN 10 AND 12 THEN 'Q2' WHEN MONTH(CP_RX_CREATE_DTE) BETWEEN 1 AND 3 THEN 'Q3' ELSE 'Q4' END ACADEMIC_QTR, 'HEM' GRP, CP_REQUESTER_NAME PROVIDER, CP_REQUESTER_ROLE PVDR_ROLE , COALESCE(DOC_SVC, OS_SVC_GRP_CD) SVC, CP_DRUG_NAME DRUG_NAME, CAST(CP_RX_ID AS CHAR(16)) ORDID, 1 RN FROM IDB.CHEMO_PRESCRIPTIONS JOIN IDB.HML_CLIENT_PRESCRIPTION ON CP_RX_ID = HCPR_PRESCRIPTION_ID JOIN IDB.OMS_CLIENT_VISIT ON OCV_VISIT_GUID = HCPR_VISIT_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_SERVICE ON OCV_SVC_GUID = OS_SVC_GUID LEFT JOIN IDB.DOC ON DOC_DR_NO = OCV_ATT_DR_NO JOIN IDB.OMS_USER ON OU_USER_GUID = HCPR_CARE_PROV_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_ORG_UNIT ON OU_ORG_UNIT_GUID = OOU_ORG_UNIT_GUID AND OU_USER_GUID = '9001207833001190' JOIN IDB.CHEMO_DRUG_GENERIC ON CP_GENERIC_NAME = CDG_GENERIC_NAME WHERE CP_RX_TYPE = 'eRx' AND CP_REQUESTER_ROLE = 'Fellow' AND CP_RX_CREATE_DTE BETWEEN DATE(SUBSTR(CHAR(CURRENT_DATE), 1, 5)||'07-01') - 3 YEAR AND LAST_DAY(CURRENT DATE - 1 MONTH) ) , DTL AS (SELECT MRN, ENTER_DATE, CHEMO_START_DATE, STATUS, PROVIDER, PVDR_ROLE, SVC , SET_GUID, SETNAME, SET_FORM_NAME, SUMMARYLINE, SVC_TYPE, ORD_TYPE , ACADEMIC_YR, ACADEMIC_QTR, GRP, DRUG_NAME, ORDID FROM CHMSET WHERE RN = 1 ) SELECT ACADEMIC_YR, ACADEMIC_QTR, PROVIDER, SETNAME, GRP, COUNT(SET_GUID) OO_ORD_GUID FROM DTL GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YR, ACADEMIC_QTR, PROVIDER, SETNAME, GRP

prompt: Patients who had ACCESS
completion: SELECT DISTINCT PDWS_NAME, PT_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_BIRTH_DTE, DTRPT.DT_DTE AS REPORT_DTE, DTPROCPATHRPT.DT_DTE AS PROCEDURE_DTE, GENE_ID, TUMOR_TYPE_NAME, PRIMARY_SITE, METASTASIS_SITE, PDRX_DMP_SAMPLE_ID FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT JOIN DV.DATE DTRPT ON PRPT_REPORT_DATE_ID = DTRPT.DT_DATE_ID JOIN DV.DATE DTPROCPATHRPT ON PRPT_PROCEDURE_DATE_ID = DTPROCPATHRPT.DT_DATE_ID JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML ON PDRX_PATH_RPT_ID = PRPT_PATH_RPT_ID JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML_SETTINGS ON PDRX_PATH_DMP_RESULTS_XML_ID = PDRXS_PATH_DMP_RESULTS_XML_ID JOIN DVDMC.PATHOLOGY_DMP_WEBSVC_SETTINGS ON PDRXS_SETTING_ID = PDWS_SETTING_ID JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON PDRX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID , XMLTABLE('$c/root/*' PASSING PDRX_XML_VALUE AS "c" COLUMNS GENE_PANEL VARCHAR(100) PATH 'gene-panel', GENE_ID VARCHAR(100) PATH 'gene_id', TUMOR_TYPE_NAME VARCHAR(255) PATH '../meta-data/tumor_type_name', PRIMARY_SITE VARCHAR(255) PATH '../meta-data/primary_site', METASTASIS_SITE VARCHAR(255) PATH '../meta-data/metastasis_site') T WHERE PDWS_NAME = 'ACCESS' ORDER BY 2, 4, 6 ; WITH CTE AS (SELECT DISTINCT PDRX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID AS PID FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML_SETTINGS ON PDRX_PATH_DMP_RESULTS_XML_ID = PDRXS_PATH_DMP_RESULTS_XML_ID JOIN DVDMC.PATHOLOGY_DMP_WEBSVC_SETTINGS ON PDRXS_SETTING_ID = PDWS_SETTING_ID WHERE PDWS_NAME = 'ACCESS' ) SELECT DISTINCT PDWS_NAME, PT_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_BIRTH_DTE, DTRPT.DT_DTE AS REPORT_DTE, DTPROCPATHRPT.DT_DTE AS PROCEDURE_DTE, GENE_ID, TUMOR_TYPE_NAME, PRIMARY_SITE, METASTASIS_SITE, PDRX_DMP_SAMPLE_ID FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT JOIN DV.DATE DTRPT ON PRPT_REPORT_DATE_ID = DTRPT.DT_DATE_ID JOIN DV.DATE DTPROCPATHRPT ON PRPT_PROCEDURE_DATE_ID = DTPROCPATHRPT.DT_DATE_ID JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML ON PDRX_PATH_RPT_ID = PRPT_PATH_RPT_ID JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML_SETTINGS ON PDRX_PATH_DMP_RESULTS_XML_ID = PDRXS_PATH_DMP_RESULTS_XML_ID JOIN DVDMC.PATHOLOGY_DMP_WEBSVC_SETTINGS ON PDRXS_SETTING_ID = PDWS_SETTING_ID JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON PDRX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID JOIN CTE ON PID = PDRX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID , XMLTABLE('$c/root/*' PASSING PDRX_XML_VALUE AS "c" COLUMNS GENE_PANEL VARCHAR(100) PATH 'gene-panel', GENE_ID VARCHAR(100) PATH 'gene_id', TUMOR_TYPE_NAME VARCHAR(255) PATH '../meta-data/tumor_type_name', PRIMARY_SITE VARCHAR(255) PATH '../meta-data/primary_site', METASTASIS_SITE VARCHAR(255) PATH '../meta-data/metastasis_site') T WHERE PDWS_NAME = 'IMPACT' ORDER BY 2, 4, 6 ; WITH CTE AS (SELECT DISTINCT PDRX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID AS PID, DTRPT.DT_DTE AS REPORT_DTE, DTPROCPATHRPT.DT_DTE AS PROCEDURE_DTE FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT JOIN DV.DATE DTRPT ON PRPT_REPORT_DATE_ID = DTRPT.DT_DATE_ID JOIN DV.DATE DTPROCPATHRPT ON PRPT_PROCEDURE_DATE_ID = DTPROCPATHRPT.DT_DATE_ID JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML ON PDRX_PATH_RPT_ID = PRPT_PATH_RPT_ID JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML_SETTINGS ON PDRX_PATH_DMP_RESULTS_XML_ID = PDRXS_PATH_DMP_RESULTS_XML_ID JOIN DVDMC.PATHOLOGY_DMP_WEBSVC_SETTINGS ON PDRXS_SETTING_ID = PDWS_SETTING_ID WHERE PDWS_NAME = 'ACCESS' ) SELECT DISTINCT RTC_TX_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_BIRTH_DTE, RTC_TX_PLAN_NAME, RTC_TX_DELIVERED_FRACTIONS, RTC_TX_DELIVERED_DOSE, RTC_TX_START_DTE, RTC_TX_STOP_DTE FROM IDB.RADONC_TREATMENT_COURSE JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON RTC_TX_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN CTE ON PID = PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID

prompt: Provide a summary of weekly Adult Long Term Survivorship Referrals
completion: SELECT OO_MRN MRN, STRIP(PT_LAST_NAME)||', '||PT_FIRST_NAME PT_NAME, OO_ORD_ID ORDID, OO_ORD_NAME ORDNAME, OO_ENTER_DTE "Order Enter Date", MAX(CASE WHEN OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'Consult_ALTFU_Referring Service' THEN SUBSTR(OUD_USER_DI_VALUE, 1, 75) END) "Referring Service", MAX(CASE WHEN OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'Consult_ALTFU_Referring MD' THEN SUBSTR(OUD_USER_DI_VALUE, 1, 75) END)"Referring MD", MAX(CASE WHEN OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'Requested For' THEN DATE(STRIP(OUD_USER_DI_VALUE)) END) "Requested For", MAX(CASE WHEN OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'Consult_ALTFU_Reason' THEN SUBSTR(OUD_USER_DI_VALUE, 1, 75) END) "Reason for Referral", MAX(CASE WHEN OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'Consult_ALTFU_Appointment' THEN SUBSTR(OUD_USER_DI_VALUE, 1, 75) END) "Appointment Requested Within", MAX(CASE WHEN OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'Consult_ALTFU_Tx Location' THEN SUBSTR(OUD_USER_DI_VALUE, 1, 75) END) "Patient treated at MSK", MAX(CASE WHEN OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'Consult_ALTFU_Tx End Date' THEN SUBSTR(OUD_USER_DI_VALUE, 1, 75) END) "Treatment End Date", MAX(CASE WHEN OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'Consult_ALTFU_Diagnosis' THEN SUBSTR(OUD_USER_DI_VALUE, 1, 75) END) "Cancer Diagnosis", MAX(CASE WHEN OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'Consult_ALTFU_Age at Diagnosis' THEN SUBSTR(OUD_USER_DI_VALUE, 1, 75) END) "Age at Diagnosis", MAX(CASE WHEN OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'Consult_ALTFU_Scheduling Contact' THEN SUBSTR(OUD_USER_DI_VALUE, 1, 75) END) "Scheduling Contact", MAX(CASE WHEN OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'Consult_ALTFU_Scheduling Contact #' THEN SUBSTR(OUD_USER_DI_VALUE, 1, 75) END) "Scheduling Contact #" FROM IDB.OMS_ORDER JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON OO_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_USER_DATA ON OO_ORD_GUID = OUD_ORD_GUID WHERE OO_ORD_STS_CD NOT IN ('CANC', 'CANP', 'AUC3') AND OO_ORD_NAME = 'Adult Long Term Follow Up Outpatient Consult' AND OO_ENTER_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT DATE - 7 DAY AND CURRENT DATE GROUP BY OO_MRN , STRIP(PT_LAST_NAME)||', '||PT_FIRST_NAME , OO_ORD_ID, OO_ORD_NAME, OO_ENTER_DTE;

prompt: We would like to request a compiled list of all of the pediatric cases from 7/1/2015-6/30/2018

'|| STRIP(A.OLAS_SURG_ROLE) AS SURGEON_NME, YEAR(OL_SURG_DTE) - YEAR(CL_DATE_OF_BIRTH) AGE_AT_SRG , LOC_LOC_NAME AS LOCATION , A.OLAS_SURG_ROLE AS SURGEON_ROLE , B.CRE_RES_NAME AS SURGEON_NAME , OLAP_PNL_NO , OLAP_LINE_NO , CPX_PROC_NAME AS CPT_PROC_NAME , CPX_PROC_CD AS CPT_CODE FROM IDB.OR_LOG JOIN IDB.OR_LOG_ALL_SURG A ON OL_LOG_ID = A.OLAS_LOG_ID AND OL_SURG_DTE >= '2015-07-01' AND OL_SURG_DTE <= '2018-06-30' AND A.OLAS_PNL_NO = 1 AND NOT (OL_LOG_STS_CD IN ('4 ', '6 ') ) JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE B ON B.CRE_RES_ID = A.OLAS_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_LOCATION ON OL_SURG_LOC_ID = LOC_LOC_ID JOIN IDB.CL_PATIENT ON CL_MRN = OL_MRN AND YEAR(OL_SURG_DTE) - YEAR(CL_DATE_OF_BIRTH) <= 21 JOIN IDB.OR_LOG_ALL_PROC ON OL_LOG_ID = OLAP_LOG_ID AND OLAP_PNL_NO = A.OLAS_PNL_NO AND OLAP_LINE_NO = A.OLAS_LINE_NO JOIN IDB.OR_PROC ON OP_OR_PROC_ID = OLAP_OR_PROC_ID JOIN IDB.OR_CL_PROC ON OCP_OR_PROC_ID = OLAP_OR_PROC_ID JOIN IDB.CL_PROC ON OCP_PROC_ID = CPX_PROC_ID JOIN IDB.OR_LNLG_DX ON OLLD_LOG_ID = OLAP_LOG_ID WHERE A.OLAS_SURG_SVC= 'NEURO' UNION SELECT DISTINCT OL_LOG_ID, OL_MRN AS MRN , STRIP(CL_LAST_NAME)||', '||STRIP(CL_FIRST_NAME) AS PT_NAME , CL_DATE_OF_BIRTH AS DOB , A.OLAS_SURG_SVC AS SVC, OL_SURG_DTE AS SURG_DTE , STRIP(B.CRE_RES_NAME)||' - '|| STRIP(A.OLAS_SURG_ROLE) AS SURGEON_NME, YEAR(OL_SURG_DTE) - YEAR(CL_DATE_OF_BIRTH) AGE_AT_SRG , LOC_LOC_NAME AS LOCATION , A.OLAS_SURG_ROLE AS SURGEON_ROLE , B.CRE_RES_NAME AS SURGEON_NAME , OLAP_PNL_NO , OLAP_LINE_NO , CPX_PROC_NAME AS CPT_PROC_NAME , CPX_PROC_CD AS CPT_CODE FROM IDB.OR_LOG JOIN IDB.OR_LOG_ALL_SURG A ON OL_LOG_ID = A.OLAS_LOG_ID AND OL_SURG_DTE >= '2015-07-01' AND OL_SURG_DTE <= '2018-06-30' AND A.OLAS_PNL_NO = 2 AND NOT (OL_LOG_STS_CD IN ('4 ', '6 ') ) JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE B ON B.CRE_RES_ID = A.OLAS_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_LOCATION ON OL_SURG_LOC_ID = LOC_LOC_ID JOIN IDB.CL_PATIENT ON CL_MRN = OL_MRN AND YEAR(OL_SURG_DTE) - YEAR(CL_DATE_OF_BIRTH) <= 21 JOIN IDB.OR_LOG_ALL_PROC ON OL_LOG_ID = OLAP_LOG_ID AND OLAP_PNL_NO = A.OLAS_PNL_NO AND OLAP_LINE_NO = A.OLAS_LINE_NO JOIN IDB.OR_PROC ON OP_OR_PROC_ID = OLAP_OR_PROC_ID JOIN IDB.OR_CL_PROC ON OCP_OR_PROC_ID = OLAP_OR_PROC_ID JOIN IDB.CL_PROC ON OCP_PROC_ID = CPX_PROC_ID JOIN IDB.OR_LNLG_DX ON OLLD_LOG_ID = OLAP_LOG_ID WHERE A.OLAS_SURG_SVC= 'NEURO'

prompt: List of patients with completed PET Axumin scans with a Prostate Cancer diagnosis.
completion: WITH DX AS (SELECT CC_MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS MIN_ICD_EFF_DTE, CC_CLSF_CD AS ICD_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS ICD_DESC FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE SUBSTR(CC_CLSF_CD, 1, 3) IN ('185', 'C61') AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' GROUP BY CC_MRN, CC_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK ) , APPTS AS (SELECT CPE_MRN AS "MRN", CPE_ENC_DTE AS "Appt Date", CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 AS "Department", CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 AS "Service", CLD_DEPT_NAME AS "Department Name", CRE_RES_NAME AS "Provider Name", CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME AS "Visit Type" FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 = 'NUC' AND CPE_ENC_DTE >= '2019-01-01' AND CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME LIKE '%AXUMIN%' ) SELECT DISTINCT CC_MRN "MRN", "Appt Date", "Department", "Service", "Department Name", "Provider Name", "Visit Type", FSC_PRIORITY "Ins Priority", FSC_NAME "Ins Name", FSC_CAT_NAME "Ins Category", FSC_REP_CAT_NAME "Ins Category Name", INS_COMP_NAME "Ins Company Name", INS_EFF_DATE "Ins eff date" FROM DX JOIN APPTS A ON CC_MRN = A."MRN" JOIN IDB.PATIENT_INSURANCE_V I ON CC_MRN = I.MRN ;

prompt: Requesting data regarding endobronchial ultrasound (EBUS) procedures performed by the Interventional Pulmonology team during the specified time period.
completion: WITH INIT AS (SELECT DISTINCT SSE_MRN AS MRN, SSE_LOG_ID AS LOG_ID, SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD AS INIT_CPT_CD, SSE_SURG_DTE, TIME(SSE_SURG_STRT_DT) AS "PROCEDURE START TIME", TIME(SSE_SURG_END_DT) AS "PROCEDURE END TIME", SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC, SSP_SURG_LAST_NM, SSP_SURG_FIRST_NM, SSP_SURG_SVC_CD, SSE_SURG_LOC FROM IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE ON SSE_LOG_ID = SSP_LOG_ID WHERE (SSE_SURG_LOC NOT LIKE '%IR%' AND SSE_SURG_LOC NOT LIKE '%ENDO%' AND SSE_SOURCE_TYPE <> 'E') AND SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD IN ('31652', '31653') AND SSE_SURG_DTE BETWEEN '01-01-2017' AND '10-20-2022' AND SSP_SURG_FIRST_NM IN ('MOHIT', 'ROBERT', 'BRYAN CHRISTOPHER', 'JASON ANTHONY', 'OR') AND SSP_SURG_LAST_NM IN ('CHAWLA', 'LEE', 'HUSTA', 'BEATTIE', 'KALCHIEM-DEKEL') ) , INIT1 AS (SELECT DISTINCT MRN, LOG_ID, SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD AS CPT_CD FROM INIT JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT ON LOG_ID = SSE_LOG_ID JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE ON LOG_ID = SSP_LOG_ID AND SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD IN ('31627', '31640')) , SURG AS (SELECT * FROM INIT WHERE LOG_ID NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT LOG_ID FROM INIT1) ) , PATH AS (SELECT DISTINCT "t1"."PT_MRN" AS "MRN", SSE_SURG_DTE, "PROCEDURE START TIME", "PROCEDURE END TIME", INIT_CPT_CD, SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC, SSP_SURG_LAST_NM, SSP_SURG_FIRST_NM, SSP_SURG_SVC_CD, SSE_SURG_LOC, "t2"."PRPT_ACCESSION_NO" AS "Pathology Report", "t3"."PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_DESC" AS "Pathology Report Type", "t4"."DT_DTE" AS "Pathology Procedure Date", "t5"."DT_DTE" AS "Pathology Report Date", UPPER(CASE WHEN LENGTH(PRPT_REPORT) <= 15000 THEN RTRIM(CAST(SUBSTR(PRPT_REPORT, 1, 15000) AS VARCHAR(15000))) ELSE CAST(SUBSTR(PRPT_REPORT, 1, 15000) AS VARCHAR(15000)) END) AS TXT, CASE WHEN UPPER(DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)SPECIMEN DESCRIPTION:[\w\W]*(?=CYTOLOGIC DIAGNOSIS:)', PRPT_REPORT)) <> '' THEN UPPER(DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)SPECIMEN DESCRIPTION:[\w\W]*(?=CYTOLOGIC DIAGNOSIS:)', PRPT_REPORT)) WHEN UPPER(DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)SPECIMENDESCRIPTION:[\w\W]*(?=CYTOLOGIC DIAGNOSIS:)', PRPT_REPORT)) <> '' THEN UPPER(DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)SPECIMENDESCRIPTION:[\w\W]*(?=CYTOLOGIC DIAGNOSIS:)', PRPT_REPORT)) END AS SPECIMEN FROM SURG LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V" "t1" ON MRN = "t1"."PT_MRN" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED" "t6" ON "t1"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t6"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V" "t2" ON "t6"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t2"."PRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATH_RPRT_TYPE_LOOKUP" "t3" ON "t2"."PRPT_REPORT_TYPE" = "t3"."PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_CD" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" "t4" ON "t2"."PRPT_PROCEDURE_DATE_ID" = "t4"."DT_DATE_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" "t5" ON "t2"."PRPT_REPORT_DATE_ID" = "t5"."DT_DATE_ID" WHERE 1=1 AND "t2"."PRPT_REPORT" IS NOT NULL AND "t4"."DT_DTE" BETWEEN SSE_SURG_DTE- 4 DAYS AND SSE_SURG_DTE+ 4 DAYS AND "t3"."PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_DESC" ='Cytology-Non GYN' ) SELECT SURG.*, "Pathology Report", "Pathology Report Type", "Pathology Procedure Date", "Pathology Report Date", SPECIMEN FROM SURG LEFT JOIN PATH ON PATH."MRN" = SURG.MRN AND PATH."Pathology Procedure Date" BETWEEN SURG.SSE_SURG_DTE - 4 DAYS AND SURG.SSE_SURG_DTE + 4 DAYS WHERE "Pathology Report Type" = 'Cytology-Non GYN' UNION SELECT SSE_MRN AS MRN, SSE_LOG_ID AS LOG_ID, SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD AS INIT_CPT_CD, SSE_SURG_DTE, TIME(SSE_SURG_STRT_DT) AS "PROCEDURE START TIME", TIME(SSE_SURG_END_DT) AS "PROCEDURE END TIME", SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC, SSP_SURG_LAST_NM, SSP_SURG_FIRST_NM, SSP_SURG_SVC_CD, SSE_SURG_LOC, PRPT_ACCESSION_NO AS "Pathology Report", PRPT_REPORT_TYPE_DESC AS "Pathology Report Type", PRPT_PROCEDURE_DTE AS "Pathology Procedure Date", PRPT_REPORT_DTE AS "Pathology Report Date", CASE WHEN UPPER(DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)SPECIMEN DESCRIPTION:[\w\W]*(?=CYTOLOGIC DIAGNOSIS:)', PRPT_REPORT)) <> '' THEN UPPER(DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)SPECIMEN DESCRIPTION:[\w\W]*(?=CYTOLOGIC DIAGNOSIS:)', PRPT_REPORT)) WHEN UPPER(DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)SPECIMENDESCRIPTION:[\w\W]*(?=CYTOLOGIC DIAGNOSIS:)', PRPT_REPORT)) <> '' THEN UPPER(DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)SPECIMENDESCRIPTION:[\w\W]*(?=CYTOLOGIC DIAGNOSIS:)', PRPT_REPORT)) END AS SPECIMEN FROM IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE ON SSE_LOG_ID = SSP_LOG_ID AND SSE_ENC_CSN_ID = SSP_ENC_CSN_ID JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V ON SSE_MRN = PRPT_MRN WHERE (SSE_SURG_LOC NOT LIKE '%IR%' AND SSE_SURG_LOC NOT LIKE '%ENDO%' AND SSE_SOURCE_TYPE <> 'E') AND SSE_MRN = '35556339' AND SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD IN ('31652') AND PRPT_REPORT_TYPE_DESC = 'Cytology-Non GYN' AND SSE_SURG_DTE = '08-06-2020' ;

prompt:
We need patient list of all children 10 years and younger who have had a lower limb salvage surgery with re-construction. The date range is 1/1/2001 to 9/22/2008.



Amended Date Range: 1/1/1993 to 9/22/2008
completion: SELECT DISTINCT "t1"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AS "Deident PT #", "t2"."PCC_CODE" AS "CPT Procedure Code - PBD", "t2"."PCC_DESC" AS "CPT Procedure Desc - PBD", "t3"."DT_DTE" AS "CPT Procedure Date - PBD", "t4"."PT_MRN" AS "MRN", "t4"."PT_LAST_NAME" AS "Last Name", "t4"."PT_FIRST_NAME" AS "First Name", "t4"."PT_BIRTH_DTE" AS "Date of Birth" FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED" "t1" LEFT JOIN "DV"."CPT_PBD_PATIENT_PROCEDURE" "t2" ON "t1"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t2"."PTX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE" "t3" ON "t2"."PTX_PROC_DATE_ID" = "t3"."DT_DATE_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS" "t4" ON "t1"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t4"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" WHERE ("t2"."PCC_CODE" IN ('27290', '27295', '27590', '27591', '27592', '27596', '27880', '27881', '27882', '27598') AND "t3"."DT_DTE" BETWEEN '1993-1-1' AND '2008-9-22') AND DAYS("t3"."DT_DTE") - DAYS("t4"."PT_BIRTH_DTE") <= (10*365)

prompt: List of all ICU Covid Positive Patients who received more than 2 RBC unit
completion: WITH CTE AS (SELECT DISTINCT CALENDAR_DATE AS ICU_DATES, COVID.MRN, COVID.LAST_NAME, COVID.FIRST_NAME, COVID.DATE_OF_BIRTH, COVID.DATE_OF_DEATH, RESULT AS COVID_STATUS, DATE(MIN_IDENTIFIED_DT) COVID_IDENTIFIED_DT, IP.ADMIT_DATE, IP.DISCHARGE_DATE, LOS, SERVICE_MIDNIGHT FROM IDB.COVID19_PATIENT_INFO COVID JOIN IDB.INPATIENT_ADMISSIONS_V IP ON COVID.MRN = IP.MRN AND (RESULT = 'Positive' OR (RESULT = 'Resolved' AND MIN_RESOLVED_PROBLEM_DT > IP.ADMIT_DT)) JOIN IDB.INPATIENT_DAYS_V IPDAYS ON IP.ADMIT_ID = IPDAYS.ADMIT_ID AND CALENDAR_DATE BETWEEN DATE(MIN_IDENTIFIED_DT) AND COALESCE(DATE(MIN_RESOLVED_PROBLEM_DT), '2999-01-01') - 1 DAY WHERE (SERVICE_MIDNIGHT = 'Intensive Care Unit' OR SVC_MIDNIGHT = 'PDU') AND CALENDAR_DATE BETWEEN '2020-03-17' AND '2020-06-30' ORDER BY COVID.MRN, CALENDAR_DATE) , RBC AS (SELECT DISTINCT ICU_DATES AS CAL_DTE, BBP_MRN, COUNT(DISTINCT BBP_RESULT_ORD_GUID) AS RBC_UNITS FROM IDB.TRANSFUSED_BLOOD_PRODUCTS_V JOIN CTE ON BBP_MRN = MRN AND BBP_TRANSACTION_DTE = ICU_DATES WHERE BBP_PRODUCT_ABRV = 'RBC' GROUP BY ICU_DATES, BBP_MRN HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT BBP_RESULT_ORD_GUID) > 1) SELECT A.*, RBC_UNITS FROM CTE A JOIN RBC B ON BBP_MRN = MRN AND CAL_DTE = ICU_DATES ; WITH CTE AS (SELECT DISTINCT CALENDAR_DATE AS ICU_DATES, COVID.MRN, COVID.LAST_NAME, COVID.FIRST_NAME, COVID.DATE_OF_BIRTH, COVID.DATE_OF_DEATH, RESULT AS COVID_STATUS, DATE(MIN_IDENTIFIED_DT) COVID_IDENTIFIED_DT, IP.ADMIT_DATE, IP.DISCHARGE_DATE, LOS, SERVICE_MIDNIGHT FROM IDB.COVID19_PATIENT_INFO COVID JOIN IDB.INPATIENT_ADMISSIONS_V IP ON COVID.MRN = IP.MRN AND (RESULT = 'Positive' OR (RESULT = 'Resolved' AND MIN_RESOLVED_PROBLEM_DT > IP.ADMIT_DT)) JOIN IDB.INPATIENT_DAYS_V IPDAYS ON IP.ADMIT_ID = IPDAYS.ADMIT_ID AND CALENDAR_DATE BETWEEN DATE(MIN_IDENTIFIED_DT) AND COALESCE(DATE(MIN_RESOLVED_PROBLEM_DT), '2999-01-01') - 1 DAY WHERE (SERVICE_MIDNIGHT = 'Intensive Care Unit' OR SVC_MIDNIGHT = 'PDU') AND CALENDAR_DATE BETWEEN '2020-03-17' AND '2020-06-30' ORDER BY COVID.MRN, CALENDAR_DATE) SELECT DISTINCT A.*, OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE, OOC_ITEM_NAME, OO_SUMMARY_LINE FROM IDB.OMS_ORDER JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_CATALOG ON OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID = OOC_MSTR_ITEM_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_STATUS ON OO_ORD_STS_CD = OSTS_ORD_STS_CD JOIN CTE A ON MRN = OO_MRN AND ICU_DATES = OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE WHERE OO_ORD_STS_CD NOT IN ('CANP', 'CANC', 'AUC3') AND OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID IN ('5000004813073029', '9000002519073001') ORDER BY MRN, ICU_DATES

prompt:
For patients <18 years old diagnosed with the following ICD 10 codes AND who had the procedures done with the following CPT codes, please provide the following: DOB, Ethnicity, TNM stage, Surgery date



Years to be included: 2021-2023
completion: WITH DX AS (SELECT DISTINCT CC_MRN, CASE WHEN PT_DATE_OF_DEATH IS NULL THEN YEAR(CURRENT date - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) END AS AGE, G.AV_DESC AS GENDER, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH AS "Date of Birth", PT_DATE_OF_DEATH AS "Date of Death", R.AV_DESC AS RACE, E.AV_DESC AS ETHNICITY, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS "ICD Date", CC_CLSF_CD AS "ICD Code", CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS "ICD Description" FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON CC_MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS R ON R.AV_ELEMENT = 'RACE' AND R.AV_CODE = PT_RACE LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS G ON G.AV_ELEMENT = 'SEX' AND G.AV_CODE = PT_SEX LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS E ON E.AV_ELEMENT = 'PT_ETHNICITY' AND E.AV_CODE = PT_PT_ETHNICITY WHERE CC_CLSF_CD IN ('C74.90', 'C49.96', 'C64.9', 'C22.2', 'C41.9') AND CASE WHEN PT_DATE_OF_DEATH IS NULL THEN YEAR(CURRENT date - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) END <= '18' AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND (CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) GROUP BY CC_MRN, G.AV_DESC, CASE WHEN PT_DATE_OF_DEATH IS NULL THEN YEAR(CURRENT date - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) END <= '18' AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND (CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) GROUP BY CC_MRN, G.AV_DESC, CASE WHEN PT_DATE_OF_DEATH IS NULL THEN YEAR(CURRENT date - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) END, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, PT_DATE_OF_DEATH, R.AV_DESC, E.AV_DESC, CC_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK HAVING MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) BETWEEN '2021-01-01' AND '2023-12-31'), SURG AS (SELECT DISTINCT SSE_MRN, AGE, GENDER, "Date of Birth", "Date of Death", RACE, ETHNICITY, "ICD Date", "ICD Code", "ICD Description", SSE_SURG_DTE AS "Surgery Date", SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD AS "Surgery CPT Code", SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC AS "Surgery CPT Description", SSP_SURG_SVC_CD AS "Surgery Service Group" FROM DX JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT ON CC_MRN = SSE_MRN JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE ON SSE_LOG_ID = SSP_LOG_ID AND SSE_ENC_CSN_ID = SSP_ENC_CSN_ID WHERE SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD IN ('49000', '45300', '41440', '38780', '50240', '32096', '32505', '44005', '32556') ) SELECT DISTINCT TM_MRN MRN, TM_CLIN_TNM_T AS "Clinical T Stage", TM_CLIN_TNM_N AS "Clinical N Stage", TM_CLIN_TNM_M AS "Clinical M Stage", TM_CLIN_STG_GRP AS "Clinical Group Stage", TM_PATH_TNM_T AS "Pathologic T Stage", TM_PATH_TNM_N AS "Pathologic N Stage", TM_PATH_TNM_M AS "Pathologic M Stage", TM_PATH_STG_GRP AS "Pathologic Group Stage" FROM SURG JOIN IDB.CDB_TUMOR ON TM_MRN = SSE_MRN JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS ON AV_ELEMENT = 'CASE_STS' AND AV_CODE = TM_CASE_STS WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') ORDER BY TM_MRN ; WITH DX AS (SELECT DISTINCT TM_MRN, CASE WHEN PT_DATE_OF_DEATH IS NULL THEN YEAR(CURRENT date - prompt: Provide additional RadOnc Attending and Detail reports to existing COM4613 report as per provided report samples.
completion: SELECT OUO_MRN MRN, STRIP(PT_LAST_NAME)||', '||STRIP(PT_FIRST_NAME) PT_NAME , OO_ACCT_NO ACCT_NO, OUO_ENTER_DTE ENTER_DTE, OUO_PVDR_NAME PROVIDER , OUO_PVDR_ROLE_TYPE PROVIDER_TYPE, OUO_USER_NAME ENTER_BY , OUO_USER_ROLE_TYPE ENTER_ROLE, OUO_ORD_SOURCE SOURCE, OUO_ORD_ID ORDID , OUO_REV_CAT_DEPT DEPT, SUBSTR(STRIP(CASE WHEN COALESCE(MD.OUD_USER_DI_VALUE, CR.OUD_USER_DI_VALUE) IS NOT NULL THEN CASE WHEN COALESCE(MD.OUD_USER_DI_VALUE, CR.OUD_USER_DI_VALUE) LIKE '%:%' THEN COALESCE(MD.OUD_USER_DI_VALUE, CR.OUD_USER_DI_VALUE) ELSE STRIP(OUO_ORD_NAME)||': '|| COALESCE(MD.OUD_USER_DI_VALUE, CR.OUD_USER_DI_VALUE) END ELSE OUO_ORD_NAME END), 1, 155) AS ORDER_NAME , STRIP(OUO_ORD_STS_CD)||'-'||STRIP(OUO_STS_DESC) STATUS , OUO_CURR_LOC LOCATION , DATE(COALESCE(OO_PERFORMED_DT, OO_SIGNIFICANT_DT)) PERFORMED_DTE , CASE WHEN OUO_IP_OP_IND = 'O' THEN 'OP' ELSE 'IP' END AS PT_TYPE , SUBSTR(CHAR(OUO_ENTER_DTE), 1, 5)|| CASE WHEN MONTH(OUO_ENTER_DTE) BETWEEN 1 AND 3 THEN 'Q1' WHEN MONTH(OUO_ENTER_DTE) BETWEEN 4 AND 6 THEN 'Q2' WHEN MONTH(OUO_ENTER_DTE) BETWEEN 7 AND 9 THEN 'Q3' ELSE 'Q4' END AS RPT_QTR , LAST_DAY(CURRENT DATE - 4 MONTH) + 1 DAY STDT , LAST_DAY(CURRENT DATE - 1 MONTH) ENDT FROM IDB.OMS_USER_ORDERS JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PT_MRN = OUO_MRN AND PT_MRN BETWEEN '00000000' AND '99999999' JOIN IDB.OMS_ORDER ON OUO_ORD_GUID = OO_ORD_GUID LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_USER_DATA CR ON CR.OUD_ORD_GUID = OUO_ORD_GUID AND CR.OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'RIS_Order - Current' LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_USER_DATA MD ON MD.OUD_ORD_GUID = OUO_ORD_GUID AND MD.OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'RIS_Order - Modified' JOIN (SELECT OU_USER_GUID, OU_DISPLAY_NAME, OU_OCCUPATION, OU_LOGON_ID, OU_ORD_ROLE_TYPE, OU_EFF_DT, OU_EXP_DT, OOU_ORG_NAME, OP_PVDR_NO, OP_PROV_TYPE, OP_DISCIPLINE, OP_TASK_ROLE_TYPE FROM IDB.OMS_USER LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_PROVIDER ON OU_USER_GUID = OP_PVDR_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_ORG_UNIT ON OU_ORG_UNIT_GUID = OOU_ORG_UNIT_GUID WHERE (OOU_ORG_NAME = 'Radiation Oncology' AND (DATE(OU_EXP_DT) >= '2010-09-01' OR OU_EXP_DT IS NULL)) OR OU_USER_GUID IN ('1000006125119029', '1000007832119029', '3000006511119029', '2000004707119029')) RSTF ON OU_USER_GUID = OO_PVDR_GUID WHERE OUO_ENTER_DTE BETWEEN LAST_DAY(CURRENT DATE - 4 MONTH) + 1 DAY AND LAST_DAY(CURRENT DATE - 1 MONTH) AND OUO_ORD_STS_CD NOT IN ('CANC', 'CANP', 'HOLD', 'PEND', 'SCHD', 'AUC3', 'DISC', 'DISCD') AND OUO_ORD_SOURCE = '.Transcribed Order'

prompt: Provide a list of Parental or Caregiver patients that received psychiatric care at MSK Pediatric Parent and Caregiver Support Program from 2010- 2022.
completion: WITH MAIN AS (SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN AS MAIN_MRN, TRIM(PT_FIRST_NAME)||' ,'||TRIM(PT_LAST_NAME) AS NAME, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH AS DATE_OF_BIRTH, YEAR(CURRENT DATE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) AS AGE, TRIM(G.AV_DESC) AS GENDER, PT_EMAIL_ADDRESS AS EMAIL_ADDRESS, PT_PHONE AS PHONE_NO, CRE_RES_NAME AS "Provider Name" FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER CPE JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON CPE_MRN = PT_MRN AND YEAR(CURRENT DATE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) > 18 LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS G ON G.AV_ELEMENT = 'SEX' AND G.AV_CODE = PT_SEX JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY PLA ON PLA_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE CR ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT CD ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE CVT ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN AS DIS_MRN, COUNT(CPE_ENC_DTE) AS DIS_CNT FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 = 'PED' GROUP BY CPE_MRN) CNT ON CNT.DIS_MRN = CPE.CPE_MRN AND CNT.DIS_CNT < 3 WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 = 'PSY' AND CRE_RES_ID IN ('011775', '018507', '020875', '026260', '023093', '026419', '013854', '029231') AND YEAR(CPE_ENC_DTE) BETWEEN '2010' AND '2022' ), FIR AS (SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN AS FIR_MRN, MIN(CPE_ENC_DTE) OVER (PARTITION BY CPE_MRN) AS FIR_PSY_DTE FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN MAIN ON CPE_MRN = MAIN_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 = 'PSY' ), LAS AS (SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN AS LAS_MRN, MAX(CPE_ENC_DTE) OVER (PARTITION BY CPE_MRN) AS LAS_PSY_DTE FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN MAIN ON CPE_MRN = MAIN_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 = 'PSY' ) SELECT DISTINCT MN.*, FIR_PSY_DTE, LAS_PSY_DTE FROM MAIN MN LEFT JOIN FIR ON MAIN_MRN = FIR_MRN LEFT JOIN LAS ON MAIN_MRN = LAS_MRN ; WITH MAIN AS (SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN AS MAIN_MRN, TRIM(PT_FIRST_NAME)||' ,'||TRIM(PT_LAST_NAME) AS NAME, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH AS DATE_OF_BIRTH, YEAR(CURRENT DATE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) AS AGE, TRIM(G.AV_DESC) AS GENDER, PT_EMAIL_ADDRESS AS EMAIL_ADDRESS, PT_PHONE AS PHONE_NO, CRE_RES_NAME AS "Provider Name" FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER CPE JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON CPE_MRN = PT_MRN AND YEAR(CURRENT DATE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) > 18 LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS G ON G.AV_ELEMENT = 'SEX' AND G.AV_CODE = PT_SEX JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY PLA ON PLA_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE CR ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT CD ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE CVT ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE 1=1 AND (CPE_MRN NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT CC_MRN FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF WHERE CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'D%' AND (CC_CLSF_CD BETWEEN 'C00' AND 'D49.9' OR CC_CLSF_CD BETWEEN '140' AND '239.9') AND (CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) ) OR CPE_MRN NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT TM_MRN FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM H ON TM_HIST_CD = H.CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON TM_SITE_CD = S.CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8'))) AND CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 = 'PSY' AND CRE_RES_ID IN ('011775', '018507', '020875', '026260', '023093', '026419', '013854', '029231') AND YEAR(CPE_ENC_DTE) BETWEEN '2010' AND '2022' ), FIR AS (SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN AS FIR_MRN, MIN(CPE_ENC_DTE) OVER (PARTITION BY CPE_MRN) AS FIR_PSY_DTE FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN MAIN ON CPE_MRN = MAIN_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 = 'PSY' ), LAS AS (SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN AS LAS_MRN, MAX(CPE_ENC_DTE) OVER (PARTITION BY CPE_MRN) AS LAS_PSY_DTE FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN MAIN ON CPE_MRN = MAIN_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 = 'PSY' ) SELECT DISTINCT MN.*, FIR_PSY_DTE, LAS_PSY_DTE FROM MAIN MN LEFT JOIN FIR ON MAIN_MRN = FIR_MRN LEFT JOIN LAS ON MAIN_MRN = LAS_MRN ;

prompt: Provide a report on consistent carbohydrate/diabetic diet educations that were completed by inpatient and outpatient dietitians over the past year.
completion: SELECT DISTINCT CDD_MRN, CDD_DOC_GUID, CDD_SERVICE_DTE, CDD_DOC_NAME, CDO_SECTION, CDO_CTLG_DISPL_NM, CDO_MSTR_ITEM_NM, CDO_ITEM_NAME, CDO_VALUE_TEXT, OCV_CURR_LOC, U1.OU_DISPLAY_NAME AS "Author" FROM IDB.CD_DOCUMENT JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION ON CDO_DOC_GUID = CDD_DOC_GUID AND CDO_AUTHORED_DTE = CDD_AUTHORED_DTE JOIN IDB.OMS_CLIENT_VISIT OCV ON CDD_VISIT_GUID = OCV_VISIT_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_USER U1 ON CDD_AUTH_PROV_GUID = U1.OU_USER_GUID WHERE CDD_CANCEL_IND = '0' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND = '0' AND UPPER(CDD_DOC_NAME) LIKE '%NUTRITION%' AND CDD_SERVICE_DTE BETWEEN '2018-10-01' AND '2019-09-30' AND CDD_DOC_NAME IN ('Follow Up - Nutrition', 'Initial Assessment - Nutrition', 'Progress Note - Nutrition') AND CDO_CTLG_DISPL_NM = 'Diet Instruction' AND CDO_MSTR_ITEM_NM = 'Initial_NUTASSMT_Instruct SUG' AND CDO_VALUE_TEXT LIKE '%Consistent carbohydrate/ diabetic diet%' SELECT DISTINCT CDD_MRN, CDD_DOC_GUID, CDD_SERVICE_DTE, CDD_DOC_NAME, CDO_SECTION, CDO_CTLG_DISPL_NM, CDO_MSTR_ITEM_NM, CDO_ITEM_NAME, CDO_VALUE_TEXT, OCV_CURR_LOC, U1.OU_DISPLAY_NAME AS "Author" FROM IDB.CD_DOCUMENT JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION ON CDO_DOC_GUID = CDD_DOC_GUID AND CDO_AUTHORED_DTE = CDD_AUTHORED_DTE JOIN IDB.OMS_CLIENT_VISIT OCV ON CDD_VISIT_GUID = OCV_VISIT_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_USER U1 ON CDD_AUTH_PROV_GUID = U1.OU_USER_GUID WHERE CDD_CANCEL_IND = '0' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND = '0' AND UPPER(CDD_DOC_NAME) LIKE '%NUTRITION%' AND CDD_SERVICE_DTE BETWEEN '2018-10-01' AND '2019-09-30' AND CDD_DOC_NAME IN ('Initial Assessment/Reassessment Amb - Nutrition', 'Miscellaneous Note, Amb - Nutrition') AND CDO_CTLG_DISPL_NM = 'Nutrition Education Intervention' AND CDO_MSTR_ITEM_NM = 'OUT_NUT_NEW Nut Ed Ther Diet RES' AND CDO_VALUE_TEXT LIKE '%consistent carbohydrate%'

prompt: Provide list of all scheduled 2020 and 2019 Lumbar Puncture patients and their wait times. We want to look at the entire process from start to finish. So when the PT/INR is collected and how long each step takes until resulted. Also want to see room-in time, in-room duration and wait times for LP patients.
completion: WITH VST AS (SELECT ENC.CPE_ENC_CSN_ID, ENC.CPE_ENC_DTE_SEQ , CPE_MRN MRN, STRIP(PT_LAST_NAME)||', '|| PT_FIRST_NAME PT_NAME, ENC.CPE_ENC_DTE VISIT_DATE, ENC.CPE_APPT_DT APPT_DT, ENC.CPE_APPT_MADE_DTE, ENC.CPE_APPT_LEN, ENC.CPE_CHK_IN_DT, ENC.CPE_RM_IN_DT, ENC.CPE_CHK_OUT_DT, ENC.CPE_RM_OUT_DT, ENC.CPE_RM_NO, VD.CLD_DEPT_NAME DEPT_NAME, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8, VT.CRE_RES_NAME VST_MD, VT.CRE_RES_TYP MD_TYPE, CVT_EXT_NAME VISIT_TYPE FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER ENC JOIN IDB.PATIENT_V ON CPE_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_PAS_PATIENT ON CPP_MRN = CPE_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT VD ON CPE_DEPT_ID = VD.CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE VT ON VT.CRE_RES_ID = CPE_VST_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID = CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID AND CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID = 7615 WHERE CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN '2019-01-01' AND CURRENT DATE AND CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CPE_ENC_TYP_CD = 50 ) SELECT MRN, PT_NAME, VISIT_DATE, LR_ACCESSION_NO, PR_LOCATION_CODE , PR_COLLECTION_DT SPECIMEN_COLLECTION, PR_RECEIVED_DT RESULT_RECEIVED, LR_ENTER_DT ENTER_INTO_SYSTEM, LR_TEST_NAME, MAX(CASE WHEN LR_SUBTEST_NAME = 'PT' THEN LR_RESULT_VALUE END) PT_RESULT, MAX(CASE WHEN LR_SUBTEST_NAME = 'INR' THEN LR_RESULT_VALUE END) INR_RESULT FROM VST LEFT JOIN IDB.LAB_RESULTS ON LR_MRN = MRN AND LR_PERFORMED_DTE = VISIT_DATE AND LR_TEST_NAME = 'PT&APTT' AND LR_SUBTEST_NAME IN ('PT', 'INR') LEFT JOIN IDB.PHLEBOTOMY_RECORDS ON MRN = PR_MRN AND LR_PERFORMED_DT = PR_COLLECTION_DT AND PR_ACCESSION_NO = LR_ACCESSION_NO AND PR_ORD_GUID = LR_ORD_GUID GROUP BY MRN, PT_NAME, VISIT_DATE, LR_ACCESSION_NO, PR_LOCATION_CODE , LR_PERFORMED_DT, LR_ENTER_DT, PR_COLLECTION_DT, PR_RECEIVED_DT , LR_TEST_NAME ;

prompt: Update report that displays daily IP and OP discharges from GMT Service to include SDH cases.
completion: SELECT OCV_MRN, OCV_ACCT_NO, OCV_VISIT_DTE, OCV_ADM_DT, OCV_DSCH_DT , OCV_VISIT_STS, OCV_IP_OP_IND, OCV_CARE_LVL , OCV_CURR_LOC, OCV_PVDR_NAME, OS_SVC_GRP_CD, OS_SVC_DESC , PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME FROM IDB.OMS_CLIENT_VISIT JOIN IDB.OMS_SERVICE ON OCV_SVC_GUID = OS_SVC_GUID JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT ON OCV_MRN = SSE_MRN AND SSE_SURG_DTE = OCV_VISIT_DTE JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PT_MRN = OCV_MRN WHERE OCV_VISIT_DTE = CURRENT DATE - 1 DAY AND OS_SVC_GRP_CD = 'GMT' AND OCV_IP_OP_IND = 'O' UNION ALL SELECT OCV_MRN, OCV_ACCT_NO, OCV_VISIT_DTE, OCV_ADM_DT, OCV_DSCH_DT , OCV_VISIT_STS, OCV_IP_OP_IND, OCV_CARE_LVL , OCV_CURR_LOC, OCV_PVDR_NAME, OS_SVC_GRP_CD, OS_SVC_DESC , PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME FROM (SELECT OCV_MRN, OCV_ACCT_NO, OCV_VISIT_DTE, OCV_ADM_DT, OCV_DSCH_DT , OCV_VISIT_STS, OCV_IP_OP_IND, OCV_CARE_LVL , OCV_CURR_LOC, OCV_PVDR_NAME, OS_SVC_GRP_CD, OS_SVC_DESC , PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME , ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY OCV_MRN, OCV_ACCT_NO, OCV_VISIT_DTE ORDER BY OCV_MRN, OCV_ACCT_NO, OCV_VISIT_DTE, OCV_DSCH_DT DESC) RN FROM IDB.OMS_CLIENT_VISIT JOIN IDB.OMS_SERVICE ON OCV_SVC_GUID = OS_SVC_GUID JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PT_MRN = OCV_MRN WHERE OCV_VISIT_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT DATE - 6 MONTH AND CURRENT DATE AND OS_SVC_GRP_CD = 'GMT' AND OCV_IP_OP_IND = 'I' AND DATE(OCV_DSCH_DT) = CURRENT DATE - 1 DAY ) IP WHERE RN = 1

prompt: Provide a list of brain tumor specimens from patients consented to 06-107 who have developed brain (parietal, cerebellar, or occipital) tumors or mets from before and after brain radiotherapy.
completion: WITH X AS (SELECT DISTINCT "t1"."PT_MRN" AS "MRN", PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_BIRTH_DTE, "t2"."PRPT_ACCESSION_NO" AS "Pathology Report", "t3"."DT_DTE" AS "Pathology Procedure Date", "t4"."DT_DTE" AS "Pathology Report Date", "t5"."PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_DESC" AS "Pathology Report Type", PRPT_ORD_DR_NAME, PRPT_ORD_DR_SVC_DESC, UPPER(CASE WHEN LENGTH(PRPT_REPORT) <= 15000 THEN RTRIM(CAST(SUBSTR(PRPT_REPORT, 1, 15000) AS VARCHAR(15000))) ELSE CAST(SUBSTR(PRPT_REPORT, 1, 15000) AS VARCHAR(15000)) END) AS TXT FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V" "t1" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED" "t6" ON "t1"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t6"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V" "t2" ON "t6"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t2"."PRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" "t3" ON "t2"."PRPT_PROCEDURE_DATE_ID" = "t3"."DT_DATE_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" "t4" ON "t2"."PRPT_REPORT_DATE_ID" = "t4"."DT_DATE_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATH_RPRT_TYPE_LOOKUP" "t5" ON "t2"."PRPT_REPORT_TYPE" = "t5"."PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_CD" WHERE 1=1 AND "t3"."DT_DTE" >= '2015-01-01' AND "t5"."PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_DESC" LIKE '%Surgical Pathology%' AND CONTAINS("t2"."PRPT_REPORT", '("BRAIN" OR "CNS" OR "CENTRAL NERVOUS SYSTEM" OR "FRONTAL" OR "PARIETAL" OR "CEREBELLAR" OR "OCCIPITAL")') = 1 AND CONTAINS("t2"."PRPT_REPORT", '("METS" OR "METAST")') = 1 ) , Y AS (SELECT DISTINCT RTC_TX_MRN, RTC_TX_PLAN_NAME, RTC_TX_START_DTE, RTC_TX_STOP_DTE, "Pathology Report", "Pathology Procedure Date", "Pathology Report Date", "Pathology Report Type", TXT, CASE WHEN AC_IRB_NO IS NOT NULL THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS "06-107 Consent" FROM X JOIN IDB.RADONC_TREATMENT_COURSE ON RTC_TX_MRN = MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.ACCRUALS ON AC_MRN = MRN AND AC_IRB_NO = '06-107' WHERE "Pathology Procedure Date" BETWEEN RTC_TX_START_DTE AND RTC_TX_STOP_DTE + 30 DAYS ) SELECT * FROM Y

WHEN CDO_ITEM_NAME = 'Assessment Type' THEN SUBSTR(CDO_VALUE_TEXT, 1, 255) END) "ASSESSMENT TYPE" , MAX(CASE WHEN CDO_ITEM_NAME = 'Reason For Visit' THEN SUBSTR(CDO_VALUE_TEXT, 1, 255) END) "REASON FOR VISIT" FROM IDB.CD_DOCUMENT JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION ON CDD_DOC_GUID = CDO_DOC_GUID JOIN IDB.VISIT V ON CDD_MRN = V.VIS_MRN AND CDD_ADM_NUM = V.VIS_ADM_NUM AND VIS_IP_OP_ADJUSTED_IND = 'I' AND THEN SUBSTR(CDO_VALUE_TEXT, 1, 150) ELSE '' END) "P2 LOCATION" , MAX(CASE WHEN CDO_ITEM_NAME = 'Pressure Injury (PI) 3 PI 3 stage' THEN SUBSTR(CDO_VALUE_TEXT, 1, 150) ELSE '' END) AS "P3 STAGE" , MAX(CASE WHEN CDO_ITEM_NAME = 'Pressure Injury (PI) 4 PI 4 origin' THEN SUBSTR(CDO_VALUE_TEXT, 1, 150) ELSE '' END) "P4 ORIGIN" , MAX(CASE WHEN CDO_ITEM_NAME = 'Pressure Injury (PI) 4 PI 4 location' MAX(CASE WHEN CDO_ITEM_NAME = 'Pressure Injury (PI) 5 PI 5 origin' THEN SUBSTR(CDO_VALUE_TEXT, 1, 150) ELSE '' END) "P5 ORIGIN" , MAX(CASE WHEN CDO_ITEM_NAME = 'Pressure Injury (PI) 5 PI 5 location' THEN SUBSTR(CDO_VALUE_TEXT, 1, 150) ELSE '' END) "P5 LOCATION" , MAX(CASE WHEN CDO_ITEM_NAME = 'Pressure Injury (PI) 6 PI 6 stage' THEN SUBSTR(CDO_VALUE_TEXT, 1, 150) ELSE '' END) "P6 STAGE" , THEN SUBSTR(CDO_VALUE_TEXT, 1, 150) ELSE '' END) "P6 LOCATION" FROM IDB.CD_DOCUMENT JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION ON CDD_DOC_GUID = CDO_DOC_GUID AND CDD_AUTHORED_DTE = CDO_AUTHORED_DTE AND CDO_VALUE_TEXT <> AND CDD_SERVICE_DTE BETWEEN '2020-01-01' AND '2021-12-31' AND CDD_CANCEL_IND = '0' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND = '0' AND CDO_ITEM_NAME LIKE 'Pressure Injury (PI)%' GROUP BY CDD_MRN, CDD_SERVICE_DTE, VIS_ADM_NUM, VIS_ADM_DTE, VIS_DSCH_DTE ;

prompt: Provide a daily listing of of order "edispo Physical Occupational Therapy OP Visit" along with corresponding specific appointment data.

"Visit Location", OCV_PVDR_NAME , OO_ORD_GUID FROM IDB.OMS_ORDER OO LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_STATUS ON OSTS_ORD_STS_CD = OO_ORD_STS_CD JOIN IDB.OMS_PROVIDER ON OO.OO_PVDR_GUID = OP_PVDR_GUID JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON OO_MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_USER_ORDERS OUO ON OO_ORD_GUID = OUO_ORD_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_CLIENT_VISIT OCV ON OO_VISIT_GUID = OCV_VISIT_GUID WHERE 1=1 AND OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID = '9000018231100730' AND OO_ORD_STS_CD NOT IN ('CANC', 'CANP', 'AUC3') ) , ORDER_ATTRIBS AS (SELECT DISTINCT OO_MRN, OUD_ENTER_DTE, OUD_ORD_GUID, OUD_USER_DI_CD, OUD_USER_DI_VALUE, OUD_UDDI_GUID FROM ORDERS JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_USER_DATA ON OO_ORD_GUID = OUD_ORD_GUID WHERE 1=1 AND OUD_USER_DI_CD IN ('Physical_Type of Visit', 'Physical_OT_Visits_Locations') ) , ORDER_TRANSPOSED AS (SELECT OO_MRN, OUD_ENTER_DTE, OUD_ORD_GUID , MAX(CASE WHEN OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'Physical_OT_Visits_Locations' THEN OUD_USER_DI_VALUE END) AS "Visit Loc" , MAX(CASE WHEN OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'Physical_Type of Visit' THEN OUD_USER_DI_VALUE END) AS "Visit Type" FROM ORDER_ATTRIBS GROUP BY OO_MRN, OUD_ENTER_DTE, OUD_ORD_GUID) SELECT ORD.* , "Visit Loc" , "Visit Type" , PT_LAST_NAME AS "Last Name", PT_FIRST_NAME AS "First Name" FROM ORDERS ORD JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON PT_MRN = OO_MRN LEFT JOIN DV.PATIENT_CORE_DEMOGRAPHICS ON PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = CORE_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID LEFT JOIN ORDER_TRANSPOSED XP ON XP.OUD_ORD_GUID = OO_ORD_GUID WHERE 1=1 ORDER BY OO_MRN DESC ; WITH ORDERS AS (SELECT DISTINCT OO_MRN AS MRN, OO_ENTER_DT AS "Enter DT", OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE AS "Significant Date", STRIP(OO_ORD_NAME) AS "Order Name", OO_ORD_STS_CD AS "Order Status", OSTS_STS_DESC AS "Status Desc", OO_ORD_PRIO AS "Priority", OO_SUMMARY_LINE AS "Summary Line", OUO_ATN_PVDR_NAME AS "Attending Name", OUO_PVDR_NAME AS "Provider Name", OUO_PVDR_ROLE_TYPE AS "Provider Role", OUO_USER_NAME AS "User Name", OUO_USER_ROLE_TYPE AS "User Role", OCV_CURR_LOC AS "Visit Location", OCV_PVDR_NAME FROM IDB.OMS_ORDER OO LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_STATUS ON OSTS_ORD_STS_CD = OO_ORD_STS_CD JOIN IDB.OMS_PROVIDER ON OO.OO_PVDR_GUID = OP_PVDR_GUID JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON OO_MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_USER_ORDERS OUO ON OO_ORD_GUID = OUO_ORD_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_CLIENT_VISIT OCV ON OO_VISIT_GUID = OCV_VISIT_GUID WHERE 1=1 AND OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID = '9000018231100730' AND OO_ORD_STS_CD NOT IN ('CANC', 'CANP', 'AUC3') ) SELECT ORD.* , PT_LAST_NAME AS "Last Name", PT_FIRST_NAME AS "First Name", PT_BIRTH_DTE AS "Date of Birth", PT_DEATH_DTE AS "Deceased Date", CASE WHEN PT_DEATH_DTE IS NULL THEN YEAR(CURRENT date - PT_BIRTH_DTE) END AS "Cur Age", CORE_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID WHERE 1=1 ORDER BY MRN DESC ; WITH ORDERS AS (SELECT DISTINCT OO_MRN AS MRN FROM IDB.OMS_ORDER OO LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_STATUS ON OSTS_ORD_STS_CD = OO_ORD_STS_CD JOIN IDB.OMS_PROVIDER ON OO.OO_PVDR_GUID = OP_PVDR_GUID JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON OO_MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_USER_ORDERS OUO ON OO_ORD_GUID = OUO_ORD_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_CLIENT_VISIT OCV ON OO_VISIT_GUID = OCV_VISIT_GUID WHERE 1=1 AND OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID = '9000018231100730' AND OO_ORD_STS_CD NOT IN ('CANC', 'CANP', 'AUC3') ) SELECT * FROM ORDERS ; WITH ORDERS AS (SELECT DISTINCT OO_MRN AS MRN, OO_ENTER_DT AS "Enter DT", OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE AS "Significant Date", STRIP(OO_ORD_NAME) AS "Order Name", OO_ORD_STS_CD AS "Order Status", OSTS_STS_DESC AS "Status Desc", OO_ORD_PRIO AS "Priority", JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON OO_MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_USER_ORDERS OUO ON OO_ORD_GUID = OUO_ORD_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_CLIENT_VISIT OCV ON OO_VISIT_GUID = OCV_VISIT_GUID WHERE 1=1 AND OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID = '9000018231100730' AND OO_ORD_STS_CD NOT IN ('CANC', 'CANP', 'AUC3') ) , APPTS AS (SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN AS "MRN", CPE_ENC_DTE AS "Appt Date", CPE_CPE_APPT_STS AS "Status", CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 AS "Department", CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 AS "Service", CLD_DEPT_NAME AS "Department Name", CRE_RES_NAME AS "Provider Name", CRE_RES_TYP AS "Provider Type", CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME AS "Visit Type" FROM CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE 1=1 AND CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Sch', 'Arrived', 'Comp') AND CPE_ENC_DTE >= '3/28/2023' AND CLD_DEPT_NAME IN ('BER OT PT' , 'MON OT PT' , 'NAS OT PT-2' , 'OT PT 300 E66' , 'OT PT 53-9' , 'OT PT KOCH-14' , 'OT PT WES') ) SELECT ORD.* , APPTS.* , PT_LAST_NAME AS "Last Name", PT_FIRST_NAME AS "First Name", PT_BIRTH_DTE AS "Date of Birth", PT_DEATH_DTE AS "Deceased Date", CASE WHEN PT_DEATH_DTE IS NULL THEN YEAR(CURRENT date - PT_BIRTH_DTE) END AS "Cur Age", PT_VITAL_STATUS AS "Vital Status", PT_SEX_DESC AS "Gender" FROM ORDERS ORD JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON PT_MRN = MRN LEFT JOIN DV.PATIENT_CORE_DEMOGRAPHICS ON PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = CORE_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID LEFT JOIN APPTS APPTS ON APPTS.MRN = ORD.MRN WHERE 1=1 ORDER BY APPTS.MRN DESC

prompt: Provide a list of solid tumor patients who received ifosfamide, cyclophosphamide, etoposide OR cisplatin AND received G-CSF anytime and have had at least one additional primary diagnosis.
completion: WITH APR AS (SELECT DISTINCT APR_MRN, YEAR(APR_START_DTE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) AS AGE, CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME, APR_START_DTE, APR_END_DTE, APR_ORD_RX_TYPE FROM IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX_V JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON APR_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE CDG_CHEMO_FLAG = 'Y' AND(UPPER(APR_GENERIC_NAME) LIKE '%IFOSFAMIDE%' OR UPPER(APR_GENERIC_NAME) LIKE '%CYCLOPHOSPHAMIDE%' OR UPPER(APR_GENERIC_NAME) LIKE '%CISPLATIN%' OR UPPER(APR_GENERIC_NAME) LIKE '%ETOPOSIDE%' OR UPPER(APR_DRUG_NAME) LIKE '%IFOSFAMIDE%' OR UPPER(APR_DRUG_NAME) LIKE '%CYCLOPHOSPHAMIDE%' OR UPPER(APR_DRUG_NAME) LIKE '%CISPLATIN%' OR UPPER(APR_DRUG_NAME) LIKE '%ETOPOSIDE%') ) , GCSF AS (SELECT DISTINCT OO_MRN , OO_ORD_NAME, OOTO_SIGNIFIC_DTE , OMD_DOSE_LOW AS "Dose", OMD_DOSE_UNIT AS "Unit" , OOTO_TASK_DOSE AS "DOSE (EMAR)", OOTO_TASK_UOM AS "Unit (EMAR)" FROM IDB.OMS_ORDER JOIN APR ON OO_MRN = APR_MRN JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON OO_MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_MED_DETAIL ON OO_ORD_GUID = OMD_ORD_GUID JOIN IDB.OAS_ORD_TASK_OCCR ON OOTO_ORD_GUID = OO_ORD_GUID AND OOTO_STATUS_CD = 'Performed' JOIN IDB.OAS_CTLG_ITEM_TASK ON OOTO_CAT_ITEM_GUID = OCIT_GUID AND OCIT_LEVEL_NO = 0 WHERE OO_ORD_STS_CD NOT IN ('CANC', 'CANP', 'AUC3') AND(UPPER(OO_ORD_NAME) LIKE '%NEUPOGEN%' OR UPPER(OO_ORD_NAME) LIKE '%NEULASTA%' OR UPPER(OO_ORD_NAME) LIKE '%FILGRASTIM%' OR UPPER(OO_ORD_NAME) LIKE '%PEGFILGRASTIM%') ) , TM1 AS (SELECT DISTINCT TM_MRN AS MRN, TM_DX_DTE AS DX_DATE, YEAR(TM_DX_DTE) AS DX_YEAR, CATEGORY2 AS SEER_CAT2, TM_SITE_CD AS SITE_CODE, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_DESC, TM_HIST_CD AS HIST_CODE, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS HIST_DESC FROM GCSF JOIN IDB.CDB_TUMOR ON TM_MRN = OO_MRN JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON TM_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.SEERGROUPING ON RECODE = DV.SEERF_ICDO(TM_SITE_CD, TM_HIST_CD) AND CATEGORY1 NOT IN ('Leukemia', 'Lymphoma', 'Myeloma', 'Miscellaneous', 'Non-Cancer', 'Invalid') JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD WHERE 1=1 AND TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND TM_DX_DTE BETWEEN '2012-01-01' AND '2016-12-31' AND YEAR(TM_DX_DTE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) <= 39 ) , TM2 AS (SELECT DISTINCT TM_MRN AS MRN, TM_DX_DTE AS DX_DATE, YEAR(TM_DX_DTE) AS DX_YEAR, CATEGORY2 AS SEER_CAT2, TM_SITE_CD AS SITE_CODE, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_DESC, TM_HIST_CD AS HIST_CODE, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS HIST_DESC FROM TM1 JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PT_MRN = MRN JOIN IDB.CDB_TUMOR ON TM_MRN = MRN JOIN IDB.SEERGROUPING TM2 ON RECODE = DV.SEERF_ICDO(TM_SITE_CD, TM_HIST_CD) JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD WHERE 1=1 AND TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND TM_DX_DTE > DX_DATE ) , TM AS (SELECT TM1.MRN, TM1.DX_DATE, TM1.DX_YEAR, TM1.SEER_CAT2, TM1.SITE_CODE, TM1.SITE_DESC, TM1.HIST_CODE, TM1.HIST_DESC FROM TM1 JOIN TM2 ON TM1.MRN = TM2.MRN UNION SELECT TM2.MRN, TM2.DX_DATE, TM2.DX_YEAR, TM2.SEER_CAT2, TM2.SITE_CODE, TM2.SITE_DESC, TM2.HIST_CODE, TM2.HIST_DESC FROM TM2) , X AS (SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY MRN ORDER BY DX_DATE) AS RN, MRN, DX_YEAR, SEER_CAT2, SITE_CODE, SITE_DESC, HIST_CODE, HIST_DESC FROM TM) SELECT MRN, MAX(CASE WHEN RN = 1 THEN DX_YEAR END) AS "Diagnosis Year 1", MAX(CASE WHEN RN = 1 THEN SEER_CAT2 END) AS "Diagnosis 1", MAX(CASE WHEN RN = 1 THEN SITE_CODE END) AS "Site Code 1", MAX(CASE WHEN RN = 1 THEN SITE_DESC END) AS "Site Description 1", MAX(CASE WHEN RN = 1 THEN HIST_CODE END) AS "Histology Code 1", MAX(CASE WHEN RN = 1 THEN HIST_DESC END) AS "Histology Description 1", MAX(CASE WHEN RN = 2 THEN DX_YEAR END) AS "Diagnosis Year 2", MAX(CASE WHEN RN = 2 THEN SEER_CAT2 END) AS "Diagnosis 2", MAX(CASE WHEN RN = 2 THEN SITE_CODE END) AS "Site Code 2", MAX(CASE WHEN RN = 2 THEN SITE_DESC END) AS "Site Description 2", MAX(CASE WHEN RN = 2 THEN HIST_CODE END) AS "Histology Code 2", MAX(CASE WHEN RN = 2 THEN HIST_DESC END) AS "Histology Description 2", MAX(CASE WHEN RN = 3 THEN DX_YEAR END) AS "Diagnosis Year 3", MAX(CASE WHEN RN = 3 THEN SEER_CAT2 END) AS "Diagnosis 3", MAX(CASE WHEN RN = 3 THEN SITE_CODE END) AS "Site Code 3", MAX(CASE WHEN RN = 3 THEN SITE_DESC END) AS "Site Description 3", MAX(CASE WHEN RN = 3 THEN HIST_CODE END) AS "Histology Code 3", MAX(CASE WHEN RN = 3 THEN HIST_DESC END) AS "Histology Description 3", MAX(CASE WHEN RN = 4 THEN DX_YEAR END) AS "Diagnosis Year 4", MAX(CASE WHEN RN = 4 THEN SEER_CAT2 END) AS "Diagnosis 4", MAX(CASE WHEN RN = 4 THEN SITE_CODE END) AS "Site Code 4", MAX(CASE WHEN RN = 4 THEN SITE_DESC END) AS "Site Description 4", MAX(CASE WHEN RN = 4 THEN HIST_CODE END) AS "Histology Code 4", MAX(CASE WHEN RN = 4 THEN HIST_DESC END) AS "Histology Description 4" FROM X GROUP BY MRN

prompt: Create a report which will provide the electronic documentation history of Fernando Castillo within the ClinDoc system.)
completion: SELECT X.TOUCHEDBY, DOCUMENTNAME, CAST(X.TOUCHEDWHEN AS date) AS 'TouchedWhen(date)', CAST(CAST(X.TOUCHEDWHEN AS TIME) AS VARCHAR(20)) AS 'TouchedWhen(time)', X.TOUCHEDWHEN, CONVERT(VARCHAR(12), CV.IDCODE) AS MRN, CV.CLIENTDISPLAYNAME AS 'Patient Name', CV.INTERNALVISITSTATUS, CURRENTLOCATION, CASE WHEN CONVERT(VARCHAR(12), CV.IDCODE) IN ('35169912', '35169912', '35348309', '35370536', '35370536', '35370536', '35370536', '35370536', '35196598', '35196598', '35196598', '35196598', '35348309', '35372738', '35372738', '35372738', '35372738', '35371900', '35371900', '35371900', '35364608', '35364608', '35364608', '35364608', '00044736', '00044736', '00044736', '00044736', '00992326', '00992326', '00044736', '00992326', '35196598', '35372738', '35364608', '00044736', '00992326', '00992326', '00992326', '00044736', '00044736', '00992326', '00044736', '00992326', '00992326', '00044736', '00044736', '00992326', '00992326', '00992326', '00044736', '00044736', '00992326', '00992326', '00992326', '00992326', '00992326', '00044736', '00044736', '00044736', '00992326', '00992326', '00044736', '35361697') THEN 'X' ELSE '' END AS 'Found in IDB Query' FROM DBO.CV3CLIENTDOCUMENT CDD(NOLOCK) INNER JOIN CV3CLIENTDOCPROVIDERXREF(NOLOCK) X ON CDD.GUID = X.CLIENTDOCGUID AND CDD.CLIENTGUID = X.CLIENTGUID INNER JOIN CV3CLIENTVISIT(NOLOCK) CV ON CV.GUID = CDD.CLIENTVISITGUID AND CV.CLIENTGUID = CDD.CLIENTGUID INNER JOIN CV3CAREPROVIDER(NOLOCK) CP ON X.PROVIDERGUID = CP.GUID WHERE X.TOUCHEDBY = 'Castillo, Fernando' AND X.TOUCHEDWHEN BETWEEN '12/17/2012' AND '12/29/2012'

prompt: Provide a list of patients that underwent radiation of the spine and subsequently had any of the specified complications.
completion: WITH RT AS (SELECT DISTINCT RTC_TX_MRN, RTC_TX_PLAN_NAME, RTC_PRIMARY_REF_POINT, RTC_TX_START_DTE, RTC_TX_STOP_DTE, RTC_TX_ELAPSED_DAYS, RTC_TX_PLANNED_FRACTIONS, RTC_TX_DELIVERED_FRACTIONS, RTC_TX_PLANNED_DOSE, RTC_TX_DELIVERED_DOSE, RTC_DOSE_CORRECTION FROM IDB.RADONC_TREATMENT_COURSE WHERE(UPPER(RTC_TX_PLAN_NAME) like '%SPIN%' OR UPPER(RTC_PRIMARY_REF_POINT) like '%SPIN%') AND UPPER(RTC_TX_PLAN_NAME) NOT LIKE '%LUMBAR%' AND UPPER(RTC_PRIMARY_REF_POINT) NOT LIKE '%LUMBAR%' AND RTC_TX_START_DTE BETWEEN '2010-01-01' AND CURRENT date) SELECT * FROM IDB.CLM WHERE CLM_CLSF_CD IN ('K22.3', '530.4', 'J86', 'J86.0', 'J86.9', '510', '510.0', '510.9', 'J85.3', 'J98.5', 'J98.51', 'J98.59', '519.2', '519.3', 'K22.2', '530.3', '530.1', '530.10', '530.11', '530.12', '530.13', '530.19', 'K20', 'K20.0', 'K20.8', 'K20.80', 'K20.81', 'K20.9', 'K20.90', 'K20.91', 'K21', 'K21.0', 'K21.00', 'K21.01') SELECT CC_MRN, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH AS DOB, RTC_TX_PLAN_NAME, RTC_PRIMARY_REF_POINT, RTC_TX_START_DTE, RTC_TX_STOP_DTE, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS INIT_EFF_DATE, CLM_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK FROM RT JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON RTC_TX_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.CTC_CLSF ON RTC_TX_MRN = CC_MRN JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND ((CC_PT_TYPE = 'I') OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) AND CC_CLSF_CD IN ('K22.3', '530.4', 'J86', 'J86.0', 'J86.9', '510', '510.0', '510.9', 'J85.3', 'J98.5', 'J98.51', 'J98.59', '519.2', '519.3', 'K22.2', '530.3', '530.1', '530.10', '530.11', '530.12', '530.13', '530.19', 'K20', 'K20.0', 'K20.8', 'K20.80', 'K20.81', 'K20.9', 'K20.90', 'K20.91', 'K21', 'K21.0', 'K21.00', 'K21.01') AND CC_EFF_DTE >= RTC_TX_START_DTE GROUP BY CC_MRN, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, RTC_TX_PLAN_NAME, RTC_PRIMARY_REF_POINT, RTC_TX_START_DTE, RTC_TX_STOP_DTE, CLM_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK

The PI is also curious as to why there are no patients prior to 2016 and only 5 before 2020 included in the original report. Can you please provide the date range for records included in the results?
completion: WITH APPTS AS (SELECT CPE_MRN AS "MRN", CPE_ENC_DTE AS "Appt Date", CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 AS "Department", CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 AS "Service", CRE_RES_NAME AS "Provider Name", ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CPE_MRN ORDER BY CPE_ENC_DTE ASC) ENC_ASC, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CPE_MRN ORDER BY CPE_ENC_DTE DESC) ENC_DESC FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE 1 = 1 AND CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND (UPPER(CRE_RES_NAME) LIKE '%GROMMES%CHRISTIAN%' OR UPPER(CRE_RES_NAME) LIKE '%MELLINGHOFF%INGO%' OR UPPER(CRE_RES_NAME) LIKE '%BOIRE%ADRIENNE%' OR UPPER(CRE_RES_NAME) LIKE '%BUDHU%JOSHUA%' OR UPPER(CRE_RES_NAME) LIKE '%COFFEE%ELIZABETH%' OR UPPER(CRE_RES_NAME) LIKE '%CORREA%DENISE%' OR UPPER(CRE_RES_NAME) LIKE '%DIAMOND%ELI%' OR UPPER(CRE_RES_NAME) LIKE '%GAVRILOVIC%IGOR%' OR UPPER(CRE_RES_NAME) LIKE '%GRAHAM%MAYA%' OR UPPER(CRE_RES_NAME) LIKE '%KALEY%THOMAS%' OR UPPER(CRE_RES_NAME) LIKE '%KHAKOO%YASMIN%' OR UPPER(CRE_RES_NAME) LIKE '%KOTCHETKOV%IVAN%' OR UPPER(CRE_RES_NAME) LIKE '%LIN%ANDREW%LEE%' OR UPPER(CRE_RES_NAME) LIKE '%MILLER%ALEXANDRA%' OR UPPER(CRE_RES_NAME) LIKE '%NOLAN%CRAIG%' OR UPPER(CRE_RES_NAME) LIKE '%PENTSOVA%ELENA%' OR UPPER(CRE_RES_NAME) LIKE '%PIOTROWSKI%ANNA%' OR UPPER(CRE_RES_NAME) LIKE '%SANTOMASSO%BIANCA%' OR UPPER(CRE_RES_NAME) LIKE '%SCHAFF%LAUREN%' OR UPPER(CRE_RES_NAME) LIKE '%STONE%JACQUELINE%' OR UPPER(CRE_RES_NAME) LIKE '%WILCOX%JESSICA%' OR UPPER(CRE_RES_NAME) LIKE '%WU%SYNPHEN%' OR UPPER(CRE_RES_NAME) LIKE '%AVILA%EDWARD%' OR UPPER(CRE_RES_NAME) LIKE '%CARVER%ALAN%' OR UPPER(CRE_RES_NAME) LIKE 'CHEN, XI' OR UPPER(CRE_RES_NAME) LIKE 'LAI, GEORGE' OR UPPER(CRE_RES_NAME) LIKE '%MAO%DAVID%' ) AND ((CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 = 'PED' AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 = 'NOC') OR (CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 = 'NEU')) ORDER BY CPE_MRN, CPE_ENC_DTE DESC ), NEU_VISIT AS (SELECT CPE_MRN AS "MRN", CPE_ENC_DTE AS "Appt Date", CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 AS "Department", CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 AS "Service", CRE_RES_NAME AS "Provider Name", ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CPE_MRN ORDER BY CPE_ENC_DTE ASC) NEU_ENC_ASC FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE 1 = 1 AND CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND ((CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 = 'PED' AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 = 'NOC') OR (CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 = 'NEU')) ), DX AS (SELECT CC_MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS DX_DTE, CC_CLSF_CD AS ICD_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS ICD_DESC FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE 1 = 1 AND (CC_CLSF_CD IN ('C69.20', 'C69.21', 'C69.22', 'H43.89', 'C85.90', '379.29', '190.5') OR UPPER(CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK) LIKE '%VITREAL%RETIN%LYMPH%' OR UPPER(CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK) LIKE '%VITREO%RETIN%LYMPH%' OR UPPER(CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK) LIKE '%INTRAOC%LYMPH%') AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND (CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) GROUP BY CC_MRN, CC_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK ), OTHER_DX AS (SELECT TM_MRN, AV_DESC AS CASE_STS, TM_DX_DTE, TM_HIST_CD, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS HIST_DESC, TM_SITE_CD, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_DESC, TM_BEST_AJCC_STG FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS ON AV_ELEMENT = 'CASE_STS' AND AV_CODE = TM_CASE_STS WHERE 1 = 1 AND TM_MRN IN (SELECT DISTINCT "MRN" FROM APPTS) AND TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') ORDER BY TM_MRN ) SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN , PT_LAST_NAME , PT_FIRST_NAME , PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH , PT_SEX , FIRST_APPT."Provider Name" , DX_DTE , ICD_CD , ICD_DESC , CASE WHEN PT_MRN IN (SELECT DISTINCT TM_MRN FROM OTHER_DX) THEN 'YES' ELSE 'NO' END OTHER_CANCER_DX , FIRST_APPT."Appt Date" FIRST_APPT , LAST_APPT."Appt Date" LAST_APPT , PLA_LST_CON_DTE LAST_CONTACT_DT , CASE WHEN PT_DEATH_IND IN ('', 'A') THEN 'ALIVE' ELSE 'DECEASED' END AS VITAL_STS , NEU_VISIT."Appt Date" FIRST_NEU_APPT FROM DX JOIN APPTS FIRST_APPT ON CC_MRN = FIRST_APPT."MRN" AND FIRST_APPT.ENC_ASC = 1 JOIN APPTS LAST_APPT ON CC_MRN = LAST_APPT."MRN" AND LAST_APPT.ENC_DESC = 1 JOIN NEU_VISIT ON CC_MRN = NEU_VISIT."MRN" AND NEU_ENC_ASC = 1 JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON CC_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY ON PT_MRN = PLA_MRN JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS ON AV_ELEMENT = 'DEATH_IND' AND AV_CODE = PT_DEATH_IND LEFT JOIN OTHER_DX ON PT_MRN = TM_MRN ; WITH APPTS AS (SELECT CPE_MRN AS "MRN", CPE_ENC_DTE AS "Appt Date", CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 AS "Department", CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 AS "Service", CRE_RES_NAME AS "Provider Name", ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CPE_MRN ORDER BY CPE_ENC_DTE ASC) ENC_ASC, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CPE_MRN ORDER BY CPE_ENC_DTE DESC) ENC_DESC FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE 1 = 1 AND CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND (UPPER(CRE_RES_NAME) LIKE '%GROMMES%CHRISTIAN%' OR UPPER(CRE_RES_NAME) LIKE '%MELLINGHOFF%INGO%' OR UPPER(CRE_RES_NAME) LIKE '%BOIRE%ADRIENNE%' OR UPPER(CRE_RES_NAME) LIKE '%BUDHU%JOSHUA%' OR UPPER(CRE_RES_NAME) LIKE '%COFFEE%ELIZABETH%' OR UPPER(CRE_RES_NAME) LIKE '%CORREA%DENISE%' OR UPPER(CRE_RES_NAME) LIKE '%DIAMOND%ELI%' OR UPPER(CRE_RES_NAME) LIKE '%GAVRILOVIC%IGOR%' OR UPPER(CRE_RES_NAME) LIKE '%GRAHAM%MAYA%' OR UPPER(CRE_RES_NAME) LIKE '%KALEY%THOMAS%' OR UPPER(CRE_RES_NAME) LIKE '%KHAKOO%YASMIN%' OR UPPER(CRE_RES_NAME) LIKE '%KOTCHETKOV%IVAN%' OR UPPER(CRE_RES_NAME) LIKE '%LIN%ANDREW%LEE%' OR UPPER(CRE_RES_NAME) LIKE '%MILLER%ALEXANDRA%' OR UPPER(CRE_RES_NAME) LIKE '%NOLAN%CRAIG%' OR UPPER(CRE_RES_NAME) LIKE '%PENTSOVA%ELENA%' OR UPPER(CRE_RES_NAME) LIKE '%PIOTROWSKI%ANNA%' OR UPPER(CRE_RES_NAME) LIKE '%SANTOMASSO%BIANCA%' OR UPPER(CRE_RES_NAME) LIKE '%SCHAFF%LAUREN%' OR UPPER(CRE_RES_NAME) LIKE '%STONE%JACQUELINE%' OR UPPER(CRE_RES_NAME) LIKE '%WILCOX%JESSICA%' OR UPPER(CRE_RES_NAME) LIKE '%WU%SYNPHEN%' OR UPPER(CRE_RES_NAME) LIKE '%AVILA%EDWARD%' OR UPPER(CRE_RES_NAME) LIKE '%CARVER%ALAN%' OR UPPER(CRE_RES_NAME) LIKE 'CHEN, XI' OR UPPER(CRE_RES_NAME) LIKE 'LAI, GEORGE' OR UPPER(CRE_RES_NAME) LIKE '%MAO%DAVID%' ) AND ((CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 = 'PED' AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 = 'NOC') OR (CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 = 'NEU')) ORDER BY CPE_MRN, CPE_ENC_DTE DESC ), DX AS (SELECT CC_MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS DX_DTE, CC_CLSF_CD AS ICD_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS ICD_DESC FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE 1 = 1 AND (CC_CLSF_CD IN ('C69.20', 'C69.21', 'C69.22', 'H43.89', 'C85.90', '379.29', '190.5') OR UPPER(CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK) LIKE '%VITREAL%RETIN%LYMPH%' OR UPPER(CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK) LIKE '%VITREO%RETIN%LYMPH%' OR UPPER(CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK) LIKE '%INTRAOC%LYMPH%') AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND (CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) GROUP BY CC_MRN, CC_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK ) SELECT TM_MRN, TM_DX_DTE, TM_HIST_CD, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS HIST_DESC, TM_SITE_CD, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_DESC FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS ON AV_ELEMENT = 'CASE_STS' AND AV_CODE = TM_CASE_STS WHERE 1 = 1 AND TM_MRN IN (SELECT DISTINCT "MRN" FROM APPTS) AND TM_MRN IN (SELECT DISTINCT CC_MRN FROM DX) AND TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') ORDER BY TM_MRN

prompt: List of all patients undergoing dedicated prostate MRI examinations between 2000-01-01 and 2019-02-28

prompt: Please provide the number of patients neuro-oncology patients seen in the last 6 months at MSK, number of palliative care consults placed in the past 6 months and how many of those were neuro-oncology patients, date that the neuro-onc placed a PACT consult, date that initial PACT consult took place
completion: SELECT CPE_MRN AS "MRN", CPE_ENC_DTE AS "Appt Date", CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 AS "Department", CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 AS "Service", CLD_DEPT_NAME AS "Department Name", CRE_RES_NAME AS "Provider Name", CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME AS "Visit Type", CVT_EXT_NAME AS "Visit Type External" FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 = 'NOC' AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 = 'PED' AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT date - 6 MONTH AND CURRENT date ; WITH CP AS (SELECT CPE_MRN AS "MRN", MIN(CPE_ENC_DTE) AS "Appt Date" FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 = 'NOC' AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 = 'PED' AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT date - 6 MONTH AND CURRENT date GROUP BY CPE_MRN), DX AS (SELECT PT_MRN, CASE_STS, TM_DX_DTE, TM_HIST_CD, HIST_DESC, TM_SITE_CD, SITE_DESC, MIN_ICD9_EFF_DTE, ICD9_CD, ICD9_DESC FROM IDB.PATIENT JOIN CP ON "MRN" = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN (SELECT TM_MRN, AV_DESC AS CASE_STS, TM_DX_DTE, TM_HIST_CD, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS HIST_DESC, TM_SITE_CD, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_DESC FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS ON AV_ELEMENT = 'CASE_STS' AND AV_CODE = TM_CASE_STS AND TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND TM_SITE_CD IN ('C710', 'C719', 'C716', 'C717', 'C718', 'C719', 'C711', 'C712', 'C713', 'C714', 'C715') AND TM_DX_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT DATE - 6 MONTH AND CURRENT DATE) AS CDB ON TM_MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN (SELECT CC_MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS MIN_ICD9_EFF_DTE, CC_CLSF_CD AS ICD9_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS ICD9_DESC FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE (CC_CLSF_CD LIKE 'C7A%' OR CC_CLSF_CD IN ('C72.30', 'D44.4', 'C71.6', 'C71.7', 'C75.3', 'D49.9', 'C71.9', 'C71.7', 'C71.9', 'C49.9', 'C72.9', 'C71.6', 'C71.4', 'C71.1', 'C71.3', 'C69.2', 'D43.2', 'C70.0', 'C70.1', 'C71.0', 'C71.1', 'C71.2', 'C71.3', 'C71.4', 'C71.5', 'C71.6', 'C71.7', 'C71.8', 'C71.9', 'D18.0', 'D32.0', 'D32.1', 'D32.9', 'D36.1', 'D35.2', 'D35.3', 'D35.4')) AND CASE WHEN CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y' AND CC_PT_TYPE <> 'E' THEN 'Y' WHEN CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' AND YEAR(CC_EFF_DTE) < 2004 THEN 'Y' WHEN CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND YEAR(CC_EFF_DTE) < 2001 THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END = 'Y' GROUP BY CC_MRN, CC_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK HAVING MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) BETWEEN CURRENT DATE - 6 MONTH AND CURRENT DATE) AS ICD9 ON CC_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE COALESCE(TM_MRN, CC_MRN) IS NOT NULL ) SELECT DISTINCT "MRN", "Appt Date", TM_DX_DTE, TM_HIST_CD, HIST_DESC, TM_SITE_CD, SITE_DESC, MIN_ICD9_EFF_DTE, ICD9_CD, ICD9_DESC FROM CP JOIN DX ON "MRN" = PT_MRN WHERE COALESCE(TM_DX_DTE, MIN_ICD9_EFF_DTE) > "Appt Date" ; WITH CP AS (SELECT CPE_MRN AS "MRN", CPE_ENC_DTE AS "Appt Date" FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 = 'NOC' AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 = 'PED' AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT date - 6 MONTH AND CURRENT date ), ORD AS (SELECT OO_MRN, OOC_ITEM_NAME, OOC_ITEM_DESC, OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE, OSTS_STS_DESC FROM IDB.OMS_ORDER JOIN CP ON "MRN" = OO_MRN JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_CATALOG ON OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID = OOC_MSTR_ITEM_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_STATUS ON OO_ORD_STS_CD = OSTS_ORD_STS_CD WHERE OOC_ITEM_NAME IN ('PACT Peds Pain and Palliative Care Team Outpatient Consult') AND OO_ORD_STS_CD NOT IN ('CANP', 'CANC', 'AUC3') AND OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT DATE - 6 MONTH AND CURRENT DATE ) SELECT DISTINCT "MRN", "Appt Date", OOC_ITEM_NAME, OOC_ITEM_DESC, OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE, OSTS_STS_DESC FROM CP JOIN ORD ON "MRN" = OO_MRN WHERE OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE >= "Appt Date" ;
