IDB_PATIENT."PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH" AS DATE_OF_BIRTH, ALLOWVALS_RACE."AV_DESC" AS RACE, ALLOWVALS_ETHNICITY."AV_DESC" AS ETHNICITY FROM "IDB"."PATIENT" AS IDB_PATIENT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS" ON IDB_PATIENT."PT_MRN" = "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_MRN" LEFT OUTER JOIN "IDB"."ALLOWVALS" AS ALLOWVALS_RACE ON IDB_PATIENT."PT_RACE" = ALLOWVALS_RACE."AV_CODE" AND ALLOWVALS_RACE."AV_ELEMENT" = 'RACE' LEFT OUTER JOIN "IDB"."ALLOWVALS" AS ALLOWVALS_ETHNICITY ON IDB_PATIENT."PT_PT_ETHNICITY" = ALLOWVALS_ETHNICITY."AV_CODE" AND ALLOWVALS_ETHNICITY."AV_ELEMENT" = 'PT_ETHNICITY') SELECT DISTINCT DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS.PT_MRN AS MRN, DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS.DATE_OF_BIRTH AS DATE_OF_BIRTH, DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS.RACE AS RACE, DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS.ETHNICITY AS ETHNICITY FROM KEYS LEFT OUTER JOIN DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS ON DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS.PT_DEID = KEYS.COHORT_PT_DEID; WITH PATHOLOGY_0 AS (SELECT "DV"."PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V"."PRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AS PT_DEID, "DV"."PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V"."PRPT_REPORT_TYPE_DESC" AS PATH_RPT_TYPE, CAST("DV"."PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V"."PRPT_REPORT" AS VARCHAR(32500)) AS PATH_RPT_TEXT FROM "DV"."PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V" JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS" ON "DV"."PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V"."PRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" WHERE "DV"."PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V"."PRPT_REPORT_DTE" BETWEEN CURRENT_DATE - 10 YEARS AND CURRENT_DATE AND "DV"."PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V"."PRPT_REPORT_TYPE_DESC" IN ('Surgical Pathology') AND SYSIBM.REGEXP_LIKE("DV"."PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V"."PRPT_REPORT", 'dermatofibroma', 'i')), COHORT AS (SELECT PT_DEID AS PT_DEID FROM (SELECT PATHOLOGY_0.PT_DEID AS PT_DEID FROM PATHOLOGY_0)), COHORT_PATHOLOGY AS (SELECT SUBJECT_ID AS SUBJECT_ID, PT_DEID AS PT_DEID FROM (SELECT PATHOLOGY_0.SUBJECT_ID AS SUBJECT_ID, PATHOLOGY_0.PT_DEID AS PT_DEID FROM PATHOLOGY_0)), KEYS AS (SELECT COHORT.PT_DEID AS COHORT_PT_DEID, COHORT_PATHOLOGY.SUBJECT_ID AS COHORT_PATHOLOGY_SUBJECT_ID, COHORT_PATHOLOGY.PT_DEID AS COHORT_PATHOLOGY_PT_DEID FROM COHORT LEFT OUTER JOIN COHORT_PATHOLOGY ON COHORT_PATHOLOGY.PT_DEID = COHORT.PT_DEID), PATHOLOGY_COLUMNS AS (SELECT DISTINCT "DV"."PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V"."PRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AS PT_DEID, "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_MRN" AS PT_MRN, "DV"."PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V"."PRPT_PATH_RPT_ID" AS SUBJECT_ID, "DV"."PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V"."PRPT_PATH_RPT_ID" AS REPORT_ID, "DV"."PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V"."PRPT_ACCESSION_NO" AS ACCESSION_NO, "DV"."PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V"."PRPT_REPORT_TYPE_DESC" AS PATH_RPT_TYPE, "DV"."PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V"."PRPT_REPORT_DTE" AS REPORT_DATE, "DV"."PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V"."PRPT_PROCEDURE_DTE" AS PROCEDURE_DATE, CAST("DV"."PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V"."PRPT_REPORT" AS VARCHAR(32500)) AS PATH_RPT_TEXT FROM "DV"."PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V" JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS" ON "DV"."PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V"."PRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID"), DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS AS (SELECT DISTINCT "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AS PT_DEID, IDB_PATIENT."PT_MRN" AS PT_MRN, "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AS prompt: We need a weekly list of first time cfDNA plasma prep orders and their order statuses
completion: WITH PTS AS (SELECT DISTINCT PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID P_ID, PT_MRN FROM DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V LEFT JOIN (SELECT TM_MRN, AV_DESC AS CASE_STS, TM_DX_DTE, TM_HIST_CD, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS HIST_DESC, TM_SITE_CD, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_DESC FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS ON AV_ELEMENT = 'CASE_STS' AND AV_CODE = TM_CASE_STS AND TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND TM_SITE_CD LIKE 'C50%') AS CDB ON TM_MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN (SELECT CC_MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS MIN_ICD9_EFF_DTE, CC_CLSF_CD AS ICD9_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS ICD9_DESC FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE SUBSTR(CC_CLSF_CD, 1, 3) IN ('174' , '175' , 'C50') AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND (CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) GROUP BY CC_MRN, CC_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK) AS ICD9 ON CC_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE COALESCE(TM_MRN, CC_MRN) IS NOT NULL AND PT_VITAL_STATUS = 'ALIVE' ) , ORDERS_R AS (SELECT OO_MRN, P_ID, OO_ORD_GUID, OO_ENTER_DTE, OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE, OO_SIGNIFICANT_DT, OO_ORD_STS_CD, OSTS_STS_DESC, OO_SUMMARY_LINE, DOC_NAME FROM PTS JOIN IDB.OMS_ORDER ON PT_MRN = OO_MRN JOIN IDB.DOC ON OO_REQ_DR_NO = DOC_DR_NO JOIN IDB.OMS_STATUS ON OO_ORD_STS_CD = OSTS_ORD_STS_CD WHERE OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID = '9000010830200730' AND OO_ORD_STS_CD IN ('RESC', 'RESF') ) , ORD_CNT AS (SELECT OO_MRN, COUNT(DISTINCT OO_ORD_GUID) CNT FROM ORDERS_R GROUP BY OO_MRN HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT OO_ORD_GUID) = 1) , OMS AS (SELECT R.OO_MRN, P_ID, OO_ORD_GUID, OO_ENTER_DTE, OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE, OO_SIGNIFICANT_DT, OO_ORD_STS_CD, OSTS_STS_DESC, OO_SUMMARY_LINE || ', ' || DOC_NAME OO_SUMMARY_LINE FROM ORDERS_R R JOIN ORD_CNT C ON R.OO_MRN = C.OO_MRN WHERE OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT date - 7 DAYS AND CURRENT date ) , ADDITIONAL_DETAILS_VALIDATION AS (SELECT DISTINCT OO_MRN MRN, OO_MRN EVENT_ID, OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE EVENT_DATE, OO_SIGNIFICANT_DT EVENT_DT, '' NAME, VARCHAR_FORMAT(OO_SIGNIFICANT_DT, 'YYYY-Mon-DD HH24:MI') VALUE, 'string' DATA_TYPE, 1 AS OB FROM OMS UNION ALL SELECT DISTINCT OO_MRN MRN, OO_MRN EVENT_ID, OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE EVENT_DATE, OO_SIGNIFICANT_DT EVENT_DT, '' NAME, TRIM(COLUMN_VALUES) VALUE, 'string' DATA_TYPE, 2 AS OB FROM OMS CROSS JOIN TABLE(DV.STRING_SPLIT(OO_SUMMARY_LINE, ', '))) , ADDITIONAL_DETAILS_XML AS (SELECT MRN, EVENT_ID, EVENT_DATE, EVENT_DT, XMLAGG(XMLELEMENT(NAME "row", XMLCONCAT(XMLELEMENT(NAME NAME, XMLATTRIBUTES(DATA_TYPE), NAME), XMLELEMENT(NAME VALUE, VALUE))) ORDER BY OB) ADDITIONAL_DETAILS FROM ADDITIONAL_DETAILS_VALIDATION GROUP BY MRN, EVENT_ID, EVENT_DATE, EVENT_DT) , DEID AS (SELECT P_ID , XMLDOCUMENT(XMLELEMENT(NAME COHORT_INCLUSION_EVENTS , XMLAGG(XMLELEMENT(NAME "row" , XMLELEMENT(NAME ADDITIONAL_DETAILS, ADDITIONAL_DETAILS OPTION EMPTY ON NULL))))) AS $xmldata$ FROM OMS LEFT JOIN ADDITIONAL_DETAILS_XML A ON OO_MRN = MRN GROUP BY P_ID)

prompt: Design an on-demand report of all patients whom have consented to 17-377 and are scheduled for surgery.
completion: WITH AC AS (SELECT AC_IRB_NO AS IRB_NO, STRIP(AC_MRN) AS MRN, STRIP(AC_LAST_NAME) AS "Last Name", STRIP(AC_FIRST_NAME) AS "First Name", AC_CONS_DTE AS "17-377 Consent Date", "06-107 Consent Date" FROM IDB.ACCRUALS LEFT JOIN IDB.ACCRUALS_DATES ON AC_MRN = ACD_MRN AND AC_IRB_NO = ACD_IRB_NO LEFT JOIN (SELECT AC_IRB_NO AS IRB_NO, AC_MRN AS MRN, AC_CONS_DTE AS "06-107 Consent Date" FROM IDB.ACCRUALS WHERE AC_IRB_NO = '06-107') A ON AC_MRN = MRN WHERE AC_IRB_NO = '17-377' AND ACD_OFF_STUDY_DTE IS NULL ) , SRG AS (SELECT DISTINCT SSE_MRN AS MRN, SSE_LOG_ID, SSE_SURG_DTE AS "Surgery Date", STRIP(SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC) AS "Procedure Description", STRIP(SSP_SURG_SVC_CD) AS "Service", STRIP(SSP_SURG_LAST_NM) || ', ' || STRIP(SSP_SURG_FIRST_NM) AS "Surgeon" FROM IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT JOIN AC ON SSE_MRN = MRN JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE ON SSE_LOG_ID = SSP_LOG_ID WHERE 1=1 AND SSE_SURG_DTE >= "17-377 Consent Date" AND SSP_SURG_SVC_CD = 'PLA' ) , X AS (SELECT MRN, "Surgery Date", LISTAGG(COALESCE(STRIP(CAST("Surgeon" AS VARCHAR(4000))), '') || ' | ' || COALESCE(STRIP(CAST("Procedure Description" AS VARCHAR(4000))), '') , CHR(13) || CHR(10)) WITHIN GROUP( ORDER BY MRN, "Surgery Date", "Surgeon", "Procedure Description") AS SURGERY FROM SRG GROUP BY MRN, "Surgery Date") , OC AS (SELECT OC_CASE_ID, OC_MRN AS MRN, OC_SURG_DTE, CRE_RES_NAME, OCAS_SURG_SVC, CPX_PROC_NAME FROM IDB.OR_CASE JOIN X ON OC_MRN = MRN JOIN IDB.OR_CASE_ALL_PROC ON OC_CASE_ID = OCAP_CASE_ID JOIN IDB.OR_CASE_ALL_SURG ON OCAP_CASE_ID = OCAS_CASE_ID AND OCAS_PNL_NO = OCAP_PNL_NO AND OCAS_SURG_ROLE = 'Primary' JOIN IDB.OR_PROC ON OCAP_OR_PROC_ID = OP_OR_PROC_ID JOIN IDB.OR_CL_PROC ON OP_OR_PROC_ID = OCP_OR_PROC_ID JOIN IDB.CL_PROC ON OCP_PROC_ID = CPX_PROC_ID JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CRE_RES_ID = OCAS_RES_ID WHERE OC_SURG_DTE >= CURRENT date AND OC_OR_CASE_STS_CD NOT IN ('2', '5') AND OCAS_SURG_SVC = 'PLA' ) , Y AS (SELECT MRN, OC_SURG_DTE, LISTAGG(COALESCE(STRIP(CAST(CRE_RES_NAME AS VARCHAR(4000))), '') || ' | ' || COALESCE(STRIP(CAST(CPX_PROC_NAME AS VARCHAR(4000))), '') , CHR(13) || CHR(10)) WITHIN GROUP( ORDER BY MRN, OC_SURG_DTE, CRE_RES_NAME, CPX_PROC_NAME) AS SCHEDULED_SURGERY FROM OC GROUP BY MRN, OC_SURG_DTE) SELECT DISTINCT AC.*, "Surgery Date", SURGERY AS "Surgery", OC_SURG_DTE AS "Scheduled Surgery Date", SCHEDULED_SURGERY AS "Scheduled Surgery" FROM AC LEFT JOIN X ON AC.MRN = X.MRN LEFT JOIN Y ON AC.MRN = Y.MRN

prompt: Provide a weekly list of NV/IR patients seen by Breast Surgery of the previous 2 weeks and their cT/cN staging.
completion: WITH COHORT AS (SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN AS "MRN", PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH AS "Date Of Birth", CPE_ENC_DTE AS "Appt Date", CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 AS "Department", CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 AS "Service", CLD_DEPT_NAME AS "Department Name", CRE_RES_NAME AS "Provider Name", CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME AS "Visit Type" FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON CPE_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 = 'BRE' AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT DATE - 14 DAY AND CURRENT DATE AND CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME IN ('BRE NV2', 'BRE NV3', 'BRE WALK IN IR1', 'IR NV', 'IR1', 'IR2', 'NV', 'NV1', 'NV3', 'OVBK IR1', 'OVBK IR2', 'OVBK NV1', 'OVBK NV3', 'PHONE IR', 'PHONE NV', 'TELEHEALTH IR', 'TELEHEALTH NV', 'TELEHEALTH NV1', 'TELEHEALTH NV2', 'TELEHEALTH NV3', 'WALK IN IR1', 'WALK IN NV1', 'BRE IR1', 'BRE IR2', 'BRE JOINT NV', 'BRE NEO IR1', 'BRE NEO NV1', 'BRE NEO NV3', 'BRE NV1') ), NOTES AS (SELECT CDD_MRN, CDD_SERVICE_DTE AS "Document Service Date", CDO_SECTION AS "Section", CDO_CTLG_DISPL_NM AS "CTLG_NAME", CDO_ITEM_NAME AS "Item", CDO_VALUE_TEXT AS "Value" FROM IDB.CD_DOCUMENT JOIN COHORT ON CDD_MRN = "MRN" LEFT JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION ON CDD_DOC_GUID = CDO_DOC_GUID AND CDD_AUTHORED_DTE = CDO_AUTHORED_DTE AND CDO_VALUE_TEXT <> '' JOIN IDB.OMS_PROVIDER ON CDD_AUTH_PROV_GUID = OP_PVDR_GUID WHERE CDD_CANCEL_IND <> '1' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND <> '1' AND CDD_DOC_NAME = 'Initial Visit, AMB - Breast Surgery' AND CDD_SERVICE_DTE BETWEEN "Appt Date" AND "Appt Date" + 2 DAY ) SELECT DISTINCT "MRN", "Date Of Birth", "Appt Date", "Provider Name", "Visit Type", "Document Service Date", MAX (CASE WHEN "Section" = 'ASSESSMENT' AND "Item" = 'ER' THEN "Value" END) AS ER, MAX (CASE WHEN "Section" = 'ASSESSMENT' AND "Item" = 'PR' THEN "Value" END) AS PR, MAX (CASE WHEN "Section" = 'ASSESSMENT' AND "Item" = 'HER2' THEN "Value" END) AS HER2, MAX (CASE WHEN "Section" = 'ASSESSMENT' AND "Item" = 'LATERALITY' THEN "Value" END) AS LATERALITY, MAX (CASE WHEN "Section" = 'ASSESSMENT' AND "Item" = 'Histology' THEN "Value" END) AS HISTOLOGY, MAX (CASE WHEN "Section" = 'ASSESSMENT' AND "Item" = 'Inflammatory?' THEN "Value" END) AS INFLAMMATORY, MAX (CASE WHEN "Section" = 'ASSESSMENT' AND "Item" = 'Clinical Staging T' THEN "Value" END) AS "Clinical Staging T", MAX (CASE WHEN "Section" = 'ASSESSMENT' AND "Item" = 'Clinical Staging N' THEN "Value" END) AS "Clinical Staging N", MAX (CASE WHEN "Section" = 'ASSESSMENT' AND "Item" = 'Clinical Staging M' THEN "Value" END) AS "Clinical Staging M", MAX (CASE WHEN "Section" = 'PHYSICAL EXAM' AND "CTLG_NAME" = 'Left Breast Findings' AND "Item" = 'Axilla Nodes:' THEN "Value" END) AS "Left Axilla Nodes", MAX (CASE WHEN "Section" = 'PHYSICAL EXAM' AND "CTLG_NAME" = 'Right Breast Findings' AND "Item" = 'Axilla Nodes:' THEN "Value" END) AS "Right Axilla Nodes" FROM COHORT LEFT JOIN NOTES ON CDD_MRN = "MRN" GROUP BY "MRN", "Date Of Birth", "Appt Date", "Provider Name", "Visit Type", "Document Service Date"

prompt: Provide the total number of patient visits per month for one year in ITC.
completion: WITH "cte1" AS (SELECT "t1"."PT_MRN" AS "MRN", "t2"."ENDP_DEPT_NAME" AS "Department Name", "t3"."ENVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR" AS "Visit Type Abbrev", "t4"."DT_DTE" AS "Encounter Date" FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V" "t1" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED" "t5" ON "t1"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t5"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_ENCOUNTER" "t6" ON "t5"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t6"."PENC_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."ENCOUNTER_DEPARTMENT" "t2" ON "t6"."PENC_DEPT_ID" = "t2"."ENDP_ENC_DEPT_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."ENCOUNTER_VISIT_TYPE" "t3" ON "t6"."PENC_VISIT_TYPE_ID" = "t3"."ENVT_ENC_VISIT_TYPE_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" "t4" ON "t6"."PENC_ENC_DATE_ID" = "t4"."DT_DATE_ID" LEFT JOIN (SELECT EDC_DEPT_ABBREV, EDC_DEPT_DESC FROM DV.ENCOUNTER_DESC_CATALOG WHERE EDC_GROUP_ID = 'STS' ) "t7" ON "t6"."PENC_APPT_STS" = "t7"."EDC_DEPT_ABBREV" WHERE ("t2"."ENDP_SERVICE_SPECIALTY_GRP_8" = 'ITC' AND (CASE WHEN "t7"."EDC_DEPT_DESC"IN ('Arrived', 'Completed') THEN 'Completed' WHEN "t7"."EDC_DEPT_DESC" IN ('Scheduled') THEN 'Scheduled' ELSE 'Non-Completed/Scheduled' END = 'Completed' AND "t4"."DT_DTE" BETWEEN '2012-11-1' AND '2013-10-31')) ) SELECT "t8"."Visit Type Abbrev" AS "Visit Type Abbrev-LBL-2", COUNT("t8"."MRN") AS "COUNT (MRN)" FROM "cte1" "t8" GROUP BY "t8"."Visit Type Abbrev"

prompt: Provide monthly report of skin biopsies done in all Dermatology clinics at MSKCC sites beginning of 9/30/2021 and monthly going forward
completion: WITH CTE AS (SELECT DISTINCT PBD_MRN, PBD_SVC_DTE VISIT_DATE, PBC_PBD_CD, PBC_CPT_CD, PBC_PBD_DESC, DOC_NAME, DOC_SVC, DOC_ACDMC_DPT, DOC_ACDMC_SVC FROM IDB.PBD_DTL_CHARGES JOIN IDB.PBD_CODE ON PBD_PBD_CD = PBC_PBD_CD JOIN IDB.PBD_INVOICE ON PBD_MRN = PBI_MRN AND PBD_ACCT_NO = PBI_ACCT_NO AND PBD_INV_NO = PBI_INV_NO JOIN IDB.DOC ON PBI_PERFORM_DR_NO = DOC_DR_NO WHERE PBD_PBD_CD like '42%' AND PBD_SVC_DTE BETWEEN LAST_DAY(CURRENT DATE - 2 MONTH) + 1 DAY AND LAST_DAY(CURRENT DATE - 1 MONTH) ) SELECT DISTINCT "t1"."PT_MRN" AS "MRN", "t1"."PT_LAST_NAME" AS "Last Name", "t1"."PT_FIRST_NAME" AS "First Name", "t1"."PT_BIRTH_DTE" AS "Date of Birth", VISIT_DATE AS "Visit Date", "t3"."PRPT_ORD_DR_NAME" AS "Physician", "t3"."PRPT_ACCESSION_NO" AS "ACCESSION NO", "t4"."DT_DTE" AS "Pathology Report Date", "t5"."PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_DESC" AS "Pathology Report Type", "t6"."DT_DTE" AS "Pathology Procedure Date" , CAST(SUBSTR("t3"."PRPT_REPORT", 1, 25000) AS VARCHAR(25000)) AS PATH_RPT FROM CTE JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS" "t1" ON PBD_MRN = "t1"."PT_MRN" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_CORE_DEMOGRAPHICS" "t2" ON "t1"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t2"."CORE_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED" "t7" ON "t1"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t7"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V" "t3" ON "t7"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t3"."PRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" "t4" ON "t3"."PRPT_REPORT_DATE_ID" = "t4"."DT_DATE_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATH_RPRT_TYPE_LOOKUP" "t5" ON "t3"."PRPT_REPORT_TYPE" = "t5"."PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_CD" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" "t6" ON "t3"."PRPT_PROCEDURE_DATE_ID" = "t6"."DT_DATE_ID" WHERE "t6"."DT_DTE" = VISIT_DATE AND ("t3"."PRPT_REPORT" IS NOT NULL) AND "t5"."PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_DESC" = 'Surgical Pathology' ORDER BY "t3"."PRPT_ORD_DR_NAME", VISIT_DATE, "t1"."PT_MRN";

prompt: Physician Billing and RMS Charges for CPT Codes 55700, 55705 and 55706
completion: WITH CTE AS (SELECT SSE_MRN, SSE_SURG_DTE, SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD, SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC, SSP_SURG_LAST_NM, SSP_SURG_FIRST_NM, SSP_SURG_SVC_CD, SSE_SURG_LOC FROM IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE ON SSE_LOG_ID = SSP_LOG_ID AND SSE_ENC_CSN_ID = SSP_ENC_CSN_ID WHERE 1=1 AND SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD IN ('55700', '55705', '55706') AND SSE_MRN IN ('38116994', '35280115', '38148945', '35163512', '38002195', '38009959', '38167261', '35520393', '38032184', '38155935', '35257127', '35475286') ) SELECT DISTINCT PBD_MRN "MRN", PBD_SVC_DTE "Service Date", PBI_INV_NO "Invoice No", PBC_CPT_CD "CPT Code", CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK "CPT Description", DOC_NAME "Surgeon", PBI_TOT_CHG_AMT "Total Charge", PBD_SVC_AMT "Service Amount", PBD_SVC_QTY "Service Qty", PBI_SVC_LOC "Service Loc", SSE_SURG_LOC "Surgery Location" FROM IDB.PBD_DTL JOIN IDB.PBD_CODE ON PBD_PBD_CD = PBC_PBD_CD JOIN IDB.CLM ON PBC_CPT_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.PBD_INVOICE ON PBD_INV_NO = PBI_INV_NO JOIN IDB.DOC ON PBI_PERFORM_DR_NO = DOC_DR_NO JOIN CTE ON PBD_MRN = SSE_MRN AND PBD_SVC_DTE = SSE_SURG_DTE ORDER BY PBD_SVC_DTE, PBD_MRN, PBI_INV_NO, PBC_CPT_CD ; WITH CTE AS (SELECT SSE_MRN, SSE_LOG_ID, SSE_SURG_DTE, SSE_SURG_LOC, VIS_VISIT_ID, VIS_ADM_DTE, VIS_DSCH_DTE, VIS_DAYS_STAY FROM IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE ON SSE_LOG_ID = SSP_LOG_ID AND SSE_ENC_CSN_ID = SSP_ENC_CSN_ID JOIN IDB.VISIT ON VIS_MRN = SSE_MRN AND VIS_VISIT_STATUS IN ('2', '3') AND VIS_ADM_DTE <= SSE_SURG_DTE AND COALESCE(VIS_DSCH_DTE, '2999-12-31') >= SSE_SURG_DTE WHERE SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD IN ('55700', '55705', '55706') AND SSE_MRN IN ('38116994', '35280115', '38148945', '35163512', '38002195', '38009959', '38167261', '35520393', '38032184', '38155935', '35257127', '35475286') ) SELECT DISTINCT RVCD_MRN "MRN", SSE_LOG_ID "Log ID", VIS_PATIENT_TYPE "Patient Type", RVCD_SVC_DTE "Service Date", DEPARTMENT_NAME "Department Name", CHARGE_DESCRIPTION "Charge Description", REV_CODE_DESC "Rev Code Desc", RVCD_AMT "Amount", RVCD_UNITS "Units", SSE_SURG_LOC "Surgery Location" FROM IDB.RMS_VISIT_CHARGE_DTL_V JOIN CTE ON VIS_VISIT_ID = RVCD_VISIT_ID ORDER BY RVCD_SVC_DTE, RVCD_MRN, DEPARTMENT_NAME

prompt: Provide data on females with urethral cancer and a pelvic MRI.
completion: WITH CDB AS (SELECT TM_MRN, TM_DX_DTE AS "Tumor Diagnosis Date", C.AV_DESC AS "Case Status", CC.AV_DESC AS "Class of Case", TM_HIST_CD AS "ICD-O Histology Code", H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS "ICD-O Histology Description", TM_SITE_CD AS "ICD-O Site Code", S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS "ICD-O Site Description", TM_PATH_TNM_T AS "Pathologic TNM T", TM_PATH_STG_GRP AS "Pathologic Stage Group", TM_GENERAL_STG AS "General Summary Stage" FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS C ON C.AV_ELEMENT = 'CASE_STS' AND C.AV_CODE = TM_CASE_STS LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS CC ON CC.AV_ELEMENT = 'CLASS_OF_CASE' AND CC.AV_CODE = TM_CLASS_OF_CASE LEFT JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD LEFT JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('3', '6', '7', '8') AND TM_SITE_CD IN ('C680', 'C681') ), CTC AS (SELECT CC_MRN, CC_CLSF_CD AS "ICD-9 Code", CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS "ICD-9 Description", MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS "ICD-9 Min Effective Date" FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND CC_CLSF_CD IN ('189.3', '189.4') GROUP BY CC_MRN, CC_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK ), PBD AS (SELECT PBD_MRN, PBC_CPT_CD AS "CPT Code", CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS "CPT Description", PBD_SVC_DTE AS "Procedure Date" FROM (SELECT DISTINCT TM_MRN AS MRN FROM CDB UNION SELECT DISTINCT CC_MRN AS MRN FROM CTC) AS A JOIN IDB.PBD_DTL ON PBD_MRN = MRN JOIN IDB.PBD_CODE ON PBD_PBD_CD = PBC_PBD_CD JOIN IDB.CLM ON PBC_CPT_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE PBC_CPT_CD IN ('72195', '72196', '72197') ) SELECT PT_MRN AS "MRN", PT_LAST_NAME AS "Last Name", PT_FIRST_NAME AS "First Name", PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH AS "Date of Birth", CASE WHEN PT_DATE_OF_DEATH IS NOT NULL THEN 'ALIVE' ELSE 'DECEASED' END AS "Vital Status", PT_DATE_OF_DEATH AS "Date of Death", "Tumor Diagnosis Date", "Case Status", "Class of Case", "ICD-O Histology Code", "ICD-O Histology Description", "ICD-O Site Code", "ICD-O Site Description", "Pathologic TNM T", "Pathologic Stage Group", "General Summary Stage", "ICD-9 Code", "ICD-9 Description", "ICD-9 Min Effective Date", "CPT Code", "CPT Description", "Procedure Date" FROM IDB.PATIENT JOIN PBD ON PT_MRN = PBD_MRN LEFT JOIN CDB ON PT_MRN = TM_MRN LEFT JOIN CTC ON PT_MRN = CC_MRN WHERE PT_SEX = 'F' WITH CDB AS (SELECT TM_MRN, TM_DX_DTE AS "Tumor Diagnosis Date", C.AV_DESC AS "Case Status", CC.AV_DESC AS "Class of Case", TM_HIST_CD AS "ICD-O Histology Code", H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS "ICD-O Histology Description", TM_SITE_CD AS "ICD-O Site Code", S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS "ICD-O Site Description", TM_PATH_TNM_T AS "Pathologic TNM T", TM_PATH_STG_GRP AS "Pathologic Stage Group", TM_GENERAL_STG AS "General Summary Stage" FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS C ON C.AV_ELEMENT = 'CASE_STS' AND C.AV_CODE = TM_CASE_STS LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS CC ON CC.AV_ELEMENT = 'CLASS_OF_CASE' AND CC.AV_CODE = TM_CLASS_OF_CASE LEFT JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD LEFT JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('3', '6', '7', '8') ), MRI AS (SELECT PBD_MRN AS MRI_MRN, PBC_CPT_CD AS "MRI CPT Code", CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS "MRI CPT Description", PBD_SVC_DTE AS "MRI Procedure Date" FROM IDB.PBD_DTL JOIN IDB.PBD_CODE ON PBD_PBD_CD = PBC_PBD_CD JOIN IDB.CLM ON PBC_CPT_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE PBC_CPT_CD IN ('72195', '72196', '72197') ), SURG AS (SELECT PBD_MRN, PBC_CPT_CD AS "Surgery CPT Code", CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS "Surgery CPT Description", PBD_SVC_DTE AS "Surgery Procedure Date" FROM MRI JOIN IDB.PBD_DTL ON PBD_MRN = MRI_MRN JOIN IDB.PBD_CODE ON PBD_PBD_CD = PBC_PBD_CD JOIN IDB.CLM ON PBC_CPT_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE PBC_CPT_CD IN ('51800', '52270', '52275', '53000', '53010', '53020', '53025', '53210', '53215', '53220', '53250', '53260', '53265', '53270', '54340', '54344', '54348') ) SELECT PT_MRN AS "MRN", PT_LAST_NAME AS "Last Name", PT_FIRST_NAME AS "First Name", PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH AS "Date of Birth", CASE WHEN PT_DATE_OF_DEATH IS NOT NULL THEN 'ALIVE' ELSE 'DECEASED' END AS "Vital Status", PT_DATE_OF_DEATH AS "Date of Death", "Tumor Diagnosis Date", "Case Status", "Class of Case", "ICD-O Histology Code", "ICD-O Histology Description", "ICD-O Site Code", "ICD-O Site Description", "Pathologic TNM T", "Pathologic Stage Group", "General Summary Stage", "MRI CPT Code", "MRI CPT Description", "MRI Procedure Date", "Surgery CPT Code", "Surgery CPT Description", "Surgery Procedure Date" FROM IDB.PATIENT JOIN MRI ON PT_MRN = MRI_MRN JOIN SURG ON PT_MRN = PBD_MRN LEFT JOIN CDB ON PT_MRN = TM_MRN WHERE PT_SEX = 'F'

prompt: Please provide a list of all admissions to pediatric inpatient units from Jan 2016 to Dec 2018
completion: WITH PTS AS (SELECT VIS_MRN, VIS_ADM_NUM, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_SEX, YEAR(VIS_ADM_DTE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) "Age at Admissions", VIS_ADM_DTE, VIS_DSCH_DTE, VIS_HOSP_SVC, TREATMENT_PLAN_DESC FROM IDB.VISIT_V JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON VIS_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE VIS_IP_OP_ADJUSTED_IND = 'I' AND VIS_VISIT_STATUS IN ('2', '3') AND VIS_ADM_DTE BETWEEN '2018-12-01' AND '2018-12-31' AND VIS_HOSP_SVC IN ('PDB', 'PDG', 'PDP', 'PDR', 'PDU', 'PED') AND VIS_MRN='38039917' ) , ADM_REASON AS (SELECT IDB.OMS_ORDER.OO_MRN, VIS_ADM_NUM, IDB.OMS_ORDER.OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE, SUBSTR(REPLACE(REPLACE(CAST(XMLSERIALIZE(CONTENT XMLAGG(XMLELEMENT(NAME "c", TRIM(IDB.OMS_ORD_USER_DATA.OUD_USER_DI_VALUE)) ORDER BY IDB.OMS_ORDER.OO_SIGNIFICANT_DT) AS CLOB(32000)) AS VARCHAR(32000)), '<c>', CHR(13) || CHR(10)), '</c>', ''), 2) AS "Admit Reason" FROM IDB.OMS_ORDER JOIN PTS C ON IDB.OMS_ORDER.OO_MRN = VIS_MRN AND IDB.OMS_ORDER.OO_ADM_NUM = VIS_ADM_NUM JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_USER_DATA ON IDB.OMS_ORDER.OO_ORD_GUID = IDB.OMS_ORD_USER_DATA.OUD_ORD_GUID WHERE IDB.OMS_ORDER.OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID = '3000003643073029' AND IDB.OMS_ORD_USER_DATA.OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'Nsg Reason Admission' AND IDB.OMS_ORDER.OO_ORD_STS_CD NOT IN('AUC3', 'CANC', 'DISC') GROUP BY IDB.OMS_ORDER.OO_MRN, VIS_ADM_NUM, IDB.OMS_ORDER.OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE, IDB.OMS_ORDER.OO_SIGNIFICANT_DT ) , CATH_R AS (SELECT SSE_MRN, SSE_SURG_DTE, SSP_LOG_ID, SSP_PROC_SEQ_NO, SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD, SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC , SSP_RES_ID, SSP_SURG_LAST_NM, SSP_SURG_FIRST_NM, SSP_SURG_SVC_CD, SSE_SURG_LOC FROM IDB.SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT ON SSE_LOG_ID = SSP_LOG_ID JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT VIS_MRN FROM PTS) A ON VIS_MRN = SSE_MRN WHERE SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD IN ('36555', '36561', '36558', '36491', '36490', '36489', '36488') ) , CATH AS (SELECT SSE_MRN, LISTAGG(SSE_SURG_DTE || ': ' || TRIM(SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD) || ' ' || TRIM(SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC), '; ') CATH FROM CATH_R GROUP BY SSE_MRN) , LABS_R AS (SELECT LR_MRN, VIS_ADM_NUM, VIS_ADM_DTE, VIS_DSCH_DTE, LR_PERFORMED_DTE, LR_TEST_NAME, LR_SUBTEST_NAME, LR_RESULT_VALUE, LR_UNIT_MEASURE, LR_ABNORMALITY_CD FROM PTS JOIN IDB.LAB_RESULTS ON VIS_MRN = LR_MRN WHERE LR_PERFORMED_DTE >= VIS_ADM_DTE AND LR_SUBTEST_NAME IN ('Abs Neut', 'Bacteria') AND LR_ABNORMALITY_CD <> 'U' ) , LABS_ANC AS (SELECT LR_MRN ANC_MRN, VIS_ADM_NUM, LISTAGG(LR_PERFORMED_DTE || ': ' || TRIM(LR_RESULT_VALUE) || ' ' || TRIM(LR_UNIT_MEASURE), CHR(13)||CHR(10)) ANC FROM LABS_R WHERE LR_SUBTEST_NAME IN ('Abs Neut') GROUP BY LR_MRN, VIS_ADM_NUM ) , LABS_BAC AS (SELECT LR_MRN BAC_MRN, VIS_ADM_NUM, LISTAGG(LR_PERFORMED_DTE || ': ' || TRIM(LR_RESULT_VALUE) || ' ' || TRIM(LR_UNIT_MEASURE), CHR(13)||CHR(10)) BAC FROM LABS_R WHERE LR_SUBTEST_NAME IN ('Bacteria') AND LR_PERFORMED_DTE BETWEEN VIS_DSCH_DTE AND VIS_DSCH_DTE + 1 MONTH GROUP BY LR_MRN, VIS_ADM_NUM ) SELECT VIS_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_SEX, "Age at Admissions", VIS_ADM_DTE, VIS_DSCH_DTE, VIS_HOSP_SVC, "Admit Reason", DATE(CBP_TRANSPLANT_DT) "BMT Date", CBP_TRANSPLANT_TYPE, CATH, ANC, BAC FROM PTS P LEFT JOIN NN.CRDB_BMT_PEDIATRICS ON VIS_MRN = CBP_MRN LEFT JOIN ADM_REASON AD ON VIS_MRN = OO_MRN AND P.VIS_ADM_NUM = AD.VIS_ADM_NUM LEFT JOIN CATH ON VIS_MRN = SSE_MRN LEFT JOIN LABS_ANC LA ON VIS_MRN = ANC_MRN AND P.VIS_ADM_NUM = LA.VIS_ADM_NUM LEFT JOIN LABS_BAC BAC ON VIS_MRN = BAC_MRN AND P.VIS_ADM_NUM = BAC.VIS_ADM_NUM

prompt: Provide a list of Retinoblastoma patients who were screened with a phone call between 3/30/2020 and 6/30/2020 prior to their Ophthalmology appointments with Drs. David Abramson and Jasmine Francis.
completion: WITH DX AS (SELECT DISTINCT STRIP(TM_MRN) AS MRN, STRIP(PT_LAST_NAME) AS LAST_NAME, STRIP(PT_FIRST_NAME) AS FIRST_NAME, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH AS DOB, PT_SEX AS GENDER, TM_DX_DTE AS DX_DATE, STRIP(TM_HIST_CD) AS HIST_CODE, STRIP(H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK) AS HIST_DESC, STRIP(TM_SITE_CD) AS SITE_CODE, STRIP(S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK) AS SITE_DESC, STRIP(LAT.AV_DESC) AS LATERALITY FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM H ON TM_HIST_CD = H.CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON TM_SITE_CD = S.CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON TM_MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS LAT ON LAT.AV_CODE = TM_LATERALITY_CD AND LAT.AV_ELEMENT = 'LATERALITY_CD' WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND TM_HIST_CD IN ('M9510/3', 'M9511/3', 'M9512/3', 'M9513/3') ) , CPE AS (SELECT DISTINCT MRN, LAST_NAME, FIRST_NAME, GENDER, DOB, DX_DATE, HIST_CODE, HIST_DESC, CPE_ENC_DTE, CPE_APPT_DT, CRE_RES_NAME, CLD_DEPT_NAME, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8, CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID, CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME, CPE_CPE_APPT_STS, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CPE_MRN ORDER BY CPE_ENC_DTE DESC) AS RN FROM DX JOIN IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER ON CPE_MRN = MRN JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp', 'Can') AND CRE_RES_TYP IN ('Physician') AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN '2020-03-30' AND '2020-06-30' AND CLD_DEPT_NAME = 'OPHTHALMIC ONC 1275' AND(CRE_RES_ID = '011593' OR CRE_RES_ID = '016840') ) , CD AS (SELECT DISTINCT CPE.*, CDD_SERVICE_DT, CDD_DOC_NAME FROM CPE JOIN IDB.CD_DOCUMENT ON CDD_MRN = MRN JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION ON CDO_DOC_GUID = CDD_DOC_GUID AND CDO_AUTHORED_DTE = CDD_AUTHORED_DTE WHERE CDD_CANCEL_IND = '0' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND = '0' AND(UPPER(CDD_DOC_NAME) LIKE '%TELEPHONE%' OR UPPER(CDD_DOC_NAME) LIKE '%NURSING%EVENT%NOTE%OUTPATIENT%SPECIMEN%') AND CDD_SERVICE_DT BETWEEN CPE_APPT_DT - 72 HOURS AND CPE_APPT_DT ) SELECT DISTINCT CD.*, RESULT, DATE(MIN_IDENTIFIED_DT) AS IDENTIFIED_DATE, DATE(MIN_RESULT_DT) AS RESULT_DATE FROM IDB.COVID19_PATIENT_INFO COV JOIN CD ON CD.MRN = COV.MRN

prompt: Provide the number of FOLFOX and FOlFORI doses dispensed at 53rd street for 2010.
completion: WITH CTE AS (SELECT PO_MRN, PAA_ADMIN_DTE, PIN_GENERIC_NAME, SUM(PAA_DOSES) AS DOSES FROM IDB.PHM_ORDER JOIN IDB.PHM_ORD_DTL ON PO_ORD_SEQ = POD_ORD_SEQ JOIN IDB.PHM_ORD_INV ON POD_ORD_SEQ = POI_ORD_SEQ AND POD_ITEM_NO = POI_ITEM_NO JOIN IDB.PHM_INVENTORY ON POI_INV_SEQ = PIN_INV_SEQ JOIN IDB.PHM_AUD_ADMIN ON PAA_ORD_SEQ = POI_ORD_SEQ AND PAA_ITEM_NO = POI_ITEM_NO AND PAA_ORD_INV_SEQ = POI_ORD_INV_SEQ WHERE PO_ORD_STS NOT IN ('X', 'P') AND PAA_ADMIN_DTE BETWEEN '2010-1-1' AND '2010-12-31' AND PIN_GENERIC_NAME IN ('Fluorouracil', 'IRINOtecan HCl', 'Leucovorin Calcium', 'OXALIplatin') AND PO_DISP_LOC_NAME IN ('53rd Street Clinic', '53rd Street Retail', '53RD') GROUP BY PO_MRN, PAA_ADMIN_DTE, PIN_GENERIC_NAME HAVING SUM(PAA_DOSES) > 0) SELECT COUNT(*), SUM(A.DOSES), SUM(B.DOSES), SUM(C.DOSES) FROM CTE A JOIN CTE B ON A.PO_MRN = B.PO_MRN AND A.PAA_ADMIN_DTE = B.PAA_ADMIN_DTE AND B.PIN_GENERIC_NAME = 'Fluorouracil' JOIN CTE C ON A.PO_MRN = C.PO_MRN AND A.PAA_ADMIN_DTE = C.PAA_ADMIN_DTE AND C.PIN_GENERIC_NAME = 'OXALIplatin' WHERE A.PIN_GENERIC_NAME = 'Leucovorin Calcium' WITH CTE AS (SELECT PO_MRN, PAA_ADMIN_DTE, PIN_GENERIC_NAME, SUM(PAA_DOSES) AS DOSES FROM IDB.PHM_ORDER JOIN IDB.PHM_ORD_DTL ON PO_ORD_SEQ = POD_ORD_SEQ JOIN IDB.PHM_ORD_INV ON POD_ORD_SEQ = POI_ORD_SEQ AND POD_ITEM_NO = POI_ITEM_NO JOIN IDB.PHM_INVENTORY ON POI_INV_SEQ = PIN_INV_SEQ JOIN IDB.PHM_AUD_ADMIN ON PAA_ORD_SEQ = POI_ORD_SEQ AND PAA_ITEM_NO = POI_ITEM_NO AND PAA_ORD_INV_SEQ = POI_ORD_INV_SEQ WHERE PO_ORD_STS NOT IN ('X', 'P') AND PAA_ADMIN_DTE BETWEEN '2010-1-1' AND '2010-12-31' AND PIN_GENERIC_NAME IN ('Fluorouracil', 'IRINOtecan HCl', 'Leucovorin Calcium', 'OXALIplatin') AND PO_DISP_LOC_NAME IN ('53rd Street Clinic', '53rd Street Retail', '53RD') GROUP BY PO_MRN, PAA_ADMIN_DTE, PIN_GENERIC_NAME HAVING SUM(PAA_DOSES) > 0) SELECT COUNT(*), SUM(A.DOSES), SUM(B.DOSES), SUM(C.DOSES) FROM CTE A JOIN CTE B ON A.PO_MRN = B.PO_MRN AND A.PAA_ADMIN_DTE = B.PAA_ADMIN_DTE AND B.PIN_GENERIC_NAME = 'Fluorouracil' JOIN CTE C ON A.PO_MRN = C.PO_MRN AND A.PAA_ADMIN_DTE = C.PAA_ADMIN_DTE AND C.PIN_GENERIC_NAME = 'IRINOtecan HCl' WHERE A.PIN_GENERIC_NAME = 'Leucovorin Calcium'

prompt: To see who is a colorectal pt scheduled in surv at NAS.
completion: SELECT CPE_MRN MRN , TRIM(PT_LAST_NAME) || ', ' || TRIM(PT_FIRST_NAME) PT_NAME , CPE_ENC_DTE APPT_DTE , C.CLD_DEPT_NAME LOCATION , A.CRE_RES_NAME PROVIDER_NAME , B.CRE_RES_NAME REFERRING_PROV_NAME , CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME VISIT_TYPE FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON CPE_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE A ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = A.CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE B ON CPE_REF_RES_ID = B.CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT C ON CPE_DEPT_ID = C.CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT D ON CPE_REF_DEP_ID = D.CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS = 'Sch' AND CPE_ENC_DTE <= '2021-04-30' AND C.CLD_DEPT_NAME = 'NAS SURVIVORSHIP-2' AND ((CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME LIKE '%SNP %' OR CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR like '%SAPP %') AND CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME like '%COL %' OR CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME like '%PHONE%' OR CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME like '%TELE%')

prompt: List of patients scheduled for both Massage and PT/OT appts on same date.
completion: WITH PTOT_APPT AS (SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN AS PTOT_MRN, CPE_ENC_DTE AS PTOT_DTE, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 AS PTOT_DEPT, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 AS PTOT_SERVICE, CLD_DEPT_NAME AS PTOT_DEPT_NAME, CRE_RES_NAME AS PTOT_PROVIDER, CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME AS PTOT_VISIT_TYPE FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE 1=1 AND CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Sch') AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT date AND CURRENT date + 14 DAYS AND CLD_DEPT_ID IN (182, 412, 613, 615, 859, 1073, 1157, 1198, 1318, 1603) ) , MASSAGE_APPT AS (SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN AS M_MRN, CPE_ENC_DTE AS M_DTE, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 AS M_DEPT, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 AS M_SERVICE, CLD_DEPT_NAME AS M_DEPT_NAME, CRE_RES_NAME AS M_PROVIDER, CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME AS M_VISIT_TYPE FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE 1=1 AND CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Sch') AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT date AND CURRENT date + 14 DAYS AND CLD_DEPT_NAME IN ('INTEG MED 74', 'INTEG MED 300 E66') ) SELECT DISTINCT PTOT_MRN AS "MRN" , PT_LAST_NAME AS "PT Last Name" , PT_FIRST_NAME AS "PT First Name" , PTOT_DTE AS "PT/OT Sch Dte" , PTOT_VISIT_TYPE AS "PT/OT Visit Type" , PTOT_PROVIDER AS "PT/OT Provider" , M_DTE AS "Massage Sch Dte" , M_VISIT_TYPE AS "Massage Visit Type" , M_PROVIDER AS "Massage Provider" FROM PTOT_APPT JOIN MASSAGE_APPT ON PTOT_MRN = M_MRN AND PTOT_DTE = M_DTE JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PTOT_MRN = PT_MRN ;

prompt: Employees tested positive after 1/21/22 who are eligible but did not receive booster
completion: WITH COVID AS (SELECT EMPLOYEE_ID, RESULT, DATE(LATEST_MIN_INF_ID_DT) LATEST_MIN_INF_ID_DTE FROM IDB.COVID19_EMPLOYEE_INFO WHERE RESULT IN ('Positive', 'Resolved') AND DATE(LATEST_MIN_INF_ID_DT) >= CURRENT DATE - 30 DAYS ) SELECT EVI_EMPLOYEE_ID, CVP_FIRST_NAME, CVP_LAST_NAME, FIRST_BOOSTER_ELIGIBLE_DTE, RESULT, LATEST_MIN_INF_ID_DTE FROM IDB.COVID19_EMPLOYEE_VACCINE_INFO JOIN IDB.COVID19_VACCINE_PERSON ON EVI_EMPLOYEE_ID = CVP_EMPLOYEE_ID AND CVP_STATUS <> 'Terminated' JOIN COVID ON EVI_EMPLOYEE_ID = EMPLOYEE_ID WHERE FIRST_BOOSTER_COMPLIANT <> 'Y' AND FIRST_BOOSTER_ELIGIBLE_DTE <= CURRENT DATE

prompt: Provide a weekly list of patients who has an appointment with Dr. Daniel Prince for the current week and the following week.
completion: WITH INIT AS (SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN AS "MRN", PT_LAST_NAME AS "First_Name", PT_FIRST_NAME AS "Last_Name", CPE_ENC_DTE AS "Appt Date", TIME(CPE_APPT_DT) AS "Appt Time", CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 AS "Department", CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 AS "Service", CLD_DEPT_NAME AS "Department Name", CRE_RES_NAME AS "Provider Name", CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME AS "Visit Type", CVT_EXT_NAME AS "Visit Type External" FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON CPE_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Sch') AND CRE_RES_NAME = 'PRINCE, DANIEL EDUARDO' AND CRE_RES_TYP IN ('Physician', 'PhD', 'Dentist', 'Psychologist') AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT DATE AND CURRENT DATE + 28 DAY ), X1 AS (SELECT "MRN", MAX("Appt Date") MAX_APPT_DATE FROM INIT GROUP BY "MRN") , NEXTAPP AS (SELECT DISTINCT * FROM (SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN AS "NEXT_MRN", CPE_ENC_DTE AS "Next Appt Date", CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 AS "Next Service", CRE_RES_NAME AS "Next Provider Name", ROWNUMBER () OVER(PARTITION BY CPE_MRN ORDER BY CPE_ENC_DTE ASC) RN FROM X1 LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER ON "MRN" = CPE_MRN JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON CPE_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Sch') AND CRE_RES_TYP IN ('Physician', 'PhD', 'Dentist', 'Psychologist') AND MAX_APPT_DATE < CPE_ENC_DTE ) WHERE RN= 1 ) , PROTOCOL AS (SELECT DISTINCT "MRN" AS P_MRN, AC_IRB_NO FROM INIT LEFT JOIN IDB.ACCRUALS ON "MRN" = AC_MRN AND AC_IRB_NO IN ('18-014', '21-216')) SELECT DISTINCT "MRN", "First_Name", "Last_Name", "Appt Date", "Appt Time", "Department", "Service", "Department Name", "Provider Name", "Visit Type", "Visit Type External", AC_IRB_NO AS "Protocol No", "Next Appt Date", "Next Provider Name", "Next Service" FROM INIT LEFT JOIN PROTOCOL ON "MRN" = P_MRN LEFT JOIN NEXTAPP ON "MRN" = "NEXT_MRN" ORDER BY "Appt Date", "Appt Time" ;

prompt: Provide a list of patients with a diagnosis of Multiple Myeloma who were treated with the bispecific therapies Teclistamab and Elranatamab between 1/1/2010 and 11/1/2023.
completion: WITH DX AS (SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN, TRIM(PT_LAST_NAME)||','||TRIM(PT_FIRST_NAME) AS PATIENT_NAME, TM_DX_DTE, TM_HIST_CD, HIST_DESC, TM_SITE_CD, SITE_DESC, MIN_ICD9_EFF_DTE, ICD9_CD, ICD9_DESC FROM IDB.PATIENT LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT TM_MRN, AV_DESC AS CASE_STS, TM_DX_DTE, TM_HIST_CD, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS HIST_DESC, TM_SITE_CD, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_DESC FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS ON AV_ELEMENT = 'CASE_STS' AND AV_CODE = TM_CASE_STS AND TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND TM_HIST_CD IN ('M9731/3', 'M9732/3', 'M9734/3') AND TM_DX_DTE BETWEEN '1990-01-01' AND '2023-11-01') AS CDB ON TM_MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT CC_MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS MIN_ICD9_EFF_DTE, CC_CLSF_CD AS ICD9_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS ICD9_DESC FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE CC_CLSF_CD IN ('203', '203.0', '203.00', '203.01', '203.02', '238.6', 'C90.0', 'C90.00', 'C90.01', 'C90.02', 'C90.2', 'C90.20', 'C90.21', 'C90.22', 'C90.30', 'C90.31', 'C90.32') AND CASE WHEN CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y' AND CC_PT_TYPE <> 'E' THEN 'Y' WHEN CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' AND YEAR(CC_EFF_DTE) < 2004 THEN 'Y' WHEN CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND YEAR(CC_EFF_DTE) < 2001 THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END = 'Y' GROUP BY CC_MRN, CC_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK HAVING MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) BETWEEN '1990-01-01' AND '2023-11-01') AS ICD9 ON CC_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE COALESCE(TM_MRN, CC_MRN) IS NOT NULL ), APR AS (SELECT DISTINCT APR_MRN, APR_START_DTE, APR_END_DTE, CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME, APR_GENERIC_NAME, APR_PRESCRIBED_DOSE, APR_ROUTE FROM DX JOIN IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX ON PT_MRN = APR_MRN JOIN IDB.CHEMO_DRUG_GENERIC ON APR_GENERIC_NAME = CDG_GENERIC_NAME WHERE CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME IN ('ELRANATAMAB', 'TECLISTAMAB') AND APR_START_DTE BETWEEN '2010-01-01' AND '2023-11-01' ) SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN AS MRN, PATIENT_NAME AS "Patient Name", TM_DX_DTE AS "Tumor Diagnosis Date", TM_HIST_CD AS "Histology Code", HIST_DESC AS "Histology Description", TM_SITE_CD AS "Site Code", SITE_DESC AS "Site Description", MIN_ICD9_EFF_DTE AS "ICD Date", ICD9_CD AS "ICD Code", ICD9_DESC AS "ICD Description", APR_START_DTE AS "Drug Start Date", APR_END_DTE AS "Drug End Date", CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME AS "Drug Name" FROM DX JOIN APR ON APR_MRN = PT_MRN ORDER BY PT_MRN ; WITH DX AS (SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN, TRIM(PT_LAST_NAME)||','||TRIM(PT_FIRST_NAME) AS PATIENT_NAME, TM_DX_DTE, TM_HIST_CD, HIST_DESC, TM_SITE_CD, SITE_DESC, MIN_ICD9_EFF_DTE, ICD9_CD, ICD9_DESC FROM IDB.PATIENT LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT TM_MRN, AV_DESC AS CASE_STS, TM_DX_DTE, TM_HIST_CD, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS HIST_DESC, TM_SITE_CD, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_DESC FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS ON AV_ELEMENT = 'CASE_STS' AND AV_CODE = TM_CASE_STS AND TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND TM_HIST_CD IN ('M9731/3', 'M9732/3', 'M9734/3') AND TM_DX_DTE BETWEEN '1990-01-01' AND '2023-11-01') AS CDB ON TM_MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT CC_MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS MIN_ICD9_EFF_DTE, CC_CLSF_CD AS ICD9_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS ICD9_DESC FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE CC_CLSF_CD IN ('203', '203.0', '203.00', '203.01', '203.02', '238.6', 'C90.0', 'C90.00', 'C90.01', 'C90.02', 'C90.2', 'C90.20', 'C90.21', 'C90.22', 'C90.30', 'C90.31', 'C90.32') AND CASE WHEN CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y' AND CC_PT_TYPE <> 'E' THEN 'Y' WHEN CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' AND YEAR(CC_EFF_DTE) < 2004 THEN 'Y' WHEN CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND YEAR(CC_EFF_DTE) < 2001 THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END = 'Y' GROUP BY CC_MRN, CC_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK HAVING MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) BETWEEN '1990-01-01' AND '2023-11-01') AS ICD9 ON CC_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE COALESCE(TM_MRN, CC_MRN) IS NOT NULL ), APR AS (SELECT DISTINCT APR_MRN, APR_START_DTE, APR_END_DTE, CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME, APR_GENERIC_NAME, APR_PRESCRIBED_DOSE, APR_ROUTE FROM DX JOIN IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX ON PT_MRN = APR_MRN JOIN IDB.CHEMO_DRUG_GENERIC ON APR_GENERIC_NAME = CDG_GENERIC_NAME WHERE CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME IN ('ELRANATAMAB', 'TECLISTAMAB') AND APR_START_DTE BETWEEN '2010-01-01' AND '2023-11-01' ), RAD AS (SELECT DISTINCT RRPT_MRN, APR_START_DTE AS DRUG_DATE, RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE, RRPT_RPT_ID, RRPT_ACCESSION_NO, RRPT_ORDER_GROUP, RRPT_PROCEDURE_NAME, VARCHAR(RRPT_REPORT_TXT, 32000) AS REPORT_TEXT FROM APR JOIN DV.RADIOLOGY_REPORT_V ON RRPT_MRN = APR_MRN AND RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE < APR_START_DTE WHERE RRPT_ORDER_GROUP IN ('PET CT for Cancer') ) , RAD1 AS (SELECT DISTINCT RRPT_MRN AS MRN, DRUG_DATE AS "DRUG START DATE", ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY RRPT_MRN ORDER BY RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE DESC) AS RN, RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE AS "Report Performed Date", RRPT_ACCESSION_NO AS "Accession Number", RRPT_ORDER_GROUP AS "Report Order Group", RRPT_PROCEDURE_NAME AS "Report Procedure Name", REPORT_TEXT AS "Report Text" FROM RAD) SELECT DISTINCT MRN, "DRUG START DATE", "Report Performed Date", "Accession Number", "Report Order Group", "Report Procedure Name", "Report Text" FROM RAD1 WHERE RN=1 ORDER BY MRN ; WITH DX AS (SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN, TRIM(PT_LAST_NAME)||','||TRIM(PT_FIRST_NAME) AS PATIENT_NAME, TM_DX_DTE, TM_HIST_CD, HIST_DESC, TM_SITE_CD, SITE_DESC, MIN_ICD9_EFF_DTE, ICD9_CD, ICD9_DESC FROM IDB.PATIENT LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT TM_MRN, AV_DESC AS CASE_STS, TM_DX_DTE, TM_HIST_CD, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS HIST_DESC, TM_SITE_CD, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_DESC FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS ON AV_ELEMENT = 'CASE_STS' AND AV_CODE = TM_CASE_STS AND TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND TM_HIST_CD IN ('M9731/3', 'M9732/3', 'M9734/3') AND TM_DX_DTE BETWEEN '1990-01-01' AND '2023-11-01') AS CDB ON TM_MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT CC_MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS MIN_ICD9_EFF_DTE, CC_CLSF_CD AS ICD9_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS ICD9_DESC FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE CC_CLSF_CD IN ('203', '203.0', '203.00', '203.01', '203.02', '238.6', 'C90.0', 'C90.00', 'C90.01', 'C90.02', 'C90.2', 'C90.20', 'C90.21', 'C90.22', 'C90.30', 'C90.31', 'C90.32') AND CASE WHEN CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y' AND CC_PT_TYPE <> 'E' THEN 'Y' WHEN CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' AND YEAR(CC_EFF_DTE) < 2004 THEN 'Y' WHEN CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND YEAR(CC_EFF_DTE) < 2001 THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END = 'Y' GROUP BY CC_MRN, CC_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK HAVING MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) BETWEEN '1990-01-01' AND '2023-11-01') AS ICD9 ON CC_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE COALESCE(TM_MRN, CC_MRN) IS NOT NULL ), APR AS (SELECT DISTINCT APR_MRN, APR_START_DTE, APR_END_DTE, CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME, APR_GENERIC_NAME, APR_PRESCRIBED_DOSE, APR_ROUTE FROM DX JOIN IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX ON PT_MRN = APR_MRN JOIN IDB.CHEMO_DRUG_GENERIC ON APR_GENERIC_NAME = CDG_GENERIC_NAME WHERE CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME IN ('ELRANATAMAB', 'TECLISTAMAB') AND APR_START_DTE BETWEEN '2010-01-01' AND '2023-11-01' ) SELECT DISTINCT RTC_TX_MRN AS MRN, RTC_TX_START_DTE, RTC_TX_STOP_DTE, RTC_TX_ELAPSED_DAYS, RTC_TX_PLAN_NAME, RTC_TX_PLANNED_FRACTIONS, RTC_TX_DELIVERED_FRACTIONS, RTC_TX_PLANNED_DOSE, RTC_TX_DELIVERED_DOSE, RTC_PRIMARY_REF_POINT, RTC_DOSE_CORRECTION FROM APR JOIN IDB.RADONC_TREATMENT_COURSE ON APR_MRN = RTC_TX_MRN WHERE RTC_TX_START_DTE BETWEEN '1990-01-01' AND '2023-11-01' ORDER BY RTC_TX_MRN, RTC_TX_START_DTE ;
