prompt: Provide a list of patients who have pancreatic adenocarcinoma with BRCA mutations
completion: WITH BRCA AS (SELECT DISTINCT PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID AS DEID, PT_MRN AS MRN, METHOD, MIN(PATH_PROCEDURE_DATE) AS PATH_PROCEDURE_DATE, COALESCE(GENE, GENE2, '') AS GENE FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_STRUCTURED_RESULTS_V WHERE (GENE IN ('BRCA1', 'BRCA2') OR GENE2 IN ('BRCA1', 'BRCA2')) AND PATH_PROCEDURE_DATE BETWEEN '2019-06-01' AND '2020-05-31' GROUP BY PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID, PT_MRN, METHOD, COALESCE(GENE, GENE2, '')) , ICD910 AS (SELECT CC_MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS MIN_ICD910_DTE FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN BRCA ON MRN = CC_MRN WHERE SUBSTR(CC_CLSF_CD, 1, 3) IN ('C25', '157') GROUP BY CC_MRN) , CDB AS (SELECT TM_MRN, AV_DESC AS CASE_STS, TM_DX_DTE, TM_HIST_CD, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS HIST_DESC, TM_SITE_CD, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_DESC, TM_CA_SURG_DTE, TM_SYST_STRT_DTE FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN BRCA ON TM_MRN = MRN JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS ON AV_ELEMENT = 'CASE_STS' AND AV_CODE = TM_CASE_STS AND TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND TM_SITE_CD LIKE 'C25%') SELECT DISTINCT MRN "MRN", PT_LAST_NAME "Last Name", PT_FIRST_NAME "First Name", PT_BIRTH_DTE "DOB" FROM BRCA JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V ON MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN ICD910 ON CC_MRN = MRN LEFT JOIN CDB ON TM_MRN = MRN WHERE COALESCE(CC_MRN, TM_MRN) IS NOT NULL ; SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_BIRTH_DTE, DTPROCPATHRPT.DT_DTE AS PROCEDUREDATE_PATHCLIN, TUMOR_TYPE_NAME, PRIMARY_SITE , DT_PROCEDURE FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML INNER JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V ON PDRX_PATH_RPT_ID = PRPT_PATH_RPT_ID LEFT JOIN DV.DATE DTRPT ON PRPT_REPORT_DATE_ID = DTRPT.DT_DATE_ID LEFT JOIN DV.DATE DTPROCPATHRPT ON PRPT_PROCEDURE_DATE_ID = DTPROCPATHRPT.DT_DATE_ID INNER JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML_SETTINGS ON PDRX_PATH_DMP_RESULTS_XML_ID = PDRXS_PATH_DMP_RESULTS_XML_ID INNER JOIN DVDMC.PATHOLOGY_DMP_WEBSVC_SETTINGS ON PDRXS_SETTING_ID = PDWS_SETTING_ID INNER JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON PDRX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID, XMLTABLE('$c/root/*' PASSING PDRX_XML_VALUE AS "c" COLUMNS TOTAL_NUMBER_VARIANTS int PATH 'count(../*[not(name()=''meta-data'')])', VARIANT_CLASS VARCHAR(100) PATH 'variant_class', SITE1_GENE VARCHAR(100) PATH 'site1_gene', SITE2_GENE VARCHAR(100) PATH 'site2_gene', GENE_ID VARCHAR(100) PATH 'gene_id', EXON_NUM VARCHAR(100) PATH 'exon_num', AA_CHANGE VARCHAR(100) PATH 'aa_change', CDNA_CHANGE VARCHAR(100) PATH 'cDNA_change', GENE_FOLD_CHANGE VARCHAR(100) PATH 'gene_fold_change', VARIANT_TYPE VARCHAR(100) PATH './local-name(.)', PROJECT VARCHAR(100) PATH '../meta-data/dmp_alys_task_name', SAMPLEID VARCHAR(100) PATH '../meta-data/dmp_sample_id', PATIENTID VARCHAR(100) PATH '../meta-data/dmp_patient_id', TUMOR_TYPE_CODE VARCHAR(100) PATH '../meta-data/tumor_type_code', TUMOR_TYPE_NAME VARCHAR(255) PATH '../meta-data/tumor_type_name', IS_METASTASIS VARCHAR(10) PATH '../meta-data/is_metastasis', PRIMARY_SITE VARCHAR(255) PATH '../meta-data/primary_site', METASTASIS_SITE VARCHAR(255) PATH '../meta-data/metastasis_site', DT_PROCEDURE VARCHAR(40) PATH '../meta-data/dt_procedure', DT_SIGNOUT VARCHAR(40) PATH '../meta-data/dt_signout', DT_ACCESSIONED VARCHAR(40) PATH '../meta-data/dt_accessioned', DT_ALYS_END_TIME VARCHAR(40) PATH '../meta-data/dt_alys_end_time', DT_DMS_START_TIME VARCHAR(40) PATH '../meta-data/dt_dms_start_time') T WHERE 1=1 AND DTPROCPATHRPT.DT_DTE BETWEEN '2019-06-01' AND '2020-05-31' AND (SITE1_GENE like 'BRCA%' OR SITE2_GENE like 'BRCA%') AND TUMOR_TYPE_NAME = 'Pancreatic Adenocarcinoma' WITH UR

prompt: Weekly screening for upcoming prostate cancer patients undergoing radical prostatectomy.
completion: WITH SURG AS (SELECT OC_CASE_ID, OC_MRN, OC_SURG_DTE, CRE_RES_NAME, CPX_PROC_CD, CPX_PROC_NAME FROM IDB.OR_CASE JOIN IDB.OR_CASE_ALL_PROC ON OC_CASE_ID = OCAP_CASE_ID JOIN IDB.OR_CASE_ALL_SURG ON OCAP_CASE_ID = OCAS_CASE_ID AND OCAS_PNL_NO = OCAP_PNL_NO AND OCAS_SURG_ROLE = 'Primary' JOIN IDB.OR_PROC ON OCAP_OR_PROC_ID = OP_OR_PROC_ID JOIN IDB.OR_CL_PROC ON OP_OR_PROC_ID = OCP_OR_PROC_ID JOIN IDB.CL_PROC ON OCP_PROC_ID = CPX_PROC_ID JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CRE_RES_ID = OCAS_RES_ID WHERE OC_SURG_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT date AND CURRENT date + 28 DAYS AND OC_OR_CASE_STS_CD NOT IN ('2', '5') AND CPX_PROC_CD IN ('55840', '55841', '55842', '55843', '55844', '55845', '55866' , '55867', '38571') ) SELECT OC_MRN AS MRN, TRIM(PT_LAST_NAME) || ', ' || TRIM (PT_FIRST_NAME) AS PATIENT_NAME, OC_SURG_DTE SCHEDULED_DATE, CRE_RES_NAME SURGEON_NAME, CPX_PROC_CD CPT_CODE, TRIM(CPX_PROC_NAME) AS PROCEDURE_NAME FROM SURG JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PT_MRN = OC_MRN

prompt: Would like an update on this prior dataline report and move it to tableau. We would also like a one-time spreadsheet that summarizes the annual data from 2018 - present.
completion: SELECT OO_MRN , OO_ORD_GUID , OO_ORD_NAME , OO_ORD_TYPE_CD , OOC_ITEM_NAME , OOC_ITEM_DESC , OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE , OO_SUMMARY_LINE , OSTS_STS_DESC , CASE WHEN UPPER(OO_SUMMARY_LINE) LIKE '%TEAM A%' THEN 'TEAM A' WHEN UPPER(OO_SUMMARY_LINE) LIKE '%TEAM B%' THEN 'TEAM B' WHEN UPPER(OO_SUMMARY_LINE) LIKE '%TEAM IP%' THEN 'TEAM IP' WHEN (UPPER(OO_SUMMARY_LINE) LIKE '%TEAM SACU%' OR UPPER(OO_SUMMARY_LINE) LIKE '%TEAM SDU%') THEN 'TEAM SACU' ELSE '' END TEAM_ASSIGN , REGEXP_EXTRACT(OO_SUMMARY_LINE, '(?<=Attending:).*((?=b\.\d{4},Fellow)|(?=b\. \d{4},Fellow)|(Tan, Miranda(?=,Fellow)))') ATTENDING , REGEXP_EXTRACT(OO_SUMMARY_LINE, '(?<=Fellow/Resident:).*((?=b\.\d{4},APP)|(?=b\.\d{4}se,APP)|(?=b\. \d{4},APP)|(N/A(?=,APP))|(?=b\d{4},APP)|(?=\d{4},APP)|(?=p\d{4},APP))') AS "Fellow/Resident" FROM IDB.OMS_ORDER JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_CATALOG ON OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID = OOC_MSTR_ITEM_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_STATUS ON OO_ORD_STS_CD = OSTS_ORD_STS_CD JOIN IDB.OMS_USER REQ ON OO_PVDR_GUID = REQ.OU_USER_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_PROVIDER ON OO_PVDR_GUID = OP_PVDR_GUID WHERE 1 = 1 AND UPPER(OOC_ITEM_NAME) LIKE '%PULM%INP%TEAM%ASSIGN%' AND UPPER(OO_SUMMARY_LINE) LIKE '%INITIAL%CONSULT%TEAM%' AND (UPPER(OO_SUMMARY_LINE) LIKE '%TEAM A%' OR UPPER(OO_SUMMARY_LINE) LIKE '%TEAM B%' OR UPPER(OO_SUMMARY_LINE) LIKE '%TEAM IP%' OR UPPER(OO_SUMMARY_LINE) LIKE '%TEAM SACU%' OR UPPER(OO_SUMMARY_LINE) LIKE '%TEAM SDU%' ) AND OO_ORD_STS_CD NOT IN ('CANP', 'CANC', 'AUC3') ORDER BY OO_ORD_GUID

prompt: Tableau Dashboard that can query MRNs/Path Accession Numbers against consent protocols.
completion: WITH CTE AS (SELECT DISTINCT TRIM(PT_MRN) AS PRO_MRN, CASE WHEN TBPC_PROTOCOL = 'SPC-POE' AND TBPC_PROTOCOL_CONSENT = '1 - CANCER - Yes' THEN 'SPC-POE 1.Cancer' WHEN TBPC_PROTOCOL = 'SPC-POE' AND TBPC_PROTOCOL_CONSENT = '2 - OTHER - Yes' THEN 'SPC-POE 2.Other' WHEN TBPC_PROTOCOL = 'SPC-POE' AND TBPC_PROTOCOL_CONSENT = '3 - INHERIT GENETIC - Yes' THEN 'SPC-POE 3.Inherit Genetic' WHEN TBPC_PROTOCOL = 'SPC-POE' AND TBPC_PROTOCOL_CONSENT = '4 - GENETIC ANALYSIS - Yes' THEN 'SPC-POE 4.Genetic Analysis' ELSE TRIM(TBPC_PROTOCOL) END AS "Protocol", DT_DTE AS "Consent Date", NULL AS "Off-Study Date" FROM DV.TISSUE_BANK_SPECIMEN_PATIENT_CONSENT JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V ON TBPC_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID JOIN DV.DATE ON DT_DATE_ID = TBPC_LATEST_CONSENT_DATE_ID WHERE (TBPC_PROTOCOL IN ('06-107', '12-245', '89-076', '90-040', '97-094', '97-134', '99-032', '00-032', '00-144', '02-060', '09-141', '11-075', '99-030', '04-017', '99-125') OR TBPC_PROTOCOL_CONSENT IN ('1 - CANCER - Yes', '2 - OTHER - Yes', '3 - INHERIT GENETIC - Yes', '4 - GENETIC ANALYSIS - Yes')) UNION SELECT TRIM(AC_MRN) AS PRO_MRN, TRIM(AC_IRB_NO) AS "Protocol", AC_CONS_DTE AS "Consent Date", ACD_OFF_STUDY_DTE AS "Off-Study Date" FROM IDB.ACCRUALS LEFT JOIN IDB.ACCRUALS_DATES ON AC_MRN = ACD_MRN AND AC_IRB_NO = ACD_IRB_NO WHERE AC_IRB_NO IN ('06-107', '12-245', '89-076', '90-040', '97-094', '97-134', '99-032', '00-032', '00-144', '02-060', '09-141', '11-075', '99-030', '04-017', '99-125') ) , T AS (SELECT PRO_MRN, "Protocol", MIN("Consent Date") "Consent Date", MAX("Off-Study Date") AS "Off-Study Date" FROM CTE GROUP BY PRO_MRN, "Protocol") , PROTOCOL_LIST AS (SELECT PRO_MRN PL_MRN, LISTAGG("Protocol", ',') WITHIN GROUP( ORDER BY "Protocol") AS "Protocol List" FROM T GROUP BY PRO_MRN) , ACCESSION AS (SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN TBA_MRN, TBA_ACCESSION_NUM FROM DV.TISSUE_BANK_ACCESSION JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON TBA_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID) SELECT PT_MRN MRN, TRIM(PT_LAST_NAME) "Last Name", TRIM(PT_FIRST_NAME) "First Name", PT_SEX "Gender", PT_BIRTH_DTE "Date of Birth", PT_DEATH_DTE "Date of Death", CASE WHEN "Protocol" IS NULL THEN 'x No Consent' ELSE "Protocol" END "Protocol", "Protocol List", "Consent Date", "Off-Study Date", CASE WHEN "Consent Date" IS NOT NULL THEN 'Yes' ELSE '' END "Consented?", TBA_ACCESSION_NUM "Accession No" FROM DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS LEFT JOIN T ON PRO_MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN PROTOCOL_LIST ON PRO_MRN = PL_MRN LEFT JOIN ACCESSION ON PT_MRN = TBA_MRN WHERE PT_MRN <> ''

prompt: Provide a list of T-PLL patients seen here at MSKCC.
completion: WITH PLL AS (SELECT TM_MRN AS MRN, TM_DX_DTE AS DX_DATE, TM_HIST_CD AS DX_CODE, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS DX_DESC FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM H ON TM_HIST_CD = H.CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON TM_SITE_CD = S.CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND TM_HIST_CD = 'M9834/3' UNION SELECT CC_MRN AS MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS DX_DATE, CLM_CLSF_CD AS DX_CODE, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS DX_DESC FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND ((CC_PT_TYPE = 'I') OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) AND CC_CLSF_CD like 'C91.6%' GROUP BY CC_MRN, CLM_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK ) , AC AS (SELECT AC_MRN, MAX(CASE WHEN AC_IRB_NO = '06-107' THEN AC_CONS_DTE END) AS "06-107 Consent Date", MAX(CASE WHEN AC_IRB_NO = '09-141' THEN AC_CONS_DTE END) AS "09-141 Consent Date", MAX(CASE WHEN AC_IRB_NO = '12-245' THEN AC_CONS_DTE END) AS "12-245 Consent Date" FROM PLL JOIN IDB.ACCRUALS ON MRN = AC_MRN AND AC_IRB_NO IN ('06-107', '09-141', '12-245') GROUP BY AC_MRN) , CPE AS (SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN, CPE_ENC_DTE, CRE_RES_NAME, CRE_RES_TYP, CLD_DEPT_NAME, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8, CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CPE_MRN ORDER BY CPE_ENC_DTE DESC) AS RN_CPE FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CRE_RES_TYP IN ('Physician') AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN '1990-01-01' AND '2022-12-31' ) , X AS (SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN AS MRN, STRIP(PT_LAST_NAME) || ', ' || STRIP(PT_FIRST_NAME) AS NAME, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH AS DOB, PT_SEX AS GENDER, PT_DATE_OF_DEATH AS DOD, COALESCE(MAX(PLA_LST_APPT_DTE, PLA_LST_DSCH_DTE), PLA_LST_APPT_DTE, PLA_LST_DSCH_DTE) AS LAST_FU_DATE, DX_DATE, DX_CODE, DX_DESC, "06-107 Consent Date", "09-141 Consent Date", "12-245 Consent Date", CPE_ENC_DTE, CRE_RES_NAME, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8, CLD_DEPT_NAME FROM IDB.PATIENT JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY ON PT_MRN = PLA_MRN JOIN PLL ON MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN AC ON AC_MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN CPE ON CPE_MRN = PT_MRN AND RN_CPE = 1) , APR AS (SELECT APR_MRN, CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME, MIN(APR_START_DTE) AS START_DATE, MAX(APR_END_DTE) AS END_DATE FROM X JOIN IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX_V ON APR_MRN = MRN WHERE CDG_CHEMO_FLAG = 'Y' AND(UPPER(CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME) LIKE '%ALEMTUZUMAB%' OR UPPER(CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME) LIKE '%PENTOSTATIN%' OR UPPER(CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME) LIKE '%RUXOLITINIB%') GROUP BY APR_MRN, CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME ) , HCT AS (SELECT CBM_MRN AS MRN, CBM_TRANSPLANT_TYPE AS BMT_TYPE, CBM_TRANSPLANT_DTE AS BMT_DATE FROM IDB.CRDB_BMT_MEDICINE WHERE CBM_MRN IN (SELECT MRN FROM X) UNION SELECT CBP_MRN AS MRN, CBP_TRANSPLANT_TYPE AS BMT_TYPE, CBP_TRANSPLANT_DTE AS BMT_DATE FROM IDB.CRDB_BMT_PEDIATRICS WHERE CBP_MRN IN (SELECT MRN FROM X) ) , DM AS (SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN, GENE, RESULT, METHOD, PRPT_ACCESSION_NO, PATH_PROCEDURE_DATE FROM X JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_STRUCTURED_RESULTS_V ON MRN = PT_MRN) SELECT * FROM X

prompt: Provide a list of patients treated with Idelalisib
completion: WITH PTS AS (SELECT APR_MRN, APR_DRUG_NAME, APR_START_DTE, APR_END_DTE FROM IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX WHERE APR_GENERIC_NAME = 'IDELALISIB' ) SELECT DISTINCT PDRX_DMP_PATIENT_ID "DMP Patient ID", PDRX_DMP_SAMPLE_ID "Sample ID", PDWS_NAME AS ASSAYNAME, TUMOR_TYPE_CODE "DMP Tumor Type Code", TUMOR_TYPE_NAME "DMP Tumor Type", PRIMARY_SITE "DMP Primary Site", TM_DX_DTE "Tumor Registry Dx Date", S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK "Tumor Registry Primary Site", H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK "Tumor Registry Histology" FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML INNER JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON PDRX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID JOIN PTS ON PT_MRN = APR_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.CDB_TUMOR ON PT_MRN = TM_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD LEFT JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD INNER JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML_SETTINGS ON PDRX_PATH_DMP_RESULTS_XML_ID = PDRXS_PATH_DMP_RESULTS_XML_ID INNER JOIN DVDMC.PATHOLOGY_DMP_WEBSVC_SETTINGS ON PDRXS_SETTING_ID = PDWS_SETTING_ID, XMLTABLE('$x/root/meta-data' PASSING PDRX_XML_VALUE AS "x" COLUMNS DT_PROCEDURE VARCHAR(40) PATH 'dt_procedure', DT_SIGNOUT VARCHAR(40) PATH 'dt_signout', TUMOR_TYPE_CODE VARCHAR(100) PATH 'tumor_type_code', TUMOR_TYPE_NAME VARCHAR(255) PATH 'tumor_type_name', IS_METASTASIS VARCHAR(10) PATH 'is_metastasis', PRIMARY_SITE VARCHAR(255) PATH 'primary_site', METASTASIS_SITE VARCHAR(255) PATH 'metastasis_site') T1

prompt: Need to pull volume of same day consult requests to help determine how many slots should be reserved on our providers new templates to accommodate these requests
completion: WITH X AS (SELECT DISTINCT OO_MRN MRN, OOC_ITEM_NAME, OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE, DAYOFWEEK(OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE) RECEIVED_DAY, OUD_USER_DI_CD, OUD_USER_DI_VALUE FROM IDB.OMS_ORDER JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_CATALOG ON OOC_MSTR_ITEM_GUID = OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_USER_DATA ON OUD_ORD_GUID = OO_ORD_GUID LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_STATUS ON OSTS_ORD_STS_CD = OO_ORD_STS_CD WHERE OOC_ITEM_NAME = 'Dermatology Outpatient Consult' AND (LOWER(OUD_USER_DI_CD) like '%urgency%' AND LOWER(OUD_USER_DI_VALUE) like '%today%') ) , NOTE AS (SELECT DISTINCT CDD_MRN, CDD_DOC_NAME AS "Document Name", OP_DISPLAY_NAME AS "Provider" FROM X LEFT JOIN IDB.CD_DOCUMENT ON MRN = CDD_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION ON CDD_DOC_GUID = CDO_DOC_GUID AND CDD_AUTHORED_DTE = CDO_AUTHORED_DTE AND CDO_VALUE_TEXT <> '' JOIN IDB.OMS_PROVIDER ON CDD_AUTH_PROV_GUID = OP_PVDR_GUID WHERE CDD_CANCEL_IND <> '1' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND <> '1' AND LOWER(CDD_DOC_NAME) like '%derm%' ), APPT AS (SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN, CPE_ENC_DTE AS "Appt Date", CLD_CLD_CENTER, CLD_CLD_PHY_LOC, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 AS "Department", CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 AS "Service", CLD_DEPT_NAME AS "Department Name", CRE_RES_NAME AS "Provider Name", CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME AS "Visit Type" FROM X LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER ON MRN = CPE_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Sch''Approved', 'Comp') AND OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE=CPE_ENC_DTE AND UPPER(CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME) LIKE '%CONSULT%' ) , SITE AS (SELECT DISTINCT OO_MRN, OU.OUD_USER_DI_CD, OU.OUD_USER_DI_VALUE FROM X JOIN IDB.OMS_ORDER B ON MRN = OO_MRN JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_CATALOG OC ON OOC_MSTR_ITEM_GUID = OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_USER_DATA OU ON OUD_ORD_GUID = OO_ORD_GUID LEFT JOIN APPT ON CPE_MRN = X.MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_STATUS ON OSTS_ORD_STS_CD = OO_ORD_STS_CD WHERE OC.OOC_ITEM_NAME = 'Dermatology Outpatient Consult' AND LOWER(OU.OUD_USER_DI_CD) like '%site%' ), FIN AS (SELECT COUNT(X.MRN) MRN_COUNT, OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE ST_DATE, OOC_ITEM_NAME FROM (SELECT DISTINCT MRN, OOC_ITEM_NAME, OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE FROM X) X GROUP BY OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE, OOC_ITEM_NAME) SELECT DISTINCT MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, MRN_COUNT, X.OOC_ITEM_NAME, X.OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE, CASE WHEN X.RECEIVED_DAY = 1 THEN 'SUNDAY' WHEN X.RECEIVED_DAY = 2 THEN 'MONDAY' WHEN X.RECEIVED_DAY = 3 THEN 'TUESDAY' WHEN X.RECEIVED_DAY = 4 THEN 'WEDNESDAY' WHEN X.RECEIVED_DAY = 5 THEN 'THURSDAY' WHEN X.RECEIVED_DAY = 6 THEN 'FRIDAY' WHEN X.RECEIVED_DAY = 7 THEN 'SATURDAY' ELSE NULL END AS RECEIVED_DAY, X.OUD_USER_DI_CD, X.OUD_USER_DI_VALUE, OU.OUD_USER_DI_CD, OU.OUD_USER_DI_VALUE, "Appt Date", "Department", "Department Name" APPT_DEPT_NAME, "Provider Name" APPT_PROVIDER, "Document Name" DERM_NOTE_NAME, "Provider" DERM_PROVIDER_NAME FROM (SELECT DISTINCT MRN, OOC_ITEM_NAME, OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE, RECEIVED_DAY, OUD_USER_DI_CD, OUD_USER_DI_VALUE FROM X)X LEFT JOIN SITE OU ON MRN= OO_MRN LEFT JOIN APPT ON MRN = CPE_MRN LEFT JOIN NOTE ON MRN = CDD_MRN LEFT JOIN FIN ON ST_DATE = OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE LEFT JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON MRN = PT_MRN ;

prompt: Provide summary of telemedicine appointments scheduled with a Remote (101045) or Video (100775) interpreter from March 2020-October 31, 2020.
completion: SELECT CPE_MRN MRN, STRIP(PT_LAST_NAME)||', '|| PT_FIRST_NAME PT_NAME, CPP_LANG LANG, RLD_LANGUAGE_NAME LANGUAGE_NAME, ENC.CPE_CPE_APPT_STS, ENC.CPE_APPT_DT APPT_DT, RES1.CRE_RES_NAME TELEHEALTH_VIRTUAL , CASE WHEN CPP_PP_LST_LGN_DTE IS NOT NULL THEN 'YES' END PORTAL_USED, CPP_INTERPRETER_NEEDED_IND INTERPRETER_NEEDED_IND, VD.CLD_DEPT_NAME DEPT_NAME, VT.CRE_RES_NAME VST_MD, VT.CRE_RES_TYP MD_TYPE, RES1.CRE_RES_NAME, RES1.CRE_RES_TYP, CVT_EXT_NAME VISIT_TYPE FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER ENC JOIN IDB.PATIENT_V ON CPE_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_PAS_PATIENT ON CPP_MRN = CPE_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.RMS_LANGUAGE_DICT_DN8732 ON CPP_LANG = RLD_LANGUAGE_MNEMONIC JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID = CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID JOIN IDB.CL_PT_APPT APPT1 ON ENC.CPE_CL_PT_ID = APPT1.CPA_CL_PT_ID AND ENC.CPE_ENC_DTE_SEQ = APPT1.CPA_ENC_DTE_SEQ AND APPT1.CPA_LINE_NO = 2 JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE RES1 ON APPT1.CPA_RES_ID = RES1.CRE_RES_ID AND RES1.CRE_RES_ID IN ('100775', '101045') JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT VD ON CPE_DEPT_ID = VD.CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE VT ON VT.CRE_RES_ID = CPE_VST_RES_ID WHERE CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN '2020-03-01' AND '2020-10-30' AND CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CPE_ENC_TYP_CD = 50

prompt: Provide a list of retinoblastoma patients who received Ophthalmic Artery Chemosurgery (OAC) or Intraarterial Chemotherapy (IAC).
completion: WITH TM AS (SELECT TM_MRN AS MRN, STRIP(PT_LAST_NAME) || ', ' || STRIP(PT_FIRST_NAME) AS NAME, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH AS DOB, TM_DX_DTE AS DX_DATE, TM_HIST_CD AS DX_CODE, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS DX_DESC, TM_SITE_CD AS SITE_CODE, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_DESC FROM IDB.PATIENT JOIN IDB.CDB_TUMOR ON TM_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD WHERE 1=1 AND TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND PT_DATE_OF_DEATH IS NULL AND TM_HIST_CD IN ('M9510/3', 'M9510/6', 'M9511/3', 'M9511/6', 'M9512/3', 'M9513/3', 'M9514/1') ) , CC AS (SELECT CC_MRN AS MRN, STRIP(PT_LAST_NAME) || ', ' || STRIP(PT_FIRST_NAME) AS NAME, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH AS DOB, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS DX_DATE, CC_CLSF_CD AS DX_CODE, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS DX_DESC, '' AS SITE_CODE, '' AS SITE_DESC FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON CC_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE CC_CLSF_CD IN ('190.5', 'C69.20', 'C69.21', 'C69.22', 'H35.022', 'H35.021', 'H35.029', 'H35.023') AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND (CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) GROUP BY CC_MRN, STRIP(PT_LAST_NAME) || ', ' || STRIP(PT_FIRST_NAME), PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, CC_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK ) , PTS AS (SELECT * FROM TM UNION SELECT * FROM CC) , X AS (SELECT MRN, NAME, DOB, REPLACE(LISTAGG(COALESCE(STRIP(CAST(DX_DATE AS VARCHAR(1000))), '')|| ' | ' || COALESCE(STRIP(CAST(DX_CODE AS VARCHAR(2000))), '') || ' - ' || COALESCE(STRIP(CAST(DX_DESC AS VARCHAR(2000))), '') || ' | ' || COALESCE(STRIP(CAST(SITE_CODE AS VARCHAR(2000))), '') || ' - ' || COALESCE(STRIP(CAST(SITE_DESC AS VARCHAR(2000))), '') , CHR(13) || CHR(10)) WITHIN GROUP( ORDER BY MRN, DX_DATE), ' | -', '') AS DX FROM PTS GROUP BY MRN, NAME, DOB) , CD AS (SELECT DISTINCT CDD_MRN, CDO_VALUE_TEXT FROM IDB.CD_DOCUMENT JOIN X ON CDD_MRN = MRN JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION ON CDO_DOC_GUID = CDD_DOC_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_USER ON OU_USER_GUID = CDD_AUTH_PROV_GUID WHERE CDD_CANCEL_IND = '0' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND = '0' AND OU_DISPLAY_NAME IN ('Abramson, David', 'Francis, Jasmine') AND(CDO_VALUE_TEXT like '%OA%' OR CDO_VALUE_TEXT like '%IA%') AND CDO_VALUE_TEXT not like '%RADIATION THERAPY%' AND CDO_VALUE_TEXT not like '%DIAGNOSIS%' AND CDO_VALUE_TEXT not like '%POAG%' AND CDO_ITEM_NAME <> 'Fax/External CC' AND CDO_ITEM_NAME <> 'Findings' AND CDO_ITEM_NAME <> 'Indications' AND CDO_ITEM_NAME <> 'Nature of Operation' AND CDO_ITEM_NAME <> 'Plan:' AND CDO_ITEM_NAME <> 'Procedure' AND CDO_ITEM_NAME <> 'Procedures Performed' AND CDO_ITEM_NAME <> 'Surgeon' ) , CD1 AS (SELECT CD.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CDD_MRN ORDER BY CDO_VALUE_TEXT) AS RN FROM CD) , CD2 AS (SELECT CDD_MRN, MAX(CASE WHEN RN = 1 THEN CDO_VALUE_TEXT END) AS TEXT1, MAX(CASE WHEN RN = 2 THEN CDO_VALUE_TEXT END) AS TEXT2, MAX(CASE WHEN RN = 3 THEN CDO_VALUE_TEXT END) AS TEXT3, MAX(CASE WHEN RN = 4 THEN CDO_VALUE_TEXT END) AS TEXT4, MAX(CASE WHEN RN = 5 THEN CDO_VALUE_TEXT END) AS TEXT5, MAX(CASE WHEN RN = 6 THEN CDO_VALUE_TEXT END) AS TEXT6, MAX(CASE WHEN RN = 7 THEN CDO_VALUE_TEXT END) AS TEXT7, MAX(CASE WHEN RN = 8 THEN CDO_VALUE_TEXT END) AS TEXT8, MAX(CASE WHEN RN = 9 THEN CDO_VALUE_TEXT END) AS TEXT9, MAX(CASE WHEN RN = 10 THEN CDO_VALUE_TEXT END) AS TEXT10, MAX(CASE WHEN RN = 11 THEN CDO_VALUE_TEXT END) AS TEXT11, MAX(CASE WHEN RN = 12 THEN CDO_VALUE_TEXT END) AS TEXT12, MAX(CASE WHEN RN = 13 THEN CDO_VALUE_TEXT END) AS TEXT13, MAX(CASE WHEN RN = 14 THEN CDO_VALUE_TEXT END) AS TEXT14, MAX(CASE WHEN RN = 15 THEN CDO_VALUE_TEXT END) AS TEXT15, MAX(CASE WHEN RN = 16 THEN CDO_VALUE_TEXT END) AS TEXT16, MAX(CASE WHEN RN = 17 THEN CDO_VALUE_TEXT END) AS TEXT17, MAX(CASE WHEN RN = 18 THEN CDO_VALUE_TEXT END) AS TEXT18, MAX(CASE WHEN RN = 19 THEN CDO_VALUE_TEXT END) AS TEXT19, MAX(CASE WHEN RN = 20 THEN CDO_VALUE_TEXT END) AS TEXT20, MAX(CASE WHEN RN = 21 THEN CDO_VALUE_TEXT END) AS TEXT21, MAX(CASE WHEN RN = 22 THEN CDO_VALUE_TEXT END) AS TEXT22, MAX(CASE WHEN RN = 23 THEN CDO_VALUE_TEXT END) AS TEXT23, MAX(CASE WHEN RN = 24 THEN CDO_VALUE_TEXT END) AS TEXT24, MAX(CASE WHEN RN = 25 THEN CDO_VALUE_TEXT END) AS TEXT25, MAX(CASE WHEN RN = 26 THEN CDO_VALUE_TEXT END) AS TEXT26, MAX(CASE WHEN RN = 27 THEN CDO_VALUE_TEXT END) AS TEXT27, MAX(CASE WHEN RN = 28 THEN CDO_VALUE_TEXT END) AS TEXT28, MAX(CASE WHEN RN = 29 THEN CDO_VALUE_TEXT END) AS TEXT29, MAX(CASE WHEN RN = 30 THEN CDO_VALUE_TEXT END) AS TEXT30 FROM CD1 GROUP BY CDD_MRN) SELECT X.* FROM X JOIN CD2 ON CDD_MRN = MRN

prompt: Provide a list of patients at MSK treated with ustekinumab or uselkumab for rashes related to cancer treatments.
completion: WITH EMAR AS (SELECT DISTINCT OO_MRN AS MRN, OO_ORD_NAME AS DRUG_NAME FROM IDB.OMS_ORDER LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_MED_DETAIL ON OO_ORD_GUID = OMD_ORD_GUID JOIN IDB.OAS_ORD_TASK_OCCR ON OOTO_ORD_GUID = OO_ORD_GUID AND OOTO_STATUS_CD = 'Performed' JOIN IDB.OAS_CTLG_ITEM_TASK ON OOTO_CAT_ITEM_GUID = OCIT_GUID AND OCIT_LEVEL_NO = 0 WHERE OO_ORD_STS_CD NOT IN ('CANC', 'CANP', 'AUC3') AND(UPPER(OO_ORD_NAME) LIKE '%USTEKINUMAB%' OR UPPER(OO_ORD_NAME) LIKE '%GUSELKUMAB%' OR UPPER(OO_ORD_NAME) LIKE '%STELARA%' OR UPPER(OO_ORD_NAME) LIKE '%TREMFYA%') ) , HML AS (SELECT HCPR_MRN AS MRN, HCPR_PRESCRIPTION_ID RX_ID , HCPR_CREATED_DTE RX_CREATE_DATE , DATE(HCPR_START_DT) START_DATE , HCPR_END_DT AS END_DATE , DATE(HCPR_DISCONTINUE_DT) AS DISCONTINUE_DATE , HCPR_DRUG_NAME AS DRUG_NAME , HGN_GENERIC_NAME AS GENERIC_NAME , HCPR_STATUS_TYPE_DESC AS PRESCRIPTION_STATUS , HCPR_PRESCRIPTION_TYPE_DESC AS RX_TYPE FROM IDB.HML_CLIENT_PRESCRIPTION LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_CLIENT_VISIT ON OCV_VISIT_GUID = HCPR_VISIT_GUID LEFT JOIN IDB.HML_GENERIC_NAME ON HGN_GENERIC_NAME_ID = HCPR_GENERIC_NAME_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_USER USR ON USR.OU_USER_GUID = HCPR_USER_GUID LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_USER REQ ON REQ.OU_USER_GUID = HCPR_CARE_PROV_GUID LEFT JOIN IDB.HML_RX_UNIT_OF_MEASURE UOM ON UOM.HRUM_RXUOM_ID = HCPR_DOSE_UOM_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.HML_RX_UNIT_OF_MEASURE PKG ON PKG.HRUM_RXUOM_ID = HCPR_INNER_PACKAGE_SIZE_UOM_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.HML_SCRIPT_FREQUENCY ON HSF_SCRIPT_FREQ_ID = HCPR_SCRIPT_FREQ_ID WHERE HCPR_STATUS_TYPE NOT IN (4, 5, 8) AND HCPR_CREATED_DTE IS NOT NULL AND(HCPR_PRESCRIPTION_TYPE = 1 AND HCPR_TRANSMISSION_STATUS IN (1, 2, 5) OR HCPR_PRESCRIPTION_TYPE = 3) AND(UPPER(HCPR_DRUG_NAME) LIKE '%USTEKINUMAB%' OR UPPER(HCPR_DRUG_NAME) LIKE '%GUSELKUMAB%' OR UPPER(HCPR_DRUG_NAME) LIKE '%STELARA%' OR UPPER(HCPR_DRUG_NAME) LIKE '%TREMFYA%' OR UPPER(HGN_GENERIC_NAME) LIKE '%USTEKINUMAB%' OR UPPER(HGN_GENERIC_NAME) LIKE '%GUSELKUMAB%' OR UPPER(HGN_GENERIC_NAME) LIKE '%STELARA%' OR UPPER(HGN_GENERIC_NAME) LIKE '%TREMFYA%') ) , DRUG AS (SELECT MRN FROM EMAR UNION SELECT MRN FROM HML) , DER AS (SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN AS MRN, CPE_ENC_DTE, CRE_RES_NAME, CRE_RES_TYP, CLD_DEPT_NAME, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8, CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CRE_RES_TYP IN ('Physician', 'Nurse Practitioner') AND CPE_MRN IN (SELECT MRN FROM DRUG) AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 = 'DER' ) , X AS (SELECT DISTINCT TM_MRN AS MRN, TM_DX_DTE, TM_SITE_CD AS SITE_CODE, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_DESC, TM_HIST_CD AS HIST_CODE, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS HIST_DESC FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM H ON TM_HIST_CD = H.CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON TM_SITE_CD = S.CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND TM_MRN IN (SELECT MRN FROM DER) ) , CTE AS (SELECT MRN AS DX_MRN, TM_DX_DTE AS DX_DATE, STRIP(SITE_CODE) || '-' || STRIP(SITE_DESC) || '|' || STRIP(HIST_CODE) || '-' || STRIP(HIST_DESC) AS DX_CODE FROM X) , CTE2 AS (SELECT * FROM CTE ORDER BY DX_MRN, DX_DATE, DX_CODE) , T1 AS (SELECT DX_MRN, DX_DATE, DX_CODE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY DX_MRN ORDER BY DX_DATE) AS RN FROM CTE2 ORDER BY DX_MRN, DX_DATE) , T2 (MRN, DX, RN1) AS (SELECT DX_MRN, CAST(DX_DATE AS VARCHAR(6000))||' | '||CAST(DX_CODE AS VARCHAR(100)), RN FROM T1 WHERE T1.RN = 1 UNION ALL SELECT DX_MRN, RTRIM(CAST(DX AS VARCHAR(4000))) || ', ' || CHR(13) || CHR(10) || CAST(DX_DATE AS VARCHAR(100))||' | '||RTRIM(CAST(DX_CODE AS VARCHAR(100))) , RN1 + 1 FROM T1, T2 WHERE DX_MRN = MRN AND RN = RN1+1 ) , T3 AS (SELECT MRN, MAX(RN1) RN FROM T2 GROUP BY MRN) , T4 AS (SELECT T2.MRN AS DX_MRN, RN, DX FROM T2 JOIN T3 ON T2.MRN = T3.MRN AND T2.RN1 = T3.RN) , Y AS (SELECT DISTINCT MRN, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH AS DOB, YEAR(CURRENT DATE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) AS AGE, PT_SEX, DX FROM DER JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN T4 ON DX_MRN = MRN) SELECT DISTINCT CC_MRN, CLM_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND ((CC_PT_TYPE = 'I') OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) AND (CC_CLSF_CD BETWEEN 'L00' AND 'L99.99' OR CC_CLSF_CD BETWEEN '680' AND '709.99') AND CC_MRN IN (SELECT MRN FROM Y)

prompt: Monthly list of patients who have an Initial Evaluation, Adult Team-Critical Care within 24 hours of a PACU discharge. Currently, this is being pulled with the logic of a PACU discharge note but a new discharge scoring tool will sometimes allow providers to bypass writing a discharge note. We are proposing that it now be tracked via Case Tracking on Epic, and using the Discharge from PACU I time instead.
completion: WITH PACU AS (SELECT PATIENT_MRN, PATIENT_NAME, PATIENT_AGE, PATIENT_SEX , LOG_NUMBER, LOG_SURGERY_DTE, PACU_OUT_TIME_ACTUAL, LOG_LOCATION, LOG_CAMPUS, LOG_PRIMARY_SERVICE, LOG_PRIMARY_SURGEON FROM IDB.PERIOP_CASE_EVENT_V WHERE DATE(PACU_OUT_TIME_ACTUAL) BETWEEN LAST_DAY(CURRENT DATE - 2 MONTH)+ 1 DAY AND LAST_DAY(CURRENT DATE - 1 MONTH) ) SELECT PATIENT_MRN, PATIENT_NAME, LOG_NUMBER, LOG_SURGERY_DTE "Surgery Date", LOG_PRIMARY_SERVICE "Surgery Primary Service", PACU_OUT_TIME_ACTUAL "PACU Out DateTime", DATE(CDD_SERVICE_DT) "Date of Initial Evaluation", TIME(CDD_SERVICE_DT) "Time of Initial Evaluation", (MAX(CASE WHEN CDO_ITEM_NAME = 'Time of Call' THEN SUBSTR(CDO_VALUE_TEXT, 1, 150) END)) "Time of Call", (MAX(CASE WHEN CDO_ITEM_NAME = 'Time of Arrival' THEN SUBSTR(CDO_VALUE_TEXT, 1, 150) END)) "Time of Arrival" , CDD_DOC_NAME "Document Name", MAX(CASE WHEN CDO_ITEM_NAME = 'Reason for Call: Consult Service' THEN SUBSTR(CDO_VALUE_TEXT, 1, 150) END) "Consult Service", MAX(CASE WHEN CDO_ITEM_NAME = 'Reason for Call: Visit Initiated' THEN SUBSTR(CDO_VALUE_TEXT, 1, 150) END) "Visit Initiated", MAX(CASE WHEN CDO_ITEM_NAME = 'Reason for Call: Reason' THEN SUBSTR(CDO_VALUE_TEXT, 1, 150) END) "Reason", MAX(CASE WHEN CDO_ITEM_NAME = 'Reason for Call: Location' THEN SUBSTR(CDO_VALUE_TEXT, 1, 150) END) "Location" FROM IDB.CD_DOCUMENT JOIN PACU ON CDD_MRN = PATIENT_MRN AND CDD_SERVICE_DT BETWEEN PACU_OUT_TIME_ACTUAL AND PACU_OUT_TIME_ACTUAL + 24 HOUR JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION ON CDD_DOC_GUID = CDO_DOC_GUID AND CDD_AUTHORED_DTE = CDO_AUTHORED_DTE WHERE CDD_DOC_NAME IN ('Initial Evaluation, Adult Team - Critical Care', 'Initial Evaluation, Adult Team-Critical Care') AND CDD_CANCEL_IND <> '1' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND <> '1' GROUP BY PATIENT_MRN, PATIENT_NAME, LOG_NUMBER, LOG_SURGERY_DTE, LOG_PRIMARY_SERVICE, PACU_OUT_TIME_ACTUAL, CDD_SERVICE_DT, CDD_DOC_GUID, CDD_DOC_NAME ;

prompt: Requesting monthly report of Outpatient Geriatric Consult
completion: WITH PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS AS (SELECT PT_MRN, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_CITY, PT_STATE, OO_ORD_STS_CD, OO_ORD_GUID, OO_ENTER_DTE AS ORDER_PLACEMENT_DATE, OO_ORD_NAME, OS_SVC_GRP_CD, OS_SVC_DESC, LGR_AMB_LOCATION, MAX(CASE WHEN OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'Consult_Geriatric OP Type' THEN SUBSTR(OUD_USER_DI_VALUE, 1, 255) END) TYPE_OF_CONSULT, MAX(CASE WHEN OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'Consult_Geriatric OP Tele' THEN SUBSTR(OUD_USER_DI_VALUE, 1, 255) END) VISIT_REQUESTED, MAX(CASE WHEN OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'Instructions_Spl' THEN SUBSTR(OUD_USER_DI_VALUE, 1, 255) END) ADDITIONAL_INFORMATION, ROW_NUMBER () OVER (PARTITION BY PT_MRN ORDER BY OO_ENTER_DTE DESC, OO_ORD_STS_CD, OO_ORD_GUID) AS ROW_NUMBERS FROM IDB.PATIENT JOIN IDB.OMS_ORDER ON PT_MRN = OO_MRN JOIN IDB.OMS_CLIENT_VISIT ON OO_VISIT_GUID = OCV_VISIT_GUID LEFT JOIN IDB.LOCATION_GROUPS_REFERENCE ON OCV_CURR_LOC_GUID = LGR_LOC_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_SERVICE ON OS_SVC_GUID = OCV_SVC_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_USER_DATA ON OO_ORD_GUID = OUD_ORD_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_CATALOG ON OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID = OOC_MSTR_ITEM_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_STATUS ON OO_ORD_STS_CD = OSTS_ORD_STS_CD WHERE 1 = 1 AND OO_ENTER_DTE >= CURRENT DATE - 30 DAYS AND UPPER(OOC_ITEM_NAME) LIKE '%CONSULT%' AND OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID = '9000011420100730' GROUP BY PT_MRN, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_CITY, PT_STATE, OO_ORD_STS_CD, OO_ENTER_DTE, OO_ORD_NAME, OO_ORD_GUID, OS_SVC_GRP_CD, OS_SVC_DESC, LGR_AMB_LOCATION) , VISITS AS (SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_CITY, PT_STATE, OO_ORD_STS_CD, OO_ORD_GUID, OS_SVC_GRP_CD, OS_SVC_DESC, ORDER_PLACEMENT_DATE, OO_ORD_NAME, TYPE_OF_CONSULT, VISIT_REQUESTED, ADDITIONAL_INFORMATION, CPE_APPT_MADE_DTE AS APPT_MADE_DTE, CPE_ENC_DTE AS APPT_DATE, CPE_CPE_APPT_STS, VD.CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 AS REF_SERVICE, VD.CLD_DEPT_ID AS DEP_NAME, VD.CLD_DEPT_NAME AS DEP_NAME1, LOC.CLD_CLD_CENTER AS SITE, CPE_VST_RES_ID AS PROV_ID, VT.CRE_RES_NAME AS PROV_NAME, VT1.CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID AS VST_ID, VT1.CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME AS VT_NAME, CPE_REF_RES_ID AS INT_REF_PROV_ID, CPE_REF_DEP_ID, LGR_AMB_LOCATION, REF.CRE_RES_NAME AS INT_REF_PROV_NAME, RFD.CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 AS REF_GRP_8, RFD.CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_4 AS REF_GRP_4, CPCA_CHANGE_REASON_TEXT AS REASON_TEXT FROM PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS AS PATIENTS LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER ON PT_MRN = CPE_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE AS VT1 ON VT1.CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID = CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT AS VD ON CPE_DEPT_ID = VD.CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE VT ON VT.CRE_RES_ID = CPE_VST_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE REF ON REF.CRE_RES_ID = CPE_REF_RES_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_PT_CHNG_APPT ON CPE_ENC_CSN_ID = CPCA_ENC_CSN_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT SD ON SD.CLD_DEPT_ID = CPCA_OLD_DEPT_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT RFD ON RFD.CLD_DEPT_ID = CPE_REF_DEP_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT LOC ON LOC.CLD_DEPT_ID = CPE_REF_DEP_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE SR ON SR.CRE_RES_ID = CPCA_OLD_RES_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE VT2 ON VT2.CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID = CPCA_OLD_VISIT_TYP_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_USER ON CPCA_USER_ID = CLE_USER_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_PATIENT ON CPE_PRK = CL_PRK WHERE 1 = 1 AND REF.CRE_RES_TYP IN ('Physician', 'Dentist', 'Psychologist', 'PhD', 'Nurse Practitioner', 'Physician Assistant', 'Advanced Practice Nurse') AND VD.CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 = 'GER' AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT DATE - 30 DAYS AND CURRENT DATE + 90 DAYS AND VT.CRE_RES_ID IN ('014811', '015594', '018895', '024505', '488856', '081935') AND REF.CRE_RES_NAME IS NOT NULL AND UPPER(CPE_CPE_APPT_STS) IN ('COMP', 'ARRIVED', 'SCH') AND CPE_APPT_MADE_DTE >= ORDER_PLACEMENT_DATE AND ROW_NUMBERS = 1 ), SURVEY AS (SELECT EF.EF_MRN, EF.EF_FORM_ID AS SURVEYID, EF.EF_SUBMISSION_DT AS SUBMITDT, EF.EF_FORM_NAME, EF.EF_FORM_ALIAS, 'Y' AS SURVERY_COMPLETED FROM IDB.EF_FORM AS EF JOIN IDB.EF_FORM_ITEM AS EI ON EF.EF_FORM_ID = EI.EFI_FORM_ID JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN FROM VISITS) AS PATIENTS ON EF.EF_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE 1 = 1 AND EF_SUBMISSION_DT BETWEEN CURRENT date - 30 DAYS AND CURRENT date AND EF.EF_FORM_NAME = ('Interdisciplinary Clinic Patient Satisfaction Survey') GROUP BY EF_MRN, EF_FORM_ID, EF_SUBMISSION_DT, EF_SURVEY_ID, EF_FORM_NAME, EF_FORM_ALIAS, EF_FORM_DESCRIPTION HAVING COUNT(EF.EF_MRN) > 0 ORDER BY EF_MRN, EF_SUBMISSION_DT, EF_SURVEY_ID, EF_FORM_NAME, EF_FORM_ALIAS, EF_FORM_DESCRIPTION) SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_CITY, PT_STATE, OS_SVC_DESC, ORDER_PLACEMENT_DATE, OO_ORD_NAME, TYPE_OF_CONSULT, VISIT_REQUESTED, ADDITIONAL_INFORMATION, APPT_MADE_DTE, APPT_DATE, CPE_CPE_APPT_STS, LGR_AMB_LOCATION, PROV_NAME, INT_REF_PROV_NAME, REASON_TEXT, CASE WHEN SURVERY_COMPLETED = 'Y' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS SURVERY_COMPLETED FROM VISITS AS V LEFT JOIN SURVEY AS S ON V.PT_MRN = S.EF_MRN

prompt: We would like the raw number of patients with epidermoid cysts (verified by pathology) since 01-01-2002 (20 years) to see in preparation to see if the project is feasible.
completion: SELECT COUNT(1) FROM (SELECT PRPT_MRN, PRPT_REPORT_TYPE_DESC, VARCHAR(PRPT_REPORT, 32000) REPORT_PRPT_CHAR, UPPER(DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)DIAGNOSIS:[\w\W]*(?=NOTE:)', PRPT_REPORT)) AS DIAG_1 FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V WHERE 1=1 AND PRPT_REPORT_DTE >= '2002-01-01' AND INSTR (VARCHAR(PRPT_REPORT, 32000), 'epidermoid cyst') >=1 AND (INSTR (VARCHAR(PRPT_REPORT, 32000), 'abdominal') >=1 OR INSTR (VARCHAR(PRPT_REPORT, 32000), 'abdomen') >=1 OR INSTR (VARCHAR(PRPT_REPORT, 32000), 'pelvis') >=1 OR INSTR (VARCHAR(PRPT_REPORT, 32000), 'pelvic') >=1) )

prompt: Identify MM patients with orthopedic surgical procedure and RT (if received RT treatment)
completion: WITH DIAGNOSIS AS (SELECT DISTINCT CC_MRN, LISTAGG(COALESCE(STRIP(CAST(MIN_DIAG_DTE AS VARCHAR(12000))), '')||' : '|| COALESCE(STRIP(CAST(DIAG_CD AS VARCHAR(12000))), '')||' - '|| COALESCE(STRIP(CAST(DIAG_DESC AS VARCHAR(12000))), '')|| ' | ', CHR(13) || CHR(10)) WITHIN GROUP ( ORDER BY DIAG_CD) AS DIAGNOSIS_DTE_CODE_DESC FROM (SELECT DISTINCT CC_MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS MIN_DIAG_DTE, CC_CLSF_CD AS DIAG_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS DIAG_DESC FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE (CC_CLSF_CD like 'C90%' OR CC_CLSF_CD like '203%' ) AND CASE WHEN CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y' AND CC_PT_TYPE <> 'E' THEN 'Y' WHEN CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' AND YEAR(CC_EFF_DTE) < 2004 THEN 'Y' WHEN CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND YEAR(CC_EFF_DTE) < 2001 THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END = 'Y' GROUP BY CC_MRN, CC_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK ) GROUP BY CC_MRN) , SURGERY AS (SELECT SSE_MRN, DATE_OF_BIRTH, GENDER, DECEASED_ALIVE, DATE_OF_DEATH, RACE, DIAGNOSIS_DTE_CODE_DESC, SURGERY_TYPE, LISTAGG(COALESCE(STRIP(CAST(SURGERY_DATE AS VARCHAR(12000))), '')||' : '|| COALESCE(STRIP(CAST(SURGERY_CODE AS VARCHAR(12000))), '')||' - '|| COALESCE(STRIP(CAST(SURGERY_DESC AS VARCHAR(12000))), '')||' : '|| COALESCE(STRIP(CAST(SURGEON_NAME AS VARCHAR(12000))), '')|| ' | ', CHR(13) || CHR(10)) WITHIN GROUP ( ORDER BY SURGERY_CODE) AS SURGERY_DTE_CODE_DESC_SURGEON FROM (SELECT DISTINCT SSE_MRN, PATIENT_NAME, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH AS DATE_OF_BIRTH, PATIENT_SEX AS GENDER, PT_DEATH_IND_DESC AS DECEASED_ALIVE, PT_DATE_OF_DEATH AS DATE_OF_DEATH, PT_RACE_DESC AS RACE, DIAGNOSIS_DTE_CODE_DESC, SSE_SURG_DTE AS SURGERY_DATE, SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD AS SURGERY_CODE, SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC AS SURGERY_DESC, TRIM(SSP_SURG_LAST_NM) || ', ' || SSP_SURG_FIRST_NM AS SURGEON_NAME, TRIM(LOG_LAPAROSCOPIC_FLAG) ||'-' || TRIM(LOG_MIN_INVASIVE_FLAG) ||'-' || TRIM(LOG_ROBOT_ASSISTED_FLAG) AS SURGERY_TYPE FROM IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE ON SSE_LOG_ID = SSP_LOG_ID AND SSE_ENC_CSN_ID = SSP_ENC_CSN_ID INNER JOIN DIAGNOSIS ON CC_MRN = SSE_MRN INNER JOIN IDB.PERIOP_CASE_EVENT_V ON PATIENT_MRN= SSE_MRN AND CASE_SURGERY_DTE = SSE_SURG_DTE INNER JOIN IDB.PATIENT_V ON PT_MRN = SSE_MRN WHERE (SSE_SURG_LOC not like '%IR%' AND SSE_SURG_LOC not like '%ENDO%' AND SSE_SOURCE_TYPE <> 'E') AND SSE_SURG_DTE BETWEEN '2010-01-01' AND '2023-06-01' ) GROUP BY SSE_MRN, DATE_OF_BIRTH, GENDER, DECEASED_ALIVE, DATE_OF_DEATH, RACE, DIAGNOSIS_DTE_CODE_DESC, SURGERY_TYPE) , RADIATION AS (SELECT DISTINCT RTC_TX_MRN, RTC_TX_PLAN_NAME AS RADIATION_PLAN, RTC_TX_PLANNED_DOSE AS RADIATION_PLANNED_DOSE, RTC_TX_DELIVERED_DOSE AS RADIATION_DELIVERED_DOSE, RTC_TX_START_DTE AS RADIATION_START_DATE, RTC_TX_STOP_DTE AS RADIATION_STOP_DATE FROM IDB.RADONC_TREATMENT_COURSE INNER JOIN SURGERY ON RTC_TX_MRN = SSE_MRN WHERE RTC_TX_START_DTE <= '2023-11-01' AND RTC_TX_STOP_DTE<= '2023-11-01' ) SELECT DISTINCT SSE_MRN AS MRN, DATE_OF_BIRTH, GENDER, DECEASED_ALIVE, DATE_OF_DEATH, RACE, DIAGNOSIS_DTE_CODE_DESC, SURGERY_DTE_CODE_DESC_SURGEON, SURGERY_TYPE, RADIATION_PLAN, RADIATION_PLANNED_DOSE, RADIATION_DELIVERED_DOSE, RADIATION_START_DATE, RADIATION_STOP_DATE FROM SURGERY LEFT JOIN RADIATION ON RTC_TX_MRN = SSE_MRN;

prompt: Provide the identified results of the Darwin query "Fine Needle Aspiration - Lymph Node 2".
completion: SELECT DISTINCT "t1"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AS "Deident PT #", "t2"."PRPT_PATH_RPT_ID" AS "DE-ID Pathology Report", "t3"."PT_SEX_DESC" AS "Gender" FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED" "t1" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V" "t2" ON "t1"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t2"."PRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V" "t3" ON "t1"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t3"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" WHERE (CONTAINS("t2"."PRPT_DEID_REPORT", '(("Thyroid Nodule Biopsy" | ("Lymph Node" IN SAME SENTENCE AS "Neck")) & ("Fine Needle Aspirate" | "cytologic"))') = 1 AND "t2"."PRPT_DEID_REPORT" IS NOT NULL)

prompt: Patient visit volume for prostate service clinics for 2018 - 2019
completion: SELECT CASE WHEN CLD_CLD_CENTER = '68TH' THEN CONCAT(RTRIM(CAV_NAME), ' (KIMMEL)') ELSE CAV_NAME END AS "Center", CLD_CLD_CENTER "Department Site", CLD_DEPT_NAME "Department Name", CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 "Service", CVT_EXT_NAME "Visit Type", SUM(CASE WHEN YEAR(CPE_ENC_DTE) = 2018 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "2018", SUM(CASE WHEN YEAR(CPE_ENC_DTE) = 2019 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "2019" FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_CATEGORY ON CAV_CATEGORY = 'CLD_CENTER' AND CAV_ABBR = CLD_CLD_CENTER WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 IN ('URO', 'GU') AND CRE_RES_TYP IN ('Physician', 'PhD', 'Psychologist', 'Dentist', 'Nurse Practitioner', 'Physician Assistant', 'Advanced Practice Nurse') AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN '2018-01-01' AND '2019-12-31' GROUP BY CASE WHEN CLD_CLD_CENTER = '68TH' THEN CONCAT(RTRIM(CAV_NAME), ' (KIMMEL)') ELSE CAV_NAME END, CLD_CLD_CENTER, CLD_DEPT_NAME, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8, CVT_EXT_NAME ; SELECT CPE_MRN "MRN", CPE_ENC_CSN_ID "Encounter Num", CLD_CLD_CENTER "Department Site", CASE WHEN CLD_CLD_CENTER = '68TH' THEN CONCAT(RTRIM(CAV_NAME), ' (KIMMEL)') ELSE CAV_NAME END AS "Center", CLD_DEPT_NAME "Department Name", CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 "Department", CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 "Service", CVT_EXT_NAME "Visit Type", CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME "Visit Type Code", CPE_ENC_DTE "Encounter Date", CRE_RES_NAME "Provider Name", CRE_RES_TYP "Provider Function", 1 "Count" FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_CATEGORY ON CAV_CATEGORY = 'CLD_CENTER' AND CAV_ABBR = CLD_CLD_CENTER WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 IN ('URO', 'GU') AND CRE_RES_TYP IN ('Physician', 'PhD', 'Psychologist', 'Dentist', 'Nurse Practitioner', 'Physician Assistant', 'Advanced Practice Nurse') AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN '2018-01-01' AND '2019-12-31' ;

prompt: Provide a list of patients seen for the first time by the lymphoma service since July 31, 2017 who received any of the following regimens: IT Methotrexate, IV Methotrexate, IT Rituximab, IT Cytarabine.
completion: WITH LYM AS (SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN AS MRN, CPE_ENC_DTE, STRIP(CRE_RES_NAME) AS CRE_RES_NAME, STRIP(CLD_DEPT_NAME) AS CLD_DEPT_NAME, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8, STRIP(CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR) AS CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CRE_RES_TYP IN ('Physician') AND CPE_ENC_DTE >= '2017-07-31' AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 = 'LYM' AND(CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR LIKE '%NV%' OR CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR LIKE '%IR%') ) SELECT APR_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, MIN(CPE_ENC_DTE) AS CPE_ENC_DTE, CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME, APR_ROUTE, MIN(APR_START_DTE) AS APR_START_DTE, MAX(APR_END_DTE) AS APR_END_DTE FROM LYM JOIN IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX ON APR_MRN = MRN JOIN IDB.CHEMO_DRUG_GENERIC ON APR_GENERIC_NAME = CDG_GENERIC_NAME JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON APR_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE(UPPER(CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME) LIKE '%METHOTREXATE%' OR UPPER(CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME) LIKE '%RITUXIMAB%' OR UPPER(CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME) LIKE '%CYTARABINE%') AND APR_START_DTE >= '2017-07-31' GROUP BY APR_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME, APR_ROUTE

prompt: Update the existing on demand report NEU22475 with genomic characteristics.
completion: WITH VARIANTS_TO_OMIT (CNV_TYPE_OMIT) AS ( VALUES ('snp-indel-silent-np'),('snp-indel-silent')) , VARIANT_CLASS_TO_OMIT (VARIANT_CLASS_OMIT) AS ( VALUES ('Unknown'),('UTR3'),('UTR5'),('intronic'),('synonymous_SNV')) , IM1 AS (SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN, PDWS_DESCRIPTION, PDRX_ACCESSION_NO AS "M Path Report ID", DV.REGEXSTR('(S|H|C|M|F|B|DMG)[0-9]{2}[\s|-][0-9]*', PART_DESCRIPTION) AS "S Path Report ID", PATIENTID AS "DMP Patient ID", SAMPLEID AS "DMP Sample ID", TUMOR_TYPE_CODE, TUMOR_TYPE_NAME, PRIMARY_SITE, METASTASIS_SITE, GENE_PANEL AS "Gene Panel", SITE1_GENE, SITE2_GENE, GENE_ID, TMBSCORE, DV.TODATE(DT_PROCEDURE) AS "Procedure Date" FROM DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML DT ON PDRX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML_SETTINGS ON PDRX_PATH_DMP_RESULTS_XML_ID = PDRXS_PATH_DMP_RESULTS_XML_ID JOIN DVDMC.PATHOLOGY_DMP_WEBSVC_SETTINGS ON PDRXS_SETTING_ID = PDWS_SETTING_ID CROSS JOIN XMLTABLE('$c/root/*' PASSING DT.PDRX_XML_VALUE AS "c" COLUMNS SAMPLEID VARCHAR(100) PATH '../meta-data/dmp_sample_id', PATIENTID VARCHAR(100) PATH '../meta-data/dmp_patient_id', DT_PROCEDURE VARCHAR(40) PATH '../meta-data/dt_procedure', TUMOR_TYPE_CODE VARCHAR(100) PATH '../meta-data/tumor_type_code', TUMOR_TYPE_NAME VARCHAR(255) PATH '../meta-data/tumor_type_name', PRIMARY_SITE VARCHAR(255) PATH '../meta-data/primary_site', IS_METASTASIS VARCHAR(10) PATH '../meta-data/is_metastasis', METASTASIS_SITE VARCHAR(255) PATH '../meta-data/metastasis_site', TOTAL_NUMBER_VARIANTS int PATH 'count(../*[not(name()=''meta-data'')])', CNV_TYPE VARCHAR(500) PATH 'name()', VARIANT_CLASS VARCHAR(100) PATH 'variant_class', SITE1_GENE VARCHAR(100) PATH 'site1_gene', SITE2_GENE VARCHAR(100) PATH 'site2_gene', GENE_ID VARCHAR(100) PATH 'gene_id', EXON_NUM VARCHAR(100) PATH 'exon_num', AA_CHANGE VARCHAR(100) PATH 'aa_change', CDNA_CHANGE VARCHAR(100) PATH 'cDNA_change', GENE_FOLD_CHANGE VARCHAR(100) PATH 'gene_fold_change', VARIANT_ID VARCHAR(255) PATH 'snp_indel_variant_id|cnv_variant_id|sv_variant_id', CHROMOSOME VARCHAR(100) PATH 'chromosome', IS_HOTSPOT VARCHAR(100) PATH 'is_hotspot', CONFIDENCE_CV_ID VARCHAR(100) PATH 'confidence_cv_id', TRANSCRIPT_ID VARCHAR(100) PATH 'transcript_id', NORMAL_DP VARCHAR(100) PATH 'normal_dp', TUMOR_DP VARCHAR(100) PATH 'tumor_dp', NORMAL_AD VARCHAR(100) PATH 'normal_ad', TUMOR_AD VARCHAR(100) PATH 'tumor_ad', TUMOR_VFREQ VARCHAR(100) PATH 'tumor_vfreq', DBSNP_ID VARCHAR(100) PATH 'dbSNP_id', START_POSITION int PATH 'start_position', ALT_ALLELE VARCHAR(255) PATH 'alt_allele', REF_ALLELE VARCHAR(255) PATH 'ref_allele', TMB_COHORT_PERCENTILE VARCHAR(25) PATH 'tmb_cohort_percentile', TMB_TT_COHORT VARCHAR(25) PATH 'tmb_tt_cohort', TMBSCORE VARCHAR(25) PATH 'tmb_score', TMB_TT_PERCENTILE VARCHAR(25) PATH 'tmb_tt_percentile', TMBCOHORT VARCHAR(25) PATH 'tmb_cohort', VARIANT_TYPE VARCHAR(100) PATH './local-name(.)', GENE_PANEL VARCHAR(100) PATH '../meta-data/gene-panel', PART_DESCRIPTION VARCHAR(2000) PATH '../meta-data/part_description', PROJECT VARCHAR(100) PATH '../meta-data/dmp_alys_task_name', DT_SIGNOUT VARCHAR(40) PATH '../meta-data/dt_signout', DT_ACCESSIONED VARCHAR(40) PATH '../meta-data/dt_accessioned', DT_ALYS_END_TIME VARCHAR(40) PATH '../meta-data/dt_alys_end_time', DT_DMS_START_TIME VARCHAR(40) PATH '../meta-data/dt_dms_start_time') T LEFT JOIN VARIANTS_TO_OMIT ON CNV_TYPE = CNV_TYPE_OMIT LEFT JOIN VARIANT_CLASS_TO_OMIT ON VARIANT_CLASS = VARIANT_CLASS_OMIT WHERE 1=1 AND PDWS_NAME like '%IMPACT%' #PROMPTMANY('MRN', 'String', ' ', ' and PT_MRN in (', '', ')')# AND CNV_TYPE_OMIT IS NULL AND VARIANT_CLASS_OMIT IS NULL ) , IM2 AS (SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN, PDWS_DESCRIPTION, "M Path Report ID", "S Path Report ID", "DMP Patient ID", "DMP Sample ID", TUMOR_TYPE_CODE, TUMOR_TYPE_NAME, PRIMARY_SITE, METASTASIS_SITE, "Gene Panel", "Procedure Date", TMBSCORE FROM IM1 WHERE 1=1 AND "M Path Report ID" like 'M%' AND "S Path Report ID" like 'S%' ) , IM3 AS (SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN, "M Path Report ID", SITE1_GENE, SITE2_GENE, GENE_ID FROM IM1) , IM4 AS (SELECT PT_MRN, "M Path Report ID", SITE1_GENE AS GENE FROM IM3 WHERE SITE1_GENE <> '' UNION SELECT PT_MRN, "M Path Report ID", SITE2_GENE AS GENE FROM IM3 WHERE SITE2_GENE <> '' UNION SELECT PT_MRN, "M Path Report ID", GENE_ID AS GENE FROM IM3 WHERE GENE_ID <> '' ) , IM5 AS (SELECT PT_MRN, "M Path Report ID", COUNT(DISTINCT GENE) AS "Mutation Count", LISTAGG(COALESCE(STRIP(CAST(GENE AS VARCHAR(12000))), '') , CHR(13) || CHR(10)) WITHIN GROUP( ORDER BY "M Path Report ID", GENE) AS GENES FROM (SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN, "M Path Report ID", GENE FROM IM4) IM GROUP BY PT_MRN, "M Path Report ID") , IMPACT AS (SELECT DISTINCT IM2.*, GENES, CASE WHEN "Mutation Count" IS NOT NULL THEN "Mutation Count" ELSE 0 END AS "Mutation Count" FROM IM2 LEFT JOIN IM5 ON IM2.PT_MRN = IM5.PT_MRN AND IM2."M Path Report ID" = IM5."M Path Report ID") , AC AS (SELECT AC_MRN, MAX(CASE WHEN AC_IRB_NO = '06-107' THEN AC_CONS_DTE END) AS "06-107 Consent Date", MAX(CASE WHEN AC_IRB_NO = '00-144' THEN AC_CONS_DTE END) AS "00-144 Consent Date" FROM IDB.ACCRUALS WHERE 1=1 AND AC_IRB_NO IN ('06-107', '00-144') #PROMPTMANY('MRN', 'String', ' ', ' and AC_MRN in (', '', ')')# GROUP BY AC_MRN ) , CRDB AS (SELECT CRDB.PT_MRN, MAX(CASE WHEN REG_ID = '100' THEN CRDB.CRNT_CONSENT_DATE END) "12-245 Part A Consent Date", MAX(CASE WHEN REG_ID = '200' THEN CRDB.CRNT_CONSENT_DATE END) "12-245 Part B Consent Date", MAX(CASE WHEN REG_ID = '300' THEN CRDB.CRNT_CONSENT_DATE END) "12-245 Part C Consent Date" CRDB.PT_MRN in (', '', ')')# GROUP BY CRDB.PT_MRN ) SELECT DISTINCT STRIP(D.PT_MRN) AS MRN, CASE WHEN IMPACT.PT_MRN IS NOT NULL THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS "IMPACT", STRIP(PDWS_DESCRIPTION) AS PDWS_DESCRIPTION, "M Path Report ID", "S Path Report ID", "DMP Patient ID", "DMP Sample ID", TUMOR_TYPE_CODE, TUMOR_TYPE_NAME, PRIMARY_SITE, METASTASIS_SITE, STRIP("Gene Panel") AS "Gene Panel", GENES, "Mutation Count", "Procedure Date", STRIP(TMBSCORE) AS "TMB Score", "06-107 Consent Date", "00-144 Consent Date", "12-245 Part A Consent Date", "12-245 Part B Consent Date", "12-245 Part C Consent Date" FROM DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS D LEFT JOIN IMPACT ON D.PT_MRN = IMPACT.PT_MRN LEFT JOIN AC ON D.PT_MRN = AC_MRN LEFT JOIN CRDB ON D.PT_MRN = CRDB.PT_MRN WHERE 1=1 #PROMPTMANY('MRN', 'String', ' ', ' and d.pt_mrn in (', '', ')')#

prompt: Provide a one time list of patients who had a cystectomy anytime, were seen in the Bladder Clinic between Jan 1, 2019 and Dec 31, 2019 and had a vitamin B12 drawn at MSK.
completion: WITH RSP AS (SELECT DISTINCT SSE_MRN, STRIP(PT_LAST_NAME)||' '||STRIP(PT_FIRST_NAME) "NAME", PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH "DATE OF BIRTH", SSE_SURG_DTE FROM IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE ON SSE_LOG_ID = SSP_LOG_ID AND SSE_ENC_CSN_ID = SSP_ENC_CSN_ID JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON SSE_MRN = PT_MRN AND YEAR(CURRENT DATE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) >= 18 WHERE 1=1 AND SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD = '51595' AND YEAR(SSE_SURG_DTE) <= '2018' ), CD AS (SELECT DISTINCT CDD_MRN AS C_MRN, VB.LR_RESULT_VALUE AS RESULT_VAL, VB.LR_PERFORMED_DTE AS PERF_DT FROM RSP JOIN IDB.CD_DOCUMENT ON SSE_MRN = CDD_MRN AND CDD_DOC_NAME = 'Follow Up, Cystectomy - Urology' AND YEAR(CDD_SERVICE_DTE) = '2019' AND CDD_CANCEL_IND <> '1' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND <> '1' LEFT JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION ON CDD_DOC_GUID = CDO_DOC_GUID AND CDD_AUTHORED_DTE = CDO_AUTHORED_DTE AND CDO_CTLG_DISPL_NM IN ('Past Surgical History', 'Past Medical History') AND CDO_VALUE_TEXT <> '' JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT LR_MRN, COUNT(LR_PERFORMED_DTE) OVER (PARTITION BY LR_MRN) AS CNT, LR_RESULT_VALUE, LR_PERFORMED_DTE FROM IDB.LAB_RESULTS WHERE LR_CTLG_ITEM_GUID = '8000001483101001' AND YEAR(LR_PERFORMED_DTE) = '2019') VB ON SSE_MRN = VB.LR_MRN AND VB.CNT >= 1 WHERE 1=1 AND RSP.SSE_MRN NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT APR_MRN FROM IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX_V WHERE YEAR(APR_START_DTE) = '2019' AND YEAR(APR_END_DTE) <> '2019' AND CDG_CHEMO_FLAG = 'Y') AND RSP.SSE_MRN NOT IN (SELECT RTC_TX_MRN FROM IDB.RADONC_TREATMENT_COURSE WHERE YEAR(RTC_TX_START_DTE) = '2019' AND YEAR(RTC_TX_STOP_DTE) <> '2019') AND RSP.SSE_MRN NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT OO_MRN FROM IDB.OMS_ORDER WHERE OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID IN ('1000004343073029', '9000001217073001', '9000003188073001') AND YEAR(OO_ENTER_DTE) = '2019' AND YEAR(OO_STOP_DTE) <> '2019') ), MD AS (SELECT HCPR_MRN , DATE(HCPR_START_DT) START_DATE , HCPR_END_DT AS END_DATE , HCPR_DRUG_NAME AS DRUG_NAME , HGN_GENERIC_NAME AS GENERIC_NAME , HCPR_STATUS_TYPE_DESC AS PRESCRIPTION_STATUS FROM CD JOIN IDB.HML_CLIENT_PRESCRIPTION ON C_MRN = HCPR_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_CLIENT_VISIT ON OCV_VISIT_GUID = HCPR_VISIT_GUID LEFT JOIN IDB.HML_GENERIC_NAME ON HGN_GENERIC_NAME_ID = HCPR_GENERIC_NAME_ID WHERE HCPR_STATUS_TYPE_DESC = 'Active' AND HCPR_CREATED_DTE IS NOT NULL AND((HCPR_PRESCRIPTION_TYPE = 1 AND HCPR_TRANSMISSION_STATUS IN (1, 2, 5) ) OR HCPR_PRESCRIPTION_TYPE = 3) ), MH AS (SELECT DISTINCT CDD_MRN AS M_MRN, CDO_VALUE_TEXT AS MED_HIST FROM CD JOIN IDB.CD_DOCUMENT ON CD.C_MRN = CDD_MRN AND CDD_DOC_NAME = 'Follow Up, Cystectomy - Urology' AND YEAR(CDD_SERVICE_DTE) = '2019' AND CDD_CANCEL_IND <> '1' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND <> '1' LEFT JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION ON CDD_DOC_GUID = CDO_DOC_GUID AND CDD_AUTHORED_DTE = CDO_AUTHORED_DTE AND CDO_CTLG_DISPL_NM = 'Past Medical History' AND CDO_VALUE_TEXT <> ''), SP AS (SELECT DISTINCT CDD_MRN AS S_MRN, CDO_VALUE_TEXT AS SURG_HIST FROM CD JOIN IDB.CD_DOCUMENT ON CD.C_MRN = CDD_MRN AND CDD_DOC_NAME = 'Follow Up, Cystectomy - Urology' AND YEAR(CDD_SERVICE_DTE) = '2019' AND CDD_CANCEL_IND <> '1' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND <> '1' LEFT JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION ON CDD_DOC_GUID = CDO_DOC_GUID AND CDD_AUTHORED_DTE = CDO_AUTHORED_DTE AND CDO_CTLG_DISPL_NM = 'Past Surgical History' AND CDO_VALUE_TEXT <> '') SELECT DISTINCT SSE_MRN "MRN" , "NAME" , "DATE OF BIRTH" , SSE_SURG_DTE "DATE OF CYSTECTOMY" , CD.RESULT_VAL "VITAMIN B12 RESULT" , MD.DRUG_NAME "MEDICATION LIST" , MH.MED_HIST "PAST MEDICAL HISTORY" , SP.SURG_HIST "PAST SURGICAL HISTORY" FROM RSP RS LEFT JOIN CD ON RS.SSE_MRN = CD.C_MRN LEFT JOIN MH ON CD.C_MRN = MH.M_MRN LEFT JOIN SP ON CD.C_MRN = SP.S_MRN LEFT JOIN MD ON CD.C_MRN = MD.HCPR_MRN

prompt: Schedule a daily report of Influenza, Parainfluenza, Metapneumovirus and Covid-19 patients who tested positive yesterday.

YEAR(RESULT_DATE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) AS AGE, RESULT, RESULT_DATE FROM IDB.PATIENT JOIN COVID ON MRN = PT_MRN) , DX AS (SELECT DISTINCT TM_MRN AS MRN, TM_DX_DTE, TM_SITE_CD AS SITE_CODE, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_DESC, TM_HIST_CD AS HIST_CODE, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS HIST_DESC FROM PT JOIN IDB.CDB_TUMOR ON MRN = TM_MRN JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD WHERE 1=1 AND TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') ) , HSCT AS (SELECT CBM_MRN AS MRN, CBM_TRANSPLANT_TYPE AS BMT_TYPE, CBM_TRANSPLANT_DTE AS BMT_DATE FROM IDB.CRDB_BMT_MEDICINE WHERE CBM_MRN IN (SELECT MRN FROM PT) UNION SELECT CBP_MRN AS MRN, CBP_TRANSPLANT_TYPE AS BMT_TYPE, CBP_TRANSPLANT_DTE AS BMT_DATE FROM IDB.CRDB_BMT_PEDIATRICS WHERE CBP_MRN IN (SELECT MRN FROM PT) ) , VISIT AS (SELECT VIS_MRN, VIS_ADM_NUM, VIS_ADM_DTE, VIS_DSCH_DTE, VIS_PATIENT_TYPE, VIS_HOSP_SVC, VIS_NURS_STA, VIS_BED, CASE WHEN ATN_DR_NAME = 'RESOURCE,ADT' THEN '' ELSE VIS_VISIT_STATUS IN ('2', '3') ) SELECT DISTINCT PT.*, SITE_CODE, STRIP(SITE_DESC) AS SITE_DESC, HIST_CODE, STRIP(HIST_DESC) AS HIST_DESC, TM_DX_DTE, BMT_TYPE, BMT_DATE, PLA_LST_CHEMO_DTE, VIS_PATIENT_TYPE, VIS_NURS_STA, VIS_BED, ATN_DR_NAME FROM PT LEFT JOIN DX ON PT.MRN = DX.MRN LEFT JOIN HSCT ON PT.MRN = HSCT.MRN LEFT JOIN VISIT ON PT.MRN = VIS_MRN AND RN = 1 LEFT JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY ON PT.MRN = PLA_MRN WITH LABS AS (SELECT DISTINCT LR_MRN AS MRN, LR_PERFORMED_DTE AS PERFORMED_DTE, STRIP(LR_TEST_NAME) AS TEST_NAME, STRIP(LR_SUBTEST_NAME) AS SUBTEST_NAME, LR_RESULT_VALUE AS RESULT_VALUE, LR_UNIT_MEASURE AS UNIT_MEASURE, LTL_TEXT_RESULT AS TEXT_RESULT FROM IDB.LAB_RESULTS LEFT JOIN IDB.LAB_TEXT_LINE ON LTL_RESULT_GUID = LR_RESULT_GUID WHERE LR_PERFORMED_DTE >= CURRENT DATE - 30 DAY AND LR_CTLG_ITEM_GUID IN ('9000004484201010', '9000004484301010', '9000004484401010', '9000004484501010', '9000004882701010', '9000004882801010', '9000004882901010', '9000006268201010', '9000006268401010', '9000004484701010', '9000006268101010', '9000004484601010', '9000006410501010', '9000006268301010', '1000003561101020', '2000003432101020', '9000004484801010') AND LTL_TEXT_RESULT LIKE 'Detected%' ) , PT AS (SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN AS MRN, STRIP(PT_LAST_NAME) || ', ' || STRIP(PT_FIRST_NAME) AS "Name", PT_SEX AS "Gender", PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH AS DOB, YEAR(PERFORMED_DTE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) AS AGE, PERFORMED_DTE, TEST_NAME, SUBTEST_NAME, STRIP(REPLACE(TEXT_RESULT, 'Reference Range: [Not Detected]', '')) AS TEXT_RESULT FROM IDB.PATIENT JOIN LABS ON MRN = PT_MRN) , DX AS (SELECT DISTINCT TM_MRN AS MRN, TM_DX_DTE, TM_SITE_CD AS SITE_CODE, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_DESC, TM_HIST_CD AS HIST_CODE, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS HIST_DESC FROM PT JOIN IDB.CDB_TUMOR ON MRN = TM_MRN JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD WHERE 1=1 AND TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') ) , HSCT AS (SELECT CBM_MRN AS MRN, CBM_TRANSPLANT_TYPE AS BMT_TYPE, CBM_TRANSPLANT_DTE AS BMT_DATE FROM IDB.CRDB_BMT_MEDICINE WHERE CBM_MRN IN (SELECT MRN FROM PT) UNION SELECT CBP_MRN AS MRN, CBP_TRANSPLANT_TYPE AS BMT_TYPE, CBP_TRANSPLANT_DTE AS BMT_DATE FROM IDB.CRDB_BMT_PEDIATRICS WHERE CBP_MRN IN (SELECT MRN FROM PT) ) , VISIT AS (SELECT VIS_MRN, VIS_ADM_NUM, VIS_ADM_DTE, VIS_DSCH_DTE, VIS_PATIENT_TYPE, VIS_HOSP_SVC, VIS_NURS_STA, VIS_BED, CASE WHEN ATN_DR_NAME = 'RESOURCE,ADT' THEN '' ELSE ATN_DR_NAME END AS ATN_DR_NAME, VIS_IP_OP_ADJUSTED_IND, VIS_VISIT_STATUS, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY VIS_MRN ORDER BY VIS_ADM_DT DESC) AS RN FROM IDB.VISIT_V JOIN PT ON VIS_MRN = MRN AND VIS_VISIT_STATUS IN ('2', '3') ) SELECT DISTINCT PT.*, SITE_CODE, STRIP(SITE_DESC) AS SITE_DESC, HIST_CODE, STRIP(HIST_DESC) AS HIST_DESC, TM_DX_DTE, BMT_TYPE, BMT_DATE, PLA_LST_CHEMO_DTE, VIS_PATIENT_TYPE, VIS_NURS_STA, VIS_BED, ATN_DR_NAME FROM PT LEFT JOIN DX ON PT.MRN = DX.MRN LEFT JOIN HSCT ON PT.MRN = HSCT.MRN LEFT JOIN VISIT ON PT.MRN = VIS_MRN AND RN = 1 LEFT JOIN IDB.PT_LATEST_ACTIVITY ON PT.MRN = PLA_MRN

prompt: Requesting Upcoming Breast NVs and IRs

visit' WHEN (CL_VISIT_TYPE_NV_IR."CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR" LIKE '%' || 'NEW' || '%') THEN 'New visit' WHEN (CL_VISIT_TYPE_NV_IR."CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR" LIKE '%' || 'IR' || '%') THEN 'Internal referral' ELSE "IDB"."CL_DEPT" AS CL_DEPT_DEPT_NAME ON CL_PT_ENCOUNTER."CPE_DEPT_ID" = CL_DEPT_DEPT_NAME."CLD_DEPT_ID" LEFT OUTER JOIN "IDB"."CL_VISIT_TYPE" AS CL_VISIT_TYPE_NV_IR ON CL_PT_ENCOUNTER."CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID" = CL_VISIT_TYPE_NV_IR."CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID" JOIN "IDB"."CL_DEPT" AS CL_DEPT_SVC ON CL_PT_ENCOUNTER."CPE_DEPT_ID" = CL_DEPT_SVC."CLD_DEPT_ID" LEFT OUTER JOIN "IDB"."CL_CATEGORY" AS CL_CATEGORY_SVC ON CL_DEPT_SVC."CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8" = CL_CATEGORY_SVC."CAV_ABBR" AND CL_CATEGORY_SVC."CAV_CATEGORY" = 'CLD_RPT_GRP_8' JOIN "IDB"."CL_RESOURCE" AS CL_PT_ENCOUNTER."CPE_CPE_APPT_STS" IN ('Sch') AND CL_DEPT_DEPT_NAME."CLD_DEPT_NAME" IN ('BER BRE DMT-C SVR', 'BER BRE MED-C', 'BER BRE MED-C NURSING', 'BER BREAST-2', 'BER BREAST-2 NURSING', 'BRE MED 1919', 'BRE MED 300 E66', 'BRE MED 300 E66 APP', 'BRE MED 300 E66 RES RN', 'BRE MED 300 E66 RN', 'BRE MED 300 E66 SVRSHP', 'BRE MED WES', 'BRE MED WES APP', 'BRE MED WES NURSING', 'BREAST 1275', 'BREAST 1919', 'BREAST 300 E66', 'BREAST 300 E66 APP', 'BREAST 300 E66 NURSING', 'BREAST 300 E66 SVRSHP', 'BREAST 64 PROCEDURES', 'BREAST BTQ 300 E66', 'BREAST DMT 300 E66 SVR', 'BREAST DMT WES SVR', 'BREAST MMC FLB', 'BREAST WES', 'BREAST WES APP', 'BREAST WES NURSING', 'BSK BRE MED-3', 'BSK BREAST', 'CHEMO BRE 300 E66', 'CMK BRE MED', 'CMK BREAST', 'IR BREAST 300 E66 PEND', 'MON BRE DMT-2 SVR', 'MON BRE DMT-C SVR', 'MON BRE MED-2', 'MON BRE MED-C', 'MON BREAST-2', 'MON BREAST-C', 'NAS BRE MED-2', 'NAS BREAST-2', 'RVC BRE MED', 'RVC BREAST', 'ST BRE 1275') AND CASE WHEN (CL_VISIT_TYPE_NV_IR."CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR" LIKE '%' || 'NV' || '%') THEN 'New visit' WHEN (CL_VISIT_TYPE_NV_IR."CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR" LIKE '%' || 'NEW' || '%') THEN 'New visit' WHEN (CL_VISIT_TYPE_NV_IR."CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR" LIKE '%' || 'IR' || '%') THEN 'Internal referral' ELSE 'Non new visit/Internal referral' END IN ('New visit', 'Internal referral') AND CL_CATEGORY_SVC."CAV_NAME" IN ('Breast') AND CL_RESOURCE_RES_TYPE."CRE_RES_TYP" IN ('Physician')), COHORT AS (SELECT PT_DEID AS PT_DEID FROM (SELECT APPOINTMENTS_0.PT_DEID AS PT_DEID FROM APPOINTMENTS_0)), COHORT_APPOINTMENTS AS (SELECT SUBJECT_ID AS SUBJECT_ID, PT_DEID AS PT_DEID FROM (SELECT APPOINTMENTS_0.SUBJECT_ID AS SUBJECT_ID, APPOINTMENTS_0.PT_DEID AS PT_DEID FROM APPOINTMENTS_0)), KEYS AS (SELECT COHORT.PT_DEID AS COHORT_PT_DEID, COHORT_APPOINTMENTS.SUBJECT_ID AS COHORT_APPOINTMENTS_SUBJECT_ID, COHORT_APPOINTMENTS.PT_DEID AS COHORT_APPOINTMENTS_PT_DEID FROM COHORT LEFT OUTER JOIN COHORT_APPOINTMENTS ON COHORT_APPOINTMENTS.PT_DEID = COHORT.PT_DEID), DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS AS (SELECT DISTINCT "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AS PT_DEID, IDB_PATIENT."PT_MRN" AS PT_MRN, "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AS SUBJECT_ID FROM "IDB"."PATIENT" AS IDB_PATIENT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS" ON IDB_PATIENT."PT_MRN" = "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_MRN"), APPOINTMENTS_COLUMNS AS (SELECT DISTINCT "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AS PT_DEID, CL_PT_ENCOUNTER."CPE_ENC_CSN_ID" AS SUBJECT_ID, CL_PT_ENCOUNTER."CPE_ENC_DTE" AS APPT_DATE, CL_PT_ENCOUNTER."CPE_CPE_APPT_STS" AS APPT_STATUS, CL_RESOURCE_PROV."CRE_RES_NAME" AS PROVIDER, CL_VISIT_TYPE_AT."CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME" AS APPT_TYPE_NAME, CL_CATEGORY_CENTER."CAV_NAME" AS CENTER FROM "IDB"."CL_PT_ENCOUNTER" AS CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS" ON CL_PT_ENCOUNTER."CPE_MRN" = "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_MRN" AND "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_MRN" != '' AND "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_MRN" IS NOT NULL JOIN "IDB"."CL_RESOURCE" AS CL_RESOURCE_PROV ON CL_PT_ENCOUNTER."CPE_VST_RES_ID" = CL_RESOURCE_PROV."CRE_RES_ID" JOIN "IDB"."CL_VISIT_TYPE" AS CL_VISIT_TYPE_AT ON CL_PT_ENCOUNTER."CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID" = CL_CATEGORY_CENTER."CAV_ABBR" = CL_DEPT_CENTER."CLD_CLD_CENTER" AND CL_CATEGORY_CENTER."CAV_CATEGORY" = 'CLD_CENTER') SELECT DISTINCT DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS.PT_MRN AS MRN, APPOINTMENTS_COLUMNS.APPT_DATE AS APPT_DATE, APPOINTMENTS_COLUMNS.APPT_STATUS AS APPT_STATUS, APPOINTMENTS_COLUMNS.PROVIDER AS APPT_PROVIDER, APPOINTMENTS_COLUMNS.APPT_TYPE_NAME AS APPT_TYPE, APPOINTMENTS_COLUMNS.CENTER AS
