prompt: Weekly report of patients seen in PACC isolation
completion: WITH APPT AS (SELECT CPE_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME "Last Name", PT_FIRST_NAME "First Name", YEAR(CPE_ENC_DTE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) "Age", CPE_CL_PT_ID, CPE_ENC_CSN_ID, CPE_ENC_DTE_SEQ, CPE_ENC_DTE AS "Appt Date", TIME(CPE_APPT_DT) "Appt Time", CRE_RES_NAME AS "Resource Name", CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME AS "Visit Type Name", CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR AS "Visit Type Abbr", TIME(CPE_CHK_IN_DT) "Check in Time", TIME(CPE_RM_IN_DT) "Room in Time", TIME(CPE_RM_OUT_DT) "Room out Time", CPE_RM_NO "Room No", TIMESTAMPDIFF(4, CHAR(CPE_RM_OUT_DT - CPE_RM_IN_DT)) "In Room Duration (mins)" FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_PT_APPT ON CPE_CL_PT_ID = CPA_CL_PT_ID AND CPE_ENC_DTE_SEQ = CPA_ENC_DTE_SEQ JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPA_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPA_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON CPE_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT date - 7 DAYS AND CURRENT date - 3 DAYS AND CRE_RES_NAME ='PACC ISOLATION' ) , NOTES AS (SELECT A.*, CPAN_ENC_DTE_SEQ, CPAN_LINE_NO, CPAN_NOTE FROM APPT A JOIN IDB.CL_PT_APPT_NOTES ON CPAN_CL_PT_ID = CPE_CL_PT_ID AND CPAN_ENC_DTE_SEQ = CPE_ENC_DTE_SEQ) , T2 (CPE_MRN, CPAN_ENC_DTE_SEQ, CPAN_NOTE, CPAN_LINE_NO) AS (SELECT CPE_MRN, T1.CPAN_ENC_DTE_SEQ, CAST(STRIP(T1.CPAN_NOTE) AS VARCHAR(4000)), T1.CPAN_LINE_NO FROM NOTES T1 WHERE T1.CPAN_LINE_NO = 1 UNION ALL SELECT T1.CPE_MRN, T1.CPAN_ENC_DTE_SEQ, CAST(STRIP(T2.CPAN_NOTE) AS VARCHAR(4000)) || ' ' || CAST(STRIP(T1.CPAN_NOTE) AS VARCHAR(4000)) , T2.CPAN_LINE_NO + 1 FROM NOTES T1, T2 WHERE T1.CPE_MRN = T2.CPE_MRN AND T1.CPAN_ENC_DTE_SEQ = T2.CPAN_ENC_DTE_SEQ AND T1.CPAN_LINE_NO= T2.CPAN_LINE_NO+1 ) , T3 AS (SELECT CPE_MRN, CPAN_ENC_DTE_SEQ, MAX(CPAN_LINE_NO) CPAN_LINE_NO FROM T2 GROUP BY CPE_MRN, CPAN_ENC_DTE_SEQ) , FINAL AS (SELECT DISTINCT T2.CPE_MRN AS CPE_MRN, T2.CPAN_ENC_DTE_SEQ, T2.CPAN_NOTE FROM T2 INNER JOIN T3 ON T2.CPE_MRN = T3.CPE_MRN AND T2.CPAN_ENC_DTE_SEQ = T3.CPAN_ENC_DTE_SEQ AND T2.CPAN_LINE_NO = T3.CPAN_LINE_NO) SELECT A.CPE_MRN "MRN", "Last Name", "First Name", "Age", "Appt Date", "Appt Time", "Resource Name", "Visit Type Name", "Visit Type Abbr", "Check in Time", "Room in Time", "Room out Time", "Room No", "In Room Duration (mins)", CPAN_NOTE "Appt Note" FROM APPT A JOIN FINAL F ON A.CPE_MRN = F.CPE_MRN AND A.CPE_ENC_DTE_SEQ = F.CPAN_ENC_DTE_SEQ ORDER BY "Appt Date", "Appt Time"

prompt: All new visits seen by the Adult Leukemia service since 2013 with an MPN Diagnosis.
completion: SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN AS MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME, CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR, CPE_ENC_DTE, CRE_RES_NAME, CRE_RES_TYP, CLD_DEPT_NAME, CC_CLSF_CD AS ICD_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS ICD_DESC FROM IDB.PATIENT JOIN IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER ON PT_MRN = CPE_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CTC_CLSF ON PT_MRN = CC_MRN JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 = 'LEU' AND CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Sch', 'Arrived', 'Comp') AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN '2013-01-01' AND CURRENT date AND (SUBSTR(CC_CLSF_CD, 1, 5) IN ('C92.1', '205.1', 'C92.2', '205.2', 'D75.8', '289.8', '207.1', '238.4', 'D75.0', '289.6', 'D47.0', '238.5', 'D47.1', 'D47.4', 'D47.3', 'D72.1', '288.3', '202.6', 'C94.3', '207.8', 'C94.4', 'D75.8') OR CC_CLSF_CD IN ('D45', '238.76', '238.79', '289.89', '238.71', 'C96.21', '238.79', '289.83', '289.84', '289.89')) AND (CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME like '%NV%' OR CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME like '%IR%') ;

prompt: Provide a list of MRNs of the patients who completed the Telehealth Usability Questionnaire in Engage for IRB #19-382 (https://engage.mskcc.org/questionnaires/57).
completion: SELECT DISTINCT EF_MRN AS MRN, AC_IRB_NO AS "IRB Number", EF_SUBMISSION_DT AS "FORM SUBMISSION DATE", EF_FORM_NAME AS "FORM NAME", EFI_ITEM_TEXT AS "Questionnaire", EFI_VALUE AS "Responses" FROM IDB.EF_FORM LEFT JOIN IDB.EF_FORM_ITEM ON EF_FORM_ID = EFI_FORM_ID JOIN IDB.ACCRUALS ON EF_MRN = AC_MRN WHERE AC_IRB_NO = '19-382' AND EF_FORM_NAME = 'Telehealth Usability Questionnaire' ORDER BY EF_MRN, EF_SUBMISSION_DT

prompt: Provide a list of patients under the age of 18 seen in all depts at 1275 outside of PACC / Peds in 2019 and 2020.
completion: WITH PED_RAW AS (SELECT CPE_MRN PED_MRN, CPE_ENC_CSN_ID, CPE_ENC_DTE, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 PEDS_SERVICE, CLD_DEPT_NAME PEDS_DEPT_NAME, CLD_CLD_CENTER PEDS_LOCATION FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON CPE_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_PAS_PATIENT ON CPE_MRN = CPP_MRN WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN '2019-01-01' AND '2020-12-31' AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 = 'PED' AND CRE_RES_TYP = 'Physician' ) , PEDS AS (SELECT PED_MRN, PEDS_SERVICE, PEDS_DEPT_NAME, PEDS_LOCATION, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY PED_MRN) RN FROM (SELECT PED_MRN, PEDS_SERVICE, PEDS_DEPT_NAME, PEDS_LOCATION, COUNT(DISTINCT CPE_ENC_CSN_ID) APPT_CNT FROM PED_RAW GROUP BY PED_MRN, PEDS_SERVICE, PEDS_DEPT_NAME, PEDS_LOCATION)) , NON_PEDS_R AS (SELECT DISTINCT E.CPE_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_STATE, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH , CPE_ENC_CSN_ID , CPE_ENC_DTE AS APPT_DATE, CLD_CLD_CENTER LOCATION, D.CAV_TITLE AS DEPT, S.CAV_TITLE AS SERVICE, CLD_DEPT_NAME AS DEPT_NAME, CRE_RES_NAME AS PROVIDER, CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME AS VISIT_TYPE FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER E JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON E.CPE_MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_CATEGORY D ON D.CAV_CATEGORY = 'CLD_RPT_GRP_6' AND D.CAV_ABBR = CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_CATEGORY S ON S.CAV_CATEGORY = 'CLD_RPT_GRP_8' AND S.CAV_ABBR = CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN '2019-01-01' AND '2020-12-31' AND YEAR(CPE_ENC_DTE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) < 18 AND CLD_CLD_CENTER = 'MAIN' AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 <> 'PED' AND (CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 NOT IN ('OPH') AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 NOT IN ('PFS', 'MSKACCESS')) AND PT_LAST_NAME <> 'TEST' ) , NON_PEDS AS (SELECT CPE_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, DEPT, SERVICE, COUNT(DISTINCT CPE_ENC_CSN_ID) APPT_COUNT FROM NON_PEDS_R GROUP BY CPE_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, DEPT, SERVICE) SELECT CPE_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, DEPT, SERVICE, APPT_COUNT, PEDS_SERVICE, PEDS_DEPT_NAME, PEDS_LOCATION FROM NON_PEDS NP LEFT JOIN PEDS ON CPE_MRN = PED_MRN AND PEDS.RN = 1

prompt: Provide a list of patients diagnosed with leptomeningeal metastases/disease who received bevacizumab from the time of diagnosis within the last 10 years.
completion: SELECT DISTINCT "t2"."PT_MRN" AS "MRN", "t2"."PT_BIRTH_DTE" AS "Date of Birth", "t5"."DT_DTE" AS "ICD-9 First Dx Date" FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED" "t1" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V" "t2" ON "t1"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t2"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DIAGNOSIS_FINAL_ALL_V" "t3" ON "t1"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t3"."PDX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DIAGNOSIS_CODE_CAT_ICD9_V" "t4" ON "t3"."PDX_DX_CATALOG_ID" = "t4"."DXCC_DX_CATALOG_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DIAGNOSIS_FINAL_DATES_V" "t8" ON "t3"."PDX_DX_CATALOG_ID" = "t8"."PDX_DX_CATALOG_ID" AND "t3"."PDX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t8"."PDX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE" "t5" ON "t8"."FIRST_DIAGNOSIS_DATE_ID" = "t5"."DT_DATE_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PHM_PT_MEDS_MQT" "t9" ON "t1"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t9"."POD_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PHM_INVENTORY_CATALOG" "t6" ON "t9"."POD_PHARMA_INVENTORY_CTLG_ID" = "t6"."PINC_INVENTORY_CTLG_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PHM_ORDER_DTL" "t10" ON "t9"."POD_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t10"."POD_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AND "t9"."POD_PHARMA_INVENTORY_CTLG_ID" = "t10"."POD_PHARMA_INVENTORY_CTLG_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE" "t7" ON "t10"."POD_START_DATE_ID" = "t7"."DT_DATE_ID" WHERE ("t3"."DXA_CIC_CDER_INIT" IN ('YES') AND ("t4"."DXCC_ICD_CODE" = '198.4' AND ("t6"."PINC_GENERIC_NAME" IN ('BEVACIZUMAB', 'BEVACIZUmab') AND "t7"."DT_DTE" >= '2002-3-12'))) AND "t7"."DT_DTE" >= "t5"."DT_DTE"

prompt: Weekly report of patients with rectal cancer with MSI-High results from IMPACT Testing
completion: WITH GENE AS (SELECT DISTINCT PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID AS P_ID, PATH_RPT_DATE, GENE, METHOD FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_STRUCTURED_RESULTS_V WHERE GENE IN ('MSH2', 'MSH6', 'MLH1', 'PMS2') ) SELECT PT_MRN "MRN", PT_LAST_NAME "Last Name", PT_FIRST_NAME "First Name", MIN(DT_DTE) "Diagnosis Date", PATH_RPT_DATE "Path Report Date", GENE, METHOD FROM DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS JOIN DV.PATIENT_DIAGNOSIS_FINAL_ALL_V ON PDX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID JOIN DV.DATE_V ON PDX_DX_DATE_ID = DT_DATE_ID JOIN DV.DIAGNOSIS_CATALOG ON PDX_DX_CATALOG_ID = DXCC_DX_CATALOG_ID JOIN GENE ON PDX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = P_ID WHERE SUBSTR(DXCC_ICD_CODE, 1, 3) IN ('C20') AND PT_DEATH_DTE IS NULL GROUP BY PT_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, PATH_RPT_DATE, GENE, METHOD ORDER BY 1 DESC, 5 DESC ; WITH DX AS (SELECT PDX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, MIN(DT_DTE) "Diagnosis Date" FROM DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS JOIN DV.PATIENT_DIAGNOSIS_FINAL_ALL_V ON PDX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID JOIN DV.DATE_V ON PDX_DX_DATE_ID = DT_DATE_ID JOIN DV.DIAGNOSIS_CATALOG ON PDX_DX_CATALOG_ID = DXCC_DX_CATALOG_ID WHERE SUBSTR(DXCC_ICD_CODE, 1, 3) IN ('C20') AND PT_DEATH_DTE IS NULL GROUP BY PDX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME) SELECT PRPT_MRN "MRN", PT_LAST_NAME "Last Name", PT_FIRST_NAME "First Name", "Diagnosis Date", PRPT_PROCEDURE_DTE "Procedure Date", PRPT_REPORT_DTE "Report Date", PRPT_REPORT_TYPE_DESC "Report Type", PRPT_ACCESSION_NO "Accession No", PRPT_REPORT "Report Text" FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V JOIN DX ON PDX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID WHERE PRPT_REPORT IS NOT NULL AND PRPT_REPORT_DTE >= CURRENT DATE - 30 DAYS ORDER BY 1 DESC, 5 DESC ; SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN "MRN", PT_LAST_NAME "Last Name", PT_FIRST_NAME "First Name", DTRPT.DT_DTE "Path Report Date", MSI_SCORE "MSI Score", MSI_TYPE "MSI Type", TUMOR_TYPE_NAME "Tumor Type", PRIMARY_SITE "Primary Site", PDWS_NAME "METHOD" FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML INNER JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT ON PDRX_PATH_RPT_ID = PRPT_PATH_RPT_ID LEFT JOIN DV.DATE DTRPT ON PRPT_REPORT_DATE_ID = DTRPT.DT_DATE_ID LEFT JOIN DV.DATE DTPROCPATHRPT ON PRPT_PROCEDURE_DATE_ID = DTPROCPATHRPT.DT_DATE_ID INNER JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML_SETTINGS ON PDRX_PATH_DMP_RESULTS_XML_ID = PDRXS_PATH_DMP_RESULTS_XML_ID INNER JOIN DVDMC.PATHOLOGY_DMP_WEBSVC_SETTINGS ON PDRXS_SETTING_ID = PDWS_SETTING_ID INNER JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON PDRX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID, XMLTABLE('$c/root/*' PASSING PDRX_XML_VALUE AS "c" COLUMNS TUMOR_TYPE_NAME VARCHAR(255) PATH '../meta-data/tumor_type_name', PRIMARY_SITE VARCHAR(255) PATH '../meta-data/primary_site', MSI_SCORE VARCHAR(40) PATH '../meta-data/msi-score', MSI_TYPE VARCHAR(40) PATH '../meta-data/msi-type') T WHERE PDWS_NAME = 'IMPACT' AND PRIMARY_SITE = 'Rectum' AND MSI_TYPE = 'Instable' AND PT_DEATH_DTE IS NULL ORDER BY 1 DESC, 4 DESC

prompt: Provide modification of existing reports MED2471 - monthly statistics of microbiology tests by location and service
completion: SELECT DISTINCT OO_MRN, OS_SVC_GRP_CD AS SVC_CD , OS_SVC_DESC AS SVC_DESC , OOC_REV_CAT_DEPT , CASE WHEN OCV_IP_OP_IND = 'O' THEN OCV_CURR_LOC ELSE COALESCE(OL_LOC_NAME, OCV_CURR_LOC) END AS COLLECTION_LOCATION , CASE WHEN SUBSTR((CASE WHEN OCV_IP_OP_IND = 'O' THEN OCV_CURR_LOC ELSE COALESCE(OL_LOC_NAME, OCV_CURR_LOC) END), 1, 1) = 'M' THEN CASE WHEN SUBSTR((CASE WHEN OCV_IP_OP_IND = 'O' THEN OCV_CURR_LOC ELSE COALESCE(OL_LOC_NAME, OCV_CURR_LOC) END), 3, 1) = '1' THEN SUBSTR((CASE WHEN OCV_IP_OP_IND = 'O' THEN OCV_CURR_LOC ELSE COALESCE(OL_LOC_NAME, OCV_CURR_LOC) END), 1, 4) ELSE SUBSTR((CASE WHEN OCV_IP_OP_IND = 'O' THEN OCV_CURR_LOC ELSE COALESCE(OL_LOC_NAME, OCV_CURR_LOC) END), 1, 3) END ELSE (CASE WHEN OCV_IP_OP_IND = 'O' THEN OCV_CURR_LOC ELSE COALESCE(OL_LOC_NAME, OCV_CURR_LOC) END) END NURS_STA , OCV_CURR_LOC, LOC.OL_LOC_NAME , OO_ORD_NAME AS TEST_NME, OO_SIGNIFICANT_DT, OO_PERFORMED_DT , OO_ORD_GUID, OO_PVDR_GUID FROM IDB.OMS_ORDER JOIN IDB.OMS_CLIENT_VISIT ON OO_VISIT_GUID = OCV_VISIT_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_CATALOG ON OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID = OOC_MSTR_ITEM_GUID AND OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID IN ('3000001528073001', '1000003801073029', '7000001526073001', '6000001523073001', '6000001508073001', '7000001507073001', '3000001508073001', '7000001529073001', '1000001924073001', '5000001524073001', '1000003801073029', '8000001401073001', '3000004309073029', '3000003802073029', '5000001512073001', '3000001230073001', '4000003802073029', '4000001512073001', '2000004309073029', '9000006287100730', '7000001047073001', '9000001507073001') AND YEAR(OO_SIGNIFICANT_DT) = YEAR(LAST_DAY(CURRENT DATE - 1 MONTHS)) AND MONTH(OO_SIGNIFICANT_DT) BETWEEN 1 AND MONTH(LAST_DAY(CURRENT DATE - 1 MONTHS)) AND OO_ORD_STS_CD LIKE 'RE%' JOIN IDB.OMS_SERVICE ON OCV_SVC_GUID = OS_SVC_GUID LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_STS_HX SR ON SR.OSH_ORD_GUID = OO_ORD_GUID AND SR.OSH_FUNCTION_CD = '105' LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_VISIT_LOCATION LOCX ON OVL_VISIT_GUID = OCV_VISIT_GUID AND OSH_CREATE_DT BETWEEN OVL_EFF_DT AND COALESCE(OVL_CHNG_DT, TIMESTAMP(CURRENT DATE, CURRENT TIME)) AND OVL_LOC_GUID <> '6000001118061001' AND OCV_IP_OP_IND = 'I' LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_LOCATION LOC ON OVL_LOC_GUID = OL_LOC_GUID

prompt: Provide a report of all CBC-Diff results that correspond to H pathology cases in the last 5 years.
completion: WITH X AS (SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN AS MRN, "t2"."PRPT_ACCESSION_NO" AS "Pathology Report", "t3"."PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_DESC" AS "Pathology Report Type", "t4"."DT_DTE" AS "Pathology Procedure Date", "t5"."DT_DTE" AS "Pathology Report Date" FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V" "t1" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED" "t6" ON "t1"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t6"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V" "t2" ON "t6"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t2"."PRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATH_RPRT_TYPE_LOOKUP" "t3" ON "t2"."PRPT_REPORT_TYPE" = "t3"."PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_CD" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" "t4" ON "t2"."PRPT_PROCEDURE_DATE_ID" = "t4"."DT_DATE_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" "t5" ON "t2"."PRPT_REPORT_DATE_ID" = "t5"."DT_DATE_ID" WHERE 1=1 AND PRPT_REPORT_TYPE like 'H%' AND "t2"."PRPT_REPORT" IS NOT NULL AND "t4"."DT_DTE" BETWEEN '2019-01-01' AND CURRENT date ) , CBC AS (SELECT DISTINCT MRN, "Pathology Report", "Pathology Procedure Date", LR_PERFORMED_DTE AS PERFORMED_DTE, LR_TEST_NAME AS TEST_NAME, LR_SUBTEST_NAME AS SUBTEST_NAME, LR_RESULT_VALUE AS RESULT_VALUE, LR_UNIT_MEASURE AS UNIT_MEASURE, LR_TEST_UP_LIMIT, LR_TEST_LOW_LIMIT FROM X JOIN IDB.LAB_RESULTS ON LR_MRN = MRN AND LR_PERFORMED_DTE BETWEEN "Pathology Procedure Date" - 1 DAYS AND "Pathology Procedure Date" + 1 DAYS LEFT JOIN IDB.LAB_TEXT_LINE ON LTL_RESULT_GUID = LR_RESULT_GUID WHERE 1=1 AND LR_TEST_NAME like '%CBC%' AND(LR_SUBTEST_NAME IN ('Abs Lymph', 'Abs Mono', 'Abs Neut', 'Absolute Basophil', 'Absolute Blasts', 'Absolute Eosinophil', 'Absolute Immature Granulocyte', 'Baso', 'Blast', 'Eos', 'HCT', 'HGB', 'Immature Granulocyte', 'Lymph', 'Mono', 'Neutrophil', 'Nucleated RBC', 'RBC', 'WBC') OR LR_SUBTEST_NAME like '%Granulocyte%' OR LR_SUBTEST_NAME like '%MCH%' OR LR_SUBTEST_NAME like '%MCHC%' OR LR_SUBTEST_NAME like '%MCV%' OR LR_SUBTEST_NAME like 'Platelets%' OR LR_SUBTEST_NAME like '%RDW%') ) SELECT * FROM CBC

prompt: Requesting total volume of discharges in last 12 months, total isolation discharges in last 12 months, and total transfer in last 12 months.
completion: WITH BASE AS (SELECT DISTINCT UC_ADM_NUM, UC_SEQ_NO, UC_TRANSFER_DTE, UC_TRANSFER_TME, UC_END_DTE, UC_END_TME, UC_BED, UC_BED_OLD, UC_NURS_STA, UC_NURS_STA_OLD , OHI_CREATE_DT , OHI_ONSET_DTE , OHI_RESOLVED_DTE , OHI_CODE , OHI_HI_DESCRIPTION , OHI_HI_TEXT , OHI_STS_CD, VIS_ADM_DTE, VIS_DSCH_DTE FROM IDB.UNIFIED_CENSUS JOIN IDB.VISIT_V ON VIS_ADM_NUM = UC_ADM_NUM JOIN IDB.OMS_CLIENT_VISIT ON VIS_ADM_NUM = OCV_ADM_NUM AND OCV_VISIT_STS <> 'CAN' LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_HEALTH_ISSUE ON OCV_VISIT_GUID = OHI_VISIT_GUID AND OCV_MRN = OHI_MRN AND OHI_TYPE_CD='Inf Control' AND OHI_STS_CD NOT IN ('Entered in Error', 'Cancelled/Entered in Error') WHERE 1=1 AND UC_SEQ_NO = 1 AND VIS_IP_OP_ADJUSTED_IND = 'I' AND VIS_VISIT_STATUS = '3' AND VIS_DSCH_DTE BETWEEN '2019-09-01' AND '2020-08-30' ) , ISO AS (SELECT A.UC_ADM_NUM ISO_ADM_NUM , A.UC_BED ISO_BED , A.UC_HOSP_SVC ISO_SVC , A.UC_NURS_STA ISO_NURS_STA , TIMESTAMP(A.UC_TRANSFER_DTE, A.UC_TRANSFER_TME) ISO_TIME_IN , TIMESTAMP(A.UC_END_DTE, A.UC_END_TME) ISO_TIME_OUT FROM IDB.UNIFIED_CENSUS A JOIN BASE B ON A.UC_ADM_NUM = B.UC_ADM_NUM WHERE OHI_CREATE_DT BETWEEN TIMESTAMP(A.UC_TRANSFER_DTE, A.UC_TRANSFER_TME) AND TIMESTAMP(A.UC_END_DTE, A.UC_END_TME) ) SELECT DISTINCT UC_ADM_NUM , MAX(VIS_DSCH_DTE) VIS_DSCH_DTE , MAX(OHI_CREATE_DT) OHI_CREATE_DT , MAX(OHI_ONSET_DTE) OHI_ONSET_DTE , MAX(OHI_RESOLVED_DTE) OHI_RESOLVED_DTE , MAX(OHI_CODE) OHI_CODE , MAX(OHI_HI_DESCRIPTION) OHI_HI_DESCRIPTION , MAX(OHI_HI_TEXT) OHI_HI_TEXT , MAX(OHI_STS_CD) OHI_STS_CD FROM BASE A JOIN ISO ON UC_ADM_NUM = ISO_ADM_NUM GROUP BY UC_ADM_NUM ; SELECT DISTINCT UC_ADM_NUM, UC_SEQ_NO, UC_TRANSFER_DTE, UC_TRANSFER_TME, UC_END_DTE, UC_END_TME, UC_BED, UC_BED_OLD, UC_NURS_STA, UC_NURS_STA_OLD FROM IDB.UNIFIED_CENSUS JOIN IDB.VISIT_V ON UC_ADM_NUM = VIS_ADM_NUM WHERE 1=1 AND VIS_IP_OP_ADJUSTED_IND = 'I' AND VIS_VISIT_STATUS = '3' AND VIS_DSCH_DTE BETWEEN '2019-09-01' AND '2020-08-30' ORDER BY UC_ADM_NUM, UC_SEQ_NO ; SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT VIS_ADM_NUM) AS DISCHARGES, MONTH(VIS_DSCH_DTE) AS MONTH, YEAR(VIS_DSCH_DTE) AS YEAR FROM IDB.VISIT_V WHERE 1=1 AND VIS_IP_OP_ADJUSTED_IND = 'I' AND VIS_VISIT_STATUS = '3' AND VIS_DSCH_DTE BETWEEN '2019-09-01' AND '2020-08-30' GROUP BY MONTH(VIS_DSCH_DTE), YEAR(VIS_DSCH_DTE) ORDER BY YEAR(VIS_DSCH_DTE), MONTH(VIS_DSCH_DTE) ;

prompt: Provide chemotherapy and hormonal volumes summary volume data since 2018 for Digital Accelerator projects.
completion: WITH DTL AS (SELECT CAO_MRN MRN, CAO_ENTER_DTE ENTER_DATE, CAO_START_DTE CHEMO_START_DATE , STRIP(CAO_ORD_STS)||' - '||STRIP(CAO_STS_DESC) ORD_RX_STATUS , CAO_DRUG_NAME DRUG_NAME, CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME GENERIC_NAME, CDG_CHEMO_FLAG CHEMO_FLAG , CDG_CLASSIC_CHEMO_FLAG CLASSIC_CHEMO_FLAG, CDG_BIOLOGIC_IMMUNO_FLAG BIOLOGIC_IMMUNO_FLAG , CDG_IMMUNOTHERAPY_FLAG IMMUNOTHERAPY_FLAG, CDG_TARGETED_FLAG TARGETED_FLAG , CDG_HORMONE_FLAG HORMONE_FLAG, CDG_BONE_AGENTS_FLAG BONE_AGENTS_FLAG , CASE WHEN CAO_ORD_NAME LIKE '%INVEST%' OR CAO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID IN ('9000006990100730', '9000005414100730', '9000008662100730', '9000006264100730', '9000012461100730', '9000008905100730', '9000012990100730') THEN 'Y' ELSE ' ' END AS INVESTIGATIVE_FLAG , CASE WHEN UPPER(CAO_DRUG_NAME) LIKE '%PLACEBO%' THEN 'Y' ELSE '' END PLACEBO_FLAG , CAO_SET_GUID SET_GUID, CAO_SET_NAME SETNAME , CAO_SET_FORM_NAME SET_FORM_NAME, CAO_SUMMARY_LINE SUMMARYLINE , CAO_ORD_GUID ORDER_SOURCE_ID, CAO_SVC_TYPE SVC_TYPE, CAO_ORD_TYPE ORD_TYPE , SUBSTR(CHAR(YEAR(CAO_ENTER_DTE)), 1, 4) RPT_YR , CASE WHEN MONTH(CAO_ENTER_DTE) BETWEEN 1 AND 3 THEN 'Q1' WHEN MONTH(CAO_ENTER_DTE) BETWEEN 4 AND 6 THEN 'Q2' WHEN MONTH(CAO_ENTER_DTE) BETWEEN 7 AND 9 THEN 'Q3' ELSE 'Q4' END RPT_QTR , OU_DISPLAY_NAME PROVIDER_NAME, OUO_PVDR_ROLE_TYPE PROVIDER_ROLE, DOC_SVC SVC , CASE WHEN CPO_ORD_GUID IS NOT NULL THEN 'Performed' ELSE 'Not Performed' END STATUS FROM IDB.CHEMO_ALL_ORDERS LEFT JOIN IDB.CHEMO_PERFORMED_ORDERS ON CAO_ORD_GUID = CPO_ORD_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_ORDER ON CAO_ORD_GUID = OO_ORD_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_USER_ORDERS ON OO_ORD_GUID = OUO_ORD_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_USER ON OO_PVDR_GUID = OU_USER_GUID LEFT JOIN IDB.DOC ON OO_REQ_DR_NO = DOC_DR_NO JOIN IDB.CHEMO_DRUG_GENERIC ON CAO_GENERIC_NAME = CDG_GENERIC_NAME WHERE CAO_ENTER_DTE >= '1/1/2018' AND CAO_ENTER_DTE < '10/1/2019' AND CAO_ORD_TYPE_CD = 'Medication' UNION ALL SELECT APR_MRN MRN, APR_ORD_CREATE_DTE ENTER_DATE, APR_START_DTE CHEMO_START_DATE , APR_ORD_RX_STATUS ORD_RX_STATUS , APR_DRUG_NAME DRUG_NAME, CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME GENERIC_NAME, CDG_CHEMO_FLAG CHEMO_FLAG , CDG_CLASSIC_CHEMO_FLAG CLASSIC_CHEMO_FLAG, CDG_BIOLOGIC_IMMUNO_FLAG BIOLOGIC_IMMUNO_FLAG , '' IMMUNOTHERAPY_FLAG, CDG_TARGETED_FLAG TARGETED_FLAG , CDG_HORMONE_FLAG HORMONE_FLAG, CDG_BONE_AGENTS_FLAG BONE_AGENTS_FLAG , ' ' INVESTIGATIVE_FLAG, '' PLACEBO_FLAG , '' AS SET_GUID, '' SETNAME , '' SET_FORM_NAME, APR_INSTRUCTIONS SUMMARYLINE , CHAR(APR_ORDER_SOURCE_ID) ORDER_SOURCE_ID , CASE WHEN APR_DOC_SVC LIKE 'PED%' OR APR_DOC_SVC LIKE 'PD%' OR YEAR(APR_START_DTE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) <= 18 THEN 'PEDIATRIC' ELSE 'ADULT' END SVC_TYPE , APR_ORD_RX_TYPE ORD_TYPE , SUBSTR(CHAR(YEAR(APR_ORD_CREATE_DTE)), 1, 4) RPT_YR , CASE WHEN MONTH(APR_ORD_CREATE_DTE) BETWEEN 1 AND 3 THEN 'Q1' WHEN MONTH(APR_ORD_CREATE_DTE) BETWEEN 4 AND 6 THEN 'Q2' WHEN MONTH(APR_ORD_CREATE_DTE) BETWEEN 7 AND 9 THEN 'Q3' ELSE 'Q4' END RPT_QTR , APR_PROVIDER_NAME PROVIDER_NAME, APR_PROVIDER_ROLE PROVIDER_ROLE , APR_DOC_SVC SVC, 'Performed' STATUS FROM IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX_V JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON APR_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE APR_ORDER_SOURCE = 'CRX' AND APR_DRUG_PROCESS_STAGE <> 'H' AND APR_ORD_CREATE_DTE >= '1/1/2018' AND APR_ORD_CREATE_DTE < '10/1/2019' ) SELECT PROVIDER_NAME, MIN(PROVIDER_ROLE) PROVIDER_ROLE, MIN(SVC) SVC , RPT_YR, RPT_QTR, ORD_TYPE, SETNAME, STATUS , GENERIC_NAME, CHEMO_FLAG, CLASSIC_CHEMO_FLAG, BIOLOGIC_IMMUNO_FLAG , IMMUNOTHERAPY_FLAG, TARGETED_FLAG, HORMONE_FLAG, BONE_AGENTS_FLAG , INVESTIGATIVE_FLAG, PLACEBO_FLAG , COUNT(*) CNT FROM DTL GROUP BY PROVIDER_NAME, RPT_YR, RPT_QTR, ORD_TYPE, SETNAME, STATUS , GENERIC_NAME, CHEMO_FLAG, CLASSIC_CHEMO_FLAG, BIOLOGIC_IMMUNO_FLAG , IMMUNOTHERAPY_FLAG, TARGETED_FLAG, HORMONE_FLAG, BONE_AGENTS_FLAG , INVESTIGATIVE_FLAG, PLACEBO_FLAG

prompt: Provide monthly report of patients that have had a BD Glucan and/or Aspergillus Galactomannan blood test, or Aspergillus Galactomannan bronch wash test. Provide number of tests over the past 3 years
completion: SELECT OO_MRN MRN, OO_ACCT_NO ACCT_NO , STRIP(PT_LAST_NAME)||', '||STRIP(PT_FIRST_NAME) PT_NAME , OO_ENTER_DT ENTER_DT, OO_ORD_ID ORDID , OCV_ADM_DT ADM_DT , OCV_DSCH_DT DSCH_DT , OO_ORD_NAME AS TEST_NAME, OAN_ANC_NAME BATTERY_CD , OO_REQUESTED_DT REQUESTED_DT, OO_PERFORMED_DT PERFORMED_DT , OO_SIGNIFICANT_DT SIGNIFICANT_DT, OO_ARRIVAL_DT FINAL_RESULT_DT , STRIP(OO_ORD_STS_CD) ORD_STS , OOC_REV_CAT_DEPT REV_DEPT, OO_ANCIL_REF_CD ANCIL_REFCD , OO_SUMMARY_LINE ORD_SUMMARY, OO_REQ_TME_PRIO TIME_PRIORITY , OU_DISPLAY_NAME USER_NAME, OU_ORD_ROLE_TYPE USER_ROLE , OP_DISPLAY_NAME REQUESTER_NAME, OP_TASK_ROLE_TYPE REQUESTER_ROLE , OCV_VISIT_GUID VISIT_GUID, OCV_IP_OP_IND PT_TYPE, OCV_CURR_LOC CURR_LOC , RL.OSH_CREATE_DT COLLECTION_DT, SR.OSH_CREATE_DT SPECIMEN_RECEIVED_DT , CASE WHEN OCV_IP_OP_IND = 'O' THEN OCV_CURR_LOC ELSE COALESCE(OL_LOC_NAME, OCV_CURR_LOC) END AS COLLECTION_LOCATION , SPES.LR_PERFORMED_DT SPECIMEN_DT, SPES.LR_ENTER_DT SPECIMEN_RESULTED_DT , SPES.LR_RESULT_VALUE, SPES.LR_UNIT_MEASURE , SPESR.LTL_TEXT_RESULT RESULT_DESC FROM IDB.LAB_RESULTS SPES JOIN IDB.OMS_ORDER ON OO_ORD_GUID = SPES.LR_ORD_GUID AND OO_MRN = SPES.LR_MRN AND SPES.LR_PERFORMED_DTE = DATE(OO_PERFORMED_DT) AND SPES.LR_ACCESSION_NO = OO_ANCIL_REF_CD AND SPES.LR_ORD_MSTR_ITEM_GUID = OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_CATALOG ON OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID = OOC_MSTR_ITEM_GUID LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_ANCILLARY_NAME ON OOC_MSTR_ITEM_GUID = OAN_MSTR_ITEM_GUID JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PT_MRN = OO_MRN JOIN IDB.OMS_CLIENT_VISIT ON OCV_VISIT_GUID = OO_VISIT_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_USER ON OO_USER_GUID = OU_USER_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_PROVIDER ON OO_PVDR_GUID = OP_USER_GUID LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_STS_HX RL ON RL.OSH_ORD_GUID = OO_ORD_GUID AND RL.OSH_FUNCTION_CD = '105' LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_STS_HX SR ON SR.OSH_ORD_GUID = OO_ORD_GUID AND SR.OSH_FUNCTION_CD = '12' LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_VISIT_LOCATION LOCX ON OVL_VISIT_GUID = OCV_VISIT_GUID AND RL.OSH_CREATE_DT BETWEEN OVL_EFF_DT AND COALESCE(OVL_CHNG_DT, TIMESTAMP(CURRENT DATE, CURRENT TIME)) AND OVL_LOC_GUID <> '6000001118061001' AND OCV_IP_OP_IND = 'I' LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_LOCATION LOC ON OVL_LOC_GUID = OL_LOC_GUID LEFT JOIN IDB.LAB_TEXT_LINE SPESR ON SPES.LR_RESULT_GUID = SPESR.LTL_RESULT_GUID AND SPESR.LTL_LINE_NO = 1 WHERE SPES.LR_PERFORMED_DTE >= CURRENT DATE - 1 MONTH - DAY(CURRENT DATE - 1 MONTHS)DAYS + 1 DAYS AND SPES.LR_PERFORMED_DTE <= LAST_DAY(CURRENT DATE - 1 MONTHS) AND DATE(SPES.LR_ENTER_DT) >= CURRENT DATE - 1 MONTH - DAY(CURRENT DATE - 1 MONTHS)DAYS - 2 DAYS AND DATE(SPES.LR_ENTER_DT) <= prompt: Identify a cohort of patients with prostate cancer who have received SBRT using and not using the MR LInac.
completion: WITH X AS (SELECT DISTINCT STRIP(CPE_MRN) AS MRN, STRIP(PT_LAST_NAME) || ', ' || STRIP(PT_FIRST_NAME) AS "Name", PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH AS DOB, PT_SEX AS GENDER, CPE_ENC_CSN_ID AS CSN_ID, CPE_ENC_DTE AS "Visit Date", STRIP(R1.CRE_RES_NAME) AS "Location", R2.CRE_RES_NAME AS "Physician", CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR, CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME FROM IDB.PATIENT JOIN IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER ON PT_MRN = CPE_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE R1 ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = R1.CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE R2 ON CPE_REF_RES_ID = R2.CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT CLD ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN '2010-01-01' AND '2022-07-31' AND(CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR like '%SETUP%' OR CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR like '%EXT RT%') AND CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME like '%<%5%' ) , X_CT AS (SELECT MRN, COUNT(DISTINCT CSN_ID) AS TX_CT FROM X GROUP BY MRN) , Y AS (SELECT X.*, TX_CT FROM X JOIN X_CT ON X.MRN = X_CT.MRN ORDER BY X.MRN, "Visit Date") , RT AS (SELECT DISTINCT RTC_TX_MRN, RTC_TX_PLAN_NAME, RTC_PRIMARY_REF_POINT, RTC_TX_START_DTE, RTC_TX_STOP_DTE, RTC_TX_ELAPSED_DAYS, RTC_TX_PLANNED_FRACTIONS, RTC_TX_DELIVERED_FRACTIONS, RTC_TX_PLANNED_DOSE, RTC_TX_DELIVERED_DOSE, RTC_DOSE_CORRECTION FROM Y JOIN IDB.RADONC_TREATMENT_COURSE ON RTC_TX_MRN = MRN AND RTC_TX_START_DTE = "Visit Date" ) , Z AS (SELECT DISTINCT Y.*, RTC_TX_PLAN_NAME, RTC_PRIMARY_REF_POINT, RTC_TX_START_DTE, RTC_TX_STOP_DTE, RTC_TX_ELAPSED_DAYS, RTC_TX_PLANNED_FRACTIONS, RTC_TX_DELIVERED_FRACTIONS, RTC_TX_PLANNED_DOSE, RTC_TX_DELIVERED_DOSE, RTC_DOSE_CORRECTION FROM Y LEFT JOIN RT ON RTC_TX_MRN = MRN AND RTC_TX_START_DTE = "Visit Date" WHERE 1=1 ) , DX1 AS (SELECT DISTINCT TM_MRN AS MRN, TM_DX_DTE AS DX_DATE, TM_SITE_CD AS SITE_CODE, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_DESC FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.SEERGROUPING ON RECODE = DV.SEERF_ICDO(TM_SITE_CD, TM_HIST_CD) AND CATEGORY2 = 'Prostate' JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD WHERE 1=1 AND TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND TM_MRN IN (SELECT DISTINCT MRN FROM Z) UNION SELECT CC_MRN AS MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS DX_DATE, CLM_CLSF_CD AS SITE_CODE, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_DESC FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.SEERGROUPING ON RECODE = MIN(DV.SEERF_ICD9(CLM_CLSF_CD), DV.SEERF_ICD10(CLM_CLSF_CD)) AND CATEGORY2 = 'Prostate' WHERE CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND ((CC_PT_TYPE = 'I') OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) AND CC_MRN IN (SELECT DISTINCT MRN FROM Z) GROUP BY CC_MRN, CLM_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK ) , DX2 AS (SELECT * FROM (SELECT DX1.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY MRN ORDER BY DX_DATE) AS RN FROM DX1) D WHERE RN = 1 ) SELECT Z.*, DX_DATE, STRIP(SITE_CODE) || ' | ' || STRIP(SITE_DESC) AS DX FROM Z JOIN DX2 ON Z.MRN = DX2.MRN

prompt: Provide a weekly scheduled report for female patients scheduled for RO set up at Basking Ridge (aged 11-50) within the next 2 weeks that will need pregnancy test.
completion: SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN "MRN", PT_LAST_NAME "Last Name", PT_FIRST_NAME "First Name", A.CRE_RES_NAME "Resource", B.CRE_RES_NAME "Referring Provider", CLD_CLD_CENTER "Location", CPE_ENC_DTE "Appt Date", TIME(CPE_APPT_DT) AS "Appt Time", CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME "Visit Type", OOC_ITEM_DESC "Order", OSTS_STS_DESC "Order Status" FROM IDB.PATIENT JOIN IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER ON PT_MRN = CPE_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE A ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = A.CRE_RES_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE B ON CPE_REF_RES_ID = B.CRE_RES_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_ORDER ON OO_MRN = PT_MRN AND OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID = '9000006089100730' LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_STATUS ON OO_ORD_STS_CD = OSTS_ORD_STS_CD LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_CATALOG ON OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID = OOC_MSTR_ITEM_GUID WHERE PT_SEX = 'F' AND YEAR(CPE_ENC_DTE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) BETWEEN 11 AND 50 AND CPE_CPE_APPT_STS = 'Sch' AND CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID IN ('5108', '5110', '5111', '5112', '5113', '5103', '5104', '5105', '5106', '5107', '6650', '6648', '11472', '6649', '6653', '11879', '6651', '11470', '6652', '11458', '11459', '11460', '11461', '11463', '11464', '11465', '11570', '11571', '11564', '11565', '11567', '11568', '11569', '11468', '11469', '6647', '11477', '5778', '13219', '13220') AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT DATE + 1 DAY AND CURRENT date + 14 DAYS AND CLD_CLD_CENTER = 'BSK'

prompt: Provide antineoplastic, surgery, RT, diagnosis, radiology, lab, and demographic data for patients ICD-9/10 coded for primary pleural tumors.
completion: WITH CONFIG AS (SELECT '(?i)breast' AS DMP_SITE_PTR, '' DMP_TUMOR_PTR , 'Breast' AS ICD9_SEER, 'icd-9 ptr' AS ICD9_PTR , 'Breast' AS ICDO_SEER, 'icd-O ptr' AS ICDO_PTR , 'alveolar soft part sarcoma' AS PATH_PTR FROM SYSIBM.SYSDUMMY1) , PHI (PHI) AS ( VALUES ('Y')) , ICD9DXCODES AS (SELECT DXA_ATTRIBUTE_ID FROM DV.DIAGNOSIS_ATTRIBUTE WHERE DXA_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND DXA_CIC_CDER_INIT = 'YES') , ICD9_10_DXS AS (SELECT PD.PDX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID AS PID, MIN(DXD.DT_DTE) AS DX_DTE FROM DV.PATIENT_DIAGNOSIS PD INNER JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS D ON PD.PDX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = D.PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID INNER JOIN DV.DATE_V DXD ON PD.PDX_DX_DATE_ID = DXD.DT_DATE_ID INNER JOIN ICD9DXCODES DA ON PD.PDX_DIAGNOSIS_ATTRIBUTE_ID = DA.DXA_ATTRIBUTE_ID INNER JOIN DV.DIAGNOSIS_CATALOG DCC ON PD.PDX_DX_CATALOG_ID = DCC.DXCC_DX_CATALOG_ID AND DCC.DXCC_DX_TYPE IN ('ICD9', 'ICD10') WHERE 1=1 AND DCC.DXCC_ICD_CODE IN ('C38.4' , 'C45.0' , 'C49.3' , '163.9' , '171.4') GROUP BY PD.PDX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID) , DT AS (SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN AS MRN , PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID FROM ICD9_10_DXS JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS PDV ON PDV.PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PID) , RADIOLOGY AS (SELECT DISTINCT RRPT_MRN , RRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID AS PID , RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE , RRPT_FILM_DTE , RRPT_ORDER_GROUP , RRPT_ACCESSION_NO , RRPT_PROCEDURE_NAME , DV.REGEXSTR('(?i)IMPRESSION[:]*[\w\W]*(?=DICTATED BY:)', RRPT_REPORT_TXT) AS "Impression" , VARCHAR(RRPT_REPORT_TXT, 32000) AS "Report Text 32000 chars" FROM DV.RADIOLOGY_REPORT_V JOIN DT DT ON PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = RRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID WHERE 1=1 AND UPPER(RRPT_PROCEDURE_NAME) like '%ABLA%' ) SELECT * FROM RADIOLOGY ORDER BY 1, 2 ;

prompt: Daily list of patients going to be seen in medical oncology for the : a) upcoming week, and b) prior 3 weeks (4 weeks total) .
completion: WITH X AS (SELECT CPE_MRN AS "MRN", CPE_ENC_DTE AS "Appt Date", CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 AS "Department", CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 AS "Service", CLD_DEPT_NAME AS "Department Name", CRE_RES_NAME AS "Provider", CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME AS "Visit Type", CCH_CHEMO_NAME AS SCH_TX_NAME FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID JOIN IDB.CL_PT_CHEMO ON CPC_CL_PT_ID = CPE_CL_PT_ID AND CPC_ENC_DTE_SEQ = CPE_ENC_DTE_SEQ JOIN IDB.CL_CHEMO ON CPC_CHEMO_ID = CCH_CHEMO_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Sch', 'Comp', 'Arrived') AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 = 'CHM' AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 ='MEDONC' AND CRE_RES_TYP = 'Chemotherapy Unit' AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT DATE - 21 DAYS AND CURRENT DATE + 7 DAYS ) , TM AS (SELECT DISTINCT TM_MRN, TM_DX_DTE AS DX_DATE, TM_HIST_CD AS HIST_CODE, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS HIST_DESC, TM_SITE_CD AS SITE_CODE, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_DESC, CASE WHEN TM_BEST_AJCC_STG NOT IN ('', '88', '9', '99') THEN TM_BEST_AJCC_STG WHEN TM_AJCC_7 NOT IN ('', '888', '999') THEN AJCC7.AV_DESC WHEN TM_AJCC NOT IN ('', '88', '99') THEN AJCC.AV_DESC WHEN TM_GENERAL_STG NOT IN ('', '9') THEN GS.AV_DESC WHEN TM_PATH_STG_GRP NOT IN ('', '88', '9', '99') THEN TM_PATH_STG_GRP ELSE CLIN.AV_DESC END AS STAGE FROM X LEFT JOIN IDB.CDB_TUMOR ON "MRN" = TM_MRN JOIN IDB.CLM H ON TM_HIST_CD = H.CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON TM_SITE_CD = S.CLM_CLSF_CD LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS AJCC7 ON AJCC7.AV_ELEMENT = 'AJCC_7' AND AJCC7.AV_CODE = TM_AJCC_7 LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS AJCC ON AJCC.AV_ELEMENT = 'AJCC' AND AJCC.AV_CODE = TM_AJCC LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS GS ON GS.AV_ELEMENT = 'GENERAL_STG' AND GS.AV_CODE = TM_GENERAL_STG LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS CLIN ON CLIN.AV_ELEMENT = 'CLIN_STG_DSCR' AND CLIN.AV_CODE = TM_CLIN_STG_DSCR LEFT JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON "MRN" = PT_MRN WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') ) , Y AS (SELECT DISTINCT "MRN", STRIP(PT_LAST_NAME) || ', ' || STRIP(PT_FIRST_NAME) AS "Name", "Appt Date", "Service", "Department", "Provider", "Visit Type", DX_DATE, HIST_CODE, HIST_DESC, SITE_CODE, SITE_DESC, STAGE FROM X JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN TM ON MRN = TM_MRN) , APR AS (SELECT APR_MRN FROM (SELECT DISTINCT MRN FROM Y) YY JOIN IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX ON APR_MRN = MRN JOIN IDB.CHEMO_DRUG_GENERIC ON APR_GENERIC_NAME = CDG_GENERIC_NAME WHERE APR_START_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT date - 3 YEARS AND CURRENT date - 42 DAYS AND APR_ORD_RX_TYPE NOT IN ('HML', 'Rx') AND (CDG_BIOLOGIC_IMMUNO_FLAG = 'Y' AND CDG_THERAPEUTIC_CATEGORY like '%anti-%') ) , Y2 AS (SELECT * FROM Y WHERE MRN NOT IN (SELECT APR_MRN FROM APR) ) SELECT DISTINCT Y2.*, APR_START_DTE, CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME, APR_GENERIC_NAME, APR_PRESCRIBED_DOSE, APR_ROUTE FROM Y2 JOIN IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX ON APR_MRN = MRN JOIN IDB.CHEMO_DRUG_GENERIC ON APR_GENERIC_NAME = CDG_GENERIC_NAME WHERE APR_ORD_RX_TYPE NOT IN ('HML', 'Rx') AND (CDG_BIOLOGIC_IMMUNO_FLAG = 'Y' AND CDG_THERAPEUTIC_CATEGORY like '%anti-%')

prompt: Small cell lung cancer patients diagnosed from 1/1/1995 to 6/4/2019
completion: SELECT TM_MRN, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, PT_DATE_OF_DEATH, PT_SEX, PT_RACE_DESC, PT_PT_ETHNICITY_DESC, PT_MARITAL_STS_DESC, TM_DX_DTE, TM_HIST_CD, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS HIST_DESC, TM_SITE_CD, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_DESC, TM_CA_SURG_DTE FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD JOIN IDB.PATIENT_V ON TM_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND TM_SITE_CD LIKE 'C34%' AND TM_DX_DTE BETWEEN '1995-01-01' AND '2019-06-04' AND TM_HIST_CD IN ('M8041/3', 'M8012/3', 'M8013/3', 'M8560/3', 'M8246/3', 'M8045/3', 'M8042/3', 'M8043/3') ; WITH DX AS (SELECT TM_MRN, TM_DX_DTE, TM_HIST_CD, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS HIST_DESC, TM_SITE_CD, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_DESC FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD JOIN IDB.PATIENT_V ON TM_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND TM_SITE_CD LIKE 'C34%' AND TM_DX_DTE BETWEEN '1995-01-01' AND '2019-06-04' AND TM_HIST_CD IN ('M8041/3', 'M8012/3', 'M8013/3', 'M8560/3', 'M8246/3', 'M8045/3', 'M8042/3', 'M8043/3') ) SELECT RTC_TX_MRN, TM_DX_DTE, TM_HIST_CD, HIST_DESC, TM_SITE_CD, SITE_DESC, RTC_TX_COURSE_ID, RTC_TX_PLAN_NAME, RTC_TX_DELIVERED_FRACTIONS, RTC_TX_DELIVERED_DOSE, RTC_TX_START_DTE, RTC_TX_STOP_DTE, RTC_TX_ELAPSED_DAYS FROM IDB.RADONC_TREATMENT_COURSE JOIN DX ON RTC_TX_MRN = TM_MRN ; WITH DX AS (SELECT TM_MRN, TM_DX_DTE, TM_HIST_CD, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS HIST_DESC, TM_SITE_CD, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_DESC FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD JOIN IDB.PATIENT_V ON TM_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND TM_SITE_CD LIKE 'C34%' AND TM_DX_DTE BETWEEN '1995-01-01' AND '2019-06-04' AND TM_HIST_CD IN ('M8041/3', 'M8012/3', 'M8013/3', 'M8560/3', 'M8246/3', 'M8045/3', 'M8042/3', 'M8043/3') ) , CHEMO AS (SELECT DISTINCT APR_MRN FROM IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX JOIN IDB.CHEMO_DRUG_GENERIC ON APR_GENERIC_NAME = CDG_GENERIC_NAME JOIN DX ON APR_MRN = TM_MRN WHERE CDG_CHEMO_FLAG = 'Y' ) SELECT TM_MRN, TM_DX_DTE, TM_HIST_CD, HIST_DESC, TM_SITE_CD, SITE_DESC, CASE WHEN APR_MRN IS NOT NULL THEN 'Y' ELSE '' END AS CHEMO_FLAG FROM DX LEFT JOIN CHEMO ON TM_MRN = APR_MRN

prompt: Weekly list of patients with non-Hodgkin's lymphoma.
completion: WITH LYMP AS (SELECT TM_MRN FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR T JOIN IDB.SEERGROUPING SG ON DV.SEERF_ICDO(TM_SITE_CD, TM_HIST_CD) = RECODE AND SG.CATEGORY1 IN ('Lymphoma') AND CATEGORY2 IN ('Non-Hodgkin Lymphoma') JOIN IDB.CLM H ON TM_HIST_CD = H.CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON TM_SITE_CD = S.CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7') ) , TRANS AS (SELECT DISTINCT CDD_MRN MRN, PT_FIRST_NAME FIRST_NAME, PT_LAST_NAME LAST_NAME, HSCT_DATE AS APPOINTMENT_DATE, LOCATION AS CENTER, 'BMT' AS SERVICE, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH DOB, 'Report_Group_3 - StemCell Proc BMT Note' AS VISIT_CATEGORY FROM (SELECT CDD_MRN, CDD_DOC_GUID, CDD_SERVICE_DTE, MAX(CASE WHEN CDO_ITEM_NAME IN ('Location') THEN TRIM(CDO_VALUE_TEXT) END) LOCATION, MAX(CASE WHEN CDO_ITEM_NAME IN ('Donor Type') THEN TRIM(CDO_VALUE_TEXT) END) DONOR, MAX(CASE WHEN CDO_ITEM_NAME IN ('HSCT Date') THEN TRIM(CDO_VALUE_TEXT) END) HSCT_DATE FROM IDB.CD_DOCUMENT JOIN IDB.CD_OBSERVATION ON CDD_DOC_GUID = CDO_DOC_GUID JOIN LYMP ON TM_MRN = CDD_MRN WHERE CDD_DOC_NAME='Pre-Admission Note - BMT' AND CDO_ITEM_NAME IN ('Location', 'Donor Type', 'HSCT Date') AND CDD_CANCEL_IND <> '1' AND CDD_INCOMPLETE_IND <> '1' AND CDD_SERVICE_DTE >= '2021-06-01' GROUP BY CDD_MRN, CDD_DOC_GUID, CDD_SERVICE_DTE) D JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PT_MRN = D.CDD_MRN) , NEW_VISIT AS (SELECT MRN, FIRST_NAME, LAST_NAME, APPOINTMENT_DATE, CENTER, SERVICE, DOB, VISIT_CATEGORY FROM (SELECT CPE_MRN AS "MRN", PT_FIRST_NAME AS FIRST_NAME, PT_LAST_NAME AS LAST_NAME, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH DOB , CAST(CPE_ENC_DTE AS varchar) AS APPOINTMENT_DATE, CLD_CLD_CENTER AS CENTER, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 AS SERVICE, 'Report_Group_1 - NEW VISIT' AS VISIT_CATEGORY , ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CPE_MRN, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 ORDER BY CPE_ENC_DTE) RN FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN LYMP ON TM_MRN = CPE_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PT_MRN = CPE_MRN WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Sch') AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 IN ('BMT' ) AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 IN ('MED', 'NEU') AND CPE_MRN <> '' AND (CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME LIKE '%NV%' OR CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME LIKE '%IR%' OR CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME LIKE '%NEW%' ) AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN '2022-01-28' AND '2022-02-05' ) WHERE RN =1 ) , NOT_NEW AS (SELECT MRN, FIRST_NAME, LAST_NAME, APPOINTMENT_DATE, CENTER, SERVICE, DOB, VISIT_CATEGORY FROM (SELECT CPE_MRN AS "MRN", PT_FIRST_NAME AS FIRST_NAME, PT_LAST_NAME AS LAST_NAME, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH DOB, CAST(CPE_ENC_DTE AS varchar) AS APPOINTMENT_DATE, CLD_CLD_CENTER AS CENTER, CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME AS SERVICE, 'Report_Group_2 - BRAIN MRI' AS VISIT_CATEGORY , ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CPE_MRN, CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME ORDER BY CPE_ENC_DTE) EX FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN LYMP ON TM_MRN = CPE_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PT_MRN = CPE_MRN WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Sch') AND UPPER(CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME) LIKE '%MR%BRAIN%' AND CPE_MRN <> '' AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN '2022-01-28' AND '2022-02-05' ) WHERE EX =1 ) , RAD AS (SELECT RRPT_MRN, MRI_DATE, PROCEDURE_NAME, REPORT_DESC FROM (SELECT RRPT_MRN, RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE MRI_DATE, RRPT_PROCEDURE_NAME PROCEDURE_NAME, RRPT_REPORT_TXT REPORT_DESC , ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY RRPT_MRN ORDER BY RRPT_PERFORMED_DT DESC) RD FROM DV.RADIOLOGY_REPORT_V JOIN LYMP ON TM_MRN = RRPT_MRN WHERE 1 = 1 AND RRPT_ORDER_GROUP = 'MR' AND UPPER(RRPT_PROCEDURE_NAME) like '%BRAIN%' ) WHERE RD =1 ) SELECT * FROM (SELECT MRN, FIRST_NAME, LAST_NAME, APPOINTMENT_DATE, CENTER, SERVICE, ROUND (MONTHS_BETWEEN(CURRENT DATE, DOB)/12, 0) AS AGE, VISIT_CATEGORY, A.MRI_DATE, A.PROCEDURE_NAME, CAST(A.REPORT_DESC AS VARCHAR(200)) AS REPORT FROM NEW_VISIT NV LEFT JOIN RAD A ON A.RRPT_MRN = NV.MRN UNION SELECT MRN, FIRST_NAME, LAST_NAME, APPOINTMENT_DATE, CENTER, SERVICE, ROUND (MONTHS_BETWEEN(CURRENT DATE, DOB)/12, 0) AS AGE, VISIT_CATEGORY, B.MRI_DATE, B.PROCEDURE_NAME, CAST(B.REPORT_DESC AS VARCHAR(200)) AS REPORT FROM NOT_NEW NN LEFT JOIN RAD B ON B.RRPT_MRN = NN.MRN UNION SELECT MRN, FIRST_NAME, LAST_NAME, APPOINTMENT_DATE, CENTER, SERVICE, ROUND (MONTHS_BETWEEN(CURRENT DATE, DOB)/12, 0) AS AGE, VISIT_CATEGORY, C.MRI_DATE, C.PROCEDURE_NAME, CAST(C.REPORT_DESC AS VARCHAR(200)) AS REPORT FROM TRANS TR LEFT JOIN RAD C ON C.RRPT_MRN = TR.MRN) ORDER BY VISIT_CATEGORY, MRN, APPOINTMENT_DATE

prompt: Provide a list of males who have been FIT tested (screened for colorectal cancer via stool test) at Ralph Lauren Cancer Center in the past year.
completion: WITH DEMO AS (SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN , PT_LAST_NAME AS "Last Name" , PT_FIRST_NAME AS "First Name" , PT_SEX AS "Sex Assigned at Birth" , YEAR(CURRENT DATE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) AS "Age" , PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH AS "Date of Birth" , R.AV_DESC AS "Race" , PT_ZIP_CD , PT_PHONE , PT_EMAIL_ADDRESS FROM IDB.PATIENT LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS R ON R.AV_ELEMENT = 'RACE' AND R.AV_CODE = PT_RACE LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS E ON E.AV_ELEMENT = 'PT_ETHNICITY' AND E.AV_CODE = PT_PT_ETHNICITY WHERE PT_SEX = 'M' AND R.AV_DESC IN ('BLACK OR AFRICAN AMERICAN') AND YEAR(CURRENT DATE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) BETWEEN 45 AND 75 ) , LAST_YEAR_APPOINTMENTS AS (SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN AS "MRN", CPE_ENC_DTE AS "Appt Date", CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 AS "Department", CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 AS "Service", CLD_DEPT_NAME AS "Department Name", CRE_RES_NAME AS "Provider Name", CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME AS "Visit Type", CLD_CLD_CENTER, CPE_CPE_APPT_STS FROM DEMO JOIN IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER ON PT_MRN = CPE_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp', 'Sch') AND CLD_CLD_CENTER = '1919' AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 IN ('Screening') AND CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME IN ('APP NV', 'APP SHORT NEW VISIT') AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN '09-01-2021' AND CURRENT DATE ) , LAB_INFO AS (SELECT LR_MRN, LR_PERFORMED_DTE, LR_TEST_NAME, LR_SUBTEST_NAME, LR_RESULT_VALUE, LTL_TEXT_RESULT, LR_ABNORMALITY_CD FROM LAST_YEAR_APPOINTMENTS JOIN IDB.LAB_RESULTS ON "MRN" = LR_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.LAB_TEXT_LINE ON LTL_RESULT_GUID = LR_RESULT_GUID WHERE 1= 1 AND LR_TEST_NAME = 'Fecal Globin by Immunochemistry (FIT)' ) SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN , "Last Name" , "First Name" , "Sex Assigned at Birth" , "Age" , "Date of Birth" , "Race" , PT_ZIP_CD , PT_PHONE , PT_EMAIL_ADDRESS , LR_PERFORMED_DTE, LR_TEST_NAME, LR_SUBTEST_NAME, LR_RESULT_VALUE, LTL_TEXT_RESULT, LR_ABNORMALITY_CD, "Appt Date", "Department", "Service", "Department Name" "Provider Name", "Visit Type", CLD_CLD_CENTER, CPE_CPE_APPT_STS FROM DEMO JOIN LAST_YEAR_APPOINTMENTS ON "MRN" = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN LAB_INFO ON "MRN" = LR_MRN ;

prompt: To identify all patients at MSK who have had checkpoint inhibitor therapy in the past 10 years (2013-2023) with either incidental or treated Vestibular Schwannoma (Acoustic Neuroma)
completion: WITH INIT AS (SELECT DISTINCT APR_MRN, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, PT_SEX, CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME, MIN(APR_START_DTE) FIRST_START_DATE, APR_GENERIC_NAME FROM IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX JOIN IDB.CHEMO_DRUG_GENERIC ON APR_GENERIC_NAME = CDG_GENERIC_NAME LEFT JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON APR_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE (LOWER(APR_GENERIC_NAME) like ('%pembrolizumab%') OR LOWER(APR_GENERIC_NAME) like ('%nivolumab%') OR LOWER(APR_GENERIC_NAME) like ('%cemiplimab%') OR LOWER(APR_GENERIC_NAME) like ('%tremelimumab%') OR LOWER(APR_GENERIC_NAME) like ('%ipilimumab%')) GROUP BY APR_MRN, PT_FIRST_NAME, PT_LAST_NAME, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, PT_SEX, CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME, APR_GENERIC_NAME), DIAG AS (SELECT DISTINCT CC_MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) MIN_EFF_DATE, CC_CLSF_CD AS ICD9_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS ICD9_DESC FROM INIT LEFT JOIN IDB.CTC_CLSF ON APR_MRN = CC_MRN JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE (SUBSTR(CC_CLSF_CD, 1, 5) IN ('D33.3', 'D33.4', 'D33.7', '225.1', '225.2') OR SUBSTR(CC_CLSF_CD, 1, 6) IN ('Z85.22', 'V10.22')) AND CASE WHEN CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y' AND CC_PT_TYPE <> 'E' THEN 'Y' WHEN CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' AND YEAR(CC_EFF_DTE) < 2004 THEN 'Y' WHEN CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND YEAR(CC_EFF_DTE) < 2001 THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END = 'Y' GROUP BY CC_MRN, CC_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK HAVING MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) BETWEEN CURRENT DATE - 10 YEAR AND CURRENT DATE) SELECT DISTINCT INIT.*, MIN_EFF_DATE, ICD9_CD, ICD9_DESC FROM INIT JOIN DIAG ON APR_MRN = CC_MRN

prompt: Provide a list of MRNs and accession numbers for the specified list of patients from cBioPortal.
Provide monthly report of all blood cultures, positive and negative, sent to the Microbiology.
completion: SELECT OUO_MRN MRN, OO_ACCT_NO ACCT_NO , STRIP(PT_LAST_NAME)||', '||STRIP(PT_FIRST_NAME) PT_NAME , OO_ENTER_DT ENTER_DT, OO_ORD_ID ORDID , TIMESTAMP(CS_ADM_DATE, CS_ADM_TIME) ADM_DT , TIMESTAMP(CS_DSCH_DATE, CS_DSCH_TIME) DSCH_DT , OO_ORD_NAME AS TEST_NAME, OUO_ANC_NAME BATTERY_CD , OO_REQUESTED_DT REQUESTED_DT, OO_PERFORMED_DT PERFORMED_DT , OO_SIGNIFICANT_DT SIGNIFICANT_DT, OO_ARRIVAL_DT FINAL_RESULT_DT , STRIP(OUO_ORD_STS_CD)||' - '||STRIP(OUO_STS_DESC) ORD_STS , OUO_REV_CAT_DEPT REV_DEPT, OUO_ANCIL_REF_CD ANCIL_REFCD , OO_SUMMARY_LINE ORD_SUMMARY, OUO_REQ_TME_PRIO TIME_PRIORITY , OUO_USER_NAME USER_NAME, OUO_USER_ROLE_TYPE USER_ROLE , OUO_PVDR_NAME REQUESTER_NAME, OUO_PVDR_ROLE_TYPE REQUESTER_ROLE , OCV_VISIT_GUID VISIT_GUID, OCV_IP_OP_IND PT_TYPE, OCV_CURR_LOC CURR_LOC , RL.OSH_CREATE_DT COLLECTION_DT, SR.OSH_CREATE_DT SPECIMEN_RECEIVED_DT , CASE WHEN OCV_IP_OP_IND = 'O' THEN OCV_CURR_LOC ELSE COALESCE(OL_LOC_NAME, OCV_CURR_LOC) END AS COLLECTION_LOCATION , SPES.LR_PERFORMED_DT SPECIMEN_DT, SPES.LR_ENTER_DT SPECIMEN_RESULTED_DT , SPESR.LTL_TEXT_RESULT SPECIMEN_DESC , CULT.LR_PERFORMED_DTE CULTURE_DT, CULT.LR_ENTER_DT CULTURE_RESULTED_DT , CULTR.LTL_TEXT_RESULT CULTURE_RESULT , ORG.LR_PERFORMED_DTE ORGANISM_DT, ORG.LR_ENTER_DT ORGANISM_RESULTED_DT , ORGR.LTL_TEXT_RESULT ORGANISM_RESULT , SENS.LR_SUBTEST_NAME SENSITIVITY_SUBTEST, SENS.LR_PERFORMED_DTE SENSITIVITY_DT , SENS.LR_ENTER_DT SENSITIVITY_RESULTED_DT, SENSR.LTL_TEXT_RESULT SENSITIVITY_RESULT FROM IDB.OMS_USER_ORDERS JOIN IDB.OMS_ORDER ON OO_ORD_GUID = OUO_ORD_GUID JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PT_MRN = OO_MRN JOIN IDB.OMS_CLIENT_VISIT ON OCV_VISIT_GUID = OO_VISIT_GUID LEFT JOIN IDB.CASE ON CS_MRN = OO_MRN AND CS_ACCT_NO = OO_ACCT_NO AND CS_PT_STS <> 'IP' AND CS_ACCT_NO LIKE '84%' JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_STS_HX RL ON RL.OSH_ORD_GUID = OO_ORD_GUID AND RL.OSH_FUNCTION_CD = '105' LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_STS_HX SR ON SR.OSH_ORD_GUID = OO_ORD_GUID AND SR.OSH_FUNCTION_CD = '12' LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_VISIT_LOCATION LOCX ON OVL_VISIT_GUID = OCV_VISIT_GUID AND RL.OSH_CREATE_DT BETWEEN OVL_EFF_DT AND COALESCE(OVL_CHNG_DT, TIMESTAMP(CURRENT DATE, CURRENT TIME)) AND OVL_LOC_GUID <> '6000001118061001' AND OCV_IP_OP_IND = 'I' LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_LOCATION LOC ON OVL_LOC_GUID = OL_LOC_GUID JOIN IDB.LAB_RESULTS SPES ON OO_ORD_GUID = SPES.LR_ORD_GUID AND OO_MRN = SPES.LR_MRN AND OO_ACCT_NO = SPES.LR_ACCT_NO AND SPES.LR_PERFORMED_DTE = DATE(OO_PERFORMED_DT) AND SPES.LR_ACCESSION_NO = OUO_ANCIL_REF_CD AND SPES.LR_SUBTEST_NAME = 'Specimen Description' LEFT JOIN IDB.LAB_TEXT_LINE SPESR ON SPES.LR_RESULT_GUID = SPESR.LTL_RESULT_GUID AND SPESR.LTL_LINE_NO = 1 JOIN IDB.LAB_RESULTS CULT ON OO_ORD_GUID = CULT.LR_ORD_GUID AND OO_MRN = CULT.LR_MRN AND OO_ACCT_NO = CULT.LR_ACCT_NO AND CULT.LR_PERFORMED_DTE = DATE(OO_PERFORMED_DT) AND CULT.LR_ACCESSION_NO = OUO_ANCIL_REF_CD AND CULT.LR_SUBTEST_NAME = 'Culture' LEFT JOIN IDB.LAB_TEXT_LINE CULTR ON CULT.LR_RESULT_GUID = CULTR.LTL_RESULT_GUID AND CULTR.LTL_LINE_NO = 1 LEFT JOIN IDB.LAB_RESULTS ORG ON OO_ORD_GUID = ORG.LR_ORD_GUID AND OO_MRN = ORG.LR_MRN AND OO_ACCT_NO = ORG.LR_ACCT_NO AND ORG.LR_PERFORMED_DTE = DATE(OO_PERFORMED_DT) AND ORG.LR_ACCESSION_NO = OUO_ANCIL_REF_CD AND ORG.LR_SUBTEST_NAME = 'Organism' LEFT JOIN IDB.LAB_TEXT_LINE ORGR ON ORG.LR_RESULT_GUID = ORGR.LTL_RESULT_GUID AND ORGR.LTL_LINE_NO = 1 LEFT JOIN IDB.LAB_RESULTS SENS ON OO_ORD_GUID = SENS.LR_ORD_GUID AND OO_MRN = SENS.LR_MRN AND OO_ACCT_NO = SENS.LR_ACCT_NO AND SENS.LR_PERFORMED_DTE = DATE(OO_PERFORMED_DT) AND SENS.LR_ACCESSION_NO = OUO_ANCIL_REF_CD AND SENS.LR_SUBTEST_NAME LIKE '%Sensitivity%' LEFT JOIN IDB.LAB_TEXT_LINE SENSR ON SENS.LR_RESULT_GUID = SENSR.LTL_RESULT_GUID AND SENSR.LTL_LINE_NO = 1 WHERE OUO_ENTER_DTE BETWEEN '2011-01-15' AND '2011-01-20' AND OUO_ORD_NAME = 'Bacterial/Fungal Culture, Blood' AND OUO_ORD_STS_CD LIKE 'RE%' AND OUO_REV_CAT_DEPT = 'Laboratory'

prompt: Provide pathology and Cancer Database (CDB) data for a specific group of patients.
completion: SELECT MRN AS "MRN", DXCC_ICD_CODE AS "ICD-O Histology Code", DXCC_ICD_MSK_DESC AS "ICD-O Histology Desc", ICSC_SITE_CD AS "ICD-O Site Code", ICSC_ICDO_SITE_MSK_DESC AS "ICD-O Site Desc", CDTM_LATERALITY_DESC AS "Laterality Code Description", TCA_CASE_STS AS "CDB Case Status" FROM WILLSJ.WILLSJ_SUR3936B JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON MRN = PT_MRN JOIN DV.CDB_TUMOR ON PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = CDTM_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID JOIN DV.TUMOR_CASE_ATTRIBUTES ON CDTM_CASE_ATTR_ID = TUMOR_CASE_ATTR_ID JOIN DV.DIAGNOSIS_CODE_CAT_ICDO_V ON CDTM_DX_CATALOG_ID = DXCC_DX_CATALOG_ID JOIN DV.ICDO_SITE_CATALOG_V ON CDTM_SITE_CATALOG_ID = ICSC_SITE_CATALOG_ID WHERE TCA_CASE_STS IN ('3', '6', '7') SELECT MRN AS "MRN", PRPT_ACCESSION_NO AS "Pathology Report", PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_DESC AS "Pathology Report Type", DT_DTE AS "Pathology Report Date" FROM WILLSJ.WILLSJ_SUR3936B JOIN DV.PATIENT_IDENTIFICATION_MRN_V ON MRN = PI_SOURCE_SYSTEM_PT_ID JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED ON PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V ON PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID JOIN DV.PATH_RPRT_TYPE_LOOKUP ON PRPT_REPORT_TYPE = PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_CD JOIN DV.DATE ON PRPT_REPORT_DATE_ID = DT_DATE_ID JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS ON PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID

prompt: Provide a list of patients seen in sarcoma 4 or more times between 1/1/2019 through today between the ages of 15-39
completion: WITH APPTS AS (SELECT CPE_MRN, CPE_ENC_CSN_ID, CPE_ENC_DTE, CRE_RES_TYP, CRE_RES_NAME, CVT_VISIT_TYP_ABBR, CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME, CLD_DEPT_NAME, CLD_CLD_CENTER, CLD_CLD_PHY_LOC, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_4, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON CPE_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN '2019-01-01' AND CURRENT date AND CRE_RES_TYP IN ('Physician', 'Advanced Practice Nurse', 'Physician Assistant') AND PT_DEATH_IND IN ('A', '') AND CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME IN ('SAR ACTIVE FR', 'SAR ACTIVE FX', 'SAR APP CH', 'SAR APP FR', 'SAR APP TX', 'SAR COVERING MD AFR', 'SAR COVERING MD AFX', 'SAR COVERING MD LFR', 'SAR COVERING MD LFX', 'SAR COVERING MD MDTX', 'SAR COVERING MD RES AFR', 'SAR COVERING MD RES LFR', 'SAR COVERIGN MD RES MDTX', 'SAR JOINT FR', 'SAR JOINT NV', 'SAR LONG TERM FR', 'SAR LONG TERM FX', 'SAR MD CH ', 'SAR MD TX', 'SAR RES ACTIVE FR', 'SAR RES LONG TERM FR', 'SAR RES MDTX', 'SAR TRANSFER FX', 'SAR IR1', 'SAR NV1', 'SAR NV3', 'SAR WALK IN IR1', 'PHONE FR', 'PHONE FX', 'PHONE IR ', 'PHONE MD CH ', 'PHONE MD TX ', 'PHONE NV', 'TELEHEALTH AFR', 'TELEHEALTH AFX', 'TELEHEALTH APP AFR', 'TELEHEALTH APP CH ', 'TELEHEALTH APP LFR', 'TELEHEALTH APP TX', 'TELEHEALTH FR', 'TELEHEALTH IR', 'TELEHEALTH LFR', 'TELEHEALTH MD CH', 'TELEHEALTH MD TX', 'TELEHEALTH NV ', 'TELEHEALTH WALK IN FR', 'TELEHEALTH POST OP', 'TELEHEALTH SAPP FR', 'TELEHEALTH SAPP IR', 'TELEHEALTH WALK IN FR', 'TELEHEALTH WALK IN NURSE ONLY', 'PEDSA ACTIVE FR', 'PEDSA ACTIVE FX', 'PEDSA APP ONLY', 'PEDSA FAMILY CONSULTS', 'PEDSA FELLOW ACTIVE FR', 'PEDSA FELLOW LONG TERM FR', 'PEDSA FELLOW MD TX', 'PEDSA FELLOW NV', 'PEDSA FELLOW PPAT', 'PEDSA LONG TERM FR', 'PEDSA MD TX', 'PEDSA NV', 'PEDSA PPAT ', 'AYASA ACTIVE FR', 'AYASA APP ONLY', 'AYASA FAMILY CONSULT ', 'AYASA IR', 'ASASA LONG TERM FR ', 'AYASA MD TX', 'AYASA NV', 'AYASA NV3', 'AYASA PPAT') ) , MAX_APPT_R AS (SELECT CPE_MRN, MAX(CPE_ENC_DTE) MAX_APPT_DTE FROM APPTS GROUP BY CPE_MRN) , MAX_APPT AS (SELECT CPE_MRN FROM MAX_APPT_R JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON CPE_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE YEAR(MAX_APPT_DTE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) BETWEEN 15 AND 39 ) , APPT_CNT AS (SELECT A.CPE_MRN, MIN(CASE WHEN CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 = 'MED' THEN CPE_ENC_DTE END) "First MED SAR date", MIN(CASE WHEN CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 = 'PED' THEN CPE_ENC_DTE END) "First PED SAR date", MAX(CPE_ENC_DTE) "Most recent SAR date", COUNT(DISTINCT CPE_ENC_CSN_ID) "Number of appts", COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN CPE_ENC_DTE >= '2020-03-01' AND (CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME like '%TELEH%' OR CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME like '%VIDEO%' OR CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME like '%PHONE%') THEN CPE_ENC_CSN_ID END) "Number of TeleHealth appts since 3/1/2020", COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN CPE_ENC_DTE >= '2020-03-01' AND NOT (CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME like '%TELEH%' OR CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME like '%VIDEO%' OR CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME like '%PHONE%') THEN CPE_ENC_CSN_ID END) "Number of In-Person appts since 3/1/2020" FROM APPTS A JOIN MAX_APPT MA ON A.CPE_MRN = MA.CPE_MRN GROUP BY A.CPE_MRN HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT CPE_ENC_CSN_ID) >= 4) , PRIM_PHY AS (SELECT CPE_MRN PP_MRN, CRE_RES_NAME PP_RES_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT CPE_ENC_CSN_ID) CNT, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CPE_MRN ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT CPE_ENC_CSN_ID) DESC) RN FROM APPTS WHERE CRE_RES_TYP = 'Physician' GROUP BY CPE_MRN, CRE_RES_NAME ) , CDB AS (SELECT TM_MRN, LISTAGG('AGE AT DX: ' || YEAR(TM_DX_DTE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) || ' ' || CHAR(TM_DX_DTE) || ': ' || TRIM(TM_SITE_CD) || ' ' || TRIM(S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK) || ' ' || TRIM(TM_HIST_CD) || ' ' || TRIM(H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK), CHR(13)||CHR(10)) TUMOR FROM (SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN FROM APPT_CNT) JOIN IDB.CDB_TUMOR ON CPE_MRN = TM_MRN JOIN IDB.CLM H ON TM_HIST_CD = H.CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON TM_SITE_CD = S.CLM_CLSF_CD JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON CPE_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND TM_HIST_CD IN ('M8033/3', 'M8074/3', 'M8122/3', 'M8710/3', 'M8800/3', 'M8800/9', 'M8801/3', 'M8802/3', 'M8803/3', 'M8804/3', 'M8805/3', 'M8806/3', 'M8810/3', 'M8811/3', 'M8812/3', 'M8813/3', 'M8814/3', 'M8825/3', 'M8830/3', 'M8832/3', 'M8833/3', 'M8840/3', 'M8850/3', 'M8851/3', 'M8852/3', 'M8853/3', 'M8854/3', 'M8855/3', 'M8857/3', 'M8858/3', 'M8860/3', 'M8890/3', 'M8891/3', 'M8894/3', 'M8895/3', 'M8896/3', 'M8900/3', 'M8901/3', 'M8902/3', 'M8910/3', 'M8912/3', 'M8920/3', 'M8921/3', 'M8930/3', 'M8931/3', 'M8933/3', 'M8935/3', 'M8936/3', 'M8963/3', 'M8964/3', 'M8980/3', 'M8981/3', 'M8991/3', 'M9020/3', 'M9040/3', 'M9041/3', 'M9042/3', 'M9043/3', 'M9044/3', 'M9051/3', 'M9120/3', 'M9124/3', 'M9140/3', 'M9150/3', 'M9170/3', 'M9180/3', 'M9181/3', 'M9182/3', 'M9183/3', 'M9184/3', 'M9185/3', 'M9186/3', 'M9187/3', 'M9190/3', 'M9192/3', 'M9193/3', 'M9194/3', 'M9195/3', 'M9220/3', 'M9221/3', 'M9230/3', 'M9231/3', 'M9240/3', 'M9242/3', 'M9243/3', 'M9250/3', 'M9260/3', 'M9290/3', 'M9330/3', 'M9342/3', 'M9364/3', 'M9442/3', 'M9473/3', 'M9480/3', 'M9481/3', 'M9539/3', 'M9540/3', 'M9561/3', 'M9581/3', 'M9592/3', 'M9593/3', 'M9610/3', 'M9631/3', 'M9640/3', 'M9642/3', 'M9662/3', 'M9738/3', 'M9740/3', 'M9755/3', 'M9756/3', 'M9757/3', 'M9758/3', 'M9850/3', 'M9930/3') GROUP BY TM_MRN ) , UPCOMING_APPT AS (SELECT CPE_MRN UP_MRN, CPE_ENC_DTE, CRE_RES_NAME, CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME, CLD_DEPT_NAME, CLD_CLD_CENTER, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6, CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CPE_MRN ORDER BY CPE_ENC_DTE) RN FROM (SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN MRN FROM APPT_CNT) JOIN IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER ON MRN = CPE_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN date - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) CURRENT_AGE, TUMOR, "First MED SAR date", "First PED SAR date", "Most recent SAR date", "Number of appts", "Number of TeleHealth appts since 3/1/2020", "Number of In-Person appts since 3/1/2020", PP_RES_NAME, UP.CPE_ENC_DTE NEXT_APPT_DATE, UP.CRE_RES_NAME NEXT_APPT_MD FROM APPT_CNT JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON CPE_MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN PRIM_PHY PP ON CPE_MRN = PP_MRN AND PP.RN = prompt: Modify MED22050 to help include the updates summarized below.
completion: SELECT DISTINCT "t1"."PT_MRN" AS "MRN" , PT_LAST_NAME AS "Last Name" , PT_FIRST_NAME AS "First Name" , "t2"."PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_DESC" AS "Pathology Report Type" , "t3"."DT_DTE" AS "Pathology Procedure Date" , "t4"."DT_DTE" AS "Pathology Report Date" , DATE(PRPT_CREATED_DT) AS "Created Date" , "t5"."PRPT_ACCESSION_NO" AS "Pathology Report" , VARCHAR(PRPT_REPORT, 32000) AS "Report Text" FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V" "t1" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED" "t6" ON "t1"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t6"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V" "t5" ON "t6"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t5"."PRPT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."PATH_RPRT_TYPE_LOOKUP" "t2" ON "t5"."PRPT_REPORT_TYPE" = "t2"."PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_CD" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" "t3" ON "t5"."PRPT_PROCEDURE_DATE_ID" = "t3"."DT_DATE_ID" LEFT JOIN "DV"."DATE_V" "t4" ON "t5"."PRPT_REPORT_DATE_ID" = "t4"."DT_DATE_ID" WHERE 1=1 AND "t2"."PRPTLK_PRPT_TYPE_DESC" IN ('Diagnostic Molecular Genetics', 'Diagnostic Molecular Pathology') AND CONTAINS("t5"."PRPT_REPORT", '"positive for flt3"') = 1 AND "t5"."PRPT_REPORT" IS NOT NULL AND (DATE(PRPT_CREATED_DT) >= CURRENT date - 8 DAYS OR PRPT_REPORT_DTE >= CURRENT date - 8 DAYS ) ORDER BY "t4"."DT_DTE" DESC ;

prompt: Provide a list of patients on oxaliplatin who got scalp cooling
completion: WITH APR AS (SELECT DISTINCT APR_MRN , TRIM(R.AV_DESC) AS RACE , TRIM(E.AV_DESC) AS ETHNICITY , MIN(APR_START_DTE) OVER (PARTITION BY APR_MRN) AS "START DATE OF DRUG" , MAX(APR_START_DTE) OVER (PARTITION BY APR_MRN) AS "END DATE OF DRUG" FROM IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX_V JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON APR_MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS R ON R.AV_ELEMENT = 'RACE' AND PT_RACE = R.AV_CODE LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS E ON E.AV_ELEMENT = 'PT_ETHNICITY' AND PT_PT_ETHNICITY = E.AV_CODE WHERE APR_START_DTE BETWEEN '2017-01-01' AND '2022-10-01' AND UPPER(CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME) LIKE ('%OXALIPLATIN%') ), SCA AS (SELECT CPE_MRN AS "MRN", CPE_ENC_DTE AS "Visit Date", CCH_CHEMO_NAME AS "Chemo Name" FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN APR ON APR_MRN = CPE_MRN JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON CPE_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_PT_CHEMO ON CPE_MRN=CPC_MRN AND CPE_ENC_DTE_SEQ=CPC_ENC_DTE_SEQ JOIN IDB.CL_CHEMO ON CPC_CHEMO_ID = CCH_CHEMO_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID WHERE CCH_CHEMO_NAME LIKE '%SCALP%' AND CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp') AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN '2017-01-01' AND '2022-10-01' ) SELECT DISTINCT APR_MRN , RACE , ETHNICITY , "START DATE OF DRUG" , "END DATE OF DRUG" , "Visit Date" , "Chemo Name" FROM APR JOIN SCA ON APR_MRN = MRN ; WITH APR AS (SELECT DISTINCT APR_MRN , TRIM(R.AV_DESC) AS RACE , TRIM(E.AV_DESC) AS ETHNICITY , MIN(APR_START_DTE) OVER (PARTITION BY APR_MRN) AS "START DATE OF DRUG" , MAX(APR_START_DTE) OVER (PARTITION BY APR_MRN) AS "END DATE OF DRUG" FROM IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX_V JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON APR_MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS R ON R.AV_ELEMENT = 'RACE' AND PT_RACE = R.AV_CODE LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS E ON E.AV_ELEMENT = 'PT_ETHNICITY' AND PT_PT_ETHNICITY = E.AV_CODE WHERE APR_START_DTE BETWEEN '2017-01-01' AND '2022-10-01' AND UPPER(CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME) LIKE ('%OXALIPLATIN%') ), ORD AS (SELECT OO_MRN AS "MRN", OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE AS "Visit Date", OO_SUMMARY_LINE AS "Chemo Name" FROM IDB.OMS_ORDER JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_CATALOG ON OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID = OOC_MSTR_ITEM_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_STATUS ON OO_ORD_STS_CD = OSTS_ORD_STS_CD WHERE UPPER(OO_SUMMARY_LINE) LIKE ('%SCALP%') AND OO_ORD_STS_CD NOT IN ('CANP', 'CANC', 'AUC3') AND OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE BETWEEN '2017-01-01' AND '2022-10-01' ) SELECT DISTINCT APR_MRN , RACE , ETHNICITY , "START DATE OF DRUG" , "END DATE OF DRUG" , "Visit Date" , "Chemo Name" FROM APR JOIN ORD ON APR_MRN = MRN ;

prompt: Provide a one-time list of pheochromocytoma patients who underwent adrenalectomy from 2019-present.
completion: WITH SURG AS (SELECT DISTINCT SSE_MRN , PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH "DATE OF BIRTH" , SSE_SURG_DTE "SURGERY DATE" , SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD "PROCEDURE CODE" , SSP_PROC_CPT4_DESC "PROCEDURE DESCRIPTION" , TRIM(G.AV_DESC) "GENDER" FROM IDB.PATIENT JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_EVENT ON SSE_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.SRG_SURG_PROCEDURE ON SSE_LOG_ID = SSP_LOG_ID LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS G ON G.AV_CODE = PT_SEX AND G.AV_ELEMENT = 'SEX' WHERE SSE_SURG_DTE BETWEEN '2019-01-01' AND CURRENT DATE AND SSP_PROC_CPT4_CD IN ('60540', '60545', '60650') ), PATH AS (SELECT DISTINCT PRPT_MRN, PRPT_PROCEDURE_DTE, UPPER(CASE WHEN LENGTH(PRPT_REPORT) <= 15000 THEN RTRIM(CAST(SUBSTR(PRPT_REPORT, 1, 15000) AS VARCHAR(15000))) ELSE CAST(SUBSTR(PRPT_REPORT, 1, 15000) AS VARCHAR(15000)) END) AS TXT FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V JOIN SURG ON SSE_MRN = PRPT_MRN WHERE PRPT_REPORT_TYPE_DESC = 'Surgical Pathology' AND PRPT_REPORT IS NOT NULL AND CONTAINS (PRPT_REPORT, 'pheochromocytoma') >= 1 ) SELECT DISTINCT SSE_MRN , "GENDER" , "DATE OF BIRTH" , "SURGERY DATE" , LA.AV_DESC AS "Laterality" , "PROCEDURE DESCRIPTION" , PRPT_PROCEDURE_DTE "PROCEDURE DATE" , TXT AS "PATHOLOGY REPORT" FROM SURG JOIN PATH ON SSE_MRN = PRPT_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.CDB_TUMOR ON SSE_MRN = TM_MRN AND TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS LA ON LA.AV_ELEMENT = 'LATERALITY_CD' AND LA.AV_CODE = TM_LATERALITY_CD

prompt: Provide carboplatin data and related data on patients enrolled in specified protocols.
completion: WITH CTE AS (SELECT DISTINCT "t1"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AS "Deident PT #", "t2"."PRO_IRB_NO" AS "IRB Number" FROM "DV"."PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED" "t1" JOIN "DV"."ACCRUALS" "t11" ON "t1"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t11"."AC_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" JOIN "DV"."PROTOCOL" "t2" ON "t11"."AC_PROTOCOL_ID" = "t2"."PRO_PROTOCOL_ID" JOIN "DV"."PHM_PT_MEDS_MQT" "t12" ON "t1"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t12"."POD_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" JOIN "DV"."PHM_INVENTORY_CATALOG" "t3" ON "t12"."POD_PHARMA_INVENTORY_CTLG_ID" = "t3"."PINC_INVENTORY_CTLG_ID" WHERE "t2"."PRO_IRB_NO" IN ('98-071', '94-068', '97-051', '04-047', '01-142', '08-026', '93-101', '99-092', '03-075') AND "t3"."PINC_GENERIC_NAME" IN ('CARBOPLATIN', 'CARBOplatin ') ) SELECT "IRB Number", "t5"."PT_MRN" AS "MRN", "t5"."PT_LAST_NAME" AS "Last Name", "t5"."PT_FIRST_NAME" AS "First Name", "t5"."PT_BIRTH_DTE" AS "Date of Birth", "t5"."PT_SEX" AS "Gender", "t3"."PINC_GENERIC_NAME" AS "Generic Drug Name", "t4"."DT_DTE" AS "Dispense Date", "t7"."POD_DOSE" AS "Normalized Dose", "t7"."POD_DOSE_UNIT" AS "Normalized Dose Unit", "t7"."POD_CALC_WT_KG" AS "Weight (kg)" FROM CTE JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED" "t1" ON CTE."Deident PT #" = "t1"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" JOIN "DV"."PHM_PT_MEDS_MQT" "t12" ON "t1"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t12"."POD_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" JOIN "DV"."PHM_INVENTORY_CATALOG" "t3" ON "t12"."POD_PHARMA_INVENTORY_CTLG_ID" = "t3"."PINC_INVENTORY_CTLG_ID" JOIN "DV"."PHM_ORDER_DTL" "t7" ON "t12"."POD_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t7"."POD_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AND "t12"."POD_PHARMA_INVENTORY_CTLG_ID" = "t7"."POD_PHARMA_INVENTORY_CTLG_ID" JOIN "DV"."PHM_ORDER_DISPENSE_OCCR" "t6" ON "t7"."POD_PHARMA_ORDER_DETAIL_ID" = "t6"."PDO_PHARMA_ORDER_DETAIL_ID" JOIN "DV"."DATE" "t4" ON "t6"."PDO_DISPNS_DATE_ID" = "t4"."DT_DATE_ID" JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V" "t5" ON "t1"."PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" = "t5"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" WHERE "t3"."PINC_GENERIC_NAME" IN ('CARBOPLATIN', 'CARBOplatin ', 'ETOPOSIDE', 'Etoposide ', 'Etoposide PHOSPHATE ') ORDER BY "IRB Number", "MRN", "t4"."DT_DTE", "t3"."PINC_GENERIC_NAME"

prompt: Provide mets, latest tx and fold change for MDM2 mutated pts
completion: WITH PTS AS (SELECT PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID PID FROM DV.PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED) , DT_1 AS (SELECT PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID AS P_ID FROM DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS REC LEFT JOIN DV.PATIENT_CORE_DEMOGRAPHICS ON PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = CORE_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID WHERE 1=1 ) , DT_2 AS (SELECT INC.PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID P_ID FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_STRUCTURED_RESULTS_V INC LEFT JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_STRUCTURED_RESULTS_V EX ON INC.PRPT_PATH_RPT_ID = EX.PRPT_PATH_RPT_ID AND EX.GENE IN ('TP53') JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML DT ON INC.PRPT_PATH_RPT_ID = DT.PDRX_PATH_RPT_ID CROSS JOIN XMLTABLE('$c/root/meta-data' PASSING DT.PDRX_XML_VALUE AS "c" COLUMNS PRIMARY_SITE VARCHAR(264) PATH 'primary_site', TUMOR_TYPE_NAME VARCHAR(264) PATH 'tumor_type_name' , TUMOR_TYPE_CODE VARCHAR(264) PATH 'tumor_type_code', IS_METASTASIS VARCHAR(3) PATH 'is_metastasis' , METASTASIS_SITE VARCHAR(264) PATH 'metastasis_site' , MSI_COMMENT VARCHAR(264) PATH 'msi-comment' , MSI_SCORE VARCHAR(264) PATH 'msi-score' , MSI_TYPE VARCHAR(264) PATH 'msi-type' , TMB_SCORE VARCHAR(25) PATH 'tmb_score' , TMB_COUNT VARCHAR(25) PATH 'tmb-count', COSMIC_ID VARCHAR(5000) PATH 'cosmic_id') T JOIN (SELECT T.TUMOR_TYPE_CODE TTC FROM TABLE(DV.STRING_SPLIT('NSCLC,GRC,BLAD,UA,UAD,PAAD,MEL', ',')) S CROSS JOIN TABLE(DV.ONCOTREE_CHILDREN(COLUMN_VALUES)) T) X ON T.TUMOR_TYPE_CODE = TRIM(X.TTC) WHERE 1=1 AND (INC.GENE IN ('MDM2') OR INC.GENE2 IN ('MDM2')) AND INC.FOLD_CHANGE <= 5 AND INC.FOLD_CHANGE >= 2 AND EX.PRPT_PATH_RPT_ID IS NULL ) , DT_3 AS (SELECT PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID AS P_ID FROM DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS REC LEFT JOIN DV.PATIENT_CORE_DEMOGRAPHICS ON PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = CORE_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID WHERE 1=1 AND PT_VITAL_STATUS IN ('ALIVE') AND YEAR(COALESCE(PT_DEATH_DTE, CURRENT date) - PT_BIRTH_DTE) >= 18 ) SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT P_ID) FROM (SELECT P_ID FROM DT_1 INTERSECT SELECT P_ID FROM DT_2 INTERSECT SELECT P_ID FROM DT_3 ) ; WITH PTS AS (SELECT PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID PID FROM DV.PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED) , DT_1 AS (SELECT PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID AS P_ID FROM DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS REC LEFT JOIN DV.PATIENT_CORE_DEMOGRAPHICS ON PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = CORE_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID WHERE 1=1 ) , DT_2 AS (SELECT INC.PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID P_ID FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_STRUCTURED_RESULTS_V INC LEFT JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_STRUCTURED_RESULTS_V EX ON INC.PRPT_PATH_RPT_ID = EX.PRPT_PATH_RPT_ID AND EX.GENE IN ('TP53') JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML DT ON INC.PRPT_PATH_RPT_ID = DT.PDRX_PATH_RPT_ID CROSS JOIN XMLTABLE('$c/root/meta-data' PASSING DT.PDRX_XML_VALUE AS "c" COLUMNS PRIMARY_SITE VARCHAR(264) PATH 'primary_site', TUMOR_TYPE_NAME VARCHAR(264) PATH 'tumor_type_name' , TUMOR_TYPE_CODE VARCHAR(264) PATH 'tumor_type_code', IS_METASTASIS VARCHAR(3) PATH 'is_metastasis' , METASTASIS_SITE VARCHAR(264) PATH 'metastasis_site' , MSI_COMMENT VARCHAR(264) PATH 'msi-comment' , MSI_SCORE VARCHAR(264) PATH 'msi-score' , MSI_TYPE VARCHAR(264) PATH 'msi-type' , TMB_SCORE VARCHAR(25) PATH 'tmb_score' , TMB_COUNT VARCHAR(25) PATH 'tmb-count', COSMIC_ID VARCHAR(5000) PATH 'cosmic_id') T LEFT JOIN (SELECT T.TUMOR_TYPE_CODE TTC FROM TABLE(DV.STRING_SPLIT('BRAIN', ',')) S CROSS JOIN TABLE(DV.ONCOTREE_CHILDREN(COLUMN_VALUES)) T) X ON T.TUMOR_TYPE_CODE = TRIM(X.TTC) WHERE 1=1 AND (' ' || LOWER(TUMOR_TYPE_NAME) || ' ' like '%' || LOWER(' sarcoma ') || '%') AND (INC.GENE IN ('MDM2') OR INC.GENE2 IN ('MDM2')) AND INC.FOLD_CHANGE > 0 AND EX.PRPT_PATH_RPT_ID IS NULL AND X.TTC IS NULL ) , DT_3 AS (SELECT PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID AS P_ID FROM DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS REC LEFT JOIN DV.PATIENT_CORE_DEMOGRAPHICS ON PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = CORE_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID WHERE 1=1 AND PT_VITAL_STATUS IN ('ALIVE') AND YEAR(COALESCE(PT_DEATH_DTE, CURRENT date) - PT_BIRTH_DTE) >= 18 ) SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT P_ID) FROM (SELECT P_ID FROM DT_1 INTERSECT SELECT P_ID FROM DT_2 INTERSECT SELECT P_ID FROM DT_3 ); WITH PTS AS (SELECT PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID PID FROM DV.PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED) , DT_1 AS (SELECT PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID AS P_ID FROM DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS REC LEFT JOIN DV.PATIENT_CORE_DEMOGRAPHICS ON PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = CORE_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID WHERE 1=1 ) , DT_2 AS (SELECT INC.PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID P_ID FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_STRUCTURED_RESULTS_V INC LEFT JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_STRUCTURED_RESULTS_V EX ON INC.PRPT_PATH_RPT_ID = EX.PRPT_PATH_RPT_ID AND EX.GENE IN ('TP53') JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML DT ON INC.PRPT_PATH_RPT_ID = DT.PDRX_PATH_RPT_ID CROSS JOIN XMLTABLE('$c/root/meta-data' PASSING DT.PDRX_XML_VALUE AS "c" COLUMNS PRIMARY_SITE VARCHAR(264) PATH 'primary_site', TUMOR_TYPE_NAME VARCHAR(264) PATH 'tumor_type_name' , TUMOR_TYPE_CODE VARCHAR(264) PATH 'tumor_type_code', IS_METASTASIS VARCHAR(3) PATH 'is_metastasis' , METASTASIS_SITE VARCHAR(264) PATH 'metastasis_site' , MSI_COMMENT VARCHAR(264) PATH 'msi-comment' , MSI_SCORE VARCHAR(264) PATH 'msi-score' , MSI_TYPE VARCHAR(264) PATH 'msi-type' , TMB_SCORE VARCHAR(25) PATH 'tmb_score' , TMB_COUNT VARCHAR(25) PATH 'tmb-count', COSMIC_ID VARCHAR(5000) PATH 'cosmic_id') T LEFT JOIN (SELECT T.TUMOR_TYPE_CODE TTC FROM TABLE(DV.STRING_SPLIT('BRAIN', ',')) S CROSS JOIN TABLE(DV.ONCOTREE_CHILDREN(COLUMN_VALUES)) T) X ON T.TUMOR_TYPE_CODE = TRIM(X.TTC) WHERE 1=1 AND NOT(' ' || LOWER(TUMOR_TYPE_NAME) || ' ' like '%' || LOWER(' sarcoma ') || '%') AND (INC.GENE IN ('MDM2') OR INC.GENE2 IN ('MDM2')) AND INC.FOLD_CHANGE >= 6 AND CASE WHEN LOCATE('heme', LOWER(INC.METHOD)) > 0 OR LOCATE('liquid', LOWER(INC.METHOD)) > 0 OR LOCATE('RDTB', INC.METHOD) >0 THEN 'liquid' ELSE 'solid' END IN ('solid') AND EX.PRPT_PATH_RPT_ID IS NULL AND X.TTC IS NULL ) , DT_3 AS (SELECT PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID AS P_ID FROM DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS REC LEFT JOIN DV.PATIENT_CORE_DEMOGRAPHICS ON PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = CORE_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID WHERE 1=1 AND PT_VITAL_STATUS IN ('ALIVE') AND YEAR(COALESCE(PT_DEATH_DTE, CURRENT date) - PT_BIRTH_DTE) >= 18 ) SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT P_ID) FROM (SELECT P_ID FROM DT_1 INTERSECT SELECT P_ID FROM DT_2 INTERSECT SELECT P_ID FROM DT_3 )

prompt: Provide a list of patients with the diagnosis code G93.82 (Brain Death) listed during their care between 1/1/2004- 1/31/2019.
completion: WITH DIAG AS (SELECT CC_MRN MRN, MIN(CC_EFF_DTE) AS FIRST_DX_DTE, CC_CLSF_CD AS ICD_9_10_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS ICD_9_10_DESC FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE CC_CLSF_CD IN ('G93.82', '348.82') GROUP BY CC_MRN, CC_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK ) SELECT DIAG.*, YEAR(FIRST_DX_DTE - PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH) AS AGE_AT_DX, PT_SEX, PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH, PT_DATE_OF_DEATH FROM DIAG JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON PT_MRN=MRN ; WITH PTS AS (SELECT DISTINCT CC_MRN MRN FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE CC_CLSF_CD IN ('G93.82', '348.82') ) SELECT TM_MRN, AV_DESC AS CASE_STS, TM_DX_DTE, TM_HIST_CD, H.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS HIST_DESC, TM_SITE_CD, S.CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK AS SITE_DESC FROM PTS JOIN IDB.CDB_TUMOR ON MRN=TM_MRN JOIN IDB.CLM H ON H.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_HIST_CD JOIN IDB.CLM S ON S.CLM_CLSF_CD = TM_SITE_CD JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS ON AV_ELEMENT = 'CASE_STS' AND AV_CODE = TM_CASE_STS AND TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8')

prompt: Provide a one-time report of patients admitted to the Lymphoma Inpatient Service from 2019 to 2021.
completion: WITH X AS (SELECT DISTINCT V.VIS_MRN, STRIP(PT_LAST_NAME) || ', ' || STRIP(PT_FIRST_NAME) AS NAME, V.VIS_ADM_NUM, V.VIS_ADM_DTE, V.VIS_DSCH_DTE, V.VIS_PATIENT_TYPE, V.ADM_DR_NAME, V.VIS_HOSP_SVC, V.HOSP_SVC_DESC, V.ADM_TYPE_DESC, V.TREATMENT_PLAN_DESC, ADMITTING_DIAGNOSIS, ADM_DIAG_DESC FROM IDB.VISIT_V V JOIN IDB.INPATIENT_ADMISSIONS_V ON V.VIS_ADM_NUM = ADMIT_ID JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON V.VIS_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE V.VIS_IP_OP_ADJUSTED_IND = 'I' AND V.VIS_VISIT_STATUS IN ('2', '3') AND V.VIS_ADM_DTE BETWEEN '2019-01-01' AND '2021-12-31' AND V.VIS_HOSP_SVC IN ('LYG', 'LYK') ) , RT AS (SELECT DISTINCT RTC_TX_MRN, VIS_ADM_DTE, VIS_DSCH_DTE, RTC_TX_PLAN_NAME, RTC_PRIMARY_REF_POINT, RTC_TX_START_DTE, RTC_TX_STOP_DTE, RTC_TX_ELAPSED_DAYS, RTC_TX_PLANNED_FRACTIONS, RTC_TX_DELIVERED_FRACTIONS, RTC_TX_PLANNED_DOSE, RTC_TX_DELIVERED_DOSE, RTC_DOSE_CORRECTION FROM X JOIN IDB.RADONC_TREATMENT_COURSE ON RTC_TX_MRN = VIS_MRN WHERE RTC_TX_START_DTE BETWEEN VIS_ADM_DTE AND VIS_DSCH_DTE OR RTC_TX_STOP_DTE BETWEEN VIS_ADM_DTE AND VIS_DSCH_DTE ) SELECT DISTINCT OO_MRN AS MRN, VIS_ADM_DTE, VIS_DSCH_DTE , OO_ORD_NAME, OOTO_SIGNIFIC_DTE FROM X JOIN IDB.OMS_ORDER ON OO_MRN = VIS_MRN AND OO_ADM_NUM = VIS_ADM_NUM LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_MED_DETAIL ON OO_ORD_GUID = OMD_ORD_GUID JOIN IDB.OAS_ORD_TASK_OCCR ON OOTO_ORD_GUID = OO_ORD_GUID AND OOTO_STATUS_CD = 'Performed' JOIN IDB.OAS_CTLG_ITEM_TASK ON OOTO_CAT_ITEM_GUID = OCIT_GUID AND OCIT_LEVEL_NO = 0 WHERE OO_ORD_STS_CD NOT IN ('CANC', 'CANP', 'AUC3') AND OOTO_SIGNIFIC_DTE BETWEEN VIS_ADM_DTE AND VIS_DSCH_DTE AND(UPPER(OO_ORD_NAME) LIKE '%TAFASITAMAB%' OR UPPER(OO_ORD_NAME) LIKE '%LENALIDOMIDE%' OR UPPER(OO_ORD_NAME) LIKE '%RITUXIMAB%' OR UPPER(OO_ORD_NAME) LIKE '%POLATUZUMAB%')

prompt: Provide data on patients at regional sites who have not completed the RO STATUS CHECK MSK Engage survey.
completion: SELECT AC_MRN, CPE_APPT_DT AS "Appt Date", CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 AS "Department", CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_8 AS "Service", CLD_DEPT_NAME AS "Department Name", CRE_RES_NAME AS "Provider Name", CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME AS "Visit Type" FROM IDB.ACCRUALS JOIN IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER ON CPE_MRN = AC_MRN JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID JOIN IDB.CL_DEPT ON CPE_DEPT_ID = CLD_DEPT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_VISIT_TYPE ON CPE_VISIT_TYPE_ID = CVT_VISIT_TYP_ID JOIN IDB.EF_ASSESSMENT ON EA_SOURCE_ID = CPE_ENC_CSN_ID AND EA_SURV_ID = '60' WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS IN ('Arrived', 'Comp', 'Sch') AND CLD_CLD_RPT_GRP_6 = 'RDO' AND CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT date - 10 DAYS AND CURRENT date + 10 DAYS AND CVT_VISIT_TYP_NAME = 'RO STATUS CHECK' AND AC_IRB_NO = '19-300' AND EA_SUBM_DT IS NULL

prompt: Can you pull the IR protocol biopsy referral requests that are placed in CIS?
completion: WITH ORD AS (SELECT OO_MRN, TRIM(PT_LAST_NAME) || ', ' || TRIM(PT_FIRST_NAME) AS PATIENT_NAME, OO_ORD_GUID, OO_ENTER_DTE, OO_ENTER_ROLE, OU_DISPLAY_NAME, P.OUD_USER_DI_VALUE AS IRB_NO, A.OUD_USER_DI_CD, A.OUD_USER_DI_VALUE FROM IDB.OMS_ORDER JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON OO_MRN = PT_MRN JOIN IDB.OMS_USER ON OO_USER_GUID = OU_USER_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_USER_DATA A ON A.OUD_ORD_GUID = OO_ORD_GUID AND (A.OUD_USER_DI_CD IN ('IR_Specimen Pick Up Person', 'IR_Specimen Pick Up Person#', 'IR_Study CRC', 'IR_Study CRC Beeper #') OR A.OUD_USER_DI_CD like 'IR_Sample%' OR A.OUD_USER_DI_CD like 'IR_Media%' OR A.OUD_USER_DI_CD like 'IR_Path Destination%') JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_USER_DATA P ON P.OUD_ORD_GUID = OO_ORD_GUID AND P.OUD_USER_DI_CD = 'RIS_IR-Biopsy Purpose Protocol' WHERE OO_MSTR_ITEM_GUID = '9000008158100730' AND OO_ORD_STS_CD NOT IN ('CANP', 'CANC', 'AUC3') AND OO_ENTER_DTE >= '2020-02-25' ) SELECT OO_MRN AS MRN , PATIENT_NAME , IRB_NO , OO_ORD_GUID AS ORD_GUID , OO_ENTER_DTE ENTER_DTE , OO_ENTER_ROLE ENTER_ROLE , OU_DISPLAY_NAME ENTERING_USER , OUD_USER_DI_CD FORM_FIELD , OUD_USER_DI_VALUE FORM_VALUE FROM ORD

prompt: Requesting a progress report demographics for U01 grant related to protocol
