"DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AS SUBJECT_ID FROM "IDB"."PATIENT" AS IDB_PATIENT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS" ON IDB_PATIENT."PT_MRN" = "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_MRN" WHERE IDB_PATIENT."PT_MRN" IN ('00360910', '00029219', '35506150', '35106645', '35295654', '35356051', '35354962', '35339996', '35397867', '00506348', '00302189', '35373446', '35403340', '35077538', '35487421', '35496394', '35327241', '00513699', '35299995', '00375161', '38073430', '35283663', '00352555', '38020718', '35256919', '35370440', '38127027', '35484363', '35548462', '35428300', '35473401', '38001113', '35025181', '00584922', '00697172', '35247737', '38016585', '38158971', '35487279', '35553636', '35423251', '35582957', '35296719', '38053838', '35456339', '35225763', '35181980', '38219161', '35200243', '35553802', '35364552', '35338350', '35050295', '38183698', '38202253', '38001113', '35541552')), COHORT AS (SELECT PT_DEID AS PT_DEID FROM (SELECT DEMOGRAPHICS_0.PT_DEID AS PT_DEID FROM DEMOGRAPHICS_0)), KEYS AS (SELECT COHORT.PT_DEID AS COHORT_PT_DEID FROM COHORT), DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS AS (SELECT DISTINCT "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AS PT_DEID, IDB_PATIENT."PT_MRN" AS PT_MRN, "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID" AS SUBJECT_ID, IDB_PATIENT."PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH" AS DATE_OF_BIRTH, ALLOWVALS_RACE."AV_DESC" AS RACE, ALLOWVALS_ETHNICITY."AV_DESC" AS ETHNICITY FROM "IDB"."PATIENT" AS IDB_PATIENT JOIN "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS" ON IDB_PATIENT."PT_MRN" = "DV"."PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS"."PT_MRN" LEFT OUTER JOIN "IDB"."ALLOWVALS" AS ALLOWVALS_RACE ON IDB_PATIENT."PT_RACE" = ALLOWVALS_RACE."AV_CODE" AND ALLOWVALS_RACE."AV_ELEMENT" = 'RACE' LEFT OUTER JOIN "IDB"."ALLOWVALS" AS ALLOWVALS_ETHNICITY ON IDB_PATIENT."PT_PT_ETHNICITY" = ALLOWVALS_ETHNICITY."AV_CODE" AND ALLOWVALS_ETHNICITY."AV_ELEMENT" = 'PT_ETHNICITY') SELECT DISTINCT DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS.PT_MRN AS MRN, DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS.DATE_OF_BIRTH AS DATE_OF_BIRTH, DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS.RACE AS RACE, DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS.ETHNICITY AS ETHNICITY FROM KEYS LEFT OUTER JOIN DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS ON DEMOGRAPHICS_COLUMNS.PT_DEID = KEYS.COHORT_PT_DEID;

prompt: Provide TUMOR_VFREQ from the IMPACT results for the provided list of patients.
completion: SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN, PDRX_ACCESSION_NO, T.* FROM DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS JOIN DV.PATHOLOGY_DMP_RESULTS_XML DT ON PDRX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID CROSS JOIN XMLTABLE('$c/root/*' PASSING DT.PDRX_XML_VALUE AS "c" COLUMNS GENE_ID VARCHAR(100) PATH 'gene_id', TUMOR_VFREQ VARCHAR(100) PATH 'tumor_vfreq', DT_PROCEDURE VARCHAR(40) PATH '../meta-data/dt_procedure') T

prompt: Provide accession numbers and text for radiology reports showing active bleeding in the last two years
completion: SELECT RRPT_MRN AS "MRN", RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE AS "Performed date", RRPT_DV_PROCESS_DTE AS "Processed date", RRPT_RPT_ID AS "Report ID", RRPT_ACCESSION_NO AS "Accession number", RRPT_ORDER_GROUP AS "Order group", RRPT_PROCEDURE_NAME AS "Procedure name", RRPT_ANC_CODE AS "ANC Code", RRPT_REPORT_TXT AS "Report text" FROM DV.RADIOLOGY_REPORT_V WHERE RRPT_PERFORMED_DTE >= '2018-01-01' AND (LOWER(RRPT_REPORT_TXT) like '%contrast extravastion%' OR LOWER(RRPT_REPORT_TXT) LIKE '%active gastrointestinal bleeding%' OR LOWER(RRPT_REPORT_TXT) LIKE '%active gi bleeding%' OR LOWER(RRPT_REPORT_TXT) LIKE '%active hemorrhage%' OR LOWER(RRPT_REPORT_TXT) LIKE '%active bleeding%') AND RRPT_PROCEDURE_NAME NOT IN ('ANGIO Lower Ext w&w/o Con, Left', 'ANGIO Lower Ext w&w/o Con, Right', 'ANGIO Lower Ext w&w/o Con, Right', 'ANGIO Neck w/&w/o Con', 'Brain w/o Con', 'Breast Right', 'Chest R/O PE', 'Chest w/ Con', 'Chest w/o Con', 'Chest w/o Con', 'CT ANGIO BILATERAL LOWER EXT', 'CT ANGIO HEAD', 'CT ANGIO NECK W/WO CON', 'GI Bleeding Imaging', 'Kidney Protocol w/ Pelvis', 'Kidney Protocol w/ Pelvis', 'Lower Extremity w/ Con, Left', 'Lower Extremity w/ Con, Right', 'Neck w/ Con', 'Urogram', 'Venogram Chest w/ Con') AND RRPT_PROCEDURE_NAME NOT LIKE 'IR%'

prompt: We are looking for number of visits that have CPTs 10000-69999 coded. We would like the volume of each CPT for the last 6 months.
completion: WITH CTE1 AS (SELECT YEAR(CC_EFF_DTE) AS YR, MONTH(CC_EFF_DTE) AS EFF_MONTH, CC_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK, COUNT(*) AS FREQUENCY FROM IDB.CTC_VISIT LEFT OUTER JOIN IDB.CTC_CLSF ON ((CC_VISIT_ID=CV_VISIT_ID) AND (CC_MRN=CV_MRN)) LEFT OUTER JOIN IDB.CLM ON (CLM_CLSF_CD = CC_CLSF_CD) WHERE CC_EFF_DTE BETWEEN LAST_DAY(CURRENT DATE - 7 MONTH) + 1 DAY AND LAST_DAY(CURRENT DATE - 1 MONTH) AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y' AND CV_CODING_STS = 'C' AND SUBSTR(CC_CLSF_CD, 1, 5) BETWEEN '10000' AND '69999' AND CC_CLSF_TYPE = 'PHH' AND CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' GROUP BY YEAR(CC_EFF_DTE), MONTH(CC_EFF_DTE), CC_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK) , CTE2 AS (SELECT CC_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK, MAX(CASE WHEN EFF_MONTH = 1 THEN FREQUENCY END) "Jan", MAX(CASE WHEN EFF_MONTH = 2 THEN FREQUENCY END) "Feb", MAX(CASE WHEN EFF_MONTH = 3 THEN FREQUENCY END) "Mar", MAX(CASE WHEN EFF_MONTH = 4 THEN FREQUENCY END) "Apr", MAX(CASE WHEN EFF_MONTH = 5 THEN FREQUENCY END) "May", MAX(CASE WHEN EFF_MONTH = 6 THEN FREQUENCY END) "Jun", MAX(CASE WHEN EFF_MONTH = 7 THEN FREQUENCY END) "Jul", MAX(CASE WHEN EFF_MONTH = 8 THEN FREQUENCY END) "Aug", MAX(CASE WHEN EFF_MONTH = 9 THEN FREQUENCY END) "Sep", MAX(CASE WHEN EFF_MONTH = 10 THEN FREQUENCY END) "Oct", MAX(CASE WHEN EFF_MONTH = 11 THEN FREQUENCY END) "Nov", MAX(CASE WHEN EFF_MONTH = 12 THEN FREQUENCY END) "Dec", SUM(FREQUENCY) AS TOTAL FROM CTE1 GROUP BY CC_CLSF_CD, CLM_CLSF_DESC_MSK) SELECT * FROM CTE2 ORDER BY 1

prompt: Lymphoma patients consented to protocol 12-245 between 2014 and March 2019
completion: WITH PRO AS (SELECT TRIM(CRDB.PT_MRN) MRN, TRIM(PT.LAST_NAME) "Last Name", TRIM(PT.FIRST_NAME) "First Name", PT_SEX, R.AV_DESC AS RACE, E.AV_DESC AS ETHNICITY, CRDB.PRT_ID "Protocol", MAX(CASE WHEN REG_ID = '100' THEN CRDB.CONSENT_PRFSNL END) "Part A Consenting Professional", MAX(CASE WHEN REG_ID = '100' THEN CRDB.CRNT_CONSENT_DATE END) "Part A Consent Date" FROM NN.CRDB_DASH_PT_REG CRDB JOIN NN.CRDB_DASH_PT PT ON CRDB.PRT_ID = PT.PRT_ID AND CRDB.PT_MRN = PT.PT_MRN JOIN IDB.PATIENT P ON CRDB.PT_MRN = P.PT_MRN LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS R ON PT_RACE = R.AV_CODE AND R.AV_ELEMENT = 'RACE' LEFT JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS E ON PT_PT_ETHNICITY = E.AV_CODE AND E.AV_ELEMENT = 'PT_ETHNICITY' WHERE CRDB.PRT_ID = '12-245' AND REG_ID IN ('100') AND CRNT_ELGBL_STATUS_DSCRP NOT IN ('Ineligible', 'Cancel') GROUP BY TRIM(CRDB.PT_MRN), TRIM(PT.LAST_NAME), PT_SEX, R.AV_DESC, E.AV_DESC, TRIM(PT.FIRST_NAME), CRDB.PRT_ID HAVING MAX(CASE WHEN REG_ID = '100' THEN CRDB.CRNT_CONSENT_DATE END) BETWEEN '2014-01-01' AND '2019-03-31') SELECT MRN, "Last Name", "First Name", PT_SEX "Gender", RACE, ETHNICITY, "Protocol", "Part A Consenting Professional", "Part A Consent Date", CATEGORY1 "SEER Category", CATEGORY2 "SEER Sub-category", CATEGORY3 "SEER Sub-sub-category" FROM PRO JOIN IDB.CDB_TUMOR ON MRN = TM_MRN JOIN DV.SEERGROUPING ON DV.SEERF_ICDO(TM_SITE_CD, TM_HIST_CD) = RECODE WHERE TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') AND CATEGORY1 = 'Lymphoma'

prompt: Provide referral and diagnostic data for physical therapy outpatient routine, occupational therapy outpatient routine and lymphedema therapy outpatient consult referrals.
completion: SELECT OUO_MRN MRN, OUO_ENTER_DTE AS ENTER_DATE, OUO_PVDR_NAME AS PROVIDER, OUO_PVDR_ROLE_TYPE AS PROV_TYPE , COALESCE(RQD.DOC_ACDMC_SVC, ATD.DOC_ACDMC_SVC) SVC, COALESCE(RQD.DOC_ACDMC_DPT, ATD.DOC_ACDMC_DPT) DEPT, OUO_ORD_NAME AS ORDER_NAME, CR.OUD_USER_DI_VALUE AS DIAGNOSIS, MD.OUD_USER_DI_VALUE AS REASON , STRIP(OUO_ORD_STS_CD)||'-'||STRIP(OUO_STS_DESC) STATUS FROM IDB.OMS_USER_ORDERS JOIN IDB.OMS_ORDER ON OUO_ORD_GUID = OO_ORD_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_PROVIDER REQ ON REQ.OP_PVDR_GUID = OO_PVDR_GUID LEFT JOIN IDB.DOC RQD ON RQD.DOC_DR_NO = REQ.OP_PVDR_NO AND RQD.DOC_SOURCE_DESC = 'SMS' JOIN IDB.OMS_PROVIDER ATT ON OUO_ATN_PVDR_NAME = ATT.OP_DISPLAY_NAME JOIN IDB.DOC ATD ON ATD.DOC_DR_NO = ATT.OP_PVDR_NO AND ATD.DOC_SOURCE_DESC = 'SMS' LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_USER_DATA CR ON CR.OUD_ORD_GUID = OO_ORD_GUID AND CR.OUD_USER_DI_CD IN ('Cancer Diagnosis', 'RDO_Clin Dx') LEFT JOIN IDB.OMS_ORD_USER_DATA MD ON MD.OUD_ORD_GUID = OO_ORD_GUID AND MD.OUD_USER_DI_CD IN ('REHAB_Reason_OT_Outpatient', 'Rehab_Lymphed_Referral', 'Rehab_Reson2') WHERE OUO_ENTER_DTE BETWEEN '2010-05-01' AND '2011-04-06' AND OUO_ORD_NAME IN ('Occupational Therapy Outpatient' , 'Lymphedema Therapy Outpatient Consult', 'Physical Therapy Outpatient') AND OUO_ORD_STS_CD NOT IN ('CANC', 'CANP') AND OUO_STS_DESC IN ('Active', 'Completed/Expired')

prompt: Please provide the number of unique patients with the words "plasmacytoid" AND "urothelial" in the pathology report between 2010 - present dat.
completion: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT PRPT_MRN) FROM DV.PATHOLOGY_REPORT_V WHERE CONTAINS(PRPT_REPORT, '"plasmacytoid" & "urothelial"') = 1 AND PRPT_REPORT_DTE >= '2010-01-01'

prompt: Provide a list of patients who will be starting BCG the following week. I would like to receive this query the Friday before the following week.
completion: WITH CLINTRAC AS (SELECT CC_MRN FROM IDB.CTC_CLSF JOIN IDB.CLM ON CC_CLSF_CD = CLM_CLSF_CD WHERE (SUBSTR(CC_CLSF_CD, 1, 3) = 'C67' OR CC_CLSF_CD IN ('D09.0', 'D41.4', 'D49.4', 'C79.1', 'C79.11')) AND CC_CLSF_TYPE LIKE 'DF%' AND (CC_PT_TYPE = 'I' OR (CC_PT_TYPE = 'O' AND CC_FINALIZED_IND = 'Y')) ) , TUMOR AS (SELECT TM_MRN FROM IDB.CDB_TUMOR JOIN IDB.ALLOWVALS ON AV_ELEMENT = 'CASE_STS' AND AV_CODE = TM_CASE_STS AND TM_CASE_STS IN ('1', '3', '6', '7', '8') WHERE SUBSTR(TM_SITE_CD, 1, 3) = 'C67' ) SELECT DISTINCT CPE_MRN AS MRN , TRIM(PT_LAST_NAME) CONCAT ', ' CONCAT TRIM(PT_FIRST_NAME) AS PATIENT_NAME , MIN(CPE_ENC_DTE) AS NEXT_APPT_DTE FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.CL_RESOURCE ON CPE_VST_RES_ID = CRE_RES_ID AND CPE_CPE_APPT_STS = 'Sch' AND CPE_CPE_IP_IND <> 'INPATIENT' AND CRE_RES_TYP = 'Chemotherapy Unit' JOIN IDB.CL_PT_CHEMO ON CPE_CL_PT_ID = CPC_CL_PT_ID JOIN IDB.CL_CHEMO ON CPC_CHEMO_ID = CCH_CHEMO_ID JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON CPE_MRN = PT_MRN LEFT JOIN CLINTRAC ON CPE_MRN = CC_MRN LEFT JOIN TUMOR ON CPE_MRN = TM_MRN WHERE CPE_ENC_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT date + 3 DAYS AND CURRENT date + 11 DAYS AND CCH_CHEMO_NAME = 'BCG' AND CPE_MRN NOT IN (SELECT APR_MRN FROM IDB.ANTINEOPLASTIC_PT_RX_V WHERE CDG_COMMON_GENERIC_NAME = 'BCG') AND COALESCE(TM_MRN, CC_MRN) IS NOT NULL GROUP BY CPE_MRN , TRIM(PT_LAST_NAME) CONCAT ', ' CONCAT TRIM(PT_FIRST_NAME)

prompt: Provide a daily report for today's and tomorrow's clinic patients with  drugs listed in Pharmacy Profile CHEMO and dexamethasone and/or dexamethasone Na Phos (IVPB) listed in Pharmacy Profile Supportive CHEMO
completion: WITH SCHVST AS (SELECT CPE_MRN MRN, CPE_ENC_DTE CURR_VST_DTE , PT_LAST_NAME LAST_NAME , PT_FIRST_NAME FIRST_NAME , PT_DATE_OF_BIRTH DOB, PT_SEX SEX FROM IDB.CL_PT_ENCOUNTER JOIN IDB.PATIENT ON CPE_MRN = PT_MRN WHERE CPE_CPE_APPT_STS = 'Sch' AND CPE_ENC_DTE >= CURRENT date AND CPE_ENC_DTE <= (CASE WHEN DAYOFWEEK(CURRENT DATE) = 6 THEN CURRENT date + 3 DAY ELSE CURRENT date + 1 DAY END) AND CPE_VST_RES_ID = '011569' ) SELECT MRN , UCASE(CASE WHEN PIN_GENERIC_NAME = '' THEN PIN_ITEM_NAME ELSE PIN_GENERIC_NAME END) AS DRUG_NAME , MAX(POD_STRT_DTE) AS CM_START_DATE , MAX(POD_STOP_DTE) AS CM_STOP_DATE , SUM(POI_DOSE) AS TOTAL_DOSE , POI_DOSE_UNIT AS DOSE_UNIT FROM SCHVST JOIN IDB.PHM_ORDER ON MRN = PO_MRN JOIN IDB.PHM_ORD_DTL ON PO_ORD_SEQ = POD_ORD_SEQ JOIN IDB.PHM_ORD_INV ON POD_ORD_SEQ = POI_ORD_SEQ AND POD_ITEM_NO = POI_ITEM_NO JOIN IDB.PHM_INVENTORY ON POI_INV_SEQ = PIN_INV_SEQ AND (PIN_ATT_FLAG LIKE '%CHEMO%' OR (PIN_ATT_FLAG LIKE '%SUPONC%' AND UPPER(PIN_GENERIC_NAME) LIKE '%DEXAMETHA%')) WHERE POD_STRT_DTE <= CURRENT DATE AND PO_ORD_STS NOT IN ('X', 'P') GROUP BY MRN, CASE WHEN PIN_GENERIC_NAME = '' THEN PIN_ITEM_NAME ELSE PIN_GENERIC_NAME END, POI_DOSE_UNIT

prompt: Weekly report of Glucose, Whole Blood, Glucose, Plasma and Fingerstick Insulin orders including order set and order summary
completion: SELECT DISTINCT OO_MRN MRN , OO_PERFORMED_DT PERFORMED_DT, LR_PERFORMED_DT SPECIMEN_COLLECTION, OO_ORD_STS_CD ORDER_STATUS, OO_ORD_ID ORDER_ID, OO_ORD_NAME ORDER_NAME , LR_RESULT_VALUE RESULT_VALUE, LR_UNIT_MEASURE UOM, OO_REQ_TME_PRIO TIME_PRIO, OP_DISPLAY_NAME ATTENDING, OP_DISCIPLINE, OP_PROV_TYPE ATTENDING_ROLE, DOC_NAME REQUESTED_BY , DOC_ACDMC_SVC REQUESTED_BY_SVC, OL_LOC_NAME PATIENT_LOCATION, OS_SVC_GRP_CD SVC_GROUP, OS_SVC_DESC SVC_DESC FROM IDB.OMS_ORDER JOIN IDB.LAB_RESULTS ON OO_MRN = LR_MRN AND OO_ORD_GUID = LR_ORD_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_CLIENT_VISIT ON OO_VISIT_GUID = OCV_VISIT_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_PROVIDER ON OCV_ATT_PVDR_GUID = OP_PVDR_GUID JOIN IDB.DOC ON OO_REQ_DR_NO = DOC_DR_NO JOIN IDB.OMS_SERVICE ON OCV_SVC_GUID = OS_SVC_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_VISIT_LOCATION ON OVL_VISIT_GUID = OCV_VISIT_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_LOCATION ON OVL_LOC_GUID = OL_LOC_GUID WHERE OO_SIGNIFICANT_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT date - 7 DAY AND CURRENT date - 1 DAY AND OO_ORD_STS_CD like 'RE%' AND(UPPER(LR_TEST_NAME) like '%GLUCOSE%' OR UPPER(LR_SUBTEST_NAME) like '%GLUCOSE%') AND OVL_VISIT_LOC_GUID = (SELECT MAX(OVL_VISIT_LOC_GUID) FROM IDB.OMS_VISIT_LOCATION WHERE OVL_VISIT_GUID = OO_VISIT_GUID AND LR_PERFORMED_DT BETWEEN OVL_EFF_DT AND OVL_CHNG_DT) ; SELECT DISTINCT OO_MRN MRN, CASE WHEN (OO_ORD_NAME) = 'Fingerstick/Blood Glucose' THEN 'Fingerstick' WHEN (OO_ORD_NAME) LIKE 'Insulin INJ%' OR (OO_ORD_NAME) LIKE 'Insulin Pump%' OR (OO_ORD_NAME) LIKE 'Insulin REGULAR%' THEN 'Insulin Regular' WHEN (OO_ORD_NAME) LIKE 'Insulin Sliding Scal%' THEN 'Insulin Sliding Scale' END ORDER_GRP, OO_ORD_ID ORDERID, OO_ORD_NAME ORDNAME, OO_SET_NAME SET_NAME, OO_SUMMARY_LINE SUMMARY_LINE, OOTO_SIGNIFIC_DT "Performed DT", OOTO_TASK_DOSE DOSE, OOTO_TASK_UOM UOM , OUO_REQ_TME_PRIO TIME_PRIO, OUO_PVDR_NAME REQUESTED_BY, OUO_PVDR_ROLE_TYPE REQUESTEDBY_ROLE, OP_DISPLAY_NAME ATTENDING, OP_DISCIPLINE, OP_PROV_TYPE ATTENDING_ROLE, OP_DISPLAY_NAME, OP_DISCIPLINE, OP_TASK_ROLE_TYPE, OL_LOC_NAME PATIENT_LOCATION, OS_SVC_GRP_CD SVC_GROUP, OS_SVC_DESC SVC_DESC FROM IDB.OAS_ORD_TASK_OCCR JOIN IDB.OMS_USER_ORDERS ON OOTO_ORD_GUID = OUO_ORD_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_ORDER ON OOTO_ORD_GUID = OO_ORD_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_CLIENT_VISIT ON OO_VISIT_GUID = OCV_VISIT_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_PROVIDER ON OCV_ATT_PVDR_GUID = OP_PVDR_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_SERVICE ON OCV_SVC_GUID = OS_SVC_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_VISIT_LOCATION ON OVL_VISIT_GUID = OCV_VISIT_GUID JOIN IDB.OMS_LOCATION ON OVL_LOC_GUID = OL_LOC_GUID JOIN IDB.OAS_CTLG_ITEM_TASK ON OOTO_CAT_ITEM_GUID = OCIT_GUID AND OCIT_LEVEL_NO = 0 WHERE OOTO_SIGNIFIC_DTE BETWEEN CURRENT date - 7 DAY AND CURRENT date - 1 DAY AND OOTO_STATUS_CD = 'Performed' AND (UPPER(OO_ORD_NAME) LIKE '%INSULIN%' OR UPPER(OO_ORD_NAME) LIKE 'FINGERSTICK%') AND OVL_VISIT_LOC_GUID = (SELECT MAX(OVL_VISIT_LOC_GUID) FROM IDB.OMS_VISIT_LOCATION WHERE OVL_VISIT_GUID = OO_VISIT_GUID AND OOTO_SIGNIFIC_DT BETWEEN OVL_EFF_DT AND OVL_CHNG_DT) ORDER BY OO_MRN, OOTO_SIGNIFIC_DT , CASE WHEN (OO_ORD_NAME) = 'Fingerstick/Blood Glucose' THEN 'Fingerstick' WHEN (OO_ORD_NAME) LIKE 'Insulin INJ%' OR (OO_ORD_NAME) LIKE 'Insulin Pump%' OR (OO_ORD_NAME) LIKE 'Insulin REGULAR%' THEN 'Insulin Regular' WHEN (OO_ORD_NAME) LIKE 'Insulin Sliding Scal%' THEN 'Insulin Sliding Scale' END;

prompt: Provide all KRAS molecular pathology results for patients with colon or rectal cancer and (group 1) brain metastases or (group 2) bone metastases.
completion: WITH CDB AS (SELECT DISTINCT PT_MRN AS "MRN", DT_DTE AS "Tumor Diagnosis Date", DXCC_ICD_CODE AS "ICD-O Histology Code", DXCC_ICD_MSK_DESC AS "ICD-O Histology Description", ICSC_SITE_CD AS "ICD-O Site Code", ICSC_ICDO_SITE_MSK_DESC AS "ICD-O Site Description" FROM DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED ON PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID JOIN DV.CDB_TUMOR_V ON PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = CDTM_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID JOIN DV.DIAGNOSIS_CODE_CAT_ICDO_V ON CDTM_DX_CATALOG_ID = DXCC_DX_CATALOG_ID JOIN DV.ICDO_SITE_CATALOG_V ON CDTM_SITE_CATALOG_ID = ICSC_SITE_CATALOG_ID JOIN DV.DATE_V ON CDTM_DX_DATE_ID = DT_DATE_ID WHERE ICSC_SITE_CD IN ('C182', 'C183', 'C184', 'C185', 'C186', 'C187', 'C188', 'C189', 'C199', 'C209', 'C218') ), ICD9 AS (SELECT PT_MRN AS "MRN", MIN(DT_DTE) AS "Min Colorectal Cancer ICD-9 Date" FROM DV.PATIENT_DEMOGRAPHICS_V JOIN DV.PATIENT_DEIDENTIFIED ON PT_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID JOIN DV.PATIENT_DIAGNOSIS_FINAL_ALL_V ON PDI_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID = PDX_PT_DEIDENTIFICATION_ID JOIN DV.DATE_V ON PDX_DX_DATE_ID = DT_DATE_ID JOIN DV.DIAGNOSIS_CATALOG ON PDX_DX_CATALOG_ID = DXCC_DX_CATALOG_ID AND DXCC_DX_TYPE = 'ICD9' WHERE DXCC_ICD_CODE IN ('153', '153.0', '153.1', '153.2', '153.3', '153.4', '153.6', '153.7', '153.8', '153.9', '154', '154.0',
